INFORMATION.title: BIBLE
INFORMATION.subject: Holy Bible
INFORMATION.description: TAMIL BIBLE transcribed in roman script (Beta)
INFORMATION.coverage: provide the Bible to the nations of the world

CHAPTER.VERS: aathiyilea theavan vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum sirushdiththaar.
poomiyaanathu ozhungkinmaiyum ve'rumaiyumaay irunthathu; aazhaththinmeal iru'l irunthathu; theava aaviyaanavar jalaththinmeal asaivaadikko'ndirunthaar.
theavan ve'lichcham u'ndaakakkadavathu en'raar, ve'lichcham u'ndaayit'ru.
ve'lichcham nallathu en'ru theavan ka'ndaar; ve'lichchaththaiyum iru'laiyum theavan vevvea'raakap piriththaar.
theavan ve'lichchaththukkup pakal en'ru pearittaar, iru'lukku iravu en'ru pearittaar; saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki muthalaam naa'l aayit'ru.
pinpu theavan: jalaththin maththiyil aakaayavirivu u'ndaakakkadavathu en'rum, athu jalaththinin'ru jalaththaip pirikkakkadavathu en'rum sonnaar.
theavan aakaayavirivai u'ndu pa'n'ni, aakaayavirivukkuk keezhea irukki'ra jalaththi'rkum aakaayavirivukku mealea irukki'ra jalaththi'rkum pirivu'ndaakkinaar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.
theavan aakaayavirivukku vaanam en'ru pearittaar; saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki ira'ndaam naa'l aayit'ru.
pinpu theavan: vaanaththin keezhea irukki'ra jalam oaridaththil searavum, vettaantharai kaa'nappadavum kadavathu en'raar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.
theavan vettaantharaikkup poomi en'rum, searntha jalaththi'rkuch samuththiram en'rum pearittaar; theavan athu nallathu en'ru ka'ndaar.

appozhuthu theavan: poomiyaanathu pullaiyum, vithaiyaip pi'rappikkum poo'nduka'laiyum, poomiyinmeal thangka'lil thangka'l vithaiyaiyudaiya kanika'laith thangka'l thangka'l jaathiyinpadiyea kodukkum kanivirudchangka'laiyum mu'laippikkakkadavathu en'raar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.

poomiyaanathu pullaiyum, thangka'l thangka'l jaathiyinpadiyea vithaiyaip pi'rappikkum poo'nduka'laiyum, thangka'l thangka'l jaathiyinpadiyea thangka'lil thangka'l vithaiyaiyudaiya kanika'laik kodukkum virudchangka'laiyum mu'laippiththathu; theavan athu nallathu en'ru ka'ndaar.
saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki moon'raam naa'l aayit'ru.

pinpu theavan: pakalukkum iravukkum viththiyaasam u'ndaakaththakkathaaka vaanam enki'ra aakaayavirivilea sudarka'l u'ndaakakkadavathu, avaika'l adaiyaa'langka'lukkaakavum kaalangka'laiyum naadka'laiyum varushangka'laiyum ku'rikki'ratha'rkaakavum irukkakkadavathu en'raar.
avaika'l poomiyinmeal pirakaasikkumpadikku vaanam enki'ra aakaayavirivilea sudarka'laayirukkakkadavathu en'raar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.
theavan, pakalai aa'lap periya sudarum, iravai aa'lach si'riya sudarum aakiya ira'ndu makaththaana sudarka'laiyum, nadchaththirangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaar.
avaika'l poomiyinmeal pirakaasikkavum,
pakalaiyum iravaiyum aa'lavum, ve'lichchaththukkum iru'lukkum viththiyaasam u'ndaakkavum, theavan avaika'lai vaanam enki'ra aakaayavirivilea vaiththaar; theavan athu nallathu en'ru ka'ndaar.
saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki naalaam naa'l aayit'ru.
pinpu theavan: neenthum jeevajanthukka'laiyum, poomiyinmeal vaanam enki'ra aakaayavirivilea pa'rakkum pa'ravaika'laiyum, jalamaanathu thira'laay janippikkakkadavathu en'raar.

theavan, makaa machchangka'laiyum, jalaththil thangka'l thangka'l jaathiyinpadiyea thira'laay janippikkappatta sakalavitha neervaazhum janthukka'laiyum, si'raku'l'la jaathijaathiyaana sakalavithap padchika'laiyum sirushdiththaar; theavan athu nallathu en'ru ka'ndaar.
theavan avaika'lai aaseervathiththu, neengka'l palukip peruki, samuththira jalaththai nirappungka'l en'rum, pa'ravaika'l poomiyil perukakkadavathu en'rum sonnaar.
saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki ainthaam naa'l aayit'ru.

pinpu theavan: poomiyaanathu jaathijaathiyaana jeevajanthukka'laakiya naattumirukangka'laiyum, oorum piraa'nika'laiyum, kaattumirukangka'laiyum, jaathijaathiyaakap pi'rappikkakkadavathu en'raar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.

theavan poomiyilu'l'la jaathijaathiyaana kaattumirukangka'laiyum, jaathijaathiyaana naattumirukangka'laiyum, poomiyil oorum piraa'nika'l ellaavat'raiyum u'ndaakkinaar; theavan athu nallathu en'ru ka'ndaar.

pinpu theavan: namathu saayalaakavum namathu roopaththinpadiyeayum manushanai u'ndaakkuvoamaaka; avarka'l samuththiraththin machchangka'laiyum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum, mirukajeevanka'laiyum, poomiyanaiththaiyum, poomiyinmeal oorum sakalap piraa'nika'laiyum aa'lakkadavarka'l en'raar.
theavan thammudaiya saayalaaka manushanaich sirushdiththaar, avanaith theavasaayalaakavea sirushdiththaar; aa'num pe'n'numaaka avarka'laich sirushdiththaar.

pinpu theavan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l palukip peruki, poomiyai nirappi, athaik keezhppaduththi, samuththiraththin machchangka'laiyum aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum, poomiyinmeal nadamaaduki'ra sakala jeevajanthukka'laiyum aa'nduko'l'lungka'l en'ru solli, theavan avarka'lai aaseervathiththaar.

pinnum theavan: ithoa, poomiyinmeal engkum vithaitharum sakalavithap poo'nduka'laiyum, vithaitharum kanimarangka'laakiya sakalavitha virudchangka'laiyum ungka'lukkuk koduththean, avaika'l ungka'lukku aakaaramaayirukkakkadavathu;

poomiyilu'l'la sakala mirukajeevanka'lukkum, aakaayaththilu'l'la sakala pa'ravaika'lukkum, poomiyinmeal oorum piraa'nika'l ellaavat'ri'rkum pasumaiyaana sakala poo'nduka'laiyum aakaaramaakak koduththean en'raar; athu appadiyea aayit'ru.
appozhuthu theavan thaam u'ndaakkina ellaavat'raiyum paarththaar, athu mikavum nan'raayirunthathu; saayangkaalamum vidiya'rkaalamumaaki aa'raam naa'l aayit'ru.
ivvithamaaka vaanamum poomiyum, avaika'lin sarvaseanaiyum u'ndaakkappattuth theernthana.
theavan thaam seytha thammudaiya kiriyaiyai eazhaam naa'lilea ni'raiveat'ri, thaam u'ndaakkina thammudaiya kiriyaika'laiyellaam mudiththapinpu, eazhaam naa'lilea oaynthirunthaar.
theavan thaam sirushdiththu u'ndupa'n'nina thammudaiya kiriyaika'laiyellaam mudiththapinpu athilea oaynthirunthapadiyaal, theavan eazhaam naa'lai aaseervathiththu, athaip parisuththamaakkinaar.
theavanaakiya karththar poomiyaiyum vaanaththaiyum u'ndaakkina naa'lilea, vaanamum poomiyum sirushdikkappatta varalaa'ru ivaika'lea.

nilaththinudaiya sakalavithach sedika'lum poomiyinmeal innum u'ndaakavillai, nilaththinudaiya sakalavithap poo'nduka'lum innum mu'laikkavillai; eanenil theavanaakiya karththar poomiyinmeal innum mazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'navillai; nilaththaip pa'npaduththa manushanum irunthathillai.
appozhuthu moodupani poomiyilirunthu ezhumpi, poomiyaiyellaam nanaiththathu.
theavanaakiya karththar manushanaip poomiyin ma'n'ninaalea uruvaakki, jeevasuvaasaththai avan naasiyilea oothinaar, manushan jeevaaththumaavaanaan.
theavanaakiya karththar kizhakkea eathean ennum oru thoattaththai u'ndaakki, thaam uruvaakkina manushanai athilea vaiththaar.

theavanaakiya karththar, paarvaikku azhakum pusippukku nalamumaana sakalavitha virudchangka'laiyum, thoattaththin naduvilea jeevavirudchaththaiyum, nanmai theemai a'riyaththakka virudchaththaiyum poomiyilirunthu mu'laikkappa'n'ninaar.
thoattaththukkuth tha'n'neer paayumpadi eatheanilirunthu oru nathi oadi, angkeayirunthu pirinthu naalu periya aa'ruka'laayit'ru.
muthalaam aat'rukkup paisoan en'ru pear, athu aavilaa theasam muzhuvathaiyum sut'ri oadum; avvidaththilea pon vi'laiyum.
anthath theasaththin pon nallathu; avvidaththilea pithoalaakum, koameathakakkallum u'ndu.
ira'ndaam aat'rukkuk keekoan en'ru pear, athu eththiyoappiyaa theasam muzhuvathaiyum sut'ri oadum.
moon'raam aat'rukku ithekkeal en'ru pear, athu aseeriyaavukkuk kizhakkea oadum; naalaam aat'rukku aipiraaththu en'ru pear.
theavanaakiya karththar manushanai eathean thoattaththil azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, athaip pa'npaduththavum kaakkavum vaiththaar.
theavanaakiya karththar manushanai noakki: nee thoattaththilu'l'la sakala virudchaththin kaniyaiyum pusikkavea pusikkalaam.
aanaalum nanmaitheemai a'riyaththakka virudchaththin kaniyaip pusikkavea'ndaam; athai nee pusikkum naa'lil saakavea saavaay en'ru katta'laiyittaar.
pinpu, theavanaakiya karththar: manushan thanimaiyaayiruppathu nallathalla, eat'ra thu'naiyai avanukku u'ndaakkuvean en'raar.

theavanaakiya karththar ve'liyin sakalavitha mirukangka'laiyum, aakaayaththin sakalavithap pa'ravaika'laiyum ma'n'ninaalea uruvaakki, aathaam avaika'lukku enna peariduvaan en'ru paarkkumpadi avaika'lai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaar; anthantha jeevajanthukku aathaam enthenthap pearittaanoa athuvea atha'rkup pearaayit'ru.
appadiyea aathaam sakalavitha naattumirukangka'lukkum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum, sakalavithak kaattumirukangka'lukkum pearittaan; aathaamukkoa eat'ra thu'nai innum kaa'nappadavillai.

appozhuthu theavanaakiya karththar aathaamukku ayarntha niththiraiyai varappa'n'ninaar, avan niththiraiyadainthaan; avar avan vilaa elumpuka'lil on'rai eduththu, antha idaththaich sathaiyinaal adaiththaar.
theavanaakiya karththar thaam manushanil eduththa vilaa elumpai manushiyaaka uruvaakki, ava'lai manushanidaththil ko'nduvanthaar.
appozhuthu aathaam: iva'l en elumpil elumpum, en maamsaththil maamsamumaay irukki'raa'l; iva'l manushanil edukkappattapadiyinaal manushi ennappaduvaa'l en'raan.
ithinimiththam purushan than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum vittu, than manaiviyoadea isainthiruppaan; avarka'l orea maamsamaayiruppaarka'l.
aathaamum avan manaiviyumaakiya iruvarum nirvaa'nika'laayirunthum, vedkappadaathirunthaarka'l.

theavanaakiya karththar u'ndaakkina sakala kaattu jeevanka'laippaarkkilum sarppamaanathu thanthiramu'l'lathaayirunthathu. athu sthireeyai noakki: neengka'l thoattaththilu'l'la sakala virudchangka'lin kaniyaiyum pusikkavea'ndaam en'ru theavan sonnathu u'ndoa en'rathu.
sthiree sarppaththaip paarththu: naangka'l thoattaththilu'l'la virudchangka'lin kanika'laip pusikkalaam;
aanaalum, thoattaththin naduvil irukki'ra virudchaththin kaniyaik ku'riththu, theavan: neengka'l saakaathapadikku athaip pusikkavum athaith thodavum vea'ndaam en'ru sonnaar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu sarppam sthireeyai noakki: neengka'l saakavea saavathillai;
neengka'l ithaip pusikkum naa'lilea ungka'l ka'nka'l thi'rakkappadum en'rum, neengka'l nanmai theemai a'rinthu theavarka'laippoal iruppeerka'l en'rum theavan a'rivaar en'rathu.

appozhuthu sthireeyaanava'l, antha virudcham pusippukku nallathum, paarvaikku inpamum, puththiyaith the'livikki'ratha'rku ichchikkappadaththakka virudchamumaay irukki'rathu en'ru ka'ndu, athin kaniyaip pa'riththu, pusiththu, than purushanukkum koduththaa'l; avanum pusiththaan.

appozhuthu avarka'l iruvarudaiya ka'nka'lum thi'rakkappattathu; avarka'l thaangka'l nirvaa'nika'l en'ru a'rinthu, aththiyilaika'laith thaiththu, thangka'lukku araikkachchaika'lai u'ndupa'n'ninaarka'l.

pakalil ku'lirchchiyaana vea'laiyilea thoattaththil ulaavuki'ra theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththai avarka'l keattaarka'l. appozhuthu aathaamum avan manaiviyum theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithikku vilaki, thoattaththin virudchangka'lukku'l'lea o'liththukko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu theavanaakiya karththar aathaamaik kooppittu: nee engkea irukki'raay en'raar.
atha'rku avan: naan theavareerudaiya saththaththaith thoattaththilea keattu, naan nirvaa'niyaayiruppathinaal payanthu, o'liththukko'ndean en'raan.
appozhuthu avar: nee nirvaa'ni en'ru unakku a'riviththavan yaar? pusikkavea'ndaam en'ru naan unakku vilakkina virudchaththin kaniyaip pusiththaayoa en'raar.
atha'rku aathaam: ennudanea irukkumpadi theavareer thantha sthireeyaanava'l avvirudchaththin kaniyai enakkuk koduththaa'l, naan pusiththean en'raan.
appozhuthu theavanaakiya karththar sthireeyai noakki: nee ippadich seythathu enna en'raar. sthireeyaanava'l: sarppam ennai vagnchiththathu, naan pusiththean en'raa'l.

appozhuthu theavanaakiya karththar sarppaththaip paarththu: nee ithaich seythapadiyaal sakala naattu mirukangka'lilum sakala kaattu mirukangka'lilum sapikkappattiruppaay, nee un vayit'rinaal nakarnthu, uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam ma'n'naith thinpaay;
unakkum sthireekkum, un viththukkum ava'l viththukkum pakai u'ndaakkuvean; avar un thalaiyai nasukkuvaar, nee avar kuthingkaalai nasukkuvaay en'raar.

avar sthireeyai noakki: nee karppavathiyaayirukkumpoathu un veathanaiyai mikavum perukappa'n'nuvean; veathanaiyoadea pi'l'lai pe'ruvaay; un aasai un purushanaip pat'riyirukkum, avan unnai aa'nduko'l'luvaan en'raar.

pinpu avar aathaamai noakki: nee un manaiviyin vaarththaikkuch sevikoduththu, pusikkavea'ndaam en'ru naan unakku vilakkina virudchaththin kaniyaip pusiththapadiyinaalea, poomi un nimiththam sapikkappattirukkum; nee uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam varuththaththoadea athin palanaip pusippaay.
athu unakku mu'l'lum kurukkum mu'laippikkum; ve'liyin payirvakaika'laip pusippaay.
nee poomiyilirunthu edukkappattapadiyaal, nee poomikkuth thirumpumattum un mukaththin vearvaiyaal aakaaram pusippaay; nee ma'n'naayirukki'raay, ma'n'nukkuth thirumpuvaay en'raar.
aathaam than manaivikku eavaa'l en'ru pearittaan; eanenil, ava'l jeevanu'l'loarukkellaam thaayaanava'l.
theavanaakiya karththar aathaamukkum avan manaivikkum thoal udaika'lai u'ndaakki avarka'lukku uduththinaar.

pinpu theavanaakiya karththar: ithoa, manushan nanmai theemai a'riyaththakkavanaay nammil oruvaraippoal aanaan; ippozhuthum avan than kaiyai neetti jeevavirudchaththin kaniyaiyum pa'riththu, pusiththu, en'raikkum uyiroadiraathapadikkuch seyyavea'ndum en'ru,
avan edukkappatta ma'n'naip pa'npaduththa theavanaakiya karththar avanai eathean thoattaththilirunthu anuppivittaar.
avar manushanaith thuraththivittu, jeevavirudchaththukkup poam vazhiyaik kaavalseyya eathean thoattaththukkuk kizhakkea kearupeenka'laiyum, veesikko'ndirukki'ra sudaro'li pattayaththaiyum vaiththaar.
aathaam than manaiviyaakiya eavaa'lai a'rinthaan; ava'l karppavathiyaaki, kaayeenaip pet'ru, karththaraal oru manushanaip pet'rean en'raa'l.
pinpu avanudaiya sakoatharanaakiya aapealaip pet'raa'l; aapeal aaduka'lai meaykki'ravanaanaan, kaayeen nilaththaip payiriduki'ravanaanaan.
silanaa'l sen'rapinpu, kaayeen nilaththin kanika'laik karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvanthaan.
aapealum than manthaiyin thalaiyeet'ruka'lilum avaika'lil kozhumaiyaanavaika'lilum silavat'raik ko'nduvanthaan. aapealaiyum avan kaa'nikkaiyaiyum karththar angkikariththaar.
kaayeenaiyum avan kaa'nikkaiyaiyum avar angkikarikkavillai. appozhuthu kaayeenukku mikavum erichchal u'ndaaki, avan mukanaadi vea'rupattathu.
appozhuthu karththar kaayeenai noakki: unakku ean erichchal u'ndaayit'ru? un mukanaadi ean vea'rupattathu?
nee nanmaiseythaal meanmai illaiyoa? nee nanmaiseyyaathirunthaal paavam vaasa'rpadiyil paduththirukkum; avan aasai unnaip pat'riyirukkum, nee avanai aa'nduko'l'luvaay en'raar.
kaayeen than sakoatharanaakiya aapealoadea peasinaan; avarka'l vayalve'liyil irukkum samayaththil, kaayeen than sakoatharanaakiya aapealukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, avanaik kolaiseythaan.
karththar kaayeenai noakki: un sakoatharanaakiya aapeal engkea en'raar; atha'rku avan: naan a'riyean; en sakoatharanukku naan kaavalaa'liyoa en'raan.
atha'rku avar: enna seythaay? un sakoatharanudaiya iraththaththin saththam poomiyilirunthu ennai noakkik kooppiduki'rathu.
ippozhuthu un sakoatharanudaiya iraththaththai un kaiyilea vaangkikko'l'lath than vaayaith thi'rantha inthap poomiyil nee sapikkappattiruppaay.
nee nilaththaip payiridumpoathu, athu than palanai ini unakkuk kodaathu; nee poomiyil nilaiyat'ru alaiki'ravanaayiruppaay en'raar.
appozhuthu kaayeen karththarai noakki: enakku itta tha'ndanai ennaal sakikkamudiyaathu.

in'ru ennai inthath theasaththilirunthu thuraththividuki'reer; naan umathu samukaththukku vilaki ma'rainthu, poomiyil nilaiyat'ru alaiki'ravanaayiruppean; ennaik ka'ndupidikki'ravan evanum ennaik kon'rupoaduvaanea en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar avanai noakki: kaayeenaik kolluki'ra evan mealum eazhu pazhi sumarum en'ru solli; kaayeenaik ka'ndupidikki'ravan evanum avanaik kon'rupoadaathapadikkuk karththar avanmeal oru adaiyaa'laththaip poattaar.
appadiyea kaayeen karththarudaiya sannithiyaivittup pu'rappattu, eatheanukkuk kizhakkaana noath ennum theasaththil kudiyirunthaan.
kaayeen than manaiviyai a'rinthaan; ava'l karppavathiyaaki, eanoakkaip pet'raa'l; appozhuthu avan oru patta'naththaik katti, anthap patta'naththukkuth than kumaaranaakiya eanoakkudaiya pearai ittaan.
eanoakkukku eeraath pi'ranthaan; eeraath mekuyavealaip pet'raan; mekuyaveal meththoosavealaip pet'raan; meththoosaveal laameakkaip pet'raan.
laameakku ira'ndu sthireeka'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; oruththikku aathaa'l en'ru pear, mat'roruththikkuch sillaa'l en'ru pear.
aathaa'l yaapaalaip pet'raa'l; avan koodaarangka'lil vaasampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lukkum manthai meaykki'ravarka'lukkum thakappanaanaan.
avan sakoatharanudaiya pear yoopaal; avan kinnarakkaarar naakasurakkaarar yaavarukkum thakappanaanaan.
sillaa'lum thoopaal kaayeenaip pet'raa'l; avan piththa'lai irumpu muthaliyavat'rin thozhilaa'lar yaavarukkum aasaariyanaanaan; thoopaal kaayeenudaiya sakoathari naamaa'l.

laameakku than manaivika'laip paarththu: aathaa'lea, sillaa'lea, naan solvathaik kea'lungka'l; laameakkin manaivika'lea, en saththaththukkuch sevikodungka'l; enakkuk kaayamu'ndaaka oru manushanaik kon'rean; enakkuth thazhumpu'ndaaka oru vaalipanaik kolaiseythean;
kaayeenukkaaka eazhupazhi sumarumaanaal, laameakkukkaaka ezhupaththeazhu pazhi sumarum en'raan.

pinnum aathaam than manaiviyai a'rinthaan; ava'l oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: kaayeen kolaiseytha aapealukkup pathilaaka, theavan enakku vea'roru puththiranaik koduththaar en'ru solli, avanukkuch seath en'ru pearittaa'l.
seaththukkum oru kumaaran pi'ranthaan; avanukku eanoas en'ru pearittaan; appozhuthu manushar karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'la aarampiththaarka'l.
aathaamin vamsavaralaa'ru: theavan manushanaich sirushdiththa naa'lilea avanaith theavasaayalaaka u'ndaakkinaar.
avarka'lai aa'num pe'n'numaakach sirushdiththu, avarka'lai aaseervathiththu, avarka'laich sirushdiththa naa'lilea avarka'lukku manushar en'ru pearittaar.
aathaam noot'ru muppathu vayathaanapoathu, than saayalaakath than roopaththinpadiyea oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukkuch seath en'ru pearittaan.
aathaam seaththaip pet'rapin, e'n'noo'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
aathaam uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththu muppathu varusham; avan mariththaan.
seath noot'rainthu vayathaanapoathu, eanoasaip pet'raan.
seath eanoasaip pet'rapin, e'n'noot'reazhu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
seaththudaiya naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththup pannira'ndu varusham; avan mariththaan.
eanoas tho'n'noo'ru vayathaanapoathu, keanaanaip pet'raan.
eanoas keanaanaip pet'rapin, e'n'noot'rup pathinainthu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
eanoasudaiya naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththu ainthu varusham; avan mariththaan.
keanaan ezhupathu vayathaanapoathu, makalaaleyealaip pet'raan.
keanaan makalaaleyealaip pet'rapin, e'n'noot'ru naa'rpathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
keanaanudaiya naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththup paththu varusham; avan mariththaan.
makalaaleyeal a'rupaththainthu vayathaanapoathu, yaareathaip pet'raan.
makalaaleyeal yaareathaip pet'rapin, e'n'noot'ru muppathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
makalaaleyealudaiya naa'lellaam e'n'noot'ruth tho'n'noot'ru ainthu varusham; avan mariththaan.
yaareath noot'ru a'rupaththira'ndu vayathaanapoathu, eanoakkaip pet'raan.
yaareath eanoakkaip pet'rapin, e'n'noo'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
yaareathudaiya naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththu a'rupaththira'ndu varusham; avan mariththaan.
eanoakku a'rupaththainthu vayathaanapoathu, meththoosalaavaip pet'raan.
eanoakku meththoosalaavaip pet'rapin, munnoo'ru varusham theavanoadea sagnchariththukko'ndirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
eanoakkudaiya naa'lellaam munnoot'ru a'rupaththainthu varusham.
eanoakku theavanoadea sagnchariththukko'ndirukkaiyil, kaa'nappadaama'rpoanaan; theavan avanai eduththukko'ndaar.
meththoosalaa noot're'npaththeazhu vayathaanapoathu, laameakkaip pet'raan.
meththoosalaa laameakkaip pet'rapin, ezhunoot'ru e'npaththira'ndu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
meththoosalaavudaiya naa'lellaam tho'laayiraththu a'rupaththonpathu varusham; avan mariththaan.
laameakku noot're'npaththira'ndu vayathaanapoathu, oru kumaaranaip pet'ru,
karththar sapiththa poomiyilea namakku u'ndaana vealaiyilum, nammudaiya kaika'lin pirayaasaththilum, ivan nammaith theat'ruvaan en'ru solli, avanukku noavaa en'ru pearittaan.
laameakku noavaavaip pet'rapin, ainnoot'ruth tho'n'noot'ru ainthu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
laameakkudaiya naa'lellaam ezhunoot'ru ezhupaththeazhu varusham; avan mariththaan.
noavaa ainnoo'ru vayathaanapoathu, seam kaam yaappeath enpavarka'laip pet'raan.
manushar poomiyinmeal perukath thuvakki, avarka'lukkuk kumaaraththika'l pi'ranthapoathu:
theavakumaarar manushakumaaraththika'lai athika saunthariyamu'l'lavarka'len'ru ka'ndu, avarka'lukku'l'lea thangka'lukkup pe'nka'laith therinthuko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar: en aavi en'raikkum manushanoadea poaraaduvathillai; avan maamsanthaanea, avan irukkap poaki'ra naadka'l noot'rirupathu varusham en'raar.

annaadka'lil iraadchathar poomiyilea irunthaarka'l; pinpu theavakumaarar manushakumaaraththika'loadea kooduki'rathinaal, ivarka'l avarka'lukkup pi'l'laika'laip pet'rapoathu, ivarka'lum poorvaththil pearpet'ra manusharaakiya palavaanka'laanaarka'l.
manushanudaiya akkiramam poomiyilea perukinathu en'rum, avan iruthayaththu ninaivuka'lin thoat'ramellaam niththamum pollaathathea en'rum, karththar ka'ndu,
thaam poomiyilea manushanai u'ndaakkinatha'rkaakak karththar manasthaapappattaar; athu avar iruthayaththukku visanamaayirunthathu.

appozhuthu karththar: naan sirushdiththa manushanaip poomiyinmeal vaikkaamal, manushan mutha'rko'ndu, mirukangka'l oorum piraa'nika'l aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l pariyanthamum u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lai nikkirakampa'n'nuvean; naan avarka'lai u'ndaakkinathu enakku manasthaapamaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
noavaavukkoa, karththarudaiya ka'nka'lil kirupai kidaiththathu.
noavaavin vamsavaralaa'ru: noavaa than kaalaththil irunthavarka'lukku'l'lea neethimaanum uththamanumaayirunthaan; noavaa theavanoadea sagnchariththukko'ndirunthaan.
noavaa seam kaam yaappeath ennum moon'ru kumaararaip pet'raan.
poomiyaanathu theavanukku munpaakach seerkettathaayirunthathu; poomi kodumaiyinaal ni'rainthirunthathu.
theavan poomiyaip paarththaar; ithoa athu seerkettathaayirunthathu; maamsamaana yaavarum poomiyinmeal thangka'l vazhiyaik keduththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu theavan noavaavai noakki: maamsamaana yaavarin mudivum enakku munpaaka vanthathu; avarka'laalea poomi kodumaiyinaal ni'rainthathu; naan avarka'laip poomiyoadungkooda azhiththuppoaduvean.
nee koppear maraththaal unakku oru peazhaiyai u'ndaakku; anthap peazhaiyilea a'raika'lai u'ndupa'n'ni, athai u'l'lum pu'rampumaakak keelpoosu.
nee athaip pa'n'navea'ndiya vitham ennaven'raal, peazhaiyin nee'lam munnoo'ru muzhamum, athin akalam aimpathu muzhamum, athin uyaram muppathu muzhamumaay irukkavea'ndum.

nee peazhaikku oar jannalai u'ndupa'n'ni, mealthattukku oru muzhath thaazhththiyilea athaich seythumudiththu, peazhaiyin kathavai athin pakkaththil vaiththu, keezh a'raika'laiyum, ira'ndaam thattin a'raika'laiyum, moon'raam thattin a'raika'laiyum pa'n'navea'ndum.
vaanaththinkeezhea jeevasuvaasamu'l'la sakala maamsajanthukka'laiyum azhikka naan poomiyinmeal jalappira'layaththai varappa'n'nuvean; poomiyilu'l'la yaavum maa'ndupoam.
aanaalum unnudanea en udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththuvean; neeyum, unnoadeakooda un kumaararum, un manaiviyum, un kumaararin manaivika'lum, peazhaikku'l piraveasiyungka'l.
sakalavitha maamsamaana jeevanka'lilum aa'num pe'n'numaaka vakai on'rukku ovvoru joadu unnudan uyiroadea kaakkappaduvatha'rku, peazhaikku'l'lea searththukko'l.

jaathijaathiyaana pa'ravaika'lilum, jaathijaathiyaana mirukangka'lilum, poomiyilu'l'la sakala jaathijaathiyaana oorum piraa'nika'lilum, vakai on'rukku ovvoru joadu uyiroadea kaakkappaduvatha'rku unnidaththilea varakkadavathu.
unakkum avaika'lukkum aakaaramaakach sakalavitha poajanapathaarththangka'laiyum searththu, unnidaththil vaiththukko'l en'raar.
noavaa appadiyea seythaan; theavan thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam avan seythu mudiththaan.
karththar noavaavai noakki: neeyum un veettaar anaivarum peazhaikku'l piraveasiyungka'l; inthach santhathiyil unnai enakku munpaaka neethimaanaakak ka'ndean.

poomiyinmeethengkum viththai uyiroadea kaakkumporuttu, nee suththamaana sakala mirukangka'lilum, aa'num pe'n'numaaka evveazhu joadum, suththamallaatha mirukangka'lil aa'num pe'n'numaaka ovvoru joadum,
aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lilum, seavalum peadumaaka evveazhu joadum unnidaththil searththukko'l.

innum eazhunaa'l sen'rapinpu, naa'rpathunaa'l iravum pakalum poomiyinmeal mazhaiyai varushikkappa'n'ni, naan u'ndaakkina jeevajanthukka'l anaiththaiyum poomiyinmeal iraathapadikku nikkirakam pa'n'nuvean en'raar.
noavaa thanakkuk karththar katta'laiyittapadiyellaam seythaan.
jalappira'layam poomiyinmeal u'ndaanapoathu, noavaa a'runoo'ru vayathaayirunthaan.
jalappira'layaththukkuth thappumpadi noavaavum avanudaneakooda avan kumaararum, avan manaiviyum, avan kumaararin manaivika'lum peazhaikku'l piraveasiththaarka'l.
theavan noavaavukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, suththamaana mirukangka'lilum, suththamallaatha mirukangka'lilum, poomiyinmeal oorum piraa'nika'l ellaavat'rilum,
aa'num pe'n'num joadujoadaaka noavaavidaththil peazhaikkudpattana.
eazhunaa'l sen'rapinpu poomiyinmeal jalappira'layam u'ndaayit'ru.

noavaavukku a'runoo'raam vayathaakum varusham ira'ndaam maatham pathineazhaam theathiyaakiya annaa'lilea, makaa aazhaththin oot'rukka'nka'lellaam pi'lanthana; vaanaththin mathakuka'lum thi'ravu'ndana.
naa'rpathunaa'l iravum pakalum poomiyinmeal perumazhai peythathu.
an'raiththinamea noavaavum, noavaavin kumaararaakiya seamum kaamum yaappeaththum, avarka'ludaneakooda noavaavin manaiviyum, avan kumaararin moon'ru manaivika'lum, peazhaikku'l piraveasiththaarka'l.

avarka'loadu jaathijaathiyaana sakalavithak kaattu mirukangka'lum, jaathijaathiyaana sakalavitha naattu mirukangka'lum, poomiyinmeal ooruki'ra jaathijaathiyaana sakalavitha oorum piraa'nika'lum, jaathijaathiyaana sakalavithap pa'ravaika'lum, palavithamaana si'rakuka'lu'l'la sakalavithap padchika'lum piraveasiththana.
ippadiyea jeevasuvaasamu'l'la maamsajanthukka'lellaam joadujoadaaka noavaavidaththil peazhaikku'l piraveasiththana.
theavan avanukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, aa'num pe'n'numaakach sakalavitha maamsajanthukka'lum u'l'lea piraveasiththana; appozhuthu karththar avanai u'l'leavittuk kathavai adaiththaar.
jalappira'layam naa'rpathu naa'l poomiyinmeal u'ndaanapoathu, jalam peruki, peazhaiyaik ki'lampappa'n'nit'ru; athu poomikkumeal mithanthathu.
jalam peruve'l'lamaaki, poomiyinmeal mikavum perukit'ru; peazhaiyaanathu jalaththinmeal mithanthuko'ndirunthathu.
jalam poomiyinmeal mikavum athikamaayp perukinathinaal, vaanaththinkeezh engkumu'l'la uyarntha malaika'lellaam moodappattana.
moodappatta malaika'lukku mealaayp pathinainthumuzha uyaraththi'rku jalam perukit'ru.

appozhuthu maamsajanthukka'laakiya pa'ravaika'lum, naattumirukangka'lum, kaattumirukangka'lum, poomiyinmeal oorum piraa'nika'l yaavum, ellaa narajeevanka'lum, poomiyinmeal sagncharikki'ravaika'l yaavum maa'ndana.
vettaantharaiyil u'ndaana ellaavat'rilum naasiyilea jeevasuvaasamu'l'lavaika'l ellaam maa'ndupoayina.

manushar muthal, mirukangka'l, oorum piraa'nika'l, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l pariyanthamum, poomiyinmeal iruntha uyiru'l'la vasthukka'l yaavum azhinthu, avaika'l poomiyil iraathapadikku nikkirakamaayina; noavaavum avanoadea peazhaiyiliruntha uyirka'lum maaththiram kaakkappattana.
jalam poomiyinmeal noot'raimpathu naa'l mikavum piravaakiththukko'ndirunthathu.

theavan noavaavaiyum, avanudanea peazhaiyiliruntha sakala kaattu mirukangka'laiyum, sakala naattu mirukangka'laiyum ninaiththaru'linaar; theavan poomiyinmeal kaat'rai veesappa'n'ninaar, appozhuthu jalam amarnthathu.
aazhaththin oot'rukka'nka'lum, vaanaththin mathakuka'lum adaipattana; vaanaththu mazhaiyum nin'rupoayit'ru.
jalam poomiyilirunthu naa'lukkunaa'l vat'rikko'ndea vanthathu; noot'raimpathu naa'lukkuppinpu jalam vadinthathu.
eazhaam maatham pathineazhaam theathiyilea peazhai araraath ennum malaika'linmeal thangkit'ru.
paththaam maatham mattum jalam vadinthuko'ndeavanthathu; paththaam maatham muthal theathiyilea malaichsikarangka'l kaa'nappattana.
naa'rpathu naa'l sen'rapin, noavaa thaan peazhaiyil seythiruntha jannalaith thi'ranthu,
oru kaakaththai ve'liyea vittaan; athu pu'rappattup poomiyinmeal iruntha jalam vat'rippoakumvaraikkum poaki'rathum varuki'rathumaay irunthathu.
pinpu poomiyinmeal jalam ku'rainthu poayit'roa en'ru a'riyumpadi, oru pu'raavaith thannidaththilirunthu ve'liyea vittaan.

poomiyinmeethengkum jalam irunthapadiyaal, anthap pu'raa than u'l'langkaal vaiththu i'laippaa'ra idam kaa'naamal, thirumpip peazhaiyilea avanidaththil vanthathu; avan than kaiyai neetti athaip pidiththuth thannidamaakap peazhaikku'l searththukko'ndaan.
pinnum eazhunaa'l po'ruththu, ma'rupadiyum pu'raavaip peazhaiyilirunthu ve'liyea vittaan.

anthap pu'raa saayangkaalaththil avanidaththil vanthu searnthathu; ithoa, athu koththikko'nduvantha oru olivamaraththin ilai athin vaayil irunthathu; athinaalea noavaa poomiyinmeal jalam ku'rainthupoayit'ru en'ru a'rinthaan.
pinnum eazhunaa'l po'ruththu, avan pu'raavai ve'liyea vittaan; athu avanidaththi'rkuth thirumpi varavillai.

avanukku a'runoot'roru vayathaakum varushaththil, muthal maatham muthal theathiyilea poomiyinmeal iruntha jalam vat'rippoayit'ru; noavaa peazhaiyin mealthattai eduththuppaarththaan; poomiyinmeal jalam illaathirunthathu.
ira'ndaam maatham irupaththeazhaam theathiyilea poomi kaaynthirunthathu.
appozhuthu theavan noavaavai noakki:
neeyum, unnoadeakooda un manaiviyum, un kumaararum, un kumaararin manaivika'lum peazhaiyai vittup pu'rappadungka'l.

unnidaththil irukki'ra sakalavitha maamsajanthukka'laakiya pa'ravaika'laiyum, mirukangka'laiyum, poomiyinmeal ooruki'ra sakala piraa'nika'laiyum unnoadea ve'liyea varavidu; avaika'l poomiyilea thira'laay varththiththu, poomiyinmeal palukip perukakkadavathu en'raar.
appozhuthu noavaavum, avan kumaararum, avan manaiviyum, avan kumaararin manaivika'lum pu'rappattu vanthaarka'l.
poomiyinmeal nadamaaduki'ra sakala mirukangka'lum, ooruki'ra sakala piraa'nika'lum, sakala pa'ravaika'lum jaathijaathiyaayp peazhaiyilirunthu pu'rappattu vanthana.

appozhuthu noavaa karththarukku oru palipeedam katti, suththamaana sakala mirukangka'lilum, suththamaana sakala pa'ravaika'lilum silavat'raith therinthuko'ndu, avaika'laip palipeedaththinmeal thakanapalika'laakap paliyittaan.

sukantha vaasanaiyaik karththar mukarnthaar. appozhuthu karththar: ini naan manushan nimiththam poomiyaich sapippathillai; manushanudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuka'l avan si'ruvayathuthodangkip pollaathathaayirukki'rathu; naan ippozhuthu seythathupoala, ini sakala jeevanka'laiyum sangkarippathillai.
poomiyu'l'la naa'la'lavum vithaippum a'ruppum, seetha'lamum ush'namum, koadaikaalamum maarikaalamum, pakalum iravum ozhivathillai en'ru thammudaiya u'l'laththil sonnaar.
pinpu theavan noavaavaiyum, avan kumaararaiyum aaseervathiththu: neengka'l palukip peruki, poomiyai nirappungka'l.

ungka'laippat'riya payamum achchamum poomiyilu'l'la sakala mirukangka'lukkum, aakaayaththilu'l'la sakala pa'ravaika'lukkum u'ndaayirukkum; poomiyilea nadamaaduki'ra yaavum, samuththiraththin machchangka'l yaavum, ungka'lukkuk kaiya'likkappattana.
nadamaaduki'ra jeevajanthukka'l yaavum, ungka'lukku aakaaramaay iruppathaaka; pasum poo'nduka'lai ungka'lukkuth thanthathupoala, avaika'l ellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukkuth thanthean.
maamsaththai athin uyiraakiya iraththaththoadea pusikkavea'ndaam.

ungka'lukku uyiraayirukki'ra ungka'l iraththaththi'rkaakap pazhivaangkuvean; sakala jeevajanthukka'lidaththilum manushanidaththilum pazhivaangkuvean; manushanudaiya uyirukkaaka avanavan sakoatharanidaththil pazhivaangkuvean.
manushan theavasaayalil u'ndaakkappattapadiyaal, manushanudaiya iraththaththai evan sinthuki'raanoa, avanudaiya iraththam manushanaalea sinthappadakkadavathu.
neengka'l palukip peruki, poomiyilea thira'laay varththiththu virththiyaakungka'l en'raar.
pinnum theavan noavaavaiyum, avan kumaararaiyum noakki:
naan ungka'loadum, ungka'lukkup pinvarum ungka'l santhathiyoadum,

ungka'loadea peazhaiyilirunthu pu'rappatta sakala jeevajanthukka'lmuthal inip poomiyil u'ndaakappoaki'ra sakala jeevajanthukka'lpariyantham, pa'ravaika'loadum, naattu mirukangka'loadum, ungka'lidaththil irukki'ra poomiyilu'l'la sakala kaattu mirukangka'loadum en udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththuki'rean.

ini maamsamaanavaika'lellaam jalappira'layaththinaal sangkarikkappaduvathillaiyen'rum, poomiyai azhikka ini jalappira'layam u'ndaavathillaiyen'rum, ungka'loadea en udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththuki'rean en'raar.
an'riyum theavan: enakkum ungka'lukkum, ungka'lidaththil irukkum sakala jeevajanthukka'lukkum, niththiya thalaimu'raika'lukken'ru naan seyki'ra udanpadikkaiyin adaiyaa'lamaaka:
naan en villai meakaththil vaiththean; athu enakkum poomikkum u'ndaana udanpadikkaikku adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum.
naan poomikku mealaay meakaththai varuvikkumpoathu, antha vil meakaththil thoan'rum.

appozhuthu ellaa maamsajeevanka'laiyum azhikka ini jalamaanathu pira'layamaayp perukaathapadikku enakkum ungka'lukkum maamsamaana sakala jeevajanthukka'lukkum u'ndaana en udanpadikkaiyai ninaivukooruvean.
antha vil meakaththil thoan'rumpoathu, theavanukkum poomiyinmealu'l'la sakalavitha maamsajeevanka'lukkum u'ndaana niththiya udanpadikkaiyai naan ninaivukoorumpadikku athai noakkippaarppean.
ithu enakkum, poomiyinmealu'l'la maamsamaana yaavukkum, naan ea'rpaduththina udanpadikkaiyin adaiyaa'lam en'ru noavaavoadea sonnaar.
peazhaiyilirunthu pu'rappatta noavaavin kumaarar, seam kaam yaappeath enpavarka'lea. kaam kaanaanukkuth thakappan.
immoovarum noavaavin kumaarar; ivarka'laalea poomiyengkum janangka'l parampinaarka'l.
noavaa payiriduki'ravanaaki, thiraadchaththoattaththai naattinaan.
avan thiraadcharasaththaik kudiththu, ve'riko'ndu, than koodaaraththil vasthiram vilakip paduththirunthaan.
appozhuthu kaanaanukkuth thakappanaakiya kaam than thakappanudaiya nirvaa'naththaik ka'ndu, ve'liyil iruntha than sakoatharar iruvarukkum a'riviththaan.

appozhuthu seamum yaappeaththum oru vasthiraththai eduththuth thangka'l iruvarudaiya thoa'lmealum poattukko'ndu, pinnittu vanthu, thangka'l thakappanudaiya nirvaa'naththai moodinaarka'l; avarka'l ethirmukamaayp poakaathapadiyinaal, thangka'l thakappanudaiya nirvaa'naththaik kaa'navillai.
noavaa thiraadcharasaththin ve'rithe'linthu vizhiththapoathu, than i'laiya kumaaran thanakkuch seythathai a'rinthu:
kaanaan sapikkappattavan, than sakoathararidaththil adimaika'lukku adimaiyaayiruppaan en'raan.
seamudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka; kaanaan avanukku adimaiyaayiruppaan.
yaappeaththai theavan virththiyaakkuvaar; avan seamudaiya koodaarangka'lil kudiyiruppaan; kaanaan avanukku adimaiyaayiruppaan en'raan.
jalappira'layaththukkuppinpu noavaa munnoot'ru aimpathu varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
noavaavin naadka'lellaam tho'laayiraththu aimpathu varusham; avan mariththaan.
noavaavin kumaararaakiya seam kaam yaappeath enpavarka'lin vamsavaralaa'ru: jalappira'layaththukkuppinpu avarka'lukkuk kumaarar pi'ranthaarka'l.
yaappeaththin kumaarar, koamar, maakoaku, maathaay, yaavaan, thoopaal, measeakku, theeraas enpavarka'l.
koamarin kumaarar, askinaas, reeppaaththu, thokarmaa enpavarka'l.
yaavaanin kumaarar, eleesaa, tharshees, kiththeem, thothaaneem enpavarka'l.
ivarka'laal jaathika'ludaiya theevuka'l, avanavan paashaiyinpadiyeayum, avaravarka'l koaththiraththinpadiyeayum, jaathiyinpadiyeayum, vea'ruvea'ru theasangka'laayp pakukkappattana.
kaamudaiya kumaarar, koosh, misraayeem, pooth, kaanaan enpavarka'l.
kooshudaiya kumaarar, seapaa, aavilaa, sapthaa, raamaa, sapthikaa enpavarka'l. raamaavin kumaarar, seapaa, thithaan enpavarka'l.
koosh nimroathaip pet'raan; ivan poomiyilea paraakkiramasaaliyaanaan.
ivan karththarukku munpaakap palaththa veattaikkaaranaayirunthaan; aakaiyaal, karththarukku munpaakap palaththa veattaikkaaranaana nimroathaippoala ennum vazhakkachsol u'ndaayit'ru.
sineyaar theasaththilu'l'la paapeal, eareak, akkaath, kalnea ennum idangka'l avan aa'nda raajyaththi'rku aathi sthaanangka'l.
anthath theasaththilirunthu asoor pu'rappattuppoay, niniveayaiyum, rekopoath patta'naththaiyum, kaalaakaiyum,
niniveakkum kaalaakukkum naduvaaka reseanaiyum kattinaan; ithu periya patta'nam.
misraayeem, lootheemaiyum, anaameemaiyum, lekaapeemaiyum, napthookeemaiyum,
pathruseemaiyum, pelistharin santhathikkuth thalaivanaakiya kaslookeemaiyum, kapthoreemaiyum pet'raan.
kaanaan than mooththamakanaakiya seethoanaiyum, keaththaiyum,
epoosiyaraiyum, emoariyaraiyum, kirkaasiyaraiyum,
eeviyaraiyum, arkeeriyaraiyum, seeniyaraiyum,
arvaathiyaraiyum, semaariyaraiyum, kaamaaththiyaraiyum pet'raan; pinpu kaanaaniyarin vamsaththaar engkum paravinaarka'l.
kaanaaniyarin ellai, seethoanmuthal kearaar vazhiyaayk kaasaamattukkum, athu muthal soathoam, komoaraa, athmaa, sepoayim vazhiyaay laasaamattukkum irunthathu.
ivarka'l thangka'l theasangka'lilum, thangka'l jaathika'lilumu'l'la thangka'l vamsangka'linpadiyeayum, thangka'l paashaika'linpadiyeayum kaamudaiya santhathiyaar.
seamukkum pi'l'laika'l pi'ranthaarka'l; avan eapearudaiya santhathiyaar ellaarukkum thakappanum, mooththavanaakiya yaappeaththukkuth thampiyumaay irunthaan.
seamudaiya kumaarar, ealaam, asoor, arpaksaath, looth, aaraam enpavarka'l.
aaraamudaiya kumaarar, ooths, kool, keathther, maas enpavarka'l.
arpaksaath saalaavaip pet'raan; saalaa eapearaip pet'raan.
eapearukku ira'ndu kumaarar pi'ranthaarka'l; oruvanukkup pealeaku en'ru pear; eanenil avanudaiya naadka'lil poomi pakukkappattathu; avanudaiya sakoatharan pear yokthaan.
yokthaan almoathaathaiyum, saaleappaiyum, asarmaaveaththaiyum, yearaakaiyum,
athoaraamaiyum, oosaalaiyum, thiklaavaiyum,
oapaalaiyum, apimaavealaiyum, seapaavaiyum,
oppeeraiyum, aavilaavaiyum, yoapaapaiyum pet'raan; ivarka'l anaivarum yokthaanudaiya kumaarar.
ivarka'ludaiya kudiyiruppu measaa thuvakki, kizhakkeayu'l'la malaiyaakiya seppaarukkup poaki'ra vazhimattum irunthathu.
ivarka'lea thangka'l theasangka'lilum, thangka'l jaathika'lilumu'l'la thangka'l vamsangka'linpadiyeayum, thangka'l paashaika'linpadiyeayum seamudaiya santhathiyaar.
thangka'l jaathika'lilu'l'la thangka'ludaiya santhathika'linpadiyea noavaavudaiya kumaararin vamsangka'l ivaika'lea; jalappira'layaththukkuppinpu ivarka'laal poomiyilea jaathika'l pirinthana.
poomiyengkum orea paashaiyum, orea vithamaana peachchum irunthathu.
janangka'l kizhakkeayirunthu pirayaa'nampa'n'nukaiyil, sineyaar theasaththilea samapoomiyaikka'ndu, angkea kudiyirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu avarka'l: naam sengkal a'ruththu, athai nan'raaych suduvoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar peasikko'ndaarka'l; kallukkup pathilaakach sengkallum, saanthukkup pathilaaka nilakkeelum avarka'lukku irunthathu.

pinnum avarka'l: naam poomiyinmeethengkum sitha'rippoakaathapadikku, namakku oru nakaraththaiyum, vaanaththai a'laavum sikaramu'l'la oru koapuraththaiyum katti, namakkup pear u'ndaakap pa'n'nuvoam vaarungka'l en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l.
manupuththirar kattuki'ra nakaraththaiyum koapuraththaiyum paarkki'ratha'rkuk karththar i'rangkinaar.

appozhuthu karththar: ithoa, janangka'l orea koottamaay irukki'raarka'l; avarka'l anaivarukkum orea paashaiyum irukki'rathu; avarka'l ithaich seyyaththodangkinaarka'l; ippozhuthum thaangka'l seyya ninaiththathu on'rum thadaipadamaattaathu en'ru irukki'raarka'l.
naam i'rangkippoay, oruvar peasuvathai mat'roruvar a'riyaathapadikku, angkea avarka'l paashaiyaith thaa'rumaa'raakkuvoam en'raar.
appadiyea karththar avarka'lai avvidaththilirunthu poomiyinmeethengkum sitha'rippoakappa'n'ninaar; appozhuthu nakaram kattuki'rathai vittuvittaarka'l.

poomiyengkum vazhangkina paashaiyaik karththar avvidaththil thaa'rumaa'raakkinapadiyaal, athin pear paapeal ennappattathu; karththar avarka'lai avvidaththilirunthu poomiyinmeethengkum sitha'rippoakappa'n'ninaar.
seamudaiya vamsavaralaa'ru: jalappira'layam u'ndaaki ira'ndu varushaththi'rkup pinpu, seam noo'ruvayathaanapoathu, arpaksaaththaip pet'raan.
seam arpaksaaththaip pet'rapin ainnoo'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
arpaksaath muppaththainthu vayathaanapoathu saalaavaip pet'raan.
saalaavaip pet'rapin arpaksaath naanoot'ru moon'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
saalaa muppathu vayathaanapoathu, eapearaip pet'raan.
eapearaip pet'rapin saalaa naanoot'ru moon'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
eapear muppaththunaalu vayathaanapoathu, pealeakaip pet'raan.
pealeakaip pet'rapin eapear naanoot'ru muppathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
pealeaku muppathu vayathaanapoathu, rekoovaip pet'raan.
rekoovaip pet'rapin pealeaku irunoot'ronpathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
rekoo muppaththira'ndu vayathaanapoathu, serookaip pet'raan.
serookaip pet'rapin rekoo irunoot'reazhu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
serooku muppathu vayathaanapoathu, naakoaraip pet'raan.
naakoaraip pet'rapin serooku irunoo'ru varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
naakoar irupaththonpathu vayathaanapoathu, thearaakaip pet'raan.
thearaakaip pet'rapin naakoar noot'ruppaththonpathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
thearaaku ezhupathu vayathaanapoathu, aapiraam, naakoar, aaraan enpavarka'laip pet'raan.
thearaakudaiya vamsavaralaa'ru: thearaaku aapiraam, naakoar, aaraan enpavarka'laip pet'raan; aaraan loaththaip pet'raan.
aaraan than janmapoomiyaakiya oor enki'ra kaltheayar theasaththup patta'naththilea than thakappanaakiya thearaaku marikkumunnea mariththaan.

aapiraamum naakoarum thangka'lukkup pe'nko'ndaarka'l; aapiraamudaiya manaivikkuch saaraay en'ru pear; naakoarudaiya manaivikku milkkaa'l en'ru pear; iva'l aaraanudaiya kumaaraththi; antha aaraan milkkaa'lukkum iskaa'lukkum thakappan.
saaraaykkup pi'l'laiyillai; maladiyaayirunthaa'l.

thearaaku than kumaaranaakiya aapiraamaiyum, aaraanudaiya kumaaranum than pearanumaayiruntha loaththaiyum, than kumaaran aapiraamudaiya manaiviyaakiya than marumaka'l saaraayaiyum azhaiththukko'ndu, avarka'ludanea oor enki'ra kaltheayarudaiya patta'naththaivittu, kaanaan theasaththukkup poakap pu'rappattaan; avarka'l aaraanmattum vanthapoathu, angkea irunthuvittaarka'l.
thearaakudaiya aayusunaadka'l irunoot'rainthu varusham; thearaaku aaraanilea mariththaan.
karththar aapiraamai noakki: nee un theasaththaiyum, un inaththaiyum, un thakappanudaiya veettaiyum vittup pu'rappattu, naan unakkuk kaa'npikkum theasaththukkup poa.
naan unnaip periya jaathiyaakki, unnai aaseervathiththu, un pearaip perumaippaduththuvean; nee aaseervaathamaay iruppaay.
unnai aaseervathikki'ravarka'lai aaseervathippean, unnaich sapikki'ravanaich sapippean; poomiyilu'l'la vamsangka'lellaam unakku'l aaseervathikkappadum en'raar.
karththar aapiraamukkuch sonnapadiyea avan pu'rappattuppoanaan; loaththum avanoadeakoodap poanaan. aapiraam aaraanaivittup pu'rappattapoathu, ezhupaththainthu vayathu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

aapiraam than manaiviyaakiya saaraayaiyum, than sakoatharanudaiya kumaaranaakiya loaththaiyum, thaangka'l sampaathiththiruntha thangka'l sampaththellaavat'raiyum, aaraanilea savathariththa janangka'laiyum koottikko'ndu, avarka'l kaanaan theasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoay, kaanaan theasaththil searnthaarka'l.
aapiraam anthath theasaththil sut'riththirinthu seekeam ennum idaththukkuch sameepamaana moarea ennum samapoomimattum vanthaan; akkaalaththilea kaanaaniyar aththeasaththil irunthaarka'l.
karththar aapiraamukkuth tharisanamaaki: un santhathikku inthath theasaththaik koduppean en'raar. appozhuthu avan thanakkuth tharisanamaana karththarukku angkea oru palipeedaththaik kattinaan.

pinpu avan avvidamvittup peyarnthu, peththealukkuk kizhakkea irukkum malaikkup poay, peththeal thanakku mea'rkaakavum aayee kizhakkaakavum irukkak koodaarampoattu, angkea karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik katti, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndaan.
athinpin aapiraam pu'rappattu, the'rkea pirayaa'nampa'n'nikko'ndupoanaan.
aththeasaththilea pagncham u'ndaayit'ru; theasaththilea pagncham kodithaayirunthapadiyaal, aapiraam ekipthu theasaththilea thangkumpadi avvidaththukkup poanaan.
avan ekipthukkuch sameepamaay vanthapoathu, than manaivi saaraayaip paarththu: nee paarvaikku azhaku'l'la sthiree en'ru a'rivean.
ekipthiyar unnaik kaa'numpoathu, iva'l avanudaiya manaivi en'ru solli, ennaik kon'rupoattu, unnai uyiroadea vaippaarka'l.
aakaiyaal, unnimiththam enakku nanmai u'ndaakumpadikkum, unnaalea en uyir pizhaikkumpadikkum, nee unnai en sakoathari en'ru sol en'raan.
aapiraam ekipthilea vanthapoathu, ekipthiyar antha sthireeyai mikuntha azhaku'l'lava'len'ru ka'ndaarka'l.
paarvoanudaiya pirapukka'lum ava'laik ka'ndu, paarvoanukku munpaaka ava'laip pukazhnthaarka'l. appozhuthu antha sthiree paarvoanudaiya aramanaikkuk ko'ndupoakappattaa'l.
ava'l nimiththam avan aapiraamukkuth thayaipaaraattinaan; avanukku aadumaaduka'lum, kazhuthaika'lum, vealaikkaararum, vealaikkaarika'lum, koa'likaik kazhuthaika'lum, ottakangka'lum kidaiththathu.
aapiraamudaiya manaiviyaakiya saaraayin nimiththam karththar paarvoanaiyum, avan veettaaraiyum makaa vaathaika'laal vaathiththaar.
appozhuthu paarvoan aapiraamai azhaiththu: nee enakku ean ippadich seythaay? iva'l un manaivi en'ru nee enakku a'riviyaama'rpoanathenna?
iva'lai un sakoathari en'ru nee sollavea'nduvathu enna? iva'lai naan enakku manaiviyaakakko'ndiruppeanea; ithoa un manaivi; iva'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoa en'ru sonnaan.
paarvoan avanaik ku'riththuth than manusharukkuk katta'lai koduththaan; avarka'l avanaiyum, avan manaiviyaiyum avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum anuppivittaarka'l.
aapiraamum, avan manaiviyum, avanukku u'ndaana yaavum, avanudanea loaththum, ekipthai vittu, thenthisaiyil vanthaarka'l.
aapiraam mirukajeevanka'lum ve'l'liyum ponnumaana aasthika'lai udaiya seemaanaayirunthaan.
avan than pirayaa'nangka'lilea the'rkeayirunthu peththealmattum, peththealukkum aayeekkum naduvaakath thaan munpu koodaarampoattathum,
thaan muthalmuthal oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakkinathumaana sthalamattum poanaan; angkea aapiraam karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndaan.
aapiraamudanea vantha loaththukkum aadumaaduka'lum koodaarangka'lum irunthana.
avarka'l orumiththuk kudiyirukka anthap poomi avarka'laith thaangkakkoodaathirunthathu; avarka'ludaiya aasthi mikuthiyaayirunthapadiyaal, avarka'l orumiththu vaasampa'n'na eathuvillaama'rpoayit'ru.
aapiraamudaiya manthaimeaypparukkum loaththudaiya manthaimeaypparukkum vaakkuvaatham u'ndaayit'ru. akkaalaththilea kaanaaniyarum perisiyarum aththeasaththil kudiyirunthaarka'l.
aapiraam loaththai noakki: enakkum unakkum, en meaypparukkum un meaypparukkum vaakkuvaatham vea'ndaam; naam sakoatharar.

inthath theasamellaam unakkumun irukki'rathu allavaa? nee ennaivittup pirinthupoakalaam; nee idathupu'ram poanaal, naan valathupu'ram poaki'rean; nee valathupu'ram poanaal, naan idathupu'ram poaki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu loaththu than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaarththu: yoarthaan nathikku arukaana samapoomi muzhuvathum neerva'lam porunthinathaayirukkakka'ndaan. karththar soathoamaiyum komoaraavaiyum azhikkummunnea, soavaarukkup poam vazhimattum athu karththarudaiya thoattaththaippoalavum ekipthu theasaththaippoalavum irunthathu.
appozhuthu loaththu yoarthaanukku arukaana samapoomi muzhuvathaiyum therinthuko'ndu, kizhakkea pirayaa'nappattuppoanaan; ippadi avarka'l oruvarai oruvar vittup pirinthaarka'l.
aapiraam kaanaan theasaththil kudiyirunthaan; loaththu antha yoarthaanukku arukaana samapoomiyilu'l'la patta'nangka'lil vaasampa'n'ni, soathoamukku nearea koodaaram poattaan.
soathoamin janangka'l pollaathavarka'lum karththarukku munpaaka makaa paavika'lumaay irunthaarka'l.
loaththu aapiraamaivittup pirinthapinpu, karththar aapiraamai noakki: un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, nee irukki'ra idaththilirunthu vadakkeayum, the'rkeayum, kizhakkeayum, mea'rkeayum noakkippaar.
nee paarkki'ra inthap poomi muzhuvathaiyum naan unakkum un santhathikkum en'raikkum irukkumpadi koduththu,
un santhathiyaip poomiyin thoo'laippoalap perukappa'n'nuvean; oruvan poomiyin thoo'lai e'n'nakkoodumaanaal, un santhathiyum e'n'nappadum.
nee ezhunthu theasaththin nee'lamum akalamum emmattoa, ammattum nadanthu thiri; unakku athaith tharuvean en'raar.
appozhuthu aapiraam koodaaraththaip peyarththukko'ndupoay, epiroanilirukkum mamreayin samapoomiyil searnthu kudiyirunthu, angkea karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattinaan.
sineyaarin raajaavaakiya amraappealum, ealaasaarin raajaavaakiya ariyoakum, ealaamin raajaavaakiya ketharlaakoamearum, jaathika'lin raajaavaakiya thithiyaalum iruntha naadka'lil;

avarka'l soathoamin raajaavaakiya pearaavoadum, komoaraavin raajaavaakiya pirsaavoadum, athmaavin raajaavaakiya sineyaavoadum, sepoayeemin raajaavaakiya semeaparoadum, soavaar ennum pealaavin raajaavoadum yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
ivarka'lellaarum uppukkadalaakiya siththeem pa'l'laththaakkilea koodinaarka'l.
ivarka'l pannira'ndu varusham ketharlaakoamearaich seaviththu, pathinmoon'raam varushaththilea kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l.

pathinaalaam varushaththilea ketharlaakoamearum, avanoadea koodiyiruntha raajaakka'lum vanthu, astharoathkarnaayeemilea iruntha reppaayeemiyaraiyum, kaamilea iruntha soosimiyaraiyum, saaveakeeriyaththaayeemilea iruntha eamiyaraiyum,
seayeer malaika'lil iruntha oariyaraiyum, vanaantharaththukku arukaana elpaaraanmattum mu'riyadiththu,
thirumpik kaatheas ennum enmispaaththukku vanthu, amaleakkiyarudaiya naadanaiththaiyum, athsaathsoan thaamaarilea kudiyiruntha emoariyaraiyumkoodach sangkariththaarka'l.
appozhuthu soathoamin raajaavum, komoaraavin raajaavum, athmaavin raajaavum, sepoayeemin raajaavum, soavaar ennum pealaavin raajaavum pu'rappattuch siththeem pa'l'laththaakkilea,

ealaamin raajaavaakiya ketharlaakoamearoadum, jaathika'lin raajaavaakiya thithiyaaloadum, sineyaarin raajaavaakiya amraappealoadum, ealaasaarin raajaavaakiya ariyoakoadum yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattu, antha ainthu raajaakka'loadum intha naalu raajaakka'lum yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

anthach siththeem pa'l'laththaakku engkum nilakkeel u'ndaakum kea'nika'l irunthathu. soathoam komoaraavin raajaakka'l mu'rinthoadi angkea vizhunthaarka'l; meenthavarka'l malaika'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l soathoamilum komoaraavilumu'l'la poru'lka'l ellaavat'raiyum, poajanapathaarththangka'l ellaavat'raiyum eduththukko'ndu poayvittaarka'l.
aapiraamin sakoatharanudaiya kumaaranaakiya loaththu soathoamilea kudiyirunthapadiyaal, avanaiyum, avan poru'lka'laiyum ko'ndupoayvittaarka'l.

thappiyoadina oruvan epireyanaakiya aapiraamidaththil vanthu athai a'riviththaan; aapiraam thannoadea udanpadikkai seythiruntha manitharaakiya eskoalukkum aanearukkum sakoatharanaakiya mamrea ennum emoariyanudaiya samapoomiyilea appozhuthu kudiyirunthaan.

than sakoatharan si'raiyaakak ko'ndupoakappattathai aapiraam kea'lvippattapoathu, avan than veettilea pi'rantha kaipadinthavarka'laakiya munnoot'rup pathinettu aadka'lukkum aayutham tharippiththu, thaa'n ennum oormattum avarka'laith thodarnthu,
iraakkaalaththilea avanum avan vealaikkaararum pirinthu, pavignchuka'laay avarka'lmeal vizhunthu, avarka'lai mu'riyadiththu, thamaskuvukku idathupu'ramaana oapaamattum thuraththi,
sakala poru'lka'laiyum thiruppikko'nduvanthaan; than sakoatharanaakiya loaththaiyum, avanudaiya poru'lka'laiyum, sthireeka'laiyum, janangka'laiyum thiruppikko'nduvanthaan.

avan ketharlaakoamearaiyum, avanoadiruntha raajaakka'laiyum mu'riyadiththuth thirumpivaruki'rapoathu, soathoamin raajaa pu'rappattu, raajaavin pa'l'laththaakku ennum saavea pa'l'laththaakkumattum avanukku ethirko'ndupoanaan.
an'riyum, unnathamaana theavanudaiya aasaariyanaayiruntha saaleamin raajaavaakiya melkiseatheakku appamum thiraadcharasamum ko'nduvanthu,
avanai aaseervathiththu: vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum udaiyavaraakiya unnathamaana theavanudaiya aaseervaatham aapiraamukku u'ndaavathaaka.
un saththurukka'lai un kaiyil oppukkoduththa unnathamaana theavanukku sthoaththiram en'ru sonnaan. ivanukku aapiraam ellaavat'rilum thasamapaakam koduththaan.
soathoamin raajaa aapiraamai noakki: janangka'lai enakkuth thaarum, poru'lka'lai neer eduththukko'l'lum en'raan.

atha'rku, aapiraam soathoamin raajaavaip paarththu: aapiraamai aisuvariyavaanaakkinean en'ru neer sollaathapadikku naan oru sarattaiyaakilum paatharadchaiyin vaaraiyaakilum, umakku u'ndaanavaika'lil yaathon'raiyaakilum eduththukko'l'lean en'ru,
vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum udaiyavaraakiya unnathamaana theavanaakiya karththarukku nearaaka en kaiyai uyarththuki'rean.
vaalipar saappittathupoaka, ennudanea vantha aanear, eskoal, mamrea ennum purusharudaiya pangkumaaththiramea varavea'ndum; ivarka'l thangka'l pangkai eduththukko'l'lattum en'raan.

inthak kaariyangka'l nadanthapinpu, karththarudaiya vaarththai aapiraamukkuth tharisanaththilea u'ndaaki, avar: aapiraamea, nee payappadaathea; naan unakkuk keadakamum, unakku makaa periya palanumaayirukki'rean en'raar.

atha'rku aapiraam: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, adiyeanukku enna tharuveer? naan pi'l'laiyillaamal irukki'reanea; thamasku ooraanaakiya intha eliyeasar en veettu visaara'naikkarththanaay irukki'raanea en'raan.
pinnum aapiraam: theavareer enakkup puththirasanthaanam aru'lavillai; ithoa en veettilea pi'rantha pi'l'lai enakkuch suthantharavaa'liyaay irukki'raan en'raan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaaki: ivan unakkuch suthantharavaa'liyalla, un karppappi'rappaayiruppavanea unakkuch suthantharavaa'liyaavaan en'ru solli,

avar avanai ve'liyea azhaiththu: nee vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaar, nadchaththirangka'lai e'n'na unnaalea koodumaanaal, avaika'lai e'n'nu en'ru solli; pinpu avanai noakki: un santhathi ivva'n'namaay irukkum en'raar.
avan karththarai visuvaasiththaan, athai avar avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'ninaar.
pinnum avar avanai noakki: inthath theasaththai unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkumporuttu, unnai oor enki'ra kaltheayarudaiya patta'naththilirunthu azhaiththuvantha karththar naanea en'raar.
atha'rku avan: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, naan athaich suthanthariththukko'lvean en'ru ethinaal a'rivean en'raan.
atha'rku avar: moon'ru vayathuk kidaariyaiyum, moon'ru vayathu ve'l'laattaiyum, moon'ru vayathu aattukkadaavaiyum, oru kaattuppu'raavaiyum, oru pu'raakkugnchaiyum, ennidaththil ko'nduvaa en'raar.
avan avaika'l ellaavat'raiyum avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu, avaika'lai naduvaakath thu'ndiththu, thu'ndangka'lai on'rukkon'ru ethiraaka vaiththaan; padchika'lai avan thu'ndikkavillai.
pa'ravaika'l antha udalka'linmeal i'rangkina; avaika'lai aapiraam thuraththinaan.
sooriyan asthamikkumpoathu, aapiraamukku ayarntha niththirai vanthathu; thikilum kaariru'lum avanai moodikko'ndathu.

appozhuthu avar aapiraamai noakki: un santhathiyaar thangka'ludaiyathallaatha anniya theasaththilea paratheasika'laayirunthu, aththeasaththaaraich seavippaarka'l en'rum, avarka'laal naanoo'ru varusham upaththiravappaduvaarka'l en'rum, nee nichchayamaay a'riyakkadavaay.
ivarka'l seavikkum jaathika'lai naan niyaayantheerppean; pinpu mikuntha poru'lka'ludanea pu'rappattu varuvaarka'l.
nee samaathaanaththoadea un pithaakka'lidaththil searuvaay; nalla muthirvayathilea adakkampa'n'nappaduvaay.
naalaam thalaimu'raiyilea avarka'l ivvidaththukkuth thirumpa varuvaarka'l; eanen'raal emoariyarudaiya akkiramam innum ni'raivaakavillai en'raar.
sooriyan asthamiththuk kaariru'l u'ndaanapinpu, ithoa, pukaiki'ra soo'laiyum, anthath thu'ndangka'lin naduvea kadanthupoaki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyum thoan'rina.
annaa'lilea karththar aapiraamoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, ekipthin nathithuvakki aipiraaththu nathi ennum periya nathimattumu'l'lathum,
keaniyarum, kenisiyarum, kathmoaniyarum,
eaththiyarum, perisiyarum, reppaayeemiyarum,
emoariyarum, kaanaaniyarum, kirkaasiyarum, epoosiyarum enpavarka'l irukki'rathumaana inthath theasaththai un santhathikkuk koduththean en'raar.
aapiraamudaiya manaiviyaakiya saaraaykkup pi'l'laiyillaathirunthathu. ekipthu theasaththaa'laakiya aakaar ennum pearko'nda oru adimaippe'n ava'lukku irunthaa'l.

saaraay aapiraamai noakki: naan pi'l'laipe'raathapadikkuk karththar en karppaththai adaiththirukki'raar; en adimaippe'n'noadea searum, oruvea'lai ava'laal en veedu kattappadum en'raa'l. saaraayin vaarththaikku aapiraam sevikoduththaan.

aapiraam kaanaantheasaththil paththu varusham kudiyirunthapinpu, aapiraamin manaiviyaakiya saaraay ekipthu theasaththaa'laana than adimaippe'n'naakiya aakaarai azhaiththu, ava'laith than purushanaakiya aapiraamukku ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakak koduththaa'l.
avan aakaaroadea searnthapoathu, ava'l karppanthariththaa'l; ava'l thaan karppavathiyaanathaik ka'ndapoathu, than naachchiyaarai a'rpamaaka e'n'ninaa'l.

appozhuthu saaraay aapiraamai noakki: enakku nearitta aniyaayam umathumeal sumarum; en adimaippe'n'nai ummudaiya madiyilea koduththean; ava'l thaan karppavathiyaanathaik ka'ndu ennai a'rpamaaka e'n'nuki'raa'l; karththar enakkum umakkum nadunin'ru niyaayantheerppaaraaka en'raa'l.

atha'rku aapiraam saaraayai noakki: ithoa, un adimaippe'n un kaikku'l irukki'raa'l; un paarvaikku nalamaanapadi ava'lukkuch sey en'raan. appozhuthu saaraay ava'laik kadinamaay nadaththinapadiyaal ava'l ava'laivittu oadippoanaa'l.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar ava'lai vanaantharaththilea soorukkuppoaki'ra vazhiyarukea irukki'ra neeroot'ra'ndaiyil ka'ndu:
saaraayin adimaippe'n'naakiya aakaarea, engkeayirunthu varuki'raay? engkea poaki'raay? en'ru keattaar; ava'l: naan en naachchiyaaraakiya saaraayaivittu oadippoaki'rean en'raa'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar: nee un naachchiyaara'ndaikkuth thirumpippoay, ava'l kaiyinkeezh adangkiyiru en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar ava'lai noakki: un santhathiyai mikavum perukappa'n'nuvean; athu peruki, e'n'nimudiyaathathaayirukkum en'raar.

pinnum karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar ava'lai noakki: nee karppavathiyaayirukki'raay, oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaay; karththar un angkalaayppaik keattapadiyinaal, avanukku ismaveal en'ru peariduvaayaaka.
avan thushdamanushanaayiruppaan; avanudaiya kai ellaarukkum viroathamaakavum, ellaarudaiya kaiyum avanukku viroathamaakavum irukkum; than sakoatharar ellaarukkum ethiraakak kudiyiruppaan en'raar.
appozhuthu ava'l: ennaik kaa'npavarai naanum ivvidaththil ka'ndean allavaa en'ru solli, thannoadea peasina karththarukku neer ennaik kaa'nki'ra theavan en'ru pearittaa'l.
aakaiyaal, anthath thuravu peyar lakaayroayee ennappattathu; athu kaatheasukkum paareaththukkum naduvea irukki'rathu.
aakaar aapiraamukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; aapiraam aakaar pet'ra than kumaaranukku ismaveal en'ru pearittaan.
aakaar aapiraamukku ismavealaip pet'rapoathu, aapiraam e'npaththaa'ru vayathaayirunthaan.
aapiraam tho'n'noot'ronpathu vayathaanapoathu, karththar aapiraamukkuth tharisanamaaki: naan sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan; nee enakku munpaaka nadanthuko'ndu uththamanaayiru.
naan unakkum enakkum naduvaaka en udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththi, unnai mikavum thira'laayp perukappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
appozhuthu aapiraam mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangkinaan. theavan avanoadea peasi:
naan unnoadea pa'n'nuki'ra en udanpadikkai ennaven'raal, nee thira'laana jaathika'lukkuth thakappanaavaay.
ini un pear aapiraam ennappadaamal, naan unnaith thira'laana jaathika'lukkuth thakappanaaka ea'rpaduththinapadiyaal, un pear aapirakaam ennappadum.
unnai mikavum athikamaayp palukappa'n'ni, unnilea jaathika'lai u'ndaakkuvean; unnidaththilirunthu raajaakka'l thoan'ruvaarka'l.

unakkum unakkup pinvarum un santhathikkum naan theavanaayirukkumpadi enakkum unakkum, unakkuppin thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka varum un santhathikkum naduvea, en udanpadikkaiyai niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka sthaapippean.
nee paratheasiyaayth thangkivaruki'ra kaanaan theasamuzhuvathaiyum, unakkum unakkup pinvarum un santhathikkum niththiya suthantharamaakak koduththu, naan avarka'lukkuth theavanaayiruppean en'raar.
pinnum theavan aapirakaamai noakki: ippozhuthu neeyum, unakkup pin thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka varum un santhathiyum, en udanpadikkaiyaik kaikko'l'lungka'l.

enakkum ungka'lukkum, unakkup pinvarum un santhathikkum naduvea u'ndaaki'rathum, neengka'l kaikko'l'lavea'ndiyathumaana en udanpadikkai ennaven'raal, ungka'lukku'l pi'rakkum sakala aa'npi'l'laika'lum viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappadavea'ndum;
ungka'l nuniththoalin maamsaththai viruththaseathanampa'n'nakkadaveerka'l; athu enakkum ungka'lukkumu'l'la udanpadikkaikku adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum.

ungka'lil thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakap pi'rakkum aa'npi'l'laika'lellaam ettaamnaa'lilea viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadavea'ndum; veettilea pi'rantha pi'l'laiyum un viththallaatha anniyanidaththil pa'naththi'rkuk ko'l'lappatta enthap pi'l'laiyum, appadiyea viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadavea'ndum.

un veettilea pi'rantha pi'l'laiyum, un pa'naththi'rkuk ko'l'lappattavanum, viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappadavea'ndiyathu avasiyam; ippadi en udanpadikkai ungka'l maamsaththilea niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka irukkakkadavathu.

nuniththoalin maamsam viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadaathirukki'ra nuniththoalu'l'la aa'npi'l'laiyirunthaal, antha aaththumaa en udanpadikkaiyai mee'rinapadiyaal, than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'raar.
pinnum theavan aapirakaamai noakki: un manaivi saaraayai ini saaraay en'ru azhaiyaathiruppaayaaka; saaraa'l enpathu ava'lukkup pearaayirukkum.
naan ava'lai aaseervathiththu, ava'laalea unakku oru kumaaranaiyum tharuvean; ava'l jaathika'lukkuth thaayaakavum, ava'laalea jaathika'lin raajaakka'l u'ndaakavum, ava'lai aaseervathippean en'raar.

appozhuthu aapirakaam mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu nakaiththu: noo'ruvayathaanavanukkup pi'l'lai pi'rakkumoa? tho'n'noo'ru vayathaana saaraa'l pi'l'lai pe'ruvaa'loa? en'ru than iruthayaththilea sollikko'ndu,
ismaveal umakku munpaakap pizhaippaanaaka! en'ru aapirakaam theavanidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu theavan: un manaiviyaakiya saaraa'l nichchayamaay unakku oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l, avanukku eesaakku en'ru peariduvaayaaka; en udanpadikkaiyai avanukkum avanukkup pinvarum avan santhathikkum niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka sthaapippean.

ismavealukkaakavum nee seytha vi'n'nappaththaik keattean; naan avanai aaseervathiththu, avanai mikavum athikamaakap palukavum perukavum pa'n'nuvean; avan pannira'ndu pirapukka'laip pe'ruvaan; avanaip periya jaathiyaakkuvean.
varuki'ra varushaththil ku'riththakaalaththilea saaraa'l unakkup pe'rappoaki'ra eesaakkoadea naan en udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththuvean en'raar.
theavan aapirakaamoadea peasi mudinthapinpu, avar avanaivittu ezhuntharu'linaar.

appozhuthu aapirakaam than kumaaranaakiya ismavealaiyum, than veettilea pi'rantha yaavaraiyum, thaan pa'naththi'rkuk ko'nda anaivarumaakiya than veettilu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'l ellaaraiyum searththu, theavan thanakkuch sonnapadi, avarka'l nuniththoalin maamsaththai annaa'lileathaanea viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan.
aapirakaamudaiya nuniththoalin maamsam viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadumpoathu, avan tho'n'noot'ronpathu vayathaayirunthaan.
avanudaiya kumaaran ismavealudaiya nuniththoalin maamsam viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadumpoathu, avan pathinmoon'ru vayathaayirunthaan.
oreanaa'lil aapirakaamum avan kumaaran ismavealum viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappattaarka'l.
veettilea pi'ranthavarka'lum anniyaridaththilea pa'naththi'rkuk ko'l'lappattavarka'lumaakiya avan veettu manusharka'l ellaarum avanoadeakooda viruththaseathanampa'n'nappattaarka'l.
pinpu karththar mamreayin samapoomiyilea avanukkuth tharisanamaanaar. avan pakalin ush'navea'laiyil koodaaravaasalilea udkaarnthirunthu,

than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkumpoathu, ithoa, moon'ru purushar avanukku ethirea nin'raarka'l; avarka'laik ka'ndavudanea, avan koodaaravaasalilirunthu avarka'lukku ethirko'ndu oadith tharaimattum kuninthu:
aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaiththathaanaal, neer umathu adiyeanaivittuk kadanthupoakavea'ndaam.
kogncham tha'n'neer ko'nduvarattum, ungka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvi, maraththadiyil saaynthuko'ndirungka'l.

neengka'l ungka'l iruthayangka'laith thidappaduththak kogncham appam ko'nduvaruki'rean; appu'ram neengka'l ungka'l vazhiyea poakalaam; itha'rkaakavea adiyean idamvaraikkum vantheerka'l en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: nee sonnapadi sey en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu aapirakaam theeviramaayk koodaaraththil saaraa'lidaththi'rkup poay: nee seekkiramaay moon'rupadi melliya maavu eduththup pisainthu, appam sudu en'raan.
aapirakaam maattumanthaikku oadi, oru nalla i'langkan'raip pidiththu, vealaikkaaran kaiyilea koduththaan; avan athaich seekkiraththil samaiththaan.
aapirakaam ve'n'neyaiyum paalaiyum samaippiththa kan'raiyum eduththuvanthu, avarka'l munpaaka vaiththu, avarka'l arukea maraththadiyil nin'ruko'ndirunthaan; avarka'l pusiththaarka'l.
avarka'l avanai noakki: un manaivi saaraa'l engkea en'raarka'l? athoa koodaaraththil irukki'raa'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avar: oru u'rpavakaalaththittaththil nichchayamaay unnidaththi'rkuth thirumpa varuvean; appozhuthu un manaiviyaakiya saaraa'lukku oru kumaaran iruppaan en'raar. saaraa'l avarukkup pinpu'ramaayk koodaaravaasalil ithaik keattukko'ndirunthaa'l.
aapirakaamum saaraa'lum vayathusen'ru muthirnthavarka'laayirunthaarka'l; sthireeka'lukku'l'la vazhipaadu saaraa'lukku nin'rupoayit'ru.
aakaiyaal, saaraa'l than u'l'laththilea nakaiththu: naan kizhaviyum, en aa'ndavan muthirntha vayathu'l'lavarumaana pinpu, enakku inpam u'ndaayirukkumoa en'raa'l.
appozhuthu karththar aapirakaamai noakki: saaraa'l nakaiththu, naan kizhaviyaayirukkap pi'l'laipe'ruvathu meyyoa en'ru solvaanean?
karththaraal aakaatha kaariyam u'ndoa? u'rpavakaalaththittaththil unnidaththi'rkuth thirumpa varuvean; appozhuthu saaraa'lukku oru kumaaran iruppaan en'raar.
saaraa'l payanthu, naan nakaikkavillai en'ru ma'ruththaa'l. atha'rku avar: illai, nee nakaiththaay en'raar.
pinpu anthap purushar ezhunthu avvidam vittu, soathoamai noakkip poanaarka'l; aapirakaamum avarka'loadea koodappoay vazhivittanuppinaan.
appozhuthu karththar: aapirakaam periya palaththa jaathiyaavathinaalum, avanukku'l poomiyilu'l'la sakala jaathika'lum aaseervathikkappaduvathinaalum,
naan seyyappoaki'rathai aapirakaamukku ma'raippeanoa?

karththar aapirakaamukkuch sonnathai ni'raiveat'rumpadiyaay avan than pi'l'laika'lukkum, thanakkup pinvarum than veettaarukkum: neengka'l neethiyaiyum niyaayaththaiyum seythu, karththarudaiya vazhiyaik kaaththu nadavungka'l en'ru katta'laiyiduvaan enpathai a'rinthirukki'rean en'raar.
pinpu karththar soathoam komoaraavin kookkural perithaayiruppathinaalum, avaika'lin paavam mikavum kodithaayiruppathinaalum,
naan i'rangkippoay, ennidaththil vanthu ettina athin kookkuralinpadiyea avarka'l seythirukki'raarka'loa illaiyoa en'ru paarththu a'rivean en'raar.
appozhuthu anthap purushar avvidam vittuch soathoamai noakkip poanaarka'l; aapirakaamoa pinnum karththarukku munpaaka nin'ruko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu aapirakaam sameepamaaych searnthu: thunmaarkkanoadea neethimaanaiyum azhippeeroa?
patta'naththukku'l'lea oruvea'lai aimpathu neethimaanka'l iruppaarka'l, atha'rku'l irukkum antha aimpathu neethimaanka'lnimiththam iradchiyaamal antha sthalaththai azhippeeroa?

thunmaarkkanoadea neethimaanaiyum sangkarippathu umakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; neethimaanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum samamaay nadappippathu umakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; sarvaloaka niyaayaathipathi neethiseyyaathiruppaaroa en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: naan soathoamil aimpathu neethimaanka'laik ka'ndaal, avarka'l nimiththam antha sthalamuzhuthaiyum iradchippean en'raar.
appozhuthu aapirakaam pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, thoo'lum saampalumaayirukki'ra adiyean aa'ndavaroadea peasaththu'ninthean.

oruvea'lai aimpathu neethimaanka'lukku ainthupear ku'rainthiruppaarka'l; antha ainthupearnimiththam patta'namuzhuthaiyum azhippeeroa en'raan. atha'rku avar: naan naa'rpaththainthu neethimaanka'lai angkea ka'ndaal, athai azhippathillai en'raar.
avan pinnum avaroadea peasi: naa'rpathu neethimaanka'l angkea kaa'nappattaaloa en'raan. atha'rku avar: naa'rpathu neethimaanka'lnimiththam athai azhippathillai en'raar.

appozhuthu avan: naan innum peasuki'rean, aa'ndavarukkuk koapam varaamaliruppathaaka; muppathu neethimaanka'l angkea kaa'nappattaaloa en'raan. atha'rku avar: naan muppathu neethimaanka'lai angkea ka'ndaal, athai azhippathillai en'raar.
appozhuthu avan: ithoa, aa'ndavaroadea peasaththu'ninthean; irupathu neethimaanka'l angkea kaa'nappattaaloa en'raan. atha'rku avar: irupathu neethimaanka'lnimiththam athai azhippathillai en'raar.

appozhuthu avan: aa'ndavarukkuk koapam varaathiruppathaaka; naan innum intha oruvisaimaaththiram peasuki'rean; paththu neethimaanka'l angkea kaa'nappattaaloa en'raan. atha'rku avar: paththu neethimaanka'lnimiththam athai azhippathillai en'raar.
karththar aapirakaamoadea peasi mudinthapinpu poayvittaar; aapirakaamum thannudaiya idaththukkuth thirumpinaan.
antha ira'ndu thootharum saayangkaalaththilea soathoamukku vanthaarka'l; loaththu soathoamin vaasalilea udkaarnthirunthaan. avarka'laik ka'ndu, loaththu ezhunthu ethirko'ndu tharaimattum kuninthu:

aa'ndavanmaarka'lea, adiyeanudaiya veettu mukamaay neengka'l thirumpi, ungka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvi, iraaththangki, kaalaiyil ezhunthu pirayaa'nappattup poakalaam en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: appadiyalla, veethiyilea iraaththangkuvoam en'raarka'l.

avan avarka'lai mikavum varunthik keattukko'ndaan; appozhuthu avanidaththi'rkuth thirumpi, avan veettilea piraveasiththaarka'l. avan pu'lippillaa appangka'laich suttu, avarka'lukku virunthupa'n'ninaan, avarka'l pusiththaarka'l.
avarka'l padukkum munnea, soathoam patta'naththu manitharaakiya vaaliparmuthal kizhavarmattumu'l'la janangka'l anaivarum naanaathisaika'lilumirunthu vanthu, veettaich soozhnthuko'ndu,
loaththaik kooppittu: intha iraaththiri unnidaththil vantha manushar engkea? naangka'l avarka'lai a'riyumpadikku avarka'lai engka'lidaththil ve'liyea ko'nduvaa en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu loaththu vaasalukku ve'liyea vanthu, thanakkup pinnaalea kathavaip pootti, avarka'lidaththil poay:
sakoathararea, intha akkiramam seyyavea'ndaam.

ithoa, purusharai a'riyaatha ira'ndu kumaaraththika'l enakku u'ndu; avarka'lai ungka'lidaththi'rku ve'liyea ko'nduvaruki'rean, avarka'lukku ungka'l ishdappadi seyyungka'l; inthap purushar en kooraiyin nizhalilea vanthapadiyaal, ivarka'lukku maaththiram on'rum seyyavea'ndaam en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l: appaalea poa; paratheasiyaay vantha ivanaa niyaayam peasuki'rathu? ippozhuthu avarka'lukkuch seyvathaippaarkkilum unakku athika pollaappuch seyvoam en'ru solli, loaththu enpavanai mikavum nerukkik kathavai udaikkak kittinaarka'l.
appozhuthu anthap purusharka'l thangka'l kaika'lai ve'liyea neetti, loaththaith thangka'l a'ndaikku veettukku'l izhuththukko'ndu, kathavaip pootti,
theruvaasaliliruntha si'riyoarum periyoarumaakiya manitharukkuk kuruttaattam pidikkappa'n'ninaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'l vaasalaith theadiththeadi aluththuppoanaarka'l.

pinpu anthap purushar loaththai noakki: ivvidaththil innum unakku yaar irukki'raarka'l? marumakanaavathu, un kumaararaavathu, un kumaaraththika'laavathu, patta'naththil unakkuriya evarka'laavathu irunthaal, avarka'lai intha sthalaththilirunthu ve'liyea azhaiththukko'ndupoa.
naangka'l intha sthalaththai azhikkappoaki'roam; ivarka'l kookkural karththarudaiya samukaththil perithaayirukki'rathu; ithai azhikkak karththar engka'lai anuppinaar en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu loaththu pu'rappattu, than kumaaraththika'lai vivaakampa'n'nappoaki'ra than marumakka'lmaaroadea peasi: neengka'l ezhunthu intha sthalaththai vittup pu'rappadungka'l; karththar inthap patta'naththai azhikkappoaki'raar en'raan; avanudaiya marumakka'lmaarin paarvaikku avan pariyaasampa'n'nuki'rathaakak ka'ndathu.

kizhakku ve'lukkumpoathu anthath thoothar loaththai noakki: patta'naththi'rku varum tha'ndanaiyil nee azhiyaathapadikku ezhunthu, un manaiviyaiyum, ingkea irukki'ra un ira'ndu kumaaraththika'laiyum azhaiththukko'ndupoa en'ru solli, avanaith thurithappaduththinaarka'l.

avan thaamathiththukko'ndirukkumpoathu, karththar avanmeal vaiththa irakkaththinaalea, anthap purushar avan kaiyaiyum, avan manaiviyin kaiyaiyum, avan ira'ndu kumaaraththika'lin kaiyaiyum pidiththu, avanaip patta'naththi'rku ve'liyea ko'ndupoay vittaarka'l.
avarka'lai ve'liyea ko'ndupoay vittapinpu, avar: un jeevan thappa oadippoa, pinnittup paaraathea; inthach samapoomiyil engkum nillaathea; nee azhiyaathapadikku malaikku oadippoa en'raar.
atha'rku loaththu: appadiyalla aa'ndavarea,

umathu ka'nka'lil umathu adiyeanukkuk kirupai kidaiththathea; en piraa'nanaik kaakkath theavareer enakkuch seytha kirupaiyaip perithaaka vi'langkappa'n'nineer; malaikku oadippoaka ennaal mudiyaathu, theengku ennaith thodarum, naan mariththuppoavean.

athoa, antha oor irukki'rathea, naan atha'rku oadippoakaththakkathaay athu kitta irukki'rathu, sinnathumaay irukki'rathu; en piraa'nan pizhaikka naan angkea oadippoakattum, athu sinna oorthaanea en'raan.
atha'rku avar: nee keattukko'nda oorai naan kavizhththuppoadaathapadikku, intha vishayaththilum unakku anukkirakam pa'n'ninean.
theeviramaay angkea oadith thappiththuk ko'l; nee angkea poaych searumattum naan on'rum seyyakkoodaathu en'raar; aakaiyaal antha oor soavaar ennappattathu.
loaththu soavaarukku'l varumpoathu poomiyinmeal sooriyan uthiththathu.
appozhuthu karththar soathoaminmealum komoaraavinmealum, karththaraalea vaanaththilirunthu kanthakaththaiyum akkiniyaiyum varushikkappa'n'ni,
anthap patta'nangka'laiyum, anthach samapoomiyanaiththaiyum, anthap patta'nangka'lin ellaak kudika'laiyum, poomiyin payiraiyum azhiththuppoattaar.
avan manaiviyoa pinnittup paarththu, uppuththoo'n aanaa'l.
vidiya'rkaalaththil aapirakaam ezhunthu, thaan karththarukku munpaaka nin'ra idaththi'rkup poay,
soathoam komoaraa patta'nangka'lin thisaiyaiyum, samapoomiyaakiya theasam muzhuvathaiyum noakkip paarththaan; anthap poomiyin pukai soo'laiyin pukaiyaippoala ezhumpit'ru.

theavan anthach samapoomiyin patta'nangka'lai azhikkumpoathu, theavan aapirakaamai ninaiththu, loaththu kudiyiruntha patta'nangka'laith thaam kavizhththuppoadukaiyil, loaththai antha azhivin naduvilirunthu thappippoakumpadi anuppivittaar.

pinpu loaththu soavaarilea kudiyirukkap payanthu, soavaarai vittuppoay, avanum avanoadeakooda avanudaiya ira'ndu kumaaraththika'lum malaiyilea vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l; angkea avanum avanudaiya ira'ndu kumaaraththika'lum oru kepiyilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu mooththava'l i'laiyava'laip paarththu: nammudaiya thakappan muthirvayathaanaar, poomiyengkum nadakki'ra mu'raimaiyinpadiyea nammoadea searap poomiyilea oru purushanum illai.
nammudaiya thakappanaal santhathi u'ndaakumpadikku, avarukku mathuvaik kudikkakkoduththu, avaroadea sayanippoam vaa en'raa'l.

appadiyea an'ru iravilea, thangka'l thakappanukku mathuvaik kudikkak koduththaarka'l. mooththava'l poay, than thakappanoadea sayaniththaa'l; ava'l sayaniththathaiyum ezhunthirunthathaiyum avan u'naraathirunthaan.

ma'runaa'lilea mooththava'l i'laiyava'laip paarththu: neat'ru raaththiri naan thakappanoadea sayaniththean; in'ru raaththiriyum mathuvaik kudikkak koduppoam, nammudaiya thakappanaal santhathi u'ndaakumpadi nee poay avaroadea sayani en'raa'l.

appadiyea an'ru raaththiriyilum thangka'l thakappanukku mathuvaik kudikkak koduththaarka'l. appozhuthu i'laiyava'l ezhunthupoay, avanoadea sayaniththaa'l; ava'l sayaniththathaiyum ezhunthirunthathaiyum avan u'naraathirunthaan.
ivvithamaay loaththin kumaaraththika'l iruvarum thangka'l thakappanaalea karppavathiyaanaarka'l.
mooththava'l oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukku moavaap en'ru pearittaa'l; avan innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra moavaapiyarukkuth thakappan.
i'laiyava'lum oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukkup pennammi en'ru pearittaa'l; avan innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra ammoan puththirarukkuth thakappan.
aapirakaam avvidam vittu, then theasaththi'rkup pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, kaatheasukkum soorukkum naduvaakak kudiyea'ri, kearaarilea thangkinaan.
angkea aapirakaam than manaiviyaakiya saaraa'laith than sakoathari en'ru sonnathinaalea, kearaarin raajaavaakiya apimeleakku aa'l anuppich saaraa'lai azhaippiththaan.
theavan iravilea apimeleakkukkuch soppanaththilea thoan'ri: nee azhaippiththa sthireeyinimiththam nee seththaay; ava'l oruvanudaiya manaiviyaayirukki'raa'lea en'raar.
apimeleakku ava'laich searaathirunthaan. aakaiyaal avan: aa'ndavarea, neethiyu'l'la janangka'lai azhippeeroa?
iva'l than sakoathari en'ru avan ennoadea sollavillaiyaa? avan than sakoatharan en'ru iva'lum sonnaa'lea; uththama iruthayaththoadum suththamaana kaika'loadum ithaich seythean en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu theavan: uththama iruthayaththoadea nee ithaich seythaay en'ru naan a'rinthirukki'rean; nee enakku viroathamaakap paavam seyyaathapadikku unnaith thaduththean; aakaiyaal, nee ava'laith thoda naan unakku idangkodukkavillai.

antha manushanudaiya manaiviyai avanidaththi'rku anuppividu; avan oru theerkkatharisi; nee pizhaikkumpadikku avan unakkaaka vea'nduthal seyvaan; nee ava'lai anuppividaathirunthaal, neeyum unnaich searntha yaavarum saakavea saaveerka'l en'ru a'rivaayaaka en'ru soppanaththilea avanukkuch sonnaar.
apimeleakku athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, than oozhiyakkaararaiyellaam azhaippiththu, inthach sangkathika'laiyellaam avarka'l keadkumpadi sonnaan; antha manushar mikavum payanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu apimeleakku aapirakaamai azhaippiththu: nee engka'lukku enna kaariyagnseythaay, nee enmealum, en raajyaththinmealum kodiya paavam sumarappa'n'nuki'ratha'rku unakku naan enna kut'ram seythean? seyyaththakaatha kaariyangka'lai ennidaththil seythaayea en'raan.
pinnum apimeleakku aapirakaamai noakki: ennaththaik ka'ndu nee inthak kaariyaththaich seythaay en'raan.
atha'rku aapirakaam: ivvidaththil theyvapayam illaiyen'rum, en manaiviyinimiththam ennaik kon'rupoaduvaarka'l en'rum naan ninaiththean.
ava'l en sakoathari enpathum meythaan; ava'l en thakappanukkuk kumaaraththi, en thaaykkuk kumaaraththiyalla; ava'l enakku manaiviyaanaa'l.

en thakappan veettaivittu theavan ennaith theasaanthariyaayth thiriyumpadi seythapoathu, naan ava'lai noakki: naam poakum idamengkum, nee ennaich sakoatharan en'ru solvathu nee enakkuch seyyavea'ndiya thayai en'ru ava'lidaththil solliyirunthean en'raan.
appozhuthu apimeleakku aadumaaduka'laiyum, vealaikkaararaiyum, vealaikkaarika'laiyum aapirakaamukkuk koduththu, avan manaiviyaakiya saaraa'laiyum avanidaththil thirumpa oppuviththaan.
pinnum apimeleakku: ithoa, en theasam unakku munpaaka irukki'rathu; un paarvaikkuch sammathiyaana idaththilea kudiyiru en'ru sonnaan.

pinpu saaraa'lai noakki: un sakoatharanukku aayiram ve'l'likkaasu koduththean; ithoa, unnoadirukki'ra ellaar munpaakavum, mat'ra yaavar munpaakavum, ithu un mukaththu mukkaattukkaavathaaka en'raan; ippadi ava'l kadinthuko'l'lappattaa'l.
aapirakaamudaiya manaiviyaakiya saaraa'linimiththam karththar apimeleakkudaiya veettaarin karppangka'laiyellaam adaiththirunthapadiyaal,
aapirakaam theavanai noakki vea'ndikko'ndaan; appozhuthu theavan apimeleakkaiyum, avan manaiviyaiyum, avan vealaikkaarika'laiyum ku'namaakki, pi'l'laipe'rumpadi anukkirakam pa'n'ninaar.
karththar thaam solliyirunthapadi saaraa'lpearil kadaadchamaanaar; karththar thaam uraiththapadiyea saaraa'lukkuch seytharu'linaar.
aapirakaam muthirvayathaayirukkaiyil, saaraa'l karppavathiyaaki, theavan ku'riththiruntha kaalaththilea avanukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu aapirakaam thanakkuch saaraa'l pet'ra kumaaranukku eesaakku en'ru pearittaan.
than kumaaranaakiya eesaakku pi'rantha ettaam naa'lilea, aapirakaam thanakkuth theavan katta'laiyittirunthapadi avanukku viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan.
than kumaaranaakiya eesaakku pi'ranthapoathu aapirakaam noo'ru vayathaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu saaraa'l: theavan ennai nakaikkappa'n'ninaar; ithaik keadki'ra yaavarum ennoadeakooda nakaippaarka'l.
saaraa'l pi'l'laika'lukkup paalkoduppaa'l en'ru aapirakaamukku evan solluvaan? avarudaiya muthirvayathilea avarukku oru kumaaranaip pet'reanea en'raa'l.
