pi'l'lai va'larnthu, paal ma'ranthathu; eesaakku paal ma'ranthanaa'lilea aapirakaam periya virunthupa'n'ninaan.
pinpu ekipthutheasaththaa'laakiya aakaar aapirakaamukkup pet'ra kumaaran pariyaasampa'n'nuki'rathaich saaraa'l ka'ndu,
aapirakaamai noakki: intha adimaippe'n'naiyum ava'l makanaiyum pu'rampea tha'l'lum; intha adimaippe'n'nin makan en kumaaranaakiya eesaakkoadea suthantharavaa'liyaayiruppathillai en'raa'l.
than makanaikku'riththuch sollappatta inthak kaariyam aapirakaamukku mikavum thukkamaayirunthathu.

appozhuthu theavan aapirakaamai noakki: anthap pi'l'laiyaiyum, un adimaippe'n'naiyum ku'riththuch sollappattathu unakkuth thukkamaayirukka vea'ndaam; eesaakkinidaththil un santhathi vi'langkum; aathalaal saaraa'l unakkuch solvathellaavat'raiyum kea'l.
adimaippe'n'nin makanum un viththaayirukki'rapadiyaal, avanaiyum oru jaathiyaakkuvean en'raar.

aapirakaam athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, appaththaiyum oru thuruththi tha'n'neeraiyum eduththu, aakaarudaiya thoa'linmeal vaiththup pi'l'laiyaiyum oppukkoduththu, ava'lai anuppivittaan; ava'l pu'rappattuppoay, peyersepaavin vanaantharaththilea alainthu thirinthaa'l.
thuruththiyiliruntha tha'n'neer selavazhinthapinpu, ava'l pi'l'laiyai oru sediyinkeezhea vittu,
pi'l'lai saaki'rathai naan paarkkamaattean en'ru, ethiraaka ampu paayum thooraththilea poay udkaarnthu saththamittu azhuthaa'l.

theavan pi'l'laiyin saththaththaik keattaar; theavathoothan vaanaththilirunthu aakaaraik kooppittu: aakaarea, unakku enna sampaviththathu, payappadaathea, pi'l'laiyirukkum idaththilea theavan avan saththaththaik keattaar.
nee ezhunthu pi'l'laiyai eduththu avanai un kaiyinaal pidiththukko'ndupoa, avanaip periya jaathiyaakkuvean en'raar.
theavan ava'ludaiya ka'nka'laith thi'ranthaar; appozhuthu ava'l oru tha'n'neerth thuravaik ka'ndu, poay, thuruththiyilea tha'n'neer nirappi, pi'l'laikkuk kudikkak koduththaa'l.
theavan pi'l'laiyudanea irunthaar; avan va'larnthu vanaantharaththilea kudiyirunthu, vilviththaiyilea vallavanaanaan.
avan paaraan vanaantharaththilea kudiyirukkaiyil, avanudaiya thaay ekipthu theasaththaa'laakiya oru pe'n'nai avanukku vivaakampa'n'nuviththaa'l.
akkaalaththil apimeleakkum avan seanaapathiyaakiya pikoalum aapirakaamai noakki: nee seyki'ra kaariyangka'l ellaavat'rilum theavan unnudanea irukki'raar.

aakaiyaal, nee enakkaavathu, en kumaaranukkaavathu, en pearanukkaavathu vagnchanai seyyaamal, naan unakkuch seytha thayavinpadiyea, nee enakkum, nee thangkiyirukki'ra inthath theasaththi'rkum, thayavuseyvean en'ru ingkea theavan pearil enakku aa'naiyittukkodu en'raan.
atha'rku aapirakaam: naan aa'naiyittukkodukki'rean en'raan.
aanaalum, apimeleakkudaiya vealaikkaarar kaivasappaduththikko'nda thuravin nimiththam aapirakaam apimeleakkaik kadinthuko'ndaan.

atha'rku apimeleakku: inthak kaariyaththaich seythavan innaan en'ru enakkuth theriyaathu, neeyum enakku a'rivikkavillai; in'ru naan athaik keattatheayan'ri, itha'rkumun athai naan kea'lvippattathea illai en'raan.
appozhuthu aapirakaam aadumaaduka'laik ko'nduvanthu apimeleakkukkuk koduththaan; avarka'l iruvarum udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
aapirakaam eazhu pe'n'naattukkuttika'laith thaniyea ni'ruththinaan.
appozhuthu apimeleakku aapirakaamai noakki: nee thaniyea ni'ruththina intha eazhu pe'n'naattukkuttika'l ennaththi'rku en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avan: naan inthath thuravu thoa'ndinathaikku'riththu, neer saadchiyaaka intha eazhu pe'n'naattukkuttika'lai en kaiyil vaangkikko'l'lavea'ndum en'raan.
avarka'l iruvarum avvidaththil aa'naiyittukko'ndapadiyaal, antha idam peyersepaa ennappattathu.
avarka'l peyersepaavilea udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndapin apimeleakkum, avan seanaapathiyaakiya pikoalum ezhunthu pelistharudaiya theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.
aapirakaam peyersepaavilea oru thoappai u'ndaakki, sathaakaalamumu'l'la theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththai avvidaththil thozhuthuko'ndaan.
aapirakaam pelistharudaiya theasaththil aneakanaa'l thangkiyirunthaan.
inthak kaariyangka'l nadanthapinpu, theavan aapirakaamaich soathiththaar; eppadiyenil, avar avanai noakki: aapirakaamea en'raar; avan: ithoa adiyean en'raan.

appozhuthu avar: un puththiranum un eakasuthanum un neasakumaaranumaakiya eesaakkai nee ippozhuthu azhaiththukko'ndu, moariyaa theasaththukkup poay, angkea naan unakkuk ku'rikkum malaika'l on'rinmeal avanaith thakanapaliyaakap paliyidu en'raar.

aapirakaam athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, than kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'nangkatti, than vealaikkaararil ira'ndupearaiyum than kumaaran eesaakkaiyum koottikko'ndu, thakanapalikkuk kattaika'laiyum pi'lanthuko'ndu, theavan thanakkuk ku'riththa idaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaan.
moon'raam naa'lil aapirakaam than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaarththu, thooraththilea antha idaththaik ka'ndaan.

appozhuthu aapirakaam than vealaikkaararai noakki: neengka'l kazhuthaiyai ni'ruththi ingkea kaaththirungka'l, naanum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanum avvidamattum poay, thozhuthuko'ndu, ungka'lidaththukkuth thirumpi varuvoam en'raan.
aapirakaam thakanapalikkuk kattaika'lai eduththu, than kumaaranaakiya eesaakkinmeal vaiththu, than kaiyilea neruppaiyum kaththiyaiyum eduththukko'ndaan; iruvarum koodippoanaarka'l.

appozhuthu eesaakku than thakappanaakiya aapirakaamai noakki: en thakappanea en'raan; atha'rku avan: en makanea, ithoa, irukki'rean en'raan; appozhuthu avan: ithoa, neruppum kattaiyum irukki'rathu, thakanapalikku aattukkutti engkea en'raan.
atha'rku aapirakaam: en makanea, theavan thamakkuth thakanapalikkaana aattukkuttiyaip paarththukko'lvaar en'raan; appu'ram iruvarum koodippoay,

theavan avanukkuch solliyiruntha idaththukku vanthaarka'l; angkea aapirakaam oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakki, kattaika'lai adukki, than kumaaranaakiya eesaakkaik katti, anthap palipeedaththil adukkiya kattaika'linmeal avanaik kidaththinaan.
pinpu aapirakaam than kumaaranai vettumpadikkuth than kaiyai neettik kaththiyai eduththaan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar vaanaththilirunthu, aapirakaamea, aapirakaamea en'ru kooppittaar; avan: ithoa, adiyean en'raan.

appozhuthu avar: pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanmeal un kaiyaip poadaathea, avanukku on'rum seyyaathea; nee avanai un puththiran en'rum, un eakasuthan en'rum paaraamal enakkaaka oppukkoduththapadiyinaal nee theavanukkup payappaduki'ravan en'ru ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'rean en'raar.

aapirakaam than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkumpoathu, ithoa, pinnaakap putharilea than kompuka'l sikkikko'ndiruntha oru aattukkadaavaik ka'ndaan; appozhuthu aapirakaam poay, kadaavaip pidiththu, athaith than kumaaranukkup pathilaakath thakanapaliyittaan.
aapirakaam antha idaththukku yeakoavaayeerea en'ru pearittaan; athinaalea karththarudaiya parvathaththilea paarththukko'l'lappadum en'ru innaa'lvaraikkum sollappattu varuki'rathu.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar ira'ndaantharam vaanaththilirunthu aapirakaamaik kooppittu:
nee un puththiran en'rum, un eakasuthan en'rum paaraamal avanai oppukkoduththu inthak kaariyaththaich seythapadiyaal;

naan unnai aaseervathikkavea aaseervathiththu, un santhathiyai vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'laippoalavum, kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoalavum perukavea perukappa'n'nuvean en'rum, un santhathiyaar thangka'l saththurukka'lin vaasalka'laich suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarka'l en'rum,
nee en sollukkuk keezhppadinthapadiyinaal, un santhathikku'l poomiyilu'l'la sakala jaathika'lum aaseervathikkappadum en'rum enpearil aa'naiyittean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
aapirakaam than vealaikkaararidaththukkuth thirumpivanthaan; avarka'l ezhunthu pu'rappattu, eakamaayp peyersepaavukkup poanaarka'l; aapirakaam peyersepaavilea kudiyirunthaan.
inthak kaariyangka'l nadanthapinpu, oruvan aapirakaamidaththil vanthu: milkkaa'lum un sakoatharanaakiya naakoarukkup pi'l'laika'laip pet'raa'l;
avarka'l yaaren'raal, mutha'rpea'raana ooths, avan thampiyaakiya poos, aaraamukkuth thakappanaakiya keamuveal,
keaseath, aasoa, pilthaas, ithlaap, peththuveal enpavarka'l; peththuveal repekkaa'laip pet'raan en'ru a'riviththaan.
antha ettuppearai milkkaa'l aapirakaamudaiya sakoatharanaakiya naakoarukkup pet'raa'l.
reayumaa'l en'ru pearko'nda avanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattiyum, theapaa, kaakaam, thaakaas, maakaa enpavarka'laip pet'raa'l.
saaraa'l noot'ru irupaththeazhu varusham uyiroadirunthaa'l; ivva'lavea saaraa'ludaiya vayathu.
kaanaan theasaththilu'l'la epiroan ennum keeriyaatharpaavilea saaraa'l mariththaa'l; appozhuthu aapirakaam vanthu, saaraa'lukkaakap pulampi azhuthaan.
pinpu aapirakaam pireatham iruntha idaththilirunthu ezhunthupoay, eaththin puththiraroadea peasi:

naan ungka'lidaththil anniyanum paratheasiyumaay irukki'rean; ennidaththilirukki'ra inthap pireatham en ka'nmun iraathapadikku naan athai adakkampa'n'nuvatha'rku, ungka'lidaththil enakkuch sonthamaaka oru kalla'raip poomiyaith tharavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku eaththin puththirar aapirakaamukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:

engka'l aa'ndavanea, naangka'l solluki'rathaik kea'lum; engka'lukku'l'lea neer makaa pirapu; engka'l kalla'raika'lil mukkiyamaanathilea pireathaththai adakkampa'n'num; neer pireathaththai adakkampa'n'na engka'lil oruvanum than kalla'raiyai umakkuth thadaiseyvathillai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu aapirakaam ezhunthirunthu, eaththin puththiraraakiya aththeasaththaarukku vanthanam seythu,

avarka'loadea peasi: ennidaththilirukki'ra pireatham en ka'nmun iraathapadikku, naan athai adakkampa'n'na ungka'lukkuch sammathiyaanaal, neengka'l en vaarththaiyaik keattu, soakaarudaiya kumaaranaakiya epperoan,

than nilaththin kadaisiyilea irukki'ra makpealaa ennappatta kukaiyai enakkuch sonthamaana kalla'raip poomiyaayirukkumpadi tharavea'ndum en'ru, avaridaththil enakkaaka vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; athu pe'rumaana vilaikku avar athaith tharuvaaraaka en'raan.

epperoan eaththin puththirar naduvilea udkaarnthirunthaan; appozhuthu eaththiyanaakiya epperoan than oor vaasalukku'l piraveasikki'ra eaththin puththirar anaivarum keadka aapirakaamukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:

appadiyalla, en aa'ndavanea, en vaarththaiyaik kea'lum; antha nilaththai umakkuth tharuki'rean, athilirukkum kukaiyaiyum umakkuth tharuki'rean, en janappuththirarudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka athai umakkuth tharuki'rean, ummidaththilirukki'ra pireathaththai adakkampa'n'num en'raan.
appozhuthu aapirakaam aththeasaththaarukku vanthanam seythu,

theasaththu janangka'l keadka, epperoanai noakki: kodukka umakku manathaanaal en vaarththaiyaik kea'lum; nilaththin vilaiyaith tharuki'rean; en kaiyil athai vaangkikko'l'lum; appozhuthu ennidaththilirukki'ra pireathaththai avvidaththil adakkampa'n'nuvean en'raan.
atha'rku epperoan aapirakaamukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:

en aa'ndavanea, naan solluki'rathaik kea'lum; antha nilam naanoo'ru seakkal ni'rai ve'l'li pe'rum; enakkum umakkum athu evva'lavu kaariyam; neer ummidaththilirukki'ra pireathaththai adakkampa'n'num en'raan.

appozhuthu aapirakaam epperoanin sollaik keattu, eaththin puththirarukku munpaaka epperoan sonnapadiyea, varththakaridaththil sellumpadiyaana naanoo'ru seakkal ni'rai ve'l'liyai avanukku ni'ruththuk koduththaan.
inthappirakaaram mamreakku ethirea makpealaavilu'l'la epperoanudaiya nilamaakiya anthap poomiyum, athilu'l'la kukaiyum, nilaththin ellaiyengkum soozhnthirukki'ra marangka'l adangkalum,
avanudaiya oorvaasalukku'l piraveasikkum eaththin puththirar ellaarum a'riya aapirakaamukkuch sonthamaaka u'ruthippaduththappattathu.
atha'rkuppin aapirakaam than manaiviyaakiya saaraa'laik kaanaantheasaththil epperoan oor poomiyaana mamreakku ethirea irukki'ra makpealaa ennum nilaththin kukaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaan.
ippadi eaththin puththirar kaiyil ko'l'lappatta antha nilamum, athilu'l'la kukaiyum, aapirakaamukkuch sontha kalla'raip poomiyaaka u'ruthippaduththappattathu.
aapirakaam vayathusen'ru muthirnthavanaanaan. karththar aapirakaamaich sakala kaariyangka'lilum aaseervathiththuvanthaar.
appozhuthu aapirakaam than veettilu'l'lavarka'lil vayathil mooththavanum, thanakku u'ndaana ellaavat'ri'rkum athikaariyumaakiya than oozhiyakkaaranai noakki:
naan kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniyarudaiya kumaaraththika'lil nee en kumaaranukkup pe'nko'l'laamal;

nee en theasaththukkum en inaththaaridaththukkum poay, en kumaaranaakiya eesaakkukkup pe'nko'lvean en'ru, vaanaththukkuth theavanum poomikkuth theavanumaakiya karththarpearil enakku aa'naiyittukkodukkumpadikku, nee un kaiyai en thodaiyinkeezh vai en'raan.

atha'rku antha oozhiyakkaaran: avvidaththup pe'n en pinnea inthath theasaththukku vara manathillaathirunthaal, neer vittuvantha theasaththi'rkuththaanea ummudaiya kumaaranai ma'rupadiyum azhaiththuppoakavea'ndumoa en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku aapirakaam: nee en kumaaranai ma'rupadiyum angkea azhaiththukko'ndupoakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru.

ennai en thakappanudaiya veettilum en inaththaar irukki'ra theasaththilumirunthu azhaiththu vanthavarum, un santhathikku intha theasaththaith tharuvean en'ru enakkuch solli aa'naiyittavarumaana vaanaththukkuth theavanaakiya karththar, nee angkeayirunthu en kumaaranukku oru pe'n'naik ko'nduvarumpadikku, thammudaiya thoothanai unakku munpaaka anuppuvaar.
pe'n un pinnea vara manathillaathirunthaa'leayaakil, appozhuthu nee intha en aa'naikku neengkalaayiruppaay; angkeamaaththiram en kumaaranai ma'rupadiyum azhaiththukko'ndu poakavea'ndaam en'raan.
appozhuthu antha oozhiyakkaaran than kaiyaith than ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamudaiya thodaiyinkeezh vaiththu, inthak kaariyaththaikku'riththu avanukku aa'naiyittukkoduththaan.

pinpu antha oozhiyakkaaran than ejamaanudaiya ottakangka'lil paththu ottakangka'laith thannudanea ko'ndupoanaan; than ejamaanudaiya sakalavitha uchchithamaana poru'lka'lum avan kaiyil irunthana; avan ezhunthu pu'rappattuppoay, mesoppoththaamiyaavilea naakoarudaiya ooril searnthu,
oorukkup pu'rampea oru tha'n'neerth thurava'ndaiyilea, tha'n'neer mo'l'la sthireeka'l pu'rappaduki'ra saayangkaala vea'laiyilea, ottakangka'lai madakki, thanakku'l'lea sollikko'ndathu ennaven'raal:
en ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamukku theavanaayirukki'ra karththaavea, in'raikku neer enakkuk kaariyam siththikkappa'n'ni, en ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamukkuth thayavuseytharu'lum.
ithoa, naan inthath tha'n'neerth thurava'ndaiyilea ni'rki'rean, intha ooraarudaiya pe'nka'l tha'n'neer mo'l'lap pu'rappattu varuvaarka'lea.

naan kudikka un kudaththaich saaykka vea'ndum en'ru naan sollumpoathu: kudi en'rum, un ottakangka'lum kudikkumpadi vaarppean en'rum sollum pe'n eva'loa, ava'lea neer ummudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakiya eesaakkukku niyamiththava'laayirukkavum, en ejamaanukku anukkirakam seytheer en'ru naan athinaalea a'riyavum seytharu'lum en'raan.

avan ippadich solli mudikkum munnea, ithoa, aapirakaamudaiya sakoatharanaakiya naakoarin manaivi milkkaa'ludaiya kumaaranaayirukki'ra peththuvealukkup pi'rantha repekkaa'l kudaththaith thoa'lmeal vaiththukko'ndu pu'rappattu vanthaa'l.
anthap pe'n makaa roopavathiyum, purushanai a'riyaatha kannikaiyumaay irunthaa'l; ava'l thuravil i'rangki, than kudaththai nirappikko'ndu ea'rivanthaa'l.
appozhuthu antha oozhiyakkaaran, ava'lukku ethirko'ndoadi: un kudaththilirukki'ra tha'n'neeril kogncham kudikkath tharavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku ava'l: kudiyum en aa'ndavanea en'ru seekkiramaayk kudaththaith than kaiyil i'rakkikko'ndu, avanukkuk kudikkak koduththaa'l.
koduththapin, ummudaiya ottakangka'lum kudiththuth theerumattum avaika'lukkum mo'ndu vaarppean en'ru solli;
seekkiramaayth than kudaththuth tha'n'neeraith thottiyilea oot'rivittu, innum mo'nduvarath thurava'ndaiyil oadi, avanudaiya ottakangka'lukkellaam mo'ndu vaarththaa'l.
antha manithan ava'laikku'riththu aachchariyappattu, karththar than pirayaa'naththai vaaykkappa'n'ninaaroa illaiyoa en'ru a'riyumporuttu mavunamaayirunthaan.

ottakangka'l kudiththuth theernthapin, antha manithan araichseakkal edaiyu'l'la po'rkaatha'niyaiyum, ava'l kaika'lukkup paththuch seakkal edaip ponnu'l'la ira'ndu kadakangka'laiyum eduththukkoduththu,
nee yaarudaiya maka'l, enakkuch sollavea'ndum; naangka'l un thakappan veettil iraaththangka idam u'ndaa en'raan.
atha'rku ava'l: naan naakoarukku milkkaa'l pet'ra kumaaranaakiya peththuvealin maka'l en'ru sonnathuman'ri,
engka'lidaththil vaikkoalum theevanamum vea'ndiyamattum irukki'rathu; iraaththangka idamum u'ndu en'raa'l.
appozhuthu antha manithan thalaikuninthu, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu,

en ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanaayirukki'ra karththarukku sthoaththiram; avar thammudaiya kirupaiyaiyum, thammudaiya u'nmaiyaiyum en ejamaanai vittu neekkavillai; naan pirayaa'nampa'n'nivarukaiyil, karththar en ejamaanudaiya sakoatharar veettukku ennai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaar en'raan.
anthap pe'n oadi, inthak kaariyangka'laith than thaayin veettilu'l'lavarka'lukku a'riviththaa'l.
repekkaa'lukku oru sakoatharan irunthaan; avanukku laapaan en'ru pear; antha laapaan ve'liyea thurava'ndaiyil iruntha antha manithanidaththukku oadinaan.

avan than sakoathari thariththiruntha anthak kaatha'niyaiyum, ava'l kaika'lil poattiruntha kadakangka'laiyum paarththu, inna innapadi antha manithan ennoadea peasinaanen'ru than sakoathari repekkaa'l sonna vaarththaika'laik keattamaaththiraththil, antha manithanidaththil vanthaan; avan thuravu arukea ottakangka'l a'ndaiyil nin'ruko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu avan: karththaraal aaseervathikkappattavarea, u'l'lea vaarum; neer ve'liyea ni'rpaanean? umakku veedum, ottakangka'lukku idamum aayaththampa'n'niyirukki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu antha manithan veettukkup poanaan. laapaan ottakangka'lin kattavizhththu, ottakangka'lukku vaikkoalum theevanamum poattu, avanum, avanoadea vanthavarka'lum thangka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvikko'l'lath tha'n'neer koduththaan.
pinpu, avanukku munpaaka poajanam vaikkappattathu. appozhuthu avan: naan vantha kaariyaththaich sollumunnea pusikkamaattean en'raan. atha'rku avan, sollum en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: naan aapirakaamudaiya oozhiyakkaaran.

karththar en ejamaanai mikavum aaseervathiththirukki'raar, avar seemaanaayirukki'raar; karththar avarukku aadumaaduka'laiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyum, vealaikkaararaiyum, vealaikkaarika'laiyum, ottakangka'laiyum, kazhuthaika'laiyum koduththirukki'raar.
en ejamaanudaiya manaiviyaakiya saaraa'l muthirvayathaanapoathu, en ejamaanukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avar thamakku u'ndaana yaavaiyum avanukkuk koduththirukki'raar.
en ejamaan ennai noakki: naan kudiyirukki'ra kaanaan theasaththaarudaiya kumaaraththika'lil nee en kumaaranukkup pe'nko'l'laamal,
nee en thakappan veettukkum, en inaththaaridaththukkum poay, en kumaaranukkup pe'nko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru aa'naiyittukkodukkumpadi sonnaar.
appozhuthu naan en ejamaanai noakki: oruvea'lai anthap pe'n enpinnea varaatheapoanaaloa en'ru keattatha'rku,
avar: naan vazhipadum karththar unnoadea thammudaiya thoothanai anuppi, un pirayaa'naththai vaaykkappa'n'nuvaar; en inaththaaridaththilum, en thakappan veettilum nee en kumaaranukkup pe'nko'lvaay.
nee en inaththaaridaththukkup poanaal, en aa'naikku neengkalaayiruppaay; avarka'l unakkup pe'nkodaama'rpoanaalum, nee en aa'naikku neengkalaayiruppaay en'raar.
appadiyea naan in'ru thurava'ndaiyilea vanthu: en ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanaakiya karththarea, en pirayaa'naththai neer ippozhuthu vaaykkappa'n'nuveeraanaal,

ithoa, naan tha'n'neerth thurava'ndaiyilea ni'rki'rean, tha'n'neer mo'l'la varappoaki'ra kannikaiyai naan noakki: un kudaththilirukki'ra tha'n'neeril kogncham enakkuk kudikkath tharavea'ndum en'ru keadkumpoathu:
nee kudi en'rum, un ottakangka'lukkum mo'ndu vaarppean en'rum sollum pe'n'nea karththar en ejamaanudaiya kumaaranukku niyamiththa sthireeyaakavea'ndum en'rean.

naan ithai en iruthayaththil solli mudikkumunnea, ithoa, repekkaa'l than kudaththaith thoa'lmeal vaiththukko'ndu pu'rappattuvanthu, thuravil i'rangkippoayth tha'n'neer mo'ndaa'l. appozhuthu naan: enakkuk kudikkath tharavea'ndum en'rean.
ava'l seekkiramaayth than thoa'lmealiruntha kudaththai i'rakki, kudiyum, ummudaiya ottakangka'lukkum vaarppean en'raa'l. naan kudiththean; ottakangka'lukkum vaarththaa'l.

appozhuthu: nee yaarudaiya maka'l en'ru ava'laik keattean; atha'rku ava'l: naan milkkaa'l naakoarukkup pet'ra kumaaranaakiya peththuvealin maka'l en'raa'l; appozhuthu ava'lukkuk kaatha'niyaiyum, ava'l kaika'lilea kadakangka'laiyum poattu;

thalaikuninthu, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu, naan en ejamaanudaiya sakoatharan kumaaraththiyai avar kumaaranukkuk ko'l'la ennai nearvazhiyaay nadaththivantha en ejamaanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanaayirukki'ra karththarai sthoaththiriththean.

ippozhuthum neengka'lum en ejamaanukkuth thayaiyum u'nmaiyum udaiyavarka'laay nadakka manathu'l'lavarka'laanaal, enakkuch sollungka'l; illaiyen'raal athaiyum enakkuch sollungka'l, appozhuthu naan valathupu'raththaiyaakilum idathupu'raththaiyaakilum noakkip poavean en'raan.
appozhuthu laapaanum peththuvealum pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthak kaariyam karththaraal vanthathu, umakku naangka'l nalam polam on'rum sollakkoodaathu.
ithoa, repekkaa'l umakku munpaaka irukki'raa'l; karththar sonnapadiyea ava'l umathu ejamaanudaiya kumaaranukku manaiviyaakumpadikku, ava'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoam en'raarka'l.
aapirakaamin oozhiyakkaaran avarka'l vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, tharaimattum kuninthu, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaan.

pinpu antha oozhiyakkaaran ve'l'liyudaimaika'laiyum, ponnudaimaika'laiyum, vasthirangka'laiyum eduththu, repekkaa'lukkuk koduththathuman'ri, ava'ludaiya sakoatharanukkum thaaykkum sila uchchithangka'laiyum koduththaan.
pinpu avanum avanoadiruntha manitharum pusiththuk kudiththu, iraaththangkinaarka'l; kaalaiyilea ezhunthirunthu, avan: en ejamaanidaththukku ennai anuppividungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l sakoatharanum ava'l thaayum, paththu naa'laakilum pe'n engka'loadirukkattum, pi'rpaadu poakalaam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: karththar en pirayaa'naththai vaaykkappa'n'niyirukka, neengka'l enakkuth thadaiseyyaathirungka'l; naan en ejamaanidaththukkuppoaka ennai anuppividavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l: pe'n'nai azhaiththu, ava'l vaayppi'rappaik keadpoam en'ru solli,
repekkaa'lai azhaiththu: nee intha manithanoadeakoodap poaki'raayaa en'ru keattaarka'l. ava'l: poaki'rean en'raa'l.
appadiyea avarka'l thangka'l sakoathariyaakiya repekkaa'laiyum, ava'l thaathiyaiyum, aapirakaamin oozhiyakkaaranaiyum, avan manitharaiyum anuppuviththu,

repekkaa'lai vaazhththi: engka'l sakoathariyea, nee koadaakoadiyaayp perukuvaayaaka; un santhathiyaar thangka'l pakaignarudaiya vaasalka'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'laaka en'ru aaseervathiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu repekkaa'lum ava'l vealaikkaarika'lum ezhunthu ottakangka'lmeal ea'ri, antha manithanoadeakoodap poanaarka'l. oozhiyakkaaran repekkaa'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.
eesaakku thentheasaththil kudiyirunthaan. appozhuthu avan: lakaayroayee ennappatta thuravin vazhiyaayp pu'rappattuvanthaan.
eesaakku saayangkaalavea'laiyilea thiyaanampa'n'na ve'liyilea poayirunthu, than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ottakangka'l varakka'ndaan.
repekkaa'lum than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu eesaakkaik ka'ndapoathu,

oozhiyakkaaranai noakki: angkea ve'liyilea namakku ethiraaka nadanthuvaruki'ra antha manithan yaar en'ru keattaa'l. avarthaan en ejamaan en'ru oozhiyakkaaran sonnaan. appozhuthu ava'l ottakaththai vitti'rangki mukkaadittukko'ndaa'l.
oozhiyakkaaran thaan seytha sakala kaariyangka'laiyum eesaakkukku vivariththuch sonnaan.

appozhuthu eesaakku repekkaa'laith than thaay saaraa'ludaiya koodaaraththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, ava'laith thanakku manaiviyaakkikko'ndu, ava'lai neasiththaan. eesaakku than thaaykkaakak ko'ndiruntha thukkam neengki aa'ruthal adainthaan.
aapirakaam keaththooraa'l ennum pearko'nda oru sthireeyaiyum vivaakampa'n'niyirunthaan.
ava'l avanukkuch simraanaiyum, yakshaanaiyum, meathaanaiyum, meethiyaanaiyum, ispaakkaiyum, soovaakaiyum pet'raa'l.
yakshaan seapaavaiyum, theathaanaiyum pet'raan; theathaanudaiya kumaarar asooreem, leththooseem, leyoomeem enpavarka'l.
meethiyaanudaiya kumaarar eappaa, eappear, aanoakku, apeethaa, elthaakaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum keaththooraa'lin pi'l'laika'l.
aapirakaam thanakku u'ndaana yaavaiyum eesaakkukkuk koduththaan.

aapirakaamukku iruntha ma'rumanaiyaattika'lin pi'l'laika'lukkoa aapirakaam nankodaika'laik koduththu, thaan uyiroadirukkumpoathea avarka'laith than kumaaranaakiya eesaakkaivittuk kizhakkea poakak keezhtheasaththukku anuppivittaan.
aapirakaam uyiroadiruntha aayusunaadka'l noot'ru ezhupaththainthu varusham.
pi'rpaadu aapirakaam nalla naraivayathilum, muthirntha poora'na aayusilum piraa'nan poay mariththu, than janaththaaroadea searkkappattaan.
avan kumaararaakiya eesaakkum ismavealum mamreakku ethirea eaththiyanaana soakaarin kumaaranaakiya epperoanin nilaththilu'l'la makpealaa ennappatta kukaiyilea avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
antha nilaththai eaththin puththirar kaiyilea aapirakaam vaangkiyirunthaan; angkea aapirakaamum avan manaiviyaakiya saaraa'lum adakkampa'n'nappattaarka'l.
aapirakaam mariththapin theavan avan kumaaranaakiya eesaakkai aaseervathiththaar. lakaayroayee ennum thuravukkuch sameepamaay eesaakku kudiyirunthaan.
saaraa'ludaiya adimaippe'n'naakiya ekipthu theasaththaa'laana aakaar aapirakaamukkup pet'ra kumaaranaakiya ismavealin vamsavaralaa'ru:
pa'rpala santhathika'laayp pirintha ismavealin puththirarudaiya naamangka'laavana; ismavealudaiya mooththa makan nepaayoath; pinpu keathaar, athpiyeal, mipsaam,
mishmaa, thoomaa, maasaa,
aathaar, theamaa, yeththoor, naapees, keathmaa enpavaika'lea.
thangka'l kiraamangka'lilum ara'nka'lilum kudiyiruntha thangka'l janaththaarukkup pannira'ndu pirapukka'laakiya ismavealin kumaararka'l ivarka'lea, ivarka'ludaiya naamangka'lum ivaika'lea.
ismavealin vayathu noot'ru muppaththeazhu. pinpu avan piraa'nan poay mariththu, than janaththaaroadea searkkappattaan.
avarka'l aavilaa thuvakki ekipthukku ethiraaka aseeriyaavukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilirukkum soormattum vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l. ithu avan sakoatharar ellaarukkum munpaaka avan kudiyea'rina poomi.
aapirakaamin kumaaranaakiya eesaakkudaiya vamsavaralaa'ru; aapirakaam eesaakkaip pet'raan.

eesaakku repekkaa'lai vivaakampa'n'nuki'rapoathu naa'rpathu vayathaayirunthaan; iva'l pathaanaraam ennum seeriyaa theasaththaanaakiya peththuvealukkuk kumaaraththiyum, seeriyaa theasaththaanaakiya laapaanukkuch sakoathariyumaanava'l.
maladiyaayiruntha than manaivikkaaka eesaakku karththarai noakki vea'nduthal seythaan; karththar avan vea'nduthalaik keattaru'linaar; avan manaivi repekkaa'l karppanthariththaa'l.
ava'l karppaththilea pi'l'laika'l on'roadon'ru moathikko'ndirunthana; appozhuthu ava'l: ippadiyaanaal enakku eppadiyoa en'ru solli, karththaridaththil visaarikkumpadi poanaa'l.

atha'rkuk karththar: ira'ndu jaathika'l un karppaththil u'ndaayirukki'rathu; ira'nduvitha janangka'l un vayit'rilirunthu piriyum, avarka'lil oru janaththaar mat'ra janaththaaraippaarkkilum palaththiruppaarka'l, mooththavan i'laiyavanaich seavippaan en'raar.
pirasavakaalam poora'namaanapoathu, ava'l karppaththil irattaip pi'l'laika'l irunthathu.
mooththavan sivantha ni'ramu'l'lavanaayum sarvaangkamum roama angki poarththavanpoalavum ve'lippattaan; avanukku easaa en'ru pearittaarka'l.

pinpu, avan sakoatharan than kaiyinaalea easaavin kuthingkaalaip pidiththukko'ndu ve'lippattaan; avanukku yaakkoapu en'ru pearittaarka'l; ivarka'lai ava'l pet'rapoathu eesaakku a'rupathu vayathaayirunthaan.
inthap pi'l'laika'l periyavarka'laanapoathu, easaa veattaiyil vallavanum vanasagnchaariyumaay irunthaan; yaakkoapu ku'nasaaliyum koodaaravaasiyumaay irunthaan.
easaa veattaiyaadik ko'nduvaruki'rathu eesaakkinudaiya vaaykku rusikaramaayirunthathinaalea easaavinmeal padchamaayirunthaan; repekkaa'loa yaakkoapinmeal padchamaayirunthaa'l.
orunaa'l easaa ve'liyilirunthu ka'laiththu vanthapoathu, yaakkoapu koozh samaiththukko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu easaa yaakkoapai noakki: anthach sivappaana koozhilea naan saappidak kogncham thaa, i'laiththirukki'rean en'raan; ithanaalea avanukku eathoam enki'ra pear u'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu: un seashda puththirapaakaththai in'ru enakku vit'ruppoadu en'raan.
atha'rku easaa: ithoa, naan saakappoaki'reanea, inthach seashda puththirapaakam enakku ennaththi'rku en'raan.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu: in'ru enakku aa'naiyittukkodu en'raan; avan yaakkoapukku aa'naiyittu, than seashda puththirapaakaththai avanukku vit'ruppoattaan.

appozhuthu yaakkoapu easaavukku appaththaiyum payat'rangkoozhaiyum koduththaan; avan pusiththuk kudiththu ezhunthirunthu poayvittaan. ippadi easaa than seashda puththirapaakaththai aladchiyampa'n'ninaan.
aapirakaamin naadka'lil u'ndaana pagnchaththai allaamal, pinnum oru pagncham theasaththil u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu eesaakku pelistharukku raajaavaakiya apimeleakkinidaththil kearaarukkup poanaan.
karththar avanukkuth tharisanamaaki: nee ekipthukkup poakaamal, naan unakkuch sollum theasaththilea kudiyiru.

inthath theasaththilea vaasampa'n'nu; naan unnoadeakooda irunthu, unnai aaseervathippean; naan unakkum un santhathikkum inthath theasangka'l yaavaiyum thanthu, un thakappanaakiya aapirakaamukku naan itta aa'naiyai ni'raiveat'ruvean.
aapirakaam en sollukkuk keezhppadinthu, en vithika'laiyum, en ka'rpanaika'laiyum, en niyamangka'laiyum, en piramaa'nangka'laiyum kaikko'ndapadiyinaal,

naan un santhathiyai vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'laippoalap perukappa'n'ni, un santhathikku inthath theasangka'l yaavaiyum tharuvean; un santhathikku'l poomiyilu'l'la sakala jaathika'lum aaseervathikkappadum en'raar.
eesaakku kearaarilea kudiyirunthaan.

avvidaththu manitharka'l avan manaiviyaikku'riththu visaariththapoathu: iva'l en sakoathari en'raan. repekkaa'l paarvaikku azhaku'l'lava'laanapadiyaal, avvidaththu manitharka'l ava'lnimiththam thannaik kolluvaarka'l en'ru e'n'ni, ava'laith than manaivi en'ru sollap payanthaan.

avan angkea nedunaa'l thangkiyirukkaiyil, pelistharukku raajaavaakiya apimeleakku jannal vazhiyaayp paarkkumpoathu, eesaakku than manaiviyaakiya repekkaa'loadea vi'laiyaadikko'ndirukki'rathaik ka'ndaan.

apimeleakku eesaakkai azhaiththu: ava'l un manaiviyaayirukki'raa'lea! pinnai ean ava'lai un sakoathari en'ru sonnaay en'raan. atha'rku eesaakku: ava'l nimiththam naan saakaathapadikku, ippadich sonnean en'raan.
atha'rku apimeleakku: engka'lidaththil ean ippadich seythaay? janangka'lukku'l yaaraakilum un manaiviyoadea sayanikkavum, engka'lmeal pazhisumaravum nee idamu'ndaakkinaayea en'raan.
pinpu, apimeleakku: inthap purushanaiyaakilum ivan manaiviyaiyaakilum thoduki'ravan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappaduvaan en'ru ellaa janangka'lum a'riyach sonnaan.
eesaakku anthath theasaththil vithai vithaiththaan; karththar avanai aaseervathiththathinaal antha varushaththil noo'rumadangku palan adainthaan;
avan aisuvariyavaanaaki, varavara viruththiyadainthu, makaa periyavanaanaan.
avanukku aattumanthaiyum, maattumanthaiyum, aneaka pa'nividaikkaararum irunthapadiyinaalea pelisthar avan pearil po'raamaiko'ndu,
avan thakappanaakiya aapirakaamin naadka'lil avanudaiya vealaikkaarar vettina thuravuka'laiyellaam thoorththu ma'n'ninaal nirappippoattaarka'l.
apimeleakku eesaakkai noakki: nee engka'lai vittup poayvidu; engka'laippaarkkilum mikavum palaththavanaanaay en'raan.
appozhuthu eesaakku avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, kearaarin pa'l'laththaakkilea koodaaram poattu, angkea kudiyirunthu,

than thakappanaakiya aapirakaamin naadka'lil vettinavaika'lum, aapirakaam mariththapin pelisthar thoorththuppoattavaika'lumaana thuravuka'lai ma'rupadiyum thoa'ndi, than thakappan avaika'lukku ittiruntha pearka'linpadiyea avaika'lukkup pearittaan.
eesaakkudaiya vealaikkaarar pa'l'laththaakkilea vetti, angkea surakkum neeroot'raik ka'ndaarka'l.

kearaaroor meayppar inthath tha'n'neer thangka'ludaiyathu en'ru solli, eesaakkudaiya meaypparudanea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l thannoadea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninapadiyaal, anthath thuravukku easeakku en'ru pearittaan.
vea'roru thuravai vettinaarka'l; athaikku'riththum vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l; aakaiyaal atha'rku sithnaa en'ru pearittaan.

pinpu avvidamvittup peyarnthupoay, vea'roru thuravai vettinaan; athaikku'riththu avarka'l vaakkuvaathampa'n'navillai; appozhuthu avan: naam theasaththil palukumpadikku, ippozhuthu karththar namakku idam u'ndaakkinaar en'ru solli, atha'rku rekopoath en'ru pearittaan.
angkeayirunthu peyersepaavukkup poanaan.

an'ru raaththiriyilea karththar avanukkuth tharisanamaaki: naan un thakappanaakiya aapirakaamudaiya theavan, payappadaathea, naan unnoadeakooda irunthu, en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya aapirakaaminimiththam unnai aaseervathiththu, un santhathiyaip perukappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
angkea avan oru palipeedaththaik katti, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu, angkea than koodaaraththaip poattaan. avvidaththil eesaakkin vealaikkaarar oru thuravai vettinaarka'l.
apimeleakkum avan sineakithanaakiya akusaaththum avan seanaapathiyaakiya pikoalum, kearaarilirunthu avanidaththukku vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu eesaakku avarka'lai noakki: ean ennidaththil vantheerka'l? neengka'l ennaip pakaiththu, ennai ungka'lidaththil iraathapadikkuth thuraththivitteerka'lea en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: nichchayamaayk karththar ummoadeakooda irukki'raar en'ru ka'ndoam; aakaiyaal engka'lukkum umakkum oru aa'nai ea'rpaadu u'ndaakavea'ndum en'ru naangka'l nir'nayam pa'n'ninoam.

naangka'l ummaith thodaamal, nanmaiyaiyea umakkuch seythu, ummaich samaathaanaththoadea anuppivittathupoala, neerum engka'lukkuth theengku seyyaathapadikku ummoadea udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'l'la vanthoam; neer karththaraal aaseervathikkappattavaraamea en'raarka'l.
avan avarka'lukku virunthupa'n'ninaan, avarka'l pusiththuk kudiththaarka'l.
athikaalaiyil ezhunthu oruvarukkoruvar aa'naiyittukko'ndaarka'l. pinpu eesaakku avarka'lai anuppivittaan; avarka'l avanidaththilirunthu samaathaanaththoadea poayvittaarka'l.
annaa'lilthaanea eesaakkin vealaikkaarar vanthu, thaangka'l thuravu vettina seythiyai avanukku a'riviththu, tha'n'neer ka'ndoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku seapaa en'ru pearittaan; aakaiyaal antha oorin pear innaa'lvaraikkum peyersepaa ennappaduki'rathu.
easaa naa'rpathu vayathaanapoathu, eaththiyanaana peyeariyinudaiya kumaaraththiyaakiya yootheeththaiyum, eaththiyanaana ealoanudaiya kumaaraththiyaakiya pasmaaththaiyum vivaakampa'n'ninaan.
avarka'l eesaakkukkum repekkaa'lukkum mananoavaayirunthaarka'l.
eesaakku muthirvayathaanathinaal avan ka'nka'l iru'ladainthu paarvaiyat'ruppoanapoathu, avan than mooththa kumaaranaakiya easaavai azhaiththu, en makanea en'raan; avan, ithoa, irukki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: naan muthirvayathaanean, en mara'nam inna naa'lil en'ru a'riyean.
aakaiyaal, nee un aayuthangka'laakiya un ampa'raaththoo'niyaiyum un villaiyum eduththukko'ndu vanaththukkuppoay, enakkaaka veattaiyaadi,
athai enakkup piriyamaayirukki'ra rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laakach samaiththu, naan pusikkavum, naan mara'namadaiyumunnea en aaththumaa unnai aaseervathikkavum, ennidaththil ko'nduvaa en'raan.
eesaakku than kumaaranaakiya easaavoadea peasukaiyil, repekkaa'l keattukko'ndirunthaa'l. easaa veattaiyaadikko'nduvarumpadi vanaththukkup poanaan.
appozhuthu repekkaa'l than kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapai noakki: un thakappan un sakoatharanaakiya easaavai azhaiththu:

naan pusiththu, enakku mara'nam varumunnea, karththarai munnittu unnai aaseervathikkumpadi, nee enakkaaka veattaiyaadi, athai enakku rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laakach samaiththukko'nduvaa en'ru sollakkeattean.
aakaiyaal, en makanea, en sollaik keattu, naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'rapadi sey.
nee aattumanthaikkup poay, ira'ndu nalla ve'l'laattukkuttika'laik ko'nduvaa; naan avaika'lai un thakappanukkup piriyamaanapadi rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laakach samaippean.
un thakappan thaam mara'namadaiyumunnea unnai aaseervathikkumpadi avar pusippatha'rku nee athai avaridaththil ko'ndupoakavea'ndum en'raa'l.
atha'rku yaakkoapu than thaayaakiya repekkaa'lai noakki: en sakoatharanaakiya easaa roamam mikuththavan, naan roamamillaathavan.
oruvea'lai en thakappan ennaith thadavippaarppaar; appozhuthu naan avarukku eththanaayk kaa'nappattu, enmeal aaseervaathaththai alla, saapaththai varappa'n'nikko'lveanea en'raan.
atha'rku avan thaay: en makanea, unmeal varum saapam enmeal varattum; en sollaimaaththiram keattu, nee poay, avaika'lai ennidaththil ko'nduvaa en'raa'l.
avan poay avaika'laip pidiththu, than thaayinidaththil ko'nduvanthaan; avanudaiya thaay avan thakappanukkup piriyamaanapadi rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laich samaiththaa'l.
pinpu, repekkaa'l veettilea thannidaththil iruntha than mooththa makanaakiya easaavin nalla vasthirangka'lai eduththu, than i'laiya makanaakiya yaakkoapukku uduththi,
ve'l'laattukkuttika'lin thoalai avan kaika'lileayum roamamillaatha avan kazhuththileayum poattu;
thaan samaiththa rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laiyum appangka'laiyum than kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapin kaiyilea koduththaa'l.
avan than thakappanidaththil vanthu, en thakappanea en'raan; atha'rku avan: ithoa, irukki'rean; nee yaar, en makanea en'raan.

appozhuthu yaakkoapu than thakappanai noakki: naan umathu mooththa makanaakiya easaa; neer enakkuch sonnapadiyea seythean; ummudaiya aaththumaa ennai aaseervathikkumpadi, neer ezhunthu udkaarnthu, naan veattaiyaadikko'nduvanthathaip pusiyum en'raan.
appozhuthu eesaakkuth than kumaaranai noakki: en makanea, ithu unakku iththanai seekkiramaay eppadi akappattathu en'raan. avan: ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar enakku nearidappa'n'ninaar en'raan.
appozhuthu eesaakku yaakkoapai noakki: en makanea, nee en kumaaranaakiya easaathaanoa allavoa en'ru naan unnaith thadavippaarkkumpadi kitta vaa en'raan.
yaakkoapu than thakappanaakiya eesaakka'ndaiyil kittap poanaan; avan ivanaith thadavippaarththu: saththam yaakkoapin saththam, kaika'loa easaavin kaika'l en'ru solli,
avanudaiya kaika'l avan sakoatharanaakiya easaavin kaika'laippoala roamamu'l'lavaika'laayirunthapadiyinaalea, innaan en'ru a'riyaamal, avanai aaseervathiththu,
nee en kumaaranaakiya easaathaanoa en'raan; avan: naanthaan en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: en kumaaranea, nee veattaiyaadik ko'nduvanthathai naan pusiththu, en aaththumaa unnai aaseervathikkumpadi athai en kittak ko'nduvaa en'raan; avan athaik kittak ko'ndupoanaan; appozhuthu avan pusiththaan; pi'rpaadu, thiraadcharasam avanukkuk ko'nduvanthu koduththaan, avan kudiththaan.
appozhuthu avan thakappanaakiya eesaakku avanai noakki: en makanea, nee kitta vanthu ennai muththagnsey en'raan.

avan kittap poay, avanai muththagnseythaan; appozhuthu avanudaiya vasthirangka'lin vaasanaiyai moanthu: ithoa, en kumaaranudaiya vaasanai karththar aaseervathiththa vayalve'liyin vaasanaiyaippoal irukki'rathu.
theavan unakku vaanaththup paniyaiyum poomiyin kozhumaiyaiyum koduththu, mikuntha thaaniyaththaiyum thiraadcharasaththaiyum thantharu'luvaaraaka.

janangka'l unnaich seavikkavum jaathika'l unnai va'nangkavum kadavarka'l; un sakoathararukku ejamaanaayiruppaay; un thaayin pi'l'laika'l unnai va'nangkuvaarka'l; unnaich sapikki'ravarka'l sapikkappattavarka'lum, unnai aaseervathikki'ravarka'l aaseervathikkappattavarka'lumaay iruppaarka'l en'ru solli avanai aaseervathiththaan.
eesaakku yaakkoapai aaseervathiththu mudinthapoathu, yaakkoapu than thakappanaakiya eesaakkin samukaththaivittup pu'rappattavudanea, avan sakoatharanaakiya easaa veattaiyaadi vanthu searnthaan.

avanum rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laich samaiththu, than thakappana'ndaikkuk ko'nduvanthu, thakappanai noakki: ummudaiya aaththumaa ennai aaseervathikkumpadi, en thakappanaar ezhunthirunthu, ummudaiya kumaaranaakiya naan veattaiyaadik ko'nduvanthathaip pusippaaraaka en'raan.
appozhuthu avan thakappanaakiya eesaakku: nee yaar en'raan; atha'rku avan: naan umathu mooththa makanaakiya easaa en'raan.

appozhuthu eesaakku mikavum piramiththu nadungki: veattaiyaadi enakkuk ko'nduvanthaanea, avan yaar? nee varumunnea avaiyellaavat'rilum naan pusiththu avanai aaseervathiththeanea, avan aaseervathikkappattavanaakavum iruppaan en'raan.
easaa than thakappanudaiya vaarththaika'laik keattavudanea, mikavum manangkasanthu uraththa saththamittu ala'ri, than thakappanai noakki: en thakappanea, ennaiyum aaseervathiyum en'raan.
atha'rku avan: un sakoatharan thanthiramaay vanthu, unnudaiya aaseervaathaththaip pet'rukko'ndaan en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: avan peyar yaakkoapu ennappaduvathu sariyallavaa? ithoadea ira'ndutharam ennai moasampoakkinaan; en seashda puththirapaakaththai eduththukko'ndaan; ithoa, ippozhuthu en aaseervaathaththaiyum vaangkikko'ndaan en'ru solli; neer enakku oru aaseervaathaththaiyaakilum vaiththuvaikkavillaiyaa en'raan.

eesaakku easaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, naan avanai unakku ejamaanaaka vaiththean; avan sakoatharar ellaaraiyum avanukku oozhiyakkaararaakak koduththu, avanaith thaaniyaththinaalum thiraadcharasaththinaalum aathariththean; ippozhuthum en makanea, naan unakku ennaseyvean en'raan.
easaa than thakappanai noakki: en thakappanea, intha orea aaseervaatham maaththiramaa ummidaththil u'ndu? en thakappanea, ennaiyum aaseervathiyum en'ru solli, easaa saththamittu azhuthaan.
appozhuthu avan thakappanaakiya eesaakku avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: un vaasasthalam poomiyin saaraththoadum uyara vaanaththilirunthu i'rangkum paniyoadum irukkum.
un pattayaththinaalea nee pizhaiththu, un sakoatharanaich seavippaay; nee mea'rko'l'lum kaalam varumpoathoa, un kazhuththil irukki'ra avanudaiya nukaththadiyai mu'riththuppoaduvaay en'raan.

yaakkoapaith than thakappan aaseervathiththathinimiththam easaa yaakkoapaip pakaiththu: en thakappanukkaakath thukkikkum naadka'l seekkiramaay varum, appozhuthu en sakoatharanaakiya yaakkoapaik kon'rupoaduvean en'ru easaa than iruthayaththilea sollikko'ndaan.

mooththa makanaakiya easaavin vaarththaika'l repekkaa'lukku a'rivikkappattathu; appozhuthu ava'l than i'laiya makanaakiya yaakkoapai azhaiththu: un sakoatharanaakiya easaa unnaik kon'rupoada ninaiththu, thannaith theat'rikko'l'luki'raan.
aakaiyaal, en makanea, naan solvathaik keattu, ezhunthu pu'rappattu, aaraanil irukki'ra en sakoatharanaakiya laapaanidaththukku oadippoay,
un sakoatharanudaiya koapam tha'niyumattum silanaa'l avanidaththilea iru.

un sakoatharan unmeal vaiththa koapam tha'ninthu, nee avanukkuch seythathai avan ma'ranthapin, naan aa'l anuppi, avvidaththilirunthu unnai azhaippippean; naan oreanaa'lil ungka'l iruvaraiyum ean izhanthupoakavea'ndum en'raa'l.

pinpu, repekkaa'l eesaakkai noakki: eaththin kumaaraththika'linimiththam en uyir enakku ve'ruppaayirukki'rathu; inthath theasaththup pe'nka'laakiya eaththin kumaaraththika'lil yaakkoapu oru pe'n'naik ko'lvaanaanaal en uyir irunthu aavathenna en'raa'l.
eesaakku yaakkoapai azhaiththu, avanai aaseervathiththu, nee kaanaaniyarudaiya kumaaraththika'lil pe'nko'l'laamal,

ezhunthu pu'rappattu, pathaan araamilirukki'ra un thaayinudaiya thakappanaakiya peththuvealudaiya veettukkup poay, avvidaththil un thaayin sakoatharanaakiya laapaanin kumaaraththika'lukku'l pe'nko'l en'ru avanukkuk katta'laiyittaan.
sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan unnai aaseervathiththu, nee pala janakkoottamaakumpadi unnaip palukavum perukavumpa'n'ni;

theavan aapirakaamukkuk koduththathum nee paratheasiyaayth thangkuki'rathumaana theasaththai nee suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi aapirakaamukku aru'liya aaseervaathaththai unakkum un santhathikkum aru'luvaaraaka en'ru solli;

eesaakku yaakkoapai anuppivittaan. appozhuthu avan pathaan araamilirukkum seeriyaa theasaththaanaakiya peththuvealudaiya kumaaranum, thanakkum easaavukkum thaayaakiya repekkaa'lin sakoatharanumaana laapaanidaththukkup poakap pu'rappattaan.

eesaakku yaakkoapai aaseervathiththu, oru pe'n'naik ko'l'lumpadi avanaip pathaan araamukku anuppinathaiyum, avanai aaseervathikkaiyil: nee kaanaaniyarudaiya kumaaraththika'lil pe'nko'l'lavea'ndaam en'ru avanukkuk katta'laiyittathaiyum,
yaakkoapu than thakappanukkum than thaaykkum keezhppadinthu, pathaan araamukkup pu'rappattuppoanathaiyum easaa ka'ndathinaalum,
kaanaaniyarudaiya kumaaraththika'l than thakappanaakiya eesaakkin paarvaikku aakaathavarka'l enpathai easaa a'rinthathinaalum,

easaa ismavealidaththukkup poay, thanakku munniruntha manaivika'luman'ri, aapirakaamudaiya kumaaranaakiya ismavealin kumaaraththiyum nepaayoaththin sakoathariyumaakiya makalaaththaiyum vivaakampa'n'ninaan.
yaakkoapu peyersepaavai vittup pu'rappattu aaraanukkup poakap pirayaa'nampa'n'ni,
oru idaththilea vanthu, sooriyan asthamiththapadiyinaal, angkea raaththangki, avvidaththuk ka'rka'lil on'rai eduththu, than thalaiyinkeezh vaiththu, angkea niththirai seyyumpadi paduththukko'ndaan.

angkea avan oru soppanang ka'ndaan; ithoa, oru ea'ni poomiyilea vaikkappattirunthathu, athin nuni vaanaththai ettiyirunthathu, athilea theavathoothar ea'ruki'ravarka'lum i'rangkuki'ravarka'lumaay irunthaarka'l.
atha'rku mealaakak karththar nin'ru: naan un thakappanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin theavanumaakiya karththar; nee paduththirukki'ra poomiyai unakkum un santhathikkum tharuvean.
un santhathi poomiyin thoo'laippoalirukkum; nee mea'rkeayum, kizhakkeayum, vadakkeayum, the'rkeayum parampuvaay; unakku'l'lum un santhathikku'l'lum poomiyin vamsangka'lellaam aaseervathikkappadum.
naan unnoadea irunthu, nee poaki'ra idaththilellaam unnaik kaaththu, inthath theasaththukku unnaith thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean; naan unakkuch sonnathaich seyyuma'lavum unnaik kaividuvathillai en'raar.
yaakkoapu niththirai the'linthu vizhiththapoathu: meyyaakavea karththar intha sthalaththil irukki'raar; ithai naan a'riyaathirunthean en'raan.
avan payanthu, intha sthalam evva'lavu payangkaramaayirukki'rathu! ithu theavanudaiya veedeayallaamal vea'ralla, ithu vaanaththin vaasal en'raan.
athikaalaiyilea yaakkoapu ezhunthu, than thalaiyinkeezh vaiththiruntha kallai eduththu, athaith thoo'naaka ni'ruththi, athinmeal e'n'ney vaarththu,
antha sthalaththi'rkup peththeal en'ru pearittaan; atha'rku munnea avvoorukku loos ennum pear irunthathu.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu: theavan ennoadea irunthu, naan poaki'ra intha vazhiyilea ennaik kaappaat'ri, u'n'na aakaaramum, udukka vasthiramum enakkuth thanthu,
ennai en thakappan veettukkuch samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivarappa'n'nuvaaraanaal, karththar enakkuth theavanaayiruppaar;
naan thoo'naaka ni'ruththina inthak kal theavanukku veedaakum; theavareer enakkuth tharum ellaavat'rilum umakkuth thasamapaakam seluththuvean en'ru sollip poruththanaipa'n'nikko'ndaan.
yaakkoapu pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, keezhththisaiyaarin theasaththil poaych searnthaan.

angkea vayalve'liyilea oru ki'nat'raiyum, athin arukea madakkiyirukki'ra moon'ru aattumanthaika'laiyum ka'ndaan; anthak ki'nat'rilea manthaika'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaattuvaarka'l; anthak ki'nat'rin vaay oru periya kallinaal adaikkappattirunthathu.
avvidaththil manthaika'l ellaam searnthapin ki'nat'rin vaayilirukkum kallai meayppar puratti, aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaatti, ma'rupadiyum kallai munnirunthapadi ki'nat'rin vaayil vaippaarka'l.
yaakkoapu avarka'laip paarththu: sakoathararea, neengka'l evvidaththaar en'raan; avarka'l, naangka'l aaraan ooraar en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: naakoarin kumaaranaakiya laapaanai a'riveerka'laa en'ru keattaan; a'rivoam en'raarka'l.
avan sukamaayirukki'raanaa en'ru visaariththaan; atha'rku avarka'l: sukamaayirukki'raan; avan kumaaraththiyaakiya raakeal, athoa, aaduka'lai oattikko'ndu varuki'raa'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: innum vekupozhuthirukki'rathea; ithu manthaika'laich searkki'ra vea'lai allavea, aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaatti, innum meayavidalaam en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: ellaa manthaika'lum searumunnea appadich seyyakkoodaathu; searnthapin ki'nat'rin vaayilu'l'la kallaip purattuvaarka'l; appozhuthu aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaattuvoam en'raarka'l.
avarka'loadea avan peasikko'ndirukkumpoathea, than thakappanudaiya aaduka'lai meayththukko'ndiruntha raakeal antha aaduka'lai oattikko'nduvanthaa'l.

yaakkoapu than thaayin sakoatharanaana laapaanudaiya kumaaraththiyaakiya raakealaiyum, than thaayin sakoatharanaakiya laapaanin aaduka'laiyum ka'ndapoathu, yaakkoapu poay, ki'nat'rin vaayiliruntha kallaip puratti, than thaayin sakoatharanaakiya laapaanin aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaattinaan.
pinpu yaakkoapu raakealai muththagnseythu, saththamittu azhuthu,
thaan ava'l thakappanudaiya marumakanen'rum, repekkaa'lin kumaaranen'rum raakealukku a'riviththaan. ava'l oadippoayth than thakappanukku a'riviththaa'l.

laapaan than sakoathariyin kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapudaiya seythiyaik keattapoathu, avanukku ethirko'ndoadi, avanaik kattikko'ndu muththagnseythu, than veettukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan; avan than kaariyangka'laiyellaam vivaramaay laapaanukkuch sonnaan.
appozhuthu laapaan: nee en elumpum en maamsamumaanavan en'raan. oru maathamvaraikkum yaakkoapu avanidaththil thangkinaan.
pinpu laapaan yaakkoapai noakki: nee en marumakanaayiruppathinaal, summaa enakku vealaiseyyalaamaa? sampa'lam evva'lavu keadki'raay, sol en'raan.
laapaanukku ira'ndu kumaaraththika'l irunthaarka'l; mooththava'l pear leayaa'l, i'laiyava'l pear raakeal.
leayaa'ludaiya ka'nka'l koochchappaarvaiyaayirunthathu; raakealoa roopavathiyum paarvaikku azhakaanava'lumaayirunthaa'l.
yaakkoapu raakealpearil piriyappattu: ummudaiya i'laiya kumaaraththiyaakiya raakealukkaaka ummidaththil eazhu varusham vealaiseyki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku laapaan: naan ava'lai anniya purushanukkuk kodukki'rathaippaarkkilum, ava'lai unakkuk kodukki'rathu uththamam, ennidaththil thariththiru en'raan.
anthappadiyea yaakkoapu raakealukkaaka eazhu varusham vealaiseythaan; ava'l pearil iruntha piriyaththinaalea antha varushangka'l avanukkuk kognchanaa'laakath thoan'rinathu.
pinpu yaakkoapu laapaanai noakki: en naadka'l ni'raivea'rinapadiyaal, en manaiviyinidaththil naan searumpadi ava'lai enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu laapaan avvidaththu manithar ellaaraiyum koodivarachseythu virunthupa'n'ninaan.
an'ru iravilea avan than kumaaraththiyaakiya leayaa'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avanidaththil vittaan; ava'lai avan searnthaan.
laapaan than vealaikkaariyaakiya silpaa'laith than kumaaraththiyaakiya leayaa'lukku vealaikkaariyaakak koduththaan.

kaalaiyilea, ithoa, ava'l leayaa'l en'ru yaakkoapu ka'ndu, laapaanai noakki: ean enakku ippadich seytheer? raakealukkaaka allavaa ummidaththil vealaiseythean; pinnai ean enakku vagnchakampa'n'nineer en'raan.
atha'rku laapaan: mooththava'l irukka i'laiyava'laik koduppathu ivvidaththu vazhakkam alla.
iva'ludaiya eazhu naa'lai ni'raiveat'ru; ava'laiyum unakkuth tharuvean; ava'lukkaakavum nee innum eazhu varusham ennidaththil vealaisey en'raan.
anthappadiyea yaakkoapu, iva'ludaiya eazhunaa'lai ni'raiveat'rinaan. appozhuthu than kumaaraththiyaakiya raakealaiyum avanukku manaiviyaakak koduththaan.
mealum laapaan than vealaikkaariyaakiya pilkaa'laith than kumaaraththiyaakiya raakealukku vealaikkaariyaakak koduththaan.
yaakkoapu raakealaiyum searnthaan; leayaa'laippaarkkilum raakealai avan athikamaay neasiththu, pinnum eazhu varusham avanidaththil seaviththaan.
leayaa'l a'rpamaay e'n'nappattaa'l en'ru karththar ka'ndu, ava'l karppantharikkumpadi seythaar; raakealoa maladiyaayirunthaa'l.
leayaa'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: karththar en si'rumaiyaip paarththaru'linaar; ippozhuthu en purushan ennai neasippaar en'ru solli, avanukku roopan en'ru pearittaa'l.
ma'rupadiyum ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: naan a'rpamaay e'n'nappattathaik karththar keattaru'li, ivanaiyum enakkuth thanthaar en'ru solli, avanukkuch simiyoan en'ru pearittaa'l.
pinnum ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: en purushanukku moon'ru kumaararaip pet'rapadiyaal avar ippozhuthu ennoadea searnthiruppaar en'ru solli, avanukku leavi en'ru pearittaa'l.
ma'rupadiyum ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: ippozhuthu karththaraith thuthippean en'ru solli, avanukku yoothaa en'ru pearittaa'l; pi'rpaadu ava'lukkup pi'l'laippea'ru nin'rupoayit'ru.
raakeal thaan yaakkoapukkup pi'l'laika'laip pe'raathathaik ka'ndu, than sakoathariyinmeal po'raamaiko'ndu, yaakkoapai noakki: enakkup pi'l'lai kodum, illaavittaal naan saaki'rean en'raa'l.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu raakealinmeal koapangko'ndu: theavanallavoa un karppaththai adaiththirukki'raar, naan theavanaa? en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l: ithoa, en vealaikkaariyaakiya pilkaa'l irukki'raa'lea; ava'l en madikkup pi'l'laika'laip pe'ravum, ava'laalaakilum en veedu kattappadavum ava'lidaththil searum en'ru solli,
avanukkuth than vealaikkaariyaakiya pilkaa'lai manaiviyaakak koduththaa'l; appadiyea yaakkoapu ava'laich searnthaan.
pilkaa'l karppavathiyaaki, yaakkoapukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu raakeal: theavan en vazhakkaith theerththu, en saththaththaiyum keattu, enakku oru kumaaranaik koduththaar en'ru solli, avanukkuth thaa'n en'ru pearittaa'l.
ma'rupadiyum raakealin vealaikkaariyaakiya pilkaa'l karppavathiyaaki, yaakkoapukku ira'ndaam kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu raakeal: naan makaa poaraattamaay en sakoathariyoadea poaraadi mea'rko'ndean en'ru solli, avanukku napthali en'ru pearittaa'l.
leayaa'l thaan pi'l'laipe'ruki'rathu nin'rupoanathaik ka'ndu, than vealaikkaariyaakiya silpaa'lai azhaiththu, ava'lai yaakkoapukku manaiviyaakak koduththaa'l.
leayaa'lin vealaikkaariyaakiya silpaa'l yaakkoapukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu leayaa'l: earaa'lamaaki'rathen'ru solli, avanukkuk kaath en'ru pearittaa'l.
pinpu leayaa'lin vealaikkaariyaakiya silpaa'l yaakkoapukku ira'ndaam kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu leayaa'l: naan paakkiyavathi, sthireeka'l ennaip paakkiyavathi enpaarka'l en'ru solli, avanukku aasear en'ru pearittaa'l.

koathumai a'ruppu naadka'lilea roopan vayalve'liyilea poay, thoothaayeem kanika'laik ka'ndeduththu, avaika'laik ko'nduvanthu than thaayaakiya leayaa'lidaththil koduththaan. appozhuthu raakeal leayaa'lai noakki: un kumaaranudaiya thoothaayeem kaniyil enakkuk kogncham thaa en'raa'l.

atha'rku ava'l: nee en purushanai eduththukko'ndathu a'rpakaariyamaa? en kumaaranudaiya thoothaayeem kanika'laiyum eduththukko'l'lavea'ndumoa en'raa'l; atha'rku raakeal: un kumaaranudaiya thoothaayeem kanika'lukku eedaaka in'ru iravu avar unnoadea sayanikkattum en'raa'l.

saayangkaalaththil yaakkoapu ve'liyilirunthu varukaiyil leayaa'l pu'rappattu avanukku ethirko'ndupoay: en kumaaranudaiya thoothaayeem kanika'laal ummaik ko'ndean; aakaiyaal, neer ennidaththil varavea'ndum en'raa'l; avan an'ru iravu ava'loadea sayaniththaan.
theavan leayaa'lukkuch sevikoduththaar. ava'l karppavathiyaaki yaakkoapukku ainthaam kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu leayaa'l: naan en vealaikkaariyai en purushanukkuk koduththa palanaith theavan enakkuth thanthaar en'ru solli, avanukku isakkaar en'ru pearittaa'l.
appu'ram leayaa'l karppavathiyaaki yaakkoapukku aa'raam kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.

appozhuthu leayaa'l: theavan enakku nalla eevaith thanthaar; en purushanukku naan aa'ru kumaararaip pet'rapadiyaal, ippozhuthu avar ennudanea vaasampa'n'nuvaar en'ru solli, avanukkuch sepuloan en'ru pearittaa'l.
pinpu ava'l oru kumaaraththiyaiyum pet'ru, ava'lukkuth theenaa'l en'ru pearittaa'l.
theavan raakealai ninaiththaru'linaar; ava'lukkuth theavan sevikoduththu, ava'l karppantharikkumpadi seythaar.
ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru: theavan en ninthaiyai neekkivittaar en'rum,
innum oru kumaaranaik karththar enakkuth tharuvaar en'rum solli, avanukku yoaseappu en'ru pearittaa'l.
raakeal yoaseappaip pet'rapin, yaakkoapu laapaanai noakki: naan en sthaanaththi'rkum en theasaththi'rkum poaka ennai anuppividum.
naan umakku oozhiyagnseythu sampaathiththa en manaivika'laiyum en pi'l'laika'laiyum enakkuth thaarum; naan poavean, naan ummidaththil seaviththa seavakaththai neer a'rinthirukki'reer en'raan.
appozhuthu laapaan: un ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavu kidaiththatheayaanaal nee iru; un nimiththam karththar ennai aaseervathiththaar en'ru ku'rippinaal a'rinthean.
un sampa'lam innathen'ru enakkuch sol, naan athaith tharuvean en'raan.
atha'rku avan: naan ummaich seaviththa vithamum, ummudaiya manthai ennidaththil iruntha vithamum a'rinthirukki'reer.

naan varumunnea umakku irunthathu kogncham; naan vanthapin karththar ummai aaseervathiththathinaal athu mikavum perukiyirukki'rathu; ini naan en kudumpaththukkuch sampaaththiyampa'n'nuvathu eppozhuthu en'raan.

atha'rku avan: naan unakku enna tharavea'ndum en'raan; yaakkoapu: neer enakku on'rum tharavea'ndiyathillai; naan solluki'rapadi neer enakkuch seythaal, ummudaiya manthaiyaith thirumpa meayththuk kaappean.

naan in'raikkuppoay, ummudaiya manthaika'laiyellaam paarvaiyittu, avaika'lil pu'l'liyum variyum ka'ruppumu'l'la semma'riyaaduka'laiyum, variyum pu'l'liyumu'l'la ve'l'laaduka'laiyum piriththuviduki'rean; appadippattavai ini enakkuch sampa'lamaayirukkattum.

appadiyea inimeal en sampa'lamaakiya ivat'rai neer paarvaiyidumpoathu, en neethi vi'langkum; pu'l'liyum variyumillaatha ve'l'laaduka'lum, ka'ruppaana semma'riyaaduka'lum en vasaththil irunthaal, avaiyellaam ennaal thirudikko'l'lappattavaika'laay e'n'nappadattum en'raan.
atha'rku laapaan: nee sonnapadiyea aakattum en'ru solli,

annaa'lilea kalappu ni'ramum variyumu'l'la ve'l'laattuk kadaakka'laiyum, pu'l'liyum variyumu'l'la ve'l'laaduka'l yaavaiyum, sat'ru ve'nmaiyum karumaiyumu'l'la semma'riyaaduka'l yaavaiyum piriththu, than kumaararidaththil oppuviththu,
thanakkum yaakkoapukkum idaiyilea moon'runaa'l pirayaa'na thooraththil irukkumpadi vaiththaan. laapaanudaiya mat'ra aaduka'lai yaakkoapu meayththaan.
pinpu yaakkoapu pachchaiyaayirukki'ra punnai, vaathumai, armoan ennum marangka'lin koppuka'lai vetti, idaiyidaiyea ve'nmai thoan'rumpadi, pattaiyai uriththu,
thaan uriththa koppuka'lai aaduka'l tha'n'neer kudikka varum kaalvaayka'lilum thottika'lilum aaduka'lukku ethiraakap poattuvaippaan; aaduka'l tha'n'neer kudikka varumpoathu polivathu'ndu.
aaduka'l anthak koppuka'lukku munpaakap polinthapadiyaal, avaika'l kalappuni'ramu'l'lathum pu'l'liyu'l'lathum variyu'l'lathumaana kuttika'laip poattathu.

antha aattukkuttika'lai yaakkoapu piriththukko'ndu, aaduka'lai laapaanudaiya manthaiyilirukkum kalappuni'ramaanavaika'lukkum ka'ruppaanavaika'lellaavat'ri'rkum ethiraaka ni'ruththi, than aaduka'lai laapaanudaiya manthaiyoadea searkkaamal, thanippu'ramaaka vaiththukko'lvaan.
palaththa aaduka'l poliyumpoathu, anthak koppuka'lukku ethirea poliyumpadi yaakkoapu avaika'lai antha aaduka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaakak kaalvaayka'lilea poattuvaippaan.
palaveenamaana aaduka'l poliyumpoathu, avaika'laip poadaamaliruppaan; ithanaal palaveenamaanavaika'l laapaanaiyum, palamu'l'lavaika'l yaakkoapaiyum searnthana.
ivvithamaay anthap purushan mikavum viruththiyadainthu, thira'laana aaduka'lum, vealaikkaarika'lum, vealaikkaararum, ottakangka'lum, kazhuthaika'lum udaiyavanaanaan.

pinpu, laapaanudaiya kumaarar: engka'l thakappanukku u'ndaanavaika'l yaavaiyum yaakkoapu eduththukko'ndaan en'rum, engka'l thakappanudaiya poru'linaalea inthach selvaththaiyellaam adainthaan en'rum sonna vaarththaika'lai yaakkoapu keattaan.
laapaanin mukaththai yaakkoapu paarththapoathu, athu neat'ru munthainaa'l irunthathupoal iraamal vea'rupattirukkak ka'ndaan.
karththar yaakkoapai noakki: un pithaakka'ludaiya theasaththi'rkum un inaththaaridaththi'rkum nee thirumpippoa; naan unnoadeakooda iruppean en'raar.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu, raakealaiyum leayaa'laiyum ve'liyilea than manthaiyidaththil azhaippiththu,
avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l thakappanudaiya mukam neat'ru munthainaa'l irunthathupoala irukkavillai en'ru enakkuth thoan'ruki'rathu; aanaalum en thakappanudaiya theavan ennoadeakooda irukki'raar.
ennaal iyan'ramattum naan ungka'l thakappanukku oozhiyagnseythean en'ru neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
ungka'l thakappanoa, ennai vagnchiththu, en sampa'laththaip paththumu'rai maat'rinaan; aanaalum avan enakkuth theengkuseyya theavan avanukku idangkodukkavillai.

pu'l'liyu'l'lavaika'l un sampa'lamaayirukkum en'ru avan sonnapoathu, aaduka'lellaam pu'l'liyu'l'la kuttika'laip poattathu; kalappuni'ramaanavaika'l un sampa'lamaayirukkum en'ru avan sonnapoathu, aaduka'lellaam kalappuni'rak kuttika'laip poattathu.
ivvithamaay theavan ungka'l thakappanudaiya aaduka'lai eduththu, enakkuth thanthaar.

aaduka'l poliyum kaalaththilea naan ka'nda soppanaththil en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkumpoathu, aaduka'loadea poliyum kadaakka'l kalappuni'ramum pu'l'liyum variyum u'l'lavaika'laayirukkak ka'ndean.
an'riyum theavathoothan oruvar soppanaththil: yaakkoapea en'raar; ithoa, irukki'rean en'rean.
appozhuthu avar: un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaar; aaduka'loadea poliyum kadaakka'lellaam kalappuni'ramum pu'l'liyum variyumu'l'lavaika'laay irukki'rathu; laapaan unakkuch seyki'ra yaavaiyum ka'ndean.

nee thoo'nukku apisheakagnseythu, enakku oru poruththanaiyaip pa'n'nina peththealilea unakkuth tharisanamaana theavan naanea; ippozhuthu nee ezhunthu, inthath theasaththaivittup pu'rappattu, un inaththaarirukki'ra theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoa en'ru sonnaar en'raan.
atha'rku raakealum leayaa'lum: engka'l thakappan veettilea ini engka'lukkup pangkum suthantharamum u'ndoa?
avaraal naangka'l anniyaraay e'n'nappadavillaiyaa? avar engka'lai vit'ru, engka'l pa'naththaiyum vaayilea poattukko'ndaar.
aakaiyaal theavan engka'l thakappanidaththilirunthu eduththa aisuvariyam ellaam namakkum nammudaiya pi'l'laika'lukkum uriyathu; ippadiyirukka, theavan umakkuch sonnapadiyellaam seyyum en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu ezhunthu, than pi'l'laika'laiyum than manaivika'laiyum ottakangka'lmeal eat'ri,

thaan pathaan araamilea sampaathiththa mirukajeevanka'laakiya manthaika'l anaiththaiyum than poru'lka'l ellaavat'raiyum eduththukko'ndu, kaanaantheasaththil irukki'ra than thakappanaakiya eesaakkinidaththukkup poakap pu'rappattaan.
laapaan, than aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikkap poayirunthaan; anthach samayaththilea raakeal than thakappanudaiya suroopangka'laith thirudikko'ndaa'l.
yaakkoapu thaan oadippoaki'rathaich seeriyanaakiya laapaanukku a'riviyaamal, thirutta'lavaayp poayvittaan.
ippadiyea avan thanakku u'ndaanavaika'laiyellaam eduththukko'ndu, aat'raik kadanthu, keeleayaath malaiyai noakki oadippoanaan.
yaakkoapu oadippoanathu moon'raam naa'lilea laapaanukku a'rivikkappattathu.
appozhuthu avan, than sakoathararaik koottikko'ndu, eazhunaa'l pirayaa'napariyantham avanaith thodarnthupoay, keeleayaath malaiyilea avanaik ka'ndupidiththaan.
an'ru raaththiri theavan seeriyaa theasaththaanaakiya laapaanukkuch soppanaththil thoan'ri: nee yaakkoapoadea nanmaiyea an'rith theemai on'rum peasaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru en'raar.
laapaan yaakkoapinidaththil vanthaan; yaakkoapu malaiyilea than koodaaraththaip poattirunthaan; laapaanum than sakoathararoadeakoodak keeleayaath malaiyilea koodaaram poattaan.
appozhuthu laapaan yaakkoapai noakki: nee thirutta'lavaayp pu'rappattu, en kumaaraththika'lai yuththaththil pidiththa si'raika'laippoalak ko'nduvanthathu enna seykai?

nee oadippoavathai ma'raiththu, enakku a'riviyaamal, thirutta'lavaay ennidaththilirunthu vanthuvittathu enna? naan unnaich santhoashamaay, sangkeetham mea'lathaa'lam kinnaramuzhakkaththudanea anuppuveanea.
en pi'l'laika'laiyum en kumaaraththika'laiyum naan muththagnseyya vidaamal poanathenna? inthach seykaiyai nee mathiyillaamal seythaay.

ungka'lukkup pollaappuchseyya enakku vallamai u'ndu; aakilum, ungka'l thakappanudaiya theavan: nee yaakkoapoadea nanmaiyea an'rith theemai on'rum peasaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru en'ru neat'ru raaththiri ennoadea sonnaar.
ippozhuthum un thakappanudaiya veettinmealu'l'la vaagnchaiyinaal nee pu'rappattuppoaki'rathaanaal poakalaam, en theyvangka'lai ean thirudikko'ndupoaki'raay en'ru keattaan.
yaakkoapu laapaanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ummudaiya kumaaraththika'laip palaathkaaramaayp pidiththu vaiththukko'lveer en'ru naan agnchinathinaalea ippadi vanthuvittean.

aanaalum yaaridaththil ummudaiya theyvangka'laik ka'ndupidikki'reeroa, avanai uyiroadea vidavea'ndaam; ummudaiya poru'lka'l eathaavathu en vasaththil u'ndaanaal neer athai nammudaiya sakoathararukku munpaakap parisoathiththa'rinthu, athai eduththukko'l'lum en'raan. raakeal avaika'laith thirudikko'nduvanthathai yaakkoapu a'riyaathirunthaan.

appozhuthu laapaan yaakkoapin koodaaraththilum, leayaa'lin koodaaraththilum, ira'ndu vealaikkaarika'lin koodaaraththilum piraveasiththuppaarththum on'rum ka'ndupidikkavillai; pinpu, leayaa'lin koodaaraththaivittu raakealin koodaaraththukkup poanaan.
raakeal anthach suroopangka'lai eduththu, ottakach sea'naththinkeezh vaiththu, athinmeal udkaarnthirunthaa'l. laapaan koodaaram engkum thadavippaarththum, avaika'laik ka'ndupidikkavillai.

ava'l than thakappanai noakki: en aa'ndavanaakiya umakku munpaaka naan ezhunthiraathathaikku'riththuk koapangko'l'lavea'ndaam; sthireeka'lukku'l'la vazhipaadu enakku u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'raa'l; appadiyea avan anthach suroopangka'laith theadiyum ka'ndupidikkavillai.
appozhuthu yaakkoapukkuk koapam ezhumpi, laapaanoadea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ni: neer ennai ivva'lavu ukkiramaayth thodarnthuvarumpadikku naan seytha thappitham enna? naan seytha thuroakam enna?

en thattumuttuka'laiyellaam thadavippaarththeerea; ummudaiya veettuth thattumuttuka'lil ennaththaik ka'ndupidiththeer? athai ennudaiya sakoathararukkum ummudaiya sakoathararukkum munpaaka ingkea vaiyum; avarka'l enakkum umakkum naduththeerkkattum.
intha irupathu varushakaalamaay naan ummidaththil irunthean; ummudaiya semma'riyaaduka'lum ve'l'laaduka'lum sinaiyazhiyavillai; ummudaiya manthaiyin kadaakka'lai naan thinnavillai.
pee'ru'ndathai naan ummidaththukkuk ko'nduvaraamal, atha'rkaaka naan uththaravaathampa'n'ninean; pakalil ka'lavupoanathaiyum, iravil ka'lavupoanathaiyum en kaiyil keattu vaangkineer.
pakalilea veyilum iravilea ku'lirum ennaip padchiththathu; niththirai en ka'nka'lukkuth thooramaayirunthathu; ivvithamaayp paadupattean.

intha irupathu varushakaalam ummudaiya veettilea irunthean; pathinaalu varusham ummudaiya ira'ndu kumaaraththika'lukkaakavum, aa'ru varusham ummudaiya manthaikkaakavum ummidaththil seaviththean; paththumu'rai en sampa'laththai maat'rineer.

en pithaavin theavanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin payapakthikkuriyavarum ennoadiraama'rpoanaal, neer ippozhuthu ennai ve'rumaiyaay anuppivittiruppeer; theavan en si'rumaiyaiyum en kaippirayaasaththaiyum paarththu, neat'ru raaththiri ummaik kadinthuko'ndaar en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu laapaan yaakkoapukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthak kumaaraththika'l en kumaaraththika'l, inthap pi'l'laika'l en pi'l'laika'l, intha manthai en manthai; nee kaa'nki'ra yaavum ennudaiyavaika'l; en kumaaraththika'laakiya ivarka'laiyum, ivarka'l pet'ra pi'l'laika'laiyum in'ru naan enna seyyakkoodum?
ippozhuthum enakkum unakkum saadchiyaayirukkumporuttu, neeyum naanum udanpadikkaipa'n'nikko'l'lakkadavoam en'raan.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu oru kallai eduththu, athaith thoo'naaka ni'ruththinaan.

pinnum yaakkoapu than sakoathararaip paarththu, ka'rka'laik kuviyalaakach searungka'l en'raan; avarka'l ka'rka'lai eduththukko'nduvanthu, oru kuviyalaakki, anthak kuviyalinmeal poajanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
laapaan atha'rku jekarsakathoothaa en'ru pearittaan; yaakkoapu atha'rkuk kalayeth en'ru pearittaan.
inthak kuviyal in'ru enakkum unakkum saadchi en'ru laapaan sonnapadiyinaalea, athin pear kalayeth ennappattathu.

allaamalum avan: naam oruvarai oruvar vittu ma'rainthapin, nee en kumaaraththika'laith thuyarappaduththi, avarka'laiyallaamal vea'rea sthireeka'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaayaanaal, karththar enakkum unakkum nadunin'ru ka'nkaa'nikkakkadavar;
nammudanea oruvarum illai; paar, theavanea enakkum unakkum saadchi en'ru sonnapadiyaal, athu mispaa ennum pearpet'rathu.
pinnum laapaan yaakkoapai noakki: ithoa, inthak kuviyalaiyum enakkum unakkum naduvaaka naan ni'ruththina thoo'naiyum paar.

theengkuseyya naan inthak kuviyalaik kadanthu unnidaththukku varaathapadikkum, nee inthak kuviyalaiyum inthath thoo'naiyum kadanthu ennidaththukku varaathapadikkum inthak kuviyalum saadchi, inthath thoo'num saadchi.

aapirakaamin theavanum naakoarin theavanum avarka'l pithaakka'lin theavanumaayirukki'ravar namakku'l'lea nadunin'ru niyaayantheerppaaraaka en'raan. appozhuthu yaakkoapu than thakappanaakiya eesaakkin payapakthikkuriyavarmeal aa'naiyittaan.
pinpu, yaakkoapu malaiyinmeal paliyittu, poajanampa'n'numpadi than sakoathararai azhaiththaan; appadiyea avarka'l poajanampa'n'ni malaiyilea iraaththangkinaarka'l.
laapaan athikaalamea ezhunthirunthu, than kumaararaiyum than kumaaraththika'laiyum muththagnseythu, avarka'lai aaseervathiththaan. pinpu laapaan pu'rappattu, than idaththukkuth thirumpippoanaan.
yaakkoapu pirayaa'nampa'n'nukaiyil, theavathootharka'l avanaich santhiththaarka'l.
yaakkoapu avarka'laik ka'ndapoathu: ithu theavanudaiya seanai en'ru solli, antha sthalaththi'rku maknaayeem en'ru pearittaan.
pinpu, yaakkoapu eathoam seemaiyaakiya seayeer theasaththilirukki'ra than sakoatharanaakiya easaavinidaththukkup poakumpadi aadka'lai azhaippiththu:
neengka'l en aa'ndavanaakiya easaavinidaththil poay, naan ithuvaraikkum laapaanidaththil thangkiyirunthean en'rum,

enakku eruthuka'lum, kazhuthaika'lum, aaduka'lum, vealaikkaararum, vealaikkaarika'lum u'nden'rum, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavukidaikkaththakkathaaka aa'ndavanaakiya umakku ithai a'rivikkumpadi aadka'lai anuppinean en'rum ummudaiya thaasanaakiya yaakkoapu sollachsonnaan en'ru sollumpadi katta'laikoduththuth thanakku munnaaka avarka'lai anuppinaan.
antha aadka'l yaakkoapinidaththukkuth thirumpivanthu: naangka'l ummudaiya sakoatharanaakiya easaavinidaththukkup poayvanthoam; avarum naanoo'ru pearoadea ummai ethirko'l'la varuki'raar en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu mikavum payanthu, viyaakulappattu, thannidaththiliruntha janangka'laiyum aadumaaduka'laiyum ottakangka'laiyum ira'ndu pakuthiyaakap piriththu:
easaa oru pakuthiyinmeal vizhunthu athai mu'riya adiththaalum, mat'rap pakuthi thappiththukko'l'la idam u'ndu en'raan.

pinpu yaakkoapu: en thakappanaakiya aapirakaamin theavanum, en thakappanaakiya eesaakkin theavanumaay irukki'ravarea: un theasaththukkum un inaththaaridaththukkum thirumpippoa, unakku nanmai seyvean en'ru ennudanea solliyirukki'ra karththaavea,

adiyeanukku theavareer kaa'npiththa ellaa thayavukkum ellaa saththiyaththukkum naan evva'laveanum paaththiran alla, naan koalum kaiyumaay intha yoarthaanaik kadanthupoanean; ippozhuthu ivvira'ndu parivaarangka'laiyum udaiyavanaanean.
en sakoatharanaakiya easaavin kaikku ennaith thappuviyum, avan vanthu ennaiyum pi'l'laika'laiyum thaaymaarka'laiyum mu'riya adippaan en'ru avanukku naan payanthirukki'rean.
theavareeroa: naan unakku meyyaakavea nanmaiseythu, un santhathiyai e'n'nimudiyaatha kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoala mikavum perukappa'n'nuvean en'ru sonneerea en'raan.
an'ru raaththiri avan angkea thangki, than kaikku uthavinavaika'lilea than sakoatharanaakiya easaavukku vekumaanamaaka,
irunoo'ru ve'l'laaduka'laiyum, irupathu ve'l'laattuk kadaakka'laiyum, irunoo'ru semma'riyaaduka'laiyum, irupathu aattukkadaakka'laiyum,

paal kodukki'ra muppathu ottakangka'laiyum, avaika'lin kuttika'laiyum, naa'rpathu kadaarika'laiyum, paththuk kaa'laika'laiyum, irupathu koa'likaik kazhuthaika'laiyum, paththuk kazhuthaikkuttika'laiyum piriththeduththu,

vealaikkaarar kaiyil ovvoru manthaiyaith thaniththaniyaaka oppuviththu, neengka'l manthai manthaikku munnum pinnumaaka idam vittu enakku munnaaka oattikko'ndupoangka'l en'ru than vealaikkaararukkuch solli,
munnea poaki'ravanai noakki: en sakoatharanaakiya easaa unakku ethirppattu: nee yaarudaiyavan? engkea poaki'raay? unakkumun poaki'ra manthai yaarudaiyathu? en'ru unnaik keattaal,
nee: ithu umathu adiyaanaakiya yaakkoapudaiyathu; ithu en aa'ndavanaakiya easaavukku anuppappaduki'ra vekumathi; ithoa, avanum engka'l pinnea varuki'raan en'ru sol en'raan.
ira'ndaam moon'raam vealaikkaaranaiyum, manthaika'lin pinnaalea poaki'ra anaivaraiyum noakki: neengka'lum easaavaik kaa'numpoathu, inthappirakaaramaaka avanoadea solli,

ithoa, umathu adiyaanaakiya yaakkoapu engka'l pinnaalea varuki'raan en'rum sollungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan; munnea vekumathiyai anuppi, avanaich saanthappaduththikko'ndu, pinpu avan mukaththaip paarppean, appozhuthu oruvea'lai enpearil thayavaayiruppaan en'raan.
anthappadiyea vekumathi avanukku mun poayit'ru; avanoa an'ru raaththiri paa'layaththilea thangki,

iraaththiriyil ezhunthirunthu, than ira'ndu manaivika'laiyum, than ira'ndu pa'nividaikkaarika'laiyum, thannudaiya pathinoru kumaararaiyum koottikko'ndu, yaappoakku enki'ra aat'rin thu'raiyaik kadanthaan.
avarka'laiyum searththu, aat'raik kadakkappa'n'ni, thanakku u'ndaana yaavaiyum akkaraippaduththinaan.
yaakkoapu pinthith thaniththirunthaan; appozhuthu oru purushan pozhuthu vidiyuma'lavum avanudanea poaraadi,
avanai mea'rko'l'laathathaik ka'ndu, avanudaiya thodaichsanthaith thottaar; athinaal avarudanea poaraadukaiyil yaakkoapin thodaichsanthu su'lukkit'ru.
avar: naan poakattum, pozhuthu vidiki'rathu en'raar. atha'rku avan: neer ennai aaseervathiththaalozhiya ummaip poakavidean en'raan.
avar: un pear enna en'ru keattaar; yaakkoapu en'raan.
appozhuthu avar: un pear ini yaakkoapu ennappadaamal israveal ennappadum; theavanoadum manitharoadum poaraadi mea'rko'ndaayea en'raar.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu: ummudaiya naamaththai enakku a'rivikkavea'ndum en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avar: nee en naamaththaik keadpaanean en'ru solli, angkea avanai aaseervathiththaar.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu: naan theavanai mukamukamaayk ka'ndean, uyir thappip pizhaiththean en'ru solli, antha sthalaththukku peniyeal en'ru pearittaan.
avan peniyealaik kadanthupoakaiyil, sooriyan uthayamaayit'ru; avan thodaichsu'lukkinaalea no'ndi no'ndi nadanthaan.
avar yaakkoapudaiya thodaichsanthu narampaith thottapadiyaal, israveal puththirar innaa'lvaraikkum thodaichsanthu narampaip pusikki'rathillai.

yaakkoapu than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, ithoa, easaavum avanoadeakooda naanoo'ru manitharum varuki'rathaik ka'ndu, pi'l'laika'lai leayaa'lidaththilum raakealidaththilum ira'ndu pa'nividaikkaarika'lidaththilum vevvea'raakap piriththuvaiththu,
pa'nividaikkaarika'laiyum avarka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum muthalilum, leayaa'laiyum ava'l pi'l'laika'laiyum idaiyilum, raakealaiyum yoaseappaiyum kadaiyilum ni'ruththi:
thaan avarka'lukku munnaaka nadanthupoay, eazhuvisai tharaimattum kuninthu va'nangki, than sakoatharan kittach searnthaan.
appozhuthu easaa ethirko'ndu oadivanthu, avanaith thazhuvi, avan kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu, avanai muththagnseythaan; iruvarum azhuthaarka'l.
avan than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, sthireeka'laiyum pi'l'laika'laiyum ka'ndu: unnoadirukki'ra ivarka'l yaar? en'raan. atha'rku avan: theavan umathu adiyaanukku aru'lina pi'l'laika'l en'raan.
appozhuthu pa'nividaikkaarika'lum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum searnthuvanthu va'nangkinaarka'l.
leayaa'lum ava'l pi'l'laika'lum searnthuvanthu va'nangkinaarka'l; pinpu yoaseappum raakealum searnthuvanthu va'nangkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: enakku ethirko'nduvantha antha manthaiyellaam ennaththukku en'raan. atha'rku avan: en aa'ndavanudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavu kidaikki'ratha'rku en'raan.
atha'rku easaa: en sakoatharanea, enakkup poathumaanathu u'ndu; unnudaiyathu unakku irukkattum en'raan.

atha'rku yaakkoapu: appadi alla, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavu kidaiththatheayaanaal, en vekumathiyai en kaiyilirunthu eat'rukko'l'lum; neer enmeal piriyamaaneer, naan ummudaiya mukaththaik ka'ndathu theavanudaiya mukaththaik ka'ndathupoala irukki'rathu.

theavan enakku anukkirakam seythirukki'raar; vea'ndiyathellaam enakku u'ndu; aakaiyaal umakkuk ko'nduvarappatta en kaa'nikkaiyai eat'rukko'l'lum en'ru solli, avanai varunthik keattukko'ndaan; appozhuthu avan athai eat'rukko'ndaan.
pinpu avan: naam pu'rappattuppoavoam vaa, naan unakku mun nadappean en'raan.

atha'rku avan: pi'l'laika'l i'lam pi'l'laika'l en'rum, ka'ravaiyaana aadumaaduka'l ennidaththil irukki'rathu en'rum en aa'ndavanukkuth theriyum; avaika'lai oru naa'laavathu thurithamaay oattinaal, manthaiyellaam maa'ndupoam.

en aa'ndavanaakiya neer umathu adiyaanukku munnea poam; naan seayeerukku en aa'ndavanidaththil varuma'lavum, enakkumun nadakki'ra manthaika'lin kaalnadaikkum pi'l'laika'lin kaalnadaikkum thakkathaaka, methuvaay avaika'lai nadaththikko'ndu varuki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu easaa: ennidaththilirukki'ra janangka'lil silarai naan unnidaththil ni'ruththivittup poakattumaa en'raan. atha'rku avan: athu ennaththi'rku, en aa'ndavanudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavukidaiththaal maaththiram poathum en'raan.
an'raiththinam easaa thirumpith thaan vantha vazhiyea seayeerukkup poanaan.
yaakkoapu sukkoaththi'rkup pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, thanakku oru veedu katti, than mirukajeevanka'lukkuk kottaarangka'laip poattaan; athinaalea antha sthalaththukkuch sukkoath en'ru pearittaan.
yaakkoapu pathaan araamilirunthu vanthapin kaanaantheasaththilirukki'ra saaleam ennum seekeamudaiya patta'naththi'rku arukea sen'ru patta'naththi'rku ethirea koodaarampoattaan.
thaan koodaarampoatta ve'liyin nilaththaich seekeamin thakappanaakiya eamoarin puththirar kaiyilea noo'ru ve'l'likkaasukkuk ko'ndu,
angkea oru palipeedaththaik katti, atha'rku ealelloakea israveal en'ru pearittaan.
leayaa'l yaakkoapukkup pet'ra kumaaraththiyaakiya theenaa'l theasaththup pe'nka'laip paarkkap pu'rappattaa'l.
ava'lai eaviyanaana eamoarin kumaaranum aththeasaththin pirapuvumaakiya seekeam enpavan ka'ndu, ava'laik ko'ndupoay, ava'loadea sayaniththu, ava'laith theettuppaduththinaan.
avanudaiya manam yaakkoapin kumaaraththiyaakiya theenaa'lmeal pat'ruthalaayirunthathu; avan anthap pe'n'nai neasiththu, anthap pe'n'nin manathukku inpamaayp peasinaan.
seekeam than thakappanaakiya eamoarai noakki: inthap pe'n'nai enakkuk ko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.

than kumaaraththiyaakiya theenaa'lai avan theettuppaduththinathai yaakkoapu kea'lvippattapoathu, avan kumaarar avanudaiya manthaiyinidaththil ve'liyilea irunthaarka'l; avarka'l varuma'lavum yaakkoapu peasaamalirunthaan.
aththaru'naththil seekeamin thakappanaakiya eamoar pu'rappattu, yaakkoapoadea peasumpadi avanidaththil vanthaan.

yaakkoapin kumaarar inthach seythiyaik keattavudanea, ve'liyilirunthu vanthaarka'l. avan yaakkoapin kumaaraththiyoadea sayaniththu, seyyaththakaatha mathiketta kaariyaththai isravealil seythathinaalea, antha manithar manangkothiththu mikavum koapangko'ndaarka'l.
eamoar avarka'loadea peasi: en kumaaranaakiya seekeamin manathu ungka'l kumaaraththiyinmeal pat'ruthalaayirukki'rathu; ava'lai avanukku manaiviyaakak kodungka'l.
neengka'l engka'loadea sampanthangkalanthu, ungka'l kumaaraththika'lai engka'lukkuk koduththu, engka'l kumaaraththika'lai ungka'lukkuk ko'ndu,
engka'loadea vaasampa'n'nungka'l; theasam ungka'l munpaaka irukki'rathu; ithilea kudiyirunthu, viyaapaarampa'n'ni, poru'l sampaathiththu, athaik kaiyaa'nduko'ndirungka'l en'raan.
seekeamum ava'l thakappanaiyum ava'l sakoathararaiyum noakki: ungka'l ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavukidaikkavea'ndum; neengka'l ennidaththil ethaik keattaalum tharuki'rean;
parisamum vekumathiyum neengka'l evva'lavu keattaalum, ungka'l so'rpadi tharuki'rean; anthap pe'n'naimaaththiram enakku manaiviyaakak kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu yaakkoapin kumaarar thangka'l sakoathariyaakiya theenaa'laich seekeam enpavan theettuppaduththinapadiyaal, avanukkum avan thakappanaakiya eamoarukkum vagnchakamaana ma'rumozhiyaaka:
viruththaseathanamillaatha purushanukku naangka'l engka'l sakoathariyaik kodukkalaakaathu; athu engka'lukku ninthaiyaayirukkum.
neengka'lum, ungka'lukku'l'lirukkum aa'nmakka'l yaavarum viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappattu engka'laippoalaaveerka'laanaal, naangka'l sammathiththu,
ungka'lukku engka'l kumaaraththika'laik koduththu, ungka'l kumaaraththika'lai engka'lukkuk ko'ndu, ungka'loadea kudiyirunthu, eakajanamaayiruppoam.
viruththaseathanam pa'n'nikko'lvatha'rku engka'l sol kea'laama'rpoaveerka'laanaal, naangka'l engka'l kumaaraththiyai azhaiththukko'ndu poayviduvoam en'ru sonnaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya vaarththaika'l eamoarukkum eamoarin kumaaranaakiya seekeamukkum nalamaayth thoan'rinathu.

antha vaalipan yaakkoapudaiya kumaaraththiyinmeal piriyam vaiththirunthapadiyaal, anthak kaariyaththaich seyya avan thaamathampa'n'navillai. avan than thakappan veettaar anaivarukku'l'lum meanmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.
eamoarum avan kumaaran seekeamum thangka'l patta'naththu vaasalil vanthu, thangka'l patta'naththu manitharoadea peasi:

intha manithar nammoadea samaathaanamaayirukki'raarka'l; aakaiyaal, avarka'l inthath theasaththil vaasampa'n'ni, ithilea viyaapaarampa'n'nattum; avarka'lum vaasampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku theasam visthaaramaayirukki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lai namakku manaivika'laakak ko'ndu, nammudaiya kumaaraththika'lai avarka'lukkuk koduppoam.

antha manithar viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappattavarka'laayirukki'rathupoala, nammilu'l'la aa'nmakka'l yaavarum viruththaseathanampa'n'nappattaal, avarka'l eakajanamaaka nammoadea vaasampa'n'nach sammathippaarka'l.
