avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'l aasthika'l mirukajeevanka'l ellaam nammaich searumallavaa? avarka'lukkuch sammathippoamaanaal, avarka'l nammudanea vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu eamoarin patta'naththu vaasalil pu'rappattuvarum anaivarum avan sollaiyum avan kumaaranaakiya seekeamin sollaiyum keattu, avanudaiya patta'naththu vaasalil pu'rappattuvarum aa'nmakka'l yaavarum viruththaseathanampa'n'nappattaarka'l.

moon'raam naa'lil avarka'lukku noaveduththukko'ndapoathu, yaakkoapin kumaararum theenaa'lin sakoathararumaana simiyoan leavi ennum ivvira'ndu pearum thanthan pattayaththai eduththukko'ndu, thu'nikaramaayp patta'naththinmeal paaynthu, aa'nmakka'l yaavaraiyum kon'rupoattaarka'l.
eamoaraiyum avan kumaaran seekeamaiyum pattayakkarukkaalea kon'ru, seekeamin veettiliruntha theenaa'lai azhaiththukko'ndu poayvittaarka'l.
mealum, yaakkoapin kumaarar vettu'ndavarka'lidaththil vanthu, thangka'l sakoathariyai avarka'l theettuppaduththinatha'rkaakap patta'naththaik ko'l'laiyittu,
avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum, patta'naththilum vayalve'liyilum irunthavaika'l yaavaiyum,
avarka'ludaiya ellaath thattumuttuka'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, avarka'ludaiya ellaak kuzhanthaika'laiyum sthireeka'laiyum si'raipidiththu, veettiliruntha ellaavat'raiyum ko'l'laiyittaarka'l.

appozhuthu yaakkoapu simiyoanaiyum leaviyaiyum paarththu: inthath theasaththil kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniyaridaththilum perisiyaridaththilum en vaasanaiyai neengka'l keduththathinaalea ennaik kalangkappa'n'nineerka'l; naan kogncha janamu'l'lavan; avarka'l enakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodi, naanum en kudumpamum azhiyumpadi ennai vettippoaduvaarka'lea en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: engka'l sakoathariyai avarka'l oru veasiyaippoala nadaththalaamoa en'raarka'l.

theavan yaakkoapai noakki: nee ezhunthu peththealukkup poay, angkea kudiyirunthu, nee un sakoatharanaakiya easaavin mukaththi'rku vilaki oadippoaki'rapoathu, unakkuth tharisanamaana theavanukku angkea oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakku en'raar.

appozhuthu yaakkoapu than veettaaraiyum thannoadeakooda iruntha mat'ra anaivaraiyum noakki: ungka'lidaththil irukki'ra anniya theyvangka'lai vilakkippoattu, ungka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndu, ungka'l vasthirangka'lai maat'rungka'l.

naam ezhunthu peththealukkup poavoam vaarungka'l; enakku aapaththu nearitta naa'lil en vi'n'nappaththukku uththaravu aru'lichseythu, naan nadantha vazhiyilea ennoadeakooda iruntha theavanukku angkea oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakkuvean en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l kaiyil iruntha ellaa anniya theyvangka'laiyum, thangka'l kaatha'nika'laiyum yaakkoapidaththil koduththaarka'l; yaakkoapu avaika'laich seekeam oor arukea iruntha oru karvaali maraththinkeezhea puthaiththuppoattaan.
pinpu pirayaa'nam pu'rappattaarka'l; avarka'laich sut'rilum iruntha patta'naththaarukkuth theavanaalea payangkaram u'ndaanathinaal, avarka'l yaakkoapin kumaararaip pinthodaraathirunthaarka'l.
yaakkoapum avanoadeakooda iruntha ellaa janangka'lum kaanaantheasaththilu'l'la peththeal ennum loosukku vanthaarka'l.
angkea avan oru palipeedaththaik katti, than sakoatharanudaiya mukaththukkuth thappi oadinapoathu, angkea thanakku theavan tharisanamaanapadiyaal, antha sthalaththi'rku ealpeththeal en'ru pearittaan.
repekkaa'lin thaathiyaakiya theporaa'l mariththu, peththealukkuch sameepamaayiruntha oru karvaali maraththinkeezh adakkampa'n'nappattaa'l; atha'rku alloanpaakooth ennum pear u'ndaayit'ru.
yaakkoapu pathaan araamilirunthu vanthapinpu theavan avanukku ma'rupadiyum tharisanamaaki, avanai aaseervathiththu:
ippozhuthu un pear yaakkoapu, ini un pear yaakkoapu ennappadaamal, israveal en'ru unakkup pear vazhangkum en'ru solli, avanukku israveal en'ru pearittaar.

pinnum theavan avanai noakki: naan sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan, nee palukip perukuvaayaaka; oru jaathiyum pa'rpala jaathika'lin koottangka'lum unnilirunthu u'ndaakum; raajaakka'lum un santhathiyil pi'rappaarka'l.
naan aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum koduththa theasaththai unakkuk koduppean; unakkuppin un santhathikkum intha theasaththaik koduppean en'ru solli,
theavan avanoadea peasina sthalaththilirunthu avanaivittu ezhuntharu'lippoanaar.
appozhuthu yaakkoapu thannoadea avar peasina sthalaththilea oru kat'roo'nai ni'ruththi, athinmeal paanapaliyai oot'ri, e'n'neyaiyum vaarththaan.
theavan thannoadea peasina antha sthalaththi'rku yaakkoapu peththeal en'ru pearittaan.
pinpu, peththealai vittup pirayaa'nam pu'rappattaarka'l. eppiraaththaavukku vara innum kogncham thooramirukkumpoathu, raakeal pi'l'laipet'raa'l; pirasavaththil ava'lukkuk kadumveathanai u'ndaayit'ru.
pirasavikkumpoathu, ava'lukkuk kadumveathanaiyaayirukkaiyil, maruththuvachchi ava'laip paarththu: payappadaathea, intha mu'raiyum puththiranaip pe'ruvaay en'raa'l.
mara'nakaalaththil ava'l aaththumaa piriyumpoathu, ava'l avanukku penoni en'ru pearittaa'l; avan thakappanoa, avanukku penyameen en'ru pearittaan.
raakeal mariththu, pethlekeam ennum eppiraaththaa oorukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaa'l.
ava'l kalla'raiyinmeal yaakkoapu oru thoo'nai ni'ruththinaan; athuvea innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra raakealudaiya kalla'raiyin thoo'n.
israveal pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, eathear enki'ra koapuraththi'rku appu'raththil koodaaram poattaan.
israveal anthath theasaththil thangkik kudiyirukkumpoathu, roopan poay, than thakappanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya pilkaa'loadea sayaniththaan; athai israveal kea'lvippattaan.
yaakkoapin kumaarar pannira'ndu pear. yaakkoapin mooththamakanaakiya roopan, simiyoan, leavi, yoothaa, isakkaar, sepuloan enpavarka'l leayaa'l pet'ra kumaarar.
yoaseappu, penyameen enpavarka'l raakeal pet'ra kumaarar.
thaa'n, napthali enpavarka'l raakealudaiya pa'nividaikkaariyaakiya pilkaa'l pet'ra kumaarar.
kaath, aasear enpavarka'l leayaa'lin pa'nividaikkaariyaakiya silpaa'l pet'ra kumaarar; ivarka'lea yaakkoapukkup pathaan araamilea pi'rantha kumaarar.
pinpu, yaakkoapu arpaavin ooraakiya mamreakku than thakappanaakiya eesaakkinidaththil vanthaan; athu aapirakaamum eesaakkum thangkiyiruntha epiroan ennum oor.
eesaakku viruththaappiyamum poora'na aayusumu'l'lavanaaki, noot're'npathu varusham jeeviththirunthu,
piraa'nanpoay mariththu, than janaththaaroadea searkkappattaan. avan kumaararaakiya easaavum yaakkoapum avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
eathoamiyarin thakappanaakiya easaavin vamsavaralaa'ru:
easaa kaanaan theasaththup pe'nka'lil eaththiyanaana ealoanin kumaaraththiyaakiya aathaa'laiyum, eaviyanaakiya sipiyoanin kumaaraththiyum aanaakin kumaaraththiyumaakiya akoalipaamaa'laiyum,
ismavealin kumaaraththiyum nepaayoaththin sakoathariyumaakiya pasmaaththaiyum vivaakampa'n'niyirunthaan.
aathaa'l easaavukku eleeppaasaip pet'raa'l; pasmaaththu rekuvealaip pet'raa'l.
akoalipaamaa'l eyooshaiyum, yaalaamaiyum, koaraakaiyum pet'raa'l; ivarka'lea easaavukkuk kaanaantheasaththilea pi'rantha kumaarar.

easaa than manaivika'laiyum, than kumaararaiyum, than kumaaraththika'laiyum, than veettilu'l'la yaavaraiyum, than aadumaaduka'laiyum, mat'ra jeevajanthukka'l yaavaiyum, thaan kaanaantheasaththilea sampaathiththa aasthi muzhuvathaiyum searththukko'ndu, than sakoatharanaakiya yaakkoapai vittup pirinthu vea'rea theasaththukkup poanaan.

avarka'ludaiya sampaththu mikuthiyaayirunthapadiyinaal avarka'l orumiththuk kudiyirukkak koodaama'rpoayit'ru; avarka'ludaiya manthaika'linimiththamaay avarka'l thangkiyiruntha poomi avarka'laith thaangkakkoodaathathaayirunthathu.
aathalaal easaa seayeermalaiyil kudiyea'rinaan; easaavukku eathoam en'rum pear.
seayeermalaiyil irukki'ra eathoamiyarudaiya thakappanaakiya easaavin santhathika'lum,
easaavin kumaararudaiya naamangka'lumaavana: easaavin manaiviyaakiya aathaa'ludaiya kumaaranukku eleeppaas en'ru pear; easaavin manaiviyaakiya pasmaaththudaiya kumaaranukku rekuveal en'ru pear.
eleeppaasin kumaarar, theamaan, oamaar, seppoa, kaththaam, keanaas enpavarka'l.
thimnaa'l easaavin kumaaranaakiya eleeppaasukku ma'rumanaiyaattiyaayirunthu, eleeppaasukku amaleakkaip pet'raa'l; ivarka'lea easaavin manaiviyaakiya aathaa'ludaiya puththirar.
rekuvealudaiya kumaarar, nakaath, seraaku, sammaa, meesaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'lea easaavin manaiviyaakiya pasmaaththin puththirar.
sipiyoanin kumaaraththiyum aanaakin kumaaraththiyumaana akoalipaamaa'l enki'ra easaavin manaivi eyoosh, yaalaam, koaraaku ennum puththirarai easaavukkup pet'raa'l.
easaavin kumaararil thoan'riya pirapukka'laavana: easaavukku mooththa makanaakiya eleeppaasudaiya kumaararil theamaan pirapu, oamaar pirapu, seppoa pirapu, keanaas pirapu,
koaraaku pirapu, kaththaam pirapu, amaleakku pirapu enpavarka'l; ivarka'l eathoam theasaththil eleeppaasin santhathiyum aathaa'lin kumaararumaayiruntha pirapukka'l.

easaavin kumaaranaakiya rekuvealin puththiraril nakaath pirapu, seraaku pirapu, sammaa pirapu, meesaa pirapu enpavarka'l; ivarka'l eathoam theasaththil rekuvealin santhathiyum easaavin manaiviyaakiya pasmaaththin kumaararumaayiruntha pirapukka'l.

easaavin manaiviyaakiya akoalipaamaa'lin kumaarar, eyoosh pirapu, yaalaam pirapu, koaraaku pirapu enpavarka'l; ivarka'l aanaakin kumaaraththiyum easaavudaiya manaiviyumaakiya akoalipaamaa'lin santhathiyaayiruntha pirapukka'l.
ivarka'lea eathoam ennum easaavin santhathi; ivarka'lea avarka'liliruntha pirapukka'l.
anthath theasaththin kudika'laakiya oariyanaana seayeerin kumaarar, loaththaan, soapaal, sipiyoan, aanaaku,
thishoan, eathsear, thishaan enpavarka'l; ivarka'lea eathoam theasaththil seayeerin puththiraraakiya oariyarudaiya santhathiyaayiruntha pirapukka'l.
loaththaanudaiya kumaarar, oari, eamaam enpavarka'l; loaththaanin sakoathari thimnaa'l enpava'l.
soapaalin kumaarar, alvaan, maanakaath, eapaal, seppoa, oanaam enpavarka'l.
sipiyoanin kumaarar, ayaa, aanaaku enpavarka'l; vanaantharaththilea than thakappanaakiya sipiyoanin kazhuthaika'lai meaykkaiyil, koavea'ru kazhuthaika'laik ka'ndupidiththa aanaaku ivanthaan.
aanaakin pi'l'laika'l, thishoan, akoalipaamaa'l enpavarka'l; intha akoalipaamaa'l aanaakin kumaaraththi.
thishoanudaiya kumaarar, emthaan, espaan, iththaraan, keraan enpavarka'l.
eathsearudaiya kumaarar, pilkaan, sakavaan, akkaan enpavarka'l.
thishaanudaiya kumaarar, ooths, araan enpavarka'l.
oariyarin santhathiyil thoan'riya pirapukka'l, loaththaan pirapu, soapaal pirapu, sipiyoan pirapu, aanaaku pirapu,
thishoan pirapu, eathsear pirapu, thishaan pirapu enpavarka'l; ivarka'lea seayeer theasaththilea thangka'l thangka'l idangka'lil iruntha oariyar santhathiyaana pirapukka'l.
israveal puththirarmeal raajaakka'l arasaa'luki'ratha'rku munnea, eathoam theasaththilea aa'nda raajaakka'laavana:
peayoarudaiya kumaaranaakiya pealaa eathoamilea arasaa'ndaan; avanudaiya patta'naththukkuth thinkaapaa en'ru pear.
pealaa mariththapin, poas'raa patta'naththaanaakiya searaakudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoapaap avan pattaththi'rku vanthaan.
yoapaap mariththapin, theamaaniya theasaththaanaakiya ushaam avan pattaththi'rku vanthaan.
ushaam mariththapin, moavaapin naattilea meethiyaaniyarai mu'riya adiththa peathaathin kumaaranaakiya aathaath avan pattaththi'rku vanthaan; avanudaiya patta'naththukku aaveeth en'ru pear.
aathaath mariththapin, masreakkaa ooraanaakiya samlaa avanudaiya pattaththi'rku vanthaan.
samlaa mariththapin angkea irukki'ra nathikkuch sameepamaana rekopoath ennum ooraanaakiya savul avanudaiya pattaththi'rku vanthaan.
savul mariththapin, akpoarudaiya kumaaranaakiya paakaalkaanaan avanudaiya pattaththi'rku vanthaan.

akpoarudaiya kumaaranaakiya paakaalkaanaan mariththapin, aathaar avanudaiya pattaththi'rku vanthaan; avanudaiya patta'naththukkup paaku en'ru pear; avan manaiviyin pear mekeathapeal; ava'l mathreaththudaiya kumaaraththiyum measakaavin kumaaraththiyumaay irunthaa'l.

thangka'l pa'rpala vamsangka'linpadiyeayum vaasasthalangka'linpadiyeayum naamatheayangka'linpadiyeayum easaavin santhathiyil thoan'riya pirapukka'ludaiya naamangka'laavana: thimnaa pirapu, alvaa pirapu, eatheath pirapu,
akoalipaamaa pirapu, ealaa pirapu, pinoan pirapu,
keanaas pirapu, theamaan pirapu, mipsaar pirapu,
makthiyeal pirapu, eeraam pirapu; ivarka'lea thangka'l sonthamaana theasaththilea pa'rpala idangka'lil kudiyiruntha eathoam santhathip pirapukka'l; intha eathoamiyarukkuth thakappan easaa.
yaakkoapu than thakappan thangkiyiruntha kaanaan theasaththilea kudiyirunthaan.

yaakkoapudaiya santhathiyin varalaa'ru: yoaseappu pathineazhu vayathilea than sakoathararudanea aaduka'lai meayththukko'ndirunthaan; antha i'laignan pilkaa'l silpaa'l ennum than thakappanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattika'lin kumaararoadea irunthu, avarka'ludaiya thunmaarkkaththaith than thakappanukkuch sollivaruvaan.
isravealin muthirvayathilea yoaseapputh thanakkup pi'ranthathinaal, israveal than kumaarar ellaarilum avanai athikamaay neasiththu, avanukkup palavaru'namaana angkiyaich seyviththaan.
avanudaiya sakoatharar ellaarilum avanaith thangka'l thakappan athikamaay neasikki'rathai avan sakoatharar ka'ndapoathu, avanoadea padchamaayp peasaamal avanaip pakaiththaarka'l.
yoaseappu oru soppanam ka'ndu, athaith than sakoathararukku a'riviththaan; athinimiththam avanai innum athikamaayp pakaiththaarka'l.
avan avarka'lai noakki: naan ka'nda soppanaththaik kea'lungka'l:
naam vayalil a'ruththa arika'laik kattikko'ndirunthoam; appozhuthu ennudaiya arikkattu nimirnthirunthathu; ungka'l arikkattuka'l en arikkattaich sut'ri va'nangki nin'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu avan sakoatharar avanaip paarththu: nee engka'lmeal thuraiththanampa'n'nuvaayoa? nee engka'lai aa'lappoaki'raayoa? en'ru solli, avanai avan soppanangka'lin nimiththamum, avan vaarththaika'lin nimiththamum innum athikamaayp pakaiththaarka'l.
avan vea'roru soppanam ka'ndu, than sakoathararai noakki: naan innum oru soppanaththaik ka'ndean; sooriyanum santhiranum pathinoru nadchaththirangka'lum ennai va'nangkinathu en'raan.

ithai avan than thakappanukkum than sakoathararukkum sonnapoathu, avan thakappan avanaip paarththu: nee ka'nda inthach soppanam enna? naanum un thaayaarum un sakoathararum tharaimattum kuninthu unnai va'nangkavaruvoamoa? en'ru avanaik kadinthuko'ndaan.
avan sakoatharar avanmeal po'raamaiko'ndaarka'l; avan thakappanoa avan sonnathai manathilea vaiththukko'ndaan.
pinpu, avan sakoatharar seekeamilea thangka'l thakappanudaiya aaduka'lai meaykkap poanaarka'l.
appozhuthu israveal yoaseappai noakki: un sakoatharar seekeamilea aaduka'lai meaykki'raarka'l allavaa? unnai avarka'lidaththukku anuppap poaki'rean, vaa en'raan. avan: ithoa, poaki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: nee poay, un sakoathararudaiya sheamam eppadi en'rum, aaduka'l eppadi irukki'rathu en'rum paarththu, enakku ma'ruseythi ko'nduvaa en'ru avanukkuch solli, epiroan pa'l'laththaakkilea irunthu avanai anuppinaan; anthappadiyea avan seekeamukkup poanaan.
appozhuthu oru manithan avan ve'liyilea vazhithappith thiriki'rathaik ka'ndu, enna theaduki'raay? en'ru avanaik keattaan.
atha'rku avan: en sakoathararaith theaduki'rean, avarka'l engkea aadu meaykki'raarka'l, sollum en'raan.

antha manithan: avarka'l ivvidaththilirunthu poayvittaarka'l, thoaththaanukkup poavoam en'ru avarka'l sollakkeattean en'raan; appozhuthu yoaseappu than sakoathararaith thodarnthupoay, avarka'laith thoaththaanilea ka'ndupidiththaan.
avarka'l avanaith thooraththil varakka'ndu, avan thangka'lukkuch sameepamaay varumunnea, avanaik kolaiseyyumpadi sathiyoasanaipa'n'ni,
oruvarai oruvar noakki: ithoa, soppanakkaaran varuki'raan,
naam avanaik kon'ru, inthak kuzhika'l on'rilea avanaip poattu, oru thushdamirukam avanaip padchiththathu en'ru solluvoam vaarungka'l; avanudaiya soppanangka'l eppadi mudiyum paarppoam en'raarka'l.
roopan athaik keattu, avanai avarka'l kaikkuth thappuviththu, avanai avan thakappanidaththukkuth thirumpavum ko'ndupoaka manathu'l'lavanaay,

avarka'lai noakki: avanaik kolla vea'ndaam, neengka'l iraththam sinthalaakaathu; neengka'l avanmeal kai vaiyaamal, avanai vanaantharaththilu'l'la inthak kuzhiyilea poattuvidungka'l en'ru solli, ivvithamaay roopan avanai avarka'l kaikkuth thappuviththaan.
yoaseappu than sakoathararidaththil searnthapoathu, yoaseappu uduththikko'ndiruntha palavaru'na angkiyai avarka'l kazhat'ri,
avanai eduththu, anthak kuzhiyilea poattaarka'l; athu tha'n'neerillaatha ve'rungkuzhiyaayirunthathu.

pinpu, avarka'l poajanagnseyyumpadi udkaarnthaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l ka'nka'lai ea'redukkumpoathu, ithoa, keeleayaaththilirunthu varuki'ra ismavealarudaiya koottaththaik ka'ndaarka'l; avarka'l ekipthukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi kanthavarkkangka'laiyum pisin thailaththaiyum ve'l'laippoa'laththaiyum ottakangka'lmeal eat'rikko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoothaa than sakoathararai noakki: naam nammudaiya sakoatharanaik kon'ru, avan iraththaththai ma'raippathinaal laapam enna?

avanai intha ismavealarukku vit'ruppoaduvoam vaarungka'l; namathu kai avanmeal padaathiruppathaaka; avan nammudaiya sakoatharanum nammudaiya maamsamumaay irukki'raanea en'raan. avan sakoatharar avan sollukku i'nangkinaarka'l.

antha varththakaraana meethiyaaniyar kadanthupoaki'rapoathu, avarka'l yoaseappai anthak kuzhiyilirunthu thookkiyeduththu, avanai ismavealar kaiyil irupathu ve'l'likkaasukku vit'ruppoattaarka'l. avarka'l yoaseappai ekipthi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
pinpu, roopan anthak kuzhiyinidaththukkuth thirumpippoanapoathu, yoaseappu kuzhiyil illaiyen'ru ka'ndu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu,
than sakoathararidaththukkuth thirumpivanthu: i'laignan illaiyea, aiyoa! naan engkea poavean en'raan.
avarka'l yoaseappin angkiyai eduththu, oru ve'l'laattukkadaavai adiththu, antha angkiyai iraththaththilea thoayththu,
pala varu'namaana antha angkiyaith thangka'l thakappanidaththukku anuppi: ithai naangka'l ka'ndeduththoam, ithu ummudaiya kumaaran angkiyoa, allavoa, paarum en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.
yaakkoapu athaik ka'ndu, ithu en kumaaranudaiya angkithaan, oru thushdamirukam avanaip padchiththuppoattathu, yoaseappu pee'ru'ndupoanaan en'ru pulampi,
than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, than araiyil irattuk kattikko'ndu, aneakanaa'l than kumaaranukkaakath thukkiththukko'ndirunthaan.

avanudaiya kumaarar kumaaraththika'l ellaarum avanukku aa'ruthal sollavanthu nin'raarka'l; aanaalum avan aa'ruthalukku idangkodaamal, naan thukkaththoadea en kumaaranidaththil paathaa'laththil i'rangkuvean en'raan. ivvithamaay avanudaiya thakappan avanukkaaka azhuthuko'ndirunthaan.
antha meethiyaaniyar yoaseappai ekipthilea paarvoanin pirathaaniyum thalaiyaarika'lukku athipathiyumaakiya poaththipaar enpavanidaththil vit'raarka'l.
akkaalaththilea yoothaa than sakoathararai vittu, athullaam ooraanaakiya eeraa ennum oru manithanidaththil poaych searnthaan.
angkea yoothaa, soovaa ennum pearu'l'la oru kaanaaniyanudaiya kumaaraththiyaik ka'ndu, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, ava'loadea searnthaan.
ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avanukku ear en'ru pearittaan.
ava'l ma'rupadiyum karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukku oanaan en'ru pearittaa'l.
ava'l ma'rupadiyum karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukkuch sealaa en'ru pearittaa'l; ava'l ivanaip pe'ruki'rapoathu, avan keseepilea irunthaan.
yoothaa than mooththa makanaakiya ear enpavanukkuth thaamaar ennum pearu'l'la oru pe'n'naik ko'ndaan.
yoothaavin mooththa makanaakiya ear enpavan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaathavanaayirunthathinaal, karththar avanai azhiththuppoattaar.
appozhuthu yoothaa oanaanai noakki: nee un thamaiyan manaiviyaich searnthu, ava'lai maiththunach suthantharamaayp padaiththu, un thamaiyanukkuch santhathiyai u'ndaakku en'raan.

anthach santhathi than santhathiyaayiraathen'ru oanaan a'rinthapadiyinaalea, avan than thamaiyanudaiya manaiviyaich searumpoathu, than thamaiyanukkuch santhathi u'ndaakaathapadikkuth than viththaith tharaiyilea vizhavittuk keduththaan.
avan seythathu karththarin paarvaikkup pollaathathaayirunthathinaal, avanaiyum avar azhiththuppoattaar.

appozhuthu yoothaa, than kumaaranaakiya sealaavum avan sakoatharar seththathupoalach saavaan en'ru agnchi, than marumaka'laakiya thaamaarai noakki: en kumaaranaakiya sealaa periyavanaakumattum, nee un thakappan veettilea kaimpe'n'naayth thangkiyiru en'ru sonnaan; anthappadiyea thaamaar poayth than thakappan veettilea thangkiyirunthaa'l.

aneakanaa'l sen'rapin, soovaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya yoothaavin manaivi mariththaa'l. yoothaavinudaiya thukkam aa'rinapin, avan athullaam ooraanaakiya than sineakithan eeraavudanea thimnaavilea than aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'ravarka'lidaththi'rkup poanaan.
appozhuthu: un maamanaar thammudaiya aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikkath thimnaavukkup poaki'raar en'ru thaamaarukku a'rivikkappattathu.

sealaa periyavanaakiyum thaan avanukku manaiviyaakak kodukkappadavillai en'ru ava'l ka'ndapadiyaal, than kaimpe'nmaikkuriya vasthirangka'laik ka'lainthupoattu, mukkaadittuth thannai moodikko'ndu, thimnaavukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilirukki'ra neeroot'ruka'lukku munpaaka udkaarnthaa'l.
yoothaa ava'laik ka'ndu, ava'l than mukaththai moodiyirunthapadiyaal, ava'l oru veasi en'ru ninaiththu,

antha vazhiyaay ava'lidaththil poay, ava'l than marumaka'l en'ru a'riyaamal: naan unnidaththil searumpadi varuvaayaa en'raan; atha'rku ava'l: neer ennidaththil searumpadi, enakku enna tharuveer en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: naan manthaiyilirunthu oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyai anuppuki'rean en'raan. atha'rku ava'l: neer athai anuppuma'lavum oru adaimaanam koduppeeraa en'raa'l.

appozhuthu avan: naan unakku adaimaanamaaka enna kodukkavea'ndum en'ru keattaan. atha'rku ava'l: ummudaiya muththirai moathiramum ummudaiya aaramum ummudaiya kaikkoalum kodukkavea'ndum en'raa'l. avan avaika'lai ava'lukkuk koduththu, ava'lidaththil searnthaan; ava'l avanaalea karppavathiyaaki,
ezhunthupoay, than mukkaattaik ka'lainthu, than kaimpe'nmaikkuriya vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndaa'l.

yoothaa antha sthireeyinidaththil iruntha adaimaanaththai vaangkikko'ndu varumpadi athullaam ooraanaakiya than sineakithan kaiyilea oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyaik koduththanuppinaan; avan ava'laik kaa'naamal,
avvidaththu manitharai noakki: vazhiya'ndai neeroot'ruka'l arukea iruntha thaasi engkea en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avarka'l: ingkea thaasi illai en'raarka'l.
avan yoothaavinidaththil thirumpivanthu: ava'laik kaa'noam, angkea thaasi illaiyen'ru avvidaththu manitharum solluki'raarka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu yoothaa: ithoa, intha aattukkuttiyai anuppinean, nee ava'laik kaa'navillai; namakku avakeerththi varaathapadikku, ava'l athaik ko'ndupoanaal poakattum en'raan.

ea'rakku'raiya moon'rumaatham sen'rapinpu un marumaka'laakiya thaamaar veasiththanampa'n'ninaa'l, antha veasiththanaththinaal karppavathiyumaanaa'l en'ru yoothaavukku a'rivikkappattathu. appozhuthu yoothaa: ava'lai ve'liyea ko'nduvaarungka'l, ava'l sutterikkappadavea'ndum en'raan.

ava'l ve'liyea ko'nduvarappattapoathu, ava'l than maamanidaththukku antha adaimaanaththai anuppi: inthap porudka'lai udaiyavan evanoa avanaalea naan karppavathiyaanean; intha muththirai moathiramum intha aaramum inthak koalum yaarudaiyavaika'l paarum en'ru solli anuppinaa'l.
yoothaa avaika'laip paarththa'rinthu: ennilum ava'l neethiyu'l'lava'l; ava'lai en kumaaranaakiya sealaavukkuk kodaama'rpoaneanea en'raan. appu'ram avan ava'laich searavillai.
ava'lukkup pirasavakaalam vanthapoathu, ava'l karppaththil irattaip pi'l'laika'l irunthana.
ava'l pe'ruki'rapoathu, oru pi'l'lai kaiyai neettinathu; appozhuthu maruththuvachchi athin kaiyaip pidiththu, athil sivappunoolaik katti, ithu muthalaavathu ve'lippattathu en'raa'l.

athu than kaiyaith thirumpa u'l'lea vaangkikko'ndapoathu, athin sakoatharan ve'lippattaan. appozhuthu ava'l: nee mee'rivanthathenna, intha mee'ruthal unmeal ni'rkum en'raa'l; athinaalea avanukkup paareas en'ru pearidappattathu.
pi'rpaadu kaiyil sivappunool kattiyiruntha avanudaiya thampi ve'lippattaan; avanukku searaa en'ru pearidappattathu.

yoaseappu ekipthukkuk ko'ndupoakappattaan. paarvoanudaiya pirathaaniyum thalaiyaarika'lukku athipathiyumaakiya poaththipaar ennum ekipthu theasaththaan avanai avvidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvantha ismavealaridaththil vilaikku vaangkinaan.
karththar yoaseappoadea irunthaar, avan kaariyasiththiyu'l'lavanaanaan; avan ekipthiyanaakiya than ejamaanudaiya veettilea irunthaan.
karththar avanoadea irukki'raar en'rum, avan seyki'ra yaavaiyum karththar vaaykkappa'n'nuki'raar en'rum, avan ejamaan ka'ndu;
yoaseappinidaththil thayavuvaiththu, avanaith thanakku oozhiyakkaaranum than veettukku visaara'naikkaaranumaakki, thanakku u'ndaana yaavat'raiyum avan kaiyil oppuviththaan.

avanaith than veettukkum thanakku u'ndaana ellaavat'ri'rkum visaara'naikkaaranaakkinathumutha'rko'ndu, karththar yoaseappinimiththam antha ekipthiyan veettai aaseervathiththaar; veettilum ve'liyilum avanukku u'ndaanavaika'l ellaavat'rilum karththarudaiya aaseervaatham irunthathu.

aakaiyaal, avan thanakku u'ndaanathaiyellaam yoaseappin kaiyilea oppukkoduththuvittu, thaan pusikki'ra poajanamthavira thannidaththiliruntha mat'ron'raikku'riththum visaariyaathirunthaan. yoaseappu azhakaana roopamum saunthariya mukamum u'l'lavanaayirunthaan.
silanaa'l sen'rapin, avanudaiya ejamaanin manaivi yoaseappinmeal ka'npoattu, ennoadea sayani en'raa'l.

avanoa than ejamaanudaiya manaiviyin sollukku i'nangkaamal, ava'lai noakki: ithoa, veettilea ennidaththil irukki'ravaika'lil yaathon'raikku'riththum en aa'ndavan visaariyaamal, thamakku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum en kaiyil oppiththirukki'raar.

intha veettilea ennilum periyavan illai; nee avarudaiya manaiviyaayirukki'rapadiyaal unnaiththavira vea'ron'raiyum avar enakku vilakki vaikkavillai; ippadiyirukka, naan iththanai periya pollaangkukku udanpattu, theavanukku viroathamaayp paavam seyvathu eppadi en'raan.
ava'l niththam niththam yoaseappoadea ippadip peasikko'ndu vanthum, avan ava'ludanea sayanikkavum ava'ludanea irukkavum sammathikkavillai.
ippadiyirukkumpoathu, orunaa'l avan than vealaiyaich seyki'ratha'rku veettukku'l poanaan; veettu manitharil oruvarum veettil illai.
appozhuthu ava'l avanudaiya vasthiraththaip pat'rip pidiththu, ennoadea sayani en'raa'l. avanoa than vasthiraththai ava'l kaiyilea vittu ve'liyea oadippoanaan.
avan than vasthiraththai ava'l kaiyilea vittu ve'liyea oadippoanathai ava'l ka'ndapoathu,

ava'l than veettu manitharaik kooppittu: paarungka'l, epireya manushan nammidaththil sarasampa'n'numpadikku avanai namakku'l ko'nduvanthaar, avan ennoadea sayanikkumpadikku ennidaththil vanthaan; naan mikuntha saththamittuk kooppittean.
naan saththamittuk kooppiduki'rathai avan keattu, than vasthiraththai ennidaththil vittu, ve'liyea oadippoayvittaan en'ru sonnaa'l.
avanudaiya ejamaan veettukku varuma'lavum avanudaiya vasthiraththaith thannidaththil vaiththirunthu,
avanai noakki: neer nammidaththil ko'nduvantha antha epireya vealaikkaaran sarasampa'n'numpadikku ennidaththil vanthaan.
appozhuthu naan saththamittuk kooppittean, avan than vasthiraththai ennidaththil vittu ve'liyea oadippoanaan en'raa'l.
ummudaiya vealaikkaaran enakku ippadich seythaan en'ru than manaivi thannoadea sonna vaarththaika'lai avanudaiya ejamaan keattapoathu, avanukkuk koapam moo'ndathu.
yoaseappin ejamaan avanaip pidiththu, raajaavin katta'laiyaal kaavalil vaikkappattavarka'l irukkum si'raichsaalaiyilea avanai oppuviththaan. anthach si'raichsaalaiyil avan irunthaan.
karththaroa yoaseappoadea irunthu, avanmeal kirupaivaiththu, si'raichsaalaith thalaivanudaiya thayavu avanukkuk kidaikkumpadi seythaar.
si'raichsaalaith thalaivan si'raichsaalaiyil vaikkappatta yaavaraiyum yoaseappin kaiyilea oppuviththaan; angkea avarka'l seyvathellaavat'raiyum yoaseappu seyviththaan.

karththar avanoadea irunthapadiyinaalum, avan ethaich seythaanoa athaik karththar vaaykkappa'n'ninapadiyinaalum, avan vasamaayiruntha yaathon'raiyum ku'riththuch si'raichsaalaith thalaivan visaarikkavillai.
intha nadapadika'lukkuppinpu, ekipthu raajaavukkup paanapaaththirakkaaranum suyampaakiyum ekipthu raajaavaakiya thangka'l aa'ndavanukkuk kut'ram seythaarka'l.
paarvoan than paanapaaththirakkaararin thalaivanum suyampaakika'lin thalaivanum aakiya ivvira'ndu pirathaanika'l mealum kadungkoapangko'ndu,
avarka'lai yoaseappu vaikkappattiruntha idamum thalaiyaarika'lin athipathiyin veedumaakiya si'raichsaalaiyilea kaaval pa'n'nuviththaan.
thalaiyaarika'lin athipathi avarka'lai visaarikkumpadi yoaseappin vasaththil oppuviththaan; avan avarka'lai visaariththuvanthaan; avarka'l aneakanaa'l kaavalil irunthaarka'l.
ekipthu raajaavukkup paanapaaththirakkaaranum suyampaakiyumaakiya avvira'ndupearum si'raichsaalaiyil irukkumpoathu, orea raaththiriyilea vevvea'ru poru'lko'nda soppanam ka'ndaarka'l.
kaalamea yoaseappu avarka'lidaththil poay, avarka'laip paarkkumpoathu, avarka'l kalangkiyirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan than ejamaanudaiya veettil thannoadea kaavalpa'n'nappattiruntha paarvoanudaiya pirathaanika'lai noakki: ungka'l mukangka'l in'ru thukkamaayirukki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: soppanam ka'ndoam, atha'rku arththam solluki'ravan oruvanum illai en'raarka'l. atha'rku yoaseappu: soppanaththukku arththam solluthal theavanukkuriyathallavaa? avaika'lai ennidaththil sollungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu paanapaaththirakkaararin thalaivan yoaseappai noakki: en soppanaththilea oru thiraadchachsedi enakku munpaaka irukkakka'ndean.
anthath thiraadchachsediyilea moon'ru kodika'l irunthathu; athu thu'lirkki'rathaayirunthathu; athil pookka'l malarnthirunthathu; athin kulaika'l pazhuththa pazhangka'laayirunthathu.

paarvoanudaiya paaththiram en kaiyilea irunthathu; naan anthap pazhangka'laip pa'riththu, avaika'laip paarvoanudaiya paaththiraththil pizhinthu, anthap paaththiraththaip paarvoanudaiya kaiyilea koduththean en'ru, than soppanaththaich sonnaan.
atha'rku yoaseappu: antha moon'ru kodika'lum moon'ru naa'laam.

moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea paarvoan un thalaiyai uyarththi, unnai ma'rupadiyum un nilaiyilea ni'ruththuvaar; munnea avarukkup paanam koduththuvantha vazhakkaththinpadi paarvoanin paaththiraththai avar kaiyilea koduppaay;

ithuthaan athin arththam en'ru sonnathum an'ri, nee vaazhvadainthirukkumpoathu, ennai ninaiththu, enmeal thayavuvaiththu, en kaariyaththaip paarvoanukku a'riviththu, intha idaththilirunthu ennai viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndum.
naan epireyarudaiya theasaththilirunthu ka'lavaayk ko'nduvarappattean; ennai inthak kaaval kidangkil vaikkumpadikkum naan ivvidaththil on'rum seyyavillai en'rum sonnaan.
arththam nan'raayirukki'rathu en'ru suyampaakika'lin thalaivan ka'ndu, yoaseappai noakki: naanum en soppanaththil moon'ru ve'l'laik koodaika'l en thalaiyinmeal irukkakka'ndean;

mea'rkoodaiyilea paarvoanukkaakach samaikkappatta sakalavitha palakaarangka'lilum kogncham kogncham irunthathu; en thalaiyinmeal koodaiyil irunthavaika'laip pa'ravaika'l vanthu padchiththathu en'raan.
atha'rku yoaseappu: antha moon'ru koodaika'lum moon'ru naa'laam.
innum moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea paarvoan un thalaiyai uyarththi, unnai maraththilea thookkippoaduvaar; appozhuthu pa'ravaika'l un maamsaththaith thinnum, ithuthaan athin arththam en'ru sonnaan.

moon'raam naa'l paarvoanudaiya janma naa'laayirunthathu; avan than oozhiyakkaarar ellaarukkum virunthupa'n'ni, paanapaaththirakkaararudaiya thalaivan thalaiyaiyum suyampaakika'ludaiya thalaivan thalaiyaiyum than uththiyoakastharin naduvea uyarththi,
paanapaaththirakkaararin thalaivanaip paanangkodukki'ra than uththiyoakaththilea ma'rupadiyum vaiththaan; anthappadiyea avan paarvoanudaiya kaiyilea paaththiraththaik koduththaan.
suyampaakika'lin thalaivanaiyoa thookkippoattaan. yoaseappu avarka'lukkuch sonna arththaththinpadiyea sampaviththathu.
aanaalum paanapaaththirakkaararin thalaivan yoaseappai ninaiyaamal avanai ma'ranthuvittaan.
ira'ndu varusham sen'rapinpu, paarvoan oru soppanam ka'ndaan; athu ennaven'raal, avan nathiya'ndaiyilea nin'ruko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu azhakum pushdiyumaana eazhu pasukka'l nathiyilirunthu ea'rivanthu pul meaynthathu.
avaika'linpin avaladcha'namum keavalamumaana vea'rea eazhu pasukka'l nathiyilirunthu ea'rivanthu, nathi oaraththil mat'rap pasukka'la'ndaiyilea nin'rathu.
avaladcha'namum keavalamumaana pasukka'l azhakum pushdiyumaana eazhu pasukka'laiyum padchiththuppoattathu; ippadip paarvoan ka'ndu vizhiththukko'ndaan.
ma'rupadiyum avan niththiraiseythu, ira'ndaamvisai oru soppanam ka'ndaan; nalla sezhumaiyaana eazhu kathirka'l orea thaa'lilirunthu oangki va'larnthathu.
pinpu, saaviyaanathum keezhkkaat'rinaal theeynthathumaana eazhu kathirka'l mu'laiththathu.
saaviyaana kathirka'l sezhumaiyum ni'raimeaniyumaana antha eazhu kathirka'laiyum vizhungkippoattathu; appozhuthu paarvoan vizhiththukko'ndu, athu soppanam en'ru a'rinthaan.

kaalamea paarvoanudaiya manam kalakkangko'ndirunthathu; appozhuthu avan ekipthilu'l'la sakala manthiravaathika'laiyum sakala saasthirika'laiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'lukkuth than soppanaththaich sonnaan; oruvaraalum athin arththaththaip paarvoanukkuch sollakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.
appozhuthu paanapaaththirakkaararin thalaivan paarvoanai noakki: naan seytha kut'ram in'ruthaan en ninaivil vanthathu.
paarvoan thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararmeal kadungkoapangko'ndu, ennaiyum suyampaakika'lin thalaivanaiyum thalaiyaarika'lin athipathi veedaakiya si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththiruntha kaalaththil,
naanum avanum orea raaththiriyilea vevvea'ru poru'lko'nda soppanam ka'ndoam.

appozhuthu thalaiyaarika'lin athipathikku vealaikkaaranaakiya epireya pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan oruvan angkea engka'loadea irunthaan; avanidaththil avaika'laich sonnoam, avan naangka'l ka'nda soppanangka'lukkuriya vevvea'ru arththaththinpadiyea engka'l soppanaththin payanaich sonnaan.
avan engka'lukkuch solliya arththaththinpadiyea nadanthathu; ennaith thirumpa en nilaiyilea ni'ruththi, avanaith thookkippoaduviththaar en'raan.
appozhuthu paarvoan yoaseappai azhaippiththaan; avanaith theeviramaayk kaavalkidangkilirunthu ko'nduvanthaarka'l. avan savarampa'n'nikko'ndu, vea'ru vasthiram thariththu, paarvoanidaththil vanthaan.

paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: oru soppanam ka'ndean; athin arththaththaich solla oruvarum illai; nee oru soppanaththaik keattaal, athin arththaththaich solluvaay en'ru unnaikku'riththu naan kea'lvippattean en'raan.
appozhuthu yoaseappu paarvoanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan alla, theavanea paarvoanukku mangka'lamaana uththaravu aru'lichseyvaar en'raan.
paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: en soppanaththilea, naan nathi oaraththil nin'ruko'ndirunthean.
azhakum pushdiyumaana eazhu pasukka'l nathiyilirunthu ea'rivanthu pulmeaynthathu.
avaika'linpin i'laiththathum makaa avaladcha'namum keavalamumaana vea'rea eazhu pasukka'l ea'rivanthathu; ivaika'laip poala avaladcha'namaana pasukka'lai ekipthutheasamengkum naan ka'ndathillai.
keavalamum avaladcha'namumaana pasukka'l kozhumaiyaana munthina eazhu pasukka'laiyum padchiththuppoattathu.
avaika'l ivaika'lin vayit'rukku'l poayum, vayit'rukku'l poayit'ren'ru thoan'raamal, mun irunthathu poalavea avaladcha'namaayirunthathu; ippadik ka'ndu vizhiththukko'ndean.
pinnum naan en soppanaththilea, ni'raimeaniyu'l'la eazhu nalla kathirka'l orea thaa'lilirunthu oangki va'larakka'ndean.
pinpu saaviyaanavaika'lum keezhkkaat'rinaal theeynthu patharaanavaika'lumaana eazhu kathirka'l mu'laiththathu.
saaviyaana kathirka'l antha eazhu nalla kathirka'laiyum vizhungkippoattathu. ithai manthiravaathika'lidaththil sonnean; ithin poru'lai enakku viduvikki'ravan oruvanum illai en'raan.
appozhuthu yoaseappu paarvoanai noakki: paarvoanin soppanam on'ruthaan; theavan thaam seyyappoaki'rathu innathen'ru paarvoanukku a'riviththirukki'raar.
antha eazhu nalla pasukka'lum eazhu varushamaam; antha eazhu nalla kathirka'lum eazhu varushamaam; soppanam on'rea.

avaika'linpin ea'rivantha keavalamum avaladcha'namumaana eazhu pasukka'lum eazhu varushamaam; keezhkkaat'rinaal theeynthu saaviyaana eazhu kathirka'lum eazhu varushamaam; ivaika'l pagnchamu'l'la eazhu varushamaam.
paarvoanukku naan sollavea'ndiya kaariyam ithuvea; theavan thaam seyyappoaki'rathaip paarvoanukkuk kaa'npiththirukki'raar.
ekipthu theasamengkum paripoora'namaana vi'laivu u'ndaayirukkum eazhu varusham varum.
athanpin pagnchamu'ndaayirukkum eazhu varusham varum; appozhuthu ekipthu theasaththil anthap paripoora'namellaam ma'rakkappattuppoam; anthap pagncham theasaththaip paazhaakkum.
varappoaki'ra makaa kodumaiyaana pagnchaththaal theasaththil munniruntha paripoora'namellaam ozhinthupoam.
inthak kaariyam theavanaal nichchayikkappattirukki'rathu enpathaiyum, theavan ithaich seekkiraththil seyvaar enpathaiyum ku'rikkumporuttu, inthach soppanam paarvoanukku irattiththathu.
aakaiyaal, viveakamum gnaanamumu'l'la oru manushanaith theadi, avanai ekipthutheasaththukku athikaariyaakap paarvoan ea'rpaduththuvaaraaka.

ippadip paarvoan seythu, theasaththinmeal visaara'naikkaararai vaiththu, paripoora'namu'l'la eazhu varushangka'lil ekipthutheasaththilea vi'laiyum vi'laichchalil ainthil oru pangkai vaangkumpadi seyvaaraaka.

avarka'l varappoaki'ra nalla varushangka'lil vi'laiyum thaaniyangka'laiyellaam searththu, patta'nangka'lil aakaaram u'ndaayirukkumpadikku, paarvoanudaiya athikaaraththukku'l'laakath thaaniyangka'laip paththirappaduththi vaiththuvaippaarka'laaka.
theasam pagnchaththinaal azhinthu poakaathapadikku, anthath thaaniyam ini ekipthutheasaththil u'ndaakum pagnchamu'l'la eazhu varushangka'lukkaaka theasaththi'rku oru vaippaayiruppathaaka en'raan.
intha vaarththai paarvoanudaiya paarvaikkum avan oozhiyakkaarar ellaarudaiya paarvaikkum nan'raayk ka'ndathu.
appozhuthu paarvoan than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: theava aaviyaip pet'ra intha manushanaippoala vea'roruvan u'ndoa en'raan.
pinpu, paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: theavan ivaiyellaavat'raiyum unakku ve'lippaduththiyirukki'rapadiyaal, unnaippoala viveakamum gnaanamumu'l'lavan vea'roruvanum illai.
nee en aramanaikku athikaariyaayiruppaay; un vaakkinpadiyea en janangka'l ellaarum adangki nadakkakkadavarka'l; singkaasanaththilmaaththiram unnilum naan periyavanaay iruppean en'raan.
pinnum paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: paar, ekipthutheasam muzhumaikkum unnai athikaariyaakkinean en'ru solli,

paarvoan than kaiyil poattiruntha than muththirai moathiraththaik kazhat'ri, athai yoaseappin kaiyilea poattu, melliya vasthirangka'lai avanukku uduththi, pon sarappa'niyai avan kazhuththilea thariththu,
thannudaiya ira'ndaam irathaththinmeal avanai eat'ri, the'ndanittup pa'niyungka'l en'ru avanukku munpaakak koo'ruviththu, ekipthutheasam muzhumaikkum avanai athikaariyaakkinaan;
pinnum paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: naan paarvoan; aanaalum ekipthutheasaththilu'l'lavarka'lil oruvanum un uththaravillaamal than kaiyaiyaavathu than kaalaiyaavathu asaikkakkoodaathu en'raan.

mealum, paarvoan yoaseappukku saapnaathpanneayaa enki'ra peyaraiyittu; oanpatta'naththu aasaariyanaakiya poaththipiraavin kumaaraththiyaakiya aasnaaththai avanukku manaiviyaakak koduththaan. yoaseappu ekipthutheasaththaich sut'rippaarkkumpadi pu'rappattaan.

yoaseappu ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanukku munpaaka ni'rkumpoathu muppathu vayathaayirunthaan; yoaseappu paarvoanudaiya sannithiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, ekipthutheasam engkum poaych sut'rippaarththaan.
paripoora'namu'l'la eazhu varushangka'lilum poomi mikuthiyaana palanaik koduththathu.

avveazhu varushangka'lil ekipthu theasaththil vi'laintha thaaniyangka'laiyellaam avan searththu, anthath thaaniyangka'laip patta'nangka'lil kattivaiththaan; anthanthap patta'naththil athinathin sut'ruppu'raththuth thaaniyangka'laik kattivaiththaan.
ippadi yoaseappu a'lavi'ranthathaayk kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoala mikuthiyaakath thaaniyaththaich searththuvaiththaan; athu a'lavukku adangkaathathaayirunthathu.

pagnchamu'l'la varushangka'l varuvatha'rku munnea yoaseappukku ira'ndu kumaarar pi'ranthaarka'l; avarka'lai oan patta'naththu aasaariyanaakiya poaththipiraavin kumaaraththiyaakiya aasnaaththu avanukkup pet'raa'l.
yoaseappu: en varuththam yaavaiyum en thakappanudaiya kudumpam anaiththaiyum naan ma'rakkumpadi theavan pa'n'ninaar en'ru solli, mooththavanukku manaasea en'ru pearittaan.
naan si'rumaippattiruntha theasaththil theavan ennaip palukappa'n'ninaar en'ru solli, i'laiyavanukku eppiraayeem en'ru pearittaan.
ekipthutheasaththil vantha paripoora'namu'l'la eazhu varushangka'lum mudinthapin,
yoaseappu solliyapadi eazhu varusha pagncham thodangkinathu; sakala theasangka'lilum pagncham u'ndaayit'ru; aanaalum ekipthutheasamengkum aakaaram irunthathu.

ekipthutheasamengkum pagncham u'ndaanapoathu, janangka'l u'navukkaakap paarvoanai noakki oalamittaarka'l; atha'rkup paarvoan: neengka'l yoaseappinidaththukkup poay, avan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rapadi seyyungka'l en'ru ekipthiyar ellaarukkum sonnaan.
theasamengkum pagncham u'ndaanapadiyaal, yoaseappu ka'lagnchiyangka'laiyellaam thi'ranthu, ekipthiyarukku vit'raan; pagncham ekipthutheasaththil varavarak kodithaayit'ru.
sakala theasangka'lilum pagncham kodithaayirunthapadiyaal, sakala theasaththaarka'lum yoaseappinidaththil thaaniyam ko'l'lumpadi ekipthukku vanthaarka'l.
ekipthilea thaaniyam u'nden'ru yaakkoapu a'rinthu, than kumaararai noakki: neengka'l oruvar mukaththai oruvar paarththukko'ndirukki'rathu enna?
ekipthilea thaaniyam u'nden'ru kea'lvippaduki'rean; naam saakaamal uyiroadirukkumpadi neengka'l avvidaththukkup poay, namakkaakath thaaniyam ko'l'lungka'l en'raan.
yoaseappin sakoatharar paththuppear thaaniyangko'l'la ekipthukkup poanaarka'l.
yoaseappin thampiyaakiya penyameenukku eathoa moasam varum en'ru solli, yaakkoapu avanai avan sakoathararoadea anuppavillai.
kaanaantheasaththilea pagncham u'ndaayirunthapadiyaal, thaaniyam ko'l'lappoaki'ravarka'ludaneakooda isravealin kumaararum poanaarka'l.
yoaseappu aththeasaththukku athipathiyaayirunthu, theasaththin janangka'l yaavarukkum vit'raan. yoaseappin sakoatharar vanthu, mukangkuppu'rath tharaiyilea vizhunthu avanai va'nangkinaarka'l.

yoaseappu avarka'laip paarththu, than sakoatharar en'ru a'rinthuko'ndaan; a'rinthum a'riyaathavanpoalak kadinamaay avarka'loadea peasi: neengka'l engkeayirunthu vantheerka'l en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avarka'l: kaanaan theasaththilirunthu thaaniyam ko'l'la vanthoam en'raarka'l.
yoaseappu avarka'laith than sakoatharar en'ru a'rinthum, avarka'l avanai a'riyavillai.
yoaseappu avarka'laikku'riththuth thaan ka'nda soppanangka'lai ninaiththu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l veavukaarar, theasam engkea thi'ranthukidakki'rathu en'ru paarkka vantheerka'l en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: appadiyalla, aa'ndavanea, umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l thaaniyam ko'l'la vanthoam.
naangka'l ellaarum oru thakappanudaiya pi'l'laika'l; naangka'l nijasthar; umathu adiyaar veavukaarar alla en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: appadiyalla, theasam engkea thi'ranthukidakki'rathu en'ru paarkkavea vantheerka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l: umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l pannira'ndu sakoatharar; kaanaan theasaththil irukki'ra oru thakappan puththirar; i'laiyavan ippozhuthu engka'l thakappanidaththil irukki'raan; oruvan kaa'naama'rpoanaan en'raarka'l.
yoaseappu avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lai veavukaarar en'ru naan sonnathu sari.
ungka'l i'laiya sakoatharan ingkea vanthaalozhiya neengka'l ingkeayirunthu pu'rappaduvathu illai en'ru paarvoanin jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittuch solluki'rean.

ithinaalea neengka'l soathikkappaduveerka'l; ungka'l sakoatharanai azhaiththuvarumpadi ungka'lil oruvanai anuppungka'l; ungka'lidaththil u'nmai u'ndoa illaiyoa en'ru ungka'l vaarththaika'l soathikkappaduma'lavum, neengka'l kaavalil irukkavea'ndum; illaavittaal, neengka'l veavukaararthaan en'ru paarvoanin jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittuch solluki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'l ellaaraiyum moon'runaa'l kaavalilea vaiththaan.
moon'raam naa'lilea yoaseappu avarka'lai noakki: naan theavanukkup payappaduki'ravan; neengka'l uyiroadea irukkumpadikku on'ru seyyungka'l.

neengka'l nijastharaanaal, sakoathararaakiya ungka'lil oruvan kaava'rkoodaththil kattu'ndirukkattum; mat'ravarka'l pu'rappattu, pagnchaththinaal varunthuki'ra ungka'l kudumpaththukkuth thaaniyam ko'ndupoayk koduththu,

ungka'l i'laiya sakoatharanai ennidaththukku azhaiththukko'nduvaarungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'l vaarththaika'l meyyen'ru vi'langkum; neengka'l saavathillai en'raan. avarka'l appadich seyki'ratha'rku isainthu:

nammudaiya sakoatharanukku naam seytha thuroakam nammeal sumanthathu; avan nammaik kegnchi vea'ndikko'ndapoathu, avanudaiya mana viyaakulaththai naam ka'ndum, avanukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanoamea; aakaiyaal, intha aapaththu namakku nearittathu en'ru oruvarai oruvar paarththuch sollikko'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu roopan avarka'laip paarththu: i'laignanukku viroathamaakap paavagnseyyaathirungka'l en'ru naan ungka'lukkuch sollavillaiyaa? neengka'l kea'laama'rpoaneerka'l; ippozhuthu, ithoa, avan iraththappazhi nammidaththil vaangkappaduki'rathu en'raan.
yoaseappu thupaasiyaikko'ndu avarka'lidaththil peasinapadiyaal, thaangka'l sonnathu avanukkuth theriyum en'ru a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.
avan avarka'lai vittu appu'ram poay azhuthu, thirumpa avarka'lidaththil vanthu, avarka'loadea peasi, avarka'lil simiyoanaip pidiththu, avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakak kattuviththaan.

pinpu, avarka'l saakkuka'laith thaaniyaththaal nirappavum, avarka'l pa'naththaith thirumpa avanavan saakkilea poadavum, vazhikku vea'ndiya aakaaraththaik kodukkavum yoaseappu katta'laiyittaan; appadiyea avarka'lukkuch seyyappattathu.
avarka'l anthath thaaniyaththaith thangka'l kazhuthaika'lmeal eat'rikko'ndu, avvidamvittup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
thangkuki'ra idaththilea avarka'lil oruvan than kazhuthaikkuth theevanam poadath than saakkaith thi'ranthapoathu, saakkin vaayilea than pa'nam irukki'rathaik ka'ndu,

than sakoathararaip paarththu, en pa'nam thirumpa vanthirukki'rathu; ithoa, athu en saakkilea irukki'rathu en'raan. appozhuthu avarka'ludaiya iruthayam soarnthupoay, avarka'l payanthu, oruvarai oruvar paarththu, theavan namakku ippadich seythathu enna en'raarka'l.
avarka'l kaanaan theasaththilu'l'la thangka'l thakappanaakiya yaakkoapinidaththil vanthu, thangka'lukkuch sampaviththavaika'laiyellaam avanukku a'riviththu:
theasaththukku athipathiyaayirukki'ravan engka'lai theasaththai veavupaarkka vanthavarka'l en'ru e'n'ni engka'loadea kadinamaayp peasinaan.
naangka'loa avanai noakki: naangka'l nijasthar, veavukaarar alla.
naangka'l pannira'ndu sakoatharar, oru thakappan puththirar, oruvan kaa'naama'rpoanaan, i'laiyavan ippozhuthu kaanaantheasaththil engka'l thakappanidaththil irukki'raan en'roam.

appozhuthu theasaththin athipathiyaanavan: neengka'l nijasthar enpathai naan a'riyumpadi ungka'l sakoathararil oruvanai neengka'l ennidaththil vittu, pagnchaththinaal varunthuki'ra ungka'l kudumpaththukkuth thaaniyam vaangkik ko'ndupoayk koduththu,

ungka'l i'laiya sakoatharanai ennidaththil azhaiththukko'nduvaarungka'l; athinaalea neengka'l veavukaarar alla, nijasthar enpathai naan a'rinthuko'ndu, ungka'l sakoatharanai viduthalai seyvean; neengka'l inthath theasaththilea viyaapaaramum pa'n'nalaam en'raan en'ru sonnaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l saakkuka'lilu'l'la thaaniyaththaik kottukaiyil, ithoa, avanavan saakkilea avanavan pa'namudippu irunthathu; anthap pa'namudippuka'lai avarka'lum avarka'l thakappanum ka'ndu payanthaarka'l.

avarka'l thakappanaakiya yaakkoapu avarka'lai noakki: ennaip pi'l'laiyat'ravanaakkuki'reerka'l; yoaseappum illai, simiyoanum illai; penyameenaiyum ko'ndupoakap paarkki'reerka'l; ithellaam enakku viroathamaay neariduki'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu roopan than thakappanaip paarththu, avanai en kaiyil oppuviyum, naan avanaith thirumpa ummidaththil ko'nduvaruvean; avanaik ko'nduvaraavittaal, en ira'ndu kumaararaiyum kon'rupoadum en'ru sonnaan.

atha'rku avan: en makan ungka'loadeakoodap poavathillai; avan thamaiyan i'ranthupoanaan, ivan oruvan meethiyaayirukki'raan; neengka'l poakum vazhiyil ivanukku moasam nearittaal, neengka'l en naraimayiraich sagnchalaththoadea paathaa'laththil i'rangkappa'n'nuveerka'l en'raan.
theasaththilea pagncham kodithaayirunthathu.
ekipthilirunthu avarka'l ko'nduvantha thaaniyam selavazhinthapoathu, avarka'l thakappan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l thirumpap poay, namakkuk kogncham thaaniyam vaangkikko'ndu vaarungka'l en'raan.
atha'rku yoothaa: ungka'l sakoatharan ungka'loadeakooda varaavittaal, neengka'l en mukaththaik kaa'npathillai en'ru antha manithan engka'lukkuch saththiyamaaych sonnaan.
engka'l sakoatharanai neer engka'loadeakooda anuppinaal, naangka'l poay, umakkuth thaaniyam vaangkikko'ndu varuvoam.
anuppaavittaal, naangka'l poakamaattoam; ungka'l sakoatharan ungka'loadeakooda varaavittaal, neengka'l en mukaththaik kaa'npathillai en'ru antha manithan engka'loadea solliyirukki'raan en'raan.
atha'rku israveal: ungka'lukku innum oru sakoatharan u'nden'ru neengka'l antha manithanukkuch solli, ean enakku inthath thunpaththai varuviththeerka'l en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l: antha manithan, ungka'l thakappan innum uyiroadirukki'raaraa? ungka'lukku innum oru sakoatharan u'ndaa? en'ru engka'laiyum engka'l vamsaththaiyum ku'riththu viparamaay visaariththaan; anthak kea'lvika'lukkuth thakkathaaka u'l'lapadi avanukkuch sonnoam; ungka'l sakoatharanai ungka'loadeakooda ingkea ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru avan solluvaan enpathai naangka'l a'rinthirunthoamaa en'raarka'l.

pinnum, yoothaa than thakappanaakiya isravealai noakki: neerum naangka'lum engka'l kuzhanthaika'lum saakaamal uyiroadirukkumpadi, naangka'l pu'rappattuppoaki'roam, pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanai ennoadea anuppum.

avanukkaaka naan uththaravaathampa'n'nuvean; avanai ennidaththilea kea'lum, naan avanai ummidaththil ko'nduvanthu, umakku munpaaka ni'ruththaama'rpoanaal, ennaa'lum anthak kut'ram enmeal iruppathaaka.
naangka'l thaamathiyaathirunthoamaanaal, itha'rku'l'lea ira'ndaantharam poayth thirumpivanthiruppoamea en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l thakappanaakiya israveal: appadiyaanaal, on'ru seyyungka'l; inthath theasaththin uchchithamaana vasthukka'lil kogncham pisin thailamum, kogncham theanum, kanthavarkkangka'lum, ve'l'laippoa'lamum, therapinthu kottaika'lum, vaathumaikkottaika'lum ungka'l saakkuka'lil poattu, antha manithanukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'ndupoayk kodungka'l.
pa'naththai irattippaay ungka'l kaika'lil ko'ndupoangka'l, saakkuka'lin vaayilea thirumpak ko'nduvantha pa'naththaiyum ko'ndupoangka'l; athu kaippisakaay vanthirukkum.
ungka'l sakoatharanaiyum koottikko'ndu, antha manithanidaththukku ma'rupadiyum poangka'l.

antha manithan angkirukki'ra ungka'l mat'rach sakoatharanaiyum penyameenaiyum ungka'ludanea anuppividumpadikku, sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan avan samukaththil ungka'lukku irakkangkidaikkappa'n'nuvaaraaka; naanoa pi'l'laiyat'rup poanavanaippoal iruppean en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l kaa'nikkaiyaiyum thangka'l kaika'lil irattippaana pa'naththaiyum eduththukko'ndu, penyameenaiyum koottikko'ndu, pirayaa'nappattu, ekipthukkuppoay, yoaseappin samukaththil vanthu nin'raarka'l.

penyameen avarka'loadeakooda vanthirukki'rathai yoaseappu ka'ndu, than veettu visaara'naikkaaranai noakki: nee intha manitharai veettukku azhaiththuppoay, saappaattukku vea'ndiyavaika'lai adiththu, aayaththampa'n'nu, maththiyaanaththilea intha manithar ennoadea saappiduvaarka'l en'raan.
avan thanakku yoaseappu sonnapadiyea seythu, antha manitharai yoaseappin veettukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.

thaangka'l yoaseappin veettukkuk ko'ndupoakappaduki'rathai avarka'l ka'ndu payanthu, munnea nammudaiya saakkuka'lil iruntha pa'naththinimiththam nammeal kut'ram sumaththi, nammaip pidiththuch si'raika'laakki, nammudaiya kazhuthaika'lai eduththukko'l'lumpadi nammaik ko'ndupoaki'raarka'l en'ru solli,
yoaseappin veettu visaara'naikkaarana'ndaiyil searnthu, veettu vaasa'rpadiyilea avanoadea peasi:
aa'ndavanea, naangka'l thaaniyam ko'l'lumpadi munnea vanthupoanoamea;

naangka'l thangkum idaththil poay engka'l saakkuka'laith thi'ranthapoathu, naangka'l ni'ruththukkoduththa ni'raiyinpadiyea avanavan pa'nam avanavan saakkin vaayilea irukkak ka'ndoam; athai naangka'l thirumpavum engka'l kaiyilea ko'nduvanthirukki'roam.
mealum, thaaniyam ko'l'lumpadi vea'rea pa'namum engka'l kaiyil ko'nduvanthirukki'roam; naangka'l mun koduththa pa'naththai engka'l saakkuka'lil poattathu innaar en'ru a'riyoam en'raarka'l.

atha'rku avan: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam; payappadavea'ndaam; ungka'l theavanum ungka'l thakappanudaiya theavanumaayirukki'ravar ungka'l saakkuka'lil athai ungka'lukkup puthaiyalaakak katta'laiyittaar; neengka'l koduththa pa'nam ennidaththil vanthu searnthathu en'ru solli, simiyoanai ve'liyea azhaiththuvanthu, avarka'lidaththil vittaan.

mealum, antha manithan avarka'lai yoaseappin veettukku'l'lea koottikko'ndupoay, avarka'l thangka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvumpadi tha'n'neer koduththu, avarka'ludaiya kazhuthaika'lukkuth theevanam poattaan.
thaangka'l angkea poajanam seyyappoaki'rathai avarka'l kea'lvippattapadiyaal, maththiyaanaththil yoaseappu varuma'lavum kaa'nikkaiyai aayaththamaay vaiththuk kaaththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
yoaseappu veettukku vanthapoathu, avarka'l thangka'l kaiyil iruntha kaa'nikkaiyai veettukku'l avanidaththil ko'ndupoay vaiththu, tharaimattum kuninthu, avanai va'nangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: avarka'l sukaseythiyai visaariththu, neengka'l sonna muthirvayathaana ungka'l thakappan sukamaayirukki'raaraa? avar innum uyiroadirukki'raaraa? en'ru avarka'lidaththil visaariththaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: engka'l thakappanaaraakiya umathu adiyaan sukamaayirukki'raar, innum uyiroadirukki'raar en'ru solli, kuninthu va'nangkinaarka'l.

avan than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, than thaay pet'ra kumaaranaakiya than sakoatharan penyameenaik ka'ndu, neengka'l enakkuch sonna ungka'l i'laiya sakoatharan ivanthaanaa en'ru keattu, makanea, theavan unakkuk kirupaiseyyakkadavar en'raan.
yoaseappin u'l'lam than sakoatharanukkaakap pongkinapadiyaal, avan azhuki'ratha'rku idam theadi, thurithamaay a'raikku'l'lea poay, angkea azhuthaan.
pinpu, avan than mukaththaik kazhuvi ve'liyea vanthu, thannai adakkikko'ndu, poajanam vaiyungka'l en'raan.

ekipthiyar epireyaroadea saappidamaattaarka'l; appadich seyvathu ekipthiyarukku aruvaruppaayirukkum; aakaiyaal, avanukkuth thanippadavum, avarka'lukkuth thanippadavum, avanoadea saappiduki'ra ekipthiyarukkuth thanippadavum vaiththaarka'l.
avanukku munpaaka, mooththavan muthal i'laiyavanvaraikkum avanavan vayathinpadiyea avarka'lai udkaaravaiththaarka'l; atha'rkaaka avarka'l, oruvarai oruvar paarththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.

avan thanakkumun vaikkappattiruntha poajanaththil avarka'lukkup pangkittu anuppinaan; avarka'l ellaarudaiya pangkuka'laippaarkkilum penyameenudaiya pangku ainthumadangku athikamaayirunthathu; avarka'l paanampa'n'ni, avanudanea santhoashamaayirunthaarka'l.

pinpu, avan than veettu visaara'naikkaaranai noakki: nee intha manitharudaiya saakkuka'lai avarka'l eat'rikko'ndupoakaththakka paaramaayth thaaniyaththinaalea nirappi, avanavan pa'naththai avanavan saakkin vaayilea poattu,

i'laiyavanudaiya saakkin vaayilea ve'l'lippaaththiramaakiya en paanapaaththiraththaiyum thaaniyaththukku avan koduththa pa'naththaiyum poadu en'ru katta'laiyittaan; yoaseappu sonnapadiyea avan seythaan.
athikaalaiyilea antha manitharka'l thangka'l kazhuthaika'lai oattikko'ndu poakumpadi anuppividappattaarka'l.

avarka'l patta'naththai vittup pu'rappattu, vekuthooram poavatha'rkumunnea, yoaseappu than veettu visaara'naikkaaranai noakki: nee pu'rappattuppoay, antha manitharaip pinthodarnthu, avarka'laip pidiththu: neengka'l nanmaikkuth theemai seythathu enna?
athu en ejamaan paanampa'n'nuki'ra paaththiram allavaa? athu poanavakai gnaanathirushdiyaal avarukkuth theriyaathaa? neengka'l seythathu thakaathakaariyam en'ru avarka'loadea sol en'raan.
avan avarka'laith thodarnthu pidiththu, thannidaththil solliyiruntha vaarththaika'lai avarka'lukkuch sonnaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: engka'l aa'ndavan ippadippatta vaarththaika'laich solluki'rathu enna? ippadippatta kaariyaththukkum ummudaiya adiyaaraakiya engka'lukkum vekuthooram.

engka'l saakkuka'lin vaayilea naangka'l ka'nda pa'naththaik kaanaantheasaththilirunthu thirumpa ummidaththukkuk ko'nduvanthoamea; naangka'l ummudaiya ejamaanin veettilirunthu ve'l'liyaiyaakilum ponnaiyaakilum thirudikko'ndu poavoamaa?
ummudaiya adiyaarukku'l'lea athu evanidaththil kaa'nappadumoa avan kolaiyu'nkakkadavan; naangka'lum engka'l aa'ndavanukku adimaika'laavoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l sonnapadiyea aakattum; evanidaththil athu kaa'nappadumoa, avan enakku adimaiyaavaan; neengka'l kut'ramat'riruppeerka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l thurithamaay avanavan thanthan saakkaith tharaiyilea i'rakki, thangka'l saakkuka'laith thi'ranthu vaiththaarka'l.
mooththavan saakkumuthal i'laiyavan saakkumattum avan soathikkumpoathu, anthap paaththiram penyameenudaiya saakkilea ka'ndupidikkappattathu.
appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, avanavan kazhuthaiyinmeal pothiyai eat'rikko'ndu, patta'naththi'rkuth thirumpinaarka'l.
yoothaavum avan sakoathararum yoaseappin veettukkup poanaarka'l. yoaseappu athuvaraiyum angkea irunthaan; avanukku munpaakath tharaiyilea vizhunthaarka'l.
yoaseappu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l enna kaariyam seytheerka'l? ennaippoaloththa manithanukku gnaanathirushdiyinaal kaariyam theriyavarum en'ru a'riyaama'rpoaneerka'laa en'raan.

atha'rku yoothaa: en aa'ndavanaakiya ummidaththil naangka'l enna solluvoam? ennaththaip peasuvoam? ethinaalea engka'l neethiyai vi'langkappa'n'nuvoam? ummudaiya adiyaarin akkiramaththai theavan vi'langkappa'n'ninaar; paaththiraththai vaiththirukki'ravanum naangka'lum en aa'ndavanukku adimaika'l en'raan.

atha'rku avan: appadippatta seykai enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; evan vasaththil paaththiram ka'ndupidikkappattathoa, avanea enakku adimaiyaayiruppaan; neengka'loa samaathaanaththoadea ungka'l thakappanidaththukkup poangka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu yoothaa avana'ndaiyilea searnthu: aa, en aa'ndavanea, umathu adiyean ummudaiya sevika'l keadka oru vaarththai solluki'rean keadpeeraaka; adiyeanmeal umathu koapam moo'laathiruppathaaka; neer paarvoanukku oppaayirukki'reer.
ungka'lukkuth thakappanaavathu sakoatharanaavathu u'ndaa en'ru en aa'ndavan ummudaiya adiyaaridaththil keatteer.

atha'rku naangka'l: engka'lukku muthirvayathu'l'la thakappanaarum, avarukku muthirvayathilea pi'rantha oru i'laignanum u'ndu en'rum, avanudaiya thamaiyan i'ranthupoanaan en'rum, avan oruvanmaaththiramea avanaip pet'ra thaayaarukku iruppathinaal thakappanaar avanmeal padchamaayirukki'raar en'rum en aa'ndavanukkuch sonnoam.
appozhuthu neer: avanai ennidaththukkuk ko'nduvaarungka'l; en ka'nka'linaal avanaip paarkkavea'ndum en'ru umathu adiyaarukkuch sonneer.
naangka'l aa'ndavanai noakki: antha i'laignan than thakappanaivittup piriyakkoodaathu, pirinthaal avar i'ranthupoavaar en'ru sonnoam.
atha'rku neer: ungka'l i'laiya sakoatharanaik ko'nduvaraavittaal, neengka'l ini en mukaththaik kaa'npathillai en'ru umathu adiyaarukkuch sonneer.
naangka'l umathu adiyaanaakiya en thakappanaaridaththukkup poanapoathu, en aa'ndavanudaiya vaarththaika'lai avarukku a'riviththoam.
engka'l thakappanaar engka'lai noakki: neengka'l thirumpappoay, namakkuk kogncham thaaniyam ko'l'lungka'l en'ru sonnaar.

atha'rku: naangka'l poakakkoodaathu; engka'l i'laiya sakoatharan engka'loadea vanthaal poavoam; engka'l i'laiya sakoatharan engka'loadea varaavittaal, naangka'l anthap purushanudaiya mukaththaik kaa'nakkoodaathu en'roam.
appozhuthu ummudaiya adiyaanaakiya en thakappanaar: en manaivi enakku ira'ndu pi'l'laika'laip pet'raa'l;
avarka'lil oruvan ennidaththilirunthu poayvittaan, avan pee'ru'ndupoayiruppaan en'rirunthean, ithuvaraikkum avanaik kaa'naathirukki'rean, ithellaam neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
neengka'l ivanaiyum ennai vittup piriththu azhaiththuppoakumidaththil ivanukku moasam nearittaal, en naraimayirai viyaakulaththoadea paathaa'laththil i'rangkappa'n'nuveerka'l en'raar.
aakaiyaal i'laiyavanai vittu, naan en thakappanaakiya umathu adiyaanidaththukkup poanaal, avarudaiya jeevan ivanudaiya jeevanoadea on'raay i'naikkappattirukki'rapadiyinaal,

avar i'laiyavan varavillai en'ru a'rinthamaaththiraththil i'ranthupoavaar; ippadi umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l umathu adiyaanaakiya engka'l thakappanudaiya naraimayirai viyaakulaththudanea paathaa'laththil i'rangkappa'n'nuvoam.

intha i'laiyavanukkaaka umathu adiyaanaakiya naan en thakappanukku uththaravaathi; an'riyum, naan ivanai ummidaththukkuk ko'nduvaraavittaal, naan ennaa'lum umakku munpaakak kut'ravaa'liyaayiruppean en'ru avarukkuch solliyirukki'rean.
ippadiyirukka, i'laiyavan than sakoathararoadeakoodap poakavidumpadi man'raaduki'rean; ummudaiya adiyaanaakiya naan i'laiyavanukkup pathilaaka ingkea en aa'ndavanukku adimaiyaayirukki'rean.
i'laiyavanai vittu, eppadi en thakappanidaththukkup poavean? poanaal en thakappanukku nearidum theengkai naan eppadik kaa'npean en'raan.

appozhuthu yoaseappu than arukea nin'ra ellaarukkum munpaakath thannai adakkikko'ndirukkakkoodaamal: yaavaraiyum ennaivittu ve'liyea poakappa'n'nungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan. yoaseappu than sakoathararukkuth thannai ve'lippaduththukaiyil, oruvarum avan arukil ni'rkavillai.
avan saththamittu azhuthaan; athai ekipthiyar keattaarka'l, paarvoanin veettaarum keattaarka'l.

yoaseappu than sakoathararaip paarththu: naan yoaseappu; en thakappanaar innum uyiroadea irukki'raaraa en'raan. avanudaiya sakoatharar avanukku munpaakak kalakkamut'rirunthathinaalea, avanukku uththaram sollakkoodaamal irunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoaseappu than sakoathararai noakki: en kitta vaarungka'l en'raan. avarka'l kittappoanaarka'l; appozhuthu avan: neengka'l ekipthukkup poaki'ravarka'lidaththil vit'ruppoatta ungka'l sakoatharanaakiya yoaseappu naanthaan.

ennai ivvidaththil varumpadi vit'ruppoattathinaal, neengka'l sagnchalappadavea'ndaam; athu ungka'lukku visanamaayirukkavum vea'ndaam; jeevaradcha'nai seyyumpadikkuth theavan ennai ungka'lukku munnea anuppinaar.
theasaththil ippozhuthu ira'ndu varushamaakap pagncham u'ndaayirukki'rathu; innum ainthu varusham uzhavum a'ruppum illaamal pagncham irukkum.
poomiyilea ungka'l vamsam ozhiyaamalirukka ungka'lai aatharikki'ratha'rkaakavum, periya radchippinaal ungka'lai uyiroadea kaappatha'rkaakavum theavan ennai ungka'lukku munnamea anuppinaar.

aathalaal neengka'l alla, theavanea ennai ivvidaththukku anuppi, ennaip paarvoanukkuth thakappanaakavum, avar kudumpam anaiththi'rkum karththanaakavum, ekipthutheasam muzhuthukkum athipathiyaakavum vaiththaar.
neengka'l seekkiramaay en thakappanidaththil poay: theavan ennai ekipthu theasam muzhuthukkum athipathiyaaka vaiththaar; ennidaththil vaarum, thaamathikkavea'ndaam.
neerum, ummudaiya pi'l'laika'lum, avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lum, ummudaiya aadumaaduka'loadum umakku u'ndaayirukki'ra yaavat'roadum koasean naattil vaasampa'n'ni en sameepaththil irukkalaam.

umakkum ummudaiya kudumpaththaarukkum umakku irukki'ra yaavat'ri'rkum va'rumai varaathapadikku, angkea ummaip paraamarippean; innum ainthu varusham pagncham irukkum en'ru, ummudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoaseappu sollachsonnaan en'ru sollungka'l.
ithoa, ungka'loadea peasuki'ra vaay en vaaythaan enpathai ungka'l ka'nka'lum en thampiyaakiya penyameenin ka'nka'lum kaa'nki'rathea.
ekipthilea enakku u'ndaayirukki'ra sakala makimaiyaiyum, neengka'l ka'nda yaavaiyum en thakappanukku a'riviththu, avar seekkiramaay ivvidaththukku varumpadi seyyungka'l en'ru solli;
than thampiyaakiya penyameenin kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu azhuthaan; penyameenum avan kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu azhuthaan.
pinpu than sakoatharar yaavaraiyum muththagnseythu, avarka'laiyum kattikko'ndu azhuthaan. atha'rkuppin avan sakoatharar avanoadea sampaashiththaarka'l.
yoaseappin sakoatharar vanthaarka'l enki'ra samaasaaram paarvoan aramanaiyil pirasiththamaanapoathu, paarvoanum avanudaiya oozhiyakkaararum santhoasham adainthaarka'l.
paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: nee un sakoathararoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: ungka'l kazhuthaika'linmeal pothiyeat'rikko'ndu pu'rappattu, kaanaantheasaththukkup poay,
ungka'l thakappanaiyum ungka'l kudumpaththaaraiyum koottikko'ndu, ennidaththil vaarungka'l, naan ungka'lukku ekipthutheasaththin nanmaiyaith tharuvean; theasaththin kozhumaiyaich saappiduveerka'l.
neengka'l ungka'l kuzhanthaika'lukkaakavum ungka'l manaivika'lukkaakavum va'ndika'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu ko'ndupoay, avarka'laiyum ungka'l thakappanudanea eat'rikko'nduvaarungka'l.
ungka'l thattumuttuka'laikku'riththuk kavalaippadavea'ndaam; ekipthutheasamengkumu'l'la nanmai ungka'ludaiyathaayirukkum en'ru sollachsolli, unakku naan itta katta'laippadiyea sey en'raan.
isravealin kumaarar appadiyea seythaarka'l. yoaseappu paarvoanudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea avarka'lukku va'ndika'laik koduththathuman'ri, vazhikku aakaaraththaiyum,
avarka'lil ovvoruvanukkum maat'ru vasthirangka'laiyum koduththaan; penyameenukkoa munnoo'ru ve'l'likkaasaiyum ainthu maat'ru vasthirangka'laiyum koduththaan.

appadiyea than thakappanukkup paththuk kazhuthaika'linmeal ekipthin uchchithamaana pathaarththangka'lum, paththuk koa'likaik kazhuthaika'linmeal than thakappanukkaaka vazhikkuth thaaniyamum appamum mat'rath thinpa'ndangka'lum eat'ri anuppinaan.
mealum, neengka'l poakum vazhiyilea sa'ndaipa'n'nikko'l'laathirungka'l en'ru avan than sakoathararukkuch solli anuppinaan; avarka'l pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
avarka'l ekipthilirunthu poay, kaanaantheasaththilea thangka'l thakappanaakiya yaakkoapinidaththil vanthu:
yoaseappu uyiroadirukki'raan, avan ekipthutheasaththukkellaam athipathiyaayirukki'raan en'ru avanukku a'riviththaarka'l. avan iruthayam moorchchai adainthathu; avan avarka'lai nampavillai.

avarka'l yoaseappu thangka'ludanea sonna vaarththaika'l yaavaiyum avanukkuch sonnapoathum, thannai eat'rikko'ndu poakumpadi yoaseappu anuppina va'ndika'lai avan ka'ndapoathum, avarka'ludaiya thakappanaakiya yaakkoapin aavi uyirththathu.
appozhuthu israveal: en kumaaranaakiya yoaseappu innum uyiroadirukki'raanea, ithu poathum; naan mara'namadaiyumunnea poay avanaip paarppean en'raan.
israveal thanakku u'ndaana yaavaiyum searththukko'ndu pu'rappattup peyersepaavukkup poay, than thakappanaakiya eesaakkudaiya theavanukkup paliyittaan.
an'ru iravilea theavan isravealukkuth tharisanamaaki: yaakkoapea, yaakkoapea en'ru kooppittaar; avan ithoa, adiyean en'raan.
appozhuthu avar: naan theavan, naan un thakappanudaiya theavan; nee ekipthutheasaththukkuppoakap payappadavea'ndaam; angkea unnaip periya jaathiyaakkuvean.
naan unnudanea ekipthukku varuvean; naan unnaith thirumpavum varappa'n'nuvean; yoaseappu than kaiyaal un ka'nka'lai mooduvaan en'ru sonnaar.

atha'rkuppinpu, yaakkoapu peyersepaavilirunthu pirayaa'nam pu'rappattaan. isravealin kumaarar thangka'l thakappanaakiya yaakkoapaiyum thangka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyum thangka'l manaivika'laiyum paarvoan anuppina va'ndika'linmeal eat'rikko'ndu,
thangka'l aadumaaduka'laiyum, thaangka'l kaanaan theasaththil sampaathiththa thangka'l porudka'laiyum searththukko'ndu, yaakkoapum avan santhathiyaar yaavarum ekipthukkup poanaarka'l.

avan than kumaararaiyum than kumaararin kumaararaiyum than kumaaraththika'laiyum than kumaararin kumaaraththika'laiyum than santhathiyaar anaivaraiyum ekipthukkuth thannoadea azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.
ekipthukku vantha isravealarin naamangka'laavana: yaakkoapum avanudaiya kumaararum; yaakkoapudaiya mooththakumaaranaana roopan.
roopanudaiya kumaarar aanoakku, palloo, esroan, karmee enpavarka'l.
simiyoanudaiya kumaarar emuveal, yaamin, oakaath, yaakeen, sokaar, kaanaaniya sthireeyin kumaaranaakiya savul enpavarka'l.
leaviyinudaiya kumaarar kersoan, koakaath, meraari enpavarka'l.
yoothaavinudaiya kumaarar ear, oanaan, sealaa, paareas, searaa enpavarka'l; avarka'lil earum oanaanum kaanaantheasaththil i'ranthupoanaarka'l; paareasudaiya kumaarar esroan, aamool enpavarka'l.
isakkaarudaiya kumaarar thoalaa, poovaa, yoapu, simroan enpavarka'l.
sepuloanudaiya kumaarar sereath, ealoan, yakleal enpavarka'l.

ivarka'l leayaa'lin santhathiyaar; ava'l ivarka'laiyum theenaa'l ennum oru kumaaraththiyaiyum pathaanaraamilea yaakkoapukkup pet'raa'l; avan kumaararum avan kumaaraththika'lumaakiya ellaarum muppaththumoon'ru pear.
kaaththudaiya kumaarar, sippiyoan, aki, sooni, espoan, eari, aroathi, areali enpavarka'l.
aasearudaiya kumaarar imnaa, isvaa, isvi, pereeyaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'ludaiya sakoathari seraakku enpava'l; pereeyaavin kumaarar eapear, malkiyeal enpavarka'l.
ivarka'l laapaan than kumaaraththiyaakiya leayaa'lukkuk koduththa silpaa'ludaiya pi'l'laika'l; ava'l inthap pathinaa'rupearaiyum yaakkoapukkup pet'raa'l.
yaakkoapin manaiviyaakiya raakealudaiya kumaarar yoaseappu, penyameen enpavarka'l.
yoaseappukku ekipthu theasaththilea manaaseayum eppiraayeemum pi'ranthaarka'l; avarka'lai oanpatta'naththu aasaariyanaakiya poaththipiraavin kumaaraththiyaakiya aasnaath avanukkup pet'raa'l.
penyameenudaiya kumaarar pealaa, pekear, aspeal, kearaa, naakamaan, eaki, roash, muppim, uppim, aarthu enpavarka'l.
raakeal yaakkoapukkup pet'ra kumaararaakiya ivarka'l ellaarum pathinaalupear.
thaa'nudaiya kumaaran useem enpavan.
napthaliyin kumaarar yaathsiyeal, kooni, ethser, silleam enpavarka'l.
ivarka'l laapaan than kumaaraththiyaakiya raakealukkuk koduththa pilkaa'l yaakkoapukkup pet'ravarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum eazhupear.
yaakkoapudaiya kumaararin manaivika'laith thavira, avanudaiya karppappi'rappaayirunthu avan moolamaay ekipthilea vanthavarka'l ellaarum a'rupaththaa'rupear.
yoaseappukku ekipthilea pi'rantha kumaarar ira'ndupear; aaka ekipthukkup poana yaakkoapin kudumpaththaar ezhupathupear.
koasean naattilea thannai yoaseappu santhikka varumpadi solla, yoothaavaith thanakku munnaaka avanidaththil yaakkoapu anuppinaan; avarka'l koaseanilea searnthaarka'l.

yoaseappu than irathaththai aayaththappaduththi, athinmeal ea'ri, than thakappanaakiya isravealaich santhikkumpadi poay, avanaik ka'ndu, avanudaiya kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu, vekunearam avan kazhuththai vidaamal azhuthaan.
appozhuthu israveal yoaseappaip paarththu: nee innum uyiroadirukki'raayea, naan un mukaththaik ka'ndean, enakku ippoathu mara'nam vanthaalum varattum en'raan.

pinpu, yoaseappu than sakoathararaiyum than thakappanudaiya kudumpaththaaraiyum noakki: naan paarvoanidaththukkup poay, kaanaantheasaththilirunthu en sakoathararum en thakappan kudumpaththaarum ennidaththil vanthirukki'raarka'l.
avarka'l meaypparka'l, aadumaaduka'lai meaykki'rathu avarka'l thozhil; avarka'l thangka'l aadumaaduka'laiyum thangka'lukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l en'ru avarukkuch solluki'rean.
paarvoan ungka'lai azhaiththu, ungka'l thozhil enna en'ru keattaal,

neengka'l, koasean naattilea kudiyirukkumpadi, avanai noakki: engka'l pithaakka'laippoala, umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'lum engka'l si'ruvayathumuthal ithuvaraikkum meaypparka'laayirukki'roam en'ru sollungka'l; meaypparka'l ellaarum ekipthiyarukku aruvaruppaayirukki'raarka'l en'raan.

yoaseappu paarvoanidaththil poay: en thakappanum en sakoathararum, thangka'l aadumaaduka'loadum thangka'lukku u'ndaana ellaavat'roadungkoodak kaanaantheasaththilirunthu vanthaarka'l; ippozhuthu koasean naattil irukki'raarka'l en'ru solli;
than sakoathararil ainthupearaip paarvoanukku munpaakak ko'ndupoay ni'ruththinaan.

paarvoan avanudaiya sakoathararai noakki: ungka'l thozhil enna en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avarka'l: umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'lum engka'l pithaakka'lum manthai meaykki'ravarka'l en'ru paarvoanidaththil sonnathuman'ri,

kaanaan theasaththilea pagncham kodithaayirukki'rathu; umathu adiyaarin manthaika'lukku meaychchal illaamaiyaal, iththeasaththilea thangkavanthoam; umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l koasean naattilea kudiyirukkumpadi thayavuseyyavea'ndum en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu paarvoan yoaseappai noakki: un thakappanum un sakoathararum unnidaththil vanthirukki'raarka'lea.

ekipthutheasam unakku munpaaka irukki'rathu; theasaththilu'l'la nalla idaththilea un thakappanaiyum un sakoathararaiyum kudiyea'rumpadi sey; avarka'l koasean naattilea kudiyirukkalaam; avarka'lukku'l'lea thi'ramaiyu'l'lavarka'l u'nden'ru unakkuth therinthirunthaal, avarka'lai en aadumaaduka'lai visaarikki'ratha'rkuth thalaivaraaka vaikkalaam en'raan.
pinpu, yoaseappu than thakappanaakiya yaakkoapai azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, avanaip paarvoanukku munpaaka ni'ruththinaan. yaakkoapu paarvoanai aaseervathiththaan.
paarvoan yaakkoapai noakki: umakku vayathu enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku yaakkoapu: naan paratheasiyaaych sagnchariththa naadka'l noot'rumuppathu varusham; en aayusunaadka'l kognchamum sagnchalamu'l'lathumaayirukki'rathu; avaika'l paratheasika'laaych sagnchariththa en pithaakka'ludaiya aayusu naadka'lukku vanthu ettavillai en'ru paarvoanudanea sonnaan.
pinnum yaakkoapu paarvoanai aaseervathiththu, avan samukaththinin'ru pu'rappattuppoanaan.

paarvoan katta'laiyittapadiyea, yoaseappu than thakappanukkum than sakoathararukkum ekipthutheasaththilea nalla naadaakiya raamaseas ennum naattilea suthantharam koduththu, avarka'laik kudiyeat'rinaan.
yoaseappu than thakappanaiyum than sakoathararaiyum than thakappanudaiya kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum, avaravarka'l kudumpaththi'rkuththakkathaay aakaaram koduththu aathariththuvanthaan.
pagncham mikavum kodithaayirunthathu; theasamengkum aakaaram kidaiyaama'rpoayit'ru; ekipthutheasamum kaanaan theasamum pagnchaththinaalea melinthu poayit'ru.
yoaseappu ekipthu theasaththilum kaanaan theasaththilumu'l'la pa'naththaiyellaam thaaniyam ko'ndavarka'lidaththil vaangki, athaip paarvoan aramanaiyilea ko'ndupoaych searththaan.

ekipthutheasaththilum kaanaantheasaththilumu'l'la pa'nam selavazhinthapoathu, ekipthiyar ellaarum yoaseappinidaththil vanthu: engka'lukku aakaaram thaarum; pa'nam illai, athinaal naangka'l umathu samukaththil saakavea'ndumoa en'raarka'l.
atha'rku yoaseappu: ungka'lidaththil pa'nam illaama'rpoanaal, ungka'l aadumaaduka'laik kodungka'l; avaika'lukkup pathilaaka ungka'lukkuth thaaniyam kodukki'rean en'raan.

avarka'l thangka'l aadumaadu muthalaanavaika'lai yoaseappinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; yoaseappu kuthiraika'laiyum aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum vaangkikko'ndu, antha varusham avarka'ludaiya aadumaadu muthalaana ellaavat'ri'rkum pathilaaka avarka'lukku aakaaram koduththu, avarka'lai aathariththaan.

antha varusham mudinthapin, ma'ruvarushaththilea avarka'l avanidaththil vanthu: pa'namum selavazhinthupoayit'ru; engka'l aadumaadu muthalaanavaika'lum engka'l aa'ndavanaich searnthathu; engka'l sareeramum engka'l nilamumea ozhiya, engka'l aa'ndavanukku munpaaka meethiyaanathu on'rum illai; ithu engka'l aa'ndavanukkuth theriyaatha kaariyam alla.

naangka'lum engka'l nilangka'lum ummudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka azhinthu poakalaamaa? neer engka'laiyum engka'l nilangka'laiyum vaangkikko'ndu, aakaaram kodukkavea'ndum; naangka'lum engka'l nilangka'lum paarvoanukku aatheenamaayiruppoam; naangka'l saakaamal uyiroadirukkavum, nilangka'l paazhaayppoakaamalirukkavum, engka'lukku vithaith thaaniyaththaith thaarum en'raarka'l.

appadiyea ekipthiyar thangka'lukkup pagncham mealittapadiyaal avaravar thangka'l thangka'l vayal nilangka'lai vit'raarka'l; yoaseappu ekipthin nilangka'l yaavaiyum paarvoanukkaakak ko'ndaan; ivvithamaay anthap poomi paarvoanudaiyathaayit'ru.
mealum avan ekipthin oru ellai muthal ma'ru ellaivaraikkumu'l'la janangka'lai anthanthap patta'nangka'lil kudimaa'rippoakappa'n'ninaan.

aasaariyarudaiya nilaththai maaththiram avan ko'l'lavillai; athu paarvoanaalea aasaariyarukku maaniyamaakak kodukkappattirunthathinaalum, paarvoan avarka'lukkuk koduththa maaniyaththinaalea avarka'l jeevanampa'n'nivanthathinaalum, avarka'l thangka'l nilaththai vi'rkavillai.

pinnum yoaseappu janangka'lai noakki: ithoa, in'ru ungka'laiyum ungka'l nilangka'laiyum paarvoanukkaaka vaangkikko'ndean; ithoa, ungka'lukkuk kodukkappaduki'ra vithaiththaaniyam; ithai nilaththil vithaiyungka'l.

vi'laivil ainthil oru pangkaip paarvoanukkuk kodukkavea'ndum; mat'ra naalupangkum vayalukku vithaiyaakavum ungka'lukkum ungka'l kudumpaththaarukkum ungka'l kuzhanthaika'lukkum aakaaramaakavum ungka'ludaiyathaayirukkattum en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l: neer engka'l piraa'nanaik kaappaat'rineer; engka'l aa'ndavanudaiya ka'nka'lil engka'lukkuth thayavu kidaikkavea'ndum; naangka'l paarvoanukku adimaika'laayirukki'roam en'raarka'l.

ainthil on'ru paarvoanukkuch searum vaaram en'ru yoaseappu itta katta'laippadi ekipthu theasaththilea innaa'lvaraikkum nadanthuvaruki'rathu; aasaariyarin nilam maaththiram paarvoanaich searaamal neengkalaayirunthathu.
isravealar ekipthu theasaththilu'l'la koasean naattilea kudiyirunthaarka'l; angkea nilangka'laik kaiyaadchi seythu, mikavum palukip perukinaarka'l.
yaakkoapu ekipthu theasaththilea pathineazhu varusham irunthaan; yaakkoapudaiya aayusunaadka'l noot'ru naa'rpaththeazhu varusham.

israveal mara'namadaiyum kaalam sameepiththathu. appozhuthu avan than kumaaranaakiya yoaseappai varavazhaiththu, avanai noakki: enmeal unakkuth thayavu'ndaanaal, un kaiyai en thodaiyinkeezh vaiththu enmeal padchamum u'nmaiyumu'l'lavanaayiru; ennai ekipthilea adakkampa'n'naathiruppaayaaka.

naan en pithaakka'loadea paduththukko'l'lavea'ndum; aakaiyaal, nee ennai ekipthilirunthu eduththukko'ndupoay, avarka'lai adakkampa'n'niyirukki'ra nilaththilea ennaiyum adakkampa'n'nu en'raan. atha'rku avan: umathu so'rpadi seyvean en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: enakku aa'naiyittukkodu en'raan; avanukku aa'naiyittukkoduththaan. appozhuthu israveal kattilin thalaimaattilea saaynthu thozhuthuko'ndaan.

atha'rkuppinpu, ummudaiya thakappanaarukku varuththamaayirukki'rathu en'ru yoaseappukkuch sollappattathu. appozhuthu avan than ira'ndu kumaararaakiya manaaseayaiyum eppiraayeemaiyum thannoadeakoodak ko'ndupoanaan.
ithoa, ummudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoaseappu ummidaththil vanthirukki'raar en'ru yaakkoapukku a'rivikkappattathu; appozhuthu israveal thannaith thidappaduththikko'ndu, kattilinmeal udkaarnthaan.
yaakkoapu yoaseappai noakki: sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan kaanaan theasaththilu'l'la loos ennum idaththil enakkuth tharisanamaaki, ennai aaseervathiththu:
naan unnaip palukavum perukavum pa'n'ni, unnaip pala janakkoottamaakki, unakkup pinvarum un santhathikku inthath theasaththai niththiya suthantharamaakak koduppean en'ru ennoadea sonnaar.
naan unnidaththil ekipthukku varumunnea unakku ekipthutheasaththil pi'rantha un ira'ndu kumaararum ennudaiya kumaarar; roopan simiyoan enpavarka'laippoala, eppiraayeemum manaaseayum ennudaiyavarka'l.
ivarka'lukkuppin, nee pe'rum pi'l'laika'l unnudaiyavarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l thangka'l sakoathararudaiya pearaal azhaikkappattu avarka'lukkuriya suthantharaththil pangkupe'ruvaarka'l.

naan pathaanai vittu varukaiyil, kaanaantheasaththil eppiraaththaavukkuk kogncham thooram irukkumpoathu, vazhiyilea raakeal enna'ndaiyil mara'namadainthaa'l; ava'lai angkea pethlekeam ennum eppiraaththaa oorukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilea adakkampa'n'ninean en'raan.
israveal yoaseappin kumaararaip paarththu: ivarka'l yaar en'ru keattaan.
yoaseappu than thakappanai noakki: ivarka'l ivvidaththil theavan enakku aru'lina kumaarar en'raan. appozhuthu avan: naan avarka'lai aaseervathikkumpadi avarka'lai en kittakko'nduvaa en'raan.

muthirvayathinaal isravealin ka'nka'l mangkalaayirunthapadiyaal, avan nan'raayp paarkkakkoodaathirunthathu. avarka'lai avana'ndaiyilea searappa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu avan avarka'lai muththagnseythu a'naiththukko'ndaan.
israveal yoaseappai noakki: un mukaththaik kaa'npean en'ru naan ninaikkavillai; aanaalum, ithoa, un santhathiyaiyum kaa'numpadi theavan enakku aru'lseythaar en'raan.
appozhuthu avanudaiya muzhangkaalka'l naduvea iruntha pi'l'laika'lai yoaseappu pinnidappa'n'ni, avanudaiya mukaththukku munpaakath tharaimattum kuninthu va'nangkinaan.

pinpu, yoaseappu avviruvaraiyum ko'nduvanthu, eppiraayeemaith than valathukaiyinaalea isravealin idathukaikku nearaakavum, manaaseayaith than idathukaiyinaalea isravealin valathukaikku nearaakavum vittaan.

appozhuthu israveal, manama'riya, than valathukaiyai neetti, i'laiyavanaakiya eppiraayeemudaiya thalaiyinmealum, manaasea mooththavanaayirunthum, than idathu kaiyai manaaseayudaiya thalaiyinmealum vaiththaan.
avan yoaseappai aaseervathiththu: en pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaamum eesaakkum vazhipattu va'nangkiya theavanum, naan pi'rantha naa'lmuthal innaa'lvaraikkum ennai aathariththuvantha theavanum,

ellaath theemaikkum neengkalaakki ennai meetta thoothanumaanavar inthap pi'l'laika'lai aaseervathippaaraaka, en pearum en pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaam eesaakku enpavarka'lin pearum ivarka'lukku idappadakkadavathu; poomiyil ivarka'l mikuthiyaayp perukakkadavarka'l en'raan.

thakappan than valathukaiyai eppiraayeemudaiya thalaiyinmeal vaiththathai yoaseappu ka'ndu, athu thanakkup piriyamillaathapadiyaal, eppiraayeemudaiya thalaiyinmeal iruntha than thakappanudaiya kaiyai manaaseayinudaiya thalaiyinmeal vaikkumpadikku eduththu:
