en thakappanea, appadiyalla, ivan mooththavan, ivanudaiya thalaiyinmeal ummudaiya valathukaiyai vaikkavea'ndum en'raan.

avan thakappanoa thaduththu: athu enakkuth theriyum, en makanea, enakkuth theriyum; ivanum oru janakkoottamaavaan, ivanum perukuvaan; ivanudaiya thampiyoa ivanilum athikamaayp perukuvaan; avanudaiya santhathiyaar thira'laana janangka'laavaarka'l en'raan.

ivvithamaaka avan an'raiththinam avarka'lai aaseervathiththu: theavan unnai eppiraayeemaippoalavum manaaseayaippoalavum aakkuvaaraaka en'ru isravealar unnai munnittu vaazhththuvaarka'l en'ru solli, eppiraayeemai manaaseakku munnea vaiththaan.
pinpu, israveal yoaseappai noakki: ithoa, naan mara'namadaiyappoaki'rean; theavan ungka'loadea iruppaar; avar ungka'l pithaakka'lin theasaththukku ungka'laith thirumpavum poakappa'n'nuvaar en'rum,
un sakoathararukkuk koduththathaippaarkkilum, naan en pattayaththaalum, en villinaalum, emoariyar kaiyilirunthu sampaathiththa oru nilaththai unakku athikamaana pangkaakak koduththean en'rum sonnaan.
yaakkoapu than kumaararai azhaiththu: neengka'l koodivaarungka'l, kadaisi naadka'lil ungka'lukku nearidum kaariyangka'lai a'rivippean.
yaakkoapin kumaararea, koodivanthu kea'lungka'l; ungka'l thakappanaakiya isravealukkuch sevikodungka'l.
roopanea, nee en seashdapuththiran; nee en saththuvamum, en mutha'rpelanumaanavan; nee meanmaiyil pirathaanamum vallamaiyil viseashamumaanavan.
tha'n'neeraippoala tha'lampinavanea, nee meanmai adaiyamaattaay; un thakappanudaiya magnchaththinmeal ea'rinaay; nee athaith theettuppaduththinaay; en padukkaiyinmeal ea'rinaanea.
simiyoanum, leaviyum eaka sakoatharar; avarka'ludaiya pattayangka'l kodumaiyin karuvika'l.

en aaththumaavea, avarka'ludaiya irakasiya aaloasanaikku udanpadaathea; en meanmaiyea, avarka'l koottaththil nee searaathea; avarka'l thangka'l koapaththinaalea oru purushanaik kon'ru, thangka'l akangkaaraththinaalea ara'nka'lai nirmoolamaakkinaarka'lea.
ukkiramaana avarka'l koapamum kodumaiyaana avarka'l moorkkamum sapikkappadakkadavathu; yaakkoapilea avarka'laip piriyavum, isravealilea avarka'laich sitha'ravum pa'n'nuvean.
yoothaavea, sakoathararaal pukazhappadupavan neeyea; un karam un saththurukka'ludaiya pidariyinmeal irukkum; un thakappanudaiya puththirar unmun pa'nivaarka'l.
yoothaa paalasingkam, nee irai kavarnthuko'ndu ea'rippoanaay; en makanea, singkampoalum kizhachsingkampoalum madangkip paduththaan; avanai ezhuppuki'ravan yaar?
samaathaana karththar varuma'lavum sengkoal yoothaavaivittu neengkuvathum illai, niyaayappiramaa'nikkan avan paathangka'lai vittu ozhivathum illai; janangka'l avaridaththil searuvaarka'l.

avan than kazhuthaikkuttiyaith thiraadchachsediyilum, than koa'likaik kazhuthaiyin kuttiyai na'rkula thiraadchachsediyilum kattuvaan; thiraadcharasaththilea than vasthiraththaiyum, thiraadchappazhangka'lin iraththaththilea than angkiyaiyum thoayppaan.
avan ka'nka'l thiraadcharasaththinaal sivappaayum, avan pa'rka'l paalinaal ve'nmaiyaayum irukkum.
sepuloan kadalthu'rai arukea kudiyiruppaan; avan kappal thu'raimukamaay iruppaan; avan ellai seethoanvaraikkum irukkum.
isakkaar ira'ndu pothiyin naduvea paduththukko'ndirukki'ra palaththa kazhuthai.
avan, i'laippaa'ruthal nallathu en'rum, naadu vasathiyaanathu en'rum ka'ndu, sumakki'ratha'rkuth than thoa'laich saayththu, pakuthikattuki'ravanaanaan.
thaa'n israveal koaththirangka'lil oru koaththiramaaki, than janaththai niyaayam visaarippaan.
thaa'n, kuthiraiyinmeal ea'riyirukki'ravan mallaanthu vizhumpadiyaay athin kuthikaalaik kadikki'ratha'rku vazhiyil kidakki'ra sarppaththaippoalavum, paathaiyil irukki'ra viriyanaippoalavum iruppaan.
karththaavea, ummudaiya iradchippukkuk kaaththirukki'rean.
kaath enpavanmeal raa'nuvakkoottam paaynthuvizhum; avanoa mudivilea athinmeal paaynthuvizhuvaan.
aasearudaiya aakaaram kozhumaiyaayirukkum; raajaakka'lukku vea'ndiya rusivarkkangka'lai avan tharuvaan.
napthali viduthalaipet'ra pe'nmaan; inpamaana vasanangka'lai vasanippaan.
yoaseappu kanitharum sedi; avan neer oot'ra'ndaiyilu'l'la kanitharum sedi; athin kodika'l suvarinmeal padarum.
vilveerar avanai manamadivaakki, avanmeal eythu, avanaip pakaiththaarka'l.
aanaalum, avanudaiya vil u'ruthiyaay nin'rathu; avan puyangka'l yaakkoapudaiya vallavarin karangka'laal palaththana; ithinaal avan meayppanum isravealin kanmalaiyum aanaan.

un thakappanudaiya theavanaalea appadiyaayit'ru, avar unakkuth thu'naiyaayiruppaar; sarvavallavaraalea appadiyaayit'ru, avar uyara vaanaththilirunthu u'ndaakum aaseervaathangka'linaalum, keezhea aazhaththil u'ndaakum aaseervaathangka'linaalum, sthanangka'lukkum karppangka'lukkum uriya aaseervaathangka'linaalum unnai aaseervathippaar.

un thakappanudaiya aaseervaathangka'l en pithaakka'ludaiya aaseervaathangka'lukku mea'rpattathaayirunthu, niththiya parvathangka'lin mudivumattum ettukin'rana; avaika'l yoaseappudaiya sirasinmealum, than sakoathararil viseashiththavanudaiya uchchanthalaiyinmealum varuvathaaka.
penyameen pee'ruki'ra oanaay; kaalaiyil than iraiyaip padchippaan, maalaiyil thaan ko'l'laiyittathaip pangkiduvaan en'raan.

ivarka'l ellaarum isravealin pannira'ndu koaththiraththaar; avarka'ludaiya thakappan avarka'lai aaseervathikkaiyil, avarka'lukkuch sonnathu ithuthaan; avanavanukkuriya aaseervaatham solli avanavanai aaseervathiththaan.

pinnum avan avarka'lai noakki: naan en janaththaaroadea searkkappadappoaki'rean; eaththiyanaana epperoanin nilaththilu'l'la kukaiyilea ennai en pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittu;

anthak kukai kaanaan theasaththilea mamreakku ethiraaka makpealaa ennappatta nilaththil irukki'rathu; athai namakkuch sonthak kalla'raip poomiyaayirukkumpadi, aapirakaam eaththiyanaakiya epperoan kaiyil atha'rkuriya nilaththudanea vaangkinaar.

angkea aapirakaamaiyum avar manaiviyaakiya saaraa'laiyum adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; angkea eesaakkaiyum avar manaiviyaakiya repekkaa'laiyum adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; angkea leayaa'laiyum adakkampa'n'ninean.
antha nilamum athil irukki'ra kukaiyum eaththin puththirar kaiyil ko'l'lappattathu en'raan.
yaakkoapu than kumaararukkuk katta'laiyittu mudinthapinpu, avan than kaalka'laik kattilinmeal madakkikko'ndu jeeviththuppoay, than janaththaaroadea searkkappattaan.
appozhuthu yoaseappu than thakappanudaiya mukaththinmeal vizhunthu, azhuthu, avanai muththagnseythaan.
pinpu, than thakappanukkuch sukanthavarkkamidumpadi yoaseappu than oozhiyakkaararaakiya vaiththiyarukkuk katta'laiyittaan; appadiyea vaiththiyar isravealukkuch sukanthavarkkamittaarka'l.
sukanthavarkkamida naa'rpathunaa'l sellum; appadiyea antha naadka'l ni'raivea'rina. ekipthiyar avanukkaaka ezhupathunaa'l thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.

thukkangko'ndaadum naadka'l mudinthapin, yoaseappu paarvoanin kudumpaththaarai noakki: ungka'l ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayavukidaiththathaanaal, neengka'l paarvoanudaiya kaathu keadka avarukku a'rivikkavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

en thakappanaar ennai noakki: ithoa, naan mara'namadaiyappoaki'rean; kaanaan theasaththilea naan enakkaaka vettivaiththirukki'ra kalla'raiyilea ennai adakkampa'n'nuvaayaaka en'ru ennidaththil solli, aa'naiyiduviththukko'ndaar; naan angkea poay, en thakappanai adakkampa'n'ni varuvatha'rku uththaravukodukka vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
atha'rkup paarvoan: un thakappan unnidaththil aa'naiyiduviththapadiyea, nee poay, avarai adakkampa'n'nivaa en'raan.
appadiyea yoaseappu than thakappanai adakkampa'n'nap poanaan. paarvoanudaiya aramanaiyiliruntha periyavarka'laakiya avanudaiya sakala uththiyoakastharum ekipthu theasaththilu'l'la sakala periyoarum,

yoaseappin veettaar yaavarum, avan sakoathararum, avan thakappan veettaarum avanoadeakoodap poanaarka'l. thangka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyum, thangka'l aadumaaduka'laiyummaaththiram koasean naattilea vittup poanaarka'l.
irathangka'lum kuthiraiveerarum avanoadea poanathinaal, parivaarakkoottam mikavum athikamaayirunthathu.

avarka'l yoarthaanukku akkaraiyil irukki'ra aaththaaththin poarkka'laththil vanthapoathu, avvidaththilea perum pulampalaakap pulampinaarka'l. angkea than thakappanukkaaka eazhunaa'l thukkangko'ndaadinaan.

aaththaaththin ka'laththilea thukkangko'ndaaduki'rathai aththeasaththin kudika'laakiya kaanaaniyar ka'ndu: ithu ekipthiyarukkup periya thukkangko'ndaadal en'raarka'l. athinaal yoarthaanukku appaal irukki'ra antha sthalaththi'rku aapealmisraayeem ennum pear u'ndaayit'ru.
yaakkoapin kumaarar, thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittirunthapadiyea,

avanaik kaanaan theasaththukkuk ko'ndupoay, aapirakaam mamreakku ethirea irukki'ra makpealaa ennum nilaththilea thanakkuch sonthak kalla'rai poomiyaaka eaththiyanaakiya epperoanidaththil vaangkina nilaththilu'l'la kukaiyilea avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoaseappu than thakappanai adakkampa'n'ninapinpu, avanum avan sakoathararum, avanudaiya thakappanai adakkampa'n'nuvatha'rku avanoadeakoodap poanavarka'l yaavarum ekipthukkuth thirumpinaarka'l.

thangka'l thakappan mara'namadainthathai yoaseappin sakoatharar ka'ndu: oruvea'lai yoaseappu nammaip pakaiththu, naam avanukkuch seytha ellaap pollaangkukkaakavum namakkuch sarikkuch sarikattuvaan en'ru solli, yoaseappinidaththil aa'l anuppi,

ummudaiya sakoatharar umakkup pollaangku seythirunthaalum, avarka'l seytha thuroakaththaiyum paathakaththaiyum neer thayavuseythu mannikkavea'ndum en'ru ummudaiya thakappanaar mara'namadaiyumunnea, umakkuch sollumpadi katta'laiyittaar.

aakaiyaal, ummudaiya thakappanaarudaiya theavanukku oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'l seytha thuroakaththai mannikkavea'ndum en'ru avanukkuch sollachsonnaarka'l. avarka'l athai yoaseappukkuch sonnapoathu, avan azhuthaan.
pinpu, avanudaiya sakoathararum poay, avanukku munpaakath thaazha vizhunthu: ithoa, naangka'l umakku adimaika'l en'raarka'l.
yoaseappu avarka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l; naan theavanaa;
neengka'l enakkuth theemaiseyya ninaiththeerka'l; theavanoa, ippozhuthu nadanthuvaruki'rapadiyea, veku janangka'lai uyiroadea kaakkumpadikku, athai nanmaiyaaka mudiyappa'n'ninaar.
aathalaal, payappadaathirungka'l; naan ungka'laiyum ungka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyum paraamarippean en'ru, avarka'lukku aa'ruthal solli, avarka'loadea padchamaayp peasinaan.
yoaseappum avan thakappan kudumpaththaarum ekipthilea kudiyirunthaarka'l. yoaseappu noot'ruppaththu varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
yoaseappu eppiraayeemukkup pi'rantha moon'raam thalaimu'raip pi'l'laika'laiyum ka'ndaan; manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin pi'l'laika'lum yoaseappin madiyil va'larkkappattaarka'l.

yoaseappu than sakoathararai noakki: naan mara'namadaiyappoaki'rean; aanaalum theavan ungka'lai nichchayamaaych santhiththu, neengka'l inthath theasaththaivittu, thaam aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum aa'naiyittukkoduththirukki'ra theasaththukkup poakappa'n'nuvaar en'ru sonnathuman'ri;
theavan ungka'laich santhikkumpoathu, en elumpuka'lai ivvidaththilirunthu ko'ndupoaveerka'laaka en'rum solli; yoaseappu israveal puththiraridaththil aa'naiyiduviththukko'ndaan.
yoaseappu noot'ruppaththu vayathu'l'lavanaay mariththaan. avanukkuch sukanthavarkkamittu, ekipthu theasaththil avanai oru pettiyilea vaiththuvaiththaarka'l.
ekipthukkup poana isravealudaiya kumaararin naamangka'laavana: roopan, simiyoan, leavi, yoothaa,
isakkaar, sepuloan, penyameen,
thaa'n, napthali, kaath, aasear enpavaika'lea.
ivarka'l yaakkoapudanea thangka'l thangka'l kudumpaththoadungkoodap poanaarka'l.
yoaseappoa atha'rku munnamea ekipthil poayirunthaan. yaakkoapin karppappi'rappaakiya yaavarum ezhupathu pear.
yoaseappum avanudaiya sakoatharar yaavarum, anthath thalaimu'raiyaar ellaarum mara'namadainthaarka'l.
israveal puththirar mikuthiyum paluki, earaa'lamaayp perukip palaththirunthaarka'l; theasam avarka'laal ni'rainthathu.
yoaseappai a'riyaatha puthiya raajan oruvan ekipthil thoan'rinaan.
avan than janangka'lai noakki: ithoa, israveal puththiraraakiya janangka'l nammilum earaa'lamaanavarka'lum, palaththavarka'lumaay irukki'raarka'l.

avarka'l perukaathapadikkum, oru yuththam u'ndaanaal, avarka'lum nammudaiya pakaignaroadea koodi, namakku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, theasaththaivittup pu'rappattuppoakaathapadikkum, naam avarka'laikku'riththu oru upaayam pa'n'navea'ndum en'raan.

appadiyea avarka'laich sumaisumakki'ra vealaiyinaal odukkumpadikku, avarka'lmeal visaara'naikkaararai vaiththaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'l paarvoanukkaakap piththoam, raamaseas ennum pa'ndasaalaip patta'nangka'laik kattinaarka'l.
aanaalum avarka'lai evva'lavu odukkinaarka'loa avva'lavaay avarka'l palukip perukinaarka'l. aakaiyaal avarka'l israveal puththiraraikku'riththu erichchal adainthaarka'l.
ekipthiyar israveal puththiraraik kodumaiyaay vealaivaangkinaarka'l.

saanthum sengkalumaakiya ivaika'laich seyyum vealaiyinaalum, vayalil seyyum sakalavitha vealaiyinaalum, avarka'lukku avarka'l jeevanaiyum kasappaakkinaarka'l; avarka'laikko'ndu seyviththa mat'ra ellaa vealaika'lilum, avarka'laik kodumaiyaay nadaththinaarka'l.
athuvuman'ri, ekipthin raajaa, sippiraa'l poovaa'l ennum pearudaiya epireya maruththuvachchika'loadea peasi:

neengka'l epireya sthireeka'lukku maruththuvam seyyumpoathu, avarka'l ma'naiyinmeal udkaarnthirukkaiyil paarththu, aa'npi'l'laiyaanaal kon'rupoadungka'l, pe'npi'l'laiyaanaal uyiroadirukkattum en'raan.
maruththuvachchika'loa, theavanukkup payanthathinaal, ekipthin raajaa thangka'lukku itta katta'laippadi seyyaamal, aa'npi'l'laika'laiyum uyiroadea kaappaat'rinaarka'l.
athinaal ekipthin raajaa maruththuvachchika'lai azhaippiththu: neengka'l aa'npi'l'laika'lai uyiroadea kaappaat'ruki'ra kaariyam enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku maruththuvachchika'l paarvoanai noakki: epireya sthireeka'l ekipthiya sthireeka'laippoal alla, avarka'l nalla palamu'l'lavarka'l; maruththuvachchi avarka'lidaththukkup poakumunnamea avarka'l pirasaviththaakum en'raarka'l.
ithinimiththam theavan maruththuvachchika'lukku nanmaiseythaar. janangka'l peruki mikuthiyum palaththuppoanaarka'l.
maruththuvachchika'l theavanukkup payanthathinaal, avarka'ludaiya kudumpangka'l thazhaikkumpadi seythaar.
appozhuthu paarvoan, pi'rakkum aa'npi'l'laika'laiyellaam nathiyilea poattuvidavum, pe'npi'l'laika'laiyellaam uyiroadea vaikkavum than janangka'l ellaarukkum katta'laiyittaan.
leaviyin kudumpaththaaril oruvan leaviyin kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ninaan.
antha sthiree karppavathiyaaki, oru aa'npi'l'laiyaip pet'ru, athu azhaku'l'lathu en'ru ka'ndu, athai moon'rumaatham o'liththuvaiththaa'l.
ava'l athai appu'ram o'liththuvaikkakkoodaamal, oru naa'na'rpettiyai eduththu, atha'rkup pisinum keelum poosi, athilea pi'l'laiyai va'larththi, nathiyoaramaay naa'nalukku'l'lea vaiththaa'l.
atha'rku enna sampavikkum enpathai a'riyumpadi athin thamakkai thooraththilea nin'ruko'ndirunthaa'l.

appozhuthu paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththi nathiyil snaanampa'n'na vanthaa'l; ava'ludaiya thaathika'l nathiyoaraththil ulaavinaarka'l; ava'l naa'nalukku'l'lea irukki'ra pettiyaik ka'ndu, than thaathiyai anuppi athaik ko'nduvarumpadi seythaa'l.
athaith thi'ranthapoathu pi'l'laiyaik ka'ndaa'l; pi'l'lai azhuthathu; ava'l athinmeal irakkamut'ru, ithu epireyar pi'l'laika'lil on'ru en'raa'l.

appozhuthu athin thamakkai paarvoanin kumaaraththiyai noakki: umakku inthap pi'l'laiyai va'larkkumpadi epireya sthireeka'lil paalkodukki'ra oruththiyai naan poay ummidaththil azhaiththukko'ndu varattumaa en'raa'l.
atha'rkup paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththi: azhaiththukko'nduvaa en'raa'l. inthap pe'n poayp pi'l'laiyin thaayaiyea azhaiththukko'nduvanthaa'l.

paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththi ava'lai noakki: nee inthap pi'l'laiyai eduththukko'ndupoay, athai enakku va'larththidu, naan unakkuch sampa'lam kodukki'rean en'raa'l. antha sthiree pi'l'laiyai eduththukko'ndupoay, athai va'larththaa'l.

pi'l'lai perithaanapoathu, ava'l athaip paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththiyinidaththil ko'ndupoay vittaa'l. ava'lukku avan kumaaranaanaan. ava'l: avanai jalaththinin'ru eduththean en'ru solli, avanukku moasea en'ru pearittaa'l.
moasea periyavanaana kaalaththil, avan than sakoathararidaththil poay, avarka'l sumaisumakki'rathaip paarththu, than sakoathararaakiya epireyaril oruvanai oru ekipthiyan adikki'rathaik ka'ndu,
angkum ingkum paarththu, oruvarum illai en'ru a'rinthu, ekipthiyanai vetti, avanai ma'nalilea puthaiththuppoattaan.

avan ma'runaa'lilum ve'liyea poanapoathu, epireya manushar iruvar sa'ndaipa'n'nikko'ndirunthaarka'l. appozhuthu avan aniyaayagn seyki'ravanai noakki: nee un thoazhanai adikki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: engka'lmeal unnai athikaariyaakavum niyaayaathipathiyaakavum ea'rpaduththinavan yaar? nee ekipthiyanaik kon'rupoattathupoala, ennaiyum kon'rupoada ninaikki'raayoa en'raan. appozhuthu moasea kaariyam nichchayamaaka ve'lippattathu en'ru payanthaan.

paarvoan anthak kaariyaththaik kea'lvippattapoathu, moaseayaik kolaiseyya vakaitheadinaan. moasea paarvoanidaththinin'ru thappiyoadi, meethiyaan theasaththil poayth thangki, oru thurava'ndaiyilea udkaarnthirunthaan.

meethiyaan theasaththu aasaariyanukku eazhu kumaaraththika'l irunthaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l thakappanudaiya aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaattumpadikku angkea vanthu, tha'n'neer mo'ndu, thottika'lai nirappinaarka'l.
appozhuthu meaypparka'l vanthu, avarka'laith thuraththinaarka'l; moasea ezhunthirunthu, avarka'lukkuth thu'nainin'ru, avarka'ludaiya aaduka'lukkuth tha'n'neer kaattinaan.
avarka'l thangka'l thakappanaakiya rekuvealidaththil vanthapoathu, avan: neengka'l in'ru iththanai seekkiramaay vanthathu enna en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: ekipthiyan oruvan meaypparin kaika'lukku engka'laith thappuviththu, engka'lukkuth tha'n'neer mo'ndu koduththu, aaduka'lukkum tha'n'neer kaattinaan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan than kumaaraththika'laip paarththu: avan engkea? antha manithanai neengka'l vittuvanthathu enna? poajanampa'n'numpadikku avanai azhaiththukko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.
moasea antha manithanidaththil thangkiyirukkach sammathiththaan. avan sippoaraa'l ennum than kumaaraththiyai moaseakkuk koduththaan.
ava'l oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l. naan anniya theasaththil paratheasiyaay irukki'rean en'ru solli, avanukku kersoam en'ru pearittaan.

silakaalam sen'rapin, ekipthin raajaa mariththaan. israveal puththirar adimaiththanaththinaal thaviththu, mu'raiyittukko'ndirunthaarka'l; avarka'l adimaiththanaththilirunthu mu'raiyidum saththam theavasannithiyil ettinathu.
theavan avarka'l perumoochchaikkeattu, thaam aapirakaamoadum eesaakkoadum yaakkoapoadum seytha udanpadikkaiyai ninaivukoornthaar.
theavan israveal puththiraraik ka'n'noakkinaar; theavan avarka'lai ninaiththaru'linaar.

moasea meethiyaan theasaththu aasaariyanaayiruntha than maamanaakiya eththiroavin aaduka'lai meayththuvanthaan. avan aaduka'lai vanaantharaththin pinpu'raththilea oatti, theavaparvathamaakiya oareapmattum vanthaan.

angkea karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar oru mudchediyin naduvilirunthu u'ndaana akkinijuvaalaiyilea nin'ru avanukkuth tharisanamaanaar. appozhuthu avan ut'ruppaarththaan; mudchedi akkiniyaal juvaaliththu erinthum, athu venthupoakaamal irunthathu.
appozhuthu moasea: intha mudchedi venthupoakaathirukki'rathu enna, naan kittappoay intha a'rputhakaadchiyaip paarppean en'raan.
avan paarkkumpadi kitta varuki'rathaik karththar ka'ndaar. mudchediyin naduvilirunthu theavan avanai noakki: moasea, moasea en'ru kooppittaar. avan: ithoa, adiyean en'raan.
appozhuthu avar: ingkea kittich searaayaaka; un kaalka'lil irukki'ra paatharadchaiyaik kazhat'rippoadu; nee ni'rki'ra idam parisuththa poomi en'raar.

pinnum avar: naan aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin theavanum yaakkoapin theavanumaakiya un pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaayirukki'rean en'raar. moasea theavanai noakkippaarkkap payanthathinaal, than mukaththai moodikko'ndaan.

appozhuthu karththar: ekipthilirukki'ra en janaththin upaththiravaththai naan paarkkavea paarththu, aa'loattika'linimiththam avarka'l iduki'ra kookkuralaik keattean, avarka'l paduki'ra veathanaika'laiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.

avarka'lai ekipthiyarin kaikku viduthalaiyaakkavum, avarka'lai anthath theasaththilirunthu neekki, kaanaaniyarum eaththiyarum emoariyarum perisiyarum eaviyarum epoosiyarum irukki'ra idamaakiya paalum theanum oaduki'ra nalamum visaalamumaana theasaththil ko'ndupoaych searkkavum i'rangkinean.
ippozhuthum israveal puththirarin kookkural en sannithiyil vanthu ettinathu; ekipthiyar avarka'lai odukkuki'ra odukkuthalaiyum ka'ndean.
nee israveal puththiraraakiya en janaththai ekipthilirunthu azhaiththu varumpadi unnaip paarvoanidaththukku anuppuvean vaa en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea theavanai noakki: paarvoanidaththukkup poakavum, israveal puththirarai ekipthilirunthu azhaiththuvaravum, naan emmaaththiram en'raan.

atha'rku avar: naan unnoadea iruppean; nee janaththai ekipthilirunthu azhaiththuvanthapin, neengka'l intha malaiyil theavanukku aaraathanai seyveerka'l; naan unnai anuppinean enpatha'rku ithuvea adaiyaa'lam en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea theavanai noakki: naan israveal puththiraridaththil poay, ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavan ungka'lidaththil ennai anuppinaar en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollumpoathu, avarudaiya naamam enna en'ru avarka'l ennidaththil keattaal, naan avarka'lukku enna solluvean en'raan.
atha'rkuth theavan: irukki'ravaraaka irukki'rean en'ru moaseayudanea solli, irukki'rean enpavar ennai ungka'lidaththukku anuppinaar en'ru israveal puththiraroadea solvaayaaka en'raar.

mealum, theavan moaseayai noakki: aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin theavanum yaakkoapin theavanumaayirukki'ra ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar ennai ungka'lidaththukku anuppinaar en'ru nee israveal puththirarukkuch solvaayaaka; en'raikkum ithuvea en naamam, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum ithuvea en pearppirasthaapam.

nee poay, isravealin moopparaikkootti, avarka'lidaththil: aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'ludaiya theavanaayirukki'ra ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar enakkuth tharisanamaaki, ungka'lai nichchayamaaych santhiththu, ekipthil ungka'lukkuch seyyappattathaik ka'ndean en'rum,

naan ungka'lai ekipthin si'rumaiyilirunthu neekki, paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasamaakiya kaanaaniyar eaththiyar emoariyar perisiyar eaviyar epoosiyarudaiya theasaththukkuk ko'ndupoavean en'rum sonnean en'raar en'ru sollu.

avarka'l un vaakkukkuch sevikoduppaarka'l; appozhuthu neeyum isravealin moopparum ekipthin raajaavinidaththil poay: epireyarudaiya theavanaakiya karththar engka'laich santhiththaar; ippozhuthum naangka'l vanaantharaththil moon'runaa'l pirayaa'nampoay, engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidumpadi engka'laip poakavidavea'ndumen'ru sollungka'l.
aanaalum, ekipthin raajaa kaivallamai ka'ndaalozhiya, ungka'laip poakavidaan en'ru naan a'rivean.
aakaiyaal, naan en kaiyai neetti, ekipthin naduvilea naan seyyum sakalavitha a'rputhangka'laalum athai vaathippean; atha'rkuppin avan ungka'laip poakaviduvaan.
appozhuthu intha janangka'lukku ekipthiyarin ka'nka'lil thayavukidaikkappa'n'nuvean; neengka'l poakumpoathu ve'rumaiyaayp poavathillai.

ovvoru sthireeyum, thanthan ayalakaththaa'lidaththilum thanthan veettil thangkuki'rava'lidaththilum, ve'l'liyudaimaika'laiyum ponnudaimaika'laiyum vasthirangka'laiyum keattu vaangkuvaa'l; avaika'lai ungka'l kumaararukkum ungka'l kumaaraththika'lukkum tharippiththu, ekipthiyaraik ko'l'laiyiduveerka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea: avarka'l ennai nampaarka'l; en vaakkukkuch sevikodaarka'l; karththar unakkuth tharisanamaakavillai en'ru solluvaarka'l en'raan.
karththar avanai noakki: un kaiyilirukki'rathu enna en'raar. oru koal en'raan.
athaith tharaiyilea poadu en'raar; avan athaith tharaiyilea poattapoathu, athu sarppamaayit'ru; moasea atha'rku vilakiyoadinaan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: un kaiyai neetti, athin vaalaip pidi en'raar; avan than kaiyai neetti, athaip pidiththapoathu, athu avan kaiyilea koalaayit'ru.

aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin theavanum yaakkoapin theavanumaayirukki'ra thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar unakkuth tharisanamaanathai avarka'l nampuvatha'rku ithuvea adaiyaa'lam en'raar.

mealum, karththar avanai noakki: un kaiyai un madiyilea poadu en'raar; avan than kaiyaith than madiyilea poattu, athai ve'liyea edukkumpoathu, ithoa, avan kai u'raintha mazhaiyaippoala ve'nkushdam pidiththirunthathu.

avar: un kaiyaith thirumpavum un madiyilea poadu en'raar. avan than kaiyaith thirumpath than madiyilea poattu, than madiyilirunthu athai ve'liyea eduththapoathu, athu thirumpa avanudaiya mat'rach sathaiyaippoalaayit'ru.
appozhuthu avar: munthina adaiyaa'laththai avarka'l ka'ndu, unnai nampaamalum unakkuch sevikodaamalum poanaal, pinthina adaiyaa'laththaik ka'ndu nampuvaarka'l.

ivvira'ndu adaiyaa'langka'laiyum avarka'l nampaamalum, un vaakkukkuch sevikodaamalum iruppaarka'laanaal, appozhuthu nee nathiyin tha'n'neerai mo'ndu nilaththil oot'ruvaayaaka; nathiyil mo'nda tha'n'neer vettaantharaiyilea iraththamaakum en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea karththarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, itha'rku munnaavathu, theavareer umathu adiyeanoadea peasinatha'rkup pinnaavathu naan vaakkuvallavan alla; naan thikkuvaayum manthanaavum u'l'lavan en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar avanai noakki: manushanukku vaayai u'ndaakkinavar yaar? oomaiyanaiyum sevidanaiyum paarvaiyu'l'lavanaiyum kurudanaiyum u'ndaakkinavar yaar? karththaraakiya naan allavaa?
aathalaal, nee poa; naan un vaayoadea irunthu, nee peasavea'ndiyathai unakkup poathippean en'raar.
atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, neer anuppach siththamaayirukki'ra yaaraiyaakilum anuppum en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayinmeal koapammoo'ndavaraaki: leaviyanaakiya aaroan un sakoatharan allavaa? avan nan'raayp peasuki'ravan en'ru a'rivean; avan unnaich santhikkap pu'rappattuvaruki'raan; unnaik kaa'numpoathu avan iruthayam makizhum.
nee avanoadea peasi, avan vaayil vaarththaika'laip poadu; naan un vaayilum avan vaayilum irunthu, neengka'l seyyavea'ndiyathai ungka'lukku u'narththuvean.
avan unakkup pathilaaka janangka'loadea peasuvaan; ivvithamaay avan unakku vaayaaka iruppaan; nee avanukkuth theavanaaka iruppaay.
inthak koalaiyum un kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndupoa, ithanaal nee adaiyaa'langka'laich seyvaay en'raar.

moasea than maamanaakiya eththiroavinidaththukku vanthu: naan ekipthilirukki'ra en sakoathararidaththukkuth thirumpippoay, avarka'l innum uyiroadea irukki'raarka'laa en'ru paarkkumpadip pu'rappattuppoaka uththaravu tharavea'ndum en'raan. appozhuthu eththiroa moaseayai noakki: sukamaayp poayvaarum en'raan.
pinnum karththar meethiyaanilea moaseayai noakki: nee ekipthukkuth thirumpip poa, un piraa'nanai vaangkath theadina manithar ellaarum i'ranthupoanaarka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea than manaiviyaiyum than pi'l'laika'laiyum kazhuthaiyinmeal eat'rikko'ndu, ekipthu theasaththukkuth thirumpinaan; theavanudaiya koalaiyum moasea than kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndupoanaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee ekipthilea thirumpippoaych searnthapin, naan un kaiyil a'liththirukki'ra a'rputhangka'l yaavaiyum paarvoanukku munpaakach seyyumpadi echcharikkaiyaayiru; aakilum, naan avan iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththuvean; avan janaththaip poakavidaan.
appozhuthu nee paarvoanoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal ennudaiya kumaaran, en seashdapuththiran.

enakku aaraathanai seyyumpadi en kumaaranai anuppividu en'ru katta'laiyiduki'rean; avanai vidamaattean enpaayaakil naan unnudaiya kumaaranai, un seashdapuththiranaich sangkarippean en'ru karththar sonnaar en'ru sol en'raar.
vazhiyilea thangkum idaththil karththar avanukku ethirppattu, avanaik kollappaarththaar.
appozhuthu sippoaraa'l karukkaana oru kallai eduththu, than puththiranudaiya nuniththoalai a'ruththu, athai avan kaalka'lukku munpaaka e'rinthu: neer enakku iraththasampanthamaana purushan en'raa'l.
pinpu avar avanaivittu vilakinaar. appozhuthu ava'l: viruththaseathanaththinimiththam neer enakku iraththasampanthamaana purushan en'raa'l.
karththar aaroanai noakki: nee vanaantharaththil moaseakku ethirko'ndupoa en'raar. avan poay, theavaparvathaththil avanaich santhiththu, avanai muththagnseythaan.
appozhuthu moasea thannai anuppina karththarudaiya sakala vaarththaika'laiyum avar thanakkuk katta'laiyitta sakala adaiyaa'langka'laiyum aaroanukkuth theriviththaan.
moaseayum aaroanum poay, israveal puththirarin mooppar ellaaraiyum koodivarach seythaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuch solliya sakala vaarththaika'laiyum aaroan solli, janangka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka antha adaiyaa'langka'laiyum seythaan.

janangka'l visuvaasiththaarka'l; karththar israveal puththiraraich santhiththaar en'rum, avarka'l padum upaththiravangka'laik ka'n'noakkippaarththaar en'rum, avarka'l keattapoathu, thalaikuninthuth thozhuthuko'ndaarka'l.

pinpu, moaseayum aaroanum paarvoanidaththil poay: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar vanaantharaththilea enakkup pa'ndikai ko'ndaadumpadi en janangka'laip poakavidavea'ndum en'ru solluki'raar en'raarka'l.
atha'rkup paarvoan: naan isravealaip poakavidak karththarin vaarththaiyaik keadki'ratha'rku avar yaar? naan karththarai a'riyean; naan isravealaip poakaviduvathillai en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l: epireyarudaiya theavan engka'laich santhiththaar; naangka'l vanaantharaththil moon'runaa'l pirayaa'nam poay, engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidumpadi poakavidavea'ndum; poakaathirunthaal, avar ko'l'lainoayum pattayamum engka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvaar en'raarka'l.
ekipthin raajaa avarka'lai noakki: moaseayum aaroanumaakiya neengka'l janangka'laith thangka'l vealaika'lai vittuk kalaiyappa'n'nuki'rathu enna? ungka'l sumaika'laich sumakkappoangka'l en'raan.
pinnum paarvoan: ithoa, theasaththil janangka'l mikuthiyaayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l sumai sumakki'rathai vittu oaynthirukkumpadi seyki'reerka'lea en'raan.
an'riyum, annaa'lilea paarvoan janangka'lin aa'loattika'laiyum avarka'l thalaivaraiyum noakki:
sengkal vealaikku neengka'l munpoala ini janangka'lukku vaikkoal kodukkavea'ndaam; avarka'l thaangka'lea poayth thangka'lukku vaikkoal searkkattum.

avarka'l mun seythukoduththa ka'nakkinpadiyea sengkal seyyumpadi sollungka'l; athilea neengka'l on'rum ku'raikkavea'ndaam, avarka'l soampalaayirukki'raarka'l; athinaal naangka'l poay engka'l theavanukkup paliyiduvoam en'ru kookkuraliduki'raarka'l.
antha manitharmeal munnilum athikavealaiyaich sumaththungka'l, athil avarka'l kashdappadattum; vee'nvaarththaika'lukku avarka'l sevikodukka vidaathirungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan.
appozhuthu janangka'lin aa'loattika'lum avarka'l thalaivarka'lum pu'rappattuppoay janangka'lai noakki: ungka'lukku vaikkoal koduppathillai;
neengka'lea poay ungka'lukku akappaduki'ra idangka'lil vaikkoal sampaathiyungka'l; aanaalum ungka'l vealaiyil on'rum ku'raikkappaduvathillai en'ru paarvoan solluki'raar en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu vaikkoalukkup pathilaakath thaa'ladika'laich searkkumpadi janangka'l ekipthu theasam engkum sitha'rippoanaarka'l.
aa'loattika'l avarka'lai noakki: vaikkoaliruntha naa'lil seythapadiyea ungka'l vealaika'lai ovvoru naa'lilum seythu mudiyungka'l en'ru solli, avarka'laith thurithappaduththinaarka'l.

paarvoanudaiya aa'loattika'l israveal puththirarmeal vaiththa avarka'ludaiya thalaivarka'lai noakki: sengkal vealaiyil neengka'l munseythathupoala neat'rum in'rum ean seyyavillai en'ru keattu, avarka'lai adiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu israveal puththirarin thalaivar paarvoanidaththil poaych saththamittu: umathu adiyaarukku neer ippadich seyki'rathu enna?

umathu adiyaarukku vaikkoal kodaathirunthum, sengkal a'ruththuth theeravea'ndum en'ru engka'lukkuch solluki'raarka'l; ummudaiya janangka'lidaththil kut'ram irukka, umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l adikkappaduki'roam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l soampalaayirukki'reerka'l, soampalaayirukki'reerka'l; athinaalthaan poakavea'ndum, karththarukkup paliyidavea'ndum enki'reerka'l.
poay, vealaiseyyungka'l, ungka'lukku vaikkoal kodukkappaduvathillai; aanaalum ka'nakkinpadiyea neengka'l sengkalai oppuvikkavea'ndum en'raan.

neengka'l ovvoru naa'lilum a'ruththuth theeravea'ndiya sengkalilea on'rum ku'raikkappadaathu en'ru sollappattathinaalea, israveal puththirarin thalaivar thangka'lukku ikkattu vanthathu en'ru ka'ndaarka'l.
avarka'l paarvoanudaiya samukaththai vittup pu'rappadukaiyil, vazhiyil nin'ra moaseakkum aaroanukkum ethirppattu,

avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l paarvoanin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum avarudaiya oozhiyakkaararin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum engka'l vaasanaiyaik keduththu, engka'laik kollumpadi avarka'l kaiyilea pattayaththaik koduththathinimiththam, karththar ungka'laip paarththu niyaayantheerkkakkadavar en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea karththaridaththil thirumpippoay: aa'ndavarea, intha janangka'lukkuth theengkuvarappa'n'ninathenna? ean ennai anuppineer?

naan umathu naamaththaikko'ndu peasumpadi paarvoanidaththil piraveasiththathumuthal avan intha janangka'lai upaththiravappaduththuki'raan; neer ummudaiya janangka'lai viduthalaiyaakkavillaiyea en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: naan paarvoanukkuch seyvathai ippozhuthu kaa'npaay; palaththa kaiyaik ka'ndu avarka'laip poakavittu, palaththa kaiyaik ka'ndu avarka'laith than theasaththilirunthu thuraththividuvaan en'raar.
mealum, theavan moaseayai noakki: naan yeakoavaa,
sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavan ennum naamaththinaal naan aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum tharisanamaanean; aanaalum yeakoavaa ennum en naamaththinaal naan avarka'lukku a'riyappadavillai.
avarka'l paratheasika'laayth thangkina theasamaakiya kaanaantheasaththai avarka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru naan avarka'loadea en udanpadikkaiyaiyum ea'rpaduththiyirukki'rean.
ekipthiyar adimaiko'l'luki'ra israveal puththirarin perumoochchaiyum naan keattu, en udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththean.

aathalaal, israveal puththirarai noakki: naanea karththar; ungka'lmeal ekipthiyar sumaththina sumaika'lai neekki naan ungka'lai viduviththu, ungka'lai avarka'l adimaiththanaththi'rku neengkalaakki, oangkiya kaiyinaalum, makaa tha'ndanaika'linaalum ungka'lai meettu,

ungka'lai enakku janangka'laakach searththukko'ndu, ungka'lukku theavanaayiruppean; ungka'lmeal ekipthiyar sumaththina sumaika'lai neekki ungka'lai viduvikki'ra ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar naan en'ru a'riveerka'l.

aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum koduppean en'ru naan aa'naiyitta theasaththil ungka'laik ko'ndupoay, athai ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduppean; naan karththar en'ru avarka'lukkuch sol en'raar.
inthappirakaaramaaka moasea israveal puththirarukkuch sonnaan; avarka'loa manamadivinaalum kodumaiyaana vealaiyinaalum moaseakkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaarka'l.
pinpu, karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanidaththil poay, avan than theasaththilirunthu israveal puththiraraip poakavidumpadi avanoadea peasu en'raar.
moasea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil nin'ru, israveal puththirarea enakkuch sevikodukkavillai; paarvoan enakku eppadich sevikoduppaan? naan viruththaseathanamillaatha uthaduka'lu'l'lavan en'raan.

karththar moaseayoadum aaroanoadum peasi, israveal puththirarai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu azhaiththukko'ndu poakumpadikku, avarka'lai israveal puththiraridaththukkum ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanidaththukkum katta'laikoduththu anuppinaar.

avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'l veettaarin thalaivar yaaren'raal, isravealukku muthal pi'ranthavanaakiya roopanudaiya kumaarar aanoakku, palloo, esroan, karmee; ivarka'l roopanudaiya vamsangka'lin thalaivar.
simiyoanin kumaarar emuveal, yaamin, oakaath, yaakeen, soakaar, kaanaaniya sthireeyin kumaaranaakiya savul; simiyoanudaiya vamsangka'lin thalaivar ivarka'lea.
u'rpaththikkiramappadi pi'rantha leaviyin kumaararudaiya naamangka'laavana, kersoan, koakaath, meraari enpavaika'l. leavi noot'ru muppaththeazhu varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
avaravar vamsangka'linpadi pi'rantha kersoanin kumaarar lipnee, simeayee enpavarka'l.
koakaaththin kumaarar amraam, ithseayaar, eproan, oosiyeal enpavarka'l; koakaath noot'ru muppaththumoon'ru varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
meraariyin kumaarar makeali, moosi enpavarka'l; avaravar santhathiyinpadi leaviyinudaiya vamsangka'lin thalaivar ivarka'lea.
amraam than aththaiyaakiya yoakepeaththai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; ava'l avanukku aaroanaiyum moaseayaiyum pet'raa'l; amraam noot'rumuppaththeazhu varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
ithseayaarin kumaarar koaraaku, neppeak, sithri enpavarka'l.
oosiyealin kumaarar meesaveal, elsaapaan, sithri enpavarka'l.
aaroan amminathaapin kumaaraththiyum nakasoanin sakoathariyumaakiya elisapaa'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; iva'l avanukku naathaapaiyum, apiyoovaiyum, eleayaasaaraiyum, iththaamaaraiyum pet'raa'l.
koaraakin kumaarar aaseer, elkkaanaa, apiyaasaap enpavarka'l; koaraakiyarin vamsaththalaivar ivarka'lea.

aaroanin kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaar pooththiyealudaiya kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ninaan, ava'l avanukkup pinekaasaip pet'raa'l; avaravar vamsangka'linpadi leaviyarudaiya pithaakka'laakiya thalaivar ivarka'lea.
israveal puththirarai a'niya'niyaay ekipthu theasaththilirunthu nadaththikko'ndupoavatha'rkuk karththaraal katta'laipet'ra aaroanum moaseayum ivarka'lea.
israveal puththirarai ekipthilirunthu nadaththikko'ndupoavatha'rku, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanoadea peasina moaseayum aaroanum ivarka'lea.
karththar ekipthutheasaththilea moaseayoadea peasina naa'lil;
karththar moaseayai noakki: naanea karththar; naan unnoadea solluki'ravaika'laiyellaam nee ekipthu raajaavaakiya paarvoanukkuch sol en'ru sonnapoathu,
moasea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil: naan viruththaseathanamillaatha uthaduka'lu'l'lavan; paarvoan enakku eppadich sevikoduppaan en'raan.
karththar moaseayai noakki: paar, unnai naan paarvoanukku theavanaakkinean; un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan un theerkkatharisiyaayiruppaan.
naan unakkuk katta'laiyidum yaavaiyum nee sollavea'ndum; paarvoan israveal puththiraraith than theasaththilirunthu anuppividumpadi un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan avanidaththil peasavea'ndum.
naan paarvoanin iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththi, ekipthu theasaththil en adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum mikuthiyaay nadappippean.

paarvoan ungka'lukkuch sevikodukkamaattaan; aakaiyaal ekipthukku viroathamaaka naan en kaiyai neetti, makaa tha'ndanaiyinaal en seanaika'lum en janangka'lumaakiya israveal puththirarai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nuvean.
naan ekipthinmeal en kaiyai neetti, israveal puththirarai avarka'l naduvilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'numpoathu, naanea karththar en'ru ekipthiyar a'rivaarka'l en'raar.
moaseayum aaroanum karththar thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythaarka'l.
avarka'l paarvoanoadea peasumpoathu, moaseakku e'npathu vayathum, aaroanukku e'npaththumoon'ru vayathumaayirunthathu.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:

ungka'l padchaththi'rku oru a'rputham kaattungka'l en'ru paarvoan ungka'loadea sonnaal; appozhuthu nee aaroanai noakki: un koalai eduththu athaip paarvoanukku munpaakap poadu enpaayaaka; athu sarppamaakum en'raar.

moaseayum aaroanum paarvoanidaththil poay, karththar thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadi seythaarka'l. aaroan paarvoanukku munpaakavum, avan oozhiyakkaararukku munpaakavum than koalaip poattaan, athu sarppamaayit'ru.
appozhuthu paarvoan saasthirika'laiyum sooniyakkaararaiyum azhaippiththaan. ekipthin manthiravaathika'lum thangka'l manthiraviththaiyinaal appadich seythaarka'l.
avarka'l ovvoruvanaakath than than koalaip poattapoathu, avaika'l sarppangka'laayina; aaroanudaiya koaloa avarka'ludaiya koalka'lai vizhungkit'ru.
karththar solliyirunthapadi paarvoanin iruthayam kadinappattathu, avarka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: paarvoanin iruthayam kadinamaayit'ru; janangka'lai vidamaattean enki'raan.
kaalamea nee paarvoanidaththukkup poa, avan nathikkup pu'rappattu varuvaan; nee avanukku ethiraaka nathiyoaraththilea nin'ru, sarppamaaka maa'rina koalai un kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu,

avanai noakki: vanaantharaththil enakku aaraathanaiseyya en janangka'lai anuppividavea'ndum en'ru sollumpadi epireyarudaiya theavanaakiya karththar ennai ummidaththukku anuppiyum, ithuvaraikkum neer kea'laama'rpoaneer.
ithoa, en kaiyil irukki'ra koalinaal nathiyil irukki'ra tha'n'neermeal adippean; appozhuthu athu iraththamaay maa'ri,

nathiyil irukki'ra meenka'l seththu, nathi naa'rippoam; appozhuthu nathiyil irukki'ra tha'n'neerai ekipthiyar kudikkakkoodaamal aroasippaarka'l; ithinaal naanea karththar enpathai a'rinthuko'lvaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

mealum, karththar moaseayai noakki: nee aaroanidaththil un koalai eduththukko'ndu ekipthin neernilaika'laakiya avarka'l vaaykkaalka'lmealum nathika'lmealum ku'langka'lmealum tha'n'neer ni'rki'ra ellaa idangka'lmealum, avaika'l iraththamaakumpadikku, un kaiyai neettu; appozhuthu ekipthu theasam engkum marappaaththirangka'lilum ka'rpaaththirangka'lilum iraththam u'ndaayirukkum en'ru sol en'raar.

karththar katta'laiyittapadi moaseayum aaroanum seythaarka'l; paarvoanudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum, avan oozhiyakkaararin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum koalai oangki, nathiyilu'l'la tha'n'neerai adikka, nathiyilu'l'la tha'n'neerellaam iraththamaay maa'rippoayit'ru.
nathiyin meenka'l seththu, nathi naa'rippoayit'ru; nathiyin tha'n'neeraik kudikka ekipthiyarukkuk koodaama'rpoayit'ru; ekipthu theasam engkum iraththamaayirunthathu.
ekipthin manthiravaathika'lum thangka'l manthiraviththaiyinaal appadich seythaarka'l; karththar solliyirunthapadi paarvoanin iruthayam kadinappattathu; avarka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan.
paarvoan ithaiyum sinthiyaamal, than veetti'rkuth thirumpippoanaan.
nathiyin tha'n'neer kudikka uthavaathapadiyaal, kudikkaththakka tha'n'neerukkaaka ekipthiyar ellaarum nathiyoaraththil oot'ruth thoa'ndinaarka'l.
karththar nathiyai adiththu eazhunaa'l aayit'ru.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee paarvoanidaththil poay: enakku aaraathanaiseyya en janangka'lai anuppividu.
nee avarka'lai anuppividamaattean enpaayaakil, un ellai adangkalaiyum thava'laika'laal vaathippean.

nathi thava'laika'laith thira'laayp pi'rappikkum; avaika'l un veettilum un padukkai a'raiyilum, un magnchaththin mealum, un oozhiyakkaarar veeduka'lilum, un janangka'lidaththilum, un aduppuka'lilum, maappisaiki'ra un thottika'lilum vanthu ea'rum.
anthath thava'laika'l unmealum, un janangka'lmealum, un oozhiyakkaarar ellaarmealum vanthu ea'rum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

mealum karththar moaseayinidaththil nee aaroanai noakki: nee un kaiyil irukki'ra koalai nathika'lmealum vaaykkaalka'lmealum ku'langka'lmealum neetti, ekipthu theasaththinmeal thava'laika'lai varumpadi sey en'ru sol en'raar.
appadiyea aaroan than kaiyai ekipthilu'l'la tha'n'neerka'lmeal neettinaan; appozhuthu thava'laika'l vanthu, ekipthu theasaththai moodikko'ndathu.
manthiravaathika'lum thangka'l manthiraviththaiyinaal appadich seythu, ekipthu theasaththinmeal thava'laika'lai varappa'n'ninaarka'l.

paarvoan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum azhaippiththu: anthath thava'laika'l ennaiyum en janangka'laiyum vittu neengkumpadi karththarai noakki vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; karththarukkup paliyidumpadi janangka'laip poakaviduvean en'raan.

appozhuthu moasea paarvoanai noakki: thava'laika'l nathiyileamaaththiram irukkaththakkathaay avaika'lai ummidaththilum ummudaiya veettilum illaamal ozhinthupoakumpadi seyya, umakkaakavum ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkaakavum ummudaiya janangka'lukkaakavum naan vi'n'nappampa'n'navea'ndiya kaalaththaik ku'rikkum meanmai umakkea iruppathaaka en'raan.
atha'rku avan: naa'laikku en'raan. appozhuthu ivan: engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku oppaanavar illai enpathai neer a'riyumpadikku ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi aakakkadavathu.
thava'laika'l ummaiyum ummudaiya veettaiyum ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararaiyum ummudaiya janangka'laiyum vittu neengki, nathiyilea maaththiram irukkum en'raan.
moaseayum aaroanum paarvoanaivittup pu'rappattaarka'l. paarvoanukku viroathamaaka varappa'n'nina thava'laika'lnimiththam moasea karththarai noakkik kooppittaan.
karththar moaseayin so'rpadi seythaar; veeduka'lilum mut'rangka'lilum vayalka'lilum iruntha thava'laika'l seththuppoayit'ru.
avaika'laik kuviyal kuviyalaakach searththaarka'l; athinaal poomiyengkum naat'ram eduththathu.
ilakuvu'ndaayit'ren'ru paarvoan ka'ndapoathoa, than iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththi, avarka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan; karththar solliyirunthapadi aayit'ru.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayinidaththil: nee aaroanai noakki: un koalai neetti, poomiyin puzhuthiyinmeal adi; appozhuthu athu ekipthu theasam engkum peanka'laayp poam en'ru sol en'raar.

appadiyea seythaarka'l; aaroan than kaiyil iruntha than koalai neetti, poomiyin puzhuthiyinmeal adiththaan; appozhuthu athu manitharmealum mirukajeevanka'lmealum peanka'laay ekipthutheasam engkum poomiyin puzhuthiyellaam peanka'laayit'ru.

manthiravaathika'lum thangka'l manthiraviththaiyinaal peanka'laip pi'rappikkumpadip pirayaththanagnseythaarka'l; seythum, avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru; peanka'l manitharmealum mirukajeevanka'lmealum irunthathu.

appozhuthu manthiravaathika'l paarvoanai noakki: ithu theavanudaiya viral en'raarka'l. aanaalum, karththar solliyirunthapadi paarvoanudaiya iruthayam kadinappattathu; avarka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: naa'lai athikaalamea nee ezhunthu poay, paarvoan nathikkup pu'rappattu varumpoathu, avanukku munpaaka nin'ru: enakku aaraathanai seyyumpadi en janangka'laip poakavidu.

en janangka'laip poakavidaayaakil, naan unmealum, un oozhiyakkaararmealum, un janangka'lmealum, un veeduka'lmealum palavitha va'nduka'lai anuppuvean; ekipthiyar veeduka'lum avarka'l irukki'ra theasamum antha va'nduka'laal ni'raiyum.
poomiyin naduvil naanea karththar enpathai nee a'riyumpadi en janangka'l irukki'ra koasean naattil annaa'lilea va'nduka'l varaathapadikku, antha naattai viseashappaduththi,
en janangka'lukkum un janangka'lukkum viththiyaasam u'ndaakumpadi seyvean; intha adaiyaa'lam naa'laikku u'ndaakum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

appadiyea karththar seythaar; makaa thira'laana va'ndu jaathika'l paarvoan veettilum, avan oozhiyakkaarar veeduka'lilum, ekipthu theasam muzhuvathilum vanthathu; va'nduka'linaalea theasam kettuppoayit'ru.
appozhuthu paarvoan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum azhaippiththu: neengka'l poay, ungka'l theavanukku theasaththileathaanea paliyidungka'l en'raan.

atha'rku moasea: appadich seyyaththakaathu; engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku naangka'l ekipthiyarudaiya aruvaruppaip paliyiduki'rathaayirukkumea, ekipthiyarudaiya aruvaruppai naangka'l avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakap paliyittaal, engka'laik kalle'rivaarka'l allavaa?
naangka'l vanaantharaththil moon'runaa'l pirayaa'nampoay, engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukku vithikki'rapadiyea avarukkup paliyiduvoam en'raan.

appozhuthu paarvoan: neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku vanaantharaththil paliyidumpadikku, naan ungka'laip poakaviduvean; aanaalum, neengka'l athika thooramaayp poakavea'ndaam; enakkaaka vea'nduthal seyyungka'l en'raan.

atha'rku moasea: naan ummai vittup pu'rappattapin, naa'laikku va'nduka'l paarvoanaiyum avar oozhiyakkaararaiyum avar janangka'laiyum vittu neengkumpadi, naan karththarai noakki vea'nduthal seyvean; aanaalum, karththarukkup paliyiduki'ratha'rku janangka'laip poakavidaathapadip paarvoan ini vagnchanai seyyaathiruppaaraaka en'raan.
moasea paarvoanai vittup pu'rappattuppoay, karththarai noakki vea'nduthal seythaan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayin so'rpadi, va'ndu jaathika'l paarvoanaiyum avan oozhiyakkaararaiyum avan janangka'laiyum vittu neengkumpadi seythaar; on'raakilum meenthirukkavillai.
paarvoanoa, intha mu'raiyum than iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththi, janangka'laip poakavidaathirunthaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseayai noakki: nee paarvoanidaththil poay: enakku aaraathanaiseyya en janangka'laip poakavidu.
nee avarka'lai vidamaattean en'ru innum ni'ruththivaiththaayaakil,

karththarudaiya karam ve'liyilirukki'ra un mirukajeevanka'laakiya kuthiraika'linmealum kazhuthaika'linmealum ottakangka'linmealum aadumaaduka'linmealum irukkum; makaa kodithaana ko'l'lainoay u'ndaakum.
karththar isravealarin mirukajeevanka'lukkum ekipthiyarin mirukajeevanka'lukkum viththiyaasam pa'n'nuvaar; israveal puththirarukku uriyavaika'l ellaavat'rilum on'rum saavathillai en'raar.

mealum, naa'laikkuk karththar inthak kaariyaththai theasaththil seyvaar en'ru solli, karththar oru kaalaththaik ku'riththaar en'rum, epireyarudaiya theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'rum avanidaththil sol en'raar.
ma'runaa'lil karththar anthak kaariyaththaich seythaar; ekipthiyarudaiya mirukajeevanka'l ellaam seththuppoayit'ru; israveal puththirarin mirukajeevanka'lil on'raakilum saakavillai.
paarvoan visaariththu, isravealarin mirukajeevanka'lil on'raakilum saakavillai en'ru a'rinthaan. paarvoanudaiya iruthayamoa kadinappattathu; avan janangka'laip poakavidavillai.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki: ungka'l kaippidi ni'raiya soo'laiyin saampalai a'l'lik ko'l'lungka'l; moasea athaip paarvoanudaiya ka'nka'lukkumun vaanaththi'rku nearaaka i'raikkakkadavan.
athu ekipthu theasam meethengkum thoosiyaaki, ekipthu theasamengkum manitharmealum mirukajeevanka'lmealum eripanthamaana koppu'langka'lai ezhumpappa'n'num en'raar.

appadiyea avarka'l soo'laiyin saampalai a'l'likko'ndu, paarvoanukku munpaaka vanthu nin'raarka'l. moasea athai vaanaththukku nearaaka i'raiththaan; appozhuthu manitharmealum mirukajeevanka'lmealum eripanthamaana koppu'langka'l ezhumpit'ru.
anthak koppu'langka'l manthiravaathika'lmealum ekipthiyar ellaarmealum u'ndaanathinaal, anthak koppu'langka'linimiththam manthiravaathika'lum moaseakku munpaaka ni'rkakkoodaathirunthathu.
aanaalum, karththar moaseayoadea solliyirunthapadiyea, karththar paarvoanin iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaar; avan avarka'lukkuch sevikodukkavillai.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee athikaalamea ezhunthirunthu poay, paarvoanukku munpaaka nin'ru: enakku aaraathanaiseyya en janangka'lai anuppividu.

vidaathirunthaal, poomiyengkum ennaippoala vea'roruvarum illai enpathai nee a'riyumpadikku, inthamu'rai naan sakalavitha vaathaika'laiyum un iruthayaththilum, un oozhiyakkaararmealum un janangka'lmealum anuppuvean.
nee poomiyil iraamal naasamaayp poakumpadi naan en kaiyai neetti, unnaiyum un janangka'laiyum ko'l'lai noayinaal vaathippean.
ennudaiya vallamaiyai unnidaththil kaa'npikkumpadiyaakavum, en naamam poomiyilengkum pirasthaapamaakumpadiyaakavum unnai nilaini'ruththinean.
nee en janangka'laip poakavidaamal, innum avarka'lukku viroathamaay unnai uyarththuki'raayaa?
ekipthu thoan'riya naa'lmuthal ithuvaraikkum athil peyyaatha mikavum kodiya kalmazhaiyai naa'lai innearam peyyappa'n'nuvean.

ippozhuthea aa'l anuppi, un mirukajeevanka'laiyum ve'liyil unakku irukki'ra yaavaiyum searththukko'l; veettilea searkkappadaamal ve'liyilirukkum ovvoru manithanum mirukamum seththuppoakaththakkathaay anthak kalmazhai peyyum en'ru epireyarin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'ru avanukkuch sol en'raar.
paarvoanudaiya oozhiyakkaararil evan karththarudaiya vaarththaikkup payappattaanoa, avan than vealaikkaararaiyum than mirukajeevanka'laiyum veeduka'lukku oadivarappa'n'ninaan.
evan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai mathiyaama'rpoanaanoa, avan than vealaikkaararaiyum than mirukajeevanka'laiyum ve'liyilea vittuvittaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: ekipthu theasam engkum manitharmealum mirukajeevanka'lmealum ekipthu theasaththilirukki'ra sakalavithamaana payirvakaika'lmealum kalmazhai peyya, un kaiyai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka neettu en'raar.

appadiyea moasea than koalai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka neettinaan. appozhuthu karththar idimuzhakkangka'laiyum kalmazhaiyaiyum anuppinaar; akkini tharaiyinmeal veakamaay oadit'ru; ekipthu theasaththinmeal karththar kalmazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'ninaar;
kalmazhaiyum kalmazhaiyoadea kalantha akkiniyum mikavum kodithaayirunthathu; ekipthu theasam kudiyeat'rappatta naa'lmuthal athil appadi orupoathum u'ndaanathillai.

ekipthu theasam engkum manitharaiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum, ve'liyilea irunthavaika'l evaika'loa avaika'l ellaavat'raiyum anthak kalmazhai azhiththuppoattathu; athu ve'liyin payirvakaika'laiyellaam azhiththu, ve'liyin marangka'laiyellaam mu'riththuppoattathu.
israveal puththirar iruntha koasean naattileamaaththiram kalmazhai illaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu paarvoan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum azhaippiththu: naan intha mu'rai paavam seythean; karththar neethiyu'l'lavar; naanum en janamum thunmaarkkar.
ithu poathum; intha makaa idimuzhakkangka'lum kalmazhaiyum ozhiyumpadikku, karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nungka'l; naan ungka'laip poakaviduvean, ini ungka'lukkuth thadaiyillai en'raan.

moasea avanai noakki: naan patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappattavudanea, en kaika'laik karththarukku nearaaka virippean; appozhuthu idimuzhakkangka'l oaynthu kalmazhai nin'rupoam; athinaal poomi karththarudaiyathu enpathai neer a'riveer.
aakilum neerum ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararum innum theavanaakiya karththarukkup payappadamaatteerka'l enpathai a'rivean en'raan.
appozhuthu vaa'rkoathumai kathirppayirum sa'nal thaa'lppayirumaayirunthathu; athinaal sa'nalum vaa'rkoathumaiyum azhikkappattuppoayit'ru.
koathumaiyum kampum kathirvidaathirunthathaal, avaika'l azhikkappadavillai.

moasea paarvoanaivittup patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappattu, than kaika'laik karththarukku nearaaka viriththaan; appozhuthu idimuzhakkamum kalmazhaiyum nin'rathu; mazhaiyum poomiyil peyyaamalirunthathu.
mazhaiyum kalmazhaiyum idimuzhakkamum nin'rupoanathaip paarvoan ka'ndapoathu, avanum avan oozhiyakkaararum pinnum paavamseythu, thangka'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaarka'l.
karththar moaseayaikko'ndu solliyirunthapadiyea, paarvoanin iruthayam kadinappattathu; avan israveal puththiraraip poakavidavillai.
pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee paarvoanidaththil poa, avarka'l naduvea naan intha en adaiyaa'langka'laich seyyumpadikkum,

naan ekipthilea nadappiththathaiyum naan avarka'lukku'l seytha en adaiyaa'langka'laiyum, nee un pi'l'laika'lin sevika'l keadkavum, un pi'l'laika'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lin sevika'l keadkavum vivariththuch sollumpadikkum, naanea karththar enpathai neengka'l a'riyumpadikkum, naan avan iruthayaththaiyum avan oozhiyakkaararin iruthayaththaiyum kadinappaduththinean en'raar.
appadiyea moaseayum aaroanum paarvoanidaththil vanthu: unnaith thaazhththa nee ethuvaraikkum manathillaathiruppaay? en samukaththil enakku aaraathanaiseyya en janangka'laip poakavidu.
nee en janangka'laip poakavidamaattean enpaayaakil, naan naa'laikku un ellaika'lukku'l'lea vettukki'lika'lai varappa'n'nuvean.
tharai kaa'naathapadikku avaika'l poomiyin mukaththai moodi, kalmazhaikkuth thappi meethiyaaka vaikkappattathaip padchiththu, ve'liyilea thu'lirkki'ra sedika'laiyellaam thin'rupoadum.

un veeduka'lum un oozhiyakkaararudaiya veeduka'lum ekipthiyarin veeduka'lum ellaam avaika'laal nirampum; un pithaakka'lum un pithaakka'lin pithaakka'lum thaangka'l poomiyil thoan'rina naa'lmuthal innaa'lvaraikkum appadippattavaika'laik ka'ndathillai en'ru epireyarin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'ru solli, thirumpikko'ndu paarvoanai vittup pu'rappattaan.

appozhuthu paarvoanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: enthamattum intha manithan namakkuk ka'n'niyaayiruppaan? thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku aaraathanaiseyya antha manitharaip poakavidum; ekipthu azhinthupoanathai neer innum a'riyavillaiyaa en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu moaseayum aaroanum paarvoanidaththukkuth thirumpa azhaikkappattaarka'l. avan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l poay ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku aaraathanai seyyungka'l en'ru solli; yaaraar poaki'raarka'l en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku moasea: engka'l i'laignaroadum, engka'l muthiyoaroadum, engka'l kumaararoadum, engka'l kumaaraththika'loadum, engka'l aaduka'laiyum engka'l maaduka'laiyum koottikko'ndupoavoam; naangka'l karththarukkup pa'ndikai ko'ndaadavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: naan ungka'laiyum ungka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyum eppadi viduveanoa, appadiyea karththar ungka'loadiruppaaraaka; echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, ungka'lukkup pollaappu nearidum;

appadi vea'ndaam; purusharaakiya neengka'l poay, karththarukku aaraathanai seyyungka'l; ithuthaanea neengka'l virumpik keattathu en'ru sonnaan. avarka'l paarvoan samukaththinin'ru thuraththividappattaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: vettukki'lika'l ekipthu theasaththinmeal vanthu, kalmazhaiyinaal azhiyaatha poomiyin payirvakaika'laiyellaam padchikkumpadikku, ekipthu theasaththinmeal un kaiyai neettu en'raar.

appadiyea moasea than koalai ekipthu theasaththinmeal neettinaan; appozhuthu karththar an'ru pakal muzhuvathum an'ru iraamuzhuvathum keezhkkaat'raith theasaththinmeal veesappa'n'ninaar; vidiya'rkaalaththilea keezhkkaat'ru vettukki'lika'laik ko'nduvanthathu.
vettukki'lika'l ekipthu theasam engkum parampi, ekipthin ellaiyil engkum mikavum earaa'lamaay i'rangkit'ru; appadippatta vettukki'lika'l atha'rkumun irunthathum illai, atha'rkuppin iruppathum illai.

avaika'l poomiyin mukam muzhuthaiyum moodit'ru; theasam avaika'laal anthakaarappattathu; kalmazhaikkuth thappiyiruntha nilaththin payirvakaika'l yaavaiyum marangka'lin kanika'l yaavaiyum avaika'l padchiththuppoattathu; ekipthu theasam engkumu'l'la marangka'lilum vayalve'liyin payirvakaika'lilum oru pachchilaiyum meethiyaayirukkavillai.
appozhuthu paarvoan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum theeviramaay azhaippiththu: ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkum ungka'lukkum viroathamaakap paavam seythean.
intha oru mu'raimaaththiram nee en paavaththai mannikkavea'ndum; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar inthach saavaimaaththiram ennaivittu vilakka avarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nungka'l en'raan.
avan paarvoanai vittup pu'rappattuppoay, karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu karththar makaa palaththa mealkaat'rai veesumpadi seythaar; athu vettukki'lika'lai adiththukko'ndupoaych sengkadalilea poattathu; ekipthin ellaiyil engkum oru vettukki'liyaakilum meethiyaayirunthathillai.
karththaroa paarvoanin iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaar; avan israveal puththiraraip poakavidavillai.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: thadavikko'ndirukkaththakkathaana iru'l ekipthu theasaththinmeal u'ndaakumpadikku, un kaiyai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka neettu en'raar.
moasea than kaiyai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka neettinaan; appozhuthu ekipthu theasam engkum moon'runaa'lmattum kaariru'l u'ndaayit'ru.
moon'runaa'lmattum oruvarai oruvar kaa'navum illai, oruvarum thammidaththaivittu ezhunthirukkavum illai; israveal puththirar yaavarukkumoavenil avarka'l vaasasthalangka'lilea ve'lichcham irunthathu.

appozhuthu paarvoan moaseayai azhaippiththu: neengka'l poayk karththarukku aaraathanaiseyyungka'l; ungka'l aaduka'lum ungka'l maaduka'lummaaththiram ni'ruththappadavea'ndum; ungka'l kuzhanthaika'l ungka'ludan poakalaam en'raan.
atha'rku moasea: naangka'l engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup padaikkum palika'laiyum sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum neer engka'l kaiyilea kodukkavea'ndum.

engka'l mirukajeevanka'lum engka'loadeakooda varavea'ndum; oru ku'lampum pinvaikkappaduvathillai; engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rku avaika'lilirunthu edukkavea'ndum; innathaikko'ndu karththarukku aaraathanai seyvoam enpathu naangka'l angkea poaych searuma'lavum engka'lukkuth theriyaathu en'raan.
karththar paarvoanudaiya iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaar; avan avarka'laip poakavida manathillaathirunthaan.
paarvoan avanai noakki: ennai vittu appaalea poa; nee ini en mukaththaik kaa'naathapadi echcharikkaiyaayiru; nee ini en mukaththaik kaa'num naa'lil saavaay en'raan.
appozhuthu moasea: neer sonnathu sari; ini naan ummudaiya mukaththaik kaa'npathillai en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: innum oru vaathaiyaip paarvoanmealum ekipthinmealum varappa'n'nuvean; atha'rkuppin avan ungka'lai ivvidaththilirunthu poakaviduvaan; samoolamaay ungka'laip poakaviduvathum allaamal, ungka'lai ivvidaththilirunthu thuraththiyum viduvaan.
ippozhuthu ovvoruvanum avanavan ayalaanidaththilum, ovvoruththiyum ava'lava'l ayalaa'lidaththilum ve'l'liyudaimaika'laiyum ponnudaimaika'laiyum keadkumpadi janangka'lukkuch sol en'raar.

appadiyea karththar janangka'lukku ekipthiyarin ka'nka'lil thayavukidaikkumpadi seythaar. moasea enpavan ekipthu theasaththil paarvoanudaiya oozhiyakkaararin paarvaikkum janangka'lin paarvaikkum mikavum periyavanaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu moasea: karththar naduraaththiriyilea naan ekipthin maththiyil pu'rappattuppoavean.

appozhuthu singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkum paarvoanudaiya thalaippi'l'laimuthal eanthiram araikkum adimaippe'n'nudaiya thalaippi'l'laivaraikkum, ekipthu theasaththilirukki'ra mutha'rpea'ranaiththum mirukajeevanka'lin thalaiyeet'ranaiththum saakum en'ru uraikki'raar en'ru sonnathuman'ri,
athinaal ekipthu theasam engkum munnum pinnum orukkaalum u'ndaakaatha periya kookkural u'ndaakum.

aanaalum karththar ekipthiyarukkum isravealarukkum pa'n'nuki'ra viththiyaasaththai neengka'l a'riyumpadikku, israveal puththirar anaivarukku'l'lum manitharmuthal mirukajeevanka'lvaraikkum oru naayaakilum than naavai asaippathillai.

appozhuthu ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararaakiya ivarka'l ellaarum ennidaththil vanthu, pa'ninthu, neeyum unnaip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'l yaavarum pu'rappattuppoangka'l en'ru solluvaarka'l; athinpin pu'rappaduvean en'ru solli, ukkiramaana koapaththoadea paarvoanai vittup pu'rappattaan.
karththar moaseayai noakki: ekipthu theasaththil en a'rputhangka'l aneakamaakumpadikku, paarvoan ungka'lukkuch sevikodukkamaattaan en'ru solliyirunthaar.

moaseayum aaroanum intha a'rputhangka'laiyellaam paarvoanukku munpaakach seythaarka'l. karththar paarvoanin iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinathinaal, avan israveal puththiraraith than theasaththilirunthu poakavidavillai.
karththar ekipthu theasaththil moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
intha maatham ungka'lukkup pirathaana maatham; ithu ungka'lukku varushaththin muthalaam maathamaayiruppathaaka.

neengka'l israveal sapaiyaar yaavaraiyum noakki: intha maatham paththaam theathiyil veettuththalaivarka'l, veettukku oru aattukkuttiyaaka, ovvoruvarum ovvoru aattukkuttiyaith therinthu ko'l'lakkadavarka'l.

oru veettil irukki'ravarka'l oru aattukkuttiyaip pusikki'ratha'rkup poathumaana pearka'laayiraama'rpoanaal, avanum avan sameepaththilirukki'ra avanudaiya ayalveettukkaaranum, thangka'lidaththilu'l'la aaththumaakka'lin ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka oru aattukkuttiyaith therinthuko'l'lavea'ndum; avanavan pusippukkuththakkathaaka ilakkam paarththu, aattukkuttiyaith therinthuko'l'lavea'ndum.
antha aattukkutti pazhuthat'rathum aa'num oru vayathu'l'lathumaay irukka vea'ndum; semma'riyaaduka'lilaavathu ve'l'laaduka'lilaavathu athaith therinthu ko'l'lalaam.
athai intha maatham pathinaalaam theathivaraikkum vaiththirunthu, israveal sapaiyin ovvoru koottaththaarum saayangkaalaththil athai adiththu,
athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, thaangka'l athaip pusikkum veettuvaasal nilaikkaalka'l ira'ndilum nilaiyin mea'rsattaththilum the'liththu,
an'ru raaththiriyilea athin maamsaththai neruppinaal suttu, pu'lippillaa appaththoadum kasappaana keeraiyoadum athaip pusikkakkadavarka'l.
pachchaiyaayum tha'n'neeril avikkappattathaayum alla; athin thalaiyaiyum athin thodaika'laiyum atha'rku'l'la yaavaiyum eakamaay neruppinaal suttathaay athaip pusippeerka'laaka.
athilea on'raiyum vidiya'rkaalammattum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, vidiya'rkaalammattum athilea meethiyaay irukki'rathai akkiniyaal sutterippeerka'laaka.

athaip pusikkavea'ndiya vithamaavathu, neengka'l ungka'l araika'lil kachchai kattikko'ndum, ungka'l kaalka'lil paatharadchai thoduththukko'ndum, ungka'l kaiyil thadi pidiththukko'ndum athaith theeviramaayp pusikkakkadaveerka'l; athu karththarudaiya paskaa.

antha raaththiriyilea naan ekipthutheasam engkum kadanthupoay, ekipthutheasaththilu'l'la manitharmuthal mirukajeevanka'lmattum, mutha'rpea'raayirukki'ravaika'laiyellaam athampa'n'ni, ekipthu theavarka'linmeal neethiyaich seluththuvean; naanea karththar.

neengka'l irukkum veeduka'lil antha iraththam ungka'lukkaaka adaiyaa'lamaay irukkum; antha iraththaththai naan ka'ndu, ungka'laik kadanthupoavean; naan ekipthu theasaththai azhikkumpoathu, azhikkum vaathai ungka'lukku'l'lea varaathirukkum.

antha naa'l ungka'lukku ninaivukooruthalaana naa'laay irukkakkadavathu; athaik karththarukkup pa'ndikaiyaaka aasarippeerka'laaka; athai ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya niyamamaaka aasarikkakkadaveerka'l.

pu'lippillaa appaththai eazhunaa'la'lavum pusikkakkadaveerka'l; muthalaam naa'lilthaanea pu'liththamaavai ungka'l veeduka'lilirunthu neekkavea'ndum; muthalaam naa'l thodangki eazhaam naa'lvaraikkum pu'liththa appam pusikki'ravan evanoa antha aaththumaa isravealarilirunthu a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.

muthalaam naa'lil parisuththa sapai kooduthalum, eazhaam naa'lilum parisuththa sapaikooduthalum irukkavea'ndum; avaika'lil oru vealaiyum seyyappadalaakaathu; avaravar saappiduki'ratha'rkuth theavaiyaanathumaaththiram ungka'laal seyyappadalaam.

pu'lippillaa appappa'ndikaiyai aasarippeerka'laaka; intha naa'lilthaan naan ungka'l seanaika'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninean; aakaiyaal, ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya niyamamaaka intha naa'lai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l.
muthalaam maatham pathinaalaam theathi saayangkaalanthodangki maathaththin irupaththoaraam theathi saayangkaalamvaraikkum pu'lippillaa appam pusikkakkadaveerka'l.

eazhunaa'la'lavum ungka'l veeduka'lil pu'liththa maa kaa'nappadalaakaathu; evanaakilum pu'lippidappattathaip pusiththaal, avan paratheasiyaanaalum sutheasiyaanaalum, antha aaththumaa israveal sapaiyil iraamal a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.
pu'lippidappatta yaathon'raiyum neengka'l pusikkavea'ndaam; ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilellaam pu'lippillaa appam pusikkakkadaveerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea israveal mooppar yaavaraiyum azhaippiththu: neengka'l ungka'l kudumpangka'lukkuth thakkathaaka ungka'lukku aattukkuttiyaith therintheduththukko'ndu, paskaavai adiththu,

eesoappuk kozhunthuka'lin koththai eduththuk ki'n'niyil irukkum iraththaththil thoayththu, athil irukkum antha iraththaththai vaasal nilaikkaalka'lin mea'rsattaththilum vaasalin nilaikkaalka'l ira'ndilum the'liyungka'l; vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum ungka'lil oruvarum veettu vaasalaivittup pu'rappadavea'ndaam.

karththar ekipthiyarai athampa'n'nuki'ratha'rkuk kadanthuvaruvaar; nilaiyin mea'rsattaththilum vaasalin nilaikkaalka'l ira'ndilum antha iraththaththaik kaa'numpoathu, karththar sangkaarakkaaranai ungka'l veeduka'lil ungka'lai athampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku varavottaamal, vaasa'rpadiyai vilakik kadanthupoavaar.
inthak kaariyaththai ungka'lukkum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum niththiya niyamamaakak kaikko'l'lakkadaveerka'l.
karththar ungka'lukkuth thaam sonnapadi kodukkappoaki'ra theasaththilea neengka'l poaych searumpoathu, intha aaraathanaiyaik kaikko'l'lakkadaveerka'l.
appozhuthu ungka'l pi'l'laika'l: intha aaraathanaiyin karuththu enna en'ru ungka'laik keattaal,

ithu karththarudaiya paskaavaakiya pali; avar ekipthiyarai athampa'n'ni, nammudaiya veeduka'laith thappappa'n'ninapoathu, ekipthiliruntha israveal puththirarudaiya veeduka'laik kadanthupoanaar en'ru neengka'l sollavea'ndum en'raan. appozhuthu janangka'l thalaiva'nangkip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.
israveal puththirar poay appadiyea seythaarka'l; karththar moaseakkum aaroanukkum katta'laiyittapadiyea seythaarka'l.

naduraaththiriyilea singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkum paarvoanudaiya thalaippi'l'laimuthal kaaval kidangkilirukkum si'raippattavanin thalaippi'l'laivaraikkum, ekipthu theasaththil iruntha mutha'rpea'ranaiththaiyum mirukajeevanka'lin thalaiyeet'ranaiththaiyum karththar azhiththaar.
appozhuthu paarvoanum avanudaiya sakala oozhiyakkaararum ekipthiyar yaavarum iraaththiriyilea ezhunthirunthaarka'l; makaa kookkural ekipthilea u'ndaayit'ru; saavillaatha oru veedum irunthathillai.

iraaththiriyilea avan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum azhaippiththu: neengka'lum israveal puththirarum ezhunthu, en janangka'laivittup pu'rappattuppoay, neengka'l sonnapadiyea karththarukku aaraathanaiseyyungka'l.
neengka'l sonnapadiyea ungka'l aadumaaduka'laiyum oattikko'ndupoangka'l; ennaiyum aaseervathiyungka'l en'raan.
ekipthiyar: naangka'l ellaarum saaki'roamea en'ru sollith, theeviramaay janangka'laith theasaththilirunthu anuppivida avarka'lai mikavum thurithappaduththinaarka'l.
pisainthamaa pu'likkumun janangka'l athaip paaththiraththudanea thangka'l vasthirangka'lil katti, thangka'l thoa'lmeal eduththukko'ndu poanaarka'l.
moasea solliyirunthapadi israveal janangka'l ekipthiyaridaththil ve'l'liyudaimaika'laiyum ponnudaimaika'laiyum vasthirangka'laiyum keattaarka'l.
karththar janangka'lukku ekipthiyarin ka'nka'lil thayavu kidaikkumpadi seythathinaal, keattathai avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; ivvithamaay avarka'l ekipthiyaraik ko'l'laiyittaarka'l.
israveal puththirar raamaseasai vittuk kaalnadaiyaayp pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, sukkoaththukkup poanaarka'l; avarka'l, pi'l'laika'lthavira aa'ruladcham purusharaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'loadea koodap pala jaathiyaana janangka'l aneakar poanathum an'ri, mikuthiyaana aadumaaduka'l muthalaana mirukajeevanka'lum poayit'ru.

ekipthilirunthu avarka'l ko'ndu vantha pisainthamaavaip pu'lippillaa appangka'laakach suttaarka'l; avarka'l ekipthil tharikkakkoodaamal thuraththividappattathinaal, athu pu'liyaathirunthathu; avarka'l thangka'lukku vazhikken'ru on'rum aayaththampa'n'navillai.
israveal puththirar ekipthilea kudiyiruntha kaalam naanoot'rumuppathu varusham.
naanoot'rumuppathu varusham mudintha an'raiththinamea karththarudaiya seanaika'l ellaam ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattathu.

karththar avarka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathinaal, ithu avarukken'ru mukkiyamaay aasarikkaththakka raaththiriyaayit'ru; israveal santhathiyaar ellaarum thangka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum karththarukku mukkiyamaay aasarikkavea'ndiya raaththiri ithuvea.
mealum, karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki: paskaavin niyamamaavathu, anniya puththiran oruvanum athaip pusikkavea'ndaam.
pa'naththinaal ko'l'lappatta adimaiyaanavan evanum, nee avanukku viruththaseathanampa'n'ninapin, avan athaip pusikkalaam.
anniyanum kooliyaa'lum athilea pusikkavea'ndaam.
athai ovvoru veetti'rku'l'lum pusikkavea'ndum; antha maamsaththil kognchamaakilum veettilirunthu ve'liyea ko'ndupoakakkoodaathu; athil oru elumpaiyum mu'rikkakkoodaathu.
israveal sapaiyaar ellaarum athai aasarikkakkadavarka'l.

anniyan oruvan unnidaththilea thangki, karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikkavea'ndumen'ru irunthaal, avanaich searntha aa'npi'l'laika'l yaavarum viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadavea'ndum; pinpu avan searnthu athai aasarikkavea'ndum; avan sutheasiyaippoal iruppaan; viruththaseathanam illaatha oruvanum athil pusikkavea'ndaam.
sutheasikkum ungka'lidaththil thangkum paratheasikkum orea piramaa'nam irukkakkadavathu en'raar.
ippadiyea israveal puththirar ellaarum seythaarka'l; karththar moaseakkum aaroanukkum katta'laiyittapadiyea seythaarka'l.
an'raiththinamea karththar israveal puththirarai a'niya'niyaay ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
israveal puththirarukku'l manitharilum mirukajeevanka'lilum karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakki'ra mutha'rpea'ranaiththaiyum enakkup parisuththappaduththu; athu ennudaiyathu en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea janangka'lai noakki: neengka'l adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta intha naa'lai ninaiyungka'l; karththar palaththa kaiyinaal ungka'lai avvidaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; aakaiyaal, neengka'l pu'liththa appam pusikkavea'ndaam.
aapip maathaththin intha naa'lilea neengka'l pu'rappatteerka'l.

aakaiyaal, karththar unakkuk koduppean en'ru un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittathum, paalum theanum oaduki'rathumaana theasamaakiya kaanaaniyar, eaththiyar, emoariyar, eaviyar, epoosiyar enpavarka'ludaiya theasaththukku unnai varappa'n'num kaalaththil, nee intha maathaththilea intha aaraathanaiyaich seyvaayaaka.
pu'lippillaa appaththai eazhunaa'la'lavum pusikkakkadavaay; eazhaamnaa'lilea karththarukkup pa'ndikai aasarikkappaduvathaaka.
antha eazhunaa'lum pu'lippillaa appam pusikkavea'ndum; pu'lippu'l'la appam unnidaththilea kaa'nappadavea'ndaam; un ellaikku'l engkum pu'liththamaavum unnidaththil kaa'nappadavea'ndaam.
annaa'lil nee un puththiranai noakki: naan ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadukaiyil, karththar enakkuch seythatha'rkaaka ippadi nadappikkappaduki'rathu en'ru sol.

karththarin niyaayappiramaa'nam un vaayilirukkumpadikku, ithu un kaiyilea oru adaiyaa'lamaakavum un ka'nka'lin naduvea ninaippoottuthalaakavum irukkakkadavathu; palaththa kaiyinaal karththar unnai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar;
aakaiyaal, nee varushanthoa'rum ku'riththa kaalaththil intha niyamaththai aasariththu varuvaayaaka.
mealum, karththar unakkum un pithaakka'lukkum aa'naiyittapadiyea, unnaik kaanaaniyarin theasaththilea varappa'n'ni, athai unakkuk kodukkumpoathu,
karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakkum anaiththaiyum, unakku irukkum mirukajeevanka'lin thalaiyeet'ranaiththaiyum, karththarukku oppukkoduppaayaaka; avaika'lilu'l'la aa'nka'l karththarudaiyavaika'l.

kazhuthaiyin thalaiyeet'raiyellaam oru aattukkuttiyaal meettukko'lvaayaaka; meedkaavittaal, athin kazhuththai mu'riththuppoadu. un pi'l'laika'lil mutha'rpea'raana sakala narajeevanaiyum meettukko'lvaayaaka.
pi'rkaalaththil un kumaaran: ithu enna en'ru unnaik keattaal; nee avanai noakki: karththar engka'laip palaththa kaiyinaal adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.

engka'lai vidaathapadikku, paarvoan kadinappattirukkumpoathu, karththar ekipthu theasaththil manitharin thalaippi'l'laika'lmuthal mirukajeevanka'lin thalaiyeet'ruka'lvaraikkum u'ndaayiruntha mutha'rpea'ruka'l yaavaiyum kon'ru poattaar; aakaiyaal, karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakkum aa'naiyellaam naan karththarukkup paliyittu, en pi'l'laika'lil mutha'rpea'ranaiththaiyum meettukko'l'luki'rean.

karththar engka'laip palaththa kaiyinaal ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninatha'rku, ithu un kaiyil adaiyaa'lamaakavum, un ka'nka'lin naduvea gnaapakakku'riyaakavum irukkakkadavathu en'ru solvaayaaka en'raan.

paarvoan janangka'laip poakavittapin: janangka'l yuththaththaik ka'ndaal manamadinthu, ekipthukkuth thirumpuvaarka'l en'ru solli; pelistharin theasavazhiyaayp poavathu sameepamaanaalum, theavan avarka'lai antha vazhiyaay nadaththaamal,
sivantha samuththiraththin vanaantharavazhiyaay janangka'laich sut'rip poakappa'n'ninaar. israveal puththirar ekipthu theasaththilirunthu a'niya'niyaayp pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.

moasea thannoadeakooda yoaseappin elumpuka'lai eduththukko'ndupoanaan. theavan nichchayamaay ungka'laich santhippaar; appozhuthu ungka'loadeakooda en elumpuka'lai ivvidaththilirunthu ko'ndupoangka'l en'ru yoaseappu solli, israveal puththirarai u'ruthiyaay aa'naiyidumpadi seythirunthaan.
avarka'l sukkoaththilirunthu pirayaa'nappattu, vanaantharaththin oaramaay eaththaamilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

avarka'l iravum pakalum vazhinadakkakkoodumpadikku, karththar pakalil avarka'lai vazhinadaththa meakasthampaththilum, iravil avarka'lukku ve'lichchangkaatta akkinisthampaththilum avarka'lukku mun sen'raar.
pakalilea meakasthampamum, iravilea akkinisthampamum janangka'lidaththilirunthu vilakippoakavillai.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

neengka'l thirumpi mikthoalukkum samuththiraththukkum naduvea paakaalsepoanukku munpaaka irukki'ra eeroath pa'l'laththaakkin munnadiyilea paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum en'ru israveal puththirarukkuch sollu; atha'rku ethiraakach samuththirakkaraiyilea paa'layami'rangkuveerka'laaka.
appozhuthu paarvoan israveal puththiraraikku'riththu: avarka'l theasaththilea thikaiththuth thiriki'raarka'l; vanaantharam avarka'lai adaiththuppoattathu en'ru solluvaan.

aakaiyaal, paarvoan avarka'laip pinthodarumpadikku, naan avan iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththi, naanea karththar enpathai ekipthiyar a'riyumpadi, paarvoanaalum avanudaiya ellaa raa'nuvaththaalum makimaippaduvean en'raar; avarka'l appadiyea seythaarka'l.

janangka'l oadippoayvittaarka'l en'ru ekipthin raajaavukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, janangka'lukku viroathamaakap paarvoanum avan oozhiyakkaararum manam vea'rupattu: namakku vealai seyyaathapadikku naam isravealaraip poakavittathu enna kaariyam en'raarka'l.
avan than irathaththaip pootti, than janangka'laik koottikko'ndu,
pirathaanamaana a'runoo'ru irathangka'laiyum, ekipthilu'l'la mat'ra sakala irathangka'laiyum, avaika'l ellaavat'ri'rkum athipathika'laana veeraraiyum koottikko'ndupoanaan.
karththar ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanin iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaar; avan israveal puththiraraip pinthodarnthaan, israveal puththirar palaththa kaiyudan pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.

ekipthiyar paarvoanudaiya sakala kuthiraika'loadum irathangka'loadum avanudaiya kuthiraiveeraroadum seanaika'loadum avarka'laith thodarnthupoay, samuththiraththa'ndaiyilea paakaalsepoanukku ethirea irukki'ra eeroath pa'l'laththaakkin munnadiyilea paa'layami'rangkiyirukki'ra avarka'laik kittinaarka'l.

paarvoan sameepiththu varuki'rapoathu, israveal puththirar thangka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaarththu, ekipthiyar thangka'lukkup pinnea varuki'rathaik ka'ndu, mikavum payanthaarka'l; appozhuthu israveal puththirar karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l.

an'riyum avarka'l moaseayai noakki: ekipthilea pireathakkuzhika'l illaiyen'raa vanaantharaththilea saakumpadikku engka'laik ko'nduvantheer? neer engka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathinaal, engka'lukku ippadich seythathu enna?

naangka'l ekipthilea irukkumpoathu, naangka'l ekipthiyarukku vealai seyya engka'laich summaa vittuvidum en'ru sonnoam allavaa? naangka'l vanaantharaththilea saaki'rathaippaarkkilum ekipthiyarukku vealaiseyki'rathu engka'lukku nalamaayirukkumea en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea janangka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l; neengka'l nin'ruko'ndu in'raikkuk karththar ungka'lukkuch seyyum iradchippaip paarungka'l; in'raikku neengka'l kaa'nki'ra ekipthiyarai ini en'raikkum kaa'namaatteerka'l.
karththar ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaar; neengka'l summaayiruppeerka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee ennidaththil mu'raiyiduki'rathu enna? pu'rappattup poangka'l en'ru israveal puththirarukkuch sollu.
nee un koalai oangki, un kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neetti, samuththiraththaip pi'lanthuvidu; appozhuthu israveal puththirar samuththiraththin naduvaaka vettaantharaiyilea nadanthupoavaarka'l.

ekipthiyar ungka'laip pinthodarnthu varumpadi naan avarka'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththi, paarvoanaalum avan irathangka'l kuthiraiveerar muthalaakiya avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvaththaalum makimaippaduvean.
ippadi naan paarvoanaalum avan irathangka'laalum avan kuthiraiveeraraalum makimaippadumpoathu, naanea karththar enpathai ekipthiyar a'rivaarka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu isravealarin seanaikku munnaaka nadantha theavathoothanaanavar vilaki, avarka'lukkup pinnaaka nadanthaar; avarka'lukku mun iruntha meakasthampamum vilaki, avarka'l pinnea nin'rathu.

athu ekipthiyarin seanaiyum isravealarin seanaiyum iraamuzhuthum on'roadon'ru searaathapadi avaika'l naduvil vanthathu; ekipthiyarukku athu meakamum anthakaaramumaay irunthathu, isravealarukkoa athu iravai ve'lichchamaakkit'ru.

moasea than kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neettinaan; appozhuthu karththar iraamuzhuthum palaththa keezhkkaat'rinaal samuththiram othungkumpadi seythu, athai va'ra'ndupoakappa'n'ninaar; jalam pi'lanthu pirinthupoayit'ru.
israveal puththirar samuththiraththin naduvaaka vettaantharaiyilea nadanthupoanaarka'l; avarka'l valathupu'raththilum avarka'l idathupu'raththilum jalam avarka'lukku mathilaaka nin'rathu.
appozhuthu ekipthiyar avarka'laith thodarnthu, paarvoanudaiya sakala kuthiraika'loadum irathangka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum avarka'l pi'rakaalea samuththiraththin naduvea piraveasiththaarka'l.
kizhakku ve'luththuvarum jaamaththil karththar akkiniyum meakamumaana sthampaththilirunthu ekipthiyarin seanaiyaip paarththu, avarka'l seanaiyaik kalangkadiththu,

avarka'ludaiya irathangka'lilirunthu uru'laika'l kazhalavum, avarka'l thangka'l irathangka'lai varuththaththoadea nadaththavum pa'n'ninaar; appozhuthu ekipthiyar: isravealaraivittu oadippoavoam, karththar avarka'lukkuth thu'nainin'ru ekipthiyarukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuki'raar en'raarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki: jalam ekipthiyarmealum avarka'ludaiya irathangka'lmealum avarka'ludaiya kuthiraiveerarmealum thirumpumpadikku, un kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neettu en'raar.

appadiyea moasea than kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neettinaan; vidiya'rkaalaththil samuththiram palamaayth thirumpi vanthathu; ekipthiyar atha'rku ethiraaka oadumpoathu, karththar avarka'laik kadalin naduvea kavizhththuppoattaar.
