jalam thirumpivanthu, irathangka'laiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum, avarka'l pinnaakach samuththiraththil piraveasiththiruntha paarvoanudaiya iraa'nuvam anaiththaiyum moodikko'ndathu; avarka'lil oruvanaakilum thappavillai.
israveal puththiraroa samuththiraththin naduvaaka vettaantharaiyin vazhiyaay nadanthupoanaarka'l; avarka'l valathupu'raththilum avarka'l idathupu'raththilum jalam avarka'lukku mathilaaka nin'rathu.
ivvithamaayk karththar annaa'lilea isravealarai ekipthiyarin kaikkuth thappuviththu radchiththaar; kada'rkaraiyilea ekipthiyar seththukkidakki'rathai isravealar ka'ndaarka'l.

karththar ekipthiyaril seytha antha makaththaana kiriyaiyai isravealar ka'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu janangka'l karththarukkup payanthu, karththaridaththilum avarudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakiya moaseayinidaththilum visuvaasam vaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu moaseayum israveal puththirarum karththaraip pukazhnthupaadina paattu: karththaraip paaduvean; avar makimaiyaay vet'risi'ranthaar; kuthiraiyaiyum kuthiraiveeranaiyum kadalilea tha'l'linaar.
karththar en pelanum en keethamumaanavar; avar enakku iradchippumaanavar; avarea en theavan, avarukku vaasasthalaththai aayaththampa'n'nuvean; avarea en thakappanudaiya theavan, avarai uyarththuvean;
karththarea yuththaththil vallavar; karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
paarvoanin irathangka'laiyum avan seanaika'laiyum samuththiraththilea tha'l'livittaar; avanudaiya pirathaana athipathika'l sivantha samuththiraththil amizhnthu poanaarka'l.
aazhi avarka'lai moodikko'ndathu; kallaippoala aazhangka'lil amizhnthupoanaarka'l.
karththaavea, ummudaiya valathukaram palaththinaal makaththuvam si'ranthirukki'rathu; karththaavea, ummudaiya valathukaram pakaignanai no'rukkivittathu.
umakku viroathamaay ezhumpinavarka'lai umathu mukkiyaththin makaththuvaththinaalea nirmoolamaakkineer; ummudaiya koapaakkiniyai anuppineer, athu avarka'laith thaa'ladiyaippoalap padchiththathu.
umathu naasiyin suvaasaththinaal jalam kuvinthu nin'rathu; ve'l'lam kuviyalaaka nimirnthu nin'rathu; aazhamaana jalam nadukkadalilea u'rainthupoayit'ru.
thodaruvean, pidippean, ko'l'laiyaadip pangkiduvean, en aasai avarka'lidaththil thirpthiyaakum, en pattayaththai uruvuvean, en kai avarka'laich sangkarikkum en'ru pakaignan sonnaan.
ummudaiya kaat'rai veesappa'n'nineer, kadal avarka'lai moodikko'ndathu; thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lil eeyampoala amizhnthupoanaarka'l.
karththaavea, theavarka'lil umakku oppaanavar yaar? parisuththaththil makaththuvamu'l'lavarum, thuthika'lil payappadaththakkavarum, a'rputhangka'laich seyki'ravarumaakiya umakku oppaanavar yaar?
neer umathu valathukaraththai neettineer; poomi avarka'lai vizhungkippoattathu.
neer meettukko'nda intha janangka'lai umathu kirupaiyinaalea azhaiththu vantheer; ummudaiya parisuththa vaasasthalaththukku nearaaka avarka'lai umathu palaththinaal vazhinadaththineer.
janangka'l athaik keattuth thaththa'lippaarka'l; pelisthiyaavin kudika'laith thikil pidikkum.
eathoamin pirapukka'l kalangkuvaarka'l; moavaapin paraakkiramasaalika'lai nadukkam pidikkum; kaanaanin kudika'l yaavarum karainthupoavaarka'l.

payamum thikilum avarka'lmeal vizhum. karththaavea, umathu janangka'l kadanthupoakumvaraiyum, neer meetta janangka'lea kadanthupoakumvaraiyum, avarka'l ummudaiya puyaththin makaththuvaththinaal kallaippoala asaivat'riruppaarka'l.

neer avarka'laik ko'ndupoay, karththaraakiya theavareer vaasampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku niyamiththa sthaanamaakiya ummudaiya suthantharaththin parvathaththilum, aa'ndavaraakiya theavareerudaiya karangka'l sthaapiththa parisuththa sthalaththilum avarka'lai naattuveer.
karththar sathaakaalangka'laakiya en'ren'raikkum raajarikam pa'n'nuvaar.

paarvoanin kuthiraika'l avanudaiya irathangka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum samuththiraththil piraveasiththathu; karththar samuththiraththin jalaththai avarka'lmeal thirumpappa'n'ninaar; israveal puththiraroa samuththiraththin naduvea vettaantharaiyilea nadanthupoanaarka'l en'ru paadinaarka'l.

aaroanin sakoathariyaakiya miriyaam ennum theerkkatharisiyaanava'lum than kaiyilea thampurai eduththukko'ndaa'l; sakala sthireeka'lum thampuruka'loadum nadanaththoadum ava'lukkup pinnea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
miriyaam avarka'lukkup pirathivasanamaaka: karththaraip paadungka'l, avar makimaiyaay vet'risi'ranthaar; kuthiraiyaiyum kuthiraiveeranaiyum kadalilea tha'l'linaar en'ru paadinaa'l.

pinpu moasea israveal janangka'laich sivantha samuththiraththilirunthu pirayaa'nappaduththinaan. avarka'l soorvanaantharaththukkup pu'rappattuppoay, moon'runaa'l vanaantharaththil tha'n'neer kidaiyaamal nadanthaarka'l.
avarka'l maaraavilea vanthapoathu, maaraavin tha'n'neer kasappaayirunthathinaal athaik kudikka avarka'lukkuk koodaathirunthathu; athinaal avvidaththukku maaraa en'ru pearidappattathu.
appozhuthu janangka'l moaseakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'ruththu: ennaththaik kudippoam en'raarka'l.

moasea karththarai noakkik kooppittaan; appozhuthu karththar moaseakku oru maraththaik kaa'npiththaar; athai avan tha'n'neeril poattavudanea, athu mathuramaana tha'n'neeraayit'ru. avar angkea avarka'lukku oru niyamaththaiyum oru niyaayaththaiyum katta'laiyittu, angkea avarka'laich soathiththu:

nee un theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththaik kavanamaayk keattu, avar paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanavaika'laich seythu, avar katta'laika'lukkuch sevikoduththu, avarudaiya niyamangka'l yaavaiyum kaikko'ndaal, naan ekipthiyarukku varappa'n'nina viyaathika'lil on'raiyum unakku varappa'n'nean; naanea un parikaariyaakiya karththar en'raar.
pinpu avarka'l ealimukku vanthaarka'l; angkea pannira'ndu neeroot'ruka'lum ezhupathu peareechchamarangka'lum irunthathu; angkea tha'n'neer arukea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum ealimaivittup pirayaa'nam pa'n'ni, ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta ira'ndaam maatham pathinainthaam theathiyilea, ealimukkum seenaaykkum naduvea irukki'ra seenvanaantharaththil searnthaarka'l.
antha vanaantharaththilea israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaaka mu'rumu'ruththu:

naangka'l i'raichchip paaththirangka'la'ndaiyilea udkaarnthu appaththaith thirpthiyaakach saappitta ekipthu theasaththilea, karththarin kaiyaal seththuppoanoamaanaal thaavi'lai; inthak koottam muzhuvathaiyum pattiniyinaal kollumpadi neengka'l engka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, intha vanaantharaththilea azhaiththuvantheerka'lea en'ru avarka'lidaththil sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: naan ungka'lukku vaanaththilirunthu appam varushikkappa'n'nuvean; janangka'l poay, ovvoru naa'lukku vea'ndiyathai ovvoru naa'lilum searththukko'l'lavea'ndum; athinaal avarka'l en niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi nadappaarka'loa nadakkamaattaarka'loa en'ru avarka'laich soathippean.
aa'raam naa'liloa, avarka'l naa'lthoa'rum searkki'rathaippaarkkilum ira'ndaththanaiyaaych searththu, athai aayaththampa'n'nivaikkakkadavarka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu moaseayum aaroanum israveal puththirar ellaaraiyum noakki: karththar ungka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninavar enpathaich saayangkaalaththil a'riveerka'l;

vidiya'rkaalaththil karththarudaiya makimaiyaiyum kaa'npeerka'l; karththarukku viroathamaana ungka'l mu'rumu'ruppuka'lai avar keattaar; neengka'l engka'lukku viroathamaay mu'rumu'rukki'ratha'rku naangka'l emmaaththiram en'raarka'l.

pinnum moasea: saayangkaalaththil neengka'l pusikki'ratha'rkuk karththar ungka'lukku i'raichchiyaiyum, vidiya'rkaalaththil neengka'l thirpthiyadaiki'ratha'rku appaththaiyum kodukkaiyil ithu vi'langkum; karththarukku viroathamaaka neengka'l mu'rumu'ruththa ungka'l mu'rumu'ruppuka'lai avar keattaar; naangka'l emmaaththiram? ungka'l mu'rumu'ruppuka'l engka'lukku alla, karththarukkea viroathamaay irukki'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu moasea aaroanaip paarththu; nee israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum noakki: karththarudaiya sannithiyil searungka'l, avar ungka'l mu'rumu'ruppuka'laik keattaar en'ru sol en'raan.

aaroan israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaarukkellaam ithaich solluki'rapoathu, avarka'l vanaantharathisaiyaakath thirumpippaarththaarka'l; appozhuthu karththarudaiya makimai meakaththilea kaa'nappattathu.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

israveal puththirarin mu'rumu'ruppuka'laik keattirukki'rean; nee avarka'loadea peasi, neengka'l saayangkaalaththil i'raichchiyaip pusiththu, vidiya'rkaalaththil appaththaal thirpthiyaaki, naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar enpathai a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
saayangkaalaththil kaadaika'l vanthu vizhunthu paa'layaththai moodikko'ndathu. vidiya'rkaalaththil paa'layaththaich sut'ri pani peythirunthathu.
peythiruntha pani neengkinapin, ithoa, vanaantharaththinmeethengkum urudchiyaana oru si'riya vasthu u'raintha panikkattip podiyaththanaiyaayth tharaiyinmeal kidanthathu.

israveal puththirar athaik ka'ndu, athu innathu en'ru a'riyaathirunthu, oruvarai oruvar paarththu, ithu enna en'raarka'l; appozhuthu moasea avarka'lai noakki: ithu karththar ungka'lukkup pusikkakkoduththa appam.

karththar katta'laiyiduki'rathu ennaven'raal, avaravar pusikkum a'lavukkuththakkathaaka athil eduththuch searkkakkadaveerka'l; ungka'lilu'l'la aaththumaakka'lin ilakkaththinpadi, avanavan than than koodaaraththil irukki'ravarka'lukkaakath thalaikku oru oamar a'lavu eduththukko'l'lakkadavan en'raan.
israveal puththirar appadiyea seythu, silar mikuthiyaayum silar kognchamaayum searththaarka'l.

pinpu, athai oamaraal a'lanthaarka'l: mikuthiyaaych searththavanukku meethiyaanathum illai, kognchamaaych searththavanukkuk ku'raivaanathum illai; avaravar thaangka'l pusikkum a'lavukkuththakkathaakach searththaarka'l.
moasea avarka'lai noakki: oruvanum vidiya'rkaalammattum athil on'rum vaikkakkoodaathu en'ru avarka'lukkuch solliyum;
moaseayin sol kea'laamal, silar athil vidiya'rkaalammattum kogncham meethiyaay vaiththaarka'l; athu poochchi pidiththu naat'rameduththathu. avarka'lmeal moasea koapangko'ndaan.
athai vidiya'rkaalanthoa'rum avaravar pusikkum a'lavukkuththakkathaakach searththaarka'l, veyil ea'raea'ra athu urukippoam.
aa'raam naa'lil thalaikku ira'ndu oamar veethamaaka ira'ndaththanaiyaay aakaaram searththaarka'l; appozhuthu sapaiyin thalaivar ellaarum vanthu, athai moaseakku a'riviththaarka'l.

avan avarka'lai noakki: karththar sonnathu ithuthaan; naa'laikkuk karththarukkuriya parisuththa oayvunaa'laakiya oayvu; neengka'l sudavea'ndiyathaichsuttu, veavikkavea'ndiyathai veaviththu, meethiyaayirukki'rathaiyellaam naa'laimattum ungka'lukkaaka vaiththuvaiyungka'l en'raan.
moasea katta'laiyittapadiyea, athai ma'runaa'lvaraikkum vaiththuvaiththaarka'l; appozhuthu athu naa'ravum illai, athilea poochchipidikkavum illai.
appozhuthu moasea: athai in'raikkup pusiyungka'l; in'ru karththarukkuriya oayvunaa'l; in'ru neengka'l athai ve'liyilea kaa'namaatteerka'l.
aa'runaa'lum athaich searppeerka'laaka; eazhaamnaa'l oayvunaa'laayirukki'rathu; athilea athu u'ndaayiraathu en'raan.
eazhaamnaa'lil janangka'lil silar athaich searkkap pu'rappattaarka'l; avarka'l athaik kaa'navillai.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: en katta'laika'laiyum en piramaa'nangka'laiyum kaikko'l'la enthamattum manathillaathiruppeerka'l?

paarungka'l, karththar ungka'lukku oayvunaa'lai aru'linapadiyaal, avar ungka'lukku aa'raam naa'lil ira'ndunaa'lukku vea'ndiya aakaaraththaik kodukki'raar; eazhaamnaa'lil ungka'lil oruvanum than than sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappadaamal, avanavan than than sthaanaththilea irukkavea'ndum en'raar.
appadiyea janangka'l eazhaamnaa'lil oaynthirunthaarka'l.
israveal vamsaththaar atha'rku mannaa en'ru pearittaarka'l; athu koththumalli a'lavaayum ve'nmaini'ramaayum irunthathu, athin rusi theanitta pa'nikaaraththi'rku oppaayirunthathu.

appozhuthu moasea: karththar katta'laiyitta kaariyam ennaven'raal, naan ungka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninapoathu, vanaantharaththil ungka'lukkup pusikkakkoduththa appaththai ungka'l santhathiyaar paarkkumpadikku, avarka'lukkaaka athaik kaappatha'rku, athilea oru oamar ni'raiya eduththu vaikkavea'ndum en'raan.

mealum, moasea aaroanai noakki: nee oru kalasaththai eduththu, athilea oru oamar a'lavu mannaavaip poattu, athai ungka'l santhathiyaarukkaakak kaappatha'rkuk karththarudaiya sannithiyilea vai en'raan.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea athu kaakkappadumpadi aaroan athaich saadchi sannithiyil vaiththaan.
israveal puththirar kudiyiruppaana theasaththukku varumattum naa'rpathu varushama'lavum mannaavaip pusiththaarka'l; avarka'l kaanaan theasaththin ellaiyil searumvaraikkum mannaavaip pusiththaarka'l.
oru oamaraanathu eppaavilea paththil oru pangku.

pinpu israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea seenvanaantharaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, revitheemilea vanthu paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; angkea janangka'lukkuk kudikkath tha'n'neer illaathirunthathu.

appozhuthu janangka'l moaseayoadea vaathaadi: naangka'l kudikki'ratha'rku engka'lukkuth tha'n'neer tharavea'ndum en'raarka'l. atha'rku moasea: ennoadea ean vaathaaduki'reerka'l, karththarai ean pareedchai paarkki'reerka'l en'raan.

janangka'l avvidaththilea tha'n'neerth thavanamaayirunthapadiyaal, avarka'l moaseakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'ruththu: neer engka'laiyum engka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum engka'l aadumaaduka'laiyum tha'n'neerth thavanaththinaal kon'rupoada engka'lai ekipthilirunthu ean ko'nduvantheer en'raarka'l.
moasea karththarai noakkik kooppittu: intha janangka'lukku naan enna seyvean, ivarka'l enmeal kalle'riyap paarkki'raarka'lea en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee israveal moopparil silarai unnoadea koottikko'ndu, nee nathiyai adiththa un koalai un kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, janangka'lukku munnea nadanthupoa.

angkea oareapilea naan unakku munpaakak kanmalaiyinmeal ni'rpean; nee anthak kanmalaiyai adi; appozhuthu janangka'l kudikka athilirunthu tha'n'neer pu'rappadum en'raar; appadiyea moasea israveal moopparin ka'nka'lukku munpaakach seythaan.

israveal puththirar vaathaadinathinimiththamum, karththar engka'l naduvil irukki'raaraa illaiyaa en'ru avarka'l karththaraip pareedchai paarththathinimiththamum, avan antha sthalaththi'rku maasaa en'rum mearipaa en'rum pearittaan.
amaleakkiyar vanthu revitheemilea isravealaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea yoasuvaavai noakki: nee namakkaaka manitharaith therinthuko'ndu, pu'rappattu, amaleakkoadea yuththampa'n'nu; naa'laikku naan malaiyuchchiyil theavanudaiya koalai en kaiyil pidiththukko'ndu ni'rpean en'raan.
yoasuvaa thanakku moasea sonnapadiyea seythu, amaleakkoadea yuththampa'n'ninaan. moaseayum aaroanum oor enpavanum malaiyuchchiyil ea'rinaarka'l.
moasea than kaiyai ea'reduththirukkaiyil, isravealar mea'rko'ndaarka'l; avan than kaiyaith thaazhavidukaiyil, amaleakku mea'rko'ndaan.

moaseayin kaika'l asanthupoayit'ru, appozhuthu avarka'l oru kallaik ko'nduvanthu avan keezhea vaiththaarka'l; athinmeal udkaarnthaan; aaroanum oorum oruvan oru pakkaththilum oruvan ma'ru pakkaththilum irunthu, avan kaika'laith thaangkinaarka'l; ivvithamaay avan kaika'l sooriyan asthamikkumvaraikkum orea nilaiyaayirunthathu.
yoasuvaa amaleakkaiyum avan janangka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaalea mu'riya adiththaan.

pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: ithai ninaivukoorumporuttu, nee oru pusthakaththil ezhuthi, yoasuvaavin sevikeadkumpadi vaasi. amaleakkai vaanaththin keezhengkum iraathapadikku naasam pa'n'nuvean en'raar.
moasea oru palipeedaththaik katti, atha'rku yeakoavaanisi en'ru pearittu,
amaleakkin kai karththarudaiya singkaasanaththukku viroathamaayirunthapadiyaal, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum avanukku viroathamaay karththarin yuththam nadakkum en'raan.

theavan moaseakkum thamathu janamaakiya isravealukkum seytha yaavaiyum, karththar isravealai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathaiyum, meethiyaanil aasaariyanaayiruntha moaseayin maamanaakiya eththiroa kea'lvippattapoathu,
moaseayin maamanaakiya eththiroa, moaseayinaalea thirumpi anuppividappattiruntha avan manaiviyaakiya sippoaraa'laiyum,
ava'ludaiya ira'ndu kumaararaiyum koottikko'ndu pirayaa'nappattaan. naan anniya theasaththilea paratheasiyaanean en'ru moasea solli, oru makanukkuk kersoam en'ru pearittirunthaan.
en pithaavin theavan enakkuth thu'nainin'ru paarvoanin pattayaththukku ennaith thappuviththaar en'ru solli, mat'ravanukku eliyeasar en'ru pearittirunthaan.
moaseayin maamanaakiya eththiroa moaseayin kumaararoadum avan manaiviyoadungkooda, avan paa'layami'rangkiyiruntha theava parvathaththinidaththil vanaantharaththukku vanthu:
eththiroa ennum ummudaiya maamanaakiya naanum, ummudaiya manaiviyum, ava'loadeakooda ava'ludaiya ira'ndu kumaararum ummidaththi'rku vanthirukki'roam en'ru moaseakkuch solliyanuppinaan.
appozhuthu moasea than maamanukku ethirko'ndupoay, avanai va'nangki, muththagnseythaan; oruvarai oruvar sukaseythi visaariththukko'ndu, koodaaraththukku'l piraveasiththaarka'l.

pinpu moasea karththar isravealinimiththam paarvoanukkum ekipthiyarukkum seytha ellaavat'raiyum, vazhiyilea thangka'lukku nearitta ellaa varuththaththaiyum, karththar thangka'lai viduviththu iradchiththathaiyum than maamanukku vivariththuch sonnaan.
karththar isravealarai ekipthiyarin kaikkuth thappuviththu, avarka'lukkuch seytha sakala nanmaika'laiyungku'riththu eththiroa santhoashappattu:
ungka'lai ekipthiyarin kaikkum paarvoanin kaikkum thappuviththu, ekipthiyarudaiya kaiyin keezhiruntha janaththai viduviththa karththarukku sthoaththiram.
karththar ellaath theavarka'laippaarkkilum periyavar enpathai ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'rean; avarka'l idumpu seytha kaariyaththil avarka'lai mea'rko'ndaar en'ru solli;

moaseayin maamanaakiya eththiroa sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum mat'rap palika'laiyum theavanukkuk ko'nduvanthu seluththinaan. pinpu aaroanum israveal mooppar anaivarum vanthu, moaseayin maamanudanea theavasamukaththil poajanam pa'n'ninaarka'l.
ma'runaa'l moasea janangka'lai niyaayam visaarikka udkaarnthaan; janangka'l kaalamea thuvakkich saayangkaalamattum moaseakku munpaaka nin'raarka'l.

janangka'lukku avan seytha yaavaiyum moaseayin maaman ka'ndu: neer janangka'lukkuch seyki'ra inthak kaariyam enna? neer on'riyaay udkaarnthirukkavum, janangka'l ellaarum kaalamea thuvakkich saayangkaalamattum umakku munpaaka ni'rkavum vea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.
appozhuthu moasea than maamanai noakki: theavanidaththil visaarikkumpadi janangka'l ennidaththil varuki'raarka'l.

avarka'lukku yaathoru kaariyam u'ndaanaal, ennidaththil varuki'raarka'l; naan avarka'lukku'l'la vazhakkaith theerththu, theavakatta'laika'laiyum avarudaiya piramaa'nangka'laiyum therivikki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku moaseayin maaman: neer seyki'ra kaariyam nallathalla;
neerum ummoadea irukki'ra janangka'lum thoynthupoaveerka'l; ithu umakku mikavum paaramaana kaariyam; neer oruvaraay athaich seyya ummaalea koodaathu.

ippozhuthu en sollaikkea'lum, umakku oru aaloasanai solluki'rean; theavanum ummoadukooda iruppaar, neer theavasannithiyilea janangka'lukkaaka irum; viseashiththavaika'laith theavanidaththil ko'ndupoay;
katta'laika'laiyum piramaa'nangka'laiyum avarka'lukku ve'lippaduththi; avarka'l nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyaiyum, avarka'l seyyavea'ndiya kaariyaththaiyum avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththum.

janangka'l ellaarukku'l'lum theavanukkup payanthavarka'lum u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'lum poru'laasaiyai ve'rukki'ravarka'lumaana thi'ramaiyu'l'la manitharaith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'lai aayirampearukku athipathika'laakavum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'laakavum, aimpathupearukku athipathika'laakavum, paththuppearukku athipathika'laakavum ea'rpaduththum.

avarka'l eppozhuthum janangka'lai niyaayam visaariththu, periya kaariyangka'l yaavaiyum ummidaththil ko'nduvarattum, si'riya kaariyangka'l yaavaiyum thaangka'lea theerkkattum; ippadi avarka'l ummoadeakooda inthap paaraththaich sumanthaal, umakku ilakuvaayirukkum.

inthappirakaaram neer seyvathum, ippadith theavan umakkuk katta'laiyiduvathum u'ndaanaal, ummaalea thaangkakkoodum; intha janangka'l ellaarum thaangka'l poakum idaththukkuch sukamaayp poaych searalaam en'raan.
moasea than maaman solkeattu, avan sonnapadiyellaam seythaan.

moasea isravealar ellaarilum thi'ramaiyu'l'la manitharaith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'lai aayirampearukku athipathika'laakavum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'laakavum, aimpathupearukku athipathika'laakavum, paththuppearukku athipathika'laakavum janangka'lmeal thalaivaraakkinaan.

avarka'l eppozhuthum janangka'lai niyaayam visaariththaarka'l; varuththamaana kaariyangka'laimaaththiram moaseayinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; si'riya kaariyangka'laiyellaam thaangka'lea theerththaarka'l.
pinpu moasea than maamanai anuppivittaan; avan thirumpath than theasaththukkup poayvittaan.
israveal puththirar ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta moon'raam maatham muthalaam naa'lilea, seenaay vanaantharaththil searnthaarka'l.

avarka'l revitheemilirunthu pirayaa'nam pu'rappattu, seenaay vanaantharaththil searnthu, antha vanaantharaththil paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; isravealar angkea malaikku ethiraakap paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
moasea theavanidaththi'rku ea'rippoanaan; karththar malaiyilirunthu avanaik kooppittu: nee yaakkoapu vamsaththaarukkuch sollavum, israveal puththirarukku a'rivikkavum vea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,
naan ekipthiyarukkuch seythathaiyum, naan ungka'laik kazhukuka'ludaiya settaika'linmeal sumanthu, ungka'lai enna'ndaiyilea searththukko'ndathaiyum, neengka'l ka'ndirukki'reerka'l.
ippozhuthu neengka'l en vaakkai u'l'lapadi keattu, en udanpadikkaiyaik kaikko'lveerka'laanaal, sakala janangka'lilum neengka'lea enakkuch sontha sampaththaayiruppeerka'l; poomiyellaam ennudaiyathu.
neengka'l enakku aasaariya raajyamum parisuththa jaathiyumaay iruppeerka'l en'ru nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiya vaarththaika'l en'raar.
moasea vanthu janangka'lin moopparai azhaippiththu, karththar thanakkuk ka'rpiththa vaarththaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukku munpaakach sonnaan.
atha'rku janangka'l ellaarum eakamaay, karththar sonnavaika'laiyellaam seyvoam en'ru pirathiyuththaram sonnaarka'l. janangka'l sonna vaarththaika'lai moasea karththaridaththil theriviththaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: naan unnoadea peasumpoathu janangka'l keattu, unnai en'raikkum visuvaasikkumpadi, naan kaarmeakaththil unnidaththi'rku varuvean en'raar. janangka'l sonna vaarththaika'lai moasea karththarukkuch sonnaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki: nee janangka'lidaththil poay, in'raikkum naa'laikkum avarka'laip parisuththappaduththu; avarka'l thangka'l vasthirangka'laith thoayththu,
moon'raam naa'laikku aayaththappattirukkakkadavarka'l; moon'raam naa'lil karththar sakala janangka'lukkum piraththiyadchamaakach seenaaymalaiyinmeal i'rangkuvaar.

janangka'lukkuch sut'rilum nee oru ellai ku'riththu, avarka'l malaiyil ea'raathapadikkum, athin adivaaraththaith thodaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaay irungka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sol; malaiyaith thoduki'ravan evanum nichchayamaakavea kollappaduvaan.

oru kaiyum athaith thodalaakaathu; thottaal, nichchayamaakak kalle'riyu'ndu, allathu ooduruva eyyu'ndu saakavea'ndum; mirukamaanaalumsari, manithanaanaalumsari, uyiroadea vaikkappadalaakaathu; ekkaa'lam nedunthoniyaayth thonikkaiyil, avarka'l malaiyin adivaaraththil varakkadavarka'l en'raar.
moasea malaiyilirunthu i'rangki, janangka'lidaththil vanthu, avarka'laip parisuththappaduththinaan; avarka'l thangka'l vasthirangka'laith thoayththaarka'l.
avan janangka'lai noakki: moon'raam naa'lukku aayaththappattirungka'l, manaiviyinidaththil searaathirungka'l en'raan.

moon'raam naa'l vidiya'rkaalaththil idimuzhakkangka'lum minnalka'lum, malaiyinmeal kaarmeakamum makaa palaththa ekkaa'lasaththamum u'ndaayit'ru; paa'layaththiliruntha janangka'l ellaarum nadungkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu janangka'l theavanukku ethirko'ndupoaka, moasea avarka'laip paa'layaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaan; avarka'l malaiyin adivaaraththil nin'raarka'l.
karththar seenaaymalaiyinmeal akkiniyil i'rangkinapadiyaal, athu muzhuvathum pukaikkaadaay irunthathu; anthap pukai soo'laiyin pukaiyaippoala ezhumpit'ru; malai muzhuvathum mikavum athirnthathu.
ekkaa'lasaththam varavara mikavum palamaayth thoniththathu; moasea peasinaan; theavan avanukku vaakkinaal ma'rumozhi koduththaar.
karththar seenaaymalaiyilu'l'la kodumudiyil i'rangkinapoathu, karththar moaseayai malaiyin kodumudiyilea varavazhaiththaar; moasea ea'rippoanaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: janangka'l paarkki'ratha'rku ellaiyaik kadanthu karththaridaththil varaathapadikkum, avarka'lil aneakar azhinthu poakaathapadikkum, nee i'rangkippoay, avarka'lai u'ruthiyaaka echchari.
karththarin samukaththil varuki'ra aasaariyarka'lum, karththar thangka'lukku'l'lea sangkaaram pa'n'naathapadi, thangka'laip parisuththappaduththikko'l'la vea'ndum en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea karththarai noakki: malaiyaich sut'rilum ellai ku'riththu, athaip parisuththappaduththungka'l en'ru theavareer engka'lai u'ruthiyaaka echchariththirukki'reer; aakaiyaal, janangka'l seenaaymalaiyinmeal ea'rivaramaattaarka'l en'raan.

karththar moaseayai noakki: nee i'rangkippoa; pinpu neeyum aaroanum koodi ea'rivaarungka'l; aasaariyarka'lum janangka'lum, karththar thangka'lukku'l'lea sangkaarampa'n'naathapadikku, ellaiyaik kadanthu karththaridaththil varaathirukkakkadavarka'l en'raar.
appadiyea moasea i'rangki janangka'lidaththil poay, athai avarka'lukkuch sonnaan.
theavan peasich solliya sakala vaarththaika'lumaavana:
unnai adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaakiya karththar naanea.
ennaiyan'ri unakku vea'rea theavarka'l u'ndaayirukkavea'ndaam.
mealea vaanaththilum, keezhea poomiyilum, poomiyinkeezhth tha'n'neerilum u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lukku oppaana oru soroopaththaiyaakilum yaathoru vikkirakaththaiyaakilum nee unakku u'ndaakkavea'ndaam;

nee avaika'lai namaskarikkavum seavikkavum vea'ndaam; un theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'ra naan erichchalu'l'la theavanaayirunthu, ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'laik ku'riththup pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramaththaip pi'l'laika'lidaththil moon'raam naankaam thalaimu'raimattum visaarikki'ravaraayirukki'rean.
ennidaththil anpukoornthu, en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukkoa aayiram thalaimu'raimattum irakkagnseyki'ravaraayirukki'rean.
un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththai vee'nilea vazhangkaathiruppaayaaka; karththar thammudaiya naamaththai vee'nilea vazhangkuki'ravanaith tha'ndiyaamal vidaar.
oayvunaa'laip parisuththamaay aasarikka ninaippaayaaka;
aa'runaa'lum nee vealaiseythu, un kiriyaika'laiyellaam nadappippaayaaka;

eazhaamnaa'loa un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya oayvunaa'l; athilea neeyaanaalum, un kumaaranaanaalum, un kumaaraththiyaanaalum, un vealaikkaaranaanaalum, un vealaikkaariyaanaalum, un mirukajeevanaanaalum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra anniyanaanaalum, yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam.

karththar aa'runaa'laikku'l'lea vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum avaika'lilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum u'ndaakki, eazhaamnaa'lilea oaynthirunthaar; aakaiyaal, karththar oayvunaa'lai aaseervathiththu, athaip parisuththamaakkinaar.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukki'ra theasaththilea un naadka'l neediththiruppatha'rku, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka.
kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
vipasaaram seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
pi'ranukku viroathamaakap poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka.

pi'ranudaiya veettai ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka; pi'ranudaiya manaiviyaiyum, avanudaiya vealaikkaaranaiyum, avanudaiya vealaikkaariyaiyum, avanudaiya eruthaiyum, avanudaiya kazhuthaiyaiyum, pinnum pi'ranukku'l'la yaathon'raiyum ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka en'raar.
janangka'l ellaarum idimuzhakkangka'laiyum minnalka'laiyum ekkaa'lach saththaththaiyum malai pukaiki'rathaiyum ka'ndaarka'l; athaik ka'ndu, janangka'l pinvaangki, thooraththilea nin'ru,
moaseayai noakki: neer engka'loadea peasum, naangka'l keadpoam; theavan engka'loadea peasaathiruppaaraaka, peasinaal naangka'l seththuppoavoam en'raarka'l.

moasea janangka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l; ungka'laich soathippatha'rkaakavum, neengka'l paavagnseyyaathapadikkuth thammaip pat'rum payam ungka'l mukaththi'rku munpaaka iruppatha'rkaakavum, theavan ezhuntharu'linaar en'raan.
janangka'l thooraththilea nin'raarka'l; moasea, theavan iruntha kaarmeakaththukkuch sameepamaaych searnthaan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, naan vaanaththilirunthu ungka'loadea peasinean en'ru ka'ndeerka'l.
neengka'l enakku oppaaka ve'l'liyinaalea theyvangka'laiyum ponninaalea theyvangka'laiyum ungka'lukku u'ndaakkavea vea'ndaam.

ma'n'ninaalea palipeedaththai enakku u'ndaakki, athinmeal un aaduka'laiyum un maaduka'laiyum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum samaathaanapaliyaakavum seluththuvaayaaka; naan en naamaththaip pirasthaapappaduththum entha sthaanaththilum unnidaththil vanthu, unnai aaseervathippean.
enakkuk kallinaal palipeedaththai u'ndaakkavea'ndumaakil, athai vettina kalluka'laal kattavea'ndaam; athinmeal u'liyittavudanea, athai asusippaduththuvaay.
en palipeedaththinmeal un nirvaa'nam kaa'nappadaathapadikku, padika'laal athinmeal ea'ravum vea'ndaam.
mealum, nee avarka'lukku a'rivikkavea'ndiya piramaa'nangka'laavana:
epireyaril oru adimaiyaik ko'ndaayaanaal, avan aa'ruvarusham seaviththu, eazhaam varushaththilea on'rum kodaamal viduthalaipet'rup poakakkadavan.
on'rikkaaranaay vanthirunthaanaanaal, on'rikkaaranaayp poakakkadavan; vivaakampa'n'ninavanaay vanthirunthaanaanaal, avan pe'njaathi avanoadeakoodap poakakkadava'l.

avan ejamaan avanukku oru pe'n'nai vivaakagnseythukoduththum, ava'l avanukku aa'npi'l'laika'laiyaavathu pe'npi'l'laika'laiyaavathu pet'rum irunthaal, anthap pe'n'num ava'l pi'l'laika'lum ava'l ejamaanaich searakkadavarka'l; avan maaththiram on'riyaayp poakakkadavan.
antha vealaikkaaran: en ejamaanaiyum en pe'njaathiyaiyum en pi'l'laika'laiyum neasikki'rean; naan viduthalai pet'ruppoaka manathillai en'ru manappoorvamaaych solvaanaanaal,

avan ejamaan avanai niyaayaathipathika'lidaththil azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avanaik kathavin arukeayaavathu kathavunilaiyin arukeayaavathu searappa'n'ni, angkea avan ejamaan avan kaathaik kampiyinaalea kuththakkadavan; pinpu avan en'raikkum avanidaththilea seaviththukko'ndirukkakkadavan.
oruvan than maka'lai vealaikkaariyaaka vit'ruppoattaanaanaal, vealaikkaaran viduthalaipet'rup poavathupoala ava'l poakakkoodaathu.

ava'laith thanakku niyamiththuk ko'nda ejamaanin paarvaikku ava'l thakaathava'laayp poanaal, ava'l meedkappadalaam; avan ava'lukkuth thuroakampa'n'ni, ava'lai anniyar kaiyil vit'ruppoada avanukku athikaaram illai.
avan than kumaaranukku ava'lai niyamiththirunthaanaanaal, than kumaaraththika'lai nadaththuvathupoala ava'laiyum nadaththakkadavan.
avan vea'roru pe'n'naik ko'ndaanaakil, iva'lukkuriya annavasthira vivaakakkadamai aakiya ivaika'lil ku'raivuseyyaamal iruppaanaaka.
immoon'rum avan ava'lukkuch seyyaama'rpoanaal, ava'l pa'nangkodaamal viduthalaipet'ruppoakakkadava'l.
oru manithanaich saakumpadi adiththavan, nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
oruvan pathivirunthu kollaamal, theavachseyalaayth than kaikku nearittavanaik kon'raal, avan oadippoaych searavea'ndiya sthalaththai unakku niyamippean.
oruvan pi'ranukku viroathamaakach sathimoasagnseythu, avanaith thu'nikaramaayk kon'rupoattaal, avanai en palipeedaththilirunthum pidiththukko'ndupoayk kolaiseyyavea'ndum.
than thakappanaiyaavathu than thaayaiyaavathu adikki'ravan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
oruvan oru manithanaith thirudi vit'ruppoattaalum, ivan avan vasaththilirukkak ka'ndupidikkappattaalum, avan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
than thakappanaiyaavathu than thaayaiyaavathu sapikki'ravan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
manithar sa'ndaipa'n'ni, oruvan mat'roruvanaik kallaal e'rinthathinaalaavathu kaiyaal adiththathinaalaavathu avan saavaamal kattilkidaiyaayk kidanthu,

thirumpa ezhunthirunthu ve'liyilea than oon'rukoalaip pidiththukko'ndu nadamaadinaal, adiththavan aakkinaikku neengkalaayiruppaan; aanaalum, avanukku vealai minakketta nashdaththaik koduththu, avanai nan'raayk ku'namaakkuvikkakkadavan.
oruvan thanakku adimaiyaanavanaiyaavathu thanakku adimaiyaanava'laiyaavathu, koalaal adiththathinaalea, avan kaiyaal i'ranthupoanaal, pazhikkuppazhi vaangkappadavea'ndum.
oru naa'laavathu ira'ndu naa'laavathu uyiroadirunthaal, avarka'l avanudaiya udaimaiyaakaiyaal, pazhivaangkavea'ndiyathillai.

manithar sa'ndaipa'n'ni, karppavathiyaana oru sthireeyai adiththathinaal, ava'lukku vea'rea seathamillaamal karppam vizhunthupoanaal, adipatta sthireeyin purushan adiththavanmeal sumaththuki'ratha'rkuththakkathaayum niyaayaathipathika'l seyyum theerppinpadiyum tha'ndam kodukkavea'ndum.
vea'rea seathamu'ndaanaal, jeevanukku jeevan,
ka'n'nukkuk ka'n, pallukkup pal, kaikkuk kai, kaalukkuk kaal,
soottukkuch soodu, kaayaththukkuk kaayam, thazhumpukkuth thazhumpu pazhi kodukkavea'ndum.
oruvan than adimaiyaanavan ka'n'naiyaakilum than adimaippe'n'nin ka'n'naiyaakilum adiththathinaal athaik keduththaal, avan ka'n'nukkup pathilaaka avanai viduthalaipa'n'nividavea'ndum.
avan than adimaiyaanavan pallaiyaavathu than adimaippe'n'nin pallaiyaavathu uthira adiththaal, avan pallukkup pathilaaka avanai viduthalaipa'n'nividavea'ndum.

oru maadu oru purushanaiyaavathu oru sthireeyaiyaavathu muttinathinaal saavu'ndaanaal, antha maadu kalle'riyappadavea'ndum, athin maamsam pusikkappadalaakaathu; appozhuthu maattin ejamaan aakkinaikku neengkalaayiruppaan.

than maadu vazhakkamaay muttuki'ra maadaayirunthu, athu athin ejamaanukku a'rivikkappattum, avan athaik katti vaikkaathathinaal, athu oru purushanaiyaavathu oru sthireeyaiyaavathu kon'rupoattaal, maadum kalle'riyappadavea'ndum, athin ejamaanum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
aparaatham kodukkumpadi theerkkappattathaanaal, avan than jeevanai meedkumporu'laaka vithikkappatta aparaathaththaik kodukkakkadavan.
athu oruvan makanai muttinaalum sari, oruvan maka'lai muttinaalum sari, inthath theerppinpadiyea avanukkuch seyyappadavea'ndum.

antha maadu oru adimaiyaanavanaiyaavathu oru adimaippe'n'naiyaavathu muttinaal, atha'rku udaiyavan avarka'ludaiya ejamaanukku muppathu seakkal ni'raiyaana ve'l'liyaik kodukkakkadavan; maadu kalle'riyappadavea'ndum.
oruvan oru kuzhiyaith thi'ranthu vaiththathinaalaavathu, oru kuzhiyai vetti athai moodaatheapoanathinaalaavathu, athilea oru maadaavathu oru kazhuthaiyaavathu vizhunthaal,
kuzhikku udaiyavan atha'rku eedaakap pa'naththai mirukaththin ejamaanukkuk kodukkakkadavan; seththathoa avanudaiyathaakavea'ndum.
oruvanudaiya maadu mat'ravanudaiya maattai muttinathinaal athu seththaal, uyiroadirukki'ra maattai avarka'l vit'ru, athin kirayaththaip pangkittu, seththathaiyum pangkittukko'l'lakkadavarka'l.
antha maadu munnamea muttuki'ra maaden'ru athin ejamaan a'rinthirunthum, athaik kattivaikkaathirunthaal, avan maattukku maattaik kodukkakkadavan; seththathoa avanudaiyathaakavea'ndum.

oruvan oru maattaiyaavathu oru aattaiyaavathu thirudi, athaik kon'raal, allathu athai vit'raal, avan antha maattukku ainthu maaduka'laiyum, antha aattukku naalu aaduka'laiyum pathilaakak kodukkakkadavan.
thirudan kannamidukaiyil ka'ndupidikkappattu, adikkappattuch seththaal, avan nimiththam iraththappazhi sumaraathu.

sooriyan avanmeal uthiththirunthathaanaal, avan nimiththam iraththappazhi sumarum; thirudan pathil koduththuth theerkkavea'ndum; avan kaiyil on'rum illaathirunthaal, thaan seytha ka'lavukkaaka vilaippadakkadavan.
avan thirudina maadaavathu kazhuthaiyaavathu aadaavathu uyirudanea avan kaiyil ka'ndupidikkappattaal, irattippaay avan kodukkavea'ndum.

oruvan pi'ranudaiya vayalilaavathu thiraadchaththoattaththilaavathu than mirukajeevanai meayavittaal, avan than suyavayalilum thiraadchaththoattaththilumu'l'la palanil uththamamaanathai eduththu, pathil seluththakkadavan.

akkini ezhumpi, mudka'lil pat'ri, thaaniyappoaraiyaavathu, vi'laintha payiraiyaavathu, vayalilu'l'la vea'rea ethaiyaavathu eriththuppoattatheayaanaal, akkiniyaik ko'luththinavan akkinich seathaththi'rku uththaravaatham pa'n'navea'ndum.

oruvan pi'ranudaiya vasaththil thiraviyaththaiyaavathu, udaimaika'laiyaavathu adaikkalamaaka vaiththirukkumpoathu, athu avan veettilirunthu thirudappattuppoanaal, thirudan akappattaanaakil, avan atha'rku irattippaakak kodukkavea'ndum.
thirudan akappadaatheapoanaal, antha veettukkaaran thaanea pi'ranudaiya poru'lai apakariththaanoa illaiyoa en'ru a'riyumpadi niyaayaathipathika'lidaththil avanaik ko'ndupoakavea'ndum.

kaa'naama'rpoana maadu, kazhuthai, aadu, vasthiram muthaliyavaika'lil yaathon'raip pi'ranoruvan thannudaiyathu en'ru sollik kut'ragnsaat'rinaal, iruthi'raththaarudaiya vazhakkum niyaayaathipathika'lidaththil varakkadavathu; niyaayaathipathika'l evanaik kut'ravaa'li en'ru theerkki'raarka'loa, avan mat'ravanukku irattippaakak kodukkakkadavan.

oruvan than kazhuthaiyaiyaavathu maattaiyaavathu aattaiyaavathu mat'ra yaathoru mirukajeevanaiyaavathu pi'ran vasaththil vittirukkumpoathu, athu seththaalum, seathappattuppoanaalum, oruvarum kaa'naathapadi oattikko'ndu poakappattaalum,

avan thaan pi'ranudaiya poru'lai apakarikkavillaiyen'ru karththar pearil idum aa'nai avarka'l iruvarukkum naduththeerkkakkadavathu; udaiyavan athai angkikarikkavea'ndum; mat'ravan pathila'likkavea'nduvathillai.
athu avan vasaththilirunthu thirudappattuppoayit'raanaal, avan athin ejamaanukku atha'rkaaka uththaravaatham pa'n'nakkadavan.
athu pee'ru'ndupoayit'raanaal, atha'rkuch saadchiyai oppuvikkavea'ndum. pee'ru'ndatha'rkaaka avan uththaravaatham pa'n'navea'nduvathillai.
oruvan pi'ranidaththil ethaiyaakilum iravalaaka vaangkinathu'ndaanaal, atha'rku udaiyavan kooda iraathapoathu, athu seathappattaalum, seththuppoanaalum, avan atha'rku uththaravaathampa'n'navea'ndum.
atha'rku udaiyavan kooda irunthaanaakil, avan uththaravaatham pa'n'navea'nduvathillai; athu vaadakaikku vaangkappattirunthaal, athu avan vaadakaikku vantha seatham.
niyamikkappadaatha oru kannikaiyai oruvan moasampoakki ava'loadea sayaniththaal, avan ava'lukkaakap parisamkoduththu, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nakkadavan.
ava'l thakappan ava'lai avanukkuk kodukkamaattean en'raanaakil, kannikaika'lukkaakak kodukkappadum parisa mu'raimaiyinpadi avan pa'naththai ni'ruththuk kodukkavea'ndum.
sooniyakkaariyai uyiroadea vaikkavea'ndaam.
mirukaththoadea pu'naruki'ravan evanum kollappadavea'ndum.
karththar oruvarukkea ozhiya vea'rea theavarka'lukkup paliyiduki'ravan sangkarikkappadakkadavan.
anniyanaich si'rumaippaduththaamalum odukkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; neengka'lum ekipthu theasaththil anniyarka'laayiruntheerka'lea.
vithavaiyaiyum thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum odukkaamal iruppeerka'laaka;
avarka'lai evva'lavaakilum odukkumpoathu, avarka'l ennai noakki mu'raiyittaal, avarka'l mu'raiyiduthalai naan nichchayamaayk keattu,
koapammoo'ndavaraaki, ungka'laip pattayaththinaal kolaiseyvean; ungka'l manaivika'l vithavaika'lum, ungka'l pi'l'laika'l thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lumaavaarka'l.
ungka'lukku'l si'rumaippattirukki'ra en janangka'lil oruvanukku neengka'l pa'nam kadanaakak koduththirunthaal, vattivaangkuki'ravarka'lpoala avanidaththil vatti vaangkavea'ndaam.
pi'ranudaiya vasthiraththai eedaaka vaangkinaal, pozhuthupoakumunnamea athai avanukkuth thirumpak koduththu viduvaayaaka.

avan poarvai athuthaanea, athuvea avan than udampai moodikko'l'luki'ra vasthiram; vea'ru ethinaalea poarththup paduththukko'l'luvaan? avan ennai noakki mu'raiyidumpoathu, naan avanukkuch sevikoduppean, naan irakkamu'l'lavaraayirukki'rean.
niyaayaathipathika'laith thooshiyaamalum, un janaththin athipathiyaich sapiyaamalum iruppaayaaka.
muthal muthal pazhukkum un pazhaththaiyum, vadiyum un irasaththaiyum kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththath thaamathikkavea'ndaam. un kumaararil mutha'rpea'raanavanai enakkuk koduppaayaaka.
un maaduka'lilum un aaduka'lilum appadiyea seyvaayaaka; kuttiyaanathu eazhunaa'l than thaayoadea irukkattum; ettaam naa'lilea athai enakkuch seluththuvaayaaka.
neengka'l enakkup parisuththa manusharaayirukkakkadaveerka'l; ve'liyilea pee'ru'nda maamsaththaip pusiyaamal, athai naayka'lukkup poattuvidungka'l.
apaa'ndamaana sollai eat'rukko'l'laayaaka; kodumaiyu'l'la saadchikkaaranaayirukka aakaathavanoadea kalavaayaaka.
theemaiseyya thira'laanapearka'laip pinpat'raathiruppaayaaka; vazhakkilea niyaayaththaip puratta mikuthiyaanavarka'lin padchaththil saaynthu, uththaravu sollaathiruppaayaaka.
viyaachchiyaththilea thariththiranudaiya mukaththaip paaraayaaka.
un saththuruvin maadaavathu avanudaiya kazhuthaiyaavathu thappippoakakka'ndaal, athaith thirumpa avanidaththil ko'ndupoay viduvaayaaka.
unnaip pakaikki'ravanudaiya kazhuthai sumaiyoadea vizhunthukidakkak ka'ndaayaanaal, atha'rku uthaviseyyaathirukkalaamaa? avasiyamaay avanoadea kooda atha'rku uthaviseyvaayaaka.
unnidaththilirukki'ra e'liyavanudaiya viyaachchiyaththil avanudaiya niyaayaththaip purattaayaaka.
ka'l'lakkaariyaththukkuth thooramaayiruppaayaaka; kut'ramillaathavanaiyum neethimaanaiyum kolaiseyyaayaaka; naan thunmaarkkanai neethimaan en'ru theerkkamaattean.
parithaanam vaangkaathiruppaayaaka; parithaanam paarvaiyu'l'lavarka'laik kurudaakki, neethimaanka'lin vaarththaika'laip purattum.
anniyanai odukkaayaaka; ekipthu theasaththil anniyarka'laayiruntha neengka'l anniyanudaiya iruthayaththai a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
aa'ruvarusham nee un nilaththil payirittu, athin palanaich searththukko'l.

eazhaam varushaththil un janaththilu'l'la e'liyavarka'l pusikkavum, meethiyaanathai ve'liyin jenthukka'l thinnavum, antha nilam summaa kidakka vittuviduvaayaaka; un thiraadchaththoattaththaiyum un olivaththoappaiyum appadiyea seyvaayaaka.
aa'runaa'l un vealaiyaich seythu, eazhaamnaa'lilea un maadum un kazhuthaiyum i'laippaa'ravum, un adimaippe'n'nin pi'l'laiyum anniyanum i'laippaa'ravum oaynthiruppaayaaka.
naan ungka'lukkuch sonnavaika'l yaavat'rilum saavathaanamaayirungka'l. anniya theavarka'lin pearaich sollavea'ndaam; athu un vaayilirunthu pi'rakkak keadkappadavum vea'ndaam.
varushaththil moon'rutharam enakkup pa'ndikai aasarippaayaaka.

pu'lippillaa appappa'ndikaiyaik ko'ndaadi, naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea aapip maathaththin ku'riththa kaalaththil eazhunaa'l pu'lippillaa appam pusippaayaaka; antha maathaththil ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattaayea, en sannithiyil ve'rungkaiyaay varavea'ndaam.

nee vayalil vithaiththa un payir vealaika'lin mutha'rpalanaich seluththuki'ra a'ruppukkaala pa'ndikaiyaiyum, varushamudivilea nee vayalil un vealaika'lin palanaich searththuth theernthapoathu, searppukkaala pa'ndikaiyaiyum aasarippaayaaka.
varushaththil moon'rutharam un aa'nmakka'l ellaarum karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya sannithiyil varakkadavarka'l.
enakku idum paliyin iraththaththaip pu'liththamaavudan seluththavea'ndaam, enakku idum paliyin kozhuppai vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum vaikkavum vea'ndaam.
un nilaththil muthal vi'laichchalka'lil mutha'r kaniyai un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'ndu varuvaayaaka; ve'l'laattukkuttiyai athin thaayin paalilea samaikkavea'ndaam.
vazhiyil unnaik kaakki'ratha'rkum, naan aayaththampa'n'nina sthaanaththukku unnaik ko'ndupoaych searkki'ratha'rkum, ithoa, naan oru thoothanai unakku munnea anuppuki'rean.
avar samukaththil echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, avar vaakkukkuch sevikodu; avaraik koapappaduththaathea; ungka'l thuroakangka'lai avar po'ruppathillai; en naamam avar u'l'laththil irukki'rathu.
nee avar vaakkai nan'raayk keattu, naan solvathaiyellaam seyvaayaakil, naan un saththurukka'lukkuch saththuruvaayum, un viroathika'lukku viroathiyaayum iruppean.
en thoothanaanavar unakku munsen'ru, emoariyarum eaththiyarum perisiyarum kaanaaniyarum eaviyarum epoosiyarum irukki'ra idaththukku unnai nadaththikko'ndupoavaar; avarka'lai naan athampa'n'nuvean.
nee avarka'ludaiya theavarka'laip pa'ninthuko'l'laamalum, seaviyaamalum, avarka'l seykaika'linpadi seyyaamalum, avarka'lai nirmoolampa'n'ni, avarka'ludaiya silaika'lai udaiththuppoaduvaayaaka.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraiyea seavikkakkadaveerka'l; avar un appaththaiyum un tha'n'neeraiyum aaseervathippaar. viyaathiyai unnilirunthu vilakkuvean.
karppam vizhuki'rathum maladum un theasaththil iruppathillai; un aayusunaadka'laip poora'nappaduththuvean.
enakkup payappadum payaththai unakkumun sellumpadi seyvean. nee sellum idamengkumu'l'la janangka'l ellaaraiyum kalangkadiththu, un saththurukka'l ellaaraiyum muthuku kaattappa'n'nuvean.
un mukaththi'rku munnin'ru eaviyaraiyum kaanaaniyaraiyum eaththiyaraiyum thuraththivida, ku'lavika'lai unakku munnea anuppuvean.
theasam paazhaayppoakaamalum, kaattumirukangka'l unakku viroathamaayp perukaamalum irukkumpadi, naan avarka'lai orea varushaththi'rku'l'lea un munnin'ru thuraththividaamal,
nee viruththiyadainthu, theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumvaraikkum, avarka'laik kogncham kognchamaay un munnin'ru thuraththividuvean.

sivantha samuththiram thodangki pelistharin samuththiramvaraikkum, vanaantharam thodangki nathivaraikkum un ellaiyaayirukkumpadi seyvean; naan anthath theasaththin kudika'lai ungka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppean; nee avarka'lai un munnin'ru thuraththividuvaay.
avarka'loadum avarka'l theavarka'loadum nee udanpadikkai pa'n'naathiruppaayaaka.
avarka'l unnai enakku viroathamaakap paavagn seyyappa'n'naathapadikku un theasaththilea kudiyirukkavea'ndaam; nee avarka'l theavarka'laich seaviththaal, athu unakkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkum en'raar.
pinpu avar moaseayai noakki: neeyum aaroanum naathaapum apiyoovum isravealin moopparil ezhupathupearum karththaridaththil ea'rivanthu, thooraththilirunthu pa'ninthuko'l'lungka'l.
moasea maaththiram karththaridaththil sameepiththu varalaam; avarka'l sameepiththu varalaakaathu; janangka'l avanoadeakooda ea'rivaravea'ndaam en'raar.

moasea vanthu, karththarudaiya vaarththaika'l yaavaiyum niyaayangka'l yaavaiyum janangka'lukku a'riviththaan; appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum eakasaththamaay: karththar aru'lina ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyum seyvoam en'ru pirathiyuththaram sonnaarka'l.

moasea karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laiyellaam ezhuthivaiththu, athikaalamea ezhunthu, malaiyin adiyil oru palipeedaththaik katti, isravealudaiya pannira'ndu koaththirangka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea pannira'ndu thoo'nka'lai ni'ruththinaan.
israveal puththirarin vaaliparai anuppinaan; avarka'l sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththi, karththarukkuch samaathaanapalika'laakak kaa'laika'laip paliyittaarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea antha iraththaththil paathi eduththu, paaththirangka'lil vaarththu, paathi iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal the'liththu,
udanpadikkaiyin pusthakaththai eduththu, janangka'lin kaathu keadka vaasiththaan; avarka'l karththar sonnapadiyellaam seythu, keezhppadinthu nadappoam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea iraththaththai eduththu, janangka'linmeal the'liththu, intha vaarththaika'l yaavaiyungku'riththu karththar ungka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyin iraththam ithuvea en'raan.
pinpu moaseayum aaroanum naathaapum apiyoovum, isravealarudaiya moopparil ezhupathupearum ea'rippoay,
isravealin theavanaith tharisiththaarka'l. avarudaiya paathaththinkeezhea neelakkallizhaiththa vealaikku oppaakavum the'lintha vaanaththin pirapaikku oppaakavum irunthathu.
avar israveal puththirarudaiya athipathika'lmeal thammudaiya kaiyai neettavillai; avarka'l theavanaith tharisiththu, pinpu pusiththuk kudiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee malaiyinmeal ennidaththi'rku ea'rivanthu, angkea iru; naan unakkuk ka'rpalakaika'laiyum, nee avarka'lukku upatheasippatha'rku, naan ezhuthina niyaayappiramaa'naththaiyum ka'rpanaika'laiyum koduppean en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea than oozhiyakkaaranaakiya yoasuvaavoadea ezhunthu poanaan. moasea theava parvathaththil ea'rippoakaiyil,

avan moopparai noakki: naangka'l ungka'lidaththil thirumpivarumattum, neengka'l ingkea engka'lukkaakak kaaththirungka'l; aaroanum oorum ungka'lidaththil irukki'raarka'l; oruvanukku yaathoru kaariyam u'ndaanaal, avan avarka'lidaththil poakalaam en'raan.
moasea malaiyinmeal ea'rinapoathu, oru meakam malaiyai moodit'ru.
karththarudaiya makimai seenaaymalaiyinmeal thangkiyirunthathu; meakam aa'runaa'l athai moodiyirunthathu; eazhaam naa'lil avar meakaththin naduvilirunthu moaseayaik kooppittaar.
malaiyin kodumudiyilea karththarudaiya makimaiyin kaadchi israveal puththirarudaiya ka'nka'lukkup padchikki'ra akkiniyaippoal irunthathu.
moasea meakaththin naduvilea piraveasiththu, malaiyinmeal ea'ri, iravum pakalum naa'rpathunaa'l malaiyil irunthaan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
israveal puththirar enakkuk kaa'nikkaiyaik ko'nduvarumpadi avarka'lukkuch sollu; manappoorvamaay u'rchaakaththudan koduppavan evanoa avanidaththil enakkuk kaa'nikkaiyai vaangkuveerka'laaka.
neengka'l avarka'lidaththil vaangkavea'ndiya kaa'nikkaiyaavana, ponnum, ve'l'liyum, ve'nkalamum,
i'laneelanoolum, iraththaamparanoolum, sivappunoolum, melliya pagnchunoolum, ve'l'laattumayirum,
sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaaththoalum, thakasuththoalum, seeththim maramum,
vi'lakke'n'neyum, apisheakathailaththukkup parima'lavarkkangka'lum, thoopaththukkuch sukanthavarkkangka'lum,
eapoaththilum maarppathakkaththilum pathikkum koameathakak ka'rka'lum iraththinangka'lumea.
avarka'l naduvilea naan vaasampa'n'na, enakku oru parisuththa sthalaththai u'ndaakkuvaarka'laaka.
naan unakkuk kaa'npikkum vaasasthalaththin maathiriyinpadiyum, athinudaiya ellaath thattumuttuka'lin maathiriyinpadiyum athaich seyveerka'laaka.
seeththim maraththinaal oru pettiyaip pa'n'nakkadavarka'l; athin nee'lam ira'ndarai muzhamum, athin akalam on'rarai muzhamum, athin uyaram on'rarai muzhamumaayiruppathaaka.
athai engkum pasumponthakattaal mooduvaayaaka; nee athin udpu'raththaiyum ve'lippu'raththaiyum athinaal moodi, athinmeal sut'rilum ponninaal thira'naiyai u'ndaakki,

atha'rku naalu pon va'laiyangka'lai vaarppiththu, avaika'lai athin naalu moolaika'lilum poattu, oru pakkaththil ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lum, ma'rupakkaththil ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lum irukkumpadi thaiththu,
seeththim maraththaal tha'nduka'laich seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi,
anthath tha'nduka'laal pettiyaich sumakkumpadi, avaika'laip pettiyin pakkangka'lilirukkum va'laiyangka'lilea paaychchakkadavaay.
anthath tha'nduka'l pettiyilirunthu kazhat'rappadaamal, athin va'laiyangka'lilea irukkavea'ndum.
naan unakkuk kodukkum saadchip piramaa'naththai anthap pettiyilea vaippaayaaka.
pasumponninaalea kirupaasanaththaip pa'n'nuvaayaaka; athu ira'ndarai muzha nee'lamum on'rarai muzha akalamumaay irukkakkadavathu.
ponninaal ira'ndu kearupeenka'laich seyvaayaaka; ponnaith thakadaay adiththu, avaika'laich seythu, kirupaasanaththin ira'ndu oarangka'lilum vaippaayaaka.

oru pu'raththu oaraththil oru kearupeenaiyum ma'rupu'raththu oaraththil mat'rak kearupeenaiyum pa'n'nivai; anthak kearupeenka'l kirupaasanaththin ira'ndu oarangka'lilum athanoadea eakavealaiyaayirukkumpadi, avaika'laip pa'n'nakkadavaay.

anthak kearupeenka'l thangka'l settaika'lai uyara viriththu, thangka'l settaika'laal kirupaasanaththai mooduki'ravaika'lum on'rukkon'ru ethirmukamu'l'lavaika'lumaay irukkakkadavathu; kearupeenka'lin mukangka'l kirupaasanaththai noakkuki'ravaika'laayiruppathaaka.
kirupaasanaththaip pettiyinmeethil vaiththu, pettikku'l'lea naan unakkuk kodukkum saadchippiramaa'naththai vaippaayaaka.

angkea naan unnaich santhippean; kirupaasanaththinmeethilum saadchippettiyinmeal ni'rkum ira'ndu kearupeenka'lin naduvilum irunthu naan israveal puththirarukkaaka unakkuk ka'rpikkap poaki'ravaika'laiyellaam unnoadea solluvean.
seeththim maraththaal oru meajaiyaiyum pa'n'nuvaayaaka; athu ira'ndu muzha nee'lamum oru muzha akalamum on'rarai muzha uyaramumaay irukkakkadavathu.
athaip pasumponthakattaal moodi, sut'rilum atha'rkup ponninaal thira'naiyai u'ndaakki,
sut'rilum atha'rku naalu vira'rkadaiyaana sattaththaiyum, athin sattaththi'rkuch sut'rilum ponninaal thira'naiyaiyum u'ndaakki,
atha'rku naalu ponva'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni, avaika'lai athin naalu kaalka'lukku irukkum naalu moolaika'lilum thaikkakkadavaay.
antha va'laiyangka'l meajaiyaich sumakkum tha'nduka'lukku idangka'laayirukkumpadi, sattaththin arukea irukkavea'ndum.
anthath tha'nduka'laich seeththim maraththinaal seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodakkadavaay; avaika'laal meajai sumakkappadavea'ndum.
atha'rkuriya thattuka'laiyum, thoopakkara'ndika'laiyum, ki'n'nangka'laiyum, paanapali karakangka'laiyum pa'n'nakkadavaay; avaika'laip pasumponninaal pa'n'nakkadavaay.
meajaiyinmeal niththamum en sannithiyil samukaththappangka'lai vaikkakkadavaay.

pasumponninaal oru kuththuvi'lakkaiyum u'ndaakkuvaayaaka; athu ponninaal adippuvealaiyaaych seyyappadavea'ndum; athin tha'ndum ki'laika'lum mokkuka'lum pazhangka'lum pookka'lum ponninaal seyyappadavea'ndum.
aa'ru ki'laika'l athin pakkangka'lil vidavea'ndum; kuththuvi'lakkin moon'ru ki'laika'l athin oru pakkaththilum, kuththuvi'lakkin moon'ru ki'laika'l athin ma'rupakkaththilum vidavea'ndum.
ovvoru ki'laiyilea vaathumaikkottaikku oppaana moon'ru mokkuka'lum, oru pazhamum, oru poovum iruppathaaka; kuththuvi'lakkilirunthu pu'rappadum aa'ru ki'laika'lilum appadiyea irukkavea'ndum.
vi'lakkuththa'ndiloa, vaathumaikkottaikku oppaana naalu mokkuka'lum, pazhangka'lum, pookka'lum iruppathaaka.

athilirunthu pu'rappadum ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum, vea'ru ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum, mat'ra ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum iruppathaaka; vi'lakkuththa'ndilirunthu pu'rappadum aa'ru ki'laika'lukkum appadiyea irukkavea'ndum.
avaika'lin pazhangka'lum avaika'lin ki'laika'lum ponninaal u'ndaanavaika'laayiruppathaaka; avaiyellaam thakadaay adiththa pasumponnaal seyyappatta orea vealaiyaayirukkavea'ndum.
athil eazhu akalka'laich seyvaayaaka; atha'rku nearethiraay eriyumpadikku avaika'l eat'rappadakkadavathu.
athin kaththarika'lum saampal paaththirangka'lum pasumponninaal seyyappaduvathaaka.
athaiyum atha'rkuriya pa'nimuttuka'l yaavaiyum oru thaalanthu pasumponninaal pa'n'navea'ndum.
malaiyilea unakkuk kaa'npikkappatta maathiriyinpadiyea avaika'laich seyya echcharikkaiyaayiru.

mealum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolinaalum i'laneelanoolinaalum iraththaamparanoolinaalum sivappunoolinaalum neyyappatta paththu mooduthiraika'laal vaasasthalaththai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; avaika'lil visiththiravealaiyaayk kearupeenka'laich seyyakkadavaay.
ovvoru mooduthiraiyum irupaththettu muzha nee'lamum naalu muzha akalamumaayiruppathaaka; mooduthiraika'lellaam orea a'lavaayirukkavea'ndum.
ainthu mooduthirai on'roadon'ru i'naikkappattirukkavea'ndum; mat'ra ainthu mooduthiraika'lum on'roadon'ru i'naikkappattirukkavea'ndum.
i'naikkappatta oru mooduthiraiyin kadai oaraththil i'laneelanoolaal kaathuka'lai u'ndupa'n'nu; i'naikkappatta mat'ra mooduthiraiyin kadai oaraththilum appadiyea seyvaayaaka.
kaathuka'l on'roadon'ru i'naiyumpadi oru mooduthiraiyil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum, i'naikkappatta mat'ra mooduthiraiyin oaraththil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
aimpathu pon kokkika'laiyum pa'n'ni, mooduthiraika'lai on'roadon'ru anthak kokkika'laal i'naiththuviduvaayaaka. appozhuthu athu orea vaasasthalamaakum.
vaasasthalaththinmeal koodaaramaakap poadumpadi aattumayiraal pathinoru mooduthiraika'lai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
ovvoru mooduthirai muppathu muzha nee'lamum naalu muzha akalamumaay irukkavea'ndum; pathinoru mooduthiraika'lum orea a'lavaayirukkavea'ndum.
ainthu mooduthiraika'lai on'raakavum, aa'ru mooduthiraika'lai on'raakavum i'naikkavea'ndum; aa'raam mooduthiraiyaik koodaaraththin mukappi'rku munnea madiththuppoaduvaayaaka.
i'naikkappatta oru mooduthiraiyin kadai oaraththil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum, i'naikkappatta mat'ra mooduthiraiyin oaraththil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ni,
aimpathu ve'nkalak kokkika'laichseythu, kokkika'laik kaathuka'lil maatti, orea koodaaramaakumpadi athai i'naiththu viduvaayaaka.
koodaaraththin mooduthiraika'lil michchamaana paathi mooduthirai vaasasthalaththin pinpu'raththil thongkavea'ndum.

koodaaraththinudaiya mooduthiraika'lin nee'laththilea meethiyaanathil, inthappu'raththil oru muzhamum anthappu'raththil oru muzhamum vaasasthalaththai moodumpadi athin pakkangka'lilea thongkavea'ndum.
sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaath thoalinaal koodaaraththi'rku oru moodiyaiyum, athinmeal thakasuththoalaal oru moodiyaiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
vaasasthalaththukku nimirnthuni'rkum palakaika'laiyum seeththim maraththaal u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
ovvoru palakaiyum paththu muzha nee'lamum on'rarai muzha akalamumaay irukkavea'ndum.
ovvoru palakaikkum on'roadon'ru oththu isainthirukkum ira'ndu kazhunthuka'l irukkavea'ndum; vaasasthalaththin palakaika'lukkellaam ippadiyea seyvaayaaka.
vaasasthalaththukkaakach seyyappaduki'ra palakaika'lil irupathu palakai the'rkea thenthisaikku ethiraaka ni'rkakkadavathu.

antha irupathu palakaika'linkeezhea vaikkum naa'rpathu ve'l'lip paathangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; oru palakaiyin keezh athin ira'ndu kazhunthuka'lukkum ira'ndu paathangka'lum, mat'rap palakaiyin keezh athin ira'ndu kazhunthuka'lukkum ira'ndu paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
vaasasthalaththin ma'rupakkamaakiya vadapu'raththilum irupathu palakaika'laiyum,
avaika'linkeezh naa'rpathu ve'l'lip paathangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; oru palakaiyinkeezh ira'ndu paathangka'lum, mat'rap palakaiyinkeezh ira'ndu paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
vaasasthalaththin mea'rpu'raththi'rku aa'ru palakaika'laiyum,
vaasasthalaththin irupakkaththilumu'l'la moolaika'lukku ira'ndu palakaika'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
avaika'l keezhea isaikkappattirukkavea'ndum; mealeayum oru va'laiyaththinaal isaikkappattirukkavea'ndum; ira'ndu moolaika'lukkum appadiyea irukkavea'ndum; avaika'l ira'ndu moolaika'lukkaakum.
anthappadi ettup palakaika'l irukkavea'ndum; ovvoru palakaiyin keezh ira'ndu ira'ndu paathangka'laakap pathinaa'ru ve'l'lip paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
seeththim maraththaal vaasasthalaththin oru pakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum,
vaasasthalaththin ma'rupakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum, vaasasthalaththin mea'rpu'ramaana pinpakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum pa'n'nuvaayaaka.
naduththaazhppaa'l oru munaithodangki ma'rumunaimattum palakaika'lin maiyaththil uruvap paaychchappattirukkavea'ndum.
palakaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi, thaazhppaa'lka'lin idangka'laakiya avaika'lin va'laiyangka'laip ponninaal pa'n'ni, thaazhppaa'lka'laip pon thakattaal moodakkadavaay.
ivvithamaaka malaiyinmeal unakkuk kaa'npikkappatta maathiriyinpadiyea vaasasthalaththai ni'ruththuvaayaaka.

i'laneelanoolum iraththaamparanoolum sivappunoolum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolumaana ivat'raal oru thiraichseelaiyai u'ndupa'n'nakkadavaay; athilea visiththiravealaiyaal seyyappatta kearupeenka'l vaikkappadavea'ndum.

seeththim maraththinaal seythu, pon thakattaal moodappatta naalu thoo'nka'lilea athaith thongkavidu; anthath thoo'nka'l naalu ve'l'lip paathangka'lmeal ni'rkavum, avaika'lin kokkika'l ponninaal seyyappadavum vea'ndum.

kokkika'linkeezhea anthath thiraichseelaiyaith thongkavittu, saadchippettiyai angkea thiraikku'l'laaka vaikkakkadavaay; anthath thiraichseelai parisuththa sthalaththi'rkum makaa parisuththa sthalaththi'rkum pirivai u'ndaakkum.
makaa parisuththa sthalaththilea saadchippettiyinmeethil kirupaasanaththai vaippaayaaka;
thiraikkup pu'rampaaka meajaiyaiyum, meajaikku ethirea vaasasthalaththin thenpu'ramaakak kuththuvi'lakkaiyum vaiththu, meajaiyai vadapu'ramaaka vaippaayaaka.
i'laneelanoolum iraththaamparanoolum sivappunoolum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolumaakiya ivat'raal siththirath thaiyal vealaiyaana oru thongkuthiraiyum koodaaraththin vaasalukku u'ndaakki,

anthath thongkuthiraikkuch seeththim maraththaal ainthu thoo'nka'laich seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi, avaika'lukkup pon kokkika'lai u'ndaakki, avaika'lukku ainthu ve'nkalap paathangka'lai vaarppikkakkadavaay.
ainthu muzha nee'lamum ainthu muzha akalamumaaka seeththim maraththaal palipeedaththaiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; athu sathuramum moon'ru muzha uyaramumaayiruppathaaka.
athin naalu moolaika'lilum naalu kompuka'lai u'ndaakkuvaayaaka; athin kompuka'l athanoadea eakamaay irukkavea'ndum; athai ve'nkalath thakattaal moodavea'ndum.

athin saampalai edukkaththakka sattika'laiyum kara'ndika'laiyum ki'n'nika'laiyum mu'lthu'raduka'laiyum neruppuchsattika'laiyum u'ndaakkuvaayaaka; athin pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam ve'nkalaththaal pa'n'nuvaayaaka.
valaippinnalpoan'ra oru ve'nkalach salladaiyaip pa'n'ni, anthach salladaiyin naalu moolaika'lilum naalu ve'nkala va'laiyangka'lai u'ndaakki,
anthach salladai palipeedaththin paathiyuyaraththil irukkumpadi athaith thaazhap palipeedaththin sut'radaippukkuk keezhaaka vaippaayaaka.
palipeedaththukkuch seeththim maraththaal tha'nduka'laiyum pa'n'ni, avaika'lai ve'nkalaththakattaal mooduvaayaaka.
palipeedaththaich sumakkaththakkathaaka anthath tha'nduka'l athin ira'ndu pakkangka'lilum va'laiyangka'lilea paaychchappattirukkavea'ndum.
athai u'l ve'livittup palakaika'linaalea pa'n'navea'ndum; malaiyil unakkuk kaa'npikkappattapadiyea athaip pa'n'nakkadavarka'l.

vaasasthalaththukkup piraakaaraththaiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; the'rkea thenthisaikku ethiraana piraakaaraththukkuth thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaal seyyappatta noo'rumuzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'l irukkavea'ndum.
avaika'lukku ve'nkalaththinaalea irupathu thoo'nka'lum, irupathu paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum avaika'lin poo'nka'lum ve'l'liyinaal seyyappadavea'ndum.

appadiyea vadapakkaththin nee'laththi'rkum noo'rumuzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'l irukkavea'ndum; avaika'lukku irupathu thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lukku irupathu paathangka'lum ve'nkalamaayirukkavea'ndum; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum poo'nka'lum ve'l'liyinaal seyyappadavea'ndum.

piraakaaraththin mea'rpakkamaana akalaththi'rku aimpathu muzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'l irukkavea'ndum; avaika'lukkup paththuth thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lukkup paththup paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
sooriyan uthikki'ra thisaiyaakiya keezhppakkaththin piraakaaram aimpathumuzha akalamaayirukkavea'ndum.
angkea oru pu'raththi'rkup pathinainthu muzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'lum, avaika'lukku moon'ru thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lukku moon'ru paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
ma'rupu'raththukkup pathinainthu muzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'lum, avaika'lukku moon'ru thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lukku moon'ru paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.

piraakaaraththin vaasalukku i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum siththirath thaiyalvealaiyaaych seyyappatta irupathumuzha nee'lamaana oru thongkuthiraiyum atha'rku naalu thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lukku naalu paathangka'lum irukkavea'ndum.
sut'rup piraakaaraththin thoo'nka'lellaam ve'l'liyinaal poo'n kattappattirukkavea'ndum; avaika'lin kokkika'l ve'l'liyinaalum avaika'lin paathangka'l ve'nkalaththinaalum seyyappattirukkavea'ndum.

piraakaaraththin nee'lam noo'rumuzhamum, irupu'raththu akalam aimpathu aimpathu muzhamum, uyaram ainthu muzhamumaayiruppathaaka; athin thongkalka'l thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolinaal seyyappattu, athin thoo'nka'lin paathangka'l ve'nkalamaayirukkavea'ndum.
vaasasthalaththukkaduththa sakala pa'nividaikkuth theavaiyaana ellaap pa'nimuttuka'lum, athin ellaa mu'laika'lum, piraakaaraththin ellaa mu'laika'lum ve'nkalamaayirukkavea'ndum.
kuththuvi'lakku eppozhuthum erinthuko'ndirukkumpadi idiththup pizhintha the'livaana oliva e'n'neyai unnidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyiduvaayaaka.

aasarippuk koodaaraththil saadchi sannithikku munnirukkum thiraichseelaikku ve'lippu'ramaaka aaroanum avan kumaararum saayangkaalam thodangki vidiya'rkaalammattum karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil antha vi'lakkai eriyavaikkakkadavarka'l; ithu israveal puththirarukku thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkakkadavathu.

un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadikku, nee aaroanaiyum avanoadeakooda avan kumaararaakiya naathaap, apiyoo, eleyaasaar, iththaamaar ennum aaroanin kumaararaiyum israveal puththirarilirunthu piriththu, unnidaththil searththukko'lvaayaaka.
un sakoatharanaakiya aaroanukku, makimaiyum alangkaaramumaay irukkumporuttu, parisuththa vasthirangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.

aaroan enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyaththakkathaaka avanaip parisuththappaduththumpadi avanukku vasthirangka'lai u'ndaakkumporuttu, naan gnaanaththin aaviyaal nirappina viveakamaana iruthayamu'l'la yaavaroadum nee solluvaayaaka.

avarka'l u'ndaakkavea'ndiya vasthirangka'laavana; maarppathakkamum, eapoaththum, angkiyum, visiththiramaana u'lsattaiyum, paakaiyum, idaikkachchaiyumea. un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadi, avanukkum avan kumaararukkum parisuththa vasthirangka'lai u'ndupa'n'navea'ndum.
avarka'l ponnum i'laneelanoolum iraththaamparanoolum sivappunoolum melliya pagnchunoolum seakarippaarka'laaka.
eapoaththaip ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum visiththiravealaiyaaych seyyakkadavarka'l.
athu on'raaka i'naikkappadumporuttu, ira'ndu thoa'lthu'nduka'linmealum athin ira'ndu munaika'lum searkkappadavea'ndum.

antha eapoaththinmeal irukkavea'ndiya visiththiramaana kachchai antha vealaikku oppaakavea, ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum pa'n'nappattu, athanoadea eakamaayirukkavea'ndum.
pinnum nee ira'ndu koameathakakka'rka'lai eduththu, israveal puththirarin naamangka'lai avaika'lil vettuvaayaaka.
avarka'l pi'rantha varisaiyinpadiyea, avarka'ludaiya naamangka'lil aa'ru naamangka'l oru kallilum, mat'ra aa'ru naamangka'l ma'ru kallilum irukkavea'ndum.
iraththinangka'lil muththirai vettuki'ravarka'l seyyum vealaikku oppaaka antha ira'ndu ka'rka'lilum israveal puththirarin naamangka'lai vetti, avaika'laip pon kuva'laika'lil pathippaayaaka.

aaroan karththarukku munpaakath than ira'ndu thoa'lka'linmealum israveal puththirarin naamangka'lai gnaapakakku'riyaakach sumanthuvara, antha ira'ndu ka'rka'laiyum eapoaththuth thoa'lka'linmeal avarka'lai ninaikkumpadiyaana ka'rka'laaka vaikkakkadavaay.
ponninaal va'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni,
sariyaana a'lavukkup pinnalvealaiyaana ira'ndu sangkilika'laiyum pasumponninaal u'ndaakki, anthach sangkilika'lai antha va'laiyangka'lil poottuvaayaaka.

niyaayavithi maarppathakkaththaiyum visiththiravealaiyaaych seyvaayaaka; athai eapoaththu vealaikku oppaakap ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seyvaayaaka.
athu sathuramum irattaiyum, oru saa'n nee'lamum oru saa'n akalamumaay irukkavea'ndum.
athilea naalu paththi iraththinakka'rka'lai ni'raiyap pathippaayaaka; muthalaam paththi pathmaraakamum pushparaakamum maa'nikkamum,
ira'ndaam paththi marakathamum inthiraneelamum vachchiramum,
moon'raam paththi kempum vaidooriyamum sukanthiyum,
naalaam paththi padikappachchaiyum koameathakamum yaspiyumaay iruppathaaka; ivaika'l anthanthap paththiyil ponninaalea pathiththirukkavea'ndum.

inthak ka'rka'l israveal puththirarudaiya naamangka'linpadiyea pannira'ndum, avarka'ludaiya naamangka'l avaika'lil vettappattavaika'lumaay irukkavea'ndum; pannira'ndu koaththirangka'lil ovvon'rinudaiya naamam ovvon'rilea muththiraivettaay vettiyirukkavea'ndum.
maarppathakkaththi'rku athin pakkangka'lilea pinnalvealaiyaana pasumpon sangkilika'laiyum pa'n'ni,
antha maarppathakkaththi'rku ira'ndu pon va'laiyangka'laiyum pa'n'ni, antha ira'ndu va'laiyangka'laiyum maarppathakkaththin ira'ndu pakkangka'lilea vaiththu,
ponninaal seytha antha ira'ndu pinnal vealaiyaana sangkilika'laiyum maarppathakkaththin pakkangka'lil irukki'ra ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lil maatti,
avvira'ndu pinnal vealaiyaana sangkilika'lin ira'ndu nunika'lai eapoaththuth thoa'lthu'ndinmeal athin munpu'raththil irukki'ra ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lil maattuvaayaaka.
nee ira'ndu ponva'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni, avaika'lai eapoaththin keezhppu'raththi'rku ethiraana maarppathakkaththinudaiya mat'ra ira'ndu pakkangka'lilum athinudaiya oaraththi'rku'l'laaka vaiththu,

vea'rea ira'ndu ponva'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni, avaika'lai eapoaththin munpu'raththu ira'ndu keezhppakkangka'lil athin i'naippukku ethiraakavum, eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaikku mealaakavum vaiththu,

maarppathakkam eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaikku mealaaka irukkumpadikkum, athu eapoaththilirunthu neengkaathapadikkum, athai athin va'laiyangka'laal eapoaththu va'laiyangka'loadea i'laneela naadaavinaal kattavea'ndum.

aaroan parisuththa sthalaththi'rku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, israveal puththirarin naamangka'laith than iruthayaththinmealirukkum niyaayavithi maarppathakkaththilea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil gnaapakakku'riyaaka eppozhuthum thariththukko'l'lakkadavan.

niyaayavithi maarppathakkaththilea ooreem thummeem enpavaika'lai vaippaayaaka; aaroan karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil piraveasikkumpoathu, avaika'l avan iruthayaththinmeal irukkavea'ndum; aaroan than iruthayaththinmeal israveal puththirarudaiya niyaayavithiyaik karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil eppozhuthum thariththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
eapoaththin keezh angkiyai muzhuvathum i'laneelanoolaal u'ndaakkakkadavaay.

thalai nuzhaiki'ra athin thuvaaram athin naduvil irukkavum, athin thuvaaraththukku neyyappatta vealaiyaana oru naadaa sut'rilum irukkavum vea'ndum; athu kizhiyaathapadikku maarkkavasaththin thuvaaraththukku oththathaaka irukkavea'ndum.

athin keezhoarangka'lil i'laneelanool iraththaamparanool sivappunool vealaiyaal seyyappatta maatha'lampazhangka'laiyum, avaika'lukku idaiyidaiyea sut'rilum ponma'nika'laiyum athin oarangka'lil sut'rilum thongkumpadi pa'n'nivaikkavea'ndum.
angkiyin oarangka'lil sut'rilum oru ponma'niyum oru maatha'lampazhamum, oru ponma'niyum oru maatha'lampazhamumaayth thongkuvathaaka.

aaroan aaraathanai seyyak karththarudaiya sannithiyil parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathum, ve'liyea varumpoathum, avan saakaathapadikku, athin saththam keadkappadumpadi athaith thariththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
pasumponninaal oru pattaththaip pa'n'ni, karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru athilea muththirai vettaaka vetti,
athu paakaiyilirukkumpadi athai i'laneela naadaavinaal paakaiyin mukappilea kattuvaayaaka.

israveal puththirar thangka'l parisuththa kaa'nikkaika'laakap padaikkum parisuththamaanavaika'lin thoashaththai aaroan sumakkumpadi, athu aaroanudaiya net'riyinmeal iruppathaaka; karththarudaiya sannithiyil avarka'l angkikarikkappadumpadi, athu eppozhuthum avan net'riyinmeal irukkavea'ndum.
melliya pagnchunoolaal visiththiramaana u'lsattaiyaiyum, melliya pagnchunoolaal paakaiyaiyum u'ndaakki, idaikkachchaiyaich siththiraththaiyal vealaiyaakap pa'n'nuvaayaaka.
aaroanudaiya kumaararukkum, makimaiyum alangkaaramumaayirukkum poruttu, angkika'laiyum, idaikkachchaika'laiyum, kullaakka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.

un sakoatharanaakiya aaroanum avanoadeakooda avan kumaararum enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadikku, nee antha vasthirangka'lai avarka'lukku uduththi, avarka'lai apisheakagnseythu, avarka'laip pirathishdaipa'n'ni, avarka'laip parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka.
avarka'ludaiya nirvaa'naththai moodumpadikku, iduppuththodangki muzhangkaalmattum uduththa sa'nalnool salladangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.

aaroanum avan kumaararum parisuththa sthalaththilea aaraathanaiseyya aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku'l piraveasikkumpoathum palipeedaththa'ndaikkuch searumpoathum, akkiramam sumanthu avarka'l saakaathapadikku, avaika'laith thariththirukkavea'ndum; ithu avanukkum avanukkup pinvarum santhathikkum niththiya katta'lai.

avarka'l enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadi avarka'laip parisuththappaduththumporuttu, nee avarka'lukkuch seyya vea'ndiyathaavathu: oru kaa'laiyaiyum pazhuthat'ra ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum therinthuko'lvaayaaka.
pu'lippillaa appaththaiyum, e'n'neyilea pisaintha pu'lippillaa athirasangka'laiyum, e'n'ney poosappatta pu'lippillaa adaika'laiyum koathumaiyin melliya maavinaal pa'n'ni,
avaika'lai oru koodaiyilea vaiththu, koodaiyoadea avaika'laiyum kaa'laiyaiyum ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu,
aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasal munpaakach searappa'n'ni, avarka'laith tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvi,

antha vasthirangka'lai eduththu, aaroanukku u'lsattaiyaiyum, eapoaththin keezh angkiyaiyum, eapoaththaiyum, maarppathakkaththaiyum thariththu, eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaiyaiyum avanukkuk katti,
avan thalaiyilea paakaiyaiyum vaiththu, parisuththa kireedaththaip paakaiyinmeal thariththu,
apisheaka thailaththaiyum eduththu, avan thalaiyinmeal vaarththu, avanai apisheakagnseyvaayaaka.
pinpu avan kumaararaich searappa'n'ni, aasaariya oozhiyam avarka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaaka irukkumpadi, avarka'lukkum angkika'lai uduththuvaayaaka.
aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum idaikkachchaika'laik katti, avan kumaararukkuk kullaakka'laiyum thariththu, ippadiyea aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum pirathishdaipa'n'nuvaayaaka.
kaa'laiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaakak ko'nduvaruvaayaaka; appozhuthu aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'laik kaa'laiyinudaiya thalaiyinmeal vaikkakkadavarka'l.
pinpu nee anthak kaa'laiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththu vaasala'ndaiyilea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil adiththu,
athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, un viralinaal palipeedaththin kompuka'lmeal ittu, mat'ra iraththam muzhuvathaiyum palipeedaththin adiyilea oot'ri,
kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppu yaavaiyum, kalleeralinmealu'l'la savvaiyum, ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'linmealu'l'la kozhuppaiyum eduththu, palipeedaththinmeal thakiththuppoattu,
kaa'laiyin maamsaththaiyum athin thoalaiyum athin saa'niyaiyum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea akkiniyaal sutterikkakkadavaay; ithu paavanivaara'napali.
pinpu antha aattukkadaakka'lil on'raik ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththuvaayaaka; athinudaiya thalaiyinmeal aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'lai vaikkakkadavarka'l.
anthak kadaavai adiththu, athin iraththaththaip pidiththu, palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththu,
aattukkadaavaich santhusanthaakath thu'ndiththu, athin kudalka'laiyum athin thodaika'laiyum kazhuvi, avaika'lai anthath thu'ndangka'linmealum athin thalaiyinmealum vaiththu,

aattukkadaa muzhuvathaiyum palipeedaththinmeal thakiththuviduvaayaaka; ithu karththarukkuch seluththum sarvaangka thakanapali; ithu sukantha vaasanaiyum karththarukkuch seluththum thakanapaliyumaay irukkum.
pinpu mat'ra aattukkadaavaiyum ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththuvaayaaka; athinudaiya thalaiyinmeal aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'lai vaikkakkadavarka'l.

appozhuthu anthak kadaavai adiththu, athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, aaroanin valathukaathu madalilum, avan kumaararin valathukaathu madalilum, avarka'l valathukaiyin peruviralilum, avarka'l valathukaalin peruviralilum ittu, mat'ra iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththu,

palipeedaththinmealirukkum iraththaththilum apisheakathailaththilum kogncham eduththu, aaroanum avan vasthirangka'lum avanudaiya kumaararum avarka'ludaiya vasthirangka'lum parisuththamaakkappadumpadi, avanmealum avan vasthirangka'lmealum avanudaiya kumaarar mealum avarka'ludaiya vasthirangka'l mealum the'lippaayaaka.

antha aattukkadaa pirathishdaiyin aattukkadaavaanathaal, athilu'l'la kozhuppaiyum vaalaiyum kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum kalleeralinmealu'l'la savvaiyum ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum avaika'linmealu'l'la kozhuppaiyum valathupakkaththu munnanthodaiyaiyum,
karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil vaiththirukki'ra pu'lippillaa appangka'lu'l'la koodaiyil oru appaththaiyum e'n'neyitta appamaakiya oru athirasaththaiyum oru adaiyaiyum eduththu,
avaika'l ellaavat'raiyum aaroanin u'l'langkaika'lilum avan kumaararin u'l'langkaika'lilum vaiththu, avaika'laik karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil asaivaattappadum kaa'nikkaiyaaka asaivaatti,

pinpu avaika'lai avarka'l kaika'lilirunthu eduththu, palipeedaththinmeal sarvaangka thakanapaliyoadu vaiththu, karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil sukantha vaasanaiyaakath thakikkakkadavaay; ithu karththarukkuch seluththappadum thakanapali.
aaroanudaiya pirathishdaiyin aattukkadaavilea maarkka'ndaththai eduththu, athaik karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil asaivaattappadum kaa'nikkaiyaaka asaivaattakkadavaay; athu un pangkaayirukkum.

mealum, aaroanudaiya pirathishdaikkum avan kumaararudaiya pirathishdaikkum niyamiththa aattukkadaavil asaivaattappaduki'ra maarkka'ndaththaiyum ea'reduththup padaikkappaduki'ra munnanthodaiyaiyum parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka.

athu ea'reduththup padaikki'ra padaippaanathinaal, israveal puththirar paliyiduki'ravaika'lil avaika'lea niththiya katta'laiyaaka aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum searvathaaka; israveal puththirar karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil ea'reduththup padaikki'ra samaathaanapalika'lil avaika'lea ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippaayirukkavea'ndum.
aaroanin parisuththa vasthirangka'l, avanukkuppin, avanudaiya kumaararaich searum; avarka'l avaika'lai uduththikko'ndu, apisheakampa'n'nappattup pirathishdaiyaakkappaduvaarka'l.

avanudaiya kumaararil avan pattaththi'rku varuki'ra aasaariyan parisuththa sthalaththil aaraathanai seyvatha'rku aasarippuk koodaaraththil piraveasikkumpoathu, avaika'lai eazhunaa'lmattum uduththikko'l'lakkadavan.
pirathishdaiyin aattukkadaavaik ko'nduvanthu, athin maamsaththaip parisuththa idaththil veavippaayaaka.
antha aattukkadaavin maamsaththaiyum, koodaiyilirukki'ra appaththaiyum, aaroanum avan kumaararum aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasalilea pusikkakkadavarka'l.

avarka'laip pirathishdaipa'n'nip parisuththappaduththumporuttu, avaika'laal paavanivirththi seyyappattapadiyaal, avaika'lai avarka'l pusikkakkadavarka'l; anniyanoa avaika'laip pusikkalaakaathu; avaika'l parisuththamaanavaika'l.
pirathishdaiyin maamsaththilum appaththilum eathaakilum vidiya'rkaalammattum meenthirunthathaanaal, athai akkiniyaalea sutterippaayaaka; athu pusikkappadalaakaathu, athu parisuththamaanathu.
inthappirakaaram naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadi ellaavat'raiyum nee aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum seyvaayaaka; eazhunaa'la'lavum nee avarka'laip pirathishdaipa'n'ni,

paavanivirththikkaaka ovvoru naa'lilum ovvoru kaa'laiyaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakap paliyittu; palipeedaththukkaakap piraayachchiththam seythapin, anthap palipeedaththaich suththiseyyavea'ndum; athaip parisuththappaduththumpadi athai apisheakampa'n'nakkadavaay.

eazhunaa'la'lavum palipeedaththi'rkaakap piraayachchiththagnseythu, athaip parisuththamaakkakkadavaay; palipeedamaanathu makaa parisuththamaayirukkum; palipeedaththaith thoduki'rathellaam parisuththamaakum.
palipeedaththinmeal nee paliyidavea'ndiyathu ennavenil; idaividaamal ovvorunaa'lilum oru vayathaana ira'ndu aattukkuttika'laip paliyidavea'ndum.
oru aattukkuttiyaik kaalaiyilum, mat'ra aattukkuttiyai maalaiyilum paliyiduvaayaaka.

oru marakkaalilea paththiloru pangkaanathum, idiththup pizhintha kaa'rpadi e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaakiya melliya maavaiyum, paanapaliyaakak kaalpadi thiraadcharasaththaiyum, oru aattukkuttiyudanea padaippaayaaka.
mat'ra aattukkuttiyai maalaiyilea paliyittu, kaalaiyilea seluththina poajanapalikkum paanapalikkum oththapirakaaram athaik karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaakap padaikkakkadavaay.

unnudanea peasumpadi naan ungka'laich santhikkum idamaayirukki'ra aasarippuk koodaaraththinudaiya vaasalaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyilea, ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum seluththappadavea'ndiya niththiya sarvaangka thakanapali ithuvea.
angkea israveal puththiraraich santhippean; antha sthalam ennudaiya makimaiyinaal parisuththamaakkappadum.
aasarippuk koodaaraththaiyum palipeedaththaiyum naan parisuththamaakkuvean; enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadikku, aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum parisuththappaduththi,
israveal puththirarin naduvea naan vaasampa'n'ni, avarka'lukkuth theavanaayiruppean.

thangka'l naduvea naan vaasampa'n'numpadi, thangka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naan thangka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru avarka'l a'rivaarka'l; naanea avarka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
thoopangkaattuki'ratha'rku oru thoopapeedaththaiyum seeththim maraththinaal u'ndaakkuvaayaaka.
athu oru muzha nee'lamum oru muzha akalamumaana sathuramum, ira'ndu muzha uyaramumaay irukkavea'ndum, athin kompuka'l athanoadea eakamumaayirukkavea'ndum.
athin mea'rpu'raththaiyum sut'ruppu'raththaiyum athin kompuka'laiyum pasumponthakattaal moodi, sut'rilum atha'rkup ponthira'naiyai u'ndupa'n'ni,

anthath thira'naiyinkeezhea athin ira'ndu pakkangka'lilum athaich sumakkum tha'nduka'lin idangka'laakiya athin ira'ndu pakkaththu ira'ndu moolaika'lilum ira'ndu pon va'laiyangka'lai u'ndaakkuvaayaaka.
anthath tha'nduka'laiyum seeththim maraththaal pa'n'ni, avaika'laiyum ponthakattaal moodakkadavaay.
