saadchippettikku munnirukkum thiraichseelaikkum, naan unnaich santhikkum idamaakiya saadchi sannithiyinmealu'l'la kirupaasanaththukkum munpaaka athai vaikkakkadavaay.
aaroan kaalaithoa'rum athinmeal sukantha thoopangkaattavea'ndum; maalaiyil vi'lakkeat'rumpoathum athinmeal thoopangkaattakkadavan; vi'lakkuka'lai vi'lakkumpoathum athinmeal thoopangkaattavea'ndum.
ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum karththarudaiya sannithiyil kaattavea'ndiya niththiya thoopam ithuvea.
athinmeal anniya thoopaththaiyaakilum, thakanapaliyaiyaakilum, poajanapaliyaiyaakilum padaikkavea'ndaam; athinmeal paanapaliyai oot'ravumvea'ndaam.

varushaththil orumu'rai aaroan paavanivaara'napaliyin iraththaththinaal athin kompuka'linmeal piraayachchiththampa'n'nuvaanaaka; ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum varushaththil orumu'rai athinmeal piraayachchiththampa'n'nuvaanaaka; athu karththarukku makaa parisuththamaanathu en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththirarai avarka'l ilakkaththinpadi ka'nakkuppaarkkum poruttu, avarka'lai e'n'numpoathu, avarka'lukku'l'lea oru vaathai u'ndaakaathapadikku, avarka'lil ovvoruvanum e'n'nappadum samayaththil thanthan aaththumaavukkaakak karththarukku meedkumporu'laik kodukkakkadavan.

e'n'nappaduki'ravarka'lin thokaiyilea searuki'ra ovvoruvanum parisuththa sthalaththuch seakkal ka'nakkinpadi araichseakkal kodukkavea'ndum; oru seakkalukku irupathu kearaa; karththarukkuch seluththappaduvathu araichseakkal.
e'n'nappaduki'ravarka'lin thokaiyilea searuki'ra irupathu vayathu mutha'rko'ndu atha'rku mea'rpatta ovvoruvanum athaik karththarukkuch seluththavea'ndum.

ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaakap paavanivirththipa'n'numpadi neengka'l karththarukkuk kaa'nikkai seluththumpoathu, aisuvariyavaan araichseakkalukku athikamaayk kodukkavum vea'ndaam, thariththiran atha'rkuk ku'raivaakak kodukkavum vea'ndaam.

anthap paavanivirththi pa'naththai nee israveal puththirar kaiyil vaangki, athai aasarippuk koodaaraththin thiruppa'nikkuk koduppaayaaka; athu karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumporuttu, israveal puththirarukku gnaapakakku'riyaayirukkum en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

kazhuvuki'ratha'rku ve'nkalaththaal oru thottiyaiyum, ve'nkalaththaal athin paathaththaiyum u'ndaakki, athai aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rkum palipeedaththi'rkum naduvea vaiththu, athilea tha'n'neer vaarppaayaaka.
athanidaththil aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'laiyum thangka'l kaalka'laiyum kazhuvakkadavarka'l.

avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku'l piraveasikkumpoathum, karththarukkuth thakanaththaik ko'luththavum palipeedaththinidaththil aaraathanaiseyyavum searumpoathum, avarka'l saakaathapadikkuth tha'n'neerinaal thangka'laik kazhuvakkadavarka'l.
avarka'l saakaathapadikkuth thangka'l kaika'laiyum thangka'l kaalka'laiyum kazhuvakkadavarka'l; ithu thalaimu'raithoa'rum avanukkum avan santhathiyaarukkum niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkum en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

meanmaiyaana sukanthavarkkangka'laakiya suththamaana ve'l'laippoa'laththil parisuththa sthalaththin seakkalinpadi ainnoo'ru seakkal idaiyaiyum, sukantha karuvaappattaiyilea athil paathiyaakiya irunoot'ru aimpathu seakkal idaiyaiyum, sukantha vasampil irunoot'ru aimpathu seakkal idaiyaiyum,
ilavangkappattaiyil ainnoo'ru seakkal idaiyaiyum, oliva e'n'neyil oru kudam e'n'neyaiyum eduththu,
athanaal, parima'la thailakkaaran seyvathupoala, koottappatta parima'lathailamaakiya suththamaana apisheaka thailaththai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka; athu parisuththa apisheaka thailamaayirukkakkadavathu.
athinaalea aasarippuk koodaaraththaiyum, saadchippettiyaiyum,
meajaiyaiyum, athin pa'nimuttuka'l ellaavat'raiyum, kuththuvi'lakkaiyum, athin karuvika'laiyum, thoopapeedaththaiyum,
thakana palipeedaththaiyum, athin pa'nimuttuka'l ellaavat'raiyum, thottiyaiyum, athin paathaththaiyum apisheakampa'n'ni,
avaika'l makaa parisuththamaayirukkumpadikku, avaika'laip parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka; avaika'laith thoduki'rathellaam parisuththamaayirukkum.
aaroanum avan kumaararum enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadikku, nee avarka'lai apisheakampa'n'ni, avarka'laip parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka.
israveal puththiraroadea nee peasich sollavea'ndiyathaavathu: ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum ithu enakkuriya parisuththa apisheaka thailamaayirukkavea'ndum.

ithu manitharudaiya sareeraththinmeal vaarkkappadalaakaathu; ithu seyyappatta mu'raiyinpadi avarka'l vea'roru thailaththaich seyyavungkoodaathu; ithu parisuththamaanathu, ithu ungka'lukkup parisuththamaayiruppathaaka.
intha mu'raiyinpadiyea thailangkoottuki'ravanum, athil eduththu anniyanmeal vaarkki'ravanum, than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoakakkadavan en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki: suththa ve'l'laippoa'lamum kungkiliyamum alpaan pisinumaakiya kanthavarkkangka'laiyum suththamaana saampiraa'niyaiyum nee samani'raiyaaka eduththu,
thailakkaaran seyki'rathupoala atha'rkup parima'lameat'ri, thuppuravaana parisuththa thoopavarkkamaakki,
athil kogncham eduththup podiyaaka idiththu, naan unnaich santhikkum aasarippuk koodaaraththilirukkum saadchi sannithiyil vaippaayaaka; athu ungka'lukku makaa parisuththamaayirukkakkadavathu.
inthath thoopavarkkaththai nee seyyavea'ndiya mu'raiyinpadi ungka'lukkaakach seythuko'l'lalaakaathu; ithu karththarukken'ru unakkup parisuththamaayiruppathaaka.
itha'rku oppaanathai mukaruki'ratha'rkaakach seyki'ravan than janaththil iraathapadi a'ruppu'ndupoakakkadavan en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
naan yoothaavin koaththiraththil oorudaiya makanaana ooriyin kumaaran pesaleyealaip pearsolli azhaiththu,
vinoathamaana vealaika'lai avan yoasiththuch seyki'ratha'rkum, ponnilum ve'l'liyilum ve'nkalaththilum vealaiseyki'ratha'rkum,
iraththinangka'lai muththiraivettaaka vettip pathikki'ratha'rkum, maraththil siththiravealaika'laich seyki'ratha'rkum,
mat'rum sakalavitha vealaika'laiyum yookiththuch seyki'ratha'rkum vea'ndiya gnaanamum puththiyum a'rivum avanukku u'ndaaka, avanai theavaaaviyinaal nirappinean.

mealum, thaa'n koaththiraththilu'l'la akisaamaakin kumaaranaakiya akoaliyaapaiyum avanoadea thu'naiyaakak koottinathuman'ri, gnaana iruthayamu'l'la yaavarudaiya iruthayaththilum gnaanaththai aru'linean; naan unakkuk katta'laiyitta yaavaiyum avarka'l seyvaarka'l.
aasarippuk koodaaraththaiyum saadchippettiyaiyum athinmealu'l'la kirupaasanaththaiyum, koodaaraththilu'l'la sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum,
meajaiyaiyum athin pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, suththamaana kuththuvi'lakkaiyum athin sakala karuvika'laiyum, thoopapeedaththaiyum,
thakanapalipeedaththaiyum athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, thottiyaiyum athin paathaththaiyum,
aaraathanai vasthirangka'laiyum, aasaariya oozhiyam seyvatha'rkaana aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin parisuththa vasthirangka'laiyum, avan kumaararin vasthirangka'laiyum,
apisheaka thailaththaiyum, parisuththa sthalaththukkuch sukanthavarkkangka'laakiya thoopavarkkaththaiyum, naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, avarka'l seyyavea'ndum en'raar.
mealum, karththar moaseayinidaththil:

nee israveal puththirarai noakki, neengka'l en oayvunaadka'lai aasarikkavea'ndum; ungka'laip parisuththappaduththuki'ra karththar naan enpathai neengka'l a'riyumpadi, ithu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum enakkum ungka'lukkum adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum.

aakaiyaal, oayvunaa'lai aasarippeerka'laaka; athu ungka'lukkup parisuththamaanathu; athaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkuki'ravan kolaiyu'nkakkadavan; athilea vealaiseyki'ra entha aaththumaavum than janaththin naduvil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.
aa'runaa'lum vealaiseyyalaam; eazhaam naa'loa vealai ozhinthirukkum oayvunaa'l; athu karththarukkup parisuththamaanathu; oayvunaa'lil vealaiseyki'ravan evanum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
aakaiyaal, israveal puththirar thangka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum oayvunaa'lai niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka aasarikkumpadi, athaik kaikko'l'lakkadavarka'l.
athu en'raikkum enakkum israveal puththirarukkum adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum; aa'runaa'laikku'l'lea karththar vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakki, eazhaam naa'lilea oaynthirunthu pooriththaar en'raar.
seenaaymalaiyil avar moaseayoadea peasi mudinthapin, theavanudaiya viralinaal ezhuthappatta ka'rpalakaika'laakiya saadchiyin ira'ndu palakaika'lai avanidaththil koduththaar.

moasea malaiyilirunthu i'rangkivarath thaamathikki'rathai janangka'l ka'ndapoathu, avarka'l aaroanidaththil koottangkoodi, avanai noakki: ekipthu theasaththilirunthu engka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvantha antha moaseakku enna sampaviththathoa a'riyoam; aathalaal neer ezhunthu, engka'lukku munsellum theyvangka'lai engka'lukkaaka u'ndupa'n'num en'raarka'l.
atha'rku aaroan: ungka'l manaivika'l kumaarar kumaaraththika'ludaiya kaathuka'lil irukki'ra ponna'nika'laik kazhat'ri, ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.
janangka'l ellaarum thangka'l kaathuka'lil iruntha ponna'nika'laik kazhat'ri, aaroanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

avarka'l kaiyilirunthu avan anthap ponnai vaangki, si'rpakkaruviyinaal karuppidiththu, oru kan'rukkuttiyai vaarppiththaan. appozhuthu avarka'l: isravealarea, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvantha ungka'l theyvangka'l ivaika'lea en'raarka'l.
aaroan athaip paarththu, atha'rku munpaaka oru palipeedaththaik katti, naa'laikkuk karththarukkup pa'ndikai en'ru koo'rinaan.

ma'runaa'l avarka'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyittu, samaathaanapalika'laich seluththinaarka'l; pinpu, janangka'l pusikkavum kudikkavum udkaarnthu, vi'laiyaada ezhunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee i'rangkippoa; ekipthutheasaththilirunthu nee nadaththikko'nduvantha un janangka'l thangka'laik keduththukko'ndaarka'l.

avarka'lukku naan vithiththa vazhiyai avarka'l seekkiramaay vittu vilakinaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'lukku oru kan'rukkuttiyai vaarppiththu, athaip pa'ninthuko'ndu, atha'rkup paliyittu: isravealarea, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvantha ungka'l theyvangka'l ivaika'lea en'ru sonnaarka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki: intha janangka'laip paarththean; ivarka'l va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'la janangka'l.
aakaiyaal en koapam ivarka'lmeal moo'lavum, naan ivarka'lai azhiththuppoadavum nee ennai vittuvidu; unnai oru periya jaathiyaakkuvean en'raar.

moasea than theavanaakiya karththarai noakki: karththaavea, theavareer makaa palaththinaalum vallamaiyu'l'la kaiyinaalum ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina ummudaiya janangka'lukku viroathamaaka ummudaiya koapam pat'riyerivathenna?

malaika'lil avarka'laik kon'ru poadavum, poomiyinmeal iraathapadikku avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkavum, avarka'lukkuth theengkuseyyumporuttea avarka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar en'ru ekipthiyar solluvaanean? ummudaiya koapaththin ukkiraththai vittuth thirumpi, umathu janangka'lukkuth theengkuseyyaathapadikku, avarka'lmeal parithaapangko'l'lum.

umathu thaasaraakiya aapirakaamaiyum eesaakkaiyum isravealaiyum ninaiththaru'lum: ungka'l santhathiyai vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'laippoalap perukappa'n'ni, naan sonna inthath theasam muzhuvathaiyum ungka'l santhathiyaar en'raikkum suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadikku, avarka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru ummaikko'ndea avarka'lukku aa'naiyittuch sonneerea en'ru kegnchip piraarththiththaan.
appozhuthu karththar thamathu janangka'lukkuch seyya ninaiththa theengkaich seyyaathapadikkup parithaapangko'ndaar.

pinpu moasea malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinaan; saadchippalakaika'l ira'ndum avan kaiyil irunthathu; anthap palakaika'l irupu'ramum ezhuthappattirunthathu, avaika'l inthap pakkaththilum anthap pakkaththilum ezhuthappattirunthathu.
anthap palakaika'l theavanaal seyyappattathaayum, avaika'lilea pathintha ezhuththu theavanaal ezhuthappatta ezhuththumaayirunthathu.
janangka'l aaravaaram pa'n'nuki'rathai yoasuvaa keattu, moaseayai noakki: paa'layaththil yuththaththin iraichchal u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'raan.
atha'rku moasea: athu jeyathoniyaakiya saththamum alla, apajeyathoniyaakiya saththamum alla; paadalin saththam enakkuk keadki'rathu en'raan.

avan paa'layaththukkuch sameepiththu, anthak kan'rukkuttiyaiyum nadanaththaiyum ka'ndapoathu, moasea koapam moo'ndavanaaki, than kaiyilea iruntha palakaika'lai malaiyin adiyilea e'rinthu udaiththuppoattu;
avarka'l u'ndupa'n'nina kan'rukkuttiyai eduththu, akkiniyil sutteriththu, athaip podiyaaka araiththu, tha'n'neerinmeal thoovi, athai israveal puththirar kudikkumpadi seythaan.
pinpu, moasea aaroanai noakki: nee intha janangka'lmeal inthap perumpaathakaththaich sumaththuki'ratha'rku, ivarka'l unakku enna seythaarka'l en'raan.
atha'rku aaroan: en aa'ndavanukkuk koapam moo'laathiruppathaaka; ithu pollaatha janam en'ru neer a'rinthirukki'reer.

ivarka'l ennai noakki: engka'lukku munsellum theyvangka'lai engka'lukku u'ndupa'n'num; ekipthu theasaththilirunthu engka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvantha antha moaseakku enna sampaviththathoa a'riyoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu naan: ponnudaimai udaiyavarka'l evarka'loa avarka'l athaik kazhat'rith tharakkadavarka'l en'rean; avarka'l appadiyea seythaarka'l; athai akkiniyilea poattean, athilirunthu inthak kan'rukkutti vanthathu en'raan.
janangka'l thangka'l pakaivarukku'l avamaanappadaththakkathaaka aaroan avarka'lai nirvaa'namaakkiyirunthaan. avarka'l nirvaa'namaayirukki'rathai moasea ka'ndu,

paa'layaththin vaasalil nin'ru: karththarudaiya padchaththil irukki'ravarka'l yaar? avarka'l ennidaththil searakkadavarka'l en'raan. appozhuthu leaviyin puththirar ellaarum avanidaththil koodivanthaarka'l.

avan avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lil ovvoruvanum than pattayaththaith than araiyilea kattikko'ndu, paa'layamengkum u'l'lum pu'rampum vaasalukku vaasal poay, ovvoruvanum than than sakoatharanaiyum ovvoruvanum than than sineakithanaiyum ovvoruvanum than than ayalaanaiyum kon'rupoadakkadavan en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
leaviyin puththirar moasea sonnapadiyea seythaarka'l; annaa'lil janangka'lil ea'rakku'raiya moovaayirampear vizhunthaarka'l.

karththar in'raikku ungka'lukku aaseervaatham a'likkumpadi, in'raikku neengka'l avanavan thanthan makanukkum sakoatharanukkum viroathamaayirukki'rathinaal, karththarukku ungka'laip pirathishdai pa'n'nungka'l en'ru moasea solliyirunthaan.

ma'runaa'lil moasea janangka'lai noakki: neengka'l makaa periya paavagnseytheerka'l; ungka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkoodumoa en'ru a'riya ippozhuthu naan karththaridaththi'rku ea'rippoaki'rean en'raan.
appadiyea moasea karththaridaththi'rkuth thirumpippoay: aiyoa, intha janangka'l ponninaal thangka'lukkuth theyvangka'lai u'ndaakki, makaa periya paavam seythirukki'raarka'l.
aakilum, theavareer avarka'l paavaththai manniththaru'luveeraanaal manniththaru'lum; illaavittaal neer ezhuthina ummudaiya pusthakaththilirunthu en pearaik ki'rukkippoadum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: enakku viroathamaayp paavam seythavan evanoa, avan pearai en pusthakaththilirunthu ki'rukkippoaduvean.

ippozhuthu nee poay, naan unakkuch sonna idaththukku janangka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoa; en thoothanaanavar unakkumun selluvaar; aakilum, naan visaarikkum naa'lil avarka'ludaiya paavaththai avarka'lidaththil visaarippean en'raar.
aaroan seytha kan'rukkuttiyai janangka'l seyviththathin nimiththam karththar avarka'lai upaathiththaar.

karththar moaseayai noakki: neeyum, ekipthu theasaththilirunthu nee azhaiththukko'nduvantha janangka'lum ivvidaththai vittup pu'rappattu, un santhathikkuk koduppean en'ru naan aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum aa'naiyittukkoduththa paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththukkup poangka'l.
naan oru thoothanai ungka'lukku munpaaka anuppi, kaanaaniyanaiyum emoariyanaiyum eaththiyanaiyum perisiyanaiyum eaviyanaiyum epoosiyanaiyum thuraththividuvean.
aanaalum, vazhiyilea naan ungka'lai nirmoolampa'n'naathapadikku, naan ungka'l naduvea sellamaattean, neengka'l va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'la janangka'l en'raar.
thukkamaana ivvaarththaika'lai janangka'l keattapoathu, oruvarum thangka'l aapara'nangka'laip poattukko'l'laamal thukkiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

eanen'raal, neengka'l va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'la janangka'l, naan oru nimishaththil ungka'l naduvil ezhumpi, ungka'lai nirmoolampa'n'nuvean; aakaiyaal, neengka'l poattirukki'ra ungka'l aapara'nangka'laik kazhat'rippoadungka'l; appozhuthu naan ungka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathai a'rivean en'ru israveal puththirarukkuch sol en'ru karththar moaseayoadea solliyirunthaar.
aakaiyaal, israveal puththirar oareap malaiyarukea thangka'l aapara'nangka'laik kazhat'rippoattaarka'l.

moasea koodaaraththaip peyarththu, athaip paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea thooraththilea poattu, atha'rku aasarippuk koodaaram en'ru pearittaan. karththaraith theadum yaavarum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampaana aasarippuk koodaaraththukkup poavaarka'l.

moasea koodaaraththukkup poakumpoathu, janangka'l ellaarum ezhunthirunthu, thangka'l thangka'l koodaaravaasalil nin'ruko'ndu, avan koodaaraththukku'l piraveasikkumattum, avan pinnea paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
moasea koodaaraththukku'l piraveasikkaiyil, meakasthampam i'rangki, koodaaravaasalil nin'rathu; karththar moaseayoadea peasinaar.
janangka'l ellaarum meakasthampam koodaaravaasalil ni'rkakka'ndaarka'l; janangka'l ellaarum ezhunthirunthu, thangka'lthangka'l koodaaravaasalil pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.

oruvan than sineakithanoadea peasuvathupoala, karththar moaseayoadea mukamukamaayp peasinaar; pinpu, avan paa'layaththukkuth thirumpinaan; noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum avanudaiya pa'nividaikkaaranaakiya vaalipan aasarippuk koodaaraththai vittup piriyaathirunthaan.

moasea karththarai noakki: theavareer intha janangka'lai azhaiththukko'ndu poa en'ru sonneer; aakilum, ennoadeakooda innaarai anuppuvean enpathai enakku neer a'rivikkavillai; en'raalum, unnaip pearsolli azhaiththu a'rinthirukki'rean en'rum, en ka'nka'lil unakkuk kirupai kidaiththathu en'rum, theavareer sonnathu'ndea;

ummudaiya ka'nka'lil ippozhuthu enakkuk kirupai kidaiththathaanaal naan ummai a'rivatha'rkum, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaippatha'rkum, ummudaiya vazhiyai enakku a'riviyum; intha jaathi ummudaiya janamen'ru ninaiththaru'lum en'raan.
atha'rku avar: en samukam unakku munpaakach sellum, naan unakku i'laippaa'ruthal tharuvean en'raar.
appozhuthu avan avarai noakki: ummudaiya samukam ennoadeakoodach sellaama'rpoanaal, engka'lai ivvidaththilirunthu ko'ndupoakaathirum.

enakkum umathu janangka'lukkum ummudaiya ka'nka'lilea kirupai kidaiththathenpathu ethinaal a'riyappadum; neer engka'loadea varuvathinaal allavaa? ippadiyea poomiyinmealu'l'la janangka'l ellaarilum, naanum ummudaiya janangka'lum viseashiththavarka'l en'ru vi'langkum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee sonna intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea seyvean; en ka'nka'lil unakkuk kirupai kidaiththathu; unnaip pearsolli azhaiththu a'rinthirukki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu avan: ummudaiya makimaiyai enakkuk kaa'npiththaru'lum en'raan.

atha'rku avar: ennudaiya thayaiyai ellaam naan unakku munpaakak kadanthupoakappa'n'ni, karththarudaiya naamaththai unakku munpaakak koo'ruvean; evanmeal kirupaiyaayirukkach siththamaayiruppeanoa, avanmeal kirupaiyaayiruppean; evanmeal irakkamaayirukkach siththamaayiruppeanoa, avanmeal irakkamaayiruppean en'ru solli,
nee en mukaththaik kaa'namaattaay, oru manushanum ennaik ka'ndu uyiroadirukkakkoodaathu en'raar.
pinnum karththar: ithoa, enna'ndaiyil oru idam u'ndu; nee angkea kanmalaiyil nillu.
en makimai kadanthupoakumpoathu, naan unnai anthak kanmalaiyin vedippilea vaiththu, naan kadanthupoakumattum en karaththinaal unnai mooduvean;
pinpu, en karaththai eduppean; appozhuthu en pinpakkaththaik kaa'npaay; en mukamoa kaa'nappadaathu en'raar.
karththar moaseayai noakki: munthina ka'rpalakaika'lukku oththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lai izhaiththukko'l; nee udaiththuppoatta munthina palakaika'lil iruntha vaarththaika'lai avaika'lil ezhuthuvean.
vidiya'rkaalaththil nee aayaththamaaki, seenaay malaiyil ea'ri, angkea malaiyin uchchiyil kaalamea en samukaththil vanthu nil.
unnoadea oruvanum angkea varakkoodaathu; malaiyilengkum oruvanum kaa'nappadavungkoodaathu; intha malaiyin sameepaththil aadumaadu meayavungkoodaathu en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea munthina ka'rpalakaika'lukku oththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lai izhaiththu, athikaalamea ezhunthirunthu, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea avvira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'laiyum than kaiyilea eduththukko'ndu, seenaaymalaiyil ea'rinaan.
karththar oru meakaththil i'rangki, angkea avan arukea nin'ru, karththarudaiya naamaththaik koo'rinaar.
karththar avanukku munpaakak kadanthupoaki'rapoathu, avar: karththar, karththar; irakkamum, kirupaiyum, neediya saanthamum, makaa thayaiyum, saththiyamumu'l'la theavan.

aayiram thalaimu'raika'lukku irakkaththaik kaakki'ravar; akkiramaththaiyum mee'ruthalaiyum paavaththaiyum mannikki'ravar; kut'ravaa'liyaik kut'ramat'ravanaaka vidaamal, pithaakka'l seytha akkiramaththaip pi'l'laika'lidaththilum, pi'l'laika'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lidaththilum moon'raam naankaam thalaimu'raimattum visaarikki'ravar en'ru koo'rinaar.
moasea theeviramaakath tharaimattum kuninthu pa'ninthuko'ndu:

aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaiththathaanaal, engka'l naduvil aa'ndavar ezhuntharu'lavea'ndum; intha janangka'l va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'lavarka'l; neeroa, engka'l akkiramaththaiyum engka'l paavaththaiyum manniththu, engka'lai umakkuch suthantharamaaka eat'rukko'l'lum en'raan.

atha'rku avar: ithoa, naan oru udanpadikkaipa'n'nuki'rean; poomiyengkum entha jaathika'lidaththilum seyyappadaatha athisayangka'lai un janangka'l ellaarukku munpaakavum seyvean; unnoadeakooda irukki'ra janangka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya seykaiyaik kaa'npaarka'l; unnoadeakooda irunthu, naan seyyum kaariyam payangkaramaayirukkum.
in'ru naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rathaik kaikko'l; emoariyanaiyum, kaanaaniyanaiyum, eaththiyanaiyum, perisiyanaiyum, eaviyanaiyum, epoosiyanaiyum unakku munpaakath thuraththividuki'rean.
nee poaych searuki'ra theasaththin kudika'loadu udanpadikkaipa'n'naathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru; pa'n'ninaal athu un naduvil ka'n'niyaayirukkum.
avarka'ludaiya palipeedangka'lai idiththu, avarka'l silaika'laith thakarththu, avarka'l thoappuka'lai vettippoadungka'l.
karththarudaiya naamam erichchalu'l'lavar enpathu, avar erichchalu'l'la theavanea; aakaiyaal, anniya theavanai nee pa'ninthuko'l'lavea'ndaam.

anthath theasaththin kudika'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nuvaayaanaal, avarka'l thangka'l theavarka'laich soaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'ri, thangka'ludaiya theavarka'lukkup paliyiduvaarka'l; oruvan unnai azhaikkaiyil, nee poay, avan paliyittathilea pusippaay;

avarka'l kumaaraththika'lil un kumaararukkup pe'nka'laik ko'l'luvaay; avarka'l kumaaraththika'l thangka'l theavarka'laich soaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'ruvathum allaamal, un kumaararaiyum thangka'l theavarka'laich soaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'rumpadi seyvaarka'l.
vaarppikkappatta theyvangka'lai ungka'lukku u'ndaakkavea'ndaam.

pu'lippillaa appappa'ndikaiyai neengka'l kaikko'ndu, naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, aapeep maathaththil ku'riththa kaalaththilea eazhunaa'l pu'lippillaa appam pusikkakkadaveerka'l; aapeep maathaththilea ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattaayea.
karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakki'ra yaavum, un aadumaaduka'lin thalaiyeet'raana aa'nka'l yaavum ennudaiyavaika'l.

kazhuthaiyin thalaiyeet'rai oru aattukkuttiyaal meettukko'lvaayaaka; athai meettukko'l'laathirunthaal athin kazhuththai mu'riththuppoadu; un pi'l'laika'lil mutha'rpea'raanavaika'laiyellaam meettukko'l'lavea'ndum. ve'rungkaiyoadea en sannithiyil oruvanum varakkoodaathu.
aa'runaa'l vealaiseythu, eazhaam naa'lilea oaynthiruppaayaaka; vithaippukkaalaththilum a'ruppukkaalaththilum oaynthiruppaayaaka.
koathumai a'ruppin mutha'rpalanaich seluththum eazhu vaarangka'lin pa'ndikaiyaiyum, varushamudivilea searppukkaala pa'ndikaiyaiyum aasarippaayaaka.
varushaththil moon'rutharam ungka'l aa'nmakka'l ellaarum isravealin theavanaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya aa'ndavarin sannithiyil varakkadavarka'l.

naan pu'rajaathika'lai ungka'l munnin'ru thuraththivittu, ungka'l ellaika'lai visthaaramaakkuvean; varushaththil moon'rutharam ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithikku munpaakak kaa'nappadap poayirukkumpoathu oruvarum ungka'l theasaththai ichchippathillai.
enakku idum paliyin iraththaththaip pu'liththamaavudan seluththavea'ndaam; paskaa pa'ndikaiyin paliyai vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum vaikkavum vea'ndaam.

ungka'l nilaththil muthal muthal vi'laintha mutha'rpalaththai ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvaarungka'l. ve'l'laattukkuttiyai athin thaayin paalilea samaikkavea'ndaam en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki: intha vaarththaika'lai nee ezhuthu; intha vaarththaika'linpadiyea unnoadum isravealoadum udanpadikkaipa'n'ninean en'raar.

angkea avan appam pusiyaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum iravum pakalum naa'rpathunaa'l karththaroadea irunthaan; avan paththukka'rpanaika'laakiya udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'laip palakaika'lil ezhuthinaan.

moasea saadchip palakaika'l ira'ndaiyum than kaiyil eduththukko'ndu, seenaaymalaiyilirunthu i'rangkuki'rapoathu, thannoadea avar peasinathinaalea than mukam pirakaasiththiruppathai avan a'riyaathirunthaan.
aaroanum israveal puththirar ellaarum moaseayaip paarkkumpoathu, avan mukam pirakaasiththiruppathaik ka'ndu, avan sameepaththil searappayanthaarka'l.
moasea avarka'lai azhaiththaan; appozhuthu aaroanum sapaiyilu'l'la pirapukka'l yaavarum avanidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthaarka'l; moasea avarka'loadea peasinaan.
pinpu israveal puththirar ellaarum avanidaththil searnthaarka'l; appozhuthu avan seenaaymalaiyil karththar thannoadea peasinavaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththaan.
moasea avarka'loadea peasi mudiyuma'lavum, than mukaththinmeal mukkaadu poattirunthaan.

moasea karththarudaiya sannithiyil avaroadea peasumpadikku udpiraveasiththathumuthal ve'liyea pu'rappadummattum mukkaadu poadaathirunthaan; avan ve'liyea vanthu thanakkuk ka'rpikkappattathai israveal puththiraroadea sollumpoathu,
israveal puththirar avan mukam pirakaasiththiruppathaik ka'ndaarka'l. moasea avaroadea peasumpadikku u'l'lea piraveasikkumvaraikkum, mukkaattaith thirumpath than mukaththinmeal poattukko'l'luvaan.
moasea israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum koodivarachseythu, avarka'lai noakki:

neengka'l aa'runaa'l vealaiseyyavea'ndum, eazhaam naa'loa ungka'lukkup parisuththa naa'laay iruppathaaka; athu karththarukken'ru oaynthirukkum oayvunaa'l; athilea vealaiseyki'ravan evanum kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
oayvunaa'lil ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lil engkum neruppu moottaathiruppeerka'laaka ennum ivvaarththaika'laik kaikko'l'lumpadi karththar katta'laiyittaar en'raan.
pinnum moasea israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum noakki:

ungka'lukku u'ndaanathilea karththarukku oru kaa'nikkaiyaik ko'nduvanthu seluththungka'l; manamu'l'lavan evanoa, avan athaik ko'nduvarattum; karththarukkuch seluththum kaa'nikkai ennaven'raal, ponnum, ve'l'liyum, ve'nkalamum,
i'laneelanoolum, iraththaamparanoolum, sivappunoolum, melliya pagnchunoolum, ve'l'laattu mayirum,
sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaaththoalum, thakasuththoalum, seeththim maramum,
vi'lakkukku e'n'neyum, apisheakathailaththukkup parima'lavarkkangka'lum, thoopaththukkuch sukanthavarkkangka'lum,
aasaariyarudaiya eapoaththilum maarppathakkaththilum pathikkaththakka koameathakam muthaliya iraththinangka'lumea.
ungka'lil gnaana iruthayamu'l'la anaivarum vanthu, karththar katta'laiyittavaika'laiyellaam seyvaarka'laaka.
vaasasthalaththaiyum, athin koodaaraththaiyum, athin moodiyaiyum, athin kokkika'laiyum, athin palakaika'laiyum, athin thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum, athin thoo'nka'laiyum, athin paathangka'laiyum,
pettiyaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, kirupaasanaththaiyum, ma'raivin thiraichseelaiyaiyum,
meajaiyaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, samukaththappangka'laiyum,
ve'lichchangkodukkum kuththuvi'lakkaiyum, athin karuvika'laiyum, athin akalka'laiyum, ve'lichchaththukku e'n'neyaiyum,
thoopapeedaththaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, apisheakathailaththaiyum, sukantha thoopavarkkaththaiyum, vaasasthalaththin vaasalukkuth thongkuthiraiyaiyum,
thakanapalipeedaththaiyum, athin ve'nkalach salladaiyaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, thottiyaiyum, athin paathaththaiyum,
piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraika'laiyum, athin thoo'nka'laiyum, athin paathangka'laiyum, piraakaaraththu vaasalin thongkuthiraiyaiyum,
vaasasthalaththin mu'laika'laiyum, piraakaaraththin mu'laika'laiyum, avaika'lin kayi'ruka'laiyum,

parisuththa sthalaththilea aaraathanai seyvatha'rkuriya vasthirangka'laiyum, aasaariya oozhiyagnseyki'ra aaroanin parisuththa vasthirangka'laiyum, avan kumaararin vasthirangka'laiyum avarka'l seyyakkadavarka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum moaseayin samukaththaivittup pu'rappattaarka'l.

pinpu evarka'lai avarka'l iruthayam ezhuppi, evarka'lai avarka'l aavi u'rchaakappaduththinathoa, avarka'l ellaarum aasarippuk koodaaraththin vealaikkum, athin sakala oozhiyaththukkum, parisuththa vasthirangka'lukkum eat'ravaika'laik karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

manappoorvamu'l'la sthiree purushar yaavarum, asthakadakangka'l, kaatha'nika'l, moathirangka'l, aarangka'l muthalaana sakala vitha ponnaapara'nangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l; karththarukkuk kaa'nikkai seluththina ovvoruvanum ponnaik kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththinaan.

i'laneelanoolaiyum iraththaamparanoolaiyum sivappunoolaiyum melliya pagnchunoolaiyum ve'l'laattu mayiraiyum sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaaththoalaiyum thakasuththoalaiyum thangka'lidaththil vaiththiruntha yaavarum avaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

ve'l'liyaiyum ve'nkalaththaiyum kodukkaththakka yaavarum avaika'laik karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l. pa'rpala vealaika'lukku uthavum seeththim maraththaith thangka'lidaththil vaiththiruntha yaavarum avaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
gnaana iruthayamu'l'la sthireeka'l ellaarum thangka'l kaika'linaal noot'ru, thaangka'l noot'ra i'laneelanoolaiyum iraththaamparanoolaiyum sivappunoolaiyum melliya pagnchunoolaiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
entha sthireeka'ludaiya iruthayam gnaana ezhupputhal adainthathoa, avarka'l ellaarum ve'l'laattu mayiraith thiriththaarka'l.
pirapukka'l eapoaththilum maarppathakkaththilum pathikkum koameathakam muthaliya iraththinangka'laiyum,
parima'lavarkkangka'laiyum, vi'lakke'n'neyaiyum, apisheakathailaththukkum sukanthavarkka thoopaththukkum vea'ndiyavaika'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

seyyappadumpadi karththar moaseayaikko'ndu ka'rpiththa vealaikkuriya yaavaiyum ko'nduvara, israveal puththirarukku'l thangka'l iruthayaththil u'rchaakamadaintha sthiree purushar yaavarum karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyai manappoorvamaayk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
pinpu moasea israveal puththirarai noakki: paarungka'l, karththar yoothaavin koaththiraththil oorin makanaana ooriyin kumaaran pesaleyealaip pearsolli azhaiththu,
avan visiththiramaana vealaika'lai yoasiththuch seyyavum, ponnilum ve'l'liyilum ve'nkalaththilum vealaiseyyavum,
iraththinangka'lai muththirai vettaaka vettip pathikkavum, maraththil siththira vealai seythu sakala vinoathamaana vealaika'laich seyyavum,
avanukku gnaanaththaiyum puththiyaiyum a'rivaiyum aru'li, avan sakalavitha vealaika'laiyum seyyumpadi theavaaaviyinaalea avanai nirappinaar.
avan iruthayaththilum, thaa'n koaththiraththu akisaamaakin kumaaranaakiya akoaliyaapin iruthayaththilum, poathikkum varaththaiyum aru'linaar.

siththiravealaiyaiyum si'rpavealaiyaiyum, i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum melliya pagnchunoolaalum seyyappadum visiththirath thaiyalvealaiyaiyum, sakala visiththira nesavu vealaika'laiyum vinoathamaana vealaika'lai yookikki'ravarka'lum seyki'ravarka'lum ni'raiveat'rum sakalavitha vealaika'laiyum seyyumpadikku avarka'ludaiya iruthayaththai gnaanaththinaal nirappinaar en'raan.

appozhuthu parisuththa sthalaththuth thiruppa'nika'lukkaduththa sakala vealaika'laiyum, karththar ka'rpiththapadiyellaam, pesaleyealum akoaliyaapum, seyya a'riyumpadikkuk karththaraal gnaanamum puththiyum pet'ra viveaka iruthayamu'l'la mat'ra anaivarum seyyaththodangkinaarka'l.

pesaleyealaiyum akoaliyaapaiyum, karththaraal gnaanamadainthu antha vealaika'laich seyyavarumpadi thangka'l iruthayaththil ezhupputhaladaintha gnaana iruthayaththaaraakiya ellaaraiyum, moasea varavazhaiththaan.

avarka'l, israveal puththirar thiruppa'nikkaduththa sakala vealaika'lukkaakavum ko'nduvantha kaa'nikkaip poru'lka'laiyellaam, moaseayinidaththil vaangkikko'ndaarka'l. pinnum janangka'l kaalaithoa'rum thangka'lukku ishdamaana kaa'nikkaika'lai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu parisuththa sthalaththu vealaika'laich seyki'ra viveakika'l yaavarum avaravar seyki'ra vealaiyin kaariyamaay vanthu,
moaseayai noakki: karththar seyyumpadi ka'rpiththa vealaikku vea'ndiyatha'rku athikamaana poru'lka'lai janangka'l ko'nduvaruki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea ini purusharka'laavathu sthireeka'laavathu parisuththa sthalaththukken'ru kaa'nikkaiyaaka oru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam en'ru paa'layam engkum koo'rumpadi katta'laiyittaan; ivvithamaay janangka'l ko'nduvaruki'rathu ni'ruththappattathu.
seyyavea'ndiya ellaa vealaika'lukkum poathumaana poru'lka'l irunthathumallaamal athikamaayum irunthathu.

vealaiseyki'ravarka'laakiya gnaana iruthayamu'l'la yaavarum vaasasthalaththai u'ndaakkinaarka'l. atha'rkuth thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum, vinoatha nesavuvealaiyaakiya kearupeenka'lu'l'la paththu mooduthiraika'laip pa'n'ninaan.
ovvoru mooduthirai irupaththettu muzha nee'lamum naalu muzha akalamumaayirunthathu; mooduthiraika'lellaam orea a'lavaayirunthathu.
ainthu mooduthiraika'lai on'roadon'ru i'naiththu, mat'ra ainthu mooduthiraika'laiyum on'roadon'ru i'naiththaan.
i'naikkappatta oru mooduthiraiyin oaraththil i'laneelanoolaal aimpathu kaathuka'lai u'ndupa'n'ni, appadiyea i'naikkappatta mat'ra mooduthiraiyin oaraththilum u'ndupa'n'ninaan.
kaathuka'l on'roadon'ru i'naikkappattavaika'laayirunthathu.
aimpathu pon kokkika'laiyum pa'n'ni, anthak kokkika'laal mooduthiraika'lai on'roadon'ru i'naiththuvittaan. ivvithamaaka orea vaasasthalamaayit'ru.
vaasasthalaththinmeal koodaaramaakap poadumpadi aattumayirinaal neytha pathinoru mooduthiraika'laiyum pa'n'ninaan.
ovvoru mooduthirai muppathu muzha nee'lamum naalu muzha akalamumaayirunthathu. pathinoru mooduthiraika'lum orea a'lavaayirunthathu.
ainthu mooduthiraika'lai on'raakavum, mat'ra aa'ru mooduthiraika'lai on'raakavum i'naiththu,
i'naikkappatta oru mooduthiraiyin oaraththil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum, i'naikkappatta mat'ra mooduthiraiyin oaraththil aimpathu kaathuka'laiyum u'ndaakki,
koodaaraththai on'raay i'naiththuvida, aimpathu ve'nkalak kokkika'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan.
sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaath thoalinaal koodaaraththukku oru moodiyaiyum athinmeal poadath thakasuththoalinaal oru moodiyaiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaan.
vaasasthalaththukku nimirnthuni'rkum palakaika'laiyum seeththim maraththaal seythaan.
ovvoru palakaiyum paththumuzha nee'lamum on'rarai muzha akalamumaayirunthathu.
ovvoru palakaikkum on'rukkon'ru samathooramaana ira'ndu kazhunthuka'l irunthathu; vaasasthalaththin palakaika'lukkellaam ippadiyea seythaan.
vaasasthalaththi'rkaakach seyyappatta palakaika'lil the'rkea thenthisaikku irupathu palakaika'lai u'ndaakki,

antha irupathu palakaika'lin keezhea vaikkum naa'rpathu ve'l'lip paathangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaan; oru palakaiyin keezh athin ira'ndu kazhunthuka'lukkum ira'ndu paathangka'laiyum, mat'rap palakaiyinkeezh athin ira'ndu kazhunthuka'lukkum ira'ndu paathangka'laiyum pa'n'nivaiththu;
vaasasthalaththin ma'rupakkamaakiya vadapu'raththil irupathu palakaika'laiyum, avaika'lukku naa'rpathu ve'l'lip paathangka'laiyum seythaan.
oru palakaiyinkeezh ira'ndu paathangka'lum, mat'rap palakaiyinkeezh ira'ndu paathangka'lum seythaan.
vaasasthalaththin mealpu'raththi'rku aa'ru palakaika'laiyum,
vaasasthalaththin irupakkangka'lilu'l'la moolaika'lukku ira'ndu palakaika'laiyum seythaan.
avaika'l keezhea isaikkappattirunthathu, mealeayum oru va'laiyaththinaal isaikkappattirunthathu; ira'ndu moolaika'lilumu'l'la avvira'ndi'rkum appadiyea seythaan.
appadiyea ettup palakaika'lum, avaika'ludaiya ovvoru palakaiyin keezh ira'ndira'ndu paathangka'laakap pathinaa'ru ve'l'lippaathangka'lum irunthathu.
seeththim maraththaal vaasasthalaththin oru pakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum,
vaasasthalaththin ma'rupakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum, vaasasthalaththin mealpu'ramaana pinpakkaththup palakaika'lukku ainthu thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum pa'n'ninaan.
naduththaazhppaa'l oru munai thodangki ma'rumunaimattum palakaika'lin maiyaththil uruvappaayumpadi seythaan.
palakaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi, thaazhppaa'lka'lin idangka'laakiya avaika'lin va'laiyangka'laip ponninaal pa'n'ni, thaazhppaa'lka'laip ponthakattaal moodinaan.

i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seyyappattathum, visiththiravealaiyaakiya kearupeenka'lu'l'lathumaana oru thiraichseelaiyai u'ndupa'n'ni,
atha'rkuch seeththim maraththinaal naalu thoo'nka'laich seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi, avaika'lin kokkika'laip ponninaal pa'n'ni, avaika'lukku naanku ve'l'lippaathangka'lai vaarppiththaan.
koodaaravaasalukku i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seytha siththirath thaiyalvealaiyaana oru thongkuthiraiyaiyum,

athin ainthu thoo'nka'laiyum, avaika'lin va'laivaa'nika'laiyum u'ndaakki, avaika'lin kumizhka'laiyum va'laiyangka'laiyum ponthakattaal moodinaan; avaika'lin ainthu paathangka'lum ve'nkalamaayirunthathu.
pesaleyeal seeththim maraththinaal pettiyai u'ndupa'n'ninaan; athin nee'lam ira'ndarai muzhamum athin akalam on'rarai muzhamum athin uyaram on'rarai muzhamumaanathu.
athai u'l'lum pu'rampum pasumpon thakattaal moodi, sut'rilum atha'rkup pon thira'naiyai u'ndaakki,

atha'rku naanku pon va'laiyangka'lai vaarppiththu, avaika'lai athin naalu moolaika'lilum poattu, oru pakkaththil ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lum ma'rupakkaththil ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lum irukkumpadi thaiththu,
seeththim maraththinaal tha'nduka'laich seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi,
anthath tha'nduka'laal pettiyaich sumakkumpadi, avaika'laip pettiyin pakkangka'lil irukkum va'laiyangka'lilea paaychchinaan.
kirupaasanaththaiyum pasumponninaal pa'n'ninaan; athu ira'ndarai muzha nee'lamum on'rarai muzha akalamumaanathu.
thakadaay adikkappatta ponninaal ira'ndu kearupeenka'laiyum u'ndaakki, kirupaasanaththin ira'ndu oarangka'lilea,

orupu'raththu oaraththil oru kearupeenum ma'rupu'raththu oaraththil mat'rak kearupeenumaaka anthak kearupeenka'laik kirupaasanaththin ira'ndu oarangka'lilum athanoadea eaka vealaippaadaakavea pa'n'ninaan.

anthak kearupeenka'l thangka'l settaika'lai uyara viriththu, thangka'l settaika'laal kirupaasanaththai mooduki'ravaika'lum, on'rukkon'ru ethirmukamu'l'lavaika'lumaayirunthathu; kearupeenka'lin mukangka'l kirupaasanaththai noakkikko'ndirunthathu.
meajaiyaiyum seeththim maraththaal pa'n'ninaan; athu ira'ndu muzha nee'lamum oru muzha akalamum on'rarai muzha uyaramumaanathu.
athaip pasumponthakattaal moodi, sut'rilum atha'rkup pon thira'naiyai u'ndaakki,
sut'rilum atha'rku naanku vira'rkadaiyaana sattaththaiyum, athin sattaththi'rkuch sut'rilum pon thira'naiyaiyum u'ndupa'n'ni,
atha'rku naanku ponva'laiyangka'lai vaarppiththu, avaika'lai athin naalu kaalka'lukku irukkum naalu moolaika'lilum thaiththaan.
antha va'laiyangka'l meajaiyaich sumakkum tha'nduka'laip paaychchum idangka'laayirukkumpadi sattaththin arukea irunthathu.
meajaiyaich sumakkum anthath tha'nduka'laich seeththim maraththaal pa'n'ni, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodi,

meajaiyinmealirukkum paaththirangka'laakiya athin pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, athin thattuka'laiyum, thoopakkara'ndika'laiyum, athin paanapali karakangka'laiyum, mooduki'ratha'rkaana athin ki'n'nangka'laiyum pasumponninaal u'ndaakkinaan.
kuththuvi'lakkaiyum pasumponninaal adippuvealaiyaay u'ndaakkinaan; athin tha'ndum ki'laika'lum mokkuka'lum pazhangka'lum pookka'lum ponninaal seyyappattirunthathu.
kuththuvi'lakkin oru pakkaththil moon'ru ki'laika'lum athin ma'rupakkaththil moon'ru ki'laika'lumaaka athin pakkangka'lil aa'ru ki'laika'l seyyappattathu.
ovvoru ki'laiyilea vaathumaikkottaikku oppaana moon'ru mokkuka'lum oru pazhamum oru poovum irunthathu; kuththuvi'lakkil seyyappatta aa'ru ki'laika'lilum appadiyea irunthathu.
vi'lakkuththa'ndil vaathumaikkottaikku oppaana naalu mokkuka'lum pazhangka'lum pookka'lum irunthathu.

athil seyyappatta ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum, vea'ru ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum, mat'ra ira'ndu ki'laika'linkeezh oru pazhamum irunthathu; vi'lakkuththa'ndil seyyappatta aa'ruki'laika'lukkum appadiyea irunthathu.
avaika'lin pazhangka'lum avaika'lin ki'laika'lum pasumponninaal orea adippu vealaiyaaych seyyappattathu.
athin eazhu akalka'laiyum, athin kaththarika'laiyum, saampal paaththirangka'laiyum pasumponninaal seythaan.
athaiyum athin pa'nimuttuka'l yaavaiyum oru thaalanthu pasumponninaal seythaan.

thoopapeedaththaiyum seeththim maraththinaal u'ndaakkinaan; athu oru muzha nee'lamum oru muzha akalamumaana sathuramum ira'ndu muzha uyaramumaay irunthathu; athin kompuka'l athanoadea eaka vealaippaadaayirunthathu.
athin mea'rpu'raththaiyum, athin sut'ruppu'raththaiyum, athin kompuka'laiyum, pasumponthakattaal moodi, sut'rilum atha'rkup pon thira'naiyai u'ndupa'n'ni,
anthath thira'naiyinkeezh athin ira'ndu pakkangka'lil irukkum ira'ndu moolaika'lilum ira'ndu ponva'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni, athaich sumakkum tha'nduka'laip paaychchum idangka'laakath thaiththu,
seeththim maraththaal anthath tha'nduka'laich seythu, avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodinaan.
parisuththa apisheakathailaththaiyum, suththamaana sukanthangka'lin thoopavarkkaththaiyum, thailakkaaran vealaikku oppaaka u'ndupa'n'ninaan.
thakanapalipeedaththaiyum seeththim maraththaal u'ndaakkinaan; athu ainthu muzha nee'lamum ainthu muzha akalamum sathuravadivum moon'ru muzha uyaramumaanathu.
athin naalu moolaika'lilum athanoadu eakamaayirukki'ra athin naalu kompuka'laiyum u'ndaakki, athai ve'nkalaththakattaal moodi,

anthap peedaththin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laakiya saampal edukkaththakka sattika'laiyum, kara'ndika'laiyum, ki'n'nika'laiyum, mu'lthu'raduka'laiyum, neruppuch sattika'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan; athin pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam ve'nkalaththinaal pa'n'ninaan.
valaippinnalpoan'ra oru ve'nkalach salladaiyaiyum palipeedaththi'rku u'ndaakki, athai anthap peedaththin sut'rukkuk keezhea paathi uyaraththil irukkaththakkathaaka vaiththu,
antha ve'nkalach salladaiyin naalu moolaika'lilum tha'nduka'laip paaychchuki'ratha'rku naalu va'laiyangka'lai vaarppiththu,
anthath tha'nduka'laich seeththim maraththaal pa'n'ni, avaika'lai ve'nkalaththakattaal moodi,
palipeedaththai avaika'laal sumakkaththakkathaaka, athin pakkangka'lilu'l'la va'laiyangka'lil paaychchinaan; palipeedaththai u'lve'livittup palakaika'linaal seythaan.
aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasalil koottam koottamaayk koodina sthireeka'lin tharppa'nangka'laalea, ve'nkalath thottiyaiyum athin ve'nkalap paathaththaiyum u'ndaakkinaan.
piraakaaraththaiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaan. the'rkea thenthisaikku ethiraana piraakaaraththukkuth thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaal neytha noo'ru muzha nee'lamaana thongkuthiraika'laich seythaan.
avaika'lin thoo'nka'l irupathu; avaika'lin ve'nkalap paathangka'l irupathu; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum avaika'lin poo'nka'lum ve'l'li.
vadapakkaththuth thongkuthiraika'l noo'ru muzham; avaika'lin thoo'nka'l irupathu; avaika'lin ve'nkalap paathangka'l irupathu; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum poo'nka'lum ve'l'li.
mea'rpakkaththuth thongkuthiraika'l aimpathu muzham; avaika'lin thoo'nka'l paththu; avaika'lin paathangka'l paththu; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum avaika'lin poo'nka'lum ve'l'li.
sooriyan uthikki'ra thisaiyaakiya keezhppakkaththuth thongkuthiraika'l aimpathu muzham.
orupu'raththuth thongkuthiraika'l pathinainthu muzham; avaika'lin thoo'nka'l moon'ru; avaika'lin paathangka'l moon'ru.
piraakaaravaasalin orupu'raththukkuch sariyaaka ma'rupu'raththilum thongkuthiraika'l pathinainthu muzham; avaika'lin thoo'nka'l moon'ru; avaika'lin paathangka'l moon'ru.
sut'ruppiraakaaraththuth thongkuthiraika'lellaam melliya pagnchunoolaal neyyappattirunthathu.

thoo'nka'lin paathangka'l ve'nkalam; thoo'nka'lin kokkika'lum poo'nka'lum ve'l'li; avaika'lin kumizhka'lai moodiya thakadum ve'l'li; piraakaaraththin thoo'nka'lellaam ve'l'lippoo'nka'l poadappattavaika'lumaayirunthathu.

piraakaara vaasalin thongkuthirai i'laneela noolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seyyappatta visiththiraththaiyal vealaiyaayirunthathu; athin nee'lam irupathu muzham, athin akalamum uyaramum piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraika'lukkuch sariyaay ainthu muzham.
avaika'lin thoo'nka'l naalu; avaika'lin ve'nkalap paathangka'l naalu; avaika'lin kokkika'l ve'l'li; avaika'lin kumizhka'lai moodiya thakadum avaika'lin poo'nka'lum ve'l'li.
vaasasthalaththukkum piraakaaraththukkum sut'rilum iruntha mu'laika'lellaam ve'nkalam.
moaseayin katta'laippadi aasaariyanaana aaroanin kumaaranaakiya iththaamaarin kaiyilea leaviyarin oozhiyaththi'rken'ru e'n'nik kodukkappatta saadchiyin vaasasthalaththup poru'lka'lin thokai ithuvea.
yoothaavin koaththiraththil oorin makanaakiya ooriyin kumaaran pesaleyeal karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththathai ellaam seythaan.

avanoadeakoodath thaa'n koaththiraththu akisaamaakin kumaaranaakiya akoaliyaap siththirak koththuvealaikkaaranum, vinoatha vealaika'laich seyki'ra thozhilaa'liyum, i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum melliya pagnchunoolaalum siththirath thaiyalvealai seyki'ravanumaayirunthaan.

parisuththa sthalaththin vealaika'l yaavat'ri'rkum kaa'nikkaiyaakak kodukkappattuch selavaana ponnellaam parisuththa sthalaththin seakkalinpadi irupaththonpathu thaalanthum ezhunoot'ru muppathu seakkal ni'raiyumaay irunthathu.
sapaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l koduththa ve'l'li parisuththa sthalaththin seakkalinpadi noo'ru thaalanthum, aayiraththezhunoot'ru ezhupaththainthu seakkal ni'raiyumaay irunthathu.

e'n'nappattavarka'lin thokaiyil searntha irupathu vayathu mutha'rko'ndu atha'rku mea'rpatta aa'ruladchaththu moovaayiraththu ainnoot'ru aimpathu pearka'lil ovvoru thalaikku parisuththa sthalaththin seakkalinpadi araichseakkalaakiya pekkaa ennum vizhukkaadu searnthathu.

antha ve'l'liyil noo'ru thaalanthu ve'l'liyinaal parisuththa sthalaththin paathangka'lum thiraiyin paathangka'lum vaarppikkappattathu; paathaththukku oru thaalanthu vizhukkaadu noo'ru paathangka'lukku noo'ru thaalanthu selavaayit'ru.
antha aayiraththezhunoot'ru ezhupaththainthu seakkalaal thoo'nka'lukkup poo'nka'laip pa'n'ni, avaika'lin kumizhka'laith thakaduka'laal moodi, avaika'lukkup poo'nka'lai u'ndaakkinaan.
kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththappatta ve'nkalamaanathu ezhupathu thaalanthum ira'ndaayiraththu naanoo'ru seakkal ni'raiyumaay irunthathu.
athinaalea aasarippuk koodaaravaasal ma'raivin paathangka'laiyum, ve'nkalap palipeedaththaiyum, athin ve'nkalach salladaiyaiyum, palipeedaththin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum,
sut'rup piraakaaraththin paathangka'laiyum, piraakaaravaasal ma'raivin paathangka'laiyum, vaasasthalaththin sakala mu'laika'laiyum, sut'ruppiraakaaraththin sakala mu'laika'laiyum pa'n'ninaan.

karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, avarka'l i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum parisuththa sthalaththil aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rku vea'ndiya vasthirangka'laiyum, aaroanukkup parisuththa vasthirangka'laiyum seythaarka'l.
eapoaththaip ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappu noolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seythaan.

anthap ponnai, i'laneelanooloadum iraththaamparanooloadum sivappunooloadum melliya pagnchunooloadum searththu visiththiravealaiyaay neyyumpadikku, melliya thakaduka'laay adiththu, avaika'laich sarikaika'laakap pa'n'ninaarka'l.
ira'ndu thoa'lka'linmealu'l'la athin ira'ndu munaika'laiyum searththaarka'l; athu on'raay i'naikkappattirunthathu.

antha eapoaththinmealirukkum visiththiramaana kachchai, antha vealaikku oppaakavea ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum, thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, seyyappattathu.
israveal puththirarin naamangka'lai muththirai vettuvealaiyaakak koameathakak ka'rka'lil vetti, avaika'laip pon kuva'laika'lil pathiththaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, avaika'l israveal puththiraraikku'riththu gnaapakakku'rik ka'rka'laayirukkumpadi eapoaththuth thoa'lka'linmeal avaika'lai vaiththaan.
maarppathakkaththai eapoaththin vealaikku oththa visiththiravealaiyaakap ponninaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum seythaan.
antha maarppathakkaththaich sathuramum irattaiyumaaych seythu, oru jaa'n nee'lamum oru jaa'n akalamumaakki,
athilea naalu paththi raththinakka'rka'laip pathiththaarka'l; muthalaam paththi pathmaraakamum pushparaakamum maa'nikkamum,
ira'ndaam paththi marakathamum inthiraneelamum vachchiramum,
moon'raam paththi kempum vaidooriyamum sukanthiyum,
naalaam paththi padikappachchaiyum koameathakamum yaspiyumaanathu. avaika'l anthantha idangka'lilea pon kuva'laika'lil pathikkappattirunthathu.

inthak ka'rka'l israveal puththirarudaiya naamangka'linpadiyea pannira'ndum, avarka'ludaiya naamangka'lu'l'lavaika'lumaayirunthathu; pannira'ndu koaththirangka'lil ovvoru koaththiraththin naamam ovvon'ril muththirai vettaay vettiyirunthathu.
maarppathakkaththukku athin pakkangka'lilea pinnal vealaiyaana pasumpon sangkilika'laiyum pa'n'ni,
ira'ndu pon kuva'laika'laiyum ira'ndu pon va'laiyangka'laiyum seythu, antha ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lai maarppathakkaththin ira'ndu pakkaththilum vaiththu,
ponninaal seytha pinnal vealaiyaana antha ira'ndu sangkilika'laiyum maarppathakkaththin pakkangka'lil irukki'ra ira'ndu va'laiyangka'lilum maatti,
pinnal vealaiyaana avvira'ndu sangkilika'lin ira'ndu nunika'laiyum eapoaththin thoa'lpu'raththuth thu'nduka'lmeal munpu'raththil irukki'ra ira'ndu kuva'laika'lilum maattinaarka'l.
pinnum ira'ndu va'laiyangka'laip pa'n'ni, avaika'lai eapoaththin keezhppu'raththi'rku ethiraana maarppathakkaththin mat'ra ira'ndu pakkangka'lilum athin oaraththil vaiththu,

vea'rea ira'ndu pon va'laiyangka'laiyum pa'n'ni, avaika'lai eapoaththin munpu'raththin ira'ndu keezhppakkangka'lil athin i'naippukku ethiraakavum, eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaikku mealaakavum vaiththu,

maarppathakkam eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaikku mealaaka irukkumpadikkum, eapoaththilirunthu neengkippoakaathapadikkum, athai athin va'laiyangka'laal eapoaththin va'laiyangka'loadea i'laneela naadaavinaalea, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, kattinaarka'l.
eapoaththin keezh angkiyai muzhuvathum i'laneelanoolaal neythaan.
angkiyin naduvil maarkkavasath thuvaaraththukku oppaaka oru thuvaaramum, athu kizhiyaathapadi anthath thuvaaraththaich sut'rilum oru naadaavum thaiththirunthathu.
angkiyin keezh oarangka'lil thongkaththakkathaakath thiriththa i'laneelanoolum iraththaamparanoolum sivappunoolumaana vealaiyaaka maatha'lampazhangka'laip pa'n'ni,
pasumponninaal ma'nika'laiyum pa'n'ni, antha ma'nika'lai angkiyin oarangka'lil sut'rilum maatha'lampazhangka'lin idaiidaiyea thongkavaiththaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea aaraathanaikkuriya angkiyin oaraththaich sut'rilum, oru ma'niyum oru maatha'lampazhamum, oru ma'niyum oru maatha'lampazhamumaay irunthathu.
aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum melliya pagnchunoolaal nesavuvealaiyaana angkika'laiyum,
melliya pagnchunoolaal paakaiyaiyum, alangkaaramaana kullaakka'laiyum, thiriththa melliya sa'nalnoolaal salladangka'laiyum,

thiriththa melliya pagnchunoolaalum i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum siththirath thaiyalvealaiyaana idaikkachchaiyaiyum, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, seythaarka'l.
parisuththa kireedaththin pattaththaiyum pasumponninaalea pa'n'ni, karththarukkup parisuththam ennum ezhuththukka'lai athilea muththirai vettaaka vetti,
athai uyarap paakaiyinmeal kattumpadi, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, i'laneela naadaavinaal kattinaarka'l.
ippadiyea aasarippuk koodaaramaakiya vaasasthalaththin vealaiyellaam mudinthathu; karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam israveal puththirar seythaarka'l.

pinpu, vaasasthalaththai moaseayinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; koodaaraththaiyum, atha'rkuriya ellaap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, athin thu'raduka'laiyum, athin palakaika'laiyum, athin thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum, athin thoo'nka'laiyum, athin paathangka'laiyum,
sivappuththeerntha aattukkadaaththoal moodiyaiyum, thakasuththoal moodiyaiyum, ma'raivin thiraichseelaiyaiyum,
saadchippettiyaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, kirupaasanaththaiyum,
meajaiyaiyum, athin ellaap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, samukaththappangka'laiyum,
suththamaana kuththuvi'lakkaiyum, varisaiyaay ozhungkupaduththappatta athin akalka'laiyum, athin ellaap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, ve'lichchaththi'rku e'n'neyaiyum,
po'rpeedaththaiyum, apisheakathailaththaiyum, sukantha thoopavarkkaththaiyum, vaasasthalaththin vaasal thongkuthiraiyaiyum,
ve'nkalap palipeedaththaiyum, athin ve'nkalach salladaiyaiyum, athin tha'nduka'laiyum, athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, thottiyaiyum, athin paathaththaiyum,

piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraika'laiyum, athin thoo'nka'laiyum, athin paathangka'laiyum, piraakaaraththu vaasal ma'raivaiyum, athin kayi'ruka'laiyum, athin mu'laika'laiyum, aasarippuk koodaaramaana vaasasthalaththin vealaikkaduththa sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum,

parisuththa sthalaththilea seyyum aaraathanaikkaduththa vasthirangka'laiyum, aasaariya oozhiyagnseyki'ra aaroanin parisuththa vasthirangka'laiyum, avan kumaararin vasthirangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam israveal puththirar sakala vealaika'laiyum seythaarka'l.
moasea antha vealaika'laiyellaam paarththaan; karththar ka'rpiththapadiyea athaich seythirunthaarka'l. moasea avarka'lai aaseervathiththaan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee muthalaam maatham muthal theathiyil aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasasthalaththai sthaapanampa'n'nu.
athilea saadchippettiyai vaiththu, pettiyaith thiraiyinaal ma'raiththu,
meajaiyaik ko'nduvanthu, athil vaikkavea'ndiyathaik kiramamaay vaiththu, kuththuvi'lakkaik ko'nduvanthu, athin vi'lakkuka'lai eat'ri,
pon thoopapeedaththaich saadchippettikku munnea vaiththu, vaasasthalaththu vaasalin thongkuthiraiyaith thookkivaikkakkadavaay.
pinpu, thakana palipeedaththai aasarippuk koodaaramaakiya vaasasthalaththin vaasalukku munpaaka vaiththu,
thottiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththukkum palipeedaththukkum naduvea vaiththu, athilea tha'n'neer vaarththu,
sut'rup piraakaaraththai ni'ruththi, piraakaaravaasal thongkuthiraiyaith thookkivaiththu,

apisheaka thailaththai eduththu, vaasasthalaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavaiyum apisheakampa'n'ni, athaiyum athilu'l'la sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka; appozhuthu parisuththamaayirukkum.
thakanapalipeedaththaiyum athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum apisheakampa'n'ni, athaip parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka; appozhuthu athu makaa parisuththamaana palipeedamaayirukkum.
thottiyaiyum athin paathaththaiyum apisheakampa'n'ni, parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka.
pinpu aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil varachseythu, avarka'lai jalaththinaal snaanampa'n'nuviththu,
aaroanukkup parisuththa vasthirangka'lai uduththi, enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadikku avanai apisheakampa'n'ni, avanaip parisuththappaduththuvaayaaka.
avan kumaararaiyum varachseythu, avarka'lukku angkika'lai uduththi,

avarka'l enakku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadi, avarka'laiyum, avarka'l thakappanai apisheakampa'n'ninapadiyea, apisheakampa'n'nuvaayaaka; avarka'l pe'rum antha apisheakam thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya aasaariyaththuvaththukku eathuvaayirukkum en'raar.
karththar thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam moasea seythaan.
ira'ndaam varusham muthalaam maatham muthal theathiyil vaasasthalam sthaapanampa'n'nappattathu.
moasea koodaaraththai eduppiththaan; avan athin paathangka'lai vaiththu, athin palakaika'lai ni'ruththi, athin thaazhppaa'lka'laip paaychchi, athin thoo'nka'lai naatti,
vaasasthalaththinmeal koodaaraththai viriththu, athinmeal koodaaraththin moodiyai, karththar thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea poattaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, saadchippiramaa'naththai eduththu, athaip pettiyilea vaiththu, pettiyil tha'nduka'laippaaychchi, pettiyinmeal kirupaasana moodiyai vaiththu,
pettiyai vaasasthalaththukku'l'lea ko'ndupoay, ma'raivin thiraichseelaiyaith thongkavaiththu, saadchippettiyai ma'raiththuvaiththaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, meajaiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththil vaasasthalaththin vadapu'ramaayth thiraikkup pu'rampaaka vaiththu,
athinmeal karththarudaiya samukaththil appaththai varisaiyaaka adukki vaiththaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, kuththuvi'lakkai aasarippuk koodaaraththil meajaikku ethiraaka vaasasthalaththin thenpu'raththilea vaiththu,
karththarudaiya sannithiyil vi'lakkuka'lai eat'rinaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, aasarippuk koodaaraththil thiraikku munpaakap po'rpeedaththai vaiththu,
athinmeal sukanthavarkkaththinaal thoopangkaattinaan.
pinpu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, vaasasthalaththin thongkuthiraiyaith thookkivaiththu,
thakanapalipeedaththai aasarippuk koodaaramaana vaasasthalaththin vaasalukku munpaaka vaiththu, athinmeal sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum seluththinaan.
avan aasarippuk koodaaraththukkum palipeedaththukkum naduvea thottiyai vaiththu, kazhuvuki'ratha'rku athilea tha'n'neer vaarththaan.
avvidaththilea moaseayum aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'laiyum kaalka'laiyum kazhuvinaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththukku'l'lea piraveasikki'rapoathum, palipeedaththa'ndaiyil searuki'rapoathum, avarka'l kazhuvikko'l'luvaarka'l.
pinpu, avan vaasasthalaththaiyum palipeedaththaiyum sut'rip piraakaaraththai ni'ruththi, piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraiyaith thongkavaiththaan; ivvithamaay moasea vealaiyai mudiththaan.
appozhuthu oru meakam aasarippuk koodaaraththai moodinathu; karththarudaiya makimai vaasasthalaththai nirappit'ru.
meakam athinmeal thangki, karththarudaiya makimai vaasasthalaththai nirappinathinaal, moasea aasarippuk koodaaraththukku'l piraveasikkakkoodaamal irunthathu.
vaasasthalaththilirunthu meakam mealea ezhumpumpoathu, israveal puththirar pirayaa'nam pa'n'nap pu'rappaduvaarka'l.
meakam ezhumpaathirunthaal, athu ezhumpum naa'lvaraikkum pirayaa'nam pa'n'naathiruppaarka'l.

israveal vamsaththaar pa'n'num ellaap pirayaa'nangka'lilum avarka'lellaarudaiya ka'nka'lukkum piraththiyadchamaakap pakalil karththarudaiya meakamum, iravil akkiniyum, vaasasthalaththinmeal thangkiyirunthathu.
karththar aasarippuk koodaaraththilirunthu moaseayaik kooppittu, avanai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraridaththil sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, ungka'lil oruvan karththarukkup paliseluththa vanthaal, maattumanthaiyilaavathu aattumanthaiyilaavathu oru mirukaththaith therintheduththu, paliseluththa vea'ndum.

avan seluththuvathu maattu manthaiyilirunthu edukkappatta sarvaangka thakanapaliyaanaal, avan pazhuthat'ra oru kaa'laiyaich seluththuvaanaaka; karththarudaiya sannithiyil thaan angkikarikkappadumpadi, avan athai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil ko'nduvanthu,
athu than paavanivirththikken'ru angkikarikkappadumpadi than kaiyai athin thalaiyinmeal vaiththu,

karththarudaiya sannithiyil anthak kaa'laiyaik kollakkadavan; appozhuthu aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyarka'l athin iraththaththai eduththu, athai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil irukki'ra palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'likkakkadavarka'l.
pinpu avan anthach sarvaangka thakanapaliyaith thoaluriththu, athaich santhusanthaakath thu'ndikkakkadavan.
appozhuthu aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaarar palipeedaththinmeal akkiniyaip poattu, akkiniyinmeal kattaika'lai adukki,
avan kumaararaakiya aasaariyarka'l, thu'ndangka'laiyum thalaiyaiyum kozhuppaiyum palipeedaththilu'l'la akkiniyil irukki'ra kattaika'linmeal adukkivaikkakkadavarka'l.

athin kudalka'laiyum thodaika'laiyum avan tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvuvaanaaka; avaika'laiyellaam aasaariyan palipeedaththinmeal sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakath thakanikkakkadavan; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.

avan seluththuvathu semma'riyaattu manthaiyilu'l'la aaduka'lilaavathu ve'l'laattu manthaiyilu'l'la aaduka'lilaavathu edukkappatta sarvaangka thakana paliyaanaal, pazhuthat'ra oru kadaavaik ko'nduvanthu,

karththarudaiya sannithiyil palipeedaththin vadapu'raththil athaik kollakkadavan; appozhuthu aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyarka'l athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'likkakkadavarka'l.

pinpu avan athaich santhusanthaakath thu'ndiththu, athin thalaiyaiyum kozhuppaiyum koodavaippaanaaka; avaika'lai aasaariyan palipeedaththilu'l'la akkiniyil irukki'ra kattaika'linmeal adukkivaikkakkadavan.

kudalka'laiyum thodaika'laiyum avan tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvuvaanaaka; avaika'laiyellaam aasaariyan ko'nduvanthu palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan; ithu sarvaangka thakanapali; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.
avan karththarukkuch seluththuvathu pa'ravaika'lilirunthu edukkappatta sarvaangka thakanapaliyaanaal, kaattup pu'raakka'lilaavathu pu'raakkugnchuka'lilaavathu eduththuch seluththakkadavan.
athai aasaariyan palipeedaththa'ndaiyil ko'nduvanthu, athin thalaiyaikki'l'li, palipeedaththil thakaniththu, athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththin pakkaththil sinthavittu,
athin iraippaiyai athin malaththoadungkooda eduththu, athaip palipeedaththa'ndaiyil keezhpu'ramaakach saampal irukki'ra idaththilea e'rinthuvittu,

pinpu athin settaika'ludan athai ira'ndaakkaamal pi'lappaanaaka; pinpu aasaariyan athaip palipeedaththilu'l'la akkiniyil irukki'ra kattaika'linmeal thakanikkakkadavan; ithu sarvaangka thakanapali; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.
oruvan poajanapaliyaakiya kaa'nikkaiyaik karththarukkuch seluththavea'ndumaanaal, avan kaa'nikkai melliya maavaayiruppathaaka; avan athinmeal e'n'ney vaarththu, athinmeal thoopavarkkam poattu,

athai aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyarka'lidaththil ko'nduvaruvaanaaka; appozhuthu aasaariyan antha maavilum e'n'neyilum oru kaippidi ni'raiya thoopavarkkam ellaavat'roadum eduththu, athaip palipeedaththinmeal gnaapakakku'riyaakath thakanikkakkadavan; athu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.
anthap poajanapaliyil meethiyaayiruppathu aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum searum; karththarukku idum thakanapalika'lil ithu makaa parisuththamaanathu.

nee padaippathu aduppil paakampa'n'nappatta poajanapaliyaanaal, athu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal seytha pu'lippillaa athirasangka'laayaavathu, e'n'ney poosappatta pu'lippillaa adaika'laayaavathu iruppathaaka.
nee padaippathu thattaiyaana sattiyil paakampa'n'nappatta poajanapaliyaanaal, athu e'n'neyilea pisaintha pu'lippillaa melliya maavinaal seyyappattathaayiruppathaaka.
athaith thu'ndu thu'ndaakap pittu, athinmeal e'n'ney vaarppaayaaka; ithu oru poajanapali.
nee padaippathu porikkugn sattiyil paakampa'n'nappatta poajanapaliyaanaal, athu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal seyyappaduvathaaka.
ippadich seyyappatta poajanapaliyaik karththarukkuch seluththuvaayaaka; athu aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvarappadumpoathu, avan athaip palipeedaththa'ndaiyil ko'nduvanthu,
anthap poajanapaliyilirunthu aasaariyan gnaapakakku'riyaaka oru pangkai eduththup palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.
inthap poajanapaliyil meethiyaanathu aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum searum; karththarukku idum thakanangka'lil ithu makaa parisuththamaanathu.

neengka'l karththarukkuch seluththum entha poajanapaliyum pu'liththamaavinaal seyyappadaathiruppathaaka; pu'liththamaavu'l'lathon'raiyum theanu'l'lathon'raiyum karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakath thakanikkavea'ndaam.
mutha'rkanika'laik kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvanthu, avaika'laik karththarukkuch seluththalaam; aanaalum, palipeedaththinmeal avaika'l sukantha vaasanaiyaakath thakanikkappadalaakaathu.

nee padaikki'ra entha poajanapaliyum uppinaal saaramaakkappaduvathaaka; un theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyin uppai un poajanapaliyilea ku'raiyavidaamal, nee padaippathu ellaavat'roadum uppaiyum padaippaayaaka.

mutha'rpalanka'lai poajanapaliyaaka nee karththarukkuch seluththavanthaal, ni'raintha pachchaiyaana kathirka'lai neruppilea vaatti uthirththu, athai un mutha'rpalanin poajanapaliyaakak ko'nduvarakkadavaay.
athinmeal e'n'ney vaarththu, athinmeal thoopavarkkaththaip poaduvaayaaka; ithu oru poajanapali.
pinpu aasaariyan, uthirththa thaaniyaththilum e'n'neyilum eduththu, gnaapakakku'riyaana pangkai athin thoopavarkkam ellaavat'roadungkoodath thakanikkakkadavan; ithu karththarukku idum thakanapali.

oruvan samaathaana paliyaip padaikkavea'ndumen'ru, maattumanthaiyil eduththuch seluththuvaanaakil, athu kaa'laiyaanaalum sari, pasuvaanaalum sari, pazhuthat'riruppathai karththarudaiya sannithiyil seluththakkadavan.

avan than paliyin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaaka athaik kollakkadavan; appozhuthu aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyar athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'likkakkadavarka'l.
pinpu samaathaana paliyilea kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum, kudalka'lilu'l'la kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum,

ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'linmeal si'ru kudalka'linidaththil irukki'ra kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'loadeakoodak kalleeralinmeal irukki'ra javvaiyum eduththu, karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakach seluththuvaanaaka.

athai aaroanin kumaarar palipeedaththu akkiniyilu'l'la kattaika'linmeal poattirukkum sarvaangka thakanapaliyinmeethil poattuth thakanikkakkadavarka'l; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali.

avan karththarukkuch samaathaana paliyaip padaikkavea'ndumen'ru aattu manthaiyilirunthu eduththuch seluththuvaanaakil, athu aa'n aanaalum sari, pe'n aanaalum sari, pazhuthat'riruppathaich seluththuvaanaaka.
avan aattukkuttiyaip paliyaakach seluththavea'ndumaanaal, athaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu,

than paliyin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaaka athaik kollakkadavan; appozhuthu aaroanin kumaarar athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'likkakkadavarka'l.
pinpu avan samaathaana paliyilea athin kozhuppaiyum, naduvelumpilirunthu eduththa muzhu vaalaiyum, kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum, avaika'linmeal irukki'ra kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum,

ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'linmeal si'ru kudalka'linidaththil irukki'ra kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'loadeakoodak kalleeralinmeal irukki'ra javvaiyum eduththu, karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakach seluththakkadavan.
athai aasaariyan palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan; ithu karththarukku idum thakana aakaaram.
avan seluththuvathu ve'l'laadaayirukkumaanaal, avan athai karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu,

athin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaaka athaik kollakkadavan; appozhuthu aaroanin kumaarar athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'likkakkadavarka'l.
avan athilea kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum, avaika'lmealirukki'ra kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum,

ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'linmeal si'ru kudalka'linidaththil irukki'ra kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'loadeakoodak kalleeralinmeal irukki'ra javvaiyum eduththu, karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakach seluththakkadavan.
aasaariyan palipeedaththinmeal avaika'laith thakanikkakkadavan; ithu sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakana aakaaram; kozhuppu muzhuvathum karththarudaiyathu.
kozhuppaiyaavathu iraththaththaiyaavathu neengka'l pusikkalaakaathu; ithu ungka'l vaasasthalangka'l engkum ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkum en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraridaththil sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, oruvan karththarudaiya katta'laika'lil yaathon'rai a'riyaamaiyinaal mee'ri, seyyaththakaathathaich seythu paavaththukku udpattaal a'riyavea'ndiyathaavathu:

apisheakam pet'ra aasaariyan, janangka'l kut'raththi'rku udpadaththakkathaakap paavagnseythaal, thaan seytha paavaththinimiththam pazhuthat'ra oru i'langkaa'laiyaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvarakkadavan.
avan anthak kaa'laiyai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu, athin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil athaik kollakkadavan.
appozhuthu, apisheakam pet'ra aasaariyan anthak kaa'laiyin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, athai aasarippuk koodaaraththil ko'nduvanthu,
than viralai iraththaththil thoayththu, parisuththa sthalaththin thiraikku ethirea karththarudaiya sannithiyil eazhutharam the'likkakkadavan.

pinpu, aasaariyan antha iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, aasarippuk koodaaraththilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil irukkum sukantha thoopapeedaththuk kompuka'linmeal poosi, kaa'laiyinudaiya mat'ra iraththam muzhuvathaiyum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaaka irukki'ra thakanapalipeedaththin adiyilea oot'rivittu,
paavanivaara'napaliyaana kaa'laiyin ellaak kozhuppumaakiya kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum, avaika'lmeal irukki'ra kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum,
ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'lmeal si'ru kudalka'linidaththil irukki'ra kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'loadeakoodak kalleeralinmeal irukki'ra javvaiyum,
samaathaanapaliyin kaa'laiyilirunthu edukki'rathupoala athilirunthu eduththu, avaika'laith thakanapalipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan.
kaa'laiyin thoalaiyum, athin maamsam muzhuvathaiyum, athin thalaiyaiyum, thodaika'laiyum, athin kudalka'laiyum, athin saa'niyaiyum,

kaa'lai muzhuvathaiyum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea saampal kottuki'ra suththamaana idaththilea ko'ndupoay, kattaika'linmeal poattu, akkiniyaalea sutterikkakkadavan; saampal kottiyirukki'ra idaththilea athaich sutterikkakkadavan.

israveal sapaiyaar ellaarum a'riyaamaiyinaal paavagnseythu, kaariyam thangka'l ka'nka'lukku ma'raivaayirukki'rathinaal, karththarudaiya katta'laika'lil yaathon'rai mee'ri, seyyaththakaathathaich seythu, paavaththukkudpattuk kut'ravaa'lika'laanaal,
avarka'l seytha paavam theriyavarumpoathu, sapaiyaar anthap paavaththinimiththam oru i'langkaa'laiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaakap paliyidak ko'nduvaravea'ndum.
sapaiyin mooppar karththarudaiya sannithiyil thangka'l kaika'lai athin thalaimeal vaikkakkadavarka'l; pinpu karththarudaiya sannithiyil anthak kaa'laiyaik kollavea'ndum.
appozhuthu, apisheakam pet'ra aasaariyan athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, aasarippuk koodaaraththil ko'nduvanthu,
than viralai iraththaththil thoayththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil thiraikku ethirea eazhutharam the'liththu,

aasarippuk koodaaraththil karththarudaiya sannithiyil irukkum palipeedaththin kompuka'linmeal antha iraththaththil kogncham poosi, mat'ra iraththamellaam aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil irukki'ra thakanapalipeedaththin adiyilea oot'rivittu,
athin kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum athilirunthu eduththu, palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththu,
paavanivaara'napaliyin kaa'laiyaich seythapirakaaram inthak kaa'laiyaiyum seythu, ivva'n'namaay aasaariyan avarka'lukkup paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avarka'lukku mannikkappadum.
pinpu kaa'laiyaip paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoay, munthina kaa'laiyaich sutteriththathupoalach sutterikkakkadavan; ithu sapaikkaakach seyyappadum paavanivaara'napali.
oru pirapu than theavanaakiya karththarudaiya katta'laika'lil yaathon'rai mee'ri, a'riyaamaiyinaal seyyaththakaathathaich seythu, paavaththukkudpattuk kut'ravaa'liyaanaal,
thaan seythathu paavam en'ru thanakkuth theriyavarumpoathu, avan ve'l'laaduka'lil pazhuthat'ra oru i'langkadaavaip paliyaakak ko'nduvanthu,
anthak kadaavin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil sarvaangka thakanapali kollappadum idaththil athaik kollakkadavan; ithu paavanivaara'napali.
appozhuthu aasaariyan athin iraththaththil kogncham than viralaal eduththu, thakanapalipeedaththuk kompuka'linmeal poosi, mat'ra iraththaththaith thakanapalipeedaththin adiyilea oot'rivittu,

athin kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum, samaathaanapaliyin kozhuppaippoala, palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththu, ivva'n'namaay aasaariyan avan seytha paavaththaikku'riththu avanukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.
saathaara'na janangka'lil oruvan a'riyaamaiyinaal karththarin katta'laika'lil yaathon'rai mee'ri, seyyaththakaathathaich seythu, paavaththukkudpattuk kut'ravaa'liyaanaal,
thaan seythathu paavam en'ru thanakkuth theriyavarumpoathu, avan thaan seytha paavaththinimiththam ve'l'laaduka'lil pazhuthat'ra oru pe'nkuttiyaip paliyaakak ko'nduvanthu,
paavanivaara'napaliyin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, sarvaangka thakanapaliyidum idaththil anthap paavanivaara'napaliyaik kollakkadavan.
appozhuthu aasaariyan athin iraththaththil kogncham than viralaal eduththu, thakanapalipeedaththuk kompuka'linmeal poosi, mat'ra iraththamellaam palipeedaththin adiyilea oot'rivittu,

samaathaanapaliyilirunthu kozhuppai eduppathupoala, athin kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum eduththu, aasaariyan palipeedaththinmeal karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaakath thakaniththu, ivva'n'namaay avanukkup paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.
avan paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru aattukkuttiyaik ko'nduvaruvaanaakil, pazhuthat'ra pe'nkuttiyaik ko'nduvanthu,
anthap paavanivaara'napaliyin thalaimeal than kaiyai vaiththu, sarvaangka thakanapali kollappadum idaththil athaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakak kollakkadavan.

appozhuthu aasaariyan anthap paavanivaara'napaliyin iraththaththil kogncham than viralaal eduththu, thakana palipeedaththuk kompuka'linmeal poosi, mat'ra iraththamellaam palipeedaththin adiyilea oot'rivittu,

samaathaana paliyaana aattukkuttiyin kozhuppai edukki'rathupoala, athin kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum eduththu, karththarukku idappadum thakanapalika'laippoala, palipeedaththinmeal aasaariyan thakanikkavea'ndum; ivva'n'namaay avan seytha paavaththukku aasaariyan paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.
saadchiyaakiya oruvan, idappatta aa'naiyaik keattirunthum, thaan ka'ndathaiyum a'rinthathaiyum theriviyaathirunthu paavagnseythaal, avan than akkiramaththaich sumappaan.

asuththamaana kaattu mirukaththin udalaiyaavathu, asuththamaana naattu mirukaththin udalaiyaavathu, asuththamaana oorum piraa'nika'lin udalaiyaavathu, ivvitha asuththamaana yaathoru vasthuvaiyaavathu, oruvan a'riyaamal thottaal, avan theettum kut'ramum u'l'lavanaavaan.
allathu, entha asuththaththinaalaakilum theettuppatta oru manithanai oruvan a'riyaamal thottu, pinpu athai a'rinthuko'ndaal, avan kut'ramu'l'lavanaavaan.

manithar patha'ri aa'naiyidum enthak kaariyaththilaanaalum, oruvan theemai seyki'ratha'rkaavathu nanmai seyki'ratha'rkaavathu, than manam a'riyaamal, than uthaduka'linaal patha'ri aa'naiyittu, pinpu avan athai a'rinthuko'ndaal, athaikku'riththuk kut'ramu'l'lavanaavaan.
ippadippattavaika'l on'ril, oruvan kut'ramu'l'lavanaakumpoathu, avan thaan seythathu paavam en'ru a'rikkaiyittu,

thaan seytha paavaththukkup paavanivaara'napaliyaaka, aaduka'lilaavathu ve'l'laaduka'lilaavathu, oru pe'nkuttiyaik kut'ranivaara'na paliyaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvaravea'ndum; athinaalea aasaariyan avan seytha paavaththaikku'riththu avanukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan.

aattukkuttiyaik ko'nduvara avanukkuch sakthiyillaathirunthaal, avan seytha kut'raththinimiththam ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu, ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu, on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum, karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvarakkadavan.
avaika'lai aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvaruvaanaaka; avan paavanivaara'na palikkaanathai munnea seluththi, athin thalaiyai athin kazhuththinidaththil ki'l'li, athai ira'ndaakkaamal vaiththu,
athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, palipeedaththin pakkaththil the'liththu, meethiyaana iraththaththaip palipeedaththin adiyilea vadiyaviduvaanaaka; ithu paavanivaara'napali.
mat'rathai niyamaththinpadiyea avan thakanapaliyaaych seluththakkadavan; ivvithamaaka avan seytha paavaththai aasaariyan nivirththiseyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.

ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu ko'nduvara avanukkuch sakthiyillaathirunthaal, paavam seythavan paavanivaara'naththukkaaka oru eppaa a'lavaana melliya maavilea paththil oru pangkaith than kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvaruvaanaaka; athu paavanivaara'na paliyaayiruppathinaal, athinmeal e'n'ney vaarkkaamalum thoopavarkkam poadaamalum irunthu,

athai aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvaravea'ndum; athilea aasaariyan gnaapakakku'riyaana pangkaakath than kaippidi ni'raiya eduththu, karththarukku idum thakanapalika'laippoala, palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan; ithu paavanivaara'napali.

ivvithamaaka mea'rsolliya kaariyangka'l on'ril avan seytha paavaththukkaaka aasaariyan paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum, meethiyaanathu poajanapaliyaippoala aasaariyanaich searum en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

oruvan karththarukkuriya parisuththamaanavaika'lil kut'ragnseythu, a'riyaamaiyinaal paavaththukkudpattaal, avan than kut'raththinimiththam parisuththa sthalaththuch seakkal ka'nakkinpadiyea, nee avanmeal sumaththum aparaatham evva'lavoa, avva'lavu ve'l'lich seakkal pe'rum pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavaik kut'ra nivaara'na paliyaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu,

parisuththamaanathaikku'riththuth thaan seytha thappithaththinaal u'ndaana nashdaththaich seluththi, athinoadu ainthil oru pangkai athikamaakak kootti, aasaariyanukkuk koduppaanaaka; kut'ranivaara'napaliyaakiya aattukkadaavinaalea avanukkaaka aasaariyan paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.

oruvan seyyaththakaathen'ru karththarudaiya katta'laika'linaal vilakkappatta yaathon'raich seythu paavaththukkudpattaal, athai avan a'riyaamaiyinaal seythaalum, avan kut'ramu'l'lavanaayirunthu, than akkiramaththaich sumappaan.

athinimiththam avan kut'ranivaara'napaliyaaka, un mathippukkuch sariyaana pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavai aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvaruvaanaaka; avan a'riyaamal seytha thappithaththai aasaariyan avanukkaaka nivirththiseyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku mannikkappadum.
ithu kut'ranivaara'napali; avan karththarukku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseythaan enpathu nichchayam en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

oruvan karththarukku viroathamaaka aniyaayam seythu, than vasaththil oppuvikkappatta poru'lilaavathu, kodukkal vaangkalilaavathu, than ayalaanukku maa'raattampa'n'ni, allathu oru vasthuvaip palaathkaaramaayp pa'riththukko'ndu, allathu than ayalaanukku idukka'nseythu,
allathu kaa'naama'rpoanathaik ka'ndadainthum athai ma'ruthaliththu, athaikku'riththup poyyaa'naiyittu, manithar seyyum ivaimuthalaana yaathoru kaariyaththil paavagnseythaaneayaakil,

avan seytha paavaththinaalea kut'ravaa'liyaanapadiyaal, thaan palaathkaaramaayp pa'riththukko'ndathaiyum, idukka'nseythu pet'rukko'ndathaiyum, than vasaththilea oppuvikkappattathaiyum, kaa'naama'rpoayirunthu thaan ka'ndeduththathaiyum,

poyyaa'naiyittuch sampaathiththa poru'laiyum thirumpak kodukkakkadavan; antha muthalaik kodukki'rathum allaamal, athinoadu ainthil oru pangku athikamaakavung kootti, athaith thaan kut'ranivaara'napaliyai idum naa'lil, atha'rkuriyavanukkuk koduththuvittu,
than kut'ranivaara'napaliyaaka, un mathippukkuch sariyaana pazhuthat'ra aattukkadaavaik karththarukkuch seluththumpadi, athai aasaariyanidaththil kut'ranivaara'napaliyaakak ko'nduvaruvaanaaka.
karththarudaiya sannithiyil avan paavaththai aasaariyan nivirththiseyyakkadavan; appozhuthu avan kut'ravaa'liyaakach seytha appadippatta enthak kaariyamum avanukku mannikkappadum en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum ka'rpikkavea'ndiya sarvaangka thakanapalikkuriya piramaa'nam ennaven'raal, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaanathu iraamuzhuvathum vidiya'rkaalamattum palipeedaththinmeal eriyavea'ndum; palipeedaththinmealu'l'la akkini erinthuko'ndea irukkavea'ndum.

aasaariyan than sa'nalnool angkiyaith thariththu, than sa'nalnool jalladaththai araiyil poattukko'ndu, palipeedaththinmeal akkiniyil erintha sarvaangka thakanapaliyin saampalai eduththu, palipeedaththup pakkaththil kotti,
