pinpu than vasthirangka'laik kazhat'ri, vea'ru vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu, anthach saampalaip paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea suththamaana oru idaththilea ko'ndupoayk kottakkadavan.

palipeedaththinmealirukki'ra akkini aviyaamal erinthuko'ndirukkavea'ndum; aasaariyan kaalaithoa'rum athinmeal eriyumpadi kattaika'laip poattu, athinmeal sarvaangka thakanapaliyai varisaiyaaka vaiththu, athinmeal samaathaana palika'lin kozhuppaip poattuth thakanikkakkadavan.
palipeedaththinmeal akkini eppozhuthum erinthuko'ndirukkavea'ndum; athu orupozhuthum avinthupoakalaakaathu.
poajanapaliyin piramaa'nam ennaven'raal, aaroanin kumaarar athaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil palipeedaththukku munnea padaikkavea'ndum.

avan poajanapaliyin melliya maavilum athin e'n'neyilum than kaippidi ni'raiya eduththu, poajanapaliyinmealu'l'la thoopavarkkam yaavat'roadum kooda athai gnaapakakku'riyaakap palipeedaththinmeal karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaakath thakanikkakkadavan.

athil meethiyaanathai aaroanum avan kumaararum pusippaarka'laaka; athu pu'lippillaa appaththudan parisuththa sthalaththil pusikkappadakkadavathu; aasarippuk koodaaraththin piraakaaraththil athaip pusikkavea'ndum.

athaip pu'liththamaavu'l'lathaakap paakampa'n'navea'ndaam; athu enakku idappadum thakanangka'lil naan avarka'lukkuk koduththa avarka'ludaiya pangku; athu paavanivaara'na paliyaippoalum kut'ranivaara'na paliyaippoalum makaa parisuththamaanathu.

aaroanin pi'l'laika'lil aa'nmakka'l yaavarum athaip pusippaarka'laaka; karththarukku idappadum thakanapalika'lil athu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya katta'laiyaay irukkakkadavathu; avaika'laith thoduki'ravanevanum parisuththamaay iruppaan en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

aaroan apisheakam pa'n'nappadum naa'lil, avanum avan kumaararum karththarukkuch seluththavea'ndiya padaippu ennaven'raal, oru eppaa a'lavaana melliya maavilea paththil oru pangkai, kaalaiyil paathiyum maalaiyil paathiyum, niththiya poajanapaliyaakach seluththakkadavarka'l.

athu sattiyilea e'n'neyvittup paakampa'n'nappadakkadavathu; paakampa'n'nappattapinpu athaik ko'nduvanthu, poajanapaliyaakap paakampa'n'nappatta thu'nduka'laik karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaakap padaikkakkadavaay.
avan kumaararil avanudaiya sthalaththilea apisheakampa'n'nappaduki'ra aasaariyanum appadiyea seyyakkadavan; athu muzhuvathum thakanikkappadavea'ndum; athu karththar niyamiththa niththiya katta'lai.
aasaariyanukkaaka idappadum enthap poajanapaliyum pusikkappadaamal, muzhuvathum thakanikkappadavea'ndum en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee aaroanoadum avan kumaararoadum sollavea'ndiyathaavathu, paavanivaara'napaliyin piramaa'nam ennaven'raal, sarvaangka thakanapali kollappadum idaththil paavanivaara'napaliyum karththarudaiya sannithiyil kollappadakkadavathu; athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.
paavanivirththiseyya athaip paliyiduki'ra aasaariyan athaip pusikkakkadavan; aasarippuk koodaaraththin piraakaaramaakiya parisuththa sthalaththilea athu pusikkappadavea'ndum.

athin maamsaththil paduki'rathu ethuvum parisuththamaayirukkum; athin iraththaththilea kogncham oru vasthiraththil the'riththathaanaal, iraththanthe'riththa vasthiraththaip parisuththa sthalaththil kazhuvavea'ndum.
athu samaikkappatta ma'npaa'ndam udaikkappadavea'ndum; seppuppaanaiyil samaikkappattathaanaal, athu vi'lakkappattuth tha'n'neeril kazhuvappadavea'ndum.
aasaariyaril aa'nmakka'l yaavarum athaip pusippaarka'laaka; athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.

enthap paavanivaara'napaliyin iraththaththil kogncham parisuththa sthalaththil paavanivirththiyinporuttu aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku'l'lea ko'nduvarappattathoa, anthap pali pusikkappadalaakaathu, athu akkiniyilea thakanikkappadavea'ndum.
kut'ranivaara'na paliyin piramaa'nam ennaven'raal, athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.
sarvaangka thakanapali kollappadum idaththil, kut'ranivaara'na paliyum kollappadavea'ndum; athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththu,
athinudaiya kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum, athin vaalaiyum, kudalka'lai moodiya kozhuppaiyum,
ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'linmeal si'ru kudalka'linidaththilirukki'ra kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'loadeakoodak kalleeralinmeal irukki'ra javvaiyum eduththuch seluththuvaanaaka.
ivaika'lai aasaariyan palipeedaththinmeal karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakath thakanikkakkadavan; athu kut'ranivaara'na pali.
aasaariyaril aa'nmakka'l yaavarum athaip pusippaarka'laaka; athu parisuththa sthalaththil pusikkappadavea'ndum; athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.
paavanivaara'napali eppadiyoa kut'ranivaara'napaliyum appadiyea; avvira'ndi'rkum piramaa'nam on'rea; athinaalea paavanivirththiseytha aasaariyanai athu searum.
oruvanudaiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaich seluththina aasaariyan thaan seluththina thakanapaliyin thoalaith thanakkaaka vaiththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
aduppilea paakampa'n'nappattathum, sattiyilum thattinmealum samaikkappattathumaana poajanapali yaavum athaich seluththuki'ra aasaariyanudaiyavaika'laayirukkum.
e'n'neyilea pisainthathum e'n'neyilea pisaiyaathathumaana sakala poajanapaliyum aaroanudaiya kumaarar yaavarukkum saripangkaakach searavea'ndum.
karththarukkuch seluththuki'ra samaathaanapalika'lin piramaa'nam ennaven'raal,

athai sthoaththiraththukkaakach seluththuvaanaanaal, avan sthoaththira paliyoadungkooda e'n'neyilea pisaintha pu'lippillaa athirasangka'laiyum, e'n'ney poosappatta pu'lippillaa adaika'laiyum, e'n'neyilea pisainthu va'rukkappatta melliya maavinaal seytha athirasangka'laiyum padaikkakkadavan.
avaika'laip padaikki'rathum allaamal, pu'liththamaavinaal seytha appaththaiyum, thannudaiya samaathaana paliyaakiya sthoaththirapaliyoadukooda padaikkavea'ndum.

anthap padaippu muzhuvathilum vakaikku ovvon'rai eduththuk karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum paliyaakach seluththuvaanaaka; athu samaathaana paliyin iraththaththaith the'liththa aasaariyanudaiyathaakum.
samaathaanapaliyaakiya sthoaththira paliyin maamsamaanathu seluththappatta an'raiththinamea pusikkappadavea'ndum; athil on'rum vidiya'rkaalamattum vaikkappadalaakaathu.
avan seluththum pali poruththanaiyaayaavathu u'rchaakapaliyaayaavathu irukkumaanaal, athu seluththappadum naa'lilum, athil meethiyaanathu ma'runaa'lilum pusikkappadalaam.
paliyin maamsaththil meethiyaayirukki'rathu moon'raam naa'lil akkiniyilea sutterikkappadakkadavathu.

samaathaanapaliyin maamsaththil meethiyaanathu moon'raam naa'lil pusikkappadumaanaal, athu angkikarikkappadaathu; athaich seluththinavanukku athu palikkaathu; athu aruvaruppaayirukkum; athaip pusikki'ravan than akkiramaththaich sumappaan.
theettaana entha vasthuvilaavathu antha maamsam pattathaanaal athu pusikkappadaamal akkiniyilea sutterikkappadakkadavathu; mat'ra maamsaththaiyoa suththamaayirukki'ravanevanum pusikkalaam.
oruvan theettu'l'lavanaayirukkaiyil karththarudaiya samaathaanapaliyin maamsaththaip pusiththaal, avan than janaththaaril iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.

manusharudaiya theettaiyaavathu, theettaana mirukaththaiyaavathu, aruvarukkappadaththakka theettaana mat'ra entha vasthuvaiyaavathu oruvan thottirunthu, karththarudaiya samaathaanapaliyin maamsaththilea pusiththaal, avan than janangka'lil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, maadu aadu ve'l'laadu enpavaika'lin kozhuppai neengka'l pusikkalaakaathu.
thaanaaych seththa mirukaththin kozhuppaiyum, pee'ru'nda mirukaththin kozhuppaiyum palavitha vealaika'lukku vazhangkalaam; aanaalum neengka'l athai orupoathum pusikkalaakaathu.
karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakach seluththappadum mirukaththin kozhuppaip pusikki'ra entha aaththumaavum than janangka'lil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.
ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lil engkum yaathoru pa'ravaiyin iraththaththaiyaavathu, yaathoru mirukaththin iraththaththaiyaavathu pusikkalaakaathu.
evvitha iraththaththaiyaakilum pusikki'ra evanum than janangka'lil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, karththarukkuch samaathaanapali seluththuki'ravan thaan seluththum samaathaanapaliyaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvaruvaanaaka.

karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakap padaippavaika'lai avan kaika'lea ko'nduvaravea'ndum; maarkka'ndaththaiyum athanoadukooda athinmeal vaiththa kozhuppaiyum karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaattumpadikkuk ko'nduvarakkadavan.
appozhuthu aasaariyan anthak kozhuppaip palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkavea'ndum; maarkka'ndamoa aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum searum.
ungka'l samaathaanapalika'lil valathu munnanthodaiyai ea'reduththup padaikkum paliyaakap padaikkumpadi aasaariyanidaththil koduppeerka'laaka.
aaroanudaiya kumaararil, samaathaanapaliyin iraththaththaiyum kozhuppaiyum seluththuki'ravanukku, valathu munnanthodai pangkaakach searum.

israveal puththirarin samaathaanapalika'lil asaivaattum maarkka'ndaththaiyum ea'reduththuppadaikkum munnanthodaiyaiyum naan avarka'l kaiyil vaangki, avaika'lai aasaariyanaakiya aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum israveal puththirarukku'l nadakkum niththiya katta'laiyaakak koduththean en'ru sol en'raar.

karththarukku aasaariya oozhiyam seyyumpadi aaroanum avan kumaararum niyamikkappatta naa'lilea, ithu apisheakampa'n'nappatta avarka'lukkuk karththarudaiya thakanapalika'lil kidaikkumpadi u'ndaana katta'lai.
ippadi avarka'lukku israveal puththirar thangka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya niyamamaakak kodukkumpadi karththar avarka'lai apisheakampa'n'nina naa'lilea katta'laiyittaar.
sarvaangka thakanapalikkum poajanapalikkum paavanivaara'na palikkum kut'ranivaara'na palikkum pirathishdai palika'lukkum samaathaana palika'lukkum aduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea.
karththarukkuth thangka'l palika'laich seluththavea'ndum en'ru avar israveal puththirarukkuch seenaay vanaantharaththilea ka'rpikkumpoathu ivaika'lai moaseakkuch seenaay malaiyil katta'laiyittaar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum varavazhaiththu, vasthirangka'laiyum, apisheakathailaththaiyum, paavanivaara'napalikku oru kaa'laiyaiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru koodaiyil pu'lippillaa appangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu,
sapaiyaiyellaam aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaakak koodivarachsey en'raar.
karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea moasea seythaan; sapai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaakak koodina poathu,
moasea sapaiyai noakki: seyyumpadi karththar katta'laiyitta kaariyam ithuvea en'ru solli,
karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, moasea aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum varavazhaiththu, avarka'lai jalaththinaal snaanampa'n'nuviththu,
avanukku u'l'langkiyaip poattu, idaikkachchaiyaik katti, mealangkiyai uduththi, eapoaththaith thariththu, athinmeal eapoaththin visiththiramaana kachchaiyaik katti,
avanukku maarppathakkaththai a'ninthu, maarppathakkaththilea ooreem thummeem enpavaika'laiyum vaiththu,
avan thalaiyilea paakaiyaith thariththu, paakaiyinmeal avan net'riyilea parisuththa kireedam ennum po'rpattaththaik kattinaan.
pinpu moasea, apisheakathailaththai eduththu, vaasasthalaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavat'raiyum apisheakampa'n'ni, parisuththappaduththi,

athil kogncham eduththu, palipeedaththinmeal eazhutharam the'liththu, palipeedaththaiyum athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, thottiyaiyum athin paathaththaiyum parisuththappaduththumpadikku apisheakampa'n'ni,
apisheakathailaththilea kogncham aaroanudaiya sirasinmeal vaarththu, avanaip parisuththappaduththumpadi apisheakampa'n'ninaan.
pinpu moasea, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, aaroanin kumaararai varavazhaiththu, avarka'lukku angkika'lai uduththi, idaikkachchaika'laik katti, kullaakka'laith thariththu,
paavanivaara'na palikkaana kaa'laiyaik ko'nduvanthaan; athinudaiya thalaiyinmeal aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l;

appozhuthu athu kollappattathu; moasea athin iraththaththai eduththu, than viralinaal palipeedaththin kompuka'linmeal sut'rilum poosi, palipeedaththi'rkaakap piraayachchiththagnseythu, mat'ra iraththaththaip palipeedaththin adiyil oot'rivittu, athinmeal paavanivirththi seyyumporuttu athaip parisuththappaduththinaan.

pinpu moasea, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, kudalka'lmeal iruntha kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum, kalleeralinmeal iruntha javvaiyum, ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'lin kozhuppaiyum eduththu, palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththu,
kaa'laiyaiyum athin thoalaiyum maamsaththaiyum saa'niyaiyum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea akkiniyilea sutteriththaan.
pinpu avan sarvaangka thakanapalikku aattukkadaavaik ko'nduvanthaan; athin thalaiyinmeal aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu athu kollappattathu; moasea athin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththaan.
aattukkadaa santhu santhaakath thu'ndikkappattathu; karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, moasea athin thalaiyaiyum thu'ndangka'laiyum kozhuppaiyum thakaniththaan.
kudalka'laiyum thodaika'laiyum tha'n'neeraal kazhuvinapin, moasea aattukkadaa muzhuvathaiyum palipeedaththinmeal karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaikkaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakath thakaniththaan.
pinpu pirathishdaippaduththuvatha'rkuriya mat'ra aattukkadaavaik ko'nduvanthaan; athin thalaiyinmeal aaroanum avan kumaararum thangka'l kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l.
pinpu athu kollappattathu; moasea athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, aaroanudaiya valathukaathin madalilum valathukaiyin peruviralilum valathukaalin peruviralilum poosinaan.

pinpu aaroanudaiya kumaararaiyum azhaiththaan; moasea antha iraththaththilea kogncham avarka'ludaiya valathukaathin madalilum valathukaiyin peruviralilum valathu kaalin peruviralilum poosi, iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththu,
kozhuppaiyum, vaalaiyum, kudalka'lmealiruntha kozhuppu muzhuvathaiyum, kalleeralinmealiruntha javvaiyum, ira'ndu ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, avaika'lin kozhuppaiyum, valathu munnanthodaiyaiyum eduththu,

karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaiththiruntha pu'lippillaa appangka'lin koodaiyilu'l'la pu'lippillaa athirasaththil on'raiyum, e'n'neyitta appamaakiya athirasaththil on'raiyum, oru adaiyaiyum eduththu, anthak kozhuppinmealum, munnanthodaiyinmealum vaiththu,
avaika'laiyellaam aaroanudaiya u'l'langkaika'lilum avan kumaararudaiya u'l'langkaika'lilum vaiththu, asaivaattum paliyaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaatti,

pinpu moasea avaika'lai avarka'l u'l'langkaika'lilirunthu eduththu, palipeedaththinmealirukki'ra thakanapaliyinmeal thakaniththaan; avaika'l sukantha vaasanaiyaana pirathishdaip palika'l; ithu karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaanathu.

pinpu moasea maarkka'ndaththai eduththu, athaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaattinaan. karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea pirathishdaiyin aattukkadaavilea athu moaseayin pangkaayit'ru.

moasea apisheakathailaththilum, palipeedaththinmealiruntha iraththaththilum kogncham eduththu, aaroanmealum avan vasthirangka'lmealum, avan kumaararmealum avarka'l vasthirangka'lmealum the'liththu, aaroanaiyum avan vasthirangka'laiyum, avan kumaararaiyum, avan kumaararin vasthirangka'laiyum parisuththappaduththinaan.

pinpu moasea aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum noakki: neengka'l antha maamsaththai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea veaviththu, aaroanum avan kumaararum athaip pusippaarka'laaka en'ru katta'laiyittirukki'rapadiyea, angkea athaiyum ungka'l pirathishdaip palika'lu'l'la koodaiyil irukki'ra appaththaiyum pusiththu,
maamsaththilum appaththilum meethiyaanathai akkiniyilea sutteriththu,
pirathishdaiyin naadka'l ni'raivea'rumvaraikkum, eazhunaa'l aasarippuk koodaaravaasalai vittup pu'rappadaathirungka'l; eazhunaa'la'lavum neengka'l pirathishdaippaduththappaduveerka'l.
in'ru seythathupoala, ungka'l paavanivirththikkaaka inimealum seyyavea'ndum en'ru karththar katta'laiyittaar.
neengka'l saakaathapadikku eazhunaa'l iravum pakalum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilirunthu, karththarudaiya kaavalaik kaakkakkadaveerka'l; ippadi naan ka'rpikkappattean en'raan.
karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyitta ellaak kaariyangka'laiyum aaroanum avan kumaararum seythaarka'l.
ettaam naa'lilea moasea aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum isravealin moopparaiyum azhaiththu,

aaroanai noakki: nee paavanivaara'napaliyaakap pazhuthat'ra oru kan'rukkuttiyaiyum, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakap pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavaiyum therinthuko'ndu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil paliyidakkadavaay.

mealum israveal puththirarai noakki: karththarudaiya sannithiyil paliyidumpadikku, neengka'l paavanivaara'napaliyaakap pazhuthat'ra oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra oru kan'rukkuttiyaiyum, oru aattukkuttiyaiyum,
samaathaanapalika'laaka oru kaa'laiyaiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, e'n'neyilea pisaintha poajanapaliyaiyum ko'nduvaarungka'l; in'ru karththar ungka'lukkuth tharisanamaavaar en'ru sol en'raan.
moasea katta'laiyittavaika'lai avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l. sapaiyaar ellaarum searnthu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil nin'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea: karththar katta'laiyitta inthak kaariyaththaich seyyungka'l; karththarudaiya makimai ungka'lukkuk kaa'nappadum en'raan.

moasea aaroanai noakki: nee palipeedaththa'ndaiyil searnthu, karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea, un paavanivaara'na paliyaiyum un sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum seluththi, unakkaakavum janangka'lukkaakavum paavanivirththi seythu, janangka'ludaiya paliyaiyum seluththi, avarka'lukkaakavum paavanivirththi sey en'raan.
appozhuthu aaroan palipeedaththa'ndaiyil searnthu, than paavanivaara'napaliyaakiya kan'rukkuttiyaik kon'raan.

aaroanin kumaarar athin iraththaththai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan than viralai antha iraththaththil thoayththu, palipeedaththin kompuka'linmeal poosi, mat'ra iraththaththaip palipeedaththin adiyilea oot'ri,
paavanivaara'napaliyin kozhuppaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, kalleeralil eduththa javvaiyum, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththu,
maamsaththaiyum thoalaiyum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea akkiniyilea sutteriththaan.
pinpu sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum kon'raan; aaroanin kumaarar athin iraththaththai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; athai avan palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththaan.
sarvaangka thakanapaliyin thu'ndangka'laiyum thalaiyaiyum avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan avaika'laip palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththu,
kudalka'laiyum thodaika'laiyum kazhuvi, palipeedaththinmeal iruntha sarvaangka thakanapaliyinmeal thakaniththaan.
pinpu avan janangka'lin paliyaik ko'nduvanthu, janangka'lin paavanivirththikkuriya ve'l'laattukkadaavaik kon'ru, munthinathaip paliyittathupoala, athaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakki,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum ko'nduvanthu, niyamaththinpadi athaip paliyittu,
poajanapaliyaiyum ko'nduvanthu, athil kaini'raiya eduththu, athaik kaalaiyil seluththum sarvaangka thakanapaliyudanea palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththaan.

pinpu janangka'lin samaathaanapalika'laakiya kaa'laiyaiyum aattukkadaavaiyum kon'raan; aaroanin kumaarar athin iraththaththai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan athaip palipeedaththinmeal sut'rilum the'liththu,
kaa'laiyilum aattukkadaavilum eduththa kozhuppaiyum, vaalaiyum, kudalka'lai moodiya javvaiyum, ku'ndikkaayka'laiyum, kalleeralinmeal iruntha javvaiyum ko'nduvanthu,
kozhuppai maarkka'ndangka'linmeal vaiththaarka'l; anthak kozhuppaip palipeedaththinmeal thakaniththaan.
maarkka'ndangka'laiyum valathu munnanthodaiyaiyum, moasea katta'laiyittapadiyea, aaroan karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaattinaan.

pinpu aaroan janangka'lukku nearaakath than kaika'lai uyarththi, avarka'lai aaseervathiththu, thaan paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, samaathaana palika'laiyum seluththina idaththilirunthu i'rangkinaan.
pinpu moaseayum aaroanum aasarippuk koodaaraththukku'l piraveasiththu, ve'liyea vanthu, janangka'lai aaseervathiththaarka'l; appozhuthu karththarudaiya makimai sakala janangka'lukkum kaa'nappattathu.

an'riyum karththarudaiya sannithiyilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, palipeedaththinmeal iruntha sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum kozhuppaiyum eriththuvittathu; janangka'lellaarum athaik ka'ndapoathu aaravaariththu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l.

pinpu aaroanin kumaararaakiya naathaapum apiyoovum thanthan thoopakalasaththai eduththu, avaika'lil akkiniyaiyum athinmeal thoopavarkkaththaiyum poattu, karththar thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyidaatha anniya akkiniyai avarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu akkini karththarudaiya sannithiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, avarka'laip padchiththathu; avarka'l karththarudaiya sannithiyil seththaarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea aaroanai noakki: ennidaththil searuki'ravarka'laal naan parisuththam pa'n'nappattu, sakala janangka'lukkum munpaaka naan makimaippaduvean en'ru karththar sonnathu ithuthaan en'raan; aaroan peasaathirunthaan.

pinpu moasea aaroanin si'riya thakappanaana oosiyealin kumaararaakiya meesavealaiyum elsaapaanaiyum azhaiththu: neengka'l kittavanthu, ungka'l sakoathararaip parisuththa sthalaththukku munnin'ru eduththu, paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoangka'l en'raan.
moasea sonnapadi avarka'l kittavanthu, avarka'lai avarka'l uduththiyiruntha sattaika'loadum eduththup paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

moasea aaroanaiyum eleyaasaar iththaamaar ennum avan kumaararaiyum noakki: neengka'l saakaathapadikkum, sapaiyanaiththinmealum kadungkoapam varaathapadikkum, neengka'l ungka'l thalaippaakaiyai eduththuppoadaamalum, ungka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhikkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; ungka'l sakoathararaakiya israveal kudumpaththaar yaavarum karththar ko'luththina intha akkinikkaakap pulampuvaarka'laaka.

neengka'l saakaathapadikku aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilirunthu pu'rappadaathirungka'l; karththarudaiya apisheakathailam ungka'lmeal irukki'rathea en'raan; avarka'l moaseayinudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea seythaarka'l.
karththar aaroanai noakki:
neeyum unnoadeakooda un kumaararum saakaathirukkavea'ndumaanaal, aasarippuk koodaaraththukku'l piraveasikki'rapoathu, thiraadcharasaththaiyum mathuvaiyum kudikkavea'ndaam.
parisuththamu'l'latha'rkum parisuththamillaathatha'rkum, theettu'l'latha'rkum theettillaathatha'rkum, viththiyaasampa'n'numpadikkum,
karththar moaseayaikko'ndu israveal puththirarukkuch sonna sakala piramaa'nangka'laiyum avarka'lukkup poathikkumpadikkum, ithu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkum en'raar.

moasea aaroanaiyum meethiyaayiruntha avan kumaararaakiya eleyaasaaraiyum iththaamaaraiyum noakki: neengka'l karththarudaiya thakanapalika'lil meethiyaana poajanapaliyai eduththu, palipeedaththa'ndaiyilea pu'lippillaathathaakap pusiyungka'l; athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.
athaip parisuththa sthalaththilea pusiyungka'l; athu karththarudaiya thakanapalika'lil unakkum un kumaararukkum ea'rpaduththappattathaayirukki'rathu; ippadik katta'lai pet'rirukki'rean.

asaivaattum maarkka'ndaththaiyum, ea'reduththup padaikkum munnanthodaiyaiyum, neeyum unnoadeakooda un kumaararum kumaaraththika'lum suththamaana sthalaththilea pusippeerka'laaka; israveal puththirarudaiya samaathaanapalika'lil avaika'l unakkum un pi'l'laika'lukkum kidaikkumpadi ea'rpaduththappattirukki'rathu.

kozhuppaakiya thakanapalika'loadea avarka'l karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaattumpadi ea'reduththup padaikkum munnanthodaiyaiyum, asaivaattum maarkka'ndaththaiyum ko'nduvaruvaarka'l; athu karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea unakkum un pi'l'laika'lukkum niththiya katta'laiyaaka ea'rpaduththappattirukki'rathu en'raan.

paavanivaara'napaliyaakach seluththappatta ve'l'laattukkadaavai moasea theadippaarththaan; athu thakanikkappattirunthathu; aakaiyaal, meethiyaayiruntha eleyaasaar iththaamaar ennum aaroanin kumaararmeal avan koapangko'ndu:

paavanivaara'napaliyai neengka'l parisuththa sthalaththil pusiyaama'rpoanathenna? athu makaa parisuththamaayirukki'rathea; sapaiyin akkiramaththaich sumanthu theerppatha'rkuk karththarudaiya sannithiyil avarka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumporuttu, athai ungka'lukkuk koduththaarea.
athin iraththam parisuththa sthalaththukku'l'lea ko'nduvarappadavillaiyea; naan katta'laiyittapadi neengka'l athaip parisuththa sthalaththil pusikkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathea en'raan.

appozhuthu aaroan moaseayai noakki: avarka'l thangka'l paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum, thangka'l sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum karththarudaiya sannithiyil seluththina in'ruthaanea enakku ippadi nearittathea; paavanivaara'napaliyai in'ru naan pusiththeanaanaal, athu karththarin paarvaikku nan'raay irukkumoa en'raan.
moasea athaik keattapoathu amaithalaayirunthaan.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
neengka'l israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, poomiyilirukki'ra sakala mirukangka'lilum neengka'l pusikkaththakka jeevajanthukka'l yaathenil:
mirukangka'lil viriku'lampu'l'lathaayirunthu, ku'lampuka'l ira'ndaakap pirinthirukki'rathum asaipoaduki'rathumaanavaika'laiyellaam neengka'l pusikkalaam.
aanaalum, asaipoaduki'rathum viriku'lampu'l'lathumaanavaika'lil ottakamaanathu asaipoaduki'rathaayirunthaalum, atha'rku viriku'lampillaathapadiyaal, athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayirukkum.
kuzhimusalaanathu asaipoaduki'rathaayirunthaalum, atha'rku viriku'lampillai; athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayirukkum.
muyalaanathu asaipoaduki'rathaayirunthum, atha'rku viriku'lampillai; athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayirukkum.
pan'riyin ku'lampu viriku'lampum ira'ndaakap pirinthathumaayirunthum, athu asaipoadaathu; athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayirukkum.
ivaika'lin maamsaththaip pusikkavum, ivaika'lin udalka'laith thodavum vea'ndaam; ivaika'l ungka'lukkuth theettaayirukkakkadavathu.
jalaththilirukki'ravaika'lil neengka'l pusikkaththakkathu yaathenil: kadalka'lum aa'ruka'lumaakiya tha'n'neerka'lilea si'rakum sethi'lum u'l'lavaika'laiyellaam neengka'l pusikkalaam.
aanaalum, kadalka'lum aa'ruka'lumaakiya tha'n'neerka'lil neenthuki'rathum vaazhki'rathumaana piraa'nika'lil si'rakum sethi'lum illaathavaika'l yaavum ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayiruppathaaka.
avaika'l ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayirukkakkadavathu; avaika'lin maamsaththaip pusiyaathirunthu, avaika'lin udalka'lai aruvaruppeerka'laaka.
tha'n'neerka'lilea si'rakum sethi'lum illaatha yaavum ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayirukkakkadavathu.
pa'ravaika'lil neengka'l pusiyaamal aruvarukkavea'ndiyavaika'l yaathenil: kazhukum, karudanum, kadaluraagnchiyum,
parunthum, sakalavitha valloo'rum,
sakalavitha kaakangka'lum,
theekkuruviyum, kookaiyum, sempukamum, sakalavitha deakaiyum,
aanthaiyum, neerkkaakamum, koattaanum,
naaraiyum, koozhakkadaavum, kurukum,
kokkum, sakalavitha raajaa'liyum, puzhukkoththiyum, vauvaalum aakiya ivaika'lea.
pa'rakki'ravaika'lil naalukaalaal nadamaaduki'ra oorum piraa'nika'l yaavum ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayiruppathaaka.
aakilum, pa'rakki'ravaika'lil naalukaalaal nadamaaduki'ra yaavilum, neengka'l pusikkaththakkathu yaathenil: tharaiyilea thaththuki'ratha'rkuk kaalka'lukkumeal thodaika'l u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lilea,

vettukki'li jaathiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, soalaiyaam ennum ki'lijaathiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, arkol ennum ki'lijaathiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, aakaapu ennum ki'lijaathiyaayirukki'rathaiyum neengka'l pusikkalaam.
pa'rakki'ravaika'lil naalukaalaal nadamaaduki'ra mat'ra yaavum ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayiruppathaaka.
avaika'laalea theettuppaduveerka'l; avaika'lin udalaith thoduki'ravan evanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
avaika'lin udalaich sumanthavan evanum than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; avan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.

virinakangka'lu'l'lavaika'laayirunthum, irupi'lavaana ku'lampillaamalum asaipoadaamalum irukki'ra mirukangka'l yaavum ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka; avaika'laith thoduki'ravan evanum theettuppaduvaan.

naalukaalaal nadakki'ra sakala jeevanka'lilum thangka'l u'l'langkaalka'lai oon'ri nadakki'ra yaavum ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka; avaika'lin udalaith thoduki'ravan evanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
avaika'lin udalaich sumanthavan than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; avan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; ivaika'l ungka'lukkuth theettaayirukkakkadavathu.
tharaiyil ooruki'ra piraa'nika'lil ungka'lukku asuththamaanavaika'l evaiyenil: peruchchaa'liyum, eliyum, sakalavithamaana aamaiyum,
udumpum, azhungkum, oa'naanum, palliyum, pachchoanthiyum aakiya ivaika'lea.
sakala oorum piraa'nika'lilum ivaika'l ungka'lukkuth theettaayirukkakkadavathu; avaika'lil seththathaith thoduki'ravan evanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.

avaika'lil seththathu on'ru yaathon'rinmeal vizhunthaal athu theettuppattirukkum; athu marappaaththiramaanaalum, vasthiramaanaalum, thoalaanaalum, paiyaanaalum, vealai seyki'ratha'rkeat'ra aayuthamaanaalum saayangkaalamattum theettaayirukkum; athu tha'n'neeril poadappadavea'ndum, appozhuthu suththamaakum.
avaika'lil on'ru ma'npaa'ndaththi'rku'l vizhunthaal, atha'rku'l irukki'ravai yaavum theettuppattirukkum; athai udaiththuppoadavea'ndum.
pusikkaththakka poajanapathaarththaththinmeal anthath tha'n'neer pattaal, athu theettaakum; kudikkaththakka enthap paanamum appadippatta paaththiraththinaal theettuppadum.

avaika'lin udalil yaathon'ru ethinmeal vizhuthoa, athuvum theettuppadum; aduppaanaalum ma'nthottiyaanaalum thakarkkappaduvathaaka; avaika'l theettuppattirukkum; aakaiyaal, avaika'l ungka'lukkuth theettaayirukkakkadavathu.
aanaalum, neeroot'rum mikuntha jalam u'ndaakiya ki'na'rum suththamaayirukkum; avaika'lilu'l'la udalaith thoduki'ravanoa theettuppaduvaan.
mea'rsolliyavaika'lin udalil yaathon'ru vithaiththaaniyaththinmeal vizhunthaal, athu theettuppadaathu.
antha udalil yaathon'ru tha'n'neer vaarkkappattirukki'ra vithaiyinmeal vizhunthathaanaal, athu ungka'lukkuth theettaayirukkakkadavathu.
ungka'lukku aakaaraththukkaana oru mirukam seththaal, athin udalaith thoduki'ravan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.

athin maamsaththaip pusiththavan than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; avan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; athin udalai eduththuppoanavanum than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; avanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
tharaiyil ooruki'ra piraa'nika'lellaam ungka'lukku aruvaruppaayirukkakkadavathu; avai pusikkappadalaakaathu.

tharaiyil ooruki'ra sakala piraa'nika'lilum, vayit'rinaal nakaruki'ravaika'laiyum, naalukaalaal nadamaaduki'ravaika'laiyum, aneakang kaalka'lu'l'lavaika'laiyum pusiyaathiruppeerka'laaka; avaika'l aruvaruppaanavaika'l.
ooruki'ra enthap piraa'nika'lilum ungka'lai aruvaruppaakkikko'l'laamalum, avaika'laal theettuppadaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; avaika'laalea neengka'l theettuppaduveerka'l.

naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar, naan parisuththar; aakaiyaal, tharaiyil ooruki'ra enthap piraa'nika'lilum ungka'laith theettuppaduththaamal, ungka'laip parisuththamaakkikko'ndu, parisuththaraayiruppeerka'laaka.
naan ungka'l theavanaayirukkumpadi ungka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina karththar, naan parisuththar; aakaiyaal, neengka'lum parisuththaraayiruppeerka'laaka.
suththamaanatha'rkum asuththamaanatha'rkum, pusikkaththakka janthukka'lukkum pusikkaththakaatha janthukka'lukkum viththiyaasampa'n'numporuttu,
mirukaththukkum pa'ravaika'lukkum, tha'n'neerka'lil neenthuki'ra sakala jeevajanthukka'lukkum, poomiyinmeal ooruki'ra sakala piraa'nika'lukkum aduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea en'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: oru sthiree karppavathiyaaki aa'npi'l'laiyaip pet'raal, ava'l soothakasthiree vilakkamaayirukkum naadka'lukkuch sariyaaka eazhunaa'l theettaayiruppaa'l.
ettaam naa'lilea anthap pi'l'laiyinudaiya nuniththoalin maamsam viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadakkadavathu.

pinpu ava'l muppaththumoon'runaa'l than uthirach suththikarippu nilaiyilea irunthu, suththikarippin naadka'l ni'raivea'ruma'lavum parisuththamaana yaathoru vasthuvaith thodavum parisuththa sthalaththukku'l varavung koodaathu.
pe'npi'l'laiyaip pet'raa'laakil, ava'l, ira'ndu vaaram soothakasthireeyaippoalath theettaayirunthu, pinpu a'rupaththaa'runaa'l uthirach suththikarippu nilaiyilea irukkakkadava'l.

ava'l aa'npi'l'laiyaiyaavathu pe'npi'l'laiyaiyaavathu pet'ratha'rkaaka ava'ludaiya suththikarippin naadka'l ni'raivea'rinapinpu, ava'l oru vayathaana aattukkuttiyai sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum, oru pu'raakkugnchaiyaavathu kaattuppu'raavaiyaavathu paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil aasaariyanidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarakkadava'l.

athai avan karththarudaiya sannithiyil paliyittu, ava'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyvaanaaka; appozhuthu ava'l than uthira oo'ralin theettu neengkich suththamaavaa'l. ithu aa'npi'l'laiyaiyaavathu pe'npi'l'laiyaiyaavathu pet'rava'laikku'riththa piramaa'nam.

aattukkuttiyaik ko'nduvara ava'lukkuch sakthiyillaathirunthaal, ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu, on'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum mat'ron'raip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum ko'nduvarakkadava'l; athinaal aasaariyan ava'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu ava'l suththamaavaa'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:

oru manithanudaiya sareeraththinmeal kushdaroakampoalirukki'ra oru thadippaavathu asa'raavathu ve'l'laippadaraavathu u'ndaanaal, avan aasaariyanaakiya aaroanidaththilaakilum, aasaariyaraakiya avan kumaararil oruvanidaththilaakilum ko'nduvarappadakkadavan.

appozhuthu aasaariyan avan sareeraththinmeal irukki'ra roakaththaip paarkkavea'ndum; roakam irukkum idaththil mayir ve'luththum, roakamu'l'la idam avanudaiya mat'rach sareeraththaippaarkkilum athikamaayk kuzhinthum irunthaal athu kushdaroakam; aasaariyan avanaip paarththapinpu, avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan.

avan sareeraththinmeal ve'l'laip padarnthirunthaalum, avvidam avanudaiya mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum athika pa'l'lamaayiraamalum, athin mayir ve'l'laiyaaka maa'raamalum irunthaal, aasaariyan avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththu vaiththu,
eazhaam naa'lil avanaip paarkkakkadavan; thoalil roakam athikappadaamal, avan paarvaikku roakam nin'rirunthaal, aasaariyan ira'ndaantharam avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,

ira'ndaantharam avanai eazhaamnaa'lil paarkkakkadavan; thoalil roakam athikappadaamal surungkiyirunthaal, aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu asa'ru; avan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththuch suththamaayiruppaanaaka.

thannaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkki'ratha'rku avan thannai aasaariyanukkuk kaa'npiththa pinpu, asa'ru thoalil athikamaay padarnthirunthaal, avan ma'rupadiyum aasaariyanukkuth thannaik kaa'npikkakkadavan.
appozhuthu asa'ru thoalilea padarnthathu en'ru aasaariyan ka'ndaal, aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu kushdaroakam.
kushdaroakam oru manithanukku irunthaal, avanai aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvaravea'ndum.

appozhuthu aasaariyan avanaip paarththu, thoalilea ve'l'laiyaana thadippirunthu, athu mayirai ve'nmaiyaaka maa'rappa'n'nit'ren'rum, anthath thadippu'l'la idaththilea ira'namaamsam u'nden'rum ka'ndaal,
athu avan sareeraththilu'l'la naa'lpatta kushdam; avan theettu'l'lavan. aathalaal, aasaariyan avanai adaiththuvaikkaamal, theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan.
aasaariyan paarkki'ra idangka'lengkum thoalilea kushdam thoan'ri, antha roakamu'l'lavanudaiya thalai thodangki avan kaalmattum athu theakamuzhuvathaiyum moodiyirukkakka'ndaal,

appozhuthu aasaariyan paarththu, kushdam avan sareeram muzhuvathaiyum moodiyirunthaal, avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; avan udampellaam ve'nmaiyaayppoanapadiyaal, avan suththamu'l'lavan.
aanaalum, ira'namaamsam avanil kaa'nappattaal, avan theettu'l'lavan.
aakaiyaal, ira'namaamsaththai aasaariyan kaa'numpoathu, avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; ira'namaamsam theettu'l'lathu; athu kushdam.
allathu, ira'namaamsam maa'ri ve'nmaiyaanaal, avan aasaariyanidaththukku varavea'ndum.
aasaariyan avanaippaarththu, roakamu'l'la idam ve'nmaiyaaka maa'rinathen'ru ka'ndaal, aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; avan suththamu'l'lavan.
sareeraththinmeal pu'n u'ndaayirunthu aa'rippoay,
avvidaththilea oru ve'l'laith thadippaavathu sivappukkalantha oru ve'l'laippadaraavathu u'ndaanaal, athai aasaariyanukkuk kaa'npikkavea'ndum.

aasaariyan athaip paarththu, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum kuzhinthirukkavum, athin mayir ve'l'laiyaaka maa'riyirukkavum ka'ndaal, aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkavea'ndum; athu pu'n'nil ezhumpina kushdam.
aasaariyan athaip paarththu, athil ve'l'laimayir illai en'rum, athu mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum kuzhinthiraamal surungkiyirukki'rathu en'rum ka'ndaanaakil, avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,
athu thoalil athikamaayp padarnthirukkakka'ndaal, avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu kushdanthaan.
antha ve'l'laippadar athikappadaamal, avva'lavil nin'rirukkumaakil, athu pu'n'nin thazhumpaayirukkum; aakaiyaal, aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan.
oruvanudaiya sareeraththinmeal neruppuppattathinaalea venthu, antha veakkaadu aa'rippoana idaththilea sivappaana padaraavathu ve'nmaiyaana padaraavathu u'ndaanaal,

aasaariyan athaip paarkkakkadavan; anthap padarilea mayir ve'nmaiyaaka maa'ri, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum pa'l'lamaayirunthaal, athu veakkaattinaal ezhumpina kushdam; aakaiyaal, aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu kushdaroakanthaan.

aasaariyan athaip paarkki'rapoathu, padarilea ve'l'laimayir illai en'rum, athu mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum kuzhinthiraamal, surungkiyirukki'rathu en'rum ka'ndaanaakil, avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,
eazhaamnaa'lil avanaip paarkkakkadavan; athu thoalil athikamaayp padarnthirunthaal, aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu kushdaroakam.

padaraanathu thoalil perukaamal, avva'lavil nin'ru surungkiyirunthathaakil, athu soottinaal u'ndaana thazhumpu; aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu soottinaal vantha veakkaadu.
purushanukkaakilum sthireekkaakilum thalaiyilaavathu thaadiyilaavathu oru so'ri u'ndaanaal,

aasaariyan athaip paarththu, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum pa'l'lamum athilea mayir pon ni'ramum miruthuvumaayirukkakka'ndaal, aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; athu thalaiyilum thaadiyilum u'ndaaki'ra so'rikushdam.

aasaariyan anthach so'rikushdaththaip paarkkumpoathu, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum pa'l'lamaayiraamalum, athilea ka'ruththa mayir illaamalum irukkakka'ndaal, aasaariyan avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,
eazhaamnaa'lil aasaariyan athaip paarkkakkadavan; anthach so'ri idangko'l'laamalum, athilea ponni'ramayir illaamalum, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum pa'l'lamillaamalum irunthaal,
anthach so'riyu'l'la idanthavira, mat'ra yaavaiyum avan siraiththukko'l'lakkadavan; pinpu, aasaariyan ira'ndaantharam avanai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,

eazhaamnaa'lil athaip paarkkakkadavan; so'ri thoalil idangko'l'laamalum, avvidam mat'rath thoalaippaarkkilum pa'l'lamillaamalum irunthaal, aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; avan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththapin suththamaayiruppaan.
avan suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkappattapin, anthach so'ri thoalil idangko'ndathaanaal,
aasaariyan avanaip paarkkakkadavan; so'ri thoalil idangko'ndirunthaal, appozhuthu mayir ponni'ramaa allavaa en'ru aasaariyan visaarikka vea'ndiyathillai; avan theettu'l'lavanea.
avan paarvaikku anthach so'ri neengki, athil ka'ruththamayir mu'laiththatheayaakil, so'ri sosthamaayit'ru; avan suththamu'l'lavan; aasaariyan avanaich suththamu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan.
oru purushanukkaakilum sthireekkaakilum avarka'l sareeraththinmeal ve'l'laip pu'l'lika'l u'ndaayirunthaal,
aasaariyan paarkkakkadavan; avarka'l sareeraththilea mangkina ve'l'laip pu'l'lika'l irunthaal, athu thoalil ezhumpuki'ra ve'l'laiththeamal; avarka'l suththamu'l'lavarka'l.
oruvanudaiya thalaimayir uthirnthu, avan mottaiyanaanaalum, avan suththamaayirukki'raan.
avanudaiya munnanthalai mayir uthirnthaal, avan araimottaiyan; avanum suththamaayirukki'raan.
mottaiththalaiyilaavathu araimottaiththalaiyilaavathu sivappukkalantha ve'nmaiyaana padar u'ndaanaal, athu athil ezhumpuki'ra kushdam.

aasaariyan avanaip paarkkakkadavan; avanudaiya mottaiththalaiyilaavathu araimottaiththalaiyilaavathu, mat'ra angkangka'linmeal u'ndaakum kushdaththaippoala, sivappukkalantha ve'nmaiyaana thadippu irukkakka'ndaal,
avan kushdaroaki, avan theettu'l'lavan; aasaariyan avanaith theettu'l'lavan en'ru theerkkakkadavan; avan viyaathi avan thalaiyilea irukki'rathu.
antha viyaathi u'ndaayirukki'ra kushdaroaki vasthiram kizhinthavanaayum, than thalaiyai moodaathavanaayum irunthu, avan than thaadiyai moodikko'ndu, "theettu, theettu" en'ru saththamidavea'ndum.

antha viyaathi avanil irukkum naa'lvaraikkum theettu'l'lavanaaka e'n'nappadakkadavan; avan theettu'l'lavanea; aakaiyaal, avan thaniyea kudiyirukkavea'ndum; avan kudiyiruppu paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea irukkakkadavathu.
aattumayir vasthiraththilaavathu, pagnchunool vasthiraththilaavathu,
pagnchunool, allathu aattumayiraana paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu, oru thoalilaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvilaavathu kushdathoasham thoan'ri,

vasthiraththilaavathu, thoalilaavathu, paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvilaavathu kushdathoasham pachchaiyaayaavathu sivappaayaavathu kaa'nappattaal athu kushdamaayirukkum; athai aasaariyanukkuk kaa'npikkavea'ndum.
aasaariyan athaip paarththu, eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,

eazhaam naa'lilea athaip paarkkakkadavan; vasthiraththilaavathu, paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu, thoalilaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvilaavathu athu athikappattirunthaal, athu arikki'ra kushdam; athu theettaayirukkum.

anthath thoasham irukki'ra aattumayirinaalum pagnchunoolinaalum seytha vasthiraththaiyum paavaiyum, oodaiyaiyum, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvaiyum sutterikkakkadavan; athu arikki'ra kushdam; aakaiyaal akkiniyil sutterikkappadavea'ndum.
vasthiraththin paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvilaavathu, anthath thoasham athikappadavillai en'ru aasaariyan ka'ndaal,
appozhuthu aasaariyan athaik kazhuvachsolli, ira'ndaantharam eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,

athu kazhuvappattapinpu, athaip paarkkakkadavan; anthath thoasham athikappadaathirunthaalum, athu ni'ram maa'raathathaayirunthaal theettaayirukkum; akkiniyil athaich sutterikkavea'ndum; athu avvasthiraththin udpu'raththilum ve'lippu'raththilum uruva arikkum.
kazhuvappattapinpu athu ku'rukit'ren'ru aasaariyan ka'ndaaneayaakil, athai vasthiraththilaavathu, thoalilaavathu, paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu iraathapadikku eduththuppoadavea'ndum.

athu innum vasthiraththilaavathu, paavilaavathu, oodaiyilaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvilaavathu kaa'nappattaal, athu padaruki'ra thoasham; aakaiyinaal athu u'l'lathai akkiniyil sutterikkavea'ndum.

vasthiraththin paavaavathu, oodaiyaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvaavathu kazhuvappattapinpu, anthath thoasham athaivittup poayit'reayaanaal, ira'ndaantharam kazhuvappadavea'ndum; appozhuthu suththamaayirukkum.

aattumayiraalaakilum pagnchunoolaalaakilum neytha vasthiraththaiyaavathu, paavaiyaavathu, oodaiyaiyaavathu, thoalinaal seytha enthavitha vasthuvaiyaavathu, suththamen'raavathu theetten'raavathu theerkki'ratha'rku, athinudaiya kushdathoashaththukkaduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
kushdaroakiyinudaiya suththikarippin naa'lil avanukkaduththa piramaa'nam ennaven'raal: avan aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvarappadavea'ndum.
aasaariyan paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea poay; kushdaroakiyin kushdaviyaathi sosthamaayit'ru en'ru ka'ndaal,
suththikarikkappadavea'ndiyavanukkaaka, uyiroadirukkum suththamaana ira'ndu kuruvika'laiyum, keathuruk kattaiyaiyum, sivappunoolaiyum, eesoappaiyum vaangkivarak katta'laiyidakkadavan.
pinpu, aasaariyan anthak kuruvika'lil on'rai oru ma'npaa'ndaththilu'l'la oot'runeermeal kollach solli,
uyiru'l'la kuruviyaiyum, keathuruk kattaiyaiyum, sivappunoolaiyum, eesoappaiyum eduththu, ivaika'laiyum uyiru'l'la kuruviyaiyum oot'runeermeal kollappatta kuruviyin iraththaththilea thoayththu,
kushdam neengkach suththikarikkappaduki'ravanmeal eazhutharam the'liththu, avanaich suththampa'n'ni, uyiru'l'la kuruviyai ve'liyilea vittuvidakkadavan.

suththikarikkappaduki'ravan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, than mayir muzhuvathaiyum siraiththu, thaan suththamaakumpadi jalaththil snaanampa'n'ni, pinpu paa'layaththil piraveasiththu, than koodaaraththukkup pu'rampea eazhunaa'l thangki,

eazhaam naa'lilea than thalaiyaiyum thaadiyaiyum puruvangka'laiyum thannudaiya mayir muzhuvathaiyum siraiththu, than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, jalaththil snaanampa'n'navea'ndum; appozhuthu suththamaayiruppaan.

ettaamnaa'lilea avan pazhuthat'ra ira'ndu aattukkuttika'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra oru pe'n'naattukkuttiyaiyum, poajanapalikkaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha oru marakkaalil paththil moon'ru pangkaakiya melliya maavaiyum, aazhaakku e'n'neyaiyum ko'nduvarakkadavan.
suththikarikki'ra aasaariyan suththikarikkappadum manithanaiyum avvasthukka'laiyum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ni'ruththakkadavan.
pinpu, aasaariyan oru aattukkuttiyaip pidiththu, athaiyum antha aazhaakku e'n'neyaiyum kut'ranivaara'napaliyaakak ko'nduvanthu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaatti,

paavanivaara'napaliyum sarvaangka thakanapaliyum idum parisuththa sthalaththilea antha aattukkuttiyaik kollakkadavan; kut'ranivaara'napali paavanivaara'napaliyaippoala aasaariyanukku uriyathu; athu makaa parisuththamaanathu.

anthak kut'ranivaara'napaliyin iraththaththil aasaariyan kogncham eduththu, suththikarikkappaduki'ravan valathukaathin madalilum, avan valathukaiyin peruviralilum, valathukaalin peruviralilum poosakkadavan.
pinpu, aasaariyan antha aazhaakku e'n'neyilea kogncham than idathukaiyil vaarththu,
than idathukaiyilu'l'la e'n'neyil than valathukaiyin viralaiththoayththu, than viralinaal eazhutharam antha e'n'neyil eduththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil the'liththu,

than u'l'langkaiyil irukki'ra meethiyaana e'n'neyilea kogncham eduththu suththikarikkappaduki'ravan valathukaathin madalilum, avan valathukaiyin peruviralilum, valathukaalin peruviralilum, munthip poosiyirukki'ra kut'ranivaara'napaliyinudaiya iraththaththinmeal poosi,
than u'l'langkaiyil irukki'ra meethiyaana e'n'neyaich suththikarikkappaduki'ravan thalaiyilea vaarththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil avanukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan.
aasaariyan paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum seluththi, suththikarikkappaduki'ravanin theettu neengka, avanukkup paavanivirththi seythu, pinpu sarvaangka thakanapaliyaik kon'ru,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum palipeedaththinmeal vaiththu, avanukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu avan suththamaayiruppaan.

avan immaaththiram seyyath thiraa'niyat'ra thariththiranaayirunthaal, avan than paavanivirththikken'ru asaivaattum kut'ranivaara'napaliyaaka oru aattukkuttiyaiyum, poajanapalikku e'n'neyil pisaintha oru marakkaal melliya maavilea paththil oru pangkaiyum, aazhaakku e'n'neyaiyum,

than thiraa'nikkuth thakkapadi ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu, on'ru paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, mat'ron'ru sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum seluththumpadi vaangki,
thaan suththikarikkappadumpadi ettaam naa'lil aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil aasaariyanidaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvaanaaka.
appozhuthu aasaariyan kut'ranivaara'napalikkuriya aattukkuttiyaiyum antha aazhaakku e'n'neyaiyum vaangki, karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum poajanapaliyaaka asaivaatti,

kut'ranivaara'na palikkaana antha aattukkuttiyaik kon'ru, kut'ranivaara'napaliyin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, suththikarikkappaduki'ravan valathukaathin madalilum, avan valathukaiyin peruviralilum, valathukaalin peruviralilum poosi,
antha e'n'neyilea kogncham than idathukaiyil vaarththu,
than idathukaiyilu'l'la e'n'neyilea than valathuviralaith thoayththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil eazhutharam the'liththu,

than u'l'langkaiyil irukki'ra e'n'neyil kogncham eduththuch suththikarikkappaduki'ravan valathukaathin madalilum, avan valathukaiyin peruviralilum, valathukaalin peruviralilum kut'ranivaara'napaliyin iraththam poosiyirukki'ra idaththinmeal poosi,
than u'l'langkaiyil irukki'ra mat'ra e'n'neyaich suththikarikkappaduki'ravan thalaiyinmeal avanukkaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil paavanivirththi seyyumpadi thadavi,
pinpu, avan than thiraa'nikkum thakuthikkum thakkathaayk kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu ko'nduvanthu,

avaika'lil on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyum, mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyumaakki, poajanapaliyoadeakoodach seluththi, ippadiyea aasaariyan suththikarikkappaduki'ravanukkaaka, karththarudaiya sannithiyil paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan.
than suththikarippukku vea'ndiyavaika'laich sampaathikkakkoodaatha kushdaroakiyaik ku'riththa piramaa'nam ithuvea en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
naan ungka'lukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakak kodukkum kaanaan theasaththilea neengka'l poaych searnthapinpu, ungka'l kaa'niyaadchiyaana theasaththil oru veettilea kushdathoashaththai naan varappa'n'ninaal,
antha veetti'rku udaiyavan vanthu, veettilea thoasham vanthirukki'rathaakath thoan'ruki'rathu en'ru aasaariyanukku a'rivikkakkadavan.
appozhuthu veettilu'l'la yaavum theettuppadaathapadikku, aasaariyan anthath thoashaththaip paarkkap poakummunnea veettai ozhiththuvaikkumpadi solli, pinpu veettaip paarkkumpadi poay,

anthath thoasham irukki'ra idaththaip paarkkakkadavan; appozhuthu veettuch suvarka'lilea kogncham pachchaiyum kogncham sivappumaana kuzhi vizhunthirunthu, avaika'l mat'rach suvaraippaarkkilum pa'l'lamaayirukkakka'ndaal,
aasaariyan veettaivittup pu'rappattu vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthu, veettai eazhunaa'l adaiththuvaiththu,
eazhaamnaa'lilea thirumpap poayp paarththu, thoasham veettuch suvarka'lil padarnthathen'ru ka'ndaal,
thoasham irukkum avvidaththuk kalluka'laip peyarkkavum, patta'naththukkup pu'rampea asuththamaana oru idaththilea poadavum avan katta'laiyittu,
veettai u'l'lea sut'rilum sethukkachsolli, sethukkippoatta ma'n'naip patta'naththukkup pu'rampea asuththamaana oru idaththilea kottavum,
vea'rea kalluka'lai eduththuvanthu, anthak kalluka'lukkup pathilaakak katti, vea'rea saanthai eduththu veettaip poosavum katta'laiyiduvaanaaka.
kalluka'laip peyarththu, veettaich sethukki, navamaayp poosinapinpum, anthath thoasham thirumpa veettil vanthathaanaal,
aasaariyan poayp paarkkakkadavan; thoasham veettil padarnthathaanaal, athu veettai arikki'ra kushdam; athu theettaayirukkum.
aakaiyaal veedumuzhuvathaiyum idiththu, athin kalluka'laiyum, marangka'laiyum, athin saanthu ellaavat'raiyum patta'naththukkup pu'rampea asuththamaana idaththilea ko'ndupoakavea'ndum.
veedu adaikkappattirukkum naadka'lil atha'rku'l piraveasikki'ravan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
antha veettilea paduththavan than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; antha veettilea saappittavanum than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan.

aasaariyan thirumpa vanthu, veedu poosappattapinpu veettilea anthath thoasham padaravillai en'ru ka'ndaaneayaakil, thoasham nivirththiyaanapadiyaal, aasaariyan antha veettaich suththam en'ru theerkkakkadavan.
appozhuthu veetti'rkuth thoashangkazhikka, ira'ndu kuruvika'laiyum, keathurukkattaiyaiyum, sivappunoolaiyum, eesoappaiyum eduththu,
oru kuruviyai oru ma'npaa'ndaththilu'l'la oot'runeerinmeal kon'ru,

keathurukkattaiyaiyum, eesoappaiyum, sivappunoolaiyum, uyiru'l'la kuruviyaiyum eduththu, ivaika'laik kollappatta kuruviyin iraththaththilum oot'ru neerilum thoayththu, veettinmeal eazhutharam the'liththu,
kuruviyin iraththaththinaalum, oot'runeerinaalum, uyiru'l'la kuruviyinaalum, keathurukkattaiyinaalum eesoappinaalum, sivappunoolinaalum veetti'rkuth thoashangkazhiththu,
uyiru'l'la kuruviyaip patta'naththukkup pu'rampea ve'liyilea vittuvittu, ippadi veetti'rkup piraayachchiththam seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu athu suththamaayirukkum.
ithu sakalavitha kushdaroakaththukkum, so'rikkum,
vasthirak kushdaththukkum, veettuk kushdaththukkum,
thadippukkum, asa'rukkum, ve'l'laippadarukkum aduththa piramaa'nam.
kushdam eppozhuthu theettu'l'lathu en'rum, eppozhuthu theettillaathathu en'rum therivippatha'rkuk kushdaroakaththukku aduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
neengka'l israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: oruvanukkup piramiyam u'ndaanaal, avan than piramiyaththinaalea theettaanavan.
avanudaiya maamsaththilu'l'la piramiyam oo'rikko'ndirunthaalum, avan piramiyam adaipattirunthaalum, athinaal avanukkuth theettu'ndaakum.
piramiyamu'l'lavan padukki'ra enthap padukkaiyum theettaakum; avan ethinmeal udkaaruki'raanoa athuvum theettaakum.
avan padukkaiyaith thoduki'ravan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhukakkadavan; saayangkaalamattum avan theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavan udkaarnthathinmeal udkaaruki'ravan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavanin sareeraththaith thoduki'ravan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavan suththamaayirukki'ra oruvanmeal thuppinaal, ivan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavan ea'rum enthachsea'namum theettaayirukkum.

avanukkuk keezhiruntha ethaiyaakilum thoduki'ravan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; athai eduththukko'ndu poaki'ravan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavan than kaika'laith tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvaamal oruvanaith thottaal, ivan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
piramiyam u'l'lavan thotta ma'npaa'ndam udaikkappadavum, marachsaamaan ellaam tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvappadavum vea'ndum.

piramiyam u'l'lavan than piramiyam neengkich suththamaanaal, than suththikarippukken'ru eazhunaa'l e'n'nikko'ndirunthu, than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, than theakaththai oot'runeeril kazhuvakkadavan; appozhuthu suththamaayiruppaan.

ettaamnaa'lilea, avan ira'ndu kaattup pu'raakka'laiyaavathu, ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu, aasaariyanidaththil kodukkakkadavan.
aasaariyan avaika'lil on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyum mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyumaakki, avanukkaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil avan piramiyaththinimiththam paavanivirththi seyyavea'ndum.
oruvanilirunthu inthiriyam kazhinthathu'ndaanaal, avan tha'n'neeril muzhukavea'ndum; saayangkaalamattum avan theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
kazhintha inthiriyam patta vasthiramum thoalum tha'n'neerinaal kazhuvappattu, saayangkaalamattum theettaayiruppathaaka.
inthiriyam kazhinthavanoadea sthiree paduththukko'ndirunthaal, iruvarum tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaarka'laaka.
soothakasthiree than sareeraththilu'l'la uthira oo'ralinimiththam eazhunaa'l than vilakkaththil irukkakkadava'l; ava'laith thoduki'ravan evanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
ava'l vilakkalaayirukkaiyil, ethinmeal paduththukko'l'luki'raa'loa ethinmeal udkaaruki'raa'loa athellaam theettaayirukkum.
ava'l padukkaiyaith thoduki'ravan evanum than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
ava'l udkaarntha ma'naiyaith thoduki'ravan evanum than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
ava'l padukkaiyinmealaakilum, ava'l udkaarntha ma'naiyinmealaakilum iruntha ethaiyaakilum thottavan, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
oruvan ava'loadea paduththukko'ndathum, ava'l theettu avanmeal pattathumu'ndaanaal, avan eazhunaa'l theettaayiruppaanaaka; avan padukki'ra padukkaiyum theettuppadum.

oru sthiree vilakiyirukkavea'ndiyakaalam allaamal ava'ludaiya uthiram aneakanaa'l oo'rikko'ndirunthaal, allathu anthak kaalaththukku mignchi athu ka'ndirukkum naa'lellaam oo'rikko'ndirunthaal, than vilakkaththin naadka'lilirunthathupoala ava'l theettaayiruppaa'laaka.

antha naadka'lellaam ava'l padukkum enthap padukkaiyum, ava'l vilakkaththin padukkaiyaippoala, ava'lukkuth theettaayirukkum; ava'l udkaarntha ma'naiyum, ava'ludaiya vilakkaththin theettaippoalavea theettaayirukkum.
appadippattavaika'laith thoduki'ravan evanum than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaanaaka.
ava'l than uthira oo'ral nin'ru suththamaanapoathu, ava'l eazhunaa'l e'n'nikko'lvaa'laaka; athinpinpu suththamaayiruppaa'l.
ettaam naa'lilea ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu, ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvarakkadava'l.

aasaariyan avaika'lil on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyum, mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyumaakki, ava'lukkaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil ava'ludaiya uthira oo'ralinimiththam paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan.

israveal puththirar thangka'l naduvea irukki'ra ennudaiya vaasasthalaththaith theettuppaduththi, thangka'l theettuka'laal saakaathapadikku, ippadi neengka'l avarka'l theettuka'lukku avarka'lai vilakkivaikkakkadaveerka'l.
piramiyamu'l'lavanukkum, inthiriyak kazhivinaalea theettaanavanukkum,
soothaka palaveenamu'l'lava'lukkum, piramiyamu'l'la sthiree purusharukkum, theettaayirukki'rava'loadea paduththukko'ndavanukkum eat'ra piramaa'nam ithuvea en'raar.
aaroanin ira'ndu kumaarar karththarudaiya sannithiyilea searnthu mariththuppoanapinpu, karththar moaseayai noakki:

kirupaasanaththinmeal oru meakaththil naan kaa'nappaduvean; aathalaal un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan saakaathapadi, parisuththa sthalaththilea thiraikku udpu'raththilirukki'ra pettiyinmealu'l'la kirupaasana moodikku munpaakach sakala vea'laiyilum varavea'ndaam en'ru avanukkuch sol.

aaroan parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasikkavea'ndiya vithamaavathu: avan oru kaa'laiyaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, oru aattukkadaavaich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum seluththip piraveasikkavea'ndum.

avan parisuththamaana sa'nalnool sattaiyaith thariththu, than araikkuch sa'nalnool jalladaththaip poattu, sa'nalnool idaikkachchaiyaik katti, sa'nalnool paakaiyaith thariththukko'ndirukkavea'ndum; avaika'l parisuththa vasthirangka'l; avan jalaththilea snaanampa'n'ni, avaika'laith thariththukko'ndu,
israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaaridaththilea, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka ira'ndu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru aattukkadaavaiyum vaangkakkadavan.
pinpu aaroan thanakkaakavum than veettaarukkaakavum paavanivirththi seyyumpadikku, thannudaiya paavanivaara'napaliyin kaa'laiyaich searappa'n'ni,
antha ira'ndu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ni'ruththi,
antha ira'ndu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyungku'riththuk karththarukken'ru oru seettum, poakkaadaaka vidappadum ve'l'laattukkadaavukken'ru oru seettum poattu,
karththarukken'ru seettu vizhuntha ve'l'laattukkadaavaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakach searappa'n'ni,

poakkaadaaka vidappadach seettu vizhuntha ve'l'laattukkadaavai, athaikko'ndu paavanivirththi u'ndaakkavum athaip poakkaadaaka vanaantharaththilea poakavidavum, karththarudaiya sannithiyil uyiroadea ni'ruththi;
pinpu aaroan thanakkaakavum than veettaarukkaakavum paavanivirththi seyyumpadi, thannudaiya paavanivaara'naththukkaana kaa'laiyaik ko'nduvanthu, athaik kon'ru,

karththarudaiya sannithiyilirukkum palipeedaththinmealu'l'la neruppuththa'nalinaal thoopakalasaththai nirappi, podiyaakkappatta sukantha thoopavarkkaththilea than kaippidika'l ni'raiya eduththu, thiraikku udpu'ramaakak ko'nduvanthu,
thaan saakaathapadikkuth thoopameakamaanathu saadchippettiyinmeal irukkum kirupaasanaththai moodaththakkathaaka, karththarudaiya sannithiyil akkiniyinmeal thoopavarkkaththaip poadakkadavan.

pinpu kaa'laiyin iraththaththilea kogncham eduththu, keezhppu'ramaaka nin'ru, than viralinaal kirupaasanaththinmeal the'liththu, antha iraththaththil kogncham eduththuk kirupaasanaththukku munpaaka eazhutharam than viralinaal the'likkakkadavan.

pinpu janaththinudaiya paavanivaara'napaliyaana ve'l'laattukkadaavai avan kon'ru, athin iraththaththaith thiraikku udpu'ramaakak ko'nduvanthu, kaa'laiyin iraththaththaith the'liththathupoala, athin iraththaththaiyum kirupaasanaththinmealum atha'rku munpaakavum the'liththu,

israveal puththirarudaiya theettuka'linimiththamum, avarka'ludaiya sakala paavangka'linaalum u'ndaana avarka'ludaiya mee'ruthalka'linimiththamum, parisuththa sthalaththi'rkaakap piraayachchiththagnseythu, avarka'lidaththil avarka'ludaiya theettuka'lukku'l'lea ni'rki'ra aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rkaakavum appadiyea seyyakkadavan.

paavanivirththi seyyumpadi avan parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasiththu, thanakkaakavum than veettaarukkaakavum israveal sapaiyaar anaivarukkaakavum paavanivirththi seythu, ve'liyea varuma'lavum aasarippuk koodaaraththil oruvarum irukkalaakaathu.

pinpu avan karththarudaiya sannithiyil irukki'ra palipeedaththa'ndai vanthu, atha'rkaakap piraayachchiththagnseythu, kaa'laiyin iraththaththilum ve'l'laattukkadaavin iraththaththilum kogncham eduththu, palipeedaththuk kompuka'linmeal sut'rilum poosi,
than viralinaal antha iraththaththil eduththu, eazhutharam athinmeal the'liththu, athai israveal puththirarin theettuka'l neengkach suththikariththu, parisuththappaduththakkadavan.
avan ippadip parisuththa sthalaththukkum aasarippuk koodaaraththukkum palipeedaththukkum piraayachchiththagnseythu theernthapinpu, uyiroadirukki'ra ve'l'laattukkadaavaich searappa'n'ni,

athin thalaiyinmeal aaroan than ira'ndu kaika'laiyum vaiththu, athinmeal israveal puththirarudaiya sakala akkiramangka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya ellaap paavangka'linaalum u'ndaana avarka'ludaiya sakala mee'ruthalka'laiyum a'rikkaiyittu, avaika'lai ve'l'laattukkadaavinudaiya thalaiyinmeal sumaththi, athai atha'rkaana aa'lvasamaay vanaantharaththukku anuppividakkadavan.

antha ve'l'laattukkadaa avarka'ludaiya akkiramangka'laiyellaam thanmeal sumanthuko'ndu, kudiyillaatha theasaththukkup poavathaaka; avan antha ve'l'laattukkadaavai vanaantharaththilea poakavidakkadavan.
aaroan aasarippuk koodaaraththukku'l vanthu, thaan parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, uduththiyiruntha sa'nalnool vasthirangka'laik ka'lainthu, angkea vaiththuvittu,

parisuththa idaththilea jalaththil snaanampa'n'ni, than vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu, ve'liyea vanthu, than sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum janangka'lin sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum ittu, thanakkaakavum janangka'lukkaakavum paavanivirththi seythu,
paavanivaara'napaliyin kozhuppaip palipeedaththinmeal thakanikkakkadavan.
poakavidappadum poakkaadaakiya ve'l'laattukkadaavaik ko'ndupoay vittavan, than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, jalaththil snaanampa'n'ni, pinpu paa'layaththukku'l varuvaanaaka.

paavanivirththikken'ru parisuththa sthalaththukku'l iraththam ko'nduvarappatta paavanivaara'napaliyaakiya kaa'laiyaiyum, paavanivaara'napaliyaakiya ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum, paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoay, avaika'lin thoalaiyum maamsaththaiyum saa'niyaiyum akkiniyilea sutterikkakkadavarka'l.
avaika'laich sutteriththavan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, jalaththilea snaanampa'n'ni, pinpu paa'layaththukku'l varuvaanaaka.

eazhaam maatham paththaam theathiyilea, sutheasiyaanaalum ungka'lukku'l thangkum paratheasiyaanaalum, thangka'l aaththumaakka'laith thaazhmaippaduththuvathuman'ri, oru vealaiyum seyyaamal irukkavea'ndum; ithu ungka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaay irukkakkadavathu.
karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'l paavamellaam neengkich suththikarikkappadumpadi, annaa'lil ungka'laich suththikarikkumporuttu, ungka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyappadum.
ungka'lukku athu viseashiththa oayvunaa'l; athilea ungka'l aaththumaakka'laith thaazhmaippaduththakkadaveerka'l; ithu niththiya katta'lai.

apisheakam pet'ravanum, than thakappan pattaththi'rku vanthu aasaariya oozhiyagnseyyap pirathishdaipa'n'nappattavanumaakiya aasaariyanea paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan. avan parisuththa vasthirangka'laakiya sa'nalnool vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu,
parisuththa sthalaththukkum aasarippuk koodaaraththukkum palipeedaththukkum piraayachchiththagnseythu, aasaariyarukkaakavum sapaiyin sakala janangka'lukkaakavum paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan.

ippadi varushaththil orumu'rai israveal puththirarukkaaka, avarka'ludaiya sakala paavangka'lukkum paavanivirththi seyvathu, ungka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkakkadavathu en'ru sol en'raar. karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea aaroan seythaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee aaroanoadum avan kumaararoadum israveal puththirar anaivaroadum sollavea'ndiyathaavathu; karththar katta'laiyiduki'rathu ennaven'raal:

israveal kudumpaththaaril evanaakilum maattaiyaavathu semma'riyaattaiyaavathu ve'l'laattaiyaavathu aasarippuk koodaaravaasalaakiya karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththukku munpaaka, karththarukkuch seluththumpadi ko'nduvaraamal,

paa'layaththukku'l'leayaakilum paa'layaththukkup pu'rampeayaakilum athaik kon'raal, athu antha manithanukku iraththappazhiyaaka e'n'nappadum. antha manithan iraththam sinthinapadiyaal, than janaththil iraamal a'ruppu'ndu poavaan.

aakaiyaal israveal puththirar ve'liyilea paliyiduki'ra thangka'l palika'lai, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil aasaariyanidaththil karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu, angkea avaika'laik karththarukkuch samaathaanapalika'laakach seluththakkadavarka'l.
angkea aasaariyan iraththaththai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilirukki'ra karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal the'liththu, kozhuppaik karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaakath thakanikkakkadavan.

thaangka'l soaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'ruki'ra peayka'lukkuth thangka'l palika'lai inich seluththaathiruppaarka'laaka; ithu avarka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum avarka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkakkadavathu.
mealum nee avarka'lai noakki: israveal kudumpaththaarilum ungka'l naduvea thangkuki'ra anniyarka'lilum evanaakilum sarvaangka thakanapali muthalaanavaika'laiyittu,
athai aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarukkuch seluththumpadi ko'nduvaraavittaal, avan than janaththil iraamal a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'ru sol.

israveal kudumpaththaarilum ungka'lukku'l thangkum anniyarka'lilum evanaakilum iraththam ennappattathaip pusiththaal, iraththaththaip pusiththa avanukku viroathamaaka naan en mukaththaith thiruppi, avan than janaththil iraathapadikku avanai a'ruppu'ndupoakap pa'n'nuvean.

maamsaththin uyir iraththaththil irukki'rathu; naan athai ungka'lukkup palipeedaththinmeal ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumpadikkuk katta'laiyittean; aaththumaavi'rkaakap paavanivirththi seyki'rathu iraththamea.
athinimiththam ungka'lil oruvanum iraththam pusikkavea'ndaam, ungka'l naduvea thangkuki'ra anniyanum iraththam pusikkavea'ndaam en'ru israveal puththirarukkuch sonnean.

israveal puththirarilum ungka'lukku'l thangkuki'ra anniyarka'lilum evanaakilum pusikkaththakka oru mirukaththaiyaavathu oru padchiyaiyaavathu veattaiyaadip pidiththaal, avan athin iraththaththaich sinthappa'n'ni, ma'n'ninaal athai moodakkadavan.

sakala maamsaththukkum iraththam uyiraayirukki'rathu; iraththam jeevanukkuch samaanam; aakaiyaal entha maamsaththin iraththaththaiyum pusikkavea'ndaam; sakala maamsaththin uyirum athin iraththanthaanea; athaip pusikki'ra evanum a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'ru israveal puththirarukkuch sonnean.

thaanaay i'ranthupoanathaiyaavathu, pee'ru'ndathaiyaavathu, pusiththavan evanum, avan sutheasiyaanaalum paratheasiyaanaalum, than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, tha'n'neeril muzhuki, saayangkaalamattum theettaayiruppaanaaka; pinpu suththamaayiruppaan.
avan than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkaamalum, snaanampa'n'naamalum irunthaal, than akkiramaththaich sumappaan en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththirarukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.

neengka'l kudiyiruntha ekipthutheasaththaarudaiya seykaiyinpadi seyyaamalum, naan ungka'lai azhaiththuppoaki'ra kaanaan theasaththaarudaiya seykaiyinpadi seyyaamalum, avarka'ludaiya mu'raimaika'linpadi nadavaamalum,
ennudaiya niyaayangka'linpadi seythu, ennudaiya katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu nadavungka'l; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
aakaiyaal en katta'laika'laiyum en niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'lakkadaveerka'l; avaika'linpadi seyki'ravan evanum avaika'laal pizhaippaan; naan karththar.
oruvanum thanakku nerungkina inamaakiya oruththiyai nirvaa'namaakkumpadi ava'laich searalaakaathu; naan karththar.
un thakappanaiyaavathu un thaayaiyaavathu nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'l un thaayaanava'l; ava'lai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu.
un thakappanudaiya manaiviyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; athu un thakappanudaiya nirvaa'nam.
un thakappanukkaavathu un thaaykkaavathu veettilaakilum pu'raththilaakilum pi'rantha kumaaraththiyaakiya un sakoathariyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu.
un kumaaranudaiya maka'laiyaavathu un kumaaraththiyinudaiya maka'laiyaavathu nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; athu unnudaiya nirvaa'nam.
un thakappanudaiya manaiviyinidaththil un thakappanukkup pi'rantha kumaaraththiyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'l unakkuch sakoathari.
un thakappanudaiya sakoathariyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'l un thakappanukku nerungkina inamaanava'l.
un thaayinudaiya sakoathariyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'l un thaaykku nerungkina inamaanava'l.
un thakappanudaiya sakoatharanai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; avan manaiviyaich searaayaaka; ava'l un thakappanudaiya sakoathari.
un marumaka'lai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'l un kumaaranukku manaivi, ava'lai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu.
un sakoatharanudaiya manaiviyai nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; athu un sakoatharanudaiya nirvaa'nam.

oru sthireeyaiyum ava'l maka'laiyum nirvaa'namaakkalaakaathu; ava'ludaiya kumaararin maka'laiyum ava'ludaiya kumaaraththiyin maka'laiyum nirvaa'namaakkumpadi vivaakampa'n'nalaakaathu; ivarka'l ava'lukku nerungkina inamaanavarka'l; athu mu'raikeadu.
un manaivi uyiroadirukkaiyil, ava'lukku upaththiravamaaka ava'l sakoathariyaiyum nirvaa'namaakkumporuttu ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nalaakaathu.
sthireeyaanava'l soothakaththaal vilakkaththilirukkaiyil, ava'lai nirvaa'namaakka ava'loadea searaathea.
pi'ranudaiya manaiviyoadea searumpadi sayaniththu, ava'laal unnaith theettuppaduththikko'l'lavea'ndaam.
nee un santhathiyil yaaraiyaakilum moa'leakukken'ru theekkadakkumpadi idangkodaathea; un theavanudaiya naamaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaathea; naan karththar.
pe'n'noadu samyoakam pa'n'nuki'rathupoala aa'noadea samyoakam pa'n'navea'ndaam; athu aruvaruppaanathu.

yaathoru mirukaththoadum nee pu'narchchiseythu, athinaalea unnaith theettuppaduththavea'ndaam; sthireeyaanava'l mirukaththoadea pu'narumpadi atha'rku munpaaka ni'rkalaakaathu; athu aruvaruppaana thaa'rumaa'ru.

ivaika'lil on'rinaalum ungka'laith theettuppaduththaathirungka'l; naan ungka'l munnin'ru thuraththividuki'ra jaathika'l ivaika'lellaavat'rinaalum thangka'laith theettuppaduththiyirukki'raarka'l; theasamum theettuppaduththappattirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal athin akkiramaththai visaarippean; theasam than kudika'laik kakkippoadum.
intha aruvaruppuka'laiyellaam ungka'lukkumun iruntha anthath theasaththin manithar seythathinaalea theasam theettaayit'ru.
ippozhuthum ungka'lukku mun iruntha jaathika'lai theasam kakkippoattathupoala, neengka'l athaith theettuppaduththumpoathu athu ungka'laiyum kakkippoadaathapadikku,
neengka'l en katta'laika'laiyum en niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'ndu, theasaththilea pi'ranthavanaanaalum ungka'l naduvea thangkuki'ra anniyanaanaalum intha aruvaruppuka'lil on'raiyum seyyavea'ndaam.
ippadippatta aruvaruppaanavaika'lil yaathon'rai yaaraavathu seythaal, seytha antha aaththumaakka'l janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaarka'l.

aakaiyaal ungka'lukkumun seyyappatta aruvaruppaana mu'raimaika'lil yaathon'rai neengka'l seythu, avaika'laal ungka'laith theettuppaduththikko'l'laathapadikku en katta'laiyaik kaikko'l'lungka'l; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththirarin sapai anaiththoadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: ungka'l theavanum karththarumaakiya naan parisuththar, aakaiyaal neengka'lum parisuththaraayirungka'l.
ungka'lil avanavan thanthan thaaykkum thanthan thakappanukkum payanthirukkavum, en oayvunaadka'lai aasarikkavumkadaveerka'l; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
vikkirakangka'lai naadaamalum, vaarppikkappatta theyvangka'lai ungka'lukku u'ndaakkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
neengka'l samaathaanapaliyaik karththarukkuch seluththinaal, athai manoa'rchaakamaaych seluththungka'l.
neengka'l athaich seluththuki'ra naa'lilum ma'runaa'lilum athaip pusikkavea'ndum; moon'raam naa'lmattum meethiyaanathu akkiniyilea sutterikkappadakkadavathu.
moon'raam naa'lil athil eathaakilum pusikkappattaal aruvaruppaayirukkum; athu angkikarikkappadamaattaathu.
athaip pusikki'ravan karththarukkup parisuththamaanathaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinapadiyaal avan than akkiramaththaich sumanthu, than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.
neengka'l theasaththin payirai a'rukkumpoathu, un vayalin oaraththilirukki'rathaith theera a'rukkaamalum, sinthikkidakki'ra kathirka'laip po'rukkaamalum,

un thiraadchaththoattaththilea pin a'ruppai a'rukkaamalum, athilea sinthikkidakki'ra pazhangka'laip po'rukkaamalum, avaika'lai e'liyavanukkum paratheasikkum vittuviduvaayaaka; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
neengka'l ka'lavuseyyaamalum, vagnchanaipa'n'naamalum, oruvarukkoruvar poy sollaamalum irungka'l.
en naamaththaikko'ndu poyyaa'naiyiduki'rathinaal, ungka'l theavanudaiya naamaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; naan karththar.
pi'ranai odukkaamalum ko'l'laiyidaamalum iruppaayaaka; koolikkaaranudaiya kooli vidiya'rkaalammattum unnidaththil irukkalaakaathu.
sevidanai ninthiyaamalum, kurudanukku munnea thadukkalai vaiyaamalum, un theavanukkup payanthiruppaayaaka; naan karththar.
niyaayavisaara'naiyil aniyaayam seyyaathirungka'l; si'riyavanukku mukathaadchi'niyam seyyaamalum, periyavanudaiya mukaththukku agnchaamalum, neethiyaakap pi'ranukku niyaayantheerppaayaaka.
un janangka'lukku'l'lea angkumingkum koa'lsollith thiriyaayaaka; pi'ranudaiya iraththappazhikku udpadavea'ndaam; naan karththar.
un sakoatharanai un u'l'laththil pakaiyaayaaka; pi'ranmeal paavam sumaraathapadikku avanai eppadiyum kadinthuko'l'lavea'ndum.
pazhikkuppazhi vaangkaamalum, un janappuththirarmeal po'raamaiko'l'laamalum, unnil nee anpukooruvathupoal pi'ranilum anpukooruvaayaaka; naan karththar.

en katta'laika'laik kaikko'lveerka'laaka; un mirukajeevanka'lai vea'rujaathiyoadea poliyavidaayaaka; un vayalilea vevvea'ru vakaiyaana vithaika'laik kalanthu vithaiyaayaaka; sa'nalnoolum kampa'linoolum kalantha vasthiraththai uduththaathiruppaayaaka.

oruvanukku adimaiyaanava'l oru purushanukku niyamikkappattava'laayirunthu, mut'rilum meedkappadaamalum thannichchaiyaay vidappadaamalumirukka, ava'loadea oruvan samyoakamaaych sayanampa'n'ninaal, avarka'l kolaiseyyappadaamal, adikkappadavea'ndum; ava'l suyaatheenamu'l'lava'l alla.
avan than kut'ranivaara'napaliyaay aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil oru aattukkadaavaik ko'nduvarakkadavan.
athinaalea aasaariyan avan seytha paavaththinimiththam avanukkaakak karththarudaiya sannithiyil paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu avan seytha paavam avanukku mannikkappadum.

neengka'l anthath theasaththil vanthu, pusikkaththakka kanika'laith tharuki'ra palavitha marangka'lai naattinapinpu, avaika'lin kanika'lai viruththaseathanamillaathavaika'len'ru e'n'nuveerka'laaka; moon'ru varusham athu pusikkappadaamal, viruththaseathanamillaathathaay ungka'lukku e'n'nappadavea'ndum.
pinpu naalaam varushaththilea avaika'lin kanika'lellaam karththarukkuth thuthiseluththuki'ratha'rkeat'ra parisuththamaayirukkum.
ainthaam varushaththilea avaika'lin kanika'laip pusikkalaam; ippadi avaika'lin palan ungka'lukkup perukum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
yaathon'raiyum iraththaththudan pusikkavea'ndaam. ku'rikea'laamalum, naa'lpaaraamalum iruppeerka'laaka.
ungka'l thalaimayiraich sut'ri othukkaamalum, thaadiyin oarangka'laik kaththarikkaamalum,
seththavanukkaaka ungka'l sareeraththaik kee'rikko'l'laamalum, adaiyaa'lamaana ezhuththuka'lai ungka'lmeal kuththikko'l'laamalum iruppeerka'laaka; naan karththar.
theasaththaar veasiththanampa'n'ni theasamengkum mu'raikeadaana paavam ni'raiyaathapadikku un kumaaraththiyai veasiththanampa'n'na viduki'rathinaalea parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaayaaka.
en oayvunaadka'lai aasariththu, en parisuththa sthalaththaikku'riththup payapakthiyaayiruppeerka'laaka; naan karththar.
agnchanampaarkki'ravarka'lai naadi, ku'risolluki'ravarka'laith theadaathirungka'l; avarka'laalea theettuppadavea'ndaam; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
naraiththavanukku munpaaka ezhunthu, muthirvayathu'l'lavan mukaththaik kanampa'n'ni, un theavanukkup payappaduvaayaaka; naan karththar.
yaathoru anniyan ungka'l theasaththil ungka'loadea thangkinaal, avanaich si'rumaippaduththavea'ndaam.

ungka'lidaththil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra anniyanaich sutheasipoala e'n'ni, neengka'l ungka'lil anpukooruki'rathupoala avanilum anpukooruveerka'laaka; neengka'lum ekipthutheasaththil anniyaraayiruntheerka'lea; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
niyaayavisaara'naiyilum, a'lavilum, ni'raiyilum, padiyilum aniyaayam seyyaathiruppeerka'laaka.

sumuththiraiyaana tharaasum, sumuththiraiyaana ni'raikallum, sumuththiraiyaana marakkaalum, sumuththiraiyaana padiyum ungka'lukku irukkavea'ndum; naan ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
aakaiyaal ennudaiya katta'laika'l yaavaiyum ennudaiya niyaayangka'l yaavaiyum kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi nadakkakkadaveerka'l; naan karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

pinnum nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal puththirarilum isravealil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra anniyarka'lilum evanaakilum than santhathiyil oru pi'l'laiyai moa'leakukkuk koduththaal, avan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; theasaththin janangka'l avanmeal kalle'riyavea'ndum.

avan en parisuththa sthalaththaith theettuppaduththi, en parisuththa naamaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkumpadikku, than santhathiyil oru pi'l'laiyai moa'leakukkuk koduththathinaalea, naan appadippattavanukku viroathamaaka ethirththunin'ru, avanaith than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndu poakappa'n'nuvean.
avan than santhathiyil oru pi'l'laiyai moa'leakukkuk kodukkumpoathu, theasaththin janangka'l avanaik kolaiseyyaathapadikkuk ka'nsaadaiyaayirunthaal,

naan antha manithanukkum avan kudumpaththukkum viroathamaaka ethirththunin'ru, avanaiyum, avan pi'rakea moa'leakai vipasaaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'rina yaavaraiyum, thangka'l janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoakappa'n'nuvean.

agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum pinthodarnthu soarampoaka entha aaththumaa avarka'lai naaduki'raanoa, antha aaththumaavukku viroathamaaka ethirththunin'ru, avanaith than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoakappa'n'nuvean.
aathalaal neengka'l ungka'laip parisuththappaduththip parisuththaraayirungka'l; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
en katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu nadavungka'l; naan ungka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar.
than thakappanaiyaavathu than thaayaiyaavathu sapikki'ra evanum kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; avan than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum sapiththaan, avan iraththappazhi avanmeal iruppathaaka.
oruvan pi'ranudaiya manaiviyoadea vipasaaram seythaal, pi'ran manaiviyoadea vipasaaram seytha antha vipasaaranum antha vipasaariyum kolaiseyyappadakkadavarka'l.
than thakappan manaiviyoadea sayanikki'ravan than thakappanai nirvaa'namaakkinapadiyaal, iruvarum kolaiseyyappadakkadavarka'l; avarka'l iraththappazhi avarka'lmeal iruppathaaka.
oruvan than marumaka'loadea sayaniththaal, iruvarum kolaiseyyappadakkadavarka'l; aruvaruppaana thaa'rumaa'ru pa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l iraththappazhi avarka'lmeal iruppathaaka.
