oruvan pe'n'noadea samyoakam pa'n'nuki'rathupoala aa'noadea samyoakampa'n'ninaal, aruvaruppaana kaariyam seytha avviruvarum kolaiseyyappadakkadavarka'l; avarka'l iraththappazhi avarka'lmeal iruppathaaka.
oruvan oru sthireeyaiyum ava'l thaayaiyum padaiththaal, athu mu'raikeadu; ivvitha mu'raikeadu ungka'lukku'l iraathapadikku, avanaiyum avarka'laiyum akkiniyil sutterikkavea'ndum.
oruvan mirukaththoadea pu'narnthaal, avan kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; antha mirukaththaiyum kollakkadaveerka'l.

oru sthiree yaathoru mirukaththoadea searnthu sayaniththaal, antha sthireeyaiyum antha mirukaththaiyum kollakkadavaay; irujeevanum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; avaika'lin iraththappazhi avaika'linmeal iruppathaaka.

oruvan than thakappanukkaavathu than thaaykkaavathu kumaaraththiyaayirukki'ra than sakoathariyaich searththukko'ndu, avan ava'ludaiya nirvaa'naththaiyum, ava'l avanudaiya nirvaa'naththaiyum paarththaal, athu paathakam; avarka'l thangka'l janangka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka a'ruppu'ndu poakakkadavarka'l; avan than sakoathariyai nirvaa'nappaduththinaan; avan than akkiramaththaich sumappaan.

oruvan soothakasthireeyoadea sayaniththu, ava'lai nirvaa'namaakkinaal, avan ava'ludaiya uthira oot'raith thi'ranthu, ava'lum than uthira oot'rai ve'lippaduththinapadiyaal, iruvarum thangka'l janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoakavea'ndum.

un thaayinudaiya sakoathariyaiyum un thakappanudaiya sakoathariyaiyum nirvaa'namaakkaayaaka, appadippattavan than nerungkiya inaththai avamaanamaakkinaan; avarka'l thangka'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarka'l.

oruvan than thakappanin sakoatharanudaiya manaiviyoadea sayaniththaal, avan than thakappanin sakoatharanai nirvaa'namaakkinaan; avarka'l thangka'l paavaththaich sumappaarka'l, santhaanamillaamal saavaarka'l.
oruvan than sakoatharan manaiviyai vivaakampa'n'ninaal, athu asuththam; than sakoatharanai nirvaa'namaakkinaan, avarka'l santhaanamat'riruppaarka'l.

aakaiyaal neengka'l kudiyiruppatha'rkaaka naan ungka'laik ko'ndupoaki'ra theasam ungka'laik kakkippoadaathapadikku, neengka'l en katta'laika'l yaavaiyum ennudaiya niyaayangka'l yaavaiyum kaikko'ndu nadavungka'l.
naan ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththividuki'ra janaththinudaiya vazhipaaduka'lil nadavaathirungka'l; avarka'l ippadippatta kaariyangka'laiyellaam seythapadiyaal naan avarka'lai aroasiththean.

neengka'l avarka'l theasaththaich suthantharippeerka'l en'ru ungka'loadea sonnean; paalum theanum oaduki'ra antha theasaththai ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduppean; ungka'lai mat'ra janangka'laivittup piriththeduththa ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar naanea.

aakaiyaal suththamaana mirukangka'lukkum asuththamaana mirukangka'lukkum, suththamaana pa'ravaika'lukkum asuththamaana pa'ravaika'lukkum neengka'l viththiyaasampa'n'ni, naan ungka'lukkuth theettaaka e'n'nachsolli vilakkina mirukangka'laalum pa'ravaika'laalum tharaiyilea ooruki'ra yaathoru piraa'nika'laalum ungka'lai aruvaruppaakkaathiruppeerka'laaka.

karththaraakiya naan parisuththaraayirukki'rapadiyinaalea neengka'lum enakkeat'ra parisuththavaanka'laayiruppeerka'laaka; neengka'l ennudaiyavarka'laayirukkumpadikku, ungka'lai mat'ra janangka'laivittup piriththeduththean.

agnchanampaarkki'ravarka'lum ku'risolluki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'ra purushanaakilum sthireeyaakilum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; avarka'lmeal kalle'rivaarka'laaka; avarka'l iraththappazhi avarka'lmeal irukkakkadavathu en'ru sol en'raar.

pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyarka'lil oruvanum than janaththaaril i'ranthupoana yaathoruvarukkaakath thangka'laith theettuppaduththalaakaathen'ru avarka'loadea sol.
than thaayum, than thakappanum, than kumaaranum, than kumaaraththiyum, than sakoatharanum,
purushanukku vaazhkkaippadaamal thannidaththilirukki'ra kanniyaasthireeyaana than sakoathariyumaakiya thanakku nerungkina inamaana ivarka'ludaiya saavukkaakath theettuppadalaam.
than janaththaaril periyavanaakiya avan vea'roruvarukkaakavum thannaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkith theettuppaduththalaakaathu.
avarka'l thangka'l thalaiyai mottaiyadikkaamalum, thangka'l thaadiyin oarangka'laich siraiththuppoadaamalum, thangka'l theakaththaik kee'rikko'l'laamalum iruppaarka'laaka.

thangka'l theavanudaiya naamaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaamal avarukkeat'ra parisuththaraayiruppaarka'laaka; avarka'l karththarin thakanapalika'laiyum thangka'l theavanudaiya appaththaiyum seluththuki'ravarka'laathalaal parisuththaraayirukkavea'ndum.

avarka'l thangka'l theavanukkup parisuththamaanavarka'l, aakaiyaal veasiyaiyaakilum ka'rpukkulainthava'laiyaakilum vivaakampa'n'naarka'laaka; than purushanaalea tha'l'lappatta sthireeyaiyum vivaakampa'n'naarka'laaka.

avan theavanudaiya appaththaich seluththuki'rapadiyaal nee avanaip parisuththappaduththavea'ndum; ungka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththaraakiya naan parisuththaraayirukki'rapadiyaal, avanum unakku munpaakap parisuththanaayiruppaanaaka.

aasaariyanudaiya kumaaraththi veasiththanampa'n'ni, thannaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkinaal, ava'l than thakappanaiyum parisuththak kulaichchalaakkuki'raa'l; ava'l akkiniyilea sutterikkappadakkadava'l.

than sakoathararukku'l'lea pirathaana aasaariyanaaka than sirasil apisheakathailam vaarkkappattavanum, avanukkuriya vasthirangka'laith tharikkumpadi pirathishdaipa'n'nappattavanumaayirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than paakaiyai edukkaamalum, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'l'laamalum,
pireatham kidakkum idaththil poakaamalum, than thakappanukkaakavum than thaaykkaakavum thannaith theettuppaduththikko'l'laamalum,

parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu pu'rappadaamalum, than theavanudaiya parisuththa sthalaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaamalum iruppaanaaka; avanudaiya theavanin apisheakathailam ennum kireedam avanmeal irukki'rathea; naan karththar.
kannikaiyaayirukki'ra pe'n'nai avan vivaakampa'n'navea'ndum.
vithavaiyaiyaanaalum tha'l'lappattava'laiyaanaalum ka'rpukulainthava'laiyaanaalum veasiyaiyaanaalum vivaakampa'n'naamal, than janangka'lukku'l'lea oru kannikaiyai vivaakampa'n'nakkadavan.
avan than viththaith than janangka'lukku'l'lea parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaamal iruppaanaaka; naan avanaip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee aaroanoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: un santhathiyaarukku'l'lea angkaveenamu'l'lavan thalaimu'raithoa'rum theavanudaiya appaththaich seluththumpadi searalaakaathu.
angkaveenamu'l'la oruvanum a'nukalaakaathu; kurudanaanaalum, sappaa'niyaanaalum, ku'rukina allathu nee'nda avayavamu'l'lavanaanaalum,
kaalodinthavanaanaalum, kaiyodinthavanaanaalum,
koonanaanaalum, ku'l'lanaanaalum, poovizhuntha ka'n'nanaanaalum, so'riyanaanaalum, asa'ru'l'lavanaanaalum, vithai nasungkinavanaanaalum a'nukalaakaathu.

aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin santhathiyaaril angkaveenamu'l'la oruvanum karththarin thakanapalika'laich seluththach searalaakaathu; avan angkaveenamu'l'lavanaakaiyaal, avan theavanudaiya appaththaich seluththach searalaakaathu.
avan than theavanudaiya appamaakiya makaa parisuththamaanavaika'lilum mat'ra parisuththamaanavaika'lilum pusikkalaam.

aanaalum avan angkaveenamu'l'lavanaakaiyaal, avan en parisuththa sthalangka'laip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaathapadikkuth thiraikku'l'lea poakaamalum palipeedaththa'ndaiyil searaamalum iruppaanaaka; naan avarka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
moasea ivaika'lai aaroanoadum avan kumaararoadum israveal puththirar anaivaroadum sonnaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

israveal puththirar enakken'ru niyamiththuch seluththuki'ra parisuththa vasthukka'laikku'riththu aaroanum avan kumaararum en parisuththa naamaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaay irukkavea'ndum en'ru avarka'loadea sol; naan karththar.

an'riyum nee avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l thalaimu'raika'lilu'l'la santhathiyaaril evanaakilum thaan theettuppattirukkumpoathu, israveal puththirar karththarukku niyamiththuch seluththuki'ra parisuththamaanavaika'la'ndaiyil searnthaal, antha aaththumaa en sannithiyil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan en'ru sol; naan karththar.

aaroanin santhathiyaaril evan kushdaroakiyoa, evan piramiyamu'l'lavanoa, avan suththamaakummattum parisuththamaanavaika'lil pusikkalaakaathu; pi'naththinaalea theettaanavaika'lil ethaiyaakilum thottavanum, inthiriyangkazhinthavanum,
theettuppaduththuki'ra yaathoru oorum piraa'niyaiyaakilum theettu'l'la manithanaiyaakilum thottavanum,
saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; avan jalaththil snaanampa'n'numvaraikkum parisuththamaanavaika'lil pusikkalaakaathu.
sooriyan asthamiththapinpu suththamaayiruppaan; athanpinpu avan parisuththamaanavaika'lil pusikkalaam; athu avanudaiya aakaaram.
thaanaaych seththathaiyum pee'ru'ndathaiyum avan pusikki'rathinaalea thannaith theettuppaduththalaakaathu; naan karththar.

aakaiyaal parisuththamaanathai avarka'l parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuki'rathinaalea, paavam sumanthu athinimiththam saakaathapadikku, en katta'laiyaik kaakkakkadavarka'l; naan avarka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar.
anniyan oruvanum parisuththamaanavaika'lil pusikkalaakaathu; aasaariyan veettil thangkiyirukki'ravanum koolivealai seyki'ravanum parisuththamaanathil pusikkalaakaathu.
aasaariyanaal pa'naththukkuk ko'l'lappattavanum, avan veettilea pi'ranthavanum avanudaiya aakaaraththil pusikkalaam.
aasaariyanudaiya kumaaraththi anniyanukku vaazhkkaippattaal, ava'l parisuththamaanavaika'lin padaippilea pusikkalaakaathu.

vithavaiyaayppoana, allathu tha'l'lappattava'laana aasaariyanudaiya kumaaraththi pi'l'laiyillaathirunthu, than thakappan veettil thannudaiya i'lavayathil irunthathupoalath thirumpavanthu irunthaa'leayaakil, ava'l than thakappan aakaaraththil pusikkalaam; anniyanaakiya oruvanum athil pusikkalaakaathu.
oruvan a'riyaamal parisuththamaanathil pusiththathu'ndaanaal, avan athilea ainthil oru pangku athikamaayk koottip parisuththamaanavaika'loadungkooda aasaariyanukkuk kodukkakkadavan.
avarka'l karththarukkup padaikki'ra israveal puththirarudaiya parisuththamaanavaika'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkaamalum,
avaika'laip pusikki'rathinaal avarka'lmeal kut'ramaana akkiramaththaich sumarappa'n'naamalum iruppaarka'laaka; naan avarka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee aaroanoadum avan kumaararoadum israveal puththirar anaivaroadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal kudumpaththaarilum isravealil thangkuki'ra anniyarka'lilum thangka'ludaiya poruththanaika'linpadiyaakilum u'rchaakaththinpadiyaakilum sarvaangka thakanapalika'laakak karththarukkuth thangka'l kaa'nikkaiyai evarka'l seluththappoaki'raarka'loa,
avarka'l thangka'l manathinpadiyea maaduka'lilaakilum aaduka'lilaakilum ve'l'laaduka'lilaakilum pazhuthat'ra oru aa'naip pidiththuvanthu seluththuvaarka'laaka.
pazhuthu'l'la on'raiyum seluththa vea'ndaam; athu ungka'lnimiththam angkikarikkappaduvathillai.

oruvan viseashiththa poruththanaiyaayaavathu, u'rchaakamaayaavathu, karththarukku maaduka'lilaakilum aaduka'lilaakilum samaathaanapalika'laich seluththappoanaal, athu angkikarikkappadumpadi, oru pazhuthumillaamal uththamamaayirukkavea'ndum.

kurudu, nerisal, mudam, kazhalai, so'ri, pu'n muthaliya pazhuthu'l'lavaika'lai neengka'l karththarukkuch seluththaamalum, avaika'laalea karththarukkup palipeedaththinmeal thakanapaliyidaamalum iruppeerka'laaka.
nee'nda allathu ku'rukina avayavamu'l'la maattaiyum aattaiyum nee u'rchaakapaliyaaka idalaam; poruththanaikkaaka athu angkikarikkappadamaattaathu.

vithai nasungkinathaiyum no'rungkinathaiyum kaayampattathaiyum vithai a'rukkappattathaiyum neengka'l karththarukkuch seluththaamalum, avaika'lai ungka'l theasaththilea paliyidaamalum iruppeerka'laaka.

anniya puththiran kaiyilum ippadippattathai vaangki, theavanukku appamaakach seluththeerka'laaka; avaika'lin keadum pazhuthum avaika'lil irukki'rathu; avaika'l ungka'lukkaaka angkikarikkappaduvathillai en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

oru kan'raavathu semma'riyaattuk kuttiyaavathu ve'l'laattukkuttiyaavathu pi'ranthaal, athu eazhunaa'l than thaayinidaththil irukkakkadavathu; ettaam naa'lmuthal athu karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaaka angkikarikkappadum.
pasuvaiyum athin kan'raiyum, aattaiyum athin kuttiyaiyum orea naa'lil kollavea'ndaam.
karththarukku sthoaththirapaliyaich seluththuveerka'laanaal manappoorvamaay athaich seluththuveerka'laaka.
annaa'lileathaan athu pusikkappadavea'ndum; vidiya'rkaalammattum neengka'l athil on'rum meethiyaaka vaikkavea'ndaam; naan karththar.
neengka'l en katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyyakkadaveerka'l; naan karththar.
en parisuththa naamaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkaathiruppeerka'laaka; naan israveal puththirar naduvea parisuththar en'ru mathikkappaduvean; naan ungka'laip parisuththamaakkuki'ra karththar.
naan ungka'lukkuth theavanaayiruppatha'rkaaka, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninean; naan karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: sapaikoodivanthu parisuththa naadka'laaka aasarikkumpadi, neengka'l koo'ravea'ndiya karththarudaiya pa'ndikai naadka'laavana:

aa'runaa'lum vealai seyyavea'ndum; eazhaamnaa'l parisuththa sapaikooduthalaana oayvunaa'l, athil oru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam; athu ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilellaam karththarukken'ru oaynthirukkum naa'laayiruppathaaka.
sapaikoodivanthu parisuththamaay aasarikkumpadi, neengka'l ku'riththakaalaththil koo'ravea'ndiya karththarin pa'ndikaika'laavana:
muthalaam maatham pathinaalaam theathi anthinearamaaki'ra vea'laiyilea karththarin paskaa pa'ndikaiyum,
antha maatham pathinainthaam theathiyilea, karththarukkup pu'lippillaa appap pa'ndikaiyumaay irukkum; eazhunaa'l pu'lippillaa appangka'laip pusikkavea'ndum.
muthalaam naa'l ungka'lukkup parisuththamaana sapaikooduthal; athilea saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam.
eazhunaa'lum karththarukkuth thakanapaliyidavea'ndum; eazhaamnaa'l parisuththamaana sapaikooduthal; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'lukkuk kodukkum theasaththil neengka'l poaych searnthu, athin ve'l'laa'nmaiyai a'rukkumpoathu, ungka'l a'ruppin mutha'rpalanaakiya oru kathirkkattai aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvarakkadaveerka'l.
ungka'lukkaaka athu angkikarikkappadumpadi, aasaariyan anthak kathirkkattai oayvunaa'lukku ma'runaa'lil karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattavea'ndum.
neengka'l anthak kathirkkattai asaivaattum naa'lil karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkuttiyaiyum,

karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaaka oru marakkaalilea paththil ira'ndu pangkaanathum e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavaakiya poajanapaliyaiyum, thiraadchappazharasaththilea kaa'rpadiyaakiya paanapaliyaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.

ungka'l theavanukkuk kaa'nikkaiyai neengka'l ko'nduvarum annaa'lmattum, appamum vaattiya kathirum pachchaikkathirum pusiyeerka'laaka; ithu ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilellaam ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum sellavea'ndiya niththiya katta'lai.
neengka'l asaivaattum kathirkkattaik ko'nduvarum oayvunaa'lukku ma'runaa'l mutha'rko'ndu e'n'naththuvakki, eazhuvaarangka'l ni'raivea'rinapinpu,
eazhaam oayvunaa'lukku ma'runaa'laakiya aimpathaam naa'lmattum e'n'ni, karththarukkup puthiya poajanapaliyaich seluththakkadaveerka'l.

neengka'l oru marakkaalilea paththil ira'ndu pangkaakiya melliya maavilea pu'lippaakap paakampa'n'nappatta asaivaattum kaa'nikkaiyaayirukki'ra ira'ndu appangka'lai ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilirunthu karththarukken'ru mutha'rpalanaakak ko'nduvanthu,

appaththoadeakoodak karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum, oru kaa'laiyaiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaaka avaika'lukku aduththa poajanapaliyaiyum, paanapalika'laiyum seluththi,
ve'l'laaduka'lil oru kadaavaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, oru vayathaana ira'ndu aattukkuttika'laich samaathaana paliyaakavum idakkadaveerka'l.

avaika'lai aasaariyan mutha'rpalanaakiya appaththoadum ira'ndu aattukkuttika'loadungkoodak karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattum paliyaaka asaivaattakkadavan; karththarukkup parisuththamaakiya avaika'l aasaariyanudaiyavaika'laakum.

antha naa'l ungka'lukkuch sapai koodum parisuththa naa'l en'ru koo'ravea'ndum; athilea saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu; ithu ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilellaam ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum sellavea'ndiya niththiya katta'lai.

ungka'l theasaththin ve'l'laa'nmaiyai neengka'l a'rukkaiyil, vayalin oaraththil irukki'rathai mut'rilum a'rukkaamalum, sinthikkidakki'ra kathirka'laip po'rukkaamalum, e'liyavanukkum paratheasikkum avaika'lai vittuvidavea'ndum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: ungka'lukku eazhaam maatham muthalaantheathi ekkaa'lach saththaththaal gnaapakakku'riyaakak ko'ndaaduki'ra pa'ndikai enki'ra sapai koodum parisuththa oayvunaa'laay iruppathaaka.
athilea saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyaamal, karththarukkuth thakanapali seluththavea'ndum en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

antha eazhaam maatham paththaantheathi ungka'lukkup paavanivirththi seyyum naa'lum sapaikoodum parisuththanaa'lumaayiruppathaaka; appozhuthu neengka'l ungka'l aaththumaakka'laith thaazhmaippaduththi, karththarukkuth thakanapali seluththakkadaveerka'l.
antha naa'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyappadum paavanivaara'na naa'laayirukki'rapadiyaal, athilea yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam.
annaa'lilea thannaith thaazhmaippaduththaatha entha aaththumaavum than janaththil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan.
annaa'lilea oru aaththumaa yaathoru vealaiyaich seythaal, antha aaththumaavai avan janaththin naduvilea vaikkaamal azhippean.
athil neengka'l entha vealaiyum seyyaathiruppathu ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilellaam ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum sellavea'ndiya niththiya katta'lai.

athu ungka'lukku viseashiththa oayvunaa'l; athil ungka'l aaththumaakka'laith thaazhmaippaduththavea'ndum; antha maathaththin onpathaantheathi saayangkaalam thuvakki, ma'runaa'l saayangkaalamattum ungka'l oayvai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: antha eazhaam maatham pathinainthaantheathimuthal eazhunaa'la'lavum karththarukku aasarikkum koodaarappa'ndikaiyaayiruppathaaka.
muthalaam naa'l sapaikoodum parisuththa naa'l; athilea saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu.

eazhunaa'lum karththarukkuth thakanapali seluththakkadaveerka'l; ettaam naa'l ungka'lukkuch sapaikoodum parisuththanaa'l; athilea karththarukkuth thakanapali seluththakkadaveerka'l; athu aasarikkappadum naa'l; athilea saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam.
neengka'l karththarudaiya oayvunaadka'lil seluththuvathum thavira, neengka'l karththarukkup padaikki'ra ungka'l ellaak kaa'nikkaika'lum poruththanaika'lum u'rchaakapalika'lum thavira,

neengka'l anthantha naa'lukkuththakkathaayk karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapali, poajanapali, iraththapali, paanapali muthalaanavaika'laich seluththumpadi sapaikoodivanthu, parisuththamaay aasarippatha'rkaaka neengka'l koo'ravea'ndiya karththarudaiya pa'ndikaika'l ivaika'lea.

nilaththin palanai neengka'l searththuvaikkum eazhaam maatham pathinainthaantheathimuthal karththarukkup pa'ndikaiyai eazhunaa'l aasarikkakkadaveerka'l; muthalaam naa'lilum oayvu; ettaam naa'lilum oayvu.

muthal naa'lilea alangkaaramaana virudchangka'lin kanika'laiyum peareechchin oalaika'laiyum thazhaiththirukki'ra virudchangka'lin ki'laika'laiyum aat'ralarika'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil eazhunaa'lum makizhchchiyaayirungka'l.

varushanthoa'rum eazhunaa'l karththarukku inthap pa'ndikaiyai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l; ithu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum sellavea'ndiya niththiya katta'lai; eazhaam maathaththil athai aasarikkavea'ndum.
naan israveal puththirarai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninapoathu, avarka'laik koodaarangka'lil kudiyirukkappa'n'ninathai ungka'l santhathiyaar a'riyumpadikku,
eazhunaa'l koodaarangka'lil kudiyirukkakkadaveerka'l; isravealil pi'ranthavarka'l ellaarum koodaarangka'lil vaasampa'n'navea'ndum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
appadiyea moasea karththarudaiya pa'ndikaika'lai israveal puththirarukkuth theriviththaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
kuththuvi'lakku eppozhuthum erinthuko'ndirukkumpadi atha'rkaaka idiththup pizhintha the'livaana oliva e'n'neyai israveal puththirar unnidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyidu.

aasarippuk koodaaraththil saadchisannithiyin thiraikku ve'lippu'ramaaka aaroan athai eppozhuthum saayangkaalam thodangki vidiya'rkaalammattum karththarudaiya sannithiyil eriyumpadi eat'rakkadavan; ithu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum sellavea'ndiya niththiya katta'lai.
avan eppozhuthum karththarudaiya sannithiyil parisuththamaana kuththuvi'lakkinmeal irukki'ra vi'lakkuka'lai eriya vaikkakkadavan.
an'riyum nee melliya maavai eduththu, athaip pannira'ndu appangka'laakach suduvaayaaka; ovvoru appam marakkaalilea paththil ira'ndupangku maavinaal seyyappadavea'ndum.
avaika'lai nee karththarudaiya sannithiyil parisuththamaana meajaiyinmeal ira'ndu adukkaaka, ovvoru adukkil avvaa'ru appam irukkumpadiyaaka vaiththu,
ovvoru adukkinidaththil suththamaana thoopavarkkam poadakkadavaay; athu appaththoadirunthu, gnaapakakku'riyaakak karththarukkeat'ra thakanapaliyaayirukkum.
appaththai niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka israveal puththirar kaiyilea vaangki, oayvunaa'lthoa'rum karththarudaiya sannithiyil adukkivaikkakkadavan.

athu aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum searum; athaip parisuththa idaththilea pusikkakkadavarka'l; niththiya katta'laiyaakak karththarukku idappadum thakanapalika'lil athu avanukku makaa parisuththamaayirukkum en'raar.

akkaalaththilea israveal jaathiyaana sthireekkum ekipthiya purushanukkum pi'rantha puththiranaakiya oruvan israveal puththiraroadeakoodap pu'rappattu vanthirunthaan; ivanum isravealanaakiya oru manithanum paa'layaththilea sa'ndaipa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu israveal jaathiyaana antha sthireeyin makan karththarin naamaththai ninthiththuth thooshiththaan. avanai moaseayinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l. avan thaayin pear seloamith; ava'l thaa'n koaththiraththaanaakiya thipriyin kumaaraththi.
karththarin vaakkinaalea thangka'lukku uththaravu varumattum, avanaik kaavalpaduththinaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:
thooshiththavanaip paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoa; keattavarka'l ellaarum thangka'l kaika'lai avan thalaiyinmeal vaippaarka'laaka; pinpu sapaiyaar ellaarum avanaik kalle'riyakkadavarka'l.
mealum nee israveal puththirarai noakki: evanaakilum than theavanaith thooshiththaal, avan than paavaththaich sumappaan.

karththarudaiya naamaththai ninthikki'ravan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; sapaiyaar ellaarum avanaik kalle'riyavea'ndum; paratheasiyaanaalum sutheasiyaanaalum karththarin naamaththaith thooshikki'ravan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
oru manithanaik kolluki'ravan evanoa avan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
mirukaththaik kon'ravan mirukaththukku mirukam kodukkakkadavan.
oruvan pi'ranai oonappaduththinaal, avan seythapadiyea avanukkum seyyappadakkadavathu.
no'rukkuthalukku no'rukkuthal, ka'n'nukkuk ka'n, pallukkup pal; avan oru manithanai oonappaduththinathupoala avanum oonappaduththappadavea'ndum.
mirukaththaik kon'ravan pathil kodukkavea'ndum; manithanaik kon'ravanoa kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
ungka'lil paratheasikkum sutheasikkum orea niyaayam irukkavea'ndum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
appadiyea, thooshiththavanaip paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoay, avanaik kalle'riyumpadi moasea israveal puththiraroadea sonnaan; karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythaarka'l.
karththar seenaaymalaiyil moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'lukkuk kodukkum theasaththilea neengka'l poaych searnthirukkumpoathu, theasam karththarukken'ru oayvu ko'ndaadavea'ndum.
aa'ruvarusham un vayalai vithaiththu, un thiraadchaththoattaththaik ki'laikazhiththu, athin palanaich searppaayaaka.
eazhaam varushaththiloa, karththarukken'ru oaynthirukkum oayvu theasaththi'rku irukkavea'ndum; athil un vayalai vithaikkaamalum, un thiraadchaththoattaththaik ki'laikazhikkaamalum,
thaanaay vi'lainthu payiraanathai a'rukkaamalum, ki'laikazhikkaathea vitta thiraadchachsediyin pazhangka'laich searkkaamalum iruppaayaaka; theasaththukku athu oayvu varushamaayirukkakkadavathu.
theasaththin oayvilea payiraaki'rathu ungka'lukku aakaaramaayiruppathaaka; un vealaikkaaranukkum, un vealaikkaarikkum, un koolikkaaranukkum, unnidaththil thangkuki'ra anniyanukkum,
un naattu mirukaththukkum, un theasaththil irukki'ra kaattu mirukaththukkum athil vi'lainthiruppathellaam aakaaramaayiruppathaaka.
an'riyum, eazhu oayvu varushangka'lu'l'la eazhu eazhu varushangka'lai e'n'nuvaayaaka; antha eazhu oayvu varushangka'lum naa'rpaththonpathu varushamaakum.
appozhuthum eazhaam maatham paththaantheathiyil ekkaa'lachsaththam thonikkumpadi seyyavea'ndum; paavanivaara'nanaa'lil ungka'l theasamengkum ekkaa'lachsaththam thonikkumpadi seyyavea'ndum.

aimpathaam varushaththaip parisuththamaakki, theasamengkum athin kudika'lukkellaam viduthalai koo'rakkadaveerka'l; athu ungka'lukku yoopili varusham; athilea ungka'lil ovvoruvanum than than kaa'niyaadchikkum than than kudumpaththukkum thirumpip poakakkadavan.

antha aimpathaam varusham ungka'lukku yoopili varushamaayiruppathaaka; athilea vithaikkaamalum, thaanaay vi'lainthu payiraanathai a'rukkaamalum, ki'laikazhikkaamal vidappatta thiraadchach sediyin pazhangka'laich searkkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka.
athu yoopili varusham; athu ungka'lukkup parisuththamaayirukkavea'ndum; antha varushaththil vayalve'liyil vi'lainthavaika'lai neengka'l pusikkavea'ndum.
antha yoopili varushaththil ungka'lil avanavan than than kaa'niyaadchikkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan.
aakaiyaal, pi'ranukku ethaiyaavathu vit'raalum, avanidaththil ethaiyaavathu ko'ndaalum oruvarukkoruvar aniyaayam seyyakkoodaathu.
yoopili varushaththukkup pinvarum varushangka'lin thokaikkea'rkap pi'ranidaththil ko'l'luvaayaaka; palanu'l'la varushangka'lin thokaikkea'rka avan unakku vi'rpaanaaka.
palanu'l'la varushangka'lin ilakkaththaip paarththu avan unakku vi'rki'rapadiyaal, varushangka'lin thokai ea'rinaal vilaiyea'ravum, varushangka'lin thokai ku'rainthaal, vilai ku'raiyavumvea'ndum.
ungka'lil oruvanum pi'ranukku aniyaayam seyyakkoodaathu; un theavanukkup payappadavea'ndum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
en katta'laika'linpadi seythu, en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'ndu avaika'linpadi nadakkakkadaveerka'l; appozhuthu theasaththilea sukamaayk kudiyiruppeerka'l.
poomi than kaniyaith tharum; neengka'l thirupthiyaakach saappittu, athil sukamaayk kudiyiruppeerka'l.
eazhaam varushaththil ethaip pusippoam? naangka'l vithaikkaamalum, vi'lainthathaich searkkaamalum irukkavea'ndumea! en'ru solveerka'laanaal,
naan aa'raam varushaththil ungka'lukku aaseervaathaththai anukkirakampa'n'nuvean; athu ungka'lukku moon'ru varushaththin palanaith tharum.
neengka'l ettaam varushaththilea vithaiththu, onpathaam varushammattum pazhaiya palanilea saappiduveerka'l; athin palan vi'laiyumvaraikkum pazhaiya palanaich saappiduveerka'l.
theasam ennudaiyathaayirukki'rapadiyaal, neengka'l nilangka'lai a'ruthiyaay vi'rkavea'ndaam; neengka'l paratheasika'lum ennidaththil pu'rakkudika'lumaayirukki'reerka'l.
ungka'l kaa'niyaadchiyaana theasamengkum nilangka'lai meettukko'l'la idangkodukkakkadaveerka'l.
ungka'l sakoatharan thariththirappattu, than kaa'niyaadchiyilea silathai vit'raal, avan inaththaan oruvan vanthu, than sakoatharan vit'rathai meedkakkadavan.
athai meedka oruvanum illaamal, thaanea athai meedkaththakkavanaanaal,
athai vit'rapin sen'ra varushangka'lin thokaiyaith tha'l'li, meentha thokaiyai eat'ri, ko'ndavanukkuk koduththu, avan than kaa'niyaadchikkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan.

appadik koduppatha'rkaana nirvaakam avanukku illaavittaal, avan vit'rathu vaangkinavan kaiyilea yoopili varushammattum irunthu, yoopili varushaththilea athu viduthalaiyaakum; appozhuthu avan than kaa'niyaadchikkuth thirumpappoavaan.

oruvan mathilsoozhntha patta'naththilu'l'la than vaasasthalamaakiya veettai vit'raal, athai vit'ra oru varushaththukku'l athai meettukko'l'lalaam; oru varushaththukku'l'laakavea athai meettukko'l'lavea'ndum.

oru varushaththukku'l'lea athai meettukko'l'laathirunthaal, mathilsoozhntha patta'naththilu'l'la antha veedu thalaimu'raithoa'rum athai vaangkinavanukkea uriyathaakum; yoopili varushaththilum athu viduthalaiyaakaathu.
mathilsoozhappadaatha kiraamangka'lilu'l'la veeduka'loa, theasaththin nilangka'lpoalavea e'n'nappadum; avaika'l meedkappadalaam; yoopili varushaththil avaika'l viduthalaiyaakum.
leaviyarin kaa'niyaadchiyaakiya patta'nangka'lilu'l'la veeduka'laiyoa leaviyar ekkaalaththilum meettukko'l'lalaam.

israveal puththirarukku'l'lea leaviyarudaiya patta'nangka'lilu'l'la veeduka'l avarka'lukkuriya kaa'niyaadchiyaanapadiyaal, leaviyaridaththil avanudaiya kaa'niyaadchip patta'naththilu'l'la veettai oruvan vaangkinaal, vi'rkappatta antha veedu yoopili varushaththil viduthalaiyaakum.
avarka'l patta'nangka'laich soozhntha ve'linilam vi'rkappadalaakaathu; athu avarka'lukku niththiya kaa'niyaadchiyaayirukkum.
un sakoatharan thariththirappattu, kaiyi'laiththuppoanavanaanaal, avanai aatharikkavea'ndum; paratheasiyaippoalum thangkavanthavanaippoalum avan unnoadea pizhaippaanaaka.
nee avan kaiyil vattiyaavathu polisaiyaavathu vaangkaamal, un theavanukkup payanthu, un sakoatharan unnoadea pizhaikkumpadi seyvaayaaka.
avanukku un pa'naththai vattikkum, un thaaniyaththaip polisaikkum kodaayaaka.
ungka'lukkuk kaanaan theasaththaik koduththu, ungka'lukku theavanaayirukkumpadi, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar naanea.
un sakoatharan thariththiranaaki, unakku vilaippattuppoanaal, avanai adimaiyaippoala oozhiyagnseyya nerukkavea'ndaam.
avan koolikkaaranaippoalavum thangkavanthavanaippoalavum unnoadea irunthu, yoopili varushammattum unnidaththil seavikkakkadavan.
pinpu, than pi'l'laika'loadungkooda unnai vittu neengkalaaki, than kudumpaththaaridaththukkum than pithaakka'lin kaa'niyaadchikkum thirumpippoakakkadavan.
avarka'l naan ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina ennudaiya oozhiyakkaarar; aakaiyaal, avarka'l adimaika'laaka vi'rkappadalaakaathu.
nee avanaik kodooramaay aa'laamal, un theavanukkup payanthiru.
unakku irukkum aa'n adimaiyum pe'n adimaiyum sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathika'laayirukkavea'ndum; avarka'lil nee aa'n adimaiyaiyum pe'n adimaiyaiyum vilaikku vaangkalaam.

ungka'lidaththilea paratheasika'laayth thangkuki'ra anniya puththirarilum, ungka'l theasaththil ungka'lidaththilea pi'ranthirukki'ra avarka'ludaiya kudumpaththaarilum neengka'l ungka'lukku adimaika'laikko'ndu, avarka'lai ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakkalaam.

avarka'lai ungka'lukkup pinvarum ungka'l santhathiyaarum suthantharikkumpadi neengka'l avarka'laich suthantharamaakkikko'l'lalaam; en'raikkum avarka'l ungka'lukku adimaika'laayirukkalaam; ungka'l sakoathararaakiya israveal puththiraroa oruvaraiyoruvar kodooramaaka aa'lakkoodaathu.

unnidaththil irukki'ra paratheasiyum anniyanum selvanaayirukka, avanidaththil irukki'ra un sakoatharan thariththirappattu, anthap paratheasikkaavathu, anniyanukkaavathu, paratheasiyin kudumpaththaaril evanukkaavathu avan vilaippattuppoanaal,
avan vilaippattuppoanapin thirumpa meedkappadalaam; avan sakoathararil oruvan avanai meedkalaam.

avanudaiya pithaavin sakoatharanaavathu, anthach sakoatharanudaiya puththiranaavathu, avan kudumpaththilu'l'la avanaich searntha inaththaaril evanaavathu avanai meedkalaam; thannaal koodumaanaal, thannaiththaanea meettukko'l'lalaam.

avan thaan vilaippatta varushanthodangki, yoopili varushamvaraikkum u'ndaana kaalaththaith thannai vilaikkuk ko'ndavanudan ka'nakkuppaarkkakkadavan; avanudaiya vilaikkirayam koolikkaaranudaiya kaalakka'nakkuppoala, varushaththokaikku oththuppaarkkavea'ndum.
innum aneaka varushangka'l irunthaal, avan than vilaikkirayaththilea avaika'lukkuth thakkathaith thannai meedkumporu'laakath thirumpak kodukkakkadavan.
yoopili varushammattum meethiyaayirukki'ra varushangka'l kognchameayaanaal, avanoadea ka'nakkuppaarththu, than varushangka'lukkuththakkathai, thannai meedkumporu'laakath thirumpak kodukkavea'ndum.
ivan varushaththi'rku varusham kooliporunthikko'nda koolikkaaranaippoala, avanidaththil irukkavea'ndum; avan ivanai unakku munpaakak kodooramaay aa'lakkoodaathu.
ippadi ivan meettukko'l'lappadaathirunthaal, ivanum ivanoadeakooda ivan pi'l'laika'lum yoopili varushaththil viduthalaiyaavaarka'l.
israveal puththirar en oozhiyakkaarar; avarka'l naan ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina en oozhiyakkaararea; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.

neengka'l ungka'lukku vikkirakangka'laiyum suroopangka'laiyum u'ndaakkaamalum, ungka'lukkuch silaiyai ni'ruththaamalum, siththirantheerntha kallai namaskarikkumporuttu ungka'l theasaththil vaikkaamalum iruppeerka'laaka; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
en oayvunaadka'lai aasariththu, en parisuththa sthalaththaikku'riththup payapakthiyaayiruppeerka'laaka; naan karththar.
neengka'l en katta'laika'linpadi nadanthu, en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seythaal,
naan eat'ra kaalaththil ungka'lukku mazhaipeyyappa'n'nuvean; poomi than palanaiyum, ve'liyilu'l'la marangka'l thangka'l kaniyaiyum kodukkum.

thiraadchappazham pa'rikkung kaalamvaraikkum poaradippuk kaalam irukkum; vithaippuk kaalamvaraikkum thiraadchappazham pa'rikkung kaalam irukkum; neengka'l ungka'l appaththaith thirupthiyaakach saappittu, ungka'l theasaththil sukamaayk kudiyiruppeerka'l.

theasaththil samaathaanam katta'laiyiduvean; thaththa'likkappa'n'nuvaar illaamal paduththukko'lveerka'l; thushda mirukangka'laith theasaththil iraathapadikku ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; pattayam ungka'l theasaththil ulaavuvathillai.
ungka'l saththurukka'laith thuraththuveerka'l; avarka'l ungka'l munpaakap pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l.
ungka'lil ainthupear noo'rupearaith thuraththuvaarka'l; ungka'lil noo'rupear pathinaayirampearaith thuraththuvaarka'l; ungka'l saththurukka'l ungka'lukku munpaakap pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l.
naan ungka'lmeal ka'n'noakkamaayirunthu, ungka'laip palukavum perukavumpa'n'ni, ungka'loadea en udanpadikkaiyaith thidappaduththuvean.
poana varushaththup pazhaiya thaaniyaththaich saappittu, puthiya thaaniyaththukku idamu'ndaakumpadi, pazhaiyathai vilakkuveerka'l.
ungka'l naduvil en vaasasthalaththai sthaapippean; en aaththumaa ungka'lai aroasippathillai.
naan ungka'l naduvilea ulaavi, ungka'l theavanaayiruppean, neengka'l en janamaayiruppeerka'l.

neengka'l ekipthiyarukku adimaika'laayiraathapadikku, naan avarka'l theasaththilirunthu ungka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, ungka'l nukaththadika'lai mu'riththu, ungka'lai nimirnthu nadakkappa'n'nina ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
neengka'l enakkuch sevikodaamalum, inthak ka'rpanaika'l ellaavat'rinpadi seyyaamalum,
en katta'laika'lai ve'ruththu, ungka'l aaththumaa en niyaayangka'lai aroasiththu, en ka'rpanaika'l ellaavat'rinpadiyum seyyaathapadikku, en udanpadikkaiyai neengka'l mee'rippoaduveerka'laakil:

naan ungka'lukkuch seyvathu ennaven'raal, ka'nka'laip pooththuppoakappa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum, iruthayaththaith thuyarappaduththuki'ratha'rkum, thikilaiyum ee'laiyaiyum kaaychchalaiyum ungka'lukku varappa'n'nuvean; neengka'l vithaikkum vithai viruthaavaayirukkum; ungka'l saththurukka'l athin palanaith thinpaarka'l.

naan ungka'lukku viroathamaaka en mukaththaith thiruppuvean; ungka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappaduveerka'l; ungka'l pakaignar ungka'lai aa'luvaarka'l; thuraththuvaar illaathirunthum oaduveerka'l.
ivvithamaay naan ungka'lukkuch seythum, innum neengka'l enakkuch sevikodaathirunthaal, ungka'l paavangka'linimiththam pinnum eazhaththanaiyaaka ungka'laith tha'ndiththu,
ungka'l vallamaiyin perumaiyai mu'riththu, ungka'l vaanaththai irumpaippoalavum, ungka'l poomiyai ve'nkalaththaippoalavum aakkuvean.
ungka'l pelan viruthaavilea selavazhiyum; ungka'l theasam than palanaiyum, theasaththin marangka'l thangka'l kanika'laiyum kodukkamaattaathu.
neengka'l enakkuch sevikodukka manathillaamal, enakku ethirththu nadappeerka'laanaal, naan ungka'l paavangka'lukkuththakkathaaka innum eazhaththanai vaathaiyai ungka'lmeal varappa'n'ni,

ungka'lukku'l'lea ve'liyin thushdamirukangka'lai varaviduvean; avaika'l ungka'laip pi'l'laika'lat'ravarka'laakki, ungka'l mirukajeevanka'lai azhiththu, ungka'laik ku'rainthupoakappa'n'num; ungka'l vazhika'l paazhaayk kidakkum.
naan seyyum tha'ndanaiyinaal neengka'l ku'nappadaamal, enakku ethirththu nadanthaal,
naan ungka'lukku ethirththu nadanthu, ungka'l paavangka'linimiththam eazhaththanaiyaaka vaathiththu,

en udanpadikkaiyai mee'rinatha'rkup pazhivaangkum pattayaththai ungka'lmeal varappa'n'ni, neengka'l ungka'l patta'nangka'lil searnthapin, ko'l'lainoayai ungka'l naduvilea anuppuvean; saththuruvin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduveerka'l.

ungka'l appam ennum aatharavukoalai naan mu'riththuppoadumpoathu, paththu sthireeka'l orea aduppil ungka'l appaththaich suttu, athaith thirumpa ungka'lukku ni'ruththukkoduppaarka'l; neengka'l saappittum thirupthiyadaiyamaatteerka'l.
innum ivaika'lellaavat'raalum neengka'l enakkuch sevikodaamal, enakku ethirththu nadanthaal,
naanum ukkiraththoadea ungka'lukku ethirththu nadanthu, naanea ungka'l paavangka'linimiththam ungka'lai eazhaththanaiyaayth tha'ndippean.
ungka'l kumaararin maamsaththaiyum ungka'l kumaaraththika'lin maamsaththaiyum pusippeerka'l.

naan ungka'l meadaika'lai azhiththu, ungka'l vikkirakach silaika'lai nirththoo'liyaakki, ungka'l udalka'lai ungka'l narakalaana theavarka'ludaiya udalka'lmeal e'rivean; en aaththumaa ungka'lai aroasikkum.
naan ungka'l patta'nangka'lai ve'rumaiyum, ungka'l parisuththa sthalangka'laip paazhumaakki, ungka'l sukantha vaasanaiyai mukaraathiruppean.
naan theasaththaip paazhaakkuvean; athilea kudiyirukki'ra ungka'l saththurukka'l piramippaarka'l.
jaathika'lukku'l'lea ungka'laich sitha'ra adiththu, ungka'l pinnaakap pattayaththai uruvuvean; ungka'l theasam paazhum, ungka'l patta'nangka'l vanaantharamumaakum.

neengka'l ungka'l saththurukka'lin theasaththil irukkumpoathu, theasamaanathu paazhaaykkidakki'ra naa'lellaam than oayvunaadka'lai irammiyamaay anupavikkum; appozhuthu theasam oayvadainthu, than oayvunaadka'lai irammiyamaay anupavikkum.
neengka'l athilea kudiyirukkumpoathu, athu ungka'l oayvu varushangka'lil oayvadaiyaathapadiyinaalea, athu paazhaaykkidakkum naa'lellaam oayvadainthirukkum.

ungka'lil uyiroadu meethiyaayiruppavarka'lin iruthayangka'l thangka'l saththurukka'lin theasangka'lil manaththa'larchchi adaiyumpadi seyvean; asaiki'ra ilaiyin saththamum avarka'lai oattum; avarka'l pattayaththi'rkuth thappi oaduki'rathupoala oadi, thuraththuvaar illaamal vizhuvaarka'l.
thuraththuvaar illaamal, pattayaththukku mun vizhuvathupoala, oruvarmeal oruvar ida'rivizhuvaarka'l; ungka'l saththurukka'lukkumun ni'rka ungka'lukkup pelan iraathu.
pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea azhinthupoaveerka'l; ungka'l saththurukka'lin theasam ungka'laip padchikkum.
ungka'lil thappinavarka'l thangka'l akkiramangka'linimiththamum, thangka'l pithaakka'lin akkiramangka'linimiththamum, ungka'l saththurukka'lin theasangka'lil vaadippoavaarka'l.
avarka'l enakku viroathamaakath thuroakampa'n'ni nadappiththa thangka'l akkiramaththaiyum, thangka'l pithaakka'lin akkiramaththaiyum a'rikkaiyiduki'rathuman'ri,

avarka'l enakku ethirththu nadanthapadiyinaal, naanum avarka'lukku ethirththu nadanthu, avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'lin theasaththilea avarka'laik ko'ndupoay vittathaiyum a'rikkaiyittu, viruththaseathanamillaatha thangka'l iruthayaththaith thaazhththi, thangka'l akkiramaththukkuk kidaiththa tha'ndanaiyai niyaayam en'ru oththukko'ndaal,
naan yaakkoapoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyaiyum, eesaakkoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyaiyum, aapirakaamoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyaiyum ninaippean; theasaththaiyum ninaippean.

theasam avarka'laalea vidappattu, paazhaaykkidakki'rathinaalea than oayvunaadka'lai irammiyamaay anupavikkum; avarka'l en niyaayangka'lai avamathiththu, avarka'ludaiya aaththumaa en katta'laika'lai ve'ruththapadiyinaal adaintha thangka'ludaiya akkiramaththin tha'ndanaiyai niyaayam en'ru oththukko'l'luvaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l saththurukka'lin theasaththilirunthaalum, naan avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkaththakkathaakavum, naan avarka'loadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyai apaththamaakkaththakkathaakavum, naan avarka'laik kaividavum ve'rukkavumaattean; naan avarka'l theavanaakiya karththar.

avarka'ludaiya theavanaayirukkumpadikku, naan pu'rajaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ekipthutheasaththilirunthu avarka'laip pu'rappadachseythu, avarka'ludaiya munnoarka'loadea naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai avarka'l nimiththam ninaivukooruvean; naan karththar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar thamakkum israveal santhathiyaarukkum naduvea irukkumpadi moaseayaikko'ndu, seenaaymalaiyinmeal koduththa katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lum ivaika'lea.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: yaathaamoruvar oru viseashiththa poruththanai pa'n'niyirunthaal, poruththanai pa'n'nappattavarka'l un mathippinpadi karththarukku uriyavarka'l.
irupathu vayathumuthal a'rupathu vayathukku udpatta aa'npi'l'laiyai nee parisuththa sthalaththin seakkalaakiya aimpathu ve'l'lich seakkalaakavum,
pe'npi'l'laiyai muppathu seakkalaakavum mathippaayaaka.
ainthu vayathumuthal irupathu vayathukku udpatta aa'npi'l'laiyai irupathu seakkalaakavum, pe'npi'l'laiyaip paththuch seakkalaakavum,
oru maathammuthal ainthu vayathukku udpatta aa'npi'l'laiyai ainthu ve'l'lich seakkalaakavum, pe'npi'l'laiyai moon'ru ve'l'lich seakkalaakavum,
a'rupathu vayathu thodangki, atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laiyaip pathinainthu seakkalaakavum, pe'npi'l'laiyaip paththuch seakkalaakavum mathikkakkadavaay.

un mathippinpadi seluththakkoodaatha thariththiranaayirunthaal, avan aasaariyanukku munpaaka vanthu ni'rkakkadavan; aasaariyan avanai mathippaanaaka; poruththanai pa'n'ninavanudaiya thiraa'nikkeat'rapadi aasaariyan avanai mathikkakkadavan.
oruvan poruththanaipa'n'ninathu karththarukkup paliyidappadaththakka mirukajeevanaanaal avan karththarukkuk kodukki'ra appadippattathellaam parisuththamaayiruppathaaka.

athai maat'raamalum, vea'rupaduththaamalum iruppaanaaka; i'lappamaanatha'rkup pathilaaka nalamaanathaiyum, nalamaanatha'rkup pathilaaka i'lappamaanathaiyum seluththaamal iruppaanaaka; avan mirukaththi'rkup pathilaaka mirukaththai maat'rik koduppaanaakil, appozhuthu athuvum atha'rkup pathilaakak koduththathum parisuththamaayiruppathaaka.
athu karththarukkup paliyidappadaththakaatha suththamallaatha yaathoru mirukamaanaal, athai aasaariyanukku munpaaka ni'ruththakkadavan.
aasaariyan athu nallathaanaalum i'lappamaanathaanaalum athai mathippaanaaka; un mathippinpadiyea irukkakkadavathu.
athai meettukko'l'la manathaayirunthaanaakil, un mathippoadea ainthil oru pangkaik koottik kodukkakkadavan.

oruvan than veettaik karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaal, aasaariyan athin nalaththukkum i'lappaththukkum thakkathaaka athai mathikkakkadavan; aasaariyan mathikki'rapadi athu irukkakkadavathu.

than veettaip parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndavan athai meettukko'l'la manathaayirunthaal, nee mathikkum thiraviyaththoadea ainthil oru pangkaik koottik kodukkakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanudaiyathaakum.

oruvan than kaa'niyaadchiyaana vayalil yaathoru pangkaik karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaal, un mathippu athin vithaippukkuththakkathaay irukkavea'ndum; oru kalam vaa'rkoathumai vithaikki'ra vayal aimpathu ve'l'lich seakkalaaka mathikkappadavea'ndum.
yoopili varushamuthal avan than vayalaip parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaal, athu un mathippinpadi irukkavea'ndum.

yoopili varushaththukkuppin than vayalaip parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaanaanaal, yoopili varushammattumu'l'la mat'ra varushangka'linpadiyea aasaariyan thiraviyaththaik ka'nakkuppaarththu, atha'rkuththakkathu un mathippilea tha'l'lappadavea'ndum.

vayalaip parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndavan athai meettukko'l'la manathaayirunthaal, un mathippaana thiraviyaththoadea ainthil oru pangkaik koottik kodukkakkadavan; appozhuthu athu avanukku u'ruthiyaakum.
avan vayalai meettukko'l'laamal, vayalai vea'roruvanukku vit'ruppoattaal, athu thirumpa meedkappadaamal,
yoopili varushaththil meedkappadumpoathu, saapaththeedaana vayalaakak karththarukken'ru niyamikkappattathaayirukkakkadavathu; athu aasaariyanukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakum.
oruvan thanakkuk kaa'niyaadchi vayalaayiraamal thaan vilaikku vaangkina oru vayalaik karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaal,

athu yoopili varushammattum, un mathippinpadi pe'rum vilai innathen'ru aasaariyan avanoadea ka'nakkuppaarththu, antha un mathippai, karththarukkup parisuththamaayirukkumpadi, avan annaa'lilea kodukkakkadavan.
yaar kaiyilea antha vayalaik ko'ndaanoa, anthak kaa'niyaadchikkaaran vasamaay athu yoopili varushaththil thirumpachsearum.
un mathippellaam parisuththa sthalaththuch seakkal ka'nakkaayirukkakkadavathu; oru seakkalaanathu irupathu kearaa.
thalaiyeet'raanavaika'l karththarudaiyathu, aakaiyaal oruvarum thalaiyeet'raakiya mirukajeevanaip parisuththam en'ru nearnthu ko'l'lalaakaathu; athu maadaanaalum aadaanaalum karththarudaiyathu.

suththamallaatha mirukaththinudaiya thalaiyeet'raanaal, athai avan un mathippinpadi meettukko'ndu, athanudanea ainthil oru pangkaik koottik kodukkakkadavan; meedkappadaamalirunthaal, un mathippinpadi athu vi'rkappadakkadavathu.

oruvan than vasaththilu'l'la narajeevanilaavathu, mirukajeevanilaavathu, kaa'niyaadchi nilaththilaavathu, ethaiyaakilum karththarukken'ru saapaththeedaaka nearnthuko'ndaal, athu vi'rkappadavum meedkappadavum koodaathu; nearnthuko'l'lappattavaika'lellaam karththarukkaakap parisuththamaayirukkum.
narajeevanil saapaththeedaaka niyamikkappattavaika'lellaam meedkappadaamal kolaiseyyappadakkadavathu.
theasaththilea nilaththin viththilum, virudchangka'lin kaniyilum, thasamapaakam ellaam karththarukku uriyathu; athu karththarukkup parisuththamaanathu.
oruvan than thasamapaakaththilea evva'lavaavathu meettukko'l'la manathaayirunthaanaanaal, athanudan ainthil oru pangkaik koottik kodukkakkadavan.
koalin keezhppatta aadumaaduka'lilea paththil oru pangkaaki'rathellaam karththarukkup parisuththamaanathu.

athu nallathoa i'lappamaanathoa en'ru avan paarkkavea'ndaam; athai maat'ravum vea'ndaam; maat'rinaal, athuvum atha'rkup pathilaakak kodukkappattathumaakiya ira'ndum parisuththamaakum; athu meedkappadakkoodaathen'ru avarka'loadea sol en'raar.
israveal puththirarukkuch sollumpadi karththar seenaaymalaiyil moaseakku vithiththa katta'laika'l ivaika'lea.
isravealar ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta ira'ndaam varusham ira'ndaam maatham muthal theathiyil, karththar seenaay vanaantharaththilirukki'ra aasarippuk koodaaraththilea moaseayai noakki:
neengka'l israveal puththirarin muzhuchsapaiyaayirukki'ra avarka'l pithaakka'ludaiya veettu vamsangka'lilu'l'la purusharka'laakiya sakala thalaika'laiyum pearpearaaka e'n'nith thokaiyeat'rungka'l.
isravealilea irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththukkup pu'rappadaththakkavarka'l ellaaraiyum avarka'l seanaika'linpadi neeyum aaroanum e'n'nip paarppeerka'laaka.
ovvoru koaththiraththukku ovvoru manithan ungka'loadea iruppaanaaka; avan than pithaakka'lin vamsaththukkuth thalaivanaayirukkavea'ndum.
ungka'loadea ni'rkavea'ndiya manitharudaiya naamangka'laavana: roopan koaththiraththil seatheayoorudaiya kumaaran elisoor.
simiyoan koaththiraththil soorishathaayin kumaaran seloomiyeal.
yoothaa koaththiraththil amminathaapin kumaaran nakasoan.
isakkaar koaththiraththil soovaarin kumaaran nethaneyeal.
sepuloan koaththiraththil ealoanin kumaaran eliyaap.
yoaseappin kumaararaakiya eppiraayeem koaththiraththil ammiyoothin kumaaran elishaamaa; manaasea koaththiraththil pethaasoorin kumaaran kamaaliyeal.
penyameen koaththiraththil keetheyoanin kumaaran apeethaan.
thaa'n koaththiraththil ammishathaayin kumaaran akiyeasear.
aasear koaththiraththil oakiraanin kumaaran paakiyeal.
kaath koaththiraththil theakuvealin kumaaran eliyaasaap.
napthali koaththiraththil eanaanin kumaaran akeeraa.
ivarka'lea sapaiyil ea'rpaduththappattavarka'lum, thangka'l thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththirangka'lil pirapukka'lum, isravealil aayiravarka'lukkuth thalaivarumaayiruppavarka'l en'raar.
appadiyea moaseayum aaroanum pearpearaakak ku'rikkappatta intha manitharaik koottikko'ndu,

ira'ndaam maatham muthal theathiyil sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum koodivarachseythaarka'l. appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l thangka'l kudumpaththinpadikkum, pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadikkum, naamath thokaiyinpadikkum, irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal thalaithalaiyaakath thangka'l vamsa u'rpaththiyaith theriviththaarka'l.
ippadik karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea, moasea avarka'laich seenaay vanaantharaththil e'n'nippaarththaan.

isravealin mooththakumaaranaakiya roopan puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'lmuthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum thalaithalaiyaaka e'n'nappattapoathu,
roopan koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, naa'rpaththaa'raayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
simiyoan puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum thalaithalaiyaaka e'n'nappattapoathu,
simiyoan koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, aimpaththonpathinaayiraththu munnoo'rupear.
kaath puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
kaath koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, naa'rpaththaiyaayiraththu a'runoot'ru aimpathupear.
yoothaa puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
yoothaa koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, ezhupaththu naalaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
isakkaar puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
isakkaar koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, aimpaththu naalaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
sepuloan puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
sepuloan koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, aimpaththeazhaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.

yoaseappin kumaararil eppiraayeem puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
eppiraayeem koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, naa'rpathinaayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
manaasea puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
manaasea koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, muppaththeeraayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
penyameen puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
penyameen koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, muppaththaiyaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
thaa'n puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
thaa'n koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, a'rupaththeeraayiraththu ezhunoo'rupear.
aasear puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
aasear koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, naa'rpaththoaraayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
napthali puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsaththaaril irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l muthal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakka purusharka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattapoathu,
napthali koaththiraththil e'n'nappattavarka'l, aimpaththu moovaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
e'n'nappattavarka'l ivarka'lea; moaseayum aaroanum isravealudaiya pithaakka'lin vamsaththil ovvoru vamsaththukku ovvoru pirapuvaakiya pannira'ndupearum e'n'ninaarka'l.
israveal puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin vamsaththil irupathu vayathu'l'lavarka'lmuthal, isravealil yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakkavarka'laakiya e'n'nappatta pearka'l ellaarum,
aa'ruladchaththu moovaayiraththu ainnoot'ru aimpathu pearaayirunthaarka'l.
leaviyar thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththiraththinpadiyea, mat'ravarka'ludanea e'n'nappadavillai.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee leavi koaththiraththaaraimaaththiram e'n'naamalum, israveal puththirarukku'l'lea avarka'l thokaiyai eat'raamalum,

leaviyaraich saadchiyin vaasasthalaththi'rkum, athinudaiya sakala pa'nimuttuka'lukkum, athilu'l'la samastha poru'lka'lukkum visaarippukkaararaaka ea'rpaduththu; avarka'l vaasasthalaththaiyum athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum sumappaarka'laaka; athinidaththil oozhiyam seythu, vaasasthalaththaich sut'rilum paa'layami'rangkakkadavarka'l.

vaasasthalam pu'rappadumpoathu, leaviyar athai i'rakkivaiththu, athu sthaapanam pa'n'nappadumpoathu, leaviyar athai eduththu ni'ruththakkadavarka'l; anniyan atha'rkuch sameepaththil vanthaal kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.
israveal puththirar thangka'l thangka'l paa'layaththoadum, thangka'l thangka'l seanaiyin kodiyoadum koodaaram poadakkadavarka'l.

israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyinmeal kadungkoapam varaathapadikku leaviyar saadchiyin vaasasthalaththaich sut'rilum paa'layami'rangki, leaviyar saadchiyin vaasasthalaththaik kaavalkaappaarka'laaka en'raar.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadi ellaavat'raiyum israveal puththirar seythaarka'l.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:

israveal puththirar avaravar thangka'l thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththin viruthaakiya thangka'l thangka'l kodiya'ndaiyilea thangka'l koodaarangka'laip poattu, aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku ethiraakach sut'rilum paa'layami'rangkakkadavarka'l.

yoothaavin paa'layaththuk kodiyaiyudaiya seanaika'l sooriyan uthikkum keezhppu'raththilea paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; amminathaapin kumaaranaakiya nakasoan yoothaa santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
e'n'nappatta avanudaiya seanai ezhupaththu naalaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
avan arukea isakkaar koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; soovaarin kumaaran nethaneyeal isakkaar santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
e'n'nappatta avanudaiya seanai aimpaththu naalaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
avan arukea sepuloan koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; ealoanin kumaaranaakiya eliyaap sepuloan santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l aimpaththeazhaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.

e'n'nappatta yoothaavin paa'layaththaar ellaarum thangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea iladchaththu e'npaththu aa'raayiraththu naanoo'rupear; ivarka'l pirayaa'naththilea mutha'rpaa'layamaayp poakakkadavarka'l.
roopanudaiya paa'layaththuk kodiyaiyudaiya seanaika'l thenpu'raththil paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; seatheayoorin kumaaranaakiya elisoor roopan santhathiyaarukkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththaa'raayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
avan arukea simiyoan koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; soorishathaayin kumaaranaakiya seloomiyeal simiyoan santhathiyaarukkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l aimpaththonpathinaayiraththu munnoo'rupear.
avan arukea kaath koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; theakuvealin kumaaranaakiya eliyaasaap kaath santhathiyaarukkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththaiyaayiraththu a'runoot'ru aimpathupear.

e'n'nappatta roopanin paa'layaththaar ellaarum thangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea iladchaththu aimpaththu oaraayiraththu naanoot'ru aimpathupear; ivarka'l pirayaa'naththil ira'ndaam paa'layamaayp poakakkadavarka'l.

pinpu aasarippuk koodaaram leaviyarin seanaiyoadea paa'layangka'lin naduvea pirayaa'nappattup poakavea'ndum; eppadip paa'layami'rangkuki'raarka'loa, appadiyea avaravar thangka'l varisaiyilea thangka'l kodika'loadea pirayaa'namaayp poakakkadavarka'l.
eppiraayeemudaiya paa'layaththuk kodiyaiyudaiya seanaika'l mealpu'raththil i'rangkavea'ndum; ammiyoothin kumaaranaakiya elishaamaa eppiraayeemin santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpathinaayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
avan arukea manaasea koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; pethaasoorin kumaaranaakiya kamaaliyeal manaasea santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l muppaththeeraayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
avan arukea penyameen koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; keetheyoanin kumaaranaakiya apeethaan penyameen santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l muppaththaiyaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
e'n'nappatta eppiraayeemin paa'layaththaar ellaarum thangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea iladchaththu e'n'naayiraththu noo'rupear; ivarka'l pirayaa'naththil moon'raam paa'layamaayp poakakkadavarka'l.
thaa'nudaiya paa'layaththuk kodiyaiyudaiya seanaika'l vadapu'raththil i'rangkavea'ndum; ammishathaayin kumaaranaakiya akiyeasear thaa'n vamsaththi'rkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l a'rupaththeeraayiraththu ezhunoo'rupear.
avan arukea aasear koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; oakiraanin kumaaranaakiya paakiyeal aasear santhathikkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththoaraayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
avan arukea napthali koaththiraththaar paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum; eanaanin kumaaranaakiya akeeraa napthali santhathiyaarukkuch seanaapathiyaayirukkakkadavan.
avanudaiya seanaiyil e'n'nappattavarka'l aimpaththu moovaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
e'n'nappatta thaa'nin paa'layaththaar ellaarum iladchaththu aimpaththeazhaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear; ivarka'l thangka'l kodika'loadea pinpaa'layamaayp poakakkadavarka'l.

ivarka'lea thangka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththinpadi israveal puththiraril e'n'nappattavarka'l. paa'layangka'lilea thangka'l thangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea e'n'nappattavarka'l ellaarum aa'ruladchaththu moovaayiraththu ainnoot'ru aimpathu pearaayirunthaarka'l.
leaviyaroa, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadi, israveal puththirarukku'l'lea e'n'nappadavillai.

karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam israveal puththirar seythu, thangka'l thangka'l kodika'linkeezh paa'layami'rangki, thangka'l thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadiyea pirayaa'nappattuppoanaarka'l.
seenaay malaiyil karththar moaseayoadea peasina naa'lilea, aaroan moasea enpavarka'ludaiya vamsavaralaa'raavathu:
aaroanudaiya kumaarar, muthal pi'ranthavanaakiya naathaap, apiyoo, eleyaasaar, iththaamaar enpavarka'lea.
aasaariya oozhiyamseyki'ratha'rku avanaal pirathishdai seyyappattu apisheakampet'ra aasaariyaraana aaroanudaiya kumaararin naamangka'l ivaika'lea.

naathaapum apiyoovum seenaay vanaantharaththil anniya akkiniyaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthapoathu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil mariththuppoanaarka'l; avarka'lukkup pi'l'laika'l illai; eleyaasaarum iththaamaarumea thangka'l thakappanaakiya aaroanukku munpaaka aasaariya oozhiyam seythaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee leavikoaththiraththaaraich searththu, avarka'l aasaariyanaakiya aaroanukkup pa'nividai seyyumpadi avarka'lai ni'ruththu.
avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaaka avanudaiya kaavalaiyum ellaach sapaiyin kaavalaiyum kaaththu, vaasasthalaththin pa'nividai vealaika'laich seyyakkadavarka'l.
avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththin thattumuttu muthalaanavaika'laiyum, israveal puththirarin kaavalaiyum kaaththu, vaasasthalaththin pa'nividaika'laich seyyakkadavarka'l.
aakaiyaal leaviyarai aaroanidaththilum avan kumaararidaththilum oppukkoduppaayaaka; israveal puththiraril ivarka'l mut'rilum avanukku oppukkodukkappattirukki'raarka'l.
aaroanaiyum avan kumaararaiyumoa, thangka'l aasaariya oozhiyaththaich seyvatha'rkaaka niyamikkakkadavaay, antha oozhiyaththaich seyyumpadi searuki'ra anniyan kolaiseyyappadakkadavan en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
israveal puththiraril karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakki'ra mutha'rpea'raana yaavukkum pathilaaka, naan leaviyarai israveal puththirarilirunthu eduththukko'ndean; avarka'l ennudaiyavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

mutha'rpea'raanavaiyellaam ennudaiyavai; naan ekipthutheasaththil mutha'rpea'raana yaavaiyum sangkariththa naa'lil, isravealil manitharmuthal mirukajeevanmattumu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana yaavaiyum enakken'ru parisuththappaduththinathinaalea, avaika'l ennudaiyavaika'laayirukkum; naan karththar en'raar.
pinnum karththar seenaay vanaantharaththil moaseayai noakki:
leavipuththirarai avarka'l pithaakka'lin vamsangka'linpadiyea e'n'nuvaayaaka; avarka'lil oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'laiyellaam e'n'nuvaayaaka en'raar.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaakkinpadi, moasea thanakkuk ka'rpikkappattapirakaaram avarka'lai e'n'ninaan.
leaviyin kumaarar thangka'l naamangka'linpadiyea, kersoan, koakaath, meraari enpavarka'l.
thangka'l vamsaththinpadiyea kersoanudaiya kumaararin naamangka'l, lipnee, seemeayi enpavaika'l.
thangka'l vamsangka'linpadiyea koakaaththudaiya kumaarar, amraam, ithseayaar, eproan, oosiyeal enpavarka'l.
thangka'l vamsangka'linpadiyea meraariyinudaiya kumaarar, makeali, moosi enpavarka'l; ivarka'lea leaviyarudaiya pithaakka'lin vamsaththaar.
kersoanin vazhiyaay lipneeyarin vamsamum seemeayiyar vamsamum thoan'rina; ivaika'lea kersoaniyarin vamsangka'l.
avarka'lil oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'lellaam e'n'nappattapoathu, e'n'nappattavarka'l eazhaayiraththu ainnoo'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.
kersoaniyarin vamsangka'l vaasasthalaththin pinpu'raththil mea'rkea paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum.
kersoaniyarudaiya thakappan vamsaththukkuth thalaivan laayealin kumaaranaakiya eliyaasaap enpavan.
aasarippuk koodaaraththilea kersoan puththirarin kaavalaavathu: vaasasthalamum, koodaaramum, athin moodiyum, aasarippuk koodaaravaasal ma'raivum,

vaasasthalaththa'ndaiyilum palipeedaththa'ndaiyilum sut'rilum irukki'ra piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraika'lum, piraakaaravaasal mooduthiraiyum, avaika'lin vealaika'lukkellaam uriya avaika'lin kayi'ruka'lumea.
koakaaththin vazhiyaay amraamiyarin vamsamum ithseayaarin vamsamum eproaniyarin vamsamum oosiyealarin vamsamum thoan'rina; ivaika'lea koakaaththiyarin vamsangka'l.
oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'lellaam e'n'nappattapoathu, parisuththa sthalaththukkuriyavaika'laik kaappavarka'l, e'n'naayiraththu a'runoo'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.
koakaath puththirarin vamsangka'l vaasasthalaththin thenpu'ramaana pakkaththilea paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum.
avarka'lin thalaivan, oosiyealin kumaaranaakiya elsaapaan.

avarka'ludaiya kaavalaavathu: pettiyum, meajaiyum, kuththuvi'lakkum, peedangka'lum, aaraathanaikkeat'ra parisuththa sthalaththin pa'nimuttuka'lum, thongkuthiraiyum, athinudaiya ellaa vealaika'lukkum eat'ravaika'lumea.
aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaran eleyaasaar enpavan leaviyarudaiya thalaivarka'lukkuth thalaivanaayp parisuththa sthalaththaik kaavalkaakki'ravarka'lukku visaarippukkaaranaayirukkavea'ndum.
meraariyin vazhiyaay makealiyarin vamsamum moosiyarin vamsamum thoan'rina; ivaika'lea meraariyin vamsangka'l.
avarka'lil oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'lellaam e'n'nappattapoathu, e'n'nappattavarka'l aa'raayiraththu irunoo'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.
apiyaayealin kumaaranaakiya sooriyeal enpavan avarka'lukkuth thalaivanaayirunthaan; ivarka'l vaasasthalaththin vadapu'ramaana pakkaththil paa'layami'rangkavea'ndum.
avarka'ludaiya kaaval visaarippaavathu: vaasasthalaththin palakaika'lum, thaazhppaa'lka'lum, thoo'nka'lum, paathangka'lum, athinudaiya ellaap pa'nimuttuka'lum, atha'rkaduththavaika'l anaiththum,
sut'ruppiraakaaraththin thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lin paathangka'lum, mu'laika'lum, kayi'ruka'lumea.

aasarippuk koodaaramaakiya vaasasthalaththukku munpaaka, sooriyan uthikkum keezhppu'raththilea moaseayum aaroanum avan kumaararum koodaarangka'laip poattu i'rangki, israveal puththirarin kaavalukkup pathilaakap parisuththa sthalaththaik kaaval kaakkavea'ndum. vaasasthalaththil searuki'ra anniyan kolaiseyyappadakkadavan.

moaseayum aaroanum, karththarudaiya vaakkinpadi, leaviyaril oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la aa'npi'l'laika'laiyellaam avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadiyea e'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l irupaththeeraayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.

athanpinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee israveal puththiraril oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana aa'npi'l'laika'laiyellaam e'n'ni, avarka'l naamangka'laith thokaiyeat'ri,

israveal puththirarilu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana yaavukkum pathilaaka leaviyaraiyum, israveal puththirarin mirukajeevanka'lilu'l'la thalaiyeet'raana yaavukkum pathilaaka leaviyarin mirukajeevanka'laiyum enakken'ru piriththedu; naan karththar en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, israveal puththirarilu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana yaavaraiyum e'n'ninaan.

oru maathammuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana aa'npi'l'laika'lellaarum pearpearaaka e'n'nappattapoathu, irupaththeeraayiraththu irunoot'ru ezhupaththumoon'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththirarilu'l'la mutha'rpea'raana yaavarukkum pathilaaka leaviyaraiyum, avarka'ludaiya mirukajeevanka'lukkup pathilaaka leaviyarin mirukajeevanka'laiyum piriththedu; leaviyar ennudaiyavarka'laayiruppaarka'l; naan karththar.
israveal puththirarudaiya mutha'rpea'ruka'lil leaviyarin thokaikku athikamaayirunthu, meedkappadavea'ndiya irunoot'ru ezhupaththumoon'rupearidaththilum,
nee thalaikku ainthu seakkal veethamaakap parisuththa seakkal ka'nakkinpadi vaangkuvaayaaka; anthach seakkalaanathu irupathu kearaa.
leaviyarudaiya thokaikku athikamaanavarka'l meedkappadum thiraviyaththai aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum koduppaayaaka en'raar.
appadiyea leaviyaraal meedkappattavarka'lin thokaikku athikamaayirunthu, innum meedkappadavea'ndiyavarka'lukku eedaaka moasea israveal puththirarudaiya mutha'rpea'raanavarka'lidaththil,
aayiraththu munnoot'ru a'rupaththainthu seakkalaakiya thiraviyaththai, parisuththa sthalaththuch seakkal ka'nakkinpadi vaangki,
karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea meedkappattavarka'lin kirayaththai aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea koduththaan.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
leaviyin puththirarukku'l'lea irukki'ra koakaath puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lil,
aasarippuk koodaaraththilea vealaiseyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'la ellaaraiyum e'n'ni, thokaiyiduvaayaaka.
aasarippuk koodaaraththilea koakaath puththirarin pa'nividai makaa parisuththamaanavaika'lukkuriyathu.
paa'layam pu'rappadumpoathu, aaroanum avan kumaararum vanthu, ma'raivin thiraichseelaiyai i'rakki, athinaalea saadchiyin pettiyai moodi,
athinmeal thakasuththoal moodiyaippoattu, athinmeal mut'rilum neelamaana thuppattiyai viriththu, athin tha'nduka'laip paaychchi,

samukaththappa meajaiyinmeal neelath thuppattiyai viriththu, thattuka'laiyum thoopakkara'ndika'laiyum ki'n'nangka'laiyum mooduki'ra thattuka'laiyum athinmeal vaippaarka'laaka; niththiya appamum athinmeal irukkakkadavathu.
avaika'linmeal avarka'l sivapputh thuppattiyai viriththu, athaith thakasuththoal moodiyaal moodi, athin tha'nduka'laip paaychchi,
i'laneelath thuppattiyai eduththu, kuththuvi'lakkuththa'ndaiyum, athin akalka'laiyum, athin kaththarika'laiyum, saampal paaththirangka'laiyum, atha'rkuriya e'n'neyp paaththirangka'laiyum moodi,
athaiyum atha'rkaduththa thattumuttuka'l yaavaiyum thakasuththoal moodikku'l'lea poattu, athai oru tha'ndilea katti,
po'rpeedaththinmeal i'laneelath thuppattiyai viriththu, athaith thakasuththoal moodiyaal moodi, athin tha'nduka'laip paaychchi,
parisuththa sthalaththil vazhangkum aaraathanaikkeat'ra sakala thattumuttuka'laiyum eduththu, i'laneelath thuppattiyilea poattu, thakasuththoal moodiyinaal moodi, tha'ndinmeal katti,
palipeedaththaich saampala'ra vi'lakki, athinmeal iraththaamparath thuppattiyai viriththu,

athinmeal aaraathanaikkeat'ra sakala pa'nimuttuka'laakiya kalasangka'laiyum, mu'l thu'raduka'laiyum, saampal edukkum kara'ndika'laiyum, kalasangka'laiyum, palipeedaththi'rkaduththa ellaap paaththirangka'laiyum, athinmeal vaiththu, athinmeal thakasuththoal moodiyai viriththu, athin tha'nduka'laip paaychchakkadavarka'l.

paa'layam pu'rappadumpoathu, aaroanum avan kumaararum parisuththa sthalaththaiyum athinudaiya sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum moodith theernthapinpu, koakaath puththirar athai eduththukko'ndupoaki'ratha'rku varakkadavarka'l; avarka'l saakaathapadikkup parisuththamaanathaith thodaathirukkakkadavarka'l; aasarippuk koodaaraththilea koakaath puththirar sumakkum sumai ithuvea.

aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaran eleyaasaar, vi'lakkukku e'n'neyaiyum, sukantha thoopavarkkaththaiyum, thinanthoa'rum idum poajanapaliyaiyum, apisheaka thailaththaiyum, vaasasthalam muzhuvathaiyum, athilu'l'la yaavaiyum, parisuththa sthalaththaiyum athin pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, visaarikkakkadavan en'raar.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
leaviyarukku'l'lea koakaath vamsamaakiya koaththiraththaar azhinthupoakaathapadi paarungka'l.
avarka'l makaa parisuththamaanavaika'laik kittukaiyil, saakaamal uyiroadirukkumpadikku, neengka'l avarka'lukkaakach seyyavea'ndiyathaavathu:

aaroanum avan kumaararum vanthu, avarka'lil avanavanai avanavan seyyum vealaikkum avanavan sumakkum sumaikkum niyamikkakkadavarka'l; avarka'loa saakaathapadikkup parisuththamaanavaika'l moodappadumpoathu paarkki'ratha'rku udpiraveasiyaamal iruppaarka'laaka en'raar.
pinnum, karththar moaseayai noakki:
kersoan puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lilum aasarippuk koodaaraththilea pa'nividai vealaiseyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka,
muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'la ellaaraiyum e'n'ni, thokai eat'ruvaayaaka.
pa'nividai seyki'rathilum sumakki'rathilum kersoan vamsaththaarin vealaiyaavathu:
avarka'l vaasasthalaththukkum aasarippuk koodaaraththukkum uriya thongkuthiraiyaiyum, moodiyaiyum, avaika'linmeal irukki'ra thakasuththoal moodiyaiyum, aasarippuk koodaaravaasal ma'raivaiyum,

piraakaaraththin thongkuthiraika'laiyum, vaasasthalaththa'ndaiyilum palipeedaththa'ndaiyilum sut'rilum irukki'ra piraakaaraththinudaiya vaasal thongkuthiraiyaiyum, avaika'lin kayi'ruka'laiyum, avaika'lin vealaikkaduththa karuvika'l yaavaiyum sumanthu, avaika'lukkaakach seyyavea'ndiya yaavaiyum seyyakkadavarka'l.

kersoan puththirar sumakkavea'ndiya sumaika'lum seyyavea'ndiya pa'nividaika'laakiya sakala vealaika'lum aaroanum avan kumaararum solluki'rapadiyea seyyavea'ndum; avarka'l sumakkavea'ndiya sakala sumaika'laiyum neengka'l niyamiththu, avarka'lidaththil oppuviyungka'l.

kersoan puththirarin vamsaththaar aasarippuk koodaaraththilea seyyum pa'nividai ithuthaan; avarka'lai vealaiko'l'lum visaara'nai, aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaran iththaamaarudaiya kaikku'l irukkavea'ndum.
meraari puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lilum aasarippuk koodaaraththilea pa'nividai vealaiseyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka,
muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'la ellaaraiyum e'n'nakkadavaay.
aasarippuk koodaaraththil avarka'l seyyum ellaap pa'nividaikkum aduththa kaaval visaarippaavathu: vaasasthalaththin palakaika'lum, thaazhppaa'lka'lum, thoo'nka'lum, paathangka'lum,

sut'rilum irukki'ra piraakaaraththin thoo'nka'lum, avaika'lin paathangka'lum, mu'laika'lum, kayi'ruka'lum, avaika'lin sakala karuvika'lum, avat'ri'rku aduththa mat'rellaa vealaiyumthaanea; avarka'l sumanthu kaavalkaakkumpadi oppuvikkappaduki'ravaika'laip pearpearaaka e'n'nakkadaveerka'l.

aasaariyanaakiya aaroanudaiya kumaaranaana iththaamaarudaiya kaikku'l'laaka meraari puththirarin vamsaththaar aasarippuk koodaaraththilea seyyum pa'nividaikku aduththa ellaa vealaiyum ithuvea en'raar.
appadiyea moaseayum aaroanum sapaiyin pirapukka'lum koakaath puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'linpadi aasarippuk koodaaraththilea pa'nividai seyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka,
muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'la ellaaraiyum e'n'ninaarka'l.
avarka'l vamsangka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l ira'ndaayiraththu ezhunoot'ru aimpathupear.

karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, moaseayinaalum aaroanaalum koakaath vamsaththaaril aasarippuk koodaaraththil vealai seyki'ratha'rkaaka e'n'nith thokaiyidappattavarka'l ellaarum ivarka'lea.
kersoan puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lilum aasarippuk koodaaraththilea pa'nividai seyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka,
muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'la ellaarum e'n'nappattaarka'l.
avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l avaravar kudumpaththinpadikkum, pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadikkum ira'ndaayiraththu a'runoot'ru muppathupear.
moaseayinaalum aaroanaalum karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea kersoan puththirarin vamsaththaaril aasarippuk koodaaraththil vealaiseyya e'n'nith thokaiyidappattavarka'l ellaarum ivarka'lea.
meraari puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lilum aasarippuk koodaaraththilea pa'nividai seyyum seanaikku udpadaththakka,
muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathu'l'lavarka'l ellaarum e'n'nappattaarka'l.
avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l thangka'l kudumpangka'linpadiyea moovaayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea moaseayinaalum aaroanaalum meraari puththirarin kudumpaththaaril e'n'nith thokaiyidappattavarka'l ellaarum ivarka'lea.

leaviyarudaiya pithaakka'lin veettu vamsangka'lil muppathu vayathumuthal aimpathu vayathuvaraikkumu'l'lavarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththilea seyyum pa'nividai vealaikkum sumaiyin vealaikkum udpadaththakkavarka'lum,
moaseayinaalum aaroanaalum isravealin pirapukka'laalum e'n'nappattavarka'lum aakiya ellaarum,
e'n'naayiraththu ainnoot'ru e'npathupearaayirunthaarka'l.

karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, avarka'l thangka'l thangka'l pa'nividaikken'rum thangka'l thangka'l sumaikken'rum moaseayinaal e'n'nappattaarka'l; ivvithamaay, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea avarka'l avanaal e'n'nappattaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
kushdaroakika'l yaavaraiyum, piramiyamu'l'lavarka'l yaavaraiyum, savaththinaal theettuppattavarka'l yaavaraiyum paa'layaththilirunthu vilakkivida israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyidu.

aa'npi'l'laiyaanaalum pe'npi'l'laiyaanaalum appadippattavarka'lai neengka'l vilakki, naan vaasampa'n'nuki'ra thangka'l paa'layangka'lai avarka'l theettuppaduththaathapadikku, neengka'l avarka'laip paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampaakkividakkadaveerka'l en'raar.
karththar moaseakkuch sonnapadiyea, israveal puththirar seythu, avarka'laip paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampaakkivittaarka'l.
mealum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: oru purushanaanaalum sthireeyaanaalum, karththarudaiya katta'laiyai mee'ri manithar seyyum paavangka'lil yaathoru paavaththaich seythu kut'ravaa'liyaanaal,

avarka'l thaangka'l seytha paavaththai a'rikkaiyidakkadavarka'l; appadippattavan thaan seytha kut'raththinimiththam aparaathaththin muthaloadea ainthil oru pangkai athikamaaykkootti, thaan kut'ragnseythavanukkuch seluththakkadavan.

athaik keattu vaangkuki'ratha'rku inaththaan oruvanum illaathirunthaal, appozhuthu avanukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumpadi aattukkadaa seluththappaduvathumallaamal, karththarukku antha aparaatham seluththappattu, athu aasaariyanaich searavea'ndum.
israveal puththirar ea'reduththup padaikkumpadi aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvaruki'ra ellaap parisuththamaana padaippum avanudaiyathaayirukkum.
ovvoruvarum padaikkum parisuththamaana vasthukka'l avanudaiyathaayirukkum; oruvan aasaariyanukkuk kodukki'rathu ethuvum avanukkea uriyathu en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththirarukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: oruvanudaiya manaivi pi'rarmukam paarththu, purushanukkuth thuroakampa'n'ni,

oruvanoadea samyoakamaaych sayaniththiruntha vishayaththil ava'l theettuppattava'laayirunthum, ava'ludaiya purushan ka'nka'lukku athu ma'raikkappattu ve'likku varaamal irukki'rapoathum, saadchiyillaamalum ava'l kaiyum ka'lavumaakap pidikkappadaamalum irukki'rapoathum,

erichchalin aavi avanmeal vanthu, avan thannudaiya manaivi theettuppaduththappattirukka, theettuppaduththappatta than manaiviyinmeal kuroathangko'ndirunthaalum, allathu avan manaivi theettuppaduththappadaathirukka, erichchalin aavi avanmeal vanthu, avan ava'lmeal kuroathangko'ndirunthaalum,

anthap purushan than manaiviyai aasaariyanidaththil azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, ava'l nimiththam oru eppaa a'lavaana vaa'rkoathumai maavilea paththil oru pangkaip padaippaakak kodukkakkadavan; athu erichchalin kaa'nikkaiyum akkiramaththai ninaippoottum kaa'nikkaiyumaay iruppathinaal, athinmeal e'n'ney vaarkkaamalum thoopavarkkam poadaamalum iruppaanaaka.
aasaariyan ava'laich sameepaththil azhaiththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil ni'ruththi,
oru ma'npaa'ndaththilea parisuththa jalam vaarththu, vaasasthalaththin tharaiyilirukkum puzhuthiyilea kogncham eduththu, antha jalaththilea poattu,

sthireeyaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil ni'ruththi, ava'l mukkaattai neekki, erichchalin kaa'nikkaiyaakiya ninaippoottuthalin kaa'nikkaiyai ava'l u'l'langkaiyilea vaippaanaaka; saapakaara'namaana kasappaana jalam aasaariyan kaiyil irukkavea'ndum.

pinpu aasaariyan ava'lai aa'naiyiduviththu: oruvanum unnoadea sayaniyaamalum, un purushanukku udpattirukki'ra nee theettuppadaththakkathaayp pi'rarmukam paaraamalum irunthaal, saapakaara'namaana inthak kasappaana jalaththin thoashaththukku neengkalaayiruppaay.
un purushanukku udpattirukki'ra nee pi'rarmukam paarththu, un purushanoadeayan'ri anniyanoadea samyoakamaay sayaniththuth theettuppattiruppaayaanaal,
karththar un iduppu soompavum, un vayi'ru veengkavumpa'n'ni, unnai un janangka'lukku'l'lea saapamum aa'naiyidung ku'riyumaaka vaippaaraaka.

saapakaara'namaana intha jalam un vayi'ru veengkavum iduppu soompavum pa'n'numpadi, un kudalukku'l piraveasikkakkadavathu enki'ra saapavaarththaiyaalea sthireeyai aa'naiyiduviththuch solvaanaaka. atha'rku antha sthiree: aamen, aamen, en'ru sollakkadava'l.
pinpu aasaariyan inthach saapavaarththaika'lai oru seettil ezhuthi, avaika'laik kasappaana jalaththinaal kazhuvippoattu,
saapakaara'namaana anthak kasappaana jalaththai ava'l kudikkumpadi pa'n'nuvaan; appozhuthu saapakaara'namaana antha jalam ava'lukku'l i'rangkik kasappaakum.
pinpu aasaariyan erichchalin kaa'nikkaiyai antha sthireeyin kaiyilirunthu vaangki, athaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaatti, peedaththinmeal seluththi,
gnaapakakku'riyaaka athilea oru kaippidi ni'raiya eduththu, peedaththinmeal thakaniththu, pinpu sthireekku antha jalaththaik kudikkumpadi kodukkakkadavan.

antha jalaththaik kudikkach seythapinpu sampavippathaavathu: ava'l theettuppattu, than purushanukkuth thuroakampa'n'niyirunthaal, saapakaara'namaana antha jalam ava'lukku'l piraveasiththuk kasappu'ndaanathinaal, ava'l vayi'ruveengki, ava'l iduppu soompum; ippadiyea antha sthiree than janangka'lukku'l'lea saapamaaka iruppaa'l.
antha sthiree theettuppadaamal suththamaayirunthaal, ava'l atha'rku neengkalaaki, karppantharikkaththakkava'laayiruppaa'l.
oru sthiree than purushanoadeayan'ri anniya purushanoadea searnthu theettuppattathinaal u'ndaana erichchalukkum,

purushanmeal erichchalin aavi varuki'rathinaal, avan than manaiviyinmeal adaintha samusayaththukkum aduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea. avan karththarudaiya sannithiyil than manaiviyai ni'ruththuvaanaaka; aasaariyan inthap piramaa'naththinpadiyellaam ava'lukkuch seyyakkadavan.
