purushanaanavan akkiramaththi'rku neengkalaayiruppaan; appadippatta sthireeyoa, than akkiramaththaich sumappaa'l en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: purushanaakilum sthireeyaakilum karththarukken'ru viratham pa'n'nikko'ndavarka'laayirukkumpadi nasareaya virathamaakiya oru viseashiththa poruththanaiyaip pa'n'ninaal,

appadippattavan thiraadcharasaththaiyum mathupaanaththaiyum vilakkakkadavan; avan thiraadcharasaththin kaadiyaiyum mat'ra mathupaanaththin kaadiyaiyum, thiraadcharasaththinaal seytha evvithamaana paanaththaiyum kudiyaamalum, thiraadchappazhangka'laiyaavathu thiraadcha vat'ralka'laiyaavathu pusiyaamalum,
thaan nasareayanaayirukkum naa'lellaam thiraadchachsedi vithaimuthal thoalvaraiyilu'l'lavaika'linaal seyyappatta yaathon'raiyum pusiyaamalum irukkakkadavan.

avan nasareaya virathangkaakkum naa'lellaam savarakan kaththi avan thalaiyinmeal padalaakaathu; avan karththarukken'ru virathangkaakkum kaalam ni'raivea'ruma'lavum parisuththamaayirunthu, than thalaimayirai va'laravidakkadavan.
avan karththarukken'ru virathangkaakkum naa'lellaam yaathoru pireathaththa'ndaiyil poakakkoodaathu.

avan than theavanukken'ru seytha nasareaya viratham avan thalaimeal irukki'rapadiyaal, mara'namadaintha than thakappanaalaakilum thaayinaalaakilum sakoatharanaalaakilum sakoathariyinaalaakilum thannaith theettuppaduththalaakaathu.
avan nasareayanaayirukkum naa'lellaam karththarukkup parisuththamaayiruppaan.

avana'ndaiyilea oruvan saduthiyil mara'namadainthathinaal, nasareaya virathamu'l'la avanudaiya thalai theettuppattatheayaakil, avan than suththikarippin naa'laakiya eazhaam naa'lil than thalaimayiraich siraiththukko'ndu,
ettaam naa'lil ira'ndu kaattuppu'raakka'laiyaavathu ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil aasaariyanidaththil ko'nduvarakkadavan.

appozhuthu aasaariyan on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum seluththi, pi'naththinaal avanukku u'ndaana theettai nivirththiseythu, avan thalaiyai annaa'lil parisuththappaduththuvaanaaka.

avan thirumpavum than virathanaadka'laik karththarukken'ru kaaththu, oru varushaththu aattukkuttiyaik kut'ranivaara'napaliyaakak ko'nduvarakkadavan; avanudaiya nasareaya viratham theettuppattathinaal sen'ra naadka'l viruthaavaakum.
nasareayanukkuriya piramaa'namaavathu: avan virathangkaakkum naadka'l ni'raivea'rina an'rea, avan aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea vanthu,

sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru varushaththu pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkuttiyaiyum, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru varushaththu pazhuthat'ra oru pe'n'naattukkuttiyaiyum, samaathaanapaliyaaka pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavaiyum,

oru koodaiyil e'n'neyilea pisaintha pu'lippillaatha melliya maavinaal seytha athirasangka'laiyum, e'n'ney thadavappatta pu'lippillaatha adaika'laiyum, avaika'lukku aduththa poajanapaliyaiyum, paanapalika'laiyum karththarukkuth than kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththakkadavan.
avaika'lai aasaariyan karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu, avanudaiya paavanivaara'na paliyaiyum avanudaiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum seluththi,
aattukkadaavaik koodaiyilirukkum pu'lippillaatha appangka'loadungkoodak karththarukkuch samaathaana paliyaakach seluththi, avanudaiya poajanapaliyaiyum paanapaliyaiyum padaippaanaaka.

appozhuthu nasareayan aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea, poruththanai seyyappatta than thalaiyaich siraiththu, poruththanai seyyappatta than thalaimayirai eduththu, samaathaanapaliyinkeezh eriki'ra akkiniyil poadakkadavan.

nasareayan poruththanai seyyappatta than thalaimayiraich siraiththukko'ndapinpu, aasaariyan aattukkadaavinudaiya veavikkappatta oru munnanthodaiyaiyum, koodaiyil irukki'ravaika'lilea pu'lippillaatha oru athirasaththaiyum pu'lippillaatha oru adaiyaiyum eduththu, avanudaiya u'l'langkaika'lil vaiththu,

avaika'laik karththarudaiya sannithiyil asaivaattakkadavan; athu asaivaattappatta maarkka'ndaththoadum, ea'reduththup padaikkappatta munnanthodaiyoadum, aasaariyanaich searum; athu parisuththamaanathu. pinpu nasareayan thiraadcharasam kudikkalaam.

poruththanaipa'n'nina nasareayanukkum, avan than kaikku uthavuki'rathaiyallaamal, than nasareaya virathaththinimiththam karththarukkuch seluththum kaa'nikkaikkum aduththa piramaa'nam ithuvea. avan seytha poruththanaiyinpadiyea than poruththanaiyin piramaa'naththukkea'rka seythu theeravea'ndum en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee aaroanoadum avan kumaararoadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l israveal puththirarai aaseervathikkumpoathu, avarka'laip paarththuch sollavea'ndiyathaavathu:
karththar unnai aaseervathiththu, unnaik kaakkakkadavar.
karththar thammudaiya mukaththai unmeal pirakaasikkappa'n'ni, unmeal kirupaiyaayirukkakkadavar.
karththar thammudaiya mukaththai unmeal pirasannamaakki, unakkuch samaathaanam katta'laiyidakkadavar enpathea.
ivvithamaay avarka'l en naamaththai israveal puththirarmeal koo'rakkadavarka'l; appozhuthu naan avarka'lai aaseervathippean en'ru sol en'raar.
moasea vaasasthalaththai sthaapanampa'n'ni, athaiyum athin ellaap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, palipeedaththaiyum athin ellaap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum apisheakampa'n'ni, parisuththappaduththi mudiththa naa'lil,
thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththalaivarum, e'n'nappattavarka'lin visaarippukku vaikkappatta koaththirap pirapukka'lumaakiya isravealin pirapukka'l kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththinaarka'l.

thangka'l kaa'nikkaiyaaka, aa'ru koo'ndu va'ndilka'laiyum, pannira'ndu maaduka'laiyum, ira'ndira'ndu pirapukka'lukku ovvoru va'ndilum, ovvoru pirapukku ovvoru maadumaaka, karththarukkuch seluththa vaasasthalaththi'rku munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee avarka'lidaththil aasarippuk koodaaraththin oozhiyaththi'rkaaka avaika'lai vaangki, leaviyarukku avaravar vealaikkuth thakkavaika'laakap pangkittuk kodu en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea antha va'ndilka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum vaangki, leaviyarukkuk koduththaan.
ira'ndu va'ndilka'laiyum naanku maaduka'laiyum kersoan puththirarukku, avarka'l vealaikkuththakka pangkaakak koduththaan.

naanku va'ndilka'laiyum ettu maaduka'laiyum meraariyin puththirarukku, aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaarar iththaamaarudaiya kaiyin keezhirukki'ra avarka'ludaiya vealaikkuththakka pangkaakak koduththaan.
koakaaththin puththirarukkoa on'rum kodukkavillai; thoa'lmeal sumappathea avarka'lukkuriya parisuththa sthalaththin vealaiyaayirunthathu.
palipeedam apisheakampa'n'nappatta naa'lilea, pirapukka'l athin pirathishdaikkaakak kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththi, palipeedaththukku munpaakath thangka'l kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: palipeedaththin pirathishdaikkaaka ovvoru pirapuvum thanthan naa'lil thanthan kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththakkadavan en'raar.
appadiyea muthalaam naa'lil than kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththinavan yoothaa koaththiraththaanaakiya amminathaapin kumaaran nakasoan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu amminathaapin kumaaranaakiya nakasoanin kaa'nikkai.
ira'ndaam naa'lil isakkaarin pirapuvaakiya soovaarin kumaaran nethaneyeal kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu soovaarin kumaaranaakiya nethaneyealin kaa'nikkai.
moon'raam naa'lil ealoanin kumaaranaakiya eliyaap ennum sepuloan puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,
samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu ealoanin kumaaranaakiya eliyaapin kaa'nikkai.
naankaam naa'lil seatheayoorin kumaaranaakiya elisoor ennum roopan puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu seatheayoorin kumaaranaakiya elisoorin kaa'nikkai.
ainthaam naa'lil soorishathaayin kumaaranaakiya seloomiyeal ennum simiyoan puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

aa'raam naa'lil theakuvealin kumaaranaakiya eliyaasaap ennum kaath puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

eazhaam naa'lil ammiyoothin kumaaranaakiya elishaamaa ennum eppiraayeem puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

ettaam naa'lil pethaasoorin kumaaranaakiya kamaaliyeal ennum manaasea puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu pethaasoorin kumaaranaakiya kamaaliyealin kaa'nikkai.
onpathaam naa'lil keetheyoanin kumaaranaakiya apeethaan ennum penyameen puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu keetheyoanin kumaaranaakiya apeethaanin kaa'nikkai.
paththaam naa'lil ammishathaayin kumaaranaakiya akiyeasear ennum thaa'n puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,

samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu ammishathaayin kumaaranaakiya akiyeasearin kaa'nikkai.
pathinoaraam naa'lil oakiraanin kumaaranaakiya paakiyeal ennum aasear puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,
samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu oakiraanin kumaaranaakiya paakiyealin kaa'nikkai.
pannira'ndaam naa'lil eanaanin kumaaranaakiya akeeraa ennum napthali puththirarin pirapu kaa'nikkai seluththinaan.

avan kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: poajanapaliyaakap padaikkumporuttu e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavinaal ni'rainthathum, parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkaaka noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'lathumaana oru ve'l'liththaalamum, ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyu'l'la oru ve'l'likkalamum aakiya ivvira'ndum,
thoopavarkkam ni'raintha paththuchseakkal ni'raiyu'l'la ponninaal seytha oru thoopakara'ndiyum,
sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavum, oru vayathaana oru aattukkuttiyum,
paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum,
samaathaanapaliyaaka ira'ndu maaduka'lum, ainthu aattukkadaakka'lum, ainthu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lum, oru vayathaana ainthu aattukkuttika'lumea; ithu eanaanin kumaaranaakiya akeeraavin kaa'nikkai.

palipeedam apisheakampa'n'nappattapoathu, israveal pirapukka'laal seyyappatta pirathishdaiyaavathu: ve'l'liththaalangka'l pannira'ndu, ve'l'likkalangka'l pannira'ndu, pon thoopakara'ndika'l pannira'ndu.

ovvoru ve'l'liththaalam noot'rumuppathu seakkal ni'raiyum, ovvoru kalam ezhupathu seakkal ni'raiyumaaka, inthap paaththirangka'lin ve'l'liyellaam parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkinpadi ira'ndaayiraththu naanoo'ru seakkal ni'raiyaayirunthathu.

thoopavarkkam ni'raintha pon thoopakara'ndika'l pannira'ndu, ovvon'ru parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkinpadi paththuchseakkal ni'raiyaaka, thoopakara'ndika'lin ponnellaam noot'rirupathu seakkal ni'raiyaayirunthathu.

sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththappatta kaa'laika'lellaam pannira'ndu, aattukkadaakka'l pannira'ndu, oru vayathaana aattukkuttika'l pannira'ndu, avaika'lukkaduththa poajanapalika'lumkoodach seluththappattathu; paavanivaara'napaliyaakach seluththappatta ve'l'laattukkadaakka'l pannira'ndu.

samaathaana paliyaakach seluththappatta kaa'laika'lellaam irupaththunaanku; aattukkadaakka'l a'rupathu, ve'l'laattukkadaakka'l a'rupathu, oru vayathaana aattukkuttika'l a'rupathu; palipeedam apisheakampa'n'nappatta pinpu seyyappatta athin pirathishdai ithuvea.

moasea theavanoadea peasumpadi aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, thannoadea peasuki'ravarin saththam saadchippettiyinmealu'l'la kirupaasanamaana ira'ndu kearupeenka'lin naduvilirunthu'ndaakak keadpaan; angkea irunthu avanoadea peasuvaar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee aaroanoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: nee vi'lakkuka'lai eat'rumpoathu eazhu vi'lakkuka'lum vi'lakkuththa'ndi'rku nearea eriyavea'ndum en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapirakaaram aaroan seythu, vi'lakkuththa'ndi'rku nearea ozhungkaaka athin vi'lakkuka'lai eat'rinaan.

inthak kuththuvi'lakku, athin paathamuthal pookka'lvaraikkum ponninaal adippuvealaiyaaych seyyappattirunthathu; karththar moaseakkuk kaa'npiththa maathiriyinpadiyea avan kuththuvi'lakkai u'ndaakkinaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal santhathiyaarinin'ru leaviyaraip piriththeduththu, avarka'laich suththikarippaayaaka.

avarka'laich suththikarikkumpadi avarka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathaavathu: avarka'lmeal suththikarikkum jalaththaith the'lippaayaaka; pinpu avarka'l sarvaangka savarampa'n'ni, thangka'l vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, thangka'laich suththikarikkakkadavarka'l.
appozhuthu oru kaa'laiyaiyum, atha'rkeat'ra e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavaakiya poajanapaliyaiyum ko'nduvarakkadavarka'l; paavanivaara'napaliyaaka vea'roru kaa'laiyaiyum nee vaangki,
leaviyarai aasarippuk koodaaraththukkumun varachseythu, israveal puththirarin sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum koodivarappa'n'nuvaayaaka.
nee leaviyaraik karththarudaiya sannithiyil varappa'n'ninapoathu, israveal puththirar thangka'l kaika'lai leaviyarmeal vaikkakkadavarka'l.
leaviyar karththarukkuriya pa'nividai seyyumporuttu, aaroan avarka'lai israveal puththirarin kaa'nikkaiyaakak karththarukku munpaaka asaivaattappadum kaa'nikkaiyaay ni'ruththakkadavan.

athanpin leaviyar thangka'l kaika'laik kaa'laika'ludaiya thalaiyinmeal vaippaarka'laaka; pinpu nee leaviyarukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumporuttu, karththarukku avaika'lil on'raip paavanivaara'napaliyaakavum, mat'ron'raich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakavum seluththi,
leaviyarai aaroanukkum avan kumaaranukkum munpaaka ni'ruththi, avarka'laik karththarukku asaivaattappadum kaa'nikkaiyaakki,
ippadi nee leaviyarai israveal puththirarilirunthu piriththedukkakkadavaay; leaviyar ennudaiyavarka'laayiruppaarka'l.
ippadi avarka'laich suththikariththu, avarka'lai asaivaattum kaa'nikkaiyaakkakkadavaay; athanpinpu leaviyar aasarippuk koodaaraththil pa'nividai seyyap piraveasikkakkadavarka'l.

israveal puththirarilirunthu avarka'l enakku mut'rilum kodukkappattirukki'raarka'l; israveal puththirar ellaarilum karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakki'ra sakala mutha'rpea'rukkum pathilaaka avarka'lai enakku eduththukko'ndean.

israveal puththiraril manitharilum mirukajeevanka'lilum mutha'rpea'raanathellaam ennudaiyathu; naan ekipthutheasaththilea mutha'rpea'raana yaavaiyum sangkariththa naa'lilea avaika'lai enakken'ru parisuththappaduththi,
pinpu leaviyarai israveal puththirarilu'l'la mutha'rpea'ru sakalaththi'rkum pathilaaka eduththukko'ndu,

leaviyar israveal puththirarudaiya pa'nividaiyai aasarippuk koodaaraththil seyyumpadikkum, israveal puththirarukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumpadikkum, israveal puththirar thaangka'lea parisuththa sthalaththil searuki'rathinaal israveal puththiraril vaathaiyu'ndaakaathapadikkum, leaviyarai avarka'lilirunthu eduththu, aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum thaththamaakak koduththean en'raar.
appozhuthu moaseayum aaroanum israveal puththirarin sapaiyaar yaavarum karththar leaviyaraikku'riththu moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam leaviyarukkuch seythaarka'l.

leaviyar suththikarikkappattu, thangka'l vasthirangka'laith thoayththaarka'l; pinpu aaroan avarka'laik karththarukku munpaaka asaivaattum kaa'nikkaiyaaka ni'ruththi, avarka'laich suththikarikka avarka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seythaan.

atha'rkuppinpu leaviyar aaroanukkum avan kumaararukkum munpaaka aasarippuk koodaaraththil thangka'l pa'nividaiyaich seyyumpadi piraveasiththaarka'l; karththar leaviyaraikku'riththu moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea avarka'lukkuch seythaarka'l.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
leaviyarukkuriya katta'lai ennaven'raal: irupaththainthu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta vayathu'l'la yaavarum aasarippuk koodaaraththin pa'nividaiyaich seyyum seanaiyilea seavikka varavea'ndum.
aimpathu vayathukku mea'rpattavarka'l vealaiseyyaamal thiruppa'ni seanaiyai vittu,

aasarippuk koodaaraththin kaavalaik kaakki'ratha'rkuth thangka'l sakoathararoadeakooda oozhiyagnseyvatheayan'ri, vea'roru seavakamum seyyavea'ndiyathillai; ippadi leaviyar seyyavea'ndiya vealaika'laikku'riththuth thittampa'n'nakkadavaay en'raar.
avarka'l ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta ira'ndaam varusham muthalaam maathaththil karththar seenaay vanaantharaththil moaseayai noakki:
ku'riththa kaalaththil israveal puththirar paskaavai aasarikkakkadavarka'l.

intha maatham pathinaalaantheathi anthinearamaana vea'laiyaakiya ku'riththa kaalaththil athai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l; atha'rkuriya ellaak katta'laiyinpadiyeayum mu'raimaika'linpadiyeayum athai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l en'raar.
appadiyea paskaavai aasarikkumpadi moasea israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyittaan.

athinaal muthalaam maatham pathinaankaam theathi anthinearamaana vea'laiyil, seenaay vanaantharaththil paskaavai aasariththaarka'l; karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam israveal puththirar seythaarka'l.
annaa'lil silar manitha pireathaththinaal theettuppattapadiyinaal paskaavai aasarikkaththakaathavarka'laayirunthaarka'l; avarka'l annaa'lilea moaseakkum aaroanukkum munpaaka vanthu:

naangka'l manitha pireathaththinaal theettuppattavarka'l; ku'riththa kaalaththil israveal puththiraroadeakoodak karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththaathapadikku, naangka'l vilakkappattirukkavea'ndiyathu enna en'raarka'l.
moasea avarka'lai noakki: po'rungka'l; karththar ungka'laikku'riththuk katta'laiyiduvathu enna en'ru keadpean en'raan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: ungka'lilaakilum ungka'l santhathiyaarilaakilum oruvan pireathaththinaal theettuppattaalum, pirayaa'namaayth thoorampoayirunthaalum, karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikkavea'ndum.
avarka'l athai ira'ndaam maatham pathinaalaantheathi anthinearamaana vea'laiyil aasariththu, athaip pu'lippillaatha appangka'loadum kasappaana keeraika'loadum pusiththu,
vidiya'rkaalammattum athil on'rum meethiyaaka vaikkaamalum, athil oru elumpaiyum mu'rikkaamalum, paskaavinudaiya sakala mu'raimaika'linpadiyum athai aasarikkakkadavarka'l.

oruvan suththamu'l'lavanumaayp pirayaa'nam poakaathavanumaayirunthum, paskaavai aasarikkaatheapoanaal, antha aaththumaa ku'riththa kaalaththil karththarin paliyaich seluththaathapadiyinaal than janaththaaril iraamal a'ruppu'ndupoavaan; antha manithan than paavaththaich sumappaan.

oru paratheasi ungka'lidaththilea thangki, karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikka vea'ndumaanaal, avan athaip paskaavin katta'laippadiyum athin mu'raimaiyinpadiyum aasarikkakkadavan; paratheasikkum sutheasikkum orea katta'lai irukkavea'ndum en'ru sol en'raar.

vaasasthalam sthaapanagnseyyappatta naa'lilea, meakamaanathu saadchiyin koodaaramaakiya vaasasthalaththai moodit'ru; saayangkaalamaanapoathu, vaasasthalaththinmeal akkinimayamaana oru thoat'ram u'ndaayit'ru; athu vidiya'rkaalamattum irunthathu.
ippadi niththamum irunthathu; pakalil meakamum, iravil akkiniththoat'ramum athai moodikko'ndirunthathu.
meakam koodaaraththilirunthu mealea ezhumpumpoathu israveal puththirar pirayaa'nampa'n'nuvaarka'l; meakam thangkumidaththil israveal puththirar paa'layami'rangkuvaarka'l.

karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea israveal puththirar pirayaa'nappaduvaarka'l; karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea paa'layami'rangkuvaarka'l; meakam vaasasthalaththinmeal thangkiyirukkum naa'lellaam avarka'l paa'layaththil thangkiyiruppaarka'l.
meakam nedunaa'l vaasasthalaththinmeal thangkiyirukkumpoathu, israveal puththirar pirayaa'nappadaamal karththarin kaavalaik kaaththukko'ndiruppaarka'l.
meakam silanaa'l maaththiram vaasasthalaththinmeal thangkiyirukkumpoathu, karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea paa'layami'rangkiyirunthu, karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea pirayaa'nappaduvaarka'l.

meakam saayangkaalanthodangki vidiya'rkaalamattum irunthu, vidiya'rkaalaththil uyara ezhumpumpoathu, udanea pirayaa'nappaduvaarka'l; pakalilaakilum iravilaakilum meakam ezhumpumpoathu pirayaa'nappaduvaarka'l.

meakamaanathu ira'ndunaa'laavathu oru maathamaavathu oru varushamaavathu vaasasthalaththinmeal thangkiyirukkumpoathu, israveal puththirar pirayaa'nampa'n'naamal paa'layami'rangkiyiruppaarka'l; athu uyara ezhumpumpoathoa pirayaa'nappaduvaarka'l.

karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea paa'layami'rangkuvaarka'l; karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea pirayaa'nampa'n'nuvaarka'l; karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyiduki'rapadiyea karththarudaiya kaavalaik kaaththukko'lvaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

sapaiyaik koodivaravazhaippatha'rkum paa'layangka'laip pirayaa'nappaduththuvatha'rkum upayoakamaaka ira'ndu ve'l'lip poorikaika'laich seythuko'lvaayaaka; avaika'l orea ve'l'liththakattaal seyyappadavea'ndum.
avaika'lai oothumpoathu, sapaiyaar ellaarum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil unnidaththil koodivaravea'ndum.
on'raimaaththiram oothinaal isravealil aayiravarka'lukkuth thalaivaraakiya pirapukka'l unnidaththil koodivarakkadavarka'l.
neengka'l avaika'laip perunthoniyaay muzhakkumpoathu, kizhakkea i'rangkiyirukki'ra paa'layangka'l pirayaa'nappadakkadavathu.

avaika'lai neengka'l ira'ndaantharam perunthoniyaay muzhakkumpoathu, the'rkea i'rangkiyirukki'ra paa'layangka'l pirayaa'nappadakkadavathu; avarka'laip pirayaa'nappaduththuvatha'rkup perunthoniyaay muzhakkavea'ndum.
sapaiyaik koottuki'ratha'rku neengka'l oothavea'ndiyatheayan'ri perunthoniyaay muzhakkavea'ndaam.
aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyar poorikaika'lai oothakkadavarka'l; ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum ithu ungka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkakkadavathu.

ungka'l theasaththil ungka'laith thunpappaduththuki'ra saththuruvukku viroathamaaka yuththaththukkup poakumpoathu, poorikaika'laip perunthoniyaay muzhakkakkadaveerka'l; appozhuthu ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya samukaththilea neengka'l ninaivukoorappattu, ungka'l pakaignarukku neengkalaaki iradchikkappaduveerka'l.

ungka'l makizhchchiyin naa'lilum, ungka'l pa'ndikaika'lilum, maathappi'rappuka'lilum, ungka'l sarvaangka thakanapalika'lum samaathaanapalika'lum seluththappadumpoathu poorikaika'lai oothavea'ndum; appozhuthu avaika'l ungka'l theavanudaiya samukaththil ungka'lukku gnaapakakku'riyaayirukkum; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'raar.
ira'ndaam varusham ira'ndaam maatham irupathaam theathiyil meakam saadchiyinudaiya vaasasthalaththin meethilirunthu uyara ezhumpit'ru.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar seenaay vanaantharaththilirunthu thangka'l pirayaa'na varisaika'laayp pu'rappattaarka'l; meakam paaraan vanaantharaththil thangkit'ru.
ippadiyea karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyittapadi muthal pirayaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoothaa santhathiyaarudaiya paa'layaththin kodi avarka'l seanaika'loadea muthal pu'rappattathu; avanudaiya seanaikku amminathaapin kumaaran nakasoan thalaivanaayirunthaan.
isakkaar santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikkuch soovaarin kumaaran nethaneyeal thalaivanaayirunthaan.
sepuloan santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikku ealoanin kumaaran eliyaap thalaivanaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu vaasasthalam i'rakki vaikkappattathu; athaik kersoan puththirarum meraari puththirarum sumanthuko'ndu pu'rappattaarka'l.
atha'rkuppinpu roopan santhathiyaarudaiya paa'layaththin kodi avarka'l seanaika'loadea pu'rappattathu; avanudaiya seanaikkuch seatheayoorin kumaaran elisoor thalaivanaayirunthaan.
simiyoan santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikkuch soorishathaayin kumaaran seloomiyeal thalaivanaayirunthaan.
kaath santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikkuth theakuvealin kumaaran eliyaasaap thalaivanaayirunthaan.
koakaaththiyar parisuththamaanavaika'laich sumanthuko'ndu pu'rappattaarka'l; ivarka'l vanthu searumun mat'ravarka'l vaasasthalaththai sthaapanampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
atha'rkuppinpu, eppiraayeem santhathiyaarudaiya paa'layaththin kodi avarka'l seanaika'loadea pu'rappattathu; avanudaiya seanaikku ammiyoothin kumaaran elishaamaa thalaivanaayirunthaan.
manaasea santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikkup pethaasoorin kumaaran kamaaliyeal thalaivanaayirunthaan.
penyameen santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikkuk keetheyoanin kumaaran apeethaan thalaivanaayirunthaan.

atha'rkuppinpu, thaa'n santhathiyaarudaiya paa'layaththin kodi sakala paa'layangka'lukkum pinnaaka avarka'l seanaika'loadea pu'rappattathu; avanudaiya seanaikku ammishathaayin kumaaran akiyeasear thalaivanaayirunthaan.
aasear santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikku oakiraanin kumaaran paakiyeal thalaivanaayirunthaan.
napthali santhathiyaarudaiya koaththiraththin seanaikku eanaanin kumaaran akeeraa thalaivanaayirunthaan.
israveal puththirar pu'rappattapoathu, ivvithamaayth thangka'l thangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea pirayaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea than maamanaakiya rekuveal ennum meethiyaananudaiya kumaaranaana oapaavai noakki: ungka'lukkuth tharuvean en'ru karththar sonna sthalaththukku naangka'l pirayaa'nampoaki'roam; neeyum engka'loadeakooda vaa, unakku nanmaiseyvoam; karththar isravealukku nalla vaakkuththaththam pa'n'niyirukki'raar en'raan.
atha'rku avan: naan varakkoodaathu; en theasaththukkum en inaththaaridaththukkum poakavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu moasea: nee engka'laivittup poakavea'ndaam; vanaantharaththilea naangka'l paa'layami'rangkum idangka'lai nee a'rinthirukki'rapadiyinaal, engka'lukkuk ka'nka'laippoala iruppaay.
nee engka'loadeakooda vanthaal, karththar engka'lukkuch seytharu'lum nanmaiyinpadiyea unakkum nanmaiseyvoam en'raan.

avarka'l karththarudaiya parvathaththaivittu, moon'runaa'l pirayaa'nam poanaarka'l; moon'runaa'l pirayaa'naththilum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippetti avarka'lukku i'laippaa'rum sthalaththaith theadik kaattumpadikku avarka'lmun sen'rathu.
avarka'l paa'layaththilirunthu pirayaa'nampoaki'rapoathu, karththarudaiya meakam pakalil avarka'lmeal thangkiyirunthathu.
pettiyaanathu pu'rappadumpoathu, moasea: karththaavea, ezhuntharu'lum, ummudaiya saththurukka'l sitha'radikkappaduvaarka'laaka; ummaip pakaikki'ravarka'l umakku munpaaka oadippoavaarka'laaka enpaan.
athu thangkumpoathu: karththaavea, aneaka aayiravarka'laakiya isravealaridaththil thirumpuveeraaka en'ru solluvaan.

pinpu, janangka'l mu'raiyittuk ko'ndirunthaarka'l; athu karththarudaiya sevika'lil pollaappaayirunthathu; karththar athaik keattapoathu, avarudaiya koapam moo'ndathu; karththarudaiya akkini avarka'lukku'l'lea pat'riyerinthu, paa'layaththin kadaisiyiliruntha silaraip padchiththathu.
appozhuthu janangka'l moaseayai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; moasea karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan; udanea akkini avinthupoayit'ru.
karththarudaiya akkini avarka'lukku'l'lea pat'riyerinthathinaal, avvidaththukkuth thapearaa en'ru pearittaan.
pinpu avarka'lukku'l iruntha palajaathiyaana anniya janangka'l mikuntha ichchaiyu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l; israveal puththirarum thirumpa azhuthu, namakku i'raichchiyaip pusikkakkoduppavar yaar?
naam ekipthilea kirayamillaamal saappitta machchangka'laiyum, ve'l'larikkaayka'laiyum, kommattikkaayka'laiyum, keeraika'laiyum, ve'nkaayangka'laiyum, ve'l'laip poo'nduka'laiyum ninaikki'roam.
ippozhuthu nammudaiya u'l'lam vaadippoaki'rathu; intha mannaavaith thavira, nammudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vea'ron'rum illaiyea en'ru sonnaarka'l.
antha mannaa koththumalli vithaiyammaaththiramum, athin ni'ram muththuppoalavum irunthathu.

janangka'l poay athaip po'rukkikko'nduvanthu, eanthirangka'lil araiththaavathu uralka'lil idiththaavathu, paanaika'lil samaippaarka'l; athai appangka'lumaakach suduvaarka'l; athin rusi puthu oliva e'n'neyin rusipoalirunthathu.
iravilea paa'layaththinmeal panipeyyumpoathu, mannaavum athinmeal vizhum.

anthantha vamsangka'laich searntha janangka'l thangka'l thangka'l koodaaravaasalil nin'ru azhuki'rathai moasea keattaan; karththarukku mikavum koapam moo'ndathu; moaseayin paarvaikkum athu pollaappaayirunthathu.

appozhuthu moasea karththarai noakki: neer intha janangka'l ellaarudaiya paaraththaiyum enmeal sumaththinathinaal, umathu adiyaanukku upaththiravam varappa'n'ninathenna? ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaiyaathea poanathenna?

ivarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku naan aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththukku nee ivarka'lai mulaiyu'nki'ra paalakanaith thakappan sumanthuko'ndupoavathupoala, un maarpilea a'naiththukko'ndupoa en'ru neer ennoadea sollumpadi intha janangka'laiyellaam karppanthariththeanoa? ivarka'laip pet'rathu naanoa?
intha janangka'l ellaarukkum kodukki'ratha'rku enakku i'raichchi engkeayirunthu varum? enakku i'raichchi kodu en'ru ennaip paarththu azhuki'raarka'lea.
intha janangka'lellaaraiyum naan oruvanaayth thaangkakkoodaathu; enakku ithu mignchina paaramaayirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya ka'nka'lilea enakkuk kirupai kidaiththathaanaal, ippadi enakkuch seyyaamal, en upaththiravaththai naan kaa'naathapadikku ippozhuthea ennaik kon'rupoadum en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: israveal janangka'lukku moopparum thalaivarumaanavarka'l innaar en'ru nee a'rinthirukki'raayea, antha moopparil ezhupathupearaik kootti, avarka'lai aasarippuk koodaaraththinidaththil angkea unnoadeakooda vanthu ni'rkumpadi sey.

appozhuthu naan i'rangkivanthu, angkea unnoadea peasi, nee oruvanmaaththiram janangka'lin paaraththaich sumakkaamal, unnoadeakooda avarka'lum athaich sumappatha'rkaaka unmeal irukki'ra aaviyai avarka'lmealum vaippean.

nee janangka'lai noakki: naa'laikkaaka ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'nungka'l; neengka'l i'raichchi saappiduveerka'l; engka'lukku i'raichchi saappidak koduppavar yaar en'rum, ekipthilea engka'lukkuch saukkiyamaayirunthathu en'rum, karththarudaiya sevika'l keadka azhutheerka'lea; aakaiyaal, neengka'l saappidumpadi karththar ungka'lukku i'raichchi koduppaar.
neengka'l orunaa'l, ira'ndunaa'l, ainthunaa'l, paththunaa'l, irupathunaa'l maaththiramalla,

oru maathamvaraikkum pusippeerka'l; athu ungka'l mookkaalea pu'rappattu, ungka'lukkuth thevittippoakumattum pusippeerka'l; ungka'lukku'l'lea irukki'ra karththarai asattaipa'n'ni, naangka'l ean ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattoam en'ru avarukku munpaaka azhutheerka'lea en'ru sol en'raar.
atha'rku moasea: ennoadirukki'ra kaalaadka'l aa'ruladchampear; oru maatham muzhuvathum pusikkumpadi avarka'lukku i'raichchi koduppean en'ru sonneerea.
aadumaaduka'lai avarka'lukkaaka adiththaalum avarka'lukkup poathumaa? samuththiraththu machchangka'laiyellaam avarka'lukkaakach searththaalum avarka'lukkup poathumaa en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar moaseayai noakki: karththarudaiya kai ku'rukiyirukki'rathoa? en vaarththaiyinpadi nadakkumoa nadavaathoa en'ru, nee ippozhuthu kaa'npaay en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea pu'rappattu, karththarudaiya vaarththaika'lai janangka'lukkuch solli, janangka'lin moopparil ezhupathupearaik kootti, koodaaraththaich sut'rilum avarka'lai ni'ruththinaan.

karththar meakaththil i'rangki, avanoadea peasi, avanmealiruntha aaviyai moopparaakiya antha ezhupathupearmealum vaiththaar; antha aavi avarka'lmeal vanthu thangkinamaaththiraththil theerkkatharisanagn sonnaarka'l; solli, pinpu oaynthaarka'l.

appozhuthu ira'ndupear paa'layaththil irunthuvittaarka'l; oruvanpear elthaath, mat'ravanpear meathaath; avarka'lum pearvazhiyil ezhuthappattirunthum, koodaaraththukkup poakap pu'rappadaathirunthaarka'l; avarka'lmealum aavi vanthu thangkinathinaal, paa'layaththil theerkkatharisanagn sonnaarka'l.
oru pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan oadivanthu, elthaathum meathaathum paa'layaththil theerkkatharisanagn solluki'raarka'l en'ru moaseakku a'riviththaan.

udanea moaseayinidaththilu'l'la vaaliparil oruvanum avanudaiya oozhiyakkaaranum noonin kumaaranumaakiya yoasuvaa pirathiyuththaramaaka: en aa'ndavanaakiya moaseayea, avarka'laith thadaipa'n'num en'raan.

atha'rku moasea: nee enakkaaka vairaakkiyam kaa'npikki'raayoa? karththarudaiya janangka'l ellaarum theerkkatharisanagn sollaththakkathaaka, karththar thammudaiya aaviyai avarka'lmeal i'rangkappa'n'ninaal nalamaayirukkumea en'raan.
pinpu, moaseayum isravealin moopparum paa'layaththilea vanthu searnthaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththaridaththilirunthu pu'rappatta oru kaat'ru samuththiraththilirunthu kaadaika'lai adiththukko'nduvanthu, paa'layaththilum paa'layaththaich sut'rilum, inthappakkam orunaa'l pirayaa'namattum anthappakkam orunaa'l pirayaa'namattum, tharaiyinmeal ira'ndumuzha uyaram vizhunthukidakkach seythathu.

appozhuthu janangka'l ezhumpi, an'ru pakalmuzhuvathum, iraamuzhuvathum, ma'runaa'l muzhuvathum kaadaika'laich searththaarka'l; kognchamaaych searththavan paththu oamar a'lavu searththaan; avaika'laip paa'layaththaich sut'rilum thangka'lukkaakak kuviththuvaiththaarka'l.
thangka'l pa'rka'l naduvea irukkum i'raichchiyai avarka'l men'ru thinnumunnea karththarudaiya koapam janangka'lukku'l'lea moo'ndathu; karththar janangka'lai makaa periya vaathaiyaal vaathiththaar.
ichchiththa janangka'lai angkea adakkampa'n'ninathinaal, antha sthalaththukkuk kiproath aththaavaa en'ru pearittaan.
pinpu, janangka'l kiproath aththaavaa ennum idaththai vittu, aasaroaththukkup pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, aasaroaththilea thangkinaarka'l.

eththiyoappiyaa theasaththu sthireeyai moasea vivaakampa'n'niyirunthapadiyinaal, miriyaamum aaroanum avan vivaakampa'n'nina eththiyoappiyaa theasaththu sthireeyinimiththam avanukku viroathamaayp peasi:
karththar moaseayaikko'ndumaaththiram peasinaaroa, engka'laikko'ndum avar peasinathillaiyoa en'raarka'l. karththar athaik keattaar.
moaseayaanavan poomiyilu'l'la sakala manitharilum mikuntha saanthaku'namu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.
saduthiyilea karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum miriyaamaiyum noakki: neengka'l moon'rupearum aasarippuk koodaaraththukkup pu'rappattuvaarungka'l en'raar; moon'rupearum poanaarka'l.
karththar meakaththoo'nil i'rangki, koodaaravaasalilea nin'ru, aaroanaiyum miriyaamaiyum kooppittaar; avarka'l iruvarum poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu avar: en vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; ungka'lukku'l'lea oruvan theerkkatharisiyaayirunthaal, karththaraakiya naan tharisanaththil ennai avanukku ve'lippaduththi, soppanaththil avanoadea peasuvean.
en thaasanaakiya moaseayoa appadippattavan alla, en veettil engkum avan u'nmaiyu'l'lavan.

naan avanudan ma'raiporu'laaka alla, mukamukamaakavum piraththiyadchamaakavum peasuki'rean; avan karththarin saayalaik kaa'nki'raan; ippadiyirukka, neengka'l en thaasanaakiya moaseakku viroathamaayp peasa, ungka'lukkup payamillaama'rpoanathenna en'raar.
karththarudaiya koapam avarka'lmeal moo'ndathu; avar poayvittaar.
meakam koodaaraththai vittu neengkippoayit'ru; miriyaam u'raintha mazhaiyin ve'nmaipoan'ra kushdaroakiyaanaa'l; aaroan miriyaamaip paarththapoathu, ava'l kushdaroakiyaayirukkak ka'ndaan.
appozhuthu aaroan moaseayai noakki: aa, en aa'ndavanea, naangka'l puththiyeenamaaych seytha inthap paavaththai engka'lmeal sumaththaathirum.
than thaayin karppaththil paathi maamsam azhukich seththuvizhuntha pi'l'laiyaippoala ava'l aakaathiruppaa'laaka en'raan.
appozhuthu moasea karththarai noakki: en theavanea, ava'laik ku'namaakkum en'ru kegnchinaan.

karththar moaseayai noakki: ava'l thakappan ava'l mukaththilea kaa'rith thuppinathu'ndaanaal, ava'l eazhunaa'l vedkappadavea'ndaamoa, athupoalavea ava'l eazhunaa'l paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea vilakkappattirunthu, pinpu searththukko'l'lappadakkadava'l en'raar.
appadiyea miriyaam eazhunaa'l paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea vilakkappattirunthaa'l; miriyaam searththukko'l'lappadumattum janangka'l pirayaa'nampa'n'naathirunthaarka'l.
pinpu, janangka'l aasaroaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, paaraan vanaantharaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

naan israveal puththirarukkuk kodukkum kaanaantheasaththaich sut'rippaarppatha'rku nee manitharai anuppu; ovvoru pithaakka'lin koaththiraththilum ovvoru pirapuvaakiya purushanai anuppavea'ndum en'raar.
moasea karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea avarka'laip paaraan vanaantharaththilirunthu anuppinaan; antha manithar yaavarum israveal puththirarin thalaivarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya naamangka'laavana: roopan koaththiraththil sakkoorin kumaaran sammuvaa.
simiyoan koaththiraththil oariyin kumaaran saappaath.
yoothaa koaththiraththil eppunneayin kumaaran kaaleap.
isakkaar koaththiraththil yoaseappin kumaaran eekaal.
eppiraayeem koaththiraththil noonin kumaaran oaseayaa.
penyameen koaththiraththil rappoovin kumaaran palththi.
sepuloan koaththiraththil soathiyin kumaaran kaathiyeal.
yoaseappin koaththiraththaich searntha manaasea koaththiraththil soosin kumaaran kaathi.
thaa'n koaththiraththil kemalliyin kumaaran ammiyeal.
aasear koaththiraththil mikaavealin kumaaran seaththoor.
napthali koaththiraththil oppeasiyin kumaaran naakapi.
kaath koaththiraththil maakiyin kumaaran kooveal.
theasaththaich sut'rippaarkkumpadi moasea anuppina manitharin naamangka'l ivaika'lea; noonin kumaaranaakiya oaseayaavukku yoasuvaa en'ru moasea pearittirunthaan.
avarka'lai moasea kaanaantheasaththaich sut'rippaarkkumpadi anuppukaiyil, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippadith the'rkea poay, malaiyil ea'ri,
theasam eppadippattathen'rum, angkea kudiyirukki'ra janangka'l palavaanka'loa palaveenarka'loa, kognchampearoa aneakampearoa en'rum,

avarka'l kudiyirukki'ra theasam eppadippattathu, athu nallathoa kettathoa en'rum, avarka'l patta'nangka'l eppadippattathen'rum, avarka'l koodaarangka'lil kudiyirukki'ravarka'loa koattaika'lil kudiyirukki'ravarka'loa en'rum,

nilam eppadippattathu, athu va'lappamaanathoa i'lappamaanathoa en'rum; athil virudchangka'l u'ndoa illaiyoa en'rum paarungka'l; thairiyangko'ndirunthu, theasaththin kanika'lilea silavat'raik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan. akkaalam thiraadchachsedi mutha'rpazham pazhukki'ra kaalamaayirunthathu.
avarka'l poay, seen vanaantharanthodangki, aamaaththukkup poaki'ra vazhiyaakiya reakopmattum, theasaththaich sut'rippaarththu,

the'rkeayum sen'ru, epiroanmattum poanaarka'l; angkea eanaakkin kumaararaakiya akeemaanum seasaayum thalmaayum irunthaarka'l. epiroan ekipthilu'l'la soavaanukku eazhuvarushaththi'rkumunnea kattappattathu.

pinpu, avarka'l eskoal pa'l'laththaakkumattum poay, angkea orea kulaiyu'l'la oru thiraadchakkodiyai a'ruththaarka'l; athai oru thadiyilea ira'ndu pear kattith thookkikko'nduvanthaarka'l; maatha'lampazhangka'lilum aththippazhangka'lilum silavat'raik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
israveal puththirar angkea a'ruththa thiraadchakkulaiyinimiththam, avvidam eskoal pa'l'laththaakku ennappattathu.
avarka'l theasaththaich sut'rippaarththu, naa'rpathunaa'l sen'rapinpu thirumpinaarka'l.

avarka'l paaraan vanaantharaththil irukki'ra kaatheasukku vanthu, moasea aaroan enpavarka'lidaththilum israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaaridaththilum searnthu, avarka'lukkum sapaiyaar anaivarukkum samaasaaraththai a'riviththu, theasaththin kanika'lai avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaarka'l.
avarka'l moaseayai noakki: neer engka'lai anuppina theasaththukku naangka'l poayvanthoam; athu paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasanthaan; ithu athinudaiya kani.
aanaalum, antha theasaththilea kudiyirukki'ra janangka'l palavaanka'l; patta'nangka'l ara'nippaanavaika'lum mikavum periyavaika'lumaay irukki'rathu; angkea eanaakkin kumaararaiyum ka'ndoam.

amaleakkiyar thenpu'ramaana theasaththil kudiyirukki'raarka'l; eaththiyarum, epoosiyarum, emoariyarum malainaattil kudiyirukki'raarka'l; kaanaaniyar kadal arukeayum yoarthaana'ndaiyilum kudiyirukki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu kaaleap moaseakku munpaaka janangka'lai amarththi: naam udanea poay athaich suthanthariththukko'lvoam; naam athai e'lithaay jeyiththukko'l'lalaam en'raan.
avanoadeakoodap poayvantha manitharoa: naam poay antha janangka'loadea ethirkka nammaalea koodaathu; avarka'l nammaippaarkkilum palavaanka'l en'raarka'l.
naangka'l poaych sut'rip paarththuvantha antha theasam than kudika'laip padchikki'ra theasam; naangka'l athilea ka'nda janangka'l ellaarum mikavum periya aadka'l.

angkea iraadchathap pi'raviyaana eanaakkin kumaararaakiya iraadchatharaiyum ka'ndoam; naangka'l engka'l paarvaikku vettukki'lika'laippoal irunthoam, avarka'l paarvaikkum appadiyea irunthoam en'ru solli, ippadi israveal puththirarukku'l'lea thaangka'l sut'rip paarththuvantha theasaththaikku'riththu thurchseythi parampachseythaarka'l.
appozhuthu sapaiyaar ellaarum kookkuralittup pulampinaarka'l; janangka'l an'ru iraamuzhuthum azhuthuko'ndirunthaarka'l.

israveal puththirar ellaarum moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaaka mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l. sapaiyaar ellaarum avarka'lai noakki: ekipthutheasaththilea seththuppoanoamaanaal nalamaayirukkum; intha vanaantharaththilea naangka'l seththaalum nalam.

naangka'l pattayaththaal madiyumpadikkum, engka'l pe'njaathika'lum pi'l'laika'lum ko'l'laiyaakumpadikkum, karththar engka'lai intha theasaththukkuk ko'nduvanthathu enna? ekipthukkuth thirumpippoaki'rathea engka'lukku uththamam allavoa en'raarka'l.
pinpu avarka'l: naam oru thalaivanai ea'rpaduththikko'ndu ekipthukkuth thirumpippoavoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu moaseayum aaroanum israveal puththirarin sapaiyaaraakiya ellaak koottaththaarukkumunpaakavum mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l.
theasaththaich sut'rippaarththavarka'lil noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum, eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapum, thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu,
israveal puththirarin samastha sapaiyaiyum noakki: naangka'l poaych sut'rippaarththu soathiththa theasam makaa nalla theasam.
karththar nammeal piriyamaayirunthaal, anthath theasaththilea nammaik ko'ndupoay, paalum theanum oaduki'ra anthath theasaththai namakkuk koduppaar.

karththarukku viroathamaakamaaththiram kalakampa'n'naathirungka'l; antha theasaththin janangka'lukku neengka'l payappadavea'ndiyathillai; avarka'l namakku iraiyaavaarka'l; avarka'laik kaaththa nizhal avarka'laivittu vilakippoayit'ru; karththar nammoadea irukki'raar; avarka'lukkup payappadavea'ndiyathillai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'lmeal kalle'riyavea'ndum en'ru sapaiyaar ellaarum sonnaarka'l; udanea karththarudaiya makimai aasarippuk koodaaraththil israveal puththirar ellaarukkum munpaakak kaa'nappattathu.

karththar moaseayai noakki: ethuvaraikkum intha janangka'l enakkuk koapam u'ndaakkuvaarka'l? thangka'lukku'l'lea naan kaattina sakala adaiyaa'langka'laiyum avarka'l ka'ndum, ethuvaraikkum ennai visuvaasiyaathiruppaarka'l?
naan avarka'laik ko'l'lainoayinaal vaathiththu, suthantharaththukkup pu'rampaakkippoattu, avarka'laippaarkkilum unnaip perithum palaththathumaana jaathiyaakkuvean en'raar.
moasea karththarai noakki: ekipthiyar ithaik keadpaarka'l, avarka'l naduvilirunthu ummudaiya vallamaiyinaalea intha janangka'laik ko'nduvantheerea.

karththaraakiya neer intha janangka'lin naduvea irukki'rathaiyum, karththaraakiya neer mukamukamaayth tharisanamaaki'rathaiyum, ummudaiya meakam ivarka'lmeal ni'rki'rathaiyum, pakalil meakaththoo'nilum, iravil akkiniththoo'nilum, neer ivarka'lukku mun selluki'rathaiyum keattirukki'raarka'l; intha theasaththin kudika'lukkum solluvaarka'l.
orea manithanaik kolluki'rathupoala intha janangka'laiyellaam neer kolveeraanaal, appozhuthu ummudaiya keerththiyaik keattirukkum pu'rajaathiyaar:
karththar antha janangka'lukkuk koduppoam en'ru aa'naiyittiruntha theasaththilea avarka'laik ko'ndupoay vidakkoodaatheapoanapadiyinaal, avarka'lai vanaantharaththilea kon'rupoattaar enpaarka'lea.

aakaiyaal karththar neediya saanthamum mikuntha kirupaiyumu'l'lavar en'rum, akkiramaththaiyum mee'ruthalaiyum mannikki'ravar en'rum, kut'ramu'l'lavarka'laik kut'ramat'ravarka'laaka vidaamal, pithaakka'l seytha akkiramaththaip pi'l'laika'lidaththil moon'raam naankaam thalaimu'raimattum visaarikki'ravar en'rum, neer solliyirukki'rapadiyea,
en aa'ndavarudaiya vallamai perithaay vi'langkuvathaaka.

umathu kirupaiyinudaiya makaththuvaththinpadiyeayum, ekipthai vittathumuthal innaa'lvaraikkum intha janangka'lukku manniththuvanthathinpadiyeayum, intha janangka'lin akkiramaththai manniththaru'lum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar: un vaarththaiyinpadiyea manniththean.
poomiyellaam karththarudaiya makimaiyinaal ni'rainthirukkum en'ru ennudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.

en makimaiyaiyum, naan ekipthilum vanaantharaththilum seytha en adaiyaa'langka'laiyum ka'ndirunthum, en saththaththukkuch sevikodaamal, ithanoadea paththumu'rai ennaip pareedchaipaarththa manitharil oruvarum,
avarka'l pithaakka'lukku naan aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththaik kaa'namaattaarka'l; enakkuk koapam u'ndaakkinavarka'lil oruvarum athaik kaa'namaattaarka'l.

ennudaiya thaasanaakiya kaaleap vea'rea aaviyai udaiyavanaayirukki'rapadiyinaalum, uththamamaay ennaip pinpat'rivanthapadiyinaalum, avan poayvantha theasaththilea avanaich searappa'n'nuvean; avan santhathiyaar athaich suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarka'l.

amaleakkiyarum kaanaaniyarum pa'l'laththaakkilea kudiyirukki'rapadiyinaal, naa'laikku neengka'l thirumpich sivantha samuththiraththukkup poaki'ra vazhiyaay vanaantharaththukkup pirayaa'nampa'n'nungka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:
enakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'rukki'ra inthap pollaatha sapaiyaarai ethuvaraikkum po'ruppean? israveal puththirar enakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'rukki'rathaik keattean.
nee avarka'loadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l en sevika'l keadkach sonnapirakaaram ungka'lukkuch seyvean enpathai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar.

intha vanaantharaththil ungka'l pireathangka'l vizhum; ungka'lil irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpattavarka'laaka e'n'nappattu, ungka'l thokaikku udpattavarka'lum enakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'ruththirukki'ravarka'lumaakiya anaivarin pireathangka'lum vizhum.
eppunneayin kumaaran kaaleapum, noonin kumaaran yoasuvaavum thavira, mat'ravarka'laakiya neengka'l naan ungka'laik kudiyeat'ruvean en'ru aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththil piraveasippathillai.
ko'l'laiyaavaarka'l en'ru neengka'l sonna ungka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyoa naan athil piraveasikkach seyvean; neengka'l asattaippa'n'nina theasaththai avarka'l ka'nda'rivaarka'l.
ungka'l pireathangka'loa intha vanaantharaththilea vizhum.
avaika'l vanaantharaththilea vizhunthu theerumattum, ungka'l pi'l'laika'l naa'rpathu varusham vanaantharaththilea thirinthu, neengka'l soarampoana paathakaththaich sumappaarka'l.

neengka'l theasaththaich sut'rippaarththa naa'rpathunaa'l ilakkaththinpadiyea, ovvoru naa'l ovvoru varushamaaka, neengka'l naa'rpathu varusham ungka'l akkiramangka'laich sumanthu, en udanpadikkaikku vantha maa'ruthalai u'naruveerka'l.

karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean; enakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodina inthap pollaatha sapaiyaar yaavarukkum ippadiyea seyvean; intha vanaantharaththilea azhivaarka'l, ingkea saavaarka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
antha theasaththaich soathiththuppaarkkumpadi moaseayaal anuppappattuth thirumpi, antha theasaththaikku'riththuth thurchseythi ko'nduvanthu,
sapaiyaar ellaarum avanukku viroathamaay mu'rumu'rukkumpadi anthath thurchseythiyaich sonnavarka'laakiya antha manithar karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaathaiyinaal seththaarka'l.
theasaththaich sut'rippaarkkappoana antha manitharil noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum, eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapummaaththiram uyiroadirunthaarka'l.
moasea intha vaarththaika'lai israveal puththirar anaivaroadum sonnapoathu, janangka'l mikavum thukkiththaarka'l.
athikaalamea avarka'l ezhunthirunthu: naangka'l paavagnseythoam, karththar vaakkuththaththampa'n'nina idaththukku naangka'l poavoam en'ru solli malaiyin uchchiyil ea'raththu'ninthaarka'l.
moasea avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippadi karththarin katta'laiyai mee'ruki'rathenna? athu ungka'lukku vaaykkaathu.
neengka'l ungka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappadaathapadikku ea'rippoakaathirungka'l; karththar ungka'l naduvil iraar.

amaleakkiyarum kaanaaniyarum angkea ungka'lukkumunnea irukki'raarka'l; pattayaththinaal vizhuveerka'l; neengka'l karththarai vittup pinvaangkinapadiyaal, karththar ungka'loadea irukkamaattaar en'raan.
aanaalum avarka'l malaiyin uchchiyil ea'rath thu'ninthaarka'l; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaiyin pettiyum moaseayum paa'layaththai vittup poakavillai.
appozhuthu amaleakkiyarum kaanaaniyarum antha malaiyilea irunthu i'rangkivanthu, avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu, avarka'lai oarmaamattum thuraththinaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l kudiyirukkumpadi naan ungka'lukkuk kodukkum theasaththil neengka'l poaych searnthapinpu,

viseashiththa poruththanaiyaayaavathu, u'rchaaka paliyaayaavathu, ungka'l pa'ndikaika'lil seluththum paliyaayaavathu, karththarukku maaduka'lilaakilum aaduka'lilaakilum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyaavathu mat'ra yaathoru paliyaiyaavathu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanamaakap paliyidumpoathu,

than padaippaik karththarukkuch seluththuki'ravan sarvaangka thakanapalikkaakilum mat'rap palikkaakilum oru aattukkuttiyudanea, oru marakkaalilea paththil oru pangkum kaa'rpadi e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavin poajanapaliyaich seluththakkadavan.
paanapaliyaaka kaa'rpadi thiraadcharasaththaiyum padaikkavea'ndum.
aattukkadaavaayirunthatheayaakil, paththil ira'ndu pangkaanathum, oru padiyil moon'ril oru pangkaakiya e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavin poajanapaliyaiyum,
paanapaliyaaka oru padiyil moon'ril oru pangku thiraadcharasaththaiyum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana padaippaakap padaikkavea'ndum.
nee sarvaangka thakanapalikkaakilum, viseashiththa poruththanai palikkaakilum, samaathaana palikkaakilum, oru kaa'laiyaik karththarukkuch seluththa aayaththappaduththumpoathu,
athanoadea paththil moon'rupangkaanathum, araippadi e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavin poajanapaliyaiyum,
paanapaliyaaka araippadi thiraadcharasaththaiyum, karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaakap padaikka vea'ndum.
inthappirakaaramaakavea ovvoru maattukkaakilum, aattukkadaavukkaakilum, semma'riyaattuk kuttikkaakilum, ve'l'laattuk kuttikkaakilum seythu padaikkavea'ndum.
neengka'l padaikki'ravaika'lin ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaay ovvon'ri'rkaakavum inthappirakaaram seyyavea'ndum.
sutheasaththil pi'ranthavarka'l yaavarum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaich seluththumpoathu ivvithamaakavea seyyavea'ndum.

ungka'lidaththilea thangkiyirukki'ra anniyanaavathu, ungka'l naduvilea ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum kudiyirukki'ravanaavathu, karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali seluththavea'ndumaanaal, neengka'l seyki'rapadiyea avanum seyyavea'ndum.

sapaiyaaraakiya ungka'lukkum ungka'lidaththil thangkuki'ra anniyanukkum orea piramaa'nam irukkavea'ndum enpathu ungka'l thalaimu'raika'lil niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkakkadavathu; karththarukku munpaaka anniyanum ungka'laippoalavea irukkavea'ndum.
ungka'lukkum ungka'lidaththil thangkuki'ra anniyanukkum orea piramaa'namum orea mu'raimaiyum irukkakkadavathu en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoaki'ra theasaththil neengka'l searnthu,
theasaththin aakaaraththaip pusikkumpoathu, karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththakkadaveerka'l.

ungka'l pisaintha maavinaal seytha mutha'rpalanaakiya athirasaththai ea'reduththup padaippeerka'laaka; poaradikki'ra ka'laththin padaippai ea'reduththup padaikki'rathupoala athaiyum ea'reduththup padaikkavea'ndum.
ippadi ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum ungka'l pisaintha maavin mutha'rpalanilea karththarukkup padaippai ea'reduththup padaikkakkadaveerka'l.
karththar moaseayinidaththil sonna inthak ka'rpanaika'l ellaavat'rinpadiyum,
karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laikoduththa naa'lmutha'rko'ndu avar ungka'lukkum ungka'l santhathika'lukkum niyamiththa ellaavat'rinpadiyeayum neengka'l seyyaamal,

a'riyaamal thava'ri nadanthaalum, sapaiyaarukkuth theriyaamal yaathoru thappitham seythaalum, sapaiyaar ellaarum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyaiyum, mu'raimaippadi atha'rkeat'ra poajanapaliyaiyum, paanapaliyaiyum, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththavea'ndum.

athinaal aasaariyan israveal puththirarin sapaiyanaiththi'rkaakavum paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; athu a'riyaamaiyinaal seyyappattapadiyaalum, athinimiththam avarka'l karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaiyum paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthathinaalum, athu avarka'lukku mannikkappadum.
athu a'riyaamaiyinaalea janangka'l yaavarukkum vanthapadiyaal, athu israveal puththirarin sapaiyanaiththi'rkum avarka'lukku'l'lea thangkuki'ra anniyanukkum mannikkappadum.
oruvan a'riyaamaiyinaal paavagnseythaanaakil, oru vayathaana ve'l'laattaip paavanivaara'napaliyaakach seluththakkadavan.
appozhuthu a'riyaamaiyinaal paavagnseythavanukkaaka aasaariyan paavanivirththi seyyumpadi karththarudaiya sannithiyil paavanivirththi seyyakkadavan; appozhuthu avanukku mannikkappadum.
israveal puththiraraakiya ungka'lil pi'ranthavanukkum ungka'lukku'l'lea thangkum anniyanukkum, a'riyaamaiyinaal paavagnseythavanimiththam, orea piramaa'nam irukkavea'ndum.

an'riyum theasaththilea pi'ranthavarka'lilaakilum anniyarka'lilaakilum evanaavathu thu'nikaramaay yaathon'raich seythaal, avan karththarai ninthikki'raan; antha aaththumaa than janaththaaril iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoakavea'ndum.
avan karththarin vaarththaiyai asattaipa'n'ni, avar ka'rpanaiyai mee'rinapadiyaal, antha aaththumaa a'ruppu'ndupoakavea'ndum; avan akkiramam avanmeal irukkum en'ru sol en'raar.
israveal puththirar vanaantharaththil irukkaiyil, oayvunaa'lil vi'rakuka'laip po'rukkikko'ndiruntha oru manithanaik ka'ndupidiththaarka'l.
vi'rakuka'laip po'rukkina antha manithanaik ka'ndupidiththavarka'l, avanai moasea aaroan enpavarka'lidaththukkum sapaiyaar anaivaridaththukkum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
avanukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru theerkkamaana uththaravu illaathapadiyinaal, avanaik kaavalil vaiththaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki: antha manithan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; sapaiyaar ellaarum avanaip paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampea kalle'riyakkadavarka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu sapaiyaar ellaarum karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, avanaip paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoayk kalle'rinthaarka'l; avan seththaan.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraridaththil peasi, avarka'l thangka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum thangka'l vasthirangka'lin oarangka'lilea thongkalka'lai u'ndaakki, oaraththin thongkalilea i'laneela naadaavaik kattavea'ndum en'ru avarka'lukkuch sol.

neengka'l pinpat'rich soarampoaki'ra ungka'l iruthayaththukkum ungka'l ka'nka'lukkum ea'rka nadavaamal, athaip paarththu, karththarin ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam ninaiththu avaika'linpadiyea seyyumpadikku, athu ungka'lukkuth thongkalaay irukkavea'ndum.
neengka'l en ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam ninaiththu, avaika'linpadiyea seythu, ungka'l theavanukkup parisuththaraayirukkumpadi athaip paarppeerka'laaka.
naan ungka'lukkuth theavanaayirukkumpadi, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar; naanea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sol en'raar.

leavikkup pi'rantha koakaaththin kumaaranaakiya ithseayaarin makan koaraaku enpavan roopan vamsaththilu'l'la eliyaapin kumaararaakiya thaaththaanaiyum apiraamaiyum pealeaththin kumaaranaakiya oanaiyum koottikko'ndu,
israveal puththiraril sapaikkuth thalaivarka'lum sangkaththukku azhaikkappattavarka'lum pirapalamaanavarka'lumaakiya irunoot'ru aimpathu pearka'loadum kooda moaseakkumunpaaka ezhumpi,

moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaakak koottangkoodi, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l mignchippoaki'reerka'l; sapaiyaar ellaarum parisuththamaanavarka'l; karththar avarka'l naduvil irukki'raarea; ippadiyirukka, karththarudaiya sapaikku mealaaka ungka'lai ean uyarththuki'reerka'l en'raarka'l.
moasea athaik keattapoathu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaan.

pinpu avan koaraakaiyum avanudaiya ellaak koottaththaiyum noakki: naa'laikkuk karththar thammudaiyavan innaan en'rum, thamma'ndaiyilea searath thaam katta'laiyitta parisuththavaan innaan en'rum kaa'npippaar; appozhuthu evanaith therinthuko'lvaaroa, avanaith thammidaththil searak katta'laiyiduvaar.
on'ru seyyungka'l; koaraakea, koaraakin koottaththaarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum thoopakalasangka'lai eduththukko'ndu,

naa'laikku avaika'lil akkinipoattu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil thoopavarkkam idungka'l; appozhuthu karththar evanaith therinthuko'lvaaroa, avan parisuththavaanaayiruppaan; leaviyin puththiraraakiya neengka'lea mignchippoaki'reerka'l en'raan.
pinnum moasea koaraakai noakki: leaviyin puththirarea, kea'lungka'l;

karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththin pa'nividaika'laich seyyavum, sapaiyaarin munnin'ru avarka'l seyyavea'ndiya vealaika'laich seyyavum, ungka'laith thamma'ndaiyilea searappa'n'numpadi isravealin theavan israveal sapaiyaarilirunthu ungka'laip piriththeduththathum,
avar unnaiyum unnoadeakooda leaviyin puththiraraakiya unnudaiya ellaach sakoathararaiyum searappa'n'ninathum, ungka'lukku a'rpakaariyamoa? ippozhuthu aasaariyappattaththaiyum theaduki'reerka'loa?
itha'rkaaka neeyum un koottaththaar anaivarum karththarukku viroathamaakavea koottangkoodineerka'l; aaroanukku viroathamaaka neengka'l mu'rumu'rukki'ratha'rku avan emmaaththiram en'raan.
pinpu moasea eliyaapin kumaararaakiya thaaththaanaiyum apiraamaiyum azhaiththanuppinaan. avarka'l: naangka'l varuki'rathillai;
intha vanaantharaththil engka'laik kon'rupoadumpadi, paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththilirunthu engka'laik ko'nduvanthathu a'rpakaariyamoa, engka'lmeal thuraiththanamum pa'n'nappaarkki'raayoa?

mealum nee engka'laip paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththukkuk ko'nduvanthathum illai, engka'lukku vayalka'laiyum thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum suthantharamaakak koduththathum illai; intha manitharudaiya ka'nka'laip pidungkappaarkki'raayoa? naangka'l varuki'rathillai en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu moaseakkuk kadungkoapam moo'ndathu; avan karththarai noakki: avarka'l seluththung kaa'nikkaiyai angkikariyaathiruppeeraaka; naan avarka'lidaththil oru kazhuthaiyai muthalaay eduththukko'l'lavillai; avarka'lil oruvanukkum yaathoru pollaappu seyyavum illai en'raan.
pinpu moasea koaraakai noakki: neeyum un koottaththaar yaavarum naa'laikkuk karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaarungka'l; neeyum avarka'lum aaroanum vanthirungka'l.

ungka'lil ovvoruvarum thangka'l thangka'l thoopakalasangka'lai eduththu, avaika'lil thoopavarkkaththaip poattu, thangka'l thangka'l thoopakalasangka'laakiya irunoot'ru aimpathu thoopakalasangka'laiyum karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvaravea'ndum; neeyum aaroanum than than thoopakalasaththaik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.

appadiyea avaravar thangka'l thangka'l thoopakalasangka'lai eduththu, avaika'lil akkiniyaiyum thoopavarkkaththaiyum poattu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaaka vanthu nin'raarka'l; moaseayum aaroanum angkea nin'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku viroathamaakak koaraaku sapaiyaiyellaam aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaakak koodivarumpadi seythaan; appozhuthu karththarudaiya makimai sapaikkellaam kaa'nappattathu.
karththar moaseayoadum aaroanoadum peasi:
inthach sapaiyaivittup pirinthupoangka'l; oru nimishaththilea avarka'lai athamaakkuvean en'raar.

appozhuthu avarka'l mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: theavanea, maamsamaana yaavarudaiya aavika'lukkum theavanea, oru manithan paavam seythirukkach sapaiyaar ellaarmealum kadungkoapangko'lveeroa en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:
koaraaku thaaththaan apiraam enpavarka'ludaiya vaasasthalaththai vittu vilakippoangka'l en'ru sapaiyaarukkuch sol en'raar.
udanea moasea ezhunthirunthu, thaaththaan apiraam enpavarka'lidaththil poanaan; isravealin moopparum avanaip pinsen'ru poanaarka'l.

avan sapaiyaarai noakki: inthath thushdamanitharin sakala paavangka'lilum neengka'l vaarikko'l'lappadaathapadikku, avarka'l koodaarangka'lai vittu vilaki, avarka'lukku u'ndaanavaika'lil on'raiyum thodaathirungka'l en'raan.

appadiyea avarka'l koaraaku thaaththaan apiraam enpavarka'ludaiya vaasasthalaththai vittu vilakippoanaarka'l; thaaththaanum apiraamum ve'liyea vanthu, thangka'l pe'njaathika'l pi'l'laika'l kuzhanthaika'loadum thangka'l koodaaravaasalilea nin'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea: inthak kiriyaika'laiyellaam seyki'ratha'rkuk karththar ennai anuppinaar en'rum, avaika'lai naan en manathinpadiyea seyyavillai en'rum, neengka'l ethinaalea a'riveerka'len'raal,
sakala manitharum saaki'rapadi ivarka'l seththu, sakala manitharukkum neariduki'rathupoala ivarka'lukkum nearittaal, karththar ennai anuppavillai en'ru a'riveerka'l.

karththar oru puthiya kaariyaththai nearidachseyvathaal, poomi than vaayaith thi'ranthu, ivarka'l uyiroadea paathaa'laththil i'rangkaththakkathaaka ivarka'laiyum ivarka'lukku u'ndaana yaavaiyum vizhungkippoattatheayaanaal, intha manithar karththarai avamathiththaarka'l enpathai a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'raan.
avan intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam solli mudiththavudanea, avarka'l nin'riruntha nilam pi'lanthathu;
poomi than vaayaith thi'ranthu, avarka'laiyum avarka'l veeduka'laiyum, koaraakukkuriya ellaa manitharaiyum, avarka'lukku u'ndaana sakala poru'lka'laiyum vizhungkippoattathu.
avarka'l thangka'lukku u'ndaanavai ellaavat'roadum uyiroadea paathaa'laththil i'rangkinaarka'l; poomi avarka'lai moodikko'ndathu; ippadich sapaiyin naduvilirunthu azhinthupoanaarka'l.
avarka'laich sut'rilum iruntha isravealar yaavarum avarka'l kookkuralaikkeattu, poomi nammaiyum vizhungkippoadum en'ru solli oadinaarka'l.
akkini karththarudaiya sannithiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, thoopangkaattina irunoot'ru aimpathu pearaiyum padchiththuppoattathu.
pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki:

akkinikku'l akappatta thoopakalasangka'lai eduththu, avaika'lilirukki'ra akkiniyai appaalea kottippoadumpadi aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaran eleyaasaarukkuch sol; anthath thoopakalasangka'l parisuththamaayina.

thangka'l aaththumaakka'lukkea keadu'ndaakkina anthap paavika'lin thoopakalasangka'laip palipeedaththai moodaththakka thattaiyaana thakaduka'laay adikkakkadavarka'l; avarka'l karththarudaiya sannithiyil avaika'laik ko'nduvanthathinaal avaika'l parisuththamaayina; avaika'l israveal puththirarukku oru adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum en'raar.
appadiyea aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaar sutterikkappattavarka'l ko'nduvanthiruntha ve'nkalath thoopakalasangka'lai eduththu,

aaroanin puththiraraay iraatha anniyan oruvanum karththarudaiya sannithiyil thoopangkaatta varaathapadikkum, koaraakaippoalum avan koottaththaaraippoalum iraathapadikkum, israveal puththirarukku gnaapakakku'riyaayirukkumporuttu, karththar moaseayaikko'ndu thanakkuch sonnapadiyea avaika'laip palipeedaththai moodum thakaduka'laaka adippiththaan.
ma'runaa'lil israveal puththirarin sapaiyaar ellaarum moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaaka mu'rumu'ruththu: neengka'l karththarin janangka'laik kon'rupoatteerka'l en'raarka'l.
sapaiyaar moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaakak koodi aasarippuk koodaaraththukku nearea paarkki'rapoathu, meakam athai moodinathu, karththarin makimai kaa'nappattathu.
moaseayum aaroanum aasarippuk koodaaraththukku munpaaka vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:
inthach sapaiyaarai vittu vilakippoangka'l; oru nimishaththil avarka'lai athamaakkuvean en'raar. avarka'l mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l.

moasea aaroanai noakki: nee thoopakalasaththai eduththu, palipeedaththilirukki'ra akkiniyai athil poattu, athinmeal thoopavarkkam ittu, seekkiramaaych sapaiyinidaththil poay, avarka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi sey; karththarudaiya sannithiyilirunthu kadungkoapam pu'rappattathu, vaathai thodangkit'ru en'raan.
moasea sonnapadi aaroan athai eduththukko'ndu sapaiyin naduvil oadinaan; janangka'lukku'l'lea vaathai thodangkiyirunthathu; avan thoopavarkkam poattu, janangka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seythu,
seththavarka'lukkum uyiroadirukki'ravarka'lukkum naduvea nin'raan; appozhuthu vaathai ni'ruththappattathu.
koaraakin kaariyaththinimiththam seththavarka'l thavira, antha vaathaiyinaal seththuppoanavarka'l pathinaalaayiraththu ezhunoo'rupear.
vaathai ni'ruththappattathu; appozhuthu aaroan aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku moaseayinidaththil thirumpivanthaan.
pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea peasi, avarka'l pithaakka'lin vamsangka'laakiya ovvoru vamsaththinudaiya pirapuvinidaththil, ovvoru koalaakap pannira'ndu koalai vaangki, avanavan koalil avanavan pearai ezhuthuvaayaaka.
leaviyinudaiya koalinmeal aaroanin pearai ezhuthakkadavaay; avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lin ovvoru vamsath thalaivanukkaakavum ovvoru koal irukkavea'ndum.
avaika'lai aasarippuk koodaaraththilea naan ungka'laich santhikkum sthaanamaakiya saadchippettikku munnea vaikkakkadavaay.
appozhuthu naan therinthuko'l'luki'ravanudaiya koal thu'lirkkum; ippadi israveal puththirar ungka'lukku viroathamaay mu'rumu'rukki'ra avarka'l mu'rumu'ruppai ennaivittu ozhiyappa'n'nuvean en'raar.

ithai moasea israveal puththiraroadea sonnaan; appozhuthu avarka'ludaiya pirapukka'l ellaarum thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadi ovvoru pirapuvukku ovvoru koalaakap pannira'ndu koalka'lai avanidaththil koduththaarka'l; aaroanin koalum avarka'ludaiya koalka'ludanea irunthathu.
anthak koalka'lai moasea saadchiyin koodaaraththilea karththarudaiya samukaththil vaiththaan.

ma'runaa'l moasea saadchiyin koodaaraththukku'l piraveasiththapoathu, ithoa, leaviyin kudumpaththaarukku iruntha aaroanin koal thu'lirththirunthathu; athu thu'lirvittu, pooppooththu, vaathumaip pazhangka'laik koduththathu.

appozhuthu moasea karththarudaiya samukaththiliruntha anthak koalka'laiyellaam eduththu, israveal puththirar ellaarum kaa'na ve'liyea ko'nduvanthaan; avarka'l ka'ndu, avaravar thangka'l thangka'l koalka'lai vaangkikko'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: aaroanin koal anthak kalakakkaararukku viroathamaana adaiyaa'lamaakumporuttu, athaith thirumpavum saadchippettikku munnea ko'ndupoay vai; ippadi avarka'l enakku viroathamaay mu'rumu'ruppathai ozhiyappa'n'nuvaay, appozhuthu avarka'l saakamaattaarka'l en'raar.
karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea moasea seythaan.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar moaseayai noakki: ithoa, seththu azhinthupoaki'roam; naangka'l ellaarum azhinthupoaki'roam.
karththarin vaasasthalaththin kittea varuki'ra evanum saaki'raan; naangka'l ellaarum seththuththaan theerumoa en'raarka'l.

pinpu karththar aaroanai noakki: neeyum unnoadeakooda un kumaararum un thakappan vamsaththaarum parisuththa sthalaththaippat'riya akkiramaththaich sumakkavea'ndum; neeyum unnoadeakooda un kumaararum ungka'l aasaariya oozhiyaththaippat'riya akkiramaththaich sumakkavea'ndum.

un thakappanaakiya leaviyin koaththiraththaaraana un sakoathararaiyum unnoadea koodiyirukkavum unnidaththilea seavikkavum avarka'laich searththukko'l; neeyum un kumaararumoa saadchiyin koodaaraththukkumun oozhiyam seyyakkadaveerka'l.

avarka'l un kaavalaiyum koodaaram anaiththin kaavalaiyum kaakkakkadavarka'l; aakilum avarka'lum neengka'lum saakaathapadikku, avarka'l parisuththa sthalaththin pa'nimuttuka'la'ndaiyilum palipeedaththa'ndaiyilum searaamal,
unnoadea koodikko'ndu, koodaaraththukkaduththa ellaap pa'nividaiyaiyum seyya, aasarippuk koodaaraththin kaavalaik kaakkakkadavarka'l; anniyan oruvanum ungka'lidaththil searakkoodaathu.
israveal puththirarmeal inik kadungkoapam varaathapadikku, neengka'l parisuththa sthalaththin kaavalaiyum palipeedaththin kaavalaiyum kaakkakkadaveerka'l.

aasarippuk koodaaraththin pa'nividaiyaich seyya, karththarukkuk kodukkappatta ungka'l sakoathararaakiya leaviyarai naan israveal puththirarilirunthu piriththu, ungka'lukkuth thaththamaakak koduththean.

aakaiyaal neeyum unnoadeakooda un kumaararum palipeedaththukkum thiraikku udpu'raththukkum aduththa ellaavat'raiyum seyyumporuttu, ungka'l aasaariya oozhiyaththaik kaaththuch seavikkakkadaveerka'l; ungka'l aasaariya oozhiyaththai ungka'lukku thaththamaaka aru'linean; athaich seyyumpadi searuki'ra anniyan kolaiseyyappadakkadavan en'raar.

pinnum karththar aaroanai noakki: israveal puththirar parisuththappaduththuki'ravaika'lilellaam enakku ea'reduththup padaikkappadum padaippuka'laik kaaththukko'ndirukki'reerka'lea, avaika'lai unakkuk koduththean; apisheakaththinimiththam avaika'lai unakkum un kumaararukkum niththiya katta'laiyaakak koduththean.

makaa parisuththamaanavaika'lilea, akkinikku udpaduththappadaamal unnudaiyathaayiruppathu evaiyenil, avarka'l enakkup padaikkum ellaap padaippum, ellaap poajanapaliyum, ellaap paavanivaara'napaliyum, ellaak kut'ranivaara'napaliyum, unakkum un kumaararukkum parisuththamaayirukkum.
parisuththa sthalaththilea avaika'laip pusikkavea'ndum; aa'nmakka'l yaavarum avaika'laip pusikkalaam; avaika'l unakkup parisuththamaayiruppathaaka.

israveal puththirar ea'reduththup padaikki'rathum asaivaattuki'rathumaana avarka'ludaiya ellaak kaa'nikkaika'lin padaippum unnudaiyavaika'laayirukkum; avaika'lai unakkum un kumaararukkum un kumaaraththika'lukkum niththiya niyamamaakak koduththean; un veettilea suththamaanavarka'l ellaarum avaika'laip pusikkalaam.
avarka'l karththarukkuk kodukkum avarka'ludaiya mutha'rpalanka'laakiya uchchithamaana e'n'neyaiyum, uchchithamaana thiraadcharasaththaiyum, thaaniyaththaiyum unakku uriyathaakak koduththean.
thangka'l theasaththil mutha'rpazhuththa palanil avarka'l karththarukkuk ko'nduvaruvathellaam unakku uriyathaakum; un veettilea suththamaayiruppavarka'l yaavarum avaika'laip pusikkalaam.
isravealilea saapaththeedaaka nearnthuko'l'lappattathellaam unakku uriyathaayirukkum.

manitharilum mirukangka'lilum avarka'l karththarukkuch seluththum samastha piraa'nika'lukku'l'lea karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakkum yaavum unakku uriyathaayirukkum; aanaalum manitharin mutha'rpeat'rai akaththiyamaay meedkavea'ndum; theettaana mirukajeevanin thalaiyeet'raiyum meedkavea'ndum.

meedkavea'ndiyavaika'l oru maathaththi'rku mea'rpattathaanaal, un mathippukku isaiya parisuththa sthalaththin seakkal ka'nakkinpadi ainthu seakkal pa'naththaalea avaika'lai meedkavea'ndum; oru seakkal irupathu kearaa.

maattin thalaiyeet'rum, semma'riyaattin thalaiyeet'rum, ve'l'laattin thalaiyeet'rumoa meedkappadavea'ndaam; avaika'l parisuththamaanavaika'l; avaika'lin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal the'liththu, avaika'lin kozhuppaik karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanamaakath thakanikkavea'ndum.
asaivaattum maarkka'ndaththaippoalum valathu munnanthodaiyaippoalum avaika'lin maamsamum unnudaiyathaakum.

israveal puththirar karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikki'ra parisuththa padaippuka'laiyellaam unakkum un kumaararukkum un kumaaraththika'lukkum niththiya katta'laiyaakak koduththean; karththarudaiya sannithiyil ithu unakkum un santhathikkum en'raikkum sellum maa'raatha udanpadikkai en'raar.

pinnum karththar aaroanai noakki: avarka'ludaiya theasaththil nee on'raiyum suthanthariththukko'l'lavea'ndaam, avarka'l naduvea unakkup pangku u'ndaayirukkavum vea'ndaam; israveal puththirar naduvil naanea un pangkum un suthantharamumaay irukki'rean.

ithoa, leaviyin puththirar aasarippuk koodaaraththin pa'nividaiyaich seyki'ra avarka'ludaiya vealaikkaaka, isravealarukku'l'lavai ellaavat'rilum thasamapaakaththai avarka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththean.
israveal puththirar kut'ragnsumanthu saakaathapadikku, ini aasarippuk koodaaraththaik kittaathirukkakkadavarka'l.

leaviyarmaaththiram aasarippuk koodaaraththukkaduththa vealaika'laich seyyavea'ndum; avarka'l thangka'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarka'l; israveal puththirar naduvea avarka'lukkuch suthantharam illai enpathu ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkum.

israveal puththirar karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippaakiya thasamapaakaththai leaviyarukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththean; aakaiyaal israveal puththirarin naduvea avarka'lukkuch suthantharamillaiyen'ru avarka'lukkuch sonnean en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee leaviyaroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal puththirar kaiyil vaangkikko'l'lumpadi naan ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththa thasamapaakaththai neengka'l avarka'l kaiyil vaangkumpoathu, thasamapaakaththil paththil oru pangkaik karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippaakach seluththavea'ndum.
neengka'l ea'reduththup padaikkum inthap padaippu ka'laththin thaaniyaththaippoalum, aalaiyin irasaththaippoalum ungka'lukku e'n'nappadum.

ippadiyea neengka'l israveal puththirar kaiyil vaangkum thasamapaakamaakiya ungka'l pangkuka'lilellaam neengka'lum karththarukku en'ru oru padaippai ea'reduththup padaiththu, anthap padaippai aasaariyanaakiya aaroanukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
ungka'lukkuk kodukkappaduki'ra ovvoru kaa'nikkaiyilumu'l'la uchchithamaana parisuththa pangkaiyellaam karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippaakach seluththavea'ndum.

aathalaal nee avarka'loadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: athil uchchithamaanathai neengka'l ea'reduththup padaikkumpoathu, athu ka'laththin varaththilum aalaiyin varaththilum irunthu eduththuch seluththuki'rathupoala leaviyarukku e'n'nappadum.
athai neengka'lum ungka'l kudumpaththaarum evvidaththilum pusikkalaam; athu neengka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththilea seyyum pa'nividaikku eedaana ungka'l sampa'lam.

ippadi athil uchchithamaanathai ea'reduththup padaiththeerka'laanaal, neengka'l athinimiththam paavam sumakkamaatteerka'l; neengka'l saakaathirukkumpadikku, israveal puththirarin parisuththamaanavaika'laith theettuppaduththalaakaathu en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:

karththar ka'rpiththa niyamappiramaa'namaavathu: pazhuthat'rathum oonamillaathathum nukaththadikku udpadaathathumaakiya sivappaana oru kidaariyai unnidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi israveal puththirarukkuch sollungka'l.
athai eleyaasaar ennum aasaariyanidaththil oppukkodungka'l; avan athaip paa'layaththukku ve'liyea ko'ndupoakakkadavan; angkea athu avanukku munpaakak kollappadakkadavathu.
appozhuthu aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaar than viralinaal athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, aasarippuk koodaaraththukku ethiraaka eazhutharam the'likkakkadavan.
pinpu kidaariyai avan ka'nka'lukku munpaaka oruvan sutterikkavea'ndum; athin thoalum athin maamsamum athin iraththamum athin saa'niyum sutterikkappadavea'ndum.
appozhuthu aasaariyan keathuruk kattaiyaiyum eesoappaiyum sivappu noolaiyum eduththu, kidaari erikkappaduki'ra neruppin naduvilea poadakkadavan.
pinpu aasaariyan than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, jalaththilea snaanampa'n'ni, athinpinpu paa'layaththil piraveasikkakkadavan; aasaariyan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
athaich sutteriththavanum than vasthirangka'lai jalaththil thoayththu, jalaththilea snaanampa'n'ni, saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.

suththamaayirukki'ra oruvan anthak kidaariyin saampalai vaarikko'ndu, paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampea suththamaana oru idaththilea kottivaikkakkadavan; athu israveal puththirarin sapaikkaakath theettukkazhikkum jalaththukken'ru kaaththu vaikkappadavea'ndum; athu paavaththaip parikarikkum.

kidaariyin saampalai vaarinavan than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; avan saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; ithu israveal puththirarukkum avarka'l naduvilea thangkuki'ra anniyanukkum niththiya katta'laiyaayiruppathaaka.
seththuppoanavanudaiya pireathaththaith thottavan eazhunaa'l theettuppattiruppaan.

avan moon'raam naa'lilum eazhaam naa'lilum theettukkazhikkum jalaththinaal thannaich suththikarikkakkadavan; appozhuthu suththamaavaan; moon'raam naa'lilum eazhaam naa'lilum thannaich suththikarikkaamaliruppaanaakil suththamaakaan.

seththavanudaiya pireathaththaith thottum, thannaich suththikariththukko'l'laathavan karththarin vaasasthalaththaith theettuppaduththuki'raan; antha aaththumaa isravealil iraamal a'ruppu'ndupoavaan; theettukkazhikkum jalam avanmeal the'likkappadaathathinaal, avan theettuppattiruppaan; avan theettu innum avanmeal irukkum.
koodaaraththil oru manithan seththaal, atha'rkaduththa niyamamaavathu: anthak koodaaraththil piraveasikki'ra yaavarum koodaaraththil irukki'ra yaavarum eazhunaa'l theettuppattiruppaarka'l.
moodik kattappadaamal thi'ranthirukkum paaththirangka'l ellaam theettuppattirukkum.
ve'liyilea pattayaththaal vettu'ndavanaiyaavathu, seththavanaiyaavathu, manitha elumpaiyaavathu, pireathakkuzhiyaiyaavathu, thottavan evanum eazhunaa'l theettuppattiruppaan.
aakaiyaal theettuppattavanukkaaka, paavaththaip parikarikkum kidaariyin saampalilea kogncham eduththu, oru paaththiraththil poattu, athinmeal oot'ru jalam vaarkkavea'ndum.
