suththamaana oruvan eesoappai eduththu, antha jalaththilea thoayththu, koodaaraththinmealum athilu'l'la sakala pa'nimuttuka'linmealum angkeayirukki'ra janangka'linmealum the'likki'rathumallaamal, elumpaiyaakilum vettu'ndavanaiyaakilum seththavanaiyaakilum pireathakkuzhiyaiyaakilum thottavanmealum the'likkakkadavan.

suththamaayirukki'ravan theettuppattavanmeal moon'raam naa'lilum eazhaam naa'lilum the'likkavea'ndum; eazhaam naa'lil ivan thannaich suththikariththu, than vasthirangka'laith thoayththu, jalaththil snaanampa'n'ni, saayangkaalaththilea suththamaayiruppaan.

theettuppattirukki'ravan thannaich suththikariththukko'l'laathirunthaal, avan sapaiyil iraathapadikku a'ruppu'ndupoavaan; avan karththarin parisuththa sthalaththaith theettuppaduththinaan; theettukkazhikkum jalam avanmeal the'likkappadaathathinaal avan theettuppattirukki'raan.
theettukkazhikkum jalaththaith the'likki'ravanum than vasthirangka'laith thoaykkakkadavan; theettukkazhikkum jalaththaith thottavanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan.
theettuppattirukki'ravan thoduki'ravaika'lellaam theettuppadum, avaika'laith thoduki'ravanum saayangkaalamattum theettuppattiruppaan; ithu ungka'lukku niththiya katta'laiyaayirukkum en'raar.

israveal puththirarin sapaiyaar ellaarum muthalaam maathaththil seenvanaantharaththilea searnthu, janangka'l kaatheasilea thangkiyirukkaiyil, miriyaam mara'namadainthu, angkea adakkampa'n'nappattaa'l.
janangka'lukkuth tha'n'neer illaathirunthathu; appozhuthu avarka'l moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaakak koottangkoodinaarka'l.
janangka'l moaseayoadea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ni: engka'l sakoatharar karththarudaiya sannithiyil maa'ndapoathu naangka'lum maa'ndupoayirunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
naangka'lum engka'l mirukangka'lum ingkea saakumpadi, neengka'l karththarin sapaiyai intha vanaantharaththilea ko'nduvanthathu enna;

vithaippum, aththimaramum, thiraadchachsediyum, maatha'lagnsediyum, kudikkaththa'n'neerum illaatha inthak ketta idaththil engka'laik ko'nduvarumpadi, neengka'l engka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathu enna en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moaseayum aaroanum sapaiyaaraivittu, aasarippuk koodaaravaasalil poay, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l; karththarudaiya makimai avarka'lukkuk kaa'nappattathu.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee koalai eduththukko'ndu, neeyum un sakoatharanaakiya aaroanum sapaiyaaraik koodivarachseythu, avarka'l ka'nka'lukkumunnea kanmalaiyaip paarththup peasungka'l; appozhuthu athu thannidaththilu'l'la tha'n'neeraik kodukkum; ippadi nee avarka'lukkuk kanmalaiyilirunthu tha'n'neer pu'rappadappa'n'ni, sapaiyaarukkum avarka'l mirukangka'lukkum kudikkak koduppaay en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea thanakkuk karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea karththarudaiya sannithiyiliruntha koalai eduththaan.

moaseayum aaroanum sapaiyaaraik kanmalaikku munpaakak koodivarachseythaarka'l; appozhuthu moasea avarka'lai noakki: kalakakkaararea, kea'lungka'l, ungka'lukku inthak kanmalaiyilirunthu naangka'l tha'n'neer pu'rappadappa'n'nuvoamoa en'ru solli,
than kaiyai oangki, kanmalaiyaith than koalinaal ira'ndutharam adiththaan; udanea tha'n'neer earaa'lamaayp pu'rappattathu, sapaiyaar kudiththaarka'l; avarka'l mirukangka'lum kudiththathu.

pinpu karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki: israveal puththirarin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ennaip parisuththampa'n'numpadi, neengka'l ennai visuvaasiyaama'r poanapadiyinaal, inthach sapaiyaarukku naan koduththa theasaththukku'l neengka'l avarka'laik ko'ndupoavathillai en'raar.
ingkea israveal puththirar karththaroadea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninathinaalum, avarka'lukku'l'lea avarudaiya parisuththam vi'langkinathinaalum ithu mearipaavin tha'n'neer ennappattathu.
pinpu moasea kaatheasilirunthu eathoamin raajaavinidaththukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:

engka'l pithaakka'l ekipthukkup poanathum, naangka'l ekipthilea nedunaa'l vaasampa'n'ninathum, ekipthiyar engka'laiyum engka'l pithaakka'laiyum upaththiravappaduththinathum, ivaika'linaal engka'lukku nearitta ellaa varuththamum umakkuth therinthirukki'rathu.

karththarai noakki naangka'l man'raadinoam; avar engka'lukkuch sevikoduththu, oru thoothanai anuppi, engka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; ippozhuthu naangka'l umathu ellaikku udpatta kaatheas ooril vanthirukki'roam.

naangka'l umathu theasaththin vazhiyaayk kadanthupoakumpadi uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum; vayalve'lika'l vazhiyaakavum, thiraadchaththoattangka'l vazhiyaakavum naangka'l poakaamalum, thuravuka'lin tha'n'neeraik kudiyaamalum, raajapaathaiyaakavea nadanthu, umathu ellaiyaik kadanthupoakumattum, valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaathiruppoam en'ru, umathu sakoatharanaakiya israveal solli anuppuki'raan en'ru sollachsonnaan.
atha'rku eathoam: nee en theasaththin vazhiyaayk kadanthupoakakkoodaathu; poanaal pattayaththoadea unnai ethirkkap pu'rappaduvean en'ru avanukkuch sollachsonnaan.

appozhuthu israveal puththirar avanai noakki: nadappaana paathaiyin vazhiyaayp poavoam; naangka'lum engka'l mirukangka'lum un tha'n'neeraik kudiththaal, atha'rkuk kirayangkoduppoam; vea'ron'rum seyyaamal, kaalnadaiyaay maaththiram kadanthupoavoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: nee kadanthupoakakkoodaathu en'ru solli, veku janangka'loadum palaththa kaiyoadum avarka'lai ethirkkap pu'rappattaan.
ippadi eathoam than ellaivazhiyaayk kadanthupoakumpadi isravealarukku uththaravu kodukkavillai; aakaiyaal isravealar avanai vittu vilakippoanaarka'l.
israveal puththiraraana sapaiyaar ellaarum kaatheasai vittup pirayaa'nappattu, oar ennum malaikkup poanaarka'l.
eathoam theasaththin ellaikku arukaana oar ennum malaiyilea karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum noakki:

aaroan than janaththaaroadea searkkappaduvaan. mearipaavin tha'n'neeraippat'riya kaariyaththil neengka'l en vaakkukkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoanapadiyinaal, naan israveal puththirarukkuk kodukki'ra theasaththil avan piraveasippathillai.
nee aaroanaiyum avan kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaaraiyum koottikko'ndu, avarka'lai oar ennum malaiyil ea'rappa'n'ni,
aaroan uduththirukki'ra vasthirangka'laik kazhat'ri, avaika'lai avan kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaarukku uduththuvaayaaka; aaroan angkea mariththu, than janaththaaroadea searkkappaduvaan en'raar.
karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea moasea seythaan; sapaiyaar ellaarum paarkka, avarka'l oar ennum malaiyil ea'rinaarka'l.

angkea aaroan uduththiruntha vasthirangka'lai moasea kazhat'ri, avaika'lai avan kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaarukku uduththinaan; appozhuthu aaroan angkea malaiyin uchchiyilea mariththaan; pinpu moaseayum eleyaasaarum malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinaarka'l.
aaroan jeeviththuppoanaan enpathaich sapaiyaar ellaarum ka'ndapoathu, israveal vamsaththaar ellaarum aaroanukkaaka muppathu naa'l thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.

veavukaarar kaa'npiththa vazhiyaaka isravealar varuki'raarka'l en'ru the'rkea vaasampa'n'nuki'ra kaanaaniyanaakiya aaraath raajaa kea'lvippattapoathu, avan isravealarukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, avarka'lil silaraich si'raipidiththukko'ndupoanaan.
appozhuthu isravealar karththarai noakki: theavareer intha janangka'lai engka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaal, avarka'ludaiya patta'nangka'laich sangkaaram pa'n'nuvoam en'ru pirathikkinai pa'n'ninaarka'l.

karththar isravealin saththaththukkuch sevikoduththu, avarka'lukkuk kaanaaniyarai oppukkoduththaar; appozhuthu avarka'laiyum avarka'l patta'nangka'laiyum sangkaarampa'n'ni, avvidaththi'rku oarmaa en'ru pearittaarka'l.
avarka'l eathoam theasaththaich sut'rippoakumpadikku, oar ennum malaiyaivittu, sivantha samuththiraththin vazhiyaayp pirayaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l; vazhiyinimiththam janangka'l manamadivadainthaarka'l.

janangka'l theavanukkum moaseakkum viroathamaakap peasi: naangka'l vanaantharaththilea saakumpadi neengka'l engka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ninathenna? ingkea appamum illai, tha'n'neerum illai; intha a'rpamaana u'navu engka'l manathukku ve'ruppaayirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar ko'l'livaaych sarppangka'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea anuppinaar; avaika'l janangka'laik kadiththathinaal isravealarukku'l'lea aneaka janangka'l seththaarka'l.

athinaal janangka'l moaseayinidaththil poay: naangka'l karththarukkum umakkum viroathamaayp peasinathinaal paavagnseythoam; sarppangka'l engka'laivittu neengkumpadi karththarai noakki vi'n'nappam pa'n'navea'ndum en'raarka'l; moasea janangka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee oru ko'l'livaaych sarppaththin uruvaththaich seythu, athai oru kampaththinmeal thookkivai; kadikkappattavan evanoa avan athai noakkippaarththaal pizhaippaan en'raar.

appadiyea moasea oru ve'nkalach sarppaththai u'ndaakki, athai oru kampaththinmeal thookkivaiththaan; sarppam oruvanaik kadiththapoathu, avan antha ve'nkalach sarppaththai noakkippaarththup pizhaippaan.
israveal puththirar pirayaa'nappattuppoay, oapoaththil paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
oapoaththilirunthu pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, sooriyoathayaththi'rku nearaay moavaapukku ethiraana vanaantharaththilu'l'la apaareemin meaduka'lil paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
angkeayirunthu pirayaa'nappattuppoay, saareath pa'l'laththaakkilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

angkeayirunthu pirayaa'nappattuppoay, emoariyarin ellaiyilirunthu varuki'rathum vanaantharaththil oaduki'rathumaana arnoan aat'rukku ippu'ram paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; antha arnoan moavaapukkum emoariyarukkum naduvea irukki'ra moavaapin ellai.
athinaal sooppaavilu'l'la vaakeapum, arnoanin aat'rukkaalka'lum,
aar ennum sthalaththukkup paayum neeroadaiyum moavaapin ellaiyaich saarnthirukki'rathu ennum vasanam karththarudaiya yuththa pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
angkeayirunthu peayearukkup poanaarka'l; janangka'laik koodivarachsey, avarka'lukkuth tha'n'neer koduppean en'ru karththar moaseakkuch sonna oot'ru irukki'ra idam athuthaan.
appozhuthu isravealar paadina paattaavathu: oot'ruth tha'n'neerea, pongkivaa; athaikku'riththup paaduvoam vaarungka'l.
niyaayappiramaa'nikkanin eavuthalaal athipathika'l ki'nat'raith thoa'ndinaarka'l; janaththil meanmakka'l thangka'l tha'ndaayuthangka'laikko'ndu thoa'ndinaarka'l en'ru paadinaarka'l.
antha vanaantharaththilirunthu maaththanaavukkum, maaththanaavilirunthu nakaaliyealukkum, nakaaliyealilirunthu paamoaththukkum,
pa'l'laththaakkilu'l'la moavaapin ve'liyil irukki'ra paamoaththilirunthu eshimoanai noakkum piskaavin uchchikkum poanaarka'l.
appozhuthu isravealar emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanidaththil sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:

umathu theasaththin vazhiyaayk kadanthupoakumpadi uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum; naangka'l vayalka'lilum, thiraadchaththoattangka'lilum poakaamalum, thuravuka'lin tha'n'neeraik kudiyaamalum, umathu ellaiyaik kadanthupoakumattum raajapaathaiyil nadanthupoavoam en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.

seekoan than ellaivazhiyaayk kadanthupoaka isravealukku uththaravu kodaamal, than janangka'lellaaraiyum koottikko'ndu, isravealarukku viroathamaaka vanaantharaththilea pu'rappattu, yaakaasukku vanthu, isravealaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaan.

isravealar avanaip pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, arnoan thodangki ammoan puththirarin theasaththaichsaarntha yaappoakkuvaraikkumu'l'la avanudaiya theasaththaik kattikko'ndaarka'l; ammoan puththirarin ellai ara'nippaanathaayirunthathu.
isravealar anthap patta'nangka'l yaavaiyum pidiththu, espoanilum athaich saarntha ellaak kiraamangka'lilum emoariyarudaiya ellaap patta'nangka'lilum kudiyirunthaarka'l.

espoanaanathu emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanin patta'namaayirunthathu; avan moavaapiyarin munthina raajaavukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, arnoanvaraikkum iruntha avan theasaththaiyellaam avan kaiyilirunthu pa'riththukko'ndaan.
athinaalea kavikattuki'ravarka'l: espoanukku vaarungka'l; seekoanin patta'nam sthiramaayk kattappaduvathaaka.
espoanilirunthu akkiniyum seekoanudaiya patta'naththilirunthu juvaalaiyum pu'rappattu, moavaapudaiya aar ennum ooraiyum, arnoanudaiya meaduka'lilu'l'la aa'ndavamaarka'laiyum padchiththathu.
aiyoa, moavaapea, keamoash theavanin janamea, nee naasamaanaay; thappi oadina than kumaararaiyum than kumaaraththika'laiyum emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanukkuch si'raika'laaka oppukkoduththaan.
avarka'lai eythupoattoam; espoan patta'nam theepoan oorvaraikkum naasamaayit'ru; meatheapaavukkuch sameepamaana noappaa patta'napariyantham avarka'laip paazhaakkinoam en'ru paadinaarka'l.
isravealar ippadiyea emoariyarin theasaththilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
pinpu, moasea yaasear patta'naththukku veavu paarkki'ravarka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'l athaichsearntha kiraamangka'laik kattikko'ndu, angkea iruntha emoariyaraith thuraththivittaarka'l.

pinpu paasaanukkup poaki'ra vazhiyaayth thirumpivittaarka'l; appozhuthu paasaan raajaavaakiya oak enpavan than samastha janangka'loadum avarka'lai ethirththu yuththampa'n'numpadikku, ethreayukkup pu'rappattu vanthaan.

karththar moaseayai noakki: avanukkup payappadavea'ndaam; avanaiyum avan janangka'l ellaaraiyum, avan theasaththaiyum un kaiyil oppukkoduththean; espoanilea vaasamaayiruntha emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanukku nee seythapadiyea ivanukkum seyvaay en'raar.
appadiyea oruvarum uyirudan meethiyaayiraathapadikku avanaiyum, avan kumaararaiyum, avanudaiya sakala janangka'laiyum vettippoattu, avan theasaththaik kattikko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu israveal puththirar pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, erikoavin kitta irukkum yoarthaanukku ikkaraiyilea moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
isravealar emoariyarukkuch seytha yaavaiyum sippoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaak ka'ndaan.
janangka'l earaa'lamaayirunthapadiyinaal, moavaap mikavum payanthu, israveal puththirarinimiththam kalakkamadainthu,

meethiyaaniyarin moopparai noakki: maadu ve'liyin pullai meayki'rathupoala, ippozhuthu inthak koottam nammaich sut'riyirukki'ra yaavaiyum meaynthupoadum en'raan. akkaalaththilea sippoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaak moavaapiyarukku raajaavaayirunthaan.

avan peayoarin kumaaranaakiya pileayaamai azhaiththuvarumpadi, than santhathiyaarudaiya theasaththil nathiyarukeayu'l'la peththoorukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: ekipthilirunthu oru janakkoottam vanthirukki'rathu; avarka'l poomiyin visaalaththai moodi, enakku ethirea i'rangkiyirukki'raarka'l.

avarka'l ennilum palavaanka'l; aakilum, neer aaseervathikki'ravan aaseervathikkappattavan, neer sapikki'ravan sapikkappattavan en'ru a'rivean; aathalaal, neer vanthu, enakkaaka antha janaththaich sapikkavea'ndum; appozhuthu oruvea'lai naan avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu, avarka'lai iththeasaththilirunthu thuraththividalaam en'ru sollachsonnaan.

appadiyea moavaapin moopparum meethiyaanin moopparum ku'risolluthalukkuriya kooliyaith thangka'l kaiyil eduththukko'ndu pu'rappattu, pileayaamidaththil poay, paalaakin vaarththaika'lai avanukkuch sonnaarka'l.

avan avarka'lai noakki: iraaththirikku ingkea thangkiyirungka'l; karththar enakkuch solluki'rapadiyea ungka'lukku uththaravu koduppean en'raan; appadiyea moavaapin pirapukka'l pileayaamidaththil thangkinaarka'l.
theavan pileayaamidaththil vanthu: unnidaththilirukki'ra intha manithar yaar en'raar.
pileayaam theavanai noakki: sippoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaak ennum moavaapin raajaa avarka'lai ennidaththukku anuppi:

poomiyin visaalaththai mooduki'ra oru janakkoottam ekipthilirunthu vanthirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal, nee vanthu enakkaaka avarka'laich sapikkavea'ndum; appozhuthu naan avarka'loadea yuththampa'n'ni, oruvea'lai avarka'laith thuraththividalaam en'ru sollachsonnaan en'raan.
atha'rkuth theavan pileayaamai noakki: nee avarka'loadea poakavea'ndaam; antha janangka'laich sapikkavum vea'ndaam; avarka'l aaseervathikkappattavarka'l en'raar.

pileayaam kaalamea ezhunthu, paalaakin pirapukka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l theasaththukkup poayvidungka'l; naan ungka'loadeakooda varuki'ratha'rkuk karththar enakku uththaravu kodukkamaattoam enki'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appadiyea moavaapiyarudaiya pirapukka'l ezhunthu, paalaakinidaththil poay: pileayaam engka'loadea varamaattean en'ru sonnaan en'raarka'l.
paalaak ma'rupadiyum avarka'lilum kanavaanka'laana athika pirapukka'lai anuppinaan.
avarka'l pileayaamidaththil poay, avanai noakki: sippoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaak engka'lai anuppi: neer ennidaththil varuki'ratha'rkuth thadaipadavea'ndaam;
ummai mikavum kanampa'n'nuvean; neer solvathaiyellaam seyvean; neer vanthu enakkaaka antha janangka'laich sapikkavea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaar en'raarka'l.

pileayaam paalaakin oozhiyakkaararukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: paalaak enakkuth than veeduni'raiya ve'l'liyum ponnum thanthaalum, si'riya kaariyamaanaalum periya kaariyamaanaalum seyyumporuttu, en theavanaakiya karththarin katta'laiyai naan mee'rakkoodaathu.
aakilum, karththar inimeal enakku enna solluvaar enpathai naan a'riyumpadikku, neengka'lum intha iraaththiri ingkea thangkiyirungka'l en'raan.

iravilea theavan pileayaamidaththil vanthu: antha manithar unnaik kooppida vanthirunthaal, nee ezhunthu avarka'loadea koodappoa; aanaalum, naan unakkuch sollum vaarththaiyinpadimaaththiram nee seyyavea'ndum en'raar.
pileayaam kaalamea ezhunthu, than kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'nangkatti, moavaapin pirapukka'loadeakoodap poanaan.

avan poaki'rathinaalea theavanukkuk koapam moo'ndathu; karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar vazhiyilea avanukku ethiraa'liyaaka nin'raar. avan than kazhuthaiyinmeal ea'rippoanaan; avan vealaikkaarar ira'ndupearum avanoadea irunthaarka'l.

karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar uruvina pattayaththaith thammudaiya kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu vazhiyilea ni'rki'rathaik kazhuthai ka'ndu, vazhiyai vittu vayalilea vilakippoayit'ru; kazhuthaiyai vazhiyil thiruppa pileayaam athai adiththaan.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar irupu'raththilum suvar vaiththiruntha thiraadchaththoattangka'lin paathaiyilea poay nin'raar.
kazhuthai karththarudaiya thoothanaikka'ndu, suvar oaramaay othungki, pileayaamin kaalaich suvaroadea nerukkit'ru; thirumpavum athai adiththaan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan appu'ram poay, valathupu'ram idathupu'ram vilaka vazhiyillaatha idukkamaana idaththilea nin'raar.
kazhuthai karththarudaiya thoothanaik ka'ndu, pileayaamin keezhp paduththukko'ndathu; pileayaam koapam moo'ndavanaaki, kazhuthaiyaith thadiyinaal adiththaan.
udanea karththar kazhuthaiyin vaayaith thi'ranthaar; athu pileayaamaip paarththu: neer ennai ippozhuthu moon'rutharam adikkumpadi naan umakku enna seythean en'rathu.
appozhuthu pileayaam kazhuthaiyaip paarththu: nee ennaip pariyaasam pa'n'nikko'ndu varuki'raay; en kaiyil oru pattayammaaththiram irunthaal, ippozhuthea unnaik kon'rupoaduvean en'raan.

kazhuthai pileayaamai noakki: neer ennaik kaikko'nda kaalamuthal innaa'lvaraikkum neer ea'rina kazhuthai naan allavaa? ippadi umakku eppoathaakilum naan seythathu u'ndaa en'rathu. atha'rku avan: illai en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar pileayaamin ka'nka'laith thi'ranthaar; vazhiyilea nin'ru uruvina pattayaththaith thammudaiya kaiyilea pidiththirukki'ra karththarudaiya thoothanai avan ka'ndu, thalaikuninthu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu pa'ninthaan.

karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar avanai noakki: nee un kazhuthaiyai ithanoadea moon'rutharam adiththathenna? un vazhi enakku maa'rupaadaayirukki'rathinaal, naan unakku ethiriyaakap pu'rappattu vanthean.
kazhuthai ennaik ka'ndu, intha moon'rutharam enakku vilakit'ru; enakku vilakaamal irunthathaanaal, ippozhuthu naan unnaik kon'rupoattu, kazhuthaiyai uyiroadea vaippean en'raar.

appozhuthu pileayaam karththarudaiya thoothanai noakki: naan paavagnseythean; vazhiyilea neer enakku ethiraaka ni'rki'rathai a'riyaathirunthean; ippozhuthum umathu paarvaikku ithu thakaathathaayirukkumaanaal, naan thirumpip poayviduki'rean en'raan.

karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar pileayaamai noakki: antha manitharoadea koodappoa; naan unnoadea sollum vaarththaiyaimaaththiram nee sollakkadavaay en'raar; appadiyea pileayaam paalaakin pirapukka'loadeakoodap poanaan.
pileayaam varuki'rathaip paalaak keattamaaththiraththil, kadaisi ellaiyaana arnoan nathiyin oaraththilu'l'la moavaapin patta'namattum avanukku ethirko'ndupoanaan.

paalaak pileayaamai noakki: ummai azhaikkumpadi naan aavaloadea ummidaththil aa'l anuppavillaiyaa? ennidaththi'rku varaamal irunthathenna? eat'rapirakaaramaaka ummai naan kanam pa'n'namaatteanaa en'raan.
appozhuthu pileayaam paalaakai noakki: ithoa, ummidaththi'rku vanthean; aanaalum, eathaakilum solluki'ratha'rku ennaalea aakumoa? theavan en vaayilea a'likkum vaarththaiyaiyea solluvean en'raan.
pileayaam paalaakudaneakoodap poanaan; avarka'l keeriyaath oosoaththil searnthaarka'l.
angkea paalaak aadumaaduka'lai adiththu, pileayaamukkum avanoadiruntha pirapukka'lukkum anuppinaan.
ma'runaa'l kaalamea paalaak pileayaamaik koottikko'ndu, avanaip paakaaludaiya meaduka'lil ea'rappa'n'ninaan; avvidaththilirunthu pileayaam janaththin kadaisip paa'layaththaip paarththaan.
pileayaam paalaakai noakki: neer ingkea enakku eazhu palipeedangka'laik katti, eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum ingkea enakku aayaththappaduththum en'raan.
pileayaam sonnapadiyea paalaak seythaan; paalaakum pileayaamum ovvoru peedaththil ovvoru kaa'laiyaiyum ovvoru aattukkadaavaiyum paliyittaarka'l.

pinpu pileayaam paalaakai noakki: ummudaiya sarvaangka thakanapaliya'ndaiyil nillum, naan poayvaruki'rean; karththar vanthu ennaich santhikki'rathaayirukkum; avar enakku ve'lippaduththuvathai umakku a'rivippean en'ru solli, oru meattinmeal ea'rinaan.

theavan pileayaamaich santhiththaar; appozhuthu avan avarai noakki: naan eazhu palipeedangka'lai aayaththampa'n'ni, ovvoru palipeedaththil ovvoru kaa'laiyaiyum ovvoru aattukkadaavaiyum paliyittean en'raan.
karththar pileayaamin vaayilea vaakku aru'li: nee paalaakinidaththil thirumpippoay, ivvithamaaych sollakkadavaay en'raar.
avanidaththukku avan thirumpippoanaan; paalaak moavaapudaiya sakala pirapukka'loadungkoodath than sarvaangka thakanapaliya'ndaiyilea nin'ruko'ndirunthaan.

appozhuthu avan than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: moavaapin raajaavaakiya paalaak ennaik kizhakku malaika'lilu'l'la aaraamilirunthu varavazhaiththu: nee vanthu enakkaaka yaakkoapaich sapikkavea'ndum; nee vanthu isravealai ve'ruththu vidavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.
theavan sapikkaathavanai naan sapippatheppadi? karththar ve'rukkaathavanai naan ve'ruppatheppadi?
kanmalaiyuchchiyilirunthu naan avanaik ka'ndu, kun'ruka'lilirunthu avanaip paarkki'rean; antha janangka'l jaathika'loadea kalavaamal thaniyea vaasamaayiruppaarka'l.
yaakkoapin thoo'lai e'n'naththakkavan yaar? isravealin kaa'rpangkai e'n'nuki'ravan yaar? neethimaan marippathu poal naan marippeanaaka, en mudivu avan mudivupoal iruppathaaka en'raan.
appozhuthu paalaak pileayaamai noakki: neer enakku ennaseytheer; en saththurukka'laich sapikkumpadi ummai azhaippiththean; neer avarka'lai aaseervathikkavea aaseervathiththeer en'raan.
atha'rku avan: karththar en vaayil aru'linathaiyea solvathu en kadamaiyallavaa en'raan.

pinpu paalaak avanai noakki: neer avarka'laip paarkkaththakka vea'roru idaththi'rku ennoadeakooda vaarum; angkea avarka'l ellaaraiyum paaraamal, avarka'ludaiya kadaisip paa'layaththaimaaththiram paarppeer; angkeayirunthu enakkaaka avarka'laich sapikkavea'ndum en'ru solli,
avanaip piskaavin kodumudiyil irukki'ra soappeemin ve'liyilea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, eazhu palipeedangka'laik katti, ovvoru peedaththil ovvoru kaa'laiyaiyum ovvoru aattukkadaavaiyum paliyittaan.
appozhuthu pileayaam paalaakai noakki: ingkea ummudaiya sarvaangka thakanapaliya'ndaiyil nillum; naan angkea poayk karththaraich santhiththuvaruki'rean en'raan.
karththar pileayaamaich santhiththu, avan vaayilea vasanaththai aru'li: nee paalaakinidaththi'rkuth thirumpippoay, ivvithamaaych sollakkadavaay en'raar.

avanidaththi'rku avan varuki'rapoathu, avan moavaapin pirapukka'loadungkoodath thannudaiya sarvaangka thakanapaliya'ndaiyilea nin'ruko'ndirunthaan; paalaak avanai noakki: karththar enna sonnaar en'ru keattaan.
appozhuthu avan than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: paalaakea, ezhunthirunthu kea'lum; sippoarin kumaaranea, enakkuch sevikodum.
poy solla theavan oru manithan alla; manammaa'ra avar oru manupuththiranum alla; avar solliyum seyyaathiruppaaraa? avar vasaniththum ni'raiveat'raathiruppaaraa?
ithoa, aaseervathikkak katta'laipet'rean; avar aaseervathikki'raar, athai naan thiruppakkoodaathu.

avar yaakkoapilea akkiramaththaik kaa'nki'rathum illai, isravealilea kut'ram paarkki'rathum illai; avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar avarka'loadea irukki'raar; raajaavin jayakempeeram avarka'lukku'l'lea irukki'rathu.
theavan avarka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; kaa'ndaamirukaththukkoththa pelan avarka'lukku u'ndu.

yaakkoapukku viroathamaana manthiravaatham illai, isravealukku viroathamaana ku'risolluthalum illai; theavan ennenna seythaar en'ru kognchakkaalaththilea yaakkoapaiyum isravealaiyum ku'riththuch sollappadum.

antha janam thushda singkampoala ezhumpum, paalasingkampoala nimirnthu ni'rkum; athu thaan pidiththa iraiyaip padchiththu, vettu'ndavarka'lin iraththaththaik kudikkumattum paduththukko'lvathillai en'raan.
appozhuthu paalaak pileayaamai noakki: neer avarka'laich sapikkavum vea'ndaam, avarka'lai aaseervathikkavum vea'ndaam en'raan.
atha'rkup pileayaam paalaakaip paarththu: karththar solluki'rapadiyellaam seyvean en'ru ummoadea naan sollavillaiyaa en'raan.

appozhuthu paalaak pileayaamai noakki: vaarum, vea'roru idaththi'rku ummai azhaiththukko'ndu poaki'rean; neer angkeayirunthaavathu enakkaaka avarka'laich sapikki'rathu theavanukkup piriyamaayirukkum en'ru solli,
avanai eshimoanukku ethiraayirukki'ra peayoarin kodumudikku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.
appozhuthu pileayaam paalaakai noakki: ingkea enakku eazhu palipeedangka'laik katti, ingkea enakku eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum eazhu aattuk kadaakka'laiyum aayaththampa'n'num en'raan.
pileayaam sonnapadi paalaak seythu, ovvoru peedaththil ovvoru kaa'laiyaiyum ovvoru aattukkadaavaiyum paliyittaan.

isravealai aaseervathippathea karththarukkup piriyam en'ru pileayaam ka'nda poathu, avan munthich seythuvanthathu poala nimiththampaarkkap poakaamal, vanaantharaththi'rku nearaakath than mukaththaith thiruppi,
than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, israveal than koaththirangka'linpadiyea paa'layami'rangkiyirukki'rathaip paarththaan; theava aavi avanmeal vanthathu.
appozhuthu avan than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: peayoarin kumaaranaakiya pileayaam solluki'rathaavathu, ka'nthi'rakkappattavan uraikki'rathaavathu,
theavan aru'lum vaarththaika'laik keattu, sarvavallavarin tharisanaththaik ka'ndu thaazha vizhumpoathu, ka'nthi'rakkappattavan vi'lampuki'rathaavathu,
yaakkoapea, un koodaarangka'lum, isravealea, un vaasasthalangka'lum evva'lavu azhakaanavaika'l!

avaika'l paravippoaki'ra aa'ruka'laippoalavum, nathiyoaraththilu'l'la thoattangka'laippoalavum, karththar naattina santhanamarangka'laippoalavum, tha'n'neer arukea u'l'la keathuru virudchangka'laippoalavum irukki'rathu.

avarka'ludaiya neerchchaalka'lilirunthu tha'n'neer paayum; avarka'l viththu thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lil paravum; avarka'ludaiya raajaa aakaakaip paarkkilum uyaruvaan; avarka'l raajyam meanmaiyadaiyum.

theavan avarka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; kaa'ndaamirukaththukkoththa pelan avarka'lukku u'ndu; avarka'l thangka'l saththurukka'laakiya jaathika'laip padchiththu, avarka'l elumpuka'lai no'rukki, avarka'laith thangka'l ampuka'laalea eyvaarka'l.

singkampoalavum thushda singkampoalavum madangkip paduththukko'ndirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lai ezhuppuki'ravan yaar? ungka'lai aaseervathikki'ravan aaseervathikkappattavan, ungka'laich sapikki'ravan sapikkappattavan en'raan.

appozhuthu paalaak pileayaaminmeal koapam moo'ndavanaaki, kaiyoadea kaithatti, pileayaamai noakki: en saththurukka'laich sapikka unnai azhaiththanuppinean; neeyoa intha moon'rumu'raiyum avarka'lai aaseervathikkavea aaseervathiththaay.
aakaiyaal un idaththukku oadippoa; unnai mikavum kanampa'n'nuvean en'rean; nee kanamadaiyaathapadikkuk karththar thaduththaar en'raan.

appozhuthu pileayaam paalaakai noakki: paalaak enakkuth than veedu ni'raiya ve'l'liyum ponnum koduththaalum, naan en manathaay nanmaiyaakilum theemaiyaakilum seyki'ratha'rkuk karththarin katta'laiyai mee'rakkoodaathu; karththar solvathaiyea solvean en'ru,
neer ennidaththi'rku anuppina sthaanaapathika'lidaththil naan sollavillaiyaa?
ithoa, naan en janaththaaridaththi'rkup poaki'rean; pi'rkaalaththilea intha janangka'l ummudaiya janangka'lukkuch seyvathu innathen'ru umakkuth therivippean vaarum en'ru solli,
avan than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: peayoarin kumaaran pileayaam solluki'rathaavathu, ka'nthi'rakkappattavan uraikki'rathaavathu,
theavan aru'lum vaarththaika'laik keattu, unnathamaanavar a'liththa a'rivai a'rinthu, sarvavallavarin tharisanaththaik ka'ndu, thaazhavizhumpoathu, ka'nthi'rakkappattavan vi'lampuki'rathaavathu;

avaraik kaa'npean, ippozhuthu alla; avaraith tharisippean, sameepamaay alla; oru nadchaththiram yaakkoapilirunthu uthikkum, oru sengkoal isravealilirunthu ezhumpum; athu moavaapin ellaika'lai no'rukki, seathpuththirar ellaaraiyum nirmoolamaakkum.
eathoam suthantharamaakum, seayeer than saththurukka'lukkuch suthantharamaakum; israveal paraakkiramagnseyyum.
yaakkoapilirunthu thoan'rum oruvar aa'lukai seyvaar; patta'nangka'lil meethiyaanavarka'lai azhippaar en'raan.
mealum, avan amaleakkaip paarththu, than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: amaleakku munthiyezhumpinavan; aanaalum avan mudivilea mut'rilum naasamaavaan en'raan.
an'riyum avan keaniyanaip paarththu, than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: un vaasasthalam ara'nippaanathu; un koottaik kanmalaiyil kattinaay.
aakilum keaniyan azhinthupoavaan; asoor unnaich si'raipidiththuk ko'ndupoaka eththanainaa'l sellum en'raan.
pinnum avan than vaakkiyaththai eduththuraiththu: aiyoa, theavan ithaich seyyumpoathu yaar pizhaippaan;
siththeemin karaithu'raiyilirunthu kappalka'l vanthu, asooraich si'rumaippaduththi, eapearaiyum varuththappaduththum; avanum mut'rilum azhinthupoavaan en'raan.
pinpu pileayaam ezhunthu pu'rappattu, than idaththi'rkuth thirumpinaan; paalaakum than vazhiyea poanaan.
israveal siththeemilea thangkiyirukkaiyil, janangka'l moavaapin kumaaraththika'loadea veasiththanam pa'n'naththodangkinaarka'l.
avarka'l thangka'l theavarka'lukku itta palika'lai virunthu'n'numpadi janangka'lai azhaiththaarka'l; janangka'l poayp pusiththu, avarka'l theavarka'laip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.
ippadi isravealar paakaalpeayoaraip pat'rikko'ndaarka'l; athanaal isravealarmeal karththarudaiya koapam moo'ndathu.

karththar moaseayai noakki: karththarudaiya ukkiramaana koapam isravealaivittu neengkumpadi nee janangka'lin thalaivar ellaaraiyum koottikko'ndu, appadich seythavarka'laich sooriyanukku ethirea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil thookkippoadumpadi sey en'raar.
appadiyea moasea isravealin niyaayaathipathika'lai noakki: neengka'l avaravar paakaalpeayoaraip pat'rikko'nda ungka'l manitharaik kon'rupoadungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu moaseayum israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar anaivarum aasarippuk koodaaravaasalukku munpaaka azhuthuko'ndu ni'rkaiyil, avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka israveal puththiraril oruvan oru meethiyaaniya sthireeyaith than sakoathararidaththilea azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan.
athai aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaranaana eleyaasaarin makan pinekaas ka'ndapoathu, avan naduchsapaiyilirunthu ezhunthu, oru eettiyaith than kaiyilea pidiththu,

isravealanaakiya antha manithan veasiththanampa'n'num a'raiyilea avan pinnaalea poay, israveal manithanum antha sthireeyumaakiya iruvarudaiya vayit'rilum eetti uruvippoaka avarka'laik kuththippoattaan; appozhuthu israveal puththiraril u'ndaana vaathai nin'rupoayit'ru.
antha vaathaiyaal seththavarka'l irupaththunaalaayirampear.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

naan en erichchalil israveal puththirarai nirmoolamaakkaathapadikku, aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaaranaana eleyaasaarin makan pinekaas, en nimiththam avarka'l naduvil pakthivairaakkiyam kaa'npiththathinaal, israveal puththirarmeal u'ndaana en ukkiraththaith thiruppinaan.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, avanukku en samaathaanaththin udanpadikkaiyaik katta'laiyiduki'rean.

avan than theavanukkaaka pakthivairaakkiyam kaa'npiththu, israveal puththirarukkaakap paavanivirththi seythapadiyinaal, avanukkum avanukkup pinpu avan santhathikkum niththiya aasaariya pattaththi'rkuriya udanpadikkai u'ndaayirukkum en'ru sol en'raar.
meethiyaaniya sthireeyoadea kuththu'ndu seththa israveal manithanudaiya pear simri; avan salloovin kumaaranum, simiyoaniyarin thakappan vamsaththil oru pirapuvumaayirunthaan.
kuththu'nda meethiyaaniya sthireeyin pear kaspi, ava'l soorin kumaaraththi, avan meethiyaaniyarudaiya thakappan vamsaththaaraana janangka'lukkuth thalaivanaayirunthaan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
meethiyaaniyarai nerukki avarka'lai vettippoadungka'l.

peayoarin sangkathiyilum peayoarin nimiththam vaathaiyu'ndaana naa'lilea kuththu'nda avarka'l sakoathariyaakiya kaspi ennum meethiyaan pirapuvinudaiya kumaaraththiyin sangkathiyilum, avarka'l ungka'lukkuch seytha sarppanaika'linaal ungka'lai moasampoakki nerukkinaarka'lea en'raar.
antha vaathai theernthapinpu, karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanin kumaaranum aasaariyanumaakiya eleyaasaaraiyum noakki:

israveal puththirarin samastha sapaiyaaraiyum avarka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadi irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta isravealilea yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadaththakkavarka'l ellaaraiyum e'n'nungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum erikoavin arukea irukkum yoarthaanukku ippaalea moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilea avarka'loadea peasi:
karththar moaseakkum ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta israveal puththirarukkum katta'laiyittirukki'rapadiyea, irupathu vayathumutha'rko'ndirukki'ravarka'lai e'n'nungka'l en'raarka'l.
roopan isravealin mooththa kumaaran; roopanudaiya kumaarar, aanoakkiyar kudumpaththukkuth thakappanaana aanoakkum, pallooviyar kudumpaththukkuth thakappanaana palloovum,
esroaniyar kudumpaththukkuth thakappanaana esroanum, karmeeyar kudumpaththukkuth thakappanaana karmeeyumea.
ivaika'lea roopaniyarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththu moovaayiraththu ezhunoot'ru muppathupear.
palloovin kumaaran eliyaap.

eliyaapin kumaarar neamuveal, thaaththaan, apiraam enpavarka'l; inthath thaaththaan apiraam enpavarka'lea sapaiyil pearpet'ravarka'laayirunthu, karththarukku viroathamaakap poaraattam pa'n'ni, koaraakin koottaa'lika'laaki, moaseakkum aaroanukkum viroathamaaka vivaathampa'n'ninavarka'l.
poomi than vaayaith thi'ranthu, avarka'laiyum koaraakaiyum vizhungkinathinaalum, akkini irunoot'ru aimpathupearaip padchiththathinaalum, anthak koottaththaar seththu, oru adaiyaa'lamaanaarka'l.
koaraakin kumaararoa saakavillai.
simiyoanudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: neamuvealin santhathiyaana neamuvealarin kudumpamum, yaaminin santhathiyaana yaaminiyarin kudumpamum, yaakeenin santhathiyaana yaakeeniyarin kudumpamum,
searaakin santhathiyaana searaakiyarin kudumpamum, savulin santhathiyaana savuliyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea simiyoaniyarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'l irupaththeeraayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
kaaththudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: sippoanin santhathiyaana sippoaniyarin kudumpamum, aakiyin santhathiyaana aakiyarin kudumpamum, sooniyin santhathiyaana sooniyarin kudumpamum,
osniyin santhathiyaana osniyarin kudumpamum, eariyin santhathiyaana eariyarin kudumpamum,
aaroathin santhathiyaana aaroathiyarin kudumpamum, arealiyin santhathiyaana arealiyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea kaath puththirarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpathinaayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
yoothaavin kumaarar ear oanaan enpavarka'l; earum oanaanum kaanaan theasaththil seththaarka'l.

yoothaavudaiya mat'rak kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: sealaavin santhathiyaana sealaaviyarin kudumpamum, paareasin santhathiyaana paareasiyarin kudumpamum, searaavin santhathiyaana searaaviyarin kudumpamumea.
paareasudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: esroanin santhathiyaana esroaniyarin kudumpamum, aamoolin santhathiyaana aamooliyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea yoothaavin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l ezhupaththaa'raayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
isakkaarudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: thoalaavin santhathiyaana thoalaaviyarin kudumpamum, poovaavin santhathiyaana poovaaviyarin kudumpamum,
yaasoopin santhathiyaana yaasoopiyarin kudumpamum, simroanin santhathiyaana simroaniyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea isakkaarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l a'rupaththu naalaayiraththu munnoo'rupear.

sepuloanudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: seareaththin santhathiyaana seareaththiyarin kudumpamum, ealoanin santhathiyaana ealoaniyarin kudumpamum, yaaleayealin santhathiyaana yaaleayealiyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea sepuloaniyarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l a'rupathinaayiraththu ainnoo'rupear.
yoaseappudaiya kumaararaana manaasea eppiraayeem enpavarka'lin kudumpangka'laavana:
manaaseayinudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'l; maakeerin santhathiyaana maakeeriyarin kudumpamum, maakeer pet'ra kileyaathin santhathiyaana kileyaathiyarin kudumpamum,
kileyaath pet'ra eeyeasearin santhathiyaana eeyeaseariyarin kudumpamum, ealeakkin santhathiyaana ealeakkiyarin kudumpamum,
asriyealin santhathiyaana asriyealarin kudumpamum, seakeamin santhathiyaana seakeamiyarin kudumpamum,
semeethaavin santhathiyaana semeethaaviyarin kudumpamum, eappearin santhathiyaana eappeariyarin kudumpamumea.
eappearin kumaaranaana seloppiyaaththi'rkuk kumaarar illaamal, kumaaraththika'lmaaththiram irunthaarka'l; ivarka'l naamangka'l maklaa'l, noavaa'l, oklaa'l, milkaa'l, thirsaa'l enpavaika'l.
ivaika'lea manaaseayin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l aimpaththeeraayiraththu ezhunoo'rupear.

eppiraayeemudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: suththelaakin santhathiyaana suththelaakiyarin kudumpamum, pekearin santhathiyaana pekeariyarin kudumpamum, thaakaanin santhathiyaana thaakaaniyarin kudumpamum,
suththelaak pet'ra earaanin santhathiyaana earaaniyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea eppiraayeem puththirarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l muppaththeeraayiraththu ainnoo'rupear; ivarka'lea yoaseappu puththirarin kudumpangka'l.
penyameenudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: pealaavin santhathiyaana pealaaviyarin kudumpamum, aspealin santhathiyaana aspealiyarin kudumpamum, akiraamin santhathiyaana akiraamiyarin kudumpamum,
suppaamin santhathiyaana suppaamiyarin kudumpamum, uppaamin santhathiyaana uppaamiyarin kudumpamum,
pealaa pet'ra aareathin santhathiyaana aareathiyarin kudumpamum, naakamaanin santhathiyaana naakamaaniyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea penyameen puththirarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththaiyaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
thaa'nudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: sookaamin santhathiyaana sookaamiyarin kudumpamea; ivaika'l thaa'nin kudumpam.
sookaamiyarin vamsangka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l ellaarum a'rupaththu naalaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
aasearudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: imnaavin santhathiyaana imnaaviyarin kudumpamum, isviyin santhathiyaana isviyarin kudumpamum, pereeyaavin santhathiyaana pereeyaaviyarin kudumpamum,
pereeyaa pet'ra eapearin santhathiyaana eapeariyarin kudumpamum, malkiyealin santhathiyaana malkiyealiyarin kudumpamumea.
aasearudaiya kumaaraththiyin pear saaraa'l.
ivaika'lea aasear puththirarin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l aimpaththu moovaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
napthaliyinudaiya kumaararin kudumpangka'laavana: yaathsiyealin santhathiyaana yaathsiyealiyarin kudumpamum, kooniyin santhathiyaana kooniyarin kudumpamum,
ethserin santhathiyaana ethseriyarin kudumpamum, silleamin santhathiyaana silleamiyarin kudumpamumea.
ivaika'lea napthaliyin kudumpangka'l; avarka'lil e'n'nappattavarka'l naa'rpaththaiyaayiraththu naanoo'rupear.
israveal puththiraril e'n'nappattavarka'l aa'ruladchaththoaraayiraththu ezhunoot'ru muppathupearaayirunthaarka'l.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
ivarka'ludaiya pearka'lin ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaay theasam ivarka'lukkuch suthantharamaakap pangkidappadavea'ndum.

aneakampearukku athika suthantharamum kognchampearukkuk kogncha suthantharamum koduppaayaaka; avarka'lil e'n'nappatta ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka avaravarka'lukkuch suthantharam kodukkappadavea'ndum.
aanaalum seettuppoattu, theasaththaip pangkidavea'ndum; thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththirangka'lukkuriya naamangka'linpadiyea suthanthariththukko'l'lakkadavarka'l.
aneakampearka'laayinum kognchampearka'laayinum seettu vizhunthapadiyea avaravarka'ludaiya suthantharangka'l pangkidappadavea'ndum en'raar.

e'n'nappatta leaviyarin kudumpangka'laavana: kersoanin santhathiyaana kersoaniyarin kudumpamum, koakaaththin santhathiyaana koakaaththiyarin kudumpamum, meraariyin santhathiyaana meraariyarin kudumpamum;
leaviyin mat'rak kudumpangka'laakiya lipneeyarin kudumpamum, eproaniyarin kudumpamum, makaliyarin kudumpamum, moosiyarin kudumpamum, koaraakiyarin kudumpamumea. koakaath amraamaip pet'raan.
amraamudaiya manaivikku yoakepeath en'ru pear; ava'l ekipthilea leavikkup pi'rantha kumaaraththi; ava'l amraamukku aaroanaiyum moaseayaiyum avarka'l sakoathariyaana miriyaamaiyum pet'raa'l.
aaroanukku naathaapum apiyoovum eleyaasaarum iththaamaarum pi'ranthaarka'l.
naathaapum apiyoovum karththarudaiya sannithiyil anniya akkiniyaik ko'nduvanthapoathu, seththuppoanaarka'l.

avarka'lil oru maathaththu aa'npi'l'lai muthalaaka e'n'nappattavarka'l irupaththu moovaayirampear; israveal puththirarin naduvea avarka'lukkuch suthantharam kodukkappadaathapadiyinaal, avarka'l israveal puththirarin ilakkaththi'rku udpadavillai.
moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum erikoavin arukeayirukkum yoarthaanukku ippaalea moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil israveal puththirarai e'n'nuki'rapoathu irunthavarka'l ivarka'lea.
munpu moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya aaroanum seenaay vanaantharaththil israveal puththirarai e'n'numpoathu irunthavarka'lil oruvarum ivarka'lukku'l illai.

vanaantharaththil saakavea saavaarka'l en'ru karththar avarka'laikku'riththuch solliyirunthaar; eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapum noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum thavira, vea'roruvarum avarka'lil meethiyaayirukkavillai.

yoaseappin kumaaranaakiya manaaseayin kudumpangka'lil, manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin makanaana kileyaaththukkup pi'rantha eapearukkup puththiranaayiruntha seloappiyaaththin kumaaraththika'laakiya maklaa'l, noavaa'l, oklaa'l, milkaa'l, thirsaa'l enpavarka'l vanthu,
aasarippuk koodaaravaasalilea moaseakkum, aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkum, pirapukka'lukkum, sapaiyanaiththi'rkum munpaaka nin'ru:

engka'l thakappan vanaantharaththil mara'namadainthaar; avar karththarukku viroathamaakak koodina koaraakin koottaththaaril searnthavar alla, thammudaiya paavaththinaalea mariththaar; avarukkuk kumaarar illai.

engka'l thakappanukkuk kumaaran illaathathinaalea, avarudaiya pear avarudaiya vamsaththil illaamal at'ruppoakalaamaa? engka'l thakappanudaiya sakoathararukku'l'lea engka'lukkuk kaa'niyaadchi kodukkavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
moasea avarka'ludaiya niyaayaththaik karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'ndupoanaan.
appozhuthu karththar moaseayai noakki:

seloappiyaaththin kumaaraththika'l solluki'rathu sarithaan; avarka'lukku avarka'l thakappanudaiya sakoathararukku'l'lea suthantharam kodukkavea'ndum; avarka'l thakappan pinvaiththa suthantharaththai avarka'lukkuk kidaikkumpadi seyvaayaaka.
mealum nee israveal puththirarai noakki: oruvan kumaaran illaamal mariththaal, avanukkuriya suthantharaththai avan kumaaraththikkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
avanukkuk kumaaraththiyum illaathirunthaal, avanukkuriya suthantharaththai avan sakoathararukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
avanukkuch sakoathararum illaathirunthaal, avanukkuriya suthantharaththai avan thakappanudaiya sakoathararukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.

avan thakappanukkuch sakoatharar illaathirunthaal, avanukkuriya suthantharaththai avan vamsaththilea avanukkuk kittina u'ravinmu'raiyaanukkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkavea'ndum; ithu, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, israveal puththirarukku niyaayavithippiramaa'namaay irukkakkadavathu en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: nee intha apaareem malaiyil ea'ri, naan israveal puththirarukkuk koduththa theasaththaip paar.
nee athaip paarththapinpu, un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan searkkappattathupoala, neeyum un janaththaaridaththil searkkappaduvaay;

sapaiyaar vaakkuvaathampa'n'nina seen vanaantharaththil tha'n'neerukkaduththa vishayaththil avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ennaip parisuththampa'n'navea'ndiya neengka'l en katta'laiyai mee'rineerka'lea en'raar. ithu seen vanaantharaththil kaatheas oorarukea u'ndaana mearipaavin tha'n'neerukkaduththa kaariyamea.
appozhuthu moasea karththarai noakki:
karththarudaiya sapai meayppan illaatha manthaiyaippoal iraathapadikku,

anthach sapaikku munpaakap poakkum varaththumaay irukkumpadikkum, avarka'laip poakavum varavum pa'n'numpadikkum, maamsamaana yaavarudaiya aavika'lukkum theavanaakiya karththar oru purushanai avarka'lmeal athikaariyaaka ea'rpaduththavea'ndum en'raan.
karththar moaseayai noakki: aaviyaip pet'rirukki'ra purushanaakiya yoasuvaa ennum noonin kumaaranai nee therinthuko'ndu, avanmeal un kaiyai vaiththu,
avanai aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkum sapaiyanaiththi'rkum munpaaka ni'ruththi, avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka avanukkuk katta'laikoduththu,
israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum avanukkuk keezhppadiyumpadikku, un kanaththil kogncham avanukkuk kodu.

avan aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukku munpaaka ni'rkakkadavan; avanimiththam antha aasaariyan karththarudaiya sannithaanaththil vanthu, ooreem ennum niyaayaththinaalea aaloasanai keadkakkadavan; avarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea, avanum avanoadeakooda israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaar ellaarum poakavum avarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea varavum vea'ndiyathu en'raar.
moasea thanakkuk karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea yoasuvaavai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avanai aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkum sapaiyanaiththi'rkum munpaaka ni'ruththi,
avanmeal than kaika'lai vaiththu, karththar thanakkuch sonnapadiyea avanukkuk katta'laikoduththaan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

enakkuch sukanthavaasanaiyaaka, thakanapalika'lukku aduththa kaa'nikkaiyaiyum appaththaiyum, ku'riththakaalaththil enakkuch seluththumpadikkuk kavanamaayirukkakkadaveerka'l en'ru nee israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyidu.

mealum nee avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l karththarukkuch seluththavea'ndiya thakanapali ennaven'raal: niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka naadoa'rum oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra ira'ndu aattukkuttika'laip paliyidavea'ndum.
kaalaiyil oru aattukkuttiyaiyum, maalaiyil oru aattukkuttiyaiyum paliyittu,
poajanapaliyaaka oru marakkaalilea paththil oru pangkaanathum idiththup pizhintha kaa'rpadi e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaakiya melliya maavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
ithu seenaay malaiyilea katta'laiyidappatta niththiya sarvaangka thakanapali; ithu karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaikkaana thakanapali.
kaa'rpadi thiraadcharasam oru aattukkuttikku aduththa paanapali; parisuththa sthalaththilea karththarukku antha irasam paanapaliyaaka vaarkkappadakkadavathu.
kaalaiyin poajanapalikkum athin paanapalikkum oppaakavea maalaiyil mat'ra aattukkuttiyaiyum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapaliyaakach seluththakkadaveerka'l.

oayvunaa'liloa poajanapalikkaaka oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra ira'ndu aattukkuttika'laiyum, paththil ira'ndu pangkaanathum e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
niththamum seluththum sarvaangka thakanapaliyum athin paanapaliyum an'ri ovvoru oayvunaa'lilum inthach sarvaangka thakanapaliyum seluththappadavea'ndum.

ungka'l maathappi'rappuka'lil neengka'l karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka ira'ndu kaa'laika'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.

poajanapaliyaaka ovvoru kaa'laikkup paththil moon'rupangkaanathum e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana melliya maavaiyum, poajanapaliyaaka oru aattukkadaavukkup paththil ira'ndu pangkaanathum e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana maavaiyum,
poajanapaliyaaka ovvoru aattukkuttikkup paththil oru pangkaanathum e'n'neyilea pisainthathumaana maavaiyum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththakkadaveerka'l.

avaika'lukkeat'ra paanapalika'l thiraadcharasaththil kaa'laikku araippadiyum, aattukkadaavukkup padiyil moon'ril oru pangkum, aattukkuttikkuk kaa'rpadi rasamumaayirukkavea'ndum; ithu varusha muzhuvathum maathanthoa'rum seluththappadavea'ndiya sarvaangka thakanapali.
niththamum idappadum sarvaangka thakanapaliyum athin paanapaliyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaakak karththarukku oru ve'l'laattukkadaavum seluththappadavea'ndum.
muthalaam maatham pathinaalaam theathi karththarukku uriya paskaa.
antha maatham pathinainthaam theathi pa'ndikainaa'l; eazhunaa'la'lavum pu'lippillaatha appam pusikkavea'ndum.
muthalaam naa'lilea parisuththa sapai kooduthal irukkavea'ndum; an'raiththinam saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu.
appozhuthu neengka'l karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka ira'ndu kaa'laika'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum,
avaika'lukkeat'ra poajanapaliyaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavilea kaa'laikkaakap paththil moon'ru pangkaiyum, aattukkadaavukkaakap paththil ira'ndu pangkaiyum,
eazhu aattukkuttika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaakap paththil oru pangkaiyum,
ungka'l paavanivirththikken'ru paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
kaalaiyilea niththamum seluththum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum an'ri ivaika'laiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.

inthappirakaaram eazhunaa'la'lavum naadoa'rum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana thakanapali seluththakkadaveerka'l; niththamum seluththappadum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, ithaiyum seluththavea'ndum.
eazhaam naa'lilea parisuththa sapaikooduthal irukkavea'ndum; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu.

antha vaarangka'lukkuppin neengka'l karththarukkup puthiya poajanapaliyaaka mutha'rkanika'laich seluththum pa'ndikai naa'lilum parisuththa sapaikooduthal irukkavea'ndum; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu.
appozhuthu neengka'l karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka ira'ndu kaa'laika'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum,
avaika'lin poajanapaliyaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavil oru kaa'laikkaakap paththil moon'ru pangkaiyum, antha oru aattukkadaavukkaakap paththil ira'ndu pangkaiyum,
eazhu aattukkuttika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaakap paththil oru pangkaiyum,
ungka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumpadikku oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum athin poajanapaliyaiyum athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, ivaika'laiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l; ivaika'l pazhuthat'ravaika'laayirukkavea'ndum.
eazhaam maatham muthaltheathi parisuththa sapaikoodum naa'laayirukkakkadavathu; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu; athu ungka'lukku ekkaa'lamoothum naa'laayirukkavea'ndum.
appozhuthu neengka'l karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyaiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum,
avaika'lukku aduththa poajanapaliyaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavilea kaa'laikkaakap paththil moon'ru pangkaiyum, aattukkadaavukkaaka ira'ndu pangkaiyum,
eazhu aattukkuttika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaaka oru pangkaiyum,
ungka'l paavanivirththikkaana paliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththi,

maathappi'rappin sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum athin poajanapaliyaiyum, thinanthoa'rum idum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum athin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin mu'raimaikkeat'ra paanapalika'laiyum an'ri, ivaika'laiyum karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththakkadaveerka'l.
intha eazhaam maatham paththaam theathi ungka'lukkup parisuththa sapaikoodum naa'laayirukkakkadavathu; athilea neengka'l yaathoru vealaiyum seyyaamal, ungka'l aaththumaakka'laith thaazhmaippaduththi,
karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyaiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum,
avaika'lin poajanapaliyaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavilea kaa'laikkaakap paththil moon'ru pangkaiyum, antha oru aattukkadaavukkaaka ira'ndu pangkaiyum,
eazhu aattukkuttika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaakap paththil oru pangkaiyum,

paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththi, paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum, niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum an'ri, ivaika'laiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.

eazhaam maatham pathinainthaam theathi ungka'lukkup parisuththa sapaikoodum naa'laayirukkakkadavathu; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu; eazhunaa'l karththarukkup pa'ndikai aasarikkakkadaveerka'l.

neengka'l karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyu'l'la sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka pathinmoon'ru kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,

avaika'lin poajanapaliyaaka e'n'neyilea pisaintha melliya maavilea anthap pathinmoon'ru kaa'laika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaakap paththil moon'ru pangkaiyum, antha ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'lil ovvon'ri'rkaaka ira'ndu pangkaiyum,
pathinaanku aattukkuttika'lil ovvon'ri'rkaaka oru pangkaiyum,
niththiya thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
ira'ndaam naa'lilea pannira'ndu kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
moon'raam naa'lilea pathinoru kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
naankaam naa'lilea paththuk kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
ainthaam naa'lilea onpathu kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
aa'raam naa'lilea ettuk kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapalika'laiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
eazhaam naa'lilea eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum, ira'ndu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra pathinaanku aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laika'lum aattukkadaakka'lum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.
ettaam naa'l ungka'lukku viseashiththa aasarippu naa'laayirukkakkadavathu; athil saathaara'namaana yaathoru vealaiyum seyyalaakaathu.

appozhuthu neengka'l karththarukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyu'l'la thakanamaana sarvaangka thakanapaliyaaka oru kaa'laiyaiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum, oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum,
kaa'laiyum aattukkadaavum aattukkuttika'lum irukki'ra ilakkaththi'rkuththakkathaaka mu'raimaiyinpadi avaika'lin poajanapaliyaiyum, avaika'lin paanapalika'laiyum,
niththiya sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, athin poajanapaliyaiyum, athin paanapaliyaiyum an'ri, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum seluththakkadaveerka'l.

ungka'l poruththanaika'laiyum, ungka'l u'rchaakapalika'laiyum, ungka'l sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum, ungka'l poajanapalika'laiyum, ungka'l paanapalika'laiyum, ungka'l samaathaanapalika'laiyum an'ri, neengka'l ungka'l pa'ndikaika'lilea karththarukkuch seluththavea'ndiyavaika'l ivaika'lea en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam moasea israveal puththirarukkuch sonnaan.
moasea israveal puththirarudaiya koaththirangka'lin thalaivarai noakki: karththar katta'laiyiduvathu ennaven'raal:

oruvan karththarukku yaathoru poruththanai pa'n'ninaalum, allathu yaathoru kaariyaththaich seyyumpadi aa'naiyittuth than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'ndaalum, avan solthava'raamal than vaayilirunthu pu'rappatta vaakkinpadiyellaam seyyakkadavan.
than thakappan veettilirukki'ra oru pe'npi'l'lai than si'ruvayathilea karththarukkup poruththanaipa'n'ni yaathoru kaariyaththaich seyyumpadi than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'ndaal,

ava'l seytha poruththanaiyaiyum, ava'l pa'n'nikko'nda nipanthanaiyaiyum ava'ludaiya thakappan keattum ava'lukku on'rum sollaathiruppaanaanaal, ava'l seytha ellaap poruththanaika'lum ava'l than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'nda nipanthanaiyum ni'raivea'ravea'ndum.

ava'l seytha poruththanaika'laiyum, ava'l seyyumpadi than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththina nipanthanaiyaiyum ava'ludaiya thakappan keadki'ra naa'lil avan vea'ndaam en'ru thaduththaal, athu ni'raivea'ravea'ndiyathillai; ava'ludaiya thakappan vea'ndaam en'ru thaduththapadiyaal, karththar athai ava'lukku mannippaar.
ava'l poruththanai pa'n'numpoathum, than uthaduka'laith thi'ranthu than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'l'lumpoathum, ava'lukkup purushan irunthaal,

appozhuthu ava'ludaiya purushan athaik keattirunthum, athaik kea'lvippaduki'ra naa'lil ava'lukku on'rum sollaathirunthaal, ava'ludaiya poruththanaika'lum ava'l than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththina nipanthanaiyum ni'raivea'ravea'ndum.

ava'ludaiya purushan athaik keadki'ra naa'lil avan vea'ndaam en'ru thaduththu, ava'l seytha poruththanaiyum ava'l than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'nda nipanthanaiyum sellaathapadi seythaaneayaanaal, appozhuthu karththar athai ava'lukku mannippaar.
oru vithavaiyaavathu, tha'l'lappattuppoana oru sthireeyaavathu than aaththumaavai entha nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'l'luki'raa'loa antha nipanthanai ni'raivea'ravea'ndum.
ava'l than purushanudaiya veettil yaathoru poruththanai pa'n'ninaalum, allathu yaathoru kaariyaththaich seyyumpadi aa'naiyittuth than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththikko'ndaalum,

ava'ludaiya purushan athaik keattum ava'lukku athai vea'ndaamen'ru thadukkaamal mavunamaayirunthaal, ava'l seytha ellaap poruththanaika'lum, ava'l than aaththumaavai nipanthanaikkudpaduththina ellaa nipanthanaika'lum ni'raivea'ravea'ndum.

ava'ludaiya purushan avaika'laik keatta naa'lil avaika'laich sellaathapadi pa'n'ninaal, appozhuthu ava'l seytha poruththanaika'lum, ava'l than aaththumaavaiyudpaduththina nipanthanaiyaikku'riththu ava'l vaayilirunthu pu'rappattathon'rum ni'raivea'ravea'ndiyathillai; ava'ludaiya purushan avaika'laich sellaathapadi pa'n'ninathinaalea karththar athai ava'lukku mannippaar.
enthap poruththanaiyaiyum, aaththumaavaith thaazhmaippaduththumpadi seyyappatta entha aa'naiyaiyum, ava'ludaiya purushan sthirappaduththavungkoodum, sellaathapadi pa'n'navum koodum.

ava'ludaiya purushan orunaa'lum ava'lukku on'rum sollaathirunthaanaakil, avan ava'ludaiya ellaap poruththanaika'laiyum, ava'lpearilirukki'ra ava'ludaiya ellaa nipanthanaika'laiyum sthirappaduththuki'raan; avan athaik keatta naa'lilea ava'lukku on'rum sollaama'r poanathinaal, avaika'lai sthirappaduththuki'raan.
avan avaika'laik keattapinpu sellaathapadi pa'n'ninaal, ava'ludaiya akkiramaththai avan sumappaan en'raar.
purushanaiyum sthireeyaiyum, thakappanaiyum thakappanudaiya veettil si'ruvayathil irukki'ra avan kumaaraththiyaiyum ku'riththu, karththar moaseakku vithiththa katta'laika'l ivaika'lea.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
israveal puththirar nimiththam meethiyaaniyaridaththil pazhivaangkuvaayaaka; athanpinpu un janaththaaridaththil searkkappaduvaay en'raar.
appozhuthu moasea janangka'lai noakki: karththar nimiththam meethiyaaniyaridaththil pazhivaangkumporuttu, ungka'lil avarka'lmeal yuththaththi'rkup poakaththakkathaaka manitharaip piriththedungka'l.
isravealudaiya ellaak koaththirangka'lilum ovvoru koaththiraththil aayirampearai yuththaththi'rku anuppavea'ndum en'raan.
appadiyea isravealaraakiya aneakam aayirangka'lil, ovvoru koaththiraththil aayiramaayiram pearaakap panneeraayirampear yuththasannaththaraay ni'ruththappattaarka'l.

moasea avarka'laiyum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarin kumaaran pinekaasaiyum yuththaththi'rku anuppukaiyil, avan kaiyilea parisuththa thattumuttuka'laiyum, thonikkum poorikaika'laiyum koduththu anuppinaan.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea avarka'l meethiyaaniyarudan yuththampa'n'ni, purusharka'l yaavaraiyum kon'rupoattaarka'l.

avarka'laik kon'rupoattathum an'ri, meethiyaaniyarin ainthu raajaakka'laakiya eavi, reakkeam, soor, oor, reapaa enpavarka'laiyum kon'rupoattaarka'l. peayoarin kumaaranaakiya pileayaamaiyum pattayaththinaalea kon'rupoattaarka'l.

an'riyum israveal puththirar meethiyaaniyarin sthireeka'laiyum kuzhanthaika'laiyum si'raipidiththu, avarka'ludaiya mirukajeevanka'laakiya aadumaaduka'l yaavaiyum, mat'ra aasthika'l yaavaiyum ko'l'laiyittu,
avarka'l kudiyiruntha oorka'l koattaika'l yaavaiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththu,
thaangka'l ko'l'laiyitta poru'laiyum thaangka'l pidiththa narajeevan mirukajeevan anaiththaiyum searththu,

si'raipidikkappatta manitharaiyum, mirukangka'laiyum, ko'l'laiyitta poru'lka'laiyum erikoavin arukeayu'l'la yoarthaanukku ikkaraiyil moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilu'l'la paa'layaththiliruntha moaseayinidaththukkum, aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarinidaththukkum, israveal puththiraraakiya sapaiyaaridaththukkum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum sapaiyin pirapukka'l ellaarum avarka'laich santhikkap paa'layaththi'rku ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea yuththaththilirunthu vantha aayirampearukkuth thalaivarum, noo'rupearukkuth thalaivarumaakiya seanaapathika'lmeal koapangko'ndu,
avarka'lai noakki: sthireeka'l ellaaraiyum uyiroadea vittuvitteerka'laa?

peayoarin sangkathiyilea pileayaamin aaloasanaiyinaal israveal puththirar karththarukku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'nak kaara'namaayirunthavarka'l ivarka'lthaanea; athinaal karththarin sapaiyilea vaathaiyum nearittathea.
aakaiyaal kuzhanthaika'lil ellaa aa'npi'l'laika'laiyum, purushasamyoakaththai a'rintha ellaa sthireeka'laiyum kon'rupoadungka'l.
sthireeka'lil purushasamyoakaththai a'riyaatha ellaap pe'npi'l'laika'laiyum ungka'lukkaaka uyiroadea vaiyungka'l.

pinpu neengka'l eazhunaa'l paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampea thangkungka'l; narajeevanaik kon'ravarka'lum, vettu'ndavarka'laith thottavarka'lumaakiya neengka'l yaavarum moon'raam naa'lilum eazhaam naa'lilum ungka'laiyum ungka'laal si'raipidikkappattavarka'laiyum suththikariththu,
anthappadiyea ellaa vasthiraththaiyum, thoalaal seytha karuvika'laiyum, ve'l'laattumayirinaal neythavaika'laiyum, marachsaamaanka'laiyum suththikarikkakkadaveerka'l en'raan.
aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum yuththaththi'rkup poayvantha padaiveerarai noakki: karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyitta vithippiramaa'nam ennaven'raal:
akkinikku ni'rkaththakkavaika'laakiya pon, ve'l'li, ve'nkalam, irumpu, thakaram, eeyam aakiya ivaika'lellaam suththamaakumpadikku,

avaika'lai akkiniyilea poattedukkakkadaveerka'l; theettukkazhikkum tha'n'neeraalum avaika'l suththikarikkappadavea'ndum; akkinikku ni'rkaththakaathavaika'laiyellaam tha'n'neerinaal suththampa'n'nakkadaveerka'l.
eazhaam naa'lil ungka'l vasthirangka'laith thoaykkavea'ndum; appozhuthu suththamaayiruppeerka'l; pinpu neengka'l paa'layaththi'rku'l varalaam en'raan.
karththar moaseayai noakki:
pidiththukko'ndu varappatta manitharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum neeyum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum sapaiyinudaiya pithaakka'laakiya thalaivarum thokaipaarththu,
ko'l'laiyidappattathai ira'ndu pangkaakap pangkittu, yuththaththi'rkup padaiyeduththuppoanavarka'lukkum sapaiyanaiththi'rkum kodungka'l.
mealum yuththaththi'rkuppoana padaiveeraridaththil karththarukkaaka manitharilum maaduka'lilum kazhuthaika'lilum aaduka'lilum ainnoot'ri'rku oru piraa'ni veethamaaka pakuthi vaangki,
avarka'ludaiya paathippangkil eduththu, karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippaaka aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.

israveal puththirarin paathippangkiloa manitharilum, maaduka'l kazhuthaika'l aaduka'laakiya sakalavitha mirukangka'lilum, aimpathi'rku on'ru veethamaay vaangki, avaika'laik karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththin kaavalaikkaakkum leaviyarukkuk kodukkavea'ndum en'raar.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum seythaarka'l.
padaiveerar ko'l'laiyitta poru'lil, aa'ruladchaththu ezhupaththaiyaayiram aaduka'lum,
ezhupaththeeraayiram maaduka'lum,
a'rupaththoaraayiram kazhuthaika'lum meethiyaayirunthathu.
purushasamyoakaththai a'riyaatha sthireeka'lil muppaththeeraayirampear irunthaarka'l.
yuththagnseyyap poanavarka'lukkuk kidaiththa paathippangkin thokaiyaavathu: aaduka'l moon'ruladchaththu muppaththeazhaayiraththu ainnoo'ru.
intha aaduka'lilea karththarukkup pakuthiyaaka vanthathu a'runoot'ru ezhupaththainthu.
maaduka'l muppaththaa'raayiram; avaika'lil karththarukkup pakuthiyaaka vanthathu ezhupaththira'ndu.
kazhuthaika'l muppathinaayiraththu ainnoo'ru; avaika'lil karththarukkup pakuthiyaaka vanthathu a'rupaththon'ru.
narajeevanka'l pathinaa'raayiram pear; avarka'lil karththarukkup pakuthiyaaka vanthavarka'l muppaththira'ndupear.
karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum anthap pakuthiyai, moasea karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaaridaththil koduththaan.
yuththampa'n'nina pearka'lukkum israveal puththirarukkum moasea paathi paathiyaakap pangkittathinpadiyea sapaiyaarukku vantha paathippangkaavathu:
aaduka'lil moon'ruladchaththu muppaththeazhaayiraththu ainnoo'ru,
maaduka'lil muppaththaa'raayiram,
kazhuthaika'lil muppathinaayiraththu ainnoo'ru,
narajeevanka'lil pathinaa'raayiram pearumea.

israveal puththirarin paathippangkukku vantha intha narajeevanka'lilum mirukangka'lilum moasea aimpathukku on'ru veethamaaka eduththu, avaika'laik karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththin kaavalaik kaakki'ra leaviyarukkuk koduththaan.
pinpu aayirampearukkuth thalaivarum noo'rupearukkuth thalaivarumaana seanaapathika'l moaseayinidaththil vanthu,
umathu oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'l engka'l kaiyin keezhirukki'ra yuththamanitharaith thokaipaarththoam; avarka'lukku'l'lea oru aa'lum ku'raiyavillai.

aakaiyaal, karththarudaiya sannithiyil engka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaakap paavanivirththi seyyumporuttu, engka'lukkuk kidaiththa po'rpa'nika'laakiya paathasarangka'laiyum, asthakadakangka'laiyum, moathirangka'laiyum, kaatha'nika'laiyum, kaappuka'laiyum karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvanthoam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum sakalavitha vealaippaadaana pa'nithika'laana anthap ponnaapara'nangka'lai avarka'lidaththil vaangkinaarka'l.

ippadi aayirampearukkuth thalaivaraanavarka'laalum noo'rupearukkuth thalaivaraanavarka'laalum karththarukku ea'reduththup padaikkum kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththappatta pon muzhuvathum pathinaa'raayiraththu ezhunoot'ru aimpathu seakkal ni'raiyaayirunthathu.
yuththaththi'rkup poana manithar ovvoruvarum thangka'l thangka'lukkaakak ko'l'laiyittirunthaarka'l.

anthap ponnai moaseayum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum aayiram pearukkuth thalaivaraanavarka'lin kaiyilum, noo'rupearukkuth thalaivaraanavarka'lin kaiyilum vaangki, israveal puththirarukku gnaapakakku'riyaaka aasarippuk koodaaraththilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ko'nduvanthu vaiththaarka'l.

roopan puththirarukkum kaath puththirarukkum aadumaaduka'l mikavum thira'laayirunthathu; avarka'l yaasear theasaththaiyum keeleayaath theasaththaiyum paarththapoathu, athu aadumaaduka'lukkuth thakuntha idamen'ru ka'ndaarka'l.
aakaiyaal roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum vanthu, moaseayaiyum aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaaraiyum sapaiyin pirapukka'laiyum noakki:

karththar israveal sapaikku munpaaka mu'riya adiththa atharoath, theepoan, yaasear, nimraa, espoan, eleyaale, seapaam, neapoa, peyoan ennum patta'nangka'laich searntha naadaanathu aadumaaduka'lukkuth thakuntha idam.
umathu adiyaarukku aadumaaduka'l u'ndu.

ummudaiya ka'nka'lil engka'lukkuth thayai kidaiththathaanaal, engka'lai yoarthaan nathikku appu'ram kadanthupoakap pa'n'neeraaka; intha naattai umathu adiyaarukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakak kodukkavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea kaath puththiraraiyum roopan puththiraraiyum noakki: ungka'l sakoatharar yuththaththi'rkup poakaiyil, neengka'l ingkea iruppeerka'loa?
karththar israveal puththirarukkuk koduththa theasaththi'rku avarka'l poakaathapadikku, neengka'l avarka'l iruthayaththaith thidanat'ruppoakappa'n'nuki'rathenna?
antha theasaththaip paarppatha'rku naan ungka'l pithaakka'laik kaatheasparneayaavilirunthu anuppinapoathu avarka'lum ippadiyea seythaarka'l.

avarka'l eskoal pa'l'laththaakkumattum poay, aththeasaththaip paarththuvanthu, israveal puththirar karththar thangka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththi'rkup poakaathapadikku avarka'l iruthayaththaith thidanat'ruppoakappa'n'ninaarka'l.
athinaal karththar annaa'lilea koapam moo'ndavaraaki:
uththamamaay ennaip pinpat'rina keaneasiyanaana eppunneayin kumaaran kaaleapum, noonin kumaaran yoasuvaavum thavira,

ekipthilirunthu vanthavarka'lil irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta manitharka'lil oruvarum ennai uththamamaayp pinpat'raathapadiyaal, avarka'l naan aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththaik kaa'npathillai en'ru aa'naiyittirukki'raar.

appadiyea karththarudaiya koapam isravealinmeal moo'ndathu; karththarudaiya samukaththil pollaappuch seytha anthach santhathiyellaam nirmoolamaakumattum avarka'lai vanaantharaththilea naa'rpathu varusham alaiyappa'n'ninaar.

ippozhuthum ithoa isravealarmealirukkum karththarudaiya koapaththin ukkiraththai innum athikarikkappa'n'numpadi, neengka'l ungka'l pithaakka'lin sthaanaththilea paavamu'l'la perungkoottamaay ezhumpiyirukki'reerka'l.
neengka'l avaraivittup pinvaangkinaal, avar innum avarka'lai vanaantharaththil irukkappa'n'nuvaar; ippadi neengka'l intha janangka'laiyellaam azhiyappa'n'nuveerka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l avan sameepaththil vanthu: engka'l aadumaaduka'lukkaakath thozhuvangka'laiyum, engka'l pi'l'laika'lukkaakap patta'nangka'laiyum ingkea kattuvoam.

naangka'loa israveal puththirarai avarka'l sthaanaththilea ko'ndupoaych searkkuma'lavum, yuththasannaththaraayth theeviraththoadea avarka'lukku munpaaka nadappoam; engka'l pi'l'laika'l iththeasaththuk kudika'linimiththam ara'naana patta'nangka'lilea kudiyirukkak keattukko'l'luki'roam.
israveal puththirar yaavarum thangka'l thangka'l suthantharaththaich suthanthariththuk ko'l'lumvaraikkum, naangka'l engka'l veeduka'lukkuth thirumpuvathillai.

yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil kizhakkea engka'lukkuch suthantharam u'ndaanapadiyinaalea, naangka'l avarka'loadeakooda yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilum, atha'rku appu'raththilum suthantharam vaangkamaattoam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea seythu, karththarudaiya samukaththil yuththasannaththaraaki,

karththar thammudaiya saththurukka'laith thammudaiya mukaththi'rku munnin'ru thuraththividuma'lavum, neengka'l yaavarum avarudaiya samukaththil yuththasannaththaraay yoarthaanaik kadanthupoaveerka'laanaal,

aththeasam karththarukku munpaaka vasappaduththappattapinpu, neengka'l thirumpivanthu, karththarukku munpaakavum, isravealarukku munpaakavum, kut'ramillaathiruppeerka'l; atha'rkuppinpu intha theasam karththarukku munpaaka ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakum.
neengka'l ippadich seyyaama'rpoanaal, karththarukku viroathamaakap paavam seythavarka'laayiruppeerka'l; ungka'l paavam ungka'laith thodarnthupidikkum en'ru nichchayamaay a'riyungka'l.
ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkaakap patta'nangka'laiyum, ungka'l aadumaaduka'lukkaakath thozhuvangka'laiyum katti, ungka'l vaaymozhiyinpadiyea seyyungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu kaath puththirarum roopan puththirarum moaseayai noakki: engka'l aa'ndavan katta'laiyittapadiyea umathu oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'l seyvoam.
engka'l pi'l'laika'lum engka'l manaivika'lum, engka'l aadumaadu muthalaana engka'ludaiya ellaa mirukajeevanka'loadum, ingkea keeleayaaththin patta'nangka'lil iruppaarka'l.
umathu oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'loa engka'l aa'ndavan sonnapadiyea, ovvoruvarum yuththasannaththaraay, karththarudaiya samukaththil yuththaththi'rkup poavoam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea avarka'lukkaaka aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkum, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavukkum, israveal puththirarudaiya koaththira pithaakka'laakiya thalaivarka'lukkum katta'laiyittu:

kaath puththirarum roopan puththirarum avaravar karththarudaiya samukaththil yuththasannaththaraay ungka'loadeakooda yoarthaanaik kadanthupoanaal, aththeasam ungka'lukku vasappattapinpu, avarka'lukkuk keeleayaath theasaththaich suthantharamaakak kodukkakkadaveerka'l.
ungka'loadeakooda yuththasannaththaraayk kadanthu poakaathirunthaarka'leayaanaal, avarka'l ungka'l naduvea kaanaan theasaththilea suthantharam adaiyakkadavarka'l en'raan.
kaath puththirarum roopan puththirarum pirathiyuththaramaaka: ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'l karththar engka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea seyvoam.

yoarthaanukku ikkaraiyilea engka'l suthantharaththin kaa'niyaadchi engka'lukku uriyathaakumpadi naangka'l karththarudaiya samukaththil yuththasannaththaraayk kaanaantheasaththi'rkup poavoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu moasea kaath puththirarukkum, roopan puththirarukkum, yoaseappin kumaaranaakiya manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarukkum, emoariyarudaiya raajaavaakiya seekoanin raajyaththaiyum, paasaanudaiya raajaavaakiya oakin raajyaththaiyum, avaika'laich searntha theasangka'laiyum avaika'lin ellaiyaich sut'rilumu'l'la patta'nangka'laiyum koduththaan.
pinpu kaath santhathiyaar theepoan, atharoath aaroavear,
aathroath, soapaan, yaasear, yokipeayaa,
pethnimraa, peththaaran ennum ara'naana patta'nangka'laiyum aattuththozhuvangka'laiyum kattinaarka'l.
roopan santhathiyaar espoan, eleyaale, keeriyaththaayeem,
pearka'l maat'rappatta neapoa, paakaalmeyoan, seepmaa enpavaika'laik katti, thaangka'l kattina patta'nangka'lukku vea'rea pearka'laik koduththaarka'l.
manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin puththirar keeleayaaththi'rkup poay, athaikkattikko'ndu, athiliruntha emoariyaraith thuraththivittaarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea keeleayaaththai manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerukkuk koduththaan; avarka'l athilea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya yaaveer poay, avarka'ludaiya kiraamangka'laik kattikko'ndu, avaika'lukku yaaveer en'ru pearittaan.
noapaak poay, keanaaththaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum kattikko'ndu, atha'rkuth than naamaththinpadiyea noapaak en'ru pearittaan.
moasea aaroan enpavarka'ludaiya kaiyinkeezhth thangka'lthangka'l seanaika'linpadiyea ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta israveal puththirarudaiya pirayaa'nangka'lin viparam:

moasea thanakkuk karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea avarka'l pu'rappattapirakaaramaaka avarka'ludaiya pirayaa'nangka'lai ezhuthinaan; avarka'l ovvoru idangka'lilirunthu pu'rappattuppa'n'nina pirayaa'nangka'laavana:

muthalaam maathaththin pathinainthaam theathiyilea avarka'l raamaseasai vittup pu'rappattaarka'l; paskaavukku ma'runaa'lilea, ekipthiyar ellaarum paarkka, israveal puththirar pelaththakaiyudan pu'rappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu ekipthiyar karththar thangka'lukku'l'lea sangkariththa thalaichchanpi'l'laika'laiyellaam adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l theavarka'linpearilum karththar neethiseluththinaar.
pinpu israveal puththirar raamaseasilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, sukkoaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
sukkoaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, vanaantharaththin ellaiyilirukki'ra eaththaamilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
eaththaamilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, paakaalsepoanukku ethiraaka irukki'ra eeroath pa'l'laththaakkin munnadikkuth thirumpi, mikthoalukku munpaakap paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
eeroaththai vittup pu'rappattu, samuththiraththai naduvaakak kadanthu vanaantharaththi'rkuppoay, eaththaam vanaantharaththilea moon'runaa'l pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, maaraavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
maaraavilirunthu pu'rappattu, ealimukkup poanaarka'l; ealimilea pannira'ndu neeroot'ruka'lum ezhupathu peareechchamarangka'lum irunthathu; angkea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
ealimilirunthu pu'rappattu, sivantha samuththiraththin arukea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
sivantha samuththiraththai vittup pu'rappattuppoay, seenvanaantharaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
seenvanaantharaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, thopkaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
thopkaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, aaloosilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
aaloosilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, revitheemilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; angkea janangka'lukkuk kudikkath tha'n'neer illaathirunthathu.
revitheemilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, seenaay vanaantharaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
seenaay vanaantharaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, kiproath aththaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
kiproath aththaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, aasaroaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
aasaroaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, rithmaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
rithmaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, rimmoanpeareasilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
rimmoanpeareasilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, lipnaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
lipnaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, reesaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
reesaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, kealaththaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
kealaththaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, saappear malaiyilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
saappear malaiyilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, aarathaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
aarathaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, makkeloaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
makkeloaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, thaakaaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
thaakaaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, thaaraakilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
thaaraakilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, mithkaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
mithkaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, asmoanaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
asmoanaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, moaseroaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
moaseroaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, peneyaakkaanilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
peneyaakkaanilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, kithkaath malaiyilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
kithkaath malaiyilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, yoathpaaththaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
yoathpaaththaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, eproanaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
eproanaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, esiyoan keapearilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
esiyoan keapearilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, kaatheasaakiya seenvanaantharaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
kaatheasilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, eathoam theasaththin ellaiyilirukki'ra oar ennum malaiyilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu aasaariyanaakiya aaroan karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea oar ennum malaiyinmeal ea'ri, angkea israveal puththirar ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'rpathaam varusham ainthaam maatham muthal theathiyilea mara'namadainthaan.
aaroan oar ennum malaiyilea mara'namadainthapoathu, noot'rirupaththumoon'ru vayathaayirunthaan.
