annaadka'lilea kaanaan theasaththin thenthisaiyil kudiyiruntha kaanaaniyanaakiya aaraath ennum raajaa israveal puththirar varuki'rathaik kea'lvippattaan.
oar ennum malaiyai vittup pu'rappattuppoay, salmoanaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
salmoanaavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, poonoanilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
poonoanilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, oapoaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
oapoaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, moavaapin ellaiyilu'l'la apaareemin meaduka'lilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
antha meaduka'lai vittup pu'rappattuppoay, theepoankaaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
theepoankaaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, almoan thiplaththaayimilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
almoan thiplaththaayimilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, neapoavukku ethiraana apaareem malaika'lilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
apaareem malaika'lilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, erikoavin arukea yoarthaanaich saarntha moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
yoarthaanaich saarntha moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil avarka'l pethyesimoaththaith thodangki, aapealsiththeemmattum paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l.
erikoavin arukea yoarthaanaich saarntha moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilea karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthu, kaanaantheasaththil poaych searumpoathu,

aththeasaththuk kudika'laiyellaam ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththivittu, avarka'ludaiya ellaach silaika'laiyum vaarppikkappatta avarka'ludaiya ellaa vikkirakangka'laiyum azhiththu, avarka'l meadaika'laiyellaam nirmoolamaakki,
theasaththilu'l'lavarka'laith thuraththivittu, athilea kudiyirukkakkadaveerka'l; anthath theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi athai ungka'lukkuk koduththean.

seettuppoattu, theasaththai ungka'l kudumpangka'lukkuch suthantharangka'laakap pangkittu, athika janangka'lukku athika suthantharamum, kogncha janangka'lukkuk kognchach suthantharamum kodukkakkadaveerka'l; avaravarkkuch seettu vizhum idam ethuvoa, avvidam avaravarkku uriyathaakum; ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththirangka'linpadiyea suthantharam pet'rukko'l'lakkadaveerka'l.

neengka'l theasaththin kudika'lai ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththividaamaliruppeerka'laanaal, appozhuthu avarka'lil neengka'l meethiyaaka vaikki'ravarka'l ungka'l ka'nka'lil mu'l'luka'lum ungka'l vilaakka'lilea koorka'lumaayirunthu, neengka'l kudiyirukki'ra theasaththilea ungka'lai upaththiravappaduththuvaarka'l.
an'riyum, naan avarka'lukkuch seyya ninaiththathai ungka'lukkuch seyvean en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyittuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: kaanaantheasam athin ellaika'l udpada ungka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak kidaikkappoaki'rathu; neengka'l kaanaantheasaththil searumpoathu,
ungka'l thenpu'ram seenvanaantharam thodangki eathoam theasaththin oaramattum irukkum; kizhakkea irukki'ra uppukkadalin kadaisi thodangki ungka'l then ellaiyaayirukkum.

ungka'l ellai the'rkilirunthu akkaraapeem meaduka'laich sut'ri, seenvanaantharamvaraiyil poay, the'rkilea kaatheasparneayaavukkum, angkeayirunthu aathsaar athaarukkum, angkeayirunthu asmoanaavukkum poay,
asmoanaavilirunthu ekipthin nathivaraikkum sut'rippoayk kadalil mudiyum.
meat'risaikkup perungkadalea ungka'lukku ellai; athuvea ungka'lukku mea'rpu'raththu ellaiyaayirukkum.
ungka'lukku vadathisai ellai perungkadal thodangki, oar ennum malaiyai ungka'lukkuk ku'rippaaka vaiththu,
oar ennum malai thodangki, aamaaththi'rkup poaki'ra vazhiyaik ku'rippaaka vaiththu, angkeayirunthu antha ellai seathaaththi'rkup poay,
angkeayirunthu athu siproanukkuppoay, aathsaar eanaanilea mudiyum; athuvea ungka'lukku vadapu'raththu ellaiyaayirukkum.
ungka'lukkuk keezhththisai ellaikku aathsaar eanaanilirunthu seappaamaik ku'rippaaka vaiththu,
seappaamilirunthu ellaiyaanathu aayinukkuk kizhakkilu'l'la riplaapariyanthamum, angkeayirunthu kinnareath kadalpariyanthamum athin keezhkkaraiyoaramaay,
angkeayirunthu yoarthaanpariyanthamum poay, uppukkadalil mudiyum; inthach sut'rellaika'laiyudaiya theasamea ungka'lukkuriya theasam en'ru sol en'raar.

appozhuthu moasea israveal puththirarai noakki: onpatharaik koaththiraththaarukkuk kodukkumpadi karththar katta'laiyittathum, neengka'l seettuppoattuch suthanthariththukko'l'lavea'ndiyathumaana theasam ithuvea.

roopan puththirar thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadiyum, kaath puththirar thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsaththinpadiyum, thangka'l suthantharaththaip pet'rukko'ndathum allaamal, manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum thangka'l suthantharaththaip pet'rukko'ndaarka'l.
intha ira'ndaraik koaththiraththaarum sooriyoathaya thisaiyaakiya kizhakkea erikoavin arukeayu'l'la yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilea thangka'l suthantharaththaip pet'rukko'ndaarka'l en'raan.
mealum karththar moaseayai noakki:
ungka'lukku theasaththaip pangkittukkodukkum manitharin naamangka'laavana: aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavumea.
an'riyum, theasaththaip pangkidumpadi ovvoru koaththiraththil ovvoru thalaivanaiyum therinthuko'l'lungka'l.
antha manitharudaiya naamangka'laavana: yoothaa koaththiraththukku eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapum,
simiyoan puththirarin koaththiraththukku ammiyoothin kumaaranaakiya saamuvealum,
penyameen koaththiraththukkuk kisloanin kumaaranaakiya elithaathum,
thaa'n puththirarin koaththiraththukku yokliyin kumaaranaakiya pukki ennum pirapuvum,
yoaseappin kumaaranaakiya manaasea puththirarin koaththiraththukku epoathin kumaaranaakiya anniyeal ennum pirapuvum,
eppiraayeem puththirarin koaththiraththukkuch sipthaanin kumaaranaakiya keamuveal ennum pirapuvum,
sepuloan puththirarin koaththiraththukkup parnaakin kumaaranaakiya elisaappaan ennum pirapuvum,
isakkaar puththirarin koaththiraththukku aasaanin kumaaranaakiya palththiyeal ennum pirapuvum,
aasear puththirarin koaththiraththukkuch seloamiyin kumaaranaakiya akiyooth ennum pirapuvum,
napthali puththirarin koaththiraththukku ammiyoothin kumaaranaakiya pethaakkeal ennum pirapuvumea en'raar.
kaanaantheasaththilea israveal puththirarukkuch suthantharangka'laip pangkittuk kodukki'ratha'rkuk karththar katta'laiyittavarka'l ivarka'lea.
erikoavin arukea yoarthaanaich searntha moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilea karththar moaseayai noakki:

israveal puththirar thangka'l kaa'niyaadchiyaakiya suthantharaththilea leaviyarukkuk kudiyirukkumpadi patta'nangka'laik kodukkavea'ndum en'ru avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyidu; anthap patta'nangka'laich soozhnthirukki'ra ve'linilangka'laiyum leaviyarukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.

anthap patta'nangka'l avarka'l kudiyiruppatha'rkum, avaika'laich soozhntha ve'linilangka'l avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'lukkum, avarka'ludaiya aasthika'lukkum, avarka'ludaiya sakala mirukajeevanka'lukkum ku'rikkappadavea'ndum.
neengka'l leaviyarukkuk kodukkum patta'nangka'laich soozhntha ve'linilangka'l patta'naththin mathilthodangki, ve'liyilea sut'rilum aayiramuzha thooraththukku ettavea'ndum.

patta'nam maththiyil irukka, patta'naththin ve'lippu'ranthodangki, kizhakkea ira'ndaayiramuzhamum, the'rkea ira'ndaayiramuzhamum, mea'rkea ira'ndaayiramuzhamum, vadakkea ira'ndaayiramuzhamum a'lanthuvidakkadaveerka'l; ithu avarka'l patta'nangka'lukku ve'linilangka'laayiruppathaaka.

neengka'l leaviyarukkuk kodukkum patta'nangka'lil adaikkalaththukkaaka aa'ru patta'nangka'l irukkavea'ndum; kolaiseythavan angkea thappi oadippoaki'ratha'rku avaika'laik ku'rikkakkadaveerka'l; avaika'laiyallaamal, naa'rpaththira'ndu patta'nangka'lai avarka'lukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
neengka'l leaviyarukkuk kodukkavea'ndiya patta'nangka'lellaam naa'rpaththettup patta'nangka'lum avaika'laich soozhntha ve'linilangka'lumea.

neengka'l israveal puththirarin suthantharaththilirunthu anthap patta'nangka'laip piriththuk kodukkumpoathu, athikamu'l'lavarka'lidaththilirunthu athikamum, kognchamu'l'lavarka'lidaththilirunthu kognchamum piriththukkodukkavea'ndum; avaravar suthanthariththukko'nda suthantharaththinpadiyea thangka'l patta'nangka'lil leaviyarukkuk kodukkakkadavarka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar moaseayai noakki:
nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthu, kaanaantheasaththil piraveasikkumpoathu,
kaippisakaay oruvanaik kon'rupoattavan oadippoayirukkaththakka adaikkalappatta'nangka'laakach sila patta'nangka'laik ku'rikkakkadaveerka'l.
kolaiseythavan niyaayasapaiyilea niyaayam visaarikkappadumun saakaamal, pazhivaangkuki'ravan kaikkuth thappippoayirukkumpadi, avaika'l ungka'lukku adaikkalappatta'nangka'laay irukkakkadavathu.
neengka'l kodukkum patta'nangka'lil aa'ru patta'nangka'l adaikkalaththukkaaka irukkavea'ndum.
yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil moon'ru patta'nangka'laiyum, kaanaantheasaththil moon'ru patta'nangka'laiyum kodukkavea'ndum; avaika'l adaikkalappatta'nangka'laam.

kaippisakaay oruvanaik kon'ravan evanoa, avan angkea oadippoayirukkumpadikku, antha aa'ru patta'nangka'lum israveal puththirarukkum ungka'l naduvea irukkum paratheasikkum anniyanukkum adaikkalappatta'nangka'laay irukkavea'ndum.
oruvan iruppu aayuthaththinaal oruvanai vettinathinaal avan seththuppoanaal, vettinavan kolaipaathakanaayirukki'raan; kolaipaathakan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
oruvan oru kallai eduththu, saakaththakkathaaka oruvanmeal e'riki'rathinaalea avan seththuppoanaal, kalle'rinthavan kolaipaathakanaayirukki'raan, avan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.

oruvan than kaiyil oru mara aayuthaththai eduththu, saakaththakkathaaka oruvanai adiththathinaal avan seththuppoanaal, adiththavan kolaipaathakanaayirukki'raan; kolaipaathakan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
pazhivaangkavea'ndiyavanea kolaipaathakanaik kollavea'ndum; avanaik ka'ndamaaththiraththil avanaik kon'rupoadalaam.
oruvan pakaiyinaal oruvanai vizhaththa'l'linathinaalaayinum, pathungkiyirunthu avan saakaththakkathaay avanmeal eathaakilum e'rinthathinaalaayinum,

avanaip pakaiththu, than kaiyinaal adiththathinaalaayinum, avan seththuppoanaal, adiththavan kolaipaathakan; avan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum, pazhivaangkuki'ravan kolaipaathakanaik ka'ndamaaththiraththil kon'rupoadalaam.
oruvan pakaiyon'rum illaamal saduthiyil oruvanaith tha'l'li vizhappa'n'ninathinaalaayinum, pathungkiyiraamal yaathoru aayuthaththai avanmeal pada e'rinthathinaalaayinum,

avanukkup pakaignanaayiraamalum avanukkuth theengku seyya ninaiyaamalum irukkaiyil, oruvanaik kon'rupoadaththakka oru kallinaal avanaik kaa'naamal e'riya, athu avanmeal pattathinaalaayinum, avan seththuppoanaal,
appozhuthu kolaiseythavanaiyum pazhivaangkuki'ravanaiyum sapaiyaar intha niyaayappadi visaariththu,

kolaiseythavanaip pazhivaangkuki'ravanudaiya kaikkuth thappuviththu, avan oadippoayiruntha adaikkalappatta'naththukku avanaith thirumpap poakumpadi seyyakkadavarka'l; parisuththa thailaththinaal apisheakam pet'ra pirathaana aasaariyan mara'namadaiyumattum avan athilea irukkakkadavan.
aanaalum kolaiseythavan thaan oadippoayirukki'ra adaikkalappatta'naththin ellaiyai vittu ve'lippattirukkumpoathu,
pazhivaangkuki'ravan kolaiseythavanai adaikkalappatta'naththukku ve'liyea ka'ndupidiththuk kon'rupoattaal, avanmeal iraththappazhi illai.

kolaiseythavan pirathaana aasaariyan mara'namadaiyumattum adaikkalap patta'naththilirukkavea'ndum; pirathaana aasaariyan mara'namadainthapinpu, than suthantharamaana kaa'niyaadchikkuth thirumpip poakalaam.
ivaika'l ungka'l vaasasthalangka'lilengkum ungka'l thalaimu'raithoa'rum ungka'lukku niyaayavithip piramaa'namaayirukkakkadavathu.

evanaakilum, oru manithanaik kon'rupoattaal, appozhuthu saadchika'ludaiya vaakkumoolaththinpadiyea anthak kolaipaathakanaik kolaiseyyakkadavarka'l; orea saadchiyaikko'ndumaaththiram oru manithan saakumpadi theerppuchseyyalaakaathu.
saaki'ratha'rkeat'ra kut'ragnsumantha kolaipaathakanudaiya jeevanukkaaka neengka'l meedkumporu'lai vaangkakkoodaathu; avan thappaamal kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
than adaikkalappatta'naththukku oadippoanavan aasaariyan mara'namadaiyaathatha'rku munnea than naatti'rkuth thirumpivarumpadi neengka'l avanukkaaka meedkumporu'lai vaangkakkoodaathu.

neengka'l irukkum theasaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaathirungka'l; iraththam theasaththaith theettuppaduththum; iraththam sinthinavanudaiya iraththaththinaaleayozhiya, vea'ron'rinaalum theasaththilea sinthu'nda iraththaththi'rkaakap paavanivirththiyillai.
neengka'l kudiyirukkum en vaasasthalamaakiya theasaththaith theettuppaduththavea'ndaam; karththaraakiya naan israveal puththirar naduvea vaasampa'n'nuki'rean en'ru sol en'raar.

yoaseappin kumaaranudaiya vamsaththaaril manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerukkup pi'rantha keeleayaaththin vamsa pithaakka'laana thalaivar searnthu, moaseakkum israveal puththirarudaiya pithaakka'lil thalaivaraakiya pirapukka'lukkum munpaaka vanthu, avarka'lai noakki:

seettuppoattu, theasaththai israveal puththirarukkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkumpadi engka'l aa'ndavanukkuk karththar katta'laiyittaarea; an'riyum, engka'l sakoatharanaakiya seloppiyaaththin suthantharaththai avan kumaaraththika'lukkuk kodukkavea'ndum en'rum engka'l aa'ndavanukkuk karththaraalea katta'laiyidappattathea.

ippadiyirukka, ivarka'l israveal puththirarudaiya vea'roru koaththiraththin puththirarukku manaivika'laanaal, anthak kumaaraththika'ludaiya suthantharam engka'l pithaakka'ludaiya suthantharaththilirunthu neengki, avarka'l udpaduki'ra koaththiraththin suthantharaththoadea searnthupoakum; ippadi engka'l suthantharaththukkuch seettinaal vizhuntha pangkil iraamal at'ruppoakumea.

israveal puththirarukku yoopili varusham vanthaalum, avarka'ludaiya suthantharam avarka'l udpattuppoana koaththiraththin suthantharaththoadea searnthupoakum; ippadi engka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththiraththin suthantharaththilirunthu athu neengkippoakumea en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu moasea karththarudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea israveal puththirarai noakki: yoaseappu puththirarin koaththiraththaar solluki'rathu sariyea.

karththar seloppiyaaththin kumaaraththika'laikku'riththa kaariyaththil katta'laiyiduki'rathaavathu: avarka'l thangka'lukku ishdamaanavarka'lai vivaakagnseyyalaam; aanaalum, thangka'l pithaavin koaththira vamsaththaarilmaaththiram avarka'l vivaakagnseyyavea'ndum.

ippadiyea israveal puththirarin suthantharam oru koaththiraththaivittu, vea'ru koaththiraththukkup poakaathirukkum; israveal puththirar avaravar thangka'lthangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya koaththiraththin suthantharaththilea nilaiko'ndirukka vea'ndum.

israveal puththirar avaravar thangka'lthangka'l pithaakka'lin suthantharaththai anupavikkumpadi, israveal puththirarudaiya oru koaththiraththilea suthantharam adainthirukki'ra enthak kumaaraththiyum than pithaavin koaththira vamsaththaaril oruvanukku manaiviyaakavea'ndum.

suthantharamaanathu oru koaththiraththaivittu vea'roru koaththiraththaich searakkoodaathu; israveal puththirarudaiya ovvoru koaththiramum thanthan suthantharaththilea nilaiko'ndirukkavea'ndum en'ru katta'laiyittirukki'raar en'raan.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seloppiyaaththin kumaaraththika'l seythaarka'l.

seloppiyaaththin kumaaraththika'laakiya maklaa'l thirsaa'l oklaa'l milkaa'l noavaa'l enpavarka'l thangka'l pithaavin sakoathararudaiya puththirarai vivaakampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l yoaseappin kumaaranaakiya manaasea puththirarin vamsaththaarai vivaakampa'n'ninapadiyaal,
avarka'ludaiya suthantharam avarka'l pithaavin vamsamaana koaththiraththoadea irunthathu.
erikoavin arukea yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilu'l'la moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil karththar moaseayaikko'ndu israveal puththirarukku vithiththa katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lum ivaika'lea.
seayeer malaivazhiyaay oareapukkup pathinorunaa'l pirayaa'na thooraththilu'l'la kaatheasparneayaavilirunthu,

sooppukku ethiraakavum, paaraanukkum thoappealukkum laapaanukkum aasaroaththukkum thisaakaapukkum naduvaakavum irukki'ra yoarthaanukku ikkaraiyaana vanaantharaththin samanaana ve'liyilea vanthapoathu, moasea isravealar ellaaraiyum noakkich sonna vasanangka'laavana:
espoanil kudiyiruntha emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanaiyum, ethreayin arukea astharoaththil kudiyiruntha paasaanin raajaavaakiya oak enpavanaiyum, moasea mu'riya adiththapinpu,
naa'rpathaam varusham pathinoaraam maatham muthal theathiyilea, moasea israveal puththirarukkuch sollumpadi thanakkuk karththar vithiththa yaavaiyum avarka'lukkuch sonnaan.
yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilirukki'ra moavaapin theasaththil moasea intha niyaayappiramaa'naththai vivariththuk kaa'npikkath thodangki,
oareapilea nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar nammoadea sonnathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l intha malaiyarukea thangkiyirunthathu poathum.

neengka'l thirumpip pirayaa'nam pu'rappattu, emoariyarin malainaatti'rkum, atha'rku aduththa ellaa samanaana ve'lika'lilum kun'ruka'lilum pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum, thenthisaiyilum kadaloaraththilum irukki'ra kaanaaniyarin theasaththukkum, leepanoanukkum, aippiraaththu nathi ennum periya nathivaraikkum poangka'l.

ithoa, inthath theasaththai ungka'lukku munpaaka vaiththean; neengka'l poay, karththar ungka'l pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum avarka'lukkup pinvarum avarka'l santhathikkum aa'naiyittuk koduththa antha theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lungka'l en'raar.
akkaalaththilea naan ungka'lai noakki: naan oruvanaaka ungka'l paaraththaith thaangkakkoodaathu.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'laip perukappa'n'ninaar; ithoa, innaa'lil neengka'l vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'laippoalath thira'laayirukki'reerka'l.
neengka'l ippozhuthu irukki'rathaippaarkkilum aayiramadangku athikamaakumpadi ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch solliyapadiyea ungka'lai aaseervathippaaraaka.
ungka'l varuththaththaiyum pirayaasaththaiyum vazhakkuka'laiyum naan oruvanaayth thaangkuvathu eppadi?
naan ungka'lukku athipathika'lai ea'rpaduththumporuttu, ungka'l koaththirangka'lil gnaanamum viveakamum a'rivum u'l'lavarka'l en'ru pearpet'ra manitharaith therinthuko'l'lungka'l en'ru sonnean.
neengka'l enakkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer seyyachsonna kaariyam nallathu en'reerka'l.

aakaiyaal naan gnaanamum a'rivumu'l'la manitharaakiya ungka'l koaththirangka'lin vamsapathika'laith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'l ungka'lukkuth thalaivaraayirukkumpadi, aayirampearukku athipathika'laakavum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'laakavum, aimpathupearukku athipathika'laakavum, paththuppearukku athipathika'laakavum ungka'l koaththirangka'lil athikaarika'laakavum ea'rpaduththivaiththean.

akkaalaththilea ungka'ludaiya niyaayaathipathika'lai naan noakki: neengka'l ungka'l sakoathararin viyaachchiyangka'laik keattu, irupadchaththaaraakiya ungka'l sakoathararukkum, avarka'lidaththil thangkum anniyanukkum, neethiyinpadi theerppuchseyyungka'l.

niyaayaththilea mukathaadchi'niyam paaraamal periyavanukkuch sevikoduppathupoalach si'riyavanukkum sevikodukkakkadaveerka'l; manithan mukaththi'rkup payappadeerka'laaka; niyaayaththeerppu theavanudaiyathu; ungka'lukkuk kadinamaayirukkum kaariyaththai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l; naan athaik keadpean en'ru solli,
neengka'l seyyavea'ndiya kaariyangka'l yaavaiyum akkaalaththilea katta'laiyittean.

nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, naam oareapaivittup pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, emoariyarin malainaatti'rku nearaaka neengka'l ka'nda anthap payangkaramaana periya vanaantharavazhi muzhuvathum nadanthuvanthu, kaatheasparneayaavilea searnthoam.
appozhuthu naan ungka'lai noakki: nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakkuk kodukkum emoariyarin malainaadumattum vanthu searntheerka'l.

ithoa, un theavanaakiya karththar antha theasaththai unakku munpaaka vaiththirukki'raar; un pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadiyea, nee poay athaich suthanthariththukko'l; payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum iru en'rean.

appozhuthu neengka'l ellaarum ennidaththil vanthu: namakkaaka antha theasaththaich soathiththuppaarkkavum, naam innavazhiyaaka athil sen'ru, innapatta'nangka'lukkup poakalaam en'ru namakku ma'ruseythi ko'nduvaravum, namakku munnaaka manitharai anuppuvoam en'reerka'l.
athu enakku nan'raayk ka'ndathu; koaththiraththi'rku oruvanaakap pannira'ndu manitharaith therintheduththu anuppinean.
avarka'l pu'rappattu, malaika'lil ea'ri, eskoal pa'l'laththaakkumattum poay, athai veavupaarththu,

aththeasaththuk kanika'lil silavat'raith thangka'l kaiyil eduththukko'ndu nammidaththil vanthu, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakkuk kodukkum theasam nalla theasam en'ru nammidaththil sonnaarka'l.
appadiyirunthum, neengka'l poakamaattoam en'ru ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya katta'laikku viroathamaaka ethirththu,
ungka'l koodaarangka'lil mu'rumu'ruththu: karththar nammai ve'ruththu, nammai azhikkumporuttaaka nammai emoariyarin kaiyil oppukkodukkumpadi, nammai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.

naam engkea poakalaam; antha janangka'l nammaippaarkkilum palavaanka'lum, nediyavarka'lum, avarka'l patta'nangka'l periyavaika'lum, vaanaththaiya'laavum mathilu'l'lavaika'lumaay irukki'rathen'rum, eanaakkiyarin puththiraraiyum angkea ka'ndoam en'rum nammudaiya sakoatharar solli, nammudaiya iruthayaththaik kalangkappa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru sonneerka'l.
appozhuthu naan ungka'lai noakki: neengka'l kalangkaamalum avarka'lukkup payappadaamalum irungka'l.

ungka'lukku mun sellum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thaamea ekipthil ungka'loadirunthu, ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakach seythathellaavat'raippoalavum, vanaantharaththil seythuvanthathupoalavum, ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaar.

oru manithan than pi'l'laiyaich sumanthuko'ndu poavathupoala, neengka'l ivvidaththi'rku varuki'ravaraikkum, nadanthuvantha vazhika'l ellaavat'rilum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'laich sumanthuko'ndu vanthathaik ka'ndeerka'lea.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar neengka'l paa'layami'rangkaththakka idaththaip paarkkavum, neengka'l poakavea'ndiya vazhiyai ungka'lukkuk kaattavum,
iravil akkiniyilum pakalil meakaththilum ungka'lukkumun sen'raarea. ippadiyirunthum, inthak kaariyaththil neengka'l avarai visuvaasiyaama'r poaneerka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar ungka'l vaarththaika'lin saththaththaik keattu, kadungkoapangko'ndu:
ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru naan aa'naiyitta antha nalla theasaththai inthap pollaatha santhathiyaaraakiya manitharil oruvarum kaa'npathillai en'rum,

eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapmaaththiram athaik kaa'npaan; avan karththarai uththamamaayp pinpat'rinapadiyinaal, naan avan mithiththuvantha theasaththai avanukkum avan pi'l'laika'lukkum koduppean en'rum aa'naiyittaar.
an'riyum ungka'l nimiththam karththar enmealum koapangko'ndu: neeyum athil piraveasippathillai;
unakku munpaaka ni'rki'ra noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa athil piraveasippaan; avanaith thidappaduththu; avanea athai isravealukkuch suthantharamaakap pangkiduvaan.

ko'l'laiyaavaarka'l en'ru neengka'l sonna ungka'l kuzhanthaika'lum, innaa'lilea nanmai theemai a'riyaatha ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum athil piraveasippaarka'l; avarka'lukku athaik koduppean; avarka'l athaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.
neengka'loa thirumpikko'ndu, sivantha samuththiraththin vazhiyaay vanaantharaththi'rkup pirayaa'nappattuppoangka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu neengka'l enakkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythoam; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam naangka'l poay yuththampa'n'nuvoam en'ru solli, neengka'l yaavarum ungka'l aayuthangka'laith thariththukko'ndu, malaiyinmeal ea'ra aayaththamaayiruntheerka'l.

appozhuthu karththar ennaip paarththu: neengka'l ungka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka mu'rinthupoakaathapadikku, poakaamalum yuththampa'n'naamalum iruppeerka'laaka; naan ungka'l naduvea irean en'ru avarka'lukkuch sol en'raar.
appadiyea naan ungka'lukkuch sonnean; neengka'loa sevikodaamal, karththarudaiya katta'laikku viroathamaakath thu'ninthu malaiyinmeal ea'rineerka'l.

antha malaiyilea kudiyiruntha emoariyar ungka'lai ethirkkumpadi pu'rappattuvanthu, theaneekka'l thuraththuki'rathupoala ungka'laith thuraththi, ungka'laich seayeer thodangki oarmaamattum mu'riya adiththaarka'l.
neengka'l thirumpivanthu, karththarudaiya samukaththil azhutheerka'l; karththar ungka'l saththaththaik keadkavillai, ungka'lukkuch sevikodukkavum illai.
ippadi kaatheasilea thangki, angkea vekunaa'laayiruntheerka'l.
karththar enakkuch solliyapadi naam thirumpi, sivantha samuththiraththi'rkup poaki'ra vazhiyaay vanaantharaththi'rkup pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, aneaka naa'l seayeer naattaich sut'riththirinthoam.
appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki:
neengka'l intha malainaattaich sut'riththirinthathu poathum; vadakkea thirumpungka'l.

janangka'lukku nee katta'laiyidavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: seayeerilea kudiyirukki'ra easaavin puththiraraana ungka'l sakoathararin ellaiyaik kadakkappoaki'reerka'l; avarka'l ungka'lukkup payappaduvaarka'l; neengka'loa mikavum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l;
avarka'loadea poarseyyavea'ndaam; avarka'l theasaththilea oru adi nilamum ungka'lukkuk kodean; seayeer malainaattai easaavukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththirukki'rean.
poajanapathaarththangka'lai avarka'l kaiyilea pa'naththi'rku vaangkip pusiththu, tha'n'neeraiyum avarka'l kaiyilea pa'naththi'rku vaangkik kudiyungka'l.

un theavanaakiya karththar un kaikkiriyaika'lilellaam unnai aaseervathiththu varuki'raar; inthap periya vanaantharavazhiyaay nee nadanthuvaruki'rathai a'rivaar; intha naa'rpathu varushamum un theavanaakiya karththar unnoadea irunthaar; unakku on'rum ku'raivupadavillai en'ru sol en'raar.

appadiyea naam seayeerilea kudiyirukki'ra nammudaiya sakoathararaakiya easaavin puththirarai vittup pu'rappattu, antharave'li vazhiyaay ealaathmealum, esiyoankeapearmealum poay, thirumpikko'ndu, moavaap vanaantharavazhiyaay vanthoam.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: nee moavaapai varuththappaduththaamalum, avarka'loadea poarseyyaamalum iru; avarka'l theasaththil unakku on'rum suthantharamaakak kodean; aar ennum patta'naththin seemaiyai loath puththirarukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththean.
thira'laanavarka'lum eanaakkiyaraippoala nediyavarka'lumaana palaththa janangka'laakiya eamiyar athil munnea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
avarka'lum eanaakkiyaraiyoththa iraadchathar en'ru e'n'nappattaarka'l; moavaapiyaroa avarka'lai eamiyar en'ru solluki'raarka'l.

oariyarum seayeeril munnea kudiyirunthaarka'l; karththar thangka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththa theasaththaarai israveal thuraththinathupoala, easaavin puththirar antha oariyaraith thuraththi, avarka'laith thangka'l mukaththi'rku munpaaka azhiththu, avarka'l iruntha sthaanaththil kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
neengka'l ezhunthu, seareath aat'raik kadanthupoangka'l en'ru sonnaar; appadiyea seareath aat'raik kadanthoam.

yuththa manitharaana anthach santhathiyellaam karththar thangka'lukku aa'naiyittapadiyea paa'layaththin naduvilirunthu maa'ndupoaka, naam kaatheasparneayaavai vittup pu'rappattathu mutha'rko'ndu, seareath aat'raik kadakkumattum, sen'ra kaalam muppaththettu varushamaayit'ru.
avarka'l paa'layaththin naduvilirunthu maa'ndu ozhiyumattum karththarin kai avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumpadikku avarka'lukku viroathamaayirunthathu.
yuththamanithar ellaarum janaththin naduvilirunthu seththuth theernthapinpu,
karththar ennai noakki:
nee aar patta'nam irukki'ra moavaapin ellaiyai in'raikkuk kadanthu,

ammoan puththirarukku ethiraakach searappoaki'raay; nee avarka'lai varuththappaduththavum avarka'loadea poarseyyavum vea'ndaam; ammoan puththirarin theasaththil on'rum unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodean; athai loath puththirarukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththirukki'rean.
athuvum iraadchatharudaiya theasamaaka e'n'nappattathu; mu'rkaalaththil iraadchathar athilea kudiyirunthaarka'l, ammoaniyar avarka'laich samsoomiyar en'ru solluki'raarka'l.

avarka'l thira'laanavarka'lum eanaakkiyaraippoala nediyavarka'lumaana palaththa janangka'laayirunthaarka'l; karththaroa seayeeril kudiyiruntha easaavin puththirarukku munpaaka oariyarai azhikka, avarka'l antha janangka'laith thuraththivittu, avarka'l iruntha sthaanaththil innaa'lvaraikkum kudiyirukki'rathupoalavum,
kapthoarilirunthu pu'rappatta kapthoariyar aaseareem thodangki aasaamattum kudiyiruntha aaviyarai azhiththu, avarka'l iruntha sthaanaththilea kudiyea'rinathupoalavum,
karththar avarka'lai ivarka'lukku munpaaka azhiyappa'n'na, ivarka'l avarka'laith thuraththivittu, avarka'l iruntha sthaanaththilea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.

neengka'l ezhunthu pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, arnoan aat'raik kadanthupoangka'l; espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoan ennum emoariyanaiyum avan theasaththaiyum un kaiyilea oppukkoduththean; ithumuthal athaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi avanoadea yuththagnsey.
vaanaththinkeezh engkumu'l'la janangka'l unnaalea thikilum payamum adaiyumpadi seyya in'ru naan thodangkuvean; avarka'l un keerththiyaik keattu, unnimiththam nadungki, veathanaippaduvaarka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu naan kethemoath vanaantharaththilirunthu espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanidaththil, samaathaana vaarththaika'laich sollumpadi sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:
naan ummudaiya theasaththaik kadanthupoakumpadi uththaravukodum; valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaamal perumpaathai vazhiyaay nadappean.

seayeeril kudiyirukki'ra easaavin puththirarum, aar patta'naththil kudiyirukki'ra moavaapiyarum enakkuch seythathupoala, neerum, naan yoarthaanaik kadanthu, engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukkuk kodukki'ra theasaththil searumattum,
enakkup pusikka aakaaraththaiyum kudikkath tha'n'neeraiyum kirayaththukkuth thaarum; naan kaalnadaiyaayk kadanthupoakamaaththiram uththaravukodum en'ru solli anuppinean.

aanaalum than theasaththaik kadanthupoakumpadi, espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoan namakku uththaravu kodukkavillai; innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, un theavanaakiya karththar avanai un kaiyil oppukkodukkumpadi, avan manathaik kadinappaduththi, avan iruthayaththai urangko'l'lappa'n'niyirunthaar.
appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: ithoa, seekoanaiyum avan theasaththaiyum unakku oppukkodukkappoaki'rean; ithumuthal avan theasaththai vasappaduththi, suthanthariththukko'l en'raar.
seekoan thannudaiya ellaa janangka'loadungkooda nammoadea yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattu, yaakaasilea vanthaan.
avanai nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakku oppukkoduththaar; naam avanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum avanudaiya sakala janangka'laiyum mu'riya adiththu,
akkaalaththil avan patta'nangka'laiyellaam pidiththu, sakala patta'nangka'lilum iruntha sthiree purusharaiyum, pi'l'laika'laiyum, oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal sangkaarampa'n'ninoam.
mirukajeevanka'laiyum naam pidiththa patta'nangka'lil ko'l'laiyadiththa poru'lka'laiyumaaththiram namakken'ru vaiththukko'ndoam.

arnoan aat'rangkaraiyil irukki'ra aaroavearum aat'ra'ndaiyil irukki'ra patta'namum thodangki, keeleayaathvaraikkum namakku ethirththuni'rkaththakka ara'nippaana patta'nam irunthathillai, ellaavat'raiyum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakku oppukkoduththaar.

ammoan puththirarudaiya theasaththaiyum, yaapoak aat'rangkaraiyilu'l'la idangka'laiyum, malaika'lilu'l'la patta'nangka'laiyum, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakku vilakkina mat'ra idangka'laiyum searaamal vilakippoanaay.

pinpu naam thirumpi, paasaanukkup poaki'ra vazhiyaayp poanoam; paasaanin raajaavaakiya oak thannudaiya sakala janangka'loadum nammoadea ethirththu yuththampa'n'numpadi pu'rappattu, ethreayikku vanthaan.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: avanukkup payappadavea'ndaam; avanaiyum avanudaiya janangka'l ellaaraiyum avan theasaththaiyum un kaiyil oppukkoduththean; espoanilea kudiyiruntha emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanukku nee seythathupoala, avanukkum seyvaay en'raar.

appadiyea nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakaiyum avanudaiya sakala janangka'laiyum nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avanukku oruvarum meethiyaayiraama'rpoakumattum avanai mu'riya adiththoam.

akkaalaththilea avanudaiya patta'nangka'laiyellaam pidiththoam; avarka'lidaththil naam pidiththukko'l'laatha patta'nam illai; paasaaniliruntha oakin raajyamaana a'rupathu patta'nangka'lu'l'la arkoap theasam muzhuvathaiyum pidiththoam.
anthap patta'nangka'lellaam uyarntha mathilka'laalum vaasalka'laalum thaazhppaa'lka'laalum ara'naakkappattirunthathu; avaika'l an'ri, mathilillaatha patta'nangka'lum aneakam.

avaika'laiyum sangkaarampa'n'ninoam; naam espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanukkuch seythathupoala, antha ellaap patta'nangka'lilumu'l'la purusharaiyum sthireeka'laiyum pi'l'laika'laiyum sangkaarampa'n'ninoam.
aanaalum patta'nangka'lilu'l'la aasthiyaiyum sakala mirukajeevanka'laiyum namakken'ru ko'l'laiyittoam.
ippadiyea yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilu'l'la arnoan nathithodangki, ermoan malaivaraikkumu'l'la theasaththai naam akkaalaththil emoariyarudaiya ira'ndu raajaakka'lidaththilumirunthu pidiththoam.
seethoaniyar ermoanaich seeriyoan enki'raarka'l; emoariyaroa athaich seaneer enki'raarka'l.

samanaana naattin ellaap patta'nangka'laiyum, keeleayaath muzhuvathaiyum, salkaayi, ethreayi ennum paasaaniliruntha oakudaiya raajyaththin patta'nangka'lmattumu'l'la paasaan muzhuvathaiyum pidiththoam.

meenthiruntha iraadchatharil paasaanin raajaavaakiya oak enpavanmaaththiram thappiyirunthaan; irumpinaa'r seytha avanudaiya kattil manitharudaiya kai muzhaththinpadiyea, onpathu muzha nee'lamum naalu muzha akalamumaayirunthathu; athu ammoan puththirarudaiya rappaapatta'naththil irukki'rathallavaa?

akkaalaththilea suthantharamaakap pet'rukko'nda theasaththai arnoan nathiyarukeayu'l'la aaroavear thodangki, keeleayaath malainaattil paathiyaiyum, athilirukki'ra patta'nangka'laiyum, roopaniyarukkum kaaththiyarukkum koduththean.

keeleayaaththin mat'rap pangkaiyum, oakin raajyamaayiruntha paasaan muzhuvathaiyum, manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththukkuk koduththathum an'ri, iraadchatha theasamennappatta paasaanukku'l'laana arkoap seemai yaavaiyum koduththean.

manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya yaaveer arkoap seemai muzhuvathaiyum keasooriyar maakaaththiyar enpavarka'ludaiya ellaimattum kattikko'ndu, atha'rkuth than naamaththinpadiyea paasaan avoathyaayeer en'ru pearittaan, athu innaa'lvaraikkum vazhangkivaruki'rathu.
maakeerukkuk keeleayaaththaik koduththean.
mealum keeleayaath thodangki arnoan nathi oaduki'ra pa'l'laththaakkum, kadaiyaantharamumaana ammoan puththirarin ellaiyaakiya yaapoakku aa'rumattum irukki'ra theasaththaiyum,

kinnareath thodangki asthoathpiskaavukkuth thaazhvaayk kizhakkea irukki'ra uppukkadalaana samanaana ve'liyin kadalmattum, yoarthaanin ellaikku'l adangkiya samanaana ve'liyaiyum, roopaniyarukkum kaaththiyarukkum koduththean.

akkaalaththilea naan ungka'lai noakki: ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukku intha theasaththaich suthantharamaakak koduththaar; yuththagnseyyaththakkavarka'laakiya neengka'l ellaarum israveal puththiraraana ungka'l sakoathararukku munnea aayuthapaa'nika'laaka nadanthu poangka'l.

ungka'l manaivika'lum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum ungka'l aadumaaduka'lummaaththiram naan ungka'lukkuk koduththa ungka'l patta'nangka'lil irukkattum; ungka'lukkuth thira'laana aadumaaduka'l u'nden'ru a'rivean.

aanaalum karththar ungka'lai i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninathupoala, ungka'l sakoathararaiyum i'laippaa'rappa'n'ni, yoarthaanukku appu'raththil ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar kodukki'ra theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumattum neengka'l irunthu, pinpu avaravar naan ungka'lukkuk koduththa ungka'l suthantharaththukkuth thirumpuveerka'laaka en'rean.

akkaalaththilea naan yoasuvaavai noakki: ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar antha ira'ndu raajaakka'lukkum seythavaika'laiyellaam un ka'nka'l ka'ndathu; nee poaych searum ellaa raajyangka'lukkum karththar appadiyea seyvaar.
avarka'lukkup payappadeerka'laaka; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thaamea ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaar en'ru sonnean.
akkaalaththilea naan karththarai noakki:

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, neer umathu adiyeanukku umathu makaththuvaththaiyum umathu vallamaiyu'l'la karaththaiyum kaa'npikkath thodangkineer; vaanaththilum poomiyilum ummudaiya kiriyaika'lukkum ummudaiya vallamaika'lukkum oppaakach seyyaththakka theavan yaar?
naan kadanthupoay yoarthaanukku appu'raththilu'l'la antha nalla theasaththaiyum, antha nalla malaiyaiyum, leepanoanaiyum paarkkumpadi uththaravu koduththaru'lum en'ru vea'ndikko'ndean.
karththaroa ungka'l nimiththam enmeal koapangko'ndu, enakkuch sevikodaamal, ennai noakki: poathum, ini inthak kaariyaththaikku'riththu ennoadea peasavea'ndaam.
nee piskaavin kodumudiyil ea'ri, un ka'nka'lai mea'rkilum vadakkilum the'rkilum kizhakkilum ea'reduththu, un ka'nka'linaalea athaip paar; intha yoarthaanai nee kadanthupoavathillai.

nee yoasuvaavukkuk katta'lai koduththu, avanaith thidappaduththip palappaduththu; avan intha janangka'lukku munpaakak kadanthupoay, avanea nee kaa'num theasaththai avarka'lukkup pangkittukkoduppaan en'raar.
pinpu pethpeyoarukku ethiraana pa'l'laththaakkil thangkiyirunthoam.

isravealarea, neengka'l pizhaiththirukkumpadikkum, ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk kodukki'ra theasaththil neengka'l piraveasiththu athaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadikkum, neengka'l kaikko'lvatha'rku naan ungka'lukkup poathikki'ra katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum kea'lungka'l.

naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikkum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin katta'laika'lai neengka'l kaikko'l'lumpadi, naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'ra vasanaththoadea neengka'l on'rum koottavum vea'ndaam, athil on'rum ku'raikkavum vea'ndaam.

paakaalpeayoarin nimiththam karththar seythathai ungka'l ka'nka'l ka'ndirukki'rathu; paakaalpeayoaraip pinpat'rina manitharaiyellaam un theavanaakiya karththar un naduvil iraathapadikku azhiththuppoattaar.
aanaalum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pat'rikko'nda neengka'lellaarum innaa'lvaraikkum uyiroadirukki'reerka'l.

neengka'l suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi piraveasikkum theasaththil neengka'l kaikko'l'lumporuttu, en theavanaakiya karththar enakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum poathiththean.

aakaiyaal avaika'laik kaikko'ndu nadavungka'l; janangka'lin ka'nka'lukkumunpaakavum ithuvea ungka'lukku gnaanamum viveakamumaay irukkum; avarka'l inthak katta'laika'laiyellaam keattu, inthap periya jaathiyea gnaanamum viveakamumu'l'la janangka'l enpaarka'l.
nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai naam thozhuthuko'l'luki'rapoathellaam, avar namakkuch sameepamaayirukki'rathupoala, theavanai ivva'lavu sameepamaayp pet'rirukki'ra vea'rea periya jaathi ethu?
innaa'lil naan ungka'lukku vithikki'ra intha niyaayappiramaa'nam muzhumaikkum oththa ivva'lavu neethiyu'l'la katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum pet'rirukki'ra vea'rea periya jaathiyum ethu?

oareapilea un theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka nee ni'rkumpoathu, karththar ennai noakki: janangka'lai ennidaththil koodivarachseythu, en vaarththaika'lai avarka'l keadkumpadi pa'n'nuvean; avarka'l poomiyil uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam enakkup payanthirukkumpadi avaika'laik kat'rukko'ndu, thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum poathikkakkadavarka'l en'ru solliya naa'lil,

un ka'nka'l ka'nda kaariyangka'lai nee ma'ravaathapadikkum, un jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam avaika'l un iruthayaththai vittu neengkaathapadikkum nee echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, un aaththumaavaich saakkirathaiyaayk kaaththukko'l; avaika'lai un pi'l'laika'lukkum un pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'lukkum a'rivikkakkadavaay.
neengka'l searnthuvanthu, malaiyin adivaaraththil nin'reerka'l; antha malaiyil vaanaththai a'laaviya akkini eriya, iru'lum meakamum anthakaaramum soozhnthathu.

antha akkiniyin naduvilirunthu karththar ungka'loadea peasinaar; vaarththaika'lin saththaththai neengka'l keatteerka'l; anthach saththaththai neengka'l keattatheayan'ri, oru roopaththaiyum kaa'navillai.

neengka'l kaikko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru avar ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta paththuk ka'rpanaika'laakiya thammudaiya udanpadikkaiyai avar ungka'lukku a'riviththu, avaika'lai ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lil ezhuthinaar.

neengka'l suthanthariththukko'l'lappoaki'ra theasaththil neengka'l kaikko'l'lavea'ndiya katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum ungka'lukkup poathikkavea'ndumen'ru akkaalaththilea karththar enakkuk katta'laiyittaar.
karththar oareapilea akkiniyin naduvilirunthu ungka'loadea peasina naa'lil, neengka'l oru roopaththaiyum kaa'navillai.
aakaiyaal neengka'l ungka'laik keduththukko'ndu, aa'n uruvum, pe'n uruvum,
poomiyilirukki'ra yaathoru mirukaththin uruvum, aakaayaththil pa'rakki'ra settaiyu'l'la yaathoru padchiyin uruvum,

poomiyilu'l'la yaathoru oorum piraa'niyin uruvum, poomiyinkeezhth tha'n'neerilu'l'la yaathoru machchaththin uruvumaayirukki'ra ivaika'lil yaathoru uruvukku oppaana vikkirakaththai ungka'lukku u'ndaakkaathapadikkum,

ungka'l ka'nka'lai vaanaththi'rku ea'reduththu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar vaanaththin keezhengkum irukki'ra ellaa janangka'lukkum ea'rpaduththina vaanaththin sarva seanaika'laakiya santhira sooriya nadchaththirangka'lai noakki, avaika'laith thozhuthu seavikka i'nangkaathapadikkum, ungka'l aaththumaakka'laikku'riththu mikavum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

innaa'lil neengka'l irukki'rathupoala, thamakkuch suthantharamaana janamaayirukkumpadi, karththar ungka'laich searththukko'ndu, ungka'lai ekipthu ennum iruppukkaa'lavaayilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.

karththar ungka'l nimiththam enmeal koapangko'ndu, naan yoarthaanaik kadanthupoavathillai en'rum, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukki'ra antha nalla theasaththil naan piraveasippathillai en'rum aa'naiyittaar.
athinaal intha theasaththil naan mara'namadaiyavea'ndum; naan yoarthaanaik kadanthupoavathillai; neengka'loa kadanthupoay, antha nalla theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'lveerka'l.

neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai ma'ranthu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar vea'ndaam en'ru vilakkina evvitha saayalaana vikkirakaththaiyum ungka'lukku u'ndaakkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
un theavanaakiya karththar padchikki'ra akkini, avar erichchalu'l'la theavan.

neengka'l pi'l'laika'lum pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'lum pet'ru, theasaththil vekunaa'l irunthapinpu, neengka'l ungka'laik keduththu, yaathoru vikkirakaththaiyaavathu yaathoru saayalaana suroopaththaiyaavathu pa'n'ni, un theavanaakiya karththarukkuk koapam u'ndaakka avar paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaal,

neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthu suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil iraamal, seekkiramaay mut'rilum azhinthupoaveerka'l en'ru, innaa'lil ungka'lukku viroathamaay vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum saadchi vaikki'rean; neengka'l athilea nedunaa'l iraamal nirmoolamaakkappaduveerka'l.
karththar ungka'laip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'ra adippaar; karththar ungka'laik ko'ndupoay vidappoaki'ra jaathika'lidaththilea kogncha janangka'laay meenthiruppeerka'l.
angkea kaa'naamalum kea'laamalum saappidaamalum mukaraamalum irukki'ra maramum kallumaana, manushar kaivealaiyaakiya theavarka'laich seavippeerka'l.
appozhuthu angkeayirunthu un theavanaakiya karththaraith theaduvaay; un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum avaraith theadumpoathu, avaraik ka'ndadaivaay.
nee viyaakulappada ivaika'lellaam unnaith thodarnthu pidikkumpoathu, kadaisi naadka'lil un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil thirumpi avar saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadivaayaanaal,

un theavanaakiya karththar irakkamu'l'la theavanaayirukki'rapadiyaal, avar unnaik kaividavumaattaar, unnai azhikkavumaattaar, un pithaakka'lukkuth thaam aa'naiyittuk koduththa udanpadikkaiyai ma'rakkavumaattaar.

theavan manushanaip poomiyilea sirushdiththa naa'lmuthal, unakku mun iruntha poorvanaadka'lil, vaanaththin orumunai thodangki athin ma'rumunaimattumu'l'la evvidaththilaakilum ippadippatta periya kaariyam nadanthathu'ndoa, ippadippatta kaariyam kea'lvippattathu'ndoa;
akkiniyin naduvilirunthu peasuki'ra theavanudaiya saththaththai nee keattathupoala, yaathoru janamaavathu keattathum uyiroadirunthathum u'ndoa,

allathu ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ekipthilea ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ungka'lukkuch seythapadiyellaam theavan anniya jaathika'lin naduvilirunthu oru janaththaich soathanaika'linaalum, adaiyaa'langka'linaalum, a'rputhangka'linaalum, yuththaththinaalum, vallamaiyu'l'la karaththinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum, makaa payangkaramaana seyalka'linaalum, thamakken'ru therinthuko'l'la vakaipa'n'ninathu'ndoa en'ru nee visaariththuppaar.
karththarea theavan, avaraiyallaamal vea'roruvarum illai enpathai nee a'riyumpadikku, ithu unakkuk kaattappattathu.

unnai upatheasikkumpadikku, avar vaanaththilirunthu thamathu saththaththai unakkuk keadkappa'n'ni, poomiyilea thamathu periya akkiniyai unakkuk kaa'npiththaar; akkiniyin naduvilirunthu u'ndaana avarudaiya vaarththaika'laik keattaay.
avar un pithaakka'lil anpukoornthapadiyaal, avarka'ludaiya pinsanthathiyaith therinthuko'ndu,

unnilum palaththa periya jaathika'lai unakku munnin'ru thuraththavum, unnai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, avarka'l theasaththai unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkavum, unnaith thamathu mukaththukkumun thamathu mikuntha vallamaiyinaal ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.
aakaiyaal, uyara vaanaththilum thaazha poomiyilum karththarea theavan, avaraith thavira oruvarum illai enpathai nee innaa'lil a'rinthu, un manathilea sinthiththu,

neeyum unakkup pinvarum un pi'l'laika'lum nan'raayirukkumpadikkum, un theavanaakiya karththar unakku en'raikkum kodukki'ra theasaththilea nee neediththa naa'laayirukkumpadikkum, naan in'ru unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum kaikko'l'lakkadavaay en'raan.
mu'rpakaiyin'rik kaippisakaay pi'ranaik kon'ravan adaikkalappatta'nangka'lil oru patta'naththil thappiyoadippoayp pizhaiththirukkumpadiyaaka,
roopaniyaraich searntha samapoomiyaakiya vanaantharaththilu'l'la peasearum, kaaththiyaraich searntha keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththum, manaaseayaraich searntha paasaanilu'l'la koalaanumaakiya,
moon'ru patta'nangka'lai moasea yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil sooriyoathaya thisaiyilea ea'rpaduththinaan.
ithuvea moasea israveal puththirarukku vithiththa piramaa'nam.

israveal puththirar ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapinpu, yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil espoanil kudiyiruntha emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanudaiya theasaththilu'l'la pethpeayoarukku ethiraana pa'l'laththaakkilea, avarka'lukku moasea sonna saadchika'lum katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lum ivaika'lea.
moaseayum israveal puththirarum ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapinpu antha raajaavai mu'riya adiththu,
yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil sooriyoathaya thisaiyil arnoan aat'rangkaraiyilu'l'la aaroavear thodangki ermoan ennum seeyoan malaivaraikkumu'l'la theasamum,
yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil sooriyoathaya thisaiyil asthoath piskaavukkum thaazhntha samanaana ve'liyaichsearntha kadalmattumu'l'la samanaana ve'liyanaiththumaakiya,
emoariyarudaiya ira'ndu raajaakka'lin theasangka'laana seekoanudaiya theasaththaiyum, paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakin theasaththaiyum kattikko'ndaarka'l.

moasea isravealar ellaaraiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'lai noakki: isravealarea, naan in'ru ungka'l kaathuka'l keadkach sollum katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum kea'lungka'l; neengka'l avaika'linpadiyea seyyumpadikku avaika'laik kat'ruk kaikko'l'lakkadaveerka'l.
nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar oareapilea nammoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ninaar.
antha udanpadikkaiyaik karththar nammudaiya pithaakka'ludan pa'n'naamal, innaa'lil ingkea uyiroadirukki'ra nammellaaroadum pa'n'ninaar.
karththar malaiyilea akkiniyin naduvilirunthu mukamukamaay ungka'loadea peasinaar.

karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai ungka'lukku a'rivikkumpadi, akkaalaththilea naan karththarukkum ungka'lukkum naduvaaka nin'rean; neengka'l akkinikkup payanthu malaiyil ea'raamal iruntheerka'l; appozhuthu avar sonnathu ennaven'raal:
unnai adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaakiya karththar naanea.
ennaiyan'ri unakku vea'rea theavarka'l u'ndaayirukkavea'ndaam.
mealea vaanaththilum, keezhea poomiyilum, poomiyinkeezhth tha'n'neerilum u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lukku oppaana oru suroopaththaiyaakilum yaathoru vikkirakaththaiyaakilum nee unakku u'ndaakkavea'ndaam.

nee avaika'lai namaskarikkavum seavikkavum vea'ndaam; un theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'ra naan erichchalu'l'la theavanaayirunthu, ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'laik ku'riththup pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramaththaip pi'l'laika'lidaththil moon'raam naankaam thalaimu'raimattum visaarikki'ravaraayirukki'rean.
ennidaththil anpukoornthu, en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukkoa aayiram thalaimu'raimattum irakkagnseyki'ravaraayirukki'rean.
un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththai vee'nilea vazhangkaathiruppaayaaka; karththar thammudaiya naamaththai vee'nilea vazhangkuki'ravanaith tha'ndiyaamal vidaar.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, oayvunaa'laip parisuththamaay aasarippaayaaka.
aa'runaa'lum nee vealaiseythu, un kiriyaika'laiyellaam nadappippaayaaka.

eazhaam naa'loa un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya oayvunaa'l; athilea neeyaanaalum, un kumaaranaanaalum, un kumaaraththiyaanaalum, un vealaikkaaranaanaalum, un vealaikkaariyaanaalum, un eruthaanaalum, un kazhuthaiyaanaalum, unakku irukki'ra mat'rentha mirukajeevanaanaalum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra anniyanaanaalum yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam; nee i'laippaa'ruvathupoala un vealaikkaaranum un vealaikkaariyum i'laippaa'ravea'ndum;

nee ekipthutheasaththil adimaiyaayirunthaay en'rum, un theavanaakiya karththar unnai avvidaththilirunthu vallamaiyu'l'la karaththinaalum oangkiya puyaththinaalum pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar en'rum ninaippaayaaka; aakaiyaal oayvunaa'lai aasarikka un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyittaar.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukki'ra theasaththilea un naadka'l neediththiruppatha'rkum, nee nan'raayiruppatha'rkum, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka.
kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
vipasaaram seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka.
pi'ranukku viroathamaakap poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka.

pi'ranudaiya manaiviyai ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka; pi'ranudaiya veettaiyum, avanudaiya nilaththaiyum, avanudaiya vealaikkaaranaiyum, avanudaiya vealaikkaariyaiyum, avanudaiya eruthaiyum, avanudaiya kazhuthaiyaiyum, pinnum pi'ranukku'l'la yaathon'raiyum ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka en'raar.

intha vaarththaika'laik karththar malaiyilea akkiniyilum meakaththilum kaariru'lilum irunthu ungka'l sapaiyaar ellaaroadum makaa saththaththudanea sonnaar; avaika'loadu on'rum koottaamal, avaika'lai ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lil ezhuthi, ennidaththil koduththaar.
malai akkiniyaay erikaiyil iru'lin naduvilirunthu u'ndaana saththaththai neengka'l keattapoathu, koaththirath thalaivarum moopparumaakiya neengka'l ellaarum ennidaththil vanthu:

ithoa, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakkuth thammudaiya makimaiyaiyum thammudaiya makaththuvaththaiyum kaa'npiththaar; akkiniyin naduvilirunthu u'ndaana avarudaiya saththaththaiyum keattoam; theavan manushanoadea peasiyum, avan uyiroadirukki'rathai innaa'lilea ka'ndoam.
ippozhuthu naangka'l saavaanean? inthap periya akkini engka'laip padchikkumea; naangka'l innum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththaik keadpoamaakil saavoam.
naangka'l keattathupoala, akkiniyin naduvilirunthu peasuki'ra jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya saththaththai maamsamaanavarka'lil yaaraavathu keattu uyiroadirunthathu u'ndoa?

neerea sameepiththuppoay, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar solvathaiyellaam keattu, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar solvathaiyellaam neerea engka'lukkuch sollavea'ndum; naangka'l keattu, athinpadiyea seyvoam en'reerka'l.

neengka'l ennoadea peasukaiyil, karththar ungka'l vaarththaika'laik keattu, karththar ennai noakki: intha janangka'l unnoadea sonna vaarththaika'laik keattean; avarka'l sonnathu ellaam nan'raaych sonnaarka'l.

avarka'lum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum en'ren'raikkum nan'raayirukkumpadi, avarka'l ennaa'lum enakkup payanthu, en ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam kaikko'lvatha'rkeat'ra iruthayam avarka'lukku irunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
nee poay: ungka'l koodaarangka'lukkuth thirumpippoangka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sol.

neeyoa ingkea ennidaththil nil; naan avarka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum theasaththil avarka'l seyyumpadi nee avarka'lukkup poathikkavea'ndiya sakala ka'rpanaika'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum unakkuch solluvean en'raar.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea seyyach saavathaanamaayirungka'l; valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaathiruppeerka'laaka.
neengka'l suthantharikkum theasaththilea pizhaiththuch sukiththu neediththirukkumpadi, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukku vithiththa vazhika'lellaavat'rilum nadakkakkadaveerka'l.

nee un theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu, uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam, neeyum un kumaaranum un kumaaraththiyum, naan unakku vithikki'ra avarudaiya ellaak ka'rpanaika'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'luki'rathinaalea un vaazhnaadka'l neediththirukkumpadi,

neengka'l suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththilea kaikko'lvatha'rkaaka, ungka'lukkup poathikkavea'ndum en'ru ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ka'rpiththa ka'rpanaika'lum katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lum ivaika'lea.

isravealea, nee nan'raayiruppatha'rkum, un pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadi, paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththil nee mikavum viruththiyadaivatha'rkum, avaika'lukkuch sevikoduththu, avaika'linpadi seyyach saavathaanamaayiru.
isravealea, kea'l: nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar oruvarea karththar.
nee un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil un muzhu iruthayaththoadum, un muzhu aaththumaavoadum, un muzhup palaththoadum anpukooruvaayaaka.
in'ru naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'ra intha vaarththaika'l un iruthayaththil irukkakkadavathu.

nee avaika'lai un pi'l'laika'lukkuk karuththaayp poathiththu, nee un veettil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, vazhiyil nadakki'rapoathum, paduththukko'l'luki'rapoathum, ezhunthirukki'rapoathum avaika'laikku'riththup peasi,
avaika'lai un kaiyinmeal adaiyaa'lamaakak kattikko'lvaayaaka; avaika'l un ka'nka'lukku naduvea gnaapakakku'riyaay irukkakkadavathu.
avaika'lai un veettu nilaika'lilum, un vaasalka'lilum ezhuthuvaayaaka.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk koduppean en'ru aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'laakiya un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa theasaththil unnaip piraveasikkappa'n'numpoathum, nee kattaatha vasathiyaana periya patta'nangka'laiyum,

nee nirappaatha sakala nalla vasthukka'laalum nirampiya veeduka'laiyum, nee vettaamal vettappattirukki'ra thuravuka'laiyum, nee nadaatha thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum olivaththoappuka'laiyum, avar unakkuk koduppathinaal, nee saappittuth thirpthiyaakumpoathum,
nee adimaippattiruntha veedaakiya ekipthutheasaththilirunthu unnaip pu'rappadappa'n'nina karththarai ma'ravaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru.
un theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu, avarukkea aaraathanaiseythu, avarudaiya naamaththaikko'ndea aa'naiyiduvaayaaka.

un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya koapam unmeal moo'ndu, unnaip poomiyil vaikkaamal azhiththuppoadaathapadikku, ungka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra janangka'lin theavarka'laakiya anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'raathiruppeerka'laaka.
un naduvilirukki'ra un theavanaakiya karththar erichchalu'l'la theavanaayirukki'raarea.
neengka'l maasaavilea seythathupoala, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pareedchai paaraathiruppeerka'laaka.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum avarudaiya saadchika'laiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum karuththaayk kaikko'lveerka'laaka.
nee nan'raayirukki'ratha'rkum, karththar un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittukkoduththa nalla theasaththil nee piraveasiththu, athaich suthantharippatha'rkum,
karththar thaam sonnapadi, un saththurukka'laiyellaam un mukaththi'rku munpaakath thuraththividuvatha'rkum, nee karththarudaiya paarvaikkuch semmaiyum nanmaiyumaay irukki'rathaich seyvaayaaka.
naa'laikku un puththiran: nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta inthach saadchika'lum katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lum enna en'ru unnidaththil keattaal;
nee un puththiranai noakki: naangka'l ekipthilea paarvoanukku adimaika'laayirunthoam; karththar palaththa kaiyinaalea engka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.
karththar engka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka, ekipthinmealum paarvoanmealum avan kudumpam anaiththinmealum kodithaana periya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum vi'langkappa'n'ni,
thaam nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa theasaththukku engka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, athai namakkuk kodukkumpadi engka'lai avvidaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar.

innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, nammai avar uyiroadea kaappatha'rkum, ennaa'lum nan'raayirukki'ratha'rkum, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu intha ellaak katta'laika'linpadiyeayum seyyak karththar namakkuk katta'laiyittaar.

nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar namakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea naam avar samukaththil intha ellaak katta'laika'linpadiyum seyyach saavathaanamaayirunthaal, namakku neethiyaayirukkum en'ru solvaayaaka.

nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil un theavanaakiya karththar unnaip piraveasikkappa'n'ni, unnaippaarkkilum janam peruththa jaathika'laakiya eaththiyar, kirkaasiyar, emoariyar, kaanaaniyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyar ennum eazhu palaththa jaathika'lai unakku munpaakath thuraththi,

un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai unnidaththil oppukkodukkumpoathu, avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu, avarka'laich sangkaaram pa'n'nakkadavaay; avarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'navum avarka'lukku irangkavum vea'ndaam.
avarka'loadea sampantham kalavaayaaka; un kumaaraththika'lai avarka'l kumaararukkuk kodaamalum, avarka'l kumaaraththika'lai un kumaararukkuk ko'l'laamalum iruppaayaaka.
ennaip pinpat'raamal, anniya theavarka'laich seavikkumpadi avarka'l un kumaararai vilakappa'n'nuvaarka'l; appozhuthu karththarudaiya koapam ungka'lmeal moo'ndu, ungka'laich seekkiraththil azhikkum.

neengka'l avarka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: avarka'l palipeedangka'lai idiththu, avarka'l silaika'laith thakarththu, avarka'l thoappuka'lai vetti, avarka'l vikkirakangka'lai akkiniyilea eriththuppoadavea'ndum.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththa janam, poochchakkaraththilu'l'la ellaa janangka'lilum un theavanaakiya karththar unnaith thamakkuch sonthamaayirukkumpadi therinthuko'ndaar.
sakala janangka'lilum neengka'l thiradchiyaana janamen'ru karththar ungka'lpearil anpuvaiththu ungka'laith therinthuko'l'lavillai; neengka'l sakala janangka'lilum kognchamaayiruntheerka'l.

karththar ungka'lil anpukoornthathinaalum, ungka'l pithaakka'lukku itta aa'naiyaik kaakkavea'ndum enpathinaalum; karththar palaththa kaiyinaal ungka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthinin'rum athin raajaavaana paarvoanin kaiyinin'rum ungka'lai meettukko'ndaar.

aakaiyaal un theavanaakiya karththarea theavan en'rum, thammil anpukoornthu, thamathu ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku avar aayiram thalaimu'raimattum udanpadikkaiyaiyum thayavaiyum kaakki'ra u'nmaiyu'l'la theavan en'rum,

thammaip pakaikki'ravarka'lukkup piraththiyadchamaayp pathila'liththu avarka'lai azhippaar en'rum, thammaip pakaikki'ravanukku avar thaamathiyaamal piraththiyadchamaayp pathila'lippaar en'rum nee a'riyakkadavaay.
aakaiyaal nee seyyumpadi naan in'ru unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'ra ka'rpanaika'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'lvaayaaka.

intha niyaayangka'lai neengka'l keattu, kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyveerka'laanaal, appozhuthu un theavanaakiya karththar un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum unakkaakak kaaththu,

unmeal anpuvaiththu, unnai aaseervathiththu, unakkuk koduppean en'ru un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa theasaththil unnaip perukappa'n'ni, un karppakkaniyaiyum, un nilaththin kanika'laakiya un thaaniyaththaiyum, un thiraadcharasaththaiyum, un e'n'neyaiyum, un maaduka'lin palanaiyum, un aattumanthaika'laiyum aaseervathippaar.
sakala janangka'laippaarkkilum nee aaseervathikkappattiruppaay; ungka'lukku'l'lum ungka'l mirukajeevanka'lukku'l'lum aa'nilaakilum pe'n'nilaakilum maladiruppathillai.

karththar sakala noayka'laiyum unnaivittu vilakkuvaar; unakkuth therinthirukki'ra ekipthiyarin kodiya roakangka'lil on'rum unmeal varappa'n'naamal, unnaip pakaikki'ra yaavarmealum avaika'lai varappa'n'nuvaar.

un theavanaakiya karththar unnidaththil oppukkodukkum sakala janangka'laiyum nirmoolamaakkakkadavaay; un ka'n avarka'lukku irangkaathiruppathaaka; avarka'l theavarka'lai nee seaviyaamal iruppaayaaka; athu unakkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkum.
antha jaathika'l ennilum janam peruththavaika'l, naan avarka'laith thuraththividuvathu eppadi en'ru un iruthayaththil sollikko'ndaayaanaal,
un theavanaakiya karththar paarvoanukkum ekipthiyar yaavarukkum seythathaiyum,

un ka'nka'l ka'nda periya soathanaika'laiyum, adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum, un theavanaakiya karththar unnaip pu'rappadappa'n'nik kaa'npiththa palaththa kaiyaiyum oangkiya puyaththaiyum nan'raay ninaiththu, avarka'lukkup payappadaathiru; nee paarththup payappaduki'ra ellaa janangka'lukkum un theavanaakiya karththar appadiyea seyvaar.
meethiyaayirunthu unakkuth thappi o'liththukko'l'luki'ravarka'lum azhinthupoakumattum un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lukku'l'lea ku'lavika'lai anuppuvaar.
avarka'laip paarththup payappadavea'ndaam; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukku'l'lea irukki'raar, avar vallamaiyum payangkaramumaana theavan.

antha jaathika'lai un theavanaakiya karththar kogncham kognchamaay unnaivittuth thuraththividuvaar; nee avarka'lai orumikka nirmoolamaakkavea'ndaam; nirmoolamaakkinaal kaattumirukangka'l unnidaththil perukippoakum.
un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai unnidaththil oppukkoduththu, avarka'l azhiyumattum avarka'lai mikavum kalangkadippaar.

avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'lai un kaiyil oppukkoduppaar; avarka'l pear vaanaththinkeezh iraathapadikku avarka'laich sangkarikkakkadavaay; nee avarka'laich sangkariththuth theerumattum oruvarum unakku ethirththu ni'rkamaattaarka'l.

avarka'l theavarka'lin vikkirakangka'lai akkiniyinaal sutterikkakkadavaay; nee avaika'laal sikkikko'l'laathapadikku, avaika'lil irukki'ra ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum ichchiyaamalum, athai eduththukko'l'laamalum iruppaayaaka; avaika'l un theavanaakiya karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaika'l.
avaika'laippoala nee saapaththukku'l'laakaathapadi aruvaruppaanathai un veettilea ko'ndupoakaayaaka; athaich chee en'ru ve'ruththu mut'rilum aruvarukkakkadavaay, athu saapaththi'rku'l'laanathu.

neengka'l pizhaiththup peruki, karththar ungka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa theasaththilea piraveasiththu, athaich suthantharikkumpadi naan in'ru ungka'lukku vithikki'ra ellaak katta'laika'linpadiyum seyyach saavathaanamaayiruppeerka'laaka.

un theavanaakiya karththar unnaich si'rumaippaduththumpadikkum, thammudaiya katta'laika'lai nee kaikko'lvaayoa kaikko'l'lamaattaayoa en'ru avar unnaich soathiththu, un iruthayaththilu'l'lathai nee a'riyumpadikkum, unnai intha naa'rpathu varushama'lavum vanaantharaththilea nadaththivantha ellaa vazhiyaiyum ninaippaayaaka.

avar unnaich si'rumaippaduththi, unnaip pasiyinaal varuththi, manushan appaththinaal maaththiram alla, karththarudaiya vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra ovvoru vaarththaiyinaalum pizhaippaan enpathai unakku u'narththumpadikku, neeyum un pithaakka'lum a'riyaathiruntha mannaavinaal unnaip poashiththaar.
intha naa'rpathu varushamum unmealiruntha vasthiram pazhaiyathaayp poakavum illai, un kaal veengkavum illai.
oruvan than puththiranaich sidchikki'rathupoala un theavanaakiya karththar unnaich sidchikki'raar en'ru nee un iruthayaththil a'rinthuko'lvaayaaka.
aakaiyaal, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya vazhika'lil nadanthu, avarukkup payappadumpadikku, avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'lakkadavaay.

un theavanaakiya karththar unnai nalla theasaththilea piraveasikkappa'n'nuki'raar; athu pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum malaika'lilumirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra aa'ruka'lum oot'ruka'lum earika'lumu'l'la theasam;
athu koathumaiyum vaa'rkoathumaiyum thiraadchachsedika'lum aththimarangka'lum maatha'lagnsedika'lumu'l'la theasam; athu olivamarangka'lum, e'n'neyum theanumu'l'la theasam;
athu thaazhchchiyillaamal appam pusikkaththakkathum on'rum unakkuk ku'raivupadaathathumaana theasam; athu kalluka'l irumpaayirukki'rathum, sempu vetti edukkaththakka malaika'lu'l'lathumaana theasam.
aakaiyaal, nee pusiththuth thirpthiyadainthirukkaiyil, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk koduththa antha nalla theasaththukkaaka avarai sthoaththirikkakkadavaay.

un theavanaakiya karththarai ma'ravaathapadikkum, naan in'ru unakku vithikki'ra avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'laama'r poakaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayiru.
nee pusiththuth thirpthiyaaki, nalla veeduka'laik katti, avaika'lil kudiyirukkumpoathum,
un aadumaaduka'l thiradchiyaaki, unakku ve'l'liyum ponnum peruki, unakku u'ndaanavaiyellaam varththikkumpoathum,
un iruthayam meattimaiyadaiyaamalum, unnai adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninavarum,

unnudaiya pinnaadka'lil unakku nanmai seyyumporuttu, unnaich si'rumaippaduththi, unnaich soathiththu, ko'l'livaaych sarppangka'lum thea'lka'lum, tha'n'neerillaatha va'radchiyumu'l'la payangkaramaana periya vanaantharavazhiyaay unnai azhaiththuvanthavarum, unakkaakap paa'raiyaana kanmalaiyilirunthu tha'n'neer pu'rappadappa'n'ninavarum,
un pithaakka'l a'riyaatha mannaavinaal vanaantharaththilea unnaip poashiththuvanthavarumaana un theavanaakiya karththarai nee ma'ravaamalum,
en saamaarththiyamum en kaippelanum intha aisuvariyaththai enakkuch sampaathiththathu en'ru nee un iruthayaththil sollikko'l'laamalum irukka echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,

un theavanaakiya karththarai ninaippaayaaka; avarea un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittukkoduththa thammudaiya udanpadikkaiyai u'ruthippaduththumpadi, innaa'lil unakku u'ndaayirukki'rathupoala, aisuvariyaththaich sampaathikki'ratha'rkaana pelanai unakkuk kodukki'ravar.

un theavanaakiya karththarai nee ma'ranthu, vea'rea theavarka'laip pinpat'ri avarka'laich seaviththu, avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'lvaayaanaal, nichchayamaay azhinthupoaveerka'l en'ru in'ru ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaay a'rivikki'rean.
un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththi'rku neengka'l keezhppadiyaama'rpoavathinaal, karththar ungka'lukku munpaaka azhiththa jaathika'laippoala neengka'lum azhiveerka'l.

isravealea, kea'l: nee ippozhuthu yoarthaanaik kadanthu, unnilum janam peruththathum palaththathumaana jaathika'laith thuraththi, vaanaththaiya'laaviya mathil soozhntha periya patta'nangka'laip pidiththu,

eanaakkin puththiraraakiya periyavarka'lum nediyavarka'lumaana janangka'laith thuraththividappoaki'raay; ivarka'l seythiyai nee a'rinthu, eanaak puththirarukku munpaaka ni'rpavan yaar en'ru sollappaduvathai nee keattirukki'raay.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakku munpaakak kadanthupoaki'ravar enpathai in'ru a'riyakkadavaay; avar padchikki'ra akkiniyaippoala avarka'lai azhippaar; avarka'lai unakku munpaaka vizhappa'n'nuvaar; ivvithamaayk karththar unakkuch sonnapadiyea, nee avarka'laich seekkiramaayth thuraththi, avarka'lai azhippaay.

un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai unakku munpaakath thuraththukaiyil, nee un iruthayaththilea: en neethiyinimiththam intha theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi karththar ennai azhaiththuvanthaar en'ru sollaayaaka; antha jaathika'ludaiya aakaamiyaththinimiththamea karththar avarka'lai unakku munpaakath thuraththividuki'raar.

un neethiyinimiththamum un iruthayaththinudaiya uththamaththinimiththamum nee avarka'l theasaththaich suthantharikkumpadi piraveasippathillai; antha jaathika'ludaiya aakaamiyaththinimiththamaakavum, aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu ennum un pithaakka'lukkuk karththar aa'naiyittuch sonna vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rumpadiyaakavum, un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai unakku munpaakath thuraththividuki'raar.
aakaiyaal, un neethiyinimiththam un theavanaakiya karththar unakku antha nalla theasaththaich suthantharikkak kodaar enpathai a'riyakkadavaay; nee va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'la janam.

nee vanaantharaththil un theavanaakiya karththarukkuk kadungkoapam u'ndaakkinathai ninai, athai ma'ravaayaaka; neengka'l ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'lmuthal, ivvidaththil vanthu searumattum, karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'nineerka'l.
oareapilum neengka'l karththarukkuk kadungkoapam u'ndaakkinathinaal, karththar ungka'lai azhikkaththakkathaana ukkirangko'ndaar.

karththar ungka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaip palakaika'laakiya ka'rpalakaika'laip pet'rukko'l'lumpadi naan malaiyil ea'rinapoathu, naa'rpathunaa'l iravumpakalum malaiyil thangki appam pusiyaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum irunthean.

appozhuthu theavanudaiya viralinaal ezhuthiyiruntha ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'laik karththar ennidaththil oppukkoduththaar; sapai koodiyiruntha naa'lil karththar malaiyilea akkiniyin naduvilirunthu ungka'ludanea peasina vaarththaika'linpadiyea avaika'lil ezhuthiyirunthathu.
iravum pakalum naa'rpathunaa'l mudinthu, karththar enakku antha udanpadikkaiyin ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'laik kodukki'rapoathu,

karththar ennai noakki: nee ezhunthu, seekkiramaay ivvidam vittu, i'rangkippoa; nee ekipthilirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvantha un janangka'l thangka'laik keduththukko'ndaarka'l; naan avarka'lukku vithiththa vazhiyai avarka'l seekkiramaaka vittu vilaki, vaarppikkappatta vikkirakaththaith thangka'lukkaaka u'ndaakkinaarka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: intha janangka'laip paarththean; athu va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'la janam.

aakaiyaal, naan avarka'lai azhiththu, avarka'l pearai vaanaththinkeezh at'ruppoakappa'n'numpadi, nee ennai vittuvidu; avarka'laippaarkkilum unnaip palaththathum janam peruththathumaana jaathiyaakkuvean en'raar.
appozhuthu naan thirumpi malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinean, malaiyaanathu akkini pat'ri erinthuko'ndirunthathu; udanpadikkaiyin ira'ndu palakaika'lum en ira'ndu kaika'lil irunthathu.

naan paarththapoathu, neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythu, vaarppikkappatta kan'rukkuttiyai ungka'lukku u'ndaakki, karththar ungka'lukku vithiththa vazhiyaich seekkiramaay vittu vilakinathaik ka'ndean.
appozhuthu naan en ira'ndu kaika'lilum iruntha antha ira'ndu palakaika'laiyum oangki e'rinthu, avaika'lai ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka udaiththuppoattean.

karththaraik koapappaduththuvatha'rku neengka'l avarudaiya samukaththil pollaappuch seythu nadappiththa ungka'ludaiya sakala paavangka'l nimiththamum, naan karththarukku munpaaka munpoala iravumpakalum naa'rpathunaa'l vizhunthukidanthean; naan appam pusikkavumillai, tha'n'neer kudikkavumillai.
karththar ungka'lai azhikkumpadi ungka'lmeal ko'ndiruntha koapaththi'rkum ukkiraththi'rkum payanthirunthean; karththar antha mu'raiyum en man'raattaik keattaar.
aaroanmealum karththar mikavum koapangko'ndu, avanai azhikkavea'ndum en'rirunthaar; appozhuthu aaroanukkaakavum vi'n'nappampa'n'ninean.

ungka'l paavakkiriyaiyaakiya anthak kan'rukkuttiyai naan eduththu akkiniyil eriththu, athai no'rukki, thoo'laayppoakumattum araiththu, anthath thoo'lai malaiyilirunthu oaduki'ra aat'rilea poattuvittean.
thapearaavilum, maasaavilum, kiproath aththaavaavilum karththarukkuk kadungkoapam u'ndaakkineerka'l.

neengka'l poay, naan ungka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lungka'l en'ru karththar kaatheasparneayaavilirunthu ungka'lai anuppukaiyilum, neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarai visuvaasiyaamalum, avarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaamalum, avarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'nineerka'l.
naan ungka'lai a'rintha naa'lmutha'rko'ndu, neengka'l karththarukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'nuki'ravarka'laayiruntheerka'l.

karththar ungka'lai azhippean en'ru sonnapadiyinaal, naan munpoal karththarin samukaththil iravum pakalum naa'rpathunaa'l vizhunthukidanthean; appozhuthu naan karththarai noakkip pa'n'nina vi'n'nappamaavathu:

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer ummudaiya makaththuvaththinaalea meettu, palaththa kaiyinaal ekipthilirunthu ko'nduvantha umathu janaththaiyum, umathu suthantharaththaiyum azhikkaathiruppeeraaka.

karththar avarka'lukku vaakkuththaththam pa'n'niyiruntha theasaththil avarka'laip piraveasikkappa'n'nakkoodaama'r poanapadiyinaalum, avarka'lai ve'ruththapadiyinaalum, avarka'lai vanaantharaththil kon'rupoadumpadikkea ko'nduvanthaar en'ru naangka'l vittup pu'rappadumpadi neer seytha theasaththin kudika'l sollaathapadikku,
theavareer intha janangka'lin murattaattaththaiyum, ivarka'l aakaamiyaththaiyum, ivarka'l paavaththaiyum paaraamal, umathu thaasaraakiya aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'lai ninaiththaru'lum.
neer umathu makaa palaththinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum pu'rappadappa'n'nina ivarka'l umathu janamum umathu suthantharamumaayirukki'raarka'lea en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninean.
akkaalaththilea karththar ennai noakki: nee munthinavaika'lukkoththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lai vettikko'ndu, malaiyinmeal ea'ri, ennidaththil vaa; oru marappettiyaiyum seyvaayaaka.
nee udaiththuppoatta munthina palakaika'lil iruntha vaarththaika'lai naan anthap palakaika'lil ezhuthuvean; nee avaika'laip pettiyilea vaippaayaaka en'raar.
appadiyea naan seeththim maraththinaal oru pettiyaich seythu, munthinavaika'lukkoththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lai vetti, avaika'lai en kaiyilea eduththukko'ndu malaiyil ea'rinean.

munnea sapaikoodivantha naa'lil karththar malaiyil akkini naduvilirunthu ungka'lukku vi'lampina paththuk ka'rpanaika'laiyum avar mun ezhuthiyirunthapirakaaram anthap palakaika'lil ezhuthi, avaika'lai ennidaththil thanthaar.
appozhuthu naan thirumpi malaiyilirunthu i'rangki, anthap palakaika'lai naan seytha pettiyilea vaiththean; karththar enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea avaika'l athilea vaiththirukki'rathu.

pinpu israveal puththirar peneyaakkaanukkaduththa pearoaththileayirunthu moaseraavukkup pirayaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l; angkea aaroan mariththu adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaar aasaariyanaanaan.
angkeayirunthu kuthkoathaavukkum, kuthkoathaavilirunthu aa'ruka'lu'l'la naadaakiya yoathpaaththukkum pirayaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l.

akkaalaththilea karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumappatha'rkum, innaa'lvaraikkum nadanthuvaruki'rathupoala, karththarudaiya sannithiyilea nin'ru avarukku aaraathanai seyvatha'rkum, avar naamaththaikko'ndu aaseervathippatha'rkum, karththar leaviyin koaththiraththaip piriththeduththaar.
aakaiyaal leavikku avan sakoathararoadea pangkum suthantharamum illai; un theavanaakiya karththar avanukkuch sonnapadi, karththarea avanukkuch suthantharam.
naan munthina pirakaaramaakavea naa'rpathunaa'l iravum pakalum malaiyil irunthean; karththar antha mu'raiyum en man'raattaik keattu, unnai azhikkaamal vittaar.

karththar ennai noakki: naan koduppean en'ru avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththil avarka'l poay athaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi, nee ezhunthu, janaththi'rku munpaakap pirayaa'nappattup poa en'raar.

ippozhuthum isravealea, nee un theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu, avar vazhika'lilellaam nadanthu, avaridaththil anpukoornthu, un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum un theavanaakiya karththaraich seaviththu,

naan in'ru unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra karththarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum unakku nanmaiyu'ndaakumpadi kaikko'l'lavea'ndum enpathaiyea allaamal, vea'rea ethai un theavanaakiya karththar unnidaththil keadki'raar.
ithoa, vaanangka'lum vaanaathivaanangka'lum, poomiyum athilu'l'la yaavum, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiyavaika'l.

aanaalum karththar un pithaakka'lmeal anpukoorumporuttu avarka'lidaththil piriyam vaiththu, avarka'lukkuppin avarka'ludaiya santhathiyaakiya ungka'lai, innaa'lil irukki'rapadiyea, sakala jaathika'lukku'l'lum thamakken'ru therinthuko'ndaar.
aakaiyaal neengka'l ini ungka'l pidariyaik kadinappaduththaamal, ungka'l iruthayaththin nuniththoalai viruththaseathanampa'n'nungka'l.

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar theavaathi theavanum, karththaathi karththarum, makaththuvamum vallamaiyum payangkaramumaana theavanumaayirukki'raar; avar padchapaatham pa'n'nuki'ravarum alla, parithaanam vaangkuki'ravarum alla.
avar thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum vithavaikkum niyaayagnseyki'ravarum, anniyanmeal anpuvaiththu avanukku annavasthiram kodukki'ravarumaay irukki'raar.
neengka'lum ekipthutheasaththil anniyaraayirunthapadiyaal, anniyaraich sineakippeerka'laaka.
un theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu, avaraich seaviththu, avaraip pat'rikko'ndirunthu, avarudaiya naamaththaikko'ndu aa'naiyiduvaayaaka.
avarea un pukazhchchi; un ka'n ka'nda inthap periya payangkaramaana kaariyangka'lai unnidaththil seytha un theavan avarea.
un pithaakka'l ezhupathupearaay ekipthukkup poanaarka'l; ippozhuthoa un theavanaakiya karththar unnaith thiradchiyilea vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'laippoalaakkinaar.

nee un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil anpukoornthu, avarudaiya piramaa'nangka'laiyum, avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum, avarudaiya niyaayangka'laiyum, avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum eppozhuthum kaikko'lvaayaaka.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar seytha sidchaiyaiyum, avarudaiya makaththuvaththaiyum, avarudaiya palaththa kaiyaiyum, avarudaiya oangkiya puyaththaiyum,
avar ekipthin naduvilea ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanukkum, avan theasam anaiththi'rkum seytha avarudaiya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum, avarudaiya kiriyaika'laiyum,

ekipthiya seanaiyum avarka'l kuthiraika'lum irathangka'lum ungka'laip pinthodarnthuvarukaiyil, karththar sivantha samuththiraththin jalaththai avarka'lmeal pura'lappa'n'ni, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rathupoala, avarka'lai azhiththa avarudaiya seykaiyaiyum,
neengka'l ivvidaththi'rku varuma'lavum avar ungka'lukku vanaantharaththil seythathaiyum,

poomi than vaayaith thi'ranthu, eliyaap ennum roopan kumaaranudaiya makka'laana thaaththaanaiyum apiraamaiyum, avarka'l kudumpangka'laiyum, avarka'l koodaarangka'laiyum, isravealar ellaarukku'l'lum avarka'lukku iruntha avarka'ludaiya sakala poru'lka'laiyum vizhungkumpadi seythathaiyum, a'riyaamalum kaa'naamalum irukki'ra ungka'l pi'l'laika'ludan naan peasavillai; in'ru neengka'lea a'rinthuko'l'lungka'l.
karththar seytha makaththuvamaana kiriyaika'laiyellaam ungka'l ka'nka'l allavoa ka'ndathu.
aakaiyaal neengka'l palappadumpadikkum,

neengka'l suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththukku'l piraveasiththu athaich suthantharikkumpadikkum, karththar ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum avarka'l santhathikkum koduppean en'ru avarka'lukku aa'naiyitta paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththil neengka'l neediththu vaazhumpadikkum, in'ru naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'ra ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam kaikko'lveerka'laaka.

nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasam nee vittuvantha ekipthu theasaththaippoal iraathu; angkea nee vithaiyai vithaiththu, keeraiththoattaththi'rku neerppaaychchuki'rathupoala un kaalaal neerppaaychchi vanthaay.
neengka'l suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasamoa, malaika'lum pa'l'laththaakkuka'lumu'l'la theasam; athu vaanaththin mazhaith tha'n'neeraik kudikkum theasam;
athu un theavanaakiya karththar visaarikki'ra theasam, varushaththin thuvakkamuthal varushaththin mudivumattum eppozhuthum un theavanaakiya karththarin ka'nka'l athinmeal vaikkappattirukkum.

neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththil ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ungka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum anpukoornthu, avaraich seavikkumpadi, naan in'ru ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'ra en ka'rpanaika'lukkuk keezhppadinthaal,
nee un thaaniyaththaiyum un thiraadcharasaththaiyum un e'n'neyaiyum searkkumpadikku, naan eat'rakaalaththil ungka'l theasaththil munmaariyaiyum pinmaariyaiyum peyyappa'n'ni,
mirukajeevanka'lukkaaka un ve'lika'lilea pul mu'laikkumpadi seyvean, nee saappittuth thirpthiyadaivaay enki'raar.
ungka'l iruthayam vagnchikkappadaamalum, neengka'l vazhivilaki anniya theavarka'laich seaviththu avarka'lai namaskariyaamalum irukkumpadi echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

illaavidil karththarudaiya koapam ungka'lmeal moo'ndu, mazhai peyyaama'rpoakavum, theasam than palanaik kodaamalirukkavum vaanaththai adaiththuppoaduvaar; karththar ungka'lukkuk koduththa nalla theasaththilirunthu neengka'l seekkiraththil azhinthupoaveerka'l.

aakaiyaal karththar ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru avarka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththil ungka'l naadka'lum, ungka'l pi'l'laika'lin naadka'lum, poomiyinmeal vaanam irukkum naadka'laippoala aneakamaayirukkumpadikku,

neengka'l en vaarththaika'lai ungka'l iruthayaththilum ungka'l aaththumaavilum pathiththu, avaika'lai ungka'l kaiyinmeal adaiyaa'lamaakak katti, ungka'l ka'nka'lin naduvea gnaapakakku'riyaaka vaiththu,

avaika'lai ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukku upatheasiththu, neengka'l veettil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, vazhiyilea nadakki'rapoathum, paduththukko'l'luki'rapoathum, ezhunthirukki'rapoathum avaika'laikku'riththup peasuveerka'laaka.
