avaika'lai ungka'l veettu nilaika'lilum ungka'l vaasalka'lilum ezhuthuveerka'laaka.

neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththil anpukoornthu, avar vazhika'lilellaam nadanthu, avaraip pat'rikko'ndirukkumpadi, naan ungka'lukkuch seyyak ka'rpikki'ra inthak ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam jaakkirathaiyaayk kaikko'lveerka'laanaal,
karththar ungka'lukku munpaaka antha jaathika'laiyellaam thuraththividuvaar; ungka'laippaarkkilum janam peruththa palaththa jaathika'lai neengka'l thuraththuveerka'l.

ungka'l u'l'langkaal mithikkum idamellaam ungka'ludaiyathaayirukkum; vanaantharaththaiyum leepanoanaiyum thodangki, aipiraaththu nathiyaiyum thodangki, kadaisich samuththiramvaraikkum ungka'l ellaiyaayirukkum.
ungka'lmun oruvarum ethirththu ni'rpathillai; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch sonnapadi ungka'laal u'ndaakum payamum kediyum neengka'l mithikkum poomiyinmealellaam varappa'n'nuvaar.
ithoa, in'ru naan ungka'lukku munpaaka aaseervaathaththaiyum saapaththaiyum vaikki'rean.
in'ru naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'ra ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'lukkuk keezhppadintheerka'laanaal aaseervaathamum,

engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'lukkuk keezhppadiyaamal, in'ru naan ungka'lukku vithikki'ra vazhiyaivittu vilaki, neengka'l a'riyaatha vea'rea theavarka'laip pinpat'ruveerka'laanaal saapamum varum.
nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil un theavanaakiya karththar unnaip piraveasikkappa'n'numpoathu, keriseem malaiyinmeal aaseervaathaththaiyum eapaal malaiyinmeal saapaththaiyum koo'rakkadavaay.

avaika'l yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea sooriyan asthamikki'ra mea'rkuvazhiyaayk kaanaaniyar kudiyirukki'ra naattu ve'liyilea kilkaalukku ethiraana moarea ennum samapoomiyin arukeayallavoa irukki'rathu?
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk kodukki'ra theasaththaich suthantharippatha'rku, neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthupoay, athaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, athilea kudiyiruppeerka'l.
aakaiyaal ungka'lukku in'ru naan ea'rpaduththuki'ra sakala katta'laika'laiyum, niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'ndu nadakkakkadaveerka'l.

ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch suthantharikkak kodukki'ra theasaththilea, neengka'l poomiyil uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam kaikko'ndu nadakkavea'ndiya katta'laika'lum niyaayangka'lumaavana:

neengka'l thuraththividum jaathika'l thangka'l theavarka'laich seaviththa uyarntha malaika'linmealum, meaduka'linmealum, pachchaiyaana sakala marangka'lin keezhumu'l'la idangka'laiyellaam mut'rilum azhiththu,

avarka'l palipeedangka'lai idiththu, avarka'l silaika'laith thakarththu, avarka'l thoappuka'lai akkiniyaal sutteriththu, avarka'l theavarka'lin vikkirakangka'lai no'rukki, avaika'lin pearum avvidaththil iraamal azhiyumpadi seyyakkadaveerka'l.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku neengka'l appadich seyyaamal,
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thammudaiya naamam vi'langkumpadi, ungka'l sakala koaththirangka'lilum therinthuko'l'lum sthaanamaakiya avarudaiya vaasasthalaththaiyea naadi, angkea poay,

angkea ungka'l sarvaangka thakanangka'laiyum, ungka'l palika'laiyum, thasamapaakangka'laiyum, ungka'l kai ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippuka'laiyum, ungka'l poruththanaika'laiyum, ungka'l u'rchaakapalika'laiyum, ungka'l aadumaaduka'lin thalaiyeet'ruka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu,

angkea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyilea pusiththu, neengka'l kaiyittuch seythathum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lai aaseervathiththathumaana yaavukkaakavum neengka'lum ungka'l kudumpaththaarum santhoashappaduveerka'laaka.
ingkea innaa'lil naam avanavan thanthan paarvaikkuch sariyaanathaiyellaam seyki'rathupoala neengka'l seyyaathiruppeerka'laaka.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk kodukkum i'laippaa'ruthalilum suthantharaththilum neengka'l innum piraveasikkavillaiyea.

neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthupoay, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch suthantharikkak kodukkum theasaththil kudiyea'rumpoathum, sut'rilum irukki'ra ungka'l saththurukka'laiyellaam avar vilakki, ungka'lai i'laippaa'rappa'n'nuki'rathinaal neengka'l sukamaay vasiththirukkumpoathum,

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum oar idam u'ndaayirukkum; angkea neengka'l naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta yaavaiyum ungka'l sarvaangka thakanangka'laiyum, ungka'l palika'laiyum, ungka'l thasamapaakangka'laiyum, ungka'l kai ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippuka'laiyum, neengka'l karththarukku nearnthuko'l'lum viseashiththa ellaap poruththanaika'laiyum ko'nduvanthu,

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil neengka'lum, ungka'l kumaararum, ungka'l kumaaraththika'lum, ungka'l vealaikkaararum, ungka'l vealaikkaarika'lum, ungka'loadu pangkum suthantharamum illaamal ungka'l vaasalka'lil irukki'ra leaviyanum santhoashappaduveerka'laaka.
ka'nda idamellaam nee un sarvaangka thakanapalika'lai idaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru.
un koaththirangka'l on'ril karththar therinthuko'l'lum idaththilmaaththiram nee un sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyittu, naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra yaavaiyum angkea seyvaayaaka.

aanaalum un theavanaakiya karththar unakku aru'lum aaseervaathaththi'rkuththakkathaay, nee un vaasalka'lilengkum un ishdappadiyea mirukajeevanka'lai adiththup pusikkalaam; theettuppattavanum theettuppadaathavanum, avaika'lai, ve'limaanaiyum kalaimaanaiyum pusikki'rathupoala pusikkalaam.
iraththaththaimaaththiram pusikkavea'ndaam; athaith tha'n'neeraippoal tharaiyilea oot'rividavea'ndum.

un thaaniyaththilum un thiraadcharasaththilum un e'n'neyilum thasamapaakaththaiyum, un aadumaaduka'lin thalaiyeet'ruka'laiyum, nee nearnthuko'l'lum unnudaiya sakala poruththanaika'laiyum, un u'rchaakak kaa'nikkaika'laiyum, un kai ea'reduththup padaikkum padaippuka'laiyum, nee un vaasalka'lil pusikkavea'ndaam.

un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththil neeyum un kumaaranum, un kumaaraththiyum, un vealaikkaaranum, un vealaikkaariyum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra leaviyanum, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil athaip pusiththu, nee kaiyittuch seyyum ellaak kaariyaththilum un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil santhoashappaduvaayaaka.
nee un theasaththilirukkum naa'lellaam leaviyanaik kaividaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadi, un ellaiyai visthaaramaakkumpoathu, nee i'raichchi pusikka aasaiko'ndu, i'raichchi pusippean enpaayaanaal, nee un ishdappadi i'raichchi pusikkalaam.

un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum sthaanam unakkuth thooramaanaal, karththar unakku a'liththa un aadumaaduka'lil ethaiyaakilum naan unakku vithiththapadi nee adiththu, un ishdappadi un vaasalka'lilea pusikkalaam.
ve'limaanaiyum kalaimaanaiyum pusikki'rathupoala nee athaip pusikkalaam; theettuppattavanum theettuppadaathavanum athaip pusikkalaam.
iraththaththaimaaththiram pusikkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru; iraththamea uyir; maamsaththoadea uyiraiyum pusikkavea'ndaam.
athai nee saappidaamal tha'n'neeraippoal tharaiyilea oot'rividavea'ndum.
nee karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seyvathinaal, neeyum unakkup pinvarum un pi'l'laika'lum nan'raayirukkumpadi nee athaich saappidalaakaathu.
unakkuriya parisuththa vasthukka'laiyum, un poruththanaika'laiyum karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththi'rku nee ko'nduvanthu,

un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal un sarvaangka thakanapalika'lai maamsaththoadum iraththaththoadumkoodap paliyidakkadavaay; nee seluththum mat'rap palika'lin iraththamum un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal oot'rappadakkadavathu; maamsaththaiyoa nee pusikkalaam.

nee un theavanaakiya karththarin paarvaikku nanmaiyum semmaiyumaanathaich seyvathinaal, neeyum unakkup pinvarum un pi'l'laika'lum en'ren'raikkum nan'raayirukkumpadikku, naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra intha ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum nee kavaniththuk kea'l.
nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththin jaathika'lai un theavanaakiya karththar unakku munpaakach sangkarikkumpoathum, nee avarka'l theasaththaich suthanthariththu athilea kudiyirukkumpoathum,

avarka'l unakku munpaaka azhikkappattapinpu, nee avarka'laip pinpat'rich sikkikko'l'laathapadikkum, intha jaathika'l thangka'l theavarka'laich seaviththapadi naanum seavippean en'ru solli avarka'ludaiya theavarka'laikku'riththuk keattu visaariyaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayiru.

un theavanaakiya karththarukku appadich seyyaayaaka; karththar ve'rukki'ra aruvaruppaana yaavaiyum avarka'l thangka'l theavarka'lukkuch seythu, thangka'l kumaararaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum thangka'l theavarka'lukku akkiniyilea sutteriththaarka'lea.
naan unakku vithikki'ra yaavaiyum seyyumpadi kavanamaayiru; nee athanoadea on'rum koottavum vea'ndaam, athil on'rum ku'raikkavum vea'ndaam.
ungka'lukku'l'lea oru theerkkatharisiyaakilum, soppanakkaaranaakilum ezhumpi:

neengka'l a'riyaatha vea'rea theavarka'laip pinpat'ri, avarka'laich seavippoam vaarungka'l en'ru solli, ungka'lukku oru adaiyaa'laththaiyum a'rputhaththaiyum kaa'npippean en'ru ku'rippaaych sonnaalum, avan sonna adaiyaa'lamum a'rputhamum nadanthaalum,

anthath theerkkatharisiyaakilum, anthach soppanakkaaranaakilum solluki'ravaika'laik kea'laathiruppeerka'laaka; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththil neengka'l ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ungka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum anpukooruki'reerka'loa illaiyoa en'ru a'riyumpadikku ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'laich soathikki'raar.
neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pinpat'ri, avarukkup payanthu, avar ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu, avar saththaththaik keattu, avaraich seaviththu, avaraip pat'rikko'lveerka'laaka.

anthath theerkkatharisiyum, anthach soppanakkaaranum kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; neengka'l nadakkumpadi ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukku vithiththa vazhiyai vittu ungka'lai vilakkumpadi, avan, ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninavarum ungka'lai adimaiththana veettilirunthu neengkalaakki meettukko'ndavarumaana ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaana thuroakappeachchaip peasinaan; ippadippatta theemaiyai ungka'lidaththilirunthu vilakkuveerka'laaka.

un thaaykkup pi'rantha un sakoatharanaakilum, un kumaaranaakilum, un kumaaraththiyaakilum, un maarpilu'l'la un manaiviyaakilum, un piraa'nanaippoalirukki'ra un sineakithanaakilum unnai noakki: naam poay vea'rea theavarka'laich seavippoam vaarungka'l en'ru solli,

unnaich sut'rilum unakkuch sameepaththilaakilum unakkuth thooraththilaakilum, theasaththin orumunai thodangki ma'rumunaimattumu'l'la evvidaththilaakilum irukki'ra janangka'ludaiya theavarka'lil, neeyum un pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha anniya theavarka'laich seavikkumpadi irakasiyamaay unnai eavivittaal,
nee avanukkuch sammathiyaamalum, avanukkuch sevikodaamalum, un ka'n avanmeal irakkangko'l'laamalum, avanaith thappavidaamalum, avanai o'liththuvaikkaamalum,
avanaik kolaiseythupoadavea'ndum; avanaik kolaiseyvatha'rku, muthal un kaiyum pinpu sakala janaththin kaiyum avanmeal irukkakkadavathu.

adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthu theasaththilirunthu unnaip pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaakiya karththarai vittu vilakumpadi avan unnai eavinapadiyinaal, avan saakumpadi avanmeal kalle'riyakkadavaay.
isravealar yaavarum athaik keattup payanthu, ini un naduvea ippadippatta theemaiyaana kaariyaththaich seyyaathiruppaarka'l.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kudiyirukkumpadi kodukkum patta'nangka'l on'ril pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya thushdamanithar unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappattu,
neengka'l a'riyaatha vea'rea theavarka'laich seavikkappoavoam vaarungka'l en'ru thangka'l patta'naththin kudika'lai eavinaarka'l enki'ra seythiyaik kea'lvippadumpoathu,
nee nan'raay visaariththu, keattaaraaynthu, appadippatta aruvaruppaana kaariyam un naduvea nadanthathu meyyum nichchayamum en'ru kaa'npaayaanaal,
anthap patta'naththin kudika'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, athaiyum athilu'l'la yaavat'raiyum athin mirukajeevanka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal sangkaarampa'n'ni,

athil ko'l'laiyittathaiyellaam athin naduveethiyilea kootti, un theavanaakiya karththarukku en'ru anthap patta'naththaiyum, athil ko'l'laiyidappatta yaavat'raiyum muzhuvathum akkiniyil sutterikkakkadavaay; athu inik kattappadaamal, niththiya ma'nmeadaayirukkakkadavathu.

sapikkappatta poru'lil on'rum un kaiyil irukkavea'ndaam. naan in'ru unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra un theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam nee kaikko'ndu, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seyyumpadi, avar saththaththi'rkuch sevikoduppaayaanaal,
karththar thamathu koapaththin ukkiraththaivittuth thirumpi, unakkuth thayaiseythu, unakku irangki, avar un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittapadi unnai viruththiyadaiyappa'n'nuvaar.
neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin pi'l'laika'l; seththavanukkaakak kee'rikko'l'laamalum, ungka'l ka'nka'lukku idaiyilea savarampa'n'naamalum iruppeerka'laaka.

neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththamaana janangka'l; poomiyinmeethengkumu'l'la ellaa janangka'lilum ungka'laiyea karththar thamakkuch sontha janangka'laayirukkath therinthuko'ndaar.
aruvaruppaanathon'raiyum pusikkavea'ndaam.
neengka'l pusikkaththakum mirukangka'laavana: maadum, semma'riyaadum, ve'l'laadum,
maanum, ve'limaanum, kalaimaanum, varaiyaadum, pu'l'limaanum, sarukumaanum, pulvaayumea.
mirukangka'lil viriku'lampu'l'lathaayirunthu, ku'lampuka'l ira'ndaakap pirinthirukki'rathum, asaipoaduki'rathumaana sakala mirukangka'laiyum neengka'l pusikkalaam;

asaipoaduki'ravaika'lilum, viriku'lampu'l'lavaika'lilum, neengka'l pusikkaththakaathavaika'l evaiyen'raal: ottakamum, musalum, kuzhimusalumea; avaika'l asaipoattum avaika'lukku viriku'lampillai; avaika'l ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka.

pan'riyum pusikkaththakaathu; athu viriku'lampu'l'lathaayirunthum, asaipoadaathirukkum; athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka; ivaika'lin maamsaththaip pusiyaamalum ivaika'lin udalaith thodaamalum iruppeerka'laaka.
jalaththilirukki'ra ellaavat'rilum si'rakum sethi'lum u'l'lavaika'laiyellaam neengka'l pusikkalaam.
si'rakum sethi'lum illaatha yaathon'raiyum pusikkalaakaathu; athu ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka.
suththamaana sakala padchika'laiyum neengka'l pusikkalaam.
neengka'l pusikkaththakaathavaika'l evaiyen'raal: kazhukum, karudanum, kadaluraagnchiyum,
pairiyum, valloo'rum, sakalavitha parunthum,
sakalavitha kaakangka'lum,
theekkuruviyum, kookaiyum, sempukamum, sakalavithamaana deakaiyum,
aanthaiyum, koattaanum, naaraiyum,
koozhakkadaavum, kurukum, neerkkaakamum,
kokkum, sakalavitha raajaa'liyum, puzhukkoththiyum, vauvaalumea.
pa'rakki'ravaika'lil oorvana yaavum ungka'lukku asuththamaayiruppathaaka; avaika'l pusikkaththakaathavaika'l.
suththamaana pa'ravaika'l yaavaiyum neengka'l pusikkalaam.

thaanaay i'ranthupoanathon'raiyum pusikkavea'ndaam; ungka'l vaasalka'lil irukki'ra paratheasikku athaip pusikkakkodukkalaam; allathu anniyanukku athai vit'ruppoadalaam; neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththa janangka'l. ve'l'laattukkuttiyai athin thaayin paalilea samaikkavea'ndaam.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarukku eppozhuthum payanthirukkap pazhakumpadikku, varushanthoa'rum nee vithaikki'ra vithaippinaalea vayalil vi'laiyum ellaap palanilum thasamapaakaththaip piriththu,

un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththilea, un thaaniyaththilum un thiraadcharasaththilum un e'n'neyilum thasamapaakaththaiyum un aadumaaduka'lin thalaiyeet'ruka'laiyum avarudaiya sannithiyil pusippaayaaka.

un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathikkum kaalaththil, un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'nda sthaanam unakku veku thooramaayirukki'rathinaal, vazhippirayaa'naththin veku tholaiyinimiththam, nee athaik ko'ndupoakakkoodaathirukkumaanaal,
athaip pa'namaakki, pa'namudippai un kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'nda sthalaththi'rkup poay,

angkea un ishdappadi aadumaadu, thiraadcharasam, mathupaanam muthalaana sakalaththaiyum pa'namkoduththu vaangki, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil, neeyum un kudumpaththaarum un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra leaviyanum pusiththuch santhoashappaduveerka'laaka.
leaviyanukku unnoadea pangkum suthantharamum illaathapadiyaal avanaik kaividaayaaka.
moon'raam varushaththin mudivilea avvarushaththil unakku vantha palan ellaavat'rilum thasamapaakaththaip piriththu, un vaasalka'lil vaikkakkadavaay.

leaviyanukku unnoadea pangkum suthantharamum illaathapadiyinaal, avanum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra paratheasiyum, thikkat'ravanum, vithavaiyum vanthu pusiththuth thirpthiyadaivaarka'laaka; appozhuthu un kai seyyum vealaiyilellaam un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathippaar.
eazhaam varushaththin mudivilea viduthalaipa'n'nuvaayaaka.

viduthalaiyin viparamaavathu: pi'ranukkuk kadankoduththavan evanum, karththar niyamiththa viduthalai koo'rappattapadiyaal, anthak kadanaip pi'ran kaiyilaakilum than sakoatharan kaiyilaakilum tha'ndaamal vittuvidakkadavan.
anniya jaathiyaan kaiyilea nee kadanaith tha'ndalaam; un sakoatharanidaththiloa unakku varavea'ndiyathai un kai vittuvidakkadavathu.

e'liyavan unakku'l illaathirukkumpadiyaaka ippadich seyyavea'ndum; in'ru naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra ellaak ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum nee seyyumpadi, un theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththaik kavanamaayk keadpaayaanaal,
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharikkumpadi kodukkum theasaththil, unnai meanmealum aaseervathippaar.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadi unnai aaseervathippathinaal, nee aneakam jaathika'lukkuk kadan koduppaay, neeyoa kadan vaangkuvathillai; nee aneakam jaathika'lai aa'luvaay, unnaiyoa avarka'l aa'luvathillai.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththin entha vaasalilum un sakoathararil e'liyavanaana oruvan irunthaal, e'liyavanaakiya un sakoatharanukku un iruthayaththai nee kadinamaakkaamalum, un kaiyai moodaamalum,
avanukku un kaiyaith thaaraa'lamaayth thi'ranthu, avanudaiya avasaraththinimiththam avanukkuth theavaiyaanathaik kadankoduppaayaaka.

viduthalai varushamaakiya eazhaam varusham kittiyirukki'rathen'ru solli, un iruthayaththilea pollaatha ninaivu ko'ndu, un eazhaich sakoatharanukkuk kodaamal ma'ruththu, avanmeal vanka'n vaikkaathapadikkum, avan unnaik ku'riththuk karththarai noakki apayamidaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayiru; appadich seyvaayaanaal athu unakkup paavamaayirukkum.

avanukkuth thaaraa'lamaayk koduppaayaaka; avanukkuk kodukkumpoathu un iruthayam visanappadaathiruppathaaka; athinimiththamaaka un theavanaakiya karththar unnudaiya ellaak kiriyaika'lilum, nee kaiyittuch seyyum ellaak kaariyangka'lilum unnai aaseervathippaar.

theasaththilea e'liyavarka'l illaathiruppathillai; aakaiyaal un theasaththilea si'rumaippattavanum e'liyavanumaakiya un sakoatharanukku un kaiyaith thaaraa'lamaayth thi'rakkavea'ndum en'ru naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.

un sakoatharanaakiya epireya purushanaakilum epireya sthireeyaakilum unakku vilaippattaal, aa'ruvarusham unnidaththil seavikkavea'ndum; eazhaam varushaththil avanai viduthalaipa'n'ni anuppividuvaayaaka.
avanai viduthalaipa'n'ni anuppividumpoathu avanai ve'rumaiyaay anuppividaamal,
un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathiththathinpadi, un aattumanthaiyilum un ka'laththilum un aalaiyilum eduththu avanukkuth thaaraa'lamaayk koduththu anuppividuvaayaaka.
nee ekipthutheasaththil adimaiyaayirunthathaiyum, un theavanaakiya karththar unnai meettukko'ndathaiyum ninaivukoorakkadavaay; aakaiyaal naan in'ru inthak kaariyaththai unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.
aanaalum, avan unnidaththil nanmaipet'ru, unnaiyum un kudumpaththaiyum neasippathinaal: naan unnaivittup poakamaattean en'ru unnudanea solvaaneayaakil,
nee oru kampiyai eduththu, avan kaathaik kathavoadea searththuk kuththuvaayaaka; pinpu avan en'raikkum unakku adimaiyaayirukkakkadavan; un adimaippe'n'nukkum appadiyea seyyakkadavaay.

avanai viduthalaiyaakki anuppividuvathu unakku visanamaayk kaa'nappadavea'ndaam; irattippaana koolikku eedaaka aa'ru varusham unnidaththil seaviththaanea; ippadi un theavanaakiya karththar nee seyyum ellaavat'rilum unnai aaseervathippaar.

un aadumaaduka'lil thalaiyeet'raakiya aa'naiyellaam un theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththamaakkakkadavaay; un maattin thalaiyeet'rai vealaiko'l'laamalum, un aattin thalaiyeet'rai mayir kaththariyaamalum iruppaayaaka.
karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthalaththilea varushanthoa'rum neeyum un veettaarumaay un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil appadippattavaika'laip pusikkakkadaveerka'l.
atha'rku mudam kurudu muthalaana yaathoru pazhuthu irunthaal, athai un theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidavea'ndaam.
appadippattathai nee un vaasalka'lilea, kalaimaanaiyum ve'limaanaiyum pusippathupoalap pusikkalaam; theettuppattavanum theettuppadaathavanum athaip pusikkalaam.
athin iraththaththaimaaththiram saappidaamal, athaith tha'n'neeraippoalath tharaiyilea oot'rividakkadavaay.

aapip maathaththaik kavaniththirunthu, athil un theavanaakiya karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikkakkadavaay; aapipmaathaththilea iraakkaalaththil un theavanaakiya karththar unnai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaarea.
karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththil, un theavanaakiya karththarukkup paskaavin paliyaakiya aadumaaduka'laip paliyiduvaayaaka.

nee ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'lai nee uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam ninaikkumpadi, paskaappaliyudanea pu'lippu'l'la appam pusiyaamal, si'rumaiyin appamaakiya pu'lippillaatha appangka'lai eazhunaa'lvaraikkum pusikkakkadavaay; nee theeviramaay ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappattapadiyinaal ippadich seyyavea'ndum.

eazhunaa'la'lavum un ellaika'lilengkum pu'lippu'l'la appam unnidaththil kaa'nappadalaakaathu; nee muthalnaa'l saayangkaalaththil itta paliyin maamsaththil eathaakilum iraamuzhuthum vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum vaikkavea'ndaam.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum unnudaiya vaasalka'lil ethilum nee paskaavai adikkavea'ndaam.

un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththilea, nee ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta nearamaakiya saayangkaalaththilea sooriyan asthamikki'rapoathu paskaavai adiththu,
un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'nda sthaanaththilea, athaip poriththup pusiththu, vidiya'rkaalaththilea un koodaarangka'lukkuth thirumpippoavaayaaka.
nee aa'runaa'lum pu'lippillaatha appam pusikkavea'ndum, eazhaam naa'l un theavanaakiya karththarukku aasarikkappadum naa'laayirukkum; athilea yaathoru vealaiyum seyyavea'ndaam.
eazhu vaarangka'lai e'n'nuvaayaaka; a'ruppu a'rukkath thodangkum kaalamuthal nee antha eazhu vaarangka'laiyum e'n'navea'ndum.

avaika'l mudinthapoathu vaarangka'lin pa'ndikaiyai un theavanaakiya karththarukku en'ru aasariththu, un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathiththatha'rkuth thakkathaay un kaikku nearntha manappoorvamaana kaa'nikkaiyaakiya pakuthiyaich seluththi,

un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththilea, neeyum, un kumaaranum, un kumaaraththiyum, un vealaikkaaranum, un vealaikkaariyum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra leaviyanum, unnidaththil irukki'ra paratheasiyum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyum, vithavaiyum, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil santhoashappattu,
nee ekipthil adimaiyaayirunthathai ninaiththu, inthak katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu ivaika'linpadi seyyakkadavaay.
nee un ka'laththin palanaiyum un aalaiyin palanaiyum searththapinpu, koodaarappa'ndikaiyai eazhunaa'l aasariththu,

un pa'ndikaiyil neeyum, un kumaaranum, un kumaaraththiyum, un vealaikkaaranum, un vealaikkaariyum, un vaasalka'lil irukki'ra leaviyanum, paratheasiyum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyum, vithavaiyum santhoashappadakkadaveerka'l;

unakku u'ndaana ellaa varaththilum un kaika'ludaiya ellaak kiriyaiyilum un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathiththapadiyinaal, karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththil un theavanaakiya karththarukku eazhunaa'la'lavum pa'ndikaiyai aasariththuch santhoashamaayiruppaayaaka.

varushaththil moon'rutharam pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyilum, vaarangka'lin pa'ndikaiyilum, koodaarappa'ndikaiyilum, un aa'nmakka'l ellaarum un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththilea, avar sannithikku munpaaka vanthu kaa'nappadakkadavarka'l.

aanaalum avarka'l karththarudaiya sannithiyil ve'rungkaiyoadea varaamal, un theavanaakiya karththar unakku aru'liya aaseervaathaththi'rkuththakkathaaka, avanavan than than thakuthikku eat'rapadi kaa'nikkaiyaik ko'nduvarakkadavan.

un theavanaakiya karththar un koaththirangka'lthoa'rum unakkuk kodukkum vaasalka'lilellaam, niyaayaathipathika'laiyum thalaivaraiyum ea'rpaduththuvaayaaka; avarka'l neethiyudan janangka'lukku niyaayaththeerppuch seyyakkadavarka'l.

niyaayaththaip purattaathiruppaayaaka; mukathaadchi'niyam pa'n'naamalum, parithaanam vaangkaamalum iruppaayaaka; parithaanam gnaanika'lin ka'nka'laik kurudaakki, neethimaanka'lin niyaayangka'laith thaa'rumaa'raakkum.
nee pizhaiththu, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadikku neethiyaiyea pinpat'ruvaayaaka.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarukku u'ndaakkum palipeedaththa'ndaiyil yaathoru thoappaiyum u'ndaakkavea'ndaam;
yaathoru silaiyaiyum ni'ruththavea'ndaam; un theavanaakiya karththar athai ve'rukki'raar.
pazhuthum avaladcha'namumu'l'la yaathoru maattaiyaavathu aattaiyaavathu un theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidavea'ndaam; athu un theavanaakiya karththarukku aruvaruppaayirukkum.

un theavanaakiya karththarin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka enthap purushanaavathu sthireeyaavathu un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukki'ra vaasalka'l on'ril akkiramagnseythu, avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri,
naan vilakkiyirukki'ra vea'rea theavarka'laiyaavathu santhirasooriyar muthalaana vaanaseanaika'laiyaavathu seaviththu, avaika'lai namaskarikki'rathaakak kaa'nappattaal,
athu un sevikeadka unakku a'rivikkappadumpoathu, nee athai nan'raay visaarikkakkadavaay; athu mey en'rum, appadippatta aruvaruppu isravealil nadanthathu nichchayam en'rum ka'ndaayaanaal,
antha akkiramaththaich seytha purushanaiyaavathu sthireeyaiyaavathu un vaasalka'lukku ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, appadippattavarka'l saakumpadi kalle'riyakkadavaay.
saavukkup paaththiramaanavan ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'ludaiya vaakkinaal kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; orea saadchiyinudaiya vaakkinaal avan kolaiseyyappadalaakaathu.
avanaik kolaiseyki'ratha'rkuch saadchika'ludaiya kaika'l munthiyum ellaa janangka'ludaiya kaika'l pinthiyum avanmeal iruppathaaka; ippadiyea theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.

un vaasalka'lil iraththappazhika'laik ku'riththum, viyaachchiyangka'laik ku'riththum, kaayampatta seathangka'laikku'riththum vazhakku nearittu, niyaayantheerppathu unakku arithaayirunthaal, nee ezhunthu, un theavanaakiya karththar therinthu ea'rpaduththina sthaanaththi'rkup poay,
leaviyaraana aasaariyaridaththilum annaadka'lil irukki'ra niyaayaathipathiyinidaththilum visaarikkavea'ndum; niyaayam innathen'ru avarka'l unakku a'rivippaarka'l.
karththar therinthuko'nda idaththilirunthu avarka'l unakku a'rivikkum theerppukku nee i'nangki, avarka'l unakku vithikki'rapadi seyyak kavanamaayiruppaayaaka.
avarka'l unakku a'rivikkum theerppai vittu valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaamal, avarka'l unakku u'narththum piramaa'naththinpadiyum, unakkuch sollum niyaayaththeerppinpadiyum seyyakkadavaay.

angkea un theavanaakiya karththarukku aaraathanai seyyumpadi ni'rki'ra aasaariyanudaiya sollaiyaakilum, niyaayaathipathiyinudaiya sollaiyaakilum kea'laamal, oruvan idumpuseythaal, avan saakakkadavan; ippadiyea theemaiyai isravealilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.
appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum athaik keattu, payanthu, ini idumpu seyyaathiruppaarka'l.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththil nee poaych searnthu, athaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, athil kudiyea'rinapin, nee: ennaich sut'rilum irukki'ra sakala jaathika'laiyum poala, naanum enakku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththavea'ndum enpaayaanaal;

un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'lpavanaiyea unakku raajaavaaka vaikkakkadavaay; un sakoathararukku'l'lirukki'ra oruvanaiyea unmeal raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththakkadavaay; un sakoatharan allaatha anniyanai raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththakkoodaathu.

avan aneaka kuthiraika'laich sampaathiyaamalum, aneaka kuthiraika'laith thanakkuch sampaathikkumpadikku janangka'laith thirumpa ekipthi'rkup poakappa'n'naamalum irukkakkadavan; ini antha vazhiyaay neengka'l thirumpippoakavea'ndaam en'ru karththar ungka'lukkuch solliyirukki'raarea.
avan iruthayam pinvaangkip poakaathapadi avan aneakam sthireeka'laip padaikkavea'ndaam; ve'l'liyum ponnum thanakku mikuthiyaayp perukappa'n'navum vea'ndaam.
avan than singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkumpoathu, avanudaiya iruthayam avan sakoathararpearil meattimaiko'l'laamalum, ka'rpanaiyaivittu valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaamalum,

intha niyaayappiramaa'naththin ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum, inthak katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'ndu, ivaika'linpadi seyvatha'rkaakath than theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthirukkumpadi kat'rukko'l'lumporuttu,

avan leaviyaraakiya aasaariyaridaththilirukki'ra niyaayappiramaa'na noolaippaarththu, thanakkaaka oru pirathiyai ezhuthi, thannidaththil vaiththukko'ndu, than jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam athai vaasikkakkadavan; ippadich seyvathinaal, thaanum than kumaararum isravealin naduvea thangka'l raajyaththilea neediththu vaazhuvaarka'l.

leaviyaraakiya aasaariyarukkum leavi koaththiraththaar anaivarukkum israveal puththirarudan pangkum suthantharamum illaathiruppathaaka; karththarukku idappadum thakanapalika'laiyum avarukkuch suthantharamaanavaika'laiyum avarka'l pusippaarka'laaka.
avarka'l sakoathararukku'l'lea avarka'lukkuch suthantharamillai; karththar avarka'lukkuch solliyapadiyea, avarea avarka'l suthantharam.

janaththinidaththil pet'rukko'l'lavea'ndiya aasaariyarukkuriya varaththaavathu: janangka'l paliyidum aadumaaduka'lil munnanthodaiyaiyum thaadaika'laiyum iraippaiyaiyum aasaariyanukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
un thaaniyam, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney, aatturoamam ennum ivaika'lin mutha'rpalanaiyum avanukkuk kodukkavea'ndum.
avanum avan kumaararum ennaa'lum karththarin naamaththai munnittu aaraathanai seyyumpadi ni'rkumporuttu, un theavanaakiya karththar un koaththiraththaar ellaarukku'l'lum avanaiyea therinthuko'ndaar.
isravealil evvidaththilumu'l'la un vaasalka'l yaathon'rilea thangkina oru leaviyan avvidaththai vittu, karththar therinthuko'nda sthaanaththi'rku manappoorvamaay vanthaal,
angkea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ni'rkum leaviyaraakiya than ellaach sakoathararaippoalum than theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththai munnittu oozhiyagnseyvaan.
appadippattavarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya aasthiyin vilaikkirayaththai anupavikki'rathum allaamal, saappaatti'rkaakach samamaana paakaththaiyum pet'rukko'lvaarka'l.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththil nee poaych searumpoathu, antha jaathika'l seyyum aruvaruppuka'linpadi seyyak kat'rukko'l'lavea'ndaam.
than makanaiyaavathu than maka'laiyaavathu theekkadakkappa'n'nuki'ravanum, ku'risolluki'ravanum, naa'lpaarkki'ravanum, agnchanam paarkki'ravanum, sooniyakkaaranum,
manthiravaathiyum, sannathakkaaranum, maayaviththaikkaaranum, seththavarka'lidaththil ku'rikeadki'ravanum ungka'lukku'l'lea irukkavea'ndaam.
ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'ravan evanum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan; ippadippatta aruvaruppuka'lin nimiththam un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai un munnin'ru thuraththividuki'raar.
un theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka nee uththamanaayirukkakkadavaay.
nee thuraththividappoaki'ra intha jaathika'l naa'lpaarkki'ravarka'lukkum ku'risolluki'ravarka'lukkum sevikodukki'raarka'l; nee appadich seyki'ratha'rku un theavanaakiya karththar uththaravukodaar.
un theavanaakiya karththar ennaip poala oru theerkkatharisiyai unakkaaka un naduvea un sakoathararilirunthu ezhumpappa'n'nuvaar; avarukkuch sevikoduppeerka'laaka.

oareapilea sapai koottappatta naa'lil: naan saakaathapadi en theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththai ini naan kea'laamalum, inthap periya akkiniyai ini naan kaa'naamalum iruppeanaaka en'ru un theavanaakiya karththarai nee vea'ndikko'ndathinpadiyellaam avar seyvaar.
appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: avarka'l sonnathu sariyea.

unnaippoala oru theerkkatharisiyai naan avarka'lukkaaka avarka'l sakoathararilirunthu ezhumpappa'n'ni, en vaarththaika'lai avar vaayil aru'luvean; naan avarukkuk ka'rpippathaiyellaam avarka'lukkuch solluvaar.
en naamaththinaalea avar sollum en vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodaathavan evanoa avanai naan visaarippean.
sollumpadi naan katta'laiyidaatha vaarththaiyai en naamaththinaalea sollath thu'niyum theerkkatharisiyum, vea'rea theavarka'lin naamaththinaalea peasum theerkkatharisiyum saakakkadavan.
karththar sollaatha vaarththai innathen'ru naan eppadi a'rivean en'ru nee un iruthayaththil solvaayaakil,

oru theerkkatharisi karththarin naamaththinaalea sollum kaariyam nadavaamalum ni'raivea'raamalumpoanaal, athu karththar sollaatha vaarththai; anthath theerkkatharisi athaith thu'nikaraththinaal sonnaan; avanukku nee payappadavea'ndaam.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththin jaathika'lai un theavanaakiya karththar vearat'ruppoakap pa'n'nuvathinaal, nee avarka'l theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, avarka'l patta'nangka'lilum avarka'l veeduka'lilum kudiyea'rumpoathu,
nee un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharikkak kodukkum un theasaththin naduvilea, unakkaaka moon'ru patta'nangka'laip piriththuvaikkakkadavaay.

kolaiseythavan evanum angkea oadippoakumpadi un theavanaakiya karththar unnaich suthantharikkappa'n'nappoaki'ra un theasaththin ellaiyai nee moon'ru pangkaakap pakuththu atha'rku vazhiyai u'ndupa'n'nakkadavaay.
kolaiseythu angkea oadippoay, uyiroadirukkaththakkavan yaaren'raal: thaan munnea pakaiththiraatha pi'ranoruvanai manatha'riyaamal kon'ravanthaanea.

oruvan vi'rakuvetta mat'roruvanoadea kaattil poay, maraththai vettath than kaiyiliruntha koadariyai oangkumpoathu, irumpaanathu kaampai vittuk kazhan'ru mat'ravanmeal pattathinaal avan i'ranthupoanaal,

iraththappazhikkaaran than manam erikaiyil, kolaiseythavanai vazhi thooramaayirukki'rathinaalea pinthodarnthu pidiththu, avanaik kon'rupoadaathapadikku, ivan anthap patta'nangka'l on'ril oadippoay uyiroadiruppaanaaka; ivan avanai munnea pakaikkaathapadiyinaal, ivanmeal saavukkaana kut'ram sumaravillai.
ithinimiththam moon'ru patta'nangka'lai unakkaakap piriththuvaikkakkadavaay en'ru naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.
nee un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil anpukoornthu, ennaa'lum avar vazhika'lil nadappatha'rkaaka, in'ru naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra intha ellaak ka'rpanaika'laiyum kaikko'ndu athinpadi seythu,
un theavanaakiya karththar un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittapadiyea, avar un ellaiyai visthaaramaakki, un pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru sonna theasam muzhuvathaiyum unakkuk koduththaal,

appozhuthu un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum un theasaththil kut'ramillaatha iraththam sinthappaduki'rathinaal unmeal iraththappazhi sumaraathapadikku, intha moon'ru patta'nangka'lum allaamal innum moon'ru patta'nangka'lai ea'rpaduththakkadavaay.
oruvan pi'ranoruvanaip pakaiththu, avanukkup pathivirunthu, avanukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, avan saakumpadi avanai adiththu, inthap patta'nangka'lil on'ril oadippoayiruppaanaakil,
anthap patta'naththin moopparka'l aa'l anuppi, angkeayirunthu avanaik ko'nduvarumpadi seythu, avan saakumpadikku avanai iraththappazhi vaangkuki'ravan kaiyil oppukkodukkakkadavarka'l.
un ka'n avanukku irangkavea'ndaam; kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyai isravealai vittu vilakkakkadavaay; appozhuthu nee nan'raayiruppaay.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum theasaththil un kaivasamaayirukkum kaa'niyaadchiyilea munnoarka'l ku'riththirukki'ra pi'ranudaiya ellaiyai ot'rippoadaayaaka.

oruvan entha akkiramaththaiyaavathu enthap paavaththaiyaavathu seythaan en'ru sollappattaal, orea saadchiyinaal niyaayantheerkkakkoodaathu; ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'ludaiya vaakkinaalea kaariyam nilaivarappadavea'ndum.
oruvanmeal oru kut'raththaich sumaththumpadi, oru poychsaadchikkaaran avanmeal saadchisolla ezhumpinaal,
vazhakkaaduki'ra iruvarum karththarudaiya sannithiyil akkaalaththil irukkum aasaariyarka'lukkum niyaayaathipathika'lukkum munpaaka vanthu ni'rpaarka'laaka.
appozhuthu niyaayaathipathika'l nan'raay visaara'naiseyyakkadavarka'l; saadchi ka'l'lachsaadchi en'rum, than sakoatharanmeal apaa'ndamaayk kut'ragnsaat'rinaan en'rum ka'ndaal,
avan than sakoatharanukkuch seyya ninaiththapadiyea avanukkuch seyyakkadaveerka'l; ivvithamaayth theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkuvaayaaka.
mat'ravarka'lum athaik keattup payanthu, ini ungka'lukku'l'lea appadippatta theemaiyaich seyyaathiruppaarka'l.
un ka'n avanukku irangkavea'ndaam; jeevanukku jeevan, ka'n'nukkuk ka'n, pallukkup pal, kaikkuk kai, kaalukkuk kaal kodukkappadavea'ndum.

nee un saththurukka'lukku ethiraaka yuththagnseyyap pu'rappattup poakaiyil, kuthiraika'laiyum irathangka'laiyum, unnilum periya koottamaakiya janangka'laiyum ka'ndaal, avarka'lukkup payappadaayaaka; unnai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaakiya karththar unnoadea irukki'raar.
neengka'l yuththagnseyyath thodangkumpoathu, aasaariyan searnthuvanthu, janangka'lidaththil peasi:

isravealarea, kea'lungka'l; in'ru ungka'l saththurukka'ludan yuththagnseyyap poaki'reerka'l; ungka'l iruthayam thuva'lavea'ndaam; neengka'l avarka'laip paarththup payappadavum kalangkavum thaththa'likkavum vea'ndaam.
ungka'lukkaaka ungka'l saththurukka'loadea yuththampa'n'navum ungka'lai iradchikkavum ungka'loadeakoodap poaki'ravar ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru sollavea'ndum.

an'riyum athipathika'l janangka'lai noakki: puthuveettaik katti, athaip pirathishdaipa'n'naathirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than veettukkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan; avan yuththaththilea seththaal vea'roruvan athaip pirathishdaipa'n'navea'ndiyathaakum.
thiraadchaththoattaththai naatti, athai anupaviyaathirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than veettukkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan; avan yuththaththilea seththaal vea'roruvan athai anupavikkavea'ndiyathaakum.

oru pe'n'naith thanakku niyamiththukko'ndu, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'naathirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than veettukkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan; avan yuththaththilea seththaal vea'roruvan ava'lai vivaakampa'n'navea'ndiyathaakum en'ru sollavea'ndum.

pinnum athipathika'l janangka'ludanea peasi: payangkaa'liyum thidanat'ravanumaayirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than sakoathararin iruthayaththaith than iruthayaththaippoalak karainthupoakappa'n'naathapadikku, than veettukkuth thirumpippoakakkadavan en'ru sollavea'ndum.
athipathika'l janangka'loadea peasi mudinthapinpu, janangka'lai nadaththumpadi, seanaiththalaivarai niyamikkakkadavarka'l.
nee oru patta'naththinmeal yuththampa'n'na nerungkumpoathu, anthap patta'naththaarukkuch samaathaanam koo'rakkadavaay.
avarka'l unakkuch samaathaanamaana uththaravukoduththu, vaasalaith thi'ranthaal, athilu'l'la janangka'l ellaarum unakkup pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laaki, unakku oozhiyagnseyyakkadavarka'l.
avarka'l unnoadea samaathaanappadaamal, unnoadea yuththampa'n'nuvaarka'laanaal, nee athai mut'rikkaipoattu,
un theavanaakiya karththar athai un kaiyil oppukkodukkumpoathu, athilu'l'la purusharka'l ellaaraiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vetti,

sthireeka'laiyum kuzhanthaika'laiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum maaththiram uyiroadea vaiththu, patta'naththilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum ko'l'laiyittu, un theavanaakiya karththar unakku oppukkoduththa un saththurukka'lin ko'l'laipporu'lai anupavippaayaaka.
intha jaathika'laichsearntha patta'nangka'laayiraamal, unakku vekuthooraththilirukki'ra sakala patta'nangka'lukkum ippadiyea seyvaayaaka.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukki'ra eaththiyar, emoariyar, kaanaaniyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyar ennum janangka'lin patta'nangka'lileamaaththiram suvaasamu'l'lathon'raiyum uyiroadea vaikkaamal,
avarka'lai un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea sangkaarampa'n'nakkadavaay.

avarka'l thangka'l theavarka'lukkuch seyki'ra thangka'ludaiya sakala aruvaruppuka'linpadiyea neengka'lum seyya ungka'lukkuk kat'rukkodaamalum, neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseyyaamalum irukkumpadi ippadich seyyavea'ndum.

nee oru patta'naththinmeal yuththampa'n'ni athaip pidikka aneaka naa'l athai mut'rikkaipoattirukkumpoathu, nee koadariyai oangki, athin marangka'lai vettich seathampa'n'naayaaka; avaika'lin kaniyai nee pusikkalaamea; aakaiyaal unakkuk koththa'laththi'rku uthavum en'ru avaika'lai vettaayaaka; ve'liyin virudchangka'l manushanudaiya jeevanaththukkaanavaika'l.

pusikki'ratha'rkeat'ra kanikodaatha maram en'ru nee a'rinthirukki'ra marangka'laimaaththiram vettiyazhiththu, unnoadu yuththampa'n'nuki'ra patta'nam pidipadumattum atha'rku ethiraakak koththa'lam poadalaam.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharikkak kodukkum theasaththil, kolaiseyyappattuk kidakki'ra oruvanai ve'liyilea ka'ndu, avanaik kon'ravan innaan en'ru theriyaathirunthaal,
un moopparum un niyaayaathipathika'lum pu'rappattuppoay, kolaiseyyappattavanaich sut'rilum irukkum patta'nangka'lmattum a'lappaarka'laaka.
kolaiseyyappattavanukkuch sameepamaana patta'naththu mooppar, vealaiyil pa'npadaathathum nukaththadiyil pi'naikkappadaathathumaana oru kidaariyaip pidiththu,
uzhuthu vithaiyaatha tharisaana pa'l'laththaakkilea athaik ko'ndupoay, anthap pa'l'laththaakkilea athin thalaiyai vettippoadakkadavarka'l.

un theavanaakiya karththar thamakku aaraathanai seyyavum karththarudaiya naamaththilea aaseervathikkavum leaviyin kumaararaakiya aasaariyaraith therinthuko'ndapadiyaal, avarka'lum aththaru'naththil vanthirukkavea'ndum; avarka'l vaakkinpadiyea sakala vazhakkum sakala kaayachseathamum theerkkappadavea'ndum.
kolaiseyyappattavanukkuch sameepamaana patta'naththin mooppar ellaarum pa'l'laththaakkilea thalai vettappatta kidaariyinmeal thangka'l kaika'laik kazhuvi:
engka'l kaika'l antha iraththaththaich sinthinathum illai, engka'l ka'nka'l athaik ka'ndathum illai;

karththaavea, neer meettukko'nda umathu janamaakiya isravealinmeal kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyaich sumaththaamal, umathu janamaakiya isravealinmeal kirupaiyu'l'lavaraayirum en'ru solvaarka'laaka; appozhuthu iraththappazhi avarka'lukku nivirththiyaakum.
ippadik karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathai nee seyvaayaakil, kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkippoaduvaay.
nee un saththurukka'lukku ethiraaka yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappattu, un theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai un kaiyil oppukkodukki'rathinaal, avarka'laich si'raipidiththuvanthu,
si'raika'lil roopavathiyaana oru sthireeyaikka'ndu, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'na virumpi,
ava'lai un veetti'rku'l azhaiththukko'ndupoavaayaanaal, ava'l than thalaiyaich siraiththu, than nakangka'laik ka'lainthu,

than si'raiyiruppin vasthiraththaiyum neekki, un veettilirunthu, oru maathamattum than thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum ninaiththuth thukkangko'ndaadakkadava'l; athanpinpu nee ava'loadea searnthu, ava'lukkup purushanaayiru, ava'l unakku manaiviyaayiruppaa'l.

ava'lmeal unakkup piriyamillaama'rpoanaal, nee ava'laip pa'naththi'rku vi'rkaamal, ava'laith than ishdappadi poakavidalaam; nee ava'laith thaazhmaippaduththinapadiyinaal ava'laalea aathaayam pe'rumpadi theadavea'ndaam.

ira'ndu manaivika'laiyudaiya oruvan, oruththiyinmeal viruppaayum mat'rava'lmeal ve'ruppaayum irukka, iruvarum avanukkup pi'l'laika'laip pet'raarka'leayaakil, mutha'rpi'ranthavan ve'rukkappattava'lin puththiranaanaalum,

thakappan thanakku u'ndaana aasthiyaith than pi'l'laika'lukkup pangkidum naa'lil, ve'rukkappattava'lidaththil pi'rantha mutha'rpea'raanavanukku seashdapuththira suthantharaththaik kodukkavea'ndumeayallaamal, virumpappattava'lidaththil pi'ranthavanukkuk kodukkalaakaathu.

ve'rukkappattava'lidaththil pi'ranthavanai seashdapuththiranaaka angkikariththu, thanakku u'ndaana aasthika'lilellaam ira'ndu pangkai avanukkuk kodukkavea'ndum; avan than thakappanudaiya mutha'rpalan, seashdapuththira suthantharam avanukkea uriyathu.
than thakappan sollaiyum than thaayin sollaiyum kea'laamalum, avarka'laal tha'ndikkappattum, avarka'lukkuk keezhppadiyaamalum poaki'ra adangkaatha thushdappi'l'lai oruvanukku irunthaal,
avan thakappanum avan thaayum avanaip pidiththu, avan irukkum patta'naththin moopparidaththukkum avvidaththu vaasalukkum avanaik ko'ndupoay:
engka'l makanaakiya ivan adangkaatha thushdanaayirukki'raan; engka'l sollaik kea'laan; peruntheenikkaaranum kudiyanumaayirukki'raan en'ru patta'naththin moopparoadea solluvaarka'laaka.

appozhuthu avan saakumpadi anthap patta'naththu manitharellaarum avanmeal kalle'riyakkadavarka'l; ippadiyea theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkippoadavea'ndum; isravealar ellaarum athaik keattup payappaduvaarka'l.
kolaiseyyappada oruvanmeal saavukkup paaththiramaana paavam u'ndaayirukka, avanaik kolaiseyyumpadi maraththilea thookkippoaduvaayaanaal,

iravilea avan pireatham maraththilea thongkalaakaathu; annaa'lileathaanea athai adakkampa'n'navea'ndum; thookkippoadappattavan theavanaal sapikkappattavan; aakaiyaal un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum un theasaththaith theettuppaduththaayaaka.
un sakoatharanudaiya maadaavathu aadaavathu vazhithappippoaki'rathaik ka'ndaayaanaal, athaik kaa'naathavanpoal iraamal, athai un sakoatharanidaththukkuth thiruppikko'ndu poakakkadavaay.

un sakoatharan unakkuch sameepamaayiraamalum unakku a'rimukamaayiraamalum irunthaal, nee athai un veetti'rkuk ko'ndupoay, athai un sakoatharan theadivarumattum unnidaththilea vaiththu, avanukkuth thirumpak kodukkakkadavaay.

appadiyea avan kazhuthaiyaik ku'riththum seyyakkadavaay; avan vasthiraththaikku'riththum appadiyea seyyakkadavaay; un sakoatharanidaththilirunthu kaa'naama'rpoanavaika'lil ethaiyaakilum ka'ndupidiththaayaanaal appadiyea seyyakkadavaay; avaika'lai nee kaa'naathavanpoal vittuppoakalaakaathu.

un sakoatharanudaiya kazhuthaiyaavathu avanudaiya maadaavathu vazhiyilea vizhunthukidakki'rathaik ka'ndaayaanaal, athaik kaa'naathavanpoala vittuppoakaamal, avanoadeakooda athaith thookkiyeduththuviduvaayaaka.
purusharin udaika'lai sthireeka'l tharikkalaakaathu, sthireeka'lin udaika'laip purushar tharikkalaakaathu; appadich seyki'ravarka'l ellaarum un theavanaakiya karththarukku aruvaruppaanavarka'l.

vazhiyarukea oru maraththilaavathu tharaiyilaavathu kugnchuka'laayinum muttaika'laayinumu'l'la oru kuruvikkoodu unakkuth thenpadumpoathu, thaayaanathu kugnchuka'linmealaavathu muttaika'linmealaavathu adaikaaththukko'ndirunthaal, nee kugnchuka'loadea thaayaiyum pidikkalaakaathu.
thaayaip poakavittu, kugnchuka'lai maaththiram eduththukko'l'lalaam; appozhuthu nee nan'raayiruppaay; un naadka'lum neediththirukkum.
nee puthuveettaik kattinaal, oruvan un meththaiyilirunthu vizhuki'rathinaalea, nee iraththappazhiyai un veettinmeal sumaththikko'l'laathapadikku, atha'rkuk kaippidisuvaraik kattavea'ndum.
un thiraadchaththoattaththilea pa'rpalavithamaana vithaiyai vithaikkaayaaka; ippadich seythaal nee vithaiththavaika'lin payiraiyum, thiraadchaththoattaththin palanaiyum theettuppaduththuvaay.
maattaiyum kazhuthaiyaiyum pi'naiththu uzhaathiruppaayaaka.
aattumayirum pagnchunoolum kalantha vasthiraththai uduththikko'l'laayaaka.
nee thariththukko'l'luki'ra un mealsattaiyin naanku oarangka'lilum thongkalka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka.
oru sthireeyai vivaakampa'n'nina oruvan ava'lidaththil piraveasiththapinpu ava'lai ve'ruththu:
naan intha sthireeyai vivaakampa'n'ni, ava'lidaththil searnthapoathu kannimaiyaik kaa'navillai en'ru ava'lmeal aavalaathiyaana viseashangka'laich saat'ri, ava'lukku avathoo'ru u'ndaakkinaal;
antha sthireeyin thakappanum ava'l thaayum ava'ludaiya kannimaiyin adaiyaa'laththaip patta'naththu vaasalilu'l'la moopparidaththil ko'nduvarakkadavarka'l.
angkea anthap pe'n'nin thakappan: en maka'lai intha manithanukku manaiviyaakak koduththean, ivan ava'lai ve'ruththu,

naan un maka'lidaththil kannimaiyaik kaa'navillaiyen'ru aavalaathiyaana viseashangka'lai ava'lmeal saat'ruki'raan; en maka'ludaiya kannimaiyin adaiyaa'lam ingkea irukki'rathu en'ru moopparidaththil solvaanaaka; pinpu patta'naththu moopparukku munpaaka antha vasthiraththai virikkakkadavarka'l.
appozhuthu anthap patta'naththu mooppar antha manithanaip pidiththu, avanaith tha'ndiththu,

avan isravealil oru kanniyai avathoo'rupa'n'ninathinaalea, avan kaiyil noo'ru ve'l'likkaasai aparaathamaaka vaangki, pe'n'nin thakappanukkuk kodukkakkadavarka'l; ava'loa avanukku manaiviyaayirukkavea'ndum; avan than jeevanu'l'la'lavum ava'laith tha'l'lividakkoodaathu.
anthap pe'n'nidaththil kannimai kaa'nappadavillaiyennum sangkathi meyppattatheayaanaal,

anthap pe'n'nai ava'l thakappanudaiya veettuvaasalukku munpaakak ko'nduvanthu, ava'l isravealil mathiketta kaariyaththaich seythu, than thakappan veettilea veasiththanampa'n'ninapadiyinaalea, ava'ludaiya patta'naththu manithar ava'laik kalle'rinthu kollakkadavarka'l; ippadiyea theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.

purushanukku vivaakampa'n'nappatta sthireeyoadea oruvan sayanikkak ka'ndupidikkappattaal, antha sthireeyoadea sayaniththa manithanum antha sthireeyum iruvarum saakavea'ndum; ippadiyea theemaiyai isravealilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.
kannikaiyaana oru pe'n oruvanukku niyamikkappattirukkaiyil, mat'roruvan ava'lai oorukku'l'lea ka'ndu, ava'loadea sayaniththaal,

appozhuthu anthap pe'n oorukku'l'lirunthum kookkuralidaathathinaalum, antha manithan pi'ranudaiya manaiviyaik ka'rpazhiththapadiyinaalum, iruvaraiyum anthap patta'naththu vaasalukkumun ko'ndupoay, avarka'lmeal kalle'rinthu kollakkadaveerka'l; ippadiyea theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.
oruvanukku niyamikkappatta pe'n'nai ve'liyilea oruvan ka'ndu, ava'laip palavanthamaayp pidiththu, ava'loadea sayaniththaaneayaakil, ava'loadea sayaniththa manithan maaththiram saakakkadavan.
pe'n'nukku on'rum seyyalaakaathu; pe'n'ninmeal saavukku eathuvaana kut'ram illai; ikkaariyam oruvan mat'roruvanmeal ezhumpi avanudaiya jeevanai vaangkinathupoala irukki'rathu.
ve'liyilea avan ava'laik ka'ndupidiththaan; niyamikkappatta pe'n appozhuthu kookkuralittum ava'laik kaappaat'ruvaar illaama'rpoayit'ru.
niyamikkappadaatha kanniyaasthireeyaakiya oru pe'n'nai oruvan ka'ndu, kaiyaip pidiththu ava'loadea sayanikkaiyil, avarka'l ka'ndupidikkappattaal,

ava'loadea sayaniththa manithan pe'n'nin thakappanukku aimpathu ve'l'likkaasaik kodukkakkadavan; avan ava'laik ka'rpazhiththapadiyinaal, ava'l avanukku manaiviyaayirukkavea'ndum; avan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum ava'laith tha'l'lividakkoodaathu.
oruvanum than thakappanudaiya manaiviyaich searalaakaathu; than thakappan maanaththai avan ve'lippaduththalaakaathu.
vithaiyadikkappattavanum, koasama'rupattavanum karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaakaathu.
veasippi'l'laiyum karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaakaathu; avanukkup paththaam thalaimu'raiyaanavanum karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaakaathu.
ammoaniyanum moavaapiyanum karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaakaathu; paththaam thalaimu'raiyilum en'raikkum avarka'l karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaakaathu.

neengka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'ra vazhiyilea, avarka'l appaththoadum tha'n'neeroadum ungka'lukku ethirko'ndu varaathathinimiththamum, unnaich sapikkumpadiyaay mesoppoththaamiyaavin ooraakiya peaththoariliruntha peayoarin kumaaran pileayaamukkuk koolipeasi avanai azhaippiththathinimiththamum ippadich seyyavea'ndum.

un theavanaakiya karththar pileayaamukkuch sevikodukkach siththamillaamal, un theavanaakiya karththar unmeal anpukoornthapadiyinaal, un theavanaakiya karththar anthach saapaththai unakku aaseervaathamaaka maa'rappa'n'ninaar.
nee un aayu'lnaadka'lu'l'la'lavum orukkaalum avarka'l samaathaanaththaiyum nanmaiyaiyum theadaathea.
eathoamiyanai aruvarukkaayaaka, avan un sakoatharan; ekipthiyanai aruvarukkaayaaka, avan theasaththilea paratheasiyaayirunthaay.
moon'raam thalaimu'raiyil avarka'lukkup pi'rantha pi'l'laika'l karththarudaiya sapaikku udpadalaam.
nee padaiyeduththu un saththurukka'lukku viroathamaayp pu'rappadumpoathu, theethaana kaariyangka'l ellaavat'ri'rkum vilakiyiruppaayaaka.
iraakkaalaththil sampaviththa theettinaalea asuththamaayirukki'ra oruvan ungka'lilirunthaal, avan paa'layaththi'rku ve'liyea poay, paa'layaththi'rku'l varaamal,
saayangkaalaththilea jalaththil snaanampa'n'ni, sooriyan asthamikkumpoathu paa'layaththi'rku'l varakkadavan.
nee ve'likkup poayirukkaththakka idam paa'layaththi'rkup pu'rampea irukkavea'ndum.

un aayuthangka'loadea oru si'ru koalum unnidaththil irukkakkadavathu; nee malajalaathikkup poakumpoathu, athanaal ma'n'naith thoa'ndi, malajalaathikkirunthu, unnilirunthu kazhinthupoanathai moodippoadakkadavaay.

un theavanaakiya karththar unnai iradchikkavum, un saththurukka'lai unakku oppukkodukkavum, un paa'layaththi'rku'l'lea ulaavikko'ndirukki'raar; aakaiyaal, avar unnidaththil asusiyaana kaariyaththaik ka'ndu, unnaivittup poakaathapadikku, un paa'layam suththamaayirukkakkadavathu.
than ejamaanukkuth thappi unnidaththil vantha vealaikkaaranai avanudaiya ejamaan kaiyil oppukkodaayaaka.
avan unakku irukki'ra un vaasalka'l on'rilea thanakkuch sammathiyaana idaththaith therinthuko'ndu, athilea unnudanea iruppaanaaka; avanai odukkavea'ndaam.
isravealin kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyum veasiyaayirukkakkoodaathu; isravealin kumaararil oruvanum aa'npu'narchchikkaaranaayirukkakkoodaathu.

veasippa'nayaththaiyum, naayin kirayaththaiyum enthap poruththanaiyinaalaakilum un theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththilea ko'nduvaraayaaka; avaika'l ira'ndum un theavanaakiya karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaika'l.
kadanaakak kodukki'ra pa'naththukkum aakaaraththukkum, kadanaakak kodukki'ra vea'rea enthap poru'lukkum, un sakoatharan kaiyil vatti vaangkaayaaka.

anniyan kaiyil nee vattivaangkalaam; nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil un theavanaakiya karththar nee kaiyidum vealaiyilellaam unnai aaseervathikkumpadi un sakoatharan kaiyilea vatti vaangkaayaaka.

nee un theavanaakiya karththarukkup poruththanai pa'n'niyirunthaal, athaich seluththath thaamathagnseyyaathea; un theavanaakiya karththar athai nichchayamaay un kaiyil keadpaar; athu unakkup paavamaakum.
nee poruththanaipa'n'naathirunthaal, unmeal paavam illai.
un vaayinaal sonnathai ni'raiveat'ravea'ndum; un theavanaakiya karththarukku un vaayinaal nee poruththanaipa'n'nich sonna u'rchaakapaliyaich seluththith theerppaayaaka.
nee pi'ranudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththil piraveasiththaal, un aasaitheera thiraadchappazhangka'laith thirpthiyaakap pusikkalaam; un koodaiyilea on'rum eduththukko'ndu poakakkoodaathu.
pi'ranudaiya vi'laichchalil piraveasiththaal, un kaiyinaal kathirka'laik koyyalaam; nee antha vi'laichchalil arivaa'lai idalaakaathu.

oruvan oru sthireeyai vivaakampa'n'nikko'ndapinpu, ava'lidaththil ilachchaiyaana kaariyaththaik ka'ndu, ava'lmeal piriyamat'ravanaanaal, avan tha'l'luthalin seettai ezhuthi, ava'l kaiyilea koduththu, ava'laith than veettilirunthu anuppividalaam.
ava'l avanudaiya veettaivittup poanapinpu, vea'roruvanukku manaiviyaakalaam.

antha ira'ndaam purushanum ava'lai ve'ruththu, tha'l'luthalin seettai ezhuthi, ava'l kaiyilea koduththu, ava'laith than veettilirunthu anuppivittaalum, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nina antha ira'ndaam purushan i'ranthupoanaalum,

ava'l theettuppattapadiyinaal, ava'laith tha'l'livitta ava'ludaiya munthina purushan thirumpavum ava'lai manaiviyaakach searththukko'l'lakkoodaathu; athu karththarukku munpaaka aruvaruppaanathu; un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum theasaththinmeal paavam varappa'n'naayaaka.

oruvan oru pe'n'naip puthithaay vivaakampa'n'niyirunthaal, avan yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadavea'ndaam; avanmeal yaathoru vealaiyum sumaththavea'ndaam; avan oru varushapariyantham than veettil than ishdappadiyirunthu, thaan vivaakampa'n'nina sthireeyaich santhoashappaduththuvaanaaka.
thirikaiyin adikkallaiyaavathu athin mea'rkallaiyaavathu oruvarum adakaaka vaangkakkoodaathu; athu jeevanai adaku vaangkuvathupoalaakum.

than sakoathararaakiya israveal puththiraril oruvanaith thirudi, athinaal aathaayantheadi, avanai vit'ruppoatta oruvan akappattaal, anthath thirudan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum; ippadiyea theemaiyai un naduvilirunthu vilakkakkadavaay.

kushdaroakaththaikku'riththu leaviyaraakiya aasaariyar ungka'lukkup poathikkum yaavaiyum kavaniththuch seyyumpadi mikavum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; naan avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seyyak kavanamaayiruppeerka'laaka.
neengka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'ra vazhiyilea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar miriyaamukkuch seythathai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l.
pi'ranukku nee eathaakilum kadanaakak koduththaal, avan kodukkum adakai vaangka nee avan veetti'rku'l piraveasikkavea'ndaam.
ve'liyea ni'rpaayaaka; kadan vaangkinavan antha adakai ve'liyea unnidaththil ko'nduvaruvaanaaka.
avan thariththiranaanaal, nee avan adakai vaiththukko'ndu niththirai seyyaamal,

avan than vasthiraththaip poattup paduththukko'ndu unnai aaseervathikkumpadi, pozhuthupoakumpoathu, thirumpa antha adakai avanukkuk koduththuvidavea'ndum; athu un theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka unakku neethiyaayirukkum.
un sakoathararilum, un theasaththin vaasalka'lilu'l'la anniyarilum eazhaiyum e'limaiyumaana koolikkaaranai odukkaayaaka.

avan vealaiseytha naa'lilthaanea, pozhuthupoakumunnea, avan kooliyai avanukkuk koduththuvidavea'ndum; avan eazhaiyum athinmeal aavalumaayirukki'raan; athaik kodaavittaal avan unnaikku'riththuk karththarai noakki mu'raiyiduvaan; athu unakkup paavamaayirukkum.
pi'l'laika'lukkaakap pithaakka'lum, pithaakka'lukkaakap pi'l'laika'lum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndaam; avanavan seytha paavaththinimiththam avanavan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum.
nee anniyanudaiya niyaayaththaiyum thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyin niyaayaththaiyum purattaamalum, vithavaiyin vasthiraththai adakaaka vaangkaamalum irunthu,
nee ekipthilea adimaiyaayirunthathaiyum, un theavanaakiya karththar unnai angkeayirunthu meettukko'nduvanthathaiyum ninaippaayaaka; aakaiyaal, ippadich seyyumpadi naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.

nee un payirai a'rukkaiyil un vayalilea oru arikkattai ma'rathiyaay vaiththuvanthaayaanaal, athai eduththu varumpadi thirumpip poakavea'ndaam; un theavanaakiya karththar un kaippirayaasaththilellaam unnai aaseervathikkumpadi, athaip paratheasikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum vithavaikkum vittuviduvaayaaka.
nee un olivamaraththai uthirththuvittapinpu, kompilea thappiyirukki'rathaip pa'rikkumpadi thirumpip poakavea'ndaam; athaip paratheasikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum vithavaikkum vittuviduvaayaaka;
nee un thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'ruththapinpu, ma'rupadiyum athai a'rukkath thirumpippoakavea'ndaam; athaip paratheasikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum vithavaikkum vittuviduvaayaaka.
nee ekipthilea adimaiyaayirunthathai ninaippaayaaka; aakaiyaal, ippadich seyyumpadi naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.

manitharukku'l'lea vazhakku'ndaay, avarka'l niyaayam visaarikkappada niyaayasthalaththilea vanthaal, niyaayaathipathika'l neethimaanai neethimaan en'rum kut'ravaa'liyaik kut'ravaa'li en'rum theerkkakkadavarka'l.
kut'ravaa'li adika'lukkup paaththiravaanaanaal, niyaayaathipathi avanaik keezhea kidakkappa'n'ni, avan kut'raththi'rkuth thakkathaayth thanakku munpaakak ka'nakkinpadi avanai adippikkakkadavan.
avanai naa'rpathu adivaraikkum adikkalaam; avanai athilum athikamaay adikki'rathinaal un sakoatharan un ka'nka'lukku munpaaka neesanaayth thoan'ruvaan; aathalaal avanai athikamaay adikkavea'ndaam.
poaradikki'ra maattai vaaykattaayaaka.

sakoatharar on'raayk kudiyirukkumpoathu, avarka'lil oruvan puththirasanthaanamillaamal mariththaal, mariththavanudaiya manaivi pu'raththilirukki'ra anniyanukku manaiviyaakakkoodaathu; ava'ludaiya purushanin sakoatharan ava'laith thanakku manaiviyaakak ko'ndu, ava'lidaththil searnthu, purushanudaiya sakoatharan seyyavea'ndiya kadamaiyaich seyyakkadavan.
mariththa sakoatharanudaiya pear isravealil at'ruppoakaathapadikku, avan pearai ava'l pe'rum thalaippi'l'laikkuth tharikkavea'ndum.

avan than sakoatharanudaiya manaiviyai vivaakampa'n'na manathillaathirunthaal, avan sakoatharanudaiya manaivi vaasalil koodiya moopparidaththukkuppoay: en purushanudaiya sakoatharan than sakoatharanudaiya pearai isravealil nilaikkappa'n'namaattean enki'raan; purushanudaiya sakoatharan seyyavea'ndiya kadamaiyaich seyya avan manathillaathirukki'raan en'ru solvaa'laaka.
appozhuthu anthap patta'naththu mooppar avanai azhaippiththu avanoadea peasiyum, avan ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nikko'l'la enakkuch sammathamillai en'ru pidivaathamaaych sonnaal,

avan sakoatharanudaiya manaivi moopparin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka avanidaththil vanthu, avan kaalilirukki'ra paatharadchaiyaik kazhat'ri, avan mukaththilea thuppi, than sakoatharan veettaik kattaathavanukku ippadiyea seyyappadavea'ndum en'ru sollakkadava'l.
isravealil appadippattavan veedu, paatharadchai kazhat'rippoadappattavan veedu ennappadum.

purushar oruvaroadoruvar sa'ndaipa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil, oruvanudaiya manaivi than purushanai adikki'ravan kaikku avanaith thappuvikkumpadi vanthu, than kaiyai neetti, adikki'ravan maanaththaip pidiththathu'ndaanaal,
ava'ludaiya kaiyaith tha'rikkakkadavaay; un ka'n ava'lukku irangkavea'ndaam.
un paiyilea perithum si'rithumaana palavitha ni'raika'rka'lai vaiththirukkavea'ndaam.
un veettil perithum si'rithumaana palavitha padika'laiyum vaiththirukkavea'ndaam.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththil un naadka'l neediththirukkumpadi, ku'raiyat'ra sumuththiraiyaana ni'raikallum, ku'raiyat'ra sumuththiraiyaana padiyum unnidaththil irukkavea'ndum.
ivaimuthalaana aniyaayaththaich seyki'ravan evanum un theavanaakiya karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan.
ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'ra vazhiyilea, amaleakku theavanukkup payappadaamal unakku ethiraaka vanthu,
nee i'laiththu vidaayththirukkaiyil, pinvaruki'ra un paa'layaththilu'l'la palaveenaraiyellaam vettinaan enpathai ninaiththiru.

un theavanaakiya karththar nee suthanthariththukko'l'la unakkuk kodukkum theasaththin sut'ruppu'raththaaraakiya unnudaiya saththurukka'laiyellaam un theavanaakiya karththar vilakki, unnai i'laippaa'rappa'n'numpoathu, nee amaleakkin pearai vaanaththinkeezh iraathapadikku azhiyappa'n'nakkadavaay; ithai ma'rakkavea'ndaam.
un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch suthantharamaakak kodukkum theasaththil nee poaych searnthu, athaik kattikko'ndu, athil vaasampa'n'numpoathu,

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum un theasaththil nee payiridum nilaththin kanika'lilellaam munthina palanai eduththu, oru koodaiyilea vaiththu, un theavanaakiya karththar thamathu naamam vi'langkumpadi therinthuko'ndirukkum sthaanaththi'rkup poay,

annaadka'lil irukkum aasaariyanidaththil sen'ru, avanai noakki: karththar engka'lukkuk kodukka nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththil vanthu searnthean en'ru in'ru ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil a'rikkaiyiduki'rean enpaayaaka.
appozhuthu aasaariyan anthak koodaiyai un kaiyilirunthu vaangki, athai un theavanaakiya karththarin palipeedaththi'rku munpaaka vaikkakkadavan.

appozhuthu nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil nin'ru vasaniththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: en thakappan azhivukku nearaana seeriyaa theasaththaanaayirunthaan; avan kogncham janangka'loadea ekipthukkuppoay, avvidaththil paratheasiyaaych sagnchariththu, angkea periya palaththa thiradchiyaana jaathiyaanaan.
ekipthiyar engka'lai odukki, engka'laich si'rumaippaduththi, engka'lmeal kadinamaana vealaiyaich sumaththinapoathu,
engka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai noakkik kooppittoam; karththar engka'l saththaththaik keattu, engka'l si'rumaiyaiyum engka'l varuththaththaiyum engka'l odukkaththaiyum paarththu,
engka'laip palaththa kaiyinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum, makaa payangkarangka'linaalum, adaiyaa'langka'linaalum, a'rputhangka'linaalum, ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni,
engka'lai ivvidaththukku azhaiththuvanthu, paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasamaakiya inthath theasaththai engka'lukkuk koduththaar.

ippozhuthum, ithoa, karththaavea, theavareer enakkuk koduththa nilaththinudaiya kanika'lin mutha'rpalanaik ko'nduvanthean en'ru solli, athai un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaiththu, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil pa'ninthu,
neeyum leaviyanum, unnidaththil irukki'ra paratheasiyum un theavanaakiya karththar unakkum un veettaarukkum anukkirakampa'n'nina sakala nanmaika'linimiththamum santhoashappaduveerka'laaka.

thasamapaakam seluththum varushamaakiya moon'raam varushaththilea, nee un varaththilellaam paththil on'rai eduththu, leaviyanum paratheasiyum thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyum vithavaiyum un vaasalka'lil pusiththuth thirpthiyaakumpadi avarka'lukkuk koduththuth theernthapinpu,

nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil poay avarai noakki: theavareer enakkuk koduththa ellaak katta'laika'linpadiyum, naan parisuththamaana poru'lka'lai en veettilirunthu eduththuvanthu, leaviyanukkum paratheasikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum vithavaikkum koduththean; ummudaiya katta'laika'lil on'raiyum naan mee'ravum illai ma'rakkavum illai.

naan thukkangko'ndaadumpoathu athil pusikkavum illai, theettaana kaariyaththukku athil on'rum edukkavum illai; izhavukaariyaththukkaaka athil on'rum padaikkavum illai; naan en theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthu, theavareer enakkuk katta'laiyittapadi sakalamum seythean.

neer umathu parisuththa vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththilirunthu noakkippaarththu, umathu janangka'laakiya isravealaraiyum, neer engka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittapadiyea, engka'lukkuk koduththa paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththaiyum aaseervathiyum en'ru solvaayaaka.

inthak katta'laika'linpadiyum niyaayangka'linpadiyum nee seyyumporuttu, in'ru un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'raar; aakaiyaal un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum avaika'laik kaaththu nadakkakkadavaay.

karththar enakku theavanaayiruppaar en'rum, naan avar vazhika'lil nadanthu, avar katta'laika'laiyum avar ka'rpanaika'laiyum avar niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'ndu, avar saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadivean en'rum nee in'ru avarukku vaakkukkoduththaay.
karththarum unakku vaakkukkoduththu unakkuch solliyirukki'rapadi: nee ennudaiya katta'laika'laiyellaam kaikko'ndaal, enakkuch sontha janamaayiruppaay en'rum,

naan u'ndupa'n'nina ellaa jaathika'laippaarkkilum, pukazhchchiyilum keerththiyilum makimaiyilum unnaich si'ranthirukkumpadi seyvean en'rum, naan sonnapadiyea, nee un theavanaakiya karththaraana enakkup parisuththa janamaayiruppaay en'rum, avar in'ru unakkuch solluki'raar en'raan.
pinpu moasea, isravealin mooppar kooda irukkaiyil, janangka'lai noakki: naan in'ru ungka'lukku vithikki'ra katta'laika'laiyellaam kaikko'l'lungka'l.
un theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk kodukkum theasaththi'rku nee poaka yoarthaanaik kadakkum naa'lil, nee periya kalluka'lai naatti, avaika'lukkuch saanthu poosi,

un pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadi unakkuk kodukkum paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththi'rku'l piraveasikkumpadi nee kadanthupoanapinpu, intha niyaayappiramaa'na vaarththaika'l yaavaiyum avaika'lil ezhuthakkadavaay.
mealum neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthapoathu, in'ru naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadi anthak kalluka'lai eapaal malaiyilea naatti, avaika'lukkuch saanthu poosi,
angkea iruppaayuthampadaatha ka'rka'laalea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattakkadavaay.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarin palipeedaththai muzhukka'rka'laalea katti, athinmeal un theavanaakiya karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum,
samaathaanapalika'laiyum ittu, un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil pusiththuch santhoashamaayirunthu,
anthak kalluka'lil intha niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'laiyellaam thulakkamaay ezhuthakkadavaay en'ru katta'laiyittaan.
pinnum moasea, leaviyaraakiya aasaariyarka'lum kooda irukkaiyil, isravealar ellaaraiyum noakki: isravealea, kavaniththuk kea'l; innaa'lilea un theavanaakiya karththarukku janamaanaay.

aakaiyaal nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthu, in'ru naan unakku vithikki'ra avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'linpadiyum seyvaayaaka en'ru sonnaan.
mealum annaa'lilea moasea janangka'lai noakki:
neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthapinpu, janangka'l aaseervathikkappadumpadi keriseem malaiyil simiyoan, leavi, yoothaa, isakkaar, yoaseappu, penyameen ennum koaththirangka'l ni'rkavea'ndum.
saapangkoo'rappadumporuttu eapaal malaiyil roopan, kaath, aasear, sepuloan, thaa'n, napthali ennum koaththirangka'l ni'rkavea'ndum.
appozhuthu leaviyar uraththa saththamittu israveal manithar ellaaraiyum paarththu:

karththarukku aruvaruppaana kaariyamaakiya thozhilaa'lika'ludaiya kaivealaiyaal seyyappattathum vaarppikkappattathumaana yaathoru vikkirakaththai u'ndupa'n'ni o'lippidaththilea vaikki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; atha'rku janangka'lellaarum pirathiyuththaramaaka aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum thooshikki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
pi'ranudaiya ellaikku'riyai ot'rippoaduki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
kurudanai vazhithappachseyki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
paratheasi thikkat'ravan vithavai aakiya ivarka'ludaiya niyaayaththaip purattuki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
than thakappan manaiviyoadea sayanikki'ravan, than thakappanudaiya maanaththaith thi'ranthapadiyinaalea, sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
yaathoru mirukaththoadea pu'narchchi seyki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
than thakappanukkaavathu thaaykkaavathu kumaaraththiyaakiya than sakoathariyoadea sayanikki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
than maamiyoadea sayanikki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
o'lippidaththilea pi'ranaik kolaiseyki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
kut'ramillaathavanaik kolaiseyyumpadi parithaanam vaangkuki'ravan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.
intha niyaayappiramaa'na vaarththaika'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu nadavaathavan sapikkappattavan enpaarka'laaka; janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollakkadavarka'l.

in'ru naan unakku vithikki'ra un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya katta'laika'linpadiyellaam seyya nee kavanamaayirukkumpadikku, avar saththaththi'rku u'nmaiyaaych sevikoduppaayaanaal, un theavanaakiya karththar poomiyilu'l'la sakala jaathika'lilum unnai meanmaiyaaka vaippaar.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththukkuch sevikodukkumpoathu, ippozhuthu sollappadum aaseervaathangka'lellaam unmeal vanthu unakkup palikkum.
nee patta'naththilum aaseervathikkappattiruppaay; ve'liyilum aaseervathikkappattiruppaay.
un karppaththin kaniyum, un nilaththin kaniyum, un maaduka'lin perukkamum, un aaduka'lin manthaika'lumaakiya un mirukajeevanka'lin palanum aaseervathikkappattirukkum.
un koodaiyum, maappisaiki'ra un thottiyum aaseervathikkappattirukkum.
nee varukaiyilum aaseervathikkappattiruppaay, nee poakaiyilum aaseervathikkappattiruppaay.

unakku viroathamaay ezhumpum un saththurukka'laik karththar unakku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappadumpadi oppukkoduppaar; oru vazhiyaay unakku ethiraakap pu'rappattu varuvaarka'l; eazhu vazhiyaay unakku munpaaka oadippoavaarka'l.
karththar un ka'lagnchiyangka'lilum, nee kaiyidum ellaa vealaiyilum unakku aaseervaatham katta'laiyiduvaar; un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk kodukkum theasaththilea unnai aaseervathippaar.
nee un theavanaakiya karththarin katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu, avar vazhika'lil nadakkumpoathu, karththar unakku aa'naiyittapadiyea, unnaith thamakkup parisuththa janamaaka nilaippaduththuvaar.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya naamam unakkuth tharikkappattathu en'ru poomiyin janangka'lellaam ka'ndu, unakkup payappaduvaarka'l.

unakkuk koduppean en'ru karththar un pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththil, karththar un karppaththin kaniyilum, un mirukajeevanka'lin palanilum, un nilaththin kaniyilum unakkup paripoora'na nanmai u'ndaakak katta'laiyiduvaar.

eat'rakaalaththil un theasaththilea mazhai peyyavum, nee kaiyittuchseyyum vealaika'laiyellaam aaseervathikkavum, karththar unakkuth thamathu nalla pokkishasaalaiyaakiya vaanaththaith thi'rappaar; nee aneakam jaathika'lukkuk kadankoduppaay, neeyoa kadan vaangkaathiruppaay.
in'ru naan ungka'lukku vithikki'ra vaarththaika'l yaavaiyum vittu vilaki vea'rea theavarka'laich seavikkumpadi, nee valathupu'ram idathupu'ram saayaamal,

in'ru naan unakku vithikki'ra un theavanaakiya karththarin katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'lavum avaika'linpadi nadakkavum avaika'lukkuch sevikoduththuvanthaal, karththar unnai vaalaakkaamal thalaiyaakkuvaar, nee keezhaakaamal mealaavaay.

in'ru naan unakku vithikki'ra un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya ellaak ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum katta'laika'linpadiyum nadakkak kavanamaayirukki'ratha'rku, avar saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaatheapoavaayaakil, ippozhuthu sollappadum saapangka'lellaam unmeal vanthu, unakkup palikkum.
nee patta'naththilum sapikkappattiruppaay, ve'liyilum sapikkappattiruppaay.
un koodaiyum, maappisaiki'ra un thottiyum sapikkappattirukkum.
un karppaththin kaniyum, un nilaththin kaniyum, un maaduka'lin perukkamum, un aaduka'lin manthaika'lum sapikkappattirukkum.
nee varukaiyilum sapikkappattiruppaay, nee poakaiyilum sapikkappattiruppaay.

ennaivittu vilaki nee seythuvaruki'ra un thurkkiriyaika'linimiththam seekkiraththil kettuppoay azhiyumattum, nee kaiyittuch seyki'rathellaavat'rilum karththar unakkuch saapaththaiyum sagnchalaththaiyum keattaiyum varappa'n'nuvaar.
nee suthantharikkum theasaththil karththar unnai nirmoolamaakkumattum ko'l'lainoay unnaip pidiththukko'l'lappa'n'nuvaar.

karththar unnai ee'laiyinaalum, kaaychchalinaalum, ush'naththinaalum, eripanthaththinaalum, va'radchiyinaalum, karukkaayinaalum, vishappaniyinaalum vaathippaar; nee azhiyumattum ivaika'l unnaip pinthodarum.
un thalaikkumealu'l'la vaanam ve'nkalamum, unakkuk keezhu'l'la poomi irumpumaay irukkum.
un theasaththu mazhaiyaik karththar puzhuthiyum ma'n'numaaka peyyappa'n'nuvaar; nee azhiyumattum appadiyea vaanaththilirunthu unmeal i'rangkivarum.

un saththurukka'lukku munpaaka nee mu'riya adikkappadumpadi karththar seyvaar; oru vazhiyaay avarka'lukku ethiraakap pu'rappaduvaay, eazhu vazhiyaay avarka'lukku munpaaka oadippoavaay; nee poomiyilu'l'la ellaa raajyangka'lilum sitha'ru'ndupoavaay.
un pi'nam aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakum; avaika'lai virattuvaarillaathiruppaarka'l.
nee ku'namaakaathapadi karththar unnai ekipthin eripanthamaana parukka'linaalum, moolaviyaathiyinaalum, so'riyinaalum, sirangkinaalum vaathippaar.
karththar unnaip puththimayakkaththinaalum, kuruttaattaththinaalum, manaththikaippinaalum vaathippaar.

kurudan anthakaaraththilea thadaviththiriki'rathupoala, nee pattappakalilea thadavikko'ndu thirivaay; un vazhika'lil on'rum unakku vaaykkaatheapoam; uthaviseyvaarillaamal nee ennaa'lum odukkappaduki'ravanum pa'rikodukki'ravanumaay iruppaay.
pe'n'nai unakku niyamippaay, vea'roruvan ava'ludan sayanippaan; veettaik kattuvaay, athilea kudiyirukkamaattaay; thiraadchaththoattaththai naattuvaay, athin palanai anupavikkamaattaay.

un maaduka'l un ka'nka'lukku munpaaka adikkappadum, nee athil on'rum pusippathillai; un kazhuthai unakku munpaakak ko'l'laiyittuk ko'ndupoakappattu, unakkuth thirumpa akappadaama'rpoam; un aaduka'l un saththurukka'lukkuk kodukkappadum, viduvippaar oruvarum unakku illaathiruppaarka'l.
un kumaararum un kumaaraththika'lum anniya janangka'lukku oppukkodukkappaduvaarka'l; avarka'laik kaa'na un ka'nka'l naadoa'rum paarththup paarththup pooththuppoam; un kaiyil pelanillaathirukkum.
un nilaththin kaniyaiyum, un pirayaasaththin ellaap palanaiyum nee a'riyaatha janangka'l pusippaarka'l; nee sakala naa'lum odukkappattum no'rukkappattum iruppaay.
un ka'nka'l kaa'num kaariyangka'linaalea mathimayangkippoavaay.
un u'l'langkaal thodangki un uchchanthalaimattum ku'namaakaathapadikku, karththar unnai muzhangkaalka'lilum thodaika'lilum kodiya eripanthap parukka'linaalea vaathippaar.

karththar unnaiyum, unakkaaka nee ea'rpaduththikko'nda raajaavaiyum, neeyum un pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha jaathika'lidaththukkup poakappa'n'nuvaar; angkea nee maramum kallumaana anniya theavarka'laich seavippaay.
karththar unnaik ko'ndupoay vidum ellaa janangka'lukku'l'lum piramippum pazhamozhiyum pariyaasach sollumaavaay.
mikuntha vithaiyai vayalukkuk ko'ndupoavaay, kogncham a'ruppaay; vettukki'li athaip padchiththuppoadum.
thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattip payiriduvaay, aanaalum nee thiraadcharasam kudippathum illai, thiraadchappazhangka'laich searppathum illai; poochchi athaith thin'rupoadum.
olivamarangka'l un ellaika'lilengkum irukkum, aanaalum athin e'n'neyai nee poosikko'lvathillai; un olivamaraththin pignchuka'l uthirnthupoam.
nee kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pe'ruvaay, aanaalum avarka'l unnoadeakooda iraarka'l; avarka'l si'raippattuppoavaarka'l.
un marangka'lellaavat'raiyum un nilaththin kanika'laiyum vittil padchiththuppoadum.
un naduvilirukki'ra anniyan unakku mea'rpattu meanmealum uyarnthiruppaan; nee mikavum thaazhththappattuppoavaay.
avan unnidaththil kadanpadaan, nee avanidaththil kadanpaduvaay; avan thalaiyaayiruppaan, nee vaalaayiruppaay.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakku vithiththa avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'lumpadi, nee avar saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaathapadiyinaal, inthach saapangka'l ellaam unmeal vanthu, nee azhiyumattum unnaith thodarnthu pidiththu,
unnilum un santhathiyilum en'raikkum adaiyaa'lamaakavum a'rputhamaakavum irukkum.
sakalamum paripoora'namaayirukkaiyil, nee manamakizhchchiyoadum ka'lippoadum un theavanaakiya karththaraich seaviyaama'rpoanathinimiththam,

sakalamum ku'raivupattu, pattiniyoadum thaakaththoadum nirvaa'naththoadum, karththar unakku viroathamaay anuppum saththurukka'laich seavippaay; avarka'l unnai azhiththuth theerumattum, iruppu nukaththadiyai un kazhuththinmeal poaduvaarka'l.
kizhavan en'ru mukampaaraamalum, vaalipan en'ru irangkaamalum irukkum kodiya mukamu'l'lathum,
unakkuth theriyaatha paashaiyaip peasuki'rathumaana jaathiyai vekuthooraththilu'l'la poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu karththar unmeal kazhuku pa'rakkum veakamaay varappa'n'nuvaar.

nee azhiyumattum antha jaathiyaan un mirukajeevanka'lin palanaiyum, un nilaththin kaniyaiyum pusippaan; avan unnai azhiththuth theerumattum un thaaniyaththilum, thiraadcharasaththilum, e'n'neyilum, un manthaika'lilu'l'la aadumaaduka'lilum unakku on'rum meethiyaaka vaikkamaattaan.

un theasamengkum nee nampiyirukkum uyaramum ara'nippumaana un mathilka'l vizhuma'lavum, avan un vaasalka'lilengkum unnai mut'rikaippoaduvaan; un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk koduththa unnudaiya theasamengkumu'l'la unnudaiya vaasalka'lthoa'rum unnai mut'rikaippoaduvaan.
un saththurukka'l unnai mut'rikaippoattu nerukkungkaalaththil, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk koduththa un karppakkaniyaana un puththirapuththirika'lin maamsaththaith thinpaay.

un saththurukka'l un vaasalka'lilengkum unnai mut'rikaippoattu nerukkungkaalaththil, unnidaththil serukkum sukaselvamumu'l'la manithan sakalaththaiyum izhanthu, than illaamaiyinaalea thaan thinnum than pi'l'laika'lin maamsaththilea,
than sakoatharanukkaakilum, than maarpil irukki'ra manaivikkaakilum, thanakku meenthirukki'ra than makka'lil oruvanukkaakilum kognchameanum kodaathapadi avarka'lmeal vanka'n'naayiruppaan.

unnidaththil sukaselvaththinaalum serukkinaalum than u'l'langkaalaith tharaiyinmeal vaikka agnchina serukkum sukaselvamumu'l'la sthiree than kaalka'lin naduvea pu'rappatta than nagnchukkodiyinimiththamum, thaan pet'ra pi'l'laika'linimiththamum, than maarpil irukki'ra purushanmealum than kumaaranmealum than kumaaraththiyinmealum vanka'n'naayiruppaa'l;
un saththurukka'l un vaasalka'lil unnai mut'rikaippoattu nerukkungkaalaththil, sakalamum ku'raivupaduvathinaal, avaika'lai irakasiyamaayth thinnuvaan.

un theavanaakiya karththar ennum makimaiyum payangkaramumaana naamaththi'rkup payappadumpadikku, nee inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra intha niyaayappiramaa'na vaarththaika'linpadiyellaam nadakkak kavanamaayiraavittaal,
