karththar neengkaatha periya vaathaika'laalum neengkaatha kodiya roakangka'laalum unnaiyum un santhathiyaiyum athisayamaay vaathiththu,
nee ka'ndu payantha ekipthu viyaathika'lellaam unmeal varuvippaar; avaika'l unnaip pat'rikko'l'lum.
intha niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyiraatha ellaap pi'niyaiyum vaathaiyaiyum nee azhiyuma'lavum karththar unmeal varappa'n'nuvaar.
thiradchiyilea vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'laippoal iruntha neengka'l, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaama'rpoanathinaal, kogncham janamaayppoaveerka'l.

karththar ungka'lukku nanmai seyyavum ungka'laip perukappa'n'navum eppadi ungka'lmeal irammiyamaayirunthaaroa, appadiyea karththar ungka'lai azhikkavum ungka'lai athampa'n'navum irammiyamaayiruppaar; neengka'l suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththilirunthu pidungkippoadappaduveerka'l.

karththar unnaip poomiyin oru munai thuvakki poomiyin ma'rumunaimattum irukki'ra ellaa janangka'lukku'l'lum sitha'ra adippaar; angkea neeyum un pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha maramum kallumaana anniya theavarka'laich seavippaay.

antha jaathika'lukku'l'lea unakku i'laippaa'ruthal iraathu, un u'l'langkaalka'l thangkith tharikka idamum iraathu; angkea karththar unakkuth thaththa'likki'ra iruthayaththaiyum, soarnthupoaki'ra ka'nka'laiyum, manachsagnchalaththaiyum koduppaar.
un jeevan unakkuch santheakaththil oosalaadum; un jeevanaippat'ri nampikkaiyillaamal iravum pakalum thikilko'ndiruppaay.

nee payappadum un iruthayaththin thikilinaalum, un ka'nka'l kaa'num kaadchiyinaalum, vidiya'rkaalaththil eppozhuthu saayangkaalam varumoa en'rum, saayangkaalaththil, eppozhuthu vidiya'rkaalam varumoa en'rum solluvaay.

inik kaa'naathiruppaay en'ru naan unakkuch sonnavazhiyaay, karththar unnaik kappalka'lilea ekipthi'rkuth thirumpak ko'ndupoakappa'n'nuvaar; angkea ungka'l saththurukka'lukku vealaikkaararaakavum vealaikkaarika'laakavum vi'rkappaduveerka'l; ungka'laik ko'lvaarum illaathiruppaarka'l en'raan.
oareapilea israveal puththiraroadea pa'n'nikko'nda udanpadikkaiyai allaamal, moavaapin theasaththilea avarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nak karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyitta vaarththaika'l ivaika'lea.

moasea isravealar ellaaraiyum varavazhaiththu, avarka'lai noakki: ekipthutheasaththil ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakap paarvoanukkum avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararukkum avanudaiya theasamuzhuvatha'rkum,
karththar seytha periya soathanaika'laiyum, periya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum, a'rputhangka'laiyum ka'n'naarak ka'ndeerka'lea.
aakilum karththar ungka'lukku u'naraththakka iruthayaththaiyum, kaa'naththakka ka'nka'laiyum, keadkaththakka kaathuka'laiyum innaa'lvaraikkum kodukkavillai.

karththaraakiya naan ungka'l theavan en'ru neengka'l a'rinthuko'l'lumpadikku, naan naa'rpathu varusham ungka'lai vanaantharaththil nadaththinean; ungka'lmealiruntha vasthiram pazhaiyathaayp poakavum illai, ungka'l kaaliliruntha paatharadchaika'l pazhaiyathaayp poakavum illai.
neengka'l appam saappidavum illai, thiraadcharasamum mathuvum kudikkavum illai en'raar.
neengka'l ivvidaththukku vanthapoathu, espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanum, paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakum nammoadea yuththagnseyyap pu'rappattaarka'l; naam avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu,
avarka'ludaiya theasaththaip pidiththu, athai roopaniyarukkum kaaththiyarukkum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththi'rkum suthantharamaakak koduththoam.
ippozhuthum neengka'l seyvathellaam ungka'lukku vaaykkumpadikku, intha udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyveerka'laaka.

un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuch sonnapadiyeayum, un pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum aa'naiyittuk koduththapadiyeayum, in'ru unnaith thamakku janamaaka ea'rpaduththikko'l'lavum, thaam unakku theavanaayirukkavum,
nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya udanpadikkaikkum in'ru avar unnoadea pa'n'nuki'ra avarudaiya aa'naiyu'ruthikkum udpadumpadikku,
ungka'l koaththirangka'lin thalaivarum ungka'l moopparum ungka'l athipathika'lum isravealin sakala purusharum,

ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum, ungka'l manaivika'lum, ungka'l paa'layaththukku'l'lirukki'ra ungka'l vi'rakukkaaranum, ungka'l tha'n'neerkkaaranumaana anniyar ellaarum in'ru ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya samukaththil ni'rki'reerka'lea.
naan ungka'loadeamaaththiram intha udanpadikkaiyaiyum intha aa'naiyaiyum u'ruthiyaiyum pa'n'naamal,
in'ru ingkea nammoadeakooda nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya samukaththil ni'rki'ravarka'loadeayum, in'ru ingkea nammoadea iraathavarka'loadeayumkooda athaip pa'n'nuki'rean.
naam ekipthu theasaththil kudiyirunthathaiyum, naam kadanthuvantha idangka'liliruntha jaathika'lin naduvil nadanthuvanthathaiyum neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'laiyum, avarka'lidaththilirukki'ra maramum kallum ve'l'liyum ponnumaana avarka'ludaiya narakalaana theavarka'laiyum ka'ndirukki'reerka'l.

aakaiyaal, antha jaathika'lin theavarka'laich seavikkap poakumpadi, in'ru nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraivittu akaluki'ra iruthayamu'l'la oru purushanaakilum sthireeyaakilum kudumpamaakilum koaththiramaakilum ungka'lil iraathapadikkum, nagnchaiyum ettiyaiyum mu'laippikki'ra yaathoru vear ungka'lil iraathapadikkum paarungka'l.

appadippattavan intha aa'naiyu'ruthiyin vaarththaika'laik keattum, thaakaththinimiththam ve'rikkak kudiththu, mana ishdappadi nadanthaalum enakkuch sukamu'ndaayirukkum en'ru than u'l'laththaith theat'rikko'ndaal, karththar avanai mannikkach siththamaayiraar.

appozhuthu karththarin koapamum erichchalum antha manithanmeal pukaiyum; inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra saapangka'lellaam avanmeal thangkum; karththar avan pearai vaanaththinkeezh iraathapadikkuk kulaiththuppoaduvaar.

intha niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra udanpadikkaiyinudaiya sakala saapangka'linpadiyum avanukkuth theengkaaka karththar israveal koaththirangka'l ellaavat'ri'rkum avanaip pu'rampaakkippoaduvaar.

appozhuthu ungka'lukkuppin ezhumpum thalaimu'raiyaana ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum, thooratheasaththilirunthu varum anniyarum, karththar intha theasaththukku varuviththa vaathaika'laiyum noayka'laiyum kaa'numpoathum,

karththar thamathu koapaththilum thamathu ukkiraththilum soathoamaiyum komoaraavaiyum athmaavaiyum sepoayeemaiyum kavizhththuppoattathupoala, intha theasaththin nilangka'lellaam vithaippum vi'laivum yaathoru poo'ndin mu'laippum illaathapadikku, kanthakaththaalum uppaalum erikkappattathaik kaa'numpoathum,
antha jaathika'lellaam karththar intha theasaththi'rku ean ippadich seythaar; intha makaa koapam pat'riyerinthatha'rkuk kaara'nam enna en'ru solluvaarka'l.
atha'rku: avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninapoathu, avarka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai avarka'l vittuppoay,
thaangka'l a'riyaamalum thangka'lukku oru palanum a'likkaamalum irukki'ra theavarka'laakiya vea'rea theavarka'laich seaviththu, avaika'laip pa'ninthuko'ndapadiyinaalea,
karththar inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra saapangka'l ellaavat'raiyum inthath theasaththinmeal varappa'n'na, athinmeal koapam moo'ndavaraaki,

avarka'laik koapaththinaalum ukkiraththinaalum makaa erichchalinaalum avarka'ludaiya theasaththilirunthu vearoadea pidungki, innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, avarka'lai vea'rea theasaththil e'rinthuvittaar en'ru sollappadum.

ma'raivaanavaika'l nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkea uriyavaika'l; ve'lippaduththappattavaika'loa, intha niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'linpadiyellaam seyyumpadikku, namakkum nammudaiya pi'l'laika'lukkum en'ren'raikkum uriyavaika'l.

naan unakku munpaaka vaiththa aaseervaathamum saapamumaakiya inthak kaariyangka'lellaam unmeal varumpoathu: nee un theavanaakiya karththaraal thuraththividappattu, ellaa jaathika'lidaththilum poayirukkumpoathu, nee un iruthayaththilea sinthanaiseythu,

un theavanaakiya karththaridaththukkea thirumpi, in'ru naan unakkuk ka'rpikki'rapadiyellaam, neeyum un pi'l'laika'lum ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ungka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum avarudaiya saththaththi'rkuch sevikoduththaal,

un theavanaakiya karththar un si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, unakku irangki, un theavanaakiya karththar unnaich sitha'ra adiththa ellaa janangka'lidaththilum irukki'ra unnaith thirumpach searththukko'l'luvaar.
unnudaiyavarka'l vaanaththin kadaiyaana thisaimattum thuraththu'ndirunthaalum, un theavanaakiya karththar angkea irukki'ra unnaik kootti, angkeayirunthu unnaik ko'nduvanthu,

un pithaakka'l suthanthariththiruntha theasaththai nee suthantharikkumpadikku, un theavanaakiya karththar athil unnaich searththu, unakku nanmaiseythu, un pithaakka'laippaarkkilum unnaip perukappa'n'nuvaar.

un theavanaakiya karththaril nee un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum anpukoornthu pizhaikkumpadi, un theavanaakiya karththar un iruthayaththaiyum un santhathiyaarin iruthayaththaiyum viruththaseathanampa'n'ni,
inthach saapangka'laiyellaam un saththurukka'lmealum unnaith thunpappaduththina un pakaignarmealum sumarappa'n'nuvaar.
neeyoa mananthirumpi, karththarin saththaththi'rkuch sevikoduththu, naan in'ru unakkuk ka'rpikki'ra avarudaiya ellaak ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum seyvaay.

appozhuthu unakku nanmai u'ndaakumpadi un theavanaakiya karththar un kaika'l seyyum ellaa vealaika'lilum, un karppaththin kaniyilum, un mirukajeevanin palanilum, un nilaththin kaniyilum unakkup paripoora'namu'ndaakach seyvaar.

un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuch sevikoduththu, intha niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'lumpoathum, un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum thirumpumpoathum, karththar un pithaakka'lmeal santhoashamaayirunthathupoala, unmealum unakku nanmai u'ndaakath thirumpavum santhoashamaayiruppaar.
naan in'ru unakku vithikki'ra katta'lai unakku ma'raiporu'lum alla, athu unakkuth thooramaanathum alla.
naangka'l athaik keattu, athinpadi seyyumporuttu, engka'lnimiththam vaanaththukku ea'ri, athai engka'lukkuk ko'nduvaruki'ravan yaaren'ru nee sollaththakkathaaka, athu vaanaththilu'l'lathum alla;

naangka'l athaik keattu, athinpadi seyyumporuttu, engka'lnimiththam samuththiraththaik kadanthu, athaik ko'nduvaruki'ravan yaar en'ru nee sollaththakkathaaka, athu samuththiraththi'rku appu'raththilu'l'lathum alla;
nee antha vaarththaiyinpadiyea seyyumporuttu, athu unakku mikavum sameepamaay un vaayilum un iruthayaththilum irukki'rathu.
ithoa, jeevanaiyum nanmaiyaiyum, mara'naththaiyum theemaiyaiyum in'ru unakku munnea vaiththean.

nee pizhaiththup perukumpadikkum, nee suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil un theavanaakiya karththar unnai aaseervathikkumpadikkum, nee un theavanaakiya karththaril anpukooravum, avar vazhika'lil nadakkavum, avar ka'rpanaika'laiyum katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'lavum, naan in'ru unakkuk ka'rpikki'rean.
nee kea'laathapadikku, manam peathiththu, izhuppu'ndupoay, vea'rea theavarka'laip pa'ninthu, avarka'laich seavippaayaanaal,
neengka'l suthantharikki'ratha'rku yoarthaanaik kadanthupoaki'ra theasaththil nedunaa'l vaazhaamal, nichchayamaay azhinthupoaveerka'l enpathai in'ru ungka'lukku a'rivikki'rean.

naan jeevanaiyum mara'naththaiyum, aaseervaathaththaiyum saapaththaiyum unakkumun vaiththean en'ru ungka'lmeal vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum in'ru saadchivaikki'rean; aakaiyaal, neeyum un santhathiyum pizhaikkumpadikku, nee jeevanaith therinthuko'ndu,

karththar un pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum koduppean en'ru avarka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa theasaththilea kudiyirukkumpadikku, un theavanaakiya karththaril anpukoornthu, avar saththaththi'rkuch sevikoduththu, avaraip pat'rikko'lvaayaaka; avarea unakku jeevanum theerkkaayusumaanavar en'raan.
pinnum moasea poay isravealar yaavaraiyum noakki:
in'ru naan noot'rirupathu vayathu'l'lavan; ini naan poakkum varaththumaayirukkakkoodaathu; intha yoarthaanai nee kadanthupoavathillai en'ru karththar ennoadea solliyirukki'raar.

un theavanaakiya karththarthaamea unakku munpaakak kadanthupoavaar, avarea unakku munnin'ru, antha theasaththaarai azhippaar; nee avarka'l theasaththaich suthantharippaay; karththar sonnapadiyea yoasuvaa unakku munpaakak kadanthupoavaan.
karththar azhiththa emoariyarin raajaakka'laakiya seekoanukkum, oakukkum, avarka'l theasaththi'rkum seythathupoalavea avarka'lukkum seyvaar.
naan ungka'lukku vithiththa katta'laika'linpadi avarka'lukkuch seyvatha'rku karththar avarka'lai ungka'lukku oppukkoduppaar.

neengka'l palangko'ndu thidamanathaayirungka'l, avarka'lukkup payappadavum thikaikkavum vea'ndaam; un theavanaakiya karththarthaamea unnoadeakooda varuki'raar; avar unnai vittu vilakuvathum illai, unnaik kaividuvathum illai en'ru sonnaan.

pinpu moasea yoasuvaavai azhaiththu, isravealar ellaarum paarththirukka, avanai noakki: palangko'ndu thidamanathaayiru; karththar ivarka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru ivarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththukku nee intha janaththai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, athai ivarka'l suthantharikkumpadi seyvaay.
karththarthaamea unakku munpaakap poaki'ravar, avar unnoadea iruppaar; avar unnai vittu vilakuvathumillai, unnaik kaividuvathumillai; nee payappadavum kalangkavum vea'ndaam en'raan.
moasea intha niyaayappiramaa'naththai ezhuthi, athaik karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra leavipuththiraraana aasaariyarukkum isravealudaiya mooppar ellaarukkum oppuviththu,
avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittathu ennaven'raal: viduthalaiyin varushamaakiya ovvoru eazhaam varushaththin mudivilea koodaarappa'ndikaiyil,

un theavanaakiya karththar therinthuko'l'lum sthaanaththil, isravealar ellaarum avarudaiya sannithiyil searnthu vanthirukkumpoathu, intha niyaayappiramaa'naththai isravealar ellaarum keadka avarka'lukku munpaaka vaasikkakkadavaay.

purusharka'lum sthireeka'lum pi'l'laika'lum un vaasalka'lilirukkum anniyarka'lum keattu, kat'rukko'ndu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthu, intha niyaayappiramaa'na vaarththaika'linpadiyellaam seyyak kavanamaayirukkumpadikkum,

athai a'riyaatha avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum keattu, neengka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthu suthantharikkappoaki'ra theasaththil uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup payappadak kat'rukko'l'lumpadikkum janaththaikkootti, athai vaasikkavea'ndum en'raan.

pinpu karththar moaseayai noakki: ithoa, nee marikkungkaalam sameepiththirukki'rathu; naan yoasuvaavukkuk katta'lai kodukkumpadi, avanai azhaiththukko'ndu, aasarippuk koodaaraththil vanthu nillungka'l en'raar; appadiyea moaseayum yoasuvaavum poay, aasarippuk koodaaraththil nin'raarka'l.
karththar koodaaraththilea meakasthampaththil tharisanamaanaar; meakasthampam koodaara vaasalmeal nin'rathu.

karththar moaseayai noakki: nee un pithaakka'loadea paduththukko'l'lappoaki'raay; intha janangka'l ezhumpi, thaangka'l poayirukkum theasaththilu'l'la anniya theavarka'laich soaramaarkkamaayp pinpat'ri, ennaivittu, thangka'ludanea naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai mee'ruvaarka'l.

annaa'lilea naan avarka'lmeal koapangko'ndu, avarka'laik kaivittu, en mukaththai avarka'lukku ma'raippean; athinaal avarka'l padchikkappadumpadikku aneaka theengkuka'lum ikkattuka'lum avarka'laith thodarum; annaa'lilea avarka'l: engka'l theavan engka'l naduvea iraathathinaalea allavaa inthath theengkuka'l engka'laith thodarnthathu enpaarka'l.
avarka'l vea'rea theavarka'lidaththil thirumpippoaych seytha sakala theemaika'linimiththamum naan annaa'lilea en mukaththai ma'raikkavea ma'raippean.

ippozhuthu neengka'l inthap paattai ezhuthikko'ndu, ithai israveal puththirarukkup padippiththu, inthap paattu enakkuch saadchiyaaka israveal puththirarukku'l'lea irukkumpadi ithai avarka'l vaayil vazhangkappa'n'nungka'l.

naan avarka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittukkoduththa paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththil avarka'laip piraveasikkappa'n'ninapinpu, avarka'l pusiththuth thirpthiyaakik kozhuththuppoayirukkumpoathu, avarka'l vea'rea theavarka'lidaththil thirumpi, avarka'laich seaviththu, enakkuk koapam mootti, en udanpadikkaiyai mee'ruvaarka'l.

aneaka theengkuka'lum ikkattuka'lum avarka'laith thodarumpoathu, avarka'l santhathiyaarin vaayil ma'ranthupoakaathirukkum inthap paattea avarka'lukku viroathamaana saadchipakarum; naan aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththil avarka'laip piraveasikkappa'n'naathirukki'ra ippozhuthea avarka'l ko'ndirukkum e'n'nam innathu en'ru a'rivean en'raar.
an'raikkea moasea anthap paattai ezhuthi, athai israveal puththirarukkup padippiththaan.

avar noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavai noakki: nee palangko'ndu thidamanathaayiru, israveal puththirarukku naan aa'naiyittukkoduththa theasaththil nee avarka'lai nadaththikko'ndupoavaay; naan unnoadiruppean en'ru katta'laiyittaar.
moasea intha niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'l muzhuvathaiyum oru pusthakaththil ezhuthi mudiththapinpu,
moasea karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra leaviyarai noakki:

neengka'l intha niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththai eduththu, athai ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyin pakkaththilea vaiyungka'l; angkea athu unakku viroathamaana saadchiyaayirukkum.

naan un kalakakku'naththaiyum un kadinak kazhuththaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean; in'ru naan innum ungka'ludan uyiroadirukkaiyil, karththarukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'nineerka'lea; en mara'naththi'rkuppinpu evva'lavu athikamaayk kalakampa'n'nuveerka'l!

ungka'l koaththirangka'lilu'l'la mooppar ungka'l athipathika'l ellaarudaiya kaathuka'lum keadkaththakkathaaka naan intha vaarththaika'laich sollavum, avarka'lukku viroathamaaka vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum saadchivaikkavum avarka'lai ennidaththil koodivarachseyyungka'l.

en mara'naththi'rkuppinpu neengka'l nichchayamaay ungka'laik keduththu, naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta vazhiyai vittu vilakuveerka'l; aakaiyaal, kadaisi naadka'lil theengku ungka'lukku nearidum; ungka'l kaikkiriyaika'linaalea karththaraik koapappaduththumpadikku, avar paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyveerka'l enpathai a'rivean en'ru solli,
israveal sapaiyaar ellaarum keadka moasea inthap paattin vaarththaika'lai mudiyumvaraiyum sonnaan.
vaanangka'lea, sevikodungka'l, naan peasuvean; poomiyea, en vaaymozhika'laik keadpaayaaka.
mazhaiyaanathu i'lampayirinmeal pozhivathupoala, en upatheasam pozhiyum; paniththu'lika'l pullinmeal i'rangkuvathupoala, en vasanam i'rangkum.
karththarudaiya naamaththai pirasiththampa'n'nuvean; nammudaiya theavanukku makaththuvaththaich seluththungka'l.
avar kanmalai; avar kiriyai uththamamaanathu; avar vazhika'lellaam niyaayam, avar niyaayakkeadillaatha saththiyamu'l'la theavan; avar neethiyum semmaiyumaanavar.
avarka'loa thangka'laik keduththukko'ndaarka'l, avarka'l avarudaiya pi'l'laika'l alla; ithuvea avarka'l kaariyam; avarka'l maa'rupaadum thaa'rumaa'rumu'l'la santhathiyaar.
viveakamillaatha mathiketta janangka'lea, ippadiyaa karththarukkup pathila'likki'reerka'l. unnai aadko'nda pithaa avarallavaa? unnai u'ndaakki unnai nilaippaduththinavar avarallavaa?

poorvanaadka'lai ninai; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaych sen'ra varushangka'laik kavaniththuppaar; un thakappanaik kea'l, avan unakku a'rivippaan; un moopparka'laik kea'l, avarka'l unakkuch solluvaarka'l.

unnathamaanavar jaathika'lukkuch suthantharangka'laip pangkittu, aathaamin puththirarai vevvea'raayp piriththakaalaththil, israveal puththirarudaiya thokaikkuththakkathaay, sarvajanangka'lin ellaika'laith thittampa'n'ninaar.
karththarudaiya janamea avarudaiya pangku; yaakkoapu avarudaiya suthantharaveetham.

paazhaana nilaththilum oo'laiyiduthalu'l'la ve'rumaiyaana avaantharave'liyilum avar avanaik ka'ndupidiththaar, avanai nadaththinaar, avanai u'narththinaar, avanaith thamathu ka'nma'niyaippoalak kaaththaru'linaar.
kazhuku than koottaik kalaiththu, than kugnchuka'linmeal asaivaadi, than settaika'lai viriththu, avaika'lai eduththu, avaika'laith than settaika'linmeal sumanthuko'ndupoaki'rathu poala,
karththar oruvarea avanai vazhinadaththinaar; anniya theavan avaroadea irunthathillai.

poomiyilu'l'la uyarntha sthaanangka'linmeal avanai ea'rivarappa'n'ninaar; vayalil vi'laiyum palanai avanukkup pusikkak koduththaar; kanmalaiyilu'l'la theanaiyum, ka'rpaa'raiyilirunthu vadiyum e'n'neyaiyum avan u'n'numpadi seythaar.

pasuvin ve'n'neyaiyum, aattin paalaiyum, paasaanil meayum aattukkuttika'l aattukkadaakka'l ve'l'laattukkadaakka'l ivaika'ludaiya kozhuppaiyum, kozhumaiyaana koathumaiyaiyum, iraththampoan'ra suyamaana thiraadcharasaththaiyum saappittaay.
yeshooran kozhuththuppoay uthaiththaan; kozhuththu, sthooliththu, ni'nam thunninapoathu, thannai u'ndaakkina theavanai vittu, than radchippin kanmalaiyai asattaipa'n'ninaan.
anniya theavarka'laal avarukku erichchalai moottinaarka'l; aruvaruppaanavaika'linaal avaraik koapappaduththinaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanukkup paliyidavillai; thaangka'l a'riyaathavaika'lum, thangka'l pithaakka'l payappadaathavaika'lum, noothanamaayth thoan'riya puthu theyvangka'lumaakiya peayka'lukkea paliyittaarka'l.
unnai jenippiththa kanmalaiyai nee ninaiyaama'rpoanaay; unnaip pet'ra theavanai ma'ranthaay.
karththar athaik ka'ndu, thamathu kumaararum thamathu kumaaraththika'lum thammaik koapappaduththinathinimiththam manamadivaaki, avarka'laip pu'rakka'niththu:
en mukaththai avarka'lukku ma'raippean; avarka'ludaiya mudivu eppadiyirukkum en'ru paarppean; avarka'l makaa maa'rupaadu'l'la santhathi; u'nmaiyillaatha pi'l'laika'l.

theyvam allaathavaika'linaal enakku erichchalai mootti, thangka'l maayaika'linaal ennaik koapappaduththinaarka'l; aakaiyaal mathikkappadaatha janangka'linaal avarka'lukku erichchalai u'ndaakki, mathiketta jaathiyinaal avarka'laik koapappaduththuvean.
en koapaththinaal akkini pat'rikko'ndathu, athu thaazhntha narakamattum eriyum; athu poomiyaiyum athin palanaiyum azhiththu, parvathangka'lin asthipaarangka'lai veakappa'n'num.
theengkuka'lai avarka'lmeal kuvippean; ennudaiya ampuka'laiyellaam avarka'lmeal pirayoakippean.

avarka'l pasiyinaal vaadi, eripanthamaana ush'naththinaalum, kodiya vaathaiyinaalum maa'ndupoavaarka'l; thushda mirukangka'lin pa'rka'laiyum, tharaiyil oorum paampuka'lin vishaththaiyum avarka'lukku'l anuppuvean.
ve'liyilea pattayamum, u'l'lea payangkaramum, vaalipanaiyum kanniyaiyum kuzhanthaiyaiyum naraiththa kizhavanaiyum azhikkum.
engka'l kai uyarnthathen'rum, karththar ithaiyellaam seyyavillai en'rum avarka'ludaiya pakaignar thappe'n'nangko'ndu solluvaarka'l en'ru,
naan saththuruvin kuroathaththi'rku agnchaathiruntheanaanaal, naan avarka'lai moolaikkumoolai sitha'ra adiththu, manitharukku'l avarka'ludaiya peyar at'rup poakappa'n'nuvean en'ru solliyiruppean.
avarka'l yoasanaiketta jaathi, avarka'lukku u'narvu illai.
avarka'l gnaanamadainthu, ithai u'narnthu, thangka'l mudivaich sinthiththukko'ndaal nalamaayirukkum en'raar.
avarka'ludaiya kanmalai avarka'lai vi'rkaamalum, karththar avarka'lai oppukkodaamalum irunthaaraanaal, oruvan aayirampearaith thuraththi, ira'ndupear pathinaayirampearai oattuvatheppadi?
thangka'l kanmalai nammudaiya kanmalaiyaippoal alla en'ru nammudaiya saththurukka'lea theermaanikki'raarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya thiraadchachsedi, soathoamilum komoaraa nilangka'lilum payiraana thiraadchachsediyilum thaazhntha jaathiyaayirukki'rathu, avaika'lin pazhangka'l piththum avaika'lin kulaika'l kasappumaay irukki'rathu.
avarka'ludaiya thiraadcharasam valusarppangka'lin vishamum viriyan paampuka'lin kodiya vishamumaanathu.
ithu ennidaththil vaiththuvaikkappattu, en pokkishangka'lil ithu muththirai poadappattirukki'rathillaiyoa?

pazhivaangkuvathum pathila'lippathum enakku uriyathu; eat'rakaalaththil avarka'ludaiya kaal tha'l'laadum; avarka'ludaiya aapaththunaa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu; avarka'lukku nearidum kaariyangka'l theeviriththu varum.

karththar thammudaiya janangka'lai niyaayantheerththu, avarka'l pelan poayit'ren'rum, adaikkappattavarka'laavathu viduthalai pet'ravarka'laavathu oruvarum illaiyen'rum kaa'numpoathu, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararmeal parithaapappaduvaar.
appozhuthu avar: avarka'l paliyitta palika'lin kozhuppaith thin'ru, paanapalika'lin thiraadcharasaththaik kudiththa avarka'ludaiya theyvangka'lum avarka'l nampina kanmalaiyum engkea?
avaika'l ezhunthu ungka'lukkuch sakaayampa'n'ni ungka'lukku ma'raividamaayirukkattum.

naan naanea avar, ennoadea vea'rea theavan illai enpathai ippozhuthu paarungka'l; naan kolluki'rean, naan uyirppikki'rean; naan kaayappaduththuki'rean, naan sosthappaduththuki'rean; en kaikkuth thappuvippaar illai.
naan en karaththai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka uyarththi, naan en'ren'raikkum jeeviththirukki'ravar enki'rean.
minnum en pattayaththai naan karukkaakki, en kaiyaanathu niyaayaththaip pidiththukko'l'lumaanaal, en saththurukka'lidaththil pazhivaangki, ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'lukkup pathila'lippean.
kolaiyu'ndum si'raippattum poanavarka'ludaiya iraththaththaalea en ampuka'lai ve'riko'l'lappa'n'nuvean; en pattayam thalaivar mutha'rko'ndu sakala saththurukka'lin maamsaththaiyum padchikkum.

jaathika'lea, avarudaiya janangka'loadeakoodak ka'likoorungka'l; avar thamathu oozhiyakkaararin iraththaththi'rkup pazhivaangki, thammudaiya saththurukka'lukkup pathila'liththu, thamathu theasaththinmealum thamathu janangka'linmealum kirupaiyu'l'lavaraavaar.
moaseayum noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum vanthu, inthap paattin vaarththaika'laiyellaam janangka'l keadkaththakkathaakach sonnaarka'l.
moasea intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam isravealar yaavarukkum solli mudiththapinpu,

avarka'lai noakki: intha niyaayappiramaa'na vaarththaika'linpadiyellaam ungka'l pi'l'laika'l seyyumpadi kavanamaayirukka, neengka'l avarka'lukkuk ka'rpikkumpadi, naan in'ru ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaay oppuvikki'ra vaarththaika'laiyellaam ungka'l manathilea vaiyungka'l.

ithu ungka'lukku viyarththamaana kaariyam allavea; ithu ungka'l jeevanaayirukki'rathu, neengka'l suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi yoarthaanaik kadanthupoaych searum theasaththil ithinaal ungka'l naadka'lai needikkappa'n'nuveerka'l en'raan.
antha naa'lileathaanea karththar moaseayai noakki:

nee erikoavukku ethiraana moavaap theasaththilu'l'la intha apaareem ennum malaika'lilirukki'ra neapoa parvathaththil ea'ri, naan israveal santhathiyaarukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakak kodukkum kaanaan theasaththaip paar;

neengka'l seen vanaantharaththilu'l'la kaatheasilea mearipaavin tha'n'neer sameepaththil israveal puththirarukku'l'lea ennaip parisuththampa'n'naamal, avarka'l naduvea en katta'laika'lai mee'rinathinaalea,
un sakoatharanaakiya aaroan oar ennum malaiyilea mariththu, than janaththaaridaththil searkkappattathupoala neeyum ea'rappoaki'ra malaiyilea mariththu, un janaththaaridaththil searkkappaduvaay.
naan israveal puththirarukkuk kodukkappoaki'ra ethireayirukki'ra theasaththai nee paarppaay; aanaalum atha'rku'l nee piraveasippathillai en'raar.
theavanudaiya manushanaakiya moasea thaan mara'namadaiyumunnea israveal puththirarai aaseervathiththa aaseervaathamaavathu:

karththar seenaayilirunthu ezhuntharu'li, seayeerilirunthu avarka'lukku uthayamaanaar; paaraan malaiyilirunthu pirakaasiththu, pathinaayirangka'laana parisuththavaanka'loadea pirasannamaanaar; avarka'lukkaaka akkinimayamaana piramaa'nam avarudaiya valathukaraththilirunthu pu'rappattathu.

meyyaakavea avar janangka'laich sineakikki'raar; avarudaiya parisuththavaanka'l ellaarum ummudaiya kaiyil irukki'raarka'l; avarka'l ummudaiya paathaththil vizhunthu, ummudaiya vaarththaika'linaal poathanaiyadaivaarka'l.
moasea namakku oru niyaayappiramaa'naththaik ka'rpiththaan; athu yaakkoapin sapaikkuch suthantharamaayit'ru.
janangka'lin thalaivarum isravealin koaththirangka'lum koottangkoodinapoathu avar yeshooranukku raajaavaayirunthaar.
roopan saavaamal pizhaippaanaaka; avan janam kognchamaayiraathu en'raan.

avan yoothaavaikku'riththu: karththaavea, yoothaavin saththaththaik keattu, avan than janaththoadea thirumpach searappa'n'num; avan kai palakkakkadavathu; avanudaiya saththurukka'lukku avanai neengkalaakki viduvikki'ra sakaayaraayiruppeeraaka en'raan.
leaviyaikku'riththu: nee maasaavilea pareedchaipaarththu, mearipaavin tha'n'neeridaththil vaakkuvaathampa'n'nina un parisuththa purushan vasamaay unnudaiya thummeem ooreem enpavaika'l iruppathaaka.

than thakappanukkum than thaaykkum: naan ungka'laip paarean en'ru solli, than sakoathararai angkikariyaamal, than pi'l'laika'laiyum a'riyaamalirukki'ravan vasamaay avaika'l iruppathaaka; avarka'l ummudaiya vaarththaika'laik kaikko'ndu, ummudaiya udanpadikkaiyaik kaakki'ravarka'l.

avarka'l yaakkoapukku ummudaiya niyaayangka'laiyum, isravealukku ummudaiya piramaa'naththaiyum poathiththu, umathu sannithaanaththilea thoopavarkkaththaiyum, umathu palipeedaththinmeal sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum iduvaarka'l.

karththaavea, avan sampaththai aaseervathiththu, avan kaikkiriyaiyinmeal piriyamaayirum; avanaip pakaiththu avanukku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'l thirumpa ezhunthiraathapadi avarka'ludaiya iduppuka'lai no'rukkividum en'raan.
penyameenaikku'riththu: karththarukkup piriyamaanavan, avaroadea sukamaayth thangkiyiruppaan; avanai ennaa'lum avar kaappaat'ri, avan ellaikku'l'lea vaasamaayiruppaar en'raan.
yoaseappaikku'riththu: karththaraal avanudaiya theasam aaseervathikkappaduvathaaka; athu vaanaththin selvaththinaalum, paniyinaalum, aazhaththilu'l'la neeroot'ruka'linaalum,
sooriyan pakkuvappaduththum arumaiyaana kanika'linaalum, santhiran pakkuvappaduththum arumaiyaana palanka'linaalum,
aathiparvathangka'lil u'ndaakum thiraviyangka'linaalum, niththiya malaika'lil pi'rakkum arumporu'lka'linaalum,

naadum athin ni'raivum kodukkum arumaiyaana thaaniyangka'linaalum aaseervathikkappaduvathaaka. mudchediyil ezhuntharu'linavarin thayai yoaseappudaiya sirasinmealum, than sakoathararil viseashiththavanudaiya uchchanthalaiyinmealum varuvathaaka.

avan alangkaaram avan thalaiyeet'ruk kaa'laiyinudaiya alangkaaraththaippoalavum, avan kompuka'l kaa'ndaamirukaththin kompuka'laippoalavum irukkum; avaika'laalea janangka'lai eakamaay theasaththin kadaiyaantharangka'lmattum muttith thuraththuvaan; avaika'l eppiraayeemin pathinaayirangka'lum manaaseayin aayirangka'lumaanavaika'l en'raan.
sepuloanaikku'riththu: sepuloanea, nee ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoakaiyilum, isakkaarea, nee un koodaarangka'lil thangkukaiyilum santhoashamaayiru.

janangka'lai avarka'l malaiyinmeal varavazhaiththu, angkea neethiyin palika'lai iduvaarka'l; kadalka'lilu'l'la sampoora'naththaiyum ma'nalukku'l'lea ma'rainthirukkum poru'lka'laiyum anupavippaarka'l en'raan.
kaaththaikku'riththu: kaaththukku visthaaramaana idaththaik kodukki'ravar sthoaththirikkappattavar; avan singkaththaippoal thangkiyirunthu, puyaththaiyum uchchanthalaiyaiyum pee'rippoaduvaan.

avan thanakkaaka muthal idaththaip paarththukko'ndaan; angkea thanakku niyaayappiramaa'nikan koduththa pangku paththiramaayirukki'rathu; aanaalum avan janaththin munna'niyaay vanthu, mat'ra isravealudanea karththarin neethiyaiyum avarudaiya niyaayangka'laiyum nadappippaan en'raan.
thaa'naikku'riththu: thaa'n oru paalasingkam, avan paasaanilirunthu paayvaan en'raan.

napthaliyaikku'riththu: napthali karththarudaiya thayavinaalea thirpthiyadainthu, avarudaiya aaseervaathaththinaalea ni'rainthiruppaan. nee meat'risaiyaiyum thenthisaiyaiyum suthanthariththukko'l en'raan.
aasearaikku'riththu: aasear puththirapaakkiyamudaiyavanaay, than sakoathararukkup piriyamaayirunthu, than kaalai e'n'neyilea thoayppaan.
irumpum ve'nkalamum un paatharadchaiyin keezhirukkum; un naadka'lukkuththakkathaay un pelanum irukkum en'raan.
yeshooranudaiya theavanaippoal oruvarum illai; avar unakkuch sakaayamaay vaanangka'linmealum thamathu maadchimaiyoadu aakaayama'ndalangka'lin mealum ea'rivaruki'raar.
anaathi theavanea unakku adaikkalam; avarudaiya niththiya puyangka'l unakku aathaaram; avar unakku munnin'ru saththurukka'laith thuraththi, avarka'lai azhiththuppoadu en'ru katta'laiyiduvaar.
israveal sukamaayth thaniththu vaasampa'n'nuvaan; yaakkoapin oot'raanathu thaaniyamum thiraadcharasamumu'l'la theasaththilea irukkum; avarudaiya vaanamum paniyaip peyyum.

isravealea, nee paakkiyavaan; karththaraal radchikkappatta janamea, unakku oppaanavan yaar? unakkuch sakaayagnseyyum keadakamum unakku makimaiporunthiya pattayamum avarea; un saththurukka'l unakku ichchakam peasi adangkuvaarka'l; avarka'l meaduka'lai mithippaay, en'ru sonnaan.

pinpu moasea moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lilirunthu erikoavukku ethiraana neapoa malaiyilirukkum piskaavin kodumudiyil ea'rinaan; appozhuthu karththar avanukku, thaa'nmattumu'l'la keeleayaath theasam anaiththaiyum,
napthali theasam anaiththaiyum, eppiraayeem manaasea enpavarka'lin theasaththaiyum, kadaisich samuththiramvaraikkumu'l'la yoothaa theasam anaiththaiyum,
thenpu'raththaiyum, soavaar varaikkumu'l'la peareechchamarangka'lin patta'nam ennum oormutha'rko'ndu erikoavin pa'l'laththaakkaakiya samanaana poomiyaiyum kaa'npiththaar.

appozhuthu karththar avanai noakki: naan ungka'l santhathikkuk koduppean en'ru aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum aa'naiyitta theasam ithuthaan, ithai un ka'n kaa'numpadi seythean; aanaalum nee avvidaththi'rkuk kadanthupoavathillai en'raar.
appadiyea karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea moavaap theasamaana avvidaththilea karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea mariththaan.
avar avanai moavaap theasaththilu'l'la pethpeayoarukku ethiraana pa'l'laththaakkilea adakkampa'n'ninaar. innaa'lvaraikkum oruvanum avan pireathakkuzhiyai a'riyaan.
moasea marikki'rapoathu noot'rirupathu vayathaayirunthaan; avan ka'n iru'ladaiyavumillai, avan pelan ku'raiyavumillai.
israveal puththirar moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil moaseakkaaka muppathu naa'l azhuthuko'ndirunthaarka'l; moaseakkaaka azhuthu thukkangko'ndaadina naadka'l mudinthathu.

moasea noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavinmeal than kaika'lai vaiththapadiyinaal avan gnaanaththin aaviyinaal ni'raiyappattaan; israveal puththirar avanukkuk keezhppadinthu, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythaarka'l.

moasea ekipthutheasaththilea paarvoanukkum, avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararukkum, avanudaiya theasam anaiththi'rkum seyyumpadi karththar avanai anuppich seyviththa sakala adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum,
avan isravealar ellaarukkum piraththiyadchamaaych seytha sakala vallamaiyaana kiriyaika'laiyum, makaa payangkaramaana seykaika'laiyum paarththaal,
karththarai mukamukamaay a'rintha moaseayaippoala, oru theerkkatharisiyum isravealil appu'ram ezhumpinathillai en'ru vi'langkum.
karththarudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea mariththapinpu, karththar moaseayin oozhiyakkaaranaana noonin kumaaran yoasuvaavai noakki:
en thaasanaakiya moasea mariththuppoanaan; ippozhuthu neeyum intha janangka'l ellaarum ezhunthu, intha yoarthaanaik kadanthu, israveal puththirarukku naan kodukkum theasaththukkup poangka'l.
naan moaseakkuch sonnapadi ungka'l kaaladi mithikkum evvidaththaiyum ungka'lukkuk koduththean.

vanaantharamum intha leepanoanum thodangki aipiraaththu nathiyaana periya nathimattumu'l'la eaththiyarin theasam anaiththum, sooriyan asthamikki'ra thisaiyaana periya samuththiramvaraikkum ungka'l ellaiyaayirukkum.
nee uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam oruvanum unakku munpaaka ethirththu ni'rpathillai; naan moaseayoadea irunthathupoala, unnoadum iruppean; naan unnaivittu vilakuvathumillai, unnaik kaividuvathumillai.
palangko'ndu thidamanathaayiru; intha janaththin pithaakka'lukku naan koduppean en'ru aa'naiyitta theasaththai nee ivarka'lukkup pangkiduvaay.

en thaasanaakiya moasea unakkuk ka'rpiththa niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyellaam seyyak kavanamaayirukkamaaththiram mikavum palangko'ndu thidamanathaayiru; nee poakum idamellaam puththimaanaay nadanthuko'l'lumpadikku, athai vittu valathu idathupu'ram vilakaathiruppaayaaka.

intha niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakam un vaayaivittup piriyaathiruppathaaka; ithil ezhuthiyirukki'ravaika'linpadiyellaam nee seyyak kavanamaayirukkumpadi, iravum pakalum athaith thiyaaniththuk ko'ndiruppaayaaka; appozhuthu nee un vazhiyai vaaykkappa'n'nuvaay, appozhuthu puththimaanaayum nadanthuko'l'luvaay.
naan unakkuk katta'laiyidavillaiyaa? palangko'ndu thidamanathaayiru; thikaiyaathea, kalangkaathea, nee poakum idamellaam un theavanaakiya karththar unnoadea irukki'raar en'raar.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa janangka'lin athipathika'lai noakki:

neengka'l paa'layaththai uruva nadanthupoay, janangka'laip paarththu: ungka'lukku poajanapathaarththangka'lai aayaththampa'n'nungka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch suthantharikkak kodukkum theasaththai neengka'l suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadikku, innum moon'runaa'laikku'l'lea intha yoarthaanaik kadanthupoaveerka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.
pinpu yoasuvaa: roopaniyaraiyum kaaththiyaraiyum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaaraiyum noakki:

karththarudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea ungka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa vaarththaiyai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lai i'laippaa'rappa'n'ni, intha theasaththai ungka'lukkuk koduththaarea.

ungka'l pe'nsaathika'lum pi'l'laika'lum mirukajeevanka'lum, moasea ungka'lukku yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilea koduththa theasaththil irukkattum; ungka'lilu'l'la yuththaveerar yaavarum ungka'l sakoathararukku munpaaka a'niya'niyaayk kadanthupoay,

karththar ungka'laippoala ungka'l sakoathararaiyum i'laippaa'rappa'n'ni, avarka'lum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thangka'lukkuk kodukkum theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumattum, avarka'lukku uthaviseyyakkadaveerka'l; pinpu neengka'l karththarudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea ungka'lukku yoarthaanukku ippu'raththil sooriyan uthikkum thisaikku nearaakak koduththa ungka'l suthantharamaana theasaththukkuth thirumpi, athaich suthanthariththukko'ndiruppeerka'laaka en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l yoasuvaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer engka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduki'rathaiyellaam seyvoam; neer engka'lai anuppum idamengkum poavoam.
naangka'l moaseakkuch sevikoduththathupoala umakkum sevikoduppoam; ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarmaaththiram moaseayoadea irunthathupoala, ummoadum iruppaaraaka.

neer engka'lukkuk katta'laiyidum sakala kaariyaththilum ummudaiya sollaik kea'laamal, ummudaiya vaakkukku murattaattampa'n'nuki'ra evanum kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; palangko'ndu thidamanathaaymaaththiram irum en'raarka'l.

noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa siththeemilirunthu veavukaararaakiya ira'ndu manusharai irakasiyamaay veavupaarkkumpadi anuppi: neengka'l poay theasaththaiyum erikoavaiyum paarththuvaarungka'l en'raan. avarka'l poay, raakaap ennum peyarko'nda veasiyin veettukku'l piraveasiththu, angkea thangkinaarka'l.
theasaththai veavupaarkkumpadi, israveal puththiraril sila manushar intha raaththiriyilea ingkea vanthaarka'l en'ru erikoavin raajaavukkuch sollappattathu.

appozhuthu erikoavin raajaa raakaapa'ndaikku aa'l anuppi: unnidaththil vanthu, un veettukku'l piraveasiththa manusharai ve'liyea ko'nduvaa; avarka'l theasaththaiyellaam veavupaarkkumpadi vanthaarka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.
antha sthiree avvira'ndu manusharaiyum ko'ndupoay avarka'lai o'liththuvaiththu: meythaan, ennidaththil manushar vanthirunthaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l evvidaththaaroa enakkuth theriyaathu.

vaasalai adaikkum nearaththil iruttuvea'laiyilea, antha manushar pu'rappattup poayvittaarka'l; avarka'l engkea poanaarka'loa enakkuth theriyaathu; avarka'laich seekkiramaayp poayth theadungka'l; neengka'l avarka'laip pidiththukko'l'lalaam en'raa'l.
ava'l avarka'lai veettinmeal ea'rappa'n'ni, veettinmeal parappappatta sa'nal thattaika'lukku'l'lea ma'raiththu vaiththirunthaa'l.
antha manushar yoarthaanukkup poaki'ra vazhiyil thu'raika'lmattum avarka'laith theadappoanaarka'l; avarka'laith theaduki'ravarka'l pu'rappattavudanea vaasal adaikkappattathu.
antha manushar paduththukko'l'lumunnea ava'l veettinmeal avarka'lidaththi'rku ea'rippoay,

karththar ungka'lukku theasaththai oppukkoduththaaren'rum, ungka'laippat'ri engka'lukkuth thikil pidiththirukki'rathen'rum, ungka'laikku'riththu theasaththuk kudika'l ellaarum soarnthupoanaarka'len'rum a'rivean.

neengka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapoathu, karththar ungka'lukku munpaakach sivantha samuththiraththin tha'n'neerai vat'rippoakappa'n'ninathaiyum, neengka'l yoarthaanukku appu'raththil sangkaaram pa'n'nina emoariyarin ira'ndu raajaakka'laakiya seekoanukkum oakukkum seythathaiyum kea'lvippattoam.

kea'lvippattapoathu engka'l iruthayam karainthupoayit'ru, ungka'laalea ellaarudaiya thairiyamum at'ruppoayit'ru; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarea uyara vaanaththilum keezhea poomiyilum theavanaanavar.
ippoathum, naan ungka'lukkuth thayavuseythapadiyinaal, neengka'lum en thakappan kudumpaththukkuth thayavuseyvoam en'ru karththarpearil enakku aa'naiyittu,

neengka'l en thakappanaiyum en thaayaiyum en sakoathararaiyum en sakoatharika'laiyum avarka'lukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum uyiroadea vaiththu, engka'l jeevanaich saavukkuth thappuvikkumpadi, enakku nichchayamaana adaiyaa'laththaik kodukkavea'ndum en'raa'l.

appozhuthu antha manushar ava'lai noakki: engka'l jeevanea ungka'l jeevanukku eedu; neengka'l engka'l kaariyaththai ve'lippaduththaathirunthaal, karththar engka'lukkuth theasaththaik kodukkumpoathu, naangka'l thayaiyum saththiyamum paaraattuvoam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'laik kayit'rinaalea jannalvazhiyaay i'rakkivittaa'l; ava'l veedu alangkaththin mathilil irunthathu; alangkaththilea ava'l kudiyirunthaa'l.

appozhuthu ava'l avarka'lai noakki: theaduki'ravarka'l ungka'laik kaa'naathapadikku, neengka'l malaiyilea poay, avarka'l thirumpivarumattum angkea moon'runaa'l o'liththirunthu, pinpu ungka'l vazhiyea poangka'l en'raa'l.

appozhuthu antha manushar ava'lai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l theasaththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, nee inthach sivappunool kayit'rai engka'lai i'rakkivitta jannalilea katti, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum un sakoathararka'laiyum un thakappan kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum unnidaththil un veettilea searththukko'l.
illaavittaal nee engka'l kaiyil vaangkina aa'naikku neengkalaayiruppoam.

evanaakilum un veettu vaasalka'lilirunthu ve'liyea pu'rappattaal, avanudaiya iraththappazhi avan thalaiyinmeal irukkum; engka'lmeal kut'ram illai; unnoadea veettil irukki'ra evanmealaakilum kaipoadappattatheayaakil, avanudaiya iraththappazhi engka'l thalaiyinmeal irukkum.
nee engka'l kaariyaththai ve'lippaduththinaayeayaanaal, nee engka'l kaiyil vaangkina aa'naikku neengkalaayiruppoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku ava'l: ungka'l vaarththaiyinpadiyea aakakkadavathu en'ru solli, avarka'lai anuppivittaa'l; avarka'l poayvittaarka'l; pinpu ava'l anthach sivappuk kayit'rai jannalilea kattivaiththaa'l.
avarka'l poay, malaiyilea searnthu, theaduki'ravarka'l thirumpivarumattum, moon'runaa'l angkea thariththirunthaarka'l; theaduki'ravarka'l vazhiyilellaam avarka'laith theadiyum kaa'naatheapoanaarka'l.
antha ira'ndu manusharum thirumpi, malaiyilirunthu i'rangki, aat'raikkadanthu, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavinidaththil vanthu, thangka'lukkuch sampaviththa yaavaiyum avanukkuth theriviththu;
karththar theasaththaiyellaam nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; theasaththin kudika'lellaam namakkumunpaakach soarnthupoanaarka'l en'ru avanoadea sonnaarka'l.

athikaalamea yoasuvaa ezhunthiruntha pinpu, avanum israveal puththirar anaivarum siththeemilirunthu pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, yoarthaanmattum vanthu, athaik kadanthupoakumunnea angkea iraaththangkinaarka'l.
moon'runaa'l sen'rapinpu, athipathika'l paa'layam engkum poay,

janangka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaiyum athaich sumakki'ra leaviyaraakiya aasaariyarka'laiyum ka'ndavudanea, neengka'lum ungka'l idaththaivittup pirayaa'nappattu, atha'rkup pinsellungka'l.

ungka'lukkum atha'rkum idaiyilea ira'ndaayiram muzhath thooramaana idam irukkavea'ndum; neengka'l nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai a'riyumpadikku, atha'rkuch sameepamaay varaathiruppeerka'laaka; itha'rku munnea neengka'l orupoathum intha vazhiyaay nadanthupoakavillai en'ru solli katta'laiyittaarka'l.
yoasuvaa janangka'lai noakki: ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l; naa'laikkuk karththar ungka'l naduvilea a'rputhangka'laich seyvaar en'raan.

pinpu yoasuvaa aasaariyarka'lai noakki: neengka'l udanpadikkaip pettiyai eduththukko'ndu, janangka'lukku munnea nadanthupoangka'l en'raan; appadiyea udanpadikkaip pettiyai eduththukko'ndu janangka'lukku munnea poanaarka'l.
karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: naan moaseayoadea irunthathupoala, unnoadum irukki'rean enpathai isravealarellaarum a'riyumpadikku, in'ru avarka'l ka'nka'lukkumunpaaka unnai meanmaippaduththuvean.
udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyaraip paarththu: neengka'l yoarthaan tha'n'neer oaraththil searumpoathu, yoarthaanil nillungka'l en'ru nee katta'laiyiduvaayaaka en'raar.
yoasuvaa israveal puththirarai noakki: neengka'l ingkea searnthu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l en'raan.

pinpu yoasuvaa: jeevanu'l'la theavan ungka'l naduvea irukki'raar enpathaiyum, avar kaanaaniyaraiyum eaththiyaraiyum eaviyaraiyum perisiyaraiyum kirkaasiyaraiyum emoariyaraiyum epoosiyaraiyum ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththividuvaar enpathaiyum, neengka'l a'rinthuko'lvatha'rku adaiyaa'lamaaka:
ithoa, sarva poomikkum aa'ndavaraayirukki'ravarudaiya udanpadikkaip petti ungka'lukku munnea yoarthaanilea poaki'rathu.
ippozhuthum israveal koaththirangka'lilea pannira'ndupearai, ovvoru koaththiraththukku ovvoruvaraakap piriththedungka'l.

sampavippathu ennaven'raal, sarva poomikkum aa'ndavaraakiya karththarin pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyarka'lin u'l'langkaalka'l yoarthaanin tha'n'neerilea pattamaaththiraththil, mealeayirunthu oadivaruki'ra yoarthaanin tha'n'neer oadaamal oru kuviyalaaka ni'rkum en'raan.

janangka'l yoarthaanaik kadanthupoakath thangka'l koodaarangka'lilirunthu pu'rappattaarka'l; aasaariyarka'l udanpadikkaip pettiyai janangka'lukku munnea sumanthuko'ndupoay, yoarthaanmattum vanthaarka'l.
yoarthaan a'ruppukkaalam muzhuvathum karaipura'ndupoam. pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyarka'lin kaalka'l tha'n'neerin oaraththil pattavudanea,

mealeayirunthu oadivaruki'ra tha'n'neer nin'ru saarthaanukkaduththa aathaam oorvaraikkum oru kuviyalaakak kuvinthathu; uppukkadal ennum samanaana ve'liyin kadalukku oadivaruki'ra tha'n'neer pirinthu oadit'ru; appozhuthu janangka'l erikoavukku ethirea kadanthupoanaarka'l.

sakala janangka'lum yoarthaanaik kadanthu theeruma'lavum, karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyarka'l yoarthaanin naduvilea tha'n'neerillaatha tharaiyil kaaloon'ri ni'rkumpoathu, isravealarellaarum tha'n'neerat'ra ularntha tharaivazhiyaayk kadanthupoanaarka'l.
janangka'l ellaarum yoarthaanaik kadanthu theernthapoathu, karththar yoasuvaavai noakki:
neengka'l, ovvoru koaththiraththi'rku ovvoruvaraaka janangka'lil pannira'ndupearaith therinthuko'ndu,

ingkea yoarthaanin naduvilea aasaariyarka'lin kaalka'l nilaiyaay nin'ra idaththilea pannira'ndu ka'rka'lai eduththu, avaika'lai ungka'loadeakooda akkaraikkuk ko'ndupoay, neengka'l in'ru iravil thangkum sthaanaththilea avaika'lai vaiyungka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyidungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa israveal puththiraril ovvoru koaththiraththi'rku ovvoruvaraaka aayaththappaduththiyiruntha pannira'ndupearai azhaiththu,

avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l yoarthaanin maththiyil ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin pettikku munpaakak kadanthupoay, ungka'lukku'l'lea oru adaiyaa'lamaayirukkumpadikku, israveal puththirarudaiya koaththirangka'lin ilakkaththi'rkuch sariyaaka, ungka'lil ovvoruvan ovvoru kallaith than thoa'linmeal eduththukko'ndu poangka'l.
naa'lai inthak ka'rka'l eathen'ru ungka'l pi'l'laika'l ungka'laik keadkumpoathu,

neengka'l: karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munpaaka yoarthaanin tha'n'neer pirinthupoanathinaal avaika'l vaikkappattirukki'rathu; yoarthaanaik kadanthupoaki'rapoathu, yoarthaanin tha'n'neer pirinthupoayit'ru; aakaiyaal inthak ka'rka'l israveal puththirarukku en'raikkum ninaippoottum adaiyaa'lam en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.

yoasuvaa katta'laiyittapadi israveal puththirar seythu, karththar yoasuvaavoadea sonnapadiyea, israveal puththirarudaiya koaththirangka'lin ilakkaththi'rkuch sariyaakap pannira'ndu ka'rka'lai yoarthaanin naduvil eduththu, avaika'laith thangka'loadeakooda akkaraikkuk ko'ndupoay, thaangka'l thangkina idaththilea vaiththaarka'l.
yoarthaanin naduvilum udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumantha aasaariyarin kaalka'l nin'ra idaththilea yoasuvaa pannira'ndu ka'rka'lai naattinaan; avaika'l innaa'lmattum angkea irukki'rathu.

moasea yoasuvaavukkuk katta'laiyittiruntha ellaavat'rinpadiyum janangka'lukkuch sollumpadi, karththar yoasuvaavukkuk katta'laiyittavaiyellaam seythu mudiyumattum, pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyar yoarthaanin naduvea nin'raarka'l; janangka'l theeviriththuk kadanthupoanaarka'l.
janamellaam kadanthupoanapinpu, karththarudaiya pettiyum kadanthathu; aasaariyar janaththukku munpaakap poanaarka'l.
roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum moasea thangka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea a'niya'niyaay israveal puththirarukku munpaakak kadanthupoanaarka'l.
ea'rakku'raiya naa'rpathinaayirampear yuththasannaththaraay yuththampa'n'numpadi, karththarukku munpaaka erikoavin samanaana ve'lika'lukkuk kadanthupoanaarka'l.

annaa'lilea karththar yoasuvaavaich sakala isravealarin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum meanmaippaduththinaar; avarka'l moaseakkup payanthirunthathupoala, avanukkum, avan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam payanthirunthaarka'l.
karththar yoasuvaavai noakki:
saadchiyin pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyar yoarthaanilirunthu karaiyea'rumpadi avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyidu en'ru sonnaar.
yoasuvaa: yoarthaanilirunthu karaiyea'ri vaarungka'l en'ru aasaariyarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra aasaariyar yoarthaan naduvilirunthu ea'ri, avarka'l u'l'langkaalka'l karaiyil oon'rinapoathu, yoarthaanin tha'n'neerka'l thangka'lidaththukkuth thirumpi, munpoala athin karaiyengkum pura'ndathu.
inthappirakaaramaaka muthal maatham paththaam theathiyilea janangka'l yoarthaanilirunthu karaiyea'ri, erikoavukkuk keezhellaiyaana kilkaalilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
avarka'l yoarthaanil eduththuk ko'nduvantha anthap pannira'ndu ka'rka'laiyum yoasuvaa kilkaalilea naatti,
israveal puththirarai noakki: naa'lai ungka'l pi'l'laika'l inthak ka'rka'l eathen'ru thangka'l pithaakka'laik keadkumpoathu,
neengka'l ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukku a'rivikkavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: isravealar vettaantharai vazhiyaay intha yoarthaanaik kadanthuvanthaarka'l.
poomiyin sakala janangka'lum karththarudaiya karam palaththathen'ru a'riyumpadikkum, neengka'l sakala naa'lum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup payappadumpadikkum,

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar sivantha samuththiraththin tha'n'neerai naangka'l kadanthu theerumattum engka'lukku munpaaka vat'rippoakappa'n'ninathu poala, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar yoarthaanin tha'n'neerukkum seythu, athai ungka'lukku munpaaka neengka'l kadanthu theeruma'lavum vat'rippoakappa'n'ninaar en'ru a'rivikkakkadaveerka'l en'raan.

israveal puththirar kadanthu theeruma'lavum, karththar yoarthaanin tha'n'neerai avarka'lukku munpaaka vat'rippoakappa'n'ninathai, yoarthaanukku mealkaraiyil kudiyiruntha emoariyarin sakala raajaakka'lum, samuththiraththarukea kudiyiruntha kaanaaniyarin sakala raajaakka'lum keattathumutha'rko'ndu, avarka'l iruthayam karainthu, israveal puththirarukku munpaakach soarnthupoanaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: nee karukkaana kaththika'lai u'ndaakki, thirumpa ira'ndaamvisai israveal puththirarai viruththaseathanampa'n'nu en'raar.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa karukkaana kaththika'lai u'ndaakki, israveal puththirarai aarloath meattilea viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan.

yoasuvaa ippadi viruththaseathanam pa'n'nina mukaantharam ennaven'raal: ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta sakala aa'nmakka'laakiya yuththapurushar ellaarum ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapinpu, vazhiyil vanaantharaththilea maa'ndupoanaarka'l.

ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta ellaa janangka'lum viruththaseathanampa'n'nappattirunthaarka'l; avarka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapinpu, vazhiyil vanaantharaththilea pi'rantha sakala janangka'lum viruththaseathanampa'n'nappadaathirunthaarka'l.

karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoana ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta yuththapurusharaana yaavarum maa'lumattum, israveal puththirar naa'rpathuvarusham vanaantharaththil nadanthu thirinthaarka'l; karththar engka'lukkuk kodukkumpadi avarka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththai avarka'l kaa'npathillai en'ru karththar avarka'lukku aa'naiyittirunthaar.

avarka'lukkup pathilaaka avar ezhumpappa'n'nina avarka'l pi'l'laika'lai yoasuvaa viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan; vazhiyilea avarka'lai viruththaseathanam pa'n'naathathinaal avarka'l viruththaseathanam illaathirunthaarka'l.
janangka'lellaarum viruththaseathanam pa'n'nappattuth theernthapinpu, avarka'l ku'namaakumattum thangka'lthangka'l idaththilea paa'layaththil thariththirunthaarka'l.
karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: in'ru ekipthin ninthaiyai ungka'lmeal iraathapadikkup purattippoattean en'raar; athanaal antha sthalam innaa'lvaraikkum kilkaal ennappaduki'rathu.
israveal puththirar kilkaalil paa'layami'rangkiyirunthu, maathaththin pathinaalaam theathi anthinearaththilea erikoavin samanaana ve'lika'lilea paskaavai aasariththaarka'l.
paskaavin ma'runaa'laakiya an'raiyathinam avarka'l theasaththinudaiya thaaniyaththaalaakiya pu'lippillaatha appangka'laiyum sutta kathirka'laiyum pusiththaarka'l.

avarka'l theasaththin thaaniyaththilea pusiththa ma'runaa'lilea mannaa peyyaamal ozhinthathu; athumuthal israveal puththirarukku mannaa illaama'rpoay, avarka'l kaanaan theasaththup palanai antha varushaththilthaanea pusiththaarka'l.

pinnum yoasuvaa erikoavin ve'liyilirunthu than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkumpoathu, ithoa, oruvar avanukku ethirea nin'raar; uruvina pattayam avar kaiyil irunthathu; yoasuvaa avaridaththil poay: neer engka'laich searnthavaroa, engka'l saththurukka'laich searnthavaroa en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avar: alla, naan karththarudaiya seanaiyin athipathiyaay ippozhuthu vanthean en'raar; appozhuthu yoasuvaa tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu pa'ninthuko'ndu, avarai noakki: en aa'ndavar thamathu adiyeanukkuch solluki'rathu ennaven'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya seanaiyin athipathi yoasuvaavai noakki: un kaalka'lilirukki'ra paatharadchaika'laik kazhat'rippoadu, nee ni'rki'ra idam parisuththamaanathu en'raar; yoasuvaa appadiyea seythaan.
erikoa israveal puththirarukku munpaaka adaikkappattirunthathu; oruvarum ve'liyea poakavumillai, oruvarum u'l'lea varavumillai.
karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: ithoa, erikoavaiyum athin raajaavaiyum yuththaveeraraiyum un kaiyil oppukkoduththean.
yuththapurusharaakiya neengka'l anaivarum patta'naththaich soozhnthu orutharam sut'rivaarungka'l; ippadi aa'runaa'l seyyakkadaveerka'l.

eazhu aasaariyar pettikku munpaaka eazhu kompu ekkaa'langka'laip pidiththukko'ndu poakavea'ndum; eazhaamnaa'lil patta'naththai eazhutharam sut'rivarakkadavarka'l; aasaariyar ekkaa'langka'lai oothavea'ndum.

avarka'l anthak kompuka'linaal nedunthoni idumpoathum, neengka'l ekkaa'lasaththaththaik keadkumpoathum, janangka'l ellaarum makaa aaravaaraththoadea aarpparikkakkadavarka'l; appozhuthu patta'naththin alangkam idinthuvizhum; udanea janangka'l avaravar thangka'lukku nearaaka ea'rakkadavarka'l en'raar.

anthappadiyea noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa aasaariyarai azhaiththu: udanpadikkaip pettiyai eduththukko'ndu poangka'l; thonikkum eazhu ekkaa'langka'laiyum eazhu aasaariyarka'l karththarudaiya pettikku munpaakap pidiththukko'ndu poakakkadavarka'l en'ru solli;
janangka'lai noakki: patta'naththaich sut'ri nadanthupoangka'l; yuththasannaththaraanavarka'l karththarin pettikkumun nadakkakkadavarka'l en'raan.

yoasuvaa janangka'lidaththil peasinavudanea, thonikkum eazhu ekkaa'langka'laip pidiththirukki'ra eazhu aasaariyar karththarukku munpaaka nadanthu ekkaa'langka'lai oothinaarka'l; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip petti avarka'lukkup pinsen'rathu.
ekkaa'langka'lai oothuki'ra aasaariyarukkumun yuththasannaththaraanavarka'l nadanthaarka'l; pintha'ndu ekkaa'langka'l oothappadumpoathu pettikkup pinsen'rathu.

yoasuvaa janangka'lai noakki: naan sollum naa'lmattum, neengka'l aarppariyaamalum ungka'l vaayinaal saththangkaattaamalum irungka'l; ungka'l vaayilirunthu oru peachchum pu'rappadavea'ndaam; aarppariyungka'l en'ru ungka'lukku naan sollum naa'lilea aarpparippeerka'laaka en'ru katta'laiyittirunthaan.
appadiyea karththarin pettiyaip patta'naththaich soozhnthu orutharam sut'rivarappa'n'ninaan; avarka'l thirumpap paa'layaththilea vanthu, paa'layaththil iraaththangkinaarka'l.
yoasuvaa athikaalamea ezhunthirunthaan; aasaariyarka'l karththarin pettiyaich sumanthuko'ndu poanaarka'l.

thonikkum eazhu ekkaa'langka'laip pidikki'ra eazhu aasaariyarka'lum ekkaa'langka'lai oothikko'ndea karththarin pettikku munpaaka nadanthaarka'l; yuththasannaththaraanavarka'l avarka'lukku munnaalea nadanthaarka'l; pintha'ndoavenil ekkaa'langka'l oothappadukaiyil, karththarin pettikkup pinsen'rathu.
ira'ndaamnaa'lilum patta'naththai orutharam sut'rivanthu, paa'layaththukkuth thirumpinaarka'l; inthappadi aa'runaa'lum seythaarka'l.

eazhaamnaa'lil, athikaalamea kizhakku ve'lukkumpoathu ezhunthirunthu anthappirakaaramea patta'naththai eazhutharam sut'rivanthaarka'l; an'raiyathinaththil maaththiram patta'naththai eazhutharam sut'rivanthaarka'l.
eazhaantharam aasaariyar ekkaa'langka'lai oothukaiyil, yoasuvaa janangka'lai noakki: aarppariyungka'l, patta'naththaik karththar ungka'lukku oppukkoduththaar.

aanaalum inthap patta'namum ithilu'l'la yaavum karththarukkuch saapaththeedaayirukkum; naam anuppina aadka'lai raakaap ennum veasi ma'raiththuvaiththapadiyaal, ava'lum ava'loadea veettukku'l irukki'ra anaivarumaaththiram uyiroadirukkakkadavarka'l.

saapaththeedaanathil eathaakilum eduththukko'l'luki'rathinaalea, neengka'l saapaththeedaakaathapadikkum, israveal paa'layaththaich saapaththeedaakki athaik kalangkappa'n'naathapadikkum, neengka'l saapaththeedaanatha'rkumaaththiram echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
sakala ve'l'liyum ponnum, ve'nkalaththinaalum irumpinaalum seyyappatta paaththirangka'lum, karththarukkup parisuththamaanavaika'l; avaika'l karththarin pokkishaththil searum en'raan.

ekkaa'langka'lai oothukaiyil, janangka'l aarppariththaarka'l; ekkaa'la saththaththai janangka'l keattu, makaa aaravaaraththoadea muzhangkukaiyil, alangkam idinthuvizhunthathu; udanea janangka'l avaravar thangka'lukku nearaakap patta'naththil ea'ri, patta'naththaip pidiththu,
patta'naththiliruntha purusharaiyum sthireeka'laiyum vaaliparaiyum kizhavaraiyum aadumaaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum sakalaththaiyum pattayakkarukkinaal sangkaaram pa'n'ninaarka'l.

yoasuvaa, theasaththai veavupaarththa ira'ndu purusharai noakki: neengka'l antha veasiyin veettilea poay, neengka'l ava'lukku aa'naiyittapadi antha sthireeyaiyum ava'lukku u'ndaana yaavaiyum angkeayirunthu ve'liyea ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu veavukaararaana antha vaalipar u'l'lea poay, raakaapaiyum ava'l thakappanaiyum ava'l thaayaiyum sakoathararka'laiyum ava'lukku'l'la yaavaiyum ava'l kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum ve'liyea azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, avarka'lai israveal paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea irukkumpadi pa'n'ninaarka'l.

patta'naththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavaiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththaarka'l; ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum, ve'nkalaththinaalum irumpinaalum seytha paaththirangka'laiyumaaththiram karththarin aalayappokkishaththil searththaarka'l.

erikoavai veavupaarkka yoasuvaa anuppina aadka'lai raakaap ennum veasi ma'raiththuvaiththapadiyinaal, ava'laiyum ava'l thakappan veettaaraiyum ava'lukku'l'la yaavaiyum yoasuvaa uyiroadea vaiththaan; ava'l innaa'lvaraikkum isravealin naduvilea kudiyirukki'raa'l.

akkaalaththilea yoasuvaa: intha erikoa patta'naththaik kattumpadi ezhumpum manushan karththarukku munpaakach sapikkappattirukkakkadavan; avan athin asthipaaraththaip poaduki'rapoathu than mooththa kumaaranaiyum, athin vaasalka'lai vaikki'rapoathu than i'laiya kumaaranaiyum saakak kodukkakkadavan en'ru saapam koo'rinaan.
ivvithamaayk karththar yoasuvaavoadeakooda irunthaar; avan keerththi theasamengkum parampit'ru.

israveal puththirar saapaththeedaanathilea thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l; eppadiyenil, yoothaakoaththiraththuch searaakudaiya kumaaranaakiya sapthiyin makan karmeekkup pi'rantha aakaan enpavan, saapaththeedaanathilea silathai eduththukko'ndaan; aakaiyaal israveal puththirarmeal karththarudaiya koapam moo'ndathu.

yoasuvaa erikoavilirunthu peththealukkuk kizhakkilu'l'la peththaavean sameepaththilirukki'ra aayipatta'naththukkup poakumpadi aadka'lai anuppi: neengka'l poay, antha naattai veavupaarungka'l en'raan; antha manushar poay, aayiyai veavupaarththu,

yoasuvaavinidaththil thirumpivanthu, avanai noakki: janangka'l ellaarum poakavea'ndiyathillai; ea'rakku'raiya ira'ndaayiram moovaayirampear poay, aayiyai mu'riya adikkalaam; ellaa janangka'laiyum angkea poakumpadi varuththappaduththavea'ndiyathillai; avarka'l kognchampearthaan en'raarka'l.
appadiyea janangka'lil ea'rakku'raiya moovaayirampear avvidaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l aayiyin manusharukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l.

aayiyin manushar avarka'lil ea'rakku'raiya muppaththaa'rupearai vettippoattaarka'l; patta'navaasalin ve'li thuvakkich sepaareemmattum avarka'laith thuraththi, malaiyi'rakkaththilea avarka'lai vettinaarka'l; janangka'lin iruthayam karainthu tha'n'neeraayppoayit'ru.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, avanum isravealin moopparum saayangkaalamattum karththarin pettikku munpaakath tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, thangka'l thalaika'linmeal puzhuthiyaip poattukko'ndu kidanthaarka'l.

yoasuvaa: aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, engka'lai azhikkumpadikku emoariyar kaika'lil oppukkoduppatha'rkaakavaa theavareer intha janaththai yoarthaanaik kadakkappa'n'nineer? naangka'l yoarthaanukku appu'raththil manaththirpthiyaaka irunthuvittoamaanaal nalamaayirukkum.
aa, aa'ndavarea, isravealar thangka'l saththurukka'lukku muthukaik kaattinaarka'l; ippozhuthu naan enna solluvean.

kaanaaniyarum theasaththuk kudika'l yaavarum ithaik keattu, engka'lai va'lainthuko'ndu, engka'l pearaip poomiyiliraathapadikku vearat'ruppoakappa'n'nuvaarka'lea; appozhuthu umathu makaththaana naamaththukku enna seyveer en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: ezhunthiru, nee ippadi mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthukidakki'rathu enna?

isravealar paavagnseythaarka'l; naan avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta en udanpadikkaiyai mee'rinaarka'l; saapaththeedaanathil eduththukko'ndathum, ka'lavuseythathum, vagnchiththathum, thangka'l pa'ndampaadika'lukku'l'lea vaiththathum u'ndea.

aathalaal israveal puththirar thangka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkakkoodaamal, thangka'l saththurukka'lukku muthukaik kaattinaarka'l; avarka'l saapaththeedaanaarka'l; neengka'l saapaththeedaanathai ungka'l naduvilirunthu nikkirakampa'n'naavittaal, ini ungka'loadu irean.

ezhunthiru, nee janangka'laip parisuththampa'n'nich sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: naa'laiyathinaththukku ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l; isravealarea, saapaththeedaanathu ungka'l naduvea irukki'rathu; neengka'l saapaththeedaanathai ungka'l naduvilirunthu vilakkaathirukkumattum, neengka'l ungka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkakkoodaathu en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.

kaalaiyilea neengka'l koaththiram koaththiramaaka varavea'ndum; appozhuthu karththar ku'rikki'ra koaththiram vamsam vamsamaaka varavea'ndum; karththar ku'rikki'ra vamsam kudumpam kudumpamaaka varavea'ndum; karththar ku'rikki'ra kudumpam pearpearaaka varavea'ndum en'ru sol.

appozhuthu saapaththeedaanathai eduththavanaayk ka'ndupidikkappaduki'ravan, karththarin udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri, isravealilea mathikeadaana kaariyaththaich seythapadiyinaal, avanum avanukku'l'la yaavum akkiniyil sutterikkappadakkadavathu en'raar.
yoasuvaa athikaalamea ezhunthirunthu, isravealaraik koaththiram koaththiramaaka varappa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu, yoothaavin koaththiram ku'rikkappattathu.
avan yoothaavin vamsangka'lai varappa'n'ninapoathu, searaakiyarin vamsam ku'rikkappattathu; avan searaakiyarin vamsaththaip pearpearaaka varappa'n'ninapoathu, sapthi ku'rikkappattaan.
avan veettaarai avan pearpearaaka varappa'n'ninapoathu, yoothaa koaththiraththuch searaakin kumaaranaakiya sapthikkup pi'rantha karmeeyin makan aakaan ku'rikkappattaan.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa aakaanai noakki: makanea, nee ippozhuthu isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai makimaippaduththu, avarukku munpaaka a'rikkaipa'n'ni, nee seythathai enakkuch sollu; athai enakku o'likkaathea en'raan.
appozhuthu aakaan yoasuvaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: meyyaakavea naan isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythean; inninna pirakaaramaakach seythean.

ko'l'laiyilea nearththiyaana oru paapiloaniya saalvaiyaiyum, irunoo'ru ve'l'lich seakkalaiyum, aimpathu seakkal ni'raiyaana oru ponpaa'laththaiyum naan ka'ndu, avaika'lai ichchiththu eduththukko'ndean; ithoa, avaika'l en koodaaraththin maththiyil poomikku'l puthaiththirukki'rathu, ve'l'li athin adiyilirukki'rathu en'raan.
udanea yoasuvaa aadka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'l koodaaraththukku oadinaarka'l; avanudaiya koodaaraththil athu puthaiththirunthathu, ve'l'liyum athinkeezh irunthathu.
avaika'laik koodaaraththin maththiyilirunthu eduththu, yoasuvaavinidaththilum israveal puththirar ellaaridaththilum ko'nduvanthu, karththarudaiya samukaththil vaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasuvaavum isravealarellaarungkoodach searaakin puththiranaakiya aakaanaiyum, antha ve'l'liyaiyum saalvaiyaiyum ponpaa'laththaiyum, avan kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum, avan maaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum aaduka'laiyum, avan koodaaraththaiyum, avanukku'l'la yaavaiyum eduththu, aakoar pa'l'laththaakkukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

angkea yoasuvaa: nee engka'laik kalangkappa'n'ninathenna? in'ru karththar unnaik kalangkappa'n'nuvaar en'raan; appozhuthu isravealarellaarum avanmeal kalle'rinthu, avaika'lai akkiniyil sutteriththu, ka'rka'linaal moodi;

avanmeal innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra periya ka'rkuviyalaik kuviththaarka'l; ippadiyea karththar thamathu koapaththin ukkiraththai vittu maa'rinaar; aakaiyaal avvidam innaa'lvaraikkum aakoar pa'l'laththaakku ennappadum.

appozhuthu karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: nee payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum iru; nee yuththa janangka'l yaavaraiyum koottikko'ndu ezhunthu, aayipatta'naththinmeal poa, ithoa, aayiyin raajaavaiyum avan janaththaiyum avan patta'naththaiyum avan naattaiyum un kaiyilea oppukkoduththean.

nee erikoavukkum athin raajaavukkum seythathupoala, aayikkum athin raajaavukkum seyyakkadavaay; athil ko'l'laiyitta poru'lka'laiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum ungka'lukkuk ko'l'laiyaaka eduththukko'l'lalaam, patta'naththukkup pinnaalea pathividaiyai vai en'raar.

appozhuthu aayiyinmeal poaka, yoasuvaavum sakala yuththajanangka'lum ezhunthu pu'rappattaarka'l; yoasuvaa yuththaveeraraana muppathinaayiram pearaith therintheduththu, iraaththiriyilea avarka'lai anuppi,
avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittathaavathu: neengka'l patta'naththin pinnaalea pathivirukkavea'ndum; patta'naththukku vekuthooramaayp poakaamal, ellaarum aayaththamaayirungka'l.
naanum ennoadirukki'ra sakala janangka'lum patta'naththa'ndaiyil kittich searuvoam; avarka'l munpoala engka'lukku ethiraakap pu'rappattu varumpoathu, avarka'lukku munnaaka naangka'l oadippoavoam.

appozhuthu avarka'l: munpoala namakku munnaaka mu'rinthu oadippoaki'raarka'l en'ru solli, engka'laith thuraththap pu'rappaduvaarka'l; naangka'loa avarka'laip patta'naththaivittu ippaalea varappa'n'numattum, avarka'lukku munnaaka oaduvoam.
appozhuthu neengka'l pathivilirunthu ezhumpivanthu, patta'naththaip pidikkavea'ndum; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar athai ungka'l kaika'lil oppukkoduppaar.
neengka'l patta'naththaip pidikkumpoathu, athaith theekko'luththippoadungka'l; karththarudaiya so'rpadi seyyungka'l; ithoa, naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'l poay, peththealukkum aayikkum naduvea, aayikku mea'rkaakap pathivirunthaarka'l; yoasuvaa an'ruraaththiri janangka'lukku'l thangkinaan.
athikaalamea yoasuvaa ezhunthirunthu, janangka'lai ilakkampaarththu, isravealin moopparoadungkooda janangka'lukku munnaalea nadanthu, aayiyinmeal poanaan.

avanoadiruntha yuththajanangka'l ellaarum nadanthu, patta'naththukku ethirea vanthusearnthu, aayikku vadakkea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; avarka'lukkum aayikkum naduvea oru pa'l'laththaakku irunthathu.
avan ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayiram pearaip piriththeduththu, avarka'laip peththealukkum aayikkum naduvea patta'naththi'rku meala'ndaiyil pathividaiyaaka vaiththaan.
patta'naththi'rku vadakkea iruntha sakala seanaiyaiyum patta'naththi'rku mea'rkea pathivirukki'ravarka'laiyum thittampa'n'ninapinpu, yoasuvaa an'ru raaththiri pa'l'laththaakkilea poayirunthaan.

aayiyin raajaa athaik ka'ndapoathu, avanum patta'naththin manusharaakiya avanudaiya sakala janangka'lum theeviriththu, athikaalamea ku'riththa vea'laiyil isravealarukku ethirea yuththampa'n'nach samanaana ve'likku nearaakap pu'rappattaarka'l; patta'naththukkup pinnaalea thanakkup pathividai vaiththirukki'rathai avan a'riyaathirunthaan.
yoasuvaavum isravealar ellaarum avarka'lukku munnaaka mu'rinthu, vanaantharaththukkup poaki'ra vazhiyea oadippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu patta'naththukku'l iruntha janangka'l ellaarum avarka'laith thuraththumpadi kooppittukko'ndu yoasuvaavaip pinthodarnthu patta'naththaivittu appu'rappattaarka'l.
aayiyilum peththealilum isravealaraip pinthodaraatha manushan irunthathillai; patta'naththaith thi'ranthuvaiththuvittu, isravealaraith thuraththikko'ndu poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: un kaiyil irukki'ra eettiyai aayikku nearaaka neettu; athai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'raar; appadiyea yoasuvaa than kaiyil iruntha eettiyaip patta'naththukku nearaaka neettinaan.

avan than kaiyai neettinavudanea, pathivirunthavarka'l theeviramaayth thaangka'l iruntha idaththilirunthu ezhumpi oadi, patta'naththukku vanthu, athaip pidiththu, theeviraththoadea patta'naththaith theekko'luththinaarka'l.

aayiyin manushar pinnittup paarththapoathu, ithoa, patta'naththin pukai aakaasaththil ezhumpuki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu angkum ingkum oadippoaki'ratha'rku avarka'lukku idam illaama'rpoayit'ru; vanaantharaththukku oadina janangka'l thangka'laith thodarnthavarka'l mukamaayth thirumpinaarka'l.
pathivirunthavarka'l patta'naththaip pidiththathaiyum, patta'naththin pukai ezhumpuki'rathaiyum, yoasuvaavum isravealarum paarththapoathu, thirumpikko'ndu, aayiyin manusharai mu'riya adiththaarka'l.

patta'naththilirunthavarka'lum avarka'lukku ethirppattathinaal, silar ippu'raththilum silar appu'raththilum iruntha isravealin naduvea akappattukko'ndaarka'l; aakaiyaal avarka'lil oruvarum thappi meenthiraathapadikku avarka'lai vettippoattu,
aayiyin raajaavai uyiroadea pidiththu, yoasuvaavinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

isravealar vanaantharave'liyilea thangka'laith thuraththina aayiyin kudika'laiyellaam vettith theernthapoathum, avarka'l anaivarum naasamaakumattum pattayakkarukkinaal vizhunthu i'ranthapoathum, isravealar ellaarum aayikkuth thirumpi, athaip pattayakkarukkinaal sangkariththaarka'l.
annaa'lilea aa'num pe'n'numaaka aayiyin manushar ellaarum panneeraayirampear vizhunthaarka'l.
aayiyin kudika'laiyellaam sangkariththuth theerumattum, yoasuvaa eettiyai neettikko'ndiruntha than kaiyai madakkavillai.
karththar yoasuvaavukkuk katta'laiyitta vaarththaiyinpadi, mirukajeevanaiyum anthap patta'naththin ko'l'laiyaiyummaaththiram isravealar eduththukko'ndaarka'l.
yoasuvaa aayiyaich sutteriththu, athai innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi en'raikkum paazhaaykkidakkum ma'nmeadaakki,

aayiyin raajaavai oru maraththilea thookkippoaduviththu, saayangkaalamattum athilea thongkavittaan; sooriyan asthamiththapinpu yoasuvaa avan udalai maraththaivittu i'rakkach sonnaan; athaip patta'navaasalil poattu, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra periya ka'rkuviyalai athinmeal kuviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa: karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea israveal puththirarukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyum, moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyum, eapaal parvathaththil isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku iruppaayuthampadaatha muzhukka'rka'laal oru palipeedaththaik kattinaan.
athinmeal karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththi, samaathaanapalika'laiyum ittaarka'l.
israveal puththirarukku munpaaka moasea ezhuthiyiruntha niyaayappiramaa'naththai avan angkea ka'rka'lil pearththezhuthinaan.

israveal janangka'lai aaseervathikkumpadi karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea muthalil katta'laiyittirunthapadiyea, isravealar ellaarum, avarka'ludaiya moopparum, athipathika'lum, niyaayaathipathika'lum, anniyarka'lum, isravealil pi'ranthavarka'lum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich sumakki'ra leaviyaraana aasaariyarukku munpaaka, pettikku irupu'raththilum, paathipear keriseem malaikku ethirpu'ramaakavum, paathipear eapaal malaikku ethirpu'ramaakavum nin'raarka'l.
atha'rkuppinpu avan niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi niyaayappiramaa'naththil solliya aaseervaathamum saapamumaakiya sakala vaarththaika'laiyum vaasiththaan.

moasea katta'laiyitta ellaavat'rilum yoasuvaa, isravealin muzhuchsapaikkum, sthireeka'lukkum pi'l'laika'lukkum, avarka'lukku'l nadamaadi sagnchariththa anniyarka'lukkum munpaaka, oru vaarththaiyaiyum vidaamal vaasiththaan.

yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilea malaika'lilum pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum leepanoanukku ethiraana periya samuththiraththin karaiyoaramengkumu'l'la eaththiyarum emoariyarum kaanaaniyarum perisiyarum eaviyarum epoosiyarumaanavarka'ludaiya sakala raajaakka'lum athaik kea'lvippattapoathu,
avarka'l orumanappattu, yoasuvaavoadum isravealaroadum yuththampa'n'na eakamaayk koodinaarka'l.
erikoavukkum aayikkum yoasuvaa seythathaik kipiyoanin kudika'l kea'lvippattapoathu,

oru thanthiramaana yoasanaipa'n'ni, thangka'lai sthaanaapathika'lpoalak kaa'npiththu, pazhaiya irattup paika'laiyum, pee'ralum poththalumaana pazhaiya thiraadcharasath thuruththika'laiyum thangka'l kazhuthaika'lmeal vaiththu,

pazhuthupaarkkappatta pazhaiya paatharadchaika'laith thangka'l kaalka'lil poattu, pazhaiya vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndaarka'l; vazhikku avarka'l ko'ndupoana appamellaam ularnthathum poosa'nam pooththathumaayirunthathu.

avarka'l kilkaalil irukki'ra paa'layaththukku yoasuvaavinidaththil poay, avanaiyum israveal manusharaiyum noakki: naangka'l thooratheasaththilirunthu vanthavarka'l, engka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nungka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu israveal manushar antha eaviyarai noakki: neengka'l engka'l naduvilea kudiyirukki'ravarka'laakkum; naangka'l eppadi ungka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nalaam en'raarka'l.
avarka'l yoasuvaavai noakki: naangka'l umakku adimaika'l en'raarka'l; atha'rku yoasuvaa: neengka'l yaar, engkeayirunthu vantheerka'l en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththin pirasthaapaththaik keattu, umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l veku thooratheasaththilirunthu vanthoam; avarudaiya keerththiyaiyum, avar ekipthilea seytha yaavaiyum,

avar espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanum astharoaththiliruntha paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakum enki'ra yoarthaanukku appu'raththiliruntha emoariyarin ira'ndu raajaakka'lukkum seytha yaavaiyum kea'lvippattoam.

aakaiyaal, engka'l moopparum engka'l theasaththuk kudika'lellaarum engka'lai noakki: ungka'l kaika'lil vazhikku aakaaram eduththukko'ndu, avarka'lukku ethirko'ndupoay, avarka'lidaththil: naangka'l ungka'l adiyaar, engka'loadea udanpadikkai pa'n'navea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.

ungka'lidaththil vara naangka'l pu'rappaduki'ra an'rea, engka'l vazhippirayaa'naththukku intha appaththaich sudachsuda engka'l veettilirunthu eduththukko'ndu vanthoam; ippozhuthu, ithoa, ularnthu poosa'nam pooththirukki'rathu.

naangka'l inthath thiraadcharasath thuruththika'lai nirappukaiyil puthithaayirunthathu; aanaalum, ithoa, kizhinthupoayit'ru; engka'l vasthirangka'lum paatharadchaika'lum nedunthooramaana pirayaa'naththinaalea pazhasaayppoayit'ru en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu isravealar: karththarudaiya vaakkaik kea'laamal avarka'ludaiya poajanapathaarththaththil si'rithu vaangkikko'ndaarka'l.
yoasuvaa avarka'loadea samaathaanampa'n'ni, avarka'lai uyiroadea kaappaat'rum udanpadikkaiyai avarka'loadea pa'n'ninaan; atha'rkaakach sapaiyin pirapukka'l avarka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththaarka'l.
avarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, moon'runaa'l sen'rapinpu, avarka'l thangka'l ayalaar en'rum thangka'l naduvea kudiyirukki'ravarka'l en'rum kea'lvippattaarka'l.
israveal puththirar pirayaa'nampa'n'nukaiyil, moon'raam naa'lil avarka'l patta'nangka'lukku vanthaarka'l; anthap patta'nangka'l kipiyoan, kepiraa, peyeroath, keeriyaathyeyaareem enpavaika'l.

sapaiyin pirapukka'l avarka'lukku isravealin theavanaakiya karththarpearil aa'naiyittirunthapadiyinaal, israveal puththirar avarka'laich sangkaarampa'n'navillai; aanaalum sapaiyaar ellaarum pirapukka'lmeal mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.
appozhuthu sakala pirapukka'lum, sapaiyaar yaavaraiyum noakki: naangka'l isravealin theavanaakiya karththarpearil avarka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththoam; aathalaal avarka'lai naam thodakkoodaathu.
kadungkoapam nammeal varaathapadikku, naam avarka'lukku itta aa'naiyinimiththam naam avarka'lai uyiroadea vaiththu, avarka'lukku on'ru seyvoam.

pirapukka'laakiya naangka'l avarka'lukkuch sonnapadi avarka'l uyiroadirunthu, sapaiyaar ellaarukkum vi'raku vettuki'ravarka'laakavum, tha'n'neer edukki'ravarka'laakavum irukkakkadavarka'l en'ru pirapukka'l avarka'loadea sonnaarka'l.
pinpu yoasuvaa avarka'lai azhaippiththu: neengka'l engka'l naduvea kudiyirukkumpoathu: naangka'l ungka'lukku vekuthooramaayirukki'ravarka'l en'ru solli, engka'lai vagnchiththathu enna?

ippoathum neengka'l sapikkappattavarka'l; en theavanudaiya aalayaththukku vi'rakuvettuki'ravarka'lum, tha'n'neer edukki'ravarka'lumaana pa'nividaikkaararaayiruppeerka'l; intha oozhiyam ungka'laivittu neengkamaattaathu en'raan.

avarka'l yoasuvaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: theasaththaiyellaam ungka'lukku oppukkodukkavum, theasaththin kudika'laiyellaam ungka'lukku munpaaka azhikkavum ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar thamathu thaasanaakiya moaseakkuk katta'laiyittathu umathu adiyaarukku nichchayamaakavea a'rivikkappattathinaal, naangka'l engka'l jeevannimiththam ungka'lukku mikavum payanthu, inthak kaariyaththaich seythoam.
ippoathum, ithoa, umathu kaiyilirukki'roam, ummudaiya paarvaikku nanmaiyum niyaayamumaayth thoan'ruki'rapadi engka'lukkuch seyyum en'raarka'l.
appadiyea yoasuvaa avarka'lukkuch seythu, israveal puththirar avarka'laik kon'rupoadaathapadikku, avarka'lai ivarka'l kaikkuth thappuviththaan.

innaa'lmattum irukki'rapadiyea, annaa'lil avarka'laich sapaikkum, karththar therinthuko'l'lum idaththilirukkum avarudaiya palipeedaththukkum vi'raku vettuki'ravarka'laakavum tha'n'neer edukki'ravarka'laakavumaakkinaan.

yoasuvaa aayiyaip pidiththu, sangkaarampa'n'ni, erikoavukkum athin raajaavukkum seythapadi, aayikkum athin raajaavukkum seythathaiyum, kipiyoanin kudika'l isravealoadea samaathaanampa'n'ni avarka'lukku'l vaasamaayirukki'rathaiyum, erusaleamin raajaavaakiya athoaniseatheak kea'lvippattapoathu,

kipiyoan raajathaani patta'nangka'lil on'raippoal periya patta'namum, aayiyaippaarkkilum perithumaayirunthapadiyinaalum, athin manusharellaarum palasaalika'laayirunthapadiyinaalum, mikavum payanthaarka'l.

aakaiyaal, erusaleamin raajaavaakiya athoaniseatheak epiroanin raajaavaakiya oakaamukkum, yarmooththin raajaavaakiya peeraamukkum, laakeesin raajaavaakiya yappiyaavukkum, ekloanin raajaavaakiya thepeerukkum aa'l anuppi:

naangka'l kipiyoanaich sangkarikkumpadi, neengka'l ennidaththil vanthu, enakkuth thu'naiseyyungka'l; avarka'l yoasuvaavoadum israveal puththiraroadum samaathaanampa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru solli anuppinaan.

appadiyea erusaleamin raajaa, epiroanin raajaa, yarmooththin raajaa, laakeesin raajaa, ekloanin raajaa enki'ra emoariyarin ainthu raajaakka'lum koodikko'ndu, avarka'lum avarka'ludaiya ellaach seanaika'lum poay, kipiyoanukku munpaakap paa'layami'rangki, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu kipiyoanin manushar kilkaalilirukki'ra paa'layaththukku yoasuvaavinidaththil aa'lanuppi: umathu adiyaaraik kaividaamal, seekkiramaay engka'lidaththil vanthu, engka'lai radchiththu, engka'lukkuth thu'naiseyyum; parvathangka'lilea kudiyirukki'ra emoariyarin raajaakka'lellaarum engka'lukku viroathamaayk koodinaarka'l en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.
udanea yoasuvaavum avanoadeakoodach sakala yuththamanusharum sakala paraakkiramasaalika'lum kilkaalilirunthu poanaarka'l.
