karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: avarka'lukkup payappadaayaaka; un kaika'lil avarka'lai oppukkoduththean; avarka'lil oruvarum unakku munpaaka ni'rpathillai en'raar.
yoasuvaa kilkaalilirunthu iraamuzhuthum nadanthu, thideeren'ru avarka'lmeal vanthuvittaan.

karththaroa avarka'lai isravealukku munpaakak kalangkappa'n'ninaar; aakaiyaal avarka'laik kipiyoanilea makaa sangkaaramaaka madangkadiththu, peththoroanukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilea thuraththi, asekkaamattum makkethaamattum mu'riya adiththaarka'l.

avarka'l peththoroanilirunthu i'rangkuki'ra vazhiyilea isravealukku munpaaka oadippoakaiyil, asekkaamattum oaduki'ra avarka'lmeal karththar vaanaththilirunthu periya ka'rka'lai vizhappa'n'ninaar, avarka'l seththaarka'l; israveal puththirar pattayaththaal kon'ravarka'laippaarkkilum kalmazhaiyinaal seththavarka'l athikamaayirunthaarka'l.

karththar emoariyarai israveal puththirarukku munpaaka oppukkodukki'ra annaa'lilea, yoasuvaa karththarai noakkip peasi, pinpu isravealin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka: sooriyanea, nee kipiyoanmealum, santhiranea, nee aayaloan pa'l'laththaakkinmealum, thariththunillungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu janangka'l thangka'l saththurukka'lukku neethiyaich sarikkattumattum sooriyan thariththathu, santhiranum nin'rathu; ithu yaasearin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukkavillaiyaa; appadiyea sooriyan asthamikkath theevirikkaamal, ea'rakku'raiya oru pakalmuzhuthum naduvaanaththil nin'rathu.
ippadik karththar oru manithanudaiya solkeatta annaa'laiyoththanaa'l atha'rku munnumillai atha'rkup pinnumillai; karththar isravealukkaaka yuththampa'n'ninaar.
pinpu yoasuvaa israveal anaiththoadumkoodak kilkaalilirukki'ra paa'layaththukkuth thirumpinaan.
antha ainthu raajaakka'lum oadippoay, makkethaavilirukki'ra oru kepiyil o'liththukko'ndaarka'l.
ainthu raajaakka'lum makkethaavilirukki'ra oru kepiyil o'liththirunthu akappattaarka'l en'ru yoasuvaavukku a'rivikkappattathu.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa: periya ka'rka'laik kepiyin vaayilea puratti, avvidaththil avarka'laik kaavalkaakka manusharai vaiyungka'l.

neengka'loa nillaamal, ungka'l saththurukka'laith thuraththi, avarka'ludaiya pinpadaika'lai vettippoadungka'l; avarka'laith thangka'l patta'nangka'lilea piraveasikkavottaathirungka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai ungka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaar en'raan.
yoasuvaavum israveal puththirarum avarka'lai makaa periya sangkaaramaay avarka'l azhiyuma'lavum sangkariththaarka'l; avarka'lil meethiyaanavarka'l ara'naana patta'nangka'lukku'l pukunthaarka'l.
janangka'lellaarum sukamaay makkethaavilirukki'ra paa'layaththilea, yoasuvaavinidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthaarka'l; israveal puththirarukku viroathamaaka oruvanum than naavai asaikkavillai.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa: kepiyin vaayaith thi'ranthu, antha ainthu raajaakka'laiyum anthak kepiyilirunthu ennidaththi'rku ve'liyea ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.

avarka'l appadiyea seythu, erusaleamin raajaavum, epiroanin raajaavum, yarmooththin raajaavum, laakeesin raajaavum, ekloanin raajaavumaakiya antha ainthu raajaakka'laiyum anthak kepiyilirunthu avanidaththi'rku ve'liyea ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

avarka'lai yoasuvaavinidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthapoathu, yoasuvaa israveal manusharaiyellaam azhaippiththu, thannoadeakooda vantha yuththamanusharin athipathika'lai noakki: neengka'l kittavanthu, ungka'l kaalka'lai intha raajaakka'ludaiya kazhuththuka'linmeal vaiyungka'l en'raan; avarka'l kittavanthu, thangka'l kaalka'lai avarka'l kazhuththuka'linmeal vaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum palaththuth thidamanathaayirungka'l; neengka'l yuththampa'n'num ungka'l saththurukka'lukkellaam karththar ippadiyea seyvaar en'raan.
atha'rkuppinpu yoasuvaa avarka'lai vettik kon'ru, ainthu marangka'lilea thookkippoattaan; saayangkaalamattum marangka'lil thongkinaarka'l.

sooriyan asthamikki'ra vea'laiyilea, yoasuvaa avarka'lai marangka'lilirunthu i'rakkak katta'laiyittaan. avarka'l o'liththukko'ndiruntha kepiyilea avarka'laip poattu; innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi periya ka'rka'laik kepiyin vaayilea adaiththaarka'l.

annaa'lilea yoasuvaa makkethaavaip pidiththu, athaip pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththu, athin raajaavaiyum athilu'l'la manusharaakiya sakala narajeevanka'laiyum, oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, sangkaarampa'n'ni, erikoavin raajaavukkuch seythathupoala, makkethaavin raajaavukkum seythaan.
makkethaavilirunthu yoasuvaa isravealar anaivaroadungkooda lipnaavukkup pu'rappattu, lipnaavinmeal yuththampa'n'ninaan.

karththar athaiyum athin raajaavaiyum isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; athaiyum athilu'l'la sakala narajeevanka'laiyum, oruvaraiyum athilea meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththu, erikoavin raajaavukkuch seythathupoala, athin raajaavukkum seythaan.
lipnaavilirunthu yoasuvaa israveal anaiththoadungkooda laakeesukkup pu'rappattu, atha'rku ethirea paa'layami'rangki, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ninaan.

karththar laakeesai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; athai ira'ndaam naa'lilea pidiththu, lipnaavukkuch seythathupoala, athaiyum athilu'l'la ellaa narajeevanka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththaan.
appozhuthu keasearin raajaavaakiya oaraam laakeesukkuth thu'naiseyyumpadi vanthaan; yoasuvaa avanaiyum avan janaththaiyum, oruvanum meethiyaayiraathapadi, vettippoattaan.
laakeesilirunthu yoasuvaavum isravealar anaivarum ekloanukkup pu'rappattu, atha'rku ethirea paa'layami'rangki, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ni,
athai annaa'lilea pidiththu, athaip pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththaarka'l; laakeesukkuch seythathupoala, athilu'l'la sakala narajeevanka'laiyum annaa'lileathaanea sangkaarampa'n'ninaan.
pinpu ekloanilirunthu yoasuvaavum isravealar anaivarumaay epiroanukkup pu'rappattu, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ni,

athaip pidiththu, ekloanukkuch seythathupoala, athaiyum athin raajaavaiyum atha'rku aduththa ellaap patta'nangka'laiyum athilu'l'la sakala narajeevanka'laiyum, oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththaarka'l; athaiyum athilu'l'la sakala narajeevanka'laiyum sangkaarampa'n'ninaan.
pinpu yoasuvaa isravealar anaivaroadungkoodath thepeerukkuth thirumpippoay, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ni,

athaiyum athin raajaavaiyum athaich searntha ellaap patta'nangka'laiyum pidiththaan; avaika'laip pattayakkarukkinaal azhiththu, athilu'l'la narajeevanka'laiyellaam, oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, sangkaarampa'n'ninaarka'l; epiroanukkum lipnaavukkum avaika'lin raajaavukkum seythathupoalath thepeerukkum athin raajaavukkum seythaan.

ippadiyea yoasuvaa malaiththeasam anaiththaiyum thentheasaththaiyum samapoomiyaiyum neerppaaychchalaana idangka'laiyum avaika'lin ellaa raajaakka'laiyum, oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaamal azhiththu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar katta'laiyittapadiyea, suvaasamu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum sangkaarampa'n'ni,
kaatheasparneayaathuvakkik kaathsaamattum irukki'rathaiyum kipiyoanmattum irukki'ra koasean theasam anaiththaiyum azhiththaan.
antha raajaakka'l ellaaraiyum avarka'l theasaththaiyum yoasuvaa orumikkap pidiththaan; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar isravealukkaaka yuththampa'n'ninaar.
pinpu yoasuvaa isravealanaiththoadumkoodak kilkaalilirukki'ra paa'layaththukkuth thirumpinaan.
aathsoarin raajaavaakiya yaapeen athaik kea'lvippattapoathu, avan maathoanin raajaavaakiya yoapaapidaththi'rkum, simroanin raajaavidaththi'rkum, aksaapin raajaavidaththi'rkum,
vadakkeayirukki'ra malaika'lilum kinnaroaththukkuth the'rkeayirukki'ra naattuppu'raththilum samapoomiyilum mea'rku ellaiyaakiya thoarilum irukki'ra raajaakka'lidaththi'rkum,

kizhakkeayum mea'rkeayumirukki'ra kaanaaniyaridaththi'rkum, malaika'lilirukki'ra emoariyar, eaththiyar, perisiyar, epoosiyaridaththi'rkum, ermoan malaiyin adiyilea mispaa seemaiyilirukki'ra eaviyaridaththi'rkum aa'l anuppinaan.
avarka'l kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoal earaa'lamaana thira'nda janamaakiya thangka'ludaiya ellaach seanaika'loadum, makaa earaa'lamaana kuthiraika'loadum irathangka'loadungkoodap pu'rappattaarka'l.
intha raajaakka'lellaarum koodi, isravealoadea yuththampa'n'navanthu, mearoam enki'ra eariya'ndaiyilea eakamaayp paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar yoasuvaavai noakki: avarka'lukkup payappadaayaaka; naa'lai innearaththilea naan avarka'laiyellaam isravealukku munpaaka vettu'ndavarka'laaka oppukkoduppean; nee avarka'l kuthiraika'lin kuthikaal narampuka'lai a'ruththu, avarka'l irathangka'lai akkiniyaal sutterikkakkadavaay en'raar.
yoasuvaavum, avanoadeakooda yuththa janangka'l anaivarum, thideeren'ru mearoam eariya'ndaiyilirukki'ra avarka'lidaththil vanthu, avarka'lmeal vizhunthaarka'l.

karththar avarka'lai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu, periya seethoanmattum misrapoathmaayeemmattum, kizhakkeayirukki'ra mispea pa'l'laththaakkumattum thuraththi, avarka'lil oruvarum meethiyaayiraathapadi, avarka'lai vettippoattaarka'l.
yoasuvaa karththar thanakkuch sonnapadi avarka'lukkuch seythu, avarka'l kuthiraika'lin kuthikaal narampuka'lai a'ruththu, avarka'l irathangka'lai akkiniyaal sutteriththaan.
akkaalaththilea yoasuvaa thirumpi, aathsoaraip pidiththu, athin raajaavaip pattayaththinaal vettippoattaan; aathsoar munnea antha raajyangka'lukkellaam thalaimaiyaana patta'namaayirunthathu.
athiliruntha narajeevanka'laiyellaam pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, sangkaarampa'n'ninaarka'l; suvaasamu'l'lathu on'rum meethiyaanathillai; aathsoaraiyoa akkiniyaal sutteriththaan.

antha raajaakka'ludaiya ellaap patta'nangka'laiyum avaika'ludaiya ellaa raajaakka'laiyum yoasuvaa pidiththu, pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, karththarudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea katta'laiyittapadi, avarka'laich sangkaarampa'n'ninaan.
aanaalum thangka'l ara'nippoadea iruntha patta'nangka'laiyellaam isravealar sutteriththuppoadaamal vaiththaarka'l; aathsoaraimaaththiram yoasuvaa sutteriththuppoattaan.

anthap patta'nangka'lilu'l'la mirukajeevanka'laiyum mat'rak ko'l'laipporu'lka'laiyum israveal puththirar thangka'lukken'ru eduththukko'ndaarka'l; aanaalum ellaa manusharaiyum azhiththuth theerumattum avarka'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaarka'l; suvaasamu'l'la on'raiyum avarka'l meethiyaaka vaikkavillai.

karththar thamathu thaasanaakiya moaseakku eppadik katta'laiyittirunthaaroa, appadiyea moasea yoasuvaavukkuk katta'laiyittirunthaan; appadiyea yoasuvaa seythaan; avan, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittathil on'raiyum seyyaamal vidavillai.

inthappirakaaramaaka yoasuvaa seayeerukku ea'rippoaki'ra aalaak malaithuvakki leepanoanin pa'l'laththaakkil ermoan malaiyadiyil irukki'ra paakaal kaathmattumu'l'la antha muzhuththeasamaakiya malaika'laiyum, thentheasam yaavaiyum, koasean theasaththaiyum, samanaana poomiyaiyum, naattuppu'raththaiyum, isravealin malaika'laiyum athin samapoomiyaiyum pidiththukko'ndu,
avaika'lin raajaakka'laiyellaam pidiththu, avarka'lai vettik kon'ru poattaan.
yoasuvaa nedunaa'laay antha raajaakka'lellaaroadum yuththampa'n'ninaan.
kipiyoanin kudika'laakiya eaviyaraith thavira, oru patta'namum israveal puththiraroadea samaathaanam pa'n'navillai; mat'rellaap patta'nangka'laiyum yuththampa'n'nip pidiththaarka'l.

yuththampa'n'na isravealukku ethiraaka varumpadikku, avarka'ludaiya iruthayam kadinamaanathum, ippadiyea avarka'lpearil irakkam u'ndaakaamal, karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadi, avarka'lai azhiththuch sangkaarampa'n'ninathum karththaraal vantha kaariyamaayirunthathu.

akkaalaththilea yoasuvaa poay, malaiththeasamaakiya epiroanilum thepeerilum aanaapilum yoothaavin sakala malaika'lilum isravealin sakala malaika'lilum iruntha eanaakkiyarai nikkirakampa'n'ni, avarka'lai avarka'l patta'nangka'loadumkoodach sangkariththaan.
israveal puththirarin theasaththil eanaakkiyar oruvarum meethiyaaka vaikkappadavillai; kaasaavilum kaaththilum asthoaththilummaaththiram silar meethiyaayirunthaarka'l.

appadiyea yoasuvaa, karththar moaseayinidaththil sonnapadiyellaam theasamanaiththaiyum pidiththu, athai isravealarukku, avarka'l koaththirangka'ludaiya pangkuka'linpadiyea, suthantharamaakak koduththaan; yuththam oaynthathinaal theasam amaithalaayirunthathu.

yoarthaanukku appu'raththil sooriyan uthayamaaki'ra thisaiyilea arnoan aa'ru thuvakki ermoan malaimattum, kizhakkea samapoomi ellaiyilellaamu'l'la raajaakka'lai israveal puththirar mu'riya adiththu, avarka'ludaiya theasangka'laiyum suthanthariththukko'ndaarka'l.

antha raajaakka'lil, espoanil kudiyiruntha emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoan, arnoan aat'rangkaraiyilirukki'ra aaroavear thodangki aat'rin nadumaiyamum paathik keeleayaaththumudpada ammoan puththirarin ellaiyaana yaapoakku aa'rumattumu'l'la theasaththaiyum,

samanaana ve'li thuvakkik kizhakkeayirukki'ra kinnaroath kadalmattum pethyesimoath vazhiyaayk kizhakkeayirukki'ra samanaana ve'liyin kadalaakiya uppukkadalmattum irukki'ra theasaththaiyum the'rkea asthoathpiskaavukkuth thaazhvaayirukki'ra theasaththaiyum aa'ndaan.
iraadchatharil meethiyaana paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakin ellaiyaiyum suthanthariththukko'ndaarka'l; avan astharoaththilum ethreayilum vaasampa'n'ni,
ermoan malaiyaiyum salkaavaiyum, kesooriyar, maakaaththiyar ellaimattum espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanin ellaiyaayiruntha paathik keeleayaathmattum irukkum paasaan anaiththaiyum aa'ndaan.

avarka'laik karththarin thaasanaakiya moaseayum israveal puththirarum mu'riya adiththaarka'l; aththeasaththaik karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea roopaniyarukkum kaaththiyarukkum manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththukkum suthantharamaakak koduththaan.

yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilea mea'rkea leepanoanin pa'l'laththaakkilu'l'la paakaalkaathmutha'rko'ndu seayeerukku ea'rippoaki'ra aalaakmalaimattum, malaika'lilum pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum samapoomiyilum malaika'lukkaduththa pu'rangka'lilum vanaantharaththilum the'rkuth theasaththilum irukki'rathum,

yoasuvaa israveal koaththirangka'lukkuch suthantharamaakap pangkittathumaana eaththiyar, emoariyar, kaanaaniyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyar enpavarka'ludaiya theasaththil irunthavarka'lum, yoasuvaavum israveal puththirarum mu'riya adiththavarka'lumaana raajaakka'l yaarenil:
erikoavin raajaa on'ru, peththealukku arukaana aayiyin raajaa on'ru,
erusaleamin raajaa on'ru, epiroanin raajaa on'ru,
yarmooththin raajaa on'ru, laakeesin raajaa on'ru,
ekloanin raajaa on'ru, keasearin raajaa on'ru,
thepeerin raajaa on'ru, kethearin raajaa on'ru,
ormaavin raajaa on'ru, aaraathin raajaa on'ru,
lipnaavin raajaa on'ru, athullaamin raajaa on'ru,
makkeathaavin raajaa on'ru, peththealin raajaa on'ru,
thappuvaavin raajaa on'ru, eppearin raajaa on'ru,
aappekkin raajaa on'ru, lasaroanin raajaa on'ru,
maathoanin raajaa on'ru, aathsoarin raajaa on'ru,
simroan mearoanin raajaa on'ru, aksaapin raajaa on'ru,
thaanaakin raajaa on'ru, mekithoavin raajaa on'ru,
keatheasin raajaa on'ru, karmealukkaduththa yokniyaamin raajaa on'ru,
thoarin karaiyaich searntha thoarin raajaa on'ru, kilkaalukkaduththa jaathika'lin raajaa on'ru,
thirsaavin raajaa on'ru; aaka ivarka'lellaarum muppaththoru raajaakka'l.
yoasuvaa vayathusen'ru muthirnthavanaanapoathu, karththar avanai noakki: nee vayathusen'ravanum muthirnthavanumaanaay; suthanthariththukko'l'lavea'ndiya theasam innum makaa visthaaramaayirukki'rathu.

meethiyaayirukki'ra theasam evaiyenil, ekipthukku ethiraana seekoar aa'ruthuvakkik kaanaaniyaraich searnthathaaka e'n'nappadum vadakkeayirukki'ra ekroanin ellaimattumu'l'la pelistharin ellaa ellaika'lum, kesoorim muzhuvathum,
kaasaa, asthoath, askaloan, kaath, ekroan enki'ra patta'nangka'lilirukki'ra pelistharudaiya ainthu athipathika'lin naadum, aaviyarin naadum,
the'rkea thuvakki aappekmattum emoariyar ellaivaraikkum irukki'ra kaanaaniyarin sakala theasamum, seethoaniyarukkaduththa meyaaraa naadum,
kipliyarin naadum, sooriyoathayap pu'raththil ermoan malaiyadivaaraththil irukki'ra paakaalkaath mutha'rko'ndu aamaaththukku'l piraveasikkumattumu'l'la leepanoan muzhuvathum,

leepanoan thuvakki misrapoathmaayeemmattum malaika'lil kudiyirukki'ra yaavarudaiya naadum, seethoaniyarudaiya ellaa naadumthaanea. naan avarka'lai israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththuvean; naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, nee isravealukkuch suthantharamaakach seettuka'laimaaththiram poattuth theasaththaip pangkidavea'ndum.
aathalaal inthath theasaththai onpathu koaththirangka'lukkum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththukkum suthantharamaakap pangkidu en'raar.

manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaarum roopaniyarum kaaththiyarum thangka'l suthantharaththai adainthu theernthathu; athaik karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea yoarthaanukku appu'raththil kizhakkea avarka'lukkuk koduththaan.
arnoan aat'rangkaraiyilirukki'ra aaroavearum, nathiyin maththiyilirukki'ra patta'namum thuvakkith theepoanmattumirukki'ra methepaavin samanaana poomi yaavaiyum,
espoanilirunthu ammoan puththirarin ellaimattum aa'nda emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanukkuriya sakala patta'nangka'laiyum,
keeleayaaththaiyum, kesooriyar maakaaththiyarudaiya ellaiyilu'l'la naattaiyum, ermoan malai muzhuvathaiyum,

astharoaththilum ethreayilum aa'ndu, moasea mu'riya adiththuth thuraththina iraadchatharil meethiyaayiruntha paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakukkuch salkaamattumiruntha paasaan muzhuvathaiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaan.
israveal puththiraroa kesooriyaraiyum maakaaththiyaraiyum thuraththividavillai, kesooriyarum maakaaththiyarum innaa'lvaraikkum isravealin naduvea kudiyirukki'raarka'l.
leaviyarin koaththiraththukkumaaththiram avan suthantharam kodukkavillai; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea, avarudaiya thakanapalika'lea avarka'ludaiya suthantharam.
moasea roopan puththirarin koaththiraththukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'lukkuththakkathaakach suthantharam koduththaan.
arnoan aat'rangkaraiyilirukki'ra aaroavearum, aat'rin maththiyilirukki'ra patta'nam thodangki methepaavaraikkummu'l'la samapoomi muzhuvathum,
samapoomiyilirukki'ra espoanum, athin ellaap patta'nangka'lumaakiya theepoan, paamoathpaakaal, pethpaakaalmeyoan,
yaakasaa, kethemoath, meapaakaath,
keeriyaaththaayeem, sipmaa, pa'l'laththaakkin malaiyilu'l'la sereathsakaar,
pethpeayoar, asthoathpiskaa, pethyesimoath muthalaana

samapoomiyilu'l'la ellaap patta'nangka'lum, espoanil aa'ndiruntha seekoan ennum emoariyarudaiya raajaavin raajyam muzhuvathum avarka'l ellaikku'l'laayit'ru; anthach seekoanaiyum, theasaththilea kudiyirunthu seekoanin athipathiyaayiruntha eavi, rekkeam, soor, oor, reapaa ennum meethiyaanin pirapukka'laiyum moasea vettippoattaan.
israveal puththirar vettina mat'ravarka'loadungkooda, peayoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaam ennum ku'risolluki'ravanaiyum pattayaththinaal vettippoattaarka'l.
appadiyea yoarthaanum atha'rkaduththathum roopan puththirarin ellaiyaayit'ru; inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum roopan puththirarukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi vantha suthantharam.
kaath puththirarin koaththiraththukku moasea avarka'l vamsangka'lukkuththakkathaakak koduththathu ennavenil:
yaasearum, keeleayaaththin sakala patta'nangka'lum, rapaavukku ethirea irukki'ra aaroavearmattumu'l'la ammoan puththirarin paathith theasamum,
espoan thuvakki raamaath mispeamattum peththoneemvaraikkum irukki'rathum, makanaayeem thuvakkith thepeerin ellaimattum irukki'rathum,

espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanudaiya raajyaththin mat'rap pangkaakiya pa'l'laththaakkilirukki'ra peththaaraamum, pethnimraavum, sukkoaththum, saappoanum, yoarthaanmattum irukki'rathum, kizhakkea yoarthaanin karaiyoaramaayk kinnareath kadalin kadaiyaantharamattum irukki'rathum, avarka'l ellaikku'l'laayit'ru.
inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum kaath puththirarukku, avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi vantha suthantharam.
manaasea puththirarin paathik koaththiraththukkum moasea avarka'l vamsaththukkuththakkathaakak koduththaan.

makanaayeem thuvakki, paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakin muzhu raajyamaayirukki'ra paasaan muzhuvathum, paasaanilu'l'la yaaveerin sakala oorka'lumaana a'rupathu patta'nangka'l avarka'l ellaikku'l'laayit'ru.

paathik keeleayaaththaiyum, paasaanilea astharoath, ethreayi ennum oaku raajyaththin patta'nangka'laiyum, manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin puththirar paathipearukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadiyea koduththaan.
moasea kizhakkea erikoavin arukea yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilirukki'ra moavaapin samanaana ve'lika'lil suthantharamaakak koduththavaika'l ivaika'lea.
leavi koaththiraththi'rku moasea suthantharam kodukkavillai, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lukkuch solliyirukki'rapadi, avarea avarka'ludaiya suthantharam.

kaanaan theasaththilea israveal puththirar suthanthariththukko'nda theasangka'lai aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum israveal puththirarudaiya koaththirap pithaakka'lin thalaivarum, karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyittapadi seettuppoattu,
onpatharaik koaththirangka'lukkum suthantharamaakap pangkittaarka'l.
mat'ra ira'ndaraik koaththirangka'lukkum moasea yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea suthantharam koduththirunthaan; leaviyarukkumaaththiram avarka'l naduvea suthantharam kodukkavillai.

manaasea eppiraayeem ennum yoaseappin puththirar ira'ndu koaththirangka'laanaarka'l; aathalaal avarka'l leaviyarukkuth theasaththilea pangkukodaamal, kudiyirukkumpadi patta'nangka'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'l muthalaana soththukkaaka ve'linilangka'laiyumaaththiram avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l.
karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittapadi israveal puththirar seythu, theasaththaip pangkittaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoothaavin puththirar kilkaalilea yoasuvaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l; keanaasiyanaana eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleap avanai noakki: kaatheasparneyaavilea karththar ennaikku'riththum ummaikku'riththum theavanudaiya manushanaakiya moaseayoadea sonna vaarththaiyai neer a'riveer.

theasaththai veavupaarkkak karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea ennaik kaatheasparneyaavilirunthu anuppuki'rapoathu, enakku naa'rpathu vayathaayirunthathu; en iruthayaththilu'l'lapadiyea avarukku ma'ruseythi ko'nduvanthean.
aanaalum ennoadeakooda vantha en sakoatharar janaththin iruthayaththaik karaiyappa'n'ninaarka'l; naanoa en theavanaakiya karththarai uththamamaayp pinpat'rinean.

annaa'lilea moasea: nee en theavanaakiya karththarai uththamamaayp pinpat'rinapadiyinaal, un kaal mithiththa theasam unakkum un pi'l'laika'lukkum en'raikkum suthantharamaayirukkakkadavathu en'ru solli aa'naiyittaar.

ippoathum, ithoa, karththar sonnapadiyea ennai uyiroadea kaaththaar; isravealar vanaantharaththil sagncharikkaiyil, karththar antha vaarththaiyai moaseayoadea solli ippoathu naa'rpaththainthu varushamaayit'ru; ithoa, in'ru naan e'npaththainthu vayathu'l'lavan.

moasea ennai anuppuki'ra naa'lil, enakku iruntha anthap pelan innaa'lvaraikkum enakku irukki'rathu; yuththaththi'rkup poakkum varaththumaayirukki'ratha'rku appoathu enakku iruntha pelan ippoathum enakku irukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal karththar annaa'lilea sonna intha malainaattai enakkuth thaarum; angkea eanaakkiyarum, ara'nippaana periya patta'nangka'lum u'nden'ru neer annaa'lilea kea'lvippatteerea; karththar ennoadiruppaaraanaal, karththar sonnapadi, avarka'laith thuraththividuvean en'raan.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa: eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapai aaseervathiththu, epiroanai avanukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththaan.

aathalaal keanaasiyanaana eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleap isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai uththamamaayp pinpat'rinapadiyinaal, innaa'lmattum irukki'rapadi, epiroan avanukkuch suthantharamaayit'ru.
munnea epiroanukkuk keeriyaatharpaa en'ru pearirunthathu; arpaa enpavan eanaakkiyarukku'l'lea periya manushanaayirunthaan; yuththam oaynthathinaal theasam amaithalaayirunthathu.
yoothaa puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana pangkuveethamaavathu: eathoamin ellaikku arukaana seenvanaantharamea thenpu'raththin kadaiyellai.
thenpu'ramaana avarka'ludaiya ellai uppukkadalin kadaisiyil the'rku mukamaayirukki'ra munaithuvakki,
thenpu'raththilirukki'ra akraapeemin meaduka'lukkum, angkeayirunthu seenukkum poay, the'rkeayirukki'ra kaatheasparneyaavukku ea'ri, esroanaik kadanthu, aathaarukku ea'ri, karkkaavaich sut'rippoay,
asmoanukkum, angkeayirunthu ekipthin aat'rukkum sen'ru, kadalmattum poay mudiyum; ithuvea ungka'lukkuth thenpu'ramaana ellaiyaayirukkum en'raan.
keezhppu'ramaana ellai, yoarthaan mukaththuvaaramattum irukki'ra uppukkadal. vadapu'ramaana ellai, yoarthaan mukaththuvaaramirukki'ra kadalin munai thuvakki,
petheklaavukku ea'ri, vadakkeayirukki'ra petharapaavaik kadanthu, roopanin kumaaranaakiya poakanin kallukku ea'rippoay,

appu'ram aakoar pa'l'laththaakkai vittuth thepeerukku ea'ri, vadakkea aat'rin thenpu'ramaana athummeemin meattukku munpaaka irukki'ra kilkaalukku nearaakavum, angkeayirunthu enseameasin tha'n'neeridaththukkum poay, entoakeal ennum ki'nat'rukkuch sen'ru,

appu'ram epoosiyar kudiyirukki'ra erusaleamukkuth thenpu'ramaay innoamudaiya kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakkaik kadanthu, vadakkeayirukki'ra iraadchatharudaiya pa'l'laththaakkin kadaisiyil mea'rkaaka innoam pa'l'laththaakkin munnirukki'ra malaiyin sikaramattum ea'rippoay,
antha malaiyin sikaraththilirunthu nepthoavaavin neeroot'rukkup poay, epperoan malaiyin patta'nangka'lukkuch sen'ru, keeriyaathyeyaareemaakiya paalaavukkup poay,
paalaavilirunthu mea'rkea seayeer malaikkuth thirumpi, vadakkea irukki'ra kesaloanaakiya yeyaareem malaikkup pakkamaakap poay, pethshimeasukku i'rangki, thimnaavukkup poay,
appu'ram vadakkeayirukki'ra ekroanukkup pakkamaaych sen'ru, sikroanukku oadi, paalaamalaiyaik kadanthu, yaapniyealukkuch sen'ru, kadalilea mudiyum.
mea'rpu'ramaana ellai, periya samuththiramea; ithu yoothaa puththirarukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi sut'rilumirukkum ellai.

eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapukku, yoasuvaa, karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadi, eanaakkin thakappanaakiya arpaavin patta'namaana epiroanai, yoothaa puththirarin naduvea, pangkaakak koduththaan.
angkeayiruntha seasaay, akeemaan, thalmaay ennum eanaakkin moon'ru kumaararaiyum kaaleap thuraththivittu,
angkeayirunthu thepeerin kudika'lidaththi'rkup poanaan; mu'rkaalaththilea thepeerin pear keeriyaathseppear.
keeriyaathseppearaich sangkaarampa'n'nip pidikki'ravanukku, en kumaaraththiyaakiya aksaa'lai vivaakampa'n'nikkoduppean en'ru kaaleap sonnaan.
appozhuthu kaaleapin sakoatharanaakiya keanaasin makan othniyeal athaip pidiththaan; aakaiyaal than kumaaraththi aksaa'lai avanukku vivaakampa'n'nik koduththaan.

ava'l pu'rappadukaiyil, en thakappanidaththil oru vayalve'liyaik keadkavea'ndum en'ru avanidaththil uththaravu pet'rukko'ndu, kazhuthaiyinmealirunthu i'rangkinaa'l. kaaleap paarththu: unakku ennavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu ava'l: enakku oru aaseervaatham tharavea'ndum; enakku va'radchiyaana nilaththaith thantheer; neerppaaychchalaana nilaththaiyum enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'raa'l; appozhuthu ava'lukku mea'rpu'raththilum keezhppu'raththilum neerppaaychchalaana nilangka'laik koduththaan.
yoothaa puththirarukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana suthantharam ennaven'raal:
kadaiyaantharath thenpu'ramaana eathoamin ellaikku nearaay, yoothaa puththirarin koaththiraththi'rkuk kidaiththa patta'nangka'laavana: kapseyeal, ethear, yaakoor,
keenaa, thimoanaa, athaathaa,
keatheas, aathsoar, ithnaan,
seep, thealem, peyaaloath,
aathsoar, athaaththaa, keeriyoath, esroan ennum aathsoar,
aamaam, seamaa, molaathaa,
aathsaarkaathaa, esmoan, pethpaaleath,
aathsaarsookaal, peyersepaa, pisyoathyaa,
paalaa, eeyim, aathseam,
elthoalaath, keseel, ormaa,
siklaak, mathmannaa, sansannaa,
lepaayoath, silleem, aayin, rimmoan enpavaika'l; ellaap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada irupaththonpathu.
pa'l'laththaakku naattil esthaavoal, soariyaa, ashnaa,
sanoakaa, enkanneem, thappuvaa, eanaam,
yarmooth, athullaam, soakkoa, aseakkaa,
saaraayeem, athiththaayeem, kethearaa, keatheroththaayeem; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpadap pathinaanku.
seanaan, athaashaa, mikthaalkaath,
thiliyaan, mispea, yoaktheyeal,
laakees, poaskaath, ekloan,
kaapoan, lakamaam, kithleesh,
ketheroath, pethdaakoan, naakamaa, makkeathaa; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpadap pathinaa'ru.
lipnaa, eaththear, aashaan,
ipthaa, asnaa, nethseep,
keakilaa, akseep, mareashaa; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada onpathu.
ekroanum athin ve'linilangka'lum kiraamangka'lum,
ekroan thuvakkich samuththirammattum, asthoaththin pu'raththilirukki'ra sakala oorka'lum, avaika'lin kiraamangka'lum,
asthoaththum, athin ve'linilangka'lum kiraamangka'lum, kaasaavum ekipthin nathimattumirukki'ra athin ve'linilangka'lum kiraamangka'lumea; periya samuththiramea ellai.
malaika'lil, saameer, yaaththeer, soakkoa,
thannaa, thepeer ennappatta keeriyaathsannaa,
aanaap, esthemo, aaneem,
koasean, oaloan, kilo; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpadap pathinon'ru.
araap, thoomaa, eshiyaan,
yaanoom, peththappuvaa, aappekkaa,
umthaa, epiroanaakiya keeriyaatharpaa, seeyoar; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada onpathu.
maakoan, karmeal, seep, yuththaa,
yesrayeal, yoktheyaam, sanoakaa,
kaayin, kipiyaa, thimnaa; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpadap paththu.
alkool, pethsoor, kethoar,
makaaraath, pethaanoath, elthekoan; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada aa'ru.
keeriyaathyeyaareemaakiya keeriyaathpaakaal, rapaa; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada ira'ndu.
vanaantharaththil, petharapaa, miththeen, sekkaakkaa,
nipsaan, uppuppatta'nam, enkeathi; inthap patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumudpada aa'ru.
erusaleamilea kudiyiruntha epoosiyarai yoothaa puththirar thuraththividakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru; aakaiyaal innaa'lmattum epoosiyar yoothaa puththiraroadea erusaleamilea kudiyirukki'raarka'l.

yoaseappin puththirarukku vizhuntha seettinaal akappatta pangkuveethamaavathu: erikoavin arukea irukki'ra yoarthaanilirunthu, yoarthaanukkuk kizhakkaana tha'n'neerukkup poay, erikoa thuvakkip peththealin malaika'l mattumu'l'la vanaantharavazhiyaakavum sen'ru,
peththealilirunthu loosukkup poay, arkeeyinudaiya ellaiyaakiya atharoaththaik kadanthu,
mea'rkea yapleththiyarin ellaikkum thaazhvaana peththoroan kaasear ennum ellaika'lmattum i'rangki, samuththiramvaraikkum poay mudiyum.
ithai yoaseappin puththiraraakiya manaaseayum eppiraayeemum suthanthariththaarka'l.
eppiraayeem puththirarukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana suthantharaththinudaiya kizhakku ellai, atharoath athaar thuvakki, mealaana peththoroanmattum poaki'rathu.
mea'rku ellai mikmeaththaaththi'rku vadakkaakach sen'ru, kizhakkea thaanaath seeloavukkuth thirumpi, athai yanoakaavukkuk kizhakkaakak kadanthu,
yanoakaavilirunthu atharoaththi'rkum naaraaththi'rkum i'rangki, erikoavin arukea vanthu, yoarthaanukkuch sellum.
thappuvaavilirunthu mea'rku ellai, kaanaanathikkup poay, samuththiraththilea mudiyum; ithu eppiraayeem puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana suthantharam.
pinnum eppiraayeem puththirarukkup piraththiyeakamaayk kodukkappatta patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lumellaam manaasea puththirarudaiya suthantharaththin naduvea irukki'rathu.

avarka'l kaasearilea kudiyiruntha kaanaaniyaraith thuraththividavillai; aakaiyaal kaanaaniyar, innaa'lmattum irukki'rapadi, eppiraayeemarukku'l'lea kudiyirunthu, pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laaych seavikki'raarka'l.

manaasea koaththiraththi'rkum pangku kidaiththathu; avan yoaseappukku mutha'rpea'raanavan; manaaseayin mooththakumaaranum kileyaaththin thakappanumaana maakeer yuththamanushanaanapadiyinaal, keeleayaaththum paasaanum avanukkuk kidaiththathu.

apiyeasarin puththirarum, ealeakkin puththirarum, asriyealin puththirarum, sekeamin puththirarum, eppearin puththirarum, semeethaavin puththirarumaana manaaseayinudaiya mat'rak kumaararin puththiraraakiya apiyeasarin vamsangka'lukkuththakka suthantharam kodukkappattathu. thangka'l vamsangka'lukku'l'lea avarka'lea yoaseappudaiya kumaaranaakiya manaaseayin aa'npi'l'laika'laayirunthaarka'l.

manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerukkup pi'rantha kileyaaththin kumaaranaakiya eppearin makan seloppiyaaththukkuk kumaaraththika'l thavira kumaarar illai; avan kumaaraththika'lin naamangka'l, maklaa'l, noavaa'l, oklaa'l, milkaa'l, thirsaa'l enpavaika'l.

avarka'l aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarukkum noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavukkum pirapukka'lukkum munpaakach searnthuvanthu: engka'l sakoatharar naduvea engka'lukkuch suthantharam kodukkumpadi karththar moaseakkuk katta'laiyittaar en'raarka'l; aakaiyaal avarka'l thakappanudaiya sakoathararin naduvea, karththarudaiya vaakkinpadi, avarka'lukkuch suthantharam koduththaan.
yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea irukki'ra keeleayaath, paasaan ennum theasangka'laiyallaamal, manaaseakkuch seettilea vizhunthathu paththup pangkuka'laam.
manaaseayin kumaaraththika'l avan kumaararukku'l'lea suthantharam pet'raarka'l; manaaseayin mat'rap puththirarukkuk keeleayaath theasam kidaiththathu.
manaaseayin ellai, aasear thodangkich seekeamin munnirukki'ra mikmeaththaavukkum, angkeayirunthu valathupu'ramaay enthappuvaavin kudika'lidaththi'rkum poaki'rathu.
thappuvaavin nilam manaaseakkuk kidaiththathu; manaaseayin ellaiyoadirukki'ra thappuvaavoa, eppiraayeem puththirarin vasamaayit'ru.

appu'ram antha ellai kaanaa ennum aat'rukkup poay, aat'rukkuth the'rkaaka i'rangkuki'rathu; manaaseayinudaiya patta'nangka'lin naduvea irukki'ra avvidaththup patta'nangka'l eppiraayeemudaiyavaika'l; manaaseayin ellai aat'rukku vadakkeayirunthu samuththiraththi'rkup poay mudiyum.
thennaadu eppiraayeemudaiyathu; vadanaadu manaaseayinudaiyathu; samuththiram athin ellai; athu vadakkea aasearaiyum, kizhakkea isakkaaraiyum thoduki'rathu.

isakkaarilum aasearilumirukki'ra moon'ru naaduka'laakiya pethseyaanum athin oorka'lum, ipleyaamum athin oorka'lum, thoarin kudika'lum athin oorka'lum, enthoarin kudika'lum athin oorka'lum, thaanaakin kudika'lum athin oorka'lum, mekithoavin kudika'lum athin oorka'lum manaaseayinudaiyavaika'l.
manaaseayin puththirar anthap patta'nangka'lin kudika'laith thuraththividakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru; kaanaaniyar anthach seemaiyileathaanea kudiyirukkavea'ndumen'ru irunthaarka'l.
israveal puththirar palaththapoathum, kaanaaniyarai mut'rilum thuraththividaamal, avarka'laip pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laakkikko'ndaarka'l.

yoaseappin puththirar yoasuvaavai noakki: karththar engka'lai ithuvaraikkum aaseervathiththuvanthathinaal, naangka'l janamperuththavarka'laayirukki'roam; neer engka'lukkuch suthantharamaaka orea veethaththaiyum orea pangkaiyum koduththathu enna en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku yoasuvaa: neengka'l janam peruththavarka'laayum, eppiraayeem malaika'l ungka'lukku nerukkamaayumirunthaal, perisiyar reppaayeemiyar kudiyirukki'ra kaattuth theasaththukkup poay ungka'lukku idam u'ndaakkikko'l'lungka'l en'raan.

atha'rku yoaseappin puththirar: malaika'l engka'lukkup poathaathu; pa'l'laththaakku naattilirukki'ra pethseyaanilum, athin oorka'lilum, yesrayeal pa'l'laththaakkilum kudiyirukki'ra ellaak kaanaaniyaridaththilum iruppurathangka'l u'ndu en'raarka'l.

yoasuvaa yoaseappu vamsaththaaraakiya eppiraayeemiyaraiyum manaaseayaraiyum noakki: neengka'l janamperuththavarka'l, ungka'lukku makaa paraakkiramamum u'ndu, oru pangkumaaththiram alla, malaiththeasamum ungka'ludaiyathaakum.

athu kaadaanapadiyinaalea, athai vettith thiruththungka'l, appozhuthu athin kadaiyaantharamattum ungka'ludaiyathaayirukkum; kaanaaniyarukku iruppurathangka'l irunthaalum, avarka'l palaththavarka'laayirunthaalum, neengka'l avarka'laith thuraththividuveerka'l en'raan.
israveal puththirarin sapaiyellaam seeloavilea koodi, angkea aasarippuk koodaaraththai ni'ruththinaarka'l. theasam avarka'l vasamaayit'ru.
israveal puththiraril thangka'l suthantharaththai innum pangkittukko'l'laatha eazhu koaththirangka'l irunthathu.

aakaiyaal yoasuvaa israveal puththirarai noakki: ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lappoaki'ratha'rku, neengka'l enthamattum asathiyaayiruppeerka'l.

koaththiraththi'rku mummoon'ru manusharaith therinthuko'l'lungka'l; avarka'l ezhunthu pu'rappattu, theasaththilea sut'riththirinthu athaith thangka'l suthantharaththi'rkuththakkathaaka vivaramaay ezhuthi, ennidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi avarka'lai anuppuvean.
athai eazhu pangkaakap pakirakkadavarka'l; yoothaa vamsaththaar the'rkeayirukki'ra thangka'l ellaiyilum, yoaseappu vamsaththaar vadakkeayirukki'ra thangka'l ellaiyilum nilaiththirukkattum.

neengka'l theasaththai eazhu pangkaaka vivariththu ezhuthi, ingkea ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l; appozhuthu ivvidaththilea nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'lukkaakach seettuppoaduvean.

leaviyarukku ungka'l naduvea pangkillai; karththarudaiya aasaariyapattamea avarka'l suthantharam; kaaththum roopanum manaaseayin paathik koaththiramum yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea kizhakkea karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea thangka'lukkuk koduththa thangka'l suthantharaththai adainthu theernthathu en'raan.

appozhuthu antha manushar ezhunthu pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; theasaththaikku'riththu vivaram ezhuthappoaki'ravarka'lai yoasuvaa noakki: neengka'l poay, theasaththilea sut'riththirinthu, athin vivaraththai ezhuthi, ennidaththil thirumpivaarungka'l; appozhuthu ingkea seeloavilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'lukkaakach seettuppoaduvean en'ru sonnaan.
antha manushar poay, theasam engkum anthanthap patta'nangka'linpadiyea eazhu pangkaaka oru pusthakaththil ezhuthikko'ndu, seeloavil irukki'ra paa'layaththilea yoasuvaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa avarka'lukkaakach seeloavilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil seettuppoattu, angkea israveal puththirarukkuth theasaththai avarka'l pangkuveethappadi pangkittaan.

penyameen puththirarukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadiyea avarka'ludaiya koaththiraththukkuch seettu vizhunthathu; avarka'l pangku veethaththin ellaiyaanathu yoothaa puththirarukkum yoaseappup puththirarukkum naduvea irunthathu.
avarka'ludaiya vada ellai, yoarthaanilirunthu vanthu, erikoavukku vadapakkamaaych sen'ru, appu'ram mea'rkea malaiyil ea'ri, peththaavean vanaantharaththil poay mudiyum.
angkeayirunthu antha ellai, peththealaakiya loosukku vanthu, loosukkuth thenpakkamaayp poay, atharoathathaarukkuth thaazhvaana peththoroanukkuth the'rkeayirukki'ra malaiyarukea i'rangkum.

angkeayirunthu ellai mea'rku moolaikkup peththoroanukku ethirea the'rkaaka irukki'ra malaikkuth thenpu'ramaayp poayth thirumpi, keeriyaathpaakaal ennappatta yoothaa puththirarin patta'namaakiya keeriyaathyeyaareem arukea poay mudiyum; ithu mea'rku ellai.
then ellai keeriyaathyeyaareemin mudivilirukki'rathu; angkeayirunthu ellai mea'rkea poay, nepthoavaavin neeroot'ri'rkuch sen'ru,

angkeayirunthu iraadchatharin pa'l'laththaakkil vadakkeayirukki'ra innoamudaiya kumaararin pa'l'laththaakkukku ethiraana malaiyadivaaraththi'rku i'rangki, appu'ram the'rkea epoosiyarukkup pakkamaana innoamin pa'l'laththaakkukkum, angkeayirunthu entoakealukkum i'rangkivanthu,
vadakkea poay, enseameasukkum, angkeayirunthu athummeem meattukku ethiraana keliloaththi'rkum, angkeayirunthu roopan kumaaranaakiya poakanin kallinidaththi'rkum i'rangkivanthu,
araapaavukku ethiraana vadapakkamaayp poay, araapaavukku i'rangkum.
appu'ram antha ellai, pethoaklaavukku vadapakkamaayp poay, yoarthaanin mukaththuvaaraththi'rkuth the'rkaana uppukkadalin vadamunaiyilea mudinthupoam; ithu then ellai.
kizhakkuppu'raththin ellai yoarthaanea; ithu penyameen puththirarukku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi sut'rilum irukki'ra ellaika'lukku'l'laana suthantharam.
penyameen puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi irukki'ra patta'nangka'laavana: erikoa, pethoaklaa, keasees pa'l'laththaakku,
petharapaa, semaraayim, peththeal,
aaveem, paaraa, oapraa,
keappaaramoanaay, opni, kaapaa ennum pannira'ndu patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lumea.
kipiyoan, raamaa, pearoath,
mispea, keppiraa, moathsaa,
rekkeam, irpeyeal, thaaraalaa,

sealaa, ealeap, erusaleamaakiya epoosi, keepeyaath, keereayaath ennum pathinaanku patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lumea; penyameen puththirarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi irukki'ra suthantharam ithuvea.

ira'ndaam seettu simiyoanukku vizhunthathu; simiyoan puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa suthantharam, yoothaa puththirarudaiya suthantharaththin naduvea irukki'rathu.
avarka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak kidaiththa patta'nangka'laavana: peyersepaa, seapaa, molaathaa,
aathsaarsookaal, paalaa, aathseam,
elthoalaath, peththool, ormaa,
siklaak, pethmaarkaapoath, aathsaar soosaa,
pethlepaavoath, sarukean patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lum udpadap pathinmoon'ru.
mealum aayin, rimmoan, eththear, aasaan ennum naalu patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lumea.

inthap patta'nangka'laich sut'rilum paalaathpeyearmattum, the'rkeayirukki'ra raamaathmattum irukki'ra ellaak kiraamangka'lumea; ivai simiyoan puththirarudaiya koaththiraththi'rku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa suthantharam.

simiyoan puththirarudaiya suthantharam yoothaa puththirarin pangkuveethaththi'rku'l irukki'rathu; yoothaa puththirarin pangku avarka'lukku michchamaayirunthapadiyaal, simiyoan puththirar avarka'l suthantharaththin naduvilea suthantharam pet'raarka'l.
moon'raam seettu sepuloan puththirarukku vizhunthathu; avarka'lukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa suthantharapangkuveetham saareethmattumu'l'lathu.
avarka'ludaiya ellai mea'rkea maaraalaavukku ea'ri, thaapaseaththukku vanthu, yokkineayaamukku ethiraana aat'rukkup poam.
saareethilirunthu athu kizhakkea sooriyan uthikkum munaiyaayk kisloaththaapoarin ellaiyinidaththukkuth thirumpi, thaaparaaththukkuch sen'ru, yappiyaavukku ea'ri,
angkeayirunthu kizhakkuppu'raththilea kiththaaeapearaiyum iththaakaathseenaiyum kadanthu, rimmoanmeththoavaarukkum neayaavukkum poam.
appu'ram antha ellai vadakkea annaththoanukkuth thirumpi, ipthaavealin pa'l'laththaakkilea mudiyum.
kaaththaath, nakalaal, simroan, ithaalaa, pethlekeam muthalaana pannira'ndu patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lum,
sepuloan puththirarukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi, kidaiththa suthantharam.
naalaam seettu isakkaarukku vizhunthathu.
isakkaar puththirarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa ellai, yesrayeal, kesulloath, sooneam,
appiraayeem, seekoan, anaakaraath,
raappith, kishiyoan, apeths,
remeath, enkanneem, enkaathaa, pethpaathses ivaika'lea.
appu'ram antha ellai thaapoarukkum, sakaseemaavukkum, pethshimeasukkum vanthu yoarthaanilea mudiyum; atha'rku'l pathinaa'ru patta'nangka'lum avaika'ludaiya kiraamangka'lumu'ndu.
inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'laichsearntha kiraamangka'lum isakkaar puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku, avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa suthantharam.
ainthaam seettu aasear puththirarudaiya koaththiraththukku vizhunthathu.
avarka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi avarka'lukkuk kidaiththa ellai, elkaath, aali, peathean, aksaap,
alammealek, aamaath, mishayaal ivaika'lea; pinpu athu mea'rkea karmealukkum seekoarlipnaaththi'rkum sen'ru,
kizhakkea peththaakoanukkuth thirumpi, sepuloanukku vadakkeayirukki'ra ipthaavealin pa'l'laththaakkukkum peththeameakkukkum neakiyelukkum vanthu, idathupu'ramaana kaapoolukkum,
epiroanukkum, reakoapukkum, ammoanukkum, kaanaavukkum, periya seethoanmattum poam.
appu'ram antha ellai raamaavukkum theeru ennum ara'nippaana patta'nammattum thirumpum; pinpu antha ellai oasaavukkuth thirumpi, akseepin ellai oaraththilu'l'la samuththiraththilea mudiyum.
ummaavum, aappekkum, reakoapum atha'rku aduththirukki'rathu; inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum irupaththira'ndu.
inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum aasear puththirarin koaththiraththukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi, kidaiththa suthantharam.
aa'raam seettu napthali puththirarukku vizhunthathu.

napthali puththirarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa ellai, ealeappilum, saanaanimilu'l'la alloanilumirunthu vanthu, aathami, nekkeapinmealum yaapniyealinmealum, lakkoommattum poay, yoarthaanil mudiyum.

appu'ram antha ellai mea'rkea asnoaththaapoarukkuth thirumpi, angkeayirunthu ukkoakukkuch sen'ru, the'rkea sepuloanaiyum, mea'rkea aasearaiyum sooriyoathayappu'raththilea yoarthaanilea yoothaavaiyum searnthu varum.
ara'nippaana patta'nangka'laavana: seeththim, sear, ammaath, rakkaath, kinnareath,
aathamaa, raamaa, aathsoar,
keatheas, ethreayi, enaathsoar,
eeroan, mikthaaleal, oaream, pethaanaath, pethshimeas muthalaanavaika'lea; patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lumudpadap paththonpathu.
inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum napthali puththirarudaiya koaththiraththukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi, u'ndaana suthantharam.
eazhaam seettu thaa'n puththirarudaiya koaththiraththi'rku vizhunthathu.
avarka'lukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa suthantharaththin ellaiyaavathu, soaraa, esthaavoal, irseameas,
saalaapeen, aayaloan, yethlaa,
ealoan, thimnaathaa, ekroan,
elthekkea, kipeththoan, paalaath,
yeakooth, penaperaak, kaathrimmoan,
meayaarkoan, raakkoan ennum patta'nangka'lum, yaappoavukku ethiraana ellaiyumea.

thaa'n puththirarin ellai avarka'lukku odukkamaayirunthapadiyaal, avarka'l pu'rappattuppoay, leaseaminmeal yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththu, pattayakkarukkinaal sangkariththu, athaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, athilea kudiyirunthu, leaseamukkuth thangka'l thakappanaakiya thaa'nudaiya naamaththinpadiyea thaa'n en'ru pearittaarka'l.
inthap patta'nangka'lum ivaika'lin kiraamangka'lum thaa'n puththirarin koaththiraththi'rku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana suthantharam.
theasaththai athin ellaika'linpadi suthantharamaakap pangkittuth theernthapoathu, israveal puththirar noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavukkuth thangka'l naduvilea oru suthantharaththaik koduththaarka'l.

eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththil irukki'ra thimnaathsearaa ennum avan keatta patta'naththai avanukkuk karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea koduththaarka'l; anthap patta'naththai avan katti, athilea kudiyirunthaan.

aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarum, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavum, koaththirap pithaakka'ludaiya thalaivarum seeloavilea aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasalilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil israveal puththirarin koaththirangka'lukkuch seettuppoattuk koduththa suthantharangka'l ivaika'lea; ivvithamaay avarka'l theasaththaip pangkittu mudiththaarka'l.
karththar yoasuvaavai noakki:

nee israveal puththiraroadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: a'riyaamal kaippisakaay oruvanaik kon'ravan oadippoayirukkumpadi, naan moaseayaikko'ndu ungka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa adaikkalappatta'nangka'lai ungka'lukku ea'rpaduththikko'l'lungka'l.
avaika'l ungka'lukku iraththappazhi vaangkuki'ravanudaiya kaikkuth thappippoayirukkaththakka adaikkalamaayirukkum.

anthap patta'nangka'lil on'ri'rku oadivaruki'ravan, patta'naththin olimukavaasalil nin'ruko'ndu, anthap patta'naththinudaiya moopparin sevika'l keadka, than kaariyaththaich solvaanaaka; appozhuthu avarka'l avanaith thangka'lidaththil patta'naththukku'l'lea searththukko'ndu, thangka'loadea kudiyirukka avanukku idam kodukkakkadavarka'l.
pazhivaangkuki'ravan avanaith thodarnthuvanthaal, avan pi'ranai mu'rpakaiyin'ri a'riyaamal kon'rathinaal, avanai ivan kaiyil oppukkodaathirukkavea'ndum.

niyaayam visaarikkum sapaikku munpaaka avan ni'rkumvaraikkum, annaadka'lilirukki'ra pirathaana aasaariyan mara'namadaiyumvaraikkum, avan anthap patta'naththilea kudiyirukkakkadavan; pinpu kolaiseythavan thaan vittoadippoana than patta'naththi'rkum than veetti'rkum thirumpippoakavea'ndum en'ru sol en'raar.

appadiyea avarka'l napthaliyin malaiththeasamaana kalileayaavilu'l'la keatheasaiyum, eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththilu'l'la seekeamaiyum, yoothaavin malaiththeasaththilu'l'la epiroanaakiya keeriyaath arpaavaiyum ea'rpaduththinaarka'l.

erikoavilirukkum yoarthaanukku akkaraiyaana kizhakkilea roopan koaththiraththi'rku irukkum samapoomiyin vanaantharaththilu'l'la peasearaiyum, kaath koaththiraththi'rku irukkum keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththaiyum, manaasea koaththiraththi'rku irukkum paasaanilu'l'la koalaanaiyum ku'riththuvaiththaarka'l.

kaippisakaay oruvanaik kon'ravan evanoa avan sapaikku munpaaka ni'rkumvaraikkum, pazhivaangkuki'ravan kaiyinaal saakaathapadikku, oadippoay othungkumpadi, israveal puththirar yaavarukkum, avarka'l naduvea thangkuki'ra paratheasikkum, ku'rikkappatta patta'nangka'l ivaika'lea.

appozhuthu leaviyarin vamsap pithaakka'lin thalaivar; kaanaantheasaththilirukki'ra seeloavilea aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaaridaththilum, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavinidaththilum, israveal puththirarudaiya koaththirap pithaakka'lilu'l'la thalaivaridaththilum searnthu vanthu:
naangka'l kudiyirukkum patta'nangka'laiyum, engka'l mirukajeevanukkaaka ve'linilangka'laiyum engka'lukkuk kodukkumpadi, karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyittaarea en'raarka'l.
karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea, israveal puththirar thangka'l suthantharaththilea leaviyarukkup patta'nangka'laiyum avaika'lin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l.

koakaaththiyarin vamsangka'lukkuch seettu vizhunthathu; anthach seettinpadi leaviyaril aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaararukku yoothaa koaththiraththilum, simiyoan koaththiraththilum, penyameen koaththiraththilum kidaiththa patta'nangka'l pathinmoon'ru.

koakaaththin mat'rap puththirarukku, eppiraayeem koaththiraththin vamsangka'lukku'l'lum, thaa'n koaththiraththilum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththilum, seettinaal kidaiththa patta'nangka'l paththu.

kersoan puththirarukku, isakkaar koaththiraththin vamsangka'lukku'l'lum, aasear koaththiraththilum, napthali koaththiraththilum, paasaanilirukki'ra manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththilum, seettinaal kidaiththa patta'nangka'l pathinmoon'ru.
meraari puththirarukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadiyea, roopan koaththiraththilum, kaath koaththiraththilum, sepuloan koaththiraththilum kidaiththa patta'nangka'l pannira'ndu.
inthap patta'nangka'laiyum avaika'lin ve'linilangka'laiyum israveal puththirar, karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyittapadiyea, seettuppoattu leaviyarukkuk koduththaarka'l.
leaviyin kumaararil muthalaam seettaippet'ra koakaaththiyarin vamsangka'lilea irukki'ra aaroanin kumaararukku,
yoothaa puththirarin koaththiraththilum, simiyoan puththirarin koaththiraththilum, avarka'l koduththavaika'lum pearpearaakach sollappattavaika'lumaana patta'nangka'lin naamangka'laavana:
yoothaavin malaiththeasaththil aanaakkin thakappanaakiya arpaavin patta'namaana epiroanaiyum athaich soozhntha ve'linilangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l.
patta'naththaich searntha vayalka'laiyum athin pattika'laiyum eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakak koduththaarka'l.
ippadiyea kolaiseythavanukku adaikkalappatta'namaaka aasaariyanaakiya aaroanin kumaararukku epiroanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, lipnaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
yaaththeeraiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, esthemoavaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
oaloanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, thepeeraiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,

aayinaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, yuththaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, pethshimeasaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; antha ira'ndu koaththirangka'lilirukki'ra patta'nangka'l onpathu.
penyameen koaththiraththilea avarka'lukkuk kipiyoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum keapaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
aanathoaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, almoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
aasaariyaraana aaroanudaiya kumaararin patta'nangka'lellaam avaika'lin ve'linilangka'ludpada pathinmoon'ru.
leaviyaraana koakaaththin puththiraril meethiyaana avarka'ludaiya mat'ra vamsangka'lukku eppiraayeem koaththiraththilea avarka'lukkup pangkuveethamaaka avarka'l koduththa patta'nangka'laavana:
kolaiseythavanukku adaikkalappatta'namaana eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththil irukki'ra seekeamaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, keasearaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
kipsaayeemaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, peththoroanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
thaa'n koaththiraththilea elthekkeayaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, kipeththoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
aayaloanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, kaathrimmoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththilea thaanaakaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, kaathrimmoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l ira'ndu.
koakaath puththirarin meethiyaana vamsangka'lukku u'ndaana patta'nangka'lellaam avaika'lin ve'linilangka'ludpadap paththu.

leaviyarin vamsangka'lilea kersoan puththirarukku manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththil kolaiseythavanukku adaikkalappatta'namaana paasaanilu'l'la koalaanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, peyeasthiraavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l ira'ndu.
isakkaarin koaththiraththilea keesoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, thaaparaaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
yarmooththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, enkanneemaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
aasearin koaththiraththilea mishayaalaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, apthoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
elkaaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, reakoapaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.

napthali koaththiraththilea kolaiseythavanukku adaikkalappatta'namaakak kalileayaavilu'l'la keatheasaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, ammoaththoaraiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, karthaanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l moon'ru.
kersoaniyarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi u'ndaana patta'nangka'lellaam avaika'lin ve'linilangka'ludpadap pathinmoon'ru.
mat'ra leaviyaraakiya meraari puththirarin vamsangka'lukkuch sepuloan koaththiraththilea yokniyaamaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, karthaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
thimnaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, nakalaalaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
roopan koaththiraththilea peasearaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, yaakasaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
kethemoaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, mepaakaaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
kaath koaththiraththilea kolaiseythavanukku adaikkalappatta'namaaka, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, maknaayeemaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
espoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, yaasearaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; inthap patta'nangka'l naalu.
ivaika'lellaam leaviyarin mat'ra vamsangka'laakiya meraari puththirarukku, avarka'l vamsangka'linpadi kidaiththa patta'nangka'l; avarka'ludaiya pangkuveetham pannira'ndu patta'nangka'l.
israveal puththirarudaiya kaa'niyaadchiyin naduvilea irukki'ra leaviyarin patta'nangka'lellaam, avaika'lin ve'linilangka'ludpada naa'rpaththettu.
inthap patta'nangka'lil ovvon'ri'rkum athathaich soozhntha ve'linilangka'l irunthathu; ellaap patta'nangka'lukkum appadiyea irunthathu.

inthappirakaaramaakak karththar isravealukkuk koduppean en'ru avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththaiyellaam koduththaar; avarka'l avaika'laich suthanthariththukko'ndu, avaika'lilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.

karththar avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyittapadiyellaam avarka'laich sut'rilum yuththamillaamal i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninaar; avarka'ludaiya ellaach saththurukka'lilum oruvarum avarka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkavillai; avarka'l saththurukka'laiyellaam karththar avarka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.
karththar israveal kudumpaththaarukkuch solliyiruntha nalvaarththaika'lilellaam oru vaarththaiyum thava'rippoakavillai; ellaam ni'raivea'rit'ru.
appozhuthu yoasuvaa roopaniyaraiyum kaaththiyaraiyum manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaiyum azhaiththu,
avarka'lai noakki: karththarudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittavaika'laiyellaam neengka'l kaikko'ndeerka'l; naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta yaavilum en so'rpadi seytheerka'l.
neengka'l ithuvaraikkum aneaka naa'laaka ungka'l sakoathararaik kaividaamal, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya katta'laiyaik kaaththukko'ndu nadantheerka'l.

ippozhuthum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar thaam ungka'l sakoathararukkuch solliyirunthapadiyea, avarka'lai i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninaar; aakaiyaal karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea ungka'lukkuk koduththa ungka'l kaa'niyaadchiyaana theasaththilirukki'ra ungka'l koodaarangka'lukkuth thirumpip poangka'l.

aanaalum neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaril anpukoornthu, avarudaiya vazhika'lilellaam nadanthu, avar ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaraip pat'rikko'ndirunthu, avarai ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ungka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum seavikki'ratha'rkaaka, karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea ungka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa ka'rpanaiyinpadiyeayum niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyeayum seyyumpadimaaththiram veku saavathaanamaayirungka'l en'raan.
ivvithamaay yoasuvaa avarka'lai aaseervathiththu, avarka'lai anuppivittaan; avarka'l thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poayvittaarka'l.

manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththukku moasea paasaanilea suthantharam koduththaan; athin mat'rap paathikku, yoasuvaa yoarthaanukku ippu'raththilea mea'rkea avarka'l sakoathararoadeakoodach suthantharam koduththaan; yoasuvaa avarka'lai avarka'l koodaarangka'lukku anuppividuki'rapoathu, avarka'lai aaseervathiththu:

neengka'l mikuntha aisuvariyaththoadum, makaa earaa'lamaana aadumaaduka'loadum, pon ve'l'li ve'nkalam irumpoadum, aneaka vasthirangka'loadum ungka'l koodaarangka'lukkuth thirumpi, ungka'l saththurukka'lidaththilea ko'l'laiyittathai ungka'l sakoathararoadea pangkittukko'l'lungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum, karththar moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyittapadiyea, thaangka'l kaivasam pa'n'nikko'nda thangka'l kaa'niyaadchi theasamaana keeleayaath theasaththukkup poakumpadikku, kaanaantheasaththilu'l'la seeloaviliruntha israveal puththirarai vittuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.

kaanaantheasaththil irukki'ra yoarthaanin ellaika'lukku vanthapoathu, roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum, angkea yoarthaanin oaraththilea paarvaikkup perithaana oru peedaththaik kattinaarka'l.

roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum kaanaantheasaththukku ethirea israveal puththirarukku aduththa yoarthaanin ellaika'lil oru peedaththaik kattinaarka'l en'ru israveal puththirar kea'lvippattaarka'l.
avarka'l athaik kea'lvippattapoathu, israveal puththirarin sapaiyaarellaarum avarka'lukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'numpadi seeloavilea koodi,

keeleayaath theasaththil irukki'ra roopan puththiraridaththukkum kaath puththiraridaththukkum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaaridaththukkum, aasaariyanaakiya eleyaasaarudaiya kumaaranaakiya pinekaasaiyum,

avanoadeakooda isravealudaiya ellaak koaththirangka'lilum ovvoru pithaavin kudumpaththukku ovvoru pirapuvaakap paththup pirapukka'laiyum anuppinaarka'l; isravealin seanaika'lilea aayiravarka'lukku'l'lea ovvoruvanum than than pithaavin kudumpaththukkuth thalaivanaayirunthaan.
avarka'l keeleayaath theasaththilea roopan puththirar kaath puththirar manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaaraakiya ivarka'lidaththi'rku vanthu:

neengka'l innaa'lilea karththaraip pinpat'raathapadikkup pura'ndu, innaa'lilea karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakam pa'n'numpadiyaaka ungka'lukku oru peedaththaik katti, isravealin theavanukku viroathamaakap pa'n'nina inthath thuroakam enna?
peayoarin akkiramam namakkup poathaathaa? karththarudaiya sapaiyilea vaathai u'ndaayirunthathea; innaa'lvaraikkum naam athinin'ru neengkich suththamaakavillaiyea.

neengka'l innaa'lil karththaraip pinpat'raathapadikkup pura'luveerka'loa? in'ru karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakam pa'n'nuveerka'loa? avar naa'laikku israveal sapaiyanaiththinmealum kadungkoapangko'lvaarea.

ungka'l kaa'niyaadchiyaana theasam theettaayirunthathaanaal, karththarudaiya vaasasthalam thangkuki'ra karththarudaiya kaa'niyaadchiyaana akkaraiyilu'l'la theasaththi'rku vanthu, engka'l naduvea kaa'niyaadchi pet'rukko'l'lalaamea; neengka'l nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin palipeedaththaiyallaamal ungka'lukku vea'roru peedaththaik kattuki'rathinaalea, karththarukkum engka'lukkum viroathamaana ira'ndakam pa'n'naathirungka'l.

searaavin kumaaranaakiya aakaan saapaththeedaana poru'laikku'riththuth thuroakampa'n'ninathinaalea, israveal sapaiyinmealellaam kadungkoapam varavillaiyaa? avan oruvanmaaththiram than akkiramaththinaalea madinthupoakavillaiyen'ru karththarudaiya sapaiyaar ellaarum sollachsonnaarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaaseayin paathik koaththiraththaarum, isravealin aayiravarin thalaivarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:

theavaathi theavanaakiya karththar, theavaathi theavanaakiya karththarea, athai a'rinthirukki'raar; isravealarum a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l; athu ira'ndakaththinaalaavathu, karththarudaiya katta'laikku viroathamaana thuroakaththinaalaavathu seyyappattathaanaal, innaa'lil avar engka'laik kaappaat'raamal irukkakkadavar.

oru kaariyaththaikku'riththu naangka'l engka'lukku anthap peedaththaik kattinathea allaamal, karththaraip pinpat'raathapadikku vilakuvatha'rkaavathu, athinmeal sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyaakilum poajanapaliyaiyaakilum samaathaanapalika'laiyaakilum seluththuki'ratha'rkaavathu athaich seythathu'ndaanaal, karththar athai visaarippaaraaka.
naa'laikku ungka'l pi'l'laika'l engka'l pi'l'laika'lai noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkum ungka'lukkum enna?

roopan puththirar kaath puththirar aakiya ungka'lukkum engka'lukkum naduvea karththar yoarthaanai ellaiyaaka vaiththaar; karththaridaththil ungka'lukkup pangkillai en'ru solli, engka'l pi'l'laika'laik karththarukkup payappadaathirukkach seyvaarka'l enki'ra aiyaththinaalea naangka'l sollikko'ndathu ennaven'raal:

sarvaangka thakanaththi'rkum alla, palikkum alla, engka'l sarvaangka thakanangka'laalum palika'laalum samaathaanapalika'laalum naangka'l karththarin sannithiyil avarudaiya aaraathanaiyaich seyyaththakkavarka'l en'ru engka'lukkum ungka'lukkum, namakkup pinvarum nammudaiya santhathiyaarukkum naduvea saadchi u'ndaayirukkumpadikkum,
karththaridaththil ungka'lukkup pangkillai en'ru ungka'l pi'l'laika'l naa'laikku engka'l pi'l'laika'loadea sollaathapadikkumea, oru peedaththai namakkaaka u'ndupa'n'nuvoam en'roam.

naa'laikku engka'loadaavathu, engka'l santhathiyaaroadaavathu appadich solvaarka'laanaal, appozhuthu sarvaangka thakanaththi'rkum alla, palikkum alla, engka'lukkum ungka'lukkum naduvea saadchikkaaka engka'l pithaakka'l u'ndupa'n'nina karththarudaiya palipeedaththin saayalaana peedaththaip paarungka'l en'ru sollalaam en'roam.

nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin vaasasthalaththi'rku munpaaka irukki'ra avarudaiya palipeedaththaiththavira, naangka'l sarvaangka thakanaththi'rkum, poajanapalikkum, mat'rap palikkum vea'roru peedaththaik kattuki'rathinaalea, karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'nuvathum, in'ru karththaraip pinpat'raathapadikku vilakuvathum, engka'lukkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka en'raarka'l.

roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum manaasea puththirarum solluki'ra vaarththaika'lai aasaariyanaakiya pinekaasum, avanoadea iruntha sapaiyin pirapukka'lum, isravealudaiya aayiravarin thalaivarum keattapoathu, athu avarka'l paarvaikku nan'raayirunthathu.

appozhuthu aasaariyanaana eleyaasaarin kumaaranaakiya pinekaas roopan puththiraraiyum kaath puththiraraiyum manaasea puththiraraiyum noakki: neengka'l karththarukku viroathamaay appadikkoththa thuroakaththaich seyyaathirukki'rathinaalea, karththar nammudaiya naduvea irukki'raar enpathai in'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; ippozhuthu israveal puththiraraik karththarin kaikkuth thappuviththeerka'l en'raan.

aasaariyanaana eleyaasaarin kumaaranaakiya pinekaasum, pirapukka'lum, keeleayaath theasaththil irukki'ra roopan puththiraraiyum kaath puththiraraiyum vittu, kaanaan theasaththi'rku israveal puththiraridaththil thirumpivanthu, avarka'lukku ma'ruseythi sonnaarka'l.

anthach seythi israveal puththirarin paarvaikku nan'raayirunthathu; aakaiyaal roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum kudiyirukki'ra theasaththai azhiththuvida, avarka'lmeal yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappaduvoam enki'ra peachchai vittu, israveal puththirar theavanai sthoaththiriththaarka'l.
karththarea theavan enpatha'rku anthap peedam namakku'l'lea saadchiyaayirukkum en'ru solli, roopan puththirarum kaath puththirarum atha'rku eath en'ru pearittaarka'l.

karththar isravealaich sut'rilum iruntha avarka'ludaiya ellaach saththurukka'laalum yuththamillaathapadikku i'laippaa'rappa'n'ni aneakanaa'l sen'rapinpu, yoasuvaa vayathusen'ru muthirnthavanaanapoathu,
yoasuvaa isravealin moopparaiyum, thalaivaraiyum, niyaayaathipathika'laiyum, athipathika'laiyum, mat'ra ellaaraiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'lai noakki: naan vayathusen'ru muthirnthavanaanean.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukku munpaaka inthach sakala jaathika'lukkum seytha yaavaiyum neengka'l ka'ndeerka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarthaamea ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'ninaar.

paarungka'l, yoarthaan muthal naan nirmoolamaakkinavaika'lum, mea'rkilu'l'la periya samuththiramattum innum meethiyaayirukki'ravaika'lumaana sakala jaathika'lin theasaththaiyum seettuppoattu; ungka'lukku, ungka'l koaththirangka'lukkuththakkathaay, suthantharamaakap pangkittean.

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea, neengka'l avarka'ludaiya theasaththaik kattikko'l'lumpadikku, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarthaamea avarka'lai ungka'lukku munpaakaththuraththi, ungka'l paarvaiyinin'ru akat'rippoaduvaar.

aakaiyaal, moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathaivittu, valathupu'ramaakilum idathupu'ramaakilum vilakippoakaamal, athaiyellaam kaikko'l'lavum seyyavum nir'nayam pa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l.

ungka'lukku'l'lea meethiyaayirukki'ra intha jaathika'loadu kalavaamalum, avarka'ludaiya theavarka'lin pearai ninaiyaamalum, avaika'laikko'ndu aa'naiyidaamalum, avaika'laich seaviyaamalum, pa'ninthuko'l'laamalum irukkumpadi echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
innaa'lmattum neengka'l seythathupoala, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pat'rikko'ndirungka'l.
karththar ungka'lukku munpaakap periyavaika'lum palaththavaika'lumaana jaathika'laith thuraththiyirukki'raar; innaa'lmattum oruvarum ungka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkavillai.
ungka'lil oruvan aayirampearaith thuraththuvaan; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuch sonnapadi, avarthaamea ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'nuki'raar.
aakaiyaal, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaril anpukoorumpadi, ungka'l aaththumaakka'laikku'riththu mikavum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

neengka'l pinvaangkippoay, ungka'lukku'l'lea meethiyaayirukki'ra intha jaathika'laich searnthu, avarka'loadea sampanthang kalanthu, neengka'l avarka'lidaththilum avarka'l ungka'lidaththilum u'ravaadinaal,

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ini intha jaathika'lai ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththividamaattaar en'rum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk koduththa intha nalla theasaththilirunthu azhinthupoakumattum, avarka'l ungka'lukkuk ka'n'niyaakavum, valaiyaakavum, ungka'l vilaakka'lukkuch savukkaakavum, ungka'l ka'nka'lukku mu'l'luka'laakavum iruppaarka'l en'rum nichchayamaay a'riyungka'l.

ithoa, in'ru naan pooloakaththaar ellaarum poaki'ravazhiyea poaki'rean; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkaakach sonna nalvaarththaika'lilellaam oru vaarththaiyum thava'rippoakavillai enpathai ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththaalum ungka'l muzhu aaththumaavaalum a'rinthirukki'reerka'l; avaika'lellaam ungka'lukku ni'raivea'rit'ru; avaika'lil oru vaarththaiyum thava'rippoakavillai.

ippozhuthum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'loadea sonna nalla kaariyamellaam ungka'lidaththilea eppadi ni'raivea'rit'roa, appadiyea, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyai neengka'l mee'ri, anniya theavarka'laich seaviththu, avaika'laip pa'ninthuko'l'lungkaalaththil,

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'lukkuk koduththa intha nalla theasaththilirunthu ungka'lai nirmoolamaakkumattum, karththar ungka'lmeal sakala theemaiyaana kaariyangka'laiyum varappa'n'nuvaar; karththarudaiya koapam ungka'lmeal pat'riyeriyum; avar ungka'lukkuk koduththa nalla theasaththilirunthu neengka'l seekkiramaay azhinthupoaveerka'l en'raan.

pinpu yoasuvaa isravealin koaththirangka'laiyellaam seekeamilea koodivarappa'n'ni, isravealin moopparaiyum, thalaivaraiyum, niyaayaathipathika'laiyum, athipathika'laiyum varavazhaiththaan; avarka'l theavanudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: poorvaththilea ungka'l pithaakka'laakiya aapirakaamukkum naakoarukkum thakappanaana thearaaku enpavan, nathikku appu'raththilea kudiyirunthapoathu avarka'l vea'rea theavarka'laich seaviththaarka'l.

naan nathikku appu'raththil iruntha ungka'l thakappanaakiya aapirakaamai azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, avanaik kaanaantheasamengkum sagncharikkachseythu, avan santhathiyaith thiradchiyaakki, avanukku eesaakkaik koduththean.
eesaakkukku yaakkoapaiyum easaavaiyum katta'laiyittu, easaavukkuch seayeer malaiththeasaththaich suthantharikkumpadi koduththean; yaakkoapum avan pi'l'laika'lumoa ekipthukkup poanaarka'l.
naan moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum anuppi, ekipthiyarai vaathiththean; appadi avarka'l naduvilea naan seythapinpu ungka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ninean.

naan ungka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninapoathu, samuththirakkaraikku vantheerka'l; ekipthiyar irathangka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum ungka'l pithaakka'laich sivantha samuththiramattum pinthodarnthaarka'l.

avarka'l karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; appozhuthu avar ungka'lukkum ekipthiyarukkum naduvea anthakaaraththai varappa'n'ni, samuththiraththai avarka'lmeal pura'lachseythu, avarka'lai moodippoattaar; naan ekipthilea seythathai ungka'l ka'nka'l ka'ndathu; pinpu vanaantharaththil aneakanaa'l sagnchariththeerka'l.

atha'rkuppinpu ungka'lai yoarthaanukku appu'raththilea kudiyiruntha emoariyarin theasaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthean; avarka'l ungka'loadu yuththampa'n'nuki'rapoathu, avarka'lai ungka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththean; avarka'l theasaththaik kattikko'ndeerka'l; avarka'lai ungka'l mukaththinin'ru azhiththuvittean.
appozhuthu sippoarin kumaaran paalaak ennum moavaapiyarin raajaa ezhumpi, isravealoadu yuththampa'n'ni, ungka'laich sapikkumpadi, peayoarin kumaaranaakiya pileayaamai azhaiththanuppinaan.
pileayaamukkuch sevikodukka enakkuch siththamillaathathinaalea, avan ungka'lai aaseervathikkavea aaseervathiththaan, ivvithamaay ungka'lai avan kaikkuth thappuviththean.

pinpu yoarthaanaik kadanthu erikoavukku vantheerka'l; erikoavin kudika'lum, emoariyarum, perisiyarum, kaanaaniyarum, eaththiyarum, kirkaasiyarum, eaviyarum, epoosiyarum, ungka'lukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'lai naan ungka'l kaiyilea oppukkoduththean.

emoariyarin ira'ndu raajaakka'laiyum ungka'l pattayaththaalum ungka'l villaalum neengka'l thuraththavillai; naan ungka'lukku munpaakak ku'lavika'lai anuppinean; avaika'l avarka'lai ungka'l munnin'ru thuraththivittathu.

appadiyea neengka'l pa'npaduththaatha theasaththaiyum, neengka'l kattaatha patta'nangka'laiyum ungka'lukkuk koduththean, avaika'lil kudiyirukki'reerka'l; neengka'l nadaatha thiraadchaththoattangka'lin palanaiyum, olivaththoappuka'lin palanaiyum pusikki'reerka'l en'raar.

aakaiyaal neengka'l karththarukkup payanthu, avarai uththamamum u'nmaiyumaaych seaviththu, ungka'l pithaakka'l nathikku appu'raththilum ekipthilum seaviththa theavarka'lai akat'rivittu, karththaraich seaviyungka'l.

karththaraich seavikki'rathu ungka'l paarvaikku aakaathathaayk ka'ndaal, pinnai yaaraich seavippeerka'l en'ru in'ru therinthuko'l'lungka'l; nathikku appu'raththil ungka'l pithaakka'l seaviththa theavarka'laich seavippeerka'loa? neengka'l vaasampa'n'nuki'ra theasaththuk kudika'laakiya emoariyarin theavarka'laich seavippeerka'loa? naanum en veettaarumoaven'raal, karththaraiyea seavippoam en'raan.
appozhuthu janangka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: vea'rea theavarka'laich seavikkumpadi, karththarai vittu vilakuki'ra kaariyam engka'lukkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka.

nammaiyum nammudaiya pithaakka'laiyum adimaiththana veedaakiya ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, nammudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakap periya adaiyaa'langka'laich seythu, naam nadantha ellaa vazhiyilum, naam kadanthu vantha ellaa janangka'lukku'l'lum nammaik kaappaat'rinavar nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarthaamea.

theasaththilea kudiyiruntha emoariyar muthalaana sakala janangka'laiyum karththar namakku munpaakath thuraththinaarea; aakaiyaal naangka'lum karththaraich seavippoam, avarea nammudaiya theavan en'raarka'l.
yoasuvaa janangka'lai noakki: neengka'l karththaraich seavikkamaatteerka'l; avar parisuththamu'l'la theavan, avar erichchalu'l'la theavan; ungka'l mee'ruthalaiyum ungka'l paavangka'laiyum manniyaar.
karththar ungka'lukku nanmaiseythirukka, neengka'l karththarai vittu, anniya theavarka'laich seaviththaal, avar thirumpi ungka'lukkuth theemai seythu, ungka'lai nirmoolamaakkuvaar en'raan.
janangka'l yoasuvaavai noakki: appadiyalla, naangka'l karththaraiyea seavippoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasuvaa janangka'lai noakki: karththaraich seavikkumpadi neengka'l avaraith therinthuko'ndatha'rku neengka'lea ungka'lukkuch saadchika'l en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'lea saadchika'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: appadiyaanaal, ippozhuthum ungka'l naduvea irukki'ra anniya theavarka'lai akat'rivittu, ungka'l iruthayaththai isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku nearaakath thiruppungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu janangka'l yoasuvaavai noakki: nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraiyea seaviththu, avar saththaththi'rkea keezhppadivoam en'raarka'l.
anthappadi yoasuvaa annaa'lil seekeamilea janangka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, avarka'lukku athaip piramaa'namum niyaayamumaaka ea'rpaduththinaan.

intha vaarththaika'lai yoasuvaa theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthi, oru periya kallai eduththu, athai angkea karththarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththin arukil iruntha karvaali maraththinkeezh naatti,

ellaa janangka'laiyum noakki: ithoa, inthak kal namakku'l'lea saadchiyaayirukkakkadavathu; karththar nammoadea sonna ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum ithu keattathu; neengka'l ungka'l theavanukku viroathamaakap poysollaathapadikku, ithu ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaayirukkakkadavathu en'ru solli,
yoasuvaa janangka'lai avaravar suthantharaththi'rku anuppivittaan.
inthak kaariyangka'l nadanthapinpu, noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaaran noot'ruppaththu vayathu'l'lavanaay mara'namadainthaan.
avanai eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththilu'l'la kaayaas malaikku vadakkea irukki'ra thimnaath searaa ennum avanudaiya suthantharaththin ellaikku'l'lea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.

yoasuvaa uyiroadiruntha sakala naadka'lilum, karththar isravealukkuch seytha avarudaiya kiriyaika'l yaavaiyum a'rinthu yoasuvaavukkuppinpu vekunaa'l uyiroadiruntha moopparudaiya sakala naadka'lilum, isravealar karththaraich seaviththaarka'l.

israveal puththirar ekipthileayirunthu ko'nduvantha yoaseappin elumpuka'lai, avarka'l seekeamilea yaakkoapu seekeamin thakappanaakiya emoariyarudaiya puththirarin kaiyil noo'ru ve'l'likkaasukkuk ko'nda nilaththin pangkilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; antha nilam yoaseappin puththirarukkuch suthantharamaayit'ru.
aaroanin kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaarum mara'namadainthaan, avan kumaaranaakiya pinekaasukku eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththilea kodukkappatta meattilea avanai adakkam pa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoasuvaa mariththapin israveal puththirar karththarai noakki: kaanaaniyarai ethirththu yuththampa'n'numpadi, engka'lil yaar muthalmuthal ezhunthu pu'rappadavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rkuk karththar: yoothaa ezhunthu pu'rappadakkadavan; ithoa, antha theasaththai avan kaiyilea oppukkoduththean en'raar.

appozhuthu yoothaa than sakoatharanaakiya simiyoanai noakki: naam kaanaaniyaroadea yuththampa'n'na nee en suthantharap pangkuveethaththil ennoadeakooda ezhunthuvaa; un suthantharap pangku veethaththil naanum unnoadukooda varuvean en'raan; appadiyea simiyoan avanoadeakoodap poanaan.
yoothaa ezhunthupoanapoathu, karththar kaanaaniyaraiyum perisiyaraiyum avarka'l kaiyilea oppukkoduththaar; avarka'l peaseakkilea pathinaayirampearai vettinaarka'l.
peaseakkilea athoanipeaseakkaik ka'ndu, avanoadu yuththampa'n'ni, kaanaaniyaraiyum perisiyaraiyum vettinaarka'l.
athoanipeaseak oadippoakaiyil, avanaip pinthodarnthu pidiththu, avan kaikaalka'lin peruviralka'laith tha'riththuppoattaarka'l.

appozhuthu athoanipeaseak: ezhupathu raajaakka'l, kaikaalka'lin peruviralka'l tha'rikkappattavarka'laay, en meajaiyinkeezh vizhunthathaip po'rukkith thin'raarka'l; naan eppadich seytheanoa, appadiyea theavan enakkum seythu sarikkattinaar en'raan. avanai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea avan seththuppoanaan.
yoothaavin puththirar erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththu, athilu'l'lavarka'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, patta'naththai akkinikku iraiyaakkivittaarka'l.
pinpu yoothaavin puththirar malaiththeasaththileayum, the'rkeayum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lileayum kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniyaroadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.

appadiyea yoothaa koaththiraththaar epiroanilea kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniyarukku viroathamaayp poay, seasaay, akeemaan, thalmaay enpavarka'lai vettippoattaarka'l. mu'rkaalaththil antha epiroanukkuk keeriyaatharpaa en'ru pear.
angkeayirunthu thepeerin kudika'lukku viroathamaakap poanaarka'l; mu'rkaalaththil thepeerukkuk keeriyaathseppear en'ru pear.
appozhuthu kaaleap: keeriyaathseppearaich sangkaarampa'n'nip pidikki'ravanukku en kumaaraththiyaakiya aksaa'lai vivaakampa'n'nikkoduppean en'raan.
appozhuthu kaaleapudaiya thampiyaakiya keanaasin kumaaran othniyeal athaip pidiththaan; aakaiyaal than kumaaraththiyaakiya aksaa'lai avanukku vivaakampa'n'nikkoduththaan.

ava'l pu'rappadukaiyil, en thakappanidaththil oru vayalve'liyaik keadkavea'ndum en'ru avanidaththil uththaravu pet'rukko'ndu, kazhuthaiyinmealirunthu i'rangkinaa'l. kaaleap ava'lai noakki: unakku ennavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu ava'l: enakku oru aaseervaatham tharavea'ndum; va'radchiyaana nilaththai enakkuth thantheer; neerppaaychchalaana nilangka'laiyum enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'raa'l; appozhuthu kaaleap mea'rpu'raththilum keezhppu'raththilum ava'lukku neerppaaychchalaana nilangka'laik koduththaan.

moaseayin maamanaakiya keaniyanin puththirarum yoothaavin puththiraroadeakoodap peareechchamarangka'lin patta'naththilirunthu aaraaththi'rkuth the'rkeayirukki'ra yoothaavin vanaantharaththi'rku vanthu, janangka'loadea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.

yoothaa than sakoatharanaakiya simiyoanoadungkoodap poanaan; avarka'l seappaaththil kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniyarai mu'riya adiththu, athaich sangkaarampa'n'ni, anthap patta'naththi'rku ormaa en'ru pearittaarka'l.
yoothaa kaasaavaiyum athin ellaiyaiyum, askaloanaiyum athin ellaiyaiyum, ekroanaiyum athin ellaiyaiyum pidiththaan.

karththar yoothaavoadeakooda irunthathinaal, malaiththeasaththaaraith thuraththivittaarka'l; pa'l'laththaakkin kudika'lukku iruppurathangka'l irunthapadiyinaal, avarka'laith thuraththakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.
moasea sonnapadiyea, epiroanaik kaaleapukkuk koduththaarka'l; avan athiliruntha eanaakkin moon'ru kumaararaiyum thuraththivittaan.
penyameen puththirar erusaleamilea kudiyiruntha epoosiyaraiyum thuraththividavillai; aakaiyaal epoosiyar innaa'lmattum penyameen puththiraroadeakooda erusaleamil kudiyirukki'raarka'l.
yoaseappin kudumpaththaarum peththealukku viroathamaayp poanaarka'l; karththar avarka'loadeakooda irunthaar.
yoaseappin puththirar peththealai veavupaarkka aadka'lai anuppinaarka'l; munnea anthap patta'naththi'rku loos en'ru pear.
antha veavukaarar patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappattuvaruki'ra oru manushanaik ka'ndu: patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkum vazhiyai engka'lukkuk kaa'npi, unakkuth thayaiseyvoam en'raarka'l.

appadiyea patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkum vazhiyai avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaan; appozhuthu avarka'l vanthu, patta'naththilu'l'lavarka'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, antha manushanaiyum avan kudumpaththaiyum vittuvittaarka'l.
appozhuthu antha manushan eaththiyarin theasaththi'rkup poay, oru patta'naththaik katti, atha'rku loos en'ru pearittaan; athuthaan innaa'lmattum athin pear.
