manaasea koaththiraththaar pethseyaan patta'naththaaraiyum atha'rku aduththa oorka'lin manusharaiyum, thaanaak patta'naththaaraiyum atha'rku aduththa oorka'lin manusharaiyum, thoarin kudika'laiyum atha'rku aduththa oorka'lin manusharaiyum, ipleyaam patta'naththaaraiyum atha'rku aduththa oorka'lin manusharaiyum, mekithoavin kudika'laiyum atha'rku aduththa oorka'lin manusharaiyum thuraththividavillai; kaanaaniyar antha theasaththileathaanea kudiyirukkavea'ndum en'ru irunthaarka'l.
isravealar palaththapoathu, kaanaaniyarai mut'rilum thuraththividaamal pakuthi kattappa'n'ninaarka'l.
eppiraayeem koaththiraththaar keasearilea kudiyiruntha kaanaaniyaraiyum thuraththividavillai; aakaiyaal kaanaaniyar keasearil avarka'l naduvea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
sepuloan koaththiraththaar kithroanin kudika'laiyum, naakaloalin kudika'laiyum thuraththividavillai, aakaiyaal kaanaaniyar avarka'l naduvea kudiyirunthu, pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laanaarka'l.
aasear koaththiraththaar akkoavin kudika'laiyum, seethoanin kudika'laiyum, aklaap, akseep, elpaa, aappeek, reakoap patta'nangka'lin kudika'laiyum thuraththividavillai.
aaseariyar theasaththin kudika'laakiya kaanaaniyarin naduvea kudiyirunthaarka'l; avarka'lai avarka'l thuraththividavillai.

napthali koaththiraththaar pethshimeasin kudika'laiyum peththaanaaththin kudika'laiyum thuraththividaamal, theasaththin kudika'laakiya kaanaaniyarin naduvea kudiyirunthaarka'l; pethshimeas, peththaanaath patta'nangka'lin kudika'l avarka'lukkup pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laanaarka'l.
emoariyar thaa'n puththiraraip pa'l'laththaakkil i'rangkavottaamal, malaiththeasaththi'rkup poakumpadi nerukkinaarka'l.

emoariyar eareas malaika'lilum aayaloanilum saalpeemilum kudiyirukkavea'ndum en'ru irunthaarka'l; aanaalum yoaseappin kudumpaththaarin kai palaththapadiyinaal, avarka'lukkup pakuthikattuki'ravarka'laanaarka'l.
emoariyarin ellai akkaraapeemukkup poaki'ra meaduthodangki atha'rku appu'ramum poayit'ru.

karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar kilkaalilirunthu poakeemukku vanthu: naan ungka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, ungka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta theasaththil naan ungka'laik ko'nduvanthu vittu, ungka'loadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyai naan orukkaalum mu'riththuppoaduvathillai en'rum,

neengka'l intha theasaththin kudika'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'naamal, avarka'l palipeedangka'lai idiththuvidakkadaveerka'l en'rum sonnean; aanaalum en sollaik kea'laatheapoaneerka'l; ean ippadich seytheerka'l?
aakaiyaal naan avarka'lai ungka'l mukaththi'rku munpaakath thuraththuvathillai en'rean; avarka'l ungka'lai nerukkuvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya theavarka'l ungka'lukkuk ka'n'niyaavaarka'l en'raar.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar intha vaarththaika'lai israveal puththirar ellaaroadum sollukaiyil, janangka'l uraththa saththamittu azhuthaarka'l.
avvidaththi'rkup poakeem en'ru pearittu, angkea karththarukkup paliyittaarka'l.
yoasuvaa israveal puththiraraakiya janangka'lai anuppivittapoathu, avarka'l theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'la avaravar thangka'lthangka'l suthanthara veethaththi'rkup poanaarka'l.

yoasuvaavin sakala naadka'lilum karththar isravealukkaakach seytha avarudaiya periya kiriyaika'laiyellaam ka'ndavarka'lum, yoasuvaavukkup pinpu uyiroadirunthavarka'lumaakiya moopparin sakala naadka'lilum janangka'l karththaraich seaviththaarka'l.
noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum karththarin oozhiyakkaaran noot'ruppaththu vayathu'l'lavanaay mara'namadainthaan.
avanai eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththilu'l'la kaayaas malaikku vadakkeayirukki'ra avanudaiya suthantharaththin ellaiyaakiya thimnaatheareasilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.

akkaalaththil iruntha anthach santhathiyaar ellaarum thangka'l pithaakka'ludan searkkappattapinpu, karththaraiyum, avar isravealukkaakach seytha kiriyaiyaiyum a'riyaatha vea'roru santhathi avarka'lukkuppin ezhumpit'ru.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, paakaalka'laich seaviththu,

thangka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththarai vittu, thangka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra janangka'ludaiya theavarka'laakiya anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'rippoay, avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'ndu, karththarukkuk koapamoottinaarka'l.
avarka'l karththarai vittu, paakaalaiyum astharoaththaiyum seaviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar isravealinmeal koapamoo'ndavaraaki, avarka'l appu'ram thangka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkakkoodaathapadi ko'l'laiyiduki'ra ko'l'laikkaarar kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkoduththu, avarka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra avarka'l pakaignarin kaiyilea vit'ruppoattaar.

karththar solliyapadiyum, karththar avarka'lukku aa'naiyittirunthapadiyum, avarka'l pu'rappattuppoaki'ra idamellaam karththarudaiya kai theemaikken'rea avarka'lukku viroathamaayirunthathu; mikavum nerukkappattaarka'l.
karththar niyaayaathipathika'lai ezhumpappa'n'ninaar; avarka'l ko'l'laiyiduki'ravarka'lin kaikku avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchiththaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l niyaayaathipathika'lin sollaik kea'laamal, anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'rich soarampoay, avaika'laip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l; thangka'l pithaakka'l karththarin ka'rpanaika'lukkuk keezhppadinthu nadantha vazhiyai avarka'l seekkiramaay vittu vilaki, avarka'l seythapadi seyyaama'rpoanaarka'l.

karththar avarka'lukku niyaayaathipathika'lai ezhumpappa'n'nuki'rapoathu, karththar niyaayaathipathiyoadeakooda irunthu, antha niyaayaathipathiyin naadka'lilellaam avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaikku avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchiththuvaruvaar; avarka'l thangka'lai i'rukappidiththu odukkuki'ravarka'linimiththam thavikki'rathinaalea, karththar manasthaapappaduvaar.

niyaayaathipathi mara'namadaintha udanea, avarka'l thirumpi, anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'ravum seavikkavum pa'ninthuko'l'lavum, thangka'l pithaakka'laippaarkkilum keadaay nadanthu, thangka'l kirththiyangka'laiyum thangka'l murattaattamaana vazhiyaiyum vidaathiruppaarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar isravealinmeal koapamoo'ndavaraaki: intha janangka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lukku naan ka'rpiththa en udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri en sollaik kea'laatheapoanapadiyaal,
yoasuvaa mariththup pinvaiththuppoana jaathika'lil oruvaraiyum, naan ini avarka'lukku munpaakath thuraththividaathiruppean.

avarka'l pithaakka'l karththarin vazhiyaik kavaniththathupoala, avarka'l athilea nadakkumpadikku, athaik kavanippaarka'loa illaiyoa en'ru, avarka'laikko'ndu isravealaich soathippatha'rkaaka appadich seyvean en'raar.
atha'rkaakak karththar antha jaathika'lai yoasuvaavin kaiyil oppukkodaamalum, avaika'laich seekkiramaayth thuraththividaamalum vittuvaiththaar.
kaanaan theasaththil nadantha sakala yuththangka'laiyum a'riyaathiruntha isravealaraakiya anaivaraiyum soathippatha'rkaakavum,
israveal puththirarin santhathiyaarum atha'rkumun yuththagnseyya a'riyaathirunthavarka'lum avaika'lai a'riyumpadi pazhakkuvippatha'rkaakavum, karththar vittuvaiththa jaathika'l yaaren'raal:
pelistharin ainthu athipathika'lum, sakala kaanaaniyarum, seethoaniyarum, paakaalermoan thuvakki aamaaththi'rku'l piraveasikkumvaraikkum leepanoanin malaika'lilea kudiyirukki'ra eaviyarumea.

karththar moaseayaikko'ndu thangka'l pithaakka'lukku vithiththa ka'rpanaika'lukku isravealar keezhppadivaarka'loa en'ru a'riyumpadi, isravealarai avarka'laalea soathippatha'rkaaka avarka'l vidappattirunthaarka'l.
ippadi israveal puththirar, kaanaaniyar, eaththiyar, emoariyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyaraakiya ivarka'l naduvea kudiyirunthu,
avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, thangka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lai avarka'l kumaararukkuk koduththu, avarka'l theavarka'laich seaviththaarka'l.
ippadi israveal puththirar karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarai ma'ranthu, paakaalka'laiyum thoappu vikkirakangka'laiyum seavikki'rapoathu,

karththar isravealinmeal koapamoo'ndavaraaki, avarka'lai mesoppoththaamiyaavin raajaavaakiya koosaantishathaayeemin kaiyilea vit'ruppoattaar; ippadiyea israveal puththirar koosaantishathaayeemai ettu varusham seaviththaarka'l.

israveal puththirar karththarai noakkik kooppittapoathu, karththar israveal puththirarai iradchikkumpadi kaaleapin thampiyaana keanaasudaiya kumaaranaakiya othniyeal ennum oru radchakanai avarka'lukku ezhumpappa'n'ninaar.

avanmeal karththarudaiya aavi vanthirunthathinaal, avan isravealai niyaayam visaariththu, yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattaan; karththar mesoppoththaamiyaavin raajaavaakiya koosaantishathaayeemai avan kaiyilea oppukkoduththaar; aakaiyaal avan kai koosaantishathaayeeminmeal palangko'ndathu.
theasam naa'rpathu varusham amaithalaayirunthathu. keanaasin kumaaranaakiya othniyeal mara'namadainthaan.

israveal puththirar ma'rupadiyum karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaarka'l; avarka'l karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythapadiyaal, karththar ekloan ennum moavaapin raajaavai isravealukku viroathamaayp palakkappa'n'ninaar.
avan ammoan puththiraraiyum amaleakkiyaraiyum koottikko'nduvanthu, isravealai mu'riya adiththaan; peareechchamarangka'lin patta'naththaiyum pidiththaan.
ippadiyea israveal puththirar ekloan ennum moavaapin raajaavaip pathinettu varusham seaviththaarka'l.

israveal puththirar karththarai noakkik kooppittapoathu, karththar avarka'lukkup penyameen koaththiraththaanaakiya kearaavin makan eakooth ennum iradchakanai ezhumpappa'n'ninaar; avan idathukaip pazhakkamu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; avan kaiyilea israveal puththirar moavaapin raajaavaakiya ekloanukkuk kaa'nikkai anuppinaarka'l.
eakooth, irupu'ramum karukkum oru muzha nee'lamumaana oru kaththiyai u'ndupa'n'ni, athaith than vasthiraththukku'l'lea than valathupu'raththu iduppilea kattikko'ndu,
kaa'nikkaiyai moavaapin raajaavaakiya ekloanukkuch seluththinaan; ekloan mikavum sthooliththa manushanaayirunthaan.
avan kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththith theernthapinpu, kaa'nikkaiyaich sumanthuvantha janangka'lai anuppivittaan.

avanoa kilkaalilu'l'la silaika'l irukkum idaththilirunthu thirumpivanthu: raajaavea, ummidaththil sollavea'ndiya irakasiyamaana oru vaarththai u'ndu en'raan. atha'rku avan: po'ru en'raan; appozhuthu avanidaththil nin'ra yaavarum avanai vittu ve'liyea poayvittaarka'l.

eakooth avan kittea poanaan; avanoa thanakkuth thanippu'ra iruntha ku'lirchchiyaana a'raiveettil udkaarnthirunthaan; appozhuthu eakooth: ummidaththil sollavea'ndiya theavavaakku enakku u'ndu en'raan; avan than aasanaththilirunthu ezhunthirunthaan.
udanea eakooth than idathukaiyai neetti, than valathupu'raththu iduppilea kattiyiruntha kaththiyai uruvi, athai avan vayit'ri'rku'l paaychchinaan.

alakoadeakoodak kaippidiyum u'l'lea pukunthathu; avanudaiya vayit'ri'rku'l poana kaththiyai ivan izhukkakkoodaathapadikku, ni'nam alakaich sut'rikko'ndu adaiththathu; athu pinpu'raththilea pu'rappattathu.
eakooth pu'rappattu, a'raiveettin kathavaich saaththip poottippoattu, kolukkoodaththin vazhiyaayp poayvittaan.
avan poanapinpu oozhiyakkaarar vanthu paarththaarka'l; ithoa, a'raiveettin kathavu poottiyirunthathu; aakaiyaal avar anthak ku'lirchchiyaana a'raiyilea malajalaathikkirukki'raaraakkum en'raarka'l.

avarka'l saliththuppoakumattum kaaththirunthaarka'l; avan a'raiveettin kathavaith thi'rakkavillai; aakaiyaal oru thi'ravukoalai eduththuth thi'ranthaarka'l; ithoa, avarka'l aa'ndavan tharaiyilea seththukkidanthaan.
avarka'l thaamathiththukko'ndirunthapoathu, eakooth oadippoay, silaika'lu'l'la idaththaik kadanthu, seayiraaththaich searnthu thappinaan.
angkea vanthapoathu eppiraayeem malaiyil ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu israveal puththirar avanoadeakooda malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinaarka'l; avan avarka'lukku munpaaka nadanthu:

ennaip pinthodarnthu vaarungka'l; karththar ungka'l pakaignaraakiya moavaapiyarai ungka'l kaika'lil oppukkoduththaar en'raan. avarka'l avanaip pinthodarnthupoay, moavaapukku ethiraana yoarthaan thu'raika'laip pidiththu, oruvanaiyum kadanthupoakavottaamal,
akkaalaththilea moavaapiyaril ea'rakku'raiyap pathinaayirampearai vettinaarka'l; avarka'lellaarum pushdiyu'l'lavarka'lum paraakkiramasaalika'lumaayirunthaarka'l; avarka'lil oruvanum thappavillai.
ippadiyea annaa'lilea moavaap isravealudaiya kaiyinkeezhth thaazhththappattathu; athanaalea theasam e'npathu varusham amaithalaayirunthathu.
avanukkuppi'rpaadu aanaaththin kumaaran samkaar ezhumpinaan; avan pelistharil a'runoo'rupearai oru thaat'rukkoalaal mu'riya adiththaan; avanum isravealai iradchiththaan.
eakooth mara'namadainthapinpu israveal puththirar thirumpak karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythuvanthaarka'l.

aakaiyaal karththar avarka'lai aathsoaril aa'luki'ra yaapeen ennum kaanaaniyarudaiya raajaavin kaiyilea vit'ruppoattaar; avanudaiya seanaapathikkuch siseraa en'ru pear; avan pu'rajaathika'ludaiya patta'namaakiya aroaseaththilea kudiyirunthaan.
avanukkuth tho'laayiram iruppurathangka'l irunthathu; avan israveal puththirarai irupathu varusham kodumaiyaay odukkinaan; israveal puththirar karththarai noakki mu'raiyittaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea lapithoaththin manaiviyaakiya theporaa'l ennum theerkkatharisiyaanava'l isravealai niyaayam visaariththaa'l.

ava'l eppiraayeem malaiththeasamaana raamaavukkum peththealukkum naduvilirukki'ra theporaa'lin peareechchamaraththinkeezhea kudiyirunthaa'l; angkea israveal puththirar ava'lidaththi'rku niyaayavisaara'naikkup poavaarka'l.

ava'l napthaliyilu'l'la keatheasilirukki'ra apinoakaamin kumaaran paaraakkai varavazhaiththu: nee napthali puththirarilum, sepuloan puththirarilum pathinaayiram pearaik koottikko'ndu, thaapoar malaikkup poakakkadavaay en'rum,

naan yaapeenin seanaapathiyaakiya siseraavaiyum, avan rathangka'laiyum, avan seanaiyaiyum, keesoan pa'l'laththaakkilea unnidaththi'rku vara izhuththu, avanai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'rum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk katta'laiyidavillaiyaa en'raa'l.
atha'rkup paaraak: nee ennoadeakooda vanthaal poavean; ennoadeakooda varaavittaal, naan poakamaattean en'raan.

atha'rku ava'l: naan unnoadeakooda nichchayamaay varuvean; aanaalum nee poaki'ra pirayaa'naththil u'ndaaki'ra meanmai unakkuk kidaiyaathu; karththar siseraavai oru sthireeyin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'ru solli, theporaa'l ezhumpi, paaraakkoadeakoodak keatheasukkup poanaa'l.
appozhuthu paaraak: sepuloan manusharaiyum napthali manusharaiyum keatheasukku varavazhaiththu, thannaip pinsellum pathinaayiram pearoadea poanaan; theporaa'lum avanoadeakoodap poanaa'l.

keaniyanaana eapear enpavan moaseayin maamanaakiya opaapin puththiraraayirukki'ra keaniyarai vittup pirinthu, keatheasin kitta irukki'ra saanaayim ennum karvaalimarangka'l arukea than koodaaraththaip poattirunthaan.
apinoakaamin kumaaran paaraak thaapoar malaiyil ea'rippoanaan en'ru siseraavukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

siseraa tho'laayiram iruppurathangka'laakiya thannudaiya ellaa rathangka'laiyum, thannoadirukkum ellaa janangka'laiyum, pu'rajaathika'lin patta'namaakiya aroaseaththilirunthu keesoan pa'l'laththaakkilea varavazhaiththaan.

appozhuthu theporaa'l paaraakkai noakki: ezhunthupoa; karththar siseraavai un kaiyil oppukkodukkum naa'l ithuvea; karththar unakku munpaakap pu'rappadavillaiyaa en'raa'l; appozhuthu paaraakkum, avan pinnaalea pathinaayirampearum, thaapoar malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinaarka'l.
karththar siseraavaiyum antha ellaa rathangka'laiyum seanaiyanaiththaiyum paaraakkukku munpaakap pattayakkarukkinaal kalangkadiththaar; siseraa rathaththaivitti'rangki kaalnadaiyaay oadippoanaan.
paaraak rathangka'laiyum seanaiyaiyum pu'rajaathika'ludaiya aroaseathmattum thuraththinaan; siseraavin seanaiyellaam pattayakkarukkinaal vizhunthathu; oruvanum meethiyaayirukkavillai.

siseraa kaalnadaiyaayk keaniyanaana eapearin manaivi yaakealudaiya koodaaraththi'rku oadivanthaan; appozhuthu yaapeen ennum aathsoarin raajaavukkum, keaniyanaana eapearin veettukkum samaathaanam u'ndaayirunthathu.

yaakeal ve'liyea siseraavukku ethirko'ndupoay: u'l'lea vaarum; en aa'ndavanea, enna'ndai u'l'lea vaarum, payappadaatheayum en'ru avanoadea sonnaa'l; appadiyea ava'la'ndai koodaaraththil u'l'lea vanthapoathu, avanai oru samukkaa'laththinaalea moodinaa'l.
avan ava'laip paarththu: kudikka enakkuk kogncham tha'n'neer thaa, thaakamaayirukki'rean en'raan; ava'l paal thuruththiyaith thi'ranthu, avanukkuk kudikkakkoduththu, thirumpavum avanai moodinaa'l.
appozhuthu avan: nee koodaaravaasalilea nin'ru, yaaraavathu oruvan vanthu, ingkea yaaraakilum irukki'raarka'laa en'ru unnidaththil keattaal, illai en'ru sol en'raan.

pinpu eapearin manaiviyaakiya yaakeal oru koodaara aa'niyai eduththu, than kaiyilea suththiyaip pidiththuk ko'ndu, me'l'la avana'ndaiyil vanthu, avan net'riyilea antha aa'niyai adiththuppoattaa'l; athu uruvippoay, tharaiyilea puthainthathu; appozhuthu aayaasamaayth thoongkina avan seththuppoanaan.

pinpu siseraavaith thodaruki'ra paaraak vanthaan; appozhuthu yaakeal ve'liyea avanukku ethirko'ndupoay: vaarum, neer theaduki'ra manushanai umakkuk kaa'npippean en'ru sonnaa'l; avan ava'lidaththi'rku vanthapoathu, ithoa, siseraa seththukkidanthaan; aa'ni avan ne'riyil adiththirunthathu.
ippadi theavan annaa'lilea kaanaaniyarin raajaavaakiya yaapeenai israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thaazhththinaar.
israveal puththirarin kai kaanaaniyarin raajaavaakiya yaapeenai nirmoolamaakkumattum avanmeal palaththuk ko'ndeayirunthathu.
annaa'lilea theporaa'lum apinoakaamin kumaaran paaraakkum paadinathaavathu:
karththar isravealukkaaka neethiyaich sarikkattinathinimiththamum, janangka'l manappoorvamaayth thangka'lai oppukkoduththathinimiththamum avarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
raajaakka'lea, kea'lungka'l; athipathika'lea, sevikodungka'l; naan karththaraip paadi, isravealin theavanaakiya karththaraik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
karththaavea, neer seayeerilirunthu pu'rappattu, eathoamin ve'liyilirunthu nadanthuvarukaiyil, poomi athirnthathu, vaanam sorinthathu, meakangka'lum tha'n'neeraayp pozhinthathu.
karththarukku munpaakap parvathangka'l karainthathu; isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka seenaayum karainthathu.
aanaaththin kumaaranaakiya samkaarin naadka'lilum, yaakealin naadka'lilum, perumpaathaika'l paazhaayk kidanthathu; vazhi nadakki'ravarka'l pakkavazhiyaay nadanthaarka'l.
theporaa'laakiya naan ezhumpuma'lavum, isravealilea naan thaayaaka ezhumpuma'lavum, kiraamangka'l paazhaayppoayina, isravealin kiraamangka'l paazhaayppoayina.
noothana theavarka'laith therinthuko'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu yuththam vaasalvaraiyum vanthathu; isravealilea naa'rpathinaayirampearukku'l'lea keadakamum eettiyum kaa'nappattathu'ndoa?
janangka'lukku'l'lea thangka'lai manappoorvamaay oppukkoduththa isravealin athipathika'lai en iruthayam naaduki'rathu; karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
ve'l'laik kazhuthaika'linmeal ea'ruki'ravarka'lea, niyaayasthalaththil veet'rirukki'ravarka'lea, vazhiyil nadakki'ravarka'lea, ithaip pirasthaapiyungka'l.

tha'n'neer mo'nduko'l'lum idangka'lil vilveerarin iraichchalukku neengkinavarka'l angkea karththarin neethiniyaayangka'laiyum, avar isravealilu'l'la thamathu kiraamangka'lukkuch seytha neethiniyaayangka'laiyumea pirasthaapappaduththuvaarka'l; athumuthal karththarin janangka'l olimukavaasalka'lilea poay i'rangkuvaarka'l.
vizhi, vizhi, theporaa'lea, vizhi, vizhi, paattuppaadu; paaraakkea, ezhumpu; apinoakaamin kumaaranea, unnaich si'raiyaakkinavarka'laich si'raiyaakkik ko'ndupoa.
meethiyaayirunthavarka'l janaththin pirapukka'lai aa'lumpadi seythaar; karththar enakkup paraakkiramasaalika'linmeal aa'lukai thanthaar.

amaleakkukku viroathamaaka ivarka'ludaiya vear eppiraayeemilirunthu thu'lirththathu; un janangka'lukku'l'lea penyameen manushar unakkup pinsen'raarka'l; maakeerilirunthu athipathika'lum, sepuloanilirunthu ezhuthukoalaip pidikki'ravarka'lum i'rangkivanthaarka'l.

isakkaarin pirapukka'lum theporaa'loadea irunthaarka'l; paaraakkaippoala isakkaar manusharum pa'l'laththaakkil kaalnadaiyaay anuppappattup poanaarka'l; roopanin pirivinaika'laal u'ndaana iruthayaththin ninaivuka'l mikuthi.
manthaika'lin saththaththaik keadka, nee thozhuvangka'lin naduvea irunthuvittathenna? roopanin pirivinaika'laal manoavisaarangka'l mikuthi.

keeleayaath manushar yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilea irunthuvittaarka'l; thaa'n manushar kappalka'lil thangkiyirunthathenna? aasear manushar kada'rkaraiyilea thangki, thangka'l kudaakka'lil thaapariththaarka'l.
sepuloanum napthaliyum poarkka'laththu munaiyilea thangka'l uyirai e'n'naamal mara'naththukkuth thu'ninthu nin'raarka'l.

raajaakka'l vanthu yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; appozhuthu kaanaaniyarin raajaakka'l mekithoavin tha'n'neer arukaana thaanaakkilea yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'lukkuth thiraviyakko'l'lai kidaikkavillai.
vaanaththilirunthu yuththam u'ndaayit'ru; nadchaththirangka'l thangka'l ayanangka'lilirunthu siseraavoadea yuththampa'n'nina.
keesoan nathi, poorva nathiyaakiya keesoan nathiyea, avarka'lai adiththukko'ndupoayit'ru; en aaththumaavea, nee palavaanka'lai mithiththaay.
appozhuthu kuthiraika'lin ku'lampuka'l, paaychchalinaalea, palavaanka'lin paaychchalinaaleayea, pi'lanthupoayina.

mearoasaich sapiyungka'l; athin kudika'laich sapikkavea sapiyungka'l en'ru karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar solluki'raar; avarka'l karththar padchaththil thu'naini'rka varavillai; paraakkiramasaalika'lukku viroathamaay avarka'l karththar padchaththil thu'naini'rka varavillaiyea.
sthireeka'lukku'l'lea keaniyanaana eapearin manaiviyaakiya yaakeal aaseervathikkappattava'l; koodaaraththil vaasamaayirukki'ra sthireeka'lukku'l'lea ava'l aaseervathikkappattava'lea.
tha'n'neeraik keattaan, paalaik koduththaa'l; raajaakka'lin ki'n'niyilea ve'n'neyaik ko'nduvanthu koduththaa'l.
than kaiyaal aa'niyaiyum, than valathukaiyaal thozhilaa'larin suththiyaiyum pidiththu, siseraavai adiththaa'l; avan net'riyil uruvakkadaavi, avan thalaiyai udaiththuppoattaa'l.
ava'l kaal arukea avan madangki vizhunthukidanthaan, ava'l kaal arukea madangki vizhunthaan; avan engkea madangki vizhunthaanoa angkea madinthu kidanthaan.
siseraavin thaay jannalil nin'ru palaka'nivazhiyaayp paarththukko'ndirunthu: avanudaiya ratham varaamal pinthippoanathenna? avanudaiya rathangka'lin oattam thaamathikki'rathenna en'ru pulampinaa'l.
ava'ludaiya naayakika'lil puththisaalika'l ava'lukku uththaravusonnathuman'ri, ava'l thaanum thanakku ma'rumozhiyaaka:

avarka'l ko'l'laiyaik ka'ndu pidikkavillaiyoa, athaip pangkidavea'ndaamoa, aa'lukku ira'ndoru pe'nka'laiyum, siseraavukkuk ko'l'laiyitta palavaru'namaana aadaika'laiyum, ko'l'laiyitta palavaru'namaana siththirath thaiyalaadaika'laiyum, ko'l'laiyittavarka'lin kazhuththukku irupu'ramum porunthum siththiraththaiyalu'l'la palavaru'namaana aadaiyaiyum kodukkavea'ndaamoa en'raa'l.

karththaavea, ummaip pakaikki'ra yaavarum ippadiyea azhiyakkadavarka'l; avaril anpukooruki'ravarka'loa, vallamaiyoadea uthikki'ra sooriyanaippoala irukkakkadavarka'l en'ru paadinaarka'l. pinpu theasam naa'rpathu varusham amaithalaayirunthathu.
pinnum israveal puththirar karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaarka'l; appozhuthu karththar avarka'lai eazhu varusham meethiyaaniyarin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

meethiyaaniyarin kai isravealinmeal palaththukko'ndapadiyaal, israveal puththirar meethiyaaniyar nimiththam thangka'lukku malaika'lilu'l'la kepika'laiyum kukaika'laiyum ara'naana sthalangka'laiyum adaikkalangka'laakkikko'ndaarka'l.
isravealar vithai vithaiththirukkumpoathu, meethiyaaniyarum amaleakkiyarum kizhakkaththip puththirarum avarka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpi vanthu;
avarka'lukku ethirea paa'layami'rangki, kaasaavin ellaimattum nilaththin vi'laichchalaik keduththu, isravealilea aakaaraththaiyaakilum, aadumaaduka'l kazhuthaika'laiyaakilum vaikkaathea poavaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l mirukajeevanka'loadum, thangka'l koodaarangka'loadum, vettukki'lika'laippoal thira'laay varuvaarka'l; avarka'lum avarka'l ottakangka'lum e'n'nimudiyaathathaayirukkum; inthappirakaaramaaka theasaththaik keduththuvida athilea varuvaarka'l.
ippadi meethiyaaniyaraalea isravealar mikavum si'rumaippattaarka'l; appozhuthu israveal puththirar karththarai noakki mu'raiyittaarka'l.
israveal puththirar meethiyaaniyar nimiththam karththarai noakki mu'raiyittapoathu,

karththar oru theerkkatharisiyai avarka'lidaththi'rku anuppinaar; avan avarka'lai noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'lai ekipthilirunthu varavum, adimaiththana veettilirunthu pu'rappadavum seythu,
ekipthiyar kaiyinin'rum, ungka'lai odukkina yaavarudaiya kaiyinin'rum ungka'lai iradchiththu, avarka'lai ungka'lukku munpaakath thuraththi, avarka'l theasaththai ungka'lukkuk koduththu,

naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'rum, neengka'l kudiyirukkum avarka'l theasaththilu'l'la emoariyarudaiya theavarka'lukkup payappadaathirungka'l en'rum, ungka'lukkuch sonnean; neengka'loa en sollaik kea'laatheapoaneerka'l enki'raar en'ru sonnaan.

atha'rkuppinpu karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar vanthu, apiyeasriyanaana yoavaasin ooraakiya opraavilirukkum oru karvaali maraththinkeezh udkaarnthaar; appozhuthu avanudaiya kumaaran kithiyoan koathumaiyai meethiyaaniyarin kaikkuth thappuvikki'ratha'rkaaka, aalaikkuch sameepamaay athaip poaradiththaan.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar avanukkuth tharisanamaaki: paraakkiramasaaliyea karththar unnoadea irukki'raar en'raar.

appozhuthu kithiyoan avarai noakki: aa en aa'ndavanea, karththar engka'loadea irunthaal, ivaiyellaam engka'lukku neariduvaanean? karththar engka'lai ekipthilirunthu ko'nduvaravillaiyaa en'ru engka'l pithaakka'l engka'lukku vivariththuchsonna avarudaiya a'rputhangka'lellaam engkea? ippozhuthu karththar engka'laik kaivittu, meethiyaaniyar kaiyil engka'lai oppukkoduththaarea en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar avanai noakkippaarththu: unakku irukki'ra inthap palaththoadea poa; nee isravealai meethiyaaniyarin kaikku neengkalaakki radchippaay; unnai anuppuki'ravar naan allavaa en'raar.
atha'rku avan: aa en aa'ndavarea, naan isravealai ethinaalea radchippean; ithoa, manaaseayil en kudumpam mikavum e'liyathu; en thakappan veettil naan ellaarilum si'riyavan en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: naan unnoadeakooda iruppean; orea manushanai mu'riya adippathupoala nee meethiyaaniyarai mu'riya adippaay en'raar.
appozhuthu avan: ummudaiya ka'nka'lil ippozhuthum enakkuth thayai kidaiththathaanaal ennoadea peasuki'ravar theavareerthaan en'ru enakku oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaattavea'ndum.
naan ummidaththi'rku en kaa'nikkaiyaik ko'nduvanthu, umakku munpaaka vaikkuma'lavum, ivvidam vittup poakaathiruppeeraaka en'raan; atha'rku avar: nee thirumpivarumattum naan iruppean en'raar.

udanea kithiyoan u'l'lea poay, oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyaiyum oru marakkaal maavilea pu'lippillaatha appangka'laiyum aayaththappaduththi, i'raichchiyai oru koodaiyil vaiththu, aa'naththai oru ki'n'naththil vaarththu, athai ve'liyea karvaalimaraththin keezhirukki'ra avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu vaiththaan.

appozhuthu theavanudaiya thoothanaanavar avanai noakki: nee i'raichchiyaiyum pu'lippillaatha appangka'laiyum eduththu, inthak ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal vaiththu aa'naththai oot'ru en'raar; avan appadiyea seythaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan thamathu kaiyiliruntha koalin nuniyai neetti, i'raichchiyaiyum pu'lippillaatha appangka'laiyum thottaar; appozhuthu akkini ka'rpaa'raiyilirunthu ezhumpi, i'raichchiyaiyum pu'lippillaatha appangka'laiyum padchiththathu; karththarin thoothanoaven'raal, avan ka'nka'lukku ma'rainthupoanaar.
appozhuthu kithiyoan, avar karththarudaiya thoothan en'ru ka'ndu: aiyoa, karththaraana aa'ndavarea, naan karththarudaiya thoothanai mukamukamaayk ka'ndeanea en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: unakkuch samaathaanam; payappadaathea, nee saavathillai en'ru sonnaar.
angkea kithiyoan karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik katti, atha'rku yekoavaa shaaloam en'ru pearittaan; athu innaa'lvaraikkum apiyeasriyarin ooraakiya opraavil irukki'rathu.

an'ru raaththiriyilea karththar avanai noakki: nee un thakappanukku irukki'ra kaa'laika'lil eazhu vayathaana ira'ndaam kaa'laiyaik ko'ndupoay, un thakappanukku irukki'ra paakaalin palipeedaththaith thakarththu, athin arukeayirukki'ra thoappai vettippoattu,

inthak ka'rpaa'rai uchchiyilea paangkaana oru idaththil un theavanaakiya karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik katti, antha ira'ndaam kaa'laiyaik ko'nduvanthu, athai nee vettippoatta thoappinudaiya kattai vi'rakuka'linmeal sarvaangka thakanamaakap paliyidakkadavaay en'raar.

appozhuthu kithiyoan, than vealaiyaadka'lil paththuppearaich searththu, karththar thanakkuch sonnapadiyea seythaan; avan than thakappan kudumpaththaarukkum antha oor manusharukkum payappattapadiyinaalea, athaip pakalilea seyyaamal, iravilea seythaan.

antha oor manushar kaalamea ezhunthirunthapoathu, ithoa, paakaalin palipeedam thakarkkappattathum, athin arukeayiruntha thoappu vettippoadappattathum, kattappattiruntha palipeedaththinmeal antha ira'ndaam kaa'lai paliyidappattathumaayirukka avarka'l ka'ndu;
oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: inthak kaariyaththaich seythavan yaar en'raarka'l; keattu visaarikki'rapoathu, yoavaasin makan kithiyoan ithaich seythaan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu ooraar yoavaasai noakki: un makanai ve'liyea ko'nduvaa; avan paakaalin palipeedaththaith thakarththu, athin arukeayiruntha thoappai vettippoattaan, avan saakavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

yoavaas thanakku viroathamaaka ni'rki'ra anaivaraiyum paarththu: neengka'laa paakaalukkaaka vazhakkaaduveerka'l? neengka'laa athai iradchippeerka'l? atha'rkaaka vazhakkaaduki'ravan in'ru kaalaiyileathaanea saakakkadavan; athu theavanaanaal than palipeedaththaith thakarththathinimiththam, athu thaanea thanakkaaka vazhakkaadattum en'raan.
than palipeedaththaith thakarththathinimiththam paakaal avanoadea vazhakkaadattum en'ru solli, annaa'lilea avanukku yerupaakaal en'ru pearidappattathu.
meethiyaaniyarum amaleakkiyarum kizhakkaththip puththirar yaavarum eakamaayk koodi, aat'raik kadanthuvanthu, yesrayeal pa'l'laththaakkilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar kithiyoanmeal i'rangkinaar; avan ekkaa'lam oothi, apiyeasriyaraik kooppittu, thanakkup pinsellumpadi seythu,

manaasea naadengkum sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi, avarka'laiyum kooppittu, thanakkup pinsellumpadi seythu, aasear, sepuloan, napthali naaduka'lilum aadka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'lum avanukku ethirko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu kithiyoan theavanai noakki: theavareer sonnapadi en kaiyinaalea isravealai iradchikkavea'ndumaanaal,

ithoa, naan mayiru'l'la oru thoalaik ka'laththilea poaduki'rean; pani thoalinmealmaaththiram peythu, poomiyellaam kaaynthirunthaal, appozhuthu theavareer sonnapadi isravealai en kaiyinaal iradchippeer en'ru athinaalea a'rivean en'raan.
appadiyea aayit'ru. avan ma'runaa'l kaalamea ezhunthirunthu, thoalaik kasakki, athiliruntha panineerai oru ki'n'nam ni'raiyap pizhinthaan.

appozhuthu kithiyoan theavanai noakki: naan innum oruvisaimaaththiram peasuki'rean, umathu koapam enmeal moo'laathiruppathaaka; thoalinaalea naan innum oreavisai soathanaipa'n'nattum; thoalmaaththiram kaaynthirukkavum poomiyengkum pani peythirukkavum katta'laiyidum en'raan.
appadiyea theavan an'ru raaththiri seythaar; thoalmaaththiram kaaynthirunthu, poomiyengkum pani peythirunthathu.

appozhuthu kithiyoanaakiya yerupaakaalum avanoadiruntha janangka'l yaavarum kaalamea ezhunthu pu'rappattu, aaroath ennum neeroot'rin kittap paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; meethiyaaniyarin paa'layam avanukku vadakkea moarea meatti'rkup pinnaana pa'l'laththaakkilea irunthathu.

appozhuthu karththar kithiyoanai noakki: naan meethiyaaniyarai unnoadirukki'ra janaththin kaiyil oppukkodukki'ratha'rku avarka'l mikuthiyaayirukki'raarka'l; en kai ennai radchiththathu en'ru israveal enakku viroathamaaka veempu peasuki'ratha'rku idamaakum.

aakaiyaal payamum thikilum u'l'lavan evanoa avan thirumpi, keeleayaath malaika'lilirunthu viraivaay oadippoakakkadavan en'ru, nee janangka'lin sevika'l keadkap pirasiththappaduththu en'raar; appozhuthu janaththil irupaththeeraayiram pear thirumpip poayvittaarka'l; pathinaayirampear meethiyaayirunthaarka'l.

karththar kithiyoanai noakki: janangka'l innum athikam, avarka'laith tha'n'neera'ndaikku i'rangkippoakappa'n'nu; angkea avarka'laip paridchiththukkaattuvean; unnoadeakooda varalaam en'ru naan yaaraik ku'rikki'reanoa, avan unnoadeakooda varakkadavan; unnoadeakooda varalaakaathu en'ru naan yaaraik ku'rikki'reanoa, avan unnoadeakooda varaathirukkakkadavan en'raar.

appadiyea avan janangka'laith tha'n'neera'ndaikku i'rangkippoakap pa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu karththar kithiyoanai noakki: tha'n'neerai oru naay nakkum pirakaaramaaka athaith than naavinaalea nakkuki'ravan evanoa avanaith thaniyeayum, kudikki'ratha'rku muzhangkaal oon'rik kuniki'ravan evanoa, avanaith thaniyeayum ni'ruththu en'raar.
thangka'l kaiyaal a'l'li, thangka'l vaaykkeduththu, nakkikko'ndavarka'lin lakkam munnoo'rupear; mat'ra janangka'lellaam tha'n'neer kudikki'ratha'rku muzhangkaal oon'rik kuninthaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar kithiyoanai noakki: nakkikkudiththa antha munnoo'rupearaalea naan ungka'lai iradchiththu, meethiyaaniyarai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean, mat'ra janangka'lellaarum thangka'l thangka'l idaththi'rkup poakakkadavarka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu janangka'l thangka'l kaiyil thinpa'ndangka'laiyum ekkaa'langka'laiyum eduththukko'ndaarka'l; mat'ra isravealarellaaraiyum thangka'l thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku anuppivittu, antha munnoo'ru pearaimaaththiram vaiththukko'ndaan; meethiyaaniyarin seanai avanukkuth thaazhvidamaana pa'l'laththaakkil irunthathu.
an'ru raaththiri karththar avanai noakki: nee ezhunthu, anthach seanaiyinidaththi'rkup poa; athai un kaiyil oppukkoduththean.
poakap payappattaayaanaal, muthal neeyum un vealaikkaaranaakiya pooraavum seanaiyinidaththi'rkup poay,

angkea enna peasuki'raarka'l en'ru kea'l; pinpu seanaiyidaththi'rkup poaka, un kaika'l thidappadum en'raar; appadiyea avanum avan vealaikkaaranaakiya pooraavum seanaiyin munna'niyilea jaamam kaakki'ravarka'lin idamattum poanaarka'l.

meethiyaaniyarum, amaleakkiyarum, sakala kizhakkaththip puththirarum, vettukki'lika'laip poalath thira'laayp pa'l'laththaakkilea paduththukkidanthaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya ottakangka'lukkum ka'nakkillai, kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoalath thira'laayirunthathu.

kithiyoan vanthapoathu, oruvan mat'roruvanukku oru soppanaththaich sonnaan. athaavathu: ithoa oru soppanaththaik ka'ndean; suttiruntha oru vaa'rkoathumai appam meethiyaaniyarin paa'layaththi'rku uru'nduvanthathu, athu koodaaramattum vanthapoathu, athai vizhaththa'l'lik kavizhththuppoattathu, koodaaram vizhunthukidanthathu en'raan.

appozhuthu mat'ravan: ithu yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya kithiyoan ennum isravealanudaiya pattayamea allaamal vea'ralla; theavan meethiyaaniyaraiyum, inthach seanai anaiththaiyum avan kaiyilea oppukkoduththaar en'raan.

kithiyoan anthach soppanaththaiyum athin viyaarththiyaiyum keattapoathu, avan pa'ninthuko'ndu, isravealin paa'layaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthu: ezhunthirungka'l, karththar meethiyaaniyarin paa'layaththai ungka'l kaika'lil oppukkoduththaar en'ru solli,
antha munnoo'rupearai moon'ru padaiyaaka vakuththu, avarka'l ovvoruvan kaiyilum oru ekkaa'laththaiyum, ve'rum paanaiyaiyum, anthap paanaikku'l vaikkum theevattiyaiyum koduththu,

avarka'lai noakki: naan seyvathaip paarththu, appadiyea neengka'lum seyyungka'l. ithoa, naan paa'layaththin munna'niyil vanthirukkumpoathu, naan eppadich seyki'reanoa appadiyea neengka'lum seyyavea'ndum.

naanum ennoadea irukkum sakalamaanapearum ekkaa'lam oothumpoathu, neengka'lum paa'layaththaich sut'ri engkum ekkaa'langka'lai oothi, karththarudaiya pattayam kithiyoanudaiya pattayam enpeerka'laaka en'ru sonnaan.

nadujaamaththin thuvakkaththil, jaamakkaararai maat'rivaiththapinpu, kithiyoanum avanoadiruntha noo'rupearum antha jaamaththin thuvakkaththilea paa'layaththin munna'niyil vanthu, ekkaa'langka'lai oothi, thangka'l kaiyiliruntha paanaika'lai udaiththaarka'l.

moon'ru padaika'lin manusharum ekkaa'langka'lai oothi, paanaika'lai udaiththu, theevattika'laith thangka'l idathukaika'lilum, oothum ekkaa'langka'laith thangka'l valathukaika'lilum pidiththukko'ndu, karththarudaiya pattayam kithiyoanudaiya pattayam en'ru saththamittu,
paa'layaththaich sut'rilum avaravar thangka'l nilaiyilea nin'raarka'l; appozhuthu paa'layaththil irunthavarka'l ellaarum sitha'rik kookkuralittu, oadippoanaarka'l.

munnoo'rupearum ekkaa'langka'lai oothukaiyil, karththar paa'layamengkum oruvar pattayaththai oruvarukku viroathamaay oangkappa'n'ninaar; seanaiyaanathu searoaththilu'l'la pethsiththaamattum, thaapaaththi'rkuch sameepamaana aapealmeakolaavin ellaimattum oadippoayit'ru.
appozhuthu napthali manusharum, aasear manusharum, manaaseayin sakala manusharumaakiya isravealar koodivanthu, meethiyaaniyaraip pinthodarnthupoanaarka'l.

kithiyoan eppiraayeem malaika'lengkum aadka'lai anuppi: meethiyaaniyarukku viroathamaayi'rangki, peththaaparaa irukkum yoarthaanmattum vanthu, avarka'lukku munthith thu'raika'laik kattikko'l'lungka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan; appadiyea eppiraayeemin manushar ellaarum koodi, peththaaparaa irukkum yoarthaanmattum vanthu, thu'raika'laik kattikko'ndu,

meethiyaaniyarin ira'ndu athipathika'laakiya oareapaiyum seapaiyum pidiththu, oareapai oareap ennappatta kanmalaiyilum, seapai seap ennappatta aalaiyilum kon'rupoattu, meethiyaaniyaraith thuraththi, oareap seap enpavarka'lin thalaika'lai yoarthaanukku ikkaraiyiliruntha kithiyoanidaththukkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu eppiraayeem manushar avanai noakki: nee meethiyaaniyarmeal yuththampa'n'nappoaki'rapoathu, engka'lai azhaippikkavillaiyea, ippadi nee engka'lukkuch seythathu enna en'ru, avanoadea palaththa vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l seythatha'rku naan seythathu emmaaththiram? apiyeasriyarin thiraadchappazhaththin muzhu a'ruppaippaarkkilum, eppiraayeemarin meethiyaana a'ruppu athikam allavaa?

theavan ungka'l kaiyilea meethiyaaniyarin athipathika'laakiya oareapaiyum seapaiyum oppukkoduththaarea; neengka'l seythathilum naan seyyakkoodiyathu emmaaththiram en'raan; intha vaarththaiyai avan sonnapoathu, avanmealiruntha avarka'ludaiya koapam aa'rit'ru.
kithiyoan yoarthaanukku vanthapoathu, avanum avanoadiruntha munnoo'rupearum athaik kadanthupoay, vidaayththirunthum (saththuruvai) pinthodarnthaarka'l.

avan sukkoaththin manusharai noakki: ennoadirukki'ra janaththi'rkuch sila appangka'laik kodungka'l; avarka'l vidaayththirukki'raarka'l, naan meethiyaaniyarin raajaakka'laakiya seapaavaiyum salmunaavaiyum pinthodaruki'rean en'raan.
atha'rkuch sukkoaththin pirapukka'l: un seanaikku naangka'l appam kodukki'ratha'rkuch seapaa salmunaa enpavarka'lin kai un kaivasamaayit'roa en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu kithiyoan avarka'lai noakki: karththar seapaavaiyum salmunaavaiyum en kaiyil oppukkodukkumpoathu, ungka'l maamsaththai vanaantharaththin mu'l'luka'laalum nerignchilka'laalum kizhiththuviduvean en'ru solli,
avvidam vittu, penoovealukkup poay, avvooraaridaththil anthappadiyea keattaan; sukkoaththin manushar pirathiyuththaramaakach sonnapadiyea penoovealin manusharum avanukkuch sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan, penoovealin manusharaip paarththu: naan samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivarumpoathu, inthak koapuraththai idiththuppoaduvean en'raan.

seapaavum salmunaavum avarka'loadeakooda avarka'ludaiya seanaika'lum ea'rakku'raiya pathinaiyaayirampear karkoaril irunthaarka'l; pattayam uruvaththakka ladchaththu irupathinaayirampear vizhunthapadiyaal, kizhakkaththiyaarin sakala seanaiyilum ivarka'lmaaththiram meenthirunthaarka'l.
kithiyoan koodaarangka'lilea kudiyirukki'ravarka'l vazhiyaay noapaakukkum, yokipeyaavukkum kizhakkea poay, anthach seanai payamillai en'rirunthapoathu, athai mu'riya adiththaan.
seapaavum salmunaavum oadippoanaarka'l; avanoa avarka'laith thodarnthu, seapaa salmunaa ennum meethiyaaniyarin ira'ndu raajaakka'laiyum pidiththu, seanai muzhuvathaiyum kalangkadiththaan.
yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya kithiyoan yuththampa'n'ni, sooriyan uthikkum munnea thirumpivanthapoathu,
sukkoaththin manusharil oru vaalipanaip pidiththu, avanidaththil visaariththaan; avan sukkoaththin pirapukka'lum athin moopparumaakiya ezhupaththeazhu manusharin pearai avanukku ezhuthikkoduththaan.

avan sukkoaththu ooraaridaththil vanthu: ithoa, vidaayththirukki'ra un manusharukku naangka'l appam kodukki'ratha'rkuch seapaa salmunaa enpavarka'lin kai un kaivasamaayit'roa en'ru neengka'l ennai ninthiththuch sonna seapaavum salmunaavum ingkea irukki'raarka'l en'ru solli,
patta'naththin moopparaip pidiththu, vanaantharaththin mu'l'luka'laiyum nerignchilka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, avaika'laal sukkoaththin manusharukkup puththivarappa'n'ni,
penoovealin koapuraththai idiththu, avvoor manusharaiyum kon'rupoattaan.

pinpu avan seapaavaiyum salmunaavaiyum noakki: neengka'l thaapoarilea kon'rupoatta antha manushar eppadippattavarka'l en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avarka'l: neer eppadippattavaroa avarka'lum appadippattavarka'lea; ovvoruvanum paarvaikku raajakumaaranaippoalirunthaan en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: avarka'l en sakoathararum en thaayin pi'l'laika'lumaayirunthaarka'l; avarka'lai uyiroadea vaiththiruntheerka'laanaal, ungka'laik kollaathiruppean en'ru karththarin jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru solli,
than mooththakumaaranaakiya yeththearai noakki: nee ezhunthu, ivarka'lai vettippoadu en'raan; antha vaalipan i'laignanaanapadiyaal payanthu than pattayaththai uruvaathirunthaan.

appozhuthu seapaavum salmunaavum: neerea ezhunthu engka'lmeal vizhum; manushan eppadiyoa appadiyea avan pelanum irukkum en'raarka'l; kithiyoan ezhunthu, seapaavaiyum salmunaavaiyum kon'rupoattu, avarka'l ottakangka'lin kazhuththuka'lil iruntha saanthukkaa'raika'lai eduththukko'ndaan.

appozhuthu israveal manushar kithiyoanai noakki: neer engka'lai meethiyaaniyar kaikku neengkalaakkivittapadiyinaal neerum ummudaiya kumaaranum, ummudaiya kumaaranin kumaaranum, engka'lai aa'lakkadaveerka'l en'raarka'l.
atha'rkuk kithiyoan: naan ungka'lai aa'lamaattean; en kumaaranum ungka'lai aa'lamaattaan; karththarea ungka'lai aa'luvaaraaka en'raan.

pinpu kithiyoan avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lidaththil oru kaariyaththaik keadki'rean; neengka'l avaravar ko'l'laiyitta kadukkanka'lai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan. avarka'l ismavealaraayirunthapadiyinaal avarka'lidaththil ponkadukkanka'l irunthathu.
isravealar: santhoashamaayk koduppoam en'ru solli, oru vasthiraththai viriththu, avaravar ko'l'laiyitta kadukkanka'lai athilea poattaarka'l.

pi'raich sinthaakkuka'lum, aarangka'lum, meethiyaaniyarin raajaakka'l poarththukko'ndiruntha iraththaamparangka'lum, avarka'ludaiya ottakangka'lin kazhuththuka'liliruntha sarappa'nika'lum allaamal, avan keattu vaangkina ponkadukkanka'lin ni'rai aayiraththu ezhunoo'ru pon seakkalin ni'raiyaayirunthathu.

athinaal kithiyoan oru eapoaththai u'ndaakki, athaith than ooraana opraavilea vaiththaan; isravealarellaarum athaip pinpat'rich soarampoanaarka'l; athu kithiyoanukkum avan veettaarukkum ka'n'niyaayit'ru.

inthappirakaaram meethiyaaniyar thirumpa thalaiyedukkakkoodaathapadikku, israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thaazhththappattaarka'l; theasamaanathu kithiyoanin naadka'lil naa'rpathuvarusham amaithalaayirunthathu.
yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya yerupaakaal poay, than veettilea vaasamaayirunthaan.
kithiyoanukku aneakam sthireeka'l irunthaarka'l; avanudaiya karppappi'rappaana kumaarar ezhupathupear.
seekeamiliruntha avanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattiyum avanukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avanukku apimeleakku en'ru pearittaan.
pinpu yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya kithiyoan nalla viruththaappiyaththilea mariththu, opraavilea than thakappanaakiya yoavaas ennum apiyeasriyanudaiya kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
kithiyoan mariththapin israveal puththirar thirumpavum paakaalka'laip pinpat'rich soarampoay, paakaalpeareeththaith thangka'lukkuth theavanaaka vaiththukko'ndaarka'l.
israveal puththirar thangka'laich sut'rilumiruntha thangka'l ellaach saththurukka'lin kaiyinin'rum thangka'lai iradchiththa thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarai ninaiyaamalum,
kithiyoan ennum yerupaakaal isravealukkuch seytha sakala nanmaikkunthakka thayavai avan veettaarukkup paaraattaamalum poanaarka'l.
yerupaakaalin kumaaran apimeleakku seekeamilirukki'ra than thaayin sakoathararidaththi'rkup poay, avarka'laiyum than thaayin thakappanudaiya vamsamaana anaivaraiyum noakki:

yerupaakaalin kumaarar ezhupathupearaakiya ellaarum ungka'lai aa'luvathu ungka'lukku nallathoa, oruvanmaaththiram ungka'lai aa'luvathu ungka'lukku nallathoa en'ru neengka'l seekeamilirukki'ra sakala periya manusharin kaathuka'lum keadkap peasungka'l; naan ungka'l elumpum ungka'l maamsamumaanavan en'ru ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l en'raan.

appadiyea avan thaayin sakoatharar seekeamilirukki'ra sakala periya manusharin kaathuka'lum keadka intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam avanukkaakap peasinaarka'l; appozhuthu: avan nammudaiya sakoatharan en'ru avarka'l sonnathinaal, avarka'l iruthayam apimeleakkaip pinpat'rach saaynthathu.

avarka'l paakaal peareeththin koavililirunthu ezhupathu ve'l'likkaasai eduththu avanukkuk koduththaarka'l; avaika'laal apimeleakku vee'narum poakkirika'lumaana manusharaich seavakaththil vaiththaan; avarka'l avanaip pinpat'rinaarka'l.

avan opraavilirukki'ra than thakappan veetti'rkuppoay, yerupaakaalin kumaararaakiya than sakoatharar ezhupathu pearaiyum orea kallinmeal kolaiseythaan; aanaalum yerupaakaalin i'laiya kumaaranaakiya yoathaam o'liththirunthapadiyinaal avan thappinaan.
pinpu seekeamilirukki'ra sakala periya manusharum, milloavin kudumpaththaaranaivarum koodikko'ndupoay, seekeamilirukki'ra uyarntha karvaalimaraththa'ndaiyilea apimeleakkai raajaavaakkinaarka'l.

ithu yoathaamukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan poay, keriseem malaiyin uchchiyil ea'rinin'ru, uraththasaththamittuk kooppittu, avarka'lai noakki: seekeamin periya manusharea, theavan ungka'lukkuch sevikodukkumpadi neengka'l enakkuch sevikodungka'l.
virudchangka'l thangka'lukku oru raajaavai apisheakampa'n'numpadi poay, olivamaraththaip paarththu: nee engka'lukku raajaavaayiru en'rathu.
atha'rku olivamaram: theavarka'lum manusharum pukazhuki'ra ennilu'l'la en kozhumaiyai naan vittu, marangka'lai arasaa'lappoaveanoa en'rathu.
appozhuthu marangka'l aththimaraththaip paarththu: nee vanthu, engka'lukku raajaavaayiru en'rathu.
atha'rku aththimaram: naan en mathuraththaiyum en na'rkaniyaiyum vittu, marangka'lai arasaa'lappoaveanoa en'rathu.
appozhuthu marangka'l thiraadchasediyaip paarththu: nee vanthu, engka'lukku raajaavaayiru en'rathu.
atha'rkuth thiraadchachsedi: theavarka'laiyum manusharaiyum makizhappa'n'num en rasaththai naan vittu marangka'lai arasaa'lappoaveanoa en'rathu.
appozhuthu marangka'lellaam mudchediyaip paarththu: nee vanthu, engka'lukku raajaavaayiru en'rathu.

atha'rku mudchediyaanathu marangka'laip paarththu: neengka'l ennai ungka'lukku raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'nuki'rathu meyyaanaal, en nizhalilea vanthadaiyungka'l; illaavittaal mudchediyilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu leepanoanin keathurumarangka'laip padchikkakkadavathu en'rathu.
en thakappan ungka'lukkaaka yuththampa'n'ni, than jeevanai e'n'naama'rpoay, ungka'lai meethiyaaniyarin kaiyinin'ru iradchiththaar.

neengka'loa in'ru en thakappanudaiya kudumpaththukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, avarudaiya kumaararaana ezhupathupearaiyum orea kallinmeal kolaiseythu, avarudaiya vealaikkaariyin makanaakiya apimeleakku ungka'l sakoatharanaanapadiyinaal, avanaich seekeam patta'naththaarukku raajaavaakkineerka'l.
ippoathum neengka'l avanai raajaavaakkina seykai u'nmaiyum uththamamumaana seykaiyaayirukkumaanaal,

neengka'l yerupaakaalaiyum avar kudumpaththaaraiyum nanmaiyaaka nadaththi, avar kaika'lin seykaikkuththakkathai avarukkuch seythu, ippadi innaa'lil avaraiyum avar kudumpaththaaraiyum nadaththinathu u'nmaiyum uththamumaayirukkumaanaal, apimeleakkinmeal neengka'lum santhoashamaayirungka'l; ungka'lmeal avanum santhoashamaayirukkattum.

illaavittaal apimeleakkilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, seekeam patta'naththaaraiyum, milloavin kudumpaththaaraiyum padchikkavum, seekeam patta'naththaarilum milloavin kudumpaththaarilumirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, apimeleakkaip padchikkavumkadavathu en'ru yoathaam solli,
than sakoatharanaakiya apimeleakkukkup payanthu, thappiyoadi, peayearukkup poay, angkea kudiyirunthaan.
apimeleakku isravealai moon'ru varusham arasaa'ndapinpu,
apimeleakkukkum seekeamin periya manusharukkum naduvea pollaappu u'ndaakkum aaviyaith theavan varappa'n'ninaar.

yerupaakaalin ezhupathu kumaararukkuch seyyappatta kodumai vanthu paliththu, avarka'ludaiya iraththappazhi avarka'laik kon'ra avarka'ludaiya sakoatharanaakiya apimeleakkinmealum, than sakoathararaik kolla avan kaika'laith thidappaduththina seekeam manushar mealum sumarumpadiyaakach seekeamin periya manushar apimeleakkukku ira'ndakampa'n'ninaarka'l.

seekeamin manushar malaika'lin uchchiyil avanukkup pathivirukki'ravarka'lai vaiththaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l arukea vazhinadanthupoaki'ra yaavaraiyum ko'l'laiyittaarka'l; athu apimeleakkukku a'rivikkappattathu.
eapeathin kumaaranaakiya kaakaal than sakoathararoadea seekeamukku'l poanaan; seekeamin periya manushar avanai nampi,

ve'liyea pu'rappattu, thangka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'lin pazhangka'lai a'ruththu, aalaiyaatti, aadippaadi, thangka'l theavanin veetti'rku'l poay, pusiththuk kudiththu, apimeleakkai sapiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu eapeathin kumaaranaakiya kaakaal: apimeleakku yaar? seekeam yaar? naam avanaich seavikkavea'ndiyathenna? avan yerupaakaalin makan allavaa? seapool avanudaiya kaariyakkaaran allavaa? seekeamin thakappanaakiya eamoarin manusharaiyea seaviyungka'l; avanai naangka'l seavippaanean?
intha janangka'lmaaththiram en kaikku'l irukkattum; naan apimeleakkaith thuraththividuvean en'raan. un seanaiyaip perukappa'n'nip pu'rappattuvaa en'ru, avan apimeleakkukkuch solliyanuppinaan.
patta'naththin athikaariyaakiya seapool eapeathin kumaaranaakiya kaakaalin vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, koapamoo'ndu,

irakasiyamaay apimeleakkinidaththukku aadka'lai anuppi: ithoa, eapeathin kumaaranaakiya kaakaalum avanudaiya sakoathararum seekeamukku vanthirukki'raarka'l; patta'naththai umakku viroathamaaka ezhuppuki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal neer ummoadirukkum janangka'loadeakooda iravil ezhunthuvanthu ve'liyilea pathivirunthu,

kaalamea sooriyan uthikkaiyil ezhumpi, patta'naththinmeal vizhunthu, avanum avanoadirukki'ra janangka'lum umakku ethirea pu'rappadumpoathu, ummudaiya kaikku neariduki'rapadi avanukkuch seyyum en'ru solliyanuppinaan.
appadiyea apimeleakkum, avanoadiruntha sakala janangka'lum, iravil ezhunthupoay, seekeamukku viroathamaaka naalu padaiyaakap pathivirunthaarka'l.
eapeathin kumaaran kaakaal pu'rappattu, patta'naththin olimukavaasalil nin'raan; appozhuthu pathiviruntha apimeleakku thannoadirukki'ra janangka'loadeakooda ezhumpivanthaan.

kaakaal antha janangka'laik ka'ndu: ithoa, malaika'lin uchchika'lilirunthu janangka'l i'rangkivaruki'raarka'l en'ru seapooloadea sonnaan. atha'rkuch seapool: nee malaika'lin nizhalaik ka'ndu, manushar en'ru ninaikki'raay en'raan.
kaakaaloa thirumpavum: ithoa, janangka'l theasaththin meattilirunthu i'rangkivanthu, oru padai meyoneneemin karvaalimaraththin vazhiyaay varuki'rathu en'raan.

atha'rkuch seapool: apimeleakkai naam seavikki'ratha'rku avan yaar en'ru nee sonna un vaay ippozhuthu engkea? nee ninthiththa janangka'l avarka'l allavaa? ippozhuthu nee pu'rappattu, avarka'loadea yuththampa'n'nu en'raan.
appozhuthu kaakaal seekeamin manusharukku munpaakap pu'rappattuppoay, apimeleakkoadea yuththampa'n'ninaan.
apimeleakku avanaith thuraththa, avan avanukku munpaaka oadinaan; patta'navaasalmattum aneakar vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.
apimeleakku arumaavil irunthuvittaan; seapool kaakaalaiyum avan sakoathararaiyum seekeamilea kudiyiraathapadikkuth thuraththivittaan.
ma'runaa'lilea janangka'l ve'liyilea vayalukkup poanaarka'l; athu apimeleakkukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

avan janangka'laik koottikko'ndu, avarka'lai moon'ru padaiyaaka vakuththu, ve'liyilea pathivirunthu, antha janangka'l patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'rathaik ka'ndu, avarka'lmeal ezhumpi, avarka'lai vettinaan.
apimeleakkum avanoadiruntha padaiyum paaynthuvanthu, patta'naththin olimukavaasalil nin'raarka'l; mat'ra ira'ndu padaika'loa ve'liyilirukki'ra yaavarmealum vizhunthu, avarka'lai vettinaarka'l.
apimeleakku annaa'l muzhuthum patta'naththinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, patta'naththaip pidiththu, athiliruntha janangka'laik kon'ru, patta'naththai idiththu vittu, athil uppu vithaiththaan.
athaich seekeam thurukkaththu manushar ellaarum kea'lvippattapoathu, avarka'l peareeth theavanudaiya koavil ara'nukku'l piraveasiththaarka'l.
seekeam thurukkaththu manushar ellaarum angkea koodiyirukki'rathu apimeleakkukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

apimeleakku thannoadiruntha ellaa janangka'loadungkoodach salmoan malaiyil ea'ri, than kaiyilea koadariyaip pidiththu, oru maraththin kompai vetti, athai eduththu, than thoa'linmeal poattukko'ndu, thannoadiruntha janangka'lai noakki: naan enna seyki'rean en'ru paarkki'reerka'lea, neengka'lum theeviramaay ennaippoalach seyyungka'l en'raan.

appadiyea sakala janangka'lum avaravar ovvoru kompai vetti, apimeleakkukkup pinsen'ru, avaika'lai antha ara'nukku arukea poattu, akkini ko'luththi antha ara'naich suttuppoattaarka'l; athinaal purusharum sthireeka'lum ea'rakku'raiya aayirampearaakiya seekeam thurukkaththu manushar ellaarum seththaarka'l.
pinpu apimeleakku theapeasukkuppoay, atha'rku viroathamaayp paa'layami'rangki, athaip pidiththaan.

anthap patta'naththin naduvea palaththa thurukkam irunthathu; angkea sakala purusharum sthireeka'lum patta'naththu manushar anaivarum oadip pukunthu, kathavaip poottikko'ndu, thurukkaththinmeal ea'rinaarka'l.
apimeleakku anthath thurukkammattum vanthu, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, thurukkaththin kathavaich sutteriththup poadumpadikku, athin kittach searnthaan.
appozhuthu oru sthiree oru eanthirakkallin thu'ndai apimeleakkudaiya thalaiyinmeal poattaa'l; athu avan ma'ndaiyai udaiththathu.

udanea avan than aayuthathaariyaakiya vealaikkaaranaik kooppittu: oru sthiree ennaik kon'raa'l en'ru ennaikku'riththuch sollaathapadikku, nee un pattayaththai uruvi, ennaik kon'rupoadu en'ru avanoadea sonnaan; appadiyea avan vealaikkaaran avanai uruvak kuththinaan, avan seththuppoanaan.
apimeleakkuch seththuppoanathai israveal manushar ka'ndapoathu, avarka'l thangka'lthangka'l idangka'lukkup poayvittaarka'l.
ippadiyea apimeleakku thannudaiya ezhupathu sakoathararaik kolaiseythathinaal, than thakappanukkuch seytha pollaappai theavan avanmeal thirumpumpadi seythaar.
seekeam manushar seytha ellaap pollaappaiyum theavan avarka'l thalaiyinmeal thirumpumpadi seythaar; yerupaakaalin kumaaran yoathaamin saapam avarka'lukkup paliththathu.

apimeleakkukkuppinpu, thoathoavin makanaakiya poovaavin kumaaran thoalaa ennum isakkaar koaththiraththaan isravealai iradchikka ezhumpinaan; avan eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththu ooraakiya saameerilea kudiyirunthaan.
avan isravealai irupaththumoon'ru varusham niyaayam visaariththu, pinpu mariththu, saameerilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
avanukkuppinpu, keeleayaaththiyanaana yaaveer ezhumpi, isravealai irupaththira'ndu varusham niyaayam visaariththaan.

muppathu kazhuthaikkuttika'linmeal ea'rum muppathu kumaarar avanukku irunthaarka'l; avarka'lukku muppathu oorka'lum irunthathu; keeleayaath theasaththilirukki'ra avaika'lukku innaa'lvaraikkum yaaveerin kiraamangka'lenki'ra pear irukki'rathu.
yaaveer mariththu, kaamoanilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.

israveal puththirar, ma'rupadiyum karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappuch seythu, karththaraich seaviyaamal avarai vittup poay, paakaalka'laiyum, astharoaththaiyum, seeriyaavin theavarka'laiyum, seethoanin theavarka'laiyum, moavaapin theavarka'laiyum, ammoan puththirarin theavarka'laiyum, pelistharin theavarka'laiyum seaviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththar isravealinmeal koapamoo'ndu, avarka'laip pelisthar kaiyilum, ammoan puththirar kaiyilum vit'ruppoattaar.
avarka'l antha varusham mutha'rko'ndu pathinettu varushamaay yoarthaanukku appaalea keeleayaaththilu'l'la emoariyarin theasaththil irukki'ra israveal puththiraraiyellaam nerukki odukkinaarka'l.
ammoan puththirar yoothaavinmealum, penyameenmealum, eppiraayeem kudumpaththaarmealum yuththampa'n'na yoarthaanaik kadanthuvanthaarka'l; isravealar mikavum nerukkappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar karththarai noakki mu'raiyittu: umakku viroathamaakap paavagnseythoam; naangka'l engka'l theavanaivittu, paakaalka'laich seaviththoam en'raarka'l.
karththar israveal puththirarai noakki: ekipthiyarum, emoariyarum, ammoan puththirarum, pelisthiyarum,
seethoaniyarum, amaleakkiyarum, maakoaniyarum, ungka'lai odukkum samayangka'lil, neengka'l ennai noakki mu'raiyittapoathu, naan ungka'lai avarka'l kaikku neengkalaakki iradchikkavillaiyaa?
appadiyirunthum neengka'l ennaivittu, anniya theavarka'laich seaviththeerka'l; aakaiyaal ini ungka'lai iradchiyean.
neengka'l poay, ungka'lukkaakath therinthuko'nda theavarka'lai noakki mu'raiyidungka'l; avaika'l ungka'l aapaththin kaalaththil ungka'lai iradchikkattum en'raar.
israveal puththirar karththarai noakki: paavagnseythoam, theavareer ummudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanathai engka'lukkuch seyyum; in'raikkumaaththiram engka'lai iradchiththaru'lum en'ru solli,
anniya theavarka'laith thangka'l naduvilirunthu vilakkivittu, karththarukku aaraathanai seythaarka'l; appozhuthu avar isravealin varuththaththaip paarththu manathurukinaar.
ammoan puththirar koottangkoodi, keeleayaaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; israveal puththirarum koodikko'ndu, mispaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu keeleayaaththin janangka'lum pirapukka'lum oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: ammoan puththirarmeal munthi yuththampa'n'nappoaki'ra manushan yaar? avanea keeleayaaththin kudika'lukkellaam thalaivanaayiruppaan en'raarka'l.
keeleayaaththiyanaana yepthaa palaththa paraakkiramasaaliyaayirunthaan; avan parasthireeyin kumaaran; kileyaath avanaip pet'raan.

kileyaaththin manaiviyum avanukkuk kumaararka'laip pet'raa'l; avan manaivi pet'ra kumaarar periyavarka'laana pinpu, avarka'l yepthaavai noakki: unakku engka'l thakappan veettilea suthantharam illai; nee anniya sthireeyin makan en'ru solli avanaith thuraththinaarka'l.
appozhuthu yepthaa: than sakoathararai vittu oadippoay, thoaptheasaththilea kudiyirunthaan; vee'naraana manushar yepthaavoadea koodikko'ndu, avanoadeakooda yuththaththi'rkup poavaarka'l.
silanaa'laikkuppinpu, ammoan puththirar isravealinmeal yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avarka'l isravealinmeal yuththampa'n'numpoathu keeleayaaththin mooppar yepthaavaith thoaptheasaththilirunthu azhaiththuvarappoay,
yepthaavai noakki: nee vanthu, naangka'l ammoan puththiraroadu yuththampa'n'na engka'l seanaapathiyaayirukka vea'ndum en'raarka'l.

atha'rku yepthaa keeleayaaththin moopparaip paarththu: neengka'l allavaa ennaip pakaiththu, en thakappan veettilirunthu ennaith thuraththinavarka'l? ippozhuthu ungka'lukku aapaththu nearittirukki'ra samayaththil neengka'l ennidaththil ean varuki'reerka'l en'raan.

atha'rkuk keeleayaaththin mooppar yepthaavai noakki: nee engka'ludaneakooda vanthu, ammoan puththiraroadu yuththampa'n'ni, keeleayaaththin kudika'laakiya engka'l anaivarmealum thalaivanaayirukkavea'ndum; itha'rkaaka ippozhuthu unnidaththil vanthoam en'raarka'l.

atha'rku yepthaa: ammoan puththiraroadea yuththampa'n'na, neengka'l ennaith thirumpa azhaiththuppoanapinpu, karththar avarka'lai en munnilaiyaay oppukkoduththaal, ennai ungka'lukkuth thalaivanaay vaippeerka'laa en'ru keeleayaaththin moopparaik keattaan.
keeleayaaththin mooppar yepthaavaip paarththu: naangka'l un vaarththaiyinpadiyea seyyaavittaal, karththar namakku nadunin'ru keadpaaraaka en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu yepthaa keeleayaaththin moopparoadea koodappoanaan; janangka'l avanaith thangka'lmeal thalaivanum seanaapathiyumaaka vaiththaarka'l. yepthaa than kaariyangka'laiyellaam mispaavilea karththarudaiya sannithiyilea sonnaan.

pinpu yepthaa ammoan puththirarin raajaavinidaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: nee en theasaththil enakku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'na varuki'ratha'rku, enakkum unakkum enna vazhakku irukki'rathu en'ru keadkachsonnaan.

ammoan puththirarin raajaa yepthaavin sthaanaapathika'lai noakki: isravealar ekipthilirunthu varuki'rapoathu, arnoan thuvakki yaapoakmattum, yoarthaanmattum irukki'ra en theasaththaik kattikko'ndaarka'lea; ippozhuthu athai enakkuch samaathaanamaayth thirumpak koduththuvidavea'ndum en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
yepthaa ma'rupadiyum ammoan puththirarin raajaavinidaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi, avanukkuch sollachsonnathaavathu:
yepthaa solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: isravealar moavaapiyarin theasaththaiyaakilum, ammoan puththirarin theasaththaiyaakilum kattikko'ndathillaiyea.
isravealar ekipthilirunthu varuki'rapoathu, vanaantharaththil sivantha samuththiramattum nadanthu, pinpu kaatheasukku vanthu,

isravealar eathoamin raajaavinidaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: naangka'l un theasaththuvazhiyaayk kadanthupoakattum en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l; atha'rku eathoamin raajaa sevikodukkavillai; appadiyea moavaapin raajaavinidaththi'rkum anuppinaarka'l; avanum sammathikkavillai. aathalaal isravealar kaatheasilea thariththirunthu,

pinpu vanaantharavazhiyaay nadanthu eathoam theasaththaiyum moavaap theasaththaiyum sut'rippoay, moavaapin theasaththi'rkuk kizhakkeavanthu, moavaapin ellaikku'l piraveasiyaamal, moavaapin ellaiyaana arnoan nathikku appaalea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu isravealar espoanil aa'luki'ra seekoan ennum emoariyarin raajaavinidaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: naangka'l un theasaththu vazhiyaay engka'l sthaanaththi'rkuk kadanthupoaka idangkodu en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.
seekoan isravealarai nampaathathinaal, than ellaiyaik kadanthupoaki'ratha'rku idangkodaamal than janangka'laiyellaam kootti, yaakaasilea paa'layami'rangki, isravealaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar seekoanaiyum avanudaiya ellaa janangka'laiyum isravealarin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarka'lai mu'riya adiththaarka'l; appadiyea isravealar antha theasaththilea kudiyiruntha emoariyarin seemaiyaiyellaam pidiththu, arnoan thuvakki,
yaapoakmattum, vanaantharamthuvakki yoarthaanmattum irukki'ra emoariyarin ellaiyaiyellaam suthantharamaayk kattikko'ndaarka'l.
ippadi isravealin theavanaakiya karththar emoariyaraith thammudaiya janamaakiya isravealukku munpaakath thuraththiyirukka, neer antha theasaththaik kattikko'l'laththakumaa?

ummudaiya theavanaakiya kaamoas umakku munpaakath thuraththuki'ravarka'lin theasaththai neer kattikko'l'lamaatteeroa? appadiyea engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukku munpaakath thuraththuki'ravarka'lin theasaththaiyellaam naangka'lum kattikko'l'luki'roam.

mealum sippoarin kumaaranaakiya paalaak ennum moavaapin raajaavaippaarkkilum umakku athika niyaayam u'ndoa? avan isravealoadea eppoathaakilum vazhakkaadinaanaa? eppoathaakilum avarka'lukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ninaanaa?

isravealar espoanilum athin kiraamangka'lilum, aaroavearilum athin kiraamangka'lilum, arnoan nathiyarukaana ellaa oorka'lilum, munnoo'ru varusham kudiyirukkaiyil, ivva'lavukaalamaay neengka'l athaith thiruppikko'l'laathea poanathenna?

naan umakku viroathamaayk kut'ram seyyavillai; neer enakku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuki'rathinaal neerthaan enakku aniyaayam seyki'reer; niyaayaathipathiyaakiya karththar in'ru israveal puththirarukkum ammoan puththirarukkum nadunin'ru niyaayam theerkkakkadavar en'ru solli anuppinaan.
aanaalum ammoan puththirarin raajaa thanakku yepthaa solliyanuppina vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodaathea poanaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi yepthaavinmeal i'rangkinaar; avan keeleayaaththaiyum manaasea naattaiyum kadanthupoay, keeleayaaththilirukki'ra mispaavukku vanthu, angkeayirunthu ammoan puththirarukku viroathamaakap poanaan.
appozhuthu yepthaa karththarukku oru poruththanaiyaip pa'n'ni: theavareer ammoan puththirarai en kaiyil oppukkodukkavea oppukkoduththaal,

naan ammoan puththiraridaththilirunthu samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivarumpoathu, en veettu vaasa'rpadiyilirunthu enakku ethirko'ndu varuvathu ethuvoa athu karththarukku uriyathaakum, athaich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththuvean en'raan.
yepthaa ammoan puththirarinmeal yuththampa'n'na, avarka'lukku viroathamaayp pu'rappattuppoanaan; karththar avarka'lai avan kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

avan avarka'lai aaroavear thuvakki minniththi'rkup poakumattum, thiraadchaththoattaththu nilangka'lvaraikkum, makaa sangkaaramaay mu'riya adiththu, irupathu patta'nangka'laip pidiththaan; ippadi ammoan puththirar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thaazhththappattaarka'l.

yepthaa mispaavilirukki'ra than veettukku varuki'rapoathu, ithoa, avan kumaaraththi thampuru vaasiththu nadanagnseythu, avanukku ethirko'ndu vanthaa'l; ava'l avanukku orea pi'l'laiyaanava'l; ava'laiyallaamal avanukkuk kumaaranum illai kumaaraththiyum illai.

avan ava'laik ka'ndavudanea than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: aiyoa! en maka'lea, ennai mikavum manamadiyavum kalangkavum pa'n'nuki'raay; naan karththarai noakki en vaayaith thi'ranthu sollivittean; athai naan maat'rakkoodaathu en'raan.

appozhuthu ava'l: en thakappanea, neer karththarai noakki ummudaiya vaayaith thi'ranthu peasineerallavoa? ammoan puththiraraakiya ummudaiya saththurukka'lukku neethiyaich sarikkattum jeyaththaik karththar umakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyinaal, ummudaiya vaayilirunthu pu'rappattapadiyea enakkuch seyyum en'raa'l.

pinnum ava'l than thakappanai noakki: neer enakku oru kaariyam seyyavea'ndum; naan malaika'linmeal poayth thirinthu, naanum en thoazhimaarka'lum en kannimaiyinimiththam thukkangko'ndaada, enakku ira'ndumaatham thava'naikodum en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: poayvaa en'ru ava'lai ira'ndu maathaththi'rku anuppivittaan; ava'l than thoazhimaarka'loadum koodappoay, than kannimaiyinimiththam malaika'linmeal thukkangko'ndaadi,
ira'ndumaatham mudinthapinpu, than thakappanidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthaa'l; appozhuthu avan pa'n'niyiruntha than poruththanaiyinpadi ava'lukkuch seythaan; ava'l purushanai a'riyaathirunthaa'l.
ithinimiththam isravealin kumaaraththika'l varushanthoa'rum poay, naalu naa'l keeleayaaththiyanaana yepthaavin kumaaraththiyaikku'riththup pulampuvathu isravealilea vazhakkamaayit'ru.

eppiraayeem manushar eakamaayk koodi vadakkea pu'rappattuppoay, yepthaavai noakki: nee engka'lai unnoadeakooda varumpadi azhaippiyaamal ammoan puththirarmeal yuththampa'n'nappoanathenna? un veettaiyum unnaiyumkooda akkiniyaal suttuppoaduvoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku yepthaa: enakkum en janaththi'rkum ammoan puththiraroadea periya vazhakku irukkumpoathu, naan ungka'laik kooppittean; neengka'l ennai avarka'l kaikku neengkalaakki radchikkavillai.

neengka'l ennai radchikkavillai en'ru naan ka'ndapoathu, naan en jeevanai en kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, ammoan puththirarukku viroathamaayp poanean; karththar avarka'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; ippadiyirukka, neengka'l enmeal yuththampa'n'na, in'ru ennidaththi'rku varavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru sonnaan.

pinpu yepthaa keeleayaath manusharaiyellaam kootti, eppiraayeemaroadu yuththampa'n'ninaan; eppiraayeemukkum manaaseakkum naduvea kudiyirukki'ra keeleayaaththiyaraana neengka'l eppiraayeemaivittu oadippoanavarka'l en'ru eppiraayeemar sonnapadiyinaal, keeleayaath manushar avarka'lai mu'riya adiththaarka'l.

keeleayaaththiyar eppiraayeemarukku munthi yoarthaanin thu'raika'laip pidiththaarka'l; appozhuthu eppiraayeemarilea thappinavarka'lil yaaraavathu vanthu: naan akkaraikkup poakattum en'ru sollumpoathu, keeleayaath manushar: nee eppiraayeemanaa en'ru avanaik keadpaarka'l; avan alla en'raal,

nee shipoaleath en'ru sol enpaarka'l; appozhuthu avan appadi uchcharikkakkoodaamal, sipoaleath enpaan; appozhuthu avanaip pidiththu, yoarthaan thu'raiyilea vettippoaduvaarka'l; akkaalaththilea eppiraayeemil naa'rpaththeeraayirampear vizhunthaarka'l.
yepthaa isravealai aa'ru varusham niyaayam visaariththaan; pinpu keeleayaaththiyanaana yepthaa mariththu, keeleayaaththilu'l'la oru patta'naththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
avanukkuppinpu pethlekeam ooraanaakiya ipsaan isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan.

avanukku muppathu kumaararum muppathu kumaaraththika'lum irunthaarka'l; muppathu kumaaraththika'laiyum pu'raththilea vivaakampa'n'nikkoduththu, than kumaararukku muppathu pe'nka'laip pu'raththilea ko'ndaan; avan isravealai eazhu varusham niyaayam visaariththaan.
pinpu ipsaan mariththu, pethlekeamilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
avanukkuppinpu sepuloaniyanaakiya ealoan isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan; avan paththu varusham isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan.
pinpu sepuloaniyanaakiya ealoan mariththu, sepuloan theasamaana aayaloan ooril adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
avanukkuppinpu illealin kumaaranaakiya piraththoaniyanaana apthoan isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan.
avanukku naa'rpathu kumaararum muppathu pearappi'l'laika'lum irunthaarka'l; avarka'l ezhupathu kazhuthaika'linmeal ea'ruvaarka'l; avan isravealai ettu varusham niyaayam visaariththaan.
pinpu piraththoaniyanaana illealin kumaaranaakiya apthoan mariththu, eppiraayeem theasaththil amaleakkiyar malaiyilirukki'ra piraththoanilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
israveal puththirar ma'rupadiyum karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythapadiyaal, karththar avarka'lai naa'rpathu varushama'lavum pelisthar kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.
appozhuthu thaa'n vamsaththaanaakiya soaraa ooraanaana oru manushan irunthaan; avan pear manoavaa; avan manaivi pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyaayirunthaa'l.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar antha sthireekkuth tharisanamaaki, ava'lai noakki: ithoa, pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyaana nee karppanthariththu, oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaay.
aathalaal nee thiraadcharasamum mathupaanamum kudiyaathapadikkum, theettaanathu on'rum pusiyaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayiru.

nee karppanthariththu, oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaay; avan thalaiyinmeal savarakan kaththi padalaakaathu; anthap pi'l'lai pi'ranthathumuthal theavanukken'ru nasareayanaayiruppaan; avan isravealaip pelistharin kaikku neengkalaakki radchikkath thodangkuvaan en'raar.

appozhuthu antha sthiree than purushanidaththil vanthu: theavanudaiya manushan oruvar ennidaththil vanthaar; avarudaiya saayal theavanudaiya thootharin saayalaippoala makaa payangkaramaayirunthathu; engkeayirunthu vantheer en'ru naan avaridaththil keadkavillai; avar thammudaiya naamaththai enakkuch sollavumillai.

avar ennai noakki: ithoa, nee karppanthariththu, oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaay; aathalaal nee thiraadcharasamum mathupaanamum kudiyaamalum, theettaanathu on'rum pusiyaamalum iru; anthap pi'l'lai pi'ranthathu muthal than mara'nanaa'lmattum theavanukken'ru nasareayanaayiruppaan en'ru sonnaar en'raa'l.

appozhuthu manoavaa karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni: aa, en aa'ndavarea, neer anuppina theavanudaiya manushan ma'rupadiyum oruvisai engka'lidaththil vanthu, pi'rakkappoaki'ra pi'l'laikkaaka naangka'l seyyavea'ndiyathai engka'lukkuk ka'rpippaaraaka en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaan.

theavan manoavaavin saththaththukkuch sevikoduththaar; antha sthiree vayalve'liyil irukkumpoathu theavanudaiya thoothanaanavar thirumpavum ava'lidaththil vanthaar; appozhuthu ava'l purushanaakiya manoavaa ava'loadea irukkavillai.
aakaiyaal antha sthiree seekkiramaay oadi, ithoa, an'ru ennidaththil vanthavar enakkuth tharisanamaanaar en'ru than purushanukku a'riviththaa'l.
appozhuthu manoavaa ezhunthirunthu, than manaiviyin pinnaalea poay, avaridaththukku vanthu: intha sthireeyoadea peasinavar neerthaanaa en'ru avaridaththil keattaan; avar naanthaan en'raar.
appozhuthu manoavaa: neer sonna kaariyam ni'raivea'rumpoathu, anthap pi'l'laiyai eppadi va'larkkavea'ndum, athai eppadi nadaththavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar manoavaavai noakki: naan sthireeyoadea sonna yaavat'ri'rkum, ava'l echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,

thiraadchachsediyilea u'ndaaki'rathon'rum saappidaamalum, thiraadcharasamum mathupaanamum kudiyaamalum, theettaanathon'rum pusiyaamalum, naan ava'lukkuk katta'laiyittathaiyellaam kaikko'l'lakkadava'l en'raar.
appozhuthu manoavaa karththarudaiya thoothanai noakki: naangka'l oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyai umakkaakach samaiththukko'nduvarumattum thariththirum en'raan.

karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar manoavaavai noakki: nee ennai irukkach sonnaalum naan un u'navaip pusiyean; nee sarvaangka thakanapali idavea'ndumaanaal, athai nee karththarukkuch seluththuvaayaaka en'raar. avar karththarudaiya thoothan en'ru manoavaa a'riyaathirunthaan.
appozhuthu manoavaa karththarudaiya thoothanai noakki: neer sonna kaariyam ni'raivea'rumpoathu, naangka'l ummaik kanampa'n'numpadi, ummudaiya naamam enna en'ru keattaan.
atha'rkuk karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar: en naamam enna en'ru nee keadkavea'ndiyathu enna? athu athisayam en'raar.

manoavaa poay, ve'l'laattukkuttiyaiyum, poajanapaliyaiyum ko'nduvanthu, athaik kanmalaiyinmeal karththarukkuch seluththinaan; appozhuthu manoavaavum avan manaiviyum paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, athisayam vi'langkinathu.

akkinijuvaalai palipeedaththilirunthu vaanaththi'rku nearaaka ezhumpukaiyil, karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar palipeedaththin juvaalaiyilea ea'rippoanaar; athai manoavaavum avan manaiviyum ka'ndu, tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l.
pinpu karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar manoavaavukkum avan manaivikkum kaa'nappadavillai; appozhuthu avar karththarudaiya thoothan en'ru manoavaa a'rinthu,
than manaiviyaip paarththu: naam theavanaik ka'ndoam, saakavea saavoam en'raan.

atha'rku avan manaivi: karththar nammaik kon'rupoadach siththamaayirunthaal, avar nammudaiya kaiyilea sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum oppukko'l'lamaattaar, ivaika'laiyellaam namakkuk kaa'npikkavumaattaar, ivaika'lai namakku a'rivikkavumaattaar en'raa'l.
pinpu antha sthiree oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukkuch simsoan en'ru pearittaa'l; anthap pi'l'lai va'larnthathu; karththar avanai aaseervathiththaar.
avan soaraavukkum esthaavoalukkum naduvilu'l'la thaa'nin paa'layaththil irukkaiyil karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avanai eavaththuvakkinaar.
simsoan thimnaaththukkup poay, thimnaaththilea pelistharin kumaaraththika'lil oru pe'n'naik ka'ndu,
thirumpa vanthu, than thaayaiyum thakappanaiyum noakki: thimnaaththilea pelistharin kumaaraththika'lil oru pe'n'naik ka'ndean; ava'lai enakkuk ko'l'lavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu avan thaayum avan thakappanum avanai noakki: nee poay, viruththaseathanamillaatha pelistharidaththil oru pe'n'naik ko'l'lavea'ndiyathenna? un sakoathararin kumaaraththika'lilum, engka'l janamanaiththilum pe'n illaiyaa en'raarka'l. simsoan than thakappanai noakki: ava'l en ka'n'nukkup piriyamaanava'l, ava'laiyea enakkuk ko'l'lavea'ndum en'raan.
avan pelistharidaththil kut'ram pidikka mukaantharam u'ndaakumpadi, ithu karththarin seyal en'ru avan thaayum thakappanum a'riyaathirunthaarka'l; akkaalaththilea pelisthar isravealai aa'ndaarka'l.

appadiyea simsoanum avan thaayum thakappanum thimnaaththukkup poakap pu'rappattaarka'l; avarka'l thimnaath oor thiraadchaththoattangka'lmattum vanthapoathu, ithoa, kerchchikki'ra paalasingkam on'ru avanukku ethiraaka vanthathu.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi avanmeal palamaay i'rangkinathinaal, avan than kaiyil on'rum illaathirunthum, athai oru aattukkuttiyaik kizhiththuppoaduki'rathupoal kizhiththuppoattaan; aanaalum thaan seythathai avan than thaay thakappanukku a'rivikkavillai.
avan poay anthap pe'n'noadea peasinaan; ava'l simsoanin ka'n'nukkup piriyamaayirunthaa'l.

silanaa'laikkuppinpu, avan ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nath thirumpivanthu, singkaththin udalaip paarkki'ratha'rku vazhivilakip poanaan; ithoa, singkaththin udalukku'l'lea theaneekkoottamum theanum irunthathu.

avan athaith than kaika'lil eduththu, saappittukko'ndea nadanthu, than thaaythakappanidaththil vanthu, avarka'lukkum koduththaan; avarka'lum saappittaarka'l; aanaalum thaan anthath theanaich singkaththin udalilea eduththathai avarka'lukku a'rivikkavillai.
avan thakappan anthap pe'n irukkum idaththil poanapoathu, simsoan angkea virunthuseythaan; vaalipar appadich seyvathu vazhakkam.
avarka'l avanaik ka'ndapoathu, avanoadeakooda irukkumpadi muppathu thoazharai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

simsoan avarka'lai noakki: oru vidukathaiyai ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; athai neengka'l virunthu'nki'ra eazhunaa'laikku'l'lea ka'ndupidiththu enakku viduviththaal, naan ungka'lukku muppathu thuppattika'laiyum muppathu maat'ru vasthirangka'laiyum koduppean.

athai enakku viduvikkaatheapoanaal, neengka'l enakku muppathu thuppattika'laiyum muppathu maat'ru vasthirangka'laiyum kodukkavea'ndum en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: un vidukathaiyaich sollu; naangka'l athaik keadkattum en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: padchikki'ravanidaththilirunthu padcha'namum, palavaanidaththilirunthu mathuramum vanthathu en'raan; antha vidukathai avarka'laal moon'runaa'lmattum viduvikkakkoodaathea poayit'ru.

eazhaamnaa'lilea avarka'l simsoanin pe'nsaathiyaip paarththu: un purushan antha vidukathaiyai engka'lukku viduvikkumpadikku nee avanai nayampa'n'nu; illaavittaal naangka'l unnaiyum un thakappan veettaiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththuppoaduvoam; engka'lukku'l'lavaika'laip pa'riththukko'l'lavaa engka'lai azhaiththeerka'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu simsoanin pe'nsaathi avanukku munpaaka azhuthu, nee ennai neasiyaamal ennaip pakaikki'raay, en janangka'lukku oru vidukathaiyaich sonnaay, athai enakkaavathu viduvikkavillaiyea en'raa'l; atha'rku avan: ithoa, naan en thaaythakappanukkum athai viduvikkavillaiyea, unakku athai viduvippeanoa en'raan.

virunthu'nki'ra eazhunaa'lum ava'l avan munpaaka azhuthuko'ndea irunthaa'l; eazhaamnaa'lilea ava'l avanai alattikko'ndirunthapadiyaal, athai ava'lukku viduviththaan; appozhuthu ava'l than janangka'lukku antha vidukathaiyai viduviththaa'l.

aakaiyaal eazhaamnaa'lilea pozhuthu poakumunnea, antha oor manushar avanai noakki: theanaippaarkkilum mathuramaanathu enna, singkaththaippaarkkilum palamaanathum enna en'raarka'l; atha'rku avan: neengka'l en kidaariyaal uzhaathiruntheerka'laanaal, en vidukathaiyaik ka'ndupidippathillai en'raan.

karththarudaiya aavi avanmeal i'rangkinathinaal, avan askaloanukkup poay, avvooraaril muppathupearaik kon'ru, avarka'ludaiya vasthirangka'lai urinthuko'nduvanthu, vidukathaiyai viduviththavarka'lukku antha maat'ru vasthirangka'laik koduththu, koapam moo'ndavanaayp pu'rappattu, than thakappan veettukkup poayvittaan.
simsoanin pe'nsaathiyoaven'raal, avanudaiya thoazharil avanoadea sineakamaayiruntha oruvanukkuk kodukkappattaa'l.

silanaa'l sen'rapinpu, simsoan koathumai a'rukki'ra naadka'lil oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyai eduththukko'ndu, than pe'nsaathiyaik kaa'nappoay: naan en pe'nsaathiyinidaththil a'raiveetti'rku'l poakattum en'raan; ava'l thakappanoa, avanai u'l'lea poaka ottaamal:

nee ava'lai mut'rilum pakaiththuvittaay en'ru naan e'n'ni, ava'lai un sineakithanukkuk koduththuvittean; ava'l thangkai ava'laippaarkkilum azhakaanava'l allavaa, ava'lukkup pathilaaka iva'l unakku irukkattum en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu simsoan: naan pelistharukkup pollaappuch seythaalum, enmeal kut'ramillai en'ru avarka'lukkuch solli,
pu'rappattuppoay, munnoo'ru narika'laip pidiththu, panthangka'lai eduththu, vaaloadea vaal searththu, ira'ndu vaalka'lukkum naduvea ovvoru panthaththai vaiththuk katti,

panthangka'laik ko'luththi, pelistharin ve'l'laa'nmaiyilea avaika'lai oadavittu, kathirkkattuka'laiyum ve'l'laa'nmaiyaiyum thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum olivaththoappuka'laiyum sutteriththup poattaan.

ippadich seythavan yaar en'ru pelisthar keadki'rapoathu, thimnaaththaanudaiya marumakanaakiya simsoanthaan; avanudaiya pe'nsaathiyai avanudaiya sineakithanukkuk koduththuvittapadiyaal appadich seythaan en'raarka'l; appozhuthu pelisthar poay, ava'laiyum ava'l thakappanaiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththaarka'l.
appozhuthu simsoan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippadich seythapadiyaal naan ungka'l kaiyilea pazhivaangkinaalozhiya i'laippaa'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'laich sinnapinnamaakach sangkaarampa'n'ni, pinpu poay, eaththaam oork kanmalaich santhilea kudiyirunthaan.
appozhuthu pelisthar poay, yoothaavilea paa'layami'rangki, leaki enki'ra ve'liyilea paraviyirunthaarka'l.

neengka'l engka'lukku viroathamaaka vanthathu enna en'ru yoothaa manushar keattatha'rku, avarka'l: simsoan engka'lukkuch seythathupoala, naangka'lum avanukkuch seyyumpadi avanaik kattuki'ratha'rkaaka vanthoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu yoothaavilea moovaayirampear eaththaam oork kanmalaich santhi'rkup poay: pelisthar nammai aa'luki'raarka'l en'ru theriyaathaa? pinnai ean engka'lukku ippadich seythaay en'ru simsoanidaththil sonnaarka'l. atha'rku avan: avarka'l enakkuch seythapadiyea naanum avarka'lukkuch seythean en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l: unnaik katti, pelisthar kaiyil oppukkodukka vanthirukki'roam en'raarka'l. atha'rkuch simsoan: neengka'lea enmeal vizhuki'rathillai en'ru enakku aa'naiyidungka'l en'raan.
