atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l unnai i'rukakkatti, avarka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppoamea allaamal, unnaik kon'rupoadamaattoam en'ru solli, ira'ndu puthuk kayi'ruka'laalea avanaik katti, kanmalaiyilirunthu ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

avan leakivaraikkum vanthu searnthapoathu, pelisthar avanukku viroathamaay aaravaaram pa'n'ninaarka'l; appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi avanmeal palamaay i'rangkinathinaal, avan puyangka'lil kattiyiruntha kayi'ruka'l neruppuppatta noolpoalaaki, avan kattuka'l avan kaika'lai vittu a'runthupoayit'ru.
udanea avan oru kazhuthaiyin pachchaith thaadaiyelumpaik ka'ndu, than kaiyai neetti athai eduththu, athinaalea aayiram pearaik kon'rupoattaan.
appozhuthu simsoan: kazhuthaiyin thaadaiyelumpinaal kuviyal kuviyalaakap pattukkidakki'raarka'l, kazhuthaiyin thaadaiyelumpinaal aayirampearaik kon'rean en'raan.
appadich sollith theernthapinpu, than kaiyil iruntha thaadaiyelumpai e'rinthuvittu, avvidaththi'rku raamaathleaki en'ru pearittaan.

avan mikavum thaakamadainthu, karththarai noakkik kooppittu: theavareer umathu adiyean kaiyinaal inthap periya iradchippaik katta'laiyittirukka, ippozhuthu naan thaakaththinaal seththu, viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'l kaiyilea vizhavea'ndumoa en'raan.

appozhuthu theavan leakiyilu'l'la pa'l'laththaip pi'lakkappa'n'ninaar; athilirunthu tha'n'neer oadivanthathu; avan kudiththapoathu avan uyir thirumpa vanthathu, avan pizhaiththaan; aanapadiyaal atha'rku ennakkoari en'ru pearittaan; athu innaa'lvaraiyum leakiyil irukki'rathu.
avan pelistharin naadka'lil isravealai irupathu varusham niyaayam visaariththaan.
pinpu simsoan kaasaavukkup poay, angkea oru veasiyaik ka'ndu, ava'lidaththil poanaan.

appozhuthu: simsoan ingkea vanthirukki'raan en'ru kaasaa ooraarukkuch sollappattathu. avarka'l: kaalaiyil ve'lichchamaaki'rapoathu avanaik kon'rupoaduvoam en'ru solli, avanai va'lainthuko'ndu iraamuzhuthum avanukkaakap patta'navaasalil pathivirunthu iraamuzhuthum peasaathirunthaarka'l.

simsoan naduraaththirimattum paduththirunthu, naduraaththiriyil ezhunthu, patta'naththu vaasal kathavuka'laiyum athin ira'ndu nilaika'laiyum pidiththu, thaazhppaa'loadeakoodap pearththu, than thoa'linmeal vaiththu, epiroanukku ethireayirukki'ra malaiyin uchchikkuch sumanthuko'ndupoanaan.
atha'rkuppinpu avan soareak aat'rangkaraiyil irukki'ra theleelaa'l ennum pearu'l'la oru sthireeyoadea sineakamaayirunthaan.

ava'lidaththi'rkup pelistharin athipathika'l poay: nee avanai nayampa'n'ni, avanudaiya makaa palam ethinaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'rum, naangka'l avanaik kattich si'rumaippaduththuki'ratha'rku ethinaalea avanai mea'rko'l'lalaam en'rum a'rinthuko'l; appozhuthu naangka'l ovvoruvarum aayiraththunoo'ru ve'l'likkaasu unakkuk koduppoam en'raarka'l.
appadiyea theleelaa'l simsoanaip paarththu: un makaa palam ethinaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu, unnaich si'rumaippaduththa unnai ethinaalea kattalaam en'ru nee enakkuch sollavea'ndum en'raa'l.
atha'rkuch simsoan: ularaatha pachchaiyaana eazhu aka'ninaark kayi'ruka'laalea ennaik kattinaal, naan paladchayamaaki, mat'ra manushanaippoal aavean en'raan.
appozhuthu pelistharin athipathika'l ularaatha pachchaiyaana eazhu aka'ni naark kayi'ruka'lai ava'lidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avaika'laal ava'l avanaik kattinaa'l.

pathivirukki'ravarka'l a'raiveettilea kaaththirukkumpoathu, ava'l: simsoanea, pelisthar unmeal vanthuvittaarka'l en'raa'l; appozhuthu, sa'nalnoolaanathu neruppuppattavudanea it'ruppoaki'rathupoala, avan anthak kayi'ruka'lai a'ruththuppoattaan; avan palam innathinaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'ru a'riyappadavillai.
appozhuthu theleelaa'l simsoanaip paarththu: ithoa, ennaip pariyaasampa'n'ni, enakkup poysonnaay; ippoathum unnai ethinaalea kattalaam en'ru enakkuch sollavea'ndum en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: ithuvaraikkum oru vealaikkum vazhangkaathirukki'ra puthukkayi'ruka'laal ennai i'rukak kattinaal, naan paladchayamaaki, mat'ra manushanaippoal aavean en'raan.

appozhuthu theleelaa'l, puthukkayi'ruka'lai vaangki, avaika'laal avanaik katti: simsoanea, pelisthar unmeal vanthuvittaarka'l en'raa'l; pathivirukki'ravarka'l a'raiveettil irunthaarka'l; aanaalum avan than puyangka'lil iruntha kayi'ruka'lai oru noolaippoala a'ruththuppoattaan.

pinpu theleelaa'l simsoanaip paarththu: ithuvaraikkum ennaip pariyaasampa'n'ni, enakkup poysonnaay; unnai ethinaalea kattalaam en'ru enakkuch sollavea'ndum en'raa'l; atha'rku avan: nee en thalaimayirin eazhu jadaika'lai nesavunool paavoadea pinnivittaal aakum en'raan.

appadiyea ava'l seythu, avaika'lai aa'niyadiththu maatti: simsoanea, pelisthar unmeal vanthuvittaarka'l en'raa'l; avan niththiraivittezhumpi, nesavu aa'niyaiyum noolpaavaiyumkoodap pidungkikko'ndupoanaan.

appozhuthu ava'l avanaip paarththu: un iruthayam ennoadu iraathirukka, unnaich sineakikki'rean en'ru nee eppadich solluki'raay? nee intha moon'ruvisaiyum ennaip pariyaasampa'n'ninaay allavaa, unnudaiya makaapalam ethinaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'ru enakkuch sollaama'rpoanaayea en'ru solli,
ippadi avanaith thinamthinam than vaarththaika'linaalea nerukki alattik ko'ndirukki'rathinaal, saakaththakkathaay avan aaththumaa visanappattu,

than iruthayaththaiyellaam ava'lukku ve'lippaduththi: savarakan kaththi en thalaiyinmeal padavillai; naan en thaayin karppaththil pi'ranthathumuthal theavanukken'ru nasareayanaanavan; en thalai siraikkappattaal, en palam ennai vittuppoam; athinaalea naan paladchayamaaki, mat'ra ellaa manusharaippoalum aavean en'ru ava'lidaththil sonnaan.

avan than iruthayaththaiyellaam thanakku ve'lippaduththinathaith theleelaa'l ka'ndapoathu, ava'l pelistharin athipathika'lukku aa'l anuppi: intha oruvisai vaarungka'l, avan than iruthayaththaiyellaam enakku ve'lippaduththinaan en'ru sollachsonnaa'l; appozhuthu pelistharin athipathika'l ve'l'likkaasuka'laith thangka'l kaiyil eduththukko'ndu ava'lidaththukku vanthaarka'l.

ava'l avanaith than madiyilea niththiraiseyyappa'n'ni, oruvanai azhaiththu, avan thalaimayirin eazhu jadaika'laiyum siraippiththu, avanaich si'rumaippaduththath thodangkinaa'l; avan palam avanaivittu neengkit'ru.

appozhuthu ava'l: simsoanea, pelisthar unmeal vanthuvittaarka'l en'raa'l; avan niththiraivittu vizhiththu, karththar thannaivittu vilakinathai a'riyaamal, eppoathumpoala utha'rippoattu ve'liyea poavean en'raan.
pelisthar avanaip pidiththu, avan ka'nka'laip pidungki, avanaik kaasaavukkuk ko'ndupoay, avanukku ira'ndu ve'nkala vilangkupoattuch si'raichsaalaiyilea maavaraiththukko'ndirukka vaiththaarka'l.
avan thalaimayir siraikkappatta pinpu, thirumpavum mu'laikkath thodangkit'ru.

pelistharin pirapukka'l: nammudaiya pakaignanaakiya simsoanai nammudaiya theavan nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar en'ru solli, thangka'l theavanaakiya thaakoanukku oru periya paliseluththavum, santhoasham ko'ndaadavum koodivanthaarka'l.

janangka'l avanaik ka'ndavudanea: nammudaiya theasaththaip paazhaakki, nammil aneakaraik kon'rupoatta nammudaiya pakaignanai nammudaiya theavan namathu kaiyil oppukkoduththaar en'rusolli, thangka'l theavanaip pukazhnthaarka'l.

ippadi avarka'l manamakizhchchiyaayirukkumpoathu: namakku munpaaka veadikkaikaattumpadikku, simsoanaik koottikko'ndu vaarungka'l en'raarka'l; appozhuthu simsoanaich si'raichsaalaiyilirunthu koottikko'ndu vanthaarka'l, avarka'lukku munpaaka veadikkai kaattinaan; avanaith thoo'nka'lukku naduvea ni'ruththinaarka'l.
simsoan thanakkuk kailaaku koduththu nadaththuki'ra pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanoadea, veettaith thaangkuki'ra thoo'nka'lilea naan saaynthuko'ndirukkumpadi avaika'lai naan thadavippaarkkattum en'raan.

antha veedu purusharaalum sthireeka'laalum ni'rainthirunthathu; angkea pelistharin sakala pirapukka'lum, veettinmeal purusharum sthireeka'lumaaka ea'rakku'raiya moovaayirampear, simsoan veadikkai kaattuki'rathaip paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu simsoan karththarai noakkik kooppittu: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, naan en ira'ndu ka'nka'lukkaaka orea theervaiyaayp pelisthar kaiyilea pazhivaangkumpadikku, intha oruvisaimaaththiram ennai ninaiththaru'lum, theavanea, palappaduththum en'ru solli,
simsoan antha veettaith thaangki ni'rki'ra ira'ndu naduththoo'nka'lil, on'raith than valathukaiyinaalum, mat'ron'raith than idathukaiyinaalum pidiththukko'ndu,

en jeevan pelistharoadea kooda madiyakkadavathu en'ru solli, palamaaych saaykka, antha veedu athil iruntha pirapukka'lmealum ellaa janangka'lmealum vizhunthathu; ivvithamaay avan uyiroadirukkaiyil avanaal kollappattavarka'laippaarkkilum, avan saakumpoathu avanaal kollappattavarka'l athikamaayirunthaarka'l.

pinpu avan sakoathararum, avan thakappan veettaaranaivarum poay, avanai eduththukko'nduvanthu, soaraavukkum esthaavoalukkum naduvea avan thakappanaakiya manoavaavin kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l. avan isravealai irupathuvarusham niyaayam visaariththaan.
eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththaanaakiya meekaa ennum pearu'l'la oru manushan irunthaan.

avan than thaayai noakki: unnidaththiliruntha aayiraththu noo'ru ve'l'likkaasu ka'lavupoayit'rea, athaikku'riththu en kaathuka'l keadka nee saapamittaayea, anthap pa'nam, ithoa, ennidaththil irukki'rathu; athai eduththavan naanthaan en'raan. atha'rku avan thaay: en makanea, nee karththaraal aaseervathikkappaduvaay en'raa'l.

avan antha aayiraththu noo'ru ve'l'likkaasaith than thaayinidaththil thirumpak koduththaan; ava'l: vettappatta oru suroopaththaiyum vaarppikkappatta oru vikkirakaththaiyum u'ndupa'n'na, naan en kaiyiliruntha intha ve'l'liyai en makanukkaaka mut'rilum karththarukken'ru niyamiththean; ippoathum ithai unakkuth thirumpak kodukki'rean en'raa'l.

avan antha ve'l'liyaith than thaaykkuth thirumpak koduththaan; appozhuthu avan thaay irunoo'ru ve'l'likkaasai eduththu, thattaan kaiyilea koduththaa'l; avan athinaalea, vettappatta oru suroopaththaiyum vaarppikkappatta oru vikkirakaththaiyum pa'n'ninaan; avaika'l meekaavin veettil irunthathu.

meekaa, suvaamikku oru a'raiveettai niyamiththu vaiththirunthaan; avan oru eapoaththaiyum suroopangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, than kumaararil oruvanaip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaan; ivan avanukku aasaariyanaanaan.
annaadka'lil isravealilea raajaa illai, avanavan thanthan paarvaikkuch sarippoanapadi seythuvanthaan.
yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraanum leaviyanumaana oru vaalipan angkea thangkiyirunthaan.

antha manushan engkeayaakilum paratheasiyaayp poayth thangkumpadikku, yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraivittup pu'rappattup pirayaa'nam poakaiyil, eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththil irukki'ra meekaavin veettil vanthu searnthaan.
engkea irunthu vanthaay en'ru meekaa avanaik keattatha'rku, avan: naan yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraanaakiya leaviyan, engkeayaakilum poayth thangkappoaki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu meekaa: nee ennidaththil iru, nee enakkuth thakappanum aasaariyanumaayiruppaay; naan unakku varushaththilea paththu ve'l'likkaasaiyum, maat'ru vasthiraththaiyum, unakku vea'ndiya aakaaraththaiyum koduppean en'ru avanidaththil sonnaan; appadiyea leaviyan u'l'lea poanaan.
antha leaviyan antha manithanidaththil irukkach sammathiththaan; antha vaalipan avanukku avan kumaararil oruvanaippoal irunthaan.
meekaa antha leaviyanaip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaan; antha vaalipan avanukku aasaariyanaaki, meekaavin veettil irunthaan.
appozhuthu meekaa: enakku aasaariyanaaka oru leaviyan akappattapadiyinaal, karththar enakku nanmaiseyvaar en'ru ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'rean en'raan.

annaadka'lil isravealilea raajaa illai; thaa'n koaththiraththaar kudiyirukki'ratha'rku, thangka'lukkuch suthantharam theadinaarka'l; annaa'lvaraikkum avarka'lukku israveal koaththirangka'l naduvea poantha suthantharam kidaikkavillai.

aakaiyaal theasaththai u'lavupaarththu varumpadi, thaa'n puththirar thangka'l koaththiraththilea palaththa manusharaakiya ainthupearaith thangka'l ellaika'lil irukki'ra soaraavilum esthaavoalilumirunthu anuppi: neengka'l poay, theasaththai aaraaynthupaarththu vaarungka'l en'ru avarka'loadea sonnaarka'l; avarka'l eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththil irukki'ra meekaavin veedumattum poay, angkea iraaththangkinaarka'l.

avarka'l meekaavin veetta'ndai irukkaiyil, leaviyanaana vaalipanudaiya saththaththai a'rinthu, angkea avanidaththil poay: unnai ingkea azhaiththuvanthathu yaar? ivvidaththil enna seyki'raay? unakku ingkea irukki'rathu enna en'ru avanidaththil keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: inna innapadi meekaa enakkuch seythaan; enakkuch sampa'lam porunthinaan; avanukku aasaariyanaanean en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l avanai noakki: engka'l pirayaa'nam anukoolamaay mudiyumaa en'ru naangka'l a'riyumpadi theavanidaththil kea'l en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku antha aasaariyan: samaathaanaththoadea poangka'l; ungka'l pirayaa'nam karththarukku eat'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu antha ainthu manusharum pu'rappattu, laayeesukkup poay, athil kudiyirukki'ra janangka'l seethoaniyarudaiya vazhakkaththinpadiyea, payamillaamal amarikkaiyum sukamumaay irukki'rathaiyum, theasaththilea avarka'lai adakki aa'la yaathoru athikaariyum illai enpathaiyum, avarka'l seethoaniyarukkuth thooramaanavarka'l enpathaiyum, avarka'lukku oruvaroadum kavai kaariyam illai enpathaiyum ka'ndu,
soaraavilum esthaavoalilum irukki'ra thangka'l sakoathararidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthaarka'l. avarka'l sakoatharar: neengka'l ko'nduvaruki'ra seythi enna en'ru avarka'laik keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avarka'l: ezhumpungka'l, avarka'lukku viroathamaayp poavoam vaarungka'l; antha theasaththaip paarththoam, athu mikavum nan'raayirukki'rathu, neengka'l summaayiruppeerka'laa? antha theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi pu'rappattuppoaka asathiyaayiraatheayungka'l.

neengka'l angkea searumpoathu, sukamaayk kudiyirukki'ra janangka'lidaththil searuveerka'l; antha theasam visthaaramaayirukki'rathu; theavan athai ungka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; athu poomiyilu'l'la sakala vasthuvum ku'raivillaamalirukki'ra idam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu soaraavilum esthaavoalilum irukki'ra thaa'n koaththiraththaaril a'runoo'rupear aayuthapaa'nika'laay angkeayirunthu pu'rappattuppoay,
yoothaavilu'l'la keeriyaathyaareemilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; aathalaal athu innaa'lvaraikkum maknithaan ennappadum; athu keeriyaathyaareemin pinnaalea irukki'rathu.
pinpu avarka'l angkeayirunthu eppiraayeem malaikkup poay, meekaavin veedumattum vanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu laayeesin naattai u'lavupaarkkap poayvantha ainthu manushar thangka'l sakoathararaip paarththu: intha veeduka'lil eapoaththum suroopangka'lum vettappatta vikkirakamum vaarppikkappatta vikkirakamum irukki'rathu en'ru ungka'lukkuth theriyumaa; ippoathum neengka'l seyyavea'ndiyathai yoasiththukko'l'lungka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avvidaththi'rkuth thirumpi, meekaavin veettil irukki'ra leaviyanaana vaalipanin veettilea vanthu, avanidaththil sukaseythi visaariththaarka'l.
aayuthapaa'nika'laakiya thaa'n puththirar a'runoo'rupearum vaasa'rpadiyilea nin'raarka'l.

aasaariyanum aayuthapaa'nika'laakiya a'runoo'rupearum vaasa'rpadiyilea ni'rkaiyil, theasaththai u'lavupaarkkap poayvantha antha ainthu manushar u'l'lea pukunthu, vettappatta vikkirakaththaiyum eapoaththaiyum suroopangka'laiyum vaarppikkappatta vikkirakaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l.

avarka'l meekaavin veetti'rku'l pukunthu, vettappatta vikkirakaththaiyum eapoaththaiyum suroopangka'laiyum vaarppikkappatta vikkirakaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu varuki'rapoathu, aasaariyan avarka'laip paarththu: neengka'l seyki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: nee peasaathea, un vaayai moodikko'ndu, engka'loadeakooda vanthu engka'lukkuth thakappanum aasaariyanumaayiru; nee orea oruvan veettukku aasaariyanaayirukki'rathu nallathoa? isravealil oru koaththiraththi'rkum vamsaththi'rkum aasaariyanaayirukki'rathu nallathoa? en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu aasaariyanudaiya manathu ithamiyappattu, avan eapoaththaiyum suroopangka'laiyum vettappatta vikkirakaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu, janangka'lukku'l'lea pukunthaan.
avarka'l thirumpumpadi pu'rappattu, pi'l'laika'laiyum, aadumaaduka'laiyum, pa'ndam paadika'laiyum, thangka'lukkumunnea poakumpadi seythaarka'l.
avarka'l pu'rappattu, meekaavin veettai vittuk kognchanthooram poanapoathu, meekaavin veetti'rku ayalveettaar koottangkoodi, thaa'n puththiraraith thodarnthuvanthu,
avarka'laip paarththuk kooppittaarka'l; avarka'l thirumpippaarththu, meekaavai noakki: nee ippadik koottaththudan varuki'ra kaariyam enna en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avan: naan u'ndupa'n'nina ennudaiya theyvangka'laiyum antha aasaariyanaiyungkooda neengka'l ko'ndupoaki'reerka'lea; ini enakku enna irukki'rathu; nee kooppiduki'ra kaariyam enna en'ru neengka'l ennidaththil eppadik keadkalaam en'raan.

thaa'n puththirar avanaip paarththu: engka'l kaathuka'l keadkak kookkural idaathea, ittaal koapika'l ungka'lmeal vizhuvaarka'l; appozhuthu un jeevanukkum un veettaarin jeevanukkum moasam varuviththukko'lvaay en'ru solli,
thangka'l vazhiyea nadanthupoanaarka'l; avarka'l thannaippaarkkilum palaththavarka'l en'ru meekaa ka'ndu, avan than veettukkuth thirumpinaan.

avarka'loa meekaa u'ndupa'n'ninavaika'laiyum, avanudaiya aasaariyanaiyum ko'ndupoay, payamillaamal sukamaayirukki'ra laayees oor janangka'lidaththil searththu, avarka'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, patta'naththai akkiniyaal sutteriththuppoattaarka'l.

athu seethoanukkuth thooramaayirunthathu; vea'rea manusharoadea avarka'lukkuch sampanthamillaamalum irunthapadiyaal, avarka'laith thappuvippaar oruvarum illai; anthap patta'nam pethreakoapukkuch sameepamaana pa'l'laththaakkil irunthathu; avarka'l athaith thirumpak katti, athilea kudiyirunthu,
poorvaththilea laayees ennum pear ko'ndiruntha anthap patta'naththi'rku isravealukkup pi'rantha thangka'l thakappanaakiya thaa'nudaiya naamaththinpadiyea thaa'n en'ru pearittaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaa'n puththirar anthach suroopaththaith thangka'lukku sthaapiththukko'ndaarka'l; manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya kersoanin makan yoanaththaanum, avan kumaararum anthath theasaththaar si'raippattuppoana naa'lmattum, thaa'n koaththiraththaarukku aasaariyaraayirunthaarka'l.
theavanudaiya aalayam seeloaviliruntha kaalamuzhuthum avarka'l meekaa u'ndupa'n'nina suroopaththai vaiththuk ko'ndirunthaarka'l.

isravealil raajaa illaatha annaadka'lilea, eppiraayeem malaika'l arukea paratheasiyaayth thangkina oru leaviyan irunthaan; avan yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraa'laakiya oru sthireeyaith thanakku ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakak ko'ndirunthaan.
ava'l avanukkuth thuroakamaay vipasaarampa'n'ni, avanai vittu, yoothaa theasaththup pethlekeam oorilirukki'ra than thakappan veettukkup poay, angkea naalumaathamvaraikkum irunthaa'l.

ava'l purushan ava'loadea nalavu sollavum, ava'laith thirumpa azhaiththuvaravum, ira'ndu kazhuthaika'lai aayaththappaduththi, than vealaikkaaranaik koottikko'ndu, ava'lidaththukkup poanaan; appozhuthu ava'l avanaith than thakappan veettukku azhaiththukko'ndu poanaa'l; sthireeyin thakappan avanaik ka'ndapoathu santhoashamaay eat'rukko'ndu,
sthireeyin thakappanaakiya avanudaiya maaman avanai iruththikko'ndathinaal, moon'runaa'l avanoadirunthaan; avarka'l angkea pusiththuk kudiththu iraaththangkinaarka'l.

naalaamnaa'l kaalamea avarka'l ezhunthirunthapoathu, avan pirayaa'nappadukaiyil, sthireeyin thakappan than marumakanai noakki: kogncham appam pusiththu, un manathaith theat'rikko'l; pi'rpaadu neengka'l poakalaam en'raan.
avarka'l udkaarnthu, iruvarumkoodap pusiththuk kudiththaarka'l; sthireeyin thakappan antha manushanaip paarththu: nee thayavuseythu, un iruthayam makizhchchiyadaiya iraaththirikkum iru en'raan.
appadiyea poaki'ratha'rku antha manushan ezhunthapoathu, avanudaiya maaman avanai varunthikko'ndathinaal, avan an'ru iraaththiriyum angkea irunthaan.

ainthaam naa'lilea avan poaki'ratha'rku athikaalamea ezhunthirunthapoathu, sthireeyin thakappan: irunthu un iruthayaththaith theat'rikko'l en'raan; appadiyea anthinearamattum thaamathiththirunthu, iruvarum poajanampa'n'ninaarka'l.

pinpu avanum, avan ma'rumanaiyaattiyum, avan vealaikkaaranum poaki'ratha'rku ezhunthirunthapoathu, sthireeyin thakappanaakiya avanudaiya maaman: ithoa, pozhuthu asthamikkappoaki'rathu, saayangkaalamumaayit'ru; ingkea iraaththirikku irungka'l; paar, maalaimayangkuki'ra vea'laiyaayit'ru: un iruthayam santhoashamaayirukkumpadi, ingkea iraaththangki naa'lai iruttoadea ezhunthirunthu, un veettukkup poakalaam en'raan.

antha manushanoa, iraaththirikku irukka manathillaamal, ira'ndu kazhuthaika'lmealum sea'namvaiththu, than ma'rumanaiyaattiyaik koottikko'ndu, ezhunthu pu'rappattu, erusaleamaakiya epoosukku nearaaka vanthaan.

avarka'l epoosukkuch sameepamaay varukaiyil, pozhuthupoaki'rathaayirunthathu; appozhuthu vealaikkaaran than ejamaanai noakki: epoosiyar irukki'ra inthap patta'naththi'rkup poay, angkea iraaththangkalaam en'raan.
atha'rku avan ejamaan naam vazhiyaivittu, israveal puththirarillaatha ma'rujaathiyaar irukki'ra patta'naththukkup poakappadaathu; appaalea kipiyaamattum poavoam en'ru solli,
than vealaikkaaranaip paarththu: naam kipiyaavilaakilum raamaavilaakilum iraaththangkumpadikku, avaika'lil oru idaththi'rkup poaych searumpadi nadanthupoavoam vaa en'raan.
appadiyea appaalea nadanthupoanaarka'l; penyameen naattaich searntha kipiyaavin kitta varukaiyil, sooriyan asthamanamaayit'ru.

aakaiyaal kipiyaavilea vanthu iraaththangkumpadikku, vazhiyaivittu avvidaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; avan patta'naththukku'l poanapoathu, iraaththangkuki'ratha'rku avarka'lai veettilea searththukko'lvaar illaathathinaal, veethiyil udkaarnthaan.
vayalilea vealaiseythu, maalaiyilea thirumpuki'ra oru kizhavan vanthaan; antha manushanum eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththaan, avan kipiyaavilea sagncharikkavanthaan; avvidaththu manusharoa penyameenar.
anthak kizhavan than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup patta'naththu veethiyil anthap pirayaa'nakkaaran irukkak ka'ndu: engkea poaki'raay, engkeayirunthu vanthaay en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: naangka'l yoothaavilu'l'la ooraakiya pethlekeamilirunthu vanthu, eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththin pu'rangka'lmattum poaki'roam; naan avvidaththaan; yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeammattum poayvanthean, naan karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poaki'rean; ingkea ennai veettilea eat'rukko'lvaar oruvarum illai.
engka'l kazhuthaika'lukku vaikkoalum theepanamum u'ndu; enakkum umathu adiyaa'lukkum umathu adiyaanoadirukki'ra vealaikkaaranukkum appamum thiraadcharasamum u'ndu; on'rilum ku'raivillai en'raan.
appozhuthu anthak kizhavan: unakkuch samaathaanam; un ku'raivuka'lellaam enmeal irukkattum; veethiyileamaaththiram iraaththangkavea'ndaam en'ru solli,
avanaith than veettukku'l azhaiththukko'ndupoay, kazhuthaika'lukkuth theepanampoattaan; avarka'l thangka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvikko'ndu, pusiththuk kudiththaarka'l.

avarka'l manamakizhchchiyaayirukki'rapoathu, ithoa, pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya antha oor manusharil silar antha veettaich soozhnthuko'ndu, kathavaith thatti: un veettilea vantha antha manushanai naangka'l a'riyumpadikku, ve'liyea ko'nduvaa en'ru veettukkaaranaakiya anthak kizhavanoadea sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu veettukkaaranaakiya antha manushan ve'liyea avarka'lidaththil poay: ippadich seyyavea'ndaam; en sakoathararea, ippadippatta pollaappaich seyyavea'ndaam; antha manushan en veetti'rku'l vanthirukkaiyil, ippadikkoththa mathikeattaich seyyeerka'laaka.

ithoa, kanniyaasthireeyaakiya en maka'lum, antha manithanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattiyum irukki'raarka'l; avarka'lai ungka'lidaththil ve'liyea ko'nduvaruki'rean; avarka'lai avamaanappaduththi, ungka'l paarvaikkuch saripoanapirakaaram avarka'lukkuch seyyungka'l; aanaalum intha manushanukku appadippatta mathikeadaana kaariyaththaich seyyavea'ndaam en'raan.

antha manushar avan sollaik keadkavillai; appozhuthu antha manushan than ma'rumanaiyaattiyaip pidiththu, avarka'lidaththil ve'liyea ko'nduvanthu vittaan; avarka'l ava'lai a'rinthuko'ndu, iraamuzhuthum vidiyungkaalamattum ava'lai ilachchaiyaay nadaththi, kizhakku ve'lukkumpoathu ava'laip poakavittaarka'l.
vidiyungkaalaththi'rku munnea antha sthiree vanthu, ve'lichchamaakumattum angkea than ejamaan iruntha veettu vaasa'rpadiyilea vizhunthukidanthaa'l.

ava'l ejamaan kaalamea ezhunthirunthu veettin kathavaith thi'ranthu, than vazhiyea poakap pu'rappaduki'rapoathu, ithoa, avan ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya sthiree veettuvaasalukku munpaakath than kaika'lai vaasa'rpadiyinmeal vaiththava'laayk kidanthaa'l.

ezhunthiru poavoam en'ru avan ava'loadea sonnatha'rkup pirathiyuththaram pi'rakkavillai. appozhuthu antha manushan ava'laik kazhuthaiyinmeal poattukko'ndu, pirayaa'nappattu, than idaththi'rkup poanaan.

avan than veettukku vanthapoathu, oru kaththiyai eduththu, than ma'rumanaiyaattiyaip pidiththu, ava'lai ava'ludaiya elumpuka'loadungkoodap pannira'ndu thu'ndamaakki, isravealin ellaika'lukkellaam anuppinaan.

appozhuthu athaik ka'ndavarka'lellaarum, israveal puththirar ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'l mutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum ithaippoaloththa kaariyam seyyappadavum illai, kaa'nappadavum illai; inthak kaariyaththai yoasiththu aaloasanaipa'n'nich seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru sollungka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu thaa'nmuthal peyersepaamattumu'l'la israveal puththirar anaivarum keeleayaath theasaththaarudan mispaavilea karththarukku munpaaka eakoapiththu sapaiyaakak koodinaarka'l.
sakala janangka'lin athipathika'lum, isravealin sakala koaththiraththaarum theavanudaiya janamaakiya sapaiyaakak koodinin'raarka'l; avarka'l pattayam uruvuki'ra naalu ladcham kaalaadka'l.
israveal puththirar mispaavukku vantha seythiyaip penyameen puththirar kea'lvippattaarka'l; antha akkiramam nadanthathu eppadi, sollungka'l en'ru israveal puththirar keattaarka'l.
appozhuthu kolaiseyyappatta sthireeyin purushanaakiya leaviyan maa'ruththaramaaka: naanum en ma'rumanaiyaattiyum penyameen naattilu'l'la kipiyaavilea iraaththangka vanthoam.

appozhuthu kipiyaapatta'naththaar enakku viroathamaay ezhumpi, ennaik kolaiseyya ninaiththu, naan iruntha veettai iraaththiriyilea va'lainthuko'ndu, en ma'rumanaiyaattiyai avamaanappaduththinaarka'l; athinaalea ava'l seththuppoanaa'l.

aakaiyaal isravealilea avarka'l ippadippatta mu'raikeattaiyum mathikeattaiyum seythapadiyinaal, naan en ma'rumanaiyaattiyaip pidiththuth thu'ndiththu, isravealin suthantharamaana sakala naaduka'lukkum anuppinean.
neengka'l ellaarum israveal puththiraraamea, ingkea aaloasiththuth theermaanampa'n'nungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu ellaa janangka'lum eakamaay ezhumpi: nammil oruvarum than koodaaraththi'rkup poakavumpadaathu, oruvanum than veetti'rkuth thirumpavumpadaathu.
ippozhuthu kipiyaavukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: seettuppoattu atha'rku viroathamaakap poavoam.

penyameen koaththiramaana kipiyaa patta'naththaar isravealilea seytha ellaa mathikeattukkum thakkathaaka janangka'l vanthu seyyumpadikku, naam thaaniyathavasangka'laich sampaathikki'ratha'rku, israveal koaththirangka'lilellaam noo'rupearil paththuppearaiyum, aayirampearil noo'rupearaiyum, pathinaayirampearil aayirampearaiyum, therintheduppoam en'raarka'l.
isravealarellaarum on'rupoala eakoapiththup patta'naththi'rku munpaakak koottangkoodi,
angkea iruntha isravealin koaththiraththaar penyameen koaththiramengkum aadka'lai anuppi: ungka'lukku'l'lea nadantha intha akkiramam enna?

ippozhuthu kipiyaavil irukki'ra pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya antha manusharai naangka'l kon'ru, pollaappai isravealai vittu vilakkumpadikku, avarka'lai oppukkodungka'l en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l; penyameen puththirar israveal puththiraraakiya thangka'l sakoathararin sollaik keadka manamillaamal,
israveal puththiraroadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappadumpadikku, patta'nangka'lilirunthu kipiyaavukku vanthu koodinaarka'l.

kipiyaavin kudika'lilea therinthuko'l'lappatta ezhunoo'rupearaiyallaamal annaa'lil patta'nangka'lilirunthu vanthu koodina pattayam uruvuki'ra manusharin lakkam irupaththaa'raayirampear en'ru thokaiyidappattathu.
antha janangka'lellaarukku'l'lum therinthuko'l'lappatta idathukai vaakkaana ezhunoo'rupear irunthaarka'l; avarka'l anaivarum oru mayirizhaiyum thappaathapadikkuk kava'nkal e'rivaarka'l.
penyameen koaththiraththaiyallaamal isravealilea pattayam uruvuki'ra manushar naalu ladchampear en'ru thokaiyidappattathu; ivarka'lellaarum yuththaveeraraayirunthaarka'l.

israveal puththiraraana avarka'l ezhumpi, theavanudaiya veetti'rkuppoay: engka'lil yaar munthip poay penyameen puththiraroadu yuththampa'n'navea'ndum en'ru theavanidaththil visaariththaarka'l; atha'rkuk karththar: yoothaa munthip poakavea'ndum en'raar.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar kaalamea ezhunthu pu'rappattu, kipiyaavukku ethiraakap paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
pinpu israveal manushar penyameenoadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattu, kipiyaavilea avarka'lukku ethiraakap poarseyya a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l.
aanaalum penyameen puththirar kipiyaavilirunthu pu'rappattu, isravealil irupaththeeraayirampearai an'raiyathinam tharaiyilea vizhumpadi sangkariththaarka'l.
israveal janangka'l thangka'laith thidappaduththikko'ndu, muthalnaa'lil a'nivakuththu nin'ra sthalaththilea, ma'rupadiyum poarseyya a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l.

avarka'l poay, karththarudaiya sannithiyil saayangkaalamattum azhuthu: engka'l sakoathararaakiya penyameen puththiraroadea thirumpavum yuththam kalakkappoavoamaa en'ru karththaridaththil visaariththaarka'l; appozhuthu karththar: avarka'lukku viroathamaayp poangka'l en'raar.
ma'runaa'lilea israveal puththirar penyameen puththirar kittach searuki'rapoathu,

penyameen koaththiraththaarum annaa'lilea kipiyaavilirunthu avarka'lukku ethiraakap pu'rappattuvanthu, pinnum israveal puththiraril pattayam uruvuki'ra pathine'n'naayirampearaith tharaiyilea vizhumpadi sangkariththaarka'l.

appozhuthu israveal puththiraraakiya sakala janangka'lum pu'rappattu, theavanudaiya veetti'rkup poay, angkea karththarudaiya sannithiyil azhuthu, thariththirunthu, an'ru saayangkaalamattum upavaasiththu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum ittu,
karththaridaththil visaariththaarka'l; theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyin petti annaadka'lil angkea irunthathu.

aaroanin kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaarin makan pinekaas annaadka'lil avarudaiya sannithiyil nin'raan; engka'l sakoathararaakiya penyameen puththiraroadea pinnum yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappadalaamaa pu'rappadalaakaathaa en'ru avarka'l visaariththaarka'l; appozhuthu karththar: poangka'l; naa'laikku avarka'lai ungka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'raar.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar kipiyaavaichsut'rilum pathividaiyaadka'lai vaiththu,
moon'raam naa'lilea penyameen puththirarukku viroathamaayp poay, mun ira'ndutharam seythathupoala, kipiyaavukkuch sameepamaayp poarukku a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu penyameen puththirar janaththi'rku viroathamaayp pu'rappattup patta'naththai vittu, appaalea vanthu, ve'liyilea peththealukkum kipiyaavukkum poaki'ra ira'ndu vazhika'lil israveal janaththil ea'rakku'raiya muppathupearai, muthal ira'ndutharam seythathu poala, vettavum kollavum thodangkinaarka'l.

munpoala namakku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappaduki'raarka'l en'ru penyameen puththirar sonnaarka'l; israveal puththiraroa: avarka'laip patta'naththai vittu appaaleayirukki'ra vazhika'lilea varappa'n'numpadikku, naam oadavea'ndum en'ru solliyirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu israveal manushar ellaarum thangka'l sthaanaththilirunthu ezhumpi, paakaalthaamaarilea yuththaththi'rku a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l; isravealaril kipiyaavin pa'l'laththaakkilea pathivirunthavarka'l thangka'l sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappattu,

avarka'lil ellaa isravealilum therinthuko'l'lappatta pathinaayirampear kipiyaavukku ethirea vanthaarka'l; yuththam palaththathu; aanaalum thangka'lukku vikkinam nearittathu en'ru avarka'l a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.

karththar isravealukku munpaakap penyameenai mu'riya adiththaar; annaa'lilea israveal puththirar penyameenilea pattayam uruvuki'ra aadka'laakiya irupaththaiyaayiraththu noo'rupearaich sangkariththaarka'l.

isravealar kipiyaavukku appaalea vaiththa pathividaiyai nampiyirunthapadiyinaalea, penyameenarukku idam koduththaarka'l; athinaalea avarka'l mu'riya adikkappaduki'raarka'l en'ru penyameen puththirarukkuk kaa'nappattathu.
appozhuthu pathividaiyirunthavarka'l theeviramaayk kipiyaavinmeal paaynthu paravi, patta'naththil irukki'ravarka'lellaaraiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettinaarka'l.
patta'naththilirunthu makaa periya pukaiyai ezhumpappa'n'nuvathea isravealarukkum pathividaikkaararukkum ku'rikkappatta adaiyaa'lamaayirunthathu.

aakaiyaal isravealar yuththaththilea pinvaangkinapoathu, penyameenar: munthina yuththaththil nadanthathupoala, avarka'l namakku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappaduki'raarka'lea en'ru solli, isravealaril ea'rakku'raiya muppathupearai vettavum kollavum thodangkinaarka'l.
patta'naththilirunthu pukaiyaanathu sthampampoala uyara ezhumpinapoathu, penyameenar pinnaakap paarththaarka'l; ithoa, patta'naththin akkinijuvaalai vaanapariyantham ezhumpit'ru.
appozhuthu isravealar thirumpik ko'ndaarka'l; penyameen manusharoa, thangka'lukku vikkinam nearittathaik ka'ndu thikaiththu,

israveal puththiraraivittu, vanaantharaththi'rkup poaki'ra vazhikku nearaayth thirumpi oadippoanaarka'l; aanaalum yuththam avarka'laith thodarnthathu; patta'nangka'lil irunthavarka'lum thangka'l naduvea akappattavarka'laik kon'rupoattaarka'l.
ippadiyea penyameenarai va'lainthuko'ndu thuraththi, kipiyaavukkuk kizhakkuppu'ramaaka varumattum, avarka'lai leasaay mithiththuppoattaarka'l.
ithinaal penyameenarilea pathine'n'naayirampear vizhunthaarka'l; avarka'lellaarum palavaanka'laayirunthaarka'l.

mat'ravarka'l vilaki, vanaantharaththil irukki'ra rimmoan kanmalaikku oadippoanaarka'l; avarka'lil innum aiyaayirampearai vazhika'lilea kon'ru, mat'ravarka'laik keethoammattum pinthodarnthu, avarka'lil ira'ndaayiram pearai vettippoattaarka'l.
ivvithamaay penyameenaril annaa'lil vizhunthavarka'lellaarum irupaththaiyaayirampear; avarka'lellaarum pattayam uruvuki'ra palavaanka'laayirunthaarka'l.
a'runoo'rupear thirumpikko'ndu oadi, vanaantharaththilirukki'ra rimmoan kanmalaikkup poay, rimmoan kanmalaiyilea naalu maatham irunthaarka'l.

isravealaroa penyameen puththirarmeal thirumpi, patta'naththil manushar thodangki mirukangka'lmattum ka'ndavaika'l ellaavat'raiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vetti, ka'nda patta'nangka'laiyellaam akkiniyaal ko'luththippoattaarka'l.
isravealar mispaavilea irukkumpoathu: nammil oruvanum than kumaaraththiyaip penyameenarukku vivaakampa'n'nikkoduppathillai en'ru aa'naiyittirunthaarka'l.
aakaiyaal janangka'l theavanudaiya veetti'rkuppoay, angkea theavasannithiyil saayangkaalamattum irunthu, saththamittu, mikavum azhuthu:
isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, in'ru isravealil oru koaththiram ku'rainthupoakaththakkathaaka isravealil inthak kaariyam nearittathu enna en'raarka'l.
ma'runaa'lilea, janangka'l kaalamea ezhunthirunthu, angkea oru palipeedaththaik katti, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaana palika'laiyum seluththinaarka'l.

karththarudaiya sannithiyil mispaavukku varaathavan nichchayamaayk kolaiseyyappadakkadavan en'ru avarka'l periya aa'naiyittirunthapadiyaal, israveal puththirar: karththarudaiya sannithiyil sapaikoodinapoathu, isravealudaiya ellaak koaththirangka'lilumirunthu varaathea poanavarka'l yaar en'ru visaariththaarka'l.
israveal puththirar thangka'l sakoathararaakiya penyameenarai ninaiththu, manasthaapappattu: in'ru isravealil oru koaththiram a'ruppu'ndupoayit'rea.

meenthiruppavarka'lukku manaivika'l kidaikkumpadi naam avarka'lukkaaka ennaseyyalaam? nammudaiya kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyaiyum avarka'lukkuk koduppathillai en'ru naam karththarmeal aa'naiyittukko'ndoamea.

isravealin koaththirangka'lil mispaavilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil varaatheapoana yaathoruvar u'ndoa en'ru visaariththaarka'l; appozhuthu keeleayaaththilu'l'la yaapeasin manusharil oruvarum paa'layaththil sapaikoodinapoathu varavillai.
janangka'l ilakkampaarkkappattapoathu, keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaapeasin kudika'lil angkea oruvarum irunthathillai.
udanea sapaiyaar palavaanka'lil panneeraayirampearai angkea azhaiththu: neengka'l poay, keeleayaaththilu'l'la yaapeasin kudika'lai sthireeka'loadum pi'l'laika'loadum pattayakkarukkinaal vettungka'l.
sakala aa'npi'l'laika'laiyum, purusharai a'rintha sakala pe'npi'l'laika'laiyum sangkarikkakkadaveerka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittu anuppinaarka'l.

ivarka'l keeleayaaththilu'l'la yaapeasin kudika'lidaththilea purusharai a'riyaatha naanoo'ru kannippe'nka'laik ka'ndu pidiththu, avarka'laik kaanaantheasamaana seeloavilirukki'ra paa'layaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu rimmoan kanmalaiyilirukki'ra penyameen puththiraroadea peasavum, avarka'lukkuch samaathaanam koo'ravum, sapaiyaar ellaarum manusharai anuppinaarka'l.

appadiyea akkaalaththil penyameenar thirumpa vanthaarka'l; keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaapeasin sthireeka'lil uyiroadea vaiththa pe'nka'lai avarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; appadich seythum avarka'l thokaikkuk kaa'naathirunthathu.
israveal koaththirangka'lilea karththar oru pi'lappai u'ndaakkinaar en'ru janangka'l penyameenarukkaaka manasthaapappattaarka'l.
penyameen koaththira sthireeka'l azhinthapadiyinaalea, meethiyaana mat'rappearka'lukkum manaivika'l kidaikkumpadi ennaseyyalaam en'ru sapaiyin moopparaanavarka'l keattu,
isravealil oru koaththiram nirmoolamaakaathapadikku, thappinavarka'ludaiya suthantharam penyameenukku irukkavea'ndumea,
naamoa nammudaiya kumaaraththika'lil avarka'lukkup pe'n kodukkakkoodaathu; penyameenarukkup pe'nkodukki'ravan sapikkappattavan en'ru, israveal puththirar aa'naiyittaarka'lea en'raarka'l.

pinnum, ithoa, peththealukku vadakkea peththealilirunthu seekeamukkup poaki'ra paathaikkuk kizhakkaakavum lipoanaavukkuth the'rkaakavum irukki'ra seeloavilea varushanthoa'rum karththarukkup pa'ndikai ko'ndaadappaduki'rathea en'ru solli,
avarka'l penyameen puththirarai noakki: neengka'l poay, thiraadchaththoattangka'lilea pathivirunthu,

seeloavin kumaaraththika'l keethavaaththiyaththoadea nadanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'laayp pu'rappattu varuki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, thiraadchaththoattangka'lilirunthu pu'rappattu, ungka'lil avaravar seeloavin kumaaraththika'lil, ovvoru pe'n'naip pidiththup penyameen theasaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoangka'l.

avarka'ludaiya thakappanmaaraakilum, sakoathararaakilum engka'lidaththil mu'raiyida varumpoathu, naangka'l avarka'lai noakki: engka'l nimiththam avarka'lukkuth thayavuseyyungka'l; naangka'l yuththampa'n'ni, avanavanukku manaiviyai vaangkikkodukkavillai; ungka'lmeal kut'ramu'ndaaka ippoathu neengka'l avarka'lukku manaivika'laik kodukkavum illai enpoam en'ru sonnaarka'l.

penyameen puththirar appadiyea seythu, nadanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lilea thangka'l thokaikkuch sariyaana pe'nka'lai manaivika'laakap pidiththukko'ndu, thangka'l suthantharaththi'rkuth thirumpippoay, patta'nangka'laip puthuppiththuk katti, avaika'lil kudiyirunthaarka'l.
israveal puththirarum akkaalaththilea avvidam vittu avaravar thangka'l koaththiraththukkum thangka'l kudumpaththukkum poay, avaravar thangka'l suthantharaththil searnthaarka'l.
annaadka'lilea isravealil raajaa illai; avanavan thanthan paarvaikkuch sarippoanapadi seythuvanthaan.

niyaayaathipathika'l niyaayam visaariththuvarum naadka'lil, theasaththilea pagncham u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraanaakiya oru manushan than manaiviyoadum ira'ndu kumaararoadungkooda moavaap theasaththilea poaych sagnchariththaan.

antha manushanudaiya pear elimeleakku, avan manaiviyin pear nakoami, avanudaiya ira'ndu kumaararil oruvan pear makloan, mat'roruvan pear kiliyoan; yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraakiya eppiraaththiyaraakiya avarka'l moavaaptheasaththi'rkup poay, angkea irunthuvittaarka'l.
nakoamiyin purushanaakiya elimeleakku i'ranthupoanaan; ava'lum ava'ludaiya ira'ndu kumaararummaaththiram irunthaarka'l.
ivarka'l moavaapiyaril pe'nko'ndaarka'l; avarka'lil oruththi pear orpaa'l, mat'rava'l pear rooth; angkea ea'rakku'raiyap paththuvarusham vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
pinpu makloan kiliyoan ennum avarka'l iruvarum i'ranthupoanaarka'l; antha sthiree than kumaarar iruvaraiyum than purushanaiyum izhanthu thaniththava'laanaa'l.

karththar thammudaiya janangka'laich santhiththu, avarka'lukku aakaaram aru'linaar en'ru ava'l moavaaptheasaththilea kea'lvippattu, than marumakka'loadeakooda moavaap theasaththilirunthu thirumpivarumpadi ezhunthu,
than ira'ndu marumakka'loadungkoodath thaaniruntha sthalaththai vittup pu'rappattaa'l. yoothaa theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoaka, avarka'l vazhinadakkaiyil,

nakoami than ira'ndu marumakka'laiyum noakki: neengka'l iruvarum ungka'l thaayveettukkuth thirumpippoangka'l; mariththuppoanavarka'lukkum enakkum neengka'l thayaiseythathupoala, karththar ungka'lukkum thayaiseyvaaraaka.

karththar ungka'l iruvarukkum vaaykkum purushanudaiya veettilea neengka'l sukamaay vaazhnthirukkach seyvaaraaka en'ru solli, avarka'lai muththamittaa'l. appozhuthu avarka'l saththamittu azhuthu, ava'laip paarththu:
ummudaiya janaththa'ndaikkea ummudankooda varuvoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku nakoami: en makka'lea, neengka'l thirumpippoangka'l; ennoadea ean varuki'reerka'l? ungka'lukkup purusharaakumpadikku, inimeal en karppaththilea enakkup pi'l'laika'l u'ndaakumoa?

en makka'lea, thirumpippoangka'l; naan vayathusen'rava'l; oru purushanudan vaazhaththakkava'lalla; appadippatta nampikkai enakku u'ndaayirunthu, naan in'ru iravil oru purushanukku vaazhkkaippattu, pi'l'laika'laip pet'raalum,

avarka'l periyavarka'laakumattum, purusharukku vaazhkkaippadaathapadikku neengka'l po'ruththiruppeerka'loa? athu koodaathu; en makka'lea, karththarudaiya kai enakku viroathamaayirukki'rathinaal, ungka'lnimiththam enakku mikuntha visanam irukki'rathu en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l saththamittu athikamaay azhuthaarka'l; orpaa'l than maamiyai muththamittuppoanaa'l; rooththoa ava'lai vidaamal pat'rikko'ndaa'l.
appozhuthu ava'l: ithoa, un sakoathari than janangka'lidaththukkum than theavarka'lidaththukkum thirumpip poayvittaa'lea; neeyum un sakoathariyin pi'rakea thirumpippoa en'raa'l.

atha'rku rooth: naan ummaip pinpat'raamal ummaivittuth thirumpippoavathaikku'riththu, ennoadea peasavea'ndaam; neer poakum idaththi'rku naanum varuvean; neer thangkum idaththilea naanum thangkuvean; ummudaiya janam ennudaiya janam; ummudaiya theavan ennudaiya theavan.

neer mara'namadaiyum idaththil naanum mara'namadainthu, angkea adakkampa'n'nappaduvean; mara'nameayallaamal vea'ron'rum ummai vittu ennaip piriththaal, karththar atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavar en'raa'l.
ava'l thannoadeakooda vara manau'ruthiyaayirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, appu'ram athaikku'riththu ava'loadea on'rum peasavillai.
appadiyea iruvarum pethlekeammattum nadanthupoanaarka'l; avarka'l pethlekeamukku vanthapoathu, ooraar ellaarum avarka'laikku'riththu aachchariyappattu, iva'l nakoamiyoa en'ru peasikko'ndaarka'l.
atha'rku ava'l: neengka'l ennai nakoami en'ru sollaamal, maaraa'l en'ru sollungka'l; sarvavallavar enakku mikuntha kasappaik katta'laiyittaar.

naan ni'raivu'l'lava'laayp poanean; karththar ennai ve'rumaiyaayth thirumpivarappa'n'ninaar; karththar ennaich si'rumaippaduththi, sarvavallavar ennaik kileasappaduththiyirukkaiyil, neengka'l ennai nakoami enpaanean en'raa'l.
ippadi nakoami moavaapiya sthireeyaana than marumaka'l rooththoadungkooda moavaap theasaththilirunthu thirumpivanthaa'l; vaa'rkoathumai a'ruppin thuvakkaththil avarka'l pethlekeamukku vanthaarka'l.
nakoamikku ava'ludaiya purushanaakiya elimeleakkin u'ravinmu'raiyil poavaas ennum pearu'l'la mikuntha aasthikkaaranaakiya inaththaan oruvan irunthaan.

moavaapiya sthireeyaana rooth enpava'l nakoamiyaip paarththu: naan vayalve'likkup poay, yaarudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaikkumoa, avar pi'rakea kathirka'laip po'rukkikko'nduvaruki'rean en'raa'l; atha'rku iva'l: en maka'lea, poa en'raa'l.
ava'l poay, vayalve'liyil a'rukki'ravarka'l pi'rakea po'rukkinaa'l; tha'rseyalaay ava'lukku nearitta antha vayalnilam elimeleakkin vamsaththaanaakiya poavaasudaiyathaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu poavaas pethlekeamilirunthu vanthu, a'rukki'ravarka'laip paarththu: karththar ungka'loadea iruppaaraaka en'raan; atha'rku avarka'l: karththar ummai aaseervathippaaraaka en'raarka'l.
pinpu poavaas a'rukki'ravarka'lmeal ka'nkaa'niyaaka vaikkappatta than vealaikkaaranai noakki: inthap pe'npi'l'lai yaarudaiyava'l en'ru keattaan.
a'rukki'ravarka'lmeal ka'nkaa'niyaaka vaikkappatta antha vealaikkaaran pirathiyuththaramaaka: iva'l moavaap theasaththilirunthu nakoamiyoadeakoodavantha moavaapiya pe'npi'l'lai.

a'rukki'ravarka'l pi'rakea arikkattuka'lilirunthu sinthinathaip po'rukkikko'l'luki'rean en'ru ava'l ennidaththil keattukko'ndaa'l; kaalamea thuvakki ithuvaraikkum ingkea irukki'raa'l; ippozhuthu ava'l kudisaikku vanthu kognchanearanthaan aayit'ru en'raan.
appozhuthu poavaas rooththaippaarththu: maka'lea, kea'l; po'rukkikko'l'la vea'rea vayalil poakaamalum, ivvidaththaivittup poakaamalum, ingkea en oozhiyakkaarap pe'nka'loadukoodavea iru.

avarka'l a'ruppa'rukkum vayalai nee paarththu, avarka'l pi'rakea poa; oruvarum unnaith thodaathapadikku, vealaikkaararukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'rean; unakkuth thaakam eduththaal, tha'n'neerkkudangka'la'ndaikkup poay, vealaikkaarar mo'nduko'ndu varuki'rathilea kudikkalaam en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangki: naan anniyatheasaththaa'laayirukka, neer ennai visaarikkumpadi enakku ethinaalea ummudaiya ka'nka'lil thayaikidaiththathu en'raa'l.

atha'rkup poavaas pirathiyuththaramaaka: un purushan mara'namadaintha pinpu, nee un maamiyaarukkaakach seythathum, nee un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum, un janmatheasaththaiyum vittu, munnea nee a'riyaatha janangka'lidaththil vanthathum ellaam enakku vivaramaayth therivikkappattathu.

un seykaikkuththakka palanaik karththar unakkuk katta'laiyiduvaaraaka; isravealin theavanaakiya karththarudaiya settaika'linkeezh adaikkalamaay vantha unakku avaraalea ni'raivaana palan kidaippathaaka en'raan.

atha'rku ava'l: en aa'ndavanea, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaikkavea'ndum; naan ummudaiya vealaikkaarika'lil oruththikkum samaanamaayiraavittaalum, neer enakku aa'ruthal solli ummudaiya adiyaa'loadea padchamaayp peasineerea en'raa'l.

pinnum poavaas saappaattu vea'laiyil ava'laip paarththu: nee ingkea vanthu, intha appaththilea pusiththu, kaadiyilea un thu'nikkaiyaith thoayththukko'l en'raan. appadiyea ava'l a'ruppa'rukki'ravarka'l arukea udkaarnthaa'l; ava'lukku va'ruththa koathumaiyaik koduththaan; ava'l saappittu, thirpthiyadainthu, meenthathai vaiththukko'ndaa'l.
ava'l kathir po'rukkikko'l'la ezhunthapoathu, poavaas than vealaikkaararai noakki: ava'l arikkattuka'l naduvea po'rukkikko'l'lattum; ava'lai eenampa'n'navea'ndaam.
ava'l po'rukkikko'l'lumpadikku ava'lukkaaka arika'lilea silathaich sinthavidungka'l, ava'lai athattaathirungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan.
appadiyea ava'l saayangkaalamattum vayalilea kathir po'rukkinaa'l; po'rukkinathai ava'l thatti adiththuth theernthapoathu, athu ea'rakku'raiya oru marakkaal vaa'rkoathumai ka'ndathu.
ava'l athai eduththukko'ndu, oorukku'l vanthaa'l; ava'l po'rukkinathai ava'ludaiya maami paarththaa'l; thaan thirupthiyaaych saappittu meethiyaaka vaiththathaiyum eduththu ava'lukkuk koduththaa'l.

appozhuthu ava'ludaiya maami: in'ru engkea kathirpo'rukkinaay, evvidaththil vealaiseythaay en'ru ava'lidaththil keattu; unnai visaariththavan aaseervathikkappaduvaanaaka en'raa'l; appozhuthu ava'l: innaaridaththilea vealaiseythean en'ru than maamikku a'riviththu: naan in'ru vealai seytha vayalkaaran pear poavaas en'raa'l.

appozhuthu nakoami than marumaka'laip paarththu: uyiroadirukki'ravarka'lukkum mariththavarka'lukkum thayavuseyki'ra karththaraalea avan aaseervathikkappaduvaanaaka en'raa'l; pinnum nakoami ava'laip paarththu: antha manushan namakku nerungkina u'ravin mu'raiyaanum nammai aatharikki'ra suthantharavaa'lika'lil oruvanumaay irukki'raan en'raa'l.
pinnum moavaapiya sthireeyaana rooth: avar ennai noakki, en a'ruppellaam a'ruththuth theerumattum, nee en vealaikkaarika'loadea koodavea iru en'ru sonnaar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu nakoami than marumaka'laakiya rooththaip paarththu: en maka'lea, vea'roru vayalilea manushar unnai ethirkkaathapadikku nee avan vealaikkaarika'loadea poaki'rathu nallathu en'raa'l.
appadiyea koathumai a'ruppum vaa'rkoathumai a'ruppum theerumattum ava'l kathir po'rukkumpadikku, poavaasudaiya vealaikkaarika'loadea koodiyirunthu, than maamiyinidaththil thangkinaa'l.
pinpu ava'l maamiyaakiya nakoami ava'lai noakki: en maka'lea, nee sukamaay vaazhnthirukkumpadi naan unakkuch savukkiyaththaith theadaathiruppeanoa?
nee poavaasin vealaikkaarika'loadea koodiyirunthaayea, avan nammudaiya u'ravinmu'raiyaan allavaa? ithoa, avan in'ru iraaththiri ka'laththilea vaa'rkoathumai thoot'ruvaan.
nee ku'liththu, e'n'ney poosi, un vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu, anthak ka'laththi'rkup poa; antha manushan pusiththuk kudiththuth theerumattum avan ka'n'nukku ethirppadaamaliru.

avan paduththukko'ndapoathu, avan paduththirukkum idaththai nee paarththirunthu poay, avan kaalka'linmeal moodiyirukki'ra poarvaiyai othukki nee paduththukko'l; appozhuthu nee seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru avan unakkuch solluvaan en'raa'l.
atha'rku ava'l: neer enakkuch sonnapadiyellaam seyvean en'raa'l.
ava'l ka'laththi'rkuppoay, than maami thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam seythaa'l.

poavaas pusiththuk kudiththu, makizhchchiyaayirunthu, oru ampaaraththu adiyilea vanthu paduththukko'ndaan. appozhuthu ava'l: me'l'lappoay, avan kaalka'linmeal moodiyirukki'ra poarvaiyai othukkip paduththukko'ndaa'l.
paathiraaththiriyilea, antha manushan aru'ndu, thirumpi, oru sthiree than paathaththa'ndaiyilea paduththirukki'rathaik ka'ndu,
nee yaar en'ru keattaan; ava'l, naan ummudaiya adiyaa'laakiya rooth; neer ummudaiya adiyaa'lmeal ummudaiya poarvaiyai viriyum; neer suthantharavaa'li en'raa'l.

atha'rku avan: maka'lea, nee karththaraal aaseervathikkappaduvaayaaka; nee thariththirarum aisuvariyavaanka'lumaana vaaliparka'lin pi'rakea poakaathathinaal, un munthina na'rku'naththaippaarkkilum un pinthina na'rku'nam uththamamaayirukki'rathu.
ippoathum maka'lea, nee payappadaathea; unakku vea'ndiyapadiyellaam seyvean; nee ku'nasaali enpathai en janamaakiya ooraarellaarum a'rivaarka'l.
naan suthantharavaa'li enpathu meythaan; aanaalum ennilum kittina suthantharavaa'li oruvan irukki'raan.

iraaththirikkuth thangkiyiru; naa'laikku avan unnaich suthantharamu'raiyaay vivaakampa'n'nach sammathiththaal nallathu, avan vivaakampa'n'nattum; avan unnai vivaakampa'n'na manathillaathirunthaaneayaakil, naan unnaich suthantharamu'raiyaay vivaakampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyiduki'rean; vidiya'rkaalamattum paduththukko'ndiru en'raan.

ava'l vidiya'rkaalamattum avan paathaththa'ndaiyil paduththirunthu, ka'laththilea oru sthiree vanthathaaka oruvarukkum therivikkavea'ndaam en'ru avan solliyirunthapadiyaal, oruvar mukam oruvarukkuth theriyaathatha'rku munnea ezhunthirunthaa'l.

avan ava'lai noakki: nee poarththukko'ndirukki'ra poarvaiyai viriththuppidi en'raan; ava'l athaip pidiththapoathu, avan athilea aa'rupadi vaa'rkoathumaiyai a'lanthupoattu, ava'lmeal thookkivittu, patta'naththi'rkup pu'rappattuvanthaan.
ava'l than maamiyinidaththil vanthapoathu, ava'l: en maka'lea, un seythi enna en'ru keattaa'l; appozhuthu ava'l: antha manushan thanakkuch seythathaiyellaam ava'lukku vivariththaa'l.
mealum avar, nee un maamiyaara'ndaikku ve'rumaiyaayp poakavea'ndaam en'ru solli, intha aa'rupadi vaa'rkoathumaiyai enakkuk koduththaar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu ava'l: en maka'lea, inthak kaariyam ennamaay mudiyum en'ru nee a'riyumattum po'ruththiru; antha manushan in'raikku inthak kaariyaththai mudikkumun i'laippaa'ramaattaan en'raa'l.

poavaas patta'navaasalil poay, udkaarnthuko'ndirunthaan; appozhuthu poavaas solliyiruntha anthach suthantharavaa'li antha vazhiyea vanthaan; avanai noakki: oay, en'ru pear sollik kooppittu, ingkea vanthu sat'ru udkaarum en'raan; avan vanthu udkaarnthaan.
appozhuthu avan patta'naththu moopparaanavarka'lil paththuppearai azhaiththu, ingkea udkaarungka'l en'raan; avarka'lum udkaarnthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan anthach suthantharavaa'liyai noakki: elimeleak ennum nammudaiya sakoatharanukku iruntha vayalnilaththin pangkai, moavaap theasaththilirunthu thirumpivantha nakoami vi'rkappoaki'raa'l.

aakaiyaal neer athai ooraarukku munpaakavum, en janaththin moopparukku munpaakavum vaangkikko'l'lumpadi umakku a'riyappa'n'navea'ndum en'rirunthean; neer athaich suthantharamu'raiyaaka meettukko'l'la manathirunthaal, meettukko'l'lum; athai meettukko'l'la manathillaathirunthaal, naan athai a'riyumpadikku enakkuch sollum; ummaiyum umakkuppinpu ennaiyum thavira, athai meedkaththakkavan vea'roruvanum illai en'raan; atha'rku avan: naan athai meettukko'l'luki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu poavaas: neer nakoamiyin kaiyilea antha vayalnilaththai vaangkuki'ra naa'lilea mariththavanudaiya suthantharaththil avan pearai nilaini'rkappa'n'numpadikku, athai mariththavan manaiviyaakiya moavaapiya sthireeyaana rooth kaiyilum vaangkavea'ndiyathu en'raan.

appozhuthu anthach suthantharavaa'li: naan en suthantharaththaik kedukkaathapadikku, naan athai meettukko'l'lamaattean; naan meedkaththakkathai neer meettukko'l'lum; naan athai meettukko'l'lamaattean en'raan.

meedki'rathilum maat'ruki'rathilum sakala kaariyaththaiyum u'ruthippaduththumpadikku, isravealilea poorvakaala vazhakkam ennaven'raal, oruvan than paatharadchaiyaik kazhat'ri, mat'ravanukkuk koduppaan, ithu isravealilea vazhangkina u'ruthippaadu.
appadiyea anthach suthantharavaa'li poavaasai noakki: neer athai vaangkikko'l'lum en'ru solli, than paatharadchaiyaik kazhat'rip poattaan.

appozhuthu poavaas moopparaiyum sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: elimeleakkukku iruntha ellaavat'raiyum kiliyoanukkum makloanukkum iruntha ellaavat'raiyum nakoamiyin kaiyilea vaangkikko'ndean enpatha'rku in'raiyathinam neengka'l saadchi.

ithuvumallaamal, mariththavanudaiya sakoathararukku'l'lum, ooraarukku'l'lum, avanudaiya pear at'ruppoakaamal, mariththavanudaiya suthantharaththilea avan pearai nilaini'ruththa, naan makloanin manaiviyaayiruntha moavaapiya sthireeyaana rooththai enakku manaiviyaakak ko'ndean; atha'rkum in'raiyathinam neengka'l saadchi en'raan.

appozhuthu olimukavaasalil irukki'ra sakala janangka'lum moopparaanavarka'lum avanai noakki: naangka'l saadchithaan; un veettilea varuki'ra manaiviyaik karththar israveal veettaik kattuviththa ira'ndupearaakiya raakealaippoalavum leayaa'laippoalavum vaazhnthirukkach seyvaaraaka; nee eppiraaththaavilea paakkiyavaanaayirunthu, pethlekeamilea pukazhpet'rirukkakkadavaay.
inthap pe'n'nidaththilea karththar unakku aru'lichseyyappoaki'ra santhaanaththinaalea, un veedu thaamaar yoothaavukkup pet'ra peareasin veettaippoala aakakkadavathu en'raarka'l.
poavaas rooththai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; ava'l avanukku manaiviyaanaa'l; avan ava'lidaththil piraveasiththapoathu, ava'l karppanthariththu, oru aa'npi'l'laiyaip pe'rak karththar anukkirakampa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu sthireeka'l nakoamiyaip paarththu: suthantharavaa'li at'ruppoakaathapadikku in'ru unakkuth thayaiseytha karththarukku sthoaththiram; avan pear isravealilea pirapalamaakakkadavathu.

avan un aaththumaavukku aa'ruthal seyki'ravanum, un muthirvayathilea unnai aatharikki'ravanumaayirukkakkadavan; unnaich sineakiththu, eazhu kumaararaippaarkkilum unakku arumaiyaayirukki'ra un marumaka'l avanaip pet'raa'lea en'raarka'l.
nakoami anthap pi'l'laiyai eduththu, than madiyilea vaiththu, athai va'larkki'ra thaayaanaa'l.
ayalveettukkaarika'l nakoamikku oru aa'npi'l'lai pi'ranthathu en'ru vaazhththi, atha'rku oapeath en'ru pearittaarka'l; avan thaaveethin thakappanaakiya eesaayin thakappan.
peareasudaiya santhathiyin varalaa'ru: peareas esroanaip pet'raan.
esroan raamaip pet'raan; raam amminathaapaip pet'raan.
amminathaap nakasoanaip pet'raan; nakasoan salmoanaip pet'raan.
salmoan poavaasaip pet'raan; poavaas oapeathaip pet'raan.
oapeath eesaayaip pet'raan; eesaay thaaveethaip pet'raan.

eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththilirukki'ra soappeem ennappatta raamathaayeem ooraanaakiya oru manushan irunthaan; avanukku elkkaanaa en'ru pear; avan eppiraayeemiyanaakiya sooppukkup pi'rantha thoakuvin kumaaranaakiya elikoovin makanaana eroakaamin puththiran.
avanukku ira'ndu manaivika'l irunthaarka'l; oruththipear annaa'l, mat'rava'lpear peninnaa'l; peninnaa'lukkup pi'l'laika'l irunthaarka'l; annaa'lukkoa pi'l'lai illai.

antha manushan seeloavilea seanaika'lin karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lavum avarukkup paliyidavum varushanthoa'rum than oorilirunthu poayvaruvaan; angkea karththarin aasaariyaraana ealiyin ira'ndu kumaararaakiya oapniyum pinekaasum irunthaarka'l.
angkea elkkaanaa paliyidum naa'lilea, avan than manaiviyaakiya peninnaa'lukkum, ava'ludaiya ellaak kumaararukkum kumaaraththika'lukkum, pangkupoattuk koduppaan.
annaa'laich sineakiththapadiyinaal, ava'lukku irattippaana pangku koduppaan; karththaroa ava'l karppaththai adaiththirunthaar.
karththar ava'l karppaththai adaiththapadiyinaal, ava'ludaiya sakka'laththi ava'l thukkappadumpadiyaaka ava'lai mikavum visanappaduththuvaa'l.

ava'l karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkup poakum samayaththil, avan varushanthoa'rum anthappirakaaramaaych seyvaan; iva'l ava'lai manamadivaakkuvaa'l; appozhuthu ava'l saappidaamal azhuthuko'ndiruppaa'l.

ava'l purushanaakiya elkkaanaa ava'laip paarththu: annaa'lea, ean azhuki'raay? ean saappidaathirukki'raay? ean sagnchalappaduki'raay? paththuk kumaararaippaarkkilum naan unakku athikamallavaa en'raan.
seeloavilea avarka'l pusiththuk kudiththapinpu, annaa'l ezhunthirunthaa'l; aasaariyanaakiya eali karththarudaiya aalayaththin vaasal nilaiya'ndaiyilea oru aasanaththinmeal udkaarnthirunthaan.
ava'l poay, manangkasanthu, mikavum azhuthu, karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni:

seanaika'lin karththaavea, theavareer ummudaiya adiyaa'lin si'rumaiyaik ka'n'noakkip paarththu, ummudaiya adiyaa'lai ma'ravaamal ninaintharu'li, umathu adiyaa'lukku oru aa'n pi'l'laiyaik koduththaal, avan uyiroadirukkum sakala naa'lum naan avanaik karththarukku oppukkoduppean; avan thalaiyinmeal savarakan kaththi paduvathillai en'ru oru poruththanai pa'n'ninaa'l.
ava'l karththarudaiya sannithiyil vekunearam vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'rapoathu, eali ava'l vaayaik kavaniththukko'ndirunthaan.
annaa'l than iruthayaththilea peasinaa'l; ava'ludaiya uthaduka'l maaththiram asainthathu, ava'l saththamoa keadkappadavillai; aakaiyaal ava'l ve'riththirukki'raa'l en'ru eali ninaiththu,
ava'lai noakki: nee ethuvaraikkum ve'riththiruppaay? un kudiyai unnaivittu vilakku en'raan.

atha'rku annaa'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: appadiyalla, en aa'ndavanea, naan manakkileasamu'l'la sthiree; naan thiraadcharasamaakilum mathuvaakilum kudikkavillai; naan karththarudaiya sannithiyil en iruthayaththai oot'rivittean.
ummudaiya adiyaa'laip pealiyaa'lin maka'laaka e'n'naatheayum; mikuthiyaana visaaraththinaalum kileasaththinaalum innearamattum vi'n'nappampa'n'ninean en'raa'l.
atha'rku eali samaathaanaththudanea poa; nee isravealin theavanidaththil keatta un vi'n'nappaththinpadi avar unakkuk katta'laiyiduvaaraaka en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l: ummudaiya adiyaa'lukku ummudaiya ka'nka'lilea thayaikidaikkakkadavathu en'raa'l; pinpu antha sthiree pu'rappattuppoay, poajanagnseythaa'l; appu'ram ava'l thukkamukamaayirukkavillai.

avarka'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu, raamaavilirukki'ra thangka'l veettukkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l; elkkaanaa than manaiviyaakiya annaa'lai a'rinthaan; karththar ava'lai ninaintharu'linaar.
silanaa'l sen'rapinpu annaa'l karppavathiyaaki, oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, karththaridaththil avanaik keattean en'ru solli, avanukku saamuveal en'ru pearittaa'l.
elkkaanaa enpavan karththarukku varushaantharam seluththum paliyaiyum than poruththanaiyaiyum seluththumpadiyaaka, than veettaar anaivaroadungkoodap poanaan.

annaa'l koodappoakavillai; ava'l: pi'l'lai paalma'ranthapinpu, avan karththarin sannithiyilea kaa'nappadavum, angkea eppozhuthum irukkavum, naan avanaik ko'ndupoay viduvean en'ru than purushanidaththil sonnaa'l.

appozhuthu ava'l purushanaakiya elkkaanaa ava'lai noakki: nee un ishdappadi seythu, avanaip paalma'rakkappa'n'numattum iru; karththar thammudaiya vaarththaiyaimaaththiram ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaka en'raan; appadiyea antha sthiree than pi'l'laiyaip paal ma'rakkappa'n'numattum atha'rku mulaikoduththaa'l.

ava'l avanaip paalma'rakkap pa'n'ninapinpu, moon'ru kaa'laika'laiyum, oru marakkaal maavaiyum, oru thuruththi thiraadcharasaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu, avanaiyum koottikko'ndu, seeloavilirukki'ra karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poanaa'l; pi'l'lai innum kuzhanthaiyaayirunthathu.
avarka'l oru kaa'laiyaip paliyittu, pi'l'laiyai ealiyinidaththil ko'nduvanthu vittaarka'l.
appozhuthu ava'l: en aa'ndavanea, ingkea umma'ndaiyilea nin'ru karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nina sthiree naanthaan en'ru en aa'ndavanaakiya ummudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
inthap pi'l'laikkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninean; naan karththaridaththil keatta en vi'n'nappaththinpadi enakkuk katta'laiyittaar.
aakaiyaal avan karththarukken'ru keadkappattapadiyinaal, avan uyiroadirukkum sakala naa'lum avanaik karththarukkea oppukkodukki'rean en'raa'l; avan angkea karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaan.

appozhuthu annaa'l jepampa'n'ni: en iruthayam karththarukku'l ka'likooruki'rathu; en kompu karththarukku'l uyarnthirukki'rathu; en pakaignarinmeal en vaay thi'ranthirukki'rathu; ummudaiya iradchippinaalea santhoashappaduki'rean.
karththaraippoalap parisuththamu'l'lavar illai; ummaiyallaamal vea'roruvarum illai; engka'l theavanaippoala oru kanmalaiyum illai.
ini meattimaiyaana peachchaip peasaathirungka'l; akanthaiyaana peachchu ungka'l vaayilirunthu pu'rappadavea'ndaam; karththar gnaanamu'l'la theavan; avar seykaika'l yathaarththamallavoa?
palavaanka'lin vil mu'rinthathu; tha'l'laadinavarka'loa palaththinaal idaikattappattaarka'l.

thirupthiyaayirunthavarka'l appaththukkaaka koolivealai seyki'raarka'l; pasiyaayirunthavarka'loa inip pasiyaayiraarka'l; maladiyaayirunthava'l eazhu pet'raa'l; aneakam pi'l'laika'laip pet'rava'loa paladchayappattaa'l.
karththar kolluki'ravarum uyirppikki'ravarumaayirukki'raar; avarea paathaa'laththil i'rangkavum athilirunthu ea'ravum pa'n'nuki'ravar.
karththar thariththiram adaiyachseyki'ravarum, aisuvariyam adaiyappa'n'nuki'ravarumaayirukki'raar; avar thaazhththuki'ravarum, uyarththuki'ravarumaanavar.

avar si'riyavanaip puzhuthiyilirunthu eduththu, e'liyavanaik kuppaiyilirunthu uyarththuki'raar; avarka'laip pirapukka'loadea udkaaravum, makimaiyu'l'la singkaasanaththaich suthantharikkavum pa'n'nuki'raar; poomiyin asthipaarangka'l karththarudaiyavaika'l; avarea avaika'linmeal poochchakkaraththai vaiththaar.
avar thamathu parisuththavaanka'lin paathangka'laik kaappaar; thunmaarkkar iru'lilea maunamaavaarka'l; pelaththinaal oruvanum mea'rko'lvathillai.

karththaroadea vazhakkaaduki'ravarka'l no'rukkappaduvaarka'l; vaanaththilirunthu avarka'lmeal muzhangkuvaar; karththar poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lai niyaayantheerththu, thaam ea'rpaduththina raajaavukkup pelan a'liththu, thaam apisheakam pa'n'ninavarin kompai uyarappa'n'nuvaar en'ru thuthiththaa'l.
pinpu elkkaanaa raamaavilirukki'ra than veettukkup poanaan; anthap pi'l'laiyoa, aasaariyanaakiya ealikku munpaakak karththarukkup pa'nividai seythuko'ndirunthaan.
ealiyin kumaarar pealiyaa'lin makka'laayirunthaarka'l; avarka'l karththarai a'riyavillai.

antha aasaariyarka'l janangka'lai nadappiththa vitham ennaven'raal, evanaakilum oru paliyaich seluththungkaalaththil i'raichchi veakumpoathu, aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaran moon'ru koo'ru'l'la oru aayuthaththaith than kaiyilea pidiththuvanthu,

athinaalea, kopparaiyilaavathu paanaiyilaavathu saruvaththilaavathu sattiyilaavathu kuththuvaan; antha aayuthaththil varuki'rathaiyellaam aasaariyan eduththukko'l'luvaan; appadi angkea seeloavilea varuki'ra isravealarukkellaam seythaarka'l.

kozhuppaith thakanikki'ratha'rku munnum, aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaran vanthu paliyiduki'ra manushanai noakki: aasaariyanukkup porikkumpadi i'raichchi kodu; pachchai i'raichchiyea allaamal, aviththathai un kaiyilea vaangkuki'rathillai enpaan.

atha'rku antha manushan: in'ru seyyavea'ndiyapadi muthalaavathu kozhuppaith thakaniththuvidattum; pi'rpaadu un manaviruppaththinpadi eduththukko'l en'ru sonnaalum; avan: appadiyalla, ippozhuthea kodu, illaavittaal palavanthamaay eduththukko'l'luvean enpaan.
aathalaal antha vaaliparin paavam karththarudaiya sannithiyil mikavum perithaayirunthathu; manushar karththarin kaa'nikkaiyai ve'ruppaay e'n'ninaarka'l.
saamuveal ennum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan sa'nalnool eapoaththaith thariththavanaayk karththarukku munpaakap pa'nividai seythaan.
avanudaiya thaay varushanthoa'rum seluththum paliyaich seluththuki'ratha'rkaaka, than purushanoadeakooda varuki'rapoathellaam, avanukku oru sinnach sattaiyaith thaiththukko'ndu varuvaa'l.

eali elkkaanaavaiyum avan manaiviyaiyum aaseervathiththu: intha sthiree karththarukken'ru oppukkoduththatha'rkup pathilaakak karththar unakku ava'laalea santhaanam katta'laiyiduvaaraaka en'raan; avarka'l thangka'l sthaanaththi'rkuth thirumpap poayvittaarka'l.

appadiyea karththar annaa'laik kadaadchiththaar; ava'l karppanthariththu moon'ru kumaararaiyum ira'ndu kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raa'l; saamuveal ennum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan karththarudaiya sannithiyil va'larnthaan.

eali mikuntha kizhavanaayirunthaan; avan than kumaarar isravealukkellaam seyki'ra ellaavat'raiyum, avarka'l aasarippuk koodaaraththin vaasalil koottangkooduki'ra sthireeka'loadea sayanikki'rathaiyum kea'lvippattu,
avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippadippatta kaariyangka'laich seyki'rathu enna? intha janangka'l ellaarum ungka'l pollaatha nadakkaika'laich sollakkeadki'rean.
en kumaararea, vea'ndaam; naan kea'lvippaduki'ra inthach seythi nallathalla; karththarudaiya janangka'l mee'ri nadakki'ratha'rkuk kaara'namaayirukki'reerka'lea.

manushanukku viroathamaaka manushan paavagnseythaal, niyaayaathipathika'l athaith theerppaarka'l; oruvan karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseyvaaneayaakil, avanukkaaka vi'n'nappagnseyyaththakkavan yaar en'raan; avarka'loa thangka'l thakappan sollaik kea'laama'rpoanaarka'l; avarka'laich sangkarikkak karththar siththamaayirunthaar.
saamuveal ennum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanoa, periyavanaaka va'larnthu, karththarukkum manusharukkum piriyamaaka nadanthuko'ndaan.
theavanudaiya manushan oruvan ealiyinidaththil vanthu: karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, un pithaavin veettaar ekipthilea paarvoanin veettil irukkaiyil, naan ennai avarka'lukku ve'lippaduththi,

en palipeedaththinmeal paliyidavum, thoopangkaattavum, en samukaththil eapoaththaith tharikkavum, israveal koaththirangka'lilellaam avanai enakku aasaariyanaakath therinthuko'ndu, un pithaavin veettaarukku israveal puththirarudaiya thakanapalika'laiyellaam kodukkavillaiyaa?

en vaasasthalaththilea seluththumpadi naan katta'laiyitta en paliyaiyum, en kaa'nikkaiyaiyum, neengka'l uthaippaanean? en janamaakiya isravealin kaa'nikkaika'lilellaam pirathaanamaanavaika'laik ko'ndu ungka'laik kozhukkappa'n'numpadikku, nee ennaippaarkkilum un kumaararai mathippaanean enki'raar.

aakaiyaal isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathaavathu: un veettaarum un pithaavin veettaarum en'raikkum en sannithiyil nadanthu ko'lvaarka'l en'ru naan nichchayamaaych solliyirunthum, ini athu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; ennaik kanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lai naan kanam pa'n'nuvean; ennai asattaipa'n'nuki'ravarka'l kanaeenappaduvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
un veettil oru kizhavanum iraathapadikku un puyaththaiyum un pithaavin veettaarudaiya puyaththaiyum naan tha'riththuppoadum naadka'l varum.
isravealukkuch seyyappadum sakala nanmaikkum maa'raaka en vaasasthalaththilea upaththiravaththaik kaa'npaay; orupoathum un veettil oru kizhavanum iruppathillai.

en palipeedaththil seavikka, naan un santhathiyil nirmoolamaakkaathavarka'loa, un ka'nka'laip pooththuppoakappa'n'navum, un aaththumaavai veathanaippaduththavum vaikkappaduvaarka'l; un vamsaththilu'l'la yaavarum vaalavayathilea saavaarka'l.
oapni pinekaas ennum un ira'ndu kumaararinmeal varuvathea unakku adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum; avarka'l iruvarum oreanaa'lil saavaarka'l.

naan en u'l'laththukkum en siththaththukkum eat'rapadi seyyaththakka u'nmaiyaana oru aasaariyanai ezhumpappa'n'ni, avanukku nilaiyaana veettaik kattuvean; avan ennaal apisheakampa'n'nappattavanukku munpaakach sakala naa'lum nadanthuko'l'luvaan.

appozhuthu un veettaaril meethiyaayiruppavan evanum oru ve'l'lippa'naththukkaakavum oru appaththu'nikkaikkaakavum avanidaththil vanthu pa'ninthu: naan kogncham appam saappida yaathoru aasaariya oozhiyaththil ennaich searththukko'l'lum en'ru kegnchuvaan en'ru solluki'raar en'raan.

saamuveal ennum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan ealikku munpaakak karththarukkup pa'nividai seythuko'ndirunthaan; annaadka'lilea karththarudaiya vasanam apoorvamaayirunthathu; piraththiyadchamaana tharisanam irunthathillai.
orunaa'l eali thannudaiya sthaanaththilea paduththukko'ndirunthaan; avan paarkkakkoodaathapadikku avanudaiya ka'nka'l iru'ladainthirunthathu.
theavanudaiya petti irukki'ra karththarudaiya aalayaththil theavanudaiya vi'lakku a'nainthupoakumunnea saamuvealum paduththukko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu karththar, saamuvealaik kooppittaar. atha'rku avan: ithoa, irukki'rean en'ru solli,
ealiyinidaththil oadi, ithoa, irukki'rean; ennaik kooppitteerea en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan kooppidavillai, thirumpippoayp paduththukko'l en'raan; avan poayp paduththukko'ndaan.

ma'rupadiyum karththar saamuvealea en'ru kooppittaar; appozhuthu saamuveal ezhunthirunthu ealiyinidaththil poay: ithoa, irukki'rean; ennaik kooppitteerea en'raan. atha'rku avan: en makanea, naan unnaik kooppidavillai, thirumpippoayp paduththukko'l en'raan.
saamuveal karththarai innum a'riyaathirunthaan; karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku innum ve'lippadavillai.

karththar ma'rupadiyum moon'raamvisai: saamuvealea en'ru kooppittaar. avan ezhunthirunthu ealiyinidaththil poay, ithoa, irukki'rean; ennaik kooppitteerea en'raan. appozhuthu karththar pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaik kooppiduki'raar en'ru eali a'rinthu,

saamuvealai noakki: nee poayp paduththukko'l; unnaik kooppittaal, appozhuthu nee: karththaavea sollum; adiyean keadki'rean en'ru sol en'raan; saamuveal poay, thannudaiya sthaanaththilea paduththukko'ndaan.
appozhuthu karththar vanthu nin'ru, munpoala: saamuvealea saamuvealea en'ru kooppittaar; atha'rkuch saamuveal: sollum; adiyean keadki'rean en'raan.
karththar saamuvealai noakki: ithoa, naan isravealil oru kaariyaththaich seyvean; athaik keadki'ra ovvoruvanudaiya ira'ndu kaathuka'lilum athu thoniththukko'ndirukkum.
naan ealiyin kudumpaththi'rku viroathamaakach sonna yaavaiyum, avanmeal annaa'lilea varappa'n'nuvean; athaith thodangkavum athai mudikkavum poaki'rean.

avan kumaarar thangka'lmeal saapaththai varappa'n'nuki'rathai avan a'rinthirunthum, avarka'lai adakkaama'rpoana paavaththinimiththam, naan avan kudumpaththukku en'rum neengkaatha niyaayaththeerppuch seyvean en'ru avanukku a'riviththean.

athinimiththam ealiyin kudumpaththaar seytha akkiramam orupoathum paliyinaalaavathu kaa'nikkaiyinaalaavathu nivirththiyaavathillai en'ru ealiyin kudumpaththaikku'riththu aa'naiyittirukki'rean en'raar.
saamuveal vidiya'rkaalamattum paduththirunthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththin kathavuka'laith thi'ranthaan; saamuveal ealikku anthath tharisanaththai a'rivikkap payanthaan.
ealiyoa: saamuvealea, en makanea en'ru saamuvealaik kooppittaan. avan: ithoa, irukki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: karththar unnidaththil sonna kaariyam enna? enakku athai ma'raikkavea'ndaam; avar unnidaththil sonna sakala kaariyaththilum yaathon'rai enakku ma'raiththaayaanaal, theavan unakku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyvaaraaka en'raan.

appozhuthu saamuveal on'raiyum avanukku ma'raikkaamal, anthak kaariyangka'laiyellaam avanukku a'riviththaan. atha'rku avan: avar karththar; avar thamathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seyvaaraaka en'raan.
saamuveal va'larnthaan; karththar avanudaneakooda irunthaar; avar thammudaiya ellaa vaarththaika'lilum on'raiyaakilum tharaiyilea vizhunthupoaka vidavillai.
saamuveal karththarudaiya theerkkatharisithaan en'ru thaa'nmuthal peyersepaamattumu'l'la sakala isravealarukkum vi'langkinathu.
karththar pinnum seeloavilea tharisanam thantharu'linaar; karththar seeloavilea thammudaiya vaarththaiyinaalea saamuvealukkuth thammai ve'lippaduththinaar.

saamuvealin vaarththai isravealukkellaam vanthathu. isravealar pelistharukku viroathamaay yuththagn seyyappu'rappattu, epeneasarukkuch sameepaththil paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; pelistharoa aappekkilea paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l.

pelisthar isravealarukku viroathamaay a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l; yuththam athikariththu, isravealar pelistharukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattaarka'l; avarka'l seanaiyil poarkka'laththilea ea'rakku'raiya naalaayirampear vettu'ndupoanaarka'l.

janangka'l thirumpap paa'layaththukku vanthapoathu, isravealin moopparaanavarka'l, in'ru karththar pelistharukku munpaaka nammai mu'riya adiththathenna? seeloavilirukki'ra karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyaik ko'nduvaruvoam; athu nammai nammudaiya pakaignarin kaikku vilakki radchikkumpadi, nammudaiya naduvilea varavea'ndiyathu en'raarka'l.

appadiyea kearupeenka'lin maththiyilea vaasamaayirukki'ra seanaika'lin karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyai eduththuvara, janangka'l seeloavukkuch solliyanuppinaarka'l; angkea ealiyin ira'ndu kumaararaakiya oapniyum pinekaasum theavanudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiya'ndaiyil irunthaarka'l.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippetti paa'layaththilea varuki'rapoathu, isravealarellaarum poomi athiraththakkathaaka makaa aarpparippaaych saththamittaarka'l.

avarka'l aarpparikki'ra saththaththaip pelisthar keattapoathu: epireyarudaiya paa'layaththil intha makaa aarpparippin saththam enna en'raarka'l; pinpu karththarin petti paa'layaththil vanthathu en'ru a'rinthuko'ndaarka'l.
theavan paa'layaththil vanthaar en'ru sollappattapadiyinaal, pelisthar payanthu, aiyoa, namakku moasam vanthathu; itha'rkumun orupoathum ippadi nadakkavillaiyea.
aiyoa, antha makaththuvamaana theavarka'lin kaikku nammaith thappuvippavar yaar? ekipthiyaraich sakalavitha vaathaika'linaalum vanaantharaththilea adiththa theavarka'l ivarka'lthaanea.

pelistharea, thidangko'ndu purusharaippoala nadanthuko'l'lungka'l; epireyar ungka'lukku adimaika'laayirunthathupoala, neengka'lum avarka'lukku adimaika'laakaathapadikku, purusharaayirunthu, yuththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu pelisthar yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; isravealar mu'rinthu, avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l; makaa periya sangkaaram u'ndaayit'ru; isravealilea muppathinaayiram kaalaadka'l vizhunthaarka'l.
theavanudaiya petti pidikkappattathu; ealiyin ira'ndu kumaararaakiya oapniyum pinekaasum maa'ndaarka'l.
penyameen koaththiraththaanaakiya oruvan padaiyilirunthu oadi, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, than thalaiyinmeal puzhuthiyai vaarip poattukko'ndu, an'raiyathinamea seeloavukku vanthaan.

avan vanthapoathu: eali oru aasanaththinmeal udkaarnthu vazhiyaip paarththukko'ndirunthaan; theavanudaiya pettikkaaka avan iruthayam thaththa'liththukko'ndirunthathu. oorilea seythiyai a'rivikka antha manushan vanthapoathu, oorengkum pulampal u'ndaayit'ru.
pulampuki'ra inthach saththaththai eali keattapoathu: intha ama'liyin iraichchal enna en'ru keattaan; appozhuthu antha manushan theeviriththu vanthu, ealikku a'riviththaan.
eali tho'n'noot'rettu vayathu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; avan paarkkakkoodaathapadikku, avan ka'nka'l mangkalaayirunthathu.
antha manushan ealiyaip paarththu: padaiyilirunthu vanthavan naanthaan; in'ru thaan padaiyilirunthu oadivanthean en'raan. appozhuthu avan: en makanea, nadantha kaariyam enna en'ru keattaan.

seythi ko'nduvanthavan pirathiyuththaramaaka: isravealar pelistharukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadippoanaarka'l; janangka'lukku'l'lea periya sangkaaram u'ndaayit'ru; ummudaiya kumaararaakiya oapni pinekaas ennum iruvarum i'ranthupoanaarka'l; theavanudaiya pettiyum pidipattuppoayit'ru en'raan.

avan theavanudaiya pettiyaik ku'riththuch sonnavudanea, eali aasanaththilirunthu vaasalin pakkamaay mallaakka vizhunthaan; avan kizhavanum sthooliththavanumaayirunthapadiyaal, avan pidari mu'rinthu seththuppoanaan. avan isravealai naa'rpathu varusham niyaayam visaariththaan.

pinekaasin manaiviyaakiya avan marumaka'l ni'raikarppi'niyaayirunthaa'l; ava'l theavanudaiya petti pidipatta seythiyaiyum, than maamanum than purushanum i'ranthu poanathaiyum kea'lvippattapoathu, ava'l karppaveathanaippattu kuninthu pirasaviththaa'l.

ava'l saakappoaki'ra nearaththil ava'la'ndaiyilea nin'ra sthireeka'l: nee payappadaathea, aa'npi'l'laiyaip pet'raay en'raarka'l; ava'loa atha'rku on'rum sollavumillai, athinmeal sinthaivaikkavumillai.

theavanudaiya petti pidipattu, ava'ludaiya maamanum ava'ludaiya purushanum i'ranthupoanapadiyinaal, ava'l: makimai isravealai vittuppoayit'ru en'ru solli, anthap pi'l'laikku ikkapoath en'ru pearittaa'l.
theavanudaiya petti pidipattup poanapadiyinaal, makimai isravealai vittu vilakippoayit'ru en'raa'l.
pelisthar theavanudaiya pettiyaip pidiththu, athai epeneasarilirunthu asthoaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
pelisthar theavanudaiya pettiyaip pidiththu, thaakoanin koavililea ko'nduvanthu, thaakoana'ndaiyilea vaiththaarka'l.

asthoath ooraar ma'runaa'l kaalamea ezhunthirunthu vanthapoathu, ithoa, thaakoan karththarudaiya pettikku munpaakath tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthukidanthathu; appozhuthu avarka'l thaakoanai eduththu, athai athin sthaanaththilea thirumpavum ni'ruththinaarka'l.

avarka'l ma'runaa'l kaalamea ezhunthirunthu vanthapoathu, ithoa, thaakoan karththarudaiya pettikku munpaakath tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthukidanthathumallaamal, thaakoanin thalaiyum athin ira'ndu kaika'lum vaasa'rpadiyinmeal udaipattuk kidanthathu; thaakoanukku udalmaaththiram meethiyaayirunthathu.
aathalaal innaa'lvaraikkum thaakoanin poojaasaarika'lum thaakoanin koavilukku'l piraveasikki'ra yaavarum asthoaththilirukki'ra thaakoanudaiya vaasa'rpadiyai mithikki'rathillai.

asthoath ooraaraip paazhaakkumpadikku karththarudaiya kai avarka'lmeal paaramaayirunthathu; avar asthoaththin janangka'laiyum, athin ellaika'lukku'l irukki'ravarka'laiyum moolaviyaathiyinaal vaathiththaar.

ippadi nadanthathai asthoaththin janangka'l ka'ndapoathu: isravealin theavanudaiya kai namathumealum, nammudaiya theavanaakiya thaakoaninmealum kadinamaayirukki'rapadiyaal, avarudaiya petti nammidaththil irukkalaakaathu en'ru solli;

pelistharin athipathika'laiyellaam azhaippiththu, thangka'la'ndaiyilea koodivarach seythu: isravealin theavanudaiya pettiyai naam enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l. avarka'l: isravealin theavanudaiya pettiyai kaathpatta'namattum eduththuch sut'rikko'ndu poakavea'ndum en'raarka'l; appadiyea isravealin theavanudaiya pettiyai eduththuch sut'rikko'ndupoanaarka'l.

athai eduththuch sut'rikko'ndu poanapinpu, karththarudaiya kai anthap patta'naththinmeal makaa ukkiramaaka i'rangkit'ru; anthap patta'naththin manusharukku'l, si'riyavarthuvakkip periyavarmattum, moolaviyaathiyai u'ndaakki, avarka'lai vaathiththaar.

athinaal avarka'l theavanudaiya pettiyai ekroanukku anuppinaarka'l; theavanudaiya petti ekroanukku varuki'rapoathu, ekroan ooraar: engka'laiyum engka'l janangka'laiyum kon'rupoada, isravealin theavanudaiya pettiyai eduththu, engka'la'ndaikkuch sut'rikko'ndu vanthaarka'l en'ru kookkuralittaarka'l.

avarka'l pelistharin athipathika'laiyellaam koodivarumpadi azhaiththu: isravealin theavan engka'laiyum engka'l janangka'laiyum kon'rupoadaathapadikku, avarudaiya pettiyai athin sthaanaththi'rkuth thirumpa anuppividungka'l en'raarka'l; anthap patta'namengkum saavu mummuramaayirunthathu; theavanudaiya kai angkea makaa paaramaayirunthathu.
seththuppoakaathirunthavarka'l moolaviyaathiyinaal vaathikkappattathinaal, anthap patta'naththin kookkural vaanapariyantham ezhumpit'ru.
karththarudaiya petti pelistharin theasaththil eazhumaatham irunthathu.

pinpu pelisthar poojaasaarika'laiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum azhaippiththu: karththarudaiya pettiyaippat'ri naangka'l enna seyyavea'ndum? athai naangka'l evvithamaay athin sthaanaththi'rku anuppividalaam en'ru engka'lukkuch sollungka'l en'raarka'l.

atha'rku avarka'l: isravealin theavanudaiya pettiyai neengka'l anuppinaal, athai ve'rumaiyaay anuppaamal, kut'ranivaara'na kaa'nikkaiyai evvithaththilum avarukkuch seluththavea'ndum; appozhuthu neengka'l sosthamadaiki'rathum allaamal, avarudaiya kai ungka'lai vidaathiruntha mukaantharam innathu en'rum ungka'lukkuth theriyavarum en'raarka'l.
