atha'rku avarka'l: kut'ranivaara'na kaa'nikkaiyaaka naangka'l avarukku ennaththaich seluththavea'ndumen'ru keattatha'rku, avarka'l: ungka'lellaarukkum ungka'l athipathika'lukkum orea vaathaiyu'ndaanapadiyaal, pelistharudaiya athipathika'lin ilakkaththi'rkuch sariyaaka moolaviyaathiyin saayalaanapadi seytha ainthu pon suroopangka'lum, ponnaal seytha ainthu su'ndelika'lum seluththavea'ndum.

aakaiyaal ungka'l moolaviyaathiyin saayalaana suroopangka'laiyum, ungka'l theasaththaik keduththuppoatta su'ndelika'lin saayalaana suroopangka'laiyum neengka'l u'ndupa'n'ni, isravealin theavanukku makimaiyaich seluththungka'l; appozhuthu oruvea'lai ungka'lmealum, ungka'l theavarka'lmealum, ungka'l theasaththinmealum i'rangkiyirukki'ra avarudaiya kai ungka'lai vittu vilakum.

ekipthiyarum paarvoanum thangka'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinathupoala, neengka'l ungka'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththuvaanean? avarka'lai avar theengkaay vaathiththapinpu, janangka'lai avarka'l anuppivittathum, avarka'l poayvittathum illaiyoa?

ippoathum neengka'l oru puthuva'ndil seythu, nukam poottaathirukki'ra ira'ndu ka'ravaippasukka'laip pidiththu, avaika'lai va'ndililea katti, avaika'lin kan'rukkuttika'lai avaika'lukkup pinnaakap poakavidaamal, veettilea ko'nduvanthu vittu,

pinpu karththarudaiya pettiyai eduththu, athai va'ndilinmeal vaiththu, neengka'l kut'ranivaara'nakaa'nikkaiyaaka avarukkuch seluththum ponnuruppadika'lai athin pakkaththil oru si'riya pettiyilea vaiththu, athai anuppividungka'l.

appozhuthu paarungka'l; athu than ellaikkup poaki'ravazhiyaayp pethshimeasukkup poanaal, inthap periya theengkai namakkuch seythavar avarthaamea en'ru a'riyalaam; poakaathirunthaal, avarudaiya kai nammaith thodaamal, athu tha'rseyalaay namakku nearittathu en'ru a'rinthuko'l'lalaam en'raarka'l.
antha manushar appadiyea seythu, ira'ndu ka'ravaippasukka'laik ko'nduvanthu, avaika'lai va'ndililea katti, avaika'lin kan'rukkuttika'lai veettilea adaiththuvaiththu,
karththarudaiya pettiyaiyum, ponnaal seytha su'ndelika'lum thangka'l moolaviyaathiyin saayalaana suroopangka'lum vaiththirukki'ra si'riya pettiyaiyum, antha va'ndilinmeal vaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu anthap pasukka'l pethshimeasukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilea sevvaiyaayp poay, valathu idathu pakkamaay vilakaamal, perumpaathaiyaana nearvazhiyaakak kooppittukko'ndea nadanthathu; pelistharin athipathika'l pethshimeasin ellaimattum avaika'lin pi'rakea poanaarka'l.

pethshimeasin manushar pa'l'laththaakkilea koathumai a'ruppu a'ruththukko'ndirunthaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l ka'nka'lai ea'redukkumpoathu, pettiyaik ka'ndu, athaik ka'ndathinaal santhoashappattaarka'l.

antha va'ndil pethshimeas ooraanaakiya yoasuvaavin vayalil vanthu, angkea nin'rathu; angkea oru periya kallirunthathu; appozhuthu va'ndilin marangka'laip pi'lanthu, pasukka'laik karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththinaarka'l.

leaviyar karththarudaiya pettiyaiyum, athanoadiruntha ponnuruppadika'lu'l'la si'riya pettiyaiyum i'rakki, anthap periya kallinmeal vaiththaarka'l; pethshimeasin manushar, an'raiyathinam karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanangka'laich seluththip palika'lai ittaarka'l.
pelistharin ainthu athipathika'lum ivaika'laikka'ndu, an'raiyathinam ekroanukkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.

pelisthar kut'ranivaara'naththi'rkaaka, karththarukkuch seluththina moolaviyaathiyin saayalaana pon suroopangka'laavana, asthoaththi'rkaaka on'ru, kaasaavukkaaka on'ru, askaloanukkaaka on'ru, kaaththukkaaka on'ru, ekroanukkaaka on'ru.

ponnaal seytha su'ndelika'loaven'raal, ara'naana patta'nangka'l thuvakki naattilu'l'la kiraamangka'lmattum, karththarudaiya pettiyai vaiththa periya kal irukki'ra aapealmattum, ainthu athipathika'lukkum aatheenamaayirukki'ra pelistharudaiya sakala oorka'lin ilakkaththi'rkuch sariyaayirunthathu. anthak kal innaa'lvaraikkum pethshimeas ooraanaakiya yoasuvaavin vayalil irukki'rathu.

aanaalum pethshimeasin manushar karththarudaiya pettikku'l paarththapadiyinaal, karththar janangka'lil aimpathinaayiraththu ezhupathupearai adiththaar; appozhuthu karththar janangka'laip periya sangkaaramaaka adiththathinimiththam, janangka'l thukkiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
inthap parisuththamaana theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka ni'rkaththakkavan yaar? petti nammidaththilirunthu yaaridaththukkup poakum en'ru pethshimeasin manushar solli,

keeriyaathyaareemin kudika'lukku aadka'lai anuppi: pelisthar karththarudaiya pettiyaith thirumpa anuppinaarka'l; neengka'l vanthu, athai ungka'lidaththukku eduththukko'ndu poangka'l en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l.

appadiyea keeriyaathyaareemin manushar vanthu, karththarudaiya pettiyai eduththu, meattinmealirukki'ra apinathaapin veettilea ko'nduvanthu vaiththu, karththarudaiya pettiyaik kaakkumpadikku, avan kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaaraip parisuththappaduththinaarka'l.
petti keeriyaathyaareemilea aneakanaa'l thangkiyirunthathu; irupathu varusham angkeayea irunthathu; israveal kudumpaththaarellaarum karththarai ninaiththu, pulampikko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal israveal kudumpaththaar yaavaraiyum noakki: neengka'l ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum karththaridaththil thirumpuki'ravarka'laanaal, anniya theavarka'laiyum astharoaththaiyum ungka'l naduvilirunthu vilakki, ungka'l iruthayaththaik karththarukku nearaakki, avar oruvarukkea aaraathanaiseyyungka'l; appozhuthu avar ungka'laip pelistharudaiya kaikku neengkalaakki viduvaar en'raan.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar paakaalka'laiyum astharoaththaiyum vilakkivittu, karththar oruvarukkea aaraathanaiseythaarka'l.
pinpu saamuveal: naan ungka'lukkaakak karththarai man'raadumpadikku, isravealar ellaaraiyum mispaavilea koottungka'l en'raan.

avarka'l appadiyea mispaavilea koodivanthu tha'n'neer mo'ndu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil oot'ri, an'raiyathinam upavaasampa'n'ni, karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythoam en'ru angkea sonnaarka'l; mispaavilea saamuveal israveal puththirarai niyaayam visaariththukko'ndirunthaan.

israveal puththirar mispaavilea koodivanthathaip pelisthar kea'lvippattapoathu, pelistharin athipathika'l isravealukku viroathamaaka ethirththu vanthaarka'l; athai israveal puththirar keattu, pelistharinimiththam payappattu,
saamuvealai noakki: nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar engka'laip pelistharin kaikku neengkalaakki radchikkumpadikku, engka'lukkaaka avarai noakki oayaamal vea'ndikko'l'lum en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal paalkudikki'ra oru aattukkuttiyaip pidiththu, athaik karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththi, isravealukkaakak karththarai noakki vea'ndikko'ndaan; karththar avanukku ma'rumozhi aru'lichseythaar.

saamuveal sarvaangka thakanapaliyaich seluththukaiyil, pelisthar isravealinmeal yuththampa'n'na nerungkinaarka'l; karththar makaa periya idimuzhakkangka'laip pelistharmeal annaa'lilea muzhangkappa'n'ni, avarka'laik kalangkadiththathinaal, avarka'l isravealukku munpaakap pattu vizhunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu isravealar mispaavilirunthu pelistharaip pinthodarnthupoay, pethkaareem pa'l'laththaakkumattum avarka'lai mu'riya adiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu saamuveal oru kallai eduththu, mispaavukkum sea'nukkum naduvaaka ni'ruththi, immattum karththar engka'lukku uthaviseythaar en'ru solli, atha'rku epeneasar en'ru pearittaan.
inthappirakaaram pelisthar appu'ram isravealin ellaiyilea varaathapadikkuth thaazhththappattaarka'l; saamuvealin naa'lellaam karththarudaiya kai pelistharukku viroathamaay irunthathu.

pelisthar israveal kaiyilirunthu pidiththiruntha ekroan thuvakkik kaathmattumu'l'la patta'nangka'lum isravealukkuth thirumpak kidaiththathu; avaika'laiyum avaika'lin ellaika'laiyum isravealar pelisthar kaiyilea iraathapadikku, viduviththuk ko'ndaarka'l; isravealukkum emoariyarukkum samaathaanam u'ndaayirunthathu.
saamuveal uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan.
avan varushaavarusham pu'rappattu, peththealaiyum kilkaalaiyum mispaavaiyum sut'rippoay, avvidangka'lilellaam isravealai niyaayam visaariththa pinpu,
avan raamaavukkuth thirumpivaruvaan, avanudaiya veedu angkea irunthathu; angkea isravealai niyaayam visaariththu, avvidaththil karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattinaan.
saamuveal muthirvayathaanapoathu, than kumaararai isravealinmeal niyaayaathipathika'laaka vaiththaan.
avanudaiya mooththakumaaranukkup peyar yoaveal, i'laiyavanukkup peyar apiyaa; avarka'l peyersepaavilea niyaayaathipathika'laayirunthaarka'l.
aanaalum avanudaiya kumaarar avan vazhika'lil nadavaamal, poru'laasaikkuch saaynthu, parithaanam vaangki, niyaayaththaip purattinaarka'l.
appozhuthu isravealin mooppar ellaarum koottangkoodi, raamaaviliruntha saamuvealinidaththil vanthu:

ithoa, neer muthirvayathu'l'lavaraaneer; ummudaiya kumaarar ummudaiya vazhika'lil nadakki'rathillai; aakaiyaal sakala jaathika'lukku'l'lum irukki'rapadi, engka'lai niyaayam visaarikki'ratha'rku, oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

engka'lai niyaayam visaarikka oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththum en'ru avarka'l sonna vaarththai saamuvealukkuth thakaathathaayk kaa'nappattathu; aakaiyaal saamuveal karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu karththar saamuvealai noakki: janangka'l unnidaththil solvathellaavat'rilum avarka'l sollaik kea'l; avarka'l unnaith tha'l'lavillai, naan avarka'lai aa'laathapadikku, ennaiththaan tha'l'linaarka'l.

naan avarka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lmuthal innaa'lmattum avarka'l ennaivittu, vea'rea theavarka'laich seaviththuvantha thangka'l ellaach seykaika'linpadiyum seythathupoala, avarka'l unakkum seyki'raarka'l.
ippoathum avarka'l sollaik kea'l; aanaalum un apippiraayaththaik kaattumpadi avarka'lai aa'lum raajaavin kaariyam innathu en'ru avarka'lukkuth thidasaadchiyaayth theriyappaduththu en'raar.
appozhuthu saamuveal, oru raajaa vea'ndum en'ru thannidaththil keatta janangka'lukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laiyellaam solli:
ungka'lai aa'lum raajaavin kaariyam ennaven'raal, than rathaththi'rkumun oadumpadi avan ungka'l kumaararai eduththu, than rathasaarathika'laakavum than kuthiraiveeraraakavum vaiththukko'l'luvaan.

aayirampearukkum aimpathupearukkum thalaivaraakavum, than nilaththai uzhuki'ravarka'laakavum, than vi'laichchalai a'rukki'ravarka'laakavum, than yuththaaayuthangka'laiyum than rathangka'lin pa'nimuttuka'laiyum pa'n'nuki'ravarka'laakavum, avarka'lai vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungka'l kumaaraththika'laip parima'lathailam seyki'ravarka'laakavum, samaiyal pa'n'nuki'ravarka'laakavum, appam suduki'ravarka'laakavum vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungka'l vayalka'lilum, ungka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'lilum, ungka'l olivaththoappuka'lilum, nallavaika'lai eduththukko'ndu, than oozhiyakkaararukkuk koduppaan.
ungka'l thaaniyaththilum ungka'l thiraadchappalanilum thasamapaakam vaangki, than pirathaanika'lukkum than seavakarka'lukkum koduppaan.
ungka'l vealaikkaararaiyum, ungka'l vealaikkaarika'laiyum, ungka'lil thi'ramaiyaana vaaliparaiyum, ungka'l kazhuthaika'laiyum eduththu thannudaiya vealaikku vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungka'l aaduka'lilea paththil on'ru eduththukko'l'luvaan; neengka'l avanukku vealaiyaadka'laaveerka'l.
neengka'l therinthuko'nda ungka'l raajaavinimiththam annaa'lilea mu'raiyiduveerka'l; aanaalum karththar annaa'lilea ungka'lukkuch sevikodukkamaattaar en'raan.
janangka'l saamuvealin sollaik keadka manathillaamal: appadiyalla, engka'lukku oru raajaa irukkaththaan vea'ndum.
sakala jaathika'laiyumpoala naangka'lum iruppoam; engka'l raajaa engka'lai niyaayam visaariththu, engka'lukku munpaakap pu'rappattu, engka'l yuththangka'lai nadaththavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
saamuveal janangka'lin vaarththaika'laiyellaam keattu, avaika'laik karththaridaththil theriyappaduththinaan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: nee avarka'l sollaik keattu, avarka'lai aa'la oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththu en'raar; appozhuthu saamuveal israveal janangka'laip paarththu: avaravar thangka'l oorka'lukkup poakalaam en'raan.

penyameen koaththiraththaaril kees ennum pearu'l'la makaa paraakkiramasaaliyaana oru manushan irunthaan; avan penyameen koaththiraththaanaakiya apiyaavin makanaana pekoaraaththi'rkup pi'rantha searoarin puththiranaakiya apeeyealin kumaaran.

avanukkuch savul ennum pearu'l'la savunthariyamaana vaalipanaakiya oru kumaaran irunthaan; israveal puththiraril avanaippaarkkilum savunthariyavaan illai; ellaa janangka'lum avan thoa'lukkuk keezhaayirukkaththakka uyaramu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

savulin thakappanaakiya keesudaiya kazhuthaika'l kaa'naama'rpoayit'ru; aakaiyaal kees than kumaaranaakiya savulai noakki: nee vealaikkaararil oruvanaik koottikko'ndu, kazhuthaika'laith theada, pu'rappattuppoa en'raan.

appadiyea avan eppiraayeem malaika'laiyum saleeshaa naattaiyum kadanthupoanaan; angkea avaika'laik kaa'naamal saaleem naattaikkadanthaarka'l. angkeayum kaa'navillai; penyameen naattai uruvakkadanthum avaika'laik kaa'navillai.

avarka'l soop ennum naatti'rku vanthapoathu, savul thannoadiruntha vealaikkaaranai noakki: en thakappan, kazhuthaika'linmealu'l'la kavalaiyai vittu, namakkaakak kavalaippadaathapadikkuth thirumpippoavoam vaa en'raan.

atha'rku avan: ithoa, inthap patta'naththilea theavanudaiya manushan oruvar irukki'raar; avar periyavar; avar solluki'rathellaam thappaamal nadakkum; angkea poavoam; oruvea'lai avar naam poakavea'ndiya nammudaiya vazhiyai namakkuth therivippaar en'raan.

appozhuthu savul than vealaikkaaranaip paarththu: naam poanaalum antha manushanukku ennaththaik ko'ndupoavoam; nammudaiya paika'lil iruntha thinpa'ndangka'l selavazhinthupoayit'ru; theavanudaiya manushanaakiya avarukkuk ko'ndu poakaththakka kaa'nikkai nammidaththil on'rum illaiyea en'raan.

antha vealaikkaaran pinnum savulaip paarththu: ithoa, en kaiyil innum kaalseakkal ve'l'liyirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya manushan namakku nammudaiya vazhiyai a'rivikkumpadikku, athai avarukkuk koduppean en'raan.

mu'rkaalaththil isravealil yaathoruvar theavanidaththil visaarikkappoanaal, gnaanathirushdikkaaranidaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungka'l enpaarka'l; innaa'lilea theerkkatharisi ennappaduki'ravan mu'rkaalaththil gnaanathirushdikkaaran ennappaduvaan.
appozhuthu savul than vealaikkaaranai noakki: nallakaariyam sonnaay, poavoam vaa en'raan; appadiyea theavanudaiya manushan iruntha anthap patta'naththi'rkup poanaarka'l.
avarka'l patta'naththu meattin vazhiyaay ea'ruki'rapoathu, tha'n'neer edukkavantha pe'nka'laik ka'ndu: gnaanathirushdikkaaran ingkea irukki'raaraa en'ru avarka'laik keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avarka'l: irukki'raar; ithoa, ungka'lukku ethirea irukki'raar; theeviramaayp poangka'l; in'raikku janangka'l meadaiyil paliyiduki'rapadiyinaal, in'raiyathinam patta'naththi'rku vanthaar.

neengka'l patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasiththavudanea, avar meadaiyinmeal poajanam pa'n'nappoaki'ratha'rku munnea avaraik kaa'npeerka'l; avar varumattum janangka'l poajanam pa'n'namaattaarka'l; paliyittathai avar aaseervathippaar; pinpu azhaikkappattavarka'l poajanampa'n'nuvaarka'l; udanea poangka'l; innearaththilea avaraik ka'nduko'l'lalaam en'raarka'l.
avarka'l patta'naththi'rkup poay, patta'naththin naduvea searnthapoathu, ithoa, saamuveal meadaiyinmeal ea'rippoaki'ratha'rkaaka, avarka'lukku ethirea pu'rappattuvanthaan.
savul vara orunaa'lukku munnea karththar saamuvealin kaathukeadka:

naa'lai innearaththi'rkup penyameen naattaanaakiya oru manushanai unnidaththil anuppuvean; avanai en janamaakiya isravealinmeal athipathiyaaka apisheakampa'n'nakkadavaay; avan en janaththaip pelistharin kaikku neengkalaakki radchippaan; en janaththin mu'raiyiduthal ennidaththil vanthu ettinapadiyinaal, naan avarka'laik kadaadchiththean en'ru ve'lippaduththiyirunthaar.
saamuveal savulaik ka'ndapoathu, karththar avanidaththil: ithoa, naan unakkuch solliyiruntha manushan ivanea; ivanthaan en janaththai aa'luvaan en'raar.
savul naduvaasalilea saamuvealidaththil vanthu: gnaanathirushdikkaaran veedu engkea, sollum en'ru keattaan.

saamuveal savulukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: gnaanathirushdikkaaran naanthaan; nee enakku munnea meadaiyinmeal ea'rippoa; neengka'l in'raikku ennoadea poajanampa'n'navea'ndum; naa'laikkaalamea naan un iruthayaththil u'l'lathu ellaavat'raiyum unakku a'riviththu, unnai anuppividuvean.

moon'runaa'laikku munnea kaa'naama'rpoana kazhuthaika'laippat'rik kavalaippadavea'ndaam; avaika'l akappattathu; ithallaamal sakala isravealin apeadchaiyum yaarai naaduki'rathu? unnaiyum un veettaar anaivaraiyum allavaa? en'raan.

appozhuthu savul pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan israveal koaththirangka'lilea si'rithaana penyameen koaththiraththaan allavaa? penyameen koaththiraththuk kudumpangka'lilellaam en kudumpam a'rpamaanathu allavaa? neer ippadippatta vaarththaiyai ennidaththil solvaanean en'raan.

saamuveal savulaiyum avan vealaikkaaranaiyum poajanasaalaikku'l azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avarka'lai azhaikkappattavarka'lukku'l'lea thalaimaiyaana idaththilea vaiththaan; azhaikkappattavarka'l ea'rakku'raiya muppathupearaayirunthaarka'l.
pinpu saamuveal samaiya'rkaaranaip paarththu: naan un kaiyilea oru pangkaik koduththuvaiththeanea, athaik ko'nduvanthu vai en'raan.

appozhuthu samaiya'rkaaran, oru munnanthodaiyaiyum, athanoadirunthathaiyum eduththukko'nduvanthu, athai savulukkumun vaiththaan; appozhuthu saamuveal: ithoa, ithu unakken'ru vaikkappattathu, ithai unakku munpaaka vaiththuch saappidu; naan janangka'lai virunthukku azhaiththathumuthal, ithuvaraikkum ithu unakkaaka vaikkappattirunthathu en'raan; appadiyea savul an'raiyathinam saamuvealoadea saappittaan.
avarka'l meadaiyilirunthu patta'naththi'rku i'rangkivanthapinpu, avan mealveettilea savuloadea peasikko'ndirunthaan.

avarka'l athikaalamea kizhakku ve'lukki'ra nearaththil ezhunthirunthapoathu, saamuveal savulai mealveettinmeal azhaiththu: naan unnai anuppividumpadikku aayaththappadu en'raan; savul aayaththappattapoathu, avanum saamuvealum iruvarumaaka ve'liyea pu'rappattaarka'l.

avarka'l patta'naththin kadaisimattum i'rangki vanthapoathu, saamuveal savulaip paarththu: vealaikkaaranai namakku munnea nadanthupoakach sol en'raan; appadiyea avan nadanthu poanaan; ippozhuthu naan theavanudaiya vaarththaiyai unakkuth therivikkumpadikku, nee sat'rea thariththunil en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal thailakkuppiyai eduththu, avan thalaiyinmeal vaarththu, avanai muththagnseythu: karththar unnaith thammudaiya suthantharaththinmeal thalaivanaaka apisheakam pa'n'ninaar allavaa?

nee in'raikku ennaivittup poaki'rapoathu, penyameen ellaiyaakiya selsaakil raakealin kalla'raiya'ndaiyil ira'ndu manusharaik kaa'npaay; avarka'l unnaip paarththu: nee theadappoana kazhuthaika'l akappattathu; ithoa, un thakappan kazhuthaika'linmealiruntha kavalaiyai vittu, ungka'lukkaaka visaarappattu, en makanukkaaka ennaseyvean? enki'raan en'ru solluvaarka'l.

nee avvidaththai vittu appu'ram kadanthupoay, thaapoarilu'l'la samapoomiyil searumpoathu, theavanaip pa'niyumpadi peththealukkup poaki'ra moon'ru manushar angkea unnaik ka'ndu santhippaarka'l; oruvan moon'ru aattukkuttika'laiyum, innoruvan moon'ru appangka'laiyum, vea'roruvan thiraadcharasamu'l'la oru thuruththiyaiyum ko'nduvanthu,
unnudaiya sukaseythiyai visaariththu, unakku ira'ndu appangka'laik koduppaarka'l; avaika'lai nee avarka'l kaiyilea vaangkavea'ndum.

pinpu pelistharin thaa'naiyam irukki'ra theavanudaiya malaikkup poavaay; angkea nee patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkaiyil, meadaiyilirunthu i'rangkivaruki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin koottaththi'rku ethirppaduvaay; avarka'lukku munpaakath thampurum mea'lamum naakasuramum surama'ndalamum poakum; avarka'l theerkkatharisanam solluvaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi unmeal i'rangkuvaar; nee avarka'loadeakoodath theerkkatharisanam solli, vea'ru manushanaavaay.
intha adaiyaa'langka'l unakku nearidumpoathu, samayaththukku eat'rapadi nee sey; theavan unnoadea irukki'raar.

nee enakku munnea kilkaalukku i'rangkippoa; sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum seluththumpadikku, naan unnidaththil varuvean; naan unnidaththil vanthu, nee seyya vea'ndiyathai unakku a'rivikkumattum, eazhunaa'l kaaththiru en'raan.
avan saamuvealai vittup poakumpadi thirumpinapoathu, theavan avanukku vea'rea iruthayaththaik koduththaar; antha adaiyaa'langka'l ellaam an'raiyathinamea nearittathu.

avarka'l antha malaikku vanthapoathu, ithoa, theerkkatharisika'lin koottam avanukku ethiraaka vanthathu; appozhuthu theavanudaiya aavi avanmeal i'rangkinathinaal, avanum avarka'lukku'l'lea theerkkatharisanam sonnaan.

atha'rku munnea avanai a'rinthavarka'l ellaarum avan theerkkatharisika'loadirunthu, theerkkatharisanam solluki'rathaik ka'ndapoathu: keesin kumaaranukku vanthathu enna? savulum theerkkatharisika'lil oruvanoa? en'ru antha janangka'l oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
atha'rku angkea irukki'ravarka'lil oruvan: ivarka'lukkuth thakappan yaar en'raan; aathalaal savulum theerkkatharisika'lil oruvanoa? enpathu pazhamozhiyaayit'ru.
avan theerkkatharisanam solli mudinthapinpu, meadaiyinmeal vanthaan.

appozhuthu savuludaiya si'riya thakappan: neengka'l engkea poaneerka'l en'ru avanaiyum avan vealaikkaaranaiyum keattaan. atha'rku avan: naangka'l kazhuthaika'laith theadappoay, avaika'lai engkung kaa'naathapadiyinaal, saamuvealidaththukkup poanoam en'raan.
appozhuthu savulin si'riyathakappan: saamuveal ungka'lukkuch sonnathu enna? athaich sol en'raan.

savul than si'riyathakappanaip paarththu: kazhuthaika'l akappattathu en'ru engka'lukkuth theermaanamaaych sonnaar en'raan; aanaalum raajyapaaraththaippat'rich saamuveal sonnathai avanukku a'rivikkavillai.
saamuveal janangka'lai mispaavilea karththaridaththil varavazhaiththu,

israveal puththirarai noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan isravealai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, ungka'lai ekipthiyar kaikkum, ungka'lai i'rukappidiththa ellaa raajyaththaarin kaikkum neengkalaakkivittean.

neengka'loa ungka'ludaiya ellaath theengkuka'lukkum nerukkangka'lukkum ungka'lai neengkalaakki radchiththa ungka'l theavanai innaa'lilea pu'rakka'niththu, oru raajaavai engka'lmeal ea'rpaduththum en'ru avaridaththil keattukko'ndeerka'l; ippozhuthu karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'l vamsangka'linpadiyeayum, aayirangka'laana ungka'l searvaika'linpadiyeayum, vanthu nillungka'l en'raan.
saamuveal isravealin koaththirangka'laiyellaam searappa'n'ninapinpu penyameen koaththiraththinmeal seettu vizhunthathu.

avan penyameen koaththiraththai athinudaiya kudumpangka'linpadiyea searappa'n'ninapinpu, maaththiri kudumpaththinmealum, athilea keesin kumaaranaakiya savulinmealum, seettu vizhunthathu; avanaith theadinapoathu, avan akappadavillai.
avan ini ingkea varuvaanaa en'ru avarka'l thirumpak karththaridaththil visaariththapoathu: ithoa, avan tha'lavaadangka'lirukki'ra idaththilea o'liththukko'ndirukki'raan en'ru karththar sonnaar.

appozhuthu avarka'l oadi, angkeayirunthu avanai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan janangka'l naduvea vanthu nin'rapoathu, ellaa janangka'lum avan thoa'lukkuk keezhaayirukkaththakka uyaramu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

appozhuthu saamuveal ellaa janangka'laiyum noakki: karththar therinthuko'ndavanaip paarungka'l, samastha janangka'lukku'l'lum avanukkuch samaanamaanavan illai en'raan; appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum aarppariththu: raajaa vaazhka en'raarka'l.
saamuveal raajaangkaththin mu'raiyai janangka'lukkuth theriviththu, athai oru pusthakaththil ezhuthi, karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaiththu, janangka'laiyellaam avaravar veettukku anuppivittaan.
savulum kipiyaavilirukki'ra than veettukkup poanaan; iraa'nuvaththil theavan evarka'l manathai eavinaaroa, avarka'lum avanoadeakoodap poanaarka'l.
aanaalum pealiyaa'lin makka'l: ivanaa nammai radchikkappoaki'ravan en'ru solli, avanukkuk kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaraamal avanai asattaipa'n'ninaarka'l; avanoa kaathukea'laathavanpoala irunthaan.

akkaalaththil naakaas ennum ammoaniyan vanthu, keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaapeasai mut'rikkaipoattaan; appozhuthu yaapeasin manushar ellaarum naakaasai noakki: engka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'num; appozhuthu ummaich seavippoam en'raarka'l.

atha'rku ammoaniyanaakiya naakaas: naan ungka'l ovvoruvarudaiya valathu ka'n'naiyum pidungki, ithinaalea israveal ellaavat'rinmealum ninthaivarappa'n'nuvathea naan ungka'loadea pa'n'num udanpadikkai en'raan.

atha'rku yaapeasin moopparka'l: naangka'l israveal naadengkum sthaanaapathika'lai anuppumpadi, eazhunaa'l engka'lukkuth thava'naikodum, engka'lai radchippaar illaavittaal, appozhuthu ummidaththil varuvoam en'raarka'l.
antha sthaanaapathika'l savulin ooraakiya kipiyaavilea vanthu, janangka'lin kaathukeadka anthach seythika'laich sonnaarka'l; appozhuthu janangka'lellaarum saththamittu azhuthaarka'l.
ithoa, savul maaduka'lin pinnaalea vayalilirunthu vanthu, janangka'l azhuki'ra mukaantharam enna en'ru keattaan; yaapeasin manushar solliya seythika'lai avanukkuth theriviththaarka'l.
savul inthach seythika'laik keattavudanea, theavanudaiya aavi avanmeal i'rangkinathinaal avan mikavum koapam moo'ndavanaaki,

oari'naimaattaip pidiththu, thu'ndiththu, antha sthaanaapathika'l kaiyilea koduththu, isravealin naaduka'lukkellaam anuppi: savulin pinnaaleayum, saamuvealin pinnaaleayum pu'rappadaathavan evanoa, avanudaiya maaduka'lukku ippadich seyyappadum en'ru solliyanuppinaan; appozhuthu karththaraal u'ndaana payangkaram janaththinmeal vanthathinaal, orumanappattup pu'rappattu vanthaarka'l.
avarka'laip peaseakkilea ilakkampaarththaan; israveal puththiraril moon'ruladchampearum, yoothaa manusharil muppathinaayirampearum irunthaarka'l.

vantha sthaanaapathika'lai avarka'l noakki: naa'laikku veyil ea'ruki'ratha'rku munnea ungka'lukku radchippuk kidaikkum en'ru keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaapeasin manusharukkuch sollungka'l en'raarka'l; sthaanaapathika'l vanthu yaapeasin manusharidaththil athai a'riviththaarka'l; atha'rku avarka'l santhoashappattaarka'l.
pinpu yaapeasin manushar: naa'laikku ungka'lidaththil varuvoam, appozhuthu ungka'l ishdappadiyellaam engka'lukkuch seyyungka'l en'raarka'l.

ma'runaa'lilea savul janangka'lai moon'ru padaiyaaka vakuththu, kizhakku ve'luththuvarum jaamaththil paa'layaththi'rku'l vanthu veyil ea'rumvaraikkum ammoaniyarai mu'riya adiththaan; thappinavarka'lil ira'ndupearaakilum searnthu oadippoakaathapadi ellaarum sitha'rippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu janangka'l saamuvealai noakki: savulaa namakku raajaavaayirukkappoaki'ravan en'ru sonnavarka'l yaar? antha manusharai naangka'l kon'rupoadumpadikku oppukkodungka'l en'raarka'l.
atha'rkuch savul: in'raiyathinam oruvarum kollappadalaakaathu; in'ru karththar isravealukku iradchippai aru'linaar en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal janangka'lai noakki: naam kilkaalukkup poay, angkea raajyapaaraththai sthirappaduththuvoam vaarungka'l en'raan.

appadiyea janangka'l ellaarum kilkaalukkup poay, avvidaththilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil savulai raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththi, angkea karththarudaiya sannithiyil samaathaanapalika'laich seluththi, angkea savulum israveal manushar yaavarum mikavum santhoashangko'ndaadinaarka'l.
appozhuthu saamuveal isravealar anaivaraiyum noakki: ithoa, neengka'l enakkuch sonnapadiyellaam ungka'l so'rkeattu ungka'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththinean.

ippoathum ithoa, raajaavaanavar ungka'lukku munpaakach sagnchariththuvaruki'raar; naanoa kizhavanum naraiththavanumaanean; en kumaarar ungka'loadiruppaarka'l; naan en si'ruvayathumuthal innaa'lvaraikkum ungka'lukku munpaakach sagnchariththuvanthean.

ithoa, irukki'rean; karththarin sannithiyilum avar apisheakampa'n'ni vaiththavarukku munpaakavum ennaikku'riththuch saadchi sollungka'l; naan yaarudaiya eruthai eduththukko'ndean? yaarudaiya kazhuthaiyai eduththukko'ndean? yaarukku aniyaayagnseythean? yaarukku idukka'nseythean? yaar kaiyil parithaanam vaangkikko'ndu ka'nsaadaiyaayirunthean? sollungka'l; appadiyu'ndaanaal athai ungka'lukkuth thirumpak koduppean en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: neer engka'lukku aniyaayagn seyyavum illai; engka'lukku idukka'n seyyavum illai; oruvar kaiyilum on'rum vaangkavum illai en'raarka'l.

atha'rku avan: neengka'l en kaiyil on'rum ka'ndupidikkavillai enpatha'rkuk karththar ungka'lukku ethiraakach saadchiyaayirukki'raar; avar apisheakampa'n'ninavarum in'ru atha'rkuch saadchi en'raan; atha'rku avarka'l: avar saadchithaan en'raarka'l.
appu'ram saamuveal janangka'lai noakki: moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum ea'rpaduththinavarum, ungka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninavarum karththarea.

ippoathum karththar ungka'lukkum ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum seythuvantha ellaa neethiyaana kiriyaika'laikku'riththum, naan karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungka'loadea niyaayam peasumpadikku neengka'l nillungka'l.

yaakkoapu ekipthilea poayirukkumpoathu, ungka'l pithaakka'l karththarai noakki mu'raiyittaarka'l, appozhuthu karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum anuppinaar; avarka'l ungka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthilirunthu azhaiththuvanthu, avarka'lai intha sthalaththilea kudiyirukkappa'n'ninaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarai ma'ranthupoaki'rapoathu, avar avarka'lai aathsoarin seanaapathiyaakiya siseraavin kaiyilum, pelistharin kaiyilum, moavaapiya raajaavin kaiyilum vit'ruppoattaar; ivarka'l avarka'lukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

aakaiyaal avarka'l karththarai noakki mu'raiyittu: naangka'l karththarai vittup paakaalka'laiyum astharoaththaiyum seaviththathinaalea, paavagnseythoam; ippoathum engka'l saththurukka'lin kaikku engka'lai neengkalaakki radchiyum; ini ummaich seavippoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar erupaakaalaiyum peathaanaiyum yepthaavaiyum saamuvealaiyum anuppi, neengka'l payamillaamal kudiyirukkumpadikkuch sut'rilum iruntha ungka'l saththurukka'lin kaikkum ungka'lai neengkalaakki radchiththaar.

ammoan puththirarin raajaavaakiya naakaas ungka'lukku viroathamaay varuki'rathai neengka'l ka'ndapoathu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarea ungka'lukku raajaavaayirunthum, neengka'l ennai noakki: appadiyalla, oru raajaa engka'lmeal aa'lavea'ndum en'reerka'l.
ippoathum neengka'l vea'ndum en'ru virumpith therinthuko'nda raajaa, ithoa, irukki'raar; ithoa, karththar ungka'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththinaar.

neengka'l karththarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'naamal karththarukkup payanthu, avaraich seaviththu, avarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthaal, neengka'lum ungka'lai aa'luki'ra raajaavum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laayiruppeerka'l.

neengka'l karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaamal, karththarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'nineerka'laanaal, karththarudaiya kai ungka'l pithaakka'lukku viroathamaayirunthathu poala ungka'lukkum viroathamaayirukkum.
ippozhuthu karththar ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakach seyyum periya kaariyaththai nin'ru paarungka'l.

in'ru koathumai a'ruppin naa'l allavaa? neengka'l ungka'lukku oru raajaavaik keattathinaal, karththarin paarvaikkuch seytha ungka'ludaiya pollaappup periyathen'ru neengka'l ka'ndu u'narumpadikku, naan karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu idimuzhakkangka'laiyum mazhaiyaiyum katta'laiyiduvaar en'ru solli,

saamuveal karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan; an'raiyathinamea karththar idimuzhakkangka'laiyum mazhaiyaiyum katta'laiyittaar; appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum karththarukkum saamuvealukkum mikavum payanthu;

saamuvealaip paarththu: naangka'l saakaathapadikku ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththaridaththil ummudaiya adiyaarukkaaka vi'n'nappam seyyum; naangka'l seytha ellaap paavangka'loadum engka'lukku oru raajaa vea'ndum en'ru keatta inthap paavaththaiyum koottikko'ndoam en'ru janangka'l ellaarum sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal janangka'lai noakki: payappadaatheayungka'l; neengka'l inthap pollaappaiyellaam seytheerka'l; aakilum karththarai vittup pinvaangkaamal karththarai ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum seaviyungka'l.
vilakippoakaathirungka'l; mat'rappadi pirayoajanamat'rathum radchikkamaattaathathumaayirukki'ra vee'naanavaika'laip pinpat'ruveerka'l; avaika'l vee'naanavaika'lea.
karththar ungka'laith thamakku janamaakkikko'l'lap piriyamaanapadiyinaal, karththar thammudaiya makaththuvamaana naamaththinimiththam thamathu janaththaik kaividamaattaar.

naanum ungka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappam seyyaathiruppeanaakil karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseyki'ravanaayiruppean; athu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; nanmaiyum sevvaiyumaana vazhiyai naan ungka'lukkup poathippean.

neengka'l eppadiyum karththarukkup payanthu, ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum u'nmaiyaay avaraich seavikkakkadaveerka'l; avar ungka'lidaththil evva'lavu makimaiyaana kaariyangka'laich seythaar enpathaich sinthiththuppaarungka'l.
neengka'l innum pollaappaich seyyavea seyveerka'laanaal, neengka'lum ungka'l raajaavum naasamadaiveerka'l en'raan.
savul raajyapaarampa'n'ni, oru varushamaayit'ru; avan isravealai ira'ndaam varusham arasaa'ndapoathu,

isravealil moovaayirampearaith thanakkuth therinthuko'ndaan; avarka'lil ira'ndaayirampear savuloadeakooda mikmaasilum peththeal malaiyilum, aayirampear yoanaththaanoadeakoodap penyameen naattilu'l'la kipiyaavilum irunthaarka'l; mat'ra janangka'lai avaravar koodaarangka'lukku anuppivittaan.

yoanaththaan keapaavilea thaa'naiyam iruntha pelistharai mu'riya adiththaan; pelisthar athaik kea'lvippattaarka'l; aakaiyinaal ithai epireyar keadkakkadavarka'l en'ru savul theasamengkum ekkaa'lam oothuviththaan.

thaa'naiyam iruntha pelistharaich savul mu'riya adiththaan en'rum, isravealar pelistharukku aruvaruppaanaarka'l en'rum, isravealellaam kea'lvippattapoathu, janangka'l savulukkup pinsellumpadi kilkaalukku varavazhaikkappattaarka'l.

pelisthar isravealoadu yuththampa'n'numpadi muppathinaayiram irathangka'loadum, aa'raayiram kuthiraiveeraroadum, kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanai janangka'loadum koodikko'nduvanthu, peththaavealukkuk kizhakkaana mikmaasilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu isravealar thangka'lukku u'ndaana ikkattaik ka'ndapoathu, janangka'l thangka'lukku u'ndaana nerukkaththinaalea kepika'lilum, mudkaaduka'lilum, kanmalaika'lilum, thurukkangka'lilum, kukaika'lilum o'liththukko'ndaarka'l.
epireyaril silar yoarthaanaiyum kadanthu, kaath naatti'rkum keeleayaath theasaththi'rkum poanaarka'l; savuloa innum kilkaalil irunthaan; sakala janangka'lum payanthuko'ndu avanukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
avan thanakkuch saamuveal ku'riththa kaalaththinpadi eazhunaa'lmattum kaaththirunthaan; saamuveal kilkaalukku varavillai, janangka'l avanai vittuch sitha'rippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu savul: sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru solli, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaich seluththinaan.
avan sarvaangka thakanapaliyittu mudiki'rapoathu, ithoa, saamuveal vanthaan; savul avanaich santhiththu vanthanagnseyya avanukku ethirko'ndupoanaan.

neer seythathu enna en'ru saamuveal keattatha'rku, savul: janangka'l ennaivittuch sitha'rippoaki'rathaiyum, ku'riththa naadka'lin thittaththilea neer varaathathaiyum, pelisthar mikmaasilea koodivanthirukki'rathaiyum, naan ka'ndapadiyinaalea,

kilkaalil pelisthar enakku viroathamaay vanthuviduvaarka'l en'rum, naan innum karththarudaiya samukaththai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'navillai en'rum, e'n'nith thu'ninthu, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaich seluththinean en'raan.

saamuveal savulaip paarththu: puththiyeenamaaych seytheer; ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar umakku vithiththa katta'laiyaik kaikko'l'laama'rpoaneer; mat'rappadi karththar isravealinmeal ummudaiya raajyapaaraththai en'raikkum sthirappaduththuvaar.

ippoathoa ummudaiya raajyapaaram nilaini'rkaathu; karththar thammudaiya iruthayaththi'rku eat'ra oru manushanaith thamakkuth theadi, avanaik karththar thammudaiya janangka'lmeal thalaivanaayirukkak katta'laiyittaar; karththar umakku vithiththa katta'laiyai neer kaikko'l'lavillaiyea en'ru sonnaan.

saamuveal ezhunthirunthu, kilkaalai vittu, penyameen naattilu'l'la kipiyaavukkup poanaan; savul thannoadeakooda irukki'ra janaththaith thokaipaarkki'rapoathu, ea'rakku'raiya a'runoo'rupear irunthaarka'l.
savulum avan kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum avarka'loadeakooda irukki'ra janangka'lum penyameen naattilu'l'la kipiyaavil irunthuvittaarka'l; pelistharoa mikmaasilea paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l.
ko'l'laikkaarar pelistharin paa'layaththilirunthu moon'ru padaiyaayp pu'rappattuvanthaarka'l; oru padai opraavazhiyaaych soovaal naatti'rku nearaakap poayit'ru.
vea'roru padai peththoroan vazhiyaayp poayit'ru; vea'rorupadai vanaantharaththil irukki'ra sepoayeemin pa'l'laththaakkukku ethiraana ellaivazhiyaayp poayit'ru.
epireyar pattayangka'laiyaakilum eettika'laiyaakilum u'ndupa'n'naathapadikkup paarththukko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru pelisthar solliyirunthapadiyaal, israveal theasaththil engkum oru kollan akappadavillai.

isravealar yaavarum avaravar thangka'l kozhuvirumpuka'laiyum, thangka'l ma'nvettika'laiyum, thangka'l koadarika'laiyum, thangka'l kadappaaraika'laiyum theettik koormaiyaakkuki'ratha'rku, pelistharidaththukkup poakavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
kadappaaraika'laiyum, ma'nvettika'laiyum, mukkooru'l'la aayuthangka'laiyum, koadarika'laiyum, thaat'rukkoalka'laiyum koormaiyaakkuki'ratha'rku arangka'l maaththiram avarka'lidaththil irunthathu.
yuththanaa'l vanthapoathu, savulukkum avan kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanukkumeayan'ri, savuloadum yoanaththaanoadum irukki'ra janangka'lil oruvar kaiyilum pattayamum eettiyum illaathirunthathu.
pelistharin paa'layam mikmaasilirunthu poaki'ra vazhimattum parampiyirunthathu.

orunaa'l savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyaakiya vaalipanai noakki: namakku ethiraaka anthap pakkaththil irukki'ra pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poavoam vaa en'ru sonnaan; athai avan than thakappanukku a'rivikkavillai.
savul kipiyaavin kadaisimunaiyaakiya mikroanilea oru maatha'lamaraththinkeezh irunthaan; avanoadeakooda iruntha janangka'l ea'rakku'raiya a'runoo'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.

seeloavilea karththarudaiya aasaariyanaayiruntha ealiyin kumaaranaakiya pinekaasukkup pi'rantha ikkapoaththin sakoatharanum akithoopin kumaaranumaakiya akiyaa enpavan eapoaththaith thariththavanaayirunthaan; yoanaththaan poanathai janangka'l a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.

yoanaththaan pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poakappaarththa vazhika'lin naduvea, inthappakkam oru sengkuththaana paa'raiyum, anthappakkam oru sengkuththaana paa'raiyum irunthathu; on'rukkup poaseas en'ru pear, mat'ron'rukkuch seanea en'ru pear.
anthap paa'raika'lil on'ru vadakkea mikmaasukku ethiraakavum, mat'ron'ru the'rkea kipiyaavukku ethiraakavum irunthathu.

yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyaakiya vaalipanai noakki: viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'ludaiya anthath thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poavoam vaa; oruvea'lai karththar namakkaaka oru kaariyam seyvaar; aneakampearaik ko'ndaakilum, kognchampearaik ko'ndaakilum, radchikkak karththarukkuth thadaiyillai en'raan.
appozhuthu avan aayuthathaari avanaip paarththu: ummudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rapadiyellaam seyyum; appadiyea poam; ithoa, ummudaiya manathukku eat'rapadi naanum ummoadeakooda varuki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku yoanaththaan: ithoa, naam kadanthu, antha manusharidaththi'rkup poaki'ravarka'lpoala avarka'lukku nammaik kaa'npippoam.
naangka'l ungka'lidaththukku varumattum nillungka'l en'ru nammoadea solvaarka'laanaal, naam avarka'lidaththukku ea'rippoakaamal, nammudaiya nilaiyilea ni'rpoam.
engka'lidaththukku ea'rivaarungka'l en'ru solvaarka'laanaal, ea'rippoavoam; karththar avarka'lai nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; ithu namakku adaiyaa'lam en'raan.

appadiyea avarka'l iruvarum pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rmun thangka'laik kaa'npiththaarka'l; appozhuthu pelisthar: ithoa, epireyar o'liththukko'ndiruntha va'laika'laivittup pu'rappaduki'raarka'l en'ru solli,

thaa'naiyam irukki'ra manushar yoanaththaanaiyum avan aayuthathaariyaiyum paarththu: engka'lidaththukku ea'rivaarungka'l, ungka'lukkup puththi ka'rpippoam en'raarka'l; appozhuthu yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyai noakki: en pinnaalea ea'rivaa; karththar avarka'lai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar en'ru solli,

yoanaththaan than kaika'laalum than kaalka'laalum thavazhnthu ea'rinaan; avan aayuthathaari avan pinnaalea ea'rinaan; appozhuthu avarka'l yoanaththaanukku munpaaka madinthu vizhunthaarka'l; avan aayuthathaariyum avan pinnaalea vettikko'ndea poanaan.
yoanaththaanum avan aayuthathaariyum adiththa antha munthina adiyilea ea'rakku'raiya irupathupear araiyear nilamaana visaalaththilea vizhunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu paa'layaththilum ve'liyilum, sakala janangka'lilum, payangkaram u'ndaaki, thaa'naiyam irunthavarka'lum ko'l'laiyidappoana tha'ndilu'l'lavarka'lungkoodath thikil adainthaarka'l; poomiyum athirnthathu; athu theavanaal u'ndaana payangkaramaayirunthathu.
penyameen naattilu'l'la kipiyaavilea savulukku iruntha jaamakkaarar paarththu: ithoa, antha earaa'lamaana koottam kalainthu, oruvarmeal oruvar vizhuki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu savul thannoadeakooda irukki'ra janangka'lai noakki: nammidaththilirunthu poanavarka'l yaar en'ru ilakkampaarungka'l en'raan; avarka'l ilakkam paarkki'rapoathu, ithoa, yoanaththaanum avan aayuthathaariyum angkea illai en'ru ka'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu savul akeeyaavai noakki: theavanudaiya pettiyaik ko'nduvaa en'raan; theavanudaiya petti annaadka'lil israveal puththiraridaththil irunthathu.
ippadich savul aasaariyanoadea peasukaiyil, pelistharin paa'layaththil u'ndaana kalakam varavara athikariththathu; appozhuthu savul aasaariyanaip paarththu: irukkattum en'raan.
savulum avanoadiruntha janangka'lum koottangkoodip poarkka'laththi'rkup poanaarka'l; oruvar pattayam oruvarukku viroathamaayirunthapadiyaal makaa ama'liyu'ndaayit'ru.
itha'rkumun pelistharudan koodi avarka'loadeakoodap paa'layaththilea thirinthu vantha epireyarum, savuloadum yoanaththaanoadum irukki'ra isravealaroadea koodikko'ndaarka'l.
eppiraayeem malaika'lil o'liththukko'ndiruntha sakala isravealarum pelisthar mu'rinthoaduki'rathaik kea'lvippattapoathu, yuththaththilea avarka'lai nerungkith thodarnthaarka'l.
ippadik karththar an'raiyathinam isravealai radchiththaar; antha yuththam peththaaveanmattum nadanthathu.

isravealar an'raiyathinam mikuntha varuththam adainthaarka'l: naan en saththurukka'l kaiyilea pazhivaangkavea'ndum, saayangkaalamattum po'rukkaamal evan poajanam seyki'raanoa, avan sapikkappattavan en'ru savul janangka'lukku aa'naiyittuch solliyirunthapadiyaal, janangka'lil oruvarum evva'laveanum poajanampa'n'naathirunthaarka'l.
theasaththu janangka'l ellaarum oru kaattilea vanthaarka'l; angkea ve'liyilea theankoodu kattiyirunthathu.

janangka'l kaattilea vanthapoathu, ithoa, thean ozhukikko'ndirunthathu; aanaalum oruvanum athaith than kaiyinaalea thottuth than vaayil vaikkavillai; janangka'l antha aa'naiyinimiththam payappattaarka'l.

yoanaththaan than thakappan janangka'lukku aa'naiyittathaik kea'lvippadavillai; avan than kaiyiliruntha koalai neetti, athin nuniyinaalea theankoottaik kuththi, athai eduththuth than vaayilea poattukko'ndaan; athinaal avan ka'nka'l the'linthathu.

appozhuthu janangka'lil oruvan: in'raikku poajanam saappiduki'ravan sapikkappattavan en'ru ummudaiya thakappanaar janangka'lukku u'ruthiyaay aa'naiyittirukki'raar; aakaiyinaal janangka'l vidaayththirukki'raarka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan: en thakappan theasaththin janangka'laik kalakkappaduththinaar; naan inthath theanilea kogncham rusipaarththathinaalea, en ka'nka'l the'linthathaip paarungka'l.

in'raiyathinam janangka'l thangka'lukku akappatta thangka'l saththurukka'lin ko'l'laiyilea eathaakilum pusiththirunthaal, eththanai nalamaayirukkum; pelistharukku'l u'ndaana sangkaaram mikavum athikamaayirukkumea en'raan.
avarka'l an'raiyathinam mikmaasilirunthu aayaloanmattum pelistharai mu'riya adiththapoathu, janangka'l mikavum vidaayththirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu janangka'l ko'l'laiyinmeal paaynthu, aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum kan'rukkuttika'laiyum pidiththu, tharaiyilea poattu adiththu, iraththaththoadum pusiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu: ithoa, iraththaththoadirukki'rathaip pusikki'rathinaal janangka'l karththarukku ealaatha paavam seyki'raarka'l en'ru savulukku a'riviththaarka'l; avan: neengka'l thuroakampa'n'nineerka'l; ippoathea oru periya kallai ennidaththil uruttikko'nduvaarungka'l.

neengka'l janaththi'rku'l'lea poay, iraththaththoadirukki'rathaich saappiduki'rathinaalea, karththarukku ealaatha paavam seyyaathapadikku, avaravar thangka'l maattaiyum avaravar thangka'l aattaiyum ennidaththil ko'nduvanthu, ingkea adiththu, pinpu saappidavea'ndum en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan; aakaiyaal janangka'l ellaarum avaravar thangka'l maaduka'lai an'ru iraaththiri thaangka'lea ko'nduvanthu, angkea adiththaarka'l.
pinpu savul karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattinaan; athu avan karththarukkuk kattina muthalaavathu palipeedam.

atha'rkuppinpu savul: naam intha iraaththiriyilea pelistharaith thodarnthupoay, vidiya'rkaala ve'lichchamaakumattum avarka'laik ko'l'laiyittu, avarka'lil oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaathiruppoamaaka en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: ummudaiya ka'nka'lukku nalamaanapadiyellaam seyyum en'raarka'l. aasaariyanoa: naam ingkea theavasannithiyil searakkadavoam en'raan.
appadiyea: pelistharaith thodarnthupoakalaamaa? avarka'lai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduppeeraa? en'ru savul theavanidaththil visaariththaan; avar antha naa'lilea avanukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lavillai.
appozhuthu savul: janaththin thalaivarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum ingkea searnthuvanthu, in'ru inthap paavam ethinaalea u'ndaayit'ru en'ru paarththa'riyungka'l.

athu en kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanidaththil kaa'nappattaalum, avan saakavea saakavea'ndum en'ru isravealai radchikki'ra karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan; sakala janangka'lukku'l'lum oruvanum avanukkup pirathiyuththaram sollavillai.

atha'rkuppin avan isravealar ellaaraiyum noakki: neengka'l anthappakkaththilea irungka'l; naanum en kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum inthappakkaththil iruppoam en'raan; janangka'l savulaip paarththu: ummudaiya ka'nka'lukku nalamaanapadi seyyum en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu savul isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai noakki: nithaanamaayk katta'laiyittu yathaarththaththai vi'langkappa'n'num en'raan; appozhuthu yoanaththaanmealum savulinmealum seettu vizhunthathu, janangka'loa thappinaarka'l.
enakkum en kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanukkum seettuppoadungka'l en'ru savul sonnapoathu, yoanaththaanmeal seettu vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu savul yoanaththaanaip paarththu: nee seythathu enna? enakkuch sol en'ru keattaan. atha'rku yoanaththaan: en kaiyil irukki'ra koalin nuniyinaalea kogncham thean eduththu rusipaarththean; atha'rkaaka naan saakavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu savul: yoanaththaanea, nee saakaththaanvea'ndum; illaavittaal theavan enakku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyyakkadavar en'raan.

janangka'loa savulai noakki: isravealilea inthap periya iradchippaich seytha yoanaththaan kolaiseyyappadalaamaa? athu koodaathu; avan thalaiyil irukki'ra oru mayirum tharaiyilea vizhappoaki'rathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittuch solluki'roam; theavan thu'nai ni'rka avan in'ru kaariyaththai nadappiththaan en'raarka'l; appadiyea yoanaththaan saakaathapadikku, janangka'l avanaith thappuviththaarka'l.
savul pelistharaith thodaraamal thirumpivittaan; pelistharum thangka'l sthalaththi'rkup poayvittaarka'l.

ippadich savul isravealai aa'luki'ra raajyapaaraththaip pet'rukko'ndu, sut'rilum irukki'ra thannudaiya ellaach saththurukka'lumaakiya moavaapiyarukkum, ammoan puththirarukkum, eathoamiyarukkum, soapaavin raajaakka'lukkum, pelistharukkum viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, evarka'lmeal padaiyeduththaanoa, avarka'laiyellaam adakkinaan.
avan palaththu, amaleakkiyarai mu'riya adiththu, isravealaraik ko'l'laiyiduki'ra yaavar kaikkum avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchiththaan.
savulukku iruntha kumaarar: yoanaththaan, isvi, malkisoovaa enpavarka'l; avanudaiya ira'ndu kumaaraththika'lil, mooththava'l pear mearap, i'laiyava'l pear meekaa'l.
savuludaiya manaiviyin pear akinoavaam, ava'l akimaasin kumaaraththi; avanudaiya seanaapathiyin pear apnear, avan savuludaiya si'riyathakappanaakiya nearin kumaaran.
kees savulin thakappan; apnearin thakappanaakiya near aapiyealin kumaaran.

savul iruntha naa'lellaam pelistharinmeal kadinamaana yuththam nadanthathu; savul oru paraakkiramasaaliyaiyaakilum oru palasaaliyaiyaakilum kaa'numpoathu, avarka'l ellaaraiyum thannidamaakach searththukko'l'luvaan.

pinpu saamuveal savulai noakki: isravealaraakiya thammudaiya janangka'lmeal ummai raajaavaaka apisheakam pa'n'nuki'ratha'rkuk karththar ennai anuppinaarea; ippoathum karththarudaiya vaarththaika'lin saththaththaik kea'lum:
seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, isravealar ekipthilirunthu vanthapoathu, amaleakku avarka'lukku vazhima'riththa seykaiyai manathilea vaiththirukki'rean.

ippoathum nee poay, amaleakkai madangkadiththu, avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum sangkariththu, avanmeal irakkam vaikkaamal, purusharaiyum, sthireeka'laiyum, pi'l'laika'laiyum, kuzhanthaika'laiyum, maaduka'laiyum, aaduka'laiyum, ottakangka'laiyum, kazhuthaika'laiyum kon'rupoadakkadavaay enki'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu savul: ithai janangka'lukku a'riyappaduththi, thelaayimilea avarka'laith thokaipaarththaan; avarka'l ira'ndu ladcham kaalaadka'lum, yoothaa janangka'l pathinaayirampearumaayirunthaarka'l.
savul amaleakkudaiya patta'namattum vanthu, pa'l'laththaakkilea oru pathividaiyai vaiththaan.

savul keaniyarai noakki: naan amaleakkiyaroadeakooda ungka'laiyum vaarikko'l'laathapadikku, neengka'l avarka'l naduvilirunthu pu'rappattu vilakippoangka'l; israveal ekipthilirunthu vanthapoathu, neengka'l avarka'l ellaarukkum thayavuseytheerka'l en'raan; appadiyea keaniyar amaleakkiyarin naduvilirunthu vilakippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu savul: aavilaa thuvakki ekipthi'rku ethireayirukki'ra soorukkup poakum ellaimattum iruntha amaleakkiyarai madangkadiththu,
amaleakkiyarin raajaavaakiya aakaakai uyiroadea pidiththaan; janangka'l yaavaraiyum pattayak karukkinaalea sangkaarampa'n'ninaan.

savulum janangka'lum aakaakaiyum, aadumaaduka'lil muthaltharamaanavaika'laiyum, ira'ndaantharamaanavaika'laiyum, aattukkuttika'laiyum, nalamaana ellaavat'raiyum, azhiththuppoada manathillaamal thappavaiththu, a'rpamaanavaika'lum uthavaathavaika'lumaana sakala vasthukka'laiyum mut'rilum azhiththuppoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai saamuvealukku u'ndaaki, avar sonnathu:

naan savulai raajaavaakkinathu enakku manasthaapamaayirukki'rathu; avan ennaivittuth thirumpi, en vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'raama'rpoanaan en'raar; appozhuthu saamuveal manam nonthu, iraamuzhuthum karththarai noakkik kooppittaan.

ma'runaa'l athikaalamea saamuveal savulaich santhikkappoanaan; appozhuthu savul karmealukku vanthu, thanakku oru jeyasthampam naatti, pinpu pala idangka'lil sen'ru kilkaalukkup poanaan en'ru, saamuvealukku a'rivikkappattathu.
saamuveal savulinidaththil poanaan; savul avanai noakki: neer karththaraal aaseervathikkappattavar; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rinean en'raan.
atha'rkuch saamuveal: appadiyaanaal en kaathuka'lil vizhuki'ra aaduka'lin saththamum, enakkuk keadki'ra maaduka'lin saththamum enna en'raan.

atha'rkuch savul: amaleakkiyaridaththilirunthu avaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l; janangka'l aadumaaduka'lil nalamaanavaika'lai ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidumpadikkuth thappavaiththaarka'l; mat'ravaika'lai mut'rilum azhiththuppoattoam en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal: anthap peachchai vidum, karththar intha iraaththiriyilea enakkuch sonnathai umakku a'rivikki'rean en'ru savuloadea sonnaan. avan: sollum en'raan.

appozhuthu saamuveal: neer ummudaiya paarvaikkuch si'riyavaraayirunthapoathu allavoa israveal koaththirangka'lukkuth thalaivaraaneer; karththar ummai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakam pa'n'nuviththaarea.

ippoathum karththar: nee poay amaleakkiyaraakiya anthap paavika'laich sangkariththu, avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkith theerumattum, avarka'loadu yuththampa'n'nu en'ru solli, ummai antha vazhiyaay anuppinaar.
ippadiyirukka, neer karththarudaiya sollaikkea'laamal, ko'l'laiyinmeal pa'ranthu, karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythathu enna en'raan.
savul saamuvealai noakki: naan karththarudaiya sollaik keattu, karththar ennai anuppina vazhiyaayp poay, amaleakkin raajaavaakiya aakaakaik ko'nduvanthu, amaleakkiyaraich sangkaaram pa'n'ninean.

janangka'loa ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkuk kilkaalilea paliyiduki'ratha'rkaaka, ko'l'laiyilea saapaththeedaakum aadumaaduka'lilea pirathaanamaanavaika'laip pidiththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l en'raan.

atha'rkuch saamuveal: karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadiki'rathaippaarkkilum, sarvaangka thakanangka'lum palika'lum karththarukkup piriyamaayirukkumoa? paliyaippaarkkilum keezhppadithalum, aattukkadaakka'lin ni'naththaippaarkkilum sevikoduththalum uththamam.

ira'ndakampa'n'nuthal pillisooniya paavaththi'rkum, murattaattampa'n'nuthal avapakthikkum vikkirakaaraathanaikkum sariyaay irukki'rathu; neer karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pu'rakka'niththapadiyinaalea, avar ummai raajaavaayiraathapadikkup pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'linaar en'raan.
appozhuthu savul saamuvealai noakki: naan karththarudaiya katta'laiyaiyum ummudaiya vaarththaika'laiyum mee'rinathinaalea paavagnseythean; naan janangka'lukkup payanthu, avarka'l sollaik keattean.
ippoathum neer en paavaththai manniththu, naan karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadikku, ennoadeakoodath thirumpivaarum en'raan.

saamuveal savulaip paarththu: naan ummoadeakoodath thirumpivaruvathillai; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pu'rakka'niththeer; neer isravealinmeal raajaavaayiraathapadikku, karththar ummaiyum pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'linaar en'raan.
poakumpadi saamuveal thirumpuki'rapoathu, savul, avan saalvaiyin thongkalaip pidiththukko'ndaan, athu kizhinthupoayit'ru.
appozhuthu saamuveal avanai noakki: karththar in'ru ummidaththiliruntha isravealin raajyaththaik kizhiththuppoattu; ummaippaarkkilum uththamanaayirukki'ra ummudaiya thoazhanukku athaik koduththaar.
isravealin jeyapalamaanavar poysolluki'rathum illai; thaam sonnathaippat'ri manasthaapappaduki'rathum illai; manammaa'ra avar manushan alla en'raan.

atha'rku avan: naan paavagnseythean; ippoathu en janaththin moopparukku munpaakavum, isravealukku munpaakavum neer ennaik kanampa'n'ni, naan ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadikku, ennoadeakoodath thirumpivaarum en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal thirumpich savulukkup pinsen'raan; savul karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaan.
pinpu saamuveal: amaleakkin raajaavaakiya aakaakai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; aakaak santhoashamaay avanidaththil vanthu, mara'naththin kasappu at'ruppoanathu nichchayam en'raan.

saamuveal: un pattayam sthireeka'laip pi'l'laiyat'ravarka'laakkinathupoala, sthireeka'lukku'l'lea un thaayum pi'l'laiyat'rava'laavaa'l en'ru solli; saamuveal kilkaalilea karththarukku munpaaka aakaakaith thu'ndiththuppoattaan.
pinpu saamuveal raamaavukkup poanaan; savuloa than ooraakiya kipiyaavilirukki'ra than veettukkup poayvittaan.

savul mara'namadaiyum naa'lmattum saamuveal appu'ram avanaik ka'ndu peasavillai; isravealinmeal savulai raajaavaakkinatha'rkaakak karththar manasthaapappattathinimiththam, saamuveal savulukkaakath thukkiththukko'ndirunthaan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: isravealinmeal raajaavaayiraathapadikku, naan pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'lina savulukkaaka nee enthamattum thukkiththukko'ndiruppaay; nee un kompai thailaththaal nirappikko'nduvaa; pethlekeamiyanaakiya eesaayinidaththukku unnai anuppuvean; avan kumaararil oruvanai naan raajaavaakath therinthuko'ndean en'raar.

atha'rkuch saamuveal: naan eppadip poavean; savul ithaik kea'lvippattaal, ennaik kon'rupoaduvaanea en'raan; appozhuthu karththar: nee oru kaa'laiyaik kaiyoadea ko'ndupoay, karththarukkup paliyidavanthean en'ru solli,
eesaayaip palivirunthukku azhaippaayaaka; appozhuthu nee seyyavea'ndiyathai naan unakku a'rivippean; naan unakkuch solluki'ravanai enakkaaka apisheakampa'n'nuvaayaaka en'raar.
karththar sonnapadiyea saamuveal seythu, pethlekeamukkup poanaan; appozhuthu avvoorin mooppar thaththa'lippoadea avanukku ethirko'nduvanthu, neer varuki'rathu samaathaanamaa en'raarka'l.

atha'rku avan: samaathaananthaan; karththarukkup paliyidavanthean; neengka'l ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'ndu, ennudaneakoodap palivirunthukku vaarungka'l en'raan; mealum eesaayaiyum avan kumaararaiyum parisuththampa'n'ni, avarka'laip palivirunthukku azhaiththaan.
avarka'l vanthapoathu, avan eliyaapaip paarththavudanea: karththaraal apisheakampa'n'nappadupavan ivanthaanaakkum en'raan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: nee ivanudaiya mukaththaiyum, ivanudaiya sareerava'larchchiyaiyum paarkkavea'ndaam; naan ivanaip pu'rakka'niththean; manushan paarkki'rapadi naan paarean; manushan mukaththaip paarppaan; karththaroa iruthayaththaip paarkki'raar en'raar.
appozhuthu eesaay apinathaapai azhaiththu, avanaich saamuvealukku munpaakak kadanthupoakappa'n'ninaan; avan: ivanaiyum karththar therinthuko'l'lavillai en'raan.
eesaay sammaavaiyum kadanthupoakappa'n'ninaan; avan: ivanaiyum karththar therinthuko'l'lavillai en'raan.
ippadi eesaay than kumaararil eazhupearai saamuvealukku munpaakak kadanthu poakappa'n'ninaan; pinpu saamuveal eesaayaip paarththu: karththar ivarka'lil oruvanaiyum therinthuko'l'lavillai en'ru solli;

un pi'l'laika'l ivva'lavuthaanaa en'ru eesaayaik keattaan. atha'rku avan: innum ellaarukkum i'laiyavan oruvan irukki'raan; avan aaduka'lai meayththukko'ndirukki'raan en'raan; appozhuthu saamuveal eesaayai noakki: aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippi; avan ingkea varumattum naan panthiyirukkamaattean en'raan.
aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippiththaan; avan sivanthameaniyum, azhakiya ka'nka'lum, nalla roopamumu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; appozhuthu karththar: ivanthaan, nee ezhunthu ivanai apisheakampa'n'nu en'raar.

appozhuthu saamuveal: thailakkompai eduththu, avanai avan sakoatharar naduvilea apisheakampa'n'ninaan; annaa'lmutha'rko'ndu, karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar thaaveethinmeal vanthu i'rangkiyirunthaar; saamuveal ezhunthu raamaavukkup poayvittaan.
karththarudaiya aavi savulai vittu neengkinaar; karththaraal varavidappatta oru pollaatha aavi avanaik kalangkappa'n'nikko'ndirunthathu.
appozhuthu savulin oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: ithoa, theavanaal vidappatta oru pollaatha aavi ummaik kalangkappa'n'nuki'rathea.

surama'ndalam vaasikki'rathil thea'rina oruvanaith theadumpadikku, engka'l aa'ndavanaakiya neer umakku munpaaka ni'rki'ra ummudaiya adiyaarukkuk katta'laiyidum; appozhuthu theavanaal vidappatta pollaatha aavi ummeal i'rangkukaiyil, avan than kaiyinaal athai vaasiththaal umakkuch savukkiyamu'ndaakum en'raarka'l.
savul than oozhiyakkaararaip paarththu: nan'raay vaasikkaththakka oruvanaith theadi, ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu antha vealaikkaararil oruvan pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, pethlekeamiyanaakiya eesaayin kumaaran oruvanaik ka'ndirukki'rean; avan vaasippathil thea'rinavan, avan paraakkiramasaali, yuththaveeran, kaariyasamarththan, savunthariyamu'l'lavan; karththar avanoadeakooda irukki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu savul: eesaayinidaththil aadka'lai anuppi, aattumanthaiyil irukki'ra un kumaaranaakiya thaaveethai ennidaththil anuppu en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu eesaay: appaththaiyum, oru thuruththi thiraadcharasaththaiyum, oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyaiyum kazhuthaiyinmeal eat'ri, than kumaaranaakiya thaaveethin vasamaay savulukku anuppinaan.
appadiyea thaaveethu savulidaththil vanthu, avanukku munpaaka nin'raan; avan ivanai mikavum sineakiththaan; avanukku ivan aayuthathaariyaanaan.
savul eesaayinidaththil aa'l anuppi, thaaveethu enakku munpaaka ni'rkattum; en ka'nka'lil avanukkuth thayavukidaiththathu en'ru sollachsonnaan.

appadiyea theavanaal vidappatta aavi savulaip pidikkumpoathu, thaaveethu surama'ndalaththai eduththu, than kaiyinaal vaasippaan; athinaalea pollaatha aavi avanaivittu neengka, savul aa'ruthaladainthu, sosthamaavaan.

pelisthar yuththampa'n'nuki'ratha'rkuth thangka'l seanaika'laich searththu, yoothaavilu'l'la soakkoavilea orumiththuk koodi, soakkoavukkum asekkaavukkum naduvea irukki'ra epeasthammeemilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
savulum israveal manusharum orumiththuk koodi, ealaa pa'l'laththaakkilea paa'layami'rangki, pelistharukku ethiraaka yuththaththi'rku a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l.
pelisthar anthappakkaththil oru malaiyinmealum, isravealar inthappakkaththil oru malaiyinmealum nin'raarka'l; avarka'lukku naduvea pa'l'laththaakku irunthathu.
appozhuthu kaath ooraanaakiya koaliyaath ennum pearu'l'la oru veeran pelistharin paa'layaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthu naduvea ni'rpaan; avan uyaram aa'rumuzhamum oru jaa'numaam.
avan than thalaiyinmeal ve'nkalach seeraavaip poattu, oru poarkkavasam thariththukko'ndiruppaan; anthak kavasaththin ni'rai aiyaayiram seakkalaana ve'nkalamaayirukkum.
avan than kaalka'lilea ve'nkalak kavasaththaiyum than thoa'lka'linmeal ve'nkalak keadakaththaiyum thariththiruppaan.
avanudaiya eettiththaangku nesavukkaararin padaimaraththin kanathiyum avan eettiyin alaku a'runoo'ruseakkal irumpumaayirukkum; parisaipidikki'ravan avanukku munnaaka nadappaan.

avan vanthunin'ru, israveal seanaika'laip paarththuch saththamittu, neengka'l yuththaththi'rku a'nivakuththu ni'rki'rathu enna? naan pelisthan allavaa? neengka'l savulin seavakar allavaa? ungka'lil oruvanaith therinthuko'l'lungka'l; avan ennidaththil varattum.

avan ennoadu yuththampa'n'navum ennaik kollavum samarththanaanaal, naangka'l ungka'lukku vealaikkaararaayiruppoam; naan avanai jeyiththu avanaik kolveanaanaal, neengka'l engka'lukku vealaikkaararaayirunthu, engka'laich seavikkavea'ndum en'ru solli,
pinnum anthap pelisthan: naan in'raiyathinam isravealudaiya seanaika'lai ninthiththean; naam oruvaroadu oruvar yuththampa'n'na oruvanai vidungka'l en'ru sollikko'nduvaruvaan.
savulum isravealar anaivarum anthap pelisthanudaiya vaarththaika'laik keattu, kalangki mikavum payappattaarka'l.

thaaveethu enpavan yoothaavilu'l'la pethlekeam ooraanaakiya eesaay ennum pearu'l'la eppiraaththiya manushanudaiya kumaaranaayirunthaan; eesaayukku ettuk kumaarar irunthaarka'l; ivan savulin naadka'lilea mat'ra janangka'lukku'l'lea vayathusen'ra kizhavanaay mathikkappattaan.

eesaayinudaiya moon'ru mooththa kumaarar savuloadeakooda yuththaththi'rkup poayirunthaarka'l; yuththaththi'rkup poayiruntha avanudaiya moon'ru kumaararil mooththavanukku eliyaap en'rum, ira'ndaangkumaaranukku apinathaap en'rum, moon'raangkumaaranukkuch sammaa en'rum pear.
thaaveethu ellaarukkum i'laiyavan; mooththavarka'laakiya antha moon'rupearum savuloadeakoodap poayirunthaarka'l.
thaaveethu savulaivittuth thirumpip poay pethlekeamilirukki'ra than thakappanudaiya aaduka'lai meayththukko'ndirunthaan.
anthap pelisthan kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum naa'rpathunaa'l vanthuvanthu ni'rpaan.

eesaay than kumaaranaakiya thaaveethai noakki: un sakoathararukku intha oru marakkaal va'ruththa payat'raiyum, inthap paththu appangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, paa'layaththilirukki'ra un sakoathararidaththil oattamaayp poay,

inthap paththup paalkattika'lai aayirampearukku athipathiyaanavanidaththil koduththu, un sakoatharar sukamaayirukki'raarka'laa en'ru visaariththu, avarka'lidaththil adaiyaa'lam vaangkik ko'nduvaa en'raan.
appozhuthu savulum, avarka'lum, isravealar ellaarum, ealaa pa'l'laththaakkilea pelistharoadu yuththampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaarka'l.

thaaveethu athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, aaduka'laik kaavalaa'li vasamaay vittu, eesaay thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea eduththukko'ndupoay, irathangka'l irukki'ra idaththilea vanthaan; seanaika'l a'nivakuththu nin'ru, yuththaththi'rken'ru aarppariththaarka'l.
isravealarum pelistharum oruvarukku ethiraaka oruvar a'nivakuththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: thaan ko'nduvanthavaika'lai i'rakki, rasthukka'laik kaakki'ravan vasamaaka vaiththuvittu, seanaikku'l oadi, than sakoathararaip paarththu: sukamaayirukki'reerka'laa en'ru keattaan.

avan ivarka'loadea peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, kaath ooraanaakiya koaliyaath ennum pearu'l'la anthap pelistha veeran pelistharin seanaika'lilirunthu ezhumpivanthu nin'ru, mun sonna vaarththaika'laiyea sonnaan; athaith thaaveethu keattaan.
isravealar ellaarum antha manushanaik kaa'numpoathu mikavum payappattu, avan mukaththukku vilaki oadippoavaarka'l.

annearaththilea isravealar: vanthu ni'rki'ra antha manushanaik ka'ndeerka'laa, isravealai ninthikka vanthu ni'rki'raan; ivanaik kolluki'ravan evanoa, avanai raajaa mikavum aisuvariyavaanaakki, avanukkuth thammudaiya kumaaraththiyaith thanthu, avan thakappan veettaarukku isravealilea sarvamaaniyam koduppaar en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu thanna'ndaiyilea ni'rki'ravarka'laip paarththu, inthap pelisthanaik kon'ru isravealukku nearitta ninthaiyai neekkuki'ravanukku enna seyyappadum; jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya seanaika'lai ninthikki'ratha'rku viruththaseathanam illaatha intha pelisthan emmaaththiram en'raan.
atha'rku janangka'l: avanaik kolluki'ravanukku inna innapadi seyyappadum en'ru mun sonna vaarththaika'laiyea avanukkuch sonnaarka'l.

antha manusharoadea avan peasikko'ndirukki'rathai avan mooththa sakoatharanaakiya eliyaap keattapoathu, avan thaaveethinmeal koapangko'ndu: nee ingkea vanthathu enna? vanaantharaththilu'l'la anthak kogncha aaduka'lai nee yaar vasaththil vittaay? yuththaththaip paarkka allavaa vanthaay? un thu'nikaraththaiyum, un iruthayaththin akangkaaraththaiyum naan a'rivean en'raan.
atha'rkuth thaaveethu: naan ippozhuthu seythathu enna? naan vanthatha'rku mukaantharam illaiyaa en'ru solli,
avanai vittu, vea'roruvanidaththil thirumpi, anthappirakaaramaakavea keattaan; janangka'l munpoalavea uththaravu sonnaarka'l.
thaaveethu sonna vaarththaika'lai avarka'l keattu, athaich savulin samukaththil a'riviththaarka'l; appozhuthu avan avanai azhaippiththaan.
thaaveethu savulai noakki: ivanimiththam oruvanudaiya iruthayamum kalangka vea'ndiyathillai; ummudaiya adiyaanaakiya naan poay, inthap pelisthanoadea yuththampa'n'nuvean en'raan.
appozhuthu savul thaaveethai noakki: nee inthap pelisthanoadea ethirththu yuththampa'n'na unnaal aakaathu; nee i'laignan, avanoa than si'ruvayathumuthal yuththaveeran en'raan.

thaaveethu savulaippaarththu: ummudaiya adiyaan en thakappanudaiya aaduka'lai meayththukko'ndirukki'rapoathu, oruvisai oru singkamum, oruvisai oru karadiyum vanthu, manthaiyilirukki'ra oru aattaip pidiththukko'ndathu.
naan athaith thodarnthupoay, athai adiththu, athai athin vaaykkuth thappuviththean; athu enmeal paaynthapoathu, naan athin thaadiyaip pidiththu, athai adiththuk kon'rupoattean.

anthach singkaththaiyum anthak karadiyaiyum ummudaiya adiyaanaakiya naan kon'rean; viruththaseathanamillaatha inthap pelisthanum avaika'lil on'raippoala iruppaan; avan jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya seanaika'lai ninthiththaanea en'raan.

pinnum thaaveethu: ennaich singkaththin kaikkum karadiyin kaikkum thappuviththa karththar inthap pelisthanudaiya kaikkum thappuvippaar en'raan; appozhuthu savul thaaveethaip paarththu: poa, karththar unnudaneakooda iruppaaraaka en'raan.
savul thaaveethukkuth than vasthirangka'lai uduththuviththu ve'nkalamaana oru seeraavai avan thalaiyinmeal poattu, oru kavasaththaiyum avanukkuth tharippiththaan.

avanudaiya pattayaththai thaaveethu than vasthirangka'lmeal kattikko'ndu, athilea avanukkup pazhakkamillaathathinaal nadanthupaarththaan; appozhuthu thaaveethu savulai noakki: naan ivaika'laip poattukko'ndu poakakkoodaathu; intha appiyaasam enakku illai en'ru solli, avaika'laik ka'lainthupoattu,

than thadiyaik kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, aat'rilirukki'ra ainthu koozhaangkalluka'laith therintheduththu, avaika'lai meaypparukkuriya thannudaiya adaippappaiyilea poattu, than kava'naith than kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, anthap pelisthana'ndaiyilea poanaan.
pelisthanum nadanthu, thaaveetha'ndaikkuk kittivanthaan; parisaiyaip pidikki'ravan avanukku munnaaka nadanthaan.
pelisthan sut'rippaarththu: thaaveethaik ka'ndu, avan i'laignanum savunthariya roopamaana sivantha meaniyu'l'lavanumaayirunthapadiyinaal, avanai asattaipa'n'ninaan.
pelisthan thaaveethaip paarththu: nee thadika'loadea ennidaththil vara naan naayaa en'ru solli, avan than theavarka'laikko'ndu thaaveethaich sapiththaan.
pinnum anthap pelisthan thaaveethaip paarththu: ennidaththil vaa; naan un maamsaththai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum kaattu mirukangka'lukkum koduppean en'raan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu: pelisthanai noakki: nee pattayaththoadum, eettiyoadum, keadakaththoadum ennidaththil varuki'raay; naanoa nee ninthiththa isravealudaiya iraa'nuvangka'lin theavanaakiya seanaika'ludaiya karththarin naamaththilea unnidaththil varuki'rean.

in'raiyathinam karththar unnai en kaiyil oppukkoduppaar; naan unnaik kon'ru, un thalaiyai unnai vittu vaangki, pelistharudaiya paa'layaththin pi'nangka'lai in'raiyathinam aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum, poomiyin kaattu mirukangka'lukkum koduppean; athanaal isravealil theavan oruvar u'ndu en'ru pooloakaththaar ellaarum a'rinthuko'l'luvaarka'l.
karththar pattayaththinaalum eettiyinaalum radchikki'ravar alla en'ru intha janakkoottamellaam a'rinthuko'l'lum; yuththam karththarudaiyathu; avar ungka'lai engka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raan.
appozhuthu anthap pelisthan ezhumpi, thaaveethukku ethiraakak kittivarukaiyil, thaaveethu theeviramaay anthach seanaikkum anthap pelisthanukkum ethiraaka oadi,

than kaiyai adaippaththilea poattu, athilirunthu oru kallai eduththu, kava'nilea vaiththuch suzhat'ri, pelisthanudaiya net'riyilea pada e'rinthaan; anthak kal avan net'riyil pathinthu poanathinaal, avan tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaan.
ivvithamaakath thaaveethu oru kava'ninaalum oru kallinaalum pelisthanai mea'rko'ndu, avanai madangkadiththu, avanaik kon'rupoattaan; thaaveethin kaiyil pattayam illaathirunthathu.

aakaiyaal thaaveethu pelisthana'ndaiyil oadi avanmeal nin'ru, avan pattayaththai eduththu, athai athin u'raiyilirunthu uruvi, avanaik kon'ru, athinaalea avan thalaiyai vettippoattaan; appozhuthu thangka'l veeran seththuppoanaan en'ru pelisthar ka'ndu, oadippoanaarka'l.

appozhuthu isravealarum yoothaa manusharum ezhumpi, aarppariththu, pa'l'laththaakkin ellaimattum, ekroanin vaasalka'lmattum, pelistharaith thuraththinaarka'l; saaraayeemin vazhiyilum, kaathpatta'namattum, ekroan patta'namattum, pelisthar vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.
israveal puththirar pelistharai moorkkamaayth thuraththinapi'rpaadu, thirumpivanthu, avarka'ludaiya paa'layangka'laik ko'l'laiyittaarka'l.
thaaveethu pelisthanudaiya thalaiyai eduththu, athai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndu vanthaan; avan aayuthangka'laiyoa than koodaaraththilea vaiththaan.

thaaveethu pelisthanukku ethiraakap pu'rappattuppoaki'rathaich savul ka'ndapoathu, avan seanaapathiyaakiya apnearaip paarththu: apnearea, intha vaalipan yaarudaiya makan en'ru keattaan; atha'rku apnear: raajaavea, enakkuth theriyaathu en'ru ummudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa: anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan yaarudaiya makan en'ru visaari en'raan.
thaaveethu pelisthanaik kon'ru thirumpukaiyil, apnear avanaich savulukku munpaaka azhaiththukko'ndu poayvittaan; pelisthanudaiya thalai avan kaiyil irunthathu.
appozhuthu savul: vaalipanea, nee yaarudaiya makan en'ru avanaik keattatha'rku, thaaveethu: naan pethlekeam ooraanaayirukki'ra ummudaiya adiyaanaakiya eesaayin makan en'raan.
avan savuloadea peasi mudinthapinpu, yoanaththaanudaiya aaththumaa thaaveethin aaththumaavoadea on'raay isainthirunthathu; yoanaththaan avanaith than uyiraippoalach sineakiththaan.
savul avanai avan thakappan veettukkuth thirumpippoaka ottaamal, an'rumuthal thannidaththil vaiththukko'ndaan.
yoanaththaan thaaveethaith than aaththumaavaippoalach sineakiththathinaal, avanum ivanum udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
yoanaththaan poarththukko'ndiruntha saalvaiyaik kazhat'ri, athaiyum, than vasthiraththaiyum, than pattayaththaiyum, than villaiyum, than kachchaiyaiyumkoodath thaaveethukkuk koduththaan.

thaaveethu savul thannai anuppuki'ra evvidaththi'rkum poay, puththiyaayk kaariyaththai nadappiththathinaal, savul avanai yuththamanusharinmeal athikaariyaakkinaan; avan ellaa janaththin ka'nka'lukkum, savuludaiya oozhiyakkaararin ka'nka'lukkumkoodap piriyamaayirunthaan.

thaaveethu pelisthanaik kon'ru thirumpivanthapinpu, janangka'l thirumpa varumpoathum, sthireeka'l isravealin sakala patta'nangka'lilumirunthu, aadalpaadaludan pu'rappattu, mea'langka'loadum keethavaaththiyangka'loadum santhoashamaay raajaavaakiya savulukku ethirko'nduvanthaarka'l.
antha sthireeka'l aadippaadukaiyil: savul kon'rathu aayiram, thaaveethu kon'rathu pathinaayiram en'ru mu'raimu'raiyaakap paadinaarka'l.

antha vaarththai savulukku visanamaayirunthathu; avan mikuntha erichchaladainthu, thaaveethukkup pathinaayiram, enakkoa aayiram koduththaarka'l; innum raajaangkamaaththiram avanukkuk ku'raivaayirukki'rathu en'ru solli,
annaa'lmutha'rko'ndu savul thaaveethaik kaaymakaaramaayp paarththaan.

ma'runaa'lilea theavanaal vidappatta pollaatha aavi savulinmeal i'rangkit'ru; avan veetti'rku'l'lea theerkkatharisanam sollikko'ndirunthaan; appozhuthu thaaveethu thinanthoa'rum seyki'rapadi, than kaiyinaal surama'ndalaththai vaasiththukko'ndirunthaan; savulin kaiyilea eettiyirunthathu.
appozhuthu savul thaaveethaich suvaroadea searththu uruvak kuththippoaduvean en'ru eettiyai avanmeal e'rinthaan; aanaalum thaaveethu vilaki ira'ndutharam avanukkuth thappinaan.
karththar thaaveethoadeakooda irukki'raar en'rum thannai vittu vilakippoanaar en'rum, savul ka'ndu, thaaveethukkup payanthu,
avanaith thannaivittu appu'rappaduththi, avanai aayirampearukku athipathiyaaka vaiththaan; appadiyea avan janaththi'rku munpaakap poakkum varaththumaayirunthaan.
thaaveethu than seykaika'lilellaam puththimaanaay nadanthaan; karththar avanoadeakooda irunthaar.
avan makaa puththimaanaay nadakki'rathaich savul ka'ndu, avanukkup payanthirunthaan.
isravealarum yoothaa janangka'lumaakiya yaavarum thaaveethaich sineakiththaarka'l; avarka'lukku munpaaka avan poakkum varaththumaayirunthaan.

en kai alla, pelistharin kaiyea avanmeal vizhattum en'ru savul ninaiththukko'ndu, savul thaaveethai noakki: ithoa, en mooththa kumaaraththiyaakiya mearaavai unakku manaiviyaakak koduppean; nee enakku nalla seavakanaaymaaththiram irunthu, karththarudaiya yuththangka'lai nadaththu en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu savulaip paarththu: raajaavukku marumakanaaki'ratha'rku naan emmaaththiram, en jeevan emmaaththiram, isravealilea en thakappan vamsamum emmaaththiram en'raan.
savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya mearaap thaaveethukkuk kodukkappadung kaalam vanthapoathu, ava'l meakoalaaththiyanaakiya aathariyealukku manaiviyaakak kodukkappattaa'l.
savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'l thaaveethai neasiththaa'l; athu savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, athu avanukkuch santhoashamaayirunthathu.

ava'l avanukkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkavum, pelistharin kai avanmeal vizhavum, ava'lai avanukkuk koduppean en'ru savul e'n'ni, thaaveethai noakki: nee ennudaiya ira'ndaam kumaaraththiyinaal in'ru enakku marumakanaavaay en'raan.

pinpu savul than oozhiyakkaararaip paarththu: neengka'l thaaveethoadea irakasiyamaayp peasi: ithoa, raajaa unmeal piriyamaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum ummaich sineakikki'raarka'l; ippoathum neer raajaavukku marumakanaanaal nalam en'ru sollungka'l en'ru ka'rpiththaan.

savulin oozhiyakkaarar intha vaarththaika'laith thaaveethin sevika'l keadkap peasinaarka'l; appozhuthu thaaveethu, naan raajaavukku marumakanaaki'rathu leasaana kaariyamaa? naan e'liyavanum, a'rpamaay e'n'nappattavanumaayirukki'rean en'raan.
thaaveethu inna innapadi sonnaan en'ru savulin oozhiyakkaarar avanukku a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu savul: raajaa parisaththai virumpaamal, pelistharin noo'ru nuniththoalka'linaal raajaavin saththurukka'lidaththil pazhivaangka viruppamaayirukki'raar en'ru thaaveethukkuch sollungka'l en'raan; thaaveethai pelistharin kaiyinaal vizhappa'n'nuvathea savuludaiya e'n'namaayirunthathu.
avan oozhiyakkaarar thaaveethukku intha vaarththaika'laich sonnapoathu, raajaavukku marumakanaaki'rathu thaaveethukkup piriyamaayirunthathu.

atha'rkuk ku'riththa naadka'l ni'raivea'rumunnea, thaaveethu ezhunthu, than manusharaik koottikko'ndupoay, pelistharil irunoo'rupearai vetti, avarka'l nuniththoalka'laik ko'nduvanthu, thaan raajaavukku marumakanaakumpadikku, avaika'lai raajaavukku e'n'nich seluththinaan; appozhuthu savul than kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'lai avanukku manaiviyaakak koduththaan.
karththar thaaveethoadirukki'raar en'ru savul ka'nda'rinthuko'ndaan; savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'lum avanai neasiththaa'l.
aakaiyaal savul innum athikamaayth thaaveethukkup payanthu, thaan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam thaaveethukkuch saththuruvaayirunthaan.
pelistharudaiya pirapukka'l pu'rappaduki'rapoathellaam thaaveethu savuludaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaaraippaarkkilum puththimaanaay nadanthuko'ndaan; avan pear mikavum kanampet'rathu.
thaaveethaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, savul than kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanoadum than oozhiyakkaarar ellaaroadum peasinaan.

savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanoa, thaaveethinmeal mikavum piriyamaayirunthaan; athanaal yoanaththaan thaaveethukku athai a'riviththu: en thakappanaakiya savul ummaik kon'rupoada vakaitheaduki'raar; ippoathum naa'laikkaalamea neer echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, ma'raivaana idaththil o'liththukko'ndirum.
naan pu'rappattuvanthu, neer ve'liyilirukkum idaththil en thakappan pakkaththilea nin'ru, umakkaaka en thakappanoadea peasi, nadakkum kaariyaththaik ka'ndu, umakku a'rivippean en'raan.

appadiyea yoanaththaan than thakappanaakiya savuloadea thaaveethukkaaka nalamaayp peasi, raajaa thammudaiya adiyaanaakiya thaaveethukku viroathamaayp paavagnseyyaathiruppaaraaka; avan umakku viroathamaakap paavagnseyyavillai; avan seykaika'l umakku meththa upayoakamaayirukki'rathea.

avan than piraa'nanaith than kaiyilea vaiththukko'ndu, anthap pelisthanaik kon'rathinaalea, karththar isravealukkellaam periya iradchippaik katta'laiyittathai neer ka'ndu, santhoashappatteerea; ippoathum mukaantharamillaamal thaaveethaik kolluki'rathinaal, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththi'rku viroathamaaka neer paavagnseyvaanean en'raan.
savul yoanaththaanudaiya sollaik keattu: avan kolaiseyyappaduvathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittaan.

pinpu yoanaththaan thaaveethai azhaiththu, antha vaarththaika'laiyellaam avanukku a'riviththu, avanaich savula'ndaiyilea koottikko'ndupoay vittaan; appadiyea avan munpoalavea avanudaiya samukaththil irunthaan.

ma'rupadiyum oru yuththam u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu thaaveethu pu'rappattuppoay, pelistharoadea yuththampa'n'ni, avarka'lukku'l makaa sangkaarampa'n'ninathinaal avarka'l avanukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadippoanaarka'l.
karththaraal vidappatta pollaatha aavi savulinmeal vanthathu; avan than veettil udkaarnthu, than eettiyaik kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndirunthaan; thaaveethu than kaiyinaalea surama'ndalam vaasiththaan.

appozhuthu savul: thaaveethai eettiyinaalea suvaroadea searththu uruvak kuththippoadap paarththaan; aanaalum ivan savulukku vilakinathinaalea, avan e'rintha eetti suvarilea pattathu; thaaveethoa an'ru iraaththiri oadippoay, thannaith thappuviththukko'ndaan.

thaaveethaik kaavalpa'n'ni, ma'runaa'l kaalamea avanaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, savul avan veetti'rkuch seavakarai anuppinaan; ithaith thaaveethukku avan manaiviyaakiya meekaa'l a'riviththu: neer in'ru iraaththiriyil ummudaiya piraa'nanaith thappuviththukko'l'laavittaal, naa'laikku neer kon'rupoadappaduveer en'ru solli,
meekaa'l thaaveethai jannalvazhiyaay i'rakkivittaa'l; avan thappi oadippoanaan.
meekaa'loa oru suroopaththai eduththu, kattilinmeal vaiththu, athin thalaimaattilea oru ve'l'laattuththoalaippoattu, thuppattiyinaal moodivaiththaa'l.
thaaveethaik ko'nduvarach savul seavakarai anuppinapoathu, avar viyaathiyaayirukki'raar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethaip paarkki'ratha'rkuch savul seavakarai anuppi, avanaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, kattiloadea avanai ennidaththi'rku eduththukko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.
seavakar vanthapoathu, ithoa, suroopam kattilinmealum, ve'l'laattuththoal athin thalaimaattilum kidakkak ka'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu savul: nee ippadi ennai eayththu, en pakaignanaith thappavittu anuppinathu enna en'ru meekaa'lidaththil keattaan. meekaa'l savulai noakki: ennaip poakavidu, naan unnai ean kollavea'ndum en'ru avar ennidaththil sonnaar en'raa'l.
thaaveethu thappi, raamaaviliruntha saamuvealidaththi'rkup poay, savul thanakkuch seythathu ellaavat'raiyum avanukku a'riviththaan; pinpu avanum saamuvealum poay, naayoathilea thangkiyirunthaarka'l.
thaaveethu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea irukki'raan en'ru savulukku a'rivikkappattathu.
