appozhuthu savul: thaaveethaik ko'nduvarach seavakarai anuppinaan; avarka'l theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin koottaththaiyum, saamuveal avarka'lin thalaivanaaka ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu savulinudaiya seavakarinmeal theavanudaiya aavi i'rangkinathinaal avarka'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarka'l.

ithu savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan vea'rea seavakarai anuppinaan; avarka'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarka'l; moon'raantharamum savul seavakarai anuppinaan; avarka'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu avanum raamaavukkup poay, seakkuvilirukki'ra periya ki'nat'ra'ndaiyilea vanthu, saamuvealum thaaveethum engkea en'ru keattaan; athoa raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea irukki'raarka'l en'ru sollappattathu.

appozhuthu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathi'rkup poanaan; avanmealum theavanudaiya aavi i'rangkinathinaal avan raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea searumattum, theerkkatharisanam sollikko'ndea nadanthuvanthu,

thaanum than vasthirangka'laik kazhat'rippoattu, saamuvealukku munpaakath theerkkatharisanam solli, an'ru pakal muzhuvathum iraamuzhuvathum vasthiram illaamal vizhunthukidanthaan; aakaiyinaalea savulum theerkkatharisika'lil oruvanoa enpaarka'l.

thaaveethu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilirunthu oadippoay, yoanaththaan munpaaka vanthu: ummudaiya thakappan en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'raarea, naan seythathu enna? en akkiramam enna? naan avarukkuch seytha thuroakam enna? en'raan.

atha'rku avan: appadi orukkaalum vaaraathu; neer saavathillai, ithoa, enakku a'rivikkaamal en thakappan periya kaariyamaanaalum si'riya kaariyamaanaalum on'rum seyki'rathillai; inthak kaariyaththai en thakappan enakku ma'raippaanean? appadi irukkamaattaathu en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaiththathu en'ru ummudaiya thakappan nan'raay a'rivaar; aakaiyaal yoanaththaanukku mananoavu u'ndaakaathapadikku avan ithai a'riyappoakaathu enpaar; mara'naththi'rkum enakkum oru adi thooramaaththiram irukki'rathu en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyum ko'ndu nichchayamaaych solluki'rean en'ru ma'rumozhi solli aa'naiyittaan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan thaaveethaip paarththu: umathu manaviruppam innathu en'ru sollum, athinpadi umakkuch seyvean en'raan.

thaaveethu yoanaththaanai noakki: ithoa, naa'laikku amaavaasi, naan raajaavoadea panthiyirunthu saappidavea'ndiyathaayirukkum; aanaalum naan moon'raam naa'l saayangkaalamattum ve'liyilea o'liththirukkumpadi enakku uththaravu kodum.

ummudaiya thakappan ennaikku'riththu visaariththaal, than ooraakiya pethlekeamilea than kudumpaththaar yaavarum varushaththukku orutharam paliyida varuki'rapadiyaal thaaveethu avvidaththi'rkuppoaka ennidaththil varunthik keattaan en'ru neer sollum.
atha'rku avar nallathu en'raal, ummudaiya adiyaanukkuch samaathaanam irukkum; avarukku erichchalu'ndaanaal, avaraalea pollaapputh theermaanappattirukki'rathu en'ru a'rinthuko'lveer.

aakaiyaal ummudaiya adiyaanukkuth thayaiseyyavea'ndum; karththarukku munpaaka ummudaiya adiyaanoadea udanpadikkai pa'n'niyirukki'reerea; ennil oru akkiramam irunthatheayaanaal, neerea ennaik kon'rupoadum; neer ennai ummudaiya thakappanidaththukkuk ko'ndupoakavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.

appozhuthu yoanaththaan: appadi umakku varaathiruppathaaka; umakkup pollaappuch seyya en thakappanaalea theermaaniththirukki'rathu en'ru naan nichchayamaay a'rintheanaanaal naan athai umakku a'rivikkaathiruppeanaa en'raan.
thaaveethu yoanaththaanai noakki: ummudaiya thakappan kadinamaana uththaram sonnaal athai yaar enakku a'rivippaar en'raan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan thaaveethaip paarththu: oorukku ve'liyea poavoam vaarum en'raan; iruvarum ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoanaththaan isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai munnittuth thaaveethai noakki: naan naa'laiyaavathu ma'runaa'lilaavathu en thakappanudaiya manathai a'rinthuko'ndu, avar thaaveethinmeal thayavaayirukki'raar en'ru ka'ndum, athai appoathu umathu sevika'lukku ve'lippaduththumpadikku, umakkuch solliyanuppaathirunthaal,

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar yoanaththaanukku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyyakkadavar; aanaalum umakkuth theengku seyya en thakappanukkup piriyamaayirunthaal, athai umathu sevika'lukku ve'lippaduththi, neer samaathaanaththoadea poakumpadikku ummai anuppividuvean; karththar en thakappanoadu irunthathupoal, ummoadum iruppaaraaka.
mealum, naan uyiroadirukkaiyil, naan saakaathapadikku neer karththarin nimiththamaay enakkuth thayaiseyyavea'ndiyathum allaamal,
karththar thaaveethin saththurukka'laakiya ovvoruvaraiyum poomiyinmeal iraathapadikku, veara'rukkumpoathum, neer en'raikkum umathu thayavai en veettaivittu akat'rividaamalum irukkavea'ndum en'raan.
ippadi yoanaththaan thaaveethin kudumpaththoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, thaaveethudaiya saththurukka'lin kaiyilea karththar ka'nakkuk keadpaaraaka en'ru solli,
yoanaththaan thaaveethai mikavum sineakiththapadiyinaal, pinnum avanukku aa'naiyittaan; than uyiraich sineakiththathupoala avanaich sineakiththaan.
pinpu yoanaththaan thaaveethaip paarththu: naa'laikku amaavaasi, neer udkaaravea'ndiya idam kaaliyaayiruppathinaal ummaikku'riththu visaarikkappadum.
kaariyam nadanthapoathu, moon'raam naa'lilea neer o'liththirukkum idaththi'rkuth theeviriththu vanthu, easeal ennum kalla'ndaiyil udkaarnthirum.
appozhuthu naan ku'rippuvaiththu eyki'rathupoala, atha'rkup pakkamaaka moon'ru ampuka'lai eythu:

nee poay, antha ampuka'laith theadi vaa en'ru oru pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanai anuppuvean; ithoa, ampuka'l unakku ippu'raththilea kidakki'rathu, avaika'lai eduththukko'nduvaa en'ru pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanidaththil naan sonnaal, neer vaarum; appozhuthu on'rum illai, umakkuch samaathaanam irukkum en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
ithoa, ampuka'l unakku appu'raththilea kidakki'rathu en'ru naan anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanidaththil sonnaal, neer poayvidum; appozhuthu karththar ummaip poakachsolluki'raar en'ru a'riyum.
neerum naanum peasikko'nda kaariyaththi'rku, ithoa, karththar enakkum umakkum en'raikkum naduni'rkum saadchi en'raan.
appadiyea thaaveethu ve'liyilea o'liththukko'ndirunthaan; amaavaasiyaanapoathu raajaa poajanampa'n'na udkaarnthaan.

raajaa suvara'ndaiyilirukki'ra than idaththil eppoathumpoal udkaarnthapoathu, yoanaththaan ezhunthirunthaan; apnearoa savuludaiya pakkaththil udkaarnthaan; thaaveethu irukkum idam kaaliyaayirunthathu.
aanaalum avan theettaayirukki'raanaakkum, avan theettuppattuththaan irukkavea'ndum en'ru an'raiyathinam savul on'rum sollavillai.

amaavaasikku ma'runaa'lilum thaaveethu irukkum idam kaaliyaayirunthathu; appozhuthu savul: eesaayin makan neat'rum in'rum poajanaththukku varaatheapoanathu enna en'ru than kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanaik keattaan.
yoanaththaan savulukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: pethlekeammattum poaka, thaaveethu ennidaththil varunthikkeattu,

angkea naan poakavea'ndum; engka'l kudumpaththaar oorilea paliyidap poaki'raarka'l; en thamaiyan ennai varumpadi katta'laiyittaar; ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaiththathaanaal, naan en sakoathararaip paarkki'ratha'rkup poaka enakku uththaravu kodum en'raan; ithanaaleathaan avan raajaavin panthikku varavillai en'raan.

appozhuthu savul yoanaththaanmeal koapamoo'ndavanaaki, avanaip paarththu: ira'ndakamum maa'rupaadumu'l'lava'lin makanea, nee unakku vedkamaakavum, un thaayin maanaththi'rku vedkamaakavum, eesaayin makanaith thoazhanaakath therinthuko'ndirukki'rathai naan a'riyeanoa?
eesaayin makan poomiyinmeal uyiroadirukkum naa'lvaraiyum neeyaanaalum un raajyapaaramaanaalum nilaippaduvathillai; ippoathea avanai azhaippiththu, ennidaththil ko'nduvaa; avan saakavea'ndum en'raan.
yoanaththaan than thakappanaakiya savulukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: avan ean kollappadavea'ndum? avan enna seythaan en'raan.
appozhuthu savul: avanaik kuththippoada avanmeal eettiyai e'rinthaan; aakaiyaal thaaveethaik kon'rupoadath than thakappan theermaaniththirukki'raan enpathai yoanaththaan a'rinthuko'ndu,

koapathaapamaay panthiyaivittu ezhunthirunthupoay, amaavaasiyin ma'runaa'laakiya an'raiyathinam poajanampa'n'naathirunthaan; than thakappan thaaveethai ninthiththuch sonnathu avanukku mananoavaayirunthathu.
ma'runaa'l kaalamea, yoanaththaan thaaveethukkuk ku'riththanearaththilea oru si'rupi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaik koottikko'ndu, ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoay:
pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanai noakki: nee oadi, naan eyki'ra ampuka'laith theadi eduththukko'nduvaa en'ru solli, anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan oadumpoathu, avanukku appaalea poakumpadi oru ampai eythaan.
yoanaththaan eytha ampirukkum idamattum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan poanapoathu, ampu unakku innum appaal irukki'rathu allavaa en'ru yoanaththaan pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanukkup pi'rakeayirunthu kooppittaan.

nee thariththuni'rkaamal theeviriththup pottenappoa en'rum yoanaththaan pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanukkup pi'rakeayirunthu kooppittaan; appadiyea yoanaththaanin pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan ampuka'laip po'rukki, than ejamaanidaththil ko'nduvanthaan.
anthak kaariyam yoanaththaanukkum thaaveethukkum therinthirunthatheayallaamal, anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanukku on'rum theriyaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan: than aayuthangka'laip pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanidaththil koduththu, ivaika'laip patta'naththi'rkuk ko'ndupoa en'raan.

pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan poanapinpu, thaaveethu thenpu'ramaana idaththilirunthu ezhunthuvanthu, tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, moon'ruvisai va'nangkinaan; avarka'l oruvarai oruvar muththagnseythu azhuthaarka'l; thaaveethu mikavum azhuthaan.

appozhuthu yoanaththaan thaaveethai noakki: neer samaathaanaththoadea poam, karththar en'raikkum enakkum umakkum, en santhathikkum umathu santhathikkum, naduni'rkum saadchi en'ru solli, karththarudaiya naamaththaikko'ndu naam iruvarum aa'naiyittuk ko'ndathai ninaiththuk ko'l'lum en'raan. (43) pinpu avan ezhunthu pu'rappattuppoanaan; yoanaththaanoa patta'naththi'rkup poayvittaan.

thaaveethu noapilirukki'ra aasaariyanaakiya akimeleakkinidaththil poanaan; akimeleakku nadukkaththoadea thaaveethukku ethirko'ndupoay: oruvarum ummoadea koodavaraamal, neer o'ndiyaay varuki'rathu enna en'ru avanaik keattaan.

thaaveethu aasaariyanaakiya akimeleakkaip paarththu: raajaa enakku oru kaariyaththaik katta'laiyittu, naan unnai anuppina kaariyamum unakkuk katta'laiyittathum innathen'ru oruvarum a'riyaathirukkavea'ndum en'ru ennoadea sonnaar; inna idaththi'rku varavea'ndum en'ru seavakarukkuch solliyirukki'rean.
ippoathum ummudaiya kaiyil irukki'rathu enna? ainthu appamaakilum, ennavaakilum, irukki'rathai en kaiyilea kodum en'raan.
aasaariyan thaaveethukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: parisuththa appam irukki'rathea ozhiya, saathaara'na appam en kaiyil illai; vaalipar sthireeka'loadeamaaththiram searaathirunthaal koduppean en'raan.

thaaveethu aasaariyanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan pu'rappaduki'ratha'rku mun neat'rum munthaanaa'lum sthireeka'l engka'lukku vilakkamaayirunthaarka'l; vaaliparudaiya asampika'lum suththamaayirukki'rathu; in'raiyathinam vea'rea appam paaththiraththil pirathishdaipa'n'nappattathinaal, ithu saathaara'namaayit'rea en'raan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya sannithiyilirunthu edukkappatta samukaththappangka'laiththavira, vea'rea appam angkea iraathapadiyinaal aasaariyan avanukkup parisuththa appaththaik koduththaan; avaika'l edukkappaduki'ra naa'lilea atha'rkup pathilaakach soodaana appam vaikkappadum.

savuludaiya vealaikkaararil eathoamiyanaakiya thoaveakku ennum pearu'l'la oruvan an'raiyathinam angkea karththarudaiya sannithiyil thadaipattirunthaan; avan savuludaiya meaypparukkuth thalaivanaayirunthaan.

thaaveethu akimeleakkaip paarththu: ingkea ummudaiya vasaththil oru eettiyaanaalum pattayamaanaalum illaiyaa? raajaavin kaariyam avasaramaanapadiyinaal, en pattayaththaiyaakilum, en aayuthangka'laiyaakilum, naan eduththuk ko'nduvaravillai en'raan.

atha'rku aasaariyan: neer ealea pa'l'laththaakkilea kon'ra pelisthanaakiya koaliyaaththin pattayam, ithoa, eapoaththukkup pinnaaka oru pudavaiyilea surutti vaiththirukki'rathu; athai neer edukka manathaanaal eduththukko'ndupoam, athuvea allaamal vea'ron'rum ingkea illai en'raan; appozhuthu thaaveethu: atha'rku nikarillai; athai enakkuth thaarum en'raan.
an'raiyathinam thaaveethu ezhunthu savulukkuth thappiyoadi, kaaththin raajaavaakiya aakeesidaththil poanaan.

aakeesin oozhiyakkaarar avanaip paarththu: theasaththu raajaavaakiya thaaveethu ivan allavoa? savul kon'rathu aayiram, thaaveethu kon'rathu pathinaayiram en'ru ivanaikku'riththallavoa aadalpaadaloadea ko'ndaadinaarka'l en'raarka'l.
intha vaarththaika'laith thaaveethu than manathilea vaiththukko'ndu, kaaththin raajaavaakiya aakeesukku mikavum payappattu,

avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakath than mukanaadiyai vea'rupaduththi, avarka'lidaththil piththangko'ndavanpoalak kaa'npiththu, vaasa'rkathavuka'lilea kee'rikko'ndirunthu, than vaayilirunthu nuraiyaith than thaadiyil vizhappa'n'nik ko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu aakees: than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: ithoa, intha manushan piththangko'ndavan en'ru kaa'nki'reerka'lea; ivanai neengka'l ennidaththil ko'nduvanthathu enna?
enakku munpaakap payiththiya seashdai seyya, neengka'l ivanaik ko'nduvaruki'ratha'rku, payiththiyakkaarar enakkuk ku'raivaayirukki'raarka'loa? ivan en veettilea varalaamaa en'raan.
thaaveethu avvidaththaivittuth thappi, athullaam ennum kepikkup poanaan; athai avan sakoathararum avan thakappan veettaar anaivarum keattu, angkea avanidaththukkup poanaarka'l.

odukkappattavarka'l, kadanpattavarka'l, mu'rumu'rukki'ravarka'l yaavarum avanoadea koodikko'ndaarka'l; avan avarka'lukkuth thalaivanaanaan; inthappirakaaramaaka ea'rakku'raiya naanoo'rupear avanoadirunthaarka'l.

thaaveethu avvidaththaivittu moavaapiyaraich searntha mispeakkup poay, moavaapin raajaavaip paarththu: theavan ennai eppadi nadaththuvaar en'ru naan a'riyumattum, en thakappanum en thaayum ungka'lidaththilea thangkiyirukkumpadi thayavuseyyum en'ru solli,
avarka'lai moavaapin raajaavinidaththil azhaiththukko'ndupoayvittaan; thaaveethu ara'nil iruntha naa'lellaam avarka'l angkea avanoadirunthaarka'l.
pinpu kaath ennum theerkkatharisi thaaveethaip paarththu: neer ara'nil iraamal yoothaatheasaththi'rkup pu'rappattuvaarum en'raan; appozhuthu thaaveethu pu'rappattu aareath ennum kaattilea poanaan.

thaaveethum avanoadiruntha manusharum kaa'nappatta seythiyaich savul kea'lvippattaan; savul kipiyaavaich searntha raamaavil oru thoappilea udkaarnthu, thannudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum thannaich soozhnthuni'rka, than eettiyaith than kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndirukkumpoathu,

savul thanna'ndaiyil ni'rki'ra than oozhiyakkaararaip paarththu: penyameen puththirarea, kea'lungka'l; eesaayin makan ungka'lellaarukkum vayalka'laiyum thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum koduppaanoa? ungka'lellaaraiyum aayiraththukku athipathika'lum noot'rukku athipathika'lumaaka vaippaanoa?

neengka'lellaarum enakku viroathamaakak kattuppaadu pa'n'nikko'ndathu enna? eesaayin makanudanea en kumaaran udanpadikkaipa'n'numpoathu, en sevikku athai oruvanum ve'lippaduththavillai; enakkaakap parithaapappattu, en sevikku athai ve'lippaduththa ungka'lil oruvanaakilum illaiyaa? innaa'lil irukki'rapadi enakkuch sathipa'n'na, en kumaaran en vealaikkaaranai enakku viroathamaaka eduththuvittaanea en'raan.
appozhuthu savulin oozhiyakkaararoadea nin'ra eathoamiyanaakiya thoaveakku pirathiyuththaramaaka: eesaayin makanai noapilirukki'ra akithoopin kumaaranaakiya akimeleakkidaththil varakka'ndean.
ivan avanukkaakak karththaridaththil visaariththu, avanukku vazhikku poajanaththaik koduththu, pelisthanaakiya koaliyaaththin pattayaththaiyum avanukkuk koduththaan en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa: akithoopin kumaaranaakiya akimeleak ennum aasaariyanaiyum, noapilirukki'ra avan thakappan veettaaraakiya ellaa aasaariyaraiyum azhaippiththaan; avarka'lellaarum raajaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu savul: akithoopin kumaaranea kea'l en'ru solla, avan: ithoa, irukki'rean en aa'ndavanea en'raan.

appozhuthu savul avanai noakki: neeyum eesaayin makanum enakku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, innaa'lil irukki'rapadi enakkuch sathipa'n'na avan enakku viroathamaaka ezhumpumpadikku, nee avanukku appamum pattayamum koduththu, theavasannithiyil avanukkaaka visaariththathu enna en'raan.

akimeleak raajaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ummudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararilum thaaveethaippoala, raajaavukku marumakanum, ummudaiya katta'laika'linpadi seythuvaruki'ravanum, ummudaiya veettilea kanamu'l'lavanumaayirukki'ra u'nmaiyu'l'lavan yaar?

in'raiyathinam avanukkaaka theava sannithiyil visaarikkath thodangkineanoa? athu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; raajaa thammudaiya adiyaanaakiya enmealaakilum en thakappan veettaaril evanmealaakilum kut'ram sumaththavea'ndaam; ummudaiya adiyaan ivaika'lilellaam oru si'riya kaariyamaakilum periya kaariyamaakilum a'rinthirunthathillai en'raan.
raajaavoa: akimeleakkea, neeyum un thakappan veettaar anaivarum saakavea saakavea'ndum en'raan.

pinpu raajaa thanna'ndaiyilea ni'rki'ra seavakarai noakki: neengka'l poay, karththarudaiya aasaariyarka'laik kollungka'l; avarka'l kaiyum thaaveethoadea irukki'rathu; avan oadippoaki'rathai avarka'l a'rinthirunthum, athai enakku ve'lippaduththavillai en'raan; raajaavin vealaikkaararoa, karththarudaiya aasaariyarka'laik kollath thangka'l kaika'lai neetta sammathikkavillai.

appozhuthu raajaa thoaveakkai noakki: nee poay aasaariyarka'laik kon'rupoadu en'raan; eathoamiyanaakiya thoaveakku aasaariyarka'lmeal vizhunthu, sa'nalnool eapoaththaith thariththirukkum e'npaththainthupearai an'raiyathinam kon'raan.

aasaariyarka'lin patta'namaakiya noapilumu'l'la purusharaiyum, sthireeka'laiyum, pi'l'laika'laiyum, kuzhanthaika'laiyum, maaduka'laiyum, kazhuthaika'laiyum, aaduka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaan.
akithoopin kumaaranaakiya akimeleakkin kumaararil apiyaththaar ennum pearu'l'la oruvan thappi, thaaveethu irukkum pu'ramaaka oadippoay,
savul karththarudaiya aasaariyarka'laik kon'rupoatta seythiyai thaaveethukku a'riviththaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu apiyaththaaraip paarththu: eathoamiyanaakiya thoaveakku angkea irunthapadiyinaalea, avan evvithaththilum savulukku athai a'rivippaan en'ru an'raiyathinamea a'rinthirunthean; un thakappan veettaaraakiya ellaarudaiya mara'naththukkum kaara'nam naanea.
nee ennidaththil iru, payappadavea'ndaam; en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravanea un piraa'nanaiyum vaangkaththeaduki'raan; nee en aatharavilea iru en'raan.
ithoa, pelisthar keakilaavinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, ka'lagnchiyangka'laik ko'l'laiyiduki'raarka'l en'ru thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattathu.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: naan poay, anthap pelistharai mu'riya adikkalaamaa en'ru karththaridaththil visaariththatha'rku, karththar: nee poa; pelistharai mu'riya adiththu, keakilaavai radchippaayaaka en'ru thaaveethukkuch sonnaar.

aanaalum thaaveethin manushar avanai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l ingkea yoothaavilea irukkumpoathea payappaduki'roam; naangka'l pelistharudaiya seanaika'lai ethirkki'ratha'rku keakilaavukkup poanaal, evva'lavu athikam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethu thirumpavum karththaridaththil visaariththapoathu, karththar avanukku uththaramaaka: nee ezhumpi, keakilaavukkup poa; naan pelistharai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'raar.

appadiyea thaaveethu than manusharaik koottikko'ndu, keakilaavukkup poay, pelistharoadu yuththampa'n'ni, avarka'lil aneakampearai vetti, avarka'l aadumaaduka'lai oattikko'ndupoanaan; ivvithamaayk keakilaavin kudika'lai radchiththaan.
akimeleakkin kumaaranaakiya apiyaththaar keakilaavil irukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil thappiyoaduki'rapoathu, avanidaththil oru eapoaththu irunthathu.

thaaveethu keakilaavukku vanthaan en'ru savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, theavan avanai en kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avan kathavuka'lum thaazhppaa'lka'lumu'l'la patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasiththathinaal, adaipattirukki'raan en'ru savul solli,
thaaveethaiyum avan manusharaiyum mut'rikkai poadumpadikku, keakilaavukkup poaka, ellaa janaththaiyum yuththaththi'rku azhaippiththaan.
thanakkup pollaappuch seyyach savul eththanampa'n'nuki'raan en'ru thaaveethu a'rinthuko'ndapoathu, aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaarai noakki: eapoaththai ingkea ko'nduvaa en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, savul keakilaavukku vanthu, ennimiththam patta'naththai azhikka vakaitheaduki'raan en'ru umathu adiyaanaakiya naan nichchayamaayk kea'lvippattean.

keakilaa patta'naththaar ennai avan kaiyil oppukkoduppaarka'loa, ummudaiya adiyaan kea'lvippattapadi savul varuvaanoa, isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, ithai ummudaiya adiyaanukkuth therivikkavea'ndum en'raan. atha'rkuk karththar: avan varuvaan en'raar.
keakilaapatta'naththaar ennaiyum en manusharaiyum savulin kaiyil oppukkoduppaarka'loa en'ru thaaveethu keattatha'rku, karththar: oppukkoduppaarka'l en'raar.

aakaiyaal thaaveethum ea'rakku'raiya a'runoo'rupearaakiya avan manusharum ezhumpi, keakilaavai vittup pu'rappattu, poakakkoodiya idaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; thaaveethu keakilaavilirunthu thappippoanaan en'ru savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, thaan pu'rappaduki'rathai ni'ruththivittaan.

thaaveethu vanaantharaththilu'l'la ara'naana sthalangka'lilea thangki, seep ennum vanaantharaththilirukki'ra oru malaiyilea thariththirunthaan; savul anuthinamum avanaith theadiyum, theavan avanai avan kaiyil oppukkodukkavillai.
than piraa'nanai vaangkath theadumpadikku, savul pu'rappattaan en'ru thaaveethu a'rinthapadiyinaalea, thaaveethu seep vanaantharaththilu'l'la oru kaattilea irunthaan.
appozhuthu savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaan ezhunthu, kaattilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil poay, theavanukku'l avan kaiyaith thidappaduththi:

neer payappadavea'ndaam; en thakappanaakiya savulin kai ummaik ka'ndu pidikkamaattaathu; neer isravealinmeal raajaavaayiruppeer; appozhuthu naan umakku ira'ndaavathaayiruppean; appadi nadakkum en'ru en thakappanaakiya savulum a'rinthirukki'raar en'raan.
avarka'l iruvarum karththarukku munpaaka udanpadikkai pa'n'ninapinpu, thaaveethu kaattil irunthuvittaan; yoanaththaanoa than veetti'rkup poanaan.

pinpu seep ooraar kipiyaavilirukki'ra savulidaththil vanthu: thaaveethu engka'lidaththil eshimoanukkuth the'rkea aakilaa ennum malaikkaattilu'l'la ara'nippaana idangka'lil o'liththukko'ndirukki'raan allavaa?
ippoathum raajaavea, neer ummudaiya manaviruppaththinpadi i'rangki vaarum; avanai raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukka, engka'laal aakum en'raarka'l.
atha'rku savul: neengka'l enmeal thayai vaiththathinaalea, karththaraal aaseervathikkappattiruppeerka'laaka.

neengka'l poay, avan kaal nadamaaduki'ra idaththaip paarththu, angkea avanaik ka'ndavan yaar enpathaiyum innum nan'raay visaariththu a'riyungka'l; avan makaa thanthiravaathi en'ru enakkuth theriyavanthathu.

avan o'liththukko'ndirukkum ellaa ma'raividangka'laiyum paarththa'rinthu ko'ndu, nichchaya seythi enakkuk ko'nduvaarungka'l; appozhuthu naan ungka'loadea koodavanthu, avan theasaththil irunthaal, yoothaavilirukki'ra sakala aayirangka'lukku'l'lum avanaith theadip poavean en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l ezhunthu, savulukku munnaalea seep oorukkup poanaarka'l; thaaveethum avan manusharum eshimoanukkuth the'rkaana anthara ve'liyaakiya maakoan vanaantharaththil irunthaarka'l.

savulum avan manusharum thaaveethaith theadavaruki'raarka'l en'ru avanukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan kanmalaiyilirunthu i'rangki, maakoan vanaantharaththilea thangkinaan; athaich savul kea'lvippattu, maakoan vanaantharaththilea thaaveethaip pin thodarnthaan.

savul malaiyin inthappakkaththilum, thaaveethum avan manusharum malaiyin anthappakkaththilum nadanthaarka'l; savulukkuth thappippoaka, thaaveethu theeviriththapoathu, savulum avan manusharum thaaveethaiyum avan manusharaiyum pidikkaththakkathaay avarka'lai va'lainthuko'ndaarka'l.
anthach samayaththil oru aa'l savulidaththil vanthu: neer seekkiramaay vaarum; pelisthar theasaththinmeal padaiyeduththu vanthirukki'raarka'l en'raan.
athanaal savul thaaveethaip pinthodaruki'rathai vittuth thirumpi, pelistharai ethirkkumpadi poanaan; aathalaal avvidaththi'rkuch sealaa ammaalikoath en'ru pearittaarka'l.
thaaveethu avvidaththai vittup pu'rappattu, enkeathiyilu'l'la ara'nippaana idangka'lil thangkinaan.
savul pelistharaip pinthodarnthu thirumpivanthapoathu, ithoa, thaaveethu enkeathiyin vanaantharaththil irukki'raan en'ru avanukku a'rivikkappattathu.
appozhuthu savul: israveal anaiththilum therinthuko'l'lappatta moovaayirampearaik koottikko'ndu, thaaveethaiyum avan manusharaiyum varaiyaaduka'lu'l'la kanmalaika'linmeal theadappoanaan.

vazhiyoaraththilirukki'ra aattuththozhuvangka'lidaththil avan vanthapoathu, angkea oru kepi irunthathu; athilea savul malajalaathikkup poanaan; thaaveethum avan manusharum anthak kepiyin pakkangka'lil udkaarnthirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethin manushar avanai noakki: ithoa, naan un saththuruvai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean; un paarvaikku nalamaanapadi avanukkuch seyvaayaaka en'ru karththar unnoadea sonna naa'l ithuthaanea en'raarka'l; thaaveethu ezhunthirunthupoay, savuludaiya saalvaiyin thongkalai me'l'la a'ruththukko'ndaan.
thaaveethu savulin saalvaith thongkalai a'ruththukko'ndathinimiththam avan manathu adiththukko'ndirunthathu.

avan than manusharaip paarththu: karththar apisheakampa'n'nina en aa'ndavanmeal en kaiyaip poadumpadiyaana ippadippatta kaariyaththai naan seyyaathapadikku, karththar ennaik kaappaaraaka; avar karththaraal apisheakam pa'n'nappattavar en'ru solli,
than manusharaich savulinmeal ezhumpa ottaamal, ivvaarththaika'linaal avarka'laith thadaipa'n'ninaan; savul ezhunthirunthu, kepiyaivittu, vazhiyea nadanthupoanaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethum ezhunthu, kepiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, savulukkup pinnaakap poay: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea en'ru kooppittaan; savul thirumpippaarththapoathu, thaaveethu tharaimattum mukangkuninthu va'nangki,
savulai noakki: thaaveethu umakkup pollaappuch seyyappaarkki'raan en'ru solluki'ra manusharudaiya vaarththaika'lai ean keadki'reer?

ithoa, karththar in'ru kepiyil ummai en kaiyil oppukkoduththaar enpathai in'raiyathinam ummudaiya ka'nka'l ka'ndathea, ummaik kon'rupoadavea'ndum en'ru silar sonnaarka'l; aanaalum en kai ummaith thappavittathu; en aa'ndavanmeal en kaiyaip poadean; avar karththaraal apisheakampa'n'nappattavaraamea en'rean.

en thakappanea paarum; en kaiyilirukki'ra ummudaiya saalvaiyin thongkalaip paarum; ummaik kon'rupoadaamal, ummudaiya saalvaiyin thongkalai a'ruththukko'ndean; en kaiyilea pollaappum thuroakamum illai en'rum, umakku naan kut'ram seyyavillai en'rum a'rinthuko'l'lum; neeroa en piraa'nanai vaangka, athai veattaiyaaduki'reer.
karththar enakkum umakkum nadunin'ru niyaayam visaariththu, karththar thaamea en kaariyaththil umakku neethiyaich sarikkattuvaaraaka; ummudaiya pearil naan kaipoaduvathillai.
muthiyoar mozhippadiyea, aakaathavarka'lidaththilea aakaamiyam pi'rakkum; aakaiyaal ummudaiyapearil naan kaipoaduvathillai.
isravealin raajaa yaaraith theadap pu'rappattaar? oru seththa naayaiyaa, oru the'l'luppoochchiyaiyaa, neer yaaraip pinthodaruki'reer?
karththar niyaayaathipathiyaayirunthu, enakkum umakkum niyaayantheerththu, enakkaaka vazhakkaadi, naan ummudaiya kaikkuth thappa ennai viduvippaaraaka en'raan.
thaaveethu intha vaarththaika'laich savuloadea solli mudinthapinpu, savul: en kumaaranaakiya thaaveethea, ithu unnudaiya saththamallavaa en'ru solli, saththamittu azhuthu,
thaaveethaip paarththu: nee ennaippaarkkilum neethimaan; nee enakku nanmai seythaay; naanoa unakku theemai seythean.
nee enakku nanmai seythathai in'ru vi'langkappa'n'ninaay; karththar ennai un kaiyil oppukkoduththirunthum, nee ennaik kon'rupoadavillai.
oruvan than maat'raanaik ka'ndupidiththaal, avanaich sukamea poakaviduvaanoa? in'ru nee enakkuch seytha nanmaikkaakak karththar unakku nanmai seyvaaraaka.
nee nichchayamaaka raajaavaay iruppaay en'rum, isravealin raajyapaaram un kaiyil nilaivarappadum en'rum a'rivean.
ippoathum nee enakkup pinnirukkum en santhathiyai veara'ruppathillai en'rum, en thakappan veettaaril en peyarai azhiththuppoaduvathillai en'rum karththarmeal enakku aa'naiyittuk kodu en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu savulukku aa'naiyittuk koduththaan; pinpu, savul than veettukkup pu'rappattuppoanaan; thaaveethum avan manusharum ara'nippaana idaththi'rku ea'rippoanaarka'l.

saamuveal mara'namadainthaan. isravealar ellaarum koodivanthu, avanukkaakath thukkangko'ndaadi, raamaavilirukki'ra avanudaiya va'lavilea avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; thaaveethu ezhunthu, paaraan vanaantharaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaan.

maakoanilea oru manushan irunthaan; avanudaiya thozhilthu'rai karmealil irunthathu; antha manushan makaa paarik kudiththanakkaaranaayirunthaan; avanukku moovaayiram aadum, aayiram ve'l'laadum irunthathu; avan appozhuthu karmealil than aaduka'lai mayir kaththariththukko'ndirunthaan.

antha manushanukku naapaal en'rum, avan manaivikku apikaayil en'rum peyar; antha sthiree makaa puththisaaliyum roopavathiyumaayirunthaa'l; anthap purushanoa muradanum thuraakiruthanumaayirunthaan; avan kaaleapudaiya santhathiyaan.
naapaal than aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'ra seythiyai vanaantharaththil irukki'ra thaaveethu keattapoathu,
thaaveethu paththu vaaliparai azhaiththu: neengka'l karmealukkup poay, naapaalidaththil sen'ru, en pearaichsolli, avan sukaseythiyai visaariththu,
avanai noakki: neer vaazhka, umakkuch samaathaanamum, ummudaiya veettukkuch samaathaanamum, umakku u'ndaana ellaavat'ri'rkum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka en'ru avanai vaazhththi,

ippozhuthu aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'ravarka'l ummidaththil irukki'raarka'l en'ru kea'lvippattean; ummudaiya meayppar engka'loadeakooda irunthaarka'l; avarka'l karmealil iruntha naa'lellaam naangka'l avarka'lai varuththappaduththavillai; avarka'ludaiya poru'l on'rum kaa'naama'rpoanathum illai.

ummudaiya vealaikkaararaik kea'lum; avarka'l umakkuch solluvaarka'l; aathalaal intha vaaliparukku ummudaiya ka'nka'lilea thayaikidaikkavea'ndum; nalla naa'lil vanthoam; ummudaiya kaikku uthavuvathai ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkum, ummudaiya kumaaranaakiya thaaveethukkum kodukkumpadi vea'nduki'rean en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
thaaveethin vaalipar poay, intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam thaaveethin naamaththinaalea naapaalidaththil solli, pinnon'rum peasaathirunthaarka'l.
naapaal thaaveethin oozhiyakkaararukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: thaaveethu enpavan yaar? eesaayin kumaaran yaar? thangka'l ejamaanka'lai vittu oadippoaki'ra vealaikkaarar innaa'lil aneakar u'ndu.

naan en appaththaiyum, en tha'n'neeraiyum, en aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'ravarka'lukkaaka naan adiththuch samaiyal pa'n'nuviththathaiyum eduththu, inna idaththaar en'ru naan a'riyaatha manusharukkuk koduppeanoa en'raan.
thaaveethin vaalipar thangka'l vazhiyea thirumpi, ma'rupadiyum thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam avanukku a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu than manusharaip paarththu: neengka'l avaravar ungka'l pattayaththaik kattikko'l'lungka'l en'raan; avaravar thangka'l pattayaththaik kattikko'ndaarka'l; thaaveethum than pattayaththaik kattikko'ndaan; ea'rakku'raiya naanoo'rupear thaaveethukkup pinsen'ru pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; irunoo'rupear rasthukka'l a'ndaiyil irunthuvittaarka'l.

appozhuthu vealaikkaararil oruvan naapaaludaiya manaiviyaakiya apikaayilai noakki: ithoa, nammudaiya ejamaanudaiya sukaseythi visaarikkath thaaveethu vanaantharaththilirunthu aadka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'lpearil avar see'rinaar.

antha manusharoa engka'lukku mikavum upakaarika'laayirunthaarka'l; naangka'l ve'lika'lil irukkumpoathu, avarka'l engka'lidaththil nadamaadina naa'lellaam avarka'l engka'lai varuththappaduththinathumillai; namathu poru'lil on'rum kaa'naama'r poanathumillai.
naangka'l aaduka'lai meayththu, avarka'lidaththil iruntha naa'lellaam avarka'l iravumpakalum engka'laich sut'rilum mathilaayirunthaarka'l.

ippoathum neer seyyavea'ndiyathaik kavaniththuppaarum; nammudaiya ejamaan mealum, avarudaiya veettaar yaavarmealum, nichchayamaay oru pollaappu varuki'rathaayirukki'rathu; ivaroa, oruvarum thammoadea peasakkoodaathapadikku, pealiyaa'lin makanaayirukki'raar en'raan.

appozhuthu apikaayil theeviramaay irunoo'ru appangka'laiyum, ira'ndu thuruththi thiraadcharasaththaiyum, samaiyalpa'n'nappatta ainthu aaduka'laiyum, ainthu padi va'ruththa payat'raiyum, vat'ralaakkappatta noo'ru thiraadchakkulaika'laiyum, vat'ralaana irunoo'ru aththippazha adaika'laiyum eduththu, kazhuthaika'lmeal eat'ri,
than vealaikkaararaip paarththu: neengka'l enakku munnea poangka'l; ithoa, naan ungka'l pinnea varuki'rean en'ru solli anuppinaa'l; than purushanaakiya naapaalukku athai a'rivikkavillai.
ava'l oru kazhuthaiyinmeal ea'ri, malaiyin ma'raivil i'rangkivarukaiyil, ithoa, thaaveethum avan manusharum ava'lukku ethiraaka i'rangkivanthaarka'l; avarka'laich santhiththaa'l.

thaaveethu than janangka'lai noakki: avanukku vanaantharaththil irukki'rathaiyellaam vee'naakavea kaappaat'rinean; avanukku u'ndaanathilellaam on'rum kaa'naama'rpoanathillai; en'raalum nanmaikkup pathilaaka avan enakkuth theemai seythaan.

avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'rilum suvaril neervidum oru naayaimuthalaayp pozhuthuvidiyumattum naan uyiroadea vaiththaal, theavan thaaveethin saththurukka'lukku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyyakkadavar en'ru solliyirunthaan.
apikaayil thaaveethaik kaa'nkaiyil, theeviramaayk kazhuthaiyai vittu i'rangki, thaaveethukku nearaakath tharaiyil mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu pa'ninthu,

avan paathaththilea vizhunthu: en aa'ndavanea, inthap paathakam enmeal sumarattum; ummudaiya adiyaa'ludaiya vaarththaika'lai neer keadkumporuttaaka ummudaiya adiyaa'l umathu sevikeadkap peasavea'ndum.

en aa'ndavanaakiya neer naapaal ennum inthap pealiyaa'lin manushanai oru poruttaaka e'n'navea'ndaam; avan peyar eppadiyoa appadiyea avanum irukki'raan; avan peyar naapaal, avanukkup payiththiyamum irukki'rathu; ummudaiya adiyaa'laakiya naanoa, en aa'ndavan anuppina vaaliparaik kaa'navillai.

ippoathum en aa'ndavanea, neer iraththam sintha varavum, ummudaiya kai neethiyaich sarikkattavum, karththar umakku idangkodukkavillai enpathaik karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum, ummudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum solluki'rean; ippoathum ummudaiya saththurukka'lum, en aa'ndavanukku viroathamaakap pollaapputh theaduki'ravarka'lum, naapaalaippoala aakakkadavarka'l.
ippoathum umathu adiyaa'l en aa'ndavanukkuk ko'nduvantha kaa'nikkaiyai eat'rukko'ndu, en aa'ndavanaip pinpat'ruki'ra vaaliparukkuk koduppeeraaka.

umathu adiyaa'lin paathakaththai manniyum, karththar en aa'ndavanukku nilaiyaana veettai nichchayamaayk kattuvaar; en aa'ndavan karththarudaiya yuththangka'lai nadaththuki'ravaraamea; neer uyiroadea irukkum naa'lil oru pollaappum ummilea kaa'nappadaathiruppathaaka.

ummaith thunpappaduththavum, ummudaiya piraa'nanai vaangka vakaitheadavum, oru manushan ezhumpinaalum en aa'ndavanudaiya aaththumaa ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin aatharavil irukki'ra jeevanu'l'loarudaiya kattilea kattappattirukkum; ummudaiya saththurukka'lin aaththumaakka'loa kava'nil vaiththu e'rinthaa'rpoala e'riyappattuppoam.
karththar ummaikku'riththuch sonna nanmaiyinpadi ellaam ini en aa'ndavanukkuch seythu, isravealukku athipathiyaaka ummai neamikkum poathu,

neer viruthaavaay iraththam sinthaamalum, en aa'ndavanaakiya neer pazhivaangkaamalum irunthathu'ndaanaal, appozhuthu en aa'ndavanaakiya umakkuth thukkamum iraathu, mana ida'ralum iraathu; karththar en aa'ndavanukku nanmai seyyumpoathu, ummudaiya adiyaa'lai ninaippeeraaka en'raa'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethu apikaayilai noakki: unnai in'raiyathinam ennaich santhikka anuppina isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram.

nee solliya yoasanai aaseervathikkappaduvathaaka; naan iraththam sintha varaathapadikkum, en kaiyea pazhivaangkaathapadikkum, nee in'raiyathinam enakkuth thadai pa'n'ninapadiyinaal, neeyum aaseervathikkappaduvaayaaka.

nee theeviramaay ennaich santhikka varaamal irunthaayaanaal, pozhuthu vidiyumattum naapaalukku oru naayum uyiroadea vaikkappaduvathillai en'ru, unakkup pollaappuch seyya enakku idangkodaathirukki'ra isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin jeevanaikko'ndu meyyaaych solluki'rean en'ru solli,

ava'l thanakkuk ko'nduvanthathaith thaaveethu ava'l kaiyilea vaangkikko'ndu, ava'laip paarththu: nee samaathaanaththoadea un veettukkup poa; ithoa, naan un sollaikkeattu, un mukaththaip paarththu, ippadich seythean en'raan.

apikaayil naapaalidaththil vanthapoathu, ithoa, raajavirunthukku oppaana virunthu avan veettilea nadanthathu; avan iruthayam ka'liththirunthathu; avan mikavum ve'riththumirunthaan; aakaiyaal pozhuthu vidiyumattum si'riya kaariyamaanaalum periya kaariyamaanaalum, on'raiyum avanukku a'rivikkavillai.
pozhuthu vidinthu, naapaalin ve'ri the'linthapinpu, avan manaivi intha varththamaanangka'lai avanukku a'riviththaa'l; appozhuthu avan iruthayam avanukku'l'lea seththu, avan kallaippoalaanaan.
karththar naapaalai vaathiththathinaal, ea'rakku'raiyap paththu naa'lukkuppinpu, avan seththaan.

naapaal seththuppoanaan en'ru thaaveethu kea'lvippattapoathu: en ninthaiyin vazhakkai naapaalin kaiyil visaariththu, thammudaiya adiyaanaip pollaappuch seyyaathapadikkuth thaduththa karththarukku sthoaththiram; karththar thaamea naapaalin pollaappai avan thalaiyinmeal thirumpappa'n'ninaar en'ru solli, apikaayilai vivaakampa'n'nuki'ratha'rkaaka ava'loadea peasa, thaaveethu aadka'lai anuppinaan.
thaaveethin oozhiyakkaarar karmealil irukki'ra apikaayila'ndaikku vanthu, thaaveethu unnai vivaakampa'n'na manathaay, engka'lai unnidaththil anuppinaar en'ru ava'loadea solluki'rapoathu,
ava'l ezhunthirunthu, tharaimattum mukangkuninthu, ithoa, naan en aa'ndavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararin kaalka'laik kazhuvaththakka pa'nividaikkaariyaakiya avarudaiya adiyaa'l en'raa'l.
pinpu apikaayil theeviriththu ezhunthu, oru kazhuthaiyinmeal ea'ri, ainthu thaathip pe'nka'laik koottikko'ndu, thaaveethin sthaanaapathika'lukkup pinsen'ru poay, avanukku manaiviyaanaa'l.
yesrayeal ooraa'laakiya akinoavaamaiyum thaaveethu vivaakampa'n'ninaan; avarka'l iruvarum avanukku manaivika'laanaarka'l.
savul thaaveethin manaiviyaakiya meekaa'l ennum than kumaaraththiyaik kaaleem ooraanaakiya laayeesin kumaaranaana palththikkuk koduththirunthaan.
pinpu seepooraar kipiyaavilirukki'ra savulidaththil vanthu: thaaveethu eshimoanukku ethiraana aakilaameattil o'liththukko'ndirukki'raan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu savul: seepvanaantharaththilea thaaveethaith theadumpadi ezhunthu, isravealilea therinthuko'l'lappatta moovaayiram pearoadungkooda, seep vanaantharaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaan.

savul eshimoanukku ethirea vazhiya'ndaiyilirukki'ra aakilaameattilea paa'layami'rangkinaan; thaaveethu vanaantharaththil thangki, savul thannaith thodarnthu vanaantharaththi'rku varuki'rathaik ka'ndu,
thaaveethu veavukaararai anuppi, savul vanthathu nichchayam en'ru a'rinthuko'ndaan.

pinpu thaaveethu ezhunthu, savul paa'layami'rangkina idaththi'rkup poay, savulum nearin kumaaranaakiya apnear ennum avan padaiththalaivanum paduththukko'ndirukki'ra idaththaip paarththaan; savul irathangka'lirukki'ra idaththilea paduththukko'ndirunthaan; janangka'l avanaich sut'rilum paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l.

thaaveethu eaththiyanaakiya akimeleakkaiyum, seruyaavin kumaaranum yoavaapin sakoatharanumaakiya apisaayaiyum paarththu: ennoadeakoodach savulidaththi'rkup paa'layaththil i'rangkivaruki'ravan yaar en'ratha'rku, apisaay: naan ummoadeakooda varuki'rean en'raan.

appadiyea thaaveethum apisaayum iraaththiriyilea antha janangka'lukku'l'lea vanthaarka'l; ithoa, savul irathangka'lirukki'ra idaththilea paduththu niththiraipa'n'ninaan; avan thalaimaattil avanudaiya eetti nilaththilea kuththiyirunthathu; avanaich sut'rilum apnearum janangka'lum paduththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu apisaay thaaveethaip paarththu: in'ru theavan ummudaiya saththuruvai ummudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; ippoathum naan avanai eettiyinaal ira'ndu kuththaakak kuththaamal, orea kuththaaka nilaththil uruvak kuththattumaa en'raan.
thaaveethu apisaayaip paarththu: avaraik kollaathea; karththar apisheakam pa'n'nuviththavarmeal than kaiyaip poattu, kut'ramillaama'rpoaki'ravan yaar? en'ru sonnaan.
pinnum thaaveethu: karththar avarai adiththu, allathu avarudaiya kaalam vanthu, avar mariththu, allathu avar yuththaththi'rkuppoay maa'ndaalozhiya,

naan en kaiyaik karththar apisheakampa'n'nuviththavarmeal poadaathapadikku, karththar ennaik kaakkakkadavar en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; ippoathum avar thalaimaattil irukki'ra eettiyaiyum, tha'n'neerch sempaiyum eduththukko'ndu poavoam en'raan.

thaaveethu savulin thalaimaattil iruntha eettiyaiyum, tha'n'neerchsempaiyum eduththukko'ndapinpu, pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; athai oruvarum kaa'navillai, a'riyavumillai, oruvarum vizhiththukko'l'lavumillai; karththar avarka'lukku ayarntha niththirai varuviththathinaal, avarka'lellaarum thoongkinaarka'l.
thaaveethu kadanthu, anthap pakkaththi'rkup poay, thangka'lukkum avarka'lukkum naduvea poantha idamu'ndaaka, thooraththilirukki'ra malaiyin kodumudiyilea,
janangka'lukkum nearin kumaaranaakiya apnearukkum nearaaka nin'ru kooppittu: apnearea, uththaravu sollamaatteeraa en'raan; atha'rku apnear: raajaavukku nearaakak kookkuraliduki'ra nee yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu apnearai noakki: neer veeran allavaa? isravealil umakkuch sariyaanavan yaar? pinnai neer ummudaiya aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavaik kaakkaama'r poanathenna? janaththil oruvan ummudaiya aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavaik kollumpadi vanthirunthaanea.

neer seytha inthak kaariyam nallathalla; karththar apisheakampa'n'nina ungka'l aa'ndavanai neengka'l kaakkaama'r poanapadiyinaal, neengka'l mara'naththi'rkup paaththiravaanka'l; ippoathum raajaavin thalaimaattil iruntha avarudaiya eettiyum tha'n'neerch sempum engkea en'ru paarum en'raan.

appozhuthu savul: thaaveethin saththaththai a'rinthu, en kumaaranaakiya thaaveethea, ithu un saththamallavaa en'raan. atha'rkuth thaaveethu: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, ithu en saththanthaan en'ru solli,
pinnum: en aa'ndavanaakiya neer ummudaiya adiyaanai ippadip pinthodaruki'rathu enna? naan enna seythean? ennidaththil enna pollaappu irukki'rathu?

ippozhuthu raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan thammudaiya adiyaanudaiya vaarththaika'laik keadpaaraaka; karththar ummai enakku viroathamaaka eduththu vittathu'ndaanaal, atha'rku avar kaa'nikkaiyai eat'rukko'lvaaraaka; manupuththirar athaich seythaarka'leayaakil, avarka'l karththarukku munpaakach sapikkappadakkadavarka'l; avarka'l: nee poay; anniya theavarka'laich seavi en'ru solli, avarka'l in'ru ennaik karththarudaiya suthantharaththi'rku aduththavanaayiraathapadikku, thuraththivittaarka'lea.

ippoathum karththarudaiya samukaththil en iraththam tharaiyil vizhaathiruppathaaka; malaika'lil oru kavuthaariyai veattaiyaaduki'rathupoala, isravealin raajaa oru the'l'luppoochchiyaith theadavanthaaroa en'raan.

appozhuthu savul: naan paavagnseythean; en kumaaranaakiya thaaveethea, thirumpivaa; en jeevan in'raiyathinam un paarvaikku arumaiyaayirunthapadiyaal, ini unakku oru pollaappugn seyyean; ithoa, naan mathiyat'ravanaay makaa periya thappithagnseythean en'raan.
atha'rkuth thaaveethu: ithoa, raajaavin eetti ingkea irukki'rathu; vaaliparil oruvan ippu'ram vanthu, athai vaangkik ko'ndupoakattum.

karththar avanavanukku avanavan neethikkum u'nmaikkum thakkathaakap palan a'lippaaraaka; in'ru karththar ummai en kaiyil oppukkoduththirunthum, karththar apisheakampa'n'ninavarmeal, en kaiyai neetta manathillaathirunthean.

ithoa, ummudaiya jeevan in'raiyathinam en paarvaikku eppadi arumaiyaayirunthathoa, appadiyea en jeevanum karththarin paarvaikku arumaiyaayiruppathinaal, avar ennai ellaa upaththiravaththi'rkum neengkalaakki viduvaaraaka en'raan.

appozhuthu savul thaaveethai noakki: en kumaaranaakiya thaaveethea, nee aaseervathikkappattavan; nee periya kaariyangka'laich seyvaay, meanmealum palappaduvaay en'raan; appadiyea thaaveethu than vazhiyea poanaan; savulum than sthaanaththi'rkuth thirumpinaan.

pinpu thaaveethu: naan entha naa'lilaakilum orunaa'l savulin kaiyinaal madinthupoavean; inich savul isravealin ellaika'lil engkeayaavathu ennaik ka'ndupidikkalaam enki'ra nampikkai at'ruppoakumpadikkum, naan avan kaikku neengkalaayirukkumpadikkum, naan pelistharin theasaththi'rkup poay, thappiththukko'lvathaippaarkkilum nalamaana kaariyam vea'rillai en'ru than iruthayaththil yoasiththaan.
aakaiyaal thaaveethu thannoadiruntha a'runoo'rupearoadungkooda ezhunthirunthu, maayoakin kumaaranaakiya aakees ennum kaaththin raajaavinidaththil poaych searnthaan.

angkea thaaveethum, avan manusharum, avaravar veettaarum, thaaveethoadeakooda avan ira'ndu manaivika'laakiya yesrayeal ooraa'laakiya akinoavaamum; naapaalin manaiviyaayiruntha karmeal ooraa'laakiya apikaayilum, kaathpatta'naththil aakeesidaththil thangkiyirunthaarka'l.
thaaveethu kaathpatta'naththi'rku oadippoanaan en'ru savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan appu'ram avanaith theadavillai.

thaaveethu aakeesai noakki: ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayai kidaikkumaanaal, naan vaasampa'n'numpadi naattilu'l'la oorka'lilea on'ril enakku idanthaarum; ummudaiya adiyaan ummoadeakooda raajathaani patta'naththilea vaasamaayiruppaanean en'raan.
appozhuthu aakees: an'raiyathinam siklaakai avanukkuk koduththaan; athinimiththam siklaak innaa'lvaraikkum yoothaavin raajaakka'laich searnthirukki'rathu.
thaaveethu pelistharin naattilea oru varushamum naalu maathamum kudiyirunthaan.

angkeayirunthu thaaveethum avan manusharum kesooriyarmealum kesriyarmealum amaleakkiyarmealum padaiyeduththuppoanaarka'l; soorukkup poaki'ra ellaithuvakki ekipthutheasamattum irukki'ra naattilea poorvakaalam thuvakkik kudiyirunthavarka'l ivarka'lea.

thaaveethu antha naattaik ko'l'laiyadikki'rapoathu, purusharka'laiyum sthireeka'laiyum uyiroadea vaikkaamal, aadumaaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum ottakangka'laiyum vasthirangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, aakeesidaththukkuth thirumpivaruvaan.
in'ru eththisaiyil poayk ko'l'laiyadiththeerka'l en'ru aakees keadkumpoathu, thaaveethu: yoothaavudaiya thenthisaiyilum, yeraamiyealarudaiya thenthisaiyilum, keaniyarudaiya thenthisaiyilum enpaan.

inna innapadi thaaveethu seythaan en'ru thangka'lukku viroathamaana seythiyai a'rivikkaththakka oruvaraiyum thaaveethu kaathpatta'naththi'rkuk ko'ndu varaathapadikku, oru purushanaiyaakilum sthireeyaiyaakilum uyiroadea vaikkaathiruppaan; avan pelistharin naattuppu'raththilea kudiyirukki'ra naa'lellaam ivva'n'nam seythuko'nduvanthaan.
aakees thaaveethai nampi: avan isravealaraakiya thannudaiya janangka'l thannai ve'rukkumpadi seyki'raan; en'raikkum avan en oozhiyakkaaranaayiruppaan enpaan.

annaadka'lilea pelisthar isravealinmeal yuththampa'n'na, thangka'l seanaika'laip poarukkuk koottinaarka'l; appozhuthu aakees thaaveethai noakki: neeyum un manusharum evvithaththilum ennoadeakooda yuththaththukku varavea'ndum en'ru a'riyakkadavaay en'raan.

thaaveethu aakeesaip paarththu: ummudaiya adiyaan seyyappoaki'rathai neer nichchayamaay a'rinthuko'lveer en'raan; appozhuthu aakees thaaveethai noakki: itha'rkaaka unnai ennaa'lum enakku meykaavalanaaka vaippean en'raan.

saamuveal itha'rku munnamea mariththuppoanaan; isravealar ellaarum avanukkuth thukkangko'ndaadi, avan ooraakiya raamaavilea avanai adakkam pa'n'ninaarka'l. savul agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum theasaththil iraathapadikkuth thuraththivittaan.
pelisthar koodivanthu, sooneamilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; savulum isravealar ellaaraiyum koottinaan; avarka'l kilpoavaavilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
savul pelistharin paa'layaththaik ka'ndapoathu payanthaan; avan iruthayam mikavum thaththa'liththukko'ndirunthathu.
savul karththaridaththil visaarikkumpoathu, karththar avanukkuch soppanangka'linaalaavathu, ooreeminaalaavathu, theerkkatharisika'linaalaavathu ma'ruuththaravu aru'lavillai.

appozhuthu savul than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: agnchanampaarkki'ra oru sthireeyaith theadungka'l; naan ava'lidaththil poay visaarippean en'raan; atha'rku avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar: ithoa, enthoaril agnchanampaarkki'ra oru sthiree irukki'raa'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu savul veasham maa'ri, vea'ru vasthiram thariththukko'ndu, avanum avanoadeakooda ira'ndupearum iraaththiriyilea antha sthireeyinidaththil poaych searnthaarka'l; ava'lai avan noakki: nee agnchanampaarththu enakkuk ku'risolli, naan unnidaththil solluki'ravanai ezhumpivarachsey en'raan.

atha'rku antha sthiree: savul agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laiyum, ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum, theasaththil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaakkina seythiyai neer a'riveerea; ennaik kon'rupoadumpadi neer en piraa'nanukkuk ka'n'nivaikki'rathu enna en'raa'l.
appozhuthu savul: inthak kaariyaththi'rkaaka unakkup pollaappu varaathu enpathaik karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru ava'lukkuk karththarmeal aa'naiyittaan.
appozhuthu antha sthiree: umakku naan yaarai ezhumpivarappa'n'navea'ndum en'ratha'rku, avan: saamuvealai ezhumpivarappa'n'navea'ndum en'raan.
antha sthiree saamuvealaik ka'ndamaaththiraththil makaa saththamaayk kooppittu, savulai noakki: ean ennai moasampoakkineer? neerthaan savulaachchuthea en'raa'l.

raajaa ava'laip paarththu: nee payappadaathea; nee kaa'nki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan. atha'rku antha sthiree: theavarka'l poomikku'l'lirunthu ea'rivaruki'rathaik kaa'nki'rean en'ru savulukkuch sonnaa'l.

avarudaiya roopam enna en'ru ava'laik keattaan. atha'rku ava'l: saalvaiyaip poarththukko'ndirukki'ra oru muthirntha vayathaana manushan ezhumpivaruki'raan en'raa'l; athinaalea savul avan saamuveal en'ru a'rinthuko'ndu, tharaimattum mukangkuninthu va'nangkinaan.

saamuveal savulai noakki: nee ennai ezhumpivarappa'n'ni, ennaik kalaiththathu enna en'ru keattaan. atha'rkuch savul: naan mikavum nerukkappattirukki'rean; pelisthar enakku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; theavanum ennaik kaivittaar; avar theerkkatharisika'linaalaavathu, soppanangka'linaalaavathu enakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'luki'rathillai; aakaiyaal naan seyyavea'ndiyathai neer enakku a'rivikkumpadikku, ummai azhaippiththean en'raan.
atha'rkuch saamuveal: karththar unnaivittu vilaki, unakkuch saththuruvaay irukkumpoathu, nee ennidaththil keadpaanean?
karththar ennaikko'ndu sonnapadiyea seythu mudiththu, raajyaththai un kaiyilirunthu pa'riththu, athai un thoazhanaakiya thaaveethukkuk koduththuvittaar.
nee karththarudaiya so'rkea'laamalum, amaleakkinmeal avarukku iruntha koapaththin ukkiraththaith theerkkaamalum poanapadiyinaal, karththar in'raiyathinam unakku inthappirakaaramaakach seythaar.

karththar unnudaiya janamaakiya isravealaraiyum pelisthar kaiyil oppuk koduppaar; naa'laikku neeyum un kumaararum ennoadiruppeerka'l; isravealin paa'layaththaiyum karththar pelistharin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raan.

anthaksha'namea savul nedithaangkidaiyaayth tharaiyilea vizhunthu, saamuvealin vaarththaika'linaalea mikavum payappattaan; avan iraappakal muzhuthum on'rum saappidaathirunthapadiyinaal, avan palaveenamaayirunthaan.

appozhuthu antha sthiree savulidaththil vanthu, avan mikavum kalangkiyirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, avanai noakki: ithoa, ummudaiya adiyaa'laakiya naan ummudaiya so'rkeattu, en piraa'nanai en kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, neer enakkuch sonna ummudaiya vaarththaika'lukkuk keezhppadinthean.

ippozhuthu neer ummudaiya adiyaa'ludaiya sollaik kea'lum, naan umakku munpaakak kogncham appam vaikki'rean, athaip pusippeeraaka; appozhuthu neer vazhinadanthu poakaththakka pelan umakku'l irukkum en'raa'l.

avanoa thattuthalpa'n'ni, naan pusikkamaattean en'raan; aanaalum avanudaiya oozhiyakkaararum antha sthireeyum avanai mikavum varunthikko'ndathinaal, avan avarka'l so'rkeattu, tharaiyilirunthu ezhunthirunthu kattilinmeal udkaarnthaan.
antha sthireeyinidaththil kozhuththa kan'rukkutti on'ru veettil irunthathu; athaith theeviramaay adiththu, maa eduththup pisainthu, athaip pu'lippillaa appangka'laakach suttu,
savulukkum avan oozhiyakkaararukkum munpaakak ko'nduvanthu vaiththaa'l; avarka'l pusiththu ezhunthirunthu, antha iraaththiriyileayea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
pelisthar thangka'l seanaika'laiyellaam aappekkilea koodivarachseythaarka'l; isravealar yesrayealilirukki'ra thurava'ndaiyilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu pelistharin athipathika'l noo'rum aayiramumaana searvaika'loadea poanaarka'l; thaaveethum avan manusharum aakeesoadea pintha'ndilea poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu pelistharin pirapukka'l: intha epireyar ennaththi'rku en'raarka'l; aakees avarka'laip paarththu: isravealin raajaavaakiya savulin oozhiyakkaaranaayiruntha inthath thaaveethu iththanai naadka'lum iththanai varushangka'lum ennoadu irukkavillaiyaa? ivan ennidaththil vanthu searntha naa'lmuthal innaa'lvaraikkum oru kut'ramum naan ivanil ka'ndupidikkavillai en'raan.

athanaal pelistharin pirapukka'l avanmeal kadungkoapamaaki, avanaip paarththu: intha manushan neer ku'riththa than idaththi'rkuth thirumpippoakumpadikku, angkea avanai ma'rupadiyum anuppividum; yuththaththil ivan namakkuch saththuruvaayiraathapadikku, ivan nammoadea kooda yuththaththi'rku varavea'ndiyathillai; ivan ethinaalea than aa'ndavanoadea oppuravaavaan? intha manusharudaiya thalaika'linaal allavaa?
savul kon'rathu aayiram, thaaveethu kon'rathu pathinaayiram en'ru inthath thaaveethaikku'riththu allavoa aadippaadich sonnaarka'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu aakees thaaveethai azhaiththu: nee uththaman en'rum, nee paa'layaththil ennoadea poakkum varaththumaayirukki'rathu en paarvaikku nallathu en'rum, karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; nee ennidaththil vanthu searntha naa'lmuthal in'raiyavaraikkum naan unnil oru pollaappum kaa'navillai; aakilum pirapukka'lin paarvaikku nee piriyamaanavan alla.
aakaiyaal pelistharudaiya pirapukka'l unmeal thaangkal adaiyaathapadikku, ippoathu samaathaanaththoadea thirumpip poayvidu en'raan.

thaaveethu aakeesai noakki: ean? naan seythathu enna? naan vanthu, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya saththurukka'loadea yuththampa'n'naathapadikku, naan ummidaththil vantha naa'lmutha'rko'ndu in'raiyavaraikkum umathu adiyeanidaththil ka'ndupidiththathu enna en'raan.

aakees thaaveethukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: athai a'rivean; nee theavanudaiya thoothanaippoala en paarvaikkup piriyamaanavan; aanaalum ivan engka'loadeakooda yuththaththi'rku varakkoodaathu en'ru pelistharin pirapukka'l solluki'raarka'l.
ippoathum nee naa'lai athikaalaiyil unnoadea vantha un aa'ndavanudaiya vealaikkaararaik koottikko'ndu, vidiya'rkaalaththilea ve'lichchamaaki'rapoathu, pu'rappattuppoa en'raan.

appadiyea thaaveethu athikaalaiyil than manusharaik koottikko'ndu, pozhuthuvidiki'ra nearaththilea, pelistharin theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoakap pu'rappattaan; pelistharoavenil yesrayealukkup poanaarka'l.

thaaveethum avan manusharum moon'raam naa'lilea, siklaakukku vanthu searuki'ratha'rku'l'lea, amaleakkiyar thenpu'raththuch seemaiyinmealum siklaakinmealum vizhunthu, siklaakaik ko'l'laiyadiththu, athai akkiniyaal sutteriththu,
athiliruntha sthireeka'laakiya si'riyavarka'laiyum periyavarka'laiyum si'raipidiththu, oruvaraiyum kon'rupoadaamal, avarka'laip pidiththukko'ndu, thangka'l vazhiyea poayvittaarka'l.

thaaveethum avan manusharum anthap patta'naththi'rku vanthapoathu, ithoa, athu akkiniyinaal sutterikkappattathu en'rum, thangka'l manaivika'lum thangka'l kumaararum thangka'l kumaaraththika'lum si'raipidiththuk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l en'rum ka'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethum avanoadiruntha janangka'lum azhuki'ratha'rkuth thangka'lil pelanillaamal poakumattum saththamittu azhuthaarka'l.
thaaveethin ira'ndu manaivika'laakiya yesrayeal ooraa'laana akinoavaamum, karmeal ooraa'laana naapaalin manaiviyaayiruntha apikaayilum, si'raipidiththuk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.

thaaveethu mikavum nerukkappattaan; sakala janangka'lum thangka'l kumaarar kumaaraththika'linimiththam manakkileasamaanathinaal, avanaik kalle'riyavea'ndum en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l; thaaveethu than theavanaakiya karththarukku'l'lea thannaith thidappaduththikko'ndaan.
thaaveethu akimeleakkin kumaaranaakiya apiyaththaar ennum aasaariyanai noakki: eapoaththai ennidaththil ko'nduvaa en'raan; apiyaththaar eapoaththaith thaaveethinidaththil ko'nduvanthaan.

thaaveethu karththarai noakki: naan anthath tha'ndaip pinthodaravea'ndumaa? athaip pidippeanaa? en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avar: athaip pinthodar; athai nee pidiththu, sakalaththaiyum thiruppikko'lvaay en'raar.
appozhuthu thaaveethum avanoadiruntha a'runoo'rupearum poanaarka'l; avarka'l peasoar aat'ra'ndaikku vanthapoathu angkea silar nin'rupoanaarka'l.
thaaveethoa, naanoo'rupearoadungkoodath thodarnthupoanaan; irunoo'rupear vidaayththuppoanapadiyinaal peasoar aat'raik kadakkamaattaamal nin'rupoanaarka'l.
oru ekipthiyanai ve'liyil avarka'l ka'ndu, avanaith thaaveethinidaththil ko'nduvanthu, pusikka avanukku appamum kudikkath tha'n'neerum koduththu,

aththippazha adaiyin oru thu'ndaiyum, vat'ralaana ira'ndu thiraadchappazhak kulaika'laiyum avanukkuk koduththaarka'l; athai avan saappitta pinpu, avanudaiya uyir thirumpa avanukku'l vanthathu. avan iraappakal moon'runaa'laay appam saappidaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum irunthaan.

thaaveethu avanai noakki: nee yaarudaiyavan? nee evvidaththaan en'ru keattatha'rku, avan: naan oru amaleakkiyanudaiya vealaikkaaranaakiya ekipthutheasaththup pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan; moon'ru naa'laikkumun naan viyaathippattapoathu, en ejamaan ennaik kaivittaan.
naangka'l kireaththiyarudaiya thenpu'raththinmealum, yoothaavukkaduththa ellaiyinmealum, kaaleapudaiya thenpu'raththinmealum, padaiyeduththuppoay siklaakai akkiniyinaal sutteriththuppoattoam en'raan.

thaaveethu avanai noakki: nee ennai anthath tha'ndinidaththukkuk ko'ndu poavaayaa en'ru keattatha'rku: avan, neer ennaik kon'rupoaduvathumillai, ennai en ejamaan kaiyil oppukkoduppathumillai en'ru theavanmeal aa'naiyiduveeraanaal, ummai anthath tha'ndinidaththukkuk koottikko'ndupoavean en'raan.

ivan avanaik ko'ndupoay vittapoathu, ithoa, avarka'l ve'liyengkum paravi, pusiththuk kudiththu, thaangka'l pelisthar theasaththilum yoothaatheasaththilum ko'l'laiyittuvantha makaa perithaana antha ellaak ko'l'laikkaakavum aadippaadikko'ndirunthaarka'l.

avarka'laith thaaveethu an'ru saayangkaalanthodangki ma'runaa'l saayangkaalamattum mu'riya adiththaan; ottakangka'lmeal ea'ri oadippoana naanoo'ru vaalipar thavira, avarka'lil vea'roruvarum thappavillai.
amaleakkiyar pidiththukko'ndupoana ellaavat'raiyum, thannudaiya ira'ndu manaivika'laiyum, thaaveethu viduviththaan.
avarka'l ko'l'laiyaadikko'ndupoana ellaavat'rilum, si'riyathilum periyathilum, kumaararilum, kumaaraththika'lilum, on'rum ku'raipadaamal ellaavat'raiyum thaaveethu thiruppikko'ndaan.
ellaa aadumaaduka'laiyum thaaveethu pidiththukko'ndaan; avaika'laith thangka'l mirukajeevanka'lukku munnaalea oatti, ithu thaaveethin ko'l'lai en'raarka'l.

vidaayththuppoanathinaalea thaaveethukkup pinsellaamal, peasoar aat'ra'ndaiyilea thangkiyiruntha irunoo'rupearidaththukkuth thaaveethu varuki'rapoathu, ivarka'l thaaveethukkum avanoadiruntha janaththi'rkum ethirko'ndu vanthaarka'l; thaaveethu antha janaththinidaththil searnthu, avarka'l sukaseythiyai visaariththaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethoadea nadanthu vantha manusharil pollaathavarka'lum pealiyaa'lin makka'lumaana ellaarum: avarka'l engka'loadea varaathapadiyinaal naangka'l thiruppikko'nda ko'l'laiyudaimaika'lil avarka'lukku on'rum koduppathillai; avarka'lil ovvoruvanum thanthan manaiviyaiyum thanthan pi'l'laika'laiyumea azhaiththukko'ndu poakattum en'raarka'l.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu: en sakoathararea, karththar namakkuth thanthathai neengka'l ippadich seyyavea'ndaam; karththar nammaik kaappaat'ri, namakku viroathamaay vanthiruntha anthath tha'ndai nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

inthak kaariyaththil ungka'l so'rkeadka yaar sammathippaan? yuththaththi'rkup poanavarka'lin pangku evva'lavoa, avva'lavu rasthukka'la'ndaiyil irunthavarka'lukkum pangkuveetham kidaikkavea'ndum; saripangkaakap pangkiduvaarka'laaka en'raan.
appadiyea annaa'lmutha'rko'ndu nadanthuvaruki'rathu; athai isravealilea innaa'lvaraikkum irukkum katta'laiyum piramaa'namumaaka ea'rpaduththinaan.

thaaveethu siklaakukku vanthapoathu, avan ko'l'laiyaadinavaika'lilea than sineakitharaakiya yoothaavin moopparukkuch silavat'rai anuppi: ithoa, karththarudaiya saththurukka'lin ko'l'laiyil ungka'lukku u'ndaayirukkum aaseervaatha paakam en'ru sollachsonnaan.
yaaryaarukku anuppinaanen'raal, peththealil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, the'rkaana raamoaththil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, yaaththeeril irukki'ravarka'lukkum,
aaroavearil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, sipmoaththil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, esthemoavaavil irukki'ravarka'lukkum,
raakkaalil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, yeraamiyealiyarin patta'nangka'lil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, keaniyarin patta'nangka'lil irukki'ravarka'lukkum,
ormaavil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, koraasaanil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, aat'raakil irukki'ravarka'lukkum,
eproanil irukki'ravarka'lukkum, thaaveethum avan manusharum nadamaadina ellaa idangka'lil irukki'ravarka'lukkum anuppinaan.
pelisthar isravealaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; isravealar pelistharukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadi, kilpoavaa malaiyilea vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.
pelisthar savulaiyum avan kumaararaiyum nerungkith thodarnthu, savulin kumaararaakiya yoanaththaanaiyum apinathaapaiyum malkisookaavaiyum vettippoattaarka'l.
savulukku viroathamaay yuththam palaththathu; vilveerar avanaik ka'ndu nerungkinaarka'l; appozhuthu savul vilveeraraal mikavum kaayappattu,

than aayuthathaariyai noakki: antha viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'l vanthu, ennaik kuththippoattu, ennai avamaanappaduththaathapadikku, nee un pattayaththai uruvi, ennaik kuththippoadu en'raan; avanudaiya aayuthathaari mikavum payappattathinaal, appadich seyyamaattean en'raan; appozhuthu savul pattayaththai nattu athinmeal vizhunthaan.
savul seththuppoanathai avan aayuthathaari ka'ndapoathu, avanum than pattayaththinmeal vizhunthu, avanoadeakoodach seththuppoanaan.
appadiyea an'raiyathinam savulum, avan moon'ru kumaararum, avan aayuthathaariyum, avanudaiya ellaa manusharum orumikkach seththuppoanaarka'l.

isravealar mu'rinthoadinaarka'l en'rum, savulum avan kumaararum seththup poanaarka'l en'rum, pa'l'laththaakkukku ippaalum yoarthaanukku ippaalum iruntha isravealar ka'ndapoathu, avarka'l patta'nangka'lai vittu oadippoanaarka'l; appozhuthu pelisthar vanthu, avaika'lilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
vettu'ndavarka'lai urinthuko'l'la, pelisthar ma'runaa'l vanthapoathu, avarka'l, savulum avan moon'ru kumaararum kilpoavaa malaiyilea vizhunthu kidakki'rathaik ka'ndu,

avan thalaiyai vetti, avan aayuthangka'lai eduththukko'ndu, thangka'l vikkirakangka'lin koavilka'lilum janangka'lukku'l'lum seythiyaip pirasiththappaduththumpadi, avaika'laip pelisthar theasaththilea sut'rilum anuppi,
avan aayuthangka'lai astharoath theavanudaiya koavililea vaiththu, avan udalaip pethsaanin alangkaththilea thookkippoattaarka'l.
pelisthar savulukkuch seythathaik keeleayaaththeasaththu yaapeas patta'naththaar keattapoathu,

avarka'lilea palasaalika'l ellaarum ezhunthu iraamuzhuthum nadanthupoay, pethsaanin alangkaththiliruntha savulin udalaiyum avan kumaararin udalka'laiyum eduththu, yaapeasukkuk ko'nduvanthu, avaika'lai angkea thakanam pa'n'ni,
avarka'ludaiya elumpuka'lai eduththu, yaapeasilirukki'ra thoappilea adakkampa'n'ni, eazhunaa'l upavaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
savul mariththapinpu, thaaveethu amaleakkiyarai mu'riya adiththu, siklaakukkuth thirumpivanthu, ira'ndunaa'l angkea irunthapi'rpaadu,

moon'raam naa'lilea oru manushan savulin paa'layaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, than thalaiyinmeal puzhuthiyaip poattuk ko'ndu, thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, tharaiyilea vizhunthu va'nangkinaan.
thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: nee engkeayirunthu vanthaay en'ru keattatha'rku, avan: isravealin paa'layaththilirunthu thappivanthean en'raan.

thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: nadantha seythi enna? sol en'ru keattatha'rku, avan: janangka'l yuththaththaivittu mu'rinthoadippoanaarka'l; janangka'lil aneakampear vizhunthu madinthupoanaarka'l; savulum avar kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum madinthaarka'l en'raan.
savulum avar kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum madinthupoanathu unakku eppadith theriyum en'ru thaaveethu thanakku athai a'rivikki'ra vaalipanidaththil keattatha'rku,

antha vaalipan: naan tha'rseyalaayk kilpoavaa malaikkup poanean; appozhuthu ithoa, savul thammudaiya eettiyinmeal saaynthuko'ndirunthaar; irathangka'lum kuthiraiveerarum avaraith thodarnthu nerungkinaarka'l.
avar thirumpip paarththu: ennaik ka'ndu kooppittaar; atha'rku naan: ithoa, irukki'rean en'rean.
appozhuthu avar: nee yaar en'ru ennaik keattaar; naan amaleakkiyan en'ru sonnean.
avar ennai noakki: nee enna'ndaiyil kittavanthu nin'ru, ennaik kon'rupoadu; en piraa'nan muzhuthum innum poakaathathinaal enakku veathanaiyaayirukki'rathu en'raar.

appozhuthu naan, avar vizhunthapinpu pizhaikkamaattaar en'ru nichchayiththu, avara'ndaiyil poay nin'ru, avaraik kon'rupoattean; pi'rpaadu avar thalaiyinmeal iruntha mudiyaiyum avar puyaththil iruntha asthakadakaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu, avaika'lai ingkea en aa'ndavanidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthean en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethum avanoadiruntha sakala manusharum thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu,

savulum, avan kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum, karththarudaiya janangka'lum, israveal kudumpaththaarum, pattayaththaalea vizhunthapadiyinaal pulampi azhuthu saayangkaalamattum upavaasamaayirunthaarka'l.
thaaveethu athaith thanakku a'riviththa vaalipanaip paarththu: nee evvidaththaan en'ru keattatha'rku, avan: naan anniya jaathiyaanudaiya makan, naan amaleakkiyan en'raan.
thaaveethu avanai noakki: karththar apisheakampa'n'ninavaraik kon'rupoadumpadi nee un kaiyai neettap payappadaama'rpoanathu enna en'ru solli,
vaaliparil oruvanaik kooppittu, nee kittappoay avanmeal vizhunthu, avanai vettu en'raan; avan avanai vettinaan; avan seththaan.
thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: un iraththappazhi un thalaiyinmeal iruppathaaka; karththar apisheakampa'n'ninavarai naan kon'rupoattean en'ru un vaayea unakku viroathamaana saadchi sollit'ru en'raan.
thaaveethu savulinpearilum, avan kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaaninpearilum, pulampal paadinaan.
(vilviththaiyai yoothaa puththirarukkuk kat'rukkodukkumpadi katta'laiyittaan; athu yaasearin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.) avan paadina pulampalaavathu:
isravealin alangkaaram uyarntha sthaanangka'lil athamaayit'ru; paraakkiramasaalika'l vizhunthupoanaarka'l.

pelistharin kumaaraththika'l santhoashappadaathapadikkum, viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'lin kumaaraththika'l ka'likooraathapadikkum, athaik kaathpatta'naththil a'riviyaamalum askaloanin veethika'lil pirasthaapappaduththaamalum irungka'l.

kilpoavaa malaika'lea, ungka'lmeal paniyum mazhaiyum peyyaamalum, kaa'nikkaikku eat'ra palantharum vayalka'l iraamalum poavathaaka; angkea paraakkiramasaalika'ludaiya keadakam avamathikkappattathu; savul thailaththaal apisheakampa'n'nappadaathavarpoala avar keadakamum avamathikkappattathea.
kolaiyu'ndavarka'lin iraththaththaik kudiyaamalum, paraakkiramasaalika'lin ni'naththai u'n'naamalum, yoanaththaanudaiya vil pinvaangkinathillai; savulin pattayam ve'rumaiyaayth thirumpinathillai.

uyiroadea irukkaiyil savulum yoanaththaanum piriyamum inpamumaayirunthaarka'l; mara'naththilum pirinthupoanathillai; kazhukuka'laippaarkkilum veakamum, singkangka'laippaarkkilum palamumu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
isravealin kumaaraththika'lea, ungka'lukku iraththaamparaththaich si'rappaay uduppiththu, ungka'l udaiyinmeal pon aapara'nangka'laith tharippiththa savulukkaaka azhuthu pulampungka'l.
poarmukaththil paraakkiramasaalika'l vizhunthaarka'lea, yoanaththaanea, uyaramaana sthalangka'lilea vettu'ndu poanaayea.

en sakoatharanaakiya yoanaththaanea, unakkaaka naan viyaakulappaduki'rean; nee enakku veku inpamaayirunthaay; un sineakam aachchariyamaayirunthathu; sthireeka'lin sineakaththaippaarkkilum athikamaayirunthathu.
paraakkiramasaalika'l vizhunthupoanaarka'lea; yuththa aayuthangka'l ellaam azhinthupoayit'rea, en'ru paadinaan.

pinpu thaaveethu karththarai noakki: naan yoothaavin patta'nangka'l on'rilea poay irukkalaamaa en'ru visaariththaan. atha'rkuk karththar: poa en'raar; evvidaththi'rkup poakalaam en'ru thaaveethu keattatha'rku, avar: eproanukkup poa en'raar.
appadiyea thaaveethu than ira'ndu manaivika'laakiya yesrayeal ooraa'laana akinoavaamoadum, naapaalin manaiviyaayiruntha karmeal ooraa'laana apikaayiloadumkooda avvidaththi'rkup poanaan.
an'riyum thannoadiruntha manusharaiyum, avarka'l kudumpangka'laiyum koottikko'ndupoanaan; avarka'l eproanin sut'roorka'lilea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoothaavin manushar vanthu, angkea thaaveethai yoothaa vamsaththaarinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l. keeleayaaththeasaththu yaapeasin manushar savulai adakkampa'n'ninavarka'l en'ru avarka'l thaaveethukku a'riviththapoathu,

thaaveethu keeleayaaththeasaththu yaapeasin manusharidaththil sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi, neengka'l ungka'l aa'ndavanaakiya savulukku inthath thayavaich seythu, avarai adakkampa'n'ninapadiyinaalea, karththar ungka'lai aaseervathippaaraaka.
karththar ungka'laik kirupaiyum u'nmaiyumaay nadaththuvaaraaka; neengka'l inthak kaariyaththaich seythapadiyinaal, naanum intha nanmaikkuththakkathaaka ungka'lai nadaththuvean.

ippoathum neengka'l ungka'l kaika'laith thidappaduththikko'ndu nalla seavakaraayirungka'l; ungka'l aa'ndavanaakiya savul mariththapinpu, yoothaa vamsaththaar ennaith thangka'lmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollachsonnaan.
savulin padaiththalaivanaana nearin kumaaranaakiya apnear savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseaththai makanaayeemukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay,
avanaik keeleayaaththinmealum, ashooriyarmealum, yesrayealinmealum, eppiraayeeminmealum, penyameeninmealum, isravealanaiththinmealum raajaavaakkinaan.

savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseath isravealinmeal raajaavaaki'rapoathu, naa'rpathu vayathaayirunthaan; avan ira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; yoothaa koaththiraththaarmaaththiram thaaveethaip pinpat'rinaarka'l.
thaaveethu eproanilea yoothaa koaththiraththinmeal raajaavaayiruntha naadka'lin ilakkam eazhu varushamum aa'ru maathamumaam.
nearin kumaaranaakiya apnear savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseaththin seavakaraik koottikko'ndu, makanaayeemilirunthu kipiyoanukkup pu'rappattuppoanaan.

appozhuthu seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaapum thaaveethin seavakarum pu'rappattuppoay, kipiyoanin ku'laththa'ndaiyil oruvarukkoruvar ethirppattu, ku'laththi'rku anthappakkaththil avarka'lum, ku'laththi'rku inthappakkaththil ivarka'lum i'rangkinaarka'l.
apnear yoavaapai noakki: vaalipar ezhunthu, namakku munpaakach silampam pa'n'nattum en'raan. atha'rku yoavaap: avarka'l ezhunthu, appadich seyyattum en'raan.
appozhuthu savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseaththin pakkaththi'rkup penyameen manusharil pannira'ndupearum, thaaveethudaiya seavakarilea pannira'ndupearum ezhunthu oru pakkamaayp poay,
oruvar thalaiyai oruvar pidiththu, oruvarudaiya vilaavilea oruvar pattayaththinaalea kuththi, orumikka vizhunthaarka'l; athinaalea kipiyoanilirukki'ra antha sthalam elkaath asoorim ennappattathu.
an'raiyathinam mikavum kadinamaana yuththamaaki, apnearum israveal manusharum thaaveethin seavakaraal mu'riya adikkappattaarka'l.
angkea seruyaavin moon'ru kumaararaakiya yoavaapum apisaayum aasakealum irunthaarka'l; aasakeal ve'liyilirukki'ra kalaimaanka'lil on'raippoala veakamaay oaduki'ravanaayirunthaan.
avan apnearaip pinthodarnthu, valathupu'raththilaakilum idathupu'raththilaakilum, avanaivittu vilakaamal thuraththikko'ndupoanaan.
apnear thirumpip paarththu: nee aasakeal allavaa en'raan. avan: naanthaan en'raan.

appozhuthu apnear avanai noakki: nee valathupakkaththi'rkaakilum idathupakkaththi'rkaakilum vilaki, vaaliparil oruvanaip pidiththu, avanai urinthuko'l en'raan; aasakealoa vidamaattean en'ru thodarnthupoanaan.
pinnum apnear aasakealai noakki: nee ennai vittuppoa; naan unnaith tharaiyoadea ean vettavea'ndum? pi'rpaadu un sakoatharanaakiya yoavaapin mukaththilea eppadi vizhippean en'raan.

aanaalum avan vilakippoakamaattean en'rapadiyinaal, apnear avanai eettiyin pinpu'ra alakinaal avan vayit'rilea kuththinaan; eetti muthukilea pu'rappattathu; avan angkeathaanea vizhunthu seththaan; aasakeal vizhunthukidakki'ra idaththilea vanthavarka'lellaarum thariththu nin'raarka'l.
yoavaapum apisaayum sooriyan asthamikkumattum apnearaip pinthodarnthaarka'l; kipiyoan vanaantharavazhikku arukaana keeyaavukku ethirea irukki'ra ammaa meadumattum vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu apnearaip pinsen'ra penyameen puththirar orea padaiyaakak koodi, oru malaiyin uchchiyilea nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu apnear yoavaapaip paarththuk kooppittu, pattayam eppoathum sangkaaram pa'n'nikko'ndirukkavea'ndumoa, mudivilea kasappu'ndaakum en'ru a'riyeeroa, thangka'l sakoathararai vittup pinvaangkumpadikku enthamattum janangka'lukkuch sollaathiruppeer en'raan.

atha'rku yoavaap: in'ru kaalamea neer peasaathiruntheeraanaal janangka'l avaravar thangka'l sakoathararaip pinthodaraamal, appoathea thirumpividuvaarka'l en'ru theavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
yoavaap ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum isravealaith thodaraamalum, yuththampa'n'naamalum nin'ruvittaarka'l.
an'ru raamuzhuthum apnearum avan manusharum antharave'li vazhiyaayp poay, yoarthaanaik kadanthu, pithroanai uruva nadanthu thaa'ndi, makanaayeemukkup poanaarka'l.
yoavaap apnearaith thodaraamal janangka'laiyellaam koodivarachseythaan; thaaveethin seavakaril paththonpathupearum aasakealum ku'rainthirunthaarka'l.
thaaveethin seavakaroa penyameenarilum, apnearin manusharilum, munnoot'ra'rupathupearai madangkadiththaarka'l.

avarka'l aasakealai eduththu, pethlekeamilu'l'la avanudaiya thakappan kalla'raiyilea avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; yoavaapum avan manusharum iraamuzhuvathum nadanthu, pozhuthu vidiyumpoathu eproanilea searnthaarka'l.
savulin kudumpaththukkum thaaveethin kudumpaththukkum nedunaa'l yuththam nadanthathu; thaaveethu varavarap palaththaan; savulin kudumpaththaaroa varavarap palaveenappattup poanaarka'l.
eproanilea thaaveethukkup pi'rantha kumaarar: yesrayeal ooraa'laana akinoavaamidaththilea pi'rantha amnoan avanukku muthal pi'ranthavan.

naapaalin manaiviyaayiruntha karmeal ooraa'laana apikaayilidaththilea pi'rantha keeleayaap avanudaiya ira'ndaam kumaaran; moon'raam kumaaran keasoorin raajaavaana thalmaay kumaaraththiyaakiya maakkaa'l pet'ra apsaloam enpavan.
naalaam kumaaran aakeeth pet'ra athoniyaa enpavan; ainthaam kumaaran apiththaa'l pet'ra seppaththiyaa enpavan.
aa'raam kumaaran thaaveethin manaiviyaakiya eklaa'lidaththil pi'rantha ithreayaam enpavan; ivarka'l eproanilea thaaveethukkup pi'ranthavarka'l.
savulin kudumpaththukkum thaaveethin kudumpaththukkum yuththam nadanthuvaruki'rapoathu, apnear savulin kudumpaththilea palaththavanaanaan.

savulukku aayaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya rispaa'l ennum pearu'l'la oru ma'rumanaiyaatti irunthaa'l; ispoaseath apnearai noakki: nee en thakappanaarudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattiyinidaththil piraveasiththathu enna en'raan.

apnear ispoaseaththin vaarththaika'lukkaaka mikavum koapangko'ndu: ummaith thaaveethin kaiyil oppukkodaamal, innaa'lmattum ummudaiya thakappanaakiya savulin kudumpaththukkum, avarudaiya sakoathararukkum, sineakitharukkum, thayavuseyki'ravanaakiya ennai neer in'ru oru sthireeyinimiththam kut'rampidikki'ratha'rku, naan yoothaavukku udkaiyaana oru naayththalaiyaa?

naan raajyapaaraththaich savulin kudumpaththai vittuth thaa'ndappa'n'ni, thaaveethin singkaasanaththaith thaa'n thuvakkip peyersepaamattumu'l'la isravealinmealum yoothaavinmealum nilaini'ruththumpadikku,
karththar thaaveethukku aa'naiyittapadiyea, naan avanukkuch seyyaama'rpoanaal, theavan apnearukku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyyakkadavar en'raan.
appozhuthu avan apnearukkup payappattathinaal, appu'ram oru ma'rumozhiyum avanukkuch sollaathirunthaan.

apnear than naamaththinaalea thaaveethinidaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: theasam yaarudaiyathu? ennoadu udanpadikkaipa'n'num; ithoa, isravealaiyellaam ummidaththil thiruppa, en kai ummoadirukkum en'ru sollachsonnaan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu: nallathu, unnoadea naan udanpadikkaipa'n'nuvean; aanaalum orea kaariyam unnidaththil keattukko'l'luki'rean; athu ennavenil, nee en mukaththaip paarkka varumpoathu, savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'lai nee azhaiththuvaravea'ndum; atha'rkumun nee en mukaththaip paarppathillai en'ru sollachsolli,

avan savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseaththinidaththi'rkum sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: naan pelistharudaiya noo'ru nuniththoalka'laip parisamaakak koduththu, vivaakampa'n'nina en manaiviyaakiya meekaa'lai anuppividum en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu, ispoaseath ava'lai laayeesin kumaaranaakiya palththiyeal ennum purushanidaththilirunthu azhaiththuvara aadka'lai anuppinaan.
ava'l purushan pakooreemmattum ava'l pi'rakaalea azhuthuko'nduvanthaan. apnear avanai noakki: nee thirumpippoa en'raan; avan thirumpippoayvittaan.
apnear isravealin moopparoadea peasi: thaaveethai ungka'lmeal raajaavaaka vaikkumpadikku neengka'l aneakanaa'laayth theadineerka'lea.

ippoathum appadich seyyungka'l; en thaasanaakiya thaaveethin kaiyinaal, en janamaakiya isravealaip pelistharin kaikkum, avarka'ludaiya ellaach saththurukka'lin kaikkum neengkalaakki radchippean en'ru karththar thaaveethaikku'riththuch solliyirukki'raarea en'raan.

inthappirakaaramaaka apnear penyameen manushar kaathuka'l keadkap peasinaan; pinpu apnear isravealar paarvaikkum, penyameenudaiya ellaak kudumpaththaarin paarvaikkum, sammathiyaanathaiyellaam eproanilea thaaveethin kaathuka'l keadkap peasuki'ratha'rkup poanaan.
apnearum, avanoadeakooda irupathupearum eproanilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil vanthapoathu, thaaveethu apnearukkum, avanoadea vantha manusharukkum virunthuseythaan.

pinpu apnear thaaveethai noakki: naan ezhunthupoay, isravealarai ellaam ummoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'numpadikku, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanidaththil searththukko'ndu varuki'rean; athinaalea ummudaiya aaththumaa arasaa'la virumpuki'ra idamellaam arasaa'luveer en'raan; appadiyea thaaveethu apnearai anuppivittaan; avan samaathaanaththoadea poanaan.

thaaveethin seavakarum yoavaapum aneakam porudka'laik ko'l'laiyittu, tha'ndilirunthu ko'nduvanthaarka'l; appozhuthu apnear eproanil thaaveethinidaththil illai; avanai anuppivittaan; avan samaathaanaththoadea poayvittaan.

yoavaapum avanoadiruntha ellaach seanaiyum vanthapoathu, nearin kumaaranaakiya apnear raajaavinidaththil vanthaan en'rum, avar avanaich samaathaanamaayppoaka anuppivittaar en'rum, yoavaapukku a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoavaap raajaava'ndaiyil piraveasiththu: enna seytheer? ithoa, apnear ummidaththil vanthaanea, neer avanaip poakavittathu enna?
nearin kumaaranaakiya apnearai a'riveerea; avan ummai moasampoakkavum, ummudaiya poakkuvaraththai a'riyavum, neer seyki'rathaiyellaam aaraayavum vanthaan en'ru sonnaan.

yoavaap thaaveethai vittup pu'rappattavudanea, avan apnearaith thaaveethukkuth theriyaamal koottikko'ndu varumpadi aadka'lai anuppinaan; avarka'l seeraa ennum thuravumattumpoay avanai azhaiththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l.

apnear eproanukkuth thirumpi varuki'rapoathu, yoavaap avanoadea irakasiyamaayp peasappoaki'ravanpoala, avanai olimukavaasalin naduvea oru pakkamaay azhaiththuppoay, than thampi aasakealudaiya iraththappazhiyai vaangka, angkea avanai vayit'rilea kuththikkon'rupoattaan.
thaaveethu athaik keattapoathu: nearin kumaaranaakiya apnearin iraththaththi'rkaaka, enmealum en raajyaththinmealum karththarukku munpaaka en'raikkum pazhiyillai.

athu yoavaapudaiya thalaiyinmealum, avan thakappan kudumpaththinmealum sumanthiruppathaaka; yoavaapin veettaarilea piramiyakkaaranum, kushdaroakiyum, koal oon'ri nadakki'ravanum, pattayaththaal vizhuki'ravanum, appam ku'raichchalu'l'lavanum, orukkaalum ozhinthupoavathillai en'raan.
apnear kipiyoanil nadantha yuththaththilea thangka'l thampiyaakiya aasakealaik kon'rathinimiththam yoavaapum avan sakoatharanaakiya apisaayum avanaich sangkaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.

thaaveethu yoavaapaiyum, avanoadiruntha sakala janangka'laiyum paarththu: neengka'l ungka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, irattuduththi, apnearukku munnaaka nadanthu thukkangko'ndaadungka'l en'ru solli, thaaveethuraajaa thaanum paadaikkup pinsen'raan.
avarka'l apnearai eproanilea adakkampa'n'nukaiyil, raajaa apnearin kalla'raiya'ndaiyilea saththamittu azhuthaan; sakala janangka'lum azhuthaarka'l.
raajaa apnearukkaakap pulampi: mathikettavan saaki'rathupoala, apnear seththuppoanaanoa?

un kaika'l kattappadavum illai; un kaalka'lil vilangku poadappadavum illai; thushdar kaiyil madiki'rathupoala madinthaayea en'raan; appozhuthu janangka'lellaarum pinnum athikamaay avanukkaaka azhuthaarka'l.
