pozhuthu innum irukkaiyil, janangka'l ellaarum vanthu: appam pusiyum en'ru thaaveethukkuch sonnapoathu, thaaveethu: sooriyan asthamikki'ratha'rku munnea naan appaththaiyaakilum vea'rethaiyaakilum rusipaarththaal, theavan enakku atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum seyyakkadavar en'ru aa'naiyittuch sonnaan.
janangka'l ellaarum athaik kavaniththaarka'l, athu avarka'l paarvaikku nan'raayirunthathu; appadiyea raajaa seythathellaam sakala janangka'lukkum nalamaayth thoan'rinathu.
nearin kumaaranaakiya apnearaik kon'rupoattathu raajaavinaal u'ndaanathallaven'ru annaa'lilea sakala janangka'lum, isravealar anaivarum a'rinthuko'ndaarka'l.
raajaa than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: in'raiyathinam isravealil pirapuvum periya manushanumaakiya oruvan vizhunthaan en'ru a'riyeerka'laa?

naan raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'nappattavanaayirunthapoathilum, naan innum palaveenan; seruyaavin kumaararaakiya intha manushar en palaththukku mignchinavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l, anthap pollaappaich seythavanukkuk karththar avan pollaappukkuththakkathaaych sarikkattuvaaraaka en'raan.
apnear eproanilea seththuppoanathaich savulin kumaaran keattapoathu, avan kaika'l thidanat'ruppoayit'ru; isravealarellaarum kalangkinaarka'l.

savulin kumaaranukkup padaiththalaivaraana ira'ndupear irunthaarka'l; oruvanukkup pear paanaa, mat'ravanukkup pear reakaap; avarka'l penyameen puththiraril pearoaththiyanaakiya rimmoanin kumaararka'l. pearoaththum penyameenukku aduththathaay e'n'nappattathu.
pearoaththiyar kiththaayeemukku oadippoay, innaa'lvaraikkum angkea sagncharikki'raarka'l.

savulin kumaaran yoanaththaanukku ira'ndu kaalum mudamaana oru kumaaran irunthaan; savulum yoanaththaanum madintha seythi yesrayealilirunthu varuki'rapoathu, avan ainthu vayathu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; appozhuthu avanudaiya thaathi avanai eduththukko'ndu oadippoanaa'l; ava'l oadippoaki'ra avasaraththil avan vizhunthu mudavanaanaan; avanukku meavipoaseath en'ru pear.
pearoaththiyanaana antha rimmoanin kumaararaakiya reakaapum paanaavum poay, ispoaseath maththiyaanaththilea veyil nearaththil padukkaiyinmeal sayaniththirukkumpoathu avan veetti'rku'l piraveasiththu,
koathumai vaangka varuki'ravarka'lpoala, naduveedumattum vanthu, avanai vayit'rilea kuththippoattaarka'l; pinpu reakaapum avan sakoatharan paanaavum thappi oadippoanaarka'l.

avan than pa'l'li a'raiyilea than kattilinmeal paduththirukkumpoathu ivarka'l u'l'lea poay, avanaik kuththikkon'rupoattu, avan thalaiyai vettippoattaarka'l; pinpu avan thalaiyai eduththukko'ndu, iraamuzhuthum antharave'li vazhiyaay nadanthu,

eproanilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil ispoaseaththin thalaiyaik ko'nduvanthu, raajaavai noakki: ithoa, ummudaiya piraa'nanai vaangkaththeadina ummudaiya saththuruvaayiruntha savulin kumaaranaakiya ispoaseaththin thalai; in'raiyathinam karththar raajaavaakiya engka'l aa'ndavanukkaakach savulin kaiyilum avan kudumpaththaarin kaiyilum pazhi vaangkinaar en'raarka'l.

aanaalum thaaveethu pearoaththiyanaana rimmoanin kumaararaakiya reakaapukkum, avan sakoatharan paanaavukkum pirathiyuththaramaaka: en aaththumaavai ellaa ikkattukkum neengkalaakki meetta karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu naan solluki'rathaik kea'lungka'l.

ithoa, oruvan enakku na'rseythi ko'nduvaruki'ravan en'ru e'n'ni, savul seththuppoanaan en'ru enakku a'riviththu, thanakku vekumaanam kidaikkum en'ru ninaiththapoathu, avanai naan pidiththu siklaakilea kon'rupoatteanea.

thamathu veetti'rku'l thamathu padukkaiyinmeal paduththiruntha neethimaanaik kolaiseytha pollaatha manusharukku evva'lavu athikamaay aakkinai seyyavea'ndum? ippoathum naan avarudaiya iraththappazhiyai ungka'l kaika'lil vaangki, ungka'lai poomiyilirunthu azhiththuppoadaathiruppeanoa en'ru solli,

avarka'laik kon'rupoadavum, avarka'l kaika'laiyum kaalka'laiyum tha'riththu, eproanilirukki'ra ku'laththa'ndaiyilea thookkippoadavum than seavakarukkuk katta'laiyittaan. ispoaseaththin thalaiyai eduththu, eproanilirukki'ra apnearin kalla'raiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea isravealin koaththirangka'lellaam eproanilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil vanthu: ithoa, naangka'l ummudaiya elumpum ummudaiya maamsamumaanavarka'l.

savul engka'lmeal raajaavaayirukkumpoathea isravealai nadaththikko'ndu poanavarum nadaththikko'ndu vanthavarum neerea; karththar: en janamaakiya isravealai nee meayththu, nee isravealinmeal thalaivanaayiruppaay en'ru ummidaththil sonnaarea en'raarka'l.

isravealin mooppar ellaarum eproanilea raajaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l; thaaveethuraajaa eproanilea karththarukku munpaaka avarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ninapinpu, avarka'l thaaveethai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
thaaveethu raajaavaakumpoathu, muppathu vayathaayirunthaan; avan naa'rpathu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan.
avan eproanilea yoothaavinmeal eazhu varushamum aa'ru maathamum, erusaleamilea samastha isravealinmealum yoothaavinmealum muppaththumoon'ru varushamum raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan.

theasaththilea kudiyirukki'ra epoosiyarmeal yuththampa'n'na raajaavaanavan than manusharoadeakooda erusaleamukkup poanaan. avarka'l: ithilea piraveasikka thaaveethinaal koodaathu en'ru e'n'ni, thaaveethai noakki: nee itha'rku'l piraveasippathillai; kurudarum sappaa'nika'lum unnaith thaduppaarka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.
aanaalum thaaveethu seeyoan koattaiyaip pidiththaan; athu thaaveethin nakaramaayit'ru.

evan saalakaththin vazhiyaay ea'ri, epoosiyaraiyum thaaveethin aaththumaa pakaikki'ra sappaa'nika'laiyum, kurudaraiyum mu'riya adikki'raanoa, avan thalaivanaayiruppaan en'ru thaaveethu an'raiyathinam solliyirunthaan; athanaal kurudanum sappaa'niyum veettilea varalaakaathu en'ru solluki'rathu'ndu.
anthak koattaiyilea thaaveethu vaasampa'n'ni, atha'rkuth thaaveethin nakaram en'ru pearittu, milloa ennum sthalanthuvakki, udpu'ramattum sut'rilum irukki'ra mathilaik kattinaan.
thaaveethu naa'lukkunaa'l viruththiyadainthaan; seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar avanoadeakooda irunthaar.
theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraam thaaveethinidaththil sthaanaapathika'laiyum, keathurumarangka'laiyum, thachcharaiyum, kalthachcharaiyum anuppinaan; avarka'l thaaveethukku oru veettaik kattinaarka'l.
karththar thannai isravealinmeal raajaavaakath thidappaduththi, thammudaiya janamaakiya isravealinimiththam thannudaiya raajyaththai uyarththinaar en'ru thaaveethu ka'nda'rinthapoathu,
avan eproanilirunthu vanthapinpu, erusaleamil innum athikamaana ma'rumanaiyaattika'laiyum sthireeka'laiyum ko'ndaan; innum athika kumaararum kumaaraththika'lum thaaveethukkup pi'ranthaarka'l.
erusaleamil avanukkuch sammuvaa, soapaap, naaththaan, saalomoan,
ippaar, elisoovaa, neppeak, yappiyaa,
elishaamaa, eliyaathaa, elippealeath ennum pearka'laiyudaiya kumaarar pi'ranthaarka'l.

thaaveethai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru pelisthar kea'lvippattapoathu, avarka'l ellaarum thaaveethaith theadumpadi vanthaarka'l; athaith thaaveethu keattapoathu, oru ara'nippaana idaththukkup poanaan.
pelistharoa vanthu, reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea paraviyirunthaarka'l.

pelistharukku viroathamaayp poakalaamaa, avarka'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduppeeraa en'ru thaaveethu karththaridaththil visaariththapoathu, karththar: poa, pelistharai un kaiyil nichchayamaay oppukkoduppean en'ru thaaveethukkuch sonnaar.

thaaveethu paakaal piraaseemukku vanthu, angkea avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu: tha'n'neerka'l udaiththoaduki'rathupoala, karththar en saththurukka'lai enakku munpaaka udaiththu oadappa'n'ninaar en'ru solli, athinimiththam antha sthalaththi'rkup paakaalpiraaseem en'ru pearittaan.
angkea pelisthar thangka'l vikkirakangka'laivittu oadippoanaarka'l; avaika'laith thaaveethum avan manusharum sutteriththaarka'l.
pelisthar thirumpavum vanthu, reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea i'rangkinaarka'l.
thaaveethu karththaridaththil visaariththatha'rku, avar: nee nearaayp poakaamal, avarka'lukkup pinnaalea sut'ri, musukkattaich sedika'lukku ethireayirunthu, avarka'lmeal paaynthu,

musukkattaich sedika'lin nunika'lilea selluki'ra iraichchalai nee keadkumpoathu, seekkiramaay ezhumpippoa; appozhuthu pelistharin paa'layaththai mu'riya adikka, karththar unakku munpaakap pu'rappattiruppaar en'raar.
karththar thaaveethukkuk katta'laiyittapirakaaram avan seythu, pelistharaik keapaa thuvakkik keasear ellaimattum mu'riya adiththaan.
pinpu thaaveethu isravealar ellaarukku'l'lum therinthuko'l'lappatta muppathinaayirampearaik kootti,

kearupeenka'lin naduvea vaasamaayirukki'ra seanaika'ludaiya karththarin naamam thozhuthuko'l'lappaduki'ra theavanudaiya pettiyaip paalaiyoothaavilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadi, avanum avanoadiruntha antha sthalaththaarum ezhunthupoay,

theavanudaiya pettiyai oru puthu irathaththinmeal eat'ri, athaik kipiyaavilirukki'ra apinathaapin veettilirunthu ko'nduvanthaarka'l; apinathaapin kumaararaakiya oosaavum akiyoavum anthap puthu irathaththai nadaththinaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanudaiya pettiyai eat'ri, athaik kipiyaavilirukki'ra apinathaapin veettilirunthu nadaththikko'ndu varuki'rapoathu, akiyoa pettikku munnaalea nadanthaan.

thaaveethum israveal santhathiyaar anaivarum theavathaaru maraththaal pa'n'nappatta sakalavitha keethavaaththiyangka'loadum, surama'ndalam thampuru mea'lam vee'nai kaiththaa'lam aakiya ivaika'loadum, karththarukku munpaaka aadippaadikko'ndupoanaarka'l.
avarka'l naakoanin ka'lam irukki'ra idaththukku vanthapoathu, maaduka'l mira'ndu pettiyai asaiththapadiyinaal, oosaa theavanudaiya pettiyinidamaayth than kaiyai neetti, athaip pidiththaan.
appozhuthu karththarukku oosaavinmeal koapam moo'ndathu; avanudaiya thu'nivinimiththam theavan angkea avanai adiththaar; avan angkea theavanudaiya pettiya'ndaiyil seththaan.
appozhuthu karththar oosaavai adiththathinimiththam thaaveethu visanappattu, antha sthalaththi'rku innaa'lmattum vazhangkivaruki'ra peareasoosaa ennum pearittaan.
thaaveethu an'raiyathinam karththarukkup payanthu, karththarudaiya petti ennidaththil varuvathu eppadiyen'ru solli,
athaith thannidaththil thaaveethin nakaraththil ko'nduvara manathillaamal, kiththiyanaakiya oapeatheathoamin veettilea ko'ndupoay vaiththaan.
karththarudaiya petti kiththiyanaakiya oapeatheathoamin veettilea moon'rumaatham irukkaiyil karththar oapeatheathoamaiyum avan veettaar anaivaraiyum aaseervathiththaar.

theavanudaiya pettiyinimiththam karththar oapeatheathoamin veettaiyum, avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum aaseervathiththaar en'ru thaaveethuraajaavukku a'rivikkappattathu; appozhuthu thaaveethu theavanudaiya pettiyai oapeatheathoamin veettilirunthu thaaveethin nakaraththukku makizhchchiyudanea ko'nduvanthaan.
karththarudaiya pettiyaich sumanthupoaki'ravarka'l aa'ru thappadi nadanthapoathu, maaduka'laiyum kozhuththa aattukkadaakka'laiyum paliyittaan.
thaaveethu sa'nalnool eapoaththaith thariththukko'ndu, than muzhup palaththoadum karththarukku munpaaka nadanampa'n'ninaan.
appadiyea thaaveethum, israveal santhathiyaar anaivarum karththarudaiya pettiyaik kempeera saththaththoadum ekkaa'la thoniyoadum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

karththarudaiya petti thaaveethin nakaraththi'rku'l piraveasikki'rapoathu, savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'l palaka'nivazhiyaayp paarththu, thaaveethuraajaa karththarukku munpaakak kuthiththu, nadanampa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndu, than iruthayaththilea avanai avamathiththaa'l.

avarka'l karththarudaiya pettiyai u'l'lea ko'nduvanthu, atha'rkuth thaaveethu poatta koodaaraththi'rku'l irukki'ra athin sthaanaththilea athai vaiththapoathu, thaaveethu karththarudaiya sannithiyilea sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum ittaan.
thaaveethu sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum ittapinpu, seanaika'lin karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea janangka'lai aaseervathiththu,

isravealin thira'lkoottamaana sthiree purusharaakiya sakala janangka'lukkum, avaravarukku ovvoru appaththaiyum, ovvoru i'raichchiththu'ndaiyum, ovvoru padi thiraadcharasaththaiyum pangkittaan; pi'rpaadu janangka'l ellaarum avaravar thangka'l veetti'rkup poayvittaarka'l.

thaaveethu than veettaarai aaseervathikki'ratha'rkuth thirumpumpoathu, savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'l thaaveethukku ethirko'nduvanthu, a'rpamanusharil oruvan than vasthirangka'laik kazhat'rippoaduki'rathupoala, in'ru thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararudaiya pe'nka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaakath thammudaiya vasthirangka'lai urinthupoattiruntha isravealin raajaa in'ru eththanai makimaippattirunthaar en'raa'l.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu meekaa'laip paarththu: un thakappanaippaarkkilum, avarudaiya ellaa veettaaraippaarkkilum, ennai isravealaakiya karththarudaiya janaththinmeal thalaivanaakak katta'laiyidumpadikkuth therinthuko'nda karththarudaiya samukaththi'rku munpaaka aadippaadinean.
ithaippaarkkilum innum naan neesanum en paarvaikku a'rpanumaavean: appadiyea nee sonna pe'nka'lukkungkooda makimaiyaay vi'langkuvean en'raan.
athinaal savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'lukku mara'namadaiyum naa'lmattum pi'l'lai illaathirunthathu.
karththar raajaavaich sut'rilum iruntha avanudaiya ellaach saththurukka'lukkum avanai neengkalaakki, i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninapoathu, avan than veettilea vaasamaayirukkaiyil,

raajaa theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanai noakki: paarum, keathurumarangka'laal seyyappatta veettilea naan vaasampa'n'numpoathu, theavanudaiya petti thiraika'lin naduvea vaasamaayirukki'rathea en'raan.
appozhuthu naaththaan raajaavai noakki: neer poay ummudaiya iruthayaththil u'l'lapadiyellaam seyyum; karththar ummoadu irukki'raarea en'raan.
an'ru raaththiriyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai naaththaanukku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee poay en thaasanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan vaasamaayirukkaththakka aalayaththai nee enakkuk kattuvaayoa?
naan israveal puththirarai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lmutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum, naan oru aalayaththilea vaasampa'n'naamal, koodaaraththilum vaasasthalaththilum ulaavinean.

naan isravealaakiya en janaththai meaykkumpadi katta'laiyitta israveal koaththirangka'lil oru koaththiraththaiyaavathu noakki: neengka'l enakkuk keathurumaraththaal seyyappatta aalayaththaik kattaathirukki'rathu enna en'ru naan israveal puththirarukku'l ulaavivantha evvidaththilaavathu yaathoru vaarththaiyaich sonnathu'ndoa?

ippoathum nee en thaasanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, nee israveal enki'ra en janangka'lukku athipathiyaayirukkumpadi, aaduka'lin pinnea nadantha unnai naan aattumanthaiyai vittu eduththu,
nee poana evvidaththilum unnoadea irunthu, un saththurukka'laiyellaam unakku munpaaka nirmoolamaakki, poomiyilirukki'ra periyoarka'lin naamaththi'rku oththa periya naamaththai unakku u'ndaakkinean.

naan en janamaakiya isravealukku oru idaththai ea'rpaduththi, avarka'l thangka'l sthaanaththilea kudiyirukkavum, ini avarka'l alaiyaamalum, munpoalum, naan en janamaakiya isravealinmeal niyaayaathipathika'laik katta'laiyitta naa'lvaraiyil nadanthathupoalum, niyaayakkeattin makka'laal inich si'rumaippadaamalum irukkumpadi avarka'lai naattinean.
unnudaiya ellaach saththurukka'lukkum unnai neengkalaakki, i'laippaa'ravum pa'n'ninean; ippoathum karththar unakku veettai u'ndupa'n'nuvaar enpathaik karththar unakku a'rivikki'raar.
un naadka'l ni'raivea'ri, nee un pithaakka'loadea niththiraipa'n'numpoathu, naan unakkuppinpu un karppappi'rappaakiya un santhathiyai ezhumpappa'n'ni, avan raajyaththai nilaippaduththuvean.
avan en naamaththi'rken'ru oru aalayaththaik kattuvaan; avan raajyapaaraththin singkaasanaththai en'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean.
naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean, avan enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaan; avan akkiramam seythaal, naan avanai manusharudaiya milaat'rinaalum manupuththirarudaiya adika'linaalum tha'ndippean.
unakku munpaaka naan tha'l'livitta savulidaththilirunthu en kirupaiyai vilakkinathupoala avanaivittu vilakkamaattean.
un veedum, un raajyamum, en'ren'raikkum unakku munpaaka sthirappattirukkum; un raajaasanam en'ren'raikkum nilaipet'rirukkum enki'raar en'ru sollachsonnaar.
naaththaan intha ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyum, intha ellaath tharisanaththinpadiyum, thaaveethukkuch sonnaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethuraajaa udpiraveasiththu, karththarudaiya samukaththilirunthu: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer ennai ithuvaraikkum ko'nduvanthatha'rku, naan emmaaththiram? en veedum emmaaththiram?

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ithu innum ummudaiya paarvaikkuk kogncha kaariyamaayirukki'rathu en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra theavareer ummudaiya adiyaanudaiya veettaikku'riththu, vekuthooramaayirukkum kaalaththuchseythiyai manushar mu'raimaiyaaych sonneerea.
ini thaaveethu ummidaththil sollavea'ndiyathu enna? karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra neer umathu adiyaanai a'riveer.
ummudaiya vaakkuththaththaththinimiththamum, ummudaiya siththaththinpadiyeayum, inthap periya kaariyangka'laiyellaam umathu adiyaanukku a'rivikkumpadikkuth thayavu seytheer.

aakaiyaal theavanaakiya karththarea, neer periyavar en'ru vi'langkuki'rathu; naangka'l engka'l kaathuka'laalea keatta sakala kaariyangka'linpadiyum, theavareerukku nikaraanavar illai; ummaiththavira vea'rea theavanum illai.

ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealukku nikaraana janamum u'ndoa? pooloakaththu jaathika'lil intha orea jaathiyaith theavan thamakku janamaaka meedki'ratha'rkum, thamakkuk keerththi vi'langkappa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum ea'rpattaarea; theavareer ekipthilirunthu meettukko'nduvantha ummudaiya janaththi'rkumunpaakap payangkaramaana periya kaariyangka'lai nadaththi, ummudaiya theasaththi'rkum, athiliruntha jaathika'lukkum, avarka'l theavarka'lukkum, umathu makimaiyai vi'langkachseythu,
ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealar en'raikkum ummudaiya janamaayiruppatha'rku, avarka'laith thidappaduththi, karththaraakiya neerthaamea avarka'lukkuth theavanaaneer.
ippoathum theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer umathu adiyaanaiyum avan veettaiyum ku'riththuch sonna vaarththaiyai en'ren'raikkum nilaivarappaduththa, theavareer sonnapadiyea seytharu'lum.

appadiyea seanaika'lin karththar isravealinmeal theavanaanavar en'ru solli, ummudaiya naamam en'ren'raikkum makimaippaduvathaaka; umathu adiyaanaakiya thaaveethin veedu umakku munpaaka nilaini'rpathaaka.

unakku veedukattuvean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththaraayirukki'ra neer umathu adiyaanin sevikku ve'lippaduththineer: aakaiyaal ummai noakki intha vi'n'nappaththaich seyya umathu adiyaanukku manaththairiyam kidaiththathu.
ippoathum karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, neerea theavan; ummudaiya vaarththaika'l saththiyam; theavareer umathu adiyaanukku intha nalviseashangka'lai vaakkuththaththampa'n'nineer.

ippoathum umathu adiyaanin veedu en'raikkum umakku munpaaka irukkumpadi athai aaseervathiththaru'lum; karththaraana aa'ndavaraakiya theavareer athaich sonneer, ummudaiya aaseervaathaththinaalea umathu adiyaanin veedu en'raikkum aaseervathikkappattiruppathaaka en'raan.
itha'rkuppinpu thaaveethu pelistharai mu'riya adiththu, avarka'laik keezhppaduththi, meaththeak ammaavaip pidiththukko'ndaan.

avan moavaapiyaraiyum mu'riya adiththu, avarka'laith tharaimattum pa'niyappa'n'ni, avarka'lmeal noolpoattu, ira'ndupangku manusharaik kon'rupoattu, oru pangkai uyiroadea vaiththaan; ivvithamaay moavaapiyar thaaveethaich seaviththu, avanukkuk kappangkattuki'ravarka'laanaarka'l.
reakoapin kumaaranaakiya aathaatheasar ennum soapaavin raajaa aipiraaththu nathiya'ndaiyil irukki'ra seemaiyaith thirumpath than vasamaakkikko'l'lappoakaiyil, thaaveethu avanaiyum mu'riya adiththu,

avanukku iruntha iraa'nuvaththil aayiraththu ezhunoo'ru kuthiraiveeraraiyum, irupathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum pidiththu, irathangka'lil noo'ru irathangka'lai vaiththukko'ndu, mat'ravaika'laiyellaam thu'ndaadippoattaan.
soapaavin raajaavaakiya aathaatheasarukku uthaviseyya thamaskup patta'naththaaraakiya seeriyar vanthaarka'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril irupaththeeraayirampearai vettippoattu,
thamaskukkaduththa seeriyaavilea thaa'naiyangka'lai vaiththaan; seeriyar thaaveethaich seaviththu, avanukkuk kappangkattinaarka'l; thaaveethu poana idaththilellaam, karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
aathaatheasarin seavakarudaiya po'rparisaika'laith thaaveethu eduththu, avaika'lai erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthaan.
aathaatheasarin patta'nangka'laakiya peaththaakilum pearoththaayilumirunthu thaaveethu raajaa makaa thira'laana ve'nkalaththaiyum eduththukko'nduvanthaan.
thaaveethu aathaatheasarudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvaththaiyum mu'riya adiththa seythiyai aamaaththin raajaavaakiya thoayee keattapoathu,

aathaatheasar thoayeeyinmeal eppoathum yuththampa'n'nikko'ndirunthapadiyaal, raajaavaakiya thaaveethin sukaseythiyai visaarikkavum, avan aathaatheasaroadea yuththampa'n'ni, avanai mu'riya adiththatha'rkaaka avanukku vaazhththuthal sollavum, thoayee than kumaaranaakiya yoaraamai raajaavinidaththil anuppinaan. mealum yoaraam than kaiyilea ve'l'liyum ponnum ve'nkalamumaana thattumuttuka'laik ko'nduvanthaan.
avan ko'nduvanthavaika'laith thaaveethuraajaa keezhppaduththina seeriyar, moavaapiyar, ammoan puththirar, pelisthar, amaleakkiyar ennum sakala jaathiyaarka'lidaththilum,

reakoapin kumaaranaakiya aathaatheasar ennum soapaavin raajaavinidaththilum ko'l'laiyittathilum eduththu, karththarukku niyamiththa ve'l'liyoadum ponnoadungkoodak karththarukkup pirathishdaipa'n'ninaan.
thaaveethu uppuppa'l'laththaakkilea pathine'n'naayiram seeriyarai mu'riya adiththuth thirumpinathinaal keerththipet'raan.

eathoamil thaa'naiyangka'lai vaiththaan; eathoam engkum avan thaa'naiyangka'lai vaiththathinaalea, eathoamiyar ellaarum thaaveethaich seavikki'ravarka'laanaarka'l; thaaveethu poana ellaa idaththilum karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
ippadiyea thaaveethu israveal anaiththinmealum raajaavaayirunthaan; avan thannudaiya ellaa janaththi'rkum niyaayamum neethiyum seythuvanthaan.
seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaap iraa'nuvaththalaivanaayirunthaan; akiloothin kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath manthiriyaayirunthaan.
akithoopin kumaaran saathoakkum, apiyaththaarin kumaaran akimeleakkum aasaariyaraayirunthaarka'l; seraayaa sampirathiyaayirunthaan.
yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaa kireaththiyarukkum pileaththiyarukkum thalaivanaayirunthaan; thaaveethin kumaararoa pirathaanika'laayirunthaarka'l.
yoanaththaannimiththam ennaal thayavupe'raththakkavan evanaavathu savulin veettaaril innum meethiyaayirukki'ravan u'ndaa en'ru thaaveethu keattaan.

appozhuthu savulin veettu vealaikkaaranaakiya seepaa ennum pearu'l'lavanaith thaaveethinidaththil azhaiththuvanthaarka'l; raajaa avanaip paarththu: neethaanaa seepaa en'ru keattaan; avan adiyeanthaan en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa: theavannimiththam naan savulin kudumpaththaarukkuth thayaiseyyumpadi avan veettaaril yaathoruvan innum meethiyaay irukki'raanaa en'ru keattatha'rku, seepaa raajaavaip paarththu: innum yoanaththaanukku ira'ndu kaalka'lum mudamaana oru kumaaran irukki'raan en'raan.
avan engkea en'ru raajaa keattatha'rku, seepaa raajaavaip paarththu: ithoa, avan loatheapaarilea ammiyealin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin veettil irukki'raan en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethuraajaa avanai loatheapaarilirukki'ra ammiyealin kumaaranaakiya maakeerin veettilirunthu azhaippiththaan.

savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanin makan meavipoaseath thaaveethinidaththil vanthapoathu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangkinaan; appozhuthu thaaveethu: meavipoaseaththea en'raan; avan: ithoa, adiyean en'raan.

thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: nee payappadaathea; un thakappanaakiya yoanaththaannimiththam naan nichchayamaay unakkuth thayaiseythu, un thakappanaakiya savulin nilangka'laiyellaam unakkuth thirumpak koduppean; nee en panthiyil niththam appam pusippaay en'raan.
appozhuthu avan va'nangki: seththa naayaippoalirukki'ra ennai neer noakkippaarkki'ratha'rku, umathu adiyaan emmaaththiram en'raan.
raajaa savulin vealaikkaaranaakiya seepaavai azhaippiththu, avanai noakki: savulukkum avar veettaar ellaarukkum iruntha yaavaiyum un ejamaanudaiya kumaaranukkuk koduththean.

aakaiyaal nee un kumaararaiyum un vealaikkaararaiyum koottikko'ndu, un ejamaanudaiya kumaaran pusikka appam u'ndaayirukkumpadi, antha nilaththaip payirittu, athin palanaich searppaayaaka; un ejamaanudaiya kumaaran meavipoaseath niththam en panthiyilea appam pusippaan en'raan; seepaavukkup pathinainthu kumaararum irupathu vealaikkaararum irunthaarka'l.

seepaa, raajaavai noakki: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan thamathu adiyaanukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam umathu adiyaanaakiya naan seyvean en'raan. raajakumaararil oruvanaippoala, meavipoaseath en panthiyilea asanam pa'n'nuvaan en'ru raajaa sonnaan.
meavipoaseaththi'rku meekaa ennum pearu'l'la si'ruvanaakiya oru kumaaran irunthaan, seepaavin veettilea kudiyiruntha yaavarum meavipoaseaththi'rku vealaikkaararaayirunthaarka'l.
meavipoaseath raajaavin panthiyil niththam asanampa'n'nuki'ravanaayirunthapadiyinaal, erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaan; avanukku ira'ndu kaalum mudamaayirunthathu.
athanpinpu ammoan puththirarin raajaa mariththuppoanaan; avan kumaaranaakiya aanoon avan pattaththi'rku raajaavaanaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: aanoonin thakappanaakiya naakaas enakkuth thayaiseythathupoala, avan kumaaranaakiya ivanukku naan thayaiseyvean en'ru solli, avan thakappanukkaaka avanukku aa'ruthal solla, than oozhiyakkaararai anuppinaan; thaaveethin oozhiyakkaarar ammoan puththirarin theasaththilea vanthapoathu,

ammoan puththirarin pirapukka'l thangka'l aa'ndavanaakiya aanoonaip paarththu: thaaveethu aa'ruthal solluki'ravarka'lai ummidaththil anuppinathu, ummudaiya thakappanaik kanampa'n'nuki'rathaay umakkuth thoan'ruki'rathoa? inthap patta'naththai aaraaynthu, u'lavupaarththu, athaik kavizhththuppoada allavoa thaaveethu than oozhiyakkaararai ummidaththi'rku anuppinaan en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu aanoon: thaaveethin oozhiyakkaararaip pidiththu, avarka'ludaiya orupakkaththuth thaadiyaich siraiththu, avarka'ludaiya vasthirangka'lai iruppidamattum vaiththuvittu, mat'rappaathiyaik kaththariththuppoattu, avarka'lai anuppivittaan.

athu thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, raajaa, antha manushar mikavum vedkap pattapadiyinaal, avarka'lukku ethiraaka aadka'lai anuppi, ungka'l thaadi va'larumattum neengka'l erikoavilirunthu, pi'rpaadu vaarungka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.

ammoan puththirar thaangka'l thaaveethukku aruvaruppaanathaik ka'ndapoathu, sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi, pethreakoap theasaththuch seeriyarilum, soapaavilirukki'ra seeriyarilum irupathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum, maakkaatheasaththu raajaavinidaththil aayirampearaiyum, ishthoapilirukki'ra panneeraayirampearaiyum, koolippadaiyaaka azhaippiththaarka'l.
athaith thaaveethu kea'lvippattapoathu, yoavaapaiyum paraakkiramasaalika'laakiya samastha iraa'nuvaththaiyum anuppinaan.

ammoan puththirar pu'rappattu, olimukavaasala'ndaiyilea poarseyya a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l; aanaalum soapaavilum reakoapilumirunthuvantha seeriyarum, ishthoapilum maakkaavilumirunthu vantha manusharum, ve'liyilea piraththiyeakamaayirunthaarka'l.

yoavaapoa iraa'nuvangka'lin padaimukam thanakku munnum pinnum irukki'rathaik kaa'nkaiyil, avan isravealilea therinthuko'l'lappatta ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lilum oru pangkaip piriththeduththu, athaich seeriyarukku ethiraaka a'nivakuththu ni'ruththi,
mat'ra janaththai ammoan puththirarukku ethiraaka a'nivakuththu ni'ruththumpadi than sakoatharanaakiya apisaayinidaththil oppuviththu:
seeriyar kaimignchuki'rathaayirunthaal nee enakku uthaviseyyavea'ndum; ammoan puththirar kai mignchuki'rathaayirunthaal naan unakku uthaviseyya varuvean.
thairiyamaayiru; nammudaiya janaththi'rkaakavum, nammudaiya theavanudaiya patta'nangka'lukkaakavum savuriyaththaik kaattuvoam; karththar thamathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seyvaaraaka en'raan.
yoavaapum avanoadiruntha janamum seeriyarmeal yuththampa'n'nak kittinaarka'l; avarka'l avanukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l.

seeriyar mu'rinthoaduki'rathai ammoan puththirar ka'ndapoathu, avarka'lum apisaayikku munpaaka mu'rinthoadip patta'naththi'rku'l pukunthaarka'l; appozhuthu yoavaap ammoan puththirarai vittuth thirumpi erusaleamukku vanthaan.
thaangka'l isravealukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattathaich seeriyar ka'ndapoathu, orumikkak koodinaarka'l.
aathaareasar nathikku appaaliruntha seeriyaraiyum azhaiththanuppinaan; avarka'l ealaamukku vanthaarka'l; aathaareasarudaiya padaiththalaivanaakiya soapaak avarka'lukku munnaalea sen'raan.

athu thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan isravealaiyellaam koottikko'ndu, yoarthaanaik kadanthu, ealaamukkup poanaan; seeriyar thaaveethukku ethiraaka iraa'nuvangka'lai a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l; avanoadu yuththampa'n'nuki'rapoathu,

seeriyar isravealukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril ezhunoo'ru irathaveeraraiyum naa'rpathinaayiram kuthiraiveeraraiyum kon'ru, avarka'ludaiya padaiththalaivanaakiya soapaakaiyum saakumpadi vettippoattaan.

appozhuthu aathaareasaraich seavikki'ra sakala raajaakka'lum thaangka'l isravealukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattathaik ka'ndu, isravealaroadea samaathaanampa'n'ni, avarka'laich seaviththaarka'l. appu'ram ammoan puththirarukku uthaviseyyach seeriyar payappattaarka'l.

ma'ruvarusham raajaakka'l yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadungkaalam vanthapoathu, thaaveethu yoavaapaiyum, avanoadeakoodath than seavakaraiyum, israveal anaiththaiyum, ammoan puththirarai azhikkavum, rappaavai mut'rikkaipoadavum anuppinaan. thaaveethoa erusaleamil irunthuvittaan.

orunaa'l saayangkaalaththil thaaveethu than padukkaiyilirunthu ezhunthu, aramanai upparikaiyinmeal ulaaththikko'ndirukkumpoathu, snaanampa'n'nuki'ra oru sthireeyai upparikaiyinmealirunthu ka'ndaan; antha sthiree veku sauntharavathiyaayirunthaa'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethu, antha sthiree yaar en'ru visaarikka aa'l anuppinaan; ava'l eliyaamin kumaaraththiyum, eaththiyanaana uriyaavin manaiviyumaakiya pathseapaa'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu aa'l anuppi ava'lai azhaiththuvarachsonnaan; ava'l avanidaththil vanthapoathu, ava'loadea sayaniththaan; pi'rpaadu ava'l than theettu neengkumpadi suththikariththukko'ndu than veettukkup poanaa'l.
antha sthiree karppam thariththu, thaan karppavathiyen'ru thaaveethukku a'rivikkumpadi aa'l anuppinaa'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethu: eaththiyanaakiya uriyaavai ennidaththil anuppu en'ru yoavaapina'ndaikku aa'l anuppinaan; appadiyea yoavaap uriyaavaith thaaveethinidaththi'rku anuppinaan.
uriyaa avanidaththil vanthapoathu, thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: yoavaap sukamaayirukki'raanaa, janangka'l sukamaayirukki'raarka'laa, yuththaththin seythi na'rseythiyaa en'ru visaariththaan.

pinpu thaaveethu uriyaavai noakki: nee un veetti'rkup poay, paathasuththi sey en'raan; uriyaa raaja aramanaiyilirunthu pu'rappattapoathu, raajaavinidaththilirunthu uchchithamaana pathaarththangka'l avan pinnaalea anuppappattathu.
aanaalum uriyaa than veetti'rkkuppoakaamal, raaja aramanaiyin vaasalilea than aa'ndavanudaiya ellaach seavakaroadungkoodap paduththukko'ndirunthaan.

uriyaa than veetti'rkup poakavillaiyen'ru thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, thaaveethu uriyaavai noakki: nee paya'naththilirunthu vanthavan allavaa, nee un veetti'rkup poakaathirukki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan.

uriyaa thaaveethai noakki: pettiyum isravealum yoothaavum koodaarangka'lilea thangki, en aa'ndavanaakiya yoavaapum en aa'ndavanin seavakarum ve'liyilea paa'layami'rangkiyirukkaiyil, naan pusikki'ratha'rkum, kudikki'ratha'rkum, en manaiviyoadea sayanikki'ratha'rkum, en veettukku'l piraveasippeanaa? naan appadich seyki'rathillai en'ru ummudaiyapearilum ummudaiya aaththumaavinpearilum aa'naiyittuch solluki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu uriyaavai noakki: in'raikkum nee ingkeayiru; naa'laikku unnai anuppividuvean en'raan; appadiyea uriyaa an'rum ma'runaa'lum erusaleamil irunthaan.

thaaveethu avanaith thanakku munpaakap pusiththuk kudikki'ratha'rku azhaiththu, avanai ve'rikkappa'n'ninaan; aanaalum avan than veettukkup poakaamal, saayangkaalaththilea than aa'ndavanin seavakaroadea than padukkaiyilea paduththukko'ndaan.
kaalamea thaaveethu yoavaapukku oru nirupaththai ezhuthi, uriyaavin kaiyil koduththu anuppinaan.
antha nirupaththilea: mummuramaay nadakki'ra poarmukaththilea neengka'l uriyaavai ni'ruththi, avan vettu'ndu saakumpadikku, avanai vittup pinvaangkungka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirunthaan.
appadiyea yoavaap anthap patta'naththaich soozhak kaavalpoattirukkaiyil paraakkiramasaalika'l irukki'raarka'l en'ru thaan a'rintha idaththil uriyaavai ni'ruththinaan.
patta'naththu manushar pu'rappattuvanthu yoavaapoadea yuththampa'n'nukaiyil, thaaveethin seavakaraakiya janaththil silar pattaarka'l; eaththiyanaakiya uriyaavum seththaan.
appozhuthu yoavaap antha yuththaththin seythika'laiyellaam thaaveethukku a'rivikka aa'l anuppi,
thaan anuppuki'ra aa'lai noakki: nee yuththaththin seythika'laiyellaam raajaavukkuch sollith theernthapoathu,
raajaavukkuk koapam ezhumpi, avar: neengka'l patta'naththi'rku iththanai kittappoay yuththampa'n'navea'ndiyathu enna? alangkaththil nin'ru eyvaarka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuth theriyaathaa?

eruppeaseaththin kumaaran apimeleakkaik kon'rathu yaar? theapeasilea oru pe'npi'l'lai alangkaththilirunthu oru eanthirakkallin thu'ndai avanmeal poattathinaal allavoa avan seththaan; neengka'l alangkaththi'rku iththanai kittappoanathu enna en'ru unnoadea sonnaal, appozhuthu nee, ummudaiya seavakanaakiya uriyaa ennum eaththiyanum seththaan en'ru sol en'raan.
antha aa'l poay, udpiraveasiththu, yoavaap thannidaththil solliyanuppina seythika'laiyellaam thaaveethukku a'riviththu,
thaaveethaip paarththu: antha manushar kaimignchi, avarka'l ve'liyea engka'lukku ethiraakap pu'rappattu vanthapoathu, naangka'l patta'navaasalmattum avarka'laith thuraththinoam.
appozhuthu vilveerar alangkaththilirunthu ummudaiya seavakarinmeal eythathinaal, raajaavin seavakaril silar seththaarka'l; ummudaiya seavakanaakiya uriyaa ennum eaththiyanum seththaan en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu antha aa'lai noakki: nee yoavaapinidaththil poay, inthak kaariyaththaippat'ri visaarappadavea'ndaam; pattayam oruvea'lai oruvanaiyum, oruvea'lai vea'roruvanaiyum padchikkum; nee yuththaththaip palakkappa'n'ni, patta'naththai idiththuppoadu en'ru avanukkuth thidagnsol en'raan.
than purushanaakiya uriyaa seththaan en'ru avan manaivi kea'lvippattapoathu, ava'l than naayakanukkaaka izhavu ko'ndaadinaa'l.

thukkanaa'l sen'rapinpu, thaaveethu ava'lai azhaiththanuppi, than veettilea searththukko'ndaan; ava'l avanukku manaiviyaaki, avanukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l. thaaveethu seytha inthak kaariyam karththarin paarvaikkup pollaathathaayirunthathu.
karththar naaththaanaith thaaveethinidaththil anuppinaar; ivan avanidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: oru patta'naththil ira'ndu manushar irunthaarka'l, oruvan aisuvariyavaan, mat'ravan thariththiran.
aisuvariyavaanukku aadumaaduka'l veku thira'laayirunthathu.

thariththiranukkoa thaan ko'ndu va'larththa orea oru sinna aattukkuttiyaiththavira vea'ron'rum illaathirunthathu; athu avanoadum avan pi'l'laika'loadungkooda irunthu va'larnthu, avan vaayin appaththaith thin'ru, avan paaththiraththilea kudiththu, avan madiyilea paduththukko'ndu, avanukku oru maka'laippoala irunthathu.

antha aisuvariyavaanidaththil vazhippoakkan oruvan vanthaan; avan thannidaththil vantha vazhippoakkanukkuch samaiyal pa'n'nuvikka, thannudaiya aadumaaduka'lil on'raip pidikka manathillaamal, anthath thariththiranudaiya aattukkuttiyaip pidiththu, athaith thannidaththil vantha manushanukkuch samaiyal pa'n'nuviththaan en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: antha manushanmeal mikavum koapamoo'ndavanaaki, naaththaanaip paarththu: inthak kaariyaththaich seytha manushan mara'naththi'rkup paaththiran en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
avan irakkamat'ravanaayirunthu, inthak kaariyaththaich seythapadiyinaal, antha aattukkuttikkaaka naalaththanai thirumpach seluththavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu naaththaan thaaveethai noakki: neeyea antha manushan; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan unnai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ni, unnaich savulin kaikkuth thappuviththu,

un aa'ndavanudaiya veettai unakkuk koduththu, un aa'ndavanudaiya sthireeka'laiyum un madiyilea thanthu, israveal vamsaththaiyum, yoothaa vamsaththaiyum unakkuk kaiya'liththean; ithu poathaathirunthaal, innum unakku vea'ndiyathaith tharuvean.

karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaana inthak kaariyaththaich seythu, avarudaiya vaarththaiyai nee asattaipa'n'ninathu enna? eaththiyanaakiya uriyaavai nee pattayaththaal madiviththu, avan manaiviyai unakku manaiviyaaka eduththukko'ndu, avanai ammoan puththirarin pattayaththaalea kon'rupoattaay.
ippoathum nee ennai asattaipa'n'ni, eaththiyanaakiya uriyaavin manaiviyai unakku manaiviyaaka eduththukko'ndapadiyinaal, pattayam en'raikkum un veettaivittu vilakaathirukkum.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, naan un veettilea pollaappai unmeal ezhumpappa'n'ni, un ka'nka'l paarkka, un sthireeka'lai eduththu, unakku aduththavanukkuk koduppean; avan inthach sooriyanudaiya ve'lichchaththilea un sthireeka'loadea sayanippaan.
nee o'lippidaththil athaich seythaay; naanoa inthak kaariyaththai isravealar ellaarukku munpaakavum, sooriyanukku munpaakavum seyvippean en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu naaththaanidaththil: naan karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythean en'raan. naaththaan thaaveethai noakki: nee saakaathapadikku, karththar un paavam neengkachseythaar.

aanaalum inthak kaariyaththinaalea karththarudaiya saththurukka'l thooshikka nee kaara'namaayirunthapadiyinaal, unakkup pi'rantha pi'l'lai nichchayamaaych saakum en'ru solli, naaththaan than veettukkup poayvittaan.
appozhuthu karththar uriyaavin manaivi thaaveethukkup pet'ra aa'npi'l'laiyai adiththaar; athu viyaathippattuk keavalamaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu thaaveethu anthap pi'l'laikkaakath theavanidaththil piraarththanaipa'n'ni, upavaasiththu, u'l'lea poay, iraamuzhuthum tharaiyilea kidanthaan.
avanaith tharaiyilirunthu ezhunthirukkappa'n'na, avan veettilu'l'la moopparaanavarka'l ezhunthu, avana'ndaiyil vanthaalum, avan maattean en'ru solli, avarka'loadea appam saappidaamal irunthaan.

eazhaamnaa'lil, pi'l'lai seththuppoayit'ru. pi'l'lai seththuppoayit'ru en'ru thaaveethin oozhiyakkaarar avanukku a'rivikka aiyappattaarka'l: pi'l'lai uyiroadirukkaiyil, naam avaroadea peasuki'rapoathu, avar nammudaiya so'rkeadkavillai; pi'l'lai seththuppoayit'ru en'ru avaroadea eppadich solluvoam? athikamaaka viyaakulappaduvaarea en'ru peasikko'ndaarka'l.

thaaveethu than oozhiyakkaarar irakasiyamaayp peasikko'l'luki'rathaikka'ndu, pi'l'lai seththuppoayit'ru en'ru a'rinthu, than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: pi'l'lai seththuppoayit'roa en'ru keattaan; seththuppoayit'ru en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu tharaiyaivittu ezhunthu, snaanampa'n'ni, e'n'ney poosikko'ndu, than vasthirangka'lai maat'ri, karththarudaiya aalayaththil piraveasiththu, pa'ninthuko'ndu, than veettukkuvanthu, poajanam keattaan; avan munnea athai vaiththapoathu pusiththaan.

appozhuthu avan oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: neer seyki'ra inthak kaariyam enna? pi'l'lai uyiroadirukkaiyil upavaasiththu azhutheer; pi'l'lai mariththa pinpu, ezhunthirunthu asanampa'n'nuki'reerea en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: pi'l'lai innum uyiroadirukkaiyil, pi'l'lai pizhaikkumpadikkuk karththar enakku irangkuvaaroa, eppadiyoa, yaarukkuth theriyum en'ru upavaasiththu azhuthean.

athu mariththirukki'ra ippoathu naan upavaasikkavea'ndiyathu enna? ini naan athaith thirumpivarappa'n'nakkoodumoa? naan athinidaththukkup poaveanea allaamal, athu ennidaththukkuth thirumpi varappoaki'rathu illai en'raan.

pinpu thaaveethu than manaiviyaakiya pathseapaa'lukku aa'ruthal solli, ava'lidaththil poay, ava'loadea sayaniththaan; ava'l oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avanukkuch saalomoan en'ru pearittaan; avanidaththil karththar anpaayirunthaar.
avar theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanai anuppa, avan karththarin nimiththam avanukku yethithiyaa en'ru pearittaan.
atha'rku'l'lea yoavaap ammoan puththirarudaiya rappaapatta'naththinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, raajathaaniyaip pidiththu,
thaaveethinidaththil aa'l anuppi, naan rappaavinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, tha'n'neer oaramaana patta'naththaip pidiththukko'ndean.
naan patta'naththaip pidikki'rathinaal, en pear vazhangkaathapadikku, neer mat'ra janangka'laik koottikko'nduvanthu, patta'naththai mut'rikkaipoattu, pidikkavea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appadiyea thaaveethu janangka'laiyellaam koottikko'ndu, rappaavukkuppoay, athinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththaan.

avarka'ludaiya raajaavin thalaimealiruntha kireedaththai eduththukko'ndaan; athu oru thaalanthu ni'raiponnum, iraththinangka'l pathiththathumaayirunthathu; athu thaaveethinudaiya thalaiyil vaikkappattathu; patta'naththilirunthu earaa'lamaana ko'l'laiyaik ko'ndupoanaan.

pinpu athiliruntha janangka'lai avan ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avarka'lai vaa'lka'lukkum, iruppup paaraika'lukkum, iruppuk koadarika'lukkum udpaduththi, avarka'laich sengka'rsoo'laiyaiyum kadakkappa'n'ninaan; ippadi ammoan puththirarin patta'nangka'lukkellaam seythu, thaaveethu ellaa janaththoadungkooda erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaan.
itha'rkuppinpu thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya apsaloamukkuth thaamaar ennum pearu'l'la savunthariyamu'l'la oru sakoathari irunthaa'l; ava'lmeal thaaveethin kumaaran amnoan moakangko'ndaan.
than sakoathariyaakiya thaamaarinimiththam eakkangko'ndu viyaathippattaan; ava'l kanniyaasthireeyaayirunthaa'l; ava'lukkup pollaappuch seyya, amnoanukku varuththamaayk ka'ndathu.
amnoanukkuth thaaveethudaiya thamaiyan simiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaap ennum pearu'l'la oru sineakithan irunthaan; antha yoanathaap makaa thanthiravaathi.

avan ivanaip paarththu: raajakumaaranaakiya nee, naa'lukkunaa'l ethinaalea ippadi melinthupoaki'raay, enakkuch sollamaattaayaa en'raan. atha'rku amnoan: en sakoatharan apsaloamin sakoathariyaakiya thaamaarinmeal naan aasaivaiththirukki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu yoanathaap avanaippaarththu: nee viyaathikkaaranaippoala un padukkaiyinmeal paduththukko'l; unnaip paarkki'ratha'rku un thakappanaar varumpoathu, nee, en sakoathariyaakiya thaamaar vanthu, enakkup poajanamkoduththu, ava'l kaiyinaalea saappidumpadikku naan paarkka, en ka'nka'lukku munpaakach samaikkumpadi thayavuseyyavea'ndum en'ru sol en'raan.

appadiyea amnoan viyaathikkaaranpoal paduththukko'ndu, raajaa thannaip paarkkavanthapoathu, raajaavai noakki: en sakoathariyaakiya thaamaar vanthu naan ava'l kaiyinaalea saappidumpadikku, en ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ira'ndu nalla pa'niyaarangka'laip pa'n'numpadi uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu: veettukkuth thaamaaridaththil aa'l anuppi, nee un sakoatharanaakiya amnoan veettukkup poay, avanukkuch samaiyal pa'n'nikkodu en'ru sollachsonnaan.
thaamaar than sakoatharanaakiya amnoan paduththukko'ndirukki'ra veettukkup poay, maaveduththup pisainthu, avan ka'nka'lukku munpaakath thatti, pa'niyaarangka'laich suttu,

sattiyai eduththu, avanukku munpaaka avaika'lai vaiththaa'l; aanaalum avan saappidamaattean en'raan; pinpu amnoan: ellaarum ennaivittu ve'liyea poakattum en'raan; ellaarum avanai vittu ve'liyea poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu amnoan thaamaaraip paarththu: naan un kaiyinaalea saappidumpadikku, anthap palakaaraththai a'raiveettilea ko'nduvaa en'raan; appadiyea thaamaar thaan seytha pa'niyaarangka'lai a'raiveettil irukki'ra than sakoatharanaakiya amnoanidaththil ko'ndu poanaa'l.
avan saappidumpadikku ava'l avaika'laik kitta ko'nduvarukaiyil, avan ava'laip pidiththu, ava'laip paarththu: en sakoathariyea, nee vanthu ennoadea sayani en'raan.
atha'rku ava'l: vea'ndaam, en sakoatharanea, ennai avamaanappaduththaathea, isravealilea ippadich seyyaththakaathu; ippadippatta mathikeadaana kaariyaththaich seyyavea'ndaam.
naan en vedkaththoadea engkea poavean? neeyum isravealilea mathikettavarka'lil oruvanaippoala aavaay; ippoathum nee raajaavoadea peasu, avar ennai unakkuth tharaamal ma'rukkamaattaar en'raa'l.
avan ava'l sollaik keadkamaattean en'ru ava'laip palavanthamaayp pidiththu, ava'loadea sayaniththu, ava'laik ka'rpazhiththaan.

pi'rpaadu amnoan ava'lai mikavum ve'ruththaan; avan ava'lai virumpina viruppaththaip paarkkilum, ava'lai ve'ruththa ve'ruppu athikamaayirunthathu. aakaiyaal: nee ezhunthu poayvidu en'ru amnoan ava'loadea sonnaan.

appozhuthu ava'l: nee enakku munthi seytha aniyaayaththaippaarkkilum, ippozhuthu ennaith thuraththividuki'ra antha aniyaayam kodumaiyaayirukki'rathu en'raa'l; aanaalum avan ava'l sollaik keadka manathillaamal,
thannidaththil seavikki'ra than vealaikkaaranaik kooppittu: nee iva'lai ennai vittu ve'liyea tha'l'li, kathavaip poottu en'raan.

appadiyea avanidaththil seavikki'ravan ava'lai ve'liyea tha'l'li, kathavaip poottinaan; ava'l palavaru'namaana vasthiraththai uduththikko'ndirunthaa'l; raajakumaaraththika'laakiya kannikaika'l ippadikkoththa saalvaika'laith thariththukko'lvaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaamaar: than thalaiyinmeal saampalai vaarip poattukko'ndu, thaan thariththiruntha palavaru'namaana vasthiraththaik kizhiththu, than kaiyaith than thalaiyinmeal vaiththu, saththamittu azhuthuko'ndupoanaa'l.

appozhuthu ava'l sakoatharanaakiya apsaloam ava'laip paarththu: un sakoatharanaakiya amnoan unnoadirunthaanoa? ippoathum en sakoathariyea, nee mavunamaayiru; avan unnudaiya sakoatharan; inthak kaariyaththai un manathilea vaikkaathea en'raan; appadiyea thaamaar than sakoatharanaakiya apsaloamin veettil thaniththuk kileasappattukko'ndirunthaa'l.
thaaveethuraajaa inthach seythika'laiyellaam kea'lvippattapoathu, vekukoapamaayerinthaan.
apsaloam amnoanoadea nanmaiyaakilum theemaiyaakilum peasavillai; than sakoathariyaakiya thaamaarai amnoan ka'rpazhiththa kaariyaththinimiththam apsaloam avanaip pakaiththaan.

ira'ndu varusham sen'rapinpu, apsaloam eppiraayeemukkuch sameepamaana paalaathsoarilea aadka'lai vaiththu, aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'ra vealaiyil irunthaan; angkea raajakumaarar ellaaraiyum virunthukku azhaiththaan.
avan raajaavinidaththil poay, aadka'lai vaiththu aaduka'lai mayirkaththarikki'rean; raajaavum avarudaiya oozhiyakkaararum umathu adiyaanoadea varumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.

raajaa apsaloamaip paarththu: appadi vea'ndaam, en makanea; naangka'l ellaarum varuvoamaakil unakku veku selavu'ndaakum en'raan; avanai varunthikkeattaalum, avan poaka manathillaamal, avanai aaseervathiththaan.

appozhuthu apsaloam: athu koodaathirunthaal, en sakoatharanaakiya amnoanaavathu engka'loadea varumpadi avanukku uththaravu seyyum en'raan. atha'rku raajaa: avan unnoadea varavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.
apsaloam pinnaiyum avanai varunthik keattukko'ndapadiyinaal, avan amnoanaiyum, raajaavin kumaarar anaivaraiyum avanoadea poakavittaan.

apsaloam than vealaikkaararai noakki: amnoan thiraadcharasam kudiththuk ka'liththirukkum samayaththai nan'raayp paarththirungka'l; appozhuthu naan: amnoanai adiyungka'l en'ru solluvean; udanea neengka'l payappadaamal avanaik kon'rupoadungka'l; naan allavoa athai ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean; thidanko'ndu thairiyamaayirungka'l en'ru solliyirunthaan.
apsaloam ka'rpiththapadiyea apsaloamin vealaikkaarar amnoanukkuch seythaarka'l; appozhuthu raajakumaarar ellaarum ezhunthirunthu, avaravar thamtham koavea'ru kazhuthaiyinmeal ea'ri oadippoanaarka'l.
avarka'l vazhiyil irukki'rapoathea, apsaloam raajakumaararaiyellaam adiththuk kon'rupoattaan, avarka'lil oruvarum meenthirukka vidavillai enki'rathaay, thaaveethukkuch seythi vanthathu.
appozhuthu raajaa ezhunthirunthu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, tharaiyilea vizhunthukidanthaan; avan oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethin thamaiyanaakiya simiyaavin kumaaran yoanathaap vanthu: raajakumaararaana vaaliparaiyellaam kon'rupoattaarka'l en'ru en aa'ndavan ninaikkavea'ndaam; amnoanmaaththiram seththuppoanaan; avan than sakoathariyaakiya thaamaaraik ka'rpazhiththa naa'lmutha'rko'ndu, athu apsaloamin negnchil irunthathu.
ippoathum raajakumaararka'l ellaarum seththaarka'l enki'ra peachchai raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan thammudaiya manathilea vaikkavea'ndaam; amnoan oruvanea seththaan en'raan; apsaloam oadippoanaan.
jaamakkaarach seavakan than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ithoa, aneakam janangka'l thanakkup pinnaalea malai oaramaay varuki'rathaik ka'ndaan.
appozhuthu yoanathaap raajaavaip paarththu: ithoa, raajakumaarar varuki'raarka'l; umathu adiyean sonnapadiyea aayit'ru en'raan.
avan peasi mudinthapoathu, raajakumaarar vanthu, saththamittu azhuthaarka'l; raajaavum avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararum mikavum pulampi azhuthaarka'l.
apsaloamoa ammiyoothin kumaaranaakiya thalmaay ennum keasoorin raajaavinidaththi'rku oadippoanaan. thaaveethu thinanthoa'rum than kumaaranukkaakath thukkiththukko'ndirunthaan.
apsaloam keasoorukku oadippoay, angkea moon'ru varusham irunthaan.
thaaveethuraajaa amnoan seththapadiyinaal, avanukkaakath thukkiththu aa'ruthal adainthapoathu apsaloamaip pinthodarum ninaivai vittuvittaan.
raajaavin iruthayam apsaloaminmeal innum thaangkalaayirukki'rathaich serooyaavin kumaaran yoavaap ka'ndu,

avan thekkoavaavilirukki'ra puththiyu'l'la oru sthireeyai azhaiththu: nee izhavu ko'ndaaduki'rava'laippoala, thukkavasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu, e'n'ney poosikko'l'laamal, i'ranthupoanavanukkaaka nedunaa'l thukkikki'ra sthireeyaippoalak kaa'npiththu,
raajaavinidaththil poay, avarai noakki: inna inna pirakaaramaakach sol en'ru ava'l sollavea'ndiya vaarththaika'lai yoavaap ava'l vaayilea poattaan.
appadiyea thekkoavaa ooraa'laana antha sthiree raajaavoadea peasappoay, tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangki: raajaavea, iradchiyum en'raa'l.
raajaa ava'laip paarththu: unakku enna vea'ndum en'ratha'rku, ava'l: naan vithavaiyaanava'l, en purushan sen'rupoanaan.
umathu adiyaa'lukku ira'ndu kumaarar irunthaarka'l; avarka'l iruvarum ve'liyilea sa'ndaipa'n'ni, avarka'lai vilakka oruvarum illaathapadiyinaal, oruvan mat'ravanai adiththuk kon'rupoattaan.

vamsaththaar ellaarum ummudaiya adiyaa'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, than sakoatharanaik kon'rupoattavanai oppi; avan kon'ra avan sakoatharanudaiya piraa'nanukkaaka naangka'l avanaik kon'rupoaduvoam; suthantharavaa'lanaayinum avanaiyum azhiththuppoaduvoam enki'raarka'l. ippadi en purushanukkup pearum neethiyum poomiyinmeal vaikkappadaathapadikku, enakku innum meethiyaayirukki'ra po'riyaiyum aviththuppoada manathaayirukki'raarka'l en'raa'l.
raajaa antha sthireeyaip paarththu: nee un veettukkup poa, un kaariyaththaikku'riththu uththaravu koduppean en'raan.

pinnum anthath thekkoavaavoor sthiree raajaavaip paarththu: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, raajaavinmealum avar singkaasanaththinmealum kut'ramillaathapadikku, anthap pazhi enmealum en thakappan veettinmealum sumarakkadavathu en'raa'l.
atha'rku raajaa: unakku viroathamaakap peasuki'ravanai ennidaththil ko'nduvaa; appozhuthu avan ini unnaith thodaathiruppaan en'raan.

pinnum ava'l: iraththappazhi vaangkuki'ravarka'l azhimpuseythu, en kumaaranai athampa'n'nap perukippoakaathapadikku, raajaavaanavar thammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai ninaippaaraaka en'raa'l. atha'rku raajaa: un kumaaranudaiya mayiril on'raavathu tharaiyil vizhuvathillai en'ru karththarin jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu antha sthiree: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoadea umathu adiyaa'l oru vaarththaisolla uththaravaaka vea'ndum en'raa'l. avan: sollu en'raan.

appozhuthu antha sthiree: pinnai ean theavanudaiya janaththi'rku viroathamaay ippadippatta ninaivai neer ko'ndirukki'reer, thuraththu'nda thammudaiyavanai raajaa thirumpa azhaikkaathathinaalea, raajaa ippozhuthu sonna vaarththaiyinaal kut'ramu'l'lavaraippoal irukki'raar.

naam marippathu nichchayam, thirumpach searkkakkoodaathapadikku, tharaiyilea suva'ruki'ra tha'n'neeraippoal irukki'roam; theavan jeevanai eduththukko'l'laamal, thuraththu'ndavan mut'rilum thammaivittu vilakkappadaathirukkum ninaivuka'lai ninaikki'raar.

ippoathum naan en aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavoadea intha vaarththaiyaip peasavantha mukaantharam ennaven'raal: janangka'l enakkup payamu'ndaakkinathinaal, naan raajaavoadea peasavanthean; oruvea'lai raajaa thamathu adiyaa'ludaiya vaarththaiyinpadi seyvaar en'ru umathu adiyaa'laakiya naan ninaiththathinaalum vantheanea ozhiya vea'rillai.
ennaiyum en kumaaranaiyum eakamaayth theavanudaiya suthantharaththi'rkup pu'rampaakki, azhikka ninaikki'ra manushanudaiya kaikkuth thamathu adiyaa'lai neengkalaakkividumpadikku raajaa keadpaar.

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya vaarththai enakku aa'ruthalaayirukkum en'ru umathu adiyaa'laakiya naan e'n'ninean; nanmaiyaiyum theemaiyaiyum keadkumpadi, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan theavanudaiya thoothanaippoala irukki'raar; itha'rkaaka ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar ummoadeakooda irukki'raar en'raa'l.

appozhuthu raajaa antha sthireekkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan unnidaththil keadkum kaariyaththai nee enakku ma'raikkavea'ndaam en'raan. atha'rku antha sthiree, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavar solvaaraaka en'raa'l.

appozhuthu raajaa: ithilellaam yoavaap unakku udkaiyaay irukkavillaiyaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku sthiree pirathiyuththaramaaka, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan sonnatha'rkellaam valathupakkaththilaavathu idathupakkaththilaavathu vilakuvatha'rku oruvaraalum koodaathu en'ru raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; umathu adiyaanaakiya yoavaapthaan ithai enakkuk ka'rpiththu, avanea intha ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum umathu adiyaa'lin vaayilea poattaan.

naan inthak kaariyaththai upamaanamaayp peasuki'ratha'rku umathu adiyaanaakiya yoavaap atha'rkuk kaara'namaayirunthaan; aanaalum theasaththil nadakki'rathaiyellaam a'riya, en aa'ndavanudaiya gnaanam theavathoothanudaiya gnaanaththaippoal irukki'rathu en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa yoavaapaippaarththu: ithoa, inthak kaariyaththaich seyki'rean, nee poay apsaloam ennum pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaith thirumpa azhaiththukko'nduvaa en'raan.

appozhuthu yoavaap tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangki, raajaavai vaazhththi: raajaa thamathu adiyaanudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi seythathinaal, en aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavin ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaiththathu en'ru in'ru umathu adiyaanukkuth theriyavanthathu en'raan.
pinpu yoavaap ezhunthu, keasoorukkup poay, apsaloamai erusaleamukku azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan.
raajaa: avan en mukaththaip paarkkavea'ndiyathillai; than veettukkuth thirumpippoakattum en'raan; appadiyea apsaloam raajaavin mukaththaip paarkkaamal than veettukkuth thirumpippoanaan.
isravealar anaivarukku'l'lum apsaloamaippoal savunthariyamu'l'lavanum mechchikko'l'lappattavanum illai; u'l'langkaal thodangki uchchanthalaimattum avanil oru pazhuthum illaathirunthathu.
avan than thalaimayir thanakkup paaramaayiruppathinaal varushaantharam siraiththukko'l'luvaan; siraikkumpoathu, avan thalaimayir raajaavudaiya ni'raiyinpadi irunoo'ru seakkal ni'raiyaayirukkum.
apsaloamukku moon'ru kumaararum, thaamaar ennum pearko'nda oru kumaaraththiyum pi'ranthirunthaarka'l; iva'l roopavathiyaana pe'n'naayirunthaa'l.
apsaloam, raajaavin mukaththaikkaa'naamalea, ira'ndu varusham erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaan.
aakaiyaal apsaloam yoavaapai raajaavinidaththil anuppumpadi azhaippiththaan; avanoa avanidaththi'rku varamaattean en'raan; ira'ndaamvisaiyum avan azhaiththanuppinaan; avan varamaattean en'raan.

appozhuthu avan than vealaikkaararaip paarththu: ithoa en nilaththi'rku arukea yoavaapin nilam irukki'rathu; athilea avanukku vaa'rkoathumai vi'lainthirukki'rathu; neengka'l poay athaith theekko'luththippoadungka'l en'raan; appadiyea apsaloamin vealaikkaarar antha nilaththai theekko'luththippoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoavaap ezhunthirunthu, apsaloamidaththil veetti'rku'l poay, ennudaiya nilaththai ummudaiya vealaikkaarar theekko'luththippoattathu enna en'ru avanaik keattaan.

apsaloam yoavaapaip paarththu: ithoa, naan ean keasoorilirunthu vanthean; naan angkea irunthuvittaal nalam en'ru raajaavukkuch sollumpadi ummai raajaavinidaththil anuppuvatha'rkaaka ummai ingkea varumpadi azhaippiththean; ippoathum naan raajaavin mukaththaip paarkkattum; enmeal kut'ramirunthaal avar ennaik kon'rupoadattum en'raan.

yoavaap raajaavinidaththil poay, athai avanukku a'riviththapoathu, apsaloamai azhaippiththaan; avan raajaavinidaththil vanthu, raajaavukku munpaakath tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu va'nangkinaan, appozhuthu raajaa apsaloamai muththamittaan.
itha'rkuppinpu, apsaloam irathangka'laiyum kuthiraika'laiyum, thanakku mun oada aimpathu seavakaraiyum sampaathiththaan.

mealum apsaloam kaalaithoa'rum ezhunthirunthu, patta'naththu vaasalukkup poaki'ra vazhi oaraththilea nin'ruko'ndu, evanaakilum thanakku irukki'ra vazhakku mukaantharamaay raajaavinidaththil niyaayaththi'rkaakap poakumpoathu, avanai azhaiththu, nee entha ooraan en'ru keadpaan; avan umathu adiyaan israveal koaththirangka'lil on'rukkaduththa inna ooraan en'raal,
appozhuthu apsaloam avanai noakki: ithoa, un kaariyam nearmaiyum niyaayamumaayirukki'rathu; aanaalum raajaavinidaththilea un kaariyaththai visaarippaar oruvarum illai enpaan.
pinnum apsaloam: vazhakku viyaajyamu'l'lavarka'l ellaarum ennidaththil vanthu, naan avarka'lukku niyaayagnseyyumpadikku, ennai theasaththilea niyaayaathipathiyaaka vaiththaal nalamaayirukkum enpaan.
evanaakilum oruvan avanai va'nangkavarumpoathu, avan than kaiyai neetti avanaith thazhuvi, muththagnseyvaan.
inthappirakaaramaaka apsaloam raajaavinidaththil niyaayaththi'rkaaka varum isravealarukkellaam seythu, israveal manusharudaiya iruthayaththaik kavarnthuko'ndaan.
naa'rpathu varusham sen'rapinpu, apsaloam raajaavai noakki: naan karththarukkup pa'n'nina en poruththanaiyai eproanil seluththumpadikku naan poaka uththaravukodum.

karththar ennai erusaleamukkuth thirumpi varappa'n'ninaal, karththarukku aaraathanai seyvean en'ru umathu adiyaanaakiya naan seeriyaatheasaththil keasoorilea kudiyirukkumpoathu, poruththanaipa'n'ninean en'raan.
atha'rku raajaa, samaathaanaththoadea poa en'raan; appozhuthu avan ezhunthu eproanukkup poanaan.
apsaloam israveal koaththirangka'lukkellaam veavukaararai anuppi, neengka'l ekkaa'laththoniyaik keadkumpoathu, apsaloam eproanilea raajaavaanaan en'ru sollungka'l en'ru sollachsolli vaiththirunthaan.
erusaleamilirunthu varavazhaikkappatta irunoo'rupear apsaloamoadea koodappoanaarka'l; avarka'l vagnchakamin'ri a'riyaamaiyinaal poanaarka'l.

apsaloam palika'laich seluththumpoathu, thaaveethin aaloasanaikkaaranaakiya akiththoappeal ennum keeloaniyanaiyum avan ooraakiya keeloavilirunthu varavazhaippiththaan; appadiyea kattuppaadu palaththu, janangka'l apsaloaminidaththil thira'laay vanthu koodinaarka'l.
athai a'rivikki'ra oruvan thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, isravealil ovvoruvarudaiya iruthayamum apsaloamaippat'rippoaki'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu erusaleamilea thannidaththilu'l'la thannudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararaiyum noakki: ezhunthu oadippoavoam, illaavittaal naam apsaloamukkuth thappa idamillai; avan theeviriththu nammidaththil vanthu, nammaip pidiththu, nammeal pollaappu varappa'n'ni, nakaraththaip pattayakkarukkinaal sangkaarampa'n'naathapadikkuth theeviramaayp pu'rappadungka'l en'raan.
raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar raajaavaip paarththu: ithoa, raajaavaakiya engka'l aa'ndavan katta'laiyidum kaariyaththaiyellaam seyya umathu adiyaaraakiya naangka'l aayaththamaayirukki'roam en'raarka'l.
appadiyea raajaavum avanudaiya veettaar ellaarum kaalnadaiyaayp pu'rappattaarka'l; veettaikkaakka raajaa ma'rumanaiyaattika'laakiya paththu sthireeka'laip pinvaiththaan.
raajaavum samastha janangka'lum kaalnadaiyaayp pu'rappattu, sat'ruththooram poay, oru idaththilea thariththu nin'raarka'l.

avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum, kireaththiyar yaavarum pileaththiyar yaavarum avan pakkaththilea nadanthupoanaarka'l; kaaththoorilirunthu kaalnadaiyaay vanthiruntha a'runoo'rupearaakiya kiththiyar ellaarum raajaavukkumunpaaka nadanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa kiththiyanaakiya eeththaayaip paarththu: nee engka'ludaneakooda varuvaanean? nee thirumpippoay, raajaavudaneakooda iru; nee anniyatheasaththaan; nee un idaththi'rkuth thirumpip poakalaam.

nee neat'ruthaanea vanthaay; in'ru naan unnai engka'loadea nadanthuvarumpadikku azhaiththukko'ndu poakalaamaa? naan poakakkoodiya idaththi'rkup poaki'rean; nee un sakoathararaiyum azhaiththukko'ndu thirumpippoa; kirupaiyum u'nmaiyum unnoadea iruppathaaka en'raan.

aanaalum eeththaay raajaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan engkeayiruppaaroa, angkea umathu adiyaanum, seththaalum pizhaiththaalum, iruppaan en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaiyum raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya jeevanaiyum ko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu eeththaayai noakki: nadanthuvaa en'raan; appadiyea kiththiyanaakiya eeththaayum avanudaiya ellaa manusharum avanoadirukki'ra ellaap pi'l'laika'lum nadanthupoanaarka'l.

sakala janangka'lum nadanthupoaki'rapoathu, theasaththaar ellaarum makaa saththamaay azhuthaarka'l; raajaa keetharoan aat'raik kadanthaan; janangka'l ellaarum vanaantharaththi'rkup poaki'ra vazhiyea nadanthupoanaarka'l.

saathoakkum theavanudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyai avanoadeakooda irunthu sumakki'ra sakala leaviyarum vanthu, theavanudaiya pettiyai angkea vaiththaarka'l; janangka'l ellaarum nakaraththilirunthu kadanthutheerumattum, apiyaththaar thirumpippoayirunthaan.

raajaa saathoakkai noakki: theavanudaiya pettiyai nakaraththi'rkuth thirumpak ko'ndupoa; karththarudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaiththathaanaal, naan athaiyum avar vaasasthalaththaiyum paarkki'ratha'rku, ennaith thirumpa varappa'n'nuvaar.
avar: unmeal enakkup piriyamillai enpaaraakil, ithoa, ingkea irukki'rean; avar thammudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanapadi enakkuch seyvaaraaka en'raan.

pinnum raajaa aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkai noakki: nee gnaanathirushdikkaaran allavoa? nee samaathaanaththoadea nakaraththi'rkuth thirumpu; un makan akimaasum apiyaththaarin makan yoanaththaanumaakiya ungka'l kumaarar ira'ndupearum ungka'loadeakoodath thirumpip poakattum.
enakku a'rivikki'ratha'rku ungka'lidaththilirunthu seythivarumattum, naan vanaantharaththin ve'lika'lilea thariththiruppean en'raan.
appadiyea saathoakkum apiyaththaarum theavanudaiya pettiyai erusaleamukkuth thirumpak ko'ndupoay, angkea irunthaarka'l.
thaaveethu than mukaththai moodi, ve'rungkaalaal nadanthu azhuthuko'ndu, olivamalaiyinmeal ea'rippoanaan; avanoadiruntha sakala janangka'lum mukaththai moodi azhuthuko'ndu ea'rinaarka'l.

apsaloamoadea kattuppaadupa'n'ninavarka'ludan akiththoappealum searnthirukki'raan en'ru thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, thaaveethu: karththaavea, akiththoappealin aaloasanaiyaip payiththiyamaakkividuveeraaka en'raan.

thaaveethu malaiyin uchchimattumvanthu, angkea theavanaip pa'ninthuko'ndapoathu, ithoa, a'rkiyanaakiya oosaay than vasthiraththaik kizhiththukko'ndu, thalaiyinmeal puzhuthiyaip poattukko'ndavanaay avanukku ethirppattaan.
thaaveethu avanaip paarththu: nee ennoadeakooda nadanthuvanthaal enakkup paaramaayiruppaay.

nee nakaraththi'rkuth thirumpippoay, apsaloamai noakki: raajaavea, ummudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaayiruppean; mun naan ummudaiya thakappanukku oozhiyakkaaranaayirunthean; ippoathu naan umakku oozhiyakkaaran en'raayeayaakil, enakkaaka akiththoappealin aaloasanaiyai apaththamaakkuvaay.

unnoadea angkea saathoak apiyaththaar ennum aasaariyarka'l irukki'raarka'l allavaa? raajaavin veettilea pi'rakki'ra eatheathu seythi u'ndoa, ennenna kea'lvippaduki'raayoa, athaiyellaam saathoak apiyaththaar ennum aasaariyarka'lukku a'rivippaay.

angkea avarka'loadea saathoakkin makan akimaasum apiyaththaarin makan yoanaththaanum, avarka'l ira'ndu kumaararum irukki'raarka'l; neengka'l kea'lvippaduki'ra seythiyaiyellaam avarka'lvasamaay enakku anuppuveerka'laaka en'raan.
appadiyea thaaveethin sineakithanaakiya oosaay nakaraththi'rku vanthaan; apsaloamum erusaleamukku vanthaan.

thaaveethu malaiyuchchiyilirunthu sat'rappu'ram nadanthupoanapoathu, ithoa, meavipoaseaththin kaariyakkaaranaakiya seepaa, pothika'laich sumakki'ra ira'ndu kazhuthaika'lai oattikko'nduvanthu, avanaich santhiththaan; avaika'lil irunoo'ru appangka'lum, vat'ralaana noo'ru thiraadchappazhakkulaika'lum, vasanthakaalaththup palanaana noo'ru kulaika'lum, oru thuruththi thiraadcharasamum irunthathu.

raajaa seepaavaippaarththu: ivaika'l ennaththi'rku en'ru keattatha'rku, seepaa: kazhuthaika'l raajaavin veettaar ea'ruki'ratha'rkum, appangka'lum pazhangka'lum vaalipar pusikki'ratha'rkum, thiraadcharasam vanaantharaththil vidaayththuppoanavarka'l kudikki'ratha'rkumea en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa: un aa'ndavanudaiya kumaaran engkea en'ru keattatha'rku, seepaa raajaavai noakki: erusaleamil irukki'raan; in'ru israveal veettaar en thakappanudaiya raajyaththai en vasamaayth thirumpappa'n'nuvaarka'l en'raan en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu raajaa seepaavai noakki: meavipoaseaththi'rku u'ndaanathellaam unnudaiyathaayit'ru en'raan. atha'rkuch seepaa: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuth thayaikidaikkavea'ndum en'ru naan pa'ninthu keattukko'l'luki'rean en'raan.

thaaveethuraajaa pakoorimmattum vanthapoathu, ithoa, savul veettu vamsaththaanaayirukki'ra kearaavin kumaaranaakiya seemeayi ennum pearu'l'la oru manushan angkeayirunthu pu'rappattu, thooshiththukko'ndea nadanthuvanthu,

sakala janangka'lum, sakala palasaalika'lum, thaaveethin valathupu'ramaakavum idathupu'ramaakavum nadakkaiyil, thaaveethinmealum, thaaveethuraajaavudaiya sakala oozhiyakkaararmealum ka'rka'lai e'rinthaan.
seemeayi avanaith thooshiththu: iraththappiriyanea, pealiyaa'lin manushanea, tholainthupoa, tholainthupoa.

savulin sthalaththil raajaavaana unmeal karththar savul veettaarin iraththappazhiyaith thirumpappa'n'ninaar; karththar raajyapaaraththai un kumaaranaakiya apsaloamin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; ippoathum ithoa, un akkiramaththil akappattaay; nee iraththappiriyanaana manushan en'raan.
appozhuthu seruyaavin kumaaran apisaay raajaavai noakki: anthach seththanaay raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanai thooshippaanean? naan poay avan thalaiyai vaangkippoadattumea en'raan.

atha'rku raajaa: seruyaavin kumaararea, enakkum ungka'lukkum enna? avan ennaith thooshikkattum; thaaveethaith thooshikkavea'ndum en'ru karththar avanukkuch sonnaar; aakaiyaal ean ippadich seyki'raay en'ru keadkaththakkavan yaar en'raan.

pinnum thaaveethu apisaayaiyum than oozhiyakkaarar ellaaraiyum paarththu: ithoa, en karppappi'rappaana en kumaaranea en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeadumpoathu, inthap penyameenan eththanai athikamaaych seyvaan, avan thooshikkattum; appadich seyyak karththar avanukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'raar.
oruvea'lai karththar en si'rumaiyaip paarththu, intha naa'lil avan ninthiththa ninthanaikkup pathilaaka enakku nanmaiyaich sarikkattuvaar en'raan.

appadiyea thaaveethum avan manusharum vazhiyea nadanthupoanaarka'l; seemeayiyum malaiyin pakkaththilea avanukku ethiraaka nadanthu thooshiththu, avanukku ethiraakak ka'rka'lai e'rinthu, ma'n'naith thoot'rikko'ndea vanthaan.
raajaavum avanoadiruntha sakala janangka'lum vidaayththavarka'laay, thangkumidaththilea searnthu, i'laippaa'rinaarka'l.
apsaloamum israveal manusharaakiya sakala janangka'lum avanoadeakooda akiththoappealum erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l.
a'rkiyanaakiya oosaay ennum thaaveethin sineakithan apsaloamidaththil vanthapoathu, oosaay apsaloamai noakki: raajaavea vaazhka, raajaavea vaazhka en'raan.
appozhuthu apsaloam oosaayaip paarththu: un sineakithanmeal unakku irukki'ra thayai ithuthaanoa? un sineakithanoadea nee poakaatheapoanathu enna en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku oosaay apsaloamai noakki: appadi alla, karththarum intha janangka'lum israveal manushar anaivarum therinthuko'l'luki'ravaraiyea naan searnthu avaroadea iruppean.
ithuvum allaamal, naan yaaridaththil seavippean? avarudaiya kumaaranidaththil allavaa? ummudaiya thakappanidaththil eppadich seaviththeanoa, appadiyea ummidaththilum seavippean en'raan.
apsaloam akiththoappealaip paarththu, naangka'l seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru aaloasanai sollum en'raan.

appozhuthu akiththoappeal apsaloamai noakki: veettaikkaakka ummudaiya thakappan pinvaiththa avarudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattika'lidaththil piraveasiyum, appozhuthu ummudaiya thakappanukku naat'ramaayppoaneer enpathai isravealar ellaarum kea'lvippattu, ummoadirukki'ra ellaarudaiya kaika'lum palakkum en'raan.

appadiyea apsaloamukku upparikaiyinmeal oru koodaaraththaip poattaarka'l; angkea apsaloam sakala isravealarin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka, than thakappanudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattika'lidaththil piraveasiththaan.
annaadka'lil akiththoappeal sollum aaloasanai theavanudaiya vaakkaippoala irunthathu, appadi akiththoappealin aaloasanaiyellaam thaaveethukkum irunthathu, apsaloamukkum appadiyea irunthathu.
pinpu akiththoappeal apsaloamai noakki: naan panneeraayirampearaith therinthuko'ndu ezhunthu, in'ru iraaththiri thaaveethaip pinthodarnthu poakattum.

avan vidaayththavanum kaitha'larnthavanumaayirukkaiyil, naan avanidaththil poay, avanaith thidukkidappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu avanoadirukkum janangka'lellaarum oadippoavathinaal, naan raajaa oruvanaimaaththiram vetti,
janangka'laiyellaam ummudaiya vasamaayth thirumpappa'n'nuvean, ippadichseyya neer vakaitheadinaal, ellaarum thirumpinapin janangka'l samaathaanaththoadu iruppaarka'l en'raan.
intha vaarththai apsaloamin paarvaikkum, isravealudaiya sakala moopparin paarvaikkum nalamaayth thoan'rinathu.
aakilum apsaloam: a'rkiyanaakiya oosaayaik kooppittu, avan vaaymozhiyaiyum keadpoam en'raan.
oosaay apsaloamidaththil vanthapoathu, apsaloam avanaip paarththu: inthappirakaaramaaka akiththoappeal sonnaan; avan vaarththaiyinpadi seyvoamaa? allaven'raal, nee sol en'raan.
appozhuthu oosaay apsaloamai noakki: akiththoappeal inthavisai sonna aaloasanai nallathalla en'raan.

mealum oosaay: ummudaiya thakappanum avan manusharum palasaalika'l en'rum, ve'liyilea kuttika'laip pa'rikoduththa karadiyaippoala manameriki'ravarka'l en'rum neer a'riveer; ummudaiya thakappan yuththaveeranumaayirukki'raar; avar iraakkaalaththil janangka'loadea thangkamaattaar.

ithoa, avar ippozhuthu oru kepiyilaavathu, vea'rea yaathoaridaththilaavathu o'liththiruppaar; thuvakkaththileathaanea nammudaiyavarka'lil silar pattaarka'leayaanaal, athaik keadki'ra yaavarum apsaloamaip pinselluki'ra janangka'lil sangkaaram u'ndaayit'ru enpaarka'l.

appozhuthu singkaththin iruthayaththi'rkoththa iruthayamu'l'la palavaanaayirukki'ravanungkooda kalangkippoavaan; ummudaiya thakappan savuriyavaan en'rum, avaroadirukki'ravarka'l palasaalika'l en'rum, isravealar ellaarum a'rivaarka'l.

aathalaal naan solluki'ra yoasanaiyaavathu, thaa'nmuthal peyersepaamattum irukki'ra kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanai thiradchiyaana isravealar ellaarum umma'ndaiyil koottappattu, neerthaaneakooda yuththaththi'rkup poakavea'ndum.

appozhuthu avaraik ka'ndupidikki'ra evvidaththilaakilum naam avaridaththil poay, pani poomiyinmeal i'rangkuvathupoala avarmeal i'rangkuvoam; appadiyea avaroadirukki'ra ellaa manusharilum oruvanum avarukku meenthiruppathillai.

oru patta'naththi'rku'l pukunthaareayaanaal, isravealar ellaarum anthap patta'naththinmeal kayi'ruka'laip poattu, angkea oru podikkallum kaa'nappadaathea poakumattum, athai izhuththu aat'rilea poaduvaarka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu apsaloamum israveal manushar anaivarum: akiththoappealin aaloasanaiyaippaarkkilum a'rkiyanaakiya oosaayin aaloasanai nallathu en'raarka'l; ippadi karththar apsaloaminmeal pollaappai varappa'n'num poruttu, akiththoappealin nalla aaloasanaiyai apaththamaakkuki'ratha'rkuk karththar katta'laiyittaar.
pinpu oosaay, saathoak apiyaththaar ennum aasaariyarka'laip paarththu: inna innapadi akiththoappeal apsaloamukkum isravealin moopparukkum aaloasanai sonnaan; naanoa inna innapadi aaloasanai sonnean.

ippozhuthum neengka'l seekkiramaayth thaaveethukku a'rivikkumpadikkuch seythi anuppi: neer in'ru iraaththiri vanaantharaththin ve'lika'lilea thangkavea'ndaam; raajaavum avaroadirukki'ra sakala janangka'lum vizhungkappadaathapadikkuth thaamatham illaamal akkaraippadavea'ndum en'ru sollachsollungka'l en'raan.

yoanaththaanum akimaasum, thaangka'l nakaraththil piraveasikki'rathinaal kaa'nappadaathapadikku, entoakeal a'ndai nin'ruko'ndirunthaarka'l; oru vealaikkaari poay, athai avarka'lukkuch sonnaa'l; avarka'l thaaveethu raajaavukku athai a'rivikkappoanaarka'l.

oru pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan avarka'laik ka'ndu, apsaloamukku a'riviththaan; aakaiyaal avarka'l iruvarum seekkiramaayp poay, pakoorimilirukki'ra oru manushan veetti'rku'l piraveasiththaarka'l; avan mut'raththil oru ki'na'ru irunthathu; athil i'rangkinaarka'l.
veettukkaari oru paayai eduththu, ki'nat'ruvaayinmeal viriththu, kaariyam ve'lippadaathapadikku, athinmeal noyyaip parappivaiththaa'l.

apsaloamin seavakar antha sthireeyinidaththil veetti'rku'l vanthu: akimaasum yoanaththaanum engkea en'ru keattaarka'l; avarka'lukku antha sthiree: vaaykkaalukku appaalea poayvittaarka'l en'raa'l; ivarka'l theadikkaa'naatheapoay, erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaarka'l.

ivarka'l poanapi'rpaadu, avarka'l ki'nat'rilirunthu ea'rivanthu, thaaveethuraajaavukku a'riviththu, thaaveethai noakki: seekkiramaay ezhunthu aat'raik kadanthupoangka'l; innapadi akiththoappeal ungka'lukku viroathamaay aaloasanai sonnaan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethum avanoadiruntha sakala janangka'lum ezhunthu yoarthaanaik kadanthupoanaarka'l; pozhuthu vidiki'ratha'rku'l'laaka yoarthaanaik kadavaathavan oruvanum illai.

akiththoappeal than yoasanaiyinpadi nadakkavillai en'ru ka'ndapoathu, than kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththu ea'ri, than oorilirukki'ra than veettukkup poay, than veettukkaariyangka'lai ozhungkupaduththi, naan'ruko'ndu seththaan; avan thakappan kalla'raiyil avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
thaaveethu maknaayeemukku vanthaan; apsaloamum sakala isravealaroadungkooda yoarthaanaik kadanthaan.

apsaloam, yoavaapukkup pathilaaka amaasaavai iraa'nuvaththalaivanaakkinaan; intha amaasaa, naakaasin kumaaraththiyum seruyaavin sakoathariyum yoavaapin aththaiyumaakiya apikaayilaip padaiththa isravealanaakiya eththiraa ennum pearu'l'la oru manushanudaiya kumaaranaayirunthaan.
israveal janangka'lum apsaloamum keeleayaath theasaththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.

thaaveethu maknaayeemil searnthapoathu, ammoan puththirarin theasaththu rappaa patta'naththaanaakiya soapi ennum naakaasin kumaaranum, loatheapaar ooraanaana ammiyealin kumaaran maakeerum, roakilim ooraanum keeleayaaththiyanumaakiya parsilaavum,

meththaika'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum, ma'npaa'ndangka'laiyum, koathumaiyaiyum, vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum, maavaiyum, va'ruththa payat'raiyum, perum payat'raiyum, si'ru payat'raiyum, va'ruththa si'ru payat'raiyum,

theanaiyum, ve'n'neyaiyum, aaduka'laiyum, paalkattika'laiyum, thaaveethukkum avanoadiruntha janangka'lukkum saappiduki'ratha'rkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l; antha janangka'l vanaantharaththilea pasiyum i'laippum thavanamumaayiruppaarka'l en'ru ippadich seythaarka'l.
thaaveethu thannoadiruntha janangka'lai ilakkam paarththu, avarka'lmeal aayiraththukku athipathika'laiyum, noot'rukku athipathika'laiyum vaiththu,

pinpu thaaveethu janangka'lil moon'ril oru pangkai yoavaapin vasamaakavum, moon'ril oru pangkaich seruyaavin kumaaranum yoavaapin sakoatharanumaana apisaayin vasamaakavum, moon'ril oru pangkaik kiththiyanaakiya eeththaayin vasamaakavum anuppi: naanum ungka'loadeakoodap pu'rappattu varuvean en'ru raajaa janangka'lidaththil sonnaan.

janangka'loa: neer pu'rappadavea'ndaam; naangka'l mu'rinthoadippoanaalum, avarka'l engka'l kaariyaththai oru poruttaaka e'n'namaattaarka'l; engka'lil paathippear seththuppoanaalum, engka'l kaariyaththaippat'rik kavalaippadamaattaarka'l; neeroa, engka'lil pathinaayirampearukkuch sari; neer patta'naththil irunthuko'ndu, engka'lukku uthaviseyki'rathu engka'lukku nalamaayirukkum en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa avarka'laip paarththu: ungka'lukku nalamaayth thoan'ruki'rathaich seyvean en'ru solli, raajaa olimukavaasal oaraththilea nin'raan; janangka'l ellaarum noo'runoo'raakavum, aayiram aayiramaakavum pu'rappattaarka'l.

raajaa yoavaapaiyum, apisaayaiyum, eeththaayaiyum noakki: pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaakiya apsaloamai ennimiththam methuvaay nadappiyungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan; ippadi raajaa apsaloamaikku'riththu athipathika'lukkellaam katta'laiyittathai janangka'l ellaarum keattirunthaarka'l.
janangka'l ve'liyea isravealarukku ethiraakap pu'rappattapi'rpaadu, eppiraayeem kaattilea yuththam nadanthathu.
angkea israveal janangka'l thaaveethin seavakarukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattaarka'l; angkea an'raiyathinam irupathinaayirampear madiyaththakkathaaka periya sangkaaram u'ndaayit'ru.
yuththam antha theasam engkum paranthathu; an'raiyathinam pattayam padchiththa janangka'laippaarkkilum, kaadu padchiththa janam athikam.

apsaloam thaaveethin seavakarukku ethirppattaan; apsaloam koavea'ru kazhuthaiyinmeal ea'rivarumpoathu, anthak koavea'rukazhuthai sannalpinnalaana oru periya karvaali maraththinkeezh vanthathinaal, avanudaiya thalai karvaalimaraththil maattikko'ndu, avan vaanaththukkum poomikkum naduvea thongkinaan; avan ea'riyiruntha koavea'rukazhuthai appaalea poayit'ru.
athai oruvan ka'ndu, yoavaapukku a'riviththu: ithoa, apsaloamai oru karvaalimaraththilea thongkakka'ndean en'raan.

appozhuthu yoavaap thanakku athai a'riviththavanai noakki: nee athaik ka'ndaayea; pinnai ean avanai angkea vetti, tharaiyilea tha'l'lippoadavillai? naan unakkup paththu ve'l'likkaasaiyum oru kachchaiyaiyum kodukkak kadamaiyu'l'lavanaayiruppeanea en'raan.

antha manushan yoavaapai noakki: en kaika'lil aayiram ve'l'likkaasu ni'ruththuk kodukkappattaalum, naan raajaavudaiya kumaaranmeal en kaiyai neettamaattean; pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaakiya apsaloamai neengka'l avaravar kaappaat'rungka'l en'ru raajaa umakkum apisaaykkum eeththaaykkum engka'l kaathuka'l keadkak katta'laiyittaarea.
raajaavukku oru kaariyamum ma'raivaayirukkamaattaathu; aathalaal, naan athaich seyveanaakil, en piraa'nanukkea viroathamaakach seypavanaavean, neerum enakku viroathamaayiruppeer en'raan.

aathalaal yoavaap: naan ippadi unnoadea peasi, thaamathikkamaattean en'ru solli, than kaiyilea moon'ru vallayangka'lai eduththukko'ndu, apsaloam innum karvaalimaraththin naduvilea uyiroadea thongkukaiyil, avaika'lai avan negnchilea kuththinaan.
appozhuthu yoavaapin aayuthathaarika'laakiya paththu seavakar apsaloamaich soozhnthu avanai adiththuk kon'rupoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoavaap ekkaa'lam oothi janangka'lai ni'ruththippoattapadiyinaal, janangka'l isravealaip pinthodaruki'rathai vittuth thirumpinaarka'l.

avarka'l apsaloamai eduththu, avanaik kaattilu'l'la oru periya kuzhiyilea poattu, avanmeal makaa periya ka'rkuviyalaik kuviththaarka'l; isravealar ellaarum avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.

apsaloam uyiroadea irukkaiyil: en pearai ninaikkappa'n'numpadiyaaka enakkuk kumaaran illai en'ru solli, raajaavin pa'l'laththaakkilea thanakken'ru oru thoo'nai ni'ruththi, anthath thoo'nukkuth than pearaith thariththirunthaan; athu innaa'lvaraikkum apsaloamin adaiyaa'lam en'ru sollappadum.
saathoakkin kumaaranaakiya akimaas: karththar raajaavai avar saththurukka'lin kaikku neengkalaakki niyaayagnseythaar ennum seythiyai avarukkuk ko'ndupoaka, naan oadattumea en'raan.

yoavaap avanai noakki: in'raiyathinam nee seythiyaik ko'ndupoakakkoodaathu; innorunaa'lilea nee seythiyaik ko'ndupoakalaam; raajaavin kumaaran seththapadiyinaal, in'raikku nee seythiyaik ko'ndupoakavea'ndaam en'ru solli,
yoavaap kooshiyai noakki: nee poay ka'ndathai raajaavukku a'rivi en'raan; kooshi yoavaapai va'nangki oadinaan.

saathoakkin kumaaranaakiya akimaas innum yoavaapai noakki: eppadiyaanaalum kooshiyin pi'rakaalea naanum oadattumea en'ru thirumpak keattatha'rku, yoavaap: en makanea, sollumpadi unakku nalla seythi illaathirukkaiyil, nee oadavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.
atha'rku avan: eppadiyaanaalum naan oaduvean en'raan; appozhuthu yoavaap: oadu en'raan; appadiyea akimaas samanaana poomivazhiyaayoadik kooshikku munthikko'ndaan.

thaaveethu ira'ndu olimukak kevuni vaasalukku naduvaaka udkaarnthirunthaan; jaamangkaakki'ravan alangkaththilirukki'ra kevuniyinmeal nadanthu, than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, ithoa, oru manushan thaniyea oadivaruki'rathaik ka'ndu,
kooppittu raajaavukku a'riviththaan. appozhuthu raajaa: avan oruvanaay vanthaal, avan vaayilea nallaseythi irukkum en'raan; avan oadi kittavarumpoathu,

jaamangkaakki'ravan, vea'roruvan oadivaruki'rathaik ka'ndu: athoa pinnoruvan thaniyea oadivaruki'raan en'ru vaasal kaakki'ravanoadea kooppittuch sonnaan; appozhuthu raajaa: avanum nalla seythi ko'nduvaruki'ravan en'raan.

mealum jaamangkaakki'ravan: munthinavanudaiya oattam saathoakkin kumaaran akimaasudaiya oattampoalirukki'rathu en'ru enakkuth thoan'ruki'rathu en'raan; appozhuthu raajaa: avan nalla manushan; avan nalla seythi solla varuki'raan en'raan.
