akimaas vanthu raajaavai noakki: samaathaanam en'ru solli, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, raajaavai va'nangki, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukku viroathamaayth thangka'l kaika'lai eduththa manusharai oppukkoduththirukki'ra ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa: pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaakiya apsaloam sukamaayirukki'raanaa en'ru keattatha'rku, akimaas yoavaap raajaavin vealaikkaaranaiyum ummudaiya adiyaanaiyum anuppuki'rapoathu, oru periya santhadiyirunthathu; aanaalum athu innathen'ru theriyaathu en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa: nee angkea poay nil en'raan; avan oru pakkaththil poay nin'raan.
ithoa, kooshi vanthu: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, na'rseythi, in'ru karththar umakku viroathamaayezhumpina ellaarin kaikkum ummai neengkalaakki niyaayagnseythaar en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa kooshiyaip paarththu: pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanaakiya apsaloam sukamaayirukki'raanaa en'ru keattatha'rku, kooshi enpavan: anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaanukku nadanthathupoala, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya saththurukka'lukkum, pollaappuch seyya umakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ra yaavarukkum nadakkakkadavathu en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa mikavum kalangki, kevunivaasalin mealveetti'rku'l ea'rippoay azhuthaan; avan ea'rippoakaiyil: en makanaakiya apsaloamea, en makanea, en makanaakiya apsaloamea, naan unakkup pathilaakach seththeanaanaal nalamaayirukkum; apsaloamea, en makanea, en makanea, en'ru solli azhuthaan.
ithoa, raajaa apsaloamukkaaka azhuthu pulampuki'raar en'ru yoavaapukku a'rivikkappattathu.
raajaa thammudaiya kumaaranukkaaka manamnonthirukki'raar en'ru an'raiyathinam janangka'l kea'lvippattaarka'l; athinimiththam an'raiyathinam antha jeyam janaththi'rkellaam thukkamaay maa'rit'ru.
yuththaththil mu'rinthoaduki'rathinaal vedkappattuth thirutta'lavaay varuki'ravarka'lpoala, janangka'l an'raiyathinam thirutta'lavaayp patta'naththi'rku'l vanthaarka'l.
raajaa than mukaththai moodikko'ndu, makaa saththamaay: en makanaakiya apsaloamea, apsaloamaakiya en makanea, en makanea en'ru ala'rikko'ndirunthaan.

appozhuthu yoavaap veetti'rku'l'lea raajaavinidaththil poay: in'ru ummudaiya jeevanaiyum, ummudaiya kumaarar kumaaraththika'lin jeevanaiyum, ummudaiya manaivika'lin jeevanaiyum, ummudaiya ma'rumanaiyaattika'lin jeevanaiyum thappuviththa ummudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaarin mukaththaiyum vedkappaduththineer; in'ru neer ummaip pakaikki'ravarka'laich sineakiththu, ummaich sineakikki'ravarka'laip pakaikki'reer en'ru vi'langkuki'rathu.

athipathika'lum seavakarum umakku a'rpamaanavarka'l en'ru in'ru vi'langkappa'n'nuki'reer; apsaloam uyiroadirunthu, naangka'l anaivarum in'ru seththuppoanaal, appozhuthu ummudaiya paarvaikku nalamaayirukkum en'ru in'ru a'rinthuko'ndean.

ippoathum ezhunthirunthu ve'liyea vanthu, ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararoadea anpaayp peasum; neer ve'liyea varaathirunthaal, in'ru iravu oruvarum ummoadea thangkiyiruppathillai en'ru karththarmeal aa'naiyiduki'rean; appozhuthu ummudaiya si'ruvayathumuthal ithuvaraikkum umakku nearitta ellaath theemaiyaippaarkkilum, athu umakku athika theemaiyaayirukkum en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa ezhunthupoay, olimukavaasalil udkaarnthaan; ithoa, raajaa olimukavaasalil udkaarnthirukki'raar en'ru sakala janangka'lukkum a'rivikkappattapoathu, janangka'l ellaarum raajaavukku munpaaka vanthaarka'l; isravealaroavenil avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.

isravealudaiya sakala koaththirangka'lilumu'l'la sakala janangka'lukku'l'lum vaakkuvaatham u'ndaaki, avarka'l: raajaa nammudaiya saththurukka'lin kaikku nammai neengkalaakkivittaar, avarthaanea pelistharin kaikku nammaith thappuviththaar; ippoathoa apsaloamukkuth thappa, theasaththaivittu oadippoanaar.
namakku raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'nivaiththa apsaloam yuththaththilea seththaan; ippoathum raajaavaith thirumpa azhaiththu varaamal neengka'l summaayiruppaanean en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l.

ippadi isravealar ellaarum peasikko'ndirukki'rathu, raajaa irukki'ra veettilea avanukkuk kea'lviyaanapadiyinaal, thaaveethuraajaa saathoak apiyaththaar ennum aasaariyarka'lidaththukku aa'l anuppi, neengka'l yoothaavin moopparoadea peasi: raajaavaith thammudaiya veettukkuth thirumpa azhaiththuvara neengka'l mat'ravarka'lukkup pinthippoavaanean?
neengka'l en sakoatharar, neengka'l en elumpum en maamsamumaanavarka'l; raajaavaith thirumpa azhaiththuvara neengka'l pinthinavarka'laayiruppaanean en'ru sollungka'l.

neengka'l amaasaavaiyum noakki: nee en elumpum en maamsamum allavoa? nee yoavaapukkup pathilaaka ennaa'lum enakku munpaakap padaiththalaivanaayiraavittaal, theavan atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavar en'ru sollachsonnaan.

ippadiyea yoothaavin sakala manusharudaiya iruthayaththaiyum oru manushanudaiya iruthayaththaippoal i'nangkappa'n'ninathinaal, avarka'l raajaavukku: neer ummudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararoadum thirumpivaarum en'ru solli anuppinaarka'l.
raajaa thirumpa varuki'ratha'rku yoarthaanmattum vanthapoathu, yoothaa koaththiraththaar raajaavukku ethirko'ndupoay, raajaavai yoarthaanaik kadakkappa'n'na kilkaalmattum vanthaarka'l.
pakoorim ooraanaana penyameenanaakiya kearaavin makan seemeayiyum theeviriththu, yoothaa manusharoadungkoodath thaaveethu raajaavukku ethirko'ndupoanaan.

avanoadea penyameen manushar aayirampearum, savulin veettu vealaikkaaranaakiya seepaavum, avanoadeakooda avanudaiya pathinainthu kumaararum, avanudaiya irupathu vealaikkaararum irunthaarka'l; avarka'l raajaavukku munpaaka yoarthaanai veakamaayk kadanthupoanaarka'l.

avarka'l raajaavin veettaarai ikkaraippaduththavum, avan virumpum kaariyaththukku uthavavum, oru padaku ikkaraiyilea vanthathu; appozhuthu kearaavin kumaaranaakiya seemeayi yoarthaanaik kadakkappoaki'ra raajaavukku munpaakath thaazhavizhunthu,

raajaavai noakki: en aa'ndavan en akkiramaththai enmeal sumaththaamalum, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan erusaleamilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'ra naa'lilea, umathu adiyaan seytha thuroakaththai raajaa ninaikkaamalum, thamathu manathil vaikkaamalum iruppaaraaka.

umathu adiyaanaakiya naan paavagnseythean en'ru a'rinthirukki'rean; ippoathum, ithoa, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukku ethirko'nduvara, yoaseappu veettaar anaivarukkum naan in'ru munthikko'ndean en'raan.
appozhuthu seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya apisaay pirathiyuththaramaaka: karththar apisheakampa'n'ninavaraich seemeayi thooshiththapadiyinaal, avanai atha'rkaakak kollavea'ndaamaa en'raan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu: seruyaavin kumaararea, in'ru neengka'l enakkuch saththurukka'laaki'ratha'rku, enakkum ungka'lukkum enna? in'ru isravealil oruvan kollappadalaamaa? in'ru naan isravealinmeal raajaavaanean en'ru enakkuth theriyaathaa en'ru solli,
raajaa seemeayiyaip paarththu: nee saavathillai en'ru avanukku aa'naiyittaan.

savulin kumaaranaakiya meavipoaseaththum raajaavukku ethirko'nduvanthaan; raajaa poananaa'lmuthal, avan samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivaruki'ra naa'lmattum, avan than kaalka'laich suththampa'n'navumillai, than thaadiyaich savarampa'n'navumillai; than vasthirangka'lai ve'lukkavumillai.
avan erusaleamilirunthu raajaavukku ethirko'ndu varuki'rapoathu, raajaa avanaip paarththu: meavipoaseaththea, nee ennoadukooda varaamalpoanathu enna en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, en vealaikkaaran ennai moasampoakkinaan; umathu adiyaanaakiya naan mudavanaanapadiyinaal, oru kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththu athinmeal ea'ri, raajaavoadeakoodap poaki'rean en'ru adiyean sonnean.

avan raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanidaththil umathu adiyaanmeal vee'npazhi sonnaan; raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoa theavanudaiya thoothanaippoala irukki'raar; umathu paarvaikku nalamaayth thoan'ruki'rapadi seyyum.

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukku munpaaka en thakappan veettaar ellaarum saavukku eathuvaayirunthaarka'lea ozhiya, mat'rappadi alla; aanaalum umathu panthiyilea saappiduki'ravarka'loadea umathu adiyeanai vaiththeer; innum naan raajaavidaththil mu'raiyida, ini enakku enna niyaayam irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa avanaip paarththu: un kaariyaththaikku'riththu athikamaayp peasuvaanean? neeyum seepaavum nilaththaip pangkittukko'l'lungka'l en'ru naan solluki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku meavipoaseath raajaavai noakki: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan samaathaanaththoadea thammudaiya veetti'rku vanthirukkumpoathu, avanea ellaavat'raiyum eduththukko'l'lattum en'raan.
keeleayaaththiyanaakiya parsilaavum roakilimilirunthu vanthu, yoarthaanmattum raajaavai vazhivittanuppa, avanoadeakooda yoarthaanin thu'raimattum kadanthuvanthaan.
parsilaa e'npathu vayathusen'ra kizhavanaayirunthaan; raajaa maknaayeemilea thangkiyirukkumattum avanaip paraamariththu vanthaan; avan makaa periya manushanaayirunthaan.
raajaa parsilaavai noakki: nee ennoadeakoodak kadanthuvaa, erusaleamilea unnai ennidaththil vaiththup paraamarippean en'raan.
parsilaa raajaavaip paarththu: naan raajaavoadeakooda erusaleamukku vara, naan innum uyiroadirukkum aayusin naadka'l emmaaththiram?

ippozhuthu naan e'npathu vayathu'l'lavan; ini nalamaanathu innathen'rum theethaanathu innathen'rum enakkuth theriyumoa? pusikki'rathum kudikki'rathum umathu adiyeanukku rusikaramaayirukkumoa? sangkeethakkaarar sangkeethakkaarika'ludaiya saththaththai inik keadkakkoodumoa? umathu adiyeanaakiya naan ini raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukkup paaramaayirukkavea'ndiyathu enna?
adiyean kognchathooram yoarthaanmattum raajaavoadeakooda varuvean; atha'rku raajaa ivva'lavu periya upakaaraththai enakkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu enna?

naan en oorilea mariththu, en thaay thakappanmaar kalla'raiyilea adakkampa'n'nappadumpadikku, umathu adiyaan thirumpippoakattum; aanaalum, ithoa, umathu adiyaanaakiya kimkaam raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoadeakooda varuvaan; ummudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanapadi avanukkuch seyyum en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa: kimkaam ennoadeakooda varattum; un paarvaikku nalamaanapadiyea naan avanukku nadappiththu, nee ennidaththil vea'ndikko'lvathaiyellaam naan unakkuch seyvean en'raan.
janangka'l ellaarum yoarthaanaik kadanthapoathu, raajaa parsilaavai muththamittu avanai aaseervathiththu, thaanum kadanthupoanaan; avanoa thannidaththi'rkuth thirumpippoayvittaan.
raajaa kadanthu, kilkaalmattum poanaan; kimkaam avanoadeakoodak kadanthuvanthaan; yoothaa janam anaiththum, isravealil paathijanamum, raajaavai ikkaraippaduththi vanthapinpu,

ithoa, israveal manushar ellaarum raajaavinidaththil vanthu, raajaavai noakki: engka'l sakoathararaakiya yoothaa manushar thirutta'lavaay ummai azhaiththuvanthu, raajaavaiyum, avar veettaaraiyum, avaroadeakooda irukki'ra thaaveethin manushar anaivaraiyum, yoarthaanaik kadakkappa'n'ninathu enna en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu yoothaa manushar ellaarum israveal manusharukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaa engka'laich searnthavaraanapadiyinaal ithaich seythoam; itha'rkaaka neengka'l koapippaanean? naangka'l raajaavin kaiyilea eathaakilum vaangkith thin'roamoa? engka'lukku vekumaanam kodukkappattathoa? en'raarka'l.

israveal manusharoa yoothaa manusharukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaavinidaththil engka'lukkup paththuppangku irukki'rathu; ungka'laippaarkkilum engka'lukkuth thaaveethinidaththil athika urimai u'ndu; pinnai ean engka'lai a'rpamaay e'n'nineerka'l; engka'l raajaavaith thirumpa azhaiththuvaravea'ndum en'ru munthich sonnavarka'l naangka'l allavaa en'raarka'l; aanaalum israveal manusharin peachchaippaarkkilum yoothaa manusharin peachchu palaththathu.

appozhuthu penyameen manushanaana pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaa ennum pearu'l'la pealiyaa'lin manushan oruvan tha'rseyalaay angkea irunthaan; avan ekkaa'lam oothi: engka'lukkuth thaaveethinidaththil pangkum illai, eesaayin kumaaranidaththil engka'lukkuch suthantharamum illai; isravealea, neengka'l avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poayvidungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu israveal manushar ellaarum thaaveethai vittup pinvaangki, pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaavaip pinpat'rip poanaarka'l; yoarthaan thodangki erusaleammattumu'l'la yoothaamanushar thangka'l raajaavaich saarnthirunthaarka'l.

thaaveethu erusaleamilu'l'la than veettukku vanthapoathu, veettaik kaakka raajaa pinvaiththuppoana paththu ma'rumanaiyaattika'laiyum varuviththu, avarka'lai oru kaaval veettilea vaiththup paraamariththaan; appu'ram avarka'lidaththil avan piraveasikkavillai; appadiyea avarka'l saaki'ra naa'lmattum adaikkappattu, uyiroadirukki'ra naa'lellaam vithavaika'lpoal irunthaarka'l.
pinpu raajaa amaasaavaip paarththu: nee yoothaa manusharai moon'runaa'laikku'l'lea ennidaththil varavazhaiththu, neeyum koodavanthu irukkavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu amaasaa: yoothaavai azhaippikkap poay, thanakkuk ku'riththa kaalaththilea varaamal thaamathiththirunthaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu apisaayaip paarththu: apsaloamaippaarkkilum pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaa, ippozhuthu namakkup pollaappuch seyvaan; avan ara'naana patta'nangka'lil vanthadainthu, nammudaiya ka'nka'lukkuth thappippoakaathapadikku, nee un ejamaanudaiya seavakaraik koottikko'ndu, avanaip pinthodarnthupoa en'raan.
appadiyea yoavaapin manusharum, kireaththiyarum pileaththiyarum, sakala palasaalika'lum avan pi'rakaalea pu'rappattu, pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaavaip pinthodara erusaleamilirunthu poanaarka'l.

avarka'l kipiyoan kitta irukki'ra periya kalla'ndaiyilea vanthapoathu, amaasaa avarka'lukku ethirppattuvanthaan; yoavaapoa, thaan uduththikko'ndirukki'ra than sattaiyinmeal oru kachchaiyaik kattikko'ndirunthaan; athil u'raiyoadea oru pattayam avan iduppa'ndaiyilea thongkit'ru; avan pu'rappadukaiyil athu vizhunthathu.
appozhuthu yoavaap amaasaavaip paarththu: en sakoatharanea, sukamaayirukki'raayaa en'ru solli, amaasaavai muththagnseyyumpadi, than valathukaiyinaal avan thaadiyaip pidiththu,

than kaiyilirukki'ra pattayaththi'rku amaasaa echcharikkaiyaayiraathapoathu, yoavaap avanai avan kudalka'l tharaiyilea sarinthupoakaththakkathaay, athinaal vayit'rilea orea kuththaakak kuththinaan; avan seththuppoanaan; appozhuthu yoavaapum avan sakoatharanaakiya apisaayum pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaavaip pinthodarnthaarka'l.
yoavaapudaiya vaaliparil oruvan seththavana'ndaiyilea nin'ru, yoavaapinmeal piriyappaduki'ravan evanoa, thaaveethin padchaththil irukki'ravan evanoa, avan yoavaapaip pinpat'rippoavaanaaka en'raan.

amaasaa naduvazhiyilea iraththaththilea pura'ndu kidanthapadiyinaal, janangka'l ellaarum thariththuni'rpathai avan ka'ndu, amaasaavai vazhiyilirunthu vayalilea izhuththuppoattaan; avana'ndaiyil varuki'ravarka'l ellaarum thariththuni'rpathaik ka'ndu, oru vasthiraththai avanmeal poattaan.
avan vazhiyilirunthu eduththuppoadappatta pi'rpaadu, ellaarum kadanthu, pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaavaith thodara, yoavaapukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
avan israveal koaththirangka'laiyellaam sut'ri, pethmaakkaavaakiya aapealmattaakavum, peareemin kadaisimattaakavum vanthirunthaan; avvidaththaarum koodi, thaangka'lum avanukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

avarka'l poay pethmaakkaavaakiya aapealilea avanai mut'rikkaipoattu, patta'naththi'rku ethiraakath thet'ruvaraikkum koththa'lam poattaarka'l; yoavaapoadea irukki'ra janangka'l ellaarum alangkaththai vizhappa'n'numpadi azhikka eththanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
appozhuthu puththiyu'l'la oru sthiree patta'naththilirunthu saththamittu: kea'lungka'l, kea'lungka'l; naan yoavaapoadea peasavea'ndum; avarai ingkea kittavarach sollungka'l en'raa'l.

avan ava'lukkuch sameepaththil vanthapoathu, antha sthiree: neerthaanaa yoavaap en'ru keattaa'l; avan naanthaan en'raan; appozhuthu, ava'l avanaip paarththu: umathu adiyaa'lin vaarththaika'laik kea'lum en'raa'l; avan: keadki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l: poorvakaalaththu janangka'l aapealilea visaariththaal vazhakkuth theerum enpaarka'l.

isravealilea naan samaathaanamum u'nmaiyumu'l'lava'laayirukkaiyil, neer isravealilea thaay patta'namaayirukki'rathai nirmoolamaakkap paarkki'reeroa? neer karththarudaiya suthantharaththai vizhungkavea'ndiyathu enna en'raa'l.
yoavaap pirathiyuththaramaaka: vizhungkavea'ndum azhikkavea'ndum enki'ra aasai enakku vekuthooramaayiruppathaaka.

kaariyam appadiyalla, pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaa ennum pearu'l'la eppiraayeem parvathaththaanaayirukki'ra oru manushan, raajaavaakiya thaaveethukku viroathamaayth than kaiyai oangkinaan; avanaimaaththiram oppukkodungka'l; appozhuthu patta'naththai vittuppoavean en'raan. appozhuthu antha sthiree yoavaapaip paarththu: ithoa, avan thalai mathilinmealirunthu ummidaththilea poadappadum en'ru solli,

ava'l janangka'lidaththil poayp puththiyaayp peasinathinaal, avarka'l pikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya seapaavin thalaiyai vetti, yoavaapidaththilea poattaarka'l; appozhuthu avan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; avaravar patta'naththai vittuk kalainthu, thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; yoavaapum raajaavidaththukkup poakumpadi erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaan.
yoavaap isravealudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvaththinmealum, yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaa kireaththiyarmealum pileaththiyarmealum thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l.
athoaraam pakuthika'lai vaangkuki'ravanum, akiloothin kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath manthiriyum,
seavaa sampirathiyum, saathoakkum apiyaththaarum aasaariyarumaayirunthaarka'l.
yayeeriyanaakiya eeraavum thaaveethukkup pirathaaniyaayirunthaan.

thaaveethin naadka'lil moon'ru varusham oayaatha pagncham u'ndaayirunthathu; appozhuthu thaaveethu karththarudaiya samukaththil visaariththaan. karththar: kipiyoaniyaraik kon'rupoatta savulukkaakavum, iraththappiriyaraana avan veettaarukkaakavum ithu u'ndaayit'ru en'raar.

appozhuthu raajaa: kipiyoaniyarai azhaippiththaan; kipiyoaniyaroa, israveal puththiraraayiraamal emoariyaril meethiyaayirunthavarka'l; avarka'lukku israveal puththirar aa'naiyittirunthum, savul israveal puththirarukkaakavum yoothaavukkaakavum kaa'npiththa vairaakkiyaththinaal avarka'lai vetta vakaitheadinaan.

aakaiyaal thaaveethu kipiyoaniyaraip paarththu: naan ungka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu enna? neengka'l karththarudaiya suthantharaththai aaseervathikkumpadikku, naan seyyavea'ndiya piraayachchiththam enna en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu kipiyoaniyar avanaip paarththu: savuloadum avan veettaaroadum engka'lukku irukki'ra kaariyaththi'rkaaka engka'lukku ve'l'liyum ponnum theavaiyillai; isravealil oruvanaik kon'rupoadavea'ndum enpathum engka'l viruppam alla en'raarka'l. appozhuthu avan: appadiyaanaal, naan ungka'lukku enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaan.
avarka'l raajaavai noakki: naangka'l isravealin ellaiyilengkum nilaikkaathapadikku, azhinthupoaka evan engka'lai nirmoolamaakki engka'lukkup pollaappuch seyya ninaiththaanoa,

avan kumaararil eazhupear karththar therinthuko'nda savulin ooraakiya kipiyaavilea naangka'l avarka'laik karththarukken'ru thookkippoada, engka'lukku oppukkodukkappadavea'ndum en'raarka'l. naan avarka'lai oppukkoduppean en'ru raajaa sonnaan.
aanaalum thaaveethum savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanum karththaraikko'ndu itta aa'naiyinimiththam, raajaa savulin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanin makan meavipoaseaththaith thappavittu,

aayaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya rispaa'l savulukkup pet'ra ava'ludaiya ira'ndu kumaararaakiya armoaniyaiyum meavipoaseaththaiyum, savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'l meakoalaaththiyanaana parsilaavin kumaaranaakiya aathariyealukkup pet'ra ava'ludaiya ainthu kumaararaiyum pidiththu,

avarka'laik kipiyoaniyar kaiyil oppukkoduththaan; avarka'laik karththarudaiya samukaththil malaiyinmeal thookkippoattaarka'l; appadiyea avarka'l eazhupearum orumikka vizhunthaarka'l; vaa'rkoathumai a'ruppu thuvakkuki'ra a'ruppukkaalaththin munthinanaadka'lilea avarka'l kon'rupoadappattaarka'l.

appozhuthu aayaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya rispaa'l irattuppudavaiyai eduththukko'ndupoay, athaip paa'raiyinmeal viriththu, a'ruppunaa'lin thuvakkam mutha'rko'ndu vaanaththilirunthu avarka'lmeal mazhai peyyumattum pakalil aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laakilum iravil kaattumirukangka'laakilum avarka'lmeal vizhavottaathirunthaa'l.
aayaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya rispaa'l ennum savulin ma'rumanaiyaatti seythathu thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

thaaveethu poay, pelisthar kilpoavaavilea savulai vettinapoathu, pethsaanin veethiyilea thookkippoadappattathum, keeleayaaththilu'l'la yaapeas patta'naththaar angkea poayth thirutta'lavaayk ko'nduvanthathumaana savulin elumpuka'laiyum, avan kumaaranaana yoanaththaanin elumpuka'laiyum, avarka'lidaththilirunthu eduththu,
angkea irunthu avarka'laik ko'nduvanthu, thookkippoadappattavarka'lin elumpuka'laiyum avaika'loadea searththu,

savulin elumpuka'laiyum avan kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaanin elumpuka'laiyum, penyameen theasaththuch sealaa oorilirukki'ra avan thakappanaakiya keesin kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'nuviththaan; raajaa katta'laiyittapadiyellaam seythaarka'l; atha'rkuppinpu theavan theasaththi'rkaakach seyyappatta vea'nduthalaik keattaru'linaar.
pinpu pelisthar isravealinmeal yuththamseythaarka'l; appozhuthu thaaveethum avanoadeakooda avan seavakarumpoay, pelistharoadu yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; thaaveethu vidaayththuppoanaan.

appozhuthu munnoo'ru seakkalni'rai ve'nkalamaana eettiyaip pidikki'ravanum, puthuppattayaththai araiyilea kattikko'ndavanumaana ispipenoap ennum iraadchatha puththiraril oruvan thaaveethai vettavea'ndum en'ru irunthaan.

seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya apisaay raajaavukku uthaviyaaka vanthu, pelisthanai vettik kon'rupoattaan. appozhuthu thaaveethin manushar: isravealin vi'lakku a'nainthupoakaathapadikku, neer ini engka'loadea yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadavea'ndaam en'ru avanukku aa'naiyittuch sonnaarka'l.
atha'rkup pinpu pelistharoadea thirumpavum koapilea yuththam nadanthathu; oosaaththiyanaakiya seepeakkaay iraadchatha santhathiyaana saappai vettippoattaan.

pelistharoadu innum vea'roru yuththam koapilea u'ndaanapoathu, yaareyorkimin kumaaranaakiya elkkaanaan ennum pethlekeamiyan kaath ooraanaakiya koaliyaaththin sakoatharanai vettinaan; avan eettith thaangkaanathu neyki'ravarka'lin padaimaram avva'lavu perithaayirunthathu.

innum oru yuththam kaath oorilea nadanthapoathu, angkea nettaiyanaana oru manushan irunthaan; avan kaika'lil avvaa'ru viralka'lum avan kaalka'lil avvaa'ru viralka'lum, aaka irupaththu naanku viralka'lu'l'lavan; ivanum iraadchatha pi'raviyaayirunthu,
isravealai ninthiththaan; thaaveethin sakoatharanaana seemeayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoanaththaan avanai vettinaan.
intha naalupearum kaaththoorilea iraadchathanukkup pi'ranthavarka'l; ivarka'l thaaveethin kaiyinaalum avan seavakarin kaiyinaalum madinthaarka'l.
karththar thaaveethai avanudaiya ellaach saththurukka'lin kaikkum, savulin kaikkum, neengkalaakki viduviththapoathu, avan karththarukku munpaakap paadina paattu:
karththar en kanmalaiyum, en koattaiyum, en radchakarumaanavar.

theavan naan nampiyirukki'ra thurukkamum, en keadakamum, en radcha'niyak kompum, en uyarntha adaikkalamum, en pukalidamum, en radchakarumaanavar; ennai valladikku neengkalaakki radchikki'ravar avarea.
sthuthikkup paaththiraraakiya karththarai noakkik kooppiduvean; athanaal en saththurukka'lukku neengkalaakki radchikkappaduvean.
mara'na alaika'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndu, thurchsanappiravaakam ennaip payappaduththinathu.
paathaa'lak kattuka'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; mara'nakka'n'nika'l enmeal vizhunthathu.
enakku u'ndaana nerukkaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittu, en theavanai noakki apayamittean; thamathu aalayaththilirunthu en saththaththaik keattaar; en kooppiduthal avar sevika'lil ea'rit'ru.
appozhuthu poomi asainthu athirnthathu; avar koapangko'ndapadiyaal vaanaththin asthipaarangka'l kulungki asainthathu.
avar naasiyilirunthu padchikki'ra pukai ezhumpit'ru, avar vaayilirunthu akkini pu'rappattathu, athanaal thazhal moo'ndathu.
vaanangka'laith thaazhththi i'rangkinaar; avar paathangka'linkeezh kaariru'l irunthathu.
kearupeeninmeal ea'ri veakamaaych sen'raar. kaat'rin settaika'linmeethil tharisanamaanaar.
aakaayaththu meakangka'lilea koodiya tha'n'neerka'lin iru'laith thammaich sut'rilum irukkum koodaaramaakkinaar.
avarudaiya sannithip pirakaasaththinaal neruppuththazhalum erinthathu.
karththar vaanaththilirunthu kumu'ri, unnathamaanavar thamathu saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ninaar.
avar ampuka'lai eythu, avarka'laich sitha'ra adiththu, minnalka'laip pirayoakiththu, avarka'laik kalangkappa'n'ninaar.
karththarudaiya ka'ndithaththinaalum, avarudaiya naasiyin suvaasak kaat'rinaalum samuththiraththin mathakuka'l thi'ravu'ndu, poothalaththin asthipaarangka'l kaa'nappattathu.
uyaraththilirunthu avar kai neetti, ennaip pidiththu, jalappiravaakaththilirukki'ra ennaith thookkivittaar.
ennilum palavaanka'laayiruntha en palaththa saththuruvukkum en pakaignarukkum ennai viduviththaar.
en aapaththunaa'lilea enakku ethirittu vanthaarka'l; karththaroa enakku aatharavaayirunthaar.
enmeal avar piriyamaayirunthapadiyaal, visaalamaana idaththilea ennaik ko'nduvanthu, ennaith thappuviththaar.
karththar en neethikkuththakkathaaka enakkup pathil a'liththaar; en kaika'lin suththaththi'rkuththakkathaaka enakkuch sarikkattinaar.
karththarudaiya vazhika'laik kaaththukko'nduvanthean; naan en theavanukkuth thuroakampa'n'ninathillai.
avarudaiya niyaayangka'laiyellaam enakku munpaaka ni'ruththinean; naan avarudaiya piramaa'nangka'lai vittu vilakaamal,
avar munpaaka manau'nmaiyaayirunthu, en thurkku'naththi'rku ennai vilakkik kaaththukko'ndean.
aakaiyaal karththar en neethikkuththakkathaakavum, thammudaiya ka'nka'lukkumun irukki'ra en suththaththi'rkuththakkathaakavum enakkup palana'liththaar.
thayavu'l'lavanukku neer thayavu'l'lavaraakavum, uththamanukku neer uththamaraakavum,
punithanukku neer punitharaakavum, maa'rupaadaanavanukku neer maa'rupaduki'ravaraakavum thoan'ruveer.
si'rumaippatta janaththai radchippeer; meattimaiyaanavarka'laith thaazhththa, ummudaiya ka'nka'l avarka'lukku viroathamaayth thiruppappattirukki'rathu.
karththaraakiya theavareer en vi'lakkaayirukki'reer; karththar en iru'lai ve'lichchamaakkuki'ravar.
ummaalea naan oru seanaikku'l paaynthupoavean; en theavanaalea oru mathilaith thaa'nduvean.
theavanudaiya vazhi uththamamaanathu; karththarudaiya vasanam pudamidappattathu; thammai nampuki'ra anaivarukkum avar keadakamaayirukki'raar.
karththarai allaamal theavan yaar? nammudaiya theavanaiyan'ri kanmalaiyum yaar?
theavan enakkup palaththa ara'naanavar; avar en vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththuki'ravar.
avar en kaalka'lai maanka'ludaiya kaalka'laippoalaakki, en uyarthalangka'lil ennai ni'ruththuki'raar.
ve'nkala villum en puyangka'laal va'laiyumpadi, en kaika'lai yuththaththi'rkup pazhakkuvikki'raar.
ummudaiya radchippin keadakaththaiyum enakkuth thantheer; ummudaiya kaaru'niyam ennaip periyavanaakkum.
en kaalka'l vazhuvaathapadikku naan nadakki'ra vazhiyai akalamaakkineer.
en saththurukka'laip pinthodarnthu avarka'lai azhippean; avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumvaraikkum thirumpean.
avarka'l ezhunthirukkamaattaathapadikku en paathangka'lin keezh vizhunthaarka'l; avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu vettinean.
yuththaththi'rku neer ennaip palaththaal idaikatti, enmeal ezhumpinavarka'lai enkeezh madangkappa'n'nineer.
naan en pakaignaraich sangkarikkumpadiyaaka, en saththurukka'lin pidariyai enakku oppukkoduththeer.
avarka'l noakkip paarkki'raarka'l, avarka'lai radchippaar oruvarumillai; karththarai noakkippaarkki'raarka'l, avarka'lukku avar uththaravu kodukki'rathillai.
avarka'lai poomiyin thoo'laaka idiththu, therukka'lin seat'raippoala avarka'lai mithiththu sitha'rappa'n'nuki'rean.
en janaththin sa'ndaika'lukku neer ennai vilakkivittu, jaathika'lukku ennaith thalaivanaaka vaikki'reer; naan a'riyaatha janangka'l ennaich seavikki'raarka'l.
anniyar ichchakam peasi enakku adangki, en saththaththaik keattavudanea enakkuk keezhppadiki'raarka'l.
anniyar munaivizhunthupoay, thangka'l ara'nka'lilirunthu thaththa'lippaayp pu'rappaduki'raarka'l.
karththar jeevanu'l'lavar; en kanmalaiyaanavar sthoaththirikkappaduvaaraaka; en radchippin kanmalaiyaakiya theavan uyarnthiruppaaraaka.
avar enakkaakap pazhikkup pazhivaangki, janangka'lai enakkuk keezhppaduththuki'ra theavanaanavar.
avarea en saththurukka'lukku ennai vilakki viduvikki'ravar; enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lmeal ennai uyarththik kodumaiyaana manushanukku ennaith thappuvikki'reer.
ithinimiththam karththaavea, jaathika'lukku'l ummaith thuthiththu, ummudaiya naamaththi'rkuch sangkeetham paaduvean.
thaam ea'rpaduththina raajaavukku makaththaana radchippai a'liththu, thaam apisheakampa'n'nina thaaveethukkum avan santhathikkum sathaakaalamum kirupai seyki'raar.

thaaveethudaiya kadaisi vaarththaika'l: meanmaiyaay uyarththappattu, yaakkoapudaiya theavanaal apisheakam pet'ru, isravealin sangkeethangka'lai inpamaayp paadina eesaayin kumaaranaakiya thaaveethu ennum purushan solluki'rathu ennaven'raal;
karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar ennaikko'ndu peasinaar; avarudaiya vasanam ennudaiya naavil irunthathu.
isravealin theavanum isravealin kanmalaiyumaanavar enakkuch solli uraiththathaavathu: neethipararaay manusharai aa'ndu, theyvapayamaayth thuraiththanampa'n'nuki'ravar iruppaar.

avar kaalaiyil manthaaramillaamal uthiththu, mazhaikkuppi'rpaadu than kaanthiyinaal pullaip poomiyilirunthu mu'laikkappa'n'nuki'ra sooriyanudaiya vidiya'rkaala ve'lichchaththaippoala iruppaar en'raar.

ennudaiya veedu theavanidaththil ippadiyiraathoa? sakalamum thittampa'n'nappattirukki'ra nichchayamaana niththiya udanpadikkaiyai ennudan avar seythirukki'raar; aathalaal ennudaiya ellaa radchippum ellaa vaagnchaiyum va'larnthoangkach seyyaaroa?
pealiyaa'lin makka'l anaivarumoa, kaiyinaal pidikkappadakkoodaathathaay e'rinthupoadappadavea'ndiya mu'l'lukkuch samaanamaanavarka'l.
avaika'lai oruvan thodappoanaal, iruppaayuthaththaiyum eettiththaangkaiyum kettiyaayp pidiththukko'l'lavea'ndum; avaika'l irukki'ra idaththilthaanea akkiniyinaal mut'rum sutterikkappadum en'raan.

thaaveethukku iruntha paraakkiramasaalika'lin naamangka'laavana: thakkemoaniyin kumaaranaakiya yoaseappaasepeth enpavan searvaikkaararin thalaivan; ivan e'n'noo'rupearka'linmeal vizhunthu, avarka'lai orumikka vettippoatta atheenoaeasni ooraanaanavan.

ivanukku ira'ndaavathu, akoayin kumaaranaakiya thoathoavin makan eleyaasaar enpavan; ivan pelisthar yuththaththi'rkuk koodina sthalaththilea israveal manushar poakaiyil, thaaveethoadea irunthu, pelistharai ninthiththa moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lil oruvanaayirunthaan.

ivan ezhumpith than kaisaliththu, than kai pattayaththoadu ottikko'l'lumattum pelistharai vettinaan; an'raiyathinam karththar periya radchippai nadappiththaar; janangka'l ko'l'laiyidamaaththiram avanaip pinsen'raarka'l.

ivanukku moon'raavathu, aakeayin kumaaranaakiya sammaa ennum aaraariyan; si'rupaya'ru ni'raintha vayaliruntha idaththilea pelisthar earaa'lamaayk koodi, janangka'l pelistharaik ka'ndu oaduki'rapoathu,
ivan antha nilaththin naduvilea nin'ru athaik kaappaat'ri, pelistharai madangkadiththuppoattaan; athanaal karththar periya radchippai nadappiththaar.

muppathu thalaivarukku'l'lea intha moon'rupearum a'ruppunaa'lilea athullaam kepiyilea thaaveethidaththil poayirunthaarka'l; pelistharin tha'ndu reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea paa'layami'rangkinapoathu,
thaaveethu ara'naana oru idaththil irunthaan; appozhuthu pelistharin thaa'naiyam pethlekeamilea irunthathu.
thaaveethu pethlekeamin olimukavaasalil irukki'ra ki'nat'rin tha'n'neerinmeal aavalko'ndu: en thaakaththi'rkuk kognchan tha'n'neer ko'nduvaruki'ravan yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu intha moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lum pelistharin paa'layaththilea thu'ninthu pukunthupoay, pethlekeamin olimukavaasalil irukki'ra ki'nat'rilea tha'n'neer mo'ndu, thaaveethinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; aanaalum avan athaik kudikka manathillaamal athaik karththarukken'ru oot'rippoattu:

karththaavea, thangka'l piraa'nanai e'n'naamal poayvantha antha manusharin iraththaththaik kudikkum inthachseyal enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka en'ru solli, athaik kudikka manathillaathirunthaan; ippadi intha moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lum seythaarka'l.

yoavaapin sakoatharanum seruyaavin kumaaranumaana apisaay enpavan, antha moon'rupearil pirathaanamaanavan; avan than eettiyai oangki munnoo'rupearai madangkadiththathinaal, intha moon'rupearka'lil pearpet'ravanaanaan.
intha moon'rupearka'lil avan meanmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthathinaalallavoa, avarka'lil thalaivanaanaan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'ru pearukku avan samamaanavan alla.

paraakkiramasaaliyaakiya yoaythaavin kumaaranum kapseyeal ooraanumaakiya penaayaavum seykaika'lil vallavanaayirunthaan; avan moavaap theasaththin ira'ndu valumaiyaana singkangka'laik kon'rathumallaamal, u'raintha mazhaikaalaththil avan i'rangkippoay, oru kepikku'l iruntha oru singkaththaiyum kon'rupoattaan.

avan payangkara roopamaana oru ekipthiyanaiyum kon'rupoattaan; antha ekipthiyan kaiyil oru eettiyirukkaiyil, ivan oru thadiyaip pidiththu, avanidaththil poay, antha ekipthiyan kaiyiliruntha eettiyaip pa'riththu, avan eettiyinaalea avanaik kon'rupoattaan.
ivaika'lai yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaa seythapadiyinaal, moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lukku'l'lea pearpet'ravanaayirunthaan.
muppathupearilum ivan meanmaiyu'l'lavan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'ru pearukkum ivan samaanamaanavan alla; ivanaith thaaveethu than meykkaavalarukkuth thalaivanaaka vaiththaan.
yoavaapin thampi aasakeal mat'ra muppathupearil oruvan; avarka'l yaarenil, pethlekeam ooraanaakiya thoathoavin kumaaran elkkaanaan,
aaroathiyanaakiya sammaa, aaroathiyanaakiya elikkaa,
palthiyanaakiya eales, ikkeasin kumaaranaakiya eeraa ennum thekkoaviyan.
aanathoaththiyanaakiya apiyeasar, oosaaththiyanaakiya mepunnaayi,
akoakiyanaakiya salmoan, neththoapaaththiyanaakiya makaraayi,
paanaavin kumaaranaakiya ealeap ennum neththoapaaththiyan, penyameen puththirarin kipiyaa ooraanaakiya ripaayin kumaaran iththaayi,
piraththoaniyanaakiya penaayaa, kaakaas neeroadaika'lin theasaththaanaakiya eeththaayi,
arpaaththiyanaakiya apialpon, parumiyanaakiya asmaaveath,
saalpoaniyanaakiya eliyoopaa, yaaseanin kumaararil yoanaththaan enpavan.
aaraariyanaakiya sammaa, saaraarin kumaaranaakiya akiyaam ennum aaraariyan,
maakaaththiyanin kumaaranaakiya akaspaayim makan elippeleath, keeloaniyanaakiya akiththoappealin kumaaran eliyaam enpavan.
karmealiyanaakiya esraayi, arpiyanaakiya paaraayi,
soapaa ooraanaakiya naaththaanin kumaaran eekaal, kaathiyanaakiya paani,
ammoaniyanaakiya sealeak, seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaapin aayuthathaariyaana peroaththiyanaakiya nakaraay,
ithriyanaakiya eeraa, ithriyanaakiya kaareap,
eaththiyanaakiya uriyaa enpavarka'lea; aaka muppaththeazhupear.
karththarudaiya koapam thirumpa isravealinmeal moo'ndathu. israveal yoothaa enpavarka'lai ilakkam paar en'ru avarka'lukku viroathamaaych solluki'ratha'rku thaaveethu eavappattaan.

appadiyea raajaa thannoadirukki'ra seanaapathiyaakiya yoavaapaip paarththu: janangka'lin ilakkaththai naan a'riyumpadikku nee thaa'nmuthal peyersepaamattumu'l'la isravealarin koaththiramengkum sut'riththirinthu janangka'laith thokaiyidungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu yoavaap raajaavaip paarththu: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya ka'nka'l kaa'numpadi ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar janangka'lai ippozhuthu irukki'rathaippaarkkilum, noo'rumadangku athikamaay varththikkappa'n'nuvaaraaka; aanaalum en aa'ndavanaakiya raajaa inthak kaariyaththai virumpuki'rathu enna en'raan.

aakilum yoavaapum iraa'nuvaththalaivarum sonna vaarththai sellaathapadikku, raajaavin vaarththai palaththathu; appadiyea israveal janangka'laith thokaiyida, yoavaapum iraa'nuvaththalaivarum raajaavaivittup pu'rappattuppoay,
yoarthaanaik kadanthu, kaath ennum aa'ruka'lin naduvea irukki'ra patta'naththi'rku valathupu'ramaana aaroavearilum yaasearidaththilum paa'layami'rangki,
angkeayirunthu keeleayaaththi'rkum thaatheemothsikkum poay, angkeayirunthu thaa'nyaanukkum, seethoanin sut'ruppu'rangka'lukkum poay,
pi'rpaadu theeru ennum koattaikkum eaviyar kaanaaniyarudaiya sakala patta'nangka'lukkum poay, angkeayirunthu yoothaavin thenpu'ramaana peyersepaavukkup poay,
ippadith theasamengkum sut'riththirinthu, onpathu maathamum irupathu naa'lum aanapi'rpaadu erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l.

yoavaap janaththai ilakkampaarththa thokaiyai raajaavukkuk koduththaan; isravealilea pattayam uruvaththakka yuththa seavakar ettuladchampear irunthaarka'l; yoothaa manushar ainthu ladcham pear irunthaarka'l.

ivvithamaay janangka'lai e'n'nina pinpu, raajaavin iruthayam avanai vaathiththathu; appozhuthu thaaveethu karththarai noakki: naan ippadich seythathinaalea periya paavagnseythean; ippoathum aa'ndavarea, umathu adiyaanin akkiramaththai neekkividum; naan makaa puththiyeenamaaych seythean en'raan.
thaaveethu kaalamea ezhunthirunthapoathu, thaaveethin gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya kaath ennum theerkkatharisikkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaakich sonnathu:

nee thaaveethinidaththil poay, moon'ru kaariyangka'lai unakku munpaaka vaikki'rean; avaika'lil oru kaariyaththaith therinthuko'l, athai naan unakkuch seyvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

appadiyea kaath thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: ummudaiya theasaththilea eazhu varusham pagncham varavea'ndumoa? allathu moon'rumaatham ummudaiya saththurukka'l ummaip pinthodara, neer avarka'lukku munpaaka oadippoakavea'ndumoa? allathu ummudaiya theasaththilea moon'runaa'l ko'l'lainoay u'ndaakavea'ndumoa? ippoathum ennai anuppinavarukku naan enna ma'ruuththaravu ko'ndupoakavea'ndum enpathai neer yoasiththuppaarum en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu kaaththai noakki: kodiya idukka'nil akappattirukki'rean; ippoathu naam karththarudaiya kaiyilea vizhuvoamaaka; avarudaiya irakkangka'l makaa periyathu; manushar kaiyilea vizhaathiruppeanaaka en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar isravealilea an'ru kaalamea thodangkik ku'riththakaalamvaraikkum ko'l'lainoayai varappa'n'ninaar; athinaal thaa'nmuthal peyersepaamattumu'l'la janangka'lil ezhupathinaayirampear seththuppoanaarka'l.

theavathoothan erusaleamai azhikkath than kaiyai athinmeal neettinapoathu, karththar anthath theengkukku manasthaapappattu, janangka'laich sangkarikki'ra thoothanai noakki: poathum, ippoathu un kaiyai ni'ruththu en'raar; antha vea'laiyil karththarudaiya thoothan epoosiyanaakiya arvanaavin poaradikki'ra ka'laththi'rku nearea irunthaan.

janaththai upaathikki'ra thoothanai thaaveethu ka'ndapoathu, avan karththarai noakki: ithoa, naanthaan paavagnseythean; naanthaan akkiramampa'n'ninean; intha aaduka'l enna seythathu? ummudaiya kai enakkum en thakappan veettukkum viroathamaayiruppathaaka en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.
an'raiyathinam kaath enpavan thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: neer poay, epoosiyanaakiya arvanaavin ka'laththilea karththarukku oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakkum en'raan.
kaaththudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea thaaveethu karththar ka'rpiththa pirakaaramaakap poanaan.
arvanaa ea'rittuppaarththu: raajaavum avanudaiya oozhiyakkaararum thannidaththil varuki'rathaikka'ndu, arvanaa ethirko'ndupoayth tharaimattum kuninthu raajaavai va'nangki,

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan thamathu adiyaanidaththil varuki'ra kaariyam enna en'ru keattatha'rku, thaaveethu: vaathai janaththaivittu ni'ruththappadak karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattumpadikku inthak ka'laththai un kaiyilea ko'l'la vanthean en'raan.

arvanaa thaaveethaip paarththu: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan ithai vaangkikko'ndu, thammudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanapadi paliyiduvaaraaka; ithoa, thakanapalikku maaduka'lum vi'rakukkup poaradikki'ra uru'laika'lum maaduka'lin nukaththadika'lum ingkea irukki'rathu en'ru solli,
arvanaa raajayoakkiyamaay avai ellaavat'raiyum raajaavukkuk koduththapinpu, arvanaa raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar ummidaththil kirupaiyaayiruppaaraaka en'raan.

raajaa arvanaavaip paarththu: appadiyalla; naan ilavasamaay vaangki, en theavanaakiya karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththaamal, athai un kaiyilea vilaikkirayamaay vaangkuvean en'ru solli, thaaveethu anthak ka'laththaiyum maaduka'laiyum aimpathu seakkal ni'rai ve'l'likkuk ko'ndaan.

angkea thaaveethu karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik katti, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum seluththinaan; appozhuthu karththar theasaththukkaakach seyyappatta vea'nduthalaik keattaru'linaar; isravealinmealiruntha antha vaathai ni'ruththappattathu.
thaaveethuraajaa vayathusen'ra virththaappiyanaanapoathu, vasthirangka'linaal avanai moodinaalum, avanukku anal u'ndaakavillai.

appozhuthu avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: raajasamukaththil nin'ru, avarukkup pa'nividai seyyavum, raajaavaakiya engka'l aa'ndavanukku anal u'ndaakumpadi ummudaiya madiyilea paduththukko'l'lavum kanniyaakiya oru si'ru pe'n'nai raajaavaakiya engka'l aa'ndavanukkuth theaduvoam en'ru solli,
isravealin ellaiyilellaam azhakaana oru pe'n'naith theadi, sooneam ooraa'laakiya apishaakaik ka'ndu, ava'lai raajaavinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
anthap pe'n veku azhakaayirunthaa'l; ava'l raajaavukku uthaviyaayirunthu avanukkup pa'nividaiseythaa'l; aanaalum raajaa ava'lai a'riyavillai.

aakeeththi'rkup pi'rantha athoaniyaa enpavan: naan raajaa aavean en'ru solli, thannaiththaan uyarththi, thanakku irathangka'laiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum, thanakkumun oadum aimpathu kaalaadka'laiyum sampaathiththaan.
avanudaiya thakappan: nee ippadich seyvaanean en'ru avanai orukkaalum kadinthuko'l'lavillai; avan mikavum azhaku'l'lavanaayirunthaan; apsaloamukkuppin avanudaiya thaay avanaip pet'raa'l.
avan seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaapoadum, aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaaroadum aaloasanaipa'n'nivanthaan; avarka'l avanidaththilirunthu avanukku uthaviseythuvanthaarka'l.

aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkum, yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaavum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanum, seemeayiyum, reayiyum, thaaveethoadirukki'ra paraakkiramasaalika'lum, athoaniyaavukku udanthaiyaayirukkavillai.

athoaniyaa entoakealukkuch sameepamaana soakeleth ennum kallin arukea aadumaaduka'laiyum kozhuththa janthukka'laiyum adiththu, raajaavin kumaararaakiya than sakoathararellaaraiyum, raajaavin oozhiyakkaararaana yoothaavin manushar anaivaraiyum azhaiththaan.
theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanaiyum, penaayaavaiyum, paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum, than sakoatharanaakiya saalomoanaiyum azhaikkavillai.

appozhuthu naaththaan saalomoanin thaayaakiya pathseapaa'lai noakki: nammudaiya aa'ndavanaakiya thaaveethukkuth theriyaamal, aakeeththin kumaaranaakiya athoaniyaa raajaavaaki'ra seythiyai nee keadkavillaiyaa?
ippoathum un piraa'nanaiyum, un kumaaranaakiya saalomoanin piraa'nanaiyum thappuvikkumpadikku nee vaa, unakku naan aaloasanai solluvean.

nee thaaveethuraajaavinidaththil poay: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, enakkuppin un kumaaranaakiya saalomoan raajaavaaki, avanea en singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaan en'ru neer umathu adiyaa'lukku aa'naiyidavillaiyaa? appadiyirukka, athoaniyaa raajaavaaki'rathu enna? en'ru avaridaththil kea'l.
nee angkea raajaavoadea peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, naanum unakkup pinvanthu, un vaarththaika'lai u'ruthippaduththuvean en'raan.
appadiyea pathseapaa'l pa'l'liya'raikku'l raajaavidaththil poanaa'l; raajaa mikavum vayathusen'ravanaayirunthaan; sooneam ooraa'laakiya apishaak raajaavukkup pa'nividai seythuko'ndirunthaa'l.
pathseapaa'l kuninthu, raajaavai va'nangkinaa'l; appozhuthu raajaa: unakku ennavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku ava'l: en aa'ndavanea, enakkuppin un kumaaranaakiya saalomoan raajaavaaki, avanea en singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaan en'ru neer ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraikko'ndu, umathu adiyaa'lukku aa'naiyitteerea.
ippozhuthu, ithoa, athoaniyaa raajaavaaki'raan; en aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavea, neer athai a'riyavillai.

avan maaduka'laiyum kozhuththa janthukka'laiyum aaduka'laiyum thira'laaka adiththu, raajaavin kumaarar anaivaraiyum aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaaraiyum, yoavaap ennum padaiththalaivanaiyum azhaiththaan; aanaalum umathu adiyaanaakiya saalomoanai azhaikkavillai.

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukkuppi'raku avarudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppavan innaan en'ru thangka'lukku a'rivikkavea'ndum en'ru isravealar anaivarin ka'nka'lum ummai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu.
a'riviyaama'rpoanaal raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan thammudaiya pithaakka'loadea paduththukko'ndapinpu, naanum en kumaaranaakiya saalomoanum kut'ravaa'lika'laay e'n'nappaduvoam en'raa'l.
ava'l raajaavoadea peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaan vanthaan.
theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaan vanthirukki'raar en'ru raajaavukkuth theriviththaarka'l; avan raajaavukku munpaakap piraveasiththu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu raajaavai va'nangkinaan.
naaththaan: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, athoaniyaa enakkuppin raajaavaaki, avanea en singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaan en'ru neer sonnathu'ndoa?

avan in'raiyathinam poay, maaduka'laiyum kozhuththa janthukka'laiyum aaduka'laiyum thira'laaka adiththu, raajaavin kumaarar anaivaraiyum iraa'nuvaththalaivaraiyum, aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaaraiyum azhaiththaan; avarka'l avanukku munpaakap pusiththuk kudiththu, raajaavaakiya athoaniyaa vaazhka en'ru solluki'raarka'l.
aanaalum umathu adiyaanaakiya ennaiyum, aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkaiyum, yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaavaiyum, umathu adiyaanaakiya saalomoanaiyum avan azhaikkavillai.

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukkuppin thamathu singkaasanaththil veet'riruppavan ivanthaan en'ru neer umathu adiyaanukkuth therivikkaathirukkaiyil, inthak kaariyam raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan katta'laiyaal nadanthirukkumoa en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethuraajaa pirathiyuththaramaaka: pathseapaa'lai ennidaththil varavazhaiyungka'l en'raan; ava'l raajasamukaththil piraveasiththu raajaavukku munnea nin'raa'l.

appozhuthu raajaa: un kumaaranaakiya saalomoan enakkuppin arasaa'ndu, avanea en sthaanaththil en singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaan en'ru naan unakku isravealin theavanaakiya karththarmeal aa'naiyittapadiyea, in'raikkuch seythu theerppean enpathai,
en aaththumaavai ellaa ikkattukkum neengkalaakki meetta karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru aa'naiyittaan.
appozhuthu pathseapaa'l tharaimattum kuninthu raajaavai va'nangki, en aa'ndavanaakiya thaaveethuraajaa en'raikkum vaazhka en'raa'l.
pinpu thaaveethuraajaa, aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkaiyum theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanaiyum yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaavaiyum ennidaththil varavazhaiyungka'l en'raan.

avarka'l raajaavukku munpaakap piraveasiththapoathu, raajaa avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l aa'ndavanudaiya seavakaraik koottikko'ndu, en kumaaranaakiya saalomoanai en koavea'rukazhuthaiyinmeal eat'ri, avanaik keekoanukku azhaiththukko'ndu poangka'l.

angkea aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkum theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanum avanai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'nakkadavarka'l; pinpu ekkaa'lam oothi, raajaavaakiya saalomoan vaazhka en'ru vaazhththungka'l.

athinpinpu avan nakarvalam vanthu, en singkaasanaththil veet'rirukkumpadi, avanaik koottikko'ndu vaarungka'l; avanea en sthaanaththil raajaavaayiruppaan; avan isravealinmealum yoothaavinmealum thalaivanaayirukkumpadi avanai ea'rpaduththinean en'raan.
appozhuthu yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaa raajaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aamen, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya theavanaakiya karththarum ippadiyea solvaaraaka.

karththar raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoadea eppadi irunthaaroa, appadiyea avar saalomoanoadum irunthu, thaaveethuraajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanudaiya singkaasanaththaip paarkkilum avarudaiya singkaasanaththaip perithaakkuvaaraaka en'raan.

appadiyea aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanum, yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaavum, kireaththiyarum pileaththiyarum poay, saalomoanaith thaaveethuraajaavinudaiya koavea'rukazhuthaiyinmeal eat'ri, avanaik keekoanukku nadaththikko'ndupoanaarka'l.

aasaariyanaakiya saathoakku thailakkompaik koodaaraththilirunthu eduththukko'ndupoay, saalomoanai apisheakampa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu ekkaa'lam oothi, janangka'lellaarum raajaavaakiya saalomoan vaazhka en'ru vaazhththinaarka'l.
pi'rpaadu janangka'lellaarum avan pi'rakaalea poanaarka'l; janangka'l naakasurangka'lai oothi, poomi avarka'l saththaththinaal athiraththakkathaaka makaa poorippaaych santhoashiththaarka'l.

athoaniyaavum avanoadiruntha ellaa virunthaa'lika'lum poajanampa'n'ni mudinthapoathu athaik keattaarka'l; yoavaap ekkaa'lasaththaththaik keattapoathu, nakaraththil u'ndaayirukki'ra aaravaaram enna en'ru visaariththaan.
avan peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaarin kumaaran yoanaththaan vanthaan; appozhuthu athoaniyaa, u'l'lea vaa, nee kettikkaaran, nee na'rseythi ko'nduvaruki'ravan en'raan.
yoanaththaan athoaniyaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: eathu, thaaveethuraajaavaakiya nammudaiya aa'ndavan saalomoanai raajaavaakkinaarea.

raajaa aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkaiyum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanaiyum, yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaavaiyum, kireaththiyaraiyum pileaththiyaraiyum avanoadea anuppinaar; avarka'l avanai raajaavudaiya koavea'rukazhuthaiyinmeal eat'rinaarka'l.

aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanum, avanaik keekoanilea raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l; nakaramellaam muzhangkaththakkathaaka angkeayirunthu poorippoadea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; neengka'l keatta iraichchal athuthaan.
allaamalum saalomoan raajaangkaththukkuriya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'raan.

raajaavin oozhiyakkaararum thaaveethu raajaavaakiya nammudaiya aa'ndavanai vaazhththuthal seyyavanthu: theavan saalomoanin naamaththai ummudaiya naamaththaippaarkkilum pirapalappaduththi, avarudaiya singkaasanaththai ummudaiya singkaasanaththaip paarkkilum perithaakkuvaaraaka en'raarka'l; raajaa thammudaiya kattilinmeal kuninthu pa'ninthuko'ndaar.
pinnum raajaa: ennudaiya ka'nka'l kaa'na in'raiyathinam en singkaasanaththinmeal oruvanai veet'rirukkachseytha isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram en'ru sonnaar en'raan.
appozhuthu athoaniyaavin virunthaa'lika'lellaarum athirnthu ezhunthirunthu, avaravar thangka'l vazhiyea poayvittaarka'l.
athoaniyaa, saalomoanukkup payanthathinaal ezhunthupoay, palipeedaththin kompuka'laip pidiththukko'ndaan.

ithoa, athoaniyaa raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkup payappaduki'raan en'rum, ithoa, avan palipeedaththin kompuka'laip pidiththukko'ndu, raajaavaakiya saalomoan thamathu adiyaanaip pattayaththaalea kon'rupoaduvathillai en'ru in'ru enakku aa'naiyiduvaaraaka enki'raan en'rum, saalomoanukku a'rivikkappattathu.

appozhuthu saalomoan: avan yoakkiyan en'ru vi'langka nadanthuko'ndaal avan thalaimayiril on'rum tharaiyilea vizhappoaki'rathillai; avanidaththil pollaappuk kaa'nappadumeayaakil, avan saakavea'ndum en'raan.
avanaip palipeedaththilirunthu ko'nduvara, raajaavaakiya saalomoan aadka'lai anuppinaan; avan vanthu, raajaavaakiya saalomoanai va'nangkinaan; saalomoan avanaip paarththu: un veetti'rkup poa en'raan.
thaaveethu mara'namadaiyum kaalam sameepiththapoathu, avan than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanukkuk katta'laiyittuch sonnathu:
naan pooloakaththaar yaavarum poaki'ra vazhiyea poaki'rean; nee thidanko'ndu purushanaayiru.

nee enna seythaalum, nee engkea poanaalum, ellaavat'rilum puththimaanaayirukki'ratha'rkum, karththar ennaikku'riththu: un pi'l'laika'l thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum thangka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum enakku munpaaka u'nmaiyaay nadakkumpadikkuth thangka'l vazhiyaik kaaththukko'ndaal, isravealin singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkaththakka purushan unakku illaama'rpoavathillai en'ru sonna thammudaiya vaarththaiyaith thidappaduththuki'ratha'rkum,

moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum, ka'rpanaika'laiyum, niyaayangka'laiyum, saadchika'laiyum kaikko'l'la, avar vazhika'lil nadakkumpadikku avarudaiya kaavalaik kaappaayaaka.

seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaap, isravealin ira'ndu seanaapathika'laakiya nearin kumaaran apnearukkum, eaththearin kumaaran amaasaavukkum seytha kaariyaththinaal enakkuch seytha kut'raththai nee a'rinthirukki'raayea; avan avarka'laik kon'ru, samaathaanakaalaththilea yuththakaalaththu iraththaththaich sinthi, yuththakaalaththu iraththaththaith than araiyilu'l'la kachchaiyilum than kaalka'lil iruntha paatharadchaiyilum vadiyavittaanea.
aakaiyaal un yukthiyinpadiyea nee seythu, avanudaiya naraimayir samaathaanamaayp paathaa'laththil i'rangkavottaathiru.

keeleayaaththiyanaana parsilaayin kumaararukkuth thayaiseyvaayaaka; avarka'l un panthiyilea saappiduki'ravarka'ludan iruppaarka'laaka; un sakoatharanaakiya apsaloamukku munpaaka naan oadippoakaiyil, avarka'l ennai aathariththaarka'l.

mealum pakoorim ooraanaana penyameenanaakiya kearaavin makan seemeayi unnidaththil irukki'raan; naan maknaayeemukkup poaki'ra naa'lilea, avan ennaik kodiya thoosha'namaayth thooshiththaan; aanaalum avan yoarthaanilea enakku ethirko'nduvanthapadiyinaal: naan unnaip pattayaththaalea kon'rupoaduvathillai en'ru karththarmeal avanukku aa'naiyittukkoduththean.
aakilum nee avanaik kut'ramat'ravan en'ru e'n'naathea; nee puththimaan; avanudaiya naraimayirai iraththaththudan paathaa'laththil i'rangkappa'n'na, nee avanukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathai a'rivaay en'raan.
pinpu thaaveethu than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
thaaveethu isravealai arasaa'nda naadka'l naa'rpathu varusham; avan eproanil eazhu varushamum, erusaleamil muppaththumoon'ru varushamum arasaa'ndaan.
saalomoan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirunthaan; avan raajyapaaram mikavum sthirappattathu.
aakeeththin kumaaranaakiya athoaniyaa saalomoanin thaayaakiya pathseapaa'lidaththil vanthaan. nee samaathaanamaay varuki'raayaa en'ru ava'l keattatha'rku: samaathaanamaayththaan varuki'rean en'raan.
pinpu avan: ummoadea naan peasavea'ndiya oru kaariyam irukki'rathu en'raan. atha'rku ava'l: sol en'raa'l.

appozhuthu avan: raajyam ennudaiyathaayirunthathu en'rum, naan arasaa'luki'ratha'rku isravealarellaarum enmeal noakkamaay irunthaarka'l en'rum neer a'riveer; aanaalum raajyapaaram ennaivittuth thaa'ndi, en sakoatharanukku aayit'ru; karththaraal athu avarukkuk kidaiththathu.
ippozhuthu naan ummidaththil oru man'raattaik keadki'rean; athai enakku ma'rukkavea'ndaam en'raan. ava'l: sol en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avan: raajaavaakiya saalomoan ummudaiya sollai ma'ruppathillai; sooneam ooraa'laakiya apishaakai enakku avar vivaakampa'n'nikkodukka, avaroadea peasumpadi vea'nduki'rean en'raan.
atha'rkup pathseapaa'l: nallathu, naan unakkaaka raajaavidaththil peasuvean en'raa'l.

pathseapaa'l athoaniyaavukkaaka raajaavaakiya saalomoanidaththil peasumpadi poanaa'l; appozhuthu raajaa ezhunthirunthu, ava'lukku ethirko'nduvanthu ava'lai va'nangki, than singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthu, raajaavin thaayaar than valathupu'ramaaka udkaara, ava'lukku oru aasanaththai vaiththaan.
appozhuthu ava'l: naan ummai oru si'riya man'raattaik keadka virumpuki'rean; enakku athai ma'rukkavea'ndaam en'raa'l. atha'rku raajaa: en thaayaarea, kea'lum; naan umakku ma'ruppathillai en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l: sooneam ooraa'laakiya apishaakai ummudaiya sakoatharanaakiya athoaniyaavukku vivaakampa'n'nikkodukkavea'ndum en'raa'l.

raajaavaakiya saalomoan than thaayaarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer sooneam ooraa'laakiya apishaakai athoaniyaavukkuk keadpaanean? appadiyaanaal raajyapaaraththaiyum avanukkuk kea'lum; avan enakku mooththa sakoatharan; avanukkum aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaarukkum seruyaavin kumaaran yoavaapukkumea athaik kea'lum en'raan.

pinpu saalomoan raajaa: athoaniyaa intha vaarththaiyaith than piraa'nanukkuch seathamaakach sollaathirunthaal, theavan atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavar en'ru karththarmeal aa'naiyittu,

ippoathum in'raikku athoaniyaa kolaiyu'npaan en'ru ennaith thidappaduththinavarum, ennai en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin singkaasanaththil veet'rirukkappa'n'ni, thaam sonnapadi enakku veettaik kattuviththavarumaakiya karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru solli,
raajaavaakiya saalomoan yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaavukkuk katta'laikoduththu avanai anuppinaan; ivan avanmeal vizhunthu avanaik kon'rupoattaan.

raajaa: aasaariyanaakiya apiyaththaarai noakki: nee un nilangka'l irukki'ra aanathoaththi'rkup poayvidu; nee mara'naththi'rkup paaththiravaanaayirunthum, nee en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukku munpaakak karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya pettiyaich sumanthapadiyinaalum, en thakappan anupaviththa upaththiravaththaiyellaam nee kooda anupaviththapadiyinaalum, in'raiyathinam naan unnaik kolaiseyyamaattean en'raan.
appadiyea karththar seeloavilea ealiyin veettaaraikku'riththuch sonna vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rumpadiyaaka, saalomoan apiyaththaaraik karththarudaiya aasaariyanaayiraathapadikkuth tha'l'lippoattaan.

nadantha inthach seythi yoavaapukku vanthapoathu, avan karththarudaiya koodaaraththi'rku oadippoay, palipeedaththin kompuka'laip pidiththukko'ndaan; yoavaap apsaloamin padcham saayaathavanaayirunthum, athoaniyaavin padcham saaynthirunthaan.

yoavaap karththarin koodaaraththi'rku oadippoanaan en'rum, ithoa, palipeedaththa'ndaiyil ni'rki'raan en'rum, raajaavaakiya saalomoanukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, saalomoan yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaavai anuppi, nee poay avanmeal vizhu en'raan.

penaayaa karththarin koodaaraththi'rkup poay, avanaip paarththu: ve'liyea vaa en'ru raajaa solluki'raar en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan varamaattean; ingkeayea saavean en'raan; aakaiyaal penaayaa raajaavinidaththil poay, yoavaap innapadi solli, innapadi enakku ma'ruuththaravu koduththaan en'ru ma'ruseythi sonnaan.

appozhuthu raajaa avanai noakki: avan sonnapadiyea nee seythu, avanaik kon'ru, adakkampa'n'ni, ivvithamaay yoavaap mukaantharamillaamal sinthina iraththaththai ennaivittum en pithaavin veettaivittum vilakkippoadu.

avan thannaippaarkkilum neethiyum na'rku'namumu'l'la ira'ndupearaakiya nearin kumaaran apnear ennum isravealin padaiththalaivanmealum, eathearin kumaaran amaasaa ennum yoothaavin padaiththalaivanmealum vizhunthu, en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkuth theriyaamal avarka'laip pattayaththaal kon'ra avanudaiya iraththappazhiyaik karththar avanudaiya thalaiyinmeal thirumpappa'n'nuvaaraaka.

ippadiyea avarka'ludaiya iraththappazhi en'rum yoavaapudaiya thalaiyin mealum, avan santhathiyaarin thalaiyin mealum thirumpavum, thaaveethukkum avar santhathiyaarukkum avar veettaarukkum avar singkaasanaththi'rkum en'ren'raikkum karththaraalea samaathaanam u'ndaayirukkavum kadavathu en'raan.
appadiyea yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaa poay, avanmeal vizhunthu avanaik kon'rupoattaan; avan vanaantharaththilirukki'ra thannudaiya veettilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
avanukkup pathilaaka raajaa yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaavai iraa'nuvaththinmealum, aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkai apiyaththaarin sthaanaththilum vaiththaan.
pinpu raajaa seemeayiyai azhaippiththu, avanai noakki: nee erusaleamilea unakku oru veettaik katti, angkeayirunthu engkeayaavathu ve'liyea poakaamal, angkeathaanea kudiyiru.
nee ve'liyea poayk keetharoan aat'raik kadakkum naa'lil, nee saakavea saavaay; appozhuthu un iraththappazhi un thalaiyinmeal irukkum enpathai nee nichchayamaay a'rinthuko'l en'raan.
seemeayi raajaavaip paarththu: athu nalla vaarththai; raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan sonnapadiyea, umathu adiyaanaakiya naan seyvean en'ru solli, seemeayi aneakanaa'l erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaan.

moon'ru varusham sen'rapoathu, seemeayiyin vealaikkaarar ira'ndupear maakkaavin kumaaranaakiya aakees ennum kaaththin raajaavinidaththukku oadippoanaarka'l; un vealaikkaarar kaath ooril irukki'raarka'l en'ru seemeayikku a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu seemeayi ezhunthu, than kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththu, than vealaikkaararaith theada, kaath oorilirukki'ra aakeesidaththukkup pu'rappattuppoanaan; ippadich seemeayi poay, than vealaikkaararaik kaath oorilirunthu ko'nduvanthaan.
seemeayi erusaleamilirunthu kaath oorukkup poay, thirumpivanthaan en'ru saalomoanukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

raajaa seemeayiyai azhaippiththu: nee ve'liyea pu'rappattu engkeayaavathu poaki'ranaa'lilea saakavea saavaay enpathai nee nichchayamaay a'rinthuko'l en'ru naan unnaik karththarmeal aa'naiyidach seythu, unakkuth thidachsaadchiyaakach solliyirukka, atha'rku nee: naan keatta vaarththai nallathen'ru sollavillaiyaa?
nee karththarin aa'naiyaiyum, naan unakkuk ka'rpiththa katta'laiyaiyum kaikko'l'laathea poanathenna? en'ru solli,

pinnum raajaa seemeayiyaip paarththu: nee en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkuch seythathum un manathukkuth therinthirukki'rathumaana ellaap pollaappaiyum a'rinthirukki'raay; aakaiyaal karththar un pollaappai un thalaiyinmeal thirumpappa'n'nuvaar.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanoa aaseervathikkappattavanaayiruppaan; thaaveethin singkaasanam en'raikkum karththarukku munpaaka u'ruthiyaayirukkum en'ru solli,
raajaa yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaavukkuk katta'laikoduththaan; avan ve'liyea poay, avanmeal vizhunthu avanaik kon'rupoattaan. raajyapaaram saalomoanin kaiyilea sthirappattathu.

saalomoan ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanoadea sampanthangkalanthu, paarvoanin kumaaraththiyai vivaakampa'n'ni, thannudaiya aramanaiyaiyum karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum erusaleamin sut'rumathilaiyum kattith theerumattum avan ava'laith thaaveethin nakaraththil ko'nduvanthu vaiththaan.
annaadka'lmattum karththarudaiya naamaththi'rku oru aalayam kattappadaathirunthathinaal, janangka'l meadaika'lilea paliyittuvanthaarka'l.
saalomoan karththaridaththil anpukoornthu, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin katta'laika'lil nadanthaan; aanaalum avan meadaika'lilea paliyittuth thoopangkaatti vanthaan.
appadiyea raajaa paliyida kipiyoanukkup poanaan; athu periya meadaiyaayirunthathu; anthap palipeedaththinmeal saalomoan aayiram sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththinaan.
kipiyoanilea karththar saalomoanukku iraaththiriyil soppanaththilea tharisanamaaki: nee virumpuki'rathai ennidaththil kea'l en'ru theavan sonnaar.

atha'rkuch saalomoan: en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum umathu adiyaan ummaippat'ri u'nmaiyum neethiyum mana nearmaiyumaay umakku munpaaka nadanthapadiyea theavareer avarukkup periya kirupaiseythu, anthap periya kirupaiyai avarukkuk kaaththu, innaa'lil irukki'rapadiyea avarudaiya singkaasanaththil veet'rirukki'ra oru kumaaranai avarukkuth thantheer.

ippoathum en theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareer umathu adiyeanai en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin sthaanaththilea raajaavaakkineerea, naanoaven'raal poakku varavu a'riyaatha si'rupi'l'laiyaayirukki'rean.
neer therinthuko'ndathum earaa'laththinaal e'n'nikkaikku adangkaathathum ilakkaththi'rku udpadaathathumaana thira'laana janangka'laakiya umathu janaththin naduvil adiyean irukki'rean.

aakaiyaal umathu janangka'lai niyaayam visaarikkavum, nanmaitheemai innathen'ru vakaiya'rukkavum, adiyeanukku gnaanamu'l'la iruthayaththaith thantharu'lum; earaa'lamaayirukki'ra intha umathu janangka'lai niyaayam visaarikka yaaraalea aakum en'raan.
saalomoan inthak kaariyaththaik keattathu aa'ndavarudaiya paarvaikku ukantha vi'n'nappamaayirunthathu.

aakaiyinaal theavan avanai noakki: nee unakku neediththa naadka'laik kea'laamalum, aisuvariyaththaik kea'laamalum, un saththurukka'lin piraa'nanaik kea'laamalum, nee inthak kaariyaththaiyea keattu, niyaayam visaarikki'ratha'rku eat'ra gnaanaththai unakku vea'ndikko'ndapadiyinaal,

un vaarththaika'linpadi seythean; gnaanamum u'narvumu'l'la iruthayaththai unakkuth thanthean; ithilea unakkuch sariyaanavan unakkumun irunthathumillai, unakkuch sariyaanavan unakkuppin ezhumpuvathumillai.
ithuvuman'ri, nee kea'laatha aisuvariyaththaiyum makimaiyaiyum unakkuth thanthean; un naadka'lil irukki'ra raajaakka'lil oruvanum unakkuch sariyaanavan iruppathillai.
un thakappanaakiya thaaveethu nadanthathupoala, neeyum en katta'laika'laiyum en niyamangka'laiyum kaikko'ndu, en vazhika'lil nadappaayaakil, un naadka'laiyum neediththirukkappa'n'nuvean en'raar.

saalomoanukku niththirai the'linthapoathu, athu soppanam en'ru a'rinthaan; avan erusaleamukku vanthu, karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munpaaka nin'ru, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyittu, samaathaanapalika'laich seluththi, than oozhiyakkaarar ellaarukkum virunthuseythaan.
appozhuthu veasika'laana ira'ndu sthireeka'l raajaavinidaththil vanthu, avanukku munpaaka nin'raarka'l.
avarka'lil oruththi: en aa'ndavanea, naanum intha sthireeyum orea veettilea kudiyirukki'roam; naan iva'loadea veettilirukkaiyil aa'npi'l'lai pet'rean.
naan pi'l'laipet'ra moon'raam naa'lilea, intha sthireeyum aa'npi'l'lai pet'raa'l; naangka'l orumiththirunthoam, engka'l iruvaraiyum thavira, veettukku'l'lea vea'roruvarum illai.
iraaththiri thookkaththilea intha sthiree than pi'l'laiyinmeal pura'ndupaduththathinaal athu seththuppoayit'ru.

appozhuthu, umathu adiyaa'l niththiraipa'n'nukaiyil, iva'l nadujaamaththil ezhunthu, en pakkaththilea kidakki'ra en pi'l'laiyai eduththu, than maarpilea kidaththikko'ndu, seththa than pi'l'laiyai eduththu, en maarpilea kidaththivittaa'l.

en pi'l'laikkup paalkodukkak kaalamea naan ezhunthirunthapoathu, athu seththukkidanthathu; pozhuthu vidinthapin naan athai ut'ruppaarkkumpoathu, athu naan pet'ra pi'l'lai allaven'ru ka'ndean en'raa'l.

atha'rku mat'ra sthiree: appadiyalla, uyiroadirukki'rathu en pi'l'lai, seththathu un pi'l'lai en'raa'l. iva'loa: illai, seththathu un pi'l'lai, uyiroadirukki'rathu en pi'l'lai en'raa'l; ippadi raajaavukku munpaaka vaathaadinaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa: uyiroadirukki'rathu en pi'l'lai, seththathu un pi'l'lai en'ru iva'l solluki'raa'l; appadiyalla, seththathu un pi'l'lai, uyiroadirukki'rathu en pi'l'lai en'ru ava'l solluki'raa'l en'ru solli,
oru pattayaththaik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; avarka'l oru pattayaththai raajaavinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
raajaa uyiroadirukki'ra pi'l'laiyai ira'ndaakap pi'lanthu, paathiyai iva'lukkum paathiyai ava'lukkum kodungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu uyiroadirukki'ra pi'l'laiyin thaay, than pi'l'laikkaaka ava'l kudal thudiththathinaal, raajaavai noakki: aiyoa, en aa'ndavanea, uyiroadirukki'ra pi'l'laiyaik kollavea'ndaam; athai ava'lukkea koduththuvidum en'raa'l; mat'rava'l athu enakkum vea'ndaam, unakkum vea'ndaam, pi'lanthu poadungka'l en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa uyiroadirukki'ra pi'l'laiyaik kollaamal, ava'lukkuk koduththuvidungka'l; ava'lea athin thaay en'raan.
raajaa theerththa intha niyaayaththai isravealar ellaarum kea'lvippattu, niyaayam visaarikki'ratha'rku theavan aru'lina gnaanam raajaavukku u'nden'ru ka'ndu, avanukkup payanthaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya saalomoan samastha isravealinmealum raajaavaayirunthaan.
avanukku iruntha pirapukka'l: saathoakkin kumaaranaakiya asariyaa pirathaana manthiriyaayirunthaan.
seesaavin kumaararaakiya ealikoareappum akiyaavum sampirathika'laayirunthaarka'l; akiloothin kumaaran yoasapaath manthiriyaayirunthaan.
yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaa padaiththalaivanum, saathoakkum apiyaththaarum aasaariyarka'lumaayirunthaarka'l.
naaththaanin kumaaran asariyaa ma'niyakkaararin thalaivanaayirunthaan; naaththaanin kumaaran saapooth raajaavin pirathaaniyum ishdanumaayirunthaan.
akeeshaar aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, apthaavin kumaaran athoaneeraam pakuthi visaarippukkaaranumaay irunthaan.

raajaavukkum avan aramanaikkum vea'ndiya u'navupporu'lka'laich seakarikki'ra pannira'ndu ma'niyakkaarar saalomoanukku israveal theasamengkum vaikkappattirunthaarka'l; avarka'l maathaththukku ovvoruvaraaka varushamuzhuvathum paraamariththuvanthaarka'l.
avarka'l naamangka'laavana: oorin kumaaran, ivan eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththil irunthaan.
theakkearin kumaaran, ivan maakkaathsilum, saalpeemilum, pethshimeasilum, ealoanpeththaanaanilum irunthaan.
easeathin kumaaran, ivan a'rupoaththil irunthaan; soakoavum eppear seemaiyanaiththum ivan visaarippil irunthathu.
apinathaapin kumaaran, ivan thoarin naattuppu'ramanaiththi'rkum visaarippukkaaranaayirunthaan; saalomoanin kumaaraththiyaakiya thaapaath ivanukku manaiviyaayirunthaa'l.

akiloothin kumaaranaakiya paanaa, ivan visaarippil, thaanaakum, mekithoavum, sarththanaavukkup pakkamaakavum yesrayealukkuk keezhaakavum pethseyaan thodangki aapeal mekollaamattum yakmeyaamukku appu'raththumattum irukki'ra pethseyaan anaiththum irunthathu.

keapearin kumaaran, ivan keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththil irunthaan; keeleayaaththilu'l'la manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya yaaveerin kiraamangka'lum mathilka'lum ve'nkalath thaazhppaa'lka'lumu'l'la paasaantheasaththinudaiya a'rupathu periya patta'nangka'lu'l'la arkoap seemaiyum ivan visaarippil irunthathu.
iththoavin kumaaran akinathaap, ivan maknaayeemil irunthaan.
akimaas, ivan napthaliyil irunthaan; ivan saalomoanukku iruntha oru kumaaraththiyaakiya pasmaath enpava'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaan.
oosaayin kumaaran paanaa, ivan aasearilum aaloaththilum irunthaan.
paruvaavin kumaaran yoasapaath, ivan isakkaaril irunthaan.
ealaavin kumaaran seemeayi, ivan penyameenil irunthaan.

ooriyin kumaaran keapear, ivan emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanukkum paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakukkum iruntha theasamaakiya keeleayaaththeasaththil irunthaan; ivanmaaththiram aththeasaththil athipathiyaay irunthaan.
yoothaavum isravealum kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanai earaa'lamaayirunthu, pusiththuk kudiththu makizhnthuko'ndirunthaarka'l.

nathithodangki, pelisthar theasavazhiyaay ekipthin ellaimattum irukki'ra sakala raajyangka'laiyum saalomoan aa'nduko'ndirunthaan; avarka'l saalomoanukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, avan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam avanaich seaviththaarka'l.
naa'l on'ri'rkuch saalomoanukkuch sellum saappaattuch selavu, muppathu marakkaal melliya maavum, a'rupathu marakkaal maavum,

kalaimaanka'laiyum ve'limaanka'laiyum varaiyaaduka'laiyum kozhumaiyaana pa'ravaika'laiyum thavira, kozhukkappatta paththu maaduka'lum, meaychchalilirunthu vantha irupathu maaduka'lum noo'ru aaduka'lumaam.

nathikku ippu'raththil irukki'ra thipsaamutha'rko'ndu aasaamattumu'l'lavaiyellaavat'raiyum, nathikku ippu'raththilu'l'la sakala raajaakka'laiyum aa'nduvanthaan; avanaich sut'ri engkum samaathaanamaayirunthathu.

saalomoanudaiya naa'lellaam thaa'n thuvakkip peyersepaamattum, yoothaavum isravealum avaravar thangka'l thangka'l thiraadchachsediyin nizhalilum, thangka'l thangka'l aththimaraththin nizhalilum sukamaayk kudiyirunthaarka'l.
saalomoanukku naalaayiram irathak kuthirailaayangka'lum, panneeraayiram kuthiraiveerarum irunthaarka'l.
mea'rsolliya ma'niyakkaararil ovvoruvarum thanthan maathaththilea saalomoan raajaavukkum, raajaavin panthikku varum yaavarukkum vea'ndiyavaika'lai oru ku'raivumin'ri paraamariththu,
kuthiraika'lukkum ottakangka'lukkum vea'ndiya vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum, vaikkoalaiyum, avaravar thangka'lukku idappatta katta'laiyinpadi avaika'l irukkum sthalaththi'rkuk ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.
theavan saalomoanukku mikuthiyaana gnaanaththaiyum puththiyaiyum, kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanaiyaana manoaviruththiyaiyum koduththaar.
sakala kizhakkaththip puththirarin gnaanaththaiyum ekipthiyarin sakala gnaanaththaiyum paarkkilum saalomoanin gnaanam si'ranthathaayirunthathu.

avan esraakiyanaakiya eaththaanilum, eamaan, kalkoal, tharthaa ennum maakoalin kumaararilum, mat'ra ellaa manusharilum gnaanavaanaayirunthaan; sut'rilum iruntha sakala jaathika'lilum avan keerththi pirapalamaayirunthathu.
avan moovaayiram neethimozhika'laich sonnaan; avanudaiya paattuka'l aayiraththu ainthu.

leepanoanil irukki'ra keathurumarangka'l mutha'rko'ndu suvaril mu'laikki'ra eesoappup poo'nduvaraikkumu'l'la maramuthaliya thaaparangka'laikku'riththum, mirukangka'l pa'ravaika'l oorum piraa'nika'l machchangka'l aakiya ivaika'laikku'riththum vaakkiyangka'laich sonnaan.
saalomoanin gnaanaththaik ku'riththuk kea'lvippatta poomiyin sakala raajaakka'lidaththilumirunthu naanaajaathiyaana janangka'lum avanudaiya gnaanaththaik keadki'ratha'rku vanthaarka'l.

saalomoanai avanudaiya pithaavin sthaanaththil raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraam kea'lvippattu, than oozhiyakkaararai avanidaththil anuppinaan; eeraam thaaveethukkuch sakalanaa'lum sineakithanaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu saalomoan eeraaminidaththil aadka'lai anuppi:

en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin saththurukka'laik karththar avarudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththividuma'lavum, avarka'l thammaich sut'rilum seyki'ra yuththaththinaal, avar thammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik katta, avarukkuk koodaathirunthathu en'ru neer a'rinthirukki'reer.
aanaalum ippozhuthoa en theavanaakiya karththar engkum enakku i'laippaa'ruthalaith thanthaar; viroathiyum illai, idaiyoo'rum illai.

aakaiyaal: naan un sthaanaththil un singkaasanaththinmeal vaikkum un kumaaranea en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattuvaan en'ru karththar en thakappanaakiya thaaveethinidaththil sonnapadiyea, en theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum en'ru irukki'rean.

aathalaal leepanoanil enakkaaka keathurumarangka'lai vettak katta'laiyidum; seethoaniyaraippoala maravettu vealai a'rinthavarka'l engka'lukku'l'lea oruvarumillai enpathu umakkuth theriyum; atha'rkaaka en vealaikkaarar ummudaiya vealaikkaararoadea iruppaarka'l; neer solvathinpadiyellaam ummudaiya vealaikkaararin sampa'laththai umakkuk koduppean en'ru sollachsonnaan.

eeraam saalomoanin vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, mikavum santhoashappattu: antha earaa'lamaana janangka'lai aa'lumpadi, thaaveethukku oru gnaanamu'l'la kumaaranaik koduththa karththar in'ru sthoaththirikkappaduvaaraaka en'ru solli;

eeraam saalomoanidaththil manusharai anuppi: neer enakkuch solliyanuppina kaariyaththai naan keattean; keathurumarangka'lukkaakavum, theavathaari virudchangka'lukkaakavum, ummudaiya viruppaththinpadiyellaam naan seyvean.

en vealaikkaarar leepanoanil irunthu avaika'lai i'rakkik kadalilea ko'nduvaruvaarka'l; angkea naan avaika'laith theppangka'laakak katti, neer niyamikkum idaththukkuk kadalvazhiyaay anuppi, avaika'lai avizhththu oppippean; angkea neer avaika'lai oppukko'ndu en janangka'lukku aakaarangkoduththu, en viruppaththinpadi seyyavea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appadiyea eeraam saalomoanukku vea'ndiyamattum keathurumarangka'laiyum theavathaari virudchangka'laiyum koduththukko'nduvanthaan.

saalomoan eeraamin aramanaikkup poajanaththi'rkaaka irupathinaayirakkalam koathumaiyaiyum, idiththuppizhintha olivamarangka'lin irupathukala e'n'neyaiyum koduththaan; ippadich saalomoan eeraamukku varushaantharam koduththuvanthaan.
karththar saalomoanukkuch solliyirunthapadiyea avanukku gnaanaththaith thantharu'linaar; eeraamukkum saalomoanukkum samaathaanam u'ndaayirunthu, iruvarum udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya saalomoan isravealarellaarilum oozhiyaththukku muppathinaayiram amagnchi aadka'laip pidiththaan.

avarka'lil ovvoru maathaththi'rkup pathinaayirampearai maat'ri maat'ri, leepanoanukku anuppinaan; avarka'l oru maatham leepanoanilum, ira'ndu maatham thangka'l veeduka'lilum iruppaarka'l; athoaneeraam antha amagnchi aadka'linmeal visaarippukkaaranaayirunthaan.
saalomoanidaththil sumai sumakki'ravarka'l ezhupathinaayirampearum, malaika'lil maram vettuki'ravarka'l e'npathinaayirampearum,
ivarka'laiththavira vealaiyai visaariththu vealaiyaadka'laik ka'nkaa'nikki'ratha'rku thalaimaiyaana visaarippukkaarar moovaayiraththu munnoo'rupearum irunthaarka'l.
vettina kallaal aalayaththukku asthipaaram poada, perithum vilaiyea'rappet'rathumaana ka'rka'laik ko'nduvara raajaa katta'laiyittaan.
aalayaththaik katta, saalomoanin si'rpaasaarika'lum, eeraamin si'rpaasaarika'lum, kipali ooraarum, antha marangka'laiyum ka'rka'laiyum vetti aayaththappaduththinaarka'l.

israveal puththirar ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta naanoot'ru e'npathaam varushaththilum, saalomoan isravealinmeal raajaavaana naalaam varusham seepmaathamaakiya ira'ndaam maathaththilum, avan karththarin aalayaththaik kattaththodangkinaan.
saalomoan raajaa karththarukkuk kattina aalayam a'rupathu muzha nee'lamum, irupathu muzha akalamum, muppathu muzha uyaramumaayirunthathu.
aalayamaakiya antha maa'likaiyin mukappilea avan kattina ma'ndapam aalayaththin akalaththi'rkuch sariyaay irupathu muzha nee'lamum, aalayaththukku munnea paththumuzha akalamumaayirunthathu.
paarvaikkuk ku'rukippoaki'ra odukkamaana jannalka'lai aalayaththi'rkuch seyviththaan.
avan theavaalayaththin suvarum sannithi sthaanachsuvarumaakiya aalayaththin suvarka'lukku aduththathaaych sut'rukkattuka'laik katti, avaika'lil a'raika'laich sut'rilum u'ndaakkinaan.

keezhea irukki'ra sut'rukkattu ainthu muzha akalamum, naduvea irukki'rathu aa'ru muzha akalamum, moon'raavathaayirukki'rathu eazhumuzha akalamumaayirunthathu; avaika'l aalayaththinudaiya suvarka'lilea thaangkaathapadikku aalayaththaich sut'rilum pu'rampea ottuchsuvarka'laik kattuviththaan.

aalayam kattappadukaiyil, athu pa'nitheernthu ko'nduvarappatta ka'rka'laalea kattappattathu; aakaiyaal athu kattappaduki'rapoathu, suththika'l vaachchika'l muthalaana entha iruppu aayuthangka'lin saththamum athilea keadkappadavillai.
nadu a'raika'lukkup poaki'ra vaasa'rpadi aalayaththin valathupu'raththil irunthathu; suzha'rpadika'laal nadu a'raika'lukkum, nadu a'raika'lilirunthu moon'raavathu a'raika'lukkum ea'ruvaarka'l.
ivvithamaay avan aalayaththaik katti, keathurumara uththirangka'laalum palakaika'laalum aalayaththai machchuppaavi mudiththaan.
avan ainthumuzha uyaramaana sut'rukkattuka'lai aalayaththinmealengkum kattuviththaan; avaika'l keathurumarangka'laal aalayaththoadea i'naikkappattirunthathu.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai saalomoanukku u'ndaayit'ru; avar:

nee en katta'laika'linpadi nadanthu, en neethiniyaayangka'lai ni'raiveat'ri, en ka'rpanaika'linpadiyellaam nadanthuko'l'lumpadikku, avaika'laik kaikko'ndaal, nee kattuki'ra intha aalayaththaikku'riththu naan un thakappanaakiya thaaveethoadea sonna en vaarththaiyai unnidaththil ni'raiveat'ri,
israveal puththirar naduvilea vaasampa'n'ni, en janamaakiya isravealaik kaividaathiruppean en'raar.
appadiyea saalomoan aalayaththaik katti mudiththaan.

aalayaththuch suvarka'lin udpu'raththai, tha'lamthodangkich suvarka'lin mealmachchumattum, keathuruppalakaika'laal moodi, ippadi udpu'raththai maravealaiyaakki, aalayaththin tha'laththai theavathaari virudchangka'lin palakaika'laal tha'lavarisaippaduththinaan.

tha'lavarisai thodangkich suvarka'lin uyaramattum aalayaththin pakkangka'laith thodarnthirukki'ra irupathumuzha nee'lamaana ma'raippaiyum keathuruppalakaika'laal u'ndaakki, udpu'raththai makaa parisuththamaana sannithi sthaanamaakak kattinaan.
athin munnirukki'ra theavaalayamaakiya maa'likai naa'rpathumuzha nee'lamaayirunthathu.
aalayaththi'rku'l irukki'ra keathurumarangka'lil mokkuka'lum malarntha pookka'lumaana siththiravealai seythirunthathu; paarvaikku oru kallaakilum kaa'nappadaamal ellaam keathurumaramaayirunthathu.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyai vaikki'ratha'rku aalayaththukku'l'lea sannithi sthaanaththai aayaththappaduththinaan.

sannithi sthaanam munpu'ramattum irupathumuzha nee'lamum, irupathumuzha akalamum, irupathumuzha uyaramumaayirunthathu; athaip pasumpon thakattaal moodinaan; keathurumarap palipeedaththaiyum appadiyea moodinaan.
aalayaththin udpu'raththaich saalomoan pasumponthakattaal moodi, sannithi sthaanaththin ma'raippukkum pon sangkilika'laik ku'rukkea poattu, athaip pon thakattaal moodinaan.
ippadi aalayam muzhuvathum kattiththeerumattum, avan aalayam muzhuvathaiyum ponthakattaal moodi, sannithi sthaanaththi'rku munpaaka irukki'ra palipeedaththai muzhuvathum ponthakattaal moodinaan.
sannithi sthaanaththil olivamarangka'laal ira'ndu kearupeenka'laich seythu vaiththaan; ovvon'rum paththumuzha uyaramaayirunthathu.

kearupeenukku irukki'ra oru settai ainthu muzhamum kearupeenin mat'rach settai ainthu muzhamumaay, ippadi oru settaiyin kadaisimunaithodangki mat'rach settaiyin kadaisimunaimattum paththu muzhamaayirunthathu.
mat'rak kearupeenum paththu muzhamaayirunthathu; ira'ndu kearupeenka'lum orea a'lavum orea thittamumaayirunthathu.
oru kearupeen paththumuzha uyaramaayirunthathu; mat'rak kearupeenum appadiyea irunthathu.

anthak kearupeenka'lai u'l aalayaththilea vaiththaan; kearupeenka'lin settaika'l viriththirunthathinaal, oru kearupeenin settai orupakkaththathuch suvarilum, mat'rak kearupeenin settai ma'rupakkaththuch suvarilum thodaththakkathaayirunthathu; aalayaththin nadumaiyaththil, avaika'lin settaika'l on'roadon'ru thodaththakkathaayirunthathu.
anthak kearupeenka'laip ponthakattaal moodinaan.
aalayaththin suvarka'laiyellaam avan sut'rilum u'l'lum pu'rampumaakak kearupeenka'lum peareenthuka'lum malarntha pookka'lumaana siththirangka'lum koththu vealaika'lumaakkinaan.
u'l'lum pu'rampumaayirukki'ra aalayaththuth tha'lavarisaiyaiyum ponthakattaal moodinaan.
sannithi sthaanaththin vaasalukku olivamarangka'laal irattaik kathavuka'laich seythaan; mealsattamum nilaika'lum ma'raippin a'lavil ainthil oru pangkaayirunthathu.

olivamaramaana antha irattaik kathavuka'lil avan kearupeenka'lum peareenthuka'lum malarntha pookka'lumaana siththirangka'laich seythu, anthak kearupeenka'lilum peareenthuka'lilum ponpathiyaththakkathaayp ponthakattaal moodinaan.
