ippadi theavaalayaththin vaasalukkum olivamara nilaika'laich seythaan; athu suvar a'lavil naalaththoru pangkaayirunthathu.
athin ira'ndu kathavuka'lum theavathaarip palakaika'laal seyyappattirunthathu; oru kathavukku ira'ndu madippup palakaika'lum, mat'rak kathavukku ira'ndu madippup palakaika'lum irunthathu.
avaika'lil kearupeenka'lum peareenthuka'lum malarntha pookka'lumaana siththira vealaiyaich seythu, siththirangka'lukkuch sariyaakach seyyappatta ponthakattaal avaika'lai moodinaan.
avan udpiraakaaraththai moon'ru varisai vettina ka'rka'laalum, oru varisai keathurup palakaika'laalum kattinaan.
naalaam varusham seepmaathaththilea karththarudaiya aalayaththukku asthipaaram poattu,

pathinoaraam varusham pool ennum ettaam maathaththilea, antha aalayamuzhuthum sakala sattathittaththinpadiyea oru pangkum ku'raiyaamal kattith theernthathu; avan athaik kattimudikka eazhuvarusham sen'rathu.
saalomoan than aramanai muzhuthaiyum kattimudikka pathinmoon'ru varusham sen'rathu.

avan leepanoan vanam ennum maa'likaiyaiyum kattinaan; athu noo'ru muzha nee'lamum, aimpathumuzha akalamum, muppathumuzha uyaramumaayirunthathu; athaik keathurumara uththirangka'l paavappatta keathurumaraththoo'nka'lin naalu varisaika'linmeal kattinaan.
ovvoru varisaikkup pathinainthu thoo'nka'laaka naa'rpaththainthu thoo'nka'linmeal vaikkappatta uththirangka'linmeal keathurukka'laal machchuppaaviyirunthathu.
moon'ru varisai jannalka'l irunthathu; moon'ru varisaiyilum jannalka'l, on'rukkon'ru ethiraayirunthathu.
jannalka'lin vaasalka'lum sattangka'lum ellaam sathuramaayirunthathu; moon'ru varisaiyilum jannalka'l on'rukkon'ru ethiraayirunthathu.

aimpathumuzha nee'lamum muppathumuzha akalamumaana ma'ndapaththaiyum thoo'nka'l ni'ruththik kattinaan; antha ma'ndapamum, athin thoo'nka'lum, uththirangka'lum, maa'likaiyin thoo'nka'lukkum uththirangka'lukkum ethiraayirunthathu.

thaan irunthu niyaayam theerkki'ratha'rku niyaayaasanam poattirukkum oru niyaayavisaara'nai ma'ndapaththaiyum katti, athin orupakkam thuvakki ma'rupakkamattum keathuruppalakaika'laal tha'lavarisaip paduththinaan.

avan vaasampa'n'num avanudaiya aramanai ma'ndapaththi'rku'l'lea atheamaathiriyaakach seyyappatta vea'roru ma'ndapamum irunthathu. saalomoan vivaakampa'n'nina paarvoanin kumaaraththikkum antha ma'ndapaththaippoala oru maa'likaiyaik kattuviththaan.

ivaika'lellaam, u'l'lum pu'rampum, asthipaaramuthal mealthira'naika'lmattum, ve'liyea irukkum periya mut'ramvaraikkum, a'lavupadi vetti vaa'laal a'rukkappatta vilaiyea'rappet'ra ka'rka'laal seyyappattathu.
asthipaaram paththumuzhak ka'rka'lum, ettumuzhak ka'rka'lumaana vilaiyea'rappet'ra periya ka'rka'laayirunthathu.
athinmeal uyara a'lavupadi pa'nippaduththina vilaiyea'rappet'ra ka'rka'lum, keathurumarangka'lum vaikkappattirunthathu.

periya mut'raththi'rkuch sut'rilum moon'ru varisaik keathurumara uththirangka'laalum oru varisai pa'nippaduththina ka'rka'laalum seyyappattirunthathu; karththarudaiya aalayaththin udpiraakaaraththi'rkum, athin munma'ndapaththi'rkum appadiyea seyyappattirunthathu.
raajaavaakiya saalomoan eeraam ennum oruvanaith theeruvilirunthu azhaippiththaan.

ivan napthali koaththiraththaa'laakiya oru kaimpe'n'nin makan; ivan thakappan theerunakaraththaanaana kannaan; ivan sakalavitha ve'nkalavealaiyaiyum seyyaththakka yukthiyum puththiyum a'rivum u'l'lavanaayirunthaan; ivan raajaavaakiya saalomoanidaththil vanthu, avan vealaiyaiyellaam seythaan.
ivan ira'ndu ve'nkalath thoo'nka'lai u'ndaakkinaan; ovvoru thoo'n pathinettu muzha uyaramum, ovvoru thoo'nin sut'ra'lavu pannira'ndu muzha noola'lavumaayirunthathu.
anthath thoo'nka'ludaiya thalaippil vaikka, ve'nkalaththaal vaarkkappatta ira'ndu kumpangka'lai u'ndaakkinaan; ovvoru kumpamum ainthumuzha uyaramaayirunthathu.
thoo'nka'ludaiya munaiyinmealu'l'la kumpangka'lukku valaipoan'ra pinnalka'lum, sangkilipoan'ra thongkalka'lum, ovvoru kumpaththi'rkum evveazhaaka irunthathu.
thoo'nka'laip pa'n'nina vithamaavathu: thalaippinmealu'l'la kumpangka'lai moodumpadikku, kumpangka'l ovvon'rilum pinnalinmeal sut'rilum ira'ndu varisai maatha'lampazhangka'laich seyviththaan.
ma'ndapaththin munnirukkum anthath thoo'nka'ludaiya thalaippinmealu'l'la kumpangka'l leelipushpangka'lin vealaiyum, naalumuzha uyaramumaayirunthathu.

ira'ndu thoo'nka'linmealumu'l'la kumpangka'lil seyyappatta pinnalukku arukea iruntha idaththil vimmiya irunoo'ru maatha'lampazhangka'lin varisaika'l sut'rilum irunthathu; mat'rak kumpaththilum appadiyea irunthathu.

anthath thoo'nka'lai theavaalaya vaasal ma'ndapaththil ni'ruththinaan; avan valathupu'raththil ni'ruththina thoo'nukku yaakeen en'rum, idathupu'raththil ni'ruththina thoo'nukku poavaas en'rum pearittaan.
thoo'nka'ludaiya sikaraththil leelipushpavealai seyyappattirunthathu; ivvithamaayth thoo'nka'lin vealai mudinthathu.

ve'nkalak kadal ennum thottiyaiyum vaarppiththaan; sut'rilum sakkaraakaaramaana athinudaiya oru vi'limpu thodangki ma'ruvi'limpumattum, akalam paththumuzhamum, uyaram ainthumuzhamum, sut'ra'lavu muppathumuzha noola'lavumaayirunthathu.

anthak kadalthottiyaich sut'ri vi'limpukkuk keezhea athaich sut'rilum mokkuka'l ovvoru muzhaththi'rkup paththu paththaakach seyyappattirunthathu; vaarkkappatta antha mokkuka'lin varisaika'l ira'ndum thottiyoadu on'raay vaarkkappattirunthathu.

athu pannira'ndu rishapangka'linmeal nin'rathu; avaika'lil moon'ru vadakkeayum, moon'ru mea'rkeayum, moon'ru the'rkeayum, moon'ru kizhakkeayum noakkiyirunthathu; kadalthotti rishapangka'lin mealaakavum, avaika'lin pinpu'rangka'lellaam u'l'laakavum irunthathu.
athin kanam naalu vira'rkadaiyum, athin vi'limpu paanapaaththiraththin vi'limpupoalum, leelipushpampoalum irunthathu; athu ira'ndaayiram kudam tha'n'neer pidikkum.
paththu ve'nkala aathaarangka'laiyum seythaan; ovvoru aathaaram naalumuzha nee'lamum, naalumuzha akalamum, moon'rumuzha uyaramumaayirunthathu.
antha aathaarangka'lin vealaippaadu ennavenil, avaika'lukkuch savukkaika'l u'ndaayirunthathu; savukkaika'loa sattangka'lin naduvil irunthathu.

sattangka'lukku naduvea irukki'ra anthach savukkaika'lil singkangka'lum, kaa'laika'lum, kearupeenka'lum, sattangka'lukku mealaaka oru thira'naiyum, singkangka'lukkum kaa'laika'lukkum keezhaaka saayvaana vealaippaadu'l'la jalathaaraika'lum athanoadea irunthathu.

ovvoru aathaaraththi'rku naalu ve'nkala uru'laika'lum, ve'nkalath thattuka'lum, athin naalu koadika'lukku achchuka'lum irunthathu; kopparaiyin keezhirukka, anthak kommaika'l ovvon'rum vaarppu vealaiyaaka jalathaaraika'lukku nearaayirunthathu.

thira'naika'lukku'l'laana athin vaay mealaaka orumuzham uyarnthirunthathu; athin vaay on'raraimuzha sakkaraakaaramum thattaiyumaay, athin vaayinmeal siththirangka'lum seyyappattirunthathu; avaika'lin savukkaika'l viruththamaayiraamal sathuramaayirunthathu.
antha naalu uru'laika'l savukkaika'lin keezhum, uru'laika'lin achchuka'l aathaaraththilum irunthathu; ovvoru uru'lai on'raraimuzha uyaramaayirunthathu.
uru'laika'lin vealai irathaththu uru'laika'lin vealaikku oththirunthathu; avaika'lin achchuka'lum, sakkarangka'lum, vattangka'lum, kampika'lum ellaam vaarppuvealaiyaayirunthathu.
ovvoru aathaaraththinudaiya naalu koadika'lilum, aathaaraththilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra naalu kommaika'l irunthathu.
ovvoru aathaaraththin thalaippilum araimuzha uyaramaana sakkaraakaaramum, ovvoru aathaaraththinudaiya thalaippinmealum athilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra athin kaippidika'lum savukkaika'lum irunthathu.

avaika'lilirukki'ra kaippidika'lukkum savukkaika'lukkum irukki'ra santhuka'lilea, kearupeenka'l singkangka'l peareenthuka'ludaiya siththirangka'laith theerththirunthaan; sut'rilum ovvon'rilum, jalathaaraika'lilum irukkum idangka'lukkuth thakkathaaych seythaan.
inthappirakaaramaaka anthap paththu aathaarangka'laiyum seythaan; avaika'lellaam orea vaarppum, orea a'lavum, oreavitha koththuvealaiyumaayirunthathu.
paththu ve'nkalak kopparaika'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan; ovvoru kopparai naa'rpathu kudam pidikkum; naalumuzha akalamaana ovvoru kopparaiyum anthap paththu aathaarangka'lil ovvon'rinmealum vaikkappattathu.

ainthu aathaarangka'lai aalayaththin valathupu'raththilum, ainthu aathaarangka'lai aalayaththin idathupu'raththilum vaiththaan; kadalthottiyaik kizhakkil aalayaththin valathupu'raththilea the'rkukku nearaaka vaiththaan.

pinpu eeraam kopparaika'laiyum saampal edukki'ra kara'ndika'laiyum kalangka'laiyum seythaan. ivvithamaay eeraam karththarudaiya aalayaththukkaaka raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkuch seyyavea'ndiya ellaa vealaiyaiyum seythu mudiththaan.

avaika'l ennavenil: ira'ndu thoo'nka'lum, ira'ndu thoo'nka'ludaiya munaiyinmeal irukki'ra ira'ndu uru'ndaik kumpangka'lum, thoo'nka'ludaiya munaiyinmeal irukki'ra ira'ndu uru'ndaik kumpangka'lai moodum ira'ndu valaip pinnalka'lum,

thoo'nka'linmealu'l'la ira'ndu uru'ndaik kumpangka'lai moodumpadi ovvoru valaippinnalukkum pa'n'nina ira'ndu varisai maatha'lampazhangka'lum, aaka ira'ndu valaippinnalukkum naanoo'ru maatha'lampazhangka'lum,
paththu aathaarangka'lum, aathaarangka'linmeal vaiththa paththuk kopparaika'lum,
oru kadalthottiyum, kadalthottiyin keezhirukki'ra pannira'ndu rishapangka'lum,

seppuchsattika'lum, saampal kara'ndika'lum, kalangka'lum seythaan; karththarin aalayaththukkaaka raajaavaakiya saalomoanukku eeraam seytha intha ellaap pa'nimuttuka'lum suththamaana ve'nkalamaayirunthathu.
yoarthaanukku aduththa samanaana poomiyilea, sukkoaththukkum sarthaanukkum naduvea ka'lima'ntharaiyilea raajaa ivaika'lai vaarppiththaan.
inthach sakala pa'nimuttuka'lin ve'nkalam mikavum earaa'lamumaayirunthapadiyaal, saalomoan avaika'lai ni'rukkavillai; athinudaiya ni'rai ivva'laven'ru aaraaynthu paarkkavumillai.
pinnum karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuth theavaiyaana pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam saalomoan u'ndaakkinaan; avaiyaavana, pon palipeedaththaiyum, samukaththappangka'lai vaikkum ponmeajaiyaiyum,

sannithi sthaanaththi'rku munpaaka vaikkum pasumpon vi'lakkuththa'nduka'l, valathupu'ramaaka ainthaiyum idathupu'ramaaka ainthaiyum, ponnaana athin pookka'loadum vi'lakkuka'loadum kaththarika'loadungkooda u'ndaakkinaan.

pasumpon ki'n'nangka'laiyum, vettukkaththika'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum, kalayangka'laiyum, thoopakalasangka'laiyum, makaa parisuththamaana u'l aalayaththinudaiya kathavuka'lin ponnaana mu'laika'laiyum, theavaalayamaakiya maa'likaik kathavuka'lin ponnaana mu'laika'laiyum seythaan.

ivvithamaay raajaavaakiya saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththukkaakach seytha vealaika'lellaam mudinthathu; appozhuthu saalomoan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu parisuththampa'n'numpadi nearnthuko'nda ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum pa'nimuttuka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'lil vaiththaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaich seeyoan ennum thaaveethin nakaraththilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadi saalomoan isravealin moopparaiyum, koaththirap pirapukka'laakiya israveal puththirarilu'l'la pithaakka'lin thalaivar anaivaraiyum, erusaleamil raajaavaakiya saalomoan thannidaththilea koodivarachseythaan.
israveal manusharellaarum eazhaam maathamaakiya eaththaaneemmaathaththup pa'ndikaiyilea, raajaavaakiya saalomoanidaththil koodivanthaarka'l.
isravealin mooppar anaivarum vanthirukkaiyil, aasaariyar karththarudaiya pettiyai eduththu,
pettiyaiyum, aasarippuk koodaaraththaiyum, koodaaraththiliruntha parisuththa pa'nimuttuka'l anaiththaiyum sumanthu ko'nduvanthaarka'l; aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, avaika'laich sumanthaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanum avanoadeakoodina israveal sapaiyanaiththum pettikku munpaaka nadanthu, e'n'nikkaiyum ka'nakkumillaatha thira'laana aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum paliyittaarka'l.

appadiyea aasaariyarka'l karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyai aalayaththin sannithi sthaanamaakiya makaaparisuththa sthaanaththilea kearupeenka'ludaiya settaika'linkeezhea ko'nduvanthu vaiththaarka'l.
kearupeenka'l pettiyirukkum sthaanaththilea thangka'l ira'ndu settaika'laiyum viriththu, uyara irunthu pettiyaiyum athin tha'nduka'laiyum moodikko'ndirunthathu.

tha'nduka'lin munaika'l sannithi sthaanaththi'rku munnaana parisuththa sthalaththilea kaa'nappadaththakkathaay anthath tha'nduka'lai munnukku izhuththaarka'l; aakilum ve'liyea avaika'l kaa'nappadavillai; avaika'l innaa'lvaraikkum angkeathaan irukki'rathu.

israveal puththirar ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappattapin karththar avarka'loadea udanpadikkai pa'n'nuki'rapoathu, moasea oareapilea anthap pettiyil vaiththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lea allaamal athilea vea'ron'rum irunthathillai.
appozhuthu aasaariyarka'l parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu pu'rappadukaiyil, meakamaanathu karththarudaiya aalayaththai nirappit'ru.
meakaththinimiththam aasaariyarka'l oozhiyagnseyki'ratha'rku ni'rkakkoodaama'r poayit'ru; karththarudaiya makimai karththarudaiya aalayaththai nirappit'ru.
appozhuthu saalomoan: kaariru'lilea vaasampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sonnaar en'rum,
theavareer vaasampa'n'naththakka veedum, neer en'raikkum thangkaththakka nilaiyaana sthaanamumaakiya aalayaththai umakkuk kattinean en'rum solli,
raajaa mukam thirumpi, israveal sapaiyaiyellaam aaseervathiththaan; israveal sapaiyaarellaarum nin'raarka'l.
avan sonnathu: isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram; avar en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkuth thammudaiya vaakkinaal sonnathaith thammudaiya karaththinaal ni'raiveat'rinaar.

avar naan en janamaakiya isravealai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lmutha'rko'ndu, en naamam vi'langkumpadi, oru aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum en'ru naan isravealudaiya ellaak koaththirangka'lilumu'l'la oru patta'naththaiyum therinthuko'l'laamal en janamaakiya isravealinmeal athikaariyaayirukkumpadi thaaveethaiyea therinthuko'ndean en'raar.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum enki'ra viruppam en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin iruthayaththil irunthathu.
aanaalum karththar en thakappanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum enki'ra viruppam un manathilea irunthathu nallakaariyanthaan.
aakilum nee antha aalayaththaik kattamaattaay, un karppappi'rappaakiya un kumaaranea en naamaththi'rku antha aalayaththaik kattuvaan en'raar.

ippoathum karththar solliya thammudaiya vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rinaar; karththar sonnapadiyea, naan en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin sthaanaththil ezhumpi, isravealin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattinean.
karththar nammudaiya pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninapoathu, avarka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkai irukki'ra pettikkaaka athilea oru sthaanaththai u'ndaakkinean en'raan.
pinpu saalomoan: karththarudaiya palipeedaththi'rkumunnea israveal sapaiyaarellaarukkum ethiraaka nin'ru, vaanaththi'rku nearaayth than kaika'lai viriththu:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, mealea vaanaththilum keezhea poomiyilum umakku oppaana theavan illai; thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum umakku munpaaka nadakki'ra umathu adiyaarukku udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum kaaththuvaruki'reer.

theavareer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum ummudaiya thaasanukkuch seytha vaakkuththaththaththaik kaaththaru'lineer; athai ummudaiya vaakkinaal sonneer; innaa'lil irukki'rapadi, ummudaiya karaththinaal athai ni'raiveat'rineer.

isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum ummudaiya thaasanai noakki: nee enakku munpaaka nadanthathupoala, un kumaararum enakku munpaaka nadakkumpadi thangka'l vazhiyaik kaappaarka'leayaanaal, isravealin singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkum purushan enakku munpaaka unakku illaama'rpoavathillai en'ru sonnathai ippozhuthu avanukku ni'raiveat'rum.
isravealin theavanea, en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum ummudaiya thaasanukkuch sonna ummudaiya vaarththai meyyen'ru vi'langkuvathaaka.
theavan meyyaaka poomiyilea vaasampa'n'nuvaaroa? ithoa, vaanangka'lum vaanaathi vaanangka'lum ummaik ko'l'laathea; naan kattina intha aalayam emmaaththiram?

en theavanaakiya karththaavea, umathu adiyean in'ru umathu sannithiyil seyki'ra vi'n'nappaththaiyum man'raattaiyum keattu, umathu adiyeanudaiya vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum thiruvu'laththil ko'ndaru'lum.

umathu adiyean ivvidaththilea seyyum vi'n'nappaththaik keadkumpadi ennudaiya naamam vi'langkumen'ru neer sonna sthalamaakiya intha aalayaththinmeal ummudaiya ka'nka'l iravum pakalum thi'ranthiruppathaaka.

umathu adiyaanum, intha sthalaththilea vi'n'nappagn seyyappoaki'ra umathu janamaakiya isravealum pa'n'num jepaththaik keattaru'lum; paraloakamaakiya ummudaiya vaasasthalaththilea athai neer keadpeeraaka, keattu mannippeeraaka.
oruvan than ayalaanukkuk kut'ragnseythirukkaiyil, ivan avanai aa'naiyidachsollumpoathu, antha aa'nai intha aalayaththilea ummudaiya palipeedaththi'rku mun vanthaal,

appozhuthu paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer keattu, thunmaarkkanudaiya nadakkaiyai avan thalaiyinmeal sumarappa'n'ni, avanaik kut'ravaa'liyaakath theerkkavum, neethimaanukku avanudaiya neethikkuththakkathaaych seythu avanai neethimaanaakkavum thakkathaay umathu adiyaarai niyaayantheerppeeraaka.

ummudaiya janangka'laakiya isravealar umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythathinimiththam saththuruvukku munpaaka mu'rinthupoay, ummidaththi'rkuth thirumpi, ummudaiya naamaththai a'rikkaipa'n'ni, intha aalayaththukku nearaaka ummai noakki vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum seythaal,
paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer keattu, ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealin paavaththai manniththu, avarka'l pithaakka'lukku neer koduththa theasaththukku avarka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuveeraaka.

avarka'l umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythathinaal vaanam adaipattu mazhaipeyyaathirukkumpoathu, avarka'l intha sthalaththi'rku nearaaka vi'n'nappagnseythu, ummudaiya naamaththai a'rikkaipa'n'ni, thangka'lai theavareer kileasappaduththukaiyil thangka'l paavangka'lai vittuth thirumpinaal,

paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer keattu, umathu adiyaarum umathu janamaakiya isravealum seytha paavaththai manniththu, avarka'l nadakkavea'ndiya nalvazhiyai avarka'lukkup poathiththu, theavareer umathu janaththi'rkuch suthantharamaakak koduththa umathu theasaththil mazhaipeyyak katta'laiyiduveeraaka.

theasaththilea pagncham u'ndaaki'rapoathum, ko'l'lainoay u'ndaaki'rapoathum, va'radchi, saavi, vettukki'li, pachchaikki'li u'ndaaki'rapoathum, avarka'l saththurukka'l theasaththilu'l'la patta'nangka'lai mut'rikkaipoaduki'rapoathum, yaathoru vaathaiyaakilum yaathoru viyaathiyaakilum varuki'rapoathum,

ummudaiya janamaakiya israveal anaivarilum entha manushanaanaalum than iruthayaththin vaathaiyai u'narnthu, intha aalayaththukku nearaakath than kaika'lai viriththuch seyyum sakala vi'n'nappaththaiyum, sakala vea'nduthalaiyum,
ummudaiya vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer keattu manniththu,

theavareer engka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththil avarka'l uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam umakkup payappadumpadikku theavareer oruvarea ellaa manupuththirarin iruthayaththaiyum a'rinthavaraathalaal, neer avanavan iruthayaththai a'rinthirukki'rapadiyea, avanavanudaiya vazhika'lukkuththakkathaakach seythu, avanavanukkup palan a'lippeeraaka.
ummudaiya janamaakiya israveal jaathiyallaatha anniya jaathiyaar umathu makaththuvamaana naamaththaiyum, umathu palaththa karaththaiyum, umathu oangkiya puyaththaiyum kea'lvippaduvaarka'lea.
appadikkoththa anniya jaathiyaanum, umathu naamaththinimiththam thooratheasaththilirunthu vanthu, intha aalayaththukku nearaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal,

umathu vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer athaik keattu, poomiyin janangka'lellaarum ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealaippoala umakkup payappadumpadikkum, naan kattina intha aalayaththukku ummudaiya naamam tharikkappattathen'ru a'riyumpadikkum, ummudaiya naamaththai a'riyaththakkathaaka, antha anniya jaathiyaan ummai noakki vea'ndikko'lvathinpadiyellaam theavareer seyveeraaka.

neer ummudaiya janangka'lai anuppum vazhiyilea avarka'l thangka'l saththurukka'loadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappadumpoathu, neer therinthuko'nda intha nakaraththukkum, ummudaiya naamaththukku naan kattina intha aalayaththukkum nearaakak karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal,
paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum keattu, avarka'l niyaayaththai visaarippeeraaka.

paavagnseyyaatha manushan illaiyea; aakaiyaal, avarka'l umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, theavareer avarka'lmeal koapangko'ndu, avarka'l saththurukka'l kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkoduththu, anthach saththurukka'l avarka'laith thooraththilaakilum sameepaththilaakilum irukki'ra thangka'l theasaththi'rkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoakumpoathu,

avarka'l si'raippattup poayirukki'ra theasaththilea thangka'lil u'narvadainthu, mananthirumpi: naangka'l paavagnseythu, akkiramampa'n'ni, thunmaarkkamaay nadanthoam en'ru thangka'l si'raiyiruppaana theasaththilea ummai noakki vea'nduthal seythu,

thangka'laich si'raipidiththukko'nda thangka'l saththurukka'lin theasaththilea thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum thangka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum ummidaththil thirumpi, theavareer thangka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa thangka'l theasaththi'rkum, theavareer therinthuko'nda intha nakaraththi'rkum, ummudaiya naamaththi'rku naan kattina intha aalayaththi'rkum nearaaka ummai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'numpoathu,
umathu vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum keattu, avarka'l niyaayaththai visaariththu,

ummudaiya janangka'l umakku viroathamaaych seytha paavaththaiyum, avarka'l ummudaiya katta'laiyai mee'riya avarka'l thuroakangka'laiyum ellaam manniththu, avarka'laich si'raipidiththuk ko'ndupoaki'ravarka'l avarka'lukku irangkaththakkathaana irakkaththai avarka'lukkuk kidaikkappa'n'nuveeraaka.
avarka'l ekipthenki'ra iruppuk kaa'lavaayin naduvilirunthu theavareer pu'rappadappa'n'nina ummudaiya janamum ummudaiya suthantharamumaay irukki'raarka'lea.

avarka'l ummai noakki vea'ndikko'lvathinpadiyellaam theavareer avarka'lukkuch seyyumpadi, ummudaiya ka'nka'l umathu adiyaanin vea'nduthalukkum, umathu janamaakiya isravealin vea'nduthalukkum thi'ranthiruppathaaka.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, neer engka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'numpoathu, ummudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseayaikko'ndu sonnapadiyea, theavareer poomiyin sakala janangka'lilum avarka'lai umakkuch suthantharamaakap piriththeduththeerea en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

saalomoan karththarai noakki, intha jepaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum ellaam seythu mudiththapinpu, avan karththarudaiya palipeedaththi'rku munpaakath than kaika'lai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka viriththu, muzhangkaa'rpadiyittirunthathai vittezhunthu,
nin'ruko'ndu, israveal sapaiyaiyellaam aaseervathiththu, uraththa saththaththoadea sonnathu:

thaam vaakkuththaththam pa'n'ninapadiyellaam thammudaiya janamaakiya isravealukku i'laippaa'ruthalai aru'lina karththarukku sthoaththiram, avar thammudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseayaikko'ndu sonna avarudaiya nalvaarththaika'lil ellaam oru vaarththaiyaanaalum thava'rippoakavillai.
nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar nammaik kaividaamalum, nammai nekizhavidaamalum, avar nammudaiya pithaakka'loadu irunthathupoala, nammoadum irunthu,

naam avarudaiya vazhika'lil ellaam nadakki'ratha'rkum, avar nammudaiya pithaakka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum, avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum, avarudaiya niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'luki'ratha'rkum, nammudaiya iruthayaththaith thammidaththil saayappa'n'nuvaaraaka.
karththarea theavan, vea'roruvarum illaiyenpathaip poomiyin janangka'lellaam a'riyumpadiyaaka,

avar thamathu adiyaanudaiya niyaayaththaiyum, thamathu janamaakiya isravealin niyaayaththaiyum, anthantha naa'lil nadakkum kaariyaththukkuththakkathaay visaarippatha'rku, naan karththarukku munpaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'nina intha ennudaiya vaarththaika'l iravumpakalum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil iruppathaaka.

aathalaal innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, neengka'l avar katta'laika'lil nadanthu, avar ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'la, ungka'l iruthayam nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththaroadu uththamamaay irukkakkadavathu en'raan.
pinpu raajaavum avanoadea iruntha isravealar anaivarum, karththarudaiya sannithiyil palika'laich seluththinaarka'l.

saalomoan karththarukkuch samaathaanapalika'laaka, irupaththeeraayiram maaduka'laiyum, iladchaththirupathinaayiram aaduka'laiyum paliyittaan; ivvithamaay raajaavum israveal puththirar anaivarum karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaarka'l.

karththarudaiya sannithiyil iruntha ve'nkalap palipeedam sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum, poajanapalika'laiyum, samaathaana palika'lin ni'naththaiyum ko'l'lamaattaamal si'rithaayirunthapadiyinaal, raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkumun irukki'ra piraakaaraththin nadumaiyaththaip parisuththappaduththi, an'raiyathinam angkea sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum, poajanapalika'laiyum, samaathaana palika'lin ni'naththaiyum seluththinaan.

akkaalaththilthaanea saalomoanum, aamaaththin ellaithodangki ekipthin nathimattum irunthuvanthu, avanoadea iruntha periya koottamaakiya israveal anaiththum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sannithiyil eazhunaa'lum, atha'rkuppinpu vea'rea eazhunaa'lum, aakap pathinaalu naa'lvaraikkum pa'ndikaiyai aasariththaarka'l.

ettaamnaa'lilea janangka'lukku vidaikoduththu anuppinaan; avarka'l raajaavai vaazhththi, karththar thamathu thaasanaakiya thaaveethukkum thamathu janamaakiya isravealukkum seytha ellaa nanmaikkaakavum santhoashappattu manamakizhchchiyoadea thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poayvittaarka'l.
saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum raaja aramanaiyaiyum, thaan seyyavea'ndum en'ru virumpina ellaavat'raiyum katti mudiththapinpu,
karththar kipiyoanilea saalomoanukkuth tharisanamaanathupoala, ira'ndaantharamum avanukkuth tharisanamaanaar.

karththar avanai noakki: nee en samukaththil seytha un vi'n'nappaththaiyum un vea'nduthalaiyum keattean; nee kattina intha aalayaththil en naamam en'raikkum vi'langkaththakkathaaka, athaip parisuththamaakkinean; en ka'nka'lum en iruthayamum ennaa'lum angkeayirukkum.

naan unakkuk katta'laiyitta ellaavat'raiyum nee seythu, en katta'laika'laiyum en niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'lumpadikku, en samukaththil mana uththamamum semmaiyumaay un thakappanaakiya thaaveethu nadanthathupoala nadappaayaanaal,

isravealin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarum purushan unakku illaama'rpoavathillai en'ru un thakappanaakiya thaaveethoadea naan sonnapadiyea, isravealinmealu'l'la un raajyapaaraththin singkaasanaththai en'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean.

neengka'lum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum ennaivittup pinvaangki, naan ungka'lukku munvaiththa en ka'rpanaika'laiyum en katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'laama'rpoay, vea'rea theavarka'laich seaviththu, avaika'laip pa'ninthuko'lveerka'laakil,

naan isravealukkuk koduththa theasaththilea avarka'lai vaikkaathapadikku nirmoolamaakki, en naamam vi'langka naan parisuththamaakkina intha aalayaththai en samukaththaivittuth tha'l'luvean; appozhuthu israveal sakala janangka'lukku'l'lum pazhamozhiyaakavum vasaichsollaakavum iruppaarka'l.

appozhuthu unnathamaayirukki'ra intha aalayaththaik kadanthupoaki'ravan evanum piramiththu, pakidiyaay eesalittu: karththar intha theasaththukkum intha aalayaththukkum ippadich seythathu enna? en'ru keadpaarka'l.

atha'rku avarka'l: thangka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraivittu, vea'rea theavarka'laip pat'rikko'ndu, avarka'lai namaskariththuch seaviththapadiyinaal, karththar inthath theengkaiyellaam avarka'lmeal varappa'n'ninaar en'ru solluvaarka'l en'raar.
saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayamum raaja aramanaiyumaakiya ira'ndu maa'likaika'laiyum katti ni'raiveat'ruki'ra irupathaam varusham mudivilea,

thannudaiya viruppaththinpadiyellaam thanakkuk keathurumarangka'laiyum, theavathaari virudchangka'laiyum, ponnaiyum koduththuvantha theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraamukku, raajaavaakiya saalomoan kalileayaa naattilu'l'la irupathu patta'nangka'laik koduththaan.
eeraam thanakkuch saalomoan koduththa patta'nangka'laip paarkki'ratha'rkuth theeruvilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthaan; avaika'lil avan piriyappadavillai.
athanaalea avan: en sakoatharanea, neer enakkuk koduththa inthap patta'nangka'l enna patta'nangka'l? en'raan. avaika'lukku innaa'lmattum vazhangki varuki'rapadi kaapool naadu en'ru pearittaan.
eeraam raajaavukku noot'rirupathu thaalanthu pon anuppiyirunthaan.

pidiththa amagnchi aadka'laikko'ndu saalomoan raajaa thaan karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum, than aramanaiyaiyum, milloavaiyum, erusaleamin mathilaiyum, aathsoaraiyum, mekithoavaiyum, keasearaiyum kattinaan.

keasearai ean kattinaan en'raal, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoan pu'rappattuvanthu, anthak keasearpatta'naththaip pidiththu, athai akkiniyaal sutteriththu, athilea kudiyiruntha kaanaaniyaraik kon'rupoattu, athaich saalomoanin manaiviyaakiya than kumaaraththikkuch seethanamaakak koduththirunthaan.
saalomoan anthak keasearpatta'naththaiyum, keezhppeththoroanaiyum,
paalaaththaiyum, vanaantharave'liyilu'l'la thathmoaraiyum,

thanakku irukki'ra rasthukka'lai vaikkum sakala patta'nangka'laiyum, irathangka'l irukkum patta'nangka'laiyum, kuthirai veerar irukkum patta'nangka'laiyum, erusaleamilum leepanoanilum, thaan arasaa'nda theasamengkum thanakku ishdamaanathaiyellaam kattinaan.
israveal puththirar sangkaaram pa'n'nakkoodaamal meenthiruntha israveal puththirarin jaathiyallaatha emoariyar, eaththiyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyarumaana sakala janaththilum,
avarka'lukkup pi'raku theasaththil meenthiruntha sakala janangka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laiyum, saalomoan innaa'lvaraikkum nadakki'rathupoala, amagnchivealai seyya adimaippaduththikko'ndaan.

israveal puththiraril oruvaraiyum saalomoan adimaippaduththavillai; avarka'l yuththamanusharum, avanukkup pa'nividaikkaararum, pirapukka'lum, searvaikkaararum, irathaveerarum, kuthiraiveerarumaayirunthaarka'l.
ainnoot'raimpathupear saalomoanin vealaiyai visaariththu, vealaiyaadka'laik ka'nkaa'nikki'ratha'rkuth thalaimaiyaana visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l.
paarvoanin kumaaraththi, thaaveethin nakaraththilirunthu saalomoan thanakkuk kattina than maa'likaiyilea kudivanthaa'l; appozhuthu milloavaik kattinaan.

saalomoan karththarin aalayaththai mudiththapinpu, avarukkuk kattina palipeedaththinmeal varushaththil moon'rumu'rai sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaana palika'laiyum ittu, karththarin sannithiyil irukki'ra palipeedaththinmeal thoopangkaattivanthaan.
raajaavaakiya saalomoan eathoam theasaththil sivantha samuththirakkaraiyilea ealoaththukkuch sameepaththilu'l'la esiyoankeapearilea kappalka'laich seyviththaan.
anthak kappalka'lil eeraam samuththira yaaththiraiyil pazhakina kappalaadka'laakiya than vealaikkaararaich saalomoanudaiya vealaikkaararoadeakooda anuppinaan.
avarka'l oappeerukkuppoay, avvidaththilirunthu naanoot'ru irupathu thaalanthu ponnai raajaavaakiya saalomoanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
karththarudaiya naamaththaikku'riththuch saalomoanukku u'ndaayiruntha keerththi seapaavin raajasthireekkuk kea'lviyaanapoathu, ava'l vidukathaika'linaal avanaich soathikki'ratha'rkaaka,

mikuntha parivaaraththoadum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, mikuthiyaana ponnaiyum iraththinangka'laiyum sumakki'ra ottakangka'loadum, erusaleamukku vanthaa'l; ava'l saalomoanidaththil vanthapoathu, than manathil iruntha ellaavat'raiyungku'riththu avanidaththil sampaashiththaa'l.
appozhuthu saalomoan ava'l keattavaika'laiyellaam viduviththaan, ava'lukku viduvikkakkoodaathapadikku, on'raakilum raajaavukku ma'raiporu'laayirukkavillai.
seapaavin raajasthiree saalomoanudaiya sakala gnaanaththaiyum, avan kattina aramanaiyaiyum,

avan panthiyin poajanapathaarththangka'laiyum, avan oozhiyakkaararin veeduka'laiyum, avan uththiyoakastharin varisaiyaiyum, avarka'l vasthirangka'laiyum, avanudaiya paanapaaththirakkaararaiyum, avan karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkum nadaima'ndapaththaiyum ka'ndapoathu ava'l aachchariyaththaal piramaiko'ndu,
raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya varththamaanangka'laiyum ummudaiya gnaanaththaiyum ku'riththu naan en theasaththil keatta seythi meyyaayit'ru.

naan vanthu athai en ka'nka'laal kaa'numattum antha vaarththaika'lai naan nampavillai; ivaika'lil paathiyaakilum enakku a'rivikkappadavillai en'ru kaa'nki'rean; naan kea'lvippatta pirasthaapaththaippaarkkilum, ummudaiya gnaanamum selvamum athikamaayirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya janangka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; eppoathum umakku munpaaka nin'ru, ummudaiya gnaanaththaik keadki'ra ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararum paakkiyavaanka'l.

ummai isravealin singkaasanaththinmeal vaikka, ummeal piriyangko'nda ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar sthoaththirikkappaduvaaraaka: karththar isravealai en'raikkum sineakikki'rapadiyinaal, niyaayamum neethiyum seyki'ratha'rku ummai raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththinaar en'raa'l.

ava'l raajaavukku noot'rirupathu thaalanthu ponnaiyum, mikuthiyaana kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, iraththinangka'laiyum koduththaa'l; seapaavin raajasthiree raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkuk koduththa avva'lavu kanthavarkkangka'l pi'rpaadu orukkaalum varavillai.
oappeerilirunthu ponnaik ko'nduvaruki'ra eeraamin kappalka'lum, oappeerilirunthu mikuntha vaasanaimarangka'laiyum iraththinangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthathu.

antha vaasanaimarangka'laal raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkum raaja aramanaikkum oon'rukaalka'laiyum, sangkeethakkaararukkuch surama'ndalangka'laiyum thampuruka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan; appadippatta vaasanaimarangka'l pi'rpaadu vanthathumillai, innaa'lvaraikkum kaa'nappadavumillai.

raajaavaakiya saalomoanthaanea santhoashamaaych seapaavin raajasthireekku vekumathika'l koduththathum allaamal, ava'l viruppappattuk keattathu ellaavat'raiyum ava'lukkuk koduththaan; pinpu ava'l than parivaaraththoadea than theasaththi'rkuth thirumpip poanaa'l.
saalomoanukku viyaapaarika'laalum, sukantha thiraviya varththakaraalum, arapitheasaththu sakala raajaakka'laalum, maakaa'nangka'lin athipathika'laalum vantha ponnaiyallaamal,
ovvoru varushaththil avanukku vantha pon a'runoot'ru a'rupaththaa'ru thaalanthu ni'raiyaayirunthathu.
saalomoan raajaa, adiththa ponthakattaal irunoo'ru parisaika'laich seyviththaan; ovvoru parisaikku a'runoo'ru seakkal ni'raipon sen'rathu.
adiththa ponthakattaal munnoo'ru keadakangka'laiyum seyviththaan; ovvoru keadakaththi'rkum moon'ru iraaththal pon sen'rathu; avaika'lai raajaa leepanoan vanam ennum maa'likaiyilea vaiththaan.
raajaa thanthaththinaal periya oru singkaasanaththaiyum seyviththu, athaip pasumponthakattaal moodinaan.

anthach singkaasanaththi'rku aa'ru padika'l irunthathu; singkaasanaththin thalaippu pinnaaka va'laivaayirunthathu; udkaarum idaththi'rku irupu'ramum kaich saaymaanangka'l irunthathu; ira'ndu singkangka'l kaichsaaymaanangka'l arukea nin'rathu.
aa'ru padika'linmealum, ira'ndu pakkaththilum, pannira'ndu singkangka'l nin'rathu; entha raajyaththilum ippadip pa'n'nappadavillai.

raajaavaakiya saalomoanukku iruntha paanapaaththirangka'lellaam ponnum, leepanoan vanam enki'ra maa'likaiyin pa'nimuttuka'lellaam pasumponnumaayirunthathu; on'rum ve'l'liyinaal seyyappadavillai; saalomoanin naadka'lil ve'l'li oru poru'laay e'n'nappadavillai.

raajaavukkuch samuththiraththilea eeraamin kappalka'loadeakoodath tharsheesin kappalka'lum irunthathu; tharsheesin kappalka'l moon'ru varushaththukku orutharam ponnaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, yaanaith thanthangka'laiyum, kurangkuka'laiyum, mayilka'laiyum ko'nduvarum.
poomiyin sakala raajaakka'laippaarkkilum, raajaavaakiya saalomoan aisuvariyaththilum gnaanaththilum si'ranthavanaayirunthaan.
saalomoanin iruthayaththilea theavan aru'liya gnaanaththaik keadki'ratha'rkaaka, sakala theasaththaarum avan mukatharisanaththaith theadinaarka'l.

varushaavarusham avaravar thangka'l kaa'nikkaiyaakiya ve'l'lippaaththirangka'laiyum, po'rpaaththirangka'laiyum, vasthirangka'laiyum, aayuthangka'laiyum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, kuthiraika'laiyum, koavea'ru kazhuthaika'laiyum ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

saalomoan irathangka'laiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum searththaan; avanukku aayiraththu naanoo'ru irathangka'l irunthathu, panneeraayiram kuthiraiveerarum irunthaarka'l; avaika'lai irathangka'l vaikkum patta'nangka'lilum, avarka'lai erusaleamil thannidaththilum vaiththirunthaan.
erusaleamilea raajaa ve'l'liyaik ka'rka'lpoalavum, keathurumarangka'laip pa'l'laththaakkuka'lil irukkum kaattaththi marangka'lpoalavum athikamaakkinaan.
saalomoan thanakkuk kuthiraika'laiyum pudavaika'laiyum ekipthilirunthu azhaippiththaan; raajaavin varththakar pudavaika'lai oppantha vilaikkirayaththi'rku vaangkinaarka'l.

ekipthilirunthu vantha ovvoru irathaththin vilai a'runoo'ru ve'l'likkaasum, ovvoru kuthiraiyin vilai noot'raimpathu ve'l'likkaasumaayirunthathu; inthappirakaaram eaththiyarin raajaakka'lellaarukkum, seeriyaavin raajaakka'lukkum, avarka'l moolamaayk ko'nduvarappattathu.

raajaavaakiya saalomoan, paarvoanin kumaaraththiyai neasiththathumallaamal, moavaapiyarum, ammoaniyarum, eathoamiyarum, seethoaniyarum, eaththiyarumaakiya anniya jaathiyaaraana aneakam sthireeka'lmealum aasaivaiththaan.

karththar israveal puththirarai noakki: neengka'l avarka'la'ndaikkum avarka'l ungka'la'ndaikkum piraveasikkalaakaathu; avarka'l nichchayamaayth thangka'l theavarka'laip pinpat'rumpadi ungka'l iruthayaththaich saayappa'n'nuvaarka'l en'ru solliyirunthaar; saalomoan avarka'lmeal aasaivaiththu, avarka'loadu aikkiyamaayirunthaan.
avanukkup pirapukka'l kulamaana ezhunoo'ru manaiyaattika'lum, munnoo'ru ma'rumanaiyaattika'lum irunthaarka'l; avanudaiya sthireeka'l avan iruthayaththai vazhuvippoakap pa'n'ninaarka'l.

saalomoan vayathusen'rapoathu, avanudaiya manaivika'l avan iruthayaththai anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'rumpadi saayappa'n'ninaarka'l; athinaal avanudaiya iruthayam avan thakappanaakiya thaaveethin iruthayaththaippoala, than theavanaakiya karththaroadea uththamamaayirukkavillai.
saalomoan seethoaniyarin theaviyaakiya astharoaththaiyum, ammoaniyarin aruvaruppaakiya milkoamaiyum pinpat'rinaan.
saalomoan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoala karththaraip poora'namaayp pinpat'raamal, karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
appozhuthu saalomoan erusaleamukku ethiraana malaiyilea moavaapiyarin aruvaruppaakiya kaamoasukkum, ammoan puththirarin aruvaruppaakiya moa'loakukkum meadaiyaik kattinaan.
ippadiyea thangka'l theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattip paliyiduki'ra anniyajaathiyaaraana than sthireeka'l ellaarukkaakavum seythaan.

aakaiyaal isravealin theavanaakiya karththar saalomoanukku ira'nduvisai tharisanamaaki, anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'ravea'ndaam en'ru katta'laiyittirunthum, avan karththarai vittuth than iruthayaththaith thiruppi,
avar ka'rpiththathaik kaikko'l'laama'rpoanathinaal karththar avanmeal koapamaanaar.

aakaiyaal karththar saalomoanai noakki: naan unakkuk katta'laiyitta en udanpadikkaiyaiyum en katta'laika'laiyum nee kaikko'l'laama'rpoay inthak kaariyaththaich seythapadiyinaal, raajyapaaraththai unnidaththilirunthu pidungki, athai un oozhiyakkaaranukkuk koduppean.
aakilum un thakappanaakiya thaaveethinimiththam, naan athai un naadka'lilea seyvathillai; un kumaaranudaiya kaiyinin'ru athaip pidungkuvean.
aanaalum raajyam muzhuvathaiyum naan pidungkaamal, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethinimiththamum, naan therinthuko'nda erusaleaminimiththamum, oru koaththiraththai naan un kumaaranukkuk koduppean en'raar.
karththar eathoamiyanaakiya aathaath ennum oru viroathiyaich saalomoanukku ezhuppinaar; ivan eathoamiliruntha raajakulamaanavan.
thaaveethu eathoamil irukkumpoathu padaiththalaivanaakiya yoavaap eathoamilu'l'la aa'nmakka'laiyellaam sangkariththu, vettu'ndavarka'lai adakkampa'n'nappoanaan.
avarka'laiyellaam sangkarikkuma'lavum, thaanum israveal anaiththum angkea aa'rumaatham irukkumpoathu,
aathaathum avanoadeakooda avan thakappanudaiya oozhiyakkaararil sila eathoamiyarum ekipthi'rkuppoaka oadippoanaarka'l; aathaath appozhuthu oru si'rupi'l'laiyaayirunthaan.

avarka'l meethiyaanilirunthu ezhunthu, paaraanukkuch sen'ru, paaraanilea sila manusharaik koottikko'ndu, ekipthi'rkup paarvoan ennum ekipthin raajaavinidaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; avan ivanukku oru veedukoduththu, ivanukku aakaaraththaith thittampa'n'ni, nilaththaiyum koduththaan.
aathaathukkup paarvoanin ka'nka'lil mikuntha thayaikidaiththapadiyinaal, avan raajasthireeyaakiya thaappeneas ennum than manaiviyin sakoathariyai avanukku vivaakagnseythukoduththaan.

thaappeneasin sakoathariyaakiya iva'l avanukkuk keanupaath ennum oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avanaith thaappeneas paarvoanin veettilea va'larththaa'l; appadiyea keanupaath paarvoanin veettil avanudaiya kumaararudan irunthaan.

thaaveethu than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthaan en'rum, padaiththalaivanaakiya yoavaap i'ranthupoanaan en'rum, ekipthilea aathaath kea'lvippattapoathu, aathaath paarvoanai noakki: naan en suyatheasaththukkup poaka ennai anuppavea'ndum en'raan.

atha'rkup paarvoan: ithoa, nee un suyatheasaththukkuppoaka virumpuki'ratha'rku, ennidaththil unakku enna ku'raivu irukki'rathu en'raan; atha'rku avan: oru ku'raivum illai; aakilum ennai anuppividavea'ndum en'raan.
eliyaathaavin kumaaranaakiya reasoan ennum vea'roru viroathiyai theavan ezhuppinaar; ivan than aa'ndavanaakiya aathaatheasar ennum soapaavin raajaavai vittu oadippoay,

thaaveethu soapaavil u'l'lavarka'laik kon'rupoadukaiyil, avan thannoadea sila manusharaich searththukko'ndu, anthak koottaththi'rkuth thalaivanaanaan; ivarka'l thamaskuvukkup poay, angkea kudiyirunthu, thamaskuvil aa'ndaarka'l.
aathaath pollaappuch seythathumallaamal, reasoan saalomoanudaiya naa'lellaam isravealukku viroathiyaaki, seeriyaavinmeal raajaavaayirunthu, isravealaip pakaiththaan.

seareathaa oorilu'l'la eppiraayeem manushanaakiya neapaaththin kumaaran yeropeyaam ennum saalomoanin oozhiyakkaaranum raajaavukku viroathamaayk kaiyeduththaan; avanudaiya thaay serookaa'l ennum pearu'l'la oru vithavai.
avan raajaavukku viroathamaayk kaiyeduththa mukaantharam ennaven'raal, saalomoan milloavaikkatti, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethudaiya nakaraththin idinthupoana idangka'laip pazhuthupaarththapoathu,
yeropeyaam enpavan paraakkiramasaaliyaayirunthaan; avan kaariya samarththanaana vaalipan en'ru saalomoan ka'ndu, yoaseappu vamsaththaarin kaariyaththaiyellaam avan visaarippukku oppuviththaan.

akkaalaththilea yeropeyaam erusaleamilirunthu ve'liyea poaki'rapoathu, seeloaniyanaana akiyaa ennum theerkkatharisi puthuchsaalvaiyaip poarththukko'ndirunthu, vazhiyilea avanaik ka'ndaan; iruvarum vayalve'liyilea thaniththirukkaiyil,
akiyaa thaan poarththukko'ndiruntha puthuchsaalvaiyaip pidiththu, athaip pannira'ndu thu'ndaakak kizhiththuppoattu,

yeropeyaamai noakki: paththuth thu'nduka'lai eduththukko'l; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan raajyapaaraththaich saalomoanudaiya kaiyilirunthu eduththuk kizhiththu, unakkup paththuk koaththirangka'laik koduppean.
aanaalum en thaasanaakiya thaaveethukkaakavum, naan israveal koaththirangka'lil ellaam therinthuko'nda erusaleam nakaraththukkaakavum, oru koaththiram avanukku irukkum.

avarka'l ennaivittu, seethoaniyarin theaviyaakiya astharoaththaiyum, moavaapiyarin theavanaakiya kaamoasaiyum, ammoan puththirarin theavanaakiya milkoamaiyum pa'ninthuko'ndu, avan thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoala en paarvaikkuch semmaiyaay irukki'rathaich seyyavum, en katta'laika'laiyum en niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'lavum, avarka'l en vazhika'lil nadavaama'rpoanapadiyinaal appadich seyvean.

aanaalum raajyapaara muzhuvathaiyum naan avan kaiyilirunthu eduththup poaduvathillai; naan therinthuko'ndavanum, en ka'rpanaika'laiyum en katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'ndavanumaana en thaasanaakiya thaaveethinimiththam, avan uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam avanai athipathiyaaka vaippean.
aanaalum raajyapaaraththai avan kumaaran kaiyilirunthu eduththu, athilea paththuk koaththirangka'lai unakkuth tharuvean.

en naamam vi'langkumpadikku, naan therinthuko'nda nakaramaakiya erusaleamilea en samukaththil en thaasanaakiya thaaveethukku ennaa'lum oru vi'lakku irukkaththakkathaaka, avan kumaaranukku oru koaththiraththaik koduppean.
nee un manaviruppaththinpadi aa'nduko'ndu, isravealinmeal raajaavaay iruppatha'rkaaka naan unnaith therinthuko'ndean.

naan unakkuk katta'laiyittathaiyellaam nee keattuk kaikko'ndu, nee en vazhika'lil nadanthu, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethu seythathupoala, en katta'laika'laiyum en ka'rpanaika'laiyum kaikko'l'lumpadikku en paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seyki'rathu'ndaanaal, naan unnoadirunthu, naan thaaveethukkuk kattinathupoala unakkum nilaiyaana veettaik katti isravealai unakkuth tharuvean.
ippadi naan inthak kaariyaththinimiththam thaaveethin santhathiyaich si'rumaippaduththuvean; aakilum ennaa'lum appadiyiraathu en'ru sonnaan.

athinimiththam saalomoan yeropeyaamaik kolla vakaitheadinaan; yeropeyaam ezhunthu, ekipthi'rkuch seeshaak ennum ekipthin raajaavinidaththil oadippoay, saalomoan mara'namadaiyumattum ekipthil irunthaan.
saalomoanin mat'ra nadapadika'lum, avan seythavai anaiththum, avanudaiya gnaanamum, saalomoanudaiya nadapadip pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
saalomoan erusaleamilea isravealaiyellaam arasaa'nda naadka'l naa'rpathu varusham.
saalomoan than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya rekopeyaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
rekopeyaamai raajaavaakkumpadi, isravealar ellaarum seekeamukku vanthirunthapadiyaal, avanum seekeamukkup poanaan.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanai vittu oadippoay, ekipthilea kudiyiruntha neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamoa, ekipthil irukkaiyil ithaik kea'lvippattaan.
avarka'l yeropeyaamukku aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippiththaarka'l; avanum israveal sapai anaiththum vanthu, rekopeyaamai noakki:

ummudaiya thakappan paaramaana nukaththai engka'lmeal vaiththaar; ippoathum neer ummudaiya thakappan sumaththina kadinamaana vealaiyaiyum, avar engka'lmeal vaiththa paaramaana nukaththaiyum lakuvaakkum; appozhuthu ummaich seavippoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l poay, moon'runaa'l po'ruththu ennidaththil thirumpivaarungka'l en'raan; appadiyea janangka'l poayirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam than thakappanaakiya saalomoan uyiroadirukkaiyil avan samukaththil nin'ra muthiyoaroadea aaloasanaipa'n'ni, intha janangka'lukku ma'ruuththaravu kodukka, neengka'l enna yoasanai solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: neer in'ru intha janangka'lukku seavakanaaki, avarka'lukku i'nangki, avarka'l so'rpadi seythu, ma'rumozhiyaaka nalvaarththaika'laich solveeraanaal, ennaa'lum avarka'l umakku oozhiyakkaararaayiruppaarka'l en'raarka'l.
muthiyoar thanakkuch sonna aaloasanaiyai avan tha'l'livittu, thannoadea va'larnthu than samukaththil ni'rki'ra vaaliparoadea aaloasanaipa'n'ni,

avarka'lai noakki: ummudaiya thakappan engka'lmeal vaiththa nukaththai lakuvaakkum en'ru ennidaththil sonna intha janangka'lukku ma'rumozhi kodukka, neengka'l enna yoasanai solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu avanoadea va'larntha vaalipar avanai noakki: ummudaiya thakappan engka'l nukaththaip paaramaakkinaar, neer athai engka'lukku lakuvaakkum en'ru ummidaththil sonna intha janaththi'rku neer sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: en su'nduviral en thakappanaarudaiya iduppaippaarkkilum parumanaayirukkum.

ippoathum en thakappan paaramaana nukaththai ungka'lmeal vaiththaar, naan ungka'l nukaththai athika paaramaakkuvean; en thakappan ungka'laich savukkuka'linaalea tha'ndiththaar, naan ungka'laith thea'lka'linaalea tha'ndippean en'ru neer avarka'loadea sollavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
moon'raam naa'l ennidaththil vaarungka'l en'ru raajaa solliyirunthapadiyea, yeropeyaamum sakala janangka'lum moon'raam naa'lilea rekopeyaamidaththil vanthaarka'l.
raajaa muthiyoar thanakkuch sonna aaloasanaiyaith tha'l'livittu, vaaliparudaiya aaloasanaiyinpadiyea avarka'loadea peasi:

en thakappan ungka'l nukaththaip paaramaakkinaar, naan ungka'l nukaththai athika paaramaakkuvean; en thakappan ungka'laich savukkuka'linaalea tha'ndiththaar, naan ungka'laith thea'lka'linaalea tha'ndippean en'ru janangka'lukkuk kadinamaana uththaravu koduththaan.

raajaa janangka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan; karththar seeloaniyanaana akiyaavaikko'ndu neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamukkuch sonna thammudaiya vaarththaiyai u'ruthippaduththumpadi karththaraal ippadi nadanthathu.

raajaa thangka'lukkuch sevikodaathathai isravealar ellaarum ka'ndapoathu, janangka'l raajaavukku ma'ruuththaravaaka: thaaveethoadea engka'lukkup pangkeathu? eesaayin kumaaranidaththil engka'lukkuch suthantharam illai; isravealea, un koodaarangka'lukkup poayvidu; ippoathu thaaveethea, un sontha veettaip paarththukko'l en'ru solli, isravealar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poayvittaarka'l.
aanaalum yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilea kudiyiruntha israveal puththirarmeal rekopeyaam raajaavaayirunthaan.

pinpu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam pakuthivisaarippukkaaranaakiya athoaraamai anuppinaan; isravealar ellaarum avanaik kalle'rinthu kon'raarka'l; appozhuthu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam theeviramaay irathaththinmeal ea'ri, erusaleamukku oadippoanaan.
appadiyea innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi isravealar thaaveethin vamsaththai vittu kalakampa'n'nip pirinthu poayirukki'raarka'l.

yeropeyaam thirumpivanthaan en'ru isravealarukkellaam kea'lviyaanapoathu, avanaich sapaiyinidaththil azhaiththanuppi, avanaich samastha isravealinmealum raajaavaakkinaarka'l; yoothaakoaththirammaaththirameayan'ri vea'roruvarum thaaveethin vamsaththaip pinpat'ravillai.

rekopeyaam erusaleamukku vanthapoathu, israveal vamsaththaaroadea yuththampa'n'navum, raajyaththaich saalomoanin kumaaranaakiya thannidamaakath thiruppikko'l'lavum, yoothaa vamsaththaar penyameen koaththiraththaar anaivarumaakiya therinthuko'l'lappatta yuththaveerar ladchaththu e'npathinaayirampearaik koottinaan.
theavanudaiya manushanaakiya seamaayaavukku theavanudaiya vaarththaiyu'ndaaki, avar sonnathu:
nee yoothaavin raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam ennum saalomoanin kumaaranaiyum yoothaa vamsaththaar anaivaraiyum, penyameenaraiyum, mat'ra janangka'laiyum noakki:

neengka'l poakaamalum, israveal puththiraraana ungka'l sakoathararoadu yuththampa'n'naamalum, avaravar thamtham veetti'rkuth thirumpungka'l; ennaalea inthak kaariyam nadanthathu en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar; appozhuthu avarka'l: karththarudaiya sollaik keattu, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea thirumpip poayvittaarka'l.
yeropeyaam eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththil seekeamaik katti, athilea vaasampa'n'ni, angkirunthu poayp penoovealaik kattinaan.
yeropeyaam: ippoathu raajyapaaram thaaveethu vamsavasamaayth thirumpuki'rathaayirukkum.

intha janangka'l erusaleamilu'l'la karththarudaiya aalayaththilea palika'laich seluththappoanaal, intha janangka'lin iruthayam yoothaavin raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam ennum thangka'l aa'ndavan vasamaayth thirumpi, avarka'l ennaik kon'rupoattu, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya rekopeyaamin paarisamaayp poayviduvaarka'l en'ru than manathilea sinthiththukko'ndirunthaan.

aakaiyaal raajaavaanavan yoasanaipa'n'ni, ponninaal ira'ndu kan'rukkuttika'lai u'ndaakki, janangka'laip paarththu: neengka'l erusaleamukkup poaki'rathu ungka'lukku varuththam; isravealarea, ithoa, ivaika'l ungka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina ungka'l theavarka'l en'ru solli,
on'raip peththealilum, on'raith thaa'nilum sthaapiththaan.
inthak kaariyam paavamaayit'ru; janangka'l intha oru kan'rukkuttikkaakath thaa'nmattum poavaarka'l.
avan meadaiyaakiya oru koavilaiyum katti, leaviyin puththiraraayiraatha janaththil eenamaanavarka'lai aasaariyaraakkinaan.

yoothaavil aasarikkappadum pa'ndikaikkoppaaka ettaam maatham pathinainthaam theathiyilea yeropeyaam oru pa'ndikaiyaiyum ko'ndaadi, palipeedaththinmeal paliyittaan; appadiyea peththealilea thaan u'ndaakkina kan'rukkuttika'lukkup paliyittu, thaan u'ndupa'n'nina meadaika'lin aasaariyarka'laip peththealilea sthaapiththu,

than manathilea thaanea niyamiththukko'nda ettaam maatham pathinainthaam theathiyilea peththealil thaan u'ndaakkina palipeedaththinmeal paliyittu, israveal puththirarukkup pa'ndikaiyai ea'rpaduththi, palipeedaththinmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattinaan.
yeropeyaam thoopangkaatta palipeedaththa'ndaiyilea ni'rkaiyil, ithoa, theavanudaiya manushan oruvan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, yoothaavilirunthu peththealukku vanthu,

anthap palipeedaththai noakki: palipeedamea palipeedamea, ithoa, thaaveethin vamsaththil yoasiyaa ennum pearu'l'la oru kumaaran pi'rappaan; avan unmeal thoopangkaattuki'ra meadaika'lin aasaariyarka'lai unmeal paliyiduvaan; manusharin elumpuka'lum unmeal sutterikkappadum enpathaik karththar uraikki'raar en'ru karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik koo'ri;
an'raiyathinam avan oru adaiyaa'laththaiyum solli, ithoa, inthap palipeedam vediththu, athinmealu'l'la saampal kottu'ndupoam; karththar uraiththatha'rku ithuvea adaiyaa'lam en'raan.

peththealil irukki'ra anthap palipeedaththi'rku ethiraaka theavanudaiya manushan koo'rina vaarththaiyai raajaavaakiya yeropeyaam keattapoathu, avanaip pidiyungka'l en'ru than kaiyaip palipeedaththilirunthu neettinaan; avanukku viroathamaay neettina kai thannidamaaka mudakkakkoodaathapadikku maraththuppoayit'ru.
theavanudaiya manushan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaal ku'riththiruntha adaiyaa'laththinpadiyea palipeedam vediththu, saampal palipeedaththilirunthu kottu'ndupoayit'ru.

appozhuthu raajaa, theavanudaiya manushanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: nee un theavanaakiya karththarudaiya samukaththai noakki vea'ndikko'ndu, en kai munpoalirukkumpadikku enakkaaka vi'n'nappam pa'n'navea'ndum en'raan; appozhuthu theavanudaiya manushan karththarudaiya samukaththai noakki varunthi vi'n'nappam seythaan, raajaavin kai munnirunthapadi seerppattathu.
appozhuthu raajaa theavanudaiya manushanai noakki: nee ennoadeakooda veettukku vanthu i'laippaa'ru; unakku vekumaanam tharuvean en'raan.
theavanudaiya manushan raajaavai noakki: neer enakku ummudaiya veettil paathi koduththaalum, naan ummoadea varuvathumillai, intha sthalaththil appam pusippathumillai, tha'n'neer kudippathumillai.
eanen'raal nee appam pusiyaamalum, tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum, poanavazhiyaayth thirumpaamalum iruven'ru karththar thammudaiya vaarththaiyaal enakkuk katta'laiyittirukki'raar en'ru solli,
avan peththealukku vanthavazhiyaayth thirumpaamal, vea'ruvazhiyaayp poayvittaan.

kizhavanaana oru theerkkatharisi peththealilea kudiyirunthaan; avan kumaarar vanthu theavanudaiya manushan an'raiyathinam peththealilea seytha ellaach seykaika'laiyum, avan raajaavoadea sonna vaarththaika'laiyum thangka'l thakappanukku a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l thakappan: avan entha vazhi poanaan en'ru avarka'laik keattaan. yoothaavilirunthu vantha theavanudaiya manushan poanavazhi innathen'ru avan kumaarar paarththirunthapadiyaal,
avan than kumaararudanea: kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththuk kodungka'l en'raan; avarka'l kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththuk koduththapin, avan athinmeal ea'ri,

theavanudaiya manushanaith thodarnthupoay, oru karvaali maraththinkeezh udkaarnthirukki'ra avanaik ka'ndu: yoothaavilirunthuvantha theavanudaiya manushan neerthaanaa en'ru avanaik keattatha'rku; avan, naanthaan en'raan.
appozhuthu avanai noakki: ennoadea veettukku vanthu appam pusiyum en'raan.
atha'rku avan: naan ummoadea thirumpavum ummoadea u'l'lea poakavumaattean; intha sthalaththilea ummoadea naan appam pusikkavum tha'n'neer kudikkavumaattean.
eanen'raal nee appam pusiyaamalum, angkea tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum, nee poanavazhiyaayth thirumpivaraamalum iru en'ru karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'raan.

atha'rku avan: ummaippoala naanum theerkkatharisithaan; avan appam pusiththuth tha'n'neer kudikka, nee avanaith thiruppi, un veettukku azhaiththukko'nduvaa en'ru oru thoothan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaaka ennoadea sonnaan en'ru avanidaththil poysonnaan.
appozhuthu avan ivanoadea thirumpip poay, ivan veettilea appam pusiththuth tha'n'neer kudiththaan.
avarka'l panthiyil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathu, avanaith thiruppikko'ndu vantha theerkkatharisikkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaanathinaal,
avan yoothaavilirunthu vantha theavanudaiya manushanaip paarththuch saththamittu, un theavanaakiya karththar unakkuk ka'rpiththa katta'laiyai nee kaikko'l'laamal karththarudaiya vaakkai mee'ri,

appam pusikkavum tha'n'neer kudikkavum vea'ndaam en'ru avar vilakkina sthalaththi'rku nee thirumpi, appam pusiththuth tha'n'neer kudiththapadiyinaal, unnudaiya pireatham un pithaakka'lin kalla'raiyilea searuvathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
avan poajanapaanampa'n'ni mudinthapinpu, anthath theerkkatharisiyaith thiruppikko'nduvanthavan avanukkuk kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththuk koduththaan.

avan poanapi'rpaadu vazhiyilea oru singkam avanukku ethirppattu avanaik kon'rupoattathu; avan pireatham vazhiyilea kidanthathu; kazhuthai athina'ndaiyilea nin'rathu; singkamum pireathaththa'ndaiyilea nin'rathu.

antha vazhiyea kadanthuvaruki'ra manushar, vazhiyilea kidakki'ra pireathaththaiyum, pireathaththa'ndaiyilea ni'rki'ra singkaththaiyum ka'ndu, kizhavanaana theerkkatharisi kudiyiruntha patta'naththilea vanthu sonnaarka'l.

avanai vazhiyilirunthu thirumpappa'n'nina theerkkatharisi athaik keattapoathu, avan karththarudaiya vaakkai mee'rina theavanudaiya manushanthaan, karththar avanukkuch sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, karththar avanai oru singkaththi'rku oppukkoduththaar; athu avanai mu'riththuk kon'rupoattathu en'ru solli,
than kumaararai noakki: enakkuk kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'nam vaiththuk kodungka'l en'raan; avarka'l sea'nam vaiththuk koduththaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan poay, vazhiyilea kidakki'ra avan pireathaththaiyum, pireathaththa'ndaiyilea kazhuthaiyum singkamum ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndaan; anthach singkam pireathaththaith thinnavumillai, kazhuthaiyai mu'riththuppoadavumillai.

appozhuthu kizhavanaana anthath theerkkatharisi theavanudaiya manushanin pireathaththai eduththu, athaik kazhuthaiyinmeal vaiththu, atha'rkaakath thukkangko'ndaadavum athai adakkampa'n'navum, athaith than patta'naththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthu,
avan pireathaththaith thannudaiya kalla'raiyilea vaiththaan. avanukkaaka: aiyoa, en sakoatharanea en'ru pulampi, thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.

avanai adakkampa'n'ninapinpu, avan than kumaararai noakki: naan marikkumpoathu, theavanudaiya manushan adakkampa'n'nappatta kalla'raiyilea ennaiyum neengka'l adakkampa'n'ni, avan elumpuka'la'ndaiyilea en elumpuka'laiyum vaiyungka'l.

avan peththealil irukki'ra palipeedaththi'rkum, samaariyaavin patta'nangka'lil irukki'ra meadaika'laakiya sakala koavilka'lukkum viroathamaakak koo'rina karththarudaiya vaarththai nichchayamaay ni'raivea'rum en'raan.

intha nadapadikkuppinpu, yeropeyaam than pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpaamal, ma'rupadiyum janaththil eenamaanavarka'lai meadaika'lin aasaariyaraakkinaan; evanmeal avanukku manathirunthathoa avanaip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaan; appadippattavarka'l meadaika'lin aasaariyaraanaarka'l.
yeropeyaamin veettaarai poomiyinmeal vaikkaamal athampa'n'ni azhikkumpadiyaaka inthak kaariyam avarka'lukkup paavamaayit'ru.
akkaalaththilea yeropeyaamin kumaaranaakiya apiyaa viyaathiyil vizhunthaan.

appozhuthu yeropeyaam than manaiviyaip paarththu: nee ezhunthu, nee yeropeyaamin manaiviyen'ru oruvarum a'riyaathapadikku veashammaa'ri seeloavukkup poa; intha janaththinmeal naan raajaavaavean en'ru ennoadea sonna theerkkatharisiyaakiya akiyaa angkea irukki'raan.

nee un kaiyilea paththu appangka'laiyum, pa'niyaarangka'laiyum, oru kalasam theanaiyum eduththukko'ndu avanidaththukkup poa; pi'l'laikkuch sampavikkappoaki'rathu innathen'ru avan unakku a'rivippaan en'raan.

appadiyea yeropeyaamin manaivi seythaa'l; ava'l ezhunthu seeloavukkup poay, akiyaavin veetti'rku'l piraveasiththaa'l; akiyaavoa muthir vayathaanathinaal avan ka'nka'l mangkaladainthu paarkkakkoodaathirunthaan.

karththar akiyaavinidaththil: ithoa, yeropeyaamin manaivi viyaathiyaayirukki'ra than kumaaranukkaaka unnai oru viseashamkeadka varuki'raa'l; nee ava'lukku inna inna pirakaaramaakach sollavea'ndum; ava'l udpiraveasikki'rapoathu, thannai anniya sthireeyaakak kaa'npippaa'l en'raar.

aakaiyaal vaasa'rpadikku'l piraveasikkum ava'ludaiya nadaiyin saththaththai akiyaa keattavudanea, avan: yeropeyaamin manaiviyea, u'l'lea vaa; unnai anniya sthireeyaakak kaa'npikki'rathenna? thukkaseythiyai unakku a'rivikka naan anuppappattean.
nee poay yeropeyaamai noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: janaththinin'ru unnai naan uyarththi, unnai israveal ennum en janaththinmeal athipathiyaaka vaiththean.

naan raajyapaaraththaith thaaveethu vamsaththaarin kaiyilirunthu pidungki unakkuk koduththean; aanaalum en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu, en paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaiyea seyya, than muzhu iruthayaththoadum ennaip pinpat'rina en thaasanaakiya thaaveethaippoala nee iraamal,

unakku munniruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum pollaappuch seythaay; enakkuk koapam u'ndaakka, nee poay unakku anniya theavarka'laiyum vaarkkappatta vikkirakangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, unakkup pu'rampea ennaith tha'l'livittaay.

aakaiyaal ithoa, naan yeropeyaamudaiya veettinmeal pollaappai varappa'n'ni, yeropeyaamukku, suvarmeal neervidum oru naay muthalaayiraathapadikku, isravealilea adaipattavanaiyum vidupattavanaiyum sangkaarampa'n'ni, kuppai kazhiththuppoadappaduki'rathupoala yeropeyaamin pinnadiyaarai avarka'l kattoadea at'ruppoakumattum kazhiththuppoaduvean en'raar.
yeropeyaamin santhathiyaaril patta'naththilea saaki'ravanai naayka'l thinnum; ve'liyilea saaki'ravanai aakaayaththin pa'ravaika'l thinnum; karththar ithai uraiththaar.
aakaiyaal nee ezhunthu, un veettukkup poa, un kaalka'l patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkaiyil pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan seththuppoavaan.

avanukkaaka isravealarellaarum thukkangko'ndaadi avanai adakkampa'n'nuvaarka'l; yeropeyaamin veettaaril isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka avanidaththilea nalla kaariyam kaa'nappattathinaal, yeropeyaamin santhathiyil avan oruvanea kalla'raikkudpaduvaan.
aanaalum karththar thamakku isravealinmeal oru raajaavai ezhumpappa'n'nuvaar; avan annaa'lilea yeropeyaamin veettaaraich sangkarippaan; ippoathea ithu nadanthea'rum.

tha'n'neerilea naa'nal asaiki'rathupoala, karththar isravealai mu'rinthasaiyappa'n'ni, avarka'l pithaakka'lukkuth thaam koduththa intha nalla theasaththilirunthu isravealai vearoadea pidungki, avarka'l thangka'lukku thoappu vikkirakangka'lai vaiththu, karththarukkuk koapam u'ndaakkinapadiyinaal, avarka'lai nathikkappaalea sitha'radiththu,
yeropeyaam seythathum isravealaich seyyappa'n'ninathumaana paavaththinimiththam isravealai oppukkoduththuviduvaar en'raan.
appozhuthu yeropeyaamin manaivi ezhunthu pu'rappattu thirsaavukku vanthaa'l; ava'l vaasa'rpadiyilea varukaiyil pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan seththuppoanaan.

karththar theerkkatharisiyaakiya akiyaa ennum thamathu oozhiyakkaaranaik ko'ndu sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, avarka'l avanai adakkampa'n'ni, isravealar ellaarum avanukkaakath thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.
yeropeyaam yuththampa'n'ninathum aa'ndathumaana avanudaiya mat'ra varththamaanangka'l israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yeropeyaam raajyapaarampa'n'nina kaalam irupaththira'ndu varusham; avan than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya naathaap avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

saalomoanin kumaaranaakiya rekopeyaam yoothaavilea raajyapaaram pa'n'ninaan; rekopeyaam raajaavaaki'rapoathu naa'rpaththoru vayathaayirunthu, karththar thammudaiya naamam vi'langkumpadi israveal koaththirangka'lilellaam therinthuko'nda nakaramaakiya erusaleamilea pathineazhuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; ammoan jaathiyaana avanudaiya thaayinpear naamaa'l.

yoothaajanangka'l karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, thaangka'l seythuvaruki'ra thangka'ludaiya paavangka'linaal thangka'l pithaakka'l seytha ellaavat'raippaarkkilum avarukku athika erichchalai moottinaarka'l.
avarka'lum uyarntha sakala meattinmealum, pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum, meadaika'laiyum silaika'laiyum thoappu vikkirakangka'laiyum thangka'lukku u'ndaakkinaarka'l.
theasaththilea ilachchaiyaana pu'narchchikkaararum irunthaarka'l; karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththivitta jaathika'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadiyellaam seythaarka'l.
rekopeyaam raajyapaarampa'n'num ainthaam varushaththilea, ekipthin raajaavaakiya seeshaak erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthu,
karththarudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'laiyum, raajaavudaiya aramanaiyin pokkishangka'laiyum, saalomoan seyviththa pon parisaika'l aakiya sakalaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu poayvittaan.
avaika'lukkup pathilaaka raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam ve'nkalap parisaika'laich seyviththu, avaika'lai raajaavin vaasa'rpadiyaik kaakki'ra seavakarudaiya thalaivarin kaiyil oppiththaan.
raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, aramanaich seavakar avaika'laip pidiththukko'ndu poay, thirumpath thangka'l a'raiyilea vaippaarka'l.
rekopeyaamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
rekopeyaamukkum yeropeyaamukkum avarka'l iruntha naadka'lilellaam yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.

rekopeyaam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, thaaveethin nakaraththil than pithaakka'la'ndaiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; ammoan jaathiyaana avan thaaykku naamaa'l en'ru pear; avan kumaaranaakiya apiyaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaam ennum raajaavin pathinettaam varushaththilea apiyaam yoothaavinmeal raajaavaaki,
moon'ru varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; apsaloamin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayin pear maakaa'l.

than thakappan thanakku munseytha ellaap paavangka'lilum avan nadanthaan; avan iruthayam avan thakappanaakiya thaaveethin iruthayaththaippoal, than theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka uththamamaayirukkavillai.

aanaalum thaaveethinimiththam avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththar, avanukkup pi'rpaadu avan kumaaranai ezhumpappa'n'nuki'rathinaalum, erusaleamai nilai ni'ruththuki'rathinaalum, avanukku erusaleamil oru vi'lakkaik katta'laiyittu vanthaar.

thaaveethu eaththiyanaakiya uriyaavin sangkathi on'ruthavira karththar thanakkuk katta'laiyittathilea thaan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam on'raiyum vittu vilakaamal, avar paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythuvanthaan.
rekopeyaamukkum yeropeyaamukkum avarka'l iruntha naadka'lilellaam yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.

apiyaamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; apiyaamukkum yeropeyaamukkum yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.
apiyaam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya aasaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
isravealin raajaavaakiya yeropeyaamin irupathaam varushaththilea aasaa yoothaavinmeal raajaavaaki,
naa'rpaththoru varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; apsaloamin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayin pear maakaa'l.
aasaa than thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoal karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
avan ilachchaiyaana pu'narchchikkaararai theasaththilirunthu akat'ri, than pithaakka'l u'ndupa'n'nina narakalaana vikkirakangka'laiyellaam vilakki,

thoappilea aruvaruppaana vikkirakaththai u'ndupa'n'nina than thaayaakiya maakaa'laiyum raajaaththiyaay iraathapadikku vilakkivittaan; ava'ludaiya vikkirakaththaiyum aasaa nirmoolamaakki, keetharoan aat'ra'ndaiyilea sutteriththuppoattaan.
meadaika'loa thakarkkappadavillai; aanaalum aasaa uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam avan iruthayam karththaroadea uththamamaayirunthathu.
than thakappanum thaanum parisuththappaduththumpadi nearnthuko'nda ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum pa'nimuttuka'laiyum avan karththarudaiya aalayaththilea ko'nduvanthaan.
aasaavukkum isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaavukkum avarka'ludaiya naadka'lilellaam yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.
oruvarum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavinidaththil poakkuvaraththaayiraathapadikku, isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaa yoothaavukku viroathamaaka vanthu raamaavaik kattinaan.

appozhuthu aasaa karththarudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'lil meethiyaana ellaa ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum, raajaavin aramanaiyin pokkishangka'laiyum eduththu, avaika'laith than oozhiyakkaarar kaiyilea thamaskuvil vaasamaayirukki'ra esiyoanin makanaakiya thaprimoanin kumaaran penaathaath ennum seeriyaavin raajaavukkuk koduththanuppi:

enakkum umakkum en thakappanukkum ummudaiya thakappanukkum udanpadikkai u'ndea; ithoa, umakku vekumathiyaay ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum anuppuki'rean; isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaa ennaivittu vilakip poakumpadikku, neer vanthu avanoadu seytha udanpadikkaiyaith tha'l'lippoadum en'ru sollachsonnaan.

penaathaath, raajaavaakiya aasaavukkuch sevikoduththu, thanakku u'ndaana seanaapathika'lai isravealin patta'nangka'lukku viroathamaaka anuppi, eeyoanaiyum, thaa'naiyum pethmaakkaa ennum aapealaiyum kinnaroath anaiththaiyum napthaliyin muzhuththeasaththoadungkooda mu'riya adiththaan.
paashaa athaik keattapoathu, raamaavaik kattuki'rathai vittuth thirsaavilirunthuvittaan.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya aasaa yoothaa engkum oruvarum thappaamal ellaarum poay, paashaa kattina raamaavin ka'rka'laiyum athin marangka'laiyum eduththuvara pa'raimu'rai iduviththu; avaika'linaal penyameen koaththiraththilu'l'la keapaavaiyum mispaavaiyum kattinaan.

aasaavin mat'ra ellaa varththamaanangka'lum, avanudaiya ellaa vallamaiyum, avan seythavai yaavum, avan kattina patta'nangka'lin varalaa'rum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; avan muthirvayathaana kaalaththil avanudaiya kaalka'lil viyaathi ka'ndirunthathu.

aasaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin nakaraththilea than pithaakka'la'ndaiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath avan sthaanaththilea raajaavaanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin ira'ndaam varushaththilea yeropeyaamin kumaaranaakiya naathaap isravealinmeal raajaavaaki, ira'ndu varusham isravealinmeal raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan.
avan karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, than thakappan vazhiyilum, avan isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina avanudaiya paavaththilum nadanthaan.

isakkaar vamsaththaanaakiya akiyaavin kumaaranaana paashaa, avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, naathaapum isravealanaiththum pelistharukku iruntha kipeththoanai mut'rikkaipoattirukkaiyil, paashaa avanaik kipeththoanilea vettippoattaan.
paashaa yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin moon'raam varushaththilea avanaik kon'rupoattapin, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

appozhuthu yeropeyaam seythathum, isravealaich seyyappa'n'ninathumaana paavangka'linimiththamum, avan isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku u'ndaakkina koapaththinimiththamum, karththar seeloaniyanaana akiyaa ennum thamathu oozhiyakkaaranaikko'ndu solliyiruntha vaarththaiyinpadiyea,
avan raajaavaanapin avan yeropeyaamin veettaaraiyellaam vettippoattaan; yeropeyaamukku iruntha suvaasamu'l'lathon'raiyum avan azhikkaamal vidavillai.
naathaapin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum avan seythavai yaavum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aasaavukkum israveal raajaavaakiya paashaavukkum avarka'l naadka'lilellaam yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin moon'raam varushaththilea akiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paashaa, isravealanaiththin mealum thirsaavilea raajaavaaki irupaththu naalu varusham aa'ndu,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, yeropeyaamin vazhiyilum, avan isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina avanudaiya paavaththilum nadanthaan.
paashaavukku viroathamaakak karththarudaiya vaarththai aanaaniyin kumaaranaakiya yekoovukku u'ndaayit'ru, avar:

naan unnaith thoo'lilirunthu uyarththi, unnai en janamaakiya isravealinmeal thalaivanaaka vaiththirukkaiyil, nee yeropeyaamin vazhiyilea nadanthu, en janamaakiya israveal thangka'l paavangka'laal enakkuk koapamu'ndaakkumpadi avarka'laip paavagnseyyappa'n'nuki'rapadiyinaal,
ithoa, naan paashaavin pinnadiyaaraiyum avan veettaarin pinnadiyaaraiyum azhiththuppoattu, un veettai neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin veettaippoala aakkuvean.
paashaavin santhathiyilea patta'naththil saaki'ravanai naayka'l thinnum; ve'liyilea saaki'ravanai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l thinnum en'raar.
paashaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythathum, avanudaiya vallamaiyum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
paashaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu thirsaavil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya ealaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

paashaa than kaika'lin seykaiyaal karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakki, avar paarvaikkuch seytha ellaap pollaappinimiththamum, avan yeropeyaamin veettaarai vettippoattathinimiththamum, ivarka'laippoal aavaan en'ru avanukkum avan veettukkum viroathamaaka aanaaniyin kumaaranaakiya yekoo ennum theerkkatharisiyinaal karththarudaiya vaarththai pinnum u'ndaayit'ru.
yoothaavin raajaavaana aasaavin irupaththaa'raam varushaththilea paashaavin kumaaranaakiya ealaa isravealinmeal thirsaavilea raajaavaaki ira'ndu varusham arasaa'ndaan.

irathangka'lil paathipangkukkuth thalaivanaakiya simri ennum avan oozhiyakkaaran avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, avan thirsaavilea avvidaththu aramanai ukkiraa'nakkaaranaakiya arsaavin veettilea kudiththu ve'ri ko'ndirukkaiyil,
simri u'l'lea pukunthu, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin irupaththeazhaam varushaththil avanai vettik kon'rupoattu, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

avan raajaavaaki, singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthapoathu, avan paashaavin veettaaraiyellaam vettippoattaan; avan inaththaaraiyaakilum, avan sineakitharaiyaakilum, suvaril neervidum oru naayaiyaakilum, avan uyiroadea vaikkavillai.

appadiyea paashaavum, avan kumaaranaakiya ealaavum, thangka'l vee'naana vikkirakangka'linaalea isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakkich seythathum isravealaich seyyappa'n'ninathumaana avarka'ludaiya ellaap paavangka'linimiththamum,
karththar theerkkatharisiyaakiya yekoovinaal paashaavaikku'riththuch solliyiruntha avarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, simri paashaavin veettaaraiyellaam azhiththuppoattaan.
ealaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin irupaththeazhaam varushaththilea simri thirsaavilea eazhunaa'l raajaavaayirunthaan; janangka'l appozhuthu pelistharukku irukki'ra kipeththoanukku ethiraakap paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l.

simri kattuppaadupa'n'ni, raajaavaik kon'rupoattaan enpathai angkea paa'layami'rangkina janangka'l keattapoathu, isravealarellaam annaa'lileathaanea paa'layaththilea padaiththalaivanaakiya umriyai isravealmeal raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu umriyum avanoadeakooda israveal anaiththum kipeththoanilirunthu vanthu, thirsaavai mut'rikkai poattaarka'l.
patta'nam pidipattathaich simri ka'ndapoathu, avan raajaavin veedaakiya aramanaikku'l piraveasiththu, thaan irukki'ra raaja aramanaiyaith theekko'luththi, athilea seththaan.

avan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, yeropeyaamin vazhiyilum avan isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina avan paavaththilum nadanthathinaal, kattikko'nda avanudaiya paavangka'linimiththam appadi nadanthathu.
simriyin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan pa'n'nina avanudaiya kattuppaadum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

appozhuthu israveal janangka'l ira'ndu vakuppaayp pirinthu, paathi janangka'l keenaaththin kumaaranaakiya thipniyai raajaavaakka, avanaip pinpat'rinaarka'l; paathi janangka'l umriyaip pinpat'rinaarka'l.
aanaalum keenaaththin kumaaranaakiya thipniyaip pinpat'rina janangka'laippaarkkilum, umriyaip pinpat'rina janangka'l palaththuppoanaarka'l; thipni seththuppoanaan; umri arasaa'ndaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin muppaththoaraam varushaththil, umri isravealmeal raajaavaaki, pannira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; avan thirsaavilea aa'ruvarusham arasaa'ndu,

pinpu seamearin kaiyilirunthu samaariyaa malaiyai ira'ndu thaalanthu ve'l'likku vaangki, antha malaiyinmeal oru patta'naththaik katti, atha'rku malaiyinudaiya ejamaanaayiruntha seamearudaiya pearinpadiyea samaariyaa ennum pearaith thariththaan.
umri karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, thanakku munniruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum keadaay nadanthu,

neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin sakala vazhiyilum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkuth thangka'l vee'naana vikkirakangka'laalea koapam moottumpadiyaay isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina avanudaiya paavangka'lilum nadanthaan.
umri seytha avanudaiya mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan kaa'npiththa vallamaiyum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
umri than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, samaariyaavilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya aakaap avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin muppaththettaam varushaththil umriyin kumaaranaakiya aakaap isravealinmeal raajaavaaki, samaariyaavil isravealinmeal irupaththira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan.
umriyin kumaaranaakiya aakaap, thanakku munniruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lil nadappathu avanukkuk kognchakkaariyamen'ru ninaiththaa'rpoal avan seethoaniyarin raajaavaakiya eathpaakaalin kumaaraththi yeasapealai vivaakampa'n'ninathumallaamal, avan poay paakaalaiyum seaviththu athaip pa'ninthuko'ndu,
thaan samaariyaavilea kattina paakaalin koavilil paakaalukkup palipeedaththai eduppiththaan.

aakaap oru vikkirakaththoappaiyum vaiththu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkuk koapam u'ndaakkumpadikku thanakku munniruntha isravealin raajaakka'lellaam seythathaippaarkkilum athikamaaych seythuvanthaan.

avan naadka'lilea peththeal ooraanaakiya eeyeal erikoavaik kattinaan; karththar noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavaikko'ndu solliyiruntha vaarththaiyinpadiyea, avan athin asthipaaraththaip poaduki'rapoathu, apiraam ennum than mooththa kumaaranaiyum, athin vaasalka'lai vaikki'rapoathu sekoop ennum than i'laiyakumaaranaiyum saakakkoduththaan.

keeleayaaththin kudika'lilea thispiyanaakiya eliyaa aakaapai noakki: en vaakkinpadiyea an'ri intha varushangka'lilea paniyum mazhaiyum peyyaathirukkum en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka ni'rki'ra naan avarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
pinpu karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaayit'ru, avar:
nee ivvidaththai vittuk keezhththisaiyai noakkip poay, yoarthaanukku nearaayirukki'ra keareeth aat'ra'ndaiyil o'liththukko'ndiru.
antha aat'rin tha'n'neeraik kudippaay; angkea unnaip poashikka, kaakangka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvean en'raar.
avan poay, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea yoarthaanukku nearaayirukki'ra keareeth aat'ra'ndaiyilea thangkiyirunthaan.
kaakangka'l avanukku vidiya'rkaalaththil appamum i'raichchiyum, saayangkaalaththil appamum i'raichchiyum ko'nduvanthathu; thaakaththi'rku antha aat'rin tha'n'neeraik kudiththaan.
theasaththil mazhai peyyaathapadiyinaal, silanaa'lukkuppinpu antha aa'ru vat'rippoayit'ru.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaayit'ru, avar:
nee ezhunthu, seethoanukkaduththa saa'ripaath oorukkup poay, angkea thangkiyiru; unnaip paraamarikkumpadi angkea irukki'ra oru vithavaikkuk katta'laiyittean en'raar.

appadiyea avan ezhunthu, saa'ripaaththukkup poanaan; anthap patta'naththin olimukavaasalukku avan vanthapoathu, angkea oru vithavai vi'raku po'rukkikko'ndirunthaa'l; avan ava'laip paarththuk kooppittu, naan kudikki'ratha'rkuk kogncham tha'n'neer oru paaththiraththil enakkuk ko'nduvaa en'raan.
ko'nduvara ava'l poaki'rapoathu avan ava'lai noakkik kooppittu, kogncham appamum un kaiyilea enakkuk ko'nduvaa en'raan.

atha'rku ava'l: paanaiyil oru pidimaavum kalayaththil kogncham e'n'neyumea allaamal, ennidaththil oru adaiyum illaiyen'ru ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; ithoa, naanum en kumaaranum saappittuch seththuppoaka, athai enakkum avanukkum aayaththappaduththuki'ratha'rku ira'ndu vi'raku po'rukkuki'rean en'raa'l.

appozhuthu eliyaa ava'laip paarththu: payappadaathea; nee poay un vaarththaiyinpadi aayaththappaduththu; aanaalum muthal athilea enakku oru si'riya adaiyaip pa'n'ni ennidaththil ko'nduvaa; pinpu unakkum un kumaaranukkum pa'n'nalaam.
