karththar theasaththinmeal mazhaiyaik katta'laiyidum naa'lmattum paanaiyin maa selavazhinthupoavathum illai; kalasaththin e'n'ney ku'rainthupoavathum illai en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
ava'l poay, eliyaavin so'rpadi seythaa'l; ava'lum, ivanum, ava'l veettaarum aneakanaa'l saappittaarka'l.
karththar eliyaavaikko'ndu sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, paanaiyilea maa selavazhinthupoakavum illai; kalasaththin e'n'ney ku'rainthupoakavum illai.
ivaika'l nadanthapinpu, veettukkaariyaakiya antha sthireeyin makan viyaathiyil vizhunthaan; avanudaiya suvaasam poakumattum avanudaiya viyaathi athikariththukko'ndea irunthathu.
appozhuthu ava'l eliyaavai noakki: theavanudaiya manushanea, enakkum umakkum enna? en akkiramaththai ninaikkappa'n'navum, en kumaaranaich saakappa'n'navumaa? ennidaththil vantheer en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: un kumaaranai ennidaththil thaa en'ru solli, avanai ava'l madiyilirunthu eduththu, thaan thangkiyirukki'ra mealveettilea avanaik ko'ndupoay, than kattilinmeal vaiththu:
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, naan thangkiyirukka idangkoduththa intha vithavaiyin makanaich saakappa'n'ninathinaal ava'lukkuth thukkaththai varuviththeeroa en'ru karththarai noakkik kooppittu;
anthap pi'l'laiyinmeal moon'rutharam kuppu'ravizhunthu: en theavanaakiya karththaavea, inthap pi'l'laiyin aaththumaa avanukku'l thirumpivarappa'n'num en'ru karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.
karththar eliyaavin saththaththaik keattaar; pi'l'laiyinudaiya aaththumaa avanu'l thirumpi vanthathu; avan pizhaiththaan.
appozhuthu eliyaa pi'l'laiyai eduththu, mealveettilirunthu avanaik keezhveetti'rku'l ko'nduvanthu, avanai avan thaayinidaththil koduththu: paar un pi'l'lai uyiroadirukki'raan en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu antha sthiree eliyaavai noakki: neer theavanudaiya manushan en'rum, ummudaiya vaayilirunthu pi'rakkum karththarin vaarththai u'nmai en'rum, ithinaal ippoathu a'rinthirukki'rean en'raa'l.
aneakanaa'l sen'ru, moon'raam varushamaakaiyil, karththarudaiya vaarththai eliyaavukku u'ndaaki: nee poay aakaapukku unnaik kaa'npi; naan theasaththinmeal mazhaiyaik katta'laiyiduvean en'raar.
appozhuthu eliyaa aakaapukkuth thannaik kaa'npikkappoanaan; pagnchamoavenil samaariyaavilea kodithaayirunthathu.
aanapadiyaal aakaap aramanai visaarippukkaaranaakiya opathiyaavai azhaippiththaan; opathiyaa karththarukku mikavum payanthu nadakki'ravanaayirunthaan.

yeasapeal karththarin theerkkatharisika'laich sangkarikki'rapoathu, opathiyaa noo'ru theerkkatharisika'laich searththu, avarka'laik kepikku aimpathu aimpathu pearaaka o'liththuvaiththu, avarka'lukku appamum tha'n'neerum koduththu, avarka'laip paraamariththuvanthaan.

aakaap opathiyaavaip paarththu: nee theasaththilirukki'ra ellaa neeroot'ruka'lidaththilum, ellaa aa'ruka'lidaththilum poa; naam sakala mirukajeevanka'laiyum saakakkodaamal, kuthiraika'laiyum koavea'ru kazhuthaika'laiyumaavathu uyiroadea kaappaat'rumpadikku namakkup pul akappadumaa en'ru paar en'raan.
appadiyea theasaththaich sut'rippaarkkumpadi, athaip pakuththukko'ndu, aakaap oru vazhiyaayum, opathiyaa vea'roru vazhiyaayum poanaarka'l.
opathiyaa vazhiyil poakumpoathu, eliyaa avanukku ethirppattaan; avan ivanai innaan en'ru a'rinthu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, neer en aa'ndavanaakiya eliyaa allavaa en'ru keattatha'rku;
avan, naanthaan; nee poay, ithoa, eliyaa vanthirukki'raan en'ru un aa'ndavanukkuch sol en'raan.
atha'rku avan: aakaap ennaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, neer umathu adiyaanai avan kaiyil oppukkodukka naan enna paavam seythean.

ummaith theadumpadi en aa'ndavan manusharai anuppaatha jaathiyum raajyamum illai en'ru ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; neer illaiyen'ru avarka'l sonnapoathu, avan antha raajyaththaiyum antha jaathiyaiyum ummaik kaa'navillai en'ru saththiyam vaangkikko'ndaan.
ippoathum nee poay, un aa'ndavanukku, ithoa, eliyaa vanthirukki'raan en'ru sol en'ru neer solluki'reerea.

naan ummai vittuppoanavudanea oruvea'lai karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar ummai eduththu, naan a'riyaatha idaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoavaar; appozhuthu naan aakaapidaththi'rkup poay a'riviththa pinpu, avan ummaik kaa'naavittaal, ennaik kon'rupoaduvaanea; umathu adiyaanaakiya naan si'ruvayathumuthal karththarukkup payanthu nadakki'ravan.

yeasapeal karththarin theerkkatharisika'laik kon'rupoaduki'rapoathu, naan karththarudaiya theerkkatharisika'lil noo'rupearai ovvoru kepiyilea aimpathu aimpathu pearaaka o'liththuvaiththu, avarka'lukku appamum tha'n'neerum koduththu, paraamariththuvantha ennudaiya seykai en aa'ndavanukku a'rivikkappadavillaiyoa?
ippoathum en aa'ndavan ennaik kon'rupoadumpadiyaaka, neer: ithoa, eliyaa vanthirukki'raan en'ru poay avanukkuch sol en'ru solluki'reerea en'raan.
atha'rku eliyaa: in'raikku ennai avanukkuk kaa'npippean en'ru seanaika'lin karththarukku munpaaka ni'rki'ra naan avarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu opathiyaa poay, aakaapaich santhiththu avanukku athai a'riviththavudanea, aakaap eliyaavaich santhikkappoanaan.
aakaap eliyaavaik ka'ndapoathu, aakaap avanai noakki: isravealaik kalangkappa'n'nuki'ravan neeyallavaa en'raan.

atha'rku avan: isravealaik kalangkappa'n'nuki'ravan naan alla; karththarin katta'laika'lai vittu paakaalka'laip pinpat'rinathinaal neerum ummudaiya thakappan veettaarumea isravealaik kalangkappa'n'nuki'ravarka'l.

ippoathum karmeal parvathaththilea isravealanaiththaiyum, paakaalin theerkkatharisika'l naanoot'raimpathupearaiyum, yeasapealin panthiyilea saappiduki'ra thoappu vikkirakaththin theerkkatharisika'l naanoo'rupearaiyum ennidaththil koottikko'nduvara aadka'lai anuppum en'raan.
appadiyea aakaap: israveal puththirar ellaaridaththilum aadka'lai anuppi, karmeal parvathaththilea anthath theerkkatharisika'laik koodivarumpadi seythaan.

appozhuthu eliyaa sakala janaththa'ndaikkum vanthu: neengka'l enthamattum ira'ndu ninaivuka'laal kunthikkunthi nadappeerka'l; karththar theyvamaanaal avaraip pinpat'rungka'l; paakaal theyvamaanaal avanaip pinpat'rungka'l en'raan, janangka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka avanukku on'rum sollavillai.
appozhuthu eliyaa janangka'lai noakki: karththarin theerkkatharisika'lil meenthirukki'ravan naan oruvan; paakaalin theerkkatharisika'loa naanoot'raimpathupear.

ippoathum ira'ndu kaa'laika'lai engka'lidaththil ko'nduvarattum; oru kaa'laiyai avarka'l therinthuko'ndu, athaich santhusanthaakath thu'ndiththu, neruppup poadaamal vi'rakuka'linmeal vaikkakkadavarka'l; naan mat'rak kaa'laiyai appadiyea seythu, neruppup poadaamal vi'rakuka'linmeal vaippean.

neengka'l ungka'l theavanudaiya naamaththaich sollik kooppidungka'l; naan karththarudaiya naamaththaich sollik kooppiduvean; appozhuthu akkiniyinaal uththaravu aru'lum theyvamea theyvam en'raan; atha'rku janangka'lellaarum ithu nalla vaarththai en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu eliyaa paakaalin theerkkatharisika'lai noakki: neengka'l aneakaraanathaal neengka'lea munthi oru kaa'laiyaith therinthuko'ndu athai aayaththampa'n'ni, neruppuppoadaamal ungka'l theavanudaiya naamaththaich sollik kooppidungka'l en'raan.

thangka'lukkuk kodukkappatta kaa'laiyai avarka'l vaangki, athai aayaththampa'n'ni: paakaalea, engka'lukku uththaravu aru'lum en'ru kaalaithodangki maththiyaanamattum paakaalin naamaththaich sollik kooppittaarka'l; aanaalum oru saththamum pi'rakkavillai, ma'ruuththaravu koduppaarum illai. avarka'l kattina palipeedaththi'rku ethirea kuthiththu aadinaarka'l.

maththiyaanavea'laiyilea eliyaa avarka'laip pariyaasampa'n'ni: uraththa saththamaayk kooppidungka'l; avan theavanaamea, avan thiyaanaththil iruppaan; allathu aluvalaayiruppaan; allathu pirayaa'nampoayiruppaan; allathu thoongkinaalum thoongkuvaan; avanai ezhuppavea'ndiyathaakkum en'raan.
avarka'l uraththasaththamaayk kooppittu, thangka'l vazhakkaththinpadiyea iraththam thangka'lmeal vadiyumattum kaththika'laalum eettika'laalum thangka'laik kee'rikko'ndaarka'l.

maththiyaanavea'lai sen'rapinpu, anthippali seluththum nearamattaakach sannatham sollikko'ndirunthaarka'l; aanaalum oru saththamum pi'rakkavillai, ma'ruuththaravu koduppaarum illai, kavanippaarum illai.
appozhuthu eliyaa sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: en kittea vaarungka'l en'raan; sakala janangka'lum avan kittea vanthapoathu, thakarkkappatta karththarudaiya palipeedaththai avan seppanittu:

unakku israveal ennum pear iruppathaaka en'ru solli, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaippet'ra yaakkoapudaiya kumaararaal u'ndaana koaththirangka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea, pannira'ndu ka'rka'lai eduththu,

anthak ka'rka'laalea karththarudaiya naamaththi'rken'ru oru palipeedaththaik katti, palipeedaththaich sut'rilum thaaniyam a'lakki'ra ira'ndupadi vithai vithaikkaththakka idamaana oru vaaykkaalai u'ndaakki,
vi'rakuka'lai adukki, oru kaa'laiyaich santhusanthaakath thu'ndiththu vi'rakuka'linmeal vaiththaan.

pi'rpaadu avan: neengka'l naalukudam tha'n'neer ko'nduvanthu, sarvaangka thakanapaliyinmealum, vi'rakuka'linmealum oot'rungka'l en'raan; pinpu ira'ndaantharamum appadiyea oot'rungka'l en'raan; ira'ndaantharamum oot'rinaarka'l; atha'rkuppinpu moon'raantharamum appadiyea oot'rungka'l en'raan; moon'raantharamum oot'rinaarka'l.
appozhuthu tha'n'neer palipeedaththaich sut'rilum oadinathu; vaaykkaalaiyum tha'n'neeraal nirappinaan.

anthippali seluththum nearaththilea, theerkkatharisiyaakiya eliyaa vanthu: aapirakaamukkum eesaakkukkum yaakkoapukkum theavanaakiya karththaavea, isravealilea neer theavan en'rum, naan ummudaiya oozhiyakkaaran en'rum, naan inthak kaariyangka'laiyellaam ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi seythean en'rum in'raikku vi'langkappa'n'num.

karththaavea, neer theavanaakiya karththar en'rum, theavareer thangka'l iruthayaththai ma'rupadiyum thiruppineer en'rum intha janangka'l a'riyumpadikku, ennaik keattaru'lum, ennaik keattaru'lum en'raan.

appozhuthu: karththaridaththil irunthu akkini i'rangki, anthach sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, vi'rakuka'laiyum, ka'rka'laiyum, ma'n'naiyum padchiththu, vaaykkaaliliruntha tha'n'neeraiyum nakkippoattathu.
janangka'lellaarum ithaik ka'ndapoathu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: karththarea theyvam, karththarea theyvam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu eliyaa avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l paakaalin theerkkatharisika'lil oruvanum thappippoakaathapadikku avarka'laip pidiyungka'l en'raan; avarka'laip pidiththapoathu, eliyaa avarka'laik keezhea keesoan aat'rangkaraiyilea ko'ndupoay, angkea avarka'lai vettippoattaan.
pinpu eliyaa aakaapai noakki: neer poam, poajanapaanampa'n'num; perumazhaiyin iraichchal keadkappaduki'rathu en'raan.
aakaap poajanapaanam pa'n'nappoanaan; pinpu eliyaa karmeal parvathaththinudaiya sikaraththinmeal ea'ri, tharaiyilea pa'ninthu, than mukam than muzhangkaalil padakkuninthu,
than oozhiyakkaaranai noakki: nee poaych samuththiramukamaayp paar en'raan; avan poayp paarththu, on'rum illai en'raan; nee innum eazhutharam poayp paar en'raan.

eazhaantharam ivan: ithoa, samuththiraththilirunthu oru manushanudaiya u'l'langkai aththanaich si'riya meakam ezhumpuki'rathu en'raan; appozhuthu avan nee poay, aakaapai noakki: mazhai ummaith thadaiseyyaathapadikku irathaththaip pootti, poayvidum en'ru sol en'raan.
atha'rku'l'laaka vaanam meakangka'linaalum kaat'rinaalum ka'ruththu perumazhai u'ndaayit'ru; aakaap irathaththil ea'ri yesrayealukkup poanaan.
karththarudaiya kai eliyaavinmeal irunthathinaal, avan than araiyaik kattikko'ndu, yesrayealukku varumattaaka aakaapukkumun oadinaan.
eliyaa seytha ellaavat'raiyum, avan theerkkatharisika'lellaaraiyum pattayaththaalea kon'rupoatta seythi anaiththaiyum, aakaap yeasapealukku a'riviththaan.

appozhuthu yeasapeal eliyaavinidaththil aa'l anuppi: avarka'lil ovvoruvanudaiya piraa'nanukkuch seyyappattathupoala, naan naa'lai innearaththil un piraa'nanukkuch seyyaatheapoanaal, theavarka'l atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavarka'l en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
avanukku athu therinthapoathu ezhunthu, than piraa'nanaik kaakka yoothaavaichsearntha peyersepaavukkup pu'rappattuppoay, than vealaikkaaranai angkea ni'ruththivittaan.

avan vanaantharaththil orunaa'l pirayaa'nam poay, oru sooraichsediyin keezh udkaarnthu, thaan saakavea'ndum en'ru koari: poathum karththaavea, en aaththumaavai eduththukko'l'lum; naan en pithaakka'laippaarkkilum nallavan alla en'ru solli,
oru sooraichsediyinkeezhp paduththukko'ndu niththiraipa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu oru thoothan avanaith thattiyezhuppi: ezhunthirunthu poajanampa'n'nu en'raan.

avan vizhiththup paarkki'rapoathu, ithoa, thazhalil sudappatta adaiyum, oru paaththiraththil tha'n'neerum avan thalaimaattil irunthathu; appozhuthu avan, pusiththuk kudiththuth thirumpap paduththukko'ndaan.
karththarudaiya thoothan thirumpa ira'ndaantharam vanthu avanaith thattiyezhuppi: ezhunthirunthu poajanampa'n'nu; nee pa'n'navea'ndiya pirayaa'nam vekuthooram en'raan.
appozhuthu avan ezhunthirunthu pusiththuk kudiththu, anthap poajanaththin palaththinaal naa'rpathunaa'l iravupakal oareap ennum theavanudaiya parvathamattum nadanthupoanaan.
angkea avan oru kepikku'l poayth thangkinaan; ithoa, karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaaki, avar: eliyaavea, ingkea unakku enna kaariyam en'raar.

atha'rku avan: seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththarukkaaka veku pakthivairaakkiyamaayirunthean; israveal puththirar umathu udanpadikkaiyaith tha'l'livittaarka'l; ummudaiya palipeedangka'lai idiththu, ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'laip pattayaththinaal kon'rupoattaarka'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram meethiyaayirukki'rean; en piraa'nanaiyum vaangkath theaduki'raarka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avar: nee ve'liyea vanthu karththarukku munpaakap parvathaththil nil en'raar; appozhuthu, ithoa, karththar kadanthupoanaar; karththarukku munpaakap parvathangka'laip pi'lakki'rathum kanmalaika'lai udaikki'rathumaana palaththa perungkaat'ru u'ndaayit'ru; aanaalum anthak kaat'rilea karththar irukkavillai; kaat'ri'rkuppin poomi athirchchi u'ndaayit'ru; poomi athirchchiyilum karththar irukkavillai.
poomi athirchchikkuppin akkini u'ndaayit'ru; akkiniyilum karththar irukkavillai; akkinikkuppin amarntha melliyasaththam u'ndaayit'ru.

athai eliyaa keattapoathu, than saalvaiyinaal than mukaththai moodikko'ndu ve'liyea vanthu, kepiyin vaasalil nin'raan. appozhuthu, ithoa, eliyaavea, ingkea unakku enna kaariyam enki'ra saththam avanukku u'ndaayit'ru.

atha'rku avan: seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththarukkaaka veku pakthivairaakkiyamaayirunthean; israveal puththirar umathu udanpadikkaiyaith tha'l'livittaarka'l; ummudaiya palipeedangka'lai idiththu, ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'laip pattayaththinaal kon'rupoattaarka'l, naan oruvanmaaththiram meethiyaayirukki'rean; en piraa'nanaiyum vaangkath theaduki'raarka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar avanaip paarththu: nee thamaskuvin vazhiyaay vanaantharaththi'rkuth thirumpippoay, aasakealaich seeriyaavinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ni,

pinpu nimsiyin kumaaranaakiya yekoovai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ni, aapealmeakolaa ooraanaana saappaaththin kumaaranaakiya elisaavai un sthaanaththilea theerkkatharisiyaaka apisheakampa'n'nu.
sampavippathaavathu: aasakealin pattayaththi'rkuth thappinavanai yekoo kon'rupoaduvaan; yekoovin pattayaththi'rkuth thappinavanai elisaa kon'rupoaduvaan.
aanaalum paakaalukku mudangkaathirukki'ra muzhangkaalka'laiyum, avanai muththagnseyyaathirukki'ra vaayka'laiyumudaiya eazhaayirampearai isravealilea meethiyaaka vaiththirukki'rean en'raar.

appadiyea avan avvidam vittup pu'rappattuppoay, pannira'ndu ear pootti uzhutha saappaaththin kumaaranaakiya elisaavaik ka'ndaan; avan pannira'ndaam earai oattikko'ndirunthaan; eliyaa avan irukkum idamattum poay, avanmeal than saalvaiyaip poattaan.

appozhuthu avan maaduka'laivittu, eliyaavin pi'rakea oadi: naan en thakappanaiyum en thaayaiyum muththagnseyya uththaravukodum, atha'rkuppin ummaip pinthodarvean en'raan. atha'rku avan: poayth thirumpivaa; naan unakkuch seythathai ninaiththukko'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avan ivanai vittup poay, oar earmaaduka'laip pidiththu adiththu, earin maramuttuka'laal avaika'lin i'raichchiyaich samaiththu janangka'lukkuk koduththaan; avarka'l saappittapi'rpaadu, avan ezhunthu, eliyaavukkup pinsen'ru avanukku oozhiyagnseythaan.

seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya penaathaath than seanaiyaiyellaam koottikko'ndupoay, samaariyaavai mut'rikkaipoattu athinmeal yuththampa'n'ninaan; avanoadeakooda muppaththira'ndu raajaakka'l irunthathumallaamal, kuthiraika'lum irathangka'lum irunthathu.
avan nakaraththi'rku'l isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapidaththil sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:

unnudaiya ve'l'liyum unnudaiya ponnum ennudaiyathu; unnudaiya sthireeka'lum unnudaiya kumaararukku'l samarththaraayirukki'ravarka'lum ennudaiyavarka'l en'ru penaathaath solluki'raan en'ru avanukkuch sollachsonnaan.
isravealin raajaa atha'rkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, naanum enakku u'ndaana yaavum ummudaiyavaika'lthaan en'ru solliyanuppinaan.

antha sthaanaapathika'l thirumpavum vanthu: penaathaath solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, un ve'l'liyaiyum, un ponnaiyum, un sthireeka'laiyum, un kumaararka'laiyum nee enakkuk kodukkavea'ndum en'ru umakkuch solliyanuppineanea.

aanaalum naa'lai innearaththil en oozhiyakkaararai unnidaththil anuppuvean; avarka'l un veettaiyum un oozhiyakkaararin veeduka'laiyum soathiththu, un ka'n'nukkup piriyamaanavaika'l ellaavat'raiyum thangka'l kaika'lil eduththukko'ndupoavaarka'l en'raar en'ru sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa, theasaththin moopparaiyellaam azhaippiththu: ivan pollaapputh theaduki'ra vithaththaik kavaniththuppaarungka'l; en sthireeka'laiyum, en kumaararka'laiyum, en ve'l'liyaiyum, en ponnaiyum keadka, ivan ennidaththil aa'l anuppinapoathu, naan kodukkamaattean en'ru ivanukku ma'rukkavillaiyea en'raan.
appozhuthu sakala moopparum sakala janangka'lum avanaip paarththu: neer avanukkuch sevikodukkavum, avanukkuch sammathikkavum vea'ndaam en'raarka'l.

athinaal avan penaathaaththin sthaanaapathika'lai noakki: neengka'l raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, neer muthalvisai umathu adiyaanukkuch solliyanuppina yaavum seyvean; inthak kaariyaththaiyoa naan seyyakkoodaathu en'ru sollungka'l en'raan; sthaanaapathika'l poay, intha ma'rumozhiyai avanukkuch sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu penaathaath avanidaththil aa'l anuppi: enakkup pin selluki'ra janangka'l ellaarum kaikku oru pidiyaavathu vaarikko'l'la samaariyaavin thoo'l poathumaanathaayirunthaal, theavarka'l atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavarka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.
atha'rku isravealin raajaa pirathiyuththaramaaka: aayutham thariththirukki'ravan, aayutham urinthu poaduki'ravanaippoalap perumaipaaraattalaakaathu en'ru avanukkuch sollungka'l en'raan.

penaathaaththum, mat'ra raajaakka'lum koodaarangka'lilea kudiththukko'ndirukkaiyil, intha vaarththaiyaik keattu, than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: aayaththampa'n'nungka'l en'raan; appadiyea nakaraththinmeal sa'ndaiseyya aayaththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu oru theerkkatharisi isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapidaththil vanthu: antha earaa'lamaana janakkoottaththaiyellaam ka'ndaayaa? ithoa, naanea karththar en'ru nee a'riyumpadi in'raikku athai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

yaaraikko'ndu en'ru aakaap keattaan; atha'rku avan: maakaa'nangka'ludaiya athipathika'lin seavakaraikko'ndu en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan; pinpu avan, yuththaththai yaar thuvakkavea'ndum en'ru keattatha'rku; avan, neerthaan en'raan.

avan maakaa'nangka'ludaiya athipathika'lin seavakarai ilakkampaarththaan, avarka'l irunoot'ru muppaththira'ndupear; avarka'lukkuppinpu, israveal puththiraraakiya sakala janaththin ilakkamum paarththu eazhaayirampear en'ru ka'ndaan.

avarka'l maththiyaanavea'laiyilea ve'liyea pu'rappattaarka'l; penaathaaththum, avanukku uthaviyaaka vantha muppaththira'ndu raajaakka'laakiya mat'ra raajaakka'lum, koodaarangka'lil kudiththu ve'riko'ndirunthaarka'l.

maakaa'nangka'ludaiya athipathika'lin seavakar mun tha'ndaakap pu'rappaduki'rapoathu, penaathaath anuppina manushar: samaariyaavilirunthu manushar pu'rappattu varuki'raarka'l en'ru avanukku a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: avarka'l samaathaanaththi'rkaakap pu'rappattuvanthaalum avarka'lai uyiroadea pidiyungka'l; avarka'l yuththaththi'rkaakap pu'rappattuvanthaalum avarka'lai uyiroadea pidiyungka'l en'raan.
maakaa'nangka'ludaiya athipathika'lin seavakaraana avarka'lum, avarka'l pinnea varuki'ra iraa'nuvamum, nakaraththilirunthu ve'liyea vanthapoathu,

avarka'l avaravar thangka'lukku ethirppaduki'ravarka'lai vettinaarka'l; seeriyar mu'rinthoadippoanaarka'l; isravealar avarka'laith thuraththinaarka'l; seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya penaathaath, kuthiraiyinmeal ea'rich sila kuthiraiveeraroadungkoodath thappiyoadippoanaan.
isravealin raajaa pu'rappattu, kuthiraika'laiyum irathangka'laiyum mu'riya adiththu, seeriyaril makaa sangkaaram u'ndaaka vettinaan.

pinpu anthath theerkkatharisi isravealin raajaavinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: neer poay ummaip palappaduththikko'ndu, neer seyyaththakkathu innathen'ru kavaniththuppaarum; ma'ruvarushaththilea seeriyaavin raajaa umakku viroathamaaka varuvaan en'raan.

seeriyaavin raajaavudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanaip paarththu: avarka'ludaiya theavarka'l malaiththeavarka'l, athinaal avarka'l nammai mea'rko'ndaarka'l; naam avarka'loadea samapoomiyilea yuththampa'n'ninaal nallathu; appozhuthu avarka'lai mea'rko'lvathu nichchayam.
atha'rkaaka neer seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, intha raajaakka'l ovvoruvaraiyum thangka'l sthalaththilirunthu maat'ri, avarka'lukkup pathilaakach seanaapathika'lai ea'rpaduththi;

neer madiyakkoduththa seanaikkuch sariyaaych seanaiyaiyum, anthak kuthiraika'lukkuch sariyaayk kuthiraika'laiyum, irathangka'lukkuch sariyaay irathangka'laiyum ilakkampaarththukko'l'lum; pi'rpaadu samapoomiyilea naam avarka'loadu yuththampa'n'ni, nichchayamaay avarka'lai mea'rko'lvoam en'raarka'l; avan avarka'l so'rkeattu appadiyea seythaan.
ma'ruvarushaththilea penaathaath seeriyarai ilakkampaarththu, isravealoadu yuththampa'n'na aappekkukku vanthaan.

israveal puththirarum ilakkam paarkkappattu, theavaiyaanathaich sampaathiththukko'ndu, avarka'lai ethirkkap pu'rappattu, avarka'lukku ethirea ira'ndu si'riya ve'l'laattuk kidaika'laippoalap paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; theasam seeriyaraal ni'rainthirunthathu.

appozhuthu theavanudaiya manushan oruvan vanthu, isravealin raajaavaip paarththu: karththar pa'l'laththaakkuka'lin theavanaayiraamal, malaika'lin theavanaayirukki'raar en'ru seeriyar solliyirukki'rapadiyinaal, naan intha earaa'lamaana janakkoottaththaiyellaam un kaiyil oppukkoduththean; athinaal naanea karththar en'ru neengka'l a'riveerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
eazhunaa'la'lavum avarka'l mukamukamaayp paa'layami'rangkiyirunthaarka'l; eazhaam naa'lil yuththam kalanthu, israveal puththirar oreanaa'lilea seeriyaril ladcham kaalaadka'lai madangkadiththaarka'l.

meethiyaanavarka'l aappekpatta'naththi'rku'l oadippoanaarka'l; angkea meethiyaayiruntha irupaththeazhaayirampearinmeal alangkam idinthu vizhunthathu; penaathaaththum oadippoay nakaraththi'rku'l pukunthu, u'l'la'raiyilea pathungkinaan.

appozhuthu avan oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: ithoa, israveal vamsaththu raajaakka'l thayavu'l'la raajaakka'l en'ru keattirukki'roam; naangka'l irattuka'lai engka'l araika'lil katti, kayi'ruka'lai engka'l thalaika'lil sut'rikko'ndu, isravealin raajaavinidaththil poavoam; oruvea'lai ummai uyiroadea vaippaar en'ru solli,

irattaith thangka'l araika'lil katti, kayi'ruka'laith thangka'l thalaika'lil sut'rikko'ndu, isravealin raajaavinidaththil vanthu: ennai uyiroadea vaiyum en'ru umathu adiyaanaakiya penaathaath vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'raan en'raarka'l. atha'rku avan, innum avan uyiroadea irukki'raanaa, avan en sakoatharan en'raan.

antha manushar nan'raayk kavaniththu, avan vaayin sollai udanea pidiththu: umathu sakoatharanaakiya penaathaath irukki'raan en'raarka'l; appozhuthu avan: neengka'l poay, avanai azhaiththukko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; penaathaath avanidaththil vanthapoathu, avanaith than irathaththil eat'rikko'ndaan.

appozhuthu penaathaath ivanaip paarththu: en thakappan ummudaiya thakappanaar kaiyilea pidiththa patta'nangka'laith thirumpak koduththuviduki'rean; en thakappan samaariyaavilea seythathupoala, neerum thamaskuvilea veethika'lai u'ndaakkikko'l'lalaam en'raan. atha'rku avan, intha udanpadikkai seythu naan ummai anuppividuki'rean en'ru solli, avanoadu udanpadikkaipa'n'ni avanai anuppivittaan.
appozhuthu theerkkatharisika'lin puththiraril oruvan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi than thoazhanai noakki: nee ennai adi en'raan; antha manushan avanaippaarththu adikkamaattean en'raan.

appozhuthu avan ivanaip paarththu: nee karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoanapadiyaal, ithoa, nee ennaivittup pu'rappattup poanavudanea oru singkam unnaik kollum en'raan; appadiyea ivan avanai vittup pu'rappattavudanea, oru singkam ivanaik ka'ndu kon'rupoattathu.
athinpin avan vea'roruvanaik ka'ndu: ennai adi en'raan; antha manushan, avanaik kaayamu'ndaaka adiththaan.
appozhuthu anthath theerkkatharisi poay, than mukaththinmeal saampalaippoattu, veashamaa'rinavanaay vazhiyilea raajaavukkaakak kaaththirunthaan.

raajaa avvazhiyaay varuki'rapoathu, ivan raajaavaippaarththuk kooppittu: umathu adiyaan yuththaththil nin'rapoathu, oruvan vilaki, ennidaththil oruvanaik ko'nduvanthu, intha manushanaip paththirampa'n'nu; ivan thappippoanaal, un piraa'nan avan piraa'nanukku eedaayirukkum, allathu oru thaalanthu ve'l'liyai nee kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
aanaalum umathu adiyaan ingkum angkum aluvalaayirukkumpoathu, avan poayvittaan en'raan. isravealin raajaa avanaip paarththu: nee sonna theerppinpadiyea aakum en'raan.
appozhuthu avan seekkiramaayth than mukaththinmealirukkum saampalaith thudaiththuvittathinaal, isravealin raajaa avan theerkkatharisika'lil oruvan en'ru a'rinthuko'ndaan.

appozhuthu ivan avanai noakki: sangkaaraththi'rku naan niyamiththa manushanai un kaiyilirunthu thappippoakumpadi nee vittapadiyinaal, un piraa'nan avan piraa'nanukku eedaakavum, un janam avan janaththi'rku eedaakavum irukkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
athinaal isravealin raajaa salippum visanamumaayth than veetti'rkup poakap pu'rappattuch samaariyaavukku vanthaan.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, yesrayealanaakiya naapoaththukku yesrayealilea samaariyaavin raajaavaakiya aakaapin aramanai a'ndaiyil oru thiraadchaththoattam irunthathu.

aakaap naapoaththoadea peasi: un thiraadchaththoattam en veetti'rku aduththirukki'rapadiyaal, athaik keeraikkollaiyaakkumpadi enakkuk kodu, athaippaarkkilum nalla thiraadchaththoattaththai atha'rkup pathilaaka unakkuth tharuvean; allathu unakku vea'ndumaanaal, athin vilaikkirayamaana pa'naththaith tharuvean en'raan.
naapoath aakaapai noakki: naan en pithaakka'lin suthantharaththai umakkuk kodaathapadi karththar ennaik kaappaaraaka en'raan.

ippadi en pithaakka'lin suthantharaththai umakkuk kodean en'ru yesrayealanaakiya naapoath thannoadea sonna vaarththaikkaaka aakaap salippum sinamumaay, than veetti'rku vanthu, poajanampa'n'naamal, than kattilinmeal paduththu, than mukaththaith thiruppikko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu avan manaiviyaakiya yeasapeal avanidaththil vanthu: neer poajanampa'n'naathapadikku, ummudaiya manam salippaayirukki'rathu enna en'ru avanaik keattatha'rku,

avan ava'laip paarththu: naan yesrayealanaakiya naapoaththoadea peasi: un thiraadchaththoattaththai enakku vilaikkirayamaayk kodu; allathu unakku raasiyaanaal atha'rkup pathilaaka vea'rea thiraadchaththoattaththai unakkuth tharuvean en'rean. atha'rku avan: en thiraadchaththoattaththai umakkuk kodukkamaattean en'ru sonnaan en'raan.

appozhuthu avan manaiviyaakiya yeasapeal avanai noakki: neer ippoathu isravealinmeal raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'ravar allavaa? neer ezhunthu poajanampa'n'ni manamakizhchchiyaayirum; yesrayealanaakiya naapoaththin thiraadchaththoattaththai naan umakkuk koduppean en'ru sonnaa'l.

ava'l aakaapin peyaraal nirupangka'lai ezhuthi, avan muththiraiyai avaika'lukkup poattu, antha nirupangka'lai naapoath irukkum patta'naththil avanoadea kudiyirukki'ra moopparidaththukkum periyoaridaththukkum anuppinaa'l.
antha nirupangka'lil ava'l ezhuthinathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l upavaasam en'ru pirasiththappaduththi, naapoaththai janaththin mun ni'ruththi,

theavanaiyum raajaavaiyum thooshiththaay en'ru avanmeal saadchisolluki'ra pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya ira'ndupearai avanukku ethiraaka ni'ruththi, avanai ve'liyea ko'ndupoay avan saakumpadikku avanaik kalle'riyungka'l en'ru ezhuthinaa'l.
avan patta'naththilea kudiyirukki'ra moopparum periyoarumaakiya avan patta'naththu manushar, yeasapeal thangka'lukku anuppina nirupangka'lil ezhuthik katta'laiyittirunthapadiyea seythaarka'l.
avarka'l upavaasam en'ru pirasiththappaduththi naapoaththai janaththin munnea ni'ruththinaarka'l.

appozhuthu pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya ira'ndupear vanthu, avanukku ethiraaka udkaarnthu: naapoath theavanaiyum raajaavaiyum thooshiththaan en'ru janaththi'rku munpaaka avanmeal saadchi sonnaarka'l; atha'rkuppinpu avanaip patta'naththi'rku ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avan saakumpadikku avanaik kalle'rinthu,
pi'rpaadu yeasapealukku, naapoath kalle'riyu'ndu seththaan en'ru solliyanuppinaarka'l.

naapoath kalle'riyu'ndu seththathai yeasapeal keattapoathu, aakaapai noakki: neer ezhunthirunthu, yesrayealanaakiya naapoath umakku vilaikkirayamaayk kodukkamaattean en'ru sonna thiraadchaththoattaththaich sonthamaay eduththukko'l'lum; naapoath uyiroadillai, avan seththuppoanaan en'raa'l.
naapoath seththuppoanathai aakaap keattapoathu, avan yesrayealanaakiya naapoaththin thiraadchaththoattaththaich sonthamaay eduththukko'l'lumpadi ezhunthupoanaan.
karththarudaiya vaarththai thispiyanaakiya eliyaavukku u'ndaayit'ru, avar:
nee ezhunthu, samaariyaavilirukki'ra isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapaich santhikkumpadi poa; ithoa, avan naapoaththin thiraadchaththoattaththaich sonthamaay eduththukko'l'la angkea poayirukki'raan.

nee avanaip paarththu: nee kolaiseythathum eduththukko'ndathum illaiyoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naayka'l naapoaththin iraththaththai nakkina sthalaththilea unnudaiya iraththaththaiyum naayka'l nakkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
appozhuthu aakaap eliyaavai noakki: en pakaignanea, ennaik ka'ndupidiththaayaa en'raan. atha'rku avan: ka'ndupidiththean; karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyya nee unnai vit'ruppoattaay.
naan unmeal pollaappu varappa'n'ni, un santhathiyai azhiththuppoattu, aakaapukku suvaril neervidum oru naayaakilum iraathapadikku isravealil adaipattavanaiyum vidupattavanaiyum sangkariththu,

nee enakkuk koapam u'ndaakki, isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'ninathinimiththam, unnudaiya kudumpaththai neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin kudumpaththukkum, akiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paashaavin kudumpaththukkum samaanamaakkuvean en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
yeasapealaiyum ku'riththuk karththar: naayka'l yeasapealai yesrayealin mathil arukea thinnum.
aakaapin santhathiyil patta'naththilea saaki'ravanai naayka'lum, ve'liyilea saaki'ravanai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lum thinnum en'raar.
than manaiviyaakiya yeasapeal thoo'ndivittapadiyea, karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyya, thannai vit'ruppoatta aakaapaippoala oruvanumillai.
karththar israveal puththirarukku munnin'ru thuraththivitta emoariyar seythapadiyellaam, avan narakalaana vikkirakangka'laip pinpat'ri, makaa aruvaruppaay nadanthuko'ndaan.

aakaap intha vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, than sareeraththinmeal irattaip poarththukko'ndu, upavaasampa'n'ni, irattilea paduththuth thaazhmaiyaay nadanthuko'ndaan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai thispiyanaakiya eliyaavukku u'ndaayit'ru, avar:

aakaap enakku munpaakath thannaith thaazhththinathaik ka'ndaayaa? avan enakku munpaakath thannaith thaazhththuki'rapadiyinaal, naan avan naadka'lil anthap pollaappai varappa'n'naamal, avan kumaaran naadka'lil athai avan veettinmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
seeriyarukkum isravealarukkum moon'ru varusham yuththamillaamalirunthathu.
moon'raam varushaththilea yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaath isravealin raajaavinidaththi'rkup poayirukkumpoathu,

isravealin raajaa than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoath nammudaiyathen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? naam athaich seeriyaa raajaavin kaiyilirunthu pidiththukko'l'laamal, summaayiruppaanean en'ru solli,

yoasapaaththai noakki: keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'na ennoadeakooda varuki'reeraa en'ru keattaan. yoasapaath isravealin raajaavai noakki: naanthaan neer, ennudaiya janangka'l ummudaiya janangka'l, ennudaiya kuthiraika'l ummudaiya kuthiraika'l en'raan.
pinnum yoasapaath isravealin raajaavaip paarththu: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai in'raikku visaariththu a'riyum en'raan.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa ea'rakku'raiya naanoo'ru theerkkatharisika'laik koodivarachseythu: naan keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'nappoakalaamaa, poakalaakaathaa en'ru avarka'laik keattatha'rku; avarka'l, poam, aa'ndavar raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raarka'l.
pinpu yoasapaath: naam visaariththu a'riki'ratha'rku ivarka'laiyallaamal karththarudaiya theerkkatharisi vea'rea yaaraakilum ingkea illaiyaa en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa, yoasapaaththai noakki: karththaridaththil visaariththu a'riki'ratha'rku imlaavin kumaaranaakiya mikaayaa ennum innum oruvan irukki'raan; aanaalum naan avanaip pakaikki'rean; avan ennaikku'riththu nanmaiyaaka alla, theemaiyaakavea theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ravan en'raan. atha'rku yoasapaath, raajaavea, appadich sollavea'ndaam en'raan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa pirathaanika'lil oruvanaik kooppittu: imlaavin kumaaranaakiya mikaayaavaich seekkiramaay azhaiththuvaa en'raan.

isravealin raajaavum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththum, samaariyaavin olimukavaasalukku munnirukkum visaalaththilea raajavasthiram thariththukko'ndavarka'laay, avaravar thamtham singkaasanaththil udkaarnthirunthaarka'l; sakala theerkkatharisika'lum avarka'lukku munpaakath theerkkatharisanagnsonnaarka'l.
keanaanaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa thanakku iruppukkompuka'lai u'ndaakki, ivaika'laal neer seeriyarai mutti nirmoolamaakkip poaduveer en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
sakala theerkkatharisika'lum atha'rku isaivaakath theerkkatharisanam solli, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththukkuppoam, umakku vaaykkum; karththar athai raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raarka'l.

mikaayaavai azhaikkappoana aa'l avanudan peasi: ithoa, theerkkatharisika'ludaiya vaarththaika'l eakavaakkaay raajaavukku nanmaiyaayirukki'rathu; ummudaiya vaarththaiyum avarka'lil oruvar vaarththaiyaippoala irukkumpadi nanmaiyaakach sollum en'raan.
atha'rku mikaayaa: karththar ennidaththil solvathaiyea solluvean en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.

avan raajaavinidaththil vanthapoathu, raajaa avanaip paarththu: mikaayaavea, naangka'l keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'nappoakalaamaa, poakalaakaathaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avan: "poam, umakku vaaykkum; karththar athai raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar" en'raan.
raajaa avanaip paarththu: nee karththarudaiya naamaththilea u'nmaiyai allaamal vea'ron'raiyum ennidaththil sollaathapadikku, naan eththanaitharam unnai aa'naiyiduvikkavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu avan: isravealarellaarum meayppan illaatha aaduka'laippoala malaika'lilea sitha'rappattathaik ka'ndean; appozhuthu karththar: ivarka'lukku ejamaan illai; avaravar thamtham veetti'rkuch samaathaanaththoadea thirumpakkadavarka'l en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa yoasapaaththai noakki: ivan ennaikku'riththu nanmaiyaaka alla, theemaiyaakavea theerkkatharisanam solluki'ravan en'ru naan ummoadea sollavillaiyaa en'raan.

appozhuthu avan sonnathu: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lum; karththar thammudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'rathaiyum, paramaseanaiyellaam avaridam avar valathupakkaththilum avar idathupakkaththilum ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndean.
appozhuthu karththar: aakaap poay, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththil vizhumpadikku, avanukkup poathanai seyki'ravan yaar en'ru keattatha'rku, oruvan ippadiyum oruvan appadiyum sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu oru aavi pu'rappattu vanthu, karththarukku munpaaka nin'ru: naan avanukkup poathanai seyvean en'rathu.

ethinaal en'ru karththar athaik keattaar. appozhuthu athu: naan poay, avanudaiya theerkkatharisika'l ellaarin vaayilum poyyin aaviyaay iruppean en'rathu. atha'rku avar: nee avanukkup poathanaiseythu appadi nadakkappa'n'nuvaay; poay appadich sey en'raar.
aathalaal karththar poyyin aaviyai intha ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'laakiya ivarka'l ellaarudaiya vaayilum katta'laiyittaar; karththar ummaik ku'riththuth theemaiyaakach sonnaar en'raan.
appozhuthu keanaanaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa kitteavanthu, mikaayaavaik kannaththil adiththu, karththarudaiya aavi enthavazhiyaay ennaivittu unnoadea peasumpadi vanthathu en'raan.
atha'rku mikaayaa: nee o'liththukko'l'la u'l'la'raiyilea pathungkum annaa'lilea athaik kaa'npaay en'raan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa: mikaayaavaip pidiththu, avanaip patta'naththuth thalaivanaakiya aamoanidaththi'rkum, raajaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaasidaththi'rkum thirumpak ko'ndupoay,

ivanaich si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththu, naan samaathaanaththoadea varuma'lavum, ivanukku idukkaththin appaththaiyum idukkaththin tha'n'neeraiyum saappidakkodungka'l en'ru raajaa sonnaar en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu mikaayaa: neer samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivaruki'rathu u'ndaanaal, karththar ennaikko'ndu peasinathillai en'ru solli; janangka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum ithaik kea'lungka'l en'raan.
pinpu isravealin raajaavum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththum keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththukkup poanaarka'l.

isravealin raajaa yoasapaaththai noakki: naan veashammaa'ri yuththaththil piraveasippean; neeroa raajavasthiram thariththirum en'ru solli, isravealin raajaa veashammaa'ri, yuththaththil piraveasiththaan.

seeriyaavin raajaa thanakku irukki'ra irathangka'lin muppaththira'ndu thalaivaraiyum noakki: neengka'l si'riyavaroadum periyavaroadum yuththampa'n'naamal isravealin raajaa oruvanoadeamaaththiram yuththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittirunthaan.

aathalaal irathangka'lin thalaivar yoasapaaththaik kaa'nkaiyil, ivanthaan isravealin raajaa en'ru solli yuththampa'n'na avanukku nearaakach saaynthuvanthaarka'l; appozhuthu yoasapaath kookkuralittaan.
ivan isravealin raajaa alla en'ru irathangka'lin thalaivar ka'ndu avanaivittu, vilakippoanaarka'l.

oruvan ninaiyaamal villai naa'neat'ri eythaan; athu isravealin raajaavinudaiya kavasaththin santhuka'lukku'l pattathu; appozhuthu avan than saarathiyaip paarththu: nee thiruppi ennai iraa'nuvaththukkappaal ko'ndupoa; enakkuk kaayampattathu en'raan.

an'raiyathinam yuththam athikariththathu; raajaavaich seeriyarukku ethiraaka irathaththil ni'ruththivaiththaarka'l; saayangkaalaththilea avan i'ranthupoanaan; kaayaththin iraththam irathaththin thattilea vadinthathu.
pozhuthupoakumpoathu avaravar thamtham patta'naththi'rkum, avaravar thamtham theasaththi'rkum poakalaam en'ru iraa'nuvaththil pa'raisaat'rappattathu.
appadiyea raajaa i'ranthapinpu, samaariyaavukkuk ko'nduvarappattaan; raajaavaich samaariyaavil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
antha irathaththaiyum avanudaiya kavasaththaiyum samaariyaavin ku'laththilea kazhuvuki'rapoathu, karththar solliyiruntha vaarththaiyinpadiyea, naayka'l avan iraththaththai nakkinathu.

aakaapin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avan kattina thantha aramanaiyin varalaa'rum, avan kattina ellaap patta'nangka'lin varalaa'rum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aakaap than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya akasiyaa avan sthalaththil raajaavaanaan.
aasaavin kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapin naalaam varushaththil yoothaavinmeal raajaavaanaan.
yoasapaath raajaavaaki'rapoathu muppaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, irupaththainthu varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; silkiyin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayin pear asupaa'l.

avan than thakappanaakiya aasaavin vazhika'lilellaam nadanthaan; avan athai vittu vilakaamal karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan; aakilum meadaika'l thakarkkappadavillai; janangka'l innum meadaika'linmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaarka'l.
yoasapaath isravealin raajaavoadea samaathaanamaayirunthaan.
yoasapaaththin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan kaattiya vallamaiyum, avan pa'n'nina yuththamum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
than thakappanaakiya aasaavin naadka'lil meethiyaay vittiruntha ilachchaiyaana pu'narchchikkaararaiyum avan theasaththilirunthu at'ruppoakappa'n'ninaan.
appozhuthu eathoamil raajaa illai; pirathiraajaa oruvan irunthaan.
ponnukkaaka oappeerukkup poakumpadi, yoasapaath tharshees kappalka'laich seythaan; aanaal avaika'l poakavillai; avaika'l esiyoankeapearilea udainthupoayina.
appozhuthu aakaapin kumaaranaakiya akasiyaa yoasapaaththai noakki: en vealaikkaarar ummudaiya vealaikkaararoadungkoodak kappalka'lilea poakattum en'raan; atha'rku yoasapaath sammathikkavillai.
yoasapaath than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, thaaveethin nakaraththilea than pithaakka'loadea adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya yoaraam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
aakaapin kumaaranaakiya akasiyaa yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththin pathineazhaam varushaththilea samaariyaavil raajaavaaki, isravealinmeal ira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, than thakappan vazhiyilum, than thaayin vazhiyilum, isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaran yeropeyaamin vazhiyilum nadanthu,
paakaalaich seaviththu, avanaip pa'ninthuko'ndu, than thakappan seythapadiyellaam isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakkinaan.
aakaap mara'namadainthapin, moavaapiyar isravealukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'nip pirinthupoanaarka'l.

akasiyaa samaariyaavilirukki'ra than mealveettilirunthu kiraathiyin vazhiyaay vizhunthu, viyaathippattu: intha viyaathi neengkip pizhaippeanaa en'ru ekroanin theavanaakiya paakaalseapoopidaththil poay visaariyungka'l en'ru aadka'lai anuppinaan.

karththarudaiya thoothan thispiyanaakiya eliyaavai noakki: nee ezhunthu, samaariyaavudaiya raajaavin aadka'lukku ethirppadappoay: isravealilea theavan illaiyen'raa neengka'l ekroanin theavanaakiya paakaalseapoopidaththil visaarikkappoaki'reerka'l?
ithinimiththam nee ea'rina kattililirunthu i'rangkaamal, saakavea saavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar enpathai avarka'loadea sol en'raan; appadiyea eliyaa poaych sonnaan.
antha aadka'l avanidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthapoathu: neengka'l thirumpi vanthathu enna en'ru avan avarka'lidaththil keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: oru manushan engka'lukku ethirppattuvanthu: neengka'l ungka'lai anuppina raajaavinidaththil thirumpippoay, isravealilea theavan illaiyen'raa nee ekroanin theavanaakiya paakaalseapoopidaththil visaarikkappoaki'raay; ithinimiththam nee ea'rina kattililirunthu i'rangkaamal saakavea saavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar enpathai avanoadea sollungka'l en'raan en'ru sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lukku ethirppattu vanthu, intha vaarththaika'lai ungka'lidaththil sonna manushan eppadippattavan en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: avan mayir udaiyaith thariththu, vaarkkachchaiyaith than araiyilea kattikko'ndirunthaan en'raarka'l; appozhuthu avan: thispiyanaakiya eliyaathaan en'ru solli;

avanidaththi'rku oru thalaivanaiyum, avanudaiya aimpathu seavakaraiyum anuppinaan; malaiyin uchchiyil udkaarnthirukki'ra avanidaththil ivan ea'rippoay: theavanudaiya manushanea, raajaa unnai varachsolluki'raar en'raan.

appozhuthu eliyaa, antha aimpathupearin thalaivanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan theavanudaiya manushanaanaal, akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, unnaiyum un aimpathupearaiyum padchikkakkadavathu en'raan; udanea akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, avanaiyum avan aimpathupearaiyum padchiththathu.

ma'rupadiyum avanidaththi'rku vea'roru thalaivanaiyum, avanudaiya aimpathu seavakaraiyum anuppinaan. ivan avanai noakki: theavanudaiya manushanea, raajaa unnaich seekkiramaay varachsolluki'raar en'raan.

eliyaa avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan theavanudaiya manushanaanaal, akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, unnaiyum un aimpathupearaiyum padchikkakkadavathu en'raan; udanea theavanudaiya akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, avanaiyum avan aimpathupearaiyum padchiththathu.

thirumpavum moon'raantharam oru thalaivanaiyum, avanudaiya aimpathu seavakaraiyum anuppinaan; intha moon'raanthalaivan ea'rivanthapoathu, eliyaavukku munpaaka muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu, avanai vea'ndikko'ndu: theavanudaiya manushanea, ennudaiya piraa'nanum, umathu adiyaaraakiya intha aimpathupearin piraa'nanum umathu paarvaikku arumaiyaayiruppathaaka.

ithoa, akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, munthina ira'ndu thalaivaraiyum, avaravarudaiya aimpathu seavakaraiyum padchiththathu; ippoathum ennudaiya piraa'nan umathu paarvaikku arumaiyaayiruppathaaka en'raan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan eliyaavai noakki: avanoadeakooda i'rangkippoa, avanukkup payappadaathea en'raan; appadiyea avan ezhunthu avanoadeakooda raajaavinidaththi'rku i'rangkippoay,

avanaip paarththu: isravealilea theavan illaiyen'raa nee ekroanin theavanaakiya paakaalseapoopidaththil visaarikka aadka'lai anuppinaay; aathalaal nee ea'rina kattililirunthu i'rangkaamal saakavea saavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

eliyaa sonna karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea avan i'ranthupoanaan; avanukkuk kumaaran illaathapadiyinaal, avan sthaanaththilea yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththudaiya kumaaranaana yoaraamin ira'ndaam varushaththil yoaraam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
akasiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'l israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
karththar eliyaavaich suzhalkaat'rilea paraloakaththi'rku eduththukko'l'lap poaki'rapoathu, eliyaa elisaavoadeakoodak kilkaalilirunthu pu'rappattuppoanaan.

eliyaa elisaavai noakki: nee ingkea iru; karththar ennaip peththealmattum poaka anuppuki'raar en'raan. atha'rku elisaa: naan ummai viduki'rathillai en'ru karththarin jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyumko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan; appadiyea iruvarum peththealukkup poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu peththealiliruntha theerkkatharisika'lin puththirar elisaavinidaththil vanthu: in'raikkuk karththar unakkuth thalaimaiyaayirukki'ra un ejamaanai unnaivittu eduththukko'lvaar enpathu unakkuth theriyumaa en'raarka'l. atha'rku avan: enakkuth theriyum, summaa irungka'l en'raan.

pinpu eliyaa avanai noakki: elisaavea, nee ingkea iru; karththar ennai erikoamattum poaka anuppuki'raar en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan ummai viduki'rathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyumko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan; appadiyea avarka'l erikoavukku vanthaarka'l.

erikoaviliruntha theerkkatharisika'lin puththirar elisaavinidaththil vanthu: in'raikkuk karththar unakkuth thalaimaiyaayirukki'ra un ejamaanai unnaivittu eduththukko'lvaar enpathu unakkuth theriyumaa en'ru avanaik keattaarka'l. atha'rku avan: enakkuth theriyum, summaa irungka'l en'raan.

pinpu eliyaa avanai noakki: nee ingkea iru; karththar ennai yoarthaanukku anuppuki'raar en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan ummai viduki'rathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyumko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan; appadiyea iruvarum poanaarka'l.
theerkkatharisika'lin puththiraril aimpathupear poay, thooraththilea paarththukko'ndu nin'raarka'l; avarka'l iruvarum yoarthaan karaiyilea nin'raarka'l.
appozhuthu eliyaa, than saalvaiyai eduththu mu'rukkith tha'n'neerai adiththaan; athu irupakkamaakap pirinthathu; avarka'l iruvarum ularntha tharaivazhiyaay akkaraikkup poanaarka'l.

avarka'l akkaraippattapinpu, eliyaa elisaavai noakki: naan unnaivittu eduththukko'l'lappadumunnea naan unakkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu enna, kea'l en'raan. atha'rku elisaa: ummidaththilu'l'la aaviyin varam enakku irattippaayk kidaikkumpadi vea'nduki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku avan: arithaana kaariyaththaik keattaay; unnaivittu naan eduththukko'l'lappadukaiyil ennai nee ka'ndaal unakkuk kidaikkum; illaavittaal kidaiyaathu en'raan.
avarka'l peasikko'ndu nadanthupoakaiyil, ithoa, akkini rathamum akkinik kuthiraika'lum avarka'l naduvaaka vanthu iruvaraiyum piriththathu; eliyaa suzhalkaat'rilea paraloakaththi'rku ea'rippoanaan.

athai elisaa ka'ndu: en thakappanea, en thakappanea, isravealukku irathamum kuthiraiveerarumaay irunthavarea en'ru pulampinaan; avanai appu'ram kaa'naamal, than vasthiraththaip pidiththu ira'ndu thu'ndaakak kizhiththaan.
pinpu avan eliyaavinmealirunthu keezhea vizhuntha saalvaiyai eduththuth thirumpippoay, yoarthaanin karaiyilea nin'ru,

eliyaavinmealirunthu keezhea vizhuntha saalvaiyaip pidiththu: eliyaavin theavanaakiya karththar engkea en'ru sollith tha'n'neerai adiththaan; tha'n'neerai adiththavudanea athu irupakkamaakap pirinthathinaal elisaa ikkaraippattaan.

erikoavil paarththukko'ndu nin'ra theerkkatharisika'lin puththirar avanaik ka'ndavudanea, eliyaavin aavi elisaavinmeal i'rangkiyirukki'rathu en'ru solli, avanukku ethirko'ndupoayth tharaimattum kuninthu avanai va'nangki:

ithoa, umathu adiyaaroadea aimpathu palavaanka'l irukki'raarka'l; avarka'l poay ummudaiya ejamaanaith theadumpadi uththaravukodum; oruvea'lai karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avarai eduththu, parvathangka'lil on'rinmealaakilum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lil on'rilaakilum ko'ndupoay vaiththiruppaar en'raarka'l. atha'rku avan: avarka'lai anuppavea'ndaam en'raan.
avan saliththuppoakumattum avarka'l avanai alattikko'ndirunthapadiyaal anuppungka'l en'raan; appadiyea aimpathupearai anuppinaarka'l; avarka'l moon'runaa'l avanaith theadiyum kaa'naamal,
erikoaviliruntha avanidaththi'rkuth thirumpivanthapoathu, avan ivarka'laip paarththu: poakavea'ndaam en'ru naan ungka'lukkuch sollavillaiyaa en'raan.
pinpu anthap patta'naththin manushar elisaavai noakki: ithoa, engka'l aa'ndavan kaa'nki'rapadi inthap patta'nam kudiyiruppukku nallathu; tha'n'neeroa kettathu, nilamum paazhnilam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: oru puthuththoa'ndiyai eduththu, athilea uppuppoattuk ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; athai avanidaththil ko'nduvanthapoathu,
avan neeroot'ra'ndaikkup poay, uppai athilea poattu: inthath tha'n'neerai aaroakkiyamaakkinean; ini ithinaal saavum varaathu, nilappaazhum iraathu en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
elisaa sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea anthath tha'n'neer innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi aaroakkiyamaayit'ru.

avan avvidaththaivittup peththealukkup poanaan; avan vazhinadanthupoakaiyil pi'l'laika'l patta'naththilirunthu vanthu, avanaip paarththu: mottaiththalaiyaa ea'rippoa, mottaiththalaiyaa ea'rippoa en'ru solli ninthiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan thirumpi avarka'laip paarththu: karththarin naamaththilea avarka'laich sapiththaan; udanea kaattilirunthu ira'ndu karadika'l pu'rappattu vanthu, avarka'lil naa'rpaththira'ndu pi'l'laika'laip pee'rippoattathu.
avan avvidaththaivittuk karmeal parvathaththi'rkuppoay, angkeayirunthu samaariyaavukkuth thirumpinaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththin pathinettaam varushaththil aakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoaraam samaariyaavilea isravealinmeal raajaavaakip pannira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; aanaalum than thakappanaippoalum than thaayaippoalum alla; than thakappan pa'n'nuviththa paakaalin silaiyai akat'rivittaan.
en'raalum isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai avan vittu neengkaamal avaika'lilea sikkikko'ndirunthaan.
moavaapin raajaavaakiya measaa aadumaaduka'l peruththavanaayirunthu, isravealin raajaavukku iladcham aattukkuttika'laiyum, iladcham ku'rumpaattukkadaakka'laiyum seluththivanthaan.
aakaap i'ranthupoanapin moavaapin raajaa isravealin raajaavukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ninaan.
akkaalaththilea yoaraam ennum raajaa samaariyaavilirunthu pu'rappattu, isravealaiyellaam ilakkam paarththuppoay:

moavaapin raajaa enakku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ninaan; moavaapiyarmeal yuththampa'n'na, ennoadeakooda varuki'reeraa en'ru yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththaik keattanuppinatha'rku; avan naan varuki'rean; naanthaan neer, ennudaiya janangka'l ummudaiya janangka'l, ennudaiya kuthiraika'l ummudaiya kuthiraika'l en'raan.
entha vazhiyaayp poavoam en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avan: eathoam vanaantharavazhiyaay en'raan.

appadiyea isravealin raajaavum yoothaavin raajaavum eathoamin raajaavum searnthu poanaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l eazhunaa'l sut'riththirinthapoathu, avarka'laip pinselluki'ra iraa'nuvaththukkum mirukajeevanka'lukkum tha'n'neer illaama'rpoayit'ru.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa: aiyoa, intha moon'ru raajaakka'laiyum karththar moavaapiyarin kaiyil oppukkodukka varavazhaiththaarea en'raan.

appozhuthu yoasapaath: naam karththaridaththil visaarikkumpadi karththarudaiya theerkkatharisi oruvarum ingkea illaiyaa en'ru keattatha'rku, eliyaavin kaika'lukkuth tha'n'neer vaarththa saappaaththin kumaaranaakiya elisaa ingkea irukki'raan en'ru israveal raajaavin oozhiyakkaararil oruvan ma'rumozhiyaakach sonnaan.
appozhuthu yoasapaath avanai noakki: karththarudaiya vaarththai avanidaththil irukki'rathu en'raan; isravealin raajaavum yoasapaaththum eathoamin raajaavum avanidaththil poanaarka'l.

elisaa isravealin raajaavaip paarththu: enakkum umakkum enna? neer ummudaiya thakappanin theerkkatharisika'lidaththilum, ummudaiya thaayaarin theerkkatharisika'lidaththilum poam en'raan. atha'rku isravealin raajaa: appadiyalla, karththar intha moon'ru raajaakka'laiyum moavaapiyarin kaiyil oppukkodukki'ratha'rku varavazhaiththaar en'raan.

atha'rku elisaa: naan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththin mukaththaip paaraathirunthaal naan ummai noakkavumaattean, ummaip paarkkavumaattean en'ru seanaika'ludaiya karththarukku munni'rki'ra naan avarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
ippoathum oru surama'ndala vaaththiyakkaaranai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; surama'ndala vaaththiyakkaaran vanthu vaasiththapoathu karththarudaiya karam avanmeal i'rangki,
avan: karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, inthap pa'l'laththaakkilea engkum vaaykkaalka'lai vettungka'l.

neengka'l kaat'raiyum kaa'namaatteerka'l, mazhaiyaiyum kaa'namaatteerka'l; aanaalum neengka'lum ungka'l aadumaaduka'lum ungka'l mirukajeevanka'lum kudikkumpadikku, inthap pa'l'laththaakku tha'n'neeraal nirappappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithu karththarin paarvaikku a'rpakaariyam; moavaapiyaraiyum ungka'l kaiyilea oppukkoduppaar.

neengka'l sakala koattaika'laiyum sakala si'rantha patta'nangka'laiyum thakarththu, nalla marangka'laiyellaam vetti, neeroot'ruka'laiyellaam thoorththu, nalla nilaththaiyellaam kalmeaduka'laakkik keduppeerka'l en'raan.
ma'runaa'l kaalamea paliseluththappadum nearaththil, ithoa, tha'n'neer eathoam theasavazhiyaay vanthathinaal theasam tha'n'neeraal nirampit'ru.

thangka'loadu yuththampa'n'na raajaakka'l varuki'rathai moavaapiyarellaarum keattapoathu, avarka'l aayutham tharikkaththakka vayathu'l'lavarka'laiyum, atha'rku mealtharamaanavarka'l ellaaraiyum kootti azhaiththukko'nduvanthu ellaiyilea nin'raarka'l.
moavaapiyar athikaalamea ezhunthapoathu sooriyan tha'n'neerinmeal pirakaasiththathinaal anthath tha'n'neer avarka'lukku iraththampoal sivappaayk kaa'nappattathu.
athinaal avarka'l: ithu iraththam, antha raajaakka'l thangka'laith thaangka'lea oruvarai oruvar vettikko'ndu maa'ndupoanaarka'l; aathalaal moavaapiyarea, ko'l'laikku vaarungka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.

avarka'l isravealin paa'layaththi'rku vanthapoathoavenil, isravealar ezhumpi, moavaapiyaraith thangka'lukku munpaaka oadippoakaththakkathaay mu'riya adiththu, avarka'l theasaththi'rku'l pukunthu, angkeayum moavaapiyarai mu'riya adiththu,

patta'nangka'lai idiththu, sakala nalla nilaththilum kalle'rinthu nirappi, neeroot'ruka'laiyellaam thoorththu, nalla marangka'laiyellaam vettippoattaarka'l; kiraareaseaththileamaaththiram athin mathilka'l innum idipadaathirukki'rapoathu; kava'nkaarar athaich sut'rikko'ndu athaiyum seathamaakkinaarka'l.

yuththam mummuramaaki'rathen'ru moavaapiyarin raajaa ka'ndapoathu, avan eathoamin raajaavinmeal valumaiyaay vizhuki'ratha'rkup pattayam uruvuki'ra ezhunoo'rupearaik koottikko'ndupoanaan; aanaalum avarka'laalea koodaama'rpoayit'ru.

appozhuthu avan than sthaanaththil raajaavaakappoaki'ra than seashdapuththiranaip pidiththu, alangkaththinmeal avanaich sarvaangka thakanamaakap paliyittaan; appozhuthu isravealarmeal kadungkoapammoo'ndathinaal, avarka'l avanaivittup pu'rappattu, thangka'l theasaththi'rkuth thirumpivittaarka'l.

theerkkatharisika'ludaiya puththiraril oruvanukku manaiviyaayiruntha oru sthiree elisaavaip paarththu: umathu adiyaanaakiya en purushan i'ranthupoanaan; umathu adiyaan karththarukkup payanthu nadanthaan enpathai a'riveer; kadankoduththavan ippoathu en ira'ndu kumaararaiyum thanakku adimaika'laakkikko'l'la vanthaan en'raa'l.

elisaa ava'lai noakki: naan unakku ennaseyyavea'ndum? veettil unnidaththil enna irukki'rathu sol en'raan. atha'rku ava'l: oru kudam e'n'ney allaamal umathu adiyaa'ludaiya veettil vea'ron'rum illai en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avan: nee poay, unnudaiya ayalveettukkaarar ellaaridaththilum aneakam ve'rumpaaththirangka'laik keattuvaangki,
u'l'lea poay, un pi'l'laika'ludan u'l'lea nin'ru kathavaip pootti, anthap paaththirangka'l ellaavat'rilum vaarththu, ni'rainthathai oru pakkaththil vai en'raan.
ava'l avanidaththilirunthu poay, than pi'l'laika'ludan kathavaip poottikko'ndu, ivarka'l paaththirangka'lai ava'lidaththil kodukka, ava'l avaika'lil vaarththaa'l.

anthap paaththirangka'l ni'rainthapin, ava'l than makan oruvanai noakki: innum oru paaththiram ko'nduvaa en'raa'l. atha'rku avan: vea'rea paaththiram illai en'raan; appozhuthu e'n'ney nin'rupoayit'ru.

ava'l poay theavanudaiya manushanukku athai a'riviththaa'l. appozhuthu avan: nee poay antha e'n'neyai vit'ru, un kadanaith theerththu, meenthathaikko'ndu neeyum un pi'l'laika'lum jeevanampa'n'nungka'l en'raan.

pinpu orunaa'l elisaa sooneamukkup poayirukkumpoathu, angkeayiruntha kanamporunthiya oru sthiree avanaip poajanampa'n'na varunthikkeattukko'ndaa'l; appadiyea avan paya'nappattu varuki'rapoathellaam poajanampa'n'numpadi angkea vanthu thangkuvaan.
ava'l than purushanai noakki: ithoa, nammidaththil eppoathum vanthupoaki'ra theavanudaiya manushanaakiya ivar parisuththavaan en'ru kaa'nki'rean.

naam meththaiyinmeal oru si'riya a'raiveettaik katti, athil avarukku oru kattilaiyum, meajaiyaiyum, naa'rkaaliyaiyum, kuththuvi'lakkaiyum vaippoam; avar nammidaththil varumpoathu angkea thangkalaam en'raa'l.
orunaa'l avan angkea vanthu, antha a'raiveettilea thangki, angkea paduththukko'ndirunthaan.
avan than vealaikkaaranaakiya keayaasai noakki: inthach sooneamiyaa'lai azhaiththukko'nduvaa en'raan; ava'lai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan; ava'l avanukkumunpaaka nin'raa'l.

avan keayaasiyaip paarththu: ithoa, ippadippatta sakala salakkara'naiyoadum engka'lai visaariththu varuki'raayea, unakku naan enna seyyavea'ndum? raajaavinidaththilaavathu seanaapathiyinidaththilaavathu unakkaaka naan peasavea'ndiya kaariyam u'ndoa en'ru ava'laik kea'l en'raan. atha'rku ava'l: en janaththin naduvea naan sukamaayk kudiyirukki'rean en'raa'l.
ava'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'ru keayaasiyai avan keattatha'rku; avan, ava'lukkup pi'l'lai illai, ava'l purushanum periya vayathu'l'lavan en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: ava'laik kooppidu en'raan; ava'laik kooppittapoathu, ava'l vanthu vaasa'rpadiyilea nin'raa'l.

appozhuthu avan: oru piraa'na u'rpaththikaalaththittaththilea oru kumaaranai a'naiththukko'ndiruppaay en'raan. atha'rku ava'l: eathu? theavanudaiya manushanaakiya en aa'ndavanea, umathu adiyaa'lukku apaththam sollavea'ndaam en'raa'l.
antha sthiree karppanthariththu, elisaa thannoadea sonnapadi, oru u'rpaththikaalaththittaththil oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
anthap pi'l'lai va'larnthaan, orunaa'l avan a'ruppa'rukki'ravarka'lidaththiliruntha than thakappana'ndaikkup poayirukkumpoathu,
than thakappanaip paarththu: en thalai noaki'rathu, en thalai noaki'rathu en'raan; appozhuthu avan vealaikkaaranidaththil, ivanai ivan thaayinidaththil eduththukko'ndupoayvidu en'raan.
avanai eduththu, avan thaayinidaththil ko'ndupoanapoathu, avan maththiyaanamattum ava'l madiyil irunthu seththuppoanaan.
appozhuthu ava'l ea'rippoay, avanai theavanudaiya manushan kattilinmeal vaiththu, avan vaikkappatta a'raiyin kathavaip poottikko'ndupoay,

than purushanidaththil aa'l anuppi: naan seekkiramaay theavanudaiya manushan irukkum idamattum poayvarumpadikku, vealaikkaararil oruvanaiyum oru kazhuthaiyaiyum enakku anuppavea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.

appozhuthu avan: ithu amaavaasiyum alla oayvunaa'lum allavea; nee in'raikku avaridaththukkup poakavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru keadkachsonnaan. atha'rku ava'l: ellaam sarithaan, naan poakavea'ndiyirukki'rathu en'ru solliyanuppi,
kazhuthaiyinmeal sea'namvaiththu ea'ri, than vealaikkaaranai noakki: ithai oattikko'ndupoa; naan unakkuch sonnaal ozhiya poaki'ra vazhiyil engkum oattaththai ni'ruththaathea en'ru sollip pu'rappattu,

karmeal parvathaththilirukki'ra theavanudaiya manushanidaththi'rkup poanaa'l; theavanudaiya manushan thooraththilea ava'lai varakka'ndu, than vealaikkaaranaakiya keayaasiyaip paarththu: athoa sooneamiyaa'l varuki'raa'l.
nee ava'lukku ethirko'ndu oadi, nee sukamaayirukki'raayaa? un purushan sukamaayirukki'raanaa? anthap pi'l'lai sukamaayirukki'rathaa en'ru ava'lidaththil kea'l en'raan. ava'l: sukanthaan en'ru solli,

parvathaththilirukki'ra theavanudaiya manushanidaththil vanthu, avan kaalaip pidiththukko'ndaa'l; appozhuthu keayaasi ava'lai vilakkivida vanthaan; theavanudaiya manushan: ava'laith thadukkaathea; ava'l aaththumaa thukkamaayirukki'rathu; karththar athai enakku a'riviyaamal ma'raiththuvaiththaar en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l, naan en aa'ndavanidaththil oru kumaaranai vea'ndum en'ru keattathu'ndaa? enakku apaththam sollavea'ndaam en'ru naan sollavillaiyaa en'raa'l.

appozhuthu avan keayaasiyaip paarththu: nee un idaiyaik kattikko'ndu, en thadiyai un kaiyil pidiththukko'ndu, vazhiyil oruvanaich santhiththaalum avanai vinavaamalum, unnai oruvan vinavinaalum avanukku ma'rumozhi sollaamalum poay, en thadiyai anthap pi'l'laiyin mukaththinmeal vai en'raan.
pi'l'laiyin thaayoa: naan ummai viduki'rathillai en'ru karththarin jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyum ko'ndu solluki'rean en'raa'l; appozhuthu avan ezhunthirunthu ava'l pinnea poanaan.

keayaasi avarka'lukku munnea poay, anthath thadiyaip pi'l'laiyin mukaththinmeal vaiththaan; aanaalum saththamum illai, u'narchchiyum illai; aakaiyaal avan thirumpi avanukku ethirko'nduvanthu: pi'l'lai vizhikkavillai en'ru avanukku a'riviththaan.
elisaa veetti'rku'l vanthapoathu, ithoa, anthap pi'l'lai avan kattilinmeal seththukkidanthaan.
u'l'lea poayth thangka'l iruvarukkum pinnaaka avan kathavaip pootti, karththarai noakki vea'nduthal seythu,

kitteapoay, than vaay pi'l'laiyin vaayinmealum, than ka'nka'l avan ka'nka'linmealum, than u'l'langkaika'l avan u'l'langkaika'linmealum padumpadiyaaka avanmeal kuppu'rap paduththukko'ndaan; appozhuthu pi'l'laiyin udal analko'ndathu.
avan ezhunthu, a'raiveettil ingkum angkum ulaavi, thirumpak kittap poay avanmeal kuppu'rappaduththaan; appozhuthu anthap pi'l'lai eazhutharam thummith than ka'nka'laith thi'ranthaan.

appozhuthu avan: keayaasiyaik kooppittu, anthach sooneamiyaa'lai azhaiththukko'nduvaa en'raan; ava'lai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan; ava'l avanidaththil vanthapoathu; avan, un kumaaranai eduththukko'ndupoa en'raan.
appozhuthu ava'l u'l'lea poay, avan paathaththilea vizhunthu, tharaimattum pa'ninthu, than kumaaranai eduththukko'ndu ve'liyea poanaa'l.

elisaa kilkaalukkuth thirumpippoay irukkaiyil, theasaththilea pagncham u'ndaayit'ru; theerkkatharisika'lin puththirar, avanukku munpaaka udkaarnthirunthaarka'l; avan than vealaikkaaranai noakki: nee periya paanaiyai aduppilea vaiththuth theerkkatharisika'lin puththirarukkuk koozhkaaychchu en'raan.

oruvan keeraika'laip pa'rikka ve'liyilea poay, oru peaykkommattik kodiyaik ka'ndu, athan kaayka'lai madi ni'raiya a'ruththuvanthu, avaika'lai arinthu koozhppaanaiyilea poattaan; athu innathen'ru avarka'lukkuth theriyaathirunthathu.

saappida athai janangka'lukku vaarththaarka'l; avarka'l anthak koozhil eduththuch saappiduki'rapoathu, athaich saappidakkoodaamal: theavanudaiya manushanea, paanaiyil saavu irukki'rathu en'ru saththamittaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan, maavaik ko'nduvarachsolli, athaip paanaiyilea poattu, janangka'l saappidumpadi avarka'lukku vaar en'raan; appu'ram paanaiyilea thoasham illaama'rpoayit'ru.

pinpu paakaal saleeshaavilirunthu oru manushan theavanudaiya manushanukku mutha'rpalanaana vaa'rkoathumaiyin irupathu appangka'laiyum thaa'l kathirka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaan; appozhuthu avan: janangka'lukkuch saappidakkodu en'raan.

atha'rku avanudaiya pa'nividaikkaaran: ithai naan noo'rupearukku mun vaippathu eppadi en'raan. atha'rku avan: athai janangka'lukkuch saappidakkodu; saappittapi'rpaadu innum meethiyu'ndaayirukkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'lukku munpaaka athai vaiththaan; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea avarka'l saappittathuman'ri meethiyum irunthathu.

seeriya raajaavin padaiththalaivanaakiya naakamaan enpavan than aa'ndavanidaththil periya manushanum e'n'nikkaiyu'l'lavanumaayirunthaan; avanaik ko'ndu karththar seeriyaavukku iradchippaik katta'laiyittaar; makaa paraakkiramasaaliyaakiya avanoa kushdaroakiyaayirunthaan.

seeriyaavilirunthu tha'nduka'l pu'rappattu, israveal theasaththilirunthu oru si'ru pe'n'naich si'raipidiththukko'ndu vanthirunthaarka'l; ava'l naakamaanin manaivikkup pa'nividai seythuko'ndirunthaa'l.
ava'l than naachchiyaaraip paarththu: en aa'ndavan samaariyaavilirukki'ra theerkkatharisiyinidaththil poavaaraanaal nalamaayirukkum; avar ivarudaiya kushdaroakaththai neekkividuvaar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avan poay, israveal theasaththup pe'n inna inna pirakaaramaaych solluki'raa'l en'ru than aa'ndavanidaththil a'riviththaan.

appozhuthu seeriyaavin raajaa: nallathu poakalaam, isravealin raajaavukku nirupam tharuki'rean en'raan; appadiyea avan than kaiyilea paththuth thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, aa'raayiram seakkal ni'raiponnaiyum, paththu maat'ruvasthirangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndupoay,

isravealin raajaavidaththil antha nirupaththaik koduththaan. athilea: intha nirupaththai ummidaththil en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya naakamaan ko'nduvaruvaan; neer avan kushdaroakaththai neekki vida avanai ummidaththil anuppiyirukki'rean en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

isravealin raajaa antha nirupaththai vaasiththapoathu, avan than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: oru manushanai avan kushdaroakaththinin'ru neekki vidavea'ndum en'ru, avan ennidaththil nirupam anuppuki'ratha'rku, kollavum uyirppikkavum naan theavanaa? ivan ennai viroathikkach samayam theaduki'raan enpathaich sinthiththuppaarungka'l en'raan.

isravealin raajaa than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'nda seythiyaith theavanudaiya manushanaakiya elisaa keattapoathu, avan: neer ummudaiya vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'lvaanean? avan ennidaththil vanthu, isravealilea theerkkatharisi u'ndenpathai a'rinthuko'l'lattum en'ru raajaavukkuch solliyanuppinaan.
appadiyea naakamaan than kuthiraika'loadum than irathaththoadum vanthu elisaavin vaasa'rpadiyilea nin'raan.
appozhuthu elisaa: avanidaththil aa'l anuppi, nee poay, yoarthaanil eazhutharam snaanampa'n'nu; appozhuthu un maamsam maa'ri, nee suththamaavaay en'ru sollachsonnaan.

atha'rku naakamaan kadungkoapangko'ndu, pu'rappattuppoay: avan ve'liyea vanthu nin'ru, than theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthu, than kaiyinaal antha idaththaith thadavi, ivvithamaayk kushdaroakaththai neekkividuvaan en'ru enakku'l ninaiththirunthean.

naan snaanampa'n'nich suththamaaki'ratha'rku isravealin tha'n'neerka'l ellaavat'raippaarkkilum thamaskuvin nathika'laakiya aapnaavum parpaarum nallathallavoa en'ru solli, ukkiraththoadea thirumpippoanaan.

avan oozhiyakkaarar sameepaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: thakappanea, anthath theerkkatharisi oru periya kaariyaththaich seyya umakkuch solliyirunthaal athai neer seyveer allavaa? snaanampa'n'num, appozhuthu suththamaaveer en'ru avar ummoadea sollumpoathu, athaich seyyavea'ndiyathu eththanai athikam en'ru sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan i'rangki, theavanudaiya manushan vaarththaiyinpadiyea yoarthaanil eazhutharam muzhukinapoathu, avan maamsam oru si'rupi'l'laiyin maamsaththaippoala maa'ri, avan suththamaanaan.

appozhuthu avan than koottaththoadellaam theavanudaiya manushanidaththukkuth thirumpivanthu, avanukku munpaaka nin'ru: ithoa, isravealilirukki'ra theavanaiththavirap poomiyengkum vea'rea theavan illai enpathai a'rinthean; ippoathum umathu adiyean kaiyil oru kaa'nikkai vaangkikko'l'lavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku avan: naan vaangkuki'rathillai en'ru karththarukku munpaaka avarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan; vaangkavea'ndum en'ru avanai varunthinaalum thattuthal pa'n'nivittaan.

appozhuthu naakamaan: aanaalum ira'ndu koavea'ru kazhuthaika'l sumakkaththakka ira'ndu pothi ma'n umathu adiyeanukkuk katta'laiyidavea'ndum; umathu adiyean inik karththarukkea allaamal, anniya theavarka'lukkuch sarvaangka thakanaththaiyum paliyaiyum seluththuvathillai.

oru kaariyaththaiyea karththar umathu adiyeanukku mannippaaraaka; en aa'ndavan pa'ninthuko'l'la rimmoan koavilukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, naan avarukkuk kailaaku koduththu rimmoan koavililea pa'niyavea'ndiyathaakum; ippadi rimmoan koavilil naan pa'niyavea'ndiya inthak kaariyaththaik karththar umathu adiyeanukku mannippaaraaka en'raan.
atha'rku avan: samaathaanaththoadea poa en'raan; ivan pu'rappattuk kognchathooram poanapoathu,

theavanudaiya manushanaakiya elisaavin vealaikkaaran keayaasi enpavan, anthach seeriyanaakiya naakamaan ko'nduvanthathai en aa'ndavan avan kaiyilea vaangkaamal avanai vittuvittaar; naan avan pi'rakea oadi, avan kaiyilea eathaakilum vaangkuvean en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanmeal aa'naiyittu,
naakamaanaip pinthodarnthaan; avan than pi'rakea oadivaruki'rathai naakamaan ka'ndapoathu, avanukku ethirko'ndupoaka irathaththilirunthu kuthiththu: sukaseythiyaa en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: sukaseythithaan; theerkkatharisika'lin puththiraril ira'ndu vaalipar ippozhuthuthaan eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththilirunthu ennidaththil vanthaarka'l; avarka'lukku oru thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, ira'ndu maat'ruvasthirangka'laiyum tharavea'ndum en'ru keadka, en ejamaan ennai anuppinaar en'raan.

atha'rku naakamaan: thayavuseythu, ira'ndu thaalanthai vaangkikko'l en'ru solli, avanai varunthi, ira'ndu thaalanthu ve'l'liyai ira'ndu paika'lil ira'ndu maat'ru vasthirangka'loadea katti, avanukku munpaakach sumanthupoaka, than vealaikkaararaana ira'ndu pearmeal vaiththaan.
avan meatta'ndaikku vanthapoathu, avan athai avarka'l kaiyilirunthu vaangki, veettilea vaiththu, antha manusharai anuppivittaan; avarka'l poayvittaarka'l.
pinpu avan u'l'lea poayth than ejamaanukku munpaaka nin'raan; keayaasiyea, engkeayirunthu vanthaay en'ru elisaa avanaik keattatha'rku, avan: umathu adiyaan engkum poakavillai en'raan.

appozhuthu avan ivanaip paarththu: antha manushan unakku ethirko'nduvarath than irathaththilirunthu i'rangkith thirumpuki'rapoathu en manam unnudankoodach sellavillaiyaa? pa'naththai vaangkuki'ratha'rkum, vasthirangka'laiyum olivaththoappuka'laiyum thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum aadumaaduka'laiyum vealaikkaararaiyum vealaikkaarika'laiyum vaangkuki'ratha'rkum ithu kaalamaa?

aakaiyaal naakamaanin kushdaroakam unnaiyum un santhathiyaaraiyum en'raikkum pidiththirukkum en'raan; udanea avan u'raintha mazhai ni'ramaana kushdaroakiyaaki, avan samukaththai vittup pu'rappattuppoanaan.
theerkkatharisika'lin puththirar elisaavai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l ummudan kudiyirukki'ra intha idam engka'lukku nerukkamaay irukki'rathu.
naangka'l yoarthaanmattum poay avvidaththil ovvoruvarum ovvoru uththiraththai vetti, kudiyirukka angkea engka'lukku oru idaththai u'ndaakkuvoam en'raarka'l. atha'rku avan: poangka'l en'raan.
avarka'lil oruvan: neer thayavu seythu umathu adiyaaroadeakooda varavea'ndum en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan varuki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'loadeakoodap poanaan; avarka'l yoarthaan nathiyarukea vanthapoathu marangka'lai vettinaarka'l.
oruvan oru uththiraththai vetti vizhuththukaiyil koadari tha'n'neeril vizhunthathu; avan: aiyoa en aa'ndavanea, athu iravalaaka vaangkappattathea en'ru koovinaan.
theavanudaiya manushan athu engkea vizhunthathu en'ru keattaan; avan antha idaththaik kaa'npiththapoathu, oru kompai vetti, athai angkea e'rinthu, antha irumpai mithakkappa'n'ni,
athai eduththukko'l en'raan; appadiyea avan than kaiyai neetti athai eduththukko'ndaan.
akkaalaththil seeriyaavin raajaa isravealukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'ni, inna inna sthalaththilea paa'layami'rangkuvean en'ru than oozhiyakkaararoadea aaloasanaipa'n'ninaan.
aakilum theavanudaiya manushan isravealin raajaavinidaththil aa'l anuppi: inna idaththukkup poakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirum; seeriyar angkea i'rangkuvaarka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa theavanudaiya manushan thannai echchariththu, thanakkuk ku'riththuchsonna sthalaththi'rku manusharai anuppippaarththu echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, ippadi aneakantharam thannaik kaaththukko'ndaan.

inthak kaariyaththinimiththam seeriya raajaavin iruthayam kuzhampi, avan than oozhiyakkaararai azhaiththu: nammudaiyavarka'lil isravealin raajaavukku u'lavaayirukki'ravan yaar en'ru neengka'l enakku a'rivikkamaatteerka'laa en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu avan oozhiyakkaararil oruvan: appadiyillai; en aa'ndavanaakiya raajaavea, neer ummudaiya pa'l'li a'raiyilea peasuki'ra vaarththaika'laiyum isravealilirukki'ra theerkkatharisiyaakiya elisaa isravealin raajaavukku a'rivippaan en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: naan manusharai anuppi avanaip pidikkumpadi, neengka'l poay avan engkea irukki'raan en'ru paarungka'l en'raan; avan thoaththaanil irukki'raan en'ru avanukku a'rivikkappattathu.
appozhuthu avan angkea kuthiraika'laiyum irathangka'laiyum palaththa iraa'nuvaththaiyum anuppinaan; avarka'l iraakkaalaththilea vanthu patta'naththai va'lainthuko'ndaarka'l.

theavanudaiya manushanin vealaikkaaran athikaalamea ezhunthu ve'liyea pu'rappadukaiyil, ithoa, iraa'nuvamum kuthiraika'lum irathangka'lum patta'naththaich sut'rikko'ndirukkak ka'ndaan; appozhuthu vealaikkaaran avanai noakki: aiyoa, en aa'ndavanea, ennaseyvoam en'raan.
atha'rku avan: payappadaathea; avarka'loadirukki'ravarka'laippaarkkilum nammoadirukki'ravarka'l athikam en'raan.

appozhuthu elisaa vi'n'nappampa'n'ni: karththaavea, ivan paarkkumpadi ivan ka'nka'laith thi'rantharu'lum en'raan; udanea karththar antha vealaikkaaran ka'nka'laith thi'ranthaar; ithoa, elisaavaichsut'rilum akkinimayamaana kuthiraika'laalum irathangka'laalum antha malai ni'rainthirukki'rathai avan ka'ndaan.

avarka'l avanidaththil varukaiyil, elisaa karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni: intha janangka'lukkuk ka'nmayakkam u'ndaakumpadi seyyum en'raan; elisaavudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea avarka'lukkuk ka'nmayakkam u'ndaakumpadi seythaar.

appozhuthu elisaa avarka'lai noakki: ithu vazhi alla; ithu patta'namum alla; en pi'rakea vaarungka'l; neengka'l theaduki'ra manushanidaththil naan ungka'lai vazhinadaththuvean en'ru solli, avarka'laich samaariyaavukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.

avarka'l samaariyaavil vanthapoathu, elisaa: karththaavea, ivarka'l paarkkumpadikku ivarka'l ka'nka'laith thi'rantharu'lum en'raan; paarkkumpadikkuk karththar avarka'l ka'nka'laith thi'rakkumpoathu, ithoa, avarka'l samaariyaavin naduvea irunthaarka'l.
isravealin raajaa avarka'laik ka'ndapoathu, elisaavaip paarththu: en thakappanea, naan avarka'lai vettippoadalaamaa en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: neer vettavea'ndaam; neer ummudaiya pattayaththaalum, ummudaiya villinaalum si'raiyaakkik ko'ndavarka'lai vettuki'reeroa? ivarka'l pusiththuk kudiththu, thangka'l aa'ndavanidaththukkup poakumpadikku, appamum tha'n'neerum avarka'lukkethiril vaiyum en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'lukkup periya virunthupa'n'ni, avarka'l pusiththuk kudiththapinpu, avarka'lai anuppivittaan; avarka'l thangka'l aa'ndavanidaththukkup poayvittaarka'l; seeriyarin tha'nduka'l israveal theasaththilea appu'ram varavillai.
itha'rkuppinpu seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya penaathaath than iraa'nuvaththaiyellaam koottikko'nduvanthu samaariyaavai mut'rikkaipoattaan.

athinaal samaariyaavilea kodiya pagnchamu'ndaayit'ru; oru kazhuthaith thalai e'npathu ve'l'likkaasukkum, pu'raakka'lukkup poaduki'ra kaa'rpadi paya'ru ainthu ve'l'likkaasukkum vi'rkappadumattum athai mut'rikkaipoattaarka'l.
isravealin raajaa alangkaththinmeal nadanthupoakaiyil, oru sthiree avanaippaarththuk kooppittu, raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, iradchiyum en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: karththar unnai iradchikkaathirunthaal naan ethilirunthu eduththu unnai iradchikkalaam? ka'lagnchiyaththilirunthaa, aalaiyilirunthaa en'ru solli,

raajaa pinnaiyum ava'laip paarththu: unakku ennavea'ndum en'ru keattaan. atha'rku ava'l: intha sthiree ennai noakki: un makanaith thaa, avanai in'ru thinpoam; naa'laikku en makanaith thinpoam en'raa'l.
appadiyea en makanai aakkith thin'roam; ma'runaa'lil naan iva'lai noakki: naam un makanaith thinna avanaith thaa en'rean; ava'l than makanai o'liththuvittaa'l en'raa'l.

antha sthireeyin vaarththaika'lai raajaa keattavudanea, alangkaththinmeal nadanthupoaki'ra avan than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndaan; avan u'l'lea than sareeraththinmeal irattu uduththiyirukki'rathai janangka'l ka'ndaarka'l.
avan: saappaaththin kumaaranaakiya elisaavin thalai in'raikku avanmeal irunthaal, theavan atha'rkuch sariyaakavum atha'rku athikamaakavum enakkuch seyyakkadavar en'ru sonnaan.

elisaa than veettil udkaarnthirunthaan; moopparum avanoadu udkaarnthirunthaarka'l. appozhuthu raajaa: oru manushanaith thanakku munnea anuppinaan; intha aa'l elisaavinidaththukku varumunnea, avan antha moopparai noakki: en thalaiyai vaangka, anthak kolaipaathakanudaiya makan aa'l anuppinaan; paarththeerka'laa? antha aa'l varumpoathu, neengka'l avanai u'l'lea varavottaamal kathavaip poottippoadungka'l; avanukkup pinnaaka avan aa'ndavanudaiya kaalin saththam keadki'rathu allavaa en'raan.

avarka'loadea avan peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, antha aa'l avanidaththil vanthu: ithoa, inthap pollaappuk karththaraal u'ndaanathu; naan inik karththarukkaakak kaaththirukka vea'ndiyathu enna en'ru raajaa solluki'raar en'raan.

appozhuthu elisaa: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; naa'lai innearaththil samaariyaavin vaasalilea oru marakkaal koathumai maa oru seakkalukkum, ira'ndu marakkaal vaa'rkoathumai oru seakkalukkum vi'rkappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaavukkuk kailaaku kodukki'ra pirathaani oruvan theavanudaiya manushanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, karththar vaanaththilea mathakuka'lai u'ndaakkinaalum ippadi nadakkumaa en'raan. atha'rku avan: unnudaiya ka'nka'linaalea athaik kaa'npaay; aanaalum athilea saappidamaattaay en'raan.
kushdaroakika'laana naalupear olimukavaasalil irunthaarka'l; avarka'l oruvarai oruvar noakki: naam ingkea irunthu saakavea'ndiyathu enna?

patta'naththi'rku'l poavoamen'raalum patta'naththil pagncham u'ndaayirukki'rathinaal angkea saavoam; naam ingkea irunthaalum saavoam; aakaiyaal ippozhuthu seeriyarudaiya iraa'nuvaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungka'l; avarka'l nammai uyiroadea vaiththaal pizhaikki'roam; nammaik kon'raal saaki'roam en'ru solli,
seeriyarudaiya iraa'nuvaththi'rkuppoaka iruttoadea ezhunthirunthu, seeriyarudaiya paa'layaththin munna'niyil vanthaarka'l; angkea oruvarumillai.

aa'ndavar seeriyarin iraa'nuvaththi'rku irathangka'lin iraichchalaiyum, kuthiraika'lin iraichchalaiyum, makaa iraa'nuvaththin iraichchalaiyum keadkappa'n'ninathinaal, avarka'l oruvarai oruvar noakki: ithoa, nammidaththil poarukku vara, isravealin raajaa eaththiyarin raajaakka'laiyum ekipthiyarin raajaakka'laiyum namakku viroathamaakak kooli poruththinaan en'ru solli,

iruttoadea ezhunthirunthu oadippoay, thangka'l koodaarangka'laiyum thangka'l kuthiraika'laiyum thangka'l kazhuthaika'laiyum thangka'l paa'layaththaiyum avaika'l iruntha pirakaaramaaka vittu, thangka'l piraa'nanmaaththiram thappumpadi oadippoanaarka'l.

anthak kushdaroakika'l paa'layaththin munna'nimattum vanthapoathu, oru koodaaraththi'rku'l piraveasiththup pusiththuk kudiththu, athilirunthu ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum vasthirangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndupoay o'liththuvaiththu, thirumpivanthu, vea'roru koodaaraththi'rku'l piraveasiththu, athilirunthum appadiyea eduththukko'ndupoay o'liththuvaiththu,
