pinpu avarka'l oruvarai oruvar noakki: naam seyki'rathu niyaayamalla, innaa'l na'rseythi a'rivikkum naa'l; naam mavunamaayirunthu, pozhuthu vidiyumattum kaaththirunthaal kut'ram nammeal sumarum; ippoathum naam poay raajaavin aramanaiyaarukku ithai a'rivippoam vaarungka'l en'raarka'l.

appadiyea avarka'l vanthu, patta'naththu vaasal kaavalaa'lanai noakkik kooppittu: naangka'l seeriyarin paa'layaththi'rkup poayvanthoam; angkea oruvarum illai, oru manushanudaiya saththamum illai, kattiyirukki'ra kuthiraika'lum kattiyirukki'ra kazhuthaika'lum, koodaarangka'lum irunthapirakaaram irukki'rathu en'ru avarka'lukkuch sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu avan vaasalkaakki'ra mat'ravarka'laik kooppittaan; avarka'l u'l'lea poay raajaavin aramanaiyaarukku athai a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu iraajaa iraaththiriyil ezhunthu, than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: seeriyar namakkuch seyki'ra kaariyaththai ungka'lukkuth theriyappaduththuki'rean; naam pattiniyaayirukki'roam en'ru avarka'l a'rivaarka'l; aakaiyaal naam patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoanaal nammai uyiroadea pidiththukko'ndu patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkalaam en'ru e'n'ni, avarka'l paa'layaththai vittup pu'rappattu ve'liyil o'liththukko'ndirukki'raarka'l en'raan.

avan oozhiyakkaararil oruvan pirathiyuththaramaaka: ingkea meethiyaana kuthiraika'lil ainthu kuthiraika'laik ko'ndupoaka uththaravu kodum; ithoa, ingkea meethiyaana isravealin sakala earaa'laththilum, maa'ndupoana isravealin sakala koottaththilum, avaika'l maaththiram meenthirukki'rathu; avaika'lai naam anuppippaarppoam en'raan.
appadiyea ira'ndu irathak kuthiraika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l; raajaa poay vaarungka'l en'ru solli, seeriyarin iraa'nuvaththaith thodarnthupoakumpadi anuppinaan.

avarka'l yoarthaanmattum avarka'laip pinthodarnthupoanaarka'l; seeriyar theeviriththu oadukaiyil, avarka'l e'rinthupoatta vasthirangka'laalum thattumuttuka'laalum vazhiyellaam ni'rainthirunthathu; anuppappattavarka'l thirumpivanthu raajaavukku athai a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu janangka'l pu'rappattu, seeriyarin paa'layaththaik ko'l'laiyittaarka'l; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, oru marakkaal koathumai maa oru seakkalukkum, ira'ndu marakkaal vaa'rkoathumai oru seakkalukkum vi'rkappattathu.

raajaa thanakkuk kailaakukodukki'ra anthap pirathaaniyai olimukavaasalil visaarippaayirukkak katta'laiyittirunthaan; olimukavaasalilea janangka'l avanai nerungki mithiththathinaalea, raajaa theavanudaiya manushanidaththil vanthapoathu solliyirunthapadiyea, avan seththuppoanaan.

ira'ndu marakkaal vaa'rkoathumai oru seakkalukkum, oru marakkaal koathumai maa oru seakkalukkum, naa'lai innearaththilea samaariyaavin olimukavaasalil vi'rkum en'ru theavanudaiya manushan raajaavoadea sonnathinpadiyea nadanthathu.

atha'rku anthap pirathaani theavanudaiya manushanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, karththar vaanaththilea mathakuka'lai u'ndaakkinaalum, intha vaarththaiyinpadi nadakkumaa en'ru solla; ivan, ithoa, unnudaiya ka'nka'linaalea athaik kaa'npaay, aanaalum athilea saappidamaattaay en'raanea.
anthap pirakaaramaakaththaanea avanukku nadanthathu; olimukavaasalilea janangka'l avanai nerungki mithiththathinaalea avan seththuppoanaan.

elisaa thaan uyirppiththa pi'l'laiyin thaayaakiya sthireeyai noakki: nee un veettaaroadungkooda ezhunthu pu'rappattuppoay engkeayaakilum sagnchari; karththar pagnchaththai varuvippaar; athu eazhuvarusham theasaththil irukkum en'ru solliyirunthaan.
antha sthiree ezhunthu, theavanudaiya manushan sonna vaarththaiyinpadi seythu, than veettaaroadungkoodap pu'rappattu, pelistharin theasaththil poay, eazhuvarusham sagnchariththaa'l.
eazhuvarusham sen'rapinpu, ava'l pelistharin theasaththai vittuth thirumpa vanthu, than veettukkaakavum than vayalukkaakavum raajaavinidaththil mu'raiyidumpadi poanaa'l.
annearaththil raajaa, theavanudaiya manushanin vealaikkaaranaayiruntha keayaasiyudanea peasi: elisaa seytha athisayangka'laiyellaam nee enakku vivaramaaych sol en'raan.

seththuppoanavanai uyirppiththaar enpathai avan raajaavukku a'rivikki'rapoathu, ithoa, avan uyirppiththa pi'l'laiyin thaayaakiya antha sthiree vanthu, than veettukkaakavum than vayalukkaakavum raajaavinidaththil mu'raiyittaa'l; appozhuthu keayaasi: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, iva'lthaan antha sthiree; elisaa uyirppiththa iva'ludaiya kumaaran ivanthaan en'raan.

raajaa antha sthireeyaik keattatha'rku, ava'l: athai avanukku vivariththuch sonnaa'l; appozhuthu raajaa ava'lukku oru pirathaaniyai niyamiththu, ava'lukku u'ndaanathu ellaavat'raiyum, ava'l theasaththai vittuppoana naa'lmuthal ithuvaraikkum u'ndaana antha vayalin varumaanam anaiththaiyum ava'lukkuk kidaikkumpadi sey en'raan.
seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya penaathaath viyaathiyaayirunthaan; elisaa thamaskuvukku vanthaan; theavanudaiya manushan ivvidaththil vanthirukki'raan en'ru avanukku a'rivikkappattapoathu,

raajaa aasakealai noakki: nee un kaiyilea oru kaa'nikkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, theavanudaiya manushanukku ethirko'ndupoay, naan intha viyaathi neengkip pizhaippeanaa en'ru avanaikko'ndu karththaridaththil visaarikkach sonnaan.

aasakeal thamaskuvin sakala uchchithangka'lilum naa'rpathu ottakangka'lin sumaiyaana kaa'nikkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, avanukku ethirko'ndu poay, avanukku munpaaka nin'ru, seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya penaathaath ennum ummudaiya kumaaran ennai ummidaththil anuppi, intha viyaathi neengkip pizhaippeanaa en'ru keadkachsonnaar en'raan.
elisaa avanai noakki: nee poay, viyaathi neengkip pizhaippeer en'ru avanukkuch sollum; aanaalum avan saakavea saavaan enpathaik karththar enakkuk kaa'npiththaar en'raan.
pinpu theavanudaiya manushan: than mukaththaith thiruppaamal avan saliththuppoakumattum avanai noakkikko'ndea azhuthaan.

appozhuthu aasakeal: en aa'ndavan azhuki'rathu enna en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avan: nee israveal puththirarukkuch seyyum theengkai naan a'rinthirukki'rapadiyinaal azhuki'rean; nee avarka'l koattaika'lai akkinikku iraiyaakki, avarka'l vaaliparaip pattayaththaal kon'ru, avarka'l kuzhanthaika'laith tharaiyoadea moathi, avarka'l karppavathika'laik kee'rippoaduvaay en'raan.

appozhuthu aasakeal: iththanai periya kaariyaththaich seyya naayaakiya umathu adiyaan emmaaththiram en'raan. atha'rku elisaa: nee seeriyaavinmeal raajaavaavaay enpathaik karththar enakkuth theriviththaar en'raan.

ivan elisaavaivittup pu'rappattu, than aa'ndavanidaththil vanthapoathu, avan: elisaa unakku enna sonnaan en'ru keattatha'rku; ivan neer viyaathi neengkip pizhaippeer en'ru enakkuch sonnaan en'ru solli,
ma'runaa'lilea oru samukkaa'laththai eduththu, tha'n'neerilea thoayththu avan mukaththinmeal viriththaan; athinaal avan seththuppoanaan; aasakeal avanukkup pathilaay raajaavaanaan.

isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapin kumaaran yoaraamudaiya ainthaam varushaththil, yoasapaath yoothaavilea innum raajaavaayirukkaiyil, yoasapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yoaraam ennum yoothaavin raajaa raajyapaarampa'n'nath thuvakkinaan.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu muppaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, ettu varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan.

avan israveal raajaakka'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, aakaapin veettaar seythathupoalach seythaan; aakaapin kumaaraththi avanukku manaiviyaayirunthaa'l; avan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

karththar: un kumaararukku'l'lea ennaa'lum oru vi'lakkai unakkuk katta'laiyiduvean en'ru thammudaiya thaasanaakiya thaaveethukkuch sonnathinpadiyea, avanimiththam avar yoothaavai mut'rilum kedukkavillai.
avan naadka'lil yoothaavudaiya kaiyinkeezhiruntha eathoamiyar kalakampa'n'ni, thangka'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththikko'ndaarka'l.

athinaalea yoaraam sakala irathangka'loadungkoodach saayeerukkup pu'rappattuppoanaan; avan iraaththiriyil ezhunthirunthu, thannai va'lainthuko'nda eathoamiyaraiyum irathangka'lin thalaivaraiyum mu'riya adiththapoathu, janangka'l thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.
appadiyea yoothaavudaiya kaiyin keezhiruntha eathoamiyar, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rathupoala, kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l; akkaalaththilthaanea lipnaa patta'naththaarum kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoaraamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoaraam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, than pithaakka'lidaththilea thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avanukkup pathilaaka avan kumaaranaakiya akasiyaa raajaavaanaan.
isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaapin kumaaran yoaraamudaiya pannira'ndaam varushaththilea, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoaraamin kumaaran akasiyaa raajaavaanaan.

akasiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu, irupaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, orea varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; isravealin raajaavaakiya omriyin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayin pear aththaaliyaa'l.
avan aakaapudaiya veettaarin vazhiyea nadanthu, aakaapin veettaaraippoal karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; avan aakaap veettaaroadea sampanthangkalanthirunthaan.
avan aakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoaraamoadea koodak keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rkuch seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealoadu yuththampa'n'nappoanaan; seeriyar yoaraamaik kaayappaduththinaarka'l.

raajaavaakiya yoaraam thaan seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealoadu yuththampa'n'nukaiyil, seeriyar raamaavilea thannai vettina kaayangka'lai aat'rikko'l'la yesrayealukkup poayirunthaan; aakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoaraam viyaathiyaayirunthapadiyinaal, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoaraamin kumaaran akasiyaa yesrayealil irukki'ra avanaip paarkki'ratha'rkup poanaan.

appozhuthu theerkkatharisiyaakiya elisaa theerkkatharisika'lin puththiraril oruvanai azhaiththu: nee idaikattikko'ndu, inthath thailakkuppiyai un kaiyil eduththukko'ndu, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rkup poa.

nee angkea searnthapoathu, nimsiyin makanaana yoasapaaththin kumaaran yekoo engkea irukki'raan en'ru paarththu, angkea udpiraveasiththu, avanaith than sakoathararin naduvilirunthu ezhunthirukkappa'n'ni, avanai u'l'laana oru a'raiyilea azhaiththukko'ndupoay,

thailakkuppiyai eduththu, avan thalaiyinmeal vaarththu: unnai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru solli, kathavaith thi'ranthu thaamathiyaamal oadippoa en'raan.
appadiyea theerkkatharisiyin oozhiyakkaaranaakiya antha vaalipan keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rkup poanaan.

avan udpiraveasiththapoathu, seanaapathika'l angkea udkaarnthirunthaarka'l; appozhuthu avan: seanaapathiyea, umakkuch sollavea'ndiya oru vaarththai u'ndu en'raan. atha'rku yekoo: engka'lellaarukku'l'lum yaarukku en'ru keattatha'rku, avan, seanaapathiyaakiya umakkuththaan en'raan.

avan ezhunthu, a'raiveetti'rku'l piraveasiththaan; avan anthath thailaththai avan thalaiyinmeal vaarththu, avanai noakki: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, unnaik karththarudaiya janamaakiya isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninean.

naan en oozhiyakkaararaakiya theerkkatharisika'lin iraththappazhiyaiyum, karththarudaiya sakala oozhiyakkaararin iraththappazhiyaiyum, yeasapealin kaiyilea vaangkumpadikku nee un aa'ndavanaakiya aakaapin kudumpaththai azhiththuvidakkadavaay.
aakaapin kudumpamellaam azhiyumpadikku, naan aakaapukkuch suvaril neervidum oru naay muthalaay iraathapadikku, isravealilea avanudaiyavarka'lil adaipattavanaiyum vidupattavanaiyum karuva'ruththu,
aakaapin kudumpaththai neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin kudumpaththukkum, akiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paashaavin kudumpaththukkum sariyaakkuvean.
yeasapealai yesrayealin nilaththilea naayka'l thin'ruvidum; ava'lai adakkampa'n'nuki'ravan illaiyenki'raar en'ru solli, kathavaith thi'ranthu oadippoanaan.

yekoo than aa'ndavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararidaththukkuth thirumpivanthapoathu, avarka'l avanai noakki: sukaseythiyaa? anthap payiththiyakkaaran unnidaththil vanthathu enna en'ru keattaarka'l. atha'rku avan: antha manushanaiyum, avan sonna kaariyaththaiyum neengka'l a'riveerka'l en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l: athu poy, athai engka'lukkuch sollum en'raarka'l. appozhuthu avan: naan unnai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru inna inna pirakaaramaaka ennidaththil sonnaan en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l theeviramaay avaravar thangka'l vasthiraththaip padika'lin uyaraththil avan keezhea viriththu, ekkaa'lam oothi: yekoo raajaavaanaan en'raarka'l.

appadiyea nimsiyin makanaakiya yoasapaaththin kumaaran yekoo enpavan yoaraamukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadu pa'n'ninaan; yoaraamoa isravealar ellaaroadungkoodak keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththilea seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealinimiththam kaaval vaiththuvaiththaan.

aanaalum seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealoadea pa'n'nina yuththaththilea, seeriyar thannai vettina kaayangka'lai yesrayealilea aat'rikko'l'luki'ratha'rku, raajaavaakiya yoaraam thirumpippoayirunthaan. yekoo enpavan: ithu ungka'lukkuch sammathiyaayirunthaal yesrayealil ithai a'rivikki'ratha'rku oruvarum patta'naththilirunthu thappippoakumpadi vidaathirungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu yekoo irathaththinmeal ea'ri, yesrayealukku nearaakap poanaan, yoaraam angkea viyaathiyaayk kidanthaan; yoaraamaippaarkka, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya akasiyaavum angkea vanthirunthaan.

yesrayealil koapuraththinmeal ni'rki'ra jaamakkaaran, yekoovin koottam varuki'rathaik ka'ndu: oru koottaththaik kaa'nki'rean en'raan. appozhuthu yoaraam: nee oru kuthiraiveeranaik kooppittu, avarka'lukku ethiraaka anuppich samaathaanamaa en'ru keadkachsol en'raan.

anthak kuthiraiveeran: avanukku ethirko'ndupoay, samaathaanamaa en'ru raajaa keadkachsonnaar en'raan. atha'rku yekoo: samaathaanaththaippat'ri unakku enna? en pi'rakea thirumpivaa en'raan. appozhuthu jaamakkaaran: anuppappattavan avarka'l irukkum idamattum poanapoathilum thirumpi varavillai en'raan.

aakaiyaal vea'roru kuthiraiveeranai anuppinaan, avan avarka'lidaththil poay: samaathaanamaa en'ru raajaa keadkachsonnaar en'raan. atha'rku yekoo: samaathaanaththaippat'ri unakku enna? en pi'rakea thirumpivaa en'raan.

appozhuthu jaamakkaaran: avan avarka'l irukkum idamattum poanapoathilum thirumpivaravillai en'rum, oattuki'rathu nimsiyin kumaaranaakiya yekoo oattuki'rathupoala irukki'rathu; athiveakamaay oattuki'raan en'rum sonnaan.

appozhuthu yoaraam: irathaththai aayaththappaduththu en'raan; avanudaiya irathaththai aayaththappaduththinapoathu, isravealin raajaavaakiya yoaraamum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya akasiyaavum avanavan than than irathaththil ea'ri yekoovukku nearaakap pu'rappattu, yesrayealiyanaakiya naapoaththin nilaththilea avanukku ethirppattaarka'l.

yoaraam yekoovaik ka'ndavudanea: yekoovea, samaathaanamaa en'raan. atha'rku yekoo: un thaayaakiya yeasapealin veasiththanangka'lum ava'ludaiya pillisooniyangka'lum, iththanai earaa'lamaayirukkaiyil samaathaanam eathu en'raan.
appozhuthu yoaraam than irathaththaith thiruppikko'ndu oadippoay, akasiyaavai noakki: akasiyaavea, ithu sathi en'raan.
yekoo than kaiyaal villai naa'neat'ri, ampu yoaraamudaiya negnchil uruvip pu'rappadaththakkathaay, avanai avan puyangka'lin naduvea eythaan; athinaal avan than irathaththilea suru'ndu vizhunthaan.

appozhuthu yekoo, than seanaapathiyaakiya pithkaarai noakki: avanai eduththu, yesrayealiyanaakiya naapoaththin vayalnilaththil e'rinthupoadu; naanum neeyum oru soadaay avan thakappanaakiya aakaapin pi'rakea kuthirai ea'ri varuki'rapoathu, karththar intha aakkinaiyai avanmeal sumaththinaar enpathai ninaiththukko'l.

neat'ru naapoaththin iraththaththaiyum, avan kumaararin iraththaththaiyum ka'ndean allavaa en'rum, intha nilaththil unakku neethiyaich sarikkattuvean en'rum appozhuthu karththar sonnaarea; ippoathum avanai eduththu, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea intha nilaththil e'rinthupoadu en'raan.

ithai yoothaavin raajaavaakiya akasiyaa ka'ndu, thoattaththin veettuvazhiyaay oadippoanaan; yekoo avanaip pinthodarnthu: avanaiyum irathaththilea vettippoadungka'l en'raan; avarka'l ipleayaam kitta irukki'ra koormalaiyinmeal ea'ruki'ra vazhiyilea appadich seythaarka'l; avan mekithoavukku oadippoay angkea seththuppoanaan.
avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanai irathaththinmeal erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoay, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil avan pithaakka'loadu avanudaiya kalla'raiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
intha akasiyaa, aakaapudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoaraamin pathinoaraam varushaththil yoothaavinmeal raajaavaanaan.
yekoo yesrayealukku vanthaan; athai yeasapeal keattapoathu, than ka'nka'lukku maiyittu, than thalaiyaich singkaariththukko'ndu, jannalvazhiyaay ettippaarththu,
yekoo olimukavaasalil vanthapoathu, ava'l: than aa'ndavanaik kon'ra simri sheamam adainthaanaa en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avan than mukaththai antha jannalukku nearaaka ea'reduththu: en padchaththil irukki'rathu yaar? yaar? en'ru keattatha'rku, ira'ndu moon'ru pirathaanika'l avanai ettippaarththaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: ava'laik keezhea tha'l'lungka'l en'raan; appadiyea ava'laik keezhea tha'l'linathinaal, ava'ludaiya iraththam suvarilum kuthiraika'lilum the'riththathu; avan ava'lai mithiththukko'ndu,
u'l'lea poay, pusiththuk kudiththa pinpu: neengka'l poaych sapikkappatta antha sthireeyaip paarththu, ava'lai adakkampa'n'nungka'l; ava'l oru raajakumaaraththi en'raan.
avarka'l ava'lai adakkampa'n'nappoaki'rapoathu, ava'ludaiya thalaiyoattaiyum kaalka'laiyum u'l'langkaika'laiyumea allaamal vea'ron'raiyum kaa'navillai.

aakaiyaal avarka'l thirumpavanthu avanukku a'riviththaarka'l; appozhuthu avan: ithu karththar thispiyanaakiya eliyaa ennum thammudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaikko'ndu sonna vaarththai; yesrayealin nilaththilea naayka'l yeasapealin maamsaththaith thinnum en'rum,
innathu yeasapealen'ru sollakkoodaathapadikku, yeasapealin pireatham yesrayealin nilaththilea vayalve'liyinmeal poadum eruvaippoal aakum en'rum sonnaarea en'raan.

aakaapukkuch samaariyaavilea ezhupathu kumaarar irunthapadiyinaal, yekoo samaariyaavilirukki'ra yesrayealin pirapukka'laakiya moopparidaththukkum, aakaapudaiya pi'l'laika'lai va'larkki'ravarka'lidaththukkum nirupangka'lai ezhuthiyanuppinaan.
athil: ungka'l aa'ndavanudaiya kumaararka'l ungka'loadirukki'raarka'lea; irathangka'lum, kuthiraika'lum, ara'naana patta'namum aayuthangka'lum ungka'lukku u'ndea.

ippoathum intha nirupam ungka'lidaththil varumpoathu neengka'l ungka'l aa'ndavanudaiya kumaararil uththamamum semmaiyumaayirukki'ravanaip paarththu, avanai avan thakappanudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal vaiththu, ungka'l aa'ndavanudaiya kudumpaththukkaaka yuththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.
avarka'l mikavum payanthu: ithoa, ira'ndu raajaakka'l avanukku munpaaka ni'rkavillaiyea; naangka'l eppadi ni'rpoam en'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, nakara visaarippukkaaranum, moopparum, pi'l'laika'lin visaarippukkaararum: naangka'l umathu adiyaarka'l, neer engka'lukkuch solvathaiyellaam seyvoam; naangka'l oruvaraiyum raajaavaakkuvathillai; umathu paarvaikkuch sammathiyaanathaich seyyum en'ru yekoovukkuch solliyanuppinaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: avarka'lukku ira'ndaam nirupaththai ezhuthinaan; athil: neengka'l en padchaththil searnthu en sollaik keadpeerka'laanaal, ungka'l aa'ndavanudaiya kumaararin thalaika'lai vaangki, naa'lai innearaththil yesrayealukku ennidaththil vaarungka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu. raajaavin kumaararaakiya ezhupathupearum thangka'lai va'larkki'ra patta'naththin periya manusharoadu irunthaarka'l.

intha nirupam avarka'lidaththil vanthapoathu, avarka'l raajaavin kumaararaakiya ezhupathupearaiyum pidiththu vetti, avarka'l thalaika'laik koodaika'lil vaiththu, yesrayealilirukki'ra avanidaththi'rku anuppinaarka'l.

anuppappatta aa'l vanthu: raajakumaararin thalaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l en'ru avanukku a'riviththapoathu, avan vidiya'rkaalamattum avaika'lai olimukavaasalil ira'ndu kuviyalaakak kuviththuvaiyungka'l en'raan.

ma'runaa'l kaalamea avan ve'liyea vanthu nin'ru, sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: neengka'l neethimaanka'lallavaa? ithoa, naan en aa'ndavanukku viroathamaakak kattuppaadupa'n'ni avanaik kon'rupoatteanea; aanaalum ivarka'l ellaaraiyum kon'ravan yaar?

aathalaal karththar aakaapin kudumpaththaarukku viroathamaakach sonna karththarudaiya vaarththaika'lil on'rum tharaiyilea vizhavillai enpathai a'rinthuko'l'lungka'l; karththar thammudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakiya eliyaavaikko'ndu sonnathaich seythaar en'raan.

yesrayealilum aakaapin kudumpaththaaril meethiyaana yaavaraiyum, avanukku iruntha ellaa manthirika'laiyum, avanaichsearntha manusharaiyum, avanudaiya aasaariyarka'laiyum, avanukku oruvaraiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaathapadikku, yekoo kon'rupoattaan.
pinpu avan ezhunthu samaariyaavukkup poakap pu'rappattaan; vazhiyilea avan aattumayir kaththarikki'ra meaypparin oor irukkum idaththukku vanthapoathu,

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya akasiyaavin sakoathararai angkea ka'ndu, neengka'l yaar en'ru keattaan. avarka'l: naangka'l akasiyaavin sakoatharar; naangka'l raajaavin pi'l'laika'laiyum raajasthireeyin pi'l'laika'laiyum vinavuki'ratha'rkup poaki'roam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: ivarka'lai uyiroadea pidiyungka'l en'raan; avarka'lai uyiroadea pidiththu, naa'rpaththira'ndu pearka'laakiya avarka'lai aattumayir kaththarikki'ra thurava'ndaiyilea vettippoattaarka'l; avarka'lil oruvanaiyum avan meethiyaaka vidavillai.

avan avvidamvittup pu'rappattapoathu, thanakku ethirppatta reakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaapaich santhiththu, avanai upasariththu: en iruthayam un iruthayaththoadea semmaiyaay irukki'rathupoala un iruthayamum semmaiyaayirukki'rathaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku yoanathaap: appadiyea irukki'rathu en'raan; appadiyirukki'rathaanaal, un kaiyaith thaa en'ru sonnaan; avan than kaiyaik koduththapoathu, avanaith thannidaththil irathaththinmeal ea'rivarachsolli,
nee ennoadea koodavanthu karththarukkaaka enakku irukki'ra pakthivairaakkiyaththaip paar en'raan; appadiyea ivanai avan irathaththinmeal eat'rinaarka'l.
avan samaariyaavukku vanthapoathu, karththar eliyaavoadea sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, samaariyaavil aakaapukku meethiyaana yaavaraiyum azhiththuth theeruma'lavum sangkaaragnseythaan.
pinpu yekoo janangka'laiyellaam kootti, avarka'lai noakki: aakaap paakaalaich seaviththathu kogncham, yekoo avanaich seavippathu mikuthi.

ippoathum paakaalin sakala theerkkatharisika'laiyum, avanudaiya sakala pa'nividaikkaararaiyum, avanudaiya sakala aasaariyaraiyum ennidaththil azhaippiyungka'l; oruvanum ku'raiyalaakaathu; naan paakaalukkup periya paliyidappoaki'rean; varaathavan evanoa avan uyiroadiruppathillai en'raan; paakaalin pa'nividaikkaararai azhikkumpadi yekoo ithaith thanthiramaaych seythaan.
paakaalukkup pa'ndikaiyin aasarippaik koo'rungka'l en'ru yekoo sonnaan; appadiyea koo'rinaarka'l.

yekoo israveal theasamengkum athaich solliyanuppinapadiyinaal, paakaalin pa'nividaikkaarar ellaarum vanthaarka'l; varaathavan oruvanumillai; avarka'l paakaalin koavilukku'l piraveasiththathinaal paakaalin koavil naa'rsaariyum ni'rainthirunthathu.
appozhuthu avan, vasthirasaalai visaarippukkaaranai noakki: paakaalin pa'nividaikkaararukkellaam vasthirangka'lai eduththukko'nduvaa en'raan; avarka'lukku vasthirangka'lai eduththukko'nduvanthaan.

pinpu yekoo: reakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaapoadungkoodap paakaalin koavilukku'l piraveasiththu, paakaalin pa'nividaikkaararai noakki: paakaalin oozhiyakkaararea allaamal karththarin oozhiyakkaararil oruvarum ingkea ungka'loadu iraathapadikkuth thittamaayp paarungka'l en'raan.

avarka'l palika'laiyum sarvaangka thakanangka'laiyum seluththa udpiraveasiththa pinpu, yekoo ve'liyilea e'npathu pearaith thanakku aayaththamaaka vaiththu: naan ungka'l kaiyil oppuvikki'ra manusharil oruvanai evan thappaviduki'raanoa avanudaiya jeevanukkup pathilaaka avanaith thappavittavanudaiya jeevan eedaayirukkum en'raan.

sarvaangka thakanapaliyittuth theernthapoathu, yekoo seavakaraiyum searvaikkaararaiyum noakki: u'l'lea poay, avarka'lai vettippoadungka'l; oruvaraiyum ve'liyea vidavea'ndaam en'raan; appadiyea pattayakkarukkinaal seavakarum searvaikkaararum avarka'lai vetti e'rinthupoattu, paakaal koavilaich searntha sthalam engkum poay,
paakaal koavil vikkirakangka'lai ve'liyea eduththuvanthu, avaika'laith theekko'luththi,
paakaalin silaiyaith thakarththu, paakaalin koavilai idiththu, athai innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rathupoala malajalaathi idamaakkinaarka'l.
ippadiyea yekoo paakaalai isravealil iraathapadikku azhiththuppoattaan.
aanaalum peththealilum thaa'nilum vaiththa po'rkan'rukkuttika'laal, isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai yekoo vittu vilakavillai.

karththar yekoovai noakki: en paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathai nee nan'raaych seythu, en iruthayaththil irunthapadiyellaam aakaapin kudumpaththukkuch seythapadiyinaal, un kumaarar isravealudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal naalu thalaimu'raiyaaka veet'riruppaarka'l en'raar.

aanaalum yekoo isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi than muzhu iruthayaththoadum nadakkak kavalaippadavillai; isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai vittu avan vilakavum illai.
annaadka'lmuthal karththar isravealaik ku'rainthupoakappa'n'ninaar; aasakeal avarka'lai isravealin ellaika'lilellaam mu'riya adiththu,

yoarthaan thuvakkik kizhakkilu'l'la arnoan nathikkuch sameepamaana aaroavear mutha'rko'ndirukki'ra keeleayaaththilum paasaanilumu'l'la kaathiyar, roopeaniyar, manaaseayar ivarka'ludaiya theasamaakiya keeleayaath muzhuvathaiyum mu'riya adiththaan.
yekoovin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avanudaiya ellaa vallamaiyum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yekoo than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avanaich samaariyaavil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan sthaanaththil avan kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaas raajaavaanaan.
yekoo samaariyaavilea isravealinmeal raajyapaarampa'n'nina naadka'l irupaththettu varusham.
akasiyaavin thaayaakiya aththaaliyaa'l than kumaaran i'ranthupoanathaik ka'ndapoathu, ezhumpi raajavamsasthar yaavaraiyum sangkaarampa'n'ninaa'l.

yoaraam ennum raajaavin kumaaraththiyum akasiyaavin sakoathariyumaakiya yoaseapaa'l, kolaiyu'n'nappaduki'ra raajakumaararin naduvilirukki'ra akasiyaavin makanaakiya yoavaasaik ka'lavaay eduththaa'l; avan kollappadaathapadi, avanaiyum avan thaathiyaiyum aththaaliyaa'lukkuth theriyaamal pa'l'li a'raiyil o'liththuvaiththaarka'l.
iva'loadeakooda avan aa'ruvarusham karththarudaiya aalayaththil o'liththuvaikkappattirunthaan; aththaaliyaa'l theasaththinmeal raajyapaarampa'n'ninaa'l.

eazhaam varushaththilea yoaythaa noo'ru pearukku athipathika'laiyum thalaivaraiyum kaavalaa'laraiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'laith thannidaththil karththarudaiya aalayaththilea varachsolli, avarka'loadu udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, avarka'laik karththarudaiya aalayaththilea aa'naiyiduviththukko'ndu, avarka'lukku raajaavin kumaaranaik kaa'npiththu,
avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l seyyavea'ndiya kaariyam ennaven'raal, oayvunaa'lil mu'raippadi ingkea varuki'ra ungka'lil moon'ril orupangku raajaavin aramanaik kaaval kaakkavea'ndum.
moon'ril orupangku soor ennum vaasalilum, moon'ril orupangku kaavalaa'larin kaavalin pi'rakea irukki'ra vaasalilumirunthu aalayakkaavalaip paththiramaayk kaakkavea'ndum.
ippadiyea oayvunaa'lil mu'raippadiyea ungka'lil ira'ndupangkupear, raajaavinidaththil karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kaaval kaakkavea'ndum.

neengka'l avaravar thangka'l aayuthangka'laik kaiyilea pidiththavarka'laay, raajaavaich sut'rilum varisaiyaay nin'ruko'ndirukkavea'ndum; varisaika'lukku'l pukunthuvaruki'ravan kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; raajaa ve'liyea poakumpoathum u'l'lea varumpoathum neengka'l avaroadea irungka'l en'raan.

aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa katta'laiyittapadiyellaam noo'rupearukku athipathika'l seythu, avaravar oayvunaa'lil mu'raippadi varuki'ravarka'lum mu'raippadi poaki'ravarka'lumaakiya thangka'l manusharaik koottikko'ndu, aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l.
aasaariyan karththarin aalayaththil thaaveethuraajaa vaiththiruntha eettika'laiyum keadakangka'laiyum noo'rupearukku athipathika'lidaththil koduththaan.

kaavalaa'lar avaravar thangka'l aayuthangka'laip pidiththavarka'laay, aalayaththin valathupakkamthodangki athin idathupakkamattum, palipeedaththi'rku ethiraakavum aalayaththi'rku ethiraakavum raajaavaich sut'rilum nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avan: raajakumaaranai ve'liyea ko'nduvanthu, kireedaththai avanmeal vaiththu, saadchiyin aakamaththai avan kaiyilea koduththaan; ippadi avanai raajaavaakki apisheakampa'n'ni: raajaa vaazhka en'ru solli kaikottinaarka'l.
oadivaruki'ra janangka'l seytha aaravaaraththai aththaaliyaa'l keattapoathu: ava'l karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku janangka'lidaththil vanthu,

ithoa, raajaa mu'raimaiyinpadiyea thoo'na'ndaiyilea ni'rki'rathaiyum, raajaava'ndaiyil ni'rki'ra pirapukka'laiyum, ekkaa'lam oothuki'ravarka'laiyum, theasaththu janangka'l ellaarum santhoashappattu ekkaa'lam oothuki'rathaiyum ka'ndavudanea, aththaaliyaa'l than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: thuroakam thuroakam en'ru koovinaa'l.

aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa iraa'nuvaththalaivaraakiya noo'rupearukku athipathika'laanavarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittu: iva'lai varisaika'lukkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoangka'l; iva'laip pinpat'ruki'ravanaip pattayaththaalea vettippoadungka'l en'raan. karththarudaiya aalayaththil ava'laik kollalaakaathu en'ru aasaariyan solliyirunthaan.
avarka'l ava'lukku idam u'ndaakkinapoathu, raajaavin aramanaikku'l kuthiraika'l piraveasikki'ra vazhiyilea ava'l poakaiyil, ava'laik kon'rupoattaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoaythaa, avarka'l karththarudaiya janamaayirukkumpadikku, raajaavum janangka'lum karththaroadea udanpadikkaipa'n'navum, raajaavum janangka'lum oruvaroadoruvar udanpadikkaipa'n'navum seythu,

pinpu theasaththin janangka'l ellaarum paakaalin koavilil poay, athai idiththu, athin palipeedangka'laiyum athin vikkirakangka'laiyum mut'rilum udaiththu, paakaalin poojaasaariyaakiya maaththaanaip palipeedangka'lukku munpaakak kon'rupoattaarka'l. aasaariyan karththarudaiya aalayaththai visaarikkum uththiyoakastharai ea'rpaduththinaan.

noo'rupearukku athipathika'laiyum thalaivaraiyum kaavalaa'laraiyum theasaththin janangka'laiyum kootti, raajaavaik karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu i'rangkappa'n'ni, avanaik kaavalaa'larin vaasal vazhiyaay raaja aramanaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea avan raajaakka'ludaiya singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthaan.
theasaththin janangka'l ellaarum makizhnthu nakaram amaithalaayit'ru. aththaaliyaa'laiyoa raajaavin aramanaiya'ndaiyil pattayaththaal kon'rupoattaarka'l.
yoavaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu eazhu vayathaayirunthaan.
yekoovin eazhaam varushaththil yoavaas raajaavaaki, erusaleamilea naa'rpathuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; peyersepaa ooraa'laakiya avanudaiya thaayin pear sipiyaa'l.
aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa yoavaasaip poathakampa'n'nina naa'lellaam avan karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
meadaika'laimaaththiram akat'ravillai; janangka'l innum meadaika'lmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaarka'l.

yoavaas aasaariyarai noakki: pirathishdaiyaakkappatta poru'lka'laakiya karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvarappaduki'ra ellaap pa'nangka'laiyum, ilakkaththi'rkudpaduki'ravarka'lin pa'naththaiyum, meedpukkaaka mathikkappaduki'ra aadka'lin pa'naththaiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvarumpadi, avaravar thamtham manathilea niyamiththirukkum ellaap pa'naththaiyum,
aasaariyarka'l avaravar thangka'lukku a'rimukamaanavarka'l kaiyil vaangkikko'ndu, aalayaththil engkengkea pazhuthukaa'nki'rathoa, angkeayellaam aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkavea'ndum en'raan.
aanaalum raajaavaakiya yoavaasin irupaththumoon'raam varushamattum aasaariyarka'l aalayaththaip pazhuthupaaraathea poanapadiyinaal,

raajaavaakiya yoavaas aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavaiyum mat'ra aasaariyarka'laiyum azhaippiththu: neengka'l aalayaththaip pazhuthupaaraatheapoanathenna? ini neengka'l ungka'lukku a'rimukamaanavarka'l kaiyilea pa'naththai vaangkaamal, athai aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkki'ratha'rkaaka vittuvidungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu aasaariyarka'l janaththin kaiyilea pa'naththai vaangkikko'l'laamalum, aalayaththaip pazhuthupaaraamalum irukki'ratha'rkuch sammathiththaarka'l.

aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa oru pettiyai eduththu, athin moodiyilea oru thuvaaramittu, athaip palipeedaththa'ndaiyilea karththarudaiya aalayaththil janangka'l udpiraveasikkum valathupakkaththil vaiththaan; vaasa'rpadiyaik kaakki'ra aasaariyarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarappatta pa'naththaiyellaam athilea poattaarka'l.
pettiyilea mikuntha pa'nam u'nden'ru avarka'l kaa'numpoathu, raajaavin sampirathiyum pirathaana aasaariyanum vanthu: karththarudaiya aalayaththilea seakarikkappatta pa'naththai e'n'ni mudippukkatti,
e'n'nina pa'naththaik karththarudaiya aalayaththilea visaarippukkaarar kaiyilea koduppaarka'l; athai avarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkki'ra thachcharukkum, si'rpaasaarika'lukkum,

kot'rarukkum, kalthachcharukkum, karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkath theavaiyaana marangka'laiyum vettina ka'rka'laiyum ko'l'luki'ratha'rkum, aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkki'ratha'rkuch sellum ellaach selavukkum koduppaarka'l.

karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvarappatta pa'naththinaalea ve'l'likki'n'nangka'lum, keethavaaththiyangka'lum, kalangka'lum, ekkaa'langka'lum, po'rpaaththirangka'lum, ve'l'lip paaththirangka'lum pa'n'nappadaamal,
karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkumpadikku vealaiseyki'ravarka'lukkea athaik koduththaarka'l.
vealaiseyki'ravarka'lukkuk kodukkumpadikku, pa'naththai varappat'rikko'nda manushar kaiyilea ka'nakkuk kea'laathirunthaarka'l; avarka'l u'nmaiyaay athai nadappiththaarka'l.
kut'rappiraayachchiththap pa'namum paavappiraayachchiththap pa'namum karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkaakak ko'nduvarappadavillai; athu aasaariyaraich searnthathu.
atha'rkuppinpu seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakeal vanthu, kaaththoorinmeal yuththampa'n'ni athaip pidiththaan; athinpinpu erusaleamukku viroathamaayp poaka aasakeal than mukaththaith thiruppinaan.

appozhuthu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoavaas, than pithaakka'laakiya yoasapaath yoaraam akasiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaakka'l parisuththampa'n'nivaiththa ellaavat'raiyum, thaan parisuththampa'n'nivaiththathaiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththilum raajaavin aramanaiyilumu'l'la pokkishangka'lil akappatta pon yaavaiyum eduththuch seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealukku anuppinaan; appozhuthu avan erusaleamai vittuth thirumpippoanaan.
yoavaasin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoavaasin oozhiyakkaarar ezhumpi kattuppaadu pa'n'nikko'ndu, sillaavukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilirukki'ra milloa veettilea avanaik kon'rupoattaarka'l.

simiyaathin kumaaran, yoasakaar soamearin kumaaran yoasapaath ennum avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanaik kon'raarka'l; i'ranthupoana avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil avanudaiya pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya amathsiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

akasiyaa ennum yoothaavudaiya raajaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaasudaiya irupaththumoon'raam varushaththil yekoovin kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaas isravealinmeal samaariyaavilea pathineazhuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'laip pinpat'ri nadanthaan; avaika'lai vittu avan vilakavillai.
aakaiyaal karththarukku isravealinmeal koapamoo'ndu, avarka'laich seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealin kaiyilum aasakealin kumaaranaakiya penaathaaththin kaiyilum annaadka'lilellaam oppukkoduththaar.
yoavaakaas karththarudaiya samukaththai noakkip piraarththiththaan; seeriyaavin raajaa isravealai odukkuki'rathinaal avarka'l odungkippoaki'rathaip paarththu: karththar avanukkuch sevikoduththaar.

karththar isravealukku oru radchakanaik koduththathinaal, avarka'l seeriyarudaiya kaiyinkeezhirunthu neengkalaanaarka'l; aathalaal israveal puththirar munpoal thangka'l koodaarangka'lilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
aakilum isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina yeropeyaam veettaarin paavangka'lai avarka'l vittu vilakaamal athilea nadanthaarka'l; samaariyaaviliruntha vikkirakaththoappum nilaiyaayirunthathu.

yoavaakaasukkuch seeriyaavin raajaa, aimpathu kuthiraiveeraraiyum, paththu irathangka'laiyum, pathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyumea allaamal, janangka'lil vea'ron'rum meethiyaaka vaikkavillai; avan avarka'lai azhiththup poaradikkum idaththuth thoo'laippoala aakkippoattaan.
yoavaakaasin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avanudaiya vallamaiyum israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoavaakaas than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avanaich samaariyaavilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya yoavaas avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoavaasudaiya muppaththeazhaam varushaththil yoavaakaasin kumaaranaakiya yoavaas, isravealinmeal raajaavaakiya samaariyaavilea pathinaa'ruvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai vittu vilakaamal avaika'lilellaam nadanthaan.

yoavaasin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaavoadu avan yuththampa'n'nina vallamaiyum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoavaas than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, yeropeyaam avan singkaasanaththil veet'rirunthaan; yoavaas samaariyaavil isravealin raajaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.

avan naadka'lil elisaa mara'naththukku eathuvaana viyaathiyaayk kidanthaan; appozhuthu isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas avanidaththukkup poay, avanmeal vizhunthu, azhuthu: en thakappanea, en thakappanea, isravealukku irathamum kuthiraiveerarumaayirunthavarea en'raan.
elisaa avanaip paarththu: villaiyum ampuka'laiyum pidiyum en'raan; appadiyea villaiyum ampuka'laiyum pidiththukko'ndaan.
appozhuthu avan isravealin raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya kaiyai villinmeal vaiyum en'raan; avan than kaiyai vaiththapoathu, elisaa than kaika'lai raajaavudaiya kaika'lmeal vaiththu:

kizhakkea irukki'ra jannalaith thi'ravum en'raan; avan athaith thi'ranthapoathu, elisaa: eyyum en'raan; ivan eythapoathu, avan: athu karththarudaiya radchippin ampum, seeriyarinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkum radchippin ampumaanathu; neer aappekkilea seeriyaraith theera mu'riya adippeer en'raan.
pinpu ampuka'laip pidiyum en'raan; avaika'laip pidiththaan. appozhuthu avan isravealin raajaavai noakki: tharaiyilea adiyum en'raan; avan moon'rutharam adiththu nin'raan.

appozhuthu theavanudaiya manushan avanmeal koapamaaki: neer ainthu aa'ruvisai adiththeeraanaal, appozhuthu seeriyaraith theera mu'riya adippeer; ippozhuthoa seeriyarai moon'ruvisaimaaththiram mu'riya adippeer en'raan.
elisaa mara'namadainthaan; avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; ma'ruvarushaththilea moavaapiyarin tha'nduka'l theasaththilea vanthathu.

appozhuthu avarka'l, oru manushanai adakkampa'n'nappoakaiyil, anthath tha'ndaik ka'ndu, antha manushanai elisaavin kalla'raiyil poattaarka'l; antha manushanin pireatham athilea vizhunthu elisaavin elumpuka'linmeal pattapoathu, antha manushan uyiradainthu than kaalka'lai oon'ri ezhunthirunthaan.
yoavaakaasin naadka'lilellaam seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakeal isravealai odukkinaan.

aanaalum karththar avarka'lukku irangki, aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'loadu seytha thamathu udanpadikkaiyinimiththam avarka'lai azhikkach siththamaayiraamalum, avarka'lai innum thammudaiya mukaththaivittuth tha'l'laamalum avarka'lmeal manathuruki, avarka'lai ninaiththaru'linaar.
seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakeal i'ranthupoay, avan kumaaranaakiya penaathaath avan sthaanaththilea raajaavaana pinpu,

yoavaakaasin kumaaranaakiya yoavaas, aasakealoadea yuththampa'n'ni, than thakappanaakiya yoavaakaasin kaiyilirunthu pidiththukko'nda patta'nangka'lai avan kumaaranaakiya penaathaaththin kaiyilirunthu thirumpap pidiththukko'ndaan; moon'ruvisai yoavaas avanai mu'riya adiththu isravealin patta'nangka'laith thirumpak kattikko'ndaan.
isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaakaasin kumaaran yoavaasudaiya ira'ndaam varushaththilea yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoavaasin kumaaran amathsiyaa raajaavaanaan.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, erusaleamilea irupaththonpathu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; erusaleam nakaraththaa'laana avan thaayinpear yovathaanaa'l.
avan karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan; aanaalum than thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoalalla; than thakappanaakiya yoavaas seythapadiyellaam seythaan.
meadaika'lmaaththiram akat'rappadavillai; janangka'l innum meadaika'linmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaarka'l.
raajyapaaram avan kaiyilea sthirappattapoathu, avanudaiya thakappanaakiya raajaavaik kon'rupoatta than oozhiyakkaararaik kon'rupoattaan.

aanaalum pi'l'laika'linimiththam pithaakka'l kolaiseyyappadaamalum pithaakka'linimiththam pi'l'laika'l kolaiseyyappadaamalum, avanavan seytha paavaththinimiththam avanavan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum en'ru moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, karththar katta'laiyittapirakaaram kolaiseythavarka'lin pi'l'laika'lai avan kollaathirunthaan.
avan uppuppa'l'laththaakkilea eathoamiyaril pathinaayirampearai madangkadiththu, yuththagnseythu sealaavaip pidiththu, atha'rku innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'ra yokthiyeal ennum pearaith thariththaan.

appozhuthu amathsiyaa yekoovin kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaasin kumaaran yoavaas ennum isravealin raajaavidaththil sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: nammudaiya saamarththiyaththaip paarppoam vaa en'ru sollachsonnaan.

atha'rku isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaavukku aa'l anuppi: leepanoanilu'l'la mudchediyaanathu, leepanoanilu'l'la keathurumaraththai noakki, nee un maka'lai en makanukku manaiviyaaka vivaakagnseythukodu en'ru sollachsollit'ru; aanaalum leepanoanilu'l'la oru kaattumirukam antha vazhi poakaiyil oadi antha mudchediyai mithiththuppoattathu.

nee eathoamiyarai mu'riya adiththathinaal un iruthayam unnaik karvangko'l'lappa'n'ninathu; nee perumaipaaraattikko'ndu un veettilea iru; neeyum unnoadeakooda yoothaavum vizhumpadikku, pollaappaith theadikko'lvaanean en'ru sollachsonnaan.

aanaalum amathsiyaa sevikodaatheapoanaan; aakaiyaal isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas vanthaan; yoothaavilu'l'la pethshimeasilea avanum, yoothaavin raajaa amathsiyaavum, thangka'l saamarththiyaththaip paarkki'rapoathu,
yoothaa janangka'l isravealarukku munpaaka mu'rinthu avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.

akasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaasin kumaaran amathsiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaavaiyoa, isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas pethshimeasilea pidiththu, erusaleamukku vanthu, erusaleamin alangkaththilea eppiraayeem vaasal thodangki moolaivaasalmattum naanoo'ru muzha nee'lam idiththuppoattu,

karththarudaiya aalayaththilum raajaavudaiya aramanaip pokkishangka'lilum akappatta pon ve'l'li yaavaiyum, sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, kiriyiruppavarka'laiyum pidiththukko'ndu samaariyaavukkuth thirumpippoanaan.

yoavaas seytha mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avanudaiya vallamaiyum, avan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaavoadu yuththampa'n'nina vithamum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoavaas than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, samaariyaavil isravealin raajaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaakaasin kumaaran yoavaas mara'namadainthapin, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoavaasin kumaaran amathsiyaa pathinainthuvarusham uyiroadirunthaan.
amathsiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'l yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
erusaleamilea avanukku viroathamaakak kattuppaadu pa'n'ninaarka'l; appozhuthu laakeesukku oadippoanaan; aanaalum avarka'l avan pi'rakea laakeesukku manusharai anuppi, angkea avanaik kon'rupoattu,
kuthiraika'lmeal avanai eduththukko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan erusaleamil irukki'ra thaaveethin nakaraththilea than pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
yoothaa janangka'l yaavarum pathinaa'ru vayathu'l'la asariyaavai azhaiththuvanthu avanai avan thakappanaakiya amathsiyaavin sthaanaththil raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
raajaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, ivan ealaathaik katti, athaith thirumpa yoothaavin vasamaakkikko'ndaan.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoavaasin kumaaran amathsiyaavin pathinainthaam varushaththil, isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaasin kumaaran yeropeyaam raajaavaaki samaariyaavil naa'rpaththoru varusham arasaa'ndu,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'l on'raiyum avan vittu vilakavillai.

kaaththeappear ooraanaakiya amiththaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin kumaaran yoanaa ennum thammudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaikko'ndu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solliyiruntha vaarththaiyinpadiyea, avan aamaaththin ellai mutha'rko'ndu samapoomiyin kadalmattumu'l'la isravealin ellaika'laith thirumpach searththukko'ndaan.
isravealin upaththiravam mikavum kodithu en'rum, adaipattavanumillai, vidupattavanumillai, isravealukku oththaasai seyki'ravanumillai en'rum karththar paarththaar.
isravealin pearai vaanaththin keezhirunthu kulaiththuppoaduvean en'ru karththar sollaamal, yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin kaiyaal avarka'lai radchiththaar.

yeropeyaamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avan yuththampa'n'ni, yoothaavukku iruntha thamaskuvaiyum aamaaththaiyum isravealukkaakath thirumpach searththukko'nda avanudaiya vallamaiyum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yeropeyaam isravealin raajaakka'laakiya than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya sakariyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
isravealin raajaavaakiya yeropeyaamin irupaththeazhaam varushaththil, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaavin kumaaran asariyaa raajaavaanaan.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu pathinaa'ru vayathaayirunthu, aimpaththira'ndu varusham erusaleamilea arasaa'ndaan; erusaleam nakaraththaa'laana avan thaayin pear ekkoaliyaa'l.
avan than thakappanaakiya amathsiyaa seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
meadaika'l maaththiram akat'rappadavillai; janangka'l innum meadaika'lmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaarka'l.

karththar intha raajaavai vaathiththathinaal, avan than mara'nanaa'lmattum kushdaroakiyaayirunthu, thaniththu oru veettilea vaasampa'n'ninaan; raajaavin kumaaranaakiya yoathaam aramanai visaarippukkaaranaayirunthu, theasaththin janangka'lai niyaayam visaariththaan.
asariyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

asariyaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththilea avan pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya yoathaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya asariyaavin muppaththettaam varushaththilea yeropeyaamin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaa isravealinmeal samaariyaavilea aa'rumaatham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,

than pithaakka'l seythathupoala, karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai avan vittu vilakavillai.
yaapeasin kumaaranaakiya salloom avanukku viroathamaakak kattuppaadupa'n'ni, janaththin munpaaka avanai vettik kon'rupoattu, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
sakariyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'l israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
un kumaarar naalaam thalaimu'raimattum isravealudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaarka'l en'ru karththar yekoovoadea sonna vaarththai ithuthaan; appadiyea aayit'ru.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya usiyaavin muppaththonpathaam varushaththil yaapeasin kumaaranaakiya salloom raajaavaaki, samaariyaavil oru maatham arasaa'ndaan.
kaathiyin kumaaranaakiya menaakeam thirsaavilirunthu samaariyaavukku vanthu, yaapeasin kumaaranaakiya salloomaich samaariyaavilea vettik kon'rupoattu, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
salloomin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seytha kattuppaadum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

appozhuthu menaakeam thipsaa patta'naththaiyum, athilu'l'la yaavaiyum, thirsaathodangki athin ellaika'laiyum mu'riya adiththaan; avarka'l thanakku vaasalaith thi'rakkavillai en'ru avarka'lai vetti, avarka'ludaiya karppavathika'laiyellaam kee'rippoattaan.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya asariyaavin muppaththonpathaam varushaththil, kaathiyin kumaaranaakiya menaakeam isravealmeal raajaavaakich samaariyaavilea paththuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni, avan than naadka'lilellaam karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai vittu vilakaathirunthaan.

aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya pool, theasaththi'rku viroathamaay vanthaan; appozhuthu menaakeam poolin uthaviyinaal raajyapaaraththaith than kaiyil palappaduththumporuttu, avanukku aayiram thaalanthu ve'l'li koduththaan.

inthap pa'naththai aseeriyaavin raajaavukkuk kodukkumpadi, menaakeam isravealil palaththa aisuvariyavaanka'lidaththil aa'l on'ri'rku aimpathu ve'l'lich seakkal tha'ndinaan; appadiyea aseeriyaavin raajaa theasaththilea ni'rkaamal thirumpippoanaan.
menaakeamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
menaakeam than pithaakka'loadu niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya pekkaakiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya asariyaavin aimpathaam varushaththil, menaakeamin kumaaranaakiya pekkaakiyaa isravealinmeal raajaavaaki samaariyaavilea ira'ndu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; avan isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai vittu vilakavillai.

aanaalum remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaa ennum avanudaiya searvaikkaaran avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, keeleayaath puththiraril aimpathupearaik koottikko'ndu, avanaiyum arkoapaiyum aariyeayaiyum raajaavin veedaakiya aramanaiyilea samaariyaavil vettik kon'rupoattu, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
pekkaakiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya asariyaavin aimpaththira'ndaam varushaththil, remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaa isravealinmeal raajaavaakich samaariyaavilea irupathuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamin paavangka'lai avan vittu vilakavillai.

isravealin raajaavaakiya pekkaavin naadka'lil aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya thikilaathpileasar vanthu, eeyoanaiyum, pethmaakkaa ennum aapealaiyum, yanoavaakaiyum, keatheasaiyum, aathsoaraiyum, keeleayaaththaiyum, kalileayaavaakiya napthali theasamanaiththaiyum pidiththu, kudika'laich si'raiyaaka aseeriyaavukkuk ko'ndupoanaan.

ealaavin kumaaranaakiya oaseyaa remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaavukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, avanai usiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoathaamin irupathaam varushaththil vettik kon'rupoattu, avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
pekkaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, israveal raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
isravealin raajaavaakiya remaliyaavin kumaaran pekkaavin ira'ndaam varushaththil, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya usiyaavin kumaaran yoathaam raajaavaanaan.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu, irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, erusaleamilea pathinaa'ruvarusham arasaa'ndaan; saathoakkin kumaaraththiyaakiya avan thaayin pear erusaa'l.
avan karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan; than thakappanaakiya usiyaa seythapadiyellaam seythaan.
meadaika'lmaaththiram akat'rappadavillai; janangka'l innum meadaika'linmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaatti vanthaarka'l; ivan karththarudaiya aalayaththin uyarntha vaasalaik kattinaan.
yoathaamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
annaadka'lilea karththar seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya reathseenaiyum, remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaavaiyum yoothaavukku viroathamaaka anuppaththodangkinaar.

yoathaam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin patta'naththilea than pithaakka'la'ndaiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya aakaas avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaavin pathineazhaam varushaththil yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoathaamin kumaaran aakaas raajaavaanaan.

aakaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupathu vayathaayirunthu, erusaleamilea pathinaa'ru varusham arasaa'ndaan; avan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoal than theavanaakiya karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seyyaamal,
israveal raajaakka'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththina jaathika'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadiyea than kumaaranai muthalaayth theekkadakkappa'n'ninaan.
meadaika'lilum malaika'linmealum pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaan.

appozhuthu seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya reathseenum, isravealin raajaavaakiya remaliyaavin kumaaran pekkaavum, erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'na vanthu aakaasai mut'rikkai poattaarka'l; aanaalum jeyikkamaattaathea poanaarka'l.

akkaalaththilea seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya reathseen ealaaththaith thirumpach seeriyaavoadea searththukko'ndu, yootharai ealaaththilirunthu thuraththinaan; seeriyar ealaaththi'rku vanthu innaa'lvaraikkum avvidaththilea kudiyaayirukki'raarka'l.

aakaas aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya thikilaathpileasaridaththi'rku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: naan ummudaiya adiyaanum ummudaiya kumaaranumaayirukki'rean; neer vanthu, enakku viroathamaayezhumpina seeriyaa raajaavin kaikkum, israveal raajaavin kaikkum ennai neengkalaakkividum en'ru sollachsolli;
karththarudaiya aalayaththilum raajaavin aramanaip pokkishangka'lilum akappatta ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum eduththu, aseeriyaavin raajaavukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaaka anuppinaan.
aseeriyaa raajaa avanukkuch sevikoduththu, thamaskuvukkuppoay athaip pidiththu, athin kudika'laik keerpatta'naththi'rkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoay, reathseenaik kon'rupoattaan.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya aakaas thamaskuvilu'l'la aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya thikilaathpileasarukku ethirko'ndupoayth thamaskuvilu'l'la palipeedaththaik ka'ndaan. raajaavaakiya aakaas anthap palipeedaththin saayalaiyum, athinudaiya sakala vealaippaadaakiya athin maathiriyaiyum aasaariyanaakiya uriyaavukku anuppinaan.

raajaavaakiya aakaas thamaskuvilirunthu varuki'ratha'rku'l aasaariyanaakiya uriyaa appadikkoththa palipeedaththaik katti, raajaavaakiya aakaas thamaskuvilirunthu anuppina katta'laiyinpadiyellaam seythaan.
raajaa thamaskuvilirunthu vanthapoathu, avan anthap palipeedaththaip paarththu, anthap palipeedaththa'ndaiyil searnthu, athinmeal paliyittu,
than sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum than poajanapaliyaiyum thakaniththu, than paanapaliyai vaarththu, than samaathaanapalika'lin iraththaththai anthap palipeedaththinmeal the'liththaan.

karththarin sannithiyil iruntha ve'nkalap palipeedaththai avan than palipeedaththi'rkum karththarin aalayaththi'rkum naduvea aalayaththin mukappilirunthu eduththu, athaith than palipeedaththi'rku vadapu'ramaay vaiththaan.

raajaavaakiya aakaas aasaariyanaakiya uriyaavai noakki: inthap periya palipeedaththinmeal nee kaalaich sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, maalaippoajanapaliyaiyum, raajaavin sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, avarudaiya poajanapaliyaiyum, theasaththinudaiya sakala janaththin sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, avarka'l poajanapaliyaiyum, avarka'l paanapalika'laiyum seluththi, athinmeal sarvaangka thakanangka'lin sakala iraththaththaiyum, palika'lin sakala iraththaththaiyum the'lippaayaaka; antha ve'nkalap palipeedamoa, naan sannatham keadki'ratha'rku uthavum en'raan.
raajaavaakiya aakaas katta'laiyittapadiyellaam aasaariyanaakiya uriyaa seythaan.

pinnum raajaavaakiya aakaas aathaarangka'lin savukkaika'lai a'ruththuvittu, avaika'linmealiruntha kopparaika'lai eduththu, kadalthottiyaik keezhea ni'rki'ra ve'nkala rishapangka'linmealirunthu i'rakki, athaik ka'rka'lin tha'lavarisaiyilea vaiththu,
aalayaththin arukea kattiyiruntha oayvunaa'lin ma'ndapaththaiyum, raajaa piraveasikkum ma'ndapaththaiyum, aseeriyarudaiya raajaavinimiththam karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu appu'rappaduththinaan.
aakaas seytha mat'ra varththamaanangka'l yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aakaas than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan thaaveethin nakaraththil than pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya eseakkiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aakaasin pannira'ndaam varushaththil, ealaavin kumaaranaakiya oaseyaa isravealinmeal raajaavaaki, samaariyaavilea onpathuvarusham raajyapaarampa'n'ni,
karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; aanaalum thanakku munniruntha isravealin raajaakka'laippoal seyyavillai.
avanukku viroathamaaka aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya salmanaasaar vanthaan; appozhuthu oaseyaa avanaich seavikki'ravanaaki, avanukkup pakuthikattinaan.

oaseyaa ekipthin raajaavaakiya soa enpavanidaththukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppinathum, thanakku varushanthoa'rum seythathupoal, pakuthi anuppaathea poanathumaana kalaka yoasanaiyai aseeriyaavin raajaa oaseyaavinidaththilea ka'ndu, avanaip pidiththuk kattich si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththaan.
aseeriyaa raajaa theasam engkum poay, samaariyaavukkum vanthu athai moon'ru varusham mut'rikkaipoattirunthaan.

oaseyaavin onpathaam varushaththil aseeriyaa raajaa samaariyaavaip pidiththu, isravealai aseeriyaavukkuch si'raiyaakak ko'ndupoay, avarka'laik koasaan nathi oaramaana aalaakilum aapoarilum meathiyarin patta'nangka'lilum kudiyeat'rinaan.

ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanudaiya kaiyinkeezhiruntha thangka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaaka israveal puththirar paavagnseythu, anniya theavarka'lukkup payanthu nadanthu,
karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththina jaathika'lin vazhipaaduka'lilum israveal raajaakka'lin vazhipaaduka'lilum nadanthuko'ndirunthaarka'l.

seyyaththakaatha kaariyangka'lai israveal puththirar thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaaka irakasiyaththil seythathuman'ri, kaavalkaakki'ra koapurangka'l thodangki ara'naana patta'nangka'lmattumu'l'la thangka'l oorka'lilellaam thangka'lukku meadaika'laiyum katti,
uyaramaana sakala meattinmealum pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum thangka'lukkuch silaika'laiyum vikkirakath thoappuka'laiyum ni'ruththi,
karththar thangka'lai vittuk kudivilakkina jaathika'laippoala, sakala meadaika'lilum thoopangkaatti, karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakath thurkkiriyaika'laich seythu,
ippadich seyyaththakaathu en'ru karththar thangka'lukkuch solliyirunthum, narakalaana vikkirakangka'laich seaviththuvanthaarka'l.

neengka'l ungka'l pollaatha vazhika'laivittuth thirumpi, naan ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk katta'laiyittathum, en oozhiyakkaararaakiya theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu ungka'lukkuch solliyanuppinathumaana niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyellaam en ka'rpanaika'laiyum en katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'lungka'l en'ru karththar theerkkatharisika'l gnaanathirushdikkaarar ellaaraiyungko'ndu isravealukkum yoothaavukkum thidachsaadchiyaay echchariththukko'ndirunthum,
avarka'l sevikodaamal, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarmeal visuvaasiyaama'rpoana kadinak kazhuththu'l'la thangka'l pithaakka'laippoal, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththi,

avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum, avar thangka'l pithaakka'loadea pa'n'nina avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyaiyum, avar thangka'lukkuth thidachsaadchiyaayk kaa'npiththa avarudaiya saadchika'laiyum ve'ruththuvittu, vee'naana vikkirakangka'laip pinpat'ri vee'naraaki, avarka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ravarka'laippoala, seyya vea'ndaamen'ru karththar thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittu vilakkiyiruntha jaathika'lukkup pinsen'ru,

thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam vittuvittu, ira'ndu kan'rukkuttika'laakiya vaarppiththa vikkirakangka'laith thangka'lukku u'ndaakki, vikkirakath thoappuka'lai naatti, vaanaththin seanaika'laiyellaam pa'ninthuko'ndu, paakaalaich seaviththaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l kumaararaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum theekkadakkappa'n'ni, ku'rikeattu nimiththangka'l paarththu, karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakka avar paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyki'ratha'rkuth thangka'lai vit'rup poattaarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar isravealinmeal mikavum koapamadainthu, avarka'laith thammudaiya mukaththaivittu akat'rinaar; yoothaakoaththiramaaththiramea meethiyaayit'ru.
yoothaa janangka'lum thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'laamal israveal u'ndaakkina vazhipaaduka'lil nadanthaarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar israveal santhathiyaaraiyellaam pu'rakka'niththu, avarka'laith thamathu mukaththaivittuth tha'l'lumattaaka odukki, avarka'laik ko'l'laikkaarar kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

isravealar thaaveethu vamsaththaivittup pirinthu, neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamai raajaavaakkinaarka'l; appozhuthu yeropeyaam isravealaik karththarai vittup pinvaangkavum, periya paavaththaich seyyavumpa'n'ninaan.
appadiyea israveal puththirar yeropeyaam seytha ellaap paavangka'lilum nadanthu,

karththar theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaaraiyum ko'ndu solliyirunthapadi, avarka'laith thamathu samukaththaivittu akat'ruki'ravaraikkum, avaika'lai vittu vilakaathirunthaarka'l; ippadiyea isravealar thangka'l theasaththinin'ru aseeriyaavukkuk ko'ndupoakappattu innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'raarka'l.

aseeriyaa raajaa, paapiloanilum, kooththaavilum, aapaavilum, aamaaththilum, sepparvaayimilum irunthu manusharai varappa'n'ni, avarka'lai israveal puththirarukkup pathilaakach samaariyaavin patta'nangka'lilea kudiyeat'rinaan; ivarka'l samaariyaavaich sonthamaayk kattikko'ndu athin patta'nangka'lilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l angkea kudiyea'rinathumuthal, karththarukkup payappadaathathinaal, karththar avarka'lukku'l'lea singkangka'lai anuppinaar; avaika'l avarka'lil silaraik kon'rupoattathu.

appozhuthu janangka'l aseeriyaa raajaavai noakki: neer ingkeayirunthu anuppi, samaariyaavin patta'nangka'lilea kudiyeat'ruviththa jaathika'l anthath theasaththuth theavanudaiya kaariyaththai a'riyaathapadiyinaal, avar avarka'lukku'l'lea singkangka'lai anuppinaar; anthath theasaththuth theavanudaiya kaariyaththai avarka'l a'riyaathapadiyinaal, avaika'l avarka'laik kon'rupoaduki'rathu en'ru sonnaarka'l.

atha'rku aseeriyaa raajaa: neengka'l angkeayirunthu ko'nduvantha aasaariyarka'lil oruvanai angkea azhaiththukko'ndupoangka'l; avarka'l angkea kudiyirukkumpadikku, avan avarka'lukku anthath theasaththuth theavanudaiya kaariyaththaip poathikkakkadavan en'ru katta'laiyittaan.
appadiyea avarka'l samaariyaavilirunthu ko'ndupoayiruntha aasaariyarka'lil oruvan vanthu, peththealilea kudiyirunthu, karththarukkup payanthu nadakkavea'ndiya vithaththai avarka'lukkup poathiththaan.

aanaalum anthantha jaathi thangka'l thangka'l theavarka'laith thangka'lukku u'ndupa'n'ni, anthantha jaathiyaar kudiyea'rina thangka'l thangka'l patta'nangka'lil samaariyar u'ndupa'n'nina meadaika'lin koavilka'lil vaiththaarka'l.
paapiloanin manushar sukkoath penoaththaiyum, kooththin manushar nearkaalaiyum, aamaaththin manushar asimaavaiyum,
aaviyar nipeakaasaiyum tharthaakkaiyum u'ndaakkinaarka'l, sepparviyar sepparvaayimin theavarka'laakiya athramaleakkukkum annamaleakkukkum thangka'l pi'l'laika'lai akkiniyil thakaniththu vanthaarka'l.

avarka'l karththarukkup payanthathuman'ri, meadaika'lilu'l'la koavilka'lil thangka'lukkaaka aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rku, thangka'lukku'l eenamaanavarka'lai aasaariyarka'laakavum ea'rpaduththinaarka'l.
appadiyea karththarukkup payanthum, thaangka'l vittuvantha jaathika'ludaiya mu'raimaiyinpadiyea thangka'l theavarka'laich seaviththum vanthaarka'l.

innaa'lvaraikkum avarka'l thangka'l munthina mu'raika'linpadiyea seythu varuki'raarka'l; avarka'l karththarukkup payanthu nadakki'rathumillai, thangka'l suyathittangka'l mu'raimaika'linpadiyaakilum, karththar israveal en'ru pearitta yaakkoapin puththirarukkuk ka'rpiththa niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkum ka'rpanaikkum oththapadiyaakilum seyki'rathumillai.

karththar ivarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, ivarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l anniya theavarka'lukkup payappadaamalum, avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'l'laamalum, seaviyaamalum, avarka'lukkup paliyidaamalum,
ungka'lai makaa vallamaiyinaalum oangkiya puyaththinaalum ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina karththarukkea payanthu, avaraiyea pa'ninthuko'ndu, avarukkea paliyittu,

avar ungka'lukku ezhuthikkoduththa thittangka'linpadiyum, mu'raimaika'linpadiyum, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyum, ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum, neengka'l sakala naa'lum seyki'ratha'rkuk kavanamaayirunthu anniya theavarka'lukkup payappadaathirungka'l.
naan ungka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai neengka'l ma'ravaamalum, anniya theavarka'lukkup payappadaamalum,
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkea payanthu nadappeerka'laaka; appozhuthu avar ungka'l ellaach saththurukka'lin kaikkum ungka'laith thappuvippaar en'ru avarka'lukkuch solliyirunthaar.
aanaalum avarka'l sevikodaamal thangka'l munthina mu'raimaika'linpadiyea seythaarka'l.

appadiyea antha jaathika'l karththarukkup payanthum, thangka'l vikkirakangka'laich seaviththum vanthaarka'l; avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'lum thangka'l pithaakka'l seythapadiyea innaa'lvaraikkum seythuvaruki'raarka'l.
isravealin raajaavaakiya ealaavin kumaaran oaseyaavin moon'raam varushaththilea aakaas ennum yoothaavudaiya raajaavin kumaaranaakiya eseakkiyaa raajaavaanaan.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu, irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, erusaleamilea irupaththonpathu varusham arasaa'ndaan; sakariyaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya avan thaayinpear aapi.
avan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.

avan meadaika'lai akat'ri, silaika'laith thakarththu, vikkirakaththoappuka'lai vetti, moasea pa'n'niyiruntha ve'nkalach sarppaththai udaiththuppoattaan; annaadka'lmattum israveal puththirar atha'rkuth thoopangkaatti vanthaarka'l; atha'rku nikusthaan en'ru pearittaan.
avan isravealin theavanaakiya karththarinmeal vaiththa nampikkaiyilea, avanukkup pinnum avanukku munnum iruntha yoothaavin raajaakka'lilellaam avanaippoal oruvanum irunthathillai.
avan karththarai vittup pinvaangkaamal avaraich saarnthirunthu, karththar moaseakkuk ka'rpiththa avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu nadanthaan.
aakaiyaal karththar avanoadirunthaar; avan poaki'ra idam engkum avanukku anukoolamaayit'ru; avan aseeriyaa raajaavaich seavikkaamal, avan athikaaraththaith tha'l'livittaan.
avan pelistharaik kaasaamattum athin ellaika'l pariyanthamum, kaavalaa'lar kaakki'ra koapurangka'l thodangki ara'naana nakarangka'l pariyanthamum mu'riya adiththaan.

isravealin raajaavaakiya ealaavin kumaaran oaseyaavin eazhaam varushaththi'rkuch sariyaana eseakkiyaa raajaavin naalaam varushaththilea aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya salmanaasaar samaariyaavukku viroathamaay vanthu athai mut'rikkaipoattaan.
moon'ru varusham sen'rapinpu, avarka'l athaip pidiththaarka'l; eseakkiyaavin aa'raam varushaththilum, isravealin raajaavaakiya oaseyaavin onpathaam varushaththilum samaariyaa pidipattathu.
aseeriyaa raajaa isravealai aseeriyaavukkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoay, koasaan nathiyoaramaana aalaakilum aapoarilum meathiyarin patta'nangka'lilum kudiyeat'rinaan.

avarka'l thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaamal, avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyaiyum karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea ka'rpiththa yaavat'raiyum mee'ri, atha'rkuch sevikodaamalum athinpadi seyyaamalum poanaarka'l.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavin pathinaalaam varushaththilea aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip yoothaavilirukki'ra ara'naana sakala patta'nangka'lukkum viroathamaay vanthu avaika'laip pidiththaan.

appozhuthu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa laakeesilu'l'la aseeriyaa raajaavukku aa'l anuppi: naan kut'ragnseythean; ennaivittuth thirumpippoam; neer enmeal sumaththuvathaich sumappean en'ru sonnaan; appadiyea aseeriyaa raajaa yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavinmeal munnoo'ru thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum muppathu thaalanthu ponnaiyum sumaththinaan.
aathalaal eseakkiyaa karththarin aalayaththilum raajaavudaiya aramanai pokkishangka'lilum akappatta ellaa ve'l'liyaiyum koduththaan.

akkaalaththilea yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa karththarudaiya aalayakkathavuka'lilum nilaika'lilum thaan azhuththiyiruntha pon thakaduka'laik kazhat'ri avaika'lai aseeriyaa raajaavukkuk koduththaan.

aakilum aseeriyaa raajaa laakeesilirunthu tharthaanaiyum rapsaareesaiyum rapsaakkeayaiyum periya seanaiyoadea erusaleamukku eseakkiyaa raajaavinidaththil anuppinaan; avarka'l erusaleamukku vanthu, va'n'naar thu'raiyin vazhiyilu'l'la mealku'laththuch saalakaththa'ndaiyilea nin'ru,

raajaavai azhaippiththaarka'l; appozhuthu ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeem ennum aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, sepnaa ennum sampirathiyum, aasaappin kumaaranaakiya yoavaak ennum ka'nakkanum avarka'lidaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
rapsaakkea avarka'lai noakki: aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya makaaraajaavaanavar uraikki'rathum, neengka'l eseakkiyaavukkuch sollavea'ndiyathum ennaven'raal: nee nampiyirukki'ra intha nampikkai enna?
yuththaththi'rku manthiraaloasanaiyum vallamaiyum u'nden'ru nee solluki'raayea, athu vaayppeachcheayan'ri vea'ralla; nee ennai viroathikkumpadi yaarmeal nampikkaivaiththirukki'raay?

ithoa, nerintha naa'nalkoalaakiya antha ekipthai nampuki'raay; athinmeal oruvan saaynthaal, athu avan u'l'langkaiyil pattu uruvippoam; ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoan thannai nampuki'ra yaavarukkum ippadiyea iruppaan.

neengka'l ennidaththil: engka'l theavanaakiya karththarai nampuki'roam en'ru solluveerka'laakil, avarudaiya meadaika'laiyum avarudaiya palipeedangka'laiyum allavoa eseakkiyaa akat'ri, yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum noakki: erusaleamilirukki'ra inthap palipeedaththinmun pa'niyungka'l en'raanea.
naan unakku ira'ndaayiram kuthiraika'laik koduppean; nee avaika'lmeal ea'raththakkavarka'laich sampaathikkakkoodumaanaal aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoadea sapathangkoo'ru.

koo'raatheapoanaal, nee en aa'ndavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararil orea oru si'riya thalaivanin mukaththai eppadith thiruppuvaay? irathangka'loadu kuthiraiveerarum varuvaarka'l en'ru ekipthaiyaa nampuki'raay?
ippoathum karththarudaiya katta'laiyillaamal intha sthalaththai azhikkavantheanoa? inthath theasaththi'rku viroathamaayp poay athai azhiththuppoadu en'ru karththar ennoadea sonnaarea en'raan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaavin kumaaran eliyaakkeemum sepnaavum yoavaakum rapsaakkeayaip paarththu: umathu adiyaaroadea seeriyapaashaiyilea peasum; athu engka'lukkuth theriyum; alangkaththilirukki'ra janaththin sevika'l keadka engka'loadea yoothapaashaiyilea peasavea'ndaam en'raarka'l.

atha'rku rapsaakkea: ungka'loadungkoodath thangka'l malaththaith thinnavum thangka'l neeraik kudikkavum alangkaththilea thangkiyirukki'ra manushara'ndaikkea allaamal, un aa'ndavana'ndaikkum unna'ndaikkumaa en aa'ndavan intha vaarththaika'laip peasa ennai anuppinaar en'ru solli,
rapsaakkea nin'ruko'ndu yoothapaashaiyilea uraththasaththamaay: aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya makaaraajaavudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
eseakkiyaa ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadi paarungka'l; avan ungka'lai en kaiyilirunthu thappuvikkamaattaan.

karththar nammai nichchayamaayth thappuvippaar; intha nakaram aseeriyaa raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvathillai en'ru solli, eseakkiyaa ungka'laik karththarai nampappa'n'nuvaan; atha'rku idangkodaathirungka'l en'ru raajaa solluki'raar.

eseakkiyaavin sollaik kea'laathirungka'l; aseeriyaa raajaa solluki'rathaavathu: neengka'l ennoadea raasiyaaki, kaa'nikkaiyoadea ennidaththil vaarungka'l; naan vanthu, ungka'lai ungka'l theasaththukku oppaana thaaniyamum thiraadchaththoattamumu'l'la theasamum, appamum thiraadcharasamumu'l'la theasamum, oliva e'n'neyum theanumu'l'la theasamumaakiya seemaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoakuma'lavum,

avanavan thanthan thiraadchachsediyin kaniyaiyum thanthan aththimaraththin kaniyaiyum pusiththu, avanavan than than ki'nat'rin tha'n'neeraik kudiyungka'l; ivvithamaay neengka'l saakaamal pizhaippeerka'l; karththar nammaith thappuvippaar en'ru ungka'laip poathanaiseyya eseakkiyaavukkuch sevikodaathirungka'l.
jaathika'ludaiya theavarka'lil yaaraavathu thangka'l theasaththai aseeriyaa raajaavin kaikkuth thappuviththathu'ndoa?
aamaath, arpaath patta'nangka'lin theavarka'l engkea? sepparvaayim, eanaa, eevaap patta'nangka'lin theavarka'l engkea? avarka'l samaariyaavai en kaikkuth thappuviththathu'ndoa?
karththar erusaleamai en kaikkuth thappuvippaar enpatha'rku, anthath theasangka'ludaiya ellaa theavarka'lukku'l'lum thangka'l theasaththai en kaikkuth thappuviththavar yaar enki'raar en'ru sonnaan.
aanaalum janangka'l avanukku oru vaarththaiyum pirathiyuththaramaakach sollaamal mavunamaayirunthaarka'l; avanukku ma'ruuththaravu sollavea'ndaam en'ru raajaa katta'laiyittirunthaan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeem ennum aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, sepnaa ennum sampirathiyum, aasaappin kumaaran yoavaak ennum ka'nakkanum vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, eseakkiyaavinidaththil vanthu, rapsaakkeayin vaarththaika'lai avanukkuth theriviththaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa athaik keattapoathu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, irattu uduththikko'ndu, karththarudaiya aalayaththil piraveasiththu,

aramanai visaarippukkaaranaakiya eliyaakkeemaiyum, sampirathiyaakiya sepnaavaiyum, aasaariyarka'lin moopparaiyum, aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa ennum theerkkatharisiyinidaththukku irattu uduththikko'ndavarka'laaka anuppinaan.
ivarka'l avanai noakki: intha naa'l nerukkamum ka'ndithamum thoosha'namum anupavikki'ra naa'l; pi'l'laipea'ru noakkiyirukki'rathu, pe'ravoa pelanillai.

jeevanu'l'la theavanai ninthikkumpadi aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya than aa'ndavanaal anuppappatta rapsaakkea sonna vaarththaika'laiyellaam umathu theavanaakiya karththar keattirukki'raar; umathu theavanaakiya karththar keattirukki'ra vaarththaika'linimiththam tha'ndanaiseyvaar; aakaiyaal innum meethiyaayirukki'ravarka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappagnseyveeraaka en'ru eseakkiyaa sollachsonnaar en'raarka'l.
ivvithamaay eseakkiyaa raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar easaayaavinidaththil vanthu sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu easaayaa avarka'lai noakki: aseeriyaa raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar ennaith thooshiththathum neer keattathumaana vaarththaika'linaalea payappadaatheayum.

ithoa, avan oru seythiyaik keattu, than theasaththukkuth thirumpuvatha'rkaana aaviyai naan avanukku'l anuppi, avanai avan theasaththilea pattayaththaal vizhappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar enpathai ungka'l aa'ndavanidaththil sollungka'l en'raan.
aseeriyaa raajaa laakeesaivittup pu'rappattaan en'ru kea'lvippattu, rapsaakkea thirumpippoay, avan lipnaavinmeal yuththampa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndaan.
ithoa, eththiyoappiyaa raajaavaakiya theeraakkaa ummoadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattaan en'ru sollak kea'lvippattaan; appozhuthu avan thirumpa eseakkiyaavinidaththukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:

neengka'l yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, erusaleam aseeriyaa raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvathillaiyen'ru nee nampiyirukki'ra un theavan unnai eththa ottaathea.
ithoa, aseeriyaa raajaakka'l sakala theasangka'laiyum sangkariththa seythiyai nee keattirukki'raayea, nee thappuvaayoa?
en pithaakka'l azhiththuvitta koasaanaiyum aaraanaiyum reathseappaiyum, thelaasaariliruntha eatheanin puththiraraiyum avarka'ludaiya theavarka'l thappuviththathu'ndoa?
aamaaththin raajaavum, arpaaththin raajaavum, sepparvaayim eanaa eevaa patta'nangka'lin raajaavum engkea? en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
eseakkiyaa sthaanaapathika'lin kaiyilirunthu nirupaththai vaangki vaasiththa pinpu, avan karththarin aalayaththi'rkup poay, athaik karththarukku munpaaka viriththu,

karththarai noakki: kearupeenka'lin maththiyil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer oruvarea poomiyin raajyangka'lukkellaam theavanaanavar; neer vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkineer.

karththaavea, umathu seviyaich saayththuk kea'lum; karththaavea, neer umathu ka'nka'laith thi'ranthupaarum; sanakerip jeevanu'l'la theavanai ninthikkumpadikkuch solliyanuppina vaarththaika'laik kea'lum.
karththaavea, aseeriyaa raajaakka'l antha jaathika'laiyum avarka'l theasaththaiyum naasamaakki,
avarka'ludaiya theavarka'lai neruppilea poattuvittathu meythaan; avaika'l theavarka'l allavea, manushar kaivealaiyaana maramum kallumthaanea; aakaiyaal avaika'lai nirththoo'liyaakkinaarka'l.

ippoathum engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer oruvarea theavanaakiya karththar en'ru poomiyin raajyangka'l ellaam a'riyumpadikku, engka'lai avan kaikku neengkalaakki iradchiyum en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa eseakkiyaavukkuch solliyanuppinathu: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakeripinnimiththam nee ennai noakkip pa'n'nina vi'n'nappaththaik keattean.

avanaikku'riththuk karththar solluki'ra vasanamaavathu: seeyoan kumaaraththiyaakiya kanniyaasthiree unnai ikazhnthu, unnaip parikaasampa'n'nuki'raa'l; erusaleam kumaaraththi un pinnaalea thalaiyaith thulukkuki'raa'l.
yaarai ninthiththuth thooshiththaay? yaarukku viroathamaay un saththaththai uyarththinaay? nee isravealin parisuththarukku viroathamaayallavoa un ka'nka'lai meattimaiyaaka ea'reduththaay?

un sthaanaapathika'laikko'ndu nee aa'ndavarai ninthiththu: en irathangka'lin thira'linaalea naan malaika'lin kodumudika'lukkum leepanoanin sikarangka'lukkum vanthu ea'rinean; athin uyaramaana keathurumarangka'laiyum, uchchithamaana theavathaari virudchangka'laiyum naan vetti, athin kadaiyaantharath thaaparamattum, athin sezhumaiyaana vanamattum varuvean en'rum,
naan anniyatheasangka'lil ki'na'ru vettith tha'n'neer kudiththean; en u'l'langkaalka'linaal ara'nippaana idangka'lin akazhika'laiyellaam va'ra'lavum pa'n'ninean en'rum sonnaay.

naan vekukaalaththi'rkumun athai niyamiththu, poorvanaadka'lmuthal athaith thittampa'n'ninean enpathai nee keattathillaiyoa? ippozhuthu nee ara'naana patta'nangka'laip paazhaana ma'nmeaduka'l aakkumpadikku naanea athaich sampavikkappa'n'ninean.

athinaalea avaika'lin kudika'l kaiyi'laiththavarka'laaki, kalangki vedkappattu, ve'liyin poo'ndukkum, pachchilaikkum, veeduka'linmeal mu'laikkum pullukkum, oangkiva'larumun theeynthupoam payirukkum samaanamaanaarka'l.
un iruppaiyum, un poakkaiyum, un varavaiyum, nee enakku viroathamaayk kontha'likki'rathaiyum a'rivean.

nee enakku viroathamaayk kontha'liththu, veeriyam peasinathu en sevika'lil ea'rinapadiyinaal, naan en thu'rattai un mookkilum en kadivaa'laththai un vaayilum poattu, nee vanthavazhiyea unnaith thiruppikko'ndupoavean en'ru avanaikku'riththuch solluki'raar.

unakku adaiyaa'lamaayiruppathu ennaven'raal: intha varushaththilea thappip payiraaki'rathaiyum, ira'ndaam varushaththilea thaanaay vi'laiki'rathaiyum saappiduveerka'l; moon'raam varushaththiloa vithaiththu a'ruththu, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'lin kanika'laip pusippeerka'l.
yoothaa vamsaththaaril thappi meenthirukki'ravarka'l ma'rupadiyum keezhea vearpat'ri mealea kanikoduppaarka'l.
meethiyaayirukki'ravarka'l erusaleamilum, thappinavarka'l seeyoan malaiyilum irunthu pu'rappaduvaarka'l; seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vairaakkiyam ithaich seyyum.

aakaiyaal karththar aseeriyaa raajaavaikku'riththu: avan intha nakaraththi'rku'l piraveasippathillai; ithinmeal ampu eyvathumillai; itha'rkumun keadakaththoadea varuvathumillai; itha'rku ethiraakak koththa'lam poaduvathumillai.
avan intha nakaraththi'rku'l piraveasiyaamal, thaan vanthavazhiyea thirumpippoavaan.
en nimiththamum en thaasanaakiya thaaveethin nimiththamum naan intha nakaraththai iradchikkumpadikku, itha'rku aatharavaayiruppean enpathaik karththar uraikki'raar en'ru solliyanuppinaan.
