an'ru iraaththiriyil sampaviththathu ennaven'raal: karththarudaiya thoothan pu'rappattu, aseeriyarin paa'layaththil ladchaththe'npaththaiyaayirampearaich sangkariththaan; athikaalamea ezhunthirukkumpoathu, ithoa, avarka'l ellaarum seththa pireathangka'laayk kidanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip pirayaa'nappattu, thirumpippoay niniveayil irunthuvittaan.

avan than theavanaakiya nisroakin koavililea pa'ninthuko'l'luki'rapoathu, avan kumaararaakiya athramaleakkum sareathsearum avanaip pattayaththinaal vettippoattu, aararaath theasaththi'rkuth thappi oadippoanaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya esaraththoan avan pattaththi'rku vanthu arasaa'ndaan.

annaadka'lil eseakkiyaa viyaathippattu mara'naththukku eathuvaayirunthaan; appozhuthu aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa ennum theerkkatharisi avanidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: neer umathu veettukkaariyaththai ozhungkuppaduththum; neer pizhaikkamaatteer, mariththuppoaveer en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa than mukaththaich suvarppu'ramaakath thiruppikko'ndu, karththarai noakki:

aa karththaavea, naan umakku munpaaka u'nmaiyum mana uththamamumaay nadanthu, umathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seythean enpathai ninaiththaru'lum en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan. eseakkiyaa mikavum azhuthaan.
easaayaa paathi mut'raththaivittu appu'ram poaki'ratha'rkumunnea, karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaaki, avar sonnathu:

nee thirumpippoay, en janaththin athipathiyaakiya eseakkiyaavai noakki: un thakappanaakiya thaaveethin theavanaayirukki'ra karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: un vi'n'nappaththaik keattean, un ka'n'neeraik ka'ndean; ithoa, naan unnaik ku'namaakkuvean; moon'raam naa'lilea nee karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poavaay.

un naadka'loadea pathinainthu varushangka'laik koottuvean; unnaiyum intha nakaraththaiyum aseeriyaa raajaavin kaikkuth thappuviththu, en nimiththamum en thaasanaakiya thaaveethin nimiththamum intha nakaraththukku aatharavaay iruppean en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu easaayaa: aththippazhaththu adaiyaik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; athai avarka'l ko'nduvanthu, pi'lavaiyinmeal pat'ruppoattapoathu avan pizhaiththaan.
eseakkiyaa easaayaavai noakki: karththar ennaik ku'namaakkuvatha'rkum, moon'raam naa'lilea naan karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkup poavatha'rkum adaiyaa'lam enna en'raan.

atha'rku easaayaa: karththar thaam sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea seyvaarenpatha'rku, karththaraal unakku u'ndaakum adaiyaa'lamaakach saayai paththuppaakai munnittup poakavea'ndumoa, paththuppaakai pinnittuth thirumpa vea'ndumoa en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku eseakkiyaa: saayai paththuppaakai munnittuppoaki'rathu leasaana kaariyam; appadi vea'ndaam; saayai paththuppaakai pinnittuth thirumpavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu easaayaa theerkkatharisi karththarai noakkik kooppidukaiyil, avar aakaasudaiya sooriya kadiyaaraththil paakaikkup paakai munpoana saayai paththuppaakai pinnittuth thirumpumpadi seythaar.

akkaalaththilea palaathaanin kumaaranaakiya peroathaakpalaathaan ennum paapiloanin raajaa eseakkiyaa viyaathippattirukki'rathaik keattu, avanidaththukku nirupangka'laiyum vekumaanaththaiyum anuppinaan.

eseakkiyaa avarka'lai angkikariththu, pinpu avarka'lukkuth than pokkishasaalai anaiththaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, nalla parima'lathailaththaiyum, than aayuthasaalai anaiththaiyum than pokkishasaalaika'lilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum kaa'npiththaan; than aramanaiyilum than raajyaththil engkum eseakkiyaa avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiyaatha poru'l on'rum illai.

appozhuthu easaayaa theerkkatharisi eseakkiyaa raajaavinidaththil vanthu: antha manushar enna sonnaarka'l, engkeayirunthu ummidaththil vanthaarka'l en'ru keattaan. atha'rku eseakkiyaa: paapiloan ennum thooratheasaththilirunthu vanthaarka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: ummudaiya veettil ennaththaip paarththaarka'l en'ru keattaan. atha'rku eseakkiyaa: en veettilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum paarththaarka'l; en pokkishangka'lil naan avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiyaatha poru'l on'rum illai en'raan.
appozhuthu easaayaa eseakkiyaavai noakki: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lum.
ithoa, naadka'l varum; appozhuthu umathu veettil u'l'lathilum, umathu pithaakka'l innaa'lvaraikkum searththathilum on'rum meethiyaaka vaikkappadaamal ellaam paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoakappadum.
neer pe'rappoaki'ra umathu santhaanamaakiya umathu kumaararka'lilum silar paapiloan raajaavin aramanaiyilea aramanai vealaikkaararaayiruppaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa easaayaavai noakki: neer sonna karththarudaiya vaarththai nallathuthaan en'ru solli, en naadka'lilaavathu samaathaanamum u'nmaiyum irukkumea en'raan.

eseakkiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avanudaiya ellaa vallamaiyum, avan oru ku'laththaiyum saalakaththaiyum u'ndaakkinathinaalea tha'n'neerai nakaraththi'rku'l'lea varappa'n'ninathum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
eseakkiyaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya manaasea avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
manaasea raajaavaaki'rapoathu pannira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, aimpaththainthu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; avan thaayinpear epsipaa'l.
karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththina jaathika'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadiyea, avan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu,

than thakappanaakiya eseakkiyaa idiththuppoatta meadaika'laith thirumpavum katti, paakaalukkup palipeedangka'lai eduppiththu, isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaap seythathupoala vikkirakaththoappai u'ndaakki, vaanaththin seanaika'laiyellaam pa'ninthuko'ndu avaika'laich seaviththaan.
erusaleamilea en naamaththai vi'langkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sollik ku'riththa karththarudaiya aalayaththilea avan palipeedangka'laik katti,
karththarudaiya aalayaththin ira'ndu piraakaarangka'lilum vaanaththin seanaika'lukkellaam palipeedangka'laik katti,

than kumaaranaith theemithikkappa'n'ni, naa'lpaarkki'ravanum nimiththampaarkki'ravanumaayirunthu, agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum vaiththu, karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaaka avar paarvaikkup pollaappaanathai mikuthiyaaych seythaan.

intha aalayaththilum, naan isravealin sakala koaththirangka'lilumirunthu therinthuko'nda erusaleamilum, en naamaththai en'raikkum vi'langkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar thaaveethoadum avan kumaaranaakiya saalomoanoadum sollik ku'riththa aalayaththilea avan pa'n'nina thoappuvikkirakaththai vaiththaan.

naan avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa ellaavat'rinpadiyeayum, en thaasanaakiya moasea avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa ellaa niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyeayum seyya jaakkirathaiyaay irunthaarka'leayaanaal, naan ini isravealin kaalai avarka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththaivittu alaiyappa'n'nuvathillai en'ru solliyirunthaar.
aanaalum avarka'l kea'laatheapoanaarka'l; karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaaka azhiththa jaathika'l seytha pollaappaippaarkkilum athikamaaych seyya manaasea avarka'lai eavivittaan.
aakaiyaal karththar theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu uraiththathu:

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya manaasea thanakku munniruntha emoariyar seytha ellaavat'raippaarkkilum keadaaka intha aruvaruppuka'laich seythu, than narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal yoothaavaiyum paavagnseyyappa'n'ninapadiyinaal,

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, keadkappoaki'ra yaavarudaiya ira'ndu kaathuka'lilum athu thoniththukko'ndirukkumpadiyaana pollaappai naan erusaleaminmealum yoothaavinmealum varappa'n'ni,

erusaleaminmeal samaariyaavin mattanoolaiyum aakaap veettin thookkunoolaiyum pidippean; oruvan oru thaalaththaith thudaiththup pinpu athaik kavizhththuvaikki'rathupoala erusaleamaith thudaiththuviduvean.

avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'lmutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, enakkuk koapam moottivanthapadiyinaal, en suthantharaththil meethiyaanathaik kaivittu, avarka'l pakaignarin kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkoduppean.
thangka'l pakaignarukkellaam ko'l'laiyum soo'raiyumaayp poavaarka'l en'raar.

karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyyumpadiyaaka, manaasea yoothaavaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina anthap paavamum thavira, avan erusaleamai naalu moolaivaraiyum iraththappazhika'laal nirappaththakkathaay, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaiyum mikuthiyaakach sinthinaan.
manaaseayin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, avan seytha paavamum yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

manaasea than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan oosaavin thoattamaakiya than aramanaith thoattaththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya aamoan raajaavaanaan.
aamoan raajaavaanapoathu irupaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, ira'ndu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; yoathpaa ooraanaakiya aaroothsin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayinpear mesulleameath.
avan than thakappanaakiya manaasea seythathupoala, karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu,
than thakappan nadantha ellaa vazhiyilum nadanthu, than thakappan seaviththa narakalaana vikkirakangka'laich seaviththu avaika'laip pa'ninthuko'ndu,
karththarin vazhiyilea nadavaamal, than pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai vittuvittaan.
aamoanin oozhiyakkaarar avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, raajaavai avan aramanaiyilea kon'rupoattaarka'l.
athinaal theasaththu janangka'l raajaavaakiya aamoanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ninavarka'laiyellaam vettippoattu, avan kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaavai avan sthaanaththil raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
aamoan seytha mat'ra varththamaanangka'l yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
avan oosaavin thoattaththilu'l'la avanudaiya kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaa raajaavaanaan.
yoasiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu, ettu vayathaayirunthu, muppaththoru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; poaskaath ooraanaakiya athaayaavin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayinpear ethithaa'l.
avan karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythu, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin vazhiyilellaam valathu idathupu'ram vilakaamal nadanthaan.
raajaavaakiya yoasiyaavin pathinettaam varushaththilea, raajaa mesullaamin kumaaranaakiya athsaliyaavin makan saappaan ennum sampirathiyaik karththarin aalayaththukku anuppi:

nee pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaavinidaththil poay, karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvarappattathum vaasalkaakki'ravarka'l janaththin kaiyilea vaangkappattathumaana pa'naththai avan thokaipaarththu,

pi'rpaadu avarka'l athaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai visaarikki'ravarka'l kaiyilea koduththu, avarka'l athaik karththarin aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkki'ratha'rkaaka athilirukki'ra vealaikkaararaakiya,
thachcharukkum, si'rpaasaarika'lukkum, kot'rarukkum, aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkumpadi vea'ndiya marangka'laiyum vettina ka'rka'laiyum vaangkuki'ratha'rkum selavazhikkavea'ndum.

aakilum anthap pa'naththaith thangka'l kaiyil oppuviththukko'l'luki'ravarka'loa kaariyaththai u'nmaiyaay nadappikki'rapadiyinaal, avarka'lidaththil athin ka'nakkaik keadkavea'ndiyathillai en'ru sol en'raan.

appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaa sampirathiyaakiya saappaanai noakki: naan karththarin aalayaththilea niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththaik ka'ndupidiththean en'ru solli, anthap pusthakaththaich saappaanidaththil koduththaan; avan athai vaasiththaan.

appozhuthu sampirathiyaakiya saappaan raajaavinidaththil vanthu, raajaavukku ma'ruuththaravu solli, aalayaththilea thokaiyittuk ka'nda pa'naththai umathu adiyaar searththuk katti, athaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai visaarikki'ravarka'l kaiyilea koduththaarka'l en'ru sonnaan.
sampirathiyaakiya saappaan pinnaiyum raajaavai noakki: aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaa ennidaththil oru pusthakaththaik koduththaan en'ru a'riviththu, athai raajaavukku munpaaka vaasiththaan.
raajaa niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththin vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu,

aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaavukkum, saappaanin kumaaranaakiya akeekkaamukkum, mikaayaavin kumaaranaakiya akpoarukkum, sampirathiyaakiya saappaanukkum, raajaavin oozhiyakkaaranaakiya asaayaavukkum raajaa katta'laiyittathu:

ka'ndedukkappatta inthap pusthakaththin vaarththaika'linimiththam neengka'l poay, enakkaakavum janaththi'rkaakavum yoothaavanaiththi'rkaakavum karththaridaththil visaariyungka'l; namakkaaka ezhuthiyirukki'ra ellaavat'rinpadiyeayum seyya nammudaiya pithaakka'l inthap pusthakaththin vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodaathapadiyinaal, nammeal pat'riyerintha karththarudaiya ukkiram periyathu en'raan.

appozhuthu aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaavum, akeekkaamum, akpoarum, saappaanum, asaayaavum, arkaasin kumaaranaakiya thikvaavin makanaana salloom ennum vasthirasaalai visaarippukkaaran manaiviyaakiya ulthaa'l ennum theerkkatharisiyaanava'lidaththi'rkup poay ava'loadea peasinaarka'l; ava'l erusaleamin ira'ndaam vakuppilea kudiyirunthaa'l.
ava'l avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lai ennidaththil anuppinavaridaththil neengka'l poay: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal:
ithoa, yoothaavin raajaa vaasiththa pusthakaththin vaarththaika'lilellaam kaattiyirukki'ra pollaappai naan intha sthalaththinmealum, athin kudika'linmealum varappa'n'nuvean.

avarka'l ennaivittu, thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaika'l ellaavat'rilum enakkuk koapamu'ndaakka vea'rea theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattinapadiyinaal, en ukkiram intha sthalaththinmeal pat'riyeriyum; athu avinthupoavathu illaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sollungka'l.

karththaridaththil visaarikki'ratha'rku ungka'lai anuppina yoothaavin raajaavinidaththil neengka'l poay: neer keatta vaarththaika'laik ku'riththu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:

naan intha sthalaththi'rkum athin kudika'lukkum viroathamaaka, avarka'l paazhum saapamumaavaarka'l en'ru sonnathai nee keattapoathu, un iruthayam i'laki, nee karththarukku munpaaka unnaith thaazhththi, un vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, enakkumunpaaka azhuthapadiyinaal naanum un vi'n'nappaththaik keattean.

aakaiyaal, ithoa, naan unnai un pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea searththukko'l'luvean; nee samaathaanaththoadea un kalla'raiyil searvaay; naan intha sthalaththinmeal varappa'n'num sakala pollaappaiyum un ka'nka'l kaa'npathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar enpathaich sollungka'l en'raa'l; intha ma'ruuththaravai avarka'l poay raajaavukkuch sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu raajaa yoothaavilum erusaleamilum iruntha moopparaiyellaam azhaippiththaan; avarka'l avanidaththil koodinapoathu,

raajaavum, avanoadu yoothaavin manushar yaavarum erusaleamin kudika'l anaivarum, aasaariyarka'lum, theerkkatharisika'lum, si'riyoarthuvakkip periyoarmattumu'l'la sakalarum karththarin aalayaththukkup poanaarka'l; karththarudaiya aalayaththilea ka'ndedukkappatta udanpadikkai pusthakaththin vaarththaika'laiyellaam avarka'l kaathuka'l keadka vaasiththaan.

appozhuthu raajaa, thoo'n arukea nin'ru, karththaraip pinpat'ri nadakkavum, avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum avarudaiya saadchika'laiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum muzhu iruthayaththoadum muzhu aaththumaavoadum kaikko'l'lavum, anthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra antha udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'ravum karththarudaiya sannithiyil udanpadikkaipa'n'ninaan; janangka'l ellaarum udanpadikkaikku udpattaarka'l.

pinpu raajaa: paakaalukkum vikkirakaththoappukkum vaanaththin sakala seanaika'lukkum pa'n'nappattiruntha sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu pu'rampaakka, pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaavukkum ira'ndaam vakuppilu'l'la aasaariyarka'lukkum vaasal kaakki'ravarka'lukkum katta'laiyittu, avaika'lai erusaleamukkup pu'rampaayk keetharoan ve'lika'lil sutteriththu, avaika'lin saampalaip peththealukkuk ko'ndupoakappa'n'ninaan.

yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamaich sut'rilum meadaika'linmeal thoopangkaatta, yoothaavin raajaakka'l vaiththa poojaasaarika'laiyum, paakaalukkum sooriyanukkum santhiranukkum kirakangka'lukkum vaanaththin sakala seanaika'lukkum thoopangkaattinavarka'laiyum akat'rivittaan.

thoappu vikkirakaththaik karththarin aalayaththilirunthu erusaleamukkup pu'rampea keetharoan aat'ri'rkuk ko'ndupoay, athaik keetharoan aat'ru oaraththilea sutteriththu, athaith thoo'laakki, anthath thoo'lai janapuththirarudaiya pireathak kuzhika'linmeal poaduviththaan.
karththarin aalayaththi'rku arukea sthireeka'l thoappu vikkirakaththukkuk koodaarangka'lai neytha idaththilu'l'la ilachchaiyaana pu'narchchikkaararin veeduka'lai idiththuppoattaan.

avan yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilu'l'la ellaa aasaariyaraiyum varachsolli, keapaamuthal peyersepaamattum aasaariyarka'l thoopangkaattiyiruntha meadaika'laith theettaakki, olimukavaasalka'lin meadaika'laiyum, patta'naththu vaasalukkuppoakum vazhikku idathupu'ramaayirukki'ra patta'naththalaivanaakiya yoasuvaavin vaasa'rpadiyil iruntha meadaiyaiyum idiththuppoattaan.

meadaika'lin aasaariyarka'l erusaleamilirukki'ra karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal paliyidaamal, thangka'l sakoathararukku'l'lea pu'lippillaatha appangka'laip pusikki'ratha'rkumaaththiram uththaaram pet'raarka'l.

oruvanum moa'leakukken'ru than kumaaranaiyaakilum than kumaaraththiyaiyaakilum theekkadakkappa'n'naathapadikku, innoam puththirarin pa'l'laththaakkilirukki'ra thoappeath ennum sthalaththaiyum avan theettaakki,

karththarin aalayaththi'rku'l poaki'ra idanthodangki, patta'naththukkup pu'rampea irukki'ra naaththaanmelek ennum pirathaaniyin a'raiveedumattum yoothaavin raajaakka'l sooriyanukken'ru vaiththiruntha kuthiraika'lai akat'ri, sooriyanin irathangka'lai akkiniyil sutteriththaan.

yoothaavin raajaakka'l u'ndaakkinathum, aakaasudaiya mealveettil irunthathumaana palipeedangka'laiyum, manaasea karththarudaiya aalayaththin ira'ndu piraakaarangka'lilum u'ndaakkina palipeedangka'laiyum raajaa idiththu, avaika'lin thoo'lai angkeayirunthu eduththuk keetharoan aat'ril kottinaan.

erusaleamukku ethirea irukki'ra naasamalaiyin valathupu'raththil isravealin raajaavaakiya saalomoan seethoaniyarin aruvaruppaakiya astharoaththi'rkum, moavaapiyarin aruvaruppaakiya kaamoasukkum, ammoan puththirarin aruvaruppaakiya milkoamukkum kattiyiruntha meadaika'laiyum raajaa theettaakki,
silaika'lai udaiththu, vikkirakath thoappuka'lai nirmoolamaakki, avaika'lin sthalaththai manusharin elumpuka'laal nirappinaan.

isravealaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nina neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaam peththealil u'ndaakkiyiruntha palipeedamum meadaiyum aakiya avvira'ndaiyum avan idiththu, antha meadaiyaich sutteriththuth thoo'laakki, vikkirakaththoappaiyum sutteriththaan.

yoasiyaa thirumpippaarkki'rapoathu angkea antha malaiyilirukki'ra kalla'raika'laik ka'ndu, aadka'lai anuppi, anthak kalla'raika'lilu'l'la elumpuka'lai eduththuvarachseythu, ippadi nadakkum en'ru theavanudaiya manushan koo'rina karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, avaika'lai anthap palipeedaththinmeal sutteriththu athaith theettaakkinaan.

appozhuthu avan: naan kaa'nki'ra anthak ku'rippadaiyaa'lam enna en'ru keattatha'rku, anthap patta'naththu manushar: athu yoothaavilirunthu vanthu, neer seytha inthak kiriyaika'laip peththealin palipeedaththi'rku viroathamaayk koo'ri, a'riviththa theavanudaiya manushanin kalla'rai en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: irukkattum, oruvanum avan elumpuka'laith thodavea'ndaam en'raan; appadiyea avan elumpuka'laich samaariyaavilirunthu vantha theerkkatharisiyin elumpuka'loadu vittuvittaarka'l.

karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakka isravealin raajaakka'l samaariyaavin patta'nangka'lil u'ndaakkiyiruntha meadaika'lin koavilka'laiyellaam yoasiyaa thakarththu, peththealilea thaan seytha seykaika'linpadiyea avaika'lukkuch seythu,
avvidangka'lil irukki'ra meadaika'lin aasaariyarka'laiyellaam palipeedangka'linmeal kon'rupoattu, avaika'linmeal manusharin elumpuka'laich sutteriththu, erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaan.
pinpu raajaa: intha udanpadikkaiyin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup paskaavai aasariyungka'l en'ru sakala janangka'lukkum katta'laiyittaan.

isravealai niyaayam visaariththa niyaayaathipathika'lin naadka'l thodangki, isravealin raajaakka'l yoothaavin raajaakka'l aakiya avarka'ludaiya sakala naadka'lilum inthap paskaavaippoal paskaa aasarikkappadavillai.
raajaavaakiya yoasiyaavin pathinettaam varushaththilea karththarukku inthap paskaa erusaleamilea aasarikkappattathu.

aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaa karththarudaiya aalayaththil ka'ndeduththa pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'rumpadikku, yoasiyaa agnchanakkaararaiyum, ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum, suroopangka'laiyum narakalaana vikkirakangka'laiyum, yoothaatheasaththilum erusaleamilum kaa'nappatta ellaa aruvaruppuka'laiyum nirmoolamaakkinaan.

karththaridaththukkuth than muzhu iruthayaththoadum than muzhu aaththumaavoadum than muzhu palaththoadum moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku eat'rapadiyellaam seyya manathaich saayththaan; avanaip poaloththa raajaa avanukkumun irunthathumillai, avanukkuppin ezhumpinathumillai.
aakilum, manaasea karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakkina sakala kaariyangka'linimiththamum avar yoothaavinmeal ko'nda thammudaiya makaa koapaththin ukkiraththai vittuth thirumpaamal:

naan isravealaith tha'l'livittathupoala yoothaavaiyum en mukaththai vittuth tha'l'li, naan therinthuko'nda intha erusaleam nakaraththaiyum, en naamam vi'langkum en'ru naan sonna aalayaththaiyum ve'ruththuviduvean en'ru karththar sonnaar.
yoasiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

avan naadka'lil ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanneakoa aseeriyaa raajaavukku viroathamaay aipiraaththu nathikkup poaki'rapoathu raajaavaakiya yoasiyaa avanukku ethiraakap pu'rappattaan; paarvoanneakoa avanai mekithoavilea ka'ndapoathu, avanaik kon'rupoattaan.

mara'namadaintha avanai avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar rathaththinmeal eat'ri, mekithoavilirunthu erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthu, avanai avan kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; appozhuthu theasaththin janangka'l yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaasai azhaiththu, avanai apisheakampa'n'ni, avan thakappan sthaanaththil avanai raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
yoavaakaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththumoon'ru vayathaayirunthu, moon'rumaatham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; lipnaa ooraanaakiya ereamiyaavin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayinpear amuththaa'l.
avan than pithaakka'l seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

avan erusaleamil arasaa'laathapadikku, paarvoanneakoa avanai aamaath theasamaana riplaavilea pidiththuk kattuviththu, theasaththinmeal noo'ru thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum oru thaalanthu ponnaiyum aparaathamaakach sumaththi,

yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeemai avan thakappanaakiya yoasiyaavin sthaanaththil raajaavaaka vaiththu, avan pearai yoayaakkeem en'ru maat'ri, yoavaakaasaik ko'ndupoayvittaan; ivan ekipthilea poay angkea mara'namadainthaan.

antha ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum yoayaakkeem paarvoanukkuk koduththaan; aanaalum paarvoanudaiya katta'laiyinpadi anthap pa'naththaik kodukkumpadi avan theasaththai mathippittu, avaravar mathippinpadi antha ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum paarvoan neakoavukkuk kodukkaththakkathaakath theasaththu janangka'lin kaiyilea tha'ndinaan.
yoayaakkeem raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, pathinoru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; roomaa ooraanaakiya pethaayaamin kumaaraththiyaakiya avan thaayinpear seputhaa'l.
avan than pithaakka'l seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
avan naadka'lilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar vanthaan; yoayaakkeem moon'ru varusham avanaich seaviththu, pinpu avanukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu karththar kaltheayarin tha'nduka'laiyum, seeriyarin tha'nduka'laiyum, moavaapiyarin tha'nduka'laiyum, ammoan puththirarin tha'nduka'laiyum avanmeal varavittaar; theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu karththar sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea avar avaika'lai yoothaavai azhikkumpadikku varavittaar.
manaasea than ellaach seykaika'linaalum seytha paavangka'linimiththam yoothaavaith thamathu samukaththai vittu akat'rumpadi karththarudaiya katta'laiyinaal appadi nadanthathu.
avan sinthina kut'ramat'ra iraththaththi'rkaakavum erusaleamaik kut'ramat'ra iraththaththaal nirappinatha'rkaakavum karththar mannikkach siththamillaathirunthaar.
yoayaakkeemin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythavai yaavum, yoothaavudaiya raajaakka'lin naa'laakamap pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoayaakkeem than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeen avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
ekipthin raajaa appu'ram than theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattu varavillai; ekipthin nathithuvakki aipiraaththu nathimattum ekipthin raajaavukku iruntha yaavaiyum paapiloan raajaa pidiththirunthaan.
yoayaakkeen raajaavaaki'rapoathu pathinettu vayathaayirunthu, erusaleamilea moon'rumaatham arasaa'ndaan; erusaleam ooraanaakiya elnaaththaanin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayinpear nekusthaa'l.
avan than thakappan seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
akkaalaththilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarin seavakar erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l; nakaram mut'rikkai poadappattathu.
paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarudaiya seavakar nakaraththai mut'rikkai poadukaiyil avan thaanum atha'rku viroathamaay vanthaan.

appozhuthu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeenum, avan thaayum, avan oozhiyakkaararum, avan pirapukka'lum, pirathaanika'lum paapiloan raajaavinidaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; avanaip paapiloan raajaa than aa'lukaiyin ettaam varushaththilea pidiththukko'ndaan.

angkeayirunthu karththarudaiya aalayaththin sakala pokkishangka'laiyum, raajaavudaiya aramanaiyin pokkishangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, isravealin raajaavaakiya saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththil u'ndaakkiyiruntha pon pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam, karththar solliyirunthapadiyea udaiththuppoattu,

erusaleamiyar anaivarum sakala pirapukka'lum sakala paraakkiramasaalika'lumaakiya pathinaayirampearaiyum, sakala thachcharaiyum kollaraiyum si'raipidiththukko'ndupoanaan; theasaththil eazhai janangka'lea allaamal vea'roruvarum meethiyaayirukkavillai.

avan yoayaakkeenaiyum, raajaavin thaayaiyum, raajaavin sthireeka'laiyum, avan pirathaanika'laiyum, theasaththin paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoanaan.

ippadiyea paapiloan raajaa paraakkiramasaalika'laana manusharaakiya eazhaayirampearaiyum, thachcharum kollarumaakiya aayirampearaiyum, yuththampa'n'naththakka palasaalika'laiyum paapiloanukkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoanaan.
avanukkup pathilaakap paapiloan raajaa avan si'riyathakappanaakiya maththaniyaavai raajaavaaka vaiththu, avanukkuch sitheakkiyaa en'ru ma'rupearittaan.
sitheakkiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththoru vayathaayirunthu, pathinoru varusham erusaleamilea arasaa'ndaan; lipnaa ooraanaakiya ereamiyaavin kumaaraththiyaana avan thaayinpear amuththaa'l.
yoayaakkeem seythapadiyellaam avanum karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

erusaleamaiyum yoothaavaiyum karththar thammudaiya samukaththaivittu akat'rith theeruma'lavum, avaika'linmealu'l'la avarudaiya koapaththinaal ippadi nadanthathum allaamal, sitheakkiyaa paapiloanilea raajaavukku viroathamaakak kalakamumpa'n'ninaan.

avan raajyapaarampa'n'num onpathaam varusham paththaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvamum erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthu, atha'rku ethirea paa'layami'rangki, sut'rilum atha'rku ethiraakak koththa'langka'laik kattinaarka'l.
appadiyea sitheakkiyaa raajaavin pathinoaraam varushamattum nakaram mut'rikkai poadappattirunthathu.
naalaam maatham onpathaantheathiyilea pagncham nakaraththilea athikariththu, theasaththin janaththi'rku aakaaram illaama'rpoayit'ru; nakaraththin mathilil thi'rappu ka'ndathu.

appozhuthu kaltheayar nakaraththaich soozhnthirukkaiyil, yuththamanushar ellaarum iraaththirikaalaththil raajaavudaiya thoattaththin vazhiyaay ira'ndu mathilka'lukku naduvaana vaasalaal thappi, avarka'lum raajaavumaaych samanaana poomiyai noakki oadippoanaarka'l.
kaltheayarin iraa'nuvaththaar raajaavaip pinthodarnthu erikoavin samanaana poomiyil avanaip pidiththaarka'l; appozhuthu avanudaiya iraa'nuvamellaam avanai vittuch sitha'rippoayit'ru.
avarka'l raajaavaip pidiththu, avanai riplaavilirukki'ra paapiloan raajaavinidaththukkuk ko'ndupoay, avanai niyaayantheerththu,
sitheakkiyaavin kumaararai avan ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vetti, sitheakkiyaavin ka'nka'laik kurudaakki, avanukku ira'ndu ve'nkala vilangkuka'laip poattu, avanaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

ainthaam maatham eazhaantheathiyilea neapukaathneachchaar ennum paapiloan raajaavin paththonpathaam varushaththilea, paapiloan raajaavin oozhiyakkaaranaakiya nepusaraathaan ennum kaaval seanaapathi erusaleamukku vanthu,
karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum, raajaavin aramanaiyaiyum, erusaleamin sakala kattadangka'laiyum, periya veeduka'l ellaavat'raiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththuvittaan.
kaaval seanaapathiyoadiruntha kaltheayarin iraa'nuvaththaarellaarum erusaleamaichsut'rilum iruntha alangkangka'lai idiththuppoattaarka'l.

nakaraththil meethiyaana mat'ra janaththaiyum, paapiloan raajaavin vasamaaka oadivanthuvittavarka'laiyum, mat'ra janakkoottaththaiyum, kaaval seanaapathiyaakiya nepusaraathaan si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoanaan.
theasaththil eazhaiyaana silaraith thiraadchaththoattakkaararaakavum payiridungkudika'laakavum vittirunthaan.

karththarudaiya aalayaththiliruntha ve'nkalath thoo'nka'laiyum, athiliruntha aathaarangka'laiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththiliruntha ve'nkalak kadalthottiyaiyum, kaltheayar udaiththuppoattu, avaika'lin ve'nkalaththaip paapiloanukku eduththukko'ndupoanaarka'l.
seppuchsattika'laiyum, saampal paaththirangka'laiyum, kaththika'laiyum, thoopakalasangka'laiyum, aaraathanaikkaduththa sakala ve'nkalap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum eduththukko'ndaarka'l.
suththap ponnum suththa ve'l'liyumaana thoopakalasangka'laiyum kalangka'laiyum kaaval seanaapathi eduththukko'ndaan.
saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththukkaakap pa'n'nuviththa ira'ndu thoo'nka'lum, oru kadalthottiyum aathaarangka'lumaakiya anthach sakala pa'nimuttuka'ludaiya ve'nkalaththi'rkum ni'raiyillai.

oru thoo'nin uyaram pathinettu muzhamaayirunthathu; athinmeal atha'rku moon'rumuzha uyaramaana ve'nkalath thalaippum u'ndaayirunthathu; kumizhilea sut'rilum seyyappattiruntha pinnalum maatha'lampazhangka'lum ellaam ve'nkalamaayirunthathu; mat'rath thoo'num athin pinnalum athaippoal irunthathu.
kaaval seanaapathi pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya seraayaavaiyum, ira'ndaam aasaariyanaakiya seppaniyaavaiyum, vaasalkaakkum moon'ru kaava'rkaararaiyum pidiththaan.

nakaraththilea avan yuththamanusharin visaarippukkaaranaakiya pirathaani oruvanaiyum, raajaavin manthirika'lilea nakaraththil akappatta ainthupearaiyum, theasaththin janaththaich seavakam ezhuthuki'ra thalaivanaana iraa'nuvachsampirathiyaiyum, theasajanaththilea nakaraththil akappatta a'rupathupearaiyum pidiththaan.
avarka'laik kaaval seanaapathiyaakiya nepusaraathaan pidiththu, riplaavil irukki'ra paapiloan raajaavinidaththukkuk ko'ndupoanaan.

avarka'laip paapiloan raajaa aamaath theasaththin patta'namaana riplaavilea vettik kon'rupoattaan; ippadiyea yoothaa janangka'l thangka'l theasaththilirunthu si'raiyiruppukkuk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.
paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar, yootheayaatheasaththil meethiyaaka vaiththa janaththinmeal, saappaanin kumaaranaakiya akeekkaamin makan kethaliyaavai athikaariyaaka vaiththaan.

paapiloan raajaa kethaliyaavai athikaariyaaka vaiththathai, sakala iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum avarka'ludaiya manusharum keattapoathu, avarka'l mispaavil irukki'ra kethaliyaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l; avarka'l yaarenil, neththaniyaavin kumaaran ismavealum, kareayaavin kumaaran yoakanaanum, neththoappaaththiyanaakiya thankoomeaththin kumaaran seraayaavum, maakaaththiyanaana oruvanudaiya kumaaran yasaniyaavum avarka'l manusharumea.

appozhuthu kethaliyaa avarka'lukkum avarka'l manusharukkum aa'naiyittu: neengka'l kaltheayaraich seavikkap payappadavea'ndaam; theasaththilirunthu paapiloan raajaavaich seaviyungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'lukku nanmai u'ndaakum en'raan.

eazhaam maathaththilea, raajavamsaththilea pi'rantha elisaamaavin kumaaranaakiya neththaniyaavin kumaaran ismaveal paththu manusharoadeakooda vanthu, kethaliyaavaiyum, avanoadea mispaaviliruntha yootharaiyum, kaltheayaraiyum vettik kon'rupoattaan.
appozhuthu si'riyoarum periyoarumaakiya janangka'l yaavarum seanaapathika'lum kaltheayarukkup payanthathinaalea ezhunthu pu'rappattu ekipthi'rkup poanaarka'l.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeenudaiya si'raiyiruppin muppaththeazhaam varusham pannira'ndaam maatham irupaththeazhaantheathiyilea, eavilmerothaak ennum paapiloan raajaa, thaan raajaavaana varushaththilea, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeenaich si'raichsaalaiyilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avan thalaiyai uyarththi,
avanoadea anpaayp peasi, avanudaiya singkaasanaththaith thannoadea paapiloanilirunthu raajaakka'lin singkaasanangka'lukku uyaramaaka vaiththu,
avanudaiya si'raichsaalai vasthirangka'lai maat'rinaan; avan uyiroadiruntha sakala naa'lum niththam thanakku munpaakap poajanampa'n'numpadi seythaan.
avan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam avanudaiya selavukkaaka, raajaavinaal katta'laiyaana anuthinath thittaththinpadi, anuthinamum kodukkappattuvanthathu.
aathaam, seath, eanoas,
keanaan, makalaaleyeal, yaareath,
eanoakku, meththoosalaa, laameakku,
noavaa, seam, kaam, yaappeath,
yaappeaththin kumaarar, koamar, maakoaku, maathaay, yaavaan, thoopaal, measeakku, theeraas enpavarka'l.
koamarin kumaarar, askinaas, reeppaaththu, thokarmaa enpavarka'l.
yaavaanin kumaarar, eleesaa, tharshees, kiththeem, thothaaneem enpavarka'l.
kaamin kumaarar, koosh, misraayim, pooth, kaanaan enpavarka'l.
kooshin kumaarar, seapaa, aavilaa, sapthaa, raamaa, sapthikaa enpavarka'l; raamaavin kumaarar, seapaa, thithaan enpavarka'l.
koosh nimroathaip pet'raan; ivan poomiyilea paraakkiramasaaliyaanaan.
misraayim lootheemiyaraiyum, aanaamiyaraiyum, lekaapiyaraiyum, napthookiyaraiyum,
pathroosiyaraiyum, pelistharaip pet'ra kaslookiyaraiyum, kapthoariyaraiyum pet'raan.
kaanaan than mooththamakanaakiya seethoanaiyum, keaththaiyum,
epoosiyaraiyum, emoariyaraiyum, kirkaasiyaraiyum,
eaviyaraiyum, arkeeyaraiyum, seeniyaraiyum,
arvaathiyaraiyum, semaariyaraiyum, kaamaaththiyaraiyum pet'raan.
seamin kumaarar, ealaam, asoor, arpaksaath, looth, aaraam, ooths, kool, keathther, measak enpavarka'l.
arpaksaath saalaavaip pet'raan; saalaa eapearaip pet'raan.
eapearukku ira'ndu kumaarar pi'ranthaarka'l; oruvan pear pealeaku, eanenil avan naadka'lil poomi pakukkappattathu; avan sakoatharan pear yokthaan.
yokthaan almoathaathaiyum, saaleappaiyum, aasarmaaveaththaiyum, yearaakaiyum,
athoaraamaiyum, oosaalaiyum, thiklaavaiyum,
eapaalaiyum, apimaavealaiyum, seapaavaiyum,
oappeeraiyum, aavilaavaiyum, yoapaapaiyum pet'raan; ivarka'l ellaarum yokthaanin kumaarar.
seam, arpaksaath, saalaa,
eapear, pealeaku, rekoo,
serooku, naakoar, thearaaku,
aapiraamaakiya aapirakaam.
aapirakaamin kumaarar, eesaakku, ismaveal enpavarka'l.
ivarka'ludaiya santhathika'laavana: ismavealin mooththa kumaaranaakiya nepaayoath, keathaar, athpiyeal, mipsaam,
mishmaa, thoomaa, maasaa, aathaath, theamaa,
yeththoor, naapees, keathmaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l ismavealin kumaarar.
aapirakaamin ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya keaththooraa'l pet'ra kumaarar, simraan, yakshaan, meathaan, meethiyaan, ispaak, soovaa enpavarka'l; yakshaanin kumaarar, seapaa, theathaan enpavarka'l.
meethiyaanin kumaarar, eappaa, eappear, aanoakku, apeethaa, elthaakaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum keaththooraa'lin kumaarar.
aapirakaam eesaakkaip pet'raan; eesaakkin kumaarar, easaa, israveal enpavarka'l.
easaavin kumaarar, eleeppaas, rekuveal, eyoosh, yaalaam, koaraaku enpavarka'l.
eleeppaasin kumaarar, theamaan, oamaar, seppi, kaththaam, keanaas, thimnaa, amaleakku enpavarka'l.
rekuvealin kumaarar, nakaath, searaaku, sammaa, meesaa enpavarka'l.
seayeerin kumaarar, loaththaan, soapaal, sipiyoan, aanaa, theesoan, ethsear, theesaan enpavarka'l.
loaththaanin kumaarar, oari, oamaam enpavarka'l; loaththaanin sakoathari thimnaa'l enpava'l.
soapaalin kumaarar, alvaan, maanakaath, eapaal, seppi, oanaam enpavarka'l; sipiyoanin kumaarar, ayaa, aanaaku enpavarka'l.
aanaakin kumaararil oruvan thishoan enpavan; thishoanin kumaarar, amraam, espaan, iththaraan, keraan enpavarka'l.
eathsearin kumaarar, pilkaan, sakavaan, yaakkaan enpavarka'l; thishaanin kumaarar, ooths, araan enpavarka'l.
israveal puththirarai oru raajaa aa'laathatha'rkumunnea, eathoam theasaththil arasaa'nda raajaakka'laanavarka'l: peayoarin kumaaran pealaa enpavan; ivan patta'naththin pear thinkaapaa.
pealaa mariththapin poasraa ooraanaakiya searaakin kumaaran yoapaap avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoapaap mariththapin, theamaaniyarin theasaththaanaakiya oosaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
oosaam mariththapin, peathaathin kumaaran aathaath avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan, ivan meethiyaaniyarai moavaapin naattilea mu'riya adiththavan; ivan patta'naththinpear aaveeth.
aathaath mariththapin, masreakkaa ooraanaakiya samlaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
samlaa mariththapin, nathiyoaramaana reakoapoaththaanaakiya savul avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
savul mariththapin, akpoarin kumaaran paakaalaanaan avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
paakaalaanaan mariththapin, aathaath avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan; ivan patta'naththinpear paaki; measakaapin kumaaraththiyaakiya maaththireaththin maka'laana avan manaiviyin pear mekeathapeal.
aathaath mariththapin, eathoamil ea'rpatta pirapukka'laanavarka'l; thimnaa pirapu, alyaa pirapu, etheath pirapu,
akoalipaamaa pirapu, ealaa pirapu, pinoan pirapu,
keanaas pirapu, theamaan pirapu, mipsaar pirapu,
makthiyeal pirapu, eeraam pirapu, ivarka'lea eathoamin pirapukka'l.
isravealin kumaarar, roopan, simiyoan, leavi, yoothaa, isakkaar, sepuloan,
thaa'n, yoaseappu, penyameen, napthali, kaath, aasear enpavarka'l.

yoothaavin kumaarar, ear, oanaan, sealaa enpavarka'l; intha moon'ru kumaarar soovaavin maka'laana kaanaan sthireeyinidaththil avanukkup pi'ranthavarka'l; ear ennum yoothaavin mooththa kumaaran karththarin paarvaikkup pollaathavanaanapadiyaal avar avanaik kon'rupoattaar.
avan marumaka'laakiya thaamaar avanukkup paareasaiyum searaavaiyum pet'raa'l; yoothaavin kumaarar ellaarum ainthupear.
paareasin kumaarar, esroan, aamool enpavarka'l.
searaavin kumaarar ellaarum, simri, eaththaan, eamaan, kalkoal, thaaraa ennum ainthupear.
saapaththeedaana vishayaththilea thuroakampa'n'ni isravealaik kalangkappa'n'nina aakaar enpavan, karmee puththiraril oruvan.
eaththaanin kumaarar asariyaa muthalaanavarka'l.
esroanukkup pi'rantha kumaarar, yermeyeal, raam, kelupaa enpavarka'l.
raam amminathaapaip pet'raan; amminathaap yoothaa puththirarin pirapuvaakiya nakasoanaip pet'raan.
nakasoan salmaavaip pet'raan; salmaa poavaasaip pet'raan.
poavaas oapeathaip pet'raan; oapeath eesaayaip pet'raan.
eesaay than mooththakumaaran eliyaapaiyum, apinathaap ennum ira'ndaam kumaaranaiyum, simmaa ennum moon'raam kumaaranaiyum,
nethaneyeal ennum naalaam kumaaranaiyum, rathaayi ennum ainthaam kumaaranaiyum,
oathseam ennum aa'raam kumaaranaiyum, thaaveethu ennum eazhaam kumaaranaiyum pet'raan.
avarka'l sakoatharika'l seruyaa'l, apikaayil enpavarka'l; seruyaa'lin kumaarar, apisaay, yoavaap, aasakeal ennum moon'rupear.
apikaayil amaasaavaip pet'raa'l; amaasaavin thakappan ismavealiyanaakiya yeththear enpavan.
esroanin kumaaran kaaleap ereeyoath ennappatta than pe'njaathiyaakiya asupaa'laalea pet'ra kumaarar, easear, soapaap, arthoan enpavarka'l.
asupaa'l sen'rupoanapin kaaleap epraaththai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; iva'l avanukku ooraip pet'raa'l.
oor ooriyaip pet'raan; oori pesaleyealaip pet'raan.
pi'rpaadu, esroan a'rupathu vayathaanapoathu kileyaaththin thakappanaakiya maakeerin kumaaraththiyai vivaakampa'n'ni, ava'lidaththil piraveasiththaan; iva'l avanukkuch sekoopaip pet'raa'l.
sekoop yaaveeraip pet'raan; ivanukkuk keeleayaath theasaththil irupaththumoon'ru oorka'l irunthathu.

keasooraiyum aaraamaiyum yaaveerin kiraamangka'laiyum, keanaaththilu'l'la kiraamangka'laakiya a'rupathu oorka'laiyum avarka'l kaiyilea vaangkinaarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum kileyaaththin thakappanaakiya maakeerin kumaarar.
kaaleapin ooraana epraaththaavil esroan i'ranthupoanapin, esroanin pe'njaathiyaakiya apiyaa'l avanukkuth thekkovaavin thakappanaakiya asooraip pet'raa'l.
esroanukku mutha'rpi'rantha yermeyealin kumaarar, raam ennum mooththavanum, poonaa, oaren, oathseam, akiyaa enpavarka'lumea.
aththaaraa'l ennum pearu'l'la vea'roru manaiviyum yermeyealukku irunthaa'l; iva'l oanaamin thaay.
yermeyealukku mutha'rpi'rantha raamin kumaarar, maas, yaamin, ekkear enpavarka'l.
oanaamin kumaarar, sammaay, yaathaa enpavarka'l; sammaayin kumaarar, naathaap, apisoor enpavarka'l.
apisoorudaiya manaiviyin pear apiyaayeal; ava'l avanukku akpaanaiyum moa'lithaiyum pet'raa'l.
naathaapin kumaarar, sealeath, appaayim enpavarka'l; sealeath puththirarillaamal mariththaan.
appaayimin kumaarar ishi muthalaanavarka'l; ishiyin kumaarar seasaan muthalaanavarka'l; seasaanin kumaaraththi aklaay.
sammaayin sakoatharanaakiya yaathaavin kumaarar, yethther, yoanaththaan enpavarka'l; yethther kumaararillaamal mariththaan.
yoanaththaanin kumaarar, pealeath, saasaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l yermeyealin puththirar.
seasaanukkuk kumaaraththika'leayan'rik kumaararka'l illai; seasaanukku yarkaa ennum pearu'l'la ekipthiya vealaikkaaran oruvan irunthaan.
seasaan than kumaaraththiyaith than vealaikkaaranaakiya yarkaavukkuk koduththaan; ava'l avanukku aththaayiyaip pet'raa'l.
aththaayi naathaanaip pet'raan. naathaan saapaathaip pet'raan.
saapaath eplaalaip pet'raan; eplaal oapeathaip pet'raan.
oapeath eakoovaip pet'raan; eakoo asariyaavaip pet'raan.
asariyaa ealeathsaip pet'raan; ealeaths eleyaasaavaip pet'raan.
eleyaasaa sismaayaip pet'raan; sismaay salloomaip pet'raan.
salloom ekkamiyaavaip pet'raan; ekkamiyaa elisaamaavaip pet'raan.
yermeyealin sakoatharanaakiya kaaleapin kumaarar, seeppin thakappanaakiya measaa ennum mutha'rpi'ranthavanum, eproanin thakappanaakiya mereasaavin kumaararumea.
eproanin kumaarar, koaraaku, thappuvaa, rekkeam, semaa enpavarka'l.
semaa yoarkkeayaamin thakappanaakiya rekkeamaip pet'raan; rekkeam sammaayaip pet'raan.
sammaayin kumaaran maakoan; maakoan pethsoorin thakappan.
kaaleapin ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya eppaa'l aaraanaiyum, moasaavaiyum, kaaseasaiyum pet'raa'l; aaraan kaaseasaip pet'raan.
yaathaayin kumaarar, reakeam, yoathaam, keasaam, pealeath, eppaa, saakaap enpavarka'l.
kaaleapin ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya maakaa'l seapearaiyum thirkaanaavaiyum pet'raa'l.
ava'l mathmannaavin thakappanaakiya saakaapaiyum, makpeanaavukkum keepeayaavukkum thakappanaakiya seavaavaiyum pet'raa'l; kaaleapin kumaaraththi aksaa'l enpava'l.
epraaththaa'lidaththil mutha'rpi'rantha oorudaiya kumaaranaakiya kaaleapin kumaarar, keeriyaathyaareemin mooppanaana soapaalum,
pethlekeamin mooppanaana salmaavum, pethkaathearin mooppanaana aareappumea.
keeriyaathyaarimin mooppanaana soapaalin kumaarar, aaroavea, aasiyam menukoath enpavarka'l.
keeriyaathyaarimiliruntha vamsangka'l, eththiriyarum pookiyarum sumaaththiyarum misraaviyarumea; ivarka'lidaththil soaraaththiyarum, esthavoaliyarum pi'ranthaarka'l.
salmaavin santhathika'l, pethlekeamiyarum, neaththoappaaththiyarum, pethyoavaap ennum atharoath ooraarum, maanaaththiyarilum soariyarilum paathi janangka'lumea.
yaapeasil kudiyiruntha ka'nakkarin vamsangka'l, thiraaththiyarum simaaththiyarum sukkaaththiyarumea; reakaap veettaarin thakappanaakiya ammaaththin santhathiyaaraana keaniyar ivarka'lea.

thaaveethukku eproanilea pi'rantha kumaarar: yesreyeal ooraa'laana akinoavaamidaththil pi'rantha amnoan mutha'rpea'raanavan; karmealin ooraa'laana apikaayealidaththil pi'rantha thaaniyeal ira'ndaam kumaaran.
keasoorin raajaavaakiya thalmaayin kumaaraththi maakkaa'l pet'ra apsaloam moon'raam kumaaran; aakeeth pet'ra athoaniyaa naalaam kumaaran.
apiththaa'l pet'ra seppaththiyaa ainthaam kumaaran; avan pe'njaathiyaakiya eklaa'l pet'ra ithreayaam aa'raam kumaaran.
intha aa'ru kumaarar avanukku eproanilea pi'ranthaarka'l; angkea eazhuvarushamum aa'rumaathamum arasaa'ndaan; erusaleamiloa muppaththumoon'ru varusham arasaa'ndaan.
erusaleamil avanukkup pi'ranthavarka'l: ammiyealin kumaaraththiyaakiya pathsuvaa'lidaththil simeeyaa, soapaap, naaththaan, saalomoan ennum naalupearum,
ipkaar, elisaamaa, elippeleath,
noakaa, neapeak, yappiyaa,
elisaamaa, eliyaathaa, elipealeath ennum onpathupearumea.
ma'rumanaiyaattika'lin kumaararaiyum ivarka'l sakoathariyaakiya thaamaaraiyum thavira, ivarka'lellaarum thaaveethin kumaarar.
saalomoanin kumaaran rekopeyaam; ivanudaiya kumaaran apiyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran aasaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran yoasapaath.
ivanudaiya kumaaran yoaraam; ivanudaiya kumaaran akasiyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran yoavaas.
ivanudaiya kumaaran amathsiyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran asariyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran yoathaam.
ivanudaiya kumaaran aakaas; ivanudaiya kumaaran eseakkiyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran manaasea.
ivanudaiya kumaaran aamoan; ivanudaiya kumaaran yoasiyaa.
yoasiyaavin kumaarar, muthal pi'rantha yoakanaanum, yoayaakkeem ennum ira'ndaam kumaaranum, sitheakkiyaa ennum moon'raam kumaaranum, salloom ennum naalaam kumaaranumea.
yoayaakkeemin kumaarar, ekoniyaa muthalaanavarka'l; ivanukku makanaanavan sitheakkiyaa.
kattu'nda ekoniyaavin kumaarar salaaththiyeal,
malkeeraam, pethaayaa, seanaasaar, yekamiyaa, osaamaa, nethapiyaa enpavarka'l.
pethaayaavin kumaarar, serupaapeal, simeayi enpavarka'l; serupaapealin kumaarar, mesullaam, ananiyaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l sakoathari seloameeth enpava'l.
asoopaa, okeal, perakiyaa, asathiyaa, oosaapeaseath ennum ainthupearumea.
ananiyaavin kumaarar, pelaththiyaa, esaayaa enpavarka'l; ivanudaiya kumaaran repaayaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran arnaan; ivanudaiya kumaaran opathiyaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran sekkaniyaa.
sekkaniyaavin kumaarar, semaayaa muthalaanavarka'l; semaayaavin kumaarar, aththoos, ekeyaal, paariyaa, neyaariyaa, seppaath ennum aa'rupear.
neyaariyaavin kumaarar, eliyoanaay, eseakkiyaa, as'reekkaam ennum moon'rupear.
eliyoanaayin kumaarar, othaayaa, eliyaasip, pelaayaa, akkoop, yoakanaan, thelaayaa, aanaani ennum eazhupear.
yoothaavin kumaarar, paareas, esroan, karmee, oor, soapaal enpavarka'l.
soapaalin kumaaran raayaa yaakaaththaip pet'raan; yaakaath akumaayiyaiyum, laakaathaiyum pet'raan; soaraaththiyarin vamsangka'l ivaika'lea.
eathaam ennum mooppanin santhathiyaar, yesreyeal, ishmaa, ithpaas enpavarka'l; ivarka'ludaiya sakoathariyin pear athselelpoani;
keathoarukku mooppanaana penuvel, ushaavukku mooppanaana esear enpavarka'l; ivarka'l pethlekeamukku mooppanaana epraaththaavukku mutha'rpi'rantha oorin kumaarar.
thekkoavaavukku mooppanaana asoorukku ealaa'l, naaraa'l ennum ira'ndu pe'njaathika'l irunthaarka'l.
naaraa'l avanukku akusaamaiyum, eppearaiyum, themaniyaiyum, aakaasthaariyaiyum pet'raa'l; naaraa'lin kumaararka'l ivarka'lea.
ealaa'lin kumaarar, seareath, ethsoakaar, ethnaan enpavarka'l.
koas enpavan anoopaiyum, soapeapaakaiyum, aarumin kumaaranaakiya akarkealin vamsangka'laiyum pet'raan.
yaapeas than sakoathararaippaarkkilum kanampet'ravanaayirunthaan. avan thaay: naan thukkaththoadea avanaip pet'rean en'ru solli avanukku yaapeas en'ru pearittaa'l.

yaapeas isravealin theavanai noakki: theavareer ennai aaseervathiththu, en ellaiyaip perithaakki, umathu karam ennoadirunthu, theengku ennaith thukkappaduththaathapadikku atha'rku ennai vilakkik kaaththaru'lum en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaan; avan vea'ndikko'ndathaith theavan aru'linaar.
sookaavin sakoatharanaakiya kealoop meakeeraip pet'raan; ivan esthoanin thakappan.
esthoan pethraapaavaiyum, paseayaakaiyum, irnaakaashin thakappanaakiya thekinaakaiyum pet'raan; ivarka'l reakaavoor manushar.
keanaasin kumaarar, othniyeal, seraayaa enpavarka'l; othniyealin kumaararil oruvan aaththaath.
meyoanaththaay opiraavaip pet'raan; seraayaa karaasheeman pa'l'laththaakkukku mooppanaakiya yoavaapaip pet'raan; avarka'l thozhilaa'lika'laayirunthaarka'l.
eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapin kumaarar, eeru, ealaa, naakaam; ealaavin kumaararil oruvan keanaas.
ekalelealin kumaarar, seep, seeppaa, thiriyaa, asaareyeal.
es'raavin kumaarar, yeththear, meareath, eappear, yaaloan; meareaththin pe'njaathi miriyaamaiyum, sammaayiyaiyum, esthemoavaa oorukku mooppanaana ispaavaiyum pet'raa'l.

avan pe'njaathiyaakiya ekuthiyaa'l, keathoarin thakappanaakiya yaareathaiyum, soakkoavin thakappanaakiya eapearaiyum, sanoavaavin thakappanaakiya ekkuththiyealaiyum pet'raa'l; meareath vivaakampa'n'nina paarvoanin kumaaraththiyaakiya piththiyaa'lin kumaarar ivarka'lea.
naakaamin sakoathariyaakiya othiyaavinudaiya pe'njaathiyin kumaarar, karmiyanaakiya aapikeayilaavum, maakaaththiyanaakiya esthemoavaavumea.
sheemoanin kumaarar, amnoan, rinnaa, penkaanaan, theeloan enpavarka'l, ishiyin kumaarar, soakeathum pensoakeathumea.
yoothaavin kumaaranaakiya sealaakin puththirar: leakkaavoor mooppanaana earum, mareasaavoor mooppanaana laathaakum, melliya pudavai neytha aspeyaa veettu vamsangka'lum,
yoakkeemum, koaseapaavin manusharum, moavaapiyarai aa'nda yoavaas, saaraap enpavarka'lum, yasupilekeamumea; ivaika'l poorvakaalaththin seythika'l.
ivarka'l kuyavaraayirunthu, neththaayimilum kethearaavilum kudiyirunthaarka'l; raajaavin vealaiyai visaarikki'ratha'rku angkea vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
simiyoanin kumaarar, nemuveal, yaamin, yaareep, searaa, savul enpavarka'l.
ivan kumaaran salloom; ivan kumaaran mipsaam; ivan kumaaran mismaa.
mismaavin kumaararil oruvan ammuveal; ivan kumaaran sakkoor; ivan kumaaran seemeayi.

seemeayikkup pathinaa'ru kumaararum aa'ru kumaaraththika'lum irunthaarka'l; avan sakoathararukku aneakam pi'l'laika'l irunthathillai; avarka'l vamsamellaam yoothaavin puththiraraippoalap perukinathumillai.
avarka'l peyersepaavilum, molaathaavilum, aathsaarsookaalilum,
pillaavilum, eathsaamilum, thoalaathilum,
peththoovealilum, oarmaavilum, siklaakilum,
pethmarkaapoaththilum, aathsaarsoosimilum, pethpiriyilum, saaraayimilum kudiyirunthaarka'l; thaaveethu raajaavaakumattum ivaika'l avarka'l patta'nangka'laayirunthathu.
avarka'ludaiya peattaika'l, eaththaam, aayin, rimmoan, thoakean, aasaan ennum ainthu patta'nangka'l.
anthap patta'nangka'laich sut'rilum, paakaalmattumu'l'la avarka'ludaiya ellaap peattaika'lum, avarka'l vaasasthalangka'lum, avarka'ludaiya vamsa attava'naiyum ivaika'lea.
mesoapaapum, yamleakum, amathsiyaavin kumaaran yoashaavum,
yoavealum, aasiyealin makan seraayaavukkup pi'rantha yoasipiyaavin kumaaran eakoovum,
eliyoanaayum, yaakkoapaavum, yesokaayaavum, asaayaavum, aathiyealum, yesimiyealum, penaayaavum,
semaayaa pet'ra simriyin makan yethaayaavukkup pi'rantha alloanin puththiranaakiya seeppiyin kumaaran seesaavum en'ru,
pearpearaay ezhuthiyirukki'ra ivarka'l thangka'l vamsangka'lil pirapukka'laayirunthaarka'l; ivarka'l pithaakka'lin veettaar earaa'lamaayp parampinaarka'l.
thangka'l aaduka'lukku meaychchalaith theadumpadikkuth theathoarin ellaiyaakiya pa'l'laththaakkin keezhppu'ramattum poay,
nalla sezhippaana meaychchalaiyum, amarikkaiyum, sukamumu'l'la visthaaramaana theasaththaiyum ka'ndupidiththaarka'l; poorvaththilea kaamin santhathiyaar angkea kudiyirunthaarka'l.

pearpearaay ezhuthiyirukki'ra ivarka'l yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavin naadka'lilea angkea poay, angkea ka'ndupidiththavarka'lin koodaarangka'laiyum thaaparangka'laiyum azhiththu, innaa'lilea irukki'rathupoala, avarka'laich sangkaarampa'n'ni, angkea thangka'l aaduka'lukku meaychchal irunthapadiyinaal, avarka'l antha sthalaththilea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.

simiyoanin puththiraraakiya ivarka'lil ainnoo'ru manusharum, avarka'l thalaimaikkaararaakiya ishiyin kumaararaana pelaththiyaavum, nekariyaavum, reppaayaavum, oosiyealum, seayeer malaiththeasaththi'rkup poay,
amaleakkiyaril thappi meethiyaayirunthavarka'lai madangkadiththu, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi angkea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.

roopan isravealukku mutha'rpi'rantha seashdapuththiran; aanaalum avan than thakappanudaiya magnchaththaith theettuppaduththinapadiyinaal, koaththiraththu attava'naiyilea avan mutha'r pi'ranthavanaaka e'n'nappadaamal, avanudaiya seashdapuththira suthantharam isravealin kumaaranaakiya yoaseappin kumaararukkuk kodukkappattathu.
yoothaa than sakoathararilea palaththathinaal raajaathipaththiyam avan santhathiyil u'ndaanathu; aakilum seashdapuththira suthantharam yoaseappudaiyathaayit'ru.
isravealin mutha'rpea'raana roopanin kumaaran aanoakku, palloo, esroan, karmee enpavarka'l.
yoavealin kumaararil oruvan semaayaa; ivan kumaaran koak; ivan kumaaran simeay.
ivan kumaaran meekaa; ivan kumaaran raayaa; ivan kumaaran paakaal.
ivan kumaaran pearaa; roopaniyarin pirapuvaana ivanai aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya thilkaathpilneasar si'raipidiththuppoanaan.
thangka'l santhathika'linpadiyea thangka'l vamsa attava'naika'lil ezhuthappatta avan sakoathararil thalaivar eayealum, sakariyaavum,
yoavealin makanaakiya seamaavukkup pi'rantha aasaasin kumaaran pealaavum; ivan santhathiyaar aaroavearilum, neapoamattum, paakaalmeyoanmattum vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
kizhakkea aipiraaththu nathithodangki vanaantharaththin ellaimattum avarka'l vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l aadumaaduka'l keeleayaaththeasaththil mikuthiyaayit'ru.
savulin naadka'lil aakaariyaroadu avarka'l yuththampa'n'ni, thangka'l kaiyaal avarka'l vizhunthapin, avarka'l koodaarangka'lilea keeleayaaththin keezhppu'ramellaam kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
kaaththin puththirar avarka'lukku ethirea paasaantheasaththilea salkaamattum vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avarka'lil yoaveal thalaivanum, saappaam avanukku ira'ndaavathumaayirunthaan; yaanaayum saappaaththum paasaanil irunthaarka'l.
avarka'l pithaakka'lin veettaaraakiya avarka'l sakoatharar, mikaaveal, mesullaam, seapaa, yoaraayi, yaakkaan, seekaa, eapear ennum eazhupear.

ivarka'l oorikkup pi'rantha apiyealin kumaarar; oori enpavan yerovaavukkum, yerovaa keeleayaaththukkum, keeleayaath mikaavealukkum, mikaaveal esisaayikkum, esisaayi yaathoavukkum, yaathoa poosukkum kumaararaayirunthavarka'l.
kooniyin kumaaranaakiya apthiyealin makan aki, avarka'l pithaakka'lin veettuth thalaivanaayirunthaan.
avarka'l keeleayaaththilirukki'ra paasaanilum, athin ve'linilangka'lilum, saaroanin ellaap peattaika'lilum avaika'lin kadaiyaantharangka'lmattum vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
ivarka'lellaarum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoathaamin naadka'lilum, isravealin raajaavaakiya yeropeyaamin naadka'lilum thangka'l vamsaththu attava'naippadi thokai eat'rappattaarka'l.

roopan puththirarilum, kaaththiyarilum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaarilum keadakamum pattayamum eduththu, villeythu, yuththaththi'rkup pazhaki, padaikkup poakaththakka seavakar naa'rpaththunaalaayiraththu ezhunoot'ru a'rupathupearaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l aakaariyaroadum, yeththoor naappees noathaap enpavarka'loadum yuththampa'n'nuki'rapoathu,

avarka'loadea ethirkkath thu'nai pet'rapadiyinaal, aakaariyarum ivarka'loadirukki'ra yaavarum avarka'l kaiyil oppukkodukkappattaarka'l; avarka'l yuththaththilea theavanai noakkik kooppittu, avarmeal nampikkaivaiththapadiyinaal avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'linaar.

avarka'l ivarka'lukku iruntha mirukajeevanka'laakiya aimpathinaayiram ottakangka'laiyum, ira'nduladchaththu aimpathinaayiram aaduka'laiyum, ira'ndaayiram kazhuthaika'laiyum, manusharil ladchampearka'laiyum pidiththaarka'l.
yuththam theavanaal nadanthapadiyinaal aneakar vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l; thaangka'l si'raippattuppoakumattum ivarka'ludaiya sthalaththilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththup puththirarum anthath theasaththil kudiyirunthu, paasaanthodangkip paakaal ermoanmattum, seneermattum, ermoan parvathamattum perukiyirunthaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin veettuth thalaivaraakiya eappear, ishi, ealiyeal, asriyeal, ereamiyaa, othaaviyaa, yaathiyeal enpavarka'l paraakkirama veeraraana manusharum pearpet'ra thalaivarumaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanukkuth thuroakampa'n'ni, theavan avarka'lukku munpaaka azhiththiruntha theasa janangka'lin theavarka'laip pinpat'rich soarampoanaarka'l.

aakaiyaal isravealin theavan aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya poolin aaviyaiyum, aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya thilkaathpilneasarin aaviyaiyum ezhuppinathinaalea, avan roopaniyarum kaaththiyarum manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaarumaakiya avarka'laich si'raipidiththu, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rathupoala, aalaavukkum aapoarukkum aaraavukkum koasaan aat'rangkaraikkum ko'ndupoanaan.
leaviyin kumaarar, kersoan, koakaath, meraari enpavarka'l.
koakaaththin kumaarar, amraam, ithsaar, eproan, oosiyeal enpavarka'l.
amraamin pi'l'laika'l, aaroan, moasea, miriyaam enpavarka'l; aaroanin kumaarar, naathaap, apiyoo, eleyaasaar, iththaamaar enpavarka'l.
eleyaasaar pinekaasaip pet'raan; pinekaas apisuvaavaip pet'raan.
apisuvaa pukkiyaip pet'raan; pukki oosiyaip pet'raan.
oosi seraakiyaavaip pet'raan; seraakiyaa meraayoathaip pet'raan.
meraayoath amariyaavaip pet'raan; amariyaa akithoopaip pet'raan.
akithoop saathoakkaip pet'raan; saathoak akimaasaip pet'raan.
akimaas asariyaavaip pet'raan; asariyaa yoakanaanaip pet'raan.
yoakanaan asariyaavaip pet'raan; saalomoan erusaleamil kattina aalayaththilea aasaariya pa'nividaiyaich seythavan ivanthaan.
asariyaa amariyaavaip pet'raan; amariyaa akithoopaip pet'raan.
akithoop saathoakkaip pet'raan; saathoak salloomaip pet'raan.
salloom ilkkiyaavaip pet'raan; ilkkiyaa asariyaavaip pet'raan.
asariyaa seraayaavaip pet'raan; seraayaa yoasathaakkaip pet'raan.
karththar neapukaathneachchaaraikko'ndu yoothaa janangka'laiyum erusaleamiyaraiyum si'raipidiththukko'ndupoakach seythapoathu yoasathaakkum si'raippattuppoanaan.
leaviyin kumaarar, kersoam, koakaath, meraari enpavarka'lea.
kersoamudaiya kumaararin naamangka'l, lipni, simeayi enpavaika'l.
koakaaththin kumaarar, amraam, ithsaar, eproan, oosiyeal enpavarka'l.
meraariyin kumaarar, makeali, moosi enpavarka'l. leaviyarukku avarka'l pithaakka'l vazhiyaay u'ndaana vamsangka'l:
kersoamin kumaaran lipni; ivan kumaaran yaakaath; ivan kumaaran simmaa.
ivan kumaaran yoavaa; ivan kumaaran iththoa; ivan kumaaran searaa; ivan kumaaran yaaththiraayi.
koakaaththin kumaararil oruvan amminathaap, ivan kumaaran koaraaku; ivan kumaaran aaseer.
ivan kumaaran elkkaanaa; ivan kumaaran apiyaasaap; ivan kumaaran aaseer.
ivan kumaaran thaakaath; ivan kumaaran ooriyeal; ivan kumaaran oosiyaa; ivan kumaaran savul.
elkkaanaavin kumaarar, amaasaayi, aakimoath enpavarka'l.
elkkaanaavin kumaararil oruvan soapaay; ivan kumaaran naakaath.
ivan kumaaran eliyaap; ivan kumaaran eroakaam; ivan kumaaran elkkaanaa.
saamuvealin kumaarar, avanudaiya mutha'rpea'raana vashnee apiyaa enpavarka'l.
meraariyin kumaararil oruvan makeali; ivan kumaaran lipni; ivan kumaaran simeayi; ivan kumaaran oosaa.
ivan kumaaran simeyaa; ivan kumaaran akiyaa; ivan kumaaran asaayaa.
karththarudaiya petti nilaipet'rapoathu, thaaveethu karththarudaiya aalayaththil sangkeetha seavaiyai nadaththuki'ratha'rku sthaapiththavarka'lum,

saalomoan erusaleamilea karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattith theerumattum aasarippuk koodaara vaasasthalaththi'rku munpaakach sangkeetha seavanaiyudan thangka'l mu'raimaiyinpadiyea pa'nividai seythuvanthavarka'lumaakiya manusharum avarka'l kumaararumaanavarka'l.
koakaaththiyarin kumaararil eamaan ennum paadakan; ivan yoavealin kumaaran; ivan saamuvealin kumaaran.
ivan elkkaanaavin kumaaran; ivan yerokaamin kumaaran; ivan eliyealin kumaaran; ivan thoavaakin kumaaran.
ivan sooppin kumaaran; ivan ilkkaanaavin kumaaran; ivan maakaaththin kumaaran; ivan amaasaayin kumaaran.
ivan elkkaanaavin kumaaran; ivan yoavealin kumaaran; ivan asariyaavin kumaaran; ivan seppaniyaavin kumaaran.
ivan thaakaathin kumaaran; ivan aaseerin kumaaran; ivan epiyaasaappin kumaaran; ivan koaraakin kumaaran.
ivan ithsaarin kumaaran; ivan koakaaththin kumaaran; ivan isravealin kumaaranaakiya leaviyin kumaaran.
ivan sakoatharanaakiya aasaap ivan valathupakkaththilea ni'rpaan; aasaap perakiyaavin kumaaran; ivan simeayaavin kumaaran.
ivan mikaavealin kumaaran; ivan paaseyaavin kumaaran; ivan malkiyaavin kumaaran.
ivan ethniyin kumaaran; ivan searaavin kumaaran; ivan athaayaavin kumaaran.
ivan eaththaanin kumaaran; ivan simmaavin kumaaran; ivan seemeayin kumaaran.
ivan yaakaathin kumaaran; ivan kersoamin kumaaran; ivan leaviyin kumaaran.
meraariyin puththiraraakiya ivarka'ludaiya sakoatharar idathupakkaththilea ni'rpaarka'l; avarka'lil eathaan enpavan kishiyin kumaaran; ivan apthiyin kumaaran; ivan mallookin kumaaran.
ivan asapiyaavin kumaaran; ivan amathsiyaavin kumaaran; ivan ilkkiyaavin kumaaran.
ivan amsiyin kumaaran; ivan paaniyin kumaaran; ivan saamearin kumaaran.
ivan makealiyin kumaaran; ivan moosiyin kumaaran; ivan meraariyin kumaaran; ivan leaviyin kumaaran.
avarka'l sakoathararaakiya mat'ra leaviyar theavanudaiya aalayamaakiya vaasasthalaththin pa'nividaikkellaam vaikkappattirunthaarka'l.

aaroanum avan kumaararum sarvaangka thakanapalipeedaththinmeal paliyittuth thoopangkaattum peedaththinmeal thoopangkaatti, makaa parisuththa sthalaththin ellaavealaikkum, theavanudaiya thaasanaakiya moasea ka'rpiththapadiyellaam isravealukkaakap paavanivirththiyu'ndaakkuki'ratha'rkum vaikkappattirunthaarka'l.
aaroanin kumaararil eleyaasaar enpavanudaiya kumaaran pineakaas; ivan kumaaran apisuvaa.
ivan kumaaran pukki; ivan kumaaran oosi; ivan kumaaran seraakiyaa.
ivan kumaaran meraayoath; ivan kumaaran amariyaa; ivan kumaaran akiththoop.
ivan kumaaran saathoak; ivan kumaaran akimaas.
avarka'l peattaika'linpadiyea avarka'l ellaikku'l'laana avarka'l vaasasthalangka'laavana: koakaaththiyarin vamsamaana aaroanin puththirarukku vizhuntha seettinpadiyea,
yoothaatheasaththilirukki'ra eproanaiyum athaich sut'riyirukki'ra ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l.
anthap patta'naththin vayalka'laiyum athin pattika'laiyum eppunneayin kumaaranaakiya kaaleapukkuk koduththaarka'l.
ippadiyea aaroanin puththirarukku eproan ennum adaikkalappatta'nangka'lil on'raiyum, lipnaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, yaaththeeraiyum esthemoavaavaiyum avat'rin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
eeleanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, thepeeraiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
aasaanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, pethseameasaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,

penyameen koaththiraththilea keapaavaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, alemeaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, aanathoaththaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; ivarka'l vamsangka'lukkuk koduththa ivarka'l patta'nangka'lellaam pathinmoon'ru.
koakaaththin mat'rap puththirarukku vea'roru koaththira vamsaththilum, paathikkoaththiramaakiya manaaseayin paathiyilum vizhuntha seettinpadiyea paththup patta'nangka'l irunthathu.

kersoamin puththirarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadiyea, isakkaar koaththiraththilum, aasear koaththiraththilum, napthali koaththiraththilum, paasaanilirukki'ra manaasea koaththiraththilum pathinmoon'ru patta'nangka'l irunthathu.
meraariyin puththirarukku avarka'l vamsangka'linpadiyea, roopan koaththiraththilum, kaath koaththiraththilum, sepuloan koaththiraththilum vizhuntha seettinpadi pannira'ndu patta'nangka'l irunthathu.
appadiyea israveal puththirar leaviyarukkuk koduththa patta'nangka'lum avaika'lin ve'linilangka'lum ennaven'raal,

seettuppoattu, silarukku yoothaa puththirarin koaththiraththilum, simiyoan puththirarin koaththiraththilum, penyameen puththirarin koaththiraththilum, pearpearaakach sollappatta anthap patta'nangka'laik koduththaarka'l.
koakaath puththiraril mat'ra vamsangka'lukku avarka'l ellaiyaana patta'nangka'l avarka'lukku eppiraayeem koaththiraththilea irunthathu.
evaiyenil, adaikkalappatta'nangka'lil avarka'lukku eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththilirukki'ra seekeamaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, keasearaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
yoakmeayaamaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, peathoaroanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,
aayaloanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, kaathrimmoanaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum,

manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththilea aanearaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum, peeliyaamaiyum athin ve'linilangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; ivaika'l kaakaath puththirarilu'l'la mat'ra vamsangka'lukku irunthathu.
kersoam puththirarukku manaaseayin paathikkoaththira vamsaththilea paasaanilirukki'ra koalaanum athin ve'linilangka'lum, astharoaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
isakkaar koaththiraththilea keatheasum athin ve'linilangka'lum, thaapiraaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
raamoaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum, aaneamum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
aasear koaththiraththilea maashaalum athin ve'linilangka'lum, apthoanum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
ukkoakkum athin ve'linilangka'lum, reakoapum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
napthali koaththiraththilea kalileayaavilirukki'ra keatheasum athin ve'linilangka'lum, ammoanum athin ve'linilangka'lum, keeriyaaththaayimum athin ve'linilangka'lum irunthathu.
meraariyin mat'rap puththirarukku sepuloan koaththiraththilea rimmoanum athin ve'linilangka'lum, thaapoarum athin ve'linilangka'lum,

erikoavukku appu'ramaayirukki'ra yoarthaanukku appaalea yoarthaanukkuk kizhakkea irukki'ra roopan koaththiraththilea vanaantharaththilu'l'la peasearum athin ve'linilangka'lum, yaathsaavum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
keatheamoaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum, meappaaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
kaath koaththiraththilea keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththum athin ve'linilangka'lum, maknaayeemum athin ve'linilangka'lum,
espoanum athin ve'linilangka'lum, yaasearum athin ve'linilangka'lum irunthathu.
isakkaarudaiya kumaarar, thoalaa, poovaa, yasup, simroan ennum naalupear.

thoalaavin kumaarar, oosi, reppaayaa, yeriyeal, yakmaayi, ipsaam, saamuveal enpavarka'l; thoalaavukkup pi'rantha ivarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'l vamsaththalaivarum thangka'l santhathika'lilea paraakkiramasaalika'lumaayirunthaarka'l; thaaveethin naadka'lil avarka'l thokai irupathinaayiraththu a'runoo'rupearaayirunthathu.
oosiyin kumaararil oruvan israkiyaa; israkiyaavin kumaarar, mikaayeal, opathiyaa, yoaveal, ishiyaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l ainthupearum thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l.

avarka'l pithaakka'l vamsaththaaraana avarka'l santhathika'lil yuththamanusharaana koottangka'l muppaththaa'raayirampear avarka'loadirunthaarka'l; avarka'lukku aneakam pe'njaathika'lum pi'l'laika'lum irunthaarka'l.
isakkaarudaiya mat'ra ellaa vamsangka'lilum avarka'lukkuch sakoathararaana paraakkiramasaalika'l thangka'l vamsa attava'naika'linpadiyellaam e'npaththeazhaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.
penyameen kumaarar, pealaa, pekear, yethiyaayeal ennum moon'rupear.

pealaavin kumaarar, espoan, oosi, oosiyeal, yerimoath, iri enpavarka'l; ivarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththil paraakkiramasaalika'laana ainthu thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l; ivarka'l vamsa attava'naikku'l'laanavarka'l irupaththeeraayiraththu muppaththunaalupear.
pekearin kumaarar, semiraa, yoavaas, eliyeasar, eliyoanaay, umri, yerimoath, apiyaa, aanathoath, alameath enpavarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum pekearin kumaarar.
thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththalaivaraakiya avarka'l santhathika'lin attava'naikku'l'laana paraakkiramasaalika'l irupathinaayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
yethiyaayealin kumaararil oruvan pilkaan; pilkaanin kumaarar, eayoosh, penyameen, eakooth, kenaanaa, seaththaan, tharshees, akishaakaar enpavarka'l.

yethiyaayealin kumaararaakiya ivarka'l ellaarum thangka'l pithaakka'l vamsaththaaril thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l; ivarka'lil yuththaththi'rkup poakaththakka seavakaraana paraakkiramasaalika'l pathineazhaayiraththu irunoo'rupear.
suppeemum uppeemum eerin kumaarar, oosim aakearin kumaararil oruvan.
napthaliyin kumaararaana pilkaa'lin pearanmaar, yaathsiyeal, kooni, ethsear, salloom enpavarka'l.
manaaseayin puththiraril oruvan kulasthireeyinidaththil pi'rantha asriyeal; avan ma'rumanaiyaattiyaakiya araamiya sthireeyinidaththil keeleayaaththin thakappanaakiya maakeer pi'ranthaan.
maakeer maakkaa'l ennum pearu'l'la uppeem suppeem enpavarka'lin sakoathariyai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; manaaseayin ira'ndaam kumaaran seloappiyaath; seloappiyaaththi'rkuk kumaaraththika'l irunthaarka'l.
maakeerin pe'njaathiyaakiya maakkaa'l oru kumaaranaip pet'ru, avanukkup peareas en'ru pearittaa'l; ivan sakoatharan pear seareas; ivanudaiya kumaarar oolaam, reakeam enpavarka'l.
oolaamin kumaararil oruvan peathaan; ivarka'l manaaseayin kumaaranaakiya maakeerukkup pi'rantha keeleayaath puththirar.
ivan sakoathariyaakiya ammo'lekeath iskoathaiyum apiyeasaraiyum maakalaavaiyum pet'raa'l.
semithaavin kumaarar, akiyaan, seakeam, likkea, aniyaam enpavarka'l.
eppiraayeemin kumaararil oruvan suththelaak; ivanudaiya kumaaran peareath; ivanudaiya kumaaran thaakaath; ivanudaiya kumaaran elaathaa; ivanudaiya kumaaran thaakaath.

ivanudaiya kumaaran saapaath; ivanudaiya kumaarar suththelaak, ethsear, eliyaath; ivarka'l theasaththil pi'rantha kaaththooraarudaiya aadumaaduka'laip pidikkappoanapadiyaal avarka'l ivarka'laik kon'rupoattaarka'l.
avarka'l thakappanaakiya eppiraayeem aneakanaa'l thukkangko'ndaadukaiyil, avan sakoatharar avanukku aa'ruthal sollavanthaarka'l.

pinpu avan than pe'njaathiyinidaththil piraveasiththathinaal, ava'l karppanthariththu oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; avan, than kudumpaththukkuth theengku u'ndaanathinaal, ivanukkup pereeyaa en'ru pearittaan.
ivanudaiya kumaaraththiyaakiya searaa'l keezhppu'ramum mea'rpu'ramumaana peththoaroanaiyum, ooseansearaavaiyum kattinava'l.
avanudaiya kumaarar, reappaak, reaseap enpavarka'l; ivanudaiya kumaaran thealaak; ivanudaiya kumaaran thaakaan.
ivanudaiya kumaaran laathaan; ivanudaiya kumaaran ammiyooth; ivanudaiya kumaaran elishaamaa.
ivanudaiya kumaaran noon; ivanudaiya kumaaran yoasuvaa.

avarka'ludaiya kaa'niyaadchiyum, vaasasthalangka'lum, kizhakkeayirukki'ra naaraanum, mea'rkeayirukki'ra keasearum athin kiraamangka'lum, peththealum athin kiraamangka'lum, seekeamum athin kiraamangka'lum, kaasaamattukkumu'l'la athin kiraamangka'lum,

manaasea puththirarin pakkaththilea pethseyaanum athin kiraamangka'lum, thaanaakum athin kiraamangka'lum, mekithoavum athin kiraamangka'lum, thoarum athin kiraamangka'lumea; ivvidangka'lil isravealin kumaaranaakiya yoaseappin puththirar kudiyirunthaarka'l.
aasearin kumaarar, imnaa, isvaa, isvi, pereeyaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l sakoathari searaa'l.
pereeyaavin kumaarar, eapear, malkiyeal enpavarka'l; ivan pirsaaveeththin thakappan.
eapear yapleaththaiyum, soamearaiyum, oththaamaiyum, ivarka'l sakoathariyaakiya sookaa'laiyum pet'raan.
yapleaththin kumaarar, paasaak, pimmaal, asvaath enpavarka'l; ivarka'lea yapleaththin kumaarar.
soamearin kumaarar aki, roakaa, ekoopaa, aaraam enpavarka'l.
avan sakoatharanaakiya ealeamin kumaarar, soapaak, imnaa, sealeas, aamaal enpavarka'l.
soapaakkin kumaarar, soovaak, arneppar, sookaal, peari, imraa,
peasear, oath, sammaa, silsaa, ithraan, pearaa enpavarka'l.
yeththearin kumaarar, eppunea, pispaa, aaraa enpavarka'l.
ullaavin kumaarar, aaraak, anniyeal, rithsiyaa enpavarka'l.

aasearin puththiraraakiya ivarka'l ellaarum thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththalaivarum therinthuko'l'lappatta paraakkiramasaalika'lum, pirapukka'lin thalaivarumaayirunthaarka'l; avarka'l vamsa attava'naika'lil yuththaththi'rkup poakaththakka seavakarin ilakkam irupaththaa'raayirampear.
penyameen, pealaa ennum than mooththa kumaaranaiyum, aspaal ennum ira'ndaam kumaaranaiyum, akaraak ennum moon'raam kumaaranaiyum,
noakaa ennum naalaam kumaaranaiyum, rappaa ennum ainthaam kumaaranaiyum pet'raan.
pealaavukku iruntha kumaarar, aathaar, kearaa, apiyooth enpavarka'l.
apisuvaa, naamaan, akoavaa,
kearaa, seppuppaan, ooraam enpavarka'l ekoothin kumaarar.
keapaavin kudika'lukku mooppaana thalaivaraayirunthu, ivarka'lai manaakaaththi'rku azhaiththukko'ndupoanavarka'l, naamaan, akiyaa, kearaa enpavarka'lea.
kearaa avarka'lai angkea azhaiththukko'ndupoanapinpu, oosaavaiyum akiyoothaiyum pet'raan.
avarka'lai anuppivittapin, sakaraayeem moavaap theasaththilea oosim paaraa'l ennum than pe'njaathika'lidaththilea pet'ra pi'l'laika'laiththavira,
than pe'njaathiyaakiya oatheasaalea yoavaapaiyum, seepeeyaavaiyum, measaavaiyum, malkaamaiyum,
eyoosaiyum, saakiyaavaiyum, mirmaavaiyum pet'raan; pithaakka'lin thalaivaraana ivarka'l avanudaiya kumaarar.
oosim vazhiyaay avan apithoopaiyum elpaalaiyum pet'raan.
elpaalin kumaarar, eapear, meeshaam, saameath; ivan oanoavaiyum loathaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinavan.
pereeyaavum seamaavum aayaloan kudika'ludaiya pithaakka'lilea thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l; ivarka'l kaaththin kudika'lai oattivittaarka'l.
akiyoa, saashaak, ereamoath,
sepathiyaa, aaraath, aathear,
mikaayeal, ispaa, yoakaa enpavarka'l pereeyaavin kumaarar.
sepathiyaa, mesullaam, iski, eapear,
ismeraayi, isliyaa, yoapaap enpavarka'l elpaalin kumaarar.
yaakkim, sikri, sapthi,
eliyeanaay, silthaay, eliyeal,
athaayaa, peraayaa, simraath enpavarka'l simiyin kumaarar.
ispaan, eapear, ealiyeal,
apthoan, sikri, aanaan,
ananiyaa, ealaam, anthoathiyaa,
ipithiyaa, penooyeal enpavarka'l saashaakkin kumaarar.
samsearaay, sekariyaa, aththaaliyaa,
yareshiyaa, eliyaa, sikri enpavarka'l erokaamin kumaarar.
ivarka'l thangka'l santhathika'lin pithaakka'lilea thalaivaraayirunthu, erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
kipiyoanilea kudiyirunthavan, kipiyoanin mooppan; avan pe'njaathiyinpear maakkaa'l.
avan mooththa kumaaran apthoan enpavan; mat'ravarka'l soor, kees, paakaal, naathaap,
keathoar, akiyoa, seakear enpavarka'l.
mikloath simiyaavaip pet'raan; ivarka'lum thangka'l sakoathararoadungkooda erusaleamilea thangka'l sakoathararukkuch sameepaththil kudiyirunthaarka'l.
near keesaip pet'raan; kees savulaip pet'raan; savul yoanaththaanaiyum, malkisoovaavaiyum, apinathaapaiyum, espaalaiyum pet'raan.
yoanaththaanin kumaaran mearipaal; mearipaal meekaavaip pet'raan.
meekaavin kumaarar, piththoan, mealeak, thareayaa, aakaas enpavarka'l.
aakaas yoakathaavaip pet'raan; yoakathaa alameaththaiyum, asmaaveaththaiyum, simriyaiyum pet'raan; simri moasaavaip pet'raan.
moasaa piniyaavaip pet'raan; ivan kumaaran rappaa; ivan kumaaran eliyaasaa; ivan kumaaran aathseal.
aathsealukku aa'rukumaarar irunthaarka'l; avarka'l naamangka'laavana, as'reekkaam, pokkuru, ismaveal, sekariyaa, opathiyaa, aanaan; ivarka'l ellaarum aathsealin kumaarar.
avan sakoatharanaakiya eseakkin kumaarar, oolaam ennum mooththakumaaranum, eakoos ennum ira'ndaam kumaaranum, elipealeath ennum moon'raam kumaaranumea.

oolaamin kumaarar paraakkiramasaalika'laana vilveeraraay irunthaarka'l; avarka'lukku aneakam puththirar pauththirar irunthaarka'l; avarka'l thokai noot'raimpathupear; ivarka'l ellaarum penyameen puththirar.

isravealar ellaarum thangka'l vamsa varalaat'rinpadi e'n'nappattaarka'l; ivarka'l naamangka'l israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu, yoothaa koaththiraththaar thangka'l thuroakaththinimiththam, paapiloanukkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.
thangka'l kaa'niyaadchiyilum thangka'l patta'nangka'lilum mun kudiyirunthavarka'l isravealarum aasaariyarum leaviyarum nithineemiyarumea.
yoothaa puththirarilum, penyameen puththirarilum, eppiraayeem manaasea enpavarka'lin puththirarilum, erusaleamil kudiyirunthavarka'l yaaren'raal,
yoothaavin puththiranaakiya peareasin santhathiyil paaniyin kumaaranaakiya imriyin makanaana umrikkup pi'rantha ammiyoothin kumaaran ooththaay.
sealaavin santhathiyil mooththavanaakiya asaayaavum, avan pi'l'laika'lum,
searaavin santhathiyil yekuvealum, avan sakoathararaakiya a'runoot'ruththo'n'noo'rupearumea.
penyameen puththiraril asenoovaavin kumaaranaakiya oathaaviyaavukkup pi'rantha mesullaamin makan sallu.
eroakaamin kumaaran ipneyaa; mikkiriyin kumaaranaakiya oosiyin makan ealaa; ipniyaavin kumaaranaakiya reakuvealukkup pi'rantha sepathiyaavin makan mesullaam enpavarka'lum;

thangka'l santhathika'linpadi iruntha ivarka'l sakoathararaakiya tho'laayiraththu aimpaththaa'rupearumea; intha manushar ellaarum, thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththilea pithaakka'lin thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l.
aasaariyarka'lil yethaayaa, yoayaareep, yaakin.
akithoopin kumaaranaakiya meraayoathin makan saathoakkukkup pi'rantha mesullaavin kumaaranaakiya ilkkiyaavin makan asariyaa enpavan theavaalayaththu visaara'naikkarththan.

malkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paskoorukkup pi'rantha eroakaamin makan athaayaa; immerin kumaaranaakiya mesilleamiththin makan mesullaamukkup pi'rantha yaaseraavin kumaaranaakiya aathiyealin makan maasaay enpavarka'lum,
avarka'l sakoathararum, thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththalaivaraana aayiraththuezhunoot'ru a'rupathupear theavaalayaththukkaduththa pa'nividaikkuth thi'ramaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
leaviyaril meraariyin santhathiyaana asapiyaavin kumaaranaakiya as'reekaamukkup pi'rantha asoopin makan semaayaa,
pakpakkaar, eareas, kaalaal, aasaapin kumaaranaakiya sikrikkup pi'rantha mikaavin makan maththaniyaa,
ethuththoonin kumaaranaakiya kaalaalukkup pi'rantha semaayaavin makan opathiyaa; neththoapaaththiyarin kiraamangka'lil kudiyiruntha elkkaanaavin kumaaranaakiya aasaavin makan perakiyaa,
vaasal kaavalaa'lika'laakiya salloom, akkoop, thalmoan, akimaan enpavarka'lum, ivarka'l sakoathararumea; ivarka'l thalaivan salloom.
leavipuththirarin seanaika'lil ivarka'l kizhakkeayirukki'ra raajaavin vaasalaik kaavalkaaththuvanthaarka'l.

koaraakin kumaaranaakiya epiyaasaapukkup pi'rantha koareayin makan salloomum, avan pithaavin vamsaththaaraakiya avanudaiya sakoathararumaana koaraakiyar pa'nividaivealaiyai visaariththu, avarka'l pithaakka'l karththarudaiya paa'layaththilea vaasasthalaththi'rkuppoaki'ra vazhiyaik kaavalkaaththathupoala, vaasasthalaththu vaasalka'laik kaaththuvanthaarka'l.
eleyaasaarin kumaaranaakiya pineakaasudanea karththar irunthapadiyinaal, avan mu'rkaalaththilea avarka'lmeal visaara'naikkaaranaayirunthaan.
meselmiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaa aasarippuk koodaaravaasal kaavalkaaranaayirunthaan.

vaasalka'laik kaakki'ratha'rkuth therinthuko'l'lappatta ivarka'lellaarum irunoot'rup pannira'ndupearaayirunthu, thangka'l kiraamangka'linpadiyea thangka'l vamsaththu attava'naika'lil ezhuthappattaarka'l; thaaveethum, gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya saamuvealum, avarka'laith thangka'l vealaika'lil vaiththaarka'l.
appadiyea avarka'lum, avarka'l kumaararum karththarudaiya aalayamaakiya vaasasthalaththu vaasalka'laik kaakki'ravarka'lai mu'raimu'raiyaay visaariththu vanthaarka'l.
vaasalka'laik kaakki'ravarka'l naaluthisaika'laakiya kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vadakkilum the'rkilum irunthaarka'l.
avarka'l sakoatharar thangka'l kiraamangka'lilirunthu, eazhunaa'lukku oruvisai maa'rimaa'ri avarka'loadirukka varuvaarka'l.
theavaalayaththin pa'ndakasaalaika'lmealum pokkishasaalaika'lmealumu'l'la visaara'nai uththiyoakam leaviyaraana antha naalu pirathaana kaavalaa'larvasaththil oppuvikkappattathu.
kaaval avarka'lukku oppuviththirunthapadiyaal avarka'l theavaalayaththaich sut'rilum iraaththangkiyirunthu, kaalamea kathavuka'laith thi'ranthuviduvaarka'l.
avarka'lil silaridaththil aaraathanai pa'nimuttuka'l oppuviththirunthathu; avarka'l avaika'lai e'n'ni u'l'lea ko'ndupoay, e'n'ni ve'liyea ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

avarka'lil silar mat'rap pa'nimuttuka'linmealum, parisuththa paaththirangka'l ellaavat'rinmealum, melliya maa, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney, saampiraa'ni, sukanthavarkkangka'linmealum visaara'naikkaararaayirunthaarka'l.
aasaariyarin kumaararil silar sukanthavarkkaththaal parima'lathailam i'rakkuvaarka'l.
leaviyaril koaraakiyanaana salloomin mooththa kumaaranaakiya maththiththiyaavukkup palakaaram suduki'ra vealaiyin visaarippu oppuviththirunthathu.
avarka'l sakoathararaakiya koakaaththiyarin puththiraril silarukku oayvunaa'lthoa'rum samukaththu appangka'lai aayaththappaduththum visaarippu irunthathu.

ivarka'lil leaviyarudaiya pithaakka'lin thalaivaraakiya sangkeethakkaarar iravumpakalum thangka'l vealaiyai nadaththavea'ndiyirunthapadiyaal, mat'ra vealaikku neengkalaayth thangka'l a'raika'lil irunthaarka'l.
leaviyaril pithaakka'lin thalaivaraakiya ivarka'l thangka'l santhathika'lukkuth thalaimaiyaanavarka'l; ivarka'l erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
kipiyoanilea kudiyirunthavarka'l yaaren'raal, kipiyoanin mooppanaakiya yekiyeal, ivan pe'njaathiyinpear maakkaa'l.
avan mooththa kumaaranaakiya apthoanum, soor, kees, paakaal, near, naathaap,
keathoar, akiyoa, sakariyaa, mikloath enpavarka'lumea.
