mikloath seemiyaamaip pet'raan; ivarka'lum thangka'l sakoathararoadungkooda erusaleamilirukki'ra thangka'l sakoathararukkuch sameepaththil kudiyirunthaarka'l.
near keesaip pet'raan; kees savulaip pet'raan; savul yoanaththaanaiyum, malkisoovaavaiyum, apinathaapaiyum, espaalaiyum pet'raan.
yoanaththaanin kumaaran meripaal; meripaal meekaavaip pet'raan.
meekaavin kumaarar, piththoan, mealeak, thareayaa, aakaas enpavarka'l.
aakaas yaaraakaip pet'raan; yaaraak alemeaththaiyum, asmaveaththaiyum, simriyaiyum pet'raan; simri moasaavaip pet'raan.
moasaa piniyaavaip pet'raan; ivan kumaaran rappaayaa; ivan kumaaran eliyaasaa; ivan kumaaran aathseal.
aathsealukku aa'ru kumaarar irunthaarka'l; avarka'l naamangka'laavana, asareekkaam, pokkuru, ismaveal, searaayaa, opathiyaa, aanaan; ivarka'l aathsealin kumaarar.
pelisthar isravealaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; israveal pelistharukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadi, kilpoavaa malaiyilea vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.
pelisthar savulaiyum avan kumaararaiyum nerungkith thodarnthu, savulin kumaararaakiya yoanaththaanaiyum apinathaapaiyum malkisoovaavaiyum vettippoattaarka'l.
savulukku viroathamaay yuththam palaththathu; vilveerar avanaikka'ndu nerungkinaarka'l; appozhuthu savul vilveerarukku mikavum payappattu,

than aayuthathaariyai noakki: antha viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'l vanthu ennai avamaanappaduththaathapadikku, nee un pattayaththai uruvi, ennaik kuththippoadu en'raan; avanudaiya aayuthathaari mikavum payappattathinaal appadich seyyamaattean en'raan. appozhuthu savul pattayaththai nattu athinmeal vizhunthaan.
savul seththuppoanathai avan aayuthathaari ka'ndapoathu, avanum pattayaththinmeal vizhunthu seththuppoanaan.
appadiyea savulum, avan moon'rukumaararum, avan veettu manushar anaivarum koodach seththuppoanaarka'l.

janangka'l mu'rinthoadinathaiyum, savulum avan kumaararum seththuppoanathaiyum, pa'l'laththaakkilu'l'la isravealar ellaarum ka'ndapoathu thangka'l patta'nangka'lai vittu oadippoanaarka'l; appozhuthu pelisthar vanthu, avaika'lil kudiyirunthaarka'l.
vettu'ndavarka'lin vasthirangka'lai urinthuko'l'lap pelisthar ma'runaa'lil vanthapoathu, avarka'l savulaiyum avan kumaararaiyum kilpoavaa malaiyilea vizhunthukidakkak ka'ndu,

avan vasthirangka'lai urinthu, avan thalaiyaiyum avan aayuthangka'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, thangka'l vikkirakangka'lukkum janangka'lukkum athaip pirasiththappaduththumpadi pelistharudaiya theasaththilea sut'rilum seythi anuppi,
avan aayuthangka'laith thangka'l theavarka'lin koavililea vaiththu, avan thalaiyaith thaakoan koavililea thookkivaiththaarka'l.
pelisthar savulukkuch seytha ellaavat'raiyung keeleayaaththeasaththu yaapeas patta'naththaar yaavarum keattapoathu,

paraakkiramasaalika'l ellaarum ezhunthupoay, savulin udalaiyum avan kumaararin udalka'laiyum eduththu, yaapeasukkuk ko'nduvanthu, avarka'l elumpuka'lai yaapeasilirukki'ra oru karvaalimaraththinkeezh adakkampa'n'ni, eazhunaa'l upavaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appadiyea savul karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kaikko'l'laamal, karththarukkuch seytha than thuroakaththinimiththamum, avan karththaraith theadaamal agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laik keadkumpadikkuth theadinathinimiththamum seththuppoanaan.
atha'rkaaka avar avanaik kon'ru, raajyapaaraththai eesaayin kumaaranaakiya thaaveethu vasamaakath thiruppinaar.
isravealar ellaarum eproanilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil koodivanthu: ithoa, naangka'l ummudaiya elumpum ummudaiya maamsamumaanavarka'l.

savul innum raajaavaayirukkumpoathea, neer isravealai nadaththikko'ndupoay nadaththikko'nduvaruveer; en janamaakiya isravealai neer meayththu, en janamaakiya isravealinmeal thalaivanaayiruppeer en'ru ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar umakkuch solliyum irukki'raar en'raarka'l.

appadiyea isravealin moopparellaarum eproanilea raajaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l; thaaveethu eproanilea karththarukku munpaaka avarka'loadu udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndapinpu, karththar saamuvealaikko'ndu sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea avarka'l thaaveethai isravealinmeal raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
pinpu thaaveethu isravealanaiththoadungkooda epoosaakiya erusaleamukkup poanaan; epoosiyar aththeasaththin kudika'laayirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu epoosin kudika'l thaaveethai noakki: nee itha'rku'l piraveasippathillai en'raarka'l; aanaalum thaaveethu seeyoan koattaiyaip pidiththaan; athu thaaveethin nakaramaayit'ru.

epoosiyarai mu'riya adikki'rathil evan munthinavanaayirukki'raanoa, avan thalaivanum seanaapathiyumaayiruppaanen'ru thaaveethu solliyirunthaan; seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaap munthi ea'rith thalaivanaanaan.
thaaveethu anthak koattaiyil vaasampa'n'ninapadiyinaal, athu thaaveethin nakaram ennappattathu.
pi'rpaadu avan nakaraththai milloa thodangkich sut'rilum kattinaan; yoavaap nakaraththin mat'ra idangka'laip pazhuthupaarththaan.
thaaveethu naa'lukkunaa'l viruththiyadainthaan; seanaika'ludaiya karththar avanoadeakooda irunthaar.

karththar isravealukkaakach sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, thaaveethai raajaavaakkumpadi avan vasamaayirunthu raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'ra avanidaththilum, sakala isravealaridaththilum, veerathaththuvaththaip paaraattina pirathaana paraakkiramasaalika'lum,

thaaveethukku iruntha anthap paraakkiramasaalika'lin ilakkamumaavathu: akmoaniyin kumaaranaakiya yaashoapiyaam ennum searvaikkaararin thalaivan; ivan munnoo'rupearka'linmeal than eettiyai oangki avarka'lai orumikkakkon'rupoattaan.
ivanukku ira'ndaavathu akoayin kumaaranaakiya thoathoavin makan eleyaasaar; ivan moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lil oruvan.
pelisthar paasthammeemilirukki'ra vaa'rkoathumai ni'raintha vayalnilaththil yuththaththi'rkuk koodivanthapoathum, janam pelistharaik ka'ndu oadinapoathum ivan thaaveethoadea angkea irunthaan.
appozhuthu avarka'l antha nilaththin naduvilea nin'ru athaik kaappaat'rip pelistharai madangkadiththaarka'l; athinaalea karththar periya radchippai nadappiththaar.
muppathu thalaivaril moon'rupear athullaam ennum kanmalaik kepiyilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil poayirunthaarka'l; pelistharin paa'layam reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkil i'rangkuki'rapoathu,
thaaveethu ara'naana oru idaththilirunthaan; appozhuthu pelistharin thaa'naiyam pethlekeamil irunthathu.
thaaveethu pethlekeamin olimukavaasalilirukki'ra ki'nat'rin tha'n'neermeal aavalko'ndu, en thaakaththi'rkuk kogncham tha'n'neer ko'nduvaruki'ravan yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu antha moon'rupear pelistharin paa'layaththi'rku'l thu'ninthu pukunthupoay, pethlekeamin olimuka vaasalilirukki'ra ki'nat'rilea tha'n'neer mo'ndu, thaaveethinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; aanaalum avan athaik kudikka manathillaamal athaik karththarukken'ru oot'rippoattu:

naan ithaich seyyaathapadikku, en theavan ennaik kaaththukko'l'lakkadavar; thangka'l piraa'nanai e'n'naamal poay athaik ko'nduvantha intha manusharin raththaththaik kudippeanoa en'ru solli athaik kudikkamaattean en'raan. ippadi intha moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lum seythaarka'l.
yoavaapin sakoatharanaakiya apisaay antha moon'rupearil pirathaanamaanavan; avan than eettiyai oangki, munnoo'rupearai madangkadiththathinaal intha moon'rupearil pearpet'ravanaanaan.
intha moon'rupearil avan mat'ra ira'ndupearilum meanmaiyu'l'lavanaanathinaal, avarka'lil thalaivanaanaan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'rupearukku avan samaanamaanavanalla.

paraakkiramasaaliyaakiya yoaythaavin kumaaranum, kapseayeal ooraanumaakiya penaayaavum seykaika'lil vallavanaayirunthaan; avan moavaap theasaththin ira'ndu valumaiyaana singkangka'laik kon'rathumallaamal, u'raintha mazhaipeytha naa'lil avan oru kepikku'l'lea i'rangkippoay, oru singkaththaik kon'raan.

ainthumuzha uyaramaana oru ekipthiyanaiyum avan kon'rupoattaan; antha ekipthiyan kaiyil neyki'ravarka'lin padaimarak kanathiyaana oru eetti irukkaiyil, ivan oru thadiyaip pidiththu, avanidaththil poay, antha ekipthiyan kaiyiliruntha eettiyaip pa'riththu, avan eettiyinaalea avanaik kon'rupoattaan.
ivaika'lai yoaythaavin kumaaranaana penaayaa seythapadiyinaal, moon'ru paraakkiramasaalika'lukku'l'lea pearpet'ravanaay irunthaan.
muppathupearilum ivan meanmaiyu'l'lavan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'rupearukkum ivan samaanamaanavanalla; avanaith thaaveethu than meykkaavalarukkuth thalaivanaaka vaiththaan.
iraa'nuvaththiliruntha mat'rap paraakkiramasaalika'l: yoavaapin thampi aasakeal, pethlekeam ooraanaakiya thoathoavin kumaaran elkkaanaan,
aaroathiyanaakiya sammoath, peloaniyanaakiya eales,
thekkoaviyanaakiya ikkeasin kumaaran eeraa, aanathoaththiyanaakiya apiyeasar,
oosaaththiyanaakiya sipekkaay, akoakiyanaakiya eelaay,
neththoapaaththiyanaakiya makaraayi, neththoapaaththiyanaakiya paanaavin kumaaran ealeath,
penyameen puththirarin kipeayaa ooraanaakiya ripaayin kumaaran iththaayi, piraththoaniyanaakiya penaayaa,
kaakaas neeroadaith theasaththaanaakiya ooraayi, arpaaththiyanaakiya apiyeal,
pakaroomiyanaakiya asmaaveath, saalpoaniyanaakiya eliyaapaa,
keesoaniyanaakiya aaseamin kumaarar, aaraariyanaakiya saakiyin kumaaran yoanaththaan.
aaraariyanaakiya saakkaarin kumaaran akiyaam, oorin kumaaran elipaal,
mekaraaththiyanaakiya eppear, peloaniyanaakiya akiyaa,
karmealiyanaakiya esroa, espaayin kumaaran naaraayi,
naaththaanin sakoatharan yoaveal, akariyin kumaaran mipkaar,
ammoaniyanaakiya sealeak, seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaapin aayuthathaariyaana peroaththiyanaakiya naaraayi,
iththariyanaakiya eeraa, iththariyanaakiya kaarep,
eaththiyanaakiya uriyaa, aklaayin kumaaran saapaath,
roopaniyarin thalaivanaakiya seesaavin kumaaran athinaa ennum roopaniyan; avanoadea muppathupear irunthaarka'l.
maakaavin kumaaran aanaan, mithiniyanaakiya yoasapaath,
asthareaththiyanaakiya usiyaa, aaroaveariyanaakiya oaththaamin kumaarar samaavum, yeakiyealum,
simriyin kumaaran ethiyaayeal, thithsiyanaakiya avan sakoatharan yoakaa,
maakaaviyarin puththiran eliyeal, elnaamin kumaarar eripaayum, yosaviyaavum, moavaapiyanaana ithmaavum,
mesoapaayaa ooraaraakiya eliyealum, oapeathum, yaaseeyealumea.
thaaveethu keesin kumaaranaakiya savulinimiththam innum ma'raivaayirukkaiyil, siklaakilirukki'ra avanidaththi'rku vanthu,

yuththaththi'rku oththaasai seytha vilveerarum, kava'nkal e'riki'ratha'rkum villinaal ampu eyki'ratha'rkum valathu idathu kaivaattamaana paraakkiramasaalika'laana mat'ra manusharumaanavarka'l: savulin sakoathararaakiya penyameen koaththiraththil,
kipeayaa ooraanaakiya seamaavin kumaarar akiyeasar ennum thalaivanum, yoavaasum, asmaaveaththin kumaararaakiya esiyealum, pealeaththum, peraakkaa, aanathoaththiyanaana eakoo enpavarka'lum,
muppathupearil paraakkiramanum muppathupearukkup periyavanumaana ismaayaa ennum kipiyoaniyanum, ereamiyaa, yakaasiyeal, yoakanaan, kethearooraanaana yoasapaath,
elusaayi, erimoath, pikaliyaa, semariyaa, aruppiyanaana seppaththiyaa,
elkkaanaa, eshiyaa, asaariyeal, yoveasear, yasopeyaam ennum koareakiyarum,
yovealaa, sepathiyaa ennum keathoar ooraanaana eroakaamin kumaararumea.

kaaththiyaril parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththu, singkamukampoan'ra mukamum, malaika'lilirukki'ra ve'limaan veakampoan'ra veakamumu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu, yuththaseavakaraana paraakkiramasaalika'l silarum vanaantharaththilu'l'la ara'naana idaththil irukki'ra thaaveethu padchamaaych searnthaarka'l.
yaaren'raal, ethsear ennum thalaivan, avanukku ira'ndaavathu opathiyaa; moon'raavathu eliyaap,
naalaavathu mismannaa, ainthaavathu ereamiyaa,
aa'raavathu aththaayi, eazhaavathu eliyeal,
ettaavathu yoakanaan, onpathaavathu elsapaath,
paththaavathu ereamiyaa, pathinoaraavathu makpannaayi;
kaath puththiraraana ivarka'l iraa'nuvaththalaivaraayirunthaarka'l; avarka'lil si'riyavan noo'rupearukkum periyavan aayirampearukkum searvaikkaararaayirunthaarka'l.
yoarthaan karaipura'ndupoayirukki'ra muthalaam maathaththil athaik kadanthu, kizhakkeayum mea'rkeayum pa'l'laththaakkuka'lil irukki'ra yaavaraiyum thuraththivittavarka'l ivarka'lea.
pinnum penyameen puththirarilum yoothaapuththirarilum silar ara'naana sthalaththil irukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil vanthaarka'l.

thaaveethu pu'rappattu, avarka'lukku ethirko'ndupoay, avarka'lukku uththaravukoduththu: neengka'l enakku uthavi seyyach samaathaanamaay ennidaththil vantheerka'laanaal, en iruthayam ungka'loadu isainthirukkum; en kaika'lil kodumai illaathirukka, ennai en saththurukka'lukkuk kaattikkodukka vantheerka'leayaakil, nammudaiya pithaakka'lin theavan athaip paarththuk ka'ndippaaraaka en'raan.

appozhuthu athipathika'lukkuth thalaivanaana amaasaayinmeal aavi i'rangkinathinaal, avan: thaaveethea, naangka'l ummudaiyavarka'l; eesaayin kumaaranea, umathu padchamaayiruppoam; umakkuch samaathaanam, samaathaanam; umakku uthaviseyki'ravarka'lukkum samaathaanam; ummudaiya theavan umakkuth thu'nai ni'rki'raar en'raan; appozhuthu thaaveethu avarka'laich searththukko'ndu, avarka'laith tha'ndukkuth thalaivaraakkinaan.

savulinmeal yuththampa'n'nappoaki'ra pelistharudaneakoodath thaaveethu varuki'rapoathu, manaaseayilum silar avan padchamaaych searnthaarka'l; pelistharin pirapukka'l yoasanaipa'n'ni, avan nammudaiya thalaika'lukku moasamaayth than aa'ndavanaakiya savulin padchamaayp poavaan en'ru avanai anuppivittaarka'l; athanaal avarka'l ivarka'lukku uthaviseyyavillai.

appadiyea avan siklaakukkuth thirumpippoakaiyil, manaaseayil athnaak, yoasapaath, ethiyaaveal, mikaayeal, yoasapaath, elikoo, silththaayi ennum manaasea koaththiraththaarin aayiraththuch searvaikkaarar avan padchamaay vanthaarka'l.
anthath tha'ndukku viroathamaay ivarka'l thaaveethukku uthaviseythaarka'l; ivarka'lellaarum paraakkiramasaalika'lum iraa'nuvaththil searvaikkaararumaayirunthaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea naa'lukkunaa'l thaaveethukku uthaviseyyum manushar avanidaththil vanthu searnthapadiyaal, avarka'l theavaseanaiyaippoala makaa seanaiyaanaarka'l.
karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea, savulin raajyapaaraththaith thaaveethinidamaayth thiruppa, eproanilirukki'ra avanidaththukku vantha yuththasannaththaraana thalaivarin ilakkamaavana:
yoothaapuththiraril parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththu, yuththasannaththaraanavarka'l aa'raayiraththu e'n'noo'rupear.
simiyoan puththiraril paraakkiramasaalika'laakiya yuththaveerar eazhaayiraththu noo'rupear.
leavi puththiraril naalaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
aaroan santhathiyaarin athipathiyaakiya yoaythaavum, avanoadiruntha moovaayiraththu ezhunoo'rupearum,
paraakkiramasaaliyaana saathoak ennum vaalipanum, avan thakappan vamsaththaaraana irupaththira'ndu thalaivarumea.
penyameen puththiraraana savulin sakoathararil moovaayirampear; athuvaraikkum avarka'lil michchamaanavarka'l savulin kudumpaththaik kaappaat'rap paarththaarka'l.
eppiraayeem puththiraril thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththil pearpet'ra manusharaana paraakkiramasaalika'l irupathinaayiraththu e'n'noo'rupear.
manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththil thaaveethai raajaavaakkuki'ratha'rku varumpadi, pearpearaakak ku'rikkappattavarka'l pathine'n'naayirampear.

isakkaar puththiraril, isravealar seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru a'rinthu kaalaakaalangka'lukkuth thakuntha yoasanai sollaththakka thalaivarka'l irunoo'rupearum, ivarka'l vaakkukkuch sevikoduththa ivarka'ludaiya ellaach sakoathararumea.

sepuloan puththiraril sakalavitha yuththa aayuthangka'laalum yuththam seyki'ratha'rkum, thangka'l a'niyaik kaaththuni'rki'ratha'rkum pazhaki, vagnchanaiseyyaamal yuththaththi'rkup poakaththakkavarka'l aimpathinaayirampear.
napthali puththiraril aayiram thalaivarka'l parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththa avarka'loadeakooda irunthavarka'l muppaththeazhaayirampear.
thaa'n puththiraril yuththaththi'rkuth thea'rinavarka'l irupaththu e'n'naayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
aasear puththiraril yuththaththi'rkuth thea'rinavarka'laaych seavakampa'n'nap poakaththakkavarka'l naa'rpathinaayirampear.
yoarthaanukku akkaraiyaana roopaniyarilum, kaaththiyarilum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaarilum, yuththampa'n'nach sakalavitha aayuthangka'laiyum thariththavarka'l noot'rirupathinaayirampear.

thaaveethai isravealinmeal raajaavaakkuki'ratha'rku, intha yuththamanushar ellaarum a'ni a'niyaay vaikkappattavarka'laaka, uththama iruthayaththoadea eproanukku vanthaarka'l; isravealil mat'ra yaavarum thaaveethai raajaavaakkuki'ratha'rku orumanappattirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l angkea thaaveethoadeakooda moon'runaa'l irunthu, poajanapaanampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l sakoatharar avarka'lukkaakach sakalaththaiyum aayaththampa'n'niyirunthaarka'l.

isakkaar, sepuloan, napthaliyin ellaimattum avarka'lukkuch sameepamaayirunthavarka'lum, kazhuthaika'lmealum ottakangka'lmealum koavea'ru kazhuthaika'lmealum maaduka'lmealum, thinpa'ndangka'laakiya maa, aththippazha adaika'l, vat'ralaana thiraadchappazhangka'l, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney, aadumaaduka'l aakiya ivaika'lai vea'ndiyamattum eat'rikko'nduvanthaarka'l; isravealilea makizhchchiyu'ndaayit'ru.
thaaveethu aayirampearukkuth thalaivaroadum noo'rupearukkuth thalaivaroadum sakala athipathika'loadum aaloasanaipa'n'ni,

israveal sapaiyaiyellaam noakki: ungka'lukkuch sammathiyum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkuch siththamumaayirunthaal, isravealin theasangka'lilellaam irukki'ra nammudaiya mat'rach sakoathararum, avarka'loadea thangka'l ve'linilangka'lil irukki'ra aasaariyarum leaviyarum nammoadea koodumpadikku naam seekkiramaay avarka'lidaththukku aa'l anuppi,
namathu theavanudaiya pettiyaith thirumpa nammidaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvoamaaka; savulin naadka'lil athaith theadaatheapoanoam en'raan.
inthak kaariyam sakala janaththin paarvaikkum semmaiyaayirunthapadiyaal, sapaiyaar ellaarum appadiyea seyvoam en'raarka'l.
appadiyea theavanudaiya pettiyaik keeriyaathyaareemilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadi, thaaveethu ekipthaichsearntha seekoar nathithuvakki aamaaththin ellaimattumu'l'la isravealaiyellaangkootti,

kearupeenka'lin naduvea vaasampa'n'nuki'ra karththaraakiya theavanudaiya naamam thozhuthuko'l'lappaduki'ra avarudaiya pettiyai yoothaavilirukki'ra keeriyaathyaareemukkaduththa paalaavilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadikku, avanum isravealar anaivarum avvidaththi'rkuppoanaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanudaiya pettiyai apinathaapin veettilirunthu oru puthurathaththinmeal eat'rikko'ndu vanthaarka'l; oosaavum akiyoavum rathaththai nadaththinaarka'l.

thaaveethum sakala isravealarum thangka'l muzhup palaththoadum theavanukkumunpaakach surama'ndalangka'laiyum thampuruka'laiyum mea'langka'laiyum kaiththaa'langka'laiyum poorikaika'laiyum seaviththu makizhchchiyaay aadippaadinaarka'l.
avarka'l keethoanin ka'lamattum vanthapoathu, maaduka'l ida'rinapadiyinaal, oosaa pettiyaip pidikkath than kaiyai neettinaan.
appozhuthu karththar oosaavinmeal koapam moo'ndavaraaki, avan thankaiyai pettiya'ndaikku neettinathinimiththam avanai adiththaar; angkea avan theavasamukaththil seththaan.
appozhuthu karththar oosaavai adiththathinimiththam thaaveethu visanappattu, antha sthalaththi'rku innaa'lmattum vazhangkivaruki'ra peareas oosaa ennum pearittu,
an'raiyathinam theavanukkuppayanthu: theavanudaiya pettiyai naan ennidaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvathu eppadiyen'ru solli,
pettiyaith thannidaththil thaaveethin nakaraththilea ko'nduvaraamal, athaik kiththiyanaakiya oapeatheathoamin veettilea searththaan.
theavanudaiya petti oapeatheathoamin veettilea avanidaththil moon'rumaatham irukkaiyil, karththar oapeatheathoamin veettaiyum avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum aaseervathiththaar.
theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraam thaaveethinidaththil sthaanaapathika'laiyum, avanukku oru veettaik kattuki'ratha'rkuk keathurumarangka'laiyum, thachcharaiyum, kalthachcharaiyum anuppinaan.
karththar thannai isravealinmeal raajaavaakath thidappaduththi, israveal ennum thammudaiya janaththinimiththam thannudaiya raajyaththai mikavum uyarththinaar en'ru thaaveethu a'rinthuko'ndaan.
erusaleamilea thaaveethu pinnum aneaka sthireeka'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, pinnum kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
erusaleamilea avanukkup pi'rantha kumaararin naamangka'laavana: sammuvaa, soapaap, naaththaan, saalomoan,
ipkaar, elisoovaa, elpeleath,
noakaa, neppeak, yappiyaa,
elishaamaa, peliyaathaa, elippeleath enpavaika'l.

thaaveethu samastha isravealinmealum raajaavaaka apisheakampa'n'nappattathaip pelisthar kea'lvippattapoathu, pelisthar ellaarum thaaveethaith theadumpadi vanthaarka'l; athaith thaaveethu keattapoathu avarka'lukku viroathamaakap pu'rappattaan.
pelisthar vanthu reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea paraviyirunthaarka'l.
pelistharukku viroathamaakap poakalaamaa, avarka'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduppeeraa en'ru thaaveethu theavanaik keattapoathu, karththar: poa, avarka'lai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'raar.

avarka'l paakaalpiraaseemukku vanthapoathu, thaaveethu angkea avarka'lai mu'riya adiththu: tha'n'neerka'l udainthoaduki'rathupoala, theavan en kaiyinaal en saththurukka'lai udainthoadappa'n'ninaar en'raan; athinimiththam antha sthalaththi'rkup paakaalpiraaseem ennum pearittaarka'l.
angkea avarka'l thangka'l theyvangka'laivittu oadippoanaarka'l; thaaveethu ka'rpiththapadi avaika'l akkiniyaalea sutterikkappattana.
pelisthar ma'rupadiyum vanthu anthap pa'l'laththaakkilea i'rangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu thirumpath theavanidaththil visaariththatha'rku, theavan nee avarka'lukkup pinnaalea poakaamal, avarka'lukkup pakkamaaych sut'ri, musukkattaich sedika'lukku ethireayirunthu, avarka'lmeal paaynthu,

musukkattaich sedika'lin nunika'lilea selluki'ra iraichchalai nee keadkumpoathu, yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadu; pelistharin paa'layaththai mu'riya adikka, theavan unakku munnea pu'rappattiruppaar en'raar.
theavan thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea thaaveethu seythapoathu, pelistharin iraa'nuvaththaik kipiyoan thuvakkik kaasearmattum mu'riya adiththaarka'l.
appadiyea thaaveethin keerththi sakala theasangka'lilum pirasiththamaaki, avanukkup payappaduki'ra payaththaik karththar sakala jaathika'linmealum varappa'n'ninaar.
avan thanakkuth thaaveethin nakaraththil veeduka'lai u'ndaakki, theavanudaiya pettikku oru sthalaththai aayaththappaduththi, atha'rku oru koodaaraththaip poattaan.

pi'rpaadu thaaveethu: leaviyar ozhiya vea'roruvarum theavanudaiya pettiyai edukkalaakaathu; theavanudaiya pettiyai edukkavum, en'raikkum avarukkup pa'nividaiseyyavum, avarka'laiyea karththar therinthuko'ndaar en'raan.
appadiyea karththarudaiya pettikkuth thaan aayaththappaduththina athin sthalaththi'rku athaik ko'nduvarumpadi, thaaveethu isravealaiyellaam erusaleamilea koodivarachseythaan.
aaroanin puththiraraiyum,
leaviyaraakiya koakaath puththiraril pirapuvaakiya ooriyealaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya noot'rirupathupearaiyum,
meraariyin puththiraril pirapuvaakiya asaayaavaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya irunoot'rirupathupearaiyum,
kersoan puththiraril pirapuvaakiya yoavealaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya noot'rumuppathupearaiyum,
elisaappaan puththiraril pirapuvaakiya semaayaavaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya irunoo'rupearaiyum,
eproan puththiraril pirapuvaakiya eliyealaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya e'npathupearaiyum,
oosiyeal puththiraril pirapuvaakiya amminathaapaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya noot'rup pannira'ndupearaiyum thaaveethu koodivarappa'n'ninaan.
pinpu thaaveethu aasaariyaraakiya saathoakkaiyum, apiyaththaaraiyum, leaviyaraakiya ooriyeal, asaayaa, yoaveal, semaayaa, eliyeal, amminathaap enpavarka'laiyum azhaiththu,

avarka'lai noakki: leaviyaril neengka'l pithaakka'ludaiya santhathika'lin thalaivar, neengka'l isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin pettiyai atha'rku naan aayaththampa'n'nina sthalaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarumpadi, ungka'laiyum ungka'l sakoathararaiyum parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l.
muthalil neengka'l athaich sumakkaathapadiyinaalum, naam nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai niyaayamaanapadiyea theadaatheapoanapadiyinaalum, avar namakku'l'lea adivizhappa'n'ninaar en'raan.
appadiyea aasaariyarum leaviyarum isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin pettiyaik ko'nduvarath thangka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu leavi puththirar karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, moasea ka'rpiththapirakaaram theavanudaiya pettiyai athin tha'nduka'linaalea thangka'l thoa'lmeal eduththukko'nduvanthaarka'l.

thaaveethu leaviyarin pirapukka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l sakoathararaakiya paadakaraith thampuru surama'ndalam kaiththaa'la muthaliya keethavaaththiyangka'l muzhangka, thangka'l saththaththai uyarththi, santhoasham u'ndaakap paadumpadi ni'ruththavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.

appadiyea leaviyar yoavealin kumaaranaakiya eamaanaiyum, avan sakoathararil perakiyaavin kumaaranaakiya aasaappaiyum, meraariyin puththiraraana thangka'l sakoathararil kushaayaavin kumaaranaakiya eaththaanaiyum,

ivarka'loadungkooda ira'ndaavathu varisaiyaakath thangka'l sakoathararaakiya sakariyaa, pean, yaasiyeal, semiramoath, yekiyeal, unni, eliyaap, penaayaa, maaseyaa, maththiththiyaa, elippeleaku, mikneayaa, oapeatheathoam, eayel ennum vaasal kaavalaa'laraiyum ni'ruththinaarka'l.
paadakaraakiya eamaanum, aasaappum, eaththaanum, pagnchaloakak kaiththaa'langka'laith thonikkappa'n'nip paadinaarka'l.
sakariyaa, aasiyeal, semiramoath, yekiyeal, unni, eliyaap, maaseyaa, penaayaa enpavarka'l almoath ennum isaiyil paadi, thampuruka'lai vaasiththaarka'l.
maththiththiyaa, elippeleaku, mikneayaa, oapeatheathoam, eayel, asasiyaa enpavarka'l semaneeth ennum isaiyil paadi, surama'ndalangka'lai nearththiyaay vaasiththaarka'l.
leaviyarukku'l'lea kenaaniyaa enpavan sangkeethaththalaivanaayirunthaan; avan nipu'nanaanapadiyaal, keethaviththaiyaip padippiththaan.
perakiyaavum elkkaanaavum pettikku munpaakak kaavalkaaththuvanthaarka'l.

sepaniyaa, yoasapaath, nethaneyeal, amaasaayi, sakariyaa, penaayaa, eliyeasar ennum aasaariyar theavanudaiya pettikku munpaakap poorikaika'lai oothinaarka'l; oapeatheathoamum, ekiyaavum pettikku vaasal kaavalaa'laraayirunthaarka'l.
ippadith thaaveethum, isravealin moopparum, aayiraththuch searvaikkaararum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyai oapeatheathoamin veettilirunthu makizhchchiyoadea ko'nduvarappoanaarka'l.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyaich sumakki'ra leaviyarukkuth theavan anukkirakampa'n'ninapadiyaal, avarka'l eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum paliyittaarka'l.

thaaveethum, pettiyaich sumakki'ra sakala leaviyarum, paadakarum, paadakarin vealaiyai visaarikki'ra thalaivanaakiya kenaaniyaavum, melliya pudavaiyaana saalvaika'laith thariththirunthaarka'l; thaaveethu sa'nalnool eapoaththaith thariththirunthaan.

appadiyea isravealanaiththum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaik kempeeraththoadum, ekkaa'langka'l poorikaika'l kaiththaa'langka'lin thoniyoadum, thampuruka'laiyum surama'ndalangka'laiyum vaasikki'ra saththaththoadum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippetti thaaveethin nakaramattum vanthapoathu, savulin kumaaraththiyaakiya meekaa'l palaka'nivazhiyaayp paarththu, thaaveethu raajaa aadippaadi varuki'rathaik ka'ndu, avanaith than iruthayaththilea avamathiththaa'l.

avarka'l theavanudaiya pettiyai u'l'lea ko'nduvanthapoathu, thaaveethu atha'rkup poatta koodaaraththin naduvea avarka'l athai vaiththu, theavanudaiya sannithiyil sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum seluththinaarka'l.
thaaveethu sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum seluththith theernthapinpu, avan janaththaik karththarudaiya naamaththilea aaseervathiththu,
purushar thodangki sthireeka'lmattum, isravealaraakiya anaivarukkum avaravarukku ovvoru appaththaiyum, ovvoru i'raichchith thu'ndaiyum, ovvorupadi thiraadcharasaththaiyum pangkittuk koduththaan.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththaraip pirasthaapampa'n'nith thuthiththup pukazhuki'ratha'rku karththarudaiya pettikku munpaakach seavikkaththakka leaviyaril silarai niyamiththaan.

avarka'lil aasaap thalaivanum, sakariyaa avanukku ira'ndaavathumaayirunthaan; eayel, semiramoath, yekiyeal, maththiththiyaa, eliyaap, penaayaa, oapeatheathoam, eayel enpavarka'l thampuru surama'ndalam ennum keethavaaththiyangka'lai vaasikkavum, aasaap kaiththaa'langka'laik kottavum,
penaayaa, yaakaasiyeal ennum aasaariyar eppoathum theavanudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munpaakap poorikaika'lai oothavum niyamikkappattaarka'l.
appadi aarampiththa annaa'lileathaanea karththarukkuth thuthiyaakap paadumpadi thaaveethu aasaappidaththilum avan sakoathararidaththilum koduththa sangkeethamaavathu:
karththaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththaip pirasthaapamaakkungka'l; avarudaiya seykaika'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea pirasiththappaduththungka'l.
avaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya athisayangka'laiyellaam thiyaaniththup peasungka'l.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattungka'l; karththaraith theaduki'ravarka'lin iruthayam makizhvathaaka.
karththaraiyum avar vallamaiyaiyum naadungka'l; avar samukaththai niththamum theadungka'l.
avarudaiya thaasanaakiya isravealin santhathiyea! avaraal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'laakiya yaakkoapin puththirarea!
avar seytha athisayangka'laiyum avarudaiya a'rputhangka'laiyum, avar vaakkin niyaayaththeerppuka'laiyum ninaivukoorungka'l.
avarea nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar; avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l poomiyengkum vi'langkum.
aayiranthalaimu'raikken'ru avar katta'laiyitta vaakkaiyum, aapirakaamoadea avar pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum,
avar eesaakkukku itta aa'naiyaiyum en'ren'raikkum ninaiththirungka'l.
athai yaakkoapukkup piramaa'namaakavum, isravealukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaakavum u'ruthippaduththi:
ungka'l suthantharapaakamaaka kaanaan theasaththai unakkuth tharuvean en'raar.
akkaalaththil avarka'l kognchaththokaikkudpatta so'rpajanangka'lum paratheasika'lumaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l oru janaththai vittu ma'ru janaththa'ndaikkum, oru raajyaththaivittu ma'ru theasaththaara'ndaikkum poanaarka'l.
avarka'lai yodukkumpadi oruvarukkum idangkodaamal, avarka'l nimiththam raajaakka'laik kadinthuko'ndu:
naan apisheakampa'n'ninavarka'lai neengka'l thodaamalum, ennudaiya theerkkatharisika'lukkuth theengkuseyyaamalum irungka'l en'raar.
poomiyin sakala kudika'lea, karththaraip paadi, naa'lukkunaa'l avarudaiya radchippaich suviseashamaay a'riviyungka'l.
jaathika'lukku'l avarudaiya makimaiyaiyum, sakala janangka'lukku'l'lum avarudaiya athisayangka'laiyum vivariththuch sollungka'l.
karththar periyavarum mikavum thuthikkappadaththakkavarumaayirukki'raar; ellaa theavarka'lilum payappadaththakkavar avarea.
sakala janangka'ludaiya theavarka'lum vikkirakangka'lthaanea; karththaroa vaanangka'lai u'ndaakkinavar.
makimaiyum kanamum avar samukaththil irukki'rathu; vallamaiyum makizhchchiyum avar sthalaththil irukki'rathu.
janangka'lin vamsangka'lea, karththarukku makimaiyaiyum vallamaiyaiyum seluththungka'l; karththarukkea athaich seluththungka'l.

karththarukku avarudaiya naamaththi'rkuriya makimaiyaich seluththi, kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, avarudaiya sannithiyil piraveasiyungka'l; parisuththa alangkaaraththudanea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungka'l.
pooloakaththaarea, neengka'l yaavarum avarukku munpaaka nadungkungka'l; avar poochchakkaraththai asaiyaathapadikku u'ruthippaduththuki'ravar.
vaanangka'l makizhnthu, poomi poorippathaaka; karththar raajarikampa'n'nuki'raar en'ru jaathika'lukku'l'lea sollappaduvathaaka.
samuththiramum athin ni'raivum muzhangki, naadum athilu'l'la yaavum ka'likooruvathaaka.
appozhuthu karththarukku munpaakak kaattuvirudchangka'lum kempeerikkum; avar poomiyai niyaayantheerkka varuki'raar.
karththaraith thuthiyungka'l, avar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.

engka'l radchippin theavanea, naangka'l umathu parisuththa naamaththaip poat'ri, ummaith thuthikki'rathinaal meanmaipaaraattumpadikku, engka'lai radchiththu, engka'laich searththukko'ndu, jaathika'lukku engka'lai neengkalaakkiyaru'lum en'ru sollungka'l.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkuch sathaakaalangka'lilum sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka; atha'rku janangka'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollik karththaraith thuthiththaarka'l.

pinpu pettikku munpaaka niththam an'raadaka mu'raiyaaych seavikkumpadi, avan angkea karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munpaaka aasaappaiyum, avan sakoathararaiyum, oapeatheathoamaiyum, avarka'ludaiya sakoathararaakiya a'rupaththettuppearaiyum vaiththu,
ethiththoonin kumaaranaakiya intha oapeatheathoamaiyum oasaavaiyum vaasalkaakki'ravarka'laaka vaiththaan.

kipiyoanilu'l'la meattinmealirukki'ra karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththi'rku munpaaka irukki'ra sarvaangka thakanapalipeedaththinmeal sarvaangka thakanangka'lai niththamum, anthisanthiyil, karththar isravealukkuk ka'rpiththa niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyellaam karththarukkuch seluththuvatha'rkaaka,
angkea avan aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkaiyum, avan sakoathararaakiya aasaariyaraiyum vaiththu,
ivarka'loadungkooda eamaanaiyum, ethiththoonaiyum, pearpearaakak ku'riththuth therinthuko'l'lappatta mat'rach silaraiyum: karththarudaiya kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru avaraith thuthikkavum,

poorikaika'laiyum kaiththaa'langka'laiyum theavanaip paaduki'ratha'rkuriya keethavaaththiyangka'laiyum thonikkachseyyavum avarka'ludan eamaanaiyum ethiththoonaiyum vaiththu, ethiththoonin kumaararai vaasalkaakki'ravarka'laakak katta'laiyittaan.
pinpu janangka'l ellaarum avaravar thangka'l veetti'rkup poanaarka'l; thaaveethum than veettaarai aaseervathikkaththirumpinaan.

thaaveethu than veettilea vaasamaayirukki'rapoathu, avan theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanai noakki: paarum, naan keathurumaraveettilea vaasampa'n'nuki'rean; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyoa thiraika'linkeezh irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu naaththaan thaaveethai noakki: ummudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyellaam seyyum; theavan ummoadu irukki'raar en'raan.
an'ru raaththiriyilea, theavanudaiya vaarththai naaththaanukku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee poay, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan vaasamaayirukka nee enakku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam.

naan isravealai varappa'n'nina naa'lmutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum naan oru aalayaththilea vaasampa'n'naamal, oru koodaaraththilirunthu ma'ru koodaaraththukkum, oru vaasasthalaththilirunthu ma'ru vaasasthalaththukkum poanean.

naan sakala isravealoadum ulaavi vantha evvidaththilaakilum, naan en janaththai meaykkak ka'rpiththa isravealin niyaayaathipathika'lil yaathoruvanai noakki: neengka'l enakkuk keathurumaraththaal seyyappatta aalayaththaik kattaathirukki'rathu enna en'ru yaathoru vaarththai sonnathu u'ndoa?

ippoathum, nee en thaasanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee en janamaakiya isravealinmeal athipathiyaayirukkumpadi, aaduka'lin pinnea nadantha unnai aattumanthaiyai vittu eduththu,
nee poana idamellaam unnoadea irunthu, un saththurukka'laiyellaam unakku munpaaka nirmoolamaakki, poomiyilirukki'ra periyoarka'lin naamaththi'rku oththa naamaththai unakku u'ndaakkinean.

naan en janamaakiya isravealukku oru idaththaiyum ea'rpaduththi, avarka'l thangka'l sthaanaththilea kudiyirukkavum, ini avarka'l alaiyaamalum, munpoalum, naan en janamaakiya isravealinmeal niyaayaathipathika'laik katta'laiyitta naa'lmuthal nadanthathupoalum, niyaayakkeattin makka'laal inich si'rumaippadaamalum irukkavum avarka'lai naattinean.
un saththurukka'laiyellaam keezhppaduththinean. ippoathum karththar unakku oru veettaik kattuvaar enpathai unakku a'rivikki'rean.
nee un pithaakka'lidaththilea poaka, un naadka'l ni'raivea'rumpoathu, naan unakkuppinpu un puththiraril oruvanaakiya un santhathiyai ezhumpappa'n'ni, avan raajyaththai nilaippaduththuvean.
avan enakku oru aalayaththaik kattuvaan; avan singkaasanaththai en'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean.
naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean, avan enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaan; unakku munnirunthavanai vittu en kirupaiyai naan vilakappa'n'ninathupoala, avanai vittu vilakappa'n'naamal,
avanai en aalayaththilum en raajyaththilum en'ren'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean; avanudaiya raajaasanam en'ren'raikkum nilaipet'rirukkum en'ru sol en'raar.
naaththaan intha ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyum intha ellaath tharisanaththinpadiyum thaaveethukkuch sonnaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethuraajaa udpiraveasiththu, karththarudaiya samukaththilirunthu: theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareer ennai ithuvaraikkum ko'nduvanthatha'rku naan emmaaththiram? en veedum emmaaththiram?

theavanea, ithu innum ummudaiya paarvaikkuk kognchakkaariyamaayirukki'rathu en'ru theavanaana karththaraayirukki'ra neer umathu adiyaanudaiya veettaikku'riththu vekuthooramaayirukkum kaalaththuch seythiyaiyum solli, ennai makaa meanmaiyaana santhathiyin manushanaakap paarththeer.
umathu adiyaanukku u'ndaakum kanaththaippat'ri, thaaveethu appu'ram ummoadea solvathu enna? theavareer umathu adiyaanai a'riveer.
karththaavea, umathu adiyaanin nimiththamum, umathu iruthayaththinpadiyum, inthap periya kaariyangka'laiyellaam a'riyappa'n'numpadikku, inthap periya kaariyaththaiyellaam seytheer.
karththaavea, naangka'l engka'l kaathuka'laal keatta ellaavat'rinpadiyum theavareerukku nikaraanavar illai; ummaiththavira vea'rea theavanum illai.

umathu janamaakiya isravealukku nikaraana janamum u'ndoa? pooloakaththil intha orea jaathiyaith theavanaakiya neer umakku janamaaka meedkumpadi, payangkaramaana periya kaariyangka'linaal umakkuk keerththiyai u'ndaakki, neer ekipthi'rku neengkalaakki meetta umathu janaththi'rkumunpaaka jaathika'laith thuraththi,
umathu janamaakiya isravealar en'raikkum umathu janamaayiruppatha'rku avarka'lai nilaippaduththi, karththaraakiya neerthaamea avarka'lukkuth theavanaaneer.
ippoathum karththaavea, theavareer adiyaanaiyum avan veettaiyum ku'riththuch sonna vaarththai en'ren'raikkum nilaivarappattiruppathaaka; theavareer sonnapadiyea seytharu'lum.

aam, athu nilaivarappattirukkavum, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar isravealukkuth theavan en'rum, umathu adiyaanaakiya thaaveethin veedu umakku munpaakath thidamaanathen'rum sollappaduvathinaal, umathu naamam en'raikkum makimaippadavumkadavathu.
unakku veedu kattuvean en'ru en theavanaakiya neer umathu adiyaan sevikeadka ve'lippaduththineer; aakaiyaal umakku munpaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'na, umathu adiyaanukku manaththairiyam kidaiththathu.
ippoathum karththaavea, neerea theavan; neer umathu adiyaanaikku'riththu intha nalla viseashaththaich sonneer.

ippoathum umathu adiyaanin veedu en'raikkum umakku munpaaka irukkumpadikku, athai aaseervathiththaru'lineer; karththaraakiya theavareer athai aaseervathiththapadiyinaal, athu en'raikkum aaseervathikkappattirukkum en'raan.
itha'rkuppinpu, thaaveethu pelistharai mu'riya adiththu, avarka'laik keezhppaduththi, kaathpatta'naththaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum pelistharin kaiyilirunthu pidiththukko'ndaan.
avan moavaapiyaraiyum mu'riya adiththathinaal, moavaapiyar thaaveethaich seaviththu avanukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththinaarka'l.
soapaavin raajaavaakiya aathaareasar aipiraath nathiya'ndaiyil than iraa'nuvaththai ni'ruththappoaki'rapoathu, thaaveethu avanaiyum aamaaththin kittea mu'riya adiththaan.

avanukku iruntha aayiram irathangka'laiyum eazhaayiram kuthiraiveeraraiyum irupathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum pidiththu, irathangka'lil noo'ru irathangka'lai vaiththukko'ndu, mat'ravaika'laiyellaam thu'ndaadippoattaan.
soapaavin raajaavaakiya aathaareasarukku uthaviseyyath thamaskupatta'naththaaraakiya seeriyar vanthaarka'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril irupaththeeraayirampearai vettippoattu,

thamaskuvukkaduththa seeriyaavilea thaa'naiyangka'lai vaiththaan; seeriyar thaaveethaich seaviththu avanukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththinaarka'l; thaaveethu poana idaththilellaam karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
aathaareasarin seavakarukku iruntha pon parisaika'laith thaaveethu eduththu, avaika'lai erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthaan.

aathaareasarin patta'nangka'laakiya thipkaaththilum koonilumirunthu thaaveethu veku thira'laana ve'nkalaththaiyum eduththukko'nduvanthaan; athinaalea saalomoan ve'nkalak kadalthottiyaiyum thoo'nka'laiyum ve'nkalath thattumuttuka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan.
thaaveethu soapaavin raajaavaakiya aathaareasarin iraa'nuvaththaiyellaam mu'riya adiththa seythiyai aamaaththin raajaavaakiya thoayoo keattapoathu,

avan thaaveethu raajaavin sukaseythiyai visaarikkavum, avan aathaareasaroadu yuththampa'n'ni, avanai mu'riya adiththatha'rkaaka avanukku vinavuthal sollavum, than kumaaranaakiya athoaraamaiyum, ponnum ve'l'liyum ve'nkalamumaana sakalavithath thattumuttuka'laiyum, avanidaththukku anuppinaan; aathaareasar thoayoovinmeal yuththampa'n'nuki'ravanaayirunthaan.

anthath thattumuttuka'laiyum, thaan eathoamiyar, moavaapiyar, ammoan puththirar, pelisthar, amaleakkiyar ennum sakala jaathika'lin kaiyilum vaangkina ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyumkoodath thaaveethuraajaa karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaan.
seruyaavin kumaaran apisaayi uppup pa'l'laththaakkilea pathine'n'naayiram eathoamiyarai mu'riya adiththaan.
aakaiyaal thaaveethu eathoamilea thaa'naiyam poattaan; eathoamiyar ellaarum avanaich seavikki'ravarka'laanaarka'l; thaaveethu poana idaththilellaam karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
thaaveethu isravealaiyellaam aa'ndu, thannudaiya janaththi'rkellaam niyaayamum neethiyum seythaan.
seruyaavin kumaaran yoavaap iraa'nuvaththalaivanaayirunthaan; aakiloothin kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath manthiriyaayirunthaan.
akithoopin kumaaran saathoakkum, apiyaththaarin kumaaran apimeleakkum aasaariyaraayirunthaarka'l; savishaa sampirathiyaayirunthaan.
yoaythaavin kumaaran penaayaa kireaththiyarukkum pileaththiyarukkum thalaivanaayirunthaan; thaaveethin puththirar raajaavinidaththil pirathaanika'laayirunthaarka'l.
athanpinpu, ammoan puththirarin raajaavaakiya naakaas mariththu, avan kumaaran avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: aanoonin thakappanaakiya naakaas enakkuth thayavuseythathupoala, naanum avan kumaaranaakiya ivanukkuth thayavuseyvean en'ru solli, avan thakappanukkaaka avanukku aa'ruthalsolla sthaanaapathika'lai anuppinaan; thaaveethin oozhiyakkaarar aanoonukku aa'ruthalsolla ammoan puththirarin theasaththilea vanthapoathu,

ammoan puththirarin pirapukka'l aanoonaip paarththu: thaaveethu aa'ruthal solluki'ravarka'lai ummidaththil anuppinathu, ummudaiya thakappanaik kanampa'n'nuki'rathaay umakkuth thoan'ruki'rathoa? theasaththai aaraayavum, athaik kavizhththuppoadavum, u'lavupaarkkavum allavoa, avan oozhiyakkaarar ummidaththil vanthaarka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu aanoon: thaaveethin oozhiyakkaararaip pidiththu, avarka'l thaadiyaich siraiththu, avarka'ludaiya vasthirangka'lai iruppidamattum vaiththuvittu, mat'rap paathiyaik kaththariththuppoattu, avarka'lai anuppivittaan.

antha manushar varukaiyil, avarka'l seythi thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattathu; appozhuthu antha manushar mikavum vedkappattapadiyinaal, avarka'lukku ethiraaka raajaa aadka'lai anuppi: ungka'l thaadi va'larumattum neengka'l erikoavilirunthu, pi'rpaadu vaarungka'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.

ammoan puththirar thaangka'l thaaveethukku aruvaruppaanathaik ka'ndapoathu, aanoonum ammoan puththirarum mesoppoththaamiyaavilum maakkaa soapaa ennum seeriyarin theasaththilumirunthu thangka'lukku irathangka'lum kuthiraiveerarum koolikku varumpadi aayiramthaalanthu ve'l'li anuppi,

muppaththeeraayiram irathangka'laiyum, maakkaavin raajaavaiyum, avan janaththaiyum koolippadaiyaaka azhaippiththaan; ivarka'l vanthu, meatheapaavukku munpu'raththilea paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l; ammoan puththirarum thangka'l patta'nangka'lilirunthu koodikko'ndu yuththampa'n'navanthaarka'l.
athaith thaaveethu keattapoathu, yoavaapaiyum palasaalika'lin iraa'nuvam muzhuvathaiyum anuppinaan.
ammoan puththirar pu'rappattuvanthu, patta'naththu vaasala'ndaiyil a'nivakuththaarka'l; vantha raajaakka'l thaniththu ve'liyilea poarukku aayaththamaay nin'raarka'l.

yuththa iraa'nuvangka'lin mukapputh thanakku munnum pinnum irukki'rathai yoavaap ka'ndu, avan isravealilea therinthuko'l'lappatta anaivarilum oru pangkaip piriththeduththu, athaich seeriyarukku ethiraaka ni'ruththi,
mat'ra janaththai ammoan puththirarukku ethiraakap poarukku aayaththappaduththi, than sakoatharanaakiya apisaayikku oppuviththu, avanai noakki:
ennaippaarkkilum seeriyar palangko'ndaal nee enakkuth thu'nainil; unnaippaarkkilum ammoan puththirar palangko'ndaal naan unakkuth thu'naini'rpean.
thairiyamaayiru; naam nammudaiya janaththi'rkaakavum, namathu theavanudaiya patta'nangka'lukkaakavum thidanko'ndirukkakkadavoam; karththar thamathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seyvaaraaka en'raan.
pinpu yoavaapum avanoadiruntha janamum seeriyaroadu yuththampa'n'nach searnthaarka'l; avarka'l avanukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l.

seeriyar mu'rinthoaduki'rathai ammoan puththirar ka'ndapoathu, avarka'lum avan sakoatharanaakiya apisaayikku munpaaka mu'rinthoadip patta'naththi'rku udpattaarka'l; yoavaap thirumpa erusaleamukku vanthaan.

thaangka'l isravealukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattathaik ka'ndapoathu, avarka'l nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra seeriyarai varavazhaiththaarka'l; aathaareasarin padaiththalaivanaakiya soappaak avarka'lukku munnaalea nadanthupoanaan.

athu thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan isravealaiyellaam koottikko'ndu, yoarthaanaik kadanthu, avarka'lukkuch sameepamaay vanthapoathu, avarka'lukku ethiraaka iraa'nuvangka'lai ni'ruththinaan; thaaveethu seeriyarukku ethiraaka iraa'nuvangka'laip poarukku aayaththappaduththinapin avanoadu yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

seeriyar isravealukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril eazhaayiram irathangka'lin manusharaiyum, naa'rpathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum kon'ru, padaiththalaivanaakiya soappaakkaiyum kon'raan.

thaangka'l isravealukku munpaaka mu'riya adikkappattathai aathaareasarin seavakar ka'ndapoathu, avarka'l thaaveethoadea samaathaanampa'n'ni, avanaich seaviththaarka'l; appu'ram ammoan puththirarukku uthaviseyya seeriyar manathillaathirunthaarka'l.

ma'ruvarusham, raajaakka'l yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadum kaalam vanthapoathu, yoavaap iraa'nuvapalaththaik koottikko'ndupoay, ammoan puththirarin theasaththaip paazhkkadiththu rappaavukku vanthu athai mut'rikkaipoattaan; thaaveethoa erusaleamil irunthuvittaan; yoavaap rappaavai adiththuch sangkariththaan.

thaaveethu vanthu, avarka'l raajaavudaiya thalaiyinmeal iruntha kireedaththai eduththukko'ndaan; athu oru thaalanthu ponni'raiyum raththinangka'l pathiththathumaayirunthathu; athu thaaveethin thalaiyil vaikkappattathu; patta'naththilirunthu earaa'lamaana ko'l'laiyaiyum ko'ndupoanaan.

pinpu athiliruntha janangka'lai avan ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avarka'lai vaa'lka'lukkum, iruppuppaaraika'lukkum, koadarika'lukkum udpaduththi; ippadi ammoan puththirarin patta'nangka'lukkellaam thaaveethu seythu, ellaa janaththoadungkooda erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaan.

atha'rkuppinpu keasearilea pelistharoadu yuththam u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu oosaaththiyanaakiya sipekkaay iraadchatha puththiraril oruvanaana sippaayi enpavanaik kon'raan; athinaal avarka'l vasappaduththappattaarka'l.

thirumpap pelistharoadu yuththam u'ndaaki'rapoathu, yaaveerin kumaaranaakiya elkkaanaan kaaththooraanaakiya koaliyaaththin sakoatharanaana laakeamiyaik kon'raan; avan eettith thaangku neyki'ravarka'lin padaimaram avva'lavu perithaayirunthathu.

ma'rupadiyum oru yuththam kaaththilea nadanthapoathu, angkea nettaiyanaana oru manushan irunthaan; avanukku avvaa'ru viralaaka irupaththunaalu viralka'l irunthathu, avanum iraadchatha santhathiyaayirunthu,
isravealai ninthiththaan; thaaveethin sakoatharanaakiya simeayaavin kumaaran yoanaththaan avanaik kon'raan.
kaaththooriliruntha iraadchathanukkup pi'rantha ivarka'l thaaveethin kaiyinaalum avan seavakarin kaiyinaalum madinthaarka'l.
saaththaan isravealukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, isravealaith thokaiyiduki'ratha'rkuth thaaveethai eavivittathu.

appadiyea thaaveethu yoavaapaiyum, janaththin searvaikkaararaiyum noakki: neengka'l poay, peyersepaathodangkith thaa'nmattum irukki'ra isravealai e'n'ni, avarka'l ilakkaththai naan a'riyumpadikku, ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu yoavaap: karththarudaiya janangka'l ippoathu irukki'rathaippaarkkilum noo'raththanaiyaay avar varththikkappa'n'nuvaaraaka; aanaalum raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, avarka'lellaarum en aa'ndavanin seavakarallavaa? en aa'ndavan ithai visaarippaanean? isravealinmeal kut'ramu'ndaaka ithu nadakkavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.
yoavaap appadich solliyum, raajaavin vaarththai mealittapadiyinaal, yoavaap pu'rappattu, israveal engkum sut'riththirinthu erusaleamukku vanthu,

janaththai ilakkampaarththu, thokaiyaith thaaveethidaththil koduththaan; isravealilellaam pattayam uruvaththakkavarka'l pathinoruladchampearum, yoothaavil pattayam uruvaththakkavarka'l naaluladchaththu ezhupathinaayirampearum irunthaarka'l.
aanaalum raajaavin vaarththai yoavaapukku aruvaruppaayirunthapadiyinaal, leavi penyameen koaththirangka'lil u'l'lavarka'lai avarka'ludaiya ilakkaththi'rkudpada e'n'naatheapoanaan.
inthak kaariyam theavanudaiya paarvaikku aakaathathaanapadiyinaal avar isravealai vaathiththaar.
thaaveethu theavanai noakki: naan inthak kaariyaththaich seythathinaal mikavum paavagnseythean; ippoathum ummudaiya adiyeanin akkiramaththai neekkividum; veku puththiyeenamaaych seythean en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar, thaaveethin gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya kaaththudanea peasi,

nee thaaveethinidaththil poay: moon'ru kaariyangka'lai unakku munpaaka vaikki'rean; avaika'lil oru kaariyaththaith therinthuko'l; athai naan unakkuch seyvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
appadiyea kaath thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki:

moon'ru varushaththup pagnchamoa? allathu un pakaignarin pattayam unnaip pinthodara nee un saththurukka'lukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadippoakach seyyum moon'rumaathach sangkaaramoa? allathu moon'runaa'l karththarudaiya thoothan isravealudaiya ellaiyengkum sangkaaram u'ndaakumpadi theasaththil ni'rkum karththarudaiya pattayamaakiya ko'l'lai noayoa? ivaika'lil on'raith therinthuko'l en'ru karththar uraikki'raar. ippoathum ennai anuppinavarukku naan enna ma'ruuththaravu ko'ndupoakavea'ndum enpathai yoasiththuppaarum en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu kaaththai noakki: kodiya idukka'nil akappattirukki'rean; ippoathu naan karththarudaiya kaiyilea vizhuveanaaka; avarudaiya irakkangka'l makaa periyathu; manushar kaiyilea vizhaathiruppeanaaka en'raan.
aakaiyaal karththar isravealilea ko'l'lainoayai varappa'n'ninaar; athinaal isravealil ezhupathinaayirampear madinthaarka'l.

erusaleamaiyum azhikkath theavan oru thoothanai anuppinaar; aanaalum avan azhikkaiyil karththar paarththu, anthath theengkukku manasthaapappattu, sangkarikki'ra thoothanai noakki: poathum; ippoathu un kaiyai ni'ruththu en'raar; karththarudaiya thoothan epoosiyanaakiya ornaanin ka'laththa'ndaiyilea nin'raan.

thaaveethu than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, poomikkum vaanaththi'rkum naduvea ni'rki'ra karththarudaiya thoothan uruvina pattayaththaith than kaiyil pidiththu, athai erusaleaminmeal neettiyirukkak ka'ndaan; appozhuthu thaaveethum moopparka'lum irattup poarththukko'ndu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarka'l.

thaaveethu theavanai noakki: janaththai e'n'nachsonnavan naan allavoa? naanthaan paavagnseythean; pollaappu nadappiththean; intha aaduka'l ennaseythathu? en theavanaakiya karththaavea, vaathikkumpadi ummudaiya karam ummudaiya janaththi'rku viroathamaayiraamal, enakkum en thakappan veetti'rkum viroathamaayiruppathaaka en'raan.

appozhuthu epoosiyanaakiya ornaanin ka'laththilea karththarukku oru palipeedaththai u'ndaakkumpadi, thaaveethu angkea poakavea'ndumen'ru thaaveethukkuch sol en'ru karththarudaiya thoothan kaaththukkuk katta'laiyittaan.
appadiyea thaaveethu karththarin naamaththilea kaath sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea poanaan.
ornaan thirumpippaarththaan; avanum avanoadirukki'ra avanudaiya naalu kumaararum antha theavathoothanaik ka'ndu o'liththukko'ndaarka'l; ornaanoa poaradiththukko'ndirunthaan.
thaaveethu ornaanidaththil vanthapoathu, ornaan kavaniththuth thaaveethaip paarththu, avan ka'laththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthu, tharaimattum kuninthu thaaveethai va'nangkinaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu ornaanai noakki: inthak ka'laththin nilaththilea naan karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik kattumpadikku athai enakkuk kodu; vaathai janaththaivittu ni'ruththappada, enakku athaip pe'rum vilaikkuk kodu en'raan.

ornaan thaaveethai noakki: raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavan athai vaangkikko'ndu, thammudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanapadi seyvaaraaka; ithoa, sarvaangkathakanangka'lukku maaduka'lum, vi'rakukkup poaradikki'ra uru'laika'lum, poajanapalikkuk koathumaiyum aakiya yaavaiyum kodukki'rean en'raan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethuraajaa ornaanai noakki: appadiyalla, naan unnudaiyathai ilavasamaay vaangki, karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanaththaip paliyidaamal, athaip pe'rum vilaikku vaangkuvean en'ru solli,
thaaveethu antha nilaththi'rku a'runoo'ru seakkal ni'raiponnai ornaanukkuk koduththu,

angkea karththarukku oru palipeedaththaik katti, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaana palika'laiyum seluththi, karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu avar vaanaththilirunthu sarvaangka thakanapalipeedaththinmeal i'rangkina akkiniyinaal avanukku ma'ruuththaravu koduththathumallaamal,
theavathoothan thannudaiya pattayaththai u'raiyilea thirumpap poadavea'ndum en'ru karththar avanukkuch sonnaar.
epoosiyanaakiya ornaanin ka'laththilea karththar thanakku uththaravu aru'linathaith thaaveethu akkaalaththilea ka'ndu angkeathaanea paliyittaan.
moasea vanaantharaththil u'ndaakkina karththarudaiya vaasasthalamum sarvaangka thakanapalipeedamum akkaalaththilea kipiyoanin meattil irunthathu.
thaaveethu karththarudaiya thoothanin pattayaththi'rkup payanthirunthapadiyaal, avan theavasannithiyil poay visaarikkakkoodaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu thaaveethu: theavanaakiya karththarudaiya aalayam irukkum sthalam ithuvea; israveal paliyidum sarvaangka thakanapalipeedam irukkum sthalamum ithuvea en'raan.

pinpu thaaveethu israveal theasaththilirukki'ra anniyajaathiyaaraik koodivarachseythu, theavanudaiya aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rkaana kalluka'lai vettip pa'nippaduththum kalthachcharai ea'rpaduththinaan.
thaaveethu vaasalka'lin kathavuka'lukku vea'ndiya aa'nika'lukkum keelka'lukkum mikuthiyaana irumpaiyum, ni'ruththu mudiyaatha earaa'lamaana ve'nkalaththaiyum,
e'n'ni'rantha keathurumarangka'laiyum sampaathiththaan; seethoaniyarum theeriyarum thaaveethukkuth thira'laana keathurumarangka'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

thaaveethu: en kumaaranaakiya saalomoan vaalipanum i'laignanumaayirukki'raan; karththarukkuk kattappadum aalayam sakala theasangka'lilum keerththiyum makimaiyum udaiyathaay vi'langkumpadi makaa periyathaayirukkavea'ndum; aakaiyaal atha'rkaaka vea'ndiyavaika'lai ippozhuthea seakarampa'n'navea'ndum en'ru solli, thaaveethu than mara'naththi'rku munnea thira'laaych savathariththuvaiththaan.
avan than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanai azhaiththu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rkaaka avanukkuk katta'laikoduththu,
saalomoanai noakki: en kumaaranea, naan en theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku oru aalayaththaik katta en iruthayaththil ninaiththirunthean.

aanaalum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki: nee thira'laana iraththaththaich sinthi, periya yuththangka'laip pa'n'ninaay; nee en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam; enakku munpaaka mikuthiyaana iraththaththaith tharaiyilea sinthappa'n'ninaay.

ithoa, unakkup pi'rakkappoaki'ra kumaaran amaithiyu'l'la purushanaayiruppaan; sut'rilumirukkum avan saththurukka'laiyellaam vilakki avanai amarnthirukkach seyvean; aakaiyaal avan pear saalomoan ennappadum; avan naadka'lil isravealinmeal samaathaanaththaiyum amarikkaiyaiyum aru'luvean.

avan en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattuvaan; avan enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaan, naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean; isravealai aa'lum avanudaiya raajaangkaththin singkaasanaththai en'ren'raikkum nilaippaduththuvean en'raar.
ippoathum en kumaaranea, nee paakkiyavaanaayirunthu, karththar unnaikku'riththuch sonnapadiyea un theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththaik kattumpadi, avar unnudaneakooda iruppaaraaka.
karththar unakku gnaanaththaiyum u'narvaiyum aru'lichseythu, un theavanaakiya karththarin niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'ndu, isravealai aa'lumpadi unakkuk katta'laiyiduvaaraaka.

karththar isravealukkaaka moaseakkuk ka'rpiththa niyamangka'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum seyya nee kavanamaayirunthaal paakkiyavaanaayiruppaay; nee palangko'ndu thairiyamaayiru, payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum iru.

ithoa, naan en si'rumaiyilea karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkaaka oru ladcham thaalanthu ponnaiyum, paththuladcham thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, ni'ruththu mudiyaatha thira'laana ve'nkalaththaiyum irumpaiyum savathariththum, marangka'laiyum ka'rka'laiyum savathariththum vaiththean; nee innum avaika'lukku athikamaaych savatharippaay.
vealaiseyyaththakka thira'laana si'rpaasaarika'lum, thachcharum kalthachcharum, entha vealaiyilum nipu'naraanavarka'lum unnoadirukki'raarka'l.
ponnukkum, ve'l'likkum, ve'nkalaththukkum, irumpukkum ka'nakkillai; nee ezhumpik kaariyaththai nadappi; karththar unnoadea iruppaaraaka en'raan.
than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanukku uthaviseyya, thaaveethu isravealin pirapukka'l anaivarukkum ka'rpiththuch sonnathu:

ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'loadirunthu naanku thisaiyilum ungka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthalaith thanthaar allavaa? theasaththin kudika'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; karththarukku munpaakavum, avarudaiya janaththi'rku munpaakavum theasam keezhppattirukki'rathu.

ippoathum neengka'l ungka'l iruthayaththaiyum, ungka'l aaththumaththaiyum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraith theaduki'ratha'rku nearaakki, karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaiyum, theavanudaiya parisuththap pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, karththarudaiya naamaththi'rkuk kattappadum antha aalayaththi'rku'l ko'ndupoakumpadikku, neengka'l ezhumpi, theavanaakiya karththarin parisuththa sthalaththaik kattungka'l en'raan.
thaaveethu kizhavanum poora'na vayathu'l'lavanumaanapoathu, than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanai isravealinmeal raajaavaakkinaan.
isravealin ellaap pirapukka'laiyum, aasaariyaraiyum, leaviyaraiyum koodivarumpadi seythaan.
appozhuthu muppathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta leaviyar pearpearaaka e'n'nappattaarka'l; thalaithalaiyaaka e'n'nappatta avarka'ludaiya ilakkam muppaththe'n'naayiram.
avarka'lil irupaththunaalaayirampear karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai visaarikki'ravarka'lum, aa'raayirampear thalaivarum ma'niyakkaararumaayirukkavea'ndum en'rum,

naalaayirampear vaasal kaakki'ravarka'laayirukkavea'ndum en'rum, thuthiseyki'ratha'rkuth thaan pa'n'nuviththa keethavaaththiyangka'laal naalaayirampear karththaraith thuthikki'ravarka'laayirukkavea'ndum en'rum thaaveethu solli,
avarka'lai leaviyin kumaararaakiya kersoan, koakaath, meraari enpavarka'ludaiya vakuppuka'linpadi vakuththaan.
kersoaniyaril, laathaanum, simeayum irunthaarka'l.
laathaanin kumaarar, yekiyeal, seaththaam, yoaveal ennum moon'rupear; ivarka'lil munthinavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
simeayin kumaarar, seloamith, aasiyeal, aaraan ennum moon'rupear; ivarka'l laathaan vamsap pithaakka'lil thalaimaiyaayirunthaarka'l.
yaakaath, seenaa, eyoosh, pereeyaa ennum naalupearum simeayin kumaararaayirunthaarka'l.

yaakaath thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; seenaa ira'ndaam kumaaranaayirunthaan; eyooshukkum pereeyaavukkum aneakam kumaarar iraathapadiyinaal, avarka'l pithaakka'lin kudumpaththaaril orea vamsamaaka e'n'nappattaarka'l.
koakaaththin kumaarar, amraam, ithsaar, eproan, oosiyeal ennum naalupear.

amraamin kumaarar, aaroan, moasea enpavarka'l; aaroanum avan kumaararum parisuththaththi'rkup parisuththamaana sthalaththai en'raikkum parisuththamaayk kaakki'ratha'rkum, en'raikkum karththarukku munpaakath thoopangkaattuki'ratha'rkum, avarukku aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rkum, avar naamaththilea aaseervaatham kodukki'ratha'rkum piriththuvaikkappattaarka'l.
theavanudaiya manushanaakiya moaseayin kumaararoavenil, leavikoaththiraththaarukku'l e'n'nappattaarka'l.
moaseayin kumaarar, kersoam, eliyeasar enpavarka'l.
kersoamin kumaararil sepuveal thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
eliyeasarudaiya kumaararil rekapiyaa ennum avan kumaaran thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; eliyeasarukku vea'rea kumaarar illai; rekapiyaavin kumaarar aneakaraayirunthaarka'l.
ithsaarin kumaararil seloamith thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
eproanin kumaararil eriyaa enpavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; ira'ndaavathu amariyaa, moon'raavathu yaakaasiyeal, naalaavathu ekkaamiyaam.
oosiyealin kumaararil meekaa enpavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; ira'ndaavathu ishiyaa.
meraariyin kumaarar, makeali, moosi enpavarka'l; makealiyin kumaarar, eleyaasaar, kees enpavarka'l.
eleyaasaar marikki'rapoathu, avanukkuk kumaaraththika'lea allaamal kumaarar illai; keesin kumaararaakiya ivarka'ludaiya sakoatharar ivarka'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
moosiyin kumaarar, makali, eathear, ereamoath ennum moon'rupear.

thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpangka'linpadiyea, pithaakka'lil thalaimaiyaayiruntha leavi puththirarin peardaappinpadiyea, thalaithalaiyaaka e'n'nappatta irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta ivarka'ludaiya santhathiyaar karththarudaiya aalayaththup pa'nividaiyaich seythaarka'l.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththar thamathu janaththai i'laippaa'riyirukkappa'n'ninaar; avar en'ren'raikkum erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuvaaren'rum,
ini leaviyar vaasasthalaththaiyaakilum athin oozhiyaththi'rkaduththa athin pa'nimuttuka'lil ethaiyaakilum sumakkaththeavaiyillai en'rum,
thaaveethu avarka'laik ku'riththuchsonna kadaisi vaarththaika'linpadiyea, leavi puththiraril thokaikkudpattavarka'l irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpattavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.

avarka'l aaroanudaiya kumaararinkeezhk karththarudaiya aalayaththin oozhiyamaay nin'ru, piraakaarangka'laiyum, a'raika'laiyum, sakala parisuththa pa'nimuttuka'lin suththikarippaiyum, theavanudaiya aalayaththin aaraathanaikkaduththa vealaiyaiyum visaarippathum,

samukaththappangka'laiyum, poajanapalikku melliya maavaiyum, pu'lippillaatha athirasangka'laiyum, sattika'lilea seyki'rathaiyum suduki'rathaiyum, thittamaana sakala ni'raiyaiyum a'lavaiyum visaarippathum,

naa'lthoa'rum kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum karththaraip poat'rith thuthiththu, oayvunaadka'lilum, amaavaasaika'lilum, pa'ndikaika'lilum, karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'l seluththappaduki'ra sakala vea'laika'lilum,
ilakkaththi'rku'l'laana avarka'l thangka'lukku niyamikkappattapadiyea, eppozhuthum anthap pirakaaramaaych seyya, karththarukku munpaaka ni'rpathum,

aasarippuk koodaaraththin kaavalaiyum parisuththa sthalaththin kaavalaiyum thangka'l sakoathararaakiya aaroanudaiya kumaararin kaavalaiyum kaappathum, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nividaiyaich seyvathum, avarka'l vealaiyaayirunthathu.
aaroan puththirarin vakuppuka'laavana: aaroanin kumaarar, naathaap, apiyoo, eleyaasaar, iththaamaar enpavarka'l.
naathaapum apiyoovum kumaarar illaamal thangka'l thakappanukku munnea mariththapadiyinaal, eleyaasaarum iththaamaarum aasaariya oozhiyam seythaarka'l.
thaaveethu saathoakkaikko'ndu eleyaasaarin puththiraraiyum, akimeleakkaikko'ndu iththaamaarin puththiraraiyum avarka'l seyyavea'ndiya oozhiyaththukku mu'raippadi avarka'lai vakuththaan.

avarka'lai vakukki'rapoathu, iththaamaarin puththiraraippaarkkilum eleyaasaarin puththirarukku'l'lea thalaimaiyaanavarka'l athikamaanapear kaa'nappattapadiyinaal, eleyaasaarin puththiraril pathinaa'rupear thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpaththukkum, iththaamaarin puththiraril ettuppear thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpaththukkum thalaimaiyaaka vaikkappattaarka'l.

eleyaasaarin puththirarilum iththaamaarin puththirarilum, parisuththa sthalaththukkum, theavanukku aduththa kaariyangka'lil pirapukka'laayirukkumpadikkum, ivarka'lukkum avarka'lukkum viththiyaasampa'n'naamal seettuppoattu avarka'lai vakuththaarka'l.

leaviyaril sampirathiyaakiya semaayaa ennum nethaneyealin kumaaran, raajaavukkum pirapukka'lukkum aasaariyanaakiya saathoakkukkum apiyaththaarin kumaaranaakiya akimeleakkukkum aasaariyarum leaviyarumaana pithaakka'lin thalaivarukkum munpaaka avarka'l naamangka'lai ezhuthinaan; oru pithaavin veettuch seettu eleyaasaarukku vizhunthathu; pinpu anthappadiyea iththaamaarukkum vizhunthathu.
muthalaavathu seettu yoayaareepin pearvazhikkum, ira'ndaavathu yethaayaavin pearvazhikkum,
moon'raavathu aarimin pearvazhikkum, naankaavathu seyoareemin pearvazhikkum,
ainthaavathu malkiyaavin pearvazhikkum, aa'raavathu miyaameenin pearvazhikkum,
eazhaavathu akkoathsin pearvazhikkum, ettaavathu apiyaavin pearvazhikkum,
onpathaavathu yesuvaavin pearvazhikkum, paththaavathu sekkaniyaavin pearvazhikkum,
pathinoaraavathu eliyaaseepin pearvazhikkum, pannira'ndaavathu yaakkeemin pearvazhikkum,
pathinmoon'raavathu uppaavin pearvazhikkum, pathinaankaavathu esepeyaapin pearvazhikkum,
pathinainthaavathu pilkaavin pearvazhikkum, pathinaa'raavathu immearin pearvazhikkum,
pathineazhaavathu easeerin pearvazhikkum, pathinettaavathu apseasin pearvazhikkum,
paththonpathaavathu peththakiyaavin pearvazhikkum, irupathaavathu ekesekkiyealin pearvazhikkum,
irupaththoaraavathu yaakinin pearvazhikkum, irupaththira'ndaavathu kaamuvealin pearvazhikkum,
irupaththumoon'raavathu thelaayaavin pearvazhikkum, irupaththunaankaavathu maasiyaavin pearvazhikkum vizhunthathu.

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar avarka'l thakappanaakiya aaroanukkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, avarka'l avanudaiya katta'laiyinpirakaaram, thangka'l mu'raivarisaika'lil karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasikkum avarka'ludaiya oozhiyaththi'rkaakap pa'n'nappatta vakuppuka'l ivaika'lea.
leaviyin mat'rap puththirarukku'l'lea irukki'ra amraamin puththiraril soopavealum, soopavealin kumaararil ekeathiyaavum,
rekapiyaavin kumaararil mooththavanaakiya ishiyaavum,
ithsaariyaril selemoaththum, selemoaththin kumaararil yaakaaththum,
eproanin kumaararil mooththavanaakiya eriyaavum, ira'ndaam kumaaranaakiya amriyaavum, moon'raam kumaaranaakiya yaakaasiyealum, naankaam kumaaranaakiya ekkaamiyaamum,
oosiyealin kumaararil meekaavum, meekaavin kumaararil saameerum,
meekaavin sakoatharanaakiya ishiyaavum, ishiyaavin kumaararil sakariyaavum,
meraariyin kumaararaakiya makeali, moosi enpavarka'lum, yaasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya peanoavum,
meraariyin kumaaranaakiya yaasiyaavin kumaararaana peanoa, soakaam, sakkoor, ipri enpavarka'lum,
makealiyin kumaararil puththiranillaatha eleyaasaarum,
keesin puththiraril yeraamiyealum,
moosiyin kumaararaana makeali, eathear, erimoath enpavarka'lumaakiya ivarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpangka'linpadiyea leaviyarin puththiraraanavarka'l.

ivarka'lum raajaavaakiya thaaveethukkum saathoakkukkum akimeleakkukkum aasaariyarilum leaviyarilum pithaakka'laayirukki'ra thalaivarukkum munpaaka, thangka'l sakoathararaakiya aaroanin puththirar seythathupoala, thangka'lilirukki'ra pithaakka'laana thalaivarukkum, avarka'ludaiya si'riya sakoathararukkum, sarisamaanamaaych seettup poattukko'ndaarka'l.

mealum surama'ndalangka'laalum thampuruka'laalum kaiththaa'langka'laalum, theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra aasaap, eamaan, ethuththoon enpavarka'lin kumaararil silarai, thaaveethum theavaalayach seanaika'lin pirapukka'lum oozhiyaththi'rken'ru piriththuvaiththaarka'l; thangka'l oozhiyaththin kiriyaikkuk ku'riththuvaikkappatta manusharka'lin thokaiyaavathu:
raajaavudaiya katta'laippiramaa'namaayth theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra aasaappin vasaththilirukki'ra, aasaappin kumaararil sakkoor, yoaseappu, nethaaniyaa, ashaarealaa enpavarka'lum,

karththaraip poat'rith thuthiththuth theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra thangka'l thakappanaakiya ethuththoonin vasaththilea surama'ndalangka'lai vaasikka, ethuththoonin kumaararaakiya kethaliyaa, searee, eshaayaa, ashapiyaa, maththiththiyaa ennum aa'rupearum,

kompaith thonikkappa'n'na, theavavishayaththil raajaavukku gnaanathirushdiyu'l'la purushanaakiya eamaanin kumaararaana pukkiyaa, maththaniyaa, oosiyeal, sepuveal, erimoath, ananiyaa, anaani, eliyaaththaa, kithalthi, romanthiyeasar, yoaspekaashaa, maloaththi, oththir, makaasiyoath enpavarka'lumea.
ivarka'lellaarum eamaanin kumaararaayirunthaarka'l; theavan eamaanukkup pathinaalu kumaararaiyum moon'ru kumaaraththika'laiyum koduththaar.

ivarka'l anaivarum raajaavudaiya katta'laippiramaa'namaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththil thaa'langka'l thampuruka'l surama'ndalangka'laakiya keethavaaththiyam vaasikka, theavanudaiya aalayaththin oozhiyamaaka avaravar thangka'l thangka'l thakappanmaaraakiya aasaap, ethuththoon, eamaan enpavarka'l vasaththil irunthaarka'l.
karththaraip paadum paattuka'laik kat'rukko'ndu, nipu'naraana thangka'l sakoathararoadungkooda avarka'l ilakkaththi'rku irunoot're'npaththettuppearaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'lil si'riyavanum periyavanum, aasaanum maa'naakkanum, sarisamaanamaay mu'raivarisaikkaakach seettuppoattukko'ndaarka'l.
muthalaavathu seettu aasaap vamsamaana yoaseappin pearvazhikkum, ira'ndaavathu kethaliyaa, avan sakoatharar, avan kumaararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
moon'raavathu sakkoor, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
naankaavathu isri, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
ainthaavathu neththaniyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
aa'raavathu pukkiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
eazhaavathu esarealaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
ettaavathu eshaayaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
onpathaavathu maththaneeyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
paththaavathu simeayaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinoaraavathu asaariyeal, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pannira'ndaavathu ashaapiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinmoon'raavathu supaveal, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinaankaavathu maththiththiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinainthaavathu ereamoath, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinaa'raavathu ananiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathineazhaavathu yoaspeakkaashaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinettaavathu aanaani, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
paththonpathaavathu maloaththi, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irupathaavathu eliyaaththaa, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irupaththoaraavathu oththir, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irupaththira'ndaavathu kithalthi, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irupaththumoon'raavathu makaasiyoath, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irupaththunaankaavathu romanthiyeasar, avan kumaarar, avan sakoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum vizhunthathu.
vaasalkaakki'ravarka'lin vakuppuka'laavana: koaraakiyar santhathiyaana aasaapin puththirarilea koareayin kumaaran mesheleamiyaa enpavan,
mesheleamiyaavin kumaarar, mooththavanaakiya sakariyaavum,
ethiyaayeal, sepathiyaa, yathaniyeal, ealaam, yoakanaan, eliyoanaay ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naankaam ainthaam aa'raam eazhaam kumaararum;
oapeatheathoamin kumaarar, mooththavanaakiya semaayaavum,
yoasapaath, yoavaak, saakkaar, nethaneyeal, ammiyeal, isakkaar, peyu'lthaayi ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naankaam ainthaam aa'raam eazhaam ettaam kumaararumea; theavan avanai aaseervathiththirunthaar.
avan kumaaranaakiya semaayaavukkum kumaarar pi'ranthu, avarka'l paraakkiramasaalika'laayirunthu, thangka'l thakappan kudumpaththaarai aa'ndaarka'l.
semaayaavukku iruntha kumaarar othniyum, palasaalika'laakiya reppaayeal, oapeath, elsaapaath ennum avan sakoathararum, elikoovum semakiyaavumea.
oapeatheathoamin puththirarum avarka'l kumaararum avarka'l sakoathararumaakiya oozhiyaththi'rkup palaththa paraakkiramasaalika'laana avarka'lellaarum a'rupaththira'ndupear.
mesheleamiyaavin kumaararum sakoathararumaana paraakkiramasaalika'l pathinettuppear.
meraariyin puththiraril oasaa enpavanudaiya kumaararka'l: simri ennum thalaimaiyaanavan; ivan mooththavanaayiraavittaalum ivan thakappan ivanaith thalaivanaaka vaiththaan.
ilkkiyaa, thepaliyaa, sakariyaa ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naankaam kumaararaanavarka'l; oasaavin kumaararum sakoathararum ellaam pathinmoon'rupear.
kaavalkaararaana thalaivarinkeezhth thangka'l sakoathararukkoththa mu'raiyaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththil vaasalkaakki'ravarka'laaych seavikka ivarka'l vakukkappattu,
thangka'l pithaakka'lin kudumpaththaaraakiya si'riyavarka'lum periyavarka'lumaay inna vaasalukku innaaren'ru seettuppoattukko'ndaarka'l.

keezhppu'raththi'rkuch seleamiyaavukkuch seettu vizhunthathu; viveakamu'l'la yoasanaikkaaranaakiya sakariyaa ennum avan kumaaranukkuch seettup poattapoathu, avan seettu vadapu'raththi'rken'ru vizhunthathu.
oapeatheathoamukkuth thenpu'raththi'rkum, avan kumaararukku asuppeem veetti'rkum,
sooppeemukkum, oasaavukkum ma'npoattu uyarththappatta vazhiyum kaavalukku ethirkaavalum irukki'ra mea'rpu'ramaana vaasalukkum seettu vizhunthathu.
kizhakkea leaviyaraana aa'rupearum, vadakkea pakalilea naalupearum, the'rkea pakalilea naalupearum, asuppeem veetta'ndaiyil ira'ndira'ndupearum,
ve'lippu'ramaana vaasal a'ndaiyil mea'rkea irukki'ra uyarntha vazhikku naalupearum, ve'lippu'ramaana vazhiyil ira'ndupearum vaikkappattaarka'l.
koaraakin puththirarukku'l'lum, meraariyin puththirarukku'l'lum, vaasalkaakki'ravarka'lin vakuppuka'l ivaika'lea.
mat'ra leaviyaril akiyaa enpavan theavanudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangka'laiyum, pirathishdaiyaakkappatta poru'lka'lin pokkishangka'laiyum visaarikki'ravanaayirunthaan.
laathaanin kumaarar yaaren'raal, kersoaniyanaana avanudaiya kumaararil thalaimaiyaana pithaakka'laayiruntha yekiyealiyum,
yekiyealiyin kumaararaakiya seaththaamum, avan sakoatharanaakiya yoavealumea; ivarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangka'lai visaarikki'ravarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
amraameeyarilum, ithsaakaariyarilum, eproaniyarilum, oosiyeariyarilum silar appadiyea visaarikki'ravarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
moaseayin kumaaranaakiya kersoamin santhathiyaana sepuveal pokkishap pirathaaniyaayirunthaan.
eliyeasar moolamaay avanukku iruntha sakoathararaanavarka'l, ivan kumaaran rekapiyaavum, ivan kumaaran eshaayaavum, ivan kumaaran yoaraamum, ivan kumaaran sikkiriyum, ivan kumaaran seloamiththumea.
raajaavaakiya thaaveethum, aayirampearukku athipathika'lum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'lumaana pithaakka'lin thalaivarum, seanaapathika'lum yuththaththil akappatta ko'l'laika'lil eduththu,
karththarudaiya aalayaththaip paripaalikkumpadikkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'nda poru'lka'lin pokkishangka'laiyellaam anthach seloamiththum avanudaiya sakoathararum visaariththaarka'l.

gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya saamuvealum, keesin kumaaranaakiya savulum, nearin kumaaranaakiya apnearum, seruyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaapum, avaravar parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'nda anaiththum seloamiththin kaiyinkeezhum avan sakoatharar kaiyinkeezhum irunthathu.
ithsaakaariyaril kenaaniyaavum avan kumaararum theasakaariyangka'laip paarkkumpadi vaikkappattu, isravealinmeal visaarippukkaararum ma'niyakkaararumaayirunthaarka'l.

eproaniyaril asapiyaavum avan sakoathararumaakiya aayiraththu ezhunoo'ru paraakkiramasaalika'l yoarthaanukku ippaalea mea'rkea irukki'ra isravealinmeal karththarudaiya ellaa oozhiyaththi'rkum raajaavin vealaikkum vaikkappattaarka'l.

eproaniyaril eriyaavum irunthaan; avan than pithaakka'lin vamsangka'laana eproaniyaril thalaimaiyaanavan; thaaveethu arasaa'nda naa'rpathaam varushaththilea avarka'l theadappattapoathu avarka'lukku'l'lea keeleayaaththeasaththu easearilea paraakkirama veerar kaa'nappattaarka'l.

palasaalika'laakiya avanudaiya sakoatharar ira'ndaayiraththu ezhunoo'ru pirathaana thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l; avarka'laith thaaveethuraajaa theavanukkaduththa sakala kaariyaththi'rkaakavum, raajaavin kaariyaththi'rkaakavum, roopaniyarmealum, kaathiyarmealum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththinmealum vaiththaan.

thangka'l ilakkaththinpadi irukki'ra israveal puththirarukku vamsangka'lin thalaivarum, aayiraththukkuch searvaikkaararum, noot'ri'rkuch searvaikkaararum, ivarka'ludaiya thalaivarum vaikkappattirunthaarka'l; ivarka'l varushaththilu'ndaana maathangka'lilellaam maathaththi'rku maatham raajaavaich seavikki'ratha'rku vakukkappatta varisaika'linpadiyellaam maa'rimaa'ri varuvaarka'l; ovvoru vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
muthalaavathu maathaththukku muthal vakuppinmeal sapthiyealin kumaaran yashopeyaam irunthaan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
avan peareasin santhathiyaaril sakala seanaapathika'lin thalaivanaayirunthu muthal maatham visaariththaan.
ira'ndaavathu maathaththin vakuppinmeal akoakiyanaana thoathaayi irunthaan; avan vakuppilea mikloath tha'lakarththanaayirunthaan; avan vakuppilea irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
moon'raavathu maathaththin moon'raam seanaapathi yoaythaavin kumaaranaakiya penaayaa ennum thalaimaiyaana pirathaani; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
inthap penaayaa antha muppathu paraakkiramasaalika'lil oruvanum antha muppathu pearka'lin thalaivanumaayirunthaan; avanudaiya vakuppai avan kumaaranaakiya amisapaath visaariththaan.
naalaavathu maathaththin naalaam seanaapathi yoavaapin sakoatharanaakiya aasakealum, avanukkuppinpu avan kumaaran septhiyaavumea; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
ainthaavathu maathaththin ainthaam seanaapathi israakiyanaana samkooth enpavan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
aa'raavathu maathaththin aa'raam seanaapathi ikkeasin kumaaran eeraa ennum thekkoaviyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
eazhaavathu maathaththin eazhaam seanaapathi eppiraayeem puththiraril oruvanaakiya ealeas ennum peloaniyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
ettaavathu maathaththin ettaam seanaapathi saariyaril oruvanaakiya sipekkaayi ennum ooshaaththiyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
onpathaavathu maathaththin onpathaam seanaapathi penyameenaril apiyeasar ennum aanathoaththaan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
paththaavathu maathaththin paththaam seanaapathi saariyaril oruvanaakiya makraayi ennum neththoapaaththiyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
pathinoaraavathu maathaththin pathinoaraam seanaapathi eppiraayeem puththiraril penaayaa ennum piraththoaniyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
pannira'ndaavathu maathaththin pannira'ndaam seanaapathi othniyeal santhathiyaana elthaayi ennum neththoapaaththiyan; avan vakuppil irupaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
israveal koaththirangka'lukkuth thalaivarka'l: roopaniyarukkuth thalaivan sikriyin kumaaran eliyeasar; simiyoaniyarukku maakkaavin kumaaran seppaththiyaa.
leaviyarukkuk keamuvealin kumaaran ashaapiyaa; aaroan santhathikkuch saathoak.
yoothaavukkuth thaaveethin sakoathararil oruvanaakiya elikoo; isakkaarukku mikaavealin kumaaran omri.
sepuloanukku opthiyaavin kumaaran ismaayaa; napthalikku asriyealin kumaaran erimoath.
eppiraayeem puththirarukku asasiyaavin kumaaran oaseyaa; manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththi'rkup pethaayaavin kumaaran yoaveal.
keeleayaaththilu'l'la manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththi'rkuch sakariyaavin kumaaran iththoa; penyameenukku apnearin kumaaran yaasiyeal.
thaa'nukku eroakaamin kumaaran asaariyeal; ivarka'l israveal koaththirangka'lukkuth thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l.

isravealai vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'l aththanaiyaayp perukappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solliyirunthapadiyaal, thaaveethu irupathu vayathumuthal atha'rkuk keezhppattavarka'lin ilakkaththaith thokaiyeat'ravillai.

seruyaavin kumaaran yoavaap e'n'naththuvakkiyum mudikkaathea poanaan; atha'rkaaka isravealinmeal kadungkoapam vanthathu; aathalaal anthaththokai thaaveethuraajaavin naa'laakamakka'nakkilea ea'ravillai.

raajaavudaiya pokkishangka'linmeal aathiyealin kumaaran asmaaveaththum, patta'nangka'lilum kiraamangka'lilum thurukkangka'lilumu'l'la nilaththin varumaana pa'ndakasaalaika'linmeal usiyaavin kumaaran yoanaththaanum,
nilaththaip payirida vayalve'liyin vealaiseyki'ravarka'linmeal kealooppin kumaaran esriyum,
thiraadchaththoattangka'linmeal raamaaththiyanaana seemeayum, thiraadchaththoattangka'lin varaththaakiya thiraadcharasam vaikkum idangka'linmeal sipmiyanaakiya sapthiyum,
pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilu'l'la olivamarangka'linmealum musukkattai virudchangka'linmealum ketheariyanaana paalkaanaanum, e'n'ney kidangkuka'linmeal yoavaasum,
saaroanil meayki'ra maaduka'linmeal saaroaniyanaana sithraayum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilu'l'la maaduka'linmeal athlaayin kumaaran saappaaththum,
ottakangka'linmeal ismavealiyanaakiya oapilum, kazhuthaika'linmeal meroanoaththiyanaakiya ekethiyaavum,
aaduka'linmeal aakaariyanaana yaasisum visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l; ivarka'lellaarum thaaveethuraajaavin poru'lka'lukku visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l.
