thaaveethin si'riya thakappanaakiya yoanaththaan ennum puththiyum padippumu'l'la manushan aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthaan; akmoaniyin kumaaran yekiyeal raajaavin kumaararoadirunthaan.
akiththoappeal raajaavukku aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthaan; arkiyanaana ooshaayi raajaavin thoazhanaayirunthaan.
penaayaavin kumaaran yoaythaavum apiyaththaarum akiththoappealukku uthaviyaayirunthaarka'l; yoavaap raajaavin padaiththalaivanaayirunthaan.

koaththirangka'lin thalaivarum, raajaavaich seavikki'ra vakuppuka'lin thalaivarum, aayirampearukku athipathika'lum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'lum, raajaavukkum raajakumaararukkum u'ndaana ellaa aasthiyaiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum visaarikki'ra thalaivarumaakiya isravealin sakala pirapukka'laiyum, pirathaanika'laiyum, palasaalika'laiyum, sakala paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum thaaveethu erusaleamilea koodivarachseythaan.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya thaaveethu ezhunthirunthu kaaloon'ri nin'ru: en sakoathararea, en janamea, naan solvathaik kea'lungka'l; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyum namathu theavanudaiya paathapadiyum thangkuvatha'rku oru aalayaththaik katta naan en manathilea ninaiththu, kattuki'ratha'rku aayaththamum pa'n'ninean.
aanaalum theavan: nee en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam; nee yuththa manushanaayirunthu, raththaththaich sinthinaay en'raar.

ippoathum israveal anaiththinmealum en'raikkum raajaavaayirukka, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar en thakappanudaiya veettaarilellaam ennaith therinthuko'ndaar; avar yoothaavaiyum yoothaavin vamsaththil en thakappan kudumpaththaiyum thalaimaiyaakath therinthuko'ndu, ennai ellaa isravealinmealum raajaavaakka, en thakappanudaiya kumaararukku'l enmeal piriyam vaiththaar.

karththar enakku aneakam kumaararaith thantharu'linaar; aanaalum isravealai aa'lum karththarudaiya raajyapaaraththin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaaruki'ratha'rku, avar ennudaiya ellaak kumaararilum en kumaaranaakiya saalomoanaith therinthuko'ndu,
avar ennai noakki: un kumaaranaakiya saalomoanea en aalayaththaiyum en piraakaarangka'laiyum kattakkadavan; avanai enakkuk kumaaranaakath therinthuko'ndean; naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean.
innaa'lil nadakki'rapadiyea avan en ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum en niyaayangka'linpadiyum seyya u'ruthiyaayiruppaanaanaal, avan raajyapaaraththai en'ren'raikkum thidappaduththuvean en'raar.

ippoathum neengka'l en'ren'raikkum intha nalla theasaththaich suthantharamaay anupaviththu, ungka'lukkuppi'raku athai ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkuch suthantharamaayp pinvaikkumporuttaaka, neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu visaariyungka'l en'ru karththarin sapaiyaakiya israveal anaiththin ka'nka'lukkumunpaakavum, namathu theavanudaiya sevikeadkavum ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.

en kumaaranaakiya saalomoanea, nee un pithaavin theavanai a'rinthu, avarai uththama iruthayaththoadum u'rchaaka manathoadum seavi; karththar ellaa iruthayangka'laiyum aaraaynthu, ninaivuka'lin thoat'rangka'laiyellaam a'riki'raar; nee avaraith theadinaal unakkuth thenpaduvaar; nee avarai vittuvittaal avar unnai en'raikkum kaividuvaar.
ippoathum echcharikkaiyaayiru; parisuththa sthalamaaka oru aalayaththaikkattuvatha'rkuk karththar unnaith therinthuko'ndaar; nee thidanko'ndu athai nadappi en'ru sonnaan.

thaaveethu than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanukku ma'ndapamum, athin a'raika'lum, athin pokkishasaalaika'lum, athin mealveeduka'lum, athin u'l'la'raika'lum, kirupaasana sthaanamum irukkavea'ndiya maathiriyaiyum,

aaviyinaal thanakkuk katta'laiyidappattapadiyellaam avan seyyavea'ndiya karththarudaiya aalayappiraakaarangka'lum, theavanudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangka'laiyum, parisuththamaaka nearnthuko'l'lappattavaika'lin pokkishangka'laiyum vaikkum sakala sut'ra'raika'lum irukkavea'ndiya maathiriyaiyum,

aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum varisaika'laaka vakukki'ratha'rkum, karththarudaiya aalayappa'nividai vealai anaiththi'rkum, karththarudaiya aalayaththu vealaiyin pa'nimuttuka'l anaiththi'rkumuriya katta'laiyaiyum koduththaan.
avan pa'rpala vealaikku vea'ndiya sakala po'rpaaththirangka'lukkaaka ni'raiyinpadi ponnaiyum, pa'rpala vealaikku vea'ndiya sakala ve'l'lippaaththirangka'lukkaaka ni'raiyinpadi ve'l'liyaiyum,

pon vi'lakkuththa'nduka'lukkum avaika'lin pon vi'lakkuka'lukkum, ovvoru vi'lakkuththa'ndukkum athin vi'lakkuka'lukkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ponnaiyum, ve'l'li vi'lakkuththa'nduka'lil ovvoru vi'lakkuththa'ndukkum athin vi'lakkuka'lukkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ve'l'liyaiyum,
samukaththappangka'lai vaikkum ovvoru meajaikkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ponnaiyum, ve'l'li meajaika'lukku vea'ndiya ve'l'liyaiyum,

mu'lku'raduka'lukkum kalangka'lukkum thattuka'lukkum vea'ndiya pasumponnaiyum, pon ki'n'nika'lil ovvoru ki'n'nikkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiyathaiyum, ve'l'likki'n'nika'lil ovvoru ki'n'nikkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiyathaiyum,

thoopangkaattum peedaththi'rku ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya pudamidappatta ponnaiyum koduththu, settaika'lai viriththuk karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyai moodum pon kearupeenka'laana vaakanaththin maathiriyaiyum koduththu,
intha maathiriyinpadi sakala vealaika'lum enakkuth theriyappaduththa, ivaiyellaam karththarudaiya karaththinaal enakku ezhuthikkodukkappattathu en'raan.

thaaveethu than kumaaranaakiya saalomoanai noakki: nee palangko'ndu thairiyamaayirunthu, ithai nadappi; nee payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum iru; theavanaakiya karththar ennum en theavan unnoadea iruppaar; karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rkaduththa sakala kiriyaika'laiyum nee mudiththuth theerumattum, avar unnaivittu vilakavumaattaar, unnaik kaividavumaattaar.

ithoa, theavanudaiya aalayaththuvealaikkellaam aasaariyar leaviyarudaiya vakuppuka'l irukki'rathu; antha ellaak kiriyaikkum sakalavitha vealaiyilum nipu'naraana manappoorvamu'l'la sakala manusharum, un so'rpadiyellaam keadkum pirapukka'lum, sakala janangka'lum unnidaththil irukki'raarka'l en'raan.

pinpu thaaveethuraajaa sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum noakki: theavan therinthuko'nda en kumaaranaakiya saalomoan innum vaalipanum i'laignanumaayirukki'raan; seyyavea'ndiya vealaiyoa periyathu; athu oru manushanukku alla, theavanaakiya karththarukkuk kattum aramanai.

naan ennaalea iyan'ramattum en theavanudaiya aalayaththukken'ru ponvealaikkup ponnaiyum, ve'l'livealaikku ve'l'liyaiyum, ve'nkalavealaikku ve'nkalaththaiyum, irumpuvealaikku irumpaiyum, maravealaikku maraththaiyum, pathikkappadaththakka kaanthiyu'l'la ka'rka'laiyum, palavaru'nak ka'rka'laiyum, vilaiyea'rappet'ra sakalavitha raththinangka'laiyum, ve'nka'rpaa'langka'laiyum, koameathaka muthaliya ka'rka'laiyum earaa'lamaakach savathariththean.

innum en theavanudaiya aalayaththinmeal naan vaiththirukki'ra vaagnchaiyinaal, parisuththa aalayaththukkaaka naan savathariththa anaiththaiyum thavira, enakkuch sonthamaana ponnaiyum ve'l'liyaiyum en theavanudaiya aalayaththukken'ru kodukki'rean.

a'raika'lin suvarka'lai mooduvatha'rkaakavum, ponvealaikkup ponnum, ve'l'livealaikku ve'l'liyum u'ndaayirukki'ratha'rkaakavum, kammaa'lar seyyum vealai anaiththi'rkaakavum, oappeerin thangkamaakiya moovaayiram thaalanthu thangkaththaiyum, suththa ve'l'liyaakiya eazhaayiram thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum kodukki'rean.
ippoathum ungka'lil in'raiyathinam karththarukkuth than kaikkaa'nikkaika'laich seluththa manappoorvamaanavarka'l yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu vamsangka'lin pirapukka'lum, israveal koaththirangka'lin pirapukka'lum, aayirampearukku athipathika'lum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'lum, raajaavin vealaikkaararaakiya pirapukka'lum manappoorvamaay,

theavanudaiya aalayaththu vealaikku aiyaayiram thaalanthu ponnaiyum, pathinaayiram thangkakkaasaiyum, pathinaayiram thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, pathine'n'naayiram thaalanthu ve'nkalaththaiyum, ladcham thaalanthu irumpaiyum koduththaarka'l.
yaar kaiyil raththinangka'l irunthathoa, avarka'l avaika'laiyum karththarudaiya aalayaththup pokkishaththi'rken'ru kersoaniyanaana yekiyealin kaiyilea koduththaarka'l.

ippadi manappoorvamaayk koduththatha'rkaaka janangka'l santhoashappattaarka'l; uththama iruthayaththoadea u'rchaakamaayk karththarukkuk koduththaarka'l; thaaveethu raajaavum mikavum santhoashappattaan.

aakaiyaal thaaveethu sapai anaiththin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum karththarukku sthoaththiram seluththich sonnathu: engka'l thakappanaakiya isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, sathaakaalangka'lilum theavareerukku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka.

karththaavea, maadchimaiyum vallamaiyum makimaiyum jeyamum makaththuvamum ummudaiyavaika'l; vaanaththilum poomiyilum u'l'lavaika'lellaam ummudaiyavaika'l; karththaavea, raajyamum ummudaiyathu; theavareer ellaarukkum thalaivaraay uyarnthirukki'reer.

aisuvariyamum kanamum ummaalea varuki'rathu; theavareer ellaavat'raiyum aa'luki'ravar; ummudaiya karaththilea saththuvamum vallamaiyum u'ndu; evaraiyum meanmaippaduththavum palappaduththavum ummudaiya karaththinaal aakum.
ippoathum engka'l theavanea, naangka'l umakku sthoaththiram seluththi, umathu makimaiyu'l'la naamaththaith thuthikki'roam.
ippadi manappoorvamaayk kodukkum thiraa'ni u'ndaavatha'rku naan emmaaththiram? en janangka'l emmaaththiram? ellaam ummaal u'ndaanathu; umathu karaththilea vaangki umakkuk koduththoam.

umakku munpaaka naangka'l engka'ludaiya pithaakka'l ellaaraippoalum aratheasika'lum paratheasika'lumaayirukki'roam; poomiyinmeal engka'l naadka'l oru nizhalaippoala irukki'rathu; nilaiththiruppoam ennum nampikkaiyillai.

engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya parisuththa naamaththi'rken'ru umakku oru aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rku, naangka'l savathariththirukki'ra inthapporu'lka'l ellaam umathu karaththilirunthu vanthathu; ellaam ummudaiyathu.

en theavanea, neer iruthayaththaich soathiththu, uththama ku'naththil piriyamaayirukki'reer enpathai a'rivean; ivaiyellaam naan uththama iruthayaththoadea manappoorvamaayk koduththean; ippozhuthu ingkeayirukki'ra ummudaiya janamum umakku manappoorvamaayk kodukki'rathaik ka'ndu santhoashiththean.

aapirakaam eesaakku israveal ennum engka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, umathu janaththin iruthayaththil u'ndaana inthach sinthaiyaiyum ninaivaiyum en'raikkum kaaththu, avarka'l iruthayaththai umakku nearaakkiyaru'lum.

en kumaaranaakiya saalomoan ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum ummudaiya saadchika'laiyum ummudaiya katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'lumpadikkum, ivaika'l ellaavat'raiyum seythu, naan aayaththampa'n'nina intha aramanaiyaik kattumpadikkum, avanukku uththama iruthayaththaith thantharu'lum en'raan.

athinpinpu thaaveethu sapai anaiththaiyum noakki: ippoathu ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l en'raan; appozhuthu sapaiyaar ellaarum thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai sthoaththiriththu, thalaikuninthu karththaraiyum raajaavaiyum pa'ninthuko'ndu,

karththarukkup paliyittu, ma'runaa'lilea sarvaangka thakanapalika'laaka aayiram kaa'laika'laiyum, aayiram aattukkadaakka'laiyum, aayiram aattukkuttika'laiyum, avaika'lukkaduththa paanapalika'laiyum israveal anaiththi'rkaakavum karththarukkuch seluththinaarka'l.

avarka'l an'raiyathinam mikuntha santhoashaththoadea karththarukku munpaakap poajanapaanampa'n'ni, thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya saalomoanai ira'ndaamvisai raajaavaakki, karththarukku munpaaka avanai athipathiyaakavum, saathoakkai aasaariyanaakavum apisheakampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appadiyea saalomoan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin sthaanaththilea karththarudaiya singkaasanaththil raajaavaay veet'rirunthu paakkiyasaaliyaayirunthaan; isravealar ellaarum avanukkuk keezhppadinthirunthaarka'l.
sakala pirapukka'lum paraakkiramasaalika'lum thaaveethu raajaavinudaiya sakala kumaararungkooda raajaavaakiya saalomoanukku adangkiyirunthaarka'l.
isravealar ellaarum kaa'nak karththar saalomoanai mikavum periyavanaakki, avanukku munnea isravealil raajaavaana oruvanukkum illaathiruntha raajarika makaththuvaththai avanukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
ivvithamaay eesaayin kumaaranaakiya thaaveethu israveal anaiththukkum raajaavaayirunthaan.
avan isravealai arasaa'nda naadka'l naa'rpathuvarusham; eproanilea eazhu varushamum, erusaleamilea muppaththumoon'ru varushamum raajaavaayirunthaan.
avan theerkkaayusum aisuvariyamum makimaiyumu'l'lavanaay, nalla muthirvayathilea mara'namadainthapin, avan kumaaranaakiya saalomoan avan sthaanaththilea arasaa'ndaan.

thaaveethu raajaavinudaiya aathiyoadanthamaana nadapadika'lum, avan arasaa'nda viparamum, avanudaiya vallamaiyum, avanukkum isravealukkum, anthanthath theasangka'lin raajyangka'l anaiththukkum nadantha kaalasampavangka'lum,
gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya saamuvealin pirapanthaththilum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanin pirapanthaththilum, gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya kaaththin pirapanthaththilum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya saalomoan than raajyaththilea palappattaan; avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththar avanudanea irunthu avanai mikavum periyavanaakkinaar.

saalomoan aayirampearukku athipathika'lum, noo'rupearukku athipathika'lum, niyaayaathipathika'lum, israveal engkumirukki'ra vamsangka'lin thalaivaraakiya sakala pirapukka'lumaana israveal anaivaroadum peasi,
avanum avanoadeakoodach sapaiyaar anaivarum, kipiyoanilirukki'ra meadaikkup poanaarka'l.

thaaveethu theavanudaiya pettikku erusaleamilea koodaarampoattu aayaththampa'n'nina sthalaththi'rkuk keeriyaathyaareemilirunthu athaik ko'nduvanthaan; karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea vanaantharaththilea pa'n'nina theavanudaiya aasarippuk koodaaram angkea irunthathu.
oorin puththiranaakiya ooriyin kumaaran pesaleyeal u'ndupa'n'nina ve'nkalap palipeedamum angkea karththarin vaasasthalaththi'rku munpaaka irunthathu; saalomoanum sapaiyaarum athai naadippoanaarka'l.
angkea saalomoan aasarippuk koodaaraththi'rku munpaakak karththarin sannithiyilirukki'ra ve'nkalap palipeedaththinmeal aayiram sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththip paliyittaan.
an'ru raaththiriyilea theavan saalomoanukkuth tharisanamaaki: nee virumpuki'rathai ennidaththil kea'l en'raar.
saalomoan theavanai noakki: theavareer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkup periya kirupai seythu, ennai avan sthaanaththilea raajaavaakkineer.

ippoathum theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukku aru'lina umathu vaakkuththaththam u'ruthippaduvathaaka; theavareer poomiyin thoo'laththanai earaa'lamaana janaththinmeal ennai raajaavaakkineer.

ippoathum naan intha janaththi'rku munpaakap poakkum varaththumaayirukkaththakka gnaanaththaiyum a'rivaiyum enakkuth thantharu'lum; earaa'lamaayirukki'ra intha ummudaiya janaththai niyaayam visaarikkaththakkavan yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu theavan saalomoanai noakki: intha viruppam un iruthayaththil irunthapadiyaalum, nee aisuvariyaththaiyum sampaththaiyum kanaththaiyum, un pakaignarin piraa'nanaiyum, neediththa aayusaiyum kea'laamal, naan unnai arasaa'lappa'n'nina en janaththai niyaayam visaarikkaththakka gnaanaththaiyum viveakaththaiyum nee keattapadiyinaalum,

gnaanamum viveakamum thanthirukki'rathumallaamal, unakkumun iruntha raajaakka'lukkaakilum unakkuppin irukkum raajaakka'lukkaakilum illaatha aisuvariyaththaiyum sampaththaiyum kanaththaiyum unakkuth tharuvean en'raar.
ippadich saalomoan kipiyoanilirukki'ra meatti'rkup poay, aasarippuk koodaaraththin sannithiyilirunthu erusaleamukku vanthu, isravealai arasaa'ndaan.

saalomoan irathangka'laiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum searththaan; avanukku aayiraththu naanoo'ru irathangka'l irunthathu; panneeraayiram kuthiraiveerarum irunthaarka'l; avaika'lai irathangka'lin patta'nangka'lilum, avarka'lai raajaavaakiya thannidaththil erusaleamilum vaiththirunthaan.
raajaa erusaleamilea ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum ka'rka'lpoalavum, keathurumarangka'laip pa'l'laththaakkil irukki'ra kaattaththimarangka'lpoalavum athikamaakkinaan.
saalomoanukku iruntha kuthiraika'lum pudavaika'lum ekipthilirunthu ko'nduvarappattathu; raajaavin varththakar pudavaika'lai oppantha vilaikkirayaththukku vaangkinaarka'l.

avarka'l ekipthilirunthu oru irathaththai a'runoo'ru ve'l'likkaasukkum, oru kuthiraiyai noot'raimpathu ve'l'likkaasukkum ko'nduvaruvaarka'l; anthappadiyea eaththiyarin sakala raajaakka'lukkum, seeriyaavin raajaakka'lukkum avarka'l moolamaayk ko'nduvarappattathu.
saalomoan karththarudaiya naamaththi'rku oru aalayaththaiyum, than raajarikaththi'rku oru aramanaiyaiyum katta nir'nayampa'n'ni,
sumaisumakki'ratha'rku ezhupathinaayirampearaiyum, malaiyil maram vettuki'ratha'rku e'npathinaayirampearaiyum, ivarka'lmeal thalaivaraaka moovaayiraththu a'runoo'rupearaiyum e'n'ni ea'rpaduththinaan.

theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraamidaththil aa'l anuppi: en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu thaam vaasamaayirukkum aramanaiyaith thamakkuk kattumpadikku, neer avarukkuth thayavuseythu, avarukkuk keathurumarangka'lai anuppinathupoala enakkum thayavuseyyum.

ithoa, en theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaakach sukanthavarkkangka'lin thoopam kaattuki'ratha'rkum, samukaththappangka'lai eppoathum vaikki'ratha'rkum, kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum, oayvunaadka'lilum, maathappi'rappuka'lilum, engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin pa'ndikaika'lilum, israveal niththiyakaalamaakach seluththavea'ndiyapadi sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththuki'ratha'rkum, avarudaiya naamaththi'rku oru aalayaththaik katti athai avarukkup pirathishdaipa'n'numpadi naan eththaniththirukki'rean.
engka'l theavan ellaa theavarka'laippaarkkilum periyavar; aakaiyaal naan kattappoaki'ra aalayam periyathaayirukkum.

vaanangka'lum vaanaathivaanangka'lum avaraik ko'l'lakkoodaathirukka, avarukku oru aalayaththaik katta vallavan yaar? avar sannithiyil thoopangkaattuki'ratha'rkea ozhiya, vea'rea mukaantharamaay avarukku aalayamkattuki'ratha'rku naan emmaaththiram?

ippoathum en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ku'riththavarka'lum, ennidaththil yoothaavilum erusaleamilum irukki'ravarka'lumaakiya nipu'naroadu, ponnilum ve'l'liyilum ve'nkalaththilum irumpilum iraththaamparanoolilum sivappunoolilum i'laneelanoolilum vealaiseyya nipu'nanum, koththuvealaiseyya a'rinthavanumaakiya oru manushanai ennidaththil anuppum.

leepanoanilirunthu keathurumarangka'laiyum, theavathaari virudchangka'laiyum, vaasanai marangka'laiyum enakku anuppum; leepanoanin marangka'lai vetta ummudaiya vealaikkaarar pazhakinavarka'len'ru a'rivean; enakku marangka'laith thira'laaka aayaththappaduththa en vealaikkaarar ummudaiya vealaikkaararoadungkooda iruppaarka'l.
naan kattappoaki'ra aalayam periyathum aachchariyappadaththakkathumaayirukkum.

antha marangka'lai vettuki'ra ummudaiya vealaikkaararukku irupathinaayiram marakkaal koathumai arisiyaiyum, irupathinaayiram marakkaal vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum, irupathinaayiram kudam thiraadcharasaththaiyum, irupathinaayiram kudam e'n'neyaiyum koduppean en'ru solli anuppinaan.
appozhuthu theeruvin raajaavaakiya eeraam saalomoanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: karththar thammudaiya janaththaich sineakiththathinaal, ummai avarka'lmeal raajaavaaka vaiththaar.

karththarukku oru aalayaththaiyum, thamathu raajarikaththi'rku oru aramanaiyaiyum kattaththakka yukthiyum puththiyumudaiya gnaanamu'l'la kumaaranai, thaaveethuraajaavukkuk katta'laiyittavaraakiya vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka.
ippoathum eeraam apiyennum puththimaanaakiya nipu'nanai anuppuki'rean.

avan thaa'nin kumaaraththika'lil oru sthireeyin kumaaran; avan thakappan theerutheasaththaan; avan ponnilum, ve'l'liyilum, ve'nkalaththilum, irumpilum, ka'rka'lilum, marangka'lilum, iraththaamparanoolilum i'laneelanoolilum melliyanoolilum sivappunoolilum vealaiseyyavum, sakalavithak koththuvealai seyyavum, ennenna seyyavea'ndumen'ru avanukkuch sollappadumoa, avaika'laiyellaam ummidaththilu'l'la nipu'naroadum, ummudaiya thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum en aa'ndavanin nipu'naroadungkooda yookiththuch seyyavum a'rinthavan.
en aa'ndavan thaam sonnapadi koathumaiyaiyum, vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum, e'n'neyaiyum, thiraadcharasaththaiyum thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararukku anuppuvaaraaka.

naangka'l umakkuth theavaiyaana marangka'laiyellaam leepanoanilea vetti, avaika'laith theppangka'laayk kattik kadalvazhiyaay yoappaamattum ko'nduvaruvoam; pi'rpaadu neer avaika'lai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoakalaam en'ru ezhuthi anuppinaan.

than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu israveal theasaththilu'ndaana ma'rujaathiyaaraiyellaam e'n'nith thokaiyittathupoala, saalomoanum avarka'lai e'n'ninaan; avarka'l ladchaththu aimpaththumoovaayiraththu a'runoo'rupearaayirunthaarka'l.

ivarka'lil avan ezhupathinaayirampearaich sumaisumakkavum, e'npathinaayirampearai malaiyil maramvettavum, moovaayiraththu a'runoo'rupearai janaththin vealaiyai visaarikkum thalaivaraayirukkavum vaiththaan.

pinpu saalomoan erusaleamilea than thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkuk kaa'npikkappatta moariyaa ennum malaiyil epoosiyanaakiya ornaanin ka'lam ennum thaaveethu ku'riththuvaiththa sthalaththilea karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattaththuvakkinaan.
avan thaan raajyapaarampa'n'nina naalaam varusham ira'ndaam maatham ira'ndaam theathiyilea kattaththodangkinaan.
theavanudaiya aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rku, saalomoan poatta asthipaaramaanathu, mu'rkaalaththu a'lavinpadiyea a'rupathumuzha nee'lamum, irupathumuzha akalamumaayirunthathu.
mukappu ma'ndapam aalayaththinudaiya akalaththinpadiyea irupathumuzha nee'lamum, noot'rirupathumuzha uyaramumaayirunthathu; athin udpu'raththaip pasumponthakattaal moodinaan.
aalayaththin periya maa'likaiyaith theavathaaru palakaika'linaal seythu pasumponninaal izhaiththu, athinmeal peareechchuvealaiyaiyum sangkilivealaiyaiyum siththiriththu,
antha maa'likaiyai raththinangka'laal alangkariththaan; ponnaanathu parvaayeemin ponnaayirunthathu.
antha maa'likaiyin uththirangka'laiyum, nilaika'laiyum, athin suvarka'laiyum, athin kathavuka'laiyum ponthakattaal moodi, koththuvealaiyaal suvarka'lilea kearupeenka'laich seyviththaan.

makaa parisuththamaana aalayaththaiyum kattinaan; athin nee'lam aalayaththinudaiya akalaththinpadi irupathumuzhamum, athin akalam irupathumuzhamumaayirunthathu; athai a'runoo'ru thaalanthu pasumponninaal izhaiththaan.
aa'nika'lin ni'rai aimpathu pon seakkalaanathu; meal a'raika'laiyum ponninaal izhaiththaan.
avan makaa parisuththamaana aalayaththilea ira'ndu kearupeenka'laiyum siththiravealaiyaay u'ndupa'n'ninaan; avaika'laip ponthakattaal moodinaan.

anthak kearupeenka'ludaiya settaika'lin nee'lam irupathu muzhamaanathu; on'rinudaiya oru settai ainthumuzhamaayirunthu, aalayaththuch suvaraith thottathu; ma'rusettai ainthumuzhamaayirunthu, mat'rak kearupeenin settaiyaith thottathu.
mat'rak kearupeenin oru settaiyum ainthumuzhamaayirunthu, aalayaththuchsuvaraith thottathu; athin ma'ru settaiyum ainthumuzhamaayirunthu, mat'rak kearupeenin settaiyaith thottathu.
ippadiyea anthak kearupeenka'lin settaika'l irupathumuzha virivaayirunthana; avaika'l thangka'l kaalka'laal oon'ri nin'rana; avaika'lin mukangka'l aalayaththu udpu'ramaay noakkiyirunthathu.
i'laneelanoolaalum iraththaamparanoolaalum sivappunoolaalum melliya noolaalum thiraiyaiyum, athilea kearupeenka'lin uruvangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaan.
aalayaththi'rku munnaaka muppaththainthumuzha uyaramaana ira'ndu thoo'nka'laiyum, avaika'ludaiya munaika'linmealirukkum ainthumuzha uyaramaana kumpangka'laiyum u'ndaakki,
sannithikku munnirukkach sangkilika'laiyum pa'n'ni, thoo'nka'lin munaika'linmeal pat'ravaiththu, noo'ru maatha'lampazhangka'laiyum pa'n'ni anthach sangkilika'lil koaththaan.

anthath thoo'nka'lai avan theavaalayaththi'rku munpaaka on'rai valathupu'raththilum on'rai idathupu'raththilum naatti, valathupu'ramaanatha'rku yaakeen en'rum, idathupu'ramaanatha'rkup poavaas en'rum pearittaan.
an'riyum irupathumuzha nee'lamum irupathumuzha akalamum paththumuzha uyaramumaana ve'nkalap palipeedaththaiyum pa'n'ninaan.

ve'nkalak kadalthottiyaiyum vaarppiththaan; sakkaraakaaramaana athinudaiya oru vi'limputhodangki ma'ruvi'limpumattum paththumuzha akalamum, ainthumuzha uyaramum, sut'ra'lavu muppathumuzha noola'lavumaayirunthathu.

athin keezhppu'ramaay rishapangka'lin uruvangka'l ovvoru muzhaththi'rkup paththu uruvamaaka anthak kadalthottiyin sakkaraththil irunthana; thottiyoadu on'raay vaarkkappatta antha rishapangka'lin ira'ndu varisaika'l irunthana.

athu pannira'ndu rishapangka'linmeal nin'rathu; ivaika'lil moon'ru vadakkeayum, moon'ru mea'rkeayum, moon'ru the'rkeayum, moon'ru kizhakkeayum noakkiyirunthana; kadalthotti avaika'linmeal uyara irunthathu; avaika'lin pinpakkamellaam udpu'ramaay irunthathu.
athin kanam naalu vira'rkadaiyum, athin vi'limpu paanapaaththiraththin vi'limpupoalum, leelipushpampoalum irunthathu; athu moovaayirangkudam tha'n'neer pidikkaththakkathaayirunthathu.

kazhuvuki'ratha'rkup paththuk kopparaika'laiyum u'ndaakki, ainthai valathupu'raththilum, ainthai idathupu'raththilum vaiththaan; sarvaangka thakanamaaki'ravaika'lai avaika'lil alaisuvaarka'l; kadalthottiyoa aasaariyarka'l thangka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'l'luki'ratha'rku irunthathu.
paththup pon vi'lakkuththa'nduka'laiyum, avaika'ludaiya piramaa'naththinpadi seyviththu, avaika'laith theavaalayaththil valathupu'raththilea ainthum idathupu'raththilea ainthumaaka vaiththaan.
paththu meajaika'laiyum seythu, avaika'laith theavaalayaththil valathupu'raththilea ainthum idathupu'raththilea ainthumaaka vaiththu, noo'ru pon kalangka'laiyum pa'n'ninaan.
mealum aasaariyarin piraakaaraththaiyum, periya piraakaaraththaiyum, piraakaaraththin vaasalka'laiyum u'ndaakki, avaika'lin kathavuka'lai ve'nkalaththaal moodinaan.
kadalthottiyaik keezhththisaiyaana valathupu'raththilea the'rkumukamaaka vaiththaan.

eeraam seppuchsattika'laiyum, saampaledukki'ra kara'ndika'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum seythaan; ivvithamaay eeraam karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkaaka raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkuch seyyavea'ndiya vealaiyaich seythumudiththaan.

avaika'l ennavenil, ira'ndu thoo'nka'lum, ira'ndu thoo'nka'ludaiya munaiyinmealirukki'ra kumpangka'lum, kumizhka'lum, thoo'nka'ludaiya munaiyin mealirukki'ra kumizhka'laana ira'ndu kumpangka'lai mooduki'ratha'rku ira'ndu valaippinnalka'lum,

thoo'nka'linmealu'l'la kumizhka'laana ira'ndu kumpangka'lai mooduki'ratha'rku, ovvoru valaippinnalin ira'ndu varisai maatha'lampazhangka'laaka, ira'ndu valaippinnalilumirukki'ra naanoo'ru maatha'lampazhangka'lumea.
aathaarangka'laiyum, aathaarangka'linmealirukkum kopparaika'laiyum,
oru kadalthottiyaiyum, athin keezhirukkum pannira'ndu rishapangka'laiyum,

seppuchsattika'laiyum, saampal kara'ndika'laiyum, mu'lthu'raduka'l muthalaana pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, eeraamapi raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkuk karththarin aalayaththi'rkaakach suththamaana ve'nkalaththaal pa'n'ninaan.
yoarthaanukkaduththa samanaana poomiyil sukkoaththi'rkum sareaththaavukkum naduvea ka'lima'n tharaiyilea raajaa avaika'lai vaarppiththaan.
inthap pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam saalomoan veku earaa'lamaay u'ndupa'n'ninaan; ve'nkalaththin ni'rai thokaikku adangkaathathaayirunthathu.
theavanudaiya aalayaththukku vea'ndiya sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum; po'rpeedaththaiyum, samukaththappangka'lai vaikkum meajaika'laiyum,
mu'raiyinpadiyea sannithikku munpaaka vi'lakkuk ko'luththuki'ratha'rkup pasumpon vi'lakkuththa'nduka'laiyum, avaika'lin vi'lakkuka'laiyum,
suththa thangkaththinaal seytha pookka'laiyum, vi'lakkuka'laiyum, kaththarika'laiyum,

pasumpon kaththika'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum, kalayangka'laiyum, thoopakalasangka'laiyum saalomoan pa'n'ninaan; makaa parisuththa sthalaththin udkathavuka'lum, aalayamaakiya veettin kathavuka'lum, aalayaththin vaasal kathavuka'lum ellaam ponnaayirunthathu.

karththarudaiya aalayaththukkaakach saalomoan seytha vealaiyellaam mudinthapoathu, saalomoan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu parisuththampa'n'numpadi nearnthavaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyum, sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, theavanudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'lil vaiththaan.

pinpu karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyaich seeyoan ennum thaaveethin nakaraththilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadi saalomoan isravealin moopparaiyum, koaththirap pirapukka'laakiya israveal puththirarin vamsath thalaivar ellaaraiyum erusaleamilea koodivarachseythaan.
appadiyea isravealar ellaarum eazhaam maathaththin pa'ndikaiyilea raajaavinidaththil koodivanthaarka'l.
isravealin mooppar ellaarum vanthapinpu leaviyar pettiyai eduththu,
pettiyaiyum, aasarippuk koodaaraththaiyum, koodaaraththilirukki'ra parisuththa pa'nimuttuka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avaika'laik ko'nduvanthavarka'l leaviyaraana aasaariyarea.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanum, avanoadea koodina israveal sapaiyaar anaivarum, pettikku munpaaka e'n'nikkaikkum thokaikkum adangkaatha earaa'lamaana aadumaaduka'laip paliyittaarka'l.

appadiyea aasaariyar karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyai, aalayaththin sannithiyaakiya makaa parisuththamaana sthalaththilea, kearupeenka'ludaiya settaika'lukkuk keezhaakak ko'nduvanthu vaiththaarka'l.
kearupeenka'l, pettiyirukkum sthaanaththinmeal, thangka'l ira'ndira'ndu settaika'lai viriththu uyara irunthu pettiyaiyum athin tha'nduka'laiyum moodikko'ndirunthana.

pettiyilirukki'ra tha'nduka'lin munaika'l sannithi sthalaththi'rku munnea kaa'nappadaththakkathaay anthath tha'nduka'lai izhuththaarka'l; pu'rampea avaika'l kaa'nappadavillai; athu innaa'lvaraikkum angkea irukki'rathu.

israveal puththirar ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattapin, karththar oareapilea avarka'loadu udanpadikkai pa'n'ninapoathu, moasea anthap pettiyilea vaiththa ira'ndu ka'rpalakaika'lea allaamal athilea vea'ron'rum irunthathillai.
vakuppuka'lin mu'raika'laip paaraamal, aasaariyar elloarum thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.

aasaap, eamaan, ethuththoonudaiya koottaththaarum, avarka'ludaiya kumaarar sakoathararudaiya koottaththaarumaakiya paadakaraana leaviyaranaivarum melliya pudavaika'laith thariththu, kaiththaa'langka'laiyum thampuruka'laiyum surama'ndalangka'laiyum pidiththup palipeedaththi'rkuk kizhakkea nin'raarka'l; avarka'loadum koodap poorikaika'lai oothuki'ra aasaariyarka'l noot'rirupathupear nin'raarka'l.

avarka'l orumikkap poorikaika'lai oothi, eakasaththamaayk karththaraith thuthiththu sthoaththiriththup paadinaarka'l; aasaariyar parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu pu'rappadukaiyilum, paadakar poorikaika'l thaa'langka'l keethavaaththiyangka'ludaiya saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ni, karththar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru avarai sthoaththirikkaiyilum, karththarudaiya veedaakiya theavaalayam meakaththinaal ni'raiyappattathu.
antha meakaththinimiththam aasaariyarka'l oozhiyagnseythu ni'rkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru; karththarudaiya makimai theavanudaiya aalayaththai nirappit'ru.
appozhuthu saalomoan: kaariru'lilea vaasampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sonnaar en'rum,
theavareer vaasampa'n'naththakka veedum, neer en'raikkum thangkaththakka nilaiyaana sthaanamumaakiya aalayaththai umakkuk kattinean en'rum solli,
raajaa mukam thirumpi, israveal sapaiyaar ellaaraiyum aaseervathiththaan; israveal sapaiyaar ellaarum nin'raarka'l.
avan sonnathu: isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram; avar en thakappanaakiya thaaveethukkuth thammudaiya vaakkinaal sonnathai, thammudaiya karaththinaal ni'raiveat'rinaar.

avar: naan en janaththai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lmutha'rko'ndu, en naamam vi'langkumpadi, oru aalayaththaik kattavea'ndumen'ru naan isravealudaiya ellaak koaththirangka'lilumu'l'la vea'rea yaathoru patta'naththaith therinthuko'l'laamalum, en janamaakiya isravealinmeal athipathiyaayirukkumpadi vea'rea oruvaraith therinthuko'l'laamalum,
en naamam vi'langkum sthaanamaaka erusaleamaiyum, en janamaakiya isravealinmeal athipathiyaayirukkath thaaveethaiyum therinthuko'ndean en'raar.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum enki'ra viruppam en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin manathil irunthathu.
aanaalum karththar en thakappanaakiya thaaveethai noakki: en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndum enki'ra viruppam un manathilea irunthathu nalla kaariyanthaan.
aakilum nee antha aalayaththaik kattamaattaay; un karppappi'rappaakiya un kumaaranea en naamaththi'rku antha aalayaththaik kattuvaan en'raar.

ippoathum karththar solliya thamathu vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rinaar; karththar sonnapadiyea, naan en thakappanaakiya thaaveethin sthaanaththil ezhumpi, isravealudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik katti,
karththar israveal puththirarudanea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyirukki'ra pettiyai athilea vaiththean en'ru solli,
karththarudaiya palipeedaththi'rku munnea israveal sapaiyaar ellaarukkum ethiraaka nin'ru than kaika'lai viriththaan.

saalomoan ainthu muzha nee'lamum, ainthu muzha akalamum, moon'ru muzha uyaramumaana oru ve'nkalap pirasangkapeedaththai u'ndaakki, athai naduppiraakaaraththilea vaiththirunthaan; athinmeal avan nin'ru, isravealin sapaiyaar ellaarukkum ethiraaka muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu, than kaika'lai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka viriththu:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, vaanaththilum poomiyilum umakku oppaana theavanillai; thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum umakku munpaaka nadakki'ra umathu adiyaarukku udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum kaaththuvaruki'reer.

theavareer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum umathu adiyaanukkuch seytha vaakkuththaththaththaik kaaththaru'lineer; ummudaiya vaakkinaal athaich sonneer; ummudaiya karaththinaal athai innaa'lil irukki'rapadi ni'raiveat'rineer.

isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareer en thakappanaakiya thaaveethu ennum umathu adiyaanai noakki: nee enakku munpaaka nadanthathupoala, un kumaararum en niyaayappiramaa'naththil nadakkumpadi thangka'l vazhiyaik kaappaarka'leayaanaal, isravealin singkaasanaththil veet'rirukkum purushan enakku munpaaka unakku illaama'rpoavathillai en'ru sonnathai ippozhuthu avanukku ni'raiveat'rum.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareer umathu adiyaanaakiya thaaveethukkuch sonna ummudaiya vaarththai mey en'ru vi'langkuvathaaka.
theavan meyyaaka manusharoadea poomiyilea vaasampa'n'nuvaaroa? ithoa, vaanangka'lum, vaanaathi vaanangka'lum ummaik ko'l'laathea; naan kattina intha aalayam emmaaththiram?

en theavanaakiya karththaavea, umathu adiyean umathu sannithiyil seyki'ra vi'n'nappaththaiyum man'raattaiyum keattu, umathu adiyeanudaiya vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum thiruvu'laththil ko'ndaru'lum.
umathu adiyean ivvidaththilea seyyum vi'n'nappaththaik keadka, en naamam vi'langkumen'ru neer sonna sthalamaakiya intha aalayaththinmeal ummudaiya ka'nka'l iravumpakalum thi'ranthiruppathaaka.

umathu adiyeanum, intha sthalaththilea vi'n'nappam seyyappoaki'ra umathu janamaakiya isravealum pa'n'num jepangka'laik keattaru'lum; paraloakamaakiya ummudaiya vaasasthalaththilea neer athaik keadpeeraaka, keattu mannippeeraaka.
oruvan than ayalaanukkuk kut'ram seythirukkaiyil, ivan avanai aa'naiyidach sollumpoathu, antha aa'nai intha aalayaththilea ummudaiya palipeedaththi'rku munpaaka vanthaal,

appozhuthu paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer keattu, thunmaarkkanudaiya nadakkaiyai avan thalaiyinmeal sumarappa'n'ni, avanukku neethiyaich sarikkattavum, neethimaanukku avanudaiya neethikkuththakkathaaych seythu avanai neethimaanaakkavunthakkathaay, umathu adiyaarai niyaayantheerppeeraaka.

ummudaiya janangka'laakiya isravealar umakku viroathamaakap paavagnseythathinimiththam saththuruvukku munpaaka mu'rinthupoay, ummidaththi'rkuth thirumpi, ummudaiya naamaththai a'rikkaipa'n'ni, intha aalayaththilea ummudaiya sannithiyil vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum seythaal,

paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer keattu, ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealin paavaththai manniththu, avarka'lukkum avarka'l pithaakka'lukkum neer koduththa theasaththukku avarka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuveeraaka.

avarka'l umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythathinaal, vaanam adaipattu mazhai peyyaathirukkumpoathu, avarka'l intha sthalaththi'rku nearaaka vi'n'nappagnseythu, ummudaiya naamaththai a'rikkaipa'n'ni, theavareer thangka'laik kileasappaduththukaiyil thangka'l paavangka'lai vittuth thirumpinaal,

paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer keattu, umathu adiyaarum umathu janamaakiya isravealum seytha paavaththai manniththu, avarka'l nadakkavea'ndiya nalvazhiyai avarka'lukkup poathiththu, theavareer umathu janaththi'rkuch suthantharamaakak koduththa ummudaiya theasaththil mazhaipeyyak katta'laiyiduveeraaka.

theasaththilea pagncham u'ndaaki'rapoathum, ko'l'lainoay u'ndaaki'rapoathum, va'radchi, saavi, vettukki'li, pachchaikki'li u'ndaaki'rapoathum, avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'l avarka'l vaasagnseyki'ra theasaththilea avarka'lai mut'rikkai poaduki'rapoathum, yaathoru vaathaiyaakilum yaathoru viyaathiyaakilum vanthirukki'rapoathum,

entha manushanaanaalum, isravealaakiya ummudaiya janaththil evanaanaalum, than than vaathaiyaiyum viyaakulaththaiyum u'narnthu, intha aalayaththi'rku nearaakath than kaika'lai viriththuch seyyum sakala vi'n'nappaththaiyum, sakala vea'nduthalaiyum,
ummudaiya vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer keattu manniththu,

theavareer engka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththil avarka'l uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam umakkup payappattu, ummudaiya vazhika'lil nadakkumpadikkuth theavareer oruvarea manupuththirarin iruthayaththai a'rinthavaraanathaal, neer avanavan iruthayaththai a'rinthirukki'rapadiyea, avanavanudaiya ellaa vazhika'lukkum thakkathaaych seythu palan a'lippeeraaka.

ummudaiya janamaakiya israveal jaathiyallaatha anniya jaathiyaar ummudaiya makaththuvamaana naamaththinimiththamum, ummudaiya palaththa karaththinimiththamum, oangkiya ummudaiya puyaththinimiththamum, thooratheasangka'lilirunthu vanthu, intha aalayaththukku nearaaka nin'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal,

umathu vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer athaik keattu, poomiyin janangka'lellaarum ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealaippoala, ummudaiya naamaththai a'rinthu umakkup payappattu, naan kattina intha aalayaththi'rku ummudaiya naamam tharikkappattathen'ru a'riyumpadikku, antha anniya jaathiyaan ummai noakki vea'ndikko'lvathinpadiyea theavareer seyveeraaka.

neer ummudaiya janangka'lai anuppum vazhiyilea avarka'l thangka'l saththurukka'loadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappadumpoathu, neer therinthuko'nda intha nakaraththukkum, ummudaiya naamaththi'rku naan kattina intha aalayaththi'rkum nearaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal,
paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavareer avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaiyum vea'nduthalaiyum keattu, avarka'l niyaayaththai visaarippeeraaka.

paavagnseyyaatha manushan illaiyea; aakaiyaal avarka'l umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, theavareer avarka'lmeal koapangko'ndu, avarka'l saththurukka'l kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkodukki'rathinaal, avarka'laich si'raipidikki'ravarka'l avarka'laith thooraththilaakilum sameepaththilaakilum irukki'ra thangka'l theasaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoayirukkaiyil,

avarka'l si'raipattuppoana theasaththilea thangka'lil u'narvadainthu, mananthirumpi: naangka'l paavagnseythu akkiramampa'n'ni, thunmaarkkamaay nadanthoam en'ru thangka'l si'raiyiruppaana theasaththilea ummai noakkik kegnchi,

thaangka'l si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoakappatta thangka'l si'raiyiruppaana theasaththilea, thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum thangka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum ummidaththil thirumpi, theavareer thangka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa thangka'l theasaththi'rkum, theavareer therinthuko'nda intha nakaraththi'rkum, ummudaiya naamaththi'rku naan kattina intha aalayaththi'rkum nearaaka ummai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal,

ummudaiya vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavareer avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaiyum jepangka'laiyum keattu, avarka'l niyaayaththai visaariththu, umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseytha ummudaiya janaththi'rku manniththaru'lum.
ippoathum en theavanea, intha sthalaththilea seyyappadum vi'n'nappaththi'rku ummudaiya ka'nka'l thi'ranthavaika'lum, ummudaiya sevika'l kavanikki'ravaika'lumaayiruppathaaka.

theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya thaapara sthalaththi'rkuth theavareer umathu vallamai vi'langkum pettiyudan ezhuntharu'lum; theavanaakiya karththaavea, umathu aasaariyar iradchippaith thariththu, ummudaiya parisuththavaanka'l nanmaiyilea makizhvaarka'laaka.
theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer apisheakampa'n'ninavanin mukaththaip pu'rakka'niyaamal, ummudaiya thaasanaakiya thaaveethukku vaakkuththaththampa'n'nina kirupaika'lai ninaiththaru'lum en'raan.
saalomoan jepampa'n'ni mudikki'rapoathu, akkini vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum mat'rap palika'laiyum padchiththathu; karththarudaiya makimaiyum aalayaththai nirappit'ru.
karththarudaiya makimai karththarudaiya aalayaththai nirappinathinaal, aasaariyarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkakkoodaathirunthathu.

akkini i'rangkuki'rathaiyum, karththarudaiya makimai aalayaththinmeal thangkiyirukki'rathaiyum, israveal puththirar ellaarum ka'ndapoathu, tha'lavarisaimattum tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'rak kuninthu pa'ninthu, karththar nallavar, avarudaiya kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru solli, avaraith thuthiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu raajaavum sakala janangka'lum karththarudaiya sannithiyil palika'laich seluththinaarka'l.

raajaavaakiya saalomoan irupaththeeraayiram maaduka'laiyum, ladchaththirupathinaayiram aaduka'laiyum paliyittaan; ivvithamaay raajaavum sakala janangka'lum theavanudaiya aalayaththaip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaarka'l.

aasaariyarka'l thangka'l pa'nividaika'laichseythu nin'raarka'l; thaaveethuraajaa leaviyaraikko'ndu, karththarudaiya kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru avaraith thuthiththup paadumpadiyaakach seyviththa karththarin keethavaaththiyangka'lai avarka'lum vaasiththuch seaviththu nin'raarka'l; aasaariyarka'l avarka'lukku ethiraaka nin'ru poorikaika'lai oothinaarka'l; isravealar ellaarum nin'ruko'ndirunthaarka'l.

saalomoan u'ndaakkina ve'nkalappalipeedam sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum poajanapalika'laiyum ni'naththaiyum ko'l'lamaattaathirunthapadiyinaal, karththarudaiya aalayaththukku munnirukki'ra piraakaaraththin nadumaiyaththaich saalomoan parisuththappaduththi, angkea sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'lin ni'naththaiyum seluththinaan.

akkaalaththilthaanea saalomoanum, aamaaththin ellaiyilirunthu ekipthin nathimattum vanthu, avanoadeakooda iruntha makaa periya koottamaakiya israveal anaiththum eazhunaa'la'lavum pa'ndikaiyai aasariththu,
ettaamnaa'lai viseashiththa aasarippu naa'laayk ko'ndaadinaarka'l; eazhunaa'l palipeedaththup pirathishdaiyaiyum, eazhunaa'l pa'ndikaiyaiyum aasariththaarka'l.

eazhaam maathaththin irupaththumoon'raam theathiyilea thangka'l thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poaka janangka'lukku vidaikoduththaan; karththar thaaveethukkum, saalomoanukkum, thamathu janamaakiya isravealukkum seytha nanmaikkaakach santhoashamum manamakizhchchiyumaayp poanaarka'l.

ivvithamaay saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum raaja aramanaiyaiyum kattith theerththaan; karththarudaiya aalayaththilum than aramanaiyilum saalomoan seyya manathaayirunthathellaam anukoolamaayit'ru.
karththar iravilea saalomoanukkuth tharisanamaaki: naan un vi'n'nappaththaik keattu, intha sthalaththai enakkup paliyidum aalayamaakath therinthuko'ndean.
naan mazhaiyillaathapadikku vaanaththai adaiththu, allathu theasaththai azhikka vettukki'lika'lukkuk katta'laiyittu, allathu en janaththi'rku'l ko'l'lainoayai anuppumpoathu,

en naamam tharikkappatta en janangka'l thangka'laith thaazhththi, jepampa'n'ni, en mukaththaith theadi, thangka'l pollaatha vazhika'laivittuth thirumpinaal, appozhuthu paraloakaththilirukki'ra naan keattu, avarka'l paavaththai manniththu, avarka'l theasaththukku ksheamaththaik koduppean.
intha sthalaththilea seyyappadum jepaththi'rku, en ka'nka'l thi'ranthavaika'lum, en sevika'l kavanikki'ravaika'lumaayirukkum.
en naamam intha aalayaththil en'ren'raikkum irukkumpadi, naan ithaith therinthuko'ndu parisuththappaduththinean; en ka'nka'lum en iruthayamum ennaa'lum ingkea irukkum.
un thakappanaakiya thaaveethu nadanthathupoala, nee enakku munpaaka nadanthu, naan unakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam seythu, en katta'laika'laiyum en niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'lvaayaanaal,

appozhuthu isravealai arasaa'lum purushan unakku illaama'rpoavathillai en'ru naan un thakappanaakiya thaaveethoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ninapadiyea, un raajyapaaraththin singkaasanaththai nilaikkappa'n'nuvean.
neengka'l vazhivilaki, naan ungka'lukku munvaiththa en katta'laika'laiyum en ka'rpanaika'laiyum vittuppoay, vea'rea theavarka'laich seaviththu, avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'lveerka'leayaakil,

naan avarka'lukkuk koduththa en theasaththil irunthu avarka'laip pidungki, en naamaththi'rken'ru naan parisuththappaduththina intha aalayaththai en samukaththinin'ru tha'l'li, athai ellaa janasatha'langka'lukku'l'lum pazhamozhiyaakavum vasaichsollaakavum vaippean.
appozhuthu unnathamaayirukki'ra intha aalayaththaik kadanthupoaki'ravan evanum piramiththu: karththar inthath theasaththi'rkum intha aalayaththi'rkum ippadich seythathu enna en'ru keadpaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: thangka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraivittu, vea'rea theavarka'laip pat'rikko'ndu, avaika'lai namaskariththu, seaviththapadiyinaal, karththar inthath theengkaiyellaam avarka'lmeal varappa'n'ninaar en'ru solluvaarka'l en'raar.
saalomoan karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum than aramanaiyaiyum katta irupathu varushakaalam sen'rapinpu,
eeraam thanakkuk koduththiruntha patta'nangka'laich saalomoan katti, avaika'lil israveal puththiraraik kudiyeat'rinaan.
pinpu saalomoan aamaathsoapaavukkup poay, athai jeyiththaan.
avan vanaantharaththilu'l'la thathmoaraiyum, aamaaththeasaththilea irasthukka'lin patta'nangka'l anaiththaiyum kattinaan.
saalomoan mealpeththoroanaiyum, keezhppeththoroanaiyum, alangkangka'lum kathavuka'lum thaazhppaa'lka'lumu'l'la ara'naana patta'nangka'laakak katti,

paalaaththaiyum, thanakku irukki'ra irasthukka'lai vaikkum sakala patta'nangka'laiyum, irathangka'l irukkum sakala patta'nangka'laiyum, kuthiraiveerar irukkum patta'nangka'laiyum, erusaleamilum leepanoanilum thaan aa'lum theasamengkum thanakku ishdamaanathaiyellaam kattinaan.
israveal puththirar sangkaarampa'n'naathiruntha israveal jaathiyallaatha eaththiyar, emoariyar, perisiyar, eaviyar, epoosiyaril meethiyaana sakala janaththilum,
avarka'lukkuppi'raku theasaththiliruntha avarka'l pi'l'laika'lai saalomoan innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi pakuthi kattachseythaan.

israveal puththiraril oruvaraiyum saalomoan than vealaiyaich seyya adimaippaduththavillai; avarka'l yuththamanusharum, avanudaiya searvaikkaararin thalaivarum, avanudaiya irathangka'lukkum kuthiraiveerarukkum thalaivarumaayirunthaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanudaiya oozhiyakkaararin thalaivaraakiya ivarka'lil irunoot'ru aimpathupear janaththai aa'ndaarka'l.

saalomoan: karththarudaiya petti vantha sthalangka'l parisuththamaayirukki'rathu; aathalaal, isravealin raajaavaakiya thaaveethin aramanaiyilea en manaivi vaasampa'n'nalaakaathu en'ru solli, paarvoanin kumaaraththiyaith thaaveethin nakaraththilirunthu thaan ava'lukkuk kattina maa'likaikkuk kudivarappa'n'ninaan.
athumutha'rko'ndu saalomoan thaan ma'ndapaththi'rku munpaakak kattiyiruntha karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal,

ovvoru naa'lin katta'laikkunthakkathaay moaseayudaiya ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea oayvunaadka'lilum maathappi'rappuka'lilum, varushaththil moon'rutharam aasarikki'ra pa'ndikaika'laakiya pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyilum, vaarangka'lin pa'ndikaiyilum, koodaarappa'ndikaiyilum, karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththinaan.

avan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethudaiya piramaa'naththinpadiyea, aasaariyarka'l thangka'l thangka'l oozhiyaththaich seyyum vakuppuka'laiyum, leaviyar ovvoru naa'lin katta'laippadiyea thuthiththuch seaviththu aasaariyarukku munpaakath thangka'l oozhiyaththaich seyyum mu'raika'laiyum, vaasal kaappavarka'l ovvoru vaasalil kaavalkaakkum vakuppuka'laiyum ni'rkappa'n'ninaan; theavanudaiya manushanaakiya thaaveethu ippadik katta'laiyittirunthaan.
sakala kaariyaththaiyum pokkishangka'lin kaariyaththaiyum ku'riththu, raajaa aasaariyarukkum leaviyarukkum koduththa katta'laiyai vittu avarka'l vilakaathirunthaarka'l.
ippadiyea karththarudaiya aalayaththukku asthipaaram poadappatta naa'lmuthal athai mudikkumattum saalomoanin vealaiyellaam nadanthea'rik karththarudaiya aalayam kattiththeernthathu.
pinpu saalomoan eathoam theasaththuk kadal oaraththilirukkum esiyoankeapearukkum ealoaththukkum poanaan.

avanukku eeraam than oozhiyakkaarar mukaantharamaayk kappalka'laiyum, samuththira yaaththiraiyil pazhakina vealaiyaadka'laiyum anuppinaan; avarka'l saalomoanin vealaikkaararoadeakooda oappeerukkuppoay, angkeayirunthu naanoot'ru aimpathu thaalanthu ponnai eat'ri raajaavaakiya saalomoanidaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

seapaavin raajasthiree saalomoanin keerththiyaik kea'lvippattapoathu, vidukathaika'linaalea saalomoanaich soathikki'ratha'rkaaka, mikuntha parivaaraththoadum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, mikuthiyaana ponnaiyum iraththinangka'laiyum sumakki'ra ottakangka'loadum erusaleamukku vanthaa'l; ava'l saalomoanidaththil vanthapoathu, than manathiliruntha ellaavat'raiyum ku'riththu avanidaththil sampaashiththaa'l.
appozhuthu saalomoan ava'l keattavaika'laiyellaam viduviththaan; ava'lukku viduvikkaathapadikku on'raakilum saalomoanukku ma'raiporu'laayirukkavillai.
seapaavin raajasthiree saalomoanudaiya gnaanaththaiyum avan aramanaiyaiyum,

avan panthiyin poajanapathaarththangka'laiyum, avan oozhiyakkaararin veeduka'laiyum, avan uththiyoakastharin varisaiyaiyum, avarka'l vasthirangka'laiyum, avanudaiya paanapaaththirakkaararaiyum, avarka'l vasthirangka'laiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkum nadaima'ndapaththaiyum ka'ndapoathu ava'l aachchariyaththaal piramaiko'ndu,
raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya varththamaanangka'laiyum ummudaiya gnaanaththaiyum ku'riththu, naan en theasaththilea keatta seythi meyyaayit'ru.

naan vanthu athai en ka'nka'laal kaa'numattum avarka'l vaarththaika'lai nampavillai; ummudaiya periya gnaanaththil paathiyaakilum avarka'l enakku a'rivikkavillai; naan kea'lvippatta pirasthaapaththaippaarkkilum athikam u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya janangka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; eppoathum umakku munpaaka nin'ru, ummudaiya gnaanaththaik keadki'ra ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararum paakkiyavaanka'l.

ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka neer raajaavaayirukkumpadikku, ummaith thammudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkappa'n'na, ummeal piriyangko'nda ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar sthoaththirikkappaduvaaraaka; ummudaiya theavan isravealai en'ren'raikkum nilaini'ruththumpadikkuch sineakikki'rathinaalea, avar niyaayamum neethiyum seyki'ratha'rku ummai avarka'lmeal raajaavaaka vaiththaar en'raa'l.

ava'l raajaavukku noot'rirupathu thaalanthu ponnaiyum, mikuthiyaana kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, iraththinangka'laiyum koduththaa'l; seapaavin raajasthiree raajaavaakiya saalomoanukkuk koduththa appadippatta kanthavarkkangka'laippoala orukkaalum varavillai.
oappeerilirunthu ponnaik ko'nduvaruki'ra eeraamin vealaikkaararum saalomoanin vealaikkaararum vaasanai marangka'laiyum iraththinangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

antha vaasanaimarangka'laal raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththukkum raaja aramanaikkum oon'rukaalka'laiyum, sangkeethakkaararukkuch surama'ndalangka'laiyum thampuruka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan; appadippattavaika'l atha'rku munnea yootheayaa theasaththil orukkaalum kaa'nappadavillai.

seapaavin raajasthiree raajaavukkuk ko'nduvanthavaika'laippaarkkilum athikamaay ava'l aasaippattukkeatta ellaavat'raiyum raajaavaakiya saalomoan ava'lukkuk koduththaan; pinpu ava'l than parivaaraththoadungkooda than theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoanaa'l.
viyaapaarika'lum varththakarum ko'nduvarum ponnaiththavira, saalomoanukku ovvoru varushaththilum vantha pon a'runoot'ru a'rupaththaa'ru thaalanthu ni'raiyaayirunthathu.
arapitheasaththuch sakala raajaakka'lum maakaa'nangka'lin athipathika'lum saalomoanukkup ponnaiyum ve'l'liyaiyum ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya saalomoan irunoo'ru parisaika'lai adiththa ponthakattaal seyviththaan; ovvoru parisaikku a'runoo'ru seakkal ni'rai ponthakattaich selavazhiththaan.

adiththa ponthakattaal munnoo'ru keadakangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan; ovvoru keadakaththi'rku munnoo'ru seakkalni'rai ponnaich selavazhiththaan; avaika'lai raajaa leepanoan vanam ennum maa'likaiyilea vaiththaan.
raajaa thanthaththinaal oru periya singkaasanaththaiyum seyviththu, athaip pasumponthakattaal moodinaan.

anthach singkaasanaththukkup ponninaal seyyappatta aa'ru padika'lum, oru paathapadiyum, udkaarum idaththi'rku irupu'raththilum kaichsaaymaanangka'lum irunthana; ira'ndu singkangka'l kaichsaaymaanangka'l arukea nin'rathu.
antha aa'ru padika'linmealum, ira'ndu pakkaththilum pannira'ndu singkangka'l nin'rana; entha raajyaththilum ippadip pa'n'nappadavillai.

raajaavaakiya saalomoanukku iruntha paanapaaththirangka'lellaam ponnum, leepanoan vanam ennum maa'likaiyin pa'nimuttuka'lellaam pasumponnumaayirunthathu; on'rum ve'l'liyinaal seyyappadavillai; saalomoanin naadka'lil ve'l'li oru poru'laay e'n'nappadavillai.

raajaavin kappalka'l eeraamin vealaikkaararudan tharsheesukkup poayvarum; tharsheesin kappalka'l moon'ru varushaththukku orutharam ponnaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, yaanaith thanthangka'laiyum, kurangkuka'laiyum, mayilka'laiyum ko'nduvarum.
poomiyin sakala raajaakka'laippaarkkilum raajaavaakiya saalomoan aisuvariyaththilum gnaanaththilum si'ranthavanaayirunthaan.
saalomoanin iruthayaththilea theavan aru'liya gnaanaththaik keadpatha'rkup poomiyin raajaakka'l ellaarum avan mukatharisanaththaith theadinaarka'l.

varushaavarusham avaravar thangka'l kaa'nikkaiyaakiya ve'l'lippaaththirangka'laiyum, po'rpaaththirangka'laiyum, vasthirangka'laiyum, aayuthangka'laiyum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, kuthiraika'laiyum, koavea'ru kazhuthaika'laiyum ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

saalomoanukku naalaayiram kuthirailaayangka'lum irathangka'lum irunthana, panneeraayiram kuthiraiveerarum irunthaarka'l; avaika'lai irathangka'l vaikkum patta'nangka'lilum, avarka'lai erusaleamil thannidaththilum raajaa vaiththirunthaan.
nathithuvakkip pelistharin theasamattukkum ekipthin ellaivaraikkum irukki'ra sakala raajaakka'laiyum avan aa'ndaan.
erusaleamilea raajaa ve'l'liyaik ka'rka'lpoalavum, keathurumarangka'laip pa'l'laththaakkuka'lil irukkum kaattaththimarangka'lpoalavum athikamaakkinaan.
ekipthilum mat'ra theasangka'lilumirunthu saalomoanukkuk kuthiraika'l ko'nduvarappattathu.

saalomoanudaiya aathiyanthamaana mat'ra nadapadika'l theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanin pusthakaththilum, seeloaniyanaakiya akiyaa ezhuthina theerkkatharisanaththilum, neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamaikku'riththu gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya iththoa ezhuthina tharisanangka'lilum allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
saalomoan erusaleamilea isravealaiyellaam naa'rpathu varusham arasaa'ndaan.

pinpu saalomoan than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthaan; avanai avan thakappanaakiya thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya rekopeyaam raajaavaanaan.
rekopeyaamai raajaavaakkumpadi isravealar ellaarum seekeamukku vanthirunthapadiyaal, avanum seekeamukkup poanaan.
raajaavaakiya saalomoanai vittu oadippoay, ekipthiliruntha neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaam athaik keattapoathu, avan ekipthilirunthu thirumpivanthaan.
aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippiththaarka'l; pinpu yeropeyaamum isravealanaiththumaay vanthu, rekopeyaamai noakki:

ummudaiya thakappan paaramaana nukaththai engka'lmeal vaiththaar; ippoathum neer ummudaiya thakappan sumaththina kadinamaana vealaiyaiyum, avar engka'lmeal vaiththa paaramaana nukaththaiyum lakuvaakkum; appozhuthu ummaich seavippoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l moon'ru naa'laikkuppi'rpaadu thirumpa ennidaththil vaarungka'l en'raan; appadiyea janangka'l poayirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam than thakappanaakiya saalomoan uyiroadirukkaiyil avan samukaththil nin'ra muthiyoaroadea aaloasanaipa'n'ni, intha janangka'lukku ma'ruuththaravu kodukka neengka'l enna aaloasanai solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avarka'l: neer intha janangka'lukkuth thayavaiyum padchaththaiyum kaa'npiththu, avarka'lukku nalvaarththaika'laich solveeraanaal, en'raikkum avarka'l umakku oozhiyakkaararaayiruppaarka'l en'raarka'l.
muthiyoar sonna aaloasanaiyai avan tha'l'livittu, thannoadea va'larnthavarka'lum than samukaththil ni'rki'ravarka'lumaakiya vaaliparoadea aaloasanaipa'n'ni,

avarka'lai noakki: ummudaiya thakappan engka'lmeal vaiththa nukaththai lakuvaakkum en'ru ennidaththil sonna intha janangka'lukku ma'ruuththaravu kodukka neengka'l enna aaloasanai solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaan.

avanoadea va'larntha vaalipar avanai noakki: ummudaiya thakappan engka'l nukaththaip paaramaakkinaar, neer athai engka'lukku lakuvaakkum en'ru ummidaththil sonna intha janaththi'rku neer sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: en su'nduviral en thakappanudaiya iduppaippaarkkilum parumanaayirukkum.

ippoathum en thakappan paaramaana nukaththai ungka'lmeal vaiththaar, naan ungka'l nukaththai athika paaramaakkuvean; en thakappan ungka'laich savukkuka'linaalea tha'ndiththaar, naan ungka'laith thea'lka'linaalea tha'ndippean en'ru sollum en'raarka'l.
moon'raam naa'l ennidaththil vaarungka'l en'ru raajaa solliyirunthapadiyea, yeropeyaamum sakala janangka'lum moon'raam naa'lilea rekopeyaamidaththil vanthaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam muthiyoar aaloasanaiyaith tha'l'livittu, avarka'lukkuk kadinamaana uththaravu koduththaan.

vaaliparudaiya aaloasanaiyinpadiyea avarka'loadea peasi, en thakappan ungka'l nukaththaip paaramaakkinaar, naan athai athika paaramaakkuvean; en thakappan ungka'laich savukkuka'linaalea tha'ndiththaar, naan ungka'laith thea'lka'linaalea tha'ndippean en'ru sonnaan.

raajaa janangka'lukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanaan; karththar seeloaniyanaana akiyaavaikko'ndu neapaaththin kumaaranaakiya yeropeyaamukkuch sonna thamathu vaarththaiyai u'ruthippaduththumpadi theavanaalea ippadi nadanthathu.

raajaa thangka'lukkuch sevikodaathathai isravealar ellaarum ka'ndapoathu, janangka'l raajaavukku ma'ruuththaramaaka: thaaveethoadea engka'lukkup pangkeathu? eesaayin kumaaranidaththil engka'lukkuch suthantharam illai; isravealea, un koodaarangka'lukkup poayvidu; ippoathu thaaveethea, un sontha veettaip paarththukko'l en'ru solli, isravealar ellaarum thangka'l koodaarangka'lukkup poayvittaarka'l.
aanaalum yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilea kudiyiruntha israveal puththirarmeal rekopeyaam raajaavaayirunthaan.

pinpu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam pakuthi visaarippukkaaranaakiya athoaraamai anuppinaan; israveal puththirar avanaik kalle'rinthu kon'raarka'l; appozhuthu raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam theeviramaay irathaththinmeal ea'ri erusaleamukku oadippoanaan.
appadiyea innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi isravealar thaaveethin vamsaththai vittuk kalakampa'n'nip pirinthupoayirukki'raarka'l.

rekopeyaam erusaleamukku vanthapoathu, isravealoadu yuththampa'n'navum, raajyaththaith thannidamaakath thiruppikko'l'lavum, yoothaa vamsaththaarum penyameen vamsaththaarumaakiya therinthuko'l'lappatta yuththaveeraraana ladchaththu e'npathinaayirampearaik koottinaan.
theavanudaiya manushanaakiya semaayaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar sonnathu:
nee yoothaavin raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam ennum saalomoanin kumaaranaiyum, yoothaavilum penyameenilum irukki'ra ellaa isravealaraiyum noakki:

neengka'l poakaamalum, ungka'l sakoathararoadu yuththampa'n'naamalum, avaravar thamtham veettukkuth thirumpungka'l; ennaalea inthak kaariyam nadanthathu en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar; appozhuthu avarka'l karththarudaiya vaarththaika'lukkuk keezhppadinthu, yeropeyaamukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuvathai vittuth thirumpip poayvittaarka'l.
rekopeyaam erusaleamil vaasamaayirunthu, yoothaavilea ara'naana patta'nangka'laik kattinaan.
avan pethlekeamum, eaththaamum, thekkovaavum,
pethsoorum, soakoavum, athullaamum,
kaaththum, mareashaavum, seeppum,
athoaraayeemum, laakeesum, aseakkaavum,
soaraavum, aayiloanum, eproanum aakiya yoothaavilum penyameenilum irukki'ra ara'nippaana patta'nangka'laikkatti,
antha ara'nippuka'laip palappaduththi, avaika'lilea thalaivaraiyum, aakaaramum e'n'neyum thiraadcharasamumu'l'la pa'ndakasaalaika'laiyum,
yoothaavum penyameenum avan padchaththilirukka, ovvoru patta'naththilum parisaika'laiyum eettika'laiyum vaiththu, avaika'lai mikuthiyum palappaduththinaan.
isravealengkum irukki'ra aasaariyarum leaviyarum thangka'l ellaa ellaika'lilumirunthu avanidaththil vanthaarka'l.

leaviyar karththarukku aasaariya oozhiyagnseyyaathapadikku yeropeyaamum avan kumaararum avarka'laith tha'l'lippoattapadiyinaal, thangka'l ve'linilangka'laiyum thangka'l kaa'niyaadchika'laiyum vittu, yoothaatheasaththukkum erusaleamukkum vanthaarka'l.
avan meadaika'lukken'rum, peayka'lukken'rum, thaan u'ndaakkina kan'rukkuttika'lukken'rum aasaariyarka'lai ea'rpaduththinaan.

antha leaviyarin pi'rakaalea isravealin koaththirangka'lilellaam isravealin theavanaakiya karththaraith theaduki'ratha'rku, thangka'l iruthayaththai nearaakkinavarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarukkup paliyidumpadikku erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l.

ippadi moon'ru varushamattum yoothaavin raajyaththaip palappaduththi, saalomoanin kumaaranaakiya rekopeyaamaith thidappaduththinaarka'l; thaaveethum saalomoanum nadantha vazhiyilea moon'ru varushamattum nadanthaarka'l.
rekopeyaam thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya erimoaththin kumaaraththi makalaaththaiyum, eesaayin kumaaranaakiya eliyaapin kumaaraththi apiyaayealaiyum vivaakampa'n'ninaan.
iva'l avanukku eayoos samariyaa saakaam ennum kumaararaip pet'raa'l.
ava'lukkuppi'raku apsaloamin kumaaraththiyaakiya maakaa'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaan; ava'l avanukku apiyaavaiyum, aththaayiyaiyum, seesaavaiyum, seloamiththaiyum pet'raa'l.

rekopeyaam thannudaiya manaivika'l ma'rumanaiyaattika'l ellaarilum, apsaloamin kumaaraththiyaakiya maakaa'laich sineakiththaan; pathinettu manaivika'laiyum a'rupathu ma'rumanaiyaattika'laiyum vivaakampa'n'ni, irupaththettuk kumaararaiyum a'rupathu kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
rekopeyaam maakaa'lin kumaaranaakiya apiyaavai avan sakoathararukku'l'lea thalaivanum periyavanumaaka ea'rpaduththinaan; avanai raajaavaakka ninaiththaan.

avan puththiyaay nadanthu, yoothaa penyameenudaiya ellaa theasangka'lilumu'l'la ara'naana sakala patta'nangka'lilum than kumaarar yaavaraiyum piriththuvaiththu, avarka'lukku vea'ndiya aakaaraththaik koduththu, avarka'lukku aneakam pe'nka'laith theadinaan.
rekopeyaam raajyaththaith thidappaduththith thannaip palappaduththikko'ndapin, avanum avanoadea isravealar anaivarum karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththai vittuvittaarka'l.

avarka'l karththarukku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ninapadiyinaal, raajaavaakiya rekopeyaamin ainthaam varushaththil ekipthin raajaavaakiya seeshaak aayiraththu irunoo'ru irathangka'loadum, a'rupathinaayiram kuthiraiveeraroadum erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthaan.
avanoadeakooda ekipthilirunthu vantha loopiyar, sookkiyar, eththiyoappiyaraana janangka'l e'n'nikkaikku adangkaathavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
avan yoothaavukku aduththa ara'naana patta'nangka'laip pidiththu, erusaleammattum vanthaan.

appozhuthu semaayaa theerkkatharisi rekopeyaamidaththukkum, seeshaakkinimiththam erusaleamilea vanthu koodiyirukki'ra yoothaavin pirapukka'lidaththukkum vanthu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ennai vittuvitteerka'l, aakaiyaal naan ungka'laiyum seeshaakkin kaiyilea vizhumpadi vittuvittean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu isravealin pirapukka'lum raajaavum thangka'laith thaazhththik karththar neethiyu'l'lavar en'raarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'laith thaazhththinathaik karththar ka'ndapoathu, karththarudaiya vaarththai semaayaavukku u'ndaaki, avar sonnathu: avarka'l thangka'laith thaazhththinaarka'l, aakaiyaal avarka'lai azhikkamaattean; en ukkiram seeshaakkaikko'ndu erusaleaminmeal oot'rappadaathapadikku, avarka'lukkuk kogncham sakaayaththaik katta'laiyiduvean.
aanaalum ennaich seavikki'ratha'rkum, anniya theasangka'lin raajyangka'laich seavikki'ratha'rkum irukki'ra viththiyaasaththai avarka'l a'riyumpadikku avanaich seavikki'ravarka'laavaarka'l en'raar.

appadiyea ekipthin raajaavaakiya seeshaak erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'laiyum, raajaavudaiya aramanaip pokkishangka'laiyum, saalomoan seyviththa ponparisaika'l aakiya sakalaththaiyum eduththukko'ndu poayvittaan.
avaika'lukkup pathilaaka raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam ve'nkalap parisaika'laich seyviththu, avaika'lai raajaavin vaasa'rpadiyaik kaakki'ra seavakarudaiya thalaivarin kaiyil oppuviththaan.
raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, aramanaich seavakar vanthu, avaika'lai eduththukko'ndupoay, thirumpath thangka'l a'raiyilea vaippaarka'l.
avan thannaith thaazhththinapadiyinaal, karththar avanai muzhuthum azhikkaathapadikku avarudaiya koapam avanaivittuth thirumpit'ru; yoothaavilea innum sila kaariyangka'l seeraayirunthathu.

appadiyea raajaavaakiya rekopeyaam erusaleamilea thannaith thidappaduththikko'ndu arasaa'ndaan; rekopeyaam raajaavaaki'rapoathu naa'rpaththoru vayathaayirunthu, karththar thammudaiya naamam vi'langkumpadi israveal koaththirangka'lilellaam therinthuko'nda nakaramaakiya erusaleamilea pathineazhu varusham raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; ammoan jaathiyaana avanudaiya thaayinpear naamaa'l.
avan karththaraith theaduki'ratha'rkuth than iruthayaththai nearaakkaamal pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

rekopeyaamin aathiyoadanthamaana nadapadika'l semaayaavin pusthakaththilum, gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya iththoavin vamsa attava'naiyilum allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; rekopeyaamukkum yeropeyaamukkum sakala naa'lum yuththam nadanthuko'ndirunthathu.
rekopeyaam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan kumaaranaakiya apiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
raajaavaakiya yeropeyaamin pathinettaam varushaththil apiyaa yoothaavinmeal raajaavaaki,
moon'ru varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; kipiyaa ooraanaakiya ooriyealin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayin pear mikaayaa'l; apiyaavukkum yeropeyaamukkum yuththam nadanthathu.

apiyaa therinthuko'l'lappatta naaluladchampearaakiya paraakkirama seavakarin iraa'nuvaththaarai yuththaththi'rku aayaththampa'n'ninaan; yeropeyaam therinthuko'l'lappatta ettuladcham pearaakiya palaththa paraakkiramasaalika'lai avanukku ethiraaka yuththaththi'rku ni'ruththinaan.
appozhuthu apiyaa eppiraayeem malaiththeasaththilu'l'la semaraayeem ennum malaiyinmeal ea'rinin'ru: yeropeyaamea, ellaa isravealarea, kea'lungka'l.
isravealai en'raikkum aa'lum raajyapaaraththai isravealin theavanaakiya karththar thaaveethukkum avan kumaararukkum maa'raatha udanpadikkaiyaayk katta'laiyittathai neengka'l a'riyeerka'laa?
aakilum thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya saalomoanin oozhiyakkaaranaana yeropeyaam ennum neapaaththin kumaaran ezhumpi, than ejamaanukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'ninaan.

pealiyaa'lin makka'laakiya vee'nar avanoadeakoodi, saalomoanin kumaaranaakiya rekopeyaam avarka'lai ethirkkakkoodaamal vaalavayathum thidanat'ra manathumaayirukkaiyil, avanukku viroathamaayth thangka'laip palappaduththikko'ndaarka'l.

ippoathum thaaveethudaiya kumaaran kaiyilirukki'ra karththarudaiya raajyaththi'rku viroathamaaka neengka'l pelanko'l'lalaamen'ru ninaikki'reerka'l; neengka'l earaa'lamaana koottam; yeropeyaam ungka'lukkuth theavarka'laaka u'ndaakkina pon kan'rukkuttika'lum ungka'lidaththil irukki'rathea.

neengka'l aaroanin kumaararaakiya karththarudaiya aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum tha'l'livittu, theasaatheasangka'lin janangka'laippoala ungka'lukku aasaariyarka'lai u'ndupa'n'navillaiyoa? i'langkaa'laiyinaalum, eazhu kadaakka'linaalum, thannaip pirathishdaiyaakkumpadi varuki'ra evanum theyvam allaathavaika'lukku aasaariyanaaki'raanea.
engka'lukkoa karththarea theavan; naangka'l avaraivittu vilakavillai; karththarukku oozhiyagnseyki'ra aasaariyarka'l aaroanin kumaararum, pa'nividai seyki'ravarka'l leaviyarumaamea.

avarka'l thinanthoa'rum karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum sukantha vaasanaiyaana thoopaththaiyum seluththi, kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum parisuththamaana meajaiyinmeal samukaththappangka'lai adukkivaikki'rathaiyum, pon kuththuvi'lakkaiyum athin vi'lakkuka'laich saayangkaalanthoa'rum eat'ruki'rathaiyum visaarikki'raarka'l; naangka'l engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin kaavalaik kaakki'roam; neengka'loa avarai vittu vilakineerka'l.

ithoa, theavan engka'l seanaapathiyaay engka'loadeakooda irukki'raar; ungka'lukku viroathamaakap poorikaika'laip perunthoniyaay muzhakkuki'ra aasaariyarka'lum irukki'raarka'l; israveal puththirarea, ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaaka yuththagnseyyaatheayungka'l; seythaal ungka'lukkuch siththikkaathu en'raan.
yeropeyaam avarka'lukkup pinnaaka varaththakkathaaka oru pathividaiyaich sut'rippoakappa'n'ninaan; appadiyea avarka'l yoothaavukku mun irunthaarka'l; anthap pathividai avarka'lukkuppin irunthathu.
yoothaa janangka'l thirumpippaarkki'rapoathu, munnum pinnum yuththam nadakki'rathaik ka'ndu, karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; aasaariyarka'l poorikaika'lai muzhakkinaarka'l.
yoothaa manushar aarppariththaarka'l; yoothaa manushar aarpparikki'rapoathu, theavan yeropeyaamaiyum isravealanaiththaiyum apiyaavukkum yoothaavukkum munpaaka mu'riya adiththaar.
israveal puththirar yoothaavukku munpaaka mu'rinthoadinaarka'l; theavan avarka'lai ivarka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.
apiyaavum avanudaiya janangka'lum avarka'lil makaa sangkaarampa'n'ninaarka'l; therinthuko'l'lappatta ainthuladchampear isravealilea vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.
appadiyea israveal puththirar akkaalaththilea thaazhththappattaarka'l; yoothaa puththiraroa thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaraich saarnthuko'ndathinaal mea'rko'ndaarka'l.

apiyaa yeropeyaamaip pinthodarnthu, avanukku u'ndaana patta'nangka'laakiya peththealaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum, eshaanaavaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum, epperoanaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum pidiththaan.
appu'ram apiyaavin naadka'lil yeropeyaam palangko'l'lamaattaatheapoay, karththar avanai adiththathinaal mara'namadainthaan.
apiyaa palaththuppoanaan; avan pathinaalu sthireeka'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, irupaththira'ndu kumaararaiyum pathinaa'ru kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
apiyaavin mat'rak kiriyaika'lum, avan nadapadika'lum avan varththamaanangka'lum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya iththoavin sariththiraththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

apiyaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapin, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya aasaa raajaavaanaan; ivanudaiya naadka'lil theasam paththu varushamattum amarikkaiyaayirunthathu.
aasaa than theavanaakiya karththarin paarvaikku nanmaiyum semmaiyumaanathaich seythaan.
anniya theavarka'lin palipeedangka'laiyum meadaika'laiyum akat'ri, silaika'lai udaiththu, vikkirakaththoappuka'lai vetti,
thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaraith theadavum, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyum ka'rpanaiyinpadiyum seyyavum yoothaavukkuk ka'rpiththu,
yoothaavudaiya ellaap patta'nangka'lilumirunthu meadaika'laiyum vikkirakangka'laiyum akat'rinaan; avanukku munpaaka raajyam amarikkaiyaayirunthathu.

karththar avanukku i'laippaa'ruthalaik katta'laiyittathinaal, antha varushangka'lil avanukku viroathamaana yuththam illaathirunthathu; theasam amarikkaiyaayirunthapadiyinaal yoothaavilea ara'naana patta'nangka'laik kattinaan.

avan yoothaavai noakki: theasam namakku munpaaka amarnthirukkaiyil, naam inthap patta'nangka'laik katti, avaika'lukku alangkangka'l, koapurangka'l, vaasalka'l u'ndupa'n'ni, thaazhppaa'l poattup palappaduththuvoamaaka; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraith theadinoam, theadinapoathu, sut'rilum namakku i'laippaa'ruthalaik katta'laiyittaar en'raan; appadiyea kattinaarka'l; avarka'lukkuk kaariyam vaayththathu.

yoothaavilea parisaiyum eettiyum pidikki'ra moon'ruladchampearum, penyameenilea keadakam pidiththu villai naa'neat'ruki'ra ira'nduladchaththu e'npathinaayirampearumaana seanai aasaavukku irunthathu, ivarka'lellaarum paraakkiramasaalika'l.
avarka'lukku viroathamaaka eththiyoappiyanaakiya searaa paththuladchampearka'l searntha seanaiyoadum munnoo'ru irathangka'loadum pu'rappattu mareasaamattum vanthaan.
appozhuthu aasaa avanukku ethiraakap pu'rappattaan; mareasaavukku aduththa seppaththaa ennum pa'l'laththaakkil yuththaththi'rku a'nivakuththu nin'raarka'l.

aasaa than theavanaakiya karththarai noakkik kooppittu: karththaavea, palamu'l'lavanukkaakilum palanat'ravanukkaakilum uthaviseyki'rathu umakku leasaana kaariyam; engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, engka'lukkuth thu'nainillum; ummaich saarnthu ummudaiya naamaththil earaa'lamaana inthak koottaththi'rku ethiraaka vanthoam; karththaavea, neer engka'l theavan; manushan ummai mea'rko'l'lavidaatheayum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar antha eththiyoappiyarai aasaavukkum yoothaavukkum munpaaka mu'riya adiththathinaal eththiyoappiyar oadippoanaarka'l.

avarka'lai aasaavum avanoadiruntha janangka'lum kearaarmattum thuraththinaarka'l; eththiyoappiyar thirumpap palangko'l'laathapadikku mu'rinthu vizhunthaarka'l; karththarukkum avarudaiya seanaikkum munpaaka no'rungkippoanaarka'l; avarka'l mikuthiyaakak ko'l'lai adiththu,

kearaarin sut'ruppatta'nangka'laiyellaam mu'riya adiththaarka'l; karththaraal avarka'lukkup payangkaram u'ndaayit'ru; anthap patta'nangka'laiyellaam ko'l'laiyittaarka'l, avaika'lil ko'l'lai mikuthiyaay akappattathu.
mirukajeevanka'l iruntha kottaarangka'laiyum avarka'l idiththuppoattu, thira'laana aaduka'laiyum ottakangka'laiyum saayththukko'ndu erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaarka'l.
appozhuthu theavanudaiya aavi oatheathin kumaaranaakiya asariyaavinmeal i'rangkinathinaal,

avan ve'liyea aasaavukku ethirko'ndupoay, avanai noakki: aasaavea, yoothaa penyameen koaththirangka'lin sakala manusharea, kea'lungka'l; neengka'l karththaroadirunthaal, avar ungka'loadiruppaar; neengka'l avaraith theadinaal, ungka'lukku ve'lippaduvaar; avarai vitteerka'leayaakil, avar ungka'lai vittuviduvaar.
isravealilea aneaka naa'laay meyyaana theavanum illai, upatheasikki'ra aasaariyanum illai, veathamum illai.
thangka'l nerukkaththilea isravealin theavanaakiya karththaridaththukkuth thirumpi, avaraith theadinapoathu, avar avarka'lukku ve'lippattaar.
akkaalangka'lilea ve'liyea poaki'ravarka'lukkum u'l'lea varuki'ravarka'lukkum samaathaanam illai; theasangka'lin kudika'l ellaarukku'l'lum makaa ama'li u'ndaayirunthu,
jaathiyai jaathiyum, patta'naththaip patta'namum no'rukkinathu; theavan avarka'laich sakalavitha idukkaththinaalum kalangkappa'n'ninaar.
neengka'loa ungka'l kaika'lai nekizhavidaamal thidanko'l'lungka'l; ungka'l kiriyaika'lukkup palan u'ndu en'raan.

aasaa intha vaarththaika'laiyum theerkkatharisiyaakiya oatheathin theerkkatharisanaththaiyum keattapoathu, avan thidanko'ndu, aruvaruppuka'lai yoothaa penyameen theasam anaiththilum, eppiraayeemin malaiththeasaththil thaan pidiththa patta'nangka'lilumirunthu akat'ri, karththarudaiya ma'ndapaththin munnirukki'ra karththarudaiya palipeedaththaip puthuppiththu,

avan yoothaa penyameen janangka'laiyum, avarka'loadeakooda eppiraayeemilum manaaseayilum simiyoanilum irunthu vanthu avarka'loadu sagnchariththavarka'laiyum koottinaan; avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththar avanoadirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, isravealilirunthu thira'laana janangka'l avan padchaththil searnthaarka'l.
aasaa arasaa'nda pathinainthaam varusham moon'raam maathaththilea avarka'l erusaleamilea koodi,
thaangka'l ko'l'laiyittu oattikko'nduvanthavaika'lil annaa'lilea ezhunoo'ru maaduka'laiyum eazhaayiram aaduka'laiyum karththarukkup paliyittu,
thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaraith thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum thangka'l muzhu aaththumaavoadum theaduvoam en'rum;
si'riyoar periyoar sthiree purushar ellaarilum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththaraith theadaathavan evanoa avan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndum en'rum oru udanpadikkai seythu,
makaa saththaththoadum kempeeraththoadum poorikaika'loadum ekkaa'langka'loadum karththarukku munpaaka aa'naiyittaarka'l.

intha aa'naikkaaka yoothaa janangka'l yaavarum santhoashappattaarka'l; thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum aa'naiyittu, thangka'l muzhumanathoadum avaraith theadinaarka'l; karththar avarka'lukku ve'lippattu, sut'ruppu'raththaaraal yuththamillaathapadikku avarka'lai i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninaar.

thoappilea aruvaruppaana vikkirakaththai u'ndupa'n'nina raajaavaakiya aasaavin thaayaana maakaa'laiyum raajaaththiyaay iraathapadikku aasaa vilakkippoattu, ava'ludaiya vikkirakaththaiyum nirmoolamaakkith thakarththu, keetharoan aat'ra'ndaiyilea sutteriththuppoattaan.
meadaika'loa isravealilirunthu thakarkkappadavillai; aanaalum, aasaavin iruthayam avan naadka'lilellaam uththamamaayirunthathu.
than thakappanum thaanum parisuththampa'n'numpadi nearnthuko'nda ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum pa'nimuttuka'laiyum avan theavanudaiya aalayaththilea ko'nduvanthaan.
aasaa arasaa'nda muppaththainthaam varushamattum yuththam illaathirunthathu.

aasaa arasaa'nda muppaththaa'raam varushaththilea, isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaa yoothaavukku viroathamaay vanthu, oruvarum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavinidaththil poakkum varaththumaayiraathapadikku raamaavaik kattinaan.

appozhuthu aasaa karththarudaiya aalayaththilum raajaavin aramanaiyilumu'l'la pokkishangka'lilu'l'la ve'l'liyum ponnum eduththu, thamaskuvil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra pennaathaath ennum seeriyaavin raajaavinidaththukku anuppi:

enakkum umakkum, en thakappanukkum ummudaiya thakappanukkum udanpadikkai u'ndea; ithoa, ve'l'liyum ponnum umakku anuppinean; isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaa ennaivittu vilakippoakumpadikku neer vanthu, avanoadu seytha udanpadikkaiyaith tha'l'lippoadum en'ru solli anuppinaan.

pennaathaath raajaavaakiya aasaavukkuch sevikoduththu, thanakku u'ndaana seanaapathika'lai isravealin patta'nangka'lukku viroathamaaka anuppinaan; avarka'l eeyoanaiyum, thaa'naiyum, aapealmaayeemaiyum, napthali patta'nangka'lin ellaap pa'ndakasaalaika'laiyum mu'riya adiththaarka'l.
ithaip paashaa keattapoathu, raamaavaik kattuki'rathai ni'ruththi, than vealaiyaivittu ozhinthaan.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya aasaa yoothaa anaiththaiyung koottikko'ndupoay, paashaa kattina raamaavin ka'rka'laiyum athin marangka'laiyum eduththuvanthu, avaika'laal keapaavaiyum mispaavaiyum kattinaan.

akkaalaththilea gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya anaani yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: neer ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththaraich saarnthuko'l'laamal, seeriyaavin raajaavaich saarnthuko'ndapadiyinaal, seeriyaa raajaavin iraa'nuvam umathu kaikkuth thappippoayit'ru.

mikavum earaa'lamaana irathangka'lum kuthiraiveerarumu'l'la eththiyoappiyarum loopiyarum makaa seanaiyaayirunthaarka'l allavaa? neer karththaraich saarnthuko'ndapoathoavenil, avarka'lai umathu kaiyil oppukkoduththaarea.

thammaippat'ri uththama iruthayaththoadirukki'ravarka'lukkuth thammudaiya vallamaiyai vi'langkappa'n'numpadi, karththarudaiya ka'nka'l poomiyengkum ulaavikko'ndirukki'rathu; intha vishayaththil mathiyillaathavaraayiruntheer; aakaiyaal ithumutha'rko'ndu umakku yuththangka'l nearidum en'raan.
athinimiththam aasaa gnaanathirushdikkaaranmeal sinanthu kadungkoapangko'ndu avanaik kaavala'raiyilea vaiththaan; ithallaamalum akkaalaththil janangka'lukku'l silaraik kodooramaay nadappiththaan.
aasaavin aathiyoadanthamaana nadapadika'lellaam yoothaavaiyum isravealaiyum searntha raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aasaa arasaa'nda muppaththonpathaam varushaththilea than kaalka'lil viyaathika'ndu, avan noavu mikavum ukkiramaayirunthathu; avan than viyaathiyilum karththarai alla, parikaarika'laiyea theadinaan.
aasaa thaan arasaa'nda naa'rpaththoaraam varushaththil mariththu, than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthaan.

thailakkaararaal seyyappatta kanthavarkkangka'linaalum parima'langka'linaalum ni'raintha oru meththaiyinmeal avanai va'larththi, avanukkaaka veku thira'laana kanthavarkkangka'laik ko'luththina pinpu, avan thaaveethin nakaraththil thanakku vettivaiththiruntha avanudaiya kalla'raiyilea, avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya yoasapaath raajaavaaki, isravealukku viroathamaayp palappattaan.
avan yoothaavin ara'naana patta'nangka'lilellaam iraa'nuvaththaiyum, yoothaa theasaththilum, than thakappanaakiya aasaa pidiththa eppiraayeemin patta'nangka'lilum thaa'naiyangka'laiyum vaiththaan.
karththar yoasapaaththoadirunthaar; avan paakaalka'laith theadaamal, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu munnaadka'lil nadantha vazhika'lil nadanthu,
than thakappanudaiya theavanaith theadi, isravealudaiya seykaiyinpadi nadavaamal, avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadi nadanthuko'ndaan.

aakaiyaal karththar avan kaiyil raajyapaaraththaith thidappaduththinaar; yoothaa koaththiraththaar ellaarum yoasapaaththukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avanukku aisuvariyamum kanamum mikuthiyaayirunthathu.
