karththarudaiya vazhika'lil avan iruthayam u'rchaakangko'ndathu; avan meadaika'laiyum vikkirakath thoappuka'laiyum yoothaavai vittakat'rinaan.

avan arasaa'nda moon'raam varushaththil yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilea upatheasampa'n'numpadikku, avan than pirapukka'laakiya pennaayilaiyum, opathiyaavaiyum, sakariyaavaiyum, nethaneyealaiyum, mikaayaavaiyum,

ivarka'loadeakoodach semaayaa, nethaniyaa, sepathiyaa, aasakeal, semiramoath, yoanaththaan, athoaniyaa, thopiyaa, thoapaththoaniyaa ennum leaviyaraiyum, ivarka'loadeakooda aasaariyaraana elishamaavaiyum, yoaraamaiyum anuppinaan.
ivarka'l yoothaavilea upatheasiththu, karththarudaiya veatha pusthakaththai vaiththukko'ndu, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilellaam thirinthu janangka'lukkup poathiththaarka'l.
yoothaavaich sut'riyirukki'ra theasangka'ludaiya raajyangka'linmealellaam karththaraal u'ndaana payangkaram vanthathinaal, yoasapaaththoadu yuththampa'n'naathirunthaarka'l.

pelistharilum silar yoasapaaththukkup pakuthippa'naththoadeakoodak kaa'nikkaika'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l; arapiyarum avanukku eazhaayiraththu ezhunoo'ru aattukkadaakka'laiyum, eazhaayiraththu ezhunoo'ru ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
ippadiyea yoasapaath varavara mikavum periyavanaaki, yoothaavilea koattaika'laiyum, rasthukka'lai vaikkum patta'nangka'laiyum kattinaan.
yoothaavin patta'nangka'lil avan periya vealaika'lai nadaththinaan; erusaleamilea paraakkiramasaalika'laana seavakar avanukku irunthaarka'l.

thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadi avarka'ludaiya ilakkamaavathu: yoothaavilea aayiraththukku athipathika'lil athnaa thalaimaiyaanavan; avanidaththilea paraakkiramasaalika'l moon'ruladchampear irunthaarka'l.
avanukku uthaviyaaka yoakanaan ennum seanaapathiyirunthaan; avanidaththilea ira'nduladchaththu e'npathinaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
avanukku uthaviyaakak karththarukkuth thannai u'rchaakamaay oppukkoduththa sikriyin kumaaranaakiya amasiyaa irunthaan; avanidaththilea paraakkiramasaalika'l ira'nduladchampear irunthaarka'l.
penyameenilea eliyaathaa ennum paraakkiramasaali irunthaan; avanidaththilea villum keadakamum pidikki'ravarka'l ira'nduladchampear irunthaarka'l.
avanukku uthaviyaaka yoasapaath irunthaan; avanidaththilea seavakaththi'rku aayuthapaa'nika'l ladchaththu e'npathinaayirampear irunthaarka'l.
raajaa yoothaa engkumu'l'la ara'naana patta'nangka'lil vaiththavarka'laiththavira ivarka'lea raajaavaich seaviththavarka'l.
yoasapaaththukku mikuntha aisuvariyamum kanamum u'ndaayirunthathu; avan aakaapoadea sampanthangkalanthu,

sila varushangka'l sen'rapinpu, samaariyaavilirukki'ra aakaapidaththukkup poanaan; appozhuthu aakaap avanukkum avanoadirukki'ra janaththi'rkum aneakam aadumaaduka'lai adippiththu, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rku varumpadi avanai eavinaan.

eppadiyenil, isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaap yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththai noakki: keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththukku ennoadea varuki'reeraa en'ru keattatha'rku, avan: naanthaan neer, ennudaiya janangka'l ummudaiya janangka'l, ummoadeakooda yuththaththi'rku varuki'rean en'raan.
pinnum yoasapaath isravealin raajaavaip paarththu: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai in'raikku visaariththu a'riyum en'raan.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa naanoo'ru theerkkatharisika'laik koodivarachseythu: naangka'l keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'nap poakalaamaa, poakalaakaathaa en'ru avarka'laik keattaan. atha'rku avarka'l: poam, theavan raajaavin kaiyil athai oppukkoduppaar en'raarka'l.
pinpu yoasapaath: naam visaariththu a'riki'ratha'rku ivarka'laiyallaamal karththarudaiya theerkkatharisi vea'rea yaaraakilum ingkea illaiyaa en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu isravealin raajaa yoasapaaththai noakki: karththaridaththil visaariththu a'riki'ratha'rku imlaavin kumaaranaakiya mikaayaa ennum mat'roruvan irukki'raan; aanaalum naan avanaip pakaikki'rean; avan ennaikku'riththu nanmaiyaaka alla, theemaiyaakavea eppozhuthum theerkkatharisanam solluki'ravan en'raan. atha'rku yoasapaath: raajaavea, appadich sollavea'ndaam en'raan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa pirathaanika'lil oruvanaik kooppittu: imlaavin kumaaranaakiya mikaayaavaich seekkiramaay azhaiththuvaa en'raan.

isravealin raajaavum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththum, samaariyaavin olimuka vaasalukku munnirukkum visaalamaana idaththilea raajavasthiram thariththukko'ndavarka'laay, avaravar thamtham singkaasanaththilea udkaarnthirunthaarka'l; sakala theerkkatharisika'lum avarka'lukku munpaakath theerkkatharisanagnsonnaarka'l.
kenaanaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa thanakku iruppukkompuka'lai u'ndaakki, ivaika'laal neer seeriyarai mutti nirmoolamaakkippoaduveer en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
sakala theerkkatharisika'lum atha'rku isaivaakath theerkkatharisanagnsolli, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rkuppoam, umakku vaaykkum, karththar athai raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raarka'l.

mikaayaavai azhaikkappoana aa'l avanudanea peasi: ithoa, theerkkatharisika'lin vaarththaika'l eakavaakkaay raajaavukku nanmaiyaayirukki'rathu; ummudaiya vaarththaiyum avarka'lil oruvar vaarththaiyaippoala irukkumpadikku nanmaiyaakach sollum en'raan.
atha'rku mikaayaa: en theavan solvathaiyea solvean en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'raan.

avan raajaavinidaththil vanthapoathu, raajaa avanaip paarththu: mikaayaavea, naangka'l keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'nap poakalaamaa, poakalaakaathaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avan: poangka'l; ungka'lukku vaaykkum; ungka'l kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvaarka'l en'raan.
raajaa avanaip paarththu: nee karththarudaiya naamaththilea u'nmaiyai allaamal vea'ron'raiyum ennidaththil sollaathapadikku, naan eththanaitharam unnai aa'naiyiduvikkavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu avan: isravealar ellaarum meayppanillaatha aaduka'laippoala malaika'lil sitha'rappattathaik ka'ndean; appozhuthu karththar: ivarka'lukku ejamaan illai; avaravar thamtham veetti'rkuch samaathaanaththoadea thirumpakkadavarka'l en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa yoasapaaththai noakki: ivan ennaikku'riththu nanmaiyaaka alla, theemaiyaakavea theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ravan en'ru naan ummoadea sollavillaiyaa en'raan.

appozhuthu avan sonnathu: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; karththar thammudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'rathaiyum, parama seanaiyellaam avar valathupakkaththilum avar idathupakkaththilum ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndean.

appozhuthu karththar: isravealin raajaavaakiya aakaap keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththil poay vizhumpadikku, avanukkup poathanaiseyki'ravan yaar en'ru keattatha'rku, oruvan ippadiyum oruvan appadiyum sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu oru aavi pu'rappattuvanthu, karththarukku munpaaka nin'ru: naan avanukkup poathanaiseyvean en'rathu; ethinaal en'ru karththar athaik keattaar.

appozhuthu athu: naan poay, avanudaiya theerkkatharisika'l ellaarin vaayilum poyyin aaviyaay iruppean en'rathu. atha'rku avar: nee avanukkup poathanaiseythu appadi nadakkappa'n'nuvaay; poay appadiyea sey en'raar.
aanathinaal karththar poyyin aaviyai intha ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'lin vaayilea katta'laiyittaar; karththar ummaikku'riththuth theemaiyaakach sonnaar en'raan.
appozhuthu kenaanaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa kittea vanthu: mikaayaavaik kannaththil adiththu, karththarudaiya aavi enthavazhiyaay ennaivittu unnoadea peasumpadi vanthathu en'raan.
atha'rku mikaayaa: nee o'liththukko'l'la u'l'la'raiyilea pathungkum annaa'lilea athaik kaa'npaay en'raan.
appozhuthu isravealin raajaa: neengka'l mikaayaavaip pidiththu, avanaip patta'naththuth thalaivanaakiya aamoanidaththukkum, raajakumaaranaakiya yoavaasidaththukkum thirumpak ko'ndupoay,

avanaich si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththu, naan samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivaruma'lavum, avanukku idukkaththin appaththaiyum idukkaththin tha'n'neeraiyum saappidak kodungka'l en'ru raajaa sonnaar en'ru sollungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu mikaayaa: neer samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivanthaal, karththar ennaikko'ndu peasinathillai en'ru solli; janangka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum kea'lungka'l en'raan.
pinpu isravealin raajaavum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththum keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththukkup poanaarka'l.

isravealin raajaa yoasapaaththaip paarththu: naan veashamaa'ri yuththaththil piraveasippean; neeroa raajavasthiram thariththirum en'ru solli, isravealin raajaa veashamaa'ri yuththaththil piraveasiththaan.

seeriyaavin raajaa thanakku irukki'ra irathangka'lin thalaivarai noakki: neengka'l si'riyavaroadum periyavaroadum yuththampa'n'naamal, isravealin raajaa oruvanoadeamaaththiram yuththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittirunthaan.

aathalaal irathangka'lin thalaivar yoasapaaththaik kaa'nkaiyil, ivanthaan isravealin raajaa en'ru solli yuththampa'n'na avanaich soozhnthuko'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu yoasapaath kookkural ittaan; karththar avanukku anusaariyaayirunthaar; avarka'l avanai vittu vilakumpadi theavan seythaar.
ivan isravealin raajaa alla en'ru irathangka'lin thalaivar ka'ndapoathu avanaivittuth thirumpinaarka'l.

oruvan ninaiyaamal villai naa'neat'ri eythaan, athu isravealin raajaavinudaiya kavasaththin santhukkidaiyilea pattathu; appozhuthu avan than saarathiyaip paarththu: nee thiruppi ennai iraa'nuvaththukkappaal ko'ndupoa, enakkuk kaayampattathu en'raan.
an'raiyathinam yuththam athikariththathu; isravealin raajaa seeriyarukku ethiraaka irathaththil saayangkaalamattum nin'rirunthu, sooriyan asthamikkumpoathu i'ranthupoanaan.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaath, erusaleamilu'l'la than veetti'rkuch samaathaanaththoadea thirumpivanthaan.

appozhuthu anaaniyin kumaaranaakiya yekoo ennum gnaanathirushdikkaaran pu'rappattu, avanaich santhiththu, raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththai noakki: thunmaarkkanukkuth thu'nainin'ru, karththaraip pakaikki'ravarka'lai neer sineakikkalaamaa? ithinimiththam karththarudaiya kadungkoapam ummeal vara irunthathu.

aakilum neer vikkirakaththoappuka'lai theasaththai vittakat'ri, theavanaith theada ummudaiya iruthayaththai nearaakkina vishayaththil nanmaiyaana kaariyangka'l ummidaththilea kaa'nappattathu u'ndu en'raan.

yoasapaath erusaleamilea vaasamaayirunthu, thirumpap peyersepaathodangki, eppiraayeem malaiththeasamattumu'l'la janaththi'rku'l'lea pirayaa'namaayp poay, avarka'laith thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar idaththi'rkuth thirumpappa'n'ninaan.
avan yoothaavin ara'naana patta'nangka'laakiya ovvoru patta'naththilum niyaayaathipathika'lai vaiththu,

antha niyaayaathipathika'lai noakki: neengka'l seyki'ra kaariyaththaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; neengka'l manushanudaiya katta'laiyinaal alla, karththarudaiya katta'laiyinaal niyaayam visaarikki'reerka'l; niyaayam visaarikki'ra vishayaththilea avar ungka'ludanea irukki'raar.

aathalaal karththarukkup payappaduki'ra payam ungka'lidaththil irukkakkadavathu, echcharikkaiyaayirunthu kaariyaththai nadaththungka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththilea aniyaayamum mukathaadchi'niyamum illai, parithaanamum avaridaththilea sellaathu en'raan.

avarka'l erusaleamil vanthirukkumpoathu, yoasapaath leaviyarilum, aasaariyarilum, isravealudaiya vamsaththalaivarilum, silaraik karththarudaiya niyaayangka'laikku'riththum vivaathavishayangka'laik ku'riththum visaarikkumpadi erusaleamilea niyamiththu,
avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittathaavathu: neengka'l karththarukkup payanthu, u'nmaiyoadum uththama iruthayaththoadum nadanthu seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

naanaavitha iraththappazhich sangkathika'lum, piramaa'naththi'rkum, ka'rpanaikkum, katta'laika'lukkum, niyaayangka'lukkum aduththa naanaavitha vazhakkuch sangkathika'lum, thangka'l patta'nangka'lilea kudiyirukki'ra ungka'l sakoathararidaththilirunthu ungka'lidaththil varumpoathu, avarka'l karththarukku nearastharaakaathapadikkum, ungka'lmealum ungka'l sakoathararmealum kadungkoapam varaathapadikkum, neengka'l avarka'lai echchariyungka'l; neengka'l ippadich seythaal nearastharaakamaatteerka'l.

ithoa, aasaariyanaakiya amariyaa karththarukkaduththa ellaa niyaayaththilum, ismavealin kumaaranaakiya sepathiyaa ennum yoothaa vamsaththin thalaivan raajaavukkaduththa ellaa niyaayaththilum ungka'lukku mealaana niyaayaathipathika'l; leaviyarum ungka'l kaikku'l uththiyoakastharaayirukki'raarka'l; neengka'l thidamanathaayirunthu kaariyangka'lai nadaththungka'l, uththamanukkuk karththar thu'nai en'raan.
itha'rkuppinpu moavaap puththirarum, ammoan puththirarum, avarka'loadea ammoaniyarukku appu'raththilu'l'la manusharungkooda yoasapaaththi'rku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'na vanthaarka'l.

silar vanthu, yoasapaaththai noakki: umakku viroathamaay earaa'lamaana janangka'l kadalukku akkaraiyilirukki'ra seeriyaavilirunthu varuki'raarka'l; ithoa, avarka'l engkeathiyaakiya aasaasoanthaamaaril irukki'raarka'l en'ru a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoasapaath payanthu, karththaraith theaduki'ratha'rku orumukappattu, yoothaavengkum upavaasaththaik koo'ruviththaan.
appadiyea yoothaa janangka'l karththaridaththilea sakaayantheadak koodinaarka'l; yoothaavilu'l'la ellaap patta'nangka'lilum irunthu avarka'l karththaraith theadavanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoasapaath karththarudaiya aalayaththilea puthuppiraakaaraththu mukappilea, yoothaa janangka'lum erusaleamiyarum koodina sapaiyilea nin'ru:

engka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, paraloakaththilirukki'ra neer allavoa theavan; theavareer jaathika'ludaiya raajyangka'laiyellaam aa'luki'ravar; ummudaiya karaththilea vallamaiyum paraakkiramamum irukki'rathu, oruvarum ummoadu ethirththu ni'rkakkoodaathu.

engka'l theavanaakiya neer ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealukku munpaaka inthath theasaththuk kudika'laith thuraththivittu ithai ummudaiya sineakithanaakiya aapirakaamudaiya santhathikku en'raikkumen'ru kodukkavillaiyaa?
aathalaal avarka'l ingkea kudiyirunthu, ithilea ummudaiya naamaththi'rken'ru oru parisuththa sthalaththaik kattinaarka'l.

engka'lmeal pattayam, niyaayatha'ndanai, ko'l'lainoay, pagncham muthalaana theemaika'l vanthaal, appozhuthu ummudaiya naamam intha aalayaththil vi'langkuki'rapadiyaal, naangka'l intha aalayaththilum umathu sannithiyilum vanthu nin'ru, engka'l idukka'nil ummai noakkik kooppidukaiyil, theavareer keattu iradchippeer en'ru solliyirukki'raarka'l.

ippoathum, ithoa, isravealar ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varuki'rapoathu, ammoan puththirar, moavaapiyar, seayeer malaiththeasaththaarudaiya seemaika'l vazhiyaayp poaka neer uththaravu kodukkavillai; aakaiyaal avarka'lai vittu vilaki, avarka'lai naasappaduththaathirunthaarka'l.

ippoathum, ithoa, avarka'l engka'lukku nanmaikkuth theemaiyaich sarikkatti, theavareer engka'laich suthantharikkappa'n'nina ummudaiya suthantharaththilirunthu engka'laith thuraththivida varuki'raarka'l.

engka'l theavanea, avarka'lai neer niyaayantheerkkamaatteeroa? engka'lukku viroathamaaka vantha intha earaa'lamaana koottaththi'rku munpaaka ni'rka engka'lukkup pelanillai; naangka'l seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru engka'lukkuth theriyavillai; aakaiyaal engka'l ka'nka'l ummaiyea noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu en'raan.
yoothaa koaththiraththaar anaivarum, avarka'l kuzhanthaika'lum, avarka'l pe'njaathika'lum, avarka'l kumaararungkoodak karththarukku munpaaka nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu sapaiyin naduvilirukki'ra maththaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya eayelin makanaana penaayaavukkup pi'rantha sakariyaavin puththiran yakaasiyeal ennum aasaappin puththiraril oruvanaana leaviyanmeal karththarudaiya aavi i'rangkinathinaal avan sonnathu:

sakala yoothaa koaththiraththaarea, erusaleamin kudika'lea, raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththea, kea'lungka'l; neengka'l antha earaa'lamaana koottaththi'rkup payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum irungka'l en'ru karththar ungka'lukkuch solluki'raar; intha yuththam ungka'ludaiyathalla, theavanudaiyathu.

naa'laikku neengka'l avarka'lukku viroathamaayp poangka'l; ithoa, avarka'l sis ennum meattuvazhiyaay varuki'raarka'l; neengka'l avarka'lai yeruveal vanaantharaththi'rku ethiraana pa'l'laththaakkin kadaiyaantharaththilea ka'ndu santhippeerka'l.

intha yuththaththaip pa'n'nuki'ravarka'l neengka'l alla; yoothaa manusharea, erusaleam janangka'lea, neengka'l thariththunin'ru karththar ungka'lukkuch seyyum iradchippaip paarungka'l; payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum irungka'l; naa'laikku avarka'lukku ethiraakap pu'rappadungka'l; karththar ungka'loadea irukki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu yoasapaath tharaimattum mukangkuninthaan; sakala yoothaa koaththiraththaarum erusaleamin kudika'lum karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lak karththarukku munpaakath thaazhavizhunthaarka'l.
koakaaththiyarin puththirarilum koaraakiyarin puththirarilum iruntha leaviyar ezhunthirunthu, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai makaa saththaththoadea kempeeramaayth thuthiththaarka'l.

avarka'l athikaalamea ezhunthirunthu, thekkovaavin vanaantharaththi'rkup poakap pu'rappattaarka'l; pu'rappadukaiyil yoasapaath nin'ru: yoothaavea, erusaleamin kudika'lea, kea'lungka'l; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarai nampungka'l, appozhuthu nilaippaduveerka'l; avarudaiya theerkkatharisika'lai nampungka'l, appozhuthu siththipe'ruveerka'l en'raan.

pinpu avan janaththoadea aaloasanaipa'n'ni, parisuththamu'l'la makaththuvaththaith thuthikkavum, aayutham a'ninthavarka'lukku munnaaka nadanthupoay, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l, avar kirupai en'rum u'l'lathen'ru karththaraip paadavum, paadakarai ni'ruththinaan.

avarka'l paadith thuthiseyyath thodangkinapoathu, yoothaavukku viroathamaay vanthu pathiviruntha ammoan puththiraraiyum, moavaapiyaraiyum, seayeer malaiththeasaththaaraiyum, oruvarukku viroathamaay oruvaraik karththar ezhumpappa'n'ninathinaal avarka'l vettu'ndu vizhunthaarka'l.

eppadiyenil, ammoan puththirarum moavaapiyarum, seayeer malaiththeasak kudika'laich sangkarikkavum azhikkavum avarka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpinaarka'l; seayeer kudika'lai azhiththuth theernthapoathu, thaangka'lum thangka'lil oruvaraiyoruvar azhikkaththakkavithamaayk kaikalanthaarka'l.

yoothaa manushar vanaantharaththilu'l'la saamakkootta'ndaiyilea vanthu, antha earaa'lamaana koottamirukkum thikkai noakkuki'rapoathu, ithoa, avarka'l tharaiyilea vizhunthukidakki'ra pireathangka'laakak ka'ndaarka'l; oruvarum thappavillai.

yoasapaaththum avanudaiya janangka'lum avarka'l udaimaika'laik ko'l'laiyida vanthapoathu, avarka'l ka'nda earaa'lamaana poru'lka'lum pireathangka'lilirunthu urinthupoatta aadai aapara'nangka'lum, thaangka'l eduththukko'ndu poakakkoodaathirunthathu; moon'runaa'laayk ko'l'laiyittaarka'l; athu avva'lavu mikuthiyaayirunthathu.
naalaam naa'lil peraakkaavilea koodinaarka'l; angkea karththarukku sthoaththiram seluththinaarka'l; aathalaal avvidaththi'rku innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi peraakkaa ennum pear thariththaarka'l.

pinpu karththar avarka'lai avarka'l saththurukka'lpearil ka'likoorach seythapadiyaal yoothaa manushar yaavarum erusaleam janangka'lum, avarka'lukku munnaalea yoasapaaththum makizhchchiyoadea erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaarka'l.
avarka'l thampuruka'loadum surama'ndalangka'loadum poorikaika'loadum erusaleamilirukki'ra karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku vanthaarka'l.
karththar isravealin saththurukka'loadu yuththampa'n'ninaar en'ru kea'lvippatta anthanthath theasaththu raajyaththaarmeal theavanaal u'ndaana payangkaram vanthathu.
ivvithamaayth theavan sut'ruppu'raththaaraal yuththamillaatha i'laippaa'ruthalai avanukkuk katta'laiyittathinaal, yoasapaaththin raajyapaaram amarikkaiyaayirunthathu.

yoasapaath yoothaavai arasaa'ndaan; avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu, muppaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, irupaththainthu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; silkiyin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayinpear asupaa'l.
avan than thakappanaakiya aasaavin vazhiyilea nadanthu, athaivittu vilakaathirunthu, karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
aanaalum meadaika'l thakarkkappadavillai; janangka'l thangka'l iruthayaththaith thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanukku innum nearaakkaathirunthaarka'l.
yoasapaaththin aathiyanthamaana mat'ra varththamaanangka'l israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ka'ndirukki'ra aanaaniyin kumaaranaakiya yekoovin vasanangka'lil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
atha'rkuppinpu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoasapaath pollaappuch seyki'ravanaana akasiyaa ennum isravealin raajaavoadea thoazhamaipa'n'ninaan.
tharsheesukkup poakumpadikkuk kappalka'laich seyya avanoadea koodikko'ndaan; appadiyea esiyoankeapearilea kappalka'laich seythaarka'l.

mareasaa ooraanaakiya thothaavaavin kumaaranaana eliyeasar yoasapaaththukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam solli: neer akasiyaavoadea koodikko'ndapadiyinaal, karththar ummudaiya kiriyaika'lai mu'riththuppoattaar en'raan; anthak kappalka'l udainthupoayit'ru, avarka'l tharsheesukkup poakakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.
yoasapaath than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthu, thaaveethin nakaraththil than pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avan sthaanaththilea avan kumaaranaakiya yoaraam raajaavaanaan.

avanukku yoasapaaththin kumaararaakiya asariyaa, eakiyeal, sakariyaa, asariyaa, mikaaveal, seppaththiyaa ennum sakoatharar irunthaarka'l; ivarka'l ellaarum isravealin raajaavaakiya yoasapaaththin kumaarar.

avarka'ludaiya thakappan ve'l'liyum ponnum uchchithangka'lumaana aneakam nankodaika'laiyum, yoothaavilea ara'naana patta'nangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk koduththaan; yoaraam seashdapuththiranaanapadiyinaal, avanukku raajyaththaik koduththaan.

yoaraam than thakappanudaiya raajyapaaraththi'rku vanthu thannaip palappaduththikko'ndapinpu, avan thannudaiya sakoatharar ellaaraiyum isravealin pirapukka'lil silaraiyum pattayaththaal kon'rupoattaan.
yoaraam raajaavaaki'rapoathu, muppaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, ettu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.

avan israveal raajaakka'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, aakaapin veettaar seythathupoalach seythaan; aakaapin kumaaraththi avanukku manaiviyaayirunthaa'l; avan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

karththar thaaveethukkum avan kumaararukkum en'ren'raikkum oru vi'lakkaik katta'laiyiduvean en'ru solli, avanoadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyinimiththam thaaveethin vamsaththai azhikkach siththamillaathirunthaar.
avan naadka'lil yoothaavudaiya kaiyinkeezhiruntha eathoamiyar kalakampa'n'ni, thangka'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththikko'ndaarka'l.

athinaal yoaraam than pirapukka'loadum than sakala irathangka'loadum pu'rappattuppoanaan; avan iraaththiriyil ezhunthirunthu, thannai va'lainthuko'nda eathoamiyaraiyum irathangka'lin thalaivaraiyum mu'riya adiththaan.

aakilum yoothaavudaiya kaiyin keezhiruntha eathoamiyar innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rathupoala, kalakampa'n'nip pirinthaarka'l; avan than pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai vittapadiyinaal, akkaalaththilea leepnaa patta'naththaarum kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avan yoothaavudaiya malaika'linmeal meadaika'lai u'ndaakki, erusaleamin kudika'laich soarampoakappa'n'ni, yoothaavaiyum atha'rku eavivittaan.

appozhuthu theerkkatharisiyaakiya eliyaa ezhuthina oru nirupam avanidaththi'rku vanthathu; athil: ummudaiya thakappanaana thaaveethin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, nee un thakappanaakiya yoasapaaththin vazhika'lilum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aasaavin vazhika'lilum nadavaamal,

israveal raajaakka'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, aakaapudaiya kudumpaththin soaramaarkkaththi'rku oththapadiyea yoothaavaiyum erusaleamin kudika'laiyum soarampoakappa'n'ni, unnaippaarkkilum nallavarka'laayiruntha un thakappan veettaaraana un sakoathararaiyum kon'rupoattapadiyinaal,
ithoa, karththar un janaththaiyum, un pi'l'laika'laiyum, un manaivika'laiyum, unakku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum makaa vaathaiyaaka vaathippaar.
neeyoa unakku u'ndaakum kudal noayinaal un kudalka'l naa'lukkunaa'l it'ru vizhumattum kodiya viyaathiyinaal vaathikkappaduvaay en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.
appadiyea karththar pelistharin aaviyaiyum, eththiyoappiyaavukkaduththa theasaththaaraana arapiyarin aaviyaiyum yoaraamukku viroathamaaka ezhuppinaar.

avarka'l yoothaavil vanthu, palaathkaaramaayp pukunthu, raajaavin aramanaiyil akappatta ellaap poru'lka'laiyum, avan pi'l'laika'laiyum, avan manaivika'laiyum pidiththukko'ndupoanaarka'l; yoavaakaas ennum avan kumaararil i'laiyavanai allaamal oru kumaaranum avanukku meethiyaaka vaikkappadavillai.
ivaika'l ellaavat'ri'rkum pi'rpaadu karththar avan kudalka'lil u'ndaana theeraatha noayinaal avanai vaathiththaar.

appadi naa'lukkunaa'l irunthu, ira'ndu varusham mudiki'rakaalaththil avanukku u'ndaana noayinaal avan kudalka'l sarinthu kodiya viyaathiyinaal seththuppoanaan; avanudaiya pithaakka'lukkaakak kanthavarkkangka'laik ko'luththinathupoal, avanudaiya janangka'l avanukkaakak ko'luththavillai.

avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu muppaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, ettu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndu, virumpuvaarillaamal i'ranthupoanaan; avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; aanaalum raajaakka'lin kalla'raika'lil avanai vaikkavillai.

erusaleamin kudika'l, avan i'laiyakumaaranaakiya akasiyaavai avan sthaanaththil raajaavaakkinaarka'l; arapiyaroadea koodavanthu paa'layami'rangkina tha'ndilirunthavarka'l mooththakumaararaiyellaam kon'rupoattaarka'l; ivvithamaay akasiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoaraamin kumaaran arasaa'ndaan.
akasiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, oru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; omriyin kumaaraththiyaakiya avan thaayinpear aththaaliyaa'l.
avanum aakaap kudumpaththaarin vazhika'lil nadanthaan; thunmaarkkamaay nadakka, avanudaiya thaay avanukku aaloasanaikkaariyaayirunthaa'l.
avan aakaapin kudumpaththaaraippoal karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; avan thakappan sen'rupoanapinpu, avarka'l avanukkuk keadaaka avanudaiya aaloasanaikkaararaayirunthaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya aaloasanaikku udpattavanaay, avan isravealin raajaavaakiya yoaraam ennum aakaapin kumaaranoadeakooda, keeleayaaththilu'l'la raamoaththi'rkuch seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nappoanaan; angkea seeriyar yoaraamaik kaayappaduththinaarka'l.

appozhuthu thaan seeriyaavin raajaavaakiya aasakealoadu yuththampa'n'nukaiyil, thannai avarka'l raamaavilea vettina kaayangka'lai yesreyealilea aat'rikko'l'la avan thirumpinaan; appozhuthu aakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoaraam viyaathiyaayirunthapadiyinaal yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoaraamin kumaaran akasiyaa, yesreyealilirukki'ra avanaip paarkki'ratha'rkup poanaan.

akasiyaa yoaraamidaththukku vanthathu avanukkuth theavanaal u'ndaana keadaaka lapiththathu; eppadiyen'raal, avan vanthapoathu yoaraamudaneakooda, karththar aakaapin kudumpaththaaraich sangkarikka apisheakampa'n'nuviththa nimsiyin kumaaranaakiya yekoovukku nearaaka ve'liyea poanaan.
yekoo, aakaapin kudumpaththaarukku aakkinai nadappikkumpoathu, avan akasiyaavaich seavikki'ra yoothaavin pirapukka'laiyum, akasiyaavudaiya sakoathararin kumaararaiyum ka'ndupidiththuk kon'rupoattaan.

pinpu avan akasiyaavaith theadinaan; samaariyaavil o'liththukko'ndiruntha avanai avarka'l pidiththu, yekoovinidaththil ko'nduvanthu, avanaik kon'rupoattu: ivan than muzhu iruthayaththoadum karththaraith theadina yoasapaaththin kumaaran en'ru solli, avanai adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; appadiyea arasaa'luki'ratha'rkup pelanko'l'laththakka oruvarum akasiyaavin kudumpaththi'rku illaama'rpoayit'ru.
akasiyaavin thaayaakiya aththaaliyaa'l than kumaaran i'ranthupoanathaik ka'ndapoathu, ava'l ezhumpi, yoothaa kudumpaththilu'l'la raajavamsamaana yaavaraiyum sangkaarampa'n'ninaa'l.

raajaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya yoaseapiyaath, kon'rupoadappaduki'ra raajakumaararukku'l irukki'ra akasiyaavin aa'npi'l'laiyaakiya yoavaasaik ka'lavaayeduththukko'ndu, avanaiyum avan thaathiyaiyum sayanaveettilea vaiththaa'l; appadiyea aththaaliyaa'l avanaik kon'rupoadaathapadikku, raajaavaakiya yoaraamin kumaaraththiyum aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavin pe'njaathiyumaakiya yoaseapiyaath avanai o'liththuvaiththaa'l; ava'l akasiyaavin sakoathariyaayirunthaa'l.
ivarka'loadu avan aa'ruvarushamaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththilea o'liththuvaikkappattirunthaan; aththaaliyaa'l theasaththinmeal raajyapaarampa'n'ninaa'l.

eazhaam varushaththilea yoaythaa thidanko'ndu, noo'rupearukku athipathika'laakiya eroakaamin kumaaran asariyaavaiyum, yoakanaanin kumaaran ismavealaiyum, oapeathin kumaaran asariyaavaiyum, aathaayaavin kumaaran maaseyaavaiyum, sikriyin kumaaran elishaapaaththaiyum than udanpadikkaikku udpaduththinaan.
avarka'l yoothaavilea sut'riththirinthu, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilellaam irukki'ra leaviyaraiyum, isravealudaiya pithaakka'lin vamsaththalaivaraiyum koottikko'ndu erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l.

anthach sapaiyaar ellaarum theavanudaiya aalayaththil raajaavoadea udanpadikkai seythaarka'l; yoaythaa avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, karththar thaaveethin kumaararaikku'riththuch sonnapadiyea raajaavin kumaaran raajaavaaka vea'ndum.
neengka'l seyyavea'ndiya kaariyam ennaven'raal, ivvaaraththil, mu'raippadi varuki'ra aasaariyarum leaviyarumaana ungka'lil moon'ril orupangku olimukavaasalka'laiyum,
moon'ril orupangku raajaavin aramanaiyaiyum, moon'ril orupangku asthipaara vaasalaiyum kaakkavum, janangka'lellaam karththarudaiya aalayap piraakaarangka'lil irukkavum vea'ndum.

aasaariyarum leaviyaril oozhiyamseyki'ravarka'lum thavira, oruvarum karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasikkavea'ndaam; avarka'lea udpiraveasippaarka'laaka; avarka'l parisuththamaakkappattavarka'l; janangka'lellaarum karththarudaiya kaavalaik kaappaarka'laaka.

leaviyar avaravar thangka'l aayuthangka'laith thangka'l kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndavarka'laay, raajaavaich sut'rilum varisaiyaay nin'ruko'ndirukkavea'ndum; aalayaththukkudpaduki'ra evanum kolaiseyyappadakkadavan; raajaa udpiraveasikki'rapoathum ve'liyea pu'rappaduki'rapoathum neengka'l avaroadea irungka'l en'raan.

aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa katta'laiyittapadiyellaam leaviyarum yoothaakoaththiraththaar anaivarum seythu, avaravar avvaaraththu mu'raippadi varuki'ravarka'lum, mu'raitheernthu poaki'ravarka'lumaana thamtham manusharaik koottikko'ndupoanaarka'l; vakuppuka'l pirinthupoaka aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa uththaravukodukkavillai.
thaaveethuraajaa theavanudaiya aalayaththil vaiththiruntha eettika'laiyum keadakangka'laiyum parisaika'laiyum aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa noo'rupearukku athipathiyinidaththil koduththu,

avaravar thangka'l aayuthangka'laik kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndavarka'laay aalayaththin valathupakkanthodangki, aalayaththin idathupakkamattum, palipeedaththi'rkum aalayaththi'rkum ethirea raajaavaich sut'rilum ni'rka janangka'laiyellaam ni'ruththinaan.

pinpu raajakumaaranai ve'liyea ko'nduvanthu, kireedaththai avanmeal vaiththu, saadchiyin aakamaththai avan kaiyilea koduththu, avanai raajaavaakkinaarka'l; yoaythaavum avan kumaararum avanai apisheakampa'n'ni, raajaa vaazhka en'raarka'l.
janangka'l oadivanthu, raajaavaip pukazhuki'ra saththaththai aththaaliyaa'l keattapoathu, ava'l karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku janangka'lidaththil vanthu,

ithoa, nadaiyilu'l'la thannudaiya thoo'na'ndaiyilea raajaa ni'rki'rathaiyum, raajaava'ndaiyil ni'rki'ra pirapukka'laiyum, ekkaa'lam oothuki'ravarka'laiyum, theasaththu janangka'lellaarum santhoashappattu ekkaa'langka'l oothuki'rathaiyum, keethavaaththiyangka'laip pidiththukko'ndu paadakarum sangkeethaththalaivarum thuthikki'rathaiyum ka'ndaa'l; appozhuthu aththaaliyaa'l than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: thuroakam thuroakam en'ru koovinaa'l.

aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaa iraa'nuvaththalaivaraakiya noo'rupearukku athipathika'laanavarka'lai ve'liyea azhaiththu, avarka'lai noakki: iva'lai varisaikkup pu'rampea ko'ndupoangka'l; iva'laip pinpat'ruki'ravanaip pattayaththaal vettippoadungka'l en'raan. karththarin aalayaththilea ava'laik kon'rupoadaatheayungka'l en'ru aasaariyan solliyirunthaan.
avarka'l ava'lukku idamu'ndaakkinapoathu, ava'l raajaavin aramanaiyilirukki'ra kuthiraika'lin vaasalukku'l piraveasikkum idamattum poanaa'l; angkea ava'laik kon'rupoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoaythaa thaangka'l karththarudaiya janamaayirukkumpadikku, thaanum sakala janangka'lum raajaavum udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'l'lumpadi seythaan.

appozhuthu janangka'lellaarum paakaalin koavilukkup poay, athai idiththu, athin palipeedangka'laiyum, athin vikkirakangka'laiyum thakarththu, paakaalin poosaasaariyaakiya maaththaanaip palipeedangka'lukku munpaakak kon'rupoattaarka'l.

thaaveethu katta'laiyittapirakaaram santhoashaththoadum sangkeethaththoadum karththarin sarvaangka thakanapalika'lai moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea seluththaththakkathaaka, yoaythaa karththarudaiya aalayaththai visaarikkum uththiyoakangka'laith thaaveethu karththarudaiya aalayaththukken'ru pakuththuvaiththa leaviyaraana aasaariyarka'lin kaiyil oppuviththu,
yaathoru kaariyaththinaal theettuppattavan karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasiyaathapadikku, athin vaasalka'lukkuk kaavalaa'larai ni'ruththinaan.

noo'rupearukku athipathika'laiyum, periyavarka'laiyum, janaththai aa'luki'ravarka'laiyum, theasaththuch samastha janangka'laiyum koottikko'ndu, raajaavaik karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu i'rangkappa'n'ni, uyarntha vaasalvazhiyaay raaja aramanaikku'l azhaiththuvanthu arasaa'lum singkaasanaththinmeal raajaavai udkaarappa'n'ninaarka'l.
theasaththu janangka'lellaarum makizhnthaarka'l; aththaaliyaa'laip pattayaththaal kon'rapinpu nakaram amarikkaiyaayit'ru.
yoavaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu eazhuvayathaayirunthu, naa'rpathu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; peyersepaa patta'naththaa'laana avan thaayin pear sipiyaa'l.
aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavin naa'lellaam yoavaas karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
avanukku yoaythaa ira'ndu sthireeka'lai vivaakagnseythu koduththaan; avarka'laal kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raan.
atha'rkuppinpu karththarudaiya aalayaththaip puthuppikka yoavaas viruppangko'ndaan.

avan aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum koodivarachseythu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l yoothaa patta'nangka'lukkup pu'rappattuppoay, ungka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththai varushaavarusham pazhuthupaarkki'ratha'rku, isravealengkum pa'nam seakariyungka'l; inthak kaariyaththaith thaamathamillaamal seyyungka'l en'raan; aanaalum leaviyar thaamathampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa yoaythaa ennum thalaivanai azhaippiththu: saadchiyin vaasasthalaththukkuk kodukka, karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea katta'laiyitta variyai yoothaavinidaththilum, erusaleamiyaridaththilum, israveal sapaiyaaridaththilum vaangkivaruki'ratha'rku, leaviyarai neer visaariyaama'rpoanathenna?

anthap pollaatha sthireeyaakiya aththaaliyaa'ludaiya makka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththaip palavanthamaayth thi'ranthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththilu'l'la pirathishdai pa'n'nappattavaika'laiyellaam paakaalka'lukkaakach selavupa'n'nip poattaarka'lea en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaavin so'rpadi oru pettiyai u'ndaakki, athaik karththarudaiya aalayaththu vaasalukkup pu'rampea vaiththu,
karththarin thaasanaakiya moasea vanaantharaththil isravealukkuk katta'laiyitta variyaik karththarukkuk ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru yoothaavilum erusaleamilum pa'raisaat'ruviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu ellaap pirapukka'lum ellaa janangka'lum santhoashamaayk ko'nduvanthu pettini'raiya athilea poattaarka'l.

vekupa'nam u'nden'ru ka'ndu, leaviyar kaiyaal anthap petti raajaavin visaarippukkaarar a'ndaiyilea ko'nduvarappadumpoathu, raajaavin sampirathiyum pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya visaarippukkaaranum vanthu, pettiyilirukki'rathaik kottiyeduththu, athaith thirumpa athin sthaanaththilea vaippaarka'l; ippadi naa'lukkunaa'l seythu mikuntha pa'naththaich searththaarka'l.

athai raajaavum yoaythaavum karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai visaarikkum oozhiyakkaarar kaiyilea koduththaarka'l; athinaal avarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththaip puthuppikkumpadi, kalthachcharaiyum thachcharaiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkumpadi kot'raraiyum kannaaraiyum koolikku amarththikko'ndaarka'l.
appadi vealaiyai visaarikki'ravarka'l thangka'l kaiyinaalea vealaiyai nadanthea'rappa'n'ni, theavanudaiya aalayaththai athin munthina seerukkuk ko'nduvanthu athaip palappaduththinaarka'l.

athai mudiththuth theernthapinpu, meentha pa'naththai raajaavukkum yoaythaavukkum munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l; athinaalea karththarudaiya aalayaththil seyyappadum pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, aaraathanai pali muthaliyavaika'lukku vea'ndiya pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, kalasangka'laiyum, po'rpaaththirangka'laiyum, ve'l'lippaaththirangka'laiyum pa'n'nuviththaan; yoaythaavin naa'lellaam niththam karththarudaiya aalayaththilea sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththivanthaarka'l.
yoaythaa theerkkaayusu'l'lavanaay muthirvayathil mariththaan; avan mara'namadaiki'rapoathu noot'rumuppathu vayathaayirunthaan.
avan theavanukkaakavum avarudaiya aalayaththi'rkaakavum isravealukku nanmaiseythapadiyinaal, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil raajaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoaythaa mara'namadainthapinpu yoothaavin pirapukka'l vanthu, raajaavaip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu raajaa avarka'lukkuch sevikoduththaan.

appadiyea avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththai vittuvittu, thoappu vikkirakangka'laiyum silaika'laiyum seaviththaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'l seytha inthak kut'raththinimiththam yoothaavinmealum erusaleaminmealum kadungkoapam moo'ndathu.

avarka'laith thammidaththi'rkuth thirumpappa'n'nak karththar avarka'lidaththilea theerkkatharisika'lai anuppinaar; avarka'l janangka'laith thidachsaadchiyaakak kadinthuko'ndaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l sevikodukkavillai.

appozhuthu theavanudaiya aavi aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavin kumaaranaana sakariyaavinmeal i'rangkinathinaal, avan janaththi'rku ethirea nin'ru: neengka'l karththarudaiya ka'rpanaika'lai mee'ruki'rathu enna? ithinaal neengka'l siththipe'ramaatteerka'l en'ru theavan solluki'raar; neengka'l karththarai vittuvittathinaal avar ungka'laik kaividuvaar en'raan.
athinaal avarka'l avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, karththarudaiya aalayappiraakaaraththil raajaavinudaiya ka'rpanaiyinpadi avanaik kalle'rinthu kon'raarka'l.

appadiyea avanudaiya thakappanaakiya yoaythaa thanakkuch seytha thayaiyai raajaavaakiya yoavaas ninaiyaamal avanudaiya kumaaranaik kon'rupoattaan; ivan saakumpoathu: karththar athaip paarppaar, athaik keadpaar en'raan.

ma'ru varushaththilea seeriyaavin seanaika'l avanukku viroathamaaka yoothaavilum erusaleamilum vanthu, janaththilirukki'ra pirapukka'laiyellaam azhiththu, ko'l'laiyitta avarka'l udaimaika'laiyellaam thamaskuvin raajaavukku anuppinaarka'l.

seeriyaavin seanai si'rukoottamaay vanthirunthaalum, avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai vittuvittapadiyinaal, karththar makaa periya seanaiyai avarka'l kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarka'l yoavaasukku tha'ndanai seythaarka'l.

avarka'l avanai makaa veathanaikku'l'laanavanaaka vittuppoanaarka'l; avarka'l pu'rappattuppoanapinpu, avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar aasaariyanaakiya yoaythaavudaiya kumaararin iraththappazhiyinimiththam, avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, avan padukkaiyilea avanaik kon'rupoattaarka'l; seththuppoana avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; aanaalum raajaakka'lin kalla'raika'lil avanai vaikkavillai.
avanukku viroathamaakak kattuppaadupa'n'ninavarka'l, ammoaniya sthireeyaana seemaaththin kumaaranaakiya saapaaththum, moavaap sthireeyaana simreeththin kumaaranaakiya yoasapaaththumea.

avan kumaararaippat'riyum, avanmeal sumantha periya paaraththaippat'riyum, theavanudaiya aalayaththai avan palappaduththinathaippat'riyum raajaakka'lin pusthakamaana sariththiraththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; avan kumaaranaakiya amathsiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
amathsiyaa irupaththainthaam vayathilea raajaavaaki, irupaththonpathu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; erusaleam nakaraththaa'laakiya avanudaiya thaayinpear yoavathaanaa'l.
avan karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan; aanaalum muzhumanathoadea appadich seyyavillai.
raajyapaaram avanukku sthirappattapoathu, avan than thakappanaakiya raajaavaik kolaiseytha thannudaiya oozhiyakkaararaik kon'rupoattaan.

aanaalum pi'l'laika'linimiththam pithaakka'lum, pithaakka'linimiththam pi'l'laika'lum kolaiseyyappadaamal, avanavan seytha paavaththinimiththam avanavan kolaiseyyappadavea'ndumen'ru moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, karththar katta'laiyittapirakaaram, avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lai avan kollaathirunthaan.

amathsiyaa yoothaa manusharaik koodivarach seythu, avarka'l pithaakka'ludaiya vamsangka'linpadiyea, yoothaa penyameen theasangka'l engkum aayirampearukku athipathika'laiyum noo'rupearukku athipathika'laiyum vaiththu, irupathu vayathumutha'rko'ndu atha'rku mea'rpattavarka'lai ilakkampaarththu, yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadavum, eettiyaiyum keadakaththaiyum pidikkavunthakka yuththaveerar moon'ruladchampearen'ru ka'ndaan.
isravealilum ladcham paraakkiramasaalika'lai noo'ruthaalanthu ve'l'li koduththuk koolikku amarththinaan.
theavanudaiya manushan oruvan avanidaththil vanthu: raajaavea, isravealin seanai ummudanea varalaakaathu; karththar eppiraayeemin sakala puththiraraakiya isravealoadum irukkavillai.

poaka manathaanaal neer poam, kaariyaththai nadaththum; yuththaththi'rkuth thidanko'ndu nillum; theavan ummaich saththuruvukku munpaaka vizhappa'n'nuvaar; oththaasai seyyavum vizhappa'n'navum theavanaalea koodum en'raan.

appozhuthu amathsiyaa: appadiyaanaal naan isravealin seanaikkuk koduththa noo'ru thaalanthi'rkaakach seyyavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru theavanudaiya manushanaik keattaan. atha'rkuth theavanudaiya manushan: athaippaarkkilum athikamaayk karththar umakkuk kodukkakkoodum en'raan.

appozhuthu amathsiyaa eppiraayeemaril thannidaththukku vantha seanaiyaith thangka'l veetti'rkup poayvidap piriththuvittaan; athinaal avarka'lukku yoothaavinmeal mikuntha koapamoo'ndu, ukkiramaana erichchaloadea thangka'lidaththi'rkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.
amathsiyaavoa thidanko'ndu, than janaththaik kootti, uppup pa'l'laththaakkukkup poay, seayeer puththiraril pathinaayirampearai vettinaan.

yoothaa puththirar, pathinaayirampearai uyiroadu pidiththu, oru kanmalaiyuchchiyilea ko'ndupoay, avarka'lellaarum no'rungkippoakaththakkathaay anthak kanmalaiyuchchiyilirunthu keezhea tha'l'livittaarka'l.

thannoadukooda yuththaththi'rku varaathapadikku, amathsiyaa thiruppivitta yuththapurushar, samaariyaa thuvakkip peththoroanmattumu'l'la yoothaa patta'nangka'linmeal vizhunthu, avaika'lil moovaayirampearai vetti, thira'laayk ko'l'laiyittaarka'l.

amathsiyaa eathoamiyarai mu'riya adiththu, seayeer puththirarin theyvangka'laik ko'nduvanthapinpu, avan avaika'laith thanakkuth theyvangka'laaka vaiththu, avaika'lukku munpaakap pa'ninthu avaika'lukkuth thoopangkaattinaan.

appozhuthu, karththar amathsiyaavinmeal koapamoo'ndavaraaki, avanidaththukku oru theerkkatharisiyai anuppinaar; ivan avanai noakki: thangka'l janaththai umathu kaikkuth thappuvikkaatheapoana janaththin theyvangka'lai neer naaduvaanean en'raan.

thannoadea avan ippadip peasinapoathu, raajaa avanai noakki: unnai raajaavukku aaloasanaikkaaranaaka vaiththaarka'loa? athai vittuvidu; nee ean vettappadavea'ndum en'raan; appozhuthu anthath theerkkatharisi athai vittuvittu: neer ippadich seythu, en aaloasanaiyaik kea'laama'rpoanapadiyinaal, theavan ummai azhikka yoasanaiyaayirukki'raar enpathai a'rivean en'raan.

pinpu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaa yoasanaipa'n'ni, yekoovin kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaasin puththiran yoavaas ennum isravealin raajaavukku: nammudaiya saamarththiyaththaip paarppoam vaa en'ru solliyanuppinaan.

atha'rku isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas yoothaavin raajaavaakiya amathsiyaavukku aa'l anuppi: leepanoanilu'l'la mudchediyaanathu leepanoanilu'l'la keathurumaraththai noakki: nee un maka'lai en makanukku manaiviyaaka vivaakagnseythu kodu en'ru keadkachsollit'ru; aanaalum leepanoanilu'l'la oru kaattumirukam antha vazhi poakaiyil oadi antha mudchediyai mithiththuppoattathu.

nee eathoamiyarai adiththaay en'ru perumaipaaraatta un iruthayam unnaik karvangko'l'lappa'n'ninathu; ippoathum nee un veettilea iru; neeyum unnoadea yoothaavumkooda vizhumpadikku, pollaappaith theadikko'lvaanean en'ru sollachsonnaan.
aanaalum amathsiyaa sevikodaatheapoanaan; avarka'l eathoamin theyvangka'lai naadinathinimiththam avarka'lai avarka'l saththurukka'l kaiyil oppukkodukkumpadikkuth theavanaalea ippadi nadanthathu.
appadiyea isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas vanthaan; yoothaavilirukki'ra pethshimeasilea avanum, amathsiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaavum thangka'l saamarththiyaththaip paarththaarka'l.
yoothaa isravealukku munpaaka mu'rinthu, avaravar thangka'l koodaarangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l.

isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaas akasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaasukkup pi'rantha amathsiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaavaip pethshimeasilea pidiththu, avanai erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthu, erusaleamin alangkaththilea eppiraayeem vaasalthodangki moolaivaasalmattum naanoo'rumuzha nee'lam idiththuppoattu,

theavanudaiya aalayaththil oapeath eathoamin vasaththilea akappatta sakala ponnaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, raajaavin aramanaip pokkishangka'laiyum, kiriyiruppavarka'laiyum, pidiththukko'ndu samaariyaavukkuth thirumpippoanaan.
yoavaakaasin kumaaranaakiya yoavaas ennum isravealin raajaa mara'namadainthapinpu, yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya amathsiyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaa pathinainthu varusham uyiroadirunthaan.
amathsiyaavin aathiyoadantha nadapadiyaana mat'ra varththamaanangka'l yoothaa israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

amathsiyaa karththarai vittup pinvaangkina kaalamutha'rko'ndu erusaleamilirunthavarka'l avanukku viroathamaakak kattuppaadu pa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l; athinimiththam avan laakeesukku oadippoanaan; aanaalum avan pi'rakea laakeesukku manusharai anuppinaarka'l; avarka'l angkea avanaik kon'rupoattu,
kuthiraika'lmeal avanai eduththuvanthu, yoothaavin nakaraththil avan pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoothaa janangka'l ellaarum pathinaa'ru vayathaana usiyaavai azhaiththuvanthu, avanai avan thakappanaakiya amathsiyaavin sthaanaththilea raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
raajaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, ivan ealoathaik katti, athaith thirumpa yoothaavin vasamaakkikko'ndaan.
usiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu, pathinaa'ru vayathaayirunthu, aimpaththira'ndu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; erusaleam nakaraththaa'laana avan thaayinpear ekkoaliyaa'l.
avan than thakappanaakiya amathsiyaa seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythu,

theavanudaiya tharisanangka'lil puththimaanaayiruntha sakariyaavin naadka'lilea theavanaith theada manathi'nangkiyirunthaan; avan karththaraith theadina naadka'lil theavan avan kaariyangka'lai vaaykkachseythaar.

avan pu'rappattuppoay, pelistharoadu yuththampa'n'ni, kaaththin alangkaththaiyum, yapneayin alangkaththaiyum, asthoaththin alangkaththaiyum idiththuppoattu, asthoath naattilum pelistharukku'l'lum patta'nangka'laik kattinaan.
pelistharaiyum koorpaakaalilea kudiyirukki'ra arapiyaraiyum mekuniyaraiyum vella, theavan avanukkuth thu'nainin'raar.
ammoaniyar usiyaavukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laik koduththaarka'l; avanudaiya keerththi ekipthin ellaimattum ettinathu; avan mikavum pelangko'ndaan.
usiyaa erusaleamilea moolaivaasalmealum, pa'l'laththaakku vaasalmealum, alangkaththuk koadika'lmealum koapurangka'laik katti avaika'laip palappaduththinaan.

avanukkup pa'l'laththaakkilum samapoomiyilum aneakam aadumaaduka'lum, malaika'lileayum vayalve'liyileayum payirkkudika'lum, thiraadchaththoattakkaararum u'ndaayirunthapadiyinaal, avan vanaantharaththilea koapurangka'laik katti, aneaka thuravuka'lai vettinaan; avan ve'l'laa'nmaip piriyanaayirunthaan.

usiyaavukku yuththaveerarin seanaiyum irunthathu; athu sampirathiyaakiya eayelinaalum aathikkakkaaranaakiya maaseayaavinaalum ilakkampaarkkappattapadiyea, raajaavin pirapukka'lil oruvanaakiya ananiyaavinkeezh vakuppu vakuppaaych seavakampa'n'nap pu'rappattathu.
paraakkiramasaalika'laana vamsaththalaivarin thokaiyellaam ira'ndaayiraththu a'runoo'ru.
ivarka'l kaiyinkeezhch saththurukka'lukku viroathamaaka raajaavukkuth thu'naini'rka, paraakkiramaththoadea yuththampa'n'nuki'ra moon'ruladchaththu eazhaayiraththu ainnoo'rupearaana seanai irunthathu.
inthach seanaiyilu'l'lavarukkellaam usiyaa keadakangka'laiyum, eettika'laiyum, thalaichseeraakka'laiyum, maarkkavasangka'laiyum, villuka'laiyum, kalle'riki'ra kava'nka'laiyum aayaththappaduththinaan.

koapurangka'lmealum alangkakkoadika'lmealum nin'ru ampuka'laiyum periya ka'rka'laiyum pirayoakikki'ratha'rku nipu'naraana thozhilaa'lika'l ka'rpiththa yanthirangka'laiyum avan erusaleamil u'ndaakkinaan; appadiyea avan keerththi vekuthooram parampit'ru; avan palappadumattum aachchariyamaay avanukku anukoolamu'ndaayit'ru.

avan palappattapoathu, thanakkuk keadu'ndaakumattum, avanudaiya manam meattimaiyaaki, than theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaaka mee'ruthal seythu, thoopapeedaththinmeal thoopangkaattak karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasiththaan.
aasaariyanaakiya asariyaavum, avanoadeakoodak karththarin aasaariyaraana paraakkiramasaalika'laakiya e'npathupearum, avan pi'rakea udpiraveasiththu,

raajaavaakiya usiyaavoadu ethirththunin'ru: usiyaavea, karththarukkuth thoopangkaattuki'rathu umakku aduththathalla; thoopangkaattuki'rathu parisuththamaakkappatta aaroanin kumaararaakiya aasaariyarukkea adukkum; parisuththa sthalaththai vittu ve'liyea poam; mee'ruthal seytheer; ithu theavanaakiya karththaraalea umakku meanmaiyaaka lapiyaathu en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu usiyaa koapangko'ndaan; avan thoopakalasaththaith than kaiyilea pidiththu, aasaariyaroadea koapamaayp peasuki'rapoathu, aasaariyarukku munpaakak karththarudaiya aalayaththilea thoopapeedaththin munni'rki'ra avanudaiya net'riyilea kushdaroakam thoan'rit'ru.

pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya asariyaavum sakala aasaariyarum avanaip paarkkumpoathu, ithoa, avan than net'riyilea kushdaroakam pidiththavanen'ruka'ndu, avanaith theeviramaay angkeayirunthu ve'lippadappa'n'ninaarka'l; karththar thannai adiththathinaal avan thaanum ve'liyea poakath theevirappattaan.

raajaavaakiya usiyaa than mara'nanaa'lmattum kushdaroakiyaayirunthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup pu'rampaakkappattapadiyinaal, oru thaniththa veettilea kushdaroakiyaay vaasampa'n'ninaan; avan kumaaranaakiya yoathaam raajaavin aramanai visaarippukkaaranaayirunthu, theasaththin janangka'lai niyaayam visaariththaan.
usiyaavin aathiyoadantha nadapadiyaana mat'ra varththamaanangka'lai aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa ennum theerkkatharisi ezhuthinaan.

usiyaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, janangka'l avanaik kushdaroakiyen'ru solli, avanai avan pithaakka'la'ndaiyil, raajaakka'lai adakkampa'n'nuki'ra idaththi'rku arukaana nilaththilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya yoathaam avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
yoathaam raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, pathinaa'ru varusham erusaleamilea arasaa'ndaan; saathoakkin kumaaraththiyaakiya avan thaayinpear erusaa'l.

avan than thakappanaakiya usiyaa seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan; aanaalum avanaippoalak karththarin aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasiyaathirunthaan; janangka'l innum thangka'laik keduththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
avan karththarudaiya aalayaththin uyarntha vaasalaik kattinathumallaamal, oapealin mathilinmeal aneaka kattadangka'laiyum kattinaan.
yoothaavin malaika'lilea patta'nangka'laiyum, kaaduka'lilea koattaika'laiyum koapurangka'laiyum kattinaan.

avan ammoan puththirarudaiya raajaavoadu yuththampa'n'ni avarka'lai mea'rko'ndaan; aathalaal ammoan puththirar avanukku antha varushaththilea noo'ruthaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, pathinaayirangkalak koathumaiyaiyum, pathinaayirangkala vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum koduththaarka'l; ira'ndaam moon'raam varushaththilum ammoan puththirar appadiyea avanukkuch seluththinaarka'l.
yoathaam than vazhika'laith than theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka nearaakkinathinaal palappattaan.
yoathaamin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avanudaiya sakala yuththangka'lum, avanudaiya nadaika'lum, israveal yoothaa raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
avan raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, pathinaa'ru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.
yoathaam than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, avanaith thaaveethin nakaraththilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya aakaas avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

aakaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupathu vayathaayirunthu, pathinaa'ru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; aanaalum avan, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethaippoal, karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seyyaamal,
israveal raajaakka'lin vazhika'lil nadanthu, paakaalka'lukku vaarppu vikkirakangka'laich seythaan.

avan innoam kumaararin pa'l'laththaakkilea thoopangkaatti, karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththina jaathika'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadiyea than kumaararai akkiniyilea thakiththuppoattu,
meadaika'lilum, malaika'lilum, pachchaiyaana sakala marangka'lin keezhum paliyittuth thoopangkaattivanthaan.

aakaiyaal avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththar avanaich seeriyarudaiya raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarka'l avanai mu'riya adiththu, avanukku irukki'ravarka'lilea periya koottaththaich si'raipidiththuth thamaskuvukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; avan isravealudaiya raajaavin kaiyilum oppukkodukkappattaan; ivan avanai vekuvaay mu'riya adiththaan.

eppadiyenil, yoothaa manushar thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai vittapadiyinaal, remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaa avarka'lil oreanaa'lil ladchaththirupathinaayirampearaik kon'rupoattaan; avarka'l ellaarum makaa veeraraayirunthavarka'l.

an'riyum eppiraayeemin paraakkiramasaaliyaana sikriyum, raajaavin kumaaranaakiya maaseayaavaiyum, aramanaith thalaivanaakiya asrikkaamaiyum, raajaavukku ira'ndaavathaana elkkaanaavaiyum kon'rupoattaan.

israveal puththirar thangka'l sakoathararil ira'ndu ladchampearaakiya sthireeka'laiyum kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum si'raipidiththu, avarka'ludaiya aneaka thiraviyangka'laik ko'l'laiyittu, ko'l'laipporu'laich samaariyaavukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

angkea oatheath ennum pearu'l'la karththarudaiya theerkkatharisi oruvan irunthaan; avan samaariyaavukku varuki'ra seanaikku ethiraakap poay, avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar yoothaavinmeal koapangko'ndapadiyinaal avarka'lai ungka'l kaika'lil oppukkoduththaar; neengka'loa vaanapariyantham ettuki'ra ukkiraththoadea avarka'laich sangkaarampa'n'nineerka'l.

ippoathum yoothaavin puththiraraiyum erusaleamiyaraiyum neengka'l ungka'lukku vealaikkaararaakavum vealaikkaarika'laakavum keezhppaduththavea'ndum en'ru ninaikki'reerka'l; aanaalum ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaana kut'rangka'l ungka'lidaththilum illaiyoa?

aathalaal neengka'l enakkuch sevikoduththu, neengka'l ungka'l sakoathararidaththil si'raipidiththukko'nduvanthavarka'laith thirumpa anuppividungka'l; karththarudaiya ukkiramaana koapam ungka'lmeal irukki'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu eppiraayeem puththirarin thalaivaril silapearaakiya yoakanaanin kumaaran asariyaavum, meshilemoaththin kumaaran perakiyaavum, salloomin kumaaran ekiskiyaavum, athlaayin kumaaran amaasaavum yuththaththilirunthu vanthavarka'lukku viroathamaaka ezhumpi,

avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l si'raipidiththa ivarka'lai ingkea u'l'lea ko'nduvaravea'ndaam; nammeal thira'laana kut'ramum, isravealinmeal ukkiramaana koapamum irukkaiyil, neengka'l karththarukku munpaaka nammeal kut'ram sumarappa'n'naththakkathaay, nammudaiya paavangka'laiyum nammudaiya kut'rangka'laiyum athikamaakka ninaikki'reerka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu aayuthapaa'nika'laanavarka'l si'raipidiththavarka'laiyum, ko'l'laiyudaimaika'laiyum, pirapukka'lukku munpaakavum samastha sapaikku munpaakavum vittuvittaarka'l.

appozhuthu pear ku'rikkappatta manushar ezhumpi, si'raipidikkappattavarka'laich searththukko'ndu, avarka'lil vasthiramillaatha sakalarukkum ko'l'laiyil edukkappatta vasthirangka'laik koduththu, uduppaiyum paatharadchaika'laiyum poaduviththu, avarka'lukkuch saappidavum kudikkavum koduththu, avarka'lukku e'n'ney vaarththu, avarka'lil paladchayamaanavarka'laiyellaam kazhuthaika'lmeal eat'ri, peareechchamarangka'lin patta'namaakiya erikoavilea avarka'l sakoathararidaththukkuk ko'nduvanthu vittu, samaariyaavukkuth thirumpinaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea aakaas ennum raajaa, aseeriyaavin raajaakka'l thanakku oththaasaipa'n'na avarka'lidaththukku aadka'lai anuppinaan.
eathoamiyarum koodavanthu, yoothaavai mu'riya adiththu, silaraich si'raipidiththup poayirunthaarka'l.

pelistharum yoothaavilea samapoomiyilum the'rkeayum irukki'ra patta'nangka'linmeal vizhunthu, pethshimeasaiyum, aayaloanaiyum, ketheroaththaiyum, sokkoavaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum, thimnaavaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum, kimsoavaiyum athin kiraamangka'laiyum pidiththu angkea kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya aakaasinimiththam karththar yoothaavaith thaazhththinaar; avan yoothaavaich seerkulaiththu, karththarukku viroathamaay mikavum thuroakampa'n'ninaan.
aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya thilkaathpilneasar avanidaththil vanthaan; avanai nerukkinaanea allaamal avanaip palappaduththavillai.
aakaas karththarudaiya aalayaththil oru pangkum, raaja aramanaiyil oru pangkum, pirapukka'lin kaiyil oru pangkum eduththu, aseeriyaavin raajaavukkuk koduththum, avanukku uthavikidaikkavillai.
thaan nerukkappaduki'ra kaalaththilum karththarukku viroathamaay antha aakaas ennum raajaa thuroakampa'n'nikko'ndea irunthaan.

eppadiyen'raal: seeriyaa raajaakka'lin theyvangka'l avarka'lukkuth thu'nai seyki'rapadiyinaal, avarka'l enakkum thu'naiseyya avarka'lukkup paliyiduvean en'ru solli, thannai mu'riya adiththa thamaskuvin theyvangka'lukku avan paliyittaan; aanaalum athu avanum israveal anaiththum naasamaaki'ratha'rku eathuvaayit'ru.

aakaas theavanudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'laich searththu, theavanudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'laith thu'nduthu'ndaakki, karththarudaiya aalayaththin kathavuka'laip poottippoattu, erusaleamil moolaikkumoolai palipeedangka'lai u'ndupa'n'ni,
anniya theyvangka'lukkuth thoopangkaattumpadikku, yoothaavin ovvoru patta'naththilum meadaika'lai u'ndupa'n'ni, than pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarukkuk koapamoottinaan.
avanudaiya mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avanudaiya aathiyoadanthamaana sakala nadapadika'lum yoothaa israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

aakaas than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, avanai erusaleam nakaraththil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; aanaalum israveal raajaakka'lin kalla'raika'lil avanaik ko'nduvanthu vaikkavillai; avan kumaaranaakiya eseakkiyaa avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
eseakkiyaa irupaththainthaam vayathil raajaavaaki, irupaththonpathu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan; sakariyaavin kumaaraththiyaakiya avanudaiya thaayinpear apiyaa'l.
avan than thakappanaakiya thaaveethu seythapadiyellaam karththarin paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythaan.
avan than raajyapaaraththin muthalaam varusham muthalaam maathaththil karththarudaiya aalayaththin kathavuka'laith thi'ranthu, avaika'laip pazhuthupaarththu,
aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum azhaiththuvanthu, avarka'laik kizhakku veethiyilea koodivarachseythu,

avarka'lai noakki: leaviyarea, kea'lungka'l; neengka'l ippoathu ungka'laip parisuththam pa'n'nikko'ndu, ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarudaiya aalayaththaip parisuththampa'n'ni, asuththamaanathaip parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu ve'liyea ko'ndupoangka'l.

nammudaiya pithaakka'l thuroakampa'n'ni, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, avarai vittu vilaki, thangka'l mukangka'laik karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththai vittuth thiruppi, atha'rku muthukaik kaattinaarka'l.

avarka'l parisuththasthalaththil isravealin theavanukkuch sarvaangka thakanapali seluththaamalum, thoopangkaattaamalum, vi'lakkuka'lai a'naiththuppoattu, ma'ndapaththin kathavuka'laiyum poottippoattaarka'l.

aakaiyaal karththarudaiya kadungkoapam yoothaavinmealum erusaleaminmealum vanthu, avar ivarka'lai, neengka'l ungka'l ka'nka'linaal kaa'nki'rapadi, thuyaraththukkum thikaippukkum pazhippukkum oppukkoduththaar.
ithoa, ithinimiththam nammudaiya pithaakka'l pattayaththinaal vizhunthu, nammudaiya kumaararum nammudaiya kumaaraththika'lum nammudaiya manaivika'lum si'raiyiruppil akappattaarka'l.
ippoathum isravealin theavanaakiya karththarudaiya ukkirakoapam nammaivittuth thirumpumpadikku, avaroadea udanpadikkaipa'n'na en manathilea nir'nayiththukko'ndean.

en kumaararea, ippozhuthu asathiyaayiraatheayungka'l; neengka'l karththarukkup pa'nividai seyyumpadi avarukku munpaaka ni'rkavum, avarukku oozhiyagnseyki'ravarka'lum thoopangkaattuki'ravarka'lumaayirukkavum ungka'lai avar therinthuko'ndaar en'raan.

appozhuthu koakaath puththiraril amaasaayin kumaaran maakaaththum, asariyaavin kumaaran yoavealum, meraariyin puththiraril apthiyin kumaaran keesum, ekalealin kumaaran asariyaavum, kersoaniyaril simmaavin kumaaran yoavaakum, yoavaakin kumaaran eatheanum,
elichsaappaan puththiraril simriyum, eayelum, aasaappin puththiraril sakariyaavum, maththaniyaavum,
eamaanin puththiraril ekiyealum, simeayiyum, ethuththoonin puththiraril semaayaavum, oosiyealum aakiya intha leaviyar ezhumpi,

thangka'l sakoathararaik koodivarachseythu, parisuththampa'n'nikko'ndu, karththarudaiya vasanangka'lukkoththa raajaavinudaiya ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea karththarudaiya aalayaththaich suththikarikka vanthaarka'l.

aasaariyarka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththaich suththikarikkumpadi udpu'raththilea piraveasiththu, karththarudaiya aalayaththil ka'nda sakala asuththaththaiyum ve'liyea karththarudaiya aalayappiraakaaraththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; appozhuthu leaviyar athai eduththu, ve'liyea keetharoan aat'ri'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

muthal maatham muthal theathiyilea avarka'l parisuththampa'n'naththuvakki, ettaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya ma'ndapaththilea piraveasiththu, karththarudaiya aalayaththai ettunaa'lil parisuththampa'n'ni, muthalaam maatham pathinaa'raam theathiyil athai mudiththaarka'l.

avarka'l raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavinidaththil poay: naangka'l karththarin aalayaththaiyum, sarvaangka thakanapalipeedaththaiyum, athinudaiya sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, samukaththappangka'lin meajaiyaiyum, athin sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum suththikariththu,

raajaavaakiya aakaas arasaa'lumpoathu thammudaiya paathakaththinaal e'rinthupoatta sakala pa'nimuttuka'laiyum musthippaakkip parisuththampa'n'ninoam; ithoa, avaika'l karththarin aalayaththi'rku munpaaka irukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa kaalamea ezhunthirunthu, nakaraththin pirapukka'laik koottikko'ndu, karththarin aalayaththi'rkup poanaan.

appozhuthu raajyapaaraththi'rkaakavum parisuththa sthalaththi'rkaakavum yoothaavukkaakavum eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum, eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, eazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum, eazhu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum paavanivaara'napaliyaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avaika'laik karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal paliyidungka'l en'ru avan aasaariyaraakiya aaroanin puththirarukkuch sonnaan.

appadiyea aasaariyar kaa'laika'lai adiththu, antha iraththaththaip pidiththup palipeedaththinmeal the'liththaarka'l; aattukkadaakka'lai adiththu, avaika'lin iraththaththaip palipeedaththinmeal the'liththaarka'l; aattukkuttika'laiyum adiththu, avaika'lin iraththaththaiyum palipeedaththinmeal the'liththaarka'l.
pi'rpaadu paavanivaara'na palikkaana ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lai raajaavukkum sapaiyaarukku munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avaika'lmeal avarka'l thangka'l kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l.

israveal anaiththi'rkaakavum, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum paavanivaara'na paliyaiyum seluththungka'l en'ru raajaa solliyirunthaan; aathalaal aasaariyar avaika'lai adiththu, israveal anaiththi'rkum paavanivirththi u'ndaakka, avaika'lin iraththaththaal palipeedaththinmeal piraayachchiththagnseythaarka'l.

avan, thaaveethum, raajaavin gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya kaaththum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya naaththaanum ka'rpiththapadiyea, kaiththaa'langka'laiyum thampuruka'laiyum surama'ndalangka'laiyum vaasikki'ra leaviyaraik karththarudaiya aalayaththilea ni'ruththinaan; ippadich seyyavea'ndum enki'ra ka'rpanai karththaraal avarudaiya theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu u'ndaayirunthathu.
appadiyea leaviyar thaaveethin keethavaaththiyangka'laiyum, aasaariyar poorikaika'laiyum pidiththu nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu eseakkiyaa sarvaangka thakanapalika'laip palipeedaththinmeal seluththak katta'laiyittaan; athaich seluththath thuvakkina nearaththil karththaraith thuthikkum keethamum poorikaika'lum, israveal raajaavaakiya thaaveethu ea'rpaduththina keethavaaththiyangka'lum muzhangkath thodangkinathu.
keethaththaippaadi, poorikaika'lai oothikko'ndirukkaiyil, sarvaangka thakanapaliyaich seluththith theerumattum sapaiyaar ellaarum pa'ninthuko'ndirunthaarka'l.
paliyittuth theernthapoathu, raajaavum avanoadiruntha anaivarum thalaikuninthu pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.

pinpu eseakkiyaa raajaavum pirapukka'lum leaviyarai noakki: neengka'l thaaveethum gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya aasaapum paadina vaarththaika'linaal karththaraith thuthiyungka'l en'raarka'l; appozhuthu makizhchchiyoadea thuthiseythu thalaikuninthu pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.

athinpinpu eseakkiyaa: ippoathum neengka'l karththarukken'ru ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'nineerka'l; aakaiyaal kittavanthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkuth thakanapalika'laiyum sthoaththirapalika'laiyum ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan; appozhuthu sapaiyaar thakanapalika'laiyum sthoaththirapalika'laiyum, ishdamu'l'lavarka'lellaam sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
sapaiyaar ko'nduvantha sarvaangka thakanapalika'lin thokai ezhupathu kaa'laika'lum, noo'ru aattukkadaakka'lum, irunoo'ru aattukkuttika'lumea; ivaika'lellaam karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanamaayina.
a'runoo'ru kaa'laika'lum moovaayiram aaduka'lum pirathishdaiyaakkappattathu.

aanaalum aasaariyarka'l kogncham pearaanathinaal avarka'laal anthach sarvaangka thakanamaana jeevanka'laiyellaam adiththuth thoalurikka mudiyaathirunthathu; athinaalea antha vealai theerumattaakavum, mat'ra aasaariyar thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'numattaakavum, avarka'l sakoathararaakiya leaviyar avarka'lukku uthaviseythaarka'l; thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'la leaviyar aasaariyaraippaarkkilum mana u'rchaakamu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.

sarvaangka thakanapalika'lum, sthoaththirapalika'lin kozhuppum, sarvaangka thakanangka'lukkaduththa paanapalika'lum mikuthiyaayirunthathu; ivvithamaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththin aaraathanai thittampa'n'nappattathu.
theavan janaththai aayaththappaduththinathaikku'riththu eseakkiyaavum janangka'l ellaarum santhoashappattaarka'l; inthak kaariyaththaich seyyumpadiyaana yoasanai saduthiyaay u'ndaayit'ru.

athanpinpu isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikkumpadi, erusaleamil irukki'ra karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku vaarungka'l en'ru eseakkiyaa israveal yoothaa engkum aadka'lai anuppinathum an'ri, eppiraayeem manaasea koaththirangka'lukkum nirupangka'lai ezhuthiyanuppinaan.
paskaavai ira'ndaam maathaththil aasarikkumpadi, raajaavum avanudaiya pirapukka'lum erusaleamilu'l'la sapaiyaar yaavarum yoasanaipa'n'niyirunthaarka'l.
aasaariyar poathumaanapear thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'naamalum, janangka'l erusaleamil innum koodivaraamalum irunthapadiyinaal, athin kaalaththil athai aasarikkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.
inthak kaariyam raajaavin paarvaikkum samastha sapaiyin paarvaikkum niyaayamaayk kaa'nappattathu.

ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi vekukaalamaay avarka'l athai aasarikkavillai; aakaiyaal isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukkup paskaavai aasarikkumpadi erusaleamukku vaarungka'l en'ru peyersepaamuthal thaa'nmattumu'l'la israveal theasamengkum pa'raisaat'ruvikkath theermaanampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appadiyea raajaavum avanudaiya pirapukka'lum koduththa nirupangka'lai agnchalkaarar vaangki, raajaavudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea israveal yoothaa engkumpoay: israveal puththirarea, aapirakaam eesaakku israveal enpavarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththaridaththukkuth thirumpungka'l; appozhuthu aseeriyarudaiya raajaakka'lin kaikkuth thappiyirukki'ra meethiyaana ungka'la'ndaikku avar thirumpuvaar.

thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarukkuth thuroakampa'n'nina ungka'l pithaakka'laippoalavum ungka'l sakoathararaippoalavum iraatheayungka'l; atha'rkaaka, neengka'l kaa'nki'rapadiyea, avarka'l paazhaayppoaki'ratha'rku oppukkoduththaarea.

ippoathum ungka'l pithaakka'laippoala ungka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththaatheayungka'l; neengka'l karththarukku udanpattu, avar sathaakaalaththukkum parisuththampa'n'nina avarudaiya parisuththasthalaththi'rku vanthu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaraich seaviyungka'l; appozhuthu avarudaiya ukkiramaana koapam ungka'laivittuth thirumpum.

neengka'l karththaridaththukkuth thirumpinaal, ungka'l sakoathararum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum thangka'laich si'raipidiththavarka'lukku munpaaka irakkam pe'ruki'ratha'rkum, inthath theasaththi'rkuth thirumpuki'ratha'rkum athu eathuvaakum; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar kirupaiyum irakkamumu'l'lavar; neengka'l avaridaththi'rkuth thirumpinaal, avar thammudaiya mukaththai ungka'laivittu vilakkuvathillai en'raarka'l.
appadi antha agnchalkaarar eppiraayeem manaasea theasangka'lil sepuloan mattukkum oorooraakath thirinthaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l ivarka'laippaarththu nakaiththup parikaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
aakilum aasearilum, manaaseayilum, sepuloanilum, silar manaththaazhmaiyaaki erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l.
yoothaavilum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, raajaavum pirapukka'lum katta'laiyittapirakaaram seyki'ratha'rku, theavanudaiya karam avarka'lai orumanappaduththit'ru.
appadiyea ira'ndaam maathaththil pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyai aasarikka veku janangka'l erusaleamil makaaperiya sapaiyaayk koodinaarka'l.
avarka'l ezhumpi, erusaleamil u'ndaana palipeedangka'laiyum, thoopapeedangka'laiyum akat'rik keetharoan aat'rilea poattaarka'l.

pinpu antha ira'ndaam maatham pathinaalaantheathiyil paskaavin aattukkuttika'lai adiththaarka'l; aasaariyarum leaviyarum vedki, thangka'laich suththampa'n'ni, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laik karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkuk ko'nduvanthu,

theavanudaiya manushanaakiya moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku eat'ra thangka'l mu'raimaiyinpadiyea thangka'l sthaanaththilea nin'raarka'l; aasaariyar leaviyarin kaiyilirunthu iraththaththai vaangkith the'liththaarka'l.

sapaiyilea aneakar thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'laathirunthaarka'l; aakaiyaal suththamillaatha ellaaraiyum karththarukkup parisuththampa'n'na, leaviyar avarka'lukkaakap paskaavin aattukkuttika'lai adikkum kaariyaththai visaariththaarka'l.

atheanen'raal eppiraayeem, manaasea, isakkaar, sepuloan manusharil earaa'lamaana aneakam janangka'l thangka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'l'laathirunthum, ezhuthiyiraathapirakaaramaakap paskaavaich saappittaarka'l.

eseakkiyaa avarka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaraana theavanaith theadumpadikku, thangka'l iruthayaththai nearaakkinavarka'l parisuththa sthalaththi'rkeat'ra suththaangkam adaiyaathirunthaalum, kirupaiyu'l'la karththar avarka'l ellaarukkum mannippaaraaka en'raan.
karththar eseakkiyaavin vi'n'nappaththaik keattu, janangka'lukku anukoolagnseythaar.

appadiyea erusaleamilea kaa'nappatta israveal puththirar pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyai eazhunaa'la'lavum makaa aananthaththoadea aasariththaarka'l; leaviyarum aasaariyarum thinanthinam karththarukken'ru pearoasaiyaayth thonikkum keethavaaththiyangka'laal karththaraith thuthiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

karththarukku aduththa kaariyaththil nalla u'narvu'l'la ellaa leaviyaroadum eseakkiyaa padchamaayp peasinaan; ippadi avarka'l pa'ndikaiyin eazhunaa'la'lavum pusiththu, sthoaththirapalika'laich seluththi, thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaraith thuthiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
pinpu vea'rea eazhunaa'la'lavum aasarikkach sapaiyaar ellaarum yoasanaipa'n'ni, antha eazhunaa'lum aananthaththoadea aasariththaarka'l.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa sapaikku aayiram kaa'laika'laiyum eazhaayiram aaduka'laiyum koduththaan; pirapukka'lum sapaikku aayiram kaa'laika'laiyum pathinaayiram aaduka'laiyum koduththaarka'l; aasaariyaril aneakampear thangka'laich suththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

yoothaavin sapaiyanaiththum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, isravealilirunthu vanthavarka'ludaiya sapaiyanaiththumaakiya israveal theasaththilirunthuvantha anniyarum, yoothaavil kudiyirunthavarka'lum makizhchchiyaayirunthaarka'l.
appadiyea erusaleamil makaa santhoasham u'ndaayirunthathu; thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya saalomoan ennum isravealudaiya raajaavin naadka'lmutha'rko'ndu ippadi erusaleamil nadanthathillai.

leaviyaraana aasaariyarka'l ezhunthu nin'ru, janaththai aaseervathiththaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya saththam keadkappattu, avarka'ludaiya vi'n'nappam avarudaiya parisuththa vaasasthalamaakiya paraloakaththil vanthu ettinathu.

ivaiyellaam mudinthapinpu, vanthiruntha isravealar ellaarum yoothaavin patta'nangka'lukkup pu'rappattuppoay, yoothaa penyameenengkum eppiraayeemilum manaaseayilungkooda u'ndaana silaika'lai udaiththu, vikkirakath thoappuka'lai vetti, meadaika'laiyum peedangka'laiyum idiththu, avaika'laiyellaam thakarththuppoattaarka'l; pinpu israveal puththirar ellaarum avaravar thangka'l oorka'lilirukki'ra thangka'l kaa'niyaadchikkuth thirumpinaarka'l.

eseakkiyaa aasaariyar leaviyarudaiya vakuppuka'lai avarka'l varisaika'linpadiyeayum, avaravarai avarka'l oozhiyaththinpadiyeayum thittappaduththi, aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum samaathaanapalika'laiyum seluththavum, karththarudaiya paa'layaththin vaasalka'lil oozhiyagnseythu thuthiththu sthoaththirikkavum ozhungkuppaduththinaan.

raajaa karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea anthisanthika'lil seluththavea'ndiya sarvaangka thakanapalika'lukkum, oayvunaadka'lilum maathappi'rappuka'lilum pa'ndikaika'lilum seluththavea'ndiya sarvaangka thakanapalika'lukkum than aasthiyiliruntheduththuth than pangkaik koduththaan.
aasaariyarum leaviyarum karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththai u'rchaakamaayk kaikko'l'lumpadi, avarka'lukkuriya paakaththaik kodukka janangka'lukkum erusaleamin kudika'lukkum katta'laiyittaan.

intha vaarththai pirasiththamaanapoathu, israveal puththirar thaaniyaththilum, thiraadcharasaththilum, e'n'neyilum, theanilum, nilaththin ellaa varaththilum mutha'rpalanka'laith thira'laakak ko'nduvanthu, sakalaththilum thasamapaakaththaip paripoora'namaayk koduththaarka'l.

yoothaavin patta'nangka'lil kudiyiruntha israveal puththirarum, yoothaa puththirarum, maaduka'lilum aaduka'lilum thasamapaakaththaiyum, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththampa'n'nappattavaika'lil thasamapaakaththaiyum ko'nduvanthu kuviyal kuviyalaaka vaiththaarka'l.
moon'raam maathaththil kuviyal seyyaththodangki eazhaam maathaththil mudiththaarka'l.
eseakkiyaavum pirapukka'lum vanthu, anthak kuviyalka'laik kaa'numpoathu, karththarukku sthoaththiragnseluththi, avarudaiya janamaakiya isravealaip pukazhnthaarka'l.
anthak kuviyalka'laik ku'riththu eseakkiyaa aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum visaariththapoathu,

saathoakkin santhathiyaanaakiya asariyaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyan avanai noakki: inthak kaa'nikkaiyaik karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarath thodangkinathumuthal naangka'l saappittuth thirpthiyadainthoam; innum michchamum irukki'rathu; karththar thammudaiya janaththai aaseervathiththathinaal inthath thiradchiyaana ampaaram meenthirukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa karththarudaiya aalayaththil pa'ndakasaalaika'lai aayaththappaduththach sonnaan.

avarka'l avaika'lai aayaththappaduththinapinpu, avaika'lilea kaa'nikkaika'laiyum, thasama paakaththaiyum, parisuththampa'n'nappattavaika'laiyum u'nmaiyaay eduththuvaiththaarka'l; avaika'linmeal leaviyanaakiya konaniyaa thalaivanum, avan thampiyaakiya simeayi ira'ndaavathumaayirunthaan.

raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavum, theavanudaiya aalaya visaara'naikkaaranaakiya asariyaavum pa'n'nina katta'laiyinpadiyea, yekiyealum, asasiyaavum, naakaaththum, aasakealum, yerimoaththum, yoasapaaththum, ealiyealum, ismakiyaavum, maakaaththum, penaayaavum, konaniyaavin keezhum avan thampiyaakiya simeayiyin keezhum visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l.

kizhakkuvaasalaik kaakki'ra imnaavin kumaaranaakiya koarea ennum leaviyan, karththarukkuch seluththappatta kaa'nikkaika'laiyum makaa parisuththamaanavaika'laiyum pangkidumpadikku, theavanukkuch seluththum u'rchaakak kaa'nikkaika'lmeal athikaariyaayirunthaan.

avanudaiya kaikku uthaviyaaka aasaariyarin patta'nangka'lil vakuppuka'linpadiyirukki'ra thangka'l sakoathararilea periyavanukkum si'riyavanukkum sarisamaanamaayk kodukkumpadikku, u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'laaka e'n'nappatta eatheanum, minyameenum, yesuvaavum, semaayaavum, amariyaavum, sekkaniyaavum ea'rpaduththappattaarka'l.

vamsa attava'naika'lil ezhuthappatta moon'ru vayathumuthal, atha'rku mea'rpatta aa'npi'l'laika'laiththavira, karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasikki'ra avaravarukkum thangka'l vakuppuka'linpadiyea, thangka'l mu'raika'lilea thaangka'l seyki'ra thangka'l pa'nividaikkuththakkathaay anuthina padi kodukkappattathu.
thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsa attava'naika'lil ezhuthappatta thangka'l vakuppuka'linpadiyea thangka'l mu'raika'lilirukki'ra irupathu vayathumuthal, atha'rku mea'rpatta aasaariyarukkum, leaviyarukkum,

avarka'ludaiya ellaak koottaththin attava'naiyilum ezhuthappatta avarka'ludaiya ellaak kuzhanthaika'lukkum, manaivika'lukkum, kumaararukkum, kumaaraththika'lukkum pangku koduththaarka'l; avarka'l parisuththamaanathai u'nmaiyinpadi parisuththamaay visaariththaarka'l.

aasaariyaril ellaa aa'npi'l'laika'lukkum leaviyarukku'l'lea attava'naiyil ezhuthappattavarka'l ellaarukkum padikodukka, aasaariyarudaiya ovvoru patta'naththukkaduththa ve'linilangka'lilum aaroan puththiraril pearpearaakak ku'rikkappatta manushar irunthaarka'l.
inthappirakaaramaaka eseakkiyaa yoothaavengkum nadappiththu, than theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaaka nanmaiyum semmaiyum u'nmaiyumaanathaich seythaan.

avan theavanudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyilum, than theavanaith theadumpadikku niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkum ka'rpanaikkum aduththa kaariyaththilum enna seyyath thodangkinaanoa, athaiyellaam than muzhu iruthayaththoadum seythu siththipet'raan.

ikkaariyangka'l nadanthea'rivarukaiyil aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip vanthu, yoothaavukku'l piraveasiththu, ara'naana patta'nangka'lukku ethiraakap paa'layami'rangki, avaika'laith than vasamaakkikko'l'la ninaiththaan.
sanakerip vanthu, erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'na noakkangko'ndiruppathai eseakkiyaa ka'ndapoathu,
nakaraththi'rkup pu'rampeayirukki'ra oot'ruka'laith thoorththuppoada, than pirapukka'loadum than paraakkiramasaalika'loadum aaloasanaipa'n'ninaan; atha'rku avarka'l uthaviyaayirunthaarka'l.
aseeriyaa raajaakka'l vanthu, athika tha'n'neeraik ka'ndupidippaanean en'ru solli, aneakam janangka'l koodi, ellaa oot'ruka'laiyum naattin naduvil paayum oadaiyaiyum thoorththuppoattaarka'l.

avan thidanko'ndu, idinthupoana mathilaiyellaam katti, avaika'laiyum ve'liyilu'l'la mat'ra mathilaiyum koththa'langka'lmattum uyarththi, thaaveethu nakaraththin koattaiyaip palappaduththi, thira'laana aayuthangka'laiyum keadakangka'laiyumpa'n'ni,
janaththinmeal padaiththalaivarai vaiththu, avarka'lai nakaravaasalin veethiyilea thanna'ndaiyil koodivarachseythu, avarka'lai noakki:

neengka'l thidanko'ndu thairiyamaayirungka'l; aseeriyaa raajaavukkum avanoadirukki'ra earaa'lamaana koottaththi'rkum payappadaamalum kalangkaamalumirungka'l; avanoadirukki'ravarka'laippaarkkilum nammoadirukki'ravarka'l athikam.

avanoadirukki'rathu maamsa puyam, namakkuth thu'nainin'ru nammudaiya yuththangka'lai nadaththa nammoadirukki'ravar nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarthaanea en'ru solli, avarka'laith theat'rinaan; yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa sonna intha vaarththaika'linmeal janangka'l nampikkai vaiththaarka'l.

ithinpinpu aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip than muzhuch seanaiyudan laakeesukku ethiraay mut'rikkaipoattirukkaiyil, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavidaththukkum, erusaleamilu'l'la yoothaa janangka'l yaavaridaththukkum than oozhiyakkaararai anuppi:
aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, mut'rikkai poadappatta erusaleamilea neengka'l irukkumpadikku, neengka'l ethinmeal nampikkaiyaayirukki'reerka'l?

nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar nammai aseeriyarudaiya raajaavin kaikkuth thappuvippaar en'ru eseakkiyaa solli, neengka'l pasiyinaalum thaakaththinaalum saakumpadi ungka'laip poathikki'raan allavaa?

avarudaiya meadaika'laiyum avarudaiya palipeedangka'laiyum tha'l'livittavanum, orea palipeedaththi'rku munpaakap pa'ninthu, athinmeal thoopangkaattungka'l en'ru yoothaavukkum erusaleamiyarukkum sonnavanum antha eseakkiyaathaan allavaa?
