naanum en pithaakka'lum theasaththuch sakala janangka'lukkum seythathai a'riyeerka'loa? anthath theasangka'ludaiya jaathika'lin theavarka'l avarka'l theasaththai nammudaiya kaikkuth thappuvikka avarka'lukkup pelan irunthathoa?

ungka'l theavan ungka'lai en kaikkuth thappuvikkakkoodumpadikku, en pithaakka'l paazhaakkina antha jaathika'ludaiya ellaa theavarka'lilum evan than janaththai en kaikkuth thappuvikkap palavaanaayirunthaan?

ippoathum eseakkiyaa ungka'lai vagnchikkavum, ippadi ungka'laip poathikkavum idangkodukkavea'ndaam; neengka'l avanai nampavum vea'ndaam; eanen'raal entha jaathiyin theavanum, entha raajyaththin theavanum than janaththai en kaikkum en pithaakka'lin kaikkum thappuvikkakkoodaathirunthathea; ungka'l theavan ungka'lai en kaikkuth thappuvippathu eppadi enki'raar en'ru solli,
avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaakavum, avarudaiya thaasanaakiya eseakkiyaavukku viroathamaakavum pinnum athikamaayp peasinaarka'l.

theasangka'ludaiya jaathika'lin theavarka'l thangka'l janangka'lai en kaikkuth thappuvikkaathirunthathupoala, eseakkiyaavin theavanum than janangka'lai en kaikkuth thappuvippathillaiyen'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai ninthikkavum, avarukku viroathamaakap peasavum avan nirupangka'laiyum ezhuthinaan.

avarka'l alangkaththinmealirukki'ra erusaleamin janangka'laip payappaduththi, kalangkappa'n'ni, thaangka'l nakaraththaip pidikkumpadi, avarka'laip paarththu: yoothapaashaiyilea makaa saththamaayk kooppittu,

manushar kaivealaiyinaal seyyappattathum, poochchakkaraththu janangka'laal thozhuthuko'l'lappattathumaayirukki'ra theavarka'laik ku'riththup peasuki'rapirakaaramaaka erusaleamin theavanaiyum ku'riththup peasinaarka'l.
ithinimiththam raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavum aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa theerkkatharisiyum piraarththiththu, vaanaththai noakki apayamittaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththar oru thoothanai anuppinaar; avan aseeriyarudaiya raajaavin paa'layaththilu'l'la sakala paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum, thalaivaraiyum, seanaapathika'laiyum athampa'n'ninaan; appadiyea sanakerip seththamukamaayth than theasaththi'rkuth thirumpinaan; angkea avan than theavanudaiya koavilukku'l piraveasikki'rapoathu, avanudaiya karppappi'rappaana silar avanaip pattayaththaal vettippoattaarka'l.

ippadik karththar eseakkiyaavaiyum erusaleamin kudika'laiyum aseeriyarudaiya raajaavaakiya sanakeripin kaikkum mat'ra ellaarudaiya kaikkum neengkalaakki iradchiththu, avarka'laich sut'ruppu'raththaarukku vilakki aathariththu nadaththinaar.

aneakampear karththarukken'ru erusaleamukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laiyum, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavukku uchchithangka'laiyum ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan itha'rkuppi'rpaadu sakala jaathika'lin paarvaikkum meanmaippattavanaayirunthaan.

annaadka'lil eseakkiyaa viyaathippattu mara'naththukku eathuvaayirunthaan; avan karththarai noakki jepampa'n'numpoathu, avar avanukku vaakkuththaththampa'n'ni, avanukku oru a'rputhaththaik katta'laiyittaar.
eseakkiyaa thanakkuch seyyappatta upakaaraththi'rkuththakkathaay nadavaamal manameattimaiyaanaan; aakaiyaal avanmealum, yoothaavinmealum, erusaleaminmealum kadungkoapam moo'ndathu.
eseakkiyaavin manameattimaiyinimiththam avanum erusaleamin kudika'lum thangka'laith thaazhththinapadiyinaal, karththarudaiya kadungkoapam eseakkiyaavin naadka'lilea avarka'lmeal varavillai.

eseakkiyaavukku mikuthiyaana aisuvariyamum kanamum u'ndaayirunthathu; ve'l'liyum ponnum iraththinangka'lum kanthavarkkangka'lum keadakangka'lum vinoathamaana aapara'nangka'lum vaikkumpadiyaana pokkishasaalaika'laiyum,

thanakku vanthuko'ndiruntha thaaniyamum thiraadcharasamum e'n'neyum vaikkumpadiyaana pa'ndakasaalaika'laiyum, sakala vakaiyu'l'la mirukajeevanka'lukkuk kottaarangka'laiyum, manthaika'lukkuth thozhuvangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan.
avan thanakkup patta'nangka'laik kattuviththu earaa'lamaana aadumaaduka'lai vaiththirunthaan; theavan avanukku makaa thira'laana aasthiyaik koduththaar.
intha eseakkiyaa keeyoan ennum aat'rilea a'naikatti, athin tha'n'neerai mea'rkeayirunthu thaazhath thaaveethin nakaraththi'rku nearaakath thiruppinaan; eseakkiyaa seythathellaam vaayththathu.

aakilum paapiloan pirapukka'lin sthaanaapathika'l theasaththilea nadantha a'rputhaththaik keadka avanidaththukku anuppappatta vishayaththil avan iruthayaththil u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum a'riyumpadi avanaich soathikki'ratha'rkaaka theavan avanaik kaivittaar.

eseakkiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seytha nanmaika'lum aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa theerkkatharisiyin pusthakaththilum, yoothaa israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththilum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

eseakkiyaa than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, avanaith thaaveethu vamsaththaarin kalla'raika'lil pirathaanamaana kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; yoothaavanaiththum erusaleamin kudika'lum avan mariththapoathu avanaik kanampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya manaasea avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
manaasea raajaavaaki'rapoathu pannira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, aimpaththainthu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.
karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaakath thuraththina jaathika'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadiyea, avan karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

avan than thakappanaakiya eseakkiyaa thakarththuppoatta meadaika'laith thirumpavum katti, paakaalka'lukkup palipeedangka'lai eduppiththu, vikkirakaththoappuka'lai u'ndaakki, vaanaththin seanaiyaiyellaam pa'ninthuko'ndu, avaika'laich seaviththu,
erusaleamilea en naamam en'ren'raikkum vi'langkum en'ru karththar sonna thammudaiya aalayaththilea palipeedangka'laik katti,
karththarudaiya aalayaththin ira'ndu piraakaarangka'lilum vaanaththin seanaika'lukkellaam palipeedangka'laik kattinaan.

avan innoam kumaararin pa'l'laththaakkilea than kumaararaith theemithikkappa'n'ni, naa'lum nimiththamum paarththu, pillisooniyangka'lai anusariththu, agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'laiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum vaiththu, karththarukkuk koapamu'ndaaka avar paarvaikku mikuthiyum pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
intha aalayaththilum, israveal koaththirangka'lilellaam naan therinthuko'nda erusaleamilum, en naamaththai en'ren'raikkum vi'langkappa'n'nuvean en'rum,

naan moaseayaikko'ndu isravealukkuk koduththa sakala niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkum katta'laika'lukkum niyaayangka'lukkum oththapadiyea avarka'lukku naan ka'rpiththavaika'laiyellaam avarka'l seyyach saavathaanamaay irunthaarka'leayaakil, naan ini avarka'l kaalai avarka'l pithaakka'lukku nilaippaduththivaiththa theasaththilirunthu vilakappa'n'nuvathillaiyen'rum, theavan thaaveethoadum avan kumaaranaakiya saalomoanoadum solliyiruntha theavanudaiya aalayaththilthaanea, avan thaan pa'n'nuviththa vikkirakamaakiya silaiyai sthaapiththaan.

appadiyea karththar israveal puththirarukku munpaaka azhiththa jaathika'laippaarkkilum, yoothaavum erusaleamin kudika'lum pollaappuch seyyaththakkathaay, manaasea avarka'lai vazhithappippoakappa'n'ninaan.
karththar manaaseayoadum avanudaiya janaththoadum peasinapoathilum, avarka'l kavanikkaatheapoanaarka'l.

aakaiyaal karththar: aseeriyaa raajaavin seanaapathika'lai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'ninaar; avarka'l manaaseayai mudchedika'lil pidiththu, ira'ndu ve'nkalach sangkiliyaal avanaik kattip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
ippadi avan nerukkappadukaiyil, than theavanaakiya karththarai noakkik kegnchi, than pithaakka'lin theavanukku munpaaka mikavum thannaith thaazhththinaan.

avarai noakki, avan vi'n'nappampa'n'nikko'ndirukki'rapoathu, avar avan kegnchuthalukku irangki, avan jepaththaik keattu, avanaith thirumpa erusaleamilu'l'la thannudaiya raajyaththi'rku varappa'n'ninaar; karththarea theavan en'ru appozhuthu manaasea a'rinthaan.

pinpu avan thaaveethudaiya nakaraththin ve'li alangkaththaik keeyoanukku mea'rkeayirukki'ra pa'l'laththaakkuthodangki meenvaasalmattum katti, oapealaich sut'rilum athai va'laiththu, athai mikavum uyarththi, yoothaavilu'l'la ara'naana patta'nangka'lilellaam iraa'nuvaththalaivarai vaiththu,

karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu anniya theavarka'laiyum antha vikkirakaththaiyum eduththuppoattu, karththarudaiya aalayamu'l'la malaiyilum erusaleamilum thaan kattiyiruntha ellaap palipeedangka'laiyum akat'ri, patta'naththi'rkup pu'rampaakap poaduviththu,

karththarudaiya palipeedaththaich seppanittu, athinmeal samaathaanapalika'laiyum sthoaththirapalika'laiyum seluththi, isravealin theavanaakiya karththaraich seavikkavea'ndum en'ru yoothaavukkuk katta'laiyittaan.
aakilum janangka'l innum meadaika'lil paliyittuvanthaarka'l; en'raalum thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarukken'rea appadich seythaarka'l.

manaaseayin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan than theavanai noakkip pa'n'nina vi'n'nappamum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththil avanoadea peasina gnaanathirushdikkaararin vaarththaika'lum, israveal raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

avanudaiya vi'n'nappamum, avan kegnchuthalukkuk karththar irangkinathum, avan thannaith thaazhththinatha'rku munnea pa'n'nina avanudaiya ellaap paavamum thuroakamum, avan meadaika'laik katti vikkirakath thoappuka'laiyum silaika'laiyum sthaapiththa idangka'lum, oasaayin pirapanthaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
manaasea than pithaakka'loadea niththiraiyadainthapinpu, avanai avan veettilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya aamoan avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.
aamoan raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththira'ndu vayathaayirunthu, ira'ndu varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.

avan than thakappanaakiya manaasea seythathupoalak karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; than thakappanaakiya manaasea pa'n'nuviththiruntha vikkirakangka'lukkellaam aamoan paliyittu, avaika'laich seaviththaan.
than thakappanaakiya manaasea thannaith thaazhththikko'ndathupoala, intha aamoan enpavan karththarukku munpaakath thannaith thaazhththaamal meanmealum akkiramam seythuvanthaan.
avan oozhiyakkaarar avanukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'ni, avan aramanaiyilea avanaik kon'rupoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu theasaththu janangka'l aamoan ennum raajaavukku viroathamaayk kattuppaadupa'n'nina yaavaraiyum vettippoattu, avan kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaavai avan sthaanaththil raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
yoasiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu ettu vayathaayirunthu, muppaththoru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.
avan karththarudaiya paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythu, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin vazhika'lil, valathu idathupu'ramaaka vilakaamal nadanthaan.

avan than raajyapaaraththin ettaam varushaththil, thaan innum i'lavayathaayirukkaiyil, than thakappanaakiya thaaveethin theavanaith theada aarampiththu, pannira'ndaam varushaththil meadaika'l thoappuka'l suroopangka'l vikkirakangka'l aakiya ivaika'l at'ruppoakumpadi, yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum suththikarikkath thodangkinaan.

avanukku munpaakap paakaalka'lin palipeedangka'lai idiththaarka'l; avaika'linmealiruntha silaika'lai vetti, vikkirakath thoappuka'laiyum vaarppu vikkirakangka'laiyum vettu vikkirakangka'laiyum udaiththu no'rukki, avaika'lukkup paliyittavarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'linmeal thoovi,
poojaasaarika'lin elumpuka'lai avarka'ludaiya peedangka'linmeal sutteriththu, ivvithamaay yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum suththikariththaan.
appadiyea avan manaasea eppiraayeem simiyoan ennum patta'nangka'lilum, napthalimattum, paazhaana avaika'lin sut'ruppu'rangka'lilum seythaan.

avan israveal theasam engkumu'l'la palipeedangka'laiyum vikkirakath thoappuka'laiyum thakarththu, vikkirakangka'lai no'rukkith thoo'laakki, ellaach silaika'laiyum vettippoattapinpu erusaleamukkuth thirumpinaan.

avan theasaththaiyum aalayaththaiyum suththikariththapinpu, avan than raajyapaaraththin pathinettaam varushaththilea, athsaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya saappaanaiyum, nakaraththalaivanaakiya maaseyaavaiyum, yoavaakaasin kumaaranaakiya yoavaak ennum manthiriyaiyum, than theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarkkumpadikku anuppinaan.

avarka'l pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaavinidaththil vanthu, vaasa'rpadiyaik kaakki'ra leaviyar manaaseayilum eppiraayeemilum isravealil meethiyaanavarka'lellaarin kaiyilum yoothaa penyameen engkum searththu, erusaleamukkuth thirumpith theavanudaiya aalayaththi'rkuk ko'nduvantha pa'naththai oppuviththu,

vealaiyaich seyvikkumpadi, karththarudaiya aalayaththin visaarippukkaararaanavarka'lin kaiyil athaik koduththaarka'l; ivarka'l athaik karththarudaiya aalayaththaip pazhuthupaarththuch seerppaduththuki'ratha'rku aalayaththil vealaiseyki'ravarka'l kaiyilea koduththaarka'l.

appadiyea yoothaavin raajaakka'l keduththuppoatta a'raika'laip pazhuthupaarkka vettina ka'rka'laiyum, i'naippukku marangka'laiyum, paavuki'ratha'rkup palakaika'laiyum vaangkath thachcharukkum si'rpaasaarika'lukkum athaik koduththaarka'l.

intha manushar vealaiyai u'nmaiyaaych seythaarka'l; vealaiyai nadaththa meraariyin puththiraril yaakaath opathiyaa ennum leaviyarum, koakaathiyarin puththiraril sakariyaavum, mesullaamum avarka'lmeal visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l; intha leaviyar ellaarum keethavaaththiyangka'lai vaasikka a'rinthavarka'l.

avarka'l sumaikaararai visaarikki'ravarka'laayum, pa'rpala vealaika'laich seyki'ravarka'l ellaaraiyum ka'nkaa'nikki'ravarka'laayum irunthaarka'l; leaviyaril innum silar ka'nakkarum ma'niyakkaararum vaasa'rkaavalaa'larumaayirunthaarka'l.

karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvarappatta pa'naththai avarka'l edukki'rapoathu moaseayaikko'ndu katta'laiyidappatta karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakaththai aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaa ka'ndeduththaan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaa sampirathiyaakiya saappaanai noakki: karththarudaiya aalayaththilea niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakaththaik ka'ndeduththean en'ru solli, anthap pusthakaththaich saappaan kaiyil koduththaan.
saappaan anthap pusthakaththai raajaavinidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoay, avanai noakki: ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkuk katta'laiyidappattavaika'laiyellaam avarka'l seyki'raarka'l.
karththarudaiya aalayaththilea searntha pa'naththai avarka'l kootti, athai visaarippukkaarar kaiyilum, vealaiseyki'ravarka'l kaiyilum koduththaarka'l en'ru raajaavukku ma'ruseythi sonnathum allaamal,
aasaariyanaakiya ilkkiyaa en kaiyil oru pusthakaththaik koduththaan enpathaich sampirathiyaakiya saappaan raajaavukku a'riviththu, raajaavukku munpaaka athai vaasiththaan.
niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'lai raajaa keattapoathu, avan than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu,

ilkkiyaavukkum, saappaanin kumaaranaakiya akikkaamukkum, meekaavin kumaaranaakiya apthoanukkum, sampirathiyaakiya saappaanukkum, raajaavin oozhiyakkaaranaakiya asaayaavukkum katta'laiyittuch sonnathu:

ka'ndedukkappatta inthap pusthakaththinudaiya vaarththaika'linimiththam neengka'l poay, enakkaakavum isravealilum yoothaavilum meethiyaanavarka'lukkaakavum karththaridaththil visaariyungka'l; inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra ellaavat'rinpadiyeayum seyyumpadikkuk karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai nammudaiya pithaakka'l kaikko'l'laatheapoanapadiyinaal, nammeal moo'nda karththarudaiya ukkiram periyathu en'raan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaavum raajaa anuppina mat'ravarka'lum asraavin kumaaranaakiya thikvaathin makanaana salloom ennum vasthirasaalai visaarippukkaaran manaiviyaakiya ulthaa'l ennum theerkkatharisiyaanava'lidaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; ava'l erusaleamil ira'ndaam vakuppilea kudiyirunthaa'l; ava'loadea athaippat'rip peasinaarka'l.
ava'l ivarka'lai noakki: ungka'lai ennidaththil anuppinavarukku neengka'l sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathaavathu,
ithoa, yoothaavin raajaavukku munpaaka vaasikkappatta pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra sakala saapangka'lumaakiya pollaappai naan intha sthalaththinmealum ithin kudika'linmealum varappa'n'nuvean.

avarka'l ennaivittu, thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaika'l ellaavat'rilum enakkuk koapam u'ndaakka vea'rea theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattinapadiyinaal, en ukkiram avinthupoakaathapadi intha sthalaththinmeal i'rangkum en'ru karththar uraikki'raar.

karththaridaththil visaarikki'ratha'rku ungka'lai anuppina yoothaavin raajaavinidaththil neengka'l poay: nee keatta vaarththaika'laikku'riththu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal,

intha sthalaththi'rkum athin kudika'lukkum viroathamaakath theavan sonna avarudaiya vaarththaika'lai nee keadkaiyil, un iruthayam i'laki, enakku munpaaka nee unnaith thaazhththi, enakku munpaakap pa'ninthu, un vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, enakku munpaaka azhuthapadiyinaal, naanum un vi'n'nappaththaik keattean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naan intha sthalaththinmealum ithin kudika'linmealum varappa'n'num ellaap pollaappaiyum un ka'nka'l kaa'naathapadikku, nee samaathaanaththoadea un kalla'raiyil searththukko'l'lappada, naan unnai un pithaakka'la'ndaiyilea searappa'n'nuvean enki'raar en'ru sonnaa'l; avarka'l raajaavukku ma'ruseythi ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu raajaa yoothaavilum erusaleamilumu'l'la moopparaiyellaam azhaippiththuk koodivarachseythu,

raajaavum, sakala yoothaa manusharum, erusaleamin kudika'lum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, periyoarmuthal si'riyoarmattumu'l'la sakalarumaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poanaarka'l; karththarudaiya aalayaththilea ka'ndedukkappatta udanpadikkaip pusthakaththin vaarththaika'laiyellaam avarka'l kaathuka'l keadka vaasiththaan.

raajaa than sthaanaththilea nin'ru, anthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'linpadiyea thaan seyvathinaalea, karththaraip pinpat'ri nadappean en'rum, than muzhu iruthayaththoadum than muzhu aaththumaavoadum avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum avarudaiya saadchika'laiyum avarudaiya katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'l'luvean en'rum karththarudaiya sannithiyil udanpadikkaipa'n'ni,

erusaleamilum penyameenilum kaa'nappatta yaavaraiyum atha'rku udpadappa'n'ninaan; appadiyea erusaleamin kudika'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya anthath theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyinpadiyea seythaarka'l.

yoasiyaa israveal puththirarudaiya theasangka'l engkum u'ndaana aruvaruppuka'laiyellaam akat'ri, isravealilea kaa'nappattavarka'laiyellaam thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraich seavikkumpadi seythaan; avan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam avarka'l thangka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarai vittup pinvaangkinathillai.
atha'rkup pinpu yoasiyaa erusaleamilea karththarukkup paskaavai aasariththaan; avarka'l muthalaam maatham pathinaalaantheathiyilea paskaa aattukkuttiyai adiththaarka'l.
avan aasaariyarka'lai avarka'l mu'raivarisaika'lil vaiththu, avarka'laik karththarudaiya aalayaththil aaraathanaiseyyath thittappaduththi,

isravealaiyellaam upatheasikki'ravarka'lum, karththarukkup parisuththamaakkappattavarka'lumaakiya leaviyarai noakki: parisuththap pettiyaith thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya saalomoan ennum isravealin raajaa kattina aalayaththilea vaiyungka'l; thoa'linmeal athaich sumakkum paaram ungka'lukkuriyathalla; ippoathu neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkum, avarudaiya janamaakiya isravealukkum oozhiyagnseythu,

isravealin raajaavaakiya thaaveethu ezhuthina katta'laikkum, avan kumaaranaakiya saalomoan ezhuthina katta'laikkum oththapadiyea ungka'l pithaakka'lin kudumpaththaarukkaakak ku'rikkappatta varisaiyilea ungka'lai aayaththappaduththi,
janangka'laakiya ungka'l sakoathararukkaakap parisuththa sthalaththilea pithaakka'ludaiya vamsap pirivuka'linpadiyeayum, leaviyarudaiya vamsaththaar vakukkappattapadiyeayum nin'ru,
paskaa aattukkuttiyai adiththu, ungka'laip parisuththampa'n'ni, moaseayaikko'ndu karththar sonnapadiyea ungka'l sakoatharar seyyumpadi, avarka'lukku avaika'lai aayaththappaduththungka'l en'raan.

vanthiruntha janangka'l ellaarukkum, avarka'l ilakkaththinpadiyea, paskaa palikkaaka muppathinaayiram aattukkuttika'laiyum, ve'l'laattukkuttika'laiyum, moovaayiram kaa'laika'laiyum, raajaavaakiya yoasiyaa thannudaiya aasthiyilirunthu koduththaan.

avanudaiya pirapukka'lum manappoorvamaana kaa'nikkaiyaaka janaththi'rkum aasaariyarukkum leaviyarukkum koduththaarka'l; theavanudaiya aalaya visaara'naikkarththaavaakiya ilkkiyaavum sakariyaavum yekiyealum aasaariyarka'lukkup paskaa palikken'ru ira'ndaayiraththu a'runoo'ru aattukkuttika'laiyum, munnoo'ru kaa'laika'laiyum koduththaarka'l.

konaaniyaa, semaayaa, nethaneyeal ennum avarka'l sakoathararum, asapiyaa, eayel, yoasapaath ennum leaviyarin pirapukka'lum, leaviyarukkup paskaa palikken'ru aiyaayiram aattukkuttika'laiyum ainnoo'ru kaa'laika'laiyum koduththaarka'l.
ippadi aaraathanai thittampa'n'nappattapoathu, raajaavinudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea, aasaariyar thangka'l sthaanaththilum, leaviyar thangka'l vakuppuka'lin varisaiyilum nin'ru,
paskaa aattukkuttiyai adiththaarka'l; aasaariyar avarka'l kaiyilirunthu iraththaththai vaangkith the'liththaarka'l; leaviyar thoaluriththaarka'l.

moaseayin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi janangka'l karththarukkup pali seluththumpadi, avarka'l thakanapali mirukangka'laip pithaakka'ludaiya vamsappirivuka'linpadiyea, ivarka'lukkuk kodukkaththakkathaay avaika'laip piriththuvaiththaarka'l; kaa'laika'laiyum appadiyea seythaarka'l.

avarka'l paskaa aattukkuttiyai niyaayamu'raimaiyinpadiyea akkiniyil poriththu, parisuththamaakkappatta mat'ravaika'laip paanaika'lilum kopparaika'lilum sattika'lilum samaiththu, janangka'lukkellaam theeviramaayp pangkittukkoduththaarka'l.

pinpu thangka'lukkaakavum aasaariyarukkaakavum aayaththappaduththinaarka'l; aaroanin puththiraraakiya aasaariyarka'l sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum ni'naththaiyum seluththuki'rathil, iravumattum vealaiyaayirunthapadiyinaal, leaviyar thangka'lukkaakavum, aaroanin puththiraraakiya aasaariyarukkaakavum aayaththappaduththinaarka'l.

thaaveethum, aasaapum, eamaanum, raajaavin gnaanathirushdikkaaranaakiya ethuththoonum ka'rpiththapadiyea, aasaapin puththiraraakiya paadakar thangka'l sthaanaththilum, vaasalkaavalaa'lar ovvoru vaasalilum nin'raarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l oozhiyaththai vittu vilakakkoodaathirunthathu; leaviyaraana avarka'l sakoatharar avarka'lukkaaka aayaththappaduththinaarka'l.

appadiyea raajaavaakiya yoasiyaavinudaiya katta'laippadi, paskaavai aasarikki'ratha'rkum, karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal sarvaangka thakanapalika'lai iduki'ratha'rkum aduththa karththarudaiya aaraathanaiyellaam an'raiyathinam thittamaaych seyyappattathu.
angkea vanthiruntha israveal puththirar akkaalaththil paskaavaiyum, pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyaiyum eazhunaa'la'lavum aasariththaarka'l.

theerkkatharisiyaakiya saamuvealin naa'l thodangki, isravealilea appadikkoththa paskaa aasarikkappadavillai; yoasiyaavum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, yoothaavanaiththum, isravealil vanthirunthavarka'lum, erusaleamin kudika'lum aasariththa paskaavaippoala israveal raajaakka'lil oruvarum aasariththathillai.
yoasiyaavudaiya raajyapaaraththin pathinettaam varushaththilea inthap paskaa aasarikkappattathu.

yoasiyaa theavaalayaththi'rku aduththathaith thittappaduththina intha ellaa nadapadika'lukkumpinpu, ekipthin raajaavaakiya neakoa aipiraaththu nathiyoaramaana karkeamis patta'naththinmeal yuththampa'n'navanthaan; appozhuthu yoasiyaa avanukku viroathamaay yuththagnseyyap pu'rappattaan.

avan ivanidaththukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi: yoothaavin raajaavea, enakkum umakkum enna? naan ippoathu umakku viroathamaay alla, ennoadea yuththampa'n'nuki'ra oruvanukku viroathamaayp poaki'rean; naan theevirikka vea'ndumen'ru theavan sonnaar; theavan ennoadirukki'raar; avar ummai azhikkaathapadikku avarukku ethiridai seyvathai vittuvidum en'ru sollachsonnaan.

aanaalum yoasiyaa than mukaththai avanai vittuth thiruppaamalum, neakoa sonna theavanudaiya vaayin vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodaamalum, avanoadea yuththampa'n'na veashammaa'ri, mekithoavin pa'l'laththaakkilea yuththampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku vanthaan.
vilveerar yoasiyaa raajaavinmeal ampeythaarka'l; appozhuthu raajaa than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: ennai appu'ram ko'ndupoangka'l, enakkuk kodiya kaayampattathu en'raan.

appozhuthu avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar antha irathaththinmealiruntha avanai i'rakki, avanukku iruntha ira'ndaavathu irathaththinmeal eat'ri avanai erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan mara'namadainthu than pithaakka'lin kalla'raiyil adakkampa'n'nappattaan; yoothaavilum erusaleamilumu'l'la yaavarum yoasiyaavukkaakath thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.

ereamiyaa yoasiyaavinmeal pulampal paadinaan; sakala paadakarum paadakika'lum innaa'lvaraikkum thangka'l pulampalka'lil yoasiyaavinmeal paaduki'raarka'l; avaika'l innaa'lvaraikkum isravealilea vazhangkivaruki'rathu; avaika'l pulampalin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
yoasiyaavin mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'ratha'rkoththa avan seytha nanmaika'lum,
avanudaiya aathiyoadantha nadapadika'lum, israveal yoothaa raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
appozhuthu janangka'l yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaakaasai azhaiththu, avanai erusaleamilea avan thakappan sthaanaththilea raajaavaakkinaarka'l.
yoavaakaas raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththumoon'ru vayathaayirunthu, moon'rumaatham erusaleamil arasaa'ndaan.
avan erusaleamil arasaa'laathapadikku ekipthin raajaa avanaith tha'l'livittu, theasaththinmeal noo'ru thaalanthu ve'l'liyum oru thaalanthu ponnumaana tha'ndaththaich sumaththi,

avanudaiya a'n'nanaakiya eliyaakkeemai yoothaavinmealum erusaleaminmealum raajaavaakki, avan pearai yoayaakkeem en'ru maat'rinaan; avan thampiyaakiya yoavaakaasai ekipthin raajaavaakiya neakoa ekipthi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaan.
yoayaakkeem raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththainthu vayathaayirunthu, pathinoru varusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndu, than theavanaakiya karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.
avanukku viroathamaakap paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar vanthu, avanaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoaka ira'ndu ve'nkalach sangkiliyaal avanaik kattinaan.
karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'lilum silavat'rai neapukaathneachchaar paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoay, avaika'laip paapiloanilu'l'la thannudaiya koavililea vaiththaan.

yoayaakkeemudaiya mat'ra varththamaanangka'lum, avan seythathum, avanidaththilea ka'ndupidikkappattathumaana avanudaiya aruvaruppuka'lum, israveal yoothaa raajaakka'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; avan sthaanaththil avan kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeen raajaavaanaan.
yoayaakkeen raajaavaaki'rapoathu ettu vayathaayirunthu, moon'ru maathamum paththu naa'lum erusaleamil arasaa'ndu, karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

ma'ruvarushaththin aarampaththilea neapukaathneachchaar ennum raajaa avanaiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththin thivviyamaana pa'nimuttuka'laiyum paapiloanukkuk ko'nduvarappa'n'ni, avan si'riya thakappanaakiya sitheakkiyaavai yoothaavinmealum erusaleaminmealum raajaavaakkinaan.
sitheakkiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththoru vayathaayirunthu, pathinoruvarusham erusaleamil arasaa'ndu,
than theavanaakiya karththarin paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan; avan karththarudaiya vaakkai uraiththa ereamiyaa enki'ra theerkkatharisikkumunpaakath thannaith thaazhththavillai.

theavanmeal thannai aa'naiyiduviththukko'nda neapukaathneachchaar ennum raajaavukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ni, isravealin theavanaakiya karththaridaththukkuth thirumpaathapadikku, than kazhuththai azhuththamaakki, than iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththinaan.

aasaariyaril pirathaanamaanavarka'l yaavarum janangka'lum koodip pu'rajaathika'ludaiya sakala aruvaruppuka'linpadiyum mikavum thuroakampa'n'ni, karththar erusaleamilea parisuththampa'n'nina avarudaiya aalayaththaith theettuppaduththinaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththar thamathu janaththaiyum thamathu vaasasthalaththaiyum kaappatha'rkaana irakkamu'l'lavaraayirunthapadiyaal, avarka'lidaththukkuth thammudaiya sthaanaapathika'lai ea'rkanavea anuppinaar.

aanaalum avarka'l theavanudaiya sthaanaapathika'laip pariyaasampa'n'ni, avarudaiya vaarththaika'lai asattaiseythu, avarudaiya theerkkatharisika'lai ninthiththapadiyaal, karththarudaiya ukkiram avarudaiya janaththinmeal moo'ndathu; sakaayamillaamal poayit'ru.

aathalaal avar avarka'lmeal kaltheayarin raajaavai varappa'n'ninaar; avan avarka'l vaaliparai avarka'ludaiya parisuththamaana aalayaththilea pattayaththinaal kon'ru, vaaliparaiyum kanniyaasthireeka'laiyum muthiyoaraiyum viruththaappiyaraiyum thappavidavillai; ellaaraiyum theavan avan kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

avan theavanudaiya aalayaththin perithum si'rithumaana pa'nimuttuka'l anaiththaiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pokkishangka'lum raajaavukkum avan pirapukka'lukkum iruntha pokkishangka'lumaakiya anaiththaiyum paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanaan.

avarka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththaith theekko'luththi, erusaleamin alangkaththai idiththu, athin maa'likaika'laiyellaam akkiniyaal sutteriththu, athiliruntha thivviyamaana pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam azhiththaarka'l.

pattayaththi'rkuth thappina meethiyaanavarka'lai avan paapiloanukkuch si'raipidiththuppoanaan; persiyaa raajyapaaram sthaapikkappadumattum angkea avarka'l avanukkum avan kumaararukkum adimaika'laayirunthaarka'l.

karththar ereamiyaavin vaayinaalea sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'rumpadikku, theasam thannudaiya oayvu varushangka'lai irammiyamaay anupaviththuth theerumattum, athu paazhaaykkidantha naa'lellaam, athaavathu, ezhupathuvarusham mudiyumattum oaynthirunthathu.

ereamiyaavin vaayinaalea karththar sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'rumpadi, persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareasin muthalaam varushaththilea karththar persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareasin aaviyai eavinathinaalea, avan: paraloakaththin theavanaakiya karththar poomiyin raajyangka'laiyellaam enakkuth thantharu'li, yoothaavilu'l'la erusaleamilea thamakku aalayaththaik kattuvikkumpadi enakkuk katta'laiyittirukki'raar.

avarudaiya janangka'l ellaarilum evan ungka'lukku'l irukki'raanoa avan poakattum, avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththar avanoadiruppaaraaka en'ru persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas a'rivikki'raar en'ru, than raajyam engkum ezhuthiyanuppi vi'lamparampa'n'ninaan.

ereamiyaavin vaayinaalea karththar sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'rumpadi, persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareasudaiya muthalaam varushaththilea, karththar persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareasin aaviyai eavinathinaalea avan:
paraloakaththin theavanaakiya karththar poomiyin raajyangka'laiyellaam enakkuth thantharu'li, yoothaavilu'l'la erusaleamilea thamakku aalayaththaik kattumpadi enakkuk katta'laiyittirukki'raar.

avarudaiya janangka'l ellaarilum evan ungka'lukku'l irukki'raanoa, avanoadea avanudaiya theavan iruppaaraaka; avan yoothaavilu'l'la erusaleamukkuppoay, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattakkadavan; erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra theavanea theavan.

antha janangka'lil meethiyaayirukki'ravan evvidaththil thangkiyirukki'raanoa, avvidaththu janangka'l erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththukken'ru avanidaththil u'rchaakamaayk kaa'nikkai koduththu anuppuki'rathuman'ri, avanukkup pon ve'l'li muthaliya thiraviyangka'laiyum, mirukajeevanka'laiyum koduththu, uthaviseyyavea'ndum en'ru persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas a'rivikki'raar en'ru than raajyamengkum ezhuthiyanuppi vi'lamparampa'n'nuviththaan.

appozhuthu erusaleamilu'l'la karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rkup poakumpadi yoothaa penyameen vamsangka'lin thalaivarum aasaariyarum leaviyaruman'ri, evarka'l aaviyai theavan eavinaaroa avarka'l ellaarum ezhumpinaarka'l.

avarka'laich sut'rilum kudiyirukki'ra yaavarum manau'rchaakamaayk kaa'nikkai koduththathuman'ri, ve'l'lip pa'nimuttuka'laiyum ponnaiyum mat'ra vasthukka'laiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum uchchithamaana poru'lka'laiyum koduththu, avarka'l kaika'laith thidappaduththinaarka'l.
neapukaathneachchaar erusaleamilirunthu ko'nduvanthu, than theavanudaiya koavililea vaiththiruntha karththarudaiya aalayaththup pa'nimuttuka'laiyum koareas raajaa eduththukkoduththaan.
avaika'laip persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas pokkishakkaaranaakiya miththireathaaththin kaiyinaal edukkachseythu, yoothaavin athipathiyaakiya seaspaathsaaridaththil e'n'nikkoduththaan.
avaika'lin thokaiyaavathu: pon thattuka'l muppathu, ve'l'liththaalangka'l aayiram, kaththika'l irupaththonpathu.
po'rki'n'nangka'l muppathu, ve'l'likki'n'nangka'l naanoot'ruppaththu, mat'rap pa'nimuttuka'l aayiram.

pon ve'l'lip pa'nimuttuka'lellaam aiyaayiraththu naanoo'ru, ivaika'laiyellaam seaspaathsaar, si'raiyiruppinin'ru viduthalaipet'ravarka'l paapiloanilirunthu erusaleamukkup poakaiyil, eduththukko'ndupoanaan.
paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanavarka'lukku'l'lea, si'raiyiruppilirunthu erusaleamukkum yoothaavilu'l'la thangka'l thangka'l patta'nangka'lukkum,

serupaapeal, yesuvaa, nekeamiyaa, seraayaa, relaayaa, morthekaay, pilsaan, mispaar, pikvaay, reakoom, paanaa enpavarka'loadeakoodath thirumpivantha theasaththup puththiraraakiya israveal janamaana manitharin thokaiyaavathu:
paaroashin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu noot'ru ezhupaththira'ndupear.
sepaththiyaavin puththirar munnoot'ru ezhupaththira'ndupear.
aaraakin puththirar ezhunoot'ru ezhupaththainthupear.
yesuvaa yoavaap enpavarka'ludaiya santhathikku'l'liruntha paakaath moavaapin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu e'n'noot'rup pannira'ndupear.
ealaamin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru aimpaththu naankupear.
saththoovin puththirar tho'laayiraththu naa'rpaththainthupear.
sakkaayin puththirar ezhunoot'ru a'rupathupear.
paaniyin puththirar a'runoot'ru naa'rpaththira'ndupear.
pepaayin puththirar a'runoot'ru irupaththumoon'rupear.
askaathin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru irupaththira'ndupear.
athonikaamin puththirar a'runoot'ru a'rupaththaa'rupear.
pikvaayin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu aimpaththaa'rupear.
aatheenin puththirar naanoot'ru aimpaththu naankupear.
eseakkiyaavin santhathiyaana athearin puththirar tho'n'noot'rettuppear.
peasaayin puththirar munnoot'ru irupaththumoon'rupear.
yoaraakin puththirar noot'ruppannira'ndupear.
aasoomin puththirar irunoot'ru irupaththumoon'rupear.
kipaarin puththirar tho'n'noot'rainthupear.
pethlekeamin puththirar noot'rirupaththumoon'rupear.
neththoapaavin manithar aimpaththaa'rupear.
aanathoaththin manithar noot'rirupaththettuppear.
asmaaveaththin puththirar naa'rpaththira'ndupear.
keeriyaathyaareem, kepiraa, pearoath enpavaika'lin puththirar ezhunoot'ru naa'rpaththumoon'rupear.
raamaa, kaapaa enpavaika'lin puththirar a'runoot'ru irupaththorupear.
mikmaasin manithar noot'rirupaththira'ndupear.
peththeal, aayi enpavaika'lin manithar irunoot'ru irupaththumoon'rupear.
neapoavin puththirar aimpaththira'ndupear.
makpeeshin puththirar noot'raimpaththaa'rupear.
mat'ra ealaamin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru aimpaththu naankupear.
aareemin puththirar munnoot'ru irupathupear.
loath, aatheeth, oanoa enpavaika'lin puththirar ezhunoot'ru irupaththainthupear.
erikoavin puththirar munnoot'ru naa'rpaththainthupear.
seanaakin puththirar moovaayiraththua'runoot'ru muppathupear.
aasaariyaraanavarka'l: yesuvaavin kudumpaththaanaakiya yethaayaavin puththirar tho'laayiraththu ezhupaththumoon'rupear.
immearin puththirar aayiraththu aimpaththira'ndupear.
paskoorin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru naa'rpaththeazhupear.
aareemin puththirar aayiraththuppathineazhupear.
leaviyaraanavarka'l: othaayaavin santhathiyaana yesuvaa kathmiyeal enpavarka'lin puththirar ezhupaththu naankupear.
paadakarka'laanavarka'l: aasaapin puththirar noot'rirupaththettuppear.

vaasal kaavalaa'larin puththiraraanavarka'l: salloomin puththirarum, athearin puththirarum, thalmoanin puththirarum, akkoopin puththirarum, athithaavin puththirarum, soapaayin puththirarumaanavarka'lellaarum noot'rumuppaththonpathupear.
nithaneemiyaraanavarka'l: seekaavin puththirar, asupaavin puththirar, thapaakoaththin puththirar,
kearoasin puththirar, seeyaakaavin puththirar, paathoanin puththirar,
lepaanaakin puththirar, akaapaavin puththirar, akkoopin puththirar,
aakaapin puththirar, salmaayin puththirar, aanaanin puththirar,
kiththealin puththirar, kaakaarin puththirar, raayaakin puththirar,
reathseenin puththirar, nekoathaavin puththirar, kaasaamin puththirar,
oosaavin puththirar, paaseyaakin puththirar, peasaayin puththirar,
asnaavin puththirar, meyooneemin puththirar, nepuseemin puththirar,
pakpookkin puththirar, akupaavin puththirar, arkoorin puththirar,
pasloothin puththirar, mekithaavin puththirar, arshaavin puththirar,
parkoasin puththirar, siseraavin puththirar, thaamaavin puththirar,
nethsiyaavin puththirar, athipaavin puththirarumea.
saalomoanudaiya vealaiyaadka'lin puththiraraanavarka'l: soathaayin puththirar, sopereaththin puththirar, peruthaavin puththirar,
yaalaakin puththirar, tharkoanin puththirar, kiththealin puththirar,
sepaththiyaavin puththirar, aththeelin puththirar, sepaayeemilu'l'la pokereaththin puththirar, aamiyin puththirarumea.
nithaneemiyarum saalomoanudaiya vealaiyaadka'lin puththirarum ellaarum munnoot'ruth tho'n'noot'rira'ndupear.

thelmelaakilum, thelarsaavilum, kearupilum, aathoanilum, immearilumirunthu vanthu, thaangka'l isravealar en'ru thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththaiyum, thangka'l poorvoaththaraththaiyum sollamaattaamal irunthavarka'l:
thelaayaavin puththirar, thopiyaavin puththirar, nekoathaavin puththirar, aaka a'runoot'ru aimpaththira'ndupear.

aasaariyarin puththiraril apaayaavin puththirar, koasin puththirar, keeleayaaththiyanaana parsilaayin kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ni, avarka'l vamsa naamam tharikkappatta parsillaayin puththirarea.
ivarka'l thangka'l vamsa attava'naiyaith theadi, athaik kaa'naama'rpoay, aasaariya oozhiyaththi'rku vilakkamaanavarka'l en'ru e'n'nappattaarka'l.
ooreem thummeem enpavaika'lu'l'la oru aasaariyan ezhumpumattum, ivarka'l makaa parisuththamaanathilea pusikkaththakaathen'ru thirshaathaa avarka'lukkuch sonnaan.
sapaiyaar ellaarum eakaththi'rku naa'rpaththeeraayiraththu munnoot'ru a'rupathupearaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'laiththavira eazhaayiraththu munnoot'ru muppaththeazhupearaana avarka'ludaiya vealaikkaararum vealaikkaarika'lum, irunoo'ru paadakarum paadakika'lum avarka'lukku irunthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya kuthiraika'l ezhunoot'ru muppaththaa'ru, avarka'ludaiya koavea'ru kazhuthaika'l irunoot'ru naa'rpaththainthu,
avarka'ludaiya ottakangka'l naanoot'ru muppaththainthu, kazhuthaika'l aa'raayiraththu ezhunoot'ru irupathu.

vamsangka'lin thalaivaril silar erusaleamilu'l'la karththarudaiya aalayaththukku vanthapoathu, theavanudaiya aalayaththai athin sthaanaththilea eduppikkumpadikku, atha'rkaaka manau'rchaakamaayk kaa'nikkaika'laik koduththaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l sakthikkuththakkathaaka thiruppa'nip pokkishaththi'rku a'rupaththoaraayiram thangkakkaasaiyum, aiyaayiram iraaththal ve'l'liyaiyum, noo'ru aasaariya vasthirangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l.

aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, janangka'lil silarum, paadakarum, vaasalkaavalaa'larum, nithaneemiyarum, thangka'lthangka'l patta'nangka'lilum, isravealar ellaarum thangka'l thangka'l patta'nangka'lilum kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
israveal puththirar patta'nangka'lilea kudiyea'ri, eazhaam maathamaanapoathu, janangka'l eakoapiththu erusaleamilea koodinaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoasathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavum, avan sakoathararaakiya aasaariyarum, seyalthiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapealum, avan sakoathararum ezhumpi, theavanudaiya manithanaakiya moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi sarvaangka thakanangka'laip paliyidumpadikku, isravealudaiya theavanin palipeedaththaik kattinaarka'l.

avarka'l aththeasaththin janangka'lukkup payanthathinaal, palipeedaththai athin aathaarangka'linmeal sthaapiththu, athinmeal avarka'l karththarukku anthisanthi sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththinaarka'l.
ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea avarka'l koodaarappa'ndikaiyai aasariththu, niththiya niyamaththinpadiyum an'raadakak ka'nakkinpadiyum ovvorunaa'lilum paliyittaarka'l.

atha'rkuppinpu niththamum, maathappi'rappuka'lilum, karththarudaiya sakala parisuththa pa'ndikaika'lilum seluththum sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum, karththarukku avaravar seluththum u'rchaakapaliyaiyum seluththinaarka'l.
eazhaam maatham muthaltheathiyil karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththath thodangkinaarka'l; aanaalum karththarudaiya aalayaththin asthipaaram innum poadappadavillai.

appozhuthu persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas thangka'lukkup pi'rappiththa uththaravinpadiyea avarka'l kalthachcharukkum thachcharukkum pa'naththaiyum, leepanoanilirunthu keathurumarangka'laich samuththiravazhiyaay yoapaamattum ko'nduvarach seethoaniyarukkum theeriyarukkum poajanapaanaththaiyum e'n'neyaiyum koduththaarka'l.

avarka'l erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththi'rku vantha ira'ndaam varusham ira'ndaam maathaththilea, seyalthiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapealum, yoasathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavum, mat'rumu'l'la avarka'l sakoathararaakiya aasaariyarum leaviyarum, si'raiyiruppilirunthu erusaleamukku vantha anaivarum, aarampagnseythu, irupathuvayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta leaviyaraik karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai nadaththumpadi vaiththaarka'l.

appadiyea theavanudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyaich seyki'ravarka'lai nadaththumpadi yesuvaavum avan kumaararum sakoathararum, kathmiyealum avan kumaararum, yoothaavin kumaararum, enaathaaththin kumaararum, avarka'l sakoathararaakiya leaviyarum orumanappattu nin'raarka'l.

si'rpaasaarika'l karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku asthipaaram poaduki'rapoathu, israveal raajaavaakiya thaaveethudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyea, karththaraith thuthikkumpadikku, vasthirangka'l tharikkappattu, poorikaika'lai oothuki'ra aasaariyaraiyum, thaa'langka'laik kottuki'ra aasaapin kumaararaakiya leaviyaraiyum ni'ruththinaarka'l.

karththar nallavar, isravealinmeal avarudaiya kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru avaraip pukazhnthu thuthikkaiyil, maa'rimaa'rip paadinaarka'l; karththaraith thuthikkaiyil, janangka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya aalayaththin asthipaaram poadappaduki'rathinimiththam makaa kempeeramaay aaravaariththaarka'l.

munthina aalayaththaik ka'ndiruntha muthirvayathaana aasaariyarilum, leaviyarilum, pithaakka'l vamsangka'lin thalaivarilum aneakar intha aalayaththukkuth thangka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka asthipaaram poadappaduki'rathaik ka'ndapoathu, makaa saththamittu azhuthaarka'l; vea'rea aneakampearoa kempeera santhoashamaay aarppariththaarka'l.

janangka'l makaa kempeeramaay aarpparikki'rathinaal avarka'l saththam vekuthooram keadkappattathu; aanaalum santhoasha aaravaaraththin saththam innathen'rum, janangka'ludaiya azhukaiyin saththam innathen'rum pakuththa'riyakkoodaathirunthathu.
si'raiyiruppilirunthu vantha janangka'l isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku aalayaththaik kattuki'raarka'l en'ru yoothaavukkum penyameenukkum iruntha saththurukka'l kea'lvippattapoathu,

avarka'l serupaapealidaththukkum thalaivaraana pithaakka'lidaththukkum vanthu: ungka'loadeakooda naangka'lum kattuvoam; ungka'laippoala naangka'lum ungka'l theavanai naaduvoam; ivvidaththukku engka'lai varappa'n'nina aseeriyaavin raajaavaakiya esaraththoan naadka'l mutha'rko'ndu avarukku naangka'lum paliyittuvaruki'roam en'ru avarka'loadea sonnaarka'l.

atha'rkuch serupaapealum, yesuvaavum, isravealil mat'rumu'l'la thalaivaraana pithaakka'lum avarka'lai noakki: engka'l theavanukku aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rku ungka'lukkum engka'lukkum sampanthamillai; persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas raajaa engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadi, naangka'lea isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku athaik kattuvoam en'raarka'l.
athinaal antha theasaththu janangka'l yoothaa janaththin kaika'laith tha'larappa'n'ni, kattaathapadikku avarka'laich sangkadappaduththi,

persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareasin kaalamuzhuthum, thariyu ennum persiyaa raajaa arasaa'ndakaalamattum, avarka'l yoasanaiyai avaththamaakkumpadi avarka'lukku viroathamaay aaloasanaikkaararukkuk kaikkooli kattinaarka'l.
akaasvearu arasaa'luki'rapoathu, avanudaiya raajyapaaraththin thuvakkaththilea, yoothaavilum erusaleamilum kudiyirukki'ravarka'lukku viroathamaakap piriyaathu ezhuthinaarka'l.

arthasashdaavin naadka'lilum, pislaamum, miththireathaaththum, thaapeyealum, mat'rumu'l'la avarka'l vakaiyaraavum, persiyaa raajaavaana arthasashdaavukku oru manu ezhuthinaarka'l; antha manu seeriya ezhuththilum seeriya paashaiyilum ezhuthiyirunthathu.
aaloasanaith thalaivanaakiya rekoomum ka'nakkanaakiya simsaavum erusaleamukku viroathamaaka arthasashdaa ennum raajaavukku ezhuthina manuvilea kaiyoppam poattavarka'l yaaren'raal:

aaloasanaith thalaivanaakiya rekoomum, ka'nakkanaakiya simsaayum, mat'rumu'l'la avarka'l vakaiyaraavaakiya theenaaviyar, apa'rsaaththiyar, tharpealiyar, appaarsiyar, a'rkeaviyar, paapiloaniyar, sooshangkiyar, thekaaviyar, ealaamiyaraanavarka'lum,

periyavarum pearpet'ravarumaana asnaappaar avvidangka'lilirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvanthu samaariyaavin patta'naththilea kudiyea'rappa'n'nina mat'ra janangka'lum, nathikku ippaalea irukki'ra mat'ra janangka'lumea.
avarka'l arthasashdaa ennum raajaavukku anuppina manuvin nakalaavathu: nathikku ippu'raththil irukki'ra umathu adiyaar muthalaanavarka'l a'rivikki'rathu ennaven'raal,

ummidaththilirunthu engka'lidaththi'rku vantha yoothar erusaleamilea koodi, kalakamum pollaappumaana anthap patta'naththi'rku asthipaarangka'lai i'naiththu, athin mathilka'lai ezhuppik kattuki'raarka'l enpathu raajaavukku a'riyalaavathaaka.

ippoathum inthap patta'nam kattappattu, alangkangka'l eduppikkappattuth theernthaal, avarka'l pakuthiyaiyum theervaiyaiyum aayaththaiyum kodukkamaattaarka'l; athinaal raajaakka'lin varumaanaththi'rku nashdam varum en'ru raajaavukku a'riyalaavathaaka.

ippoathum naangka'l aramanai upputh thinki'rapadiyinaal, raajaavukkuk ku'raivuvarap paarththirukki'rathu engka'lukku adaathakaariyam; aakaiyaal naangka'l ithai anuppi, raajaavukkuth theriyappaduththuki'roam.

ummudaiya pithaakka'lin nadapadi pusthakangka'lil soathiththuppaarkka uththaravaakavea'ndum; appozhuthu inthap patta'nam kalakamum, raajaakka'lukkum seemaika'lukkum nashdamum u'ndaakkuki'ra patta'nam en'rum, poorvakaalamuthal kalaathi u'l'lathaayirunthapadiyinaal inthap patta'nam paazhkkadikkappattathu en'rum, antha nadapadi pusthakangka'lil ka'nda'riyalaam.

aakaiyaal inthap patta'nam kattappattu, ithin alangkangka'l eduppikkappattuth theernthaal, nathikku ippu'raththilea umakku on'rum iraatheapoam enpathai raajaavukku a'riyappaduththuki'roam en'ru ezhuthi anuppinaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa aaloasanaith thalaivanaakiya rekoomukkum, ka'nakkanaakiya simsaayikkum, samaariyaavil kudiyirukki'ra mat'rumu'l'la avarka'ludaiya vakaiyaraavukkum, nathikku appu'raththil irukki'ra mat'ravarka'lukkum ezhuthiyanuppina pirathiyuththaramaavathu: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam,
neengka'l anuppina manu namathu samukaththil theerkkamaay vaasikkappattathu.
nammudaiya uththaravinaal soathiththup paarkkumpoathu, anthap patta'nam poorvakaalamuthal raajaakka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpinathu en'rum, athilea kalakamum raajathuroakamum kaa'nappattathu en'rum,

erusaleamil vallamaiyu'l'la raajaakka'l irunthaarka'l en'rum, avarka'l nathikku appu'raththil irukki'ra sakala theasangka'laiyum aa'nduvanthaarka'l en'rum, pakuthiyum theervaiyum aayamum avarka'lukkuch seluththappattathu en'rum theriyavaruki'rathu.
ippozhuthum nammidaththilirunthu ma'ruuththaravu pi'rakkumvaraiyum antha manithar anthap patta'naththaik kattaamal ni'ruththividumpadi katta'laiyidungka'l.
ithilea neengka'l thava'raathapadi echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; raajaakka'lukku nashdamum seathamum varavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru ezhuthi anuppinaan.

raajaavaakiya arthasashdaavudaiya uththaravin nakal rekoomukkum, ka'nakkanaakiya simsaayikkum, avarka'l vakaiyaraavukku munpaaka vaasikkappattapoathu, avarka'l theeviraththudanea erusaleamilirukki'ra yootharidaththi'rkup poay, palavanthaththoadum kattaayaththoadum avarka'lai vealaiseyyaathapadikku ni'ruththippoattaarka'l.
appozhuthu erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththin vealai thadaipattu, persiyaavin raajaavaakiya thariyu raajyapaarampa'n'nina ira'ndaam varushamattum ni'ruththappattirunthathu.

appozhuthu aakaay theerkkatharisiyum, iththoavin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaa ennum theerkkatharisiyum, yoothaavilum erusaleamilumu'l'la yootharukku israveal theavanin naamaththilea theerkkatharisanam sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu seyalthiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapealum yoasathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavum ezhumpi, erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththaik kattaththodangkinaarka'l; avarka'lukkuth thidansolla theavanudaiya theerkkatharisika'lum irunthaarka'l.

akkaalaththilea nathikku ippu'raththil irukki'ra naaduka'lukku athipathiyaakiya thathnaay enpavanum, seaththaarposnaayum, avarka'l vakaiyaraavum avarka'lidaththukku vanthu, intha aalayaththaik kattavum, intha mathilai eduppikkavum ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittavan yaar en'ru avarka'laik keattaarka'l.
appozhuthu atha'rku eat'ra uththaravaiyum, intha maa'likaiyaik kattuki'ra manitharin naamangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuch sonnoam.

aanaalum inthach seythi thariyuvinidaththi'rkup poay ettuki'ravaraikkum ivarka'l yootharudaiya moopparin vealaiyaith thadukkaathapadikku, avarka'ludaiya theavanin ka'n avarka'lmeal vaikkappattirunthathu; appozhuthu ithaikku'riththu avarka'l sonna ma'rumozhiyaik kadithaththil ezhuthiyanuppinaarka'l.

nathikku ippu'raththilirukki'ra thathnaay ennum theasaathipathiyum, seaththaarposnaayum, nathikku ippu'raththilirukki'ra appa'rsaakiyaraana avan vakaiyaraavum, raajaavaakiya thariyuvukku ezhuthiyanuppina kadithaththin nakalaavathu:
raajaavaakiya thariyuvukkuch sakala samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

naangka'l yoothar seemaiyilu'l'la makaa theavanudaiya aalayaththukkup poanoam; athu perungka'rka'laal kattappaduki'rathu; mathilka'linmeal uththirangka'l paaychchappattu, antha vealai thurisaay nadanthu, avarka'lukkuk kaikoodivaruki'rathenpathu raajaavukkuth theriyalaavathaaka.
appozhuthu naangka'l avarka'l moopparka'lai noakki: intha aalayaththaik kattavum, intha mathilai eduppikkavum ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittathu yaar en'ru keattoam.
ithuvumallaamal, avarka'lukku'l'lea thalaivaraana manithar innaaren'ru umakku ezhuthi a'riyappaduththumpadi avarka'l naamangka'l ennaven'rum keattoam.

avarka'l engka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naangka'l paraloakaththukkum pooloakaththukkum theavanaayirukki'ravarukku adiyaaraayirunthu, isravealin periya raajaa oruvan aneaka varushangka'lukkumunnea kattiththeerththa intha aalayaththai naangka'l ma'rupadiyum kattuki'roam.

engka'l pithaakka'l paraloakaththin theavanukkuk koapamoottinapadiyinaal, avar ivarka'laip paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ennum kaltheayan kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avan intha aalayaththai nirmoolamaakki, janaththaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanaan.
aanaalum paapiloan raajaavaakiya koareasin muthalaam varushaththilea koareas raajaavaanavar theavanudaiya intha aalayaththaik kattumpadi katta'laiyittaar.

neapukaathneachchaar erusaleamiliruntha theavaalayaththilirunthu eduththu, paapiloan koavilil ko'ndupoay vaiththiruntha theavanudaiya aalayaththin pon ve'l'lip pa'nimuttuka'laiyum raajaavaakiya koareas paapiloan koavililirunthu eduththu, avar theasaathipathiyaaka niyamiththa sespaathsaarennum naamamu'l'lavanidaththil avaika'lai oppuviththu,
avanai noakki: nee inthap pa'nimuttuka'lai eduththu, erusaleamilirukkum theavaalayaththukkuk ko'ndupoa; theavanudaiya aalayam athin sthaanaththilea kattappadavea'ndum en'raar.

appozhuthu anthach sespaathsaar vanthu, erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththin asthipaaraththaip poattaan; annaa'lmuthal ithuvaraikkum athu kattappattuvaruki'rathu; athu innum mudiyavillai en'raarka'l.

ippozhuthum raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththaik katta, raajaavaakiya koareas katta'laiyittathu'ndoa en'ru paapiloanil irukki'ra raajaavin kajaanaavilea aaraaynthu paarkkavum, intha vishayaththil raajaavinudaiya siththam innathen'ru engka'lukku ezhuthiyanuppavum uththaravaakavea'ndum en'ru ezhuthiyanuppinaarka'l.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya thariyu itta katta'laiyinpadiyea paapiloan kajaanaavilu'l'la thasthira a'raiyaich soathiththaarka'l.
meathiya seemaiyilirukki'ra akmeathaa patta'naththin aramanaiyilea oru suru'l akappattathu; athilea ezhuthiyiruntha viparamaavathu:

raajaavaakiya koareasin muthalaam varushaththil, koareas raajaa erusaleamiliruntha theavaalayaththaikku'riththup pi'rappiththa uththaravu ennaven'raal: theavaalayamaanathu paliseluththappattuvantha sthaanaththilea kattappadakkadavathu; athin asthipaarangka'l palamaayiruppathaaka; athu a'rupathu muzha uyaramum, a'rupathu muzha akalamumaayirukkavea'ndum.
athu moon'ru varisai perungka'rka'laalum, oru machchuvarisai puthu uththirangka'laalum kattappadakkadavathu; atha'rkuch sellum selavu raajaavin aramanaiyilirunthu kodukkappaduvathaaka.

an'riyum neapukaathneachchaar erusaleamiliruntha aalayaththilirunthu eduththu, paapiloanukkuk ko'nduvantha theavanudaiya aalayaththukkaduththa pon ve'l'lip pa'nimuttuka'l erusaleamilu'l'la theavaalayamaakiya thangka'l sthaanaththi'rkup poaych searumpadikkuth thirumpak kodukkappadakkadavathu; avaika'lai theavanudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'ndupoakakkadavarka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

appozhuthu thariyuraajaa ezhuthiyanuppinathaavathu: ippozhuthum, nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra theasaathipathiyaakiya thathnaayum seaththaarposnaayumaakiya neengka'lum, nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra appa'rsaakiyaraana ungka'l vakaiyaraa yaavarum avvidaththaivittu vilakiyirungka'l.
theavanudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai avarka'l seyyattum, yootharudaiya athipathiyum, yootharin moopparum, theavanudaiya aalayaththai athin sthaanaththilea kattakkadavarka'l.

theavanudaiya aalayaththai yootharin mooppar kattum vishayaththil neengka'l avarka'lukkuch seyyaththakkathaay, nammaal u'ndaana katta'lai ennaven'raal, antha manitharukkuth thadai u'ndaakaathapadikku, nathikku appu'raththil vaangkappadum pakuthiyaakiya raajaavin thiraviyaththilea avarka'lukkuth thaamathamillaamal sellum selavu kodukkavea'ndum.

paraloakaththin theavanukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyidath theavaiyaana i'langkaa'laika'l, aattukkadaakka'l, aattukkuttika'l, koathumai, uppu, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney muthalaanavai thinanthinam avarka'l so'rpadi thaazhchchiyillaamal kodukkappadakkadavathu.

erusaleamilirukki'ra aasaariyarka'l paraloakaththin theavanukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana palika'laich seluththi, raajaavukkum avar kumaararukkum theerkkaayusu'ndaaka man'raadumpadikku ippadich seyyappaduvathaaka.

pinnum nammaal pi'rakkum katta'lai ennaven'raal: entha manithanaavathu inthak katta'laiyai maat'rinaal, avan veettilirunthu oru uththiram pidungki naattappattu, avan athil thookkippoadappadavum, athinimiththamaaka avanudaiya veedu kuppaimeadaakkappadavungkadavathu.

aakaiyaal ithai maat'ravum, erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayaththaik kedukkavum, thangka'l kaiyai neettappoaki'ra sakala raajaakka'laiyum sakala janangka'laiyum thammudaiya naamaththai angkea vi'langkappa'n'nina theavan nirmoolamaakkakkadavar; thariyuvaakiya naam inthak katta'laiyaik koduththoam; ithinpadi jaakkirathaiyaaych seyyappadakkadavathu en'ru ezhuthiyanuppinaan.
appozhuthu nathikku ippu'raththilirukki'ra theasaathipathiyaakiya thathnaayum, seaththaarposnaayum, avarka'l vakaiyaraavum, thariyuraajaa katta'laiyittapirakaaram jaakkirathaiyaaych seythaarka'l.

appadiyea yootharin mooppar kattinaarka'l; theerkkatharisiyaakiya aakaayum iththoavin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaavum theerkkatharisanam sollivanthapadiyinaal avarka'ludaiya kaariyam kaikoodi vanthathu; avarka'l isravealin theavanudaiya katta'laippadiyeayum, koareas, thariyu, persiyaavin raajaavaakiya arthasashdaa enpavarka'ludaiya katta'laippadiyeayum athaik katti mudiththaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya thariyu arasaa'luki'ra aa'raam varusham aathaar ennum maatham moon'raantheathiyilea antha aalayam katti mudinthathu.
appozhuthu israveal puththirarum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, si'raiyiruppilirunthu vantha mat'ravarka'lum, theavanudaiya aalayap pirathishdaiyaich santhoashamaayk ko'ndaadinaarka'l.

theavanudaiya aalayaththin pirathishdaikkaaka noo'ru kaa'laika'laiyum, irunoo'ru aattukkadaakka'laiyum, naanoo'ru aattukkuttika'laiyum, israveal koaththirangka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea, israveal anaiththin paavanivaara'napalikkaakap pannira'ndu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum paliyittu,

moaseayin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea, avarka'l erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya aaraathanaikken'ru aasaariyarai avarka'l vakuppuka'linpadiyum, leaviyarai avarka'l mu'raivarisaika'linpadiyum ni'ruththinaarka'l.
si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'l muthalaam maatham pathinaalaantheathiyilea paskaavaiyum aasariththaarka'l.

aasaariyarum leaviyarum orumanappattuth thangka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndathinaal, ellaarum suththamaayirunthu, si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'l ellaarukkaakavum, aasaariyaraana thangka'l sakoathararukkaakavum, thangka'lukkaakavum paskaavin aattukkuttika'lai adiththaarka'l.

appadiyea si'raiyiruppilirunthu thirumpivantha israveal puththirarum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarai naadumpadi, pooloaka jaathika'lin asuththaththai vittu, avarka'la'ndaiyilea searntha anaivarum athaip pusiththu,

pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyai eazhunaa'laakach santhoashaththudanea aasariththaarka'l; karththar avarka'lai makizhchchiyaakki, avarka'l kaika'lai isravealin theavan ennum theavanudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyilea palappaduththaththakkathaay aseeriyarudaiya raajaavin iruthayaththai avarka'l padchaththil saarnthirukkappa'n'ninaar.

intha varththamaanangka'lukkuppinpu, seraayaavin kumaaranaakiya es'raa, persiyaavin raajaavaakiya arthasashdaa arasaa'luki'ra kaalaththilea paapiloanilirunthu vanthaan; inthach seraayaa asariyaavin kumaaran, ivan ilkkiyaavin kumaaran,
ivan salloomin kumaaran, ivan saathoakkin kumaaran, ivan akithoopin kumaaran,
ivan amariyaavin kumaaran, ivan asariyaavin kumaaran, ivan meraayoathin kumaaran,
ivan searaakiyaavin kumaaran, ivan oosiyin kumaaran, ivan pukkiyin kumaaran,
ivan apisuvaavin kumaaran, ivan pinekaasin kumaaran, ivan eleyaasaarin kumaaran, ivan pirathaana aasaariyanaana aaroanin kumaaran.

intha es'raa isravealin theavanaakiya karththar aru'liya moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththilea thea'rina veathapaarakanaayirunthaan; avanudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya karam avanmeal irunthathinaal, avan keattavaika'laiyellaam raajaa avanukkuk koduththaan.

avanoadeakooda israveal puththirarilum, aasaariyarilum, leaviyarilum, paadakarilum, vaasal kaavalaa'larilum, nithaneemiyarilum, silar arthasashdaa raajaavin eazhaam varushaththilea erusaleamukkup poanaarka'l.
ainthaam maathaththil avan erusaleamukku vanthaan; athu antha raajaavin eazhaam varushamaanathu.

muthalaam maatham muthaltheathiyilea avan paapiloanilirunthu pirayaa'namaakap pu'rappattu, ainthaam maatham muthaltheathiyilea than theavanudaiya thayavu'l'la karam thanmealirunthathinaal erusaleamukku vanthaan.
karththarudaiya veathaththai aaraayavum, athinpadi seyyavum, isravealilea katta'laika'laiyum neethiniyaayangka'laiyum upatheasikkavum, es'raa than iruthayaththaip pakkuvappaduththiyirunthaan.

karththarudaiya ka'rpanaika'lin vaarththaika'lilum, avar isravealukkuk koduththa katta'laika'lilum, padiththuth thea'rina veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ennum aasaariyanukku, raajaavaakiya arthasashdaa koduththa sannathin nakalaavathu:

raajaathiraajaavaakiya arthasashdaa paraloakaththin theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththaip poathikki'ra uththama veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ennum aasaariyanukkup poora'na samaathaanamu'ndaaka vaazhththi ezhuthuki'rathu ennaven'raal:

nammudaiya raajyaththil irukki'ra israveal janaththilum, athin aasaariyarilum, leaviyarilum, unnoadeakooda erusaleamukkup poaka manappoorvamaayirukki'ra yaavarum poakalaam en'ru nammaalea uththaravaaki'rathu.
nee un kaiyilirukki'ra un theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi, yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum visaariththu nadaththavum,
raajaavum avarudaiya manthirimaarum erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra isravealin theavanukku manappoorvamaayk koduththa ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum,

paapiloan seemaiyengkum unakkuk kidaikkum ellaa ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum, unnudaiya janamum aasaariyarum erusaleamilu'l'la thangka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukken'ru manau'rchaakamaayk kodukkum kaa'nikkaika'laiyum nee ko'ndupoakavum, nee raajaavinaalum avarudaiya eazhu manthirimaaraalum anuppappaduki'raay.

aakaiyaal anthath thiraviyaththinaal nee thaamathamin'ri kaa'laika'laiyum, aattukkadaakka'laiyum, aattukkuttika'laiyum, avaika'lukkaduththa poajanapalika'laiyum, paanapalika'laiyum vaangki, avaika'lai erusaleamilu'l'la ungka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththup palipeedaththinmeal seluththuvaayaaka.
meethiyaana ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum ko'ndu seyyavea'ndiyathinnathen'ru unakkum un sakoathararukkum nalamaayth thoan'ruki'rapadi athai ungka'l theavanudaiya siththaththinpadiyea seyyungka'l.
un theavanudaiya aalayaththin aaraathanaikkaaka unakkuk kodukkappatta pa'nimuttuka'laiyum nee erusaleamin theavanudaiya sannithiyil oppuvikkakkadavaay.
pinnum un theavanudaiya aalayaththukku avasiyamaayk kodukkavea'ndiyiruppathai, nee raajaavin kajaanaavilirunthu vaangkik koduppaayaaka.

nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra ellaa kajaansika'lukkum arthasashdaa ennum raajaavaakiya naam iduki'ra katta'lai ennaven'raal, paraloakaththin theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththaip poathikkum veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ennum aasaariyan noo'ru thaalanthu ve'l'li, noot'rukkalak koathumai, noot'rukkalath thiraadcharasam, noot'rukkala e'n'neymattum ungka'laik keadpavai ellaavat'raiyum,
vea'ndiya uppaiyum, thaamathamillaamal kodukkavum,

paraloakaththin theavanudaiya ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea, ethu theavaiyaayirukkumoa athuvellaam paraloakaththin theavanudaiya aalayaththi'rku jaakkirathaiyaaych seluththappadavum vea'ndum; raajaavum avar kumaararum aa'lum raajyaththinmeal kadungkoapam varuvaanean.

pinnum aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, paadakarum, vaasal kaavalaa'larum, nithaneemiyarum, theavanudaiya aalayaththin pa'nividaikkaararumaana oruvanmealum pakuthiyaakilum theervaiyaakilum aayamaakilum sumaththalaakaathen'ru avarka'laikku'riththu ungka'lukku a'riyappaduththuki'roam.

pinnum nathikku appu'raththilirunthu un theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nangka'lai a'rintha sakala janangka'laiyum niyaayam visaarikkaththakka thuraika'laiyum, niyaayaathipathika'laiyum, es'raavaakiya nee unnilu'l'la un theavanudaiya gnaanaththinpadiyea ea'rpaduththuvaayaaka; anthap piramaa'nangka'lai a'riyaathavarka'lukku avaika'lai upatheasikkavungkadavaay.

un theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyeayum, raajaavinudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyeayum seyyaathavanevanum udanea mara'naththukkaakilum, theasaththukkup pu'rampaakkuthalukkaakilum, aparaathaththukkaakilum, kaavalukkaakilum theerkkappattuth tha'ndikkappadakkadavan en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

erusaleamilu'l'la karththarudaiya aalayaththai alangkarikka, ippadippatta yoasanaiyai raajaavin iruthayaththil aru'li, raajaavukkum avarudaiya manthirimaarka'lukkum raajaavin kaikku'l'laana palaththa ellaa makaap pirapukka'lukkum munpaaka enakkuth thayavu kidaikkappa'n'nina engka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram.
appadiyea en theavanaakiya karththarudaiya karam enmeal irunthathinaal naan thidanko'ndu, isravealil sila thalaivarai ennoadeakooda varumpadi searththukko'ndean.
arthasashdaa raajaa arasaa'lum kaalaththil paapiloanilirunthu ennoadeakooda vantha thangka'l pithaakka'l vamsangka'lin thalaivarum avarka'l vamsa attava'naika'lumaavana:
pinekaasin puththiraril kersoam, iththaamaarin puththiraril thaaniyeal, thaaveethin puththiraril aththoos,
paaroashin puththiraril oruvanaana sekkaniyaavin puththiraril sakariyaavum, avanoadeakooda vamsa attava'naiyil ezhuthiyirukki'ra noot'raimpathu aa'nmakka'lum,
paakaathmoavaapin puththiraril serakiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyoanaayum, avanoadeakooda irunoo'ru aa'nmakka'lum,
sekkaniyaavin puththiraril yakasiyealin kumaaranum, avanoadeakooda munnoo'ru aa'nmakka'lum,
aathinin puththiraril yoanaththaanin kumaaranaakiya eapeathum, avanoadeakooda aimpathu aa'nmakka'lum,
ealaamin puththiraril athaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya eshaayaavum, avanoadeakooda ezhupathu aa'nmakka'lum,
seppathiyaavin puththiraril mikavealin kumaaranaakiya seppathiyaavum, avanoadeakooda e'npathu aa'nmakka'lum,
yoavaapin puththiraril yekiyealin kumaaranaakiya opathiyaavum, avanoadeakooda irunoot'rup pathinettu aa'nmakka'lum,
seloamiththin puththiraril yosipiyaavin kumaaranum, avanoadeakooda noot'ra'rupathu aa'nmakka'lum,
peyaayin puththiraril peyaayin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaavum, avanoadeakooda irupaththettu aa'nmakka'lum,
askaathin puththiraril kaaththaanin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, avanoadeakooda noot'ruppaththu aa'nmakka'lum,
athoanikaamin kadaisippuththiraraana elipealeath, eayel, semaayaa ennum naamangka'lu'l'lavarka'lum, avarka'loadeakooda a'rupathu aa'nmakka'lum,
pikvaayin puththiraril ooththaayum, sapoothum, avarka'loadeakooda ezhupathu aa'nmakka'lumea.

ivarka'lai naan akaavaavukku oaduki'ra nathiya'ndaiyilea koottikko'ndupoanean; angkea moon'runaa'l thangkiyirunthoam; naan janangka'laiyum aasaariyaraiyum paarvaiyidumpoathu, leaviyin puththiraril oruvaraiyum angkea kaa'navillai.

aakaiyaal naan eliyeasar, ariyeal, semaayaa, elnaaththaan, yaarip, elnaaththaan, naaththaan, sakariyaa, misullaam ennum thalaivaraiyum, yoayaarip, elnaaththaan ennum puththimaanka'laiyum azhaippiththu,

kasippiyaa ennum sthalaththilirukki'ra thalaivanaakiya iththoavidaththi'rkuch seythi ko'ndupoaka avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththu, namathu theavanudaiya aalayaththup pa'nividaikkaararai engka'lidaththi'rku azhaiththuvarumpadi, avarka'l kasippiyaa ennum sthalaththilirukki'ra thangka'l sakoatharanaakiya iththoavukkum, nithaneemiyarukkum sollavea'ndiya vaarththaika'laich sollikkoduththean.

avarka'l engka'lmealiruntha engka'l theavanudaiya thayaiyu'l'la karaththinpadiyea, isravealukkup pi'rantha leaviyin kumaaranaakiya makealiyin puththiraril puththiyu'l'la manushanaakiya serepiyaavum avan kumaararum sakoathararumaana pathinettuppearaiyum,
meraariyarin puththiraril ashapiyaavum avanoadea eshaayaavum avan sakoathararum avarka'l kumaararumaana irupathupearaiyum,

thaaveethum pirapukka'lum leaviyarukkup pa'nividaikkaararaaka vaiththa nithaneemiyaril irunoot'ru irupathupearaiyum, engka'lidaththil azhaiththukko'nduvanthaarka'l; avarka'l ellaarudaiya pearka'lum ku'rikkappattana.

appozhuthu naangka'l engka'l theavanukku munpaaka engka'laith thaazhththuki'ratha'rkum, engka'lukkaakavum engka'l pi'l'laika'lukkaakavum engka'l sakala poru'lka'lukkaakavum sevvaiyaana vazhiyaith theaduki'ratha'rkum, naan angkea antha akaavaa nathiya'ndaiyilea upavaasaththaik koo'rinean.

vazhiyilea saththuruvai vilakki, engka'lukkuth thu'naiseyyumpadikku, naan raajaavinidaththil seavakaraiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum keadka vedkappattirunthean; engka'l theavanudaiya karam thammaith theaduki'ravarka'l ellaarmealum avarka'lukku nanmaiyaaka irukki'rathen'rum, avarudaiya vallamaiyum avarudaiya koapamum avarai vittu vilakuki'ravarka'l ellaarmealum irukki'rathen'rum, naangka'l raajaavukkuch solliyirunthoam.
appadiyea naangka'l upavaasampa'n'ni, engka'l theavanidaththilea athaith theadinoam; engka'l vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'linaar.
pinpu naan aasaariyarin thalaivarilea pannira'ndupearaakiya serepiyaavaiyum, ashpiyaavaiyum, avarka'l sakoathararilea paththuppearaiyum piriththeduththu,

raajaavum, avarudaiya aaloasanaikkaararum, avarudaiya pirapukka'lum, angkeayiruntha sakala isravealarum, engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukken'ru eduththukkoduththa kaa'nikkaiyaakiya ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyum, pa'nimuttuka'laiyum avarka'lidaththil ni'ruththuk koduththean.
avarka'l kaiyilea naan a'runoot'ru aimpathu thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, noo'ruthaalanthu ni'raiyaana ve'l'lip pa'nimuttuka'laiyum, noo'ruthaalanthu ponnaiyum,
aayiram thangkakkaasu pe'rumaana irupathu po'rki'n'nangka'laiyum, ponnaippoala e'n'nappatta pa'lapa'lappaana ira'ndu nalla ve'nkalap paaththirangka'laiyum ni'ruththukkoduththu,

avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l karththarukkup parisuththamaanavarka'l; inthap pa'nimuttuka'lum, ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththarukku manau'rchaakamaaych seluththappatta intha ve'l'liyum, inthap ponnum parisuththamaanavaika'l.

neengka'l athai erusaleamilirukki'ra theavanudaiya aalayaththin a'raika'lil aasaariyar leaviyarudaiya pirapukka'lukkum, isravealudaiya vamsaththalaivarka'lukkum munpaaka ni'ruththu oppuvikkumattum vizhippaayirunthu, athaik kaaththukko'l'lungka'l en'rean.

appadiyea antha aasaariyarum leaviyarum, antha ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum pa'nimuttuka'laiyum erusaleamilirukki'ra engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadikku, ni'ruththu vaangkikko'ndaarka'l.

naangka'l erusaleamukkuppoaka, muthalaam maatham pannira'ndaantheathiyilea, akaavaa nathiyaivittup paya'nam pu'rappattoam; engka'l theavanudaiya karam engka'lmealirunthu, vazhiyilea saththuruvin kaikkum, pathivirukki'ravarka'lin kaikkum engka'laith thappuviththathu.
naangka'l erusaleamukku vanthu, angkea moon'runaa'l irunthapinpu,

naalaam naa'lilea antha ve'l'liyum ponnum pa'nimuttuka'lum, engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththil aasaariyanaakiya uriyaavin kumaaran mereamoaththin kaiyilum, pinekaasin kumaaran eleyaasaarin kaiyilum, ellaavat'ri'rkum iruntha ni'raiyinpadiyeayum ni'ruththu, oppuvikkappattathu; yesuvaavin kumaaran yoasapaaththum, pinnooyin kumaaran novathiyaavum enki'ra leaviyarum avarka'loadeakooda irunthaarka'l.
antha ni'raiyellaam akkaalaththil ezhuthappattathu.

si'raippattu mee'ndavarka'l isravealin theavanukkuch sarvaangka thakanapalika'laaka israveal anaiththinimiththam pannira'ndu kaa'laika'laiyum, tho'n'noot'raa'ru aattukkadaakka'laiyum, ezhupaththeazhu aattukkuttika'laiyum, paavanivaara'naththukkaakap pannira'ndu ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum paliyittu, avaiyellaam karththarukkuch sarvaangka thakanapaliyaakach seluththinaarka'l.

pinpu raajaavin sannathuka'lai nathikku ippu'raththilirukki'ra raajaavin theasaathipathika'lukkum athikaarika'lukkum oppuviththaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'l janangka'lukkum theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum uthaviyaayirunthaarka'l.

ivaika'l seythu mudinthapinpu, pirapukka'l ennidaththil searnthu: israveal janangka'lum, aasaariyarum leaviyarum aakiya ivarka'l, kaanaaniyar, eaththiyar, perisiyar, epoosiyar, ammoaniyar, moavaapiyar, ekipthiyar, ammoariyar ennum intha theasangka'lin janangka'lukkum, avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'lukkum vilakiyirukkavillai.

eppadiyen'raal, avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lilea thangka'lukkum thangka'l kumaararukkum pe'nka'laik ko'ndaarka'l; ippadiyea parisuththa viththuth theasangka'lin janangka'loadea kalanthupoayit'ru; pirapukka'lin kaiyum, athikaarika'lin kaiyum, inthak kut'raththil munthinathaayirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
intha varththamaanaththai naan keattapozhuthu, en vasthiraththaiyum en saalvaiyaiyum naan kizhiththu, en thalaiyilum en thaadiyilumu'l'la mayiraip pidungkith thikaiththavanaay udkaarnthirunthean.

appozhuthu si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'ludaiya kut'raththinimiththam isravealudaiya theavanin vaarththaika'lukku nadungkuki'ra yaavarum ennoadea koodikko'ndaarka'l; naanoa anthippali seluththappadumattum thikaiththavanaay udkaarnthuko'ndirunthean.
anthippali nearaththilea naan thukkaththoadea ezhunthu, kizhiththukko'nda vasthiraththoadum saalvaiyoadum muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu, en kaika'lai en theavanaakiya karththarukku nearaaka viriththu:

en theavanea, naan en mukaththai en theavanaakiya umakku munpaaka ea'redukka vedkik kalangkuki'rean; engka'l akkiramangka'l engka'l thalaikkumealaakap perukit'ru; engka'l kut'ram vaanapariyantham va'larnthupoayit'ru.

engka'l pithaakka'lin naadka'lmuthal innaa'lmattum naangka'l periya kut'raththukku u'l'laayirukki'roam; engka'l akkiramangka'linimiththam naangka'lum, engka'l raajaakka'lum, engka'l aasaariyarka'lum, innaa'lilirukki'rathupoala, anniyatheasa raajaakka'lin kaiyilea, pattayaththukkum, si'raiyiruppukkum, ko'l'laikkum, vedkaththukkum oppukkodukkappattoam.

ippozhuthum engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lilea thappina silarai meethiyaaka vaikkavum, thammudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil engka'lukku oru kuchchaik kodukkavum, ippadiyea engka'l theavan engka'l ka'nka'laip pirakaasippiththu, engka'l adimaiththanaththilea engka'lukkuk kogncham uyir kodukkavum, avaraalea kognchanearamaavathu kirupaikidaiththathu.

naangka'l adimaika'laayirunthoam; aanaalum engka'l adimaiththanaththilea engka'l theavan engka'laik kaividaamal, engka'lukku uyirkodukkavum; naangka'l engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththai eduppiththu, paazhaayppoana athaip puthuppikkumpadikkum engka'lukku yoothaavilum erusaleamilum oru vealiyaik katta'laiyidumpadikkum, persiyaavin raajaakka'l samukaththil engka'lukkuth thayaikidaikkachseythaar.
ippozhuthum engka'l theavanea, naangka'l ini ennasolluvoam; theavareer umathu oozhiyakkaararaakiya theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu ka'rpiththa umathu ka'rpanaika'lai vittuvittoam.

neengka'l suthantharikki'ratha'rku udpiraveasikkum theasamaanathu, theasaatheasangka'ludaiya janangka'lin asangkiyaththinaalum, avarka'l athai oru munaithodangki ma'rumunaimattum ni'raiyappa'n'nina avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linaalum avarka'ludaiya asuththaththinaalum, theettuppattathaayirukki'rathu.

aathalaal neengka'l palaththukko'ndu, theasaththin nanmaiyaip pusiththu, athai niththiyakaalamaaka ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukku umpi'likkaiyaakap pinvaikkumpadikku, neengka'l ungka'l kumaaraththika'lai avarka'ludaiya kumaararukkuk kodaamalum, avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lai ungka'l kumaararukkuk ko'l'laamalum, avarka'ludaiya samaathaanaththaiyum nanmaiyaiyum orukkaalum naadaamalum iruppeerka'laaka en'reerea.

ippozhuthum engka'l theavanea, engka'l pollaatha seykaika'linaalum, engka'l periya kut'raththinaalum, ivaika'lellaam engka'lmeal vanthum, theavareer engka'l akkiramaththukkuththakka aakkinaiyai engka'lukku idaamal, engka'lai ippadith thappavittirukkaiyil,

naangka'l umathu ka'rpanaika'lai vee'naakkavum, intha aruvaruppuka'lu'l'la janangka'loadea sampanthangkalakkavum thakumoa? appadich seythaal, engka'lil oruvarum meenthu thappaathapadikku, theavareer engka'lai nirmoolamaakkumattum engka'lmeal koapamaayiruppeerallavoa?

isravealin theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer neethiyu'l'lavar; aakaiyaal innaa'lil irukki'rathupoala, naangka'l thappi meenthirukki'roam; ithoa, naangka'l umakku munpaakak kut'raththi'rku'l'laanavarka'l; ithinimiththam naangka'l umakku munpaaka ni'rkaththakkavarka'l alla en'ru piraarththiththean.

es'raa ippadi vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, a'rikkaiyittu azhuthu, theavanudaiya aalayaththukku munpaakath thaazha vizhunthukidakkaiyil, isravealil purusharum sthireeka'lum pi'l'laika'lumaana makaa periya sapai avanidaththil vanthu koodit'ru; janangka'l mikavum azhuthaarka'l.

appozhuthu ealaamin puththiraril oruvanaakiya yekiyealin kumaaran sekkaniyaa es'raavai noakki: naangka'l theasaththu janangka'lilu'l'la anniya sthireeka'laich searththukko'ndathinaal, engka'l theavanukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythoam; aakilum ippozhuthu inthak kaariyaththilea innum isravealukkaaka nampikkai u'ndu.

ippozhuthum antha sthireeka'l ellaaraiyum, avarka'lidaththil pi'ranthavarka'laiyum, en aa'ndavanudaiya aaloasanaikkum, namathu theavanudaiya ka'rpanaikku nadungkuki'ravarka'lin aaloasanaikkum eat'rapirakaaram akat'rippoaduvoam en'ru nammudaiya theavanoadea udanpadikkaip pa'n'nakkadavoam; niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyea seyyappaduvathaaka.
ezhunthirum; inthak kaariyaththai nadappikki'rathu umakku aduththathu; naangka'lum ummoadeakooda iruppoam; neer thidanko'ndu ithaich seyyum en'raan.

appozhuthu es'raa ezhunthirunthu, aasaariyarilum leaviyarilum pirathaanamaanavarka'lum israveal anaivarum intha vaarththaiyinpadi seyyumpadikku, avarka'lai aa'naiyidach sonnaan; avarka'l aa'naiyittaarka'l.

athinpinpu es'raa theavanudaiya aalayaththukku munnirunthu ezhunthu, eliyaasipin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanin a'raikku'l piraveasiththaan; angkea vanthapoathu, avan si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'ludaiya kut'raththinimiththam appam pusiyaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum thukkiththukko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'l ellaarum erusaleamilea vanthu koodavea'ndum en'rum,

moon'runaa'laikku'l'lea pirapukka'l moopparka'ludaiya aaloasanaiyinpadiyea evanaakilum varaatheapoanaal, avanudaiya poru'lellaam japthi seyyappattu, si'raiyiruppilirunthu vantha sapaikku avan pu'rampaakkappaduvaan en'rum, yoothaavilum erusaleamilum vi'lamparampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appadiyea yoothaa penyameen koaththiraththaar ellaarum moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea erusaleamilea koodinaarka'l; athu onpathaam maatham irupathaan theathiyaayirunthathu; janangka'l ellaarum theavanudaiya aalayaththin veethiyilea anthak kaariyaththinaalum adaimazhaiyinaalum nadungkikko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu aasaariyanaakiya es'raa ezhunthirunthu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l isravealinmealirukki'ra kut'raththai athikarikkappa'n'na, ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'lai vivaakampa'n'ninathinaal paavagnseytheerka'l.

ippozhuthum neengka'l ungka'l pithaakka'lin theavanaakiya karththaridaththil a'rikkaiyittu, avarudaiya piriyaththinpadiyea seythu, theasaththin janangka'laiyum, ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'laiyum vittu vilakungka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu sapaiyaar yaavarum makaa saththaththoadea pirathiyuththaramaaka: aam, neer sonna vaarththaika'linpadiyea seyyavea'ndiyathuthaan.

aanaalum janangka'l thira'laayirukki'raarka'l, ithu maarikaalamumaayirukki'rathu, ingkea ve'liyilea ni'rka engka'laalea koodaathu; ithu orunaa'l ira'ndunaa'l vealaiyalla; inthak kaariyaththilea katta'lai mee'rinavarka'laakiya naangka'l aneakar.

aakaiyaal itha'rkuch sapaiyengkum engka'l pirapukka'l visaarippukkaararaaka vaikkappadavea'ndum; inthak kaariyaththinimiththam nammudaiya theavanukku irukki'ra ukkirakoapam engka'lai vittuth thirumpumpadi, engka'l patta'nangka'lil ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'laikko'nda anaivarum ovvoru patta'naththin moopparoadum niyaayaathipathika'loadum ku'riththakaalangka'lil varakkadavarka'l en'raarka'l.

aasakealin kumaaran yoanaththaanum, thikkaavin kumaaran yaksiyaavumaaththiram athai visaarikkumpadikku vaikkappattaarka'l; mesullaamum, sappeathaa ennum leaviyanum avarka'lukku uthaviyaayirunthaarka'l.

si'raiyiruppilirunthu vanthavarka'l inthappirakaaram seythaarka'l; aasaariyanaakiya es'raavum, thangka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpaththinpadiyea pearpearaaka azhaikkappatta pithaa vamsangka'lin thalaivar anaivarum, inthak kaariyaththai visaarikkumpadi, paththaam maatham muthaltheathiyilea, thaniththu udkaarnthu,
anniyajaathiyaana sthireeka'laik ko'ndavarka'l ellaarudaiya kaariyaththaiyum muthalaam maatham muthaltheathiyilea visaariththu mudiththaarka'l.

aasaariya puththiraril ma'rujaathiyaana manaivika'laik ko'ndavarka'laakak kaa'nappattavarka'l yaaren'raal: yoasathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavin kumaararilum avan sakoathararilum, maaseyaa, eliyeasar, yaareep, kethaliyaa enpavarka'l.
ivarka'l thangka'l sthireeka'laith tha'l'lividuvoam en'ru kaiyadiththukkoduththu; thaangka'l kut'ravaa'lika'laanapadiyinaal kut'ranivaara'napaliyaaka oru aattukkadaavaich seluththinaarka'l.
immearin puththiraril anaaniyum, sepathiyaavum,
aareemin puththiraril maaseyaa, eliyaa, semaayaa, yekiyeal, usiyaa enpavarka'lum;
paskoorin puththiraril eliyoanaay, maaseyaa, ismaveal, nethaneyeal, yoasapaath, elaasaa enpavarka'lum;
leaviyaril yoasapaath, simeayi, kelithaa ennum pearumu'l'la kelaayaa, peththakeeyaa, yoothaa, eliyeasar enpavarka'lum;
paadakaril eliyaasipum, vaasalkaavalaa'laril salloom, thealeam, oori enpavarka'lum;
mat'ra isravealarukku'l'lea paaroashin puththiraril rameeyaa, yesiyaa, malkiyaa, miyaamin, eleyaasaar, malkijaa, penaayaa enpavarka'lum;
ealaamin puththiraril maththaniyaa, sakariyaa, yekiyeal, apthi, yerimoath, eliyaa enpavarka'lum;
saththoovin puththiraril eliyoanaay, eliyaasip, maththaniyaa, yerimoath, saapaath, asisaa enpavarka'lum;
pepaayin puththiraril yoakanaan, ananiyaa, saapaayi, athlaayi enpavarka'lum;
paaniyin puththiraril mesullaam, mallook, athaayaa, yaasup, seyaal, raamoath enpavarka'lum;
paakaathmoavaapin puththiraril athnaa, kelaal, penaayaa, maaseyaa, maththaniyaa, pesaleyeal, pinnooyi, manaasea enpavarka'lum;
aareemin puththiraril eliyeasar, ishiyaa, malkiyaa, semaayaa, shimiyoan,
penyameen, mallook, semariyaa enpavarka'lum;
aasoomin puththiraril mathnaayi, maththaththaa, saapaath, elipeleath, eremaayi, manaasea, simeyi enpavarka'lum;
paaniyin puththiraril maathaayi, amraam, ooveal,
penaayaa, pethiyaa, kelloo,
vaniyaa, meremoath, eleyaaseep,
maththaniyaa, mathanaay, yaasaay,
paani, pinnooyi, simeyi,
seleamiyaa, naaththaan, athaayaa,
maknaathpaayi, saasaayi, saaraayi,
asareyeal, seleamiyaa, semariyaa,
salloom, amariyaa, yoaseap enpavarka'lum;
neapoavin puththiraril eayel, maththiththiyaa, saapaath, sepinaa, yathaay, yoaveal, penaayaa enpavarka'lumea.
ivarka'l ellaarum ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'laik ko'ndavarka'l; ivarka'lil silar ko'ndiruntha sthireeka'lidaththil pi'l'laika'laip pet'rirunthaarka'l.
