akaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya nekeamiyaavin nadapadika'l: irupathaam varusham kisleayumaathaththil naan soosaan ennum aramanaiyil irukkumpoathu sampaviththathu ennaven'raal,

en sakoathararil oruvanaakiya aanaaniyum, vea'rea sila manusharum yoothaavilirunthu vanthaarka'l; avarka'lidaththil naan si'raiyiruppil meenthu thappina yootharin seythiyaiyum, erusaleamin seythiyaiyum visaariththean.

atha'rku avarka'l: si'raiyiruppil meenthirukki'ravarka'l anthath theasaththilea makaa theengkaiyum ninthaiyaiyum anupavikki'raarka'l; erusaleamin alangkam idipattathum, athin vaasalka'l akkiniyaal sutterikkappattathumaayk kidakki'rathu en'raarka'l.
intha vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu naan udkaarnthu azhuthu, sila naa'laayth thukkiththu, upavaasiththu, man'raadi, paraloakaththin theavanai noakki:

paraloakaththin theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummil anpukoornthu, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku, udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum kaakki'ra makaththuvamum payangkaramumaana theavanea,

umathu adiyaaraakiya israveal puththirarukkaaka in'ru iravumpakalum umakku munpaaka man'raadi, israveal puththiraraakiya naangka'l umakku viroathamaakach seytha paavangka'lai a'rikkaiyiduki'ra adiyeanudaiya jepaththaik keadki'ratha'rku, ummudaiya sevi kavaniththum, ummudaiya ka'nka'l thi'ranthum iruppathaaka; naanum en thakappan veettaarum paavagnseythoam.
naangka'l umakku munpaaka mikavum kettavarka'laay nadanthoam; neer ummudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseakkuk ka'rpiththa ka'rpanaika'laiyum, katta'laika'laiyum, niyaayangka'laiyum kaikko'l'laatheapoanoam.
neengka'l katta'laiyai mee'rinaal, naan ungka'lai jaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radippean en'rum,

neengka'l ennidaththil thirumpi, en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyveerka'laanaal, ungka'lilea tha'l'lu'ndu poanavarka'l vaanaththin kadaiyaantharaththil irunthaalum, naan angkeayirunthu avarka'laich searththu, en naamam vi'langkumpadi naan therinthuko'nda sthalaththukku avarka'laik ko'nduvaruvean en'rum theavareer ummudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseakkuk katta'laiyitta vaarththaiyai ninaiththaru'lum.
theavareer umathu makaa vallamaiyinaalum, umathu palaththa karaththinaalum, meettukko'nda umathu adiyaarum umathu janangka'lum ivarka'lthaanea.

aa'ndavarea, umathu adiyaanin jepaththaiyum, umathu naamaththukkup payappadavea'ndum en'ru virumpuki'ra umathu adiyaarin jepaththaiyum umathu sevika'l kavaniththiruppathaaka; in'raikku umathu adiyaanukkuk kaariyaththaik kaikoodi varappa'n'ni, intha manushanukku munpaaka enakku irakkam kidaikkappa'n'niyaru'lum en'ru piraarththiththean. naan raajaavukkup paanapaaththirakkaaranaayirunthean.

arthasashdaa raajaavin irupathaam varusham nisaan maathaththilea, thiraadcharasam raajaavukku munpaaka vaiththirukkaiyil, naan athai eduththu avarukkuk koduththean; naan mun orupoathum avar samukaththil thukkamaayirunthathillai.
appozhuthu raajaa ennaip paarththu: nee thukkamukamaayirukki'rathu enna? unakku viyaathiyillaiyea, ithu manathin thukkamea ozhiya vea'ron'rum alla en'raar; appozhuthu naan mikavum payanthu,

raajaavai noakki: raajaa en'raikkum vaazhka; en pithaakka'lin kalla'raika'l irukkum sthalamaakiya nakaram paazhaanathum, athin vaasalka'l akkiniyaal sutterikkappattathumaayk kidakkumpoathu, naan thukkamukaththoadu iraathiruppathu eppadi en'rean.
appozhuthu raajaa ennaip paarththu: nee keadki'ra kaariyam enna en'raar. appozhuthu naan: paraloakaththin theavanai noakki jepampa'n'ni,

raajaavaip paarththu: raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthu, adiyeanukku umathu samukaththil thayai kidaiththathaanaal, en pithaakka'lin kalla'raika'lilirukkum patta'naththaik kattumpadi, yoothaa theasaththukku neer ennai anuppavea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'rean.

appozhuthu raajasthireeyum pakkaththil udkaarnthirunthaa'l. raajaa ennaip paarththu: un pirayaa'nam eththanainaa'l sellum, nee eppozhuthu thirumpivaruvaay en'ru keattaar. ivva'lavukaalam sellumen'ru naan raajaavukkuch sonnapoathu, ennai anuppa avarukkuch siththamaayit'ru.

pinnum naan raajaavaip paarththu: raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, naan yoothaa theasaththukkup poaychsearumattum, nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra theasaathipathika'l ennai vazhivittanuppumpadikku avarka'lukkuk kadithangka'l kodukkumpadikkum,

theavaalayaththukku irukki'ra ara'nin kathavu vealaikkum, nakara alangkaththin vealaikkum, naan thangkappoaki'ra veettin vealaikkum vea'ndiya marangka'lai raajaavin vanaththuk kaavalaa'lanaakiya aasaap enakkuk kodukkumpadikkum, avanukkum oru kaditham katta'laiyidappaduvathaaka en'rean; en theavanudaiya thayavu'l'la karam enmeal irunthapadiyaal, raajaa avaika'lai enakkuk katta'laiyittaar.

appadiyea naan nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra theasaathipathika'lidaththukku vanthu, raajaavin kadithangka'lai avarka'lukkuk koduththean; raajaa ennoadeakooda iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararaiyum, kuthiraiveeraraiyum anuppiyirunthaar.

ithai oaroaniyanaana sanpallaaththum, ammoaniyanaana thopiyaa ennum oozhiyakkaaranum keattapoathu, israveal puththirarin nanmaiyai visaarikka oruvan vanthaan enpathu avarka'lukku mikavum visanamaayirunthathu.
naan erusaleamukku vanthu, angkea moon'runaa'l irunthapinpu,

naan sila manusharaik koottikko'ndu, raaththiriyil ezhunthu nakara soathanai seythean; aanaalum erusaleamukkaakach seyyumpadi en theavan en manathilea vaiththathai naan oruvarukkum a'rivikkavillai; naan ea'rippoana mirukameayallaamal vea'roru mirukamum ennoadirunthathillai.

naan an'ru raaththiri pa'l'laththaakkin vaasalvazhiyaayp pu'rappattu, valusarppath thuravaik kadanthu, kuppaimeattu vaasalukku vanthu, erusaleamil idinthupoana alangkaththaiyum, akkiniyaal sutterikkappatta athin vaasalka'laiyum paarvaiyittean.
avvidaththai vittu ooru'ni vaasala'ndaikkum, raajaavin ku'laththa'ndaikkum poanean; naan ea'riyiruntha mirukam angkea nadanthupoaki'ratha'rku vazhiyillaathirunthathu.
an'ru raaththiriyileayea naan aat'roaramaayp poay, alangkaththaip paarvaiyittuth thirumpi, pa'l'laththaakkin vaasalvazhiyaay vanthuvittean.

naan poanathum, naan seythathum athikaarika'l oruvarukkum theriyaathu; athuvaraiyilum naan yootharukkaakilum, aasaariyarka'l periyavarka'l athikaarika'lukkaakilum, vealaiseyki'ra mat'ravarka'lukkaakilum on'rum a'rivikkavillai.

pinpu naan avarka'lai noakki: erusaleam paazhaayirukki'rathaiyum, athin vaasalka'l akkiniyaal sutterikkappattukkidakki'rathaiyum, naam irukki'ra si'rumaiyaiyum paarkki'reerka'lea; naam ini ninthaikku'l'laayiraathapadikku, erusaleamin alangkaththaik kattuvoam vaarungka'l en'ru solli,

en theavanudaiya karam enmeal nanmaiyaaka irukki'rathaiyum, raajaa ennoadea sonna vaarththaika'laiyum avarka'lukku a'riviththean; appozhuthu avarka'l: ezhunthu kattuvoam vaarungka'l en'ru solli, antha nalla vealaikkuth thangka'l kaika'laith thidappaduththinaarka'l.

oaroaniyanaana sanpallaaththum, ammoaniyanaana thopiyaa ennum oozhiyakkaaranum, arapiyanaana keasheamum ithaik keattapoathu, engka'laip pariyaasampa'n'ni, engka'lai ninthiththu: neengka'l seyki'ra inthak kaariyam enna? neengka'l raajaavukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'nappoaki'reerka'loa en'raarka'l.

atha'rku naan ma'rumozhiyaaka: paraloakaththin theavanaanavar engka'lukkuk kaariyaththaik kaikoodivarappa'n'nuvaar; avarudaiya oozhiyakkaararaakiya naangka'l ezhunthu kattuvoam; ungka'lukkoaven'raal erusaleamilea pangkumillai paaththiyamumillai; ungka'l pear vi'langka on'rum illaiyen'ru avarka'ludanea sonnean.

appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya eliyaaseepum, avan sakoathararaakiya aasaariyarka'lum ezhunthu, aattuvaasalaik kattinaarka'l; athaik katti, avarka'l pirathishdaipa'n'ni, athin kathavuka'lai vaiththu, meayaa enki'ra kommaimuthal anaaneyealin kommaimattum kattip pirathishdaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
avan arukea erikoavin manushar kattinaarka'l; avarka'l arukea imriyin kumaaranaakiya sakkoor kattinaan.
meenvaasalai asenaavin kumaarar kattinaarka'l; atha'rku uththarampaavi, atha'rkuk kathavuka'laiyum poottuka'laiyum thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum poattaarka'l.

avarka'l arukea koasin kumaaranaakiya uriyaavin makan meremoath pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; avarka'l arukea mesheasaapeyealin kumaaranaakiya perakiyaavin makan mesullaam pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; avarka'l arukea paanaavin kumaaranaakiya saathoak pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avarka'l arukea thekkoavaa ooraar pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya pirapukka'loa, thangka'l aa'ndavarudaiya vealaikkuth thangka'l kazhuththaik kodukkavillai.

pazhaiya vaasalaip paseyaakin kumaaranaakiya yoaythaavum, peasoathiyaavin kumaaranaakiya mesullaamum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l; avarka'l atha'rku uththarampaavi, atha'rkuk kathavuka'laiyum poottuka'laiyum thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum poattaarka'l.

avarka'l arukea kipiyoan mispaa oorka'lin manusharaana melatheeyaa ennum kipiyoaniyanum, yaathoan ennum meronoaththiyanum, nathikku ippu'raththilirukki'ra athipathiyin samasthaanamattum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.

avarka'l arukea thattaaril oruvanaakiya araayaavin kumaaran oosiyeal pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; avan arukea thailakkaararil oruvan kumaaranaakiya ananiyaa pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; athumutha'rko'ndu akalamaana mathilmattum erusaleam idikkaamal vittirunthathu.
avarka'l arukea erusaleam patta'naththin paathikkup pirapuvaakiya oorin kumaaran reppaayaa pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avarka'l arukea arumaappin kumaaran yethaayaa than veettukku ethiraanathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; avan arukea aasaapneyaavin kumaaran aththoos pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
mat'rap pangkaiyum, soo'laika'lin kommaiyaiyum, aareemin kumaaran malkijaavum, paakaathmoavaapin kumaaran asoopum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.
avan arukea erusaleam patta'naththin ma'rupaathikkup pirapuvaakiya aloakeasin kumaaran salloomum, avan kumaaraththika'lum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.

pa'l'laththaakkin vaasalai aanoonum, saanoavaakin kudika'lum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l; avarka'l athaik katti, atha'rkuk kathavuka'laiyum poottuka'laiyum thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum poattu, kuppaimeattu vaasalmattaaka alangkaththil aayiram muzham kattinaarka'l.

kuppaimeattu vaasalaip pethkeareamin maakaa'naththup pirapuvaakiya rekkaavin kumaaran malkiyaa pazhuthupaarththu, athaik katti, atha'rkuk kathavuka'laiyum poottuka'laiyum thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum poattaan.

ooru'nivaasalai mispaavin maakaa'naththup pirapuvaakiya kolloaseayin kumaaran salloom pazhuthupaarththu, athaik katti, machchuppaavi, atha'rkuk kathavuka'laiyum poottuka'laiyum thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum poattu, raajaavin singkaarath thoattaththa'ndaiyilirukki'ra seeloavaavin ku'laththu mathilaiyum, thaaveethin nakaraththilirunthu i'rangkuki'ra padika'lmattaaka irukki'rathaiyum kattinaan.

avanukkup pinnaakap pethsoor maakaa'naththin paathikkup pirapuvaakiya aspookin kumaaran nekeamiyaa thaaveethin kalla'raika'lukku ethiraana idamattaakavum, vettappatta ku'lamattaakavum, paraakkiramasaalika'lin veedumattaakavum irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avanukkup pinnaaka leaviyaril paaniyin kumaaran reakoomum, avan arukea keakilaa maakaa'naththil thannudaiya paathippangkukkup pirapuvaakiya asapiyaavum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.
avanukkup pinnaaka avanudaiya sakoathararil keakilaa maakaa'naththu ma'rupaathikkup pirapuvaakiya enaathaathin kumaaran paapaayi pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avan arukea mispaavin pirapuvaakiya yesuvaavin kumaaran easar enpavan mathilin koadiyilea aayuthasaalaiyin padika'lukku ethireayirukki'ra vea'roru pangkaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.

avanukkup pinnaakach saapaayin kumaaran paarook anthak koadi thuvakkip pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya eliyaaseepin vaasa'rpadimattum irukki'ra pinnoru pangkai veku jaakkirathaiyoadea pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.

avanukkup pinnaakak koasin kumaaranaakiya uriyaavin makan meremoath eliyaaseepin veettu vaasa'rpadi thuvakki avanudaiya veettin kadaikkoadimattum irukki'ra pinnoru pangkaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avanukkup pinnaakach samanaana poomiyil vaasamaayirukki'ra aasaariyarka'l pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.

avarka'lukkup pinnaaka penyameenum, asoopum thangka'l veettukku ethirea irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l; avarka'lukkup pinnaaka ananiyaavin kumaaranaakiya maaseayaavin makan asariyaa than veettin arukea irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
avanukkup pinnaaka enaathaathin kumaaran pinnoovi asariyaavin veedu thuvakki alangkaththuk koadi va'laivuvaraikkum irukki'ra vea'roru pangkaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.

oosaayin kumaaran paalaal va'laivukku ethireayum, kaaval veettin mut'raththukkaduththa raajaavin uyaramaana aramanaikku ve'lippu'ramaayirukki'ra kommaikku ethireayum irukki'rathaik kattinaan; avanukkup pinnaakap paaroashin kumaaran pethaayaavum,
oapealilea kudiyirukki'ra nithaneemiyaraich searntha manitharum kizhakkeayirukki'ra tha'n'neer vaasalukku ve'lippu'ramaana kommaikku ethireayirukki'ra idamattum kattinaarka'l.
avarka'lukkup pinnaakath thekkoavaa ooraar ve'lippu'ramaana periya kommaikku ethirea oapealin mathilmattum irukki'ra pinnoru pangkaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.
kuthiraivaasal mutha'rko'ndu aasaariyarka'l avaravar thangka'l veeduka'lukku ethirea irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.

avarka'lukkup pinnaaka immearin kumaaran saathoak than veettukku ethirea irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan; avanukkup pinnaakak kizhakku vaasalaik kaakki'ra sekkaniyaavin kumaaran semaayaa pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.

avanukkup pinnaakach selmeeyaavin kumaaran ananiyaavum, saalaapin aa'raavathu kumaaranaakiya aanoonum, vea'roru pangkaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l; avarka'lukkup pinnaakap perakiyaavin kumaaran mesullaam, than a'raiveettukku ethirea irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.

avanukkup pinnaakath thattaanin kumaaran malkiyaa mipkaath ennum vaasalukku ethirea nithaneemiyarum ma'likaikkaararum kudiyirukki'ra sthalamuthal koadiyin mealveedumattaakavum irukki'rathaip pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaan.
koadiyin mealveettukkum aattuvaasalukkum naduvea irukki'rathaith thattaarum ma'likaikkaararum pazhuthupaarththuk kattinaarka'l.
naangka'l alangkaththaik kattuki'ra seythiyaich sanpallaath keattapoathu, avan koapiththu, erichchaladainthu, yootharaich sakkanthampa'n'ni:

antha a'rpamaana yoothar seyki'rathu enna, avarka'lukku idangkodukkappadumoa, paliyiduvaarka'loa, orunaa'lilea mudiththuppoaduvaarka'loa, sutteriththup poadappattu ma'nmeaduka'laana ka'rka'lukku uyir koduppaarka'loa, en'ru than sakoathararukkum samaariyaavin seanaikkum munpaakach sonnaan.
appozhuthu ammoaniyanaakiya thopiyaa avan pakkaththil nin'ru: avarka'l kattinaalum enna, oru nari ea'rippoanaal avarka'ludaiya kalmathil idinthupoakum en'raan.
engka'l theavanea, naangka'l avamathikkappaduki'rathaik keattu, avarka'l ninthikki'ra ninthaiyai avarka'l thalaiyinmeal thiruppi, avarka'laich si'raiyiruppin theasaththilea soo'raikku oppukkodum.
avarka'l akkiramaththai moodippoadaatheayum; avarka'l paavam umakku munpaakak kolaikkappadaathiruppathaaka; kattuki'ravarka'lukku manamadivu'ndaakap peasinaarka'lea.
naangka'l alangkaththaik kattivanthoam; alangkamellaam paathimattum on'raay i'nainthu uyarnthathu; janangka'l vealaiseyki'ratha'rku aavalaayirunthaarka'l.

erusaleamin alangkaththaik kattuki'ra vealai va'larnthea'ruki'rathu en'rum, idikkappatta idangka'l adaipattuvaruki'rathu en'rum sanpallaaththum, thopiyaavum, arapiyarum, ammoaniyarum, asthoaththiyarum keattapoathu, avarka'l mikavum erichchalaaki,
erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'na ellaarum eakamaay varavum, vealaiyaith thadukkavum kattuppaadu pa'n'ninaarka'l.
aanaalum naangka'l engka'l theavanai noakki jepampa'n'ni, avarka'l nimiththam iravumpakalum jaamangkaakki'ravarka'lai vaiththoam.
appozhuthu yoothaa manithar: sumaikaararin pelan ku'rainthupoaki'rathu; ma'nmeadu michchamaayirukki'rathu; naangka'l alangkaththaik kattakkoodaathu en'raarka'l.

engka'l saththurukka'loaven'raal: naangka'l avarka'l naduvea vanthu, avarka'laik kon'rupoadumattum, avarka'l athai a'riyaamalum paaraamalum irukkavea'ndum; ivvithamaay antha vealaiyai oayappa'n'nuvoam en'raarka'l.
athai avarka'la'ndaiyilea kudiyirukki'ra yootharum, pala idangka'lilumirunthu engka'lidaththukku vanthu, paththuvisai engka'lukkuch sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan: alangkaththukkup pinnaaka irukki'ra pa'l'lamaana idangka'lilum meaduka'lilum, pattayangka'laiyum, eettika'laiyum, villuka'laiyum pidiththirukki'ra janangka'laik kudumpang kudumpamaaka ni'ruththinean.

athai naan paarththu ezhumpi, pirapukka'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum mat'ra janangka'laiyum noakki: avarka'lukkup payappadaathirungka'l; neengka'l makaththuvamum payangkaramumaana aa'ndavarai ninaiththu, ungka'l sakoathararukkaakavum, ungka'l kumaararukkaakavum, ungka'l kumaaraththika'lukkaakavum, ungka'l manaivika'lukkaakavum, ungka'l veeduka'lukkaakavum yuththampa'n'nungka'l en'rean.

engka'lukkuch seythi theriyavanthathen'rum, theavan avarka'l aaloasanaiyai apaththamaakkinaaren'rum, engka'l pakaignar keattapoathu, naangka'l ellaarum avaravar thangka'l vealaiyaich seyya alangkaththukkuth thirumpinoam.

an'rumutha'rko'ndu en vealaikkaararil paathippear vealaiseythaarka'l, paathippear eettika'laiyum parisaika'laiyum villuka'laiyum kavasangka'laiyum pidiththu nin'raarka'l; athikaarika'l yoothaa vamsaththaar ellaarukkum pinnaaka nin'raarka'l.
alangkaththilea kattuki'ravarka'lum, sumaisumakki'ravarka'lum, sumaiyeat'ruki'ravarka'lum, avaravar oru kaiyinaalea vealaiseythu, ma'rukaiyinaalea aayutham pidiththirunthaarka'l.
kattuki'ravarka'l avaravar thangka'l pattayaththaith thangka'l iduppilea kattikko'ndavarka'laay vealaiseythaarka'l; ekkaa'lam oothuki'ravan enna'ndaiyilea nin'raan.
naan pirapukka'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum mat'ra janangka'laiyum noakki: vealai perithum visthaaramumaayirukki'rathu; naam alangkaththinmeal sitha'rappattu oruvarukku oruvar thooramaayirukki'roam.
neengka'l evvidaththilea ekkaa'lach saththaththaik keadki'reerka'loa avvidaththilea vanthu, engka'loadea koodungka'l; nammudaiya theavan namakkaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaar en'rean.
ippadiyea naangka'l vealaiseythuko'ndirunthoam; avarka'lilea paathippear kizhakku ve'lukkum nearamuthal nadchaththirangka'l kaa'numattum eettika'laip pidiththirunthaarka'l.

akkaalaththilea naan janangka'laip paarththu: iraamaa'ru namakkuk kaavalukkum pakalmaa'ru vealaikkum uthava, avaravar thangka'l vealaikkaararoadungkooda erusaleamukku'l'lea iraaththangkakkadavarka'l en'ru solli,

naanaakilum, en sakoathararaakilum, en vealaikkaararaakilum, ennaip pinpat'rik kaavalkaakki'ra seavakaraakilum engka'l vasthirangka'laik ka'lainthupoadaathirunthoam; avaravarukku aayuthamum tha'n'neerum irunthathu.
janangka'lukku'l aneakarum avarka'ludaiya sthireeka'lum yootharaakiya thangka'l sakoathararmeal mu'raiyiduki'ra periya kookkuralu'ndaayit'ru.

athennaven'raal, avarka'lil silar: naangka'l engka'l kumaararoadum engka'l kumaaraththika'loadum aneakaraanapadiyinaal, saappittup pizhaikkumpadikku naangka'l thaaniyaththaik kadanaaka vaangkinoam en'raarka'l.
vea'ru silar: engka'l nilangka'laiyum engka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum engka'l veeduka'laiyum naangka'l adaimaanamaaka vaiththu, inthap pagnchaththilea thaaniyam vaangkinoam en'raarka'l.
innum silar: raajaavukkuth theervaiseluththa, naangka'l engka'l nilangka'lmealum engka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'lmealum, pa'naththaik kadanaaka vaangkinoam en'rum;

engka'l udalum engka'l sakoatharar udalum sari; engka'l pi'l'laika'lum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum sari; aanaalum, ithoa, naangka'l engka'l kumaararaiyum engka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum adimaiththanaththi'rku udpaduththavea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu; appadiyea engka'l kumaaraththika'lil silar adimaippattumirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lai meedka engka'lukku nirvaakamillai; engka'l nilangka'lum engka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'lum vea'rea manithar kaivasamaayit'ru en'raarka'l.
avarka'l kookkuralaiyum, intha vaarththaika'laiyum naan keattapoathu, mikavum koapangko'ndu,

en manathilea aaloasanaipa'n'ni, pi'rpaadu pirapukka'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum kadinthuko'ndu: neengka'l avaravar thangka'l sakoathararmeal ean vatti sumaththuki'reerka'l en'ru solli, avarka'lukku viroathamaaka oru periya sapai koodivarachseythu,

avarka'lai noakki: pu'rajaathiyaarukku vi'rkappatta yootharaakiya engka'l sakoathararai naangka'l engka'l sakthikkuththakkathaay meettirukkaiyil, neengka'l thirumpa ungka'l sakoathararai vi'rkalaamaa? ivarka'l namakku vilaippattuppoakalaamaa en'rean; appozhuthu avarka'l ma'ruuththaravu solla idamillaamal mavunamaayirunthaarka'l.

pinnum naan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l seyki'ra kaariyam nallathalla; nammudaiya pakaignaraakiya pu'rajaathiyaar ninthikki'rathinimiththam neengka'l nammudaiya theavanukkup payanthu nadakkavea'ndaamaa?
naanum en sakoathararum en vealaikkaararum ivvithamaakavaa avarka'lukkup pa'namum thaaniyamum kadankoduththirukki'roam? intha vattiyai vittuviduvoamaaka.

neengka'l in'raikku avarka'l nilangka'laiyum, avarka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum, avarka'l olivaththoappuka'laiyum, avarka'l veeduka'laiyum, neengka'l pa'naththilum thaaniyaththilum thiraadcharasaththilum e'n'neyilum noot'rukkon'ru veethamaaka avarka'lidaththil tha'ndivaruki'ra vattiyaiyum, avarka'lukkuth thirumpak koduththuvidungka'l en'rean.

atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l athaith thirumpak koduththuvittu, ini appadi avarka'lidaththil keadkamaattoam; neer solluki'rapadiyea seyvoam en'raarka'l; appozhuthu naan aasaariyarka'lai azhaiththu, avarka'l intha vaarththaiyinpadi seyya avarka'lai aa'naiyiduviththukko'ndean.

naan en vasthiraththai utha'rippoattu, ippadi intha vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'raatha entha manithanaiyum avan veettilum avan sampaaththiyaththilum irunthu theavan utha'rippoadakkadavar; inthappirakaaramaaka avan utha'rippoadappattu, ve'rumaiyaayp poavaanaaka en'rean; atha'rkuch sapaiyaar ellaarum aamen en'ru solli, karththaraith thuthiththaarka'l; pinpu janangka'l intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea seythaarka'l.

naan yoothaatheasaththilea athipathiyaayirukkumpadi raajaavaakiya arthasashdaa enakkuk ka'rpiththa naa'laakiya avarudaiya irupathaam varusham thodangki, avarudaiya muppaththira'ndaam varushamvaraikkumiruntha pannira'ndu varushakaalamaay, naanum en sakoathararum athipathika'l vaangkuki'ra padiyai vaangkich saappidavillai.

enakku munniruntha athipathika'l janangka'lukkup paaramaayirunthu, avarka'l kaiyilea appamum thiraadcharasamum vaangkinathum allaamal, naa'rpathu seakkal ve'l'liyum vaangkivanthaarka'l; avarka'l vealaikkaarar muthalaay janangka'lmeal athikaaram seluththinaarka'l; naanoa theavanukkup payanthathinaal ippadich seyyavillai.
oru vayalaiyaavathu naangka'l ko'l'lavillai; antha alangkaththin vealaiyilea muyan'ru nin'rean; en vealaikkaararanaivarum koottamaay antha vealaikkuk koodivanthaarka'l.
yootharum moopparumaana noot'raimpathupearum, engka'laich sut'rilumirukki'ra pu'rajaathika'lidaththilirunthu engka'lidaththi'rku vanthavarka'lum en panthiyil saappittaarka'l.

naa'lon'rukku oru kaa'laiyum, muthaltharamaana aa'ru aadum samaikkappattathu; padchika'lum samaikkappattathu; paththunaa'laikku orutharam naanaavithath thiraadcharasamum selavazhinthathu; ippadiyellaam irunthapoathum, intha janangka'l pattapaadu kadinamaayirunthapadiyaal, athipathika'l vaangkuki'ra padiyai naan vaangkavillai.
en theavanea, naan intha janaththukkaakach seytha ellaavat'rinpadiyum enakku nanmaiyu'ndaaka ennai ninaiththaru'lum.

naan alangkaththaik kattimudiththathaiyum, ini athilea thi'rappu on'rumillai enpathaiyum, sanpallaaththum, thopiyaavum, arapiyanaana keasheamum engka'lukku'ndaayiruntha mat'rap pakaignarum kea'lvippattapoathu,

naan vaasalka'lukku innum kathavupoadaathirukkaiyil, sanpallaaththum, keasheamum aa'l anuppi: naam oanoa pa'l'laththaakkil irukki'ra kiraamangka'l on'ril oruvaraiyoruvar ka'ndu peasuvoam vaarum en'ru kooppittaarka'l; avarka'loaven'raal enakkup pollaappuch seyya ninaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan avarka'lidaththi'rku aadka'lai anuppi: naan periya vealaiyaich seyki'rean, naan varakkoodaathu; naan antha vealaiyaivittu ungka'lidaththi'rku varuki'rathinaal athu minakkattuppoavaanean en'ru sollachsonnean.
avarka'l inthappirakaaramaaka naalutharam enakkuch solliyanuppinaarka'l; naanum inthappirakaaramaakavea avarka'lukku ma'rumozhi anuppinean.
ainthaantharamum sanpallaaththu anthap pirakaaramaakavea than vealaikkaaranaiyum, avan kaiyilea muththiraipoadaatha oru kadithaththaiyum enakku anuppinaan.
athilea: neerum yootharum kalakampa'n'na ninaikki'reerka'l en'rum, atha'rkaaka neer alangkaththaik kattuki'reer en'rum, ivvithamaaka neer avarka'lukku raajaavaakap poaki'reer en'rum,

yoothaavilea oru raajaa irukki'raar en'ru ummaikku'riththu erusaleamilea koo'ruki'ra theerkkatharisika'laiyum sampaathiththeeren'rum pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea pirasthaapamaayirukki'rathu, kashmoovum appadich solluki'raan; ippoathum inthach seythi raajaavukku ettumea; aakaiyaal naam oruvaroadoruvar aaloasanaipa'n'nuki'ratha'rkaaka neer varavea'ndum en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.
atha'rku naan: neer solluki'ra anthak kaariyangka'lil on'rum nadakkavillai; avaika'l ummudaiya manoaraajyamea ozhiya vea'ralla en'ru solliyanuppinean.

antha vealai nadanthea'raathapadikku, engka'l kai saliththuppoam en'ru solli, avarka'l ellaarum engka'laip payamu'ruththappaarththaarka'l. aathalaal theavanea, neer en kaika'laith thidappaduththiyaru'lum.

mekathaapeyealin kumaaranaakiya thelaayaavin makan semaayaa than veettilea adaikkappattirukkumpoathu, naan avanidaththil poanean; appozhuthu avan: naam iruvarumaay theavanudaiya veedaakiya aalayaththukku'l'lea poay, theavaalayaththin kathavuka'laip poottuvoam vaarum; ummaik kon'rupoada varuvaarka'l, iravilea ummaik kon'rupoada varuvaarka'l en'raan.
atha'rku naan: ennaippoan'ra manithan oadippoavaanoa? ennaip poan'ravan uyir pizhaikkumpadi theavaalayaththilea poayp pathungkuvaanoa? naan poavathillai en'rean.
theavan avanai anuppavillaiyen'rum, thopiyaavum sanpallaaththum avanukkuk koolikoduththathinaal, avan enakku viroathamaay anthath theerkkatharisanaththaich sonnaan en'rum a'rinthuko'ndean.
naan payanthu appadich seythu paavangkattikko'l'luki'ratha'rkum, ennai ninthikkaththakka apakeerththikku mukaantharam u'ndaakkuki'ratha'rkum avanukkuk kaikkooli koduththirunthaarka'l.

en theavanea, thopiyaavum sanpallaaththum seytha inthach seykaika'lukkuththakkathaaka neer avarka'laiyum, novathiyaa'l ennum theerkkatharisiyaanava'laiyum, enakkup payamu'ndaakkap paarththa mat'rath theerkkatharisika'laiyum ninaiththukko'l'lum.
appadiyea alangkamaanathu aimpaththira'ndu naa'laikku'l'lea kattappattu, elool maatham irupaththainthaantheathiyilea mudinthathu.

engka'l pakaignar ellaarum athaik keattapoathum, engka'l sut'ruppu'raththaaraakiya pu'rajaathiyaana anaivarum ka'ndapoathum, mikavum munaiyat'ruppoay, inthak kiriyai engka'l theavanaal kaikoodi vanthathen'ru a'rinthaarka'l.
antha naadka'lil yoothaavilu'l'la periya manitharidaththilirunthu thopiyaavukkup poaki'rathum, thopiyaavinidaththilirunthu avarka'lukku varuki'rathumaana kadithangka'l aneakamaayirunthathu.

avan aaraakin kumaaranaakiya sekaniyaavukku marumakanaayirunthathum allaamal, avan kumaaranaakiya yoakanaan perakiyaavin kumaaranaakiya mesullaamin kumaaraththiyai vivaakampa'n'niyirunthapadiyaalum, yoothaavil aneakar avanukku aa'naiyittuk koduththirunthaarka'l.
avan seyyum nanmaika'laiyum avarka'l enakku munpaaka vivariththu, en vaarththaika'lai avanukkuk ko'ndupoavaarka'l; thopiyaa enakkup payamu'ndaakak kadithangka'lai anuppuvaan.
alangkam kattimudinthu, kathavuka'l poadappattu, vaasal kaavalaa'laraiyum, paadakaraiyum, leaviyaraiyum ea'rpaduththinapinpu,

naan en sakoatharanaakiya aanaaniyaiyum, aneakaraippaarkkilum u'nmaiyu'l'lavanum theavanukkup payanthavanumaayiruntha aramanaiththalaivanaakiya ananiyaavaiyum, erusaleamin kaaval visaara'naikku ea'rpaduththinean.

avarka'lai noakki: veyil ea'rumattum erusaleamin vaasalka'l thi'rakkappadavea'ndaam; neengka'l ni'rkumpoathea kathavuka'laich saaththith thaazhppaa'l poattu, erusaleamin kudika'lil kaavalaa'lar avaravar thangka'l kaavalilea, avaravar thangka'l veeduka'lukku ethiraaka ni'ruththappadavea'ndum en'rean.
patta'nam visthaaramum perithumaayirunthathu, atha'rku'l'lea janangka'l kognchamaayirunthaarka'l, veeduka'lum kattappadavillai.

appozhuthu vamsa attava'naika'laip paarkki'ratha'rku, naan pirapukka'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum janangka'laiyum koodivarachseyya, en theavan en manathilea oru e'n'naththai u'ndaakkinaar; munthi vanthavarka'lin vamsa attava'naip pusthakam appozhuthu enakku akappattathu; athilea ezhuthiyirukka naan ka'ndathu ennaven'raal:

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar si'raipidiththuppoanavarka'lum, si'raiyiruppilirunthu serupaapealoadum, yesuvaa, nekeamiyaa, asariyaa, raamiyaa, nakamaani, morthekaay, pilsaan, mispereath, pikvaayi, nekoom, paanaa enpavarka'loadungkooda vanthu,
erusaleamukkum yoothaavukkum thirumpith thangka'l thangka'l patta'nangka'lilea kudiyi'rangkinavarka'lumaana inthath theasaththin puththiraraakiya israveal janangka'laana manitharin thokaiyaavathu:
paaroashin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu noot'ru ezhupaththira'ndupear.
sepaththiyaavin puththirar munnoot'ru ezhupaththira'ndupear.
aaraakin puththirar a'runoot'ru aimpaththira'ndupear.
yesuvaa yoavaap enpavarka'lin santhathikku'l'liruntha paakaathmoavaapin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu e'n'noot'rup pathinettuppear.
ealaamin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru aimpaththunaalupear.
saththoovin puththirar e'n'noot'ru naa'rpaththainthupear.
sakkaayin puththirar ezhunoot'ru a'rupathupear.
pinnoovin puththirar a'runoot'ru naa'rpaththettuppear.
pepaayin puththirar a'runoot'ru irupaththettuppear.
askaathin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu munnoot'ru irupaththira'ndupear.
athoanikaamin puththirar a'runoot'ru a'rupaththeazhupear.
pikvaayin puththirar ira'ndaayiraththu a'rupaththeazhupear.
aatheenin puththirar a'runoot'ru aimpaththainthupear.
eseakkiyaavin santhathiyaana aathearin puththirar tho'n'noot'ru ettuppear.
aasoomin puththirar munnoot'ru irupaththettuppear.
peasaayin puththirar munnoot'ru irupaththunaalupear.
aareeppin puththirar noot'ruppannira'ndupear.
kipiyoanin puththirar tho'n'noot'ru ainthupear.
pethlekeam ooraarum, neththoapaa ooraarum noot'ru e'npaththettuppear.
aanathoaththoor manithar noot'ru irupaththettuppear.
pethasmaaveath ooraar naa'rpaththira'ndupear.
keeriyaathyaareem, kepiraa, pearoath oorka'lin manithar ezhunoot'ru naa'rpaththumoon'rupear.
raamaa, kaapaa oorka'lin manithar a'runoot'ru irupaththorupear.
mikmaas ooraar noot'ru irupaththira'ndupear.
peththeal, aayi oorka'lin manithar noot'ru irupaththumoon'rupear.
vea'roru neapoa ooraar aimpaththira'ndupear.
mat'roru ealaam puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru aimpaththunaalupear.
aareem puththirar munnoot'ru irupathupear.
erikoa puththirar munnoot'ru naa'rpaththainthupear.
loath, aatheeth, oanoa oorka'lin puththirar ezhunoot'ru irupaththorupear.
senaakaa puththirar moovaayiraththuth tho'laayiraththu muppathupear.
aasaariyaraanavarka'l: yesuvaa kudumpaththaanaakiya yethaayaavin puththirar tho'laayiraththu ezhupaththumoon'rupear.
immearin puththirar aayiraththu aimpaththira'ndupear.
paskoorin puththirar aayiraththu irunoot'ru naa'rpaththeazhupear.
aareemin puththirar aayiraththup pathineazhupear.
leaviyaraanavarka'l: othiyaavin puththirarukku'l'lea kathmiyealin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavin puththirar ezhupaththunaalupear.
paadakaraanavarka'l: aasaapin puththirar noot'ru naa'rpaththettuppear.
vaasal kaavalaa'laraanavarka'l: salloomin puththirar, athearin puththirar, thalmoanin puththirar, akkoopin puththirar, athithaavin puththirar, soapaayin puththirar, aaka noot'ru muppaththettuppear.
nithaneemiyaraanavarka'l: seekaavin puththirar, asupaavin puththirar, thapaakoaththin puththirar,
kearoasin puththirar, seeyaavin puththirar, paathoanin puththirar,
lepaanaavin puththirar, akaapaavin puththirar, salmaayin puththirar,
aanaanin puththirar, kiththealin puththirar, kaakaarin puththirar,
raayaakin puththirar, reathseenin puththirar, nekoathaavin puththirar,
kaasaamin puththirar, oosaavin puththirar, paaseyaakin puththirar,
peasaayin puththirar, meyuneemin puththirar, nepishaseemin puththirar,
pakpookkin puththirar, akupaavin puththirar, arkoorin puththirar,
pasleethin puththirar, mekithaavin puththirar, arshaavin puththirar,
parkoasin puththirar, siseraavin puththirar, thaamaavin puththirar,
nethsiyaakin puththirar, athipaavin puththirar,
saalomoanudaiya vealaikkaararin puththiraraanavarka'l: soathaayin puththirar, sopereaththin puththirar, perithaavin puththirar,
yaalaavin puththirar, tharkoanin puththirar, kiththealin puththirar,
sepaththiyaavin puththirar, aththeelin puththirar, pokereath sepaayimilu'l'la puththirar, aamoanin puththirar.
nithaneemiyarum, saalomoanudaiya vealaiyaadka'lin puththirarum eakaththukku munnoot'ruth tho'n'noot'rira'ndupear.

thelmelaakilum, thelarsaavilum, kearupilum, aathoanilum, immearilum irunthuvanthum, thaangka'l isravealar en'ru thangka'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththaiyum, thangka'l poorvoaththaraththaiyum sollamaattaamal irunthavarka'l:
thelaayaavin puththirar, thopiyaavin puththirar, nekoathaavin puththirar, aaka a'runoot'ru naa'rpaththira'ndupear.

aasaariyarka'lil apaayaavin puththirar, koasin puththirar, kileayaaththiyanaana parsillaayin kumaaraththika'lil oruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ni, avarka'l vamsa naamam tharikkappatta parsillaayin puththirar.
ivarka'l thangka'l vamsa attava'naiyaith theadi, athaik kaa'naama'rpoay, aasaariya oozhiyaththukku vilakkamaanavarka'l en'ru e'n'nappattaarka'l.
ooreem thummeem enpavaika'lu'l'la oru aasaariyan ezhumpumattum, avarka'l makaa parisuththamaanathilea pusikkaththakaathen'ru thirshaathaa avarka'lukkuch sonnaan.
sapaiyaar ellaarum eakaththukku naa'rpaththeeraayiraththu munnoot'ru a'rupathupearaayirunthaarka'l.

avarka'laiththavira eazhaayiraththu munnoot'ru muppaththeazhupearaana avarka'ludaiya vealaikkaararum vealaikkaarika'lum, irunoot'ru naa'rpaththainthu paadakarum paadakika'lum avarka'lukku irunthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya kuthiraika'l ezhunoot'ru muppaththaa'ru, avarka'l koavea'ru kazhuthaika'l irunoot'ru naa'rpaththainthu.
ottakangka'l naanoot'ru muppaththainthu, kazhuthaika'l aa'raayiraththu ezhunoot'ru irupathu.

vamsaththalaivaril silar vealaikken'ru koduththathaavathu: thirshaathaa aayiram thangkakkaasaiyum, aimpathu kalangka'laiyum, ainnoot'ru muppathu aasaariya vasthirangka'laiyum pokkishaththukkuk koduththaan.
vamsaththalaivaril silar vealaiyin pokkishaththukku irupathinaayiram thangkakkaasaiyum, ira'ndaayiraththu irunoo'ru raaththal ve'l'liyaiyum koduththaarka'l.
mat'ra janangka'l irupathinaayiram thangkakkaasaiyum, ira'ndaayiram raaththal ve'l'liyaiyum, a'rupaththeazhu aasaariya vasthirangka'laiyum koduththaarka'l.

aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, vaasalkaavalaa'larum, paadakarum, janangka'lil silarum, nithaneemiyarum, isravealar anaivarum thangka'l thangka'l patta'nangka'lil kudiyea'rinaarka'l; eazhaam maathamaanapoathu, israveal puththirar thangka'l patta'nangka'lil irunthaarka'l.

janangka'l ellaarum tha'n'neervaasalukku munnaana veethiyilea orumanappattuk koodi, karththar isravealukkuk ka'rpiththa moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththaik ko'nduvaravea'ndumen'ru veathapaarakanaakiya es'raavukkuch sonnaarka'l.
appadiyea eazhaam maatham muthaltheathiyil aasaariyanaakiya es'raa niyaayappiramaa'naththaip purusharum sthireeka'lum, keattu a'riyaththakka anaivarumaakiya sapaikku munpaakak ko'nduvanthu,

tha'n'neer vaasalukku munnaana veethikku ethireayirunthu kaalameathodangki maththiyaanamattum purusharukkum sthireeka'lukkum, keattu a'riyaththakka mat'ravarka'lukkum munpaaka athai vaasiththaan; sakala janangka'lum niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththi'rkuk kavanamaaych sevikoduththaarka'l.

veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa atha'rken'ru maraththaal seyyappatta oru pirasangkapeedaththinmeal nin'raan; avana'ndaiyil avanukku valathupakkamaaka maththiththiyaavum, semaavum, anaayaavum, uriyaavum, ilkkiyaavum, maaseyaavum, avanukku idathupakkamaakap pethaayaavum, meesavealum, malkiyaavum, asoomum, aspathaanaavum, sakariyaavum, mesullaamum nin'raarka'l.
es'raa sakala janangka'lukkum uyaranin'ru, sakala janangka'lum kaa'nap pusthakaththaith thi'ranthaan; avan athaiththi'ranthapoathu, janangka'l ellaarum ezhunthunin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu es'raa makaththuvamu'l'la theavanaakiya karththarai sthoaththiriththaan; janangka'lellaarum thangka'l kaika'laik kuviththu, atha'rku ma'rumozhiyaaka, aamen aamen en'ru solli, kuninthu, mukangkuppu'ravizhunthu, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.

yesuvaa, paani, serepiyaa, yaamin, akkoop, sapethaayi, othiyaa, maaseyaa, kealithaa, asariyaa, yoasapaath, aanaan, pelaayaa enpavarka'lum, leaviyarum, niyaayappiramaa'naththai janangka'lukku vi'langkappa'n'ninaarka'l; janangka'l thangka'l nilaiyilea nin'raarka'l.
avarka'l theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakaththai theerkkamaaka vaasiththu, arththagnsolli, vaasiththathai avarka'lukku vi'langkappa'n'ninaarka'l.

janangka'l ellaarum niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, azhuthapadiyaal, thirshaathaa ennappatta nekeamiyaavum, veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ennum aasaariyanum, janangka'lukku vi'lakkikkaattina leaviyarum sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: intha naa'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup parisuththamaana naa'l; neengka'l thukkappadavum azhavum vea'ndaam en'raarka'l.

pinnum avan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l poayk kozhumaiyaanathaip pusiththu, mathuramaanathaik kudiththu, on'rumillaathavarka'lukkup pangkuka'lai anuppungka'l; intha naa'l nammudaiya aa'ndavarukkup parisuththamaana naa'l, visaarappadavea'ndaam; karththarukku'l makizhchchiyaayiruppathea ungka'ludaiya pelan en'raan.
leaviyarum janangka'laiyellaam amarththi: azhaathirungka'l, intha naa'l parisuththamaana naa'l, visaarappadavea'ndaam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu janangka'l ellaarum thangka'lukku a'rivikkappatta vaarththaika'lai u'narnthuko'ndapadiyaal, pusiththuk kudikkavum, pangkuka'lai anuppavum, mikuntha santhoasham ko'ndaadavum poanaarka'l.

ma'runaa'lil janaththin sakala vamsaththalaivarum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, niyaayappiramaa'naththin vaarththaika'lai a'rinthuko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru veathapaarakanaakiya es'raavinidaththil koodivanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu niyaayappiramaa'naththilea, israveal puththirar eazhaam maathaththin pa'ndikaiyilea koodaarangka'lil kudiyirukkavea'ndum en'ru karththar moaseayaikko'ndu ka'rpiththa kaariyam ezhuthiyirukki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l.

aakaiyaal ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi koodaarangka'laip poadumpadikku, neengka'l malaika'lukkup pu'rappattuppoay olivakki'laika'laiyum, kaattu olivakki'laika'laiyum, miruthuch sedika'lin ki'laika'laiyum, peareechcha mattaika'laiyum, adarnthamarakki'laika'laiyum ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru thangka'ludaiya sakala patta'nangka'lilum, erusaleamilum koo'rip pirasiththappaduththinaarka'l.

appadiyea janangka'l ve'liyea poay avaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, avaravar thangka'l veeduka'lmealum, thangka'l mut'rangka'lilum, theavanudaiya aalayappiraakaarangka'lilum, tha'n'neervaasal veethiyilum, eppiraayeem vaasal veethiyilum thangka'lukkuk koodaarangka'laip poattaarka'l.

inthappirakaaramaakach si'raiyiruppilirunthu thirumpi vanthavarka'lin sapaiyaar ellaarum koodaarangka'laip poattu, koodaarangka'lil kudiyirunthaarka'l; ippadiyea noonin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaavin naadka'lmuthal annaa'lmattum israveal puththirar seyyaathirunthu ippozhuthu seythapadiyaal, mikuntha santhoashamu'ndaayirunthathu.

muthalaam naa'l thodangkik kadaisinaa'lmattum, thinamthinam theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakam vaasikkappattathu; eazhunaa'l pa'ndikaiyai aasariththaarka'l; ettaamnaa'loavenil, mu'raimaiyinpadiyea viseashiththa aasarippu naa'laayirunthathu.
antha maatham irupaththunaalaantheathiyilea israveal puththirar upavaasampa'n'ni, irattuduththi, thangka'lmeal puzhuthiyaip poattukko'ndavarka'laayk koodivanthaarka'l.
israveal santhathiyaar ma'rujaathiyaaraiyellaam vittuppirinthu vanthu nin'ru, thangka'l paavangka'laiyum, thangka'l pithaakka'lin akkiramangka'laiyum a'rikkaiyittaarka'l.

avarka'l ezhunthirunthu, thangka'l nilaiyil nin'raarka'l; appozhuthu oru jaamamattum avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththarin niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakam vaasikkappattathu; pinpu oru jaamamattum avarka'l paava a'rikkai pa'n'ni, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.

yesuvaa, paani, kathmiyeal, seppaniyaa, punni, serepiyaa, paani, kenaani enpavarka'l leaviyarudaiya padika'linmeal nin'ru, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarai noakki makaa saththamaay oalamittaarka'l.

pinpu leaviyaraana yesuvaa, kathmiyeal, paani, aasaapneyaa, serepiyaa, othiyaa, sepaniyaa, peththakiyaa enpavarka'l janangka'laip paarththu: neengka'l ezhunthirunthu, anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkumirukki'ra ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l en'ru solli, karththarai noakki: entha sthuthi sthoaththiraththukkum mealaana ummudaiya makimaiyu'l'la naamaththukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka.

neer oruvarea karththar; neer vaanangka'laiyum, vaanaathi vaanangka'laiyum, avaika'ludaiya sarva seanaika'laiyum, poomiyaiyum athilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum, samuththirangka'laiyum avaika'lilu'l'la ellaavat'raiyum u'ndaakkineer; avaika'laiyellaam neer kaappaat'ruki'reer; vaanaseanaika'l ummaip pa'ninthuko'l'luki'rathu.
aapiraamaith therinthuko'ndu, avanai oor ennum kaltheayarin patta'naththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avanukku aapirakaam ennum pearitta theavanaakiya karththar neer.

avan iruthayaththai umakku munpaaka u'nmaiyu'l'lathaakakka'ndu, kaanaaniyar, eaththiyar, emoariyar, perisiyar, epoosiyar, kirkaasiyarudaiya theasaththai avan santhathikkuk kodukkumpadi, avanoadu udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, ummudaiya vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'rineer; neer neethiyu'l'lavar.
ekipthilea engka'l pithaakka'l anupaviththa si'rumaiyai neer ka'ndu, sivantha samuththiraththil avarka'l kooppiduthalaik keatteer.

paarvoanidaththilum, avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararidaththilum, avan theasaththin sakala janaththinidaththilum, adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum seytheer; avarka'l umathu janangka'lai akanthaiyaay nadaththinaarka'l enpathai a'rinthiruntheer; ippadiyea innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi umakkuk keerththiyai u'ndaakkineer.

neer avarka'lukku munpaakach samuththiraththaip piriththathinaal, kadalin naduvaakak kaalnanaiyaamal nadanthaarka'l; valuvaana tha'n'neerka'lilea kallaippoaduki'rathupoala, avarka'laith thodarnthavarka'lai aazhangka'lilea poattuvitteer.
neer pakalilea meakasthampaththinaalum, avarka'l nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai avarka'lukku ve'lichchamaakka iravilea akkinisthampaththinaalum, avarka'lai vazhinadaththineer.

neer seenaay malaiyili'rangki, vaanaththilirunthu avarka'loadea peasi, avarka'lukkuch semmaiyaana neethiniyaayangka'laiyum, nalla katta'laika'lum ka'rpanaika'lumaakiya u'nmaiyaana piramaa'nangka'laiyum koduththeer.

umathu parisuththa oayvunaa'lai avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththi, umathu thaasanaakiya moaseayaikko'ndu, avarka'lukkuk ka'rpanaika'laiyum, katta'laika'laiyum, niyaayappiramaa'nangka'laiyum ka'rpiththeer.

avarka'l pasikku vaanaththilirunthu appam koduththu, avarka'l thaakaththukkuk kanmalaiyilirunthu tha'n'neer pu'rappadappa'n'ni, neer avarka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru aa'naiyitta theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lap piraveasiyungka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sonneer.
engka'l pithaakka'laakiya avarka'loa akangkaaramaay nadanthu, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththi, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'lukkuch sevikodaathea poanaarka'l.

avarka'l sevikodukka manathillaamalum, avarka'lidaththilea neer seytha ummudaiya a'rputhangka'lai ninaiyaamalum poay, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththi, thangka'l adimaiththanaththukkuth thirumpumpadikku avarka'l kalakampa'n'ni, oru thalaivanai ea'rpaduththinaarka'l; aakilum vekuvaay mannikki'ravarum, irakkamum manaurukkamum, neediya saanthamum, makaa kirupaiyumu'l'lavarumaana theavanaakiya neer avarka'laik kaividavillai.

avarka'l vaarppikkappatta oru kan'rukkuttiyaith thangka'lukku u'ndaakki: ithu unnai ekipthilirunthu ko'nduvantha un theyvam en'ru solli, koapamoottaththakka periya akkiramangka'laich seythirunthaalum,

neer ummudaiya mikuntha manaurukkaththinpadiyea, avarka'lai vanaantharaththilea kaividavillai; avarka'lai vazhinadaththap pakalilea meakasthampamum, avarka'lukku ve'lichchaththaiyum avarka'l nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyaiyum kaatta iravilea akkinisthampamum, avarka'lai vittu vilakavillai.
avarka'lukku a'rivai u'narththa ummudaiya nal aaviyaik katta'laiyitteer; avarka'l vaaykku ummudaiya mannaavai aru'li, avarka'l thaakaththukkuth tha'n'neeraik koduththeer.

ippadi naa'rpathu varushamaaka vanaantharaththil avarka'lukku on'rum ku'raivupadaathapadikku, avarka'laip paraamariththu vantheer; avarka'l vasthirangka'l pazhamaiyaayppoakavumillai, avarka'l kaalka'l veengkavumillai.

avarka'lukku raajyangka'laiyum janangka'laiyum oppukkoduththu, avaika'lai ellai ellaiyaaka avarka'lukkup pangkitteer; espoanin raajaavaakiya seekoanin theasaththaiyum, paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakin theasaththaiyum kattikko'ndaarka'l.
avarka'l pi'l'laika'lai vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'laippoalap perukappa'n'ni, suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi neer avarka'l pithaakka'lukkuch sonna theasaththilea avarka'lai azhaiththuvantheer.

appadiyea pi'l'laika'l udpiraveasiththu, theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndaarka'l; neer avarka'lukku munpaakath theasaththin kudika'laakiya kaanaaniyaraith thaazhththi, avarka'laiyum avarka'l raajaakka'laiyum, theasaththin janangka'laiyum, thangka'l ishdappadi seyya, avarka'l kaiyilea oppukkoduththeer.

avarka'l ara'naana patta'nangka'laiyum, sezhumaiyaana poomiyaiyum kattikko'ndu, sakalavitha udaimaika'l ni'raintha veeduka'laiyum, vettappatta thuravuka'laiyum, earaa'lamaana thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum, olivaththoappuka'laiyum, kanikodukkum virudchangka'laiyum suthanthariththukko'ndu, pusiththuth thirupthiyaakik kozhuththu, ummudaiya periya thayaiyinaal selvamaay vaazhnthaarka'l.

aanaalum avarka'l keezhppadiyaathavarka'laaki, umakku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ni, ummudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththaith thangka'lukkup pu'rampea e'rinthuvittu, thangka'lai ummidaththil thiruppumpadi avarka'laith thidasaadchiyaayk kadinthuko'nda ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'laik kon'rupoattu, koapamoottuki'ra periya akkiramangka'laich seythaarka'l.

aakaiyaal avarka'lai nerukkuki'ra avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkoduththeer; avarka'l nerukkam anupavikki'ra kaalaththil avarka'l ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rapoathoa, neer paraloakaththilirunthu keattu, ummudaiya mikuntha irakkaththinaal avarka'lai avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaikku neengkalaakkividuki'ra iradchakarka'lai avarka'lukkuk koduththeer.

avarka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal u'ndaanapoathoa, umakku munpaaka ma'rupadiyum pollaappuch seyyaththodangkinaarka'l; aakaiyaal avarka'l saththurukka'l avarka'lai aa'lumpadikku, avarka'l kaiyilea oppuviththeer; avarka'l mananthirumpi, ummai noakkik kooppittapoathoa, neer paraloakaththilirunthu keattu, avarka'lai ummudaiya irakkangka'linpadiyea aneakantharam viduthalaiyaakkivitteer.

avarka'lai ummudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuth thiruppa avarka'laith thidasaadchiyaayk kadinthuko'ndeer; aanaalum avarka'l akangkaarangko'ndu, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'lukkuch sevikodaamal, keezhppadinthu nadakki'ra manushan seythu pizhaikki'ra ummudaiya neethiniyaayangka'lukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythu, thangka'l thoa'lai mura'nduththanamaay vilakki, sevikodaamal, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththikko'ndaarka'l.

neer aneaka varushamaaka avarka'lmeal po'rumaiyaayirunthu, ummudaiya aaviyinaal peasina ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu avarka'laith thidasaadchiyaayk kadinthuko'ndaalum, avarka'l sevikodaathapadiyinaalea, avarka'lai anniya theasajanangka'lin kaiyil oppukkoduththeer.
aakilum ummudaiya mikuntha irakkangka'linpadiyea, avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkaamalum avarka'laik kaividaamalum iruntheer; neer kirupaiyum irakkamumu'l'la theavan.

ippozhuthum udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum kaakki'ra vallamaiyum payangkaramumu'l'la makaa theavanaakiya engka'l theavanea, aseeriyaa raajaakka'lin naadka'l mutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum engka'lukkum, engka'l raajaakka'lukkum, engka'l pirapukka'lukkum, engka'l aasaariyarka'lukkum, engka'l theerkkatharisika'lukkum, engka'l pithaakka'lukkum, ummudaiya janangka'l anaivarukkum nearitta sakala varuththamum umakku munpaaka a'rpamaayk kaa'nappadaathiruppathaaka.
engka'lukku nearidappa'n'nina ellaavat'rilum neer neethiyu'l'lavar; neer u'nmaiyaay nadappiththeer; naangka'loa aakaamiyampa'n'ninoam.

engka'l raajaakka'lum, engka'l pirapukka'lum, engka'l aasaariyarka'lum, engka'l pithaakka'lum, ummudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi seyyaamalum, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum, neer avarka'laik kadinthuko'nda ummudaiya saadchika'laiyum kavaniyaamalum poanaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l raajyaththilum, neer avarka'lukkuk koduththa ummudaiya periya thayaiyilum, neer avarka'lukku munpaakath thi'ranthuvaiththa visaalamum sezhippumaana theasaththilum umakku oozhiyagnseyyaamalum, thangka'l thurkkarumangka'lai vittuth thirumpaamalum poanaarka'l.

ithoa, in'raiyathinam naangka'l adimaika'laayirukki'roam; ithoa, palanaiyum nanmaiyaiyum anupavikkumpadi neer engka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa inthath theasaththilthaanea naangka'l adimaika'laayirukki'roam.

athin varumaanam engka'l paavangka'linimiththam neer engka'lmeal vaiththa raajaakka'lukkuth thira'laakappoaki'rathu; avarka'l thangka'lukku ishdamaanapadiyea engka'l sareerangka'laiyum engka'l mirukajeevanka'laiyum aa'luki'raarka'l; naangka'l makaa ikkattil akappattirukki'roam.

ivaiyellaam ippadi irukki'rapadiyaal, naangka'l u'ruthiyaana udanpadikkaipa'n'ni athai ezhuthivaikki'roam; engka'l pirapukka'lum, engka'l leaviyarum, engka'l aasaariyarum atha'rku muththiraipoaduvaarka'l en'raarka'l.
muththiraipoattavarka'l yaaren'raal: akaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya thirshaathaa ennum nekeamiyaa, sitheakiyaa,
seraayaa, asariyaa, ereamiyaa,
paskoor, amariyaa, malkijaa,
aththoos, sepaniyaa, mallook,
aareem, meremoath, opathiyaa,
thaaniyeal, kineathoan, paaruk,
mesullaam, apiyaa, meeyaamin,
maasiyaa, pilkaay, semaayaa ennum aasaariyarka'lum,
leaviyaraakiya asaniyaavin kumaaran yesuvaa, enaathaathin kumaararil oruvanaakiya pinnooyi, kathmiyeal enpavarka'lum,
avarka'l sakoathararaakiya sepaniyaa, othiyaa, kealithaa, pelaayaa, aanaan,
meekaa, reakoap, asapiyaa,
sakkoor, serepiyaa, sepaniyaa,
othiyaa, paani, peninu enpavarka'lum,
janaththin thalaivaraakiya paaroash, paakaathmoavaap, ealaam, saththoo, paani,
punni, askaath, pepaayi,
athoaniyaa, pikvaay, aathin,
aathear, iskiyaa, asoor,
othiyaa, aasoom, pethsaay,
aareep, aanathoath, nepaay,
makpiyaas, mesullaam, easeer,
meshesaapeyeal, saathoak, yathuvaa,
pelaththiyaa, aanaan, aanaayaa,
oaseyaa, ananiyaa, asoop,
alloakeas, pilakaa, soapeak,
reakoom, ashapanaa, maaseyaa,
akiyaa, kaanaan, aanaan,
mallook, aarim, paanaa enpavarka'lumea.

janangka'lil mat'ravarka'laakiya aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, vaasal kaavalaa'larum, paadakarum, nithaneemiyarum, theasangka'lin janangka'laivittup pirinthu vilaki theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuth thirumpina anaivarum, avarka'l manaivika'lum, avarka'l kumaararum, avarka'l kumaaraththika'lumaakiya a'rivum puththiyum u'l'lavarka'lellaarum,

thangka'lukkup periyavarka'laakiya thangka'l sakoathararoadea koodikko'ndu: theavanudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseayaikko'ndu kodukkappatta theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi nadanthuko'lvoam en'rum, engka'l aa'ndavaraakiya karththarin ka'rpanaika'laiyum sakala neethiniyaayangka'laiyum, katta'laika'laiyum ellaam kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyvoam en'rum,
naangka'l engka'l kumaaraththika'lai theasaththin janangka'lukkuk kodaamalum, engka'l kumaararukku avarka'l kumaaraththika'laik ko'l'laamalum iruppoam en'rum,

theasaththin janangka'l oayvunaa'lilea sarakkuka'laiyum, enthavithath thaaniyathavasaththaiyum vi'rki'ratha'rkuk ko'nduvanthaal, naangka'l athai oayvunaa'lilum parisuththanaa'lilum avarka'l kaiyil ko'l'laathiruppoam en'rum, naangka'l eazhaam varushaththai viduthalai varushamaakkich sakala kadanka'laiyum vittuviduvoam en'rum aa'naiyittup piramaa'nampa'n'ninaarka'l.

mealum: naangka'l engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththin aaraathanaikkaaka samukaththappangka'lukkum, niththiya poajanapalikkum, oayvunaadka'lilum maathappi'rappuka'lilum seluththum niththiya sarvaangka thakanapalika'lukkum, pa'ndikaika'lukkum, pirathishdaiyaana poru'lka'lukkum, isravealukkaakap paavanivirththi u'ndaakkum palika'lukkum,
engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththin sakala vealaikkum, varushanthoa'rum naangka'l seakkalil moon'ril oru pangkaik koduppoam enki'ra kadanai engka'lmeal eat'rukko'ndoam.

niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea engka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya palipeedaththinmeal eriki'ratha'rkaaka, ku'rikkappatta kaalangka'lil varushaavarusham engka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumpangka'linpadiyea, engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvaravea'ndiya vi'raku kaa'nikkaikkaakavum, aasaariyarukkum, leaviyarukkum, janaththukkum seettuppoattoam.
naangka'l varushanthoa'rum engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukku engka'l theasaththin mutha'rpalanaiyum, sakalavitha virudchangka'lin ellaa mutha'rkanika'laiyum ko'nduvaravum,

niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea, engka'l kumaararil mutha'rpea'ruka'laiyum, engka'l aadumaaduka'laakiya mirukajeevanka'lin thalaiyeet'ruka'laiyum, engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththilea oozhiyagnseyki'ra aasaariyaridaththukkum ko'nduvaravum,

naangka'l engka'l pisainthamaavil mutha'rpaakaththaiyum, engka'l padaippuka'laiyum, sakala marangka'lin munthina palanaakiya thiraadchappazharasaththaiyum, e'n'neyaiyum, engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththin a'raika'lil vaikkumpadi aasaariyaridaththukkum, engka'l nilappayirka'lil thasamapaakam leaviyaridaththukkum ko'nduvaravum, leaviyaraakiya ivarka'l engka'l ve'l'laa'nmaiyin patta'nangka'lilellaam thasamapaakam searkkavum,

leaviyar thasamapaakam searkkumpoathu aaroanin kumaaranaakiya oru aasaariyan leaviyaroadeakooda irukkavum, thasamapaakamaakiya athilea leaviyar paththil oru pangkai engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththilu'l'la pokkisha a'raika'lil ko'nduvaravum thittampa'n'nikko'ndoam.

parisuththasthalaththin pa'nimuttuka'lum, oozhiyagnseyki'ra aasaariyarum, vaasal kaavalaa'larum, paadakarum irukki'ra antha a'raika'lilea israveal puththirarum leavipuththirarum thaaniyam thiraadcharasam e'n'ney enpavaika'lin padaippuka'laik ko'nduvaravea'ndiyathu; ivvithamaay naangka'l engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththaip paraamariyaamal viduvathillaiyen'ru thittampa'n'nikko'ndoam.

janaththin athikaarika'l erusaleamilea kudiyirunthaarka'l; mat'ra janangka'l, thangka'lukku'l'lea paththuppearil oruvanai erusaleamennum parisuththa nakaraththilum onpathupearai mat'rap patta'nangka'lilum kudiyirukkappa'n'na, seettuka'laip poattaarka'l.
aanaalum erusaleamilea kudiyirukka manappoorvamaaych sammathiththa manusharka'laiyellaam janangka'l vaazhththinaarka'l.

yoothaavin patta'nangka'lil isravealarum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, nithaneemiyarum, saalomoanudaiya vealaikkaararin puththirarum, avaravar thangka'l patta'nangka'lilu'l'la thangka'l kaa'nipoomiyilea kudiyirunthaarka'l; erusaleamilea kudiyiruntha naaduka'lin thalaivar yaaren'raal:

erusaleamilea yoothaa puththiraril silarum, penyameen puththiraril silarum kudiyirunthaarka'l; yoothaa puththirarilea peareasin puththirarukku'l oruvanaana makalaaleyealin kumaaranaakiya sepathiyaavin kumaaran amariyaavukkup pi'rantha sakariyaavukkuk kumaaranaana usiyaavin makan aththaayaavum,
seeloanin kumaaran sakariyaavukkuk kumaaranaakiya yoayaaripukkuk kumaaranaana athaayaavukkup pi'rantha asaayaavin kumaaran kolloasea pet'ra paarukkin makan maaseyaavumea.
erusaleamilea kudiyirukki'ra peareasin puththirarellaarum naanoot'ru a'rupaththettup paraakkiramasaalika'laayirunthaarka'l.

penyameen puththiraril yaaren'raal, sallu enpavan; ivan mesullaamukkum, ivan yoavealukkum, ivan pethaayaavukkum, ivan kolaayaavukkum, ivan maaseyaavukkum, ivan ithiyealukkum, ivan esaayaavukkum kumaaranaanavan.
avanukkuppin kappaay, sallaay muthalaanavarka'l tho'laayiraththu irupaththettuppear.
avarka'lmeal visaarippukkaaranaana sikriyin kumaaran yoavealum, patta'naththinmeal ira'ndaavathu visaarippukkaaranaana senuvaavin kumaaran yoothaavumea.
aasaariyarka'lil yoayaaripin kumaaran yethaayaa, yaakin enpavarka'lum,
akithoopin kumaaran meraayoaththukkup pi'rantha saathoakkin kumaaran mesullaam pet'ra ilkkiyaavin makan seraayaa ennum theavanudaiya aalayaththin visaara'naikkarththanum,

aalayaththilea pa'nividai seyki'ra avarka'l sakoathararaakiya e'n'noot'ru irupaththira'ndupearum, malkiyaavin kumaaran paskoorukku makanaana sakariyaavin kumaaran amsikkup pi'rantha pelliyaavin kumaaran eroakaamukkup pi'rantha athaayaavum,
pithaa vamsaththalaivaraakiya avanudaiya sakoatharar irunoot'ru naa'rpaththira'ndupearum, immearin kumaaran mesilleamoaththin makanaakiya akasaaykkup pi'rantha asareyealin makan amaasaayum,
avarka'ludaiya sakoathararaakiya paraakkiramasaalika'l noot'ru irupaththettuppearumea; ivarka'lmeal akethoalimin kumaaran sapthiyeal visaarippukkaaranaayirunthaan.
leaviyarilea punniyin kumaaran asapiyaavin makanaakiya asrikkaamin kumaaranaana asoopin makan semaayaavum,
theavanudaiya aalayaththin ve'livealaiyai visaarikki'ra leaviyarin thalaivarilea sapethaayum, yoasapaaththum,

aasaapin kumaaran sapthiyin kumaaranaakiya meekaavin makan maththaniyaa jepaththil sthoaththirappaattaith thuvakkuki'ra thalaivanum avan sakoathararil ira'ndaavathaana pakpookkiyaa ennum oruvanum, ethuththoonin kumaaran kaalaavin makanaakiya samuvaavin kumaaran apthaavumea.
parisuththa patta'naththiliruntha leaviyar ellaarum irunoot'ru e'npaththunaalupear.
vaasal kaavalaa'lar akkoopum, thalmoanum, vaasalka'lil kaavalkaakki'ra avarka'l sakoathararum noot'ruezhupaththira'ndupear.
mat'ra isravealarum, aasaariyarum, leaviyarum, yoothaavin sakala patta'nangka'lilum, avaravar thangka'l suthantharaththilirunthaarka'l.
nithaneemiyar oapealilea kudiyirunthaarka'l; avarka'lmeal seekaavum kispaavum visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarka'l.

erusaleamilirukki'ra leaviyarin visaarippukkaaran meekaavin kumaaran maththaniyaavin makanaakiya asapiyaavukkup pi'rantha paaniyin kumaaran oosi enpavan theavanudaiya aalayaththin oozhiyaththukku ni'rki'ra paadakaraakiya aasaapin kumaararil oruvan.
paadakaraakiya avarka'lukkaaka an'raadakappadi kodukkappadumpadi raajaavinaal katta'laiyidappattirunthathu.
yoothaavin kumaaranaakiya searaakkin puththiraril mesesaapeyealin kumaaran peththakiyaa janaththin kaariyangka'lukkellaam raajaavin samukaththil nin'raan.

thangka'l naattuppu'rangka'laana kiraamangka'lil irukki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea yoothaavin puththiraril silar keeriyaatharpaavilum athin kiraamangka'lilum, theepoanilum athin kiraamangka'lilum, ekaapseyealilum athin kiraamangka'lilum,
yesuvaavilum, moalaathaakilum, pethpeleathilum,
aathsaarsookaalilum, peyersepaavilum athin kiraamangka'lilum,
siklaakilum, meakoanaakilum athin kiraamangka'lilum,
entimmoanilum, saareayaakilum, yarmooththilum,

saanoavaakilum, athullaamilum avaika'lin kiraamangka'lilum, laakeesilum athin naattuppu'rangka'lilum, asekkaavilum athin kiraamangka'lilum, peyersepaathodangki innoamin pa'l'laththaakkumattum kudiyea'rinaarka'l.
keapaavin ooraaraayiruntha penyameen puththirar, mikmaas, aayaa, peththeal oorka'lilum athin kiraamangka'lilum,
aanathoath, noap, ananiyaa,
aathsoar, raamaa, kiththaayim,
aatheeth, sepoayim, nepalaath,
loath, oanoa ennum oorka'lilum, si'rpaasaarika'lin pa'l'laththaakkilum kudiyirunthaarka'l.
leaviyarilea sila vakuppaar yoothaavilum, silar penyameenilum irunthaarka'l.
seyalthiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapealoadum yesuvaavoadum vantha aasaariyarum leaviyarum yaaren'raal: seraayaa, ereamiyaa, es'raa,
amariyaa, mallook, aththoos,
sekaniyaa, rekoom, meremoath,
iththoa, kineathoa, apiyaa,
miyaamin, maathiyaa, pilkaa,
semaayaa, yoayaarip, yethaayaa,
sallu, aamoak, ilkkiyaa, yethaayaa enpavarka'l; ivarka'l yesuvaavin naadka'lil, aasaariyarukkum thangka'l sakoathararukkum thalaivaraayirunthaarka'l.
leaviyar yaaren'raal: yesuvaa, pinnooyi, kathmiyeal, serepiyaa, yoothaa, maththaniyaa enpavarka'l; ivanum ivan sakoathararum thuthiseythalai visaariththaarka'l.
pakpukkiyaa, unni enki'ra avarka'l sakoatharar avarka'lukku ethirea kaavalkaaththirunthaarka'l.
yesuvaa yoyakeemaip pet'raan, yoyakeem eliyaasipaip pet'raan, eliyaasip yoyathaavaip pet'raan.
yoyathaa yoanaththaanaip pet'raan, yoanaththaan yathuvaavaip pet'raan.
yoyakeemin naadka'lilea pithaa vamsangka'lin thalaivaraana aasaariyarka'l yaaren'raal: seraayaavin santhathiyil meraayaa, ereamiyaavin santhathiyil ananiyaa,
es'raavin santhathiyil mesullaam, amariyaavin santhathiyil yoakanaan,
melikuvin santhathiyil yoanaththaan, sepaniyaavin santhathiyil yoaseappu,
aareemin santhathiyil athnaa, meraayoathin santhathiyil elkaay,
iththoavin santhathiyil sakariyaa, kinethoanin santhathiyil mesullaam,
apiyaavin santhathiyil sikri, miniyaa meenmovathiyaa enpavarka'lin santhathiyil pilthaay.
pilkaavin santhathiyil sammuvaa, semaayaavin santhathiyil yoanaththaan,
yoayaripin santhathiyil maththanaa, yethaayaavin santhathiyil oosi,
sallaayin santhathiyil kallaay, aamoakkin santhathiyil eapear,
ilkkiyaavin santhathiyil asapiyaa, yethaayaavin santhathiyil nethaneyeal enpavarka'l.

eliyaasipin naadka'lil yoyathaa, yoakanaan, yathuvaa enki'ra leaviyar pithaa vamsangka'lin thalaivaraaka ezhuthappattaarka'l; persiyanaakiya thariyuvin raajyapaaramattum iruntha aasaariyarka'lum appadiyea ezhuthappattaarka'l.
leavi puththiraraakiya pithaa vamsangka'lin thalaivar eliyaasipin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanin naadka'lmattum naa'laakamap pusthakaththil ezhuthappattaarka'l.

leaviyarin thalaivaraakiya asapiyaavum, serepiyaavum, kathmiyealin kumaaran yesuvaavum, avarka'lukku ethirea ni'rki'ra avarka'l sakoathararum, theavanudaiya manushanaakiya thaaveethinudaiya ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea thuthikkavum thoaththirikkavum, oruvarukkoruvar ethirmukamaaka mu'raimu'raiyaayirunthaarka'l.
maththaniyaa, pakpukkiyaa, opathiyaa, mesullaam, thalmoan, akkoop enpavarka'l vaasalka'lilirukki'ra pokkisha a'raika'laik kaavalkaakki'ravarka'laayirunthaarka'l.

yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yesuvaavin kumaaran yoyakeemin naadka'lilum, athipathiyaakiya nekeamiyaavum, veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ennum aasaariyanum irukki'ra naadka'lilum avarka'l irunthaarka'l.

erusaleamin alangkaththaip pirathishdaipa'n'nukaiyil, thuthiyinaalum paadalinaalum, kaiththaa'lam thampuru surama'ndalam muthalaana keethavaaththiyangka'linaalum, pirathishdaiyai makizhchchiyoadea ko'ndaada ellaa idangka'lilum irukki'ra leaviyarai erusaleamukku varumpadi theadinaarka'l.
appadiyea paadakarin puththirar erusaleamin sut'ruppu'rangka'laana samapoomiyilum, neththoapaaththiyarin kiraamangka'lilum,
pethkilkaalilum, keapaa, asmaaveath oorka'lin naattuppu'rangka'lilum irunthuvanthu koodinaarka'l; paadakar erusaleamaich sut'rilum thangka'lukkuk kiraamangka'laik kattiyirunthaarka'l.
aasaariyarum leaviyarum thangka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndu, janaththaiyum patta'navaasalka'laiyum alangkaththaiyum suththampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan yoothaavin pirapukka'lai alangkaththinmeal ea'rappa'n'ni, thuthiseythu nadanthupoakumpadi ira'ndu periya koottaththaarai ni'ruththinean; avarka'lil oru koottaththaar alangkaththinmeal valathupu'ramaakak kuppaimeattu vaasalukkup poanaarka'l.
avarka'l pi'rakaalea osaayaavum, yoothaavin pirapukka'lil paathippearum,
asariyaa, es'raa, mesullaam,
yoothaa, penyameen, semaayaa, ereamiyaa enpavarka'lum,

poorikaika'laip pidikki'ra aasaariyarin puththiraril aasaappin kumaaran sakkoorin makanaakiya mikaayaavukkuk kumaaranaana maththaniyaavin makan semaayaavukkup pi'rantha yoanaththaanin kumaaran sakariyaavum,

theavanudaiya manushanaakiya thaaveethin keethavaaththiyangka'lai vaasikki'ra avan sakoathararaana semaayaa, asareyeal, milaalaay, kilaalaay, makaay, nethaneyeal, yoothaa, anaani enpavarka'lum poanaarka'l; veathapaarakanaakiya es'raa ivarka'lukku munpaaka nadanthaan.

angkeayirunthu avarka'l thangka'lukku ethiraana ooru'nivaasalukku vanthapoathu, alangkaththaippaarkkilum uyaramaana thaaveethu nakaraththin padika'lil ea'ri, thaaveethu veettinmealaakak kizhakkeayirukki'ra tha'n'neer vaasalmattum poanaarka'l.

thuthiseyki'ra ira'ndaam koottaththaar ethireayirukki'ra vazhiyaay nadanthupoanaarka'l, avarka'l pi'rakaalea naan poanean; janaththil paathippear alangkaththinmeal soo'laika'lin kommaiyaik kadanthu, akazh mathilmattum nedukappoay,
eppiraayeem vaasalaiyum, pazhaiya vaasalaiyum, meen vaasalaiyum, anaaneyealin kommaiyaiyum, meayaa enki'ra kommaiyaiyum kadanthu, aattuvaasalmattum pu'rappattuk kaavalveettuvaasalilea nin'raarka'l.
atha'rkuppinpu thuthiseyki'ra ira'ndu koottaththaarum theavanudaiya aalayaththilea vanthu nin'raarka'l; naanum ennoadeakooda irukki'ra thalaivaril paathippearum,
poorikaika'laip pidikki'ra eliyaakkeem, maaseyaa, miniyaameen, mikaayaa, eliyoanaay, sakariyaa, anaaniyaa enki'ra aasaariyarka'lum,
maaseyaa, semaayaa, eleyaasaar, oosi, yoakanaan, malkiyaa, ealaam, easear enpavarka'lum nin'roam; paadakarum, avarka'l visaarippukkaaranaakiya yesharakiyaavum saththamaayp paadinaarka'l.

annaa'lilea mikuthiyaana palika'laich seluththi, theavan thangka'lukku makaa santhoashaththai u'ndaakkinathinaal makizhchchiyaayirunthaarka'l; sthireeka'lum pi'l'laika'lungkoodak ka'likoornthaarka'l; erusaleamin ka'lippu thooraththilea keadkappattathu.

an'raiyathinam pokkishangka'laiyum, padaippuka'laiyum, muthal kanika'laiyum, thasamapaakangka'laiyum vaikkum a'raika'linmeal, aasaariyarka'lukkum leaviyarka'lukkum niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyea varavea'ndiya patta'nangka'ludaiya nilangka'lin pangkuka'lai avaika'lil searkkumpadikku, sila manushar visaarippukkaararaaka vaikkappattaarka'l; oozhiyagnseythu ni'rki'ra aasaariyarmealum leaviyarmealum yoothaa manithar santhoashamaayirunthaarka'l.
paadakarum, vaasal kaavalaa'larum, thaaveethum avan kumaaranaakiya saalomoanum ka'rpiththapadiyea thangka'l theavanudaiya kaavalaiyum, suththikarippin kaavalaiyum kaaththaarka'l.
thaaveethum aasaappum iruntha poorvanaadka'lil paadakarin thalaivarum vaikkappattu, theavanukkuth thuthiyum thoaththirangka'lum seluththuki'ra sangkeethangka'l thittampa'n'nappattirunthathu.

aakaiyaal serupaapealin naadka'lilum, nekeamiyaavin naadka'lilum, isravealar ellaarum paadakarukkum vaasal kaavalaa'larukkum an'raadakath thittamaakiya pangkuka'laik koduththaarka'l; avarka'l leaviyarukken'ru pirathishdaipa'n'nik koduththaarka'l; leaviyar aaroanin puththirarukken'ru avarka'l pangkaip pirathishdaipa'n'nik koduththaarka'l.

an'raiyathinam janangka'l keadka, moaseayin pusthakaththai vaasiththaarka'l; athilea ammoaniyarum moavaapiyarum, israveal puththirarukku appamum tha'n'neerum kodukka ethirko'nduvaraamal, avarka'laich sapikka avarka'lukku viroathamaayp pileayaamaik kooliporunthikko'ndapadiyinaal,
avarka'l en'raikkum, anthach saapaththai aaseervaathamaakath thiruppina engka'l theavanudaiya sapaikkudpadalaakaathu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathaakak kaa'nappattathu.
aakaiyaal avarka'l anthak katta'laiyaik keattapoathu, pala jaathiyaana janangka'laiyellaam isravealaivittup piriththuvittaarka'l.
itha'rkumunnea engka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththin a'raika'lai visaarikka vaikkappatta aasaariyanaakiya eliyaasip thopiyaavoadea sampanthangkalanthavanaayirunthu,

mu'rkaalaththil kaa'nikkaika'lum, saampiraa'niyum, pa'nimuttuka'lum, leaviyarukkum paadakarukkum vaasalkaavalaa'larukkum katta'laipa'n'nappatta thaaniyam thiraadcharasam e'n'ney enpavaika'lilea thasamapaakamum, aasaariyaraich searuki'ra padaippaana kaa'nikkaika'lum vaikkappattiruntha idaththil oru periya a'raiyai avanukku aayaththampa'n'niyirunthaan.

ithellaam nadakkumpoathu naan erusaleamil illai; paapiloan raajaavaakiya arthasashdaavin muppaththira'ndaam varushaththilea naan raajaavinidaththi'rkuppoay, silanaa'lukkuppinpu thirumpa raajaavinidaththil uththaravu pet'rukko'ndu,
erusaleamukku vanthean; appozhuthu eliyaasip thopiyaavukkuth theavanudaiya aalayaththup piraakaarangka'lil oru a'raiyai aayaththampa'n'ninathinaal, seytha pollaappai a'rinthuko'ndean.
athinaal naan mikavum manamadivaaki, thopiyaavin veettuth thattumuttuka'laiyellaam antha a'raiyilirunthu ve'liyea e'rinthuvittean.
pinpu naan a'raiveeduka'laich suththikarikkachsolli, theavanudaiya aalayappa'nimuttuka'laiyum kaa'nikkaika'laiyum saampiraa'niyaiyum angkea thirumpakko'nduvanthu vaiththean.

pinnaiyum leaviyarukku avarka'l pangkuka'l kodukkappadavillaiyenpathaiyum, pa'nividai seyki'ra leaviyarum paadakarum avaravar thangka'l ve'linilangka'lukku oadippoanaarka'l enpathaiyum naan a'rinthuko'ndean.
appozhuthu naan thalaimaiyaanavarka'loadea vazhakkaadi, theavanudaiya aalayam kaividappattuppoavaanean en'ru solli, avarka'laich searththu, avaravar nilaiyil avarka'lai vaiththean.
appozhuthu yoothar ellaarum thaaniyam thiraadcharasam e'n'ney enpavaika'lil thasamapaakaththaip pokkisha a'raika'lil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan aasaariyanaakiya seleamiyaavaiyum, veathapaarakanaakiya saathoakkaiyum, leaviyaril pethaayaavaiyum, ivarka'lukkuk kaiththu'naiyaaka maththaniyaavin kumaaran sakkoorin makanaakiya aanaanaiyum pokkisha a'raika'linmeal visaarippukkaararaaka vaiththean; avarka'l u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'l en'ru e'n'nappattaarka'l; aakaiyaal thangka'l sakoathararukkup pangkiduki'ra vealai avarka'lukku oppuvikkappattathu.
en theavanea, naan en theavanudaiya aalayaththukkaakavum athin mu'raimaika'lukkaakavum seytha na'rkiriyaika'laik kulaiththuppoadaamal, inthak kaariyaththilea ennai ninaiththaru'lum.

antha naadka'lil naan yoothaavilea oayvunaa'lil silar aalaika'lai mithikki'rathaiyum, silar thaaniyap pothika'laik kazhuthaika'lmeal eat'rikko'ndu varuki'rathaiyum, thiraadcharasam, thiraadchappazham, aththippazham muthalaanavaika'lin pa'rpala sumaika'lai oayvunaa'lilea erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvaruki'rathaiyum ka'ndu, avarka'l thinpa'ndam vi'rki'ra naa'laippat'ri avarka'laith thidasaadchiyaayk kadinthuko'ndean.
meenaiyum sakalavitha sarakkuka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, oayvunaa'lilea yoothaa puththirarukkum erusaleamil irukki'ravarka'lukkum vi'rki'ra sila theeriyarum u'l'lea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
aakaiyaal naan yoothaavin periyavarka'laik kadinthuko'ndu: neengka'l oayvunaa'laip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkuki'ra inthap pollaatha seykaiyenna?

ungka'l pithaakka'l ippadich seythathinaalallavaa, namathu theavan nammealum intha nakaraththinmealum inthath theengkaiyellaam varappa'n'ninaar; neengka'loaven'raal oayvunaa'laip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkuki'rathinaal, isravealinmealirukki'ra ukkiraththai athikarikkappa'n'nuki'reerka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sonnean.

aakaiyaal oayvunaa'lukku munnea erusaleamin patta'navaasalil, maalaimayangkumpoathu, kathavuka'laip poottavum, oayvunaa'l mudiyumattum avaika'laith thi'ravaathirukkavum vea'ndumen'ru katta'laiyittu, oayvunaa'lilea oru sumaiyum u'l'lea varaathapadikku vaasala'ndaiyilea en vealaikkaararil silarai ni'ruththinean.
athinaal varththakarum, sakalavitha sarakkuka'lai vi'rki'ravarka'lum, ira'ndorutharam erusaleamukkup pu'rampea iraaththangkinaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan avarka'laith thidasaadchiyaayk kadinthuko'ndu, neengka'l alangkaththa'ndaiyilea iraaththangkuki'rathu enna? neengka'l ma'rupadiyum ippadich seythaal, ungka'lmeal kaipoaduvean en'ru avarka'loadea sonnean; athumuthal avarka'l oayvunaa'lil varaathirunthaarka'l.

oayvunaa'laip parisuththamaakkumpadikku, ungka'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndu vaasalka'laik kaakka vaarungka'l en'ru leaviyarukkum sonnean. en theavanea, ithaikku'riththu neer ennai ninaiththaru'li, ummudaiya mikuntha kirupaiyinpadi enakku irangkuveeraaka.
asthoath, ammoan, moavaap jaathika'laana sthireeka'laich searththukko'nda sila yootharaiyum antha naadka'lil ka'ndean.
avarka'l pi'l'laika'l peasina peachchil paathi asthoath paashaiyaayirunthathu; ivarka'l anthantha jaathika'lin paashaiyaiththavira, yoothapaashaiyaith thittamaayp peasa a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.

avarka'laiyum naan kadinthuko'ndu, avarka'lmeal varum saapaththaik koo'ri, avarka'lil silarai adiththu, mayiraip piyththu: neengka'l ungka'l kumaaraththika'lai avarka'l kumaararukkuk kodaamalum, avarka'l kumaaraththika'lil oruvaraiyum ungka'l kumaararukkaakilum ungka'lukkaakilum ko'l'laamalum irukkavea'ndumen'ru avarka'lai theavanmeal aa'naiyidappa'n'ni, naan avarka'lai noakki:

isravealin raajaavaakiya saalomoan ithinaalea paavagnseythaanallavaa? avanaippoan'ra raajaa aneakam jaathika'lukku'l'lea u'ndaayirunthathillai; avan than theavanaalea sineakikkappattavanaayirunthaan; theavan avanai isravealanaiththinmealum raajaavaaka vaiththaar; appadippattavanaiyum ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'l paavagnseyyappa'n'ninaarka'lea.
neengka'l ma'rujaathiyaana sthireeka'laich searththukko'l'luki'rathinaal, nammudaiya theavanukkuth thuroakika'laaki, inthap periya pollaappaiyellaam seyyumpadi, ungka'lukku idangkoduppoamoa en'rean.
yoyathaavin puththirarilea pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya eliyaasipinudaiya kumaaran oruvan oaroaniyanaana sanpallaaththukku marumakanaanaan; aakaiyaal avanai ennaivittuth thuraththinean.
en theavanea, avarka'l aasaariya oozhiyaththaiyum, aasaariya oozhiyaththukkum leaviyarukkum irukki'ra udanpadikkaiyaiyum theettuppaduththinaarka'l en'ru avarka'lai ninaiththukko'l'lum.
ippadiyea naan ma'rujaathiyaaraiyellaam neekki, aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum suththikariththu, avaravarai avarka'l vealaiyin mu'raika'lil ni'ruththi,
ku'rikkappatta kaalangka'lilea seluththappadavea'ndiya vi'rakukaa'nikkaiyaiyum, mutha'rpalanka'laiyungku'riththuth thittampa'n'ninean. en theavanea enakku nanmaiyu'ndaaka ennai ninaiththaru'lum.
inthutheasammuthal eththiyoappiyaa theasamvaraikkumu'l'la noot'rirupaththeazhu naaduka'laiyum arasaa'nda akaasvearuvin naadka'lilea sampaviththathaavathu:
raajaavaakiya akaasvearu soosaan aramanaiyilirukki'ra than raajyaththin singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirunthaan.

avan than raajyapaaraththin moon'raam varushaththilea thannudaiya pirapukka'lukkum oozhiyakkaararukkum virunthupa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu persiyaa meathiyaa theasangka'lilu'l'la makaththaanavarka'lum, naaduka'lin athipathika'lum, pirapukka'lum, avan samukaththil vanthirunthaarka'l.
avan than raajyaththin makimaiyaana aisuvariyaththaiyum, than makaththuvaththin si'rantha pirathaapaththaiyum aneaka naa'laakiya noot're'npathunaa'la'lavum vi'langkachseythuko'ndirunthaan.

antha naadka'l mudinthapoathu, raajaa soosaan aramanaiyil vanthiruntha periyoarmuthal si'riyoarmattumu'l'la samastha janangka'lukkum raaja aramanaiyaichsearntha singkaaraththoattaththilu'l'la ma'ndapaththil eazhunaa'l virunthu seyviththaan.

angkea ve'nkalath thoo'nka'linmealu'l'la ve'l'li va'laiyangka'lil melliya noolum sivappunoolumaana kayi'ruka'laal ve'l'laiyum pachchaiyum i'laneelamumaakiya thongkuthiraika'l vithaaniththirunthathu; sivappum neelamum ve'l'laiyum ka'ruppumaana ka'rka'l pathiththiruntha tha'lavarisaiyinmeal po'rsarikaiyum ve'l'lichsarikaiyumaana meththaika'l vaikkappattirunthathu.
ponnaal seyyappatta naanaavitha paaththirangka'lilea paanam kodukkappattathu; muthaltharamaana thiraadcharasam raajasthithikku ea'rkap paripoora'namaayp parimaa'rappattathu.
avaravarudaiya manathinpadiyea seyyalaam en'ru raajaa than aramanaiyin periya manusharukkellaam katta'laiyittirunthapadiyinaal, mu'raippadi paanampa'n'ninaarka'l; oruvanum palavantham pa'n'navillai.
raajasthireeyaakiya vasthiyum raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvin aramanaiyilea sthireeka'lukku oru virunthu seythaa'l.

eazhaam naa'lilea raajaa thiraadcharasaththinaal ka'lippaayirukkumpoathu, makaa roopavathiyaayiruntha raajasthireeyaakiya vasthiyin saunthariyaththai janangka'lukkum pirapukka'lukkum kaa'npikkumpadi, raajakireedam tharikkappattava'laaka, ava'lai raajaavukkumunpaaka azhaiththuvaravea'ndumen'ru,
raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvin samukaththil seavikki'ra mekumaan, pisthaa, a'rpoanaa, pikthaa, apakthaa, seathaar, karkaas ennum eazhu pirathaanika'lukkum katta'laiyittaan.
aanaalum pirathaanika'l moolamaay raajaa solliyanuppina katta'laikku raajasthireeyaakiya vasthi varamaattean en'raa'l; appozhuthu raajaa kadungkoapamadainthu, thanakku'l'lea moorkkave'riko'ndaan.

achsamayaththil raajasamukaththaith tharisikki'ravarka'lum, raajyaththin muthal aasanangka'lil udkaaruki'ravarka'lumaana karsheanaa, seathaar, athmaathaa, tharshees, meareas, marseanaa, memukaan ennum persiyar meathiyarudaiya eazhu pirapukka'lum avan sameepaththil irunthaarka'l.
raajaa niyaayappiramaa'naththaiyum raajaneethiyaiyum a'rinthavarka'lidaththil peasuvathu thanakku vazhakkamaanapadiyaal, kaalaakaala varththamaanangka'lai a'rintha pa'nditharka'lai noakki:

raajaavaakiya akaasvearu pirathaanika'l moolamaaych solliyanuppina katta'laiyinpadi raajasthireeyaakiya vasthi seyyaama'rpoanathinimiththam, theasachsattaththinpadi ava'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu memukaan raajaavukkum pirapukka'lukkum munnea pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajasthireeyaakiya vasthi raajaavukkumaaththiram alla, raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvinudaiya sakala naaduka'lilumu'l'la sakala pirapukka'lukkum sakala janangka'lukkungkooda aniyaayagnseythaa'l.

raajaavaakiya akaasvearu raajasthireeyaakiya vasthiyaith thamakku munpaaka azhaiththuvarach sonnapoathu, ava'l varamaattoam enki'ra seythi ellaa sthireeka'lukkum pirasiththamaanaal, avarka'lum thangka'l purusharaith thangka'l paarvaiyil a'rpamaay e'n'nuvaarka'l.

in'raiyathinamea persiyaavilum meathiyaavilumu'l'la pirapukka'lin sthireeka'l raajasthireeyin seythiyaik keadkumpoathu, raajaavin pirapukka'lukkellaam appadiyea solluvaarka'l; mikuntha asattaiyum erichchalum vi'laiyum.

raajaavukkuch sammathiyaayirunthaal, vasthi ini raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvukku munpaaka varakkoodaathu en'rum, ava'ludaiya raajameanmaiyai ava'laippaarkkilum uththamiyaakiya mat'roru sthireekku raajaa koduppaaraaka en'rum, avaraal oru raajakatta'lai pi'ranthu, athu mee'rappadaathapadikku, persiyaavukkum meathiyaavukkum uriya theasach sattaththilum ezhuthappadavea'ndum.

ippadi raajaa theerththa kaariyam thamathu vistheera'namaana raajyamengkum keadkappadumpoathu, periyoarmuthal si'riyoarmattumu'l'la ellaa sthireeka'lum thangka'l purusharaik kanampa'n'nuvaarka'l en'raan.
intha vaarththai raajaavukkum pirapukka'lukkum nalamaayth thoan'rinathinaal, raajaa memukaanudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea seythu,

enthap purushanum than veettukkuththaanea athikaariyaayirukkavea'ndum en'rum, ithai anthantha janangka'ludaiya paashaiyilea pirasiththampa'n'navea'ndum en'rum, anthantha naattil vazhangkuki'ra adcharaththilum, anthantha jaathiyaar peasuki'ra paashaiyilum, raajaavin sakala naaduka'lukkum katta'lai ezhuthi anuppinaan.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvin ukkiram tha'ninthapoathu, avan vasthiyaiyum ava'l seythathaiyum ava'laikku'riththuth theermaanikkappattathaiyum ninaiththaan.
appozhuthu raajaavaich seavikki'ra avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: roopavathika'laayirukki'ra kannippe'nka'lai raajaavukkaakath theadavea'ndum.

atha'rkaaka raajaa thammudaiya raajyaththin naaduka'lilellaam visaarippukkaararai vaikkavea'ndum; ivarka'l roopavathika'laayirukki'ra sakala kannippe'nka'laiyum kootti, soosaan aramanaiyilirukki'ra kannimaadaththukku azhaiththuvanthu, sthireeka'laik kaavalpa'n'nuki'ra raajaavin pirathaaniyaakiya yeakaayin vasaththilea oppuvikkavea'ndum; avarka'ludaiya suththikarippukku vea'ndiyavaika'l avarka'lukkuk kodukkappadavea'ndum.

appozhuthu raajaavin ka'nka'lukkup piriyamaana kanni vasthikkup pathilaakap pattaththu sthireeyaaka vea'ndum en'raarka'l; intha vaarththai raajaavukku nalamaayth thoan'rinapadiyaal appadiyea seythaan.
appozhuthu soosaan aramanaiyilea penyameeniyanaakiya keesin kumaaran seemeayinudaiya makanaakiya yaaveerin kumaaran morthekaay ennum pearu'l'la oru yoothan irunthaan.

avan paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar yoothaavin raajaavaakiya ekoniyaavaip pidiththukko'ndu poaki'rapoathu, avanoadeakooda erusaleamilirunthu pidiththukko'ndu poakappattavarka'lil oruvanaayirunthaan.

avan than si'riya thakappan kumaaraththiyaakiya esthar ennum athsaa'lai va'larththaan; ava'lukkuth thaaythakappanillai; anthap pe'n roopavathiyum saunthariyamudaiyava'lumaayirunthaa'l; ava'l thakappanum ava'l thaayum mara'namadainthapoathu, morthekaay ava'laith than kumaaraththiyaaka eduththukko'ndaan.

raajaavin katta'laiyum theermaanamum pirasiththamaaki, aneakam pe'nka'l koottappattu, soosaan aramanaiyilu'l'la yeakaayin vasaththil oppuvikkappaduki'rapoathu, estharum raajaavin aramanaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoakappattu, sthireeka'laik kaavalpa'n'nuki'ra yeakaayin vasaththil oppuvikkappattaa'l.
