anthap pe'n avan paarvaikku nan'raayirunthathinaal, ava'lukku avan ka'nka'lilea thayaikidaiththathu; aakaiyaal ava'ludaiya suththikarippukku vea'ndiyavaika'laiyum, ava'lukkuth theavaiyaana mat'ravaika'laiyum ava'lukkuk kodukkavum, raaja aramanaiyilirukki'ra eazhu thaathimaarka'lai ava'lukku niyamikkavum jaakkirathaippattu kannimaadaththil si'rantha oru idaththilea ava'laiyum ava'l thaathimaarka'laiyum vaiththaan.
estharoaven'raal than kulaththaiyum, than poorvoaththaraththaiyum a'rivikkaathirunthaa'l; morthekaay athaith therivikkavea'ndaamen'ru ava'lukkuk ka'rpiththirunthaan.
estharudaiya sukaseythiyaiyum ava'lukku nadakkungkaariyaththaiyum a'riya morthekaay naadoa'rum kannimaadaththu mut'raththukku munpaaka ulaavuvaan.

ovvoru pe'n'num aa'rumaatham ve'l'laippoa'lath thailaththinaalum, aa'rumaatham sukanthavarkkangka'linaalum, sthireeka'lukkuriya mat'rach suththikarippuka'linaalum joadikkappaduki'ra naadka'l ni'raivea'ri, ivvithamaay sthireeka'lin mu'raimaippadi pannira'ndu maathamaakach seyyappattuth theernthapinpu, raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvinidaththil piraveasikka, ava'lava'ludaiya mu'rai varuki'rapoathu,
ippadi joadikkappatta pe'n raajaavinidaththil piraveasippaa'l; kannimaadaththilirunthu thannoadeakooda raaja aramanaikkuppoaka, ava'l thanakku vea'ndumen'ru keadpavaiyellaam ava'lukkuk kodukkappadum.

saayangkaalaththilea ava'l u'l'lea piraveasiththu, kaalamea, apimaana sthireeka'laik kaavalpa'n'nuki'ra raajaavin pirathaaniyaakiya saaskaasudaiya visaarippukku'l'lirukki'ra sthireeka'lin ira'ndaam maadaththukkuth thirumpivaruvaa'l; raajaa thannai virumpip pearsolli azhaippiththaalozhiya ava'l orupoathum raajaavinidaththil piraveasikkakkoodaathu.

morthekaay thanakkuk kumaaraththiyaay eat'rukko'ndava'lum, avan si'riyathakappanaakiya apiyaayealin kumaaraththiyumaana esthar raajaavinidaththil piraveasikki'ratha'rku mu'raivanthapoathu, ava'l sthireeka'laik kaavalpa'n'nuki'ra raajaavin pirathaaniyaakiya yeakaay niyamiththa kaariyameayallaamal vea'ron'rum keadkavillai; estharukkuth thannaik kaa'nki'ra ellaar ka'nka'lilum thayaikidaiththathu.
appadiyea esthar raajaavaakiya akaasvearu arasaa'luki'ra eazhaam varusham theapeath maathamaakiya paththaam maathaththilea raajaavinidaththil aramanaikku azhaiththukko'ndu poakappattaa'l.

raajaa sakala sthireeka'laippaarkkilum estharmeal anpuvaiththaan; sakala kannikaika'laippaarkkilum ava'lukku avan samukaththil athika thayaiyum padchamum kidaiththathu; aakaiyaal avan raajakireedaththai ava'l sirasinmeal vaiththu, ava'lai vasthiyin sthaanaththilea pattaththu sthireeyaakkinaan.

appozhuthu raajaa thannudaiya ellaap pirapukka'lukkum oozhiyakkaararukkum, estharinimiththam oru periya virunthuseythu, naaduka'lukkuch salakkara'nai u'ndaakki, raajasthithikkuththakka vekumaanangka'laik koduththaan.
ira'ndaantharam kannikaika'l searkkappadumpoathu, morthekaay raajaavin aramanai vaasalil udkaarnthirunthaan.

esthar morthekaay thanakkuk ka'rpiththirunthapadi, than poorvoaththaraththaiyum than kulaththaiyum therivikkaathirunthaa'l; esthar morthekaay idaththilea va'larumpoathu avan so'rkeattu nadanthathupoala, ippozhuthum avan so'rkeattu nadanthuvanthaa'l.

annaadka'lil morthekaay raajaavin aramanai vaasalil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathu, vaasalkaakki'ra raajaavin ira'ndu pirathaanika'laakiya pikthaanum theareasum varmam vaiththu, raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvinmeal kaipoada vakaitheadinaarka'l.
inthak kaariyam morthekaaykkuth theriyavanthathinaal, avan athai raajaaththiyaakiya estharukku a'riviththaan; esthar morthekaayin pearaal athai raajaavukkuch sonnaa'l.

anthak kaariyam visaarikkappaduki'rapoathu, athu meyyen'ru kaa'nappattathu; aakaiyaal avarka'l iruvarum maraththilea thookkippoadappattaarka'l; ithu raaja samukaththilea naa'laakamappusthakaththilea ezhuthappattirukki'rathu.

intha nadapadika'lukkuppinpu, raajaavaakiya akaasvearu ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaakiya aamaan ennum aakaakiyanai meanmaippaduththi, thannidaththilirukki'ra sakala pirapukka'lukkum mealaaka avanudaiya aasanaththai uyarththivaiththaan.

aakaiyaal raajaavin aramanai vaasalilirukki'ra raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum aamaanai va'nangki namaskariththu vanthaarka'l; avanukku ippadich seyyavea'ndum en'ru raajaa katta'laiyittirunthaan; aanaalum morthekaay avanai va'nangkavumillai, namaskarikkavumillai.
appozhuthu raajaavin aramanai vaasalilirukki'ra raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar morthekaayaip paarththu: nee raajaavin katta'laiyai mee'ruki'rathu enna en'ru keattaarka'l.

ippadi avarka'l naa'lukkunaa'l avanudanea solliyum, avan thangka'lukkuch sevikodaathapoathu, thaan yoothan en'ru avan avarka'lukku a'riviththirunthapadiyaal, morthekaayin so'rka'l nilaini'rkumoa en'ru paarkki'ratha'rku, athai aamaanukku a'riviththaarka'l.
aamaan morthekaay thannai va'nangki namaskariyaathathaik ka'ndapoathu, moorkkam ni'rainthavanaanaan.

aanaalum morthekaayinmealmaaththiram kaipoaduvathu avanukku a'rpakkaariyamaakak ka'ndathu; morthekaayin janangka'l innaaren'ru aamaanukku a'rivikkappattirunthapadiyaal, akaasvearuvin raajyamengkum irukki'ra morthekaayin janamaakiya yootharaiyellaam sangkarikka avan vakaitheadinaan.

raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvin pannira'ndaam varusham nisaan maathamaakiya muthalaam maathaththilea aamaanukku munpaakap poor ennappatta seettu ovvoru naa'laiyum ovvoru maathaththaiyum ku'riththup poadappattu, aathaarmaathamaana pannira'ndaam maathaththinmeal vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu aamaan akaasvearu raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya raajyaththin sakala naaduka'lilumu'l'la janangka'lukku'l'lea oruvitha janangka'l sitha'ru'ndu parampiyirukki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya vazhakkangka'l sakala janangka'ludaiya vazhakkangka'lukkum vika'rpamaayirukki'rathu; avarka'l raajaavin sattangka'laik kaikko'l'luki'rathillai; aakaiyaal avarka'lai ippadi vittirukki'rathu raajaavukku niyaayamalla.

raajaavukkuch sammathiyaanaal, avarka'lai azhikkavea'ndumen'ru ezhuthi anuppavea'ndiyathu; appozhuthu naan raajaavin kajaanaavilea ko'nduvanthu seluththa pathinaayiram thaalanthu ve'l'liyai e'n'nik kaariyakkaarar kaiyil koduppean en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa than kaiyilirukki'ra than moathiraththaik kazhat'ri, athai aakaakiyanaana ammethaaththaavin kumaaranum yootharin saththuruvumaakiya aamaanidaththil koduththu,
aamaanai noakki: antha ve'l'liyai nee vaiththukko'l; antha janaththukku un ishdappadi seyyalaam en'raan.

muthalaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyilea, raajaavin sampirathika'l azhaikkappattaarka'l; aamaan ka'rpiththapadiyellaam raajaavin theasaathipathika'lukkum, ovvoru naattinmeal vaikkappattiruntha thuraika'lukkum, ovvoru janaththin pirapukka'lukkum, anthantha naattil vazhangkum adcharaththilum, anthantha jaathiyaar peasum paashaiyilum ezhuthappattathu; raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvin pearaal athu ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththirai poadappattathu.

aathaar maathamaana pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyaakiya oreanaa'lilea si'riyoar periyoar kuzhanthaika'l sthireeka'l aakiya sakala yootharaiyum azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkavum, avarka'laik ko'l'laiyidavum, agncha'rkaarar kaiyilea raajaavin naaduka'lukkellaam katta'laika'l anuppappattathu.
antha naa'lukku aayaththappattirukkavea'ndum en'ru sakala janangka'lukkum koo'ri a'rivikki'ratha'rkaakak kodukkappatta katta'laiyin nakal ithuvea, ithu ovvoru naattilum pirasiththampa'n'nappattathu.

antha agncha'rkaarar raajaavin uththaravinaal theeviramaayp pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; anthak katta'lai soosaan aramanaiyil pi'ranthathu. raajaavum aamaanum kudikkumpadi udkaarnthaarka'l; soosaan nakaram kalangkit'ru.

nadantha yaavat'raiyum morthekaay a'rinthapoathu, morthekaay than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, irattuduththi, saampal poattukko'ndu, nakaraththin naduvea pu'rappattuppoay, thuyaramu'l'la makaa saththaththudanea ala'rikko'ndu,
raajaavin aramanai vaasal mukappumattum vanthaan; irattuduththinavanaay raajaavin aramanai vaasalukku'l piraveasikka oruvanukkum uththaravillai.

raajaavin uththaravum avanudaiya katta'laiyum poaych searntha ovvoru naattilum sthalaththilumu'l'la yootharukku'l'lea makaa thukkamum, upavaasamum, azhukaiyum, pulampalum u'ndaay, aneakar irattuduththich saampalil kidanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu estharin thaathimaarka'lum, ava'ludaiya pirathaanika'lumpoay, athai ava'lukku a'riviththaarka'l; athinaalea raajaaththi mikavum thukkappattu, morthekaay uduththiruntha irattai eduththuppoattu, avanai uduththuvikki'ratha'rku vasthirangka'lai anuppinaa'l; avanoa avaika'lai eat'rukko'l'laathirunthaan.

appozhuthu esthar than pa'nividaikken'ru raajaavinaal niyamiththiruntha avanudaiya pirathaanika'lil oruvanaakiya aaththaakai azhaippiththu: kaariyam enna? athin mukaantharam enna? en'ru a'riyumpadi, morthekaayinidaththil visaarikka avanukkuk katta'laiyittaa'l.
appadiyea aaththaaku raajaavin aramanai vaasalukku munnaana patta'naveethiyilirukki'ra morthekaayinidaththil pu'rappattuppoanaan.

appozhuthu morthekaay thanakkuch sampaviththa ellaavat'raippat'riyum, yootharai azhikkumpadi aamaan raajaavin kajaanaavukku e'n'nikkoduppean en'ru sonna pa'naththokaiyaippat'riyum avanukku a'riviththathum an'ri,

yootharka'lai azhikkumpadi soosaanil pi'rantha katta'laiyin nakalaiyum avanidaththil koduththu, athai estharukkuk kaa'npiththuth theriyappaduththavum, ava'l akaththiyamaay raajaavinidaththi'r poay, avanidaththil than janangka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'navum man'raadavum vea'ndumen'ru ava'lukkuch sollachsonnaan.
aaththaaku vanthu, morthekaayin vaarththaika'lai estharukku a'riviththaan.
appozhuthu esthar aaththaakinidaththil morthekaaykkuch solliyanuppinathu:

yaaraavathu azhaippikkappadaamal, u'lmut'raththil raajaavinidaththil piraveasiththaal, purusharaanaalum sthireeyaanaalum sari, avarka'l pizhaikkumpadikku avarka'lukku raajaa po'rsengkoalai neettinaalozhiya mat'rappadi saakavea'ndum enki'ra oru thava'raatha sattamu'ndu, ithu raajaavin sakala oozhiyakkaararukkum, raajaavinudaiya naaduka'lilu'l'la sakala janangka'lukkum theriyum; naan intha muppathunaa'la'lavum raajaavinidaththil varavazhaippikkappadavillai en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
estharin vaarththaika'lai morthekaaykkuth theriviththaarka'l.
morthekaay estharukkuth thirumpach sollachsonnathu: nee raajaavin aramanaiyilirukki'rathinaal, mat'ra yoothar thappakkoodaathirukka, nee thappuvaayen'ru un manathilea ninaivuko'l'laathea.

nee inthak kaalaththilea mavunamaayirunthaal, yootharukkuch sakaayamum iradchippum vea'roru idaththilirunthu ezhumpum, appozhuthu neeyum un thakappan kudumpaththaarum azhiveerka'l; nee ippadippatta kaalaththukku uthaviyaayirukkumpadi unakku raajameanmai kidaiththirukkalaamea, yaarukkuth theriyum, en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu esthar morthekaaykku ma'rupadiyum sollachsonnathu:

neer poay, soosaanil irukki'ra yootharaiyellaam koodivarachseythu, moon'runaa'l allum pakalum pusiyaamalum kudiyaamalumirunthu, enakkaaka upavaasampa'n'nungka'l; naanum en thaathimaarum upavaasampa'n'nuvoam; ivvithamaaka sattaththai mee'ri, raajaavinidaththil piraveasippean; naan seththaalum saaki'rean en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
appozhuthu morthekaay pu'rappattuppoay, esthar thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam seythaan.

moon'raam naa'lilea esthar raajavasthiran thariththukko'ndu, raaja aramanaiyin u'lmut'raththil, raajaa koluvirukkum sthaanaththukku ethiraaka vanthu nin'raa'l; raajaa aramanaivaasalukku ethiraana koluma'ndapaththil raajaasanaththilea veet'rirunthaan.

raajaa raajasthireeyaakiya esthar mut'raththil ni'rki'rathaik ka'ndapoathu, ava'lukku avan ka'nka'lil thayai kidaiththathinaal, raajaa than kaiyilirukki'ra po'rsengkoalai estharidaththi'rku neettinaan; appozhuthu esthar kittavanthu sengkoalin nuniyaith thottaa'l.
raajaa ava'lai noakki: esthar raajaaththiyea, unakku ennavea'ndum? nee keadki'ra man'raattu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum, unakkuk kodukkappadum en'raan.
appozhuthu esthar: raajaavukkuch siththamaanaal, naan thamakkuch seyviththa virunthukku raajaavum aamaanum in'raikku varavea'ndum en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa esthar so'rpadi seyya, aamaanaith theeviriththu varumpadi solli, esthar seytha virunthukku raajaavum aamaanum vanthaarka'l.

virunthilea thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappadukaiyil, raajaa estharaip paarththu: un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk kodukkappadum; nee keadki'rathu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum kidaikkum en'raan.
atha'rku esthar pirathiyuththaramaaka:

raajaavin ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupaikidaiththu, en vea'nduthalaik katta'laiyidavum, en vi'n'nappaththinpadi seyyavum, raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, raajaavum aamaanum naan innum thangka'lukkuch seyyappoaki'ra virunthukku varavea'ndum enpathea en vea'nduthalum en vi'n'nappamumaayirukki'rathu; naa'laikku raajaavin so'rpadi seyvean en'raa'l.

an'raiyathinam aamaan santhoashamum manamakizhchchiyumaayp pu'rappattaan; aanaalum raajaavin aramanai vaasalilirukki'ra morthekaay thanakku mun ezhunthiraamalum asaiyaamalum irukki'rathai aamaan ka'ndapoathu, avan morthekaayinmeal ukkiram ni'rainthavanaanaan.
aakilum aamaan athai adakkikko'ndu, than veettukku vanthu, than sineakitharaiyum than manaiviyaakiya sireashaiyum azhaiththu,

than aisuvariyaththin makimaiyaiyum, than pi'l'laika'lin thiradchiyaiyum, raajaa thannaip periyavanaakki, thannaip pirapukka'lmealum raajaavin oozhiyakkaararmealum uyarththina ellaavat'raiyum aamaan avarka'lukku vivariththuchsonnaan.

pinnaiyum aamaan: raajasthireeyaakiya estharum thaan seytha virunthukku raajaavudaneakooda ennaiththavira vea'roruvaraiyum azhaikkavillai; naa'laikkum raajaavudaneakooda naan virunthukku varavazhaikkappattirukki'rean.
aanaalum antha yoothanaakiya morthekaay raajaavin aramanaivaasalil udkaarnthirukki'rathai naan kaa'numa'lavum avaiyellaam enakku on'rumillaiyen'raan.

appozhuthu avan manaiviyaakiya sireashum avanudaiya sineakithar ellaarum avanaip paarththu: aimpathumuzha uyaramaana oru thookkumaram seyyappadavea'ndum; athilea morthekaayai thookkippoadumpadi naa'laiyaththinam neer raajaavukkuch sollavea'ndum; pinpu santhoashamaay raajaavudaneakooda virunthukkup poakalaam en'raarka'l; inthak kaariyam aamaanukku nan'raayk ka'ndathinaal thookkumaraththaich seyviththaan.
antha raaththiriyilea raajaavukku niththirai varaathapadiyinaal, kaalavarththamaanangka'l ezhuthiyirukki'ra nadapadi pusthakaththaik ko'nduvarachsonnaan; athu raajasamukaththil vaasikkappattathu.

appozhuthu vaasa'r kaavalaa'laril raajaavin ira'ndu pirathaanika'laakiya pikthaanaavum theareasum, raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvinmeal kaipoadappaarththa seythiyai morthekaay a'riviththaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu vaasikkappattathu.
appozhuthu raajaa: itha'rkaaka morthekaaykku kanamum meanmaiyum seyyappattathaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku raajaavaich seavikki'ra oozhiyakkaarar: avanukku on'rum seyyappadavillai en'ru sonnaarka'l.

aamaan thaan seytha thookkumaraththilea morthekaayaith thookkippoadavea'ndumen'ru, raajaavidaththil peasumpadi raaja aramanaiyin ve'limut'raththilea vanthirunthaan. appozhuthu raajaa: mut'raththilirukki'rathu yaar en'ru keattaan.
raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: ithoa, aamaan mut'raththilea ni'rki'raan en'raarka'l; raajaa: avan u'l'lea varattum en'raan.

aamaan u'l'lea vanthapoathu, raajaa avanai noakki: raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuki'ra manushanukku enna seyyappadavea'ndum en'ru keattaan; atha'rku aamaan, ennaiyan'ri, yaarai raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuvaar en'ru than manathilea ninaiththu,
raajaavai noakki: raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuki'ra manushanukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,
raajaa uduththikko'l'luki'ra raajavasthiramum, raajaa ea'ruki'ra kuthiraiyum, avar sirasilea tharikkappadum raajamudiyum ko'nduvarappadavea'ndum.

antha vasthiramum kuthiraiyum raajaavudaiya pirathaana pirapukka'lil oruvanudaiya kaiyilea kodukkappadavea'ndum; raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuki'ra manushanai alangkariththapin, avanaik kuthiraiyinmeal eat'ri, nakaraveethiyil ulaavumpadi seythu, raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuki'ra manushanukku ippadiyea seyyappadum en'ru avanukku munpaakak koo'rappadavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa aamaanai noakki: seekkiramaay nee sonnapadi vasthiraththaiyum kuthiraiyaiyum ko'ndupoay, raaja aramanaiyin vaasalil udkaarnthirukki'ra yoothanaakiya morthekaaykku anthappirakaaram sey; nee sonna ellaavat'rilum on'rum thava'raathapadi paar en'raan.

appadiyea aamaan vasthiraththaiyum kuthiraiyaiyum ko'ndupoay, morthekaayai alangkariththu, avanaik kuthiraiyinmeal eat'ri, nakaraveethiyil ulaavumpadi seythu, raajaa kanampa'n'na virumpuki'ra manushanukku ippadiyea seyyappadum en'ru avanukku munpaakak koo'rinaan.
pinpu morthekaay raajaavin aramanaivaasalukkuth thirumpivanthaan; aamaanoaven'raal sagnchalappattu mukkaadittukko'ndu than veettukkuth theeviriththuppoanaan.

aamaan thanakku nearitta ellaavat'raiyum than manaiviyaakiya sireashukkum than sineakithar ellaarukkum a'riviththapoathu, avanudaiya aaloasanaikkaararum avan manaiviyaakiya sireashum avanaip paarththu: morthekaaykku munpaaka neer thaazhnthupoakath thodangkineer; avan yoothakulamaanaal, neer avanai mea'rko'l'laamal avanukku munpaakath thaazhnthupoavathu nichchayam en'raarka'l.
avarka'l ippadip peasikko'ndirukkumpoathea, raajaavin pirathaanika'l vanthu, esthar seytha virunthukku vara aamaanaith thurithappaduththinaarka'l.
raajaaththiyaakiya estharudanea virunthu'n'na, raajaavum aamaanum vanthapoathu,

ira'ndaam naa'l virunthil thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappadumpoathu, raajaa estharai noakki: esthar raajaaththiyea, un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk kodukkappadum; nee keadki'ra man'raattu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum kidaikkum en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaaththiyaakiya esthar pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaavea, ummudaiya ka'nka'lil enakkuk kirupai kidaiththu, raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal en vea'nduthalukku en jeevanum, en man'raattukku en janangka'lum enakkuk katta'laiyidappaduvathaaka.

engka'lai azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkumpadi naanum en janangka'lum vi'rkappattoam; adimaika'laakavum ve'l'laattika'laakavum vi'rkappattuppoanaalum naan mavunamaayiruppean; ippozhuthoa raajaavukku u'ndaakum nashdaththukku anthach saththuru uththaravaathampa'n'na mudiyaathu en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya akaasvearu ma'rumozhiyaaka, raajaaththiyaakiya estharai noakki: ippadich seyyath thu'nikarangko'ndavan yaar? avan engkea? en'raan.
atha'rku esthar: saththuruvum pakaignanumaakiya antha manithan inthath thushda aamaanthaan en'raa'l; appozhuthu raajaavukkum raajaaththikkum munpaaka aamaan thikiladainthaan.

raajaa ukkiraththoadea thiraadcharasappanthiyai vittezhunthu, aramanaith thoattaththi'rkup poanaan; raajaavinaal thanakkup pollaappu nir'nayikkappattathen'ru aamaan ka'ndu, raajaaththiyaakiya estharidaththil than piraa'nanukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'na ezhunthunin'raan.

raajaa aramanaith thoattaththilirunthu thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappatta idaththukkuth thirumpivarukaiyil, esthar udkaarnthirukki'ra meththaiyinmeal aamaan vizhunthukidanthaan; appozhuthu raajaa: naan aramanaiyilirukkumpoathea en ka'nmunnea ivan raajaaththiyaip palavantham seyyavea'ndumen'rirukki'raanoa en'raan; intha vaarththai raajaavin vaayilirunthu pi'ranthavudanea aamaanin mukaththai moodippoattaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajasamukaththil irukki'ra pirathaanika'lil a'rpoanaa ennum oruvan: ithoa, raajaavin nanmaikkaakap peasina morthekaaykku aamaan seyviththa aimpathu muzha uyaramaana thookkumaram aamaanin veetta'ndai naattappattirukki'rathu en'raan; appozhuthu raajaa: athilea avanaith thookkippoadungka'l en'raan.
appadiyea aamaan morthekaaykku aayaththampa'n'nina thookkumaraththil aamaanaiyea thookkippoattaarka'l; appozhuthu raajaavin ukkiram tha'ninthathu.

an'raiyathinam akaasvearu raajaa yootharin saththuruvaayiruntha aamaanin veettai raajaaththiyaakiya estharukkuk koduththaan; morthekaay raajasamukaththil vanthaan; avan thanakku inna u'ravu en'ru esthar a'riviththirunthaa'l.
raajaa aamaanin kaiyilirunthu vaangkippoatta thammudaiya moathiraththai eduththu, athai morthekaaykkuk koduththaan; esthar morthekaayai aamaanin aramanaikku athikaariyaaka vaiththaa'l.

pinnum esthar raajasamukaththil peasi, avan paathangka'lil vizhunthu azhuthu, aakaakiyanaana aamaanin theevinaiyaiyum avan yootharukku viroathagnseyya yoasiththa yoasanaiyaiyum parikarikka avanidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa po'rsengkoalai estharukku neettinaan; esthar ezhunthirunthu raajasamukaththil nin'ru:

raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthu avar samukaththil enakkuk kirupaikidaiththu, raajasamukaththil naan sollum vaarththai sariyen'ru kaa'nappattu, avarudaiya ka'nka'lukku naan piriyamaayirunthaal, raajaavin naaduka'lilellaam irukki'ra yootharai azhikkavea'ndum en'ru ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaakiya aamaan ennum aakaakiyan theevinaiyaay ezhuthina katta'laika'l sellaama'rpoakappa'n'numpadi ezhuthi anuppappadavea'ndum.
en janaththinmeal varum pollaappai naan eppadip paarkkakkoodum? en kulaththukku varum azhivai naan eppadich sakikkakkoodum? en'raa'l.

appozhuthu akaasvearu raajaa raajaaththiyaakiya estharaiyum yoothanaakiya morthekaayaiyum noakki: ithoa, aamaanin veettai estharukkuk koduththean; avan yootharmeal than kaiyaippoada eththaniththapadiyinaal avanai maraththilea thookkippoattaarka'l.

ippoathum ungka'lukku ishdamaanapadi neengka'l raajaavin naamaththinaal yootharukkaaka ezhuthi, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththiraipoadungka'l; raajaavinpearaal ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththiraipoadappattathaich sellaama'r poakappa'n'na oruvaraalum koodaathu en'raan.

seevaan maatham ennum moon'raam maatham irupaththumoon'raantheathiyaakiya akkaalaththileathaanea raajaavin sampirathika'l azhaikkappattaarka'l; morthekaay ka'rpiththapadiyellaam yootharukkum inthutheasammuthal eththiyoappiyaa theasamattumu'l'la noot'rirupaththeazhu naaduka'lin theasaathipathika'lukkum, athipathika'lukkum, athikaarika'lukkum, anthantha naattil vazhangkum adcharaththilum, anthantha jaathiyaar peasum paashaiyilum, yootharukkum avarka'l adcharaththilum avarka'l paashaiyilum ezhuthappattathu.

anthak katta'laika'l akaasvearu raajaavin pearaal ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththirai poadappattapin, kuthiraika'lmealum veakamaana ottakangka'lmealum, koavea'ru kazhuthaika'lmealum ea'rippoaki'ra agncha'rkaarar kaiyil anuppappattathu.
avaika'lil, akaasvearu raajaavudaiya ellaa naaduka'lilum aathaar maatham enki'ra pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyaakiya antha oreanaa'lilea,

anthanthap patta'naththilirukki'ra yoothar on'raaych searnthu, thangka'l piraa'nanaik kaappaat'ravum, thangka'lai viroathikkum saththurukka'laakiya janaththaarum theasaththaarumaana ellaaraiyum, avarka'l kuzhanthaika'laiyum, sthireeka'laiyum azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkavum, avarka'l udaimaika'laik ko'l'laiyidavum, raajaa yootharukkuk katta'laiyittaar en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

yoothar thangka'l pakaignarukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattumpadi niyamiththa an'raiyathinaththil aayaththamaayirukkavea'ndumen'ru anthantha naattilu'l'la sakala janangka'lukkum koo'rappaduki'ratha'rkaakak kodukkappatta katta'laiyin nakal ithuvea; ithu ovvoru naattilum pirasiththampa'n'nappattathu.

appadiyea veakamaana ottakangka'lmealum, koavea'ru kazhuthaika'lmealum ea'rina agncha'rkaarar raajaavin vaarththaiyinaalea eavappattu, theeviraththoadea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; anthak katta'lai soosaan aramanaiyil kodukkappattathu.

appozhuthu morthekaay i'laneelamum ve'l'laiyumaana raajavasthiramum, periya ponmudiyum, pattum iraththaamparamum a'ninthavanaay raajaavinidaththilirunthu pu'rappattaan; soosaan nakaram aarppariththu makizhnthirunthathu.
ivvithamaay yootharukku ve'lichchamum, makizhchchiyum, ka'lippum, kanamum u'ndaayit'ru.

raajaavin vaarththaiyum avanudaiya katta'laiyum poaychsearntha ellaa naaduka'lilum, ellaap patta'nangka'lilum, yootharukku'l'lea athu makizhchchiyum, ka'lippum, virunthu'ndu ko'ndaadum nalla naa'lumaayirunthathu; yootharukkup payappaduki'ra payam theasaththu janangka'laip pidiththathinaal, avarka'lil aneakar yoothamaarkkaththil amainthaarka'l.

raajaavin vaarththaiyinpadiyum avanudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyum seyyappaduki'ratha'rku, aathaar maatham enki'ra pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raan theathiyilea, yootharin pakaignar avarka'lai mea'rko'l'lalaam en'ru nampinaarka'lea; annaa'lileathaanea, yootharaanavarka'l thangka'l pakaignarai mea'rko'l'lumpadikkuk kaariyam maa'ruthalaay mudinthathu.

yoothar akaasvearu raajaavin sakala naaduka'lilumu'l'la patta'nangka'lilea thangka'lukkup pollaappu varappa'n'nap paarththavarka'lmeal kaipoadak koodikko'ndaarka'l; oruvarum avarka'lukku munpaaka ni'rkakkoodaathirunthathu; avarka'laippat'ri sakala janangka'lukkum payamu'ndaayit'ru.

naaduka'lin sakala athikaarika'lum, theasaathipathika'lum, thuraika'lum, raajaavin kaariyangka'lai nadappikki'ravarka'lum, yootharukkuth thu'nainin'raarka'l; morthekaayinaal u'ndaana payangkaram avarka'laip pidiththathu.
morthekaay raajaavin aramanaiyil periyavanaayirunthaan; avanudaiya keerththi ellaa naaduka'lilum pirasiththamaayit'ru; intha morthekaay enpavan meanmealum periyavanaanaan.
appadiyea yoothar thangka'l saththurukka'laiyellaam pattayaththaal vettik kon'ru nirmoolamaakki, thangka'l ishdappadi thangka'l pakaignarukkuch seythaarka'l.
yoothar soosaan aramanaiyilum ainnoo'rupearaik kon'ru nirmoolamaakkinaarka'l.
ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaakiya aamaan ennum yootharudaiya saththuruvin kumaararaana parsaanthaaththaa, thalpoan, aspaathaa,
poraathaa, athaliyaa, arithaaththaa,
parmashdaa, arisaay, arithaay, vaaysaathaa aakiya paththuppearaiyum kon'rupoattaarka'l.
aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangka'l kaiyai neettavillai.
an'raiyathinam soosaan aramanaiyil kon'rupoadappattavarka'lin thokai raajasamukaththil ko'nduvarappattathu.

appozhuthu raajaa, raajaaththiyaakiya estharai noakki: yoothar soosaan aramanaiyil ainnoo'rupearaiyum aamaanin paththuk kumaararaiyum kon'ru nirmoolamaakkinaarka'l; raajaavin mat'ra naaduka'lilum enna seythiruppaarka'loa! ippoathum un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk katta'laiyidappadum; un man'raattu enna? athinpadi seyyappadum en'raan.

appozhuthu esthar: raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, in'raiyathinaththuk katta'laiyinpadiyea soosaanilirukki'ra yoothar naa'laiyathinamum seyyavum, aamaanin paththuk kumaararin udalaiyum thookkumaraththil thookkippoadavum uththaravaakavea'ndum en'raa'l.
appadiyea seyyumpadikku raajaa uththaravu koduththaan; atha'rkuch soosaanilea katta'lai pi'ranthathu; aamaanin paththuk kumaararudaiya udalaiyum thookkippoattaarka'l.
soosaanilirukki'ra yoothar aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaantheathiyilum koodichsearnthu, soosaanil munnoo'rupearaik kon'rupoattaarka'l; aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangka'l kaiyai neettavillai.

raajaavin naaduka'lilu'l'la mat'ra yootharka'l thangka'l piraa'nanaith tha'rkaakkavum, thangka'l pakaignarukku vilaki i'laippaa'ruthal adaiyavum orumikkach searnthu, thangka'l viroathika'lil ezhupaththaiyaayiram pearaik kon'rupoattaarka'l; aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangka'l kaiyai neettavillai.
aathaar maathaththin pathinmoon'raantheathiyilea ippadich seythu, pathinaalaantheathiyilea i'laippaa'ri, athai virunthu'ndu santhoashappaduki'ra pa'ndikai naa'laakkinaarka'l.

soosaanilu'l'la yootharoaven'raal, antha maathaththin pathinmoon'raantheathiyilum pathinaalaantheathiyilum eakamaayk koodi, pathinainthaantheathiyil i'laippaa'ri, athai virunthu'ndu santhoashappaduki'ra pa'ndikai naa'laakkinaarka'l.

aathalaal alangkamillaatha oorka'lil kudiyirukki'ra naattuppu'raththaaraana yootharka'l aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaantheathiyaich santhoashamum, virunthu'nki'ra poorippumaana naa'lum, oruvarukkoruvar varisaika'lai anuppuki'ra naa'lumaakkinaarka'l.
morthekaay intha varththamaanangka'lai ezhuthi, sameepaththilum thooraththilum irukki'ra akaasvearu raajaavin sakala naaduka'lilumu'l'la ellaa yootharukkum nirupangka'lai anuppi,

varushanthoa'rum aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaam pathinainthaantheathika'lai, yoothar thangka'l pakaignarukku neengkalaaki i'laippaa'ruthal adaintha naadka'laakavum, avarka'l sagnchalam santhoashamaakavum, avarka'l thukkam makizhchchiyaakavum maa'rina maathamaakavum aasariththu,
annaadka'lil virunthu'ndu santhoashangko'ndaadavum, oruvarukkoruvar varisaika'lai anuppavum, e'liyavarka'lukkuth thaanatharmagnseyyavum vea'ndumen'ru thittampa'n'ninaan.
appozhuthu yoothar thaangka'l seyyaththodangkinapadiyum morthekaay thangka'lukku ezhuthinapadiyum seyyach sammathiththaarka'l.

ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaakiya aamaan ennum aakaakiyan, yootharukkellaam saththuruvaayirunthu yootharaich sangkarikka ninaiththu, avarka'lai azhikkavum nirmoolamaakkavum, poor ennappatta seettaip poaduviththaan.

aanaalum esthar, raajasamukaththil poay, yootharukku viroathamaay avan ninaiththa avanudaiya pollaatha yoasanai avanudaiya thalaiyinmeal thirumpumpadi katta'lai pi'rappiththathinaalea, avanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum maraththilea thookkippoattaarka'l.

aakaiyinaal antha naadka'l poor ennum pearinaal pooreem ennappattathu; avan antha nirupaththil ezhuthiyiruntha ellaa vaarththaika'linimiththamum, thaangka'lea intha vishayaththil anupaviththavaika'linimiththamum, thangka'lukku nearittavaika'linimiththamum,
yoothar athaith thittappaduththi, antha ira'ndu naadka'laikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea, avaika'lai varushanthoa'rum, avaika'lin sariyaana kaalaththilea aasariyaamaliruppathillai enpathaiyum,

intha naadka'l ellaath thalaimu'raika'lilum, vamsangka'lilum, theasangka'lilum, oorka'lilum ninaivukoorappattu aasarikkappadavea'ndum enpathaiyum, inthap pooreem ennum pa'ndikai naadka'l yootharukku'l'lea thava'rippoakaamalum, avaika'lai ninaivukooruthal thangka'l santhathiyaarukku'l'lea ozhinthupoakaamalum irukkavea'ndum enpathaiyum, thangka'lmealum, thangka'l santhathiyaarmealum, thangka'l maarkkaththil amaiyappoaki'ra mat'ra yaavarmealum kadanaaka niyamiththukko'ndaarka'l.

pooreemaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'ra intha ira'ndaam nirupaththaith thidappaduththumpadikku, apiyaayealin kumaaraththiyaakiya esthar ennum raajaaththiyum, yoothanaakiya morthekaayum, pinnum makaa u'ruthiyaay ezhuthinaarka'l.

yoothanaakiya morthekaayum, raajaaththiyaakiya estharum yootharukku u'ruthippaadupa'n'ninathum, avarka'lthaanea upavaasaththoadum ala'ruthaloadum aasarippoam en'ru thangka'lmealum thangka'l santhathiyaarmealum kadanaaka niyamiththukko'ndathumaana, pooreem ennappatta intha naadka'l avaika'lin sariyaana kaalangka'lil aasarikkappadum kaariyaththai u'ruthiyaakka,
avan akaasvearuvin raajyaththilu'l'la noot'rirupaththeazhu naaduka'lilum irukki'ra ellaa yootharukkum samaathaanamum u'nmaiyumaana vaarththaika'laiyudaiya nirupangka'lai anuppinaan.
ippadiyea estharin katta'laiyaanathu pooreem naadka'laippat'rina intha varththamaanangka'laith thidappaduththinathu; athu oru pusthakaththil ezhuthappattathu.
raajaavaakiya akaasvearu theasaththinmealum, samuththiraththilu'l'la theevuka'linmealum, pakuthi ea'rpaduththinaan.

vallamaiyum paraakkiramamumaana avanudaiya ellaach seykaika'lum, raajaa periyavanaakkina morthekaayinudaiya meanmaiyin virththaanthamum, meathiyaa persiyaa raajaakka'lin nadapadi pusthakaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

yoothanaakiya morthekaay raajaavaakiya akaasvearuvukku ira'ndaavathaanavanum, yootharukku'l periyavanum, than thira'laana sakoathararukkup piriyamaanavanumaayirunthathum an'rith than janangka'ludaiya nanmaiyai naadi, than kulaththaarukkellaam samaathaanamu'ndaakap peasuki'ravanumaayirunthaan.
ooths theasaththilea yoapu ennum pearko'nda oru manushan irunthaan; antha manushan uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup payanthu, pollaappukku vilakuki'ravanumaayirunthaan.
avanukku eazhu kumaararum, moon'ru kumaaraththika'lum pi'ranthaarka'l.

avanukku eazhaayiram aaduka'lum, moovaayiram ottakangka'lum, ainnoo'ru earmaaduka'lum, ainnoo'ru kazhuthaika'lumaakiya mirukajeevanka'l irunthathuman'ri, thira'laana pa'nividaikkaararum irunthaarka'l; athinaal antha manushan kizhakkaththip puththirar ellaarilum periyavanaayirunthaan.
avan kumaarar, avanavan thanthan naa'lilea thanthan veettilea virunthuseythu, thangka'l moon'ru sakoatharika'laiyum thangka'loadea poajanam pa'n'numpadi azhaippaarka'l.

virunthuseyki'ra avaravarudaiya naa'lmu'rai mudiki'rapoathu, yoapu: oruvea'lai en kumaarar paavagnseythu, theavanaith thangka'l iruthayaththilea thooshiththiruppaarka'l en'ru solli, avarka'lai azhaiththanuppi, parisuththappaduththi, athikaalamea ezhunthu, avarka'l ellaarudaiya ilakkaththinpadiyeayum sarvaangka thakanapalika'laich seluththuvaan; inthappirakaaramaaka yoapu annaadka'lilellaam seythuvaruvaan.
orunaa'l theavapuththirar karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'rapoathu, saaththaanum avarka'l naduvilea vanthu nin'raan.
karththar saaththaanaip paarththu: nee engkeayirunthu varuki'raay en'raar. saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: poomiyengkum ulaavi, athil sut'riththirinthu varuki'rean en'raan.

karththar saaththaanai noakki: en thaasanaakiya yoapinmeal kavanam vaiththaayoa? uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup payanthu, pollaappukku vilakuki'ravanumaakiya avanaippoalap poomiyil oruvanum illai en'raar.
atha'rkuch saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: yoapu viruthaavaakavaa theavanukkup payanthu nadakki'raan?
neer avanaiyum avan veettaiyum avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum sut'ri vealiyadaikkavillaiyoa? avan kaika'lin kiriyaiyai aaseervathiththeer; avanudaiya sampaththu theasaththil perukit'ru.
aanaalum ummudaiya kaiyai neetti avanukku u'ndaanavaiyellaam thoduveeraanaal, appozhuthu avan umathu mukaththukku ethirea ummaith thooshikkaanoa paarum en'raan.

karththar saaththaanai noakki: ithoa, avanukku u'ndaanavaiyellaam un kaiyilirukki'rathu; avanmealmaaththiram un kaiyai neettaathea en'raar; appozhuthu saaththaan karththarudaiya sannithiyaivittup pu'rappattuppoanaan.
pinpu orunaa'l yoapudaiya kumaararum, avan kumaaraththika'lum, thangka'l mooththa sakoatharan veettilea pusiththu, thiraadcharasam kudikki'rapoathu,
oru aa'l avanidaththil vanthu: eruthuka'l uzhuki'rapoathu, kazhuthaika'l avaika'lin pakkaththilea meaynthuko'ndirukkaiyil,

sapeayar avaika'lmeal vizhunthu, avaika'laich saayththukko'ndupoanaarka'l; vealaiyaadka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaarka'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.

ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: vaanaththilirunthu theavanudaiya akkini vizhunthu, aaduka'laiyum vealaiyaadka'laiyum sutteriththuppoattathu; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.

ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: kaltheayar moon'ru pavugnchaay vanthu, ottakangka'lmeal vizhunthu, avaika'lai oattikko'ndupoanaarka'l; vealaiyaadka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaarka'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.
ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: ummudaiya kumaararum ummudaiya kumaaraththika'lum, thangka'l mooththa sakoatharan veettilea pusiththuth thiraadcharasam kudikki'rapoathu,

vanaantharavazhiyaayp perungkaat'ru vanthu, antha veettin naalu moolaiyilum adikka, athu pi'l'laika'linmeal vizhunthathinaal avarka'l i'ranthupoanaarka'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.
appozhuthu yoapu ezhunthirunthu, than saalvaiyaik kizhiththu, than thalaiyaich siraiththu, tharaiyilea vizhunthu pa'ninthu:
nirvaa'niyaay en thaayin karppaththilirunthu vanthean; nirvaa'niyaay avvidaththukkuth thirumpuvean; karththar koduththaar, karththar eduththaar; karththarudaiya naamaththukku sthoaththiram en'raan.
ivaiyellaavat'rilum yoapu paavagnseyyavumillai, theavanaippat'rik ku'raisollavumillai.
pinnorunaa'lilea theavapuththirar karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'rapoathu, saaththaanum avarka'l naduvilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'raan.
karththar saaththaanaip paarththu: nee engkeayirunthu varuki'raay en'raar; saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: poomiyengkum ulaavi, athil sut'riththirinthu varuki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar saaththaanai noakki: nee en thaasanaakiya yoapinmeal kavanam vaiththaayoa? uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup payanthu, pollaappukku vilakuki'ravanumaana manushanaakiya avanaippoala poomiyil oruvanumillai; mukaantharamillaamal avanai nirmoolamaakkumpadi nee ennai eavinapoathilum, avan innum than uththamaththilea u'ruthiyaay ni'rki'raan en'raar.
saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: thoalukkup pathilaakath thoalaiyum, than jeevanukkup pathilaakath thanakku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum, manushan koduththuviduvaan.
aanaalum neer ummudaiya kaiyai neetti, avan elumpaiyum avan maamsaththaiyum thoduveeraanaal, appozhuthu avan umathu mukaththukku ethirea ummaith thooshikkaanoa paarum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar saaththaanai noakki: ithoa, avan un kaiyilirukki'raan; aakilum avan piraa'nanaimaaththiram thappavidu en'raar.
appozhuthu saaththaan karththarudaiya sannithiyaivittup pu'rappattu, yoapin u'l'langkaalthodangki avan uchchanthalaimattum kodiya parukka'laal avanai vaathiththaan.
avan oru oattai eduththu, thannaich su'ra'ndikko'ndu saampalil udkaarnthaan.
appozhuthu avan manaivi avanaip paarththu: neer innum ummudaiya uththamaththil u'ruthiyaay ni'rki'reeroa? theavanaith thooshiththu jeevanai vidum en'raa'l.

atha'rku avan: nee payiththiyakkaari peasuki'rathupoalap peasuki'raay; theavan kaiyilea nanmaiyaip pet'ra naam theemaiyaiyum pe'ravea'ndaamoa en'raan; ivaika'l ellaavat'rilum yoapu than uthaduka'linaal paavagnseyyavillai.

yoapudaiya moon'ru sineakitharaakiya theamaaniyanaana elippaasum, sookiyanaana pilthaathum, naakamaaththiyanaana soappaarum, yoapukku nearitta theemaika'l yaavaiyum kea'lvippattapoathu, avanukkaakap parithapikkavum, avanukku aa'ruthalsollavum, oruvaroadoruvar yoasanaipa'n'nikko'ndu, avaravar thangka'l sthalangka'lilirunthu vanthaarka'l.

avarka'l thooraththil varukaiyil thangka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, avanai uruththeriyaamal, saththamittu azhuthu, avaravar thangka'l saalvaiyaik kizhiththu, vaanaththaip paarththu: thangka'l thalaika'lmeal puzhuthiyaith thoot'rikko'ndu,
vanthu, avan thukkam makaakodiya thukkam en'ru ka'ndu, oruvarum avanoadu oru vaarththaiyaiyum peasaamal, iravupakal eazhunaa'l, avanoadukoodath tharaiyilea udkaarnthirunthaarka'l.
atha'rkuppinpu yoapu than vaayaith thi'ranthu, thaan pi'rantha naa'laich sapiththu,
vasaniththuch sonnathu ennaven'raal:
naan pi'ranthanaa'lum oru aa'npi'l'lai u'rpaththiyaayit'ren'ru sollappatta raaththiriyum azhivathaaka.
antha naa'l anthakaarappaduvathaaka; theavan uyaraththilirunthu athai visaariyaamalum, o'li athinmeal pirakaasiyaamalum,
anthakaaramum mara'na iru'lum athaik ka'raippaduththi, mappu athai moodi, manthaaranaa'lin payangkarangka'l athai arukka'lippaakkuvathaaka.
antha raaththiriyai anthakaaram pidippathaaka; varushaththin naadka'lil athu santhoashappaduki'ra naa'laayiraamalum maathangka'lin ka'nakkilea athu varaamalum poavathaaka.
antha raaththiri thanimaiyaayiruppathaaka; athilea kempeerasaththam illaama'rpoavathaaka.
naa'laich sapikki'ravarka'lum, liviyaathaanai ezhumpappa'n'naththakkavarka'lum, athaich sapippaarka'laaka.
athin asthamanakaalaththil thoan'riya nadchaththirangka'l iru'ndu, athu ethirpaarththiruntha ve'lichcham u'ndaakaamalum, vidiya'rkaalaththu ve'luppai athu kaa'naamalum iruppathaaka.
naan iruntha karppaththin vaasalai athu adaikkaamalum, en ka'nka'l kaa'nki'ra varuththaththai ma'raiththuvidaamalum irunthathea.
naan karppaththilthaanea azhiyaamalum, karppaththilirunthu pu'rappaduki'rapoathea saakaamalum poanathenna?
ennai eanthikko'l'la madiyum, naan paalu'n'na sthanangka'lum u'ndaayirunthathenna?
appadiyillaathirunthaal, asaiyaamal kidanthu amarnthirunthu,
paazhnilangka'lil thangka'lukku maa'likaiyaikkattina poomiyin raajaakka'loadum manthirimaarka'loadum,
allathu, ponnai udaiyavarka'lum, thangka'l veeduka'lai ve'l'liyinaal nirappinavarka'lumaana pirapukka'loadungkooda naan ippozhuthu thoongki i'laippaa'ruveanea.
allathu, ve'lippadaatha muthiraappi'ndampoalavum, ve'lichchaththaik kaa'naatha sisukka'lpoalavum iruppeanea.
thunmaarkkarudaiya thontharavu angkea oaynthirukki'rathu; pelanat'ru vidaayththuppoanavarka'l angkea i'laippaa'ruki'raarka'l.
kattu'ndirunthavarka'l angkea eakamaaka amainthirukki'raarka'l; odukkuki'ravanudaiya saththam angkea keadkappaduki'rathillai.
si'riyavanum periyavanum angkea sariyaayirukki'raarka'l; adimai than ejamaanukku neengkalaayirukki'raan.
mara'naththukku aasaiyaayk kaaththirunthu, puthaiyalaith theaduki'rathupoala athaith theadiyum adaiyaama'rpoaki'ravarka'lum,
pireathakkuzhiyaik ka'ndupidiththathinaal mikavum ka'likoornthu,
atha'rkaakach santhoashappaduki'ra nirppaakkiyarumaakiya ivarka'lukku ve'lichchamum, manachsagnchalamu'l'la ivarka'lukku jeevanum kodukkappaduki'rathinaal palan enna?
than vazhiyaik kaa'nakkoodaathapadikku, theavanaal va'lainthuko'l'lappattavanukku ve'lichchaththinaal palan enna?
en poajanaththukku munnea enakkup perumoochchu u'ndaaki'rathu; en katha'ruthal ve'l'lampoal pura'ndupoaki'rathu.
naan payantha kaariyam enakku nearittathu; naan agnchinathu enakku vanthathu.
enakkuch sukamumillai, i'laippaa'ruthalumillai, amaithalumillai; enakkuth thaththa'lippea nearittathu.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaakiya elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaka:
naangka'l ummudanea peasaththu'ninthaal, aayaasappaduveeroa? aanaalum peasaamal adakkikko'l'laththakkavan yaar?
ithoa, neer aneakarukkup puththisolli, i'laiththa kaika'laith thidappaduththineer.
vizhuki'ravanai ummudaiya vaarththaika'laal ni'rkappa'n'ni, tha'l'laaduki'ra muzhangkaalka'laip palappaduththineer.
ippozhuthoa thunpam umakku nearittapadiyinaal aayaasappaduki'reer; athu ummaith thottathinaal kalangkuki'reer.
ummudaiya theavapakthi ummudaiya u'ruthiyaayum, ummudaiya vazhika'lin uththamam ummudaiya nampikkaiyaayum irukkavea'ndiyathallavoa?
kut'ramillaamal azhinthavan u'ndoa? sanmaarkkar athampa'n'nappattathu eppoa? ithai ninaiththuppaarum.
naan ka'ndirukki'rapadi, aniyaayaththai uzhuthu, theevinaiyai vithaiththavarka'l, athaiyea a'rukki'raarka'l.
theavanudaiya suvaasaththinaalea avarka'l azhinthu, avarudaiya naasiyin kaat'rinaalea nirmoolamaaki'raarka'l.
singkaththin kerchchippum, thushdasingkaththin muzhakkamum adangkum; paalasingkangka'lin pa'rka'lum thakarnthu poam.
kizhachsingkam iraiyillaamaiyaal maa'ndupoam, paalasingkangka'l sitha'ru'ndupoam.
ippoathum oru vaarththai ennidaththil irakasiyamaay a'rivikkappattathu, athinudaiya melliya oasai en seviyil vizhunthathu.
manusharmeal ayarntha niththirai i'rangkukaiyil, iraaththarisanangka'lil palavitha thoat'rangka'l u'ndaakumpoathu,
thikilum nadukkamum ennaip pidiththathu, en elumpuka'lellaam nadungkinathu.
appozhuthu oru aavi en mukaththukku munpaakak kadanthathu, en udalin mayir silirththathu.
athu oru uruppoala en ka'nka'lukkumun nin'rathu, aanaalum athin roopam innathen'ru vi'langkavillai; amaithalu'ndaayit'ru, appozhuthu naan keatta saththamaavathu:
manushan theavanaippaarkkilum neethimaanaayiruppaanoa? manupuththiran thannai u'ndaakkinavaraippaarkkilum suththamaayiruppaanoa?
kea'lum, avar thammudaiya pa'nividaikkaararidaththil nampikkai vaippathillai; thammudaiya thootharinmealum puththiyeenaththaich sumaththuki'raarea,
puzhuthiyil asthipaaram poattu, ma'n veeduka'lil vaasampa'n'ni, pottuppoochchiyaal arikkappaduki'ravarka'lmeal avar nampikkai vaippathu eppadi?
kaalaimuthal maalaivaraikkum madinthu, kavanippaar oruvarumillaamal, niththiya azhivadaiki'raarka'l.
avarka'lilirukki'ra avarka'ludaiya meanmai poayvidumallavoa? gnaanamadaiyaamal saaki'raarka'lea en'ru sonnaan.
ippoathu kooppidum, umakku uththaravu koduppaar u'ndoa paarppoam? parisuththavaanka'lil yaarai noakkip paarppeer?
koapam nirmoodanaik kollum; po'raamai puththiyillaathavanai athampa'n'num.
nirmoodan oruvan vearoon'ruki'rathai naan ka'ndu udanea avan vaasasthalaththaich sapiththean.
avan pi'l'laika'l iradchippukkuth thooramaaki, thappuvippaarillaamal, vaasalilea no'rukkappattaarka'l.
pasiththavan avan vi'laichchalai mudchedika'lukku'l'lumirunthu pa'riththuth thin'raan; pa'rikaaran avan aasthiyai vizhungkinaan.
theengku puzhuthiyilirunthu u'ndaaki'rathumillai; varuththam ma'n'nilirunthu mu'laikki'rathumillai.
akkinippo'rika'l mealea pa'rakki'rathupoala, manushan varuththam anupavikkap pi'ranthirukki'raan.
aanaalum naan theavanai naadi, en niyaayaththaith theavanidaththil oppuvippean.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha periya kaariyangka'laiyum, e'n'nimudiyaatha athisayangka'laiyum avar seyki'raar.
thaazhnthavarka'lai uyaraththil vaiththu, thukkikki'ravarka'lai iradchiththu uyarththuki'raar.
avar poomiyinmeal mazhaiyai varushikkappa'n'ni, ve'linilangka'linmeal tha'n'neerka'lai varuvikki'raar.
thanthirakkaararin kaika'l kaariyaththai mudiya nadaththakkoodaathapadikku, avarka'ludaiya upaayangka'lai avar apaththamaakkuki'raar.
avar gnaanika'lai avarka'ludaiya thanthiraththilea pidikki'raar; thiriyaavarakkaararin aaloasanai kavizhkkappadum.
avarka'l paka'rkaalaththilea anthakaaraththukku'l'laaki, maththiyaana vea'laiyilea iravil thadavuki'rathupoalath thadavith thiriki'raarka'l.
aanaalum e'liyavanai avarka'l vaayilirukki'ra pattayaththukkum, pelavaanin kaikkum vilakki iradchikki'raar.
athinaal thariththiranukku nampikkai u'ndu; theemaiyaanathu than vaayai moodum.
ithoa, theavan tha'ndikki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan; aakaiyaal sarvavallavarudaiya sidchaiyai a'rpamaaka e'n'naathirum.
avar kaayappaduththik kaayangkattuki'raar; avar adikki'raar, avarudaiya kai aat'ruki'rathu.
aa'ru ikkattuka'lukku ummai neengkalaakkuvaar; eazhaavathilum pollaappu ummaith thodaathu.
pagnchakaalaththilea avar ummai mara'naththukkum, yuththaththilea pattayaththin vettukkum vilakki meedpaar.
naavin savukkukkum ma'raikkappaduveer; paazhaakkuthal varumpoathum payappadaamaliruppeer.
paazhaakkuthalaiyum pagnchaththaiyum paarththu nakaippeer; kaattumirukangka'lukkum payappadaamaliruppeer.
ve'liyin kalluka'loadum umakku udanpadikkaiyirukkum; ve'liyin mirukangka'lum ummoadea samaathaanamaayirukkum.
ummudaiya koodaaram samaathaanaththoadirukkak kaa'npeer; ummudaiya vaasasthalaththai visaarikkumpoathu ku'raivaik kaa'namaatteer.
ummudaiya santhaanam peruki, ummudaiya santhathiyaar poomiyin poo'nduka'laippoala iruppaarka'l enpathai a'rinthuko'lveer.
thaaniyam eat'rakaalaththilea ampaaraththil searuki'rathupoala, muthirvayathilea kalla'raiyil searuveer.
ithoa, naangka'l aaraaynthu a'rinthathu ithuthaan; kaariyam ippadiyirukki'rathu; ithai neer keattu umakku nanmaiyu'ndaaka a'rinthuko'l'lum en'raan.
yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
en sagnchalam ni'rukkappattu, en nirppantham ellaam tharaasilea vaikkappattaal nalamaayirukkum.
appozhuthu athu kada'rkarai ma'nalaippaarkkilum paaramaayirukkum; aakaiyaal en thukkam sollimudiyaathu.
sarvavallavarin ampuka'l enakku'l thaiththirukki'rathu; avaika'lin visham en uyiraik kudikki'rathu; theavanaal u'ndaakum payangkarangka'l enakku munpaaka a'niya'niyaay ni'rki'rathu.
pullirukki'ra idaththilea kaattukkazhuthai kaththumoa? thanakkuth theevanamirukki'ra idaththilea eruthu katha'rumoa?
rusiyillaatha pathaarththaththai uppillaamal saappidakkoodumoa? muttaiyin ve'l'laikkaruvil suvai u'ndoa?
ungka'l vaarththaika'lai en aaththumaa thodamaattean enki'rathu; avaika'l aroasikamaana poajanampoal irukki'rathu.
aa, en man'raattu enakku aru'lappattu, naan vaagnchippathaith theavan enakkuth thanthu,
theavan ennai no'rukkach siththamaay, thammudaiya kaiyai neetti ennaith thu'ndiththuppoattaal nalamaayirukkum.

appozhuthaavathu enakku aa'ruthal irukkumea; appozhuthu ennaith thappavidaatha noavilea maraththiruppean; parisuththarudaiya vaarththaika'lai naan ma'raiththuvaikkavillai, avar ennaith thappavidaaraaka.
naan kaaththukko'ndirukka en pelan emmaaththiram? en jeevanai neediththirukkappa'n'na en mudivu eppadippattathu?
en pelan ka'rka'lin pelanoa? en maamsam ve'nkalamoa?
enakku uthaviyaanathu on'rum illaiyallavoa? sakaayam ennaivittu neengkit'rea.
upaathikkappaduki'ravanukku avanudaiya sineakithanaal thayaikidaikkavea'ndum; avanoa sarvavallavarukkup payappadaatheapoaki'raan.
en sakoatharar kaattaa'rupoala moasampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; aa'ruka'lin ve'l'laththaippoalak kadanthupoaki'raarka'l.
avaika'l ku'lirkaalap panikkattiyinaalum, athil vizhunthirukki'ra u'raintha mazhaiyinaalum kalangkalaaki,
ush'nangka'ndavudanea uruki vat'ri, analpattavudanea thangka'l sthalaththil uruvazhinthupoakin'rana.
avaika'ludaiya vazhika'lin poakkuka'l ingkumangkum piriyum; avaika'l viruthaavilea paravi on'rum illaama'rpoakum.
theamaavin paya'nakkaarar theadi, seapaavin paya'nakkoottangka'l avaika'lmeal nampikkai vaiththu,
thaangka'l ippadi nampinathinaalea vedkappaduki'raarka'l; avvidamattum vanthu kalangkippoaki'raarka'l.
appadiyea neengka'lum ippozhuthu on'rukkum uthavaama'rpoaneerka'l; en aapaththaik ka'ndu payappaduki'reerka'l.
enakku eathaakilum ko'nduvaarungka'l en'rum, ungka'l aasthiyilirunthu enakku yaathoru vekumaanam kodungka'l en'rum;
allathu saththuruvin kaikku ennaith thappuviyungka'l, valladikkaararin kaikku ennai neengkalaakki meettu vidungka'l en'rum naan sonnathu'ndoa?
enakku upatheasampa'n'nungka'l, naan mavunamaayiruppean; naan ethilea thava'rineanoa athai enakkuth theriyappaduththungka'l.
semmaiyaana vaarththaika'lil evva'lavu vallamai u'ndu? ungka'l kadinthuko'l'luthalinaal kaariyam enna?
kadinthuko'l'la neengka'l vaarththaika'lai yoasiththu, nampikkaiyat'ravanudaiya vaarththaika'laik kaat'rilea vittuviduki'reerka'loa?
ippadich seythu thikkat'ravanmeal neengka'l vizhunthu, ungka'l sineakithanukkup padukuzhiyai vettuki'reerka'l.
ippoathum ungka'lukkuch siththamaanaal ennai noakkip paarungka'l; appozhuthu naan poysolluki'reanoa en'ru ungka'lukkup piraththiyadchamaay vi'langkum.
neengka'l thirumpungka'l, akkiramam kaa'nappadaathirukkum; thirumpungka'l en neethi athilea vi'langkum.
en naavilea akkiramam u'ndoa? en vaay aakaathavaika'laip pakuththa'riyaathoa?
poomiyilea poaraada manushanukkuk ku'rikkappatta kaalam u'ndallavoa? avan naadka'l oru koolikkaaran naadka'laippoal irukki'rathallavoa?
oru vealaiyaa'l nizhalai vaagnchiththu, oru koolikkaaran than kooliyai varappaarththirukki'rathupoala,
maayaiyaana maathangka'l ennudaiya suthantharamaaki, sagnchalamaana raaththirika'l enakkuk ku'rikkappattathu.
naan paduththukko'l'luki'rapoathu, eppozhuthu ezhunthiruppean? iraakkaalam eppozhuthu mudiyum en'ru solli, kizhakku ve'lukkumattum ara'ndu pura'luki'rathinaal enakkup poathumen'ru poaki'rathu.
en maamsam poochchika'linaalum, adaipat'rina puzhuthiyinaalum moodappattirukki'rathu; en thoal vediththu aruvaruppaayit'ru.
en naadka'l neyki'ravan e'riki'ra naadaavilum theeviramaay oaduki'rathu; avaika'l nampikkaiyillaamal mudinthupoakum.
en piraa'nan kaat'raippoalirukki'rathen'rum, en ka'nka'l ini nanmaiyaik kaa'nappoaki'rathillaiyen'rum ninaiththaru'lum.
ippoathu ennaik kaa'nki'ravarka'lin ka'nka'l ini ennaik kaa'npathillai; ummudaiya ka'nka'l enmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; naanoa illaama'rpoaki'rean.
meakam pa'ranthupoaki'rathupoala, paathaa'laththil i'rangkuki'ravan ini ea'rivaraan.
ini than veettukkuth thirumpaan, avan sthalam ini avanai a'riyaathu.
aakaiyaal naan en vaayai adakkaamal, en aaviyin veathanaiyinaal peasi, en aaththumaththin kasappinaal angkalaayppean.
theavareer enmeal kaaval vaikki'ratha'rku naan samuththiramoa? naan oru thimingkilamoa?
en kattil enakku aa'ruthal kodukkum en'rum, en padukkai en thavippai aat'rum en'rum naan solveanaakil,
neer soppanangka'laal ennaik kalangkappa'n'ni, tharisanangka'laal enakkuth thikilu'ndaakkuki'reer.
athinaal en aaththumaa, nerukku'ndu saaki'rathaiyum, en elumpuka'loadea uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum, mara'naththaiyum virumpuki'rathu.
ippadiyirukki'rathai aroasikki'rean; ennaa'lum uyiroadirukka virumpean, ennai vittuvidum; en naadka'l maayaithaanea.
manushanai neer oru poruttaaka e'n'nuki'ratha'rkum, avanmeal sinthai vaikki'ratha'rkum,
kaalaithoa'rum avanai visaarikki'ratha'rkum, nimishanthoa'rum avanaich soathikki'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
naan en umizhneerai vizhungkaathapadi eththanaikaalam ennai nekizhaamalum, ennai vidaamalum iruppeer.
mannuyiraik kaappavarea, paavagnseytheanaanaal umakku naan seyyavea'ndiyathu enna? naan enakkuththaanea paaramaayirukkumpadikku, neer ennai umakku ilakkaaka vaiththathu enna?
en mee'ruthalai neer manniyaamalum, en akkiramaththai neekkaamalum irukki'rathu enna? ippozhuthea ma'n'nil paduththukko'lvean; vidiya'rkaalaththilea ennaith theaduveeraanaal naan irean en'raan.
appozhuthu sookiyanaana pilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaka:
neer enthamattum ippadippattavaika'laip peasuveer? ethuvaraikkum ummudaiya vaayin vaarththaika'l palamaana kaat'raippoalirukkum?
theavan niyaayaththaip purattuvaaroa? sarvavallavar neethiyaip purattuvaaroa?
ummudaiya pi'l'laika'l avarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythirunthaalum avarka'ludaiya paathakaththin aakkinaikku avarka'lai avar oppukkoduththirunthaalum,
neer theavanai ea'rkanavea theadi, sarvavallavarai noakki vi'n'nappagnseythu,
suththamum semmaiyumaay iruntheereayaanaal, appozhuthu avar umakkaaka vizhiththu neethiyu'l'la ummudaiya vaasasthalaththaich saangkoapaangkamaakkuvaar.
ummudaiya thuvakkam a'rpamaayirunthaalum, ummudaiya mudivu sampoora'namaayirukkum.
aakaiyaal, neer munthina thalaimu'raiyaaridaththil visaariththu, avarka'l munnoarka'lin seythiyai aaraaynthupaarum.
naam neat'ru u'ndaanavarka'l, on'rum a'riyoam; poomiyinmeal nammudaiya naadka'l nizhalaippoalirukki'rathu.
avarka'l umakku upatheasiththu, umakkuth theriviththu, thangka'l iruthayaththilirukkum niyaayangka'lai ve'lippaduththuvaarka'l allavoa?
sea'rillaamal naa'nal oangki va'larumoa? tha'n'neerillaamal koaraippul mu'laikkumoa?
athu innum pachchaiyaayirukkumpoathea, a'rukkappadaathirunthum mat'ra enthap pullaippaarkkilum seekkiramaay vaadippoam allavoa?
theavanai ma'rakki'ra ellaarudaiya vazhika'lum appadiyea irukkum; maayakkaararin nampikkai azhinthupoam.
avanudaiya vee'n e'n'nam at'ruppoay, avanudaiya nampikkai silanthippoochchi veedupoalirukkum.
oruvan athin veettinmeal saaynthaal, athu nilaikkamaattaathu, athaip pidiththaal, athu ni'rkaathu.
veyil erikkaathatha'rku munnea avan pachchaichsedi, athin kodika'l avan thoattaththinmealea padarum;
athin vearka'l ka'rkuviyalil sikki, ka'rpaa'raiyai naadum.
athu athinidaththil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaanapin, athu iruntha idam unnai naan ka'ndathillaiyen'ru ma'ruthalikkum.
ithoa, avan vazhiyin makizhchchi ippadiyea poaki'rathu; aanaalum vea'rea pear ma'n'nilirunthu mu'laippaarka'l.
ithoa, theavan uththamanai ve'rukki'rathumillai, pollaathavarka'lukkuk kaikodukki'rathumillai.
ini avar ummudaiya vaayai nakaippinaalum, ummudaiya uthaduka'laik kempeeraththinaalum nirappuvaar.
ummaip pakaikki'ravarka'l vedkaththaal moodappaduvaarka'l; thunmaarkkarudaiya koodaaram azhinthupoakum en'raan.
atha'rku yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
aam, kaariyam ippadiyirukki'rathu en'ru a'rivean; theavanukku munpaaka manushan neethimaanaayiruppatheppadi?
avar avanoadea vazhakkaadach siththamaayirunthaal, aayiraththil on'rukkaakilum avarukku uththaravu sollamaattaanea.
avar iruthayaththil gnaanamu'l'lavar, pelaththil paraakkiramamu'l'lavar; avarukku viroathamaakath thannaik kadinappaduththi vaazhnthavan yaar?
avar parvathangka'laich sadithiyaayp pearkki'raar; thammudaiya koapaththil avaika'laip purattippoaduki'raar.
poomiyin thoo'nka'l athiraththakkathaay athai athin sthaanaththinin'ru asaiyappa'n'nuki'raar.
avar sooriyanukkuk katta'laiyida athu uthikkaathirukkum; avar nadchaththirangka'lai ma'raiththuppoaduki'raar.
avar oruvarea vaanangka'lai viriththu, samuththira alaika'linmeal nadakki'ravar.
avar thuruvachchakkara nadchaththirangka'laiyum, mirukaseerishaththaiyum, a'rumeenaiyum, thadcha'na ma'ndalangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinavar.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha periya kaariyangka'laiyum, e'n'nimudiyaatha athisayangka'laiyum avar seyki'raar.
ithoa, avar en arukil poaki'raar, naan avaraik kaa'nean; avar kadanthupoaki'raar, naan avarai a'riyean.
ithoa, avar pa'riththukko'ndupoaki'raar, avarai ma'rippavan yaar? neer enna seyki'reer en'ru avaraik keadpavan yaar?
theavan thammudaiya koapaththaith thiruppamaattaar; oruvarukkoruvar thu'naini'rki'ra akangkaarika'l avarukku adangkavea'ndum.
ippadiyirukka, avarukku ma'rumozhi kodukkavum, avaroadea vazhakkaadum vaarththaika'laith therinthuko'l'lavum naan emmaaththiram?
naan neethimaanaayirunthaalum avaroadea vazhakkaadaamal, en niyaayaathipathiyinidaththil irakkaththukkuk kegnchuvean.
naan kegncha, avar enakku uththaravu aru'linaalum, avar en vi'n'nappaththukkuch sevikoduththaar en'ru nampean.
avar pusalinaal ennai mu'rikki'raar; mukaantharamillaamal aneakam kaayangka'lai enakku u'ndaakkuki'raar.
naan moochchuvida enakku idangkodaamal, kasappinaal ennai nirappuki'raar.
pelaththaip paarththaal, avarea pelaththavar; niyaayaththaip paarththaal, en padchaththil saadchi solluki'ravan yaar?
naan ennai neethimaanaakkinaalum en vaayea ennaik kut'ravaa'liyaakkum; naan uththaman en'ru sonnaalum, naan maa'rupaadaanavan en'ru athu saadchikodukkum.
naan uththamanen'raalum en u'l'laththai naan a'riyean; en jeevanai aroasippean.
oru kaariyam u'ndu, athaich solluki'rean; sanmaarkkanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum avar azhikki'raar.
savukkaanathu asuppilea vaathiththuk kollumpoathu, avar kut'ramillaathavarka'lin soathanaiyaippaarththu nakaikki'raar.
ulakam thunmaarkkar kaiyil vidappattirukki'rathu; athilirukki'ra niyaayaathipathika'lin mukaththai moodippoaduki'raar; avar ithaich seyki'rathillaiyen'raal, pinnai yaar ithaich seyki'raar.
en naadka'l agncha'rkaarar oattaththilum theeviramaayirukki'rathu; avaika'l nanmaiyaik kaa'naamal pa'ranthupoam.
avaika'l veakamaay oaduki'ra kappalka'laippoalavum, iraiyinmeal paayki'ra kazhukaippoalavum kadanthupoaki'rathu.
en angkalaayppai naan ma'ranthu, en mukaththin thukkaththai maat'ri, thidanko'lvean en'ru sonnaal,
en varuththangka'laippat'rip payamaayirukki'rean; ennaik kut'ramillaathavanaaka e'n'namaatteer en'ru a'rivean.
naan pollaathavanaayirunthaal, viruthaavaayp poaraadavea'ndiyathu enna?
naan u'raintha mazhaith tha'n'neeril muzhuki, en kaika'laich savukkaaraththinaal suththampa'n'ninaalum,
neer ennaich seat'ruppa'l'laththilea amizhththuveer. appozhuthu en vasthiramea ennai aruvarukkum.
naan avarukkup pirathiyuththaram solluki'ratha'rkum, naangka'l koodi niyaayaththi'rku varuki'ratha'rkum, avar ennaippoala manushan allavea.
engka'l iruvarmealum than kaiyai vaikkaththakka maththiyasthan engka'lukku'l illaiyea.
avar thamathu milaat'rai ennai vittu akat'ruvaaraaka; avarudaiya payangkaram ennaik kalangkappa'n'naathiruppathaaka.
appozhuthu naan avarukkup payappadaamal peasuvean; ippozhuthoa appadich seyya idamillai.
en aaththumaa jeevanai aroasikki'rathu, naan en thuyaraththukku enakku'l'lea idangkoduththu, en manachsagnchalaththinaalea peasuvean.
naan theavanai noakki: ennaik kut'ravaa'liyen'ru theerkkaathirum; neer ethinimiththam ennoadea vazhakkaaduki'reer, athai enakkuth theriyappaduththum enpean.
neer ennai odukki, ummudaiya kaika'lin kiriyaiyai ve'ruththu, thunmaarkkarin yoasanaiyaik kirupaiyaayp paarkki'rathu umakku nan'raayirukkumoa?
maamsak ka'nka'l umakku u'ndoa? manushan paarkki'rapirakaaramaayp paarkki'reeroa?
neer en akkiramaththaik ki'ndikki'lappi, en paavaththai aaraaynthu visaarikki'ratha'rku,
ummudaiya naadka'l oru manushanudaiya naadka'laippoalavum, ummudaiya varushangka'l oru purushanudaiya jeevakaalaththaippoalavum irukki'rathoa?
naan thunmaarkkan alla enpathu umakkuth theriyum; ummudaiya kaikku ennaith thappuvikki'ravan illai.
ummudaiya karangka'l ennaiyum enakkuriya ellaavat'raiyum uruvaakkip padaiththirunthum, ennai nirmoolamaakkuki'reer.
ka'lima'npoala ennai uruvaakkineer enpathaiyum, ennaith thirumpath thoo'laakappoakappa'n'nuveer enpathaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
neer ennaip paalpoal vaarththu, thayirpoal u'raiyappa'n'nineer allavoa?
thoalaiyum sathaiyaiyum enakkuth thariththu, elumpuka'laalum narampuka'laalum ennai isaiththeer.
enakku jeevanaith thanthathum allaamal, thayavaiyum enakkup paaraattineer; ummudaiya paraamarippu en aaviyaik kaappaat'rinathu.
ivaika'l ummudaiya u'l'laththil ma'rainthirunthaalum, ithu umakku'l irukki'rathu en'ru a'rivean.
naan paavagnseythaal, athai neer ennidaththil visaariththu, en akkiramaththai enmeal sumaththaamal videer.

naan thunmaarkkanaayirunthaal enakku aiyoa! naan neethimaanaayirunthaalum en thalaiyai naan edukkamaattean; avamaanaththaal nirappappattean; neer en si'rumaiyaip paarththaru'lum, athu athikarikki'rathu.
singkaththaippoala ennai veattaiyaadi, enakku viroathamaay umathu athisaya vallamaiyai vi'langkappa'n'nuki'reer.
neer ummudaiya saadchika'lai enakku viroathamaay irattikkappa'n'nuki'reer; enmeal ummudaiya koapaththai athikarikkappa'n'nuki'reer; poaraattaththinmeal poaraattam athikarikki'rathu.
neer ennaik karppaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathu enna? oru ka'n'num ennaik kaa'naathapadi, naan appozhuthea jeeviththuppoanaal nalamaamea.
naan orukkaalum illaathathu poalirunthu, karppaththilirunthu pireathakkuzhikkuk ko'ndupoakappattiruppean.
en naadka'l kognchamallavoa?

kaariru'lum mara'naanthakaaramumaana iru'nda theasamum, iru'lsoozhntha ozhungkillaatha mara'naanthakaaramu'l'la theasamum, o'liyum iru'laakum theasamumaakiya, poanaal thirumpivaraatha theasaththukku, naan poakumunnea,
naan sat'ru i'laippaa'rumpadi neer ennaivittu oaynthirum en'raan.
appozhuthu naakamaaththiyanaakiya soappaar pirathiyuththaramaaka:
earaa'lamaana vaarththaika'lukku uththaravu sollavea'ndaamoa? vaaychsaalakan neethimaanaay vi'langkuvaanoa?
ummudaiya veempuvaarththaika'lukku manushar mavunamaayiruppaarka'loa? neer pariyaasampa'n'numpoathu, oruvarum ummai vedkappaduththa vea'ndaamoa?
en sol suththam en'rum, naan theavareerudaiya paarvaikkuth thuppuravaanavan en'rum neer solluki'reer.
aanaalum theavan peasi, umakku viroathamaayth thammudaiya uthaduka'laith thi'ranthu,

umakku gnaanaththin irakasiyangka'lai ve'lippaduththinaal nalamaayirukkum; u'l'lapadi paarththaal, athu irattippu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal ummudaiya akkiramaththi'rkeat'rapadi theavan ummaith tha'ndikkavillaiyen'ru a'rinthuko'l'lum.
theavanudaiya antharangka gnaanaththai neer aaraaynthu, sarvavallavarudaiya sampoora'naththai neer a'riyakkoodumoa?
athu vaanapariyantham uyarnthathu; ummaal enna aakum? athu paathaa'laththilum aazhamaanathu, neer a'riyakkoodiyathu enna?
athin a'lavu poomiyaippaarkkilum nee'lamum, samuththiraththaippaarkkilum akalamumaayirukki'rathu.
avar pidiththaalum, avar adaiththaalum, avar niyaayaththil ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththinaalum, avaraith thadaipa'n'nuki'ravan yaar?
manusharudaiya maayaththai avar a'rivaar; akkiramaththai avar ka'ndum, athaik kavaniyaathiruppaaroa?
puththiyillaatha manushan kaattukkazhuthaikkuttikku oppaakap pi'ranthirunthaalum, perunegnchu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan.
neer ummudaiya iruthayaththai aayaththappaduththi, ummudaiya kaika'lai avarukku nearaaka viriththaal nalamaayirukkum.
ummudaiya kaiyilea akkiramam irunthaal, athaith thooraththil akat'rivittu, aniyaayam ummudaiya koodaarangka'lil vaasamaayirukkavottaathirum.
appozhuthu ummudaiya mukaththai maasillaamal ea'reduththu, payappadaamal thidanko'ndiruppeer.
appozhuthu neer varuththaththai ma'ranthu, kadanthupoana tha'n'neeraippoala athai ninaippeer.
appozhuthu ummudaiya aayusukaalam pattappakalaippaarkkilum pirakaasamaayirukkum; iru'l adaintha neer vidiya'rkaalaththaippoaliruppeer.
nampikkai u'ndaayirukki'rathinaal thidanaayiruppeer; thoa'ndi aaraaynthu sukamaayp paduththukko'lveer.
payappaduththuvaarillaamal niththirai seyveer; aneakar umathu mukaththai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
thunmaarkkarudaiya ka'nka'l pooththuppoay, avarka'l adaikkalam avarka'lai vittozhinthu, avarka'l nampikkai saaki'ravan suvaasampoal azhinthupoakum en'raan.
yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
aam, neengka'lea gnaanamu'l'la janangka'l; ungka'ludanea gnaanam saakum.
ungka'laippoala enakkum puththiyu'ndu; ungka'lilum naan thaazhnthavan alla; ippadippattavaika'lai a'riyaathavan yaar?
en sineakitharaal naan ninthikkappattu, theavanai noakkip piraarththippean; avar enakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'luvaar; uththamanaakiya neethimaan pariyaasampa'n'nappaduki'raan.
aapaththukku'l'laanavan sukamaayirukki'ravanudaiya ninaivil ikazhchchiyadaiki'raan; kaalida'rinavarka'lukku ithu nearidum.
ka'l'larudaiya koodaarangka'lil selvamu'ndu; theavanaik koapappaduththuki'ravarka'lukkuch saangkoapaangkamu'ndu; avarka'l kaiyilea theavan ko'nduvanthu kodukki'raar.
ippoathum nee mirukangka'laik keattuppaar, avaika'l unakkup poathikkum; aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laik kea'l, avaika'l unakku a'rivikkum.
allathu poomiyai visaariththuk kea'l, athu unakku upatheasikkum; samuththiraththin machchangka'laik kea'l, avaika'l unakku vivarikkum.
karththarudaiya karam ithaich seythathen'ru ivaika'lellaavat'rinaalum a'riyaathavan yaar?
sakala piraa'nika'lin jeevanum, maamsamaana sakala manusharin aaviyum avar kaiyilirukki'rathu.
vaayaanathu poajanaththai rusipaarkki'rathupoala, seviyaanathu vaarththaika'laich soathiththuppaarkki'rathallavaa?
muthiyoaridaththil gnaanamum vayathusen'ravarka'lidaththil puththiyum irukkumea.
avaridaththil gnaanamum vallamaiyum eththanai athikamaay irukkum? avarukkuththaan aaloasanaiyum puththiyum u'ndu.
ithoa, avar idiththaal kattamudiyaathu; avar manushanai adaiththaal viduvikkamudiyaathu.
ithoa, avar tha'n'neerka'lai adakkinaal ellaam ularnthupoam; avar avaika'lai varavittaal, poomiyaik keezhathumealathaakkum.
avaridaththil pelanum gnaanamumu'ndu; moasampoaki'ravanum moasampoakkuki'ravanum, avar kaiyin keezhirukki'raarka'l.
avar aaloasanaikkaararaich si'raipidiththu, niyaayaathipathika'lai mathimayakkuki'raar.
avar raajaakka'ludaiya kattuka'lai avizhththu, avarka'l iduppuka'laik kachchaikattuki'raar.
avar manthirika'laich si'raipidiththukko'ndupoay, pelavaanka'laik kavizhththuppoaduki'raar.
avar nampikkaiyu'l'lavarka'ludaiya vaakkai vilakki, muthirvayathu'l'lavarka'lin aaloasanaiyai vaangkippoaduki'raar.
avar pirapukka'linmeal ikazhchchi varappa'n'nuki'raar; palavaanka'lin kachchaiyaith tha'larnthupoakappa'n'nuki'raar.
avar anthakaaraththilirukki'ra aazhangka'lai ve'liyarangkamaakki, mara'na iru'lai ve'lichchaththil ko'nduvaruki'raar.
avar jaathika'laip perukavum azhiyavum pa'n'nuki'raar; avar jaathika'laip paravavum ku'rukavum pa'n'nuki'raar.
avar poomiyilu'l'la janaththinudaiya athipathika'lin negnchai akat'rippoattu, avarka'lai vazhiyillaatha antharaththilea alaiyappa'n'nuki'raar.
avarka'l ve'lichchamat'ra iru'lilea thadaviththiriki'raarka'l; ve'riththavarka'laippoala avarka'laith thadumaa'rith thiriyappa'n'nuki'raar.
ithoa, ivaika'lellaavat'raiyum en ka'n ka'ndu, en kaathu keattu a'rinthirukki'rathu.
neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rathai naanum a'rinthirukki'rean; naan ungka'lukkuth thaazhnthavan alla.
sarvavallavaroadea naan peasinaal nallathu; theavanoadea niyaayaththi'rkaaka vazhakkaada virumpuvean.
neengka'l poyyaip pi'naikki'ravarka'l; neengka'l ellaarum kaariyaththukkuthavaatha vaiththiyarka'l.
neengka'l peasaamalirunthaal nalamaakum; athu ungka'lukku gnaanamaayirukkum.
neengka'l en niyaayaththaik keattu, en uthaduka'l sollum viseashangka'laik kavaniyungka'l.
neengka'l theavanukkaaka niyaayakkeadaayp peasi, avarukkaaka vagnchakamaay vasanikkavea'ndumoa?
avarukku mukathaadchi'niyam pa'n'nuveerka'loa? theavanukkaaka vazhakkaaduveerka'loa?
avar ungka'lai aaraaynthupaarththaal athu ungka'lukku nalamaayirukkumoa? manushanaip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'rathupoala avaraip pariyaasampa'n'nuveerka'loa?
neengka'l antharangkamaay mukathaadchi'niyampa'n'ninaal, avar ungka'lai evvithaththilum ka'ndippaar.
avarudaiya makaththuvam ungka'laith thidukkidappa'n'naathoa? avarudaiya payangkaram ungka'laip pidikkamaattaathoa?
ungka'l pearai ninaikkappa'n'num adaiyaa'langka'l saampalukkuch sari; ungka'l meattimaika'l seat'rukkuviyalka'lukkuch samaanam.
neengka'l mavunamaayirungka'l, naan peasuki'rean, enakku varuki'rathu varattum.
naan en pa'rka'linaal en sathaiyaip pidungki, en piraa'nanai en kaiyilea vaippaanean?
avar ennaik kon'rupoattaalum, avarmeal nampikkaiyaayiruppean; aanaalum en vazhika'lai avarukku munpaaka roopakaarampa'n'nuvean.
avarea en iradchippu; maayakkaaranoa avar sannithiyil searaan.
en vasanaththaiyum, naan sollik kaa'npikki'rathaiyum, ungka'l sevika'laal kavanamaayk kea'lungka'l.
ithoa, en niyaayangka'lai a'niya'niyaaka vaiththean; en neethi vi'langkum en'ru a'rivean.
ennoadea vazhakkaadavea'ndumen'ru irukki'ravan yaar? naan mavunamaayirunthaal jeeviththuppoaveanea.
ira'ndu kaariyangka'laimaaththiram enakkuch seyyaathiruppeeraaka; appozhuthu umathu mukaththukku munpaaka o'liththukko'l'laathiruppean.
ummudaiya kaiyai ennaivittuth thoorappaduththum; ummudaiya payangkaram ennaik kalangkappa'n'naathiruppathaaka.
neer kooppidum, naan uththaravu koduppean; allathu naan peasuvean; neer enakku ma'rumozhi sollum.
en akkiramangka'lum paavangka'lum eththanai? en mee'ruthalaiyum en paavaththaiyum enakku u'narththum.
neer umathu mukaththai ma'raiththu, ennai umakkup pakaignanaaka e'n'nuvaanean?
kaat'radiththa sarukai no'rukkuveeroa? kaaynthupoana thurumpaip pinthodaruveeroa?
makaa kasappaana theerppuka'lai enpearil ezhuthuki'reer; en si'ruvayathin akkiramangka'lai enakkup palikkappa'n'nuki'reer.
en kaalka'laith thozhuvadiththuppoattu, en vazhika'laiyellaam kaavalpa'n'nuki'reer; en kaaladika'lil adaiyaa'laththaip poaduki'reer.
ippadippattavan azhukippoaki'ra vasthupoalavum, pottariththa vasthirampoalavum azhinthupoavaan.
sthireeyinidaththil pi'rantha manushan vaazhnaa'l ku'rukinavanum sagnchalam ni'rainthavanumaayirukki'raan.
avan poovaippoalap pooththu a'ruppu'nki'raan; nizhalaippoala nilaini'rkaamal oadippoaki'raan.
aakilum ippadippattavanmeal neer ummudaiya ka'nka'laith thi'ranthuvaiththu, ummudaiya niyaayaththukku ennaik ko'ndupoaveeroa?
asuththamaanathilirunthu suththamaanathaip pi'rappikkaththakkavan u'ndoa? oruvanumillai.
avanudaiya naadka'l immaaththiram en'ru ku'rikkappattirukkaiyaal, avanudaiya maathangka'lin thokai ummidaththil irukki'rathu; avan kadanthupoakakkoodaatha ellaiyai avanukku ea'rpaduththineer.
avan oru koolikkaaranaippoal than naa'lin vealaiyaayit'ru en'ru rammiyappadumattum avan oaynthirukkumpadi umathu paarvaiyai avanai vittu vilakkum.
oru maraththaikku'riththaavathu nampikkaiyu'ndu; athu vettippoadappattaalum thirumpath thazhaikkum, athin i'langki'laika'l thu'lirkkum;
athin vear tharaiyilea pazhaiyathaaki, athin adikkattai ma'n'nilea seththaalum,
tha'n'neerin vaasanaiyinaal athu thu'lirththu, i'lamarampoalak ki'laividum.
manushanoaven'raal seththapin ozhinthupoaki'raan, manupuththiran jeeviththuppoanapin avan engkea?
tha'n'neer eariyilirunthu vadinthu, ve'l'lam vat'rich suva'rippoaki'rathupoala,
manushan paduththukkidakki'raan, vaanangka'l ozhinthupoakuma'lavum ezhunthirukki'rathum illai, niththirai the'linthu vizhikki'rathum illai.
neer ennaip paathaa'laththil o'liththu, umathu koapam theerumattum ennai ma'raiththu, ennaith thirumpa ninaikkumpadikku enakku oru kaalaththaik ku'riththaal nalamaayirukkum.
manushan seththapin pizhaippaanoa? enakku maa'ruthal eppoathu varumen'ru enakkuk ku'rikkappatta poaraattaththin naa'lellaam naan kaaththirukki'rean.
ennaik kooppidum, appozhuthu naan umakku uththaravu solluvean; umathu kaika'lin kiriyaiyinmeal viruppam vaippeeraaka.
ippozhuthu en nadaika'lai e'n'nuki'reer; en paavaththinmealallavoa kavanamaayirukki'reer.
en mee'ruthal oru kattaakak kattappattu muththiraipoadappattirukki'rathu, en akkiramaththai orumikkach searththeer.
malaimuthalaay vizhunthu karainthupoam; kanmalai than idaththaivittup pearnthupoam.
tha'n'neer ka'rka'laik kudaiyum; jalappiravaakam poomiyin thoo'lil mu'laiththathai moodum; appadiyea manushan ko'ndirukkum nampikkaiyai azhikki'reer.
neer en'raikkum avanaip pelanaay nerukkuki'rathinaal avan poay viduki'raan; avan mukaroopaththai maa'rappa'n'ni avanai anuppividuki'reer.
avan pi'l'laika'l kanamadainthaalum avan u'naraan; avarka'l si'rumaippattaalum avarka'laik kavaniyaan.
avan maamsam avanilirukkuma'lavum atha'rku noavirukkum; avan aaththumaa avanukku'l'lirukkumattum atha'rkuth thukkamu'ndu en'raan.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaakiya elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaka:
gnaanavaan kaat'raippoan'ra niyaayangka'laich solli, than vayit'raik ko'ndalkaat'rinaal nirappi,
pirayoajanamillaatha vaarththaika'laalum, upayoakamillaatha vasanangka'laalum tharkkikkalaamoa?
neer payapakthiyai vee'nen'ru solli, theavanukku munpaaka jepaththiyaanaththaik ku'raiyappa'n'nuki'reer.
ummudaiya vaay ummudaiya akkiramaththaich sollikkaattuki'rathu; neer thanthiramu'l'lavarka'lin naavaith therinthuko'ndeer.
naan alla, ummudaiya vaayea ummaik kut'ravaa'li en'ru theerkki'rathu; ummudaiya uthaduka'lea umakku viroathamaakach saadchiyiduki'rathu.
manusharil munthip pi'ranthavar neerthaanoa? parvathangka'lukkumunnea uruvaakkappatteeroa?
neer theavanudaiya irakasiya aaloasanaiyaik keattu, gnaanaththai ummidamaaych searththukko'ndeeroa?
naangka'l a'riyaatha enthak kaariyaththai neer a'rinthirukki'reer? engka'lukku vi'langkaatha enthak kaariyamaavathu umakku vi'langkiyirukki'rathoa?
ummudaiya thakappanaippaarkkilum periya vayathu'l'la naraiththoarum viruththaappiyarum engka'lukku'l irukki'raarka'lea.
theavan aru'liya aa'ruthalka'lum, ummoadea sollappaduki'ra miruthuvaana peachchum umakku a'rpakaariyamaayirukki'rathoa?
ummudaiya iruthayam ummai engkea ko'ndupoaki'rathu? ummudaiya ka'nka'l ne'riththuppaarkki'rathu enna?
theavanukku viroathamaaka ummudaiya aaviyai ezhuppi, ummudaiya vaayilirunthu vasanangka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'nuki'reer.
manushanaanavan parisuththamaayirukki'ratha'rkum, sthireeyinidaththil pi'ranthavan neethimaanaayirukki'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
ithoa, thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'laiyum avar nampuki'rathillai; vaanangka'lum avar paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaika'l alla.
aniyaayaththaith tha'n'neeraippoalak kudikki'ra manushan eththanai athikamaay aruvaruppum asuththamumaayirukki'raan?
umakkuk kaariyaththaith theriyappa'n'nuvean, ennaik kea'lum; naan ka'ndathai umakku vivariththuch solluvean.
gnaanika'l thangka'l pithaakka'l sollak keattu ma'raikkaamal a'riviththathaiyea naan solluvean.
avarka'lukkumaaththiram poomi a'likkappattathu; anniyar avarka'l naduvea kadanthupoaka idamillai.
thunmaarkkan uyiroadirukki'ra naa'lellaam thunpaththaal vaathikkappaduki'raan; palavanthampa'n'nuki'ravanukku avan varushangka'lin thokai ma'raikkappattirukki'rathu.
payangkaramaana saththam avan kaathuka'lil thonikki'rathu; avan samaathaanamaayirukkaiyil paazhaakki'ravan avanmeal varuvaan.
iru'lilirunthu thirumpivara avanukku nampikkaiyillaamal, pathivirukki'ravarka'lin pattayaththukku avan payappaduki'raan.
appam engkea kidaikkum en'ru avan alainthu thiriki'raan; anthakaaranaa'l thanakkuch sameepiththirukki'rathai a'rivaan.
ikkattum nerukkamum avanaik kalangkappa'n'ni, yuththasannaththanaana raajaavaippoala avanai mea'rko'l'lum.
avan theavanukku viroathamaakak kai neetti, sarvavallavarukku viroathamaakap paraakkiramam paaraattuki'raan.
kadinakkazhuththoadum, paruththa kumizhu'l'la than keadayangka'loadum avarukku ethiraaka oaduki'raan.
avan mukaththaik kozhuppu moodiyirukki'rathu; adivayi'ru thonthi vittirukki'rathu.
aanaalum paazhaana patta'nangka'lilum, kudipoana ka'rkuviyalaana veeduka'lilum vaasampa'n'nuvaan.
avan aisuvariyavaanaavathumillai, avan aasthi nilaippathumillai; appadippattavarka'lin selvam poomiyil neediththiruppathillai.
iru'lukku avan thappuvathillai; akkinijuvaalai avanudaiya ki'laiyaik kaaynthupoakappa'n'num; avarudaiya vaayin suvaasaththaal at'ruppoavaan.
vazhithappinavan maayaiyai nampaanaaka; nampinaal maayaiyea avan palanaayirukkum.
athu avan naa'l varumunnea avanukkup poora'namaayp palikkum; avanudaiya koppup pachchaiko'lvathillai.
pignchuka'l uthirnthupoaki'ra thiraadchachsediyaippoalavum, pookka'l uthirnthupoaki'ra olivamaraththaippoalavum avan iruppaan.
maayakkaararin koottam ve'rumaiyaayp poam; parithaanam vaangkinavarka'lin koodaarangka'lai akkini padchikkum.
appadippattavan aniyaayaththaik karppanthariththu akkiramaththaip pe'ruki'raan; avarka'l karppam maayaiyaip pi'rappikkum en'raan.
atha'rku yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
ippadippatta aneakang kaariyangka'lai naan keattirukki'rean; neengka'l ellaarum alattu'ndaakkuki'ra theat'raravaa'lar.
kaat'raippoan'ra vaarththaika'lukku mudiviraathoa? ippadi nee uththaravusolla unakkuth thu'nivu u'ndaanathenna?
ungka'laippoala naanum peasakkoodum; naan irukkum nilaimaiyil neengka'l irunthaal, naan ungka'lukku viroathamaaka vaarththaika'laik koarththu, ungka'lukku ethirea en thalaiyaith thulukkavungkoodum.
aanaalum naan en vaayinaal ungka'lukkuth thidansolluvean, en uthaduka'lin asaivu ungka'l thukkaththai aat'rum.
naan peasinaalum en thukkam aa'raathu; naan peasaamalirunthaalum enakku enna aa'ruthal?
ippoathu avar ennai i'laiththuppoakach seythaar; en koottaththaiyellaam paazhaakkineer.
neer ennaich surungkippoakappa'n'ninathu atha'rkuch saadchi; en melivu ennil aththaadchiyaaka nin'ru, en mukaththukku munpaaka uththaravu sollum.
ennaip pakaikki'ravanudaiya koapam ennaip pee'ruki'rathu, enpearil pa'rkadikki'raan; en saththuru kodiya ka'n'ninaal ennaip paarkki'raan.
enakku viroathamaakath thangka'l vaayai virivaayth thi'ranthaarka'l; ninthaiyaaka ennaik kannaththil adiththaarka'l; enakku viroathamaaka eakamaayk koottangkoodinaarka'l.
theavan ennai aniyaayakkaaran vasamaaka oppuviththu, thunmaarkkarin kaiyil ennai akappadappa'n'ninaar.
naan sukamaay vaazhnthirunthean; avar ennai narukki, en pidariyaip pidiththu, ennai no'rukki, ennaith thamakku ilakkaaka ni'ruththinaar.
avarudaiya villaa'lar ennaich soozhnthuko'ndaarka'l; en eeralaith thappavidaamal pi'lanthaar; en pichchaith tharaiyil oot'rivittaar.
no'rukkuthalinmeal no'rukkuthalai enmeal varappa'n'ninaar; paraakkiramasaaliyaippoala enmeal paaynthaar.
naan irattuchsealaiyaith thaiththu, en thoa'linmeal poarththukko'ndean; en makimaiyaip puzhuthiyilea poattuvittean.
azhuki'rathinaal en mukam azhukkadainthathu; mara'na iru'l en ka'n'nimaika'linmeal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
en kaika'lilea kodumaiyillaathirukkaiyilum, en jepam suththamaayirukkaiyilum, appadiyaayit'ru.
poomiyea, en iraththaththai moodippoadaathea; en ala'ruthalukku ma'raividam u'ndaakaathiruppathaaka.
ippoathum ithoa, en saadchi paraloakaththilirukki'rathu, enakkuch saadchi pakaruki'ravar unnathangka'lil irukki'raar.
en sineakithar ennaip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; en ka'n theavanai noakkik ka'n'neer soriki'rathu.
oru manupuththiran than sineakithanukkaaka vazhakkaaduki'rathupoala, theavanoadea manushanukkaaka vazhakkaaduki'ravar oruvar u'ndaanaal nalamaayirukkum.
ku'rukina varushangka'lukku mudivu varuki'rathu; naan thirumpivaraatha vazhiyea poavean.
en suvaasam ozhiki'rathu, en naadka'l mudiki'rathu; pireathakkuzhi enakku aayaththamaayirukki'rathu.
pariyaasampa'n'nuki'ravarka'l ennidaththil illaiyoa? avarka'l seyyum aniyaayangka'lai en ka'n paarththukko'ndirukki'rathu.
theavareer en kaariyaththai mealpoattukko'ndu, enakkaakap pi'naippaduveeraaka; vea'rea yaar enakkuk kaikodukkaththakkavar?
neer avarka'l iruthayaththukku gnaanaththai ma'raiththeer; aakaiyaal avarka'lai uyarththaathiruppeer.
evan than sineakitharukkuk keadaakath thuroakam peasuki'raanoa, avan pi'l'laika'lin ka'nka'lum pooththuppoakum.
janangka'lukku'l'lea avar ennaip pazhamozhiyaaka vaiththaar; avarka'l mukaththukkumun naan aruvaruppaanean.
ithinimiththam en ka'nka'l sagnchalaththinaal iru'ladainthathu; en avayavangka'lellaam nizhalaippoalirukki'rathu.
sanmaarkkar itha'rkaakap piramippaarka'l; kut'ramillaathavan maayakkaaranukku viroathamaaka ezhumpuvaan.
neethimaan than vazhiyai u'ruthiyaayp pidippaan; suththamaana kaika'lu'l'lavan meanmealum palaththuppoavaan.
ippoathum neengka'l ellaarum poayvaarungka'l; ungka'lil gnaanamu'l'la oruvanaiyum kaa'nean.
en naadka'l poayit'ru; en iruthayaththil enakku u'ndaayiruntha sinthanaika'l at'ruppoayit'ru.
avaika'l iravaip pakalaakkit'ru; iru'lai ve'lichcham thodarnthuvarum en'ru e'n'nachseythathu.
appadi naan kaaththukko'ndirunthaalum, paathaa'lam enakku veedaayirukkum; iru'lil en padukkaiyaip poaduvean.
azhivaippaarththu, nee enakkuth thakappan enki'rean; puzhukka'laip paarththu, neengka'l enakkuth thaayum enakkuch sakoathariyum enki'rean.
en nampikkai ippoathu engkea? naan nampiyirunthathaik kaa'npavan yaar?
athu paathaa'laththin kaavalukku'l i'rangkum; appoathu thoo'lil eakamaay i'laippaa'ruvoam en'raan.
appozhuthu sookiyanaana pilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaka:
neengka'l enthamattum peachchuka'lai mudikkaathiruppeerka'l? puththimaanka'laayirungka'l; naangka'lum peasattum.
naangka'l mirukangka'laippoala e'n'nappattu, ungka'l paarvaikkuth theezhppaanavarka'laayiruppaanean?
koapaththinaal ummaiththaanea pee'ruki'ra umathunimiththam poomi paazhaayppoakumoa? kanmalai thannidaththai vittup pearumoa?
thunmaarkkanudaiya vi'lakku a'nainthupoam; avan aduppin neruppum avinthupoam.
avan koodaaraththil ve'lichcham anthakaarappadum; avan vi'lakku avanudanea a'nainthupoam.
