avan pelanaay nadantha nadaika'l ku'rainthupoam; avan aaloasanai avanai vizhappa'n'num.
avan than kaalka'linaal valaiyil akappattu, valaichsikkalilea nadakki'raan.
ka'n'ni avan kuthikaalaip pidikkum; pa'rikaarar avanai mea'rko'lvaarka'l.
avanukkaakach surukku tharaiyilum, avanukkaakak ka'n'ni vazhiyilum vaikkappattirukki'rathu.
sut'rilumirunthu'ndaakum payangkarangka'l avanaith thidukkidappa'n'ni, avan kaalka'laith thisaitheriyaamal alaiyappa'n'num.
avan pelanaip pattini thin'rupoadum; avan pakkaththil keadu aayaththappattu ni'rkum.
athu avan angkaththin palaththaip padchikkum; payangkaramaana mara'namea avan avayavangka'laip padchikkum.
avan nampikkai avan koodaaraththilirunthu vearoadea pidungkappadum; athu avanaip payangkara raajaavinidaththil thuraththum.
avanukku on'rumillaama'rpoanathinaal, payangkaram avan koodaaraththil kudiyirukkum; kanthakam avan vaasasthalaththinmeal the'likkappadum.
keezhea irukki'ra avan vearka'l azhinthupoakum; mealea irukki'ra avan ki'laika'l pattuppoakum.
avanai ninaikkum ninaippup poomiyilirunthazhiyum, veethika'lil avan pearillaama'rpoakum.
avan ve'lichchaththilirunthu iru'lil thuraththividappattu, pooloakaththilirunthu tha'l'lu'ndupoavaan.
avan janaththukku'l'lea avanukkup puththiranum illai pauththiranum illai; avan veettil meethiyaayirukkaththakkavan oruvanum illai.
avan kaalaththoar avan naa'lukkaakath thidukkittathupoala, pinnadiyaarum piramippaarka'l.
akkiramakkaaran kudiyiruntha sthaanangka'l ivaika'lthaan; theavanai a'riyaama'rpoanavanudaiya sthalam ithuvea enpaarka'l en'raan.
yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
neengka'l enthamattum en aaththumaavai varuththappaduththi, vaarththaika'linaal ennai no'rukkuveerka'l?
ippoathu paththutharam ennai ninthiththeerka'l; neengka'l enakkuk kadinamukam kaa'npikki'rathinaal ungka'lukku vedkamillai.
naan thappinadanthathu meyyaanaalum, en thappitham ennoadeathaan irukki'rathu.
neengka'l enakku viroathamaakap perumaipaaraatti, enakku ninthaiyaaka ennaik kadinthuko'l'lavea'ndum en'riruppeerka'laakil,
theavan ennaik kavizhththu, thammudaiya valaiyai enmeal veesinaar en'ru a'riyungka'l.
ithoa, kodumai en'ru kooppiduki'rean, keadpaar oruvarum illai; kookkuraliduki'rean, niyaayavisaara'nai illai.
naan kadanthupoakakkoodaathapadikku avar en paathaiyai vealiyadaiththu, en vazhika'lai iru'laakkivittaar.
enniliruntha en makimaiyai avar urinthuko'ndu, en sirasin kireedaththai eduththuppoattaar.
avar ennai naankupu'raththilum naasamaakkinaar, naan at'ruppoaki'rean; en nampikkaiyai oru sediyaippoalap pidungkippoattaar.
avar thamathu koapaththai enmeal eriyappa'n'ninaar; ennaith thammudaiya saththurukka'lil oruvanaaka e'n'nikko'l'luki'raar.
avarudaiya tha'nduppadaika'l eakamaay vanthu, enakku viroathamaayth thangka'l vazhiyai uyarththi, en koodaaraththaich sut'rip paa'layami'rangkinaarka'l.
en sakoathararai ennaivittuth thoorappaduththinaar; enakku a'rimukamaanavarka'l enakku anniyaraayp poanaarka'l.
en panthujanangka'l vilakippoanaarka'l; en sineakithar ennai ma'ranthuvittaarka'l.
en veettu janangka'lum, en vealaikkaarika'lum, ennai anniyanaaka e'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'l paarvaikku naan paratheasiyaanean.
naan en vealaikkaaranaik kooppiduki'rapoathu avan enakku uththaravukodaan; en vaayinaal naan avanaik kegnchavea'ndiyathaayit'ru.
en suvaasam en manaivikku vea'rupattirukki'rathu; en karppaththin pi'l'laika'lukkaakap parithapikki'rean.
si'rupi'l'laika'lum ennai asattaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l; naan ezhunthaal, avarka'l enakku viroathamaayp peasuki'raarka'l.
en piraa'nasineakithar ellaarum ennai ve'rukki'raarka'l; naan sineakiththavarka'l enakku viroathika'laanaarka'l.
en elumpuka'l en thoaloadum en maamsaththoadum ottikko'ndirukki'rathu; en pa'rka'lai moodak kogncham thoalmaaththiram thappinathu.
en sineakitharea, enakku irangkungka'l, enakku irangkungka'l; theavanudaiya kai ennaith thottathu.
theavanaippoala neengka'lum ennaith thunpappaduththuvaanean? en maamsam padchikkappattaalum neengka'l thirupthiyat'rirukki'rathenna?
aa, naan ippozhuthu sollum vaarththaika'l ezhuthappattaal nalamaayirukkum; avaika'l oru pusthakaththil varaiyappattu,
allathu en'raikkum nilaikka avaika'l karungkallilea u'livettaakavum eeya ezhuththaakavum pathinthaal nalamaayirukkum.
en meedpar uyiroadirukki'raar en'rum, avar kadaisinaa'lil poomiyinmeal ni'rpaar en'rum naan a'rinthirukki'rean.
intha en thoalmuthalaanavai azhukippoanapinpu, naan en maamsaththil irunthu theavanaip paarppean.
avarai naanea paarppean; anniya ka'nka'l alla, en ka'nka'lea avaraik kaa'num; intha vaagnchaiyaal en u'l'linthiriyangka'l enakku'l soarnthupoaki'rathu.
kaariyaththin moolam enakku'l ka'ndupidikkappadukaiyil, naam ean avanaith thunpappaduththuki'roam en'ru neengka'l sollavea'ndiyathaamea.
pattayaththukkup payappadungka'l; niyaayaththeerppu u'ndenki'rathai neengka'l a'riyumporuttu, moorkkamaanathu pattayaththinaal u'ndaakum aakkinaiyai varappa'n'num en'raan.
appozhuthu naakamaaththiyanaana soappaar pirathiyuththaramaaka:
itha'rkaaka ma'ruuththaravu kodukka en sinthanaika'l ennai eavuki'rapadiyaal naan theeviriththuch solluki'rean.
ninthiththean en'ru naan kadinthuko'l'lappattathaik keattean; aanaalum u'narvinaal en aavi pirathiyuththaram solla ennai eavuki'rathu.
thunmaarkkanin kempeeram ku'rukinathu enpathaiyum, maayakkaaranin santhoasham oru nimishammaaththiram ni'rkum enpathaiyum,
avar manushanaip poomiyil vaiththa aathikaalamuthal ippadiyirukki'rathu enpathaiyum neer a'riyeeroa?
avanudaiya meanmai vaanapariyantham uyarnthaalum, avanudaiya thalai meakangka'lmattum ettinaalum,
avan than malaththaippoala en'raikkum azhinthupoavaan; avanaik ka'ndavarka'l, avan engkea? enpaarka'l.
avan oru soppanaththaippoal pa'ranthupoayk kaa'nappadaathavanaavaan; iravil thoan'rum tharisanaththaippoal pa'rakkadikkappaduvaan.
avanaip paarththa ka'n ini avanaip paarppathillai; avan iruntha sthalam ini avanaik kaa'npathillai.
avan pi'l'laika'l e'limaiyaanavarka'lin sakaayaththaith theaduvaarka'l; avan pa'riththathai avan kaika'l thirumpak kodukkavea'ndiyathaakum.
avan elumpuka'l avanudaiya vaalavayathin paavangka'linaal ni'rainthirunthu, avanoadeakooda ma'n'nilea paduththukko'l'lum.
pollaappu avan vaayilea inimaiyaayiruppathaal, avan athaith than naavinkeezh adakki,
athai vidaamal pathanampa'n'ni, than vaaykku'l'lea vaiththukko'ndirunthaalum,
avan poajanam avan kudalka'lil maa'ri, avanukku'l viriyanpaampuka'lin pichchaayppoakum.
avan vizhungkina aasthiyaik kakkuvaan; theavan athai avan vayit'rilirunthu ve'liyea tha'l'lividuvaar.
avan viriyan paampuka'lin vishaththai u'rignchuvaan; viriyanin naakku avanaik kollum.
theanum neyyum oadum vaaykkaalka'laiyum aa'ruka'laiyum avan kaa'npathillai.
thaan pirayaasappattuth theadinathai avan vizhungkaamal thirumpak koduppaan; avan thirumpakkodukki'rathu avan aasthikkuch sariyaayirukkum; avan ka'likooraathiruppaan.
avan odukki, eazhaika'laik kaivittu, thaan kattaatha veettaip pa'riththapadiyinaalum,
than vayi'ru thirupthiyat'rirunthapadiyinaalum, avan ichchiththa kaariyangka'lil avanukku on'rum iruppathillai.
avan poajanaththil on'rum meethiyaavathillai; aakaiyaal avan aasthi nilaini'rpathillai.
avan vea'ndumenki'ra paripoora'nam avanukku vanthapin, avanukku viyaakulam u'ndaakum; si'rumaippaduki'ra ovvoruvarudaiya kaiyum avanmeal varum.
than vayit'rai nirappaththakkathu innum avanukku irunthaalum, avar avanmeal thamathu koapaththin ukkiraththai varavittu, avan poajanampa'n'nukaiyil, athai avanmeal soriyappa'n'nuvaar.
iruppu aayuthaththukku avan thappiyoadinaalum urukkuvil avanai uruva eyyum.
uruvina pattayam avan sareeraththaiyum, minnuki'ra ampu avan pichchaiyum uruvippoakum; payangkarangka'l avanmeal varum.
avan o'likkum idangka'lil kaariru'l adangkiyirukkum; aviyaatha akkini avanaip padchikkum; avan koodaaraththil meethiyaayirukki'ravan theengku anupavippaan.
vaanangka'l avan akkiramaththai ve'lippaduththi, poomi avanukku viroathamaaka ezhumpum.
avan veettin sampaththup poayvidum; avarudaiya koapaththin naa'lilea avaika'l karainthupoakum.
ithuvea theavanaal thunmaarkkanukkuk kidaikkum pangkum, avan seykaikkuth theavanaal avanukku varum suthantharamumaam en'raan.
yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
en vasanaththaik kavanamaayk kea'lungka'l; ithu neengka'l ennaith theat'raravupa'n'nuvathupoala irukkum.
naan peasappoaki'rean, sakiththirungka'l; naan peasinapinpu pariyaasampa'n'nungka'l.
naan manushanaippaarththaa angkalaaykki'rean? appadiyaanaalum en aavi visanappadaathirukkumaa?
ennaik kavaniththuppaarungka'l, appozhuthu neengka'l piramiththu, ungka'l vaayaik kaiyaal poththikko'lveerka'l.
ithai naan ninaikkaiyil kalangkuki'rean; nadukkam en maamsaththaip pidikkum.
thunmaarkkar jeeviththu viruththaraaki, vallavaraavaanean?
avarka'loadungkooda avarka'l santhathiyaar avarka'lukku munpaakavum, avarka'l pi'l'laika'l avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum thidappaduki'raarka'l.
avarka'l veeduka'l payamillaamal paththirappattirukkum; theavanudaiya milaa'ru avarka'lmeal varuki'rathillai.
avarka'ludaiya eruthu polinthaal, vee'naayppoakaathu; avarka'ludaiya pasu sinai azhiyaamal eenuki'rathu.
avarka'l thangka'l kuzhanthaika'lai oru manthaiyaippoala ve'liyea poakaviduki'raarka'l; avarka'l pi'l'laika'l kuthiththu vi'laiyaaduki'raarka'l.
avarka'l thampuraiyum surama'ndalaththaiyum eduththup paadi, kinnaraththin oasaikkuch santhoashappaduki'raarka'l.
avarka'l selvavaanka'laayth thangka'l naadka'laip poakki, oru ksha'nappozhuthilea paathaa'laththil i'rangkuki'raarka'l.
avarka'l theavanai noakki: engka'laivittu vilakiyirum, ummudaiya vazhika'lai a'riya virumpoam;
sarvavallavarai naam seavikka avar yaar? avarai noakki jepampa'n'nuvathinaal namakkup pirayoajanam enna enki'raarka'l.
aanaalum avarka'l vaazhvu avarka'l kaiyiliraathu; thunmaarkkarin aaloasanai enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka.
eththanaich saduthiyil thunmaarkkarin vi'lakku a'nainthupoam; avar thamathu koapaththinaal veathanaika'laip pakirnthukodukkaiyil, avarka'l aapaththu avarka'lmeal varum.
avarka'l kaat'rumukaththilirukki'ra thurumpaippoalavum, perungkaat'ru pa'rakkadikki'ra patharaippoalavum irukki'raarka'l.
theavan avanudaiya akkiramaththai avan pi'l'laika'lukku vaiththu vaikki'raar; avan u'naraththakkavithamaay athai avanukkup palikkappa'n'nuki'raar.
avanudaiya azhivai avanudaiya ka'nka'l kaa'num, sarvavallavarudaiya ukkiraththaik kudippaan.
avan maathangka'lin thokai ku'rukkappadumpoathu, avanukkup pi'rpaadu avan veettaippat'ri avanukku irukkum viruppamenna?
uyarnthoarai niyaayantheerkki'ra theavanukku a'rivai u'narththa yaaraalaakum?
oruvan nirvaakaththoadum sukaththoadum vaazhnthu ku'raiyat'ra pelanu'l'lavanaaych saaki'raan.
avanudaiya paalpaaththirangka'l paalaal nirampiyirukki'rathu, avan elumpuka'lil oon pushdiyaayirukki'rathu.
vea'roruvan oru naa'laavathu santhoashaththoadea saappidaamal, manakkileasaththoadea saaki'raan.
iruvarum samamaay ma'n'nilea paduththukko'l'luki'raarka'l; puzhukka'l avarka'lai moodum.
ithoa, naan ungka'l ninaivuka'laiyum, neengka'l ennaippat'ri aniyaayamaayk ko'ndirukkum aaloasanaika'laiyum a'rivean.
pirapuvinudaiya veedu engkea? thunmaarkkarudaiya koodaaram engkea? en'ru solluki'reerka'l.
vazhinadanthupoaki'ravarka'lai neengka'l keadkavillaiyaa, avarka'l sollum ku'rippuka'lai neengka'l a'riyavillaiyaa?
thunmaarkkan aapaththunaa'lukken'ru vaikkappaduki'raan; avan koapaakkinaiyin naa'lukken'ru ko'nduvarappaduki'raan.
avan vazhiyai avan mukaththukku munpaakath thoo'ndik kaa'npikki'ravan yaar? avan seykaikkuththakka palanai avanukkuch sarikkattuki'ravan yaar?
avan kalla'raikkuk ko'nduvarappaduki'raan; avan koari kaakkappattirukkum.
pa'l'laththaakkin pulpaththaika'l avanukku inpamaayirukkum; avanukku munnaaka e'n'ni'rantha janangka'l poanathupoala, avanukkup pinnaaka ovvoruvarum avvidaththukkuch selluvaarka'l.
neengka'l vee'naana aa'ruthalai enakkuch solluki'rathu enna? ungka'l ma'rumozhika'lil u'nmaikkeadu irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaana elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaka:
oru manushan viveakiyaayirunthu, thanakkuththaan pirayoajanamaayirukki'rathinaal theavanukkup pirayoajanamaayiruppaanoa?
neer neethimaanaayiruppathinaal sarvavallavarukku nanmaiyu'ndaakumoa? neer ummudaiya vazhika'lai uththamamaakkuki'rathu avarukku aathaayamaayirukkumoa?
avar umakkup payanthu ummoadea vazhakkaadi, ummoadea niyaayaththukku varuvaaroa?
ummudaiya pollaappup periyathum, ummudaiya akkiramangka'l mudivillaathavaika'lumaay irukki'rathallavoa?
mukaantharamillaamal ummudaiya sakoatharar kaiyil adakuvaangki, eazhaika'lin vasthirangka'laip pa'riththukko'ndeer.
vidaayththavanukkuth thaakaththukkuth tha'n'neer kodaamalum, pasiththavanukkup poajanam kodaamalum poaneer.
palavaanukkea theasaththil idamu'ndaayit'ru; kanavaan athil kudiyea'rinaan.
vithavaika'lai ve'rumaiyaay anuppivitteer; thaaythakappan illaathavarka'lin puyangka'l mu'rikkappattathu.
aakaiyaal ka'n'nika'l ummaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; asuppilea umakku vantha payangkaram ummaik kalangkappa'n'nuki'rathu.
neer paarkkakkoodaathapadikku iru'l vanthathu, jalappiravaakam ummai mooduki'rathu.
theavan paraloakaththin unnathangka'lilirukki'raar allavoa? nadchaththirangka'lin uyaraththaip paarum, avaika'l eththanai uyaramaayirukki'rathu.
neer: theavan eppadi a'rivaar, anthakaaraththukku appu'raththilirukki'ravar niyaayam visaarikkakkoodumoa?
avar paaraathapadikku meakangka'l avarukku ma'raivaayirukki'rathu; parama'ndalangka'lin sakkaraththilea avar ulaavuki'raar en'ru solluki'reer.
akkirama maanthar poorvaththil nadantha maarkkaththaik kavaniththup paarththeeroa?
kaalam varumunnea avarka'l vaadippoanaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya asthipaaraththinmeal ve'l'lam pura'ndathu.
theavan avarka'l veeduka'lai nanmaiyaal nirappiyirunthaalum, avarka'l avarai noakki: engka'laivittu vilakum, sarvavallavaraalea engka'lukku enna aakum en'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal thunmaarkkarin aaloasanai enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka.
engka'l nilaimai nirmoolamaakaamal, avarka'lukku meethiyaanathaiyoa akkini padchiththathenpathai neethimaanka'l ka'ndu santhoashappaduki'raarka'l.
kut'ramillaathavan avarka'laip paarththu nakaikki'raan.
neer avaroadea pazhakich samaathaanamaayirum; athinaal umakku nanmai varum.
avar vaayinin'ru pi'rantha veathappiramaa'naththai eat'rukko'ndu, avar vaarththaika'lai ummudaiya iruthayaththil vaiththukko'l'lavea'nduki'rean.
neer sarvavallavaridaththil mananthirumpinaal, thirumpak kattappaduveer; akkiramaththai umathu koodaaraththukkuth thooramaakkuveer.
appozhuthu thoo'laippoal ponnaiyum, aat'ruk ka'rka'laippoal oappeerin thangkaththaiyum searththu vaippeer.
appozhuthu sarvavallavar thaamea umakkup pasumponnum, umakkuch sokkave'l'liyumaayiruppaar.
appozhuthu sarvavallavarmeal manamakizhchchiyaayirunthu, theavanukku nearaaka ummudaiya mukaththai ea'reduppeer.
neer avarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'na, avar umakkuch sevikoduppaar; appozhuthu neer ummudaiya poruththanaika'laich seluththuveer.
neer oru kaariyaththai niru'nayampa'n'ninaal, athu umakku nilaivarappadum; ummudaiya paathaika'lil ve'lichcham pirakaasikkum.
manushar odukkappadumpoathu thidappadakkadavarka'l en'ru neer solla, thaazhnthoar radchikkappaduvaarka'l.
kut'ramat'riraathavanaiyungkoodath thappuvippaar; ummudaiya kaika'lin suththaththinimiththam avan thappippoavaan en'raan.
yoapu pirathiyuththaramaaka:
in'raiyathinamum en angkalaayppu mura'nduththanamaaka e'n'nappaduki'rathu; en thavippaippaarkkilum en vaathai kadinamaanathu.
naan avarai engkea ka'ndu santhikkalaam enpathai a'rinthaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu naan avar aasanaththukku munpaaka vanthusearnthu,
en niyaayaththai avarukku munpaaka varisaiyaay vaiththu, kaariyaththai roopikkum vaarththaika'laal en vaayai nirappuvean.
avarudaiya ma'rumozhika'lai naan a'rinthu, avar enakkuch solvathai u'narnthuko'l'luvean.
avar thammudaiya makaa vallamaiyinpadiyea ennoadea vazhakkaaduvaaroa? avar appadich seyyaamal enmeal thayai vaippaar.
angkea sanmaarkkan avaroadea vazhakkaadalaam; appozhuthu ennai niyaayantheerkki'ravarin kaikku en'raikkum neengkalaayth thappuviththukko'lvean.
ithoa, naan munnaakappoanaalum avar illai; pinnaakappoanaalum avaraik kaa'nean.
idathupu'raththil avar kiriyai seythum avaraik kaa'nean; valathupu'raththilum naan avaraik kaa'naathapadikku o'liththirukki'raar.
aanaalum naan poakum vazhiyai avar a'rivaar; avar ennaich soathiththapin naan ponnaaka vi'langkuvean.
en kaalka'l avar adika'laip pat'rippidiththathu; avarudaiya ne'riyaivittu naan saayaamal athaik kaikko'ndean.
avar uthaduka'lin ka'rpanaika'lai vittu naan pinvaangkuvathillai; avarudaiya vaayin vaarththaika'lai enakku vea'ndiya aakaaraththaippaarkkilum athikamaayk kaaththukko'ndean.
avaroaven'raal orea manamaayirukki'raar; avaraith thiruppaththakkavar yaar? avarudaiya siththaththinpadiyellaam seyvaar.
enakkuk ku'riththirukki'rathai avar ni'raiveat'ruvaar; ippadippattavaika'l innum aneakam avaridaththil u'ndu.
aakaiyaal avarukku munpaakak kalangkuki'rean; naan sinthikki'rapoathu, avarukkup payappaduki'rean.
theavan en iruthayaththai i'lakkarikkappa'n'ninaar; sarvavallavar ennaik kalangkappa'n'ninaar.
anthakaaram varaathatha'rku munnea naan sangkarikkappadaamalum, iru'lai avar enakku ma'raikkaamalumpoanathinaal ippadiyirukki'rean.
sarvavallavarukkuk kaalangka'l ma'raikkappadaathirukka, avarai a'rinthavarka'l avar niyamiththa naadka'lai a'riyaathirukki'rathenna?
silar ellaikku'rippuka'lai ot'ri, manthaika'laip palaathkaaramaaych saayththukko'ndupoayp padchikki'raarka'l.
thaay thakappan illaathavarka'lin kazhuthaiyai oattikko'ndupoay, vithavaiyin maattai eedaaka eduththukko'l'luki'raarka'l.
theasaththil si'rumaippattavarka'l eakamaay o'liththukko'l'laththakkathaaka, e'limaiyaanavarka'lai vazhiyaivittu vilakkuki'raarka'l.

ithoa, avarka'l kaattukkazhuthaika'laippoala iraitheada athikaalamea thangka'l vealaikkup pu'rappaduki'raarka'l; vanaantharave'lithaan avarka'lukkum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum aakaaram kodukkavea'ndum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya vayalil avarka'l avanukkaaka a'ruppu a'ruththu, avanudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththin pazhangka'laich searkki'raarka'l.
ku'lirilea poarththukko'l'luki'ratha'rku on'rum illaathathinaal, vasthiramillaamal iraaththangki,
malaika'lilirunthuvarum mazhaika'lilea nanainthu, othukkidamillaathathinaal kanmalaiyilea a'ndikko'l'luki'raarka'l.
avarka'loa thakappanillaatha pi'l'laiyai mulaiyaivittup pa'riththu, thariththiran poarththukko'ndirukki'rathai adakuvaangkuki'raarka'l.
avanai vasthiramillaamal nadakkavum, pattiniyaay arikkattuka'laich sumakkavum,
thangka'l mathilka'lukku'l'lea sekkaattavum, thaakaththavanamaay aalaiyaattavum pa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
ooril manushar thavikki'raarka'l, kut'ruyiraayk kidakki'ravarka'lin aaththumaa kooppiduki'rathu; en'raalum, theavan athaik kut'ramaaka avarka'lmeal sumaththuki'rathillai.
avarka'l ve'lichchaththukku viroathamaay nadakki'ravarka'lin koottaththaar; avarka'l avarudaiya vazhika'lai a'riyaamalum, avarudaiya paathaika'lil tharikkaamalum irukki'raarka'l.
kolaipaathakan pozhuthu vidiki'rapoathu ezhunthu, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaik kon'ru, iraakkaalaththilea thirudanaippoal thiriki'raan.
vipasaaranudaiya ka'n maalai mayangkuki'ra vea'laikkuk kaaththirunthu: ennai oru ka'n'num kaa'namaattaathen'ru mukaththai moodikko'l'luki'raan.
avarka'l pakalil adaiyaa'lam paarththa veeduka'lai iruttilea kannamiduki'raarka'l; avarka'l ve'lichchaththai a'riyaarka'l.
vidiyungkaalamum avarka'lukku mara'na iru'lpoal irukki'rathu; appadippattavan mara'na iru'lin payangkaraththoadu pazhakiyirukki'raan.
neeroattaththaippoal theeviramaayp poavaan; theasaththil avan pangku sapikkappattup poaki'rathinaal, avan thiraadchaththoattangka'lin vazhiyai inik kaa'npathillai.
va'radchiyum ush'namum u'raintha mazhaiyaip padchikkum; appadiyea paathaa'lamaanathu paavika'laip padchikkum.
avanaip pet'ra karppam avanai ma'rakkum; puzhu thirupthikaramaay avanaith thinnum; avan appu'ram ninaikkappaduvathillai; akkiramamaanathu pattamaraththaippoala mu'rinthuvizhum.
pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyin aasthiyaip padchiththuvittu, vithavaikku nanmai seyyaatheapoaki'raan.
than palaththinaalea vallavarka'laith than paarisamaakkuki'raan; avan ezhumpuki'rapoathu oruvanukkum piraa'nanaippat'ri nichchayamillai.
theavan avanukkuch sukavaazhvaik katta'laiyittaal, athinmeal u'ruthiyaay nampikkai vaikki'raan; aanaalum avarudaiya ka'nka'l appadippattavarka'lin vazhika'lukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
avarka'l kognchakkaalam uyarnthirunthu, kaa'naama'rpoay, thaazhththappattu, mat'ra ellaaraippoalum adakkappaduki'raarka'l; kathirka'lin nuniyaippoala a'rukkappaduki'raarka'l.
appadiyillaiyen'ru ennaip poyyanaakki, en vaarththaika'lai viyarththamaakkaththakkavan yaar en'raan.
appozhuthu sookiyanaana pilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaka:
athikaaramum payangkaramum avaridaththil irukki'rathu; avar thamathu unnathamaana sthalangka'lil samaathaanaththai u'ndaakkuki'raar.
avarudaiya seanaika'lukkuth thokaiyu'ndoa? avarudaiya ve'lichcham yaarmeal uthikkaamalirukki'rathu?
ippadiyirukka, manushan theavanukku munpaaka neethimaanaayiruppathu eppadi? sthireeyinidaththil pi'ranthavan suththamaayiruppathu eppadi?
santhiranai a'n'naanthupaarum, athuvum pirakaasiyaamalirukki'rathu; nadchaththirangka'lum avar paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaika'l alla.
puzhuvaayirukki'ra manithanum, poochchiyaayirukki'ra manupuththiranum emmaaththiram en'raan.
yoapu ma'rumozhiyaaka:
thidanillaathavanukku nee eppadi oththaasaipa'n'ninaay? pelanat'ra kaiyai nee eppadi aathariththaay?
nee gnaanamillaathavanukku eppadi usaavuthu'naiyaayirunthu, meypporu'laik ku'raiva'ra a'riviththaay?
yaarukku a'rivaip poathiththaay? unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappatta aavi yaarudaiyathu?
jalaththin keezh madinthavarka'lukkum, avarka'loadea thangkuki'ravarka'lukkum thaththa'lippu u'ndu.
avarukku munpaakap paathaa'lam ve'liyaayth thi'ranthirukki'rathu; narakam moodappadaathirukki'rathu.
avar uththarama'ndalaththai vettave'liyilea viriththu, poomiyai antharaththilea thongkavaikki'raar.
avar tha'n'neerka'laith thammudaiya kaarmeakangka'lil kattivaikki'raar; athin paaraththinaal meakam kizhiki'rathillai.
avar thamathu singkaasanam ni'rkum aakaasaththai sthirappaduththi, athinmeal thamathu meakaththai virikki'raar.
avar tha'n'neerka'lmeal sakkaravattam theerththaar; ve'lichchamum iru'lum mudiyumattum appadiyea irukkum.
avarudaiya ka'ndithaththaal vaanaththin thoo'nka'l athirnthu thaththa'likkum.
avar thamathu vallamaiyinaal samuththirak kontha'lippai amarappa'n'ni, thamathu gnaanaththinaal athin moorkkaththai adakkuki'raar.
thamathu aaviyinaal vaanaththai alangkariththaar; avarudaiya karam ne'livaana sarppa nadchaththiraththai uruvaakkit'ru.
ithoa, ivaika'l avarudaiya kiriyaiyil kadaikoadiyaanavaika'l, avaraikku'riththu naangka'l keattathu evva'lavu kogncham; avarudaiya vallamaiyin idimuzhakkaththai a'rinthavan yaar en'raan.
yoapu pinnum than pirasangkavaakkiyaththaith thodarnthu sonnathu:
en suvaasam ennilum, theavan thantha aavi en naasiyilum irukkumattum,
en uthaduka'l theemaiyaich solvathumillai; en naakku kapadam peasuvathumillaiyen'ru,
en niyaayaththaith tha'l'lividuki'ra theavanum, en aaththumaavaik kasappaakkuki'ra sarvavallavarumaanavarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
neengka'l peasuki'rathu neethiyen'ru naan oththukko'lvathu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaka; en aavi piriyumattum en uththamaththai ennaivittu vilakkean.
en neethiyaik kettiyaayp pidiththirukki'rean; athai naan vittuvidean; naan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum en iruthayam ennai ninthikkaathu.
en pakaignan aakaathavanaippoalum, enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravan akkiramakkaaranaippoalum iruppaanaaka.
maayakkaaran poru'laith theadi vaiththirunthaalum, theavan avan aaththumaavai eduththukko'l'lumpoathu, avan nampikkai enna?
aapaththu avanmeal varumpoathu, theavan avan kooppiduthalaik keadpaaroa?
avan sarvavallavarmeal manamakizhchchiyaayiruppaanoa? avan eppozhuthum theavanaith thozhuthuko'ndiruppaanoa?
theavanudaiya karaththin kiriyaiyaik ku'riththu ungka'lukku upatheasippean; sarvavallavaridaththil irukki'rathai naan ma'raikkamaattean.
ithoa, neengka'l ellaarum athaik ka'ndirunthum, neengka'l iththanai vee'n e'n'nangko'ndirukki'rathu enna?
pollaatha manushanukkuth theavanidaththilirunthu varuki'ra pangkum, kodoorakkaarar sarvavallavaraal adaiki'ra suthantharamum ennavenil,
avanudaiya kumaarar perukinaal pattayaththukku iraiyaavaarka'l; avan karppappi'rappuka'l aakaaraththinaal thirupthiyaavathillai.
avanukku meethiyaanavarka'l seththup puthaikkappaduvaarka'l; avanudaiya vithavaika'l pulampuvathillai.
avan puzhuthiyaippoalap pa'naththaik kuviththukko'ndaalum, ma'n'naippoala vasthirangka'laich savathariththaalum,
avan savathariththathai neethimaan uduththikko'ndu, kut'ramillaathavan avan pa'naththaip pakirnthuko'l'luvaan.
avanudaiya veedu pottuppoochchi kattina veettaippoalum, kaavalkaakki'ravan poatta kudisaiyaippoalumaakum.
avan aisuvariyavaanaayth thoongkik kidanthu, on'rum pa'rikodaatheapoanaalum, avan than ka'nka'laith thi'rakkumpoathu on'rumillaathirukkum.
ve'l'laththaippoalath thikilka'l avanai vaarikko'ndupoakum; iraakkaalaththil perungkaat'ru avanai adiththukko'ndupoakum.
ko'ndalkaat'ru avanaith thookkikko'ndupoaka, avan poayviduvaan; athu avanai avan sthalaththilirunthu tha'l'likko'ndupoakum.
avar ivaika'lai avanmeal varappa'n'ni avanaith thappavidaathiruppaar; avarudaiya kaikkuth thappiyoadap paarppaan.
janangka'l avanaip paarththuk kaikotti, avanai avan sthalaththaivittu veruttividuvaarka'l.
ve'l'likku vi'laividam u'ndu, ponnukkup pudamidum sthalamumu'ndu.
irumpu ma'n'nilirunthu edukkappadum; sempu ka'rka'lil urukki edukkappadum.
manithan anthakaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilum irukki'ra ka'rka'laik kadaiyaantharamattum aaraaynthu theadi, iru'lukkum angkea mudivu'ndaakkuki'raan.
kadakkakkoodaathathum nilaiyaathathumaana aa'ru ezhumpinaalum, uzhaippaa'liyaanavan athai manusharaal vat'rippoakappa'n'nich selluki'raan.
poomiyinmeal aakaaram vi'laiyum; athin keezhidangka'lilirukki'ravaika'loa, akkiniyaal maa'rinathupoalirukkum.
athin kalluka'lil inthiraneelam vi'laiyum; athin podiyil ponpodika'lum u'ndaayirukkum.
oru vazhiyu'ndu, athu oru padchikkum theriyaathu; valloo'rin ka'n'num athaik ka'ndathillai;
thushdamirukangka'lin kaal athil padavillai; singkam athaik kadanthathillai.
avan than kaika'laik ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal neetti, malaika'lai vearoadea purattuki'raan.
kanmalaika'lukku'l'lum neerkkaalka'lai vettuki'raan; avan ka'n vilaiyuyarntha ellaavat'raiyum kaa'num.
oru thu'liyum kasiyaathapadi aa'ruka'lai adaikki'raan; ma'raividaththilirukki'rathai ve'lichchaththilea ko'nduvaruki'raan.
aanaalum gnaanam ka'ndedukkappaduvathu engkea? puththi vi'laiki'ra idam ethu?
athin vilai manushanukkuth theriyaathu; athu jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea akappaduki'rathillai.
aazhamaanathu: athu ennidaththil illaiyenki'rathu; samuththiramaanathum, athu ennidaththil illaiyenki'rathu.
atha'rku eedaakath thangkaththaik kodukkavum, atha'rkuk kirayamaaka ve'l'liyai ni'rukkavum koodaathu.
oappeerin thangkamum, vilaiyea'rappet'ra koameathakamum, inthira neelakkallum atha'rku eedalla.
ponnum pa'lingkum atha'rku oppalla; pasumponnaapara'nangka'lukku athai maat'rakkoodaathu.
pava'laththaiyum spadikaththaiyum aththoadea oppittup peasalaakaathu; muththukka'laippaarkkilum gnaanaththin vilai uyarnthathu.
eththiyoappiyaavin pushparaakam atha'rku nikaralla; pasumponnum atha'rkuch sariyalla.
ippadiyirukka, gnaanam engkeayirunthu varum; puththi thangkum idam engkea?
athu jeevanu'l'la sakalarudaiya ka'nka'lukkum o'liththum, aakaasaththup pa'ravaika'lukku ma'rainthum irukki'rathu.
naasamum mara'namum, naangka'l engka'l kaathuka'linaaleamaaththiram athin keerththiyaik keattoam enki'rathu.
theavanoa athin vazhiyai a'rivaar, athin sthaanam avarukkea theriyum.
avar poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'laip paarththu, vaanangka'linkeezh irukki'rathaiyellaam kaa'nki'raar.
avar kaat'rukku athin ni'raiyai niyamiththu, jalaththukku athin a'lavaip piramaa'niththu,
mazhaikkuth thittaththaiyum, idimuzhakkaththoadea koodiya minnalukku vazhiyaiyum ea'rpaduththuki'raar.
avar athaip paarththuk ka'nakkittaar; athai aaraaynthu aayaththappaduththi,
manushanai noakki: ithoa, aa'ndavarukkup payappaduvathea gnaanam; pollaappai vittu vilakuvathea puththi en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
pinnum yoapu than pirasangkavaakkiyaththaith thodarnthu sonnathu:
sen'rupoana maathangka'lilum, theavan ennaik kaappaat'rivantha naadka'lilum enakku u'ndaayiruntha seer ippozhuthu irunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
appozhuthu avar theepam en thalaiyinmeal pirakaasiththathu; avar aru'lina ve'lichchaththinaal iru'laik kadanthupoanean.
theavanudaiya irakasiyachseyal en koodaaraththinmeal irunthathu.
appozhuthu sarvavallavar ennoadirunthaar; en pi'l'laika'l ennaich soozhnthirunthaarka'l.
en paathangka'lai naan neyyinaal kazhuvinean; kanmalaika'lilirunthu enakkaaka e'n'ney nathipoala oadivanthathu; anthach selvanaadka'lin seer ippoathirunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
naan patta'naveethiyaal vaasalukku'l pu'rappattuppoay, veethiyil en aasanaththaip poadumpoathu,
vaalipar ennaik ka'ndu o'liththukko'lvaarka'l; muthiyoar ezhunthirunthu ni'rpaarka'l.
pirapukka'l peasuki'rathai ni'ruththi, kaiyinaal thangka'l vaayaip poththikko'lvaarka'l.
periyoarin saththam adangki, avarka'l naakku avarka'l mealvaayoadu ottikko'l'lum.
ennaik keatta kaathu ennaip paakkiyavaan en'rathu; ennaik ka'nda ka'n enakkuch saadchiyittathu.
mu'raiyiduki'ra eazhaiyaiyum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum, uthaviyat'ravanaiyum iradchiththean.
kettuppoaka irunthavanudaiya aaseervaatham enmeal vanthathu; vithavaiyin iruthayaththaik kempeerikkappa'n'ninean.
neethiyaith thariththukko'ndean; athu en uduppaayirunthathu; en niyaayam enakkuch saalvaiyum paakaiyumaay irunthathu.
naan kurudanukkuk ka'n'num, sappaa'nikkuk kaalumaayirunthean.
naan e'liyavarka'lukkuth thakappanaayirunthu, naan a'riyaatha vazhakkai aaraaynthupaarththean.
naan aniyaayakkaararudaiya kadaivaayp pa'rka'lai udaiththu, avarka'l pa'riththathai avarka'l pa'rka'lilirunthu pidungkinean.
en koottilea naan jeeviththuppoavean; en naadka'lai ma'nalaththanaiyaayp perukappa'n'nuvean en'rean.
en vear tha'n'neerka'lin oaramaayp padarnthathu; en ki'laiyinmeal pani iraamuzhuthum thangkiyirunthathu.
en makimai ennil sezhiththoangki, en kaiyilu'l'la en vil puthuppelan ko'ndathu.
enakkuch sevikoduththuk kaaththirunthaarka'l; en aaloasanaiyaik keattu mavunamaayirunthaarka'l.
en peachchukkup peasaamalirunthaarka'l; en vasanam avarka'lmeal thu'lithu'liyaay vizhunthathu.
mazhaikkuk kaaththirukki'rathupoal enakkuk kaaththirunthu, pinmaarikku aasaiyu'l'lavarka'lpoal thangka'l vaayai aaven'ru thi'ranthirunthaarka'l.
naan avarka'laip paarththu nakaikkumpoathu, avarka'l thu'nikarangko'l'lavillai; en mukakka'laiyai maa'rachseyyavum illai.
avarka'l vazhiyeapoaka enakkuch siththamaakumpoathu, naan thalaivanaay udkaarnthu, iraa'nuvaththukku'l raajaavaippoalum, thukkiththavarka'laith theat'raravupa'n'nuki'ravanaippoalum irunthean.
ippoathoa ennilum i'lavayathaanavarka'l ennaip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; ivarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lai naan en manthaiyaik kaakkum naayka'loadea vaikkavungkooda vedkappattiruppean.
viruththaappiyaththinaalea pelanat'ruppoana avarka'l kaika'linaal enakku enna uthaviyirunthathu.
ku'raichchalinaalum pasiyinaalum avarka'l vaadi, vekunaa'laayp paazhum ve'rumaiyumaana antharave'likku oadippoay,
sedika'lukku'l irukki'ra thazhaika'laip pidungkuvaarka'l; kaattuppoo'nduka'lin kizhangkuka'l avarka'lukku aakaaramaayirunthathu.
avarka'l manusharin naduvilirunthu thuraththappattaarka'l; ka'l'lanaith thuraththuki'rathupoal: ka'l'lan ka'l'lan en'ru avarka'laith thuraththivittaarka'l.
avarka'l pa'l'laththaakkuka'lin vedippuka'lilum, poomiyin kepika'lilum, kanmalaika'lilum poay kudiyirunthaarka'l.
sedika'lukku'l'lirunthu katha'ri, kaagncho'rika'linkeezh othungkinaarka'l.
avarka'l moodarin makka'lum, neesarin pi'l'laika'lum, theasaththilirunthu thuraththu'ndavarka'lumaay irunthaarka'l.
aanaalum ippoathu naan avarka'lukkup paattum pazhamozhiyum aanean.
ennai aruvaruththu, enakkuth thooramaaki, en mukaththukku munpaakath thuppak koosaathirukki'raarka'l.
naan kattina kattai avar avizhththu, ennaich si'rumaippaduththinapadiyinaal, avarka'lum kadivaa'laththai en mukaththukku munpaaka utha'rivittaarka'l.
valathupaarisaththil vaalipar ezhumpi, en kaalka'laith thava'rivizhappa'n'ni, thangka'l keadaana vazhika'lai enakku nearaaka aayaththappaduththuki'raarka'l.
en paathaiyaik keduththu, en aapaththai varththikkappa'n'nuki'raarka'l; atha'rku avarka'lukku oththaasaipa'n'nuki'ravarka'l theavaiyillai.
perithaana thi'rappu'ndaakki, thaangka'l keduththa vazhiyil pura'nduvaruki'raarka'l.
payangkarangka'l enmeal thirumpivaruki'rathu, avaika'l kaat'raippoala en aaththumaavaip pinthodaruki'rathu; en sukavaazhvu oru meakaththaippoal kadanthupoayit'ru.
aakaiyaal ippoathu en aaththumaa ennil mu'rinthupoayit'ru; upaththiravaththin naadka'l ennaip pidiththukko'ndathu.
iraakkaalaththilea en elumpuka'l thu'laikkappattu, en narampuka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal illaathirukki'rathu.
noayin ukkiraththinaal en uduppu vea'rupattuppoayit'ru; athu en angkiyin kazhuththuppattaiyaippoala, ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu.
seat'rilea tha'l'lappattean; thoo'lukkum saampalukkum oppaanean.
ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; neer enakku ma'ruuththaravu kodaathirukki'reer; kegnchini'rki'rean, enmeal paaraamukamaayirukki'reer.
enmeal kodooramu'l'lavaraaka maa'rineer; ummudaiya karaththin vallamaiyaal ennai viroathikki'reer.
neer ennaith thookki, ennaik kaat'rilea pa'rakkavittu, ennaip payaththinaal urukippoakappa'n'nuki'reer.
sakala jeevaaththumaakka'lukkum ku'rikkappatta thaavaramaakiya mara'naththukku ennai oppukkoduppeer en'ru a'rivean.
aanaalum naan yaathoruvanai avan aapaththilea thavikkappa'n'ninathum,

thunnaa'laik ka'ndavanukkaaka naan azhaathirunthathum, e'liyavanukkaaka en aaththumaa viyaakulappadaathirunthathum u'ndaanaal, avar en manuvukku idangkodaamal, enakku viroathamaayth thamathu kaiyai neettuvaaraaka.
nanmaikkuk kaaththiruntha enakkuth theemai vanthathu; ve'lichchaththai varap paarththukko'ndiruntha enakku iru'l vanthathu.
en kudalka'l kothiththu, amaraathirukki'rathu; upaththiravanaadka'l enmeal vanthathu.
veyil padaathirunthum, naan ka'ruka'ruththuth thiriki'rean; naan sapaiyilirunthu ezhunthirukkumpoathu ala'ruki'rean.
naan malaippaampuka'lukkuch sakoatharanum, koattaanka'lukkuth thoazhanumaanean.
en thoal enmeal ka'ruththuppoayit'ru; en elumpuka'l ush'naththinaal kaaynthupoayit'ru.
en surama'ndalam pulampalaakavum, en kinnaram azhuki'ravarka'lin oalamaakavum maa'rina.
en ka'nka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nina naan oru kannikaiyinmeal ninaippaayiruppatheppadi?
appozhuthu unnathangka'lilirunthu theavan a'likkum pangkum, unnathaththilirunthu sarvavallavar kodukkum suthantharamum kidaikkumoa?
maa'rupaadaanavanukku aapaththum, akkiramach seykaikkaararukku aakkinaiyumallavoa kidaikkum.
avar en vazhika'laip paarththu, en nadaika'laiyellaam e'n'nuki'raar allavoa?
naan maayaiyilea nadantheanoa, en kaal kapaduseyyath theeviriththathoa en'ru,
sumuththiraiyaana tharaasilea theavan ennai ni'ruththu, en uththamaththai a'rivaaraaka.
en nadaika'l vazhiyaivittu vilakinathum, en iruthayam en ka'nka'laip pinthodarnthathum, eathaakilum oru maasu en kaika'lil ottikko'ndathum u'ndaanaal,
appozhuthu naan vithaiththathai vea'roruvan pusippaanaaka; en payirka'l vearat'ruppoakakkadavathu.
en manam yaathoru sthireeyinmeal mayangki, ayalaanudaiya vaasalai naan ettippaarththathu'ndaanaal,
appozhuthu en manaivi vea'roruvanukku maavaraippaa'laaka; veat'rumanithar ava'lmeal saayvaarka'laaka.
athu thoasham, athu niyaayaathipathika'laal visaarikkappadum akkiramamaamea.
athu paathaa'lapariyantham padchikkum akkiniyaay en sampaththaiyellaam nirmoolamaakkum.
en vealaikkaaranaanaalum, en vealaikkaariyaanaalum, ennoadu vazhakkaadumpoathu, avarka'l niyaayaththai naan asattaipa'n'niyirunthaal,
theavan ezhumpumpoathu, naan ennaseyvean; avar visaarikkumpoathu, naan avarukku enna ma'ruuththaravu solluvean.
thaayin karppaththil ennai u'ndupa'n'ninavar avanaiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaar allavoa? oreavithamaana karppaththil engka'lai uruvaakkinaar allavoa?
e'liyavarka'l vaagnchiththathai naan kodaathirunthu, vithavaiyin ka'nka'laip pooththuppoakappa'n'ni,
thaaythakappanillaatha pi'l'lai en aakaaraththil saappidaamal, naan oruvanaaych saappittathu'ndoa?
en si'ruvayathumuthal avan thakappanidaththil va'larvathupoala ennoadea va'larnthaan; naan en thaayin karppaththilea pi'ranthathumuthal appadippattavarka'laik kailaakukoduththu nadaththinean.
oruvan uduppillaathathinaal madinthupoaki'rathaiyum, eazhaikku mooda vasthiramillaathirukki'rathaiyum naan ka'ndapoathu,
avan en aattumayirk kampa'liyinaalea analko'ndathinaal, avan idai ennaip pukazhaathirunthathum,
olimukavaasalil enakkuch selvaakku u'nden'ru naan ka'ndu, thikkat'ravanukku viroathamaay en kaiyai neettinathum u'ndaanaal,
en kaippattai thoa'lilirunthu sarinthu, en puyaththu elumpu mu'rinthupoavathaaka.
theavan aakkinaiyiduvaar en'rum, avarudaiya makaththuvaththai uththarikkakkoodaathu en'rum, enakkup payangkaramaayirunthathu.
naan ponninmeal en nampikkaiyai vaiththu, thangkaththaippaarththu: nee en aatharavu en'ru naan sonnathum,
en aasthiperiyathen'rum, en kaikku mikuthiyum kidaiththathen'rum naan makizhnthathum,
sooriyan pirakaasikkumpoathum, allathu santhiran makimaiyaaych sellumpoathum, naan athai noakki:
en manam irakasiyamaay mayakkappattu, en vaay en kaiyai muththi seythathu'ndaanaal,
ithuvum niyaayaathipathika'laal visaarikkappadaththakka akkiramamaayirukkum; athinaal unnathaththilirukki'ra theavanai ma'ruthalippeanea.
en pakaignanudaiya aapaththilea naan makizhnthu, pollaappu avanukku nearittapoathu ka'likoornthiruntheanoa?
avan jeevanukkuch saapaththaik kodukkumpadi virumpi, vaayinaal paavagnseyya naan idangkodukkavillai.
avan inaththaarka'lil thirupthiyaakaathavanaik kaa'npippavan yaaren'ru en koodaaraththin manushar sollaarka'loa?
paratheasi veethiyilea iraaththangkinathillai; vazhippoakkanukku en vaasalka'laith thi'ranthean.
naan aathaamaippoala en mee'ruthalka'lai moodi, en akkiramaththai en madiyilea o'liththuvaiththeanoa?

thira'laana en koottaththukku naan payanthathinaalaavathu, inaththaar janaththaar pa'n'num ikazhchchi ennaith thidukkidappa'n'ninathinaalaavathu, naan peasaathirunthu, vaasa'rpadiyai vittup pu'rappadaathiruntheanoa?
aa, en vazhakkaik keadki'ravan oruvan irunthaal nalamaayirukkum; ithoa, sarvavallavar enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyavum, en ethiraa'li than vazhakkai ezhuthikkodukkavum enakku viruppamu'ndu.
athai naan en thoa'linmeal vaiththu, enakkuk kireedamaakath thariththukko'lveanea.
avanukku naan en nadaika'laith thokai thokaiyaayk kaa'npiththu, oru pirapuvaippoala avanidaththil poavean.
enakku viroathamaaka en kaa'nipoomi kooppiduki'rathum, athin padaichchaalka'lkooda azhuki'rathum,
koolikodaamal naan athin palanaip pusiththu, payirittavarka'lin aaththumaavai upaththiravappaduththinathum u'ndaanaal,
athil koathumaikkup pathilaaka mu'l'lum, vaa'rkoathumaikkup pathilaakak ka'laiyum mu'laikkakkadavathu en'raan. yoapin vaarththaika'l mudinthathu.
yoapu than paarvaikku neethimaanaayirunthapadiyinaal, avanukku antha moon'ru manusharum pirathiyuththaram solli oaynthaarka'l.

athinaal raamin vamsaththaanaana poosiyanaakiya parakeyealin kumaaran elikoovukkuk koapam moo'ndathu; yoapu, theavanaippaarkkilum thannaiththaan neethimaanaakkinathinimiththam, avanmealum avanukkuk koapam moo'ndathu.
kodukkaththakka ma'rumozhi yoapin moon'ru sineakitharukkum akappadaathirunthum, avarka'l avanai aakaathavanen'ru theerththathinimiththam, avarka'lmealum avanukkuk koapam moo'ndathu.
avarka'l thannaippaarkkilum vayathusen'ravarka'laanapadiyinaal, elikoo yoapin vaarththaika'l mudinthu theerumattum kaaththirunthaan.
antha moon'ru manusharin vaayilum ma'ruuththaravu pi'rakkavillaiyen'ru elikoo ka'ndapoathu, avanukkuk koapam moo'ndathu.

aathalaal parakeyealin kumaaran elikoo ennum poosiyan pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan i'lavayathu'l'lavan, neengka'loa viruththaappiyar; aakaiyaal naan agnchi, en apippiraayaththai ungka'lukku munpaaka ve'lippaduththap payanthirunthean.
muthiyoar peasattum, vayathusen'ravarka'l gnaanaththai a'rivikkattum en'rirunthean.
aanaalum manusharil oru aaviyu'ndu; sarvavallavarudaiya suvaasamea avarka'lai u'narvu'l'lavarka'laakkum.
periyoarellaam gnaanika'lalla; muthiyoarellaam neethiyai a'rinthavarka'lumalla.
aakaiyaal enakkuch sevikodungka'l; naanum en apippiraayaththai ve'lippaduththuvean en'rean.
ithoa, ungka'l vasanangka'l mudiyumattum kaaththirunthean; neengka'l sollaththakkathai aaraaynthu theadumattum, ungka'l niyaayangka'lukkuch sevikoduththean.
naan ungka'l sollaik kavaniththean; aanaalum ithoa, ungka'lil yoapukku niyaayaththaith theriyakkaatti, avarudaiya vasanangka'lukku eat'ra pirathiyuththaram solluki'ravanillai.
gnaanaththaik ka'ndupidiththoam en'ru neengka'l sollaathapadi paarungka'l; manushanalla, theavanea avarai jeyangko'l'lavea'ndum.
avar ennaippaarththup peasinathillai; neengka'l sonna vaarththaika'linaal naan avarukkup pirathiyuththaram solvathumillai.
avarka'l kalangki, appu'ram pirathiyuththaram sollaathirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lukkup peachchu at'ruppoayit'ru.
avarka'l peasaarka'loa en'ru kaaththirunthean; aanaalum avarka'l appu'ram ma'rumozhi kodaamalirunthapadiyinaal,
naanum pirathiyuththaramaaka enakkuth thoan'riyamattum solluvean; naanum en apippiraayaththai ve'lippaduththuvean.
vaarththaika'l enakku'l ni'rainthirukki'rathu; en u'l'laththilu'l'la aavi ennai nerukki eavuki'rathu.
ithoa, en u'l'lam adaikkappattirunthu, puthuth thuruththika'lai muthalaayp pee'rappa'n'nuki'ra puthu rasaththaippoalirukki'rathu.
naan aa'ruthaladaiyumpadi peasuvean; en uthaduka'laith thi'ranthu pirathiyuththaram solluvean.
naan oruvanudaiya mukaththaip paaraamalum, oru manushanukkum ichchakam peasaamalum iruppeanaaka.
naan ichchakam peasa a'riyean; peasinaal ennai u'ndaakkinavar seekkiramaay ennai eduththukko'lvaar.
yoapea, en niyaayangka'laik kea'lum; en vaarththaika'lukkellaam sevikodum.
ithoa, en vaayai ippoathu thi'ranthean; en vaayilirukki'ra en naavaanathu peasum.
en vaarththaika'l en iruthayaththin u'nmaikku oththirukkum; naan a'rinthathai en uthaduka'l suththamaay vasanikkum.
theavanudaiya aaviyaanavar ennai u'ndaakkinaar; sarvavallavarudaiya suvaasam enakku uyirkoduththathu.
ummaalea koodumaanaal enakku ma'rumozhi kodum; neer aayaththappattu enakku ethiraaka nillum.
ithoa, ummaippoala naanum theavanaal u'ndaanavan; naanum ma'n'ninaal uruvaakkappattavan.
ithoa, neer enakkup payappattuk kalangkath theavaiyillai; en kai ummeal paaramaayirukkamaattaathu.
naan kaathaarak keadka neer sonnathum, enakkuk kea'lviyaana ummudaiya vaarththaika'lin saththamum ennaven'raal:
naan mee'ruthal illaatha suththan, naan kut'ramat'ravan, ennil akkiramamillai.
ithoa, ennil avar kut'rampidikkap paarkki'raar, ennaith thamakkuch saththuruvaaka e'n'nikko'l'luki'raar.
avar en kaalka'laith thozhuvilea maatti, en nadaika'laiyellaam kaavalpaduththuki'raar en'ru sonneer.
ithilea neer neethiyu'l'lavar allaven'ru umakkup pirathiyuththaramaakach solluki'rean; manushanaippaarkkilum theavan periyavaraayirukki'raar.
avar thammudaiya seyalka'l ellaavat'raiyungku'riththuk kaara'nam sollavillaiyen'ru neer avaroadea ean vazhakkaaduki'reer?
theavan oruvisai solliyirukki'ra kaariyaththai ira'ndaamvisai paarththuth thiruththuki'ravarallavea.
kananiththirai manusharmeal i'rangki, avarka'l padukkaiyinmeal ayarnthirukkaiyil,
avar iraakkaalaththuth tharisanamaana soppanaththilea manusharudaiya sevikkuth thaam seyyum kaariyaththai ve'lippaduththi, athai avarka'lukku varum tha'ndanaiyinaalea muththiraipoattu,
manushan thannudaiya seykaiyaivittu neengkavum, manusharudaiya perumai adangkavum seyki'raar.
ivvithamaay avan aaththumaavaip padukuzhikkum, avan jeevanaip pattaya vettukkum thappuvikki'raar.
avan than padukkaiyilea vaathaiyinaalum, than sakala elumpuka'lilum akoaramaana noavinaalum tha'ndikkappaduki'raan.
avan jeevan appaththaiyum, avan aaththumaa rusikaramaana poajanaththaiyum aroasikkum.
avan maamsam kaa'nappadaathapadikku azhinthu, moodappattiruntha avan elumpuka'l ve'lippaduki'rathu.
avan aaththumaa paathaa'laththukkum, avan piraa'nan saavukkum sameepikki'rathu.
aayiraththil oruvaraakiya saamaasipa'n'nuki'ra thoothanaanavar manushanukkuth thammudaiya nithaanaththai a'rivikkumpadikku, avanukku anusaariyaayirunthaareayaakil,
avar avanukku irangki, avan padukuzhiyil i'rangkaathapadikku: neer avanai iradchiyum; meedkumporu'lai naan ka'ndupidiththean enpaar.
appozhuthu avan maamsam vaalipaththil irunthathaippaarkkilum aaroakkiyamadaiyum; than vaalavayathu naadka'lukkuth thirumpuvaan.
avan theavanai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'numpoathu, avan avarudaiya samukaththaik kempeeraththoadea paarkkumpadi avar avanmeal piriyamaaki, antha manushanukku avanudaiya neethiyin palanaik koduppaar.
avan manusharai noakkippaarththu: naan paavagnseythu semmaiyaanathaip purattinean, athu enakkup pirayoajanamaayirukkavillai.
en aaththumaa padukuzhiyil i'rangkaathapadi, avar athai iradchippaar; aakaiyaal en piraa'nan ve'lichchaththaik kaa'num en'ru solluvaan.
ithoa, theavan manushanudaiya aaththumaavaip padukuzhikku vilakkuki'ratha'rkum, avanai jeevanu'l'loarin ve'lichchaththinaalea pirakaasippikki'ratha'rkum,
avar ivaika'laiyellaam avanidaththil palamu'rai nadappikki'raar.
yoapea, neer kavaniththu en sollaik kea'lum; naan peasappoaki'rean, neer mavunamaayirum.
sollaththakka niyaayangka'l irunthatheayaanaal, enakku ma'ruuththaravu kodum; neer peasum, ummai neethimaanaakath theerkka enakku aasaiyu'ndu.
on'rum illaathirunthatheayaakil neer en sollaik kea'lum, mavunamaayirum, naan umakku gnaanaththai upatheasippean en'raan.
pinnum elikoo maa'ruththaramaaka:
gnaanika'lea, en vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; a'rivaa'lika'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l.
vaayaanathu poajanaththai rusipaarkki'rathupoala, seviyaanathu vaarththaika'laich soathiththuppaarkkum.
namakkaaka niyaayamaanathaith therinthuko'lvoamaaka; nanmai innathen'ru namakku'l'lea a'rinthuko'lvoamaaka.
yoapu: naan neethimaan; theavan en niyaayaththaith tha'l'livittaar en'rum,
niyaayam ennidaththil irunthum naan poyyanen'ru e'n'nappaduki'rean; mee'ruthal illaathirunthum, ampinaal enakku u'ndaana kaayam aa'raathathaayirukki'rathen'rum sonnaarea.
yoapaippoalavea, pariyaasampa'n'nuthalaith tha'n'neeraippoal kudiththu,
akkiramakkaararoadea koodikko'ndu, thunmaarkkaroadea thiriki'ravan yaar?
eppadiyenil, theavanmeal piriyam vaikki'rathu manushanukkup pirayoajanam alla en'raarea.
aakaiyaal puththimaanka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; akkiramam theavanukkum, aneethi sarvavallavarukkum thooramaayirukki'rathu.
manushanudaiya seykaikkuththakkathai avanukkuch sarikkatti, avanavan nadakkaikkuththakkathaaka avanavanukkup palana'likki'raar.
theavan aniyaayagn seyyaamalum, sarvavallavar neethiyaip purattaamalum irukki'rathu meyyea.
poomiyinmeal manushanukku athikaaram koduththavar yaar? poochchakkaram muzhuthaiyum ozhungkuppaduththinavar yaar?
avar thammudaiya iruthayaththai avanukku viroathamaakath thiruppinaaraakil, avanudaiya aaviyaiyum avanudaiya suvaasaththaiyum thammidaththil izhuththukko'l'luvaar.
appadiyea maamsamaana yaavum eakamaay jeeviththuppoam, manushan thoo'lukkuth thirumpuvaan.
umakku u'narvirunthaal ithaik kea'lum, en vaarththaika'lin saththaththukkuch sevikodum.
neethiyaip pakaikki'ra oruvan aa'lakkoodumoa? makaa neethipararaik kut'rappaduththuveeroa?
oru raajaavaip paarththu, nee pollaathavan en'rum, athipathika'laip paarththu, neengka'l akkiramakkaarar en'rum sollaththakumoa?

ippadiyirukka, pirapukka'lin mukaththaippaaraamalum, eazhaiyaippaarkkilum aisuvariyavaanai athikamaay e'n'naamalum irukki'ravarai noakki ippadich sollalaamaa? ivarka'l ellaarum avar karangka'lin kiriyaiyea.
ippadippattavarka'l sadithiyil saavaarka'l; janangka'l paathijaamaththil kalangki ozhinthupoavaarka'l; kaa'naatha kaiyinaal palavanthar azhinthupoavaarka'l.
avarudaiya ka'nka'l manusharudaiya vazhika'lai noakkiyirukki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya nadaika'laiyellaam avar paarkki'raar.
akkiramakkaarar o'liththukko'l'laththakka anthakaaramumillai, mara'na iru'lumillai.
manushan theavanoadea vazhakkaadumpadi avar avanmeal mignchinathon'raiyum sumaththamaattaar.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha niyaayamaay avar vallamaiyu'l'lavarka'lai no'rukki, vea'rea manusharai avarka'l sthaanaththilea ni'ruththuki'raar.
avarka'l kiriyaika'lai avar a'rinthavaraanapadiyaal, avarka'l nasungkippoakaththakkathaay iraakkaalaththil avarka'laik kavizhththuppoaduki'raar.
avarka'l avarai vittup pinvaangki, avarudaiya ellaa vazhika'laiyum u'narnthuko'l'laamal poanapadiyinaalum,
e'liyavarka'lin kookkural avaridaththil searumpadi seythathinaalum, si'rumaiyaanavanudaiya kookkuralaik keadki'ra avar,
ellaarum paarkkumpadi avarka'laith thunmaarkkaren'ru adikki'raar.
maayakkaaran aa'laathapadikkum, janangka'l sikkikko'l'lappadaathapadikkum,
oru janaththukkaanaalum oru manushanukkaanaalum, avar samaathaanaththai aru'linaal yaar kalangkappa'n'nuvaan? avar thamathu mukaththai ma'raiththaal avaraik kaa'nki'ravan yaar?
naan tha'ndikkappattean; naan inip paavagnseyyamaattean.
naan kaa'naatha kaariyaththai neer enakkup poathiyum, naan aniyaayam pa'n'nineanaanaal, naan ini appadich seyvathillai en'ru theavanai noakkich sollaththakumea.

neer appadich seyyamaattoamenki'rapadiyinaal, ummoadirukki'ravarka'lil oruvanai umakkup pathilaaka athaich seyyachsolveeroa? naan alla, neerea therinthuko'l'lavea'ndum; allaven'raal, neer a'rinthirukki'rathaich sollum.
yoapu a'rivillaamal peasinaar; avar vaarththaika'l gnaanamu'l'lavaika'l allaven'ru,
puththiyu'l'la manushar en padchamaayp peasuvaarka'l; gnaanamu'l'la manushanum enakkuch sevikoduppaan.
akkiramakkaarar sonna ma'ruuththaravuka'linimiththam yoapu mut'ramudiya soathikkappadavea'ndiyathea en apeadchai.
thammudaiya paavaththoadea mee'ruthalaik koottinaar; avar engka'lukku'l'lea kaikotti, theavanukku viroathamaayth thammudaiya vaarththaika'lai mikuthiyaaka vasaniththaar en'raan.
pinnum elikoo maa'ruththaramaaka:
en neethi theavanudaiya neethiyaippaarkkilum periyathen'ru neer sonnathu niyaayam en'ru e'n'nuki'reeroa?
naan paaviyaayiraathathinaal enakkup pirayoajanamenna? palan enna? en'ru sonneer.
umakkum ummoadea irukki'ra ummudaiya sineakitharukkum naan pirathiyuththaram solluki'rean.
neer vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, ummaippaarkkilum uyaramaayirukki'ra aakaayama'ndalangka'laik ka'n'noakkum.
neer paavagnseythaal athinaalea avarukku enna nashdam? ummudaiya mee'ruthalka'l mikuthiyaanaalum, athinaalea avarukku enna seatham?
neer neethimaanaayirunthaal, athinaalea avarukku enna kidaikkum? allathu avar ummudaiya kaiyil enna laapaththaip pe'ruvaar?
ummudaiya paavaththinaal ummaippoan'ra manushanukku nashdamum, ummudaiya neethiyinaal manupuththiranukku laapamum u'ndaakum.
aneakaraal palavanthamaay odukkappattavarka'l mu'raiyittu, vallavarka'ludaiya puyaththinimiththam ala'ruki'raarka'l.
poomiyin mirukangka'laippaarkkilum engka'laip puththimaanka'lum, aakaasaththup pa'ravaika'laippaarkkilum engka'lai gnaanavaanka'lumaakki,
ennai u'ndaakkinavarum, iravilum keethampaada aru'lseyki'ravarumaakiya en sirushdikarththaavaakiya theavan engkea en'ru keadpavan oruvanumillai.
angkea avarka'l pollaathavarka'lin perumaiyinimiththam kooppiduki'raarka'l; avaroa ma'ruuththaravu kodukki'rathillai.
theavan vee'nvaarththaikkuch sevikodaar, sarvavallavar athaik kavaniyaar.
avarudaiya tharisanam umakkuk kidaikki'rathillai en'ru neer solluki'reerea; aanaalum niyaayaththeerppu avaridaththil irukki'rathu; aakaiyaal avarukkuk kaaththukko'ndirum.
ippoathu avarudaiya koapamaanathu niyaayaththai mut'rilum visaariyaathu; avar innum on'raiyum ku'raiyat'ravithamaayth theerkkavillai.
aakaiyaal yoapu vee'naayth thammudaiya vaayaith thi'ranthu, a'rivillaamal vaarththaika'lai mikuthiyaay vasanikki'raar en'raan.
pinnum elikoo:
naan peasimudiyumattum sat'rea po'rum; innum theavanpadchaththil naan sollavea'ndiya niyaayangka'lai umakkuch sollikkaa'npippean.
naan thooraththilirunthu en gnaanaththaik ko'nduvanthu, ennai u'ndaakkinavarudaiya neethiyai vi'langkappa'n'nuvean.
meyyaakavea en vaarththaika'l poyyat'rirukkum; ummoadea peasuki'ravan a'rivil thea'rinavan.
ithoa, theavan makaththuvamu'l'lavar, avar oruvaraiyum pu'rakka'niyaar; mana urukkaththilum avar makaththuvamu'l'lavar.
avar thunmaarkkaraip pizhaikka ottaathirukki'raar; si'rumaiyaanavarka'lin niyaayaththai visaarikki'raar.
avar thammudaiya ka'nka'lai neethimaanka'laivittu vilakkaamal, avarka'lai raajaakka'loadea koodach singkaasanaththil ea'ravum, uyarntha sthalaththil en'raikkum udkaarnthirukkavum seyki'raar.
avarka'l vilangkuka'l poadappattu, upaththiravaththin kayi'ruka'laal kattappattirunthaalum,
avar, avarka'l kiriyaiyaiyum, mignchippoana avarka'ludaiya mee'ruthalka'laiyum avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththi,
akkiramaththai vittuth thirumpumpadi avarka'l seviyaith thi'ranthu kadinthuko'l'luki'raar.
avarka'l adangki avaraich seaviththaal, thangka'l naadka'lai nanmaiyaakavum, thangka'l varushangka'laich selvavaazhvaakavum poakkuvaarka'l.
adangkaarka'leayaakil pattayaththukku iraiyaaki, gnaanam adaiyaamal maa'ndupoavaarka'l.
maayamu'l'la iruthayaththaar kuroathaththaik kuviththukko'l'luki'raarka'l; avarka'lai avar kattivaikkumpoathu kegnchik kooppiduvaarka'l.
avarka'l vaalavayathilea maa'ndupoavaarka'l; ilachchaiyaanavarka'lukku'l'lea avarka'l piraa'nan mudiyum.
si'rumaippattavarka'lai avar si'rumaikku neengkalaakki, avarka'l odukkappattirukkaiyil avarka'l seviyaith thi'rakki'raar.
appadiyea avar ummaiyum nerukkaththinin'ru vilakki, odukkamillaatha visaalaththilea vaippaar; ummudaiya poajanapanthi kozhumaiyaana pathaarththangka'laal ni'rainthirukkum.
aakaathavanmeal varum niyaayaththeerppu ni'raivea'rap paarppeer; niyaayamum neethiyum ummai aatharikkum.
ukkiramu'ndaayirukki'rathinaal avar ummai oru adiyinaal vaarikko'ndu poakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirum; appozhuthu meedkumporu'lai mikuthiyaayk koduththaalum atha'rku neer neengkalaakamaatteer.
ummudaiya selvaththai avar mathippaaroa? ummudaiya ponnaiyum, poora'na paraakkiramaththaiyum avar mathikkamaattaarea.
janangka'l thangka'l idaththaivittu vaarikko'l'lappadappoaki'ra iravai vaagnchikkaathirum.
akkiramaththukkuth thirumpaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirum; upaththiravaththaippaarkkilum akkiramaththaith therinthuko'ndeerea.
ithoa, theavan thammudaiya vallamaiyil uyarnthirukki'raar; avaraippoal poathikki'ravar yaar?
avarudaiya vazhiyin niyaayaththai visaarikkaththakkavan yaar? neer aniyaayam seytheer en'ru sollaththakkavan yaar?
manushar noakkippaarkki'ra avarudaiya kiriyaiyai neer makimaippaduththa ninaiyum.
ellaa manusharum athaik kaa'nki'raarka'lea; thooraththilirunthu athu manusharukku ve'lippaduki'rathu.
ithoa, theavan makaththuvamu'l'lavar; naam avarai a'riya mudiyaathu; avarudaiya varushangka'lin ilakkam aaraaynthu mudiyaathathu.
avar neerththu'lika'lai a'nuvaippoala ea'rappa'n'nuki'raar; avaika'l meakaththilirunthu mazhaiyaaych soriki'rathu.
athai meakangka'l peythu, manusharmeal mikuthiyaayp pozhiki'rathu.
meakangka'lin paravuthalaiyum, avarudaiya koodaaraththilirunthu ezhumpum kumu'ralka'laiyum a'riyamudiyumoa?
ithoa, athinmeal thammudaiya minnalin o'liyai virikki'raar; samuththiraththin aazhangka'laiyum mooduki'raar.
avaika'laal janangka'lai tha'ndikki'ravarum, aakaarangkoduththu iradchikki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
avar minnalin o'liyaith thamathu kaikku'l'lea moodi, athu inninnathai adikkavea'ndumen'ru katta'laiyiduki'raar.
athinaal avar seyya ninaikki'rathaiyum, manthaaram ezhumpappoaki'rathaiyum, aadumaaduka'l a'riyappaduththum.
ithinaal en iruthayam thaththa'liththu, thannidaththaivittuth the'rikki'rathu.
avarudaiya saththaththinaal u'ndaaki'ra athirchchiyaiyum, avar vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra muzhakkaththaiyum kavanamaayk kea'lungka'l.
avar vaanaththin keezhengkum anthath thoniyaiyum, poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lmeal athin minnalaiyum sellaviduki'raar.
atha'rkuppinpu avar saththamaay muzhangki, thammudaiya makaththuvaththin saththaththaik kumu'rappa'n'nuki'raar; avarudaiya saththam keadkappadumpoathu athaith thavirkkamudiyaathu.
theavan thammudaiya saththaththai aachchariyamaanavithamaayk kumu'rappa'n'nuki'raar; naam kirakikkakkoodaatha periyakaariyangka'lai avar seyki'raar.
avar u'raintha mazhaiyaiyum, kalmazhaiyaiyum, thammudaiya vallamaiyin perumazhaiyaiyum paarththu: poomiyinmeal peyyungka'l en'ru katta'laiyiduki'raar.
thaam u'ndaakkina sakala manusharum thammai a'riyumpadikku, avar sakala manusharudaiya kaiyaiyum muththiriththuppoaduki'raar.
appozhuthu kaattumirukangka'l thangka'l kukaika'lil pukunthu, thangka'l kepika'lil thangkum.
the'rkeayirunthu soo'raava'liyum, vadakaat'rinaal ku'lirum varum.
thammudaiya suvaasaththinaal theavan ku'liraik kodukki'raar; appozhuthu jalaththin mea'rparappaanathu u'rainthupoam.
avar neerththu'lika'lai meakaththil eat'ri, minnalinaal meakaththaich sitha'rappa'n'nuki'raar.
avar avaika'lukkuk katta'laiyiduki'ra yaavaiyum, avaika'l poochchakkaraththil nadappikkumpadi, avar avaika'laith thammudaiya gnaana aaloasanaika'linpadiyea sut'rith thiriyappa'n'nuki'raar.
on'ril tha'ndanaiyaakavum, on'ril thammudaiya poomikku upayoakamaakavum, on'ril kirupaiyaakavum, avaika'lai varappa'n'nuki'raar.
yoapea, itha'rkuch sevikodum; thariththunin'ru theavanudaiya aachchariyamaana kiriyaika'laith thiyaaniththuppaarum.
theavan avaika'laith thittampa'n'ni, thammudaiya meakaththin minnalaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num vithaththai a'riveeroa?
meakangka'l thongkumpadi vaikkum ni'raiyaiyum, poora'na gnaanamu'l'lavarin a'rputhamaana seykaika'laiyum,
then'ralinaal avar poomiyai amaiyappa'n'numpoathu, ummudaiya vasthirangka'l ush'namaayirukkum vakaiyaiyum a'riveeroa?
vaarkkappatta ka'n'naadiyaippoal kettiyaana aakaayama'ndalangka'lai neer avaroadeakooda irunthu viriththeeroa?
avarukku naam sollaththakkathai engka'lukkup poathiyum; anthakaaraththinimiththam mu'raithappip peasuki'roam.
naan peasaththu'ninthean en'ru yaathaamoruvan avarukku munpaakach sollaththakumoa? oruvan peasaththu'ninthaal avan vizhungkappattuppoavaanea.
ippoathum kaat'ru veesi aakaayama'ndalangka'lilu'l'la mappu neengkappa'n'niyirukki'ra samayaththil vadakkeayirunthu ponmayamaana kaanthi varuki'rapoathu,
aakaayama'ndalaththilea pirakaasikki'ra sooriyanai muthalaay oruvarum noakkip paarkkakkoodaathea; theavanidaththiloa payangkaramaana makaththuvamu'ndu.
sarvavallavarai naam ka'ndupidikkakkoodaathu; avar vallamaiyilum niyaayaththilum peruththavar; avar makaaneethiparar; avar odukkamaattaar.
aakaiyaal manushar avarukkup payappadavea'ndum; thangka'l e'n'naththil gnaanika'laayirukki'ra evarka'laiyum avar mathikkamaattaar en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar: perungkaat'rilirunthu yoapukku uththaravaaka:
a'rivillaatha vaarththaika'linaal aaloasanaiyai anthakaarappaduththuki'ra ivan yaar?
ippoathum purushanaippoal idaikattikko'l; naan unnaik keadpean; nee enakku uththaravu sollu.
naan poomiyai asthipaarappaduththuki'rapoathu nee engkeayirunthaay? nee a'rivaa'liyaanaal athai a'rivi.
atha'rku a'lavu ku'riththavar yaar? athinmeal noolpoattavar yaar? ithai nee a'rinthirunthaal sollu.
athin aathaarangka'l ethinmeal poadappattathu? athin koadikkallai vaiththavar yaar?
appozhuthu vidiya'rkaalaththu nadchaththirangka'l eakamaayp paadi, theavapuththirar ellaarum kempeeriththaarka'lea.
karppaththilirunthu uthikki'rathupoal samuththiram pura'nduvanthapoathu, athaik kathavuka'laal adaiththavar yaar?
meakaththai atha'rku vasthiramaakavum, iru'lai atha'rkup pudavaiyaakavum naan uduththinapoathum,
naan atha'rku ellaiyaik ku'riththu, atha'rkuth thaazhppaa'lka'laiyum kathavuka'laiyum poattu:
immattum vaa, mignchi varaathea; un alaika'lin perumai ingkea adangkakkadavathu en'ru naan solluki'rapoathum nee engkeayirunthaay?
thushdarka'l poomiyilirunthu utha'rippoadappadumpadikku, athin kadaiyaantharangka'laip pidikkumporuttu,
un jeevakaalaththil eppoathaavathu nee vidiya'rkaalaththukkuk katta'laikoduththu, aru'noathayaththukku athin idaththaik kaa'npiththathu'ndoa?
poomi muththiraiyidappatta ka'lima'npoal vea'rea roopangko'l'lum; sakalamum vasthiram thariththirukki'rathupoal kaa'nappadum.
thunmaarkkarin o'li avarka'lai vittu edupadum; meattimaiyaana puyam mu'rikkappadum.
nee samuththiraththin adiththalangka'lmattum pukunthu, aazhaththin adiyil ulaavinathu'ndoa?
mara'navaasalka'l unakkuth thi'ranthathu'ndoa? mara'na iru'lin vaasalka'lai nee paarththathu'ndoa?
nee poomiyin visaalangka'lai aaraaynthu a'rinthathu'ndoa? ivaika'laiyellaam nee a'rinthirunthaal sollu.
ve'lichcham vaasamaayirukkum idaththukku vazhiyengkea? iru'l kudiko'ndirukkum sthaanamengkea?
athin ellai innathen'ru unakkuth theriyumoa? athin veettukkuppoaki'ra paathaiyai a'rinthirukki'raayoa?
nee athai a'riyumpadi appoathu pi'ranthirunthaayoa? un naadka'lin thokai avva'lavu perithoa?
u'raintha mazhaiyin pa'ndasaalaika'lukku'l nee piraveasiththaayoa? kalmazhaiyirukki'ra pa'ndasaalaika'laip paarththaayoa?
aapaththu varungkaalaththilum, kalakamum yuththamum varungkaalaththilum, pirayoakikkumpadi naan avaika'lai vaiththuvaiththirukki'rean.
ve'lichcham paravappaduki'ratha'rkum, keezhkkaat'ru poomiyinmeal veesuki'ratha'rkumaana vazhi engkea?
paazhum antharave'liyumaana tharaiyaith thirupthiyaakki, i'lampoo'nduka'lin mu'laika'lai mu'laikkappa'n'numpadi,
poomiyengkum manushar kudiyillaatha idaththilum, manushasagnchaaramillaatha vanaantharaththilum mazhaiyai varushikkappa'n'ni,
ve'l'laththukku neerkkaalka'laiyum, idimuzhakkangka'loadu varum minnalukku vazhika'laiyum pakuththavar yaar?
mazhaikku oru thakappanu'ndoa? paniththu'lika'lai janippiththavar yaar?
u'raintha tha'n'neer yaarudaiya vayit'rilirunthu pu'rappaduki'rathu? aakaayaththinudaiya u'raintha paniyaip pet'ravar yaar?
jalam kalluruvangko'ndu ma'rainthu, aazhaththin mukam kettiyaay u'rainthirukki'rathea.
a'rumeen nadchaththiraththin sukirtha sampanthaththai nee i'naikkakkoodumoa? allathu mirukaseerishaththin kattuka'lai avizhppaayoa?
iraasika'lai athinathin kaalaththilea varappa'n'nuvaayoa? thuruvachchakkara nadchaththiraththaiyum athaich searntha nadchaththirangka'laiyum vazhinadaththuvaayoa?
vaanaththin niyamangka'lai nee a'rivaayoa? athu poomiyaiyaa'lum aa'lukaiyai nee thittampa'n'nuvaayoa?
earaa'lamaana tha'n'neer unmeal soriyavea'num en'ru un saththaththai meakangka'lpariyantham uyarththuvaayoa?
nee minnalka'lai azhaiththanuppi, avaika'l pu'rappattuvanthu: ithoa, ingkeayirukki'roam en'ru unakkuch sollumpadi seyvaayoa?
anthakkara'nangka'lil gnaanaththai vaiththavar yaar? u'l'laththil puththiyaik koduththavar yaar?
gnaanaththinaalea kodimaasika'lai e'n'nupavar yaar?
thoo'laanathu eakapaa'lamaakavum, ma'nkattika'l on'roadon'ru ottikko'l'lavum, aakaayaththuruththika'lilu'l'la tha'n'neeraip pozhiyappa'n'nuki'ravar yaar?
nee singkaththukku iraiyai veattaiyaadi,
singkakkuttika'l thaangka'l thangkum idangka'lilea kidanthu kepiyilea pathivirukki'rapoathu, avaika'lin aasaiyaith thirupthiyaakkuvaayoa?
kaakkaikkugnchuka'l theavanai noakkik kooppittu, aakaaramillaamal pa'ranthu alaiki'rapoathu, avaika'lukku iraiyaich savathariththuk kodukki'ravar yaar?
varaiyaaduka'l eenungkaalaththai a'rivaayoa? maanka'l kuttipoaduki'rathaik kavaniththaayoa?
avaika'l sinaippattirunthu varuki'ra maathangka'lai nee e'n'ni, avaika'l eenungkaalaththai a'rivaayoa?
avaika'l nonthu kuninthu thangka'l kuttika'laip poattu, thangka'l veathanaika'lai neekkividum.
avaika'lin kuttika'l palaththu, vanaththilea va'larnthu, avaika'la'ndaikkuth thirumpa varaama'rpoayvidum.
kaattukkazhuthaiyaith thannichchaiyaayth thiriyavittavar yaar? anthak kaattukkazhuthaiyin kattuka'lai avizhththavar yaar?
atha'rku naan vanaantharaththai veedaakavum, uvarnilaththai vaasasthalamaakavum koduththean.
athu patta'naththin iraichchalai aladchiyampa'n'ni, oattuki'ravanudaiya kookkuralai mathikki'rathillai.
athu malaika'lilea than meaychchalaik ka'ndupidiththu, sakalavithap pachchaippoo'nduka'laiyum theadiththiriyum.
kaa'ndaamirukam unnidaththil seavikkach sammathikkumoa? athu un munna'naikku munpaaka iraaththangkumoa?
padaichchaalka'lai uzha nee kaa'ndaamirukaththaik kayi'rupoattu earilea poottuvaayoa? athu unakku isainthu parampadikkumoa?
athu athika pelamu'l'lathen'ru nee nampi athinidaththil vealai vaangkuvaayoa?
un thaaniyaththai athu un veettil ko'nduvanthu, un ka'lagnchiyaththil searkkum en'ru nee athai nampuvaayoa?
theekkuruvika'l thangka'l settaika'lai asaivaatti oaduki'ra oattam, naarai than settaika'laalum i'rakuka'laalum pa'rakki'ratha'rkuch samaanamallavoa?
athu than muttaika'laith tharaiyilea ittu, avaika'lai ma'nalilea analu'raikka vaiththuvittuppoay,
kaalaal mithipattu udainthupoam enpathaiyum, kaattumirukangka'l avaika'lai mithiththuvidum enpathaiyum ninaikki'rathillai.
athu than kugnchuka'l thannudaiyathallaathathupoala avaika'laik kaakkaatha kadinaku'namu'l'lathaayirukkum; avaika'lukkaaka atha'rkuk kavalaiyillaathapadiyinaal athu patta varuththam viruthaavaam.
theavan atha'rkup puththiyaik kodaamal, gnaanaththai vilakkivaiththaar.
athu settai viriththu ezhumpumpoathu, kuthiraiyaiyum athinmeal ea'riyirukki'ravanaiyum aladchiyampa'n'num.
kuthiraikku nee veeriyaththaik koduththaayoa? athin tho'ndaiyil kumu'ralai vaiththaayoa?
oru vettukki'liyai mirattuki'rathupoala athai mirattuvaayoa? athinudaiya naasiyin serukku payangkaramaayirukki'rathu.
athu tharaiyilea thaa'ladiththu, than palaththil ka'liththu, aayuthangka'laith thariththavarukku ethiraakap pu'rappadum.
athu kalangkaamalum, pattayaththukkup pinvaangkaamalumirunthu, payappaduthalai aladchiyampa'n'num.
ampa'raaththoo'niyum, minnuki'ra eettiyum, keadakamum athinmeal kalakalakkumpoathu,
karvamum moorkkamungko'ndu tharaiyai vizhungkividuki'rathupoal anumaaniththu, ekkaa'laththin thonikku agnchaamal paayum.
ekkaa'lam thonikkumpoathu athu nikiyen'ru kanaikkum; yuththaththaiyum, padaiththalaivarin aarpparippaiyum, seanaika'lin aaravaaraththaiyum thooraththilirunthu moappam pidikkum.
un puththiyinaalea raajaa'li pa'ranthu, the'rkukku ethiraakath than settaika'lai virikki'rathoa?
un ka'rpanaiyinaalea kazhuku uyarap pa'ranthu, uyaraththilea than koottaik kattumoa?
athu kanmalaiyilum, kanmalaiyin sikaraththilum, ara'naana sthalaththilum thangki vaasampa'n'num.
angkeayirunthu iraiyai noakkum; athin ka'nka'l thooraththilirunthu athaip paarkkum.
athin kugnchuka'l iraththaththai u'rignchum; pi'nam engkeayoa angkea kazhuku searum en'raar.
pinnum karththar yoapukku uththaramaaka:
sarvavallavaroadea vazhakkaadi avarukkup puththi padippikki'ravan yaar? theavanpearil kut'ram pidikki'ravan ivaika'lukku uththaravu sollakkadavan en'raar.
appozhuthu yoapu karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:
ithoa, naan neesan; naan umakku enna ma'ruuththaravu solluvean; en kaiyinaal en vaayaip poththikko'l'luki'rean.
naan ira'ndorutharam peasinean; ini naan pirathiyuththaram kodaamalum peasaamalum iruppean en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar perungkaat'ril irunthu yoapukku uththaravu aru'linaar.
ippoathum purushanaippoala nee araikattikko'l; naan unnaik keadpean; nee enakku uththaravu sollu.
nee en niyaayaththai avamaakkuvaayoa? nee unnai neethimaanaakkikko'l'lumpadikku enmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaayoa?
theavanudaiya puyaththaippoal unakkup puyamu'ndoa? avaraippoal idimuzhakkamaaych saththamidakkoodumoa?
ippoathum nee mukkiyaththaalum makaththuvaththaalum unnai alangkariththu, makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum thariththukko'ndu,
nee un koapaththin ukkiraththai veesi, akanthaiyu'l'lavanaiyellaam theadippaarththuth thaazhththivittu,
perumaiyu'l'lavanaiyellaam kavaniththu, avanaip pa'niyappa'n'ni, thunmaarkkarai avarka'lirukki'ra sthalaththilea mithiththuvidu.
nee avarka'lai eakamaayp puzhuthiyilea puthaiththu, avarka'l mukangka'lai antharangkaththilea kattippoadu.
appozhuthu un valathukai unakku iradchippu u'ndupa'n'num en'ru solli, naan unnaip pukazhuvean.
ippoathum pikemoaththai nee kavaniththuppaar; unnai u'ndaakkinathupoala athaiyum u'ndaakkinean; athu maattaippoal pullaith thinnum.
ithoa, athinudaiya pelan athin iduppilum, athin veeriyam athin vayit'rin narampuka'lilum irukki'rathu.
athu than vaalaik keathurumaraththaippoal neettuki'rathu; athin iduppu narampuka'l pinnikko'ndirukki'rathu.
athin elumpuka'l kettiyaana ve'nkalaththaippoalavum, athin asthika'l iruppuk kampika'laippoalavum irukki'rathu.
athu theavanudaiya kiriyaika'lil pirathaanamaana oru kiriyai, athai u'ndaakkinavar atha'rku oru pattayaththaiyum koduththaar.
kaattumirukangka'l yaavum vi'laiyaaduki'ra malaika'l atha'rku meaychchalai vi'laivikkum.
athu nizhalu'l'la sedika'lin keezhum, naa'nalin ma'raivilum, u'laiyilum paduththukko'l'lum.
thazhaika'lin nizhal athaik kavinthu, nathiyin alarika'l athaich soozhnthuko'l'lum.
ithoa, nathi pura'nduvanthaalum athu payanthoadaathu; yoarthaan nathiyaththanai tha'n'neer athin mukaththil moathinaalum athu asaiyaamalirukkum.
athin ka'nka'l paarththirukka athai yaar pidikkakkoodum? mookka'naangkayi'rupoada athin mookkai yaar kuththakkoodum?
liviyaathaanai thoo'ndilinaal pidikkakkoodumoa? athin naakkai nee viduki'ra kayit'rinaalea pidikkakkoodumoa?
athin mookkai naarkkayi'rupoattuk kattakkoodumoa? ku'rattinaal athin thaadaiyai uruvak kuththakkoodumoa?
athu unnaip paarththu aneaka vi'n'nappagn seyyumoa? unnai noakki ichchakavaarththaika'laich sollumoa?
athu unnoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'numoa? athaich sathaakaalamum adimaiko'lvaayoa?
oru kuruviyoadea vi'laiyaaduki'rathupoal, nee athanoadea vi'laiyaadi, athai nee un pe'nmakka'la'ndaiyilea kattivaippaayoa?
koottaa'lika'l athaip pidikkap pirayaththanappattu, athai viyaapaarika'lukkup pangkiduvaarka'loa?
nee athin thoalai aneaka ampuka'linaalum, athin thalaiyai e'rivallaiyangka'linaalum e'rivaayoa?
athinmeal un kaiyaippoadu, yuththaththai ninaiththukko'l; ini appadich seyyath thu'niyamaattaay.
ithoa, athaip pidikkalaam en'ru nampinavan moasampoay, athaip paarththavudanea vizhuvaan allavoa?
athai ezhuppaththakka thairiyavaan illaathirukka, enakku munpaaka ni'rpavan yaar?
thanakkup pathilkodukkappadumpadi, munthi enakkuk koduththavan yaar? vaanaththin keezhu'l'lavaika'l ellaam ennudaiyavaika'l.
athin angkangka'lum, athin veeriyamum, athin udal isaivin nearththiyum innathen'ru naan sollaamal ma'raikkamaattean.
athu moodiyirukki'ra athin poarvaiyaik ki'lappakkoodiyavan yaar? athin ira'ndu thaadaika'lin naduvea kadivaa'lam poadaththakkavan yaar?
athin mukaththin kathavaith thi'rakkakkoodiyavan yaar? sut'rilumirukki'ra athin pa'rka'l payangkaramaanavaika'l.
muththiraip pathippuppoala azhuththangko'ndu adarththiyaayirukki'ra athin parisaika'lin ara'nippu makaa si'rappaayirukki'rathu.
avaika'l naduvea kaat'rum pukamaattaatha nerukkamaay avaika'l on'roadon'ru i'naikkappattirukki'rathu.
avaika'l on'roadon'ru ottikko'ndu i'naipiriyaamal pidiththukko'ndirukki'rathu.
athu thummukaiyil o'li veesum, athin ka'nka'l aru'noathayaththin puruvangka'laippoal irukki'rathu.
athin vaayilirunthu eriki'ra panthangka'l pu'rappattu, akkinippo'rika'l pa'rakkum.
kothikki'ra sattiyilum kopparaiyilum irunthu pu'rappaduki'rathupoala, athin naasika'lilirunthu pukai pu'rappadum.
athin suvaasam karika'laik ko'luththum, athin vaayilirunthu juvaalai pu'rappadum.
athin kazhuththilea pelan kudiko'ndirukkum; payangkaram atha'rkumun kooththaadum.
athin uda'rkoo'ruka'l, asaiyaatha kettiyaay on'roadon'ru ottikko'ndirukkum.
athin negnchu kallaippoalavum, eanthiraththin adikkallaippoalavum kettiyaayirukkum.
athu ezhumpumpoathu palasaalika'l agnchi payaththinaal mayangkith thikaippaarka'l.
athaith thaakkuki'ravanudaiya pattayam, eetti, vallaiyam, kavasam, on'rum atha'rkumun ni'rkaathu.
athu irumpai vaikkoalaakavum, ve'nkalaththai u'luththa maramaakavum e'n'num.
ampu athaith thuraththaathu; kava'nka'rka'l atha'rkuth thurumpaakum.
athu perunthadika'laith thaa'ladika'laaka e'n'ni, eettiyin asaivai ikazhum.
athin keezhaakak koormaiyaana ka'rka'l kidanthaalum, athu seat'rinmeal oaduki'rathupoalak karukkaana avaika'linmealum oadum.
athu aazhaththai ulaippaanaiyaippoal pongkappa'n'ni, kadalaith thailampoalak kalakkividum.
athu thanakkup pinnaakap paathaiyaith thulangkappa'n'num; aazhamaanathu ve'luppaana naraiyaippoal vi'langkum.
poomiyinmeal atha'rku oppaanathu on'rumillai; athu nirppayamaayirukka u'ndupa'n'nappattathu.
athu meattimaiyaanathaiyellaam a'rpamaay e'n'nuki'rathu; athu akangkaaramu'l'la jeevanka'lukkellaam raajaavaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
appozhuthu yoapu karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:
theavareer sakalaththaiyum seyya vallavar; neer seyya ninaiththathu thadaipadaathu enpathai a'rinthirukki'rean.
a'rivillaamal aaloasanaiyai ma'raikki'ra ivan yaar? aakaiyaal naan enakkuth theriyaathathaiyum, en puththikku ettaathathaiyum, naan a'riyaathathaiyum alappinean enki'rean.
neer enakkuch sevikodum, appozhuthu naan peasuvean; naan ummaik kea'lvikeadpean, neer enakku uththaravu sollum.
en kaathinaal ummaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattean; ippozhuthoa en ka'n ummaik kaa'nki'rathu.
aakaiyaal naan ennai aruvaruththu, thoo'lilum saampalilum irunthu manasthaapappaduki'rean en'raan.

karththar intha vaarththaika'lai yoapoadea peasinapin, karththar theamaaniyanaana elippaasai noakki: unmealum un ira'ndu sineakitharmealum enakkuk koapam moo'luki'rathu; en thaasanaakiya yoapu peasinathupoal, neengka'l ennaikku'riththu nithaanamaayp peasavillai.

aathalaal neengka'l eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum, eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum therinthuko'ndu, en thaasanaakiya yoapinidaththil poay, ungka'lukkaakach sarvaangka thakanapalika'lai idungka'l; en thaasanaakiya yoapum ungka'lukkaaka vea'nduthal seyvaan; naan avan mukaththaip paarththu, ungka'lai ungka'l puththiyeenaththukkuth thakkathaaka nadaththaathiruppean; en thaasanaakiya yoapu peasinathupoal, neengka'l ennaikku'riththu nithaanamaayp peasavillai en'raar.

appozhuthu theamaaniyanaana elippaasum sookiyanaana pilthaathum naakamaaththiyanaana soappaarum poay, karththar thangka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea seythaarka'l; appozhuthu karththar yoapin mukaththaip paarththaar.

yoapu than sineakitharukkaaka vea'nduthal seythapoathu, karththar avan si'raiyiruppai maat'rinaar. yoapukku mun iruntha ellaavat'raippaarkkilum ira'ndaththanaiyaayk karththar avanukkuth thantharu'linaar.

appozhuthu avanudaiya ellaach sakoathararum sakoatharika'lum, mun avanukku a'rimukamaana anaivarum avanidaththil vanthu, avan veettilea avanoadea poajanampa'n'ni, karththar avanmeal varappa'n'nina sakala theengkinimiththam avanukkaaka angkalaayththu, avanukku aa'ruthal solli, avaravar ovvoru thangkakkaasaiyum, avaravar ovvoru pon aapara'naththaiyum avanukkuk koduththaarka'l.

karththar yoapin munnilaimaiyaip paarkkilum avan pinnilaimaiyai aaseervathiththaar; pathinaalaayiram aaduka'lum, aa'raayiram ottakangka'lum, aayiram earka'lum, aayiram kazhuthaika'lum avanukku u'ndaayina.
eazhu kumaararum, moon'ru kumaaraththika'lum avanukkup pi'ranthaarka'l.
mooththa maka'lukku emeemaa'l en'rum, ira'ndaam maka'lukkuk kethseeyaa'l en'rum, moon'raam maka'lukkuk keareanaappuk en'rum pearittaan.
theasaththil engkum yoapin kumaaraththika'laippoal saunthariyamaana pe'nka'l kaa'nappadavillai; avarka'l thakappan avarka'l sakoathararin naduvilea avarka'lukkuch suthantharam koduththaan.
itha'rkuppinpu yoapu noot'runaa'rpathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, naalu thalaimu'raiyaakath than pi'l'laika'laiyum than pi'l'laika'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laiyum ka'ndaan.
yoapu nedunaa'lirunthu, poora'na vayathu'l'lavanaay mariththaan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya aaloasanaiyil nadavaamalum, paavika'ludaiya vazhiyil nillaamalum, pariyaasakkaarar udkaarum idaththil udkaaraamalum,
karththarudaiya veathaththil piriyamaayirunthu, iravum pakalum avarudaiya veathaththil thiyaanamaayirukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
avan neerkkaalka'lin oaramaay nadappattu, than kaalaththil than kaniyaith thanthu, ilaiyuthiraathirukki'ra maraththaippoaliruppaan; avan seyvathellaam vaaykkum.
thunmaarkkaroa appadiyiraamal, kaat'rup pa'rakkadikkum patharaippoal irukki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal thunmaarkkar niyaayaththeerppilum, paavika'l neethimaanka'lin sapaiyilum nilaini'rpathillai.
karththar neethimaanka'lin vazhiyai a'rinthirukki'raar; thunmaarkkarin vazhiyoa azhiyum.
jaathika'l kontha'liththu, janangka'l viruthaakkaariyaththaich sinthippaanean?
karththarukku viroathamaakavum, avar apisheakampa'n'ninavarukku viroathamaakavum, poomiyin raajaakka'l ezhumpinin'ru, athikaarika'l eakamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ni:
avarka'l kattuka'lai a'ruththu, avarka'l kayi'ruka'lai nammaivittu e'rinthupoaduvoam enki'raarka'l.
paraloakaththil veet'rirukki'ravar nakaippaar; aa'ndavar avarka'lai ikazhuvaar.
appozhuthu avar thamathu koapaththilea avarka'loadea peasi, thamathu ukkiraththilea avarka'laik kalangkappa'n'nuvaar.
naan ennudaiya parisuththa parvathamaakiya seeyoanmeethil ennudaiya raajaavai apisheakampa'n'ni vaiththean en'raar.
theermaanaththin vivaram solluvean; karththar ennai noakki: neer ennudaiya kumaaran, in'ru naan ummai jenippiththean;
ennaik kea'lum, appozhuthu jaathika'lai umakkuch suthantharamaakavum, poomiyin ellaika'lai umakkuch sonthamaakavum koduppean;
iruppukkoalaal avarka'lai no'rukki, kuyakkalaththaippoal avarka'lai udaiththuppoaduveer en'ru sonnaar.
ippoathum raajaakka'lea, u'narvadaiyungka'l, poomiyin niyaayaathipathika'lea, echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
payaththudanea karththaraich seaviyungka'l, nadukkaththudanea ka'likoorungka'l.

kumaaran koapangko'l'laamalum, neengka'l vazhiyilea azhiyaamalum irukkumpadikku, avarai muththagn seyyungka'l; kognchakkaalaththilea avarudaiya koapam pat'riyeriyum; avarai a'ndikko'l'luki'ra yaavarum paakkiyavaanka'l.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'l evva'lavaayp perukiyirukki'raarka'l! enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'l aneakar.
theavanidaththil avanukku iradchippu illaiyen'ru, en aaththumaavaik ku'riththuch solluki'ravarka'l aneakaraayirukki'raarka'l. (sealaa.)
aanaalum karththaavea, neer en keadakamum, en makimaiyum, en thalaiyai uyarththuki'ravarumaayirukki'reer.
naan karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kooppittean; avar thamathu parisuththa parvathaththilirunthu enakkuch sevikoduththaar. (sealaa.)
naan paduththu niththirai seythean; vizhiththukko'ndean; karththar ennaith thaangkuki'raar.
enakku viroathamaakach sut'rilum padaiyeduththu varuki'ra pathinaayirampearukkum naan payappadean.
karththaavea, ezhuntharu'lum; en theavanea, ennai iradchiyum. neer en pakaignar ellaaraiyum thaadaiyilea adiththu, thunmaarkkarudaiya pa'rka'laith thakarththuppoatteer.
iradchippu karththarudaiyathu; theavareerudaiya aaseervaatham ummudaiya janaththinmeal iruppathaaka. (sealaa.)
en neethiyin theavanea, naan kooppidukaiyil enakkuch sevikodum; nerukkaththil iruntha enakku visaalamu'ndaakkineer; enakku irangki, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum.
manupuththirarea, ethuvaraikkum en makimaiyai avamaanappaduththi, vee'naanathai virumpi, poyyai naaduveerka'l. (sealaa.)
pakthiyu'l'lavanaik karththar thamakkaakath therinthuko'ndaaren'ru a'riyungka'l; naan karththarai noakkik kooppidukaiyil avar keadpaar.
neengka'l koapangko'ndaalum, paavagnseyyaathirungka'l; ungka'l padukkaiyilea ungka'l iruthayaththil peasikko'ndu amarnthirungka'l. (sealaa.)
neethiyin palika'laich seluththi, karththarmeal nampikkaiyaayirungka'l.
engka'lukku nanmai kaa'npippavan yaar en'ru solluki'ravarka'l aneakar; karththaavea, ummudaiya mukaththin o'liyai engka'lmeal pirakaasikkappa'n'num.
avarka'lukkuth thaaniyamum thiraadcharasamum perukiyirukki'rakaalaththin santhoashaththaippaarkkilum, athika santhoashaththai en iruthayaththil thantheer.
samaathaanaththoadea paduththukko'ndu niththiraiseyvean; karththaavea, neer oruvarea ennaich sukamaayth thangkappa'n'nuki'reer.
karththaavea, en vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodum, en thiyaanaththaik kavaniyum.
naan ummidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean; en raajaavea, en theavanea, en vea'nduthalin saththaththaik keattaru'lum.
karththaavea, kaalaiyilea en saththaththaik keattaru'luveer; kaalaiyilea umakku nearea vanthu aayaththamaaki, kaaththiruppean.
neer thunmaarkkaththil piriyappaduki'ra theavan alla; theemai ummidaththil searvathillai.
veempukkaarar ummudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka nilaini'rkamaattaarka'l; akkiramakkaarar yaavaraiyum ve'rukki'reer.
poy peasuki'ravarka'lai azhippeer; iraththappiriyanaiyum soothu'l'la manushanaiyum karththar aruvarukki'raar.
naanoa umathu mikuntha kirupaiyinaalea umathu aalayaththukku'l piraveasiththu, umathu parisuththa sannithikku nearea payapakthiyudan pa'ninthuko'l'luvean.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'linimiththam ennai ummudaiya neethiyilea nadaththi, enakkumunpaaka ummudaiya vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththum.
avarka'l vaayil u'nmai illai, avarka'l u'l'lam keadupaadu'l'lathu; avarka'l tho'ndai thi'rakkappatta pireathakkuzhi; thangka'l naavinaal ichchakam peasuki'raarka'l.

theavanea, avarka'laik kut'ravaa'lika'laakath theerum; avarka'l thangka'l aaloasanaika'laaleayea vizhumpadi seyyum; avarka'l thuroakangka'linudaiya thiradchiyinimiththam avarka'laith tha'l'lividum; umakku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ninaarka'lea.
