ummai nampuki'ravarka'l yaavarum santhoashiththu, ennaa'lum kempeerippaarka'laaka; neer avarka'laik kaappaat'ruveer; ummudaiya naamaththai neasikki'ravarka'l ummil ka'likooruvaarka'laaka.
karththaavea, neer neethimaanai aaseervathiththu, kaaru'niyam ennung keadakaththinaal avanaich soozhnthuko'l'luveer.
karththaavea, ummudaiya koapaththilea ennaik kadinthuko'l'laatheayum, ummudaiya ukkiraththilea ennaith tha'ndiyaatheayum.
enmeal irakkamaayirum karththaavea, naan pelanat'ruppoanean; ennaik ku'namaakkum karththaavea, en elumpuka'l nadungkuki'rathu.
en aaththumaa mikavum viyaakulappaduki'rathu; karththaavea, ethuvaraikkum irangkaathiruppeer.
thirumpum karththaavea, en aaththumaavai viduviyum; ummudaiya kirupaiyinimiththam ennai iradchiyum.
mara'naththil ummai ninaivukoorvathillai, paathaa'laththil ummaith thuthippavan yaar?
en perumoochchinaal i'laiththuppoanean; iraamuzhuvathum en ka'n'neeraal en padukkaiyai mikavum eeramaakki, en kattilai nanaikki'rean.
thuyaraththinaal en ka'n kuzhi vizhunthupoayit'ru, en saththurukka'l anaivar nimiththamum mangkippoayit'ru.
akkiramakkaararea, neengka'l ellaarum ennaivittu akan'rupoangka'l; karththar en azhukaiyin saththaththaik keattaar.
karththar en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaar; karththar en jepaththai eat'rukko'l'luvaar.
en pakaignar ellaarum vedki mikavum kalangkippoavaarka'l; avarka'l pinnaakath thirumpich sadithiyilea vedkappaduvaarka'l.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummai nampiyirukki'rean; ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'l ellaarukkum ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
saththuru singkampoal en aaththumaavaip pidiththukko'ndupoay, viduvikki'ravan illaamaiyaal, athaippee'raathapadikku ennaith thappuviyum.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, naan ithaich seythathum, en kaika'lil niyaayakkeadirukki'rathum,
ennoadea samaathaanamaayirunthavanukku naan theemaiseythathum, kaara'namillaamal enakkuch saththuruvaanavanai naan ko'l'laiyittathum u'ndaanaal,
pakaignan en aaththumaavaith thodarnthupidiththu, en piraa'nanaith tharaiyilea tha'l'li mithiththu, en makimaiyaith thoo'lilea thaazhththakkadavan. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, neer ummudaiya koapaththil ezhunthirunthu, en saththurukka'ludaiya moorkkangka'linimiththam ummai uyarththi, enakkaaka vizhiththukko'l'lum; niyaayaththeerppai niyamiththirukki'reerea.
janakkoottam ummaich soozhnthuko'l'lum; avarka'lukkaakath thirumpavum unnathaththi'rku ezhuntharu'lum.
karththar janangka'lukku niyaayagn seyvaar; karththaavea, en neethiyinpadiyum ennilu'l'la u'nmaiyinpadiyum enakku niyaayagnseyyum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya pollaangkai ozhiyappa'n'num; neethimaanai sthirappaduththuveeraaka; neethiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'ra theavareer iruthayangka'laiyum u'l'linthiriyangka'laiyum soathiththa'riki'ravar.
semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lai iradchikki'ra theavanidaththil en keadakam irukki'rathu.
theavan neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathipathi; avar naa'lthoa'rum paaviyinmeal sinangko'l'luki'ra theavan.
avan mananthirumpaavittaal avar thammudaiya pattayaththaik karukkaakkuvaar; avar thammudaiya villai naa'neat'ri, athai aayaththappaduththiyirukki'raar.
avanukku mara'naayuthangka'lai aayaththampa'n'ninaar; thammudaiya ampuka'lai akkini ampuka'laakkinaar.
ithoa, avan akkiramaththaip pe'rak karppaveathanaippaduki'raan; theevinaiyaik karppanthariththu, poyyaip pe'ruki'raan.
kuzhiyai vetti, athai aazhamaakkinaan; thaan vettina kuzhiyil thaanea vizhunthaan.
avan theevinai avan sirasinmeal thirumpum, avan kodumai avan uchchanthalaiyinmeal i'rangkum.
naan karththarai avarudaiya neethiyinpadi thuthiththu, unnathamaana karththarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
engka'l aa'ndavaraakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam poomiyengkum evva'lavu meanmaiyu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu! ummudaiya makaththuvaththai vaanangka'lukku mealaaka vaiththeer.
pakaignanaiyum pazhikaaranaiyum adakkippoada, theavareer ummudaiya saththurukka'linimiththam kuzhanthaika'l paalakar vaayinaal pelan u'ndupa'n'nineer.
umathu viralka'lin kiriyaiyaakiya ummudaiya vaanangka'laiyum, neer sthaapiththa santhiranaiyum nadchaththirangka'laiyum naan paarkkumpoathu,
manushanai neer ninaikki'ratha'rkum, manushakumaaranai neer visaarikki'ratha'rkum avan emmaaththiram enki'rean.
neer avanaith theavathootharilum sat'ru si'riyavanaakkineer; makimaiyinaalum kanaththinaalum avanai mudisoottineer.
ummudaiya karaththin kiriyaika'linmeal neer avanukku aa'lukai thanthu, sakalaththaiyum avanudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththineer.
aadumaaduka'lellaavat'raiyum, kaattumirukangka'laiyum,
aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum, samuththiraththu machchangka'laiyum, kadalka'lil sagncharikki'ravaika'laiyum avanudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththineer.
engka'l aa'ndavaraakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam poomiyengkum evva'lavu meanmaiyu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu!
karththaavea, en muzhu iruthayaththoadum ummaith thuthippean; ummudaiya athisayangka'laiyellaam vivarippean.
ummil makizhnthu ka'likooruvean; unnathamaanavarea, umathu naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
en saththurukka'l pinnaakath thirumpumpoathu, umathu samukaththil avarka'l ida'ru'ndu azhinthupoavaarka'l.
neer en niyaayaththaiyum en vazhakkaiyum theerththu, neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathipathiyaay singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'reer.
jaathika'laik kadinthuko'ndu, thunmaarkkarai azhiththu, avarka'l naamaththai en'ren'raikkum illaathapadi kulaiththuppoatteer.
saththurukka'l en'ren'raikkum paazhaakkappattaarka'l; avarka'l patta'nangka'lai nirmoolamaakkineer; avarka'l pearum avarka'loadeakooda ozhinthupoayit'ru.
karththaroa en'ren'raikkum iruppaar; thammudaiya singkaasanaththai niyaayaththeerppukku aayaththampa'n'ninaar.
avar poochchakkaraththai neethiyaay niyaayantheerththu, sakala janangka'lukkum semmaiyaay neethiseyvaar.
si'rumaippattavanukkuk karththar adaikkalamaanavar; nerukkappaduki'ra kaalangka'lil avarea thagnchamaanavar.
karththaavea, ummaith theaduki'ravarka'lai neer kaividuki'rathillai; aathalaal, umathu naamaththai a'rinthavarka'l ummai nampiyiruppaarka'l.
seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'ra karththaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avar seykaika'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea a'riviyungka'l.
iraththappazhika'laikku'riththu avar visaara'nai seyyumpoathu, avaika'lai ninaikki'raar; si'rumaippattavarka'ludaiya kooppiduthalai ma'ravaar.
mara'navaasalka'lilirunthu ennaith thookkividuki'ra karththaavea, naan ummudaiya thuthika'laiyellaam seeyoan kumaaraththiyin vaasalka'lil vivariththu, ummudaiya iradchippinaal ka'likoorumpadikku,
theavareer enakku irangki, ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'laal enakku varum thunpaththai noakkippaarum.
jaathika'l thaangka'l vettina kuzhiyil thaangka'lea vizhunthaarka'l; avarka'l ma'raivaay vaiththa valaiyil avarka'ludaiya kaalea akappattukko'ndathu.
karththar thaam seytha niyaayaththinaal a'riyappaduki'raar; thunmaarkkan than kaika'lin seykaiyilea sikkikko'ndaan. (ikaayoan, sealaa.)
thunmaarkkarum, theavanai ma'rakki'ra ellaa jaathika'lum, narakaththilea tha'l'lappaduvaarka'l.
e'liyavan en'raikkum ma'rakkappaduvathillai; si'rumaippattavarka'ludaiya nampikkai orupoathum kettuppoavathillai.
ezhuntharu'lum karththaavea, manushan pelanko'l'laathapadi seyyum; jaathika'l ummudaiya samukaththil niyaayantheerkkappadakkadavarka'l.
jaathika'l thangka'lai manusharen'ru a'riyumpadikku, avarka'lukkup payamu'ndaakkum, karththaavea. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, ean thooraththil ni'rki'reer? aapaththu neariduki'ra samayangka'lil neer ean ma'rainthirukki'reer?
thunmaarkkan than perumaiyinaal si'rumaippattavanaik kadooramaayth thunpappaduththuki'raan; avarka'l ninaiththa sathimoasangka'lil avarka'lea akappaduvaarka'l.
thunmaarkkan than u'l'lam ichchiththathaip pet'rathinaal perumaipaaraatti, poru'lai apakariththuth thannaiththaan poat'ri, karththarai asattaipa'n'nuki'raan.
thunmaarkkan than karvaththinaal theavanaith theadaan; avan ninaivuka'lellaam theavan illaiyenpathea.
avan vazhika'l eppoathum keadu'l'lavaika'l; ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l avan paarvaikku ettaamal mikavum uyaramaayirukki'rathu; than ethiraa'lika'lellaarmealum see'ruki'raan.
naan asaikkappaduvathillai, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum theengku ennai a'nukuvathillaiyen'ru than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'luki'raan.
avan vaay sapippinaalum kapadaththinaalum kodumaiyinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avan naavinkeezh theevinaiyum akkiramamum u'ndu.
kiraamangka'lin o'lippidangka'lilea pathivirunthu, ma'raividangka'lilea kut'ramat'ravanaik kolluki'raan; thikkat'ravarka'laip pidikka avan ka'nka'l noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu.
than kepiyilirukki'ra singkaththaippoala ma'raivil pathivirukki'raan; eazhaiyaip pidikkap pathivirunthu, eazhaiyaith than valaikku'l izhuththup pidiththukko'l'luki'raan.
thikkat'ravarka'l than palavaanka'l kaiyil vizhumpadi avan pathungkikkidakki'raan.
theavan athai ma'ranthaar en'rum, avar thammudaiya mukaththai ma'raiththu, orukkaalum athaik kaa'namaattaar en'rum, than iruthayaththilea sollikko'l'luki'raan.
karththaavea, ezhuntharu'lum; theavanea, ummudaiya kaiyai uyarththum; eazhaika'lai ma'ravaatheayum.
thunmaarkkan theavanai asattaipa'n'ni: neer keattu visaarippathillai en'ru than iruthayaththil sollikko'lvaanean?

athaip paarththirukki'reerea! upaththiravaththaiyum kuroathaththaiyum kavaniththirukki'reerea; neer pathila'lippeer; eazhaiyaanavan thannai umakku oppuvikki'raan; thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lukkuch sakaayar neerea.
thunmaarkkanum pollaathavanumaayirukki'ravanudaiya puyaththai mu'riththuvidum; avanudaiya aakaamiyam kaa'naama'rpoakumattum athaith theadi visaariyum.
karththar sathaakaalangka'lukkum raajaavaayirukki'raar; pu'rajaathiyaar avarudaiya theasaththilirunthu azhinthupoavaarka'l.
karththaavea, si'rumaippattavarka'ludaiya vea'nduthalaik keattirukki'reer; avarka'l iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuveer.
ma'n'naana manushan inip palavanthagnseyyath thodaraathapadikku, theavareer thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lukkum odukkappattavarka'lukkum neethiseyya ummudaiya sevika'laich saayththuk keattaru'luveer.
naan karththarai nampiyirukki'rean; pinnai ean neengka'l en aaththumaavai noakki: padchiyaippoala un malaikkup pa'ranthupoa en'ru solluki'reerka'l.
ithoa, thunmaarkkar villai va'laiththu, semmaiyaana iruthayaththaarmeal anthakaaraththil eyyumpadi thangka'l ampuka'lai naa'nilea thodukki'raarka'l.
asthipaarangka'lum nirmoolamaaki'rathea, neethimaan ennaseyvaan?

karththar thammudaiya parisuththa aalayaththil irukki'raar; karththarudaiya singkaasanam paraloakaththil irukki'rathu; avarudaiya ka'nka'l manupuththiraraip paarkki'rathu; avarudaiya imaika'l avarka'laich soathiththa'riki'rathu.
karththar neethimaanaich soathiththa'riki'raar; thunmaarkkanaiyum kodumaiyil piriyamu'l'lavanaiyum avarudaiya u'l'lam ve'rukki'rathu.
thunmaarkkarmeal ka'n'nika'lai varushikkappa'n'nuvaar; akkiniyum kanthakamum kadungkoadaik kontha'lippum avarka'l kudikkum paaththiraththin pangku.
karththar neethiyu'l'lavar, neethiyinmeal piriyappaduvaar; avarudaiya mukam semmaiyaanavanai noakkiyirukki'rathu.
iradchiyum karththaavea, pakthiyu'l'lavan at'ruppoaki'raan; u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'l manupuththiraril ku'rainthirukki'raarka'l.
avaravar thangka'l thoazharoadea poypeasuki'raarka'l; ichchaka uthaduka'laal irumanathaayp peasuki'raarka'l.
ichchakampeasuki'ra ellaa uthaduka'laiyum, perumaika'laip peasuki'ra naavaiyum karththar a'ruththuppoaduvaar.
avarka'l: engka'l naavuka'laal mea'rko'l'luvoam, engka'l uthaduka'l engka'ludaiyathu; yaar engka'lukku aa'ndavan en'ru solluki'raarka'l.

eazhaika'l paazhaakkappattathinimiththamum, e'liyavarka'l vidum perumoochchinimiththamum, naan ippozhuthu ezhunthu, avanmeal see'ruki'ravarka'lukku avanaik kaaththuch sukamaayirukkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththarudaiya so'rka'l ma'nkukaiyil eazhutharam urukki, pudamidappatta ve'l'likkoppaana suththa so'rka'laayirukki'rathu.
karththaavea, neer avarka'laik kaappaat'ri, avarka'lai en'raikkum inthach santhathikku vilakkik kaaththukko'l'luveer.
manupuththiraril sa'ndaa'lar uyarnthirukkumpoathu, thunmaarkkar engkum sut'riththirivaarka'l.
karththaavea, ethuvaraikkum ennai ma'ranthiruppeer, ethuvaraikkum ummudaiya mukaththai enakku ma'raippeer?
en iruthayaththilea sagnchalaththai niththam niththam vaiththu, ethuvaraikkum en aaththumaavilea aaloasanai pa'n'nikko'ndiruppean? ethuvaraikkum en saththuru enmeal thannai uyarththuvaan?
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer noakkippaarththu, enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum; naan mara'naniththirai adaiyaathapadikku en ka'nka'laith the'livaakkum.
avanai mea'rko'ndean en'ru en pakaignan sollaathapadikkum, naan tha'l'laaduki'rathinaal en saththurukka'l ka'likooraathapadikkum ippadich seytharu'lum.
naan ummudaiya kirupaiyinmeal nampikkaiyaayirukki'rean; ummudaiya iradchippinaal en iruthayam ka'likoorum.
karththar enakku nanmaiseythapadiyaal avaraip paaduvean.
theavan illai en'ru mathikettavan than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'luki'raan. avarka'l thangka'laik keduththu, aruvaruppaana kiriyaika'laich seythuvaruki'raarka'l; nanmaiseyki'ravan oruvanum illai.
theavanaith theaduki'ra u'narvu'l'lavan u'ndoa en'ru paarkka, karththar paraloakaththilirunthu manupuththiraraik ka'n'noakkinaar.
ellaarum vazhivilaki, eakamaayk kettuppoanaarka'l; nanmaiseyki'ravan illai, oruvanaakilum illai.
akkiramakkaararil oruvanukkum a'rivuillaiyoa? appaththaip padchikki'rathupoala, en janaththaip padchikki'raarka'lea; avarka'l karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'luki'rathillai.
angkea avarka'l mikavum payanthaarka'l; theavan neethimaanudaiya santhathiyoadea irukki'raarea.
si'rumaippattavanukkuk karththar adaikkalamaayirukki'raar en'ru solli, neengka'l avanudaiya aaloasanaiyai aladchiyampa'n'nineerka'l.
seeyoanilirunthu isravealukku iradchippu varuvathaaka; karththar thammudaiya janaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, yaakkoapukkuk ka'lippum, isravealukku makizhchchiyum u'ndaakum.
karththaavea, yaar ummudaiya koodaaraththil thangkuvaan? yaar ummudaiya parisuththa parvathaththil vaasampa'n'nuvaan?
uththamanaay nadanthu, neethiyai nadappiththu, manathaarach saththiyaththaip peasuki'ravanthaanea.
avan than naavinaal pu'rangkoo'raamalum, than thoazhanukkuth theengkuseyyaamalum, than ayalaanmeal sollappadum ninthaiyaana peachchai edukkaamalum irukki'raan.
aakaathavan avan paarvaikkuth theezhppaanavan; karththarukkup payanthavarka'laiyoa kanampa'n'nuki'raan; aa'naiyittathil thanakku nashdam vanthaalum thava'raathirukki'raan.
than pa'naththai vattikkukkodaamalum, kut'ramillaathavanukku viroathamaayp parithaanam vaangkaamalum irukki'raan. ippadich seyki'ravan en'ren'raikkum asaikkappaduvathillai.
theavanea, ennaik kaappaat'rum, ummai nampiyirukki'rean.
en negnchamea, nee karththarai noakki: theavareer en aa'ndavaraayirukki'reer, en selvam umakku vea'ndiyathaayiraamal;
poomiyilu'l'la parisuththavaanka'lukkum, naan en muzhup piriyaththaiyum vaiththirukki'ra makaaththumaakka'lukkum, athu vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu en'ru sonnaay.

anniya theavanai naadip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'lukku veathanaika'l perukum; avarka'l seluththuki'ra iraththa paanapalika'lai naan seluththamaattean, avarka'l naamangka'lai en uthaduka'linaal uchcharikkavumaattean.
karththar en suthantharamum en paaththiraththin pangkumaanavar; en suthantharaththai theavareer kaappaat'ruki'reer.
nearththiyaana idangka'lil enakkup pangku kidaiththathu; aam, si'rappaana suthantharam enakku u'ndu.
enakku aaloasanai thantha karththaraith thuthippean; iraakkaalangka'lilum en u'l'linthiriyangka'l ennai u'narththum.
karththarai eppozhuthum enakku munpaaka vaiththirukki'rean; avar en valathupaarisaththil irukki'rapadiyaal naan asaikkappaduvathillai.
aakaiyaal en iruthayam pooriththathu, en makimai ka'likoornthathu; en maamsamum nampikkaiyoadea thangkiyirukkum.
en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththil videer; ummudaiya parisuththavaanai azhivaik kaa'navotteer.
jeevamaarkkaththai enakkuth theriyappaduththuveer; ummudaiya samukaththil paripoora'na aananthamum, ummudaiya valathupaarisaththil niththiya pearinpamum u'ndu.
karththaavea, niyaayaththaik keattaru'lum, en kooppiduthalaik kavaniyum; kapadamillaatha uthaduka'linin'ru pi'rakkum en vi'n'nappaththi'rkuch sevikodum.
ummudaiya sannithiyilirunthu en niyaayam ve'lippaduvathaaka; ummudaiya ka'nka'l niyaayamaanavaika'lai noakkuvathaaka.
neer en iruthayaththaip parisoathiththu, iraakkaalaththil athai visaariththu, ennaip pudamittuppaarththum on'rum kaa'naathirukki'reer; en vaay mee'raathapadikkuth theermaanampa'n'ninean.
manusharin seykaika'laikku'riththu, naan ummudaiya uthaduka'lin vaakkinaalea thushdanudaiya paathaika'lukku vilakkamaay ennaik kaaththuk ko'l'luki'rean.
en kaaladika'l vazhuvaathapadikku, en nadaika'lai umathu vazhika'lil sthirappaduththum.
theavanea, naan ummai noakkik kegnchuki'rean, enakkuch sevikodukki'reer; ennidaththil ummudaiya seviyaich saayththu, en vaarththaiyaik keattaru'lum.
ummai nampuki'ravarka'lai avarka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'linin'ru umathu valathukaraththinaal thappuviththu iradchikki'ravarea! ummudaiya athisayamaana kirupaiyai vi'langkappa'n'num.
ka'nma'niyaippoala ennaik kaaththaru'lum.
ennai odukkuki'ra thunmaarkkarukkum, ennaich soozhnthuko'l'luki'ra en piraa'nappakaignarukkum ma'raivaaka, ummudaiya settaika'lin nizhalilea ennaik kaappaat'rum.
avarka'l ni'nanthunniyirukki'raarka'l, thangka'l vaayinaal veempu peasuki'raarka'l.
naangka'l sellum paathaika'lil ippozhuthu engka'lai va'lainthuko'ndaarka'l; engka'laith tharaiyilea tha'l'lumpadi avarka'l ka'nka'l engka'lai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu.
pee'ruki'ratha'rku aavalu'l'la singkaththukkum, ma'raividangka'lil pathivirukki'ra paalasingkaththukkum oppaayirukki'raarka'l.
karththaavea, neer ezhunthirunthu, avanukku ethirittu, avanai madangkadiyum; karththaavea, en aaththumaavaith thunmaarkkanudaiya kaikku ummudaiya pattayaththinaal thappuviyum.

manusharudaiya kaikkum, immaiyil thangka'l pangkaip pet'rirukki'ra ulakamakka'lin kaikkum ummudaiya karaththinaal ennaith thappuviyum; avarka'l vayit'rai umathu thiraviyaththinaal nirappuki'reer; avarka'l puththirapaakkiyaththinaal thirupthiyadainthu, thangka'lukku meethiyaana poru'laith thangka'l kuzhanthaika'lukku vaikki'raarka'l.
naanoa neethiyil ummudaiya mukaththaith tharisippean; naan vizhikkumpoathu umathu saayalaal thirupthiyaavean.
en pelanaakiya karththaavea, ummil anpukooruvean.
karththar en kanmalaiyum, en koattaiyum, en iradchakarum, en theavanum, naan nampiyirukki'ra en thurukamum, en keadakamum, en iradcha'niyak kompum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaayirukki'raar.
thuthikkup paaththiraraakiya karththarai noakkik kooppiduvean; athanaal en saththurukka'lukku neengkalaaki iradchikkappaduvean.
mara'nakkattuka'l ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu; thurchsanappiravaakam ennaip payappaduththinathu.
paathaa'lakkattuka'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; mara'nakka'n'nika'l enmeal vizhunthathu.

enakku u'ndaana nerukkaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittu, en theavanai noakki apayamittean; thamathu aalayaththilirunthu en saththaththaik keattaar, en kooppiduthal avar sannithiyil poay, avar sevika'lil ea'rit'ru.
appozhuthu poomi asainthu athirnthathu, avar koapangko'ndapadiyaal parvathangka'lin asthipaarangka'l kulungki asainthathu.
avar naasiyilirunthu pukai ezhumpit'ru, avar vaayilirunthu padchikki'ra akkini pu'rappattathu; athanaal thazhal moo'ndathu.
vaanangka'laith thaazhththi i'rangkinaar; avar paathangka'linkeezh kaariru'l irunthathu.
kearupeenmeal ea'ri veakamaaych sen'raar; kaat'rin settaika'laik ko'ndu pa'ranthaar.
iru'laith thamakku ma'raividamaakkinaar; karumpunalka'laiyum, aakaayaththuk kaarmeakangka'laiyum thammaich soozhak koodaaramaakkinaar.
avarudaiya sannithip pirakaasaththinaal avarudaiya meakangka'l pa'ranthu vilakit'ru, kalmazhaiyum neruppuththazhalum vizhunthathu.
karththar vaanangka'lilea kumu'rinaar, unnathamaanavar thamathu saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ninaar; kalmazhaiyum neruppuththazhalum vizhunthathu.
thammudaiya ampuka'lai eythu, avarka'laich sitha'radiththaar; minnalka'laip pirayoakiththu, avarka'laik kalangkappa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu karththaavea, ummudaiya ka'ndithaththinaalum ummudaiya naasiyin suvaasakkaat'rinaalum tha'n'neerka'lin mathakuka'l thi'ravu'ndu, poothalaththin asthipaarangka'l kaa'nappattathu.
uyaraththilirunthu avar kai neetti, ennaip pidiththu, jalappiravaakaththilirukki'ra ennaith thookkivittaar.
ennilum athika palavaanka'laayiruntha en palaththa saththuruvukkum ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'lukkum ennai viduviththaar.
en aapaththunaa'lil enakku ethirittu vanthaarka'l; karththaroa enakku aatharavaayirunthaar.
avar visaalamaana idaththilea ennaik ko'nduvanthu, enmeal piriyamaayirunthapadiyaal, ennaith thappuviththaar.
karththar en neethikkuththakkathaaka enakkup pathila'liththaar; en kaika'lin suththaththi'rkuththakkathaaka enakkuch sarikkattinaar.
karththarudaiya vazhika'laik kaikko'nduvanthean; naan en theavanukkuth thuroakampa'n'ninathillai.
avarudaiya niyaayangka'laiyellaam enakku munpaaka ni'ruththinean; avarudaiya piramaa'nangka'lai naan tha'l'lippoadavillai.
avar munpaaka naan manavu'nmaiyaayirunthu, en thurkku'naththukku ennai vilakkik kaaththukko'ndean.
aakaiyaal karththar en neethikkum, thammudaiya ka'nka'lukku munnirukki'ra en kaika'lin suththaththi'rkum thakkathaaka enakkup palana'liththaar.
thayavu'l'lavanukku neer thayavu'l'lavaraakavum, uththamanukku neer uththamaraakavum;
punithanukku neer punitharaakavum, maa'rupaadu'l'lavanukku neer maa'rupaduki'ravaraakavum thoan'ruveer.
theavareer si'rumaippatta janaththai iradchippeer; meattimaiyaana ka'nka'laith thaazhththuveer.
theavareer en vi'lakkai eat'ruveer; en theavanaakiya karththar en iru'lai ve'lichchamaakkuvaar.
ummaalea naan oru seanaikku'l paaynthupoavean; en theavanaalea oru mathilaith thaa'nduvean.
theavanudaiya vazhi uththamamaanathu; karththarudaiya vasanam pudamidappattathu; thammai nampuki'ra anaivarukkum avar keadakamaayirukki'raar.
karththaraiyallaamal theavan yaar? nammudaiya theavanaiyan'rik kanmalaiyum yaar?
ennaip palaththaal idaikatti, en vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththuki'ravar theavanea.
avar en kaalka'lai maanka'ludaiya kaalka'laippoalaakki, ennudaiya uyarthalangka'lil ennai ni'ruththuki'raar.
ve'nkala villum en puyangka'laal va'laiyumpadi, en kaika'lai yuththaththi'rkup pazhakkuvikki'raar.
ummudaiya iradchippin keadakaththaiyum enakkuth thantheer; ummudaiya valathukaram ennaith thaangkuki'rathu; ummudaiya kaaru'niyam ennaip periyavanaakkum.
en kaalka'l vazhuvaathapadikku, naan nadakki'ra vazhiyai akalamaakkineer.
en saththurukka'laip pinthodarnthu, avarka'laip pidippean; avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumvaraikkum thirumpean.
avarka'l ezhunthirukkamaattaathapadikku, en paathangka'linkeezh vizhaththakkathaaka avarka'lai vettinean.
yuththaththi'rku neer ennaip palaththaal idaikatti, enmeal ezhumpinavarka'lai en keezh madangkappa'n'nineer.
naan en pakaignaraich sangkarikkumpadiyaaka, en saththurukka'lin pidariyai enakku oppukkoduththeer.
avarka'l kooppiduki'raarka'l, avarka'lai iradchippaar oruvarumillai; karththarai noakkik kooppiduki'raarka'l, avarka'lukku avar uththaravu kodukki'rathillai.
naan avarka'laik kaat'rumukaththilea pa'rakki'ra thoo'laaka idiththu, therukka'lilu'l'la seat'raippoal avarka'lai e'rinthupoaduki'rean.
janangka'lin sa'ndaika'lukku neer ennaith thappuviththu, jaathika'lukku ennaith thalaivanaakkuki'reer; naan a'riyaatha janangka'l ennaich seavikki'raarka'l.
avarka'l en saththaththaik keattavudanea enakkuk keezhppadiki'raarka'l; anniyarum enakku ichchakampeasi adangkuki'raarka'l.
anniyar munaivizhunthupoay, thangka'l ara'nka'lilirunthu thaththa'lippaayp pu'rappaduki'raarka'l.
karththar jeevanu'l'lavar; en kanmalaiyaanavar thuthikkappaduvaaraaka; en iradchippin theavan uyarnthiruppaaraaka.
avar enakkaakap pazhikkup pazhivaangki, janangka'lai enakkuk keezhppaduththuki'ra theavanaanavar.
avarea en saththurukka'lukku ennai vilakki viduvikki'ravar; enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lmeal ennai neer uyarththi, kodumaiyaana manushanukku ennaith thappuvikki'reer.
ithinimiththam karththaavea, jaathika'lukku'l'lea ummaith thuthiththu, ummudaiya naamaththi'rkuch sangkeetham paaduvean.
thaam ea'rpaduththina raajaavukku makaththaana iradchippai a'liththu, thaam apisheakampa'n'nina thaaveethukkum avan santhathikkum sathaakaalamum kirupai seyki'raar.
vaanangka'l theavanudaiya makimaiyai ve'lippaduththuki'rathu, aakaayavirivu avarudaiya karangka'lin kiriyaiyai a'rivikki'rathu.
pakalukkup pakal vaarththaika'laip pozhiki'rathu, iravukku iravu a'rivaith therivikki'rathu.
avaika'lukkup peachchumillai, vaarththaiyumillai, avaika'lin saththam keadkappaduvathumillai.
aakilum avaika'lin saththam poomiyengkum, avaika'lin vasanangka'l poochchakkaraththuk kadaisivaraikkum selluki'rathu; avaika'lil sooriyanukku oru koodaaraththai sthaapiththaar.
athu than ma'nava'raiyilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra ma'navaa'lanaippoalirunthu, paraakkiramasaaliyaippoal than paathaiyil oada makizhchchiyaayirukki'rathu.
athu vaanangka'lin oru munaiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, avaika'lin ma'rumunaivaraikkum sut'riyoaduki'rathu; athin kaanthikku ma'raivaanathu on'rumillai.
karththarudaiya veatham ku'raivat'rathum, aaththumaavai uyirppikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya saadchi saththiyamum, peathaiyai gnaaniyaakkuki'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththarudaiya niyaayangka'l semmaiyum, iruthayaththaich santhoashippikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya ka'rpanai thooymaiyum, ka'nka'laith the'livikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththarukkup payappaduki'ra payam suththamum, en'raikkum nilaikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya niyaayangka'l u'nmaiyum, avaika'l anaiththum neethiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaika'l ponnilum, mikuntha pasumponnilum virumpappadaththakkathum, theanilum theankoottilirunthu ozhukum the'litheanilum mathuramu'l'lathumaay irukki'rathu.
an'riyum avaika'laal umathu adiyean echcharikkappaduki'rean; avaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'rathinaal mikuntha palan u'ndu.
than pizhaika'lai u'naruki'ravan yaar? ma'raivaana kut'rangka'lukku ennai neengkalaakkum.
thu'nikaramaana paavangka'lukku umathu adiyeanai vilakkikkaarum, avaika'l ennai aa'nduko'l'la ottaathirum; appozhuthu naan uththamanaaki, perumpaathakaththukku neengkalaayiruppean.
en kanmalaiyum en meedparumaakiya karththaavea, en vaayin vaarththaika'lum, en iruthayaththin thiyaanamum, umathu samukaththil pireethiyaayiruppathaaka.
aapaththunaa'lilea karththar umathu jepaththaik keadpaaraaka; yaakkoapin theavanudaiya naamam umakku uyarntha adaikkalamaavathaaka.
avar parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu umakku oththaasaiyanuppi, seeyoanilirunthu ummai aatharippaaraaka.
neer seluththum kaa'nikkaika'laiyellaam avar ninaiththu, umathu sarvaangka thakanapaliyaip piriyamaay eat'rukko'lvaaraaka. (sealaa.)
avar umathu manaviruppaththinpadi umakkuth thantharu'li, umathu aaloasanaika'laiyellaam ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaka.
naangka'l umathu iradchippinaal makizhnthu, engka'l theavanudaiya naamaththilea kodiyeat'ruvoam; umathu vea'nduthalka'laiyellaam karththar ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaka.

karththar thaam apisheakampa'n'ninavarai iradchikki'raar enpathai ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'rean; thamathu valathukaram seyyum iradchippin vallamaika'laik kaa'npiththu, thamathu parisuththa vaanaththilirunthu avarudaiya jepaththaik keadpaar.
silar irathangka'laikku'riththum, silar kuthiraika'laikku'riththum meanmaipaaraattuki'raarka'l; naangka'loa engka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththaikku'riththea meanmaipaaraattuvoam.
avarka'l mu'rinthu vizhunthaarka'l; naangka'loa ezhunthu nimirnthu ni'rki'roam.
karththaavea, iradchiyum; naangka'l kooppiduki'ra naa'lilea raajaa engka'lukkuch sevikoduppaaraaka.
karththaavea, ummudaiya vallamaiyilea raajaa makizhchchiyaayirukki'raar; ummudaiya iradchippilea evva'lavaayk ka'likooruki'raar!
avarudaiya manaviruppaththinpadi neer avarukkuth thantharu'li, avarudaiya uthaduka'lin vi'n'nappaththaith tha'l'laathirukki'reer. (sealaa.)
uththama aaseervaathangka'loadu neer avarukku ethirko'nduvanthu, avar sirasil po'rkireedam tharippikki'reer.
avar ummidaththil aayusaikkeattaar; neer avarukku en'ren'raikkumu'l'la theerkkaayusai a'liththeer.
umathu iradchippinaal avar makimai perithaayirukki'rathu; meanmaiyaiyum makaththuvaththaiyum avarukku aru'lineer.
avarai niththiya aaseervaathangka'lu'l'lavaraakkuki'reer; avarai ummudaiya samukaththin makizhchchiyinaal poorippaakkuki'reer.
raajaa karththarmeal nampikkaiyaayirukki'raar; unnathamaanavarudaiya thayavinaal asaikkappadaathiruppaar.
umathu kai umathu saththurukka'lellaaraiyum ettippidikkum; umathu valathukaram ummaip pakaikki'ravarka'laik ka'ndupidikkum.
umathu koapaththin kaalaththilea avarka'lai akkinich soo'laiyaakkip poaduveer; karththar thamathu koapaththilea avarka'lai azhippaar; akkini avarka'laip padchikkum.
avarka'l kaniyai poomiyiliraathapadi neer azhiththu, avarka'l santhathiyai manupuththirariliraathapadi ozhiyappa'n'nuveer.
avarka'l umakku viroathamaayp pollaangku ninaiththaarka'l; theevinaiyai eththanampa'n'ninaarka'l; on'rum vaaykkaama'rpoayit'ru.
avarka'lai ilakkaaka vaiththu, ummudaiya ampuka'lai naa'neat'ri avarka'l mukaththi'rku nearea viduki'reer.
karththaavea, ummudaiya palaththilea neer ezhuntharu'lum; appozhuthu ummudaiya vallamaiyaip paadikkeerththanampa'n'nuvoam.
en theavanea, en theavanea, ean ennaik kaivitteer? enakku uthavi seyyaamalum, naan katha'rich sollum vaarththaika'laik kea'laamalum ean thooramaayirukki'reer?
en theavanea, naan pakalilea kooppiduki'rean, uththaravukodeer; iravilea kooppiduki'rean, enakku amaithalillai.
isravealin thuthika'lukku'l vaasamaayirukki'ra theavareerea parisuththar.
engka'l pithaakka'l ummidaththil nampikkaivaiththaarka'l; nampina avarka'lai neer viduviththeer.
ummai noakkik kooppittuth thappinaarka'l; ummai nampi vedkappattuppoakaathirunthaarka'l.
naanoa oru puzhu, manushanalla; manusharaal ninthikkappattum, janangka'laal avamathikkappattum irukki'rean.
ennaip paarkki'ravarka'lellaarum ennaip pariyaasampa'n'ni, uthattaip pithukki, thalaiyaith thulukki:
karththarmeal nampikkaiyaayirunthaanea, avar ivanai viduvikkattum; ivanmeal piriyamaayirukki'raarea, ippozhuthu ivanai meettuvidattum enki'raarka'l.
neerea ennaik karppaththilirunthu eduththavar; en thaayin mulaippaalai naan u'nkaiyil ennai ummudaiyapearil nampikkaiyaayirukkappa'n'nineer.
karppaththilirunthu ve'lippattapoathea umathu saarpil vizhunthean; naan en thaayin vayit'ril irunthathumuthal neer en theavanaayirukki'reer.
ennaivittuth thooramaakaatheayum; aapaththu kittiyirukki'rathu, sakaayarum illai.
aneakam kaa'laika'l ennaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; paasaan theasaththup palaththa eruthuka'l ennai va'lainthuko'ndathu.
pee'ri kerchchikki'ra singkaththaippoal, enmeal thangka'l vaayaith thi'rakki'raarka'l.
tha'n'neeraippoala oot'ru'ndean; en elumpuka'lellaam kattuvittathu, en iruthayam mezhukupoalaaki, en kudalka'lin naduvea urukit'ru.
en pelan oattaippoal kaaynthathu; en naavu mealvaayoadea ottikko'ndathu; ennai mara'naththoo'lilea poaduki'reer.
naayka'l ennaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; pollaathavarka'lin koottam ennai va'lainthuko'ndathu; en kaika'laiyum en kaalka'laiyum uruvak kuththinaarka'l.
en elumpuka'laiyellaam naan e'n'nalaam; avarka'l ennai noakkip paarththukko'ndirukki'raarka'l.
en vasthirangka'laith thangka'lukku'l'lea pangkittu, en udaiyinpearil seettuppoaduki'raarka'l.
aanaalum karththaavea, neer enakkuth thooramaakaatheayum; en pelanea, enakkuch sakaayampa'n'nath theeviriththukko'l'lum.
en aaththumaavaip pattayaththi'rkum, enakku arumaiyaanathai naayka'lin thushdaththanaththi'rkum thappuviyum.
ennaich singkaththin vaayilirunthu iradchiyum; naan kaa'ndaamirukaththin kompuka'lil irukkumpoathu enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lineer.
ummudaiya naamaththai en sakoathararukku a'riviththu, sapainaduvil ummaith thuthippean.

karththarukkup payappaduki'ravarka'lea, avaraith thuthiyungka'l; yaakkoapin santhathiyaarea, neengka'l ellaarum avaraik kanampa'n'nungka'l; isravealin vamsaththaarea, neengka'l ellaarum avarpearil payapakthiyaayirungka'l.

upaththiravappattavanudaiya upaththiravaththai avar a'rpamaaye'n'naamalum aruvarukkaamalum, thammudaiya mukaththai avanukku ma'raikkaamalumirunthu, thammai noakki avan kooppidukaiyil avanaik keattaru'linaar.
makaa sapaiyilea naan ummaith thuthippean; avarukkup payappaduki'ravarka'lukku munpaaka en poruththanaika'laich seluththuvean.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'l pusiththuth thirupthiyadaivaarka'l; karththaraith theaduki'ravarka'l avaraith thuthippaarka'l; ungka'l iruthayam en'ren'raikkum vaazhum.
poomiyin ellaika'lellaam ninaivukoornthu karththaridaththil thirumpum; jaathika'ludaiya santhathika'lellaam umathu samukaththil thozhuthuko'l'lum.
raajyam karththarudaiyathu; avar jaathika'lai aa'luki'ravar.

poomiyin selvavaanka'l yaavarum pusiththup pa'ninthuko'lvaarka'l; puzhuthiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'l yaavarum avarukku munpaaka va'nangkuvaarka'l. oruvanum than aaththumaa azhiyaathapadi athaik kaakkakkoodaathea.
oru santhathi avaraich seavikkum; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka athu aa'ndavarudaiya santhathi ennappadum.
avarka'l vanthu: avarea ivaika'laich seythaar en'ru pi'rakkappoaki'ra janangka'lukku avarudaiya neethiyai a'rivippaarka'l.
karththar en meaypparaayirukki'raar; naan thaazhchchiyadaiyean.
avar ennaip pullu'l'la idangka'lil meayththu, amarntha tha'n'neerka'l a'ndaiyil ennaik ko'ndupoay viduki'raar.
avar en aaththumaavaith theat'ri, thammudaiya naamaththinimiththam ennai neethiyin paathaika'lil nadaththuki'raar.
naan mara'na iru'lin pa'l'laththaakkilea nadanthaalum pollaappukkup payappadean; theavareer ennoadeakooda irukki'reer; umathu koalum umathu thadiyum ennaith theat'rum.
en saththurukka'lukku munpaaka neer enakku oru panthiyai aayaththappaduththi, en thalaiyai e'n'neyaal apisheakampa'n'nuki'reer; en paaththiram nirampi vazhiki'rathu.
en jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam nanmaiyum kirupaiyum ennaith thodarum; naan karththarudaiya veettilea neediththa naadka'laay nilaiththiruppean.
poomiyum athin ni'raivum, ulakamum athilu'l'la kudika'lum karththarudaiyathu.
avarea athaik kadalka'lukku mealaaka asthipaarappaduththi, athai nathika'lukku mealaaka sthaapiththaar.
yaar karththarudaiya parvathaththil ea'ruvaan? yaar avarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil nilaiththiruppaan?
kaika'lil suththamu'l'lavanum iruthayaththil maasillaathavanumaayirunthu, than aaththumaavai maayaikku oppukkodaamalum, kapadaay aa'naiyidaamalum irukki'ravanea.
avan karththaraal aaseervaathaththaiyum, than iradchippin theavanaal neethiyaiyum pe'ruvaan.
ithuvea avaraith theadi visaariththu, avarudaiya samukaththai naaduki'ra yaakkoapu ennum santhathi. (sealaa.)
vaasalka'lea, ungka'l thalaika'lai uyarththungka'l; anaathi kathavuka'lea, uyarungka'l; makimaiyin raajaa udpiraveasippaar.
yaar intha makimaiyin raajaa? avar vallamaiyum paraakkiramamumu'l'la karththar; avar yuththaththil paraakkiramamu'l'la karththaraamea.
vaasalka'lea, ungka'l thalaika'lai uyarththungka'l; anaathi kathavuka'lea, uyarungka'l, makimaiyin raajaa udpiraveasippaar.
yaar intha makimaiyin raajaa? avar seanaika'lin karththaraanavar; avarea makimaiyin raajaa. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththuki'rean.
en theavanea, ummai nampiyirukki'rean, naan vedkappattuppoakaathapadi seyyum; en saththurukka'l ennai mea'rko'ndu makizhavidaatheayum.
ummai noakkik kaaththirukki'ra oruvarum vedkappattup poakaathapadi seyyum; mukaantharamillaamal thuroakampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lea vedkappattup poavaarka'laaka.
karththaavea, ummudaiya vazhika'lai enakkuth theriviyum; ummudaiya paathaika'lai enakkup poathiththaru'lum.
ummudaiya saththiyaththilea ennai nadaththi, ennaip poathiththaru'lum; neerea en iradchippin theavan, ummai noakki naa'lmuzhuthum kaaththirukki'rean.
karththaavea, ummudaiya irakkangka'laiyum ummudaiya kaaru'niyangka'laiyum ninaiththaru'lum, avaika'l anaathikaalamuthal irukki'rathea.
en i'lavayathin paavangka'laiyum en mee'ruthalka'laiyum ninaiyaathirum; karththaavea, ummudaiya thayavinimiththam ennai umathu kirupaiyinpadiyea ninaiththaru'lum.
karththar nallavarum uththamarumaayirukki'raar; aakaiyaal paavika'lukku vazhiyaith therivikki'raar.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'lai niyaayaththilea nadaththi, saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'lukkuth thamathu vazhiyaip poathikki'raar.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaiyaiyum avarudaiya saadchika'laiyum kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku, avarudaiya paathaika'lellaam kirupaiyum saththiyamumaanavaika'l.
karththaavea, en akkiramam perithu; ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam athai manniththaru'lum.
karththarukkup payappaduki'ra manushan evanoa avanukkuth thaam therinthuko'l'lum vazhiyaip poathippaar.
avan aaththumaa nanmaiyil thangkum; avan santhathi poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'lum.
karththarudaiya irakasiyam avarukkup payanthavarka'lidaththil irukki'rathu; avarka'lukkuth thammudaiya udanpadikkaiyaith theriyappaduththuvaar.
en ka'nka'l eppoathum karththarai noakkik ko'ndirukki'rathu; avarea en kaalka'lai valaikku neengkalaakkividuvaar.
enmeal noakkamaaki, enakku irangkum; naan thaniththavanum si'rumaippaduki'ravanumaayirukki'rean.
en iruthayaththin viyaakulangka'l perukiyirukki'rathu; en idukka'nka'lukku ennai neengkalaakkividum.
en thunpaththaiyum en varuththaththaiyum paarththu, en paavangka'laiyellaam manniththaru'lum.
en saththurukka'laip paarum; avarka'l perukiyirunthu, ukkirapakaiyaay ennaip pakaikki'raarka'l.
en aaththumaavaik kaappaat'ri ennai viduviyum; naan vedkappattuppoakaathapadi seyyum; ummai nampiyirukki'rean.
uththamamum nearmaiyum ennaik kaakkakkadavathu; naan umakkuk kaaththirukki'rean.
theavanea, isravealai avanudaiya ellaa ikkattuka'lukkum neengkalaakki meettuvidum.
karththaavea, ennai niyaayam visaariyum, naan en uththamaththilea nadakki'rean; naan karththarai nampiyirukki'rean, aakaiyaal naan tha'l'laaduvathillai.
karththaavea, ennaip pareedchiththu, ennaich soathiththuppaarum; en u'l'linthiriyangka'laiyum en iruthayaththaiyum pudamittuppaarum.
ummudaiya kirupai en ka'nka'lukku munpaaka irukki'rathu; ummudaiya saththiyaththilea nadanthuko'l'luki'rean.
vee'naroadea naan udkaaravillai, vagnchakaridaththil naan searuvathillai.
pollaathavarka'lin koottaththaip pakaikki'rean; thunmaarkkaroadea udkaarean.
karththaavea, naan thuthiyin saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ni, ummudaiya athisayangka'laiyellaam vivarippatha'rkaaka,
naan kut'ramillaamaiyilea en kaika'laik kazhuvi, ummudaiya peedaththaich sut'rivaruki'rean.
karththaavea, umathu aalayamaakiya vaasasthalaththaiyum, umathu makimai thangkiya sthaanaththaiyum vaagnchikki'rean.
en aaththumaavaip paavika'loadum, en jeevanai iraththappiriyaroadungkooda vaarikko'l'laatheayum.
avarka'l kaika'lilea theevinaiyirukki'rathu; avarka'l valathukai parithaanangka'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
naanoa en uththamaththilea nadappean; ennai meettukko'ndu enmeal irakkamaayirum.
en kaal semmaiyaana idaththilea ni'rki'rathu; sapaika'lilea naan karththaraith thuthippean.
karththar en ve'lichchamum en iradchippumaanavar, yaarukkup payappaduvean? karththar en jeevanin pelanaanavar, yaarukku agnchuvean?
en saththurukka'lum en pakaignarumaakiya pollaathavarka'l en maamsaththaip padchikka, ennai nerukkukaiyil avarka'lea ida'rivizhunthaarka'l.
enakku viroathamaaka oru paa'layami'rangkinaalum, en iruthayam payappadaathu; enmeal yuththam ezhumpinaalum, ithilea naan nampikkaiyaayiruppean.

karththaridaththil on'rai naan keattean, athaiyea naaduvean; naan karththarudaiya makimaiyaip paarkkumpadiyaakavum, avarudaiya aalayaththil aaraaychchiseyyumpadiyaakavum, naan en jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam karththarudaiya aalayaththil thangkiyiruppathaiyea naaduvean.
theengkunaa'lil avar ennaith thammudaiya koodaaraththil ma'raiththu, ennaith thamathu koodaara ma'raivilea o'liththuvaiththu, ennaik kanmalaiyinmeal uyarththuvaar.

ippozhuthu en thalai ennaich sut'rilum irukki'ra en saththurukka'lukku mealaaka uyarththappadum; athinimiththam avarudaiya koodaaraththilea naan aanantha palika'laiyittu, karththaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
karththaavea, naan kooppiduki'ra saththaththai neer keattu, enakku irangki, enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
en mukaththaith theadungka'l en'ru sonneerea, ummudaiya mukaththaiyea theaduvean karththaavea, en'ru en iruthayam ummidaththil sollit'ru.

umathu mukaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum; neer koapaththudan umathu adiyeanai vilakkippoadaatheayum; neerea enakkuch sakaayar; en iradchippin theavanea, ennai nekizhavidaamalum ennaik kaividaamalum irum.
en thakappanum en thaayum ennaik kaivittaalum, karththar ennaich searththukko'l'luvaar.
karththaavea, umathu vazhiyai enakkup poathiththu, en ethiraa'lika'linimiththam sevvaiyaana paathaiyil ennai nadaththum.
en saththurukka'lin ishdaththukku ennai oppukkodaatheayum; poychsaadchika'lum aakkiramiththuch see'ruki'ravarka'lum enakku viroathamaay ezhumpiyirukki'raarka'l.
naanoa, jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea karththarudaiya nanmaiyaik kaa'npean en'ru visuvaasiyaathirunthaal kettuppoayiruppean.
karththarukkuk kaaththiru; avar un iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuvaar; thidamanathaayirunthu, karththarukkea kaaththiru.
en kanmalaiyaakiya karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; neer kea'laathavarpoala mavunamaayiraatheayum; neer mavunamaayirunthaal naan kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'lukku oppaavean.
naan ummai noakkich saththamittu, ummudaiya parisuththa sannithikku nearaakak kaiyedukkaiyil, en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththaik keattaru'lum.
ayalaanukkuch samaathaana vaazhththuthalaich solliyum, thangka'l iruthayangka'lil pollaappai vaiththirukki'ra thunmaarkkaroadum akkiramakkaararoadum ennai vaarikko'l'laatheayum.

avarka'ludaiya kiriyaika'lukkum avarka'ludaiya nadaththaika'lin pollaangkukkum thakkathaaka avarka'lukkuch seyyum; avarka'l kaika'lin seykaikkuththakkathaaka avarka'lukku a'liyum, avarka'lukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattum.
avarka'l karththarudaiya seykaika'laiyum avar karaththin kiriyaika'laiyum kavaniyaathapadiyaal, avarka'lai idiththuppoaduvaar, avarka'laik kattamaattaar.
karththarukku sthoaththiram; avar en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththaik keattaar.
karththar en pelanum en keadakamumaayirukki'raar; en iruthayam avarai nampiyirunthathu; naan sakaayam pet'rean; aakaiyaal en iruthayam ka'likooruki'rathu; en paattinaal avaraith thuthippean.
karththar avarka'ludaiya pelan; avarea thaam apisheakampa'n'ninavanukku ara'naana adaikkalamaanavar.
theavareer umathu janaththai iradchiththu, umathu suthantharaththai aaseervathiyum; avarka'laip poashiththu, avarka'lai en'ren'raikkum uyarththiyaru'lum.
palavaanka'lin puththirarea, karththarukku makimaiyaiyum vallamaiyaiyum seluththungka'l; karththarukkea athaich seluththungka'l.
karththarudaiya naamaththi'rkuriya makimaiyai avarukkuch seluththungka'l; parisuththa alangkaaraththudanea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungka'l.
karththarudaiya saththam tha'n'neerka'linmeal thonikki'rathu; makimaiyu'l'la theavan muzhangkuki'raar; karththar thira'laana tha'n'neerka'linmeal irukki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam vallamaiyu'l'lathu; karththarudaiya saththam makaththuvamu'l'lathu.
karththarudaiya saththam keathurumarangka'lai mu'rikki'rathu; karththar leepanoanin keathurumarangka'lai mu'rikki'raar.
avaika'laik kan'rukkuttika'laippoalavum, leepanoanaiyum seeriyoanaiyum kaa'ndaamirukak kuttika'laippoalavum thu'l'lappa'n'nuki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam akkinijuvaalaika'laip pi'lakkum.
karththarudaiya saththam vanaantharaththai athirappa'n'num; karththar kaatheas vanaantharaththai athirappa'n'nuki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam pe'nmaanka'lai eenumpadi seythu, kaaduka'lai ve'liyaakkum; avarudaiya aalayaththilu'l'la yaavarum avarudaiya makimaiyaip pirasthaapikki'raarka'l.
karththar jalappiravaakaththinmeal udkaarnthirukki'raar; karththar en'ren'raikkum raajaavaaka veet'rirukki'raar.
karththar thamathu janaththi'rkup pelankoduppaar; karththar thamathu janaththi'rkuch samaathaanam aru'li, avarka'lai aaseervathippaar.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'l ennai mea'rko'ndu makizhavottaamal, neer ennaik kaithookki eduththapadiyinaal, naan ummaip poat'ruvean.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean, ennai neer ku'namaakkineer.
karththaavea, neer en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththilirunthu ea'rappa'n'ni, naan kuzhiyil i'rangkaathapadi ennai uyiroadea kaaththeer.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lea, avaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya parisuththaththin ninaivukooruthalaik ko'ndaadungka'l.
avarudaiya koapam oru nimisham, avarudaiya thayavoa neediya vaazhvu; saayangkaalaththil azhukai thangkum, vidiya'rkaalaththilea ka'lippu'ndaakum.
naan orukkaalum asaikkappaduvathillaiyen'ru, en vaazhvilea sonnean.
karththaavea, ummudaiya thayavinaal neer en parvathaththaith thidamaay ni'rkappa'n'niyiruntheer; umathu mukaththai neer ma'raiththukko'ndapoathoa naan kalangkinavanaanean.
naan kuzhiyil i'rangkukaiyil en iraththaththaal enna laapamu'ndu? puzhuthi ummaith thuthiththu, umathu saththiyaththai a'rivikkumoa?
karththaavea, neer enakkuch sevikoduththu enmeal irakkamaayirum; karththaavea, neer enakkuch sakaayaraayirum en'ru solli;
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean; karththarai noakkik kegnchinean.

en pulampalai aananthak ka'lippaaka maa'rappa'n'nineer; en makimai amarnthiraamal ummaik keerththanampa'n'numpadiyaaka neer en irattaik ka'lainthupoattu, makizhchchiyennum kattinaal ennai idaikattineer.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummai en'ren'raikkum thuthippean.
karththaavea, ummai nampiyirukki'rean; naan orukkaalum vedkamadaiyaathapadi seyyum; umathu neethiyinimiththam ennai viduviyum.
umathu seviyai enakkuch saayththu, seekkiramaay ennaith thappuviyum; neer enakkup palaththa thurukamum, enakku adaikkalamaana ara'numaayirum.
en kanmalaiyum en koattaiyum neerea; umathu naamaththinimiththam enakku vazhikaatti, ennai nadaththiyaru'lum.
avarka'l enakku ma'raivaay vaiththa valaikku ennai neengkalaakkividum; theavareerea enakku ara'n.
umathu kaiyil en aaviyai oppuvikki'rean; saththiyaparanaakiya karththaavea, neer ennai meettukko'ndeer.
vee'nmaayaika'laip pat'rikko'l'luki'ravarka'lai naan ve'ruththu, karththaraiyea nampiyirukki'rean.
umathu kirupaiyilea ka'likoornthu makizhuvean; neer en upaththiravaththaip paarththu, en aaththumaviyaakulangka'lai a'rinthirukki'reer.
saththuruvin kaiyil ennai oppukkodaamal, en paathangka'lai visaalaththilea ni'ruththineer.
enakku irangkum karththaavea, naan nerukkappaduki'rean; thukkaththinaal en ka'n'num en aaththumaavum en vayi'rungkoodak karukippoayit'ru.
en piraa'nan sagnchalaththinaalum, en varushangka'l thavippinaalum kazhinthu poayit'ru; en akkiramaththinaalea en pelan ku'rainthu, en elumpuka'l ularnthupoayit'ru.
en saththurukka'laakiya yaavar nimiththamum, naan en ayalaarukku ninthaiyum, enakku a'rimukamaanavarka'lukku arukka'lippumaanean; veethiyilea ennaik ka'ndavarka'l enakku vilaki oadippoanaarka'l.
seththavanaippoala ellaaraalum muzhuvathum ma'rakkappattean; udaintha paaththiraththaippoalaanean.
aneakar sollum avathoo'raik keattean; enakku viroathamaaka avarka'l eakamaay aaloasanaipa'n'nuki'rathinaal thikil ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; en piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'raarka'l.
naanoa, karththaavea, ummai nampiyirukki'rean; neerea en theavan en'ru sonnean.
en kaalangka'l umathu karaththilirukki'rathu; en saththurukka'lin kaikkum ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'lin kaikkum ennaith thappuviyum.
neer umathu mukaththai umathu oozhiyakkaaranmeal pirakaasikkappa'n'ni, umathu kirupaiyinaalea ennai iradchiyum.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean; naan vedkappattup poakaathapadi seyyum; thunmaarkkar vedkappattup paathaa'laththil mavunamaayirukkattum.
neethimaanukku viroathamaayp perumaiyoadum ikazhchchiyoadum kadinamaayp peasuki'ra poy uthaduka'l kattappattuppoavathaaka.
umakkup payanthavarka'lukkum, manupuththirarukku munpaaka ummai nampuki'ravarka'lukkum, neer u'ndu pa'n'nivaiththirukki'ra ummudaiya nanmai evva'lavu perithaayirukki'rathu!
manusharudaiya akangkaaraththukku avarka'lai umathu samukaththin ma'raivilea ma'raiththu, naavuka'lin sa'ndaikku avarka'lai vilakki, umathu koodaaraththilea o'liththuvaiththuk kaappaat'ruki'reer.
karththar ara'naana nakaraththil enakkuth thamathu kirupaiyai athisayamaay vi'langkappa'n'ninapadiyaal, avarukku sthoaththiram.
ummudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka iraathapadikku vettu'ndean en'ru naan en manakkalakkaththilea sonnean; aanaalum naan ummai noakkik kooppittapoathu, en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththaik keatteer.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lea, neengka'lellaarum avaril anpukoorungka'l; u'nmaiyaanavanaik karththar tha'rkaaththu, idumpuseyki'ravanukkup poora'namaayp pathila'lippaar.
karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'lea, neengka'lellaarum thidamanathaayirungka'l, avar ungka'l iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuvaar.
evanudaiya mee'ruthal mannikkappattathoa, evanudaiya paavam moodappattathoa, avan paakkiyavaan.
evanudaiya akkiramaththaik karththar e'n'naathirukki'raaroa, evanudaiya aaviyil kapadamillaathirukki'rathoa, avan paakkiyavaan.
naan adakkivaiththamattum, niththam en katha'ruthalinaalea en elumpuka'l ularnthupoayit'ru.
iravum pakalum enmeal ummudaiya kai paaramaayirunthathinaal, en saaram ush'nakaala va'radchipoala va'ra'ndupoayit'ru. (sealaa.)
naan en akkiramaththai ma'raikkaamal, en paavaththai umakku a'riviththean; en mee'ruthalka'laik karththarukku a'rikkaiyiduvean en'rean; theavareer en paavaththin thoashaththai manniththeer. (sealaa.)
itha'rkaakach sakaayangkidaikkung kaalaththil pakthiyu'l'lavanevanum ummai noakki vi'n'nappagnseyvaan; appozhuthu mikuntha jalappiravaakam vanthaalum athu avanai a'nukaathu.
neer enakku ma'raividamaayirukki'reer; ennai neer ikkattukku vilakkikkaaththu, iradcha'niyap paadalka'l ennaich soozhnthuko'l'lumpadi seyveer. (sealaa.)
naan unakkup poathiththu, nee nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai unakkuk kaattuvean; unmeal en ka'n'nai vaiththu, unakku aaloasanai solluvean.
vaarinaalum kadivaa'laththinaalum vaaykattappattaalozhiya, un kittach searaatha puththiyillaak kuthiraiyaippoalavum koavea'ru kazhuthaiyaippoalavum irukkavea'ndaam.
thunmaarkkanukku aneaka veathanaika'lu'ndu; karththarai nampiyirukki'ravanaiyoa kirupai soozhnthuko'l'lum.
neethimaanka'lea, karththarukku'l makizhnthu ka'likoorungka'l; semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum aananthamuzhakkamidungka'l.
neethimaanka'lea, karththarukku'l ka'likoorungka'l; thuthiseyvathu semmaiyaanavarka'lukkuth thakum.
surama'ndalaththinaal karththaraith thuthiththu, paththu narampu vee'naiyinaalum avaraik keerththanampa'n'nungka'l.
avarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungka'l; aananthasaththaththoadea vaaththiyangka'lai nearththiyaay vaasiyungka'l.
karththarudaiya vaarththai uththamamum, avarudaiya seykaiyellaam saththiyamumaayirukki'rathu.
avar neethiyilum niyaayaththilum piriyappaduki'raar; poomi karththarudaiya kaaru'niyaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinaal vaanangka'lum, avarudaiya vaayin suvaasaththinaal avaika'lin sarvaseanaiyum u'ndaakkappattathu.
avar samuththira jalangka'laik kuviyalaakach searththu, aazhamaana jalangka'laip pokkishavaippaaka vaikki'raar.
poomiyellaam karththarukkup payappaduvathaaka; ulakaththilu'l'la kudika'lellaam avarukku agnchiyiruppathaaka.
avar solla aakum, avar katta'laiyida ni'rkum.
karththar jaathika'lin aaloasanaiyai viruthaavaakki, janangka'ludaiya ninaivuka'lai avamaakkuki'raar.
karththarudaiya aaloasanai niththiyakaalamaakavum, avarudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuka'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakavum ni'rkum.
karththaraith thangka'lukkuth theyvamaakakko'nda jaathiyum, avar thamakkuch suthantharamaakath therinthuko'nda janamum paakkiyamu'l'lathu.
karththar vaanaththilirunthu noakkippaarththu, ellaa manupuththiraraiyum kaa'nki'raar.
thaam vaasamaayirukki'ra sthaanaththilirunthu poomiyin kudika'l ellaarmealum ka'n'noakkamaayirukki'raar.
avarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'laiyellaam avar uruvaakki, avarka'l seykaika'laiyellaam kavaniththirukki'raar.
entha raajaavum than seanaiyin mikuthiyaal iradchikkappadaan; savuriyavaanum than palaththin mikuthiyaal thappaan.
iradchikki'ratha'rkuk kuthirai viruthaa; athu than mikuntha veeriyaththaal thappuviyaathu.
thamakkup payanthu, thamathu kirupaikkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'lin aaththumaakka'lai mara'naththi'rku vilakki viduvikkavum;
pagnchaththil avarka'lai uyiroadea kaakkavum, karththarudaiya ka'n avarka'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu.
nammudaiya aaththumaa karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'rathu; avarea namakkuth thu'naiyum namakkuk keadakamumaanavar.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththai naam nampiyirukki'rapadiyaal, nammudaiya iruthayam avarukku'l ka'likoorum.
karththaavea, naangka'l ummai nampiyirukki'rapadiyea umathu kirupai engka'lmeal iruppathaaka.
karththarai naan ekkaalaththilum sthoaththirippean; avar thuthi eppoathum en vaayilirukkum.
karththarukku'l en aaththumaa meanmaipaaraattum; si'rumaippattavarka'l athaikkeattu makizhuvaarka'l.
ennoadeakoodak karththarai makimaippaduththungka'l; naam orumiththu avar naamaththai uyarththuvoamaaka.
naan karththaraith theadinean, avar enakkuch sevikoduththu, ennudaiya ellaap payaththukkum ennai neengkalaakkivittaar.
avarka'l avarai noakkippaarththup pirakaasamadainthaarka'l; avarka'l mukangka'l vedkappadavillai.
intha eazhai kooppittaan, karththar keattu, avanai avan idukka'nka'lukkellaam neengkalaakki iradchiththaar.
karththarudaiya thoothan avarukkup payanthavarka'laich soozhap paa'layami'rangki avarka'lai viduvikki'raar.
karththar nallavar enpathai rusiththuppaarungka'l; avarmeal nampikkaiyaayirukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lea, avarukkup payanthirungka'l; avarukkup payanthavarka'lukkuk ku'raivillai.
singkakkuttika'l thaazhchchiyadainthu pattiniyaayirukkum; karththaraith theaduki'ravarka'lukkoa oru nanmaiyung ku'raivupadaathu.
pi'l'laika'lea, vanthu enakkuch sevikodungka'l; karththarukkup payappaduthalai ungka'lukkup poathippean.
nanmaiyaik kaa'numpadi, jeevanai virumpi, neediththa naadka'lai apeadchikki'ra manushan yaar?
un naavaip pollaappukkum, un uthaduka'laik kapattuvasanippukkum vilakkik kaaththukko'l.
theemaiyai vittu vilaki, nanmaisey; samaathaanaththaith theadi, athaith thodarnthuko'l.
karththarudaiya ka'nka'l neethimaanka'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; avarudaiya sevika'l avarka'l kooppiduthalukkuth thi'ranthirukki'rathu.
theemaiseyki'ravarka'ludaiya pearaip poomiyil iraamal at'ruppoakappa'n'na, karththarudaiya mukam avarka'lukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
neethimaanka'l kooppidumpoathu karththar keattu, avarka'lai avarka'ludaiya ellaa upaththiravangka'lukkum neengkalaakkividuki'raar.
no'rungku'nda iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lukkuk karththar sameepamaayirunthu, narungku'nda aaviyu'l'lavarka'lai iradchikki'raar.
neethimaanukku varum thunpangka'l aneakamaayirukkum, karththar avaika'lellaavat'rilum nin'ru avanai viduvippaar.
avanudaiya elumpuka'laiyellaam kaappaat'ruki'raar; avaika'lil on'rum mu'rikkappaduvathillai.
theemai thunmaarkkanaik kollum; neethimaanaip pakaikki'ravarka'l kut'ravaa'lika'laavaarka'l.
karththar thamathu oozhiyakkaararin aaththumaavai meettukko'l'luki'raar; avarai nampuki'ra oruvanmealum kut'ragnsumaraathu.
karththaavea, neer en vazhakkaa'lika'loadea vazhakkaadi, ennoadu yuththampa'n'nuki'ravarka'loadea yuththampa'n'num.
neer keadakaththaiyum parisaiyaiyum pidiththu, enakku oththaasaiyaaka ezhunthunillum.
ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'loadu ethirththunin'ru, eettiyaiyoangki avarka'lai ma'riththu: naan un iradchippu en'ru en aaththumaavukkuch sollum.
en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'l vedkappattuk kalangkuvaarka'laaka; enakkuth theengkuseyya ninaikki'ravarka'l naa'namadaivaarka'laaka.
avarka'l kaat'rumukaththil pa'rakkum patharaippoalaavaarka'laaka; karththarudaiya thoothan avarka'laith thuraththuvaanaaka.
avarka'ludaiya vazhi iru'lum sa'rukkalumaayiruppathaaka; karththarudaiya thoothan avarka'laip pinthodaruvaanaaka.
mukaantharamillaamal enakkaakath thangka'l valaiyaik kuzhiyil o'liththuvaiththaarka'l; mukaantharamillaamal en aaththumaavukkup padukuzhi vettinaarka'l.
avan ninaiyaatha azhivu avanukku varavum, avan ma'raivaay vaiththa valai avanaiyea pidikkavungkadavathu; avanea anthak kuzhiyil vizhunthu azhivaanaaka.
en aaththumaa karththaril ka'likoornthu, avarudaiya iradchippil makizhnthirukkum.

si'rumaippattavanai avanilum palavaanudaiya kaikkum, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaik ko'l'laiyiduki'ravanudaiya kaikkum thappuvikki'ra umakkoppaanavar yaar karththaavea, en'ru en elumpuka'lellaam sollum.
kodumaiyaana saadchika'l ezhumpi, naan a'riyaathathai ennidaththil keadki'raarka'l.
naan seytha nanmaikkup pathilaakath theemaiseyki'raarka'l; en aaththumaa thikkat'ruppoakap paarkki'raarka'l.
avarka'l viyaathiyaayirunthapoathu irattu en uduppaayirunthathu; naan upavaasaththaal en aaththumaavai upaththirappaduththinean; en jepamum en madiyilea thirumpavanthathu.
naan avanai en sineakithanaakavum sakoatharanaakavum paaviththu nadanthuko'ndean; thaaykkaakath thukkikki'ravanaippoal thukkavasthiram thariththuth thalaikavizhnthu nadanthean.
aanaalum enakku aapaththu'ndaanapoathu avarka'l santhoashappattuk koottangkoodinaarka'l; neesarum naan a'riyaathavarka'lum enakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodi, oayaamal ennai ninthiththaarka'l.
appaththi'rkaaka ichchakampeasuki'ra pariyaasakkaararoadea searnthuko'ndu enpearil pa'rkadikki'raarka'l.
aa'ndavarea, ethuvaraikkum ithaip paarththukko'ndiruppeer? en aaththumaavai azhivukkum, enakku arumaiyaanathaich singkakkuttika'lukkum thappuviyum.
makaa sapaiyilea ummaith thuthippean; thira'laana janangka'lukku'l'lea ummaip pukazhuvean.
vee'naay enakkuch saththurukka'laanavarka'l ennimiththam santhoashiyaamalum, mukaantharamillaamal ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'l ka'n simittaamalum iruppaarka'laaka.
avarka'l samaathaanamaayp peasaamal, theasaththilea amaithalaayirukki'ravarka'lukku viroathamaay vagnchakamaana kaariyangka'laik karuthuki'raarka'l.
enakku viroathamaakath thangka'l vaayai virivaayth thi'ranthu, aa aa, aa aa, engka'l ka'n ka'ndathu enki'raarka'l.
karththaavea, neer ithaik ka'ndeer, mavunamaayiraatheayum; aa'ndavarea, enakkuth thooramaakaatheayum.
en theavanea, en aa'ndavarea, enakku niyaayagnseyyavum en vazhakkaith theerkkavum vizhiththukko'ndu ezhuntharu'lum.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya neethiyinpadi ennai niyaayam visaariyum, ennaikku'riththu avarka'lai makizhavottaathirum.
avarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththilea: aa aa, ithuvea naangka'l virumpinathu en'ru sollaathapadikkum, avanai vizhungkivittoam en'ru peasaathapadikkum seyyum.
enakku nearitta aapaththukkaakach santhoashikki'ravarka'l eakamaay vedki naa'ni, enakku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattuki'ravarka'l vedkaththaalum ilachchaiyaalum moodappadakkadavarka'l.
en neethivi'langka virumpuki'ravarka'l kempeeriththu makizhnthu, thamathu oozhiyakkaaranudaiya sukaththai virumpuki'ra karththarukku makimai u'ndaavathaaka en'ru eppoathum sollakkadavarka'l.
en naavu umathu neethiyaiyum, naa'lmuzhuthum umathu thuthiyaiyum sollikko'ndirukkum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya thuroakappeachchu en u'l'laththi'rkuth theriyum; avan ka'nka'lukkumun theyvapayam illai.
avan, than akkiramam aruvaruppaanathen'ru kaa'nappaduma'lavum, than paarvaikkeat'rapadi thanakkuththaanea ichchakam peasuki'raan.
avan vaayin vaarththaika'l akkiramamum vagnchakamumu'l'lathu; puththiyaay nadanthuko'lvathaiyum nanmaiseyvathaiyum vittuvittaan.
avan than padukkaiyinmeal akkiramaththai yoasiththu, nallathallaatha vazhiyilea nilaiththu, pollaappai ve'rukkaathirukki'raan.
karththaavea, umathu kirupai vaanangka'lil vi'langkuki'rathu; umathu saththiyam meakama'ndalangka'l pariyantham ettuki'rathu.
umathu neethi makaththaana parvathangka'lpoalavum, umathu niyaayangka'l makaa aazhamaakavum irukki'rathu; karththaavea, manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum kaappaat'ruki'reer.
theavanea, ummudaiya kirupai evva'lavu arumaiyaanathu! athinaal manupuththirar umathu settaika'lin nizhalilea vanthadaiki'raarka'l.
umathu aalayaththilu'l'la sampoora'naththinaal thirupthiyadaivaarka'l; umathu pearinpa nathiyinaal avarka'l thaakaththaith theerkki'reer.
jeevaoot'ru ummidaththil irukki'rathu; ummudaiya ve'lichchaththilea ve'lichcham kaa'nki'roam.
ummai a'rinthavarka'lmeal umathu kirupaiyaiyum, semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lmeal umathu neethiyaiyum paaraattiyaru'lum.
perumaikkaararin kaal enmeal varaamalum, thunmaarkkarudaiya kai ennaip pa'rakkadiyaamalum iruppathaaka.
athoa akkiramakkaarar vizhunthaarka'l; ezhunthirukkamaattaamal tha'l'lu'ndupoanaarka'l.
pollaathavarka'laikku'riththu erichchaladaiyaathea; niyaayakkeaduseyki'ravarka'lmeal po'raamaiko'l'laathea.
avarka'l pullaippoal seekkiramaay a'ruppu'ndu, pasumpoo'ndaippoal vaadippoavaarka'l.
karththarai nampi nanmaisey; theasaththil kudiyirunthu saththiyaththai meaynthuko'l.
karththaridaththil manamakizhchchiyaayiru; avar un iruthayaththin vea'nduthalka'lai unakku aru'lseyvaar.
un vazhiyaik karththarukku oppuviththu, avarmeal nampikkaiyaayiru; avarea kaariyaththai vaaykkappa'n'nuvaar.
un neethiyai ve'lichchaththaippoalavum, un niyaayaththaip pattappakalaippoalavum vi'langkappa'n'nuvaar.
karththarai noakki amarnthu, avarukkuk kaaththiru; kaariyasiththiyu'l'lavanmealum theevinaika'laich seyki'ra manushanmealum erichchalaakaathea.
koapaththai nekizhnthu, ukkiraththai vittuvidu; pollaappuchseyya eathuvaana erichchal unakku vea'ndaam.
pollaathavarka'l a'ruppu'ndupoavaarka'l; karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'loa poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.
innung kognchanearanthaan, appoathu thunmaarkkan iraan; avan sthaanaththai ut'ru visaariththaayaanaal avan illai.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'l poomiyaich suthanthariththu, mikuntha samaathaanaththinaal manamakizhchchiyaayiruppaarka'l.
thunmaarkkan neethimaanukku viroathamaayth theengku ninaiththu, avanpearil pa'rkadikki'raan.
aa'ndavar avanaippaarththu nakaikki'raar; avanudaiya naa'l varuki'rathen'ru kaa'nki'raar.
si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanai madivikkavum, semmai maarkkaththaarai vizhappa'n'navum, thunmaarkkar pattayaththai uruvi, thangka'l villai naa'neat'ruki'raarka'l.
aanaalum avarka'l pattayam avarka'ludaiya iruthayaththi'rku'l uruvippoam; avarka'l villuka'l mu'riyum.
aneaka thunmaarkkarukku'l'la selvaththiradchiyaippaarkkilum, neethimaanukku'l'la kognchamea nallathu.
thunmaarkkarudaiya puyangka'l mu'riyum; neethimaanka'laiyoa karththar thaangkuki'raar.
uththamarka'lin naadka'laik karththar a'rinthirukki'raar; avarka'l suthantharam en'ren'raikkum irukkum.
avarka'l aapaththukkaalaththilea vedkappattuppoakaathirunthu, pagnchakaalaththilea thirupthiyadaivaarka'l.
thunmaarkkaroa azhinthupoavaarka'l, karththarudaiya saththurukka'l aattukkuttika'lin ni'naththaippoal pukainthupoavaarka'l, avarka'l pukaiyaayp pukainthupoavaarka'l.
thunmaarkkan kadanvaangkich seluththaama'rpoaki'raan; neethimaanoa irangkikkodukki'raan.
avaraal aaseervathikkappattavarka'l poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarka'l; avaraal sapikkappattavarka'loa a'ruppu'ndupoavaarka'l.
nalla manushanudaiya nadaika'l karththaraal u'ruthippadum, avanudaiya vazhiyinmeal avar piriyamaayirukki'raar.
avan vizhunthaalum tha'l'lu'ndu poavathillai; karththar thamathu kaiyinaal avanaith thaangkuki'raar.
naan i'laignanaayirunthean, muthirvayathu'l'lavanumaanean; aanaalum neethimaan kaividappattathaiyum, avan santhathi appaththukku iranthuthiriki'rathaiyum naan kaa'navillai.
avan niththam irangkik kadan kodukki'raan, avan santhathi aaseervathikkappadum.
theemaiyai vittu vilaki, nanmaisey; en'ren'raikkum nilaiththiruppaay.
karththar niyaayaththai virumpuki'ravar; avar thamathu parisuththavaanka'laik kaividuvathillai; avarka'l en'raikkum kaakkappaduvaarka'l; thunmaarkkarudaiya santhathiyoa a'ruppu'ndupoam.
neethimaanka'l poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, en'raikkum athilea vaasamaayiruppaarka'l.
neethimaanudaiya vaay gnaanaththai uraiththu, avanudaiya naavu niyaayaththaip peasum.
avanudaiya theavan aru'liya veatham avan iruthayaththil irukki'rathu; avan nadaika'lil on'rum pisakuvathillai.
thunmaarkkan neethimaanmeal ka'nvaiththu, avanaik kolla vakaitheaduki'raan.
karththaroa avanai ivan kaiyil viduvathillai; avan niyaayam visaarikkappadukaiyil, avanai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerppathumillai.
nee karththarukkuk kaaththirunthu, avarudaiya vazhiyaik kaikko'l; appozhuthu nee poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'lvatha'rku avar unnai uyarththuvaar; thunmaarkkar a'ruppu'ndupoavathai nee kaa'npaay.
kodiya palavanthanaana oru thunmaarkkanaik ka'ndean, avan thanakkeat'ra nilaththil mu'laiththirukki'ra pachchaimaraththaippoal thazhaiththavanaayirunthaan.
aanaalum avan ozhinthupoanaan; paarungka'l, avan illai; avanaith theadinean, avan kaa'nappadavillai.
nee uththamanai noakki, semmaiyaanavanaip paarththiru; antha manushanudaiya mudivu samaathaanam.
akkiramakkaarar eakamaay azhikkappaduvaarka'l; a'ruppu'ndupoavathea thunmaarkkarin mudivu.
neethimaanka'ludaiya iradchippu karththaraal varum; ikkattukkaalaththil avarea avarka'l adaikkalam.
karththar avarka'lukku uthaviseythu, avarka'lai viduvippaar; avarka'l avarai nampiyirukki'rapadiyaal, avarka'laith thunmaarkkarudaiya kaikkuth thappuviththu iradchippaar.
karththaavea, ummudaiya koapaththil ennaik kadinthuko'l'laatheayum; ummudaiya ukkiraththil ennaith tha'ndiyaatheayum.
ummudaiya ampuka'l enakku'l'lea thaiththirukki'rathu; umathu kai ennai iruththuki'rathu.
umathu koapaththinaal en maamsaththil aaroakkiyamillai; en paavaththinaal en elumpuka'lil savukkiyamillai.
en akkiramangka'l en thalaikku mealaakap perukit'ru, avaika'l paarachsumaiyaippoala ennaal thaangkakkoodaatha paaramaayit'ru.
en mathikeattinimiththam en pu'nka'l azhuki naat'rameduththathu.
naan veathanaippattu odungkinean; naa'lmuzhuthum thukkappattuth thiriki'rean.
en kudalka'l eripanthamaay eriki'rathu; en maamsaththil aaroakkiyam illai.
naan pelanat'ruppoay, mikavum no'rukkappattean; en iruthayaththin kontha'lippinaal katha'ruki'rean.
aa'ndavarea, en eangkalellaam umakku munpaaka irukki'rathu; en thavippu umakku ma'raivaayirukkavillai.
en u'l'lam kuzhampi alaiki'rathu; en pelan ennai vittu vilaki, en ka'nka'lin o'li muthalaay illaama'rpoayit'ru.
en sineakitharum en thoazharum en vaathaiyaik ka'ndu vilakuki'raarka'l; en inaththaarum thooraththilea ni'rki'raarka'l.
en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'l enakkuk ka'n'nika'lai vaikki'raarka'l; enakkup pollaangku theaduki'ravarka'l keadaanavaika'laip peasi, naa'lmuzhuthum vagnchanaika'lai yoasikki'raarka'l.
naanoa sevidanaippoalak kea'laathavanaakavum, oomaiyanaippoala vaaythi'ravaathavanaakavum irukki'rean.
kaathukea'laathavanum, than vaayil ma'ruuththaravuka'l illaathavanumaayirukki'ra manushanaippoalaanean.
karththaavea, umakkuk kaaththirukki'rean; en theavanaakiya aa'ndavarea, neer ma'ruuththaravu koduppeer.
avarka'l ennimiththam santhoashappadaathapadikku ippadich sonnean; en kaal thava'rumpoathu enmeal perumaipaaraattuvaarka'lea.
naan thadumaa'ri vizha eathuvaayirukki'rean; en thukkam eppozhuthum en munpaaka irukki'rathu.
en akkiramaththai naan a'rikkaiyittu, en paavaththinimiththam visaarappaduki'rean.
en saththurukka'l vaazhnthu palaththirukki'raarka'l; mukaantharamillaamal ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'l perukiyirukki'raarka'l.
naan nanmaiyaip pinpat'ruki'rapadiyaal, nanmaikkuth theemai seyki'ravarka'l ennai viroathikki'raarka'l.
karththaavea, ennaik kaividaatheayum; en theavanea, enakkuth thooramaayiraatheayum.
en iradchippaakiya aa'ndavarea, enakkuch sakaayagnseyyath theeviriyum.
en naavinaal paavagnseyyaathapadikku naan en vazhika'laik kaaththu, thunmaarkkan enakku munpaaka irukkumattum en vaayaik kadivaa'laththaal adakkivaippean en'rean.
naan mavunamaaki, oomaiyanaayirunthean, nalamaanathaiyum peasaamal amarnthirunthean; aanaalum en thukkam athikariththathu;
en iruthayam enakku'l'lea analko'ndathu; naan thiyaanikkaiyil akkini moo'ndathu; appozhuthu en naavinaal vi'n'nappam seythean.
karththaavea, naan evva'lavaay nilaiyat'ravan en'ru u'narumpadi en mudivaiyum, en naadka'lin a'lavu ivva'lavu enpathaiyum enakkuth theriviyum.
ithoa, en naadka'lai naalu vira'rkadaiya'lavaakkineer; en aayusu umathu paarvaikku illaathathupoalirukki'rathu; entha manushanum maayaiyea enpathu nichchayam. (sealaa.)
veashamaakavea manushan thiriki'raan; viruthaavaakavea sagnchalappaduki'raan; aasthiyaich searkki'raan, yaar athai vaarikko'l'luvaan en'ru a'riyaan.
ippoathum aa'ndavarea, naan etha'rku ethirpaarththirukki'rean? neerea en nampikkai.
en mee'ruthalka'l ellaavat'rilumirunthu ennai viduthalaiyaakkum, moodanudaiya ninthanaikku ennai oppukkodaatheayum.
neerea ithaich seytheer en'ru naan en vaayaith thi'ravaamal mavunamaayirunthean.
ennilirunthu ummudaiya vaathaiyai eduththuppoadum; umathu karaththin adika'laal naan soarnthupoanean.
akkiramaththinimiththam neer manushanaik kadinthuko'ndu tha'ndikki'rapoathu, avan vadivaip pottarippaippoal azhiyappa'n'nuki'reer; nichchayamaaka entha manushanum maayaiyea. (sealaa.)

karththaavea, en jepaththaikkeattu, en kooppiduthalukkuch sevikodum; en ka'n'neerukku mavunamaayiraatheayum; en pithaakka'lellaaraiyumpoala naanum umakku munpaaka anniyanum paratheasiyumaayirukki'rean.
naan ini iraama'rpoakumunnea, thea'ruthaladaiyumpadi ennidaththil po'rumaiyaayirum.
karththarukkaakap po'rumaiyudan kaaththirunthean; avar ennidamaaych saaynthu, en kooppiduthalaik keattaar.
payangkaramaana kuzhiyilum u'laiyaana seat'rilumirunthu ennaith thookkiyeduththu, en kaalka'laik kanmalaiyinmeal ni'ruththi, en adika'lai u'ruthippaduththi,
namathu theavanaith thuthikkum puthuppaattai avar en vaayilea koduththaar; aneakar athaik ka'ndu, payanthu, karththarai nampuvaarka'l.
akangkaarika'laiyum poyyaich saarnthirukki'ravarka'laiyum noakkaamal, karththaraiyea than nampikkaiyaaka vaikki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.

en theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer engka'l nimiththagnseytha ummudaiya athisayangka'lum ummudaiya yoasanaika'lum aneakamaayirukki'rathu; oruvarum avaika'lai umakku vivariththuch sollimudiyaathu; naan avaika'laich solli a'rivikkavea'ndumaanaal avaika'l e'n'nikkaikku mealaanavaika'l.
paliyaiyum kaa'nikkaiyaiyum neer virumpaamal, en sevika'laith thi'rantheer; sarvaangka thakanapaliyaiyum paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum neer keadkavillai.
appozhuthu naan: ithoa, varuki'rean, pusthakachsuru'lil ennaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rathu;
en theavanea, umakkup piriyamaanathaich seyya virumpuki'rean; umathu niyaayappiramaa'nam en u'l'laththi'rku'l irukki'rathu en'ru sonnean.
makaa sapaiyilea neethiyaip pirasangkiththean; en uthaduka'lai moodean, karththaavea, neer athai a'riveer.

ummudaiya neethiyai naan en iruthayaththi'rku'l ma'raiththuvaikkavillai; umathu saththiyaththaiyum umathu iradchippaiyum solliyirukki'rean; umathu kirupaiyaiyum umathu u'nmaiyaiyum makaa sapaikku a'riviyaathapadikku naan o'liththuvaikkavillai.
karththaavea neer ummudaiya irakkangka'lai enakkuk kidaiyaama'r poakappa'n'naatheayum; umathu kirupaiyum umathu u'nmaiyum eppozhuthum ennaik kaakkakkadavathu.

e'n'nikkaikku adangkaatha theemaika'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu, en akkiramangka'l ennaith thodarnthupidiththathu, naan nimirnthu paarkkakkoodaathirukki'rathu, avaika'l en thalaimayirilum athikamaayirukki'rathu, en iruthayam soarnthupoaki'rathu.
karththaavea, ennai viduviththaru'lum; karththaavea, enakkuch sakaayampa'n'nath theeviriyum.
en piraa'nanai azhikkath theaduki'ravarka'l eakamaay vedki naa'ni, enakkuth theengkuseyya virumpuki'ravarka'l pinnittu ilachchaiyadaivaarka'laaka.
enpearil aa aa! aa aa! en'ru solluki'ravarka'l, thangka'l vedkaththin palanaiyadainthu kaividappaduvaarka'laaka.
ummaith theaduki'ra anaivarum umakku'l makizhnthu santhoashappaduvaarka'laaka; ummudaiya iradchippai virumpuki'ravarka'l karththarukku makimai u'ndaavathaaka en'ru eppozhuthum solvaarka'laaka.
naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan, karththaroa enmeal ninaivaayirukki'raar; theavareer en thu'naiyum ennai viduvikki'ravarumaayirukki'reer; en theavanea, thaamathiyaatheayum.
si'rumaippattavanmeal sinthaiyu'l'lavan paakkiyavaan; theengkunaa'lil karththar avanai viduvippaar.
karththar avanaip paathukaaththu avanai uyiroadea vaippaar; poomiyil avan paakkiyavaanaayiruppaan; avan saththurukka'lin ishdaththi'rku neer avanai oppukkodeer.
padukkaiyinmeal viyaathiyaaykkidakki'ra avanaik karththar thaangkuvaar; avanudaiya viyaathiyilea avan padukkai muzhuvathaiyum maat'rippoaduveer.
karththaavea, enmeal irakkamaayirum; umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythean, en aaththumaavaik ku'namaakkum en'ru naan sonnean.
avan eppozhuthu saavaan, avan pear eppozhuthu azhiyum? en'ru en saththurukka'l enakku viroathamaaych solluki'raarka'l.
oruvan ennaip paarkkavanthaal vagnchanaiyaayp peasuki'raan; avan than iruthayaththil akkiramaththaich seakariththukko'ndu, theruvileapoay, athaith thoot'ruki'raan.
en pakaignarellaarum enmeal eakamaay mu'numu'nuththu, enakku viroathamaayirunthu, enakkup pollaangku ninaiththu,
theeraaviyaathi avanaip pidiththukko'ndathu; padukkaiyil kidakki'ra avan ini ezhunthiruppathillai enki'raarka'l.
en piraa'nasineakithanum, naan nampinavanum, en appam pusiththavanumaakiya manushanum, enmeal than kuthikaalaith thookkinaan.
karththaavea, neer enakku irangki, naan avarka'lukkuch sarikkatta ennai ezhunthirukkappa'n'num.
en saththuru enmeal jeyangko'l'laathathinaal, neer enmeal piriyamaayirukki'reeren'ru a'rivean.
neer en uththamaththilea ennaiththaangki, en'ren'raikkum ummudaiya samukaththil ennai nilaini'ruththuveer.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththar anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum sthoaththirikkappadaththakkavar. aamen, aamen.
maanaanathu neeroadaika'lai vaagnchiththuk katha'ruvathupoala, theavanea, en aaththumaa ummai vaagnchiththuk katha'ruki'rathu.
en aaththumaa theavanmeal, jeevanu'l'la theavanmealeayea thaakamaayirukki'rathu; naan eppozhuthu theavanudaiya sannithiyil vanthu ni'rpean?
un theavan engkea en'ru avarka'l naa'lthoa'rum ennidaththil solluki'rapadiyaal, iravum pakalum en ka'n'neerea enakku u'navaayit'ru.

munnea naan pa'ndikaiyai aasarikki'ra janangka'loadea kooda nadanthu, koottaththin ka'lippum thuthiyumaana saththaththoadea theavaalayaththi'rkup poayvaruveanea; ivaika'lai naan ninaikkumpoathu en u'l'lam enakku'l'lea urukuki'rathu.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalangkuki'raay? ean enakku'l thiyangkuki'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; avar samukaththu iradchippinimiththam naan innum avaraith thuthippean.
en theavanea, en aaththumaa enakku'l kalangkuki'rathu; aakaiyaal yoarthaan theasaththilum ermoan malaika'lilum si'rumalaiyilumirunthu ummai ninaikki'rean.
umathu mathakuka'lin iraichchalaal aazhaththai aazham kooppiduki'rathu; umathu alaika'lum thiraika'lum ellaam enmeal pura'ndupoaki'rathu.

aakilum karththar paka'rkaalaththilea thamathu kirupaiyaik katta'laiyiduki'raar; iraakkaalaththilea avaraip paadum paattu en vaayilirukki'rathu; en jeevanudaiya theavanai noakki vi'n'nappagnseyki'rean.
naan en kanmalaiyaakiya theavanai noakki: ean ennai ma'rantheer? saththuruvinaal odukkappattu, naan ean thukkaththudanea thiriyavea'ndum en'ru solluki'rean.
un theavan engkea en'ru en saththurukka'l naa'lthoa'rum ennoadea solli, ennai ninthippathu en elumpuka'lai uruvakkuththuki'rathupoal irukki'rathu.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalangkuki'raay? ean enakku'l thiyangkuki'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; en mukaththi'rku iradchippum en theavanumaayirukki'ravarai naan innum thuthippean.
theavanea, neer en niyaayaththai visaariththu, pakthiyillaatha jaathiyaaroadu enakkaaka vazhakkaadi, soothum aniyaayamumaana manushanukku ennaith thappuviyum.
en ara'naakiya theavan neer; ean ennaith tha'l'lividuki'reer? saththuruvinaal odukkappattu naan ean thukkaththudanea thiriyavea'ndum?
umathu ve'lichchaththaiyum umathu saththiyaththaiyum anuppiyaru'lum; avaika'l ennai nadaththi, umathu parisuththa parvathaththi'rkum umathu vaasasthalangka'lukkum ennaik ko'ndupoavathaaka.
appozhuthu naan theavanudaiya peedaththa'ndaikkum, enakku aanantha makizhchchiyaayirukki'ra theavanidaththi'rkum piraveasippean. theavanea, en theavanea, ummaich surama'ndalaththaal thuthippean.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalangkuki'raay? ean enakku'l thiyangkuki'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; en mukaththi'rku iradchippum en theavanumaayirukki'ravarai naan innum thuthippean.
theavanea, engka'l pithaakka'ludaiya naadka'laakiya poorvanaadka'lil neer nadappiththa kiriyaika'lai avarka'l engka'lukku a'riviththaarka'l; avaika'lai engka'l kaathuka'laal keattoam.
theavareer ummudaiya kaiyinaalea jaathika'laith thuraththi, ivarka'lai naatti; janangka'laith thunpappaduththi, ivarka'laip paravappa'n'nineer.

avarka'l thangka'l pattayaththaal theasaththaik kattikko'l'lavillai; avarka'l puyamum avarka'lai iradchikkavillai; neer avarka'lmeal piriyamaayirunthapadiyaal, ummudaiya valathukaramum, ummudaiya puyamum, ummudaiya mukaththin pirakaasamum avarka'lai iradchiththathu.
theavanea, neer en raajaa; yaakkoapukku iradchippaik katta'laiyidum.
ummaalea engka'l saththurukka'laik keezhea vizhaththaakki, engka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lai ummudaiya naamaththinaal mithippoam.
en villai naan nampean, en pattayam ennai iradchippathillai.
neerea engka'l saththurukka'linin'ru engka'lai iradchiththu, engka'laip pakaikki'ravarka'lai vedkappaduththuki'reer.
theavanukku'l niththam meanmaipaaraattuvoam; umathu naamaththai en'ren'raikkum thuthippoam. (sealaa.)
neer engka'laith tha'l'livittu, naa'nappa'n'nuki'reer; engka'l seanaika'ludanea sellaathirukki'reer.
saththuruvukku naangka'l idainthu pinnittuth thirumpippoakap pa'n'nuki'reer; engka'l pakaignar thangka'lukken'ru engka'laik ko'l'laiyiduki'raarka'l.
neer engka'lai aaduka'laippoala iraiyaaka oppukkoduththu, jaathika'lukku'l'lea engka'laich sitha'radikki'reer.
neer ummudaiya janangka'lai ilavasamaaka vi'rki'reer; avarka'l kirayaththinaal umakku laapamillaiyea.
engka'l ayalaarukku engka'lai ninthaiyaakavum, engka'l sut'ruppu'raththaarukkup pariyaasamum sakkanthamumaakavum vaikki'reer.
naangka'l jaathika'lukku'l'lea pazhamozhiyaayirukkavum, janangka'l engka'laikku'riththuth thalaithulukkavum seyki'reer.
ninthiththuth thooshikki'ravanudaiya saththaththinimiththamum, saththuruvinimiththamum, pazhivaangkuki'ravanimiththamum,
en ilachchai niththam enakku munpaaka irukki'rathu; en mukaththin vedkam ennai mooduki'rathu.
ivaiyellaam engka'lmeal vanthirunthum, ummai naangka'l ma'rakkavum illai, ummudaiya udanpadikkaikkuth thuroakampa'n'navum illai.
neer engka'lai valusarppangka'lu'l'la idaththilea no'rukki, mara'na iru'linaalea engka'lai moodiyirunthum,
engka'l iruthayam pinvaangkavum illai, engka'l kaaladi ummudaiya paathaiyai vittu vilakavum illai.
naangka'l engka'l theavanudaiya naamaththai ma'ranthu, anniya theavanai noakkik kaiyeduththirunthoamaanaal,
theavan athai aaraaynthu, visaariyaathiruppaaroa? iruthayaththin antharangkangka'lai avar a'rinthirukki'raarea.
umathu nimiththam ennearamum kollappaduki'roam; adikkappadum aaduka'laippoala e'n'nappaduki'roam.
aa'ndavarea, vizhiththukko'l'lum; ean niththiraipa'n'nuki'reer? ezhuntharu'lum, engka'lai en'raikkum tha'l'lividaathirum.
ean ummudaiya mukaththai ma'raiththu, engka'l si'rumaiyaiyum engka'l nerukkaththaiyum ma'ranthuviduki'reer?
engka'l aaththumaa puzhuthimattum thaazhnthirukki'rathu; engka'l vayi'ru tharaiyoadu ottiyirukki'rathu.
engka'lukku oththaasaiyaaka ezhuntharu'lum; ummudaiya kirupaiyinimiththam engka'lai meettuvidum.
en iruthayam nalla viseashaththinaal pongkuki'rathu; naan raajaavaikku'riththup paadina kaviyaich solluki'rean; en naavu viraivaay ezhuthuki'ravanudaiya ezhuththaa'ni.
ellaa manupuththirarilum neer makaa savunthariyamu'l'lavar; ummudaiya uthaduka'lil aru'l pozhiki'rathu; aakaiyaal theavan ummai en'ren'raikkum aaseervathikki'raar.
savuriyavaanea, umathu makimaiyum umathu makaththuvamumaakiya ummudaiya pattayaththai neer ummudaiya araiyilea kattikko'ndu,
saththiyaththinimiththamum, neethiyudan koodiya saanthaththinimiththamum, umathu makaththuvaththilea jeyamaaka ea'rivaarum; umathu valathukaram payangkaramaanavaika'lai umakku vi'langkappa'n'num.
ummudaiya ampuka'l koormaiyaanavaika'l, avaika'l raajaavudaiya saththurukka'lin iruthayaththi'rku'l paayum; janasatha'langka'l umakkuk keezhea vizhuvaarka'l.
theavanea, umathu singkaasanam en'ren'raikkumu'l'lathu, umathu raajyaththin sengkoal neethiyu'l'la sengkoalaayirukki'rathu.
neer neethiyai virumpi, akkiramaththai ve'rukki'reer; aathalaal theavanea, ummudaiya theavan umathu thoazharaippaarkkilum ummai aananthathailaththinaal apisheakampa'n'ninaar.
thanthaththinaal seytha aramanaika'lilirunthu pu'rappadukaiyil, neer makizhumpadi umathu vasthirangka'lellaam ve'l'laippoa'lam santhanam lavangkam ivaika'lin vaasanai porunthiyathaayirukki'rathu.
umathu naayakika'lukku'l'lea arasarin kumaaraththika'lu'ndu, raajasthiree oappeerin thangkam a'ninthava'laay umathu valathupaarisaththil ni'rki'raa'l.
kumaaraththiyea kea'l, nee un seviyaich saayththuch sinthiththukko'l; un janaththaiyum un thakappan veettaiyum ma'ranthuvidu.
appozhuthu raajaa un azhakil piriyappaduvaar; avar un aa'ndavar, aakaiyaal avaraip pa'ninthuko'l.
theeru kumaaraththi kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaruvaa'l; janangka'lil aisuvariyavaanka'lum un thayavai naadi va'nangkuvaarka'l.
