raajakumaaraththi u'l'laakap poora'na makimaiyu'l'lava'l; ava'l udai po'rsarikaiyaayirukki'rathu.

siththiraththaiyalaadai thariththava'laay, raajaavinidaththil azhaiththukko'nduvarappaduvaa'l; ava'l pinnaalea sellum ava'ludaiya thoazhika'laakiya kannikaika'l ummidaththil koottikko'nduvarappaduvaarka'l.
avarka'l makizhchchiyoadum ka'lippoadum vanthu, raaja aramanaikku'l piraveasippaarka'l.
umathu pithaakka'lukkup pathilaaka umathu kumaarar iruppaarka'l; avarka'laip poomiyengkum pirapukka'laaka vaippeer.
umathu naamaththai ellaath thalaimu'raika'lilum pirasthaapappaduththuvean, ithinimiththam janangka'l ummai en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum thuthippaarka'l.
theavan namakku adaikkalamum pelanum, aapaththukkaalaththil anukoolamaana thu'naiyumaanavar.
aakaiyaal poomi nilaimaa'rinaalum, malaika'l naduchsamuththiraththil saaynthupoanaalum,
athin jalangka'l kontha'liththup pongki, athin perukkinaal parvathangka'l athirnthaalum, naam payappadoam. (sealaa.)
oru nathiyu'ndu, athin neerkkaalka'l theavanudaiya nakaraththaiyum, unnathamaanavar vaasampa'n'num parisuththa sthalaththaiyum santhoashippikkum.
theavan athin naduvil irukki'raar, athu asaiyaathu; athikaalaiyilea theavan atha'rkuch sakaayampa'n'nuvaar.
jaathika'l kontha'liththathu, raajyangka'l thaththa'liththathu; avar thamathu saththaththai muzhangkappa'n'ninaar, poomi urukippoayit'ru.
seanaika'lin karththar nammoadirukki'raar; yaakkoapin theavan namakku uyarntha adaikkalamaanavar. (sealaa.)
poomiyilea paazhkkadippuka'lai nadappikki'ra karththarudaiya seykaika'lai vanthu paarungka'l.
avar poomiyin kadaimunaimattum yuththangka'lai oayappa'n'nuki'raar; villai odiththu, eettiyai mu'rikki'raar; irathangka'lai neruppinaal sutterikki'raar.
neengka'l amarnthirunthu, naanea theavanen'ru a'rinthuko'l'lungka'l; jaathika'lukku'l'lea uyarnthiruppean, poomiyilea uyarnthiruppean.
seanaika'lin karththar nammoadirukki'raar, yaakkoapin theavan namakku uyarntha adaikkalamaanavar. (sealaa.)
sakala janangka'lea, kaikotti, theavanukku munpaakak kempeerasaththamaay aarppariyungka'l.
unnathamaanavaraakiya karththar payangkaramaanavarum, poomiyinmeethengkum makaththuvamaana raajaavumaayirukki'raar.
janangka'lai namakku vasappaduththi, jaathika'lai nammudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththuvaar.
thamakkup piriyamaana yaakkoapin si'rappaana theasaththai namakkuch suthantharamaakath therintha'lippaar. (sealaa.)
theavan aarpparippoadum, karththar ekkaa'la saththaththoadum uyara ezhuntharu'linaar.
theavanaip poat'rip paadungka'l, paadungka'l; nammudaiya raajaavaip poat'rip paadungka'l, paadungka'l.
theavan poomiyanaiththi'rkum raajaa; karuththudanea avaraip poat'rip paadungka'l.
theavan jaathika'lmeal arasaa'luki'raar; theavan thamathu parisuththa singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'raar.
janangka'lin pirapukka'l aapirakaamin theavanudaiya janangka'laakach searkkappaduki'raarka'l; poomiyin keadakangka'l theavanudaiyavaika'l; avar makaa unnathamaanavar.
karththar periyavar, avar namathu theavanudaiya nakaraththilum, thamathu parisuththa parvathaththilum mikavum thuthikkappadaththakkavar.
vadathisaiyilu'l'la seeyoan parvatham vadippamaana sthaanamum sarvapoomiyin makizhchchiyumaayirukki'rathu, athuvea makaaraajaavin nakaram.
athin aramanaika'lil theavan uyarntha adaikkalamaaka a'riyappattirukki'raar.
ithoa, raajaakka'l koodikko'ndu, eakamaayk kadanthuvanthaarka'l.
avarka'l athaik ka'ndapoathu piramiththuk kalangki virainthoadinaarka'l.
angkea nadukkangko'ndu, pirasavaveathanaippaduki'ra sthireeyaippoala veathanaippattaarka'l.
keezhkkaat'rinaal tharsheesin kappalka'lai neer udaikki'reer.
naam kea'lvippattapadiyea namathu theavanudaiya nakaramaakiya seanaika'ludaiya karththarin nakaraththilea ka'ndoam; theavan athai en'ren'raikkum sthirappaduththuvaar. (sealaa.)
theavanea, umathu aalayaththin naduvilea, umathu kirupaiyaich sinthiththuk ko'ndirukki'roam.
theavanea, umathu naamam vi'langkuki'rathupoala umathu pukazhchchiyum poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'l pariyanthamum vi'langkuki'rathu; umathu valathukaram neethiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'linimiththam seeyoan parvatham makizhvathaaka, yoothaavin kumaaraththika'l ka'likooruvaarka'laaka.
seeyoanaich sut'ri ulaavi, athin koththa'langka'lai e'n'nungka'l.
pinvarum santhathikku neengka'l vivarippatha'rkaaka, athin alangkaththaik kavaniththu, athin aramanaika'lai ut'ruppaarungka'l.
inthath theavan en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum nammudaiya theavan; mara'napariyantham nammai nadaththuvaar.
janangka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum ithaik kea'lungka'l.
poomiyin kudika'lea, si'riyoarum periyoarum aisuvariyavaanka'lum e'liyavarka'lumaakiya neengka'l ellaarum eakamaaych sevikodungka'l.
en vaay gnaanaththaip peasum; en iruthayam u'narvaith thiyaanikkum.
en seviyai uvamaimozhikkuch saayththu, en ma'raiporu'laich surama'ndalaththinmeal ve'lippaduththuvean.
ennaith thodaruki'ravarka'ludaiya akkiramam ennaich soozhnthuko'l'lun theengkunaadka'lil, naan payappadavea'ndiyathenna?
thangka'l selvaththai nampi thangka'l thira'laana aisuvariyaththinaal perumaipaaraattuki'ra,
oruvanaavathu, than sakoatharan azhivaik kaa'naamal ini en'raikkum uyiroadirukkumpadi,
evvithaththinaalaavathu avanai meettukko'l'lavum, avanimiththam meedkumporu'lai theavanukkuk kodukkavungkoodaathea.
avarka'l aaththumameedpu mikavum arumaiyaayirukki'rathu; athu orupoathum mudiyaathu.
gnaanika'lum mariththu, agngnaanika'lum nirmoodarum eakamaay azhinthu, thangka'l aasthiyai mat'ravarka'lukku vaiththuppoaki'rathaik kaa'nki'raan.

thangka'l veeduka'l niththiyakaalamaakavum, thangka'l vaasasthalangka'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakavum irukkumenpathu avarka'l u'l'laththin apippiraayam; avarka'l thangka'l naamangka'laith thangka'l nilangka'lukkuth tharikki'raarka'l.
aakilum kanamporunthiyavanaayirukki'ra manushan nilaiththirukki'rathillai; azhinthupoakum mirukangka'lukku oppaayirukki'raan.
ithuthaan avarka'l vazhi, ithuthaan avarka'l paiththiyam; aakilum avarka'l santhathiyaar avarka'l sollai mechchikko'l'luki'raarka'l. (sealaa.)

aattumanthaiyaippoalap paathaa'laththilea kidaththappaduki'raarka'l; mara'nam avarka'lai meaynthupoadum; semmaiyaanavarka'l athikaalaiyil avarka'lai aa'nduko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l vaasasthalaththil nilaiththirukkakkoodaathapadi avarka'ludaiya roopaththaip paathaa'lam azhikkum.
aanaalum theavan en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththin vallamaikkuth thappuviththu meedpaar, avar ennai eat'rukko'lvaar. (sealaa.)
oruvan aisuvariyavaanaaki, avan veettin makimai perukumpoathu, nee payappadaathea.
avan marikkumpoathu on'rum ko'ndupoavathillai; avan makimai avanaip pinpat'rich selvathumillai.
avan uyiroadirukkaiyil than aaththumaavai vaazhththinaalum: nee unakku nanmaiyai naadinaay en'ru manushar avanaip pukazhnthaalum,
avan en'ren'raikkum ve'lichchaththaik kaa'naatha than pithaakka'lin santhathiyaich searuvaan.
kanam porunthinavanaayirunthum a'rivillaatha manushan azhinthupoakum mirukangka'lukku oppaayirukki'raan.
vallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththar vasaniththu, sooriyan uthikkun thisaithodangki athu asthamikkun thisaivaraikkumu'l'la poomiyaik kooppiduki'raar.
poora'navadivu'l'la seeyoanilirunthu theavan pirakaasikki'raar.
nammudaiya theavan varuvaar, mavunamaayiraar; avarukkumun akkini padchikkum; avaraich sut'rilum makaa pusal kontha'lippaayirukkum.
avar thammudaiya janaththai niyaayantheerkka uyara irukkum vaanangka'laiyum poomiyaiyum kooppiduvaar.
paliyinaalea ennoadea udanpadikkai pa'n'nina ennudaiya parisuththavaanka'lai ennidaththil koottungka'l enpaar.
vaanangka'l avarudaiya neethiyai a'rivikkum; theavanea niyaayaathipathi. (sealaa.)
en janamea, kea'l, naan peasuvean; isravealea, unakku viroathamaaych saadchiyiduvean; naanea theavan, un theavanaayirukki'rean.
un palika'linimiththam unnaik kadinthuko'l'lean; un thakanapalika'l eppoathum enakku munpaaka irukki'rathu.
un veettilirunthu kaa'laika'laiyum, un thozhuvangka'lilirunthu aattukkadaakka'laiyum naan vaangkikko'lvathillai.
sakala kaattujeevanka'lum, parvathangka'lil aayiramaayiramaayth thiriki'ra mirukangka'lum ennudaiyavaika'l.
malaika'lilu'l'la pa'ravaika'laiyellaam a'rivean; ve'liyil nadamaaduki'ravaika'lellaam ennudaiyavaika'l.
naan pasiyaayirunthaal unakkuch sollean; poomiyum athin ni'raivum ennudaiyavaika'lea.
naan eruthuka'lin maamsam pusiththu, aattukkadaakka'lin iraththam kudippeanoa?
nee theavanukku sthoaththirapaliyittu, unnathamaanavarukku un poruththanaika'laich seluththi;
aapaththukkaalaththil ennai noakkik kooppidu; naan unnai viduvippean, nee ennai makimaippaduththuvaay.
theavan thunmaarkkanai noakki: nee en piramaa'nangka'lai eduththuraikkavum, en udanpadikkaiyai un vaayinaal sollavum, unakku enna niyaayamu'ndu.
sidchaiyai nee pakaiththu, en vaarththaika'lai unakkup pinnaaka e'rinthupoaduki'raay.
nee thirudanaik kaa'numpoathu avanoadu orumiththuppoaki'raay; vipasaararoadum unakkup pangku'ndu.
un vaayaip pollaappukkuth thi'rakki'raay, un naavu sa'rpanaiyaip pi'naikki'rathu.
nee udkaarnthu un sakoatharanukku viroathamaayp peasi, un thaayin makanukku avathoo'ru u'ndaakkuki'raay.

ivaika'lai nee seyyumpoathu naan mavunamaayirunthean, unnaippoal naanum iruppean en'ru ninaivu ko'ndaay; aanaalum naan unnaik kadinthuko'ndu, avaika'lai un ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ovvon'raaka ni'ruththuvean.
theavanai ma'rakki'ravarka'lea, ithaich sinthiththukko'l'lungka'l; illaavittaal naan ungka'laip pee'rippoaduvean, oruvarum ungka'lai viduvippathillai.
sthoaththira paliyiduki'ravan ennai makimaippaduththuki'raan; than vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththuki'ravanukku theavanudaiya iradchippai ve'lippaduththuvean en'ru solluki'raar.
theavanea, umathu kirupaiyinpadi enakku irangkum, umathu mikuntha irakkangka'linpadi en mee'ruthalka'l neengka ennaich suththikariyum.
en akkiramam neengka ennai mut'rilum kazhuvi, en paavama'ra ennaich suththikariyum.
en mee'ruthalka'lai naan a'rinthirukki'rean; en paavam eppozhuthum enakku munpaaka ni'rki'rathu.

theavareer oruvarukkea viroathamaaka naan paavagnseythu, umathu ka'nka'lukku munpaakap pollaangkaanathai nadappiththean; neer peasumpoathu ummudaiya neethi vi'langkavum, neer niyaayantheerkkumpoathu ummudaiya parisuththam vi'langkavum ithai a'rikkaiyiduki'rean.
ithoa, naan thurkku'naththil uruvaanean; en thaay ennaip paavaththil karppanthariththaa'l.
ithoa, u'l'laththil u'nmaiyirukka virumpuki'reer; anthakkara'naththil gnaanaththai enakkuth theriyappaduththuveer.
neer ennai eesoappinaal suththikariyum, appozhuthu naan suththamaavean; ennaik kazhuviyaru'lum, appozhuthu naan u'raintha mazhaiyilum ve'nmaiyaavean.
naan santhoashamum makizhchchiyum keadkumpadi seyyum, appozhuthu neer no'rukkina elumpuka'l ka'likoorum.
en paavangka'laip paaraathapadikku neer umathu mukaththai ma'raiththu, en akkiramangka'laiyellaam neekkiyaru'lum.
theavanea, suththa iruthayaththai ennilea sirushdiyum, nilaivaramaana aaviyai en u'l'laththilea puthuppiyum.
umathu samukaththai vittu ennaith tha'l'laamalum, umathu parisuththa aaviyai ennidaththilirunthu eduththukko'l'laamalum irum.
umathu iradcha'niyaththin santhoashaththaith thirumpavum enakkuth thanthu, u'rchaakamaana aavi ennaith thaangkumpadi seyyum.
appozhuthu paathakarukku umathu vazhika'lai upatheasippean; paavika'l ummidaththil mananthirumpuvaarka'l.
theavanea, ennai iradchikkun theavanea, iraththappazhika'lukku ennai neengkalaakkividum; appozhuthu en naavu ummudaiya neethiyaik kempeeramaayppaadum.
aa'ndavarea, en uthaduka'laith thi'rantharu'lum; appozhuthu en vaay ummudaiya pukazhai a'rivikkum.
paliyai neer virumpuki'rathillai, virumpinaal seluththuvean; thakanapaliyum umakkup piriyamaanathalla.
theavanukkea'rkum palika'l no'rungku'nda aavithaan; theavanea, no'rungku'ndathum narungku'ndathumaana iruthayaththai neer pu'rakka'niyeer.
seeyoanukku umathu piriyaththinpadi nanmaiseyyum; erusaleamin mathilka'laik kattuveeraaka.
appozhuthu thakanapaliyum sarvaangka thakanapaliyumaakiya neethiyin palika'lil piriyappaduveer; appozhuthu umathu peedaththinmeal kaa'laika'laip paliyiduvaarka'l.
palavaanea, pollaappil ean perumaipaaraattuki'raay? theavanudaiya kirupai ennaa'lumu'l'lathu.
nee keaduka'laich seyya eththanampa'n'nuki'raay, kapaduseyyum un naavu theettappatta savarakan kaththiyaippoal irukki'rathu.
nanmaiyaippaarkkilum theemaiyaiyum, yathaarththam peasuki'rathaippaarkkilum poyyaiyum virumpuki'raay. (sealaa.)
kapadamu'l'la naavea, sangkarikkum sakala vaarththaika'laiyum nee virumpuki'raay.

theavan unnai en'ren'raikkum iraathapadi azhiththuppoaduvaar; avar unnaip pidiththu, un vaasasthalaththilirunthu pidungki, nee jeevanu'l'loar theasaththil iraathapadikku unnai nirmoolamaakkuvaar. (sealaa.)
neethimaanka'l athaik ka'ndu payanthu, avanaippaarththu nakaiththu:
ithoa, theavanaith than pelanaaka e'n'naamal, than selvapperukkaththai nampi, than theevinaiyil palaththukko'nda manushan ivanthaan enpaarka'l.
naanoa theavanudaiya aalayaththil pachchaiyaana olivamaraththaippoalirukki'rean, theavanudaiya kirupaiyai en'ren'raikkum nampiyirukki'rean.
neerea ithaich seytheer en'ru ummai en'ren'raikkum thuthiththu, umathu naamaththi'rkuk kaaththiruppean; ummudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukku munpaaka athu nalamaayirukki'rathu.
theavan illai en'ru mathikeadan than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'luki'raan; avarka'l thangka'laik keduththu, aruvaruppaana akkiramangka'laich seythuvaruki'raarka'l; nanmaiseyki'ravan oruvanum illai.
theavanaith theaduki'ra u'narvu'l'lavan u'ndoa en'ru paarkka, theavan paraloakaththilirunthu manupuththiraraik ka'n'noakkinaar.
avarka'l ellaarum vazhivilaki, eakamaayk kettuppoanaarka'l; nanmaiseyki'ravan illai, oruvanaakilum illai.
akkiramakkaararukku a'rivu illaiyaa? appaththaip padchikki'rathupoal en janaththaip padchikki'raarka'lea; avarka'l theavanaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'rathillai.

unakku viroathamaayp paa'layami'rangkinavanudaiya elumpuka'laith theavan sitha'rappa'n'ninapadiyaal, payamillaatha idaththil mikavum payanthaarka'l; theavan avarka'lai ve'ruththapadiyinaal nee avarka'lai vedkappaduththinaay.
seeyoanilirunthu isravealukku iradchippu varuvathaaka; theavan thammudaiya janaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, yaakkoapukkuk ka'lippum isravealukku makizhchchiyum u'ndaakum.
theavanea, umathu naamaththinimiththam ennai iradchiththu, umathu vallamaiyinaal enakku niyaayagnseyyum.
theavanea, en vi'n'nappaththaikkeattu, en vaayin vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodum.
anniyar enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'raarka'l; kodiyar en piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'raarka'l; theavanaith thangka'lukku munpaaka ni'ruththi noakkaarka'l. (sealaa.)
ithoa, theavan enakkuch sakaayar; aa'ndavar en aaththumaavai aatharikki'ravarka'loadea irukki'raar.
avar en saththurukka'lukkuth theemaikkuth theemaiyaich sarikkattuvaar, umathu saththiyaththinimiththam avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkum.
u'rchaakaththudan naan umakkup paliyiduvean; karththaavea, umathu naamaththaith thuthippean, athu nalamaanathu.
avar ellaa nerukkaththaiyum neekki, ennai viduviththaar; en ka'n en saththurukka'lil neethi sarikkattuthalaik ka'ndathu.
theavanea, en jepaththaik keattaru'lum; en vi'n'nappaththi'rku ma'rainthiraatheayum.
enakkuch sevikoduththu, uththaravu aru'lichseyyum; saththuruvinudaiya kookkuralinimiththamum, thunmaarkkar seyyum idukkaththinimiththamum en thiyaanaththil mu'raiyiduki'rean.
avarka'l enmeal pazhisaatti, kuroathangko'ndu, ennaip pakaikki'raarka'l.
en iruthayam enakku'l viyaakulappaduki'rathu; mara'naththikil enmeal vizhunthathu.
payamum nadukkamum ennaip pidiththathu; arukka'lippu ennai moodit'ru.
appozhuthu naan: aa, enakkup pu'raavaippoal si'rakuka'l irunthaal, naan pa'ranthupoay i'laippaa'ruvean.
naan thooraththil alainthu thirinthu vanaantharaththil thangkiyiruppean. (sealaa.)
perungkaat'rukkum pusalukkum thappath theeviriththukko'l'luvean en'rean.
aa'ndavarea, avarka'lai azhiththu, avarka'l paashaiyaip pirinthupoakappa'n'num; kodumaiyaiyum sa'ndaiyaiyum nakaraththilea ka'ndean;
avaika'l iravum pakalum athin mathilka'lmeal sut'riththiriki'rathu; akkiramamum vaathaiyum athin naduvil irukki'rathu;
keadupaaduka'l athin naduvil irukki'rathu; kodumaiyum kapadum athin veethiyai vittu vilakippoaki'rathillai.
ennai ninthiththavan saththuru alla, appadiyirunthaal sakippean; enakku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattinavan en pakaignan alla, appadiyirunthaal avanukku ma'rainthiruppean.
enakkuch samamaana manushanum, en vazhikaattiyum, en thoazhanumaakiya neeyea avan.
naam orumiththu, inpamaana aaloasanaipa'n'ni, koottaththoadea theavaalayaththukkup poanoam.
mara'nam avarka'laith thodarnthu pidippathaaka; avarka'l uyiroadea paathaa'laththil i'rangkuvaarka'laaka; avarka'l vaasasthalangka'lilum avarka'l u'l'laththilum pollaangku irukki'rathu.
naanoa theavanai noakkik kooppiduvean; karththar ennai iradchippaar.
anthisanthi maththiyaana vea'laika'lilum naan thiyaanampa'n'ni mu'raiyiduvean; avar en saththaththaik keadpaar.
thira'laana koottamaayk koodi ennoadu ethirththaarka'l; avaroa enakku nearitta poarai neekki, en aaththumaavaich samaathaanaththudan meettuvittaar.
aathimuthalaay veet'rirukki'ra theavan keattu, avarka'lukkup pathila'lippaar; avarka'lukku maa'ruthalka'l nearidaathathinaal, avarka'l theavanukkup payappadaama'rpoaki'raarka'l. (sealaa.)
avan thannoadea samaathaanamaayirunthavarka'lukku viroathamaay than kaiyai neetti, than udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri nadanthaan.
avan vaayin so'rka'l ve'n'neyaippoala methuvaanavaika'l, avan iruthayamoa yuththam; avan vaarththaika'l e'n'neyilum miruthuvaanavaika'l, aanaalum avaika'l uruvina pattayangka'l.
karththarmeal un paaraththai vaiththuvidu, avar unnai aatharippaar; neethimaanai orupoathum tha'l'laadavottaar.

theavanea, neer avarka'lai azhivin kuzhiyil i'rangkappa'n'nuveer; iraththappiriyarum soothu'l'la manusharum thangka'l aayu'lin naadka'lil paathivaraiyilaakilum pizhaiththirukkamaattaarka'l; naanoa ummai nampiyirukki'rean.
theavanea, enakku irangkum; manushan ennai vizhungkappaarkki'raan; naa'lthoa'rum poarseythu, ennai odukkuki'raan.
en saththurukka'l naa'lthoa'rum ennai vizhungkappaarkki'raarka'l; unnathamaanavarea, enakku viroathamaay akangkariththup poarseyki'ravarka'l aneakar.
naan payappaduki'ra naa'lil ummai nampuvean.
theavanai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pukazhuvean; theavanai nampiyirukki'rean, naan payappadean; maamsamaanavan enakku enna seyvaan?
niththamum en vaarththaika'laip purattuki'raarka'l; enakkuth theengkuseyvathea avarka'l muzhu e'n'namaayirukki'rathu.
avarka'l eakamaayk koodi, pathivirukki'raarka'l; en piraa'nanai vaangka virumpi, en kaaladika'laith thodarnthuvaruki'raarka'l.
avarka'l thangka'l akkiramaththinaal thappuvaarka'loa? theavanea, koapangko'ndu janangka'laik keezhea tha'l'lum.
en alaichchalka'laith theavareer e'n'niyirukki'reer; en ka'n'neerai ummudaiya thuruththiyil vaiyum; avaika'l ummudaiya ka'nakkil allavoa irukki'rathu?
naan ummai noakkik kooppidum naa'lil en saththurukka'l pinnittuth thirumpuvaarka'l; theavan en padchaththil irukki'raar enpathai a'rivean.
theavanai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pukazhuvean; karththarai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pukazhuvean.
theavanai nampiyirukki'rean, naan payappadean; manushan enakku ennaseyvaan?
theavanea, naan umakkup pa'n'nina poruththanaika'l enmeal irukki'rathu; umakku sthoaththirangka'laich seluththuvean.
naan theavanukku munpaaka jeevanu'l'loarudaiya ve'lichchaththilea nadakkumpadi, neer en aaththumaavai mara'naththukkum en kaalka'lai ida'ralukkum thappuviyaathiruppeeroa?
enakku irangkum, theavanea, enakku irangkum; ummai en aaththumaa a'ndikko'l'luki'rathu; vikkinangka'l kadanthupoakumattum umathu settaika'lin nizhalilea vanthu adaivean.
enakkaaka yaavaiyum seythu mudikkappoaki'ra theavanaakiya unnathamaana theavanai noakkik kooppiduvean.
ennai vizhungkappaarkki'ravan ennai ninthikkaiyil, avar paraloakaththilirunthu oththaasai anuppi, ennai iradchippaar: (sealaa.) theavan thamathu kirupaiyaiyum thamathu saththiyaththaiyum anuppuvaar.

en aaththumaa singkangka'lin naduvilirukki'rathu; theeyai i'raikki'ra manupuththirarukku'l'lea kidakki'rean; avarka'l pa'rka'l eettika'lum ampuka'lum, avarka'l naavu karukkaana pattayamumaayirukki'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangka'lukku mealaaka uyarntharu'lum; umathu makimai poomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaka.
en kaalka'lukkuk ka'n'niyai vaiththirukki'raarka'l; en aaththumaa thoynthupoayit'ru; enakku munpaakak kuzhiyai vetti, athin naduvilea vizhunthaarka'l. (sealaa.)
en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu, theavanea, en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; naan paadik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
en makimaiyea, vizhi; vee'naiyea, surama'ndalamea, vizhiyungka'l; athikaalaiyil vizhiththukko'lvean.
aa'ndavarea, janangka'lukku'l'lea ummaith thuthippean; jaathika'lukku'l'lea ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
umathu kirupai vaanapariyanthamum, umathu saththiyam meakama'ndalangka'lpariyanthamum ettuki'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangka'lukkumealaaka uyarntharu'lum; umathu makimai poomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaka.
mavunamaayirukki'ravarka'lea, neengka'l meyyaay neethiyaip peasuveerka'loa? manupuththirarea, niyaayamaayth theerppuseyveerka'loa?
manathaara niyaayakkeadu seyki'reerka'l; poomiyilea ungka'l kaika'lin kodumaiyai ni'ruththuk kodukki'reerka'l.
thunmaarkkar karppaththil u'rpaviththathumuthal peathalikki'raarka'l; thaayin vayit'rilirunthu pi'ranthathumuthal poy solli vazhithappip poaki'raarka'l.
sarppaththin vishaththi'rku oppaana visham avarka'lil irukki'rathu.
paampaattika'l vinoathamaay oothinaalum avarka'l oothum saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaathapadikkuth than kaathai adaikki'ra sevittu viriyanaippoal irukki'raarka'l.
theavanea, avarka'l vaayilu'l'la pa'rka'laith thakarththuppoadum; karththaavea, paalasingkangka'lin kadaivaayppa'rka'lai no'rukkippoadum.
kadanthoaduki'ra tha'n'neeraippoal avarka'l kazhinthupoakattum; avan than ampuka'laith thodukkumpoathu avaika'l sinnapinnamaayp poakakkadavathu.
karainthupoaki'ra naththaiyaippoal ozhinthupoavaarka'laaka; sthireeyin muthiraap pi'ndaththaippoal sooriyanaik kaa'naathiruppaarka'laaka.
mu'l neruppinaal ungka'l paanaika'lil soodea'rumunnea pachchaiyaanathaiyum erinthupoanathaiyum avar suzhalkaat'rinaal adiththukko'ndupoavaar.
pazhivaangkuthalai neethimaan kaa'numpoathu makizhuvaan; avan than paathangka'laith thunmaarkkanudaiya iraththaththilea kazhuvuvaan.
appozhuthu, meyyaay neethimaanukkup palan u'nden'rum, meyyaay poomiyilea niyaayagnseyki'ra theavan u'nden'rum manushan solluvaan.
en theavanea, en saththurukka'lukku ennaith thappuviyum; enmeal ezhumpuki'ravarka'lukku ennai vilakki uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaiyum.
akkiramakkaararukku ennaith thappuviththu, iraththappiriyaraana manusharukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
ithoa, en piraa'nanukkup pathivirukki'raarka'l; karththaavea, ennidaththil mee'ruthalum paavamum illaathirunthum, palavaanka'l enakku viroathamaayk koottangkooduki'raarka'l.
ennidaththil akkiramam illaathirunthum, oadiththirinthu yuththaththukku aayaththamaaki'raarka'l; enakkuth thu'naiseyya vizhiththu ennai noakkippaarum.
seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, isravealin theavanea, neer sakala jaathika'laiyum visaarikka vizhiththezhumpum; vagnchakamaayth thuroakagnseyki'ra oruvarukkum thayai seyyaatheayum. (sealaa.)
avarka'l saayangkaalaththil thirumpivanthu, naayka'laippoala oo'laiyittu, ooraichsut'rith thiriki'raarka'l.
ithoa, thangka'l vaarththaika'laik kakkuki'raarka'l; avarka'l uthaduka'lil pattayangka'l irukki'rathu, keadki'ravan yaar enki'raarka'l.
aanaalum karththaavea, neer avarka'laip paarththu nakaippeer; pu'rajaathika'l yaavaraiyum ikazhuveer.
avan vallamaiyai naan ka'ndu, umakkuk kaaththiruppean; theavanea enakku uyarntha adaikkalam.
en theavan thammudaiya kirupaiyinaal ennaich santhippaar; theavan en saththurukka'lukkuvarum neethisarikkattuthalai naan kaa'numpadi seyvaar.
avarka'laik kon'rupoadaatheayum, en janangka'l ma'ranthupoavaarka'lea; engka'l keadakamaakiya aa'ndavarea, umathu vallamaiyinaal avarka'laich sitha'radiththu, avarka'laith thaazhththippoadum.
avarka'l uthaduka'lin peachchu avarka'l vaayin paavamaayirukki'rathu; avarka'l itta saapamum solliya poyyum aakiya ivaika'linimiththam thangka'l perumaiyil akappaduvaarka'laaka.

theavan poomiyin ellaivaraikkum yaakkoapilea arasaa'luki'ravar en'ru avarka'l a'riyumporuttu, avarka'lai ummudaiya ukkiraththilea nirmoolamaakkum; ini iraathapadikku avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkum. (sealaa.)
avarka'l saayangkaalaththil thirumpivanthu, naayka'laippoala oo'laiyittu, ooraichsut'rith thiriki'raarka'l.
avarka'l u'navukkaaka alainthu thirinthu thirupthiyadaiyaamal, mu'rumu'ruththukko'ndiruppaarka'l.
naanoa ummudaiya vallamaiyaip paadi, kaalaiyilea ummudaiya kirupaiyai makizhchchiyoadu pukazhuvean; enakku nerukkamu'ndaana naa'lilea neer enakkuth thagnchamum uyarntha adaikkalamumaaneer.
en pelanea, ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean; theavan enakku uyarntha adaikkalamum, kirupaiyu'l'la en theavanumaayirukki'raar.
theavanea, neer engka'laik kaivitteer, engka'laich sitha'radiththeer, engka'lmeal koapamaayiruntheer; ma'rupadiyum engka'lidamaayth thirumpiyaru'lum.
poomiyai athirappa'n'ni, athai vedippaakkineer; athin vedippuka'laip porunthappa'n'num; athu asaikin'rathu.
ummudaiya janangka'lukkuk kadinamaana kaariyaththaik kaa'npiththeer; thaththa'lippin mathupaanaththai engka'lukkuk kudikkak koduththeer.
saththiyaththinimiththam eat'rumpadiyaaka, umakkup payanthu nadakki'ravarka'lukku oru kodiyaik koduththeer. (sealaa.)
umathu piriyar viduvikkappadumpadi, umathu valathukaraththinaal iradchiththu, enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum.
theavan thamathu parisuththaththaikko'ndu vi'lampinaar, aakaiyaal ka'likooruvean; seekeamaip pangkittu, sukkoaththin pa'l'laththaakkai a'lanthuko'l'luvean.
keeleayaath ennudaiyathu, manaaseayum ennudaiyathu, eppiraayeem en thalaiyin pelan, yoothaa en niyaayappiramaa'nikan.
moavaap en paathapaaththiram, eathoaminmeal en paatharadchaiyai e'rinthupoaduvean; pelisthiyaavea, ennimiththam aarppariththukko'l.
ara'naana patta'naththi'rku'l ennai nadaththikko'ndupoaki'ravar yaar? eathoammattum enakku vazhikaattuki'ravar yaar?
engka'l seanaika'loadea pu'rappadaamaliruntha theavareer allavoa? engka'laith tha'l'livittiruntha theavareer allavoa?
ikkattil engka'lukku uthaviseyyum; manushanudaiya uthavi viruthaa.
theavanaalea paraakkiramam seyvoam; avarea engka'l saththurukka'lai mithiththuppoaduvaar.
theavanea, en kooppiduthalaik keattu, en vi'n'nappaththaik kavaniyum.
en iruthayam thoyyumpoathu poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu ummai noakkik kooppiduvean; enakku ettaatha uyaramaana kanmalaiyil ennaik ko'ndupoayvidum.
neer enakku adaikkalamum, saththuruvukku ethirea pelaththa thurukamumaayiruntheer.
naan ummudaiya koodaaraththil sathaakaalamum thangkuvean; umathu settaika'lin ma'raivilea vanthu adaivean. (sealaa.)
theavanea, neer en poruththanaika'laik keatteer; umathu naamaththi'rkup payappaduki'ravarka'lin suthantharaththai enakkuth thantheer.
raajaavin naadka'loadea naadka'laik koottuveer; avar varushangka'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka irukkum.
avar theavanukku munpaaka en'ren'raikkum nilaiththiruppaar; thayaiyum u'nmaiyum avaraik kaakkak katta'laiyidum.
ippadiyea thinamum en poruththanaika'lai naan seluththumpadiyaaka, umathu naamaththai en'raikkum keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
theavanaiyea noakki en aaththumaa amarnthirukki'rathu; avaraal en iradchippu varum.
avarea en kanmalaiyum, en iradchippum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaanavar; naan athikamaay asaikkappaduvathillai.
neengka'l ethuvaraikkum oru manushanukkuth theengkuseyya ninaippeerka'l, neengka'l anaivarum sangkarikkappaduveerka'l, saaynthamathilukkum idinthasuvarukkum oppaaveerka'l.

avanudaiya meanmaiyilirunthu avanaith tha'l'lumpadikkea avarka'l aaloasanaipa'n'ni, apaththampeasa virumpuki'raarka'l; thangka'l vaayinaal aaseervathiththu, thangka'l u'l'laththil sapikki'raarka'l. (sealaa.)
en aaththumaavea, theavanaiyea noakki amarnthiru; naan nampuki'rathu avaraalea varum.
avarea en kanmalaiyum, en iradchippum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaanavar; naan asaikkappaduvathillai.
en iradchippum, en makimaiyum theavanidaththil irukki'rathu; pelanaana en kanmalaiyum en adaikkalamum theavanukku'l irukki'rathu.
janangka'lea, ekkaalaththilum avarai nampungka'l; avar samukaththil ungka'l iruthayaththai oot'rividungka'l; theavan namakku adaikkalamaayirukki'raar. (sealaa.)
keezhmakka'l maayaiyum, meanmakka'l poyyumaamea; tharaasilea vaikkappattaal avarka'lellaarum maayaiyilum leasaanavarka'l.
kodumaiyai nampaathirungka'l; ko'l'laiyinaal perumaipaaraattaathirungka'l; aisuvariyam viruththiyaanaal iruthayaththai athinmeal vaikkaatheayungka'l.
theavan orutharam vi'lampinaar, ira'ndutharam keattirukki'rean; vallamai theavanudaiyathu enpathea.
kirupaiyum ummudaiyathu, aa'ndavarea! theavareer avanavan seykaikkuth thakkathaakap palana'likki'reer.

theavanea, neer ennudaiya theavan; athikaalamea ummaith theaduki'rean; va'ra'ndathum vidaayththathum tha'n'neerat'rathumaana nilaththilea en aaththumaa ummeal thaakamaayirukki'rathu, en maamsamaanathu ummai vaagnchikki'rathu.
ippadiyea parisuththa sthalaththil ummaippaarkka aasaiyaayirunthu, umathu vallamaiyaiyum umathu makimaiyaiyum ka'ndean.
jeevanaippaarkkilum umathu kirupai nallathu; en uthaduka'l ummaith thuthikkum.
en jeevanu'l'lamattum naan ummaith thuthiththu, umathu naamaththaich sollik kaiyeduppean.
ni'naththaiyum kozhuppaiyum u'ndathupoala en aaththumaa thirupthiyaakum; en vaay aananthakka'lippu'l'la uthaduka'laal ummaip poat'rum.
en padukkaiyinmeal naan ummai ninaikkumpoathu, iraachsaamangka'lil ummaith thiyaanikki'rean.
neer enakkuth thu'naiyaayirunthathinaal, umathu settaika'lin nizhalilea ka'likooruki'rean.
en aaththumaa ummaith thodarnthu pat'rikko'ndirukki'rathu; umathu valathukaram ennaith thaangkuki'rathu.
en piraa'nanai azhikkath theaduki'ravarka'loa, poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil i'rangkuvaarka'l.
avarka'l pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; narika'lukku iraiyaavaarka'l.
raajaavoa theavanil ka'likooruvaar; avarpearil saththiyampa'n'nuki'ravarka'l yaavarum meanmaipaaraattuvaarka'l; poy peasuki'ravarka'lin vaay adaikkappadum.
theavanea, en vi'n'nappaththil en saththaththaik keattaru'lum; saththuruvaal varum payaththai neekki, en piraa'nanaik kaaththaru'lum.
thunmaarkkar seyyum irakasiya aaloasanaikkum, akkiramakkaararudaiya kalakaththukkum ennai vilakki ma'raiththaru'lum.
avarka'l thangka'l naavaip pattayaththaippoal koormaiyaakki,
ma'raivuka'lil uththamanmeal eyyumporuttuk kasappaana vaarththaika'laakiya thangka'l ampuka'lai naa'neat'ruki'raarka'l; sat'rum payamin'rich sadithiyil avanmeal eyki'raarka'l.
avarka'l pollaatha kaariyaththil thangka'lai u'ruthippaduththikko'ndu, ma'raivaana ka'n'nika'lai vaikka aaloasanaipa'n'ni, avaika'laik kaa'npavan yaar enki'raarka'l.
avarka'l niyaayakkeaduka'lai aaynthutheadi, thanthiramaana yoasanai ni'raivea'rumpadi pirayaththanampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'lil ovvoruvanudaiya udkaruththum iruthayamum aazhamaayirukki'rathu.
aanaalum theavan avarka'lmeal ampuka'lai eyvaar, sadithiyaay avarka'l kaayappaduvaarka'l.
avarka'l tha'l'lappattu, keezheavizhumpadi avarka'l naavuka'lea avarka'laik kedukkum; avarka'laik kaa'nki'ra yaavarum oadippoavaarka'l.
ellaa manusharum payanthu, theavanudaiya seyalai a'riviththu, avar kiriyaiyai u'narnthuko'lvaarka'l.
neethimaan karththarukku'l makizhnthu, avarai nampuvaan; semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'l yaavarum meanmaipaaraattuvaarka'l.
theavanea, seeyoanil umakkaakath thuthiyaanathu amainthu kaaththirukki'rathu; poruththanai umakkuch seluththappadum.
jepaththaik keadki'ravarea, maamsamaana yaavarum ummidaththil varuvaarka'l.
akkirama vishayangka'l enmeal mignchi vallamaiko'ndathu; theavareeroa engka'l mee'ruthalka'lai nivirththiyaakkuki'reer.
ummudaiya piraakaarangka'lil vaasamaayirukkumpadi neer therinthuko'ndu searththukko'l'luki'ravan paakkiyavaan; ummudaiya parisuththa aalayamaakiya umathu veettin nanmaiyaal thirupthiyaavoam.

poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lilum thooramaana samuththirangka'lilumu'l'lavarka'l ellaarum nampum nampikkaiyaayirukki'ra engka'l iradchippin theavanea, neer payangkaramaana kaariyangka'laich seyki'rathinaal engka'lukku neethiyu'l'la uththaravu aru'luki'reer.
vallamaiyai idaikattikko'ndu, ummudaiya palaththinaal parvathangka'lai u'ruthippaduththi,
samuththirangka'lin mummuraththaiyum avaika'ludaiya alaika'lin iraichchalaiyum, janangka'lin ama'liyaiyum amarththuki'reer.
kadaiyaanthara idangka'lil kudiyirukki'ravarka'lum ummudaiya adaiyaa'langka'linimiththam payappaduki'raarka'l; kaalaiyaiyum maalaiyaiyum ka'likoorappa'n'nuki'reer.

theavareer poomiyai visaariththu atha'rku neerppaaychchuki'reer; tha'n'neer ni'raintha theavanathiyinaal athai mikavum sezhippaakkuki'reer; ippadi neer athaith thiruththi, avarka'lukkuth thaaniyaththai vi'laivikki'reer.
athin varappuka'l tha'niyaththakkathaay athin padaichchaalka'lukkuth tha'n'neer i'raiththu, athai mazhaika'laal karaiyappa'n'ni, athin payirai aaseervathikki'reer.
varushaththai ummudaiya nanmaiyaal mudisoottuki'reer; umathu paathaika'l neyyaayp pozhiki'rathu.
vanaanthara thaaparangka'lilum pozhiki'rathu; meaduka'l sut'rilum poorippaayirukki'rathu.
meaychchalu'l'la ve'lika'lil aaduka'l ni'rainthirukki'rathu; pa'l'laththaakkuka'l thaaniyaththaal moodiyirukki'rathu; avaika'l kempeeriththup paaduki'rathu.
poomiyin kudika'lea, neengka'l ellaarum theavanukku munpaakak kempeeramaayp paadungka'l.
avar naamaththin makaththuvaththaik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya thuthiyin makimaiyaik ko'ndaadungka'l.
theavanai noakki: umathu kiriyaika'lil evva'lavu payangkaramaayirukki'reer; umathu makaththuvamaana vallamaiyinimiththam ummudaiya saththurukka'l umakku ichchakampeasi adangkuvaarka'l.
poomiyinmeethengkum ummaip pa'ninthuko'ndu ummaith thuthiththup paaduvaarka'l; avarka'l ummudaiya naamaththaith thuthiththup paaduvaarka'l en'ru sollungka'l. (sealaa.)
theavanudaiya seykaika'lai vanthu paarungka'l; avar manupuththiraridaththil nadappikkung kiriyaiyil payangkaramaanavar.
kadalai ularntha tharaiyaaka maat'rinaar; aat'raik kaalnadaiyaayk kadanthaarka'l; angkea avaril ka'likoornthoam.
avar thammudaiya vallamaiyinaal en'ren'raikkum arasaa'luki'raar; avarudaiya ka'nka'l jaathika'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; thuroakika'l thangka'lai uyarththaathiruppaarka'laaka. (sealaa.)
janangka'lea, nammudaiya theavanai sthoaththiriththu, avaraith thuthikkugnsaththaththaik keadkappa'n'nungka'l.
avar nammudaiya kaalka'laith tha'l'laadavottaamal, nammudaiya aaththumaavai uyiroadea vaikki'raar.
theavanea, engka'laich soathiththeer; ve'l'liyaip pudamiduki'rathupoala engka'laip pudamitteer.
engka'lai valaiyil akappaduththi, engka'l iduppuka'linmeal varuththamaana paaraththai eat'rineer.
manusharai engka'l thalaiyinmeal ea'rippoakappa'n'nineer; theeyaiyum tha'n'neeraiyum kadanthuvanthoam; sezhippaana idaththil engka'laik ko'nduvanthu vitteer.
sarvaangka thakanapalika'loadea umathu aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasippean;
en ikkattil naan en uthaduka'laith thi'ranthu, en vaayinaal solliya en poruththanaika'lai umakkuch seluththuvean.
aattukkadaakka'lin ni'nappukaiyudanea kozhumaiyaanavaika'lai umakkuth thakanapaliyaaka iduvean; kaa'laika'laiyum semma'riyaattuk kadaakka'laiyum umakkup paliyiduvean. (sealaa.)
theavanukkup payanthavarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum vanthu kea'lungka'l; avar en aaththumaavukkuch seythathaich solluvean.
avarai noakki en vaayinaal kooppittean, en naavinaal avar pukazhappattaar.
en iruthayaththil akkiramasinthai ko'ndiruntheanaanaal, aa'ndavar enakkuch sevikodaar.
meyyaay theavan enakkuch sevikoduththaar, en jepaththin saththaththaik keattaar.
en jepaththaith tha'l'laamalum, thamathu kirupaiyai ennaivittu vilakkaamalum iruntha theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka.
theavanea, poomiyil ummudaiya vazhiyum, ellaa jaathika'lukku'l'lum ummudaiya iradcha'niyamum vi'langkumpadiyaay,
theavareer engka'lukku irangki, engka'lai aaseervathiththu, ummudaiya mukaththai engka'lmeal pirakaasikkappa'n'num. (sealaa.)
theavanea, janangka'l ummaith thuthippaarka'laaka; sakala janangka'lum ummaith thuthippaarka'laaka.
theavareer janangka'lai nithaanamaay niyaayantheerththu, poomiyilu'l'la jaathika'lai nadaththuveer; aathalaal jaathika'l santhoashiththu, kempeeraththoadea makizhakkadavarka'l. (sealaa.)
theavanea, janangka'l ummaith thuthippaarka'laaka; sakala janangka'lum ummaith thuthippaarka'laaka.
poomi than palanaith tharum, theavanaakiya engka'l theavanea engka'lai aaseervathippaar.
theavan engka'lai aaseervathippaar; poomiyin ellaika'lellaam avarukkup payanthirukkum.
theavan ezhuntharu'luvaar, avarudaiya saththurukka'l sitha'ru'ndu, avaraip pakaikki'ravarka'l avarukku munpaaka oadippoavaarka'l.
pukai pa'rakkadikkappaduvathupoala avarka'laip pa'rakkadippeer; mezhuku akkinikkumun urukuvathupoala thunmaarkkar theavanukkumun azhivaarka'l.
neethimaanka'loa theavanukkumunpaaka makizhnthu ka'likoornthu, aanantha santhoashamadaivaarka'l.

theavanaip paadi, avarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nungka'l; vanaantharangka'lil ea'rivaruki'ravarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l; avarudaiya naamam yeakoavaa, avarukku munpaakak ka'likoorungka'l.
thammudaiya parisuththa vaasasthalaththilirukki'ra theavan, thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lukkuth thakappanum, vithavaika'lukku niyaayam visaarikki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
theavan thanimaiyaanavarka'lukku veeduvaasal ea'rpaduththi, kattu'ndavarka'lai viduthalaiyaakkuki'raar; thuroakika'loa va'ra'nda poomiyil thangkuvaarka'l.
theavanea, neer ummudaiya janangka'lukku munnea sen'ru, avaantharave'liyilea nadanthuvarukaiyil, (sealaa.)
poomi athirnthathu; theavanaakiya umakku munpaaka vaanamum pozhinthathu; isravealin theavanaayirukki'ra theavanukku munpaakavea inthach seenaay malaiyum asainthathu.
theavanea, sampoora'na mazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'nineer; i'laiththuppoana umathu suthantharaththaith thidappaduththineer.
ummudaiya manthai athilea thangkiyirunthathu; theavanea, ummudaiya thayaiyinaalea eazhaika'laip paraamarikki'reer.
aa'ndavar vasanam thanthaar; athaip pirasiththappaduththuki'ravarka'lin koottam mikuthi.
seanaika'lin raajaakka'l thaththa'liththu oadinaarka'l; veettiliruntha sthireeyaanava'l ko'l'laipporu'laip pangkittaa'l.
neengka'l aduppinadiyil kidanthavarka'laayirunthaalum, ve'l'liyaal alangkarikkappatta pu'raachsi'rakuka'lpoalavum, pasumpon ni'ramaakiya athin i'rakuka'lin saayalaakavum iruppeerka'l.
sarvavallavar athil raajaakka'laich sitha'radiththapoathu, athu salmoan malaiyin u'raintha mazhaipoal ve'nmaiyaayit'ru.
theavaparvatham paasaan parvathampoalirukki'rathu; paasaan parvatham uyarntha sikarangka'lu'l'lathu.
uyarntha sikaramu'l'la parvathangka'lea, ean thu'l'luki'reerka'l; inthap parvathaththil vaasamaayirukka theavan virumpinaar; aam, karththar ithilea en'ren'raikkum vaasamaayiruppaar.
theavanudaiya irathangka'l pathinaayirangka'lum, aayiramaayirangka'lumaayirukki'rathu; aa'ndavar parisuththa sthalamaana seenaayilirunthava'n'namaay avaika'lukku'l irukki'raar.

theavareer unnathaththi'rku ea'ri, si'raippattavarka'laich si'raiyaakkik ko'ndupoaneer; theavanaakiya karththar manusharukku'l vaasampa'n'num poruttu, thuroakika'laakiya manusharka'lukkaakavum varangka'laip pet'rukko'ndeer.
ennaa'lum aa'ndavarukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka; nammeal paaragnsumaththinaalum nammai iradchikki'ra theavan avarea. (sealaa.)
nammudaiya theavan iradchippai aru'lum theavanaayirukki'raar; aa'ndavaraakiya karththaraal mara'naththi'rku neengkum vazhika'lu'ndu.
meyyaakavea theavan thammudaiya saththurukka'lin sirasaiyum, than akkiramangka'lil thu'ninthu nadakki'ravanudaiya mayiru'l'la uchchanthalaiyaiyum udaippaar.
un kaalka'l saththurukka'lin iraththaththil pathiyumpadiyaakavum, un naayka'lin naavu athai nakkumpadiyaakavum,
ennudaiya janaththaip paasaanilirunthu thirumpa azhaiththuvaruvean; athaich samuththira aazhangka'lilirunthum thirumpa azhaiththuvaruvean en'ru aa'ndavar sonnaar.
theavanea, ummudaiya nadaika'laik ka'ndaarka'l; en theavanum en raajaavum parisuththa sthalaththilea nadanthuvaruki'ra nadaika'laiyea ka'ndaarka'l.
munnaakap paaduki'ravarka'lum, pinnaaka vee'naika'lai vaasikki'ravarka'lum, sut'rilum thampuru vaasikki'ra kannikaika'lum nadanthaarka'l.
isravealin oot'rilirunthu thoan'rinavarka'lea, sapaika'lin naduvea aa'ndavaraakiya theavanai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
angkea avarka'lai aa'luki'ra sinna penyameenum, yoothaavin pirapukka'lum, avarka'l koottamum, sepuloanin pirapukka'lum, napthaliyin pirapukka'lum u'ndu.
un theavan unakkup palaththaik katta'laiyittaar; theavanea, neer engka'lnimiththam u'ndupa'n'ninathaith thidappaduththum.
erusaleamilu'l'la ummudaiya aalayaththinimiththam, raajaakka'l umakkuk kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

naa'nalilu'l'la mirukakoottaththaiyum, janangka'laakiya kan'ruka'loadukooda rishapa koottaththaiyum athattum; ovvoruvanum ve'l'lippa'nangka'laik ko'nduvanthu pa'ninthuko'l'luvaan; yuththangka'lil piriyappaduki'ra janangka'laich sitha'radippaar.
pirapukka'l ekipthilirunthu varuvaarka'l; eththiyoappiyaa theavanai noakki kaiyedukkath theevirikkum.
poomiyin raajyangka'lea, theavanaip paadi, aa'ndavaraik keerththanam pa'n'nungka'l. (sealaa.)
aathimuthalaayirukki'ra vaanaathi vaanangka'linmeal ezhuntharu'liyirukki'ravaraip paadungka'l; ithoa, thamathu saththaththaip palaththa saththamaay muzhangkappa'n'nuki'raar.
theavanudaiya vallamaiyaip pirasiththappaduththungka'l; avarudaiya makimai isravealinmealum, avarudaiya vallamai meakama'ndalangka'lilum u'l'lathu.

theavanea, umathu parisuththa sthalangka'lilirunthu payangkaramaay vi'langkuki'reer; isravealin theavan thammudaiya janangka'lukkup pelanaiyum saththuvaththaiyum aru'luki'ravar; theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka.
theavanea, ennai iradchiyum; ve'l'langka'l en aaththumaamattum perukivaruki'rathu.
aazhamaana u'laiyil amizhnthirukki'rean, ni'rka nilaiyillai, nilaiyaatha jalaththil aazhnthirukki'rean; ve'l'langka'l enmeal pura'ndupoaki'rathu.
naan kooppiduki'rathinaal i'laiththean; en tho'ndai va'ra'ndupoayit'ru; en theavanukku naan kaaththirukkaiyaal, en ka'nka'l pooththuppoayit'ru.

nimiththamillaamal ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'l en thalaimayirilum athikamaayirukki'raarka'l; vee'naaka enakkuch saththurukka'laaki ennaich sangkarikkavea'ndumen'rirukki'ravarka'l palaththirukki'raarka'l; naan eduththukko'l'laathathai naan kodukka vea'ndiyathaayit'ru.
theavanea, neer en puththiyeenaththai a'rinthirukki'reer; en kut'rangka'l umakku ma'rainthirukkavillai.

seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, umakkaakak kaaththirukki'ravarka'l ennimiththam vedkappattuppoakaathiruppaarka'laaka; isravealin theavanea, ummaith theaduki'ravarka'l ennimiththam naa'namadaiyaathiruppaarka'laaka.
umathunimiththam ninthaiyaich sakiththean; ilachchai en mukaththai moodit'ru.
en sakoathararukku veat'ru manushanum, en thaayin pi'l'laika'lukku anniyanumaanean.
ummudaiya veettaikku'riththu u'ndaana pakthivairaakkiyam ennaip padchiththathu; ummai ninthikki'ravarka'ludaiya ninthanaika'l enmeal vizhunthathu.
en aaththumaa vaadumpadi upavaasiththu azhuthean; athuvum enakku ninthaiyaay mudinthathu.
irattai en uduppaakkinean; appozhuthum avarka'lukkup pazhamozhiyaanean.
vaasalil udkaarnthirukki'ravarka'l enakku viroathamaayp peasuki'raarka'l; mathupaanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lin paadalaanean.
aanaalum karththaavea, anukkirakakaalaththilea ummai noakki vi'n'nappagn seyki'rean; theavanea, umathu mikuntha kirupaiyinaalum umathu iradchippin saththiyaththinaalum enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum.
naan amizhnthippoakaathapadikkuch seat'rinin'ru ennaith thookkividum; ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'linin'rum nilaiyaatha jalaththinin'rum naan neengkumpadi seyyum.
jalappiravaakangka'l enmeal pura'laamalum, aazham ennai vizhungkaamalum, paathaa'lam enmeal than vaayai adaiththukko'l'laamalum iruppathaaka.
karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum, ummudaiya thayai nalamaayirukki'rathu; umathu urukkamaana irakkangka'linpadi ennaik kadaadchiththaru'lum.
umathu mukaththai umathu adiyeanukku ma'raiyaatheayum; naan viyaakulappaduki'rean, enakkuth theeviramaaych sevikoduththaru'lum.
neer en aaththumaavinidaththil vanthu athai viduthalaipa'n'num; en saththurukka'linimiththam ennai meettuvidum.
theavareer en ninthaiyaiyum en vedkaththaiyum en avamaanaththaiyum a'rinthirukki'reer; en saththurukka'l ellaarum umakku munpaaka irukki'raarka'l.

ninthai en iruthayaththaip pi'lanthathu; naan mikavum veathanaippaduki'rean; enakkaaka parithapikki'ravanu'ndoa en'ru kaaththirunthean, oruvanum illai; theat'ruki'ravarka'lukkuk kaaththirunthean, oruvanaiyum kaa'nean.
en aakaaraththil kasappuk kalanthu koduththaarka'l, en thaakaththukkuk kaadiyaik kudikkakkoduththaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya panthi avarka'lukkuk ka'n'niyum, avarka'ludaiya selvam avarka'lukku valaiyumaayirukkakkadavathu.
avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l kaa'naathapadi anthakaarappadakkadavathu; avarka'l iduppuka'lai eppoathum tha'l'laadappa'n'num.
ummudaiya ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal oot'rum; ummudaiya koapaakkini avarka'laith thodarnthu pidippathaaka.
avarka'l vaasasthalam paazhaakakkadavathu; avarka'ludaiya koodaarangka'lil kudiyillaama'rpoavathaaka.
theavareer adiththavanai avarka'l thunpappaduththi, neer kaayappaduththinavarka'lai noakap peasuki'raarka'lea.
akkiramaththinmeal akkiramaththai avarka'lmeal sumaththum, avarka'l umathu neethikku vanthettaathiruppaarka'laaka.
jeevapusthakaththilirunthu avarka'lpear ki'rukkappattuppoavathaaka; neethimaanka'l pearoadea avarka'l pear ezhuthappadaathiruppathaaka.
naanoa si'rumaiyum thuyaramumu'l'lavan; theavanea, ummudaiya iradchippu enakku uyarntha adaikkalamaavathaaka.
theavanudaiya naamaththaip paattinaal thuthiththu, avarai sthoaththiraththinaal makimaippaduththuvean.
kompum viriku'lampumu'l'la kaa'laiyeruthaippaarkkilum, ithuvea karththarukkup piriyamaayirukkum.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'l ithaik ka'ndu santhoashappaduvaarka'l; theavanaith theaduki'ravarka'lea, ungka'l iruthayam vaazhum.
karththar e'liyavarka'lin vi'n'nappaththaik keadki'raar, kattu'nda thammudaiyavarka'lai avar pu'rakka'niyaar.
vaanamum poomiyum samuththirangka'lum avaika'lil sagncharikki'ra yaavum avaraith thuthikkakkadavathu.
theavan seeyoanai iradchiththu, yoothaavin patta'nangka'laik kattuvaar; appozhuthu angkea kudiyirunthu athaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.
avarudaiya oozhiyakkaararin santhathiyaar athaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l; avarudaiya naamaththai neasikki'ravarka'l athil vaasamaayiruppaarka'l.
theavanea, ennai viduviyum, karththaavea, enakkuch sakaayagnseyyath theeviriyum.
en piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'l vedki naa'nuvaarka'laaka; enakkuth theengkuvarumpadi virumpuki'ravarka'l pinnittuth thirumpi ilachchaiyadaivaarka'laaka.
aa aa, aa aa, enpavarka'l thaangka'l adaiyum vedkaththinaal pinnittuppoavaarka'laaka.
ummaith theaduki'ra yaavarum ummil makizhnthu santhoashappaduvaarka'laaka; umathu iradchippil piriyappaduki'ravarka'l theavanukku makimaiyu'ndaavathaaka en'ru eppozhuthum solvaarka'laaka.
naanoa si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan; theavanea, ennidaththil theeviramaay vaarum: neerea en thu'naiyum ennai viduvikki'ravarumaanavar, karththaavea, thaamathiyaatheayum.
karththaavea, ummai nampiyirukki'rean; naan orupoathum vedkam adaiyaathapadi seyyum.
umathu neethiyinimiththam ennai viduviththu, ennaik kaaththaru'lum; umathu seviyai enakkuch saayththu, ennai iradchiyum.
naan eppozhuthum vanthadaiyaththakkak kanmalaiyaayirum; ennai iradchippatha'rkuk katta'laiyitteerea; neerea en kanmalaiyum en koattaiyumaay irukki'reer.
en theavanea, thunmaarkkanudaiya kaikkum, niyaayakkeadum kodumaiyumu'l'lavanudaiya kaikkum ennaith thappuviyum.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, neerea en noakkamum, en si'ruvayathuthodangki en nampikkaiyumaayirukki'reer.
naan karppaththil u'rpaviththathumuthal ummaal aatharikkappattean; en thaayin vayit'rilirunthu ennai eduththavar neerea; ummaiyea naan eppozhuthum thuthippean.
aneakarukku naan oru puthumaippoalaanean; neeroa enakkup palaththa adaikkalamaayirukki'reer.
en vaay umathu thuthiyinaalum, naa'lthoa'rum umathu makaththuvaththinaalum ni'rainthiruppathaaka.
muthirnthavayathil ennaith tha'l'lividaamalum, en pelan odungkumpoathu ennaik kaividaamalum irum.
en saththurukka'l enakku viroathamaayp peasi, en aaththumaavukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'l eakamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ni:
theavan avanaik kaivittaar, avanaith thodarnthupidiyungka'l; avanai viduvippaar illai enki'raarka'l.
theavanea, enakkuth thooramaayiraatheayum; en theavanea, enakkuch sakaayampa'n'nath theeviriyum.
en aaththumaavai viroathikki'ravarka'l vedki azhiyavum, enakkup pollaapputh theaduki'ravarka'l ninthaiyaalum ilachchaiyaalum moodappadavungkadavarka'l.
naanoa eppozhuthum nampikkaiko'ndirunthu, meanmealum ummaith thuthippean.
en vaay naa'lthoa'rum umathu neethiyaiyum umathu iradchippaiyum sollum; avaika'lin thokaiyai naan a'riyean.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya vallamaiyai munnittu nadappean; ummudaiya neethiyaippat'riyea meanmaipaaraattuvean.
theavanea, en si'ruvayathumuthal enakkup poathiththuvantheer; ithuvaraikkum ummudaiya athisayangka'lai a'riviththuvanthean.

ippozhuthum theavanea, inthach santhathikku umathu vallamaiyaiyum, varappoaki'ra yaavarukkum umathu paraakkiramaththaiyum naan a'rivikkuma'lavum, muthirvayathum naraimayirumu'l'lavanaakumvaraikkum ennaik kaivideeraaka.
theavanea, ummudaiya neethi unnathamaanathu, perithaanavaika'lai neer seytheer; theavanea, umakku nikaraanavar yaar?
aneaka ikkattuka'laiyum aapaththuka'laiyum kaa'numpadi seytha ennai neer thirumpavum uyirppiththu, thirumpavum ennaip poomiyin paathaa'langka'lilirunthu ea'rappa'n'nuveer.
en meanmaiyaip perukappa'n'ni, ennai ma'rupadiyum theat'ruveer.
en theavanea, naan vee'naiyaikko'ndu ummaiyum ummudaiya saththiyaththaiyum thuthippean; isravealin parisuththarea, surama'ndalaththaikko'ndu ummaip paaduvean.
naan paadumpoathu en uthaduka'lum, neer meettukko'nda en aaththumaavum kempeeriththu makizhum.
enakkup pollaappaith theaduki'ravarka'l vedki ilachchaiyadainthapadiyaal, naa'lthoa'rum en naavu umathu neethiyaik ko'ndaadum.
theavanea, raajaavukku ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'laiyum, raajaavin kumaaranukku ummudaiya neethiyaiyum koduththaru'lum.
avar ummudaiya janangka'lai neethiyoadum, ummudaiya eazhaika'lai niyaayaththoadum visaarippaar.
parvathangka'l janaththi'rkuch samaathaanaththaith tharum, meaduka'l neethiyin vi'laivoadirukkum.
janaththil si'rumaippaduki'ravarka'lai avar niyaayam visaariththu, eazhaiyin pi'l'laika'lai iradchiththu, idukka'n seyki'ravanai no'rukkuvaar.
sooriyanum santhiranumu'l'lamattum, avarka'l umakkuth thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakap payanthiruppaarka'l.
pulla'ruppu'nda ve'liyinmeal peyyum mazhaiyaippoalavum, poomiyai nanaikkum thoo'ralaippoalavum i'rangkuvaar.
avarudaiya naadka'lil neethimaan sezhippaan; santhiranu'l'lavaraikkum mikuntha samaathaanam irukkum.
oru samuththiranthodangki ma'rusamuththiramvaraikkum, nathithodangki poomiyin ellaika'lvaraikkum avar arasaa'luvaar.
vanaantharaththaar avarukku munpaakak kuninthu va'nangkuvaarka'l; avarudaiya saththurukka'l ma'n'nai nakkuvaarka'l.
tharsheesin raajaakka'lum theevuka'lin raajaakka'lum kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvaruvaarka'l; sheapaavilum seapaavilumu'l'la raajaakka'l vekumaanangka'laik ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.
sakala raajaakka'lum avaraip pa'ninthuko'lvaarka'l; sakala jaathika'lum avaraich seavippaarka'l.
kooppiduki'ra e'liyavanaiyum, uthaviyat'ra si'rumaiyaanavanaiyum avar viduvippaar.
palaveenanukkum e'liyavanukkum avar irangki, e'liyavarka'lin aaththumaakka'lai iradchippaar.
avarka'l aaththumaakka'lai vagnchakaththi'rkum kodumaikkum thappuvippaar; avarka'ludaiya iraththam avarudaiya paarvaikku arumaiyaayirukkum.
avar pizhaiththiruppaar, sheapaavin pon avarukkuk kodukkappadum; avarnimiththam idaividaamal jepampa'n'nappadum, ennaa'lum sthoaththirikkappaduvaar.
poomiyilea malaika'lin uchchika'lil oru pidi thaaniyam vithaikkappattirukkum; athin vi'laivu leepanoanaippoala asaiyum; poomiyin pullaippoala nakaraththaar sezhiththoangkuvaarka'l.

avarudaiya naamam en'ren'raikkum irukkum; sooriyanu'l'lamattum avarudaiya naamam santhaana paramparaiyaay nilaikkum; manushar avarukku'l aaseervathikkappaduvaarka'l, ellaa jaathika'lum avaraip paakkiyamudaiyavar en'ru vaazhththuvaarka'l.
isravealin theavanaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka; avarea athisayangka'laich seyki'ravar.
avarudaiya makimaiporunthiya naamaththukku en'ren'raikkum sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka; poomi muzhuvathum avarudaiya makimaiyaal ni'rainthiruppathaaka. aamen, aamen.
eesaayin puththiranaakiya thaaveethin vi'n'nappangka'l mudinthathu.
suththa iruthayamu'l'lavarka'laakiya isravealarukku theavan nallavaraakavea irukki'raar.
aanaalum en kaalka'l tha'l'laaduthalukkum, en adika'l sa'rukkuthalukkum sat'rea thappit'ru.
thunmaarkkarin vaazhvai naan kaa'nkaiyil, veempukkaararaakiya avarka'lmeal po'raamaiko'ndean.
mara'napariyantham avarka'lukku idukka'nka'lillai; avarka'ludaiya pelan u'ruthiyaayirukki'rathu.
narar padum varuththaththil akappadaarka'l; manushar adaiyum upaathiyai adaiyaarka'l.
aakaiyaal perumai sarappa'niyaippoal avarka'laich sut'rikko'l'lum, kodumai aadaiyaippoal avarka'lai moodikko'l'lum.
avarka'l ka'nka'l kozhuppinaal eduppaayp paarkki'rathu; avarka'l iruthayam virumpuvathilum athikamaay nadanthea'ruki'rathu.
avarka'l seerkettuppoay, akanthaiyaayk kodumaipeasuki'raarka'l; i'rumaappaayp peasuki'raarka'l.
thangka'l vaay vaanamattum ettappeasuki'raarka'l; avarka'l naavu poomiyengkum ulaavuki'rathu.
aakaiyaal avarudaiya janangka'l intha vazhiyaakavea thirumpuki'raarka'l; tha'n'neerka'l avarka'lukkup paripoora'namaaych suranthuvarum.
theavanukku athu eppadith theriyum? unnathamaanavarukku athaippat'ri a'rivu u'ndoa? en'ru solluki'raarka'l.
ithoa, ivarka'l thunmaarkkar; ivarka'l en'rum sukajeevika'laayirunthu, aasthiyaip perukappa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
naan viruthaavaakavea en iruthayaththaich suththampa'n'ni, kut'ramillaamaiyilea en kaika'laik kazhuvinean.
naa'lthoa'rum naan vaathikkappattum, kaalaithoa'rum tha'ndikkappattum irukki'rean.
ivvithamaayp peasuvean en'ru naan sonneanaanaal, ithoa, ummudaiya pi'l'laika'lin santhathikkuth thuroakiyaavean.
ithai a'riyumpadikku yoasiththuppaarththean; naan theavanudaiya parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasiththu,
avarka'l mudivaik kavaniththu u'naruma'lavum, athu en paarvaikku visanamaayirunthathu.
nichchayamaakavea neer avarka'laich sa'rukkalaana idangka'lil ni'ruththi, paazhaana idangka'lil vizhappa'n'nuki'reer.
avarka'l oru nimishaththil evva'lavu paazhaayppoaki'raarka'l! payangkarangka'laal azhinthu nirmoolamaaki'raarka'l.
niththirai the'linthavudanea soppanam ozhivathupoal, aa'ndavarea, neer vizhikkumpoathu, avarka'l veashaththai ikazhuveer.
ippadiyaaka en manam kasanthathu, en u'l'linthiriyangka'lilea kuththu'ndean.
naan kaariyam a'riyaatha moodanaanean; umakku munpaaka mirukampoalirunthean.
aanaalum naan eppozhuthum ummoadirukki'rean; en valathukaiyaip pidiththuth thaangkuki'reer.
ummudaiya aaloasanaiyinpadi neer ennai nadaththi, mudivilea ennai makimaiyil eat'rukko'lveer.
paraloakaththil ummaiyallaamal enakku yaar u'ndu? pooloakaththil ummaith thavira enakku vea'rea viruppamillai.
en maamsamum en iruthayamum maa'ndupoaki'rathu; theavan en'ren'raikkum en iruthayaththin kanmalaiyum en pangkumaayirukki'raar.
ithoa, ummaivittuth thooramaayppoaki'ravarka'l naasamadaivaarka'l; ummaivittuch soarampoaki'ra anaivaraiyum sangkarippeer.
enakkoa, theavanai a'ndikko'ndiruppathea nalam; naan umathu kiriyaika'laiyellaam sollivarumpadi karththaraakiya aa'ndavarmeal en nampikkaiyai vaiththirukki'rean.
theavanea, neer engka'lai en'ren'raikkum ean tha'l'lividuki'reer? umathu meaychchalin aaduka'lmeal umathu koapam ean pukaiki'rathu?
neer poorvakaalaththil sampaathiththa umathu sapaiyaiyum, neer meettukko'nda umathu suthantharamaana koaththiraththaiyum, neer vaasamaayiruntha seeyoan parvathaththaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
nedungkaalamaakap paazhaaykkidakki'ra sthalangka'lil ummudaiya paathangka'lai ezhuntharu'lappa'n'num; parisuththa sthalaththilea saththuru anaiththaiyum keduththuppoattaan.
ummudaiya saththurukka'l ummudaiya aalayangka'lukku'l'lea kerchchiththu, thangka'l kodika'lai adaiyaa'langka'laaka naattuki'raarka'l.
koadarika'lai oangkich soalaiyilea marangka'lai vettuki'ravan pearpet'ravanaanaan.
ippozhuthoa avarka'l athin siththiravealaika'l muzhuvathaiyum vaachchika'laalum sammattika'laalum thakarththup poaduki'raarka'l.
umathu parisuththa sthalaththai akkinikku iraiyaakki, umathu naamaththin vaasasthalaththaith tharaimattum idiththu, asuththappaduththinaarka'l.
avarka'lai eakamaay nirththoo'liyaakkuvoam en'ru thangka'l iruthayaththil solli, theasaththilu'l'la aalayangka'laiyellaam sutteriththuppoattaarka'l.
engka'lukku iruntha adaiyaa'langka'laik kaa'noam; theerkkatharisiyum illai; ithu ethuvaraikkum en'ru a'riki'ravanum engka'lidaththil illai.
theavanea, ethuvaraikkum saththuru ninthippaan? pakaivan umathu naamaththai eppozhuthum thooshippaanoa?
umathu valathukaraththai ean mudakkikko'l'luki'reer; athai umathu madiyilirunthu eduththu oangki nirmoolamaakkum.
poomiyin naduvil iradchippuka'laich seythuvaruki'ra theavan poorvakaalamuthal ennudaiya raajaa.
theavareer umathu vallamaiyinaal samuththiraththai ira'ndaakap pi'lanthu, jalaththilu'l'la valusarppangka'lin thalaika'lai udaiththeer.
theavareer muthalaika'lin thalaika'lai narukkippoattu, athai vanaantharaththu janangka'lukku u'navaakak koduththeer.
oot'raiyum aat'raiyum pi'lanthuvitteer; makaa nathika'laiyum vat'rippoakappa'n'nineer.
pakalum ummudaiyathu, iravum ummudaiyathu; theavareer o'liyaiyum sooriyanaiyum padaiththeer.
poomiyin ellaika'laiyellaam thittampa'n'nineer; koadaikaalaththaiyum maarikaalaththaiyum u'ndaakkineer.
karththaavea, saththuru ummai ninthiththathaiyum, mathiyeena janangka'l umathu naamaththaith thooshiththathaiyum ninaiththukko'l'lum.
umathu kaattuppu'raavin aaththumaavaith thushdarudaiya koottaththi'rku oppukkodaatheayum; umathu eazhaika'lin koottaththai en'raikkum ma'ravaatheayum.
ummudaiya udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththaru'lum; poomiyin iru'laana idangka'l kodumaiyu'l'la kudiyiruppuka'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathea.
thunpappattavan vedkaththoadea thirumpavidaathirum; si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan umathu naamaththaith thuthikkumpadi seyyum.
theavanea, ezhuntharu'lum, umakkaaka neerea vazhakkaadum; mathiyeenanaalea naadoa'rum umakku varum ninthaiyai ninaiththukko'l'lum.
ummudaiya saththurukka'lin aaravaaraththai ma'ravaatheayum; umakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lin ama'li eppozhuthum athikarikki'rathu.
ummaith thuthikki'roam, theavanea, ummaith thuthikki'roam; umathu naamam sameepamaayirukki'rathen'ru umathu athisayamaana kiriyaika'l a'rivikki'rathu.
niyamikkappatta kaalaththilea, yathaarththamaay niyaayantheerppean.
poomiyaanathu athin ellaak kudika'loadum karainthupoaki'rathu; athin thoo'nka'lai naan nilaini'ruththuki'rean. (sealaa.)
veempukkaararai noakki, veempu peasaatheayungka'l en'rum; thunmaarkkarai noakki, kompai uyarththaathirungka'l en'rum sonnean.
ungka'l kompai uyaramaay uyarththaathirungka'l; i'rumaappu'l'la kazhuththudaiyavarka'laayp peasaathirungka'l.
kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vanaantharathisaiyilumirunthu jeyam varaathu.
theavanea niyaayaathipathi; oruvanaith thaazhththi, oruvanai uyarththuki'raar.

kalangkip pongkuki'ra mathupaanaththinaal ni'raintha paaththiram karththarudaiya kaiyilirukki'rathu, athilirunthu vaarkki'raar; poomiyilu'l'la thunmaarkkar yaavarum athin va'ndalka'lai u'rignchik kudippaarka'l.
naanoa en'ren'raikkum ithai a'riviththu, yaakkoapin theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
thunmaarkkarudaiya kompuka'laiyellaam vettippoaduvean; neethimaanudaiya kompuka'loa uyarththappadum.
yoothaavil theavan a'riyappattavar; isravealil avarudaiya naamam periyathu.
saaleamil avarudaiya koodaaramum, seeyoanil avarudaiya vaasasthalamum irukki'rathu.
angkeayirunthu villin ampuka'laiyum, keadakaththaiyum, pattayaththaiyum, yuththaththaiyum mu'riththaar. (sealaa.)
makaththuvamu'l'lavarea, ko'l'laiyu'l'la parvathangka'laippaarkkilum neer pirakaasamu'l'lavar.
thairiya negnchu'l'lavarka'l ko'l'laiyidappattu, niththiraiyadainthu asarnthaarka'l; vallamaiyu'l'la ellaa manusharudaiya kaika'lum avarka'lukku uthavaama'rpoayit'ru.
yaakkoapin theavanea, ummudaiya ka'ndithaththinaal irathangka'lum kuthiraika'lum u'rangki vizhunthathu.
neer, neerea, payangkaramaanavar; umathu koapam moo'lumpoathu umakku munpaaka ni'rpavan yaar?
niyaayam visaarikkavum poomiyil si'rumaippattavarka'l yaavaraiyum iradchikkavum, theavareer ezhuntharu'linapoathu,
vaanaththilirunthu niyaayaththeerppuk keadkappa'n'nineer; poomi payanthu amarnthathu. (sealaa.)
manushanudaiya koapam umathu makimaiyai vi'langkappa'n'num; mignchungkoapaththai neer adakkuveer.
poruththanaipa'n'ni athai ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku ni'raiveat'rungka'l; avaraich soozhnthirukki'ra anaivarum payangkaramaanavarukkuk kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvarakkadavarka'l.
pirapukka'lin aaviyai adakkuvaar; poomiyin raajaakka'lukku avar payangkaramaanavar.
naan theavanai noakki en saththaththai uyarththik kegnchinean, en saththaththai theavanidaththil uyarththinean, avar enakkuch sevikoduththaar.
en aapaththunaa'lil aa'ndavaraith theadinean; iravilum en kai tha'laraamal virikkappattirunthathu; en aaththumaa aa'ruthaladaiyaama'rpoayit'ru.
naan theavanai ninaiththapoathu ala'rinean; naan thiyaanikkumpoathu en aavi thoynthupoayit'ru. (sealaa.)
naan thoongkaathapadi en ka'n'nimaika'laip pidiththirukki'reer; naan peasamaattaathapadi sagnchalappaduki'rean.
poorvanaadka'laiyum, aathikaalaththu varushangka'laiyum sinthikki'rean.
iraakkaalaththil en sangkeethaththai naan ninaiththu, en iruthayaththoadea sampaashiththukko'l'luki'rean; en aavi aaraaychchiseythathu.
aa'ndavar niththiyakaalamaayth tha'l'lividuvaaroa? ini orupoathum thayaiseyyaathiruppaaroa?
avarudaiya kirupai mut'rilum at'ruppoayit'roa? vaakkuththaththamaanathu thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum ozhinthupoayit'roa?
theavan irakkagnseyya ma'ranthaaroa? koapaththinaalea thamathu urukkamaana irakkangka'lai adaiththukko'ndaaroa? en'rean. (sealaa.)
appozhuthu naan: ithu en palaveenam; aanaalum unnathamaanavarudaiya valathukaraththilu'l'la varushangka'lai ninaivukooruvean.
karththarudaiya seyalka'lai ninaivukooruvean, ummudaiya poorvakaalaththu athisayangka'laiyea ninaivukooruvean;
ummudaiya kiriyaika'laiyellaam thiyaaniththu, ummudaiya seyalka'lai yoasippean en'rean.
theavanea, umathu vazhi parisuththa sthalaththilu'l'lathu; nammudaiya theavanaippoalap periya theavan yaar?
athisayangka'laich seyki'ra theavan neerea; janangka'lukku'l'lea ummudaiya vallamaiyai vi'langkappa'n'nineer.
yaakkoapu yoaseappu enpavarka'lin puththiraraakiya ummudaiya janangka'lai, umathu puyaththinaalea meettukko'ndeer. (sealaa.)
jalangka'l ummaik ka'ndathu; theavanea, jalangka'l ummaik ka'ndu thaththa'liththathu; aazhangka'lum kalangkinathu.
meakangka'l jalangka'laip pozhinthathu; aakaayama'ndalangka'l muzhakkamittathu; ummudaiya ampuka'lum the'rippu'ndu pa'ranthathu.
ummudaiya kumu'ralin saththam suzhalkaat'ril muzhangkinathu; minnalka'l poochchakkaraththaip pirakaasippiththathu; poomi kulungki athirnthathu.
umathu vazhi kadalilum, umathu paathaika'l thira'nda tha'n'neerka'lilum irunthathu; umathu kaaladika'l theriyappadaama'rpoayit'ru.
moasea aaroan enpavarka'lin kaiyaal, umathu janangka'lai oru aattumanthaiyaippoala vazhinadaththineer.
en janangka'lea, en upatheasaththaik kea'lungka'l; en vaayin vasanangka'lukku ungka'l sevika'laich saayungka'l.
en vaayai uvamaika'laal thi'rappean; poorvakaalaththu ma'raiporu'lka'lai ve'lippaduththuvean.
avaika'lai naangka'l kea'lvippattu a'rinthoam; engka'l pithaakka'l avaika'lai engka'lukkuth theriviththaarka'l.
pinvarum santhathiyaana pi'l'laika'lukku naangka'l avaika'lai ma'raikkaamal, karththarin thuthika'laiyum avarudaiya palaththaiyum, avar seytha avarudaiya athisayangka'laiyum vivarippoam.
avar yaakkoapilea saadchiyai ea'rpaduththi, isravealilea veathaththai sthaapiththu, avaika'laith thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukku a'rivikkumpadi nammudaiya pithaakka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
inip pi'rakkum pi'l'laika'laakiya pinsanthathiyaar athai a'rinthuko'ndu, avarka'l ezhumpith thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukku avaika'laich sollumpadikkum;
theavanmeal avarka'l thangka'l nampikkaiyai vaiththu, theavanudaiya seyalka'lai ma'ravaamal, avar ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'lumpadikkum;

iruthayaththaich sevvaippaduththaamalum, theavanai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'l'laamalum iruntha murattaattamum kalakamumu'l'la santhathiyaakiya thangka'l pithaakka'lukku avarka'l oppaakaathapadikkum, ivaika'laik katta'laiyittaar.
aayuthama'nintha vilveeraraana eppiraayeem puththirar yuththanaa'lilea muthukukaattinaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyaik kaikko'l'laamalum, avarudaiya katta'laika'linpadi nadakkach sammathiyaamalum,
avarudaiya seyalka'laiyum, avar thangka'lukkuk kaa'npiththa athisayangka'laiyum ma'ranthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukkumunpaaka, ekipthutheasaththuch soavaan ve'liyilea, avar athisayamaanavaika'laich seythaar.
kadalaip pi'lanthu, avarka'laik kadakkappa'n'ni, jalaththaik kuviyalaaka ni'rkumpadi seythaar.
pakalilea meakaththinaalum, iraamuzhuthum akkini ve'lichchaththinaalum avarka'lai vazhinadaththinaar.
vanaantharaththilea kanmalaika'laip pi'lanthu, makaa aazhangka'lilirunthu tha'n'neerai avarka'lukkuk kudikkakkoduththaar.
kanmalaiyilirunthu neeroattangka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, tha'n'neerai nathipoala oadivarumpadi seythaar.
en'raalum, avarka'l pinnum avarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, va'ra'nda ve'liyilea unnathamaanavarukkuk koapam moottinaarka'l.
thangka'l ichchaikkeat'ra poajanaththaik keattu, thangka'l iruthayaththil theavanaip pareedchaipaarththaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanukku viroathamaayp peasi: theavan vanaantharaththilea poajanapanthiyai aayaththappaduththakkoodumoa?

ithoa avar kanmalaiyai adiththathinaal tha'n'neer pu'rappattu, nathika'laayp pura'nduvanthathu; avar appaththaiyum kodukkakkoodumoa? thammudaiya janaththi'rku maamsaththaiyum aayaththappaduththuvaaroa? en'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar athaik keattuk koapangko'ndaar; avarka'l theavanai visuvaasiyaamalum, avarudaiya iradchippai nampaamalum poanathinaal,
yaakkoapukku viroathamaay akkini pat'riyerinthathu; isravealukku viroathamaayk koapam moo'ndathu.
avar uyaraththilu'l'la meakangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittu, vaanaththin kathavuka'laith thi'ranthu,
mannaavai avarka'lukku aakaaramaaka varushikkappa'n'ni, vaanaththin thaaniyaththai avarka'lukkuk koduththaar.
thootharka'lin appaththai manushan saappittaan; avarka'lukku aakaaraththaip poora'namaay anuppinaar.
aakaasaththilea keezhkkaat'rai varappa'n'ni, thammudaiya vallamaiyinaal then'ralaiyum veesachseythu,
maamsaththaith thoo'laththanaiyaayum, si'raku'l'la pa'ravaika'laik kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanaiyaayum varushikkappa'n'ni,
avaika'lai avarka'l paa'layaththin naduvilum, avarka'l koodaarangka'laich sut'rilum i'rangkappa'n'ninaar.
avarka'l pusiththuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l; avarka'l ichchiththathai avarka'lukkuk koduththaar.
avarka'l thangka'l ichchaiyai ve'rukkavillai; avarka'ludaiya poajanam avarka'l vaayil irukkumpoathea,
theavakoapam avarka'lmeal ezhumpi, avarka'lil kozhuththavarka'laich sangkariththu, isravealil viseashiththavarka'lai madiyappa'n'nit'ru.
ivaiyellaam nadanthum, avar seytha athisayangka'lai avarka'l nampaamal, pinnum paavagnseythaarka'l.
aathalaal avarka'l naadka'lai viruthaavilum, avarka'l varushangka'laip payangkaraththilum kazhiyappa'n'ninaar.
avarka'lai avar kollumpoathu avaraikku'riththu visaariththu, avarka'l thirumpivanthu theavanai athikaalamea theadi;
theavan thangka'l kanmalaiyen'rum, unnathamaana theavan thangka'l meedpar en'rum, ninaivukoornthaarka'l.
aanaalum avarka'l thangka'l vaayinaal avarukku ichchakampeasi, thangka'l naavinaal avaridaththil poysonnaarka'l.
avarka'l iruthayam avaridaththil nilaivarappadavillai; avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyil avarka'l u'nmaiyaayirukkavillai.
avaroa avarka'lai azhikkaamal, irakkamu'l'lavaraay avarka'l akkiramaththai manniththaar; avar thamathu ukkiram muzhuvathaiyum ezhuppaamal, aneakantharam thamathu koapaththai vilakkivittaar.
avarka'l maamsamen'rum, thirumpivaraamal akaluki'ra kaat'ren'rum ninaivukoornthaar.
eththanaitharamoa vanaantharaththilea avarukkuk koapam mootti, avaantharave'liyilea avarai visanappaduththinaarka'l.
avarka'l thirumpi theavanaip pareedchaipaarththu, isravealin parisuththarai mattuppaduththinaarka'l.
avarudaiya karaththaiyum, avar thangka'laich saththuruvukku vilakki meetta naa'laiyum ninaiyaama'rpoanaarka'l.
avar ekipthilea thammudaiya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum, soavaan ve'liyilea thammudaiya a'rputhangka'laiyum seythaar.
avarka'ludaiya nathika'lai iraththamaaka maat'ri, avarka'ludaiya aa'ruka'lilu'l'la jalaththaik kudikkakkoodaathapadi seythaar.
avarka'lai azhikkumpadi va'ndu jaathika'laiyum, avarka'laik kedukkumpadi thava'laika'laiyum avarka'lukku'l'lea anuppinaar.
avarka'ludaiya vi'laichchalaip puzhukka'lukkum, avarka'ludaiya pirayaasaththin palanai vettukki'lika'lukkum koduththaar.
kalmazhaiyinaal avarka'ludaiya thiraadchachsedika'laiyum, aalaangkattiyinaal avarka'ludaiya aththimarangka'laiyum azhiththu,
avarka'ludaiya mirukajeevanka'laik kalmazhaikkum, avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'lai idika'lukkum oppukkoduththaar.
thamathu ukkiramaana koapaththaiyum, moorkkaththaiyum, sinaththaiyum, upaththiravaththaiyum, theengkuseyyum thootharka'laiyum avarka'lukku'l'lea anuppinaar.
avar thammudaiya koapaththukku vazhithi'ranthu, avarka'l aaththumaavai mara'naththukku vilakkik kaavaamal, avarka'l jeevanaik ko'l'lainoaykku oppukkoduththaar.
ekipthilea thalaichchanka'l anaiththaiyum, kaamin koodaarangka'lilea avarka'ludaiya pelanil mutha'rpalanaana yaavaraiyum azhiththu;
thammudaiya janangka'lai aaduka'laippoal pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avarka'lai vanaantharaththilea manthaiyaippoal koottikko'ndupoay;
avarka'l payappadaathapadikku avarka'laip paththiramaay vazhinadaththinaar; avarka'l saththurukka'laik kadal moodippoattathu.
avarka'laith thamathu parisuththa sthalaththin ellaivaraikkum, thamathu valathukaram sampaathiththa inthap parvathamattukkum azhaiththukko'nduvanthu,
avarka'l mukaththi'rku munpaaka jaathika'laith thuraththivittu, theasaththai noolpoattup pangkittu, avarka'ludaiya koodaarangka'lil isravealin koaththirangka'laik kudiyeat'rinaar.
aanaalum avarka'l unnathamaana theavanaip pareedchaipaarththu, avarukkuk koapam mootti, avarudaiya saadchika'laik kaikko'l'laama'rpoay,
thangka'l pithaakka'laippoala vazhivilaki, thuroakampa'n'ni, moasampoakkum villaippoal thuva'ndu,
thangka'l meadaika'linaal avarukkuk koapam mootti, thangka'l vikkirakangka'linaal erichchal u'ndaakkinaarka'l.
theavan athaik keattu ukkiramaaki, isravealai mikavum ve'ruththu,
thaam manusharukku'l'lea poatta koodaaramaakiya seeloavilu'l'la vaasasthalaththai vittuvilaki,
thamathu palaththaich si'raiyiruppukkum, thamathu makimaiyaich saththuruvin kaikkum oppukkoduththu,
thamathu janaththaip pattayaththukku iraiyaakki, thamathu suthantharaththinmeal koapangko'ndaar.
avarka'l vaaliparai akkini padchiththathu, avarka'l kanniyaasthireeka'l vaazhkkaippadaathirunthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya aasaariyarka'l pattayaththaal vizhunthaarka'l, avarka'ludaiya vithavaika'l azhavillai.
appozhuthu aa'ndavar niththirai the'linthavanaippoalavum, thiraadcharasaththaal kempeerikki'ra paraakkiramasaaliyaippoalavum vizhiththu,
thammudaiya saththurukka'laip pinpu'ramaaka adiththu, avarka'lukku niththiya ninthaiyai varappa'n'ninaar.
avar yoaseappin koodaaraththaip pu'rakka'niththaar; eppiraayeem koaththiraththai avar therinthuko'l'laamal,
yoothaa koaththiraththaiyum thamakkup piriyamaana seeyoan parvathaththaiyum therinthuko'ndaar.
thammudaiya parisuththa sthalaththai malaika'laippoalavum, en'raikkum ni'rkumpadi thaam asthipaarappaduththina poomiyaippoalavum kattinaar.
thammudaiya thaasanaakiya thaaveethaith therinthuko'ndu, aattuththozhuvangka'lilirunthu avanai eduththaar.
ka'ravalaaduka'lin pinnaakath thirintha avanai, thammudaiya janamaakiya yaakkoapaiyum thammudaiya suthantharamaakiya isravealaiyum meayppatha'rkaaka, azhaiththukko'nduvanthaar.
ivan avarka'laith than iruthayaththin u'nmaiyinpadiyea meayththu, than kaika'lin thi'ramaiyinaal avarka'lai nadaththinaan.
theavanea, pu'rajaathiyaar umathu suthantharaththil vanthu, umathu parisuththa aalayaththaith theettuppaduththi, erusaleamai ma'nmeaduka'laakkinaarka'l.
umathu oozhiyakkaararin pireathangka'lai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum, umathu parisuththavaanka'lin maamsaththaip poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakak koduththaarka'l.
erusaleamaich sut'rilum avarka'ludaiya iraththaththai tha'n'neeraippoalach sinthinaarka'l; avarka'lai adakkampa'n'nuvaarumillai.
engka'l ayalaarukku ninthaiyum, engka'l sut'ruppu'raththaarukkup pariyaasamum sakkanthamumaanoam.
ethuvaraikkum karththaavea! neer en'raikkum koapamaayiruppeeroa? ummudaiya erichchal akkiniyaippoal eriyumoa?
ummai a'riyaatha jaathika'lmealum, umathu naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'laatha raajyangka'lmealum, ummudaiya ukkiraththai oot'rividum.
avarka'l yaakkoapaip padchiththu, avan kudiyiruppaip paazhaakkinaarka'lea.
poorvakaalaththu akkiramangka'lai engka'lukku viroathamaaka ninaiyaatheayum; ummudaiya irakkangka'l seekkiramaay engka'lukku neariduvathaaka; naangka'l mikavum thaazhththappattuppoanoam.
engka'lai iradchikkum theavanea, neer umathu naamaththin makimaiyinimiththam engka'lukku uthaviseythu, umathu naamaththinimiththam engka'lai viduviththu, engka'l paavangka'lai nivirththiyaakkum.

avarka'ludaiya theavan engkea en'ru pu'rajaathika'l solvaanean? umathu oozhiyakkaararudaiya sinthu'nda iraththaththin pazhivaangkuthal jaathika'lukku'l'lea engka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vi'langkumpadi seyyum.
kattu'ndavanudaiya perumoochchu umakku munpaaka varattum; kolaikku niyamikkappattavarka'lai umathu puyapalaththinaal uyiroadea kaaththaru'lum.
aa'ndavarea, engka'l ayalaar ummai ninthiththa ninthaiyai, eazhaththanaiyaaka avarka'l madiyilea thirumpappa'n'num.
appozhuthu, ummudaiya janangka'lum ummudaiya meaychchalin aaduka'lumaakiya naangka'l ummai en'ren'raikkum pukazhuvoam; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka umathu thuthiyaich sollivaruvoam.
isravealin meaypparea, yoaseappai aattumanthaiyaippoal nadaththuki'ravarea, sevikodum; kearupeenka'l maththiyil vaasampa'n'nuki'ravarea, pirakaasiyum.
eppiraayeem penyameen manaasea enpavarka'lukku munpaaka, neer umathu vallamaiyai ezhuppi, engka'lai iradchikka vantharu'lum.
theavanea, engka'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, umathu mukaththaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, umathu janaththin vi'n'nappaththukku viroathamaay neer ethuvaraikkum koapangko'lveer.
ka'n'neeraakiya appaththai avarka'lukku poajanamaakavum, mikuthiyaana ka'n'neeraiyea avarka'lukkup paanamaakavum koduththeer.
engka'l ayalaarukku engka'lai vazhakkaaka vaikki'reer; engka'l saththurukka'l engka'laip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
seanaika'lin theavanea, engka'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, umathu mukaththaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
neer ekipthilirunthu oru thiraadchakkodiyaik ko'nduvanthu, jaathika'laith thuraththivittu, athai naattineer.
atha'rku idaththai aayaththappaduththineer; athu vearoon'ri, theasamengkum padarnthathu.
athin nizhalaal malaika'lum athin ki'laika'laal thivviyamaana keathurukka'lum moodappattathu.
athu than kodika'laich samuththiramattaakavum, than ki'laika'lai nathimattaakavum padaravittathu.
ippozhuthoa vazhinadakki'ra yaavarum athaip pa'rikkumpadiyaaka, athin adaippuka'lai ean thakarththuppoatteer?
kaattuppan'ri athai uzhuthupoaduki'rathu, ve'liyin mirukangka'l athai meaynthupoaduki'rathu.
seanaika'lin theavanea, thirumpivaarum, vaanaththilirunthu ka'n'noakkippaarththu, inthath thiraadchachsediyai visaariththaru'lum;
ummudaiya valathukaram naattina kodiyaiyum, umakku neer thidappaduththina ki'laiyaiyum kadaadchiththaru'lum.
athu akkiniyaal sudappattum vettu'ndum poayit'ru; ummudaiya mukaththin payamu'ruththalaal azhinthupoaki'raarka'l.
umathu karam umathu valathupaarisaththup purushanmeethilum, umakku neer thidappaduththina manushakumaaranmeethilum iruppathaaka.
appozhuthu ummaivittup pinvaangkamaattoam; engka'lai uyirppiyum, appozhuthu umathu naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luvoam.
seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, engka'laith thiruppikko'ndu vaarum; umathu mukaththaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
nammudaiya pelanaakiya theavanaik kempeeramaayp paadi, yaakkoapin theavanaikku'riththu aarppariyungka'l.
thampuru vaasiththu, vee'naiyaiyum iniya oasaiyaana surama'ndalaththaiyum eduththu, sangkeetham paadungka'l.
maathappi'rappilum, niyamiththakaalaththilum, nammudaiya pa'ndikainaadka'lilum, ekkaa'lam oothungka'l.
ithu isravealukkup piramaa'namum, yaakkoapin theavan vithiththa niyaayamumaayirukki'rathu.
naam a'riyaatha paashaiyaik keatta ekipthutheasaththaivittup pu'rappadukaiyil, ithai yoaseappilea saadchiyaaka ea'rpaduththinaar.
avan thoa'laich sumaikku vilakkinean; avan kaika'l koodaikku neengkalaakkappattathu.

nerukkaththilea nee kooppittaay, naan unnaith thappuviththean; idimuzhakkam u'ndaakum ma'raividaththilirunthu unakku uththaravu aru'linean; mearipaavin tha'n'neerka'lidaththil unnaich soathiththu a'rinthean. (sealaa.)
en janamea kea'l, unakkuch saadchiyittuch solluvean; isravealea, nee enakkuch sevikoduththaal nalamaayirukkum.
unakku'l vea'ru theavan u'ndaayirukkavea'ndaam; anniya theavanai nee namaskarikkavum vea'ndaam.
unnai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaakiya karththar naanea; un vaayai virivaayth thi'ra, naan athai nirappuvean.
en janamoa en saththaththukkuch sevikodukkavillai; israveal ennai virumpavillai.
aakaiyaal avarka'lai avarka'l iruthayaththin kadinaththi'rku vittuvittean; thangka'l yoasanaika'linpadiyea nadanthaarka'l.
aa, en janam enakkuch sevikoduththu, israveal en vazhika'lil nadanthaal nalamaayirukkum!
naan seekkiraththil avarka'l ethiraa'lika'laith thaazhththi, en kaiyai avarka'l saththurukka'lukku viroathamaakath thiruppuvean.
appozhuthu karththaraip pakaikki'ravarka'l avarukku ichchakam peasi adangkuvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kaalam en'ren'raikkum irukkum.
uchchithamaana koathumaiyinaal avarka'laip poashippaar; kanmalaiyin theaninaal unnaith thirupthiyaakkuvean.
theavasapaiyilea theavan ezhuntharu'liyirukki'raar; theavarka'lin naduvilea avar niyaayam visaarikki'raar.
ethuvaraikkum neengka'l aniyaayaththeerppuchseythu, thunmaarkkarukku mukathaadchi'niyam pa'n'nuveerka'l. (sealaa.)
eazhaikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum niyaayagnseythu, si'rumaippattavanukkum thikkat'ravanukkum neethi seyyungka'l.
palaveenanaiyum e'liyavanaiyum viduviththu, thunmaarkkarin kaikku avarka'laith thappuviyungka'l.
a'riyaamalum u'naraamalum irukki'raarka'l, anthakaaraththilea nadakki'raarka'l; theasaththin asthipaarangka'lellaam asaiki'rathu.
neengka'l theavarka'l en'rum, neengka'lellaarum unnathamaanavarin makka'l en'rum naan solliyirunthean.
aanaalum neengka'l manusharaippoalach seththu, loakappirapukka'lil oruvanaippoala vizhunthupoaveerka'l.
theavanea, ezhuntharu'lum, poomikku niyaayaththeerppuch seyyum; neerea sakala jaathika'laiyum suthantharamaakak ko'ndiruppavar.
theavanea, mavunamaayiraatheayum, peasaamaliraatheayum; theavanea, summaayiraatheayum.
ithoa, ummudaiya saththurukka'l kontha'liththu, ummudaiya pakaignar thalaiyedukki'raarka'l.
umathu janaththukku viroathamaaka upaaya thanthirangka'lai yoasiththu, umathu ma'raivilirukki'ravarka'lukku viroathamaaka aaloasanaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
avarka'l ini oru jaathiyaaraayiraamalum, isravealin pear ini ninaikkappadaamalum poavatha'rkaaka, avarka'lai athampa'n'nuvoam vaarungka'l enki'raarka'l.
ippadi, eathoamin koodaaraththaarum, ismavealarum, moavaapiyarum, aakaariyarum,
keapaalarum, ammoaniyarum, amaleakkiyarum, theeruvin kudika'loadu koodiya pelistharum,
eakamananir'nayamaay aaloasanaiseythu, umakku viroathamaay oppanthampa'n'nikko'ndirukki'raarka'l.
aseeriyarum avarka'loadeakoodak kalanthu, loaththin puththirarukkup puyapalamaanaarka'l. (sealaa.)
meethiyaaniyarukkuch seythathupoalavum, keesoan ennum aat'ra'ndai enthoarilea azhikkappattu,
nilaththukku eruvaayppoana siseraa, yaapeen enpavarka'lukkuch seythathupoalavum, avarka'lukkuch seyyum.
avarka'laiyum avarka'l athipathika'laiyum oareapukkum seapukkum, avarka'l pirapukka'laiyellaam seapaavukkum salmunaavukkum samamaakkum.
theavanudaiya vaasasthalangka'lai engka'lukkuch suthantharamaaka naangka'l kattikko'lvoam en'ru solluki'raarka'lea.
en theavanea, avarka'laich suzhalkaat'rin puzhuthikkum, kaat'rumukaththil pa'rakkum thurumpukkum samamaakkum.
neruppu kaattaik ko'luththuvathupoalavum, akkinijuvaalaika'l malaika'lai erippathupoalavum,
neer umathu pusalinaalea avarka'laith thodarnthu, umathu perungkaat'rinaalea avarka'laik kalangkappa'n'num.
karththaavea, avarka'l umathu naamaththaith theadumpadikku, avarka'l mukangka'lai avamaanaththaalea moodum.
