yeakoavaa ennum naamaththaiyudaiya theavareer oruvarea poomiyanaiththinmealum unnathamaanavar en'ru manushar u'narumpadi,
avarka'l en'raikkum vedkikkalangki, naa'namadainthu azhinthupoavaarka'laaka.
seanaika'lin karththaavea, umathu vaasasthalangka'l evva'lavu inpamaanavaika'l!
en aaththumaa karththarudaiya aalayappiraakaarangka'linmeal vaagnchaiyum thavanamumaayirukki'rathu; en iruthayamum en maamsamum jeevanu'l'la theavanai noakkik kempeera saththamiduki'rathu.
en raajaavum en theavanumaakiya seanaika'lin karththaavea, ummudaiya peedangka'la'ndaiyil adaikkalaan kuruvikku veedum, thakaivilaan kuruvikkuth than kugnchuka'lai vaikkum koodum kidaiththathea.
ummudaiya veettil vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l eppozhuthum ummaith thuthiththukko'ndiruppaarka'l. (sealaa.)
ummilea pelanko'l'luki'ra manushanum, thangka'l iruthayangka'lil sevvaiyaana vazhika'laik ko'ndirukki'ravarka'lum paakkiyavaanka'l.
azhukaiyin pa'l'laththaakkai uruva nadanthu athai neeroot'raakkik ko'l'luki'raarka'l; mazhaiyum ku'langka'lai nirappum.
avarka'l palaththinmeal palam adainthu, seeyoanilea theavasannithiyil vanthu kaa'nappaduvaarka'l.
seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththai kea'lum; yaakkoapin theavanea, sevikodum. (sealaa.)
engka'l keadakamaakiya theavanea, ka'n'noakkamaayirum; neer apisheakampa'n'ninavarin mukaththaip paarum.

aayiram naa'laippaarkkilum umathu piraakaarangka'lil sellum orea naa'l nallathu; aakaamiyak koodaarangka'lil vaasamaayiruppathaippaarkkilum en theavanudaiya aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyil kaaththiruppathaiyea therinthuko'l'luvean.
theavanaakiya karththar sooriyanum keadakamumaanavar; karththar kirupaiyaiyum makimaiyaiyum aru'luvaar; uththamamaay nadakki'ravarka'lukku nanmaiyai vazhangkaathiraar.
seanaika'lin karththaavea, ummai nampiyirukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
karththaavea, umathu theasaththinmeal piriyam vaiththu, yaakkoapin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppineer.
umathu janaththin akkiramaththai manniththu, avarka'l paavaththaiyellaam moodineer. (sealaa.)
umathu ukkiraththaiyellaam adakkikko'ndu, umathu koapaththin erichchalaivittuth thirumpineer.
engka'l iradchippin theavanea, neer engka'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, engka'lmealu'l'la umathu koapaththai aa'rappa'n'num.
en'raikkum engka'lmeal koapamaayiruppeeroa? thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka umathu koapaththai neediththirukkappa'n'nuveeroa?
umathu janangka'l ummil makizhnthirukkumpadi neer engka'laith thirumpa uyirppikkamaatteeroa?
karththaavea, umathu kirupaiyai engka'lukkuk kaa'npiththu, umathu iradchippai engka'lukku aru'lichseyyum.

karththaraakiya theavan vi'lampuvathaik keadpean; avar thammudaiya janangka'lukkum thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukkum samaathaanam koo'ruvaar; avarka'loa mathikeattukkuth thirumpaathiruppaarka'laaka.
nammudaiya theasaththil makimai vaasamaayirukkumpadi, avarudaiya iradchippu avarukkup payanthavarka'lukkuch sameepamaayirukki'rathu.
kirupaiyum saththiyamum on'raiyon'ru santhikkum, neethiyum samaathaanamum on'raiyon'ru muththagnseyyum.
saththiyam poomiyilirunthu mu'laikkum, neethi vaanaththilirunthu thaazhappaarkkum.
karththar nanmaiyaanathaith tharuvaar; nammudaiya theasamum than palanaik kodukkum.
neethi avarukku munnaakach sen'ru, avarudaiya adichsuvaduka'lin vazhiyilea nammai ni'ruththum.
karththaavea, umathu seviyaich saayththu, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum; naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan.
en aaththumaavaik kaaththaru'lum, naan pakthiyu'l'lavan; en theavanea, ummai nampiyirukki'ra umathu adiyeanai neer iradchiyum.
aa'ndavarea, enakku irangkum, naadoa'rum ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean.
umathu adiyeanudaiya aaththumaavai makizhchchiyaakkum; aa'ndavarea, ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththuki'rean.
aa'ndavarea, neer nallavarum, mannikki'ravarum, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'ra yaavarmealum kirupai mikunthavarumaayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, en jepaththi'rkuch sevikoduththu, en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththaik kavaniyum.
naan thuyarappaduki'ra naa'lil ummai noakkik kooppiduvean; neer ennaik keattaru'luveer.
aa'ndavarea, theavarka'lukku'l'lea umakku nikarumillai; ummudaiya kiriyaika'lukku oppumillai.
aa'ndavarea, neer u'ndaakkina ellaa jaathika'lum vanthu, umakku munpaakap pa'ninthu, umathu naamaththai makimaippaduththuvaarka'l.
theavareer makaththuvamu'l'lavarum athisayangka'laich seyki'ravarumaayirukki'reer; neer oruvarea theavan.
karththaavea, umathu vazhiyai enakkup poathiyum, naan umathu saththiyaththilea nadappean; naan umathu naamaththi'rkup payanthirukkumpadi en iruthayaththai orumukappaduththum.
en theavanaakiya aa'ndavarea ummai en muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthiththu, umathu naamaththai en'ren'raikkum makimaippaduththuvean.
neer enakkup paaraattina umathu kirupai periyathu; en aaththumaavaith thaazhntha paathaa'laththi'rkuth thappuviththeer.

theavanea, akangkaarika'l enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'raarka'l, kodumaikkaararaakiya koottaththaar en piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'raarka'l, ummaith thangka'lukku munpaaka ni'ruththi noakkaathirukki'raarka'l.
aanaalum aa'ndavarea, neer manavurukkamum, irakkamum, neediya po'rumaiyum, poora'na kirupaiyum, saththiyamumu'l'la theavan.
enmeal noakkamaaki, enakku irangkum; umathu vallamaiyai umathu adiyaanukku aru'li, umathu adiyaa'lin kumaaranai iradchiyum.
karththaavea, neer enakkuth thu'naiseythu ennaith theat'ruki'rathai en pakaignar ka'ndu vedkappadumpadikku, enakku anukoolamaaka oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaa'npiththaru'lum.
avar asthipaaram parisuththa parvathangka'lil irukki'rathu.
karththar yaakkoapin vaasasthalangka'lellaavat'raippaarkkilum seeyoanin vaasalka'lil piriyamaayirukki'raar.
theavanudaiya nakaramea! unnaik ku'riththu makimaiyaana viseashangka'l vasanikkappadum. (sealaa.)
ennai a'rinthavarka'lukku'l'lea raakaapaiyum paapiloanaiyum ku'riththup peasuvean; ithoa, pelisthiyarilum, theeriyarilum, eththiyoappiyarilungkooda, innaan angkea pi'ranthaan en'rum;
seeyoanaikku'riththu, innaan innaan athilea pi'ranthaanen'rum sollappadum; unnathamaanavarthaamea athai sthirappaduththuvaar.
karththar janangka'laip pearezhuthumpoathu, innaan athilea pi'ranthaan en'ru avarka'laith thokaiyiduvaar. (sealaa.)
engka'l oot'ruka'lellaam unnil irukki'rathu en'ru paaduvaarum aaduvaarum eakamaaych solluvaarka'l.
en iradchippin theavanaakiya karththaavea, iravum pakalum ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean.
en vi'n'nappam umathu samukaththil varuvathaaka; en kooppiduthalukku umathu seviyaich saayththaru'lum.
en aaththumaa thukkaththaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; en jeevan paathaa'laththi'rkuch sameepamaay vanthirukki'rathu.
naan kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'loadu e'n'nappattu, pelanat'ra manushanaippoalaanean.
mariththavarka'lil oruvanaippoal nekizhappattirukki'rean; neer ini orupoathum ninaiyaathapadi, umathu kaiyaal a'ruppu'ndupoayp pireathakkuzhika'lilea kidakki'ravarka'laippoalaanean.
ennaip paathaa'lakkuzhiyilum iru'lilum aazhangka'lilum vaiththeer.
ummudaiya koapam ennai iruththuki'rathu; ummudaiya alaika'l ellaavat'rinaalum ennai varuththappaduththuki'reer. (sealaa.)
enakku a'rimukamaanavarka'lai enakkuth thooramaaka vilakki, avarka'lukku ennai aruvaruppaakkineer; naan ve'liyea pu'rappadakkoodaathapadi adaipattirukki'rean.
thukkaththinaal en ka'n thoynthupoayit'ru; karththaavea, anuthinamum naan ummai noakkik kooppittu, umakku nearaaka en kaika'lai virikki'rean.
mariththavarka'lukku athisayangka'laich seyveeroa? seththuppoana veerar ezhunthu ummaith thuthippaarka'loa? (sealaa.)
pireathakkuzhiyil umathu kirupaiyum, azhivil umathu u'nmaiyum vivarikkappadumoa?
iru'lil umathu athisayangka'lum, ma'rathiyin poomiyil umathu neethiyum a'riyappadumoa?
naanoa karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; kaalaiyilea en vi'n'nappam umakku munpaaka varum.
karththaavea, ean en aaththumaavaith tha'l'lividuki'reer? ean umathu mukaththai enakku ma'raikki'reer?
si'ruvayathumuthal naan si'rumaippattavanum maa'ndupoaki'ravanumaayirukki'rean; ummaal varum thikilka'l enmeal sumanthirukki'rathu, naan manangkalangkuki'rean.
ummudaiya erichchalka'l enmeal pura'ndupoaki'rathu; ummudaiya payangkarangka'l ennai athampa'n'nuki'rathu.
avaika'l naadoa'rum tha'n'neeraippoal ennaich soozhnthu, eakamaay ennai va'lainthuko'l'luki'rathu.
sineakithanaiyum thoazhanaiyum enakkuth thooramaaka vilakkineer; enakku a'rimukamaanavarka'l ma'rainthupoanaarka'l.
karththarin kirupaika'lai en'ren'raikkum paaduvean; umathu u'nmaiyaith thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka en vaayinaal a'rivippean.
kirupai en'ren'raikkum sthirappattirukkum; umathu u'nmaiyai vaanangka'lilea sthaapippeer en'rean.
ennaal therinthuko'l'lappattavanoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethai noakki:
en'ren'raikkum un santhathiyai nilaippaduththi, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka un singkaasanaththai sthaapippean en'ru aa'naiyittean en'reer. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, vaanangka'l ummudaiya athisayangka'laith thuthikkum, parisuththavaanka'lin sapaiyilea ummudaiya u'nmaiyum vi'langkum.
aakaayama'ndalaththil karththarukku nikaraanavar yaar? palavaanka'lin puththiraril karththarukku oppaanavar yaar?
theavan parisuththavaanka'ludaiya aaloasanaich sapaiyil mikavum payappadaththakkavar, thammaich soozhnthirukki'ra anaivaraalum agnchappadaththakkavar.
seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummaippoal vallamaiyu'l'la karththar yaar? ummudaiya u'nmai ummaich soozhnthirukki'rathu.
theavareer samuththiraththin perumaiyai aa'luki'ravar; athin alaika'l ezhumpumpoathu avaika'lai adangkappa'n'nuki'reer.
neer raakaapai vettu'nda oruvanaippoal no'rukkineer; umathu vallamaiyaana puyaththinaal ummudaiya saththurukka'laich sitha'radiththeer.
vaanangka'l ummudaiyathu, poomiyum ummudaiyathu, pooloakaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavaiyum neerea asthipaarappaduththineer.
vadakkaiyum the'rkaiyum neer u'ndaakkineer; thaapoarum ermoanum ummudaiya naamam vi'langkak kempeerikkum.
umakku vallamaiyu'l'la puyamirukki'rathu; ummudaiya karam paraakkiramamu'l'lathu; ummudaiya valathukaram unnathamaanathu.
neethiyum niyaayamum ummudaiya singkaasanaththin aathaaram; kirupaiyum saththiyamum umakku munpaaka nadakkum.
kempeerasaththaththai a'riyum janangka'l paakkiyamu'l'lavarka'l; karththaavea, avarka'l ummudaiya mukaththin ve'lichchaththil nadappaarka'l.
avarka'l ummudaiya naamaththil naadoa'rum ka'likoornthu, ummudaiya neethiyaal uyarnthiruppaarka'l.
neerea avarka'l palaththin makimaiyaayirukki'reer; ummudaiya thayavinaal engka'l kompu uyarum.
karththaraal engka'l keadakamum, isravealin parisuththaraal engka'ludaiya raajaavum u'ndu.
appozhuthu neer ummudaiya pakthanukkuth tharisanamaaki: sakaayagnseyyaththakka sakthiyai oru savuriyavaanmeal vaiththu, janaththil therinthuko'l'lappattavanai uyarththinean.
en thaasanaakiya thaaveethaik ka'ndupidiththean; en parisuththa thailaththinaal avanai apisheakampa'n'ninean.
en kai avanoadea u'ruthiyaayirukkum; en puyam avanaip palappaduththum.
saththuru avanai nerukkuvathillai; niyaayakkeattin makan avanai odukkuvathillai.
avan saththurukka'lai avanukkumunpaaka madangkadiththu, avanaip pakaikki'ravarka'lai vettuvean.
en u'nmaiyum en kirupaiyum avanoadirukkum; en naamaththinaal avan kompu uyarum.
avan kaiyaich samuththiraththinmealum, avan valathukaraththai aa'ruka'lmealum aa'lumpadi vaippean.
avan ennai noakki: neer en pithaa, en theavan, en iradchippin kanmalaiyen'ru solluvaan.
naan avanai enakku mutha'rpea'raanavanum, poomiyin raajaakka'laippaarkkilum makaa uyarnthavanumaakkuvean.
en kirupaiyai en'ren'raikkum avanukkaakak kaappean; en udanpadikkai avanukkaaka u'ruthippaduththappadum.
avan santhathi en'ren'raikkum nilaiththirukkavum, avan raajaasanam vaanangka'lu'l'lamattum nilaini'rkavum seyvean.
avan pi'l'laika'l en niyaayangka'linpadi nadavaamal, en veathaththai vittu vilaki;
en katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'laamal, en niyamangka'lai mee'rinadanthaal;
avarka'l mee'ruthalai milaat'rinaalum, avarka'l akkiramaththai vaathaika'linaalum tha'ndippean.
aanaalum en kirupaiyai avanai vittu vilakkaamalum, en u'nmaiyil pisakaamalum iruppean.
en udanpadikkaiyai mee'raamalum, en uthaduka'l vi'lampinathai maat'raamalum iruppean.
oruvisai en parisuththaththinpearil aa'naiyittean, thaaveethukku naan poysollean.
avan santhathi en'ren'raikkum irukkum; avan singkaasanam sooriyanaippoala enakku munpaaka nilaini'rkum.
santhiranaippoala athu en'ren'raikkum u'ruthiyaayum, aakaayama'ndalaththuch saadchiyaippoal u'nmaiyaayum irukkum en'ru vi'lampineer. (sealaa.)
aanaalum neer engka'lai ve'ruththuth tha'l'livitteer, neer apisheakampa'n'nuviththavanmeal ukkiramaaneer.
umathu adiyaanudan neer pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai ozhiththuvittu, avan kireedaththaith tharaiyilea tha'l'li avamaanappaduththineer.
avan mathilka'laiyellaam thakarththuppoattu, avan ara'naana sthalangka'laip paazhaakkineer.
vazhinadakki'ra yaavarum avanaik ko'l'laiyiduki'raarka'l; than ayalaarukku ninthaiyaanaan.
avan saththurukka'lin valathukaiyai neer uyarththi, avan viroathika'l yaavarum santhoashikkumpadi seytheer.
avan pattayaththin karukkai mazhukkippoattu, avanai yuththaththil ni'rkaathapadi seytheer.
avan makimaiyai at'ruppoakappa'n'ni, avan singkaasanaththaith tharaiyilea tha'l'lineer.
avan vaalipanaadka'laik ku'rukki, avanai vedkaththaal moodineer. (sealaa.)
ethuvaraikkum, karththaavea! neer en'raikkum ma'rainthiruppeeroa? umathu koapam akkiniyaippoala eriyumoa?
en jeevan evva'lavu nilaiyat'rathu enpathai ninaiththaru'lum; manupuththirar yaavaraiyum vee'naakach sirushdikka vea'ndiyathenna?
mara'naththaik kaa'naamal uyiroadiruppavan yaar? than aaththumaavaip paathaa'la valladikku vilakkividuki'ravan yaar? (sealaa.)
aa'ndavarea, neer thaaveethukku ummudaiya u'nmaiyaikko'ndu saththiyampa'n'nina umathu poorva kirupaika'l engkea?
aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya saththurukka'l ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararaiyum, neer apisheakampa'n'ninavanin kaaladika'laiyum ninthikki'rapadiyinaal,
karththaavea, umathu adiyaar sumakkum ninthaiyaiyum, valumaiyaana janangka'lellaaraalum naan en madiyil sumakkum en ninthaiyaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
karththarukku en'ren'raikkum sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka. aamen, aamen.
aa'ndavarea, theavareer thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka engka'lukku adaikkalamaanavar.
parvathangka'l thoan'rumunnum, neer poomiyaiyum ulakaththaiyum uruvaakkumunnum, neerea anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkum theavanaayirukki'reer.
neer manusharai nirththoo'liyaakki, manupuththirarea, thirumpungka'l enki'reer.
umathu paarvaikku aayiram varusham neat'rukkazhintha naa'lpoalavum iraachsaamampoalavum irukki'rathu.
avarka'lai ve'l'lampoal vaarikko'ndupoaki'reer; niththiraikku oththirukki'raarka'l; kaalaiyilea mu'laikki'ra pullukku oppaayirukki'raarka'l.
athu kaalaiyilea mu'laiththup pooththu, maalaiyilea a'ruppu'ndu ularnthupoam.
naangka'l umathu koapaththinaal azhinthu, umathu ukkiraththinaal kalangkippoaki'roam.
engka'l akkiramangka'lai umakku munpaakavum, engka'l antharangka paavangka'lai umathu mukaththin ve'lichchaththilum ni'ruththineer.
engka'l naadka'lellaam umathu koapaththaal poayvittathu; oru kathaiyaippoal engka'l varushangka'laik kazhiththuppoattoam.

engka'l aayusunaadka'l ezhupathu varusham, pelaththin mikuthiyaal e'npathu varushamaayirunthaalum, athin meanmaiyaanathu varuththamum sagnchalamumea; athu seekkiramaayk kadanthupoaki'rathu, naangka'lum pa'ranthupoaki'roam.
umathu koapaththin vallamaiyaiyum, umakkup payappadaththakkavithamaay umathu ukkiraththaiyum a'rinthuko'l'luki'ravan yaar?
naangka'l gnaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'laakumpadi, engka'l naadka'lai e'n'num a'rivai engka'lukkup poathiththaru'lum.
karththaavea, thirumpivaarum, ethuvaraikkum koapamaayiruppeer? umathu adiyaarukkaakap parithapiyum.
naangka'l engka'l vaazhnaa'lellaam ka'likoornthu makizhumpadi, kaalaiyilea engka'lai umathu kirupaiyaal thirupthiyaakkum.
theavareer engka'laich si'rumaippaduththina naadka'lukkum, naangka'l thunpaththaik ka'nda varushangka'lukkum sariyaay engka'lai makizhchchiyaakkum.
umathu kiriyai umathu oozhiyakkaararukkum, umathu makimai avarka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum vi'langkuvathaaka.

engka'l theavanaakiya aa'ndavarin piriyam engka'lmeal iruppathaaka; engka'l kaika'lin kiriyaiyai engka'lidaththil u'ruthippaduththum; aam, engka'l kaika'lin kiriyaiyai engka'lidaththil u'ruthippaduththiyaru'lum.
unnathamaanavarin ma'raivilirukki'ravan sarvavallavarudaiya nizhalil thangkuvaan.
naan karththarai noakki: neer en adaikkalam, en koattai, en theavan, naan nampiyirukki'ravar en'ru solluvean.
avar unnai veadanudaiya ka'n'nikkum, paazhaakkum ko'l'lainoaykkum thappuvippaar.
avar thamathu si'rakuka'laalea unnai mooduvaar; avar settaika'lin keezhea adaikkalam pukuvaay; avarudaiya saththiyam unakkup parisaiyum keadakamumaakum.
iravil u'ndaakum payangkaraththukkum, pakalil pa'rakkum ampukkum,
iru'lil nadamaadum ko'l'lainoaykkum, maththiyaanaththil paazhaakkum sangkaaraththukkum payappadaathiruppaay.
un pakkaththil aayirampearum, un valathupu'raththil pathinaayirampearum vizhunthaalum, athu unnai a'nukaathu.
un ka'nka'laal maaththiram nee athaip paarththu, thunmaarkkarukku varum palanaik kaa'npaay.
enakku adaikkalamaayirukki'ra unnathamaana karththarai unakkuth thaaparamaakakko'ndaay.
aakaiyaal pollaappu unakku nearidaathu, vaathai un koodaaraththai a'nukaathu.
un vazhika'lilellaam unnaik kaakkumpadi, unakkaakath thammudaiya thootharka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvaar.
un paatham kallil ida'raathapadikku avarka'l unnaith thangka'l kaika'lil eanthikko'ndupoavaarka'l.
singkaththinmealum viriyan paampinmealum nee nadanthu, paalasingkaththaiyum valusarppaththaiyum mithiththuppoaduvaay.
avan ennidaththil vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rapadiyaal avanai viduvippean; en naamaththai avan a'rinthirukki'rapadiyaal avanai uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaippean.
avan ennai noakkik kooppiduvaan, naan avanukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lichseyvean; aapaththil naanea avanoadirunthu, avanaith thappuviththu, avanaik kanappaduththuvean.
neediththa naadka'laal avanaith thirupthiyaakki, en iradchippai avanukkuk kaa'npippean.
karththaraith thuthippathum, unnathamaanavarea, umathu naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvathum,
paththunarampu vee'naiyinaalum, thampuruvinaalum, thiyaanaththoadu vaasikkum surama'ndalaththinaalum,
kaalaiyilea umathu kirupaiyaiyum, iravilea umathu saththiyaththaiyum a'rivippathum nalamaayirukkum.
karththaavea, umathu seykaika'laal ennai makizhchchiyaakkineer, umathu karaththin kiriyaika'linimiththam aananthasaththamiduvean.
karththaavea, umathu kiriyaika'l evva'lavu makaththuvamaanavaika'l! umathu yoasanaika'l makaa aazhamaanavaika'l.
mirukaku'namu'l'la manushan athai a'riyaan; moodan athai u'naraan.
thunmaarkkar pullaippoalea thazhaiththu, akkiramakkaarar yaavarum sezhikkumpoathu, athu avarka'l en'ren'raikkum azhinthupoavatha'rkea eathuvaakum.
karththaavea, neer en'ren'raikkum unnathamaanavaraayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, umathu saththurukka'l azhivaarka'l; umathu saththurukka'l azhintheapoavaarka'l; sakala akkiramakkaararum sitha'ru'ndupoavaarka'l.
en kompaik kaa'ndaamirukaththin kompaippoala uyarththuveer; puthu e'n'neyaal apisheakampa'n'nappaduki'rean.
en saththurukka'lukku neariduvathai en ka'n kaa'num; enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ra thunmaarkkarukku neariduvathai en kaathu keadkum.
neethimaan panaiyaippoal sezhiththu, leepanoanilu'l'la keathuruvaippoal va'laruvaan.
karththarudaiya aalayaththilea naattappattavarka'l engka'l theavanudaiya piraakaarangka'lil sezhiththiruppaarka'l.
karththar uththamaren'rum, en kanmalaiyaakiya avaridaththil aneethiyillaiyen'rum, vi'langkappa'n'numpadi,
avarka'l muthirvayathilum kani thanthu, pushdiyum pasumaiyumaayiruppaarka'l.

karththar raajarikampa'n'nuki'raar, makaththuvaththai a'ninthuko'ndirukki'raar; karththar paraakkiramaththai a'ninthu, avar athaik kachchaiyaakak kattikko'ndirukki'raar; aathalaal poochchakkaram asaiyaathapadi nilaipet'rirukki'rathu.
umathu singkaasanam poorvamuthal u'ruthiyaanathu; neer anaathiyaayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, nathika'l ezhumpina; nathika'l iraichchalittu ezhumpina; nathika'l alaithira'ndu ezhumpina.
thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lin iraichchalaippaarkkilum, samuththiraththin valumaiyaana alaika'laippaarkkilum, karththar unnathaththilea vallamaiyu'l'lavar.
umathu saadchika'l mikavum u'nmaiyu'l'lavaika'l; karththaavea, parisuththamaanathu niththiyanaa'laaka umathu aalayaththin alangkaaramaayirukki'rathu.
neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ra theavanaakiya karththaavea, neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ra theavanea, pirakaasiyum.
poomiyin niyaayaathipathiyea, neer ezhunthu, perumaikkaararukkup pathila'liyum.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkar ethuvaraikkum makizhnthu, thunmaarkkar ethuvaraikkum ka'likoornthiruppaarka'l?
ethuvaraikkum akkiramakkaarar yaavarum vaayaadi, kadinamaayp peasi, perumaipaaraattuvaarka'l?
karththaavea, avarka'l umathu janaththai no'rukki, umathu suthantharaththai odukkuki'raarka'l.
vithavaiyaiyum paratheasiyaiyum kon'ru, thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'laik kolaiseythu:
karththar paaraar, yaakkoapin theavan kavaniyaar en'ru solluki'raarka'l.
janaththil mirukaku'namu'l'lavarka'lea, u'narvadaiyungka'l; moodarea, eppozhuthu puththimaanka'laaveerka'l?
kaathai u'ndaakkinavar kea'laaroa? ka'n'nai uruvaakkinavar kaa'naaroa?
jaathika'lai tha'ndikki'ravar kadinthuko'l'laaroa? manushanukku a'rivaip poathikki'ravar a'riyaaroa?
manushanudaiya yoasanaika'l vee'nen'ru karththar a'rinthirukki'raar.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanukkuk kuzhivettappadumvaraikkum, neer theengkunaadka'lil amarnthirukkappa'n'ni,
sidchiththu, ummudaiya veathaththaikko'ndu poathikki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
karththar thammudaiya janaththai nekizhavidaamalum, thammudaiya suthantharaththaik kaividaamalum iruppaar.
niyaayam neethiyinidamaakath thirumpum; semmaiyaana iruthayaththaar yaavarum athaip pinpat'ruvaarka'l.
thunmaarkkarukku viroathamaay en padchaththil ezhumpuki'ravan yaar? akkiramakkaararukku viroathamaay en padchaththil ni'rpavan yaar?
karththar enakkuth thu'naiyaayiraavittaal, en aaththumaa seekkiramaay mavunaththil vaasampa'n'niyirukkum.
en kaal sa'rukkuki'rathu en'ru naan sollumpoathu, karththaavea, umathu kirupai ennaith thaangkuki'rathu.
en u'l'laththil visaarangka'l perukukaiyil, ummudaiya aa'ruthalka'l en aaththumaavaith theat'ruki'rathu.
theemaiyaik katta'laiyinaal pi'rappikki'ra kodungkoalaasanam umakku isainthirukkumoa?
avarka'l neethimaanudaiya aaththumaavukku viroathamaayk koottangkoodi, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaik kut'rappaduththuki'raarka'l.
karththaroa enakku adaikkalamum, en theavan naan nampiyirukki'ra kanmalaiyumaayirukki'raar.
avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththai avarka'lmeal thiruppi, avarka'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam avarka'laich sangkarippaar; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarea avarka'laich sangkarippaar.
karththaraik kempeeramaayp paadi, nammudaiya iradcha'niyak kanmalaiyaich sangkeerththanam pa'n'nakkadavoam vaarungka'l.
thuthiththaludanea avar sannithikku munpaaka vanthu, sangkeethangka'laal avarai aarppariththup paadakkadavoam.
karththarea makaa theavanum, ellaa theavarka'lukkum makaaraajanumaayirukki'raar.
poomiyin aazhangka'l avar kaiyil irukki'rathu; parvathangka'lin uyarangka'lum avarudaiyavaika'l.
samuththiram avarudaiyathu, avarea athai u'ndaakkinaar; vettaantharaiyaiyum avarudaiya karam uruvaakkit'ru.
nammai u'ndaakkina karththarukku munpaaka naam pa'ninthu kuninthu muzhangkaa'rpadiyidakkadavoam vaarungka'l.
avar nammudaiya theavan; naam avar meaychchalin janangka'lum, avar kaikku'l'laana aaduka'lumaamea.
in'ru avarudaiya saththaththaik keadpeerka'laakil, vanaantharaththil koapam moottinapoathum soathanainaa'lilum nadanthathupoala, ungka'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththaatheayungka'l.
angkea ungka'l pithaakka'l ennaich soathiththu, ennaip pareedchaipaarththu, en kiriyaiyaiyum ka'ndaarka'l.

ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil avarka'l piraveasippathillaiyen'ru, ennudaiya koapaththilea aa'naiyittean.
karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungka'l; poomiyin kudika'lea, ellaarum karththaraip paadungka'l.

neethimaanukkaaka ve'lichchamum, semmaiyaana iruthayaththaarukkaaka makizhchchiyum vithaikkappattirukki'rathu.

poomiyin kudika'lea, neengka'lellaarum karththarai noakki aananthamaay aarppariyungka'l; muzhakkamittuk kempeeramaayp paadungka'l.

karththar seeyoanil periyavar, avar ellaa janangka'lmealum uyarnthavar.

nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai uyarththi, avar paathapadiyilea pa'niyungka'l; avar parisuththamu'l'lavar.
avarudaiya aasaariyaril moaseayum aaroanum, avar naamaththaippat'rik kooppiduki'ravarka'lil saamuvealum, karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; avar avarka'lukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'linaar.
meakasthampaththilirunthu avarka'loadea peasinaar; avarka'l avarudaiya saadchippiramaa'nangka'laiyum avar thangka'lukkuk koduththa katta'laiyaiyum kaikko'ndaarka'l.
engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer avarka'lukku uththaravu aru'lineer; neer avarka'l kiriyaika'linimiththam neethi sarikkattinapoathilum, avarka'lukku mannikki'ra theavanaayiruntheer.
nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai uyarththi, avarudaiya parisuththa parvathaththi'rku nearaakap pa'niyungka'l; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar parisuththamu'l'lavar.
poomiyin kudika'lea, ellaarum karththaraik kempeeramaayp paadungka'l.

avar vaasalka'lil thuthiyoadum, avar piraakaarangka'lil pukazhchchiyoadum piraveasiththu, avaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
karththar nallavar, avarudaiya kirupai en'ren'raikkum, avarudaiya u'nmai thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum u'l'lathu.
irakkaththaiyum niyaayaththaiyum ku'riththup paaduvean; karththaavea, ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
uththamamaana vazhiyilea viveakamaay nadappean; eppozhuthu ennidaththil varuveer! en veettilea uththama iruthayaththoadu nadanthuko'l'luvean.
theengkaana kaariyaththai en ka'nmun vaikkamaattean; vazhi vilakuki'ravarka'lin seykaiyai ve'rukki'rean; athu ennaip pat'raathu.
maa'rupaadaana iruthayam ennaivittu akalavea'ndum; pollaathavanai a'riyamaattean.
pi'ranai irakasiyamaay avathoo'rupa'n'nuki'ravanaich sangkarippean; meattimaik ka'n'nanaiyum perunegnchu'l'lavanaiyum po'rukkamaattean.
theasaththil u'nmaiyaanavarka'l ennoadea vaasampa'n'numpadi en ka'nka'l avarka'lmeal noakkamaayirukkum; uththamamaana vazhiyil nadakki'ravan ennaich seavippaan.
kapaduseyki'ravan en veettukku'l iruppathillai; poysolluki'ravan en ka'nmun nilaippathillai.
akkiramakkaarar oruvarum karththarudaiya nakaraththil iraathapadi vear a'ruppu'ndupoaka, theasaththilu'l'la akkiramakkaarar yaavaraiyum athikaalamea sangkarippean.
karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththaik kea'lum; en kooppiduthal ummidaththil searvathaaka.
en aapaththunaa'lilea umathu mukaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum; umathu seviyai ennidaththil saayum; naan kooppiduki'ra naa'lilea enakkuth theeviramaay uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
en naadka'l pukaiyaippoal ozhinthathu; en elumpuka'l oru ko'l'liyaippoal eriyu'ndathu.

en perumoochchin saththaththinaal, en elumpuka'l en maamsaththoadu ottikko'l'luki'rathu.
vanaanthara naaraikku oppaanean; paazhaana idangka'lil thangkum aanthaiyaippoalaanean.
naan niththiraiyillaamal veettinmeal thaniththirukkum kuruviyaippoal irukki'rean.

avaika'l umathu ka'ndithaththaal vilakiyoadi, umathu kumu'ralin saththaththaal virainthupoayit'ru.
avaika'l malaika'lil ea'ri, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lil i'rangki, neer avaika'lukku ea'rpaduththina idaththil sen'rathu.

avaika'l ve'liyin jeevanka'lukkellaam tha'n'neer kodukkum; angkea kaattukkazhuthaika'l thangka'l thaakaththaith theerththukko'l'lum.
avaika'lin oaramaay aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l sagnchariththu, ki'laika'lmealirunthu paadum.
thammudaiya mealveeduka'lilirunthu parvathangka'lukkuth tha'n'neer i'raikki'raar; umathu kiriyaika'lin palanaalea poomi thirupthiyaayirukki'rathu.
poomiyilirunthu aakaaram u'ndaakumpadi, avar mirukangka'lukkup pullaiyum, manusharukku upayoakamaana payirvakaika'laiyum mu'laippikki'raar.

manushanudaiya iruthayaththai makizhchchiyaakkum thiraadcharasaththaiyum, avanukku mukakka'laiyai u'ndupa'n'num e'n'neyaiyum, manushanudaiya iruthayaththai aatharikkum aakaaraththaiyum vi'laivikki'raar.
karththarudaiya virudchangka'lum, avar naattina leepanoanin keathurukka'lum saaraththinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
angkea kuruvika'l koodukattum; theavathaaruvirudchangka'l kokkuka'lin kudiyiruppu.
uyarntha parvathangka'l varaiyaaduka'lukkum, kanmalaika'l kuzhimusalka'lukkum adaikkalam.
santhiranaik kaalakku'rippuka'lukkaakap padaiththaar; sooriyan than asthamanaththai a'riyum.
neer iru'laik katta'laiyiduki'reer, iraakkaalamaakum; athilea sakala kaattu jeevanka'lum nadamaadum.
paalasingkangka'l iraikkaaka kerchchiththu, theavanaal thangka'lukku aakaaram kidaikkumpadith theadum.
sooriyan uthikkaiyil avaika'l othungki, thangka'l thaaparangka'lil paduththukko'l'lum.
appozhuthu manushan saayangkaalamattum than vealaikkum, than pa'n'naikkum pu'rappaduki'raan.
karththaavea, umathu kiriyaika'l evva'lavu thira'laayirukki'rathu! avaika'laiyellaam gnaanamaayp padaiththeer; poomi ummudaiya poru'lka'linaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
perithum visthaaramumaana inthach samuththiramum appadiyea ni'rainthirukki'rathu; athilea sagncharikkum si'riyavaika'lum periyavaika'lumaana e'n'ni'rantha jeevanka'l u'ndu.
athilea kappalka'l oadum; athilea vi'laiyaadumpadi neer u'ndaakkina thimingkilangka'lum u'ndu.
eat'ravea'laiyil aakaaraththaith tharuveer en'ru avaika'lellaam ummai noakkik kaaththirukkum.
neer kodukka, avaika'l vaangkikko'l'lum; neer ummudaiya kaiyaiththi'rakka, avaika'l nanmaiyaal thirupthiyaakum.
neer umathu mukaththai ma'raikka, thikaikkum; neer avaika'lin suvaasaththai vaangkikko'l'la, avaika'l maa'ndu, thangka'l ma'n'nukkuth thirumpum.
neer ummudaiya aaviyai anuppumpoathu, avaika'l sirushdikkappadum; neer poomiyin roopaththaiyum puthithaakkuki'reer.
karththarudaiya makimai en'ren'raikkum vi'langkum; karththar thammudaiya kiriyaika'lilea makizhuvaar.
avar poomiyai noakkippaarkka, athu athirum; avar parvathangka'laith thoda, avaika'l pukaiyum.
naan uyiroadirukkumattum en karththaraip paaduvean; naan u'l'la'lavum en theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
naan avaraith thiyaanikkum thiyaanam inithaayirukkum; naan karththarukku'l makizhuvean.
paavika'l poomiyilirunthu nirmoolamaaki, thunmaarkkar ini iraama'rpoavaarka'l. en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri, allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththaip pirasthaapamaakkungka'l, avarudaiya seykaika'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea pirasiththappaduththungka'l.
avaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'nungka'l; avarudaiya athisayangka'laiyellaam thiyaaniththup peasungka'l.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththaik ku'riththu meanmaipaaraattungka'l; karththaraith theaduki'ravarka'lin iruthayam makizhvathaaka.
karththaraiyum avar vallamaiyaiyum naadungka'l; avar samukaththai niththamum theadungka'l.
avarudaiya thaasanaakiya aapirakaamin santhathiyea! avaraal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'laakiya yaakkoapin puththirarea!
avar seytha athisayangka'laiyum, avarudaiya a'rputhangka'laiyum, avar vaakkin niyaayaththeerppuka'laiyum ninaivukoorungka'l.
avarea nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar, avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l poomiyengkum vi'langkum.
aayiranthalaimu'raikken'ru avar katta'laiyitta vaakkaiyum, aapirakaamoadea avar pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum,
avar eesaakkukku itta aa'naiyaiyum en'ren'raikkum ninaiththirukki'raar.
athai yaakkoapukkup piramaa'namaakavum, isravealukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaakavum u'ruthippaduththi:
ungka'l suthantharapaakamaana kaanaan theasaththai unakkuth tharuvean en'raar.
akkaalaththil avarka'l kognchath thokaikkudpatta so'rpa janangka'lum paratheasika'lumaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l oru janaththaivittu ma'ru janaththa'ndaikkum, oru raajyaththaivittu ma'ru theasaththaara'ndaikkum poanaarka'l.
avarka'lai odukkumpadi oruvarukkum idangkodaamal, avarka'l nimiththam raajaakka'laik kadinthu ko'ndu:
naan apisheakampa'n'ninavarka'lai neengka'l thodaamalum, ennudaiya theerkkatharisika'lukkuth theengku seyyaamalum irungka'l en'raar.
avar theasaththilea pagnchaththai varuviththu, aakaaramennum aatharavukoalai mut'rilum mu'riththaar.
avarka'lukku munnaalea oru purushanai anuppinaar; yoaseappu si'raiyaaka vi'rkappattaan.
avan kaalka'lai vilangkupoattu odukkinaarka'l; avan piraa'nan irumpil adaipattirunthathu.
karththar sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'ruma'lavum avarudaiya vasanam avanaip pudamittathu.
raajaa aa'l anuppi, avanaik kattavizhkkachsonnaan; janangka'lin athipathi avanai viduthalaipa'n'ninaan.
than pirapukka'lai avan manathinpadi kattavum, than moopparka'lai gnaanika'laakkavum,
avanaith than veettukku aa'ndavanum, than aasthikkellaam athipathiyumaakkinaan.
appozhuthu israveal ekipthi'rku vanthaan; yaakkoapu kaamin theasaththilea paratheasiyaayirunthaan.
avar thammudaiya janangka'lai mikavum palukappa'n'ni, avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'laippaarkkilum avarka'laip palavaanka'laakkinaar.
thammudaiya janangka'laip pakaikkavum, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararai vagnchanaiyaay nadaththavum, avarka'ludaiya iruthayaththai maat'rinaar.
thammudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseayaiyum thaam therinthuko'nda aaroanaiyum anuppinaar.
ivarka'l avarka'lukku'l avarudaiya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum, kaamin theasaththilea a'rputhangka'laiyum seythaarka'l.
avar iru'lai anuppi, anthakaaraththai u'ndaakkinaar; avarudaiya vaarththaika'lai ethirppaarillai.
avarka'ludaiya tha'n'neerka'lai iraththamaaka maat'ri, avarka'ludaiya machchangka'laich saakappa'n'ninaar.
avarka'ludaiya theasam thava'laika'laith thira'laayp pi'rappiththathu; avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'lin a'raiveeduka'lilum avaika'l vanthathu.
avar katta'laiyida, avarka'ludaiya ellaika'lilengkum va'nduka'lum peanka'lum vanthathu.
avarka'ludaiya mazhaika'laik kalmazhaiyaakki, avarka'ludaiya theasaththilea juvaalikki'ra akkiniyai varappa'n'ninaar.
avarka'ludaiya thiraadchach sedika'laiyum aththimarangka'laiyum azhiththu, avarka'ludaiya ellaika'lilu'l'la marangka'laiyum mu'riththaar.
avar katta'laiyida, e'n'nimudiyaatha vettukki'lika'lum pachchaippuzhukka'lum vanthu,
avarka'ludaiya theasaththilu'l'la sakala poo'nduka'laiyum ariththu, avarka'ludaiya nilaththin kaniyaith thin'rupoattathu.
avarka'ludaiya theasaththilea thalaichchanka'l anaiththaiyum, avarka'ludaiya pelanil mutha'rpelanaana yaavaraiyum sangkariththaar.
appozhuthu avarka'lai ve'l'liyoadum ponnoadum pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; avarka'l koaththirangka'lil palaveenappattavan oruvanum irunthathillai.
ekipthiyar avarka'lukkup payanthathinaal, avarka'l pu'rappattapoathu makizhnthaarka'l.
avar meakaththai ma'raivukkaaka viriththu, iravai ve'lichchamaakkuki'ratha'rkaaka akkiniyaiyum thanthaar.
keattaarka'l, avar kaadaika'lai varappa'n'ninaar; vaana appaththinaalum avarka'laith thirupthiyaakkinaar.
kanmalaiyaith thi'ranthaar, tha'n'neerka'l pu'rappattu, va'ra'nda ve'lika'lil aa'raay oadit'ru.
avar thammudaiya parisuththa vaakkuththaththaththaiyum, thammudaiya thaasanaakiya aapirakaamaiyum ninaiththu,
thammudaiya janaththaik ka'lippoadum, thaam therinthuko'ndavarka'laik kempeera saththaththoadum pu'rappadappa'n'ni,
thamathu katta'laika'laik kaaththu nadakkumpadikkum, thamathu niyaayappiramaa'nangka'laik kaikko'l'lumpadikkum,
avarka'lukkup pu'rajaathika'ludaiya theasangka'laik koduththaar; anniya janangka'ludaiya pirayaasaththin palanaich suthanthariththukko'ndaarka'l. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththarudaiya vallamaiyaana seykaika'laich solli, avarudaiya thuthiyaiyellaam pirasthaapappaduththaththakkavan yaar?
niyaayaththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lum, ekkaalaththilum neethiyaichseyki'ravarka'lum paakkiyavaanka'l.
karththaavea, neer therinthuko'ndavarka'lin nanmaiyai naan ka'ndu, ummudaiya jaathiyin makizhchchiyaal makizhnthu, ummudaiya suthantharaththoadea meanmaipaaraattumpadikku,
ummudaiya janangka'lukku neer paaraattum kirupaiyinpadi ennai ninaiththu, ummudaiya iradchippinaal ennaich santhiththaru'lum.
engka'l pithaakka'loadungkooda naangka'lum paavagnseythu, akkiramam nadappiththu, aakaamiyampa'n'ninoam.
engka'l pithaakka'l ekipthilea ummudaiya athisayangka'lai u'naraamalum, ummudaiya kirupaika'lin thiradchiyai ninaiyaamalum poay, sivantha samuththira oaraththilea kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
aanaalum avar thamathu vallamaiyai ve'lippaduththumpadi, thammudaiya naamaththinimiththam avarka'lai iradchiththaar.
avar sivantha samuththiraththai athattinaar, athu vat'rippoayit'ru; vettaantharaiyil nadakki'rathupoala avarka'lai aazhangka'lil nadanthupoakappa'n'ninaar.
pakaignan kaikku avarka'lai vilakki iradchiththu, saththuruvin kaikku avarka'lai vilakki meettaar.
avarka'l saththurukka'laith tha'n'neerka'l moodikko'ndathu; avarka'lil oruvanum meenthirukkavillai.
appozhuthu avarka'l avarudaiya vaarththaika'lai visuvaasiththu, avarudaiya thuthiyaip paadinaarka'l.
aanaalum seekkiramaay avarudaiya kiriyaika'lai ma'ranthaarka'l; avarudaiya aaloasanaikku avarka'l kaaththiraamal,
vanaantharaththilea ichchaiyu'l'lavarka'laaki, avaantharave'liyilea theavanaip pareedchaipaarththaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l keattathai avarka'lukkuk koduththaar, avarka'l aaththumaakka'liloa i'laippai anuppinaar.
paa'layaththil avarka'l moaseayinmealum, karththarudaiya parisuththanaakiya aaroaninmealum po'raamaiko'ndaarka'l.
poomi pi'lanthu thaaththaanai vizhungki, apiraamin koottaththai moodippoattathu.
avarka'l koottaththil akkini pat'riyerinthathu; akkinijuvaalai thunmaarkkarai eriththuppoattathu.
avarka'l oareapilea oru kan'rukkuttiyaiyu'ndaakki, vaarppikkappatta vikkirakaththai namaskariththaarka'l.
thangka'l makimaiyaip pullaith thinki'ra maattin saayalaaka maat'rinaarka'l.
ekipthilea periya kiriyaika'laiyum, kaamin theasaththilea athisayangka'laiyum, sivantha samuththiraththa'ndaiyilea payangkaramaanavaika'laiyum seythavaraakiya,
thangka'l iradchakaraana theavanai ma'ranthaarka'l.

aakaiyaal, avarka'lai naasampa'n'nuvean en'raar; appozhuthu avaraal therinthuko'l'lappatta moasea, avarka'lai avar azhikkaathapadikku, avarudaiya ukkiraththai aat'rumporuttu, avarukku munpaakath thi'rappin vaayilea nin'raan.
avarudaiya vaarththaiyai visuvaasiyaamal, ichchikkappadaththakka theasaththai asattaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaamal, thangka'l koodaarangka'lil mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l vanaantharaththilea madiyavum, avarka'l santhathi jaathika'lukku'l'lea azhiyavum,
avarka'l pa'rpala theasangka'lilea sitha'radikkappadavum, avarka'lukku viroathamaakath thammudaiya kaiyai eduththaar.
avarka'l paakaalpeayoaraip pat'rikko'ndu, jeevanillaathavaika'lukku itta palika'laip pusiththu,
thangka'l kiriyaika'linaal avarukkuk koapam moottinaarka'l; aakaiyaal vaathai avarka'lukku'l pukunthathu.
appozhuthu pinekaas ezhunthu nin'ru niyaayagnseythaan; athinaal vaathai ni'ruththappattathu.
athu thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka en'raikkum avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu.
mearipaavin tha'n'neerka'lidaththilum avarukkuk kadungkoapam moottinaarka'l; avarka'l nimiththam moaseakkum pollaappu vanthathu.
avarka'l avan aaviyai visanappaduththinathinaalea, than uthaduka'linaal patha'rippeasinaan.
karththar thangka'lukkuch sonnapadi, avarka'l antha janangka'lai azhikkavillai.
jaathika'ludanea kalanthu, avarka'l kiriyaika'laik kat'ru;
avarka'ludaiya vikkirakangka'laich seaviththaarka'l; avaika'l avarka'lukkuk ka'n'niyaayit'ru.
avarka'l thangka'l kumaararaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum pisaasuka'lukkup paliyittaarka'l.
avarka'l kaanaantheasaththu vikkirakangka'lukkup paliyittu, thangka'l kumaarar kumaaraththika'ludaiya kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthinaarka'l; theasam iraththaththaal theettuppattathu.
avarka'l thangka'l kiriyaika'linaal asuththamaaki, thangka'l seykaika'linaal soarampoanaarka'l.
athinaal karththarudaiya koapam thamathu janaththinmeal moo'ndathu; avar thamathu suthantharaththai aruvaruththaar.
avarka'lai jaathika'ludaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarka'ludaiya pakaignar avarka'lai aa'ndaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'l avarka'lai odukkinaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kaiyinkeezhth thaazhththappattaarka'l.
aneakantharam avarka'lai viduviththaar; avarka'loa thangka'l yoasanaiyinaal avarukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ni, thangka'ludaiya akkiramaththinaal si'rumaippaduththappattaarka'l.
avarka'l kooppiduthalai avar keadkumpoathoa, avarka'lukku u'ndaana idukkaththai avar ka'n'noakki,
avarka'lukkaakath thamathu udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththu, thamathu mikuntha kirupaiyinpadi manasthaapappattu,
avarka'laich si'raipidiththa yaavarum avarka'lukku irangkumpadi seythaar.

engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, naangka'l umathu parisuththa naamaththaippoat'ri, ummaith thuthikki'rathil meanmaipaaraattumpadi engka'lai iradchiththu, engka'lai jaathika'lilirunthu searththaru'lum.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththar anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkappadaththakkavar. janangka'lellaarum: aamen, allealooyaa, enpaarka'laaka.
karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththaraal saththuruvin kaikku neengkalaakki meedkappattu,
kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vadakkilum the'rkilumu'l'la pala theasangka'lilumirunthu searkkappattavarka'l, appadich sollakkadavarka'l.
avarka'l thaaparikkum ooraik kaa'naamal, vanaantharaththilea avaantharavazhiyaay,
pasiyaakavum, thaakamaakavum, aaththumaa thoynthathaakavum alainthu thirinthaarka'l.
thangka'l aapaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l, avarka'l ikkattuka'lilirunthu avarka'lai viduviththaar.
thaaparikkum oorukkuppoaychseara, avarka'laich sevvaiyaana vazhiyilea nadaththinaar.
thavanamu'l'la aaththumaavaik karththar thirupthiyaakki, pasiyu'l'la aaththumaavai nanmaiyinaal nirappuki'raaren'ru,
avarudaiya kirupaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seyki'ra athisayangka'linimiththamum avaraith thuthippaarka'laaka.
theavanudaiya vaarththaika'lukku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ni, unnathamaanavarudaiya aaloasanaiyai asattaipa'n'ninavarka'l,
anthakaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilum vaikkappattirunthu, odukkaththilum irumpilum kattu'ndu kidanthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya iruthayaththai avar varuththaththaal thaazhththinaar; sakaayarillaamal vizhunthupoanaarka'l.
thangka'l aapaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; avarka'l ikkattuka'lilirunthu avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchiththaar.
anthakaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilumirunthu avarka'lai ve'lippadappa'n'ni, avarka'l kattuka'lai a'ruththaar.
karththar ve'nkalak kathavuka'lai udaiththu, irupputh thaazhppaa'lka'lai mu'riththaaren'ru,
avarudaiya kirupaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seyki'ra athisayangka'linimiththamum avaraith thuthippaarka'laaka.
nirmoodar thangka'l paathakamaarkkaththaalum thangka'l akkiramangka'laalum noayko'ndu odungkippoaki'raarka'l.
avarka'l aaththumaa sakala poajanaththaiyum aroasikki'rathu, avarka'l mara'navaasalka'l pariyantham sameepikki'raarka'l.
thangka'l aapaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppiduki'raarka'l; avarka'l ikkattuka'lukku avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchikki'raar.
avar thamathu vasanaththai anuppi avarka'laik ku'namaakki, avarka'lai azhivukkuth thappuvikki'raar.
avarka'l karththarai avarudaiya kirupaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seyki'ra athisayangka'linimiththamum thuthiththu,
sthoaththirapalika'laich seluththi, avarudaiya kiriyaika'lai aananthasaththaththoadea vivarippaarka'laaka.
kappalea'ri, kadalyaaththiraipa'n'ni, thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lilea thozhil seyki'raarka'lea,
avarka'l karththarudaiya kiriyaika'laiyum, aazhaththilea avarudaiya athisayangka'laiyum kaa'nki'raarka'l.
avar katta'laiyida perungkaat'ru ezhumpi, athin alaika'laik kontha'likkappa'n'num.
avarka'l aakaayaththil ea'ri, aazhangka'lil i'rangkuki'raarka'l, avarka'l aaththumaa kileasaththinaal karainthupoaki'rathu.
ve'riththavanaippoal alainthu thadumaa'ruki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya gnaanamellaam muzhukippoaki'rathu.
appozhuthu thangka'l aapaththilea avarka'l karththarai noakkik kooppiduki'raarka'l, avarka'l ikkattuka'lukku avarka'lai neengkalaakki viduvikki'raar.
kontha'lippai amarththuki'raar, athin alaika'l adangkukin'rathu.
amaithalu'ndaanathinimiththam avarka'l santhoashappaduki'raarka'l; thaangka'l naadina thu'raimukaththil avarka'laik ko'nduvanthu searkki'raar.
avarka'l karththarai avarudaiya kirupaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seyki'ra athisayangka'linimiththamum thuthiththu,
janangka'lin sapaiyilea avarai uyarththi, moopparka'lin sangkaththilea avaraip poat'ruvaarka'laaka.
avar aa'ruka'lai avaantharave'liyaakavum, neeroot'ruka'lai va'ra'nda sthalamaakavum,
kudika'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam sezhippaana theasaththai uvar nilamaakavum maat'ruki'raar.
avar avaantharave'liyaith tha'n'neerth thadaakamaakavum, va'ra'nda nilaththai neeroot'ruka'laakavum maat'ri,
pasiththavarka'lai angkea kudiyeat'ruki'raar; angkea avarka'l kudiyirukkum nakaraththaik katti,
vayalka'lai u'ndaakki vithaiththu, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattuki'raarka'l, avaika'l varaththu'l'la palanaith tharum.
avarka'lai aaseervathikki'raar, mikuthiyum perukuki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya mirukajeevanka'l ku'raiyaathirukkappa'n'nuki'raar.
pinpu avarka'l idukkaththinaalum, aapaththinaalum, thuyaraththinaalum ku'raivupattuth thaazhvadaiki'raarka'l.
avar pirapukka'linmeal ikazhchchi varappa'n'ni, vazhiyillaatha avaantharave'liyilea avarka'laith thiriyachseythu,
e'liyavanaiyoa si'rumaiyinin'ru eduththu, uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaiththu, avan vamsangka'lai manthaiyaippoalaakkuki'raar.
uththamarka'l athaikka'ndu makizhuvaarka'l; niyaayakkeadellaam than vaayai moodum.
evan gnaanamu'l'lavanoa avan ivaika'laik kavanikkakkadavan; gnaanavaanka'l karththarudaiya kirupaika'lai u'narnthuko'lvaarka'l.
theavanea, en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; naan paadik keerththanampa'n'nuvean; en makimaiyum paadum.
vee'naiyea, surama'ndalamea, vizhiyungka'l, naan athikaalaiyil vizhippean.
karththaavea, janangka'lukku'l'lea ummaiththuthippean; jaathika'lukku'l'lea ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
umathu kirupai vaanangka'lukku mealaakavum, umathu saththiyam meakama'ndalangka'l pariyanthamum ettuki'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangka'lukku mealaaka uyarnthirum; umathu makimai poomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaka.
umathu piriyar viduvikkappadumporuttu, umathu valathukaraththinaal iradchiththu, engka'l jepaththaik keattaru'lum.
theavan thamathu parisuththaththaikko'ndu vi'lampinaar, aakaiyaal ka'likooruvean; seekeamaip pangkittu, sukkoaththin pa'l'laththaakkai a'lanthuko'l'luvean.
keeleayaath ennudaiyathu, manaaseayum ennudaiyathu; eppiraayeem en thalaiyin pelan, yoothaa en niyaayappiramaa'nikan.
moavaap en paathapaaththiram; eathoaminmeal en paatharadchaiyai e'rivean; pelisthiyaavin meal aarpparippean.
ara'naana patta'naththi'rku'l ennai nadaththikko'ndu poaki'ravan yaar? eathoammattum enakku vazhikaattuki'ravan yaar?
engka'l seanaika'loadea pu'rappadaamaliruntha theavareerallavaa? engka'laith tha'l'livittiruntha theavareerallavaa?
ikkattil engka'lukku uthaviseyyum; manushanudaiya uthavi viruthaa.
theavanaalea paraakkiramagnseyvoam; avarea engka'l saththurukka'lai mithiththuppoaduvaar.
naan thuthikkum theavanea, mavunamaayiraatheayum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya vaayum, kapattuvaayum, enakku viroathamaayth thi'ranthirukki'rathu; ka'l'lanaavinaal ennoadea peasuki'raarka'l.
pakaiyu'ndaakkum vaarththaika'laal ennaich soozhnthuko'ndu, mukaantharamillaamal ennoadea poarseyki'raarka'l.
en sineakaththukkup pathilaaka ennai viroathikki'raarka'l, naanoa jepampa'n'nikko'ndirukki'rean.
nanmaikkup pathilaaka enakkuth theemaiseyki'raarka'l, en sineakaththukkup pathilaaka ennaip pakaikki'raarka'l.
avanukku mealaakath thushdanai ea'rpaduththivaiyum, saaththaan avan valathupakkaththil ni'rpaanaaka.
avan niyaayam visaarikkappadumpoathu kut'ravaa'liyaakakkadavan; avan jepam paavamaakakkadavathu.
avan naadka'l kognchamaakakkadavathu; avan uththiyoakaththai vea'roruvan pe'rakkadavan.
avan pi'l'laika'l thikkat'ravarka'lum, avan manaivi vithavaiyumaakakkadavarka'l.
avan pi'l'laika'l alainthu thirinthu pichchaiyeduththu, thangka'l paazhaana veeduka'lilirunthu iranthu'n'nakkadavarka'l.
kadan koduththavan avanukku u'l'lathellaavat'raiyum apakariththukko'lvaanaaka; avan pirayaasaththin palanai anniyar pa'riththukko'l'lakkadavarka'l.
avanukku oruvarum irakkang kaa'npiyaamalum, avanudaiya thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lukkuth thayavuseyyaamalum poavaarka'laaka.
avan santhathiyaar nirmoolamaakakkadavarka'l; ira'ndaanthalaimu'raiyil avarka'l pear at'ruppoavathaaka.
avan pithaakka'lin akkiramam karththarukku munpaaka ninaikkappadakkadavathu, avan thaayin paavam neengkaamaliruppathaaka.
avaika'l niththamum karththarukku munpaaka irukkakkadavathu; avarka'l pear poomiyiliraamal nirmoolamaavathaaka.
avan thayaiseyya ninaiyaamal, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaith thunpappaduththi, manamu'rivu'l'lavanaik kolaiseyyumpadi theadinaanea.
saapaththai virumpinaan, athu avanukku varum; avan aaseervaathaththai virumpaama'rpoanaan, athu avanukkuth thooramaay vilakippoam.
saapaththai avan thanakku angkiyaaka uduththikko'ndaan; athu avan u'l'laththil tha'n'neeraippoalavum, avan elumpuka'lil e'n'neyaippoalavum paayum.
athu avan moodikko'l'luki'ra vasthiramaakavum, niththamum kattikko'l'luki'ra kachchaiyaakavum iruppathaaka.
ithuthaan ennai viroathikki'ravarka'lukkum, en aaththumaavukku viroathamaayth theengku peasuki'ravarka'lukkum karththaraal varum palan.
aa'ndavaraakiya karththaavea, neer umathu naamaththinimiththam ennai aathariththu, umathu kirupai nalamaanathinaal, ennai viduviththaru'lum.
naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan, en iruthayam enakku'l kuththu'ndirukki'rathu.
saayum nizhalaippoal akan'ru poanean; vettukki'liyaippoal pa'rakkadikkappaduki'rean.
upavaasaththinaal en muzhangkaalka'l tha'larchchiyadaiki'rathu; en maamsam pushdiyat'ru ularnthu poaki'rathu.
naan avarka'lukku ninthaiyaanean; avarka'l ennaip paarththu, thangka'l thalaiyaith thulukkuki'raarka'l.
en theavanaakiya karththaavea enakkuch sakaayampa'n'num; umathu kirupaiyinpadi ennai iradchiyum.
ithu umathu karam en'rum, karththaavea, theavareer ithaich seytheer en'rum, avarka'l a'rivaarka'laaka.
avarka'l sapiththaalum, neer aaseervathiyum; avarka'l ezhumpinaalum vedkappattuppoavaarka'laaka; umathu adiyaanoa makizhakkadavan.
en viroathika'l ilachchaiyaal moodappattu, thangka'l vedkaththaich saalvaiyaippoal thariththukko'l'lakkadavarka'l.
karththarai naan en vaayinaal mikavum thuthiththu, aneakar naduvilea avaraip pukazhuvean.
aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkki'ravarka'linin'ru e'liyavanudaiya aaththumaavai iradchikkumpadi avar avan valathupaarisaththil ni'rpaar.
karththar en aa'ndavarai noakki: naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum, neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'raar.
karththar seeyoanilirunthu umathu vallamaiyin sengkoalai anuppuvaar; neer ummudaiya saththurukka'lin naduvea aa'lukaiseyyum.

umathu paraakkiramaththin naa'lilea ummudaiya janangka'l manappoorvamum parisuththa alangkaaramumu'l'lavarka'laayiruppaarka'l; vidiya'rkaalaththuk karppaththil pi'rakkum panikkuch samaanamaay ummudaiya yauvana janam umakkup pi'rakkum.
neer melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi en'ren'raikkum aasaariyaraayirukki'reer en'ru karththar aa'naiyittaar; manam maa'raamalumiruppaar.
ummudaiya valathupaarisaththilirukki'ra aa'ndavar, thamathu koapaththin naa'lilea raajaakka'lai vettuvaar.
avar jaathika'lukku'l niyaayantheerppaar; ellaa idangka'laiyum pireathangka'laal nirappuvaar; visthaaramaana theasangka'linmeal thalaivarka'laayirukki'ravarka'lai no'rukkippoaduvaar.
vazhiyilea avar nathiyil kudippaar; aakaiyaal avar thamathu thalaiyai eduppaar.
allealooyaa, semmaiyaanavarka'ludaiya sangkaththilum sapaiyilum karththarai muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthippean.
karththarin seykaika'l periyavaika'lum, avaika'lil piriyappaduki'ra ellaaraalum aaraayappaduki'ravaika'lumaayirukki'rathu.
avarudaiya seyal makimaiyum makaththuvamumu'l'lathu, avarudaiya neethi en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum.
avar thammudaiya athisayamaana seykaika'lai ninaivukoorumpadi seythaar, karththar irakkamum manaurukkamumu'l'lavar.
thamakkup payanthavarka'lukku aakaaram koduththaar; thamathu udanpadikkaiyai en'ren'raikkum ninaippaar.
jaathika'lin suthantharaththaith thamathu janangka'lukkuk koduththathinaal, thamathu kiriyaika'lin pelaththai avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththinaar.
avarudaiya karaththin kiriyaika'l saththiyamum niyaayamumaanavaika'l; avarudaiya katta'laika'lellaam u'nmaiyaanavaika'l.
avaika'l en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lukkum u'ruthiyaanavaika'l, avaika'l u'nmaiyum semmaiyumaaych seyyappattavaika'l.
avar thamathu janaththi'rku meedpai anuppi, thamathu udanpadikkaiyai niththiya udanpadikkaiyaakak katta'laiyittaar; avarudaiya naamam parisuththamum payangkaramumaanathu.
karththarukkup payappaduthalea gnaanaththin aarampam; avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadi seyki'ra yaavarukkum na'rpuththiyu'ndu; avar pukazhchchi en'raikkum ni'rkum.
allealooyaa, karththarukkup payanthu, avarudaiya katta'laika'lil mikavum piriyamaayirukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
avan santhathi poomiyil palaththirukkum, semmaiyaanavarka'lin vamsam aaseervathikkappadum.
aasthiyum aisuvariyamum avan veettilirukkum; avanudaiya neethi en'raikkum ni'rkum.
semmaiyaanavarka'lukku iru'lilea ve'lichcham uthikkum; avan irakkamum manaurukkamum neethiyumu'l'lavan.
irangkik kadankoduththu, than kaariyangka'lai niyaayamaanapadi nadappikki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
avan en'ren'raikkum asaikkappadaathiruppaan; neethimaan niththiya keerththiyu'l'lavan.
thurchseythiyaik keadki'rathinaal payappadaan; avan iruthayam karththarai nampith thidanaayirukkum.
avan iruthayam u'ruthiyaayirukkum; avan than saththurukka'lil sarikkattuthalaik kaa'numattum payappadaathiruppaan.
vaariyi'raiththaan, eazhaika'lukkuk koduththaan, avanudaiya neethi en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum; avan kompu makimaiyaay uyarththappadum.
thunmaarkkan athaik ka'ndu manamadivaaki, than pa'rka'laik kadiththuk karainthupoavaan; thunmaarkkarudaiya aasai azhiyum.
allealooyaa, karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaararea, thuthiyungka'l; karththarudaiya naamaththaith thuthiyungka'l.
ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum karththarudaiya naamam sthoaththirikkappadakkadavathu.
sooriyan uthikkum thisaithodangki athu asthamikkum thisaimattum karththarudaiya naamam thuthikkappaduvathaaka.
karththar ellaa jaathika'lmealum uyarnthavar; avarudaiya makimai vaanangka'lukku mealaanathu.
unnathangka'lil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkuch samaanamaanavar yaar?
avar vaanaththilum poomiyilumu'l'lavaika'laip paarkkumpadi thammaith thaazhththuki'raar.
avar si'riyavanaip puzhuthiyilirunthu thookkividuki'raar; e'liyavanaik kuppaiyilirunthu uyarththuki'raar.
avanaip pirapukka'loadum, thamathu janaththin athipathika'loadum udkaarappa'n'nuki'raar.
maladiyaich santhoashamaana pi'l'laiththaaychchiyaakki, veettilea kudiyirukkappa'n'nuki'raar. allealooyaa.
israveal ekipthilum, yaakkoapin kudumpam anniya paashaikkaararaana janaththilumirunthu pu'rappattapoathu,
yoothaa avarukkup parisuththa sthaanamum, israveal avarukku raajyamumaayit'ru.
kadal ka'ndu vilaki oadit'ru; yoarthaan pinnittuth thirumpinathu.
malaika'l aattukkadaakka'laippoalavum, kun'ruka'l aattukkuttika'laippoalavum thu'l'linathu.
kadalea, nee vilakiyoaduki'ratha'rkum; yoarthaanea, nee pinnittuth thirumpuki'ratha'rkum;
malaika'lea, neengka'l aattukkadaakka'laippoalavum; kun'ruka'lea, neengka'l aattukkuttika'laippoalavum thu'l'luki'ratha'rkum, ungka'lukku enna vanthathu?
poomiyea, nee aa'ndavarukku munpaakavum, yaakkoapudaiya theavanukku munpaakavum athiru.
avar kanmalaiyaith tha'n'neerth thadaakamaakavum, ka'rpaa'raiyai neeroot'ruka'laakavum maat'ruki'raar.
engka'lukku alla, karththaavea, engka'lukku alla, umathu kirupaiyinimiththamum, umathu saththiyaththinimiththamum, ummudaiya naamaththi'rkea makimai varappa'n'num.
avarka'ludaiya theavan ippozhuthu engkea en'ru pu'rajaathika'l solvaanean?
nammudaiya theavan paraloakaththil irukki'raar; thamakkuch siththamaana yaavaiyum seyki'raar.
avarka'ludaiya vikkirakangka'l ve'l'liyum ponnum, manusharudaiya kaivealaiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaika'lukku vaayirunthum peasaathu; avaika'lukkuk ka'nka'lirunthum kaa'naathu.
avaika'lukkuk kaathuka'lirunthum kea'laathu; avaika'lukku mookkirunthum mukaraathu.
avaika'lukkuk kaika'lirunthum thodaathu; avaika'lukkuk kaalka'lirunthum nadavaathu; thangka'l tho'ndaiyaal saththamidavum maattaathu.
avaika'laip pa'n'nuki'ravarka'lum, avaika'lai nampuki'ravarka'l yaavarum, avaika'laippoalavea irukki'raarka'l.
isravealea, karththarai nampu; avarea avarka'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarka'lukkuk keadakamumaayirukki'raar.
aaroan kudumpaththaarea, karththarai nampungka'l; avarea avarka'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarka'lukkuk keadakamumaayirukki'raar.
karththarukkup payappaduki'ravarka'lea, karththarai nampungka'l; avarea avarka'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarka'lukkuk keadakamumaayirukki'raar.
karththar nammai ninaiththirukki'raar, avar aaseervathippaar; israveal kudumpaththaarai aaseervathippaar, avar aaroan kudumpaththaarai aaseervathippaar.
karththarukkup payappaduki'ra periyoaraiyum si'riyoaraiyum aaseervathippaar.
karththar ungka'laiyum ungka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum varththikkappa'n'nuvaar.
vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum padaiththa karththaraalea neengka'l aaseervathikkappattavarka'l.
vaanangka'l karththarudaiyavaika'l; poomiyaiyoa manupuththirarukkuk koduththaar.
mariththavarka'lum mavunaththil i'rangkuki'ra anaivarum karththaraith thuthiyaarka'l.
naamoa, ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum karththarai sthoaththirippoam. allealooyaa.
karththar en saththaththaiyum en vi'n'nappaththaiyum keattathinaal, avaril anpukooruki'rean.
avar thamathu seviyai enakkuch saayththapadiyaal, naan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum avaraith thozhuthuko'l'luvean.
mara'nakkattuka'l ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu, paathaa'la idukka'nka'l ennaip pidiththathu; ikkattaiyum sagnchalaththaiyum adainthean.
appozhuthu naan karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu: karththaavea, en aaththumaavai viduviyum en'ru kegnchinean.
karththar kirupaiyum neethiyumu'l'lavar, nammudaiya theavan manaurukkamaanavar.
karththar kapadat'ravarka'laik kaakki'raar; naan melinthupoanean, avar ennai iradchiththaar.
en aaththumaavea, karththar unakku nanmai seythapadiyaal, nee un i'laippaa'ruthalukkuth thirumpu.
en aaththumaavai mara'naththukkum, en ka'n'naik ka'n'neerukkum, en kaalai ida'ruthalukkum thappuviththeer.
naan karththarukku munpaaka jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea nadappean.
visuvaasiththean, aakaiyaal peasuki'rean; naan mikuthiyum varuththappattean.
entha manushanum poyyan en'ru en manakkalakkaththilea sonnean.
karththar enakkuch seytha ellaa upakaarangka'lukkaakavum, avarukku ennaththaich seluththuvean.
iradchippin paaththiraththai eduththukko'ndu, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luvean.
naan karththarukkuch seytha poruththanaika'lai avarudaiya janangka'lellaarukku munpaakavum seluththuvean.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lin mara'nam avar paarvaikku arumaiyaanathu.
karththaavea, naan umathu adiyean; naan umathu adiyaa'lin puththiranum, umathu oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukki'rean; en kattuka'lai avizhththuvitteer.
naan umakku sthoaththirapaliyaich seluththi, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luvean.
naan karththarukkuch seytha poruththanaika'lai avarudaiya janangka'lellaarukku munpaakavum,
karththarudaiya aalayaththin piraakaarangka'lilum, erusaleamea un naduvilum ni'raiveat'ruvean. allealooyaa.
jaathika'lea, ellaarum karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; janangka'lea, ellaarum avaraip poat'rungka'l.
avar nammeal vaiththa kirupai periyathu; karththarin u'nmai en'ren'raikkumu'l'lathu. allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiyungka'l, avar nallavar; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathen'ru israveal solvathaaka.
avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathen'ru, aaroanin kudumpaththaar solvaarka'laaka.
avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathen'ru, karththarukkup payappaduki'ravarka'l solvaarka'laaka.
nerukkaththilirunthu karththarai noakkik kooppittean, karththar ennaik keattaru'li visaalaththilea vaiththaar.
karththar en padchaththil irukki'raar, naan payappadean; manushan enakku ennaseyvaan?
enakku anukoolam pa'n'nuki'ravarka'l naduvil karththar en padchaththil irukki'raar; en saththurukka'lil sarikkattuthalaik kaa'npean.
manushanai nampuvathaippaarkkilum, karththar pearil pat'ruthalaayiruppathea nalam.
pirapukka'lai nampuvathaippaarkkilum, karththar pearil pat'ruthalaayiruppathea nalam.
ellaa jaathiyaarum ennai va'lainthuko'l'luki'raarka'l; karththarudaiya naamaththinaal avarka'laich sangkarippean.
ennaich sut'rilum va'lainthuko'l'luki'raarka'l; karththarudaiya naamaththinaal avarka'laich sangkarippean.
theaneekka'laippoala ennai va'lainthuko'l'luki'raarka'l; mu'l'lil pat'rina neruppaippoala a'nainthu poavaarka'l; karththarudaiya naamaththinaal avarka'laich sangkarippean.
naan vizhumpadi nee ennaith tha'l'linaay; karththaroa enakku uthaviseythaar.
karththar en pelanum, en keethamumaanavar; avar enakku iradchippumaanaar.
neethimaanka'ludaiya koodaarangka'lil iradchippin kempeerasaththam u'ndu; karththarin valathukaram paraakkiramagnseyyum.
karththarin valathukaram uyarnthirukki'rathu; karththarin valathukaram paraakkiramagnseyyum.
naan saavaamal, pizhaiththirunthu, karththarudaiya seykaika'lai vivarippean.
karththar ennai vekuvaayth tha'ndiththum, ennaich saavukku oppukkodukkavillai.
neethiyin vaasalka'laith thi'ravungka'l; naan avaika'lukku'l piraveasiththuk karththaraith thuthippean.
