karththaavea, ummudaiya irakkangka'l mikuthiyaayirukki'rathu; umathu niyaayangka'linpadi ennai uyirppiyum.
ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'lum ennai viroathikki'ravarka'lum aneakar; aanaalum ummudaiya saadchika'lai vittu vilakean.
umathu vasanaththaik kaaththukko'l'laatha thuroakika'lai naan ka'ndapoathu, enakku aruvaruppaayirunthathu.
ithoa, ummudaiya katta'laika'lai neasikki'rean; karththaavea, umathu kirupaiyinpadi ennai uyirppiyum.
ummudaiya vasanam samoolamum saththiyam, ummudaiya neethi niyaayamellaam niththiyam.
(sheen.) pirapukka'l kaara'namillaamal ennaith thunpappaduththinaarka'l, aanaalum en iruthayam umathu vasanaththi'rkea payappaduki'rathu.
mikuntha ko'l'laiyudaimaiyaik ka'ndupidikki'ravan makizhuki'rathupoala, naan umathu vaarththaiyinpearil makizhuki'rean.
poyyaip pakaiththu aruvarukki'rean; ummudaiya veathaththaiyoa neasikki'rean.
umathu neethiniyaayangka'linimiththam, orunaa'lil eazhutharam ummaith thuthikki'rean.
ummudaiya veathaththai neasikki'ravarka'lukku mikuntha samaathaanamu'ndu; avarka'lukku ida'ralillai.
karththaavea, ummudaiya iradchippukku naan kaaththirunthu, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadi seyki'rean.
en aaththumaa umathu saadchika'laik kaakkum; avaika'lai naan mikavum neasikki'rean.
umathu katta'laika'laiyum umathu saadchika'laiyum kaaththu nadakki'rean; en vazhika'lellaam umakku munpaaka irukki'rathu.
(thau.) karththaavea, en kooppiduthal umathu sannithiyil varuvathaaka; umathu vasanaththinpadiyea ennai u'narvu'l'lavanaakkum.
en vi'n'nappam umathu sannithiyil varuvathaaka; umathu vaarththaiyinpadi ennai viduviththaru'lum.
ummudaiya piramaa'nangka'lai neer enakkup poathikkumpoathu, en uthaduka'l umathu thuthiyaip pirasthaapappaduththum.
umathu ka'rpanaika'lellaam neethiyu'l'lavaika'l; aathalaal, en naavu ummudaiya vasanaththai vivariththuchsollum.
naan ummudaiya katta'laika'laith therinthuko'ndapadiyaal, umathu karam enakkuth thu'naiyaayiruppathaaka.
karththaavea, ummudaiya iradchippinmeal aavalaayirukki'rean; ummudaiya veatham en manamakizhchchi.
en aaththumaa pizhaiththirunthu ummaith thuthikkakkadavathu; umathu niyaayaththeerppuka'l enakku uthaviyaayiruppathaaka.
kaa'naama'rpoana aattaippoala vazhithappippoanean; umathu adiyeanaith theaduveeraaka; umathu ka'rpanaika'lai naan ma'ravean.
en nerukkaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittean; avar enakkuch sevikoduththaar.
karththaavea, poy uthaduka'lukkum kapadanaavukkum en aaththumaavaith thappuviyum.
kapadanaavea, unakku enna kidaikkum? unakku enna seyyappadum?
palavaanudaiya koormaiyaana ampuka'lum, sooraichsedika'lai erikkum thazhalumea kidaikkum.
aiyoa! naan measeakkilea sagnchariththathu poathum, keathaarin koodaarangka'la'ndaiyilea kudiyirunthathum poathum!
samaathaanaththaip pakaikki'ravarka'lidaththil en aaththumaa kudiyirunthathum poathum!
naan samaathaanaththai naaduki'rean; avarka'loa, naan peasumpoathu yuththaththukku eththanappaduki'raarka'l.
enakku oththaasai varum parvathangka'lukku nearaaka en ka'nka'lai ea'redukki'rean.
vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththaridaththilirunthu enakku oththaasai varum.
un kaalaith tha'l'laadavottaar; unnaik kaakki'ravar u'rangkaar.
ithoa, isravealaik kaakki'ravar u'rangkuvathumillai thoongkuki'rathumillai.
karththar unnaik kaakki'ravar; karththar un valathupakkaththilea unakku nizhalaayirukki'raar.
pakalilea veyilaakilum, iravilea nilavaakilum unnaich seathappaduththuvathillai.
karththar unnai ellaath theengkukkum vilakkik kaappaar; avar un aaththumaavaik kaappaar.
karththar un poakkaiyum un varaththaiyum ithumutha'rko'ndu en'raikkung kaappaar.
karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'ru enakku avarka'l sonnapoathu makizhchchiyaayirunthean.
erusaleamea, un vaasalka'lil engka'l kaalka'l ni'rkalaayit'ru.
erusaleam isaivi'naippaana nakaramaayk kattappattirukki'rathu.
angkea isravealukkuch saadchiyaakak karththarudaiya janangka'laakiya koaththirangka'l karththarin naamaththai sthoaththirippatha'rkup poakum.
angkea thaaveethin vamsaththaarudaiya singkaasanangka'laakiya niyaayaasanangka'l vaikkappattirukki'rathu.
erusaleamin samaathaanaththukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; unnai neasikki'ravarka'l sukiththiruppaarka'laaka.
un alangkaththi'rku'l'lea samaathaanamum, un aramanaika'lukku'l'lea sukamum iruppathaaka.
en sakoatharar nimiththamum en sineakithar nimiththamum, unnil samaathaanam iruppathaaka enpean.
engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththinimiththam unakku nanmaiyu'ndaakath theaduvean.
paraloakaththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarea, ummidaththi'rku en ka'nka'lai ea'redukki'rean.

ithoa, vealaikkaararin ka'nka'l thangka'l ejamaanka'lin kaiyai noakkiyirukkumaappoalavum, vealaikkaariyin ka'nka'l than ejamaattiyin kaiyai noakkiyirukkumaappoalavum, engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukku irakkagnseyyumvaraikkum, engka'l ka'nka'l avarai noakkiyirukki'rathu.
engka'lukku irangkum karththaavea, engka'lukku irangkum; ninthanaiyinaal mikavum ni'rainthirukki'roam.
sukajeevika'ludaiya ninthanaiyinaalum, akangkaarika'ludaiya ikazhchchiyinaalum, engka'l aaththumaa mikavum ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
manushar namakku viroathamaay ezhumpinapoathu, karththar namathu pakkaththiliraavittaal,
karththar thaamea namathu pakkaththiliraavittaal,
avarka'l koapam nammeal erikaiyil, nammai uyiroadea vizhungkiyiruppaarka'l.
appozhuthu tha'n'neerka'l nammeal paaynthu, ve'l'langka'l namathu aaththumaavinmeal peruki,
kontha'likkum jalangka'l namathu aaththumaavinmeal pura'ndupoayirukkum en'ru israveal ippozhuthu solvathaaka.
nammai avarka'ludaiya pa'rka'lukku iraiyaaka oppukkodaathirukki'ra karththarukku sthoaththiram.
veadarudaiya ka'n'nikkuth thappina kuruviyaippoala nammudaiya aaththumaa thappit'ru, ka'n'ni the'riththathu, naam thappinoam.
nammudaiya sakaayam vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththarudaiya naamaththil u'l'lathu.
karththarai nampuki'ravarka'l en'ren'raikkum asaiyaamal nilaiththirukkum seeyoan parvathaththaippoal iruppaarka'l.
parvathangka'l erusaleamaich sut'rilum irukkumaappoal, karththar ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum thammudaiya janaththaich sut'rilum irukki'raar.
neethimaanka'l aniyaayaththi'rkuth thangka'l kaika'lai neettaathapadikku, aakaamiyaththin kodungkoal neethimaanka'ludaiya suthantharaththinmeal nilaiththiraathu.
karththaavea, nallavarka'lukkum iruthayaththil semmaiyaanavarka'lukkum nanmaiseyyum.
thangka'l koa'nalaana vazhika'lukkuch saayki'ravarka'laik karththar akkiramakkaararoadea poakappa'n'nuvaar. isravealukkoa samaathaanam u'ndu.
seeyoanin si'raiyiruppaik karththar thiruppumpoathu, soppanam kaa'nki'ravarka'lpoal irunthoam.

appozhuthu nammudaiya vaay nakaippinaalum, nammudaiya naavu aananthasaththaththinaalum ni'rainthirunthathu; appozhuthu: karththar ivarka'lukkup periya kaariyangka'laich seythaar en'ru pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarka'l.
karththar namakkup periya kaariyangka'laich seythaar; ithinimiththam naam makizhnthirukki'roam.
karththaavea, the'rkaththi ve'l'langka'laith thiruppuvathupoala, engka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppum.
ka'n'neeroadea vithaikki'ravarka'l kempeeraththoadea a'ruppaarka'l.
a'l'liththoovum vithaiyaich sumakki'ravan azhuthuko'ndu poaki'raan; aanaalum thaan a'ruththa arika'laich sumanthuko'ndu kempeeraththoadea thirumpivaruvaan.
karththar veettaik kattaaraakil, athaik kattuki'ravarka'lin pirayaasam viruthaa; karththar nakaraththaik kaavaaraakil kaavalaa'lar vizhiththirukki'rathu viruthaa.
neengka'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, nearappada vealaiyilea thariththu, varuththaththin appaththaich saappiduki'rathum viruthaa; avarea thamakkup piriyamaanavanukku niththirai a'likki'raar.
ithoa, pi'l'laika'l karththaraal varum suthantharam, karppaththin kani avaraal kidaikkum palan.
vaalavayathin kumaarar palavaan kaiyilu'l'la ampuka'lukku oppaayirukki'raarka'l.
avaika'laal than ampa'raaththoo'niyai nirappina purushan paakkiyavaan; avarka'l naa'namadaiyaamal olimukavaasalil saththurukka'loadea peasuvaarka'l.
karththarukkup payanthu, avar vazhika'lil nadakki'ravan evanoa, avan paakkiyavaan.
un kaika'lin pirayaasaththai nee saappiduvaay; unakkup paakkiyamum nanmaiyum u'ndaayirukkum.
un manaivi un veettoarangka'lil kanitharum thiraadchakkodiyaippoal iruppaa'l; un pi'l'laika'l un panthiyaich sut'rilum olivamarak kan'ruka'laippoal iruppaarka'l.
ithoa, karththarukkup payappaduki'ra manushan ivvithamaay aaseervathikkappaduvaan.
karththar seeyoanilirunthu unnai aaseervathippaar; nee jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam erusaleamin vaazhvaik kaa'npaay.
nee un pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'laiyum, isravealukku u'ndaakum samaathaanaththaiyum kaa'npaay.
en si'ruvayathu thodangki aneakantharam ennai nerukkinaarka'l.
en si'ruvayathu thodangki aneakantharam ennai nerukkiyum, ennai mea'rko'l'laama'rpoanaarka'l.
uzhuki'ravarka'l en muthukinmeal uzhuthu, thangka'l padaichchaalka'lai nee'lamaakkinaarka'l.
karththaroa neethiyu'l'lavar; thunmaarkkarudaiya kayi'ruka'lai avar a'ruththaar en'ru, israveal ippozhuthu solvathaaka.
seeyoanaip pakaikki'ra anaivarum vedkip pinnittuth thirumpakkadavarka'l.
veettinmeal mu'laikkum pullukku avarka'l oppaavaarka'laaka; athu va'larumun ularnthupoam.
a'rukki'ravan athinaal than kaiyaiyum, arika'laik kattuki'ravan than madiyaiyum nirappuvathillai.
karththarudaiya aaseervaatham ungka'lukku u'ndaavathaaka; karththarin naamaththinaal ungka'lai aaseervathikki'roam en'ru vazhippoakkar solvathumillai.
karththaavea, aazhangka'lilirunthu ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean.
aa'ndavarea, en saththaththaik kea'lum; en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththi'rku umathu sevika'l kavaniththiruppathaaka.
karththaavea, neer akkiramangka'laik kavaniththiruppeeraanaal, yaar nilaini'rpaan, aa'ndavarea.
umakkup payappadumpadikku ummidaththil mannippu u'ndu.
karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'rean; en aaththumaa kaaththirukki'rathu; avarudaiya vaarththaiyai nampiyirukki'rean.
eppozhuthu vidiyum en'ru vidiya'rkaalaththukkuk kaaththirukki'ra jaamakkaararaippaarkkilum athikamaay en aaththumaa aa'ndavarukkuk kaaththirukki'rathu.
israveal karththarai nampiyiruppathaaka; karththaridaththil kirupaiyum, avaridaththil thira'laana meedpum u'ndu.
avar isravealai athin sakala akkiramangka'linin'rum meettukko'lvaar.
karththaavea, en iruthayam i'rumaappu'l'lathalla, en ka'nka'l meattimaiyu'l'lavaika'lumalla; periya kaariyangka'lilum, enakku mignchina karumangka'lilum naan thalaiyiduki'rathumillai.
thaayin paalma'rantha kuzhanthaiyaippoala naan en aaththumaavai adakki amarappa'n'ninean; en aaththumaa paalma'rantha kuzhanthaiyaippoal irukki'rathu.
ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum israveal karththarai nampiyiruppathaaka.
karththaavea, thaaveethaiyum avanudaiya sakala upaththiravaththaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
avan: naan karththarukku oru idaththaiyum, yaakkoapin vallavarukku oru vaasasthalaththaiyum kaa'numattum,
en veedaakiya koodaaraththil piraveasippathumillai, en padukkaiyaakiya kattilinmeal ea'ruvathumillai;
en ka'nka'lukku niththiraiyaiyum, en imaika'lukku u'rakkaththaiyum varaviduvathumillai en'ru,
karththarukku aa'naiyittu, yaakkoapin vallavarukkup poruththanai pa'n'ninaan.
ithoa, naam eppiraaththaavilea athin seythiyaik keattu, vanaththin ve'lika'lil athaik ka'ndoam.
avarudaiya vaasasthalangka'lukku'l piraveasiththu, avar paathapadiyil pa'nivoam.
karththaavea, umathu vallamai vi'langkum pettiyudan neer umathu thaapara sthalaththi'rku'l ezhuntharu'lum.
ummudaiya aasaariyarka'l neethiyaith thariththu, ummudaiya parisuththavaanka'l kempeerippaarka'laaka.
neer apisheakampa'n'nuviththavanin mukaththai umathu thaasanaakiya thaaveethinimiththam pu'rakka'niyaathirum.
un karppaththin kaniyai un singkaasanaththinmeal vaippean en'rum,

un kumaarar en udanpadikkaiyaiyum, naan poathikkum en saadchika'laiyum kaaththu nadanthaal, avarka'l kumaararum en'ren'raikkum un singkaasanaththil veet'riruppaarka'l en'rum, karththar thaaveethukku u'nmaiyaay aa'naiyittaar; avar thava'ramaattaar.
karththar seeyoanaith therinthuko'ndu, athu thamakku vaasasthalamaakumpadi virumpinaar.
ithu en'ren'raikkum naan thangkum idam; ithai naan virumpinapadiyaal, ingkea vaasampa'n'nuvean.
athin aakaaraththai naan aaseervathiththu varuvean; athin eazhaika'lai naan appaththinaal thirupthiyaakkuvean.
athin aasaariyarka'lukku iradchippai uduththuvean; athilu'l'la parisuththavaanka'l mikavum kempeerippaarka'l.
angkea thaaveethukkaaka oru kompai mu'laikkappa'n'nuvean; naan apisheakampa'n'nuviththavanukkaaka oru vi'lakkai aayaththampa'n'ninean.
avan saththurukka'lukku vedkaththai uduththuvean; avanmeethiloa avan kireedam pookkum en'raar.
ithoa, sakoatharar orumiththu vaasampa'n'nuki'rathu eththanai nanmaiyum eththanai inpamumaanathu?
athu aaroanudaiya sirasinmeal oot'rappattu, avanudaiya thaadiyilea vadiki'rathum, avanudaiya angkika'linmeal i'rangkuki'rathumaana nalla thailaththukkum,
ermoanmealum, seeyoan parvathangka'lmealum i'rangkum panikkum oppaayirukki'rathu; angkea karththar en'ren'raikkum aaseervaathaththaiyum jeevanaiyum katta'laiyiduki'raar.
ithoa, iraakkaalangka'lil karththarudaiya aalayaththil ni'rkum karththarin oozhiyakkaararea, neengka'lellaarum karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
ungka'l kaika'laip parisuththa sthalaththi'rku nearaaka eduththu, karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththar seeyoanilirunthu unnai aaseervathippaaraaka.
allealooyaa, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thuthiyungka'l; karththarin oozhiyakkaararea, thuthiyungka'l.
karththarudaiya veettilum, namathu theavanudaiya aalayappiraakaarangka'lilum ni'rki'ravarka'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l.
karththar nallavar; avarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nungka'l; athu inpamaanathu.
karththar yaakkoapaith thamakkaakavum, isravealaith thamakkuch sonthamaakavum therinthuko'ndaar.
karththar periyavar en'rum, nammudaiya aa'ndavar ellaa theavarka'lukkum mealaanavar en'rum naan a'rivean.
vaanaththilum poomiyilum, samuththirangka'lilum, ellaa aazhangka'lilum, karththar thamakkuch siththamaanathaiyellaam seyki'raar.
avar poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lilirunthu meakangka'lai ezhumpappa'n'ni, mazhaiyudan minnalaiyum u'ndaakki, kaat'raith thamathu pa'ndasaalaika'lilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nuki'raar.
avar ekipthilea manusharudaiya thalaippi'l'laika'laiyum mirukaththin thalaiyeet'ruka'laiyum adiththaar.
ekipthutheasamea, un naduvil paarvoanmealum avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararmealum adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum anuppinaar.
avar aneakam jaathika'lai adiththu, palaththa raajaakka'laik kon'ru;
emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanaiyum, paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakaiyum, kaanaanin sakala raajyangka'laiyum azhiththu,
avarka'l theasaththaith thammudaiya janamaakiya isravealukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththaar.
karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam en'raikkumu'l'lathu; karththaavea, ummudaiya pirasthaapam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum irukkum.
karththar thammudaiya janaththin niyaayaththai visaariththu, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararmeal parithaapappaduvaar.
agngnaanika'ludaiya vikkirakangka'l ve'l'liyum ponnum, manusharudaiya kaivealaiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaika'lukku vaayirunthum peasaathu, avaika'lukkuk ka'nka'lirunthum kaa'naathu.
avaika'lukkuk kaathuka'lirunthum kea'laathu, avaika'ludaiya vaayilea suvaasamumillai.
avaika'laip pa'n'nuki'ravarka'lum, avaika'lai nampuki'ravarka'l yaavarum, avaika'laippoal irukki'raarka'l.
israveal kudumpaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l; aaroan kudumpaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
leavi kudumpaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l; karththarukkup payanthavarka'lea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra karththarukku seeyoanilirunthu sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka. allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
theavaathi theavanaith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththaathi karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
oruvaraayp periya athisayangka'laich seyki'ravaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
vaanangka'lai gnaanamaay u'ndaakkinavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
tha'n'neerka'lukku mealea poomiyaip parappinavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
periya sudarka'lai u'ndaakkinavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu;
pakalil aa'lach sooriyanaip padaiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
iravil aa'lach santhiranaiyum nadchaththirangka'laiyum padaiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu;
ekipthiyarudaiya thalaichchanka'laich sangkariththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
avarka'l naduvilirunthu isravealaip pu'rappadappa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
palaththa kaiyinaalum oangkiya puyaththinaalum athaich seythavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
sivantha samuththiraththai ira'ndaakap piriththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
athin naduvea isravealaik kadanthupoakappa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paarvoanaiyum avan seanaika'laiyum sivantha samuththiraththil kavizhththuppoattavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
thammudaiya janangka'lai vanaantharaththil nadaththinavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
periya raajaakka'laich sangkariththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
pirapalamaana raajaakka'lai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
emoariyarin raajaavaakiya seekoanai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paasaanin raajaavaakiya oakai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
avarka'l theasaththaich suthantharamaakath thanthavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
athaith thammudaiya thaasanaakiya isravealukkuch suthantharamaakavea thanthavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
nammudaiya thaazhvil nammai ninaiththavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
nammudaiya saththurukka'lin kaiyilirunthu nammai viduthalaipa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
maamsatheakamu'l'la yaavukkum aakaarang kodukki'ravaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paraloakaththin theavanaith thuthiyungka'l; avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paapiloan aa'ruka'l arukea naangka'l udkaarnthu, angkea seeyoanai ninaiththu azhuthoam.
athin naduvilirukkum alarichsedika'linmeal engka'l kinnarangka'laith thookkivaiththoam.

engka'laich si'raipidiththavarka'l angkea engka'l paadalka'laiyum, engka'laip paazhaakkinavarka'l mangka'la keethaththaiyum virumpi: seeyoanin paattuka'lil silathai engka'lukkup paadungka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.
karththarin paattai anniyatheasaththil naangka'l paaduvatheppadi?
erusaleamea, naan unnai ma'ranthaal en valathukai than thozhilai ma'rappathaaka.
naan unnai ninaiyaamalum, erusaleamai en mukkiyamaana makizhchchiyilum athikamaaka e'n'naamalumpoanaal, en naavu en mealvaayoadu ottikko'lvathaaka.
karththaavea, erusaleamin naa'lil eathoamin puththirarai ninaiyum; avarka'l: athai idiththuppoadungka'l, asthipaaramattum idiththuppoadungka'l en'ru sonnaarka'lea.
paapiloan kumaaraththiyea, paazhaayppoaki'rava'lea, nee engka'lukkuch seythapadi unakkup pathil seyki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
un kuzhanthaika'laip pidiththu, kallinmeal moathiyadikki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
ummai en muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthippean; theavarka'lukku munpaaka ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.

umathu parisuththa aalayaththi'rku nearaaka naan pa'ninthu, umathu kirupaiyinimiththamum umathu u'nmaiyinimiththamum umathu naamaththaith thuthippean; umathu sakala pirasthaapaththaippaarkkilum umathu vaarththaiyai neer makimaippaduththiyirukki'reer.
naan kooppitta naa'lilea enakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lineer; en aaththumaavilea pelanthanthu ennaith thairiyappaduththineer;
karththaavea, poomiyin raajaakka'lellaarum umathu vaayin vaarththaika'laik keadkumpoathu ummaith thuthippaarka'l.
karththarin makimai perithaayiruppathinaal, avarka'l karththarin vazhika'laip paaduvaarka'l.
karththar uyarnthavaraayirunthum, thaazhmaiyu'l'lavanai noakkip paarkki'raar; meattimaiyaanavanaiyoa thooraththilirunthu a'riki'raar.
naan thunpaththin naduvil nadanthaalum neer ennai uyirppippeer; en saththurukka'lin koapaththukku viroathamaaka umathu kaiyai neettuveer; umathu valathukaram ennai iradchikkum.
karththar enakkaaka yaavaiyum seythu mudippaar; karththaavea, umathu kirupai en'rumu'l'lathu; umathu karaththin kiriyaika'lai nekizhavidaathiruppeeraaka.
karththaavea, neer ennai aaraaynthu, a'rinthirukki'reer.
en udkaaruthalaiyum en ezhunthirukkuthalaiyum neer a'rinthirukki'reer; en ninaivuka'laith thooraththilirunthu a'riki'reer.
naan nadanthaalum paduththirunthaalum ennaich soozhnthirukki'reer; en vazhika'lellaam umakkuth theriyum.
en naavil sol pi'ravaathatha'rkumunnea, ithoa, karththaavea, athaiyellaam neer a'rinthirukki'reer.
mu'rpu'raththilum pi'rpu'raththilum neer ennai nerukki, umathu karaththai enmeal vaikki'reer.
intha a'rivu enakku mikuntha aachchariyamum, enakku ettaatha uyaramumaayirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya aavikku ma'raivaaka engkea poavean? ummudaiya samukaththaivittu engkea oaduvean?
naan vaanaththi'rku ea'rinaalum, neer angkea irukki'reer; naan paathaa'laththil padukkai poattaalum, neer angkeayum irukki'reer.
naan vidiya'rkaalaththuch settaika'lai eduththu, samuththiraththin kadaiyaantharangka'lilea poayth thangkinaalum,
angkeayum umathu kai ennai nadaththum, umathu valathukaram ennaip pidikkum.
iru'l ennai moodikko'l'lumen'raalum, iravum ennaich sut'ri ve'lichchamaayirukkum.
umakku ma'raivaaka iru'lum anthakaarappaduththaathu; iravum pakalaippoala ve'lichchamaayirukkum; umakku iru'lum ve'lichchamum sari.
neer en u'l'linthiriyangka'laik kaikko'ndirukki'reer; en thaayin karppaththil ennaik kaappaat'rineer.
naan piramikkaththakka athisayamaay u'ndaakkappattapadiyaal, ummaith thuthippean; umathu kiriyaika'l athisayamaanavaika'l, athu en aaththumaavukku nan'raayth theriyum.
naan o'lippidaththilea u'ndaakkappattu, poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lilea visiththira vinoathamaay uruvaakkappattapoathu, en elumpuka'l umakku ma'raivaayirukkavillai.
en karuvai ummudaiya ka'nka'l ka'ndathu; en avayavangka'lil on'raakilum illaathapoathea avaika'l anaiththum, avaika'l uruvea'rpadum naadka'lum, umathu pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirunthathu.
theavanea, umathu aaloasanaika'l enakku eththanai arumaiyaanavaika'l; avaika'lin thokai evva'lavu athikam.
avaika'lai naan e'n'nappoanaal, ma'nalaippaarkkilum athikamaam; naan vizhikkumpoathu innum umma'ndaiyil irukki'rean.
theavanea, neer thunmaarkkanai azhiththeeraanaal nalamaayirukkum; iraththappiriyarea, neengka'l ennaivittu akan'rupoangka'l.
avarka'l ummaik ku'riththuth thunmaarkkamaayp peasuki'raarka'l; ummudaiya saththurukka'l umathu naamaththai vee'naay vazhangkuki'raarka'l.
karththaavea, ummaip pakaikki'ravarka'lai naan pakaiyaamalum, umakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lai aruvarukkaamalum iruppeanoa?
muzhuppakaiyaay avarka'laip pakaikki'rean; avarka'lai enakkup pakaignaraaka e'n'nuki'rean.
theavanea, ennai aaraaynthu, en iruthayaththai a'rinthuko'l'lum; ennaich soathiththu, en sinthanaika'lai a'rinthuko'l'lum.
veathanai u'ndaakkum vazhi ennidaththil u'ndoa en'ru paarththu, niththiya vazhiyilea ennai nadaththum.
karththaavea, pollaatha manushanukku ennaith thappuviyum; kodumaiyu'l'lavanukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
avarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththil pollaappuka'laich sinthiththu, yuththagnseyya naa'lthoa'rum koottangkooduki'raarka'l.
sarppaththaippoal thangka'l naavaik koormaiyaakkuki'raarka'l; avarka'l uthaduka'linkeezh viriyan paampinvisham irukki'rathu. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanudaiya kaika'lukku ennai neengkalaakki, kodiyavanukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum; avarka'l en nadaika'laik kavizhkkappaarkki'raarka'l.
akangkaarika'l enakkuk ka'n'niyaiyum kayi'ruka'laiyum ma'raivaay vaikki'raarka'l; vazhiyoaraththilea valaiyai viriththu, enakkuch surukkuka'lai vaikki'raarka'l. (sealaa.)
naan karththarai noakki: neer en theavan en'rean; karththaavea, en vi'n'nappangka'lin saththaththukkuch sevikodum.
aa'ndavaraakiya karththaavea, en iradchippin pelanea, yuththanaa'lil en thalaiyai moodineer.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanudaiya aasaika'l siththiyaathapadi seyyum; avan thannai uyarththaathapadi avanudaiya yoasanaiyai nadanthea'ravottaatheayum. (sealaa.)
ennai va'lainthuko'l'luki'ravarka'ludaiya uthaduka'lin theevinaika'l avarka'l thalaika'laiyea mooduvathaaka.
neruppuththazhal avarka'lmeal vizhuvathaaka; akkiniyilum, avarka'l ezhunthirukkakkoodaatha padukuzhika'lilum tha'l'lappaduvaarka'laaka.
pollaatha naavu'l'lavan poomiyilea nilaippathillai; kodumaiyaana manushanai pa'rakkadikkap pollaappu avanai veattaiyaadum.
si'rumaiyaanavanin vazhakkaiyum, e'liyavarka'lin niyaayaththaiyum karththar visaarippaaren'ru a'rivean.
neethimaanka'l umathu naamaththaith thuthippaarka'l; semmaiyaanavarka'l umathu samukaththil vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean, ennidaththi'rku varaththeeviriyum; naan ummai noakkik kooppidukaiyil, en saththaththi'rkuch sevikodum.
en vi'n'nappam umakku munpaakath thoopamaakavum, en kaiyeduppu anthippaliyaakavum irukkakkadavathu.
karththaavea, en vaaykkuk kaaval vaiyum; en uthaduka'lin vaasalaik kaaththukko'l'lum.

akkiramagnseyki'ra manusharoadea aakaamiyak kiriyaika'lai nadappikkumpadi en iruthayaththaith thunmaarkkaththi'rku i'nangkavottaatheayum; avarka'ludaiya rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'lil on'raiyum naan saappidaamal iruppeanaaka.
neethimaan ennaith thayavaaykkutti, ennaik kadinthuko'l'lattum; athu en thalaikku e'n'neyaippoalirukkum; en thalai athai allaththattuvathillai; avarka'l ikkattuka'lil naan innum jepampa'n'nuvean.
avarka'ludaiya niyaayaathipathika'l kanmalaich saarpuka'lilirunthu tha'l'lu'ndupoaki'rapoathu, en vaarththaika'l inpamaanavaika'len'ru keadpaarka'l.
poomiyinmeal oruvan maraththai vettip pi'lakki'rathupoala, engka'l elumpuka'l paathaa'lavaaykku nearaaych sitha'radikkappattirukki'rathu.
aanaalum aa'ndavaraakiya karththaavea, en ka'nka'l ummai noakkiyirukki'rathu; ummai nampiyirukki'rean; en aaththumaavai ve'rumaiyaaka vidaatheayum.
avarka'l enakku vaiththa ka'n'niyin sikkuka'lukkum, akkiramakkaararin surukkuka'lukkum ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
thunmaarkkar thangka'l valaika'lil akappaduvaarka'laaka; naanoa atha'rkuth thappik kadanthupoavean.
karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kooppiduki'rean; karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kegnchuki'rean.
avarukku munpaaka en sagnchalaththai oot'ruki'rean; avarukku munpaaka en nerukkaththai a'rikkaiyiduki'rean.
en aavi ennil thiyangkumpoathu, neer en paathaiyai a'rinthirukki'reer; naan nadakki'ra vazhiyil ma'raivaaka enakkuk ka'n'nivaiththaarka'l.
valathupu'ramaayk ka'n'noakkippaarum, ennai a'rivaar oruvarum illai; enakku adaikkalamillaama'rpoayit'ru; en aaththumaavai visaarippaar oruvarum illai.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; neerea en adaikkalamum, jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea en pangkumaayirukki'reer en'rean.
en kookkuralukkuch sevikodum, naan mikavum thaazhththappattean; ennaip pinthodaruki'ravarka'lukku ennaith thappuviyum, avarka'l ennilum palavaanka'laayirukki'raarka'l.
umathu naamaththai naan thuthikkumpadi, en aaththumaavaik kaavalukku neengkalaakkividum; enakku neer thayavuseyyumpoathu neethimaanka'l ennaich soozhnthuko'l'luvaarka'l.
karththaavea, en jepaththaik kea'lum, en vi'n'nappangka'lukkuch sevikodum; umathu u'nmaiyinpadiyum umathu neethiyinpadiyum enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
jeevanu'l'la oruvanum umakku munpaaka neethimaan allaathathinaalea, adiyeanai niyaayantheerkkap piraveasiyaatheayum.
saththuru en aaththumaavaith thodarnthu, en piraa'nanaith tharaiyoadea nasukki, vekukaalaththukkumun mariththavarka'lpoal ennai iru'lil irukkappa'n'nuki'raan.
en aavi ennil thiyangkuki'rathu; en iruthayam enakku'l soarnthupoaki'rathu.
poorvanaadka'lai ninaikki'rean, umathu seykaika'laiyellaam thiyaanikki'rean; umathu karaththin kiriyaika'lai yoasikki'rean.
en kaika'lai umakku nearaaka virikki'rean; va'ra'nda nilaththaippoal en aaththumaa ummeal thaakamaayirukki'rathu. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, seekkiramaay enakkuch sevikodum, en aavi thoynthupoaki'rathu; naan kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'lukku oppaakaathapadikku, umathu mukaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum.
athikaalaiyil umathu kirupaiyaik keadkappa'n'num, ummai nampiyirukki'rean, naan nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai enakkuk kaa'npiyum; ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththuki'rean.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'lukku ennaith thappuviyum; ummaip pukalidamaakak ko'l'luki'rean.
umakkup piriyamaanathaich seyya enakkup poathiththaru'lum, neerea en theavan; ummudaiya nalla aavi ennaich semmaiyaana vazhiyilea nadaththuvaaraaka.
karththaavea, ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam ennai uyirppiyum; ummudaiya neethiyinpadi en aaththumaavai idukkaththi'rku neengkalaakkividum.
ummudaiya kirupaiyinpadi en saththurukka'lai azhiththu, en aaththumaavai odukkuki'ra yaavaraiyum sangkaarampa'n'num; naan umathu adiyean.
en kaika'laip poarukkum en viralka'lai yuththaththi'rkum padippikki'ra en kanmalaiyaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram.
avar en thayaapararum, en koattaiyum, en uyarntha adaikkalamum, ennai viduvikki'ravarum, en keadakamum, naan nampinavarum, en janangka'lai enakkuk keezhppaduththuki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
karththaavea, manushanai neer kavanikki'ratha'rkum, manupuththiranai neer e'n'nuki'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
manushan maayaikku oppaayirukki'raan; avan naadka'l kadanthupoaki'ra nizhalukkuch samaanam.
karththaavea, neer umathu vaanangka'laith thaazhththi i'rangki, parvathangka'l pukaiyumpadi avaika'laith thodum.
minnalka'lai varavittuch saththurukka'laich sitha'radiyum, umathu ampuka'lai eythu avarka'laik kalangkadiyum.
uyaraththilirunthu umathu karaththai neetti, jalappiravaakaththukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
maayaiyaip peasum vaayum, ka'l'laththanamaana valathukaiyum udaiya anniya puththirarin kaikku ennai vilakkith thappuviyum.
karththaavea, naan umakkup puthuppaattaip paaduvean; thampurinaalum paththunarampu vee'naiyinaalum ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
neerea raajaakka'lukku jeyaththaith thanthu, umathadiyaanaakiya thaaveethaip pollaatha pattayaththi'rkuth thappuvikki'ravar.
maayaiyaip peasum vaayum, ka'l'laththanamaana valathukaiyum udaiya anniya puththirarin kaikku ennai vilakkith thappuviyum.
appozhuthu engka'l kumaarar i'lamaiyil oangkiva'laruki'ra virudchakkan'ruka'laippoalavum, engka'l kumaaraththika'l siththirantheerntha aramanai moolaikka'rka'laippoalavum iruppaarka'l.
engka'l ka'lagnchiyangka'l sakalavitha vasthukka'laiyum kodukkaththakkathaay nirampiyirukkum; engka'l kiraamangka'lil engka'l aaduka'l aayiram pathinaayiramaayp palukum.
engka'l eruthuka'l palaththavaika'laayirukkum; saththuru udpukuthalum kudiyoadippoakuthalum iraathu; engka'l veethika'lil kookkuralum u'ndaakaathu.
ivvithamaana seeraippet'ra janam paakkiyamu'l'lathu; karththaraith theyvamaakak ko'ndirukki'ra janam paakkiyamu'l'lathu.
raajaavaakiya en theavanea, ummai uyarththi, ummudaiya naamaththai eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirippean.
naadoa'rum ummai sthoaththiriththu, eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum ummudaiya naamaththaith thuthippean.
karththar periyavarum mikavum pukazhappadaththakkavarumaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya makaththuvam aaraaynthumudiyaathu.
thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka ummudaiya kiriyaika'lin pukazhchchiyaich solli, ummudaiya vallamaiyu'l'la seykaika'lai a'rivippaarka'l.
ummudaiya si'rantha makimaippirathaapaththaiyum, ummudaiya athisayamaana kiriyaika'laiyungku'riththup peasuvean.
janangka'l ummudaiya payangkaramaana kiriyaika'lin vallamaiyaich solluvaarka'l; ummudaiya makaththuvaththai naan vivarippean.
avarka'l umathu mikuntha thayavai ninaiththu ve'lippaduththi, umathu neethiyaik kempeeriththup paaduvaarka'l.
karththar irakkamum mana urukkamum, neediya saanthamum mikuntha kirupaiyum u'l'lavar.
karththar ellaarmealum thayavu'l'lavar; avar irakkangka'l avarudaiya ellaak kiriyaika'linmealumu'l'lathu.
karththaavea, ummudaiya kiriyaika'lellaam ummaith thuthikkum; ummudaiya parisuththavaanka'l ummai sthoaththirippaarka'l.
manupuththirarukku umathu vallamaiyu'l'la seykaika'laiyum, umathu raajyaththin si'rantha makimaippirathaapaththaiyum therivikkumpadikku;
umathu raajyaththin makimaiyai a'riviththu, umathu vallamaiyaik ku'riththup peasuvaarka'l.
ummudaiya raajyam sathaakaalangka'lilumu'l'la raajyam, ummudaiya aa'lukai thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakavum u'l'lathu.
karththar vizhuki'ra yaavaraiyum thaangki, madangkadikkappatta yaavaraiyum thookkividuki'raar.
ellaa jeevanka'lin ka'nka'lum ummai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu; eat'ra vea'laiyilea neer avaika'lukku aakaarangkodukki'reer.
neer umathu kaiyaith thi'ranthu, sakala piraa'nika'lin vaagnchaiyaiyum thirupthiyaakkuki'reer.
karththar thamathu vazhika'lilellaam neethiyu'l'lavarum, thamathu kiriyaika'lilellaam kirupaiyu'l'lavarumaayirukki'raar.
thammai noakkik kooppiduki'ra yaavarukkum, u'nmaiyaayth thammai noakkik kooppiduki'ra yaavarukkum, karththar sameepamaayirukki'raar.
avar thamakkup payanthavarka'ludaiya viruppaththinpadi seythu, avarka'l kooppiduthalaik keattu, avarka'lai iradchikki'raar.
karththar thammil anpukooruki'ra yaavaraiyum kaappaat'ri, thunmaarkkar yaavaraiyum azhippaar.
en vaay karththarin thuthiyaich solvathaaka; maamsatheakamu'l'la yaavum avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththai eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkakkadavathu.
allealooyaa, en aaththumaavea, karththaraith thuthi.
naan uyiroadirukkumattum karththaraith thuthippean; naan u'l'la'lavum en theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
pirapukka'laiyum, iradchikkaththiraa'niyillaatha manupuththiranaiyum nampaatheayungka'l.
avanudaiya aavi piriyum, avan than ma'n'nukkuth thirumpuvaan; annaa'lilea avan yoasanaika'l azhinthupoam.
yaakkoapin theavanaith than thu'naiyaakak ko'ndirunthu, than theavanaakiya karththarmeal nampikkaiyai vaikki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
avar vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum avaika'lilu'l'la yaavaiyum u'ndaakkinavar; avar en'ren'raikkum u'nmaiyaik kaakki'ravar.
avar odukkappattavarka'lukku niyaayagnseyki'raar; pasiyaayirukki'ravarka'lukku aakaarang kodukki'raar; kattu'ndavarka'laik karththar viduthalaiyaakkuki'raar.
kurudarin ka'nka'laik karththar thi'rakki'raar; madangkadikkappattavarka'laik karththar thookkividuki'raar; neethimaanka'laik karththar sineakikki'raar.
paratheasika'laik karththar kaappaat'ruki'raar; avar thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum vithavaiyaiyum aatharikki'raar; thunmaarkkarin vazhiyaiyoa kavizhththuppoaduki'raar.
karththar sathaakaalangka'lilum arasaa'luki'raar; seeyoanea, un theavan thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakavum raajarikampa'n'nuki'raar. allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; nammudaiya theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuki'rathu nallathu, thuthiththalea inpamum eat'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththar erusaleamaik kattuki'raar; thuraththu'nda isravealaraik koottich searkki'raar.
iruthayam no'rungku'ndavarka'laik ku'namaakkuki'raar, avarka'ludaiya kaayangka'laik kattuki'raar.
avar nadchaththirangka'lin ilakkaththai e'n'ni, avaika'lukkellaam pearittu azhaikki'raar.
nammudaiya aa'ndavar periyavarum makaa pelamu'l'lavarumaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya a'rivu a'lavillaathathu.
karththar saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'lai uyarththuki'raar; thunmaarkkaraith tharaimattum thaazhththuki'raar.
karththaraith thuthiyudan paadik ko'ndaadungka'l; nammudaiya theavanaich surama'ndalaththaal keerththanam pa'n'nungka'l.
avar vaanaththai meakangka'laal moodi, poomikku mazhaiyai aayaththappaduththi, malaika'lil pullai mu'laippikki'raar.
avar mirukajeevanka'lukkum kooppiduki'ra kaakkaik kugnchuka'lukkum aakaarangkodukki'raar.
avar kuthiraiyin palaththil viruppamaayiraar; veeranudaiya kaalka'lil piriyappadaar.
thamakkup payanthu, thamathu kirupaikkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'lmeal karththar piriyamaayirukki'raar.
erusaleamea, karththarai sthoaththiri; seeyoanea, un theavanaith thuthi.
avar un vaasalka'lin thaazhppaa'lka'laip palappaduththi, unnidaththilu'l'la un pi'l'laika'lai aaseervathikki'raar.
avar un ellaika'laich samaathaanamu'l'lavaika'laakki, uchchithamaana koathumaiyinaal unnaith thirupthiyaakkuki'raar.
avar thamathu vaarththaiyaip poomiyilea anuppuki'raar; avarudaiya sol makaa theeviramaaych selluki'rathu.
pagnchaippoal u'raintha mazhaiyaith tharuki'raar; saampalaippoala u'raintha paniyaith thoovuki'raar.
avar thamathu kalmazhaiyaith thu'nikkaika'laaka anuppuki'raar; avarudaiya ku'lirukku munpaaka ni'rpavan yaar?
avar thamathu vaarththaiyai anuppi, avaika'lai urukappa'n'nuki'raar; thamathu kaat'rai veesumpadi seyya, tha'n'neerka'l oadum.
yaakkoapukkuth thammudaiya vasanangka'laiyum, isravealukkuth thamathu piramaa'nangka'laiyum thamathu niyaayangka'laiyum a'rivikki'raar.
avar vea'rea entha jaathikkum ippadich seythathillai; avarudaiya niyaayangka'lai a'riyaama'rpoaki'raarka'l. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, vaanangka'lil u'l'lavaika'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; unnathangka'lil avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
avarudaiya thootharka'lea, neengka'l yaavarum avaraith thuthiyungka'l; avarudaiya seanaika'lea, neengka'l yaavarum avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
sooriya santhirarea, avaraith thuthiyungka'l; pirakaasamu'l'la sakala nadchaththirangka'lea, avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
vaanaathi vaanangka'lea, avaraith thuthiyungka'l; aakaayama'ndalaththinmealu'l'la tha'n'neerka'lea, avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
avaika'l karththarin naamaththaith thuthikkakkadavathu; avar katta'laiyida avaika'l sirushdikkappattathu.
avar avaika'lai en'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum nilaikkumpadi seythaar; maa'raatha piramaa'naththai avaika'lukku niyamiththaar.
poomiyilu'l'lavaika'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; makaamachchangka'lea, sakala aazhangka'lea,
akkiniyea, kalmazhaiyea, u'rainthamazhaiyea, moodupaniyea, avar so'rpadi seyyum perungkaat'rea,
malaika'lea, sakala meaduka'lea, kanimarangka'lea, sakala keathurukka'lea,
kaattumirukangka'lea, sakala naattu mirukangka'lea, oorum piraa'nika'lea, i'raku'l'la pa'ravaika'lea,
poomiyin raajaakka'lea, sakala janangka'lea, pirapukka'lea, poomiyilu'l'la sakala niyaayaathipathika'lea,
vaaliparea, kannikaika'lea, muthirvayathu'l'lavarka'lea, pi'l'laika'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l.
avarka'l karththarin naamaththaith thuthikkakkadavarka'l; avarudaiya naamam maaththiram uyarnthathu; avarudaiya makimai poomikkum vaanaththi'rkum mealaanathu.
avar thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'l yaavarukkum, thammaich searntha janamaakiya israveal puththirarukkum ko'ndaattamaaka, thammudaiya janaththi'rku oru kompai uyarththinaar. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungka'l; parisuththavaanka'lin sapaiyilea avarudaiya thuthi vi'langkuvathaaka.
israveal thannai u'ndaakkinavaril makizhavum, seeyoan kumaarar thangka'l raajaavil ka'likooravungkadavarka'l.
avarudaiya naamaththai nadanaththoadea thuthiththu, thampurinaalum kinnaraththinaalum avaraik keerththanampa'n'nakkadavarka'l.
karththar thammudaiya janaththinmeal piriyam vaikki'raar; saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'lai iradchippinaal alangkarippaar.
parisuththavaanka'l makimaiyoadea ka'likoornthu, thangka'l padukkaika'linmeal kempeerippaarka'l.
jaathika'lidaththil pazhivaangkavum, janangka'laith tha'ndikkavum,
avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'laich sangkilika'laalum, avarka'ludaiya meanmakka'lai iruppu vilangkuka'laalum kattavum, ezhuthappatta niyaayaththeerppai avarka'lpearil seluththavum,
avarka'l vaayil karththarai uyarththum thuthiyum, avarka'l kaiyil irupu'ramum karukku'l'la pattayamum irukkum.
inthak kanam avarudaiya parisuththavaanka'l yaavarukkum u'ndaakum. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, theavanai avarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil thuthiyungka'l; avarudaiya vallamai vi'langkum aakaaya virivaippaarththu avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
avarudaiya vallamaiyu'l'la kiriyaika'lukkaaka avaraith thuthiyungka'l; maadchimai porunthiya avarudaiya makaththuvaththi'rkaaka avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
ekkaa'la thoniyoadea avaraith thuthiyungka'l; vee'naiyoadum surama'ndalaththoadum avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
thampuroadum nadanaththoadum avaraith thuthiyungka'l; yaazhoadum theengkuzhaloadum avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
oasaiyu'l'la kaiththaa'langka'loadum avaraith thuthiyungka'l; pearoasaiyu'l'la kaiththaa'langka'loadum avaraith thuthiyungka'l.
suvaasamu'l'la yaavum karththaraith thuthippathaaka. allealooyaa.
thaaveethin kumaaranum isravealin raajaavumaakiya saalomoanin neethimozhika'l:
ivaika'laal gnaanaththaiyum poathakaththaiyum a'rinthu, puththimathika'lai u'narnthu,
viveakam, neethi, niyaayam, nithaanam enpavaika'laippat'riya upatheasaththai adaiyalaam.
ivaika'l peathaika'lukku vinaavaiyum, vaaliparukku a'rivaiyum viveakaththaiyum kodukkum.
puththimaan ivaika'laik keattu, a'rivil thea'ruvaan; viveaki nallaaloasanaika'lai adainthu;
neethimozhiyaiyum, athin arththaththaiyum, gnaanika'lin vaakkiyangka'laiyum, avarka'l uraiththa puthaiporu'lka'laiyum a'rinthuko'lvaan.
karththarukkup payappaduthalea gnaanaththin aarampam; moodar gnaanaththaiyum poathakaththaiyum asattaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
en makanea, un thakappan puththiyaik kea'l, un thaayin poathakaththaith tha'l'laathea.
avaika'l un sirasukku alangkaaramaana mudiyum, un kazhuththukkuch sarappa'niyumaayirukkum.
en makanea, paavika'l unakku nayangkaattinaalum nee sammathiyaathea.
engka'loadea vaa, iraththagnsinthumpadi naam pathivirunthu, kut'ramat'rirukki'ravarka'lai mukaantharamin'rip pidikkumpadi o'liththiruppoam;
paathaa'lam vizhungkuvathupoal naam avarka'lai uyiroadea vizhungkuvoam; kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'l vizhungkappaduvathupoal avarka'lai muzhumaiyum vizhungkuvoam;
vilaiyuyarntha sakalavithap poru'lka'laiyum ka'ndadaivoam; ko'l'laip poru'linaal nammudaiya veeduka'lai nirappuvoam.
engka'loadea pangkaa'liyaayiru; nammellaarukkum orea pai irukkum en'ru avarka'l solvaarka'laakil;
en makanea, nee avarka'loadea vazhinadavaamal, un kaalai avarka'l paathaikku vilakkuvaayaaka.
avarka'l kaalka'l theengkuseyya oadi, iraththagnsinthath theevirikki'rathu.
evvakaiyaana padchiyaanaalum sari, athin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka valaiyai virippathu viruthaa.
ivarka'loa thangka'l iraththaththi'rkea pathivirukki'raarka'l, thangka'l piraa'nanukkea o'livaiththirukki'raarka'l.
poru'laasaiyu'l'la ellaarudaiya vazhiyum ithuvea; ithu thannaiyudaiyavarka'lin uyirai vaangkum.
gnaanamaanathu ve'liyea nin'ru kooppiduki'rathu, veethika'lil saththamiduki'rathu.
athu santhadiyu'l'la therukka'lin santhilum, olimukavaasalilum nin'ru kooppittu, patta'naththil than vaarththaika'lai vasaniththuch solluki'rathu:
peathaika'lea, neengka'l peathaimaiyai virumpuvathum, ninthanaikkaararea, neengka'l ninthanaiyil piriyappaduvathum, mathiyeenarea, neengka'l gnaanaththai ve'ruppathum, ethuvaraikkum irukkum.
en kadinthuko'l'luthalukkuth thirumpungka'l; ithoa, en aaviyai ungka'lukku aru'luvean, en vaarththaika'lai ungka'lukkuth therivippean.
naan kooppittum, neengka'l keadkamaattoam enki'reerka'l; naan en kaiyai neettiyum kavanikki'ravan oruvanum illai.
en aaloasanaiyaiyellaam neengka'l tha'l'li, en kadinthuko'l'luthalai ve'ruththeerka'l.
aakaiyaal, naanum ungka'l aapaththukkaalaththil nakaiththu, neengka'l payappadungkaariyam varumpoathu aakadiyampa'n'nuvean.
neengka'l payappadungkaariyam pusalpoal varumpoathum, aapaththu soo'raava'lipoal ungka'lukku nearidumpoathum, nerukkamum idukka'num ungka'lmeal varumpoathum, aakadiyampa'n'nuvean.
appozhuthu avarka'l ennai noakkik kooppiduvaarka'l; naan ma'ruuththaravu kodukkamaattean; avarka'l athikaalaiyilea ennaith theaduvaarka'l, ennaik kaa'namaattaarka'l.
avarka'l a'rivai ve'ruththaarka'l, karththarukkup payappaduthalaith therinthu ko'l'laama'rpoanaarka'l.
en aaloasanaiyai avarka'l virumpavillai; en kadinthuko'l'luthalaiyellaam asattaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
aakaiyaal avarka'l thangka'l vazhiyin palanaip pusippaarka'l; thangka'l yoasanaika'linaal thirupthiyadaivaarka'l.
peathaika'lin maa'rupaadu avarka'laik kollum, moodarin nirvisaaram avarka'lai azhikkum.
enakkuch sevikodukki'ravan evanoa, avan vikkinamin'ri vaasampa'n'ni, aapaththi'rkup payappadaamal amaithiyaayiruppaan.
en makanea, nee un seviyai gnaanaththi'rkuch saayththu, un iruthayaththaip puththikku amaiyappa'n'numporuttu,
nee en vaarththaika'lai eat'rukko'ndu, en katta'laika'lai unnidaththil paththirappaduththi,
gnaanaththai vaa en'ru kooppittu, puththiyaich saththamittu azhaiththu,
athai ve'l'liyaippoal naadi, puthaiyalka'laith theaduki'rathupoal theaduvaayaakil,
appozhuthu karththarukkup payappaduthal innathen'ru nee u'narnthu, theavanai a'riyum a'rivaik ka'ndadaivaay.
karththar gnaanaththaith tharuki'raar; avar vaayinin'ru a'rivum puththiyum varum.
avar neethimaanka'lukken'ru meygngnaanaththai vaiththuvaiththirukki'raar; uththamamaay nadakki'ravarka'lukku avar keadakamaayirukki'raar.
avar niyaayaththin ne'rika'laith tha'rkaaththu, thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'lin paathaiyaik kaappaat'ruki'raar.
appozhuthu neethiyaiyum, niyaayaththaiyum, nithaanaththaiyum, sakala nalvazhika'laiyum a'rinthuko'l'luvaay.
gnaanam un iruthayaththil piraveasiththu, a'rivu un aaththumaavukku inpamaayirukkumpoathu,
nalyoasanai unnaik kaappaat'rum, puththi unnaip paathukaakkum.
athinaal nee thunmaarkkanudaiya vazhikkum, maa'rupaadu peasuki'ra manushanukkum,
anthakaara vazhika'lil nadakka neethine'rika'lai vittu,
theemaiseyya makizhnthu, thunmaarkkarudaiya maa'rupaaduka'lil ka'likooruki'ravarka'lukkum,
maa'rupaadaana paathaika'lilum koa'nalaana vazhika'lilum nadakki'ravarka'lukkum nee thappuvikkappaduvaay.
than i'lavayathin naayakanai vittu, than theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyai ma'ranthu,
ichchakamaana vaarththaika'laippeasum anniya pe'n'naakiya parasthireekkum thappuvikkappaduvaay.
ava'ludaiya veedu mara'naththukkum, ava'ludaiya paathaika'l mariththoaridaththi'rkum saayki'rathu.
ava'lidaththil poaki'ravarka'lil oruvarum thirumpuki'rathillai, jeevapaathaika'lil vanthu searuki'rathumillai.
aathalaal nee nallavarka'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, neethimaanka'lin paathaika'laik kaaththukko'lvaayaaka.
sevvaiyaanavarka'l poomiyilea vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l; uththamarka'l athilea thangkiyiruppaarka'l.
thunmaarkkaroa poomiyilirunthu a'ruppu'ndupoavaarka'l; thuroakika'l athil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaavaarka'l.
en makanea, en poathakaththai ma'ravaathea; un iruthayam en katta'laika'laik kaakkakkadavathu.
avaika'l unakku neediththa naadka'laiyum, theerkkaayusaiyum, samaathaanaththaiyum perukappa'n'num.
kirupaiyum saththiyamum unnaivittu vilakaathiruppathaaka; nee avaika'lai un kazhuththilea poo'ndu, avaika'lai un iruthayamaakiya palakaiyil ezhuthikko'l.
athinaal theavanudaiya paarvaiyilum manusharudaiya paarvaiyilum thayaiyum na'rpuththiyum pe'ruvaay.
un suyapuththiyinmeal saayaamal, un muzhu iruthayaththoadum karththaril nampikkaiyaayirunthu,
un vazhika'lilellaam avarai ninaiththukko'l; appozhuthu avar un paathaika'laich sevvaippaduththuvaar.
nee unnai gnaaniyen'ru e'n'naathea; karththarukkup payanthu, theemaiyai vittu vilaku.
athu un naapikku aaroakkiyamum, un elumpuka'lukku oonumaakum.
un poru'laalum, un ellaa vi'laivin mutha'rpalanaalum karththaraik kanampa'n'nu.
appozhuthu un ka'lagnchiyangka'l poora'namaay nirampum; un aalaika'lil thiraadcharasam pura'ndoadum.
en makanea, nee karththarudaiya sidchaiyai a'rpamaaka e'n'naathea, avar kadinthuko'l'lumpoathu soarnthupoakaathea.
thakappan thaan neasikki'ra puththiranaich sidchikki'rathupoala, karththarum evanidaththil anpukooruki'raaroa avanaich sidchikki'raar.
gnaanaththaik ka'ndadaiki'ra manushanum, puththiyaich sampaathikki'ra manushanum paakkiyavaanka'l.
athin varththakam ve'l'li varththakaththilum, athin aathaayam pasumponnilum uththamamaanathu.
muththukka'laippaarkkilum athu vilaiyea'rappet'rathu; nee ichchikkaththakkathon'rum atha'rku nikaralla.
athin valathukaiyil theerkkaayusum, athin idathukaiyil selvamum kanamum irukki'rathu.
athin vazhika'l inithaana vazhika'l, athin paathaika'lellaam samaathaanam.
athu thannai adainthavarka'lukku jeevavirudcham, athaip pat'rikko'l'luki'ra evanum paakkiyavaan.
karththar gnaanaththinaalea poomiyai asthipaarappaduththi, puththiyinaalea vaanangka'lai sthaapiththaar.
avarudaiya gnaanaththinaalea aazhangka'l pirinthathu, aakaayamum paniyaip peyki'rathu.
en makanea, ivaika'l un ka'nka'lai vittup piriyaathiruppathaaka; meygngnaanaththaiyum nallaaloasanaiyaiyum kaaththukko'l.
avaika'l un aaththumaavukku jeevanum, un kazhuththukku alangkaaramumaayirukkum.
appozhuthu nee payamin'ri un vazhiyil nadappaay, un kaal ida'raathu.
nee padukkumpoathu payappadaathiruppaay; nee paduththukko'l'lumpoathu un niththirai inpamaayirukkum.
sadithiyaana thikilum, thushdarka'lin paazhkkadippum varumpoathu nee agnchavea'ndaam.
karththar un nampikkaiyaayirunthu, un kaal sikkikko'l'laathapadi kaappaar.
nanmaiseyyumpadi unakkuth thiraa'niyirukkumpoathu, athaich seyyaththakkavarka'lukkuch seyyaamal iraathea.
unnidaththil poru'l irukkaiyil un ayalaanai noakki: nee poayth thirumpavaa, naa'laikkuth tharuvean en'ru sollaathea.
achchamin'ri unnidaththil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra un ayalaanukku viroathamaaka theengku ninaiyaathea.
oruvan unakkuth theengkuseyyaathirukka, kaara'namin'ri avanoadea vazhakkaadaathea.
kodumaiyu'l'lavanmeal po'raamai ko'l'laathea; avanudaiya vazhika'lil on'raiyum therinthuko'l'laathea.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavan karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan; neethimaanka'loadea avarudaiya irakasiyam irukki'rathu.
thunmaarkkanudaiya veettil karththarin saapam irukki'rathu, neethimaanka'ludaiya vaasasthalaththaiyoa avar aaseervathikki'raar.
ikazhvoarai avar ikazhuki'raar; thaazhmaiyu'l'lavarka'lukkoa kirupaiya'likki'raar.
gnaanavaanka'l kanaththaich suthantharippaarka'l; mathikeadaroa kanaveenaththai adaivaarka'l.
pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l thakappan poathakaththaik keattu, puththiyai adaiyumpadi kavaniyungka'l.
naan ungka'lukku na'rpoathakaththaith tharuki'rean; en upatheasaththai vidaathirungka'l.
naan en thakappanukkup piriyamaana kumaaranum, en thaaykku mikavum arumaiyaana orea pi'l'laiyumaanavan.
avar enakkup poathiththuch sonnathu: un iruthayam en vaarththaika'laik kaaththukko'l'lakkadavathu; en katta'laika'laik kaikko'l, appozhuthu pizhaippaay.
gnaanaththaich sampaathi, puththiyaiyum sampaathi; en vaayin vaarththaika'lai ma'ravaamalum vittu vilakaamalum iru.
athai vidaathea, athu unnaith tha'rkaakkum; athinmeal piriyamaayiru, athu unnaik kaaththukko'l'lum.
gnaanamea mukkiyam, gnaanaththaich sampaathi; ennaththaich sampaathiththaalum puththiyaich sampaathiththukko'l.
nee athai meanmaippaduththu, athu unnai meanmaippaduththum; nee athaith thazhuvikko'ndaal, athu unnaik kanampa'n'num.
athu un thalaikku alangkaaramaana mudiyaik kodukkum; athu makimaiyaana kireedaththai unakkuch soottum.
en makanea, kea'l, en vaarththaika'lai eat'rukko'l; appozhuthu un aayusin varushangka'l athikamaakum.
gnaanamaarkkaththai naan unakkup poathiththean; sevvaiyaana paathaika'lilea unnai nadaththinean.
nee avaika'lil nadakkumpoathu un nadaika'lukku idukka'n u'ndaavathillai; nee avaika'lil oadinaalum ida'ramaattaay.
puththimathiyai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'l, athai vittuvidaathea; athaik kaaththukko'l, athuvea unakku jeevan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya paathaiyil piraveasiyaathea; theeyoarudaiya vazhiyil nadavaathea.
athai ve'ruththuvidu, athin vazhiyaayp poakaathea; athai vittu vilakik kadanthupoa.
pollaappuch seythaalozhiya avarka'lukku niththirai varaathu; avarka'l yaaraiyaakilum vizhappa'n'naathirunthaal avarka'l thookkam kalainthupoam.
avarka'l aakaamiyaththin appaththaip pusiththu, kodumaiyin irasaththaik kudikki'raarka'l.
neethimaanka'ludaiya paathai naduppakalvaraikkum athikamathikamaayp pirakaasikki'ra sooriyappirakaasampoalirukkum.
thunmaarkkarudaiya paathaiyoa kaariru'laippoalirukkum; thaangka'l ida'ruvathu innathil en'ru a'riyaarka'l.
en makanea, en vaarththaika'laik kavani; en vasanangka'lukku un seviyaich saay.
avaika'l un ka'nka'lai vittup piriyaathiruppathaaka; avaika'lai un iruthayaththukku'l'lea kaaththukko'l.
avaika'laik ka'ndupidikki'ravarka'lukku avaika'l jeevanum, avarka'l udalukkellaam aaroakkiyamumaam.
ellaak kaavaloadum un iruthayaththaik kaaththukko'l, athinidaththinin'ru jeevaoot'ru pu'rappadum.
vaayin thaa'rumaa'ruka'lai unnai vittakat'ri, uthaduka'lin maa'rupaattai unakkuth thoorappaduththu.
un ka'nka'l nearaay noakkakkadavathu; un ka'n'nimaika'l unakku munnea sevvaiyaayp paarkkakkadavathu.
un kaal nadaiyaich seerthookkippaar; un vazhika'lellaam nilaivarappattiruppathaaka.
valathupu'ramaavathu idathupu'ramaavathu saayaathea; un kaalaith theemaikku vilakkuvaayaaka.
en makanea, en gnaanaththaik kavaniththu, en puththikku un seviyaich saay;
appozhuthu nee viveakaththaip pea'nikko'lvaay, un uthaduka'l a'rivaik kaaththukko'l'lum.
parasthireeyin uthaduka'l theankoodupoal ozhukum; ava'l vaay e'n'neyilum miruthuvaayirukkum.
ava'l seykaiyin mudivoa ettiyaippoalak kasappum, irupu'ramung karukku'l'la pattayampoal koormaiyumaayirukkum.
ava'l kaaladika'l mara'naththukku i'rangkum; ava'l nadaika'l paathaa'laththaip pat'rippoakum.
nee jeevamaarkkaththaich sinthiththuk ko'l'laathapadikku, ava'ludaiya nadaika'l maa'rimaa'ri vikaarappadum; avaika'lai a'riyamudiyaathu.
aathalaal pi'l'laika'lea, ippozhuthu enakkuch sevikodungka'l; en vaayin vasanangka'lai vittu neengkaathirungka'l.
un vazhiyai ava'lukkuth thoorappaduththu; ava'ludaiya veettin vaasalaik kittich searaathea.
searnthaal un meanmaiyai anniyarka'lukkum, un aayusin kaalaththaik kodoorarukkum koduththuviduvaay.
anniyar un selvaththinaal thirupthiyadaivaarka'l; un pirayaasaththin palan pu'raththiyaarudaiya veettil searum.
mudivilea un maamsamum un sareeramum uruvazhiyumpoathu nee thukkiththu:
aiyoa, poathakaththai naan ve'ruththeanea, kadinthuko'l'luthalai en manam aladchiyampa'n'ninathea!
en poathakarin sollai naan kea'laamalum, enakku upatheasampa'n'ninavarka'lukku en seviyaich saayaamalum poaneanea!
sapaikku'l'lum sangkaththukku'l'lum kognchangku'raiya ellaath theemaikkumu'l'laaneanea! en'ru mu'raiyiduvaay.
un ki'nat'rilu'l'la tha'n'neeraiyum, un thuravil oo'ruki'ra jalaththaiyum paanampa'n'nu.
un oot'ruka'l ve'liyilum un vaaykkaalka'l veethika'lilum paayvathaaka.
avaika'l anniyarukkum uriyavaika'laayiraamal, unakkea uriyavaika'laayiruppathaaka.
un oot'rukka'n aaseervathikkappaduvathaaka; un i'lavayathin manaiviyoadea makizhnthiru.

ava'lea neasikkappadaththakka pe'nmaanum, azhakaana varaiyaadumpoaliruppaa'laaka; ava'ludaiya sthanangka'lea eppozhuthum unnaith thirupthiseyvathaaka; ava'ludaiya neasaththaal nee eppozhuthum mayangkiyiruppaayaaka.
en makanea, nee parasthireeyinmeal mayangkith thirinthu, anniya sthireeyin maarpaith thazhuvavea'ndiyathenna?
manushanudaiya vazhika'l karththarin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka irukki'rathu; avanudaiya vazhika'lellaavat'raiyum avar seerthookkippaarkki'raar.
thunmaarkkanai avanudaiya akkiramangka'lea pidiththukko'l'lum; than paavakkayi'ruka'laal kattappaduvaan.
avan puththiyaik kea'laathathinaal madinthu, than mathikeattin mikuthiyinaal mayangkippoavaan.
en makanea, nee un sineakithanukkaakap pi'naippattu, anniyanukkuk kaiyadiththukkoduththaayaanaal,
nee un vaaymozhika'laal sikku'ndaay, un vaayin vaarththaika'laal pidipattaay.
ippozhuthu en makanea, un sineakithanudaiya kaiyil nee akappattukko'ndapadiyaal, nee unnaith thappuviththukko'l'la on'ru sey.
un ka'n'nukku niththiraiyum, un ka'n'nimaikkuth thookkamum varavidaamal, un sineakithanidaththil poay, unnaith thaazhththi, avanai varunthik keattukko'l.
ve'limaan veattaikkaaran kaikkum, kuruvi veadan kaikkum thappuvathupoala, nee unnaith thappuviththukko'l.
soampea'riyea, nee e'rumpinidaththilpoay, athin vazhika'laip paarththu, gnaanaththaik kat'rukko'l.
atha'rkup pirapuvum, thalaivanum, athikaariyum illaathirunthum,
koadaikaalaththil thanakku aakaaraththaich sampaathiththu, a'ruppukkaalaththil thanakkuth thaaniyaththaich searththuvaikkum.
soampea'riyea, nee evva'lavunearam paduththiruppaay? eppozhuthu un thookkaththaivittu ezhunthiruppaay?
innung kogncham thoongkattum, innung kogncham u'rangkattum, innung kogncham kaimudakkikko'ndu niththirai seyyattum enpaayoa?
un thariththiram vazhippoakkanaippoalavum, un va'rumai aayuthama'ninthavanaippoalavum varum.
pealiyaa'lin manushanaakiya oru thunmaarkkan aakadiyam peasiththiriki'raan.
avan than ka'nka'laal saikaikaatti, than kaalka'laal peasi, than viralka'laal poathanaiseyki'raan.
avan iruthayaththilea thiriyaavaramu'ndu; idaividaamal pollaappaip pi'naiththu, vazhakkuka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuki'raan.
aakaiyaal sadithiyil avanukku aapaththu varum; sakaayamin'rich sadithiyil naasamadaivaan.
aa'ru kaariyangka'laik karththar ve'rukki'raar, eazhum avarukku aruvaruppaanavaika'l.
avaiyaavana: meattimaiyaana ka'n, poynaavu, kut'ramat'ravarka'ludaiya iraththam sinthung kai,
thuraaloasanaiyaip pi'naikkum iruthayam, theengku seyvatha'rku virainthoadung kaal,
apaththampeasum poychsaadchi, sakoathararukku'l'lea viroathaththai u'ndupa'n'nuthal aakiya ivaika'lea.
en makanea, un thakappan ka'rpanaiyaik kaaththukko'l; un thaayin poathakaththaith tha'l'laathea.
avaika'lai eppozhuthum un iruthayaththilea a'ninthu, avaika'lai un kazhuththilea kattikko'l.
nee nadakkumpoathu athu unakku vazhikaattum; nee padukkumpoathu athu unnaik kaappaat'rum; nee vizhikkumpoathu athu unnoadea sampaashikkum.
katta'laiyea vi'lakku, veathamea ve'lichcham, poathakasidchaiyea jeevavazhi.
athu unnaith thunmaarkka sthireekkum, ichchakampeasum naavaiyudaiya parasthireekkum vilakkik kaakkum.
un iruthayaththilea ava'l azhakai ichchiyaathea; ava'l than ka'n'nimaika'linaal unnaip pidikkavidaathea.
veasiyinimiththam oru appaththu'nikkaiyaiyum irakkavea'ndiyathaakum; vipasaariyaanava'l arumaiyaana uyirai veattaiyaaduki'raa'l.
than vasthiram veakaamal madiyilea evanaavathu neruppai vaiththukko'l'lakkoodumoa?
than kaal sudaamal evanaavathu thazhalinmeal nadakkakkoodumoa?
pi'ranudaiya manaiviyidaththil piraveasippavanum, appadiyea ava'laith thoduki'ra evanum, aakkinaikkuth thappaan.
thirudan than pasiyai aat'rath thirudinaal janangka'l avanai ikazhamaattaarka'l;
avan ka'ndupidikkappattaal eazhumadangku koduththuth theeravea'ndum; than veettilu'l'la poru'lka'laiyellaam kodukkavea'ndiyathaakum.
sthireeyudanea vipasaarampa'n'nuki'ravan mathikettavan; appadich seyki'ravan than aaththumaavaik keduththuppoaduki'raan.
vaathaiyaiyum ilachchaiyaiyum adaivaan; avan ninthai ozhiyaathu.
sthireeyaippat'riya erichchal purushanukku moorkkaththai u'ndupa'n'num; avan pazhivaangkum naa'lil thappavidaan.
avan entha eettaiyum paaraan; aneakam vekumathika'laik koduththaalum amarnthirukkamaattaan.
en makanea, nee en vaarththaika'laik kaaththu, en katta'laika'lai unnidaththil paththirappaduththu.
en katta'laika'laiyum en poathakaththaiyum un ka'nma'niyaippoal kaaththukko'l, appozhuthu pizhaippaay.
avaika'lai un viralka'lil katti, avaika'lai un iruthaya palakaiyil ezhuthikko'l.
ichchakavaarththaika'laip peasum anniya pe'n'naakiya parasthireekku unnai vilakkik kaappatha'rkaaka,
gnaanaththai noakki, nee en sakoathari en'rum, puththiyaippaarththu, nee en inaththaa'l en'rum solvaayaaka.
naan en veettin jannalarukea nin'ru, palaka'ni vazhiyaayp paarththapoathu,
peathaiyarka'laakiya vaaliparukku'l'lea oru puththiyeena vaalipanaikka'ndu avanaik kavaniththean.
avan maalaimayangkum asthamananearaththilum, iravin iru'nda anthakaaraththilum,
ava'l irukkum santhukkaduththa theruvil sen'ru, ava'l veettuvazhiyaay nadanthupoanaan.
appozhuthu ithoa, veasiyin aadaiyaapara'nanthariththa thanthiramanamu'l'la oru sthiree avanukku ethirppattaa'l.
ava'l vaayaadiyum adangkaathava'lumaanava'l; ava'l kaalka'l veettilea tharikki'rathillai.
silavea'lai ve'liyiliruppaa'l, silavea'lai veethiyiliruppaa'l, santhuka'lthoa'rum pathiviruppaa'l.
ava'l avanaip pidiththu muththagnseythu, mukam naa'naamal avanaip paarththu:
samaathaana palika'l enmeal sumanthirunthathu, in'raikkuththaan en poruththanaika'lai ni'raiveat'rinean.
aathalaal, naan unnaich santhikkap pu'rappattu, un mukaththai aavaloadu theadinean; ippozhuthu unnaik ka'ndupidiththean.
en magnchaththai iraththina kampa'langka'laalum, ekipthutheasaththu visiththiramaana melliya vasthirangka'laalum singkaariththean.
en padukkaiyai ve'l'laippoa'laththaalum santhanaththaalum ilavangkappattaiyaalum vaasanai kattinean.
vaa, vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum sampoakamaayiruppoam, inpangka'linaal poorippoam.
purushan veettilea illai, thoorap pirayaa'nam poanaan.
pa'nappaiyaith than kaiyilea ko'ndupoanaan, ku'rikkappatta naa'lilea veettukku varuvaan en'ru solli,
than mikuthiyaana iniya so'rka'laal avanai vasappaduththi, than uthaduka'lin mathuravaakkinaal avanai i'nangkappa'n'ninaa'l.
udanea avan ava'l pinnea sen'raan; oru maadu adikkappadumpadi selvathupoalum, oru moodan vilangkidappattuth tha'ndanaikkup poavathu poalum,
oru kuruvi than piraa'nanai vaangkum ka'n'niyai a'riyaamal athil vizhath theevirikki'rathupoalum, ava'lukkup pinnea poanaan; ampu avan eeralaip pi'lanthathu.
aathalaal pi'l'laika'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; en vaayin vaarththaika'laik kavaniyungka'l.
un iruthayam ava'l vazhiyilea saayavea'ndaam; ava'l paathaiyilea mayangkith thiriyaathea.
ava'l aneakaraik kaayappaduththi, vizhappa'n'ninaa'l; palavaanka'l aneakaraik kolaiseythaa'l.
ava'l veedu paathaa'laththukkuppoam vazhi; athu mara'na a'raika'lukkuk ko'ndupoayvidum.
gnaanam kooppiduki'rathillaiyoa? puththi saththamiduki'rathillaiyoa?
athu vazhiyarukeayu'l'la meadaika'lilum, naa'rsanthika'lilum ni'rki'rathu.
athu oorvaasalka'lin oaraththilum, patta'naththin mukappilum, nadai koodangka'lilum nin'ru saththamittu:
manusharea, ungka'lai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; en saththam manupuththirarukkuth thonikkum.
peathaika'lea, viveakam adaiyungka'l; moodarka'lea, puththiyu'l'la sinthaiyaayirungka'l.
kea'lungka'l, meampaadaana kaariyangka'laip peasuvean; en uthaduka'l uththama kaariyangka'lai vasanikkum.
en vaay saththiyaththai vi'lampum, aakaamiyam en uthaduka'lukku aruvaruppaanathu.
en vaayin vaakkuka'lellaam neethiyaanavaika'l; avaika'lil purattum vipareethamum illai.
avaika'lellaam puththiyu'l'lavanukkuth the'livum, gnaanaththaip pet'ravarka'lukku yathaarththamumaayirukkum.
ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum en puththimathiyaiyum, pasumponnaippaarkkilum gnaanaththaiyum angkeekariththukko'l'lungka'l.
muththukka'laippaarkkilum gnaanamea nallathu; ichchikkappadaththakkavaika'lellaam atha'rku nikaralla.
gnaanamaakiya naan viveakaththoadea vaasampa'n'ni, nalyukthiyaana a'rivuka'laik ka'ndadaiki'rean.
theemaiyai ve'ruppathea karththarukkup payappadum payam; perumaiyaiyum, akanthaiyaiyum, theeya vazhiyaiyum, purattuvaayaiyum naan ve'rukki'rean.
aaloasanaiyum meygngnaanamum ennudaiyavaika'l; naanea puththi, vallamai ennudaiyathu.
ennaalea raajaakka'l arasaa'luki'raarka'l, pirapukka'l neethiseluththuki'raarka'l.
ennaalea athikaarika'lum, pirapukka'lum, poomiyilu'l'la sakala niyaayaathipathika'lum aa'lukaiseythuvaruki'raarka'l.
ennaich sineakikki'ravarka'lai naan sineakikki'rean; athikaalaiyil ennaith theaduki'ravarka'l ennaik ka'ndadaivaarka'l.
aisuvariyamum, kanamum, nilaiyaana poru'lum, neethiyum ennidaththil u'ndu.
ponnaiyum thangkaththaiyum paarkkilum en palan nallathu; suththa ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum en varumaanam nallathu.
ennaich sineakikki'ravarka'l meypporu'laich suthantharikkumpadikkum, avarka'ludaiya ka'lagnchiyangka'lai naan nirappumpadikkum,
avarka'lai neethiyin vazhiyilum, niyaayapaathaika'lukku'l'lum nadaththuki'rean.
karththar thamathu kiriyaika'lukkumun poorvamuthal ennaith thamathu vazhiyin aathiyaakak ko'ndirunthaar.
poomi u'ndaakumunnum, aathimutha'rko'ndum anaathiyaay naan apisheakampa'n'nappattean.
aazhangka'lum, jalam pura'nduvarum oot'ruka'lum u'ndaakumunnea naan janippikkappattean.
malaika'l nilaipe'ruvatha'rku munnum, kun'ruka'l u'ndaavatha'rku munnum,
avar poomiyaiyum athin ve'lika'laiyum, poomiyilu'l'la ma'n'nin thira'lka'laiyum u'ndaakkumunnum naan janippikkappattean.
avar vaanangka'laip padaikkaiyil naan angkea irunthean; avar samuththira vilaasaththai vatta'nikkaiyilum,
uyaraththil meakangka'lai sthaapiththu, samuththiraththin oot'ruka'lai adaiththu vaikkaiyilum,
samuththira jalam than karaiyai vittu mee'raathapadikku atha'rku ellaiyaik katta'laiyittu, poomiyin asthipaarangka'lai nilaippaduththukaiyilum,
naan avar arukea sellappi'l'laiyaayirunthean; niththam avarudaiya manamakizhchchiyaayirunthu, eppozhuthum avar samukaththil ka'likoornthean.
avarudaiya poovulakaththil santhoashappattu, manumakka'ludanea makizhnthuko'ndirunthean.
aathalaal pi'l'laika'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; en vazhika'laik kaaththu nadakki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l.
neengka'l puththiyaik keattu, gnaanamadaiyungka'l; athai vittu vilakaathirungka'l.
en vaasa'rpadiyil niththam vizhiththirunthu, en kathavu nilaiyarukea kaaththirunthu, enakkuch sevikodukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.
ennaik ka'ndadaiki'ravan jeevanaik ka'ndadaiki'raan; karththaridaththil thayavaiyum pe'ruvaan.
enakku viroathamaakap paavagnseyki'ravanoa, than aaththumaavaich seathappaduththuki'raan; ennai ve'rukki'ravarka'l yaavarum mara'naththai virumpuki'ravarka'l en'ru solluki'rathu.
gnaanam than veettaik katti, than eazhu thoo'nka'laiyum siththirantheerththu,
than kozhuththa janthukka'lai adiththu, thiraadcharasaththai vaarththuvaiththu, than poajanapanthiyai aayaththappaduththi,
than pa'nividaikkaarika'lai anuppi, patta'naththin uyarntha meadaika'linmeal nin'ru kooppittu,
puththiyeenanai noakki: evan peathaiyoa avan ivvidaththil varakkadavan.
neengka'l vanthu en appaththaip pusiththu, naan vaarththa thiraadcharasaththaip paanampa'n'nungka'l.
peathaimaiyai vittu vilakungka'l, appozhuthu pizhaiththiruppeerka'l; puththiyin vazhiyilea nadavungka'l en'ru vi'lampuki'rathu.
pariyaasakkaaranaik ka'ndikki'ravan ilachchaiyadaiki'raan; thunmaarkkanaik ka'ndikki'ravan thannaik ka'raippaduththikko'l'luki'raan.
pariyaasakkaaranaik kadinthuko'l'laathea, avan unnaip pakaippaan; gnaanamu'l'lavanaik kadinthuko'l, avan unnai neasippaan.
gnaanamu'l'lavanukkup poathakampa'n'nu, avan gnaanaththil thea'ruvaan; neethimaanukku upatheasampa'n'nu, avan a'rivil viruththiyadaivaan.
karththarukkup payappaduthalea gnaanaththin aarampam; parisuththarin a'rivea a'rivu.
ennaalea un naadka'l perukum; un aayusin varushangka'l viruththiyaakum.
nee gnaaniyaanaal unakken'ru gnaaniyaavaay; nee pariyaasakkaaranaanaal neeyea athin payanai anupavippaay en'ru solluki'rathu.
mathiyat'ra sthiree vaayaadiyum, on'ruma'riyaatha nirmoodamumaayirukki'raa'l.
ava'l than veettuvaasa'rpadiyilum patta'naththin meadaika'lilum aasanam poattu udkaarnthu,
thangka'l vazhika'lai noakki nearea poakum vazhippoakkaraip paarththu:
evan peathaiyoa avan ivvidaththil varakkadavan en'rum,
mathiyeenanai noakki: thiruttuththa'n'neer thiththikkum, antharangkaththil pusikkum appam inpamaayirukkum en'rum sollik kooppiduki'raa'l.
aayinum mariththavarka'l avvidaththil u'nden'rum, ava'ludaiya virunthaa'lika'l narakapaathaa'langka'lil kidakki'raarka'len'rum avan a'riyaan.
saalomoanin neethimozhika'l: gnaanamu'l'la makan thakappanaich santhoashappaduththuki'raan; moodaththanamu'l'lavanoa thaaykkuch sagnchalamaayirukki'raan.
aniyaayaththin thiraviyangka'l on'rukkum uthavaathu; neethiyoa mara'naththukkuth thappuvikkum.
karththar neethimaanka'laip pasiyinaal varunthavidaar; thunmaarkkarudaiya poru'laiyoa akat'rividuki'raar.
soampa'rkaiyaal vealaiseyki'ravan eazhaiyaavaan; su'rusu'ruppu'l'lavan kaiyoa selvaththai u'ndaakkum.
koadaikaalaththil searkki'ravan puththiyu'l'la makan; a'ruppukkaalaththil thoongkuki'ravanoa ilachchaiyai u'ndaakkuki'ra makan.
neethimaanudaiya sirasinmeal aaseervaathangka'l thangkum; kodumaiyoa thunmaarkkanudaiya vaayai adaikkum.
neethimaanudaiya pear pukazhpet'ru vi'langkum; thunmaarkkanudaiya pearoa azhinthupoakum.
iruthayaththil gnaanamu'l'lavan katta'laika'lai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan; alappuki'ra moodanoa vizhuvaan.
uththamamaay nadakki'ravan paththiramaay nadakki'raan; koa'nalaana vazhika'lil nadakki'ravanoa ka'ndupidikkappaduvaan.
ka'nsaadai kaattuki'ravan noavu u'ndaakkuki'raan; alappuki'ra moodan vizhuvaan.
neethimaanudaiya vaay jeevaoot'ru; kodumaiyoa thunmaarkkanudaiya vaayai adaikkum.
pakai viroathangka'lai ezhuppum; anpoa sakala paavangka'laiyum moodum.
puththimaanudaiya uthaduka'lil vi'langkuvathu gnaanam; mathikeadanudaiya muthukukku eat'rathu pirampu.
gnaanavaanka'l a'rivaich searththuvaikki'raarka'l; moodanudaiya vaaykkuk keadu sameepiththirukki'rathu.
aisuvariyavaanudaiya poru'l avanukku ara'naana patta'nam; eazhaika'lin va'rumaiyoa avarka'laik kalangkappa'n'num.
neethimaanudaiya pirayaasam jeevanaiyum, thunmaarkkanudaiya vi'laivoa paavaththaiyum pi'rappikkum.

ka'nka'lin o'li iruthayaththaip poorippaakkum; na'rseythi elumpuka'laip pushdiyaakkum.
jeevanukkeathuvaana kadinthuko'l'luthalai eat'rukko'l'lum kaathu gnaanika'lidaththea thangkum.
puththimathiyaith tha'l'lividuki'ravan than aaththumaavai ve'rukki'raan; kadinthuko'l'luthalaik keadki'ravanoa gnaanamadaivaan.
karththarukkup payappaduthal gnaanaththaip poathikkum; meanmaikku munnaanathu thaazhmai.
manathin yoasanaika'l manushanudaiyathu; naavin pirathiyuththaram karththaraal varum.
manushanudaiya vazhika'lellaam avan paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaika'l; karththaroa aavika'lai ni'ruththuppaarkki'raar.
un seykaika'laik karththarukku oppuvi; appozhuthu un yoasanaika'l u'ruthippadum.
karththar sakalaththaiyum thamakken'ru padaiththaar; theengkunaa'lukkaakath thunmaarkkanaiyum u'ndaakkinaar.
manameattimaiyu'l'lavanevanum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan; kaiyoadea kaikoarththaalum avan tha'ndanaikkuth thappaan.
kirupaiyinaalum saththiyaththinaalum paavam nivirththiyaakum; karththarukkup payappaduki'rathinaal manushar theemaiyai vittu vilakuvaarka'l.
oruvanudaiya vazhika'l karththarukkup piriyamaayirunthaal, avanudaiya saththurukka'lum avanoadea samaathaanamaakumpadi seyvaar.
aniyaayamaay vantha athika varumaanaththilum, niyaayamaay vantha kogncha varumaanamea uththamam.
manushanudaiya iruthayam avanudaiya vazhiyai yoasikkum; avanudaiya nadaika'lai u'ruthippaduththuki'ravaroa karththar.
raajaavin uthaduka'lil thivviya vaakku pi'rakkum; niyaayaththil avan vaay thava'raathu.
sumuththiraiyaana ni'raikoalum tharaasum karththarudaiyathu; paiyilirukkum ni'raikallellaam avarudaiya seyal.
aniyaayagnseyvathu raajaakka'lukku aruvaruppu; neethiyinaal singkaasanam u'ruthippadum.
neethiyu'l'la uthaduka'l raajaakka'lukkup piriyam; nithaanamaayp peasuki'ravanil raajaakka'l piriyappaduvaarka'l.
raajaavin koapam mara'nathootharukkuch samaanam; gnaanamu'l'lavanoa athai aat'ruvaan.
raajaavin mukakka'laiyil jeevan u'ndu; avanudaiya thayai pinmaari peyyum meakaththaippoal irukkum.
ponnaich sampaathippathilum gnaanaththaich sampaathippathu evva'lavu uththamam! ve'l'liyaich sampaathippathilum puththiyaich sampaathippathu evva'lavu meanmai!
theemaiyai vittu vilakuvathea semmaiyaanavarka'lukkuch samanaana paathai; than nadaiyaik kavaniththirukki'ravan than aaththumaavaik kaakki'raan.
azhivukku munnaanathu akanthai; vizhuthalukku munnaanathu manameattimai.
akangkaarika'loadea ko'l'laip poru'laip pangkiduvathaippaarkkilum, si'rumaiyaanavarka'loadea manaththaazhmaiyaayiruppathu nalam.
viveakaththudan kaariyaththai nadappikki'ravan nanmaipe'ruvaan; karththarai nampuki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
iruthayaththil gnaanamu'l'lavan viveakiyennappaduvaan; uthaduka'lin mathuram kalviyaip perukappa'n'num.
puththi thannai udaiyavarka'lukku jeeva oot'ru; mathiyeenarin poathanai mathiyeenamea.
gnaaniyin iruthayam avan vaaykku a'rivaiyoottum; avan uthaduka'lukku athu meanmealum kalviyaik kodukkum.
iniya so'rka'l theankoodupoal aaththumaavukku mathuramum, elumpuka'lukku aushathamumaakum.
manushanukkuch semmaiyaayth thoan'ruki'ra vazhiyu'ndu; athin mudivoa mara'na vazhika'l.
pirayaasappaduki'ravan thanakkaakavea pirayaasappaduki'raan; avan vaay athai avanidaththil varunthik keadkum.
pealiyaa'lin makan ki'ndividuki'raan; eriki'ra akkinipoan'rathu avan uthaduka'lil irukki'rathu.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavan sa'ndaiyaik ki'lappividuki'raan; koa'l solluki'ravan piraa'nasineakitharaiyum piriththuviduki'raan.
kodumaiyaanavan than ayalaanukku nayangkaatti, avanai nalamallaatha vazhiyilea nadakkappa'n'nuki'raan.
avan maa'rupaadaanavaika'lai yoasikkumpadi than ka'nka'lai moodi, theemaiyaich seyyumpadi than uthaduka'laik kadikki'raan.
neethiyin vazhiyil u'ndaakum naraimayiraanathu makimaiyaana kireedam.
palavaanaippaarkkilum neediya saanthamu'l'lavan uththaman; patta'naththaip pidikki'ravanaippaarkkilum than manathai adakkuki'ravan uththaman.
seettu madiyilea poadappadum; kaariyasiththiyoa karththaraal varum.
sa'ndaiyoadu koodiya veeduni'raintha kozhumaiyaana pathaarththangka'laippaarkkilum, amarikkaiyoadea saappidum ve'rum thu'nikkaiyea nalam.
puththiyu'l'la vealaikkaaran ilachchaiyu'ndaakkuki'ra puththiranai aa'ndu, sakoathararukku'l'la suthantharaththil pangkadaivaan.
ve'l'liyaik kukaiyum, ponnaip pudamum soathikkum; iruthayangka'laich soathikki'ravaroa karththar.
thushdan akkirama uthaduka'l solvathai ut'rukkeadki'raan; poyyan keadu'l'la naavukkuch sevikodukki'raan.
eazhaiyaip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'ravan avanai u'ndaakkinavarai ninthikki'raan; aapaththaikku'riththuk ka'likki'ravan tha'ndanaikkuth thappaan.
pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'l muthiyoarukkuk kireedam; pi'l'laika'lin meanmai avarka'l pithaakka'lea.
meanmaiyaanavaika'laip peasum uthadu moodanukkuth thakaathu; poy peasum uthadu pirapuvukku evva'laveanum thakaathu.
parithaanam vaangkuki'ravarka'lin paarvaikku athu iraththinampoalirukkum; athu noakkum thisaiyellaam kaariyam vaaykkum.
kut'raththai mooduki'ravan sineakaththai naaduki'raan; keattathaich solluki'ravan piraa'nasineakitharaiyum piriththuviduki'raan.
moodanai noo'radi adippathaippaarkkilum, puththimaanai vaayinaal ka'ndippathea athikamaay u'raikkum.
thushdan kalakaththaiyea theaduki'raan; kuroorathoothan avanukku viroathamaaka anuppappaduvaan.
than mathikeattil thiriyum mathiyeenanukku ethirppaduvathaippaarkkilum, kuttika'laip pa'rikoduththa karadikku ethirppaduvathu vaasi.
nanmaikkuth theemaiseyki'ravan evanoa, avan veettaivittuth theemai neengkaathu.
sa'ndaiyin aarampam mathakaith thi'ranthuviduki'rathupoalirukkum; aathalaal vivaatham ezhumpumun athai vittuvidu.
thunmaarkkanai neethimaanaakkuki'ravanum, neethimaanaik kut'ravaa'liyaakkuki'ravanumaakiya ivviruvarum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavarka'l.
gnaanaththaik ko'l'lumpadi moodan kaiyilea rokkam ennaththi'rku? athinmeal avanukku manamillaiyea.
sineakithan ellaak kaalaththilum sineakippaan; idukka'nil uthavavea sakoatharan pi'ranthirukki'raan.
puththiyeenan than sineakithanukku munpaakak kaiyadiththukkoduththup pi'naippaduki'raan.
vaathuppiriyan paathakappiriyan; than vaasalai uyarththik kattuki'ravan azhivai naaduki'raan.
maa'rupaadaana iruthayamu'l'lavan nanmaiyaik ka'ndadaivathillai; purattu naavu'l'lavan theemaiyil vizhuvaan.
moodapuththiranaip pe'ruki'ravan thanakkuch sagnchalamu'ndaaka avanaip pe'ruki'raan; mathiyeenanudaiya thakappanukku makizhchchiyillai.
manamakizhchchi nalla aushatham; mu'rintha aaviyoa elumpuka'lai ularappa'n'num.
thunmaarkkan, neethiyin vazhiyaip puratta, madiyilu'l'la parithaanaththai vaangkuki'raan.
gnaanam puththimaanukku munpaaka irukkum; moodanudaiya ka'nka'loa poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lil sellum.
moodapuththiran than pithaavukkuch salippum, thannaip pet'ravarka'lukkuk kasappumaanavan.
neethimaanaith tha'ndampidikki'rathum, niyaayagnseyki'ravanaip pirapukka'l adikki'rathum thakuthiyalla.
a'rivaa'li than vaarththaika'lai adakkuki'raan; viveaki ku'lirntha manamu'l'lavan.
peasaathirunthaal moodanum gnaanavaan en'ru e'n'nappaduvaan; than uthaduka'lai mooduki'ravan puththimaan en'ru e'n'nappaduvaan.
pirinthupoaki'ravan than ichchaiyinpadi seyyappaarkki'raan, ellaa gnaanaththilum thalaiyittukko'l'luki'raan.
moodan gnaanaththil piriyangko'l'laamal, than manathilu'l'lavaika'lai ve'lippaduththap piriyappaduki'raan.
thunmaarkkan vara avamaanam varum; avamaanaththoadea ninthaiyum varum.
manushanudaiya vaaymozhika'l aazhamaana jalampoalirukkum; gnaanaththin oot'ru paayki'ra aat'raippoalirukkum.
vazhakkilea neethimaanaith thoa'rkadikki'ratha'rku, thunmaarkkanukku mukathaadchi'niyampa'n'nuvathu nallathalla.
moodanudaiya uthaduka'l vivaathaththil nuzhaiyum, avan vaay adika'lai varavazhaikkum.
moodanudaiya vaay avanukkuk keadu, avan uthaduka'l avan aaththumaavukkuk ka'n'ni.
koa'lkaaranudaiya vaarththaika'l vi'laiyaattuppoalirukkum, aanaalum avaika'l u'l'laththi'rku'l thaikkum.
than vealaiyil asathiyaayiruppavan azhimpanukkuch sakoatharan.
karththarin naamam palaththa thurukam; neethimaan atha'rku'l oadich sukamaayiruppaan.
aisuvariyavaanudaiya poru'l avanukku ara'naana patta'nam; athu avan e'n'naththil uyarntha mathilpoalirukkum.
azhivu varumun manushanudaiya iruthayam i'rumaappaayirukkum; meanmaikku munnaanathu thaazhmai.
kaariyaththaik keadkumun uththaram solluki'ravanukku, athu puththiyeenamum vedkamumaayirukkum.
manushanudaiya aavi avan palaveenaththaith thaangkum; mu'rintha aavi yaaraal thaangkakkoodum?
puththimaanudaiya manam a'rivaich sampaathikkum; gnaaniyin sevi a'rivai naadum.
oruvan kodukkum vekumathi avanukku vazhiyu'ndaakki, periyoarka'lukku munpaaka avanaik ko'ndupoayvidum.
than vazhakkilea muthalpeasuki'ravan neethimaanpoal kaa'nappaduvaan; avan ayalaanoa vanthu avanaip parisoathikki'raan.
seettuppoaduthal viroathangka'lai ozhiththu, palavaanka'l naduvea sikka'rukkum.
ara'naana patta'naththai vasappaduththuvathaippaarkkilum koapangko'nda sakoatharanai vasappaduththuvathu arithu; avarka'ludaiya viroathangka'l koattaith thaazhppaa'lka'lpoalirukkum.
avanavan vaayin palanaal avanavan vayi'ru nirampum; avanavan uthaduka'lin vi'laivinaal avanavan thirupthiyaavaan.
mara'namum jeevanum naavin athikaaraththilirukkum; athil piriyappaduki'ravarka'l athin kaniyaip pusippaarka'l.
manaiviyaik ka'ndadaiki'ravan nanmaiyaanathaik ka'ndadaiki'raan; karththaraal thayaiyum pet'rukko'l'luki'raan.
thariththiran kegnchikkeadki'raan; aisuvariyavaan kadinamaay uththaravu kodukki'raan.
sineakitharu'l'lavan sineakam paaraattavea'ndum; sakoatharanilum athika sonthamaaych sineakippavanumu'ndu.
maa'rupaadaana uthaduka'lu'l'la moodanaippaarkkilum, uththamanaay nadakki'ra thariththiranea vaasi.
aaththumaa a'rivillaamaliruppathu nallathalla; kaal thurithamaanavan thappi nadakki'raan.
manushanudaiya mathiyeenam avan vazhiyaith thaa'rumaa'raakkum; en'raalum avan manam karththarukku viroathamaayth thaangkaladaiyum.
selvam aneaka sineakitharaich searkkum; thariththiranoa than sineakithanaalum nekizhappaduvaan.
poychsaadchikkaaran aakkinaikkuth thappaan; poyka'laip peasuki'ravanum thappuvathillai.
pirapuvin thayaiyai aneakar varunthik keadpaarka'l; kodaikodukki'ravanukku evanum sineakithan.

thariththiranai avanudaiya sakoatharar ellaarum pakaikki'raarka'lea, eththanai athikamaay avan sineakithar avanukkuth thooramaavaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya vaarththaika'lai avan naaduki'raan, avaika'loa ve'rum vaarththaika'lea.
gnaanaththaip pet'rukko'l'luki'ravan than aaththumaavaich sineakikki'raan; puththiyaik kaakki'ravan nanmaiyadaivaan.
poychsaadchikkaaran aakkinaikkuth thappaan; poyka'laip peasuki'ravan naasamadaivaan.
moodanukkuch selvam thakaathu; pirapukka'lai aa'nduko'lvathu adimaikku evva'lavum thakaathu.
manushanudaiya viveakam avan koapaththai adakkum; kut'raththai mannippathu avanukku makimai.
raajaavin koapam singkaththin kerchchippukkuch samaanam; avanudaiya thayai pullinmeal peyyum panipoalirukkum.
moodanaakiya makan than thakappanukku mikuntha thukkam; manaiviyin sa'ndaika'l oayaatha ozhukku.
veedum aasthiyum pithaakka'l vaikkum suthantharam; puththiyu'l'la manaiviyoa karththar aru'lum eevu.
soampal thoongkivizhappa'n'num; asathiyaanavan pattiniyaayiruppaan.
katta'laiyaik kaaththukko'l'luki'ravan than aaththumaavaik kaakki'raan; than vazhika'lai avamathikki'ravan saavaan.
eazhaikku irangkuki'ravan karththarukkuk kadankodukki'raan; avan koduththathai avar thirumpak koduppaar.
nampikkaiyirukkumattum un makanaich sidchaisey; aanaalum avanaik kolla un aaththumaavai ezhumpavottaathea.
kadungkoapi aakkinaikku'l'laavaan; nee avanaith thappuviththaal thirumpavum thappuvikkavea'ndiyathaay varum.
un anthiyakaalaththil nee gnaanamu'l'lavanaayirukkumpadi, aaloasanaiyaikkeattu, puththimathiyai eat'rukko'l.
manushanudaiya iruthayaththin e'n'nangka'l aneakam; aanaalum karththarudaiya yoasanaiyea nilaini'rkum.
nanmaiseyya manushan ko'ndirukkum aasaiyea thayai; poyyanaippaarkkilum thariththiran vaasi.
karththarukkup payappaduthal jeevanukkeathuvaanathu; athai adainthavan thirupthiyadainthu nilaiththiruppaan; theemai avanai a'nukaathu.
soampea'ri than kaiyaik kalaththilea vaiththu, athaith thirumpath than vaaya'ndaikku edukkaamalirukki'raan.
pariyaasakkaaranai adi, appozhuthu peathai echcharikkappaduvaan; puththimaanaik kadinthuko'l, avan a'rivu'l'lavanaavaan.
than thakappanaik ko'l'laiyadiththu, than thaayaith thuraththividuki'ravan, ilachchaiyaiyum avamaanaththaiyum u'ndaakkuki'ra makan.
en makanea, a'rivaith tharum vaarththaika'lai vittu vilakachseyyum poathakangka'lai nee kea'laathea.
