pealiyaa'lin saadchikkaaran niyaayaththai ninthikki'raan; thunmaarkkarudaiya vaay akkiramaththai vizhungkum.
pariyaasakkaararukkuth tha'ndanaika'lum, moodarudaiya muthukukku adika'lum aayaththamaayirukki'rathu.
thiraadcharasam pariyaasagnseyyum, mathupaanam ama'lipa'n'num; athinaal mayangkuki'ra oruvanum gnaanavaanalla.
raajaavin u'rukkuthal singkaththin kerchchippukkuch samaanam; avanaik koapappaduththuki'ravan than piraa'nanukkea thuroakagnseyki'raan.
vazhakkukku vilakuvathu manushanukku meanmai; moodanaanavan evanum athilea thalaiyittukko'lvaan.
soampea'ri ku'liruki'rathen'ru uzhamaattaan; a'ruppilea pichchaikeattaalum avanukku on'rungkidaiyaathu.
manushanudaiya iruthayaththilu'l'la yoasanai aazhamaana tha'n'neerpoalirukki'rathu; puththimaanoa athai mo'ndeduppaan.
manushar perumpaalum thangka'l thayaa'laththaip pirasiththappaduththuvaarka'l; u'nmaiyaana manushanaik ka'ndupidippavan yaar?
neethimaan than uththamaththilea nadakki'raan; avanukkuppi'raku avan pi'l'laika'lum paakkiyavaanka'laayiruppaarka'l.
niyaayaasanaththil veet'rirukkum raajaa than ka'nka'linaal sakala pollaappaiyum sitha'rappa'n'nuki'raan.
en iruthayaththaich suththamaakkinean, en paavama'rath thuppuravaanean en'ru sollaththakkavan yaar?
vevvea'raana ni'raikallum, vevvea'raana marakkaalum aakiya ivvira'ndum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaika'l.
pi'l'laiyaanaalum, athin seykai suththamoa semmaiyoa enpathu, athin nadakkaiyinaal vi'langkum.
keadki'ra kaathum, kaa'nki'ra ka'n'num aakiya ivvira'ndaiyum karththar u'ndaakkinaar.
thookkaththai virumpaathea, virumpinaal thariththiranaavaay; ka'nvizhiththiru, appozhuthu aakaaraththinaal thirupthiyaavaay.
ko'l'luki'ravan: nallathalla, nallathalla enpaan; poayvittapinpoa mechchikko'lvaan.
ponnum mikuthiyaana muththukka'lum u'ndu; a'rivu'l'la uthaduka'loa vilaiyuyarntha iraththinam.
anniyanukkaakap pi'naippattavanudaiya vasthiraththai eduththukko'l; anniya sthireeyinimiththam avan kaiyil eedu vaangkikko'l.
vagnchanaiyinaal vantha poajanam manushanukku inpamaayirukkum; pinpoa avanudaiya vaay parukkaikka'rka'laal nirappappadum.
aaloasanaiyinaal e'n'nangka'l sthirappadum; nalyoasanai seythu yuththampa'n'nu.
thoot'rikko'ndu thiriki'ravan irakasiyangka'lai ve'lippaduththuvaan; aathalaal than uthaduka'linaal alappuki'ravanoadea kalavaathea.
than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum thooshikki'ravanudaiya theepam kaariru'lil a'nainthupoam.
aarampaththilea thurithamaakak kidaiththa suthantharam mudivilea aaseervaatham pe'raathu.
theemaikkuch sarikkattuvean en'ru sollaathea; karththarukkuk kaaththiru, avar unnai iradchippaar.
vevvea'raana ni'raika'rka'l karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaika'l; ka'l'lath tharaasu nallathalla.
karththaraalea manusharudaiya nadaika'l vaaykkum; aakaiyaal manushan than vazhiyai a'rinthuko'lvatheppadi?
parisuththamaanathai vizhungkuki'rathum, poruththanai seythapinpu yoasikki'rathum, manushanukkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkum.
gnaanamu'l'la raajaa thunmaarkkaraich sitha'radiththu, avarka'lmeal uru'laiyai uruttuvaan.
manushanudaiya aavi karththar thantha theepamaayirukki'rathu; athu u'l'laththil u'l'lavaika'laiyellaam aaraaynthupaarkkum.
thayaiyum saththiyamum raajaavaik kaakkum; thayaiyinaalea than singkaasanaththai ni'rkappa'n'nuvaan.
vaaliparin alangkaaram avarka'l paraakkiramam; muthirvayathaanavarka'lin makimai avarka'l narai.
kaayaththin thazhumpuka'lum, u'l'laththil u'raikkum adika'lum, pollaathavanai azhukka'rath thudaikkum.
raajaavin iruthayam karththarin kaiyil neerkkaalka'laippoalirukki'rathu; athaith thamathu siththaththinpadi avar thiruppuki'raar.
manushanudaiya vazhiyellaam avan paarvaikkuch semmaiyaakath thoan'rum; karththaroa iruthayangka'lai ni'ruththuppaarkki'raar.
paliyiduvathaippaarkkilum, neethiyum niyaayamum seyvathea karththarukkup piriyam.
meattimaiyaana paarvaiyum, akanthaiyaana manamumu'l'la thunmaarkkar poadum ve'lichcham paavamea.
jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanudaiya ninaivuka'l selvaththukkum, patha'ruki'ravanudaiya ninaivuka'l thariththiraththukkum eathuvaakum.
poynaavinaal poru'laich sampaathippathu saavaith theaduki'ravarka'l viduki'ra suvaasampoalirukkum.
thunmaarkkar niyaayagnseyya manathillaathirukki'rapadiyaal, avarka'l paazhkkadikkappattuppoavaarka'l.
kut'ramu'l'lavan than vazhika'lil maa'rupaadu'l'lavan; suththamu'l'lavanoa than kiriyaiyil semmaiyaanavan.
sa'ndaikkaariyoadea oru periya veettil kudiyiruppathaippaarkkilum, veettinmeal oru moolaiyil thangkiyiruppathea nalam.
thunmaarkkanudaiya manam pollaappaich seyya virumpum; avan ka'nka'lil avan ayalaanukku irakkangkidaiyaathu.
pariyaasakkaaranaith tha'ndikkumpoathu peathai gnaanamadaivaan; gnaanavaan poathikkappadumpoathu a'rivadaivaan.
neethiparar thunmaarkkarudaiya veettaik kavaniththuppaarkki'raar; thunmaarkkaraith theengkil kavizhththuppoaduvaar.
eazhaiyin kookkuralukkuth than seviyai adaiththukko'l'luki'ravan, thaanum saththamittuk kooppidumpoathu keadkappadamaattaan.
antharangkamaayk kodukkappatta vekumathi koapaththaith tha'nikkum; madiyilu'l'la parithaanam kuroathaththai aat'rum.
niyaayantheerppathu neethimaanukkuch santhoashamum, akkiramakkaararukkoa azhivumaam.
viveakaththin vazhiyai vittuth thappi nadakki'ra manushan seththavarka'lin koottaththil thaaparippaan.
sit'rinpappiriyan thariththiranaavaan; mathupaanaththaiyum e'n'neyaiyum virumpuki'ravan aisuvariyavaanaavathillai.
neethimaanukkup pathilaakath thunmaarkkanum, semmaiyaanavanukkup pathilaaka thuroakiyum meedkumporu'laavaarka'l.
sa'ndaikkaariyum koapakkaariyumaana sthireeyudan kudiyiruppathaippaarkkilum vanaantharaththil kudiyiruppathu nalam.
vea'ndiya thiraviyamum e'n'neyum gnaanavaanudaiya vaasasthalaththil u'ndu; moodanoa athaich selavazhiththuppoaduki'raan.
neethiyaiyum thayaiyaiyum pinpat'ruki'ravan jeevanaiyum neethiyaiyum makimaiyaiyum ka'ndadaivaan.
palavaanka'ludaiya patta'naththin mathilai gnaanamu'l'lavan ea'rippidiththu, avarka'l nampina ara'nai idiththuppoaduvaan.
than vaayaiyum than naavaiyum kaakki'ravan than aaththumaavai idukka'nka'lukku vilakkik kaakki'raan.
akangkaaramum idumpumu'l'lavanukkup pariyaasakkaaranen'ru peyar, avan akanthaiyaana sinaththoadea nadakki'raan.
soampea'riyin kaika'l vealaiseyyach sammathiyaathathinaal, avan aasai avanaik kollum.
avan naa'lthoa'rum aavaludan ichchikki'raan; neethimaanoa pisiniththanamillaamal koduppaan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya pali aruvaruppaanathu; athaith thurchsinthaiyoadea seluththinaaloa eththanai athikamaay aruvarukkappadum.
poychsaadchikkaaran kettuppoavaan; sevikodukki'ravanoa eppozhuthum peasaththakkavanaavaan.
thunmaarkkan than mukaththaik kadinappaduththuki'raan; semmaiyaanavanoa than vazhiyai nearppaduththuki'raan.
karththarukku viroathamaana gnaanamumillai, puththiyumillai, aaloasanaiyumillai.
kuthirai yuththanaa'lukku aayaththamaakkappadum; jeyamoa karththaraal varum.
thira'laana aisuvariyaththaippaarkkilum na'rkeerththiyea therinthuko'l'lappadaththakkathu; pon ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum thayaiyea nalam.
aisuvariyavaanum thariththiranum oruvaraiyoruvar santhikki'raarka'l; avarka'l anaivaraiyum u'ndaakkinavar karththar.
viveaki aapaththaik ka'ndu ma'rainthuko'l'luki'raan; peathaika'l nedukappoayth tha'ndikkappaduki'raarka'l.
thaazhmaikkum karththarukkup payappaduthalukkum varum palan aisuvariyamum makimaiyum jeevanumaam.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavanudaiya vazhiyilea mu'l'luka'lum ka'n'nika'lumu'ndu; than aaththumaavaik kaakki'ravan avaika'lukkuth thooramaay vilakippoavaan.
pi'l'laiyaanavan nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyilea avanai nadaththu; avan muthirvayathilum athai vidaathiruppaan.
aisuvariyavaan thariththiranai aa'luki'raan; kadanvaangkinavan kadankoduththavanukku adimai.
aniyaayaththai vithaikki'ravan varuththaththai a'ruppaan; avan ukkiraththin milaa'ru ozhiyum.
karu'naikka'n'nan aaseervathikkappaduvaan; avan than aakaaraththil thariththiranukkuk kodukki'raan.
pariyaasakkaaranaith thuraththividu; appozhuthu vaathu neengkum, viroathamum avamaanamum ozhiyum.
suththa iruthayaththai virumpuki'ravanudaiya uthaduka'l inimaiyaanavaika'l; raajaa avanukkuch sineakithanaavaan.
karththarudaiya ka'nka'l gnaanaththaik kaakkum; thuroakika'lin vaarththaika'laiyoa avar thaa'rumaa'raakkuki'raar.
ve'liyilea singkam, veethiyilea kolaiyu'npean en'ru soampea'ri solluvaan.
parasthireeka'lin vaay aazhamaana padukuzhi; karththarudaiya koapaththi'rku eathuvaanavan athilea vizhuvaan.
pi'l'laiyin negnchil mathiyeenam ottiyirukkum; athaith tha'ndanaiyin pirampu avanaivittu akat'rum.
thanakku athikam u'ndaakath thariththiranai odukkuki'ravan thanakkuk ku'raichchalu'ndaakavea aisuvariyavaanukkuk koduppaan.
un seviyaich saayththu, gnaanika'ludaiya vaarththaika'laik keattu, en poathakaththai un iruthayaththil vai.
avaika'lai un u'l'laththil kaaththu, avaika'lai un uthaduka'lil nilaiththirukkappa'n'numpoathu, athu inpamaayirukkum.
un nampikkai karththarmeal irukkumpadi, in'raiyathinam avaika'lai unakkuth theriyappaduththuki'rean.
saththiya vaarththaika'lin yathaarththaththai naan unakkuth therivikkumpadikkum, nee unnai anuppinavarka'lukkuch saththiya vaarththaika'lai ma'rumozhiyaakach sollumpadikkum,
aaloasanaiyaiyum gnaanaththaiyum pat'ri naan unakku mukkiyamaanavaika'lai ezhuthavillaiyaa?
eazhaiyaayirukki'raan en'ru eazhaiyaik ko'l'laiyidaathea; si'rumaiyaanavanai niyaayasthalaththil upaththiravappaduththaathea.
karththar avarka'lukkaaka vazhakkaadi, avarka'laik ko'l'laiyiduki'ravarka'ludaiya piraa'nanaik ko'l'laiyiduvaar.
koapakkaaranukkuth thoazhanaakaathea; ukkiramu'l'la manushanoadea nadavaathea.
appadich seythaal, nee avanudaiya vazhika'laik kat'rukko'ndu, un aaththumaavukkuk ka'n'niyai varuvippaay.
kaiyadiththu udanpattu, kadanukkaakap pi'naippaduki'ravarka'lil oruvanaakaathea.
seluththa unakku on'rumillaathirunthaal, nee paduththirukkum padukkaiyaiyum avan eduththukko'l'lavea'ndiyathaakumea.
un pithaakka'l naattina poorva ellaikku'riyai maat'raathea.
than vealaiyil jaakkirathaiyaayirukki'ravanai nee ka'ndaal, avan neesarukku munpaaka nillaamal, raajaakka'lukku munpaaka ni'rpaan.
nee oru athipathiyoadea poajanampa'n'na udkaarnthaal, unakku munpaaka irukki'rathai nan'raayk kavaniththuppaar.
nee poajanappiriyanaayirunthaal, un tho'ndaiyilea kaththiyai vai.
avanudaiya rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'lai ichchiyaathea; avaika'l ka'l'lappoajanamaamea.
aisuvariyavaanaakavea'ndumen'ru pirayaasappadaathea; suyapuththiyaich saaraathea.
illaama'rpoakum poru'lmeal un ka'nka'laip pa'rakkaviduvaanean? athu kazhukaippoalach si'rakuka'laith thanakku u'ndupa'n'nikko'ndu, aakaayamaarkkamaayp pa'ranthupoam.
vanka'n'nanudaiya aakaaraththaip pusiyaathea; avanudaiya rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'lai ichchiyaathea.
avan iruthayaththin ninaivu eppadiyoa, appadiyea avan irukki'raan; pusiyum, paanampa'n'num en'ru avan unnoadea sonnaalum, avan iruthayam unnoadea iraathu.
nee pusiththa thu'nikkaiyai vaanthipa'n'ni, un iniya so'rka'lai izhanthupoavaay.
moodanudaiya sevika'l keadkappeasaathea; avan un vaarththaika'lin gnaanaththai asattaipa'n'nuvaan.
poorva ellaikku'riyai maat'raathea; thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'ludaiya nilangka'lai apakariththukko'l'laathea.
avarka'ludaiya meedpar vallavar; avar unnudanea avarka'lukkaaka vazhakkaaduvaar.
un iruthayaththaip puththimathikkum, un sevika'lai a'rivin vaarththaika'lukkum saayppaayaaka.
pi'l'laiyai tha'ndiyaamal vidaathea; avanaip pirampinaal adiththaal avan saakaan.
nee pirampinaal avanai adikki'rathinaal paathaa'laththukku avan aaththumaavaith thappuvippaayea.
en makanea, un iruthayam gnaanamu'l'lathaayirunthaal, ennilea en iruthayam makizhum.
un uthaduka'l semmaiyaanavaika'laip peasinaal, en u'l'linthiriyangka'l makizhum.
un manathaip paavika'lmeal po'raamaiko'l'la vidaathea; nee naadoa'rum karththaraip pat'rum payaththoadiru.
nichchayamaakavea mudivu u'ndu; un nampikkai vee'npoakaathu.
en makanea, nee sevikoduththu gnaanamadainthu, un iruthayaththai nalvazhiyilea nadaththu.
mathupaanappiriyaraiyum maamsapperuntheenikkaararaiyum searaathea.
kudiyanum poajanappiriyanum thariththiraraavaarka'l; thookkam kanthaika'lai uduththuvikkum.
unnaip pet'ra thakappanukkuch sevikodu; un thaay vayathusen'rava'laakumpoathu ava'lai asattaipa'n'naathea.
saththiyaththai vaangku, athai vi'rkaathea; appadiyea gnaanaththaiyum upatheasaththaiyum puththiyaiyum vaangku.
neethimaanudaiya thakappan mikavum ka'likooruvaan; gnaanamu'l'la pi'l'laiyaip pet'ravan avanaal makizhuvaan.
un thakappanum un thaayum santhoashappaduvaarka'l; unnaip pet'rava'l makizhuvaa'l.
en makanea, un iruthayaththai enakkuth thaa; un ka'nka'l en vazhika'lai noakkuvathaaka.
veasi aazhamaana padukuzhi; parasthiree idukkamaana ki'na'ru.
ava'l ko'l'laikkaaranaippoal pathivirunthu, manusharukku'l'lea paathakaraip perukappa'n'nuki'raa'l.
aiyoa! yaarukku veathanai? yaarukkuth thukkam? yaarukkuch sa'ndaika'l? yaarukkup pulampal? yaarukkuk kaara'namillaatha kaayangka'l? yaarukku iraththangkalangkina ka'nka'l?
mathupaanam irukkum idaththilea thangkith tharippavarka'lukkum, kalappu'l'la saaraayaththai naaduki'ravarka'lukkunthaanea.
mathupaanam iraththavaru'namaayirunthu, paaththiraththil pa'lapa'lappaayth thoan'rumpoathu, nee athaip paaraathea; athu methuvaay i'rangkum.
mudivilea athu paampaippoal kadikkum, viriyanaippoal thee'ndum.
un ka'nka'l parasthireeka'lai noakkum; un u'l'lam thaa'rumaa'raanavaika'laip peasum.
nee nadukkadalilea sayaniththirukki'ravanaippoalum, paaymaraththattilea paduththirukki'ravanaippoalum iruppaay.
ennai adiththaarka'l, enakku noakavillai; ennai a'rainthaarka'l, enakkuch sura'naiyillai; naan athaip pinnum thodarnthu theada eppozhuthu vizhippean enpaay.
pollaatha manusharmeal po'raamai ko'l'laathea; avarka'loadea irukkavum virumpaathea.
avarka'l iruthayam kodumaiyai yoasikkum, avarka'l uthaduka'l theevinaiyaip peasum.
veedu gnaanaththinaalea kattappattu, viveakaththinaalea nilaini'ruththappadum.
a'rivinaalea a'raika'lil arumaiyum inimaiyumaana sakalavithap poru'lka'lum ni'rainthirukkum.
gnaanamu'l'lavan pelamu'l'lavan; a'rivu'l'lavan than vallamaiyai athikarikkappa'n'nuki'raan.
nalyoasanai seythu yuththampa'n'nu; aaloasanaikkaarar aneakaraal jeyangkidaikkum.
moodanukku gnaanam ettaatha uyaramaayirukkum; avan niyaayasthalaththil than vaayaith thi'ravaan.
theevinaiseyya upaayagnseyki'ravan thushdan ennappaduvaan.
theeyanoakkam paavamaam; pariyaasakkaaran manusharukku aruvaruppaanavan.
aapaththukkaalaththil nee soarnthu poavaayaanaal, un pelan ku'rukinathu.
mara'naththukku oppikkappattavarka'laiyum, kolaiyu'n'nappoaki'ravarka'laiyum viduvikkakkoodumaanaal viduvi.
athai a'riyoam enpaayaakil, iruthayangka'laich soathikki'ravar a'riyaaroa? un aaththumaavaik kaakki'ravar kavaniyaaroa? avar manusharukku avanavan kiriyaikkuththakkathaakap palana'liyaaroa?
en makanea, theanaich saappidu, athu nallathu; koottilirunthu ozhukum thean un vaaykku inpamaayirukkum.
appadiyea gnaanaththai a'rinthuko'lvathu un aaththumaavukku inpamaayirukkum; athaip pet'rukko'ndaal, athu mudivil uthavum, un nampikkai vee'npoakaathu.
thushdanea, nee neethimaanudaiya vaasasthalaththukku viroathamaayp pathiviraathea; avan thangkum idaththaip paazhaakkippoadaathea.
neethimaan eazhutharam vizhunthaalum thirumpavum ezhunthiruppaan; thunmaarkkaroa theengkilea ida'ru'ndu kidappaarka'l.
un saththuru vizhumpoathu santhoashappadaathea; avan ida'rumpoathu un iruthayam ka'likooraathiruppathaaka.
karththar athaik kaa'npaar, athu avar paarvaikkup pollaappaayirukkum; appozhuthu avanidaththinin'ru avar thamathu koapaththai neekkividuvaar.
pollaathavarka'laikku'riththu erichchalaakaathea; thunmaarkkarmeal po'raamai ko'l'laathea.
thunmaarkkanukku nalmudivu illai; thunmaarkkanudaiya vi'lakku a'nainthupoam.
en makanea, nee karththarukkum raajaavukkum payanthu nada; kalakakkaararoadu kalavaathea.
sadithiyil avarka'ludaiya aapaththu ezhumpum; avarka'l iruvarin sangkaaraththaiyum a'rinthavan yaar?
pinnum gnaanamu'l'lavarka'lin puththimathika'l ennavenil: niyaayaththilea mukathaadchi'niyam nallathalla.
thunmaarkkanaip paarththu: neethimaanaayirukki'raay en'ru solluki'ravanai janangka'l sapippaarka'l, pirajaika'l avanai ve'ruppaarka'l.
avanaik kadinthuko'l'luki'ravarka'lmeal piriyamu'ndaakum, avarka'lukku uththama aaseervaatham kidaikkum.
semmaiyaana ma'rumozhi solluki'ravan uthaduka'lai muththamiduki'ravanukkuch samaanam.
ve'liyil un vealaiyai eththanappaduththi, vayalil athai ozhungkaakki, pinpu un veettaik kattu.
niyaayamin'rip pi'ranukku viroathamaaych saadchiyaaka ea'rpadaathea; un uthaduka'linaal vagnchakam peasaathea.
avan enakkuch seythapirakaaram naanum avanukkuch seyvean, avan seytha seykaikkuththakkathaaka naanum avanukkuch sarikkattuvean en'ru nee sollaathea.
soampea'riyin vayalaiyum, mathiyeenanudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththaiyum kadanthupoanean.
ithoa, athellaam mu'l'lukkaadaayirunthathu; nilaththin mukaththaik kaagncho'ri moodinathu, athin ka'rsuvar idinthu kidanthathu.
athaik ka'ndu sinthanaipa'n'ninean; athai noakkip puththiyadainthean.
innungkogncham u'rangkattum, innungkogncham kaimudakkikko'ndu niththirai seyyattum enpaayoa?
un thariththiram vazhippoakkanaippoalum un va'rumai aayuthama'ninthavanaippoalum varum.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavin manushar pearththezhuthina saalomoanudaiya neethimozhika'l:
kaariyaththai ma'raippathu theavanukku meanmai; kaariyaththai aaraayvathoa raajaakka'lukku meanmai.
vaanaththin uyaramum, poomiyin aazhamum, raajaakka'lin iruthayangka'lum aaraaynthumudiyaathu.
ve'l'liyinin'ru ka'limpai neekkividu, appozhuthu thattaanaal nalla udaimai pi'rakkum.
raajaavin munnin'ru thushdarai neekkividu, appozhuthu avanudaiya singkaasanam neethiyinaal nilaini'rkum.
raajaavin samukaththil meanmaipaaraattaathea; periyoarka'ludaiya sthaanaththil nillaathea.
un ka'nka'l ka'nda pirapuvin samukaththil nee thaazhththappaduvathu nallathalla; avan unnaip paarththu: mealea vaa en'ru solvathea unakku meanmai.
vazhakkaadap pathat'ramaayp poakaathea; mudivilea un ayalaan unnai vedkappaduththumpoathu, nee enna seyyalaam en'ru thikaippaayea.
nee un ayalaanudaneamaaththiram un viyaajyaththaikku'riththu vazhakkaadu, mat'ravanidaththil irakasiyaththai ve'lippaduththaathea.
mat'rappadi athaik keadki'ravan unnai ninthippaan; un avamaanam unnaivittu neengkaathu.
eat'ra samayaththil sonna vaarththai ve'l'liththattil vaikkappatta po'rpazhangka'lukkuch samaanam.
keadki'ra sevikku, gnaanamaayk kadinthuko'ndu puththisolluki'ravan, po'rkadukkanukkum aparagnchip poosha'naththi'rkum sari.

koadaikaalaththil u'rainthamazhaiyin ku'lirchchi eppadiyirukki'rathoa, appadiyea u'nmaiyaana sthaanaapathiyum thannai anuppinavanukku iruppaan; avan than ejamaanka'ludaiya aaththumaavaik ku'lirappa'n'nuvaan.
koduppean en'ru solliyum kodaamalirukki'ra vagnchakan mazhaiyillaatha meakangka'lukkum kaat'rukkum sari.
nee'nda po'rumaiyinaal pirapuvaiyum sammathikkappa'n'nalaam; iniya naavu elumpaiyum no'rukkum.
theanaik ka'ndupidiththaayaanaal mattaaych saappidu; mithamignchich saappittaal vaanthipa'n'nuvaay.
un ayalaan saliththu unnai ve'rukkaathapadikku, adikkadi avan veettil kaalvaikkaathea.
pi'ranukku viroathamaayp poychsaadchi solluki'ra manushan tha'ndaayuthaththukkum kadkaththukkum koormaiyaana ampukkum oppaanavan.
aapaththukkaalaththil thuroakiyai nampuvathu udaintha pallukkum mozhipura'nda kaalukkum samaanam.
manathukkamu'l'lavanukkup paattuka'laip paaduki'ravan, ku'lirkaalaththil vasthiraththaik ka'laiki'ravanaippoalavum, vediyuppinmeal vaarththa kaadiyaippoalavum iruppaan.
un saththuru pasiyaayirunthaal, avanukkup pusikka aakaarangkodu; avan thaakamaayirunthaal, kudikkath tha'n'neerkodu.
athinaal nee avan thalaiyinmeal eriki'ra thazhalka'laik kuvippaay; karththar unakkup palana'lippaar.
vadakaat'ru mazhaiyaiyum, pu'rangkoo'ruki'ra naavu koapamukaththaiyum pi'rappikkum.
sa'ndaikkaariyoadea oru periya veettil kudiyiruppathaippaarkkilum veettinmeal oru moolaiyil thangkuvathea nalam.
thooratheasaththilirunthu varum na'rseythi vidaayththa aaththumaavukkuk kidaikkum ku'lirntha tha'n'neerukkuch samaanam.
thunmaarkkarukku munpaaka neethimaan tha'l'laaduvathu kalangkina ki'nat'rukkum kettuppoana sunaikkum oppaakum.
theanai mikuthiyaay u'npathu nallathalla, tha'rpukazhai naaduvathum pukazhalla.
than aaviyai adakkaatha manushan mathilidintha paazhaana patta'nampoalirukki'raan.
ush'nakaalaththilea u'raintha paniyum, a'ruppukkaalaththilea mazhaiyum thakaathathupoala, moodanukku makimai thakaathu.
adaikkalaan kuruvi alainthupoavathupoalum, thakaivilaan kuruvi pa'ranthupoavathupoalum, kaara'namillaamalitta saapam thangkaathu.
kuthiraikkuch savukkum, kazhuthaikkuk kadivaa'lamum, moodanudaiya muthukukkup pirampum eat'rathu.
moodanukku avan mathiyeenaththinpadi ma'ruuththaravu kodaathea; koduththaal neeyum avanaip poalaavaay.
moodanukku avan mathiyeenaththinpadi ma'ruuththaravu kodu; kodaavittaal avan than paarvaikku gnaaniyaayiruppaan.
moodan kaiyilea seythi anuppuki'ravan than kaalka'laiyea tha'riththukko'ndu nashdaththai adaiki'raan.
no'ndiyin kaalka'l kunthikkunthi nadakkum, appadiyea moodarin vaayilu'l'la uvamaichsollum kunthum.
moodanukkuk kanaththaik kodukki'ravan kava'nilea kallaikkattuki'ravanpoaliruppaan.
moodan vaayil akappatta pazhamozhi ve'riyan kaiyil akappatta mu'l'lu.
pelaththavan anaivaraiyum noakappa'n'ni, moodanaiyum vealaiko'l'luki'raan, mee'ri nadakki'ravarka'laiyum vealaiko'l'luki'raan.
naayaanathu thaan kakkinathaith thinnumpadi thirumpuvathupoala, moodanum than moodaththanaththukkuth thirumpuki'raan.
than paarvaikku gnaaniyaayiruppavanaik ka'ndaayaanaal, avanaippaarkkilum moodanaikku'riththu athika nampikkaiyaayirukkalaam.
vazhiyilea singkam irukkum, naduveethiyilea singkam irukkum en'ru soampea'ri solluvaan.
kathavu keelmu'laiyil aaduki'rathupoala, soampea'riyum padukkaiyil aadikko'ndirukki'raan.
soampea'ri than kaiyaik kalaththilea vaiththu athaith than vaaykkuth thirumpa edukka varuththappaduki'raan.
puththiyu'l'la ma'ruuththaravu sollaththakum eazhupearaippaarkkilum soampea'ri than paarvaikku athika gnaanamu'l'lavan.
vazhiyea poakaiyil thanakkadaatha vazhakkil thalaiyiduki'ravan naayaik kaathaip pidiththizhukki'ravanaippoalirukki'raan.
ko'l'lika'laiyum ampuka'laiyum saavukkeathuvaanavaika'laiyum e'riki'ra paiththiyakkaaran eppadiyirukki'raanoa,
appadiyea, thanakkaduththavanai vagnchiththu: naan vi'laiyaattukkallavoa seythean en'ru solluki'ra manushanum irukki'raan.
vi'rakillaamal neruppu aviyum; koa'lsolluki'ravanillaamal sa'ndai adangkum.
karika'l thazhalukkum, vi'raku neruppukkum eathuvaanathupoala, vaathuppiriyan sa'ndaika'lai moottuki'ratha'rku eathuvaanavan.
koa'lkaaranudaiya vaarththaika'l vi'laiyaattuppoalirukkum; aanaalum avaika'l u'l'laththi'rku'l thaikkum.
neasa analaik kaa'npikki'ra uthaduka'loadu koodiya theeyanegncham ve'l'lippoochchu poosiya oattaippoalirukkum.
pakaignan than u'l'laththil kapadaththai ma'raiththu, than uthaduka'linaal soothupeasuki'raan.
avan ithampeasinaalum avanai nampaathea; avan iruthayaththil eazhu aruvaruppuka'l u'ndu.
pakaiyai vagnchakamaay ma'raiththu vaikki'ravanevanoa, avanudaiya pollaangku makaa sapaiyilea ve'lippaduththappadum.
padukuzhiyai vettuki'ravan thaanea athil vizhuvaan; kallaip purattuki'ravanmeal anthak kal thirumpa vizhum.
ka'l'lanaavu thannaal kileasappattavarka'laip pakaikkum; ichchakampeasum vaay azhivai u'ndupa'n'num.
naa'laiyaththinaththaikku'riththup perumaipaaraattaathea; orunaa'l pi'rappippathai a'riyaayea.
un vaay alla, pu'raththiyaanea unnaip pukazhattum; un uthadu alla, anniyanea unnaip pukazhattum.
kal kanamum, ma'nal paaramumaayirukkum; moodanudaiya koapamoa ivvira'ndilum paaramaam.
ukkiram kodumaiyu'l'lathu, koapam nishdooramu'l'lathu; po'raamaiyoaven'raal, atha'rku munni'rkaththakkavan yaar?
ma'raivaana sineakaththaippaarkkilum ve'lippadaiyaana kadinthuko'l'luthal nallathu.
sineakithan adikkum adika'l u'nmaiyaanavaika'l; saththuru idum muththangka'loa vagnchanaiyu'l'lavaika'l.
thirupthiyadainthavan theankoottaiyum mithippaan; pasiyu'l'lavanukkoa kasappaana pathaarththangka'lum thiththippaayirukkum.
than koottaivittu alaiki'ra kuruvi eppadiyirukki'rathoa, appadiyea than sthaanaththaivittu alaiki'ra manushanum irukki'raan.
parima'lathailamum sukanthathoopamum iruthayaththaik ka'lippaakkuvathupoala, oruvanudaiya sineakithan udkaruththaana aaloasanaiyinaal paaraattum inpamaanathu ka'lippaakkum.

un sineakithanaiyum, un thakappanudaiya sineakithanaiyum vittuvidaathea; un aapaththukkaalaththil un sakoatharanudaiya veetti'rkup poakaathea; thooraththilu'l'la sakoatharanilum sameepaththilu'l'la ayalaanea vaasi.
en makanea, ennai ninthikki'ravanukku naan uththaravukodukkaththakkathaaka, nee gnaanavaanaaki, en iruthayaththaich santhoashappaduththu.
viveaki aapaththaik ka'ndu ma'rainthuko'l'luki'raan; peathaika'loa nedukappoayth tha'ndikkappaduki'raarka'l.
anniyanukkaakap pi'naippaduki'ravanudaiya vasthiraththai eduththukko'l, anniya sthireekkaaka eeduvaangkikko'l.
oruvan athikaalaiyilea ezhunthu uraththasaththaththoadea than sineakithanukkuch sollum aaseervaatham saapamaaka e'n'nappadum.
adaimazhainaa'lil oayaatha ozhukkum sa'ndaikkaariyaana sthireeyum sari.
ava'lai adakkappaarkki'ravan kaat'rai adakkith than valathukaiyinaal e'n'neyaip pidikkappaarkki'raan.
irumpai irumpu karukkidum; appadiyea manushanum than sineakithanudaiya mukaththaik karukkiduki'raan.
aththimaraththaik kaakki'ravan athin kaniyaip pusippaan; than ejamaanaik kaakki'ravan kanamadaivaan.
tha'n'neeril mukaththukku mukam oththirukkumaappoala, manusharil iruthayaththi'rku iruthayam oththirukkum.
paathaa'lamum azhivum thirupthiyaaki'rathillai; athupoala manushanudaiya ka'nka'lum thirupthiyaaki'rathillai.
ve'l'likkuk kukaiyum, ponnukkup pudamum soathanai; manushanukku avanukku u'ndaakum pukazhchchiyea soathanai.
moodanai uralil poattu ulakkaiyinaal noyyoadea noyyaakak kuththinaalum, avanudaiya moodaththanam avanai vittu neengkaathu.
un aaduka'lin nilaimaiyai nan'raay a'rinthuko'l; un manthaika'linmeal kavanamaayiru.
selvam en'raikkum nilaiyaathu; kireedam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum nilaini'rkumoa?
pul mu'laikkum, pachchilaika'l thoan'rum, malaippoo'nduka'l searkkappadum.
aattukkuttika'l unakku vasthiraththaiyum, kadaakka'l vayal vaangkaththakka kirayaththaiyum kodukkum.
ve'l'laattuppaal un aakaaraththukkum, un veettaarin aakaaraththukkum, un vealaikkaarika'lin pizhaippukkum poathumaanapadiyirukkum.
oruvanum thodaraathirunthum thunmaarkkar oadippoaki'raarka'l; neethimaanka'loa singkaththaippoalea thairiyamaayirukki'raarka'l.
theasaththin paavaththinimiththam athin athikaarika'l aneakaraayirukki'raarka'l; puththiyum a'rivumu'l'la manushanaaloa athin na'rseer neediththirukkum.
eazhaika'lai odukkuki'ra thariththiran aakaaram vi'laiyaathapadi ve'l'lamaay adiththukko'ndupoaki'ra mazhaiyaippoalirukki'raan.
veathappiramaa'naththai vittu vilakuki'ravarka'l thunmaarkkaraip pukazhuki'raarka'l; veathappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'loa avarka'loadea poaraaduki'raarka'l.
thushdar niyaayaththai a'riyaarka'l; karththaraith theaduki'ravarka'loa sakalaththaiyum a'rivaarka'l.
iruvazhika'lil nadakki'ra thiriyaavarakkaaran aisuvariyavaanaayirunthaalum, nearmaiyaay nadakki'ra thariththiran avanilum vaasi.
veathappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravan viveakamu'l'la puththiran; poajanappiriyarukkuth thoazhanaayirukki'ravanoa than thakappanai avamaanappaduththuki'raan.
aniyaaya vattiyinaalum aathaayaththinaalum than aasthiyaip perukappa'n'nuki'ravan, thariththirarpearil irangkuki'ravanukkaaka athaich seakarikki'raan.
veathaththaik kea'laathapadi than seviyai vilakkuki'ravanudaiya jepamum aruvaruppaanathu.
uththamarka'lai moasappaduththi, pollaatha vazhiyilea nadaththuki'ravan thaan vettina kuzhiyil thaanea vizhuvaan; uththamarka'loa nanmaiyaich suthantharippaarka'l.
aisuvariyavaan than paarvaikku gnaanavaan; puththiyu'l'la thariththiranoa avanaip parisoathikki'raan.
neethimaanka'l ka'likoorumpoathu makaa ko'ndaattam u'ndaakum; thunmaarkkar ezhumpumpoathoa manushar ma'rainthuko'l'luki'raarka'l.
than paavangka'lai ma'raikki'ravan vaazhvadaiyamaattaan; avaika'lai a'rikkai seythu vittuviduki'ravanoa irakkam pe'ruvaan.
eppozhuthum payanthirukki'ravan paakkiyavaan; than iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththuki'ravanoa theengkil vizhuvaan.
eazhai janangka'lai aa'lum thushda athikaari kerchchikkum singkaththukkum alainthuthiriki'ra karadikkum oppaayirukki'raan.
pirapu puththiyeenanaayirunthaal avan seyyum idukka'n mikuthi; poru'laasaiyai ve'rukki'ravan theerkkaayusaip pe'ruvaan.
iraththappazhikkaaka odukkappattavan kuzhiyil o'likka oadivanthaal, avanai aatharikkavea'ndaam.
uththamanaay nadakki'ravan iradchikkappaduvaan; maa'rupaadaana iruvazhiyil nadakki'ravanoa avat'ril on'rilea vizhuvaan.
than nilaththaip payiriduki'ravan aakaaraththaal thirupthiyaavaan; vee'naraip pinpat'ruki'ravanoa va'rumaiyaal ni'rainthiruppaan.
u'nmaiyu'l'la manushan paripoora'na aaseervaathangka'laip pe'ruvaan; aisuvariyavaanaaki'ratha'rkuth theevirikki'ravanoa aakkinaikkuth thappaan.
mukathaadchi'niyam nallathalla, mukathaadchi'niyamu'l'lavan oru thu'ndu appaththukkaaka aniyaayagnseyvaan.
vanka'n'nan selvanaaki'ratha'rkup patha'ruki'raan, va'rumai thanakku varumen'ru a'riyaathirukki'raan.
than naavinaal mukasthuthi peasuki'ravanaippaarkkilum, kadinthuko'l'luki'ravan mudivil angkeekaaram pe'ruvaan.
than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum ko'l'laiyittu, athu thuroakamalla enpavan paazhkkadikki'ra manushanukkuth thoazhan.
perunegnchan vazhakkaik ko'luvuki'raan; karththarai nampuki'ravanoa sezhippaan.
than iruthayaththai nampuki'ravan moodan; gnaanamaay nadakki'ravanoa iradchikkappaduvaan.
thariththirarukkuk koduppavan thaazhchchiyadaiyaan; than ka'nka'lai eazhaika'lukku vilakkuki'ravanukkoa aneaka saapangka'l varum.
thunmaarkkar ezhumpumpoathu manushar ma'rainthuko'l'luki'raarka'l; avarka'l azhiyumpoathoa neethimaanka'l perukuki'raarka'l.
adikkadi kadinthuko'l'lappattum than pidariyaik kadinappaduththuki'ravan sakaayamin'rich sadithiyil naasamadaivaan.
neethimaanka'l perukinaal janangka'l makizhuvaarka'l; thunmaarkkar aa'lumpoathoa janangka'l thavippaarka'l.
gnaanaththil piriyappaduki'ravan than thakappanai makizhappa'n'nuki'raan; veasika'loadea thonthippaanavanoa aasthiyai azhikki'raan.
niyaayaththinaal raajaa theasaththai nilaini'ruththuki'raan; parithaanappiriyanoa athaik kavizhkki'raan.
pi'ranai mukasthuthi seyki'ravan, avan kaalka'lukku valaiyai virikki'raan.
thushdanudaiya thuroakaththilea ka'n'niyirukki'rathu; neethimaanoa paadi makizhuki'raan.
neethimaan eazhaika'lin niyaayaththaik kavaniththa'riki'raan; thunmaarkkanoa athai a'riya virumpaan.
pariyaasakkaarar patta'naththil theekko'luththividuki'raarka'l; gnaanika'loa kuroathaththai vilakkuki'raarka'l.
gnaani moodanudan vazhakkaadukaiyil, sinanthaalum siriththaalum amaithiyillai.
iraththappiriyar uththamanaip pakaikki'raarka'l; semmaiyaanavarka'loa avanudaiya piraa'nanaik kaappaat'ruki'raarka'l.
moodan than u'l'laththaiyellaam ve'lippaduththuki'raan; gnaaniyoa athaip pinnukku adakkivaikki'raan.
athipathiyaanavan poyka'lukkuch sevikoduththaal, avan oozhiyakkaarar yaavarum thunmaarkkaraavaarka'l.
thariththiranum kodumaikkaaranum oruvaraiyoruvar santhikki'raarka'l; avviruvarudaiya ka'nka'lukkum karththar ve'lichchang kodukki'raar.
eazhaika'ludaiya niyaayaththai u'nmaiyaay visaarikki'ra raajaavin singkaasanam en'rum nilaipet'rirukkum.
pirampum kadinthuko'l'luthalum gnaanaththaik kodukkum; than ishdaththi'rku vidappatta pi'l'laiyoa than thaaykku vedkaththai u'ndupa'n'nuki'raan.
thunmaarkkar perukinaal paavamum perukum; neethimaanka'loa avarka'l vizhuvathaik kaa'npaarka'l.
un makanaich sidchaisey, avan unakku aa'ruthalseyvaan, un aaththumaavukku aananthaththaiyum u'ndaakkuvaan.
theerkkatharisanamillaatha idaththil janangka'l seerkettuppoavaarka'l; veathaththaik kaakki'ravanoa paakkiyavaan.
adimaiyaanavan vaarththaika'linaalea adangkaan; avaika'lai avan a'rinthaalum uththaravukodaan.
than vaarththaika'lil patha'ruki'ra manushanaik ka'ndaayaanaal, avanai nampuvathaippaarkkilum moodanai nampalaam.
oruvan than adimaiyaich si'rupiraayamuthal i'lakkaaramaaka va'larththaal, mudivilea avan thannaip puththiranaakap paaraattuvaan.
koapakkaaran vazhakkaik ko'luvuki'raan; moorkkan perumpaathakan.
manushanudaiya akanthai avanaith thaazhththum; manaththaazhmaiyu'l'lavanoa kanamadaivaan.
thirudanoadea pangkittukko'l'luki'ravan than aaththumaavaip pakaikki'raan; saapaththai avan keattaalum kaariyaththai ve'lippaduththamaattaan.
manushanukkup payappadum payam ka'n'niyai varuvikkum; karththarai nampuki'ravanoa uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaikkappaduvaan.
aa'lukaiseyki'ravanudaiya mukatharisanaththaith theaduki'ravarka'l aneakar; aanaalum avanavanudaiya niyaayam karththaraalea theerum.
neethimaanukku aniyaayakkaaran aruvaruppaanavan; sanmaarkkanum thunmaarkkanukku aruvaruppaanavan.
yaakkeayin kumaaranaakiya aakoor ennum purushan eeththiyealukku vasaniththu, eeththiyealukkum ookaalukkum uraiththa upatheasa vaakkiyangka'laavana:
manusharellaarilum naan moodan; manusharukkeat'ra puththi enakku illai.
naan gnaanaththaik ka'rkavum illai, parisuththarin a'rivai a'rinthuko'l'lavum illai.

vaanaththukku ea'riyi'rangkinavar yaar? kaat'raith thamathu kaippidika'lil adakkinavar yaar? tha'n'neerka'lai vasthiraththilea kattinavar yaar? poomiyin ellaika'laiyellaam sthaapiththavar yaar? avarudaiya naamam enna? avar kumaaranudaiya naamam enna? athai a'rivaayoa?
theavanudaiya vasanamellaam pudamidappattavaika'l; thammai a'ndikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku avar keadakamaanavar.
avarudaiya vasanangka'loadu on'raiyum koottaathea, koottinaal avar unnaik kadinthuko'lvaar, nee poyyanaavaay.
ira'ndu manu ummidaththil keadki'rean; naan marikkumpariyanthamum avaika'lai enakku ma'rukkaamal thaarum.
maayaiyaiyum poyvasanippaiyum enakkuth thoorappaduththum; thariththiraththaiyum aisuvariyaththaiyum enakkuk kodaathiruppeeraaka.

naan paripoora'nam adaiki'rathinaal ma'ruthaliththu, karththar yaar en'ru sollaathapadikkum; thariththirappaduki'rathinaal thirudi, en theavanudaiya naamaththai vee'nilea vazhangkaathapadikkum, en padiyai enakku a'lanthu ennaip poashiththaru'lum.
ejamaanidaththil avanudaiya vealaikkaaranmeal kut'ragnsumaththaathea; avan unnaich sapippaan, nee kut'ravaa'liyaakak kaa'nappaduvaay.
thangka'l thakappanaich sapiththum, thangka'l thaayai aaseervathiyaamalum irukki'ra santhathiyaarumu'ndu.
thaangka'l azhukka'rak kazhuvappadaamalirunthum, thangka'l paarvaikkuch suththamaakath thoan'ruki'ra santhathiyaarumu'ndu.
vea'roru santhathiyaarumu'ndu; avarka'l ka'nka'l eththanai meattimaiyum avarka'l imaika'l eththanai ne'rippumaanavaika'l.

theasaththil si'rumaiyaanavarka'laiyum manusharil e'limaiyaanavarka'laiyum padchippatha'rkuk kadkangka'laiyoththa pa'rka'laiyum kaththika'laiyoththa kadaivaayppa'rka'laiyumudaiya santhathiyaarumu'ndu.
thaa, thaa, enki'ra ira'ndu kumaaraththika'l attaikku u'ndu. thirupthiyadaiyaatha moon'ru'ndu, poathum en'ru sollaatha naankumu'ndu.
avaiyaavana: paathaa'lamum, malattuk karppamum, tha'n'neeraal thirupthiyadaiyaatha nilamum, poathumen'ru sollaatha akkiniyumea.
thakappanaip pariyaasampa'n'ni, thaayin katta'laiyai asattaipa'n'nuki'ra ka'n'nai nathiyin kaakangka'l pidungkum, kazhukin kugnchuka'l thinnum.
enakku mikavum aachchariyamaanavaika'l moon'ru'ndu, en puththikkettaathavaika'l naankumu'ndu.
avaiyaavana: aakaayaththil kazhukinudaiya vazhiyum, kanmalaiyinmeal paampinudaiya vazhiyum, nadukkadalil kappalinudaiya vazhiyum, oru kannikaiyai naadiya manushanudaiya vazhiyumea.
appadiyea vipasaarasthireeyinudaiya vazhiyum irukki'rathu; ava'l thin'ru, than vaayaith thudaiththu: naan oru paavamum seyyavillai enpaa'l.
moon'rinimiththam poomi sagnchalappaduki'rathu, naankaiyum athu thaangkamaattaathu.
arasaa'luki'ra adimaiyinimiththamum, poajanaththaal thirupthiyaana moodaninimiththamum,
pakaikkappadaththakkava'laayirunthum, purushanukku vaazhkkaippatta sthireeyinimiththamum, than naachchiyaarukkup pathilaaka illaa'laakum adimaippe'n'ninimiththamumea.
poomiyil si'riyavaika'laayirunthum, makaa gnaanamu'l'lavaika'l naanku'ndu.
avaiyaavana: a'rpamaana jenthuvaayirunthum, koadaikaalaththilea thangka'l aakaaraththaich sampaathikki'ra e'rumpum,
saththuvamat'ra jenthuvaayirunthum, thangka'l veettaik kanmalaiyilea thoa'ndivaikkum kuzhimusalka'lum,
raajaa illaathirunthum, pavugnchu pavugnchaayp pu'rappaduki'ra vettukki'lika'lum,
than kaika'linaal valaiyaip pinni, arasar aramanaika'lilirukki'ra silanthip poochchiyumea.
vinoathamaay adivaiththu nadakki'ravaika'l moon'ru'ndu; vinoatha nadaiyu'l'lavaika'l naalumu'ndu.
avaiyaavana: mirukangka'lil savuriyamaanathum on'rukkum pinnidaiyaathathumaakiya singkamum,
poarkkuthiraiyum, ve'l'laattukkadaavum, oruvarum ethirkkakkoodaatha raajaavumea.
nee meattimaiyaanathinaal paiththiyamaay nadanthu, thurchsinthanaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthaayaanaal, kaiyinaal vaayai moodu.
paalaik kadaithal ve'n'neyaip pi'rappikkum; mookkaip pisaithal iraththaththaip pi'rappikkum; appadiyea koapaththaik ki'ndividuthal sa'ndaiyaip pi'rappikkum.
raajaavaakiya leamuvealukkaduththa vasanangka'l; avan thaay avanukkup poathiththa upatheasamaavathu:
en makanea, en karppaththin kumaaranea, en poruththanaika'lin puththiranea,
sthireeka'lukku un pelanaiyum raajaakka'laik kedukkum kaariyangka'lukku un vazhika'laiyum kodaathea.
thiraadcharasam kudippathu raajaakka'lukkuth thakuthiyalla; leamuvealea, athu raajaakka'lukkuth thakuthiyalla; mathupaanam pirapukka'lukkuth thakuthiyalla.
mathupaanampa'n'ninaal avarka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththai ma'ranthu, si'rumaippaduki'ravarka'ludaiya niyaayaththaiyum purattuvaarka'l.
madinthupoaki'ravanukku mathupaanaththaiyum, manangkasanthavarka'lukkuth thiraadcharasaththaiyum kodungka'l;
avan kudiththuth than ku'raivai ma'ranthu, than varuththaththai appu'ram ninaiyaathirukkattum.
oomaiyanukkaakavum thikkat'ravarka'lellaarudaiya niyaayaththukkaakavum un vaayaith thi'ra.
un vaayaith thi'ranthu, neethiyaay niyaayantheerththu, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanukku niyaayagnsey.
ku'nasaaliyaana sthireeyaik ka'ndupidippavan yaar? ava'ludaiya vilai muththukka'laippaarkkilum uyarnthathu.
ava'l purushanudaiya iruthayam ava'lai nampum; avan sampaththuk ku'raiyaathu.
ava'l uyiroadirukki'ra naa'lellaam avanukkuth theemaiyaiyalla, nanmaiyaiyea seyki'raa'l.
aattumayiraiyum sa'nalaiyum theadi, than kaika'linaal u'rchaakaththoadea vealaiseyki'raa'l.
ava'l viyaapaarak kappalka'laippoalirukki'raa'l; thooraththilirunthu than aakaaraththaik ko'nduvaruki'raa'l.
iruttoadea ezhunthu than veettaarukku aakaarangkoduththu, than vealaikkaarika'lukkup padiya'lakki'raa'l.
oru vayalai visaariththu athai vaangkuki'raa'l; than kaika'lin sampaaththiyaththinaal thiraadchaththoattaththai naattuki'raa'l.
thannaip pelaththaal idaikkattikko'ndu, than kaika'laip palappaduththuki'raa'l.
than viyaapaaram pirayoajanamu'l'lathen'ru a'rinthirukki'raa'l; iravilea ava'l vi'lakku a'naiyaathirukkum.
than kaika'lai iraattinaththil vaikki'raa'l; ava'l viralka'l kathiraip pidikkum.
si'rumaiyaanavarka'lukkuth than kaiyaith thi'ranthu, eazhaika'lukkuth than karangka'lai neettuki'raa'l.
than veettaar anaivarukkum irattaippurai uduppirukki'rathaal, than veettaarinimiththam ku'lirukkup payappadaa'l.
iraththinak kampa'langka'laith thanakku u'ndupa'n'nuki'raa'l; melliya pudavaiyum iraththaamparamum ava'l uduppu.
ava'l purushan theasaththu moopparka'loadea niyaayasthalangka'lil udkaarnthirukkaiyil pearpet'ravanaayirukki'raan.
melliya pudavaika'lai u'ndupa'n'ni vi'rki'raa'l; kachchaika'lai varththakaridaththil oppuvikki'raa'l.
ava'l udai palamum alangkaaramumaayirukki'rathu; varungkaalaththaippat'riyum makizhuki'raa'l.
than vaayai gnaanam vi'langkath thi'rakki'raa'l; thayaiyu'l'la poathakam ava'l naavinmeal irukki'rathu.
ava'l soampalin appaththaip pusiyaamal, than veettukkaariyam eppadi nadakki'rathu en'ru ka'n'noakkamaayirukki'raa'l.
ava'l pi'l'laika'l ezhumpi, ava'laip paakkiyavathi enki'raarka'l; ava'l purushanum ava'laippaarththu:
aneakam pe'nka'l ku'nasaalika'laayirunthathu'ndu; neeyoa avarka'l ellaarukkum mea'rpattava'l en'ru ava'laip pukazhuki'raan.
saunthariyam vagnchanaiyu'l'lathu, azhakum vee'n, karththarukkup payappaduki'ra sthireeyea pukazhappaduvaa'l.
ava'l kaika'lin palanai ava'lukkuk kodungka'l; ava'ludaiya seykaika'l vaasalka'lil ava'laip pukazhakkadavathu.
thaaveethin kumaaranum erusaleamin raajaavumaakiya pirasangkiyin vaakkiyangka'l.
maayai, maayai, ellaam maayai en'ru pirasangki solluki'raan.
sooriyanukkuk keezhea manushan paduki'ra ellaap pirayaasaththinaalum avanukkup palan enna?
oru santhathi poaki'rathu, ma'ru santhathi varuki'rathu; poomiyoa en'raikkum nilaiththirukki'rathu.
sooriyan uthikki'rathu, sooriyan asthamikki'rathu; thaan uthiththa idaththi'rkea athu thirumpavum theevirikki'rathu.
kaat'ru the'rkea poay, vadakkeayugnsut'ri, suzhan'ru suzhan'ru adiththu, thaan sut'rina idaththukkea thirumpavum varum.
ellaa nathika'lum samuththiraththilea oadi vizhunthum samuththiram nirampaathu; thaangka'l u'rpaththiyaana idaththi'rkea nathika'l ma'rupadiyum thirumpum.
ellaam varuththaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; athu manusharaal sollimudiyaathu; kaa'nki'rathinaal ka'n thirupthiyaaki'rathillai, keadki'rathinaal sevi nirappappaduki'rathumillai.
mun irunthathea inimealum irukkum; mun seyyappattathea pinnum seyyappadum; sooriyanukkuk keezhea noothanamaanathu on'rumillai.
ithaip paar, ithu noothanam en'ru sollappadaththakka kaariyam on'ru'ndoa? athu namakku munnu'l'la poorvakaalangka'lilum irunthathea.
mun irunthavaika'laippat'ri gnaapakam illai; appadiyea pinvarum kaariyangka'laippat'riyum inimealiruppavarka'lukku gnaapakam iraathu.
pirasangkiyaakiya naan erusaleamil isravealarukku raajaavaayirunthean.

vaanaththinkeezh nadappathaiyellaam gnaanamaay visaariththu aaraaychchi seyki'ratha'rku en manathaip pirayoakampa'n'ninean; manupuththirar inthak kadunthollaiyil adipadumpadikkuth theavan athai avarka'lukku niyamiththirukki'raar.
sooriyanukkuk keezhea seyyappaduki'ra kaariyangka'laiyellaam kavaniththup paarththean; ithoa, ellaam maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirukki'rathu.
koa'nalaanathai nearaakkakkoodaathu; ku'raivaanathai e'n'nimudiyaathu.

ithoa, naan periyavanaayirunthu, enakkumun erusaleamiliruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum gnaanamadainthu thea'rinean; en manam mikuntha gnaanaththaiyum a'rivaiyum ka'nda'rinthathu en'ru naan en u'l'laththilea sollikko'ndean.
gnaanaththai a'riki'ratha'rkum, paiththiyaththaiyum mathiyeenaththaiyum a'riki'ratha'rkum, naan en manathaip pirayoakampa'n'ninean; ithuvum manathukkuch sagnchalamaayirukki'rathen'ru ka'ndean.
athika gnaanaththilea athika salippu'ndu; a'rivuperuththavan noavuperuththavan.
naan en u'l'laththilea sollikko'ndathu ennaven'raal: vaa, ippozhuthu unnaich santhoashaththinaalea soathiththuppaarppean, inpaththai anupavi en'rean; ithoa, ithuvum maayaiyaayirunthathu.
nakaippaikku'riththu, athu paiththiyam en'rum, santhoashaththaikku'riththu, athu enna seyyum? en'rum sonnean.

vaanaththinkeezh manupuththirar uyiroadirukkum naa'la'lavum pet'ru anupavikkaththakkathu innathen'ru a'riyumporuttu, en iruthayaththai gnaanaththaal theat'rikko'ndirukkumpoathea, naan en theakaththai mathupaanaththaal seeraattikko'ndirukkavum, mathiyeenaththaip pat'rikko'ndirukkavum en u'l'laththil vakaitheadinean.
naan periya vealaika'laich seythean; enakkaaka veeduka'laik kattinean, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattinean.
enakkaakath thoattangka'laiyum singkaaravanangka'laiyum u'ndaakki, avaika'lil sakalavakaik kanivirudchangka'laiyum naattinean.
marangka'l payiraakum thoappukku neerppaaychchuki'ratha'rkuk ku'langka'lai u'ndupa'n'ninean.

vealaikkaararaiyum vealaikkaarika'laiyum sampaathiththean; veettilum vealaikkaarar pi'ranthaarka'l; enakkumun erusaleamiliruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum aadumaadu muthalaana thira'nda aasthika'l enakku irunthathu.

ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum, raajasampaththaiyum maakaa'nangka'lilu'l'la poru'lka'laiyum seakariththean; sangkeethakkaararaiyum sangkeethakkaarika'laiyum, manupuththirarukku inpamaana palavitha vaaththiyangka'laiyum sampaathiththean.
enakkumun erusaleamiliruntha ellaaraippaarkkilum naan periyavanum thiraviya sampannanumaanean; en gnaanamum ennoadeakooda irunthathu.

en ka'nka'l ichchiththavaika'lil on'raiyum naan avaika'lukkuth thadaipa'n'navillai; en iruthayaththukku oru santhoashaththaiyum naan vea'ndaamen'ru vilakkavillai; naan seytha muya'rchika'lilellaam en manam makizhchchiko'ndirunthathu; ithuvea en pirayaasangka'l ellaavat'rinaalum enakku vantha palan.

en kaika'l seytha sakala vealaika'laiyum, naan patta ellaap pirayaasaththaiyum ka'n'noakkip paarththean; ithoa, ellaam maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirunthathu; sooriyanukkuk keezhea palan on'rumillai.
pinpu naan, gnaanamaanathu enna en'rum, paiththiyamum mathiyeenamum enna en'rum paarththu a'riyumpadi thirumpinean; raajaavukkup pinvarum manushan enna seyyakkoodum? seythathaiyea seyvaan.
iru'laippaarkkilum ve'lichcham evva'lavu uththamamoa, avva'lavaay mathiyeenaththaippaarkkilum gnaanam uththamamen'ru ka'ndean.
gnaaniyin ka'nka'l avan mukaththilea irukki'rathu; moodanoa iru'lilea nadakki'raan; aakilum avarka'lellaarukkum oreavithamaaych sampavikki'rathu en'ru ka'ndean.
moodanukkuch sampavikki'rathupoala enakkum sampavikki'rathea; appadiyirukka naan athika gnaanamadainthathinaal kaariyamenna en'ru sinthiththean; ithuvum maayai en'ru en u'l'laththil e'n'ninean.
moodan en'raalum gnaaniyen'raalum en'raikkum ninaivil iruppathillai; ippozhuthu irukki'rathellaam varungkaalaththil ma'rakkappattuppoam; moodan eppadich saaki'raanoa appadiyea gnaaniyum saaki'raan.
aakaiyaal intha jeevanai ve'ruththean; sooriyanukkukkeezhea seyyappadum kiriyaiyellaam enakku visanamaayirunthathu; ellaam maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirukki'rathu.
sooriyanukkukkeezhea naan patta pirayaasaththaiyellaam ve'ruththean; enakkup pinvarappoaki'ravanukku athai naan vaiththuppoakavea'ndiyathaakumea.

avan puththimaanaayiruppaanoa, moodanaayiruppaanoa, athai yaar a'rivaar? aakilum sooriyanukkukkeezhea naan pirayaasappattu gnaanamaaych sampaathiththa sakala vasthukka'linpearilum avan athikaariyaavaan; ithuvum maayaiyea.
aakaiyaal sooriyanukkukkeezhea naan patta ellaap pirayaasaththinmealumu'l'la aasaiyai vittuvida vakaipaarththean.

oruvan puththi, yukthi, nithaanaththoadu pirayaasappaduki'raan; aakilum appadip pirayaasappadaathiruntha vea'roruvanukku avan athaich sonthamaaka vittuvidavea'ndiyathaakum; ithuvum maayaiyum periya theengkumaay irukki'rathu.
manushan sooriyanukkukkeezhea paduki'ra ellaap pirayaasaththinaalum avanudaiya iruthayaththin e'n'nangka'linaalum avanukkup palan enna?
avan naadka'lellaam aluppu'l'lathu, avan vealaika'l varuththamu'l'lathu; iraaththiriyilum avan manathukku i'laippaa'ruthalillai; ithuvum maayaiyea.
manushan pusiththuk kudiththu, than pirayaasaththin palanai anupavippathaippaarkkilum, avanukku oru nanmaiyum illai; ithuvum theavanudaiya karaththilirunthu varuki'rathu en'ru naan ka'ndean.
ennaippaarkkilum sampiramamaaych saappidaththakkavan yaar? ennaippaarkkilum thurithamaaych sampaathikkaththakkavan yaar?

theavan thamathu paarvaikku nallavanaayirukki'ravanukku gnaanaththaiyum a'rivaiyum inpaththaiyum a'likki'raar; paavagnseyki'ravanukkoa thamathu paarvaikku nallavanaayirukki'ravan vasamaay vaiththuvittup poakumporuttuch searththuk kuviththuvaikkum thollaiyai avar niyamiththirukki'raar; ithuvum maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirukki'rathu.
ovvon'ri'rkum ovvoru kaalamu'ndu; vaanaththin keezhirukki'ra ovvoru kaariyaththukkum ovvoru samayamu'ndu.
pi'rakka oru kaalamu'ndu, i'rakka oru kaalamu'ndu; nada oru kaalamu'ndu, nattathaip pidungka oru kaalamu'ndu;
kolla oru kaalamu'ndu, ku'namaakka oru kaalamu'ndu; idikka oru kaalamu'ndu, katta oru kaalamu'ndu;
azha oru kaalamu'ndu, nakaikka oru kaalamu'ndu; pulampa oru kaalamu'ndu, nadanampa'n'na oru kaalamu'ndu;
ka'rka'lai e'rinthuvida oru kaalamu'ndu, ka'rka'laich searkka oru kaalamu'ndu; thazhuva oru kaalamu'ndu, thazhuvaamalirukka oru kaalamu'ndu;
theada oru kaalamu'ndu, izhakka oru kaalamu'ndu; kaappaat'ra oru kaalamu'ndu, e'rinthuvida oru kaalamu'ndu;
kizhikka oru kaalamu'ndu, thaikka oru kaalamu'ndu; mavunamaayirukka oru kaalamu'ndu, peasa oru kaalamu'ndu;
sineakikka oru kaalamu'ndu, pakaikka oru kaalamu'ndu; yuththampa'n'na oru kaalamu'ndu, samaathaanampa'n'na oru kaalamu'ndu.
varuththappattup pirayaasappaduki'ravanukku athinaal palan enna?
manupuththirar paadupadumpadi theavan avarka'lukku niyamiththa thollaiyaik ka'ndean.

avar sakalaththaiyum athinathin kaalaththilea nearththiyaakach seythirukki'raar; ulakaththaiyum avarka'l u'l'laththilea vaiththirukki'raar; aathalaal theavan aathimuthal anthammattum seythuvarum kiriyaiyai manushan ka'ndupidiyaan.
makizhchchiyaayiruppathum, uyiroadirukkaiyil nanmaiseyvathumeayallaamal, vea'roru nanmaiyum manushanukku illaiyen'ru a'rinthean.
an'riyum manushar yaavarum pusiththuk kudiththuth thangka'l sakalap pirayaasaththin palanaiyum anupavippathu theavanudaiya anukkirakam.

theavan seyvathu ethuvoa athu en'raikkum nilaikkum en'ru a'rivean; athinoadea on'rum koottavungkoodaathu, athilirunthu on'rum ku'raikkavungkoodaathu; manushar thamathu samukaththil payanthirukkumpadi theavan ippadich seythuvaruki'raar.
mun nadanthathea ippozhuthum nadakki'rathu; ini nadakkappoaki'rathum munnamea nadanthathu; nadanthathaiyoa theavan visaarippaar.
pinnum sooriyanukkuk keezhea naan niyaayasthalaththaik ka'ndean, angkea aniyaayam irunthathu; neethisthalaththaiyum ka'ndean, angkea aneethi irunthathu.
sakala e'n'nangka'laiyum sakala seykaika'laiyum niyaayantheerkkungkaalam ini irukki'rapadiyaal sanmaarkkanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum theavan niyaayantheerppaar en'ru en u'l'laththil e'n'ninean.

manupuththirar thaangka'l mirukangka'laippoal irukki'raarka'lenpathai avarka'l kaa'numpadikku theavan avarka'laich soathikki'raaren'ru naan manusharudaiya nilaimaiyaikku'riththu en u'l'laththil e'n'ninean.

manupuththirarukkuch sampavikki'rathu mirukangka'lukkum sampavikkum; avarka'lukkum ivaika'lukkum eaka sampavamu'ndu; ivaika'l saaki'rathupoalavea avarka'lum saaki'raarka'l; jeevanka'lukkellaam suvaasam on'rea; mirukaththaippaarkkilum manushan meanmaiyu'l'lavan alla; ellaam maayaiyea.
ellaam orea idaththukkup poaki'rathu; ellaam ma'n'nilea u'ndaaki'rathu, ellaam ma'n'nukkuth thirumpuki'rathu.
uyara ea'rum manushanudaiya aaviyaiyum, thaazhap poomiyili'rangkum mirukangka'ludaiya aaviyaiyum a'riki'ravan yaar?

ippadiyirukki'rapadiyaal, manushan than seykaika'lil makizhchchiyaayirukkum nanmaiyaiyeayallaamal, vea'rea nanmai illaiyen'ru ka'ndean; ithuvea avan pangku; thanakkup pinvarum kaariyangka'laik kaa'numpadikku avanaith thirumpivarappa'n'nuki'ravan yaar?

itha'rkuppinpu naan sooriyanukkukkeezhea seyyappadum kodumaika'laiyellaam sinthiththuppaarththean; ithoa, odukkappattavarka'lin ka'n'neeraik ka'ndean, avarka'laith theat'ruvaarillai; odukkuki'ravarka'l padchaththil pelam irunthathu, appadiyirunthum theat'ruvaarillai.
aathalaal innum uyiroadirunthu pizhaikki'ravarka'laippaarkkilum munnamea kaalagnsen'ru mariththavarka'laiyea paakkiyavaanka'l en'rean.
ivviruthi'raththaarudaiya nilaimaiyaippaarkkilum innum pi'ravaathavanudaiya nilaimaiyea vaasi; avan sooriyanukkuk keezhea seyyappadum thurchseykaika'laik kaa'navillaiyea.
manushan padum ellaap pirayaasamum, payanpadum ellaak kiriyaiyum, ayalaanudaiya po'raamaikku eathuvaayirukki'rathai naan ka'ndean; ithuvum maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirukki'rathu.
moodan than kaika'laik kattikko'ndu, than sathaiyaiyea thinki'raan.
varuththaththoadum manachsagnchalaththoadum ira'ndu kaippidiyum ni'raiyakko'ndiruppathaippaarkkilum, amaichchaloadu oru kaippidi ni'raiyak ko'ndiruppathea nalam.
pinpu naan thirumpikko'ndu sooriyanukkuk keezhea maayaiyaana vea'roru kaariyaththaik ka'ndean.

oruvan o'ndikkaaranaayirukki'raan; avanukku udanaa'liyumillai, avanukkup pi'l'laiyum sakoatharanumillai; appadiyirunthum avan padum pirayaasaththukku mudivillai; avan ka'n aisuvariyaththaal thirupthiyaaki'rathumillai; naan oru nanmaiyaiyum anupaviyaamal yaarukkaakap pirayaasappaduki'rean en'ru avan sinthikki'rathumillai; ithuvum maayai, theeraatha thollai.
o'ndiyaayiruppathilum iruvar koodiyiruppathu nalam; avarka'ludaiya pirayaasaththinaal avarka'lukku nalla palanu'ndaakum.
oruvan vizhunthaal avan udanaa'li avanaith thookkividuvaan; o'ndiyaayirunthu vizhuki'ravanukku aiyoa, avanaith thookkividath thu'naiyillaiyea.
ira'ndupearaayp paduththukko'ndirunthaal avarka'lukkuch soodu'ndaakum; o'ndiyaayirukki'ravanukkuch soodu'ndaavathu eppadi?
oruvanai yaathaamoruvan mea'rko'l'la vanthaal iruvarum avanukku ethirththuni'rkalaam; muppurinool seekkiramaay a'raathu.
ini aaloasanaiyaik kea'laatha kizhavanum moodanumaakiya raajaavaippaarkkilum, eazhaiyum gnaaniyumaakiya i'laignanea vaasi.
arasaa'lach si'raichchaalaiyilirunthu pu'rappaduvaarumu'ndu; raajaangkaththil pi'ranthu eazhaiyaavaarumu'ndu.
sooriyanukkukkeezhea jeevanu'l'loar yaavarum raajaavin pattaththi'rku varappoaki'ra pi'l'laiyin padchaththil saarnthiruppathaik ka'ndean.
avarka'lukkumun appadich seytha janangka'lin ilakkaththi'rku mudivillai; ini iruppavarka'l ivanmealum piriyam vaikkaama'rpoavaarka'l; ithuvum maayaiyum, manathukkuch sagnchalamumaayirukki'rathu.

nee theavaalayaththukkup poakumpoathu un nadaiyaik kaaththukko'l; moodar paliyiduvathupoalap paliyiduvathaippaarkkilum sevikodukkach searvathea nalam. thaangka'l seyki'rathu theemaiyen'ru a'riyaathirukki'raarka'l.

theavasamukaththil nee thu'nikaramaay un vaayinaal peasaamalum, manampatha'ri oru vaarththaiyaiyum sollaamalum iru; theavan vaanaththilirukki'raar; nee poomiyilirukki'raay, aathalaal un vaarththaika'l surukkamaayiruppathaaka.
thollaiyin thiradchiyinaal soppanam pi'rakki'rathupoala, vaarththaika'lin thiradchiyinaal moodanudaiya saththam pi'rakkum.
nee theavanukku oru poruththanai pa'n'nikko'ndaal, athaich seluththath thaamathiyaathea; avar moodaril piriyappaduki'rathillai; nee nearnthuko'ndathaich sey.
nee nearnthuko'ndathaich seyyaama'rpoavathaippaarkkilum, nearnthuko'l'laathiruppathea nalam.

un maamsaththaip paavaththukku'l'laakka un vaaykku idangkodaathea; athu puththipisakinaal seythathu en'ru thoothanukkumun sollaathea; theavan un vaarththaika'linaalea koapangko'ndu, un kaika'lin kiriyaiyai azhippaanean?
aneaka soppanangka'l maayaiyaayiruppathupoala, aneaka vaarththaika'lum viyarththamaayirukkum; aakaiyaal nee theavanukkup payanthiru.

oru theasaththil eazhaika'l odukkappaduki'rathaiyum, niyaayamum neethiyum purattappaduki'rathaiyum nee kaa'npaayaanaal, athaikku'riththu aachchariyappadaathea; uyarnthavanmeal uyarnthavan kaavalaa'liyaayirukki'raan; avarka'lmeal uyarnthavarum oruvaru'ndu.
poomiyil vi'laiyum palan yaavarukkumuriyathu; raajaavum vayalin palanaal aatharikkappaduki'raan.
pa'nappiriyan pa'naththinaal thirupthiyadaivathillai; selvappiriyan selvapperukkinaal thirupthiyadaivathillai; ithuvum maayaiyea.
poru'l perukinaal athaith thinki'ravarka'lum perukuki'raarka'l; athai udaiyavarka'l thangka'l ka'nka'linaal athaik kaa'npatheayan'ri avarka'lukkup pirayoajanam enna?
vealaiseyki'ravan kognchamaayp pusiththaalum athikamaayp pusiththaalum avan niththirai inpamaayirukkum; selvanudaiya perukkoa avanaith thoongkavottaathu.
sooriyanukkuk keezhea naan ka'nda vea'roru kodiya theengkumu'ndu; athaavathu, aisuvariyamaanathu athai udaiyavarka'lukkea keadu'ndaakumpadi seakariththu vaikkappaduvathaam.
antha aisuvariyam vikkinaththaal azhinthupoaki'rathu; avan oru puththiranaip pe'ruki'raan, avan kaiyil yaathon'rum illai.

than thaayin karppaththilirunthu nirvaa'niyaay vanthaan; vanthathupoalavea nirvaa'niyaayth thirumpappoavaan; avan than pirayaasaththinaal u'ndaana palanon'raiyum than kaiyilea eduththukko'ndupoavathillai.
avan vanthapirakaaramea poaki'raan, ithuvum kodumaiyaana theengku; avan kaat'rukkup pirayaasappattathinaal avanukku laapam enna?
avan than naadka'lilellaam iru'lilea pusiththu, mikavum saliththu, noayum thunpamum adaiki'raan.

ithoa, uyiroadirukkumpadi theavan aru'lichseytha naa'lellaam manushan pusiththuk kudiththu, sooriyanukkuk keezhea thaan padum pirayaasam anaiththin palanaiyum anupavippathea nalamum uththamumaana kaariyamen'ru naan ka'ndean, ithuvea avan pangku.

theavan aisuvariyaththaiyum sampaththaiyum evanukkuk koduththirukki'raaroa, avan athilea pusikkavum, than pangkaip pe'ravum, than pirayaasaththilea makizhchchiyaayirukkavum avanukku athikaaram a'lippathu theavanudaiya anukkirakam.
avanudaiya iruthayaththilea makizhumpadi theavan avanukku anukkirakam pa'n'nuki'rapadiyinaal, avan than jeevanu'l'la naadka'lai athikamaay ninaiyaan.
sooriyanukkuk keezhea naan ka'nda vea'roru theengkumu'ndu; athu manusharukku'l'lea perumpaalum nadanthuvaruki'rathu.

athaavathu, oruvanukkuth theavan selvaththaiyum sampaththaiyum kanaththaiyum kodukki'raar; avan enna ichchiththaalum athellaam avanukkuk ku'raivillaamal kidaikkum; aanaalum avaika'lai anupavikkum sakthiyaith theavan avanukkuk kodukkavillai; anniya manushan athai anupavikki'raan; ithuvum maayaiyum, kodiya noayumaanathu.

oruvan noo'ru pi'l'laika'laip pet'ru, aneakam varusham jeeviththu, theerkkaayusai adainthirunthaalum, avan aaththumaa anthach selvaththaal thirupthiyadaiyaamalum, avanukkup pireathakkalla'rai muthalaay illaamalum poakumaanaal, avanaippaarkkilum karuvazhintha pi'ndam vaasi enki'rean.
athu maayaiyaayth thoan'ri iru'lilea ma'rainthupoayviduki'rathu; athin pear anthakaaraththaal moodappadum.
athu sooriyanaik ka'ndathumillai, on'raiyum a'rinthathumillai; avanukku illaatha amaichchal atha'rku u'ndu.
avan ira'ndaayiram varusham pizhaiththirunthaalum oru nanmaiyaiyum kaa'npathillai; ellaarum orea idaththukkup poaki'raarka'l allavaa?
manushan padum pirayaasamellaam avan vaaykkaakaththaanea; avan manathukkoa thirupthiyillai.
ippadiyirukka, moodanaippaarkkilum gnaanikku u'ndaakum meanmai enna? jeevanu'l'loarukku munpaaka nadanthuko'l'lumpadi a'rintha eazhaikkum u'ndaakum meanmai enna?
aasaiyaanathu alainthutheaduki'rathaip paarkkilum ka'n ka'ndathea nalam; ithuvum maayaiyum, manathaich sagnchalappaduththuki'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
irukki'ravan evanum thoan'rumunnamea pearidappattirukki'raan; avan manushanen'ru therinthirukki'rathu; thannilum palaththavaroadea poaraada avanaal koodaathu.
maayaiyaip perukappa'n'nuki'ra aneaka viseashangka'l u'ndaayirukki'rapadiyaal athinaalea manusharukkup pirayoajanamenna?

nizhalaippoan'ra maayaiyaana than jeevakaalaththaip poakkum manushanukku intha jeevanil nanmai innathen'ru a'rinthavan yaar? thanakkuppinpu sooriyanukkuk keezhea sampavikkungkaariyam innathen'ru manushanukku a'rivippavan yaar?
parima'lathailaththaippaarkkilum na'rkeerththiyum, oruvanudaiya janananaa'laippaarkkilum mara'nanaa'lum nallathu.
virunthuveettukkup poavathilum thukkaveettukkup poavathu nalam; ithilea ellaa manusharin mudivum kaa'nappadum; uyiroadirukki'ravan ithaith than manathilea sinthippaan.
nakaippaip paarkkilum thukkippu nalam; mukathukkaththinaalea iruthayam seerppadum.
gnaanika'lin iruthayam thukkaveettilea irukkum; moodarin iruthayam ka'lippuveettilea irukkum.
oruvan moodarin paattaik keadpathilum, gnaaniyin kadinthuko'l'luthalaik keadpathu nalam.
moodanin nakaippu paanaiyinkeezh eriki'ra mu'l'luka'lin padapadappaippoalirukkum; ithuvum maayaiyea.
idukka'naanathu gnaaniyaiyum paiththiyakkaaranaakkum; parithaanam iruthayaththaik kedukkum.
oru kaariyaththin thuvakkaththaippaarkkilum athin mudivu nallathu; perumaiyu'l'lavanaippaarkkilum po'rumaiyu'l'lavan uththaman.
un manathil seekkiramaayk koapangko'l'laathea; moodarin negnchilea koapam kudiko'l'lum.
innaadka'laippaarkkilum munnaadka'l nalamaayirunthathu en'ru sollaathea; nee ithaikku'riththuk keadpathu gnaanamalla.
suthantharaththoadea gnaanam nallathu; sooriyanaik kaa'nki'ravarka'lukku ithinaalea pirayoajanamu'ndu.
gnaanam keadakam, thiraviyamum keadakam; gnaanam thannai udaiyavarka'lukku jeevanaith tharum; ithuvea a'rivin meanmai.
theavanudaiya seyalaik kavaniththuppaar; avar koa'nalaakkinathai nearmaiyaakkaththakkavan yaar?

vaazhvukaalaththil nanmaiyai anupaviththiru, thaazhvukaalaththil sinthanaisey; manushan thanakkuppin varuvathon'raiyum ka'ndupidiyaathapadikkuth theavan ivvira'ndaiyum on'rukkon'ru ethiridaiyaaka vaiththirukki'raar.
ivai ellaavat'raiyum en maayaiyin naadka'lil ka'ndean; than neethiyilea kettuppoaki'ra neethimaanumu'ndu, than paavaththilea neediththirukki'ra paaviyumu'ndu.
mignchina neethimaanaayiraathea, unnai athika gnaaniyumaakkaathea; unnai nee ean keduththukko'l'lavea'ndum?
mignchina thushdanaayiraathea, athika peathaiyumaayiraathea; un kaalaththukkumunnea nee ean saakavea'ndum?
nee ithaip pat'rikko'lvathum athaik kaividaathiruppathum nalam; theavanukkup payappaduki'ravan ivaika'l ellaavat'rinin'rum kaakkappaduvaan.
nakaraththilu'l'la paththu athipathika'laippaarkkilum, gnaanam gnaaniyai athika pelavaanaakkum.
oru paavamum seyyaamal, nanmaiyea seyyaththakka neethimaan poomiyilillai.
sollappadum ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum kavaniyaathea; kavaniththaal un vealaikkaaran unnai ninthippathaik kea'lvippadavea'ndiyathaakum.
aneakantharam neeyum pi'rarai ninthiththaayen'ru, un manathukkuth theriyumea.
ivai ellaavat'raiyum gnaanaththinaal soathiththuppaarththean: naan gnaanavaanaavean en'rean, athu enakkuth thooramaayit'ru.
thooramum makaa aazhamumaayirukki'rathaik ka'ndadaiki'ravan yaar?
gnaanaththaiyum, kaara'nakaariyaththaiyum visaariththu aaraaynthu a'riyavum, mathikeattin aakaamiyaththaiyum puththimayakkaththin paiththiyaththaiyum a'riyavum en manathaich seluththinean.

ka'n'nika'lum valaika'lumaakiya negnchamum, kayi'ruka'lumaakiya kaika'lumudaiya sthireeyaanava'l, saavilum athika kasappu'l'lava'len'ru ka'ndean; theavanukku munpaakach sa'rku'nanaayirukki'ravan ava'lukkuth thappuvaan; paaviyoa ava'laal pidipaduvaan.
kaariyaththai a'riyumpadikku ovvon'raay visaara'naipa'n'ni, ithoa, ithaik ka'ndupidiththean en'ru pirasangki solluki'raan:
en manam innum on'raith theaduki'rathu, athai naan ka'ndupidikkavillai; aayirampearukku'l'lea oru purushanaik ka'ndean; ivarka'lellaarukku'l'lum oru sthireeyai naan kaa'navillai.
ithoa, theavan manushanaich semmaiyaanavanaaka u'ndaakkinaar; avarka'loa aneaka upaayathanthirangka'laith theadikko'ndaarka'l; ithaimaaththiram ka'ndean.
gnaanamu'l'lavanukku oppaanavan yaar? kaariyaththin thaa'rpariyaththai a'rinthavan yaar? manushanudaiya gnaanam avan mukaththaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num, avan mukaththin moorkkam maa'rum.
raajaavin katta'laiyaik kaikko'ndu nada en'ru naan unakku echcharikki'rean; nee theavanukku itta aa'naiyinpadiyea ithaich sey.
nee avan samukaththai vittuvilakath thurithappadaathea; pollaatha kaariyaththilea pidivaathamaay nillaathea; avan thanakku ishdamaanathellaam seyvaan.
raajaavin vaarththai engkeayoa angkea athikaaram u'ndu; neer enna seyki'reer en'ru avanukkuch sollaththakkavan yaar?
ka'rpanaiyaik kaikko'l'luki'ravan oru theengkaiyum a'riyaan; gnaaniyin iruthayam kaalaththaiyum niyaayaththaiyum a'riyum.
ellaak kaariyaththukkum kaalamum niyaayamumu'ndu; aathalaal manushanukku nearidum sagnchalam mikuthi.
innathu sampavikkum en'ru avan a'riyaanea; athu innavithamaaych sampavikkum en'ru avanukkuch sollaththakkavan yaar?

aaviyai vidaathirukki'ratha'rku aaviyinmeal oru manushanukkum athikaaramillai; mara'nanaa'linmealum avanukku athikaaramillai; anthap poarukku neengkippoavathumillai; thunmaarkkaraith thunmaarkkam viduvikkavumaattaathu.
ivaiyellaavat'raiyum naan paarththu, sooriyanukkuk keezhea seyyappadum ellaak kiriyaika'laiyum sinthiththean; oru manushan thanakkea keadu'ndaaka vea'roru manushanai aa'luki'ra kaalamumu'ndu.
parisuththa sthalaththukkup poakkuvaravu seytha thunmaarkkar adakkampa'n'nappattathaik ka'ndean; avarka'l appadi seythuvantha patta'naththileayea ma'rakkappattuppoanaarka'l; ithuvum maayaiyea.
thurkkiriyaikkuththakka tha'ndanai seekkiramaay nadavaathapadiyaal, manupuththirarin iruthayam pollaappaich seyya avarka'lukku'l'lea thu'nikarangko'ndirukki'rathu.
paavi noo'rutharam pollaappaich seythu neediththu vaazhnthaalum enna? theavanukku agnchi, avarukku munpaakap payanthiruppavarka'lea nan'raayiruppaarka'l en'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
thunmaarkkanoa nan'raayiruppathillai; avan theavanukku munpaakap payappadaathirukki'rapadiyaal, nizhalaippoalirukki'ra avanudaiya vaazhnaa'l neediththiruppathumillai.

poomiyinmeal nadakki'ra vea'roru maayaiyaana kaariyamumu'ndu; athaavathu, thunmaarkkarin kiriyaikku varuvathupoala, neethimaanka'lukkum varum; neethimaanka'lin kiriyaikku varuvathupoala, thunmaarkkarukkum varum; ithuvum maayai en'rean.

aakaiyaal naan ka'lippaip pukazhnthean; pusippathum kudippathum makizhvathumeayallaamal sooriyanukkukkeezhea manushanukku vea'roru nanmaiyum illai; sooriyanukkukkeezhea theavan avanukkuth thantha jeevakaalaththil avan pirayaasaththinaal avanukku nilaikkum palan ithuvea.
naan gnaanaththai a'riyavum, manushan iravum pakalum ka'n'nu'rakkamillaamal poomiyilea seyyum vealaika'laip paarkkavum en manathaich seluththinapoathu,

theavan seyyum sakala kiriyaika'laiyum naan kavaniththuppaarththu, sooriyanukkukkeezhea seyyappadum kiriyaiyai manushan ka'ndupidikkakkoodaathen'ru ka'ndean. athai a'riyumpadi manushan pirayaasappattaalum a'riyamaattaan; athai a'riyalaam en'ru gnaani e'n'ninaalum avanum athai a'rinthuko'l'lamaattaan.

ivai ellaavat'raiyum naan en manathilea vakaiya'rukkumpadikkuch sinthiththean; neethimaanka'lum gnaanika'lum, thangka'l kiriyaika'ludan, theavanudaiya kaivasamaayirukki'raarka'l; thanakkumun irukki'ravarka'laikko'ndu oruvanum viruppaiyaavathu ve'ruppaiyaavathu a'riyaan.

ellaarukkum ellaam oreavithamaaych sampavikkum; sanmaarkkanukkum thunmaarkkanukkum, na'rku'namum suththamumu'l'lavanukkum suththamillaathavanukkum, paliyiduki'ravanukkum paliyidaathavanukkum, oreavithamaaych sampavikkum; nallavanukku eppadiyoa pollaathavanukkum appadiyea; aa'naiyiduki'ravanukkum aa'naiyidap payappaduki'ravanukkum samamaaych sampavikkum.

ellaarukkum oreavithamaaych sampavikki'rathu sooriyanukkuk keezhea nadakki'rathellaavat'rilum viseashiththa theengkaam; aathalaal manupuththirarin iruthayam theemaiyinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avarka'l uyiroadirukkum naa'la'lavum avarka'l iruthayam paiththiyangko'ndirunthu, pinpu avarka'l seththavarka'lidaththi'rkup poaki'raarka'l.
itha'rku neengkalaayirukki'ravan yaar? uyiroadirukki'ra anaivaridaththilum nampikkaiyu'ndu; seththa singkaththaippaarkkilum uyiru'l'la naay vaasi.
uyiroadirukki'ravarka'l thaangka'l marippathai a'rivaarka'lea, mariththavarka'l on'rum a'riyaarka'l; ini avarka'lukku oru palanumillai, avarka'l pearmuthalaay ma'rakkappattirukki'rathu.
avarka'l sineakamum, avarka'l pakaiyum, avarka'l po'raamaiyum ellaam ozhinthupoayit'ru; sooriyanukkuk keezhea seyyappaduki'rathon'rilum avarka'lukku ini en'raikkum pangkillai.
nee poay, un aakaaraththaich santhoashaththudan pusiththu, un thiraadcharasaththai manamakizhchchiyudan kudi; theavan un kiriyaika'lai angkeekaarampa'n'niyirukki'raar.
un vasthirangka'l eppozhuthum ve'l'laiyaayum, un thalaikku e'n'ney ku'raiyaathathaayum iruppathaaka.

sooriyanukkukkeezhea theavan unakku niyamiththirukki'ra maayaiyaana naadka'lilellaam nee neasikki'ra manaiviyoadea nilaiyillaatha intha jeevavaazhvai anupavi; intha jeevanukkuriya vaazhvilum, nee sooriyanukkukkeezhea paduki'ra pirayaasaththilum pangku ithuvea.
seyyumpadi un kaikku neariduki'rathu ethuvoa, athai un pelaththoadea sey; nee poaki'ra paathaa'laththilea seykaiyum viththaiyum a'rivum gnaanamum illaiyea.

naan thirumpikko'ndu sooriyanukkuk keezhea ka'ndathaavathu: oaduki'ratha'rku veakamu'l'lavarka'lin veakamum, yuththaththukkuch savuriyavaanka'lin savuriyamum poathaathu; pizhaippukku gnaanamu'l'lavarka'lin gnaanamum poathaathu; aisuvariyam adaiki'ratha'rkup puththimaanka'lin puththiyum poathaathu; thayavu adaiki'ratha'rku viththuvaanka'lin a'rivum poathaathu; avarka'lellaarukkum samayamum theavachseyalum nearidavea'ndum.

than kaalaththai manushan a'riyaan; machchangka'l kodiya valaiyil akappaduvathupoalavum, kuruvika'l ka'n'niyil pidipaduvathupoalavum, manupuththirar pollaatha kaalaththilea sadithiyil thangka'lukku nearidum aapaththil akappaduvaarka'l.
sooriyanukkuk keezhea gnaanamu'l'la kaariyaththaiyum ka'ndean; athu en paarvaikkup perithaayth thoan'rit'ru.

oru si'ru patta'nam irunthathu, athilea iruntha kudika'l kogncha manithar; atha'rku viroathamaay oru periya raajaa vanthu, athai va'lainthuko'ndu, atha'rku ethiraakap periya koththa'langka'laik kattinaan.
athilea gnaanamu'l'la oru eazhai manithan irunthaan; avan than gnaanaththinaalea anthap patta'naththai viduviththaan; aanaalum antha eazhai manithanai oruvarum ninaikkavillai.
aakaiyaal eazhaiyin gnaanam asattaipa'n'nappattu, avan vaarththaika'l keadkappadaama'rpoanaalum, pelaththaippaarkkilum gnaanamea uththamam en'rean.
moodarai aa'lum athipathiyin kookkuralaippaarkkilum gnaanika'ludaiya amarikkaiyaana vaarththaika'lea keadkappadaththakkavaika'l.
yuththa aayuthangka'laippaarkkilum gnaanamea nalam; paaviyaana oruvan mikuntha nanmaiyaik keduppaan.
seththa eekka'l thailakkaaranudaiya parima'lathailaththai naa'rik kettuppoakappa'n'num; gnaanaththilum kanaththilum pearpet'ravanaich so'rpa mathiyeenamum appadiyea seyyum.
gnaaniyin iruthayam valathukaiyilum, moodanin iruthayamoa idathukaiyilum irukkum.
moodan vazhiyilea nadakki'rapoathum mathikettavanaayirukki'raan; thaan moodanen'ru avan ellaarukkum solluki'raan.
athipathiyin koapam unmeal ezhumpinaal un sthaanaththai vittu vilakaathea; i'nangkuthal periya kut'rangka'laiyum amarththippoadum.
naan sooriyanukkukkeezhea ka'nda oru theengku'ndu, athu athipathiyinidaththil thoan'rum thappithamea.
moodar makaa uyarntha nilaiyil vaikkappaduki'raarka'l; seemaanka'loa thaazhntha nilaiyil udkaarnthirukki'raarka'l.
vealaikkaarar kuthiraika'lmeal ea'rippoaki'rathaiyum, pirapukka'l vealaikkaararpoal tharaiyilea nadakki'rathaiyum ka'ndean.
padukuzhiyai vettuki'ravan athilea vizhuvaan; adaippaip pidungkuki'ravanaip paampu kadikkum.
kalluka'laip pearkki'ravan avaika'laal kaayappaduvaan; maraththaip pi'lakki'ravan athinaal moasappaduvaan.

iruppu aayutham mazhungkalaayirukka, athai oruvan theettaama'rpoanaal, athikapalaththaip pirayoakampa'n'navea'ndiyathaakum; aakaiyaal oru kaariyaththaich sevvaiyaaych seyvatha'rku gnaanamea pirathaanam.
thadaikattappadaatha paampu kadikkumea, alappuvaayanum atha'rku oppaanavan.
gnaaniyinudaiya vaaymozhika'l thayaiyu'l'lavaika'l; moodanudaiya uthaduka'loa avanaiyea vizhungkum.
avan vaaymozhika'lin thuvakkam mathiyeenamum, avan vaakkin mudivu kodiya paiththiyamumaam.
moodan mikuthiyaayp peasuki'raan, nadakkappoaki'rathu innathen'ru manushan a'riyaan; thanakkuppi'rpaadu sampavikkappoaki'rathai avanukku a'rivippavan yaar?
oorukkup poakum vazhiyai moodan a'riyaathathinaal, avan thollai ovvoruvaraiyum i'laikkappa'n'num.
raajaa si'rupi'l'laiyumaay, pirapukka'l athikaalamea u'nki'ravarka'lumaayirukkappatta theasamea, unakku aiyoa!
raajaa kulamakanumaay, pirapukka'l ve'rikka u'n'naamal pelanko'l'la eat'ravea'laiyil u'nki'ravarka'lumaayirukkappatta theasamea, nee paakkiyamu'l'lathu.
mikuntha soampalinaal mealmachchup pazhuthaakum; kaika'lin nekizhvinaalea veedu ozhukkaakum.
virunthu santhoashaththukken'ru seyyappadum; thiraadcharasam jeevanu'l'loaraik ka'lippaakkum; pa'namoa ellaavat'ri'rkum uthavum.
raajaavai un manathilum ninthiyaathea, aisuvariyavaanai un padukkaiyilum ninthiyaathea; aakaayaththup pa'ravai anthach saththaththaik ko'ndupoakum, settaika'lu'l'lathu anthach seythiyai a'rivikkum.
un aakaaraththaith tha'n'neerka'lmeal poadu; aneaka naadka'lukkup pinpu athin palanaik kaa'npaay.
eazhupearukkum ettupearukkum pangkittukkodu; poomiyinmeal enna aapaththu nearidumoa unakkuth theriyaathu.
meakangka'l ni'rainthirunthaal mazhaiyaip poomiyinmeal pozhiyum; maramaanathu the'rkea vizhunthaalum vadakkea vizhunthaalum, vizhuntha idaththileayea maram kidakkum.
kaat'raik kavanikki'ravan vithaikkamaattaan; meakangka'lai noakkuki'ravan a'rukkamaattaan.
aaviyin vazhi innathen'rum, karppavathiyin vayit'ril elumpuka'l uruvaakum vitham innathen'rum nee a'riyaathirukki'rathupoalavea, ellaavat'raiyum seyki'ra theavanudaiya seyalka'laiyum nee a'riyaay.
kaalaiyilea un vithaiyai vithai; maalaiyilea un kaiyai nekizhavidaathea; athuvoa, ithuvoa, ethu vaaykkumoa en'rum, ira'ndum sariyaayp payanpadumoa en'rum nee a'riyaayea.
ve'lichcham inpamum, sooriyanaik kaa'npathu ka'nka'lukkup piriyamumaamea.
manushan aneaka varusham jeeviththu, avaika'lilellaam makizhchchiyaayirunthaalum, avan iru'lin naadka'laiyum ninaikkavea'ndum; avaika'l aneakamaayirukkum; vanthu sampavippathellaam maayaiyea.

vaalipanea! un i'lamaiyilea santhoashappadu, un vaalipa naadka'lilea un iruthayam unnaip poorippaakkattum; un negnchin vazhika'lilum, un ka'n'nin kaadchika'lilum nada; aanaalum ivaiyellaavat'rinimiththamum theavan unnai niyaayaththilea ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththuvaar en'ru a'ri.
nee un iruthayaththilirunthu sagnchalaththaiyum, un maamsaththilirunthu theengkaiyum neekkippoadu; i'lavayathum vaalipamum maayaiyea.
nee un vaalipappiraayaththilea un sirushdikarai ninai; theengkunaadka'l varaathatha'rkumunnum, enakkup piriyamaanavaika'lalla en'ru nee sollum varushangka'l searaathatha'rkumunnum,
sooriyanum, ve'lichchamum, santhiranum, nadchaththirangka'lum, anthakaarappadaathatha'rkumunnum,

mazhaikkuppin meakangka'l thirumpath thirumpa varaathatha'rkumunnum, veettukkaavalaa'lika'l tha'l'laadi, pelasaalika'l koonippoay, eanthiram araikki'ravarka'l kognchamaanathinaal oaynthu, palaka'nivazhiyaayp paarkki'ravarka'l iru'ndupoaki'ratha'rkumunnum,
eanthira saththam thaazhnthathinaal theruvaasalin kathavuka'l adaipattu, kuruviyin saththaththukkum ezhunthirukkavea'ndiyathaaki, keethavaaththiyak kannikaika'lellaam adangkippoakaathatha'rkumunnum,

meattukkaaka achchamu'ndaaki, vazhiyilea payangka'l thoan'ri, vaathumaimaram pooppooththu, vettukki'liyum paaramaaki, pasiththeepanamum at'ruppoakaathatha'rku munnum, manushan than niththiya veettukkup poaki'rathinaalea, thukkangko'ndaaduki'ravarka'l veethiyilea thiriyaathatha'rkumunnum,
ve'l'likkayi'ru kattuvittu, po'rki'n'ni nasungki, oot'rin arukea saal udainthu, thurava'ndaiyil uru'lai no'rungki,
ivvithamaay ma'n'naanathu thaan munniruntha poomikkuth thirumpi, aavi thannaith thantha theavanidaththi'rku ma'rupadiyum poakaathatha'rkumunnum, avarai un vaalipappiraayaththilea ninai.
maayai maayai, ellaam maayai en'ru pirasangki solluki'raan.
mealum, pirasangki gnaanavaanaayirunthapadiyaal, avan janaththukku a'rivaippoathiththu, kavanamaayk keattaaraaynthu, aneakam neethimozhika'laich searththu ezhuthinaan.
ithamaana vaarththaika'laik ka'ndupidikkap pirasangki vakaitheadinaan; ezhuthina vaakkiyangka'l sevvaiyum saththiyamumaanavaika'l.
gnaanika'lin vaakkiyangka'l thaat'rukkoalka'lpoalavum sangkaththalaivarka'laal a'raiyappatta aa'nika'lpoalavum irukki'rathu; avaika'l orea meayppanaal a'likkappattathu.
en makanea! ivaika'linaalea puththiyadaivaayaaka; aneakam pusthakangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuki'ratha'rku mudivillai; athika padippu udalukku i'laippu.
kaariyaththin kadaiththokaiyaik keadpoamaaka, theavanukkup payanthu, avar ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l; ellaa manusharmealum vizhuntha kadamai ithuvea.
ovvoru kiriyaiyaiyum, antharangkamaana ovvoru kaariyaththaiyum, nanmaiyaanaalum theemaiyaanaalum, theavan niyaayaththilea ko'nduvaruvaar.
saalomoan paadina unnathappaattu.
avar thamathu vaayin muththangka'laal ennai muththamiduvaaraaka: umathu neasam thiraadcharasaththaippaarkkilum inpamaanathu.
umathu parima'lathailangka'l inpamaana vaasanaiyu'l'lavaika'l; umathu naamam oot'ru'nda parima'lathailamaayirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal kanniyarka'l ummai neasikki'raarka'l.

ennai izhuththukko'l'lum, umakkup pinnea oadivaruvoam; raajaa ennaith thamathu a'raika'lil azhaiththukko'nduvanthaar; naangka'l umakku'l ka'likoornthu makizhuvoam; thiraadcharasaththaippaarkkilum umathu neasaththai ninaippoam; uththamarka'l ummai neasikki'raarka'l.
erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! keathaarin koodaarangka'laippoalavum, saalomoanin thiraika'laippoalavum naan ka'ruppaayirunthaalum, azhakaayirukki'rean.

naan ka'ruppaayirukki'rean en'ru paaraatheayungka'l; veyil enmea'rpattathu; en thaayin pi'l'laika'l enmeal koapamaayirunthu, ennaith thiraadchaththoattangka'lukkuk kaava'rkaariyaaka vaiththaarka'l; en sonthath thiraadchaththoattaththaiyoa naan kaakkavillai.

en aaththuma neasarea! umathu manthaiyai engkea meayththu, athai maththiyaanaththil engkea madakkuki'reer? enakkuch sollum; umathu thoazharin manthaika'l arukea alainthuthiriki'rava'laippoala naan irukkavea'ndiyathenna?
sthireeka'lil roopavathiyea! athai nee a'riyaayaakil, manthaiyin kaaladika'laith thodarnthupoay, meaypparka'ludaiya koodaarangka'la'ndaiyil un aattukkuttika'lai meayavidu.
en piriyamea! paarvoanudaiya irathangka'lil poo'ndirukki'ra parika'l pavugnchukku unnai oppiduki'rean.
aapara'naathika'l poo'nda un kannangka'lum, aarangka'l poo'nda un kazhuththum azhakaayirukki'rathu.
ve'l'lip pottuka'lu'l'la pon aapara'nangka'lai unakkup pa'n'nuvoam.
raajaa thamathu panthiyilirukkunthanaiyum ennudaiya na'lathathailam than vaasanaiyai veesum.
en neasar enakku en sthanangka'lin naduvil thangkum ve'l'laippoa'lach se'ndu.
en neasar enakku engkeathi oor thiraadchaththoattangka'lil mu'laikkum maruthoan'rip poongkoththu.
en piriyamea! nee roopavathi; nee roopavathi; un ka'nka'l pu'raakka'nka'l.
neer roopamu'l'lavar; en neasarea! neer inpamaanavar; nammudaiya magncham pasumaiyaanathu.
nammudaiya veettin uththirangka'l keathurumaram, nammudaiya machchu theavathaarumaram.
naan saaroanin roajaavum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lin leelipushpamumaayirukki'rean.
mu'l'luka'lukku'l'lea leelipushpam eppadiyirukki'rathoa, appadiyea kumaaraththika'lukku'l'lea enakkup piriyamaanava'lum irukki'raa'l.

kaattumarangka'lukku'l'lea kichchilimaram eppadiyirukki'rathoa, appadiyea kumaararukku'l'lea en neasar irukki'raar; athin nizhalilea vaagnchaiyaay udkaaruki'rean, athin kani en vaaykku mathuramaayirukki'rathu.
ennai virunthusaalaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar; enmeal pa'rantha avarudaiya kodi neasamea.
thiraadcharasaththaal ennaith theat'rungka'l, kichchilippazhangka'laal ennai aat'rungka'l; neasaththaal soakamadainthirukki'rean.
avar idathukai en thalaiyinkeezh irukki'rathu; avar valathukai ennai a'naiththukko'l'luki'rathu.

erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! enakkup piriyamaanava'lukku manathaakumattum, neengka'l ava'lai vizhikkappa'n'naamalum ezhuppaamalumirukkumpadi ve'limaanka'lmealum ve'liyin maraika'lmealum ungka'lai aa'naiyiduki'rean.
ithu en neasarudaiya saththam! ithoa, avar malaika'lmeal kuthiththum meaduka'lmeal thu'l'liyum varuki'raar.

en neasar ve'limaanukkum maraikkuttikkum oppaayirukki'raar; ithoa, avar engka'l mathilukkup pu'rampea nin'ru, palaka'ni vazhiyaayp paarththu, kiraathiyin vazhiyaayth thamathu malarntha mukaththaik kaa'npikki'raar.
en neasar ennoadea peasi: en piriyamea! en roopavathiyea! ezhunthuvaa.
ithoa, maarikaalam sen'rathu, mazhaipeythu ozhinthathu.
poomiyilea pushpangka'l kaa'nappaduki'rathu; kuruvika'l paadungkaalam vanthathu, kaattuppu'raavin saththam namathu theasaththil keadkappaduki'rathu.
aththimaram kaaykaayththathu; thiraadchakkodika'l pooppooththu vaasanaiyum parima'likki'rathu; en piriyamea! en roopavathiyea! nee ezhunthuvaa.

kanmalaiyin vedippuka'lilum sikarangka'lin ma'raividangka'lilum thangkuki'ra en pu'raavea! un mukaroopaththai enakkuk kaa'npi, un saththaththai naan keadkattum; un saththam inpamum, un mukaroopam azhakumaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
thiraadchaththoattangka'laik kedukki'ra kuzhinarika'laiyum si'runarika'laiyum namakkup pidiyungka'l; nammudaiya thiraadchaththoattangka'l poovum pignchumaayirukki'rathea.
en neasar ennudaiyavar, naan avarudaiyava'l. avar leelipushpangka'lukku'l'lea meayki'raar.
en neasarea! pakal ku'lirchchiyaaki, nizhal saaynthupoakumvaraikkum, neer thirumpi, kun'rum pi'lappumaana kanmalaika'lil kuthiththuvarum kalaimaanukkum maraika'lin kuttikkum samaanamaayirum.
iraakkaalangka'lil en padukkaiyilea en aaththuma neasaraith theadinean; theadiyum naan avaraik kaa'navillai.
naan ezhunthu nakaraththin veethika'lilum therukka'lilum thirinthu, en aaththuma neasaraith theaduvean en'rean; theadiyum naan avaraik kaa'navillai.
nakaraththilea thiriki'ra kaavalaa'lar ennaik ka'ndaarka'l: en aaththuma neasaraik ka'ndeerka'laa en'ru avarka'laik keattean.

naan avarka'lai vittuk kognchathooram kadanthupoanavudanea, en aaththuma neasaraik ka'ndean; avarai naan en thaayin veettilum ennaip pet'rava'lin a'raiyilum ko'nduvanthu vidumattum vidaamal pat'rikko'ndean.

erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! enakkup piriyamaanava'lukku manathaakumattum neengka'l ava'lai vizhikkappa'n'naamalum ezhuppaamalumirukkumpadi, ve'limaanka'lmealum ve'liyin maraika'lmealum ungka'lai aa'naiyiduki'rean.

ve'l'laippoa'laththinaalum saampiraa'niyinaalum varththakarudaiya sakalavitha kanthappodiyinaalum u'ndaakiya vaasanaiyai veesi, thoopasthampangka'laippoal vanaantharaththilirunthu varuki'ra ivar yaar?
