ithoa, saalomoanudaiya magncham; isravealin savuriyavaanka'lil a'rupathu savuriyavaanka'l athaich sut'ri ni'rki'raarka'l.
ivarka'lellaarum pattayam pidiththu, yuththaththukkup pazhakinavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l; iraakkaala payaththinimiththam avanavanudaiya pattayam avanavan araiyilirukki'rathu.
saalomoan raajaa thanakku leepanoanin maraththinaal oru irathaththaip pa'n'nuviththaar.

athin thoo'nka'lai ve'l'liyinaalum, athin thattaip ponninaalum, athin aasanaththai iraththaamparaththinaalum pa'n'nuviththaar; athin udpu'raththilea erusaleamin kumaaraththika'linimiththam neasam ennum samukkaa'lam viriththirunthathu.

seeyoan kumaaraththika'lea! neengka'l pu'rappattuppoay, raajaavaakiya saalomoanin kaliyaa'nanaa'lilum, manamakizhchchiyin naa'lilum, avarudaiya thaayaar avarukkuch soottina mudiyoadirukki'ra avaraip paarungka'l.
nee roopavathi, en piriyamea! nee roopavathi; un mukkaattin naduvea un ka'nka'l pu'raakka'nka'laayirukki'rathu; un koonthal keeleayaath malaiyil thazhaimeayum ve'l'laattu manthaiyaippoalirukki'rathu.
un pa'rka'l, mayir kaththarikkappattapin ku'lippaattappattuk karaiyea'ruki'ravaika'lum, on'raakilum maladaayiraamal ellaam irattaikkuttiyeen'ravaika'lumaana aattumanthaiyaippoalirukki'rathu.
un uthaduka'l sivappunoolukkuch samaanamum, un vaakku inpamumaayirukki'rathu; un mukkaattin naduvea un kannangka'l vediththa maatha'lampazhampoalirukki'rathu.
un kazhuththu, paraakkiramasaalika'lin keadakangka'laakiya aayiram parisaika'l thookkiyirukki'ra aayuthasaalaiyaakkappatta thaaveethin koapurampoalirukki'rathu.
un ira'ndu sthanangka'lum leelipushpangka'lil meayum ve'limaanin irattaikkuttika'lukkuch samaanam.
pakal ku'lirchchiyaaki nizhal saaynthupoakumvaraikkum, naan ve'l'laippoa'lamalaiyilum saampiraa'nimalaiyilum poayiruppean.
en piriyamea! nee poora'na roopavathi; unnil pazhuthon'rumillai.

leepanoanilirunthu ennoadea vaa, en ma'navaa'liyea! leepanoanilirunthu ennoadea vaa. amanaavin kodumudiyilirunthum, seaneer ermoanin kodumudiyilirunthum, singkangka'lin thaaparangka'lilirunthum, sivingkika'lin malaika'lilirunthum keezhea paar.
en iruthayaththaik kavarnthuko'ndaay; en sakoathariyea! en ma'navaa'liyea! un ka'nka'lilon'rinaalum un kazhuththilu'l'la oru sarappa'niyinaalum en iruthayaththaik kavarnthuko'ndaay.

un neasam evva'lavu inpamaayirukki'rathu; en sakoathariyea! en ma'navaa'liyea! thiraadcharasaththaippaarkkilum un neasam evva'lavu mathuramaayirukki'rathu! sakala kanthavarkkangka'laippaarkkilum un parima'lathailangka'l evva'lavu vaasanaiyaayirukki'rathu!
en ma'navaa'liyea! un uthaduka'lilirunthu thean ozhukuki'rathu, un naavinkeezh theanum paalum irukki'rathu, un vasthirangka'lin vaasanai leepanoanin vaasanaikkoppaayirukki'rathu.
en sakoathariyea! en ma'navaa'liyea! nee adaikkappatta thoattamum, ma'raivu kattappatta neeroot'rum, muththirikkappatta ki'na'rumaayirukki'raay.
un thoattam maatha'lagnsedika'lum, arumaiyaana kanimarangka'lum, maruthoan'rich sedika'lum, na'lathachsedika'lum,

na'lathamum, kungkumamum, vasampum, lavangkamum, sakalavitha thoopavarkka marangka'lum, ve'l'laippoa'lachsedika'lum, santhana virudchangka'lum, sakalavitha kanthavarkkachsedika'lumu'l'la singkaaravanamaayirukki'rathu.
thoattangka'lukku neeroot'rum, jeevaththa'n'neerin thuravum, leepanoanilirunthu oadivarum vaaykkaalka'lum u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
vaadaiyea! ezhumpu; then'ralea! vaa; kanthappisinka'l vadiya en thoattaththil veesu; en neasar thammudaiya thoattaththukku vanthu, thamathu arumaiyaana kanika'laip pusippaaraaka.

en sakoathariyea! en ma'navaa'liyea! naan en thoattaththil vanthean, en ve'l'laippoa'laththaiyum en kanthavarkkangka'laiyum searththean; en theankoottai en theanoadu pusiththean; en thiraadcharasaththai en paaloadum kudiththean. sineakitharea! pusiyungka'l; piriyamaanavarka'lea! kudiyungka'l, poorththiyaayk kudiyungka'l.

naan niththiraipa'n'ninean, en ithayamoa vizhiththirunthathu; kathavaith thattuki'ra en neasarin saththaththaik keattean: en sakoathariyea! en piriyamea! en pu'raavea! en uththamiyea! kathavaith thi'ra; en thalai paniyinaalum, en thalaimayir iravil peyyum thoo'ralinaalum nanainthirukki'rathu en'raar.
en vasthiraththaik kazhat'rip poattean; naan eppadi athaith thirumpavum uduppean, en paathangka'laik kazhuvinean, naan eppadi avaika'laith thirumpavum azhukkaakkuvean en'rean.
en neasar thamathu kaiyaik kathavuth thuvaaraththin vazhiyaay neettinaar, appozhuthu en u'l'lam avar nimiththam pongkinathu.
en neasarukkuk kathavaiththi'rakka naan ezhunthean; poottina kaippidika'lmeal en kaika'lilirunthu ve'l'laippoa'lamum, en viralka'lilirunthu vaasanaiyu'l'la ve'l'laippoa'lamum vadinthathu.

en neasarukkuk kathavaith thi'ranthean; en neasaroa illai, poayvittaar; avar sonna vaarththaiyaal, en aaththumaa soarnthupoayit'ru. avaraith theadinean, avaraik kaa'navillai; avaraik kooppittean, avar enakku ma'ruuththaravu kodukkavillai.
nakaraththil thiriki'ra kaavalaa'lar ennaik ka'ndu, ennai adiththu, ennaik kaayappaduththinaarka'l; alangkaththin kaava'rkaarar enmealiruntha en poarvaiyai eduththukko'ndaarka'l.
erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! en neasaraik ka'ndeerka'laanaal, naan neasaththaal soakamadainthirukki'rean en'ru avarukkuch sollumpadi ungka'lai aa'naiyiduki'rean.
sthireeka'lukku'l roopavathiyea! mat'ra neasaraippaarkkilum un neasar ethinaal viseashiththavar? nee ippadi engka'lai aa'naiyida, mat'ra neasaraippaarkkilum un neasar ethinaal viseashiththavar?
en neasar ve'nmaiyum sivappumaanavar; pathinaayirampearka'lil si'ranthavar.
avar thalai thangkamayamaayirukki'rathu; avar thalaimayir suru'l suru'laayum, kaakaththaippoal karumaiyaayumirukki'rathu.
avarudaiya ka'nka'l tha'n'neer ni'raintha nathika'lin oaramaayth thangkum pu'raakka'nka'lukku oppaanavaika'lum, paalil kazhuvappattavaika'lum, nearththiyaayp pathikkappattavaika'lumaayirukki'rathu.

avar kannangka'l kanthavarkkap paaththika'laippoalavum, vaasanaiyu'l'la pushpangka'laippoalavumirukki'rathu; avar uthaduka'l leelipushpangka'laip poan'rathu, vaasanaiyu'l'la ve'l'laippoa'lam athilirunthu vadiki'rathu.
avar karangka'l padikappachchai pathiththa pon va'laiyalka'laippoalirukki'rathu; avar angkam inthiraneela iraththinangka'l izhaiththa pirakaasamaana yaanaith thanthaththaippoalirukki'rathu.
avar kaalka'l pasumpon aathaarangka'linmeal ni'rki'ra ve'l'laikkal thoo'nka'laippoalirukki'rathu; avar roopam leepanoanaippoalavum keathurukka'laippoalavum si'rappaayirukki'rathu.
avar vaay mikavum mathuramaayirukki'rathu; avar mut'rilum azhaku'l'lavar. ivarea en neasar; erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! ivarea en sineakithar.
un neasar engkea poanaar? sthireeka'lil roopavathiyea! un neasar evvidam poayvittaar? unnoadeakooda naangka'lum avaraith theaduvoam.
thoattangka'lil meayavum, leelipushpangka'laik koyyavum, en neasar thamathu thoattaththukkum kanthavarkkap paaththika'lukkum poanaar.
naan en neasarudaiyava'l, en neasar ennudaiyavar; avar leelipushpangka'lukku'l'lea meayki'raar.
en piriyamea! nee thirsaavaippoal saunthariyamum, erusaleamaippoal vadivamum, kodika'l pa'rakkum padaiyaippoal kediyumaanava'l.
un ka'nka'lai ennaivittuth thiruppu, avaika'l ennai ven'rathu; un a'lakapaaram keeleayaath malaiyilea thazhaimeayum ve'l'laattu manthaiyaippoalirukki'rathu.
un pa'rka'l ku'lippaattappattuk karaiyea'ruki'ravaika'lum, on'raanaalum maladaayiraamal irattaik kuttiyeen'ravaika'lumaana aattumanthaiyaippoalirukki'rathu.
un mukkaattin naduvea un kannangka'l vediththa maatha'lampazhampoalirukki'rathu.
raajasthireeka'l a'rupathupearum, ma'rumanaiyaattika'l e'npathupearumu'ndu; kanniyarukkuth thokaiyillai.

en pu'raavoa, en uththamiyoa oruththiyea; ava'l than thaaykku orea pi'l'lai; ava'l thannaip pet'rava'lukku arumaiyaanava'l; kumaaraththika'l ava'laik ka'ndu, ava'lai vaazhththinaarka'l; raajasthireeka'lum ma'rumanaiyaattika'lum ava'laip poat'rinaarka'l.
santhiranaippoal azhakum, sooriyanaippoal pirakaasamum, kodika'l pa'rakkum padaiyaippoal kediyumu'l'lava'laay, aru'noathayampoal uthikki'ra iva'l yaar?
pa'l'laththaakkilea pazhuththa kanika'laip paarkkavum, thiraadchachsedika'l thu'lirvittu, maatha'lagnsedika'l pooththathaa en'ru a'riyavum, vaathumaith thoattaththukkup poanean.
ninaiyaathathukkumunnea en aaththumaa ennai amminathaapin irathangka'lukku oppaakkit'ru.

thirumpivaa, thirumpivaa, soolamiththiyea! naangka'l unnaip paarkkumpadikku, thirumpivaa, thirumpivaa. soolamiththiyil neengka'l ennaththaip paarkki'reerka'l? ava'l ira'ndu seanaiyin koottaththukkuch samaanamaanava'l.
raajakumaaraththiyea! paatharadchaika'litta un paathangka'l mikavum azhakaayirukki'rathu; un iduppin vadivu visiththirath thozhi'rkaararin vealaiyaakiya poosha'nampoalirukki'rathu.
un naapi thiraadcharasam ni'raintha vattakkalasampoalirukki'rathu; un vayi'ru leelipushpangka'l soozhntha koathumai ampaarampoalirukki'rathu.
un ira'ndu sthanangka'lum ve'limaanin irattaikkuttika'lukkuch samaanamaayirukki'rathu.

un kazhuththu yaanaiththanthaththinaal seytha koapuraththaippoalavum, un ka'nka'l espoanilea pathrapeem vaasala'ndaiyilirukkum ku'langka'laippoalavum, un mookku thamaskuvin thisaiyai noakkum leepanoanin koapuraththaippoalavum irukki'rathu.
un sirasu karmeal malaiyaippoalirukki'rathu; un thalaimayir iraththaamparamayamaayirukki'rathu; raajaa nadaikkaava'nangka'lil mayangkini'rki'raar.
manamakizhchchiyai u'ndaakkum en piriyamea! nee evva'lavu roopavathi, nee evva'lavu inpamu'l'lava'l.
un uyaram panaimaraththozhungkupoalavum, un sthanangka'l thiraadchakkulaika'lpoalavum irukki'rathu.
naan panaimaraththilea'ri, athin madalka'laip pidippean en'rean; ippozhuthum un sthanangka'l thiraadchakkulaika'lpoalavum, un mookkin vaasanai kichchilippazhangka'lpoalavum irukki'rathu.
un tho'ndai, en neasar kudikkaiyil methuvaayi'rangkuki'rathum, u'rangkuki'ravarka'lin uthaduka'laip peasappa'n'nuki'rathumaana, nalla thiraadcharasaththaippoalirukki'rathu.
naan en neasarudaiyava'l, avar piriyam enmealirukki'rathu.
vaarum en neasarea! vayalve'liyil poay, kiraamangka'lil thangkuvoam.

athikaalaiyilea thiraadchaththoattangka'lukkup poavoam; thiraadchakkodi thu'lirththu athin poo malarnthathoa en'rum, maatha'lagnsedika'l pooppooththathoa en'rum paarppoam; angkea en neasaththin uchchithangka'lai umakkuth tharuvean.
thoothaayeem pazham vaasanai veesum; namathu vaasalka'la'ndaiyilea puthiyavaika'lum pazhaiyavaika'lumaana sakalavitha arumaiyaana kanika'lumu'ndu; en neasarea! avaika'lai umakku vaiththirukki'rean.
aa, neer en thaayin paalkudiththa en sakoatharanaippoaliruntheeraanaal, naan ummai ve'liyilea santhiththu muththamiduvean; ennai ninthikkavumaattaarka'l.

naan ummaik koottikko'ndu, en thaayin veettukku azhaiththukko'ndupoavean; neer ennaip poathippeer, kanthavarkkamitta thiraadcharasaththaiyum, en maatha'lampazharasaththaiyum umakkuk kudikkakkoduppean.
avar idathukai en thalaiyin keezhirukkum, avar valathukai ennai a'naikkum.
erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea! enakkup piriyamaanava'lukku manathaakumattum neengka'l ava'lai vizhikkappa'n'naamalum ezhuppaamalum irukka ungka'lai aa'naiyiduki'rean.

than neasarmeal saarnthuko'ndu vanaantharaththilirunthu varuki'ra iva'l yaar? kichchilimaraththinkeezh ummai ezhuppinean; angkea umathu thaay ummaip pet'raa'l; angkea ummaip pet'rava'l veathanaippattu ummaip pet'raa'l.

neer ennai umathu iruthayaththinmeal muththiraiyaippoalavum, umathu puyaththinmeal muththiraiyaippoalavum vaiththukko'l'lum; neasam mara'naththaippoal valithu; neasavairaakkiyam paathaa'laththaippoal kodithaayirukki'rathu; athin thazhal akkiniththazhalum athin juvaalai kadum juvaalaiyumaayirukki'rathu.

thira'laana tha'n'neerka'l neasaththai avikkamaattaathu, ve'l'langka'lum athaith tha'nikkamaattaathu; oruvan than veettilu'l'la aasthika'laiyellaam neasaththukkaakak koduththaalum, athu mut'rilum asattaipa'n'nappadum.
namakku oru si'riya sakoathariyu'ndu, ava'lukku sthanangka'lillai; nammudaiya sakoathariyaik keadkum naa'lil ava'lukkaaka naam enna seyvoam?
ava'l oru mathilaanaal, athinmeal ve'l'likkoattaiyaik kattuvoam; ava'l kathavaanaal, keathuruppalakaika'lai atha'rku i'naippoam.
naan mathilthaan, en sthanangka'l koapurangka'l; avarudaiya ka'nka'lil kadaadchampe'ralaanean.

paakaal aamoanilea saalomoanukku oru thiraadchaththoattam u'ndaayirunthathu, anthath thoattaththaik kaavalaa'lika'l vasaththilea athin palanukkaaka, ovvoruvan aayiram ve'l'likkaasu ko'nduvarumpadi vittaar.
en thiraadchaththoattam enakku munpaaka irukki'rathu; saalomoanea! umakku antha aayiramum, athin kaniyaik kaakki'ravarka'lukku irunoo'rum searum.
thoattangka'lil vaasampa'n'nuki'rava'lea! thoazhar un saththaththaik keadki'raarka'l; naanum athaik keadkattum.
en neasarea! theeviriyum, kanthavarkkangka'lin malaika'lmealu'l'la ve'limaanukkum maraika'lin kuttikkum samaanamaayirum.
aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa, yoothaavin raajaakka'laakiya usiyaa, yoathaam, aakaas, eseakkiyaa enpavarka'lin naadka'lil, yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum ku'riththuk ka'nda tharisanam.
vaanangka'lea, kea'lungka'l; poomiyea, sevikodu; karththar peasuki'raar; naan pi'l'laika'lai va'larththu aathariththean; avarka'loa enakku viroathamaayk kalakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
maadu than ejamaanaiyum, kazhuthai than aa'ndavanin munna'naiyaiyum a'riyum; isravealoa a'rivillaamalum, en janam u'narvillaamalum irukki'rathu enki'raar.

aiyoa, paavamu'l'la jaathiyum, akkiramaththaal paaragnsumantha janamum, pollaathavarka'lin santhathiyum, keadu u'ndaakkuki'ra puththirarumaayirukki'raarka'l; karththarai vittu, isravealin parisuththarukkuk koapamu'ndaakki, pinvaangkippoanaarka'l.
innum neengka'l ean adikkappadavea'ndum? athikam athikamaay vilakippoaki'reerka'lea; thalaiyellaam viyaathiyum, iruthayamellaam paladchayamumaay irukki'rathu.

u'l'langkaal thodangki uchchanthalaimattum athilea sukameayillai; athu kaayamum, veekkamum, nothikki'ra ira'namumu'l'lathu; athu seezh pithukkappadaamalum, kattappadaamalum, e'n'neyinaal aat'rappadaamalum irukki'rathu.

ungka'l theasam paazhaayirukki'rathu; ungka'l patta'nangka'l akkiniyinaal sutterikkappattathu; ungka'l naattai anniyar ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakap padchikki'raarka'l; athu anniyaraal kavizhkkappatta paazhntheasampoal irukki'rathu.
seeyoan kumaaraththi thiraadchaththoattaththilu'l'la oru kuchchupoalavum, ve'l'lariththoattaththilu'l'la oru kudisaipoalavum, mut'rikkaipoadappatta oru patta'nampoalavum meenthirukki'raa'l.
seanaika'lin karththar namakkuk kogncham meethiyai vaikkaathirunthaaraanaal, naam soathoamaippoalaaki, komoaraavukku oththiruppoam.
soathoamin athipathika'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; komoaraavin janamea, namathu theavanudaiya veathaththukkuch sevikodungka'l.

ungka'l palika'lin thira'l enakku ennaththukku en'ru karththar solluki'raar; aattukkadaakka'lin thakanapalika'lum, kozhuththa mirukangka'lin ni'namum enakku aroasikamaayirukki'rathu; kaa'laika'l, aattukkuttika'l, kadaakka'ludaiya iraththaththinmeal enakkup piriyamillai.
neengka'l en sannithiyil varumpoathu, en piraakaarangka'lai ippadi mithikkavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lidaththil keattathu yaar?

ini vee'n kaa'nikkaika'laik ko'nduvaravea'ndaam; thoopangkaattuthal enakku aruvaruppaayirukki'rathu; neengka'l akkiramaththoadea aasarikki'ra maathappi'rappaiyum, oayvunaa'laiyum, sapaikkoottaththaiyum naan inich sakikkamaattean.
ungka'l maathappi'rappuka'laiyum, ungka'l pa'ndikaika'laiyum en aaththumaa ve'rukki'rathu; avaika'l enakku varuththamaayirukki'rathu; avaika'laich sumanthu i'laiththuppoanean.
neengka'l ungka'l kaika'lai viriththaalum, en ka'nka'lai ungka'laivittu ma'raikki'rean; neengka'l mikuthiyaay jepampa'n'ninaalum kea'lean; ungka'l kaika'l iraththaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
ungka'laik kazhuvich suththikariyungka'l; ungka'l kiriyaika'lin pollaappai en ka'nka'lukku ma'raivaaka akat'rivittu, theemaiseythalai vittu oayungka'l;
nanmaiseyyap padiyungka'l; niyaayaththaith theadungka'l; odukkappattavanai aathariththu, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyin niyaayaththaiyum, vithavaiyin vazhakkaiyum visaariyungka'l.

vazhakkaaduvoam vaarungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; ungka'l paavangka'l sivearen'rirunthaalum u'raintha mazhaiyaippoal ve'nmaiyaakum; avaika'l iraththaamparachsivappaayirunthaalum pagnchaippoalaakum.
neengka'l manamporunthich sevikoduththaal, theasaththin nanmaiyaip pusippeerka'l.
maattoam en'ru ethirththuni'rpeerka'laakil pattayaththukku iraiyaaveerka'l; karththarin vaay ithaich sollit'ru.
u'nmaiyu'l'la nakaram eppadi veasiyaayppoayit'ru! athu niyaayaththaal ni'rainthirunthathu, neethi athil kudiko'ndirunthathu; ippozhuthoa athin kudika'l kolaipaathakar.
un ve'l'li ka'limpaayit'ru; un thiraadcharasam tha'n'neerkkalappaanathu.

un pirapukka'l muradarum thirudarin thoazharumaayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lil ovvoruvanum parithaanaththai virumpi, kaikkooliyai naadiththiriki'raan; thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyin niyaayaththai visaariyaarka'l; vithavaiyin vazhakku avarka'lidaththil ea'ruki'rathillai.
aakaiyaal seanaika'lin karththarum isravealin vallavarumaakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathaavathu: oakoa, naan en saththurukka'lil koapam aa'ri, en pakaignarukku neethiyaich sarikkattuvean.
naan en kaiyai unnidamaayth thiruppi, un ka'limpu neengka unnaich suththamaayp pudamittu, un eeyaththaiyellaam neekkuvean.
un niyaayaathipathika'lai munnirunthathupoalavum, un aaloasanaikkaararai aathiyil irunthathupoalavum thirumpak katta'laiyiduvean; pinpu nee neethipuram en'rum, saththiyanakaram en'rum peyarpe'ruvaay.
seeyoan niyaayaththinaalum, athilea thirumpivaruki'ravarka'l neethiyinaalum meedkappaduvaarka'l.
thuroakika'lum paavika'lumoa eakamaay no'rungku'ndupoavaarka'l; karththarai vittu vilakuki'ravarka'l nirmoolamaavaarka'l.
neengka'l virumpina karvaalimarangka'linimiththam vedkappaduveerka'l; neengka'l therinthuko'nda thoappuka'linimiththam naa'namadaiveerka'l.
ilaiyuthirntha karvaalimaraththaippoalavum, tha'n'neerillaatha thoappaippoalavum iruppeerka'l.
paraakkiramasaali sa'na'rkoo'lamum, avan kiriyai akkinippo'riyumaaki, ira'ndum avippaarillaamal eakamaay venthupoam en'ru solluki'raar.
aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum ku'riththuk ka'nda tharisanam.
kadaisinaadka'lil karththarudaiya aalayamaakiya parvatham parvathangka'lin kodumudiyil sthaapikkappattu, malaika'lukku mealaay uyarththappadum; ellaa jaathika'lum atha'rku oadivaruvaarka'l.

thira'laana janangka'l pu'rappattu vanthu: naam karththarin parvathaththukkum, yaakkoapin theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum poavoam vaarungka'l; avar thamathu vazhika'lai namakkup poathippaar, naam avar paathaika'lil nadappoam enpaarka'l; eanenil seeyoanilirunthu veathamum, erusaleamilirunthu karththarin vasanamum ve'lippadum.

avar jaathika'lukku'l niyaayantheerththu, thira'laana janangka'laik kadinthuko'lvaar; appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l pattayangka'lai ma'nvettika'laakavum, thangka'l eettika'lai arivaa'lka'laakavum adippaarka'l; jaathikku viroathamaay jaathi pattayam eduppathillai, ini avarka'l yuththaththaik ka'rpathumillai.
yaakkoapin vamsaththaarea, karththarin ve'lichchaththilea nadappoam vaarungka'l.

yaakkoapin vamsaththaaraakiya ummudaiya janaththaik kainekizhntheer; avarka'l keezhththisaiyaarin poathakaththaal ni'rainthu, pelistharaippoal naa'lpaarkki'ravarka'laayirunthu, anniya puththirarmeal piriyappaduki'raarka'lea.

avarka'l theasam ve'l'liyinaalum ponninaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avarka'l pokkishangka'lukku mudivillai; avarka'l theasam kuthiraika'laalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avarka'l irathangka'lukkum mudivillai.
avarka'l theasam vikkirakangka'laalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaiyaiyum, thangka'l viralka'l u'ndupa'n'ninathaiyum pa'ninthuko'l'luki'raarka'l.
si'riyavanum kuniki'raan, periyavanum pa'niki'raan; aakaiyaal avarka'lukku manniyaathiruppeer.
karththarin payangkaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya makimaippirathaapaththi'rkum vilaki, nee kanmalaiyil othungki, ma'n'nil o'liththukko'l.
nararin meattimaiyaana ka'nka'l thaazhththappadum, manusharin vee'raappum tha'niyum; karththar oruvarea annaa'lil uyarnthiruppaar.
ellaam thaazhththappadumporuttuch seanaika'ludaiya karththarin naa'laanathu perumaiyum meattimaiyumaanavai ellaavat'rinmealum, uyarnthavai ellaavat'rinmealum,
leepanoanilu'l'la uyaramum oangkalumaana ellaak keathurukka'linmealum, paasaanilu'l'la ellaak karvaali marangka'linmealum,
unnathamaana ellaap parvathangka'linmealum, uyaramaana ellaa malaika'linmealum,
uyarntha ellaak koapuraththinmealum, ara'naana ellaa mathilinmealum,
tharsheesin kappalka'l ellaavat'rinmealum, ellaach siththira vinoathangka'linmealum varum.
appozhuthu nararin meattimai thaazhnthu, manusharin vee'raapputh tha'niyum; karththar oruvarea annaa'lil uyarnthiruppaar.
vikkirakangka'l kattoadea ozhinthupoam.

poomiyaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nak karththar ezhumpumpoathu, avarudaiya payangkaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya makimaippirathaapaththi'rkum vilaki, kanmalaika'lin kepika'lilum, poomiyin kukaika'lilum pukunthuko'lvaarka'l.

poomiyaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nak karththar ezhumpum annaa'lilea, avarudaiya payangkaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya makimaippirathaapaththi'rkum vilaki, kanmalaika'lin vedippuka'lilum kun'ruka'lin santhuka'lilum pukunthuko'l'lumpadikku,
manushan pa'ninthuko'l'lath thanakku u'ndaakkiyiruntha than ve'l'li vikkirakangka'laiyum, than pon vikkirakangka'laiyum, moognchoo'ruka'lukkum thurignchilka'lukkum e'rinthuviduvaan.
naasiyilea suvaasamu'l'la manushanai nampuvathai vittuvidungka'l; e'n'nappaduvatha'rku avan emmaaththiram.
ithoa, seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar erusaleamilirunthum yoothaavilirunthum sakalavithamaana aatharavuka'laakiya appamenki'ra ellaa aatharavaiyum, tha'n'neerenki'ra ellaa aatharavaiyum;
paraakkiramasaaliyaiyum, yuththaveeranaiyum, niyaayaathipathiyaiyum, theerkkatharisiyaiyum, saasthiriyaiyum, mooppanaiyum;
aimpathupearukku athipathiyaiyum, kanamporunthinavanaiyum, aaloasanaikkaaranaiyum, thozhilka'lil saamarththiyamu'l'lavanaiyum, saathuriyanaiyum vilakkuvaar.
vaaliparai avarka'lukku athipathika'laakath tharuvean enki'raar; pi'l'laika'l avarka'lai aa'luvaarka'l.
janangka'l odukkappaduvaarka'l; oruvarukkoruvarum, ayalaanukku ayalaanum viroathamaayiruppaarka'l; vaalipan muthirvayathu'l'lavanukkum, keezhmakan meanmakanukkum idumpu seyvaan.

appozhuthu oruvan than thakappan veettaanaakiya than sakoatharanaip pidiththu: unakku vasthiram irukki'rathu, nee engka'lukku athipathiyaayiru; keattukku inamaana inthak kaariyam un kaiyin keezhaavathaaka en'ru solla;
avan annaa'lilea than kaiyai uyarththi: naan seerppaduththuki'ravanaayirukkamaattean; en veettilea appamumillai, vasthiramumillai; ennai janangka'lukku athipathiyaaka vaikkavea'ndaam enpaan.

eanen'raal erusaleam paazhaakkappattathu, yoothaa vizhunthupoayit'ru; avarka'l naavum, avarka'l kiriyaika'lum, karththarudaiya makimaiyin ka'nka'lukku erichchal u'ndaakkaththakkathaaka avarukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.

avarka'l mukappaarvai avarka'lukku viroathamaaych saadchiyidum; avarka'l thangka'l paavaththai ma'raikkaamal, soathoam ooraaraippoala ve'lippaduththuki'raarka'l; avarka'l aaththumaavukku aiyoa! thangka'lukkea theemaiyai varuviththukko'l'luki'raarka'l.
ungka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaakum en'ru neethimaanka'lukkuch sollungka'l; avarka'l thangka'l kiriyaika'lin palanai anupavippaarka'l.
thunmaarkkanukku aiyoa! avanukkuk keadu u'ndaakum; avan kaika'lin palan avanukkuk kidaikkum.

pi'l'laika'l en janangka'lai odukkuki'ravarka'laayirukki'raarka'l; sthireeka'l avarka'lai aa'luki'raarka'l. en janamea, unnai nadaththuki'ravarka'l unnai moasampoakki, nee nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai azhiththuppoaduki'raarka'l.
karththar vazhakkaada ezhunthirunthu, janangka'lai niyaayantheerkka ni'rki'raar.

karththar thamathu janaththin moopparaiyum, athin pirapukka'laiyum niyaayam visaarippaar. neengka'lea inthath thiraadchaththoattaththaip padchiththuppoatteerka'l; si'rumaiyaanavanidaththil ko'l'laiyitta poru'l ungka'l veeduka'lil irukki'rathu.
neengka'l en janaththai no'rukkich si'rumaiyaanavarka'lin mukaththai nerikki'rathu ennaven'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

pinnum karththar solluki'rathaavathu: seeyoan kumaaraththika'l akanthaiyaayirunthu, kazhuththai ne'riththu nadanthu, ka'nka'laal maruttippaarththu, oyyaaramaay nadanthu, thangka'l kaalka'lil silampu olikkath thiriki'raarka'l.
aathalaal aa'ndavar seeyoan kumaaraththika'lin uchchanthalaiyai mottaiyaakkuvaar; karththar avarka'l maanaththaik kulaippaar.
annaa'lilea aa'ndavar avarka'ludaiya aapara'nangka'laakiya silampuka'laiyum, suttika'laiyum, pi'raichsinthaakkuka'laiyum,
aarangka'laiyum, asthakadakangka'laiyum, thalaimukkaaduka'laiyum,
sirapoosha'nangka'laiyum, paathasarangka'laiyum, maarkkachchaika'laiyum, sukanthapara'nika'laiyum,
thaayiththuka'laiyum, moathirangka'laiyum, mookkuththika'laiyum,
vinoatha vasthirangka'laiyum, saalvaika'laiyum, poarvaika'laiyum, kuppika'laiyum,
ka'n'naadika'laiyum, sallaakka'laiyum, kullaakka'laiyum, thuppattaakka'laiyum urinthupoaduvaar.

appozhuthu, sukanthaththukkup pathilaakath thurkkanthamum, kachchaikkup pathilaakak kayi'rum, mayirchsuru'lukkup pathilaaka mottaiyum, aadamparamaana vasthirangka'lukkup pathilaaka irattukkachchum, azhakukkup pathilaakak karukippoakuthalum irukkum.
un purushar kadkaththinaalum, un pelasaalika'l yuththaththilum vizhuvaarka'l.
ava'ludaiya vaasalka'l thukkiththup pulampum; ava'l ve'rumaiyaakkappattuth tharaiyilea udkaaruvaa'l enki'raar.

annaa'lil eazhu sthireeka'l orea purushanaip pidiththu: naangka'l engka'l sontha aakaaraththaip pusiththu, engka'l sontha vasthiraththai uduppoam; engka'l ninthai neengkumpadikku unpearmaaththiram engka'lmeal vi'langkattum enpaarka'l.
isravealil thappinavarka'lukku annaa'lilea karththarin ki'lai alangkaaramum makimaiyumaayirukkum; poomiyin kani avarka'lukkuch si'rappum alangkaaramumaayirukkum.
appozhuthu aa'ndavar, seeyoan kumaaraththika'lin azhukkaik kazhuvi, niyaayaththin aaviyinaalum, sutterippin aaviyinaalum, erusaleamin iraththappazhika'lai athin naduvilirunthu neekkividumpoathu,
seeyoanil meethiyaayirunthu, erusaleamil thariththirunthu jeevanukken'ru pearezhuthappattavanevanum parisuththanen'ru sollappaduvaan.

appozhuthu karththar seeyoan malaiyilu'l'la ellaa vaasasthalangka'lilum, athin sapaika'linmealum, pakalil meakaththaiyum pukaiyaiyum, iravil kozhunthuvittu eriyum akkinippirakaasaththaiyum u'ndaakkuvaar; makimaiyaanavaika'linmealellaam kaaval u'ndaayirukkum.
pakalilea veyilukku nizhalaakavum, perungkaat'rukkum mazhaikkum adaikkalamaakavum, ma'raividamaakavum, oru koodaaram u'ndaayirukkum.

ippozhuthu naan en neasaridaththil avarudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththaik ku'riththu en neasarukkeat'ra oru paattaip paaduvean; en neasarukku makaa sezhippaana meattilea oru thiraadchaththoattam u'ndu.

avar athai vealiyadaiththu, athilu'l'la ka'rka'laip po'rukki, athilea na'rkula thiraadchachsedika'lai nattu, athin naduvil oru koapuraththaikkatti, athil aalaiyaiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, athu nalla thiraadchappazhangka'laith tharumen'ru kaaththirunthaar; athuvoa kasappaana pazhangka'laith thanthathu.
erusaleamin kudika'lea, yoothaavin manusharea, enakkum en thiraadchaththoattaththukkum niyaayantheerungka'l.

naan en thiraadchaththoattaththi'rkaakach seyyaatha entha vealaiyai atha'rku inich seyyalaam? athu nalla thiraadchappazhangka'laith tharumen'ru naan kaaththirukka, athu kasappaana pazhangka'laith thanthathenna?
ippoathum naan en thiraadchaththoattaththukkuch seyvathai ungka'lukku a'rivippean; athin vealiyai eduththuppoaduvean, athu meaynthupoadappadum; athin adaippaith thakarppean, athu mithiyu'ndupoam.

athaip paazhaakkividuvean; athin ki'lai na'rukkappadaamalum, ka'laikoththi edukkappadaamalum poavathinaal, mudchediyum nerignchilum mu'laikkum; athinmeal mazhai peyyaathapadikku meakangka'lukkum katta'laiyiduvean enki'raar.

seanaika'lin karththarudaiya thiraadchaththoattam isravealin vamsamea; avarudaiya manamakizhchchiyin naat'ru yoothaavin manusharea; avar niyaayaththukkuk kaaththirunthaar, ithoa, kodumai; neethikkuk kaaththirunthaar, ithoa, mu'raippaadu.
thaangka'lmaaththiram theasaththin naduvil vaasamaayirukkumpadi mat'ravarka'lukku idamillaama'rpoakumattum, veettoadea veettaich searththu, vayaloadea vayalaik koottuki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!
seanaika'lin karththar en sevikeadkach sonnathu: meyyaakavea anthath thira'laana veeduka'l paazhaakum; periyavaika'lum nearththiyaanavaika'lumaakiya veeduka'l kudiyillaathirukkum.
paththear nilamaakiya thiraadchaththoattam oreapadi rasam tharum; oru kala vithai oru ku'ru'ni vi'laiyum.
saaraayaththai naadi athikaalamea ezhunthu, mathupaanam thangka'laich soodaakkumpadi thariththirunthu, iruttippoakuma'lavum kudiththukko'ndeayirukki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

avarka'l surama'ndalaththaiyum, thampuruvaiyum, mea'laththaiyum, naakasuraththaiyum, mathupaanaththaiyum vaiththu virunthuko'ndaaduki'raarka'l; aanaalum karththarin kiriyaiyai noakkuki'rathumillai; avar karaththin seykaiyaich sinthikki'rathumillai.

en janangka'l a'rivillaamaiyinaal si'raippattuppoaki'raarka'l; avarka'lil kanamu'l'lavarka'l pattiniyinaal thoynthupoaki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya thira'laana koottaththaar thaakaththaal naava'ra'ndupoaki'raarka'l.

athinimiththam paathaa'lam thannai virivaakki, than vaayai aaven'ru mattillaamal thi'ranthathu; avarka'l makimaiyum, avarka'l thira'lkoottamum, avarka'l aadamparamum, avarka'lil ka'likooruki'ravarka'lum atha'rku'l i'rangkippoavaarka'l.
si'riyavan thaazhththappaduvaan, periyavanum thaazhchchiyadaivaan; meattimaiyaanavarka'lin ka'nka'l thaazhnthupoam.
seanaika'lin karththar niyaayaththeerppinaal uyarnthu, parisuththamu'l'la theavan neethiyinaal parisuththaraay vi'langkuvaar.
appozhuthu aattukkuttika'l ka'ndavidamellaam meayum; kozhuththavarka'ludaiyathaayirunthu paazhaayppoana nilangka'laip paratheasika'l anupavippaarka'l.
maayaiyin kayi'ruka'laal akkiramaththaiyum, va'ndiyin vadangka'laal paavaththaiyum izhuththukko'ndu vanthu,

naam paarkkumpadi avar theeviriththuth thamathu kiriyaiyaich seekkiramaay nadappikkattumen'rum, isravealin parisuththarudaiya aaloasanaiyai naam a'riyumpadi athu sameepiththu varattumen'rum solluki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

theemaiyai nanmaiyen'rum, nanmaiyaith theemaiyen'rum solli, iru'lai ve'lichchamum, ve'lichchaththai iru'lumaakap paaviththu, kasappaith thiththippum, thiththippaik kasappumen'ru saathikki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!
thangka'l paarvaikku gnaanika'lum, thangka'l e'n'naththukkup puththimaanka'lumaay irukki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!
saaraayaththaik kudikka veerarum, mathuvaik kalanthuvaikkap paraakkiramasaalika'lumaayirunthu,
parithaanaththi'rkaakak kut'ravaa'liyai neethimaanaakath theerththu, neethimaanin niyaayaththai avanukku viroathamaayp purattuki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

ithinimiththam akkinijuvaalai vaikkoalaip padchippathupoalavum, seththaiyaanathu neruppukku iraiyaaki erinthupoavathupoalavum, avarka'l vear vaadi, avarka'l thu'lir thoosiyaippoal pa'ranthupoakum; avarka'l seanaika'lin karththarudaiya veathaththai ve'ruththu, isravealilu'l'la parisuththarudaiya vasanaththai asattaipa'n'ninaarka'lea.

aakaiyaal karththarudaiya koapam thamathu janangka'lukku viroathamaay moo'ndathu; avar thamathu kaiyai avarka'lukku viroathamaay neetti, parvathangka'l athiraththakkathaayum, avarka'l pi'nangka'l naduveethika'lil kuppaipoalaakaththakkathaayum, avarka'lai adiththaar; ivai ellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koapam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
avar thooraththilu'l'la jaathiyaarukku oru kodiyai eat'ri, avarka'laip poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lilirunthu payilkaatti azhaippaar; appozhuthu avarka'l theeviramum veakamumaay varuvaarka'l.

avarka'lil vidaayththavanum ida'ruki'ravanum illai; thoongkuki'ravanum u'rangkuki'ravanum illai; avarka'lil oruvanudaiya iduppin kachchai avizhvathum, paatharadchaika'lin vaar a'runthupoavathum illai.

avarka'l ampuka'l koormaiyum, avarka'l villuka'lellaam naa'neat'rinavaika'lum, avarka'l kuthiraika'lin ku'lampuka'l ka'rpaa'raiyaaka e'n'nappattavaika'lum, avarka'l uru'laika'l suzhalkaat'rukku oththavaika'lumaayirukkum.

avarka'l kerchchippu singkaththin kerchchippupoalirukki'rathu; paalasingkangka'laippoalak kerchchiththu, u'rumi, iraiyaip pidiththu, thappuvikki'ravan illaamal, athai eduththukko'ndu poayviduvaarka'l.

annaa'lil, samuththiram iraivathupoal avarka'lukku viroathamaay iraivaarka'l; appozhuthu theasaththaippaarththaal, ithoa, anthakaaramum viyaakulamum u'ndu; athin meakangka'linaal ve'lichcham iru'ndupoam.
usiyaa raajaa mara'namadaintha varushaththil, aa'ndavar uyaramum unnathamumaana singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkakka'ndean; avarudaiya vasthiraththongkalaal theavaalayam ni'rainthirunthathu.

searaapeenka'l avarukku mealaaka nin'raarka'l; avarka'lil ovvoruvanukkum avvaa'ru settaika'lirunthana; avanavan ira'ndu settaika'laal than than mukaththai moodi, ira'ndu settaika'laal than than kaalka'lai moodi, ira'ndu settaika'laal pa'ranthu;
oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: seanaika'lin karththar parisuththar, parisuththar, parisuththar, poomiyanaiththum avarudaiya makimaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu en'ru kooppittuch sonnaarka'l.
kooppiduki'ravarka'lin saththaththaal vaasalka'lin nilaika'l asainthu, aalayam pukaiyinaal ni'rainthathu.

appozhuthu naan: aiyoa! athamaanean, naan asuththa uthaduka'lu'l'la manushan, asuththa uthaduka'lu'l'la janangka'lin naduvil vaasamaayirukki'ravan; seanaika'lin karththaraakiya raajaavai en ka'nka'l ka'ndathea en'rean.
appozhuthu searaapeenka'lil oruvan palipeedaththilirunthu, than kaiyilea pidiththa ku'rattaal oru neruppuththazhalai eduththu, ennidaththil pa'ranthu vanthu,
athinaal en vaayaith thottu: ithoa, ithu un uthaduka'laith thottathinaal un akkiramam neengki, un paavam nivirththiyaanathu en'raan.
pinpu: yaarai naan anuppuvean, yaar namathu kaariyamaayp poavaan en'ru uraikki'ra aa'ndavarudaiya saththaththaik keattean. atha'rku naan: ithoa, adiyean irukki'rean; ennai anuppum en'rean.
appozhuthu avar: nee poay, intha janangka'lai noakki, neengka'l kaathaarak keattum u'naraamalum, ka'n'naarakka'ndum a'riyaamalum irungka'l en'ru sol.

intha janangka'l thangka'l ka'nka'linaal kaa'naamalum, thangka'l kaathuka'linaal kea'laamalum, thangka'l iruthayaththinaal u'narnthu ku'nappadaamalum, naan avarka'lai aaroakkiyamaakkaamalumirukka, nee avarka'l iruthayaththaik kozhuththathaakki, avarka'l kaathuka'lai manthappaduththi, avarka'l ka'nka'lai moodippoadu en'raar.
appozhuthu naan: aa'ndavarea, ethuvaraikkum en'ru keattean. atha'rku avar: patta'nangka'l kudiyillaamalum, veeduka'l manushasagnchaaramillaamalum paazhaaki, poomi avaantharave'liyaaki,
karththar manusharaith thooramaaka vilakkuvathinaal, theasaththin nadumaiyam mut'rilum ve'rumaiyaakkappadum varaikkumea.

aakilum athil innum paththil oru pangkirukkum, athuvum thirumpa nirmoolamaakkappadum; karvaalimaramum arasamaramum ilaiyat'ruppoanapinpu, avaika'lin adimaram iruppathupoala, athin adimaramum parisuththa viththaayirukkum en'raar.

usiyaavinudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoathaamin kumaaran aakaas ennum yoothaatheasaththu raajaavin naadka'lilea, reathseen ennum seeriyaavin raajaavum, remaliyaavin kumaaranaakiya pekkaa ennum isravealin raajaavum erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'na vanthaarka'l, avarka'laal athaip pidikkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.

seeriyar eppiraayeemaich saarnthirukki'raarka'len'ru thaaveethin kudumpaththukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, raajaavin iruthayamum avan janaththin iruthayamum kaattilu'l'la marangka'l kaat'rinaal asaiki'rathupoal asainthathu.
appozhuthu karththar easaayaavai noakki: neeyum un makan seayaaryaasoopumaaka va'n'naar thu'raivazhiyilu'l'la mea'rku'laththu mathakin kadaisimattum aakaasukku ethirko'ndupoay,
nee avanai noakki: seeriyar eppiraayeemoadum, remaliyaavin makanoadum unakku viroathamaakath thuraaloasanai pa'n'ni,
naam yoothaavukku viroathamaayppoay, athai nerukki, athai namakku'l'lea pangkittukko'ndu, atha'rkuth thapeayaalin kumaaranai raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththuvoam en'ru sonnathinimiththam;

nee payappadaamal amarnthirukkap paar; intha ira'ndu pukaiki'ra ko'l'likkattaika'laakiya seeriyaroadea vantha reathseenum, remaliyaavin makanum ko'nda ukkirakkoapaththinimiththam un iruthayam thuva'lavea'ndaam.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar: antha aaloasanai nilaini'rpathillai, athinpadi sampavippathumillai;
seeriyaavin thalai thamasku, thamaskuvin thalai reathseen; innum a'rupaththainthu varushangka'lilea eppiraayeem oru janamaayiraathapadikku no'rungku'ndupoam.
eppiraayeemin thalai samaariyaa, samaariyaavin thalai remaliyaavin makan; neengka'l visuvaasiyaavittaal nilaipe'ramaatteerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar aakaasai noakki:
nee un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil oru adaiyaa'laththai vea'ndikko'l; athai aazhaththilirunthaakilum, unnathaththilirunthaakilum u'ndaakak keattukko'l en'ru sonnaar.
aakaasoa: naan keadkamaattean, naan karththaraip pareedchai seyyamaattean en'raan.
appozhuthu easaayaa: thaaveethin vamsaththaarea, kea'lungka'l; neengka'l manusharai visanappaduththuki'rathu poathaathen'ru en theavanaiyum visanappaduththap paarkki'reerka'loa?
aathalaal aa'ndavar thaamea ungka'lukku oru adaiyaa'laththaik koduppaar; ithoa, oru kannikai karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l, avarukku immaanuveal en'ru peariduvaa'l.
theemaiyai ve'ruththu nanmaiyaith therinthuko'l'la a'riyum vayathumattum avar ve'n'neyaiyum theanaiyum saappiduvaar.
anthap pi'l'lai theemaiyai ve'rukkavum, nanmaiyaith therinthuko'l'lavum a'riki'ratha'rkumunnea, nee aruvarukki'ra theasam athin ira'ndu raajaakka'laal vittuvidappadum.
eppiraayeem yoothaavaivittup pirintha naa'lmuthal varaatha naadka'laik karththar unmealum, un janaththinmealum, un pithaavudaiya vamsaththinmealum, aseeriyaavin raajaavinaalea varappa'n'nuvaar.
annaadka'lilea, karththar ekipthu nathika'lin kadaiyaantharaththilu'l'la eeyaiyum, aseeriyaa theasaththilirukkum theaneeyaiyum payilkaatti azhaippaar.
avaika'l vanthu eakamaay vanaantharangka'lin pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum, kanmalaika'lin vedippuka'lilum, ellaa mudkaaduka'lilum, meaychchalu'l'la ellaa idangka'lilum thangkum.

akkaalaththilea aa'ndavar koolikkuvaangkina savarakan kaththiyinaal, athaavathu, nathiyin akkaraiyilu'l'la aseeriyaa raajaavinaal, thalaimayiraiyum kaalmayiraiyum siraippiththu, thaadiyaiyum vaangkippoaduvippaar.
akkaalaththil oruvan oru i'lampasuvaiyum, ira'ndu aaduka'laiyum va'larththaal,
avaika'l poora'namaayp paal ka'rakki'rapadiyinaal ve'n'neyaich saappiduvaan; theasaththin naduvil meethiyaayiruppavanevanum ve'n'neyaiyum theanaiyumea saappiduvaan.
annaa'lilea, aayiram ve'l'likkaasu pe'rum aayiram thiraadchachsediyiruntha nilamellaam mudchediyum nerignchilumaakum.
theasamengkum mudchediyum nerignchilum u'ndaayiruppathinaal, ampuka'laiyum villaiyum pidiththu angkea poakavea'ndiyathaayirukkum.

ma'nvettiyaal koththappaduki'ra malaika'l u'ndea; mudchedika'lukkum nerignchilka'lukkum payappaduvathinaal avaika'lil on'ri'rkum poakak koodaamaiyinaal, avaika'l maaduka'lai oattividuvatha'rkum, aaduka'l mithippatha'rkumaana idamaayirukkum en'raan.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: nee oru periya paththiraththai eduththu manushan ezhuthuki'ra pirakaaramaay athilea makear-saalaal-ash-paas en'ru ezhuthu en'raar.
appozhuthu naan u'nmaiyu'l'la saadchikkaararaakiya aasaariyanaana uriyaavaiyum, yeperekiyaavin kumaaranaana sakariyaavaiyum atha'rkuch saadchika'laaka vaiththukko'ndean.
naan theerkkatharisiyaanava'laich searnthapoathu, ava'l karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: makear-saalaal-ash-paas ennum pearai avanukku idu.
inthap paalakan, appaa, ammaa en'ru kooppida a'riyumunnea, thamaskuvin aasthiyum, samaariyaavin ko'l'laiyum, aseeriyaavin raajaavukku munpaakak ko'ndupoakappadum en'raar.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki:
intha janam methuvaay oaduki'ra seeloavaavin tha'n'neerka'lai asattaipa'n'ni, reathseenaiyum remaliyaavin kumaaranaiyum saarnthu santhoashikki'rapadiyinaal,

ithoa, aa'ndavar vallamaiyu'l'la thira'laana aat'runeeraippoan'ra aseeriyaavin raajaavaiyum, avanudaiya sakala aadamparaththaiyum avarka'lmeal pura'lappa'n'nuvaar; athu avarka'ludaiya oadaika'lellaavat'rinmealum poay, avarka'ludaiya ellaak karaika'lmealum pura'ndu,
yoothaavukku'l pukunthu piravaakiththuk kadanthu, kazhuththumattum varum en'raar. immaanuvealea, avan settaika'lin virivu umathu theasaththin visaalaththai moodum.
janangka'lea, neengka'l koottangkoodungka'l, mu'riyadikkappaduveerka'l; thooratheasaththaaraakiya neengka'l ellaarum sevikodungka'l; idaikkattikko'l'lungka'l, mu'rinthoaduveerka'l,
aaloasanai seyyungka'l, athu apaththamaakum; vaarththaiyai vasaniyungka'l, athu ni'rkaathu; theavan engka'loadea irukki'raar.
karththarudaiya karam enmeal amarnthu, avar ennudanea peasi, naan intha janaththin vazhiyilea nadavaathapadi enakkup puththisolli vi'lampinathaavathu:
intha janangka'l kattuppaadu en'ru solluki'rathaiyellaam neengka'l kattuppaadu en'ru sollaamalum, avarka'l payappaduki'ra payaththinpadi neengka'l payappadaamalum, kalangkaamalum,
seanaika'lin karththaraiyea parisuththampa'n'nungka'l; avarea ungka'l payamum, avarea ungka'l achchamumaayiruppaaraaka.

avar ungka'lukkup parisuththa sthalamaayiruppaar; aakilum isravealin ira'ndu koaththiraththukkum thadukkalin kallum, ida'ruthalin kanmalaiyum, erusaleamin kudika'lukkuch surukkum ka'n'niyumaayiruppaar.
avarka'lil aneakar ida'rivizhunthu no'rungkich sikku'ndu pidipaduvaarka'l.
saadchi aakamaththaik katti, en seesharukku'l'lea veathaththai muththiraiyidu en'raar.
naanoa yaakkoapin kudumpaththukkuth thamathu mukaththai ma'raikki'ra karththarukkaakak kaaththirunthu, avarukku ethirpaarththiruppean.
ithoa, naanum, karththar enakkuk koduththa pi'l'laika'lum seeyoan parvathaththil vaasamaayirukki'ra seanaika'lin karththaraalea isravealil adaiyaa'langka'laakavum a'rputhangka'laakavum irukki'roam.

avarka'l ungka'lai noakki: agnchanam paarkki'ravarka'lidaththilum, mu'numu'nen'ru oathuki'ra ku'rikaararidaththilum visaariyungka'l en'ru sollumpoathu, janangka'l than theavanidaththil visaarikkavea'ndiyathallavoa? uyiru'l'lavarka'lukkaakach seththavarka'lidaththil visaarikkalaamoa?
veathaththaiyum saadchi aakamaththaiyum kavanikkavea'ndum; intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea sollaavittaal, avarka'lukku vidiya'rkaalaththu ve'lichchamillai.
idukka'n adainthavarka'laayum pattiniyaayum theasaththaik kadanthupoavaarka'l; avarka'l pattiniyaayirukkumpoathu, moorkkave'riko'ndu, thangka'l raajaavaiyum thangka'l theavanaiyum thooshippaarka'l.
avarka'l a'n'naanthupaarppaarka'l, poomiyaiyum noakkippaarppaarka'l; aanaalum ithoa, ikkattum anthakaaramum irukkum; idukkaththaal iru'ladainthu, anthakaaraththilea tha'l'lu'ndu alaivaarka'l.

aakilum avar sepuloan naattaiyum, napthali naattaiyum idukkamaay eenappaduththina munthina kaalaththilirunthathupoala athu iru'ndiruppathillai; eanen'raal avar kada'rkaraiyarukilum, yoarthaan nathiyoaraththilumu'l'la pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya kalileayaavaakiya aththeasaththaip pi'rkaalaththilea makimaippaduththuvaar.
iru'lil nadakki'ra janangka'l periya ve'lichchaththaik ka'ndaarka'l; mara'na iru'lin theasaththil kudiyirukki'ravarka'linmeal ve'lichcham pirakaasiththathu.

antha jaathiyaith thira'laakki, atha'rku makizhchchiyaip perukappa'n'nineer; a'ruppil makizhki'rathupoalavum, ko'l'laiyaip pangkittukko'l'lukaiyil ka'likooruki'rathupoalavum, umakku munpaaka makizhuki'raarka'l.
meethiyaaniyarin naa'lil nadanthathupoala, avarka'l sumantha nukaththadiyaiyum, avarka'l thoa'linmealiruntha milaat'raiyum, avarka'l aa'loattiyin koalaiyum mu'riththuppoatteer.
ama'liyaay yuththampa'n'nuki'ra veerarudaiya aayuthavarkkangka'lum, iraththaththil pura'nda uduppum akkinikku iraiyaakach sutterikkappadum.

namakku oru paalakan pi'ranthaar; namakku oru kumaaran kodukkappattaar; karththaththuvam avar thoa'linmealirukkum; avar naamam athisayamaanavar, aaloasanaikkarththaa, vallamaiyu'l'la theavan, niththiya pithaa, samaathaanappirapu ennappadum.

thaaveethin singkaasanaththaiyum avanudaiya raajyaththaiyum avar thidappaduththi, athai ithumutha'rko'ndu en'ren'raikkum niyaayaththinaalum neethiyinaalum nilaippaduththumpadikku, avarudaiya karththaththuvaththin perukkaththukkum, athin samaathaanaththukkum mudivillai; seanaika'lin karththarudaiya vairaakkiyam ithaich seyyum.
aa'ndavar yaakkoapukku oru vaarththaiyai anuppinaar; athu isravealinmeal i'rangkit'ru.
sengkalkattu idinthupoayit'ru, po'lintha kallaalea thirumpak kattuvoam; kaattaththimarangka'l vettippoadappattathu, avaika'lukkup pathilaakak keathurumarangka'lai vaippoam en'ru,
akanthaiyum, manapperumaiyumaaych solluki'ra eppiraayeemarum, samaariyaavin kudika'lumaakiya ellaa janaththukkum athu theriyavarum.
aathalaal karththar reathseenudaiya saththurukka'lai avarka'lmeal uyarththi, avarka'ludaiya mat'rach saththurukka'lai avarka'loadea koottik kalappaar.

mu'rpu'raththil seeriyarum, pi'rpu'raththil pelistharum vanthu, isravealaith thi'ranthavaayaal padchippaarka'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koapam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
janangka'l thangka'lai adikki'ravaridaththil thirumpaamalum, seanaika'lin karththaraith theadaamalum irukki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththar isravealilea thalaiyaiyum, vaalaiyum, ki'laiyaiyum, naa'nalaiyum, oreanaa'lilea vettippoaduvaar.
mooppanum kanamporunthinavanumea thalai, poyppoathakampa'n'nuki'ra theerkkatharisiyea vaal.
intha janaththai nadaththuki'ravarka'l eththarumaay, avarka'laal nadaththappaduki'ravarka'l naasamadaiki'ravarka'lumaay irukki'raarka'l.

aathalaal, aa'ndavar avarka'l vaaliparmeal piriyamaayiruppathillai; avarka'lilirukki'ra thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lmealum vithavaika'lmealum irangkuvathumillai; avarka'l anaivarum maayakkaararum pollaathavarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; ellaa vaayum aakaamiyam peasum; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koapam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
aakaamiyamaanathu akkiniyaippoala eriki'rathu; athu mudchediyaiyum nerignchilaiyum padchikkum, athu nerungkiya kaattaik ko'luththum, pukai thira'ndu ezhumpum.
seanaika'lin karththarudaiya sinaththaal theasam anthakaarappattu, janangka'l akkinikku iraiyaavaarka'l; oruvanum than sakoatharanaith thappavidaan.
valathupu'raththil padchiththaalum pasiththiruppaarka'l; idathupu'raththil thin'raalum thirupthiyadaiyaarka'l; avanavan thanthan puyaththin maamsaththaith thinpaan.

manaasea eppiraayeemaiyum, eppiraayeem manaaseayaiyum padchippaarka'l; ivarka'l eakamaay yoothaavukku viroathamaayiruppaarka'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koapam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
eazhaika'lai vazhakkilea thoa'rkappa'n'navum, en janaththil si'rumaiyaanavarka'lin niyaayaththaip purattavum, vithavaika'laich soo'raiyaadavum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'laik ko'l'laiyidavum,
aniyaayamaana theerppuka'laich seyki'ravarka'lukkum, kodumaiyaana katta'laika'lai ezhuthuki'ravarka'lukkum aiyoa!
visaarippin naa'lilum, thooraththilirunthu varum paazhkkadippin naa'lilum neengka'l ennaseyveerka'l? uthavipe'rumpadi yaaridaththil oaduveerka'l? ungka'l makimaiyai engkea vaiththuviduveerka'l?
kattu'ndavarka'linkeezh mudangkinaalozhiya kolaiseyyappattavarka'lukku'l vizhuvaarka'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koapam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
en koapaththin koalaakiya aseeriyanukku aiyoa! avan kaiyilirukki'rathu en sinaththin tha'ndaayutham.

avapakthiyaana janangka'lukku viroathamaay naan avanai anuppi, enakkuk koapamoottina janaththaik ko'l'laiyidavum, soo'raiyaadavum, athai veethika'lin seat'raippoal mithiththuppoadavum avanukkuk katta'laikoduppean.
avanoa appadi e'n'nuki'rathumillai, avan iruthayam appadippattathai ninaikki'rathumillai; aneakam jaathika'lai azhikkavum, sangkarikkavumea than manathilea ninaivuko'l'luki'raan.
avan: en pirapukka'l anaivarum raajaakka'lallavoa?
kalnoapatta'nam karkeamisaippoalaanathillaiyoa? aamaath arpaaththaippoalaanathillaiyoa? samaariyaa thamaskuvaippoalaanathillaiyoa?
erusaleamaiyum samaariyaavaiyumpaarkkilum viseashiththa silaika'lu'l'la vikkiraka raajyangka'lai en kai ka'ndupidiththirukka,
naan samaariyaavukkum, athin vikkirakangka'lukkum seythathupoal, erusaleamukkum athin vikkirakangka'lukkum seyyaamaliruppeanoa en'ru solluki'raan.

aathalaal: aa'ndavar seeyoan malaiyilum erusaleamilum thamathu seyalaiyellaam mudiththirukkumpoathu, aseeriya raajaavinudaiya perumaiyaana negnchin vinaiyaiyum, avan ka'nka'lin meattimaiyaana paarvaiyaiyum naan visaarippean enki'raar.

avan: en kaiyin pelaththinaalum, en gnaanaththinaalum ithaich seythean; naan puththimaan, naan janangka'lin ellaika'lai maat'ri, avarka'l pa'ndakasaalaika'laik ko'l'laiyittu vallavanaippoal kudika'laith thaazhththinean.

oru kuruvikkoottaik ka'ndupidikki'rathupoal en kai janangka'lin aasthiyaik ka'ndupidiththathu; vittuvidappatta muttaika'lai vaarikko'lvathupoal poomiyaiyellaam naan vaarikko'ndean; oruvarum settaiyai asaiththathumillai, vaayaith thi'ranthathumillai, keechchen'ru saththamittathumillai en'ru solluki'raan.

koadariyaanathu thannaal vettuki'ravanukku viroathamaay meanmaipaaraattalaamoa? vaa'laanathu thannaik kaiyaaduki'ravanukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattalaamoa? paaraattinaal, thadiyaanathu thannaip pidiththavanai mirattinaa'rpoalavum, koalaanathu naan marakkattaiyallaven'ru ezhumpinaa'rpoalavum irukkumea.
aakaiyaal seanaika'lin aa'ndavaraakiya karththar, avanaichsearntha kozhuththavarka'lukku'l'lea i'laippai anuppuvaar; padchikkum akkiniyaippoalum oru akkiniyai avan makimaiyinkeezh ko'luththuvaar.
isravealin o'liyaanavar akkiniyum, athin parisuththar akkinijuvaalaiyumaaki, oreanaa'lilea avanudaiya mudchedika'laiyum, nerignchilka'laiyum thakiththup padchiththu,
avanudaiya vanaththin makimaiyaiyum, avanudaiya payirnilaththin makimaiyaiyum, u'l'lum pu'rampumaay azhiyappa'n'nuvaar; kodipidikki'ravan ka'laiththu vizhuvathupoalaakum.
kaattil avanukku meethiyaana marangka'l kognchamaayirukkum, oru si'rupi'l'lai avaika'lai e'n'ni ezhuthalaam.

akkaalaththilea isravealil meethiyaanavarka'lum, yaakkoapin vamsaththil thappinavarka'lum, pinnorupoathum thangka'lai adiththavanaich saarnthuko'l'laamal, isravealin parisuththaraakiya karththaraiyea u'nmaiyaaych saarnthuko'lvaarka'l.
meethiyaayiruppavarka'l, yaakkoapil meethiyaayiruppavarka'lea, vallamaiyu'l'la theavanidaththil thirumpuvaarka'l.

isravealea, un janangka'l samuththiraththin ma'nalaththanaiyaayirunthaalum, avarka'lil meethiyaayiruppavarka'lmaaththiram thirumpuvaarka'l; theermaanikkappatta azhivu ni'raintha neethiyoadea pura'nduvarum.
seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar theasaththukku'l'lengkum theermaanikkappatta azhivai varachseyvaar.
aakaiyaal seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'ra en janamea, aseeriyanukkup payappadaathea; avan unnaik koalaal adiththu, ekipthiyaraippoal than tha'ndaayuthaththai unmeal oangkuvaan.
aanaalum innum kognchakkaalaththukku'l'lea en ukkiramum, avarka'laich sangkarikkappoaki'rathinaal en koapamum theernthupoam en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

oareap kanmalaiya'ndaiyilea meethiyaaniyar vettu'ndathupoal seanaika'lin karththar avanmeal oru savukkai ezhumpivarappa'n'ni, ekipthilea thamathu koalaik kadalinmeal oangkinathupoal athai avanmeal oangkuvaar.
annaa'lil un thoa'linin'ru avan sumaiyum, un kazhuththinin'ru avan nukamum neekkappadum; apisheakaththin nukam mu'rinthupoam.
avan aayaaththukku vanthu, mikroanaik kadanthu, mikmaasilea than rasthukka'lai vaiththirukki'raan.
ka'navaayaith thaa'ndi, keapaavilea paa'layami'rangkuki'raarka'l; raamaa athirki'rathu; savulin ooraakiya kipiyaa oadippoaki'rathu.
kaaleem kumaaraththiyea, uraththa saththamaayk kooppidu; eazhai aanathoaththea, laayeesh oormattum etta saththamittuk kooppidu.
mathmeanaa valasaivaangkippoam, keapimin kudika'l thappioadak koottangkooduki'raarka'l.
ini orunaa'l noapilea thangki, seeyoan kumaaraththiyin parvathaththukkum, erusaleamin meattukkum viroathamaayk kai neetti mirattuvaan.
ithoa, seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar thoappuka'laip payangkaramaay vettuvaar; oangki va'larnthavaika'l vettu'ndu meattimaiyaanavaika'l thaazhththappadum.
avar kaattin adarththiyaik koadariyinaalea vettippoaduvaar; makaththuvamaanavaraalea leepanoan vizhum.
eesaayennum adimaraththilirunthu oru thu'lir thoan'ri, avan vearka'lilirunthu oru ki'lai ezhumpich sezhikkum.

gnaanaththaiyum u'narvaiyum aru'lum aaviyum, aaloasanaiyaiyum pelanaiyum aru'lum aaviyum, a'rivaiyum karththarukkup payappaduki'ra payaththaiyum aru'lum aaviyumaakiya karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avarmeal thangkiyiruppaar.
karththarukkup payappaduthal avarukku ukantha vaasanaiyaayirukkum; avar thamathu ka'n ka'ndapadi niyaayantheerkkaamalum, thamathu kaathu keattapadi theerppuchseyyaamalum,

neethiyinpadi eazhaika'lai niyaayam visaariththu, yathaarththaththinpadi poomiyilu'l'la si'rumaiyaanavarka'lukkuth theerppuchseythu, poomiyaith thamathu vaakkin koalaal adiththu, thamathu vaayin suvaasaththaal thunmaarkkaraich sangkarippaar.
neethi avarukku araikkattum, saththiyam avarukku idaikkachchaiyumaayirukkum.

appozhuthu oanaay aattukkuttiyoadea thangkum, puli ve'l'laattukkuttiyoadea paduththukko'l'lum; kan'rukkuttiyum, paalasingkamum, kaa'laiyum, orumiththirukkum; oru si'ru paiyan avaika'lai nadaththuvaan.
pasuvum karadiyum koodimeayum, avaika'lin kuttika'l orumiththup paduththukko'l'lum; singkam maattaippoal vaikkoal thinnum.
paal kudikkungkuzhanthai viriyanpaampu va'laiyinmeal vi'laiyaadum, paal ma'rantha pi'l'lai kattuviriyan put'rilea than kaiyai vaikkum.
en parisuththa parvathamengkum theengkuseyvaarumillai; keaduseyvaarumillai; samuththiram jalaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathupoal, poomi karththarai a'riki'ra a'rivinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
akkaalaththilea, janangka'lukkuk kodiyaaka ni'rkum eesaayin vearukkaaka jaathika'l visaariththuk keadpaarka'l; avarudaiya thaaparasthalam makimaiyaayirukkum.

akkaalaththilea, aa'ndavar aseeriyaavilum, ekipthilum, pathroasilum, eththiyoappiyaavilum, persiyaavilum, sineayaarilum, aamaaththilum, samuththirath theevuka'lilum, thammudaiya janaththil meethiyaanavarka'lai meettukko'l'lath thirumpa ira'ndaamvisai thamathu karaththai neetti,
jaathika'lukku oru kodiyai eat'ri, isravealil thuraththu'ndavarka'laich searththu, yoothaavil sitha'radikkappattavarka'lai poomiyin naanku thisaika'lilumirunthu koottuvaar.
eppiraayeemin po'raamai neengkum, yoothaavin saththurukka'l sangkarikkappaduvaarka'l; eppiraayeem yoothaavinmeal po'raamaiyaayiraan, yoothaa eppiraayeemaith thunpappaduththaan.

avarka'l iruvarum eakamaayk koodi mea'rkeayirukki'ra pelistharudaiya ellaika'linmeal paaynthu, keezhththisaiyaaraik ko'l'laiyittu, eathoaminmealum moavaapinmealum kaipoaduvaarka'l; ammoan puththirar avarka'lukkuk keezhppadivaarka'l.

ekipthin samuththiramunaiyaik karththar mut'rilum azhiththu, thammudaiya kaat'rin valumaiyinaal nathiyinmeal thamathu kaiyai neetti, eazhaa'ruka'laakap piriththu, janangka'l kaalnanaiyaamal kadanthupoakumpadi pa'n'nuvaar.
isravealar ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattanaa'lil avarka'lukku irunthathupoala, aseeriyaavilea avarudaiya janaththil meethiyaanavarka'lukku oru perumpaathaiyirukkum.
akkaalaththilea nee solvathu: karththaavea, naan ummaith thuthippean; neer enmeal koapamaayiruntheer; aanaalum ummudaiya koapam neengkit'ru; neer ennaith theat'ruki'reer.
ithoa, theavanea en iradchippu; naan payappadaamal nampikkaiyaayiruppean; karththaraakiya yeakoavaa en pelanum, en keethamumaanavar; avarea enakku iradchippumaanavar.
neengka'l iradchippin oot'ruka'lilirunthu makizhchchiyoadea tha'n'neer mo'nduko'lveerka'l.

akkaalaththilea neengka'l solvathu: karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'lungka'l; avarudaiya seykaika'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea a'riviyungka'l; avarudaiya naamam uyarnthathen'ru pirasthaapampa'n'nungka'l.
karththaraik keerththanampa'n'nungka'l, avar makaththuvamaana kiriyaika'laich seythaar; ithu poomiyengkum a'riyappadakkadavathu enpeerka'l.
seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'rava'lea, nee saththamittuk kempeeri; isravealin parisuththar un naduvil periyavaraayirukki'raar.
aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa paapiloanmeal varakka'nda paaram.
uyarntha parvathaththinmeal kodiyeat'rungka'l; uraththa saththamittu janangka'lai varavazhaiyungka'l; avarka'l pirapukka'lin vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasippatha'rkuch saikai kaattungka'l.

naan parisuththamaakkinavarka'lukkuk katta'lai koduththean; en koapaththai ni'raiveat'ra en paraakkiramasaalika'lai azhaiththum irukki'rean; avarka'l en makaththuvaththinaalea ka'likooruki'ravarka'l enki'raar.

thira'laana janangka'lin saththaththukkoththa veku koottaththin iraichchalum, koottappatta jaathika'ludaiya raajyangka'lin ama'liyaana iraichchalum malaika'lil keadkappaduki'rathu; seanaika'lin karththar yuththaraa'nuvaththai ilakkampaarkki'raar.
karththar varuki'raar; avarudaiya koapaththin aayuthangka'lum, theasaththaiyellaam azhikka, vaanangkavizhntha kadaiyaanthara theasaththilirunthu varuki'rathu.
ala'rungka'l, karththarin naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu; athu sarvavallavaridaththilirunthu makaa sangkaaramaay varum.
aathalaal ellaak kaika'lum nekizhnthu, ellaa manusharin iruthayamum karainthupoam.

avarka'l thikiladaivaarka'l; veathanaika'lum vaathaika'lum avarka'laip pidikkum; pi'l'laipe'ruki'rava'laippoala veathanaippaduvaarka'l; oruvaraiyoruvar piramiththuppaarppaarka'l; avarka'l mukangka'l neruppaana mukangka'laayirukkum.
ithoa, theasaththaip paazhaakki, athin paavika'lai athilirunthu azhippatha'rkaakak karththarudaiya naa'l kadooramum, moorkkamum, ukkirakoapamumaay varuki'rathu.
vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'lum raasika'lum o'li kodaathirukkum; sooriyan uthikkaiyil iru'ndupoam; santhiran o'li kodaathirukkum.
paavaththinimiththam ulakaththaiyum, akkiramaththinimiththam thunmaarkkaraiyum naan tha'ndiththu, akangkaararin perumaiyai ozhiyappa'n'ni, kodiyarin idumpaith thaazhththuvean.
purushanaip pasumponnilum, manushanai oappeerin thangkaththilum apooruvamaakkuvean.
ithinimiththam seanaika'lin karththarudaiya ukkiraththinaal avarudaiya kadungkoapaththin naa'lilea poomi thannidaththaivittu neengkumpadi vaanaththai athirappa'n'nuvean.

thuraththappatta ve'limaanaippoalum, yaarum searkkaatha aattaippoalum iruppaarka'l; avaravar thangka'l janaththa'ndaikkup poaka mukaththaith thiruppi, avaravar thangka'l theasaththukku oadippoavaarka'l.
akappattavanevanum kuththu'ndu, avarka'laich searnthirunthavanevanum pattayaththaal vizhuvaan.
avarka'l kuzhanthaika'l avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka moathiyadikkappadum; avarka'l veeduka'l ko'l'laiyidappadum; avarka'l manaivika'l avamaanappaduvaarka'l.
ithoa, naan avarka'lukku viroathamaay meathiyarai ezhuppuvean; avarka'l ve'l'liyai mathiyaamalum, ponninmeal piriyappadaamalum,
villuka'laal i'laignaraich sithaiththuviduvaarka'l; karppakkaniyinmeal avarka'l irangkuvathillai; avarka'l ka'n pi'l'laika'laith thappaviduvathumillai.
raajyangka'lukku'l alangkaaramum, kaltheayarudaiya pirathaana makimaiyumaakiya paapiloanaanathu theavanaal soathoamum komoaraavum kavizhkkappattathupoala kavizhkkappadum.

ini orupoathum athil oruvarum kudiyea'ruvathumillai, thalaimu'raithoa'rum athil oruvarum thangkith tharippathumillai; angkea arapiyan koodaarampoaduvathumillai; angkea meayppar manthaiyai ma'rippathumillai.
kaattumirukangka'l angkea paduththukko'l'lum; oo'laiyidum piraa'nika'l avarka'l veeduka'lai nirappum; koattaanka'l angkea kudiko'l'lum; kaattaadu angkea thu'l'lum.

avarka'l paazhaana maa'likaika'lil oarika'l oo'laiyidum; valusarppangka'l avarka'l selvikkaiyaana aramanaika'lil eakamaayk koodum; athinkaalam seekkiram varum, athin naadka'l neediththiraathu enki'raar.

karththar yaakkoapukku irangki, pinnum isravealaraith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'lai avarka'l theasaththilea thaaparikkappa'n'nuvaar; anniyarum avarka'loadu searkkaiyaaki, yaakkoapin vamsaththoadea koodikko'lvaarka'l.

janangka'l avarka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay avarka'l sthaanaththil viduvaarka'l; israveal vamsaththaar karththarudaiya theasaththilea avarka'lai vealaikkaararaakavum vealaikkaarika'laakavum kaiyaa'ndu, thangka'laich si'raiyaakkinavarka'laich si'raiyaakki, thangka'lai odukkinavarka'lai aa'luvaarka'l.
karththar un thukkaththaiyum, un thaththa'lippaiyum, nee adimaiyaakkappattiruntha kadinamaana adimaiththanaththaiyum neekki, unnai i'laippaa'rappa'n'num akkaalaththilea,
nee paapiloan raajaavinmeal sollum vaakkiyamaavathu: odukkinavan ozhinthupoanaanea! ponnakari ozhinthupoayit'rea!
karththar thushdarin tha'ndaayuthaththaiyum, arasaa'ndavarka'lin sengkoalaiyum mu'riththuppoattaar.
ukkirangko'ndu oayaatha adiyaay janangka'lai adiththu, koapamaay jaathika'lai arasaa'ndavan, thaduppaarillaamal thunpappaduththappaduki'raan.
poomimuzhuthum i'laippaa'ri amainthirukki'rathu; kempeeramaay muzhangkuki'raarka'l.
theavathaaru virudchangka'lum, leepanoanin keathurukka'lum, unnimiththam santhoashappattu, nee vizhunthukidanthathu mutha'rko'ndu engka'lai vettavaruvaar oruvarum illai en'ru solluki'rathu.

keezhea irukki'ra paathaa'lam unnimiththam athirnthu, un varukaikku ethirko'ndu, poomiyil athipathika'laayirunthu seththa iraadchathar yaavaraiyum unnimiththam ezhuppi, jaathika'ludaiya ellaa raajaakka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya singkaasanangka'lilirunthu ezhunthirukkappa'n'nuki'rathu.
avarka'lellaarum unnai noakki: neeyum engka'laippoalap paladchayamaanaayoa? engka'lukkuch samaanamaanaayoa? en'ru solluvaarka'l.
un aadamparamum, un vaaththiyangka'lin muzhakkamum paathaa'laththil tha'l'lu'ndupoayit'ru; puzhukka'lea un padukkai, poochchika'lea un poarvai.
athikaalaiyin makanaakiya vidive'l'liyea, nee vaanaththilirunthu vizhunthaayea! jaathika'lai eenappaduththinavanea, nee tharaiyilea vizha vettappattaayea!

naan vaanaththukku ea'ruvean, theavanudaiya nadchaththirangka'lukkumealaaka en singkaasanaththai uyarththuvean; vadapu'rangka'lilu'l'la aaraathanaik koottaththin parvathaththilea veet'riruppean en'rum,
naan meakangka'lukku mealaaka unnathangka'lil ea'ruvean; unnathamaanavarukku oppaavean en'rum nee un iruthayaththil sonnaayea.
aanaalum nee akaathamaana paathaa'laththilea tha'l'lu'ndupoanaay.
unnaik kaa'nki'ravarka'l unnai ut'ruppaarththu, unnaikku'riththuch sinthiththu: ivanthaanaa poomiyaith thaththa'likkavum, raajyangka'lai athiravum seythu,
ulakaththai vanaantharamaakki, athin nakarangka'lai azhiththu, si'raippattavarka'laith thangka'l veeduka'lukkup poakavidaamalirunthavan enpaarka'l.
jaathika'ludaiya sakala raajaakka'lum, avaravar thangka'l a'raiyilea makimaiyoadea kidaththappattirukki'raarka'l.

neeyoa azhukippoana ki'laiyaippoalavum, pattayakkuththaal kolaiyu'ndavarka'lin uduppaippoalavum, oru kuzhiyin ka'rka'lukku'l'lea kidakki'ravarka'laippoalavum, kaalaal mithikkappatta pi'naththaippoalavum, un kalla'raikkup pu'rampaay e'rinthuvidappattaay.
nee avarka'loadea adakkam pa'n'nappaduvathillai; nee un theasaththaik keduththu un janaththaik kon'rupoattaay; theemaiseyki'ravarka'ludaiya santhathi orupoathum pearpe'ruvathillai.

avan puththirar ezhumpith theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, ulakaththaip patta'nangka'laal nirappaathapadikku, avarka'l pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramaththinimiththam avarka'laik kolaiseyya aayaththampa'n'nungka'l.

naan avarka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; paapiloanudaiya pearaiyum, athil meenthirukki'rathaiyum, puththiranaiyum pauththiranaiyum sangkarippeanen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
athai mu'l'lampan'rika'lukkuch suthantharamum, tha'n'neer ni'rkum pa'l'langka'lumaakki, athaich sangkaaram ennum thudaippaththinaal perukkividuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
naan ninaiththirukki'rapadiyea nadakkum; naan nir'nayiththapadiyea nilaini'rkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar aa'naiyittuch sonnaar.
aseeriyanai en theasaththilea mu'riththu, en malaika'linmeal avanai mithiththuppoaduvean; appozhuthu avanudaiya nukam avarka'lmealirunthu vilaki, avanudaiya sumai avarka'l thoa'lilirunthu neengkum.
theasamanaiththinmealum nir'nayikkappatta yoasanai ithuvea; sakala jaathika'lmealum neettappattirukki'ra kaiyum ithuvea en'raar.
seanaika'lin karththar ippadi nir'nayiththirukki'raar, yaar athai viyarththamaakkuvaan? avarudaiya kai neettappattirukki'rathu, yaar athaith thiruppuvaan?
aakaas raajaa mara'namadaintha varushaththilea u'ndaana paaram ennaven'raal:
muzhu pelisthiyaavea, unnai adiththa koal mu'rinthathen'ru akka'lippaayiraathea; paampin vearilirunthu kattuviriyan thoan'rum; athin kani pa'rakki'ra akkini sarppamaayirukkum.

thariththirarin thalaippi'l'laika'l thirupthiyaayp pusiththu, e'liyavarka'l sukamaayp paduththiruppaarka'l; unvearaip pagnchaththinaalea saakappa'n'nuvean, unnil meethiyaanavarka'lai avan kon'rupoaduvaan.
vaasalea ala'ru; nakaramea katha'ru; pelisthiyaavea, nee muzhuthum karainthupoaki'raay; eanen'raal, vadakkea irunthu pukaikkaadaay varuki'raan; avan koottangka'lil thaniththavanillai.

ippoathum intha jaathiyin sthaanaapathika'lukku enna maa'ruththaravu sollappadum? karththar seeyoanai asthipaarappaduththinaar; avarudaiya janaththil si'rumaiyaanavarka'l athilea thidanko'ndu thangkuvaarka'l enpathea.

moavaapin paaram. iravilea moavaapilu'l'la aar ennum patta'nam paazhaakkappattathu, athu sangkaaramaayit'ru; iravilea moavaapilu'l'la keer ennum patta'nam paazhaakkappattathu, athu sangkaaramaayit'ru.

azhumpadi meadaika'laakiya paayiththukkum theepoanukkum poaki'raarka'l; neapoavinimiththamum meathepaavinimiththamum moavaap ala'ruki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya thalaika'lellaam mottaiyadiththirukkum; thaadika'lellaam kaththariththirukkum.
athin veethika'lil irattaikkattikko'ndu, ellaarum athin veeduka'lmealum, athin therukka'lilum ala'ri, azhuthuko'ndirukki'raarka'l.

espoan ooraarum eleyaalea ooraarum kookkuraliduki'raarka'l; avarka'l saththam yaakaasmattum keadkappaduki'rathu; aakaiyaal moavaapin aayuthapaa'nika'l katha'ruki'raarka'l; avanavanudaiya aaththumaa avanavanil kileasappaduki'rathu.

en iruthayam moavaapinimiththam oalamiduki'rathu; athilirunthu oadivaruki'ravarka'l moon'ru vayathu kidaariyaippoala alaiki'raarka'l; lookiththukku ea'rippoaki'ra vazhiyilea azhukaiyoadea ea'ruki'raarka'l; oroanaayeemin vazhiyilea no'rungkuthalin kookkural iduki'raarka'l.
nimreemin neerppaaychchalaana idangka'l paazhaayppoam; pul ularnthu, mu'lai azhinthu, pachchaiyillaama'rpoaki'rathu.
aathalaal mikuthiyaakach searththathaiyum, avarka'l sampaathiththu vaiththathaiyum, alarika'lin aat'rukkappaalea eduththukko'ndupoavaarka'l.
kookkural moavaapin ellaiyengkum sut'rum; eklaayimmattum athin ala'ruthalum, perealeemmattum athin pulamputhalum ettum.

theemoanin tha'n'neerka'l iraththaththaal ni'rainthirukkum; theemoaninmeal athika keaduka'laik katta'laiyiduvean; moavaapilea thappinavarka'lmealum, theasaththil meethiyaanavarka'lmealum singkaththai varappa'n'nuvean.
theasaathipathikkuch seluththum aattukkuttika'lai neengka'l sealaapatta'nanthuvakki vanaantharamattum searththuch seeyoan kumaaraththiyin malaikku anuppungka'l.
illaavittaal koottaivittuth thuraththappattu alaiki'ra kuruviyaippoala moavaapin kumaaraththika'l arnoan nathiyin thu'raika'lidaththiliruppaarka'l.
nee aaloasanaipa'n'ni, niyaayagnseythu, maththiyaanaththilea un nizhalai iravaippoalaakki, thuraththappattavarka'lai ma'raiththukko'l, oadivaruki'ravarka'laik kaattikkodaathiru.

moavaapea, thuraththividappatta en janangka'l unnidaththil thangkattum; sangkarikki'ravanukkuth thappa avarka'lukku adaikkalamaayiru; odukkuki'ravan illaatheapoavaan; sangkarippu ozhinthupoam; mithikki'ravarka'l theasaththil iraathapadikku azhinthupoavaarka'l.
kirupaiyinaalea singkaasanam sthaapikkappadum; niyaayam visaariththuth thurithamaay neethiseyki'ra oruvar athinmeal thaaveethin koodaaraththilea niyaayaathipathiyaay u'nmaiyoadea veet'riruppaar.
moavaapin perumaiyaiyum, avan meattimaiyaiyum, avan akangkaaraththaiyum, avan ukkiraththaiyum ku'riththuk keattoam; avan meththap perumaikkaaran; aanaalum avan veempu sellaathu.

aakaiyaal, moavaapiyar oruvarukkaaka oruvar ala'ruvaarka'l, ellaarum eakamaay ala'ruvaarka'l; kiraareaseath oorin asthipaarangka'l thakarkkappattathea en'ru avaika'lukkaakap perumoochchu viduvaarka'l.

espoan oor vayalka'l vaadippoayina; sipmaaoorth thiraadchachsediyin nalla kodika'lai jaathika'lin athipathika'l na'rukkippoattaarka'l; avaika'l yaasearmattum sen'ru vanaantharaththil padarnthirunthathu; avaika'lin kodika'l nee'ndu kadalukkappaalea ettiyirunthathu.

aakaiyaal yaasearukkaaka azhuthathupoala, sipmaaoorth thiraadchachsedikkaakavum mikavum azhuvean; espoanea, eleyaaleayea, unakku en ka'n'neeraip paaychchuvean; un vasanthakaalaththup pazhangka'lukkaakavum, un thiraadchappazha a'ruppukkaakavum aaravaarikki'ra santhoasha saththam vizhunthupoayit'ru.

payirve'liyilirunthu santhoashamum ka'lippum at'ruppoayina; thiraadchaththoattangka'lil paadalumillai aarpparippumillai; aalaiyil irasaththai mithikki'ravanumillai; santhoasha aaravaaraththai oayappa'n'ninean.
aakaiyaal moavaapinimiththam en kudalka'lum, kiraareasinimiththam en u'l'lamum surama'ndalaththaip poalath thonikki'rathu.
moavaap meadaika'linmeal saliththuppoanaan en'ru kaa'nappadumpoathu, piraarththanaiseyyath than parisuththa sthaanaththilea piraveasippaan; aanaalum anukoolappadamaattaan.
moavaapaikku'riththu akkaalaththilea karththar sonna vaarththai ithuvea.

oru koolikkaaranudaiya varushangka'lukkoththa moon'ru varushangka'lukku'l'lea moavaapin makimaiyum athin makaa janakkoottamum seerazhinthupoam; athil meethiyaayiruppathu mikavum si'rithum a'rpamumaayirukkum en'ru karththar ippozhuthu solluki'raar.
thamaskuvin paaram. ithoa, thamaskuvaanathu nakaramaayiraamal tha'l'lappattu, paazhaana ma'nmeadaakum.
aaroavearin patta'nangka'l paazhaay vidappattu, manthaika'lin ve'liyaayirukkum; mirattuvaarillaamal avaika'l angkea paduththukko'l'lum.

ara'n eppiraayeemaiyum, raajaangkam thamaskuvaiyum vittozhiyum; israveal puththirarudaiya makimaikku nearittathupoala seeriyaavil meethiyaayiruppavarka'lukkum nearidum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
akkaalaththilea yaakkoapin makimai ku'rainthupoam, avanudaiya kozhuththa theakam melinthupoam.
oruvan oangkina payirai arinthu, than kaiyinaal kathirka'lai a'ruththu, reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea kathirka'laich searkki'rathupoalirukkum.

aanaalum oliva maraththai ulukkumpoathu nunikkompilea ira'ndu moon'ru kaayka'lum, kaaykki'ra athin ki'laika'lilea naalainthu kaayka'lum meethiyaayiruppathupoala, athilea pinpa'rippukkuk kogncham meethiyaayirukkumen'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.
akkaalaththilea manushan than kaika'lin kiriyaiyaakiya peedangka'lai noakkaamalum, than viralka'l u'ndupa'n'nina thoappuvikkirakangka'laiyum, silaika'laiyum noakkaamalum,
thannai u'ndaakkinavaraiyea noakkuvaan, avan ka'nka'l isravealin parisuththaraiyea noakkikko'ndirukkum.
akkaalaththilea avarka'ludaiya ara'naana patta'nangka'l israveal puththirarukku meethiyaay vaikkappatta thazhaiyaippoalavum, nunikkompaippoalavumaaki, paazhaayk kidakkum.
un pelamaakiya kanmalaiyai nee ninaiyaamal, un iradchippaakiya theavanai ma'ranthaay; aathalaal nee nearththiyaana naat'ruka'lai nattaalum, anniya theasaththuk kan'ruka'lai vaiththaalum,
paka'rkaalaththilea un naat'rai va'laravum, vidiya'rkaalaththilea un vithaiyai mu'laikkavum pa'n'ninaalum, palanaich searkkum naa'lilea thukkamum kadumveathanaiyumea ungka'l a'ruppaayirukkum.
aiyoa! kadalka'l kontha'likki'rathupoala kontha'likki'ra aneaka janangka'lin thira'lum, palaththa tha'n'neerka'l iraiki'rathupoala iraiki'ra janakkoottangka'lin ama'liyum u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

janakkoottangka'l thira'laana tha'n'neerka'l iraiki'rathupoala irainthaalum, avarka'lai avar athattuvaar; avarka'l thooramaay oadippoavaarka'l; malaika'lilea kaat'rinaal pa'rakkadikki'ra patharaippoalavum, suzhalkaat'rilea akappatta thurumpaippoalavum thuraththappaduvaarka'l.

ithoa, saayangkaalaththilea kalakkamu'ndaakum, vidiya'rkaalaththukkumun avarka'l ozhinthupoavaarka'l; ithuvea nammaik ko'l'laiyaaduki'ravarka'lin pangkum, nammaich soo'raiyaaduki'ravarka'lin veethamumaayirukkum.
eththiyoappiyaavin nathika'lukku akkaraiyilea nizhalidum settaika'ludaiyathum,

kadalvazhiyaayth tha'n'neerka'linmeal naa'nal padavuka'lilea sthaanaapathika'lai anuppuki'rathumaana theasaththukku aiyoa! veakamaana thootharka'lea, nedunthooramaayp paraviyirukki'rathum, siraikkappattathum, thuvakkamuthal ithuvaraikkum kediyaayirunthathum, a'lavidappattathum, mithikkappattathum, nathika'l paazhaakkuki'rathumaana jaathiya'ndaikkup poangka'l.
poochchakkaraththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'lum, theasaththuk kudika'lumaakiya neengka'lellaarum, malaika'linmeal kodiyeat'rappadumpoathu paarungka'l, ekkaa'lam oothappadumpoathu kea'lungka'l.

naan amarnthirunthu payirinmeal kaayum kaanthiyu'l'la veyilaippoalavum, a'ruppukkaalaththu ush'naththil u'ndaakum panimeakaththaippoalavum, en vaasasthalaththilirunthu ka'n'noakkuvean en'ru karththar ennudanea sonnaar.
thiraadchachsedika'l a'ruppukku munnea pooppooththu mut'rik kaaykki'ra kaayka'l pignchaayirukkumpoathea, avar arivaa'lka'linaalea kappukkavarka'lai a'ruththuk kodika'laiyarinthu akat'rippoaduvaar.
avaika'l eakamaay malaika'lin padchika'lukkum, poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum vidappadum; padchika'l athinmeal koadaikaalaththilum, kaattumirukangka'lellaam athinmeal maarikaalaththilum thangkum.

akkaalaththilea nedunthooramaayp paraviyirukki'rathum, siraikkappattathum, thuvakkamuthal ithuvaraikkum kediyaayirunthathum, a'lavidappattathum, mithikkappattathum, nathika'l paazhaakkuki'rathumaana jaathiyaanathu, seanaika'lin karththarin naamam thangkum sthalamaakiya seeyoan malaiyil, seanaika'lin karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'nduvarappadum.

ekipthin paaram. ithoa, karththar veakamaana meakaththinmeal ea'ri ekipthukku varuvaar; appozhuthu ekipthin vikkirakangka'l avarukku munpaakak kulungkum, ekipthin iruthayam thanakku'l'lea karainthupoakum.

sakoatharanoadea sakoatharanum, sineakithanoadea sineakithanum, patta'naththoadea patta'namum, raajyaththoadea raajyamum yuththampa'n'numpadiyaay, ekipthiyarai ekipthiyaroadea poar kalakkappa'n'nuvean.

athinaal ekipthiyarudaiya aavi avarka'lukku'l soarnthupoakum; avarka'l aaloasanaiyai muzhukippoakap pa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu vikkirakangka'laiyum, manthiravaathika'laiyum, sannathakkaararka'laiyum, ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum theaduvaarka'l.
naan ekipthiyaraik kadinamaana athipathiyin kaiyil oppippean; kadooramaana raajaa avarka'lai aa'luvaan en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu kadalin tha'n'neerka'l ku'rainthu, nathiyum vat'ri va'ra'ndupoam.
aa'ruka'laith thiruppividuvaarka'l; ara'nippaana akazhika'l ve'rumaiyaaki va'ra'ndupoam; ko'rukkaiyum naa'nalum vaadum.
nathiyoaraththilum nathimukaththilum irukki'ra madalu'l'la sedika'lum, nathiyarukea vithaikkappatta yaavum ularnthupoam; athu pa'rakkadikkappattu illaatheapoam.
meenpidikki'ravarka'l perumoochchuviduvaarka'l, nathiyilea thoo'ndilpoaduki'ra yaavarum thukkippaarka'l; tha'n'neerka'linmeal valaika'lai veesuki'ravarka'l saliththuppoavaarka'l.
melliya sa'nalaip pakkuvappaduththuki'ravarka'lum, sallaakka'lai neyki'ravarka'lum naa'nuvaarka'l.
meen va'larkki'ra ku'langka'laik koolikku a'naikkattuki'ra anaivarudaiya a'naikkattuka'lum udainthupoam.

soavaanpatta'naththin pirapukka'laanavarka'l moodarka'l; paarvoanudaiya gnaanamu'l'la aaloasanaikkaararin aaloasanai mathiyeenamaayit'ru: naan gnaanika'lin puththiran, naan poorva raajaakka'lin kumaaran en'ru paarvoanudanea eppadich solluki'reerka'l?
avarka'l engkea? un gnaanika'l engkea? seanaika'lin karththar ekipthaikku'riththup pa'n'nina yoasanaiyai avarka'l unakkuth therivikkattum; allathu thaangka'lea a'rinthuko'l'lattum.
soavaan pirapukka'l moodaraanaarka'l; noappin pirapukka'l moasampoanaarka'l; ekipthaiyum athin koaththiraththalaivaraiyum vazhithappappa'n'nuki'raarka'l.

karththar athin naduvil thaa'rumaa'ruka'lin aaviyai varappa'n'ninaar; aanathuko'ndu ve'riyan vaanthipa'n'ni, tha'l'laadith thiriki'rathupoala, avarka'l ekipthai athin ellaach seykaiyilum tha'l'laadith thiriyappa'n'nuki'raarka'l.
ekipthil thalaiyaakilum vaalaakilum ki'laiyaakilum naa'nalaakilum seyyum vealai on'rumiraathu.
akkaalaththilea ekipthiyar pe'nduka'laippoalirunthu, seanaika'lin karththar thangka'lmeal asaikkum kaiyasaivinaalea agnchi nadungkuvaarka'l.

seanaika'lin karththar avarka'lukku viroathamaaka nir'nayiththukko'nda aaloasanaiyinimiththam yoothaavin theasam ekipthiyarukkup payangkaramaayirukkum; thanakku'l athai ninaikki'ravanevanum thidukkiduvaan.
akkaalaththilea ekipthutheasaththilirukkum ainthu patta'nangka'l kaanaan paashaiyaip peasi, seanaika'lin karththarai munnittu aa'naiyidum; avaika'lil on'ru nirmoolamaana patta'nam ennappadum.
akkaalaththilea ekipthutheasaththin naduvilea karththarukku oru palipeedamum, athin ellaiyarukea karththarukku oru sthampamum u'ndaayirukkum.

athu ekipthu theasaththilea seanaika'lin karththarukku adaiyaa'lamum saadchiyumaayirukkum; odukkuki'ravarka'linimiththam avarka'l karththarai noakkik kooppiduvaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'lukku oru iradchakanaiyum, oru pelavaanaiyum anuppi avarka'lai viduvippaar.

appozhuthu karththar ekipthiyarukku a'riyappaduvaar; ekipthiyar karththarai akkaalaththilea a'rinthu, avarukkup palika'loadum kaa'nikkaika'loadum aaraathanaiseythu, karththarukkup poruththanaika'laippa'n'ni avaika'laich seluththuvaarka'l.
karththar ekipthiyarai vaathaiyinaal adippaar; adiththuk ku'namaakkuvaar; avarka'l karththaridaththil mananthirumpuvaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaik keattu, avarka'laik ku'namaakkuvaar.

akkaalaththilea ekipthilirunthu aseeriyaavukkup poaki'ra perumpaathai u'ndaayirukkum; aseeriyar ekipthukkum, ekipthiyar aseeriyaavukkum vanthu, ekipthiyar aseeriyaroadungkooda aaraathanai seyvaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea israveal ekipthoadum aseeriyaavoadum moon'raavathaakap poomiyin naduvil aaseervaathamaayirukkum.

avarka'laikku'riththuch seanaika'lin karththar: ekipthiyaraakiya en janamum, aseeriyaraakiya en karaththin kiriyaiyum, isravealaraakiya en suthantharamum aaseervathikkappattathu en'ru solli, avarka'lai aaseervathippaar.
tharththaan, aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sarkoanaalea anuppappattu, asthoaththukku vanthu, asthoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththa varushaththilea,

karththar aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaavai noakki: nee poay un araiyilirukki'ra irattai avizhththu, un kaalka'lilirukki'ra paatharadchaika'laik kazhat'ru en'raar; avan appadiyea seythu, vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay nadanthaan.

appozhuthu karththar: ekipthinmealum eththiyoappiyaavinmealum varum moon'ruvarushaththuk kaariyangka'lukku adaiyaa'lamum ku'rippumaaka en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya easaayaa vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay nadakki'rathupoala,

aseeriyaa raajaa, thaan si'raipidikkappoaki'ra ekipthiyarum, thaan kudivilakkappoaki'ra eththiyoappiyarumaakiya i'laignaraiyum kizhavaraiyum, vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay ekipthiyarukku vedkamu'ndaakumpadi, iruppidam moodappadaathavarka'laayk ko'ndupoavaan.
appozhuthu inthak kada'rkaraik kudika'l thaangka'l nampiyiruntha eththiyoappiyaavaikku'riththum, thaangka'l perumaipaaraattina ekipthaikku'riththum kalangki vedki:

ithoa, aseeriya raajaavin mukaththukkuth thappumpadikku naangka'l nampi, sakaayaththukken'ru oadivanthu a'ndinavan ippadiyaanaanea; naangka'l eppadi viduvikkappaduvoam en'ru akkaalaththilea solluvaarka'l en'raar.
kadal vanaantharaththin paaram. suzhalkaat'ru thenthisaiyilirunthu ezhumpik kadanthuvaruki'rathupoala, payangkaramaana theasamaakiya vanaantharaththilirunthu athu varuki'rathu.

kodiya tharisanam enakkuth therivikkappattathu; thuroaki thuroakampa'n'ni, paazhaakki'ravan paazhaakkikko'ndea irukki'raan; ealaamea ezhumpu; meathiyaavea mut'rikkaipoadu; athinaalea u'ndaana thavippaiyellaam ozhiyappa'n'ninean.

aakaiyaal, en iduppu makaa veathanaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; pi'l'laipe'ruki'rava'lin veathanaika'lukku oththa veathanaika'l ennaip pidiththathu; keattathinaal u'laivuko'ndu, ka'ndathinaal kalangkinean.
en iruthayam thikaiththathu; thikil ennaith thidukkidappa'n'nit'ru; enakku inpanthantha iravu payangkaramaayit'ru.
panthiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l, jaamakkaararai vaiyungka'l, pusiyungka'l, kudiyungka'l; pirapukka'lea, ezhunthu parisaika'lukku e'n'ney poosungka'l.
aa'ndavar ennai noakki: nee poay, kaa'npathaith therivikkumpadi jaamakkaaranai vai en'raar.

avan oru irathaththaiyum, joadu joadaana kuthiraiveeraraiyum, joadu joadaakak kazhuthaika'linmealum ottakangka'linmealum ea'rivaruki'ravarka'laiyum ka'ndu, mikuntha kavanamaayk kavaniththukko'ndea irunthu:
aa'ndavarea, naan pakalmuzhuthum en kaavalilea nin'ru, iraamuzhuthum naan en kaavalidaththilea thariththirukki'rean en'ru singkaththaippoal saththamittuk kooppiduki'raan.

ithoa, oru joadu kuthirai poo'nda irathaththinmeal ea'riyirukki'ra oru manushan varuki'raan; paapiloan vizhunthathu, vizhunthathu; athin vikkiraka theavarka'laiyellaam tharaiyoadea moathi udaiththaar en'ru pirathiyuththaram solluki'raan.
