en poaradippin thaaniyamea, en ka'laththin koathumaiyea, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththaraal naan kea'lvippattathai ungka'lukku a'riviththean.
thoomaavin paaram. seayeerilirunthu ennai noakki: jaamakkaaranea, iravu evva'lavu sen'rathu? en'ru kooppittuk keadka;
atha'rku jaamakkaaran: vidiya'rkaalam varuki'rathu, iraakkaalamum varuki'rathu; neengka'l keadka manathaanaal thirumpivanthu kea'lungka'l en'ru solluki'raan.
arapiyaavin paaram. thithaaniyaraakiya paya'nakkoottangka'lea, neengka'l arapiyaavin kaaduka'lil iraaththangkuveerka'l.
theamaatheasaththin kudika'lea, neengka'l thaakamaayirukki'ravarka'lukkuth tha'n'neer ko'ndupoay, thappi oaduki'ravarka'lukku appangkodukka ethirko'ndupoangka'l.
avarka'l, pattayangka'lukkum, uruvina kadkaththukkum, naa'neat'rina villukkum, yuththaththin kodumaikkum thappi oaduki'raarka'l.
aa'ndavar ennai noakki: oru koolikkaaranudaiya varushangka'lukkoththa orea varushaththilea keathaarudaiya makimaiyellaam at'ruppoam.
keathaar puththiraraakiya paraakkirama vilveerarin thokaiyil meethiyaanavarka'l kognchappearaayiruppaarka'l en'raar; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar ithai uraiththaar.
tharisanap pa'l'laththaakkin paaram. unnil u'l'lavarka'l ellaarum veeduka'linmeal ea'ruvatha'rku unakku ippozhuthu vanthathu enna?
santhadika'laal ni'rainthu aaravaarampa'n'ni, ka'likoornthiruntha nakaramea, unnidaththil kolaiyu'ndavarka'l pattayaththaal kolaiyu'ndathillai, yuththaththil seththathum illai.
un athipathika'l ellaarum eakamaay oadi alainthum, vilveeraraal kattappaduki'raarka'l; unnil akappatta yaavarum thooraththukku oadiyum eakamaayk kattappaduki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal, ennai noakkip paaraatheayungka'l; en janamaakiya kumaaraththi paazhaayppoanathinimiththam manangkasanthu azhuvean; enakku aa'ruthal solla varaatheayungka'l enki'rean.

seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraalea ithu tharisanap pa'l'laththaakkilea ama'liyum, mithiyu'nkuthalum, kalakkamumu'l'la naa'laayirukki'rathu; ithu alangkaththaith thakarththu, parvathaththukku nearea aarpparikkum naa'laayirukki'rathu.
ealaamiyan ampa'raaththoo'niyai eduththu, irathangka'loadum kaalaadka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum varuki'raan; keer keadakaththai ve'lippaduththum.
makaa vadivaana un pa'l'laththaakkuka'l irathangka'laal nirappappadum; kuthiraiveerar vaasalka'lmattum vanthu a'nivakuththu ni'rpaarka'l.
avan yoothaavin ma'raivai neekkippoaduvaan; annaa'lilea vanamaa'likaiyaakiya aayuthasaalaiyai noakkuvaay.
neengka'l thaaveethu nakaraththin idithalka'l aneakamaayiruppathaik ka'ndu, keezhkku'laththuth tha'n'neerka'laik kattivaiththu,
erusaleamin veeduka'lai e'n'ni, alangkaththai ara'nippaakkumpadi veeduka'lai idiththu,

ira'ndu mathilka'lukku naduvea pazhaiya ku'laththuth tha'n'neerka'lukku oru akazhai u'ndupa'n'nuveerka'l; aanaalum athaich seythavarai neengka'l noakkaamalum, athai ea'rpaduththith thooraththilirunthu varappa'n'ninavaraik kavaniyaamalum poaki'reerka'l.
seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar akkaalaththilea azhavum, pulampavum, mottaiyidavum, irattuduththavum katta'laiyittaar.
neengka'loa, santhoashiththuk ka'liththu, aadumaaduka'lai adiththu, i'raichchiyaich saappittu, thiraadcharasaththaik kudiththu: pusippoam kudippoam, naa'laikkuch saavoam en'ru solveerka'l.

meyyaakavea neengka'l saakumattum intha akkiramam ungka'lukku nivirththiyaavathillai en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raarenpathu en sevi keadkumpadi seanaika'lin karththaraal therivikkappattathu.
seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraiththathaavathu: nee aramanai visaarippukkaaranum pokkishakkaaranumaakiya sepnaa enpavanidaththil poaych sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

uyarntha sthalaththilea than kalla'raiyai vetti, kanmalaiyilea thanakku vaasasthalaththaith thoa'nduki'ravanaippoala, nee unakku ingkea kalla'raiyai vettumpadikku unakku ingkea enna irukki'rathu? unakku ingkea yaar irukki'raarka'l?
ithoa, pelavaan oruvanaith thuraththuki'rava'n'namaakak karththar unnaith thuraththivittu, nichchayamaay unnai moodippoaduvaar.

avar unnai uru'ndaiyaippoala akalamum visaalamumaana theasaththilea suzhat'ri e'rinthuviduvaar; angkea nee saavaay; angkea un makimaiyin irathangka'l un aa'ndavanudaiya veettukku ikazhchchiyaaka irukkum.
unnai un nilaiyaivittuth thuraththividuvean; un sthaanaththilirunthu nee pidungkippoadappaduvaay.
annaa'lilea ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeem ennum en oozhiyakkaaranai naan azhaiththu:
un vasthiraththai avanukkuth thariththu, un kachchaiyaal avanai idaikkatti, un athikaaraththai avan kaiyilea koduppean; avan erusaleamin kudika'lukkum, yoothaavin vamsaththukkum thakappanaayiruppaan.
thaaveethudaiya veettin thi'ravukoalai avan thoa'linmeal vaippean; oruvarum poottakkoodaathapadikku avan thi'rappaan, oruvarum thi'rakkakkoodaathapadikku avan poottuvaan.
avanai u'ruthiyaana idaththilea aa'niyaakak kadaavuvean; avan than thakappan veettukku makimaiyaana singkaasanamaaka iruppaan.
athinmeal avan thakappan vamsaththaaraakiya puththirar pauththirarudaiya makimai anaiththaiyum, si'rithum perithumaana sakala paanapaaththirangka'laiyum thookkivaippaarka'l.

u'ruthiyaana idaththil kadaavappattiruntha aa'ni annaa'lilea pidungkappattu, mu'rinthuvizhum; appozhuthu athinmeal thongkina paaram a'runthuvizhum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar; karththarea ithai uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

theeruvin paaram. tharshees kappalka'lea, ala'rungka'l; athu veedu illaathapadikkum, athil varuvaar illaathapadikkum paazhaakkappattathu; inthach seythi kiththeem theasaththilirunthu avarka'lukkuth therivikkappaduki'rathu.
theevukkudika'lea, mavunamaayirungka'l; seethoanin varththakar samuththiraththilea yaaththiraipa'n'ni unnai nirappinaarka'l.
seekoar nathiyin mikuntha neerppaaychchalka'laal vi'laiyum payirvakaika'lum, aat'rangkaraiyin a'ruppum athin varumaanamaayirunthathu; athu jaathika'lin santhaiyaayirunthathu.

seethoanea, vedkappadu; naan inik karppaveathanaippaduki'rathum illai; pe'ruki'rathum illai; i'laignarai va'larkki'rathum illai; kannikaika'lai aatharikki'rathum illai en'ru samuththirak koattaiyaana kadalthu'rai solluki'rathu.
ekipthin seythi keadkappattathinaal noay u'ndaanathupoala, theeruvin seythi keadkappaduvathinaalum noay u'ndaakum.
karaithu'raik kudika'lea, neengka'l tharsheesmattum pu'rappattuppoay ala'rungka'l.
poorvanaadka'lmuthal nilaipet'ruk ka'likoornthiruntha ungka'l patta'nam ithuthaanaa? paratheasampoaych sagncharikki'ratha'rku ava'l kaalka'lea ava'laith thooramaayk ko'ndupoam.
kireedam tharippikkum theeruvukku viroathamaaka ithai yoasiththuth theermaaniththavar yaar? athin varththakar pirapukka'lum, athin viyaapaarika'l poomiyin kanavaanka'lumaamea.
sarva singkaaraththin meanmaiyaik kulaikkavum, poomiyin kanavaanka'l yaavaraiyum kanaeenappaduththavum, seanaika'lin karththarea ithai yoasiththuth theermaaniththaar.
tharsheesin kumaaraththiyea, nathiyaippoala nee un theasaththil paaynthupoa, unakku a'naiyillai.
karththar thamathu kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neetti, raajyangka'laik kulungkappa'n'ninaar; kaanaanin ara'nka'lai azhikka avar atha'rku viroathamaayk katta'laikoduththu:
odungku'nda kanniyaakiya seethoan kumaaraththiyea, inik ka'likoornthuko'ndiraay; ezhunthu kiththeemukkup pu'rappattuppoa, angkum unakku i'laippaa'ruthal illaiyen'raar.

kaltheayarudaiya theasaththaip paar; antha janam munnirunthathillai; aseeriyan vanaantharaththaarukkaaka athai asthipaarappaduththinaan; avarka'l athin koapurangka'lai u'ndaakki, athin aramanaika'laik kattinaarka'l; avar athai azhivukken'ru niyamiththaar.
tharshees kappalka'lea, ala'rungka'l; ungka'l ara'n paazhaakkappattathu.

akkaalaththilea theeru, oru raajaavudaiya naadka'linpadi, ezhupathu varusham ma'rakkappattirukkum; ezhupathu varushangka'lin mudivilea theeruvukkuch sampavippathu veasiyin paadalukkuch samaanamaayirukkum.
ma'rakkappatta veasiyea, nee vee'naiyai eduththu nakaraththaich sut'riththiri; nee ninaikkappadumpadi athai inithaaka vaasiththup pala paattuka'laip paadu.
ezhupathu varushangka'lin mudivilea karththar vanthu theeruvaich santhippaar; appozhuthu athu than pa'naiyaththukku thirumpivanthu, poomiyilu'l'la sakala raajyangka'loadum veasiththanam pa'n'num.

athin viyaapaaramum, athin pa'naiyamum karththarukkup parisuththamaakkappadum; athu pokkishamaaych searkkappaduvathum illai; pootti vaikkappaduvathum illai; karththarudaiya samukaththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'l thirupthiyaakach saappidavum nalla vasthirangka'laith tharikkavum athin viyaapaaram avarka'laich searum.
ithoa, karththar theasaththai ve'rumaiyum paazhumaakki, athaik kavizhththu, athin kudika'laich sitha'radippaar.

appozhuthu, janaththukku eppadiyoa appadiyea aasaariyanukkum, vealaikkaaranukku eppadiyoa appadiyea ejamaanukkum, vealaikkaarikku eppadiyoa appadiyea ejamaanikkum, ko'ndavanukku eppadiyoa appadiyea vit'ravanukkum, kadan koduththavanukku eppadiyoa appadiyea kadanvaangkinavanukkum, vattivaangkinavanukku eppadiyoa appadiyea vattikoduththavanukkum, ellaarukkum sariyaaka nadakkum.
theasam muzhuthum ko'l'laiyaaki, mut'rilum ve'rumaiyaakum; ithu karththar sonna vaarththai.
theasam pulampi vaadum; poomi saththuvamat'ru ularnthupoakum; theasaththu janaththilea uyarnthavarka'l thavippaarka'l.
theasam than kudika'lin moolamaayth theettuppattathu; avarka'l niyaayappiramaa'nangka'lai mee'ri, katta'laiyai maa'rupaadaakki, niththiya udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththaarka'l.
ithinimiththam saapam theasaththaip padchiththathu, athin kudika'l tha'ndikkappattaarka'l; theasaththaar thakikkappattaarka'l, silarmaaththiram meenthirukki'raarka'l.
thiraadcharasam thukkangko'ndaadum, thiraadchachsedi vathangkum; manakka'lippaayirunthavarka'l ellaarum perumoochchuviduvaarka'l.
mea'langka'lin santhoasham oayum, ka'likooruki'ravarka'lin santhadi ozhiyum, vee'naiyin ka'lippu nin'rupoam.
paadaloadea thiraadcharasam kudiyaarka'l; mathupaanam athaik kudikki'ravarka'lukkuk kasakkum.
ve'rumaiyaayppoana nakaram thakarnthu, oruvarum u'l'lea piraveasikkakkoodaathapadi, veeduka'lellaam adaipattukkidakkum.
thiraadcharasaththukkaaka veethika'lilea kookkural u'ndu; ellaach santhoashamum mangki, theasaththin makizhchchi at'ruppoam.
nakaraththil meethiyaayiruppathu azhivea; vaasalka'l idikkappattup paazhaayk kidakkum.

olivamaraththai ulukkumpoathum, thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'ruththuth theerumpoathum, pinpa'rippukkuk kogncham meenthiruppathupoala, theasaththukku'l'lum intha janangka'lin naduvilum kogncham meenthirukkum.
avarka'l saththamittuk kempeerippaarka'l; karththarudaiya makaththuvaththinimiththam samuththiraththinin'ru aarpparippaarka'l.
aakaiyaal karththarai, ve'lukkunthisaiyilum, isravealin theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththaich samuththirath theevuka'lilum makimaippaduththungka'l.

neethiparanukku makimai en'ru paadum keethangka'lai poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu keadki'roam; naanoa, i'laiththuppoanean, i'laiththuppoanean; enakku aiyoa! thuroakika'l thuroakampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; thuroakika'l mikuthiyaayth thuroakampa'n'nuki'raarka'l enki'rean.
theasaththuk kudika'lea, thikilum, padukuzhiyum, ka'n'niyum ungka'lukku nearidum.

appozhuthu, thikilin saththaththi'rku vilaki oaduki'ravan padukuzhiyil vizhuvaan; padukuzhiyilirunthu ea'ruki'ravan ka'n'niyil akappaduvaan; uyara irukkum mathakuka'l thi'ravu'ndu, poomiyin asthipaarangka'l kulungkum.
theasam no'rungkavea no'rungkum, theasam mu'riyavea mu'riyum, theasam asaiyavea asaiyum.
ve'riththavanaippoala theasam tha'l'laadi, oru kudilaippoalap peyarththuppoadappadum; athin paathakam athinmeal paaramaayirukkaiyaal, athu vizhunthupoam, ini ezhunthiraathu.
akkaalaththil karththar unnathamaana seanaiyai unnathaththilum, poomiyin raajaakka'laip poomiyilum visaarippaar.
avarka'l kepiyil eakamaayk kattu'ndavarka'laakach searnthu, kaavalil adaikkappattu, aneakanaa'l sen'rapinpu visaarikkappaduvaarka'l.
appozhuthu seanaika'lin karththar seeyoan malaiyilum erusaleamilum aa'lukaiseyvathaal, santhiran kalangkum, sooriyan naa'namadaiyum; avarudaiya moopparka'lukku munpaaka makimai u'ndaayirukkum.
karththaavea, neerea en theavan; ummai uyarththi, umathu naamaththaith thuthippean; neer athisayamaanavaika'laich seytheer; umathu poorva aaloasanaika'l saththiyamum u'ruthiyumaanavaika'l.
neer nakaraththai ma'nmeadum, ara'naana patta'naththaip paazhumaakkineer; anniyarin raajathaaniyai ooraayiraathapadikkum, en'raikkum kattappadaathapadikkum seytheer.
aakaiyaal palaththa janangka'l ummai makimaippaduththuvaarka'l; kodooramaana jaathika'lin nakaram umakkup payappadum.

kodooramaanavarka'lin see'ral mathilai moathiyadikki'ra peru ve'l'laththaippoal irukkaiyil, neer eazhaikkup pelanum, nerukkappaduki'ra e'liyavanukkuth thidanum, peruve'l'laththukkuth thappum adaikkalamum, veyilukku othungkum nizhalumaaneer.
va'radchiyaana idaththin kaangkai meakaththinaal tha'nivathupoal, anniyarin mummuraththaith tha'niyappa'n'nuveer; meakaththin nizhalinaal veyil tha'niki'rathupoal pelavantharin aaravaaram tha'niyum.

seanaika'lin karththar intha malaiyilea sakala janangka'lukkum oru virunthai aayaththappaduththuvaar; athu kozhumaiyaana pathaarththangka'lum, pazhamaiyaana thiraadcharasamum, oonum ni'namumu'l'la pathaarththangka'lum, the'lintha pazhamaiyaana thiraadcharasamum ni'raintha virunthaayirukkum.
sakala janangka'lmealumu'l'la mukkaattaiyum, sakala jaathika'laiyum moodiyirukki'ra moodalaiyum, intha malaiyilea akat'rippoaduvaar.

avar mara'naththai jeyamaaka vizhungkuvaar; karththaraakiya theavan ellaa mukangka'lilumirunthu ka'n'neeraith thudaiththu, thamathu janaththin ninthaiyaip poomiyiliraathapadikku mut'rilum neekkividuvaar; karththarea ithaich sonnaar.

akkaalaththilea: ithoa, ivarea nammudaiya theavan; ivarukkaakak kaaththirunthoam, ivar nammai iradchippaar; ivarea karththar, ivarukkaakak kaaththirunthoam; ivarudaiya iradchippinaal ka'likoornthu makizhuvoam en'ru sollappadum.
karththarudaiya karam intha malaiyilea thangkum; koo'lam erukka'laththil mithikkappaduvathupoala, moavaap avarkeezh mithikkappattuppoam.

neenthuki'ravan neenthuvatha'rkaakath than kaika'lai virippathupoal avar thamathu kaika'lai avarka'l naduvilea viriththu, avarka'l perumaiyaiyum, avarka'l kaika'lin sathisarppanaika'laiyum thaazhththividuvaar.
avar un mathilka'ludaiya uyarntha ara'naik keezhea tha'l'lith thaazhththith tharaiyilea thoo'laaka azhippaar.
akkaalaththilea yoothaatheasaththil paadappadum paattaavathu: pelanaana nakaram namakku u'ndu; iradchippaiyea atha'rku mathilum ara'numaaka ea'rpaduththuvaar.
saththiyaththaik kaikko'nduvaruki'ra neethiyu'l'la jaathi u'l'lea piraveasippatha'rkaaka vaasalka'laith thi'ravungka'l.
ummai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'nda manathaiyudaiyavan ummaiyea nampiyirukki'rapadiyaal, neer avanaip poora'na samaathaanaththudan kaaththukko'lveer.
karththarai en'ren'raikkum nampungka'l; karththaraakiya yeakoavaa niththiya kanmalaiyaayirukki'raar.
avar uyaraththilea vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'laiyum keezhea tha'l'luki'raar, uyarntha nakaraththaiyum thaazhththuki'raar; avar tharaimattum thaazhththi athu ma'n'naakumattum idiyappa'n'nuvaar.
kaal athai mithikkum, si'rumaiyaanavarka'lin kaalum e'limaiyaanavarka'lin adika'lumea athai mithikkum.
neethimaanudaiya paathai semmaiyaayirukki'rathu; makaa neethipararaakiya neer neethimaanudaiya paathaiyaich semmaippaduththuki'reer.
karththaavea, ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'lin vazhiyilea umakkuk kaaththirukki'roam; umathu naamamum, ummai ninaikkum ninaivum engka'l aaththuma vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rathu.

en aaththumaa iravilea ummai vaagnchikki'rathu; enakku'l irukki'ra en aaviyaal athikaalaiyilum ummaith theaduki'rean; ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l poomiyilea nadakkumpoathu poochchakkaraththukkudika'l neethiyaik kat'rukko'lvaarka'l.
thunmaarkkanukkuth thayaiseythaalum neethiyaik kat'rukko'l'laan; neethiyu'l'la theasaththilum avan aniyaayagnseythu karththarudaiya makaththuvaththaik kavaniyaatheapoaki'raan.

karththaavea, umathu kai oangkiyirukki'rathu, avarka'l athaik kaa'naathirukki'raarka'l; aanaalum umathu janaththukkaaka neer ko'nda vairaakkiyaththaikka'ndu vedkappaduvaarka'l; akkini ummudaiya saththurukka'laip padchikkum.
karththaavea, engka'lukkuch samaathaanaththaik katta'laiyiduveer; engka'l kiriyaika'laiyellaam engka'lukkaaka nadaththivaruki'ravar neerea.
engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummaiyallaamal vea'rea aa'ndavanmaar engka'lai aa'ndaarka'l; ini ummaimaaththiram saarnthu ummudaiya naamaththaip pirasthaapappaduththuvoam.
avarka'l seththavarka'l, jeevikkamaattaarka'l; maa'nda raadchathar thirumpa ezhunthiraarka'l; neer avarka'lai visaariththuch sangkariththu, avarka'l pearaiyum azhiyappa'n'nineer.
intha jaathiyaip perukappa'n'nineer; karththaavea, intha jaathiyaip perukappa'n'nineer; neer makimaippatteer, theasaththin ellai ellaavat'raiyum nedunthooraththil tha'l'livaiththeer.
karththaavea, nerukkaththil ummaith theadinaarka'l; ummudaiya tha'ndanai avarka'lmealirukkaiyil antharangka vea'nduthal seythaarka'l.
karththaavea, pea'rukaalam sameepiththirukkaiyil veathanaippattu, than ampaayaththil kooppiduki'ra karppavathiyaippoala, umakku munpaaka irukki'roam.
naangka'l karppamaayirunthu veathanaippattu, kaat'raip pet'ravarka'laippoal irukki'roam; theasaththil oru iradchippaiyum seyyamaattaathirukki'roam; poochchakkaraththukkudika'l vizhuki'rathumillai.

mariththa ummudaiyavarka'l pireathamaana ennudaiyavarka'loadea kooda ezhunthiruppaarka'l; ma'n'nilea thangkiyirukki'ravarka'lea, vizhiththuk kempeeriyungka'l; ummudaiya pani poo'nduka'linmeal peyyum panipoal irukkum; mariththoaraip poomi pu'rappadappa'n'num.
en janamea, nee poay un a'raika'lukku'l'lea piraveasiththu, un kathavuka'laip poottikko'ndu, sinam kadanthupoakumattum kognchanearam o'liththukko'l.

ithoa, poomiyinudaiya kudika'lin akkiramaththinimiththam avarka'lai visaarikkumpadi karththar thammudaiya sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvaruvaar; poomi than iraththappazhika'lai ve'lippaduththi, thannidaththil kolaiseyyappattavarka'lai ini moodaathirukkum.

akkaalaththilea karththar liviyaathaan ennum nee'nda paampai, liviyaathaan ennum koa'nalaana sarppaththaiyea, kadithum perithum palaththathumaana thamathu pattayaththaal tha'ndippaar; samuththiraththil irukki'ra valusarppaththaik kon'rupoaduvaar.
akkaalaththilea nalla thiraadcharasaththaith tharum thiraadchaththoattam u'ndaayirukkum; athaikku'riththup paadungka'l.
karththaraakiya naan athaik kaappaat'ri, adikkadi atha'rkuth tha'n'neerppaaychchi, oruvarum athaich seathappaduththaathapadikku athai iravumpakalum kaaththukko'lvean.
ukkiram ennidaththil illai; mudchediyaiyum nerignchilaiyum enakku viroathamaay yuththaththil ko'nduvaruki'ravan yaar? naan avaika'lmeal vanthu, avaika'lai eakamaayk ko'luththividuvean;
illaavittaal avan en pelanaip pat'rikko'ndu ennoadea oppuravaakattum; avan ennoadea oppuravaavaan.
yaakkoapu vearpat'ri, israveal pooththukkaayththu ulakaththaip palanaal nirappum naadka'l varum.
avar avanai adiththavarka'lai adiththathupoala ivanai adikki'raaroa? avarka'l kollappadum kolaiyaay ivan kollappaduki'raanoa?
theavareer janaththaith thuraththividukaiyil mattaay athanoadea vazhakkaaduki'reer; ko'ndalkaat'radikki'ra naa'lilea avar thammudaiya kadungkaat'rinaal athai vilakkividuki'raar.

aakaiyaal, athinaal yaakkoapin akkiramam nikkirakampa'n'nappadum; thoappuvikkirakangka'lum silaika'lum ini ni'rkaathapadi avarka'l palipeedangka'lin kalluka'laiyellaam no'rukkappatta su'n'naampu kalluka'laakkividumpoathu, avarka'ludaiya paavaththai avar akat'ruvaarenpathea athinaal u'ndaakum palan.

ara'naana nakaram avaantharaiyaakum, antha vaasasthalam tha'l'lu'ndu vanaantharaththaippoala vittuvidappattathaayirukkum; kan'rukkuttika'l angkea meaynthu, angkea paduththukko'ndu, athin thazhaika'laith thinnum.

athin koppuka'l ularumpoathu odinthupoam; sthireeka'l vanthu avaika'laik ko'luththividuvaarka'l; athu u'narvu'l'la janamalla; aakaiyaal athai u'ndaakkinavar atha'rku irangkaamalum, athai uruvaakkinavar atha'rkuk kirupaiseyyaamalum iruppaar.
akkaalaththilea, karththar aat'rangkaraiyin vi'laivuthodangki ekipthin nathimattum poaradippaar; israveal puththirarea, neengka'l ovvoruvaraaych searkkappaduveerka'l.

akkaalaththilea periya ekkaa'lam oothappadum; appozhuthu, aseeriyaa theasaththilea sitha'radikkappattavarka'lum, ekipthutheasaththilea thuraththividappattavarka'lum vanthu, erusaleamilu'l'la parisuththa parvathaththilea karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'luvaarka'l.

eppiraayeemudaiya ve'riyarin perumaiyaana kireedaththukku aiyoa, mathupaanaththaal mayakkamadainthavarka'lin sezhippaana pa'l'laththaakkudaiya kodumudiyinmealu'l'la alangkaara joadippu vaadippoakum pushpamea!

ithoa, thiraa'niyum vallamaiyumudaiya oruvan aa'ndavaridaththil irukki'raan; avan kalmazhaippoalavum, sangkaarap pusalpoalavum, pura'nduvaruki'ra peruve'l'lampoalavum vanthu, kaiyinaalea athaith tharaiyil tha'l'lividuvaan.
eppiraayeemudaiya ve'riyarin perumaiyaana kireedam kaalaal mithiththuppoadappadum.

sezhippaana pa'l'laththaakkudaiya kodumudiyinmealu'l'la alangkaara joadippaakiya vaadiya pushpam, paruvakaalaththukkumun pazhuththathum, kaa'nki'ravan paarththu, athu than kaiyil irukkumpoathea vizhungkuki'rathumaana muthal kaniyaippoala irukkum.
akkaalaththilea seanaika'lin karththar thamathu janaththil meethiyaanavarka'lukku makimaiyaana kireedamaakavum, alangkaaramaana mudiyaakavum,
niyaayam visaarikka udkaaruki'ravanukku niyaayaththin aaviyaakavum, yuththaththai athin vaasalmattum thiruppuki'ravarka'lin paraakkiramamaakavum iruppaar.

aanaalum ivarka'lum thiraadcharasaththaal mayangki, mathupaanaththaal vazhi thappippoaki'raarka'l; aasaariyanum theerkkatharisiyum mathupaanaththaal mathimayangki, thiraadcharasaththaal vizhungkappattu, saaraayaththinaal vazhithappi, theerkkatharisanaththil moasampoay, niyaayantheerkki'rathil ida'ruki'raarka'l.
poajanapeedangka'lellaam vaanthiyinaalum asuththaththinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; suththamaana idamillai.
avar yaarukku a'rivaip poathippaar? yaarukku upatheasaththai u'narththuvaar? paalma'ranthavarka'lukkum, mulai ma'rakkappa'n'nappattavarka'lukkumea.
ka'rpanaiyinmeal ka'rpanaiyum, ka'rpanaiyinmeal ka'rpanaiyum, piramaa'naththinmeal piramaa'namum, piramaa'naththinmeal piramaa'namum, ingkea kognchamum angkea kognchamumaam enki'raarka'l.
pariyaasa uthaduka'linaalum anniyapaashaiyinaalum intha janaththoadea peasuvaar.
ithuvea neengka'l i'laiththavanai i'laippaa'rappa'n'naththakka i'laippaa'ruthal; ithuvea aa'ruthal en'ru avarka'loadea avar sonnaalum keadkamaattoam enki'raarka'l.

aathalaal avarka'l poay, pinnittu vizhunthu, no'rungkumpadikkum, sikku'ndu pidipadumpadikkum, karththarudaiya vaarththai avarka'lukkuk ka'rpanaiyinmeal ka'rpanaiyum, ka'rpanaiyinmeal ka'rpanaiyum, piramaa'naththinmeal piramaa'namum, piramaa'naththinmeal piramaa'namum, ingkea kognchamum angkea kognchamumaaka irukkum.
aakaiyaal erusaleamilu'l'la intha janaththai aa'luki'ra ninthanaikkaararea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

neengka'l: mara'naththoadea udanpadikkaiyum, paathaa'laththoadea oppanthamum pa'n'ninoam; vaathai peruve'l'lamaayp pura'nduvanthaalum engka'lai a'nukaathu; naangka'l poyyai engka'lukku adaikkalamaakki, maayaiyin ma'raivilea vanthu adainthoam enki'reerka'lea.

aathalaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathaavathu: ithoa, asthipaaramaaka oru kallai naan seeyoanilea vaikki'rean; athu pareedchikkappattathum, vilaiyea'rappet'rathum, thida asthipaaramu'l'lathumaana moolaikkallaayirukkum, visuvaasikki'ravan patha'raan.
naan niyaayaththai noolum, neethiyaith thookkunoolumaaka vaippean; poy ennum adaikkalaththaik kalmazhai azhiththuvidum; ma'raividaththai jalappiravaakam adiththukko'ndupoakum.
neengka'l mara'naththoadu seytha udanpadikkai viruthaavaaki, neengka'l paathaa'laththoadu seytha oppantham ni'rkaatheapoam; vaathai pura'nduvarumpoathu athinkeezh mithikkappaduveerka'l.
athu pura'nduvanthamaaththiraththil ungka'lai adiththukko'ndupoam; athu naa'lthoa'rum iravumpakalum pura'nduvarum; athaippat'rip pi'rakkugnseythiyaik keadpathum sagnchalaththai u'ndaakkum.
kaal neettap padukkaiyin nee'lam poathaathu; moodikko'l'lap poarvaiyin akalamum poathaathu.

karththar thamathu kiriyaiyaakiya apoorvamaana kiriyaiyaich seyyavum, thamathu vealaiyaakiya apoorvamaana vealaiyai ni'raiveat'ravum, avar peraathseem malaiyilea ezhumpinathupoala ezhumpi, kipiyoanin pa'l'laththaakkil koapangko'ndathupoala koapangko'lvaar.

ippozhuthum ungka'l kattuka'l palaththuppoakaathapadikkup pariyaasampa'n'naathirungka'l; theasam anaiththinmealum nir'nayikkappatta sangkaaraththin seythiyaich seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraalea kea'lvippattirukki'rean.
sevikoduththu en saththaththaik kea'lungka'l; naan solvathaik kavaniththuk kea'lungka'l.
uzhuki'ravan vithaikki'ratha'rkaaka naa'lthoa'rum uzhuki'rathu'ndoa? than nilaththaik koththi naa'lthoa'rum parampadikki'rathu u'ndoa?

avan athai mealaaka niravinapinpu, athatha'rkeat'ra idaththil u'lunthaith the'liththu, seerakaththaith thoovi, muthaltharamaana koathumaiyaiyum therinthuko'nda vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum kampaiyum vithaikki'raan allavoa?
avanudaiya theavan avanai nan'raayp poathiththu, avanai u'narththuki'raar.
u'lunthu thoolaththaalea poaradikkappaduki'rathillai; seerakaththinmeal va'ndilin uru'laich sut'ra vidappaduki'rathumillai; u'lunthu koalinaalum seerakam milaat'rinaalum adikkappadum.
appaththukkuth thaaniyam idikkappadum; idaividaamal avan athaip poaradikki'rathillai; avan than va'ndilin uru'laiyaal athai nasukkuki'rathumillai, than kuthiraika'laal athai no'rukkuki'rathumillai.
ithuvum seanaika'lin karththaraalea u'ndaaki'rathu; avar aaloasanaiyil aachchariyamaanavar, seyalil makaththuvamaanavar.
thaaveethu vaasampa'n'nina nakaramaakiya ariyealea, ariyealea, aiyoa! varushaavarusham pa'ndikaika'lai anusariththuvanthaalum,
ariyealukku idukkam u'ndaakkuvean; appozhuthu thukkamum salippum u'ndaakum; athu enakku ariyealaakaththaan irukkum.
unnaich soozhap paa'layami'rangki, unnaith thet'ruka'laal mut'rikkaipoattu, unakku viroathamaakak koththa'langka'lai eduppippean.

appozhuthu nee thaazhththappattuth tharaiyilirunthu peasuvaay; un peachchup pa'ninthathaay ma'n'nilirunthu pu'rappattu, un saththam agnchanam paarkki'ravanudaiya saththaththaippoal tharaiyilirunthu mu'numu'nuththu, un vaakku ma'n'nilirunthu kasukusu en'ru uraikkum.
unmeal varuki'ra anniyarin thira'l podiththoo'laththanaiyaakavum, palavantharin thira'l pa'rakkum patharka'laththanaiyaakavum irukkum; athu thideeren'ru sadithiyaaych sampavikkum.
idika'linaalum, poomi athirchchiyinaalum, periya iraichchalinaalum, perungkaat'rinaalum, pusalinaalum, padchikki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyinaalum, seanaika'lin karththaraalea visaarikkappaduvaay.

ariyealinmeal yuththampa'n'nuki'ra thira'laana sakala jaathika'lum, athinmealum athin ara'nmealum yuththampa'n'ni, atha'rku idukka'n seyki'ra anaivarum, iraakkaalaththarisanamaakiya soppanaththaik kaa'nki'ravarka'lukku oppaayiruppaarka'l.

athu, pasiyaayirukki'ravan thaan pusikki'rathaakach soppanam ka'ndum, vizhikkumpoathu avan ve'rumaiyaayirukki'rathupoalavum, thaakamaayirukki'ravan, thaan kudikki'rathaakach soppanam ka'ndum, vizhikkumpoathu avan vidaayththuth thavanaththoadirukki'rathupoalavum seeyoan malaikku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nuki'ra thira'laana sakala jaathika'lum irukkum.
thariththunin'ru thikaiyungka'l; piramiththuk kooppidungka'l; ve'riththirukki'raarka'l, thiraadcharasaththinaal alla; tha'l'laaduki'raarka'l, mathupaanaththinaal alla.
karththar ungka'lmeal kananiththiraiyin aaviyai varappa'n'ni, ungka'l ka'nka'lai adaiththu, gnaanathirushdikkaararaakiya ungka'l theerkkatharisika'lukkum thalaivarka'lukkum mukkaadupoattaar.

aathalaal tharisanamellaam ungka'lukku muththirikkappatta pusthakaththin vasanangka'laippoalirukkum; vaasikka a'rinthirukki'ra oruvanukku athaik koduththu: nee ithai vaasi en'raal, avan: ithu ennaal koodaathu, ithu muththiriththirukki'rathu enpaan.
allathu vaasikkath theriyaathavanidaththil pusthakaththaik koduththu: nee ithai vaasi en'raal, avan: enakku vaasikkath theriyaathu enpaan.

intha janangka'l thangka'l vaayinaal ennidaththil searnthu, thangka'l uthaduka'linaal ennaik kanampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'l iruthayamoa enakkuth thooramaay vilakiyirukki'rathu; avarka'l enakkup payappaduki'ra payam manusharaalea poathikkappatta ka'rpanaiyaayirukki'rathu.

aathalaal ithoa, naan a'rputhamum aachchariyamumaana pirakaaramaaka intha janangka'lukku'l'lea oru athisayaththaich seyvean; avarka'ludaiya gnaanika'lin gnaanam kettu, avarka'ludaiya viveakika'lin viveakam ma'rainthupoakum en'ru aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

thangka'l aaloasanaiyaik karththarukku ma'raikkumpadikku ma'raividangka'lil o'liththu, thangka'l kiriyaika'lai anthakaaraththil nadappiththu: nammaik kaa'nki'ravar yaar? nammai a'riki'ravar yaar? enki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

aa, neengka'l evva'lavu maa'rupaadu'l'lavarka'l! kuyavan ka'lima'n'nukkuch samaanamaaka e'n'nappadalaamoa? u'ndaakkappattathu thannai u'ndaakkinavaraikku'riththu: avar ennai u'ndaakkinathillai en'rum; uruvaakkappattathu thannai uruvaakkinavaraikku'riththu: avarukkup puththiyillaiyen'rum sollaththakumoa?
innum kognchakkaalaththilallavoa leepanoan sezhippaana vayalve'liyaaka maa'rum; sezhippaana vayalve'li kaadaaka e'n'nappadum.
akkaalaththilea sevidar pusthakaththin vasanangka'laik keadpaarka'l; kurudarin ka'nka'l iru'lukkum anthakaaraththukkum neengkalaakip paarvaiyadaiyum.
si'rumaiyaanavarka'l karththarukku'l mikavum makizhnthu, manusharil e'limaiyaanavarka'l isravealin parisuththarukku'l ka'likooruvaarka'l.
kodiyan at'ruppoavaan, sakkanthakkaaran illaama'rpoavaan.

oru vaarththaiyinimiththam manushanaik kut'rappaduththi, niyaayavaasalil thangka'laik kadinthuko'l'luki'ravanukkuk ka'n'nivaiththu, neethimaanai nirnimiththamaayth thuraththi, ippadi akkiramagnseyya vakaitheaduki'ra yaavarum sangkarikkappaduvaarka'l.
aakaiyaal, aapirakaamai meettukko'nda karththar yaakkoapin vamsaththaik ku'riththu: ini yaakkoapu vedkappaduvathillai; ini avan mukam seththuppoavathumillai.

avan en karangka'lin seyalaakiya than pi'l'laika'lai than naduvilea kaa'numpoathu, en naamaththaip parisuththappaduththuvaarka'l; yaakkoapin parisuththarai avarka'l parisuththappaduththi, isravealin theavanukkup payappaduvaarka'l.
vazhuvippoaki'ra manathai udaiyavarka'l puththimaanka'laaki, mu'rumu'rukki'ravarka'l upatheasam kat'rukko'l'luvaarka'l.
paavaththoadea paavaththaik koottumpadi, ennai allaamal aaloasanaipa'n'ni, en aaviyai allaamal thangka'lai moodikko'l'lap paarkki'ravarka'lum,

en vaakkaik kea'laamal paarvoanin pelaththinaalea pelakkavum, ekipthin nizhalilea othungkavum vea'ndum en'ru ekipthukkup poaki'ravarka'lumaakiya murattaattamu'l'la puththirarukku aiyoa! en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
paarvoanudaiya pelan ungka'lukku vedkamaakavum ekipthinudaiya nizhalothukku ungka'lukku ilachchaiyaakavum irukkum.
avarka'l pirapukka'l soavaanilea poay, avarka'l sthaanaapathika'l aaneasmattum searuki'raarka'l.
aanaalum thangka'l sakaayaththukkum pirayoajanaththukkum uthavaamal, vedkaththukkum ninthaikkumea uthavum janaththinaalea yaavarum vedkappaduvaarka'l.

the'rkeapoaki'ra mirukajeevanka'lin paaram. thushdasingkamum, kizhachsingkamum, viriyanum, pa'rakki'ra ko'l'livaaychsarppamum varuki'rathum, nerukkamum idukkamum adaivikki'rathumaana theasaththukku, avarka'l kazhuthai ma'rika'ludaiya muthukinmeal thangka'l aasthika'laiyum, ottakangka'ludaiya muthukinmeal thangka'l pokkishangka'laiyum, thangka'lukku uthavaatha janaththa'ndaikku eat'rikko'ndupoaki'raarka'l.
ekipthiyar sakaayampa'n'nuvathu viyarththamum vee'numaam; aakaiyaal, summaayiruppathea avarka'lukkup pelan en'ru atha'rkaakak koo'ruki'rean.
ippozhuthu nee poay, ithu pi'rkaalaththukku en'ren'raikkum irukkumpadi, ithai avarka'lukku munpaaka oru palakaiyil ezhuthi, oru pusthakaththil varai.
ivarka'l kalakamu'l'la janangka'lum, poypeasuki'ra pi'l'laika'lum, karththarudaiya veathaththaik keadka manathillaatha puththirarumaayirukki'raarka'l.

ivarka'l tharisanakkaararai noakki: tharisanang kaa'navea'ndaam en'rum, gnaanathirushdikkaararai noakki: yathaarththamaay engka'lukkuth tharisanagnsollaamal, engka'lukku ithamaana so'rka'lai uraiththu, maayamaanavaika'laith thirushdiyungka'l en'rum,
neengka'l vazhiyai vittu, paathaiyinin'ru vilaki, isravealin parisuththarai engka'l munpaaka iraamal oayappa'n'nungka'l en'rum solluki'raarka'l.
neengka'l intha vaarththaiyai ve'ruththu, idukkamum thaa'rumaa'rum seyki'rathai nampi, athaich saarnthuko'l'luki'rapadiyaal,
intha akkiramam ungka'lukku uyarntha suvaril vizhap pithungkini'rki'rathum, thideeren'ru sadithiyaay idiyappoaki'rathumaana vedippaippoala irukkum en'ru isravealin parisuththar solluki'raar.

avarka'lai avar thappavidaamal udaiyumpadi kuyakkalaththai no'rukkuvathupoala avarka'lai no'rukkuvaar; aduppilea neruppu edukki'ratha'rkum, ku'laththilea tha'n'neer mo'l'luki'ratha'rkum no'rungkina thu'nduka'lil, oru oadaakilum akappadaatheapoam.

neengka'l mananthirumpi amarnthirunthaal iradchikkappaduveerka'l; amarikkaiyum nampikkaiyumea ungka'l pelanaayirukkum en'ru isravealin parisuththaraayirukki'ra karththaraakiya theavan solluki'raar; neengka'loa appadich seyya manathaayiraamal;

appadiyalla, kuthiraika'linmeal ea'ri oadippoavoam enki'reerka'l; appadiyea oadippoaveerka'l, veakamaana vaakanangka'linmeal ea'rippoavoam enki'reerka'l; appadiyea ungka'laith thuraththuki'ravarka'l veakamaayth thuraththuvaarka'l.

neengka'l malaiyuchchiyinmeal oru kampaththaippoalavum, meattinmeal oru kodiyaippoalavum meenthirukkumattaaka, oruvan payamu'ruththa aayirampearum, ainthupear payamu'ruththa neengka'l anaivarum oadippoaveerka'l.
aanaalum ungka'lukku irangkumpadi karththar kaaththiruppaar, ungka'lmeal manathurukumpadi ezhunthiruppaar; karththar neethiseyki'ra theavan; avarukkuk kaaththirukki'ra anaivarum paakkiyavaanka'l.

seeyoanaich searntha janangka'l erusaleamil vaasamaayiruppaarka'l; ini nee azhuthuko'ndiraay; un kooppiduthalin saththaththukku avar urukkamaay irangki, athaik keattavudanea unakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'luvaar.

aa'ndavar ungka'lukkuth thunpaththin appaththaiyum, upaththiravaththin tha'n'neeraiyum koduththaalum, un poathakarka'l ini orupoathum ma'rainthirukkamaattaarka'l; un ka'nka'l un poathakarka'laik kaa'num.
neengka'l valathupu'ramaaych saayumpoathum, idathupu'ramaaych saayumpoathum: vazhi ithuvea, ithilea nadavungka'l en'ru ungka'lukkup pinnaalea sollum vaarththaiyai ungka'l kaathuka'l keadkum.

un suroopangka'lai moodiya ve'l'liththakattaiyum, un vikkirakangka'lin pon aadaiyaapara'naththaiyum theettaaka e'n'ni, avaika'laith theettuppatta vasthirampoala e'rinthuvittu, athaich chee! poa enpaay.

appozhuthu nee nilaththil vithaikkum un vithaikku avar mazhaiyaiyum, nilaththin palanaakiya aakaaraththaiyum tharuvaar; athu kozhumaiyum pushdiyumaay irukkum; akkaalaththilea un aadumaaduka'l visthaaramaana meaychchalu'l'la sthalaththilea meayum;
nilaththai uzhuki'ra eruthuka'lum kazhuthaima'rika'lum, mu'raththinaalum thoot'rukkoodaiyinaalum thoot'rappatta rusiyu'l'la kappika'laith thinnum.
koapurangka'l vizhuki'ra makaa sangkaaraththin naa'lilea, uyaramaana sakala malaika'linmealum, uyaramaana sakala meaduka'linmealum aa'ruka'lum vaaykkaalka'lum u'ndaakum.

karththar thamathu janaththin mu'rivaik katti, athin adikkaayaththaik ku'namaakkum naa'lilea, santhiranudaiya ve'lichcham sooriyanudaiya ve'lichchaththaippoalavum, sooriyanudaiya ve'lichcham eazhaththanaiyaay eazhu pakalin ve'lichchaththaippoalavum irukkum.

ithoa, karththarudaiya naamam thooraththilirunthu varum; avarudaiya koapam eriki'rathum kanan'ru pukaiki'rathumaayirukkum; avarudaiya uthaduka'l sinaththaal ni'rainthu, avarudaiya naavu padchikki'ra akkinipoala irukkum.

naasam ennum salladaiyilea jaathika'lai arikkumpadikku avar oothum suvaasam kazhuththumattum ettuki'ra aat'ruve'l'laththaippoalavum, janangka'ludaiya vaayilea poattu alaikkazhikki'ra kadivaa'laththaippoalavum irukkum.

pa'ndikai aasarikkappadum iraaththiriyilea paaduki'rathupoalap paaduveerka'l; karththarudaiya parvathamaakiya isravealin kanmalaiya'ndaikkuppoaka naakasuraththoadea nadanthuvaruki'rapoathu makizhuki'rathupoala makizhuveerka'l.

karththar makaththuvamaanavar; thamathu saththaththaik keadkappa'n'ni, ukkira koapaththinaalum, padchikki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyinaalum, idi peruve'l'lam kalmazhaiyinaalum, thamathu puyaththin vallamaiyaik kaa'npippaar.
appozhuthu tha'ndaayuthaththinaal adiththa aseeriyan karththarudaiya saththaththinaalea no'rungku'ndupoavaan.
karththar avanmeal sumaththum aakkinaiththa'ndam sellumidamengkum, mea'langka'lum vee'naika'lum athinudan poakum; kodiya yuththangka'linaal avanai ethirththu yuththagnseyvaar.

thoappeath ea'rkanavea ea'rpaduththappattathu; raajaavukku athu aayaththappaduththappattathu; athai aazhamum visaalamumaakkinaar; veakumpadi akkiniyum mikuntha vi'rakumu'ndu; karththarin suvaasam kenthakath theeyaippoala athaik ko'luththum.

sakaayamadaiyumpadi isravealudaiya parisuththarai noakkaamalum, karththaraith theadaamalum, ekipthukkuppoay, kuthiraika'lmeal nampikkaivaiththu, irathangka'l aneakamaayiruppathinaal avaika'lai naadi, kuthiraiveerar makaa pelasaalika'laayiruppathinaal avarka'lai nampikko'ndirukki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

avarum gnaanamu'l'lavar; avar thammudaiya vaarththaika'lai ma'rukkaamal, theengku varappa'n'ni, theemai seyki'ravarka'lin veettukkum, akkiramakkaararukkuch sakaayagnseyki'ravarka'lukkum viroathamaaka ezhumpuvaar.

ekipthiyar theyvam alla, manusharthaanea; avarka'ludaiya kuthiraika'l aaviyalla, maamsanthaanea; karththar thamathu karaththai neettuvaar, appozhuthu sakaayam seyki'ravanum ida'ri, sakaayam pe'ruki'ravanum vizhunthu, anaivarum eakamaay azhinthupoavaarka'l.

karththar ennudanea sonnathu: singkamum paalasingkamum thangka'l iraiyaip pidiththirukkumpoathu kerchchiththu, thangka'lukku viroathamaayk kooppiduki'ra thira'laana meaypparin saththaththinaalea kalangkaamalum, avarka'l ama'liyinaalea pa'niyaamalum irukki'rathupoala, seanaika'lin karththar seeyoanmalaikkaakavum, athin meattukkaakavum yuththampa'n'na i'rangkuvaar.
pa'ranthu kaakki'ra padchika'laippoala, seanaika'lin karththar erusaleaminmeal aatharavaaka iruppaar; avar athaik kaaththuth thappappa'n'nuvaar; avar kadanthuvanthu athai viduvippaar.
israveal puththirarea, neengka'l mut'rilum vittuvilakinavaridaththil thirumpungka'l.
ungka'lukkup paavamaaka ungka'l kaika'l seythiruntha ve'l'li vikkirakangka'laiyum, pon vikkirakangka'laiyum, ungka'lil ovvoruvarum akkaalaththilea ve'ruththuviduveerka'l.

appozhuthu veeranudaiya pattayam allaatha pattayaththaalea aseeriyan vizhuvaan; neesanudaiya pattayam allaatha pattayamea avanaip padchikkum; avan pattayaththukkuth thappa oaduvaan; avan vaalipar kalainthupoavaarka'l.
avanudaiya kanmalai payaththinaal ozhinthupoam, avarka'ludaiya pirapukka'l kodiyaik ka'ndu kalangkuvaarka'l enpathai, seeyoanil neruppaiyum erusaleamil soo'laiyaiyumudaiya karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, oru raajaa neethiyaaka arasaa'luvaar; pirapukka'lum niyaayamaakath thuraiththanampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
avar kaat'rukku othukkaakavum, peruve'l'laththukkup pukalidamaakavum, va'ra'nda nilaththukku neerkkaalka'laakavum, vidaayththa poomikkup perungkanmalaiyin nizhalaakavum iruppaar.
appozhuthu kaa'nki'ravarka'lin ka'nka'l mangkalaayiraathu; keadki'ravarka'lin sevika'l kavaniththea irukkum.
pathat'ramu'l'lavarka'lin iruthayam a'rivai u'narnthuko'l'lum, thet'ruvaayarudaiya naavu thadaiyin'rith the'livaayp peasum.
moodan ini thayaa'lan en'ru mathikkappadaan; loapi ini uthaaran en'ru sollappaduvathumillai.

eanen'raal moodan, moodaththanaththaip peasuki'raan; avan iruthayam aniyaayaththai nadappikkum; avan maayampa'n'ni, karththarukku viroathamaay vipareetham peasi, pasiyu'l'la aaththumaavai ve'rumaiyaaka vaiththu, thaakamu'l'lavanukkuth thaakantheerkkaathirukki'raan.
loapiyin eththanangka'lum pollaathavaika'l; eazhaika'l niyaayamaayp peasumpoathu, avan ka'l'lavaarththaika'laalea e'liyavarka'laik kedukkumpadi theevinaika'lai yoasikki'raan.
thayaa'laku'namu'l'lavan thayaa'lamaanavaika'lai yoasikki'raan, thayaa'lamaanavaika'lilea nilaiththum irukki'raan.
sukajeevika'laakiya sthireeka'lea, ezhunthirunthu en vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; nirvisaaramaana kumaaraththika'lea, en vasanaththukkuch sevikodungka'l.
nirvisaarika'lea, oru varushamum sila naadka'lumaayth thaththa'lippeerka'l; thiraadchappalan at'ruppoam; a'ruppukkaalam varaathu.
sukajeevika'lea, nadungkungka'l; nirvisaarika'lea, thaththa'liyungka'l; udaiyai urinthu ka'lainthupoattu, araiyil irattaik kattikko'l'lungka'l.
sezhippaana vayalka'linimiththamum kanitharum thiraadchach sedika'linimiththamum maaradiththup pulampuvaarka'l.
en janaththinudaiya nilaththilum, ka'likoornthiruntha nakaraththilu'l'la santhoasham ni'raintha ellaa veeduka'lilum, mudchediyum nerignchilum mu'laikkum.

aramanai paazhaaka vidappadum, janam ni'raintha nakaram ve'rumaiyaakum, meadum thurukkamum en'raikkum kepika'laakum, avaika'l kaattukkazhuthaika'l ka'likkum idamaayum manthaika'lukku meaychchalidamaayum irukkum.
unnathaththilirunthu nammeal aavi oot'rappadumattum appadiyea irukkum; appozhuthu vanaantharam sezhippaana vayalve'liyaakum; sezhippaana vayalve'li kaadaaka e'n'nappadum.
vanaantharaththilea niyaayam vaasamaayirukkum, sezhippaana vayalve'liyilea neethi thangkiththarikkum.
neethiyin kiriyai samaathaanamum, neethiyin palan en'rumu'l'la amarikkaiyum sukamumaam.
en janam samaathaana thaaparangka'lilum, nilaiyaana vaasasthalangka'lilum, amaithiyaayth thangkum idangka'lilum kudiyirukkum.
aanaalum kaadu azhiya kalmazhai peyyum, antha nakaram makaa thaazhvaayth thaazhnthupoam.
maaduka'laiyum kazhuthaika'laiyum nadaththikko'ndupoay, neerva'lam porunthiya idangka'lilellaam vithai vithaikki'ra neengka'l paakkiyavaanka'l.

ko'l'laiyidappadaathirunthum, ko'l'laiyiduki'ravanum, thuroakampa'n'naathirukki'ravarka'lukkuth thuroakampa'n'nuki'ravanumaakiya unakku aiyoa! nee ko'l'laiyittu mudinthapinpu ko'l'laiyidappaduvaay; nee thuroakampa'n'nith theernthapinpu unakkuth thuroakampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
karththaavea, engka'lukku irangkum, umakkuk kaaththirukki'roam; theavareer kaalaiyil avarka'l puyamum, ikkattukkaalaththil engka'l iradchippumaayirum.
ama'liyin saththaththinaalea janangka'l alainthoadi, neer ezhunthirukkumpoathu jaathika'l sitha'radikkappaduvaarka'l.
vettukki'lika'l searkki'rathupoala ungka'l ko'l'lai searkkappadum; vettukki'lika'l kuthiththuth thiriki'rathupoala manushar athinmeal kuthiththuth thirivaarka'l.
karththar uyarnthavar, avar unnathaththil vaasamaayirukki'raar; avar seeyoanai niyaayaththinaalum neethiyinaalum nirappuki'raar.
poora'naradchippum gnaanamum a'rivum un kaalangka'ludaiya u'ruthiyaayirukkum; karththarukkup payappaduthalea athin pokkisham.
ithoa, avarka'ludaiya paraakkiramasaalika'l ve'liyilea ala'ruki'raarka'l; samaathaanaththu sthaanaapathika'l manangkasanthu azhuki'raarka'l.
paathaika'l paazhaayina; vazhippoakkar illai; udanpadikkaiyai mee'ruki'raan; nakarangka'lai ikazhchchipa'n'nuki'raan; manushanai e'n'naatheapoaki'raan.
theasam thukkiththu vidaayththirukki'rathu; leepanoan vedki vaaduki'rathu; saaroan vanaantharaththukku oppaaki'rathu; paasaanum karmealum paazhaakkappaduki'rathu.
ippozhuthu ezhuntharu'luvean, ippozhuthu uyaruvean, ippozhuthu meanmaippaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
patharaik karppanthariththuth thaa'ladiyaip pe'ruveerka'l; akkiniyaippoal ungka'l suvaasamea ungka'laip padchikkum.
janangka'l su'n'naampaippoala neet'rappaduvaarka'l; vettappatta mudchedika'laippoalath theeyil erikkappaduvaarka'l.
thooraththilu'l'lavarka'lea, naan seyki'rathaik kea'lungka'l; sameepaththilirukki'ravarka'lea, en paraakkiramaththai a'rinthuko'l'lungka'l enki'raar.

seeyoanilu'l'la paavika'l thikaikki'raarka'l; maayakkaararai nadukkam pidikki'rathu; padchikkum akkinikku munpaaka nammil thariththiruppavan yaar? niththiyajuvaalaikku munpaaka nammil thaaparippavan yaar enki'raarka'l.

neethiyaay nadanthu, semmaiyaanavaika'laip peasi, idukka'n seyvathaal varum aathaayaththai ve'ruththu, parithaanangka'lai vaangkaathapadikkuth than kaika'lai utha'ri, iraththagnsinthuvatha'rkaana yoasanaika'laik kea'laathapadikkuth than seviyai adaiththu, pollaappaik kaa'naathapadikkuth than ka'nka'lai mooduki'ravanevanoa,
avan uyarntha idangka'lil vaasampa'n'nuvaan; kanmalaika'lin ara'nka'l avanudaiya uyarntha adaikkalamaakum; avan appam avanukkuk kodukkappadum; avan tha'n'neer avanukku nichchayamaayk kidaikkum.
un ka'nka'l raajaavai makimai porunthinavaraakak kaa'num, thooraththilu'l'la theasaththaiyum paarkkum.
un manam payangkaraththai ninaivukoorum; ka'nakkan engkea? tha'ndalkaaran engkea? koapurangka'lai e'n'ninavan engkea?
unakku vi'langkaatha paashaiyaiyum, a'ritha'rkariya oruvithamaana peachchaiyumudaiya anthak kuroora janangka'lai ini nee kaa'naay.

nammudaiya pa'ndikaika'l aasarikkappadum nakaramaakiya seeyoanai noakkippaar; un ka'nka'l erusaleamai amarikkaiyaana thaaparamaakavum, peyarkkappadaatha koodaaramaakavum kaa'num; ini athin mu'laika'l en'raikkum pidungkappaduvathumillai, athin kayi'ruka'lil on'rum a'runthu poavathumillai.
makimaiyu'l'la karththar angkea namakku makaa visaalamaana nathika'lum aa'ruka'lumu'l'la sthalampoaliruppaar; valikki'ra padavu angkea oaduvathum illai; periya kappal angkea kadanthuvaruvathum illai.
karththar nammudaiya niyaayaathipathi, karththar nammudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nikar, karththar nammudaiya raajaa, avar nammai iradchippaar.
un kayi'ruka'l tha'larnthupoam; paaymaraththaik kettippaduththavum, paayai virikkavung koodaama'rpoam; appozhuthu thira'laana ko'l'laipporu'l pangkidappadum; sappaa'nika'lum ko'l'laiyaaduvaarka'l.
viyaathippattirukki'rean en'ru nakaravaasika'l solvathillai; athil vaasamaayirukki'ra janaththin akkiramam mannikkappattirukkum.
jaathika'lea, keadki'ratha'rkuk kittivaarungka'l; janangka'lea, kavaniyungka'l; poomiyum athin ni'raivum, poochchakkaramum athil u'rpaththiyaana yaavum keadkakkadavathu.

sakala jaathika'linmealum karththarudaiya kadungkoapamum, avaika'ludaiya sakala seanaika'linmealum avarudaiya ukkiramum moo'luki'rathu; avarka'laich sangkaaraththukku niyamiththu, kolaikku oppukkodukki'raar.
avarka'lilea kolaiseyyappattavarka'l ve'liyea e'riyu'ndukidappaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya pireathangka'l naat'ramedukkum; avarka'ludaiya iraththaththinaalea malaika'lum karainthupoam.

vaanaththin sarva seanaiyum karainthu, vaanangka'l pusthakachsuru'laippoal suruttappattu, avaika'lin sarvaseanaiyum thiraadchachsediyin ilaika'l uthiruki'rathupoalavum, aththimaraththin kaayka'l uthiruki'rathupoalavum uthirnthu vizhum.
vaanangka'lil en pattayam ve'riko'ndathu; ithoa, eathoaminmealum, naan sangkaaraththukku niyamiththa janaththinmealum, athu niyaayagnseyya i'rangkum.

poas'raavilea karththarukku oru yaakamum, eathoam theasaththilea makaa sangkaaramum u'ndu; karththarudaiya pattayam iraththaththaal thirupthiyaaki, ni'naththinaal poorikkin'rathu; aattukkuttika'l kadaakka'ludaiya iraththaththinaalum, aattukkadaakka'ludaiya ku'ndikkaayka'lin kozhuppinaalum thirupthiyaakum.
avaika'loadea kaa'ndaamirukangka'lum, rishapangka'loadea kaa'laika'lum vanthu madiyum; avarka'l theasam iraththave'riko'ndu, avarka'l ma'n ni'naththinaal kozhuththuppoam.
athu karththar pazhivaangkum naa'l, seeyoanudaiya vazhakkinimiththam pathila'likkum varusham.
athin aa'ruka'l pisinaakavum, athin ma'n kanthakamaakavum maa'ri, athin nilam eriki'ra keelaayppoam.
iravum pakalum athu aviyaathu; athin pukai en'ren'raikkum ezhumpum; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka athu paazhaayirukkum; sathaakaalam sathaakaalamaaka athai oruvarum kadanthupoavathillai.
naaraiyum mu'l'lampan'riyum athaich suthantharikkum, aanthaiyum kaakkaiyum athilea kudiyirukkum; athinmeal vettave'liyin noolaiyum, ve'rumaiyin thookkaiyum pidippaar.
raajyapaarampa'n'na athin meanmakka'lai azhaiththaal, angkea avarka'lil oruvarum iraarka'l; athin pirapukka'l anaivarum illaama'rpoavaarka'l.
athin aramanaika'lil mudchedika'lum, athin koattaika'lil kaagncho'rika'lum mudpoo'nduka'lum mu'laikkum; athu valusarppangka'lin thaaparamum, koattaanka'lin maa'likaiyumaayirukkum.
angkea kaattumirukangka'lum oarika'lum on'raiyon'ru santhiththu, kaattaattaik kaattaadu kooppidum; angkea saakkuruvika'lum thangki, i'laippaa'rum idaththaik ka'ndadaiyum.
angkea valloo'rum koodukatti, muttaiyittu, kugnchuporiththu, avaika'laith than nizhalilea koottikko'l'lum; angkea koo'lika'lum joadujoadaakach searum.
karththarudaiya pusthakaththilea theadi vaasiyungka'l; ivaika'lil on'rum ku'raiyaathu; ivaika'lil on'rum joadillaathiraathu; avarudaiya vaay ithaich sollit'ru; avarudaiya aavi avaika'laich searkkum.

avarea avaika'lukkuch seettuppoattaar; avarudaiya kaiyea athai avaika'lukku a'lavunoolaal pakirnthukoduththathu; avaika'l en'raikkum athaich suthanthariththuth thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka athilea sagncharikkum.
vanaantharamum va'ra'nda nilamum makizhnthu, kaduve'li ka'liththu, pushpaththaippoalach sezhikkum.

athu mikuthiyaaych sezhiththup pooriththu aananthakka'lippudan paadum; leepanoanin makimaiyum, karmeal saaroan enpavaika'lin alangkaaramum atha'rku a'likkappadum; avarka'l karththarudaiya makimaiyaiyum, namathu theavanudaiya makaththuvaththaiyum kaa'npaarka'l.
tha'larntha kaika'laith thidappaduththi, tha'l'laaduki'ra muzhangkaalka'laip palappaduththungka'l.

manam patha'ruki'ravarka'laip paarththu: neengka'l payappadaathirungka'l, thidanko'l'lungka'l; ithoa, ungka'l theavan neethiyaich sarikkattavum, ungka'l theavan pathila'likkavum varuvaar; avar vanthu ungka'lai iradchippaar en'ru sollungka'l.
appozhuthu kurudarin ka'nka'l thi'rakkappattu, sevidarin sevika'l thi'ravu'ndupoam.
appozhuthu mudavan maanaippoal kuthippaan; oomaiyan naavum kempeerikkum; vanaantharaththilea tha'n'neerka'lum, kaduve'liyilea aa'ruka'lum paaynthoadum.
vettaantharai tha'n'neerth thadaakamum, va'ra'nda nilam neeroot'ruka'lumaakum; valusarppangka'l thaapariththuk kidantha idangka'lilea pullum ko'rukkaiyum naa'nalum u'ndaakum.

angkea perumpaathaiyaana vazhiyum irukkum; athu parisuththa vazhi ennappadum; theettu'l'lavan athilea nadanthuvaruvathillai; antha vazhiyil nadakki'ravarka'l peathaiyaraayirunthaalum thisaikettup poavathillai.
angkea singkam iruppathillai; thushdamirukam angkea poavathumillai, angkea kaa'nappadavumaattaathu; meedkappattavarka'lea athil nadappaarka'l.

karththaraal meedkappattavarka'l thirumpi, aananthakka'lippudan paadi, seeyoanukku varuvaarka'l; niththiya makizhchchi avarka'l thalaiyinmealirukkum; santhoashamum makizhchchiyum adaivaarka'l; sagnchalamum thavippum oadippoam.

eseakkiyaa raajaa arasaa'nda pathinaalaam varushaththilea aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip yoothaavilirukki'ra ara'naana sakala patta'nangka'lukkum viroathamaay vanthu, avaika'laip pidiththukko'ndaan.

appozhuthu aseeriyaa raajaa laakeesilirunthu rapsaakkeayaip periya seanaiyoadea erusaleamukku eseakkiyaa raajaavinidaththil anuppinaan; avan vanthu va'n'naar thu'raiyin vazhiyilu'l'la mealku'laththuch saalakaththa'ndaiyilea nin'raan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeem ennum aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, sepnaa ennum sampirathiyum, aasaappin kumaaranaakiya yoavaak ennum ka'nakkanum avanidaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
rapsaakkea avarka'lai noakki: aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya makaaraajaavaanavar uraikki'rathum, neengka'l eseakkiyaavukkuch sollavea'ndiyathum ennaven'raal: nee nampiyirukki'ra intha nampikkai enna?
yuththaththukku manthiraaloasanaiyum vallamaiyum u'nden'ru solluki'raayea, athu vaayppeachcheayan'ri vea'ralla; nee ennai viroathikkumpadi yaarmeal nampikkai vaiththirukki'raay?

ithoa, nerintha naa'nalkoalaakiya antha ekipthai nampuki'raay; athinmeal oruvan saaynthaal, athu avan u'l'langkaiyil patturuvippoam; ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoan thannai nampuki'ra yaavarukkum appadiyea iruppaan.

nee ennidaththil: naangka'l engka'l theavanaakiya karththarai nampuki'roam en'ru solvaayaakil, avarudaiya meadaika'laiyum avarudaiya palipeedangka'laiyum allavoa eseakkiyaa akat'ri, yoothaavaiyum, erusaleamaiyum noakki: inthap palipeedaththinmun pa'niyungka'l en'raanea.
naan unakku ira'ndaayiram kuthiraika'laik koduppean; nee avaika'lmeal ea'raththakkavarka'laich sampaathikkakkoodumaanaal aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanoadea sapathangkoo'ru.

koo'raatheapoanaal, nee en aa'ndavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararil orea oru si'riya thalaivanudaiya mukaththai eppadith thiruppuvaay? irathangka'loadu kuthiraiveerarum varuvaarka'l en'ru ekipthaiyaa nampuki'raay?

ippozhuthum karththarudaiya katta'laiyillaamal inthath theasaththai azhikka vantheanoa? inthath theasaththukku viroathamaayp poay athai azhiththuppoadu en'ru karththar ennoadea sonnaarea en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu eliyaakkeemum sepnaavum yoavaakum, rapsaakkeayaippaarththu: ummudaiya adiyaaroadea seeriyapaashaiyilea peasum, athu engka'lukkuth theriyum; alangkaththilirukki'ra janaththin sevika'l keadka engka'loadea yoothapaashaiyilea peasavea'ndaam en'raarka'l.

atha'rku rapsaakkea: ungka'loadungkoodath thangka'l malaththaith thinnavum, thangka'l neeraik kudikkavum, alangkaththilea thangkiyirukki'ra purushara'ndaikkea allaamal, un aa'ndavana'ndaikkum, unna'ndaikkumaa, en aa'ndavan intha vaarththaika'laip peasa ennai anuppinaar en'ru solli;
rapsaakkea nin'ruko'ndu, yoothapaashaiyilea uraththasaththamaay: aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya makaaraajaavudaiya vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l.
eseakkiyaa ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadi paarungka'l; avan ungka'laith thappuvikkamaattaan.

karththar nammai nichchayamaayth thappuvippaar, intha nakaram aseeriyaa raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvathillai en'ru solli, eseakkiyaa ungka'laik karththarai nampappa'n'nuvaan; atha'rku idangkodaathirungka'l en'ru raajaa solluki'raar.
eseakkiyaavin sollaik kea'laathirungka'l. aseeriyaa raajaa solluki'rathaavathu: neengka'l ennoadea raajiyaaki, kaa'nikkaiyoadea ennidaththil vaarungka'l.

naan vanthu, ungka'laith thaaniyamum thiraadchaththoattamumu'l'la theasamum, appamum thiraadcharasamumu'l'la theasamumaakiya ungka'l theasaththukku oppaana theasaththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoakuma'lavum, avanavan than than thiraadchachsediyin kaniyaiyum, than than aththimaraththin kaniyaiyum pusiththu, avanavan than than ki'nat'rin tha'n'neeraik kudiyungka'l.

karththar nammaith thappuvippaar en'ru ungka'laip poathanaiseyya eseakkiyaavukkuch sevikodaathirungka'l; jaathika'ludaiya theavarka'lil yaaraavathu thangka'l theasaththai aseeriyaa raajaavin kaikkuth thappuviththathu'ndoa?
aamaath arpaath patta'nangka'lin theavarka'l engkea? sepparvaayeemin theavarka'l engkea? avarka'l samaariyaavai en kaikkuth thappuviththathu'ndoa?

karththar erusaleamai en kaikkuth thappuvippaar enpatha'rku, anthaththeasangka'ludaiya ellaath theavarka'lukku'l'lum thangka'l theasaththai en kaikkuth thappuviththavar yaar en'ru raajaa solluki'raar en'raan.
avarka'loa avanukku oru vaarththaiyaiyum pirathiyuththaramaakach sollaamal mavunamaayirunthaarka'l; avanukku ma'ruuththaravu sollavea'ndaam en'ru raajaa katta'laiyittirunthaan.

appozhuthu ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya eliyaakkeem ennum aramanai visaarippukkaaranum, sepnaa ennum sampirathiyum, aasaappin kumaaranaakiya yoavaak ennum ka'nakkanum, vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, eseakkiyaavinidaththil vanthu, rapsaakkeayin vaarththaika'lai avanukku a'riviththaarka'l.
raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa athaik keattapoathu, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, irattu uduththukko'ndu, karththarudaiya aalayaththil piraveasiththu,

aramanai visaarippukkaaranaakiya eliyaakkeemaiyum, sampirathiyaakiya sepnaavaiyum, aasaariyarka'lin moopparaiyum, aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa ennum theerkkatharisiyinidaththi'rku irattu uduththavarka'laaka anuppinaan.
ivarka'l avanai noakki: intha naa'l nerukkamum, ka'ndithamum, thoosha'namum anupavikki'ra naa'l; pi'l'laippea'ru noakkiyirukki'rathu; pe'ravoa pelan illai.

jeevanu'l'la theavanai ninthikkumpadi, aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya than aa'ndavanaal anuppappatta rapsaakkea sonna vaarththaika'lai umathu theavanaakiya karththar keattirukki'raar; umathu theavanaakiya karththar keattirukki'ra vaarththaika'linimiththam tha'ndanaiseyvaar; aakaiyaal, innum meethiyaayirukki'ravarka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappagnseyveeraaka en'ru eseakkiyaa sollachsonnaar en'raarka'l.
ivvithamaay eseakkiyaa raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar easaayaavinidaththil vanthu sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu easaayaa avarka'lai noakki: aseeriyaa raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar ennaith thooshiththathum neer keattathumaana vaarththaika'linaalea payappadaatheayum.

ithoa, avan oru seythiyaikkeattu, than theasaththukkuth thirumpuvatha'rkaana aaviyai naan avanukku'l anuppi, avanai avan theasaththilea pattayaththaal vizhappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar enpathai ungka'l aa'ndavanidaththil sollungka'l en'raan.
aseeriyaa raajaa laakeesaivittup pu'rappattaan en'ru kea'lvippattu, rapsaakkea thirumpippoay, avan lipnaavinmeal yuththampa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndaan.

appozhuthu, eththiyoappiyaavin raajaavaakiya thiraakkaa ummoadu yuththampa'n'nap pu'rappattaan en'ru sollak kea'lvippattaan; athaik keattapoathu avan eseakkiyaavinidaththukku sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi:

neengka'l yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, erusaleam aseeriyaa raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvathillai en'ru nee nampiyirukki'ra un theavan unnai eththavottaathea.
ithoa, aseeriyaa raajaakka'l sakala theasangka'laiyum sangkariththa seythiyai nee kea'lvippattirukki'raay; nee thappuvaayoa?
en pithaakka'l azhiththuvitta koasaanaiyum, aaraanaiyum, reathseappaiyum, thelaasaariliruntha eatheanin puththiraraiyum avarka'ludaiya theavarka'l thappuviththathu'ndoa?
aamaaththin raajaavum, arpaaththin raajaavum, sepparvaayeem eanaa eevaa patta'nangka'lin raajaavum engkea en'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
eseakkiyaa sthaanaapathika'lin kaiyiliruntha nirupaththai vaangki vaasiththaan; pinpu eseakkiyaa karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkup poay athaik karththarukku munpaaka viriththu,
karththarai noakki:

seanaika'lin karththaavea, kearupeenka'lin maththiyil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra isravealin theavanea, neer oruvarea poomiyin raajyangka'lukkellaam theavanaanavar; neer vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkineer.

karththaavea, umathu seviyaich saayththukkea'lum; karththaavea, neer umathu ka'nka'laith thi'ranthupaarum, sanakerip jeevanu'l'la theavanai ninthikkumpadikkuch solliyanuppina vaarththaika'laiyellaam kea'lum.
karththaavea, aseeriyaa raajaakka'l antha jaathika'laiyum, avarka'l theasaththaiyum naasamaakki,
avarka'ludaiya theavarka'lai neruppilea poattuvittathu meythaan; avaika'l theavarka'l allavea, manushar kaivealaiyaana maramum kallunthaanea; aakaiyaal avaika'lai nirththoo'liyaakkinaarka'l.
ippoathum engka'l theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer oruvarea karththar en'ru poomiyin raajyangka'lellaam a'riyumpadikku, engka'lai avan kaikku neengkalaakki iradchiyum en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa, eseakkiyaavukkuch solliyanuppinathu: isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakeripinimiththam nee ennai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaayea.

avanaikku'riththuk karththar solluki'ra vasanamaavathu: seeyoan kumaaraththiyaakiya kanniyaasthiree unnai ikazhnthu, unnaip parikaasampa'n'nuki'raa'l; erusaleam kumaaraththi un pinnaalea thalaiyaith thulukkuki'raa'l.
yaarai ninthiththuth thooshiththaay? yaarukku viroathamaay un saththaththai uyarththinaay? nee isravealin parisuththarukku viroathamaay allavoa un ka'nka'lai meattimaiyaay ea'reduththaay.

un oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu nee aa'ndavarai ninthiththu: en irathangka'lin thira'linaalea naan malaika'lin kodumudika'lukkum leepanoanin sikarangka'lukkum vanthu ea'rinean; athin uyaramaana keathurumarangka'laiyum, uchchithamaana theavathaaru virudchangka'laiyum naan vetti, uyarntha athin kadaisi ellaimattum, athin sezhumaiyaana vanamattum varuvean en'rum,
naan ki'na'ru vettith tha'n'neer kudiththean; en u'l'langkaalinaal ara'nippaana idangka'lin akazhika'laiyellaam va'ra'lavum pa'n'ninean en'rum sonnaay.

naan vekukaalaththukkumun athai niyamiththu, poorvanaadka'lmuthal athaith thittampa'n'ninean enpathai nee keattathillaiyoa? ippozhuthu nee ara'naana patta'nangka'laip paazhaana ma'nmeaduka'laakkumpadi naanea athaich sampavikkappa'n'ninean.

athinaalea avaika'lin kudika'l kaiyi'laiththavarka'laaki, kalangki vedkappattu, ve'liyin poo'ndukkum, pachchilaikkum, veeduka'linmeal mu'laikkum pullukkum, oangki va'larumun theeynthupoam payirukkum samaanamaanaarka'l.
un iruppaiyum, un poakkaiyum, un varavaiyum, nee enakku viroathamaayk kontha'likki'rathaiyum a'rivean.

nee enakku viroathamaayk kontha'liththu, veeriyampeasinathu en sevika'lil ea'rinapadiyinaalea, naan en thu'rattai un mookkilum, en kadivaa'laththai un vaayilum poattu, nee vantha vazhiyea unnaith thirumpappa'n'nuvean.

unakku adaiyaa'lamaayiruppathu ennaven'raal: intha varushaththilea thappip payiraaki'rathaiyum, ira'ndaam varushaththilea thaanaay vi'laiki'rathaiyum saappiduveerka'l; moon'raam varushaththiloa vithaiththu a'ruththu, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'lin kanika'laip pusippeerka'l.
yoothaa vamsaththaaril thappi meenthirukki'ravarka'l ma'rupadiyum keezhea vearpat'ri mealea kanikoduppaarka'l.
meethiyaayirukki'ravarka'l erusaleamilum, thappinavarka'l seeyoan malaiyilumirunthu pu'rappaduvaarka'l; seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vairaakkiyam ithaich seyyum.

aakaiyaal karththar aseeriyaa raajaavaikku'riththu: avan intha nakaraththukku'l piraveasippathillai; ithinmeal ampu eyvathumillai; itha'rku munpaakak keadakaththoadea varuvathumillai; itha'rku ethiraakak koththa'lam poaduvathumillai.
avan intha nakaraththukku'l piraveasiyaamal, thaan vanthavazhiyea thirumpippoavaan.
ennimiththamum en thaasanaakiya thaaveethinimiththamum, naan intha nakaraththai iradchikkumpadikku itha'rku aatharavaayiruppean enpathaik karththar uraikki'raar en'ru solliyanuppinaan.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan pu'rappattu, aseeriyarin paa'layaththil ladchaththe'npaththaiyaayiram pearaich sangkariththaan; athikaalamea ezhunthirukkumpoathu, ithoa, avarka'lellaarum seththa pireathangka'laayk kidanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu aseeriyaa raajaavaakiya sanakerip pirayaa'nappattuth thirumpippoay, niniveayil irunthuvittaan.

avan than theavanaakiya nisroakin koavililea pa'ninthuko'l'luki'rapoathu, avan kumaararaakiya athramaleakkum sareathsearum avanaip pattayaththinaal vettippoattu, araraath theasaththukkuth thappi oadippoanaarka'l; avan kumaaranaakiya esaraththoan avan pattaththi'rku vanthu arasaa'ndaan.

annaadka'lil eseakkiyaa viyaathippattu mara'naththukku eathuvaayirunthaan; appozhuthu aamoathsin kumaaranaakiya easaayaa ennum theerkkatharisi avanidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki: neer umathu veettukkaariyaththai ozhungkuppaduththum, neer pizhaikkamaatteer, mariththuppoaveer en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa than mukaththaich suvarppu'ramaakath thiruppikko'ndu, karththarai noakki:

aa karththaavea, naan umakku munpaaka u'nmaiyum mana uththamamumaay nadanthu, umathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seythean enpathai ninaiththaru'lum en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, eseakkiyaa mikavum azhuthaan.
appozhuthu easaayaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaavathu:

nee poay eseakkiyaavai noakki: un thakappanaakiya thaaveethin theavanaayirukki'ra karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, un vi'n'nappaththaik keattean; un ka'n'neeraik ka'ndean; ithoa, un naadka'loadea pathinainthu varusham koottuvean.
naan unnaiyum intha nakaraththaiyum aseeriyaa raajaavin kaikkuth thappuviththu, intha nakaraththukku aatharavaayiruppean.
ithoa, aakaasudaiya sooriya kadiyaaraththil paakaikkup paakai i'rangkina saayaiyaip paththuppaakai pinnittuth thiruppuvean en'raar.

thaam sonna intha vaarththaiyinpadi karththar seyvaar enpatha'rku ithu karththaraal unakku adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum en'ru sol en'raar; appadiyea kadiyaaraththil i'rangkiyiruntha sooriyasaayai paththuppaakai thirumpit'ru.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaa viyaathippattu, than viyaathi neengkich sosthamaanapoathu ezhuthivaiththathaavathu:
naan en poora'na aayusin varushangka'lukkuch searaamal paathaa'laththin vaasalka'lukkudpaduvean en'ru en naadka'l a'ruppu'nki'rapoathu sonnean.
karththarai, karththarai, naan ini uyiroadirukki'ravarka'lin theasaththilea tharisippathillai; ini pooloakak kudika'loadea irunthu manusharai naan kaa'npathillai.

en aayusu meayppanudaiya koodaaraththaippoala ennaivittup peyarnthupoaki'rathu; neyki'ravan paavai a'rukki'rathupoala en jeevanai a'rukkak kodukki'rean; ennaip paavilirunthu a'ruththuviduki'raar; in'ru iravukku'l'lea ennai mudivadaiyappa'n'nuveer.
vidiya'rkaalamattum naan e'n'namittukko'ndirunthean; avar singkampoala en elumpuka'laiyellaam no'rukkuvaar; in'ru iravukku'l'lea ennai mudivadaiyappa'n'nuveer en'ru solli,

namuttaippoalum, thakaivilaan kuruviyaippoalum koovinean, pu'raavaippoal pulampinean; en ka'nka'l uyarap paarkki'rathinaal pooththuppoayina; karththaavea, odungkippoaki'rean; en kaariyaththai mea'rpoattuk ko'l'lum en'rean.
naan ennasolluvean? avar enakku vaakku aru'linaar; anthappirakaaramea seythaar; en aayusin varushangka'lilellaam en aaththumaavin kasappai ninaiththu nadanthuko'lvean.
aa'ndavarea, ivaika'linaal manushar pizhaikki'raarka'l; ivaika'lellaam en uyirkku uyiraayirukki'rathu; ennaich sosthappadavum pizhaikkavumpa'n'nineer.

ithoa, samaathaanaththukkup pathilaaka makaa kasappu vanthirunthathu, theavareeroa en aaththumaavai neasiththu azhivin kuzhikku vilakkineer; en paavangka'laiyellaam umathu muthukukkup pinnaaka e'rinthuvitteer.
paathaa'lam ummaith thuthiyaathu, mara'nam ummaip poat'raathu; kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'l ummudaiya saththiyaththaith thiyaanippathillai.
naan in'ru seyki'rathupoala, uyiroadirukki'ravan, uyiroadirukki'ravanea, ummaith thuthippaan, thakappan pi'l'laika'lukku umathu saththiyaththaith therivippaan.
karththar ennai iradchikkavanthaar; aakaiyaal engka'l jeevanaa'lellaam karththarudaiya aalayaththilea en keethavaaththiyangka'lai vaasiththup paaduvoam en'ru ezhuthivaiththaan.
aththippazhaththu adaiyaik ko'nduvanthu, pi'lavaiyinmeal pat'ruppoadungka'l; appozhuthu pizhaippaar en'ru easaayaa solliyirunthaan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa: naan karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poavatha'rku adaiyaa'lam ennaven'ru keattirunthaan.

akkaalaththilea palaathaanin kumaaranaakiya meroathaakpalaathaan ennum paapiloanin raajaa, eseakkiyaa viyaathippattirunthu aaroakkiyamaanathaik kea'lvippattu, avanidaththi'rku nirupangka'laiyum vekumaanaththaiyum anuppinaan.

eseakkiyaa avarka'laik ka'ndu santhoashappattu, than pokkishasaalaiyaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyum, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum, nalla parima'lathailaththaiyum, than aayuthasaalai anaiththaiyum, than pokkishasaalaika'lil u'l'lathellaavat'raiyum avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaan; eseakkiyaa than aramanaiyilum, than raajyaththil engkum avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiyaatha poru'l on'rum illai.

appozhuthu easaayaa theerkkatharisi eseakkiyaa raajaavinidaththil vanthu: antha manushar enna sonnaarka'l, engkeayirunthu ummidaththil vanthaarka'l en'ru keattaan. atha'rku eseakkiyaa: paapiloan ennum thooratheasaththilirunthu ennidaththi'rku vanthaarka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avan: ummudaiya veettil ennaththaip paarththaarka'l en'ru keattaan. atha'rku eseakkiyaa: en veettilu'l'lathellaavat'raiyum paarththaarka'l; en pokkishangka'lil naan avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiyaatha poru'l on'rum illai en'raan.
appozhuthu easaayaa eseakkiyaavai noakki: seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vaarththaiyaik kea'lum.
ithoa, naadka'l varum; appozhuthu un veettil u'l'lathilum, un pithaakka'l innaa'lvaraikkum searththathilum on'rum meethiyaay vaikkappadaamal ellaam paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoakappadum.
nee pe'rappoaki'ra un santhathiyaakiya un kumaararilum silar paapiloan raajaavin aramanaiyilea aramanai vealaikkaararaayiruppaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu eseakkiyaa easaayaavai noakki: neer sonna karththarudaiya vaarththai nallathuthaan en'ru solli, en naadka'lilaavathu samaathaanamum u'nmaiyum irukkumea en'raan.
en janaththai aat'rungka'l, theat'rungka'l;

erusaleamudan padchamaayppeasi, athin poar mudinthathu en'rum, athin akkiramam nivirththiyaayit'ru en'rum, athu than sakala paavangka'linimiththamum karththarin kaiyil irattippaay adainthu theernthathu en'rum, atha'rkuk koo'rungka'l en'ru ungka'l theavan solluki'raar.
karththarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l, avaantharave'liyilea nammudaiya theavanukkup paathaiyaich sevvaipa'n'nungka'l en'rum,
pa'l'lamellaam uyarththappattu, sakala malaiyum kun'rum thaazhththappattu, koa'nalaanathu sevvaiyaaki, karadumuradaanavaich samamaakkappadum en'rum,
karththarin makimai ve'liyarangkamaakum, maamsamaana yaavum athai eakamaayk kaa'num, karththarin vaakku athai uraiththathu en'rum vanaantharaththilea kooppiduki'ra saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
pinnum kooppittuch sol en'ru oru saththam u'ndaayit'ru; ennaththaik kooppittuch solvean en'rean. atha'rku: maamsamellaam pullaippoalavum, athin meanmaiyellaam ve'liyin poovaippoalavum irukki'rathu.
karththarin aavi athinmeal oothumpoathu, pul ularnthu, poo uthirum; janamea pul.
pul ularnthu poo uthirum; namathu theavanudaiya vasanamoa en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum enpathaiyea sol en'ru uraiththathu.

seeyoan ennum suviseashakiyea, nee uyarntha parvathaththil ea'ru; erusaleam ennum suviseashakiyea, nee uraththa saththamittuk kooppidu, payappadaamal saththamittu, yoothaa patta'nangka'lai noakki: ithoa, ungka'l theavan en'ru koo'ru.

ithoa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar paraakkiramasaaliyaaka varuvaar; avar thamathu puyaththinaal arasaa'luvaar; ithoa, avar a'likkum palan avaroadeakooda varuki'rathu; avar kodukkum pirathipalan avarudaiya mukaththukku munpaakach selluki'rathu.
meayppanaippoalath thamathu manthaiyai meayppaar; aattukkuttika'laith thamathu puyaththinaal searththu, thamathu madiyilea sumanthu, ka'ravalaaduka'lai methuvaay nadaththuvaar.

tha'n'neerka'laith thamathu kaippidiyaal a'lanthu, vaanangka'lai jaa'na'lavaayp piramaa'niththu, poomiyin ma'n'nai marakkaalil adakki, parvathangka'laith thulaakkoalaalum, malaika'laith tharaasaalum ni'ruththavar yaar?
karththarudaiya aaviyai a'lavittu, avarukku aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthu, avarukkup poathiththavan yaar?

thamakku a'rivai u'narththavum, thammai niyaayavazhiyilea upatheasikkavum, thamakku gnaanaththaik kat'rukkodukkavum, thamakku viveakaththin vazhiyai a'rivikkavum, avar yaaroadea aaloasanaipa'n'ninaar?
ithoa, jaathika'l eat'rachsaalil thongkum thu'lipoalavum, tharaasilea padiyum thoosipoalavum e'n'nappaduki'raarka'l; ithoa, theevuka'lai oru a'nuvaippoal thookkuki'raar.
leepanoan erikkum vi'rakukkup poathaathu; athilu'l'la mirukajeevanka'l thakanapalikkum poathaathu.
sakala jaathika'lum avarukku munpaaka on'rumillai, avarka'l sooniyaththil sooniyamaakavum, maayaiyaakavum e'n'nappaduki'raarka'l.
ippadiyirukka, theavanai yaarukku oppiduveerka'l? enthach saayalai avarukku oppiduveerka'l?
kannaan oru suroopaththai vaarkki'raan, thattaan ponthakattaal athai moodi, atha'rku ve'l'lichsangkilika'laip porunthavaikki'raan.
atha'rkuk kodukka vakaiyillaathavan u'luththuppoakaatha maraththaith therinthuko'ndu, asaiyaatha oru suroopaththaich seyyumpadi nipu'nanaana oru thachchanaith theaduki'raan.
neengka'l a'riyeerka'laa? neengka'l kea'lvippadavillaiyaa? aathimuthal ungka'lukkuth therivikkappadavillaiyaa? poomi asthipaarappattathumuthal u'naraathirukki'reerka'laa?

avar poomi uru'ndaiyinmeal veet'rirukki'ravar; athin kudika'l vettukki'lika'laippoala irukki'raarka'l; avar vaanangka'lai melliya thiraiyaakap parappi, avaika'laik kudiyirukki'ratha'rkaana koodaaramaaka virikki'raar.
avar pirapukka'lai maayaiyaakki, poomiyin niyaayaathipathika'lai avaantharamaakkuki'raar.

avarka'l thirumpa naattappaduvathumillai, vithaikkappaduvathumillai; avarka'ludaiya adimaram thirumpap poomiyilea vearviduvathumillai; avarka'lmeal avar oothavea pattuppoavaarka'l; perungkaat'ru avarka'lai oru thurumpaippoal adiththukko'ndupoam.
ippadiyirukka, ennai yaarukku oppiduveerka'l? enakku yaarai nikaraakkuveerka'l? en'ru parisuththar solluki'raar.

ungka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaarungka'l; avaika'laich sirushdiththavar yaar? avar avaika'lin seanaiyai ilakkaththittamaakap pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avaika'laiyellaam pearpearaaka azhaikki'ravaraamea; avarudaiya makaa pelaththinaalum, avarudaiya makaa vallamaiyinaalum, avaika'lil on'rum ku'raiyaamalirukki'rathu.
yaakkoapea, isravealea: en vazhi karththarukku ma'raivaayit'ru en'rum, en niyaayam en theavanidaththil ettaamal poaki'rathu en'rum nee solvaanean?

poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'laich sirushdiththa karththaraakiya anaathitheavan soarnthupoavathumillai, i'laippadaivathumillai; ithai nee a'riyaayoa? ithai nee keattathillaiyoa? avarudaiya puththi aaraaynthu mudiyaathathu.
soarnthupoaki'ravanukku avar pelan koduththu, saththuvamillaathavanukkuch saththuvaththaip perukappa'n'nuki'raar.
i'laignar i'laippadainthu soarnthupoavaarka'l, vaaliparum ida'rivizhuvaarka'l.
karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'loa puthuppelan adainthu, kazhukuka'laippoalach settaika'lai adiththu ezhumpuvaarka'l; avarka'l oadinaalum i'laippadaiyaarka'l, nadanthaalum soarnthupoakaarka'l.

theevuka'lea, enakku munpaaka mavunamaayirungka'l; janangka'l thangka'l pelanaip puthithaakkikko'ndu, sameepiththu vanthu, pinpu peasakkadavarka'l; naam orumikka niyaayaasanaththukku munpaakach searuvoam.

kizhakkilirunthu neethimaanai ezhuppi, thamathu paathapadiyilea varavazhaiththavar yaar? jaathika'lai avanukku oppukkoduththu, avanai raajaakka'lukku aa'ndavanaakki, avarka'lai avan pattayaththukkuth thoosiyum, avan villukkuch sitha'radikkappatta thaa'ladiyumaakki,
avan avarka'laith thuraththavum, than kaalka'l nadavaathiruntha paathaiyilea samaathaanaththoadea nadakkavum pa'n'ninavar yaar?
athaich seythu ni'raiveat'ri, aathimutha'rko'ndu thalaimu'raika'lai varavazhaikki'ravar yaar? munthinavaraayirukki'ra karththaraakiya naanthaanea; pinthinavarka'loadum iruppavaraakiya naanthaanea.
theevuka'l athaik ka'ndu payappadum, poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'l nadungkum; avarka'l searnthuvanthu,
oruvarukku oruvar oththaasai seythu thidanko'l en'ru sakoatharanukkuch sakoatharan solluki'raan.

siththiravealaikkaaran thattaanaiyum, suththiyaalea melliya thakadu thattuki'ravan adaikallinmeal adikki'ravanaiyum u'rchaakappaduththi, isaikki'ratha'rkaana pakkuvamen'ru solli, athu asaiyaathapadikku avan aa'nika'laal athai i'rukkuki'raan.
en thaasanaakiya isravealea, naan therinthuko'nda yaakkoapea, en sineakithanaana aapirakaamin santhathiyea,
naan poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lilirunthu, unnai eduththu, athin ellaika'lilirunthu azhaiththuvanthu: nee en thaasan, naan unnaith therinthuko'ndean, naan unnai ve'ruththuvidavillai en'ru sonnean.
nee payappadaathea, naan unnudanea irukki'rean; thikaiyaathea, naan un theavan; naan unnaip palappaduththi unakkuch sakaayampa'n'nuvean; en neethiyin valathukaraththinaal unnaith thaangkuvean.
ithoa, unmeal erichchalaayirukki'ra yaavarum vedki ilachchaiyadaivaarka'l; unnoadea vazhakkaaduki'ravarka'l naasamaaki on'rumillaama'rpoavaarka'l.
unnoadea poaraadinavarka'laith theadiyum kaa'naathiruppaay; unnoadea yuththampa'n'nina manushar on'rumillaamal ilporu'laavaarka'l.
un theavanaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya naan un valathukaiyaip pidiththu: payappadaathea, naan unakkuth thu'naini'rki'rean en'ru solluki'rean.
yaakkoapu ennum poochchiyea, isravealin si'rukoottamea, payappadaathea; naan unakkuth thu'naini'rki'rean en'ru karththarum isravealin parisuththarumaakiya un meedpar uraikki'raar.
ithoa, poaradikki'ratha'rku naan unnaip puthithum koormaiyumaana pa'rka'lu'l'la yantharamaakkuki'rean; nee malaika'lai mithiththu no'rukki, kun'ruka'laip patharukku oppaakkividuvaay.

avaika'laith thoot'ruvaay, appozhuthu kaat'ru avaika'laik ko'ndupoay, suzhalkaat'ru avaika'laip pa'rakkadikkum; neeyoa karththarukku'l'lea ka'likoornthu, isravealin parisuththarukku'l'lea meanmaipaaraattik ko'ndiruppaay.

si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavarka'l tha'n'neeraith theadi, athu kidaiyaamal, avarka'l naavu thaakaththaal va'ra'lumpoathu, karththaraakiya naan avarka'lukkuch sevikoduththu, isravealin theavanaakiya naan avarka'laik kaividaathiruppean.
uyarntha meaduka'lil aa'ruka'laiyum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lin naduvea oot'ruka'laiyum thi'ranthu, vanaantharaththaith tha'n'neerth thadaakamum, va'ra'nda poomiyai neerkkea'nika'lumaakki,

vanaantharaththilea keathurumarangka'laiyum, seeththeemmarangka'laiyum, miruthuchsedika'laiyum, olivamarangka'laiyum nattu, avaantharave'liyilea theavathaaru virudchangka'laiyum, paaymaravirudchangka'laiyum, punnaimarangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'nuvean.
karththarudaiya karam athaich seythathu en'rum, isravealin parisuththar athaip padaiththaar en'rum, yaavarum ka'ndu u'narnthu sinthiththu a'rivaarka'l.
ungka'l vazhakkaik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; ungka'l palamaana niyaayangka'lai ve'lippaduththungka'l en'ru yaakkoapin raajaa uraikki'raar.

avarka'l avaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, sampavikkappoaki'ravaika'lai namakkuth therivikkattum; avaika'lil munthi sampavippavaika'l innavaika'len'ru solli, naam nammudaiya manathai avaika'linmeal vaikkumpadikkum, pinthi sampavippavaika'laiyum naam a'riyumpadikkum namakkuth therivikkattum; varungkaariyangka'lai namakku a'rivikkattum.

pinvarum kaariyangka'lai engka'lukkuth theriviyungka'l; appozhuthu neengka'l theavarka'l en'ru a'rivoam; allathu nanmaiyaavathu theemaiyaavathu seyyungka'l; appozhuthu naangka'l thikaiththu eakamaayk koodi athaip paarppoam.
ithoa, neengka'l sooniyaththilum sooniyamaayirukki'reerka'l; ungka'l seyal ve'rumaiyilum ve'rumaiyaanathu; ungka'laith therinthuko'l'luki'ravan aruvaruppaanavan.

naan vadakkeayirunthu oruvanai ezhumpappa'n'nuvean, avan varuvaan; sooriyoathaya thisaiyilirunthu en naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luvaan; avan vanthu athipathika'laich seat'raippoalavum, kuyavan ka'lima'n'nai mithippathupoalavum mithippaan.

naam athai a'riyumpadiyaaka aathiyil sonnavan yaar? naam avanai yathaarththavaan en'ru sollumpadi poorvakaalaththil a'riviththavan yaar? a'rivikki'ravan oruvanum illaiyea; uraikki'ravanum illaiyea; ungka'l vaarththaika'laik keattirukki'ravanum illaiyea.
muthal muthal, naanea, seeyoanai noakki: ithoa, avaika'laip paar en'ru solli, erusaleamukkuch suviseashakaraik kodukki'rean.
naan paarththean, avarka'lil a'rivikki'ravan oruvanumillai; naan keadkung kaariyaththukkup pirathiyuththaram kodukkaththakka oru aaloasanaikkaaranum avarka'lil illai.
ithoa, avarka'l ellaarum maayai, avarka'l kiriyaika'l viruthaa; avarka'ludaiya vikkirakangka'l kaat'rum ve'rumaiyunthaanea.

ithoa, naan aatharikki'ra en thaasan, naan therinthuko'ndavarum, en aaththumaavukkup piriyamaanavarum ivarea; en aaviyai avarmeal amarappa'n'ninean; avar pu'rajaathika'lukku niyaayaththai ve'lippaduththuvaar.
avar kookkuralidavumaattaar, thammudaiya saththaththai uyarththavum athai veethiyilea keadkappa'n'navumaattaar.
avar nerinthanaa'nalai mu'riyaamalum, mangkiyeriki'ra thiriyai a'naiyaamalum, niyaayaththai u'nmaiyaaka ve'lippaduththuvaar.
avar niyaayaththaip poomiyilea nilaippaduththumattum i'lakkarippathumillai, patha'ruvathumillai; avarudaiya veathaththukkuth theevuka'l kaaththirukkum.

vaanangka'laich sirushdiththu, avaika'lai viriththu, poomiyaiyum, athilea u'rpaththiyaaki'ravaika'laiyum parappinavarum, athil irukki'ra janaththukkuch suvaasaththaiyum, athil nadamaaduki'ravarka'lukku aaviyaiyum kodukki'ravarumaana karththaraakiya theavan solluki'rathaavathu:
neer kurudarudaiya ka'nka'laith thi'rakkavum, kattu'ndavarka'laik kaavalilirunthum, iru'lil irukki'ravarka'laich si'raichchaalaiyilirunthum viduvikkavum,
karththaraakiya naan neethiyinpadi ummai azhaiththu, ummudaiya kaiyaip pidiththu, ummaith tha'rkaaththu, ummai janaththi'rku udanpadikkaiyaakavum, jaathika'lukku o'liyaakavum vaikki'rean.
naan karththar, ithu en naamam; en makimaiyai vea'roruvanukkum, en thuthiyai vikkirakangka'lukkum kodean.
poorvakaalaththil therivikkappattavaika'l, ithoa, ni'raivea'ralaayina; puthiyavaika'laiyum naanea a'rivikki'rean; avaika'l thoan'raathatha'rku munnea, avaika'lai ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

samuththiraththil yaaththirai pa'n'nuki'ravarka'lea, athilu'l'lavaika'lea, theevuka'lea, avaika'lin kudika'lea, karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungka'l; poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu avarudaiya thuthiyaip paadungka'l.

vanaantharamum, athin oorka'lum, keathaariyar kudiyirukki'ra kiraamangka'lum uraththa saththamidakkadavathu; kanmalaika'lilea kudiyirukki'ravarka'l kempeeriththu, parvathangka'lin kodumudiyilirunthu aarpparippaarka'laaka.
karththarukku makimaiyaich seluththi, avar thuthiyaith theevuka'lil a'rivippaarka'laaka.
karththar paraakkiramasaaliyaippoal pu'rappattu, yuththaveeranaippoal vairaakkiyamoo'ndu, muzhangkik kerchchiththu, thammudaiya saththurukka'lai mea'rko'l'luvaar.
naan vekukaalam mavunamaayirunthean; summaayirunthu enakku'l'lea adakkikko'ndirunthean; ippozhuthu pi'l'lai pe'ruki'rava'laippoalach saththamittu, avarka'laip paazhaakki vizhungkuvean.
