naan malaika'laiyum kun'ruka'laiyum paazhaakki, avaika'lilu'l'la poo'nduka'laiyellaam vaadappa'n'ni, aa'ruka'laith thittuka'laakki, earika'lai vat'rippoakappa'n'nuvean.

kurudarai avarka'l a'riyaatha vazhiyilea nadaththi, avarka'lukkuth theriyaatha paathaika'lil avarka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, avarka'lukku munpaaka iru'lai ve'lichchamum, koa'nalaich sevvaiyumaakkuvean; inthak kaariyangka'lai naan avarka'lukkuch seythu, avarka'laik kaividaathiruppean.
siththiravealaiyaana vikkirakangka'lai nampi, vaarppikkappatta suroopangka'lai noakki: neengka'l engka'l theavarka'l en'ru solluki'ravarka'l pinnidainthu mikavum vedkappaduvaarka'l.
sevidarea, kea'lungka'l; kurudarea, neengka'l kaa'numpadi noakkippaarungka'l.
en thaasanaiyallaamal kurudan yaar? naan anuppiya thoothanaiyallaamal sevidan yaar? uththamanaiyallaamal kurudan yaar? karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaiyallaamal anthakan yaar?
nee aneaka kaariyangka'laik ka'ndum kavaniyaathirukki'raay; avanukkuch sevika'laith thi'ranthaalum kea'laathea poaki'raan.
karththar thamathu neethiyinimiththam avanmeal piriyam vaiththirunthaar; avar veathaththai mukkiyappaduththi athai makimaiyu'l'lathaakkuvaar.

intha janamoa ko'l'laiyidappattum, soo'raiyaadappattum irukki'raarka'l; avarka'l anaivarum kepika'lilea akappattu, kaavala'raika'lilea adaikkappattirukki'raarka'l; thappuvippaar illaamal ko'l'laiyaaki, vittuvidu enpaar illaamal soo'raiyaavaarka'l.
ungka'lil itha'rkuch sevikoduththup pinvaruki'rathaik kavaniththuk keadki'ravan yaar?

yaakkoapaich soo'raiyittu isravealaik ko'l'laikkaararukku oppukkodukki'ravar yaar? avarka'l paavagnseythu viroathiththa karththar allavoa? avarudaiya vazhika'lil nadakka manathaayiraamalum, avarudaiya veathaththukkuch sevikodaamalum poanaarka'lea.

ivarka'lmeal avar thamathu koapaththin ukkiraththaiyum, yuththaththin valimaiyaiyum varappa'n'ni, avarka'laichsoozha akkinijuvaalaika'laik ko'luththiyirunthum u'naraathirunthaarka'l; athu avarka'laith thakiththum, athai manathilea vaikkaatheapoanaarka'l.

ippoathum yaakkoapea, unnaich sirushdiththavarum, isravealea, unnai uruvaakkinavarumaakiya karththar solluki'rathaavathu: payappadaathea; unnai meettukko'ndean; unnaip pearsolli azhaiththean; nee ennudaiyavan.

nee tha'n'neerka'laik kadakkumpoathu naan unnoadu iruppean; nee aa'ruka'laik kadakkumpoathu avaika'l unmeal pura'luvathillai; nee akkiniyil nadakkumpoathu veakaathiruppaay; akkinijuvaalai unpearil pat'raathu.
naan isravealin parisuththarum, un iradchakarumaayirukki'ra un theavanaakiya karththar; unnai meedkumporu'laaka ekipthaiyum, unakku eedaaka eththiyoappiyaavaiyum seapaavaiyum koduththean.
nee en paarvaikku arumaiyaanapadiyinaal kanampet'raay; naanum unnaich sineakiththean, aathalaal unakkup pathilaaka manusharka'laiyum, un jeevanukku eedaaka janangka'laiyum koduppean.
payappadaathea, naan unnoadea irukki'rean; naan un santhathiyaik kizhakkilirunthu varappa'n'ni, unnai mea'rkilum irunthu koottichsearppean.
naan vadakkai noakki: kodu en'rum, the'rkai noakki: vaiththiraathea en'rum solli, thooraththilirunthu en kumaararaiyum, poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu en kumaaraththika'laiyum,
naan en makimaikken'ru sirushdiththu uruvaakkip padaiththu, en naamantharikkappatta yaavaraiyum ko'nduvaa enpean.
ka'nka'lirunthum kurudaraayirukki'ra janaththaiyum, kaathuka'lirunthum sevidaraayirukki'ravarka'laiyum pu'rappattu varappa'n'nungka'l.

sakala jaathika'lum eakamaaych searnthuko'ndu, sakala janangka'lum koodivarattum; ithai a'riviththu, munthi sampavippavaika'lai namakkuth therivikki'ravan yaar? keattu meyyen'ru sollakkoodumpadikku, avarka'l thangka'l saadchika'laik ko'nduvanthu yathaarththavaanka'laay vi'langkattum.

naanea avaren'ru neengka'l u'narnthu, ennai a'rinthu visuvaasikkumpadikku, neengka'lum naan therinthuko'nda en thaasanum enakkuch saadchika'laayirukki'reerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; enakkumun ea'rpatta theavan illai; enakkuppin iruppathum illai.
naan, naanea karththar; ennaiyallaamal radchakar illai.
naanea a'riviththu, iradchiththu, vi'langkappa'n'ninean; ungka'lil ippadich seyyaththakka anniya theavan illai; naanea theavan enpatha'rku neengka'l enakkuch saadchika'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naa'l u'ndaakaathatha'rku munnum naanea irukki'rean; en kaikkuth thappuvikkaththakkavan illai; naan seyki'rathaith thaduppavan yaar?

naan ungka'lukkaaka ara'nka'lellaam idinthuvizhavum, kaltheayar padavuka'lilirunthu ala'ravum seyyaththakkavarka'laip paapiloanukku anuppineanen'ru, ungka'l meedparum isravealin parisuththarumaakiya karththar solluki'raar.
naanea ungka'l parisuththaraakiya karththarum, isravealin sirushdikarum, ungka'l raajaavumaanavar.
samuththiraththilea vazhiyaiyum valiya tha'n'neerka'lilea paathaiyaiyum u'ndaakki,

irathangka'laiyum kuthiraika'laiyum iraa'nuvangka'laiyum paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avaika'l ezhunthiraathapadikku orumiththu vizhunthu kidakkavum, oru thiri a'naiki'rathupoal avaika'l a'nainthupoakavumpa'n'nuki'ra karththar solluki'rathaavathu:
munthinavaika'lai ninaikkavea'ndaam; poorvamaanavaika'laich sinthikkavea'ndaam.
ithoa, naan puthiya kaariyaththaich seyki'rean; ippozhuthea athu thoan'rum; neengka'l athai a'riyeerka'laa? naan vanaantharaththilea vazhiyaiyum, avaantharave'liyilea aa'ruka'laiyum u'ndaakkuvean.

naan therinthuko'nda en janaththin thaakaththukku vanaantharaththilea tha'n'neerka'laiyum avaantharave'liyilea aa'ruka'laiyum u'ndaakkuvathinaal, kaattumirukangka'lum, valusarppangka'lum, koattaan kugnchuka'lum ennaik kanampa'n'num.
intha janaththai enakken'ru ea'rpaduththinean; ivarka'l en thuthiyaich sollivaruvaarka'l.
aanaalum yaakkoapea, nee ennai noakkik kooppidavillai; isravealea, nee ennaikku'riththu managnsaliththuppoanaay.

un aaduka'laith thakanapalika'laaka nee enakkuch seluththavillai; un palika'laalea nee ennaik kanampa'n'navumillai; kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththumpadi naan unnaich sangkadappaduththaamalum, thoopangkaattumpadi unnai varuththappaduththaamalum irunthean.

nee enakkup pa'nangka'laal sukanthapattaiyaik ko'l'laamalum, un palika'lin ni'naththinaal ennaith thirupthiyaakkaamalum, un paavangka'linaal ennaich sangkadappaduththi, un akkiramangka'linaal ennai varuththappaduththinaay.
naan, naanea un mee'ruthalka'lai en nimiththamaakavea kulaiththuppoaduki'rean; un paavangka'lai ninaiyaamalum iruppean.
naam oruvaroadoruvar vazhakkaadumpadi enakku ninaippoottu; nee neethimaanaaka vi'langkumpadi un kaariyaththaich sol.
un aathithakappan paavagnseythaan; unakku munnin'ru peasuki'ravarka'lum enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
aakaiyaal, naan parisuththa sthalaththin thalaivarka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, yaakkoapaich saapaththukkum, isravealai ninthanaikkum oppukkoduppean.
ippoathum, en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapea, naan therinthuko'nda isravealea, kea'l.

unnai u'ndaakkinavarum, thaayin karppaththil unnai uruvaakkinavarum, unakkuth thu'naiseyki'ravarumaakiya karththar solluki'rathaavathu: en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapea, naan therinthuko'nda yeshooranea, payappadaathea.
thaakamu'l'lavanmeal tha'n'neeraiyum, va'ra'nda nilaththinmeal aa'ruka'laiyum oot'ruvean; un santhathiyinmeal en aaviyaiyum, un santhaanaththinmeal en aaseervaathaththaiyum oot'ruvean.
athinaal avarka'l pullin naduvea neerkkaalka'lin oaraththilu'l'la alarichsedika'laippoala va'laruvaarka'l.
oruvan, naan karththarudaiyavan enpaan; oruvan, yaakkoapinpearaith thariththukko'lvaan; oruvan, thaan karththarudaiyavan en'ru kaiyezhuththuppoattu, isravealin naamaththaith thariththukko'lvaan.
naan munthinavarum, naan pinthinavarunthaanea; ennaiththavirath theavan illaiyen'ru, isravealin raajaavaakiya karththarum, seanaika'lin karththaraakiya avanudaiya meedparum solluki'raar.

poorvakaalaththu janangka'lai naan sthaapiththathu mutha'rko'ndu, ennaippoala ethaiyaakilum varavazhaiththu, inninnathen'ru munna'riviththu, enakku munnea varisaiyaaka ni'ruththaththakkavan yaar? nikazhkaariyangka'laiyum varungkaariyangka'laiyum thangka'lukku avarka'l a'rivikkattum.

neengka'l kalangkaamalum payappadaamalum irungka'l; akkaalamutha'rko'ndu naan athai unakku vi'langkappa'n'ninathum munna'riviththathum illaiyoa? itha'rku neengka'lea en saadchika'l; ennaiththavirath theavanu'ndoa? vea'roru kanmalaiyum illaiyea; oruvanaiyum a'riyean.

vikkirakangka'lai uruvaakkuki'ra yaavarum vee'nar; avarka'laal ichchikkappattavaika'l on'rukkum uthavaathu; avaika'l on'rum kaa'naamalum, on'rum a'riyaamalum irukki'rathen'ru thangka'lukku vedkamu'ndaaka avaika'lukkuth thaangka'lea saadchika'laayirukki'raarka'l.
on'rukkum uthavaatha theyvaththai uruvaakki, vikkirakaththai vaarppikki'ravan eppadippattavan?
ithoa, avanudaiya koottaa'lika'lellaarum vedkamadaivaarka'l; thozhilaa'lika'l narajeevanka'lthaanea; avarka'l ellaarum koodivanthu ni'rkattum; avarka'l eakamaayth thikaiththu vedkappaduvaarka'l.

kollan irumpaik ku'rattaal idukki, ulaiyilea kaayavaiththu, suththika'laal athai uruvaakki, than puyapalaththinaal athaip pa'npaduththuki'raan; pattiniyaayirunthu pelanat'ruppoaki'raan; tha'n'neer kudiyaamal ka'laiththuppoaki'raan.

thachchan noolpidiththu, mattappalakaiyaal maraththukkuk ku'ripoattu, u'lika'linaal uruppaduththi, kavaraasaththinaal athai vakuththu, manushasaayalaaka manusharoopaththinpadi uruvamaakkuki'raan; athaik koavililea naatti vaikki'raan.

avan thanakkuk keathurukka'lai vettuki'raan; oru maruthamaraththaiyaavathu oru karvaalimaraththaiyaavathu, therinthuko'ndu, kaattumarangka'lilea pelaththa maraththaith than kaariyaththukkaaka va'larkki'raan; allathu asoakamaraththai naduki'raan, mazhai athai va'larachseyyum.

manushanukku avaika'l aduppukkaakumpoathu, avan avaika'lil eduththuk ku'lirkaayki'raan; neruppaimootti appamum suduki'raan; athinaal oru theyvaththaiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, athaip pa'ninthuko'l'luki'raan; oru vikkirakaththaiyum athinaal seythu, athai va'nangkuki'raan.

athil oru thu'ndai aduppil erikki'raan; oru thu'ndinaal i'raichchiyaich samaiththup pusiththu, poriyalaip poriththu thirupthiyaaki, ku'lirungkaaynthu: aaaa, analaanean; neruppaik ka'ndean en'ru solli;
athil meethiyaana thu'ndaith thanakku vikkirakatheyvamaakach seythu, atha'rkumun vizhunthu, athai va'nangki: nee en theyvam, ennai iradchikkavea'ndum en'ru athai noakki man'raaduki'raan.
a'riyaamalum u'naraamalum irukki'raarka'l; kaa'naathapadikku avarka'l ka'nka'lum, u'naraathapadikku avarka'l iruthayamum adaikkappattirukki'rathu.

athil paathiyai aduppil eriththean; athin thazhalinmeal appaththaiyum suttu, i'raichchiyaiyum poriththup pusiththean; athil meethiyaana thu'ndai naan aruvaruppaana vikkirakamaakkalaamaa? oru marakkattaiyai va'nangkalaamaa en'ru solla, than manathil avanukkuth thoan'ravillai; ammaaththiram a'rivum sora'naiyum illai.

avan saampalai meayki'raan; vagnchikkappatta manam avanai moasappaduththinathu; avan than aaththumaavaith thappuvikkaamalum: en valathu kaiyilea apaththam allavoa irukki'rathen'ru sollaamalum irukki'raan.
yaakkoapea, isravealea, ivaika'lai ninai; nee en thaasan; naan unnai uruvaakkinean; nee en thaasan; isravealea, nee ennaal ma'rakkappaduvathillai.
un mee'ruthalka'lai meakaththaippoalavum, un paavangka'laik kaarmeakaththaippoalavum akat'rivittean; ennidaththil thirumpu; unnai naan meettukko'ndean.

vaanangka'lea, ka'liththup paadungka'l; karththar ithaich seythaar; poothalaththin thaazhvidangka'lea, aarppariyungka'l; parvathangka'lea, kaaduka'lea, kaattilu'l'la sakala marangka'lea, kempeeramaay muzhangkungka'l; karththar yaakkoapai meettu, isravealilea makimaippaduki'raar.

un meedparum, thaayin karppaththil unnai uruvaakkinavarumaana karththar solluki'rathaavathu: naanea ellaavat'raiyum seyki'ra karththar; naan oruvaraay vaanangka'lai viriththu, naanea poomiyaip parappinavar.
naan kattukkathaikkaararin ku'rika'lai apaththamaakki, ku'risolluki'ravarka'lai nirmoodaraakki, gnaanika'lai vedkappaduththi, avarka'l a'rivaip paiththiyamaakap pa'n'nuki'ravar.

naan en oozhiyakkaararin vaarththaiyai nilaippaduththi, en sthaanaapathika'lin aaloasanaiyai ni'raiveat'ri: kudiyea'ruvaay en'ru erusaleamukkum, kattappaduveerka'l en'ru yoothaavin patta'nangka'lukkum solli, avaika'lin paazhaana sthalangka'lai eduppippavar.
naan aazhaththai noakki: vat'rippoa en'rum, un nathika'lai vettaantharaiyaakkuvean en'rum solluki'ravar.

koareasaik ku'riththu: avan en meayppan; avan erusaleamai noakki: nee kattappadu en'rum; theavaalayaththai noakki: nee asthipaarappadu en'rum solli, enakkup piriyamaanathaiyellaam ni'raiveat'ruvaan en'ru solluki'ravar naan.

karththaraakiya naan apisheakampa'n'nina koareasukku munpaaka jaathika'laik keezhppaduththi, raajaakka'lin idaikkattuka'lai avizhkkumpadikkum, avanukku munpaaka vaasalka'l poottappadaathirukka, kathavuka'laith thi'ranthuvaikkumpadikkum, avanaippaarththu, avan valathukaiyaip pidiththukko'ndu, avanukkuch solluki'rathaavathu:
naan unakku munnea poay, koa'nalaanavaika'laich sevvaiyaakkuvean.
unnaip peyarsolli azhaikki'ra isravealin theavanaakiya karththar naanea en'ru nee a'riyumpadikku,

ve'nkalak kathavuka'lai udaiththu, irupputh thaazhppaa'lka'lai mu'riththu, anthakaaraththil irukki'ra pokkishangka'laiyum, o'lippidaththil irukki'ra puthaiyalka'laiyum unakkuk koduppean; naan en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapinimiththamum, naan therinthuko'nda isravealinimiththamum, naan unnaip peyarsolli azhaiththu, nee ennai a'riyaathirunthum, unakku naamam thariththean.
naanea karththar, vea'roruvar illai; ennaiththavirath theavan illai.

ennaiththavira oruvarum illaiyen'ru sooriyan uthikki'ra thisaiyilum, athu asthamikki'ra thisaiyilum a'riyappadumpadikku nee ennai a'riyaathirunthum, naan unakku idaikkattu kattinean; naanea karththar, vea'roruvar illai.
o'liyaip padaiththu, iru'laiyum u'ndaakkinean, samaathaanaththaip padaiththuth theengkaiyum u'ndaakkuki'ravar naanea; karththaraakiya naanea ivaika'laiyellaam seyki'ravar.

vaanangka'lea, uyara irunthu soriyungka'l; aakaayama'ndalangka'l neethiyaippozhiyakkadavathu; poomi thi'ravu'ndu, iradchippin kaniyaiththanthu, neethiyungkooda vi'laivathaaka; karththaraakiya naan ivaika'lai u'ndaakkuki'rean.

ma'n'noaduka'lukkoththa oadaayirunthum, thannai uruvaakkinavaroadea vazhakkaaduki'ravanukku aiyoa! ka'lima'n thannai uruvaakkinavanai noakki: enna seyki'raayen'ru sollaththakumoa? un kiriyaiyaanathu: avarukkuk kaika'l illaiyen'ru sollalaamoa?
thakappanai noakki: ean janippiththaay en'rum, thaayai noakki: ean pet'raay en'rum solluki'ravanukku aiyoa!

isravealin parisuththarum avanai uruvaakkinavarumaakiya karththar solluki'rathaavathu: varungkaariyangka'lai ennidaththil kea'lungka'l; en pi'l'laika'laikku'riththum, en karangka'lin kiriyaika'laikku'riththum enakkuk katta'laiyidungka'l.
naan poomiyai u'ndupa'n'ni, naanea athinmeal irukki'ra manushanaich sirushdiththean; en karangka'l vaanangka'lai viriththana; avaika'lin sarvaseanaiyaiyum naan katta'laiyittean.

naan neethiyinpadi avanai ezhuppinean; avan vazhika'laiyellaam sevvaippaduththuvean; avan en nakaraththaik katti, si'raippattuppoana ennudaiyavarka'laik kirayamillaamalum parithaanamillaamalum viduthalaiyaakkuvaan en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

ekipthin sampaaththiyamum, eththiyoappiyaavin varththakalaapamum, nediya aadka'laakiya sapeayarin varththakalaapamum, unnidaththi'rkuth thaa'ndivanthu, unnudaiyathaakum; avarka'l un pinnea sen'ru, vilangkidappattu nadanthuvanthu: unnudanea maaththiram theavan irukki'raar en'rum, avaraiyallaamal vea'rea theavan illaiyen'rum solli, unnaip pa'ninthuko'ndu, unnai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
isravealin theavanum iradchakarumaakiya neer meyyaakavea ummai ma'raiththukko'ndirukki'ra theavanaayirukki'reer.
vikkirakangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuki'ra anaivarum vedkappattu ilachchaiyadainthu, eakamaayk kalangkippoavaarka'l.
isravealoa, karththaraalea niththiya iradchippinaal iradchikkappaduvaan; neengka'l en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum vedkappadaamalum kalangkaamalum iruppeerka'l.

vaanangka'laich sirushdiththup poomiyaiyum ve'rumaiyaayirukkach sirushdiyaamal athaik kudiyiruppukkaakach seythu padaiththu, athai uruvea'rpaduththina theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathaavathu: naanea karththar, vea'roruvar illai.

naan antharangkaththilum, poomiyin anthakaaramaana idaththilum peasinathillai; viruthaavaaka ennaith theadungka'len'ru naan yaakkoapin santhathikkuch sonnathumillai; naan neethiyaippeasi, yathaarththamaanavaika'lai a'rivikki'ra karththar.

jaathika'linin'ru thappinavarka'lea, koottangkoodi vaarungka'l; eakamaaych searungka'l; thangka'l vikkirakamaakiya maraththaich sumanthu, iradchikkamaattaatha theavanaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'l a'rivillaathavarka'l.

neengka'l therivikkumpadi searnthu, eakamaay yoasanaipa'n'nungka'l; ithaip poorvakaalamutha'rko'ndu vi'langkappa'n'ni, annaa'lthuvakki ithai a'riviththavar yaar? karththaraakiya naan allavoa? neethipararum iradchakarumaakiya ennaiyallaamal vea'rea theavan illai; ennaiththavira vea'roruvarum illai.
poomiyin ellaiyengkumu'l'lavarka'lea, ennai noakkippaarungka'l; appozhuthu iradchikkappaduveerka'l; naanea theavan, vea'roruvarum illai.

muzhangkaal yaavum enakku munpaaka mudangkum, naavu yaavum ennai munnittu aa'naiyidum en'ru naan ennaikko'ndea aa'naiyittirukki'rean; intha neethiyaana vaarththai en vaayilirunthu pu'rappattathu; ithu maa'ruvathu illaiyenki'raar.
karththaridaththilmaaththiram neethiyum vallamaiyumu'nden'ru avanavan solli avaridaththil vanthu searuvaan; avarukku viroathamaay erichchalko'ndirukki'ra yaavarum vedkappaduvaarka'l.
isravealin santhathiyaakiya yaavarum karththarukku'l neethimaanka'laakkappattu meanmaipaaraattuvaarka'l.

peal pa'niyum, neapoa kuniyum, avaika'lin vikkirakangka'l kaattumirukangka'lukkum naattumirukangka'lukkum sumaiyaakum; neengka'l sumantha sumaika'l i'laiththuppoana mirukangka'lukkup paaramaayirukkum.
avaika'l eakamaayk kuninthupa'niyum; sumaika'lai avaika'l thappuvikkamaattaathu; avaika'l thaamea si'raippattuppoakum.

yaakkoapin santhathiyaarea israveal santhathiyil meethiyaakiya sakala janangka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; thaayin vayit'ril thoan'rinathumuthal ungka'lai eanthi, thaayin karppaththil u'rpaththiyaanathumuthal ungka'laith thaangkinean.
ungka'l muthirvayathuvaraikkum naan appadich seyvean; naraivayathumattum naan ungka'laith thaangkuvean; naan appadich seythuvanthean; inimealum naan eanthuvean, naan sumappean, thappuvippean.
yaarukku ennaich saayalum samamumaakki, yaarukku naan oppaakumpadikku ennai oppiduveerka'l?

paiyilirukki'ra ponnaikkotti, ve'l'liyaith tharaasil ni'ruththu, thattaanudanea kooli poruththikko'l'luki'raarka'l; avan oru theyvaththai u'ndaakkuki'raan; athai va'nangkip pa'ninthuko'l'luki'raarka'l.

athaith thoa'linmeal eduththu, athaich sumanthu, athai athin sthaanaththilea vaikki'raarka'l; angkea athu ni'rkum; than idaththaivittu asaiyaathu; oruvan athai noakkik kooppittaal, athu ma'ruuththaravu kodukki'rathumillai, avan ikkattai neekki avanai iradchikki'rathumillai.
ithai ninaiththup purusharaayirungka'l; paathakarea, ithai manathil vaiyungka'l.
munthip poorvakaalaththil nadanthavaika'lai ninaiyungka'l; naanea theavan, vea'roruvarum illai; naanea theavan, enakkuch samaanamillai.

anthaththilu'l'lavaika'lai aathimutha'rko'ndum, innum seyyappadaathavaika'laip poorvakaalamutha'rko'ndum a'rivikki'rean; en aaloasanai nilaini'rkum, enakkuch siththamaanavaika'laiyellaam seyvean en'ru solli,

uraaygnchuki'ra oru padchiyaik kizhakkilirunthum, en aaloasanaiyai ni'raiveat'rum manushanaith thooratheasaththilirunthum varavazhaikki'ravaraayirukki'rean; athaich sonnean, athai ni'raiveat'ruvean; athaith thittampa'n'ninean, athaich seythu mudippean.
murattu iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lea, neethikkuth thooramaanavarka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l.
en neethiyaich sameepikkappa'n'nuki'rean, athu thooramaayiruppathillai; en iradchipputh thaamathippathumillai; naan seeyoanil iradchippaiyum, isravealukku en makimaiyaiyum katta'laiyiduvean.

paapiloan kumaaraththiyaakiya kannikaiyea, nee i'rangki ma'n'nilea udkaaru; kaltheayarin kumaaraththiyea, tharaiyilea udkaaru; unakkuch singkaasanamillai; nee serukkukkaariyum sukaselviyum en'ru ini azhaikkappaduvathillai.
eanthiraththai eduththu maavarai; un mukkaattai neekkividu; ve'rungkaalum amma'naththodaiyumaay aa'ruka'laik kadanthupoa.
un nirvaa'nam ve'lippadum; un ilachchai kaa'nappadum; naan oruvanaiyum paaraamal neethiyaich sarikkattuvean.
engka'l meedparudaiya naamam isravealin parisuththaraakiya seanaika'ludaiya karththar enpathu.
kaltheayarin kumaaraththiyea, nee anthakaaraththukku'l piraveasiththu mavunamaay udkaaru; ini nee raajyangka'lin naayakiyen'ru azhaikkappaduvathillai.

naan en janaththinmeal kadungkoapamadainthu, en suthantharaththaip parisuththak kulaichchalaakki, avarka'lai un kaiyil oppukkoduththean; nee avarka'lmeal irakkamvaiyaamal, muthirvayathu'l'lavarka'linmeal un nukaththai makaa paaramaakki,
en'ren'raikkum naayakiyaayiruppeanen'ru solli, inthakkaariyangka'lai ithuvaraikkum un manathilea vaiyaamalum, athin mudivai ninaiyaamalum poanaay.

ippozhuthum sukaselviyea, visaaramillaamal vaazhki'rava'lea: naanthaan, ennaiththavira oruvarumillai; naan vithavaiyaavathillai, naan santhaana seathaththai a'rivathillaiyen'ru un iruthayaththilea solluki'rava'lea, naan solluki'rathaik kea'l.

santhaana seathamum vithavaiyiruppum aakiya ivvira'ndum unakkuch sadithiyaaka oreanaa'lil varum; un thira'laana sooniyangka'linimiththamum, un vekuvaana sthampana viththaika'linimiththamum avaika'l poora'namaay unmeal varum.

un thunmaarkkaththilea nee thidanampikkaiyaayirunthu: ennaip paarkki'ravar oruvarum illaiyen'raay. un gnaanamum un a'rivumea unnaik keduththathu; naanthaan, ennaiththavira oruvarumillaiyen'ru un iruthayaththil e'n'ninaay.

aakaiyaal theengku unmeal varum, athu engkeayirunthu uthiththathen'ru nee a'riyaay; vikkinam unmeal varum, nee athai nivirththiyaakkamaattaay; nee a'riyaathapadikkuch sadithiyaay u'ndaakum paazhkkadippu unmeal varum.

nee un si'ruvayathumuthal pirayaasappattup pazhakivaruki'ra un sthampana viththaika'laiyum, un thira'laana sooniyangka'laiyum nee anusariththu nil; avaika'laal unakkup pirayoajanam u'ndoa, palan u'ndoa, paarppoam.

un thira'laana yoasanaika'linaal nee i'laiththuppoanaay; ippozhuthum joasiyarum, nadchaththiram paarkki'ravarka'lum, amaavaasi ka'nikki'ravarka'lum ezhumpi, unakku neariduki'ravaika'lukku unnai vilakki iradchikkattum.

ithoa, avarka'l thaa'ladiyaippoala iruppaarka'l, neruppu avarka'laich sutterikkum; avarka'l thangka'l piraa'nanai akkinijuvaalaiyinin'ru viduvippathillai; athu ku'lirkaayaththakka thazhalumalla; ethirea udkaaraththakka aduppumalla.
un si'ruvayathumuthal nee pirayaasappattu evarka'ludan viyaapaaram pa'n'ninaayoa, avarka'lum appadiyea iruppaarka'l; avaravar thangka'l poakkilea poay alaivaarka'l; unnai iradchippaar illai.

isravealennum peyarpet'ru, yoothaavin neeroot'rilirunthu suranthavarka'lum, karththarudaiya naamaththinmeal aa'naiyittu, u'nmaiyum neethiyum illaamal isravealin theavanai a'rikkaiyiduki'ravarka'lumaana yaakkoapin vamsaththaarea, kea'lungka'l.
avarka'l thangka'laip parisuththa nakaraththaar en'ru solli, seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'la isravealin theavanmeal pat'ruthalaayirukki'raarka'l.
poorvakaalaththil nadanthavaika'lai aathimuthal a'riviththean, avaika'l en vaayilirunthu pi'ranthana, avaika'lai ve'lippaduththinean; avaika'laich sadithiyaaych seythean, avaika'l nadanthana.
nee kadinamu'l'lavanen'rum, un pidari narampu irumpen'rum, un net'ri ve'nkalamen'rum a'rinthirukki'rean.

aakaiyaal: en vikkirakam avaika'laich seythathen'rum, naan seytha suroopamum, naan vaarppiththa vikkirakamum avaika'laik katta'laiyittathen'rum nee sollaathapadikku, naan avaika'lai munnamea unakku a'riviththu, avaika'l varaathatha'rkumunnea unakku ve'lippaduththinean.

avaika'laik kea'lvippattaayea, avaika'laiyellaam paar, ippozhuthu neengka'lum avaika'lai a'rivikkalaamallavoa? ithumuthal puthiyavaika'laanavaika'laiyum, nee a'riyaatha ma'raiporu'laanavaika'laiyum unakkuth therivikki'rean.
avaika'l aathimutha'rko'ndu alla, ippozhuthea u'ndaakkappattana; ithoa, avaika'lai a'rivean en'ru nee sollaathapadikku, innaadka'lukku munnea nee avaika'laik kea'lvippadavillai.

nee kea'lvippadavumillai, a'riyavumillai; aathimuthal un sevi thi'ranthirukkavumillai; nee thuroakampa'n'nuvaayenpathaiyum, thaayin karppanthodangki nee mee'ruki'ravanen'ru peyarpet'rathaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.
en naamaththinimiththam en koapaththai ni'ruththivaiththean; unnaich sangkarikkaathapadikku naan en pukazhchchiyinimiththam unmeal po'rumaiyaayiruppean.
ithoa, unnaip pudamittean; aanaalum ve'l'liyaippoalalla, upaththiravaththin kukaiyilea unnaith therinthuko'ndean.
ennimiththam, ennimiththamea, appadich seyvean; en naamaththin parisuththam eppadik kulaikkappadalaam? en makimaiyai naan vea'roruvarukkungkodean.
yaakkoapea, naan azhaiththirukki'ra isravealea, enakkuch sevikodu; naan avarea, naan munthinavarum, naan pinthinavarumaamea.
en karamea poomiyai asthipaarappaduththi, en valathukai vaanangka'lai a'lavittathu; naan avaika'lukkuk katta'laiyida, avaika'l anaiththum ni'rkum.

neengka'lellaarum koodivanthu kea'lungka'l; karththarukkup piriyamaanavan avarukkuch siththamaanathaip paapiloanil seyvaan; avan puyam kaltheayarinmeal irukkum enpathai ivarka'lil a'riviththavan yaar?
naan, naanea athaich sonnean; naan avanai azhaiththean; naan avanai varappa'n'ninean; avan vazhi vaaykkum.

neengka'l en sameepaththil vanthu, naan solvathaik kea'lungka'l; naan aathimutha'rko'ndu antharangkaththil peasavillai; athu u'ndaana kaalanthuvakki angkea naan irunthean; ippozhuthoa karththaraakiya aa'ndavarum, avarudaiya aaviyum ennai anuppuki'raar.

isravealin parisuththaraayirukki'ra un meedparaana karththar solluki'rathaavathu: pirayoajanamaayirukki'rathai unakkup poathiththu, nee nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyilea unnai nadaththuki'ra un theavanaakiya karththar naanea.
aa, en ka'rpanaika'laik kavaniththaayaanaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu un samaathaanam nathiyaippoalum, un neethi samuththiraththin alaika'laippoalum irukkum.
appozhuthu un santhathi ma'nalaththanaiyaakavum, un karppappi'rappu athin a'nukka'laththanaiyaakavum irukkum; appozhuthu athin peyar nammai vittu at'ruppoakaamalum azhikkappadaamalum irukkum.

paapiloanilirunthu pu'rappadungka'l; kaltheayaraivittu oadivaarungka'l; karththar thammudaiya thaasanaakiya yaakkoapai meettukko'ndaaren'ru sollungka'l; ithaik kempeerasaththamaayk koo'rip pirasiththappaduththungka'l, poomiyin kadaiyaantharamattum ve'lippaduththungka'l enki'raar.

avar avarka'lai vanaantharangka'lil nadaththumpoathu, avarka'lukkuth thaakavidaayirunthathillai; kanmalaiyilirunthu tha'n'neerai avarka'lukkuch surakkappa'n'ninaar, kanmalaiyaip pi'lanthaar, tha'n'neer oadivanthathu.
thunmaarkkarukkuch samaathaanam illaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.

theevuka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; thooraththilirukki'ra janangka'lea, kavaniyungka'l; thaayin karppaththilirunthathumuthal karththar ennai azhaiththu, naan en thaayin vayit'ril irukkaiyil en naamaththaip pirasthaapappaduththinaar.
avar en vaayaik koormaiyaana pattayamaakki, thamathu karaththin nizhalinaal ennai ma'raiththu, ennaith thulakkamaana ampaakki, ennaith thamathu ampa'raaththoo'niyilea moodivaiththaar.
avar ennai noakki: nee en thaasan; isravealea, naan unnil makimaippaduvean en'raar.

atha'rku naan: viruthaavaay uzhaikki'rean, vee'num viyarththamumaay en pelanaich selavazhikki'rean; aakilum en niyaayam karththaridaththilum, en palan en theavanidaththilum irukki'rathu en'ru sonnean.

yaakkoapaith thammidaththil thiruppumpadi naan thaayin karppaththilirunthathumuthal karththar thamakkuth thaasanaaka ennai uruvaakkinaar; isravealoa searaatheapoaki'rathu; aakilum karththarudaiya paarvaiyil kanamadaivean, en theavan en pelanaayiruppaar.

yaakkoapin koaththirangka'lai ezhuppavum, isravealil kaakkappattavarka'laith thiruppavum, neer enakkuth thaasanaayiruppathu a'rpakaariyamaayirukki'rathu; neer poomiyin kadaisipariyanthamum ennudaiya iradchippaayirukkumpadi, ummai jaathika'lukku o'liyaakavum vaippean enki'raar.

isravealin meedparum athin parisuththarumaakiya karththar, manusharaal asattaipa'n'nappattavarum, jaathiyaaraal aruvarukkappattavarum, athikaarika'lukku oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukki'ravarai noakki, u'nmaiyu'l'la karththar nimiththamum, ummaith therinthuko'nda isravealin parisuththar nimiththamum, raajaakka'l ka'ndu ezhunthirunthu, pirapukka'l pa'ninthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru solluki'raar.

pinnum karththar: anukkiraka kaalaththilea naan umakkuch sevikoduththu, iradcha'niyanaa'lilea umakku uthaviseythean; neer poomiyaich seerppaduththi, paazhaaykkidakki'ra idangka'laich suthantharikkappa'n'navum;

kattu'ndavarka'lai noakki: pu'rappattuppoangka'l en'rum; iru'lil irukki'ravarka'lai noakki: ve'lippadungka'l en'rum sollavum, naan ummaik kaappaat'ri, ummai janangka'lukku udanpadikkaiyaaka ea'rpaduththuvean; avarka'l vazhiyoarangka'lilea meayvaarka'l; sakala meaduka'lilum avarka'lukku meaychchal u'ndaayirukkum.

avarka'l pasiyaayiruppathumillai, thaakamaayiruppathumillai; ush'namaakilum, veyilaakilum avarka'lmeal paduvathumillai; avarka'lukku irangkuki'ravar avarka'lai nadaththi, avarka'lai neeroot'ruka'lidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoayviduvaar.
en malaika'laiyellaam vazhika'laakkuvean; en paathaika'l uyarththappadum.
ithoa, ivarka'l thooraththilirunthu varuvaarka'l; ithoa, avarka'l vadakkilum mea'rkilumirunthu varuvaarka'l; ivarka'l seeneem theasaththilumirunthu varuvaarka'l enki'raar.

vaanangka'lea, kempeeriththuppaadungka'l; poomiyea, ka'likooru; parvathangka'lea, kempeeramaay muzhangkungka'l; karththar thammudaiya janaththukku aa'ruthal seythaar; si'rumaippattirukki'ra thammudaiyavarka'lmeal irakkamaayiruppaar.
seeyoanoa: karththar ennaik kaivittaar, aa'ndavar ennai ma'ranthaar en'ru solluki'raa'l.
sthireeyaanava'l than karppaththin pi'l'laikku irangkaamal, than paalakanai ma'rappaa'loa? avarka'l ma'ranthaalum, naan unnai ma'rappathillai.
ithoa, en u'l'langkaika'lil unnai varainthirukki'rean; un mathilka'l eppoathum enmun irukki'rathu.
un kumaarar theeviriththuvaruvaarka'l; unnai nirmoolamaakkinavarka'lum unnaip paazhaakkinavarka'lum unnaivittup pu'rappattuppoavaarka'l.

un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuch sut'rilum paar; avarka'lellaarum eakamaayk koodi unnidaththil varuki'raarka'l; nee avarka'lellaaraiyum aapara'namaakath thariththu, ma'namaka'l a'ninthuko'lvathupoala, nee avarka'lai a'ninthuko'lvaay en'ru, en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar.
appozhuthu un vanaantharangka'lum, un paazhidangka'lum, nirmoolamaana un theasamum, inik kudika'lin thira'linaalea unakku nerukkamaayirukkum; unnai vizhungkinavarka'l thooramaavaarka'l.
pi'l'laika'lat'riruntha unakku u'ndaayirukkappoaki'ra pi'l'laika'l: idam engka'lukku nerukkamaayirukki'rathu; naangka'l kudiyirukkumpadikku vilakiyiru en'ru, un kaathuka'l keadkach solluvaarka'l.

appozhuthu nee: ivarka'lai enakkup pi'rappiththavar yaar? naan pi'l'laika'lat'rum, thaniththum, si'raippattum, nilaiyat'rum iruntheanea; ivarka'lai enakku va'larththavar yaar? ithoa, naan on'riyaay vidappattiruntheanea; ivarka'l engkeayirunthavarka'l? en'ru un iruthayaththil solluvaay.

ithoa, jaathika'lukku nearaaka en karaththai uyarththi, janangka'lukku nearaaka en kodiyai eat'ruvean; appozhuthu un kumaararaik kodungkaika'lil eanthikko'ndu varuvaarka'l; un kumaaraththika'l thoa'linmeal eduththukko'ndu varappaduvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

raajaakka'l unnai va'larkkum thanthaika'lum, avarka'ludaiya naayakika'l un kaiththaayka'lumaayiruppaarka'l; tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu unnaip pa'ninthu, un kaalka'lin thoo'lai nakkuvaarka'l; naan karththar, enakkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'l vedkappaduvathillai enpathai appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lvaay.
paraakkiraman kaiyilirunthu ko'l'laipporu'laip pa'rikkakkoodumoa? allathu neethiyaaych si'raippattuppoanavarka'lai viduvikkakkoodumoa?

en'raalum ithoa, paraakkiramanaal si'raippaduththappattavarka'lum viduvikkappaduvaarka'l; pelavanthanaal ko'l'laiyidappattathum viduthalaiyaakkappadum; unnoadu vazhakkaaduki'ravarka'loadea naan vazhakkaadi, un pi'l'laika'lai iradchiththukko'l'luvean;

unnai odukkinavarka'ludaiya maamsaththai avarka'lukkea thinnakkoduppean; mathupaanaththaal ve'riko'lvathupoal thangka'ludaiya iraththaththinaal ve'riko'lvaarka'l; karththarum yaakkoapin vallavarumaakiya naan un iradchakarum un meedparumaayirukki'rathai maamsamaana yaavarum a'rinthuko'lvaarka'len'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'raar: naan ungka'l thaayai anuppivittapoathu, ava'lukkuk koduththa tha'l'lutha'rseettu engkea? allathu enakkuk kadankoduththa evanukku ungka'lai naan vit'ruppoattean? ithoa, ungka'l akkiramangka'linimiththam neengka'l vi'rkappatteerka'l; ungka'l paathakangka'linimiththam ungka'l thaay anuppividappattaa'l.

naan vanthapoathu oruvanum illaama'rpoanathenna? naan kooppittapoathu ma'ruuththaravu kodukka oruvanum illaama'rpoanathenna? meedkakkoodaathapadikku en karam ku'rukit'roa? viduvikki'ratha'rku ennidaththil pelanillaama'rpoayit'roa? ithoa, en ka'ndithaththinaalea kadalai vat'rappa'n'ni, nathika'lai vettaantharaiyaakkippoaduki'rean; avaika'lilu'l'la meen tha'n'neerillaamal thaakaththaal seththu naa'rukin'rathu.
naan vaanangka'lukkuk kaariru'lai uduththi, irattai avaika'lin mooduseelaiyaakkuki'rean.

i'laippadainthavanukku samayaththi'rkeat'ra vaarththai solla naan a'riyumpadikku, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuk kalvimaanin naavaith thantharu'linaar; kaalaithoa'rum ennai ezhuppuki'raar; kat'rukko'l'luki'ravarka'laippoala, naan keadkumpadi en seviyaik kavanikkachseyki'raar.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enseviyaith thi'ranthaar; naan ethirkkavumillai, naan pinvaangkavumillai.
adikki'ravarka'lukku en muthukaiyum, thaadaimayiraip pidungkuki'ravarka'lukku en thaadaika'laiyum oppukkoduththean; avamaanaththukkum umizhneerukkum en mukaththai ma'raikkavillai.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuth thu'naiseyki'raar; aakaiyaal naan vedkappadean; naan vedkappattuppoavathillaiyen'ru a'rinthirukki'rean; aathalaal en mukaththaik ka'rpaa'raiyaippoalaakkinean.
ennai neethimaanaakkuki'ravar sameepamaayirukki'raar; ennoadea vazhakkaaduki'ravan yaar? eakamaay ni'rpoamaaka, yaar enakku ethiraa'li? avan ennidaththil varattum.

ithoa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuth thu'naiseyki'raar; ennai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkki'ravan yaar? ithoa, avarka'l ellaarum oru vasthiraththaippoalap pazhasaavaarka'l; pottuppoochchi avarka'lai arikkum.

ungka'lil evan karththarukkup payanthu, avarudaiya thaasanin sollaik keattu, thanakku ve'lichchamillaathathinaal iruttilea nadakki'raanoa, avan karththarudaiya naamaththai nampi, than theavanaich saarnthuko'l'lakkadavan.

ithoa, neruppaik ko'luththi, akkinippo'rika'laal soozhappattirukki'ra neengka'l anaivarum, ungka'l akkini theepaththilum, neengka'l moottina akkinijuvaalaiyilum nadavungka'l; veathanaiyil kidappeerka'l; en karaththinaal ithu ungka'lukku u'ndaakum.

neethiyaip pinpat'ri, karththaraith theaduki'ra neengka'l enakkuch sevikodungka'l; neengka'l vetti edukkappatta kanmalaiyaiyum, neengka'l thoa'ndi edukkappatta thuravin kuzhiyaiyum noakkippaarungka'l.
ungka'l thakappanaakiya aapirakaamaiyum, ungka'laip pet'ra saaraa'laiyum noakkippaarungka'l; avan oruvanaayirukkaiyil naan avanai azhaiththu, avanai aaseervathiththu, avanaip perukappa'n'ninean.

karththar seeyoanukku aa'ruthal seyvaar; avar athin paazhaana sthalangka'laiyellaam thea'ruthaladaiyach seythu, athin vanaantharaththai eatheanaippoalavum, athin avaantharave'liyaik karththarin thoattaththaippoalavum aakkuvaar; santhoashamum makizhchchiyum thuthiyum keethasaththamum athil u'ndaayirukkum.
en janangka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; en jaathiyaarea, en vaakkaik kavaniyungka'l; veatham ennilirunthu ve'lippadum; en piramaa'naththai janangka'lin ve'lichchamaaka sthaapippean.
en neethi sameepamaayirukki'rathu; en iradchippu ve'lippadum; en puyangka'l janangka'lai niyaayantheerkkum; theevuka'l enakkuk kaaththirunthu, en puyaththinmeal nampikkaiyaayirukkum.

ungka'l ka'nka'lai vaanaththukku ea'redungka'l, keezhea irukki'ra poomiyaiyum noakkippaarungka'l; vaanam pukaiyaippoal ozhinthupoam, poomi vasthiraththaippoal pazhasaayppoam; athin kudika'lum appadiyea ozhinthupoavaarka'l; en iradchippoa en'ren'raikkum irukkum; en neethi at'ruppoavathillai.

neethiyai a'rinthavarka'lea, en veathaththai iruthayaththil pathiththirukki'ra janangka'lea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l; manusharin ninthanaikkup payappadaamalum, avarka'l thoosha'nangka'laal kalangkaamalum irungka'l.

pottuppoochchi avarka'lai vasthiraththaippoal ariththu, puzhu avarka'lai aattumayiraippoal thinnum; ennudaiya neethiyoa en'ren'raikkum nilaikkum, en iradchipputh thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum irukkum.

ezhumpu, ezhumpu, pelanko'l; karththarin puyamea, munthinanaadka'lilum poorva thalaimu'raika'lilum ezhumpinapadi ezhumpu; iraakaapaith thu'ndiththathum valusarppaththai vathaiththathum neethaanallavoa?
makaa aazhaththin tha'n'neerka'laakiya samuththiraththai vat'rippoakappa'n'ninathum, meedkappattavarka'l kadanthupoakak kadalin pa'l'langka'lai vazhiyaakkinathum neethaanallavoa?

appadiyea karththaraal meedkappattavarka'l aananthakka'lippudan paadi seeyoanukkuth thirumpivaruvaarka'l; niththiya makizhchchi avarka'l thalaiyinmeal irukkum; santhoashamum makizhchchiyum adaivaarka'l; sagnchalamum thavippum oadippoam.

naan, naanea ungka'lukku aa'ruthal seyki'ravar; saakappoaki'ra manushanukkum, pullukkoppaaki'ra manupuththiranukkum payappaduki'ratha'rkum, vaanangka'lai viriththu, poomiyai asthipaarappaduththi, unnai u'ndaakkina karththarai ma'rakki'ratha'rkum nee yaar?
idukka'nseyki'ravan azhikka aayaththamaaki'rapoathu, nee avanudaiya ukkiraththukku niththam idaividaamal payappaduki'rathenna? idukka'nseyki'ravanudaiya ukkiram engkea?
si'raippattuppoanavan theeviramaay viduthalaiyaavaan; avan kidangkilea saavathumillai, avanudaiya appam ku'raivupaduvathumillai.
un theavanaayirukki'ra karththar naanea; alaika'l kontha'likkaththakkathaaych samuththiraththaik kulukkuki'ra seanaika'lin karththar enki'ra naamamu'l'lavar.

naan vaanaththai nilaippaduththi, poomiyai asthipaarappaduththi, seeyoanai noakki: nee en janamen'ru solvatha'rkaaka, naan en vaarththaiyai un vaayilea aru'li, en karaththin nizhalinaal unnai ma'raikki'rean.

ezhumpu, ezhumpu, karththarudaiya ukkiraththin paaththiraththai avar kaiyil vaangkik kudiththirukki'ra erusaleamea, ezhunthunil, thaththa'likkachseyyum paaththiraththin va'ndalka'lai u'rignchik kudiththaay.
ava'l pet'ra puththirarellaarilum ava'lai nadaththuvaar oruvarumillai; ava'l va'larththa kumaararellaarilum ava'laik kaikoduththu azhaippaar oruvarumillai.
ivvira'ndum unakkuch sampaviththathu; unakkup parithapikki'ravan yaar? paazhkkadippum, sangkaaramum, pagnchamum, pattayamum vanthana; yaaraikko'ndu unakku aa'ruthal seyvean?

un kumaarar moorchchiththu vizhunthaarka'l; avarka'l, valaiyilea sikku'nda kalaimaanaippoala, ellaa veethika'lin munaiyilum, karththarudaiya ukkiraththinaalum, un theavanudaiya ka'ndithaththinaalum ni'rainthavarka'laayk kidakki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal si'rumaippattava'lea, mathupaanangkudiyaamal ve'riko'ndava'lea, nee kea'l.

karththaraakiya un aa'ndavarum thammudaiya janaththukkaaka vazhakkaadappoaki'ra un theavanumaanavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, thaththa'lippin paaththiraththai un kaiyilirunthu neekkippoaduki'rean, ini en ukkiraththinudaiya paaththiraththin va'ndalka'lai nee kudippathillai.

unnai noakki: naangka'l kadanthupoakumpadikkuk kuniyen'rusolli, kadanthupoaki'ravarka'lukku nee un muthukaith tharaiyum veethiyumaakkumpadi, unnaich sagnchalappaduththinavarka'lin kaiyil athaik koduppean en'raar.

ezhumpu, ezhumpu, seeyoanea, un vallamaiyaith thariththukko'l; parisuththa nakaramaakiya erusaleamea, un alangkaara vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'l; viruththaseathanamillaathavanum asuththanum ini unnidaththil varuvathillai.
thoosiyai utha'rivittu ezhunthiru; erusaleamea, veet'riru; si'raippattuppoana seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, un kazhuththilu'l'la kattuka'lai avizhththu vidu.
vilaiyin'ri vi'rkappatteerka'l, pa'namin'ri meedkappaduveerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
poorvaththil en janangka'l thangkumpadi ekipthukkup poanaarka'l; aseeriyanum mukaantharamillaamal avarka'lai odukkinaan en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

ippozhuthu enakku ingkea enna irukki'rathu, en janangka'l viruthaavaayk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l; avarka'lai aa'luki'ravarka'l avarka'lai ala'rappa'n'nuki'raarka'l; niththamum idaividaamal en naamam thooshikkappaduki'rathu en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithinimiththam, en janangka'l en naamaththai a'rivaarka'l; ithaich solluki'ravar naanea en'ru akkaalaththilea a'rivaarka'l; ithoa, ingkea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

samaathaanaththaik koo'ri, na'rkaariyangka'laich suviseashamaay a'riviththu, iradchippaip pirasiththappaduththi: un theavan raajarikam pa'n'nuki'raaren'ru seeyoanukkuch solluki'ra suviseashakanudaiya paathangka'l malaika'linmeal evva'lavu azhakaayirukkin'rana.
un jaamakkaararudaiya saththam keadkappadum; avarka'l saththamittu eakamaayk kempeerippaarka'l; eanen'raal, karththar seeyoanaith thirumpivarappa'n'numpoathu, athaik ka'n'naarak kaa'npaarka'l.
erusaleamin paazhaana sthalangka'lea, muzhangki eakamaayk kempeeriththup paadungka'l; karththar thammudaiya janangka'lukku aa'ruthalseythu erusaleamai meettukko'ndaar.

ellaa jaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum karththar thammudaiya parisuththa puyaththai ve'lippaduththuvaar; poomiyin ellaika'lil u'l'lavarka'lellaarum namathu theavanudaiya iradchippaik kaa'npaarka'l.

pu'rappadungka'l, pu'rappadungka'l, avvidamvittup poangka'l; asuththamaanathaith thodaathirungka'l; karththarudaiya paaththirangka'laich sumakki'ravarka'lea, athin naduvilirunthu pu'rappattu ungka'laich suththikariyungka'l.

neengka'l theeviriththup pu'rappaduvathillai; neengka'l oadippoaki'ravarka'lpoala oadippoavathumillai; karththar ungka'l munnea poavaar; isravealin theavan ungka'l pi'rakea ungka'laik kaakki'ravaraayiruppaar.
ithoa, en thaasan gnaanamaay nadappaar, avar uyarththappattu, meanmaiyum makaa unnathamumaayiruppaar.
manushanaippaarkkilum avarudaiya mukappaarvaiyum, manupuththiraraippaarkkilum avarudaiya roopamum, ivva'lavu anthakkeadu adainthapadiyinaalea, avaraikka'nda aneakar piramippadainthaarka'l.

appadiyea, avar aneakam jaathika'lmeal the'lippaar; avar nimiththam raajaakka'l thangka'l vaayai mooduvaarka'l; eanenil, thangka'lukkuth therivikkappadaathirunthathai avarka'l kaa'npaarka'l; kea'lvippadaathirunthathai avarka'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
engka'l moolamaayk kea'lvippattathai visuvaasiththavan yaar? karththarudaiya puyam yaarukku ve'lippattathu?

i'langki'laiyaippoalavum, va'ra'nda nilaththilirunthu thu'lirkki'ra vearaippoalavum avanukku munpaaka ezhumpuki'raar; avarukku azhakumillai, saunthariyamumillai; avaraip paarkkumpoathu, naam avarai virumpaththakka roopam avarukku illaathirunthathu.

avar asattaipa'n'nappattavarum, manusharaal pu'rakka'nikkappattavarum, thukkam ni'rainthavarum, paadu anupaviththavarumaayirunthaar; avaraivittu, nammudaiya mukangka'lai ma'raiththukko'ndoam; avar asattaipa'n'nappattirunthaar; avarai e'n'naama'rpoanoam.
meyyaakavea avar nammudaiya paaduka'lai eat'rukko'ndu, nammudaiya thukkangka'laich sumanthaar; naamoa, avar theavanaal adipattu vaathikkappattu, si'rumaippattavaren'ru e'n'ninoam.

nammudaiya mee'ruthalka'linimiththam avar kaayappattu, nammudaiya akkiramangka'linimiththam avar no'rukkappattaar; namakkuch samaathaanaththai u'ndupa'n'num aakkinai avarmeal vanthathu; avarudaiya thazhumpuka'laal ku'namaaki'roam.
naamellaarum aaduka'laippoala vazhithappith thirinthu, avanavan than than vazhiyilea poanoam; karththaroa nammellaarudaiya akkiramaththaiyum avarmeal vizhappa'n'ninaar.

avar nerukkappattum odukkappattum irunthaar, aanaalum thammudaiya vaayai avar thi'rakkavillai; adikkappadumpadi ko'ndupoakappaduki'ra oru aattukkuttiyaippoalavum, thannai mayirkaththarikki'ravanukku munpaakach saththamidaathirukki'ra aattaippoalavum, avar thammudaiya vaayaith thi'ravaathirunthaar.

idukka'nilum niyaayaththeerppilumirunthu avar edukkappattaar; avarudaiya vamsaththai yaaraal solli mudiyum; jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilirunthu a'ruppu'ndupoanaar; en janaththin mee'ruthalinimiththam avar vaathikkappattaar.
thunmaarkkaroadea avarudaiya pireathakkuzhiyai niyamiththaarka'l; aanaalum avar mariththapoathu aisuvariyavaanoadea irunthaar; avar kodumai seyyavillai; avar vaayil vagnchanai irunthathumillai.

karththaroa avarai no'rukkach siththamaaki, avaraip paaduka'lukkudpaduththinaar; avarudaiya aaththumaa thannaik kut'ranivaara'napaliyaaka oppukkodukkumpoathu, avar thamathu santhathiyaik ka'ndu, neediththa naa'laayiruppaar, karththarukkuch siththamaanathu avar kaiyinaal vaaykkum.

avar thamathu aaththuma varuththaththin palanaik ka'ndu thirupthiyaavaar; en thaasanaakiya neethiparar thammaip pat'rum a'rivinaal aneakarai neethimaanka'laakkuvaar; avarka'ludaiya akkiramangka'laith thaamea sumanthuko'lvaar.

avar thammudaiya aaththumaavai mara'naththiloot'ri, akkiramakkaararil oruvaraaka e'n'nappattu, aneakarudaiya paavaththaith thaamea sumanthu, akkiramakkaararukkaaka vea'ndikko'ndathinimiththam aneakarai avarukkup pangkaakak koduppean; palavaanka'lai avar thamakkuk ko'l'laiyaakap pangkittukko'lvaar.

pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyea, makizhnthupaadu; karppaveathanaippadaathava'lea, kempeeramaayp paadi aananthasaththamidu; vaazhkkaippattava'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laippaarkkilum, anaatha sthireeyinudaiya pi'l'laika'l athikam en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
un koodaaraththin idaththai visaalamaakku; un vaasasthalangka'lin thiraika'l virivaakattum; thadaiseyyaathea; un kayi'ruka'lai nee'lamaakki, un mu'laika'lai u'ruthippaduththu.
nee valathupu'raththilum idathupu'raththilum idangko'ndu perukuvaay; un santhathiyaar jaathika'laich suthanthariththukko'ndu, paazhaaykkidantha patta'nangka'laik kudiyeat'ruvippaarka'l.
payappadaathea, nee vedkappaduvathillai; naa'naathea, nee ilachchaiyadaivathillai; un vaalipaththin vedkaththai nee ma'ranthu, un vithavaiyiruppin ninthaiyai ini ninaiyaathiruppaay.
un sirushdikarea un naayakar; seanaika'lin karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam, isravealin parisuththar un meedpar, avar sarvapoomiyin theavan ennappaduvaar.
kaividappattu manamnonthava'laana sthireeyaippoalavum, i'lampiraayaththil vivaakagnseythu tha'l'lappatta manaiviyaippoalavum irukki'ra unnaik karththar azhaiththaar en'ru un theavan solluki'raar.
imaippozhuthu unnaik kaivittean; aanaalum urukkamaana irakkangka'laal unnaich searththukko'lvean.
a'rpakaalam moo'nda koapaththinaal en mukaththai imaippozhuthu unakku ma'raiththean; aanaalum niththiya kirupaiyudan unakku irangkuvean en'ru karththaraakiya un meedpar solluki'raar.

ithu enakku noavaavin kaalaththilu'ndaana ve'l'lampoalirukkum; noavaavin kaalaththilu'ndaana ve'l'lam ini poomiyinmeal pura'ndu varuvathillai en'ru naan aa'naiyittathupoala, unmeal naan koapangko'lvathillaiyen'rum, unnai naan kadinthuko'lvathillaiyen'rum aa'naiyittean.

malaika'l vilakinaalum, parvathangka'l nilaipeyarnthaalum, en kirupai unnaivittu vilakaamalum, en samaathaanaththin udanpadikkai nilaipeyaraamalum irukkum en'ru, unmeal manathurukuki'ra karththar solluki'raar.
si'rumaippattava'lea, perungkaat'ril adipattava'lea, theat'raravat'rava'lea, ithoa, naan un kalluka'laip pirakaasikkumpadi vaiththu, neelaraththinangka'lai un asthipaaramaakki,
un palaka'nika'laip pa'lingkum, un vaasalka'lai maa'nikkak ka'rka'lum, un mathilka'laiyellaam uchchithamaana ka'rka'lumaakkuvean.
un pi'l'laika'lellaarum karththaraal poathikkappattiruppaarka'l; un pi'l'laika'ludaiya samaathaanam perithaayirukkum.
neethiyinaal sthirappattiruppaay; kodumaikkuth thooramaavaay; payamillaathiruppaay; thikilukkuth thooramaavaay, athu unnai a'nukuvathillai.
ithoa, unakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodinaal, athu ennaalea kooduki'ra koottamalla; evarka'l unakku viroathamaayk kooduki'raarka'loa, avarka'l un padchaththil varuvaarka'l.
ithoa, karineruppai oothi, than kiriyaikkaana aayuthaththai u'ndupa'n'nuki'ra kollanaiyum naan sirushdiththean; keduththu nikkirakamaakkuki'ravanaiyum naan sirushdiththean.

unakku viroathamaay uruvaakkappadum entha aayuthamum vaaykkaatheapoam; unakku viroathamaay niyaayaththil ezhumpum entha naavaiyum nee kut'rappaduththuvaay; ithu karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaararin suthantharamum, ennaalu'ndaana avarka'ludaiya neethiyumaayirukki'rathen'ru karththar solluki'raar.

oa, thaakamaayirukki'ravarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum tha'n'neerka'la'ndaikku vaarungka'l; pa'namillaathavarka'lea, neengka'l vanthu, vaangkich saappidungka'l; neengka'l vanthu, pa'namumin'ri vilaiyumin'rith thiraadcharasamum paalum ko'l'lungka'l.

neengka'l appamallaathatha'rkaakap pa'naththaiyum, thirupthiseyyaatha poru'lukkaaka ungka'l pirayaasaththaiyum selavazhippaanean? neengka'l enakkuk kavanamaaych sevikoduththu, nalamaanathaich saappidungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'l aaththumaa kozhuppaana pathaarththaththinaal makizhchchiyaakum.

ungka'l seviyaich saayththu, ennidaththil vaarungka'l: kea'lungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'l aaththumaa pizhaikkum; thaaveethukku aru'lina nichchayamaana kirupaika'lai ungka'lukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaaka ea'rpaduththuvean.
ithoa, avarai janakkoottangka'lukkuch saadchiyaakavum, janangka'lukkuth thalaivaraakavum, athipathiyaakavum ea'rpaduththinean.

ithoa, nee a'riyaathiruntha jaathiyai varavazhaippaay; unnai a'riyaathiruntha jaathi un theavanaakiya karththarin nimiththamum, isravealudaiya parisuththarin nimiththamum unnidaththi'rku oadivarum; avar unnai meanmaippaduththiyirukki'raar.
karththaraik ka'ndadaiyaththakka samayaththil avaraith theadungka'l; avar sameepamaayirukkaiyil avarai noakkik kooppidungka'l.

thunmaarkkan than vazhiyaiyum, akkiramakkaaran than ninaivuka'laiyum vittu, karththaridaththil thirumpakkadavan; avar avanmeal manathurukuvaar; nammudaiya theavanidaththi'rkea thirumpakkadavan; avar mannikki'ratha'rkuth thayai peruththirukki'raar.
en ninaivuka'l ungka'l ninaivuka'l alla; ungka'l vazhika'l en vazhika'lum allaven'ru karththar solluki'raar.
poomiyaippaarkkilum vaanangka'l eppadi uyarnthirukki'rathoa, appadiyea ungka'l vazhika'laippaarkkilum en vazhika'lum, ungka'l ninaivuka'laippaarkkilum en ninaivuka'lum uyarnthirukki'rathu.

maariyum u'raintha mazhaiyum vaanaththilirunthu i'rangki, avvidaththukkuth thirumpaamal poomiyai nanaiththu, athil mu'lai ki'lampi vi'laiyumpadichseythu, vithaikki'ravanukku vithaiyaiyum, pusikki'ravanukku aakaaraththaiyum kodukki'rathu eppadiyoa,
appadiyea en vaayilirunthu pu'rappadum vasanamum irukkum; athu ve'rumaiyaay ennidaththi'rkuth thirumpaamal, athu naan virumpuki'rathaichseythu, naan athai anuppina kaariyamaakumpadi vaaykkum.
neengka'l makizhchchiyaayp pu'rappattu, samaathaanamaayk ko'ndupoakappaduveerka'l; parvathangka'lum malaika'lum ungka'lukku munpaakak kempeeramaay muzhangki, ve'liyin marangka'lellaam kaikottum.

mudchedikkup pathilaakath theavathaaru virudcham mu'laikkum; kaagncho'rikkup pathilaaka miruthuchsedi ezhumpum; athu karththarukkuk keerththiyaakavum, nirmoolamaakaatha niththiya adaiyaa'lamaakavum irukkum.
karththar solluki'raar: neengka'l niyaayaththaik kaikko'ndu, neethiyaich seyyungka'l; en iradchippu varavum, en neethi ve'lippadavum sameepamaayirukki'rathu.

ippadich seyki'ra manushanum, ithaip pat'rikko'ndirunthu, oayvunaa'laip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkaathapadi aasariththu, oru pollaappaiyum seyyaathapadi than kaiyaik kaaththukko'ndirukki'ra manupuththiranum paakkiyavaan.
karththaraich searntha anniyapuththiran: karththar ennaith thammudaiya janaththaivittu mut'rilum piriththuppoaduvaaren'ru sollaanaaka; a'n'nakanum: ithoa, naan pattamaramen'ru sollaanaaka.
en oayvunaadka'lai aasariththu, enakku ishdamaanavaika'laith therinthuko'ndu, en udanpadikkaiyaip pat'rikko'l'luki'ra a'n'nakarka'laik ku'riththuk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:

naan avarka'lukku en aalayaththilum, en mathilka'lukku'l'lum kumaararukkum kumaaraththika'lukkumuriya idaththaiyum keerththiyaiyumpaarkkilum, uththama idaththaiyum keerththiyaiyum koduppean, en'rum azhiyaatha niththiya naamaththai avarka'lukku aru'luvean.

karththaraich seavikkavum, karththarudaiya naamaththai neasikkavum, avarukku oozhiyakkaararaayirukkavum, avaraich searnthu, oayvunaa'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkaathapadi aasariththu, en udanpadikkaiyaip pat'rikko'ndirukki'ra anniyapuththirar anaivaraiyum,

naan en parisuththa parvathaththukkuk ko'nduvanthu: en jepaveettilea avarka'lai makizhappa'n'nuvean; avarka'ludaiya sarvaangkathakanangka'lum, avarka'ludaiya palika'lum, en palipeedaththinmeal angkikarikkappattirukkum; ennudaiya veedu sakala janangka'lukkum jepaveedu ennappadum.
isravealil tha'l'lu'ndavarka'laich searkki'ra karththaraakiya aa'ndavar: avanidaththil searkkappattavarka'laiyallaamal innum avanidaththil searppean enki'raar.
ve'liyil sagncharikki'ra sakala mirukangka'lea, kaattilu'l'la sakala mirukangka'lea, padchikka vaarungka'l.

avanudaiya kaava'rkaarar ellaarum on'rum a'riyaatha kurudar; avarka'lellaarum kulaikkamaattaatha oomaiyaana naayka'l; thookkamayakkamaayp pulampuki'ravarka'l, paduththukko'l'luki'ravarka'l, niththiraip piriyar;

thirupthiyadaiyaamalirukkum peruvayit'ru naayka'l; pakuththa'rivillaatha meayppar; avarka'lil ovvoruvanum than than vazhiyaiyum, avanavan than than moolaiyilirunthu than than pozhivaiyum noakkikko'ndirukki'raan.
vaarungka'l, thiraadcharasaththaik ko'nduvaruvean, mathuvaik kudippoam; naa'laiyaththinam in'raiyaththinampoalavum, itha'rku athikamaakavum irukkum enpaarka'l.

neethimaan madinthupoaki'raan, oruvarum athai manathil vaikki'rathillai; puththimaanka'l eduththukko'l'lappaduki'raarka'l, aanaalum theengkuvaraathatha'rkumunnea neethimaan eduththukko'l'lappaduki'raan enpathaich sinthippaar illai.
nearmaiyaay nadanthavarka'l samaathaanaththukku'l piraveasiththu, thangka'l padukkaika'lil i'laippaa'ruki'raarka'l.
naa'lpaarkki'rava'lin pi'l'laika'lea, vipasaaranukkum veasikkum pi'rantha santhathiyaarea, neengka'l ingkea kittivaarungka'l.
neengka'l yaaraip pariyaasampa'n'nuki'reerka'l? yaarukku viroathamaay vaayaith thi'ranthu, naakkai neettuki'reerka'l? neengka'l thuroakampa'n'nuki'ra pi'l'laika'lum, ka'l'lach santhathiyaarumallavoa?
neengka'l pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum, vikkiraka theavarka'loadea moakaakkiniyil venthu, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilea kanmalai vedippuka'lin keezhp pi'l'laika'laik kon'rupoaduki'ravarka'l.

pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilu'l'la vazhavazhappaana silaika'lidaththil un pangku irukki'rathu; avaika'l, avaika'lea un veetham; avaika'lukku nee paanapaliyai vaarththu, poajanapaliyaiyum seluththuki'raay; ivaika'linmeal piriyappaduveanoa?
nee uyaramum unnathamumaana malaika'linmeal un magnchaththai vaikki'raay; angkeayum paliyidumpadi ea'ruki'raay.

kathavuka'lukkum nilaika'lukkum pinnaaka un gnaapakakku'riyai vaikki'raay; nee ennaivittuppoay mat'ravarka'lukku unnai ve'lippaduththinaay; ea'rippoay un magnchaththai akalamaakki, avarka'loadea udanpadikkai pa'n'ninaay; avarka'ludaiya magnchaththaik kaa'nki'ra ellaa idaththilum athai neasikki'raay.
nee thailaththaip poosikko'ndu raajaavinidaththil poaki'raay; un parima'langka'lai mikuthiyaakki, un sthaanaapathika'laith thooraththukku anuppi, unnaip paathaa'lamattum thaazhththuki'raay.
vazhithooramaanathaal uzhan'rupoaki'raay; athu viruthaaven'ru nee solluki'rathillai; un kaipelaththaik ka'ndupidiththaay; aakaiyaal nee aayaasappadavillai.

nee yaarukku agnchip payappaduki'raay, nee poysolluki'raayea; nee ennai ninaiyaamalum, un manathilea vaikkaamalum poaki'raay; naan vekukaalam mavunamaayirunthean allavaa? aakaiyaal enakkup payappadaathirukki'raay.
un neethiyaiyum un kiriyaika'laiyum naan ve'lippaduththuvean, avaika'l unakku uthavaathu.

nee kooppidumpoathu, un ka'nangka'l unnaith thappuvikkattum; kaat'ru avaika'laiyellaam pa'rakkadiththu, maayai avaika'laik ko'ndupoam; ennai nampiyirukki'ravanoa theasaththaich suthanthariththu, en parisuththa parvathaththilea kaa'niyaadchikkaaranaayiruppaan.
vazhiyai uyarththi uyarththi, athaich semmaippaduththi, ida'ralka'lai en janaththin vazhiyilirunthu eduththuppoadungka'l ennappadum.

niththiyavaasiyum parisuththar enki'ra naamamu'l'lavarumaakiya makaththuvamum unnathamumaanavar solluki'raar: unnathaththilum parisuththa sthalaththilum vaasampa'n'nuki'ra naan, pa'ninthavarka'lin aaviyai uyirppikki'ratha'rkum, no'rungkinavarka'lin iruthayaththai uyirppikki'ratha'rkum, no'rungku'ndu pa'nintha aaviyu'l'lavarka'lidaththilum vaasampa'n'nuki'rean.
naan eppoathum vazhakkaadamaattean; naan en'raikkum koapamaayiruppathumillai; eanen'raal, aaviyum, naan u'ndupa'n'nina aaththumaakka'lum, en mukaththukku munpaakach soarnthupoakumea.

naan avarka'l poru'laasaiyennum akkiramaththinimiththam kadungkoapamaaki, avarka'lai adiththean; naan ma'rainthu, kadungkoapamaayirunthean; thangka'l manampoanapoakkilea maa'rupaadaay nadanthaarka'lea.
avarka'l vazhika'lai naan paarththu, avarka'laik ku'namaakkuvean; avarka'lai nadaththi, thirumpavum avarka'lukkum avarka'lilea thukkappaduki'ravarka'lukkum aa'ruthal a'lippean.

thooramaayirukki'ravarka'lukkum sameepamaayirukki'ravarka'lukkum samaathaanam samaathaanam en'ru koo'rum uthaduka'lin palanaich sirushdikki'rean; avarka'laik ku'namaakkuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
thunmaarkkaroa kontha'likkum kadalaippoalirukki'raarka'l; athu amarnthirukkak koodaamal, athin jalangka'l seat'raiyum azhukkaiyum karaiyil othukkuki'rathu.
thunmaarkkarukkuch samaathaanam illaiyen'ru en theavan solluki'raar.
saththamittuk kooppidu; adakkikko'l'laathea; ekkaa'laththaippoal un saththaththai uyarththi, en janaththukku avarka'l mee'ruthalaiyum, yaakkoapin vamsaththaarukku avarka'l paavangka'laiyum therivi.

thangka'l theavanudaiya niyaayaththai vittu vilakaamal neethiyaich seythuvaruki'ra jaathiyaaraippoal avarka'l naadoa'rum ennaith theadi, en vazhika'lai a'riya virumpuki'raarka'l; neethiniyaayangka'lai ennidaththil visaariththu, theavanidaththil seara virumpuki'raarka'l.

naangka'l upavaasampa'n'numpoathu neer noakkaamalirukki'rathenna? naangka'l engka'l aaththumaakka'lai odukkumpoathu neer athai a'riyaamalirukki'rathenna enki'raarka'l; ithoa, neengka'l upavaasikkum naa'lilea ungka'l ichchaiyinpadi nadanthu, ungka'l vealaika'laiyellaam kattaayamaaych seyki'reerka'l.

ithoa, vazhakkukkum vaathukkum thushdaththanaththaiyudaiya kaiyinaal kuththuki'ratha'rkum upavaasikki'reerka'l; neengka'l ungka'l kookkuralai uyaraththilea keadkappa'n'numpadiyaay, innaa'lil upavaasikki'rathupoal upavaasiyaathirungka'l.

manushan than aaththumaavai odukkuki'rathum, thalaiva'nangki naa'nalaippoal irattilum saampalilum paduththukko'l'luki'rathum, enakkup piriyamaana upavaasa naa'laayirukkumoa? ithaiyaa upavaasamen'rum karththarukkup piriyamaana naa'len'rum solluvaay?

akkiramaththin kattuka'lai avizhkki'rathum, nukaththadiyin pi'naiyalka'lai nekizhkki'rathum, nerukkappattirukki'ravarka'lai viduthalaiyaakkividuki'rathum, sakala nukaththadika'laiyum udaiththuppoaduki'rathum,

pasiyu'l'lavanukku un aakaaraththaip pakirnthukodukki'rathum, thuraththu'nda si'rumaiyaanavarka'lai veettilea searththukko'l'luki'rathum, vasthiramillaathavanaik ka'ndaal avanukku vasthirang kodukki'rathum, un maamsamaanavanukku unnai o'likkaamalirukki'rathum allavoa enakku ukantha upavaasam.
appozhuthu vidiya'rkaala ve'luppaippoala un ve'lichcham ezhumpi, un sukavaazhvu seekkiraththil thu'lirththu, un neethi unakku munnaalea sellum; karththarudaiya makimai unnaip pinnaalea kaakkum.

appozhuthu nee kooppiduvaay, karththar ma'ruuththaravu koduppaar; nee saththamiduvaay: ithoa, naan irukki'rean en'ru solluvaar. nukaththadiyaiyum, viral neettuthalaiyum, nipachsollaiyum, nee un naduvilirunthu akat'ri,
pasiyu'l'lavanidaththil un aaththumaavaich saayththu, si'rumaippatta aaththumaavaith thirupthiyaakkinaal, appozhuthu iru'lil un ve'lichcham uthiththu, un anthakaaram maththiyaanaththaippoalaakum.

karththar niththamum unnai nadaththi, makaa va'radchiyaana kaalangka'lil un aaththumaavaith thirupthiyaakki, un elumpuka'lai ni'namu'l'lathaakkuvaar; nee neerppaaychchalaana thoattaththaippoalavum, vat'raatha neeroot'raippoalavum iruppaay.

unnidaththilirunthu thoan'rinavarka'l poorvamuthal paazhaaykkidantha sthalangka'laik kattuvaarka'l; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka irukkum asthipaarangka'lmeal nee kattuvaay; thi'rappaanathai adaikki'ravan en'rum, kudiyirukkumpadi paathaika'laith thiruththuki'ravan en'rum nee peyar pe'ruvaay.

en parisuththanaa'laakiya oayvunaa'lilea unakku ishdamaanathaich seyyaathapadi, un kaalai vilakki, un vazhika'linpadi nadavaamalum, unakku ishdamaanathaich seyyaamalum, un sonthappeachchaip peasaamalirunthu, oayvunaa'lai manamakizhchchiyin naa'len'rum, karththarudaiya parisuththa naa'lai makimaiyu'l'la naa'len'rum solli, athai makimaiyaaka e'n'nuvaayaanaal,

appozhuthu karththaril manamakizhchchiyaayiruppaay; poomiyin uyarntha idangka'lil unnai ea'riyirukkumpadi pa'n'ni, un thakappanaakiya yaakkoapudaiya suthantharaththaal unnaip poashippean; karththarudaiya vaay ithaich sollit'ru.
ithoa, iradchikkakkoodaathapadikkuk karththarudaiya kai ku'rukippoakavumillai; keadkakkoodaathapadikku avarudaiya sevi manthamaakavumillai.

ungka'l akkiramangka'lea ungka'lukkum ungka'l theavanukkum naduvaakap pirivinai u'ndaakkuki'rathu; ungka'l paavangka'lea avar ungka'lukkuch sevikodaathapadikku avarudaiya mukaththai ungka'lukku ma'raikki'rathu.
eanen'raal, ungka'l kaika'l iraththaththaalum, ungka'l viralka'l akkiramaththaalum ka'raippattirukki'rathu; ungka'l uthaduka'l poyyaip peasi, ungka'l naavu niyaayakkeattai vasanikki'rathu.

neethiyaith theaduki'ravanumillai, saththiyaththinpadi vazhakkaaduki'ravanumillai; maayaiyai nampi, apaththamaanathaip peasuki'raarka'l; theemaiyaik karppanthariththu, akkiramaththaip pe'ruki'raarka'l.
kattuviriyanin muttaika'lai adaikaaththu, silanthiyin nesavuka'lai neyki'raarka'l; avaika'lin muttaika'laich saappiduki'ravan saavaan; avaika'l nerukkappattatheayaanaal viriyan pu'rappadum.

avaika'lin nesavuka'l vasthirangka'lukkeat'ravaika'l alla; thangka'l kiriyaika'laalea thangka'lai moodikko'l'lamaattaarka'l; avarka'l kiriyaika'l akkiramakkiriyaika'l; kodumaiyaana seykai avarka'l kaika'lilirukki'rathu.

avarka'l kaalka'l pollaappuch seyya oadi, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthath theevirikki'rathu; avarka'l ninaivuka'l akkiramaninaivuka'l; paazhkkadippum azhivum avarka'l vazhika'lilirukki'rathu.
samaathaana vazhiyai a'riyaarka'l; avarka'l nadaika'lil niyaayamillai; thangka'l paathaika'laith thaangka'lea koa'nalaakkikko'ndaarka'l; avaika'lil nadakki'ra oruvanum samaathaanaththai a'riyaan.

aathalaal, niyaayam engka'lukkuth thooramaayirukki'rathu; neethi engka'laith thodarnthu pidikkaathu; ve'lichchaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, ithoa, iru'l; pirakaasaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, aanaalum anthakaaraththilea nadakki'roam.

naangka'l kurudaraippoal suvaraip pidiththu, ka'n'nillaathavarka'laippoal thadavuki'roam; iravil ida'ruki'rathupoalap pattappakalilum ida'ruki'roam; seththavarka'laippoal paazhidangka'lil irukki'roam.

naangka'l anaivarum karadika'laippoala u'rumi, pu'raakka'laippoalak koovikko'ndirukki'roam, niyaayaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, athaik kaa'noam; iradchippukkuk kaaththirunthoam, athu engka'lukkuth thooramaayit'ru.

engka'l mee'ruthalka'l umakku munpaaka mikuthiyaayirunthu, engka'l paavangka'l engka'lukku viroathamaaych saadchi solluki'rathu; engka'l mee'ruthalka'l engka'loadea irukki'rathu; engka'l akkiramangka'lai a'rinthirukki'roam.

karththarukku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ni, poypeasi, engka'l theavanaivittup pinvaangkinoam; kodumaiyaakavum kalakamaakavum peasinoam; ka'l'lavaarththaika'laik karppanthariththu, iruthayaththilirunthu pi'rappikkappa'n'ninoam.
niyaayam pinnittu akan'rathu; neethi thooramaay nin'rathu; saththiyam veethiyilea ida'ri, yathaarththam vanthu searamaattaama'rpoaki'rathu.
saththiyam tha'l'lupadiyaayit'ru; pollaappai vittu vilakuki'ravan ko'l'laiyaaki'raan; ithaik karththar paarththu niyaayamillaiyen'ru visanamu'l'lavaraanaar.
oruvarum illaiyen'ru ka'ndu, vi'n'nappam pa'n'nuki'ravan illaiyen'ru aachchariyappattaar; aathalaal avarudaiya puyamea avarukku iradchippaaki, avarudaiya neethiyea avaraith thaangkuki'rathu.

avar neethiyai maarkkavasamaaka a'ninthu, iradchippennum seeraavaith thamathu sirasil thariththu, neethisarikkattuthalennum vasthirangka'lai uduppaaka uduththu, vairaakkiyaththaich saalvaiyaakap poarththukko'ndaar.

kiriyaika'lukkuththakka palanai a'lippaar; thammudaiya saththurukka'lidaththil ukkiraththaich sarikkatti, thammudaiya pakaignarukkuththakka palanaiyum, theevuka'lukkuththakka palanaiyum sarikkattuvaar.

appozhuthu sooriyan asthamikkunthisaithodangki karththarin naamaththukkum, sooriyan uthikkunthisaithodangki avarudaiya makimaikkum payappaduvaarka'l; ve'l'lampoal saththuru varumpoathu, karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avanukku viroathamaayk kodiyeat'ruvaar.
meedpar seeyoanukkum, yaakkoapilea mee'ruthalaivittuth thirumpuki'ravarka'lukkum, varuvaar en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

unmealirukki'ra en aaviyum, naan un vaayil aru'liya en vaarththaika'lum, ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum un vaayilirunthum, un santhathiyin vaayilirunthum, un santhathiyinudaiya santhathiyin vaayilirunthum neengkuvathillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar; ithu enakku avarka'loadirukkum en udanpadikkaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ezhumpip pirakaasi; un o'li vanthathu, karththarudaiya makimai unmeal uthiththathu.
ithoa, iru'l poomiyaiyum, kaariru'l janangka'laiyum moodum; aanaalum unmeal karththar uthippaar; avarudaiya makimai unmeal kaa'nappadum.
un ve'lichchaththinidaththukku jaathika'lum, uthikki'ra un o'liyinidaththukku raajaakka'lum nadanthuvaruvaarka'l.

sut'rilum un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaar; avarka'l ellaarum eakamaayk koodi unnidaththi'rku varuki'raarka'l; un kumaarar thooraththilirunthu vanthu, un kumaaraththika'l un pakkaththilea va'larkkappaduvaarka'l.
appozhuthu nee athaik ka'ndu oadivaruvaay; un iruthayam athisayappattup poorikkum; kada'rkaraiyin thira'laana koottam un vasamaakath thirumpum, jaathika'lin palaththa seanai unnidaththukku varum.

ottakangka'lin earaa'lamum, meethiyaan eappaath theasangka'lin veakamaana ottakangka'lum unnai moodum; seapaavilu'l'lavarka'l yaavarum ponnaiyum thoopavarkkaththaiyum ko'nduvanthu, karththarin thuthika'laip pirasiththappaduththuvaarka'l.

keathaarin aaduka'lellaam unnidaththil searkkappadum; nepaayoaththin kadaakka'l unnaich seaviththu, angkikarikkappattathaay en palipeedaththinmeal ea'rum; en makimaiyin aalayaththai makimaippaduththuvean.
meakaththaippoalavum, thangka'l palaka'niththuvaarangka'lukkuth theevirikki'ra pu'raakka'laippoalavum pa'ranthuvaruki'ra ivarka'l yaar?

theevuka'l enakkuk kaaththirukkum; avar unnai makimaippaduththinaar en'ru un pi'l'laika'laiyum, avarka'loadeakooda avarka'l ponnaiyum, avarka'l ve'l'liyaiyum un theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththukken'rum, isravealin parisuththarukken'rum, thooraththilirunthu ko'nduvara, tharsheesin kappalka'lum ea'rkanavea enakkuk kaaththirukkum.
anniyarin puththirar un mathilka'laik katti, avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'l unnaich seavippaarka'l; en kadungkoapaththinaal unnai adiththean; aanaalum en kirupaiyinaal unakku irangkinean.
unnidaththukku jaathika'lin palaththa seanaiyaik ko'nduvarumpadikkum, avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'lai azhaiththuvarumpadikkum, un vaasalka'l iravumpakalum poottappadaamal eppozhuthum thi'ranthirukkum.
unnaich seavikkaatha jaathiyum raajyamum azhiyum; antha jaathika'l nichchayamaayp paazhaakum.

en parisuththa sthaanaththaich singkaarikkumpadikku, leepanoanin makimaiyum, theavathaaruvirudchangka'lum, paaymara virudchangka'lum, punnaimarangka'lungkooda unnidaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarappadum; en paathasthaanaththai makimaippaduththuvean.

unnai odukkinavarka'lin pi'l'laika'lum kuninthu unnidaththil vanthu, unnai asattaipa'n'nina yaavarum un kaaladiyil pa'ninthu, unnaik karththarudaiya nakaram en'rum, isravealudaiya parisuththarin seeyoan en'rum solvaarka'l.
nee nekizhappattathum, kaividappattathum, oruvarum kadanthu nadavaathathumaayirunthaay; aanaalum unnai niththiya maadchimaiyaakavum, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaayirukkum makizhchchiyaakavum vaippean.
nee jaathika'lin paalaik kudiththu, raajaakka'lin mulaippaalaiyum u'ndu, karththaraakiya naan iradchakaren'rum, yaakkoapin vallavar un meedparen'rum a'rinthuko'lvaay.

naan ve'nkalaththukkup pathilaakap ponnaiyum, irumpukkup pathilaaka ve'l'liyaiyum, marangka'lukkup pathilaaka ve'nkalaththaiyum, ka'rka'lukkup pathilaaka irumpaiyum varappa'n'ni, un ka'nkaa'nika'laich samaathaanamu'l'lavarka'lum, un tha'nda'rkaararai neethiyu'l'lavarka'lumaakkuvean.
inik kodumai un theasaththilum, azhivum naasamum un ellaika'lilum keadkappadamaattaathu; un mathilka'lai iradchippen'rum, un vaasalka'laith thuthiyen'rum solluvaay.

inich sooriyan unakkup pakalilea ve'lichchamaayiraamalum, santhiran than ve'lichchaththaal unakkup pirakaasiyaamalum, karththarea unakku niththiya ve'lichchamum, un theavanea unakku makimaiyumaayiruppaar.
un sooriyan ini asthamippathumillai; un santhiran ma'raivathumillai; karththarea unakku niththiya ve'lichchamaayiruppaar; un thukkanaadka'l mudinthupoam.
un janangka'l yaavarum neethimaanka'lum, en'raikkum poomiyaich suthantharikkung kudika'lum, naan natta ki'laika'lum, naan makimaippadumpadi en karangka'lin kiriyaika'lumaayiruppaarka'l.
sinnavan aayiramum, si'riyavan palaththa jaathiyumaavaan; karththaraakiya naan eat'rakaalaththil ithaith theeviramaay nadappippean.

karththaraakiya theavanudaiya aaviyaanavar enmeal irukki'raar; si'rumaippattavarka'lukkuch suviseashaththai a'rivikkak karththar ennai apisheakampa'n'ninaar; iruthayam no'rungku'ndavarka'lukkuk kaayangkattuthalaiyum, si'raippattavarka'lukku viduthalaiyaiyum, kattu'ndavarka'lukkuk kattavizhththalaiyum koo'ravum,
karththarudaiya anukkiraka varushaththaiyum, nammudaiya theavan neethiyaichsarikkattum naa'laiyum koo'ravum, thuyarappatta anaivarukkum aa'ruthal seyyavum,

seeyoanilea thuyarappattavarka'laich seerppaduththavum, avarka'lukkuch saampalukkup pathilaakach singkaaraththaiyum, thuyaraththukkup pathilaaka aanantha thailaththaiyum, odungkina aavikkup pathilaakath thuthiyin udaiyaiyum kodukkavum, avar ennai anuppinaar; avarka'l karththar thammudaiya makimaikken'ru naattina neethiyin virudchangka'lennappaduvaarka'l.

avarka'l nedungkaalam paazhaayk kidanthavaika'laik katti, poorvaththil nirmoolamaanavaika'lai eduppiththu, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaay idinthukidantha paazhaana patta'nangka'laip puthithaayk kattuvaarka'l.
ma'rujaathiyaar nin'ruko'ndu ungka'l manthaika'lai meayththu, anniya puththirar ungka'l pa'n'naiyaadka'lum, ungka'l thiraadchaththoattakkaararumaayiruppaarka'l.

neengka'loa karththarin aasaariyaren'ru sollappaduveerka'l; ungka'lai namathu theavanudaiya pa'nividaikkaararenpaarka'l; neengka'l jaathika'lin selvaththai anupaviththu, avarka'l makimaiyaikko'ndu meanmaipaaraattuveerka'l.

ungka'l vedkaththukkup pathilaaka ira'ndaththanaiyaayp palan varum; ilachchaikkup pathilaakath thangka'l paakaththil santhoashappaduvaarka'l; athinimiththam thangka'l theasaththil irattippaana suthantharam adaivaarka'l; niththiya makizhchchi avarka'lukku u'ndaakum.
karththaraakiya naan niyaayaththai virumpi, ko'l'laipporu'linaal idappatta thakanapaliyai ve'rukki'rean; naan avarka'l kiriyaiyai u'nmaiyaakki, avarka'loadea niththiya udanpadikkai pa'n'nuvean.

avarka'l santhathiyaanathu jaathika'lin naduvilum, avarka'l santhaanamaanathu janangka'lin naduvilum a'riyappattirukkum; avarka'laip paarkki'ra yaavarum avarka'l karththaraal aaseervaatham pet'ra santhathiyen'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

karththarukku'l poorippaay makizhuki'rean; en theavanukku'l en aaththumaa ka'likoornthirukki'rathu; ma'navaa'lan aapara'nangka'linaal thannai alangkariththukko'l'luki'ratha'rkum, ma'navaatti nakaika'linaal thannaich singkaariththukko'l'luki'ratha'rkum oppaaka, avar iradchippin vasthirangka'lai enakku uduththi, neethiyin saalvaiyai enakkuth thariththaar.

poomi than poo'nduka'lai vi'laivippathupoalavum, thoattam thannil vithaikkappattavaika'lai mu'laivippathupoalavum, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar ellaa jaathika'lukkum munpaaka neethiyaiyum thuthiyaiyum mu'laikkappa'n'nuvaar.
seeyoaninimiththamum erusaleaminimiththamum naan mavunamaayiraamalum, athin neethi pirakaasaththaippoalavum, athin iradchippu eriki'ra theevattiyaippoalavum ve'lippadumattum amaraamalum iruppean.
jaathika'l un neethiyaiyum, sakala raajaakka'lum un makimaiyaiyum kaa'npaarka'l; karththarudaiya vaay sollum puthu naamaththaal nee azhaikkappaduvaay.
nee karththarudaiya kaiyil alangkaaramaana kireedamum, un theavanudaiya karaththil raajamudiyumaayiruppaay.

nee inik kaividappattava'l ennappadaamalum, un theasam inip paazhaana theasamennappadaamalum, nee epsipaa en'rum, un theasam piyoolaa en'rum sollappadum; karththar unmeal piriyamaayirukki'raar; un theasam vaazhkkaippadum.
vaalipan kannikaiyai vivaakampa'n'nuvathupoala, un makka'l unnai vivaakampa'n'nuvaarka'l; ma'navaa'lan ma'navaattiyinmeal makizhchchiyaayiruppathupoala, un theavan unmeal makizhchchiyaayiruppaar.

erusaleamea, un mathilka'linmeal pakalmuzhuthum iraamuzhuthum orukkaalum mavunamaayiraatha jaamakkaararaik katta'laiyiduki'rean. karththaraip pirasthaapampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lea, neengka'l amarikkaiyaayirukkalaakaathu.
avar erusaleamai sthirappaduththi, poomiyilea athaip pukazhchchiyaakkumvaraikkum avarai amarnthirukkavidaathirungka'l.

ini naan un thaaniyaththai un saththurukka'lukku aakaaramaakakkodean; un pirayaasaththinaalaakiya un thiraadcharasaththai anniya puththirar kudippathumillaiyen'ru karththar thamathu valathukaraththinmealum thamathu vallamaiyu'l'la puyaththinmealum aa'naiyittaar.
athaich searththavarka'lea athaip pusiththuk karththaraith thuthippaarka'l; athaik koottivaiththavarka'lea en parisuththa sthalaththin piraakaarangka'lil athaik kudippaarka'l.

vaasalka'l vazhiyaayp piraveasiyungka'l, piraveasiyungka'l; janaththukku vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththungka'l; paathaiyai uyarththungka'l, uyarththungka'l; athilu'l'la ka'rka'laip po'rukkippoadungka'l; janangka'lukkaakak kodiyai eat'rungka'l.

neengka'l seeyoan kumaaraththiyai noakki: ithoa, un iradchippu varuki'rathu; ithoa, avar aru'lum palan avaroadum, avar seyyum pirathipalan avar munpaakavum varuki'rathu en'ru sollungka'l en'ru, karththar poomiyin kadaiyaantharamvaraikkum koo'ruki'raar.
avarka'laip parisuththa janamen'rum, karththaraal meedkappattavarka'len'rum solluvaarka'l; nee theadikko'l'lappattathen'rum, kaividappadaatha nakaramen'rum peyarpe'ruvaay.

eathoamilum athilu'l'la poas'raa patta'naththilumirunthu, saayantheerntha vasthirangka'ludaiyavaraakavum, makaththuvamaay uduththirukki'ravaraakavum, thamathu makaththaana vallamaiyilea ezhuntharu'linavaraakavum varuki'ra ivar yaar? neethiyaayp peasi iradchikka vallavaraakiya naanthaanea.
ummudaiya uduppuch sivappaakavum, ummudaiya vasthirangka'l aalaiyai mithikki'ravan vasthirangka'lpoalavum irukki'rathenna?

naan oruvanaay aalaiyai mithiththean; janangka'lil oruvanum ennoadirunthathillai; naan en koapaththilea avarka'lai mithiththu, en ukkiraththilea avarka'lai nasukkippoattean; athinaal avarka'l iraththam en vasthirangka'linmeal the'riththathu, en uduppaiyellaam ka'raippaduththikko'ndean.
neethiyaich sarikkattum naa'l en manathilirunthathu; ennudaiyavarka'lai meedkum varusham vanthathu.
naan paarththean, thu'naiseyvaar oruvarumillai; thaangkuvaar oruvarumillai en'ru aachchariyappattean; appozhuthu en puyamea enakku iradchippaaki, en ukkiramea ennaith thaangkit'ru.
naan en koapaththilea janangka'lai mithiththu, en ukkiraththilea avarka'lai ve'riyaakki, avarka'l saaraththaith tharaiyilea i'rangkappa'n'ninean.

karththar engka'lukkuch seytharu'lina ellaavat'ri'rkum thakkathaakavum, avar thammudaiya irakkangka'linpadiyum thammudaiya thira'laana thayavuka'linpadiyum, israveal vamsaththukkuch seytha makaa nanmaikkuththakkathaakavum, karththarudaiya kiriyaika'laiyum, karththarudaiya thuthika'laiyum pirasthaapampa'n'nuvean.
avarka'l en jananthaanen'rum, avarka'l vagnchanaiseyyaathirukkum pi'l'laika'len'rum solli, avarka'lukku iradchakaraanaar.

avarka'ludaiya ellaa nerukkaththilum avar nerukkappattaar; avarudaiya samukaththin thoothanaanavar avarka'lai iradchiththaar; avar thamathu anpinimiththamum, thamathu parithaapaththinimiththamum avarka'lai meettu, poorvanaadka'lilellaam avarka'laith thookkich sumanthuvanthaar.
avarka'loa kalakampa'n'ni, avarudaiya parisuththa aaviyai visanappaduththinaarka'l; athinaal avar avarka'lukkuch saththuruvaay maa'ri, avarea avarka'lukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'ninaar.

aakilum avar poorvanaadka'laiyum, moaseayaiyum, thammudaiya janaththaiyum ninaivukoornthaar; aanaalum avarka'laiyum, thamathu manthaiyin meayppanaiyum samuththiraththilirunthu ea'rappa'n'ninavar ippozhuthu engkea?

avarka'l naduvilea thammudaiya parisuththa aaviyai irukkak katta'laiyittu, moaseayin valathukaiyaikko'ndu avarka'laith thamathu makimaiyin puyaththinaalea nadaththi, thamakku niththiyakeerththiyai u'ndaakka avarka'lukku munpaakath tha'n'neeraippi'lanthu,
oru kuthirai vanaantharave'liyilea nadakki'rathupoala, avarka'l ida'raathapadikku avarka'lai aazhangka'lil nadakkappa'n'ninavar engkea?

karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avarka'laip pa'l'laththaakkilea poay i'rangkuki'ra mirukajeevanka'laippoala i'laippaa'rappa'n'ninaar; ippadiyea theavareer, umakku makimaiyu'l'la keerththiyai u'ndaakkumpadi ummudaiya janaththai nadaththineer.

theavareer paraloakaththilirunthu ka'n'noakki, parisuththamum makimaiyumu'l'la ummudaiya vaasasthalaththilirunthu paarum, ummudaiya vairaakkiyamum, ummudaiya vallamaiyum engkea? ummudaiya u'l'laththin kothippaiyum, ummudaiya mana urukkaththaiyum enakku munpaaka adakkikko'l'luki'reeroa?

theavareer engka'l pithaavaayirukki'reer; aapirakaam engka'lai a'riyaan, isravealukku naangka'l a'riyappattavarka'lumalla; karththaavea, neer engka'l pithaavum, engka'l meedparumaayirukki'reer; ithu poorvakaalamuthal ummudaiya naamam.

karththaavea, neer engka'lai ummudaiya vazhika'laivittuth thappippoakappa'n'ni, engka'l iruthayaththai umakkup payappadaathapadikkuk kadinappaduththuvaanean? ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararinimiththamum, ummudaiya suthantharamaana koaththirangka'linimiththamum thirumpiyaru'lum.
parisuththamu'l'la umathu janangka'l kognchakkaalamaaththiram athaich suthanthariththaarka'l; engka'l saththurukka'l ummudaiya parisuththa sthalaththai mithiththuppoattaarka'l.
naangka'lea ummudaiyavarka'l, avarka'lai orupozhuthum neer aa'ndathillai; avarka'lukku umathu naamam tharikkappattathumillai.
aa, umathu naamaththaich saththurukka'lukkuth theriyappa'n'nuvatha'rkum, jaathika'l ummudaiya sannithikku mun thaththa'lippatha'rkum,
theavareer vaanangka'laik kizhiththi'rangki, urukkum akkini eriyumaappoalavum, akkini tha'n'neeraip pongkappa'n'numaappoalavum, parvathangka'l umakku munpaaka urukumpadiseyyum.
naangka'l ethirpaarththiraatha payangkaramaana kaariyangka'lai neer seythapoathu, neer i'rangkineer, umathu sannithiyil parvathangka'l urukippoayina.
theavanea, umakkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'lukku neer seypavaika'lai, neereayallaamal ulakaththoat'rammutha'rko'ndu oruvarum keattathumillai, seviyaal u'narnthathumillai, avaika'laik ka'ndathumillai.

makizhchchiyaay neethiyaich seyki'ravarka'laiyum, ummudaiya vazhika'lil ummai ninaikki'ravarka'laiyum santhikki'reer; naangka'loa, avaika'lukku viroathamaaka eppozhuthum paavagnseythapadiyinaalea, theavareer kadungkoapangko'ndeer; innamum thappiyirukki'roam.

naangka'l anaivarum theettaanavarka'lpoala irukki'roam; engka'ludaiya neethika'lellaam azhukkaana kanthaipoala irukki'rathu, naangka'l anaivarum ilaika'laippoal uthiruki'roam; engka'l akkiramangka'l kaat'raippoal engka'lai adiththukko'ndupoaki'rathu.

umathu naamaththai noakkik kooppiduki'ravanum, ummaip pat'rikko'l'lumpadikku vizhiththukko'l'luki'ravanum illai; theavareer ummudaiya mukaththai engka'lai vittu ma'raiththu, engka'l akkiramangka'linimiththam engka'laik karaiyappa'n'nuki'reer.
ippozhuthum karththaavea, neer engka'ludaiya pithaa, naangka'l ka'lima'n; neer engka'lai uruvaakkuki'ravar, naangka'l anaivarum umathu karaththin kiriyai.
karththaavea, athikamaayk kadungkoapangko'l'laamalum, en'raikkum akkiramaththai ninaiththukko'l'laamalum iruppeeraaka; ithoa, paarum, naangka'l anaivarum ummudaiya janangka'lea.
umathu parisuththa patta'nangka'l vanaantharamaayina; seeyoan vanaantharamaayit'ru; erusaleam paazhaaykkidakki'rathu.
engka'l pithaakka'l ummaith thuthiththa parisuththamum makimaiyumaana engka'ludaiya aalayam akkinikku iraiyaaki, inpamaana engka'ludaiya sthaanangka'lellaam paazhaayina.
karththaavea, ivaika'l ippadiyirunthum adakkikko'ndiruppeeroa? mavunamaayirunthu, athikamaay engka'laich si'rumaippaduththuveeroa?
