ennaikku'riththu visaariththuk kea'laathirunthavarka'laalea theadappattean; ennaith theadaathirunthavarka'laalea ka'nda'riyappattean; ennudaiya naamam vi'langkaathiruntha jaathiyai noakki: ithoa, ingkea irukki'rean en'rean.
nalamallaatha vazhiyilea thangka'l ninaivuka'linpadi nadakki'ra murattaattamaana janaththa'ndaikku naa'l muzhuthum en kaika'lai neettinean.
antha janangka'l en sannithiyilea niththam enakkuk koapamu'ndaakki, thoattangka'lilea paliyittu, sengka'rka'linmeal thoopangkaatti,
pireathakkuzhika'la'ndaiyil udkaarnthu, paazhaana sthalangka'lil iraaththangki, pan'riyi'raichchiyaith thin'ru, thangka'l paaththirangka'lil aruvaruppaanavaika'lin aa'naththai vaiththirunthu:
nee unmattiliru, en sameepaththil varaathea, unnaippaarkkilum naan parisuththan en'ru solluki'raarka'l; ivarka'l en koapaththaalaakiya pukaiyum, naa'lmuzhuthum eriki'ra akkiniyumaayiruppaarka'l.
ithoa, athu enakku munpaaka ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; naan mavunamaayiraamal sarikkuch sarikkattuvean.

ungka'l akkiramangka'lukkum malaika'lil thoopangkaatti, meadaika'linmeal ennai ninthiththa ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramangka'lukkum thakkathaaka avarka'l madiyilea sarikkattuvean; naan avarka'l munthina seykaiyin palanai avarka'l madiyilea a'lappeanen'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: oru thiraadchakkulaiyil irasam kaa'nappadumpoathu athai azhikkaathea, athilea aaseervaatham u'nden'ru solluki'rapadi, naan en oozhiyakkaararinimiththam anaiththaiyum azhikkaathapadi seyvean.

yaakkoapilirunthu oru viththaiyum, yoothaavilirunthu en malaika'laich suthantharippavaraiyum ezhumpappa'n'nuvean; naan therinthuko'ndavarka'l athaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, en oozhiyakkaarar angkea vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
ennaith theaduki'ra en janaththukkuch saaroan aattuththozhuvamaakavum, aakoarin pa'l'laththaakku maattukkidaiyaakavum irukkum.
aanaalum karththarai vittu, en parisuththa parvathaththai ma'ranthu, kaath ennum theyvaththukkup panthiyai aayaththampa'n'ni, meani ennum theyvaththukkup paanapaliyai ni'raiya vaarkki'ravarka'lea,

ungka'lai naan pattayaththukku e'n'nikkoduppean; neengka'l anaivarum kolaiseyyappadak kuniveerka'l; naan kooppittum neengka'l ma'ruuththaravu kodukkavillai; naan peasiyum neengka'l keadkavillai; en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, enakkup piriyamallaathathaith therinthuko'ndeerka'l.

aathalaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: ithoa, en oozhiyakkaarar pusippaarka'l, neengka'loa pasiyaayiruppeerka'l; ithoa, en oozhiyakkaarar kudippaarka'l, neengka'loa thaakamaayiruppeerka'l; ithoa, en oozhiyakkaarar santhoashappaduvaarka'l, neengka'loa vedkappaduveerka'l.
ithoa, en oozhiyakkaarar manamakizhchchiyinaalea kempeerippaarka'l, neengka'loa mananoavinaalea ala'ri, aaviyin mu'rivinaalea pulampuveerka'l.

naan therinthuko'ndavarka'lukku neengka'l ungka'l naamaththaich saapavaarththaiyaakap pinvaiththuppoaveerka'l; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar unnaik kon'rupoattu, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararukku vea'rea naamaththaith tharippaar.

athinaalea poomiyilea thannai aaseervathikki'ravan saththiya theavanukku'l thannai aaseervathippaan; poomiyilea aa'naiyiduki'ravan saththiya theavanpearil aa'naiyiduvaan; munthina idukka'nka'l ma'rakkappattu, avaika'l en ka'nka'lukku ma'rainthupoayina.
ithoa, naan puthiya vaanaththaiyum puthiya poomiyaiyum sirushdikki'rean; munthinavaika'l ini ninaikkappaduvathumillai, manathilea thoan'ruvathumillai.
naan sirushdikki'rathinaalea neengka'l en'ren'raikkum makizhnthu ka'likoornthirungka'l; ithoa, erusaleamaik ka'likooruthalaakavum, athin janaththai makizhchchiyaakavum sirushdikki'rean.
naan erusaleaminmeal ka'likoornthu, en janaththinmeal makizhchchiyaayiruppean; azhukaiyin saththamum, kookkuralin saththamum athil inik keadkappaduvathillai.

angkea ini a'rpa aayusu'l'la paalakanum, than naadka'l poora'namaakaatha kizhavanum u'ndaayiraarka'l; noo'ru vayathusen'ru marikki'ravanum vaalipanen'ru e'n'nappaduvaan, noo'ru vayathu'l'lavanaakiya paaviyoa sapikkappaduvaan.
veeduka'laik katti, avaika'lil kudiyiruppaarka'l, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'lin kaniyaip pusippaarka'l.

avarka'l kattuki'rathum, vea'roruvar kudiyirukki'rathum, avarka'l naattuki'rathum, vea'roruvar kanipusikki'rathumaayiruppathillai; eanenil virudchaththin naadka'laippoala en janaththin naadka'lirukkum; naan therinthuko'ndavarka'l thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaika'lai nedunaa'laay anupavippaarka'l.

avarka'l viruthaavaaka uzhaippathillai; avarka'l thunpamu'ndaakap pi'l'laika'laip pe'ruvathumillai; avarka'lum, avarka'loadeakooda avarka'l santhaanamum karththaraalea aaseervathikkappatta santhathiyaayiruppaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l kooppiduki'ratha'rkumunnea naan ma'ruuththaravu koduppean; avarka'l peasumpoathea naan keadpean.

oanaayum aattukkuttiyum orumiththu meayum; singkam maattaippoala vaikkoalaith thinnum; puzhuthi sarppaththukku iraiyaakum; en parisuththa parvathamengkum avaika'l theengkuseyvathumillai, keadu'ndaakkuvathumillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: vaanam enakkuch singkaasanam, poomi enakkup paathapadi; neengka'l enakkuk kattum aalayam eppadippattathu? naan thangkiyirukkum sthalam eppadippattathu?

ennudaiya karam ivaika'laiyellaam sirushdiththathinaal ivaika'lellaam u'ndaayina en'ru karththar solluki'raar; aanaalum si'rumaippattu, aaviyil no'rungku'ndu, en vasanaththukku nadungkuki'ravanaiyea noakkippaarppean.

maattai vettuki'ravan manushanaik kolluki'ravanaakavum, aattaip paliyiduki'ravan naayaik kazhuththa'rukki'ravanaakavum, kaa'nikkaiyaip padaikki'ravan pan'ri iraththaththaip padaikki'ravanaakavum, thoopangkaattuki'ravan vikkirakaththai sthoaththirikki'ravanaakavum irukki'raan; ivarka'l thangka'l vazhika'laiyea therinthuko'l'luki'raarka'l; ivarka'ludaiya aaththumaa thangka'l aruvaruppuka'linmeal viruppamaayirukki'rathu.

naan kooppittum ma'ruuththaravu kodukki'ravanillaamalum, naan peasiyum avarka'l kea'laamalum, avarka'l en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythu, naan virumpaathathaith therinthuko'ndathinimiththam, naanum avarka'ludaiya aapaththaith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'ludaiya thikilka'lai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

karththarudaiya vasanaththukku nadungkuki'ravarka'lea, avarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; en naamaththinimiththam ungka'laip pakaiththu, ungka'lai appu'rappaduththuki'ra ungka'l sakoatharar, karththar makimaippaduvaaraaka enki'raarka'lea; avar ungka'lukkuch santhoasham u'ndaakumpadi kaa'nappaduvaar; avarka'loa vedkappaduvaarka'l.
nakaraththilirunthu ama'liyin iraichchalum theavaalayaththilirunthu saththamum keadkappadum; athu thamathu saththurukka'lukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattuki'ra karththarudaiya saththanthaanea.
pirasavaveathanaippadumun pet'raa'l, karppaveathanai varumun aa'npi'l'laiyaip pet'raa'l.

ippadippattavaika'laik kea'lvippattathu yaar? ippadippattavaika'laik ka'ndathu yaar? oru theasaththukku oreanaa'lil pi'l'laippea'ru varumoa? oru jaathi orumikkap pi'rakkumoa? seeyoanoavenil, orumikka veathanaippattum, than kumaararaip pet'rum irukki'rathu.
pe'rappa'n'nuki'ravaraakiya naan pe'rachseyyaamal iruppeanoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; pirasavikkappa'n'nuki'ravaraakiya naan pirasavaththaith thaduppeanoa en'ru un theavan solluki'raar.

erusaleamai neasikki'ra neengka'lellaarum ava'loadeakoodach santhoashappattu, ava'laikku'riththuk ka'likoorungka'l; ava'lnimiththam thukkiththiruntha neengka'lellaarum ava'loadeakooda mikavum makizhungka'l.
neengka'l ava'ludaiya aa'ruthalka'lin mulaippaalai u'ndu thirupthiyaaki, neengka'l sooppikkudiththu, ava'ludaiya makimaiyin pirakaasaththinaal manamakizhchchiyaakungka'l;

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan samaathaanaththai oru nathiyaippoalavum, jaathika'lin makimaiyaip pura'ndu oaduki'ra aat'raippoalavum ava'lidamaakap paayumpadi seyki'rean; appozhuthu neengka'l mulaippaal kudippeerka'l; iduppil vaiththuch sumakkappaduveerka'l; muzhangkaalil vaiththuth thaalaattappaduveerka'l.
oruvanai avan thaay theat'ruvathupoal naan ungka'laith theat'ruvean; neengka'l erusaleamilea theat'rappaduveerka'l.

neengka'l athaik kaa'numpoathu, ungka'l iruthayam makizhnthu, ungka'l elumpuka'l pasumpullaip poalach sezhikkum; appozhuthu karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaararidaththil avarudaiya karamum, avarudaiya saththurukka'lidaththil avarudaiya sinamum a'riyappadum.

ithoa, thammudaiya koapaththai ukkiramaakavum, thammudaiya kadinthuko'l'luthalai akkinijuvaalaiyaakavum seluththak karththar akkiniyoadum varuvaar, perungkaat'raippoan'ra thammudaiya irathangka'loadum varuvaar.
karththar akkiniyaalum, thamathu pattayaththaalum, maamsamaana ellaaroadum vazhakkaaduvaar; karththaraal kolaiyu'ndavarka'l aneakaraayiruppaarka'l.

thangka'laith thaangka'lea parisuththappaduththikko'l'luki'ravarka'lum, thoappuka'lin naduvilea thangka'laith thaangka'lea oruvarpin oruvaraaych suththikariththukko'l'luki'ravarka'lum, pan'riyi'raichchiyaiyum, aruvaruppaanathaiyum, eliyaiyum saappiduki'ravarka'lum eakamaaych sangkarikkappaduvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

naan avarka'l kiriyaika'laiyum, avarka'l ninaivuka'laiyum a'rinthirukki'rean; naan sakala jaathiyaaraiyum paashaikkaararaiyung koottichsearkkungkaalam varum; avarka'l vanthu en makimaiyaik kaa'npaarka'l.

naan avarka'lil oru adaiyaa'laththaik katta'laiyiduvean; avarka'lil thappinavarka'lai, en keerththiyaik kea'laamalum, en makimaiyaik kaa'naamalumirukki'ra jaathika'lin theasangka'laakiya tharsheesukkum, vilveerar irukki'ra poolukkum, loothukkum, thoopaalukkum, yaavaanukkum, thooraththilu'l'la theevuka'lukkum anuppuvean; avarka'l en makimaiyai jaathika'lukku'l'lea a'rivippaarka'l.

israveal puththirar suththamaana paaththiraththil kaa'nikkaiyaik karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvaruki'rathupoala, ungka'l sakoathararellaaraiyum avarka'l kuthiraika'linmealum, irathangka'linmealum, kulaariva'ndilka'linmealum, koavea'rukazhuthaika'linmealum, veakamaana ottakangka'linmealum, sakala jaathika'lidaththilumirunthu erusaleamilu'l'la karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaaka en parisuththa parvathaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'lilum silarai aasaariyaraakavum leaviyaraakavum therinthuko'lvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan padaikkappoaki'ra puthiya vaanamum puthiya poomiyum enakku munpaaka ni'rpathupoala, ungka'l santhathiyum, ungka'l naamamum ni'rkumen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu: maathanthoa'rum, oayvunaa'lthoa'rum, maamsamaana yaavarum enakku munpaakath thozhuthuko'lvaarka'len'ru karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l ve'liyea poay enakku viroathamaayp paathakagnseytha manusharudaiya pireathangka'laip paarppaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya poochchi saakaamalum, avarka'ludaiya akkini aviyaamalum irukkum; avarka'l maamsamaana yaavarukkum aroasikamaayiruppaarka'l.
penyameen theasaththilu'l'la aanathoath ooriliruntha aasaariyarka'lil oruvanaakiya ilkkiyaavin kumaaran ereamiyaavinudaiya vasanangka'l:
aamoanudaiya kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaa enki'ra yoothaavudaiya raajaavin naadka'lil, avan arasaa'nda pathinmoon'raam varushaththil ivanukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru.

appu'ram yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem enki'ra yoothaavudaiya raajaavin naadka'lilum, yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa enki'ra yoothaavudaiya raajaavin pathinoaraam varushaththu mudivumattaakavum, erusaleam ooraar ainthaam maathaththil si'raippattuppoakumvaraikkum karththarudaiya vaarththai avanukku u'ndaayit'ru.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

naan unnaith thaayin vayit'ril uruvaakku munnea unnai a'rinthean; nee karppaththilirunthu ve'lippadumunnea naan unnaip parisuththampa'n'ni, unnai jaathika'lukkuth theerkkatharisiyaakak katta'laiyittean en'ru sonnaar.
appozhuthu naan: aa karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ithoa, naan peasa a'riyean; si'rupi'l'laiyaayirukki'rean en'rean.
aanaalum karththar: naan si'rupi'l'laiyen'ru nee sollaathea, naan unnai anuppuki'ra ellaaridaththilum nee poay, naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'ravaika'laiyellaam nee peasuvaayaaka.
nee avarka'lukkup payappadavea'ndaam; unnaik kaakkumpadikku naan unnudanea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solli,
karththar thamathu karaththai neetti, en vaayaith thottu: ithoa, en vaarththaika'lai un vaayilea vaikki'rean.
paar, pidungkavum, idikkavum, azhikkavum, kavizhkkavum, kattavum, naattavum unnai naan in'raiyathinam jaathika'linmealum raajyangka'linmealum ea'rpaduththinean en'ru karththar ennudanea sonnaar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar: ereamiyaavea, nee ennaththaik kaa'nki'raay en'ru keattaar; vaathumaimaraththin ki'laiyaik kaa'nki'rean en'rean.
appozhuthu karththar: nee ka'ndathu sariyea; en vaarththaiyaith theeviramaay ni'raiveat'ruvean en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai ira'ndaantharam enakku u'ndaaki, avar: nee kaa'nki'rathu enna en'ru keattaar; pongkuki'ra paanaiyaik kaa'nki'rean, athin vaay vadakkeayirunthu noakkuki'rathu en'rean.
appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: vadakkeayirunthu theengku theasaththinudaiya kudika'l ellaarmealum varum.

ithoa, naan vadathisai raajyangka'lin vamsangka'laiyellaam kooppiduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'l vanthu avanavan than than singkaasanaththai erusaleamin olimukavaasalka'lukkum, athin sut'rumathilka'l ellaavat'ri'rkum viroathamaakavum, yoothaa theasaththu ellaap patta'nangka'lukkum viroathamaakavum vaippaarka'l.

avarka'l ennaivittu anniya theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaatti, thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaiyaip pa'ninthuko'nda avarka'ludaiya sakala theemaika'linimiththamum naan en niyaayaththeerppuka'lai avarka'lukku viroathamaakak koo'ruvean.

aakaiyaal nee un araiyaik kattikko'ndu nin'ru, naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'ravaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukkuch sol; naan unnai avarka'lukku munpaakak kalangkappa'n'naathapadikku, nee avarka'l mukaththukku agnchaathiru.

ithoa, theasamanaiththukkum, yoothaavin raajaakka'lukkum, athin pirapukka'lukkum, athin aasaariyarka'lukkum, theasaththin janangka'lukkum ethiraaka naan unnai in'raiyathinam ara'nippaana patta'namum, iruppuththoo'num, ve'nkala alangkamum aakkinean.
avarka'l unakku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaarka'l; aanaalum unnai mea'rko'l'lamaattaarka'l; unnai iradchikkumpadikku naan unnudanea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

nee poay, erusaleamin sevika'l keadkumpadik kooppittuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: vithaikkappadaatha theasamaakiya vanaantharaththilea nee ennaip pinpat'rivantha un i'lavayathin pakthiyaiyum, nee vaazhkkaippattapoathu unakkiruntha neasaththaiyum ninaiththirukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

israveal karththarukkup parisuththamum, avarudaiya vi'laivin mutha'rpalanumaayirunthathu; athaip padchiththa yaavarum kut'ravaa'lika'laanaarka'l; pollaappu avarka'lmeal vanthathen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
yaakkoapin kudumpaththaarea, israveal kudumpaththin vamsangka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: engka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ninavarum, avaantharave'liyum, pa'l'langka'lumu'l'la theasamum, va'radchiyum, mara'na iru'lumu'l'la theasamum, oruvanum kadavaamalum oru manushanum kudiyiraamalum irukki'ra theasamumaana vanaantharaththil engka'lai nadaththinavarumaakiya karththar engkeayen'ru ungka'l pithaakka'l kea'laamal,
ennaivittuth thoorappattu, maayaiyaip pinpat'ri, vee'naraayp poaki'ratha'rku ennidaththil enna aniyaayaththaik ka'ndaarka'l?

sezhippaana theasaththin kaniyaiyum nanmaiyaiyum saappidumpadikku naan ungka'lai avvidaththukku azhaiththukko'nduvanthean; aanaalum neengka'l atha'rku'l piraveasiththapoathu, en theasaththaith theettuppaduththi, en suthantharaththai aruvaruppaakkineerka'l.

karththar engkeayen'ru aasaariyarka'l sollaamalum, veathaththaip poathikki'ravarka'l ennai a'riyaamalumirunthu, meaypparka'l enakkuth thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l; theerkkatharisika'l paakaalaikko'ndu theerkkatharisanagnsolli, vee'naanavaika'laip pinpat'rinaarka'l.
aathalaal innum naan ungka'loadea vazhakkaaduvean, ungka'l pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'loadum vazhakkaaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l kiththeemin theevuka'lmattum kadanthupoayp paarththu, keathaarukku aa'l anuppi nan'raay visaariththu, ippadippatta kaariyam u'ndoa en'rum,
entha jaathiyaavathu theavarka'lallaatha thangka'l theavarka'lai maat'rinathu u'ndoa en'rum paarungka'l; en janangka'loa vee'naanavaika'lukkaakath thangka'l makimaiyai maat'rinaarka'l.
vaanangka'lea, ithinimiththam piramiththuk kontha'liththu, mikavum thidukkidungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en janangka'l ira'ndu theemaika'laich seythaarka'l; jeevaththa'n'neer oot'raakiya ennai vittuvittaarka'l; tha'n'neer ni'rkaatha thottika'laakiya vedippu'l'la thottika'laith thangka'lukku vettikko'ndaarka'l.
israveal oru vealaikkaaranoa? avan veettil pi'rantha adimaiyoa? ean ko'l'laiyaanaan?
paalasingkangka'l avanmeal kerchchiththu, muzhangki, avan theasaththaip paazhaakkivittana; avan patta'nangka'l kudiyiraamal sutterikkappattana.
noap, thakapaaneas ennum patta'nangka'lin puththirarum, un uchchanthalaiyai no'rukkinaarka'l.
un theavanaakiya karththar unnai vazhiyilea nadaththikko'ndupoakungkaalaththil, nee avarai vittuppoaki'rathinaal allavoa ithai unakku nearidappa'n'ninaay?

ippoathum seekoarin tha'n'neeraik kudippatha'rku ekipthukkup poaki'rathinaal unakkup pirayoajanam enna? aippiraaththu nathiyin tha'n'neeraik kudippatha'rku aseeriyaavukkup poaki'rathinaal unakkup pirayoajanam enna?

un theemai unnaith tha'ndikkum, un maa'rupaaduka'l unnaik ka'ndikkum; nee un theavanaakiya karththarai viduki'rathum, ennaip pat'rum payam unnidaththil illaamalirukki'rathum, eththanai pollaappum kasappumaana kaariyam en'ru u'narnthuko'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

poorvakaalanthuvakki naan un nukaththadiyai mu'riththu, un kattuka'lai a'ruththean; naan adimaippaduvathillaiyen'ru neeyum sonnaayea; aakilum, uyaramaana sakala meattinmealum, pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum nee veasiyaayth thiriki'raay.
naan unnai mut'rilum na'rkanitharum uyarkulath thiraadchachsediyaaka naattinean; nee enakkuk kaattuth thiraadchachsediyin aakaatha kodika'laay maa'rippoanathu enna?
nee unnai uvarma'n'ninaalea kazhuvi, athika savukkaaraththaik kaiyaadinaalum, un akkiramaththin ka'raika'l enakku munpaaka irukkumen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

naan theettuppadavillai; naan paakaalka'laip pinpat'ravillai en'ru nee eppadich solluki'raay? pa'l'laththaakkilea nee nadakki'ra maarkkaththaip paar; nee seythathai u'narnthuko'l; thaa'rumaa'raay oaduki'ra veakamaana pe'n'nottakam nee.

vanaantharaththilea pazhakinathum, than ichchaiyin mathave'riyilea kaat'rai udko'l'luki'rathumaana kaattukkazhuthai nee; athin aavalai ni'ruththi, athaith thiruppuki'ravan yaar? athaith theaduki'ravarka'l oruvarum varuththappadavea'ndiyathillai; athin maasaththil athaik ka'ndupidippaarka'l.

un kaal ve'rungkaalaakaathapadikkum, un tho'ndai va'radchiyadaiyaathapadikkum adakkikko'l en'raal, nee: athu koodaathakaariyam; naan appadich seyyamaattean; anniyarai neasikki'rean; avarka'l pi'rakea poavean enki'raay.

thirudan akappaduki'rapoathu, eppadi vedkappaduki'raanoa, appadiyea israveal vamsaththaar vedkappaduvaarka'l; kattaiyaip paarththu, nee en thakappan en'rum; kallaippaarththu, nee ennaippet'raay en'rum solluki'ra avarka'lum, avarka'l raajaakka'lum, avarka'l pirapukka'lum, avarka'l aasaariyarka'lum, avarka'l theerkkatharisika'lum vedkappaduvaarka'l.
avarka'l thangka'l mukaththaiyalla, thangka'l muthukai enakkuk kaattinaarka'l; thangka'l aapaththukkaalaththiloa ezhunthu engka'lai iradchiyum enki'raarka'l.
nee unakku u'ndupa'n'nina theavarka'l engkea? un aapaththukkaalaththil unnai iradchikkakkoodumaanaal avaika'l ezhumpattum; yoothaavea, un patta'nangka'lin ilakkamum, un theavarka'lin ilakkamum sari.
ennoadea neengka'l vazhakkaaduvaanean? neengka'l anaivarum enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'nineerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan ungka'l pi'l'laika'lai adiththathu viruthaa; sidchaiyai eat'rukko'l'laama'rpoanaarka'l; azhikki'ra singkaththaippoala ungka'l pattayam ungka'l theerkkatharisika'laip padchiththathu.

santhathiyaarea, neengka'l karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaich sinthiththuppaarungka'l: naan isravealukku vanaantharamum, kaariru'laana poomiyumaaka iruntheanoa? pinnai ean en janangka'l: naangka'lea ejamaanka'l, ini ummidaththil naangka'l varuvathillaiyen'ru solluki'raarka'l.
oru pe'n than aapara'naththaiyum, oru ma'navaatti than aadaika'laiyum ma'rappaa'loa? en janangka'loa e'n'nimudiyaatha naadka'laay ennai ma'ranthuvittaarka'l.
neasaththaith theadumpadikku nee un vazhika'lai nayappaduththuki'rathenna? ivvithamaay nee pollaatha sthireeka'lukkum un vazhika'laik kat'rukkoduththaay.

un vasthira oarangka'lilum kut'ramillaatha eazhai aaththumaakka'lin iraththam kaa'nappaduki'rathu; athaith thoa'ndith theaduki'rathinaal alla, athu ellaavat'rinmealum ve'liyaayirukki'rathinaal athaik ka'ndupidiththean.

aakilum: kut'ramillaathirukki'rean en'rum, avarudaiya koapam ennaivittuth thirumpit'ru en'rum solluki'raay; ithoa, naan paavagnseyyavillaiyen'ru nee solluki'rathinimiththam naan unnoadea vazhakkaaduvean.
nee un vazhiyai maat'rimaat'ri ivva'lavaay vilakippoaki'rathu enna? nee aseeriyaavinaal vedkippoanathupoala ekipthinaalum vedkippoavaay.
nee un kaika'lai un thalaiyinmeal vaiththukko'ndu ivvidaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoavaay; eanenil, un nampikkaika'laik karththar ve'ruththirukki'raar; avaika'laal unakkuk kaariyam vaaykkaathu.

oru purushan than manaiviyaith tha'l'livida, ava'l avanidaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, anniyapurushanukku manaiviyaanaal, avan ava'lidaththil inith thirumpappoavaanoa? antha theasam mikavum theettuppadumallavoa? en'ru manushar solluvaarka'l; neeyoaven'raal aneaka neasaroadea veasiththanampa'n'ninaay; aakilum ennidaththi'rkuth thirumpivaa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

nee meaduka'linmeal un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, nee veasiththanampa'n'naatha idam on'ru u'ndoa en'ru paar; vanaantharaththilea arapiyan kaaththukko'ndirukki'rathupoala, nee vazhi oarangka'lil un neasarukkuk kaaththukko'ndirunthu, un veasiththanangka'laalum, un akkiramangka'laalum theasaththaith theettuppaduththinaay.
athinimiththam mazhai varushiyaamalum, pinmaariyillaamalum poayit'ru; unakkoa, soarasthireeyin net'riyirukki'rathu; neeyoa: naa'namaattean enki'raay.
nee ithumuthal ennai noakki: en pithaavea, theavareer en i'lavayathin athipathiyen'ru solli,
sathaakaalamum koapaththai vaippaaroa? athai en'ren'raikkum kaappaaroa enki'raay allavoa? ithoa, ippadi nee solliyum pollaappuka'laich seythu, mignchippoaki'raay enki'raar.

yoasiyaa raajaavin naadka'lilea karththar ennai noakki: seerketta israveal enpava'l seythathaik ka'ndaayaa? ava'l uyaramaana sakala malaiyinmealum, pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum poay, angkea veasiththanampa'n'ninaa'l.
ava'l ippadiyellaam seythapinpu: nee ennidaththil thirumpivaa en'ru naan sonnean; ava'loa thirumpavillai; ithai ava'ludaiya sakoathariyaakiya yoothaa enki'ra thuroaki ka'ndaa'l.

seerketta israveal enpava'l vipasaarampa'n'nina mukaantharangka'l ellaavat'rinimiththamum naan ava'lai anuppivittu, ava'ludaiya tha'l'lutha'rseettai ava'lukkuk koduththapoathum, ava'ludaiya sakoathariyaakiya yoothaa enki'ra thuroaki payappadaamal; iva'lum poay veasiththanampa'n'ninaa'l, ithai naan ka'ndean.
pirasiththamaana ava'ludaiya veasiththanaththinaalea theasam theettuppattuppoayit'ru; kalloadum maraththoadum vipasaaram pa'n'nikko'ndirunthaa'l en'raar.

ivaika'laiyellaam ka'ndum, yoothaa enki'ra ava'ludaiya sakoathariyaakiya thuroaki, ka'l'laththanamaayth thirumpinaa'leayan'ri, muzhu iruthayaththoadum ennidaththil thirumpavillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: yoothaa enki'ra thuroakiyaippaarkkilum seerketta israveal enpava'l thannai neethiyu'l'lava'laakkinaa'l.

nee poay vadathisaiyai noakkik koo'ravea'ndiya vaarththaika'l ennaven'raal: seerketta isravealea, thirumpu en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan ungka'lmeal en koapaththai i'rangkappa'n'nuvathillai; naan kirupaiyu'l'lavaren'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan en'raikkum koapam vaikkamaattean.

neeyoa, un theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ni, pachchaiyaana sakala maraththinkeezhum anniyaroadea soaramaarkkamaay nadanthu, un akkiramaththaiyum, en saththaththukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanathaiyum oththukko'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

seerketta pi'l'laika'lea, thirumpungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan ungka'l naayakar; naan ungka'lai ooril oruvanum, vamsaththil ira'ndupearumaakath therinthu, ungka'laich seeyoanukku azhaiththukko'nduvanthu,
ungka'lukku en iruthayaththukku eat'ra meaypparka'laik koduppean, avarka'l ungka'lai a'rivoadum puththiyoadum meayppaarka'l.

neengka'l theasaththilea perukip palukuki'ra annaadka'lilea, avarka'l karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyen'ru inich solvathillai; athu avarka'l manathil ezhumpuvathum illai; athu avarka'l ninaivil varuvathum illai; athaikku'riththu visaarippathum illai; athu inich seppanidappaduvathum illai en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

akkaalaththilea erusaleamaik karththarudaiya singkaasanam enpaarka'l; sakala jaathiyaarum erusaleamil vi'langkiya karththarudaiya naamaththinimiththam athinidamaakach searvaarka'l; avarka'l inith thangka'l pollaatha iruthayaththin ichchaiyinpadi nadavaarka'l.

annaadka'lilea yoothaa vamsaththaar israveal vamsaththaaroadea searnthu, avarka'l eakamaay vadatheasaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, naan thangka'l pithaakka'lukkuch suthantharamaakak koduththa theasaththi'rku varuvaarka'l.

naan unnaip pi'l'laika'lin varisaiyilea vaiththu, janakkoottangka'lukku'l'lea nalla suthantharamaakiya theasaththai unakkuk koduppathu eppadiyen'ru sonnean; aanaalum nee ennai noakki, en pithaavea en'ru azhaippaay; nee ennaivittu vilakuvathillai en'ru thirumpavum sonnean.
oru manaivi than purushanukkuth thuroakam seyvathupoala, israveal vamsaththaaraakiya neengka'l enakkuth thuroakamseythathu mey en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
israveal puththirar thangka'l vazhiyai maa'rupaadaakki, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarai ma'ranthathinimiththam azhuthuko'ndu vi'n'nappagnseyyum saththam uyarntha sthaanangka'lilea keadkappadum.
seerketta pi'l'laika'lea, thirumpungka'l; ungka'l seerkeaduka'laik ku'namaakkuvean en'raar. ithoa, ummidaththil varuki'roam; neerea engka'l theavanaakiya karththar.
kun'ruka'laiyum, thira'laana malaika'laiyum nampuki'rathu viruthaa enpathu mey; isravealin iradchippu engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku'l iruppathu enpathu meyyea.

intha ilachchaiyaanathu engka'l si'ruvayathumuthal engka'l pithaakka'ludaiya pirayaasaththaiyum, avarka'l aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum, avarka'l kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum padchiththuppoattathu.

engka'l ilachchaiyilea kidakki'roam; engka'l avamaanam engka'lai moodiyirukki'rathu; naangka'lum, engka'l pithaakka'lum engka'l si'ruvayathumuthal innaa'lvaraikkum engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythoam; engka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya sollaik kea'laamalumpoanoam.
isravealea, nee thirumpuki'ratha'rku manathaayirunthaal ennidaththil thirumpu en'ru karththar solluki'raar; nee un aruvaruppuka'lai en paarvaiyinin'ru akat'rivittaal, nee ini alainthu thirivathillai.
nee u'nmaiyoadum, niyaayaththoadum, neethiyoadum, karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyiduvaay; pu'rajaathika'lum avarukku'l aaseervathikkappattu, avarukku'l meanmaipaaraattuvaarka'l.
yoothaa manusharoadum, erusaleamiyaroadum karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l mu'l'luka'lukku'l'lea vithaiyaathirungka'l, ungka'l tharisunilaththaip pa'npaduththungka'l.

yoothaa manusharea, erusaleamin kudika'lea, ungka'l kiriyaika'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam en ukkiram akkiniyaippoala ezhumpi, avippaar illaamal eriyaathapadikku neengka'l karththarukken'ru ungka'lai viruththaseathanampa'n'ni, ungka'l iruthayaththin nuniththoalai neekkippoadungka'l.

theasaththil ekkaa'lam oothungka'l en'ru solli, yoothaavil a'riviththu, erusaleamil keadkappa'n'nungka'l; naam ara'naana patta'nangka'lukku udpadumpadikkuch searungka'l en'ru solli, uraththa saththamaayk kooppidungka'l.
seeyoanukku nearea kodiyeat'rungka'l; koodungka'l, ni'rkaathirungka'l; naan vadakkeayirunthu pollaappaiyum, makaa sangkaaraththaiyum varappa'n'nuki'rean.

un theasaththaip paazhaakki vidumpadikkuch singkam than putharilirunthu ezhumpi, jaathika'laich sangkarikki'ravan than sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'raan; un patta'nangka'l kudiyiraathapadi azhikkappadum enki'raar.
ithinimiththam irattaik kattikko'l'lungka'l; pulampi ala'rungka'l; karththarudaiya ukkirakoapam nammaivittuth thirumpavillaiyea.
annaa'lilea raajaavin iruthayamum, pirapukka'lin iruthayamum madinthupoam; aasaariyarka'l thidukkittu, theerkkatharisika'l thikaippaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

appozhuthu naan: aa! karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ungka'lukkuch samaathaanamirukkum en'ru sonnathinaal, meyyaakavea intha janaththukkum erusaleamukkum mikuthiyaana moasaththai varappa'n'nineer; pattayam piraa'nanmattum ettuki'rathea en'rean.

vanaantharaththilu'l'la uyarnilangka'lilirunthu, oru theekkaat'ru en janamaakiya kumaaraththikku nearaaka adikkum en'ru akkaalaththilea intha janaththoadum erusaleamoadum sollappadum; athu thoot'ravumaattaathu suththikarikkavumaattaathu.
ithaippaarkkilum palamaana kaat'ru en kaariyamaay varum; ippozhuthu naanum avarka'loadea niyaayam peasuvean.

ithoa, meakangka'laippoala ezhumpivaruki'raan; avanudaiya irathangka'l perungkaat'raippoalirukki'rathu; avan kuthiraika'l kazhukuka'lilum veakamaanavaika'l; namakku aiyoa! naam paazhaakkappaduki'roamea.
erusaleamea, nee iradchikkappadumpadikku un iruthayaththaip pollaappa'rak kazhuvu; enthamattum akkirama ninaivuka'l un u'l'laththilea thangkum.
thaa'nilirunthu oru saththam vanthu, seythiyai a'rivikki'rathu; eppiraayeemin malaiyilirunthu vanthu, theengkaip pirasiththampa'n'nuki'rathu.

jaathika'lukku athai neengka'l pirasthaapampa'n'nungka'l; ithoa, kaava'rseavakar thooratheasaththilirunthu vanthu, yoothaavudaiya patta'nangka'lukku viroathamaay uraththasaththamiduvaarka'l en'ru erusaleamukkuk koo'rungka'l.
atha'rku viroathamaay avarka'l vayalve'lika'lin kaava'rkaararaippoalach sut'rilumiruppaarka'l; athu enakku viroathamaayk kalakagnseythathu en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
un nadakkaiyum un kiriyaika'lumea ivaika'lai unakku nearidappa'n'nina; ithu iththanai kasappaayirunthu, un iruthayamattum ettuki'ratha'rkuk kaara'nam un pollaappuththaanea.

en kudalka'l, en kudalka'lea noaki'rathu; en u'l'lam veathanaippaduki'rathu, en iruthayam ennil katha'ruki'rathu; naan peasaamal amarnthirukkakkoodaathu; en aaththumaavea, ekkaa'laththin saththaththaiyum, yuththaththin aarpparippaiyum keattaayea.
naasaththukkumeal naasam varuki'rathaakak koo'rappaduki'rathu; theasamellaam paazhaaki'rathu; asuppilea en koodaarangka'lum, oru nimishaththilea en thiraika'lum paazhaakkappaduki'rathu.
naan ethuvaraikkum kodiyaikka'ndu, ekkaa'laththin saththaththaik keadpean.

en janangka'loa mathiyat'ravarka'l, ennai avarka'l a'riyaathirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l paiththiyamu'l'la pi'l'laika'l, avarka'lukku u'narvea illai; pollaappuchseyya avarka'l a'rivaa'lika'l, nanmaiseyyavoa avarka'l a'rivillaathavarka'l.
poomiyaip paarththean, athu ozhungkinmaiyum ve'rumaiyumaayirunthathu; vaanangka'laip paarththean, avaika'lukku o'liyillaathirunthathu.
parvathangka'laip paarththean, avaika'l athirnthana; ellaak kun'ruka'lum asainthana.
pinnum naan paarkkumpoathu, manushanillai; aakaasaththup pa'ravaika'lellaam pa'ranthupoayina.
pinnum naan paarkkumpoathu, karththaraalum, avarudaiya ukkirakoapaththaalum payirnilam vanaantharamaayit'ru; athin patta'nangka'lellaam idinthupoayina.
theasamellaam paazhaayppoam; aakilum sarvasangkaaram seyyean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithinimiththam poomi pulampum, uyara irukki'ra vaanangka'l ka'ruththuppoam; naan athaich sonnean, athai nir'nayam pa'n'ninean; naan manasthaapappaduvathum illai; naan athaivittuth thirumpuvathum illai.

kuthiraiveerarum vilveerarum idum saththaththinaalea sakala ooraarum oadi, adarththiyaana kaaduka'lil pukunthu, kanmalaika'lilum ea'ruvaarka'l; oru manushanum avaika'lilea kudiyiraathapadi ellaa oorka'lum vidappattirukkum.

paazhaayppoana nee ippozhuthu enna seyvaay? nee iraththaamparam uduththaalum, ponnaapara'nangka'laal unnaich singkaariththaalum, un ka'nka'lil maiyittukko'ndaalum, vee'naay unnai azhakupaduththuvaay; soaranaayakar unnai asattaipa'n'ni, un piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduvaarka'l.

karppaveathanaippaduki'rava'lin saththamaakavum, muthalvisai pi'l'lai pe'ruki'rava'lin viyaakulamaakavum, seeyoan kumaaraththiyin saththaththaik keadki'rean; ava'l perumoochchuvittu, than kaika'lai viriththu: aiyoa! kolaipaathakarka'laalea en aaththumaa soarnthupoaki'rathea enki'raa'l.

niyaayagnseyki'ra manushanaik ka'ndupidippeerka'loa en'rum, saththiyaththaith theaduki'ravan u'ndoa en'rum, erusaleamin therukka'lilea thirinthupaarththu, visaariththu, athin veethika'lilea theadungka'l; kaa'npeerka'laanaal atha'rku mannipputh tharuvean.
avarka'l: karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'roam en'raalum, poyyaa'naiyiduki'raarka'lea.

karththaavea, ummudaiya ka'nka'l saththiyaththai allavoa noakkukin'rathu; avarka'lai adikki'reer, aanaalum avarka'lukku noakaathu; avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkuki'reer, aanaalum puththiyai eat'rukko'l'lamaattoam enki'raarka'l; thangka'l mukangka'laik kanmalaiyaippaarkkilum kettiyaakki, thirumpamaattoam enki'raarka'l.
appozhuthu naan: ivarka'l neesaraamea, ivarka'l mathiyat'ravarka'l; karththarudaiya vazhiyaiyum, thangka'l theavanudaiya niyaayaththaiyum a'riyaathirukki'raarka'l en'rum;

naan periyoarka'lidaththilea poay, avarka'loadea peasuvean; avarka'l karththarudaiya vazhiyaiyum, thangka'l theavanudaiya niyaayaththaiyum a'rivaarka'l en'rum sonnean; avarka'loa eakamaay nukaththadiyai mu'riththu, kattuka'lai a'ruththuppoattaarka'l.

aakaiyaal kaattilirunthu varum singkam avarka'laik kollum, vanaantharaththilu'l'la oanaayka'l avarka'laip pee'rum, sivingki avarka'l patta'nangka'linmeal noakkamaayirukkum; avaika'lilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ravan evanum pee'rappaduvaan; avarka'l mee'ruthalka'l peruki, avarka'l seerkeaduka'l athikariththathu.

ivaika'lai naan unakku mannippathu eppadi? un pi'l'laika'l ennai vittuvittu, theyvam allaathavaika'l pearil aa'naiyiduki'raarka'l; naan thirupthiyaakkina avarka'l vipasaarampa'n'ni, veasiveettilea koottangkooduki'raarka'l.
avarka'l kozhuththa kuthiraika'laippoal kaalamea ezhumpi, avanavan thanthan ayalaanudaiya pe'njaathiyin pinnaalea kanaikki'raan.
ivaika'lai visaariyaathiruppeanoa? ippadippatta jaathikku en aaththumaa neethiyaich sarikkattaathirukkumoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
athin mathilka'lmealea'ri azhiththuppoadungka'l; aanaalum sarvasangkaaram seyyaathirungka'l; athin koththa'langka'lai idiththuppoadungka'l; avaika'l karththarudaiyavaika'l alla.
israveal vamsaththaarum, yoothaa vamsaththaarum enakku viroathamaay mikuthiyum thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avar appadippattavar allaven'rum, pollaappu nammeal varaathu, naam pattayaththaiyaakilum, pagnchaththaiyaakilum kaa'npathillaiyen'rum,
theerkkatharisika'l kaat'raayppoavaarka'l; thiruvaakku avarka'lil illai; avarka'lukkea appadi aakakkadavathen'rum, avarka'l sollik karththarai ma'ruthaliththaarka'l.

aakaiyaal seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l intha vaarththaiyaich sonnapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan un vaayilitta en vaarththaika'lai akkiniyum, intha janaththai vi'rakum aakkuvean, athu ivarka'laip padchikkum.

israveal vamsaththaarea, ithoa, thooraththilirunthu naan ungka'lmeal oru jaathiyaik ko'nduvaruvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; athu palaththa jaathi, athu poorvakaalaththu jaathi, avarka'l nee a'riyaatha paashaiyaip peasum jaathi, avarka'l peasuki'rathu innathen'ru unakku vi'langkaathu.
thi'rantha pireathakkuzhika'laippoal avarka'l ampa'raaththoo'nika'l irukkum; avarka'l anaivarum paraakkiramasaalika'l.

avarka'l un kumaararum un kumaaraththika'lum saappidavea'ndiya un vi'laichchalaiyum, un appaththaiyum saappittu, un aaduka'laiyum un maaduka'laiyum padchiththu, un thiraadchappazhangka'laiyum un aththippazhangka'laiyum saappittu, nee nampina unnudaiya ara'naana patta'nangka'laip pattayaththaalea ve'rumaiyaakkuvaarka'l.
aakilum naan annaadka'lilum ungka'laich sarvasangkaaram seyyaathiruppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

engka'l theavanaakiya karththar engka'lukku ivaika'laiyellaam ethinimiththam seythaar en'ru neengka'l keattaal, appozhuthu nee avarka'laip paarththu: neengka'l ennaivittu, ungka'ludaiya theasaththilea anniya theavarka'laich seaviththathupoala, ungka'ludaiyathallaatha theasaththilea anniyarka'laich seavippeerka'len'ru solvaayaaka.
neengka'l yaakkoapin veettilea a'riviththu, yoothaavilea sollik koo'ravea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,
ka'nka'l irunthum kaa'naamalum, kaathuka'l irunthum kea'laamalumirukki'ra a'rivillaatha janangka'lea, kea'lungka'l.

enakkup payappadaathiruppeerka'loa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; alaika'l moathiyadiththaalum mea'rko'l'laathapadikkum, avaika'l irainthaalum kadavaathapadikkum, kadakkakkoodaatha niththiya piramaa'namaakach samuththiraththin ma'nalai ellaiyaay vaiththirukki'ravaraakiya enakku munpaaka athiraathiruppeerka'loa?
intha janangka'loa murattaattamum kalakamumaana iruthayamu'l'lavarka'l; murattaattampa'n'nip poayviduki'raarka'l.

anthanthap paruvaththilea engka'lukku mazhaiyaiyum, munmaariyaiyum pinmaariyaiyum koduththu, a'ruppukku niyamiththa vaarangka'lai engka'lukkuth tha'rkaakki'ra engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup payanthiruppoam en'ru avarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththilea solluki'rathillai.
ungka'l akkiramangka'l ivaika'lai vilakki, ungka'l paavangka'l ungka'lukku nanmaiyai varavottaathirukki'rathu.
kuruvipidikki'ravarka'l pathungkuki'rathupoal pathungki, manusharaip pidikkak ka'n'nika'lai vaikki'ra thunmaarkkar en janangka'lil kaa'nappaduki'raarka'l.
kuruvika'laal koo'ndu ni'rainthirukki'rathupoal, avarka'l veeduka'l kapadangka'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; aathalaal avarka'l peruki aisuvariyavaanka'laaki'raarka'l.

kozhuththu, sa'lukkuppa'n'nuki'raarka'l; thunmaarkkanudaiya seyalka'laik ka'ndikkaamal viduki'raarka'l; thikkat'ravanudaiya vazhakkai visaariyaamal, thaangka'lmaaththiram vaazhuki'raarka'l; e'liyavarka'lin niyaayaththaith theeraarka'l.
ivaika'lai visaariyaathiruppeanoa? ippadippatta jaathikku en aaththumaa neethiyaich sarikkattaathirukkumoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
thikaiththuth thidukkidaththakka kaariyam theasaththilea nadanthuvaruki'rathu.

theerkkatharisika'l ka'l'laththeerkkatharisanam solluki'raarka'l; aasaariyarka'l avarka'l moolamaay aa'luki'raarka'l; ippadiyiruppathu en janaththukkup piriyamaayirukki'rathu; aanaalum mudivilea ennaseyveerka'l?

penyameen puththirarea, neengka'l erusaleamin naduvilirunthu eakamaayk koodiyoadi, thekkoavaavil ekkaa'lam oothi, pethkeareaminmeal adaiyaa'lamaakath theeve'lichchang kaattungka'l; oru theengkum makaa sangkaaramum vadakkeayirunthu thoan'ruki'rathaayirukki'rathu.
selvamaay va'larntha roopavathiyaana seeyoan kumaaraththiyaip paazhaakkuvean.
meayppar thangka'l manthaika'loadea ava'lidaththukku varuvaarka'l; avarka'l ava'lukku viroathamaaych sut'rilum koodaarampoattu, avanavan than than sthalaththil meayththu,

ava'lukku viroathamaay yuththagnseyya aayaththampa'n'nungka'l en'rum, maththiyaanaththilthaanea naam poayea'rumpadikku ezhunthirungka'l; aiyoa! pozhuthu saaynthu, anthi nizhalka'l nee'ndupoaki'rathea;
ezhunthirungka'l, naam iraakkaalaththilaakilum poayea'ri, ava'ludaiya aramanaika'lai azhippoam en'rum solluvaarka'l.
seanaika'ludaiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, marangka'lai vetti, erusaleamukku viroathamaayk koththa'lam poadungka'l; athuvea visaarikkappadavea'ndiya nakaram; athin udpu'ramellaam kodumai.

oot'raanathu, than tha'n'neeraich surakkappa'n'numaappoala, athu than theengkaich surakkappa'n'nuki'rathu; athilea kodumaiyum azhimpum keadkappaduki'rathu; thukkamum kaayangka'lum niththamum enakku munpaakak kaa'nappaduki'rathu.
erusaleamea, en aaththumaa unnaivittup piriyaathapadikkum, naan unnaip paazhum kudiyat'ra theasamum aakkaathapadikkum puththikea'l.

thiraadchakkulaika'lai a'rukki'ravanaippoala un kaiyaith thirumpak koodaika'linmeal poaden'ru solli, avarka'l isravealil meethiyaayiruntha kaniyaith thiraadchachsediyin kaniyaippoal nan'raayp po'rukkikko'ndu poavaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l keadkumpadi naan yaaroadea peasi echcharippean? avarka'ludaiya sevi viruththaseathanamillaathathu; avarka'l keadkamaattaarka'l; karththarudaiya vasanam avarka'lukku ninthaiyaayirukki'rathu; athinmeal avarka'lukku viruppamillai.

aakaiyaal naan karththarudaiya ukkiraththaal ni'rainthirukki'rean; athai adakki i'laiththuppoanean; veethika'lilu'l'la pi'l'laika'linmealum, vaaliparudaiya koottaththinmealum eakamaay athai oot'rividuvean; purusharum, sthireeka'lum, kizhavarum, poora'na vayathu'l'lavarka'lungkoodap pidikkappaduvaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya veeduka'lum, avarka'ludaiya kaa'nipoomika'lum, avarka'ludaiya manaivika'loadea eakamaay anniyar vasamaakum; en kaiyai inthath theasaththin kudika'lukku viroathamaaka neettuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'lil, si'riyoarmuthal periyoarmattum, ovvoruvarum poru'laasaikkaarar; ithuvumallaamal theerkkatharisika'lmuthal aasaariyarka'lmattum ovvoruvarum poyyar.
samaathaanamillaathirunthum: samaathaanam samaathaanam en'ru solli, en janaththin kaayangka'lai mea'rpoochchaayk ku'namaakkuki'raarka'l.

avarka'l aruvaruppaanathaich seythathinimiththam vedkappaduki'raarka'loa? parichcheatham vedkappadaarka'l, naa'navum a'riyaarka'l; aathalaal vizhuki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea vizhuvaarka'l; naan avarka'lai visaarikkung kaalaththil ida'ru'ndupoavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

vazhika'lilea nin'ru, poorva paathaika'l evaiyen'ru keattu visaariththu, nalla vazhi engkea en'ru paarththu, athilea nadavungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'l aaththumaavukku i'laippaa'ruthal kidaikkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'loa: naangka'l athilea nadakkamaattoam enki'raarka'l.
naan ungka'lmeal kaavalaa'laraiyum vaiththu, ekkaa'la saththaththukkuch sevikodungka'l en'rum sonnean; avarka'loa: naangka'l keadkamaattoam enki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal jaathika'lea, kea'lungka'l; sapaiyea, avarka'lukku'l nadakki'rathai a'rinthuko'l.

poomiyea, kea'l; intha janangka'l en vaarththaika'laik kea'laamalirunthu, en niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuch sevikodaamal athai ve'ruththuviduki'raarka'l; avarka'lmeal naan avarka'l ninaivuka'lin palanaakiya theengkai varappa'n'nuvean.

seapaavilirunthu varuki'ra thoopavarkkamum, thooratheasaththinudaiya sukanthappattaiyum enakku ennaththukku? ungka'l sarvaangkathakanangka'l enakku viruppamalla; ungka'l palika'l enakku inpamaayiraathu.

aakaiyaal ithoa, naan intha janaththukku ida'ralka'lai vaippean; avaika'lmeal pithaakka'lum, pi'l'laika'lum, kudiyaanavanum, avanukkaduththavanum, eakamaay ida'ru'ndu azhivaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, vadatheasaththilirunthu oru janam vanthu, poomiyin kadaiyellaika'lilirunthu oru periya jaathi ezhumpum.

avarka'l villum vealum pidiththu varuvaarka'l; avarka'l kodiyar, irakkam a'riyaathavarka'l; avarka'l saththam samuththira iraichchalukkuch samaanamaayirukkum; seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, avarka'l unakku viroathamaaka yuththasannaththaraayk kuthiraika'linmealea'ri a'niya'niyaaka varuvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'l varuki'ra seythiyaik keattoam; nammudaiya kaika'l tha'larnthathu; idukka'num, karppavathikku u'ndaakum veathanaikkoppaana veathanaiyum nammaip pidiththathu.
vayalve'liyilea pu'rappadaathirungka'l; vazhiyilum nadavaathirungka'l; sut'rilum saththuruvin pattayamum payangkaramumu'ndu.
en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyea, nee irattaik kattikko'ndu, saampalilea pura'ndu, orea puththiranukkaakath thukkikki'rathupoala manangkasanthu pulampu; paazhaakkuki'ravan sadithiyaay nammeal varuvaan.
nee en janaththin vazhiyai a'rinthuko'l'lavum soathiththuppaarkkavum naan unnai avarka'lukku'l'lea thurukamaakavum, ara'naakavum vaiththean.
avarka'lellaarum murattaattamaana akangkaarika'lum, thoot'riththiriki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l ve'nkalamum irumpumaanavarka'l; avarka'lellaarum kettavarka'l.
thuruththi venthathu; eeyam neruppinaal azhinthathu; pudamiduki'ravanudaiya pirayaasam viruthaavaayppoayit'ru; pollaappuka'l at'ruppoakavillai.
avarka'l tha'l'lupadiyaana ve'l'li ennappaduvaarka'l; karththar avarka'laith tha'l'livittaar.
karththaraal ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vasanam:

nee karththarudaiya aalayaththin vaasalilea nin'ru, angkea koo'rich sollavea'ndiya vasanam ennaven'raal, karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'la intha vaasalka'lukku'l'lea piraveasikki'ra yootha janangka'laakiya neengka'lellaarum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar: ungka'l vazhika'laiyum ungka'l kiriyaika'laiyum seerppaduththungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lai intha sthalaththilea kudiyirukkappa'n'nuvean.
karththarin aalayam, karththarin aalayam, karththarin aalayam ithuvea en'ru solli, poyvaarththaika'lai nampikko'l'laathirungka'l.
neengka'l ungka'l vazhika'laiyum ungka'l kiriyaika'laiyum nan'raaych seerppaduththi, neengka'l manushanukkum manushanukkumu'l'la vazhakkai niyaayamaayth theerththu,

paratheasiyaiyum thikkat'ravanaiyum vithavaiyaiyum odukkaamalum, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththai intha sthalaththilea sinthaamalum; ungka'lukkuk keadu'ndaaka anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'raamalum iruppeerka'leayaakil,
appozhuthu naan ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa theasamaakiya intha sthalaththilea ungka'laich sathaakaalamum kudiyirukkappa'n'nuvean.
ithoa, on'rukkum uthavaatha poyvaarththaika'lai neengka'l nampuki'reerka'l.
neengka'l thirudi, kolaiseythu, vipasaarampa'n'ni, poyyaa'naiyittu, paakaalukkuth thoopangkaatti, neengka'l a'riyaatha anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'ri,
pi'rpaadu vanthu, en naamam tharikkappatta intha aalayaththilea enakku munpaaka nin'ru: intha aruvaruppuka'laiyellaam seyvatha'rkaaka viduthalai pet'rirukki'roamen'ru solveerka'loa?
en naamam tharikkappatta intha aalayam ungka'l paarvaikkuk ka'l'larkukaiyaayit'roa? ithoa, naanum ithaik ka'ndean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan munthi en naamam vi'langkappa'n'nina seeloavilu'l'la en sthalaththukku neengka'l poay, israveal janaththinudaiya pollaappinimiththam naan atha'rkuch seythathaip paarungka'l.

neengka'l inthak kiriyaika'laiyellaam seytheerka'l, naan ungka'lukku ea'rkanavea sollivanthirunthum, neengka'l kea'laamalum, naan ungka'laik kooppittum, neengka'l uththaravukodaamalum poanapadiyinaal,

en naamam tharikkappattathum, neengka'l nampikkai ko'ndirukki'rathumaana intha aalayaththukkum, ungka'lukkum ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum naan koduththa sthalaththukkum, naan seeloavukkuch seythathupoalach seyvean.
naan ungka'ludaiya ellaach sakoathararumaakiya eppiraayeem santhathi anaiththaiyum tha'l'lippoattathupoala, ungka'laiyum en mukaththaivittuth tha'l'lippoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
nee intha janaththukkaaka vi'n'nappam seyyavea'ndaam; avarka'lukkaaka man'raadavum kegnchavum vea'ndaam, ennidaththil avarka'lukkaakap parinthupeasavum vea'ndaam, naan unakkuch sevikoduppathillai.
yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum avarka'l seyki'rathai nee kaa'navillaiyaa?

enakku manamadivu'ndaaka anniya theavarka'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarkki'raarka'l; avarka'l vaanaraakkinikkup pa'niyaarangka'laich sudumpadi pi'l'laika'l vi'raku po'rukkuki'raarka'l, pithaakka'l neruppu moottuki'raarka'l, sthireeka'l maappisaiki'raarka'l.
avarka'l enakkaa manamadivu'ndaakkuki'raarka'l? thangka'l mukangka'l vedkaththukkudpadumpadi avarka'l thangka'lukkea allavoa manamadivu'ndaakkuki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aathalaal ithoa, en koapamum en ukkiramum intha sthalaththinmealum, manusharmealum, mirukangka'lmealum, ve'liyin marangka'lmealum, poomiyin kanika'lmealum oot'rappadum; athu aviyaamal eriyum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathennaven'raal: ungka'l thakanapalika'lai mat'rap palika'loadungkootti, i'raichchiyaich saappidungka'l.

naan ungka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththuvantha naa'lilea, thakanapaliyaikku'riththum, mat'rap palika'laikku'riththum naan avarka'loadea peasinathaiyum katta'laiyittathaiyumpaarkkilum,

en vaakkukkuch sevikodungka'l, appozhuthu naan ungka'l theavanaayiruppean, neengka'l en janamaayiruppeerka'l; naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikkum ellaa vazhiyilum, neengka'l ungka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaakumpadikku nadavungka'l enki'ra viseashaththaiyea avarka'lukkuch sollik katta'laiyittean.
avarka'loa athaik kea'laamalum, thangka'l seviyaich saayaamalumpoay, thangka'l pollaatha iruthayaththin yoasanaika'linpadiyum kadinaththinpadiyum nadanthu, munnittalla pinnittea poanaarka'l.

ungka'l pithaakka'l ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappatta naa'lmuthal innaa'lmattum naan theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararaiyellaam thinanthinam ungka'la'ndaikku ea'rkanavea anuppikko'ndirunthean.
aanaalum avarka'l en sollaik kea'laamalum, thangka'l seviyaich saayaamalum poay, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththi, thangka'l pithaakka'laippaarkkilum athika pollaappuch seythaarka'l.
nee intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukkuch sonnaalum, avarka'l unakkuch sevikodukkamaattaarka'l; nee avarka'lai noakkik kooppittaalum, avarka'l unakku ma'ruuththaravu kodukkamaattaarka'l.

aakaiyaal thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththaik kea'laamalum, puththiyai eat'rukko'l'laamalum irukki'ra jaathi ithuthaan en'rum, saththiyam azhinthu, athu avarka'l vaayilirunthu at'ruppoanathen'rum avarka'lukkuch sol.
nee un thalaimayiraich siraiththu, e'rinthuvittu, uyarthalangka'lilea pulampikko'ndiru; karththar thamathu sinaththukku eathuvaana santhathiyai ve'ruththu nekizhavittaar.

yoothaa puththirar en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; en naamam thariththirukki'ra aalayaththaith theettuppaduththath thangka'l aruvaruppuka'lai athilea vaiththaarka'l.

thangka'l kumaararaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum akkiniyilea thakanikki'ratha'rkaaka, avarka'l innoam kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakkilu'l'la thoappeaththin meadaika'laik kattinaarka'l; athai naan katta'laiyidavumillai, athu en manathil thoan'ravumillai.

aathalaal, ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar; appozhuthu athu appu'ram thoappeath en'rum, innoam kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakken'rum sollappadaamal, sangkaarap pa'l'laththaakken'ru sollappadum; thoappeaththilea idangkidaiyaama'rpoakumattum savangka'lai adakkampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
intha janaththin pi'nangka'l aakaayaththin pa'ravaika'lukkum poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakum; avaika'lai veruttuvaarum illaathiruppaarka'l.

naan yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum ka'lippin saththaththaiyum, makizhchchiyin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaa'lanin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaattiyin saththaththaiyum oayappa'n'nuvean; theasam paazhaakum.

akkaalaththilea yoothaavinudaiya raajaakka'lin elumpuka'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya pirapukka'lin elumpuka'laiyum, aasaariyarka'lin elumpuka'laiyum, theerkkatharisika'lin elumpuka'laiyum, erusaleamudaiya kudika'lin elumpuka'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'lilirunthu eduththu,

avarka'l neasiththathum, seaviththathum, pinpat'rinathum, naadinathum, pa'ninthuko'ndathumaayiruntha sooriyanukkum, santhiranukkum, vaanaththin sarvaseanaikkum munpaaka avaika'laip parappivaippaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avaika'l vaari adakkampa'n'nappadaamal poomiyinmeal eruvaakum.

inthath thushda vamsaththil meethiyaayirunthu, ennaal ellaa idangka'lilum thuraththividappattu meenthirukki'ra yaavarukkum, jeevanaippaarkkilum mara'namea viruppamaayirukkumen'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
nee avarka'lai noakki: vizhunthavarka'l ezhunthirukki'rathillaiyoa? vazhithappippoanavarka'l thirumpuki'rathillaiyoa?
aanaalum erusaleamiyaraakiya intha janam en'raikkum vazhithappippoaki'rathenna? kapadaththai u'ruthiyaayp pidiththirukki'raarka'l; thirumpamaattoam enki'raarka'l.

naan kavaniththuk keattean, avarka'l yathaarththam peasavillai; enna seytheanen'ru solli, than pollaappinimiththam manasthaapappaduki'ravan oruvanumillai; yuththaththukku'l paayki'ra kuthiraiyaippoala avaravar veakamaay oadippoanaarka'l.

aakaayaththilu'l'la naarai muthalaayth than vea'laiyai a'riyum; kaattuppu'raavum, kokkum, thakaivilaan kuruviyum thaangka'l varaththakka kaalaththai a'riyum; en janangka'loa karththarin niyaayaththai a'riyaarka'l en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.

naangka'l gnaanika'len'rum, karththarudaiya veatham engka'lidaththilirukki'rathen'rum neengka'l solluki'ratheppadi? meyyaakavea, ithoa, veathapaarakarin ka'l'la ezhuththaa'ni athai apaththamaakkuki'rathu.
gnaanika'l vedki, kalangkip pidipaduvaarka'l; ithoa, karththarudaiya sollai ve'ruththuppoattaarka'l; avarka'lukku gnaanameathu?

aakaiyaal avarka'ludaiya sthireeka'lai anniyarukkum, avarka'ludaiya vayalka'lai avaika'laik kattikko'lpavarka'lukkum koduppean; avarka'lilea si'riyoarthodangkip periyoarmattum ovvoruvarum poru'laasaikkaararaayirukki'raarka'l; theerkkatharisika'lthodangki aasaariyarka'lmattum ovvoruvarum poyyaraayirunthu,
samaathaanamillaathirunthum, samaathaanam samaathaanam en'ru solli, en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyin kaayangka'lai mea'rpoochchaayk ku'namaakkuki'raarka'l.

thaangka'l aruvaruppaanathaich seythathinimiththam vedkappaduki'raarka'laa? parichcheatham vedkappadaarka'l, naa'navum a'riyaarka'l; aakaiyaal vizhuki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea vizhuvaarka'l; naan avarka'lai visaarikkungkaalaththilea ida'ru'ndupoavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'lai mut'rilum azhiththuppoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; thiraadchachsediyilea kulaika'l iraathu, aththimaraththilea pazhangka'l iraathu, ilaiyum uthirum, naan avarka'lukkuk koduththathu avarka'laivittuth thaa'ndippoakum en'ru sol.

naam summaayiruppaanean? koodivaarungka'l; naam ara'naana patta'nangka'lukku'l piraveasiththu, angkea sangkaaramaavoam; naam karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythapadiyaal, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar nammaich sangkaarampa'n'ni, namakkup pichchukkalantha tha'n'neeraik kudikkakkodukki'raar.
samaathaanaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, pirayoajanamillai; aaroakkiya kaalaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, ithoa, aapaththu.

thaa'nilirunthu avarka'ludaiya kuthiraika'lin moochche'rithal keadkappaduki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya palaththa asvangka'l kanaikki'ra saththaththinaal theasamellaam athiruki'rathu; avarka'l vanthu theasaththaiyum athil u'l'lavaika'laiyum, patta'naththaiyum athin kudika'laiyum padchippaarka'l.
meyyaay, ithoa, thadaikattappadaatha sarppangka'laiyum, kattuviriyanka'laiyum ungka'lukku'l anuppuki'rean, avaika'l ungka'laik kadikkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan sagnchalaththil aa'ruthaladaiyap paarththum, en iruthayam paladchayamaayirukki'rathu.

ithoa, seeyoanil karththar illaiyoa? athil raajaa illaiyoa? en'ru, en janamaakiya kumaaraththi thooratheasaththilirunthu kooppidum saththam keadkappaduki'rathu; aanaal, avarka'l thangka'l suroopangka'linaalum anniyarin maayaika'linaalum enakkuk koapamu'ndaakkinathu enna enki'raar.
a'ruppukkaalam sen'rathu, koadaikkaalamum mudinthathu, naamoa iradchikkappadavillai.
en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyin kaayangka'linaal naanum kaayappattean; karika'ruththirukki'rean; thikaippu ennaip pidiththathu.
keeleayaaththilea pisin thailam illaiyoa? ira'navaiththiyanum angkea illaiyoa? pinnai ean en janamaakiya kumaaraththi sosthamadaiyaama'rpoanaa'l?
aa, en thalai tha'n'neerum, en ka'nka'l ka'n'neeroot'rumaanaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu en janamaakiya kumaaraththi kolaiyu'n'nak koduththavarka'l nimiththam naan iravumpakalum azhuvean.

aa, vanaantharaththil vazhippoakkarin thaaparam enakku irunthaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu naan en janaththaivittu, avarka'lidaththil iraathapadikkup poayviduvean; avarka'lellaarum vipasaararum thuroakika'lin koottamumaayirukki'raarka'l.

avarka'l poyyaip pirayoakikkath thangka'l naavaakiya villai va'laikki'raarka'l; avarka'l inthath theasaththilea palaththukko'lvathu saththiyaththukkaaka alla; pollaappilirunthu pollaappukku nadanthea'ruki'raarka'l; ennaiyoa a'riyaathirukki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

neengka'l avanavan than than sineakithanukku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, enthach sakoatharanaiyum nampaathirungka'l; enthach sakoatharanum moasampa'n'nuki'raan, enthach sineakithanum thoot'riththiriki'raan.
avarka'l meyyaip peasaamal ovvoruvarum thamakkaduththavanai eaykki'raarka'l; poyyaippeasath thangka'l naavaip pazhakkuki'raarka'l, akkiramagnseyya uzhaikki'raarka'l.
kapadaththin naduvilea kudiyirukki'raay; kapadaththinimiththam avarka'l ennai a'riyamaattoamenki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, naan avarka'lai urukki, avarka'laip pudamiduvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyai vea'renthappirakaaramaaka nadaththuvean?

avarka'l naavu koormaiyaakkappatta ampu, athu kapadam peasuki'rathu; avanavan than than ayalaanoadea than than vaayinaalea samaathaanamaayp peasuki'raan, aanaalum than u'l'laththilea avanukkup pathividai vaikki'raan.
ivaika'linimiththam avarka'lai visaariyaathiruppeanoa? ippadippatta jaathikku en aaththumaa neethiyaich sarikkattaathirukkumoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

malaika'lukkaaka azhuthu thukkangko'ndaaduvean; vanaantharath thaaparangka'lukkaakap pulampuvean; oruvanum avaika'laik kadanthu poakaathava'n'namaay avaika'l paazhaakkappattuk kidakkin'rana; aadumaaduka'lin saththam keadkappaduki'rathumillai; aakaasaththup pa'ravaika'lum mirukajeevanka'lum ellaam oadich sitha'rippoayina.
naan erusaleamai ma'nmeaduka'lum valusarppangka'lin thaaparamumaakkuvean; yoothaavin patta'nangka'laiyum kudiyillaathapadi paazhaakkippoaduvean.

ithai u'naraththakka gnaanamu'l'lavan yaar? theasam azhinthu, oruvanum kadanthu poakaathapadi athu paazhaakkappaduki'ra mukaantharamennaven'ru karththarudaiya vaay thannudanea solluki'rathaik keattu a'rivikkaththakkavan yaar?
naan avaravarukku vithiththa en niyaayappiramaa'naththai avarka'l vittu, en sollaik kea'laamalum, athinpadi nadavaamalum,
thangka'ludaiya iruthayaththin kadinaththaiyum, thangka'l pithaakka'l thangka'lukkuk kat'rukkoduththapadi paakaalka'laiyum pinthodarnthaarka'lea en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aathalaal, ithoa, naan intha janaththukkup pusikka ettiyaiyum, kudikkap pichchukkalantha tha'n'neeraiyum koduththu,

avarka'lum, avarka'l pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea avarka'laich sitha'radiththu, pattayam avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumattum athai avarka'lukkup pinnaaka anuppuvean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l yoasanaipa'n'ni, pulampa'rkaarika'lai varavazhaiththu, athilea pazhakina sthireeka'laik kooppidungka'len'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'l seekkiramaay vanthu, nammudaiya ka'nka'l ka'n'neeraaych soriyaththakkathaakavum, nammudaiya imaika'l tha'n'neeraay oadaththakkathaakavum, oppaari sollakkadavarka'l.

eththanaiyaayp paazhaakkappattoam! mikavum kalangkiyirukki'roam; naangka'l theasaththai vittuppoaki'roam, engka'l vaasasthalangka'lai avarka'l kavizhththuppoattaarka'l en'ru seeyoanilirunthu u'ndaaki'ra pulampalin saththam keadkappadum.

aathalaal sthireeka'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; ungka'l sevi avarudaiya vaayin vasanaththai eat'rukko'l'lattum; neengka'l ungka'l kumaaraththika'lukku oppaariyaiyum, ava'lava'l than than thoazhikkup pulampalaiyum kat'rukkodungka'l.
veethiyilirukki'ra kuzhanthaika'laiyum, therukka'lilirukki'ra i'laignaraiyum sangkaarampa'n'nach saavu nammudaiya palaka'nika'lilea'ri, nammudaiya aramanaika'lil piraveasiththathu.
manusharin savangka'l vayalve'liyinmeal eruvaippoalavum, a'rukki'ravanukkup pinnaalea oruvanum vaarikko'l'laathirukki'ra ariyaippoalavum kidakkum en'ru karththar uraiththaar en'ru sol.

gnaani than gnaanaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattavea'ndaam; paraakkiraman than paraakkiramaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattavea'ndaam; aisuvariyavaan than aisuvariyaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattavea'ndaam;

meanmaipaaraattuki'ravan poomiyilea kirupaiyaiyum niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyki'ra karththar naan en'ru ennai a'rinthu u'narnthirukki'rathaikku'riththea meanmaipaaraattakkadavan en'ru karththar solluki'raar; ivaika'linmeal piriyamaayirukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, naadka'l varum; appozhuthu viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'loadungkooda viruththaseathanamu'l'la yaavaraiyum,

ekipthaiyum, yoothaavaiyum, eathoamaiyum, ammoan puththiraraiyum, moavaapaiyum, kadaisi ellaika'lilu'l'la vanaantharakkudika'laana yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean; pu'rajaathiyaar anaivarum viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'l; aanaalum, israveal vamsaththaar anaivarum iruthayaththilea viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
israveal veettaarea, karththar ungka'lukkuch solluki'ra vasanaththaik kea'lungka'l:
pu'rajaathika'ludaiya maarkkaththaik kat'rukko'l'laathirungka'l; vaanaththin adaiyaa'langka'laalea pu'rajaathika'l kalangkuki'raarka'lea en'ru solli, neengka'l avaika'laalea kalangkaathirungka'l.
janangka'lin vazhipaaduka'l vee'naayirukki'rathu; kaattil oru maraththai vettuki'raarka'l; athu thachchan kaiyaaduki'ra vaachchiyaal pa'nippadum.
ve'l'liyinaalum ponninaalum athai alangkariththu, athu asaiyaathapadikku athai aa'nika'laalum suththika'laalum u'ruthiyaakkuki'raarka'l.

avaika'l panaiyaippoala nettaiyaay ni'rki'rathu, avaika'l peasamaattaathavaika'l, avaika'l nadakkamaattaathathinaal sumakkappadavea'ndum; avaika'lukkup payappadavea'ndaam; avaika'l theemaiseyyakkoodaathu, nanmaiseyyavum avaika'lukkuch sakthi illaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththaavea, umakku oppaanavan illai; neerea periyavar; umathu naamamea vallamaiyil periyathu.
jaathika'lin raajaavea, umakkup payappadaathiruppavan yaar? theavareerukkea payappadavea'ndiyathu; jaathika'ludaiya ellaa gnaanika'lilum, avarka'ludaiya ellaa raajyaththilum umakku oppaanavan illai.
avarka'l yaavarum mirukaku'namum mathiyeenamumu'l'lavarka'l; anthak kattai maayaiyaana poathakamaayirukki'rathu.

thakadaakkappatta ve'l'li tharsheesilum, pon ooppaasilumirunthu ko'nduvarappattu, avaika'l thozhilaa'liyinaalum, thattaan kaika'linaalum seyyappaduki'rathu; i'laneelamum iraththaamparamum avaika'lin udumaanam; avaika'lellaam thozhilaa'lika'lin kaivealaiyaayirukki'rathu.
karththaroa meyyaana theyvam; avar jeevanu'l'la theavan, niththiya raajaa; avarudaiya koapaththinaal poomi athirum; avarudaiya ukkiraththai jaathika'l sakikkamaattaarka'l.
vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkaatha theyvangka'l, poomiyilum intha vaanaththinkeezhum iraathapadikku azhinthupoakum enpathai avarka'lukkuch sollungka'l.
avarea poomiyaith thammudaiya vallamaiyinaal u'ndaakki, poochchakkaraththaith thammudaiya gnaanaththinaal padaiththu, vaanaththaith thammudaiya a'rivinaal viriththaar.

avar saththamidukaiyil vaanaththilea thira'laana tha'n'neer u'ndaaki'rathu; avar poomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu meakangka'lai ezhumpappa'n'ni, mazhaiyudanea minnalka'lai u'ndaakki, kaat'raith thamathu pa'ndakasaalaika'lilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nuki'raar.

manushar anaivarum a'rivillaamal mirukaku'namu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l; thattaar anaivarum vaarppiththa suroopangka'laalea vedkippoaki'raarka'l; avarka'l vaarppiththa vikkirakam poyyea, avaika'lil aavi illai.
avaika'l maayaiyum, makaa eththaana kiriyaiyumaayirukki'rathu; avaika'l visaarikkappadum naa'lilea azhiyum.
yaakkoapin pangkaayirukki'ravar avaika'laippoal alla, avar sarvaththaiyum uruvaakkinavar; israveal avarudaiya suthantharamaana koaththiram; seanaika'lin karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
ara'nil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, theasaththilirunthu un poru'lka'laich searththukko'l.
ithoa, naan intha mu'rai theasaththin kudika'laik kava'nko'nde'rinthu, avarka'l ka'ndu u'narumpadi avarka'lukku nerukkamu'ndaakkuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aiyoa! naan no'rukkappattean; en kaayam kodithaayirukki'rathu; aanaalum ithu naan sakikkavea'ndiya en noay en'ru naan solluvean.

en koodaaram azhinthupoayit'ru, en kayi'ruka'lellaam a'ruppu'ndupoayina; en pi'l'laika'l ennaivittup poayvittaarka'l; avarka'lil oruvanumillai; ini en koodaaraththai viriththu, en thiraika'laith thookkik kattuvaarillai.
meaypparka'l mirukaku'namu'l'lavarka'laaki, karththaraith theadaama'r poanaarka'l; aakaiyaal, avarka'l kaariyam vaaykkaama'rpoay, avarka'l manthaiyellaam sitha'radikkappattathu.
ithoa, yoothaavin patta'nangka'laip paazhum valusarppangka'lin thaavumaakkippoadum seythiyin saththamum, vadatheasaththilirunthu periya kontha'lippum varuki'rathu.
karththaavea, manushanudaiya vazhi avanaalea aaki'rathallaven'rum, than nadaika'lai nadaththuvathu nadakki'ravanaalea aaki'rathallaven'rum a'rivean.
karththaavea, ennaith tha'ndiyum; aanaalum naan avamaayppoakaathapadikku ummudaiya koapaththinaalea alla, mattaayth tha'ndiyum.

ummai a'riyaatha jaathika'linmealum, umathu naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'laatha vamsangka'linmealum, ummudaiya ukkiraththai oot'rividum; avarka'l yaakkoapaip padchiththu, avanai vizhungki, avanai nirmoolamaakki, avan vaasasthalaththaip paazhaakkinaarka'lea.
karththaraalea ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vasanam:
neengka'l keattu yoothaavin manusharukkum erusaleamin kudika'lukkum sollavea'ndiya udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'laavana:
en saththaththaik keattu, naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'rapadiyea ellaak kaariyangka'laiyum seyyungka'l; appozhuthu neengka'l en janamaayiruppeerka'l, naan ungka'l theavanaayiruppean;

naan ungka'l pithaakka'lai iruppukkaa'lavaayaakiya ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lilea avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththa intha udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'laik kea'laatha manushan sapikkappattavanen'ru, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'raar en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollu.

in'raiyathinam irukki'rapadi, paalum theanum oaduki'ra theasaththai ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru naan avarka'lukku itta aa'naiyai naan thidappaduththumpadi ippadi aakum en'raar; atha'rku naan pirathiyuththaramaaka, appadiyea aakakkadavathu karththaavea en'rean.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: nee yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam koo'ri: intha udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'lai neengka'l keattu, avaika'linpadiyea seyyungka'l.

naan ungka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina naa'lmuthal, innaa'lmattum naan avarka'lukkuth thidachsaadchiyaay en saththaththaik kea'lungka'len'ru ea'rkanavea saadchi vi'langkaththakkavithamaay echchariththuvanthean.

aanaalum avarka'l kea'laamalum, thangka'l seviyaich saayaamalum poay, avaravar thamtham pollaatha iruthayakadinaththinpadi nadanthaarka'l; aathalaal naan avarka'l seyyumpadi katta'laiyittathum, avarka'l seyyaama'rpoanathumaana intha udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukkup palikkappa'n'nuvean en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnaiyum karththar ennai noakki: yoothaavin manusharukku'l'lum erusaleamin kudika'lukku'l'lum oru kattuppaadu kaa'nappaduki'rathu.

avarka'l en vaarththaika'laik keadkamaattoamen'ru anniya theavarka'laich seavikka avaika'laip pinpat'ri, thangka'ludaiya munnoarka'lin akkiramangka'lukkuth thirumpinaarka'l; naan thangka'l pithaakka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai israveal kudumpaththaarum yoothaa kudumpaththaarum mee'rippoattaarka'l.

aakaiyinaal ithoa, avarka'l thappiththukko'l'lamaattaatha theengkai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu ennai noakkik kooppiduvaarka'l; naan avarka'laik kea'laathiruppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

appozhuthu yoothaapatta'nangka'lin manusharum, erusaleamin kudika'lum poayth thaangka'l thoopangkaattiyiruntha theavarka'lai noakkik kooppittum, avaika'l avarka'ludaiya aapaththukkaalaththil avarka'lai iradchippathillai.

yoothaavea, un patta'nangka'lin ilakkamum un theavarka'lin ilakkamum sari; erusaleamudaiya veethika'lin ilakkamum, neengka'l paakaalukkuth thoopangkaattumpadi antha ilachchaiyaana kaariyaththukku sthaapiththa peedangka'lin ilakkamum sari.

aathalaal nee intha janaththukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'navea'ndaam, avarka'lukkaaka man'raadavum kegnchavumvea'ndaam; avarka'l thangka'l aapaththinimiththam ennai noakkik kooppidungkaalaththilea naan avarka'laik kea'laathiruppean.

thurchsanaroadu makaa theevinai seyyumpoathu, en piriyamaanava'lukku en veettil enna irukki'rathu? parisuththa maamsaththai unnaivittuth thaa'ndippoakappa'n'nuvaarka'l; un pollaappu nadakkumpoathu nee ka'likooruki'raayea.

nalla kani u'ndaayirukki'ra nearththiyum pachchaiyumaana olivamaramennum pearaik karththar unakku ittaar; aanaal makaa ama'liyin saththamaay athaich sut'rilum neruppaik ko'luththuki'raar, athin kompuka'l mu'rikkappattathu.

paakaalukkuth thoopangkaattuki'rathinaalea enakkuk koapamu'ndaakka israveal kudumpaththaarum, yoothaa kudumpaththaarum thangka'lukkuk keadaakach seytha pollaappinimiththam unmeal theengkai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru unnai naattina seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
athaik karththar enakku a'riviththathinaalea a'rinthuko'ndean; avarka'ludaiya seykaika'lai appozhuthu enakkuth theriyakkaattineer.

maraththai athin kanika'loadungkooda azhiththuppoaduvoamen'rum, avan jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththiliraamalum, avan pear ini ninaikkappadaamalumpoaka avanaich sangkarippoamen'rum, enakku viroathamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l enpathai a'riyaathirunthu, naan adikkappaduvatha'rkuk ko'ndupoakappadum saathuvaana aattukkuttiyaippoala irunthean.

seanaika'lin karththaavea, u'l'linthiriyangka'laiyum iruthayaththaiyum soathiththa'riki'ra neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathipathiyea, neer avarka'lukku neethiyaich sarikkattuki'rathaip paarppeanaaka; en vazhakkai umakku ve'lippaduththivittean en'rean.

aathalaal nee engka'l kaiyinaalea saakaathapadikkuk karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea theerkkatharisanam sollavea'ndaam en'ru solli, un piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ra aanathoaththin manusharaikku'riththuk karththar solluki'raar:
ithoa, ithinimiththam ungka'lai visaarippean; i'lavayathu'l'lavarka'l pattayaththaalea saavaarka'l; avarka'l kumaararum avarka'l kumaaraththika'lum pagnchaththaalea saavaarka'l.
avarka'lil meethiyaay iruppavarka'lillai; naan aanathoaththin manusharai visaarikkum varushaththilea avarka'lmeal aapaththai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

karththaavea, ummoadea naan vazhakkaadappoanaal, theavareer neethiyu'l'lavaraamea; aakilum ummudaiya niyaayangka'laik ku'riththu ummoadea naan peasumpadi vea'nduki'rean; aakaathavarka'lin vazhi vaaykki'rathenna? thuroakagnseythuvaruki'ra anaivarum sukiththirukki'rathenna?
neer avarka'lai naattineer, vearpat'rith thea'rippoanaarka'l, kaniyum kodukki'raarka'l; neer avarka'l vaaykkuch sameepamum, avarka'l u'l'linthiriyangka'lukkoa thooramumaayirukki'reer.

karththaavea, neer ennai a'rinthirukki'reer, ennaik kaa'nki'reer; en iruthayam umakku munpaaka eppadippattathen'ru soathiththu a'riki'reer; adikkappadum aaduka'laippoala avarka'laip pidungkippoattu, kolainaa'lukku avarka'lai niyamiyum.
enthamattum theasam pulampi, ellaa ve'liyin pullum vaadi, athin kudika'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam mirukangka'lum pa'ravaika'lum azhiyavea'ndum! engka'l mudivai avan kaa'npathillaiyenki'raarka'l.

nee kaalaadka'loadea oadumpoathea unnai i'laikkappa'n'ninaarka'laanaal, kuthiraika'loadea eppadich searnthu oaduvaay? samaathaanamu'l'la theasaththileayea nee adaikkalam theadinaal, yoarthaan piravaakiththu varumpoathu nee ennaseyvaay?

un sakoathararum, un thakappan vamsaththaarum unakku thuroakampa'n'ni, avarka'lum unnaip pinthodarnthu mikavum aaravaarampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l unnoadea iniya vaarththaika'laip peasinaalum avarka'lai nampavea'ndaam.
naan en veettai vittuvittean, en suthantharaththai nekizhavittean; en aaththumaa neasiththavanai avanudaiya saththuruvin kaiyilea oppukkoduththean.
en suthantharam kaattilu'l'la singkaththaippoal enakkaayit'ru; athu enakku viroathamaay kerchchikki'rathu; aathalaal athai ve'rukki'rean.
en suthantharam palavaru'namaana padchiyaippoala enakkaayit'ru; aakaiyaal, padchika'l athaich sut'rilum varuvathaaka; ve'liyil sakala jeevanka'lea athaip padchikkumpadi koodivaarungka'l.
aneaka meaypparka'l en thiraadchaththoattaththai azhiththu, en pangkaik kaalaal mithiththu, en piriyamaana pangkaip paazhaana vanaantharamaakkinaarka'l.
athaip paazhaakkivittaarka'l; paazhaayk kidakki'ra athu ennai noakkip pulampuki'rathu; theasamellaam paazhaayit'ru; oruvanum athai manathilea vaikki'rathillai.

ko'l'laikkaarar vanaantharaththilu'l'la ellaa uyarnilangka'linmealum varuki'raarka'l; karththarudaiya pattayam theasaththin orumunaithodangkith theasaththin ma'rumunaimattum padchiththukko'ndirukkum; maamsamaakiya on'rukkum samaathaanamillai.

koathumaiyai vithaiththaarka'l, mu'l'luka'lai a'ruppaarka'l; pirayaasappaduvaarka'l, pirayoajanamadaiyaarka'l; karththarudaiya ukkirakoapaththinaal ungka'lukku varum palanaikku'riththu vedkappadungka'l.

ithoa, naan en janamaakiya isravealukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaakak koduththa en suthantharaththaith thoduki'ra thushdaraana ayalaar anaivaraiyum thangka'l theasaththil iraathapadikkup pidungkippoaduvean en'ru, karththar avarka'laikku'riththuch solluki'raar; yoothaa vamsaththaaraiyum avarka'l naduvil iraathapadikkup pidungkippoaduvean.
avarka'lai naan pidungkippoatta pi'rpaadu, naan thirumpavum avarka'lmeal irangki, avarka'laith thangka'l thangka'l suthantharaththukkum thangka'l thangka'l poomikkum thirumpappa'n'nuvean.

appu'ram avarka'l en janaththukkup paakaalinmeal aa'naiyidak kat'rukkoduththathupoala, karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu en'ru solli, en naamaththinmeal aa'naiyidumpadi en janaththin vazhika'lai nan'raayk kat'rukko'ndaal, avarka'l en janaththin naduvilea oon'rakkattappaduvaarka'l.
kea'laarka'leayaakil, naan appadippatta jaathiyai vearoadea pidungkippoattu azhiththuviduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththar ennai noakki: nee poay, unakku oru sa'nal kachchaiyai vaangki, athai un araiyilea kattikko'l; athaith tha'n'neerilea padavottaathea en'raar.
naan karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea oru kachchaiyai vaangki, athai en araiyilea kattikko'ndean.
ira'ndaamvisai karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee vaangkinathum un araiyilirukki'rathumaana kachchaiyai eduththukko'ndu ezhunthu, aippiraaththu nathimattum poay, athai angkea oru kanmalai vedippilea o'liththuvai en'raar.
naan poay, karththar enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea athai aippiraaththu nathiyin oaraththil o'liththuvaiththean.
aneakanaa'l sen'rapinpu karththar ennai noakki: nee ezhunthu aippiraaththu nathikkuppoay angkea o'liththuvaikka naan unakkuk katta'laiyitta kachchaiyai avvidaththilirunthu eduththukko'nduvaa en'raar.
appozhuthu naan aippiraaththu nathikkuppoay, kachchaiyai o'liththuvaiththa idaththilea thoa'ndi athai eduththean; aanaal, ithoa, anthak kachchai kettu on'rukkum uthavaama'r poayit'ru.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
ippadiyea naan yoothaavudaiya perumaiyaiyum, erusaleamudaiya mikuntha perumaiyaiyum kettuppoakappa'n'nuvean.

en vaarththaika'laik keadkamaattoam en'ru ma'ruththu, thangka'l iruthayaththin kadinaththinpadi nadanthu, anniya theavarka'laich seavikkavum avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'l'lavum avarka'laip pinpat'ruki'ra inthap pollaatha janangka'l on'rukkum uthavaama'rpoana inthak kachchaiyaippoalaavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

kachchaiyaanathu manushanudaiya araikkuch searkkaiyaayirukki'rathupoala, naan israveal kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum yoothaavin kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum, enakku janangka'laakavum, keerththiyaakavum, thuthiyaakavum, makimaiyaakavum searkkaiyaakkik ko'ndean; aanaalum avarka'l sevikodaama'rpoanaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

sakala jaadika'lum thiraadcharasaththinaalea nirappappadumen'ru, isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'raar enki'ra vaarththaiyai avarka'ludanea sol; atha'rku avarka'l: sakala jaadika'lum thiraadcharasaththinaalea nirappappaduvathu engka'lukkuth theriyaathaa en'ru unnudanea solluvaarka'l.

appozhuthu nee avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, inthath theasaththin kudika'lellaaraiyum, thaaveethin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthirukki'ra raajaakka'laiyum, aasaariyarka'laiyum, theerkkatharisika'laiyum, erusaleamin kudika'l ellaaraiyum naan ve'riyinaal nirappi,

pithaakka'lum pi'l'laika'lumaakiya avarka'lai oruvarmeal oruvar moathi vizhumpadippa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan avarka'lai azhippatheayan'ri mannippathumillai, thappaviduvathumillai, irangkuvathumillaiyen'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
neengka'l sevikoduththuk kea'lungka'l; meattimaiyaay iraatheayungka'l; karththar vi'lampinaar.

avar anthakaaraththai varappa'n'nuvatha'rku munnum, iru'nda malaika'lil ungka'l kaalka'l ida'ruvatha'rku munnum, neengka'l ve'lichchaththukkuk kaaththirukkumpoathu, avar athai anthakaaramum kaariru'lumaaka maa'rappa'n'nuvatha'rku munnum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku makimaiyaich seluththungka'l.

neengka'l ithaik kea'laama'r poaneerka'laanaal, en aaththumaa ma'raividangka'lil ungka'l perumaiyinimiththam thukkiththu, karththarudaiya manthai si'raippattuppoanathen'ru en ka'n mikavum azhuthu ka'n'neer soriyum.
neengka'l raajaavaiyum raajaaththiyaiyum noakki: thaazhavanthu udkaarungka'l; ungka'l sirasin singkaaramaakiya ungka'l makimaiyin kireedam vizhunthathen'ru sollungka'l.
the'rkilu'l'la patta'nangka'l adaikkappattana; avaika'laith thi'rappaar illai; yoothaa anaiththum kudivilakkappattuppoam; athu samoolamaaych si'raippattuppoam.
ungka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, vadakkeayirunthu varuki'ravarka'laip paarungka'l; unakkuk kodukkappattiruntha manthaiyum, un makimaiyaana aattukkidaiyum engkea?

avar unnai visaarikkumpoathu enna solluvaay? avarka'l unmeal aathikkakkaararum thalaivarumaayirukka, nee avarka'laip pazhakkuviththaayea; karppavathikkup pirasavaveathanai u'ndaakumpoathu u'ndaakum veathanaika'laippoal veathanaika'l unnaip pidippathillaiyoa?

ivaika'l enakku nearittathu eathen'ru nee un iruthayaththil sonnaayaakil, un thira'laana akkiramaththinimiththamea un vasthiraththu oarangka'l vilakkappattu, un paathangka'l palavanthagnseyyappadukin'rana.
eththiyoappiyan than thoalaiyum, sivingki than pu'l'lika'laiyum maat'rakkoodumoa? koodumaanaal, theemaiseyyap pazhakina neengka'lum nanmaiseyyakkoodum.
aathalaal vanaantharak kaat'raal pa'rakkadikkappadum thurumpaippoala avarka'laich sitha'radippean.
nee ennai ma'ranthu, poyyai nampinapadiyinaalea, ithu unnudaiya veethamum, ennaal unakku a'lakkappadum unnudaiya pangkumaayirukkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
un maanam kaa'nappada naan un vasthiraththu oarangka'lai un mukamattaaka eduththuppoaduvean.

un vipasaarangka'laiyum, un kanaikkuthalka'laiyum, ve'liyilea meaduka'linmeal nee pa'n'nina veasiththanaththin mu'raikeaduka'laakiya un aruvaruppuka'laiyum naan ka'ndean; erusaleamea, unakku aiyoa! nee suththikarikkappadamaattaayaa? ithu innum eththanai kaalaththukkuppin nadakkum? enki'raar.
mazhaiththaazhchchiyaik ku'riththu ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam:
yoothaa thukkikki'rathu, athin vaasalka'l pelanat'ruk kidakki'rathu; tharaimattum kuninthu, karika'ruththuth thiriki'raarka'l; erusaleamin kookkural ezhumpuki'rathu.

avarka'lil pirapalamaanavarka'l thangka'l si'ruvarka'laith tha'n'neerukku anuppuki'raarka'l; ivarka'l pa'l'langka'lukkup poayth tha'n'neeraik kaa'naamal ve'rum paaththirangka'loadea thirumpivaruki'raarka'l; vedki naa'ni, thangka'l thalaiyai moodikko'l'luki'raarka'l.
theasaththinmeal mazhai illaathathinaal tharai vediththirukki'rathu; payir seyki'ravarka'l vedki, thangka'l thalaiyai moodikko'l'luki'raarka'l.
ve'liyin pe'nmaanum kuttipoattu, pullillaathathinaal athai vittu oadippoakum.
kaattukkazhuthaika'l meaduka'lil nin'ru, valusarppangka'laippoal kaat'rai udko'l'luki'rathu; pul illaathathinaal avaika'ludaiya ka'nka'l pooththuppoaki'rathu en'raar.

karththaavea, engka'l akkiramangka'l engka'lukku viroathamaaych saadchiyittaalum, ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam kirupaiseyyum; engka'l seerkeaduka'l mikuthiyaayirukki'rathu; umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythoam.
isravealin nampikkaiyea, aapaththukkaalaththil athin iradchakarea, neer theasaththil paratheasiyaippoalavum, iraaththangka i'rangkuki'ra vazhippoakkanaippoalavum iruppaanean?

neer vidaayththuppoana purushanaippoalavum, iradchikkamaattaatha paraakkiramasaaliyaippoalavum iruppaanean? karththaavea, neer engka'l naduvilirukki'ravaraamea; ummudaiya naamam engka'lukkuth tharikkappattumirukki'rathea; engka'lai vittup poakaathirum.

avarka'l thangka'l kaalka'lai adakkikko'l'laamal, alaiya virumpuki'raarka'len'ru karththar intha janaththaikku'riththuch solluki'raar; aakaiyaal, karththar avarka'lmeal piriyamaayiraamal, ippozhuthu avarka'l akkiramaththai ninaiththu, avarka'l paavangka'lai visaarippaar.
