karththar ennai noakki: nee intha janaththukku nanmaiyu'ndaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'navea'ndaam.

avarka'l upavaasiththaalum, naan avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaik keadpathillai; avarka'l thakanapalika'laiyum kaa'nikkaika'laiyum seluththinaalum, naan avarka'lmeal piriyamaayiruppathillai; pattayaththinaalum pagnchaththinaalum ko'l'lainoayinaalum naan avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkuvean en'raar.

appozhuthu naan: aa karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ithoa, neengka'l pattayaththaik kaa'npathillai, ungka'lukkup pagnchamum varuvathillai; u'ruthiyaana samaathaanaththaiyea ivvidaththil ungka'lukkuth tharuvoamen'raar en'ru theerkkatharisika'l avarka'lukkuch solluki'raarka'lea en'rean.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: theerkkatharisika'l en naamaththaikko'ndu poyyaayth theerkkatharisanagn solluki'raarka'l. naan avarka'lai anuppinathumillai, avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththathumillai, avarka'loadea peasinathumillai; avarka'l ka'l'lath tharisanaththaiyum, ka'l'la sakunaththaiyum, illaatha viseashaththaiyum, thangka'l iruthayaththin kapadaththaiyumea, ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanamaaych solluki'raarka'l.

aathalaal, naan anuppaathirunthum, en naamaththaikko'ndu theerkkatharisanagnsolli, inthath theasaththilea pattayamum pagnchamum varuvathillaiyenki'ra theerkkatharisika'laikku'riththu: ippadippatta theerkkatharisika'l pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum saavaarka'l.

avarka'lidaththil theerkkatharisanam keadkum janangka'lum, erusaleamin veethika'lilea pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum azhinthu, avarka'lum avarka'l manaivika'lum, avarka'l kumaararum, avarka'l kumaaraththika'lum adakkam pa'n'nuvaarillaamal kidappaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya pollaappai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en ka'nka'lilirunthu iravum pakalum oayaamal ka'n'neer oadikko'ndirukkum; en janamenki'ra kumaaraththiyaakiya kannikai makaa veathanaiyu'l'la adiyinaalum kodiya kaayaththinaalum seathappattirukki'raa'l.

naan ve'liyea poanaal, ithoa, pattayaththaal kollappattavarka'l; nakaraththil vanthaal ithoa, pagnchaththaal varunthuki'ravarka'l; theerkkatharisika'lum aasaariyarka'lum on'rum a'riyaamal theasaththil alaiki'raarka'l ennum intha vaarththaiyai avarka'lukkuch sol en'raar.

yoothaavai mut'rilum ve'ruththeeroa? seeyoan ummudaiya aaththumaavukku aroasikamaayit'roa? naangka'l aaroakkiyam adaiyakkoodaathapadi engka'lai ean adiththeer? samaathaanaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, oru nanmaiyumillai; aaroakkiya kaalaththukkuk kaaththirunthoam, ithoa, aapaththu.
karththaavea, engka'l theemaiyaiyum engka'l pithaakka'lin akkiramaththaiyum naangka'l a'rinthirukki'roam; umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythoam.

ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam engka'lai aruvarukkaathirum, umathu makimaiyin singkaasanaththaik kanaveenappaduththaatheayum; engka'loadea umakku irukki'ra udanpadikkai apaththamaakaathapadi engka'lai ninaiththaru'lum.

pu'rajaathika'ludaiya vee'naana theavarka'lukku'l mazhai varushikkappa'n'naththakkavarka'l u'ndoa? allathu, vaanangka'l thaanaay mazhaika'laik kodukkumoa? engka'l theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'ra neerallavoa athaich seyki'ravar; aakaiyaal, umakkuk kaaththirukki'roam; theavareer ivaika'laiyellaam u'ndupa'n'nineer.

karththar ennai noakki: moaseayum saamuvealum en mukaththukku munpaaka nin'raalum, en manam intha janangka'l padchamaaych saaraathu; ivarka'l en mukaththaivittup pu'rappattuppoakumpadi ivarka'laith thuraththividu.

engkea pu'rappattuppoavoam en'ru ivarka'l unnaik keattaal, nee avarka'lai noakki: saavukku eathuvaanavarka'l saavukkum, pattayaththukku eathuvaanavarka'l pattayaththukkum, pagnchaththukku eathuvaanavarka'l pagnchaththukkum, si'raiyiruppukku eathuvaanavarka'l si'raiyiruppukkum nearaayp poakavea'ndum en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.

kon'rupoadap pattayamum, pidiththu izhukka naayka'lum, padchiththu azhikka aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lum, poomiyin mirukangka'lum aakiya naankuvithamaana vaathaika'lai naan avarka'lmeal varak katta'laiyiduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
eseakkiyaavin kumaaranum, yoothaavin raajaavumaakiya manaasea erusaleamil seythavaika'linimiththam avarka'laip poomiyilu'l'la ellaa raajyangka'lilum alaiyappa'n'nuvean.
erusaleamea, yaar unmeal irangkuvaarka'l? yaar unmeal parithapippaarka'l? yaar unnidaththi'rkuth thirumpi, un sukaseythiyai visaarippaarka'l?
nee ennaivittup pinvaangkippoanaay; aakaiyaal, en kaiyai unakku viroathamaay neetti, unnai azhippean; naan po'ruththup po'ruththu i'laiththuppoanean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

theasaththin vaasalka'lil avarka'laith thoot'rukkoodaiyaal thoot'rippoaduvean; en janangka'l thangka'l vazhika'laivittuth thirumpaathapadiyinaal naan avarka'laip pi'l'laika'l at'ravarka'laakki azhippean.

kada'rkarai ma'nalaippaarkkilum athika vithavaika'l avarka'lil u'ndaayiruppaarka'l; pattappakalilea paazhaakkuki'ravanaith thaayinmealum pi'l'laika'linmealum varappa'n'nuvean; avarka'lmeal patta'naththin kalakaththaiyum, payangkarangka'laiyum vizhappa'n'nuvean.

eazhu pi'l'laika'laip pet'rava'l ka'laiththuppoaki'raa'l; ava'l than piraa'nanai vittuvittaa'l; innum pakalaayirukkaiyil ava'ludaiya sooriyan asthamiththathu; vedkamum ilachchaiyum adainthaa'l; avarka'lil meethiyaaki'ravarka'laiyoa avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'lukku munpaakap pattayaththukku oppukkoduppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en thaayea, theasaththukkellaam vazhakkukkum vaathukkum u'l'laanavanaayirukkumpadi ennai nee pet'raayea; aiyoa! naan avarka'lukku vattikkuk koduththathumillai, avarka'l enakku vattikkuk koduththathumillai; aanaalum, ellaarum ennaich sapikki'raarka'l.

unnil meethiyaayiruppavarka'l nanmaiyadaivaarka'l; theengkin kaalaththilum nerukkaththin kaalaththilum unakkaaka naan saththuruvukku ethirppattu, unakkuch sakaayagnseyvean en'ru meyyaakavea solluki'rean.
vadakkeayirunthu varum irumpaiyum ve'nkalaththaiyum irumpu no'rukkumoa?
unnudaiya ellaap paavangka'linimiththamum, unnudaiya ellaa ellaika'lilum, naan un aasthiyaiyum, un pokkishangka'laiyum kirayamillaamal soo'raiyiduvippean.
nee a'riyaatha theasaththil un saththurukka'l vasamaaka naan unnaith thaa'ndippoakap pa'n'nuvean; ungka'lmeal eriyappoaki'ra akkini en koapaththinaalea moo'ndathu en'ru karththar sonnaar.

karththaavea, neer athai a'riveer; theavareer ennai ninaiththu, ennai visaariththu, ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'lukku ennimiththam neethiyaich sarikkattum; ummudaiya neediya po'rumaiyinimiththam ennai vaarikko'l'laathirum; naan ummudaiya nimiththam ninthaiyaich sakikki'rean en'ru a'riyum.

ummudaiya vaarththaika'l kidaiththavudanea avaika'lai udko'ndean; ummudaiya vaarththaika'l enakkuch santhoashamum, en iruthayaththukku makizhchchiyumaayirunthathu; seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam enakkuth tharikkappattirukki'rathu.
naan pariyaasakkaararudaiya koottaththil udkaarnthu ka'likoornthathillai; umathu karaththinimiththam thaniththu udkaarnthean; salippinaal ennai nirappineer.
en noavu niththiyakaalamaakavum, en kaayam aa'raatha kodiya pu'n'naakavum iruppaanean? neer enakku nampappadaatha oot'raippoalavum, vat'rippoaki'ra jalaththaippoalavum iruppeeroa?

ithinimiththam: nee thirumpinaal naan unnaith thirumpach seerppaduththuvean; en mukaththukkumunpaaka nilaiththumiruppaay; nee theezhppaanathinin'ru vilaiyea'rappet'rathaip piriththeduththaal, en vaaypoaliruppaay; nee avarka'lidaththil thirumpaamal, avarka'l unnidaththil thirumpuvaarka'laaka en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

unnai intha janaththukku ethirea ara'naana ve'nkala alangkamaakkuvean; avarka'l unakku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nuvaarka'l, aanaalum unnai mea'rko'l'lamaattaarka'l; unnai iradchippatha'rkaakavum, unnaith thappuvippatha'rkaakavum, naan unnudanea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan unnaip pollaathavarka'lin kaikkuth thappuviththu, unnaip palavantharin kaikku neengkalaakki viduvippean enki'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee pe'n'nai vivaakampa'n'navea'ndaam; ivvidaththil unakkuk kumaararum kumaaraththika'lum irukkavea'ndaam en'raar.

ivvidaththilea pi'rakki'ra kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum, inthath theasaththil avarka'laip pet'ra thaayka'laiyum avarka'laip pet'ra pithaakka'laiyungku'riththuk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal,

makaa kodiya viyaathika'laal saavaarka'l, avarka'lukkaakap pulampuvaarum, avarka'lai adakkampa'n'nuvaarumillai, nilaththinmeal eruvaavaarka'l; pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum madinthupoavaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya pireatham aakaasaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakum.

aakaiyaal, nee thukkaveettil piraveasiyaamalum, pulampappoakaamalum, avarka'lukkup parithapikkaamalum iruppaayaaka en'ru karththar solluki'raar; en samaathaanaththaiyum, kirupaiyaiyum, irakkaththaiyum, intha janaththaivittu eduththuppoattean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
inthath theasaththilea periyoarum si'riyoarum saavaarka'l; avarka'lai adakkampa'n'nuvaarillai; avarka'lukkaakap pulampuvaarumillai; avarka'l nimiththam kee'rikko'ndu, mottaiyadiththukko'lvaarumillai.

seththavarka'l nimiththam u'ndaana thukkaththai aat'ra avarka'lukku appam pangkidappaduvathumillai; oruvanudaiya thakappanukkaavathu, oruvanudaiya thaaykkaavathu thukkappaduki'ravarka'lukkuth theat'raravin paaththiraththaik kudikkakkoduppaarumillai.
nee avarka'loadea pusiththuk kudikka udkaarumpadi virunthuveettilum piraveasiyaayaaka.

eanenil, ithoa, ivvidaththilea naan ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum, ungka'l naadka'lilumea, santhoashaththin saththaththaiyum, makizhchchiyin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaa'lanin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaattiyin saththaththaiyum oayappa'n'nuvean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

nee intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam intha janaththukku a'rivikkumpoathu, avarka'l unnai noakki: karththar engka'lmeal iththanai periya theengkaik koo'ruvaanean en'rum, naangka'l seytha akkiramam enna? naangka'l engka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku viroathamaakach seytha engka'l paavam enna? en'rum keadpaarka'laanaal,

nee avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l pithaakka'l ennaivittu anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'ri, avarka'laich seaviththu, avarka'laip pa'ninthuko'ndu, en niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'laamal ennai vittuvittaarka'lea.
neengka'l ungka'l pithaakka'laippaarkkilum athika keadaaka nadantheerka'lea; ithoa, ungka'lil ovvoruvarum en sollaik kea'laathapadikku, ungka'l pollaatha iruthayakadinaththinpadi nadakki'reerka'l.

aathalaal, ungka'lai inthath theasaththilirunthu neengka'lum ungka'l pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha theasaththi'rkuth thuraththividuvean; angkea iravum pakalum anniya theavarka'laich seavippeerka'l; angkea naan ungka'lukkuth thayai seyvathillai.
aathalaal, ithoa, naadka'l varum, appozhuthu israveal puththirarai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu inimeal saththiyampa'n'naamal,

israveal puththirarai vadatheasaththilum, thaam avarka'laith thuraththivitta ellaa theasangka'lilumirunthu varappa'n'nina karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu saththiyampa'n'nuvaarka'l; naan avarka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa avarka'ludaiya theasaththukku avarka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naan meenpidikki'ra aneakarai azhaiththanuppuvean, ivarka'l avarka'laip pidippaarka'l; atha'rkup pinpu veattaikkaararaakiya aneakarai azhaiththanuppuvean, ivarka'l avarka'lai ellaa malaika'lilum, ellaak kun'ruka'lilum, kanmalaika'lin vedippuka'lilum veattaiyaaduvaarka'l.

en ka'nka'l avarka'ludaiya ellaa vazhika'linmealum noakkamaayirukki'rathu; avaika'l en mukaththukku munpaaka ma'rainthirukki'rathillai; avarka'ludaiya akkiramam en ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ma'raivaayirukki'rathumillai.

muthalaavathu naan avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththukkum, avarka'ludaiya paavaththukkum irattippaay neethiyaich sarikkattuvean; avarka'l en theasaththaith theettuppaduththi, en suthantharaththaich cheeyen'ru aruvarukkappadaththakka thangka'l kaariyangka'lin naat'ramaana vikkirakangka'linaalea nirappinaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en pelanum, en koattaiyum, nerukkappaduki'ra naa'lil en adaikkalamumaakiya karththaavea, pu'rajaathika'l poomiyin kadaiyaantharangka'lilirunthu ummidaththil vanthu: meyyaakavea, engka'l pithaakka'l pirayoajanamillaatha poyyaiyum maayaiyaiyum kaippat'rinaarka'l enpaarka'l.
manushan thanakkuth theavarka'lai u'ndupa'n'nalaamoa? avaika'l theavarka'l allavea.
aathalaal, ithoa, ippozhuthu naan avarka'lukkuth theriyappa'n'nuvean; en karaththaiyum en pelaththaiyumea avarka'lukkuth theriyappa'n'nuvean; en naamam yeakoavaa en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
yoothaavin paavam irumpezhuththaa'niyinaalum, vairaththin nuniyinaalum ezhuthappattu, avarka'ludaiya iruthayaththin palakaiyilum ungka'l palipeedangka'ludaiya kompuka'lilum pathinthirukki'rathu.
uyarntha meaduka'linmeal pachchaiyaana marangka'la'ndaiyil iruntha avarka'ludaiya palipeedangka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya thoappuka'laiyum avarka'l pi'l'laika'l ninaikkumpadi ippadich seythirukki'rathu.
vayalnilaththilu'l'la en malaiyea, nee un ellaika'lilellaam seytha paavaththinimiththam naan un aasthiyaiyum, un ellaap pokkishangka'laiyum, un meadaika'laiyungkoodach soo'raiyiduvippean.

appadiyea naan unakkuk koduththa suthantharaththai neethaanea vittuviduvaay; nee a'riyaatha theasaththil unnai un saththurukka'lukku adimaiyumaakkuvean; en'ren'raikkum eriyaththakka en koapaththin akkiniyai moottivitteerka'lea.
manushanmeal nampikkaivaiththu, maamsamaanathaith than puyapalamaakkikko'ndu, karththarai vittu vilakuki'ra iruthayamu'l'la manushan sapikkappattavan en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avan antharave'liyil ka'ra'laiyaayppoana sediyaippoalirunthu, nanmaivaruki'rathaik kaa'naamal, vanaantharaththin va'radchiyaana idangka'lilum, kudiyillaatha uvarnilaththilum thangkuvaan.
karththarmeal nampikkaivaiththu, karththaraith than nampikkaiyaakak ko'ndirukki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan.

avan tha'n'neera'ndaiyilea naattappattathum, kaalvaay oaramaakath than vearka'lai viduki'rathum, ush'nam varuki'rathaik kaa'naamal ilai pachchaiyaayirukki'rathum, mazhaiththaazhchchiyaana varushaththilum varuththamin'rith thappaamal kani kodukki'rathumaana maraththaippoaliruppaan.
ellaavat'raippaarkkilum iruthayamea thirukku'l'lathum makaa keadu'l'lathumaayirukki'rathu, athai a'riyaththakkavan yaar?

karththaraakiya naanea ovvoruvanukkum, avanavan vazhika'lukkum seykaika'lin palanka'lukkum thakkathaik kodukkumpadikku, iruthayaththai aaraayki'ravarum u'l'linthiriyangka'laich soathiththa'riki'ravarumaayirukki'rean.

aniyaayamaay aisuvariyaththaich sampaathikki'ravan muttaiyittu avayangkaaththum, kugnchuporikkaama'r poaki'ra kavuthaarikkuch samaanamaayirukki'raan; avan than paathi vayathilea athaivittu, than mudivilea moodanaayiruppaan.
engka'l parisuththa sthaanam aathimutha'rko'ndu uyarntha makimaiyu'l'la singkaasanamaayirukki'rathu.

isravealin nampikkaiyaakiya karththaavea, ummaivittu vilakuki'ra yaavarum vedkappaduvaarka'l; avarka'l jeevanu'l'la tha'n'neerin oot'raakiya karththarai vittu vilakippoanapadiyaal, ummaivittu akan'rupoaki'ravarka'lin peyar puzhuthiyil ezhuthappadum.
karththaavea, ennaik ku'namaakkum, appozhuthu ku'namaavean; ennai iradchiyum, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvean; theavareerea en thuthi.
ithoa, ivarka'l ennaip paarththu: karththarudaiya vaarththai engkea? athu ippozhuthu varattum enki'raarka'l.

naanoa ummaip pinpat'ruki'ra meayppan, itha'rku naan mignchi nadakkavillai; aapaththunaa'lai virumpuki'rathumillaiyen'ru neer a'riveer; en uthaduka'lilirunthu pu'rappattathu umakku munpaakach sevvaiyaayirunthathu.
neer enakkup payangkaramaayiraatheayum; theengkunaa'lil neerea en adaikkalam.

naan vedkappadaamal, ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'l vedkappaduvaarka'laaka; naan kalangkaamal, avarka'l kalangkuvaarka'laaka; theavareer theengkunaa'lai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'ni, irattippaana no'rukkuthalaal avarka'lai no'rukkum.
karththar ennai noakki: nee poay yoothaavin raajaakka'l varaththumpoakkumaayirukki'ra intha janangka'lin puththirarudaiya vaasalilum erusaleamin ellaa vaasalka'lilum nin'ruko'ndu,

avarka'ludanea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: intha vaasalka'lil piraveasikki'ra yoothaavin raajaakka'lum, ellaa yootharum, erusaleamin ellaak kudika'lumaakiya neengka'l karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
neengka'l oayvunaa'lil sumaika'lai eduththu, avaika'lai erusaleamin vaasalka'lukku'l ko'nduvaraathapadikkum,

oayvunaa'lil ungka'l veeduka'lilirunthu sumaiyai ve'liyea ko'ndu poakaathapadikkum, oru vealaiyaiyum seyyaathapadikkum, ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaaka echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, naan ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadi oayvunaa'laip parisuththamaakkungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'loa kea'laamalum thangka'l sevika'laich saayaamalumpoayk kea'laathapadikkum puththiyai eat'rukko'l'laathapadikkum, thangka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththinaarka'l.

neengka'loavenil, oayvunaa'lil intha nakaraththin vaasalka'lukku'l'lea sumaiyaik ko'nduvaraathapadikkum, oayvunaa'lil oru vealaiyaiyum seyyaamal athaip parisuththamaakkumpadikkum en sollaik keadpeerka'laanaal,

appozhuthu thaaveethin singkaasanaththil udkaarnthirukki'ravarka'lum, irathangka'linmealum kuthiraika'linmealum ea'ruki'ravarka'lumaakiya raajaakka'lum raajakumaararka'lum, avarka'l pirapukka'lum, yoothaavin manusharum, erusaleamin kudika'lum intha nakaraththin vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasippaarka'l; intha nakaramum en'raikkum kudiyu'l'lathaayirukkum.

yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum, erusaleamin sut'ruppu'ramaana oorka'lilum, penyameen theasaththilum, pa'l'laththaakkaana seemaiyilum, malainaattilum, the'rkilumirunthu janangka'l sarvaangka thakanangka'laiyum, palika'laiyum, poajanapalika'laiyum, thoopavarkkangka'laiyum, sthoaththirapalika'laiyum karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

neengka'l oayvunaa'laip parisuththamaakkumpadikkum oayvunaa'lilea sumaiyai erusaleamin vaasalka'lukku'l eduththuvaraathirukkumpadikkum, en sollaik kea'laama'rpoaneerka'laakil, naan athin vaasalka'lil theekko'luththuvean; athu erusaleamin aramanaika'laip padchiththum, avinthupoakaathirukkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththaraal ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vasanam:
nee ezhunthu, kuyavan veetti'rkuppoa; angkea en vaarththaika'lai unakkuth therivippean en'raar.
appadiyea naan kuyavan veetti'rkup poanean; ithoa, avan thirikaiyinaalea vanainthuko'ndirunthaan.

kuyavan vanainthuko'ndiruntha ma'npaa'ndam avan kaiyilea kettuppoayit'ru; appozhuthu athaith thiruththamaaych seyyumpadikku, than paarvaikkuch sariyaayk ka'ndapadi kuyavan athaith thirumpa vea'reapaa'ndamaaka vanainthaan.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vasanam enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

israveal kudumpaththaarea, inthak kuyavan seythathupoala naan ungka'lukkuch seyyakkoodaathoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; ithoa, israveal veettaarea, ka'lima'n kuyavan kaiyil irukki'rathupoala neengka'l en kaiyil irukki'reerka'l.
pidungkuvean, idippean, azhippean en'ru naan oru jaathikku viroathamaakavum, oru raajyaththukku viroathamaakavum sonnamaaththiraththil,
naan viroathamaayp peasina antha jaathiyaar thangka'l theengkaivittuth thirumpinaal, naanum avarka'lukkuch seyya ninaiththa theengkaich seyyaathapadikku, manam maa'ruvean.
kattuvean, naattuvean en'rum, oru jaathiyaiyum oru raajyaththaiyum ku'riththu naan solluki'rathumu'ndu.
avarka'l en saththaththaikkea'laamal, en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seyvaarka'laanaal, naanum avarka'lukku aru'lseyvean en'ru sonna nanmaiyaich seyyaathapadikku, manam maa'ruvean.

ippozhuthum, nee yoothaavin manusharaiyum erusaleamin kudika'laiyum noakki: ithoa, naan ungka'lukku viroathamaaka oru theengkai uruppaduththi, ungka'lukku viroathamaaka oru kaariyaththai yoasikki'rean; aakaiyaal, ungka'lil ovvoruvarum than than pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpi, ungka'l vazhika'laiyum, ungka'l kiriyaika'laiyum seerppaduththungka'len'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.
aanaalum avarka'l: athu koodaathakaariyam, naangka'l engka'l yoasanaika'linpadiyea nadanthu, avaravar thamtham pollaatha iruthayaththinudaiya kadinaththinpadiyea seyvoam enki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal karththar solluki'raar: ippadippattavaika'laik kea'lvippattavan yaar en'ru pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea visaariththuppaarungka'l; mikavum thidukkidaththakka kaariyaththai israveal ennum kannikai seyki'raa'l.
leepanoanin u'raintha mazhai vayalve'liyin kanmalaiyilirunthu at'ruppoaki'rathu'ndoa? oadivaruki'ra anniyatheasaththuk ku'lirntha tha'n'neerka'l vadinthupoaki'rathu'ndoa?

en janangka'loa ennai ma'ranthu, maayaiyaana vikkirakangka'lukkuth thoopangkaattuki'raarka'l; seppanidappadaatha paathaika'lilum vazhiyilum avarka'l nadakkumpadi, avaika'l avarka'laip poorva paathaika'laakiya avarka'ludaiya vazhika'lilirunthu ida'rumpadi seyki'rathu.

naan avarka'ludaiya theasaththaip paazhaakkavum, en'ren'raikkum eesalittu ninthikkum ninthaiyaakkavum seyyumpadi ippadich seyki'raarka'l; athaik kadanthupoaki'ravan evanum piramiththu, than thalaiyaith thulukkuvaan.

ko'ndalkaat'rup pa'rakkadikkumaappoal naan avarka'lai avarka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaakap pa'rakkadippean; avarka'ludaiya aapaththin naa'lilea en mukaththaiyalla, en muthukai avarka'lukkuk kaattuvean en'ru sol en'raar.

atha'rku avarka'l: ereamiyaavukku viroathamaaka aaloasanai seyvoam vaarungka'l; aasaariyaridaththilea veathamum, gnaanika'lidaththilea aaloasanaiyum, theerkkatharisika'lidaththilea vasanamum ozhinthupoavathillai. ivan vaarththaika'lai naam kavaniyaamal, ivanai naavinaalea vettippoaduvoam vaarungka'l en'raarka'l.
karththaavea, neer ennaik kavaniththu, ennoadea vazhakkaaduki'ravarka'lin saththaththaik kea'lum.

nanmaikkuth theemaiyaich sarikkattalaamoa? en aaththumaavukkup padukuzhiyai vettuki'raarka'lea; ummudaiya ukkiraththai avarka'laivittuth thiruppumpadikku naan avarka'lukkaaka nanmaiyaip peasa umakku munpaaka nin'rathai ninaiththaru'lum.

aakaiyaal, avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laip pagnchaththukku oppukkoduththu, avarka'laip pattayaththukku iraiyaakkividum; avarka'l manaivika'l pi'l'laika'lat'ravarka'lum vithavaika'lumaaki, avarka'l purusharka'l kolaiseyyappattu, avarka'l vaaliparka'l yuththaththilea pattayavettaal madiyakkadavarka'l.

neer sadithiyil avarka'lmeal iraa'nuvaththai varappa'n'nukaiyaal, kookkural avarka'l veeduka'lilirunthu keadkappadakkadavathu; ennaip pidikkap padukuzhiyai vetti, en kaalka'lukkuk ka'n'nika'lai vaiththaarka'lea.

aanaalum karththaavea, avarka'l enakku viroathamaaych seyyum kolaipaathaka yoasanaiyaiyellaam neer a'riveer; avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththai umathu ka'n'nukku ma'raivaaka moodaamalum, avarka'l paavaththaik kulaikkaamalum iruppeeraaka; avarka'l umakku munpaakak kavizhkkappadakkadavarka'l; umathu koapaththin kaalaththilea ippadi avarka'lukkuch seyyum.
karththar sonnathu: nee poayk kuyavan vealaiyaana oru kalasaththaikko'ndu, janaththin moopparilum aasaariyarka'lin moopparilum silaraik koottikko'ndu,
kizhakku vaasalukku ethiraana innoamudaiya kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakkilea pu'rappattuppoay, naan unnoadea sollum vaarththaika'lai angkea pirasiththappaduththu.

nee avarka'lai noakki: yoothaavin raajaakka'lea, erusaleamin kudika'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar: ithoa, naan intha sthalaththinmeal oru pollaappai varappa'n'nuvean; athaik keadki'ra yaavarudaiya kaathuka'lilum athu thoniththukko'ndirukkum.

avarka'l ennai vittuvittu, intha sthalaththai anniya sthalamaakki, thaangka'lum, thangka'l pithaakka'lum, yoothaavin raajaakka'lum, a'riyaathiruntha anniya theavarka'lukku athilea thoopangkaatti, intha sthalaththaik kut'ramillaathavarka'lin iraththaththinaalea nirappinapadiyinaalum,

thangka'l pi'l'laika'laip paakaalukkuth thakanapalika'laakath thakanikkumpadi paakaalin meadaika'laik kattinapadiyinaalum ippadi varappa'n'nuvean; ivaika'lai naan ka'rpiththathumillai, sonnathumillai, ivaika'l en iruthayaththil thoan'rinathumillai.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, naadka'l varum, appozhuthu intha sthalam thoappeaththen'rum, innoamudaiya kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakken'rum inich sollappadaamal, sangkaarap pa'l'laththaakken'ru sollappadum.

appozhuthu naan yoothaavukkum erusaleamukkum ko'ndiruntha aaloasanaiyai intha sthalaththilea ve'rumaiyaakki, avarka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaaka avarka'laip pattayaththinaalum, avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyinaalum vizhappa'n'ni, avarka'l pireathangka'lai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkum, poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakak koduththu,
intha nakaraththaip paazhaakavum, eesalittu ninthikki'ra ninthaiyaakavum vaippean; athaik kadanthupoaki'ravan evanum piramiththu, athin ellaa vaathaika'linimiththamum eesaliduvaan.

avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'lum avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'ravarka'lum, avarka'lai i'rukappidikkappoaki'ra mut'rikkaiyilum idukkaththilum, naan avarka'laith thangka'l kumaararin maamsaththaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'lin maamsaththaiyum thinnappa'n'nuvean; avanavan thanakku aduththavanudaiya maamsaththaith thinpaan en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru nee solli,
unnoadea koodavantha manusharudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka anthak kalasaththai udaiththuppoattu,

avarka'lai noakki: thirumpach seppanidappadakkoodaatha kuyavanudaiya ma'npaa'ndaththai udaiththuppoattava'n'namaaka naan intha janaththaiyum intha nakaraththaiyum udaiththuppoaduvean; puthaikki'ratha'rku idamillaathathinaal thoappeaththilea savangka'laip puthaippaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
ivvithamaaka naan intha sthalaththukkum ithin kudika'lukkum seythu, intha nakaraththaith thoappeaththukkuch sariyaakkuvean.

entha veeduka'linmeal vaanaththin sakala seanaikkum thoopangkaatti, anniya theavarka'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarththaarka'loa, antha veeduka'laakiya erusaleamin veeduka'lum yoothaavudaiya raajaavin veeduka'lum thoappeath enki'ra sthalaththaippoal theettuppattavaika'laay irukkumen'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu ereamiyaa, karththar thannaith theerkkatharisanagnsolla anuppina thoappeaththilirunthu vanthu, karththarudaiya aalayaththin piraakaaraththilea nin'ruko'ndu, ellaa janangka'laiyum paarththu:

ithoa, neengka'l en vaarththaika'laik kea'laathapadikku ungka'l kazhuththaik kadinappaduththinapadiyinaal naan intha nakaraththukku viroathamaaych sonna ellaath theengkaiyum ithin mealum itha'rkaduththa patta'nangka'lin mealum varappa'n'nuvean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

ereamiyaa intha vaarththaika'laith theerkkatharisanamaakach solluki'rathai aasaariyanaana immearudaiya kumaaranum, karththarudaiya aalayaththup pirathaana visaara'naik karththanumaakiya paskoor keattapoathu,
ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaip paskoor adiththu, avanaik karththarudaiya aalayaththilea penyameen koaththiraththaaraich searntha mealvaasalil irukkum kaavala'raiyilea poattaan.

ma'runaa'lilea paskoor ereamiyaavaik kaavala'raiyilirunthu ve'liyea poakavittaan; appozhuthu ereamiyaa avanai noakki: karththar unnaip paskoor en'ru azhaikkaamal, maakoarmeesaapeep en'ru azhaikki'raar.

mealum karththar: ithoa, naan unnaiyum, un ellaach sineakitharaiyum payaththukku oppukkodukki'rean; un ka'nka'l kaa'na ivarka'l saththurukka'lin pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; yoothaa anaiththaiyum naan paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduppean; avan avarka'laich si'raipidiththuch silaraip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoaych silaraip pattayaththaal vettippoaduvaan.

intha nakaraththin ellaap palaththaiyum, athin ellaach sampaththaiyum, athin arumaiyaana ellaap poru'lka'laiyum, yoothaa raajaakka'lin ellaap pokkishangka'laiyum, naan avarka'l saththurukka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppean; avarka'l avaika'laik ko'l'laiyittu, paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoavaarka'l.

paskoorea, neeyum un veettil vaasamaayirukki'ra yaavarum si'raippattuppoaveerka'l; neeyum un ka'l'laththeerkkatharisanaththukkuch sevikoduththa un sineakithar yaavarum paapiloanukkup poay, angkea mariththu, angkea adakkampa'n'nappaduveerka'len'ru solluki'raar en'raan.

karththaavea, ennai i'nangkappa'n'nineer, naan i'nangkinean; neer ennilum palaththavaraayirunthu, ennai mea'rko'ndeer; naa'lthoa'rum nakaippukku idamaanean; ellaarum ennaip parikaasampa'n'nuki'raarka'l.

naan peasinathu mutha'rko'ndu katha'ruki'rean; kodumaiyen'rum paazhkkadippen'rum saththamittuk koo'ruki'rean; naan koo'rina karththarudaiya vaarththai naa'lthoa'rum enakku ninthaiyum, parikaasamumaayit'ru.

aathalaal naan avaraip pirasthaapampa'n'naamalum inik karththarudaiya naamaththilea peasaamalum iruppean en'rean; aanaalum avarudaiya vaarththai en elumpuka'lil adaipattu eriki'ra akkiniyaippoal en iruthayaththil irunthathu; athaich sakiththu i'laiththuppoanean; enakkup po'rukkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.

aneakar sollum avathoo'raik keattean, payagnsoozhnthirunthathu; a'riviyungka'l, appozhuthu naangka'l athai a'rivippoam enki'raarka'l; ennoadea samaathaanamaayiruntha anaivarum naan thava'rivizhumpadik kaaththirunthu: oruvea'lai i'nangkuvaan, appozhuthu avanai mea'rko'ndu, avanil kuroathantheerththukko'lvoam enki'raarka'l.

karththaroa payangkaramaana paraakkiramasaaliyaay ennoadu irukki'raar, aakaiyaal ennaith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'l mea'rko'l'laamal ida'ruvaarka'l; thangka'l kaariyam vaaykkaathapadiyaal mikavum vedkappaduvaarka'l; ma'rakkappadaatha niththiya ilachchai avarka'lukku u'ndaakum.

aanaalum neethimaanaich soathiththa'rinthu, u'l'linthiriyangka'laiyum iruthayaththaiyum paarkki'ra seanaika'lin karththaavea, neer avarka'lukku neethiyaich sarikkattuki'rathaik kaa'npeanaaka; en kaariyaththai ummidaththil saattivittean.
karththaraip paadungka'l, karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; avar e'liyavanudaiya aaththumaavaip pollaathavarka'lin kaikkuth thappuvikki'raar.
naan pi'ranthanaa'l sapikkappaduvathaaka; en thaayaar ennaip pet'ra naa'l aaseervathikkappadaathiruppathaaka.
umakku oru aa'npi'l'lai pi'ranthathen'ru en thakappanukku na'rseythiyaaka a'riviththu, avanai mikavum santhoashappaduththina manushan sapikkappadakkadavan.
antha manushan, karththar manam maa'raamal kavizhththuppoatta patta'nangka'laippoalirunthu, kaalamea ala'ruthalaiyum maththiyaana vea'laiyilea kookkuralaiyum keadkakkadavan.
en thaayaar enakkup pireathakkuzhiyum, naan en'raikkum pirasaviyaatha soolumaay irukkaththakkathaakak karppaththilea naan kolaiseyyappadaama'rpoanathenna?
naan varuththaththaiyum sagnchalaththaiyum ka'ndu, en naadka'l vedkamaayk kazhiyumpadikku naan karppaththilirunthu ve'lippattathenna?
sitheakkiyaa raajaa malkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paskooraiyum, aasaariyanaana maaseyaavin kumaaranaakiya seppaniyaavaiyum ereamiyaavinidaththil anuppi:

neer engka'lukkaakak karththaridaththil visaariyum; paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar engka'lukku viroathamaay yuththagnseyki'raan; oruvea'lai karththar thammudaiya ellaa a'rputhach seyalinpadiyeayum engka'lukku anukkirakagnseythu, avanai engka'laivittup poakappa'n'nuvaar en'ru solliyanuppinapoathu,
ereamiyaa avarka'laippaarththu, neengka'l sitheakkiyaavukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, ungka'lai alangkaththukku ve'liyea mut'rikkaipoatta paapiloan raajaavoadum kaltheayaroadum, neengka'l yuththampa'n'numpadi ungka'l kaika'lil pidiththirukki'ra yuththa aayuthangka'lai naan thiruppivittu, avarka'lai intha nakaraththin naduvilea searththu,
naan neettina kaiyinaalum palaththa puyaththinaalum koapamum ukkiramum makaa kadumaiyumaaka ungka'loadea yuththampa'n'ni,
intha nakaraththin kudika'laiyum, manusharaiyum, mirukangka'laiyum sangkarippean; makaa ko'l'lainoayaal saavaarka'l.

atha'rkuppinpu naan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavaiyum, avan oozhiyakkaararaiyum, janaththaiyum, intha nakaraththilea ko'l'lainoaykkum pattayaththukkum pagnchaththukkum thappi meethiyaanavarka'laiyum paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarudaiya kaiyilum, avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaiyilum, avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum oppukkoduppean; avan avarka'laip pattayakkarukkinaal vettuvaan; avan avarka'laith thappaviduvathumillai, avan mannippathumillai, irangkuvathumillaiyen'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'raan.
pinnaiyum avar, intha janangka'lai noakki: ithoa, naan ungka'l munnea jeevavazhiyaiyum mara'navazhiyaiyum vaikki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

intha nakaraththilea tharikki'ravan pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum saavaan; ungka'lai mut'rikkaipoadum kaltheayar vasamaayp pu'rappattup poayviduki'ravanoa pizhaippaan; avan piraa'nan avanukkuk kidaiththa ko'l'laipporu'laippoal irukkum.

en mukaththai intha nakaraththukku viroathamaay nanmaikku alla, theemaikkea vaiththean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; athu paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappadum; avan akkiniyaal athaich sutterippaanen'ru sol en'raar.
yoothaaraajaavin kudumpaththaaraiyum noakki: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

thaaveethin kudumpaththaarea, ungka'l seykaika'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam en ukkiram akkiniyaippoal pu'rappattu, avikki'ravan illaamal eriyaathapadikku, neengka'l ea'rkanavea niyaayangkeattu, pa'rikoduththavanai odukkuki'ravanudaiya kaikkuth thappuviyungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, pa'l'laththaakkil vaasampa'n'nuki'rava'lea, samanaana idaththil kanmalaiyaay irukki'rava'lea, engka'lukku viroathamaay varuki'ravan yaar en'rum, engka'l vaasasthalangka'lukku'l varuki'ravan yaar en'rum solluki'ra unakku naan ethiraa'liyaayirukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

naan ungka'l kiriyaika'lin palanukkuththakkathaay ungka'lai visaarippean; naan athin kaattilea theekko'luththuvean; athu athaich sut'rilumu'l'la yaavaiyum padchikkum en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththar sonnathu: nee yoothaa raajaavin aramanaikkup poay, angkea sollavea'ndiya vasanam ennaven'raal:

thaaveethin singkaasanaththil veet'rirukki'ra yoothaavin raajaavea, neerum ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararum intha vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasikki'ra ummudaiya janamum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

neengka'l niyaayamum neethiyum seythu, pa'rikoduththavanai odukkuki'ravanudaiya kaikkuth thappuviyungka'l; neengka'l paratheasiyaiyum thikkat'ravanaiyum vithavaiyaiyum odukkaamalum, kodumaiseyyaamalum, ivvidaththil kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthaamalum irungka'l.

intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea neengka'l meyyaaych seyveerka'laakil, thaaveethin singkaasanaththil udkaarnthirukki'ra raajaakka'l irathangka'lmealum kuthiraika'lmealum ea'ri, avanum avan oozhiyakkaararum avan janamumaaka intha aramanai vaasalka'lin vazhiyaay udpiraveasippaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l intha vaarththaika'laik kea'laama'rpoaneerka'leayaakil intha aramanai paazhaayppoam en'ru enpearil aa'naiyittean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

yoothaa raajaavin aramanaiyaik ku'riththuk karththar: nee enakkuk keeleayaaththaippoalavum leepanoanin kodumudiyaippoalavum irukki'raay; aanaalum meyyaakavea naan unnai vanaantharaththaippoalavum, kudiyillaatha patta'nangka'laippoalavum aakkividuvean.
sangkaarakkaararai avaravar aayuthangka'loadungkooda naan unakku viroathamaaka aayaththappaduththuvean; un uchchithamaana keathurukka'lai avarka'l vetti, akkiniyilea poaduvaarka'l.
aneakam jaathika'l intha nakaraththaik kadanthuvanthu, avanavan than than ayalaanai noakki: inthap periya nakaraththukkuk karththar ippadich seythathu ennaven'ru keadpaarka'l.

atha'rkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: avarka'l thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarin udanpadikkaiyai vittuvittu, anniya theavarka'laip pa'ninthuko'ndu, avaika'lukku aaraathanaiseythapadiyinaal ippadiyaayit'ru enpaarka'l en'ru solluki'raar.
mariththavanukkaaka azhavea'ndaam, avanukkaakap parithapikkavumvea'ndaam, si'raippattuppoanavanukkaakavea azhungka'l; avan inith thirumpivaruvathumillai, than janana poomiyaik kaa'npathumillai.

than thakappanaakiya yoasiyaavin pattaththukku vanthu, arasaa'ndu, ivvidaththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoana yoothaavin raajaavaayiruntha yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya salloomaikku'riththu: avan ini ingkea thirumpa varaamal,
thaan ko'ndupoakappatta sthalaththilea marippaan; inthath theasaththai avan inik kaa'npathillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.

thanakku visthaaramaana veettaiyum, kaat'ru veesum visaalamaana meala'raika'laiyum kattuveanen'ru solli, palaka'nika'laith thanakkuth thi'ranthu, keathuru palakaika'lai vaiththu, jaathilingkavaru'nam poosi,
aneethiyinaalea than veettaiyum, aniyaayaththinaalea than meala'raika'laiyum katti, than ayalaan seyyum vealaikkuk koolikodaamal, avanaich summaa vealaiko'l'luki'ravanukku aiyoa!
nee keathurumara maa'likaika'lil ulaavuki'rapadiyinaalea raajaavaayiruppaayoa? un thakappan poajanapaanampa'n'ni, niyaayamum neethiyugn seythapoathu avan sukamaay vaazhnthirukkavillaiyoa?
avan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanudaiya niyaayaththai visaariththaan; appozhuthu sukamaay vaazhnthaan; appadich seyvathallavoa ennai a'riki'ra a'rivu en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
un ka'nka'lum un manathumoaven'raal tha'rpozhivinmealum, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthuvathinmealum, idukkamum no'rukkuthalum seyvathinmealumea allaamal vea'ron'rinmealum vaikkappadavillai.

aakaiyaal karththar yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem enki'ra yoothaavin raajaavaikku'riththu: aiyoa! en sakoatharanea, aiyoa! sakoathariyea, en'ru avanukkaakap pulampuvathillai; aiyoa! aa'ndavanea, aiyoa! avarudaiya makaththuvamea, en'ru avanukkaakap pulampuvathillai.
oru kazhuthai puthaikkappaduki'ra va'n'namaay avan erusaleamin vaasalka'lukku ve'liyea izhuththe'rinthu puthaikkappaduvaan en'ru solluki'raar.
leepanoaninmealea'rip pulampu, paasaanil uraththa saththamidu, aapareemilirunthu kooppittukko'ndiru; un neasar anaivarum mu'rinthaarka'l.
nee sukamaay vaazhnthirukkaiyil naan unakkuch sonnean, nee kea'lean en'raay; un si'ruvayathumuthal nee en saththaththaik kea'laama'rpoaki'rathea un vazhakkam.
un meaypparka'l ellaaraiyum kaat'ru adiththukko'ndupoakum; un neasar si'raippattuppoavaarka'l; appoathallavoa un ellaap pollaappinimiththamum nee vedkappattu ilachchaiyadaivaay.

leepanoanil vaasamaayirunthu, keathurumarangka'lil koodukattikko'ndirukki'rava'lea, veathanaika'lum pi'l'laip pe'ruki'rava'lukkoththa vaathaiyum unakku varukaiyil, nee evva'lavu parithapikkappadaththakkava'laayiruppaay!

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeemin kumaaran koaniyaa, en valathukaiyin muththirai moathiramaayirunthaalum, athilirunthu unnaik kazhat'ri e'rinthupoaduvean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

un piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum, nee payappaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum unnai oppukkoduppean; paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarin kaiyilum kaltheayarin kaiyilum oppukkoduppean.
unnaiyum, unnaip pet'ra thaayaiyum, ungka'l janana poomiyallaatha anniya theasaththilea thuraththividuvean. angkea saaveerka'l.
thirumpuvatha'rkuth thangka'l aaththumaa vaagnchikkum theasaththukku avarka'l thirumpivaruvathillai.

koaniyaa enki'ra intha manushan avamathikkappatta udaintha silaiyoa? oruvarum virumpaatha paaththiramoa? avanum avan santhathiyum tha'l'lu'ndathum, thaangka'l a'riyaatha theasaththilea thuraththividappattathum ean?
theasamea! theasamea! theasamea! karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l.

inthap purushan santhaanamat'ravan, than naadka'lil vaazhvadaiyaathavan en'ru ivanaikku'riththu ezhuthungka'l; avan viththil oruvanaakilum vaazhvadainthu, thaaveethin singkaasanaththil veet'rirunthu, yoothaavil arasaa'lappoaki'rathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
en meaychchalin aaduka'laik keduththuch sitha'radikki'ra meaypparka'lukku aiyoa! en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar thamathu janaththai meaykki'ra meaypparka'lukku viroathamaakach solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l en aaduka'laip paraamariyaamal, avaika'laich sitha'radiththu avaika'laith thuraththivitteerka'l; ithoa, naan ungka'lpearil ungka'l seykaika'lin pollaappukkeat'ra tha'ndanaiyai ungka'lmeal varuvippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

naan en aaduka'lil meethiyaayiruppavaika'laith thuraththiyiruntha ellaath theasangka'lilumirunthu searththu, avaika'laith thirumpa avaika'lin thozhuvangka'lukkuk ko'nduvaruvean; appozhuthu avaika'l palukip perukum.
avaika'lai meaykkaththakkavarka'laiyum avaika'lmeal ea'rpaduththuvean; ini avaika'l payappaduvathumillai, kalangkuvathumillai, kaa'naama'rpoavathumillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu thaaveethukku oru neethiyu'l'la ki'laiyai ezhumpappa'n'nuvean; avar raajaavaayirunthu, gnaanamaay raajarikampa'n'ni, poomiyilea niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum nadappippaar.
avar naadka'lil yoothaa iradchikkappadum, israveal sukamaay vaasampa'n'num; avarukku idum naamam namathu neethiyaayirukki'ra karththar enpathea.
aathalaal, ithoa, naadka'l varum, appozhuthu israveal puththirarai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvantha karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu saththiyampa'n'naamal,

israveal veettin santhathiyaaraith thangka'l suyatheasaththil kudiyirukkumpadikku vadatheasaththilum, naan avarka'laith thuraththiyiruntha ellaa theasangka'lilumirunthu azhaiththu vazhi nadaththikko'nduvantha karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu saththiyampa'n'nuvaarka'len'ru karththar solluki'raar.

theerkkatharisika'linimiththam en iruthayam en u'l'laththilea no'rungkiyirukki'rathu; en elumpuka'lellaam athiruki'rathu; karththar nimiththamum, avarudaiya parisuththa vaarththaika'linimiththamum naan ve'riththirukki'ra manushanaippoalavum mathupaanam mea'rko'ndavanaippoalavum irukki'rean.

theasam vipasaarakkaararaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu, theasam saapaththinaal thukkikki'rathu, vanaantharaththin meaychchalka'l vaadippoaki'rathu; avarka'l oattam pollaathathu; avarka'l pelan aniyaayamaayirukki'rathu.
theerkkatharisiyum aasaariyanum maayakkaararaayirukki'raarka'l; en aalayaththilum avarka'ludaiya pollaappaik ka'ndean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aathalaal, avarka'l vazhi avarka'lukku iruttilea sa'rukkalaana vazhiyaayirukkum, thuraththu'ndu athilea vizhuvaarka'l; avarka'l visaarikkappadum varushaththilea avarka'lmeal pollaappai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
samaariyaavin theerkkatharisika'liloa mathikeattaik ka'ndean; paakaalaikko'ndu theerkkatharisanagnsolli, israveal ennum en janaththai moasampoakkinaarka'l.

erusaleamin theerkkatharisika'lilum thidukkidaththakka kaariyaththaik kaa'nki'rean; vipasaarampa'n'ni, vagnchakamaay nadanthu, oruvanum than pollaappai vittuth thirumpaathapadikkup pollaathavarka'lin kaika'laith thidappaduththuki'raarka'l; avarka'l ellaarum enakkuch soathoamaippoalum, athin kudika'l komoaraavaippoalum irukki'raarka'l.

aathalaal seanaika'lin karththar theerkkatharisika'laikku'riththu: ithoa, naan avarka'lukkup pusikka ettiyaiyum, kudikkap pichchukkalantha tha'n'neeraiyum koduppean; erusaleamin theerkkatharisika'lilirunthu maayamaanathu theasamengkum parampit'rea en'ru solluki'raar.

ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin vaarththaika'laik kea'laathirungka'l; avarka'l ungka'lai vee'nperumai ko'l'lumpadi seyki'raarka'l; karththarudaiya vaakkai alla, thaangka'l yookiththa tharisanaththaich solluki'raarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l ennai asattaipa'n'nuki'ravarka'lai noakki: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam irukkumen'ru karththar sonnaaren'ru solluki'rathumallaamal; thangka'l iruthayaththin kadinaththilea nadakki'ra yaavaraiyum noakki: ungka'lmeal pollaappu varaathen'rum solluki'raarka'l.
karththarudaiya aaloasanaiyil koodanin'ru, avarudaiya vaarththaiyaik keatta'rinthavan yaar? avarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kavaniththuk keattavan yaar?
ithoa, karththarudaiya perungkaat'raakiya kodiya pusal pu'rappattathu; athu thunmaarkkarudaiya thalaiyinmeal ukkiramaay moathum.
karththar thammudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuka'lai nadappiththu ni'raiveat'ruma'lavum, avarudaiya koapam tha'niyaathu; kadaisinaadka'lil athai nan'raay u'naruveerka'l.
anthath theerkkatharisika'lai naan anuppaathirunthum avarka'l oadinaarka'l; avarka'loadea naan peasaathirunthum avarka'l theerkkatharisanagn sonnaarka'l.

avarka'l en aaloasanaiyilea nilaiththirunthaarka'leayaakil, appozhuthu avarka'l en vaarththaika'lai janangka'lukkuth theriviththu, avarka'laith thangka'l pollaatha vazhika'laiyum thangka'l seykaika'lin pollaappaiyum vittuth thiruppuvaarka'l.
naan sameepaththi'rku maaththiramaa theavan, thooraththi'rkum theavan allavoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

yaavanaakilum thannai naan kaa'naathapadikku ma'raividangka'lil o'liththukko'l'lakkoodumoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum nirappuki'ravar allavoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
soppanangka'ndean, soppanangka'ndean en'ru, en naamaththaich sollip poyththeerkkatharisanam uraikki'ra theerkkatharisika'l solluki'rathaik keattean.

ethuvaraikkum ippadiyirukkum? poyththeerkkatharisanam solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin iruthayaththil eathaakilumu'ndoa? ivarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththin vagnchakaththaiyea theerkkatharisanamaakach solluki'ravarka'l.

en janaththin pithaakka'l paakaalinimiththam en naamaththai ma'ranthathupoala, ivarka'l thangka'l ayalaarukku vivarikki'ra thangka'l soppanangka'linaalea en naamaththai avarka'l ma'rakkumpadi seyyappaarkki'raarka'l.

soppanangka'nda theerkkatharisi soppanaththai vivarippaanaaka; en vaarththaiyu'l'lavanoa, en vaarththaiyai u'nmaiyaaych solvaanaaka; koathumaikkumun pathar emmaaththiram? en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
en vaarththai akkiniyaippoalum, kanmalaiyai no'rukkum sammattiyaippoalum irukki'rathallavoa? en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, ovvoruvaraayth thanthan ayalaaridaththil en vaarththaiyaith thiruttuththanamaay edukki'ra theerkkatharisika'lukku naan viroathi en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, thangka'l naavin sollaiyea vazhangki: avar athai uraiththaar en'ru solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lukku naan viroathi en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, poychsoppanangka'laith theerkkatharisanamaakach solli, avaika'lai vivariththu, en janaththaith thangka'l poyka'linaalum, thangka'l veempuka'linaalum, moasampoakkuki'ravarka'lukku naan viroathi en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan avarka'lai anuppinathumillai, avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththathumillai; avarka'l intha janaththukku oru pirayoajanamaay iruppathumillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththaraalea sumarum paaram ennaven'ru intha janamaakilum oru theerkkatharisiyaakilum oru aasaariyanaakilum unnaik keattaal, ungka'laith tha'l'lividuvean enpathea paaram en'ru nee avarka'ludanea sollavea'ndum.

karththaraal sumarum paaram en'ru solluki'ra theerkkatharisiyaakilum aasaariyanaakilum janamaakilum sari, appadich solluki'ra manushanaiyum avan veettaaraiyum tha'ndippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththar enna ma'ruuththaravu koduththaar? karththar enna sonnaar? en'ru neengka'l avaravar thangka'l ayalaanaiyum avaravar thangka'l sakoatharanaiyum keadpeerka'laaka.

aanaal karththaraal sumarum paaram enki'ra sollai ini vazhangkaathiruppeerka'laaka, avanavan vaarththaiyea avanavanukkup paaramaayirukkum; atheanen'raal, namathu theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar enki'ra jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya vaarththaika'laip purattuki'reerka'l.
karththar unakku enna ma'ruuththaravu koduththaar? karththar enna sonnaar? en'ru nee theerkkatharisiyaik keadpaayaaka.

neengka'loavenil, karththaraal sumarum paaram en'ru solluki'rapadiyinaalea: karththarin paaram en'ru sollaathirungka'len'ru naan ungka'lukkuch solli anuppiyum, neengka'l intha vaarththaiyaik karththarin paaram en'ru solluki'reerka'lea.
aathalaal, ithoa, naan ungka'lai ma'rakkavea ma'ranthu, ungka'laiyum, naan ungka'lukkum ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum koduththa nakaraththaiyum, enakku munpaaka iraathapadikkuk kaivittu,
ma'rakkappadaatha niththiya ninthaiyaiyum, niththiya ilachchaiyaiyum ungka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar, yoayaakkeemin kumaaranaakiya ekoniyaa enki'ra yoothaavin raajaavaiyum, yoothaavin pirapukka'laiyum, erusaleamilu'l'la thachcharaiyum kollaraiyum si'raipidiththu, paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoanapinpu, ithoa, karththarudaiya aalayaththinmun vaikkappattiruntha aththippazhangka'lu'l'la ira'ndu koodaika'laik karththar enakkuk kaa'npiththaar.
oru koodaiyilea muthal kanthaayaththu aththippazhangka'lukkuch samaanamaana mikavum nalla aththippazhangka'lum, mat'rak koodaiyilea pusikkaththakaatha mikavum ketta aththippazhangka'lum irunthathu.

karththar ennai noakki: ereamiyaavea, nee ennaththaik kaa'nki'raay en'raar; atha'rku naan: aththippazhangka'laik kaa'nki'rean; nallavaika'laana aththippazhangka'l mikavum nallavaika'lum, kettavaika'loa pusikkaththakaatha mikavum kettavaika'lumaayirukki'rathu en'rean.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
naan ivvidaththilirunthu, kaltheayar theasaththukkuch si'raippattup poakavitta yootharai naan intha nalla aththippazhangka'lukku oppittu, avarka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaaka avarka'lai angkikarippean.

avarka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaaka naan en ka'nka'lai avarka'lmeal vaiththu, avarka'lai intha theasaththukkuth thirumpivarappa'n'ni, avarka'laik kattuvean, avarka'lai idikkamaattean, avarka'lai naattuvean, avarka'laip pidungkamaattean.

naan karththar en'ru a'riyum iruthayaththai avarka'lukkuk koduppean; avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean; avarka'l thangka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ennidaththi'rkuth thirumpuvaarka'l en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.

pusikkaththakaatha ketta aththippazhangka'laith tha'l'lividuvathupoala, naan sitheakkiyaa enki'ra yoothaavin raajaavaiyum avanudaiya pirapukka'laiyum, inthath theasaththilea meethiyaana erusaleamin kudika'laiyum, ekipthu theasaththil kudiyirukki'ravarka'laiyum tha'l'livittu,

avarka'lukkuth theemaiyu'ndaaka avarka'lai poomiyilu'l'la ellaa raajyangka'lilum alainthu thiriki'ravarka'laakavum, naan avarka'laith thuraththivitta ellaa idangka'lilum ninthaiyaakavum, pazhamozhiyaakavum, vasaichsollaakavum, saapamaakavum vaiththu,

avarka'lukkum avarka'l pithaakka'lukkum naan koduththa theasaththil avarka'l iraathapadikku nirmoolamaakumattum, avarka'lukku'l'lea pattayaththaiyum, pagnchaththaiyum, ko'l'lainoayaiyum anuppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem enki'ra yoothaavudaiya raajaavin naalaam varushaththukkuch sariyaana, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar arasaa'nda muthalaam varushaththilea yoothaavin janam anaiththaiyum ku'riththu ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vaarththai;
athaith theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaa yoothaavin janam anaiththukkum, erusaleamin kudika'l ellaarukkum a'rivikki'ratha'rkaaka avarka'lai noakki:

aamoanin kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaavin pathinmoon'raam varusham thuvakki innaa'lmattum sen'ra intha irupaththumoon'ru varushamaakak karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaayit'ru; athai naan ungka'lukku ea'rkanavea sollikko'nduvanthum neengka'l kea'laama'rpoaneerka'l.

karththar ungka'lidaththi'rkuth theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya sakala oozhiyakkaararaiyum ea'rkanavea anuppikko'ndeayirunthum, neengka'l kea'laamalum, keadkumpadikku ungka'l sevika'laich saayaamalumpoaneerka'l.

avarka'laikko'ndu avar: ungka'lil avanavan thanthan pollaatha vazhiyaiyum, ungka'l kiriyaika'lin pollaappaiyum vittuth thirumpi, karththar ungka'lukkum ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum koduththa theasaththil sathaakaalamum kudiyirunthu,

anniya theavarka'laip pinpat'raamalum, avaika'lukku aaraathanaiseyyaamalum, avaika'laip pa'niyaamalumirunthu, naan ungka'lukkuth theemai seyyaathapadikku ungka'l kaika'lin seykaika'laal enakkuk koapamu'ndaakkaamalum irungka'l en'ru solliyanuppinean.
neengka'loa, ungka'lukkuth theemaiyaaka ungka'l kaika'lin seykaika'laalea enakkuk koapamoottumpadikku, en sollaik kea'laama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
neengka'l en vaarththaika'laik kea'laama'rpoanapadiyinaal,

ithoa, naan vadakkeayirukki'ra sakala vamsangka'laiyum, en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya neapukaathneachchaar enki'ra paapiloan raajaavaiyum azhaiththanuppi, avarka'lai inthath theasaththukku viroathamaakavum, ithin kudika'lukku viroathamaakavum, sut'rilumirukki'ra intha ellaa jaathika'lukkum viroathamaakavum varappa'n'ni, avaika'laich sangkaaraththukku oppukkoduththu, avaika'laip paazhaakavum ikazhchchikku'riyaakiya eesalpoaduthalaakavum, niththiya vanaantharangka'laakavum seyvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

makizhchchiyin saththaththaiyum, santhoashaththin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaa'lanin saththaththaiyum, ma'navaattiyin saththaththaiyum, eanthiraththin saththaththaiyum vi'lakkin ve'lichchaththaiyum avarka'lilirunthu neengkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
inthath theasamellaam vanaantharamum paazhumaakum; intha jaathika'loa, ezhupathu varushamaakap paapiloan raajaavaich seavippaarka'l.

ezhupathu varusham ni'raivea'rinapinpu, naan paapiloan raajaavinidaththilum, antha jaathiyinidaththilum, kaltheayarudaiya theasaththinidaththilum, avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththai visaariththu, athai niththiya paazhidamaakki,

naan anthath theasaththukku viroathamaay uraiththa en vaarththaika'laiyellaam, ereamiyaa sakala jaathika'lukkum viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanamaaych sonnathum, inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathumaana yaavaiyum athinmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aneakam jaathika'lum periya raajaakka'lum avarka'lai adimaiko'lvaarka'l; naan avarka'lukku avarka'l kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaakavum, avarka'l kaika'lin seykaika'lukkuththakkathaakavum pathil a'lippean enki'raar.
isravealin theavanaakiya karththar ennai noakki: naan unnai anuppuki'ra jaathika'l kudiththu, naan thangka'lukku'l anuppum pattayaththaal avarka'l tha'l'laadi, puththikettuppoakumpadikku,
intha ukkiramaakiya mathupaanaththin paaththiraththai nee en kaiyilirunthu vaangki, avarka'l ellaarukkum athilea kudikkakkodu en'raar.
appozhuthu naan anthap paaththiraththaik karththarudaiya kaiyilirunthu vaangki, karththar ennai anuppina ellaa jaathika'lukkum kudikkak koduththean.

erusaleamukkum yoothaavin patta'nangka'lukkum, athin raajaakka'lukkum, athin pirapukka'lukkum, avarka'lai innaa'lilirukki'rapadi vanaantharamum paazhum ikazhchchikku'riyaakiya eesalpoaduthalum saapamumaakkippoadumpadi kudikkakkoduththean.
ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanukkum, avan oozhiyakkaararukkum, avan pirapukka'lukkum, avanudaiya ellaa janaththukkum,

kalanthu kudiyirukki'ra anaivarukkum, ooths theasaththinudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, pelistharudaiya theasaththil irukki'ra ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, askaloanukkum, kaasaavukkum, ekroanukkum, asthoaththil meethiyaanavarka'lukkum,
eathoamukkum, moavaapukkum, ammoan puththirarukkum,
theeruvinudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, seethoanudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, samuththiraththukku akkaraiyaana theevuka'lin raajaakka'lukkum,
theathaanukkum, theamaavukkum, poosukkum, kadaiyaantharangka'lilu'l'la anaivarukkum,
arapitheasaththu ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, vanaantharaththil kalanthu kudiyirukki'ravarka'ludaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum,
simriyinudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, ealaaminudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, meathiyaavinudaiya ellaa raajaakka'lukkum,

vadakkeayirukki'ra ellaa raajaakka'lukkum, sameepamaanavarka'lum thooramaanavarka'lumaakiya avaravarka'lukkum, poomiyinmeethilu'l'la sakala theasaththu raajyangka'lukkum kudikkakkoduththean; seasaakku enki'ra raajaavum avarka'lukkup pi'rpaadu kudippaan en'raar.

neengka'l kudiththu, ve'riththu, vaanthipa'n'ni, naan ungka'lukku'l anuppum pattayaththaalea ezhunthiraathapadikku vizhungka'l en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru nee avarka'lukkuch sollu.

avarka'l kudikki'ratha'rku anthap paaththiraththai un kaiyil vaangkamaattoam en'ru solvaarka'laanaal, nee avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l kudiththuth theeravea'ndum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru sollu.

ithoa, theengkaik katta'laiyida naan en naamam tharikkappatta nakaraththilea thuvakkumpoathu, neengka'l tha'ndanaikkuth thappuveerka'loa? neengka'l thappuvathillai; naan poomiyin ellaak kudika'linmealum pattayaththai varavazhaikki'rean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

aathalaal nee avarka'lukku viroathamaaka intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam theerkkatharisanamaaka uraiththu, avarka'lai noakki: karththar uyaraththilirunthu kerchchiththu, thamathu parisuththa vaasasthalaththilirunthu thammudaiya saththaththaik kaatti, thammudaiya thaaparaththukku viroathamaayk kerchchikkavea kerchchiththu, aalaiyai mithikki'ravarka'l aarpparippathupoal poomiyinudaiya ellaak kudika'lukkum viroathamaaka aarpparippaar en'ru sol en'raar.

aaravaaram poomiyin kadaiyaantharamattum poay ettum; jaathika'loadea karththarukku vazhakku irukki'rathu; maamsamaana yaavaroadum avar niyaayaththukku'l piraveasippaar; thunmaarkkaraip pattayaththukku oppukkoduppaar en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, jaathijaathikkuth theemai parampum, poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu makaa pusal ezhumpum.

akkaalaththilea poomiyin orumunai thuvakkip poomiyin ma'rumunaimattum karththaraal kolaiyu'ndavarka'l kidappaarka'l; avarka'l pulampappadaamalum searkkappadaamalum adakkampa'n'nappadaamalum poomiyinmeal eruvaavaarka'l.

meaypparka'lea, ala'rungka'l; manthaiyil pirasthaapamaanavarka'lea, saampalil pura'ndu katha'rungka'l; neengka'l vettappadavum sitha'radikkappadavum ungka'l naadka'l ni'raivea'rina; uchchithamaana paaththirampoal vizhunthu no'rungkuveerka'l.
meaypparka'l oadippoaki'ratha'rkum, manthaiyil pirasthaapamaanavarka'l thappiththukko'l'luki'ratha'rkum idamiraathu.
thangka'l meaychchalaik karththar paazhaakkinathinimiththam meaypparka'l kooppiduki'rathum, manthaiyil pirasthaapamaanavarka'l ala'ruki'rathumaana saththamu'ndaakum.
avarka'l sukiththiruntha thaaparangka'l karththarudaiya koapaththin erichchalaalea sangkaaramaayina.

avar pathivirunthu pu'rappadum singkaththaippoaliruppaar; odukkuki'ravanudaiya ukkiraththinaalum, avanudaiya ukkirakoapaththinaalum avarka'l theasam paazhaayit'ren'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
yoasiyaavin kumaaranum yoothaavin raajaavumaakiya yoayaakkeemudaiya raajyapaaraththin thuvakkaththilea karththaraal u'ndaana vaarththai:

nee karththarudaiya aalayaththin piraakaaraththilea nin'ruko'ndu, karththarudaiya aalayaththilea pa'niyavaruki'ra yoothaavudaiya patta'nangka'lin kudika'l anaivaroadum sollumpadi naan unakkuk ka'rpiththa ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum avarka'lukkuch sollu; oru vaarththaiyaiyum ku'raiththuppoadaathea en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l seykaika'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam naan avarka'lukkuch seyya ninaikki'ra theengkukku naan manasthaapappadaththakkathaaka oruvea'lai avarka'l keattu, avaravar thamtham pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpuvaarka'l.
nee avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'lidaththukku ea'rkanavea anuppikko'ndirunthum, neengka'l kea'laama'rpoana en oozhiyakkaararaakiya theerkkatharisika'lin vaarththaika'lai neengka'l keadkumpadikkum,
naan ungka'l munvaiththa en niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi neengka'l nadakkumpadikkum, neengka'l en sollaik kea'laama'rpoanaal,
naan intha aalayaththaich seeloavaavaippoalaakki, intha nakaraththaip poomiyilu'l'la ellaa jaathika'lukku munpaakavum saapamaakkippoaduvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
ereamiyaa intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam karththarudaiya aalayaththilea sollumpoathu, aasaariyarka'lum, theerkkatharisika'lum, sakala janangka'lum keattaarka'l.

sakala janangka'lukkum sollak karththar thanakkuk ka'rpiththavaika'laiyellaam ereamiyaa solli mudiththapoathu, aasaariyarka'lum theerkkatharisika'lum sakala janangka'lum avanaip pidiththu: nee saakavea saakavea'ndum.

intha aalayam seeloavaippoalaaki, intha nakaram kudiyillaamal paazhaayppoam en'ru, nee karththarudaiya naamaththilea theerkkatharisanam solvaanean en'ru solli, janangka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya aalayaththilea ereamiyaavukku viroathamaayk koodinaarka'l.
yoothaavin pirapukka'l intha varththamaanangka'laik keattu, raajaavin veettilirunthu karththarudaiya aalayaththukkup poay, karththarudaiya puthiya vaasalil udkaarnthaarka'l.

appozhuthu aasaariyarka'lum theerkkatharisika'lum, pirapukka'laiyum sakala janangka'laiyum noakki: intha manushan mara'na aakkinaikkup paaththiran; ungka'l sevika'laalea neengka'l keattapadi, intha nakaraththukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam sonnaanea en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu ereamiyaa ellaap pirapukka'laiyum, ellaa janangka'laiyum noakki: neengka'l keatta ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum intha aalayaththukkum intha nakaraththukkum viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanamaaych sollak karththar ennai anuppinaar.

ippozhuthum neengka'l ungka'l vazhika'laiyum, ungka'l kiriyaika'laiyum seerppaduththi, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththaik kea'lungka'l; appozhuthu karththar ungka'lukku viroathamaaych sonna theengkukku manasthaapappaduvaar.
naanoavenil, ithoa, ungka'l kaiyil irukki'rean; ungka'l paarvaikku nanmaiyum niyaayamumaayirukki'rathai enakkuch seyyungka'l.

aakilum neengka'l ennaik kon'rupoattaal, neengka'l kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyai ungka'lmealum intha nakaraththinmealum ithin kudika'linmealum sumaththikko'lveerka'len'ru nichchayamaay a'riyungka'l; intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam ungka'l sevika'lilea sollak karththar meyyaakavea ennai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppinaar en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu pirapukka'lum sakala janangka'lum, aasaariyarka'laiyum theerkkatharisika'laiyum noakki: intha manushan mara'na aakkinaikkup paaththiranalla; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin naamaththilea nammudanea peasinaan en'raarka'l.
theasaththilea moopparaanavarka'lil silar ezhumpi, sapaiyaakiya janangka'lai noakki:

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavin naadka'lil moreasaa ooraanaakiya meekaa theerkkatharisanagnsolli, yoothaavin sakala janangka'laiyum paarththu: seeyoan vayalve'liyaaka uzhappattu, erusaleam ma'nmeaduka'laayppoam; intha aalayaththin parvatham kaattilu'l'la meaduka'laayppoam en'ru seanaika'lin karththar uraiththaar en'ru sonnaan.

avanai yoothaavin raajaavaakiya eseakkiyaavum mat'ra yootharka'lum searnthu kon'rupoattaarka'laa? avan karththarukkup payanthu, karththarin mukaththai noakkik kegnchinaanallavaa? appozhuthu karththar avarka'lukku viroathamaakach solliyiruntha theengkukku manasthaapappattaar; ippoathum, naam nammudaiya aaththumaavukku viroathamaaka makaa pollaappai varappa'n'nuki'ravarka'laayirukki'roamea.

keeriyaathyaareem ooraanaakiya semaayaavin kumaaran uriyaa ennum oru manushanum karththarudaiya naamaththilea theerkkatharisanam solluki'ravanaayirunthaan; avan ereamiyaavin vaarththaika'lukkuch sariyaaka intha nakaraththukkum inthath theasaththukkum viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam sonnaan.

yoayaakkeem raajaavum avanudaiya sakala paraakkiramasaalika'lum pirapukka'lum avan vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, raajaa avanaik kon'rupoadumpadi eththaniththaan; athai uriyaa keattu, payanthu, oadippoay, ekipthilea searnthaan.
appozhuthu yoayaakkeemraajaa akpoarin kumaaranaakiya elnaaththaanaiyum avanoadeakooda vea'rea silaraiyum ekipthuvaraikkum anuppinaan.

ivarka'l uriyaavai ekipthilirunthu ko'nduvanthu, avanai yoayaakkeem raajaavinidaththil vittaarka'l; avan pattayaththaalea avanai vetti, avan udalai neesa janangka'lin pireathakkuzhika'lidaththilea e'rinthuvittaan en'raarka'l.
aakilum ereamiyaavaik kolla janangka'lin kaiyil oppukkodaathapadi, saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya akeekkaam avanukkuch sakaayamaayirunthaan.
yoasiyaavin kumaaranum yoothaavin raajaavumaakiya yoayaakkeemudaiya raajyapaaraththin thuvakkaththilea karththaraal ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vaarththai:
karththar ennai noakki: nee unakkuk kayi'ruka'laiyum nukangka'laiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, avaika'lai un kazhuththilea poottikko'ndu,

avaika'lai erusaleamukkuch sitheakkiyaa raajaavinidaththil varum sthaanaapathika'l kaiyilea eathoamin raajaavukkum, moavaapin raajaavukkum, ammoan puththirarin raajaavukkum, theeruvin raajaavukkum, seethoanin raajaavukkum anuppi,
avarka'l thangka'l ejamaanka'lukkuch sollumpadik ka'rpikkavea'ndumen'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal,
naan poomiyaiyum manushanaiyum poomiyinmealu'l'la mirukajeevanka'laiyum en makaa palaththinaalum oangkiya en puyaththinaalum u'ndaakkinean; enakku ishdamaanavanukku athaik kodukki'rean.

ippozhuthum naan inthath theasangka'laiyellaam en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya neapukaathneachchaar enki'ra paapiloan raajaavin kaiyilea koduththean; avanukku oozhiyagnseyyumpadi ve'liyin mirukajeevanka'laiyum koduththean.

avanudaiya theasaththukkuk kaalam varuki'ravaraiyil sakala jaathika'lum avanaiyum avanudaiya puththirapauththiraraiyum seavippaarka'l; athinpinpu aneakam jaathika'lum periya raajaakka'lum avanai adimaiko'lvaarka'l.

entha jaathiyaavathu, entha raajyamaavathu paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar enpavanaich seaviyaamalum, than kazhuththaip paapiloan raajaavin nukaththukkuk keezhppaduththaamalumpoanaal, antha jaathiyai naan avan kaiyaalea nirmoolamaakkuma'lavum, pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum ko'l'lainoayaalum tha'ndippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

paapiloan raajaavai neengka'l seavippathillaiyen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'ra ungka'l theerkkatharisika'lukkum, ungka'l ku'rikaararukkum, ungka'l soppanakkaararukkum, ungka'l naadpaarkki'ravarka'lukkum, ungka'l sooniyakkaararukkum neengka'l sevikodaathirungka'l.

naan ungka'lai ungka'l theasaththilirunthu thoorappaduththuki'ratha'rkum, ungka'laith thuraththividuki'ratha'rkum, neengka'l azhiki'ratha'rkumaaka avarka'l ungka'lukkup poyyaana theerkkatharisanam solluki'raarka'l.

aanaalum entha jaathi than kazhuththaip paapiloan raajaavin nukaththukkuk keezhppaduththi, avanaich seavikkumoa, antha jaathiyaith than theasaththaip payirittu, athilea kudiyirunthu thaaparikkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

intha ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyea naan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavoadu peasi: ungka'l kazhuththaip paapiloan raajaavin nukaththukkuk keezhppaduththi, avanaiyum avan janaththaiyum seaviyungka'l; appozhuthu pizhaippeerka'l.
paapiloan raajaavaich seaviyaama'rpoaki'ra jaathikku viroathamaakak karththar sonnathinpadiyea, neeyum un janamum pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum ko'l'lainoayaalum saavaanean?

neengka'l paapiloan raajaavaich seavippathillaiyen'ru ungka'ludanea solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin vaarththaika'laik kea'laathirungka'l; avarka'l ungka'lukkup poyyaana theerkkatharisanam solluki'raarka'l.

naan avarka'lai anuppinathillai; naan ungka'laith thuraththividuki'ratha'rkum, neengka'lum ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lum azhinthupoaki'ratha'rkum allavoa ivarka'l en naamaththaich solli, poyyaana theerkkatharisanam uraikki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'rean.

mealum naan aasaariyaraiyum intha ellaa janangka'laiyum noakki: ithoa, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'l ippozhuthu seekkiraththilea paapiloanilirunthu thirumpik ko'nduvarappadumen'ru, ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra ungka'ludaiya theerkkatharisika'lin vaarththaika'laik kea'laathirungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'l ungka'lukkup poyyaana theerkkatharisanam solluki'raarka'l.
avarka'lukkuch sevikodaathirungka'l; paapiloan raajaavaich seaviyungka'l, appozhuthu pizhaippeerka'l; intha nakaram paazhaayppoakavea'ndiyathenna?

allathu avarka'l theerkkatharisika'laayirunthu, avarka'lidaththilea karththarudaiya vaarththai irunthaal, karththarudaiya aalayaththilum, yoothaaraajaavin aramanaiyilum, erusaleamilum meethiyaana pa'nimuttuka'l paapiloanukkup poakaathapadikku avarka'l seanaika'lin karththarai noakki man'raadattumea.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar yoayaakkeemin kumaaranaakiya ekoniyaa ennum yoothaavin raajaavaiyum, yoothaavilum erusaleamiliruntha periyoar anaivaraiyum erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukkuch si'raipidiththukko'ndupoakaiyil,

edukkaamal vitta sakala thoo'nka'laiyum, kadalthottiyaiyum, aathaarangka'laiyum, intha nakaraththil meethiyaana mat'rap pa'nimuttuka'laiyungku'riththuch seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal,

karththarudaiya aalayaththilum, yoothaaraajaavin aramanaiyilum, erusaleamilum meethiyaana anthap pa'nimuttuka'l paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoakappadumen'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
naan avaika'lai visaarikkum naa'lvaraikkum avaika'l angkea irukkum; pinpu avaika'laith thirumpa intha sthalaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'rean.

yoothaavudaiya raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa arasaa'lath thuvakkina naalaam varusham ainthaam maathaththilea, asoorin kumaaranaakiya ananiyaa ennappatta kipiyoan ooraanaakiya theerkkatharisi karththarudaiya aalayaththilea aasaariyarka'lum sakala janangka'lum paarththirukka ennai noakki:
isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, paapiloan raajaavin nukaththai mu'riththean.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ivvidaththilirunthu eduththup paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoana karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'laiyellaam naan ira'ndu varushakaalaththilea ivvidaththukkuth thirumpak ko'nduvarappa'n'nuvean.

yoayaakkeemin kumaaranaakiya ekoniyaa enki'ra yoothaavudaiya raajaavaiyum paapiloanukkuch si'raiyaakak ko'ndupoakappatta yoothar anaivaraiyum naan ivvidaththukkuth thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean; paapiloan raajaavin nukaththai udaippean en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi aasaariyarka'l paarththirukkavum, karththarudaiya aalayaththil nin'riruntha janangka'lellaarum paarththirukkavum ananiyaa theerkkatharisiyai noakki:

aamen, karththar appadiyea seyvaaraaka; karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nimuttuka'laiyum si'raippattuppoana anaivaraiyum paapiloanilirunthu thirumpivarappa'n'nuvaaren'ru nee theerkkatharisanamaakach sonna un vaarththaika'laik karththar ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaka.
aakilum, un sevika'lum sakala janaththin sevika'lum keadka naan sollum vaarththaiyaik kea'l.

poorvakaalamuthal enakku munnum unakku munnum iruntha theerkkatharisika'l aneakam theasangka'lukku viroathamaakavum, periya raajyangka'lukku viroathamaakavum, yuththaththaiyum pagnchaththaiyum ko'l'lainoayaiyum ku'riththuth theerkkatharisanam sonnaarka'l.

samaathaanam varum en'ru theerkkatharisi theerkkatharisanam solliyirukka, anthath theerkkatharisi sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea vanthaal, appozhuthu avan karththar meyyaay anuppina theerkkatharisiyaaka vi'langkuvaanen'ru ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi sonnaan.
appozhuthu ananiyaa enki'ra theerkkatharisi ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyin kazhuththiliruntha nukaththai eduththu athai udaiththuppoattaan.

pinpu ananiyaa sakala janangka'lukku munpaakavum: inthappirakaaramaaka ira'ndu varushakaalaththilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarudaiya nukaththaich sakala jaathika'lin kazhuththilumirunthu vilaka udaiththuppoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan. appozhuthu ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi than vazhiyea poanaan.
ananiyaa enki'ra theerkkatharisi ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyin kazhuththiliruntha nukaththai udaiththuppoattapi'rpaadu, karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee poay, ananiyaavai noakki: nee maranukaththai udaiththaay; atha'rkup pathilaaka iruppu nukaththai u'ndupa'n'nu en'ru karththar sonnaar.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaaraich seavikkumpadikku iruppu nukaththai intha ellaa jaathika'ludaiya kazhuththinmealum poattean; avarka'l avanaich seavippaarka'l. ve'liyin mirukajeevanka'laiyum avanukku oppukkoduththean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi ananiyaa enki'ra theerkkatharisiyai noakki: ippoathum ananiyaavea, kea'l; karththar unnai anuppinathillai; neeyoa intha janaththaip poyyai nampumpadich seythaay.

aakaiyaal, ithoa, unnaip poomiyinmeal iraathapadikku akat'rividuvean; intha varushaththilea nee saavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar; karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakam u'ndaakap peasinaayea en'raan.
appadiyea ananiyaa enki'ra theerkkatharisi avvarushaththileathaanea eazhaam maathaththil seththuppoanaan.
ekoniyaa ennum raajaavum, raajasthireeyum, pirathaanika'lum, yoothaavilum erusaleamilumu'l'la pirapukka'lum, thachcharum, kollarum erusaleamaivittup pu'rappattuppoana pi'rpaadu,

ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi si'raippattuppoana moopparka'lil meethiyaanavarka'lukkum, aasaariyarka'lukkum, theerkkatharisika'lukkum, neapukaathneachchaar si'raippaduththi erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoana sakala janangka'lukkum ezhuthi,

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaaridaththil kodukkumpadi saappaanin kumaaranaakiya eleyaasaarin kaiyilum, ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya kemariyaavin kaiyilum koduththu, erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukku anuppina nirupaththin viparam:
isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar, thaam erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukkuch si'raippattuppoakappa'n'nina anaivarukkum a'rivikki'rathu ennaven'raal,
neengka'l veeduka'laik katti, kudiyirunthu, thoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'lin kaniyaich saappidungka'l.

neengka'l pe'nka'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'ru, ungka'l kumaararukkup pe'nka'laikko'ndu, ungka'l kumaaraththika'laip purusharukkuk kodungka'l; ivarka'lum kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pe'rattum; neengka'l angkea ku'rukaamal peruki,

naan ungka'laich si'raippattuppoakappa'n'nina patta'naththin samaathaanaththaith theadi, atha'rkaakak karththarai vi'n'nappampa'n'nungka'l; atha'rkuch samaathaanamirukkaiyil ungka'lukkum samaathaanamirukkum.

mealum, ungka'l naduvilirukki'ra ungka'l theerkkatharisika'lum ungka'l ku'rikaararum ungka'lai moasampoakkavottaathirungka'l; soppanam kaa'nappa'n'nuki'ra ungka'l soppanakkaararukkuch sevikodaamalum irungka'l en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'l en naamaththaich solli ungka'lukkup poyyaana theerkkatharisanam uraikki'raarka'l; naan avarka'lai anuppinathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

paapiloanilea ezhupathuvarusham ni'raivea'rinapinpu naan ungka'laich santhiththu, ungka'lai ivvidaththukkuth thirumpivarappa'n'numpadikku ungka'lmeal en nalvaarththaiyai ni'raivea'rappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

neengka'l ethirpaarththirukkum mudivai ungka'lukkuk kodukkumpadikku naan ungka'lpearil ninaiththirukki'ra ninaivuka'lai a'rivean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avaika'l theemaikkalla, samaathaanaththukkeathuvaana ninaivuka'lea.
appozhuthu neengka'l koodivanthu, ennaith thozhuthuko'ndu, ennai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuveerka'l; naan ungka'lukkuch sevikoduppean.
ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ennaith theadineerka'laanaal, ennaith theadukaiyil ka'ndupidippeerka'l.

naan ungka'lukkuk kaa'nappaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan ungka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, naan ungka'laith thuraththivitta ellaa jaathika'lilum ellaa idangka'lilumirunthu ungka'laich searththu, naan ungka'lai vilakkiyiruntha sthalaththukkea ungka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththar engka'lukkup paapiloanilum theerkkatharisika'lai ezhuppinaar en'ru solluki'reerka'l.

aanaal thaaveethin singkaasanaththil udkaarnthirukki'ra raajaavaikku'riththum, ungka'loadeakoodach si'raiyiruppil pu'rappattuppoakaamal intha nakaraththil kudiyirukki'ra ungka'l sakoathararaakiya ellaa janangka'laikku'riththum,

ithoa, naan pattayaththaiyum, pagnchaththaiyum, ko'l'lainoayaiyum avarka'lukku'l anuppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; pusikkaththakaatha kettuppoana aththippazhangka'lukku avarka'lai oppaakkuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l en vaarththaika'laik kea'laama'rpoanapadiyaal, naan avarka'laip pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum ko'l'lainoayaalum pinthodarnthu, avarka'laip poomiyilu'l'la ellaa raajyangka'lilum alainthu thiriki'ravarka'laakavum, naan avarka'laith thuraththuki'ra ellaa jaathika'lidaththilum saapamaakavum, paazhaakavum, eesaliduthalukkidamaakavum, ninthaiyaakavum vaippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan ungka'lidaththi'rkuth theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararai ea'rkanavea anuppikko'ndeayirunthum, neengka'l sevikodaama'rpoaneerka'lea en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ippoathum si'raiyirukkumpadi naan erusaleamilirunthu paapiloanukku anuppivitta neengka'lellaarum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

en naamaththaich solli, ungka'lukkup poyyaana theerkkatharisanam uraikki'ra kolaayaavin kumaaranaakiya aakaapaiyum, maaseyaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaavaiyungku'riththu: ithoa, naan avarka'laip paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarin kaiyilea oppukkodukki'rean; avan avarka'lai ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakak kon'rupoaduvaan.

paapiloan raajaa akkiniyinaal suttuppoatta sitheakkiyaavukkum aakaapukkum karththar unnaich samaanamaakkakkadavaren'ru, avarka'laik ku'riththu oru saapavaarththai paapiloanilea si'raiyirukki'ra yoothaa anaivarukku'l'lum vazhangkum en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l isravealilea mathiketta kaariyaththaich seythu, thangka'l ayalaarudaiya pe'njaathika'loadea vipasaarampa'n'ni, naan avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiyaatha poyyaana vaarththaiyai en naamaththaich solli uraiththaarka'l; naan athai a'rivean; atha'rku naanea saadchi en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru ezhuthinaan.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: nee nekelaamiyanaakiya semaayaavukkum solliyanuppavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

nee erusaleamilirukki'ra ellaa janangka'lukkum, maaseyaavin kumaaranaakiya seppaniyaa ennum aasaariyanukkum, mat'ra aasaariyarka'lukkum un naamaththilea nirupaththai ezhuthiyanuppinathu ennaven'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

ivanukku avan ezhuthiyiruntha nirupamaavathu: neengka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththin visaarippukkaararaayirukkumpadikkum, piramaiko'ndu thannaith theerkkatharisiyaakkikko'l'luki'ravanaakiya entha manushanaiyum neer kaaval a'raiyilum thozhuvilum poadumpadikkum, karththar ummai aasaariyanaayiruntha yoaythaavin sthaanaththilea aasaariyanaaka vaiththaarea.
ippoathum ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanam koo'rivaruki'ra aanathoath ooraanaakiya ereamiyaavai neer kadinthu ko'l'laama'rpoanathenna?

inthach si'raiyiruppu nedungkaalamaaka irukkum; neengka'l veeduka'laikkatti, avaika'lil kudiyirunthu, thoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'lin kanika'laich saappidungka'len'ru paapiloanil irukki'ra engka'lukkuch solliyanuppinaanen'ru ezhuthiyirunthaan.
intha nirupaththaich seppaniyaa enki'ra aasaariyan ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyin kaathuka'l keadka vaasiththaan.
aathalaal, karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:

si'raiyirukki'ra anaivarukkum nee solliyanuppavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: nekelaamiyanaakiya semaayaavaikku'riththu, karththar: semaayaavai naan anuppaathirunthum, avan ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanagnsolli, ungka'laip poyyai nampappa'n'nuki'rapadiyinaal,

ithoa, naan nekelaamiyanaakiya semaayaavaiyum, avan santhathiyaiyum tha'ndippean; intha janaththin naduvilea kudiyiruppavan oruvanum avanukku illaathiruppaan; naan en janaththukkuch seyyum nanmaiyai avan kaa'npathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar; karththarukku viroathamaayk kalakamu'ndaakap peasinaan en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththaraalea ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vaarththai:
isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan unnoadea sonna ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum oru pusthakaththil ezhuthikko'l.

ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu naan isravealum yoothaavumaakiya en janaththinudaiya si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, naan avarka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththukku avarka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean; athai avarka'l suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ivaika'l karththar isravealaiyum yoothaavaiyungku'riththuch sonna vaarththaika'lea.
karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: thaththa'lippin saththaththaik keadki'roam; thikilu'ndu, samaathaanamillai.

aa'naayp pi'ranthavan pirasavikki'rathu'ndoa en'ru keattuppaarungka'l; pirasavikki'ra sthireeyaippoal purushar yaavarum thangka'l iduppuka'linmeal thangka'l kaika'lai vaiththirukki'rathaiyum, mukangka'lellaam maa'ri ve'luththirukki'rathaiyum naan kaa'nki'rathenna?
aiyoa! antha naa'l periyathu; athaippoaloththa naa'lillai; athu yaakkoapukku ikkattukkaalam; aanaalum avan atha'rku neengkalaaki iradchikkappaduvaan.
annaa'lil naan avan nukaththai un kazhuththinmeal iraathapadikku udaiththu, un kattuka'lai a'ruppean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; anniyar ini avanai adimaiko'lvathillai.
thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraiyum, naan thangka'lukku ezhuppappoaki'ra thangka'l raajaavaakiya thaaveethaiyumea seavippaarka'l.

aakaiyaal en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapea, nee payappadaathea; isravealea, kalangkaathea en'ru karththar solluki'raar; ithoa, naan unnaith thooraththilum, un santhathiyaith thangka'l si'raiyiruppin theasaththilum iraathapadikku iradchippean; yaakkoapu thirumpivanthu amarnthu sukiththiruppaan; avanaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nuki'ravanillai.
