unnai iradchippatha'rkaaka naan unnoadea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; unnaich sitha'radiththa ellaa jaathika'laiyum naan nirmoolamaakkuvean; unnaiyoa naan nirmoolamaakkaamalum, mut'rilum tha'ndiyaamal vidaamalum, mattaayth tha'ndippean.
karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: un pu'n aa'raathathaayum un kaayam kodithaayum irukki'rathu.
un kaayangka'laik kattumpadi unakkaaka ea'rpaduvaarillai; unnaich sosthappaduththum aushathangka'lumillai.

un neasar yaavarum unnai ma'ranthaarka'l; avarka'l unnaith theadaarka'l; thira'laana un akkiramaththinimiththamum, un paavangka'l palaththuppoanathinimiththamum, saththuru vettum va'n'namaakavum, kodiyavan tha'ndikki'ra va'n'namaakavum naan unnaith tha'ndiththean.
un no'rungkuthalinaalum un veathanaiyin mikuthiyinaalum nee kookkuraliduvaanean? thira'laana un akkiramaththinimiththamum palaththuppoana un paavangka'linimiththamum ippadi unakkuch seythean.

aathalaal unnaip padchikki'ravarka'l yaavarum padchikkappaduvaarka'l; un saththurukka'lellaarum si'raippattuppoavaarka'l; unnaich soo'raiyaaduki'ravarka'l soo'raiyaadappaduvaarka'l; unnaik ko'l'laiyiduki'ra anaivaraiyum ko'l'laikku oppukkoduppean.

avarka'l: unnai visaarippaarat'ra seeyoan en'ru solli, unakkuth tha'l'lu'ndava'l en'ru pearittapadiyaal, naan unakku aaroakkiyam varappa'n'ni, un kaayangka'lai aat'ruvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan yaakkoapudaiya koodaarangka'lin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, avan vaasasthalangka'lukku irakkagnseyvean; nakaram than ma'nmeattinmeal kattappattu, aramanai munpoala nilaippadum.

avaika'lilirunthu sthoaththiramum aadalpaadalin saththamum pu'rappadum; avarka'lai varththikkappa'n'nuvean, avarka'l ku'rukippoavathillai; avarka'lai makimaippaduththuvean, avarka'l si'rumaippaduvathillai.
avarka'l pi'l'laika'l munpoaliruppaarka'l; avarka'l sapai enakku munpaakath thidappadum; avarka'lai odukkina yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean.

avarka'ludaiya pirapu avarka'lil oruvanaayirukka, avarka'ludaiya athipathi avarka'l naduvilirunthu thoan'ruvaar; avaraich sameepiththu varappa'n'nuvean, avar sameepiththu varuvaar, ennidaththil searumpadi than iruthayaththaip pi'naippaduththuki'ra ivar yaar? en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l en janamaayiruppeerka'l, naan ungka'l theavanaayiruppean.
ithoa, koaraavaarik kaat'raakiya karththarudaiya perungkaat'ru ukkiramaayezhumpi, adiththu, thunmaarkkarudaiya thalaiyinmeal moathum.
karththar thammudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuka'lai nadappiththu ni'raiveat'ruma'lavum, avarudaiya ukkirakoapam tha'niyaathu; kadaisinaadka'lil athai u'narnthuko'lveerka'l.
akkaalaththilea naan isravealin vamsangka'lukkellaam theavanaayiruppean, avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
pattayaththi'rkuth thappi, meentha janam vanaantharaththil irakkam pet'rathu; isravealukku i'laippaa'ruthalaik katta'laiyidappoaki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
poorvakaalamuthal karththar enakkuth tharisanaiyaanaar enpaay; aam anaathi sineakaththaal unnaich sineakiththean; aathalaal kaaru'niyaththaal unnai izhuththukko'l'luki'rean.

israveal ennum kannikaiyea, ma'rupadiyum unnaik kattuvippean, nee kattappaduvaay; ma'rupadiyum nee mea'lavaaththiyaththoadum aadalpaadal seyki'ravarka'lin ka'lippu'l'la koottaththoadum pu'rappaduvaay.
ma'rupadiyum samaariyaavin malaika'lilea thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattuvaay; naattuki'ravarka'l avaika'lai naatti, athin palanai anupavippaarka'l.
ezhunthirungka'l, seeyoanil nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththaridaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'ru eppiraayeemin malaika'lilu'l'la jaamakkaarar koo'rungkaalam varum.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: yaakkoapinimiththam makizhchchiyaayk kempeeriththu, jaathika'ludaiya thalaivarinimiththam aarppariyungka'l; saththaththaik keadkappa'n'ni, thuthiththu: karththaavea, isravealil meethiyaana umathu janaththai iradchiyum en'ru sollungka'l.

ithoa, naan avarka'lai vadatheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ni, avarka'laip poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu koottivaruvean; kurudarum, sappaa'nika'lum, karppavathika'lum, pi'l'laiththaaychchika'lungkooda avarka'lil iruppaarka'l; makaa koottamaay ivvidaththukkuth thirumpuvaarka'l.

azhukaiyoadum vi'n'nappangka'loadum varuvaarka'l; avarka'lai vazhinadaththuvean; avarka'laith tha'n'neeru'l'la nathika'la'ndaikku ida'raatha semmaiyaana vazhiyilea nadakkappa'n'nuvean; isravealukku naan pithaavaayirukki'rean, eppiraayeem en seashdapuththiranaayirukki'raan.

jaathika'lea, neengka'l karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik keattu, thooraththilu'l'la theevuka'lil a'riviththu, isravealaich sitha'radiththavar athaich searththukko'ndu, oru meayppan than manthaiyaik kaakkumva'n'namaaka athaik kaappaar en'ru sollungka'l.
karththar yaakkoapai meettu, avanilum palaththavanudaiya kaikku avanai neengkalaakki viduvikki'raar.

avarka'l vanthu, seeyoanin uchchiyilea kempeeriththu, karththar aru'lum koathumai, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney, aattukkuttika'l, kan'rukkuttika'l enpavaika'laakiya intha nanmaika'lukkaaka oadivaruvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya aaththumaa neerppaaychchalaana thoattampoalirukkum; avarka'l inith thoynthupoavathillai.

appozhuthu kannikaika'lum, vaaliparum, muthiyoarungkooda aananthakka'lippaay makizhuvaarka'l; naan avarka'l thukkaththaich santhoashamaaka maat'ri, avarka'laith theat'ri, avarka'l sagnchalam neengka avarka'laich santhoashappaduththuvean.
aasaariyarka'lin aaththumaavaik kozhumaiyaanavaika'linaal poorippaakkuvean; en janangka'l naan a'likkum nanmaiyinaal thirupthiyaavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

raamaavilea pulampalum kasappaana azhukaiyumaakiya kookkural keadkappattathu; raakeal than pi'l'laika'lukkaaka azhuthu, than pi'l'laika'l illaathapadiyaal avaika'linimiththam aa'ruthal adaiyaathirukki'raa'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

nee azhaathapadikku un saththaththai adakki, nee ka'n'neer vidaathapadikku un ka'nka'laik kaaththukko'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; un kiriyaikkup palanu'nden'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'l saththuruvin theasaththilirunthu thirumpivaruvaarka'l.
un mudivaippat'ri unakku nampikkaiyu'ndu; un pi'l'laika'l thangka'l theasaththukkuth thirumpivaruvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
neer ennaith tha'ndiththeer, naan pa'niyaatha maadupoal adikkappattean; ennaith thiruppum, appozhuthu thiruppappaduvean; neerea en theavanaakiya karththar.

naan thirumpinapinpu manasthaapappattukko'ndirukki'rean, naan ennai a'rinthuko'ndatha'rkup pinpu vilaavil adiththukko'ndirukki'rean, vedki naa'nikko'ndumirukki'rean, en i'lavayathin ninthaiyaich sumanthuvaruki'rean en'ru eppiraayeem thukkiththup pulampikko'ndirukki'rathai nichchayamaayk keattean.

eppiraayeem enakku arumaiyaana kumaaran allavoa? avan enakkup piriyamaana pi'l'laiyallavoa? avanukku viroathamaayp peasinathumuthal avanai ninaiththukko'ndea irukki'rean; aakaiyaal en u'l'lam avanukkaakak kothikki'rathu; avanukku urukkamaay irangkuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

unakkuk ku'rippadaiyaa'langka'lai ni'ruththu; unakkuth thoo'nka'lai naattu; nee nadantha vazhiyaakiya paathaiyinmeal un manathai vai; isravealaakiya kumaaraththiyea, thirumpu; intha unnudaiya patta'nangka'lukkea thirumpu.
seerkettuppoana kumaaraththiyea, enthamattum vilakith thirivaay? karththar poomiyilea oru puthumaiyaich sirushdippaar, sthireeyaanava'l purushanaich soozhnthuko'l'luvaa'l.

isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan avarka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, avarka'l: neethiyin vaasasthalamea, parisuththa parvathamea, karththar unnai aaseervathikkakkadavarenki'ra vaarththaiyai yoothaavin theasaththilum athin patta'nangka'lilum solluvaarka'l.
athilea yoothaavum, athanudaiya ellaap patta'nangka'lin manusharum payiridung kudika'lum, manthaika'lai meayththuth thiriki'ravarka'lum eakamaayk kudiyiruppaarka'l.
naan vidaayththa aaththumaavaich sampoora'namadaiyappa'n'ni, thoyntha ellaa aaththumaavaiyum nirappuvean.
itha'rkaaka naan vizhiththuppaarththukko'ndirukki'rean; en niththirai enakku inpamaayirunthathu.
ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu israveal kudumpaththaiyum yoothaa kudumpaththaiyum manushaviththinaalum, mirukaviththinaalum vithaippean.

appozhuthu naan pidungkavum idikkavum nirmoolamaakkavum azhikkavum theengkuseyyavum avarka'lpearil eppadi jaakkirathaiyaayiruntheanoa, appadiyea kattavum naattavum avarka'lpearil jaakkirathaiyaayiruppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
pithaakka'l thiraadchakkaayka'laith thin'raarka'l, pi'l'laika'lin pa'rka'l koosippoayina en'ru annaadka'lil sollamaattaarka'l.
avanavan thanthan akkiramaththinimiththamea saavaan; entha manushan thiraadchakkaayka'laith thinpaanoa avanudaiya pa'rka'lea koosippoakum.
ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu israveal kudumpaththoadum yoothaa kudumpaththoadum puthu udanpadikkai pa'n'nuvean.

naan avarka'l pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththuvarak kaippidiththa naa'lilea avarka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyinpadi alla; eanenil naan avarka'lukku naayakaraayirunthum, antha en udanpadikkaiyai avarka'l mee'ri avamaakkippoattaarka'lea en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

annaadka'lukkuppi'rpaadu, naan israveal kudumpaththoadea pa'n'nappoaki'ra udanpadikkaiyaavathu; naan en niyaayappiramaa'naththai avarka'l u'l'laththilea vaiththu, athai avarka'l iruthayaththilea ezhuthi, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean, avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ini oruvan than ayalaanaiyum, oruvan than sakoatharanaiyum noakki: karththarai a'rinthuko'l en'ru poathippathillai; avarka'lil si'riyavanmuthal periyavanmattum, ellaarum ennai a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan avarka'l akkiramaththai manniththu, avarka'l paavangka'lai ini ninaiyaathiruppean.

sooriyanaip pakal ve'lichchaththukkaakavum santhiranadchaththira niyamangka'lai iraave'lichchaththukkaakavum katta'laiyittavarum, alaika'l kontha'likkaththakkathaakach samuththiraththaik kulukkuki'ravarum, seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'lavarumaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:
intha niyamangka'l enakku munpaaka illaathapadikku ozhinthupoanaal, appozhuthu israveal santhathiyum enakku munpaaka en'raikkum oru jaathiyaayiraathapadikku at'ruppoam en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: mealea irukki'ra vaanangka'l a'lakkappadavum, keezhea irukki'ra poomiyin asthipaarangka'l aaraayappadavum koodumaanaal, naan israveal vamsaththaar anaivaraiyum avarka'l seytha ellaavat'rinimiththamum ve'ruththuviduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar; appozhuthu intha nakaram, anaaneyealin koapuramuthal koadivaasalmattum karththarukken'ru kattappadum.
appu'ramum a'lavunool atha'rku ethiraayk kaareap ennum meattinmeal sen'ru koavaathpu'ramaaka sut'rippoam.

pireathangka'laip puthaikki'rathum, saampalaik kottuki'rathumaana pa'l'laththaakkanaiththum, keetharoan vaaykkaalukku ippaalea kizhakkea irukki'ra kuthiraivaasalin koadimattum u'ndaana sakala nilangka'lum karththarukkup parisuththamaayirukkum; appu'ram athu en'ren'raikkum pidungkappaduvathumillai idikkappaduvathumillai enki'raar.
neapukaathneachchaarin pathinettaam varushaththukkuch sariyaana yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa arasaa'nda paththaam varushaththil, karththaraal ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vaarththai:
appozhuthu paapiloan raajaavin seanai erusaleamai mut'rikkai poattirunthathu; ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyoa, yoothaa raajaavin aramanaiyilu'l'la kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilea adaikkappattirunthaan.
eanen'raal, ithoa, intha nakaraththaip paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukki'rean; avan ithaippidippaan en'ru karththar solluki'raaren'rum,

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa kaltheayarudaiya kaikkuth thappippoakaamal, paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil nichchayamaaka oppukkodukkappaduvaan; avan vaay ivan vaayoadea peasum, avan ka'nka'l ivan ka'nka'laik kaa'num.

avan sitheakkiyaavaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoavaan; naan avanaich santhikkumattum angkea avan iruppaan; neengka'l kaltheayaroadea yuththampa'n'ninaalum ungka'lukku vaayppathillai en'ru karththar solluki'raaren'rum, nee theerkkatharisanagnsollavea'ndiyathu enna en'ru solli, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa angkea avanai adaiththuvaiththaan.
atha'rku ereamiyaa sonnathu: karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

ithoa, un periya thakappanaakiya salloomin kumaaran anaameyeal unnidaththil vanthu: aanathoaththilirukki'ra en nilaththai nee vaangkikko'l; athaik ko'l'luki'ratha'rku unakkea meedkum athikaaram aduththathen'ru solvaan en'ru uraiththaar.

appadiyea en periyathakappan makanaakiya anaameyeal, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththil ennidaththukku vanthu: penyameen naattu aanathoaththoorilu'l'la en nilaththai neer vaangkikko'l'lum; suthantharapaaththiyam umakku'ndu, athai meedkum athikaaram umakku aduththathu; athai vaangkikko'l'lum en'raan; appozhuthu athu karththarudaiya vaarththai en'ru a'rinthuko'ndean.

aakaiyaal en periyathakappan makanaakiya anaameyealin kaiyil, naan aanathoaththilirukki'ra avanudaiya nilaththaikko'ndu, athin vilaikkirayamaakiya pathineazhu seakkalidai ve'l'liyai avanukku ni'ruththukkoduththean.
naan paththiraththil kaiyezhuththaiyum, muththiraiyaiyum poattu, saadchika'lai vaiththu, ve'l'liyaith tharaasilea ni'ruththukkoduththapinpu,
naan sattaththukkum vazhakkaththukkum eat'rapadi muththiraipoadappatta kirayappaththiraththaiyum thi'ranthirukki'ra pirathiyaiyum eduththu,

en periyathakappan makanaakiya anaameyealudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum, kirayappaththiraththil kaiyezhuththuppoatta saadchika'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum, kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththil udkaarnthiruntha ellaa yootharudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum, athai maaseyaavin kumaaranaakiya neariyaavin makanaana paarukkinidaththil koduththu,
avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakap paarukkai noakki:

isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, nee muththiraipoadappatta kirayappaththiramum, thi'ranthirukki'ra pirathipaththiramumaakiya inthach saasanangka'lai vaangki, avaika'l aneakanaa'lirukkumpadikku avaika'lai oru ma'npaa'ndaththilea vai.
eanenil ini inthath theasaththil veeduka'lum nilangka'lum thiraadchaththoattangka'lum ko'l'lappadumen'ru, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'rean.
naan kirayappaththiraththai neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukkinidaththil koduththapinpu, naan karththarai noakkip pa'n'nina vi'n'nappamaavathu:

aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ithoa, theavareer ummudaiya makaa palaththinaalum, neettappatta ummudaiya puyaththinaalum, vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkineer; ummaalea seyyakkoodaatha athisayamaana kaariyam on'rumillai.

aayiram thalaimu'raika'lukkum kirupai seyki'ravarum, pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramaththai avarka'ludaiya pinnadiyaar pi'l'laika'lin madiyilea sarikkattuki'ravarumaakiya seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'la makaththuvamum vallamaiyumu'l'la theavanea,

yoasanaiyilea periyavarum, seyalilea vallavarumaayirukki'reer; avanavanukku avanavanudaiya vazhikkuththakkathaakavum, avanavanudaiya kiriyaika'lin palanukkuththakkathaakavum a'likkumpadi, ummudaiya ka'nka'l manupuththirarudaiya ellaa vazhika'linmealum noakkamaayirukkin'rana.

isravealilum mat'ra manusharukku'l'lum innaa'lvaraikkum vi'langkuki'ra adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum theavareer ekipthutheasaththilea seythu, innaa'lil ni'rkum keerththiyai umakku u'ndaakki,

isravealaakiya umathu janaththai adaiyaa'langka'linaalum, a'rputhangka'linaalum, palaththa kaiyinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum, makaa payangkaraththinaalum ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni,
avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lukku neer koduppean en'ru aa'naiyitta paalum theanum oadiya theasamaayirukki'ra inthath theasaththai avarka'lukkuk koduththeer.

avarka'l atha'rku'l piraveasiththu, athaich suthanthariththukko'ndaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l umathu saththaththukkuch sevikodaamalum, umathu niyaayappiramaa'naththil nadavaamalum, seyyumpadi neer avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththathon'raiyum seyyaamalum poanaarka'l; aathalaal inthath theengkaiyellaam avarka'lukku nearidappa'n'nineer.

ithoa, koththa'langka'l poadappattirukki'rathu; nakaraththaip pidikkavaruki'raarka'l; pattayaththinimiththamum, pagnchaththinimiththamum, ko'l'lainoayinimiththamum intha nakaram atha'rku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuki'ra kaltheayarin kaiyilea kodukkappaduki'rathu; neer sonnapadi sampavikki'rathu; ithoa, neer athaip paarkki'reer.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, nakaram kaltheayarin kaiyilea kodukkappaduki'rathaayirunthum, theavareer ennai noakki: nee unakku oru nilaththai vilaikkirayamaakakko'ndu, atha'rkuch saadchika'lai vaiyen'ru sonneerea en'rean.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:
ithoa, naan maamsamaana yaavarukkum theavanaakiya karththar; ennaalea seyyakkoodaatha athisayamaana kaariyam on'ru'ndoa?
aathalaal, ithoa, naan intha nakaraththaik kaltheayarin kaiyilum, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarin kaiyilum oppukkodukki'rean, avan ithaip pidippaan en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

intha nakaraththukku viroathamaay yuththampa'n'nuki'ra kaltheayar udpiraveasiththu, intha nakaraththaith theekko'luththi, ithaich sutterippaarka'l; enakkuk koapamu'ndaakkumpadi entha veeduka'linmeal paakaalukkuth thoopangkaatti, anniya theavarka'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarththaarka'loa, antha veeduka'laiyum sutterippaarka'l.

israveal puththirarum yoothaa puththirarum thangka'l si'ruvayathumuthal en paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaiyea seythuvanthaarka'l; israveal puththirar thangka'l kaika'lin seykaiyinaalea enakkuk koapaththaiyea u'ndaakki vanthaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l intha nakaraththaik kattina naa'l mutha'rko'ndu, innaa'lvaraikkum athu enakkuk koapamu'ndaakavum, enakku ukkiramu'ndaakavum, naan athai en mukaththai vittu akat'ruki'ratha'rku eathuvaakavum irunthathu.

enakkuk koapamu'ndaakumpadikku israveal puththirarum, yoothaa puththirarum, avarka'l raajaakka'lum, avarka'l pirapukka'lum, avarka'l aasaariyarka'lum, avarka'l theerkkatharisika'lum, yoothaavin manusharum, erusaleamin kudika'lum seytha ellaap pollaappinimiththamum ippadi nadakkum.
mukaththaiyalla, muthukai enakkuk kaattinaarka'l; naan ea'rkanavea avarka'lukku upatheasiththum avarka'l puththiyai eat'rukko'l'lach sevikodaama'rpoanaarka'l.
avarka'l en naamam tharikkappatta aalayaththaith theettuppaduththumpadikku, thangka'l aruvaruppuka'lai athilea vaiththaarka'l.

avarka'l moa'leakukken'ru thangka'l kumaararaiyum thangka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum theekkadakkappa'n'numpadi innoamudaiya kumaaranin pa'l'laththaakkilirukki'ra paakaalin meadaika'laik kattinaarka'l; yoothaavaip paavagnseyyappa'n'nuvatha'rku avarka'l intha aruvaruppaana kaariyaththaich seyyavea'ndumen'ru naan avarka'lukkuk ka'rpiththathumillai, athu en manathilea thoan'rinathumillai.

ippadiyirukkaiyil pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum, paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappattuppoam en'ru neengka'l solluki'ra intha nakaraththaikku'riththu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:

ithoa, en sinaththilum, en koapaththilum, en makaa ukkiraththilum, naan avarka'laith thuraththina ellaath theasangka'lilumirunthu avarka'laich searththukko'ndu, avarka'lai intha sthalaththukkuth thirumpivaravum ithilea sukamaayth thangkiyirukkavum pa'n'nuvean.
avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean.

avarka'l thangka'lukkum, thangka'l pinnadiyaarukkum, thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum nanmaiyu'ndaakumpadi sakala naadka'lilum enakkup payappadumpadikku, naan avarka'lukku orea iruthayaththaiyum orea vazhiyaiyum katta'laiyittu,

avarka'lukku nanmaiseyyumpadi, naan avarka'lai vittup pinvaangkuvathillaiyenki'ra niththiya udanpadikkaiyai avarka'loadea pa'n'ni, avarka'l ennaivittu akan'ru poakaathapadikku, enakkup payappadum payaththai avarka'l iruthayaththilea vaiththu,
avarka'lukku nanmaiseyyumpadi avarka'lmeal santhoashamaayirunthu, en muzhu iruthayaththoadum en muzhu aaththumaavoadum avarka'lai inthath theasaththilea nichchayamaay naattuvean.
naan intha janaththinmeal inthap periya theengkaiyellaam varappa'n'ninathupoala, avarka'laikku'riththuch sonna ellaa nanmaiyaiyum avarka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
manushanum mirukamum illaathapadikkup paazhaayppoayit'ru en'rum, kaltheayarin kaiyilea oppukkodukkappattuppoayit'ru en'rum, neengka'l solluki'ra inthath theasaththilea nilangka'l ko'l'lappadum.

penyameen theasaththilum, erusaleamin sut'ruppu'rangka'lilum, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum, malaikkaadaana patta'nangka'lilum, pa'l'laththaakkaana patta'nangka'lilum, thenthisaip patta'nangka'lilum, nilangka'l vilaikkirayamaakak ko'l'lappaduki'ra paththirangka'lil kaiyezhuththup poaduki'rathum muththiraiyiduki'rathum atha'rkuch saadchi vaikki'rathum u'ndaayirukkum; avarka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
ereamiyaa innum kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilea adaikkappattirukkaiyil, karththarudaiya vaarththai ira'ndaantharam avanukku u'ndaaki, avar:
ithaich seyki'ra karththarumaay, ithaith thidappaduththumpadikku ithai uruvea'rpaduththuki'ra karththarumaayirukki'ra yeakoavaa ennum naamamu'l'lavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:
ennai noakkik kooppidu, appozhuthu naan unakku uththaravukoduththu, nee a'riyaathathum unakku ettaathathumaana periya kaariyangka'lai unakku a'rivippean.
ethirkkoththa'langka'linaalum pattayaththaalum idikkappattavaika'laakiya intha nakaraththin veeduka'laiyum, yoothaa raajaakka'lin veeduka'laiyungku'riththu:

intha nakaraththin ellaap pollaappinimiththamum naan en mukaththai ma'raiththapadiyinaalea en koapaththilum ukkiraththilum vettu'nda manushap pireathangka'linaalea avaika'lai naan nirappumpadiyaakavea, avarka'l kaltheayaroadea yuththampa'n'nappoaki'raarka'l.
ithoa, naan avarka'lukkuch savukkiyamum aaroakkiyamum varappa'n'ni, avarka'laik ku'namaakki, avarka'lukkup paripoora'na samaathaanaththaiyum saththiyaththaiyum ve'lippaduththuvean.
naan yoothaavin si'raiyiruppaiyum, isravealin si'raiyiruppaiyum thiruppi, munnirunthathupoala avarka'laik kattuviththu,

avarka'l enakku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseytha avarka'ludaiya ellaa akkiramangka'lukkum avarka'lai neengkalaakkich suththikariththu, avarka'l enakku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseythu, enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'nina avarka'ludaiya ellaa akkiramangka'laiyum mannippean.

naan avarka'lukkuch seyyum nanmaiyaiyellaam keadkappoaki'ra poomiyin ellaa jaathika'lukkumunpaaka athu enakku makizhchchiyu'l'la keerththiyaayum pukazhchchiyaayum makimaiyaayum irukkum; naan avarka'lukku aru'lichseyyum ellaa nanmaiyinimiththamum, ellaach samaathaanaththinimiththamum ivarka'l payanthu nadungkuvaarka'l en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.

manushanillaamalum mirukamillaamalum avaantharave'liyaayk kidakki'rathen'ru, neengka'l solluki'ra ivvidaththilum, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum manushanaavathu mirukamaavathu illaatha paazhaana erusaleamin veethika'lilum,

innum ka'lippin saththamum, makizhchchiyin saththamum, ma'navaa'lanin saththamum, ma'navaattiyin saththamum: seanaika'lin karththaraith thuthiyungka'l, karththar nallavar, avar kirupai en'rumu'l'lathen'ru solluki'ravarka'lin saththamum, karththarudaiya aalayaththukku sthoaththirapalika'laik ko'nduvaruki'ravarka'lin saththamum keadkappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'l munnirunthathupoalirukkumpadi theasaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

manushanum mirukamum illaamal avaantharave'liyaayk kidakki'ra ivvidaththilum, itha'rkaduththa patta'nangka'lilum, aattumanthaiyai meayththu madakkuki'ra meaypparka'lin thaaparangka'l u'ndaayirukkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

malaiththeasamaana patta'nangka'lilum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'laana patta'nangka'lilum, thenthisaip patta'nangka'lilum penyameen naattilum, erusaleamin sut'ruppu'rangka'lilum, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum, aattumanthaika'l thangka'laith thokaiyiduki'ravanudaiya kaikku'l'laakak kadanthuvarum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu naan isravealin kudumpaththukkum, yoothaavin kudumpaththukkum sonna nalvaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'ruvean.
annaadka'lilum, akkaalaththilum thaaveethukku neethiyin ki'laiyai mu'laikkappa'n'nuvean; avar poomiyilea niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum nadappippaar.
annaadka'lil yoothaa iradchikkappattu, erusaleam sukamaayth thangkum; avar engka'l neethiyaayirukki'ra karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
israveal vamsaththin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaaraththakka purushan thaaveethukku illaama'rpoavathillai.
thakanapaliyittu, poajanapaliseluththi, naa'lthoa'rum paliyidum purushan enakku munpaaka aasaariyarukkum leaviyarukkum illaama'rpoavathumillai en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
pinnum ereamiyaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:

ku'riththa nearangka'lil paka'rkaalamum iraakkaalamum u'ndaakaathapadikku, neengka'l paka'rkaalaththaikku'riththu naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum, iraakkaalaththaikku'riththu naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum avamaakkinaal,

appozhuthu en thaasanaakiya thaaveethoadea naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyum, avan singkaasanaththil arasaa'lum kumaaran avanukku illaama'rpoakumpadiyaaka avamaakum; en oozhiyakkaararaakiya leaviyaroadum aasaariyaroadum naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyum appozhuthu avamaakum.

vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'l e'n'nappadaathathum kada'rkarai ma'nal a'lakkappadaathathumaayirukki'rathupoala, naan en thaasanaakiya thaaveethin santhathiyaiyum enakku oozhiyagnseyki'ra leaviyaraiyum varththikkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
pinnum ereamiyaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:

karththar therinthuko'nda ira'ndu vamsangka'laiyum ve'ruththuppoattaaren'ru intha janam solli, thangka'lukku munpaaka en janam ini oru jaathiyallaven'ru athaith thooshikki'raarka'lenpathai nee kaa'nki'rathillaiyoa?
vaanaththukkum poomikkum ku'riththirukki'ra niyamangka'lai naan kaavaamal, paka'rkaalaththaiyum iraakkaalaththaiyungku'riththu naan pa'n'nina udanpadikkai at'ruppoaki'rathu u'ndaanaal,

appozhuthu naan yaakkoapin santhathiyaiyum, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethin santhathiyaiyum tha'l'li, naan aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'lin santhathiyai aa'laththakkavarka'lai athilirunthu edukkaathapadikku ve'ruththuppoaduvean; avarka'ludaiya si'raiyiruppai naan thiruppi, avarka'lukku irangkuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarum avanudaiya sarvaseanaiyum, avan aa'lukaikkudpatta poomiyin sakala raajyangka'lum, sakala janangka'lum erusaleamukkum athaich searntha sakala patta'nangka'lukkum viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nukaiyil ereamiyaavukkuk karththaraal u'ndaana vaarththai:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee poay, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavinidaththil peasi, avanukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu: ithoa, naan intha nakaraththaip paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukki'rean; avan ithai akkiniyaal sutterippaan.

nee avan kaikkuth thappippoakaamal, nichchayamaayp pidipattu, avan kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvaay; un ka'nka'l paapiloan raajaavin ka'nka'laik kaa'num; avan vaay un vaayoadea peasum; nee paapiloanukkup poavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aakilum yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l; unnaikku'riththuk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee pattayaththaalea saavathillai.

samaathaanaththoadea saavaay; unakku munniruntha raajaakka'laakiya un pithaakka'linimiththam kanthavarkkangka'laik ko'luththinathupoala unnimiththamum ko'luththi, aiyoa! aa'ndavanea, en'ru solli, unakkaakap pulampuvaarka'l; ithu naan sonna vaarththaiyen'ru karththar uraiththaar en'ru sol en'raar.
intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaa erusaleamilea yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavinidaththil sonnaan.

appozhuthu paapiloan raajaavin seanaika'l erusaleamukku viroathamaakavum, yoothaavin ellaap patta'nangka'lilum meentha patta'nangka'laakiya laakeesukkum, asekkaavukkum viroathamaakavum yuththampa'n'nikko'ndirunthathu; yoothaavin ara'nippaana patta'nangka'lil ivaika'lea meenthirunthavaika'l.

oruvanum yoothajaathiyaanaakiya than sakoatharanai adimaiko'l'laathapadikku, avanavan epireyanaakiya than vealaikkaaranaiyum, epireya sthireeyaakiya than vealaikkaariyaiyum suyaatheenaraaka anuppividavea'ndumen'ru avarka'lukku viduthalaiyaik koo'rumpadi,
raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa erusaleamil irukki'ra ellaa janaththoadum udanpadikkai pa'n'ninapinpu, ereamiyaavukkuk karththaraal vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru.

ovvoruvanum than vealaikkaaranaiyum than vealaikkaariyaiyum ini adimaiko'l'laathapadikku, suyaatheenaraaka anuppividavea'ndumen'ru udanpadikkaikku udpatta ellaap pirapukka'lum ellaa janangka'lum keattapoathu, sevikoduththu avarka'lai anuppivittaarka'l.

aanaalum atha'rkuppinpu avarka'l maa'raattampa'n'ni, thaangka'l suyaatheenaraaka anuppivitta vealaikkaararaiyum vealaikkaarika'laiyum ma'rupadiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'lai vealaikkaararum vealaikkaarika'lumaayirukkumpadi adimaippaduththikko'ndaarka'l.
aathalaal, karththaraalea ereamiyaavukku vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, avanavan thanakku vi'rkappatta epireyanaakiya than sakoatharanai mudivilea neengka'l eazhaam varushaththilea anuppividavea'ndum en'rum, avan unakku aa'ruvarusham adimaiyaayirunthapinpu, avanai unnidaththil vaikkaamal suyaatheenanaaka anuppividavea'ndum en'rum,

naan ungka'l pithaakka'lai adimai veedaakiya ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lilea avarka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ninean; aanaalum ungka'l pithaakka'l en sollaik kea'laamalum, thangka'l seviyaich saayaamalum poanaarka'l.

neengka'loa, innaa'lilea mananthirumpi, avanavan than ayalaanukku viduthalaiyaik koo'rina vishayaththilea en paarvaikkuch semmaiyaanathaich seythu, en naamam tharikkappatta aalayaththilea itha'rkaaka en mukaththukkumun udanpadikkaipa'n'niyiruntheerka'l.

aanaalum neengka'l maa'raattampa'n'ni, en naamaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, neengka'l avanavan viduthalaiyaakavum suyaatheenaraakavum anuppivitta than vealaikkaaranaiyum than vealaikkaariyaiyum thirumpa azhaiththuvanthu, avarka'lai ungka'lukku vealaikkaararum vealaikkaarika'lumaayirukkumpadi adimaippaduththineerka'l.

aakaiyaal karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l avanavan than sakoatharanukkum avanavan than ayalaanukkum viduthalaiyaik koo'rinavishayaththil en sollaik kea'laama'rpoaneerka'lea; ithoa, naan ungka'laip pattayaththukkum, ko'l'lainoaykkum, pagnchaththukkum oppukkodukki'ra viduthalaiyai ungka'lukkuk koo'ruki'rean; poomiyin raajyangka'lilellaam alaiki'ratha'rkum ungka'lai oppukkoduppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en mukaththukkumun pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyin vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'raamal, en udanpadikkaiyai mee'rina manusharai naan thu'ndangka'lin naduvaakak kadanthupoakumpadi avarka'lai ira'ndaakath thu'ndiththa kan'rukkuttiyaippoal aakkuvean.

kan'rukkuttiyin thu'nduka'lin naduvea kadanthupoana yoothaavin pirapukka'laiyum, erusaleamin pirapukka'laiyum, pirathaanika'laiyum, aasaariyarka'laiyum, theasaththin sakala janangka'laiyum appadich seythu,

naan avarka'lai avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaiyilum, avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum oppukkoduppean; avarka'ludaiya pireatham aakaayaththin pa'ravaika'lukkum poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum iraiyaakum.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavaiyum avanudaiya pirapukka'laiyum avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaiyilum; avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum, ungka'laivittup pearnthupoana paapiloan raajaavinudaiya seanaika'lin kaiyilum oppukkoduppean.

ithoa, naan katta'laikoduththu, avarka'lai intha nakaraththukkuth thirumpappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l atha'rku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththu, athai akkiniyaal sutterippaarka'l; yoothaavin patta'nangka'laiyum, oruvarum avaika'lil kudiyiraathapadip paazhaayppoakappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem ennum yoothaa raajaavin naadka'lil ereamiyaavukkuk karththaraal u'ndaana vaarththai:
nee reakaapiyarudaiya veettukkup poay, avarka'loadea peasi, avarka'laik karththarudaiya aalayaththin a'raika'lil on'rilea azhaiththuvanthu, avarka'lukkuth thiraadcharasam kudikkakkodu en'raar.

appozhuthu naan apasiniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ereamiyaavukku makanaana yasiniyaavaiyum, avanudaiya sakoathararaiyum, avanudaiya kumaarar ellaaraiyum, reakaapiyarudaiya kudumpaththaar anaivaraiyum azhaiththu;

karththarudaiya aalayaththilea pirapukka'ludaiya a'raiyin arukeayum, vaasalaikkaakki'ra salloomin kumaaranaakiya maaseyaavinudaiya a'raiyinmealumu'l'la iththaliyaavin kumaaranum theavanudaiya manushanumaakiya aanaan ennum puththirarudaiya a'raiyilea avarka'laik koottikko'nduvanthu,

thiraadcharasaththinaal nirappappatta kudangka'laiyum ki'n'nangka'laiyum reakaapiyarudaiya kudumpaththaich searntha puththirarin munnea vaiththu, avarka'lai noakki: thiraadcharasam kudiyungka'l en'rean.

atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l thiraadcharasam kudikki'rathillai; eanen'raal, reakaapin kumaaranaakiya engka'ludaiya thakappan yoanathaap, neengka'l paratheasika'laayth thangkuki'ra theasaththil neediththirukkumpadikku,

neengka'lum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lum en'ren'raikkum thiraadcharasam kudiyaamalum, veettaik kattaamalum, vithaiyai vithaiyaamalum, thiraadchaththoattaththai naattaamalum, athaik kaiyaa'laamalum, ungka'ludaiya ellaa naadka'lilum koodaarangka'lilea kudiyiruppeerka'laaka en'ru engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
appadiyea engka'ludaiya ellaa naadka'lilum naangka'lum engka'l sthireeka'lum engka'l kumaararum engka'l kumaaraththika'lum thiraadcharasam kudiyaamalum,

naangka'l kudiyirukka veeduka'laikkattaamalum, reakaapin kumaaranaakiya engka'ludaiya thakappan yoanathaapin saththaththukkuk keezhppadinthirukki'roam; engka'lukkuth thiraadchaththoattamum vayalum vithaippaadumillai.
naangka'l koodaarangka'lil kudiyirunthu, engka'l thakappanaakiya yoanathaap engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam keezhppadinthu seythuvanthoam.

aanaalum paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar inthath theasaththil vanthapoathu, naam kaltheayarudaiya iraa'nuvaththukkum seeriyarudaiya iraa'nuvaththukkum thappumpadi erusaleamukkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'ru sonnoam; appadiyea erusaleamil thangkiyirukki'roam en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:

isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, nee poay, yoothaavin manusharaiyum erusaleamin kudika'laiyum noakki: neengka'l en vaarththaika'laik keattu, puththiyai eat'rukko'l'luki'rathillaiyoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

thiraadcharasam kudiyaathapadikku, reakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaap than puththirarukkuk katta'laiyitta vaarththaika'l kaikko'l'lappattuvaruki'rathu; avarka'l innaa'lmattum athaik kudiyaamal, thangka'l thakappanudaiya katta'laikkuk keezhppadiki'raarka'l; aanaalum naan ungka'lukku ea'rkanavea sollikko'ndeayirunthum, enakkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoaneerka'l.

neengka'l anniya theavarka'laich seavikkumpadi avarka'laip pinpat'raamal, avanavan than pollaatha vazhiyai vittuth thirumpi, ungka'l nadakkaiyaich seerthiruththungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkum ungka'l pithaakka'lukkum naan koduththa theasaththilea kudiyiruppeerka'l en'ru solli, theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararaiyellaam naan ungka'lidaththukku ea'rkanavea anuppikko'ndirunthum, neengka'l ungka'l seviyaich saayaamalum enakkuk keezhppadiyaamalumpoaneerka'l.

ippoathum, reakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaapin puththirar thangka'l thakappan thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta ka'rpanaiyaik kaikko'ndirukkumpoathu, intha janangka'l enakkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoanapadiyinaalum,

ithoa, naan avarka'lidaththil peasiyum avarka'l kea'laamalum, naan avarka'lai noakkik kooppittum avarka'l ma'ruuththaravu kodaamalum poanapadiyinaalum, yoothaavinmealum erusaleamin kudika'l ellaarinmealum naan avarka'lukku viroathamaakach sonna ellaath theengkaiyum varappa'n'nuvean en'ru isravealin theavanum seanaika'lin theavanumaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

pinnum ereamiyaa reakaapiyarudaiya kudumpaththaarai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l thakappanaakiya yoanathaapin katta'laikkuk keezhppadinthu, avanudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu, avan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam seythuvantheerka'len'ru, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

aathalaal sakala naadka'lilum enakku munpaaka ni'rkaththakka purushan reakaapin kumaaranaakiya yoanathaapukku illaama'rpoavathillaiyen'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem ennum yoothaa raajaavin naalaam varushaththilea karththaraal ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vaarththai ennaven'raal:

nee oru pusthakachsuru'lai eduththu, yoasiyaavin naadka'lilea naan unnudanea peasina naa'l mutha'rko'ndu innaa'lmattum isravealaikku'riththum, yoothaavaikku'riththum, sakala jaathika'laikku'riththum unnoadea sonna ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum athilea ezhuthu.

yoothaavin kudumpaththaar, avaravar thangka'l pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpumpadiyaakavum, thangka'l akkiramaththaiyum thangka'l paavaththaiyum naan mannikkumpadiyaakavum, thangka'lukku naan seyya ninaiththirukki'ra theengkuka'laikku'riththu oruvea'lai avarka'l keadpaarka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu ereamiyaa neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukkai azhaiththaan; paarukku enpavan karththar ereamiyaavudanea sollivantha ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum avan vaay solla oru pusthakachsuru'lil ezhuthinaan.
pinpu ereamiyaa paarukkai noakki: naan adaikkappattavan; naan karththarudaiya aalayaththukku'l piraveasikkakkoodaathu.

nee u'l'lea piraveasiththu, en vaay solla nee ezhuthina suru'lilu'l'la karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laik karththarudaiya aalayaththil upavaasa naa'lilea janangka'ludaiya sevika'l keadka vaasippathuman'ri, thangka'l patta'nangka'lilirunthuvaruki'ra ellaa yoothaa koaththiraththaarum keadkumpadi avaika'lai vaasippaayaaka.

oruvea'lai avarka'l karththarudaiya mukaththukku munpaakap pa'ninthu vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, avaravar thangka'l pollaatha vazhiyai vittuth thirumpuvaarka'l; karththar intha janaththukku viroathamaakak koo'riyirukki'ra koapamum ukkiramum periyathu en'ru sonnaan.

appadiyea neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukku anthap pusthakaththil, karththarudaiya aalayaththil karththarudaiya vaarththaika'lai vaasikkumpadi ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam seythaan.

yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem ennum yoothaa raajaavin ainthaam varushaththu onpathaam maathaththilea, erusaleamilirukki'ra ellaa janaththukkum, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilirunthu erusaleamukku varuki'ra ellaa janaththukkum, karththarukku munpaaka upavaasam seyyavea'ndumen'ru koo'rappattathu.

appozhuthu paarukku karththarudaiya aalayaththin mea'rpiraakaaraththil, karththarudaiya aalayaththu vaasalin nadaikku arukaana saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya kemariyaa ennum sampirathiyin a'raiyilea, anthap pusthakaththilu'l'la ereamiyaavin vaarththaika'lai janangka'l ellaarum keadka vaasiththaan.
saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya kemariyaavin makan mikaayaa anthap pusthakaththilu'l'la karththarudaiya vaarththaika'laiyellaam vaasikkakkeattapoathu,

avan raajaavin aramanaikkup poay, sampirathiyin a'raiyil piraveasiththaan; ithoa, angkea ellaap pirapukka'lum sampirathiyaakiya elisaamaavum semaayaavin kumaaranaakiya thelaayaavum, akpoarin kumaaranaakiya elnaaththaanum, saappaanin kumaaranaakiya kemariyaavum, ananiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaavum, mat'ra ellaap pirapukka'lum udkaarnthirunthaarka'l.
paarukku janaththin sevika'l keadkap pusthakaththilu'l'lavaika'lai vaasikkaiyil, thaan keatta ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum mikaayaa avarka'lukkuth theriviththaan.

appozhuthu ellaap pirapukka'lum kooshiyin kumaaranaakiya seleamiyaavin makanaana neththaaniyaavinudaiya kumaaranaayirukki'ra yekuthiyaip paarukkinidaththil anuppi, janangka'l keadka nee vaasiththukko'ndiruntha suru'lai un kaiyil eduththukko'nduvaa en'ru sollachsonnaarka'l; aakaiyaal, neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukku suru'laith than kaiyil eduththukko'ndu, avarka'lidaththukku vanthaan.
avarka'l avanai noakki: nee udkaarnthuko'ndu, naangka'l keadka vaasiyen'raarka'l; avarka'l keadka vaasiththaan.

appozhuthu avarka'l ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum keadkaiyil payamut'ravarka'laay oruvaraiyoruvar paarththu, paarukkai noakki: intha ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum raajaavukku nichchayamaay a'rivippoam en'raarka'l.
avan vaay solla, nee intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam evvithamaay ezhuthinaay athai engka'lukkuch sol en'ru paarukkaik keattaarka'l.
atha'rkup paarukku: avar thamathu vaayinaal intha ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum uraiththu, ennudanea sonnaar, naan maiyinaal pusthakaththil ezhuthinean en'raan.
appozhuthu pirapukka'l paarukkai noakki: neeyum ereamiyaavum poay o'liththukko'l'lungka'l; neengka'l irukkum idaththai oruvarum a'riyappadaathu en'ru solli,
suru'laich sampirathiyaakiya elisaamaavin a'raiyilea vaiththu, raajaavinidaththukku aramanaiyilea poay, raajaavin sevika'lukku intha vaarththaika'laiyellaam a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa anthach suru'lai eduththukko'nduvara yekuthiyai anuppinaan; yekuthi athaich sampirathiyaakiya elisaamaavin a'raiyilirunthu eduththukko'nduvanthu, raajaa keadkavum, raajaavinidaththil nin'ra ellaap pirapukka'lum keadkavum vaasiththaan.
onpathaam maathaththilea raajaa, ku'lirkaalaththukkuth thangkum veettil udkaarnthirunthaan; avanukku munpaakak ka'nappu moottiyirunthathu.

yekuthi moon'ru naalu paththika'lai vaasiththa pinpu, raajaa oru soorikkaththiyinaal athai a'ruththu, suru'lanaiththum ka'nappilu'l'la akkiniyilea venthupoakumpadi, ka'nappiliruntha akkiniyil e'rinthupoattaan.
raajaavaayinum, antha vaarththaika'laiyellaam keatta avanudaiya sakala oozhiyakkaararaayinum payappadavumillai, thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'l'lavumillai.
elnaaththaanum, thelaayaavum, kemariyaavumoa: anthach suru'laich sutterikkavea'ndaam en'ru raajaavinidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaarka'l; aanaalum, avarka'lukku avan sevikodaamal,

paarukku ennum sampirathiyaiyum ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaiyum pidikkumpadikku, raajaa ammeleakin kumaaranaakiya yerameyealukkum, asriyealin kumaaranaakiya seraayaavukkum, aptheyealin kumaaranaakiya seleamiyaavukkum katta'laikoduththaan; aanaalum karththar avarka'lai ma'raiththaar.
raajaa anthach suru'laiyum, athilea ereamiyaavin vaaysollap paarukku ezhuthiyiruntha vaarththaika'laiyum sutteriththapinpu, ereamiyaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:
nee thirumpa vea'roru suru'lai eduththu, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeem sutteriththa muthalaam suru'liliruntha munthina vaarththaika'laiyellaam athilea ezhuthu en'raar.

mealum nee yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeemai noakki: paapiloan raajaa nichchayamaay varuvaan enpathaiyum, avan inthath theasaththai azhiththu ithilirunthu manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum ozhiyappa'n'nuvaan enpathaiyum nee athil ezhuthinatheathen'ru solli, anthach suru'lai nee sutteriththaayea en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeemaikku'riththu: thaaveethin singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarumpadi avan vamsaththil oruvanum iraan; avanudaiya pireathamoaven'raal, pakalin ush'naththukkum iravin ku'lirukkum e'rinthuvidappattuk kidakkum.

naan avanidaththilum, avan santhathiyinidaththilum, avan pirapukka'linidaththilum avarka'l akkiramaththai visaariththu, avanmealum erusaleamin kudika'lmealum, yoothaa manusharmealum, naan avarka'lukkuch sonnathum, avarka'l kea'laama'rpoanathumaana theengkanaiththaiyum varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

appozhuthu ereamiyaa vea'roru suru'lai eduththu, athai neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukku ennum sampirathiyinidaththil koduththaan; avan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeem akkiniyaal sutteriththa pusthakaththin vaarththaika'laiyellaam, athilea ereamiyaavin vaay solla ezhuthinaan; innum avaika'lukkoththa aneakam vaarththaika'lum avaika'loadea searkkappattathu.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar yoothaatheasaththil raajaavaaka niyamiththa yoayaakkeemudaiya kumaaranaakiya koaniyaavin pattaththukku yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sitheakkiyaa vanthu arasaa'ndaan.
karththar ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaikko'ndu sonna vaarththaika'lukku avanaakilum, avanudaiya oozhiyakkaararaakilum, theasaththin janangka'laakilum sevikodukkavillai.

sitheakkiyaa raajaavoavenil, seleamiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yookaalaiyum, maaseyaavin kumaaranaakiya seppaniyaa ennum aasaariyanaiyum ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyinidaththil anuppi: nee nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai noakki engka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappam pa'n'navea'ndum en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa janaththin naduvea varaththumpoakkumaayirunthaan; avanai avarka'l kaaval veettil innum poadavillai.
paarvoanin seanaiyoaven'raal, ekipthilirunthu pu'rappattathu; erusaleamai mut'rikkaipoatta kaltheayar avarka'ludaiya seythiyaikkeattu, erusaleamaivittu neengkippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa theerkkatharisikkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:

isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ennidaththil visaarikkumpadi ungka'lai ennidaththi'rku anuppina yoothaavin raajaavai neengka'l noakki: ithoa, ungka'lukku oththaasaiyaakap pu'rappatta paarvoanin seanai than theasamaakiya ekipthukkuth thirumpippoakum.
kaltheayaroaven'raal, thirumpivanthu intha nakaraththukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththu, akkiniyaal sutterippaarka'l.
kaltheayar nammaivittu nichchayamaayp poayviduvaarka'len'ru solli, neengka'l moasampoakaathirungka'l, avarka'l poavathillai.

ungka'loadea yuththampa'n'nuki'ra kaltheayarudaiya seanaiyaiyellaam neengka'l mu'riya adiththaalum, meenthavarka'l ellaarum kaayampattavarka'laayirunthaalum, avarka'l thangka'l koodaarangka'lilirunthu ezhumpi, intha nakaraththai akkiniyaal sutterippaarka'l en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
paarvoanin seanai varuki'rathen'ru, kaltheayarudaiya seanai erusaleamaivittup poanapoathu,
ereamiyaa avvidaththaivittu, janaththin naduvea jaadaiyaay vilaki, penyameen theasaththukkup poaka manathaay erusaleamilirunthu pu'rappattuppoanaan.

avan penyameen vaasalil vanthapoathu, kaava'rsearvaiyin athipathiyaakiya yeriyaa ennum naamamu'l'la oruvan angkea irunthaan; avan ananiyaavin kumaaranaakiya seleamiyaavin makan; avan: nee kaltheayaraich searappoaki'ravan en'ru solli, ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaip pidiththaan.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa: athu poy, naan kaltheayaraich searappoaki'ravanalla en'raan; aanaalum yeriyaa ereamiyaavin sollaik kea'laamal, avanaip pidiththu, pirapukka'lidaththil ko'ndupoanaan.

appozhuthu pirapukka'l: ereamiyaavinpearil kadungkoapangko'ndu, avanai adiththu, avanaich sampirathiyaakiya yoanaththaanudaiya veettil kaava'rpaduththinaarka'l; avarka'l athaik kaava'rkoodamaakkiyirunthaarka'l.
appadiyea ereamiyaa kaava'rkidangkin nilava'raika'lil piraveasiththu, angkea aneakanaa'l irunthaan.

pinpu sitheakkiyaa raajaa avanai azhaiththanuppi: karththaraal oru vaarththai u'ndoa en'ru raajaa avanaith than veettilea irakasiyamaayk keattaan. atha'rku ereamiyaa: u'ndu, paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduveer en'ru sonnaan.
pinnum ereamiyaa, sitheakkiyaa raajaavai noakki: neengka'l ennaik kaaval veettilea adaippatha'rku, naan umakkum ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkum intha janaththukkum viroathamaaka enna kut'ragnseythean?
paapiloan raajaa ungka'lukkum inthath theasaththukkum viroathamaaka varuvathillaiyen'ru ungka'lukkuth theerkkatharisanam sonna ungka'ludaiya theerkkatharisika'l engkea?

ippoathum raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, enakkuch sevikoduththu, en vi'n'nappaththukkuth thayaiseythu, ennaich sampirathiyaakiya yoanaththaanudaiya veetti'rkuth thirumpa anuppavea'ndaam; anuppinaal naan angkea seththuppoavean en'raan.

appozhuthu ereamiyaavaik kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilea kaakkavum, nakaraththilea appamirukkumattum appagnsuduki'ravarka'lin veethiyilea thinam oru appaththai avanukku vaangkikkodukkavum katta'laiyittaan; appadiyea ereamiyaa kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilea irunthaan.

intha nakaraththilea thariththirukki'ravan, pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum saavaan; kaltheayaridaththukkup pu'rappattuppoaki'ravanoa uyiroadiruppaan; avanudaiya piraa'nan avanukkuk kidaiththa ko'l'laiyudaimaiyaippoalirukkum; avan pizhaippaanenpathaik karththar uraikki'raar en'rum,
intha nakaram paapiloan raajaavinudaiya iraa'nuvaththin kaiyil nichchayamaaka oppukkodukkappadum; avan athaip pidippaanenpathaik karththar uraikki'raar en'rum,

ereamiyaa ellaa janaththoadum sollikko'ndiruntha vaarththaika'lai maaththaanin kumaaranaakiya seppaththiyaavum, paskoorin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavum, seleamiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yookaalum, malkiyaavin kumaaranaakiya paskoorum keattaarka'l.

appozhuthu pirapukka'l raajaavai noakki: intha manushan kollappada uththaravaakavea'ndum; atheanen'raal, intha nakaraththil meethiyaayirukki'ra yuththamanusharidaththilum, mat'rumu'l'la sakala janangka'lidaththilum, ivan ippadippatta vaarththaika'laich solluki'rathinaalea avarka'ludaiya kaika'laith tha'larnthupoakappa'n'nuki'raan; ivan intha janaththin ksheamaththaith theadaamal, avarka'l keattaiyea theaduki'raan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu sitheakkiyaa raajaa: ithoa, avan ungka'l kaika'lil irukki'raan; ungka'lukku viroathamaay raajaa on'rum seyyakkoodaathu en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l ereamiyaavaip pidiththu, avanaik kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththiliruntha ammeleakin kumaaranaakiya malkiyaavinudaiya thuravilea poattaarka'l; ereamiyaavaik kayi'ruka'linaal athilea i'rakkivittaarka'l; anthath thuravilea tha'n'neer illaamal u'laiyaayirunthathu, antha u'laiyilea ereamiyaa amizhnthinaan.
avarka'l ereamiyaavaith thuravilea poattathai raajaavin aramanaiyil iruntha eththiyoappiyanaakiya epethmeleak ennum oru pirathaani kea'lvippattaan; raajaavoa penyameen vaasalilea udkaarnthirunthaan.
appozhuthu epethmeleak raajaavin aramanaiyilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, raajaavai noakki:

raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanea, inthap purushar ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaith thuravilea poattuch seythathu ellaam thakaatha seykaiyaayirukki'rathu; avan irukki'ra idaththilea pattiniyinaal saavaanea, ini nakaraththilea appamillai en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa epethmeleak ennum eththiyoappiyanai noakki: nee ivvidaththilirunthu muppathu manusharai unnudanea koottikko'ndupoay, ereamiyaa theerkkatharisisaakaathatha'rkumunnea avanaith thuravilirunthu thookkividu en'ru katta'laiyittaan.

appozhuthu epethmeleak antha manusharaith thannudanea koottikko'ndu, raajaavin aramanaip pokkishasaalaiyin keezhiruntha a'raikku'l pukunthu, kizhinthupoana pazhampudavaika'laiyum kanthaiththu'nika'laiyum eduththukko'ndupoay, avaika'laik kayi'ruka'linaal ereamiyaava'ndaikkuth thuravilea i'rakkivittu,

epethmeleak ennum eththiyoappiyan ereamiyaavudanea: kizhinthupoana inthap pazhampudavaika'laiyum kanthaika'laiyum ummudaiya akku'lka'lil kayi'ruka'lukku'l adangkavaiththup poattukko'l'lum en'raan; ereamiyaa appadiyea seythaan.
appozhuthu ereamiyaavaik kayi'ruka'laal thookki, avanaith thuravilirunthu eduththuvittaarka'l; ereamiyaa kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththil irunthaan.

pinpu sitheakkiyaa raajaa, ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaik karththarudaiya aalayaththil irukkum moon'raam vaasalilea thannidaththi'rku varavazhaiththaan; angkea raajaa, ereamiyaavainoakki: naan unnidaththil oru kaariyam keadki'rean; nee enakku on'rum ma'raikkavea'ndaam en'raan.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa sitheakkiyaavai noakki: naan athai umakku a'riviththaal ennai nichchayamaayk kolaiseyveerallavaa? naan umakku aaloasanai sonnaalum, en sollaik keadkamaatteer en'raan.

appozhuthu sitheakkiyaa raajaa: naan unnaik kollaamalum, un piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ra intha manushar kaiyil unnai oppukkodaamalum iruppean enpathai, namakku intha aaththumaavai u'ndupa'n'nina karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru ereamiyaavukku irakasiyamaay aa'naiyittaan.

appozhuthu ereamiyaa sitheakkiyaavai noakki: neer paapiloan raajaavin pirapukka'la'ndaikkup pu'rappattuppoaveeraanaal, ummudaiya aaththumaa uyiroadirukkum; inthappatta'nam akkiniyaal sutterikkappaduvathillai; neerum ummudaiya kudumpamum uyiroadiruppeerka'l.

neer paapiloan raajaavin pirapukka'lidaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoakaavittaal, appozhuthu intha nakaram kaltheayar kaiyil oppukkodukkappadum, avarka'l ithai akkiniyaal sutterippaarka'l; neer avarka'lukkuth thappippoavathillai enki'rathai isravealin theavanum seanaika'lin theavanumaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu sitheakkiyaa raajaa ereamiyaavai noakki: kaltheayar thangka'laich searnthupoana yootharin kaiyilea ennaip pariyaasampa'n'na oppukkoduppaarka'loa en'ru naan aiyappaduki'rean en'raan.
atha'rku ereamiyaa: ummai oppukkodaarka'l; naan ummidaththil solluki'ra karththarudaiya vaarththaikkuch sevikodum, appozhuthu umakku nanmaiyaayirukkum, ummudaiya aaththumaa pizhaikkum.
naan pu'rappaduki'rathillai enpeereayaakil, karththar enakkuth theriyappaduththina vaarththaiyaavathu:

ithoa, yoothaa raajaavin veettilea meethiyaana ellaa sthireeka'lum ve'liyea paapiloan raajaavin pirapukka'la'ndaiyil ko'ndupoakappaduvaarka'l; appozhuthu, ithoa, avarka'lthaanea ummudaiya ishdarka'l; avarka'l umakkup poathanaiseythu, ummai mea'rko'ndaarka'l en'rum, ummudaiya kaalka'l u'laiyilea amizhnthinapinpu avarka'l pinvaangkippoanaarka'l en'rum antha sthireeka'lea solluvaarka'l.

ummudaiya ellaa sthireeka'laiyum, ummudaiya pi'l'laika'laiyum ve'liyea kaltheayaridaththil ko'ndupoavaarka'l; neerum avarka'l kaikkuth thappippoakaamal paapiloan raajaavin kaiyinaal pidikkappattu, intha nakaram akkiniyaal sutterikkappadak kaara'namaayiruppeer en'raan.
appozhuthu sitheakkiyaa ereamiyaavai noakki: intha vaarththaika'lai oruvarukkum a'rivikkavea'ndaam; appozhuthu nee saavathillai.

naan unnoadea peasinathaip pirapukka'l kea'lvippattu, unnidaththil vanthu: nee raajaavoadea peasik ko'ndathai engka'lukkuth therivi, engka'lukku on'rum ma'raikkaathea, appozhuthu unnaik kollaathiruppoam; raajaa unnoadu enna peasinaar en'ru unnaik keadpaarka'leayaakil,
naan yoanaththaanudaiya veettilea saakaathapadikku raajaa ennai angkea thirumpa anuppavea'ndaam en'ru, avar mukaththukku munpaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninean en'ru solvaayaaka en'raan.

pinpu ellaap pirapukka'lum, ereamiyaavinidaththil vanthu, avanaik keattaarka'l; appozhuthu avan: raajaa ka'rpiththa intha ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyea avarka'lukku a'riviththaan; kaariyam kea'lvippadaama'rpoanapadiyinaal, avanoadea peasaamalirunthuvittaarka'l.
appadiyea ereamiyaa, erusaleam pidipaduki'ra naa'lmattaakak kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththil irunthaan; erusaleam pidipattuppoanapoathum angkeayea irunthaan.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa arasaa'nda onpathaam varusham paththaam maathaththilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvamum erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthu, athai mut'rikkaipoattaarka'l.
sitheakkiyaa arasaa'nda pathinoaraam varusham naalaam maatham, onpathaam theathiyilea nakaraththu mathilil thi'rappukka'ndathu.

appozhuthu paapiloan raajaavin pirapukka'laakiya nerkalsareathsear, samkaarneapoa, sarseakim, rapsaarees, nerkalsareathsear, rapmaak enpavarka'lum, paapiloan raajaavin mat'ra ellaap pirapukka'lum udpiraveasiththu, naduvaasalil irunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavum sakala yuththa manusharum avarka'laik ka'ndapoathu, oadi, iraaththirikaalaththil raajaavudaiya thoattaththuvazhiyea, ira'ndu mathilka'lukku naduvaana vaasalaal nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l; avan vayalve'liyin vazhiyea poayvittaan.

aanaalum, kaltheayarudaiya iraa'nuvam avarka'laip pinthodarnthu, erikoavin samapoomiyil sitheakkiyaavaik kitti, avanaip pidiththu, avanai aamaaththeasaththin ooraakiya riplaavukku, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaaridaththil ko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea ivan avanaik ku'riththuth theerppuchseythaan.
pinpu paapiloan raajaa riplaavilea, sitheakkiyaavin kumaararai avan ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vettuviththaan; yoothaa pirapukka'l anaivaraiyum paapiloan raajaa vetti,
sitheakkiyaavin ka'nka'laik keduththu, avanaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoaka avanukku ira'ndu ve'nkala vilangkuka'laip poattaan.
kaltheayar raajaavin aramanaiyaiyum janaththin veeduka'laiyum akkiniyaal sutteriththu, erusaleamin mathilka'lai idiththuppoattaarka'l.

nakaraththil thangkiyiruntha janangka'laiyum, than padchaththil oadivanthuvittavarka'laiyum, meethiyaana mat'ra janangka'laiyum, kaava'r seanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan paapiloanukkuch si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoanaan.

kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan on'rumillaatha eazhaika'lil silarai yoothaa theasaththilea vaiththu, avarka'lukku annaa'lilea thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum vayalnilangka'laiyum koduththaan.
aanaalum ereamiyaavaik ku'riththu, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaanai noakki:
nee avanai azhaippiththu, avanukku oru pollaappum seyyaamal, avanaip paththiramaayp paarththu, avan unnoadea solluki'rapadiyellaam avanai nadaththen'ru katta'laikoduththaan.
appadiyea kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaanum, neapusaspaan, rapsaarees, nerkalsareathsear, rapmaak enpavarka'lum, paapiloan raajaavin ellaap pirapukka'lum,

ereamiyaavaik kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilirunthu varavazhaiththu, avanai ve'liyea veettukku azhaiththukko'ndupoakumpadikku avanaich saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makanaana kethaliyaavinidaththil oppuviththaarka'l; appadiyea avan janaththukku'l'lea thangkiyirunthaan.
ithuvumallaamal, ereamiyaa innum kaava'rsaalaiyin mut'raththilea adaikkappattirukkaiyil, avanukkuk karththaraal u'ndaana vasanam:

nee poay, eththiyoappiyanaakiya epethmeleakkukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, ennudaiya vaarththaika'lai intha nakaraththinmeal nanmaiyaaka alla, theemaiyaakavea varappa'n'nuvean; avaika'l annaa'lilea un ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ni'raivea'rum en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
aanaal annaa'lilea unnaith thappuvippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; nee payappaduki'ra manusharin kaiyilea oppukkodukkappaduvathillai.

unnai nichchayamaaka viduvippean, nee pattayaththukku iraiyaavathillai; nee ennai nampinapadiyinaal un piraa'nan unakkuk kidaiththa ko'l'laipporu'laippoala irukkumen'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.

paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi erusaleamilum yoothaavilum si'raika'laayp pidiththuvaikkappatta janangka'lukku'l vilangkidappattiruntha ereamiyaavaik kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan viduthalaiyaakki raamaavilirunthu anuppivitta pinpu, ereamiyaavukkuk karththaraal u'ndaana vasanam:
kaava'rseanaathipathi ereamiyaavai azhaippiththu, avanai noakki: un theavanaakiya karththar intha sthalaththukku inthath theengku varumen'ru solliyirunthaar.

thaam sonnapadiyea karththar varappa'n'niyumirukki'raar; neengka'l karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, avarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaama'rpoaneerka'l; aakaiyaal ungka'lukku inthak kaariyam vanthathu.

ippoathum, ithoa, un kaika'lilidappatta vilangkuka'lai in'ru neekkippoattean; ennoadeakoodap paapiloanukku vara unakku nanmaiyaayth thoan'rinaal vaa, naan unnaip paththiramaayp paarththukko'lvean; ennoadeakoodap paapiloanukku vara unakku nan'raayth thoan'raavittaal, irukkattum; ithoa, theasamellaam unakku munpaaka irukki'rathu, evvidaththukkuppoaka unakku nanmaiyum sevvaiyumaayk kaa'nki'rathoa avvidaththukkup poa en'raan.

avan innum poakaamalirukkumpoathu, avan ivanai noakki: nee paapiloan raajaa yoothaa patta'nangka'linmeal athikaariyaaka vaiththa saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makanaana kethaliyaavinidaththukkuth thirumpippoay, avanoadea janangka'lukku'l'lea thangkiyiru; illaavittaal, evvidaththukkup poaka unakkuch sevvaiyaayth thoan'ruki'rathoa, avvidaththukkup poa en'ru solli, kaava'rseanaathipathi avanukku vazhichselavaiyum vekumathiyaiyum koduththu avanai anuppivittaan.
appadiyea ereamiyaa mispaavukku akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavinidaththil poay, theasaththil meethiyaana janangka'lukku'l avanoadea thangkiyirunthaan.

paapiloan raajaa akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavaith theasaththinmeal athikaariyaakkinaan en'rum, paapiloanukkuch si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoakappattiraatha kudika'lil eazhaika'laana purusharaiyum sthireeka'laiyum kuzhanthaika'laiyum avanudaiya visaarippukku oppuviththaan en'rum, ve'liyilirukki'ra iraa'nuvach searvaikkaarar anaivarum avarka'ludaiya manusharum keattapoathu,

avarka'l mispaavukkuk kethaliyaavinidaththil vanthaarka'l; yaarenil, neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealum, kareayaavin kumaararaakiya yoakanaanum, yoanaththaanum, thankoomeaththin kumaaranaakiya seraayaavum, neththoapaaththiyanaakiya eappaayin kumaararum, maakaaththiyanaana oruvanudaiya kumaaranaakiya yesaniyaavum aakiya ivarka'lum ivarka'laich searnthavarka'lumea.

appozhuthu saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makan kethaliyaa avarka'laiyum avarka'l manusharaiyum noakki: neengka'l kaltheayaraich seavikkap payappadavea'ndaam, neengka'l theasaththilirunthu paapiloan raajaavaich seaviyungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaakum.

naanoavenil, ithoa, nammidaththilea varuki'ra kaltheayaridaththil seavikkumpadi mispaavilea kudiyirukki'rean; neengka'loa poay, thiraadcharasaththaiyum pazhangka'laiyum e'n'neyaiyum searththu, ungka'l paa'ndangka'lil vaiththu, ungka'l vasamaayirukki'ra oorka'lil kudiyirungka'l en'ru aa'naiyittuch sonnaan.

moavaapilum ammoan puththiraridaththilum eathoamilum sakala theasangka'lilum irukki'ra yootharum, paapiloan raajaa yoothaavil silar meethiyaayirukkak katta'laiyittaanen'rum, saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makanaana kethaliyaavai avarka'lmeal athikaariyaakkinaanen'rum, keattapoathu,

ellaa yootharum thaangka'l thuraththu'nda ellaa idangka'lilumirunthu, yoothaatheasaththil kethaliyaavinidaththil mispaavukku vanthu, thiraadcharasaththaiyum pazhangka'laiyum mikuthiyaaych searththuvaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum ve'liyilea iruntha sakala iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum mispaavukkuk kethaliyaavinidaththil vanthu,

ummaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, ammoan puththirarin raajaavaakiya paalis enpavan, neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealai anuppinaanenpathai neer a'riyavillaiyoa en'raarka'l; aanaalum akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaa avarka'l vaarththaiyai nampavillai.

pinnum kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaan mispaavilea kethaliyaavoadea irakasiyamaayp peasi: naan poay oruvarum a'riyaamal neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealai vettippoada uththaravaakavea'ndum; ummidaththil searntha yootharellaarum sitha'ru'ndupoakavum yoothaavil meenthavarka'l azhiyavum avan ummaik kon'rupoadavea'ndiyathenna en'raan.
aanaalum akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaa kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanai noakki: nee inthak kaariyaththaich seyyaathea; ismavealinmeal nee poy solluki'raay en'raan.

pinpu eazhaam maathaththilea raajavamsaththil pi'ranthavanum, elisaamaavin kumaaranaakiya neththaaniyaavin makanumaana ismavealum, avanudaneakooda raajaavin pirapukka'laana paththuppearum mispaavukku akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavinidaththil vanthu, angkea eakamaayp poajanampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealum, avanoadiruntha paththuppearum ezhumpi, paapiloan raajaa theasaththinmeal athikaariyaaka vaiththa saappaanin kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makanaana kethaliyaavaip pattayaththaal vettinaarka'l.
mispaavilea kethaliyaavinidaththil iruntha ellaa yootharaiyum, angkea kaa'nappatta yuththamanusharaakiya kaltheayaraiyum ismaveal vettippoattaan.
avan kethaliyaavaik kon'ra pinpu, ma'runaa'lilea athai oruvarum innum a'riyaathirukkaiyil:

thaadiyaich siraiththu, vasthirangka'laik kizhiththu, thangka'laik kee'rikko'ndiruntha e'npathupear seekeamilum seeloavilum samaariyaavilumirunthu, thangka'l kaika'lil kaa'nikkaika'laiyum thoopavarkkangka'laiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi vanthaarka'l.

appozhuthu neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal mispaavilirunthu pu'rappattu, avarka'lukku ethiraaka azhuthuko'ndea nadanthuvanthu, avarka'laich santhiththapoathu, avarka'lai noakki: akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavinidaththil vaarungka'l en'raan.
avarka'l nakaraththin maththiyil vanthapoathu, neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealum, avanoadiruntha manusharum avarka'lai vetti oru pa'l'laththilea tha'l'lippoattaarka'l.

aanaalum avarka'lil paththuppear meenthirunthaarka'l; avarka'l ismavealaippaarththu: engka'laik kolai seyyavea'ndaam; koathumaiyum vaa'rkoathumaiyum e'n'neyum theanumu'l'la puthaiyalka'l engka'lukku nilaththinkeezh irukki'rathu en'raarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'lai avarka'l sakoathararoadungkoodak kolaiseyyaamal vittuvaiththaan.

ismaveal kethaliyaavinimiththam vettina manusharudaiya pireathangka'laiyellaam e'rinthupoatta pa'l'lamoavenil, aasaa ennum raajaa isravealin raajaavaakiya paashaavinimiththam u'ndupa'n'nina pa'l'lanthaanea; athai neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal vettu'nda pireathangka'laal nirappinaan.

pinpu ismaveal mispaavil irukki'ra meethiyaana janaththaiyellaam si'raippaduththikko'ndupoanaan; raajaavin kumaaraththika'laiyum kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavin visaarippukku oppuviththuppoana mispaavilu'l'la meethiyaana sakala janangka'laiyum neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal si'raippaduththikko'ndu ammoan puththirar padchaththil poakap pu'rappattaan.
neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal seytha pollaappaiyellaam kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, avanoadiruntha ellaa iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum keattapoathu,
avarka'l purusharaiyellaam koottikko'ndu, neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealoadea yuththampa'n'nappoay, avanaik kipiyoanilirukkum perungku'laththuth tha'n'neera'ndaiyilea ka'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu ismavealoadiruntha sakala janangka'lum kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanaiyum, avanoadiruntha ellaa iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararaiyum ka'ndu santhoashappattu,
ismaveal mispaavilirunthu si'raipidiththukko'ndupoana janangka'lellaam pinnittuth thirumpi, kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanidaththil vanthuvittaarka'l.
neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismavealoa, ettuppearoadungkooda yoakanaanin kaikkuth thappi, ammoan puththiraridaththil poanaan.

kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, avanoadiruntha ellaa iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum, akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavai vettippoatta neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal ko'ndupoanathum, thaangka'l kipiyoanilea viduthalaiyaakkith thirumpappa'n'ninathumaana meethiyaana sakala janamumaakiya seavakaraana manusharaiyum, sthireeka'laiyum, kuzhanthaika'laiyum, aramanaip pirathaanika'laiyum searththukko'ndu,
paapiloan raajaa theasaththinmeal athikaariyaakkina akikkaamin kumaaranaakiya kethaliyaavai neththaaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya ismaveal vettippoattathinimiththam, kaltheayarukkup payanthapadiyinaal,
thaangka'l ekipthukkup poakap pu'rappattu, pethlekeamoorukku arukaana kimkaamin peattaiyil thangkiyirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu ellaa iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum, kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, oasaayaavin kumaaranaakiya yesaniyaavum, si'riyoar muthal periyoarmattumaana sakala janangka'lum searnthuvanthu,

theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaavai noakki: ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar naangka'l nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyaiyum, seyyavea'ndiya kaariyaththaiyum engka'lukkuth theriyappa'n'numpadikku, neer engka'l vi'n'nappaththukku idangkoduththu, meethiyaayirukki'ra inthach sakala janangka'laakiya engka'lukkaaka ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththarai noakki jepampa'n'num.
ummudaiya ka'nka'l engka'laik kaa'nki'rapadiyea thira'laana janangka'lil kognchappearea meenthirukki'roam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l sonnathaik keattean; ithoa, ungka'l vaarththaiyinpadiyea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarai noakki jepampa'n'nuvean; karththar ungka'lukku ma'ruuththaravaakach sollum ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum naan ungka'lukku on'raiyum ma'raikkaamal a'rivippean en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l ereamiyaavai noakki: ummudaiya theavanaakiya karththar ummaikko'ndu engka'lukkuch solliyanuppum ellaa vaarththaika'linpadiyum naangka'l seyyaavittaal, karththar namakku naduvea saththiyamum u'nmaiyumaana saadchiyaayirukkakkadavar.

athu nanmaiyaanaalum theemaiyaanaalum sari, engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththukku naangka'l keezhppadivathinaal engka'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaakumpadi naangka'l ummai anuppuki'ra engka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththukkuk keezhppadinthu nadappoam en'raarka'l.
paththunaa'l sen'rapinpu, karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu avan, kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanaiyum, avanoadiruntha ellaa iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararaiyum, si'riyoarmuthal periyoarmattum u'ndaana sakala janangka'laiyum azhaiththu,
avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappagnseyyumpadikku neengka'l ennai anuppina isravealin theavanaakiya karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal,

neengka'l inthath theasaththilea thariththirunthaal, naan ungka'laik kattuvean, ungka'lai idikkamaattean; ungka'lai naattuvean, ungka'laip pidungkamaattean; naan ungka'lukkuch seythirukki'ra theengkukku manasthaapappattean.

neengka'l payappaduki'ra paapiloan raajaavukkup payappadavea'ndaam, avanukkup payappadaathiruppeerka'laaka en'ru karththar solluki'raar, ungka'lai iradchikkumpadikkum, ungka'lai avan kaikkuth thappuvikkumpadikkum naan ungka'ludanea irunthu,
avan ungka'lukku irangkuki'ratha'rkum, ungka'l suyatheasaththukku ungka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum ungka'lukku irakkagnseyvean.
neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaamal, naangka'l inthath theasaththilea irukki'rathillaiyen'rum,

naangka'l yuththaththaik kaa'naathathum, ekkaa'la saththaththaik kea'laathathum, appaththaazhchchiyinaal pattiniyaay iraathathumaana ekipthu theasaththukkea poay, angkea thariththiruppoam en'rum solveerka'leayaakil,

yoothaavil meenthirukki'ravarka'lea, athaikku'riththu u'ndaana karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l: neengka'l ekipthukkup poaka ungka'l mukangka'laith thiruppi, angkea thangkappoaveerka'laanaal,
neengka'l payappaduki'ra pattayam ekipthu theasaththilea ungka'laip pidikkum; neengka'l aiyappaduki'ra pagncham ekipthilea ungka'laith thodarnthu varum, angkea saaveerka'l.

ekipthilea thangkavea'ndumen'ru avvidaththukkuth thangka'l mukangka'laith thiruppina ellaa manusharukkum enna sampavikkumen'raal, pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum saavaarka'l; naan avarka'lmeal varappa'n'num theengkinaalea avarka'lil meethiyaaki'ravarka'lum thappuki'ravarka'lumillai en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

en koapamum en ukkiramum erusaleamin kudika'lmeal eppadi moo'ndathoa, appadiyea en ukkiram neengka'l ekipthukkup poakumpoathu, ungka'lmeal moo'lum; neengka'l saapamaakavum paazhaakavum pazhippaakavum ninthaiyaakavum irunthu, ivvidaththai inikkaa'naathiruppeerka'l en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
yoothaavil meethiyaanavarka'lea, ekipthukkup poakaathirungka'l en'ru karththar ungka'laikku'riththuch sonnaarenpathai innaa'lil ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka a'riviththean en'ru a'riyungka'l.

ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukku viroathamaay ungka'lai moasampoakkineerka'l; nee engka'l theavanaakiya karththarai noakki: engka'lukkaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, engka'l theavanaakiya karththar solvathaiyellaam engka'lukku a'rivikkavea'ndum; athinpadiyea seyvoam en'ru neengka'l solli, ennai ungka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththukku anuppineerka'l.

naan innaa'lil athai ungka'lukku a'riviththean; aanaalum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththukkum, avar ennaikko'ndu ungka'lukkuch solliyanuppina enthakkaariyaththukkum sevikodaama'rpoaneerka'l.
ippoathum thangkiyiruppatha'rku neengka'l poaka virumpuki'ra sthalaththilthaanea pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum saaveerka'len'ru nichchayamaay a'riyungka'l en'raan.

ereamiyaa sakala janangka'lukkum avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar thannaikko'ndu avarka'lukkuch solliyanuppina ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum sonnaan; avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya ellaa vaarththaika'laiyum avan avarka'lukkuch sollimudiththapinpu,

oasaayaavin kumaaranaakiya asariyaavum, kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, akangkaarika'laana ellaa manusharum ereamiyaavai noakki: nee poy solluki'raay; ekipthilea thangkumpadikku angkea poakaathirungka'l en'ru solla, engka'l theavanaakiya karththar unnai engka'lidaththukku anuppavillai.

kaltheayar engka'laik kon'rupoadavum, engka'laip paapiloanukkuch si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoakavum, engka'lai avarka'l kaiyil oppukkodukkumpadi, neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukkuththaanea unnai engka'lukku viroathamaaka eavinaan en'raarka'l.

appadiyea yoothaavin theasaththilea thariththirukkavea'ndum ennum karththarudaiya saththaththukkuk kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum, sakala iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum, sakala janangka'lum sevikodaama'rpoanaarka'l.

yoothaa theasaththil thangkiyiruppatha'rku, thaangka'l thuraththu'ndiruntha sakala jaathika'lidaththilumirunthu thirumpivantha meethiyaana yootharellaaraiyum, purusharaiyum, sthireeka'laiyum, kuzhanthaika'laiyum, raajaavin kumaaraththika'laiyum, kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan, saappaanin kumaaranaakiya akikkaamin makanaana kethaliyaavinidaththil vittuppoana sakala aaththumaakka'laiyum, theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaavaiyum, neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paarukkaiyum,
kareayaavin kumaaranaakiya yoakanaanum sakala iraa'nuvach searvaikkaararum koottikko'ndu,
karththarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaathapadiyinaalea, ekipthutheasaththukkup poaka eththaniththu, athilu'l'la thakpaaneasmattum poaych searnthaarka'l.
thakpaaneasilea karththarudaiya vaarththai ereamiyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:

nee un kaiyilea periya ka'rka'lai eduththukko'ndu, yoothaa janangka'lukku munpaaka avaika'laith thakpaaneasil irukki'ra paarvoanudaiya aramanaiyin olimukavaasalil irukki'ra soo'laiyin ka'lima'n'nilea puthaiththu vaiththu,

avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, en oozhiyakkaaranaakiya neapukaathneachchaar enki'ra paapiloan raajaavai naan azhaiththanuppi, naan puthaippiththa inthak ka'rka'linmeal avanudaiya singkaasanaththai vaippean; avan than raajakoodaaraththai avaika'linmeal virippaan.
avan vanthu, ekipthutheasaththai azhippaan; saavukku eathuvaanavan saavukkum, si'raiyiruppukku eathuvaanavan si'raiyiruppukkum, pattayaththukku eathuvaanavan pattayaththukkum u'l'laavaan.

ekipthin theavarka'ludaiya koavilka'lil akkiniyaik ko'luththuvean; avan avaika'laich sutteriththu, avaika'laich si'raipidiththuppoay, oru meayppan than kampa'liyaip poarththukko'l'lumaappoal ekipthutheasaththaip poarththukko'ndu, avvidaththilirunthu sukamaayp pu'rappattuppoavaan.

avan ekipthutheasaththil irukki'ra pethshimeasin silaika'lai udaiththu, ekipthin theavarka'ludaiya koavilka'lai akkiniyaal suttuppoaduvaan en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
ekipthutheasaththil kudiyea'ri, mikthoalilum, thakpaaneasilum, noappilum, pathroas seemaiyilum vaasamaana ellaa yootharaiyungku'riththu, ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana vasanam:
isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan erusaleaminmealum, yoothaavin sakala patta'nangka'linmealum, varappa'n'nina theengkaiyellaam neengka'l ka'ndeerka'l.

ithoa, avarka'lum neengka'lum ungka'l pithaakka'lum a'riyaatha theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattavum, aaraathanai seyyavum poay, enakkuk koapamoottumpadikkuch seytha avarka'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam, avaika'l innaa'lil paazhaaykkidakki'rathu, avaika'lil kudiyillai.
naan ve'rukki'ra intha aruvaruppaana kaariyaththaich seyyaathirungka'len'ru, theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu ungka'lukku ea'rkanavea solliyanuppikko'ndirunthean.
aanaalum avarka'l anniya theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattaathapadikku, en sollaik kea'laamalum, pollaappai vittuth thirumpuvatha'rkuch seviyaich saaykkaamalum poanaarka'l.
aakaiyaal, en ukkiramum en koapamum moo'ndu, yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum pat'riyerinthathu; avaika'l innaa'lil irukki'rapadi vanaantharamum paazhumaayp poayit'ru.

ippoathum isravealin theavanum seanaika'lin theavanumaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l yoothaavil oruvaraiyum ungka'lukku meethiyaaka vaikkaamal, ungka'lil purushanaiyum sthireeyaiyum pi'l'laiyaiyum paalkudikki'ra kuzhanthaiyaiyum vearat'ruppoakappa'n'numpadikku, ungka'l kaika'lin kiriyaika'laalea enakkuk koapamoottuki'ra periya pollaappai ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukku viroathamaakach seythu,

ungka'lai vearat'ruppoakappa'n'nuvatha'rkaakavum, neengka'l poomiyin sakala jaathika'lukku'l'lum saapamum ninthaiyumaayiruppatha'rkaakavum, neengka'l thangkiyirukkavantha ekipthutheasaththilea anniya theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattuvaanean?

yoothaatheasaththilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum ungka'l pithaakka'l seytha pollaappuka'laiyum, yoothaavin raajaakka'l seytha pollaappuka'laiyum, avarka'l sthireeka'l seytha pollaappuka'laiyum, neengka'l seytha pollaappuka'laiyum, ungka'l sthireeka'l seytha pollaappuka'laiyum ma'ranthupoaneerka'loa?

avarka'l innaa'lmattum manam no'rungku'ndathumillai, avarka'l payappaduki'rathumillai; naan ungka'l munpaakavum ungka'l pithaakka'l munpaakavum vaiththa en veathaththinpadiyum en katta'laika'linpadiyum nadakki'rathumillai.

aakaiyaal, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, naan ungka'lukkuth theengku'ndaakavum, yoothaavanaiththaiyum sangkarikkaththakkathaakavum, en mukaththai ungka'lukku viroathamaakath thiruppi,

ekipthutheasaththilea thangkumpadikku varath thangka'l mukangka'laith thiruppina meethiyaana yootharai vaarikko'l'luvean; avarka'l anaivarum ekipthutheasaththilea nirmoolamaavaarka'l; avarka'l si'riyavanmuthal periyavanvaraikkum, pattayaththukku iraiyaaki, pagnchaththaalum nirmoolamaavaarka'l; avarka'l pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum seththu, saapamum paazhum pazhippum ninthaiyumaavaarka'l.
naan erusaleamaith tha'ndiththapadi ekipthutheasaththil kudiyirukki'ravarka'laiyum pattayaththaalum, pagnchaththaalum, ko'l'lainoayaalum tha'ndippean.

ekipthutheasaththilea thangkavum, ma'rupadiyum thangka'l aaththumaa vaagnchiththirukki'ra yoothaa theasaththilea kudiyea'ruvatha'rku angkea thirumpippoakavum vea'ndumen'ru ingkea vantha meethiyaana yootharilea meethiyaayirukki'ravarka'lum thappuki'ravarka'lumillai; thappippoaki'ravarka'laakiya mat'ravarka'leayozhiya avarka'lil oruvarum angkea thirumpuvathillaiyen'raar en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu thangka'l sthireeka'l anniya theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattinathaaka a'rinthiruntha ellaap purusharum, periya koottamaay nin'riruntha ellaa sthireeka'lum, ekipthutheasaththil pathroasilea kudiyiruntha sakala janangka'lum ereamiyaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka:
nee karththarudaiya naamaththil engka'lukkuch sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea naangka'l unakkuch sevikodaamal,

engka'l vaayilirunthu pu'rappatta ellaa vaarththaiyinpadiyeayum naangka'l seythu, vaanaraakkinikkuth thoopangkaatti, ava'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarppoam; naangka'lum, engka'l pithaakka'lum, engka'l raajaakka'lum, engka'l pirapukka'lum, yoothaa patta'nangka'lilum erusaleamin veethika'lilum seythathupoalavea seyvoam; appozhuthu naangka'l appaththinaal thirupthiyaaki, oru pollaappaiyum kaa'naamal vaazhnthirunthoam.

naangka'l vaanaraakkinikkuth thoopangkaattaamalum, ava'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarkkaamalum poanathumutha'rko'ndu, ellaam engka'lukkuk ku'raivupattathu; pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum azhinthupoanoam.

mealum naangka'l vaanaraakkinikkuth thoopangkaatti, ava'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarththapoathu, naangka'l engka'l purusharin anumathiyillaamal ava'lukkup pa'niyaarangka'laich suttu, paanapalika'lai vaarththu, ava'lai namaskariththoamoa? en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu ereamiyaa, thanakku ippadippatta ma'rumozhi koduththa sakala janangka'laakiya sthiree purusharka'laiyum mat'ra yaavaraiyum noakki:

yoothaavin patta'nangka'lilum, erusaleamin veethika'lilum, neengka'lum ungka'l pithaakka'lum ungka'l raajaakka'lum, ungka'l pirapukka'lum, theasaththin janangka'lum kaattina thoopangka'lai allavoa karththar ninaiththuth thammudaiya manathilea vaiththukko'ndaar.

ungka'l kiriyaika'lin pollaappaiyum, neengka'l seytha aruvaruppuka'laiyum, karththar appu'ram po'ruththirukkakkoodaathapadiyinaal allavoa, ungka'l theasam innaa'lil irukki'rapadi kudiyat'ra antharave'liyum paazhum saapamumaayit'ru.
