neengka'l thoopangkaatti, karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythu, karththarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaamalum, avarudaiya veathaththukkum, avarudaiya katta'laika'lukkum, avarudaiya saadchika'lukkum i'nangki nadavaamalum poanapadiyinaalea innaa'lil irukki'rapadi inthath theengku ungka'lukku nearittathu en'raan.
pinnum ereamiyaa sakala janangka'laiyum, sakala sthireeka'laiyum noakki: ekipthutheasaththil irukki'ra yootharaakiya neengka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, vaanaraakkinikkuth thoopangkaattavum, ava'lukkup paanapalika'lai vaarkkavum, naangka'l nearnthuko'nda poruththanaika'lai evvithaththilum seluththuvoamen'ru, neengka'lum ungka'l sthireeka'lum, ungka'l vaayinaalea solli, ungka'l kaika'linaalea ni'raiveat'rineerka'l; neengka'l ungka'l poruththanaika'lai sthirappaduththinathu meyyea, avaika'laich seluththinathum meyyea.

aakaiyaal, ekipthutheasaththil kudiyirukki'ra yoothaa janangka'laakiya neengka'l ellaarum karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; ithoa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya jeevanaa'nai en'ru, ekipthu theasamengkum oru yoothaa manushan vaayinaalum ini en naamam vazhangkappaduvathillaiyen'ru naan en makaththaana naamaththaikko'ndu aa'naiyiduki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naan avarka'lmeal nanmaikkalla theemaikkea jaakkirathaiyaayiruppean; ekipthu theasaththilirukki'ra yoothaa manushar ellaarum ozhinthu theeruma'lavum pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum sangkaaramaavaarka'l.

aanaalum pattayaththukkuth thappuki'ravarka'l ekipthutheasaththilirunthu yoothaatheasaththukkuk kogncham pearaayth thirumpuvaarka'l; appadiyea ekipthutheasaththilea thangkiyirukka vantha yoothaavil meethiyaana anaivarum akkaalaththilea thangka'ludaiya vaarththaiyoa, en vaarththaiyoa, yaarudaiya vaarththai meyppadum en'ru a'rivaarka'l.

naan ivvidaththil ungka'laith tha'ndippean en'ru ungka'lukku viroathamaaych sonna en vaarththaika'l meyppadumen'ru neengka'l a'rivatha'rku ungka'lukku ithuvea adaiyaa'lam en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naan yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavai, avanudaiya saththuruvum avan piraa'nanai vaangkath theadinavanumaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ennum paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil oppukkoduththathupoala, naan paarvoan oppiraa ennum ekipthin raajaavaiyum, avanudaiya saththurukka'lin kaiyilum, avan piraa'nanai vaangkaththeaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum oppukkoduppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem ennum yoothaa raajaavin naalaam varushaththilea neariyaavin kumaaranaakiya paaruk intha vasanangka'lai ereamiyaavin vaay solla oru pusthakaththil ezhuthukaiyil, ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi avanidaththil peasi,
paarukkea, unnaikku'riththu isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal,
nee: ippozhuthu enakku aiyoa! karththar en noavaich sagnchalaththaal varththikkappa'n'ninaar, en thavippinaal i'laiththean, i'laippaa'ruthalaik kaa'naatheapoanean en'ru sonnaay enki'raar.
ithoa, naan kattinathaiyea naan idikki'rean; naan naattinathaiyea naan pidungkuki'rean; intha muzhuththeasaththukkum ippadiyea nadakkum.

nee unakkup periya kaariyangka'laith theaduki'raayoa? theadaathea; ithoa, maamsamaana yaavarmealum theengkai varappa'n'nuki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; aanaalum, nee poakum sakala sthalangka'lilum un piraa'nanai unakkuk kidaikkum ko'l'laipporu'laakath tharuki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru avanudanea sol en'raar.
pu'rajaathika'lukku viroathamaay ereamiyaa theerkkatharisikku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam:

ekipthaikku'riththum, aippiraaththu nathiya'ndaiyil karkeamisilea irunthathum paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar, yoasiyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoayaakkeem ennum yoothaa raajaavin naalaam varushaththilea mu'riya adiththathumaana paarvoanneakoa ennappatta ekipthu raajaavin raa'nuvaththaikku'riththum avar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:
keadakangka'laiyum parisaika'laiyum aayaththampa'n'ni, yuththaththukku vaarungka'l.
kuthiraiveerarea, kuthiraika'linmeal sea'nangka'lai vaiththu ea'ri, thalaichseeraayai a'ninthuko'ndu nillungka'l; eettika'laith thulakki, kavasangka'laith thariththukko'l'lungka'l.

avarka'l kalangki, pinvaangkuki'rathai naan kaa'nki'rathenna? sut'rilumu'ndaana payangkaraththinimiththam avarka'ludaiya paraakkiramasaalika'l mu'riyu'ndu, thirumpippaaraamal oattamaay oadippoaki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
veakamaay oaduki'ravan oadippoakavea'ndaam; paraakkiramasaali thappippoakavea'ndaam; vadakkea aippiraaththu nathiya'ndaiyilea avarka'l ida'rivizhuvaarka'l.
piravaakampoal pura'nduvaruki'ra ivan yaar? alaika'l moathiyadikki'ra nathika'lpoal ezhumpivaruki'ra ivan yaar?

ekipthiyanea piravaakaththaippoal pura'nduvaruki'raan, avanea alaika'l moathiyadikki'ra nathika'lpoala ezhumpivaruki'raan; naan poay, theasaththai moodi, nakaraththaiyum athil kudiyirukki'ravarka'laiyum azhippean en'raan.

kuthiraika'lea, poay ea'rungka'l; irathangka'lea, kadakada en'ru oadungka'l; paraakkiramasaalika'lum, keadakam pidikki'ra eththiyoappiyarum, pooththiyarum, villaippidiththu naa'neat'ruki'ra leethiyarum pu'rappadakkadavarka'l.

aanaalum, ithu seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavarin naa'lum, avar thammudaiya saththurukka'lukku neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ra naa'lumaayirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal, pattayam padchiththu, avarka'ludaiya iraththaththaal thirupthiyaaki ve'riththirukkum; vadatheasaththil aippiraaththu nathiya'ndaiyilea seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavarukku oru yaakamum u'ndu.
ekipthin kumaaraththiyaakiya kannikaiyea, nee keeleayaaththukkup poay, pisin thailam vaangku; thira'laana avizhthangka'lai nee koottuki'rathu viruthaa, unakku aaroakkiyamu'ndaakaathu.
jaathika'l un ilachchaiyaik kea'lvippattaarka'l; un kookkuralaal theasam ni'rainthathu; paraakkiramasaaliyinmeal paraakkiramasaali ida'ri, iruvarum eakamaay vizhunthaarka'l en'raar.
ekipthutheasaththai azhikkap paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar varuvaanenpathaikku'riththu, ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyinidaththil karththar sonna vasanam:
aayaththappattu nil, pattayam unnaich sut'rilum u'ndaanathaip padchiththuppoaduki'rathen'ru solli, ekipthilea a'riviththu, mikthoalilea koo'ri, noappilum thakpaaneasilum pirasiththampa'n'nungka'l.
un veerar vaarikko'l'lappaduki'rathenna? karththar avarka'laith tha'l'linathaal avarka'l nilaini'rkavillai.

aneakarai ida'rappa'n'nuki'raar; avanavan thanakkaduththavanmeal vizhuki'raan; avarka'l: ezhunthirungka'l, kolluki'ra pattayaththukkuth thappa namathu janaththa'ndaikkum, naam pi'rantha theasaththukkum thirumpippoavoam enki'raarka'l.
ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoan paazhaakkappattaan; avanukkuk ku'riththa kaalam mudinthathen'ru angkea saththamittuch solluki'raarka'l.
parvathangka'lil thaapoarum, samuththiraththin arukea karmealum irukki'ra nichchayampoal avan varuvaanen'ru seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'la raajaa thammudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'raar.
ekipthutheasavaasiyaakiya kumaaraththiyea, si'raiyiruppukkup poakum pirayaa'na saamaanka'lai aayaththappaduththu, noap paazhaakum; athu kudiyillaamal sutterikkappattuk kidakkum.
ekipthu makaa nearththiyaana kadaari, adikki'ravan vadakkeayirunthu varuki'raan.

athin naduvil irukki'ra athin koolippadaika'l kozhuththa kaa'laika'l poalirukki'raarka'l; ivarka'lum ni'rkaamal, thirumpikko'ndu eakamaay oadippoavaarka'l; avarka'l visaarikkappaduki'ra avarka'ludaiya aapaththunaa'l avarka'lmeal vanthathu.
avan paampaippoal see'rivaruvaan, iraa'nuvapalaththoadea nadanthu, kaaduvettika'laippoal koadarika'loadu athinmeal varuvaarka'l.
e'n'nappadaatha marangka'laayirunthaalum anthak kaattai vettuvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'l vettukki'lika'laippaarkkilum athikamaanavarka'l, avarka'lukkuth thokaiyillai.
ekipthin kumaaraththi kalangkuvaa'l; vadathisai janaththin kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvaa'l.

isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan noa ennum patta'naththilu'l'la thira'laana janangka'laiyum, paarvoanaiyum, ekipthaiyum, athin theavarka'laiyum, athin raajaakka'laiyum, paarvoanaiyum, avanai nampiyirukki'ravarka'laiyum visaariththu,

avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarin kaiyilum, avanudaiya seavakarin kaiyilum, avarka'lai oppukkoduppean; atha'rkuppinpu athu poorvakaalaththil irunthathupoal kudiyeat'rappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapea, nee payappadaathea; isravealea, nee kalangkaathea; ithoa, naan unnaith thooraththilum, un santhathiyai avarka'l si'raiyiruppin theasaththilumirunthu viduviththu iradchippean; appozhuthu yaakkoapu thirumpivanthu, amaithiyoadum saangkoapaangkaththoadum iruppaan; avanaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nuvaar illai.

en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapea, nee payappadaathea en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan unnudanea irukki'rean; unnaith thuraththivitta ellaa jaathika'laiyum naan nirmoolamaakkuvean; unnaiyoa naan nirmoolamaakkaamal, unnai mattaayth tha'ndippean; aanaalum unnai naan kut'ramillaamal neengkalaaka viduvathillaiyenki'raar.
paarvoan kaathsaavai azhikkumunnea, pelistharukku viroathamaayth theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam:

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, vadakkeayirunthu jalam pongkip piravaakamaakith theasaththinmealum, athilu'l'la ellaavat'rinmealum, nakaraththinmealum, athil kudiyirukki'ravarka'linmealum pura'ndu oadum; appozhuthu manushar kookkuralittu, theasaththin kudika'lellaarum ala'ruvaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya palaththa kuthiraika'ludaiya ku'lampuka'lin saththaththaiyum, avarka'ludaiya irathangka'lin kadakadappaiyum, avarka'ludaiya uru'laika'lin iraichchalaiyum keattu, thakappanmaar thangka'l kai ayarnthupoanathinaal thangka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum noakkip paaraathiruppaarka'l.

pelistharaiyellaam paazhaakkavum, theeruvukkum seethoanukkum meethiyaana sakaayaraiyellaam sangkaarampa'n'navum varuki'ra naa'lilea ippadiyaakum; kapthoar ennum kada'rkaraiyaana theasaththaaril meethiyaakiya pelistharaiyum karththar paazhaakkuvaar.
kaathsaa mottaiyadikkappadum; avarka'ludaiya pa'l'laththaakkilea meethiyaakiya askaloan sangkaaramaakum; nee enthamattunthaan unnaik kee'rikko'l'luvaay.
aa karththarin pattayamea, enthamattum amaraathiruppaay? un u'raikku'l thirumpivanthu, oaynthu amarnthiru.
athu eppadi amarnthirukkum? askaloanukku viroathamaakavum kadalthu'rai theasaththukku viroathamaakavum karththar atha'rkuk katta'laikoduththu, avvidangka'lukken'ru athaik ku'riththaarea.

moavaapaikku'riththu isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, aiyoa! neapoa paazhaakkappattathu; keeriyaaththaayeem vedkappattu, pidikkappattuppoayit'ru; miskaap vedkappattu, kalangkippoayit'ru.

espoanaikku'riththu moavaapukku iruntha peththarikkam ini iraathu; athu oru jaathiyaayiraathapadikku athai nirmoolamaakkuvean vaarungka'len'ru atha'rku viroathamaakap pollaappai ninaiththirukki'raarka'l; mathmeanea, neeyum sangkaaramaavaay; pattayam unnaith thodarum.
paazhkkadippinaalum periya no'rukkuthalinaalum u'ndaaki'ra kooppiduthalin saththam oronaayimilirunthu keadkappadum.
moavaap no'rungku'ndathu; athilu'l'la si'ruvarka'l kooppidum saththam keadkappaduki'rathu.

lookiththukku ea'rippoaki'ra vazhiyilea azhukaiyinmeal azhukai ezhumpum; oronaayimukku i'rangkippoaki'ra vazhiyilea no'rukkuthal seyki'rathinaal u'ndaakiya kookkuralaik saththurukka'l keadki'raarka'l.
ungka'l piraa'nan thappa oadippoangka'l; vanaantharaththilu'l'la ka'ra'laiyaayppoana sediyaippoaliruppeerka'l.

nee un sampaththaiyum un pokkishangka'laiyum nampuki'rapadiyinaalea neeyum pidikkappaduvaay, appozhuthu keamoash si'raiyaakkappattuppoam; athin aasaariyarum pirapukka'lum eakamaaych si'raippattuppoavaarka'l.
paazhaakkuki'ravan ellaap patta'nangka'linmealum varuvaan; oru patta'namum thappippoavathillai; pa'l'laththaakkuka'lum kettuppoakum; samanaana poomiyum azhikkappadum en'ru karththar sonnaar.
moavaapukkuch settaika'laik kodungka'l; athu pa'ranthupoakattum; athin patta'nangka'l kudika'lillaamal paazhaayppoakum.
karththarudaiya vealaiyai asathiyaaych seyki'ravan sapikkappattavan; iraththam sinthaathapadikkuth than pattayaththai adakkikko'l'luki'ravan sapikkappattavan.

moavaap than si'ruvayathumuthal sukamaay vaazhnthathu; athu oru paaththiraththilirunthu ma'ru paaththiraththil vaarkkappadaamalum, athin va'ndalka'linmeal asaiyaamalum irunthathu; athu si'raiyiruppukkup poanathillai; aathalaal athin rusi athil nilaiththirunthathu; athin vaasanai vea'rupadavillai.

aakaiyaal, ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu kavizhththuppoaduki'ravarka'lai atha'rku anuppuvean; avarka'l athaik kavizhththu, athin paaththirangka'lai ve'rumaiyaakki, athin jaadika'lai udaiththuppoaduvaarka'l.
appozhuthu israveal santhathi thangka'l nampikkaiyaana peththealaalea vedkappattathupoala, moavaap keamoashaalea vedkappadum.
naangka'l paraakkiramasaalika'len'rum, naangka'l yuththasannaththaren'rum neengka'l solluki'rathenna?
moavaap azhinthathu, athin patta'nangka'l erinthupoayina; athin thi'ramaiyu'l'la vaalipar kolaikka'laththukku i'rangkuki'raarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'la raajaa solluki'raar.
moavaapin aapaththuvarach sameepamaayirukki'rathu; athin theengku mikavum theeviriththuvaruki'rathu.

athin sut'ruppu'raththaarum athin pearai a'rinthavarka'lumaakiya neengka'l ellaarum atha'rkaaka angkalaayththuk ko'l'lungka'l; pelanaana thadiyum alangkaaramaana koalum eppadi udainthathen'ru sollungka'l.

theepoan patta'navaasiyaana kumaaraththiyea, nee un makimaiyai vitti'rangki, thaakaththoadea udkaarnthiru; moavaapaip paazhaakkuki'ravan unakku viroathamaay vanthu, un ara'nka'lai azhiththuppoaduvaan.
aaroavearil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, nee vazhiyilea nin'ru paarththukko'ndiru; nadanthathennaven'ru oadivaruki'ravanaiyum thappivaruki'ravanaiyum kea'l.
moavaap mu'riya adikkappattapadiyinaal kalangkippoayit'ru; ala'rikkooppidungka'l; moavaap paazhaakkappattathen'ru arnoanil a'riviyungka'l.
samanaana poomiyaakiya oaloaninmealum, yaathsaavinmealum, meapkaaththinmealum,
theepoaninmealum, neapoavinmealum, peththiplaaththaayeeminmealum,
keeriyaaththaayeeminmealum, peathkamoolinmealum, pethmeyoaninmealum,
keeriyoaththinmealum, poas'raavinmealum, moavaap theasaththilea thooraththilum sameepaththilum irukki'ra ellaap patta'nangka'linmealum niyaayaththeerppu varum.
moavaapin kompu vettu'ndathu; avan puyam mu'rikkappattathu en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avanai ve'riko'l'lach seyyungka'l; karththarukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattinaan; moavaap thaan vaanthipa'n'ni athilea pura'luvaan; avan pariyaasaththukkidamaavaan.
israveal unakkup pariyaasamaayirunthaan allavoa? avan thirudarukku'l ka'ndupidikkappattaanoa? nee avanaikku'riththup peasuki'rapoathellaam, thalaiyaith thulukkuki'raayea.
moavaap theasaththin kudika'lea, neengka'l patta'nangka'lai vittuppoay, kanmalaiyil thangki, kukaiyin vaay oarangka'lil koodukattuki'ra pu'raavukku oppaayirungka'l.
avan meththap perumaikkaaran, moavaapin perumaiyaiyum, avan meattimaiyaiyum, avan akanthaiyaiyum, avan peththarikkaththaiyum, avan iruthayaththin meattimaiyaiyum ku'riththuk keattean.
avan moorkkaththai naan a'rivean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; appadiyaakaathu, avan veempu sellaathu enki'raar.
aakaiyaal moavaapinimiththam naan ala'ri, moavaap theasam anaiththinimiththamum kookkuraliduvean; keeraareas manusharinimiththam perumoochchu vidappadum.

sipmaavoorin thiraadchachsediyea, yaasearukkaaka naan azhuthathupoala unakkaakavum azhuvean; un kodika'l kadalaik kadanthupoayina; avaika'l yaasear kadalmattum poay ettina; paazhaakkuki'ravan un vasantha kaalaththup pazhangka'linmealum, un thiraadchappazha a'ruppinmealum vizhunthaan.

payirve'liyilum moavaap theasaththilumirunthu santhoashamum ka'lippum neengkippoayit'ru; thiraadcharasam aalaika'lilirunthu pozhiki'rathai oayappa'n'ninean; aalaiyai mithikki'ravarka'lin paadal illai; athu aaravaarameayallaamal aalai mithikkum paadalalla.

espoanthuvakki eleyaaleamattum yaakaasvaraikkum u'ndaakum kookkuralinimiththam avarka'l moon'ruvayathuk kadaariyaippoal, soavaarthuvakki oronaayimmattum saththamiduvaarka'l; nimreemin jalangka'lum vat'rippoakum.
moavaaptheasaththu meadaika'lil paliyiduki'ravanaiyum than theavarka'lukkuth thoopangkaattuki'ravanaiyum oayappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal, moavaapinimiththam en iruthayam naakasurampoal thuyaramaayth thonikkum; keeraareas manusharinimiththamum, en iruthayam naakasurampoal thuyaramaayth thonikkum; avarka'l sampaathiththa aisuvariyam azhinthu poaki'rapadiyinaal appadith thonikkum.
thalaika'l ellaam mottaiyidappattum, thaadika'l ellaam kaththarikkappattum irukkum; kaika'lil ellaam kee'ruthalka'lum, araika'lil irattuduppum u'ndu.
moavaapin sakala veeduka'linmealum athin therukka'lileayum eakappulampal u'ndaakum; oruvarum virumpappadaatha paaththirampoala moavaapai udaiththuppoattean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
moavaap evva'lavaay mu'rinthupoayit'ren'ru ala'ruki'raarka'l; athu muthukaikkaatti evva'lavaay vedkappadum? ippadi moavaap than sut'ruppu'raththaar anaivarukkum pariyaasamum thikaippumaayirukkum.
ithoa, oruvan kazhukaippoal pa'ranthuvanthu, moavaapinmeal than settaika'lai virippaan.
keeriyoath pidikkappadum, koattaika'l kaivasamaakum; annaa'lilea moavaapin paraakkiramasaalika'ludaiya iruthayam pirasavaveathanaippaduki'ra sthireeyin iruthayampoala irukkum.
moavaap karththarukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattinapadiyaal, athu oru janamaayiraathapadikku azhikkappadum.
moavaap theasaththin kudiyaanavanea, thikilum, padukuzhiyum, ka'n'niyum unmeal varum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

thikilukku vilaka oaduki'ravan padukuzhiyilea vizhuvaan; padukuzhiyilirunthu ea'ruki'ravanoa ka'n'niyilea pidipaduvaan; avarka'l visaarikkappadum varushaththai athinmeal, athaavathu, moavaapinmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

valladikkuth thappa oadippoaki'ravarka'l espoanin nizhalil thariththu nin'raarka'l, aanaalum neruppu espoanilum, akkinijuvaalai seekoan naduvilumirunthu pu'rappattu, moavaap theasaththin ellaika'laiyum, kalakagnseyki'ravarka'lin uchchanthalaiyaiyum padchikkum.
moavaapea, unakku aiyoa! keamoash vikkirakaththaiyaduththa janam azhiyum, un kumaararum si'raipidikkappaduki'raarka'l, un kumaaraththika'lum si'raipidikkappattuppoaki'raarka'l.
aanaalum kadaisinaadka'lil moavaapin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar. moavaapinmeal varum niyaayaththeerppin seythi iththoadea mudinthathu.

ammoan puththiraraikku'riththuk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: isravealukkuk kumaarar illaiyoa? avanukkuch suthantharavaa'li illaiyoa? avarka'l raajaa kaaththeasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, athin janam ivan patta'nangka'lil kudiyiruppaanean?

aakaiyaal, ithoa, naadka'l varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar, appozhuthu ammoan puththirarin patta'namaakiya rappaavilea yuththaththin aarpparippaik keadkappa'n'nuvean; athu paazhaana ma'nmeadaakum; atha'rkaduththa oorka'lum akkiniyaal sutterikkappadum; aanaalum israveal than theasaththaich suthanthariththuk ko'ndavarka'lin theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

espoanea, ala'ru; aayi paazhaakkappattathu; rappaavin kumaaraththika'lea, oalamidungka'l; irattai uduththikko'ndu, pulampi, vealika'lil sut'riththiriyungka'l; avarka'l raajaa athin aasaariyarka'loadum athin pirapukka'loadungkoodach si'raippattuppoavaan.

enakku viroathamaay varuki'ravan yaar en'ru solli, un selvaththai nampina seerketta kumaaraththiyea, nee pa'l'laththaakkuka'laippat'rip perumaipaaraattuvaanean? un pa'l'laththaakkuk karainthupoaki'rathu.

ithoa, un sut'ruppu'raththaar ellaaraalum unmeal thikilai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; neengka'l avaravar thamtham mun irukkum vazhiyea oadath thuraththappaduveerka'l; valasaivaangki oaduki'ravarka'laich searppaar oruvarumillai.
atha'rkuppinpu ammoan puththirarudaiya si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
eathoamaikku'riththuch seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: theamaanilea ini gnaanamillaiyoa? aaloasanai viveakika'laivittu azhinthathoa? avarka'ludaiya gnaanam kettuppoayit'roa?
theathaanin kudika'lea, oadungka'l, muthukaik kaattungka'l, pa'l'langka'lil pathungkungka'l; easaavai visaarikkungkaalaththil avan aapaththai avanmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'rukki'ravarka'l unnidaththilea vanthaarka'laakil, pinpa'rikki'ratha'rkuk kogncham vaiyaarka'loa? iraaththiriyil thirudar vanthaarka'laakil, thangka'lukkup poathumenki'ramattum ko'l'laiyadippaarka'l allavoa?

naanoa easaavai ve'rumaiyaakki, avan o'liththukko'l'lak koodaathapadikku avanudaiya ma'raividangka'lai ve'lippaduththippoaduvean; avanudaiya santhathiyaarum avanudaiya sakoathararum avanudaiya ayalaarum azhikkappaduvaarka'l; avan ini iraan.
thikkat'ravarka'laayppoakum un pi'l'laika'lai oppuvi, naan avarka'lai uyiroadea kaappaat'ruvean; un vithavaika'l ennai nampuvaarka'laaka.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, paaththiraththil kudikkavea'ndumenki'ra niyaayaththeerppukku u'l'laayiraathavarka'l athil kudiththaarka'l; nee kut'ramat'ru neengkalaayiruppaayoa? nee neengkalaayiraamal athil nichchayamaayk kudippaay.
poas'raa paazhum ninthaiyum avaantharamum saapamumaaka irukkumen'rum, athin patta'nangka'l ellaam niththiya vanaantharangka'laayirukkumen'rum ennaikko'ndu aa'naiyittean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

neengka'l koodikko'ndu, atha'rku viroathamaaka vanthu, yuththampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku ezhumpungka'l en'ru solla, jaathika'lidaththil sthaanaathipathiyai anuppuki'ra seythiyaik karththaridaththilea kea'lvippattean.
ithoa, unnai jaathika'lukku'l'lea si'riyathum, manusharukku'l'lea asattaipa'n'nappattathumaakkuki'rean enki'raar.

kanmalai vedippuka'lil vaasampa'n'ni, meaduka'lin uchchiyaip pidiththirukki'ravanea unnaal un payangkaramum un iruthayaththin akanthaiyum unnai moasam poakkit'ru; nee kazhukaippoal uyaraththil un koottaik kattinaalum angkeayirunthu unnai vizhappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
appadiyea eathoam paazhaakum; athaik kadanthupoaki'ravan evanum athin ellaa vaathaika'linimiththamum piramiththu eesalpoaduvaan.

soathoamum komoaraavum avaika'lin sut'ruppu'rangka'lum kavizhkkappattathupoala ithuvum kavizhkkappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar; angkea oruvanum kudiyiruppathillai, athil oru manupuththiranum thangkuvathillai.

ithoa, pura'ndu oaduki'ra yoarthaanidaththilirunthu singkam varuvathupoal palavaanudaiya thaaparaththukku viroathamaaka varuki'raan; avanaich sadithiyilea angkeayirunthu oadivarappa'n'nuvean; naan atha'rku viroathamaayk katta'laiyittu anuppath therinthuko'l'lappattavan yaar? enakkuch samaanamaanavan yaar? enakku mattukkattuki'ravan yaar? enakku munpaaka nilaini'rkappoaki'ra meayppan yaar?

aakaiyaal karththar eathoamukku viroathamaaka yoasiththa aaloasanaiyaiyum, avar theamaanin kudika'lukku viroathamaaka ninaiththirukki'ra ninaivuka'laiyum kea'lungka'l; manthaiyil si'riyavarka'l meyyaakavea avarka'laip pidiththizhuppaarka'l, avarka'l irukki'ra thaaparangka'lai avar meyyaakavea paazhaakkuvaar.
avaika'lukku'l idinthuvizhum saththaththinaalea poomi athirum; kookkuralin saththam sivantha samuththiramattum keadkappadum.

ithoa, oruvan kazhukaippoala ezhumpi, pa'ranthuvanthu, than settaika'laip poas'raavinmeal virippaan; annaa'lilea eathoamudaiya paraakkiramasaalika'lin iruthayam pirasavaveathanaippaduki'ra sthireeyin iruthayampoala irukkum enki'raar.

thamaskuvaik ku'riththuch solvathu: aamaaththum arppaaththum kalangkuki'rathu; pollaatha seythiyai avarka'l keattapadiyinaal karainthupoaki'raarka'l; samuththiraththoaramaaych sagnchalamu'ndu; atha'rku amaithalillai.
thamasku tha'larnthupoam, pu'rangkaatti oadippoam; thikil athaip pidiththathu; pirasava sthireeyaippoala idukkamum veathanaika'lum athaip pidiththathu.
santhoashamaana en ooraakiya anthap pukazhchchiyu'l'la nakaram thappavidappadaama'rpoayit'rea!
aathalaal athin vaalipar athin veethika'lil vizhunthu, yuththamanushar ellaarum annaa'lilea sangkaaramaavaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
thamaskuvin mathilka'lil theekko'luththuvean; athu penaathaaththin aramanaika'laip padchikkum enki'raar.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar mu'riyadikkum keathaaraiyum kaathsoarudaiya raajyangka'laiyum ku'riththuk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ezhumpi, keathaarukku viroathamaakap poay, keezhththisaip puththiraraip paazhaakkungka'l.

avarka'ludaiya koodaarangka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya manthaika'laiyum vaangki, avarka'ludaiya thiraika'laiyum avarka'ludaiya ellaath thattumuttuka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya ottakangka'laiyum thangka'lukken'ru ko'ndupoay, eththisaiyum payam en'ru solli, avarka'lmeal aarpparippaarka'l.

kaathsoarin kudika'lea, oadi, thooraththil alaiyungka'l; pa'l'laththil othungkip pathungkungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ungka'lukku viroathamaaka aaloasanaiseythu, ungka'lukku viroathamaaka upaayangka'laich sinthiththirukki'raan.

agnchaamal nirvisaaramaayk kudiyirukki'ra jaathikku viroathamaaka ezhumpippoangka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; atha'rku vaasalka'lumillai, thaazhppaa'lka'lumillai; avarka'l thanippadath thangkiyirukki'raarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya ottakangka'l ko'l'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya aadumaaduka'lin earaa'lam soo'raiyumaakum; naan avarka'laich sakala thisaika'lumaana kadaiyaanthara moolaika'lil irukki'ravarka'lidaththukkuch sitha'radiththuvittu, athinudaiya sakala pakkangka'lilumirunthu avarka'lukku aapaththai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aathsoar valusarppangka'lin thaaparamaaki, en'ren'raikkum paazhaaykkidakkum; oruvanum angkea kudiyiruppathillai, oru manupuththiranum athilea thangkuvathumillaiyenki'raar.
yoothaa raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaavinudaiya raajyapaaraththin thuvakkaththilea, ealaamukku viroathamaaka ereamiyaa ennum theerkkatharisikku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam:
seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan ealaamin villennum avarka'ludaiya pirathaana vallamaiyai mu'riththuppoattu,

vaanaththin naalu thisaika'lilumirunthu naalu kaat'ruka'lai ealaaminmeal varappa'n'ni, avarka'lai intha ellaath thisaika'lilum sitha'radippean; ealaam theasaththilirunthu thuraththu'ndavarka'l sakala jaathika'lilum sitha'rappaduvaarka'l.

naan ealaamiyarai avarka'l saththurukka'lukku munpaakavum, avarka'l piraa'nanai vaangkath theaduki'ravarka'lukku munpaakavum kalangkappa'n'ni, en koapaththin ukkiramaakiya theengkai avarka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumattum pattayaththai avarka'lukkup pinnaaka anuppi,
en singkaasanaththai ealaamilea vaiththu, angkeayirunthu raajaavaiyum pirapukka'laiyum azhiththuppoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aanaalum kadaisinaadka'lilea naan ealaamin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththar theerkkatharisiyaakiya ereamiyaavaikko'ndu paapiloanukkum kaltheayar theasaththukkum viroathamaaka uraiththa vasanam:

paapiloan pidipattathu; peal vedkappattathu; merothaak no'rungku'ndathu; athinudaiya silaika'l ilachchaiyadainthathu; athinudaiya vikkirakangka'l no'rungkippoayina en'ru jaathika'lukku'l'lea a'riviththup pirasiththampa'n'nungka'l; ithai ma'raikkaamal kodiyeat'ri vi'lamparampa'n'nungka'l.
atha'rku viroathamaay vadakkeayirunthu oru jaathi vanthu, athin theasaththaip paazhaakkippoadum; athilea kudiyiruppaarillai; manusharoadea mirukangka'lum oadippoayvidum.

annaadka'lilum akkaalaththilum israveal puththirar varuvaarka'l; avarka'lum yoothaa puththirarum eakamaay azhuthu, nadanthuvanthu, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraith theaduvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ma'rakkappadaatha niththiya udanpadikkaiyinaal naam karththaraich searnthuko'lvoam vaarungka'l en'ru seeyoanukku nearaay mukangka'laith thiruppi, seeyoanukkup poaki'ra vazhi ethuven'ru keattu visaarippaarka'l.

en janangka'l kaa'naama'rpoana aaduka'l, avarka'ludaiya meaypparka'l avarka'laich sitha'rappa'n'ni, parvathangka'lil alaiyavittaarka'l; oru malaiyilirunthu ma'rumalaikkup poanaarka'l; thangka'l thozhuvaththai ma'ranthuvittaarka'l.

avarka'laik ka'ndupidiththavarka'l ellaarum avarka'laip padchiththaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'l: engka'lmeal kut'ramillai; avarka'l neethiyin vaasasthalaththilea karththarukku viroathamaaka, thangka'l pithaakka'l nampina karththarukku viroathamaakavea, paavagnseythaarka'l en'raarka'l.
paapiloanin naduvilirunthoadi, kaltheayarin theasaththaivittup pu'rappattu, manthaiyin munnadakkum kadaakka'laippoal irungka'l.

ithoa, naan paapiloanukku viroathamaaka vadatheasaththil irukkum periya jaathika'lin koottaththai ezhuppi, athai varappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l atha'rku viroathamaaka aayaththampa'n'nuvaarka'l; angkeayirunthu varuki'ravarka'laal athu pidikkappadum; avarka'ludaiya ampuka'l saamarththiyamu'l'la paraakkiramasaaliyin ampuka'laippoal irukkum; avaika'l viruthaavaayth thirumpuvathillai.
kaltheayaa ko'l'laiyaakum: athaik ko'l'laiyiduki'ravarka'l ellaarum paripoora'namadaivaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
en suthantharaththaik ko'l'laiyitta neengka'l santhoashiththeerka'lea, ka'likoorntheerka'lea, pulmeaynthu kozhuththa kadaariyaippoal pooriththu, valiyarishapampoal mukkaaram poaduki'reerka'lea.
ungka'l thaay mikavum vedki, ungka'laip pet'rava'l naa'namadaivaa'l; ithoa, ava'l jaathika'lukku'l'lea kadaisiyaavathuman'ri, vanaantharamum va'radchiyum antharave'liyumaavaa'l.
karththarin koapaththinaalea athu kudiyat'rathum perumpaazhumaayirukkum; paapiloanaik kadanthupoaki'ra evanum athin ellaa vaathaika'linimiththamum piramiththu, eesalpoaduvaan.

neengka'l ellaarum paapiloanukku viroathamaaych sut'rilum a'nivakuththu nin'ru, villai naa'neat'ri, athinmeal ampuka'lai eyyungka'l; ampuchselavaip paaraatheayungka'l; athu, karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythathu.

atha'rku viroathamaaych sut'rilum aarppariyungka'l; athu thannaik kaiya'liththathu; athin asthipaarangka'l vizhunthathu, athin mathilka'l idikkappattathu; ithu karththar vaangkum pazhi; athinidaththil pazhivaangkungka'l; athu seythathupoalavea neengka'lum atha'rkuch seyyungka'l.

vithaivithaikki'ravanaiyum a'ruppukkaalaththil arivaa'laip pidikki'ravanaiyum paapiloanil iraathapadich sangkaarampa'n'nungka'l; kolluki'ra pattayaththukkuth thappa avaravar thangka'l janaththa'ndaikkuth thirumpikko'ndu, avaravar thangka'l theasaththukku oadippoavaarka'l.

israveal the'rippattuppoana aadu, singkangka'l athaith thuraththina; muthalil aseeriyaa raajaa athaip padchiththaan; kadaisiyil paapiloan raajaavaakiya intha neapukaathneachchaar athin elumpuka'lai mu'riththaan.
aakaiyaal, isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan aseeriyaa raajaavaith tha'ndiththathupoal paapiloan raajaavaiyum avan theasaththaiyum tha'ndiththu,
isravealai athin vaasasthalaththukkuth thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu athu karmealilum paasaanilum meayum; eppiraayeemin malaika'lilum keeleayaaththilum athin aaththumaa thirupthiyaakum.

annaadka'lilum akkaalaththilum isravealin akkiramam theadappattaalum athu kaa'naathirukkum; yoothaavin paavangka'l theadappattaalum avaika'l kidaiyaathirukkum; naan meethiyaaka vaikki'ravarka'lukku mannippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

merathaayeem theasaththukku viroathamaakavum peakoadu kudika'lukku viroathamaakavum nee poay, avarka'laith thuraththi, yaavaiyum paazhaakkich sangkaarampa'n'ni, naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyellaam sey en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
theasaththilea yuththaththin saththamum makaa sangkaaramum u'ndu.
sarva poomiyin sammatti eppadi mu'riththu udaikkappattathu! jaathika'lukku'l'lea paapiloan eppadip paazhaayppoayit'ru!
paapiloanea, unakkuk ka'n'niyai vaiththean, nee athai a'riyaamal athilea sikku'ndupoanaay; nee akappattum pidipattum poanaay, nee karththaroadea yuththangkalanthaayea.

karththar thammudaiya aayuthasaalaiyaith thi'ranthu, thammudaiya sinaththin asthiraayuthangka'lai eduththukko'ndu vanthaar; ithu kaltheayar theasaththilea seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar seyki'ra kiriyai.

kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu atha'rku viroathamaaka vanthu, athin ka'lagnchiyangka'laith thi'ranthu, kuviyal kuviyalaakak kuviththu, athil on'rum meethiyaakaathapadikku athai mut'rilum azhiththuppoadungka'l.
athin kaa'laika'laiyellaam vettungka'l; avaika'l kolaikka'lam searakkadavathu; aiyoa! avarka'l visaarikkappadum naa'l vanthathea.

nammudaiya theavan pazhivaangkinathai, avar thamathu aalayaththukkaakap pazhivaangkinathaiyea, seeyoanilea a'rivikkumpadikku, paapiloan theasaththilirunthu thappiyoadivanthavarka'lin saththam keadkappadum.

paapiloanukku viroathamaay varumpadi vilveerarai azhaiyungka'l; vil va'laikki'ravarka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum atha'rku viroathamaaych sut'rilum paa'layami'rangkungka'l, oruvaraiyum thappavidaathirungka'l; athin kiriyaikkuththakka palanai atha'rkuch sarikkattungka'l; athu seythathinpadiyellaam atha'rkuch seyyungka'l; athu isravealin parisuththaraakiya karththarukku viroathamaaka idumpuseythathu.
aakaiyaal athin vaalipar athin veethika'lil vizhuvaarka'l; athin yuththaveerar ellaarum annaa'lilea sangkaaramaavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, idumpu'l'lavanea, naan unakku viroathamaaka varuki'rean en'ru seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; naan unnai visaarikkungkaalamaakiya unnudaiya naa'l vanthathu.
idumpu'l'lavan ida'rivizhuvaan; avanai eduththu ni'ruththuvaarillai; naan avanudaiya patta'nangka'lil akkiniyaik ko'luththuvean, athu avan sut'ruppu'raththaar ellaaraiyum padchikkum.

seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: israveal puththirarum yoothaa puththirarum eakamaay odungku'ndaarka'l; avarka'laich si'raiyaakkina yaavarum avarka'lai vidamaattoam en'ru kettiyaayp pidiththukko'ndaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya meedparoavenil vallamaiyu'l'lavar, seanaika'lin karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam; theasaththai i'laippaa'rappa'n'nuvatha'rkum, paapiloan kudika'laith thaththa'likkappa'n'nuvatha'rkum avarka'ludaiya vazhakkai avar nadaththuvaar.
pattayam kaltheayarmealum, paapiloan kudika'lmealum, athinudaiya pirapukka'lmealum, athinudaiya gnaanika'lmealum varumen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
pattayam poyka'laip pi'naikki'ravarka'lmealum varum; avarka'l paiththiyakkaararaavaarka'l; pattayam athin paraakkiramasaalika'lmealum varum, avarka'l kalangkuvaarka'l.

pattayam athin kuthiraika'lmealum, athin irathangka'lmealum, athin naduvil irukki'ra palajaathiyaana janangka'l yaavarmealum varum, avarka'l peadika'laavaarka'l; pattayam athin pokkishangka'linmeal varum, avaika'l ko'l'laiyaakum.
va'radchi athin tha'n'neerka'lmeal varum, avaika'l va'ra'ndupoam; athu vikkiraka theasam; arukka'lippaana silaika'linmeal manamayangkiyirukki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal kaattumirukangka'lum oarika'lum athilea kudiyirukkum; koattaanka'l athilea thangkum; ini en'ren'raikkum athu kudiyeat'rappaduvathillai; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka oruvarum athil sagncharippathumillai.

theavan soathoamaiyum komoaraavaiyum athin sut'ruppu'rangka'laiyum kavizhththuppoattathupoala ithaiyum kavizhththuppoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; oruvarum athil kudiyiruppathillai, oru manupuththiranum athil thangkuvathumillai.
ithoa, vadakkeayirunthu oru janamum periya jaathiyum varum; poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu palaththa raajaakka'l ezhumpuvaarka'l.

avarka'l villum vealum pidiththuvaruvaarka'l; avarka'l irakkamillaatha kodiyar; avarka'l iraichchal samuththira iraichchalpoal irukkum; paapiloan kumaaraththiyea, avarka'l unakku viroathamaaka yuththaththukku aayaththappatta aadka'laayk kuthiraika'linmeal ea'ri varuvaarka'l.
avarka'l varuki'ra seythiyai paapiloan raajaa keadkaiyil avan kaika'l tha'larum; idukkamum pirasava veathanaippaduki'rava'lukku'ndaakum veathanaiyaippoan'ra veathanaiyum avanaip pidikkum.

ithoa, pura'ndu oaduki'ra yoarthaanilirunthu singkaththaippoal palavaanudaiya thaaparaththukku viroathamaaka varuki'raan; avanai angkeayirunthu sadithiyilea oadivarappa'n'nuvean; naan atha'rku viroathamaakak katta'laiyittu, anuppath therinthuko'l'lappattavan yaar? enakkuch samaanamaanavan yaar? enakkuth thittagnsolpavan yaar? enakku munpaaka ni'rkappoaki'ra meayppan yaar?

aakaiyaal karththar paapiloanukku viroathamaaka yoasiththa aaloasanaiyaiyum, avar kaltheayar theasaththukku viroathamaaka ninaiththirukki'ra ninaivuka'laiyum kea'lungka'l; meyyaakavea manthaiyil si'riyavarka'l avarka'laip pidiththizhuppaarka'l; meyyaakavea avarka'l irukki'ra thaaparangka'lai avar paazhaakkuvaar.
paapiloan pidipattathin saththaththinaal poomi athirum, athin kooppiduthal jaathika'lukku'l'lea keadkappadum.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan paapiloanukku viroathamaakavum, enakku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ravarka'lin maththiyil kudiyirukki'ravarka'lukku viroathamaakavum azhikkum kaat'rai ezhumpappa'n'ni,
thoot'ruvaaraip paapiloanukku anuppuvean; avarka'l athaiththoot'ri, ve'rumaiyaakkippoaduvaarka'l; aapaththunaa'lilea atha'rku viroathamaaych soozhnthuko'ndiruppaarka'l.

villai naa'neat'ruki'ravanukku viroathamaakavum, than kavasaththil perumaipaaraattuki'ravanukku viroathamaakavum, vilveeran than villai naa'neat'rakkadavan; athin vaaliparaith thappavidaamal athin seanaiyai ellaam sangkaarampa'n'nungka'l.
kuththippoadappattavarka'l kaltheayarin theasaththilum, kolaiseyyappattavarka'l athin veethika'lilum vizhuvaarka'l.
avarka'l theasam isravealin parisuththarukku viroathamaakach seytha akkiramaththinaal ni'rainthirunthum, yoothaa than theavanaalum israveal seanaika'lin karththaraalum kaividappadavillai.

neengka'l paapiloanin akkiramaththil sangkaaramaakaathapadikku athin naduvilirunthu oadi, avaravar thangka'l aaththumaavaith thappuviyungka'l; ithu karththar athinidaththil pazhivaangkuki'ra kaalamaayirukki'rathu; avar atha'rkup pathil seluththuvaar.
paapiloan karththarudaiya kaiyilu'l'la po'rpaaththiram; athu poomi anaiththaiyum ve'rikkappa'n'ninathu; athin mathuvai jaathika'l kudiththaarka'l; aakaiyaal jaathika'l puththimayangkippoanaarka'l.
paapiloan sadithiyil vizhunthu thakarnthathu; atha'rkaaka ala'rungka'l; athin noavai aat'rap pisin thailam poadungka'l; oruvea'lai ku'namaakum.

paapiloanaik ku'namaakkumpadip paarththoam, athu ku'namaakavillai; athai vittuvidungka'l; naam avaravar nammudaiya theasangka'lukkup poakakkadavoam; athin aakkinai vaanamattum ea'ri aakaayama'ndalangka'l pariyantham ettinathu.
karththar nammudaiya neethiyai ve'lippaduththinaar; nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarin seyalaich seeyoanil vivarippoam vaarungka'l.

ampuka'laith thulakkungka'l; keadakangka'lai nan'raaych seppanidungka'l; karththar meathiyarudaiya raajaakka'lin aaviyai ezhuppinaar; paapiloanai azhikkavea'ndumenpathea avarudaiya ninaivu; ithu karththar vaangkum pazhi, ithu thamathu aalayaththukkaaka avar vaangkum pazhi.

paapiloanin mathilka'lmeal kodiyeat'rungka'l, kaavalaip palappaduththungka'l, jaamang kaakki'ravarka'lai ni'ruththungka'l, pathiviruppaarai vaiyungka'l; aanaalum karththar eppadi ninaiththaaroa appadiyea thaam paapiloanin kudika'lukku viroathamaakach sonnathaich seyvaar.
thira'laana tha'n'neerka'linmeal vaasampa'n'nuki'rava'lea, thira'nda sampaththudaiyava'lea, unakku mudivum un poru'laasaikku ozhivum vanthathu.

meyyaakavea, pachchaikki'lika'laippoal thira'laana manusharaal unnai nirampappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l unmeal aaravaarampa'n'nuvaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar thammudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittaar.
avar poomiyaith thamathu vallamaiyinaal u'ndaakki, poochchakkaraththaith thamathu gnaanaththinaal padaiththu, vaanaththaith thamathu peara'rivinaal viriththaar.

avar saththamidukaiyil thira'laana tha'n'neer vaanaththil u'ndaaki'rathu; avar poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu meakangka'lai ezhumpappa'n'ni, mazhaiyudanea minnalka'lai u'ndaakki, kaat'raith thamathu pa'ndasaalaiyilirunthu eavividuki'raar.
manushar anaivarum a'rivillaamal miruka ku'namaanaarka'l; thattaar anaivarum suroopangka'laalea vedkippoaki'raarka'l; avarka'l vaarppiththa vikkirakam poyyea, avaika'lil suvaasam illai.
avaika'l maayaiyum makaa eththumaana kiriyaiyaayirukki'rathu; avaika'l visaarikkappadum naa'lilea azhiyum.
yaakkoapin pangkaayirukki'ravar avaika'laippoala alla, avar sarvaththaiyum u'ndaakkinavar; israveal avarudaiya suthantharamaana koaththiram; seanaika'lin karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
nee enakkuth tha'ndaayuthamum asthiraayuthamumaanavan; naan unnaikko'ndu jaathika'lai no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu raajyangka'lai azhippean.
unnaikko'ndu kuthiraiyaiyum, kuthirai veeranaiyum no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu irathaththaiyum irathaveeranaiyum no'rukkuvean.
unnaikko'ndu purushanaiyum sthireeyaiyum no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu kizhavanaiyum i'laignanaiyum no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu vaalipanaiyum kannikaiyaiyum no'rukkuvean.

unnaikko'ndu meayppanaiyum avanudaiya manthaiyaiyum no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu uzhavanaiyum avanudaiya uzhavukaa'laika'laiyum no'rukkuvean; unnaikko'ndu athipathika'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum no'rukkuvean.

paapiloanukkum kaltheayar theasaththin sakala kudika'lukkum, avarka'l ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakach seeyoanil seytha avarka'ludaiya ellaap pollaappukkaakavum pazhivaangkuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, poomiyai ellaam kedukki'ra keadaana parvathamea, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, en kaiyai unakku viroathamaaka neetti, unnaik kanmalaika'lilirunthu urutti, unnai erinthupoana parvathamaakkippoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
moolaikkallukkaakilum asthipaarakkallukkaakilum oru kallaiyum unnilirunthu edukkamaattaarka'l; nee en'ren'raikkum paazhaaykkidakki'ra sthalamaavaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

theasaththilea kodiyeat'rungka'l; jaathika'lukku'l ekkaa'lam oothungka'l; jaathika'lai atha'rku viroathamaaka aayaththappaduththungka'l; aararaath, minni, askenaas ennum raajyangka'lai atha'rku viroathamaaka varakkooppidungka'l; atha'rku viroathamaakath tha'lakarththanukkup pattangkattungka'l; su'naiyu'l'la vettukki'lika'lpoan'ra kuthiraika'lai varappa'n'nungka'l.

meathiyaatheasaththin raajaakka'lum athin thalaivarum athin sakala athikaarika'lum avaravarudaiya raajyapaaraththukkuk keezhaana sakala theasaththaarumaakiya jaathika'lai atha'rku viroathamaaka aayaththappaduththungka'l.
appozhuthu theasam athirnthu veathanaippadum; paapiloan theasaththaik kudiyillaathapadip paazhaakka, paapiloanukku viroathamaayk karththar ninaiththavaika'l nilaikkum.

paapiloanin paraakkiramasaalika'l yuththampa'n'naamal, koattaika'lil irunthuvittaarka'l; avarka'l paraakkiramam azhinthu peadika'laanaarka'l; athin vaasasthalangka'laik ko'luththippoattaarka'l; athin thaazhppaa'lka'l udaikkappattathu.

kadaiyaanthara munaithuvakki avanudaiya patta'nam pidipattathu en'rum, thu'raivazhika'l akappattuppoay, naa'nalka'l akkiniyaal sutterikkappattathu en'rum, yuththa manushar kalangkiyirukki'raarka'l en'rum paapiloan raajaavukku a'rivikka,
agncha'rkaaranmeal agncha'rkaaranum thoothanmeal thoothanum oaduki'raan.

paapiloan kumaaraththi mithikkappadung ka'laththukkuch samaanam; athaip poaradikkung kaalam vanthathu; innum kognchakkaalaththilea a'ruppukkaalam atha'rku varum en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ennaip padchiththaan, ennaik kalangkadiththaan, ennai ve'rum paaththiramaaka vaiththuppoanaan; valusarppampoala ennai vizhungki, en suvaiyu'l'la pathaarththangka'laal than vayit'rai nirappinaan, ennaith thuraththivittaan.

enakkum en inaththaarukkum seytha kodumaiyin pazhi paapiloanmeal varakkadavathen'ru seeyoanil vaasamaanava'l solluki'raa'l; en iraththappazhi kaltheayar theasaththuk kudika'linmeal varakkadavathen'ru erusaleam enpava'lum solluki'raa'l.
aakaiyaal karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan unakkaaka vazhakkaadi, un pazhikkup pazhivaangki, athin kadalai va'ra'lavum athin oot'raich suva'ravumpa'n'nuvean.
appozhuthu paapiloan kudiyillaatha ma'nmeaduka'lum, valusarppangka'lin thaaparamum, paazhum, eesalpoadappaduthalukku idamumaayppoakum.
eakamaay avarka'l singkangka'laippoalak kerchchiththu, singkakkuttika'laippoalach saththamiduvaarka'l.

avarka'l ka'likkum samayaththilea naan avarka'l kudikkum paanaththai avarka'lukkuk kudikkakkoduththu, avarka'l thu'l'laththakkathaaka avarka'lai ve'riyaakkuvean; athinaal avarka'l en'ren'raikkum vizhikkaatha niththirai adaivaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
avarka'lai aattukkuttika'laippoalavum, aattukkadaakka'laippoalavum, ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laippoalavum adikkappada i'rangkippoakap pa'n'nuvean.
seasaakku pidiyu'ndu, poomimuzhuthum pukazhum pukazhchchi akappattathu eppadi? jaathika'lukku'l'lea paapiloan piramippaanathu eppadi?
samuththiram paapiloanmeal pura'nduvanthathu; athin alaika'lin thiradchiyinaal athu moodappattathu.
athin patta'nangka'l paazhumaay, va'radchiyum vanaantharamumaana poomiyumaay, oru manushanum kudiyiraathathum oru manupuththiranum kadavaathathumaana nilamumaayppoayit'ru.
naan paapiloanil irukki'ra pealaith tha'ndippean; athu vizhungkinathai athin vaayilirunthu kakkappa'n'nuvean; jaathika'l ini athinidaththi'rku oadivaramaattaarka'l, paapiloanin mathilum vizhum.
en janangka'lea, neengka'l athin naduvilirunthu pu'rappadungka'l; karththarudaiya koapaththin ukkiraththukkuth thappumpadi avanavan thanthan aaththumaavai iradchiththukko'l'lakkadavan.

ungka'l iruthayam thuva'laamalum, theasaththil keadkappadum seythiyinaal neengka'l payappadaamalum irungka'l; oru varushaththilea oru seythi keadkappattu, pinpu ma'ruvarushaththilea vea'ru seythi keadkappadum; theasaththilea kodumai u'ndaakum; aa'luki'ravanmeal aa'luki'ravan varuvaan.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, naan paapiloanin vikkirakangka'laith tha'ndikkum naadka'l varum, appozhuthu athin theasam ellaam kalangkum; athil kolaiyu'nki'ra yaavarum athin naduvil vizhunthukidappaarka'l.
vaanamum poomiyum avaika'lilu'l'la yaavum paapiloanmeal kempeerikkum; paazhkkadikki'ravarka'l atha'rku vadakkeayirunthu varuvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
paapiloan isravealil kolaiyu'ndavarka'lai vizhappa'n'ninathupoala, paapiloanilum samastha theasangka'lilum kolaiyu'nki'ravarka'l vizhuvaarka'l.
pattayaththukkuth thappinavarka'lea, thangkiththariyaamal nadanthuvaarungka'l; thooraththilea karththarai ninaiyungka'l; erusaleam ungka'l gnaapakaththil varakkadavathu.
ninthaiyaik keattathinaal vedkappattoam; karththarudaiya aalayaththin parisuththa sthalangka'linmeal anniyar vanthathinaal naa'nam nammudaiya mukangka'lai moodit'ru.
aakaiyaal, karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan athin vikkirakangka'lukku viroathamaay visaarikkum naadka'l varum; appozhuthu athin theasamengkum kolaiyu'nki'ravarka'l kaththuvaarka'l.
paapiloan vaanapariyantham ea'rinaalum, athu than palamaana ara'nai uyarththinaalum, athaip paazhaakkuki'ravarka'l ennidaththilirunthu varuvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
paapiloanilirunthu kookkuralin saththamum, kaltheayar theasaththilirunthu makaa sangkaaramum keadkappadum.
karththar paapiloanaip paazhaakki athilu'l'la periya saththaththai ozhiyappa'n'nuvaar; avarka'ludaiya alaika'l thira'laana tha'n'neerka'laippoala iraiyum, avarka'ludaiya saththam ama'liyaayirukkum.

paapiloanaip paazhaakkuki'ravan athinmeal varuki'raan; athin paraakkiramasaalika'l pidipaduvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya villuka'l mu'rinthupoakum; sarikkattuki'ra theavanaakiya karththar nichchayamaakap pathil a'lippaar.

athin pirapukka'laiyum athin gnaanika'laiyum athin thalaivaraiyum athin athikaarika'laiyum athin paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum ve'rikkappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu avarka'l en'ren'raikkum vizhikkaatha thookkamaayth thoongki vizhuvaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar ennum naamamu'l'la raajaa solluki'raar.

paapiloanin vistheera'namaana mathilka'l mut'rilum tharaiyaakkappattu, athin uyaramaana vaasalka'l akkiniyaal sutterikkappadum; appadiyea janangka'l pirayaasappattathu viruthaavum, jaathika'l varuththappattuch sampaathiththathu akkinikku iraiyumaakumen'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
paapiloanmeal varum ellaath theengkaiyum, paapiloanukku viroathamaaka ezhuthappatta intha ellaa vasanangka'laiyum ereamiyaa oru pusthakaththil ezhuthinaan.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya sitheakkiyaa raajyapaarampa'n'num naalaam varushaththilea paapiloanukkup poana samayaththil avanoadea koodappoana maseyaavin makanaakiya neariyaavin kumaaranum saanthaku'namu'l'la pirapuvumaakiya seraayaavukku ereamiyaa theerkkatharisi ka'rpiththa vaarththai.
ereamiyaa seraayaavai noakki: nee paapiloanukku vanthapinpu nee ithaip paarththu, intha ellaa vasanangka'laiyum vaasiththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

karththaavea, intha sthalaththilea manushanum mirukamumuthalaayth thangkith tharikkaathapadikkum, athu en'ren'raikkum paazhaayk kidakkumpadikkum, athai azhiththuppoaduvean en'ru theavareer athaikku'riththu uraiththeer enpathai nee solli,
nee inthap pusthakaththai vaasiththuth theernthapoathu, athilea oru kallaikkatti, athai aippiraaththu naduvil e'rinthuvittu,

ippadiyea paapiloan muzhukippoakum, naan athinmeal varappa'n'num theengkinaal ezhunthirukkamaattaamal i'laiththu vizhuvaarka'l en'raar en'ru solluvaayaaka en'raan. ereamiyaavin vasanangka'l ivva'lavoadea mudinthathu.

sitheakkiyaa raajaavaaki'rapoathu irupaththoru vayathaayirunthaan; avan pathinoru varusham erusaleamil raajyapaarampa'n'ninaan; avanudaiya thaayinpear amooththaa'l, ava'l leepnaa ooraanaakiya ereamiyaavin kumaaraththi.
yoayaakkeem seythapadiyellaam avanum karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythaan.

erusaleamaiyum yoothaavaiyum karththar thammudaiya samukaththaivittu akat'rith theeruma'lavum, avaika'linmealu'l'la avarudaiya koapaththinaal ippadi nadanthathum allaamal, sitheakkiyaa paapiloanilea raajaavukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'ninaan.

avan raajyapaarampa'n'num onpathaam varusham paththaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarum, avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvamum erusaleamukku viroathamaay vanthu, atha'rku ethiraakap paa'layami'rangki, sut'rilum atha'rku ethiraakak koththa'langka'laik kattinaarka'l.
appadiyea sitheakkiyaa raajaavin pathinoaraam varushamattum nakaram mut'rikkai poadappattirunthathu.
naalaam maatham onpathaam theathiyilea pagncham nakaraththilea athikariththu, theasaththin janaththukku aakaaramillaamalpoayit'ru.

nakaraththin mathil idikkappattathu; appozhuthu kaltheayar nakaraththaich soozhnthirukkaiyil, yuththamanushar ellaarum iraaththirikaalaththil oadi, raajaavudaiya thoattaththin vazhiyea ira'ndu mathilka'lukkum naduvaana vaasalaal nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, vayalve'liyin vazhiyea poayvittaarka'l.

aanaalum kaltheayarudaiya iraa'nuvaththaar raajaavaip pinthodarnthu, erikoavin samanaana poomiyil sitheakkiyaavaik kittinaarka'l; appozhuthu avanudaiya iraa'nuvaththaar ellaarum avanaivittuch sitha'rippoayirunthaarka'l.

avarka'l raajaavaip pidiththu, avanai aamaaththeasaththin ooraakiya riplaavukkup paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaaridaththukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea ivanukku niyaayaththeerppuk koduththaan.
pinpu paapiloan raajaa sitheakkiyaavin kumaararai avan ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vettinaan; yoothaavin pirapukka'lellaaraiyum riplaavilea vettinaan.

sitheakkiyaavin ka'nka'laik kurudaakki, avanukku ira'ndu vilangkuka'laip poaduviththaan; pinpu paapiloan raajaa avanaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoay, avan mara'namadaiyum naa'lmattum avanaik kaaval veettil adaiththuvaiththaan.

ainthaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea, paapiloan raajaavukku munpaaka ni'rki'ravanaakiya kaava'rseanaathipathiyaana neapusaraathaan erusaleamukku vanthaan; athu neapukaathneachchaar ennum raajaa paapiloanai arasaa'luki'ra paththonpathaam varushamaayirunthathu.
avan karththarudaiya aalayaththaiyum, raajaavin aramanaiyaiyum, erusaleamilu'l'la ellaa veeduka'laiyum, ovvoru periya manithanudaiya veettaiyum akkiniyinaal sutteriththuppoattaan.
kaava'rseanaathipathiyoadiruntha kaltheayarin iraa'nuvaththaarellaarum erusaleamaich sut'rilum iruntha alangkangka'lai idiththuppoattaarka'l.

janaththil eazhaika'laana silaraiyum nakaraththil meethiyaana mat'ra janaththaiyum, paapiloan raajaavin vasamaaka oadivanthuvittavarka'laiyum, mat'ra janangka'laiyum kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan si'raika'laakak ko'ndupoanaan.
aanaal theasaththaaril eazhaika'laana silaraik kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan thiraadchaththoattakkaararaakavum payiridungkudika'laakavum vittuvaiththaan.

karththarudaiya aalayaththiliruntha ve'nkalath thoo'nka'laiyum, karththarudaiya aalayaththiliruntha aathaarangka'laiyum, ve'nkalak kadalthottiyaiyum kaltheayar udaiththuppoattu, avaika'lin ve'nkalaththaiyellaam paapiloanukku eduththukko'ndu poanaarka'l.

seppuchsattika'laiyum, saampal edukkum kara'ndika'laiyum, vettukkaththika'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum, kalayangka'laiyum, aaraathanaikkuriya sakala ve'nkalappa'nimuttuka'laiyum eduththukko'ndupoanaarka'l.

pasumponnum suththave'l'liyumaana ki'n'nangka'laiyum, thoopakalasangka'laiyum, kalangka'laiyum, sattika'laiyum, vi'lakkuththa'nduka'laiyum, kalayangka'laiyum, karakangka'laiyum kaava'rseanaathipathi eduththukko'ndaan.

saalomoan raajaa karththarudaiya aalayaththukkaakach seythu vaiththa ira'ndu thoo'nka'lum oru kadalthottiyum aathaarangka'lin keezhnin'ra pannira'ndu ve'nkala rishapangka'lum aakiya ivaika'lukkuriya ve'nkalaththukku ni'raiyillai.
anthath thoo'nka'loavenil, ovvoru thoo'num pathinettumuzha uyaramaayirunthathu; pannira'ndu muzhanool athaich sut'rum; naalu vira'rkadai athin kanam; u'l'lea kuzhaayaayirunthathu.

athinmeal ve'nkalak kumizh irunthathu; oru kumizhin uyaram ainthu muzham, kumizhilea sut'rilum pinnalum maatha'lampazhangka'lum seythirunthathu; ellaam ve'nkalamaayirunthathu; atha'rkuch sariyaay mat'rath thoo'nukkum maatha'lampazhangka'lum seythirunthathu.
tho'n'noot'raa'ru maatha'lampazhangka'l naanku thisaika'lukkum ethiraakach seythirunthathu; kumizhaich sut'rilum seythiruntha maatha'lampazhangka'l noo'ru.
kaava'rseanaathipathi pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya seraayaavaiyum, ira'ndaam aasaariyanaakiya seppaniyaavaiyum, vaasa'rpadiyin moon'ru kaava'rkaararaiyum pidiththukko'ndupoanaan.

nakaraththiloaven'raal avan yuththa manusharin visaarippukkaaranaakiya pirathaani oruvanaiyum, raajaavin manthirika'lil nakaraththil akappatta eazhupearaiyum, theasaththin janaththaich seavakam ezhuthuki'ra thalaimaiyaana sampirathiyaiyum, theasaththu janaththilea patta'naththin naduvil akappatta a'rupathupearaiyum pidiththukko'ndupoanaan.
avarka'laik kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan pidiththu, avarka'lai riplaavukkup paapiloan raajaavinidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoayvittaan.

appozhuthu paapiloan raajaa aamaath ennum theasaththin patta'namaakiya riplaavilea avarka'lai vettik kon'rupoattaan; ivvithamaaka yootharka'l thangka'l theasaththilirunthu si'raika'laayk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.
neapukaathneachchaar si'raipidiththuppoana janangka'lin thokai evva'laven'raal, eazhaam varushaththil moovaayiraththu irupaththumoon'ru yootharum,
neapukaathneachchaarudaiya pathinettaam varushaththil erusaleamilirunthu e'n'noot'ru muppaththira'ndupearka'lum ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.

neapukaathneachchaarudaiya irupaththumoon'raam varushaththil kaava'rseanaathipathiyaakiya neapusaraathaan yootharil ezhunoot'ru naa'rpaththainthupearka'laich si'raipidiththukko'ndupoanaan; aaka naalaayiraththu a'runoo'rupearka'laam.

yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeenudaiya si'raiyiruppin muppaththeazhaam varusham pannira'ndaam maatham irupaththainthaam theathiyilea, eavil merothaak ennum paapiloan raajaa, thaan raajaavaana varushaththilea, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeenaich si'raichsaalaiyilirunthu ve'lippadappa'n'ni, avan thalaiyai uyarththi,
avanoadea anpaayp peasi, avanudaiya aasanaththaith thannoadea paapiloanil iruntha raajaakka'ludaiya aasanangka'lukku mealaaka vaiththu,
avanudaiya si'raiyiruppu vasthirangka'lai maat'rinaan; avan uyiroadiruntha sakala naa'lum than samukaththil niththam poajanampa'n'numpadi seythaan.

avan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam avanudaiya mara'nanaa'l pariyanthamum, avanudaiya selavukkaakap paapiloan raajaavinaal katta'laiyaana anuthinath thittaththinpadi, anuthinamum avanukkuk kodukkappattuvanthathu.
aiyoa! janamperuththa nakari thanimaiyaaka udkaarnthirukki'raa'lea! vithavaikku oppaanaa'lea! jaathika'lil periyava'lum, seemaika'lil naayakiyumaayirunthava'l kappangkattuki'rava'laanaa'lea!

iraakkaalaththilea azhuthuko'ndirukki'raa'l, ava'ludaiya ka'n'neer ava'l kannangka'lil vadiki'rathu; ava'ludaiya neasar ellaarukku'l'lum ava'laith theat'ruvaar oruvarum illai; ava'ludaiya sineakithar ellaarum ava'lukkuth thuroakika'lum saththurukka'lumaanaarka'l.

yoothaa janangka'l upaththiravappadavum, kodumaiyaana adimaivealaiseyyavum si'raippattuppoanaarka'l. ava'l pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea thangkuki'raa'l, i'laippaa'ruthal adaiyaa'l; ava'laith thunpappaduththuki'ra yaavarum ava'lai idukkamaana idangka'lilea thodarnthupidiththaarka'l.

pa'ndikaikku varuvaar illaathathinaal, seeyoanukkup poaki'ra vazhika'l pulampuki'rathu; ava'l vaasalka'l ellaam paazhaaykkidakki'rathu; ava'l aasaariyarka'l thavikki'raarka'l; ava'l kannikaika'l sagnchalappaduki'raarka'l; ava'lukkuk kasappea u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

ava'l saththurukka'l thalaimaiyaanaarka'l, ava'l pakaignar sukiththirukki'raarka'l; ava'ludaiya thira'laana paathakangka'linimiththam karththar ava'laich sagnchalappaduththinaar; ava'l pi'l'laika'l saththuruvukku munpaakach si'raippattuppoanaarka'l.
seeyoan kumaaraththiyin azhakellaam ava'lai vittuppoayit'ru; ava'l pirapukka'l meaychchalaik kaa'naatha maanka'lukku oppaaki, thodaruki'ravanukku munpaakach saththuvamillaamal nadanthupoanaarka'l.

thanakkuch si'rumaiyum thavippum u'ndaakiya naadka'lilea erusaleam poorvanaadka'l mutha'rko'ndu thanakku u'ndaayiruntha inpamaanavaika'laiyellaam ninaikki'raa'l; ava'lukku uthaviseyvaar illaamal ava'ludaiya janangka'l saththuruvin kaiyilea vizhukaiyil, pakaignar ava'laip paarththu, ava'ludaiya oayvunaadka'laik ku'riththup pariyaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.

erusaleam mikuthiyaayp paavagnseythaa'l; aathalaal thoorasthireeyaippoalaanaa'l; ava'laik kanampa'n'ninavarka'l ellaarum ava'lai asattaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l; ava'ludaiya maanaththaik ka'ndaarka'l; ava'lum perumoochchuvittup pinnittuth thirumpinaa'l.

ava'ludaiya asoosam ava'l vasthira oarangka'lil irunthathu; thanakku varappoaki'ra mudivai ninaiyaathirunthaa'l; aakaiyaal athisayamaayth thaazhththappattuppoanaa'l; theat'ruvaar illai; karththaavea, en si'rumaiyaip paarum; pakaignan perumaipaaraattinaanea.

ava'ludaiya inpamaana ellaavat'rinmealum saththuru than kaiyai neettinaan; ummudaiya sapaiyilea varalaakaathen'ru theavareer vilakkiya pu'rajaathiyaar umathu parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasiththathaik ka'ndaa'l.

ava'ludaiya janangka'lellaarum appantheadith thavikki'raarka'l; thangka'l uyiraik kaappaat'rath thangka'ludaiya inpamaanavaika'lai aakaaraththukken'ru koduththuvittaarka'l; karththaavea, noakkippaarum; e'n'namat'rava'laaneanea.

vazhiyil nadanthupoaki'ra sakala janangka'lea, ithaikku'riththu ungka'lukkuk kavaiyillaiyaa? karththar thamathu ukkiramaana koapamoo'nda naa'lilea ennaich sagnchalappaduththinathinaal enakku u'ndaana en thukkaththukkuch sariyaana thukkam u'ndoa en'ru ennai noakkippaarungka'l.

uyaraththilirunthu en elumpuka'lil akkiniyai anuppinaar, athu avaika'lil pat'riyeriki'rathu; en kaalka'lukku valaiyai veesinaar; ennaip pinnittu vizhappa'n'ninaar; ennaip paazhaakkinaar; niththam naan paladchayappattup poaki'rean.

en paathakangka'lin nukam avarudaiya kaiyaal poottappattirukki'rathu; avaika'l pi'naikkappattu en kazhuththaich sut'rikko'ndathu; en pelanai vizhappa'n'ninaar; naan ezhunthirukkak koodaathapadikku aa'ndavar ennai odukkuki'ravarka'lin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar.

ennilu'l'la paraakkiramasaalika'laakiya ennudaiyavarka'lellaaraiyum aa'ndavar mithiththuppoattaar; en vaaliparai no'rukkumpadi enakku viroathamaay oru koottaththai varavazhaiththaar; thiraadchappazhaththai aalaiyil mithikki'rathupoala, aa'ndavar yoothaa kumaaraththiyaakiya kannikaiyai mithiththaar.

ivaika'linimiththam naan azhuki'rean; en ka'n, en ka'n'nea neeraaych soriki'rathu; en uyiraik kaappaat'rith theat'ruki'ravar ennai vittuth thooramaanaar; pakaignan mea'rko'ndathinaal en pi'l'laika'l paazhaayppoanaarka'l.

seeyoan than kaika'lai virikki'raa'l; ava'laith theat'ruvaar oruvarumillai; karththar yaakkoapin sut'ruppu'raththaarai avanukkuch saththurukka'laakak katta'laiyittaar; avarka'lukku'l'lea erusaleam thoorasthireekku oppaanaa'l.

karththar neethiparar; avarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaay naan ezhumpinean; janangka'lea, neengka'l ellaarum ithaik keattu en thukkaththaip paarungka'l; en kannikaika'lum en vaaliparum si'raippattuppoanaarka'l.

ennaich sineakiththavarka'laik kooppittean, avarka'loa ennai moasampoakkinaarka'l; en aasaariyarka'lum en moopparka'lum thangka'l uyiraik kaappaat'rath thangka'lukku appantheadukaiyil nakaraththil moochchodungki maa'ndaarka'l.

karththaavea, paarum, naan nerukkappaduki'rean; en kudal kothikki'rathu; naan kadunthuroakampa'n'ninapadiyinaal en iruthayam viyaakulappaduki'rathu; ve'liyilea pattayam ennaip pi'l'laiyat'rava'laakkit'ru, veettukku'l'lea mara'nam vanthirukki'rathu.

naan thavikki'rathai avarka'l keattaalum ennaith theat'ruvaar oruvarum illai; en pakaignar ellaarum enakku vantha aapaththaik keattu, theavareer athaich seythapadiyaal santhoashamaayirukki'raarka'l; neer koo'rina naa'lai varappa'n'nuveer, appozhuthu avarka'lum ennaippoalaavaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya pollaappellaam umathu mukaththukku munpaaka varakkadavathu. en sakala paathakangka'linimiththamum neer enakkuch seythathupoala avarka'lukkum seyyum; en perumoochchuka'l mikuthiyaayina, en iruthayam paladchayamaayirukki'rathu.

aiyoa! aa'ndavar thamathu koapaththil seeyoan kumaaraththiyai manthaaraththinaal moodinaar; avar thamathu koapaththin naa'lilea thamathu paathapeedaththai ninaiyaamal isravealin makimaiyai vaanaththilirunthu tharaiyilea vizhaththa'l'linaar.

aa'ndavar thappavidaamal yaakkoapin vaasasthalangka'laiyellaam vizhungkinaar; avar yoothaa kumaaraththiyin ara'nka'laiyellaam thamathu sinaththilea idiththu, tharaiyoadea tharaiyaakkippoattaar; raajyaththaiyum athin pirapukka'laiyum parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinaar.

avar thamathu ukkirakoapaththilea isravealin kompu muzhuvathaiyum vettippoattaar; saththuruvukku munpaaka avar thamathu valathukaraththaip pinnaakath thiruppi, sut'rilum iruppathaip padchikki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyaippoal yaakkoapukku viroathamaaka eriththaar.

pakaignanaippoal thammudaiya villai naa'neat'rinaar; saththuruvaippoal thammudaiya valathukaraththai neettinin'ru, ka'n'nukku inpamaanathaiyellaam azhiththuppoattaar; seeyoan kumaaraththiyin koodaaraththilea thammudaiya ukkiraththai akkiniyaippoal soriyappa'n'ninaar.

aa'ndavar pakaignanpoalaanaar; isravealai vizhungkinaar; athin aramanaika'laiyellaam vizhungkinaar; athin ara'nka'lai azhiththu, yoothaa kumaaraththikku mikuntha thukkippaiyum salippaiyum u'ndaakkinaar.

thoattaththin vealiyaippoala iruntha thammudaiya vealiyaip palavanthamaayp pidungkippoattaar; sapaikooduki'ra thammudaiya sthalangka'lai azhiththaar; karththar seeyoanilea pa'ndikaiyaiyum oayvunaa'laiyum ma'rakkappa'n'ni, thamathu ukkiramaana koapaththil raajaavaiyum aasaariyanaiyum pu'rakka'niththuvittaar.

aa'ndavar thamathu palipeedaththai ozhiththuvittaar; thamathu parisuththa sthalaththai ve'ruththuvittaar; athinudaiya aramanaika'lin mathilka'laich saththuruvin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; pa'ndikainaa'lil aaravaarampa'n'nuki'rathupoal karththarin aalayaththil aaravaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.

karththar seeyoan kumaaraththiyin alangkaththai nirmoolamaakka ninaiththaar; noolaippoattaar; azhikkaathapadith thammudaiya kaiyai avar mudakkikko'ndathillai; ara'nippaiyum alangkaththaiyum pulampachseythaar; avaika'l mut'rilum pelanat'ruk kidakki'rathu.

ava'l vaasalka'l tharaiyil amizhnthikkidakki'rathu; ava'l thaazhppaa'lka'lai mu'riththu udaiththuppoattaar; ava'l raajaavum ava'l pirapukka'lum pu'rajaathiyaarukku'l irukki'raarka'l; veathamumillai; ava'l theerkkatharisika'lukkuk karththaraal tharisanam kidaikki'rathumillai.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyin moopparka'l tharaiyil udkaarnthu maunamaay irukki'raarka'l; thangka'l thalaika'linmeal puzhuthiyaip poattukko'l'luki'raarka'l; irattu uduththiyirukki'raarka'l; erusaleamin kanniyarka'l thalaikavizhnthu tharaiyai noakkikko'ndirukki'raarka'l.

en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyin no'rungkuthalinimiththam ka'n'neer soriki'rathinaal en ka'nka'l pooththuppoaki'rathu; en kudalka'l kothikki'rathu; en eeral i'lakith tharaiyilea vadiki'rathu; kuzhanthaika'lum paalakarum nakaraththin veethika'lilea moorchchiththukkidakki'raarka'l.

avaika'l kuththu'ndavarka'laippoala nakaraththin veethika'lilea moorchchiththukkidakkumpoathum, thangka'l thaayka'lin madiyilea thangka'l piraa'nanai vidumpoathum, thangka'l thaayka'lai noakki: thaaniyamum thiraadcharasamum engkea enki'raarka'l.

erusaleam kumaaraththiyea, naan unakkuch saadchiyaaka ennaththaich solluvean? unnai etha'rku oppiduvean? seeyoan kumaaraththiyaakiya kannikaiyea, naan unnaith theat'rumpadikku unnai etha'rku nikarsolluvean? un kaayam samuththiraththaippoal perithaayirukki'rathea, unnaik ku'namaakkuki'ravan yaar?

un theerkkatharisika'l apaththamum viyarththamumaana tharisanangka'lai unakkaakath tharisiththaarka'l; avarka'l un si'raiyiruppai vilakkumpadi un akkiramaththai eduththukkaattaamal, apaththamaanavaika'laiyum keadaanavaika'laiyum unakkaakath tharisiththaarka'l.

vazhippoakkar yaavarum unpearil kai kottuki'raarka'l; erusaleam kumaaraththiyinpearil eesa'rpoattu, thangka'l thalaika'laith thulukki: poora'navadivum sarvapoomiyin makizhchchiyumaana nakaram ithuthaanaa enki'raarka'l.

un pakaignar ellaarum unpearil thangka'l vaayaith thi'rakki'raarka'l; eesa'rpoattup pa'rkadikki'raarka'l; athai vizhungkinoam, naam kaaththiruntha naa'l ithuvea, ippozhuthu namakkuk kidaiththathu, athaik ka'ndoam enki'raarka'l.

karththar thaam ninaiththathaich seythaar; poorvanaadka'l mutha'rko'ndu thaam katta'laiyitta thamathu vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rinaar; avar thappavidaamal nirmoolamaakki, unmeal pakaignan santhoashikkumpadi seythaar; un saththurukka'lin kompai uyarththinaar.

avarka'l iruthayam aa'ndavarai noakkik kooppiduki'rathu; seeyoan kumaaraththiyin mathilea, iravum pakalum nathiyavva'lavu ka'n'neer vidu, oaynthiraathea, un ka'n'nin ka'ruppuvizhi summaayirukkavottaathea.

ezhunthiru, iraaththiriyilea mutha'rsaamaththil kooppidu; aa'ndavarin samukaththil un iruthayaththaith tha'n'neeraippoala oot'rividu; ellaath therukka'lin munaiyilum pasiyinaal moorchchiththuppoaki'ra un kuzhanthaika'lin piraa'nanukkaaka un kaika'lai avaridaththi'rku ea'redu.

karththaavea, yaarukku inthappirakaaramaakach seytheeren'ru noakkippaarum; sthireeka'l kaikkuzhanthaika'laakiya thangka'l karppakkaniyaith thinnavea'ndumoa? aa'ndavarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil aasaariyanum theerkkatharisiyum kolaiseyyappadavea'ndumoa?

i'laignanum muthirvayathu'l'lavanum therukka'lil tharaiyilea kidakki'raarka'l; en kannikaika'lum en vaaliparum pattayaththaal vizhunthaarka'l; umathu koapaththin naa'lilea vetti, avarka'laith thappavidaamal kon'rupoatteer.

pa'ndikainaa'lil kumpuka'lai varavazhaippathupoal sut'rilumirunthu enakkuth thikilka'lai varavazhaiththeer; karththarudaiya koapaththin naa'lilea thappinavanum meethiyaanavanumillai; naan kaika'lil eanthi va'larththavarka'lai en pakaignan naasampa'n'ninaan.
aa'ndavarudaiya sinaththin milaat'rinaal u'ndaana si'rumaiyaik ka'nda purushan naan.
avar ennai ve'lichchaththilea alla, iru'lilea azhaiththu nadaththivanthaar.
avar thamathu kaiyai enakku viroathamaakavea niththamum thiruppinaar.
en sathaiyaiyum en thoalaiyum mut'ralaakkinaar; en elumpuka'lai no'rukkinaar.
avar enakku viroathamaakak koththa'langkatti, kasappinaalum varuththaththinaalum ennai va'lainthuko'ndaar.
poorvakaalaththil seththukkidakki'ravarka'laippoala ennai iru'laana idangka'lil kidakkappa'n'ninaar.
naan pu'rappadakkoodaathapadi ennaich soozha vealiyadaiththaar; en vilangkaip paaramaakkinaar.
naan saththamittuk kooppittaalum, en jepaththukku vazhiyai adaiththuppoattaar.
vettina ka'rka'lin suvaraal en vazhika'lai adaiththuppoattaar, en paathaika'laith thaa'rumaa'raakkinaar.
avar enakkup pathivirukki'ra karadiyum, ma'raividangka'lil thangkuki'ra singkamumaayirukki'raar.
en vazhika'lai appu'rappaduththi, ennaith thu'ndiththuppoattaar; ennaip paazhaakkivittaar.
thamathu villai naa'neat'ri, ennai ampukku ilakkaaka vaiththaar.
thammudaiya ampa'raaththoo'niyin ampuka'lai en u'l'linthiriyangka'lil padappa'n'ninaar.
naan en janaththaar yaavarukkum pariyaasamum, niththam avarka'l kinnarap paadalumaanean.
kasappinaal ennai nirappi, ettiyinaal ennai ve'rikkachseythaar.
avar parukkaikka'rka'laal en pa'rka'lai no'rukki, ennaich saampalil pura'lappa'n'ninaar.
en aaththumaavaich samaathaanaththukkuth thooramaakkinaar; sukaththai ma'ranthean.
en pelanum naan karththarukkuk kaaththiruntha nampikkaiyum azhinthupoayit'ru en'rean.
ettiyum pichchumaakiya en si'rumaiyaiyum en thavippaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
en aaththumaa avaika'lai ninaiththu ninaiththu enakku'l mu'rinthupoaki'rathu.
ithai en manathilea vaiththu, nampikkaiko'ndiruppean.
naam nirmoolamaakaathirukki'rathu karththarudaiya kirupaiyea, avarudaiya irakkangka'lukku mudivillai.
avaika'l kaalaithoa'rum puthiyavaika'l; umathu u'nmai perithaayirukki'rathu.
karththar en pangku en'ru en aaththumaa sollum; aakaiyaal avaridaththil nampikkaiko'ndiruppean.
thamakkuk kaaththirukki'ravarka'lukkum thammaith theaduki'ra aaththumaavukkum karththar nallavar.
karththarudaiya iradchippukku nampikkaiyoadu kaaththirukki'rathu nallathu.
than i'lampiraayaththil nukaththaich sumakki'rathu manushanukku nallathu.
avarea athaith thanmeal vaiththaaren'ru avan thaniththirunthu maunamaayirukkakkadavan.
nampikkaikku idamu'ndoa en'ru than vaayaith thoo'lil nuzhunthuvaanaaka.
thannai adikki'ravanukkuth than kannaththaik kaatti, ninthaiyaal ni'rainthiruppaanaaka.
aa'ndavar en'ren'raikkum kaividamaattaar.
avar sagnchalappaduththinaalum thamathu mikuntha kirupaiyinpadi irangkuvaar.
avar manappoorvamaay manupuththiraraich si'rumaiyaakkich sagnchalappaduththuki'rathillai.
oruvan poomiyil si'raippattavarka'l yaavaraiyum than kaalka'linkeezh nasukkuki'rathaiyum,
unnathamaanavarin samukaththil manusharudaiya niyaayaththaip purattuki'rathaiyum,
manushanai avanudaiya vazhakkilea maa'rupaadaakkuki'rathaiyum, aa'ndavar kaa'naathiruppaaroa?
aa'ndavar katta'laiyidaathirukkak kaariyam sampavikkum en'ru solluki'ravan yaar?
unnathamaanavarudaiya vaayilirunthu theemaiyum nanmaiyum pu'rappaduki'rathillaiyoa?
uyiru'l'la manushan mu'raiyiduvaanean? avan than paavaththukku varum tha'ndanaiyaikku'riththu mu'raiyiduki'rathenna?
naam nammudaiya vazhika'laich soathiththu aaraaynthu, karththaridaththil thirumpakkadavoam.
naam nammudaiya kaika'loadungkooda nammudaiya iruthayaththaiyum paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavanidaththi'rku ea'redukkakkadavoam.
naangka'l thuroakagnseythu, kalakampa'n'ninoam; aakaiyaal theavareer manniyaathiruntheer.
theavareer koapaththaal moodikko'ndu, engka'laith thappavidaamal pinthodarnthu kon'reer.
jepam udpiraveasikkakkoodaathapadikku ummai meakaththaal moodikko'ndeer.
janangka'lukku'l'lea engka'laik kuppaiyum aruvaruppumaakkineer.
engka'l pakaignar ellaarum engka'lukku viroathamaayth thangka'l vaayaith thi'ranthaarka'l.
thikilum padukuzhiyum paazhkkadippum sangkaaramum engka'lukku nearittathu.
en janamaakiya kumaaraththi adaintha keattinimiththam en ka'nka'lilirunthu neerkkaalka'l paayki'rathu.
karththar paraloakaththilirunthu noakkippaarkkumattum,
en ka'n idaividaamal oayvin'rich soriki'rathu.
en nakaraththinudaiya kumaaraththika'l anaivarinimiththamum, en ka'n en aaththumaavukku noavu'ndaakkuki'rathu.
mukaantharam illaamal ennaip pakaikki'ravarka'l ennai oru padchiyaippoala veattaiyaadinaarka'l.
kaava'rkidangkilea en piraa'nanai odukki, enmeethil kallai vaiththaarka'l.
tha'n'neer en thalaiyinmeal pura'ndathu; naasamaanean en'rean.
makaa aazhamaana kidangkilirunthu, karththaavea, ummudaiya naamaththaippat'rik kooppittean.
en saththaththaik keatteer; en perumoochchukkum en kooppiduthalukkum umathu seviyai adaiththukko'l'laatheayum.
naan ummai noakkik kooppitta naa'lilea neer a'nuki: payappadaathea en'reer.
aa'ndavarea, en aaththumaavin vazhakkai nadaththineer; en piraa'nanai meettukko'ndeer.
karththaavea, enakku u'ndaana aniyaayaththaik ka'ndeer; en niyaayaththaith theerum.
avarka'ludaiya ellaak kuroathaththaiyum, avarka'l enakku viroathamaaka ninaiththa ellaa ninaivuka'laiyum ka'ndeer.
karththaavea, avarka'l ninthikkum ninthaiyaiyum, avarka'l enakku viroathamaay ninaiththa ellaa ninaivuka'laiyum,
enakku viroathamaay ezhumpinavarka'lin vaaymozhika'laiyum, avarka'l naa'lmuzhuthum enakku viroathamaay yoasikkum yoasanaika'laiyum keatteer.
avarka'l udkaarnthiruppathaiyum avarka'l ezhunthiruppathaiyum noakkippaarum; naan avarka'ludaiya paadalaayirukki'rean.
karththaavea, avarka'l kaika'l seytha kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaaka avarka'lukkup palan a'lippeer.
avarka'lukku iruthaya veathanaiyaik koduppeer, ummudaiya saapam avarka'lmeal irukkum.
koapamaay avarka'laip pinthodarnthu karththarudaiya vaanangka'lin keezh iraathapadikku avarka'lai azhiththuviduveer.
aiyoa! pon mangki, pasumponmaa'ri, parisuththa sthalaththin ka'rka'l sakala veethika'lin munaiyilum kottu'ndupoayit'rea.
aiyoa! thangkaththukkoppaana vilaiyea'rappet'ra seeyoan kumaarar kuyavanudaiya kaivealaiyaana ma'npaa'ndangka'laay e'n'nappaduki'raarka'lea.
thimingkilangka'l muthalaayk kongkaika'lai neetti, thangka'l kuttika'lukkup paal kodukkum; en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyoa vanaantharaththilu'l'la theekkuruviyaippoal kurooramaayirukki'raa'lea.
kuzhanthaika'lin naavu thaakaththaal mealvaayoadea ottikko'ndirukki'rathu; pi'l'laika'l appangkeadki'raarka'l, avarka'lukkuk koduppaarillai.
rusiyaana pathaarththangka'laich saappittavarka'l veethika'lil paazhaaykkidakki'raarka'l; iraththaamparam uduththi va'larnthavarka'l kuppaimeaduka'lai a'naiththuk ko'l'luki'raarka'l.

kaichseykai illaamal oru nimishaththilea kavizhkkappatta soathoamin paavaththukku vantha tha'ndanaiyaippaarkkilum en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyin akkiramaththukku vantha tha'ndanai perithaayirukki'rathu.
ava'ludaiya nasareayar u'raintha mazhaiyaippaarkkilum suththamum, paalaippaarkkilum ve'nmaiyum, pava'laththaippaarkkilum sivappum, inthiraneelaththaippaarkkilum meaniyumaayirunthaarka'l.
ippozhuthoa avarka'ludaiya mukam kariyilum ka'ruththuppoayit'ru; veethika'lil a'riyappadaarka'l; avarka'l thoal avarka'l elumpuka'loadu ottikko'ndu, kaayntha maraththukku oppaayit'ru.
pasiyinaal kolaiyu'ndavarka'laippaarkkilum pattayaththaal kolaiyu'ndavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'laayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l vayalin varaththillaamaiyaal kuththu'ndu, karainthupoaki'raarka'l.
irakkamu'l'la sthireeka'lin kaika'l thangka'l pi'l'laika'laich samaiththana, en janamaakiya kumaaraththiyin azhivil avaika'l avarka'lukku aakaaramaayina.
karththar thamathu koapaththai ni'raiveat'ri, thamathu ukkirakoapaththai oot'ri, seeyoanil akkiniyaik ko'luththinaar; athu athin asthipaarangka'laip padchiththuppoattathu.
saththuruvum pakaignanum erusaleamin vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasippaan enki'rathaip poomiyin raajaakka'lum poochchakkaraththin sakala kudika'lum nampamaattaathirunthaarka'l.
athin naduvil neethimaanka'lin iraththaththaich sinthina athin theerkkatharisika'lin paavangka'linaalum, athin aasaariyarka'lin akkiramangka'linaalum ippadi vanthathu.
kurudarpoala veethika'lil alainthu, oruvarum avarka'l vasthirangka'laith thodakkoodaathapadi iraththaththaal ka'raippattirunthaarka'l.

vilakungka'l, theettuppattavarka'lea, thodaamal vilakungka'l, vilakungka'l, en'ru avarka'lai noakkik kooppittaarka'l; meyyaayp pa'ranthoadi alainthu poanaarka'l; inith thangkith tharikkamaattaarka'l en'ru pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sollappattathu.
karththarudaiya koapam avarka'laich sitha'radiththathu, avarka'lai ini avar noakkaar; aasaariyarudaiya mukaththaip paaraamalum muthiyoarai mathiyaamalumpoanaarka'l.
innum engka'lukkuch sakaayam varumen'ru naangka'l vee'naay ethirpaarththirunthathinaalea engka'l ka'nka'l pooththuppoayina; iradchikkamaattaatha jaathikku ethirpaarththukko'ndirunthoam.
naangka'l engka'l veethika'lil nadavaathapadikku engka'l adichsuvaduka'lai veattaiyaadinaarka'l; engka'l mudivu sameepiththathu; engka'l naadka'l ni'raivea'rippoayina; engka'l mudivu vanthuvittathu.
engka'laip pinthodarnthavarka'l aakaayaththuk kazhukuka'laippaarkkilum veakamaayirunthaarka'l; parvathangka'lmeal engka'laip pinthodarnthaarka'l; vanaantharaththil engka'lukkup pathivirunthaarka'l.

karththaraal apisheakampa'n'nappattavanum, engka'l naasiyin suvaasamaayirunthavanum avarka'ludaiya padukuzhiyil akappattaan; avanudaiya nizhalilea jaathika'lukku'l'lea pizhaiththiruppoam en'ru avanaikku'riththuch solliyirunthoamea.
oothstheasavaasiyaakiya eathoam kumaaraththiyea, santhoashiththuk ka'likooru; paaththiram unnidaththi'rkum thaa'ndivarum, appozhuthu nee ve'riththu, maanapangkamaayk kidappaay.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, un akkiramaththukku varum tha'ndanai theernthathu; avar ini unnai appu'ram si'raippattuppoakavidaar; eathoam kumaaraththiyea, un akkiramaththai avar visaarippaar; un paavangka'lai ve'lippaduththuvaar.
karththaavea, engka'lukku nearittathai ninaiththaru'lum; engka'l ninthaiyai noakkippaarum.
engka'l suthantharam anniyar vasamaakavum, engka'l veeduka'l pu'raththeasaththaarvasamaakavum thaa'ndippoayina.
thikkat'ravarka'laanoam, thakappan illai; engka'l thaayka'l vithavaika'laippoala irukki'raarka'l.
engka'l tha'n'neeraip pa'naththukku vaangkik kudikki'roam; engka'l vi'raku vilaikkirayamaay varuki'rathu.
paaragnsumanthu engka'l kazhuththu noaki'rathu; naangka'l uzhaikki'roam, engka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal illai.
appaththaal thirupthiyaakumpadi ekipthiyarukkum aseeriyarukkum engka'laik kaiya'liththoam.
engka'l pithaakka'l paavagnseythu maa'ndupoanaarka'l; naangka'l avarka'ludaiya akkiramangka'laich sumakki'roam.
adimaika'l engka'lai aa'luki'raarka'l; engka'lai avarka'l kaiyilirunthu viduvippaarillai.
vanaantharaththil irukki'ra pattayaththinaal piraa'namoasaththukku eathuvaanavarka'laay engka'l appaththaith theaduki'roam.
pagnchaththin kodumaiyinaal engka'l thoal aduppangkaraiyaippoal ka'ruththuppoayit'ru.
seeyoanil iruntha sthireeka'laiyum yoothaa patta'nangka'lil iruntha kannikaika'laiyum avamaanappaduththinaarka'l.
pirapukka'ludaiya kaika'lai avarka'l katti, avarka'lai ea'raththookkinaarka'l; muthiyoarin mukangka'l mathikkappadavillai.
vaaliparai eanthiram araikkak ko'ndupoaki'raarka'l; i'laignar vi'raku sumanthu ida'rivizhuki'raarka'l.
muthiyoarka'l vaasalka'lil udkaaruki'rathum, vaalipar kinnarangka'lai vaasikki'rathum nin'rupoayit'ru.
engka'l iruthayaththin ka'likooruthal ozhinthupoayit'ru; engka'l santhoasham thukkamaay maa'rit'ru.
engka'l thalaiyilirunthu kireedam vizhunthathu; aiyoa! naangka'l paavagnseythoamea.
athinaal engka'l iruthayam paladchayamaayit'ru; athinaal engka'l ka'nka'l iru'ndupoayina.
paazhaaykkidakki'ra seeyoan malaiyinmeal narika'l oadiththiriki'rathu.
karththaavea, neer en'ren'raikkum irukki'reer; ummudaiya singkaasanam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka nilaini'rkum.
theavareer en'raikkum engka'lai ma'ranthu, nedungkaalamaaka engka'laik kaivittiruppathenna?
karththaavea, engka'lai ummidaththil thiruppikko'l'lum, appozhuthu thirumpuvoam; poorvakaalaththilirunthathupoala engka'l naadka'laip puthiyavaika'laakkum.
engka'lai mut'rilum ve'ruththuviduveeroa? engka'lpearil kadungkoapamaayirukki'reerea!

muppathaam varusham naalaam maasam ainthaantheathiyilea, naan keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea si'raippattavarka'l naduvil irukkumpoathu, sampaviththathu ennaven'raal, vaanangka'l thi'rakkappada, naan theavatharisanangka'laik ka'ndean.
athu yoayaakkeen raajaavudaiya si'raiyiruppin ainthaam varushamaayirunthathu.

antha ainthaantheathiyilea, kaltheayar theasaththilu'l'la keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea poosiyennum aasaariyanudaiya kumaaranaakiya eseakkiyealukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, angkea karththarudaiya karam avanmeal amarnthathu.

ithoa, vadakkeayirunthu pusalkaat'rum periya meakamum, aththoadea kalantha akkiniyum varakka'ndean; athaich sut'rilum pirakaasamum, athin naduvil akkinikku'l'lirunthu vi'langkiya sokusaavin ni'ramum u'ndaayirunthathu.
athin naduvilirunthu naalu jeevanka'l thoan'rina; avaika'lin saayal manushasaayalaayirunthathu.
avaika'lil ovvon'rukkum nannaanku mukangka'lum, ovvon'rukkum nannaanku settaika'lum irunthana.

avaika'ludaiya kaalka'l nimirntha kaalka'laayirunthana; avaika'ludaiya u'l'langkaalka'l kan'rukkuttiyin u'l'langkaalka'lukku oppaayirunthana; avaika'l thulakkappatta ve'nkalaththin varu'namaay minnikko'ndirunthana.
