avaika'ludaiya settaika'linkeezh avaika'lin naalu pakkangka'lilum manushakaika'l irunthana; antha naalukkum athinathin mukangka'lum athinathin settaika'lum u'ndaayirunthana.
avaika'l ovvon'rin settaika'lum mat'rathin settaika'loadea searnthirunthana; avaika'l sellukaiyil thirumpaamal ovvon'rum thanthan thisaikku nearmukamaaych sen'rana.
avaika'ludaiya mukangka'lin saayalaavathu, valathupakkaththil naalum manushamukamum singkamukamum, idathupakkaththil naalum eruthu mukamum kazhuku mukamumaayirunthana.

avaika'ludaiya mukangka'l ippadiyirukka, avaika'ludaiya settaika'l mealea pirinthirunthana, ovvon'rukkumu'l'la ira'ndira'ndu settaika'l on'roadon'ru searnthirunthana; mat'ra ira'ndira'ndu settaika'l avaika'ludaiya udalka'lai moodina.
avaika'l ovvon'rum thanthan thisaikku nearmukamaaych sen'rathu; aavi poakavea'ndumen'riruntha evvidaththukkum avaika'l poayina; poakaiyil avaika'l thirumpippaarkkavillai.

jeevanka'ludaiya saayal eppadiyirunthathen'raal, avaika'l eriki'ra akkiniththazhalin thoat'ramum theevarththika'lin thoat'ramumaayirunthathu; antha akkini jeevanka'lukku'l'lea ulaavip pirakaasamaayirunthathu; akkiniyilirunthu minnal pu'rappattathu.
antha jeevanka'l minnalin thoat'rampoala oadiththirinthana.
naan antha jeevanka'laip paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, poomiyil jeevanka'la'ndaiyilea naalu mukangka'laiyudaiya oru sakkaraththaik ka'ndean.

sakkarangka'lin roopamum avaika'lin vealaiyum padikappachchai varu'namaayirunthathu; avaika'l naalukkum oreavitha saayal irunthathu; avaika'lin roopamum avaika'lin vealaiyum sakkaraththukku'l sakkaram irukkumaapoal irunthathu.
avaika'l oadukaiyil thangka'l naalu pakkangka'lilum oadum, oadukaiyil avaika'l thirumpuki'rathillai.
avaika'lin vattangka'l payangkarappadaththakka uyaramaayirunthana; antha naalu vattangka'lum sut'rilum ka'nka'laal ni'rainthirunthana.
antha jeevanka'l sellumpoathu, anthach sakkarangka'l avaika'l arukea oadina; antha jeevanka'l poomiyilirunthu ezhumpumpoathu sakkarangka'lum ezhumpina.

aavi poakavea'ndumen'riruntha evvidaththukkum avaika'l poayina; avvidaththukku avaika'lin aaviyum poakavea'ndumen'rirunthathu; sakkarangka'lum avaika'lin arukea ezhumpina; jeevanudaiya aavi sakkarangka'lil irunthathu.

avaika'l sellumpoathu ivaika'lum sen'rana; avaika'l ni'rkumpoathu ivaika'lum nin'rana; avaika'l poomiyilirunthu ezhumpumpoathu, sakkarangka'lum avaika'l arukea ezhumpina; jeevanudaiya aavi sakkarangka'lil irunthathu.
jeevanudaiya thalaika'linmeal piramikkaththakka vachchirappirakaasamaana oru ma'ndalam irunthathu; athu avaika'ludaiya thalaika'linmeal uyara virinthirunthathu.

ma'ndalaththinkeezh avaika'ludaiya settaika'l on'rukkon'ru ethirnearaay virinthirunthana; thangka'lthangka'l udalka'lai moodikko'l'luki'ra ira'ndira'ndu settaika'l irupakkaththilum irukki'ra ovvon'rukkum irunthana.

avaika'l sellumpoathu avaika'ludaiya settaika'lin iraichchalaik keattean; athu peruve'l'laththin iraichchalpoalavum, sarvavallavarudaiya saththampoalavum, oru iraa'nuvaththin iraichchalukku oththa aaravaaraththin saththampoalavumirunthathu; avaika'l ni'rkumpoathu thangka'l settaika'laith tha'laravittirunthana.
avaika'l nin'ru thangka'l settaika'laith tha'laravittirukkaiyil, avaika'ludaiya thalaika'lukku mealaana ma'ndalaththinmealirunthu oru saththam pi'ranthathu.

avaika'lin thalaika'lukkumealu'l'la ma'ndalaththinmeethil neelaraththinampoala vi'langkum oru singkaasanaththin saayalum, anthach singkaasanaththin saayalinmeal manushasaayalukku oththa oru saayalum irunthathu.

avarudaiya iduppaakak kaa'nappattathumuthal mealellaam udpu'ram sut'rilum akkinimayamaana sokusaavin ni'ramaayirukkakka'ndean; avarudaiya iduppaakak kaa'nappattathumuthal keezhellaam akkinimayamaakavum, athaich sut'rilum pirakaasamaakavum irukkakka'ndean.

mazhaipeyyum naa'lil meakaththil vaanavil eppadik kaa'nappaduki'rathoa, appadiyea sut'rilumu'l'la anthap pirakaasam kaa'nappattathu; ithuvea karththarudaiya makimaiyin saayalukkuriya tharisanamaayirunthathu; athai naan ka'ndapoathu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthean; appozhuthu peasuki'ra oruvarudaiya saththaththaik keattean.
avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, un kaaloon'ri nil; unnudanea peasuvean en'raar.
ippadi avar ennoadea peasumpoathu, aavi enakku'l vanthu, ennaik kaaloon'ri ni'rkumpadi seythathu; appozhuthu avar ennudanea peasuki'rathaik keattean.

avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, enakku viroathamaay ezhumpina kalakakkaara jaathiyaakiya israveal puththiraridaththi'rku naan unnai anuppuki'rean; avarka'lum avarka'l pithaakka'lum innaa'lvaraikkum enakku viroathamaayth thuroakagnseythaarka'l.
avarka'l kadinamukamum murattaatta iruthayamumu'l'la puththirar; avarka'lidaththi'rku naan unnai anuppuki'rean; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar inninnathai uraikki'raar en'ru avarka'loadea sollu.
kalakaveettaaraakiya avarka'l keattaalum sari, kea'laavittaalum sari, thangka'lukku'l'lea oru theerkkatharisi u'ndenki'rathai avarka'l a'riyavea'ndum.

manupuththiranea, nee avarka'lukkup payappadavea'ndaam; avarka'l vaarththaika'lukkum agnchavea'ndaam; nerignchilka'lukku'l'lum mu'l'luka'lukku'l'lum nee thangkiyirunthaalum, nee thea'lka'lukku'l vaasampa'n'ninaalum, nee avarka'l vaarththaika'lukkup payappadaamalum avarka'l mukaththukkuk kalangkaamalumiru; avarka'l kalakaveettaar.
kalakakkaararaakiya avarka'l keattaalum sari, kea'laavittaalum sari, nee en vaarththaika'lai avarka'lukkuch sollu.
manupuththiranea, nee anthak kalakaveettaaraippoalak kalakakkaaranaayiraamal, naan unnoadea solluki'rathaik kea'l; un vaayaith thi'ranthu naan unakkuk kodukki'rathaip pusi en'raar.
appozhuthu ithoa, ennidaththi'rku neettappatta oru kaiyaik ka'ndean; anthak kaiyilea oru pusthakachsuru'l irunthathu.
avar athai enakkumunpaaka viriththaar; athil u'l'lum pu'rampum ezhuthappattirunthathu; athilea pulampalka'lum, thavippum, aiyoa enpathum ezhuthiyirunthathu.
pinpu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee kaa'nki'rathaip pusi; inthach suru'lai nee pusiththu, israveal santhathiyaaridaththil poay avarka'loadea peasu en'raar.
appadiyea en vaayaith thi'ranthean; appozhuthu avar anthach suru'lai enakkup pusikkakkoduththu:

manupuththiranea, naan unakkuk kodukki'ra inthach suru'lai nee un vayit'rilea udko'ndu, athinaal un kudalka'lai nirappuvaayaaka en'raar; appozhuthu naan athaip pusiththean; athu en vaaykkuth theanaippoal thiththippaayirunthathu.
pinpu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee poay, israveal santhathiyaaridaththil searnthu, en vaarththaika'laikko'ndu avarka'loadea peasu.
vi'langkaatha peachchum, kadinamaana paashaiyumu'l'la janaththa'ndaikkalla, israveal santhathiyaaridaththi'rkea nee anuppappaduki'raay.

vi'langkaatha peachchum, thaangka'l sollum vaarththaika'lai nee a'riyaatha kadinamaana paashaiyumu'l'la aneakamaana janangka'lidaththi'rku nee anuppappadavillai; naan avarka'lidaththi'rku unnai anuppinaalum, avarka'l unakkuch sevikoduppaarka'loa?

israveal veettaaroavenil, unakkuch sevikodukkamaattaarka'l; enakkea sevikodukkamaattoam enki'raarka'lea; israveal vamsaththaar anaivarum kadinamaana net'riyum murattaattamu'l'la iruthayamum u'l'lavarka'l.
ithoa, un mukaththai avarka'l mukaththukku ethiraakavum, un net'riyai avarka'l net'rikku ethiraakavum kettiyaakkinean.

un net'riyai vachchirakkallaippoalaakkinean, kanmalaiyaippaarkkilum kettiyaakkinean; avarka'l kalakamu'l'la veettaaren'ru nee avarka'lukkup payappadaamalum avarka'l mukangka'lukkuk kalangkaamalum iru en'raar.
pinnum avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, naan unnudanea sollum en vaarththaika'laiyellaam nee un sevika'laalea keattu, un iruthayaththil eat'rukko'ndu,

nee poay, si'raippatta un janaththin puththiraridaththilea searnthu, avarka'l keattaalum kea'laavittaalum avarka'loadea peasi, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar inninnathai uraikki'raar en'ru avarka'loadea sol en'raar.

appozhuthu aavi, ennai uyara eduththukko'ndathu; karththarudaiya sthaanaththilirunthu vi'langkiya avarudaiya makimaikku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka en'ru enakkup pinnaakak kooppitta makaa saththaththin iraichchalaik keattean.
on'roadon'ru i'nainthirukki'ra jeevanka'ludaiya settaika'lin iraichchalaiyum, atha'rkethirea oadiya sakkarangka'lin iraichchalaiyum, makaa saththaththin iraichchalaiyum keattean.
aavi ennai uyara eduththukko'ndathu; naan en aaviyin ukkiraththinaalea manangkasanthupoanean; aanaalum karththarudaiya karam enmeal palamaaka irunthathu.

keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea thelaapeepilea thaaparikki'ra si'raippattavarka'lidaththukku naan vanthu, avarka'l thaaparikki'ra sthalaththilea thaapariththu, eazhunaa'l avarka'l naduvilea piramiththavanaayth thangkinean.
eazhunaa'l mudinthapinpu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, unnai israveal vamsaththaarukkuk kaavalaa'lanaaka vaiththean; nee en vaayinaalea vaarththaiyaikkeattu, en naamaththinaalea avarka'lai echcharippaayaaka.

saakavea saavaay en'ru naan thunmaarkkanukkuch sollukaiyil, nee thunmaarkkanaith than thunmaarkkamaana vazhiyil iraathapadikku echcharikkumpadiyaakavum, avanai uyiroadea kaakkumpadiyaakavum, athai avanukkuch sollaamalum, nee avanai echcharikkaamalum irunthaal, anthath thunmaarkkan than thunmaarkkaththilea saavaan; avan iraththappazhiyaiyoa un kaiyilea keadpean.

nee thunmaarkkanai echchariththum, avan than thunmaarkkaththaiyum than aakaatha vazhiyaiyum vittuth thirumpaama'r poavaanaakil, avan than thunmaarkkaththilea saavaan; neeyoaven'raal un aaththumaavaith thappuvippaay.

appadiyea, neethimaan than neethiyai vittuth thirumpi, neethikeadu seyyumpoathum, naan avanmun ida'ralai vaikkumpoathum, avan saavaan; nee avanai echcharikkaathapadiyinaalea avan than paavaththilea saavaan; avan seytha neethika'l ninaikkappaduvathillai; avanudaiya iraththappazhiyaiyoa un kaiyilea keadpean.

neethimaan paavagn seyyaathapadikku nee neethimaanai echchariththapinpu avan paavagnseyyaavittaal, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan; avan echcharikkappattaan; neeyum un aaththumaavaith thappuviththaay en'raar.
avvidaththilea karththarudaiya karam enmeal amarnthathu; avar: nee ezhunthirunthu pa'l'laththaakkukkup pu'rappattuppoa, angkea unnudanea peasuvean en'raar.

appadiyea naan ezhunthirunthu, pa'l'laththaakkukkup pu'rappattup poanean; ithoa, keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea naan ka'nda makimaikkuch sariyaaka angkea karththarudaiya makimai vi'langkinathu; appozhuthu naan mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthean.
udanea aavi enakku'l'lea pukunthu, ennaik kaaloon'ri ni'rkumpadi seythathu, appozhuthu avar ennudanea peasi: nee poay, un veettukku'l'lea unnai adaiththukko'ndiru.
ithoa, manupuththiranea, unmeal kayi'ruka'laippoattu, avaika'laal unnaik kattappoaki'raarka'l; aakaiyaal nee avarka'lukku'l'lea poakavea'ndaam.
naan un naavai un mealvaayoadea ottikko'l'lappa'n'nuvean; nee avarka'laik kadinthuko'l'luki'ra manushanaayiraamal, oomaiyanaayiruppaay; avarka'l kalakaveettaar.

naan unnoadea peasumpoathu, un vaayaith thi'rappean; appozhuthu karththaraakiya aa'ndavar inninnathai uraiththaar en'ru avarka'loadea solvaay; keadki'ravan keadkattum, kea'laathavan kea'laathirukkattum; avarka'l kalakaveettaar.
manupuththiranea, nee oru sengkalai eduththu, athai unmun vaiththu, athinmeal erusaleam nakaraththai varainthu,

atha'rku viroathamaaka mut'rikkaipoattu, atha'rku viroathamaakak koththa'langka'laik katti, atha'rku viroathamaaka ma'nmeadupoattu, atha'rku viroathamaaka iraa'nuvangka'lai ni'ruththi, sut'rilum atha'rku viroathamaaka mathilidikkum yanthirangka'lai vai.

mealum nee oru iruppuchsattiyai vaangki, athai unakkum nakaraththukkum naduvaaka iruppuchsuvaraakki, athu mut'rikkaiyaayk kidakkumpadikku un mukaththai atha'rku nearaayth thiruppi, athai mut'rikkaipoattukko'ndiru; ithu israveal vamsaththukku adaiyaa'lam.

nee un idathupakkamaay orukka'liththup paduththu, athinmeal israveal vamsaththaarin akkiramaththaich sumaththikko'l; nee anthappakkamaay orukka'liththirukkum naadka'lin ilakkaththinpadiyea avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththaich sumappaay.
avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththin varushangka'lai unakku naadka'nakkaay e'n'nak katta'laiyittean; munnoot'ruth tho'n'noo'ru naadka'lvaraikkum nee israveal vamsaththaarin akkiramaththaich sumakkavea'ndum.

nee ivaika'lai ni'raiveat'rinapinpu, ma'rupadiyum un valathupakkamaay orukka'liththu, yoothaa vamsaththaarin akkiramaththai naa'rpathunaa'lvaraikkum sumakkavea'ndum; ovvoru varushaththukkup pathilaaka ovvoru naa'lai unakkuk katta'laiyittean.
nee erusaleamin mut'rikkaikku nearaakath thiruppiya mukamum, thi'rantha puyamumaaka irunthu, atha'rku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam sollu.
ithoa, nee athai mut'rikkaippoadum naadka'lai ni'raiveat'rumattum oru pakkaththilirunthu ma'rupakkaththil pura'lakkoodaathapadikku unnaik kayi'ruka'laal kattuvean.

nee koathumaiyaiyum vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum perumpayat'raiyum si'rupayat'raiyum thinaiyaiyum kampaiyum vaangki, avaika'lai oru paaththiraththilea poattu, avaika'laal unakku appagnsuduvaay; nee orukka'liththup padukkum naadka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea munnoot'ruth tho'n'noo'runaa'l athil eduththuch saappiduvaayaaka.
nee saappidum poajanam, naa'l on'rukku irupathu seakkal ni'raiyaayirukkum; appadi naa'lukkunaa'l saappiduvaayaaka.
tha'n'neeraiyum a'lavaay hin ennum padiyil aa'riloru pangkaik kudippaay; appadi naa'lukkunaa'l kudippaayaaka.
athai vaa'rkoathumai adaiyaippoal saappiduvaayaaka; athu manushanilirunthu kazhintha kashdaththin va'rattika'laal avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakach sudappaduvathaaka.
atha'rku oththapadiyea israveal puththirar, naan avarka'laith thuraththuki'ra pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea thangka'l appaththaith theettu'l'lathaakach saappiduvaarka'l en'ru karththar sonnaar.

appozhuthu naan: aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ithoa, en aaththumaa theettuppadavillai; thaanaaych seththathaiyaavathu, pee'ru'ndathaiyaavathu naan en si'ruvayathumuthal ithuvaraikkum saappittathillai; aruvaruppaana i'raichchi en vaaykkudpattathumillai en'rean.
appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: paar, manusha kashdaththin va'rattikkup pathilaaka unakku maattuchsaa'ni va'rattiyaik katta'laiyiduki'rean; athinaal un appaththaich suduvaayaaka en'raar.
pinnum avar: manupuththiranea, ithoa, appamum tha'n'neerum avarka'lukkuk ku'raiyavum, avanavan thidukkidavum, avarka'l thangka'l akkiramaththilea vaadippoakavum,
naan erusaleamilea appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'rikki'rean; avarka'l appaththai ni'raiyinpadiyea visaaraththoadea saappittu, tha'n'neerai a'lavinpadiyea thidukkiduthaloadea kudippaarka'l.

pinnum avar: manupuththiranea, savarakan kaththiyaakiya karukkaana kaththiyai vaangki, athinaal un thalaiyaiyum un thaadiyaiyum siraiththukko'ndu, pinpu ni'rukkum tharaasai eduththu, antha mayiraip pangkidakkadavaay.

moon'ril oru pangkai eduththu mut'rikkaipoadum naadka'l mudiki'rapoathu nakaraththin naduvilea akkiniyaal sutteriththu, moon'ril oru pangkai eduththu, athaich sut'rilum kaththiyaalea vetti, moon'ril oru pangkai eduththuk kaat'rilea thoot'rakkadavaay; avaika'lin pinnaaka naan pattayaththai uruvuvean.
athil kognchammaaththiram eduththu, athai un vasthiraththoarangka'lil mudinthuvaippaayaaka.
pinnum athil kogncham eduththu, athaith theeyin naduvil e'rinthu, athai akkiniyaal sutterippaayaaka; athilirunthu israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum viroathamaaka akkini pu'rappadum.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithuvea erusaleam, pu'rajaathika'lin naduvilea naan athai vaiththean, athaich sut'rilum theasangka'l irukki'rathu.

athu pu'rajaathika'laippaarkkilum en niyaayangka'laiyum, thannaich sut'rilum irukki'ra theasangka'laippaarkkilum en katta'laika'laiyum akkiramamaaka maat'rippoattathu; avarka'l en niyaayangka'lai ve'ruththu, en katta'laika'lil nadavaama'r poanaarka'l.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, ungka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathika'laippaarkkilum athikarikki'ravarka'laakiya neengka'l en katta'laika'lilea nadavaamalum, en niyaayangka'linpadi seyyaamalum, ungka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathika'ludaiya neethiniyaayangka'linpadiyaavathu nadavaamalum poanapadiyinaalea,
ithoa, naan, naanea unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, pu'rajaathika'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka un naduvilea neethi seluththi,
naan munpu seyyaathathum inichseyyaathiruppathumaanavithamaay unakku un ellaa aruvaruppuka'linimiththamum seyvean.

aathalaal un naduvilea pithaakka'l pi'l'laika'laith thinpaarka'l; pi'l'laika'l pithaakka'laith thinpaarka'l; naan unnil neethiseluththi unnil meethiyaayiruppavarka'laiyellaam sakala thisaika'lilum sitha'rippoakappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

aathalaal, cheeyen'rikazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaana un kiriyaika'laal nee en parisuththa sthalaththaith theettuppaduththinapadiyaal en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu, naan unnaik ku'rukippoakappa'n'nuvean, naan irangkamaattean, ithai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

unnilea moon'ril oru pangku ko'l'lainoayaal saavaarka'l, pagnchaththaalum un naduvilea madinthupoavaarka'l; moon'ril oru pangku unnaich sut'rilum irukki'ra pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhuvaarka'l; moon'ril oru pangkai naan sakala thisaika'lilum sitha'rippoakappa'n'ni, avarka'l pinnea pattayaththai uruvuvean.

ippadi en koapam ni'raivea'rum; ippadi naan en ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal thangkappa'n'nuki'rathinaal ennai aat'rikko'lvean; naan en ukkiraththai avarka'lil ni'raiveat'rumpoathu, karththaraakiya naan en vairaakkiyaththilea ithaip peasinean en'ru a'rivaarka'l.
kadanthupoaki'ra yaavarudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum un sut'ruppu'raththaaraakiya jaathika'lukku'l'lea naan unnaip paazhum ninthaiyumaakkuvean.

naan koapaththaalum ukkiraththaalum kodiya ka'ndanaika'laalum, unnil neethiseluththumpoathu, un sut'ruppu'raththaaraakiya jaathika'lukku athu ninthaiyum thurkkeerththiyum echcharippum piramippumaay irukkum; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean.

ungka'lai azhippatha'rku naan anuppum azhivukkeathuvaana pagnchaththin kodiya ampuka'lai naan avarka'lukku'l'lea eyyumpoathu, naan pagnchaththai ungka'lmeal athikarikkappa'n'ni, ungka'l appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'riththuppoaduvean.

pagnchaththaiyum, unnaip pi'l'laiyillaama'rpoakappa'n'num thushdamirukangka'laiyum ungka'lukku viroathamaaka anuppuvean; ko'l'lainoayum iraththagnsinthuthalum unnil sut'riththiriyum; pattayaththai naan unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee isravealin parvathangka'lukku nearaaka un mukaththaith thiruppi, avaika'lukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

isravealin parvathangka'lea, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarin vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar parvathangka'laiyum kun'ruka'laiyum oadaika'laiyum pa'l'laththaakkuka'laiyum noakki: ithoa, ungka'lmeal naan, naanea pattayaththai varappa'n'ni, ungka'l meadaika'lai azhiththuppoaduvean.
ungka'l palipeedangka'l paazhaakkappattu, ungka'l silaika'l thakarkkappadum; ungka'lil kolaiyu'nki'ravarka'lai ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku munpaaka vizhappa'n'nuvean.
naan israveal puththirarudaiya pireathangka'lai avarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'lin munnea kidakkappa'n'ni, ungka'l palipeedangka'laich sut'rilum ungka'l elumpuka'laich sitha'rappa'n'nuvean.

ungka'l palipeedangka'l nirmoolamum paazhumaakumpadikkum, ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'l thakarkkappattu, oaynthu, ungka'l silaika'l vettu'ndu, ungka'l kiriyaika'l kulainthupoakumpadikkum, ungka'ludaiya sakala vaasasthalangka'lilumu'l'la patta'nangka'l nirmoolamum ungka'l meadaika'l paazhumaakum.
kolaiseyyappattavarka'l ungka'l naduvil vizhuvaarka'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
neengka'l theasangka'lil sitha'radikkappadumpoathu, pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea pattayaththukkuth thappuvaarai ungka'lukku meethiyaaka vaippean.

ennai vittuch soarampoaki'ra iruthayaththaikku'riththum, thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'lin pinnea soarampoaki'ra thangka'l ka'nka'laikku'riththum manamadivaanean en'ru ungka'lil thappippoana avarka'l thaangka'l si'raippattirukkum pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea ennai ninaiththu, thangka'ludaiya sakala aruvaruppuka'linaalum thaangka'l seytha pollaappuka'linimiththam thangka'laiyea ve'ruththu,
inthath theengkuka'laiyellaam thangka'lukku nearidappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya naan viruthaavaaych sonnathillaiyen'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee un kaiyil adiththu, un kaalaal thatti, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya sakala pollaatha aruvaruppuka'linimiththamum aiyoa! en'ru sol; avarka'l pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum ko'l'lainoayaalum vizhuvaarka'l.

thooraththilirukki'ravan ko'l'lainoayaal saavaan; sameepaththilirukki'ravan pattayaththaal vizhuvaan; meethiyaayirunthu, mut'rikkaipoadappattavan pagnchaththaal saavaan; ippadi avarka'lil en ukkiraththaith theerththukko'l'luvean.

avarka'l thangka'l narakalaana sakala vikkirakangka'lukkum mathuravaasanaiyaana thoopaththaik kaattina sthalangka'laakiya uyarntha sakala meaduka'lilum, parvathangka'ludaiya sakala sikarangka'lilum, pachchaiyaana sakala virudchangka'linkeezhum, thazhaiththirukki'ra sakala karvaali marangka'linkeezhum, avarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'lin naduvilum avarka'ludaiya palipeedangka'laich sut'rilum, avarka'lil kolaiyu'ndavarka'l kidakkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

naan en kaiyai avarka'lukku viroathamaaka neetti, avarka'ludaiya ellaa vaasasthalangka'lumu'l'la theasaththai azhiththu, athaith thiplaaththin vanaantharaththaippaarkkilum athikamaayp paazhaakkuvean, appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, israveal theasaththaikku'riththuk karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: mudivu varuki'rathu, theasaththin naalu munaika'linmealum mudivu varuki'rathu.
ippoathea unmeal mudivu varuki'rathu; naan en koapaththai unmeal varuviththu, un vazhika'lukkuththakkathaaka unnai niyaayantheerththu, un ellaa aruvaruppuka'lin palanaiyum unmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu; naan irangkaamal un vazhika'lukkuththakkathai unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; un aruvaruppuka'lukkuththakkathu un naduvil vanthirukkum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: theengku varuki'rathu; ithoa, eakamaana theengku varuki'rathu.
mudivu varuki'rathu, mudivu varuki'rathu, athu unmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; ithoa, varuki'rathu.
theasaththil kudiyirukki'ravanea, annaa'lin vidiya'rkaalam varuki'rathu, kaalam varuki'rathu, ama'liyin naa'l sameepiththirukki'rathu, malaika'lil santhoashasaththam illai.

ippozhuthu viraivil en ukkiraththai unmeal oot'ri, en koapaththai unnil theerththukko'ndu, unnai un vazhika'lukkuththakkathaaka niyaayantheerththu, un ellaa aruvaruppuka'lin palanaiyum unmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu; naan irangkaamal un vazhika'lukkuththakkathai unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; un aruvaruppuka'lukkuththakkathu un naduvil vanthirukkum; appozhuthu adikki'ravaraakiya naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
ithoa, antha naa'l, ithoa, varuki'rathu, annaa'lin vidiya'rkaalam uthikki'rathu, milaa'ru pookki'rathu, akanthai sezhikki'rathu.

akkiramaththukku milaa'raakak kodumai ezhumpuki'rathu; avarka'lilum avarka'ludaiya thira'laana kumpilum avarka'ludaiya ama'liyilum on'rum meethiyaayiruppathillai; avarka'l nimiththam pulampal u'ndaayiruppathumillai.
anthak kaalam varuki'rathu, antha naa'l kittuki'rathu; ko'l'luki'ravan santhoashappadaamalum, vi'rki'ravan thukkappadaamalum iruppaanaaka; athin thira'laana kumpinmealum ukkiram i'rangkum.

avarka'l jeevanu'l'loarukku'l'lea innum uyiroadirunthaalum, vit'ravan vi'rkappattatha'rkuth thirumpivaruvathillai; athin thira'laana kumpinmealum u'ndaana tharisanam thirumpaathu; than akkiramaththilea vaazhuki'ra evanum thannaith thidappaduththamaattaan.
avarka'l ekkaa'lam oothi, ellaavat'raiyum aayaththampa'n'niyum, yuththaththukkup poaki'ravanillai; en ukkiram athin thira'laana kumpinmealum i'rangkuki'rathu.
ve'liyea pattayamum u'l'lea ko'l'lainoayum pagnchamum u'ndu; vayalve'liyil irukki'ravan pattayaththaal saavaan; nakaraththil irukki'ravanaiyoa pagnchamum ko'l'lainoayum padchikkum.

avarka'lil thappuki'ravarka'l thappuvaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l anaivarum avanavan than than akkiramaththinimiththam thukkiththuk kooppiduki'ra pa'l'laththaakkuka'lin pu'raakka'laippoala malaika'lil iruppaarka'l.
ellaak kaika'lum saliththu, ellaa muzhangkaalka'lum tha'n'neeraippoal thaththa'likkum.
irattai uduththikko'lvaarka'l; thaththa'lippu avarka'lai moodum; ellaa mukangka'lum vedkappadum, ellaath thalaika'lum mottaiyidappadum.

thangka'l ve'l'liyaith therukka'lil e'rinthuviduvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya pon vea'ndaave'ruppaayirukkum; karththarudaiya sinaththin naa'lilea avarka'l ve'l'liyum avarka'l ponnum avarka'lai viduvikkamaattaathu; avarka'l athinaal thangka'l aaththumaakka'laith thirupthiyaakkuvathum illai, thangka'l vayi'ruka'lai nirappuvathum illai; avarka'l akkiramamea avarka'lukku ida'ralaayirunthathu.

avarudaiya singkaaraththin makimaiyai akanthaikken'ru vaiththu, athilea aruvarukkappadaththakkathum cheeyen'rikazhappadaththakkathumaana kaariyangka'lin vikkirakangka'lai u'ndupa'n'ninaarka'l; aakaiyaal naan avaika'lai avarka'lukku vea'ndaave'ruppaakki,
athai anniyar kaiyilea ko'l'laiyaakavum, poomiyil thushdarka'lukkuch soo'raiyaakavum koduppean; avarka'l athaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarka'l.

en mukaththai avarka'lai vittuth thiruppuvean; athinaal en antharangka sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarka'l; pa'rikaarar atha'rku'l piraveasiththu, athaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarka'l.
oru sangkiliyaip pa'n'nivai; theasam niyaayaththeerppukku'l'laana iraththappazhika'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; nakaram kodumaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal pu'rajaathika'lin thushdarka'lai varappa'n'nuvean, avarka'l ivarka'ludaiya veeduka'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l; palavaanka'lin perumaiyai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean, avarka'l parisuththa sthalangka'l parisuththakkulaichchalaakum.
sangkaaram varuki'rathu; appozhuthu samaathaanaththaith theaduvaarka'l; aanaalum athu kidaiyaathu.

vikkinaththinmeal vikkinam varum; thurchseythiyinmeal thurchseythi pi'rakkum; appozhuthu theerkkatharisiyinidaththilea tharisanaththaith theaduvaarka'l; aanaalum aasaariyanidaththilea veathamum moopparidaththilea aaloasanaiyum iraamal ozhinthupoakum.

raajaa thukkiththukko'ndiruppaan; pirapuvaith thikil moodikko'ndirukkum; theasaththu janangka'lin kaika'l tha'larnthupoakum; naan avarka'l vazhika'linpadiyea avarka'lukkuch seythu, avarka'l niyaayangka'linpadiyea avarka'lai niyaayantheerppean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.

aa'raam varushaththu aa'raam maatham ainthaantheathiyilea, naan en veettil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, yoothaavin moopparka'l enakku munpaaka udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya karam angkea enmeal amarnthathu.

appozhuthu ithoa, akkinichsaayalaayth thoan'ruki'ra oruvaraik ka'ndean; avarudaiya iduppukkuk keezhellaam akkiniyum avarudaiya iduppukku mealellaam sokusaavaippoal pirakaasikki'ra saayalumaayirunthathu.

kaipoal thoan'rinathai avar neetti, en thalaimayiraip pidiththu ennaith thookkinaar; aaviyaanavar ennaip poomikkum vaanaththukkum naduvea ko'ndupoay, theavatharisanaththilea ennai erusaleamil vadathisaikku ethiraana u'lvaasalin nadaiyilea vittaar; angkea erichchalu'ndaakkuki'ra vikkirakaththin sthaanam irunthathu.
ithoa, naan pa'l'laththaakkilea ka'ndiruntha tharisanaththukkuch sariyaaka isravealin theavanudaiya makimai angkea vi'langkinathu.

avar ennaippaarththu: manupuththiranea, un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, vadakkea paar en'raar; appozhuthu naan en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, vadakkea paarththean; ithoa, palipeedaththin vaasalukku vadakkea paarththean; nadaiyilea erichchalu'ndaakkuki'ra antha vikkirakam irunthathu.

avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, avarka'l seyki'rathaik kaa'nki'raayaa? en parisuththa sthalaththaivittu ennaith thooramaayp poakappa'n'numpadiyaana israveal vamsaththaar ingkea seyki'ra mikuntha aruvaruppuka'laik kaa'nki'raay allavaa? ithilum athika aruvaruppuka'lai innamum kaa'npaay en'ru solli,
ennaip piraakaaraththin vaasalukkuk ko'ndupoanaar; appozhuthu ithoa, suvaril oru thuvaaraththaik ka'ndean.
avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee suvarilea thuvaaramidu en'raar; naan suvarilea thuvaaramittapoathu, ithoa, oru vaasal irunthathu.
avar ennaippaarththu: nee u'l'lea poay, avarka'l ingkea seyki'ra kodiya aruvaruppuka'laip paar en'raar.

naan u'l'lea poayp paarththapoathu, ithoa, sakalavitha oorumpiraa'nika'lum aruvaruppaana mirukangka'lumaakiya ivaika'lin suroopangka'lum, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya narakalaana sakala vikkirakangka'lum suvaril sut'rilum siththirantheerappattirunthana.

israveal vamsaththaarin moopparil ezhupathupearum, avarka'lin naduvilea saappaanudaiya kumaaranaakiya yasaniyaavum, avanavan thanthan kaiyilea thanthan thoopakalasaththaip pidiththukko'ndu, avaika'lukku munpaaka nin'raarka'l; thoopavarkkaththinaal mikuntha pukai ezhumpit'ru.

appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, israveal vamsaththaarin moopparka'l anthakaaraththilea avaravar thangka'l vikkirakangka'lin siththira vinoatha a'raika'lil seyki'rathai nee ka'ndaayaa? karththar engka'laip paarkki'rathillai; karththar theasaththaik kaivittaar en'ru solluki'raarka'lea en'raar.
pinnum avarka'l seyki'ra athika aruvaruppuka'lai innamum kaa'npaay en'ru avar ennudanea solli,
ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththu vadakku vaasalin nadaiyilea ko'ndu poanaar; ithoa, angkea thammoosukkaaka azhuthuko'ndirukki'ra sthireeka'l udkaarnthirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: manupuththiranea, ithaik ka'ndaayaa? ithilum athika aruvaruppuka'lai innamum kaa'npaay en'ru ennudanea solli,

ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin udpiraakaaraththilea ko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, karththarudaiya aalayaththin vaasal nadaiyilea ma'ndapaththukkum palipeedaththukkum naduvea, ea'rakku'raiya irupaththainthu purushar, thangka'l muthukaik karththarudaiya aalayaththukkum thangka'l mukaththaik keezhththisaikkum nearaakath thiruppinavarka'laayk kizhakkea irukkum sooriyanai namaskariththaarka'l.

appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ithaik ka'ndaayaa? ingkea yoothaa vamsaththaar seyki'ra aruvaruppuka'l a'rpamaana kaariyamaa? avarka'l theasaththaik kodumaiyinaal nirappi ennai adikkadi koapamoottuki'raarka'l; ithoa, avarka'l thiraadchakki'laiyaith thangka'l naasikku nearaakap pidikki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal naanum ukkiraththoadea kaariyaththai nadaththuvean; en ka'n thappaviduvathillai, naan irangkuvathillai; avarka'l makaa saththamaay en sevika'l keadkak kooppittaalum avarka'lukku naan sevikoduppathillai en'raar.
pinpu avar en kaathuka'l keadka makaa saththamaay: nakaraththin visaarippukkaarar sangkarikkum aayuthangka'laith thangka'l kaika'lil pidiththukko'ndu varakkadavarka'l en'ru sonnaar.

appozhuthu ithoa, aa'ru purushar, vettuki'ra aayuthangka'laith thangka'l kaika'lil pidiththukko'ndu, vadakkea paarththa uyarntha vaasalin vazhiyilirunthu vanthaarka'l; avarka'lil sa'nalnool angkithariththu, than araiyil ka'nakkanudaiya maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra oruvan irunthaan; avarka'l u'l'lea piraveasiththu, ve'nkala palipeedaththa'ndaiyilea nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu isravealin theavanudaiya makimai kearupeenmealirunthezhumpi, aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthu, sa'nalnool angkithariththu, than araiyilea ka'nakkanudaiya maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra purushanaik kooppittu,

karththar avanai noakki: nee erusaleam nakaram engkum uruvappoay, atha'rku'l'lea seyyappaduki'ra sakala aruvaruppuka'linimiththamum perumoochchuvittazhuki'ra manusharin net'rika'lil adaiyaa'lam poadu en'raar.
pinpu avar en kaathuka'l keadka mat'ravarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ivan pinnaalea nakaramengkum uruvappoay vettungka'l; ungka'l ka'n thappavidaamalum, neengka'l irangkaamalum,

muthiyoaraiyum, vaaliparaiyum, kannikaika'laiyum, kuzhanthaika'laiyum, sthireeka'laiyum sangkariththuk kon'rupoadungka'l; adaiyaa'lam poadappattirukki'ra oruvanaiyum kittaathirungka'l, en parisuththa sthalaththilea thuvakkungka'l en'ru en kaathuka'l keadkach sonnaar; appozhuthu avarka'l aalayaththukkumunnea iruntha moopparidaththil thuvakkam pa'n'ninaarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l aalayaththaith theettuppaduththi, piraakaarangka'laik kolaiyu'ndavarka'laalea nirappi, pu'rappattuppoangka'l en'raar; avarka'l nakaraththil poay vettinaarka'l.

avarka'l vettikko'ndupoakaiyil naanmaaththiram thaniththu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer erusaleaminmeal umathu ukkiraththai oot'rukaiyil isravealin meethiyaanavarka'laiyellaam azhippeeroa en'ru mu'raiyittean.

atha'rku avar: isravealum yoothaavumaakiya vamsaththaarin akkiramam mikavum perithu; theasam iraththappazhika'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; nakaramum maa'rupaattinaal nirappappattirukki'rathu; karththar theasaththaik kaivittaar; karththar paarkkamaattaar en'ru solluki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal en ka'n thappaviduvathumillai, naan irakkagnseyvathumillai; avarka'ludaiya vazhiyin palanai avarka'l sirasinmeal i'rangkappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
ithoa, sa'nalnool angki thariththu, than araiyil maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra purushan vanthu: neer enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythean en'ru kaariyaththaith theriviththaan.
ithoa, kearupeenka'ludaiya thalaikkumeal iruntha ma'ndalaththil inthiraneelaraththinampoan'ra singkaasanach saayalaana oru thoat'raththaik ka'ndean; athu avaika'lukkumeal kaa'nappattathu.

avar sa'nalnool angki thariththiruntha purushanai noakki: nee kearupeeninkeezh irukki'ra sakkarangka'lukku naduvilea piraveasiththu, kearupeenka'lin naduvea irukki'ra akkiniththazhalil un kai ni'raiya eduththu, athai nakaraththinmeal i'raiyen'raar; appadiyea avan en ka'n kaa'na u'l'lea piraveasiththaan.
anthap purushan u'l'lea piraveasikkaiyil, kearupeenka'l aalayaththin valathupu'raththil nin'rana; oru meakam udpiraakaaraththai nirappit'ru.

karththarudaiya makimai kearupeenin mealirunthu ezhumpi, aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthathu; aalayam meakaththinaalea ni'rainthirunthathu, piraakaaramum karththarudaiya makimaiyin pirakaasaththinaal nirampit'ru.
kearupeenka'ludaiya settaika'lin iraichchal sarvaththukkum valla theavan peasukaiyil u'ndaakum saththampoala ve'lippiraakaaramattum keadkappattathu.

avar sa'nalnool angki thariththiruntha purushanai noakki: nee kearupeenka'lukku'l sakkarangka'lin naduvilirunthu akkiniyai edu en'ru katta'laiyittavudanea, avan u'l'lea piraveasiththuch sakkarangka'la'ndaiyilea nin'raan.

appozhuthu kearupeenka'lukku'l'lea oru kearupeen than kaiyaik kearupeenka'lin naduvil irukki'ra akkiniyil neetti, athil eduththu, sa'nalnool angki thariththiruntha purushanudaiya kaiyil koduththaan; avan athai vaangkikko'ndu ve'liyea vanthaan.
kearupeenka'ludaiya settaika'lin keezh manushar kaiyin saayalaanathu kaa'nappattathu.
ithoa, kearupeenka'la'ndaiyil naalu sakkarangka'l irukkak ka'ndean; ovvoru kearupeen a'ndaiyil ovvoru sakkaram irunthathu; sakkarangka'lin thoat'ram padikappachchai varu'nampoalirunthathu.
avaika'l naalukkum orea saayalaana roopam irunthathu; sakkarangka'lin naduvilea sakkaram irukkumaappoal kaa'nappattathu.
avaika'l oadukaiyil thangka'l naalu pakkangka'lilum oadum; oadukaiyil avaika'l thirumpinathillai; thalainoakkum idaththukkea avaika'l athin pinnaalea oadina; oadukaiyil avaika'l thirumpinathillai.

avaika'lin udal anaiththum, avaika'lin muthukuka'lum, avaika'lin kaika'lum, avaika'lin settaika'lum, anthach sakkarangka'lum, sut'rilum ka'nka'linaalea ni'rainthirunthana; avaika'l naalukkum iruntha sakkarangka'lum appadiyea irunthana.
anthach sakkarangka'laip paarththu: sakkaramea en'ru oruvan kooppiduki'ra saththaththaik keattean.
ovvon'rukkum naalu mukangka'l irunthana; muthalaam mukam kearupeen mukamum, ira'ndaam mukam manushamukamum, moon'raam mukam singkamukamum, naalaam mukam kazhukumukamumaayirunthathu.
kearupeenka'l mealea ezhumpina; ithuthaan, naan keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea ka'ndiruntha jeevan.
kearupeenka'l sellukaiyil sakkarangka'l avaika'l arukea oadina; poomiyilirunthu ezhumpak kearupeenka'l thangka'l settaika'lai viriththapoathu, sakkarangka'lum avaika'lai vittu vilakippoakavillai.
avaika'l ni'rkaiyil ivaika'lum nin'rana; avaika'l ezhumpukaiyil ivaika'lum ezhumpina; jeevanudaiya aavi ivaika'lil irunthathu.
karththarudaiya makimai aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyaivittup pu'rappattu, kearupeenka'linmeal nin'rathu.

appozhuthu kearupeenka'l thangka'l settaika'lai viriththu, en ka'n kaa'nap poomiyaivittu ezhumpina; avaika'l pu'rappadukaiyil sakkarangka'lum avaika'lukkuch sariyaaych sen'rana; karththarudaiya aalayaththin kizhakku vaasalilea poay ni'rka, isravealin theavanudaiya makimai avaika'linmeal uyara irunthathu.
ithu naan keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea isravealin theavanukkuk keezhea irukkakka'nda antha jeevanthaanea; avaika'l kearupeenka'l en'ru a'rinthuko'ndean.
avaika'lil ovvon'rukkum naalu mukamum, ovvon'rukkum naalu settaika'lum irunthana; avaika'ludaiya settaika'lin keezh manushakaika'lin saayal irunthathu.
avaika'ludaiya mukangka'l naan keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea ka'ndiruntha antha mukangka'lin saayalaayirunthathu; ovvon'rum thanthan mukaththukku ethiraana thisaiyai noakkich sen'rathu.

pinpu aaviyaanavar ennai eduththu, ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin kizhakku mukamaayirukki'ra vaasalukkuk ko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, antha vaasalin nadaiyil irupaththainthu purushar irunthaarka'l; avarka'lin naduvea janaththin pirapukka'laakiya aasoorin kumaaranaakiya yasaniyaavaiyum, penaayaavin kumaaranaakiya pelaththiyaavaiyum ka'ndean.
appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ivarka'l intha nakaraththilea akkiramamaana ninaivuka'lai ninaiththu, thuraaloasanai solluki'ra manushar.
ithu veeduka'laik kattuvatha'rkuk kaalamalla en'rum, intha nakaram paanai, naangka'l athilu'l'la i'raichchiyen'rum solluki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal avarka'lukku viroathamaayth theerkkatharisanagnsollu, manupuththiranea, theerkkatharisanagnsollu en'raar.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi enmeal i'rangkinaar; avar ennai noakki: nee sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l ippadip peasuki'rathu u'ndu; ungka'l manathil ezhumpuki'rathai naan a'rivean.
intha nakaraththil neengka'l aneakaraik kolaiseytheerka'l; athin veethika'laik kolaiyu'ndavarka'laal nirappineerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal neengka'l kolaiseythu, athin naduvilea poattuvittavarka'lea i'raichchiyum, intha nakaram paanaiyumaamea; ungka'laiyoa atha'rku'l iraathapadikkup pu'rampaakkuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pattayaththukkup payappatteerka'l, pattayaththaiyea ungka'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
naan ungka'lai atha'rku'l iraathapadikkup pu'rampaakki, ungka'lai anniyarin kaiyil oppukkoduththu, ungka'lil niyaayaththeerppuka'lai ni'raiveat'ruvean.
pattayaththaal vizhuveerka'l; israveal theasaththin ellaiyilea ungka'lai niyaayantheerppean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
intha nakaram ungka'lukkup paanaiyaayiruppathumillai, neengka'l athilu'l'la i'raichchiyaayiruppathumillai; israveal theasaththin ellaiyilea ungka'lai niyaayantheerppean.

en katta'laika'linpadi nadavaamalum, en niyaayangka'linpadi seyyaamalum, ungka'laich sut'rilumirukki'ra pu'rajaathika'ludaiya mu'raimaika'linpadi seytha neengka'l appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.

naan ippadith theerkkatharisanagnsollukaiyil, penaayaavin kumaaranaakiya pelaththiyaa seththaan; appozhuthu naan mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, makaa saththamaay: aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer isravealil meethiyaanavarka'laich sarvasangkaaragnseyveeroa en'ru mu'raiyittean.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, neengka'l karththarai vittuth thooramaayp poangka'l, engka'lukku inthath theasam suthantharamaakak kodukkappattathen'ru, un sakoathararukkum, un kudumpaththaarukkum, un panthu janangka'lukkum, israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum, erusaleamin kudika'l solluki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal naan avarka'laith thooramaakap pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea thuraththiyirunthaalum, naan avarka'laith theasangka'lilea sitha'radiththirunthaalum, naan avarka'l poana theasangka'lil avarka'lukkuk kognchakkaalaththukkup parisuththa sthalamaaka iruppean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.

aathalaal naan ungka'lai janangka'lidaththilirunthu searththu, neengka'l sitha'radikkappatta theasangka'lilirunthu ungka'laik koottikko'ndu, israveal theasaththai ungka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.
avarka'l angkea vanthu, athil cheeyen'rikazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaayirukki'rathaiyellaam athilirunthu akat'ruvaarka'l.

avarka'l en katta'laika'linpadi nadanthu, en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyya naan avarka'lukku eaka iruthayaththaith thanthu, avarka'l u'l'laththil puthiya aaviyaik koduththu, kallaana iruthayaththai avarka'l maamsaththilirunthu eduththuppoattu, sathaiyaana iruthayaththai avarka'lukku aru'luvean.
avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean.

aanaalum cheeyen'rikazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaana thangka'l iruthayaththin ichchaiyilea evarka'l nadakki'raarka'loa avarka'ludaiya vazhiyin palanai avarka'l thalaika'linmeal sumarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu kearupeenka'l thangka'l settaika'lai viriththu ezhumpina; sakkarangka'lum avaika'lukku arukea sen'rana; isravealin theavanudaiya makimai avaika'linmeal uyara irunthathu.
karththarudaiya makimai nakaraththin naduvilirunthezhumpi, nakaraththukkuk kizhakkea irukki'ra malaiyinmeal poay nin'rathu.

pinpu aaviyaanavar ennai eduththu, ennai theavanudaiya aavikku'l'laana tharisanaththilea kaltheayaavukkuch si'raippattuppoanavarka'l idaththilea ko'ndupoay vittaar; appozhuthu naan ka'nda tharisanam ennilirunthu edupattuppoayit'ru.
karththar enakkuk kaa'npiththa yaavaiyum si'raiyiruppilirunthavarka'lukkuch sonnean.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee kalakaveettaarin naduvilea thangkiyirukki'raay; kaa'numpadikku avarka'lukkuk ka'nka'l irunthaalum kaa'naama'rpoaki'raarka'l; keadkumpadikku avarka'lukkuk kaathuka'l irunthaalum kea'laama'rpoaki'raarka'l; avarka'l kalakaveettaar.

ippoathum manupuththiranea, nee paratheasam poakumpadi pirayaa'na saamaanka'lai aayaththappaduththi, paka'rkaalaththilea avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakap pirayaa'nappadu; un sthalaththaivittu vea'rea sthalaththukku avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakap pu'rappattuppoa; avarka'l kalakaveettaaraanapoathilum oruvea'lai sinthiththu u'naruvaarka'l.

si'raiyiruppukkup poaki'ravanaippoal un saamaanka'lai nee paka'rkaalaththilea avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ve'liyea vaiththu, nee saayangkaalaththilea avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakach si'raiyiruppukkup poaki'ravanaippoal pu'rappaduvaayaaka.
avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka nee suvarilea thuvaaramittu, athin vazhiyaay avaika'lai ve'liyea ko'ndupoavaayaaka.

avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka avaika'lai un thoa'linmeal eduththu, maalaimayangkum vea'laiyilea ve'liyea ko'ndupoavaayaaka; nee theasaththaip paaraathapadi un mukaththai moodikko'l; israveal vamsaththaarukku unnai adaiyaa'lamaakkinean en'raar.

enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea naan seythean; si'raippattuppoakumpoathu saamaanka'laik ko'ndupoavathupoala en saamaanka'laip paka'rkaalaththil ve'liyea vaiththean; saayangkaalaththiloa kaiyinaal suvarilea thuvaaramittu, maalai mayangkum vea'laiyilea avaika'lai ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka avaika'laith thoa'linmeal eduththukko'ndupoanean.
vidiya'rkaalaththilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, kalakaveettaaraakiya israveal vamsaththaar unnaip paarththu: nee seyki'rathu ennaven'ru unnaik keattaarka'l allavaa?
ithu erusaleamil irukki'ra athipathiyinmealum athin naduvil irukki'ra israveal vamsaththaar anaivarinmealum sumarum paaram en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru avarka'lidaththil sollu.
nee avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayirukki'rean; naan seyvathu eppadiyoa, appadiyea avarka'lukkum seyyappadum; si'raippattup paratheasam poavaarka'l.

avarka'l naduvil irukki'ra athipathi maalaimayangkumpoathu thoa'linmeal sumaisumanthu pu'rappaduvaan; ve'liyea sumaiko'ndupoakach suvarilea thuvaaramiduvaarka'l; ka'n'ninaalea avan than theasaththaik kaa'naathapadi than mukaththai moodikko'lvaan.
naan en valaiyai avanmeal veesuvean, avan en ka'n'niyilea pidipaduvaan; avanaik kaltheayar theasamaakiya paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoavean; angkea avan saavaan; aakilum athaik kaa'namaattaan.
avanukku uthaviyaaka avanaich sut'rilum irukki'ra yaavaraiyum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangka'laiyum naan sakala thisaika'lilum thoot'ri, avarka'l pinnea pattayaththai uruvuvean.
appadi naan avarka'lai jaathika'lukku'l'lea thoot'ri, avarka'lai theasangka'lilea sitha'radikkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

aanaalum thaangka'l poaychsearum jaathika'lukku'l'lea thangka'l aruvaruppuka'laiyellaam vivarikkumpadi, naan avarka'lil kognchampearaip pagnchaththukkum pattayaththukkum ko'l'lainoaykkum thappi meenthirukkappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee un appaththai nadukkaththoadea pusiththu, un tha'n'neeraith thaththa'lippoadum visaaraththoadum kudiththu,

theasaththilu'l'la janangka'lai noakki: israveal theasaththilu'l'la erusaleamin kudika'laikku'riththuk karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, thangka'l appaththai visaaraththoadea pusiththu, thangka'l tha'n'neeraith thikiloadea kudippaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya theasaththuk kudika'ludaiya kodumaika'linimiththam athilu'l'lathellaam azhiya, athu paazhaakum.
kudiyea'riyirukki'ra patta'nangka'l vanaantharangka'laaki, theasam paazhaayppoakum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, naadka'l needikkum, tharisanam ellaam avamaakum en'ru israveal theasaththilea vazhangkum pazhamozhi enna?

aakaiyaal nee avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, avarka'l ini isravealilea inthap pazhamozhiyaich sollivaraathapadikku naan athai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; naadka'lum ellaath tharisanaththin poru'lum sameepiththu vanthana en'ru avarka'loadea sollu.
israveal vamsaththaarin naduvil inich sakala ka'l'laththarisanamum mukasthuthiyaana ku'risolluthalum iraama'rpoakum.

naan karththar, naan solluvean, naan sollum vaarththai ni'raivea'rum; inith thaamathiyaathu; kalakaveettaarea, ungka'l naadka'lilea naan vaarththaiyaich solluvean, athai ni'raivea'ravum pa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, ithoa, israveal vamsaththaar: ivan kaa'nki'ra tharisanam ni'raivea'ra aneakanaa'l sellum; thooramaayirukki'ra kaalangka'laikku'riththu ivan theerkkatharisanam solluki'raan enki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal en vaarththaika'lil on'raakilum inith thaamathippathillaiyen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar; naan sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'rum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru avarka'loadea sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, theerkkatharisanam solluki'ra isravealin theerkkatharisika'lukku viroathamaaka nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, thangka'l iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyea eduththuth theerkkatharisanagn solluki'ravarka'loadea nee sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathaavathu: thaangka'l on'rum tharisiyaathirunthum, thangka'ludaiya aaviyin eavuthalaip pinpat'ruki'ra mathiketta theerkkatharisika'lukku aiyoa!
isravealea, un theerkkatharisika'l vanaantharangka'lilu'l'la narika'lukku oppaayirukki'raarka'l.
neengka'l karththarudaiya naa'lilea yuththaththil nilaini'rkumpadikku, thi'rappuka'lil ea'rinathumillai; israveal vamsaththaarukkaakach suvarai adaiththathumillai.

karththar thangka'lai anuppaathirunthum, karththar uraiththaar en'ru solli, avarka'l apaththaththaiyum poykku'riyaiyum tharisiththu, kaariyaththai nirvaakampa'n'nalaamen'ru nampikkaiyaayirukki'raarka'l.
naan uraikkaathirunthum, neengka'l karththar uraiththaar en'ru sollumpoathu, apaththamaana tharisanaiyaith tharisiththu, poykku'riyaich solluki'reerka'l allavaa?

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l apaththamaanathaich solli, poyyaanathaith tharisikki'rapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan ungka'lukku viroathamaanavar en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

apaththamaanathaith tharisiththu, poykku'riyaich solluki'ra theerkkatharisika'lukku en kai viroathamaayirukkum; avarka'l en janaththin sangkaththil iruppathumillai; israveal vamsaththaarin attava'naiyil ezhuthappaduvathumillai; israveal theasaththukku'l piraveasippathumillai; appozhuthu naan karththaraakiya aa'ndavaren'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

samaathaanam illaathirunthum samaathaanamen'ru solli, avarka'l en janaththai moasampoakkuki'raarka'l; oruvan ma'nsuvarai vaikki'raan; ithoa, mat'ravarka'l saaramillaatha saanthai atha'rkup poosuki'raarka'l.
saaramillaatha saanthaip poosuki'ravarka'lai noakki: athu idinthuvizhumen'ru sol; ve'l'lamaakap perukuki'ra mazhai peyyum; makaa kalmazhaiyea, nee sorivaay; kodiya pusalkaat'rum athaip pi'lakkum.
ithoa, suvar vizhumpoathu: neengka'l poosina poochchu engkea en'ru solvaarka'l allavaa?

aakaiyaal en ukkiraththilea kodiya pusalkaat'rai ezhumpi adikkappa'n'nuvean; en koapaththilea ve'l'lamaaka adikki'ra mazhaiyum, en ukkiraththilea nirmoolamaakkaththakka perungkal mazhaiyum soriyum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

appozhuthu neengka'l saaramillaatha saanthaip poosina suvarai naan idiththu, athin asthipaaram thi'ranthukidakkumpadi athaith tharaiyilea vizhappa'n'nuvean; u'l'lea irukki'ra neengka'l nirmoolamaakumpadi athu vizhum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
ippadich suvarilum, atha'rkuch saaramillaatha saanthaip poosinavarka'lilum naan en ukkiraththaith theerththukko'ndu: suvarumillai, atha'rkuch saanthu poosinavarka'lumillai.

erusaleamaikku'riththuth theerkkatharisanagnsolli, samaathaanam illaathirunthum samaathaanam u'nden'ru tharisanangkaa'nki'ra isravealin theerkkatharisika'l illaama'rpoavaarka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

manupuththiranea, thangka'ludaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyea eduththu, theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ra un janaththin kumaaraththika'lukku ethiraaka un mukaththaith thiruppi, avarka'lukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

aaththumaakka'lai veattaiyaadumpadikkuch sakala kaika'lukkum thazhuva'naika'laith thaiththu, anthantha vayathu'l'lavarka'ludaiya thalaikkum thalaiya'naika'lai u'ndu pa'n'nuki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa! neengka'l en janaththin aaththumaakka'lai veattaiyaadi, avaika'lai ungka'lukku uyiroadea kaappaat'ruveerka'loa?

saakaththakaatha aaththumaakka'laik kolvatha'rkum, uyiroadea irukkaththakaatha aaththumaakka'lai uyiroadea kaappaat'ruvatha'rkumaaka neengka'l poykkuch sevikodukki'ra en janaththukkup poy solluki'rathinaalea sila sirangkai vaa'rkoathumaikkaakavum appaththu'nduka'lukkaakavum ennai en janaththukku'l'lea parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuveerka'loa en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, neengka'l aaththumaakka'laip pa'rakkadikkumpadi veattaiyaaduki'ra ungka'l thazhuva'naika'lukku viroathamaaka naan vanthu, avaika'lai ungka'l puyangka'lilirunthu pidungkik kizhiththu, neengka'l pa'rakkadikka veattaiyaaduki'ra aaththumaakka'lai naan viduthalai pa'n'ni,

ungka'l thalaiya'naika'laik kizhiththu, en janaththai ungka'l kaika'lukku neengkalaakkividuvean; avarka'l ini veattaiyaadappadumpadi ungka'l kaika'lil iraarka'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

naan sagnchalappaduththaatha neethimaanin iruthayaththai neengka'l vee'naay mu'riyappa'n'ninapadiyinaalum, thunmaarkkan than pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpavum naan avanai uyiroadea kaakkavung koodaathapadikku neengka'l avanudaiya kaika'laith thidappaduththinapadiyinaalum,

neengka'l ini apaththamaanathaith tharisippathumillai, saasthiram paarppathumillai; naan en janaththai ungka'l kaika'lukku neengkalaakkividuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
isravealudaiya moopparil silar ennidaththil vanthu, enakku munpaaka udkaarnthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, intha manushar thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laith thangka'l iruthayaththinmeal naatti, thangka'l akkiramamaakiya ida'ralaith thangka'l mukaththukku ethiraaka vaiththukko'ndirukki'raarka'lea; ivarka'l ennidaththil visaarikkaththakumaa?

aakaiyaal, nee avarka'loadea peasichsollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal vamsaththaaril thannudaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'laith than iruthayaththinmeal naatti, than akkiramamaakiya ida'ralaith than mukaththukku ethiraaka vaiththukko'ndirukki'ra evanaakilum theerkkatharisiyinidaththil vanthaal, karththaraakiya naan israveal vamsaththaarudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaip pidikkumpadiyaaka appadippattavanudaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'lin thiradchikkuththakkathaaka uththaravu koduppean.
avarka'l ellaarum thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laip pinpat'ri, ennaivittup peathaliththuppoanaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal, nee israveal vamsaththaarai noakki: thirumpungka'l, ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'lai vittuth thirumpungka'l; ungka'l sakala aruvaruppuka'laiyum vittu ungka'l mukangka'laith thiruppungka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

israveal vamsaththaarilum isravealil thangkuki'ra anniyarilum ennaip pinpat'raamal peathaliththu, than narakalaana vikkirakangka'laith than iruthayaththinmeal naatti, than akkiramamaakiya ida'ralaith than mukaththukkethiraaka vaiththukko'ndirukki'ra evanaakilum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay ennidaththil visaarikka vanthaal, avanukkuk karththaraakiya naanea uththaravukoduththu,

antha manushanukku viroathamaaka en mukaththaith thiruppi, avanai adaiyaa'lamaakavum pazhamozhiyaakavum vaiththu, avanai en janaththin naduvil iraathapadikkuch sangkariththuppoaduvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

oru theerkkatharisi eththappattu oru viseashaththaich sonnaanaakil, appadikkoththa theerkkatharisiyaik karththaraakiya naanea eththappadappa'n'ninean; naan avanukku viroathamaaka en kaiyai neetti, avanai israveal janaththin naduvil iraathapadikku azhippean.

appadiyea avaravar thangka'l thangka'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarka'l; theerkkatharisiyinidaththil visaarikki'ravanudaiya tha'ndanai eppadiyoa appadiyea theerkkatharisiyinudaiya tha'ndanaiyum irukkum.

israveal vamsaththaar ini ennaivittu vazhithappippoakaamalum, thangka'l ellaa mee'ruthalka'laalum ini asusippadaamalum irukkumporuttaaka ippadich sampavikkum; appozhuthu avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, oru theasam enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'nikko'ndeayirunthu, paavagnseythaal, naan atha'rku viroathamaaka en kaiyai neetti, athil appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'riththu, athil pagnchaththai anuppi, manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum athil iraathapadikku naasampa'n'nuvean.

appozhuthu noavaa thaaniyeal yoapu aakiya immoon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, avarka'l thangka'l neethiyinaal thangka'l aaththumaakka'laimaaththiram thappuvippaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
naan theasaththil thushdamirukangka'lai anuppa, ammirukangka'linimiththam oruvarum athin vazhiyaay nadakkakkoodaathapadi ve'rumaiyum paazhumaakumpoathu,

antha moon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, thaangka'lmaaththiram thappuvaarka'leayallaamal, kumaararaiyaakilum kumaaraththika'laiyaakilum thappuvikkamaattaarka'l; theasamum paazhaayppoakum en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean enpathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
allathu naan anthath theasaththinmeal pattayaththai varappa'n'ni: pattayamea, theasaththai uruvappoa en'ru solli, athilu'l'la manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum naasampa'n'numpoathu,

antha moon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, thaangka'lmaaththiram thappuvaarka'leayallaamal, kumaararaiyaakilum kumaaraththika'laiyaakilum thappuvikkamaattaarka'l en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean enpathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
allathu naan anthath theasaththil ko'l'lainoayai anuppi, athilu'l'la manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum naasampa'n'numpadi athinmeal iraththappazhiyaaka en ukkiraththai oot'rumpoathu,

noavaavum thaaniyealum yoapum athin naduvil irunthaalum, avarka'l thangka'l neethiyinaal thangka'l aaththumaakka'lai maaththiram thappuvippaarka'leayallaamal, kumaaranaiyaakilum, kumaaraththiyaiyaakilum thappuvikkamaattaarka'l en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean enpathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

aakaiyaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum naasampa'n'numpadi erusaleamukku viroathamaakap pattayam, pagncham, thushdamirukangka'l, ko'l'lainoay ennum innaanku kodiya tha'ndanaika'laiyum anuppumpoathu evva'lavu athika sangkaaramaakum?

aakilum, ithoa, athilea thappi meethiyaaki ve'liyea ko'nduvarappaduki'ra kumaararum kumaaraththika'lum silar iruppaarka'l; ithoa, avarka'l ungka'la'ndaikkup pu'rappattu varuvaarka'l; appozhuthu neengka'l avarka'l maarkkaththaiyum avarka'l kiriyaika'laiyum ka'ndu, naan erusaleaminmeal varappa'n'nina theengkaiyum athinmeal naan varappa'n'nina ellaavat'raiyungku'riththuth theat'rappaduveerka'l.

neengka'l avarka'l maarkkaththaiyum avarka'l kiriyaiyaiyum kaa'numpoathu, avarka'l ungka'lukkuth theat'raravaayiruppaarka'l; naan athilea seytha ellaavat'raiyum mukaantharamillaamal seyyavillaiyen'ru appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lveerka'l enpathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sonnaar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, kaattilirukki'ra sedika'lukku'l mat'ra ellaach sedikodika'laippaarkkilum thiraadchachsedikku meanmai enna?
yaathoru vealaiseyya athilea oru kattai edukkappadumoa? yaathoru thattumuttaith thookkivaikkumpadi oru mu'laiyai athinaal seyvaarka'loa?
ithoa, athu akkinikku iraiyaaka e'riyappadum; athin ira'ndu munaika'laiyum akkini eriththuppoadum; athin naduththu'ndum venthupoam; athu entha vealaikkaavathu uthavumoa?
ithoa, athu veakaathirukkumpoathea oru vealaikkum uthavaathirukka, akkini athai eriththu, athu venthupoanapinpu, athu ini oru vealaikku uthavuvatheppadi?

aathalaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: kaattuch sedika'lukku'l'lirukki'ra thiraadchachsediyai naan akkinikku iraiyaaka oppukkoduththathupoala, erusaleamin kudika'laiyum appadiyea oppukkoduththu,

en mukaththai avarka'lukku viroathamaakath thiruppuvean; avarka'l oru akkiniyilirunthu neengkith thappinaalum, vea'rea akkini avarka'laip padchikkum; appadiyea naan en mukaththai avarka'lukku viroathamaayth thiruppumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
avarka'l thuroakampa'n'ninapadiyinaal, naan theasaththaip paazhaayp poakappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee erusaleamin aruvaruppuka'lai atha'rku a'riviththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar erusaleamukkuch solluki'raar, kaanaan theasamea un u'rpaththikkum un pi'rappukkum idam, un thakappan emoariyan, un thaay eaththiththi.

un pi'rappin varththamaanam ennaven'raal, nee pi'rantha naa'lilea un thoppu'l a'rukkappadavumillai; nee suththamaavatha'rkuth tha'n'neerinaal ku'lippaattappadavumillai; uppaal suththikarikkappadavumillai; thu'nika'lil sut'rappadavumillai.
unakkaakap parithapiththu, ivaika'lil on'raiyaakilum unakkuch seyya oru ka'n'num unpearil irakkamaayirunthathumillai; nee pi'ranthanaa'lil nee aruvarukkappattathinaal ve'liyil e'rinthuvidappattaay.

naan un arukea kadanthupoakumpoathu, mithikkappaduvatha'rku eathuvaay nee un iraththaththil kidakki'rathaik ka'ndu, un iraththaththil kidakki'ra unnaippaarththu: pizhaiththiru en'rean; aam, un iraththaththil kidakki'ra unnaippaarththu: pizhaiththiru en'ru sonnean.

unnai vayalin payiraippoala aneakamaayiramaayp perukumpadi vaiththean; nee va'larnthu periyava'laaki, makaa saunthariyavathiyaanaay; un sthanangka'l ezhumpina, un mayir va'larnthathu; aanaalum, nee nirvaa'namum amma'namumaayirunthaay.

naan un arukea kadanthupoanapoathu, unnaip paarththean; ithoa, un kaalam paruvakaalamaayirunthathu; appozhuthu en vasthiraththai unmeal viriththu, un nirvaa'naththai moodi, unakku aa'naiyittukkoduththu, unnoadu udanpadikkai pa'n'ninean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; ivvithamaay nee ennudaiyava'laanaay.
naan unnai jalaththinaal muzhukkaatti, unnai iraththama'ra snaanam pa'n'nuviththu, unakku e'n'ney poosi,
siththiraththaiyalaadaiyai unakku uduththi, saayantheerntha paatharadchaika'lai unakkuth thariththu, katta melliya pudavaiyaiyum, moodikko'l'lap pattuch saalvaiyaiyum unakkuk koduththu,
unnai aapara'nangka'laal alangkariththu, un kaika'lilea kadakangka'laiyum, un kazhuththilea sarappa'niyaiyum poattu,
un net'riyil net'rippattaththaiyum, un kaathuka'lil kaatha'niyaiyum, un thalaiyinmeal singkaaramaana kireedaththaiyum thariththean.

ivvithamaayp ponninaalum ve'l'liyinaalum nee alangkarikkappattaay; un uduppu melliya pudavaiyum pattum siththiraththaiyalaadaiyumaayirunthathu; melliya maavaiyum theanaiyum neyyaiyum saappittaay; nee mikavum azhaku'l'lava'laaki, raajyaththaich suthantharikkum silaakkiyaththaiyum pet'raay.
un azhakinaalea un keerththi pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea pirasiththamaayit'ru; naan unmeal vaiththa en makimaiyinaalea athu ku'raivat'rathaay irunthathen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
neeyoaven'raal un azhakai nampi, un keerththiyinaal soaramaarkkamaay nadanthu, vazhippoakkaril unakku nearpatta yaavaroadum veasiththanampa'n'ni,

un vasthirangka'lil silavat'rai eduththu, palavaru'nach soadippaana meadaika'lai unakku u'ndaakki, avaika'linmeal veasiththanampa'n'ninaay; appadikkoththa kaariyangka'l orukkaalum sampaviththathumillai, sampavippathumillai.
naan unakkuk koduththa en ponnum en ve'l'liyumaana un singkaara aapara'nangka'lai nee eduththu, unakku aa'nsuroopangka'lai u'ndaakki, avaika'loadea veasiththanampa'n'ni,
un siththiraththaiyalaadaika'lai eduththu, avaika'lai moodi, en e'n'neyaiyum en thoopavarkkaththaiyum avaika'linmun padaiththu,

naan unakkuk koduththa en appaththaiyum, nee saappidumpadi unakkuk koduththa melliya maavaiyum neyyaiyum theanaiyum nee avaika'linmun sukanthavaasanaiyaakap padaiththaay; kaariyam ippadi aayit'ren'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
nee enakkup pet'ra un kumaararaiyum un kumaaraththika'laiyum eduththu, avarka'lai avaika'lukku iraiyaakap paliyittaay.
nee seytha veasiththanangka'l poathaathen'ru, nee en pi'l'laika'lai avaika'lukkuth theekkadakkappa'n'na oppukkoduththu, avarka'laik kolaiseythaay.

nee un ellaa aruvaruppuka'lilum veasiththanangka'lilum nadakkumpoathu, nirvaa'namum amma'namumaayirunthathum, un iraththaththilea mithikkappada eathuvaayk kidanthathumaana un si'ruvayathin naadka'lai ninaiyaama'rpoanaay.
aiyoa! unakku aiyoa! en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; nee seytha pollaappuka'lellaam thavira,
nee unakku ma'ndapangka'laik katti, unakkuch sakala veethika'lilum uyarntha meadaika'lai u'ndupa'n'ninaay.
nee sakala vazhimukanaiyilum un uyarntha meadaika'laik katti, un azhakai aruvaruppaakki, vazhippoakkar yaavarukkum un kaalka'lai viriththu, un veasiththanangka'laith thira'laayp perukappa'n'ni,
sathai peruththa un ayal theasaththaaraakiya ekipthiya puththiraroadea veasiththanampa'n'ni, enakkuk koapam u'ndaakkumpadi un veasiththanangka'laip perukappa'n'ninaay.

aathalaal, ithoa, naan en kaiyai unakku viroathamaaka neetti, unakku niyamiththa poajanaththaik ku'rukki, un mu'raikeadaana maarkkaththaik ku'riththu vedkappatta un pakaiyaa'lika'laakiya pelistharudaiya kumaaraththika'lin ichchaikku unnai oppukkoduththean.
nee thirupthiyadaiyaathathinaal aseeriya puththiraroadum veasiththanampa'n'ninaay; avarka'loadea veasiththanampa'n'niyum nee thirupthiyadaiyavillai.
nee kaanaan theasaththilea seytha veasiththanaththaik kaltheayarmattum ettach seythaay; athinaalum nee thirupthiyadaiyaama'rpoanaay.
vedkangketta veasiyin kiriyaika'laakiya ivaika'laiyellaam nee seythu,

sakala vazhimukanaiyilum un ma'ndapangka'laik katti, sakala veethika'lilum un meadaika'lai u'ndaakkinapadiyaal, un iruthayam evva'lavaayk ka'laiththuppoayirukki'rathu en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; nee pa'naiyaththai aladchiyampa'n'nuki'rathinaal, nee veasiyaippoala iraamal,
than purushanukkup pathilaaka anniyaraich searththukko'l'luki'ra vipasaara sthireeyaippoala irukki'raay.

ellaa veasika'lukkum pa'naiyang kodukki'raarka'l; neeyoa un neasarka'l sut'ruppu'rangka'lilirunthu unnidaththil veasiththanagnseyya varumpadi avarka'lukkellaam neeyea pa'naiyangkoduththu, avarka'lukku vekumathika'laith tharuki'raay.

ivvithamaay un veasiththanangka'lukkum vea'rea sthireeka'lin veasiththanangka'lukkum viththiyaasamu'ndu; veasiththanampa'n'na avarka'l unnaip pin sellamaattaarka'l; pa'naiyam unakkuk kodukkappadaamal neeyea pa'naiyam kodukki'rapadiyaal nee seyvathu vipareetham.
aakaiyaal, veasiyea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: un veasiththanaththin asuththam paaynthapadiyinaalum, nee un kaamavikaarika'loadum aruvaruppaakiya un narakalaana vikkirakangka'loadum veasiththanampa'n'ni, ivaika'lukku un pi'l'laika'lin iraththaththaip padaiththathinaal un nirvaa'nam thi'rakkappattapadiyinaalum,

ithoa, nee sampoakampa'n'nina un ellaak kaamavikaarika'laiyum, nee neasiththa yaavaraiyum, nee pakaiththirukki'ra anaivaroadum naan koodivarachseythu, sut'rilumirunthu avarka'lai unakku viroathamaakach searththu, avarka'l un nirvaa'naththaiyellaam kaa'numpadi un nirvaa'naththai avarka'lukku munpaakath thi'ranthuvaiththu,
vipasaarika'laiyum iraththagnsinthinavarka'laiyum niyaayantheerkki'rapadiyea unnai niyaayantheerththu, ukkiraththoadum erichchaloadum iraththappazhiyai unpearil sumaththi,

unnai avarka'l kaiyil oppukkoduppean; avarka'l un ma'ndapangka'lai idiththu, un meadaika'laith tharaiyaakkippoattu, un vasthirangka'lai urinthu, un singkaara aapara'nangka'lai eduththukko'ndu, unnai amma'namum nirvaa'namumaaka vittuppoay,
unakku viroathamaaka oru koottaththaik ko'nduvanthu, unnaik kalle'rinthu, unnaith thangka'l pattayangka'laal kuththipoattu,

un veeduka'lai akkiniyaal sutteriththu, aneaka sthireeka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka unnil niyaayaththeerppuka'laich seyvaarka'l; un veasiththanaththai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; nee inip pa'naiyangkoduppathillai.
ivvithamaay en erichchal unnai vittu neengkumpadi, naan en ukkiraththai unnil aa'rappa'n'ni, ini koapamaayiraamal amaruvean.

nee un i'lavayathin naadka'lai ninaiyaamal, ivaika'lellaavat'rinaalum enakkuk koapam u'ndaakkinapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan un vazhiyin palanai un thalaiyinmeal sumarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; athinaalea ini un ellaa aruvaruppuka'linaalum ippadippatta mu'raikeadaana kaariyaththaich seyyamaattaay.
ithoa, pazhamozhi solluki'ravarka'l ellaarum: thaayaippoala maka'l en'ru unnaikku'riththup pazhamozhi solluvaarka'l.

nee, than purushanaiyum than pi'l'laika'laiyum aruvaruththa un thaayin maka'l; nee, thangka'l purusharaiyum thangka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum aruvaruththa un sakoatharika'lin sakoathari; ungka'l thaay eaththiththi; ungka'l thakappan emoariyan.
un idathupu'raththilea, thaanum than kumaaraththika'lumaayk kudiyiruntha samaariyaa un thamakkai; un valathupu'raththilea, thaanum than kumaaraththika'lumaayk kudiyiruntha soathoam un thangkai.

aakilum nee avarka'ludaiya maarkkangka'lilea nadavaamalum, avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'linpadi seyyaamalum, athu makaa a'rpakaariyam enki'rathupoala nee un ellaa vazhika'lileayum avarka'laippaarkkilum keadaay nadanthaay.

neeyum un kumaaraththika'lum seythathupoala, un sakoathariyaakiya soathoamum ava'ludaiya kumaaraththika'lum seyyavillai en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

ithoa, kervamum, aakaarath thiradchiyum, nirvisaaramaana saangkoapaangkamumaakiya ivaika'lea un sakoathariyaana soathoamin akkiramam; ivaika'lea ava'lidaththilum ava'l kumaaraththika'lidaththilum irunthana; si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanudaiya kaiyai ava'l palappaduththavillai.
avarka'l thangka'lai uyarththi, en mukaththukku munpaaka aruvaruppaanathaich seythaarka'l; athai naan ka'ndapoathu, avarka'lai ozhiththuvittean.

nee seytha paavangka'lil araivaasiyum samaariyaa seyyavillai; nee un sakoatharika'laippaarkkilum un paavangka'laip perukappa'n'ni, nee seytha un ellaa aruvaruppuka'linaalum avarka'lai neethiyu'l'lavarka'len'ru vi'langkappa'n'ninaay.

ippoathum un sakoatharika'laik kut'ravaa'lika'l en'ru theerththa nee avarka'laippaarkkilum aruvaruppaakach seytha un paavangka'linimiththam un ilachchaiyaich sumanthuko'l; unnaippaarkkilum avarka'l neethiyu'l'lavarka'l; un sakoatharika'lai neethiyu'l'lavarka'len'ru vi'langkappa'n'nina nee vedkamadainthu, un ilachchaiyaich sumanthuko'l.

naan soathoamum ava'l kumaaraththika'lum si'raiyirukki'ra avarka'ludaiya si'raiyiruppaiyum, samaariyaavum ava'l kumaaraththika'lum si'raiyirukki'ra si'raiyiruppaiyum thiruppumpoathu, avarka'l naduvilea nee si'raiyirukki'ra unnudaiya si'raiyiruppaiyum thiruppuvean.
athinaal nee avarka'lukku aa'ruthalaaka irunthu, un ilachchaiyaich sumanthu, nee seytha ellaavat'rinaalum vedkamadaivaay.

un sakoatharika'laakiya soathoamum ava'l kumaaraththika'lum thangka'l munthina seerukkuth thirumpuvaarka'l; samaariyaavum ava'l kumaaraththika'lum thangka'l munthina seerukkuth thirumpuvaarka'l; neeyum un kumaaraththika'lum ungka'l munthina seerukkuth thirumpuveerka'l.
unnai ve'rukkum seeriyaavin kumaaraththika'lum, ava'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pelistharin kumaaraththika'lum avamaanampa'n'ninapoathu un pollaappu ve'liyaayit'rea.
atha'rkumun un kervaththin naa'lilea un sakoathariyaakiya soathoamin peyarai un vaayinaalea uchcharikkavumaattaay.
un mu'raikeattaiyum un aruvaruppuka'laiyum nee sumappaay en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoaduki'rathinaal aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'nina nee seythathupoala naan unakkum seyvean.
aakilum un i'lavayathil unnoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyai naan ninaiththu, niththiya udanpadikkaiyai unakku ea'rpaduththuvean.

appozhuthu un thamakkaika'laiyum un thangkaika'laiyum nee searththukko'l'lukaiyil, un vazhika'lai ninaiththu naa'nuvaay; avarka'lai naan unakkuk kumaaraththika'laakak koduppean; unnudaiya udanpadikkaiyaip paarththuk koduppathillai.
unnoadea en udanpadikkaiyaippa'n'ni ea'rpaduththuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rivaay.

nee seytha ellaavat'raiyum naan manniththaru'lumpoathu, nee ninaiththu vedki, un naa'naththinaal un vaayai inith thi'rakkamaattaathiruppaay en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee israveal vamsaththaarukku oru vidukathaiyaiyum uvamaiyaiyum koo'ri, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar, periya settaika'laiyum nee'lamaana i'rakuka'laiyum udaiyathum, palavaru'namaana i'rakuka'laal ni'rainthathumaakiya oru periya kazhuku leepanoanil vanthu, oru keathuruvin nunikki'laiyaip pidiththu,
athin i'langki'laiyilu'l'la kozhunthuka'laikkoythu, athai varththaka theasaththukkuk ko'ndupoay, athai varththakarudaiya nakaraththilea vaiththathu;
theasaththin vithaiyil on'rai eduththu, athaip payirnilaththilea poattu, athai eduththu, mikuntha tha'n'neer oaraththilea paththiramaay nattathu.

athu thu'lirththu, padarnthu, thaazhntha adimaramu'l'la thiraadchachsediyaayit'ru; athinkodika'l anthak kazhukukku nearaakavum, athin vearka'l athin keezhaakavum irunthana; ivvithamaay athu thiraadchachsediyaaki, ki'laika'lai veesi, koppuka'lai vittathu.

an'riyum periya settaika'laiyum thira'laana i'rakuka'laiyum udaiya vea'roru periya kazhuku irunthathu; ithoa, athu than nadavaakiya paaththika'lilirunthu atha'rkuth tha'n'neer paaychchumpadi intha thiraadchachsedi atha'rku nearaakath than vearka'lai vittu, atha'rku nearaakath than kodika'lai veesinathu.
koppuka'lai viduki'ratha'rkum, kaniyaith tharuki'ratha'rkum, makimaiyaana thiraadchachsediyaaki'ratha'rkum, ithu mikuntha tha'n'neerka'lin oaramaakiya nalla nilaththil nadappattirunthathu.

ithu sezhikkumaa? ithu pattuppoakaththakkathaay oruvan ithin vearka'laip pidungkaamalum, ithin kaniyai vettaamalum iruppaanoa? thu'lirththa ellaa ilaika'loadum ithu pattuppoakum; ithai vearoadea pidungkumpadi oruvan palaththa puyaththoadum thira'nda janaththoadum varaththeavaiyillai.

ithoa, nadappatta ithu sezhippaayirukkumoa? ko'ndalkaat'ru ithinpearil padumpoathu ithu vaadi ularnthu poakaathoa? ithu nadappatta paaththika'lilea vaadippoamen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

ippoathum ivaika'lin thaa'rpariyam theriyumaa en'ru nee kalakaveettaaraikkeattuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, paapiloan raajaa erusaleamukku vanthu, athin raajaavaiyum athin pirapukka'laiyum pidiththu, avarka'laith thannidamaakap paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoakumpoathu,
avan raajavamsaththilea oruvanaith therintheduththu, avanoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni,

raajyam thannai uyarththaamal thaazhnthirukkumpadikkum, than udanpadikkaiyai avan kaikko'l'luki'rathinaal athu nilaini'rkumpadikkum, avanai aa'naippiramaa'naththukku udpaduththi, theasaththil palasaalika'laip pidiththuk ko'ndupoanaanea.

ivan avanukku viroathamaayk kalakagnseythu, thanakkuk kuthiraika'laiyum aneakam aadka'laiyum anuppavea'ndumen'ru than sthaanaapathika'lai ekipthukku anuppinaan; ippadippattavanukku vaaykkumoa? ippadich seyki'ravan thappiththukko'lvaanoa? udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththavan thappiththukko'lvaanoa?

thannai raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththiya raajaavinudaiya aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ni, avanudaiya udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattavan, antha raajaavinudaiya sthaanamaakiya paapiloan naduvilea avana'ndaiyil irunthu mara'namadaivaanen'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
avan aneakam janangka'lai naasampa'n'numpadi a'naipoattu, koththa'langka'laik kattumpoathu, paarvoan periya seanaiyoadum, thira'laana koottaththoadum vanthu ivanukkaaka yuththaththil uthavamaattaan.
ithoa, ivan kaiyadiththuk koduththirunthum udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattu, aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ninaan; ippadiyellaam seythavan thappuvathillai.

athinimiththam karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: avan en aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ninathaiyum, en udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattathaiyum, naan avanudaiya thalaiyinmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.

avan ennudaiya ka'n'niyil akappadumpadikku naan en valaiyai avanmeal veesi, avanaip paapiloanukkuk ko'ndupoay, avan enakku viroathamaayp pa'n'nina thuroakaththinimiththam angkea avanai niyaayam visaarippean.

avanoadeakooda oadippoaki'ra yaavarum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lum pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; meethiyaanavarka'loa sakala thisaika'lilum sitha'radikkappaduvaarka'l; appozhuthu karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan uyarntha keathuruvin nunikki'laika'lil on'rai eduththu, athai naduvean; athin i'langki'laiyilu'l'la kozhunthuka'lil i'lasaayirukki'ra on'raik koythu, athai uyaramum unnathamumaana oru parvathaththinmeal naattuvean.

isravealin uyaramaana parvathaththilea athai naattuvean; athu koppuka'lai vittu, kanithanthu, makimaiyaana keathuruvaakum; athin keezhea sakalavitha padchijaathika'lum thangki, athin ki'laika'lin nizhalilea thaaparikkum.

appadiyea karththaraakiya naan uyarntha virudchaththaith thaazhththi, thaazhntha virudchaththai uyarththinean en'rum, naan pachchaiyaana virudchaththaip pattuppoakappa'n'ni, pattuppoana virudchaththaith thazhaikkappa'n'ninean en'rum ve'liyin virudchangka'lukku ellaam theriyavarum; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean, ithai ni'raiveat'rinean en'ru uraiththaar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
pithaakka'l thiraadchakkaayka'laith thin'raarka'l, pi'l'laika'lin pa'rka'l koosippoayina ennum pazhamozhiyai neengka'l israveal theasaththaikku'riththuch solluki'rathu enna?
ini isravealil inthap pazhamozhiyaich solvathu illai enpathai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
ithoa, ellaa aaththumaakka'lum ennudaiyavaika'l; thakappanin aaththumaa eppadiyoa, appadiyea makanin aaththumaavum ennudaiyathu; paavagnseyki'ra aaththumaavea saakum.
oruvan neethimaanaayirunthu, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seythu,

malaika'linmeal saappidaamalum, israveal vamsaththaarin narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku nearaakath than ka'nka'lai ea'redukkaamalum, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththaamalum thoorasthireeyoadea searaamalum,

oruvanaiyum odukkaamalum, ko'l'laiyidaamalumirunthu, kadan vaangkinavanukku adaimaanaththaith thirumpakkoduththu, than appaththaip pasiththavanukkup pangkittu, vasthiramillaathavanukku vasthiram tharippiththu,
vattikkuk kodaamalum, polisai vaangkaamalum, aniyaayaththukkuth than kaiyai vilakki, manitharukku'l'la vazhakkai u'nmaiyaayth theerththu,
en katta'laika'linpadi nadanthu, en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'ndu, u'nmaiyaayiruppaanaakil avanea neethimaan; avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
aanaalum avanukku oru kumaaran pi'ranthu, avan ka'l'lanum iraththagnsinthuki'ravanum, mea'rsolliya kadamaika'linpadi nadavaamal,
ivaika'lil on'rukkoppaanathaich seyki'ravanumaayirunthu, malaika'linmeal saappittu, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththi,

si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanai odukki, ko'l'laikkaaranaayirunthu, adaimaanaththaith thirumpak kodaamal, narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku nearaakath than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, aruvaruppaanathaich seythu,
vattikkuk koduththu, polisai vaangkinaal, avan pizhaippaanoa? avan pizhaippathillai; intha ellaa aruvaruppuka'laiyum seythaanea; avan saakavea saavaan; avan iraththappazhi avanmeal irukkum.
pinnum, ithoa, avanukku oru kumaaran pi'ranthu, avan than thakappan seytha ellaap paavangka'laiyum ka'ndu, thaan avaika'linpadi seyyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,
malaika'linmeal saappidaamalum, israveal vamsaththaarin narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku nearaakath than ka'nka'lai ea'redukkaamalum, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththaamalum,
oruvanaiyum odukkaamalum, adaimaanaththai vaiththukko'ndiraamalum, ko'l'laiyidaamalum, than appaththaip pasiththavanukkup pangkittu, vasthiramillaathavanukku vasthirantharippiththu,

si'rumaiyaanavanukku noavu'ndaakkaathapadith than kaiyai vilakki, vattiyum polisaiyum vaangkaamalirunthu en niyaayangka'linpadi seythu, en katta'laika'lil nadanthaal, avan than thakappanudaiya akkiramaththinimiththam saakaamal pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan.
avan thakappanoaven'raal kodumaiseythu, sakoatharanaik ko'l'laiyittu, thakaathathaith than janangka'lin naduvilea seythapadiyinaal, ithoa, avan than akkiramaththilea saavaan.

itheppadi, kumaaran thakappanudaiya akkiramaththaich sumakki'rathillaiyaa en'ru neengka'l keattaal, kumaaran niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seythu, en katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seythathinaal, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan.

paavagnseyki'ra aaththumaavea saakum; kumaaran thakappanudaiya akkiramaththaich sumappathumillai, thakappan kumaaranudaiya akkiramaththaich sumappathumillai; neethimaanudaiya neethi avanmealthaan irukkum, thunmaarkkanudaiya thunmaarkkamum avanmealthaan irukkum.

thunmaarkkan thaan seytha ellaap paavangka'laiyum vittuth thirumpi, en katta'laika'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyvaaneayaakil, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan, avan saavathillai.
avan seytha ellaa mee'ruthalka'lum ninaikkappaduvathillai; avan thaan seytha neethiyilea pizhaippaan.
