thunmaarkkan saaki'rathu enakku evva'laveanum piriyamoa? avan than vazhika'lai vittuth thirumpip pizhaippathu allavoa enakkup piriyam en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

neethimaan than neethiyaivittu vilaki, aneethi seythu, thunmaarkkan seyki'ra sakala aruvaruppuka'linpadiyum seyvaaneayaakil, avan pizhaippaanoa? avan seytha avanudaiya ellaa neethika'lum ninaikkappaduvathillai; avan seytha than thuroakaththileayum avan seytha than paavaththileayum saavaan.

neengka'loa, aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaay irukkavillai enki'reerka'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, kea'lungka'l; en vazhi semmaiyaayiraathoa? ungka'l vazhika'l allavoa semmaiyallaathathaayirukki'rathu.
neethimaan than neethiyaivittu vilaki, aneethiseythu athilea seththaal, avan seytha than aneethiyinimiththam avan saavaan.
thunmaarkkan thaan seytha thunmaarkkaththaivittu vilaki, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyvaaneayaakil, avan than aaththumaavaip pizhaikkappa'n'nuvaan.
avan echcharippadainthu, thaan seytha ellaa mee'ruthalka'laiyum vittuth thirumpuki'rapadiyinaalea avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan, avan saavathillai.

israveal vamsaththaaroa: aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaay irukkavillai enki'raarka'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, en vazhika'l semmaiyaayiraathoa? ungka'l vazhika'l allavoa semmaiyallaathathaayirukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal israveal vamsaththaarea, naan ungka'lil avanavanai avanavan vazhika'lukkuth thakkathaaka niyaayantheerppean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; neengka'l mananthirumpungka'l, ungka'ludaiya ellaa mee'ruthalka'laiyum vittuth thirumpungka'l; appozhuthu akkiramam ungka'l keattukkuk kaara'namaayiruppathillai.

neengka'l thuroakampa'n'nina ungka'ludaiya ellaath thuroakangka'laiyum ungka'lmeal iraathapadikku vilakki, ungka'lukkup puthu iruthayaththaiyum puthu aaviyaiyum u'ndupa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l ean saakavea'ndum?
mananthirumpungka'l, appozhuthu pizhaippeerka'l; saaki'ravanudaiya saavai naan virumpuki'rathillai en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
nee israveal pirapukka'linpearil oru pulampal paadi,
sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: un thaay eppadippattava'l? ava'l oru pe'nsingkam, ava'l singkangka'lukku'l'lea paduththirunthu, paalasingkangka'lin naduvilea than kuttika'lai va'larththaa'l.
than kuttika'lil on'ru va'larnthu, paalasingkamaaki, iraitheadap pazhaki, manusharaip padchiththathu.
pu'rajaathika'lum athin seythiyaik keattaarka'l, athu avarka'ludaiya padukuzhiyil akappattathu; athaich sangkilika'linaal katti, ekipthutheasaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
thaaychsingkam kaaththirunthu, than nampikkai apaththamaayp poayit'ren'ru ka'ndu, athu than kuttika'lil vea'ron'rai eduththu, athaip paalasingkamaaka vaiththathu.
athu singkangka'lukku'l'lea sagnchariththu, paalasingkamaaki, iraitheadap pazhaki, manusharaip padchiththathu.
avarka'ludaiya paazhaana aramanaika'lil thirinthu, avarka'ludaiya patta'nangka'laip paazhaakkit'ru; athinudaiya kerchchippin saththaththukkuth theasamum athilu'l'la yaavum thikaiththathu.
appozhuthu sut'ruppu'raththu jaathika'l atha'rku viroathamaaka ezhumpivanthu, thangka'l valaiyai athinmeal veesinaarka'l; athu avarka'ludaiya padukuzhiyilea akappattathu.

avarka'l athaich sangkilika'linaal katti, oru koottukkudpaduththi, athaip paapiloan raajaavinidaththukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; ini athin saththam isravealin parvathangka'linmeal keadkappadaathapadikku athai ara'naana idangka'lil ko'ndupoay adaiththaarka'l.
nee amarikkaiyoadu irukkaiyil un thaay tha'n'neer oaramaay naattappattathum, mikuthiyaana neerppaaychchalaal kanitharuki'rathum thazhaiththirukki'rathumaana thiraadchachsediyaayirunthaa'l.

aa'luki'ravarka'lin sengkoalukkeat'ra palaththa koppuka'l atha'rku irunthathu; athin va'larththi adarththiyaana ki'laika'lukku'l'lea uyara oangki, than uyarththiyinaalea than thira'laana kodika'loadungkoodath thoan'rit'ru.

aanaalum athu ukkiramaayp pidungkappattu, tharaiyilea tha'l'lu'ndathu; keezhkkaat'rinaal athin kani kaaynthupoayit'ru; athin palaththa koppuka'l mu'rinthu, pattuppoayina; akkini avaika'laip padchiththathu.
ippozhuthu athu va'ra'ndathum tha'n'neer illaathathumaana vanaanthara poomiyilea nadappattirukki'rathu.

athin kodika'lilu'l'la oru koppilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, athin kaniyaip padchiththathu; aa'luki'ra sengkoalukkeat'ra palaththa koppu ini athil illaiyen'ru sol; ithuvea pulampal, ithuvea pulampalaayirukkum en'raar.
eazhaam varushaththu ainthaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea isravealin moopparil silar karththaridaththil visaarikkumpadivanthu, enakku munpaaka udkaarnthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee israveal moopparoadea peasi, avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l ennidaththil visaarikka vantheerka'loa? neengka'l ennidaththil visaarikka idangkodean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.
manupuththiranea, nee avarka'lukkaaka vazhakkaaduvaayoa? vazhakkaada manathaanaal, nee avarka'l pithaakka'lin aruvaruppuka'lai avarka'lukkuth theriyakkaatti, avarka'lai noakki:

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan isravealaith therinthuko'nda naa'lilea yaakkoapu vamsaththu janangka'lukku naan aa'naiyittu, ekipthutheasaththil ennai avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththi, naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru aa'naiyittean.

naan avarka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaippean en'rum, avarka'lukkaaka naan paarththuvaiththathum, paalum theanum oaduki'rathum ellaath theasangka'lin singkaaramumaana theasaththilea avarka'laik ko'nduvanthu viduvean en'rum annaa'lilea aa'naiyittu,

ungka'lil avaravar thangka'l ka'nka'laal noakkina aruvaruppuka'laith tha'l'livittu, ekipthin narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal ungka'laith theettuppaduththaathiruppeerka'laaka; ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar naan en'ru avarka'loadea sonnean.

avarka'loa, en sollaik keadka manathillaamal enakku viroathamaay ira'ndakampa'n'ninaarka'l; avaravar thangka'l ka'nka'laal noakkina aruvaruppuka'laith tha'l'lippoadaamalum, ekipthin narakalaana vikkirakangka'lai vidaamalum irunthaarka'l; aathalaal ekipthu theasaththin naduvilea en koapaththai avarka'lilea theerththukko'l'lumpadikku en ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal oot'ruvean en'rean.

aakilum naan ennai ivarka'lukku ve'lippaduththi, ivarka'lukku munpaaka en naamam parisuththakkulaichchalaakaathapadikku, ivarka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, en naamaththinimiththam kirupaiseythean.
aakaiyaal naan avarka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avarka'lai vanaantharaththil azhaiththuvanthu,
en katta'laika'lai avarka'lukkuk koduththu, en niyaayangka'lai avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththinean; avaika'linpadi seyki'ra manushan avaika'laal pizhaippaan.
naan thangka'laip parisuththampa'n'nuki'ra karththar en'ru avarka'l a'riyumpadikku, enakkum avarka'lukkum adaiyaa'lamaay iruppatha'rkaana en oayvunaadka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittean.

aanaalum israveal vamsaththaar vanaantharaththil enakku viroathamaay ira'ndakampa'n'ninaarka'l; en katta'laika'linpadiyea manushan seythaal avaika'laal pizhaippaan; avarka'loa avaika'lil nadavaamal, en niyaayangka'lai ve'ruththu, en oayvunaadka'lin parisuththaththai mikavum kulaiththuppoattaarka'l; aathalaal avarka'lai nirmoolamaakkumpadi vanaantharaththilea en ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal oot'ruvean en'rean.
aakilum naan ivarka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ninathaik ka'nda pu'rajaathika'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka en naamam parisuththakkulaichchalaakaathapadikku, en naamaththinimiththam kirupaiseythean.

aanaalum avarka'ludaiya iruthayam avarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'laip pinpat'ri, avarka'l en niyaayangka'lai ve'ruththu, en katta'laika'lil nadavaama'rpoay, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinapadiyaal,

naan vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninathum, paalum theanum oaduki'rathum, ellaa theasangka'lin singkaaramaayirukki'rathumaana theasaththilea avarka'laik ko'nduvanthu viduvathillai en'ru vanaantharaththil aa'naiyittean.
aakilum avarka'lai azhikkaathapadikku, en ka'n avarka'laith thappavittathu; naan avarka'lai vanaantharaththil nirmoolamaakkavillai.

vanaantharaththil avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l pithaakka'lin mu'raimaika'lil nadavaamalum avarka'ludaiya niyaayangka'laik kaikko'l'laamalum, avarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal ungka'laith theettuppaduththaamalum irungka'l.
ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar naanea; neengka'l en katta'laika'lil nadanthu, en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadiyea seythu,
en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththamaakkungka'l; naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru neengka'l a'riyumpadikku avaika'l enakkum ungka'lukkum adaiyaa'lamaayirukkum en'rean.

aanaalum pi'l'laika'lum enakku viroathamaay ezhumpinaarka'l; en katta'laika'linpadiyea manushan seythaal avaika'laal pizhaippaanea; avarka'loa avaika'lil nadavaamalum, en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'ndu avaika'linpadi seyyaamalum, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkippoattaarka'l; aakaiyaal vanaantharaththilea en koapaththai avarka'lil theerththukko'l'lumpadi en ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal oot'ruvean en'rean.

aakilum naan en kaiyaith thiruppi, naan ivarka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ninathaik ka'nda pu'rajaathika'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka en naamam parisuththakkulaichchalaakaathapadikku, en naamaththinimiththam kirupaiseythean.

aanaalum avarka'l en niyaayangka'linpadi seyyaamal, en katta'laika'lai ve'ruththu, en oayvunaadka'lai parisuththak kulaichchalaakkinapadiyaalum, avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l avarka'l pithaakka'lin narakalaana vikkirakangka'linmeal noakkamaayirunthapadiyaalum,
naan avarka'laip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu, avarka'laith theasangka'lilea thoot'rippoaduki'ratha'rku vanaantharaththilea aa'naiyittean.
aakaiyaal nanmaikkeathuvallaatha katta'laika'laiyum jeevanukkeathuvallaatha niyaayangka'laiyum naan avarka'lukkuk koduththean.

naan karththar en'ru avarka'l a'riyaththakkathaaka, naan avarka'laip paazhaakkumpadi, avarka'l karppanthi'ranthu pi'rakki'rathaiyellaam theekkadakkappa'n'ni, ivvithamaay avarka'ludaiya palika'linaalea avarka'laith theettuppadappa'n'ninean.

aakaiyaal manupuththiranea, nee israveal vamsaththaaroadea peasi, avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ungka'l pithaakka'l innum enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ni, ennaith thooshiththaarka'l.

avarka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru aa'naiyitta theasaththilea naan avarka'laip piraveasikkappa'n'ninapinpu, avarka'l uyarntha oru meattaiyum thazhaiththa oru virudchaththaiyum engkengkea ka'ndaarka'loa, angkangkea thangka'l palika'laich seluththi, avvidangka'lilellaam enakku erichchal u'ndaakkuki'ra thangka'l kaa'nikkaika'laip padaiththu, sukantha vaasanaiyaana thangka'l thoopangka'laikkaatti, thangka'l paanapalika'lai vaarththaarka'l.
appozhuthu naan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l poaki'ra antha meadu ennaven'ru keattean; athinaal innaa'lvaraikkum atha'rkup paamaa en'ru pear.

aakaiyaal nee israveal vamsaththaarai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya maarkkaththinpadiyea neengka'lum theettuppattavarka'l allavoa? avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'lai neengka'lum pinpat'rich soarampoaki'reerka'l allavoa?

neengka'l ungka'l pi'l'laika'laith theekkadakkappa'n'ni, ungka'l palika'laich seluththuki'rapoathu, innaa'lvaraikkum avarka'ludaiya ellaa narakalaana vikkirakangka'laalum neengka'l theettuppaduki'reerka'lea; neengka'l ennidaththil visaarikka idangkoduppeanoa? israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l ennidaththil visaarikkumpadi idangkoduppathillai en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

maraththukkum kallukkum aaraathanaiseythu, agngnaanika'laippoalavum theasaththu janangka'lin jaathika'laippoalavum iruppoam en'ru solluki'reerka'lea; ungka'l manathil ezhumpuki'ra intha ninaivinpadi aavathea illai.
palaththa kaiyinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum, oot'rappatta ukkiraththinaalum, ungka'lai aa'luvean enpathai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

neengka'l janangka'lukku'l iraathapadikku naan ungka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, neengka'l sitha'riyirukki'ra theasangka'lil iraathapadikku naan ungka'laip palaththakaiyinaalum, oangkiya puyaththinaalum, oot'rappatta ukkiraththinaalum koodivarachseythu,
ungka'lai janasatha'langka'lin vanaantharaththilea ko'ndupoay, angkea ungka'loadea mukamukamaay vazhakkaaduvean.
naan ekipthutheasaththin vanaantharaththil ungka'l pithaakka'loadu vazhakkaadinathupoala ungka'loadum vazhakkaaduvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
naan ungka'laik koalinkeezh sellumpadi seythu, ungka'lai udanpadikkaiyin kattukkudpaduththi,

kalakakkaararaiyum thuroakika'laiyum ungka'laivittup piriththuppoaduvean; avarka'laith thaangka'l thangkum theasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nuvean; aanaalum avarka'l israveal theasaththil piraveasippathillai; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

ippoathum israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l en sollaikkeadka manathillaathirunthaal, neengka'l poay, avanavan than than narakalaana vikkirakangka'lai innum seaviyungka'l; aanaalum en parisuththa naamaththai ungka'l kaa'nikkaika'laalum ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laalum inip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkaathirungka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

isravealin uyaramaana malaiyaakiya en parisuththa malaiyilea isravealudaiya ellaa vamsaththaarumaakiya theasaththilu'l'la anaivarum ennaich seavippaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; angkea avarka'lmeal piriyam vaippean; angkea neengka'l parisuththampa'n'nuki'ra ellaavat'rilum ungka'l kaa'nikkaika'laiyum ungka'l mutha'rpalanka'laiyum seluththumpadi keadpean.

naan ungka'lai janangka'lilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, neengka'l sitha'ru'ndirukki'ra theasangka'lilirunthu ungka'laich searththukko'l'lumpoathu, sukantha vaasanaiyinimiththam naan ungka'lpearil piriyamaayiruppean; appozhuthu pu'rajaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ungka'laal parisuththampa'n'nappaduvean.
ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru aa'naiyitta theasamaakiya israveal theasaththilea naan ungka'laith thirumpivarappa'n'numpoathu, naan karththar en'ru neengka'l a'rinthuko'ndu,

angkea ungka'ludaiya ellaa vazhika'laiyum ungka'laith theettuppaduththina ungka'ludaiya ellaak kiriyaika'laiyum ninaiththu, neengka'l seythiruntha ungka'ludaiya ellaap pollaappuka'linimiththamum ungka'lai neengka'lea aruvaruppeerka'l.

israveal vamsaththaarea, ungka'l pollaatha vazhika'lukkuth thakkathaakavum, ungka'l ketta kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaakavum naan ungka'lukkuch seyyaamal, en naamaththinimiththam ungka'lukkuk kirupaiseyyumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l enki'rathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee un mukaththaith thenthisaikku nearea thiruppi, the'rkukku viroathamaaka un vasanaththaippozhinthu, thenpu'ramaana vayalve'liyin kaattukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu,

thenthisaik kaattai noakki: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, naan unnil akkiniyaik ko'luththuvean; athu unnil pachchaiyaana sakala marangka'laiyum pattuppoana sakala marangka'laiyum padchikkum; juvaalikki'ra juvaalai avikkappadamaattaathu; the'rku thuvakki vadakkumattumu'l'la theasamengkum athinaal venthupoakum.
karththaraakiya naan athaik ko'luththinean enpathai ellaa maamsamum kaa'num; athu avikkappaduvathillai en'ru sol en'raar.
appozhuthu naan: aa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ivan uvamaika'laiyallavoa solluki'raan en'ru avarka'l ennaikku'riththuch solluki'raarka'l en'rean.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee un mukaththai erusaleamukku nearaakath thiruppi, parisuththa sthalangka'lukku viroathamaaka un vasanaththaip pozhinthu, israveal theasaththukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu,

israveal theasaththai noakki, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, en pattayaththai athin u'raiyilirunthu uruvi, unnil sanmaarkkanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum sangkaarampa'n'nuvean.

naan unnil sanmaarkkanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum sangkaarampa'n'nap poaki'rapadiyinaal the'rku thuvakki vadakkumattumu'l'la ellaa maamsaththukkum viroathamaay en pattayam athin u'raiyilirunthu pu'rappadum.
appozhuthu karththaraakiya naan en pattayaththai athin u'raiyilirunthu uruvinean enpathai ellaa maamsamum a'riyum; athu ini u'raikku'l thirumpuvathillai.
aathalaal manupuththiranea, un iduppu no'rungkumpadi perumoochchuvidu; avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka manangkasanthu perumoochchuvidu.

nee ethinimiththam perumoochchuviduki'raay en'ru avarka'l unnidaththil keattaal, nee avarka'lai noakki: thurchseythi varuki'rathinimiththamea; athinaal, iruthayangka'lellaam uruki, kaika'lellaam tha'larnthu, manamellaam thiyangki, muzhangkaalka'lellaam tha'n'neeraippoala alaivu'n'num; ithoa, athu vanthu sampavikkum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: pattayam koormaiyaakkappattathu, pattayam koormaiyaakkappattathu; athu thulakkappattumirukki'rathu.

makaa sangkaaragnseyvatha'rku athu koormaiyaakkappattirukki'rathu; minnaththakkathaay athu thulakkappattirukki'rathu; santhoashappaduvoamoa? athu en kumaaranudaiya koal, athu sakala virudchangka'laiyum aladchiyampa'n'num.

athaik kaiyaadumpadi athaiththulakkak koduththaar; kolluki'ravan kaiyilea kodukkumpadi anthap pattayam koormaiyaakkappattirukki'rathu; athu thulakkappattathumaayirukki'rathu en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.

manupuththiranea, nee oalamittu ala'ru; pattayam en janaththinmeal varum; athu israveal pirapukka'l ellaarmealum varum; athinimiththam en janaththukku'l'lea thikil u'ndaayirukkum; aakaiyaal un vilaavilea adiththukko'l.
yaavaiyum ka'ndikki'ra koal vanthaalozhiya inich soathanaiyinaal theeruki'rathennaven'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam solli, kaiyoadea kaikottu; pattayam moon'rutharam irattiththuvarum; athu kolaiyu'ndavarka'lin pattayam; athu kolaiyu'n'nappoaki'ra periyavarka'lin u'l'la'raika'lil piraveasikki'ra pattayam.

avarka'ludaiya iruthayam karainthu, avarka'ludaiya idaiyoo'ruka'l thira'laakumpadi, pattayaththin koormaiyai avarka'ludaiya ellaa vaasalka'lukkum nearidak katta'laiyiduvean; aa, athu minnumpadiyaakap pathamidappattathu, vettumpadiyaakath theettivaikkappattathu.
eakapalamaay valathupu'ramaaka vettu, thirumpi idathupu'ramaakavum vettu; un mukam thirumpuki'ra thikkellaam vettu.
naanum kaiyoadea kaikotti, en ukkiraththai aa'rappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya naan sonnean en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, paapiloan raajaavin pattayam varaththakkathaaka ira'nduvazhika'laik ku'riththukko'l; ira'ndum orea theasaththilirunthu varavea'ndum; nee oru idaththaith therinthuko'l, nakaraththukkup poaki'ra vazhiyin munaiyil antha idaththaith therinthuko'l.

pattayam ammoan puththirarin patta'namaakiya rappaavukku viroathamaaka varaththakka oru vazhiyaiyum, yoothaavil irukki'ra ara'naana erusaleamukku viroathamaaka varaththakka oru vazhiyaiyum ku'riththukko'l.
paapiloan raajaa ira'ndu vazhika'lin munaiyaakiya vazhippirivilea nimiththam paarkki'ratha'rkaaka ni'rpaan; ampuka'laith theetti, vikkirakangka'lai usaavi, eeralaal ku'ripaarppaan.

thalaivarai niyamikki'ratha'rkum, sangkaaragnseyyumpadi aarpparikki'ratha'rkum, kempeeramaaych saththamiduki'ratha'rkum, vaasalka'lai muttum yanthirangka'lai vaikki'ratha'rkum, ma'nmeadu poaduki'ratha'rkum, koththa'langka'laik kattuki'ratha'rkum, erusaleamaikku'riththu nimiththam paarkkuthal avanudaiya valathupu'raththilea u'ndaayirukkum.
intha nimiththamaanathu aa'naiyittavarka'lukku munpaakap poyyaakath thoan'rum; aayinum avarka'l pidikkappadumpadi avan avarka'l thuroakaththai ninaippaan.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ungka'l thuroakangka'l ve'liyarangkamaaki'rathinaalum, ungka'l seykaika'lilellaam ungka'l paavangka'l theriyavaruki'rathinaalum, neengka'l ungka'l akkiramaththai ninaikkappa'n'nuki'reerka'lea; neengka'l ippadippattavarka'len'ru ninaikkappaduki'reerka'lea; aathalaal kaippidiyaayp pidikkappaduveerka'l.
isravealai aa'luki'ra avapakthiyu'l'la thunmaarkka athipathiyea, akkiramaththukku mudivuvarungkaalaththil un naa'l vanthathu.
paakaiyaik kazhat'ru, kireedaththai eduththuppoadu; athu ini munpoaliraathu; thaazhnthavanai uyarththi, uyarnthavanaith thaazhththuvean.
athaik kavizhppean, kavizhppean, kavizhppean; urimaikkaaranaanavar varumattum athu illaathirukkum; avarukkea athaik koduppean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pinnum manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam sollu: ammoan puththiraraiyum avarka'l sollum ninthanaika'laiyum ku'riththuk karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal,

akkiramaththukku mudivuvarungkaalaththil vantha thangka'ludaiya naa'lukku eathuvaaki, kolaiyu'ndupoanavarka'ludaiya pidarika'loadeakooda unnaith thunmaarkkarin kaiyinaal vizhappa'n'numpadikku, unakku apaththamaanathu tharisikkappaduki'rapoathum, unakkup poynimiththam paarkkappaduki'rapoathum pattayam uruvappattathu, pattayamea uruvappattathu; vettavum sangkarikkavum athu minnaththakkathaayth thulakkappattirukki'rathu.
un pattayaththai nee thirumpa athin u'raiyilea poadu; nee sirushdikkappatta sthaanamaakiya un jenmatheasaththilea naan unnai niyaayantheerththu,
en sinaththai unmeal oot'ruvean; naan en moorkkaththin akkiniyai unmeal oothi, mirukaku'namu'l'lavarka'lum, azhikki'ratha'rkuth thi'ramaiyu'l'lavarka'lumaakiya manusharin kaiyil unnai oppukkoduppean.
nee akkinikku iraiyaavaay; un iraththam un theasaththin naduvil sinthikkidakkum; nee ini ninaikkappaduvathillai; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
ippoathum manupuththiranea, iraththagnsinthina nakaraththukkaaka nee vazhakkaaduvaayoa? vazhakkaada manathaanaal, nee athin aruvaruppuka'laiyellaam atha'rkuth theriyakkaatti,

athai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, un kaalam varaththakkathaaka un naduvilea iraththagnsinthuki'rathum, unnaith theettuppaduththaththakkathaaka unakkea viroathamaay narakalaana vikkirakangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuki'rathumaana nakaramea,

nee sinthina un iraththaththinaal nee kut'ragnsumanthathaaki, nee u'ndupa'n'nina un narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal nee theettuppattu, un naadka'laich sameepikkappa'n'ni, un varushangka'lai ni'raiveat'rinaay; aakaiyaal naan unnaip pu'rajaathika'lukku ninthaiyaakavum, theasangka'lukkellaam pariyaasamaakavum vaippean.
unakkuch sameepamum unakkuth thooramumaana theasangka'lin manushar nee avakeerththiyu'l'lathen'rum, ama'li peruththathen'rum unnaip pariyaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l.
ithoa, isravealin athipathika'lil avaravar thangka'l puyapalaththukkuth thakkathaaka, unnil iraththagnsinthinaarka'l.
unnilu'l'la thaay thakappanai a'rpamaay e'n'ninaarka'l; un naduvil paratheasikku idukka'n seythaarka'l; unakku'l thikkat'ravanaiyum vithavaiyaiyum odukkinaarka'l.
nee en parisuththa vasthukka'lai asattaipa'n'ni, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinaay.

iraththagnsinthumpadikku apaa'ndam peasuki'ravarka'l unnidaththil irukki'raarka'l; malaika'linmeal saappiduki'ravarka'lum unnidaththil irukki'raarka'l; mu'raikeadu seyki'ravarka'l un naduvil irukki'raarka'l.
thakappanai nirvaa'namaakkinavarka'l unnil irukki'raarka'l; thoorasthireeyaip palavanthappaduththinavarka'l unnil irukki'raarka'l.

unnil oruvan than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyoadea aruvaruppaanathaich seyki'raan; vea'roruvan mu'raikeadaayth than marumaka'laith theettuppaduththuki'raan; vea'roruvan than thakappanukkup pi'rantha than sakoathariyaip palavantham pa'n'nuki'raan.

iraththagnsinthumpadikkup parithaanam vaangkinavarka'l unnil irukki'raarka'l; nee vattiyaiyum polisaiyaiyum vaangki, poru'laasaiyinaal un ayalaanukku idukka'n seythu, ennai ma'ranthu poanaay en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
ithoa, nee aniyaayamaaych sampaathiththa poru'linimiththamum, un naduvil nee sinthina iraththaththinimiththamum naan kaikottuki'rean.
naan unnil niyaayagnseyyum naadka'lil un iruthayam thaangkumoa? appozhuthu un kaika'l thidamaayirukkumoa? karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean, ithai ni'raiveat'ruvean.
naan unnaip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu, unnaith theasangka'lilea thoot'ri, un asuththaththai unnil ozhiyappa'n'nuvean.
nee pu'rajaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaakap parisuththak kulaichchalaayirunthu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaay en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, israveal vamsaththaar enakkuk ka'limpaayp poanaarka'l; avarka'lellaarum kukaiyilu'l'la piththa'laiyum thakaramum irumpum eeyamumaayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l ve'l'liyin ka'limpaayp poanaarka'l.
aathalaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengka'lellaarum ka'limpaayp poanapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan ungka'lai erusaleamukku'l searppean.

ve'l'liyaiyum piththa'laiyaiyum irumpaiyum eeyaththaiyum thakaraththaiyum akkiniyil oothi urukkuvatha'rkaakak kukaikku'l searkki'rathupoala, naan en koapaththinaalum en ukkiraththinaalum ungka'laich searththuvaiththu urukkuvean.
naan ungka'laik kootti, en koapamaakiya akkiniyai ungka'lmeal oothuvean; atha'rku'l'lea neengka'l urukuveerka'l.
kukaikku'l ve'l'li urukumaappoala, neengka'l atha'rku'l urukuveerka'l; appozhuthu karththaraakiya naan en ukkiraththai ungka'lmeal oot'rivittean en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee theasaththaip paarththu: nee suththampa'n'nappadaathatheasam, koapaththin kaalaththil mazhai peyyaatha theasam en'ru atha'rkuch sollu.

athilu'l'la theerkkatharisika'l athin naduvil kattuppaadu pa'n'nuki'raarka'l; kerchchikki'ra singkam irai kavvuki'rathupoala, aaththumaakka'lai avarka'l padchikki'raarka'l; thiraviyaththaiyum vilaiyuyarntha poru'lka'laiyum vaangkikko'l'luki'raarka'l; athin naduvil aneakarai vithavaika'laakkuki'raarka'l.

athin aasaariyarka'l en veathaththukku aniyaayagnseythu, en parisuththa vasthukka'laip parisuththak kulaichchalaakkuki'raarka'l; parisuththamu'l'latha'rkum parisuththamillaathatha'rkum viththiyaasampa'n'naamalum, asuththamu'l'latha'rkum asuththamillaathatha'rkum u'ndaana veat'rumaiyaik kaa'npiyaamalum irunthu, en oayvunaadka'lukkuth thangka'l ka'nka'lai moodikko'l'luki'raarka'l; avarka'l naduvilea naan kanaeenampa'n'nappaduki'rean.

athin naduvil irukki'ra athin pirapukka'l irai kavvuki'ra oanaayka'laippoal irukki'raarka'l; aniyaayamaayp poru'l sampaathikki'ratha'rku iraththagnsinthuki'raarka'l, aaththumaakka'laik ko'l'laiyiduki'raarka'l.

athin theerkkatharisika'l apaththamaanathaith tharisiththu, poychsaasthiraththai avarka'lukkuch solli, karththar uraikkaathirunthum, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraiththaar en'ru solli, avarka'lukkuch saaramat'ra saanthaip poosuki'raarka'l.
theasaththin janangka'l idukka'nseythu, ko'l'laiyadiththu, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanai odukki, anniyanai aniyaayamaayth thunpappaduththuki'raarka'l.
naan theasaththai azhikkaathapadikkuth thi'rappilea ni'rkavum suvarai adaikkavunthakkathaaka oru manushanaith theadinean, oruvanaiyum kaa'nean.

aakaiyaal, naan avarka'lmeal en koapaththai oot'ri, en moorkkaththin akkiniyaal avarka'lai nirmoolamaakki, avarka'ludaiya vazhiyin palanai avarka'l thalaiyinmeal sumarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, orea thaayin kumaaraththika'laakiya ira'ndu sthireeka'l irunthaarka'l.

avarka'l ekipthilea veasiththanampa'n'ninaarka'l; thangka'l i'lampiraayaththilea veasiththanampa'n'ninaarka'l; angkea avarka'ludaiya sthanangka'l amukkappattu, avarka'ludaiya kannimaiyin kongkaika'l thodappattathu.

avarka'lil mooththava'lin peyar akoalaa'l, ava'ludaiya thangkaiyin peyar akoalipaa'l; avarka'l ennudaiyavarka'laaki, kumaararaiyum kumaaraththika'laiyum pet'raarka'l; ivaika'lea avarka'ludaiya peyarka'l; akoalaa'l enpatha'rkuch samaariyaa en'rum, akoalipaa'l enpatha'rku erusaleam en'rum poru'laam.
akoalaa'l ennudaiyava'laayirukkumpoathu soarampoanaa'l.

neelaamparanthariththa thalaivarum, athipathika'lum, saunthariya vaaliparum, kuthiraika'linmeal ea'ruki'ra veerarumaayiruntha sameepatheasaththaaraakiya aseeriyarenki'ra than sineakitharmeal ava'l moakiththu,

aseeriyarin puththiraril sireashdamaana anaivaroadum, thaan moakiththa anaivaroadum than veasiththanangka'lai nadappiththu, avarka'ludaiya narakalaana sakala vikkirakangka'laalum theettuppattuppoanaa'l.

thaan ekipthilea pa'n'nina veasiththanangka'lai ava'l vidavillai; avarka'l ava'ludaiya vaalipaththilea ava'loadea sayaniththu, ava'ludaiya kannimaiyin kongkaika'laith thottu, ava'lidaththil thangka'l veasiththanaththai nadappiththaarka'l.
aakaiyaal ava'ludaiya sineakitharin kaiyilea, ava'l moakiththiruntha aseeriyapuththirarin kaiyilea, naan ava'lai oppukkoduththean.

avarka'l ava'lai nirvaa'namaakkinaarka'l; ava'ludaiya kumaararaiyum ava'ludaiya kumaaraththika'laiyum si'raipidiththu, ava'laiyoa pattayaththinaal kon'rupoattaarka'l; appadiyea ava'lidaththil aakkinaika'l seyyappattapadiyinaal sthireeka'lukku'l avakeerththiyu'l'lava'laanaa'l.
ava'ludaiya thangkaiyaakiya akoalipaa'l ithaik ka'ndum, than moakavikaaraththil ava'laippaarkkilum kettava'laanaa'l; than sakoathariyin veasiththanangka'lilum than veasiththanangka'l athikamaayit'ru.
makaa alangkaara uduppu'l'la thalaivarum, athipathika'lum, kuthiraika'lmeal ea'ruki'ra veerarum, saunthariyamu'l'la vaaliparumaana sameepatheasaththaaraakiya aseeriya puththirarmeal moakangko'ndaa'l.
ava'lum asuththamaanaa'len'rum, avarka'l iruvarum orea vazhiyil poanaarka'len'rum ka'ndean.
ava'l than veasiththanangka'lil athikariththaa'l; suvaril jaathilingkaththaal siththirantheerntha kaltheayarin purusha suroopangka'laik ka'ndaa'l.

avarka'l ellaarum thangka'l jenmatheasamaakiya kaltheayaavil u'l'la paapiloan puththirarin saayalaakath thangka'l araika'lil kachchai kattinavarka'lum, thangka'l thalaika'lil saayantheerntha periya paakaika'laith thariththavarka'lum, paarvaikku raajakumaararka'lumaaka irunthaarka'l.
ava'ludaiya ka'nka'l avarka'laip paarththavudanea, ava'l avarka'lmeal moakiththu, kaltheayaavukku avarka'la'ndaiyilea sthaanaathipathika'lai anuppinaa'l.

appozhuthu paapiloan puththirar ava'la'ndaiyilea sineaka sampoakaththukku vanthu, thangka'l veasiththanangka'laal ava'laith theettuppaduththinaarka'l; ava'l ivarka'laal theettuppattup poanapinpu, ava'l manathu avarka'lai vittup pirinthathu.
ivvithamaay ava'l than veasiththanangka'lai ve'lippaduththi, thannai nirvaa'namaakkinapoathu, en manam ava'ludaiya sakoathariyai vittup pirinthathupoala ava'laiyum vittup pirinthathu.
ava'l ekipthutheasaththilea veasiththanam pa'n'nina than vaalipaththin naadka'lai ninaiththu, than veasiththanangka'lil athikariththuppoanaa'l.
kazhuthaimaamsamaana maamsamum, kuthirai inthiriyamaana inthiriyamumu'l'la avarka'lukku ava'l vaippaattiyaayirukkumpadi avarka'lmeal moakiththaa'l.
ekipthiyaraal un kannimaiyin sthanangka'laakiya kongkaika'l thodappatta kaalaththil, nee un i'lampiraayaththil seytha mu'raikeaduka'lai ninaiththuvaruki'raay.

aakaiyaal, akoalipaa'lea, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, un manathu vittup pirintha un sineakitharai naan unakku viroathamaaka ezhuppi, unakku viroathamaaka avarka'laich sut'rilum varappa'n'nuvean.

saunthariyamu'l'la vaaliparum, thalaivarum, athipathika'lum, kuthiraika'lmeal ea'ruki'ra veerarumaakiya pearpet'ra pirapukka'laana paapiloan puththiraraiyum, kaltheayar ellaaraiyum, peakoadu, soavaa, koavaa enki'ra theasangka'lin manusharaiyum avarka'loadeakooda aseeriya puththirar ellaaraiyum varappa'n'nuvean.

avarka'l va'ndilka'loadum, irathangka'loadum, yanthirangka'loadum, janakkoottaththoadum, keadakangka'lum parisaika'lum thalaichseeraakka'lum thariththavarka'laay, unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, unnaich sut'rilum paa'layami'rangkuvaarka'l; avarka'lukku munnea naan niyaayaththai vi'langkappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l thangka'l niyaayangka'linpadi unnai niyaayantheerppaarka'l.

unakku viroathamaaka en erichchalai vi'langkappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l unnai ukkiramaay nadappiththu, un mookkaiyum un kaathuka'laiyum a'ruththuppoaduvaarka'l; unnil meethiyaayiruppavarka'l pattayaththaal vettu'ndupoavaarka'l; avarka'l un kumaararaiyum un kumaaraththika'laiyum pidiththukko'l'luvaarka'l; unnil meethiyaayiruppavarka'l akkinikku iraiyaavaarka'l.
avarka'l un vasthirangka'lai urinthu, un singkaaramaana aapara'nangka'laip pa'riththukko'l'luvaarka'l.

ivvithamaay un mu'raikeattaiyum, nee ekipthutheasaththil thuvakkina un veasiththanaththaiyum ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; nee ini avarka'lai noakka un ka'nka'lai ea'redukkaamalum, ekipthuvai ninaiyaamalum iruppaay.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, nee pakaikki'ravarka'lin kaiyilum, un manam vittup pirinthavarka'lin kaiyilum naan unnai oppukkoduppean.

avarka'l unnai ve'ruppaay nadaththi, un pirayaasaththin palanaiyellaam eduththukko'ndu, unnai amma'namum nirvaa'namumaakkividuvaarka'l; appadiyea un vedkakkeadum un mu'raikeadumaana un veasiththanaththin nirvaa'nam ve'lippaduththappadum.
nee pu'rajaathika'laip pinthodarnthu, avarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal unnaith theettuppaduththikko'nda un veasiththanaththinimiththam ivaika'l unakkuch seyyappadum.
un sakoathariyin vazhiyilea nee nadanthaay; aakaiyaal ava'ludaiya paaththiraththai un kaiyilea koduppean.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee un sakoathariyinudaiya aazhamum akalamumaanathum ni'raiya vaarkkappattathumaana paaththiraththaik kudiththu, nakaippum pariyaasamumaavaay.
samaariyaa ennum un sakoathariyinudaiya paaththiramaayirukki'ra piramippum paazhkkadippum enki'ra paaththiraththaal ve'riyinaalum sagnchalaththinaalum ni'raiyappaduvaay.
nee athil irukki'rathaik kudiththu, u'rignchi, athin oaduka'lai udaiththuppoattu, un sthanangka'laik kee'rikko'lvaay; naan ithaich sonnean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
aakaiyaal, nee ennai ma'ranthu, ennai unakkup pu'rampea tha'l'livittathinimiththam, nee un mu'raikeattaiyum un veasiththanangka'laiyum sumappaay en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee akoalaa'laiyum akoalipaa'laiyum ku'riththu vazhakkaada manathaanaal, avarka'ludaiya aruvaruppuka'lai avarka'lukkuth theriyakkaattu.

avarka'l vipasaarampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'l kaika'lil iraththamum irukki'rathu; avarka'l thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'loadea vipasaarampa'n'ni, thaangka'l enakkup pet'ra thangka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum avaika'lukku iraiyaakath theekkadakkappa'n'ninaarka'l.
an'riyum avarka'l en parisuththa sthalaththai annaa'lileathaanea theettuppaduththi, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinaarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l pi'l'laika'laith thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukken'ru paliyittapinpu, avarka'l en parisuththa sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakka annaa'lilthaanea atha'rku'l piraveasiththaarka'l; ithoa, en aalayaththin naduvilea ippadich seythaarka'l.

ithuvumallaamal, thooraththilu'l'la purusharidaththi'rkuth thoothu anuppi, avarka'lai varavazhaiththaarka'l, avarka'l vanthaarka'l; avarka'lukken'ru nee ku'liththu, un ka'nka'lil maiyittukko'ndu, aapara'nangka'laal unnai alangkariththu,
si'rantha magnchaththinmeal udkaarnthuko'ndaay; athin munnea oru peedam aayaththampa'n'nappattirunthathu; en thoopavarkkaththaiyum en e'n'neyaiyum athinmeal vaiththaay.

ava'lidaththilea anthach santhadiyin iraichchal adangkina pinpu, janaththira'laana purusharaiyum azhaiththanuppinaarka'l; sapeayar vanaantharaththilirunthu ko'nduvarappattaarka'l; ivarka'l avarka'ludaiya kaika'lil kadakangka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya thalaika'lil alangkaaramaana kireedangka'laiyum poattaarka'l.
vipasaarangka'lil kizhaviyaanava'laikku'riththu ava'l innum than veasiththanangka'laich seyvaa'loa en'rean.
parasthireeyinidaththilea piraveasikkumaappoala ava'lidaththil piraveasiththaarka'l; inthappirakaaramaaka mu'raikeadaanavarka'laakiya akoalaa'lidaththilum akoalipaa'lidaththilum piraveasiththaarka'l.

aakaiyaal, vipasaarika'lai niyaayantheerkki'ra pirakaaramaakavum, iraththagnsinthum sthireeka'lai niyaayantheerkki'ra pirakaaramaakavum, neethimaanka'l avarka'lai niyaayantheerppaarka'l; avarka'l vipasaarika'l, avarka'ludaiya kaika'lil iraththam irukki'rathu.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan avarka'lukku viroathamaay oru koottaththaivarappa'n'ni, avarka'lai alaichchalukkum ko'l'laikkum oppukkoduppean.

anthak koottaththaar avarka'laik kalle'rinthu, thangka'l pattayangka'laal vettippoaduvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kumaararaiyum avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'laiyum kon'ru, avarka'ludaiya veeduka'lai akkiniyaal sutterippaarka'l.
ivvithamaay ellaa sthireeka'lum puththiyadainthu, ungka'l mu'raikeaduka'laich seyyaathirukkumpadi, mu'raikeattaith theasaththaivittu ozhiyappa'n'nuvean.

ungka'l mu'raikeattai ungka'lmeal sumaththuvaarka'l; appozhuthu neengka'l ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laich seaviththa paavangka'laich sumanthu, naan karththaraakiya aa'ndavar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
onpathaam varusham paththaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, intha naa'lin pearaiyum inthath theathiyaiyum nee ezhuthivai, inthath theathiyilthaanea paapiloan raajaa erusaleamil paa'layami'rangkinaan.

ippoathum nee kalakaveettaarukku oru upamaanaththaik kaa'npiththu, avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, oru kopparaiyai aduppilea vai; athai aduppilea vaiththu, athilea tha'n'neerai vidu.
sakala nalla ka'ndangka'laana pinnanthodaika'lum munnanthodaika'lumaakiya ka'ndangka'laich searththu athilea poadu; nalla elumpuka'laal athai nirappu.

aattumanthaiyil therinthuko'l'lappattathai atha'rkaakak ko'nduvanthu, elumpuka'lai athin keezhea kuviththu erikkavea'ndum; athilu'l'la elumpuka'lum veakaththakkathaaka athaip pongkappongkak kaaychchavea'ndum.

itha'rkaakak karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nurai ottikko'ndirukki'rathum nurai neengkaathathumaakiya kopparai ennappatta iraththagnsinthiya nakaraththukku aiyoa! athil irukki'rathaik ka'ndangka'ndamaaka eduththukko'ndupoa; athinpearil seettuppoadalaakaathu.
ava'l iraththam ava'l naduvil irukki'rathu; ma'n'nilea ma'rainthu poakumpadi athaith tharaiyilea oot'raamal ka'rpaa'raiyilea oot'rippoattaa'l.
neethiyaich sarikkattuvatha'rkaakak koapam moo'lumpadi naan ava'l iraththaththai ma'raikkaamal kanmalaiyinmeal vaiththean.
aathalaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: iraththagnsinthiya nakaraththukku aiyoa! naan perithaana kattaika'laik kuviththu eriyappa'n'nuvean.
thira'laana vi'rakuka'laik koottu, theeyai moottu, i'raichchiyai mu'rukaveaviththuch sampaarangka'lai idu; elumpuka'lai eriththuppoadu.
pinpu kopparai kaaynthu, athin ka'limpu venthu, atha'rku'l irukki'ra athin azhukku uruki, athin nurai neengkumpadi athai ve'rumaiyaakath thazhalinmeal vai.
athu makaa varuththaththai u'ndaakkiyum, athin thira'laana nurai athai vittu neengkavillai; athin nurai akkinikku u'l'laakavea'ndiyathu.

un asuththaththoadea mu'raikeadum irukki'rathu; naan unnaich suththikariththum, nee suththamaakaathapadiyinaal, ini en ukkiram unnil aa'riththeerumattum un asuththam neengkich suththikarikkappadamaattaay.

karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean, ithu ni'raivea'rum, naan ithaich seyvean; naan pinvaangkuvathum thappaviduvathum manasthaapappaduvathum illai; un vazhika'lukkum un seykaika'lukkunthakkathaaka unnai niyaayantheerppaarka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, ithoa, naan un ka'nka'lukku viruppamaanava'lai orea adiyinaalea unnaivittu eduththukko'l'luvean; aanaalum nee pulampaamalum azhaamalum ka'n'neervidaamalum iruppaayaaka.

ala'raamal perumoochchuvidu, izhavu ko'ndaadavea'ndaam; un paakaiyai un thalaiyilea katti, un paatharadchaika'lai un paathangka'lil thoduththukko'l; un thaadiyai moodaamalum thukkangko'ndaaduki'ravarka'lin appaththaip pusiyaamalum irukkakkadavaay en'raar.
vidiya'rkaalaththil naan janangka'loadea peasinean; an'ru saayangkaalaththil en manaivi seththuppoanaa'l; enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea vidiya'rkaalaththil seythean.
appozhuthu janangka'l ennai noakki: neer seyki'ravaika'l engka'lukku ennaththi'rku adaiyaa'lam enpathai engka'lukkuth therivikkamaatteeraa en'ru keattaarka'l.
naan avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

nee israveal veettaarai noakki, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, ungka'l palaththin mukkiyamum ungka'l ka'nka'lin viruppamum ungka'l aaththumaavin vaagnchaiyumaakiya en parisuththa sthalaththai naan parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuki'rean; neengka'l vittuvantha ungka'l kumaararum ungka'l kumaaraththika'lum pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l.
appozhuthu naan seythathupoala neengka'lum seyveerka'l; thaadiyai moodaamalum thukkangko'ndaaduki'ravarka'lin appaththaip pusiyaamalum iruppeerka'l.

ungka'l paakaika'l ungka'l thalaika'lilum, ungka'l paatharadchaika'l ungka'l kaalka'lilum irukkum; neengka'l pulampaamalum azhaamalum irunthu, ungka'l akkiramangka'lil vaadippoay, oruvaraiyoruvar paarththuth thavippeerka'l.

appadiyea eseakkiyeal ungka'lukku adaiyaa'lamaaka iruppaan; avan seythapadi ellaam neengka'lum seyveerka'l; ippadi varumpoathu naan karththaraakiya aa'ndavar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru sol en'ru uraiththaar en'rean.

pinnum manupuththiranea, naan entha naa'lilea avarka'ludaiya palaththaiyum, avarka'ludaiya alangkaaraththin makizhchchiyaiyum, avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lin viruppaththaiyum, avarka'ludaiya aaththumaavin viseashiththa vaagnchaiyaiyum, avarka'ludaiya kumaararaiyum, avarka'ludaiya kumaaraththika'laiyum avarka'laivittu eduththukko'l'luki'reanoa,
antha naa'lileathaanea thappivantha oruvan unnidaththil vanthu un kaathuka'l keadkach solluvaan allavoa?

antha naa'lileathaanea un vaay thi'rakkappattu, nee thappivanthavanoadea peasuvaay; ini mavunamaayirukkamaattaay; ippadi nee avarka'lukku adaiyaa'lamaaka iruppaay; naan karththar en'ru appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee ammoan puththirarukku ethiraaka un mukaththaiththiruppi, avarka'lukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu,

ammoan puththirarukkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar: en parisuththa sthalam parisuththakkulaichchalaakkappaduki'rapoathum, israveal theasam paazhaakkappaduki'rapoathum, yoothaa vamsaththaar si'raiyiruppilea poaki'rapoathum, nee avarka'lukku viroathamaaka aa aa, en'ru ninthiththapadiyinaal,

ithoa, naan unnaik kizhakkuth theasaththaarukkuch suthantharamaaka oppukkoduppean, avarka'l unnil thangka'l ara'nka'laik katti, unnil thangka'l vaasasthalangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nuvaarka'l; avarka'l un kanika'laip pusiththu, un paalaik kudippaarka'l.
naan rappaavai ottakangka'lin kottakaiyum, ammoan puththirarin theasaththai aattukkidaiyumaakkuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: israveal theasaththukku viroathamaaka nee kaikotti, un kaalaal thatti, varmam vaiththu, aakadiyam pa'n'ninapadiyinaal,

ithoa, unakku viroathamaaka naan en kaiyai neetti, unnai jaathika'lukkuk ko'l'laiyaaka oppukkoduththu, unnai janangka'lukku'l'lea vearat'ruppoakappa'n'ni, unnaith theasangka'lukku'l'lea azhiththu, unnai nirmoolamaakkuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaay.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, yoothaa vamsaththaar ellaa jaathika'lukkum oththavarka'len'ru moavaapum seayeerum solluki'rapadiyinaal,
ithoa, ammoan puththirarinpear jaathika'lukku'l iraathapadikku naan ammoan puththirarin theasaththaik kizhakkuth theasaththaarukkuth thi'ranthuvaiththu, suthantharamaay oppukkodukki'rava'n'namaaka,

naan moavaap theasaththin pakkaththilu'l'la athin kadaiyaanthara oorka'laakiya patta'nangka'l mutha'rko'ndu'l'la theasaththin alangkaaramaakiya pethyesimoaththaiyum, paakaalmeyoanaiyum, keeriyaaththaayeemaiyum avarka'lukkuth thi'ranthuvaiththu,
moavaapilea niyaayangka'laich seyvean, appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: eathoam yoothaa vamsaththaaridaththil kuroathantheerththu, pazhivaangki, periya kut'ragnseythapadiyinaal,

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: naan eathoam theasaththukku viroathamaaka en kaiyai neetti athil manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum iraathapadikkuch sangkaarampa'n'ni, athaith theamaan thuvakkith theathaanmattum vanaantharamaakkuvean; pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l.

naan isravealaakiya en janaththin kaiyinaal eathoaminidaththil pazhivaangkuvean; avarka'l en koapaththinpadiyum en ukkiraththinpadiyum eathoamukkuch seyvaarka'l; appozhuthu naan pazhivaangkuvathu innathen'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: pelisthiyar kuroathakkaararaayirunthu, pazhampakaiyaal keaduseyyavea'ndumen'ru, varmam vaiththup pazhivaangkinapadiyinaal,
ithoa, naan pelisthiyarukku viroathamaaka en kaiyai neetti, kireaththiyaraich sangkariththu, samuththirakkaraiyil meethiyaanavarka'lai azhiththu,
ukkiramaana tha'ndanaika'linaal avarka'lil kodithaayp pazhivaangkuvean; naan avarka'lil pazhivaangkumpoathu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pathinoaraam varusham muthalaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, theeruvaanathu erusaleamukku viroathamaaka, aa aa, janasatha'langka'lin olimukavaasalaayiruntha nakari idikkappattathen'rum ennidamaaka ellaam pura'nduvarum, athu paazhaakkappattirukka naan nirappappaduvean en'rum solluki'rapadiyinaal,

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: theeruvea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka varuki'rean; samuththiram than alaika'lai ezhumpivarappa'n'nuki'ra va'n'namaay naan aneakam jaathika'lai unakku viroathamaaka ezhumpi varappa'n'nuvean.
avarka'l theeruvin mathilka'lai azhiththu, athin koththa'langka'lai idiththuppoaduvaarka'l; naan athin ma'n'num athil iraathapadikku vi'lakkippoattu, athai ve'rum paa'raiyaakkividuvean.
athu valaika'lai virikki'ra idamaakach samuththiraththin naduvilea irukkum; naan ithaich sonnean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar; athu jaathika'lukkuk ko'l'laiyaakum.
ve'liyil irukki'ra athin kumaaraththika'loa pattayaththaal kon'rupoadappaduvaarka'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan raajaathiraajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ennum paapiloan raajaavai vadakkeayirunthu kuthiraika'loadum irathangka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum koottaththoadum thira'laana janaththoadum theeruvukku viroathamaaka varappa'n'nuvean.

avan ve'liyil irukki'ra un kumaaraththika'laip pattayaththinaal kon'ru, unakku viroathamaakak koththa'langka'laik katti, unakku viroathamaaka a'naipoattu, unakku viroathamaakak keadayangka'lai eduththu,
un mathilka'lai idikki'ra yanthirangka'lai ethirea vaiththu, than kattaippaaraika'laal un koththa'langka'lai idiththuppoaduvaan.

avan kuthiraika'lin earaa'laththinaal thoo'l ezhumpi unnai moodum; idiththuth thi'rappaakkappatta patta'naththil piraveasikkum va'n'namaaka, avan un vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasikkaiyil, kuthiraiveerarum va'ndilka'lum irathangka'lum iraiki'ra saththaththinaalea un mathilka'l athirum.
than kuthiraika'lin ku'lampuka'linaal un veethika'laiyellaam mithippaan; un janaththaip pattayaththinaal kon'rupoaduvaan; un palamaana thoo'nka'l tharaiyil vizhunthupoakum.

avarka'l un aasthiyaik ko'l'laiyittu, un sarakkuka'laich soo'raiyaadi, un mathilka'lai idiththu, unakku viruppamaana veeduka'lai azhiththu, un kalluka'laiyum un marangka'laiyum un ma'n'naiyum kadalin naduvilea poattuviduvaarka'l.
un paattuka'lin saththaththai oayappa'n'nuvean; un surama'ndalangka'lin saththam inik keadkappaduvathillai.
unnai ve'rum paa'raiyaakkividuvean; nee valaika'lai virikki'ra sthalamaayiruppaay; inik kattappadaay; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
theeruvukkuk karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: kaayampattavarka'l ala'rumpoathum, un naduvil sangkaaram nadakkumpoathum, nee vizhuki'ra saththaththinaal theevuka'l athiraathoa?

kadalarasar ellaarum thangka'l singkaasanangka'laivittu i'rangki; thangka'l saalvaika'laik kazhat'ri, thangka'l siththiraththaiyalaadaika'lai urinthupoaduvaarka'l; nadukkamea avarka'l udaiyaakum; tharaiyilea udkaarnthu, nimishanthoa'rum thaththa'liththu, unnimiththam piramippaarka'l.

avarka'l unnimiththam pulampi, unnaik ku'riththu: kadal sagnchaarika'l kudiyiruntha pukazhpet'ra nakariyea, aiyoa! unnil thangkinavarka'lukkellaam payamu'ndaakkina un kudika'loadungkoodach samuththiraththilea palaththiruntha nee azhinthupoanaayoa!
nee vizhum naa'lil theevuka'l thaththa'likkum; nee akan'rupoakumpoathu samuththiraththilu'l'la theevuka'l kalangkum enpaarka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan unnaik kudiyillaatha nakarangka'laippoalap paazhaana nakaramaakkumpoathum, mikuntha tha'n'neerka'l unnai moodaththakkathaay naan unmeal samuththiraththai varappa'n'numpoathum,

poorvakaalaththu janaththa'ndaikkuk kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'loadea naan unnai i'rangkappa'n'nuvean; nee kudiyea'raathirukkumpadi poorvakaalamutha'rko'ndu paazhaayirukki'ra poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lilea kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'loadeakooda naan unnaith thangkiyirukkappa'n'nuvean; jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththiloa makimai vi'langkach seyvean.
unnai makaa payangkaramaaka vaippean; ini nee irukkamaattaay; nee theadappattaalum ini en'raikkum kaa'nappadamaattaay en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranaakiya nee ippoathu theeruvinpearilea pulampi,

samuththirak karaithu'raiyilea kudiyirunthu, aneakam theevuka'lin janangka'loadea viyaapaarampa'n'nuki'ra theeruvai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, theeruvea, nee unnaip poora'nasaunthariyavathi enki'raay.
kadalka'lin nadumaiyaththilea un thaaparam irukki'rathu; unnaik kattinavarka'l unnaip poora'navadivaayk kattinaarka'l.
seaneerilirunthu vantha theavathaarumaraththaal un kappa'r palakaika'laich seythaarka'l; paaymarangka'laich seyyumpadikku leepanoanilirunthu keathurumarangka'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

paasaanin karvaalimarangka'linaalea un thuduppuka'laich seythaarka'l; kiththeem theevuka'lilirunthu vantha aashoor maraththaal un vaaripalakaika'laich seythu, athilea yaanaiththantham azhuththiyirunthaarka'l.
ekipthilirunthu vantha siththiraththaiyalu'l'la sa'nalnool pudavai nee viriththa paayaayirunthathu; eleesaa theevuka'lin i'laneelamum iraththaamparamum un vithaanamaayirunthathu.
seethoan arvaath ennum patta'nangka'lin kudika'l unakkuth tha'nduvalikki'ravarka'laayirunthaarka'l. theeruvea, unnidaththiliruntha un saasthirika'l un maalumika'laayirunthaarka'l.

keapaarin muthiyoarum athin saasthirika'lum unnil kampaththuppaarkki'ravarka'laayirunthaarka'l; samuththiraththin sakala kappalka'lum avaika'lilu'l'la kappa'rkaararum unnoadea thozhilthu'rai viyaapaaram pa'n'nuki'ratha'rkaaka unnidaththil irunthaarka'l.
persiyarum, loothiyarum, pooththiyarum un iraa'nuvaththil yuththaveeraraayirunthu unakku'l keadakamum thalaichseeraavum thookkivaiththu, unnai alangkariththaarka'l.

arvaath puththirarum un iraa'nuva manusharum un mathilka'lmeal sut'rilum, kammaaththiyar un koththa'langka'lilum irunthaarka'l; ivarka'l un mathilka'lmeal sut'rilum thangka'l parisaika'laith thookkivaiththu, un vadivaththaip poora'nappaduththinaarka'l.
sakalavitha poru'lka'lin thira'linaalum tharshees ooraar unnoadea viyaapaaram pa'n'ninaarka'l; ve'l'liyaiyum irumpaiyum thakaraththaiyum eeyaththaiyum un santhaika'lil vi'rkavanthaarka'l.
yaavaan, thoopaal, measeak ennum jaathiyaar un viyaapaarika'laayirunthu, manusharka'laiyum ve'nkalappaaththirangka'laiyum un thozhilthu'raikkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
thokarmaa vamsaththaar kuthiraika'laiyum kuthiraiveeraraiyum koavea'ru kazhuthaika'laiyum un santhaika'lukkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

theathaan puththirar un viyaapaarika'laayirunthaarka'l; aneakam theevuka'lin varththakam un vasamaakach searnthathu; yaanaiththanthangka'laiyum karungkaali marangka'laiyum avaika'lukkup pathilaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

seeriyar un vealaippaadaana pa'rpala poru'lka'linimiththam unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ni, marakathangka'laiyum, iraththaamparangka'laiyum, siththiraththaiyalaadaika'laiyum, uyarntha vasthirangka'laiyum, pava'langka'laiyum, pa'lingkaiyum un santhaika'lil vi'rkavanthaarka'l.

yootharum israveal theasaththaarum unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ni, minneeth, pannaak enki'ra oorka'lin koathumaiyaiyum, theanaiyum, e'n'neyaiyum, pisinthailaththaiyum un thozhilthu'raikkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

thamasku un vealaippaadaana pa'rpala poru'lka'linimiththamum, sakalavithap poru'lka'lin thiradchiyinimiththamum unnoadea varththakampa'n'ni, kelpoanin thiraadcharasaththaiyum ve'nmaiyaana aattumayiraiyum unakku vit'raarka'l.
thaa'n naattaarum, poakkum varaththumaana yaavaanarum thulakkappatta irumpaiyum ilavangkaththaiyum vasampaiyum un santhaika'lil ko'nduvanthu un thozhilthu'raiyil vit'raarka'l.
irathangka'lukkup poaduki'ra meanmaiyaana iraththinakkampa'langka'laith theathaanin manushar ko'nduvanthu, unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.

arapiyarum, keathaarin sakala pirapukka'lum unakku vaadikkaiyaana varththakaraaki, aattukkuttika'laiyum aattukkadaakka'laiyum ve'l'laattukkadaakka'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.

seapaa, raamaa patta'nangka'lin viyaapaarika'l unnoadea varththakampa'n'ni, mealtharamaana sakalavitha sampaarangka'laiyum, sakalavitha iraththinakka'rka'laiyum, ponnaiyum un santhaika'lil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
aaraan, kannea, eathean ennum patta'naththaarum, seapaavin viyaapaarika'lum, aseeriyarum, kilmaath patta'naththaarum unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.

ivarka'l sakalavitha uyarntha sarakkuka'laiyum, i'laneelap pattuka'lum visiththiraththaiyalaadaika'lum adangkiya pudavaikkattuka'laiyum, vilai uyarntha vasthirangka'l vaikkappattu, kayi'ruka'laal kattiyirukkum keathurumarappettika'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, unnoadea viyaapaarampa'n'ninaarka'l.
un thozhilthu'raiyil tharsheesin kappalaadka'l unnaip poat'rip paadinaarka'l; nee samuththiraththin naduvilea unnaip poora'nappaduththi, unnai mikavum makimaippaduththinaay.
tha'nduvalikki'ravarka'l aazhamaana tha'n'neerka'lil unnai valiththukko'ndupoanaarka'l; naduchsamuththiraththilea ko'nda'rkaat'ru unnai udaiththuppoattathu.

nee naasamadaiyum naa'lilea un aasthiyoadum, un santhaika'loadum, un thozhilthu'raiyoadungkooda un kappalaadka'lum, un maalumika'lum, unnil kampaththuppaarkki'ravarka'lum, un viyaapaarika'lum, unnilu'l'la ellaa yuththaveerarum, un naduvil irukki'ra ellaak koottaththaarum naduchsamuththiraththilea vizhuvaarka'l.
un maalumika'l oalamidum saththaththinaal sut'ruppu'rangka'l athirum.
tha'nduvalikki'ra yaavarum, kappalaadka'lum, kadal maalumika'l anaivarum, thangka'l kappalka'lai vittui'rangki, karaiyilea nin'ru,
unnimiththam saththamittuppulampi, manangkasanthu azhuthu, thangka'l thalaika'linmeal puzhuthiyaip poattukko'ndu, saampalil pura'ndu,
unakkaaka mottaiyittu irattuduththikko'ndu, unakkaaka manangkasanthu azhuthu, thukkangko'ndaaduvaarka'l.
avarka'l unakkaakath thangka'l thukkaththilea oalamittu, unnimiththam pulampi, unnaikku'riththu: samuththiraththin naduvilea azhinthupoana theeruvukkuch samaana nakaram u'ndoa?

un santhaichsarakkuka'l samuththirangka'l vazhiyaayk ko'nduvarappadukaiyil, aneaka janangka'laith thirupthiyaakkinaay; un aasthiyin thira'linaalum un viyaapaaraththinaalum poomiyin raajaakka'lai aisuvariyavaanka'laakkinaay.
nee samuththirath thiraika'linaalea aazhangka'lil udaikkappattapoathu, un thozhil thu'raiyum un naduvilu'l'la koottam anaiththum azhinthupoayina enpaarka'l.
theevuka'lin kudika'l ellaam unnimiththam thikaippaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'l mikavum piramiththu, kalangkina mukamaayiruppaarka'l.
sakala janangka'lilumu'l'la varththakar unpearil eesalpoaduvaarka'l; nee payangkaramaavaay; ini orupoathum irukkamaattaay enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee theeruvin athipathiyai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, un iruthayam meattimaiko'ndu: naan theavan, naan samuththiraththin naduvea theavaasanaththil veet'rirukki'rean en'ru nee solli, un iruthayaththaith theavanin iruthayaththaippoal aakkinaalum, nee manushaneayallaamal theavanalla.
ithoa, thaaniyealaippaarkkilum nee gnaanavaan; irakasiyamaanathon'rum unakku ma'raiporu'l alla.
nee un gnaanaththinaalum un puththiyinaalum poru'l sampaathiththu, ponnaiyum ve'l'liyaiyum un pokkishasaalaika'lil searththukko'ndaay.
un viyaapaaraththinaalum un makaa gnaanaththinaalum un poru'laip perukappa'n'ninaay; un iruthayam un selvaththinaal meattimaiyaayit'ru.
aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee un iruthayaththaith theavanin iruthayaththaippoala aakkuki'rapadiyinaal,

ithoa, jaathika'lil makaa palavaanka'laakiya ma'rutheasaththaarai unakku viroathamaay varappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l un gnaanaththin azhakukku viroathamaayth thangka'l pattayangka'lai uruvi, un minukkaik kulaiththuppoaduvaarka'l.
unnaik kuzhiyilea vizhaththa'l'luvaarka'l; nee samuththirangka'lin naduvea kolaiyu'ndu saaki'ravarka'laippoal saavaay.
unnaik kolluki'ravanukku munpaaka: naan theavanen'ru nee solvaayoa? unnaik kuththippoaduki'ravan kaikku nee manushaneayallaamal theavanallavea.
ma'rutheasaththaarin kaiyinaal nee viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'l saavathupoal saavaay; naan ithaich sonnean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee theeru raajaavaikku'riththup pulampi, avanai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, nee visiththiramaaych seyyappatta muththiraimoathiram; nee gnaanaththaal ni'rainthavan; poora'na azhaku'l'lavan.

nee theavanudaiya thoattamaakiya eatheanil irunthavan; pathmaraakam, pushparaakam, vairam, padikappachchai, koameathakam, yaspi, inthiraneelam, marakatham, maa'nikkam muthalaana sakalavitha iraththinangka'lum ponnum unnai moodikko'ndirukki'rathu; nee sirushdikkappatta naa'lil un mea'lavaaththiyangka'lum un naakasurangka'lum unnidaththil aayaththappattirunthathu.
nee kaappaat'ruki'ratha'rkaaka apisheakampa'n'nappatta kearup; theavanudaiya parisuththa parvathaththil unnai vaiththean; akkinimayamaana ka'rka'lin naduvea ulaavinaay.
nee sirushdikkappatta naa'lthuvakki unnil aniyaayam ka'ndupidikkappattathumattum, un vazhika'lil ku'raiyat'rirunthaay.

un viyaapaaraththin mikuthiyinaal, un kodumai athikariththu nee paavagnseythaay; aakaiyaal naan unnaith theavanudaiya parvathaththilirunthu aakaathavanen'ru tha'l'li, kaappaat'ruki'ra kearupaay iruntha unnai akkinimayamaana ka'rka'lin naduvea iraathapadikku azhiththuppoaduvean.

un azhakinaal un iruthayam meattimaiyaayit'ru; un minukkinaal un gnaanaththaik keduththaay; unnaith tharaiyilea tha'l'lippoaduvean; raajaakka'l unnaip paarkkumpadi unnai avarka'lukku munpaaka veadikkaiyaakkuvean.

un akkiramangka'lin earaa'laththinaalum, un viyaapaaraththin aneethaththinaalum un parisuththa sthalangka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinaay; aakaiyaal unnaip padchippathaakiya oru akkiniyai naan un naduvilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, unnaippaarkki'ra ellaarudaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaakavum unnaip poomiyinmeal saampalaakkuvean.
janangka'lil unnai a'rintha anaivarum unnimiththam thikaippaarka'l; makaa payangkaramaavaay; ini orupoathum irukkamaattaay en'ru uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee un mukaththaich seethoanukku ethiraakath thiruppi, atha'rku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

karththaraakiya theavan solluki'raar: seethoanea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, un naduvilea makimaippaduvean; naan athilea niyaayaththeerppuka'laich seythu, athilea parisuththaren'ru vi'langkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

naan athilea ko'l'lainoayaiyum, athin veethika'lil iraththaththaiyum varappa'n'nuvean; atha'rku viroathamaaych sut'rilum vantha pattayaththinaal kaayampattavarka'l athin naduvilea vettu'ndu vizhuvaarka'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

israveal vamsaththaarai ikazhntha avarka'ludaiya sut'ruppu'raththaaraakiya anaivarilum, inith thaikki'ra mu'l'lum noavu'ndaakkuki'ra nerignchilum avarka'lukku iraathu; appozhuthu naan karththaraakiya aa'ndavaren'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan israveal vamsaththaarai, avarka'l sitha'radikkappattirukki'ra janangka'lidaththilirunthu searththukko'nduvanthu, avarka'laal jaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaakap parisuththaren'ru vi'langkumpoathu, avarka'l en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapukku naan koduththa thangka'ludaiya theasaththilea kudiyiruppaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya sut'ruppu'raththaaril avarka'lai ikazhntha anaivarilum naan niyaayaththeerppuka'laich seyyumpoathu, avarka'l athilea sukamaayk kudiyirunthu, veeduka'laik katti, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naatti, sukamaay vaazhnthu, naan thangka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
paththaam varusham paththaam maatham pannira'ndaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanukku ethiraaka un mukaththaith thiruppi, avanukkum ekipthu muzhuthukkum viroathamaayth theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanea, nee un nathika'lin naduvilea paduththukko'ndu: en nathi ennudaiyathu, naan athai enakkaaka u'ndupa'n'ninean en'ru solluki'ra periya muthalaiyea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaay vanthu,

un vaayilea thu'raduka'lai maatti, un nathika'lin machchangka'lai un sethi'lka'lil ottikko'l'lumpadi seythu, unnai un nathika'lin naduvilirunthu thookkividuvean; un nathika'lin machchangka'lellaam un sethilka'lil ottikko'ndirukkum.

unnaiyum un nathika'lin ellaa machchangka'laiyum vanaantharaththilea poattuviduvean; vettave'liyilea vizhuvaay; nee searththukko'l'lappaduvathillai; unnaip poomiyin mirukangka'lukkum aakaayaththin pa'ravaika'lukkum iraiyaakak koduppean.
appozhuthu ekipthutheasaththin kudika'lellaarum naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l israveal vamsaththaarukku naa'na'rkoalaayirunthaarka'lea.
avarka'l unnaik kaiyilea pidikkumpoathu, nee odinthupoay, avarka'l vilaavaiyellaam pi'lappaay; avarka'l unmeal saayumpoathu, nee mu'rinthu, avarka'l iduppu muzhuvathaiyum maraththuppoakappa'n'nuvaay.
aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan unmeal pattayaththai varappa'n'ni, unnil manusharaiyum mirukangka'laiyum sangkaarampa'n'nuvean.
ekipthu theasam paazhum vanaantharamumaakum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l: nathi ennudaiyathu, naan athai u'ndaakkinean en'ru sonnaanea.

aakaiyaal, ithoa, naan unakkum un nathika'lukkum viroathamaaka vanthu, mikthoalmuthal eththiyoappiyaavin ellaiyilu'l'la seveneavaraikkum ekipthutheasaththai avaantharamum paazhumaana vanaantharangka'laakkuvean.
manushanudaiya kaal athaik kadappathumillai, mirukajeevanudaiya kaal athai mithippathumillai; athu naa'rpathu varusham kudiyat'rirukkum.

ekipthutheasaththaip paazhaayppoana theasangka'lin naduvilea paazhaayppoakappa'n'nuvean; athin patta'nangka'l avaantharamaakkappatta patta'nangka'lin naduvilea naa'rpathu varusham paazhaayk kidakkum; naan ekipthiyarai jaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu, avarka'laith theasangka'lukku'l'lea thoot'rividuvean.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naa'rpathuvarusham mudiyumpoathu, naan ekipthiyarai avarka'l sitha'ru'ndirukki'ra janangka'lidaththilirunthu searththukko'ndu,
ekipthiyarin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, avarka'lai avarka'ludaiya jananatheasamaakiya pathroas theasaththilea thirumpivarappa'n'nuvean; angkea avarka'l a'rpa raajyamaayiruppaarka'l.
athu ini jaathika'linmeal thannai uyarththaamal, mat'ra raajyangka'lilum a'rpamaanathaayirukkum; avarka'l ini jaathika'lai aa'laathapadikku avarka'laik ku'rukippoakappa'n'nuvean.

avarka'lin pi'rakea poay, avarka'lai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathinaal israveal vamsaththaar enakkuth thangka'l akkiramaththai ninaippoottaathapadikku, ini avarka'l ivarka'ludaiya nampikkaiyaayiraama'rpoavaarka'l; appozhuthu naan karththaraakiya aa'ndavar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
irupaththeazhaam varusham muthalaam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar theeruvin munnea than seanaiyinidaththil kadum oozhiyam vaangkinaan; ovvoru thalaiyum mottaiyaayit'ru; ovvoru thoa'lpattaiyin thoalum urinthupoayit'ru; aanaalum avan theeruvukku viroathamaakach seytha oozhiyaththinaalea avanukkaavathu avan seanaikkaavathu kooli kidaikkavillai.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarukku ekipthutheasaththaik kodukki'rean; avan athin earaa'lamaana janaththaich si'raipidiththu athin aasthiyaich soo'raiyaadi, athin ko'l'laipporu'lai eduththukko'lvaan; ithu avanudaiya seanaikkuk kooliyaayirukkum.
avan athilea seytha vealaikku ekipthutheasaththai naan avanukkuk kooliyaakak koduththean; enakkaaka athaich seythaarka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

annaa'lilea naan israveal vamsaththaarin kompai mu'laikkappa'n'ni, avarka'l naduvilea thaaraa'lamaayp peasum vaayai unakkuk katta'laiyiduvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam sollu: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, aiyoa! aapaththunaa'l varuki'rathen'ru ala'rungka'l.
naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu; aam, karththarudaiya naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu; athu manthaaramaana naa'l, athu pu'rajaathika'lukku varum kaalam.

pattayam ekipthilea varum; ekipthilea kolaiyu'nki'ravarka'l vizhumpoathu eththiyoappiyaavilea makaa veathanai u'ndaayirukkum; athin earaa'lamaana janaththaip pidiththukko'ndupoavaarka'l; athin asthipaarangka'l nirmoolamaakkappadum.
eththiyoappiyarum, pooththiyarum, looththiyarum, kalantha koottamaakiya anaivarum, koopiyarum, udanpadikkaikku'l'laana theasaththin puththirarum avarka'loadeakoodap pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l.

ekipthai aatharikki'ravarka'lum vizhuvaarka'l; athinudaiya palaththin mukkiyamum thaazhnthupoam en'ru karththar solluki'raar; athilea mikthoalmuthal seveneavaraikkum pattayaththinaal vizhuvaarka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
paazhaayppoana theasangka'lin naduvilea paazhaayppoavaarka'l; avaantharamaakkappatta patta'nangka'lil avarka'l patta'nangka'lum avaantharamaakum.
naan ekipthilea theekko'luththumpoathum, unakkuth thu'nainin'ra yaavarum mu'rikkappadumpoathum, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

nirvisaaramaana eththiyoappiyaraith thaththa'likkappa'n'na annaa'lilea en katta'laiyinaal thoothaadka'l kappalka'lilea poavaarka'l; appozhuthu ekipthin naa'lilea u'ndaanathupoala avarka'lukku'l'lea makaa veathanai u'ndaayirukkum; ithoa, athu varuki'rathu.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: paapiloan raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaaraikko'ndu ekipthin santhathiyai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean.

ivanum ivanoadeakooda jaathika'lil makaa palasaalika'laana ivanudaiya janangka'lum theasaththai azhippatha'rkaaka eavappattu vanthu, thangka'l pattayangka'lai ekipthukku viroathamaaka uruvi, kolaiyu'ndavarka'laalea theasaththai nirappuvaarka'l.

appozhuthu naan nathika'lai vat'rippoakappa'n'ni, theasaththaith thushdarka'lin kaiyilea vit'ru, theasaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavaiyum anniyatheasaththaarin kaiyaal paazhaakkippoaduvean; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan narakalaana vikkirakangka'lai azhiththu, noappin silaika'lai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; ini ekipthutheasaththil oru athipathiyum iraan; naan ekipthutheasaththil payamu'ndaakki,
pathroasaip paazhaakki, soavaanilea theekko'luththi, noa patta'naththil aakkinaika'laich seythu,
ekipthin pelanaakiya seeninmeal en ukkiraththai oot'ri, noa patta'naththin earaa'lamaana janaththaich sangkarippean.
ekipthil theekko'luththuvean; seen makaa veathanai adaiyum; noa patta'nam thakarnthu idinthupoakum; noappukkuth thinanthoa'rum nerukkangka'lu'ndaakum.
aaven, pipeaseth enki'ra patta'nangka'lin vealaikkaarar pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; avaika'lin kudika'l si'raiyiruppukkup poavaarka'l.

ekipthin nukangka'lai naan mu'rikkumpoathum, athinudaiya pelaththin mukkiyam athilea oayumpoathum, manthaaram athai moodum; thakpaaneasilea pakal iru'ndupoakum; athin kumaaraththika'l si'raippattuppoavaarka'l.
ippadi ekipthilea niyaayaththeerppuka'laich seyvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pathinoaraam varusham muthalaam maatham eazhaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanudaiya puyaththai mu'riththuppoaduvean; ithoa, athu ku'namaakaththakkathaakak kattappaduvathillai; athu pattayaththaip pidikkaththakka pelanai adaiyumpadi paththai vaiththuk kattappaduvathumillai.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanukku viroathamaaka vanthu, pelanu'l'lathum mu'rinthathumaakiya avanudaiya puyangka'lai mu'riththuppoaduvean; pattayaththai naan avan kaiyilirunthu vizhappa'n'ni,
ekipthiyarai jaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu, avarka'laith theasangka'lil thoot'rividuvean.

paapiloan raajaavin puyangka'laip pelappaduththi, avan kaiyilea en pattayaththaik koduththu, paarvoanin puyangka'lai mu'riththuviduvean; appozhuthu avan kolaiyu'nki'ravan thavikki'rathupoala avanukku munpaakath thavippaan.

paapiloan raajaavin puyangka'laip pelappaduththuvean; paarvoanin puyangka'loa vizhunthupoam; en pattayaththai naan paapiloan raajaavin kaiyil kodukkumpoathum, avan athai ekipthutheasaththinmeal neettumpoathum, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
naan ekipthiyarai jaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu, avarka'laith theasangka'lil thoot'rippoaduvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
pathinoaraam varusham moon'raam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanoadum avanudaiya thira'laana janaththoadum nee sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: nee un makaththuvaththilea yaarukku oppaayirukki'raay?

ithoa, aseeriyan leepanoanilea alangkaarak koppuka'loadum, nizhalidum thazhaika'loadum, va'larnthoangkiya keathuru virudchamaayirunthaan; athin ki'laika'lin thazhaika'lukku'l'lea athin nunikkozhunthu uyarnthirunthathu.
tha'n'neerka'l athaip perithum, aazham athai uyarththiyum aakkina; athin aa'ruka'l athin adimaraththaich sut'rilum oadina; than neerkkaalka'lai ve'liyin virudchangka'lukkellaam paayavittathu.
aakaiyaal ve'liyin sakala virudchangka'lilum athu mikavum uyarnthathu; athu thu'lirvidukaiyil thira'laana tha'n'neerinaal athin ki'laika'l peruki, athin koppuka'l nee'lamaayina.

athin koppuka'lil aakaayaththin pa'ravaika'lellaam koodukattina; athin koppuka'linkeezh ve'liyin mirukangka'lellaam kuttika'laippoattana; perithaana sakala jaathika'lum athin nizhalilea kudiyirunthaarka'l.
appadiyea athin vear thira'laana tha'n'neerka'larukea irunthathinaal athu than sezhippinaalum than koppuka'lin nee'laththinaalum alangkaaramaayirunthathu.

theavanudaiya vanaththilu'l'la keathurukka'l athai ma'raikkakkoodaathirunthathu; theavathaaru virudchangka'l athin koppuka'lukkuch samaanamalla; armoan marangka'l athin ki'laika'lukku nikaralla; theavanudaiya vanaththilu'l'la oru virudchamum alangkaaraththilea atha'rku oppalla.
athin ki'laika'lin thira'linaal athai alangkariththean; theavanudaiya vanamaakiya eatheanin virudchangka'lellaam athinpearil po'raamaiko'ndana.

aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: athu than va'larththiyilea meattimaiyaaki, koppuka'lin thazhaika'lukku'l'lea than nunikki'laiyai oangkavittapadiyinaalum, athin iruthayam than meattimaiyinaal uyarnthupoanapadiyinaalum,
naan athai jaathika'lil makaa vallamaiyu'l'lavan kaiyilea oppukkoduththean; avan thanakku ishdamaanapadi atha'rkuch seyvaan; athinudaiya akkiramaththinimiththam athaith tha'l'lippoattean.

jaathika'lil vallavaraakiya anniyatheasaththaar athai vettippoattu, vittuppoanaarka'l; athin koppuka'l malaika'linmealum sakala pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum vizhunthana; athin ki'laika'l theasaththinudaiya ellaa aa'ruka'linarukea mu'rinthana; poomiyilu'l'la janangka'lellaarum athin nizhalaivittuk kalainthupoanaarka'l.
vizhunthukidakki'ra athinmeal aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lellaam thaapariththana; athin kompuka'linmeal ve'liyin mirukangka'lellaam thangkina.

tha'n'neerin oaramaay va'laruki'ra entha virudchangka'lum thangka'l uyarththiyinaalea meattimaiko'l'laamalum, thangka'l koppuka'lin thazhaikku'l'lea thangka'l nunikki'laiyai oangkavidaamalum, tha'n'neeraik kudikki'ra entha marangka'lum thangka'l uyarththiyinaalea thangka'lmeal nampikkaivaikkaamalum irukkumporuttu ippadich seyvean; manupuththirarin naduvea avarka'l ellaarum kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'loadeakooda mara'naththukku oppukkodukkappattu, poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil poanaarka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: avan paathaa'laththil i'rangkuki'ra naa'lilea pulampalai varuviththean; naan avanimiththam aazhaththai moodippoattu, thira'laana tha'n'neerka'l oadaathapadikku athin aa'ruka'lai adaiththu, avanimiththam leepanoanai iru'ladaiyappa'n'ninean; ve'liyin virudchangka'lellaam avanimiththam pattuppoayina.

naan avanaik kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'loadeakoodap paathaa'laththil i'rangkappa'n'nukaiyil, avan vizhuki'ra saththaththinaal jaathika'lai athirappa'n'ninean; appozhuthu poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil eatheanin virudchangka'lum, leepanoanin meanmaiyaana si'rantha virudchangka'lum, tha'n'neer kudikkum sakala marangka'lum aa'ruthal adainthana.
avanoadeakooda ivarka'lum, jaathika'lin naduvea avan nizhalil kudiyirunthu avanukkup puyapalamaayirunthavarka'lum, pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'la'ndaiyilea paathaa'laththil i'rangkinaarka'l.

ippadippatta makimaiyilum makaththuvaththilum eatheanin virudchangka'lil nee etha'rku oppaanavan? eatheanin virudchangka'loadeakooda neeyum poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil i'rakkappattu, pattayaththaalea vettu'ndavarka'loadeakooda viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lin naduvilea kidappaay; paarvoanum avan koottamum ithuvea en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pannira'ndaam varusham pannira'ndaam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoanaikku'riththup pulampi, avanoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: jaathika'lukku'l'lea nee paalasingkaththukku oppaanavan; nee peruntha'n'neerka'lil muthalaiyaippoal irunthu, un nathika'lil ezhumpi, un kaalka'laal tha'n'neerka'laik kalakki, avaika'lin aa'ruka'laik kuzhappivittaay.
aakaiyaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: naan veku janakkoottaththaikko'ndu unmeal en valaiyai veesuvean; avarka'l en valaiyil unnai izhuththukko'lvaarka'l.
unnaith tharaiyilea poattuviduvean; naan unnai vettave'liyil e'rinthuvittu, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyellaam unmeal i'rangkappa'n'ni, poomiyanaiththin mirukangka'laiyum unnaal thirupthiyaakki,
un sathaiyaip parvathangka'linmeal poattu, un udalinaalea pa'l'laththaakkuka'lai nirappi,
nee neenthina theasaththinmeal un iraththaththaip parvathangka'lmattum paayachseyvean; aa'ruka'l unnaalea nirampum.
unnai naan a'naiththuppoadukaiyil, vaanaththai moodi, athin nadchaththirangka'lai iru'ndupoakappa'n'nuvean; sooriyanai meakaththinaal mooduvean, santhiranum than o'liyaikkodaathirukkum.
naan vaanajoathiyaana vi'lakkuka'laiyellaam unmeal iru'ndupoakappa'n'ni, un theasaththinmeal anthakaaraththai varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
un sangkaaraththai jaathika'lmattum, nee a'riyaatha theasangka'lmattum naan ettappa'n'nukaiyil, aneakam janangka'lin iruthayaththai visanamadaiyappa'n'nuvean.

aneakam janangka'lai unnimiththam thikaikkappa'n'nuvean; avarka'lin raajaakka'l, thangka'l mukangka'lukku munpaaka en pattayaththai naan veesukaiyil mikavum thidukkiduvaarka'l; nee vizhum naa'lil avaravar thamtham piraa'nanukkaaka nimishanthoa'rum thaththa'lippaarka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: paapiloan raajaavin pattayam unmeal varum.

paraakkiramasaalika'lin pattayangka'laal un janaththira'lai vizhappa'n'nuvean; avarka'lellaarum jaathika'lil vallamaiyaanavarka'l; avarka'l ekipthin aadamparaththaik keduppaarka'l; athin earaa'lamaana koottam azhikkappadum.

thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lin karaika'lil nadamaaduki'ra athin mirukajeevanka'laiyellaam azhippean; ini manushanudaiya kaal avaika'laik kalakkuvathumillai, mirukangka'ludaiya ku'lampuka'l avaika'laik kuzhappuvathumillai.
appozhuthu avarka'ludaiya tha'n'neerka'laith the'liyappa'n'ni, avarka'l aa'ruka'lai e'n'neyaippoal oadappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

naan ekipthutheasaththaip paazhaakkumpoathum, theasam than ni'raivai izhanthu ve'rumaiyaayk kidakkumpoathum, naan athil kudiyirukki'ra yaavaraiyum sangkarikkumpoathum, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

ithu pulampal; ippadip pulampuvaarka'l; ippadi jaathika'lin kumaaraththika'l pulampuvaarka'l; ippadi ekipthukkaakavum, athinudaiya ellaath thira'laana janangka'lukkaakavum pulampuvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum pannira'ndaam varusham antha maathaththin pathinainthaantheathiyilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee ekipthinudaiya earaa'lamaana janaththinimiththam pulampi, avarka'laiyum pirapalamaana jaathika'lin kumaaraththika'laiyum kuzhiyil i'rangkinavarka'l a'ndaiyilea poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil tha'l'lividu.
mat'ravarka'laippaarkkilum nee azhakil si'ranthava'loa? nee i'rangki, viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lidaththil kida.
avarka'l pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'lin naduvilea vizhuvaarka'l, pattayaththukku oppukkodukkappattirukki'raarka'l; ava'laiyum ava'ludaiya janaththira'l yaavaiyum pidiththizhungka'l.

paraakkiramasaalika'lil vallavarka'lum, avanukkuth thu'nainin'ravarka'lum, paathaa'laththin naduvilirunthu avanoadea peasuvaarka'l; avarka'l viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'laayp pattayaththaal vettu'ndu, i'rangki, angkea kidakki'raarka'l.

angkea asoorum avanudaiya ellaak koottaththaarum kidakki'raarka'l; avanaich sut'rilum avarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'l irukki'rathu; avarka'l ellaarum pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhunthavarka'lthaanea.

paathaa'laththin pakkangka'lil avarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'l irukki'rathu; avanudaiya pireathakkuzhiyaich sut'rilum avanudaiya koottam kidakki'rathu, jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea kediyu'ndaakkina avarka'lellaarum pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhunthavarka'lthaanea.

angkea ealaamum avanudaiya pireathakkuzhiyaich sut'rilum avanudaiya ellaa earaa'lamaana janamum kidakki'raarka'l; avarka'lellaarum pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhunthu, viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'laayp poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil i'rangkinaarka'l; jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea kediyu'ndaakkina avarka'l, kuzhiyil i'rangkinavarka'loadeakoodath thangka'l avamaanaththaich sumakki'raarka'l.
