vettu'ndavarka'lin naduvea avanai avanudaiya ellaa earaa'lamaana janaththukku'l'lum kidaththinaarka'l; avanaich sut'rilum avarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'l irukki'rathu; avarka'lellaarum pattayaththaal vettu'nda viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'l; jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea avarka'l kediyu'ndaakkinavarka'laayirunthum, avarka'l kuzhiyil i'rangkinavarka'loadeakoodath thangka'l avamaanaththaich sumakki'raarka'l; avan vettu'ndavarka'lin naduvea vaikkappattirukki'raan.

angkea measeakkum thoopaalum avarka'ludaiya earaa'lamaana janangka'lum kidakki'raarka'l; avarka'laichsut'rilum avarka'ludaiya pireathakkuzhika'l irukki'rathu; avanudaiya jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea kediyu'ndaakkinavarka'laayirunthum, avarka'lellaarum viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'l; pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhuvaarka'l.

jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea paraakkiramasaalika'lukkuk kediyu'ndaakkuki'ravarka'laayirunthum, avarka'l viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'laay vizhunthu, thangka'l yuththa aayuthangka'loadu paathaa'laththili'rangkina paraakkiramasaalika'loadea ivarka'l kidappathillai; avarka'l thangka'l pattayangka'laith thangka'l thalaika'linkeezh vaiththaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'ludaiya akkiramam thangka'l elumpuka'linmeal irukkum.
neeyum viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lin naduvea no'rungku'ndu, pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'loadea kidappaay.

angkea eathoamum athin raajaakka'lum athin ellaap pirapukka'lum kidakki'raarka'l; pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'lidaththil ivarka'l thangka'l vallamaiyoadungkoodak kidaththappattaarka'l; ivarka'l viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lidaththilum, kuzhiyil i'rangkuki'ravarka'lidaththilum kidakki'raarka'l.

angkea vadathisai athipathika'l anaivarum ellaach seethoaniyarum kidakki'raarka'l; ivarka'l kediyu'ndaakkuki'ravarka'laayirunthaalum thangka'l paraakkiramaththaik ku'riththu vedkappattu, vettu'ndavarka'lidaththil i'rangki, pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'loadea viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'laayk kidanthu, kuzhiyil i'rangkinavarka'lidaththil thangka'l avamaanaththaich sumanthuko'ndirukki'raarka'l.

paarvoan avarka'laip paarththu than earaa'lamaana janaththinpearilum aa'ruthaladaivaan; pattayaththaal vettu'ndaarka'len'ru, paarvoanum avanudaiya sarva seanaiyum aa'ruthaladaivaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

ennaippat'riya kediyai jeevanu'l'loar theasaththil u'ndupa'n'nuki'rean, paarvoanum avanudaiya earaa'lamaana janamum pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'lidaththil viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lin naduvea kidaththappaduvaarka'l enki'rathaik karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee un janaththin puththiraroadea peasi, avarka'loadea sollavea'ndiyathaavathu: naan theasaththinmeal pattayaththai varappa'n'nukaiyil theasaththin janam thangka'l ellaika'lilu'l'la oruvanai azhaiththu, avanaith thangka'lukkuk kaava'rkaaranaaka vaiththapinpu,
ivan theasaththinmeal pattayam varuvathaikka'ndu, ekkaa'lam oothi, janaththai echcharikkumpoathu,
ekkaa'laththin saththaththaik keadki'ravan athaik keattum, echcharikkaiyaayiraamal, pattayam vanthu avanai vaarikko'l'luki'rathu u'ndaanaal, avanudaiya iraththappazhi avan thalaiyinmeal sumarum.
avan ekkaa'laththin saththaththaik keattum, echcharikkaiyaayirukkavillai; avanudaiya iraththappazhi avan pearilea sumarum; echcharikkaiyaayirukki'ravanoa than jeevanaith thappuviththukko'l'luvaan.

kaava'rkaaran pattayam varuvathaik ka'ndum, avan ekkaa'lam oothaamalum janangka'l echcharikkappadaamalum, pattayam vanthu avarka'lil yaathoruvanai vaarikko'l'luki'rathu u'ndaanaal, avan than akkiramaththilea vaarikko'l'lappattaan; aanaalum avan iraththappazhiyaik kaava'rkaaran kaiyilea keadpean.
manupuththiranea, naan unnai israveal vamsaththaarukkuk kaava'rkaaranaaka vaiththean; aakaiyaal nee en vaayinaalea vaarththaiyaikkeattu, en naamaththinaalea avarka'lai echcharippaayaaka.

naan thunmaarkkanai noakki: thunmaarkkanea, nee saakavea saavaay en'ru sollukaiyil, nee thunmaarkkanaith than thunmaarkkaththil iraathapadi echcharikkaththakkathaaka athai avanukkuch sollaama'rpoanaal, anthath thunmaarkkan than akkiramaththilea saavaan; aanaalum avan iraththappazhiyai un kaiyilea keadpean.
thunmaarkkan than vazhiyaivittuth thirumpumpadi nee avanai echchariththum, avan than vazhiyaivittuth thirumpaama'rpoanaal, avan than akkiramaththilea saavaan; neeyoa un aaththumaavaith thappuvippaay.

manupuththiranea, nee israveal vamsaththaarai noakki: engka'l thuroakangka'lum engka'l paavangka'lum engka'lmeal irukki'rathu, naangka'l soarnthupoaki'roam, naangka'l pizhaippathu eppadiyen'ru neengka'l solluki'reerka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan thunmaarkkanudaiya mara'naththai virumpaamal, thunmaarkkan than vazhiyaivittuth thirumpip pizhaippathaiyea virumpuki'rean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; israveal vamsaththaarea, ungka'l pollaatha vazhika'laivittuth thirumpungka'l, thirumpungka'l; neengka'l ean saakavea'ndum enki'raar en'ru avarka'loadea sollu.

manupuththiranea, nee un janaththin puththirarai noakki: neethimaan thuroakampa'n'nuki'ra naa'lilea avanudaiya neethi avanaith thappuvippathillai; thunmaarkkan than thunmaarkkaththaivittuth thirumpuki'ra naa'lilea avan than akkiramaththinaal vizhunthupoavathumillai; neethimaan paavagnseyki'ra naa'lilea than neethiyinaal pizhaippathumillai.

pizhaikkavea pizhaippaay en'ru naan neethimaanukkuch sollumpoathu, avan than neethiyai nampi, aniyaayagnseythaal, avanudaiya neethiyil on'rum ninaikkappaduvathillai, avan seytha than aniyaayaththilea saavaan.
pinnum saakavea saavaay en'ru naan thunmaarkkanukkuch sollumpoathu, avan than paavaththaivittuth thirumpi, niyaayamum neethiyugnseythu,

thunmaarkkan thaan vaangkina adaimaanaththaiyum thaan ko'l'laiyitta poru'laiyum thirumpak koduththuvittu, aniyaayam seyyaathapadi jeevappiramaa'nangka'lil nadanthaal, avan saakaamal pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan.
avan seytha avanudaiya ellaap paavangka'lum avanukku viroathamaaka ninaikkappaduvathillai; avan niyaayamum neethiyum seythaan, pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan en'ru sollu.
un janaththin puththiraroa, aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaanathalla enki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya vazhiyea semmaiyaanathalla.
neethimaan than neethiyaivittuth thirumpi, aniyaayagnseythaal, avan athinaal saavaan.
thunmaarkkan than akkiramaththaivittuth thirumpi, niyaayamum neethiyum seythaal, avan avaika'linaal pizhaippaan.
neengka'loa, aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaanathalla enki'reerka'l, israveal veettaarea, naan ungka'lil ovvoruvanaiyum avanavan vazhika'linpadiyea niyaayantheerppean en'ru sol en'raar.
engka'l si'raiyiruppin pannira'ndaam varusham paththaam maatham ainthaantheathiyilea erusaleamilirunthu thappina oruvan ennidaththil vanthu: nakaram azhikkappattathu en'raan.

thappinavan varuki'ratha'rku munthina saayangkaalaththilea karththarudaiya kai enmeal amarnthu, avan kaalaiyil ennidaththil varumattum en vaayaith thi'ranthirukkappa'n'nit'ru; en vaay thi'rakkappattathu, pinpu naan maunamaayirukkavillai.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, israveal theasaththin paazhaana idangka'lilu'l'la kudika'l: aapirakaam oruvanaayirunthu, theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndaan; naangka'l aneakaraayirukki'roam, engka'lukku inthath theasam suthantharamaakak kodukkappattathu en'ru solluki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal, nee avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l iraththaththoadea koodiyathaith thin'ru, ungka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku nearaaka ungka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, iraththaththaich sinthiyirukki'reerka'l, neengka'l theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'lveerka'loa?

neengka'l ungka'l pattayaththai nampikko'ndu, aruvaruppaanathaich seythu, ungka'lil avanavan thanthan ayalaan manaiviyaith theettuppaduththuki'reerka'l; neengka'l theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'lveerka'loa en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.

nee avarka'lai noakki: paazhaana idangka'lil irukki'ravarka'l pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; ve'lika'lil irukki'ravanai mirukangka'lukku iraiyaaka oppukkoduppean; koattaika'lilum kepika'lilum irukki'ravarka'l ko'l'lainoayaal saavaarka'l.
naan theasaththaip paazhum avaantharamumaakkuvean; appozhuthu athinudaiya pelaththin perumai ozhinthupoakum; appozhuthu isravealin malaika'l kadanthupoavaarillaamal avaantharamaayk kidakkum.

avarka'l seytha avarka'ludaiya ellaa aruvaruppuka'linimiththamum naan theasaththaip paazhum avaantharamumaakkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l, ithai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.

mealum manupuththiranea, un janaththin puththirar suvar oarangka'lilum veettuvaasalka'lilum unnaikku'riththup peasi, karththaridaththilirunthu pu'rappatta vaarththai ennaven'ru keadpoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvarum sakoatharanoadea sakoatharanum solli,

janangka'l koodivaruki'ra vazhakkaththinpadi unnidaththil vanthu, unakku munpaaka en janangka'lpoal udkaarnthu, un vaarththaika'laik keadki'raarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l avaika'linpadi seyki'rathillai; avarka'l thangka'l vaayinaalea inpamaayp peasuki'raarka'l, avarka'l iruthayamoa poru'laasaiyaip pinpat'rip poaki'rathu.

ithoa, nee iniya kuralum keethavaaththiyam vaasippathil saamarththiyamumudaiyavan paadum inpamaana paattukkuch samaanamaayirukki'raay; avarka'l un vaarththaika'laik keadki'raarka'l; aanaalum avaika'linpadi seyyaama'rpoaki'raarka'l.
ithoa, athu varuki'rathu, athu varukaiyil thangka'l naduvilea oru theerkkatharisi irunthaan en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, isravealin meaypparukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam urai; nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, avarka'loadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar meaypparukkuch solluki'raar; thangka'laiyea meaykki'ra isravealin meaypparukku aiyoa! meayppar allavaa manthaiyai meaykkavea'ndum.
neengka'l neyyaich saappittu, aattumayirai uduppaakkikko'l'luki'reerka'l; kozhuththathai adikki'reerka'l; manthaiyaiyoa meaykkaama'rpoaki'reerka'l.

neengka'l palaveenamaanavaika'laip palappaduththaamalum, nasalko'ndavaika'laik ku'namaakkaamalum, elumpu mu'rinthavaika'laik kaayangkattaamalum, thuraththu'ndavaika'laith thiruppikko'ndu varaamalum, kaa'naama'rpoanavaika'laith theadaamalum poay, palaathkaaramum kadooramumaay avaika'lai aa'ndeerka'l.
meayppan illaathathinaal avaika'l sitha'ru'ndupoayina; sitha'ru'ndupoanavaika'l kaattu mirukangka'lukkellaam iraiyaayina.
en aaduka'l sakala malaika'lilum uyaramaana sakala meaduka'lilum alaippu'ndu, poomiyinmeethengkum en aaduka'l sitha'riththiriki'rathu; visaarikki'ravanumillai, theaduki'ravanumillai.
aakaiyaal meaypparea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra naan en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; meayppan illaathathinaal en aaduka'l soo'raiyaaki, en aaduka'l kaattumirukangka'lukkellaam iraiyaayp poayina; en meaypparka'l en aaduka'lai visaariyaama'rpoanaarka'l, meaypparka'l manthaiyai meaykkaamal thangka'laiyea meayththaarka'l.
aakaiyaal meaypparea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: ithoa, naan meaypparukku viroathamaaka vanthu, en aaduka'lai avarka'l kaiyilea keattu, meayppar inith thangka'laiyea meaykkaathapadi, manthaiyai meaykkum thozhilaivittu avarka'lai vilakki, en aaduka'l avarka'lukku aakaaramaayiraathapadi, avaika'lai avarka'l vaaykkuth thappappa'n'nuvean en'ru sollu.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, naan naanea en aaduka'lai visaariththu, avaika'laith theadippaarppean.

oru meayppan sitha'ru'nda than aaduka'lin naduvea irukki'ra naa'lil than manthaiyaith theadikko'ndirukki'rathupoala, naan en aaduka'laith theadi, mappum manthaaramumaana naa'lilea avaika'l sitha'ru'ndupoana ellaa idangka'lilumirunthu avaika'laith thappivarappa'n'ni,

avaika'lai janangka'lidaththilirunthu pu'rappadavum theasangka'lilirunthu searavumpa'n'ni, avaika'ludaiya suyatheasaththilea avaika'laik ko'nduvanthu, israveal malaika'linmealum aa'ruka'l a'ndaiyilum theasaththin sakala vaasasthalangka'lilum avaika'lai meayppean.

avaika'lai nalla meaychchalilea meayppean; isravealudaiya uyarntha malaika'lil avaika'ludaiya thozhuvam irukkum; angkea avaika'l nalla thozhuvaththil paduththukko'l'lum, isravealin malaika'linmeal nalla meaychchalai meayum.
en aaduka'lai naan meayththu, avaika'lai naan madakkuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

naan kaa'naama'rpoanathaith theadi, thuraththu'ndathaith thirumpakko'nduvanthu, elumpu mu'rinthathaik kaayangkatti, nasalko'ndathaith thidappaduththuvean; niyaayaththukkuththakkathaay avaika'lai meayththu, pushdiyum pelamumu'l'lavaika'lai azhippean.
en manthaiyea, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, aattukkum aattukkum, aattukkadaakka'lukkum, ve'l'laattukkadaakka'lukkum naan niyaayantheerppean.

neengka'l nalla meaychchalai meaynthu, ungka'l meaychchalka'lil meethiyaanathai ungka'l kaalka'laal mithikkalaamaa? the'lintha tha'n'neeraik kudiththu meethiyaayirukki'rathai ungka'l kaalka'laal kuzhappippoadalaamaa?
en aaduka'l ungka'l kaalka'laal mithikkappattathai meayavum, ungka'l kaalka'laal kuzhappappattathaik kudikkavum vea'ndumoa?
aakaiyaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar avaika'lai noakki: ithoa, naan, naanea kozhuththa aaduka'lukkum i'laiththa aaduka'lukkum niyaayantheerppean.
neengka'l palaveenamaayirukki'ravaika'laiyellaam pu'rampaakkich sitha'rappa'n'numpadi, avaika'laip pakkaththinaalum munnanthodaiyinaalum tha'l'li ungka'l kompuka'laikko'ndu muttuki'rapadiyinaalea,
naan en aaduka'lai inich soo'raiyaakaathapadikku iradchiththu, aaduka'lukkum aaduka'lukkum niyaayantheerppean.
avarka'lai meaykkumpadi en thaasanaakiya thaaveethu ennum orea meayppanai naan avarka'lmeal visaarippaayirukka ea'rpaduththuvean; ivar avarka'lai meayththu, ivarea avarka'lukku meayppanaayiruppaar.
karththaraakiya naan avarka'lukkuth theavanaaka iruppean, en thaasanaakiya thaaveethu avarka'l naduvil athipathiyaayiruppaar; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean.

naan avarka'loadu samaathaana udanpadikkaiseythu, thushda mirukangka'laith theasaththil iraathapadikku ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l sukamaay vanaantharaththil thaapariththu, kaaduka'lil niththiraipa'n'nuvaarka'l.
naan avarka'laiyum en meattin sut'ruppu'rangka'laiyum aaseervaathamaakki, eat'rakaalaththilea mazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'nuvean; aaseervaathamaana mazhai peyyum.

ve'liyin virudchangka'l thangka'l kaniyaiththarum; poomi than palanaik kodukkum; avarka'l thangka'l theasaththil sukamaayiruppaarka'l; naan avarka'l nukaththin kayi'ruka'lai a'ruththu, avarka'lai adimaiko'ndavarka'lin kaikku avarka'lai neengkalaakki viduvikkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
ini avarka'l pu'rajaathika'lukkuk ko'l'laiyaavathillai, poomiyin mirukangka'l avarka'laip padchippathumillai; thaththa'likkappa'n'nuvaar illaamal sukamaayth thangkuvaarka'l.

naan avarka'lukkuk keerththiporunthiya oru naat'rai ezhumpappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l ini theasaththilea pagnchaththaal vaarikko'l'lappaduvathumillai, inip pu'rajaathika'l seyyum avamaanaththaich sumappathumillai.

thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'ra naan thangka'loadea irukki'rathaiyum, israveal vamsaththaaraakiya thaangka'l en janamaayirukki'rathaiyum, avarka'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
en manthaiyum en meaychchalin aaduka'lumaakiya neengka'l manushar; naan ungka'l theavan en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee un mukaththaich seayeermalaikku nearaakath thiruppi atha'rku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu,

atha'rkuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, seayeermalaiyea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, en kaiyai unakku viroathamaakaneetti, unnaip paazhum avaantharave'liyumaakkuvean.
un patta'nangka'lai vanaantharamaakkippoaduvean; nee paazhaayppoavaay; naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaay.

nee pazhaiya pakaiyai vaiththu, israveal puththirarudaiya akkiramam ni'raivea'rukaiyil avarka'lukku u'ndaana aapaththin kaalaththilea pattayaththin koormaiyinaal avarka'ludaiya iraththaththaich sinthinapadiyaal,

naan iraththap pazhikku unnai oppuvippean; iraththappazhi unnaip pinthodarum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra naan en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean; nee iraththaththai ve'rukkaathapadiyinaal iraththam unnaip pinthodarum.
naan seayeermalaiyaip paazhum avaanthara idamumaakki, athilea poakkuvaravu seyvaar illaathapadi sangkaaragnseythu,
athin malaika'laik kolaiyu'ndavarka'laalea nirappuvean; un meaduka'lilum un pa'l'laththaakkuka'lilum un ellaa aa'ruka'lilum pattayaththaal vettu'ndavarka'l vizhuvaarka'l.
nee en'raikkum avaantharave'liyaayirukkumpadi seyvean; un patta'nangka'l kudiyeat'rappaduvathillai; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
ira'ndu jaathika'lum ira'ndu theasangka'lum karththar vasamaayirunthum, avaika'l ennudaiyavaika'laakum, naan avaika'laich suthanthariththukko'l'luvean en'ru nee solluki'rapadiyinaal,

nee avarka'lmeal vaiththa varmaththinaal seytha un koapaththukkuththakkathaakavum, un po'raamaikkuththakkathaakavum naan seythu, karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra naan unnai niyaayantheerkkumpoathu, ennai avarka'lukku'l athinaal a'riyappa'n'nuvean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean.

isravealin malaika'l paazhaakkappattu engka'lukku iraiyaakak kodukkappattathu en'ru, nee avaika'lukku viroathamaaych sonna un ninthanaika'laiyellaam karththaraakiya naan keattean en'ru appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lvaay.
neengka'l ungka'l vaayinaal enakku viroathamaakap perumaipaaraatti, enakku viroathamaaka ungka'l vaarththaika'laip perukappa'n'nineerka'l; athai naan keattean.
poomiyellaam makizhumpoathu naan unnaip paazhaayirukkumpadi seyvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

israveal vamsaththaarin suthantharam paazhaayppoanathaik ka'ndu makizhnthaayea, unakkum appadiyea sampavikkachseyvean; seayeermalaiyea, eathoamea, nee muzhuthum paazhaavaay; athinaal naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'len'ru uraiththaar en'ru sollu.
manupuththiranea, nee israveal malaika'lai noakkith theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal malaika'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar; pakaignan ungka'laikku'riththu aa aa, niththiya meaduka'l engka'l vasamaayit'ru en'ru solluki'rapadiyinaal,

nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, neengka'l pu'rajaathika'lil meethiyaanavarka'lukkuch suthantharamaayirukkumpadi avarka'l ungka'laip paazhaakki, ungka'laich sut'rilumirunthu vizhungkinapadiyinaalum, neengka'l vaayaadika'lukkuppeachchum janangka'lukku avathoo'rumaanavarka'laanapadiyinaalum,

israveal malaika'lea, neengka'l karththaraakiya aa'ndavarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; malaika'lukkum, meaduka'lukkum, aa'ruka'lukkum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lukkum, paazhaakkappatta avaanthara idangka'lukkum, ve'rumaiyaay vidappatta patta'nangka'lukkum karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: ungka'laich sut'rilum meethiyaana pu'rajaathika'lukku neengka'l ko'l'laiyum pariyaasamumaayppoanapadiyinaal,

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar: en theasaththaik ko'l'laiyidappatta ve'liyaakkumpadikku athai muzhu iruthayaththin santhoashaththoadum karvamaana manathoadum thangka'lukkuch suthantharamaaka niyamiththukko'nda pu'rajaathika'lil meethiyaanavarka'lukku viroathamaakavum eathoam anaiththukkum viroathamaakavum, en akkiniyaana erichchalinaal peasinean en'ru nichchayamaaych solluki'rean.

aakaiyaal, nee israveal theasaththaikku'riththuth theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, malaika'lukkum, meaduka'lukkum, aa'ruka'lukkum, pa'l'laththaakkuka'lukkum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, ithoa, neengka'l pu'rajaathika'l seyyum avamaanaththaich sumanthapadiyinaal naan en erichchalinaalum en ukkiraththinaalum peasinean,

aathalaal, karththaraakiya aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra naan en karaththai uyarththuvean, ungka'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathika'l thangka'ludaiya avamaanaththai nichchayamaaych sumappaarka'l en'ru solluki'rean.
israveal malaika'lea, neengka'l ungka'l koppuka'lai vittu, en janamaakiya isravealukku ungka'l kanika'laik koduppeerka'l; avarka'l sameepamaay vanthuvittaarka'l.
ithoa, naan ungka'l padchaththilirunthu, ungka'laik ka'n'noakkuvean; neengka'l pa'npaduththappattu vithaikkappaduveerka'l.
naan ungka'lmeal israveal vamsamaakiya manushar yaavaraiyum varththikkappa'n'nuvean; patta'nangka'l kudiyeat'rappadum, avaantharamaana sthalangka'l kattappadum.

ungka'lmeal manusharaiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum perukip palukumpadi varththikkappa'n'nuvean; poorvanaadka'lil neengka'l iruntha nilaimaiyil naan ungka'lai sthaapiththu, ungka'l munthina seeraippaarkkilum ungka'lukku na'rseer u'ndaakachseyvean; athinaal naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.
naan ungka'lmeal en janamaakiya isravealin manusharai nadamaadappa'n'nuvean, avarka'l unnaik kaiyaa'luvaarka'l; avarka'lukkuch suthantharamaayiruppaay; nee inimeal avarka'laich saakakkoduppathillai.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, janangka'l unnaippaarththu: nee manusharaip padchikki'ra theasamen'rum, nee un janangka'laich saakakkodukki'ra theasamen'rum solluki'rapadiyinaal,
nee inimeal manusharaip padchippathumillai, inimeal un janangka'laich saakakkoduppathumillai en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

naan inimeal pu'rajaathika'l seyyum avamaanaththai unnidaththilea keadkappa'n'nuvathumillai, nee janangka'lin ninthaiyai inimeal sumappathumillai; nee inimeal un jaathika'laich saakakkoduppathumillaiyen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, israveal vamsaththaar thangka'l suyatheasaththilea kudiyirukkaiyil athaith thangka'l nadakkaiyinaalum thangka'l kiriyaika'linaalum theettuppaduththinaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya nadakkai en mukaththukku munpaakath thoorasthireeyin theettaippoal irunthathu.

aakaiyinaal theasaththilea avarka'l sinthina iraththaththinimiththamum, athai avarka'l thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laal theettuppaduththinathinimiththamum naan en ukkiraththai avarka'lmeal oot'ri,

avarka'laip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththean; theasangka'lil thoot'rippoadappattaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya nadakkaiyinpadiyeayum avarka'ludaiya kiriyaika'linpadiyeayum avarka'lai niyaayantheerththean.

avarka'l pu'rajaathika'lidaththil poanapoathu antha janangka'l ivarka'laikku'riththu: ivarka'l karththarudaiya janangka'l, avarudaiya theasaththilirunthu vanthaarka'l en'ru sonnathinaal, ivarka'l en parisuththa naamaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinaarka'l.
aanaalum israveal vamsaththaar thaangka'l vanthusearntha pu'rajaathika'lidaththilea parisuththakkulaichchalaakkina en parisuththa naamaththinimiththamaakavea irangkuki'rean.

aathalaal, nee israveal vamsaththaarai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, israveal vamsaththaarea, ungka'l nimiththam alla, neengka'l vanthu searntha pu'rajaathika'lidaththil parisuththakkulaichchalaakkina en parisuththa naamaththinimiththamea naan ippadich seyki'rean.

pu'rajaathika'lin naduvea neengka'l parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinathum avarka'lukku'l ungka'laal parisuththakkulaichchalaakkappattathumaana en makaththaana naamaththai naan parisuththampa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu pu'rajaathika'l thangka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka naan ungka'lukku'l parisuththampa'n'nappadukaiyil, naan karththar enpathai a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
naan ungka'laip pu'rajaathika'lidaththilirunthu azhaiththu, ungka'laich sakala theasangka'lilumirunthu searththu, ungka'l suyatheasaththi'rku ungka'laik ko'nduvaruvean.

appozhuthu naan ungka'lmeal suththamaana jalam the'lippean; naan ungka'ludaiya ellaa asuththangka'laiyum ungka'ludaiya ellaa narakalaana vikkirakangka'laiyum neekki ungka'laich suththamaakkuvean, neengka'l suththamaaveerka'l.

ungka'lukku navamaana iruthayaththaik koduththu, ungka'l u'l'laththilea puthithaana aaviyaik katta'laiyittu, kallaana iruthayaththai ungka'l maamsaththilirunthu eduththuppoattu, sathaiyaana iruthayaththai ungka'lukkuk koduppean.
ungka'l u'l'laththilea en aaviyai vaiththu, ungka'lai en katta'laika'lil nadakkavum en niyaayangka'laik kaikko'l'lavum avaika'linpadi seyyavumpa'n'nuvean.
ungka'l pithaakka'lukku naan koduththa theasaththilea neengka'l kudiyiruppeerka'l; neengka'l en janamaayiruppeerka'l, naan ungka'l theavanaayirunthu,
ungka'l asuththangka'laiyellaam neekki, ungka'lai iradchiththu, ungka'lmeal pagnchaththaik katta'laiyidaamal, koathumaiyai varavazhaiththu, athaipperukappa'n'ni,
neengka'l inimeal jaathika'lukku'l'lea pagnchaththinaalu'ndaakum ninthaiyai adaiyaathapadikku, virudchaththin kanika'laiyum vayalin palanka'laiyum perukappa'n'nuvean.

appozhuthu neengka'l ungka'l pollaatha maarkkangka'laiyum ungka'l thakaatha kiriyaika'laiyum ninaiththu, ungka'l akkiramangka'linimiththamum ungka'l aruvaruppuka'linimiththamum ungka'laiyea aroasippeerka'l.

naan ippadich seyvathu ungka'l nimiththamaaka allaven'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar, ithu ungka'lukku a'riyappattirukkakkadavathu; israveal vamsaththaarea, ungka'l vazhika'linimiththam vedki naa'nungka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan ungka'l akkiramangka'laiyellaam neekki, ungka'laich suththamaakkum kaalaththilea patta'nangka'lil kudiyeat'ruvippean; avaantharamaana sthalangka'lum kattappadum.
paazhaakkappatta theasam kadanthupoaki'ra yaavarudaiya paarvaikkum paazhaaykkidanthatha'rkup pathilaaka payiridappadum.

paazhaaykkidantha iththeasam, eathean thoattaththaippoalaayit'ren'rum, avaantharamum paazhum nirmoolamumaayiruntha patta'nangka'l ara'nippaanavaika'lum kudiyeat'rappattavaika'lumaay irukki'rathu en'rum solluvaarka'l.

karththaraakiya naan nirmoolamaanavaika'laik kattuki'rean en'rum, paazhaanathaip payirnilamaakkuki'rean en'rum, appozhuthu ungka'laich sut'rilumu'l'la meethiyaana jaathika'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l; karththaraakiya naan ithaich sonnean, ithaich seyvean.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: israveal vamsaththaarukkaaka naan ithai anukkirakagnseyyumpadi avarka'l ennidaththil vi'n'nappam pa'n'navea'ndum; manthai perukuki'rathupoal avarka'lil manitharaip perukappa'n'nuvean.

pa'ndikai kaalangka'lil erusaleamilea parisuththampa'n'nappattu varuki'ra manthaika'l eppadith thira'laayirukki'rathoa, appadiyea avaantharamaayiruntha patta'nangka'l manusharin manthaiyaal nirampiyirukkum; athinaal naan karththar enpathai a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya kai enmeal amarnthu, karththar ennai aavikku'l'laakki ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, elumpuka'l ni'raintha oru pa'l'laththaakkin naduvil ni'ruththi,
ennai avaika'lin arukea sut'ri nadakkappa'n'ninaar; ithoa, pa'l'laththaakkin vettave'liyilea antha elumpuka'l makaa thira'laaykkidanthathu; avaika'l mikavum ularnthathumaayirunthathu.
avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, intha elumpuka'l uyiradaiyumaa en'ru keattaar; atha'rku naan: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer athai a'riveer en'rean.

appozhuthu avar: nee intha elumpuka'laikku'riththuth theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, avaika'laippaarththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: ularntha elumpuka'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar intha elumpuka'lai noakki: ithoa, naan ungka'lukku'l aaviyaip piraveasikkappa'n'nuvean, appozhuthu uyiradaiveerka'l.

naan ungka'lmeal narampuka'laich searththu, ungka'lmeal maamsaththai u'ndaakki, ungka'laith thoalinaal moodi, ungka'lil aaviyaik katta'laiyiduvean; appozhuthu neengka'l uyiradainthu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'len'ru uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea naan theerkkatharisanam uraiththean; naan theerkkatharisanam uraikkaiyil oru iraichchal u'ndaayit'ru; ithoa, asaivu'ndaaki, ovvoru elumpum thanthan elumpoadea searnthuko'ndathu.
naan paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, avaika'lmeal narampuka'lum maamsamum u'ndaayit'ru, mea'rpu'ramengkum thoalinaal moodappattathu; aanaalum avaika'lil aavi illaathirunthathu.

appozhuthu avar ennaippaarththu: nee aaviyai noakkith theerkkatharisanam urai; manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, aaviyai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, aaviyea, nee kaat'ruththisai naankilumirunthu vanthu, kolaiyu'nda ivarka'l uyiradaiyumpadikku ivarka'lmeal oothu enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
enakkuk ka'rpikkappattapadi naan theerkkatharisanam uraiththean; appozhuthu aavi avarka'lukku'l piraveasikka, avarka'l uyiradainthu, kaaloon'ri, makaa periya seanaiyaay nin'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, intha elumpuka'l israveal vamsaththaar anaivarumea; ithoa, avarka'l engka'l elumpuka'l ularnthupoayit'ru; engka'l nampikkai at'ruppoayit'ru; naangka'l a'ruppu'ndupoaki'roam enki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, avarka'loadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, ithoa, en janangka'lea, naan ungka'l pireathakkuzhika'laith thi'ranthu, ungka'lai ungka'l pireathakkuzhika'lilirunthu ve'lippadavum, ungka'lai israveal theasaththukku varavumpa'n'nuvean.
en janangka'lea, naan ungka'l pireathakkuzhika'laith thi'ranthu, ungka'lai ungka'l pireathakkuzhika'lilirunthu ve'lippadappa'n'numpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l.

en aaviyai ungka'lukku'l vaippean; neengka'l uyiradaiveerka'l; naan ungka'lai ungka'l theasaththil vaippean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l; ithaich sonnean, ithaich seyvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee oru koalai eduththu, athilea yoothaavukkum athaich searntha israveal puththirarukkum aduththathu en'ru ezhuthi; pinpu vea'roru koalai eduththu, athilea eppiraayeemukkum athaichsearntha israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum aduththa yoaseappin koalen'ru ezhuthi,
avaika'lai orea koalaakumpadi on'roadon'ru isaiyachsey, avaika'l un kaiyil on'raakum.
ivaika'lin poru'l innathen'ru engka'lukku a'rivikkamaatteeroa en'ru un janaththin puththirar unnidaththil keattaal,

nee avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, eppiraayeemukkum athaichsearntha israveal koaththirangka'lukkum aduththa yoaseappin koalai eduththu, athai yoothaavin koaloadea searththu, avaika'lai orea koalaakkuvean; avaika'l en kaiyil on'raakum enki'raar en'ru sol.
sollumpoathu, nee ezhuthina koalka'l avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka un kaiyil irukkavea'ndum.

nee avarka'lai noakki: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, naan israveal vamsaththaarai avarka'l poayirukkum jaathika'lidaththilirunthu azhaiththu, sut'rilumirunthu avarka'laich searththu, avarka'lai avarka'l suyatheasaththilea varappa'n'ni,

avarka'lai isravealin malaika'laakiya theasaththilea orea jaathiyaakkuvean; orea raajaa avarka'l ellaarukkum raajaavaaka iruppaar; avarka'l ini ira'ndu jaathika'laaka iruppathillai; avarka'l ini ira'ndu raajyangka'laakap pirivathumillai.

avarka'l inith thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'linaalum thangka'l aruvaruppuka'linaalum thangka'ludaiya sakala mee'ruthalka'linaalum thangka'laith theettuppaduththuvathumillai; avarka'l kudiyirunthu paavagnseytha ellaa idangka'lilirunthum naan avarka'lai neengkalaakki iradchiththu, avarka'laich suththampa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean.

en thaasanaakiya thaaveethu enpavar avarka'lmeal raajaavaaka iruppaar; avarka'l ellaarukkum orea meayppar iruppaar; appozhuthu avarka'l en niyaayangka'lil nadanthu, en katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadiyea seythu,

naan en thaasanaakiya yaakkoapukkuk koduththathum, ungka'l pithaakka'l kudiyirunthathumaana theasaththilea kudiyiruppaarka'l; avarka'lum avarka'l pi'l'laika'lum avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lin pi'l'laika'lum athilea en'ren'raikkum kudiyiruppaarka'l; en thaasanaakiya thaaveethu enpavar en'ren'raikkum avarka'lukku athipathiyaayiruppaar.

naan avarka'loadea samaathaana udanpadikkai seyvean; athu avarka'lukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaayirukkum; naan avarka'lai nilaippaduththi, avarka'lai varththikkappa'n'ni, avarka'l naduvilea en parisuththa sthalaththai en'ren'raikkum sthaapippean.
en vaasasthalam avarka'lidaththil irukkum, naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean, avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l.

appadiyea en parisuththa sthalam avarka'l naduvilea en'ren'raikkum irukkumpoathu, naan isravealaip parisuththampa'n'nuki'ra karththar en'ru jaathika'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l enki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

manupuththiranea, measeak thoopaal jaathika'lin thalaimaiyaana athipathiyaakiya maakoaku theasaththaanaana koakukku ethiraaka nee un mukaththaith thiruppi, avanukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu,
sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, measeak thoopaal jaathika'lin athipathiyaakiya koakea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka varuvean.

naan unnaith thiruppi, un vaayil thu'raduka'laip poattu, unnaiyum unnudaiya ellaach seanaiyaiyum, kuthiraika'laiyum, sarvaayuthanthariththa kuthiraiveerarka'laiyum, parisaiyum keadakamumudaiya thira'laana koottaththaiyum pu'rappadappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l ellaarum pattayangka'laip pidiththiruppaarka'l.
avarka'loadeakoodap persiyarum, eththiyoappiyarum, leepiyarum iruppaarka'l; avarka'lellaarum keadakam pidiththu, thalaichseeraavun thariththiruppavarka'l.
koamearum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lum, vadathisaiyilu'l'la thoakarmaa vamsaththaarum avarka'ludaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lumaakiya thira'laana janangka'l unnudaneakooda iruppaarka'l.
nee aayaththappadu, unnudanea koodina un ellaak koottaththaiyum aayaththappaduththu; nee avarka'lukkuk kaavalaa'lanaayiru.

aneaka naadka'lukkup pi'rpaadu nee visaarikkappaduvaay; pattayaththukku neengkalaaki, pa'rpala janangka'lilirunthu searththukko'l'lappattu vanthavarka'lin theasaththil kadaisi varushangka'lilea varuvaay; nedunaa'l paazhaaykkidanthu, pi'rpaadu jaathika'lilirunthu ko'nduvarappattavarka'l ellaarum sukaththoadea kudiyirukkum isravealin malaika'lukku viroathamaay varuvaay; avarka'l ellaarum agnchaamal kudiyirukkumpoathu,
perungkaat'raippoal ezhumpivaruvaay; neeyum unnudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lum unnoadeakooda irukkum thira'laana janangka'lum kaarmeakampoal theasaththai mooduveerka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: annaa'lilea paazhaaykkidanthu thirumpak kudiyeat'rappatta sthalangka'lukku viroathamaakavum, jaathika'lidaththilirunthu searkkappattathum, aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum aasthika'laiyum sampaathiththu, theasaththin naduvil kudiyirukki'rathumaana janaththukku viroathamaakavum, nee un kaiyaith thiruppumpadikku,
un iruthayaththil yoasanaika'l ezhumpa, nee pollaatha ninaivai ninaiththu,

naan ko'l'laiyidavum soo'raiyaadavum, mathilka'lillaamal kidakki'ra kiraamangka'lu'l'la theasaththukku viroathamaayppoavean; nirvisaaramaaych sukaththoadea kudiyirukki'ravarka'linmeal varuvean; avarka'l ellaarum mathilka'lillaamal kudiyirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lukkuth thaazhppaa'lum illai, kathavuka'lum illai enpaay.

seapaa theasaththaarum, theathaan theasaththaarum, tharsheesin varththakarum athinudaiya paalasingkangka'laana anaivarum unnai noakki: nee ko'l'laiyida allavoa varuki'raayen'rum, nee soo'raiyaadi, ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum aasthiyaiyum eduththukko'l'luki'ratha'rkum, aaduka'laiyum maaduka'laiyum pidikki'ratha'rkum, mikavum ko'l'laiyiduki'ratha'rkum allavoa unnudaiya koottaththaik koottinaayen'rum solluvaarka'l.

aakaiyaal manupuththiranea, nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, koakai noakkich sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar; en janamaakiya israveal sukamaayk kudiyirukki'ra akkaalaththilea nee athai a'rivaay allavoa?

appozhuthu neeyum unnudaneakoodath thira'laana janangka'lum vadathisaiyilu'l'la un sthaanaththilirunthu varuveerka'l; avarka'l periya koottamum thira'laana seanaiyumaayirunthu, ellaarum kuthiraika'linmeal ea'ruki'ravarka'laayiruppaarka'l.

nee theasaththaik kaarmeakampoal mooda, en janamaakiya isravealukku viroathamaaka ezhumpivaruvaay; kadaisi naadka'lilea ithu sampavikkum; koakea, jaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka unmoolamaay naan parisuththar en'ru vi'langkappaduki'rathinaal avarka'l ennai a'riyumpadikku unnai en theasaththukku viroathamaaka varappa'n'nuvean.

unnai avarka'lukku viroathamaaka varappa'n'nuvean en'ru poorvanaadka'lilea aneaka varushakaalamaayth theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, isravealin theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu, annaadka'lilea naan ku'riththuchsonnavan nee allavoa en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
israveal theasaththukku viroathamaakak koaku varumkaalaththil en ukkiram en naasiyil ea'rumen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
annaa'lilea israveal theasaththilea periya athirchchi u'ndaaki,

en pirasannaththinaal samuththiraththu machchangka'lum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lum, ve'liyin mirukangka'lum, tharaiyil ooruki'ra sakala piraa'nika'lum, theasamengkumu'l'la sakala narajeevanka'lum athirum; parvathangka'l idiyum; sengkuththaanavaika'l vizhum; ellaa mathilka'lum tharaiyilea vizhunthupoam en'ru en erichchalinaalum en sinaththin akkiniyinaalum nichchayamaaych solluki'rean.
en ellaa malaika'lilum pattayaththai avanukku viroathamaaka varavazhaippean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; avanavan pattayam avanavan sakoatharanukku viroathamaayirukkum.

ko'l'lainoayinaalum iraththam sinthuthalinaalum naan avanoadea vazhakkaadi, avanmealum avan iraa'nuvangka'linmealum avanoadirukkum thira'laana janangka'linmealum ve'l'lamaay adikkum mazhaiyaiyum, perungkalmazhaiyaiyum, akkiniyaiyum, kanthakaththaiyum varushikkappa'n'nuvean.
ivvithamaay naan aneaka jaathika'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka en makaththuvaththaiyum en parisuththaththaiyum vi'langkappa'n'ni, a'riyappaduvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

ippoathum manupuththiranea, nee koakukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam uraiththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, measeak thoopaal jaathika'lin athipathiyaakiya koakea, ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka varuki'rean.
naan unnaith thiruppi unnai aa'ru thu'raduka'laal izhuththu, unnai vadapu'rangka'lilirunthu ezhumpavum israveal malaika'lil varavumpa'n'ni,
un villai un idathukaiyilirunthu thattivittu, un ampuka'lai un valathukaiyilirunthu vizhappa'n'nuvean.
neeyum un ellaa iraa'nuvangka'lum unnoadirukki'ra janangka'lum israveal malaika'lil vizhuveerka'l; uraaygnchuki'ra sakalavitha padchika'lukkum ve'liyin mirukangka'lukkum unnai iraiyaakak koduppean.
visaalamaana ve'liyil vizhuvaay; naan ithaich sonnean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
naan maakoakidaththilum theevuka'lil nirvisaaramaayk kudiyirukki'ravarka'lidaththilum akkiniyai anuppuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

ivvithamaay naan en janamaakiya isravealin naduvilea en parisuththanaamaththaith therivippean; en parisuththa naamaththai inip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkavottean; athinaal naan isravealil parisuththaraakiya karththar en'ru pu'rajaathika'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
ithoa, athu vanthathu, athu sampaviththathu en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar; naan sonna naa'l ithuvea.

israveal patta'nangka'lin kudika'l ve'liyea poay, keadakangka'lum, parisaika'lum, villuka'lum, ampuka'lum, va'laithadika'lum, eettika'lumaakiya aayuthangka'lai eduththu erippaarka'l; eazhuvarusham avaika'lai eduththu erippaarka'l.

avarka'l ve'liyilirunthu vi'raku ko'nduvaraamalum kaaduka'lil vettaamalum, aayuthangka'lai eduththu erippaarka'l; avarka'l thangka'laik ko'l'laiyittavarka'laik ko'l'laiyittu, thangka'laich soo'raiyaadinavarka'laich soo'raiyaaduvaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

annaa'lil israveal theasaththilea samuththiraththukkuk kizhakkea pirayaa'nakkaararin pa'l'laththaakkaip puthaikki'ra sthaanamaakak koakukkuk koduppean; athu vazhippoakkar mookkaip poththikko'ndupoakappa'n'num; angkea koakaiyum avanudaiya ellaach seanaiyaiyum puthaiththu, athai aamoankoakin pa'l'laththaakku enpaarka'l.
israveal vamsaththaar, theasaththaich suththampa'n'numpadikku avarka'laip puthaiththuththeera eazhumaatham sellum.
theasaththin janangka'lellaarum puthaiththukko'ndiruppaarka'l; naan makimaippadum annaa'lilea athu avarka'lukkuk keerththiyaaka irukkum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

theasaththaich suththampa'n'nuvatha'rkaaka athil kidakkum mat'rap pireathangka'laip puthaikkumpadikku niththamum theasaththil sut'riththiriyum manusharaiyum, sut'riththiriki'ravarka'loadeakoodap puthaikki'ravarka'laiyum therinthu niyamippaarka'l; eazhumaathangka'l mudinthapinpum ivarka'l theadikko'ndiruppaarka'l.

theasaththil sut'riththiriki'ravarka'l thirinthuko'ndiruppaarka'l; yaaraavathu oruvan manushanin elumpaik kaa'numpoathu puthaikki'ravarka'l athai aamoankoakudaiya pa'l'laththaakkilea puthaikkumattum athina'ndaiyilea oru adaiyaa'laththai naattuvaan.
antha nakaraththukku aamoanaa en'ru peyaridappadum; ivvithamaayth theasaththaich suththampa'n'nuvaarka'l.

manupuththiranea, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee sakalavitha padchika'laiyum ve'liyil irukki'ra sakala mirukangka'laiyum noakki: neengka'l eakamaayk koodikko'ndu, isravealin malaika'lil naan ungka'lukkaakach seyyum yaakamaakiya makaa yaakaththukkuch sut'rilumirunthu vanthusearnthu, maamsam thin'ru iraththangkudiyungka'l.

neengka'l paraakkiramasaalika'lin maamsaththaith thin'ru, poomiyinudaiya pirapukka'lin iraththaththaik kudippeerka'l; avarka'l ellaarum paasaanilea kozhuththuppoana aattukkadaakka'lukkum, aattukkuttika'lukkum ve'l'laattuk kadaakka'lukkum kaa'laika'lukkum samaanamaanavarka'l.
naan ungka'lukkaakach seyyum yaakaththilea neengka'l thirupthiyaakuma'lavum kozhuppaith thin'ru, ve'riyaakuma'lavum iraththaththaik kudippeerka'l.

ivvithamaay en panthiyilea kuthiraika'laiyum, irathaveerarka'laiyum, paraakkiramasaalika'laiyum, sakala yuththaveerarka'laiyum thin'ru, thirupthiyaaveerka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.
ivvithamaay en makimaiyai naan pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea vi'langkappa'n'nuvean; naan seytha en niyaayaththaiyum avarka'lmeal naan vaiththa en kaiyaiyum ellaa jaathika'lum kaa'npaarka'l.
an'rumuthal en'rum naan thangka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru israveal vamsaththaar a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

israveal vamsaththaar thangka'l akkiramaththinimiththamea si'raippattuppoanaarka'l en'ru appozhuthu pu'rajaathika'l a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ninapadiyaal, en mukaththai naan avarka'lukku ma'raiththu, avarka'l saththurukka'lin kaiyil avarka'lai oppukkoduththean; avarka'l anaivarum pattayaththaal vizhunthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya asuththaththukkuth thakkathaakavum, avarka'ludaiya mee'ruthalka'lukkuththakkathaakavum, naan avarka'lukkuch seythu, en mukaththai avarka'lukku ma'raiththean.
aathalaal karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:

avarka'l thangka'l avamaanaththaiyum, payappaduththuvaar illaamal, thaangka'l sukamaayth thangka'l theasaththil kudiyirukkumpoathu enakku viroathamaayth thaangka'l seytha ellaath thuroakaththaiyum sumanthu theerththapinpu, naan yaakkoapin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppi, israveal vamsamanaiththukkum irangki, en parisuththa naamaththukkaaka vairaakkiyamaayiruppean.

naan avarka'lai janasatha'langka'lilirunthu thirumpivarappa'n'ni, avarka'ludaiya pakaignarin theasangka'lilirunthu avarka'laik koottikko'nduvanthu, thira'laana jaathika'ludaiya ka'nka'lukku munpaaka avarka'lukku'l naan parisuththar en'ru vi'langkumpoathu,

thangka'laip pu'rajaathika'lidaththil si'raippattuppoakappa'n'nina naan thangka'lil oruvaraiyum angkea appu'ram vaikkaamal, thangka'laith thangka'l suyatheasaththilea thirumpakkoottikko'nduvanthean enpathinaal, naan thangka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.
naan israveal vamsaththaarmeal en aaviyai oot'rinapadiyinaal en mukaththai ini avarka'lukku ma'raikkamaattean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar en'raar.

naangka'l si'raippattuppoana irupaththainthaam varushaththin aarampaththil muthalaam maatham paththaantheathiyaakiya an'rea karththarudaiya kai enmeal amarnthathu, avar ennai avvidaththukkuk ko'ndupoanaar; appozhuthu nakaram azhikkappattup pathinaalu varushamaayit'ru.

theavatharisanangka'lil avar ennai israveal theasaththukkuk ko'ndupoay, ennai makaa uyaramaana oru malaiyinmeal ni'ruththinaar; athinmeal the'rkaaka oru nakaram kattiyirukki'rathupoal kaa'nappattathu.
avar ennai angkea ko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, angkea oru purushan irunthaar; avarudaiya thoat'ram ve'nkalamaayirunthathu; avar kaiyil sa'na'rkayi'rum oru a'lavukoalum irunthathu; avar vaasalilea nin'raar.

anthap purushan ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee ka'n'naarappaarththu, kaathaarak keattu, naan unakkuk kaa'npippathellaavat'rin mealum un manathai vai; naan unakku avaika'laik kaa'npikkumpadi nee ingkea ko'nduvarappattaay; nee kaa'npathaiyellaam israveal vamsaththaarukkuth therivi en'raar.

ithoa, aalayaththukkup pu'rampea sut'rilum oru mathil irunthathu; anthap purushan kaiyilea aa'rumuzha nee'lamaana oru a'lavukoal irunthathu; ovvoru muzhamum namathu kaimuzhaththilum naalu vira'rkadai athikamaanathu; avar antha mathilai a'lanthaar; akalam oru koalaakavum uyaram oru koalaakavum irunthathu.
pinpu avar kizhakkumuka vaasalukku vanthu, athin padika'linmeal ea'ri, vaasa'rpadiyai oru koal akalamaakavum, ma'ruvaasa'rpadiyai oru koal akalamaakavum a'lanthaar.
ovvoru a'raiyum oru koal nee'lamum oru koal akalamumaayirunthathu; a'raiveeduka'lukku naduvea ainthumuzha idam vittirunthathu; vaasalin ma'ndapaththarukea u'lvaasa'rpadi oru koala'lavaayirunthathu.
vaasalin ma'ndapaththaiyum u'l'lea oru koala'lavaaka a'lanthaar.
pinpu vaasalin ma'ndapaththai ettumuzhamaakavum, athin thoo'naathaarangka'lai ira'ndu muzhamaakavum a'lanthaar; vaasalin ma'ndapam udpu'raththilirunthathu.

keezhththisaikkethiraana vaasalin a'raika'l inthappu'raththil moon'rum anthappu'raththil moon'rumaayirunthathu; avaika'l moon'rukkum orea a'lavum, inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum iruntha thoo'naathaarangka'lukku orea a'lavum irunthathu.
pinpu vaasal nadaiyin akalaththaip paththumuzhamaakavum, vaasalin nee'laththaip pathinmoon'ru muzhamaakavum a'lanthaar.
a'raika'lukkumunnea inthappu'raththil oru muzha idamum anthappu'raththil oru muzha idamum irunthathu; ovvoru a'raiyum inthappu'raththil aa'ru muzhamum anthappu'raththil aa'ru muzhamumaayirunthathu.
pinpu vaasalil iruntha a'raiyin meththaiyinin'ru mat'ra a'raiyin meththaimattum irupaththainthu muzhamaaka a'lanthaar; kathavukkuk kathavu nearaayirunthathu.
thoo'naathaarangka'lai a'rupathu muzhamaaka a'lanthaar; inthath thoo'naathaarangka'lin arukea sut'rilum munvaasalin mut'ram irunthathu.
piraveasa vaasalin mukappuththuvakki, udpu'ravaasal ma'ndapamukappumattum aimpathu muzhamaayirunthathu.

vaasalukku udpu'ramaakach sut'rilumu'l'la a'raika'lukkum avaika'lin thoo'naathaarangka'lukkum odukkamaana jannalka'l irunthathu; ma'ndapangka'lilum appadiyea irunthathu; udpu'ramaaych sut'rilum antha jannalka'lum thoo'naathaarangka'lil siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum irunthathu.

pinpu ennai ve'lippiraakaaraththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar; angkea a'raiveeduka'lum, piraakaaraththin sut'rilum pathiththa tha'lavarisaiyum irunthathu; anthath tha'lavarisaiyinmeal muppathu a'raiveeduka'l irunthathu.
vaasalukkup pakkaththilum vaasalka'lin nee'laththukku ethirilumu'l'la anthath tha'lavarisai thaazhvaana tha'lavarisaiyaayirunthathu.
pinpu avar keezhvaasalin mukappuththuvakki, udpiraakaaraththup pu'ramukappumattumu'l'la visaalaththai a'lanthaar; athu kizhakkum vadakkum noo'ru muzhamaayirunthathu.
ve'lippiraakaaraththukku aduththa vadathisaikku ethiraana vaasalin nee'laththaiyum akalaththaiyum a'lanthaar.

atha'rku ippu'raththil moon'ru a'raika'lum appu'raththil moon'ru a'raika'lum irunthathu; athin thoo'naathaarangka'lum athin ma'ndapangka'lum muthal vaasalin a'lavukkuch sariyaayirunthathu; athin nee'lam aimpathu muzhamum, akalam irupaththainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu.

athin jannalka'lum, athin ma'ndapangka'lum, athinmeal siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum, keezhththisaikku ethiraana vaasalin a'lavukkuch sariyaayirunthathu; athil ea'ruki'ratha'rku eazhu padika'lirunthathu; athin ma'ndapangka'l avaika'lukku munnaaka irunthathu.
vadathisaiyilum keezhththisaiyilumu'l'la ovvoru vaasalukku ethiraaka udpiraakaaraththukkum vaasalka'l irunthathu; oru vaasalthuvakki mat'ra vaasalmattum noo'ru muzhamaaka a'lanthaar.
pinpu ennaith thenthisaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar; angkea thenthisaikku ethiraana vaasal irunthathu; athin thoo'naathaarangka'laiyum athin ma'ndapangka'laiyum atha'rkuriya a'lavinpadi a'lanthaar.
antha jannalka'lukkuch sariyaaka atha'rkum athin ma'ndapangka'lukkum jannalka'l sut'rilum irunthathu; nee'lam aimpathumuzhamum akalam irupaththainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu.

athil ea'ruki'ratha'rku eazhu padika'lirunthathu; atha'rku munpaaka athin ma'ndapangka'lum irunthathu; athin thoo'naathaarangka'lil siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum inthappu'raththil on'rum anthappu'raththil on'rumaaka irunthathu.
udpiraakaaraththukkum oru vaasal thenthisaikku ethiraaka irunthathu; thenthisaiyilu'l'la oru vaasalthuvakki mat'ra vaasalmattum noo'rumuzhamaaka a'lanthaar.
pinpu avar the'rku vaasalaal ennai udpiraakaaraththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, antha a'lavukkuch sariyaakath the'rku vaasalaiyum a'lanthaar.

athin a'raika'lum, athin thoo'naathaarangka'lum, athin ma'ndapangka'lum, antha a'lavukkuch sariyaaka irunthathu; atha'rkum athin ma'ndapangka'lukkum jannalka'l sut'rilum irunthathu; nee'lam aimpathu muzhamum akalam irupaththainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu.
irupaththainthu muzha nee'lamum ainthumuzha akalamumaana ma'ndapangka'l sut'rilum irunthathu.
athin ma'ndapangka'l ve'lippiraakaaraththil irunthathu; athin thoo'naathaarangka'lil siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum irunthathu; athil ea'ruki'ratha'rku ettuppadika'l irunthathu.
pinpu avar keezhththisai vazhiyaay ennai udpiraakaaraththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, antha a'lavukkuch sariyaaka antha vaasalaiyum a'lanthaar.

athin a'raika'lum athin thoo'naathaarangka'lum athin ma'ndapangka'lum antha a'lavuka'lukkuch sariyaaka irunthathu; atha'rkum athin ma'ndapangka'lukkum jannalka'l sut'rilum irunthathu; nee'lam aimpathu muzhamum akalam irupaththainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu.

athin ma'ndapangka'l ve'lippiraakaaraththil irunthathu; athin thoo'naathaarangka'lil inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum irunthathu; athil ea'ruki'ratha'rku ettup padika'l irunthathu.
pinpu avar ennai vadakkuvaasalukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, antha a'lavukkuch sariyaay athin vaasalai a'lanthaar.
athin a'raika'lum athin thoo'naathaarangka'lum athin ma'ndapangka'lum a'lakkappattathu; athaich sut'ri jannalka'lum irunthathu; nee'lam aimpathu muzhamum akalam irupaththainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu.

athin thoo'naathaarangka'l ve'lippiraakaaraththil irunthathu; inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum athin thoo'naathaarangka'lil peareechchamarangka'lum siththirikkappattirunthathu; athil ea'ruvatha'rku ettup padika'l irunthathu.
athin a'raika'lum athin kathavuka'lum vaasalka'lin thoo'naathaarangka'lukku arukil irunthathu; angkea thakanapalika'laik kazhuvuvaarka'l.

vaasalin ma'ndapaththilea inthappu'raththil ira'ndu peedangka'lum anthappu'raththil ira'ndu peedangka'lum irunthathu; avaika'linmeal thakanapaliyaiyum paavanivaara'na paliyaiyum kut'ranivaara'napaliyaiyum seluththuvaarka'l.
vadakkuvaasalukku'l piraveasikki'ratha'rku ea'rippoaki'ra ve'lippu'raththilea ira'ndu peedangka'lum, vaasalin ma'ndapaththilu'l'la ma'rupu'raththilea ira'ndu peedangka'lum irunthathu.
vaasalin arukea inthappu'raththil naalu peedangka'lum, anthappu'raththil naalu peedangka'lum, aaka ettup peedangka'l irunthathu; avaika'linmeal palika'laich seluththuvaarka'l.

thakanapalikkuriya naalu peedangka'l vettina kallaayirunthathu; avaika'l on'rarai muzha nee'lamum, on'rarai muzha akalamum, oru muzha uyaramumaayirunthathu; avaika'linmeal thakanapalika'laiyum mat'rap palika'laiyum seluththuki'ra aayuthangka'lai vaippaarka'l.
naalu vira'rkadaiyaana mu'laika'l u'l'lea sut'rilum varisaiyaay adikkappattirunthathu; seluththum palika'lin maamsam peedangka'linmeal vaikkappadum.

udpiraakaaraththilea u'lvaasalukkup pu'rampaakach sangkeethakkaararin a'raiveeduka'l irunthathu; avaika'lil vadakku vaasalin pakkamaaka irunthavaika'l thenthisaikku ethiraakavum, kizhakku vaasalin pakkamaaka iruntha vea'roru varisai vadathisaikku ethiraakavum irunthathu.
pinpu avar ennai noakki: thenthisaikku ethiraayirukki'ra intha a'rai aalayakkaavalaik kaakki'ra aasaariyarka'ludaiyathu.

vadathisaikku ethiraayirukki'ra a'raiyoa, palipeedaththin kaavalaik kaakki'ra aasaariyarka'ludaiyathu; ivarka'l leaviyin puththiraril karththarukku aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rkaaka avaridaththil searuki'ra saathoakkin puththirar en'raar.
avar piraakaaraththai noo'rumuzha nee'lamaakavum noo'rumuzha akalamaakavum a'lanthaar; athu sathuramaayirunthathu; palipeedamoa aalayaththukku munpaaka irunthathu.

pinpu avar ennai aalaya ma'ndapaththukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, ma'ndapaththin thoo'naathaaraththai inthappu'raththil ainthu muzhamum anthappu'raththil ainthu muzhamumaaka a'lanthaar; vaasalin akalam inthappu'ram moon'ru muzhamum anthappu'ram moon'ru muzhamumaayirunthathu.

ma'ndapaththin nee'lam irupathu muzhamum, akalam pathinoru muzhamumaayirunthathu; atha'rku ea'rippoaki'ra padika'lum irunthathu; thoo'naathaarangka'lilea inthappu'raththil oru thoo'num anthappu'raththil oru thoo'num irunthathu.

pinpu avar ennaith theavaalayaththi'rku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, thoo'naathaarangka'lai inthappu'raththil aa'rumuzha akalamum anthappu'raththil aa'rumuzha akalamumaaka a'lanthaar; athu vaasasthalaththin akala a'lavaam.

vaasal nadaiyin akalam paththu muzhamum vaasal nadaiyin pakkangka'l inthappu'raththil ainthu muzhamum anthappu'raththil ainthu muzhamumaayirunthathu; athin nee'laththai naa'rpathu muzhamum akalaththai irupathu muzhamumaaka a'lanthaar.
pinpu avar u'l'lea poay, vaasal nadaiyin thoo'naathaarangka'lai ira'ndu muzhamaakavum, vaasal nadaiyai aa'rumuzhamaakavum, vaasal nadaiyin akalaththai eazhumuzhamaakavum a'lanthaar.
pinpu avar theavaalayaththin munpu'raththilea athin nee'laththai irupathumuzhamaakavum, athin akalaththai irupathu muzhamaakavum a'lanthu, ennai noakki: ithu makaa parisuththa sthalam en'raar.
pinpu avar aalayaththin suvarai aa'ru muzhamaakavum, aalayaththaich sut'rilum iruntha sut'rukkattinudaiya akalaththai naalumuzhamaakavum a'lanthaar.

inthach sut'rukkattuka'l pakkakkattinmeal pakkakkattaana varisaika'laay muppaththumoon'ru irunthathu; avaika'l aalayaththin suvarukku'l oon'riyiraamal, sut'rukkattuka'lukkaakach sut'rilum avaika'l oon'rumpadikku aalayaththukku aduththiruntha ottuchsuvarilea paaynthirunthathu.

uyara uyarach sut'rilum sut'rukkattuka'lukku akalam athikamaayirunthathu; aalayaththaich sut'rilum uyara uyara aalayaththaich sut'rich sut'ri akalam varavara athikamaayirunthathu; aathalaal ivvithamaayk keezhnilaiyilirunthu nadunilaivazhiyaay mealnilaikku ea'rum vazhiyirunthathu.
maa'likaikkuch sut'rilum iruntha uyaraththaiyum paarththean, sut'rukkattuka'lin asthipaarangka'l aa'ru periya muzhangko'nda oru muzhakkoalin uyaramaayirunthathu.
pu'rampea sut'rukkattukku iruntha suvarin akalam ainthumuzhamaayirunthathu; aalayaththukku irukkum sut'rukkattuka'lin maa'likaiyilea ve'rumaiyaay vittiruntha idangka'lum appadiyea irunthathu.
aalayaththaich sut'rilum a'raiveeduka'lukku naduvaaka iruntha visaalam irupathu muzhamaayirunthathu.

sut'rukkattinudaiya vaasal nadaika'l, ve'rumaiyaay vittiruntha idangka'lilirunthu, oru vaasal nadai vadakkeayum, oru vaasal nadai the'rkeayum irunthathu; ve'rumaiyaay vittiruntha idangka'lin visaalam sut'rilum ainthu muzhamaayirunthathu.

meat'risaiyilea piraththiyeakamaana idaththukku munniruntha maa'likaimattum akalam ezhupathu muzhamum, maa'likaiyinudaiya suvarin akalam sut'rilum ainthu muzhamum, athinudaiya nee'lam tho'n'noo'ru muzhamumaayirunthathu.
avar aalayaththai noo'ru muzha nee'lamaakavum, piraththiyeakamaana idaththaiyum maa'likaiyaiyum athin suvarka'laiyum noo'ru muzha nee'lamaakavum a'lanthaar.
aalayaththin mu'rpu'ramum kizhakkukku ethiraana piraththiyeakamaana idamum iruntha akalam noo'ru muzhamaayirunthathu.

piraththiyeakamaana idaththin pinpu'ramaaka atha'rku ethirea iruntha maa'likaiyin nee'laththaiyum, atha'rku inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum iruntha nadaikaava'nangka'laiyum a'lanthaar; u'l'laana theavaalayamum mut'raththin ma'ndapangka'lum udpada noo'ru muzhamaayirunthathu.

vaasa'rpadika'lum, odukkamaana jannalka'lum, moon'ru pakkangka'lil sut'rilum vaasalka'lukku ethiraana nadaikaava'nangka'lum sut'rilum tharaithuvakki jannalka'l mattaakap palakai adiththirunthathu; jannalka'l moodappattirunthathu.
vaasalin mealeathuvakki aalayaththin udpu'ramum ve'lippu'ramum sut'rilum suvarin udpu'ramum ve'lippu'ramum ellaam a'lavittirunthathu.

kearupeenka'lum peareechchamarangka'lum siththirikkappattirunthathu; kearupeenukkum kearupeenukkum naduvaaka ovvoru peareechchamaram irunthathu; ovvoru kearupeenukkum ira'ndira'ndu mukangka'l irunthathu.
peareechchamaraththukku intha'ndaiyil manushamukamum, peareechchamaraththukku antha'ndaiyil singkamukamum irunthathu; ippadiyea aalayaththaich sut'rilum seythirunthathu.
tharaithuvakki vaasalin mea'rpu'ramattum, theavaalayaththin suvarilum, kearupeenka'lum peareechchamarangka'lum siththirikkappattirunthathu.
theavaalayaththin kathavu nilaika'l sathuramum, parisuththa sthalaththinudaiya mukappin uruvam antha uruvaththukkuch sariyumaayirunthathu.

maraththinaal seyyappatta palipeedaththin uyaram moon'ru muzhamum, athin nee'lam ira'ndu muzhamumaayirunthathu; athin koadika'lum athin vi'limpuka'lum athin pakkangka'lum maraththinaal seyyappattirunthathu. avar ennai noakki: ithu karththarudaiya sannithiyilirukki'ra peedam en'raar.
theavaalayaththukkum parisuththa sthalaththukkum ira'ndu vaasalka'lum,
vaasalka'lukku madakkuk kathavuka'laakiya irattaik kathavuka'lum irunthathu; oru vaasalukku ira'ndu kathavuka'lum mat'ra vaasalukku ira'ndu kathavuka'lum irunthathu.

suvarka'lil siththirikkappattirunthathupoal aalayaththinudaiya kathavuka'lilum kearupeenka'lum peareechchamarangka'lum siththirikkappattirunthathu; pu'rampea ma'ndapaththin munpaaka uththirangka'l vaiththirunthathu.

ma'ndapaththin pakkangka'lil inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum, aalayaththin sut'rukkattuka'lilum odukkamaana jannalka'lum siththirikkappatta peareechchamarangka'lum uththirangka'lum irunthathu.

pinpu avar ennai vadathisaiyin vazhiyaaka ve'lippiraakaaraththilea pu'rappadappa'n'ni, piraththiyeakamaana idaththukku ethiraakavum, maa'likaikku ethiraakavum vadakkea iruntha a'raiveeduka'lukku ennai azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar.
noo'ru muzha nee'laththukku munnea vadakku vaasal irunthathu; avvidaththu akalam aimpathu muzham.

udpiraakaaraththil iruntha irupathu muzhaththukku ethiraakavum ve'lippiraakaaraththil iruntha tha'lavarisaikku ethiraakavum on'rukkon'ru ethiraana moon'ru nilaika'lu'l'la nadaikaava'nangka'l irunthathu.
udpu'raththilea a'raiveeduka'lin munpaakap paththu muzha akalamaana vazhiyum, oru muzha akalamaana paathaiyum irunthathu; avaika'lin vaasalka'l vadakkea irunthathu.
uyara iruntha a'raiveeduka'l akalakkattaiyaayirunthathu; nadaikaava'nangka'l keezheayirukki'ra a'raiveeduka'lukkum naduveayirukki'ravaika'lukkum athika uyaramaana maa'likaiyaayirunthathu.

avaika'l moon'ru adukkuka'laayirunthathu; piraakaarangka'lin thoo'nka'lukku irunthathupoala, avaika'lukkuth thoo'nka'lillai; aakaiyaal tharaiyilirunthu a'lakka, avaika'l keezheayum naduveayum irukki'ravaika'laippaarkkilum akalakkattaiyaayirunthathu.
pu'rampea a'raiveeduka'lukku ethirea ve'lippiraakaarath thisaiyil a'raiveeduka'lukku munpaaka iruntha mathilin nee'lam aimpathu muzham.
ve'lippiraakaaraththilu'l'la a'raiveeduka'lin nee'lam aimpathu muzham, theavaalayaththukku munnea noo'ru muzhamaayirunthathu.
kizhakkea ve'lippiraakaaraththilirunthu antha a'raiveeduka'lukku'l piraveasikki'ra nadai avaika'lin keezhea irunthathu.
keezhththisaiyaana piraakaaraththu mathilin akalaththilea piraththiyeakamaana idaththukku munpaakavum maa'likaikku munpaakavum a'raiveeduka'lum irunthathu.

avaika'lukku munnaana vazhiyilea antha a'raiveeduka'l nee'laththilum akalaththilum, ellaa vaasa'rpadika'lilum, thittangka'lilum, vaasal nadaika'lilum vadathisaiyaana a'raiveeduka'lin saayalaayirunthathu.

thenthisaiyaana a'raiveeduka'lin vaasal nadaikku oppaaka oru vaasal nadaivazhiyin mukappil irunthathu; keezhththisaiyil avaika'lukkup piraveasikkum idaththilea semmaiyaana mathilin ethirea iruntha vazhiyin mukappil oru vaasalirunthathu.

avar ennai noakki: piraththiyeakamaana idaththukku munnirukki'ra vadapu'ramaana a'raiveeduka'lum, thenpu'ramaana a'raiveeduka'lum, parisuththa a'raiveeduka'laayirukki'rathu; karththaridaththil searuki'ra aasaariyar angkea makaa parisuththamaanathaiyum, poajanapaliyaiyum, paavanivaara'na paliyaiyum, kut'ranivaara'na paliyaiyum vaippaarka'l; antha sthalam parisuththamaayirukki'rathu.

aasaariyar udpiraveasikkumpoathu, avarka'l parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu ve'lippiraakaaraththukku varaathatha'rkumunnea, angkea thaangka'l aaraathanaiseythu, uduththiyiruntha vasthirangka'laik kazhat'rivaippaarka'l; avvasthirangka'l parisuththamaanavaika'l; vea'rea vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'ndu, janaththin piraakaaraththilea poavaarka'l en'raar.
avar u'lveettai a'lanthu theernthapinpu, keezhththisaikku ethiraana vaasalvazhiyaay ennai ve'liyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, athaich sut'rilum a'lanthaar.
keezhththisaip pakkaththai a'lavukoalaal a'lanthaar; athu a'lavukoalinpadiyea sut'rilum ainnoo'ru koalaayirunthathu.
vadathisaippakkaththai a'lavukoalaal sut'rilum ainnoo'ru koalaay a'lanthaar.
thenthisaippakkaththai a'lavukoalaal ainnoo'ru koalaay a'lanthaar.
meat'risaippakkaththukkuth thirumpi athai a'lavukoalaal ainnoo'ru koalaay a'lanthaar.

naalu pakkangka'lilum athai a'lanthaar; parisuththamaanatha'rkum parisuththamillaathatha'rkum viththiyaasampa'n'numpadikku atha'rku ainnoo'ru koal nee'lamum ainnoo'ru koal akalamumaana mathil sut'rilum irunthathu.
pinpu avar ennaik keezhththisaikku ethir vaasalaakiya vaasalukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar.
ithoa, isravealin theavanudaiya makimai keezhththisaiyilirunthu vanthathu; avarudaiya saththam peruve'l'laththin iraichchalaippoala irunthathu; avarudaiya makimaiyinaal poomi pirakaasiththathu.

naan ka'nda inthath tharisanam nakaraththai azhikkavanthapoathu ka'nda tharisanampoala irunthathu; inthath tharisanangka'l keapaar nathiya'ndaiyilea naan ka'ndiruntha tharisanaththaippoalum irunthathu; naan mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthean.
karththarudaiya makimai keezhththisaikku ethiraana vaasalvazhiyaay aalayaththukku'l piraveasiththathu.
appozhuthu aavi ennai eduththu, udpiraakaaraththilea ko'ndupoayvittathu; ithoa, karththarudaiya makimai aalayaththai nirappit'ru.
avar aalayaththilirunthu ennoadea peasuki'rathaik keattean; anthap purushan enna'ndaiyil nin'rirunthaar.

avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ithu naan israveal puththirarin naduvea en'ren'raikkum vaasampa'n'num en singkaasanamum en paathapeedaththin sthaanamumaayirukki'rathu; ini israveal vamsaththaarum avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'lum en parisuththa naamaththaith thangka'l meadaika'lil thangka'l veasiththanaththinaalum thangka'l raajaakka'lin pireathangka'linaalum theettuppaduththuvathillai.

avarka'l enakkum thangka'lukkum naduvea oru suvar irukkumpadi, thangka'l vaasa'rpadiyai en vaasa'rpadiya'ndaiyilum, thangka'l vaasalnilaika'lai en vaasal nilaika'la'ndaiyilum searththu, en parisuththa naamaththaith thaangka'l seytha aruvaruppuka'linaal theettuppaduththinaarka'l; aakaiyaal en koapaththilea avarka'lai naasamaakkinean.
ippozhuthum avarka'l thangka'l veasiththanaththaiyum thangka'l raajaakka'lin pireathangka'laiyum en samukaththinin'ru akat'rinaal naan en'ren'raikkum avarka'l naduvea vaasamaayiruppean.
manupuththiranea, israveal vamsaththaar thangka'l akkiramangka'linimiththam vedkappadumpadikku, nee avarka'lukku intha aalayaththaik kaa'npi; athin a'lavai a'lakkakkadavarka'l.

avarka'l seytha ellaavat'rinimiththamum vedkappattaal, appozhuthu intha aalayaththin roopaththaiyum, athin a'lavaiyum, athin mun vaasalka'laiyum, athin pin vaasalka'laiyum, athin ellaa ozhungkuka'laiyum, athin ellaak katta'laika'laiyum, athin ellaa niyamangka'laiyum, athin ellaach sattangka'laiyum avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththi, avarka'l athinudaiya ellaa ozhungkuka'laiyum, athinudaiya ellaa mu'raimaika'laiyum kaikko'ndu, avaika'linpadi seyyumpadikku athai avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ezhuthivai.
aalayaththinudaiya piramaa'nam ennaven'raal: malaiyuchchiyinmeal sut'rilum athin ellaiyengkum mikavum parisuththamaayirukkum; ithuvea aalayaththinudaiya piramaa'nam.

muzhangka'linpadi a'lakkum palipeedaththin a'lavuka'laavana: oru kai muzhamum naalu vira'rkadaiyum ko'ndathu oru muzhamaakum; athinpadi sut'raathaaram, oru muzha uyaramum, oru muzha akalamum, athin oaraththaich sut'rilumu'l'la vi'limpu oru jaa'numaayirukkum; ithu palipeedaththin mea'rpu'ram.
tharaiyil irukki'ra aathaaranthuvakkik keezhnilaimattum ira'ndumuzhamum, akalam oru muzhamum, sinna nilaithuvakkip periya nilaimattum naalu muzhamum, akalam oru muzhamumaayirukkum.
palipeedaththin sikaram naalu muzha uyaramaayirukkum; palipeedaththin sikaraththukkumealea naalu kompuka'l irukkum.
palipeedaththin sikaram pannira'ndu muzha nee'lamum, pannira'ndu muzha akalamum than naalu pakkangka'lilum naa'rsathuramumaayirukkum.

athin naalu pakkangka'lilu'l'la sattaththin nee'lam pathinaalu muzhamum, akalam pathinaalu muzhamum, athaich sut'rilumirukki'ra vi'limpu arai muzhamum, atha'rku aathaaramaanathu sut'rilum oru muzhamumaayirukkum; athin padika'l kizhakkukku ethiraayirukkum en'raar.

pinnum avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: palipeedaththai u'ndupa'n'num naa'lilea athinmeal thakanapaliyiduki'ratha'rkum athinmeal iraththam the'likki'ratha'rkumaana katta'laika'laavana:

enakku aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rku ennidaththil searuki'ra saathoakkin vamsaththaaraana leavi koaththiraththaaraakiya aasaariyarka'lukku nee paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru i'langkaa'laiyaik koduppaayaaka en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
athin iraththaththil kogncham eduththu, athin naalu kompuka'lilum, sattaththin naalu koadika'lilum, sut'riyirukki'ra vi'limpilum poosi paavanivirththiseythu, athaich suththikariththu,
pinpu paavanivaara'naththin kaa'laiyaik ko'ndupoay, athai aalayaththilea parisuththa sthalaththukkup pu'rampaakak ku'rikkappatta idaththilea sutterikkavea'ndum.

ira'ndaam naa'lilea pazhuthat'ra oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaip paavanivaara'naththukkaakap paliyiduvaayaaka; avarka'l i'langkaa'laiyinaalea palipeedaththaich suththiseythathupoalap paavanivaara'nagn seyyavea'ndum.
nee paavanivaara'naththai mudiththapinpu, pazhuthat'ra oru i'langkaa'laiyaiyum, pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavaiyum manthaiyiliruntheduththup paliyiduvaayaaka.
avaika'laik karththarudaiya sannithiyil paliyiduvaayaaka; aasaariyarka'l avaika'linmeal upputhoovi, avaika'laik karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaaka idakkadavarka'l.

eazhunaa'lvaraikkum thinanthinam paavanivaara'naththukkaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaip padaippaayaaka; pazhuthat'ravaika'laana i'langkaa'laiyaiyum manthaiyiliruntheduththa aattukkadaavaiyum padaippaarka'laaka.
eazhunaa'lvaraikkum palipeedaththaip paavanivirththiseythu, athaich suththikariththu, pirathishdaipa'n'nakkadavarka'l.

annaadka'l mudinthapinpu, ettaam naa'lmuthal aasaariyarka'l palipeedaththinmeal ungka'l thakanapalika'laiyum ungka'l sthoaththirapalika'laiyum padaippaarka'laaka; appozhuthu ungka'lai angkeekarippean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
pinpu, avar ennaik kizhakkukku ethirea parisuththa sthalaththukkup pu'ravaasal vazhiyea thirumpappa'n'ninaar; athu poottappattirunthathu.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: intha vaasal thi'rakkappadaamal poottappattirukkum; oruvarum itha'rku'l piraveasippathillai; isravealin theavanaakiya karththar itha'rku'l piraveasiththaar, aakaiyaal ithu poottappattirukkavea'ndum.

ithu athipathikkea uriyathu, athipathi karththarudaiya sannithiyil poajanampa'n'numpadi ithil udkaaruvaan; avan vaasal ma'ndapaththin vazhiyaayp piraveasiththu, ma'rupadiyum athin vazhiyaayp pu'rappaduvaan en'raar.

pinpu avar ennai vadakku vaasalvazhiyaay aalayaththin mukappilea azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, karththarudaiya aalayam karththarudaiya makimaiyaal ni'rainthathai naan ka'ndu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthean.

appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, karththarudaiya aalayaththin sakala niyamangka'laiyum athin sakala sattangka'laiyungku'riththu naan unnoadea solvathaiyellaam nee un manathilea kavaniththu, un ka'nka'linaalea paarththu, un kaathuka'linaalea keattu, parisuththa sthalaththinudaiya ellaa vaasa'rpadika'lin vazhiyaay aalayaththukku'l piraveasippathum athilirunthu pu'rappaduvathum innavithamen'ru nee aaloasiththup paarththu,
israveal vamsaththaaraakiya kalakakkaararoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththaraakiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar, israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l seytha sakala aruvaruppuka'lum poathum.

neengka'l enakkuch seluththavea'ndiya aakaaramaakiya ni'naththaiyum iraththaththaiyum seluththukaiyil, en aalayaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkumpadi viruththaseathanamillaatha iruthayamum viruththaseathanamillaatha maamsamumu'l'la anniya puththirarai en parisuththa sthalaththukku'l irukki'ratha'rkaaka azhaiththukko'nduvantheerka'l; neengka'l seytha ellaa aruvaruppuka'linaalum avarka'l en udanpadikkaiyai mee'rinaarka'l.
neengka'l en parisuththa vasthukka'lin kaavalaik kaavaamal, ungka'lukku ishdamaanavarka'lai en parisuththa sthalaththilea en kaavalaik kaakki'ratha'rkaaka vaiththeerka'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: israveal puththirarin naduvil irukki'ra sakala anniya puththirarilum, viruththaseathanamillaatha iruthayamum viruththaseathanamillaatha maamsamumu'l'la anniya puththiran oruvanum en parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasippathillai.

israveal vazhithappippoakaiyil, ennaivittuth thooramaanavarka'lum, ennaivittu vazhithappith thangka'l narakalaana vikkirakangka'laip pinpat'rinavarka'lumaakiya leaviyarum thangka'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarka'l.

aakilum avarka'l en aalayaththin vaasalka'laik kaaththu, en aalayaththil oozhiyagnseythu, en parisuththa sthalaththilea pa'nividaikkaararaayiruppaarka'l; avarka'l janangka'lukkaakath thakanapalika'laiyum mat'rap palika'laiyum seluththi, ivarka'lukku oozhiyagnseyki'ratha'rku ivarka'l munpaaka en parisuththa sthalaththilea pa'nividaikkaararaayiruppaarka'l.

avarka'l ivarka'ludaiya narakalaana vikkirakangka'lukku munpaaka nin'ru ivarka'lukku oozhiyagnseythu, israveal vamsaththaarai akkiramaththil vizhappa'n'ninapadiyinaal, naan en kaiyai avarka'lukku viroathamaay uyarththinean, avarka'l thangka'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

avarka'l enakku aasaariyaraay aaraathanai seyyumpadi en sameepaththil varaamalum, makaa parisuththamaana sthalaththil en parisuththa vasthukka'lil yaathon'raiyum kittaamalum irukkavea'ndum, avarka'l thangka'l ilachchaiyaiyum thaangka'l seytha aruvaruppuka'laiyum sumakkakkadavarka'l.
aalayaththin sakala vealaika'lukkum athil seyyappadavea'ndiya ellaavat'ri'rkum naan avarka'lai athil kaavalkaakki'ravarka'laayirukkak katta'laiyiduvean.

israveal puththirarea, ennaivittu vazhithappippoakaiyil, en parisuththa sthalaththin kaavalaik kaakki'ra saathoakkin puththiraraakiya leaviyarennum aasaariyarka'lea enakku aaraathanaiseyya en sameepaththil searnthu, ni'naththaiyum iraththaththaiyum enakkuch seluththa en sannithiyil ni'rpaarka'len'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
ivarka'l en parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasippaarka'l; ivarka'lea enakku aaraathanai seyya en peedaththaik kittivanthu, en kaavalaik kaappaarka'l.

udpiraakaaraththin vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasikki'rapoathu, sa'nalnool vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'lvaarka'laaka; avarka'l udpiraakaaraththin vaasalka'lilum, u'l'leayum aaraathanai seykaiyil, aattumayir uduppaith tharikkalaakaathu.
avarka'ludaiya thalaika'lil sa'nalnool kullaakka'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya idaika'lil sa'nalnool salladangka'laiyum tharikkavea'ndum; vearvaiyu'ndaakkaththakkathon'raiyum araiyil kattalaakaathu.

avarka'l ve'lippiraakaaramaakiya pu'ramut'raththilea janangka'lidaththil poakumpoathu, avarka'l thaangka'l aaraathanaiseyyum samayaththil uduththiyiruntha thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kazhat'ri, avaika'laip parisuththa a'raiveeduka'lil vaiththu, vea'rea vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'l'lakkadavarka'l; thangka'l vasthirangka'laalea janangka'laip parisuththappaduththalaakaathu.
avarka'l thangka'l thalaika'laich siraiyaamalum, thangka'l mayirai nee'lamaay va'larkkaamalum, thangka'l thalaimayiraik kaththarikkakkadavarka'l.
aasaariyarka'lil oruvanum, udpiraakaaraththukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu, thiraadcharasam kudikkalaakaathu.
vithavaiyaiyum tha'l'lividappattava'laiyum avarka'l vivaakampa'n'naamal, israveal vamsaththaa'laakiya kannikaiyaiyaakilum oru aasaariyanin manaiviyaayiruntha vithavaiyaiyaakilum vivaakampa'n'nalaam.

avarka'l parisuththamaanatha'rkum parisuththamallaathatha'rkum, theettaanatha'rkum theettallaathatha'rkum irukkum viththiyaasaththai en janaththukkup poathiththu, avarka'lukkuth theriyappa'n'nakkadavarka'l.

vazhakkirunthaal avarka'l niyaayantheerkka aayaththamaayirunthu, en niyaayangka'linpadi athaith theerththu, ennudaiya pa'ndikaika'lil ellaam en niyaayappiramaa'naththaiyum en katta'laika'laiyum kaikko'ndu, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththamaakkakkadavarka'l.

thakappan, thaay, kumaaran, kumaaraththi, sakoatharan, purushanukku vaazhkkaippadaatha sakoathari ennum ivarka'ludaiya savaththinaal avarka'l theettuppadalaameayallaamal, avarka'lil oruvanum seththa oruvanidaththil poayth theettuppadalaakaathu.
avan suththikarikkappattapinpu, avanukku eazhunaa'l e'n'nappadavea'ndum.

avan parisuththa sthalaththil aaraathanai seyyumpadi parisuththa sthalam irukki'ra udpiraakaaraththukku'l piraveasikki'ranaa'lilea, avan thanakkaakap paavanivaara'na paliyaich seluththakkadavan en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
avarka'lukkuriya suthantharam ennaven'raal: naanea avarka'l suthantharam; aakaiyaal isravealil avarka'lukkuk kaa'niyaadchiyaik kodaathiruppeerka'laaka; naanea avarka'l kaa'niyaadchi.
poajanapaliyaiyum paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum kut'ranivaara'napaliyaiyum avarka'l pusippaarka'l; isravealilea poruththanai pa'n'nappattathellaam avarka'ludaiyathaayiruppathaaka.

sakalavitha mutha'rkanika'lil ellaam munthina palanum, neengka'l kaa'nikkaiyaaych seluththum evvithamaana poru'lka'lum aasaariyarka'ludaiyathaayiruppathaaka; ungka'l veettil aaseervaatham thangkumpadikku neengka'l pisainthamaavil mutha'rpaakaththaiyum aasaariyanukkuk kodukkakkadaveerka'l.
pa'ravaika'lilum mirukangka'lilum thaanaaych seththathum pee'ru'ndathumaana on'raiyum aasaariyarka'l pusikkalaakaathu.

neengka'l suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi theasaththaich seettuppoattup pangkidumpoathu, theasaththil irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum, pathinaayirangkoal akalamumaana parisuththa pangkaik karththarukku arppithamaakap piriththu vaikkakkadaveerka'l; ithu than sut'rellai engkum parisuththamaayirukkum.
ithilea parisuththa sthalaththukken'ru ainnoo'ru koal nee'lamum ainnoo'ru koal akalamumaana naa'rsathuram a'lakkappadakkadavathu; atha'rkuch sut'rilum aimpathu muzhamaana ve'linilam irukkavea'ndum.
intha a'lavu udpada irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'laththaiyum pathinaayirangkoal akalaththaiyum a'lappaayaaka; atha'rku'l parisuththa sthalamum makaa parisuththa sthalamum irukkavea'ndum.

theasaththil parisuththa pangkaakiya ithu karththarukku aaraathanaiseyyach searuki'ravarka'lum, parisuththa sthalaththil aaraathanai seyki'ravarka'lumaana aasaariyarudaiyathu; ithu avarka'lukku veeduka'lukkaana idamum, parisuththa sthalaththukku aduththa idamumaayirukkavea'ndum.

pinnum irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum pathinaayirangkoal akalamumaana idam aalayaththin pa'nividaikkaararaakiya leaviyarudaiyathaayirukkum; athu avarka'ludaiya kaa'niyaadchi; athil irupathu a'raiveeduka'l irukkavea'ndum.

parisuththa pangkaakap padaikkappattatha'rku ethirea nakaraththin kaa'niyaadchiyaaka aiyaayirangkoal akalaththaiyum irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'laththaiyum a'lanthu koduppeerka'laaka; athu israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum sonthamaayirukkum.

parisuththa pangkaakap padaikkappattatha'rkum nakaraththin kaa'niyaadchikkum inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum, parisuththa padaippukku munpaakavum, nakaraththin kaa'nikku munpaakavum, athipathiyinudaiya pangku mea'rkilea mea'rpu'ramaakavum kizhakkilea keezhppu'ramaakavum iruppathaaka; athin nee'lam meal ellai thuvakkik keezh ellaimattum pangkuka'lil ovvon'rukkum ethiraayirukkavea'ndum.

ithu avanukku isravealilea kaa'nipoomiyaaka irukkakkadavathu; en athipathika'l ini en janaththai odukkaamal theasaththai israveal vamsaththaarukku avarka'ludaiya koaththirangka'lukkuththakkathaaka vittuviduvaarka'laaka.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: isravealin athipathika'lea, neengka'l seythathupoathum; neengka'l kodumaiyaiyum ko'l'laiyiduthalaiyum thavirththu, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyyungka'l; ungka'l uththa'ndangka'lai en janaththaivittu akat'rungka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
sumuththiraiyaana tharaasum, sumuththiraiyaana marakkaalum, sumuththiraiyaana a'lavukudamum ungka'lukku irukkakkadavathu.

marakkaalum a'lavukudamum orea a'lavaayirunthu, marakkaal kalaththilea paththil oru pangkum, a'lavukudam kalaththilea paththil oru pangkum pidikkakkadavathu; kalaththinpadiyea athin a'lavu niru'nayikkappaduvathaaka.
seakkalaanathu irupathu kearaa; irupathu seakkalum irupaththainthu seakkalum pathinainthu seakkalum ungka'lukku oru iraaththalaakum.

neengka'l seluththavea'ndiya kaa'nikkaiyaavathu: oru kalam koathumaiyilea oru marakkaalil aa'riloru pangkaiyum, oru kalam vaa'rkoathumaiyilea oru marakkaalil aa'rilorupangkaiyum padaikkakkadaveerka'l.

a'lavukudaththaal a'lakki'ra e'n'neyin katta'laiyaavathu: paththukkudam pidikki'ra kalaththukkuch sariyaana oru jaadi e'n'neyilea paththil oru pangkaip padaippeerka'laaka; paththu a'lavukudam oru kalamaakum.

israveal theasaththilea nallameaychchalai meayki'ra manthaiyilea irunoo'ru aaduka'lil oru aadum, avarka'ludaiya paavanivaara'naththi'rkaakap poajanapaliyaakavum thakanapaliyaakavum samaathaanapaliyaakavum seluththappadakkadavathen'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
isravealin athipathikku munpaakath theasaththin janangka'lellaarum inthak kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'raarka'l.

israveal vamsaththaar koodivarak ku'rikkappatta sakala pa'ndikaika'lilum maathappi'rappuka'lilum oayvunaadka'lilum thakanapalika'laiyum poajanapalika'laiyum paanapalika'laiyum seluththuvathu athipathiyinmeal sumantha kadanaayirukkum; avan israveal vamsaththaarukkaakap paavanivaara'nampa'n'numpadikkup paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum thakanapaliyaiyum samaathaanapaliyaiyum padaippaanaaka.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: muthalaam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea nee pazhuthat'ra oru kaa'laiyaik ko'nduvanthu, parisuththa sthalaththukkup paavanivirththi seyvaayaaka.

paavanivaara'napaliyin iraththaththilea kogncham aasaariyan eduththu, aalayaththin vaasal nilaika'lilum, palipeedaththuch sattaththin naalu koadika'lilum, udpiraakaaraththin vaasalnilaika'lilum poosakkadavan.
pizhaiseythavanukkaakavum, a'riyaamal thappitham seythavanukkaakavum anthappirakaaramaaka eazhaantheathiyilum seyvaayaaka; ivvithamaay aalayaththukkup paavanivarththi seyvaayaaka.
muthalaam maatham pathinaalaantheathiyilea pu'lippillaatha appam pusikkappaduki'ra eazhunaa'l pa'ndikaiyaakiya paskaa aarampamaakum.
annaa'lilea athipathi thannimiththamum theasaththu ellaa janangka'linimiththamum paavanivaara'naththukkaaka oru kaa'laiyaip padaippaanaaka.

eazhunaa'l pa'ndikaiyil, avan antha eazhunaa'lum thinanthoa'rum karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakap pazhuthat'ra eazhu kaa'laika'laiyum eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum, paavanivaara'napaliyaaka oru ve'l'laattukkadaavaiyum thinanthoa'rum padaippaanaaka.
