ovvoru kaa'laiyoadea oru marakkaal maavum ovvoru aattukkadaavoadea oru marakkaal maavumaana poajanapaliyaiyum, ovvoru marakkaal maavoadea orupadi e'n'neyaiyum padaippaanaaka.

eazhaam maatham pathinainthaantheathiyil aarampamaaki'ra pa'ndikaiyilea avan appadiyea eazhunaa'lum atha'rkuch sariyaanapirakaaramaakap paavanivaara'napalika'laiyum thakanapalika'laiyum poajanapalika'laiyum, e'n'neyaiyum padaikkakkadavan.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: vealaiseyki'ra aa'runaa'lilum kizhakkukku ethiraana udpiraakaaraththinudaiya vaasal poottappattirunthu, oayvunaa'lilum maathappi'rappilum thi'rakkappadakkadavathu.

appozhuthu athipathi ve'livaasal ma'ndapaththin vazhiyaayp piraveasiththu, vaasal nilaiya'ndaiyilea ni'rkakkadavan; aasaariyarka'loa avanudaiya thakanapaliyaiyum, avanudaiya samaathaana palika'laiyum padaikkakkadavarka'l; avan vaasa'rpadiyilea aaraathanaiseythu, pinpu pu'rappaduvaanaaka; antha vaasal saayangkaalamattum poottappadaathiruppathaaka.
theasaththu janangka'lum oayvunaadka'lilum maathappi'rappuka'lilum antha vaasalin nadaiyilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil aaraathanai seyyakkadavarka'l.
athipathi oayvunaa'lilea karththarukkup paliyidum thakanapali, pazhuthat'ra aa'ru aattukkuttika'lum pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkadaavumea.

aattukkadaavoadea poajanapaliyaaka oru marakkaal maavaiyum, aattukkuttika'loadea poajanapaliyaakath than thiraa'nikkuththakkathaayth tharuki'ra eevaiyum, ovvoru marakkaal maavoadea orupadi e'n'neyaiyum padaikkakkadavan.
maathappi'rappaana naa'liloa, avan pazhuthat'ra oru i'langkaa'laiyaiyum, pazhuthat'ra aa'ru aattukkuttika'laiyum, oru aattukkadaavaiyum paliyittu,

poajanapaliyaaka i'langkaa'laiyoadea oru marakkaal maavaiyum, aattukkadaavoadea oru marakkaal maavaiyum, aattukkuttika'loadea than thiraa'nikkuththakkathaay, ovvoru marakkaal maavoadea orupadi e'n'neyaiyum padaikkakkadavan.
athipathi varuki'rapoathu vaasal ma'ndapaththin vazhiyaayp piraveasiththu, athu vazhiyaayth thirumpap pu'rappadakkadavan.

theasaththin janangka'l ku'rikkappatta naadka'lil karththarudaiya sannithiyil varumpoathu, aaraathanai seyki'ratha'rkaaka vadakku vaasalvazhiyaay udpiraveasiththavan the'rku vaasal vazhiyaayp pu'rappadavum, the'rku vaasalvazhiyaay udpiraveasiththavan vadakku vaasalvazhiyaayp pu'rappadavumkadavan; thaan piraveasiththa vaasalvazhiyaayth thirumpippoakaamal, thanakku ethiraana vazhiyaayp pu'rappattuppoavaanaaka.
avarka'l udpiraveasikkumpoathu, athipathi avarka'l naduvilea avarka'loadeakooda udpiraveasiththu, avarka'l pu'rappadumpoathu avanum koodap pu'rappaduvaanaaka.

pa'ndikaika'lilum ku'rikkappatta kaalangka'lilum avan padaikkum poajanapaliyaavathu: kaa'laiyoadea oru marakkaal maavum, aattukkadaavoadea oru marakkaal maavum, aattukkuttika'loadea avan thiraa'nikkuththakkathaayth tharuki'ra oru eevum, ovvoru marakkaal maavoadea orupadi e'n'neyum kodukkavea'ndum.

athipathi u'rchaakamaana thakanapaliyaakilum, samaathaana palika'laiyaakilum karththarukku u'rchaakamaaych seluththavea'ndumen'raal, avanukkuk kizhakku noakkiya ethiraana vaasal thi'rakkappaduvathaaka; appozhuthu avan oayvunaa'lil seyki'rathupoala, than thakanapaliyaiyum than samaathaana paliyaiyum seluththi, pinpu pu'rappadakkadavan; avan pu'rappattapinpu vaasal poottappadavea'ndum.
thinanthoa'rum oru vayathaana pazhuthat'ra oru aattukkuttiyaik karththarukkuth thakanapaliyaakap padaikkakkadavaay; kaalaithoa'rum athaippadaikkavea'ndum.

athinoadea kaalaithoa'rum poajanapaliyaaka oru marakkaal maavilea aa'raththoru pangkaiyum, melliya maavaip pisaiyumpadikku orupadi e'n'neyilea moon'raththoru pangkaiyum padaikkakkadavaay; ithu an'raadam karththarukkup padaikkavea'ndiya niththiya katta'laiyaana poajanapali.
ippadik kaalaithoa'rum an'raada thakanapaliyaaka aattukkuttiyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum e'n'neyaiyum seluththuvaarka'laaka.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: athipathi than kumaararil oruvanukkuth than suthantharaththil oru pangkaik koduththaal, athu avan kumaararudaiyathaayirukkum; athu suthantharaveethamaay avarka'lukkuch sonthamaakum.

avan than oozhiyakkaararil oruvanukkuth than suthantharaththil oru pangkaik koduththaaneayaakil, athu viduthalaiyin varushamattum avanudaiyathaayirunthu, pinpu thirumpa athipathiyin vasamaaych searum; athin suthantharam avan kumaararukkea uriyathu, athu avarka'ludaiyathaayirukkum.

athipathiyaanavan janaththai idukka'n seythu, avarka'lin sonthamaanatha'rku avarka'laip pu'rampaakki, avarka'ludaiya suthantharaththilirunthu on'rum edukkalaakaathu; en janaththil oruvarum thangka'l sonthamaanatha'rkup pu'rampaakkappattuch sitha'radikkappadaathapadikku avan than sonthaththilea than kumaararukkuch suthantharam kodukkakkadavan.

pinpu avar vaasalin pakkaththil iruntha nadaivazhiyaay ennai vadakkukku ethiraana aasaariyarka'ludaiya parisuththa a'raiveeduka'lukku azhaiththukko'ndupoanaar; avvidaththil mea'rkea irupu'raththilum oru idam irunthathu.

avar ennai noakki: kut'ranivaara'napaliyaiyum paavanivaara'napaliyaiyum poajanapaliyaiyum aasaariyarka'l ve'lippiraakaaraththilea ko'ndupoay janangka'laip parisuththampa'n'naathapadikku, avarka'l avaika'laich samaikki'ratha'rkum suduki'ratha'rkumaana sthalam ithuvea en'raar.
pinpu avar ennai ve'lippiraakaaraththil azhaiththukko'ndupoay, ennaip piraakaaraththin naalu moolaika'laiyum kadanthupoakappa'n'ninaar; piraakaaraththu ovvoru moolaiyilum ovvoru mut'ram irunthathu.

piraakaaraththin naalu moolaika'lilum pukaiththuvaarangka'lu'l'la intha mut'rangka'l naa'rpathu muzha nee'lamum, muppathu muzha akalamumaanavaika'l; intha naalu moolai mut'rangka'lukkum orea a'lavu irunthathu.
intha naalukkum sut'rilum u'l'lea oru sut'rukkattu u'ndaayirunthathu; inthach sut'rukkattuka'lin sut'rilum aduppuka'l poadappattirunthathu.
avar ennai noakki: ivaika'l janangka'l idum palika'lai aalayaththin pa'nividaikkaarar samaikki'ra veeduka'l en'raar.

pinpu avar ennai aalayaththin vaasalukkuth thirumpivarappa'n'ninaar; ithoa, vaasa'rpadiyin keezhirunthu tha'n'neer pu'rappattuk kizhakkea oaduki'rathaayirunthathu; aalayaththin mukappu kizhakku noakkiyirunthathu; anthath tha'n'neer aalayaththin valathupu'ramaayp palipeedaththukkuth the'rkea paaynthathu.

avar ennai vadakku vaasal vazhiyaayp pu'rappadappa'n'ni, ennai ve'liyilea keezhththisaikku ethiraana pu'ravaasalmattum sut'ri nadaththikko'ndupoanaar; angkea tha'n'neer valathupu'raththilirunthu paayki'rathaayirunthathu.
anthap purushan thamathu kaiyil noolaip pidiththukko'ndu, kizhakkea pu'rappadukaiyil aayiramuzham a'lanthu, ennaith tha'n'neeraik kadakkappa'n'ninaar; tha'n'neer ka'nukkaal a'lavaayirunthathu.

pinnum avar aayiramuzham a'lanthu, ennaith tha'n'neeraik kadakkappa'n'ninaar; angkea tha'n'neer muzhangkaal a'lavaayirunthathu; pinnum avar aayiramuzham a'lanthu ennaik kadakkappa'n'ninaar; angkea tha'n'neer iduppa'lavaayirunthathu.
pinnum avar aayiramuzham a'lanthaar; angkea athu naan kadakkakkoodaatha nathiyaayirunthathu; tha'n'neer neechchaazhamum kadakkamudiyaatha nathiyumaayirunthathu.
avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ithaik ka'ndaayaa en'ru solli, ennai nathiyoaramaayth thirumpa nadaththikko'ndupoanaar.
naan nadanthuvarukaiyil, ithoa, nathiyoaraththil ikkaraiyilum akkaraiyilum veku thira'laana virudchangka'l irunthathu.
avar ennai noakki: inthath tha'n'neer kizhakkutheasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoay, vanaantharavazhiyaay oadi kadalil vizhum; ithu kadalil paaynthu, vizhunthapinpu, athin tha'n'neer aaroakkiyamaakum.

sampavippathu ennaven'raal, intha nathi poakumidamengkum sagncharikkum jeevapiraa'nika'l yaavum pizhaikkum; inthath tha'n'neer angkea vanthapadiyinaal veku earaa'lamaana machchangka'lum u'ndaayirukkum; intha nathi poakumidamengkumu'l'la yaavum aaroakkiyappattup pizhaikkum.

appozhuthu enkeathithuvakki eneklaayimmattum meenpidikki'ravarka'l athin karaiyilea ni'rpaarka'l; athellaam valaika'lai virikki'ra sthalamaayirukkum; athin machchangka'l periya samuththiraththin machchangka'laippoalap pala jaathiyum makaa earaa'lamumaayirukkum.
aanaalum athinudaiya u'laiyaana pa'l'langka'lum athinudaiya madukka'lum aaroakkiyamaakaamal, uppaakavea vittuvidappadum.

nathiyoaramaay athin ikkaraiyilum akkaraiyilum pusippukkaana sakalavitha virudchangka'lum va'larum; avaika'lin ilaika'l uthirvathumillai, avaika'lin kanika'l keduvathumillai; avaika'lukkup paayum tha'n'neer parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu paayki'rapadiyinaal maathanthoa'rum puthukkanika'laik koduththukko'ndeayirukkum; avaika'lin kanika'l pusippukkum, avaika'lin ilaika'l avizhthaththukkumaanavaika'l.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l isravealin pannira'ndu koaththirangka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndu ku'rikkavea'ndiya ellaiyaavathu: yoaseappukku ira'ndu pangku u'ndu.

sakoatharanoadea sakoatharanukkuch saripangku u'ndaaka athaich suthanthariththukko'l'lakkadaveerka'l; athai ungka'l pithaakka'lukkuk koduppean en'ru naan aa'naiyittuk koduththean; aakaiyaal ungka'lukku inthath theasam suthantharamaakak kidaikkum.
theasaththin ellaiyaavathu: vadapu'ram periya samuththiranthuvakki, seathaathukkup poaki'ra ethloan vazhiyaayirukki'ra,
aamaaththum, pearoththaavum, thamaskuvin ellaikkum aamaaththin ellaikkum naduvaana sipraayimum, aapraanin ellaiyoadea searntha aathsaar aththeekoanumaanathu.
appadiyea samuththiraththilirunthu poaki'ra ellai aathsaareanaanum, thamaskuvin ellaiyum, vadamoolaiyaana vadakkum aamaaththin ellaiyumaanathu; ithu vadapu'ram.

keezhppu'raththai aapraanukkum thamaskuvukkum naduvaakavum, keeleayaaththukkum yoarthaanin oaramaana israveal theasaththukkum naduvaakavum keezhkkadalmattum irukkum ellaiyaay a'lappeerka'laaka; ithu keezhppu'ram.

thenmoolaiyaana thenpu'ram thaamaar thuvakki, kaatheasilu'l'la sa'ndaimoottuthalin tha'n'neerka'lmattaakavum, aa'rumattaakavum, periya samuththiramattaakavum iruppathu; ithu thenmoolaiyaana thenpu'ram.
mea'rpu'ram antha ellaithuvakki aamaaththukku ethiraaka vanthu searumattum irukki'ra periya samuththiramea; ithu mea'rpu'ram.
inthath theasaththai neengka'l israveal koaththirangka'linpadiyea ungka'lukku'l'lea pangkittukko'lveerka'laaka.

ungka'lukkum, ungka'lukku'l'lea thangki ungka'lukku'l'lea pi'l'laika'laip pe'ruki'ra anniyarka'lukkum, neengka'l athaich seettuppoattuch suthantharamaakkikko'lveerka'laaka; ivarka'l ungka'lukku israveal puththiraril pi'ranthavarka'laippoala irunthu, ungka'loadeakooda israveal koaththirangka'lin naduvea suthantharaththukku udanpaduvaarka'laaka.
anniyan enthak koaththiraththoadea thangkiyirukki'raanoa, athilea avanudaiya suthantharaththai avanukkuk kodukkakkadaveerka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

koaththirangka'lin naamangka'laavana: vadamunaithuvakki aamaaththukkuppoaki'ra ethloan vazhiyin oaraththukkum, aathsaareanaanukkum, aamaaththarukea vadakkeayirukki'ra thamaskuvin ellaikkum u'l'laakak keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum thaa'nukku oru pangkum,
thaa'nin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum aasearukku oru pangkum,
aasearin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum napthalikku oru pangkum,
napthaliyin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum manaaseakku oru pangkum,
manaaseayin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum eppiraayeemukku oru pangkum,
eppiraayeemin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum roopanukku oru pangkum,
roopanin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum yoothaavukku oru pangkum u'ndaavathaaka.

yoothaavin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum neengka'l arppithamaakkavea'ndiya pangku irukkum; athu, irupaththaiyaayirangkoal akalamum, keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum irukki'ra pangkuka'lil ovvon'rukkum sariyaana nee'lamumaam; parisuththa sthalam athin naduvilea iruppathaaka.
ithilea karththarukku neengka'l arppithamaakkavea'ndiya pangku irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum, pathinaayirangkoal akalamumaayiruppathaaka.

vadakkea irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum, mea'rkea pathinaayirangkoal akalamum, kizhakkea pathinaayirangkoal akalamum, the'rkea irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamumaakiya inthap parisuththa arppithanilamaanathu aasaariyarudaiyathaayirukkum; karththarudaiya parisuththa sthalam athin naduvilea iruppathaaka.

israveal puththirar vazhithappippoakaiyil, leaviyar vazhithappippoanathupoala vazhithappippoakaamal, en kaavalaik kaaththukko'nda saathoakkin puththiraraakiya parisuththamaakkappatta aasaariyarka'lukku athu uriyathaakum.
appadiyea theasaththil arppithamaakkappaduki'rathilea makaa parisuththamaana pangku avarka'lukku leaviyarudaiya ellaiyarukea iruppathaaka.

aasaariyarin ellaikku ethiraaka leaviyar adaiyum pangku irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum, pathinaayirangkoal akalamumaayirukkavea'ndum; nee'lam irupaththaiyaayirangkoalum, akalam pathinaayirangkoalumaayiruppathaaka.
avarka'l athil on'raiyum vi'rkavum theasaththin muthal vi'laivai maat'ravum mat'ravarka'lukkuk kodukkavum thakaathu; athu karththarukkup parisuththamaanathu.

irupaththaiyaayirangkoalukku ethiraaka akalaththil meethiyaayirukkum aiyaayirangkoaloaven'raal, parisuththamaayiraamal, kudiyea'rum nakaraththukkum ve'linilangka'lukkum vidavea'ndum; nakaram athin naduvil iruppathaaka.

athin a'lavuka'laavana: vadapu'ram naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koalum, thenpu'ram naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koalum, keezhppu'ram naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koalum, mea'rpu'ram naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koalumaam.
nakaraththin ve'linilangka'l vadakkea irunoot'raimpathu koalum, the'rkea irunoot'raimpathu koalum, kizhakkea irunoot'raimpathu koalum, mea'rkea irunoot'raimpathu koalumaayiruppathaaka.

parisuththa arppithanilaththukku ethiraaka nee'laththil meethiyaanathu kizhakkea pathinaayirangkoalum mea'rkea pathinaayirangkoalumaam; athu parisuththa arppithanilaththukku ethiraayirukkum; athin varumaanam nakaraththi'rkaaka oozhiyagnseyki'ravarka'lukku aakaaramaayiruppathaaka.
isravealin sakala koaththirangka'lilumirunthu ku'rikkappatta silar nakaraththi'rkaakap pa'nividai seyvaarka'l.

arppithanilamanaiththum irupaththaiyaayirangkoal nee'lamum, irupaththaiyaayirangkoal akalamumaay irukkakkadavathu; patta'naththin kaa'ni udpada inthap parisuththa arppithanilam sathuramaay irukkavea'ndum.

parisuththa arppithanilaththukkum nakaraththin kaa'nikkum inthappu'raththilum anthappu'raththilum, arppithanilaththinudaiya irupaththaiyaayirangkoalin munpaakak kizhakku ellaimattukkum, mea'rkilea irupaththaiyaayirangkoalin munpaaka mea'rku ellaimattukkum meethiyaayiruppathu athipathiyinudaiyathu; pangkuka'lukku ethiraana athu athipathiyinudaiyathaayiruppathaaka; atha'rku naduvaakap parisuththa arppithanilamum aalayaththin parisuththa sthalamum irukkum.
athipathiyinudaiyatha'rku naduveayirukkum leaviyarin kaa'nithuvakkiyum nakaraththin kaa'nithuvakkiyum, yoothaavin ellaikkum penyameenin ellaikkum naduveayirukki'rathu athipathiyinudaiyathu.
mat'rak koaththirangka'lukku u'ndaakum pangkuka'laavana: keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum penyameenukku oru pangkum,
penyameen ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum simiyoanukku oru pangkum,
simiyoanin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum isakkaarukku oru pangkum,
isakkaarin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum sepuloanukku oru pangkum,
sepuloanin ellaiyarukea keezhththisai thuvakki meat'risaimattum kaaththukku oru pangkum u'ndaayiruppathaaka.
kaaththin ellaiyarukea thenmoolaiyaakiya the'rku ellai, thaamaarthuvakki kaatheasilu'l'la sa'ndaimoottuthalin tha'n'neerka'l mattaakavum periya samuththiramattaakavum poakum.
suthantharikkumpadi ithuvea neengka'l israveal koaththirangka'lukkuch seettuppoattup pangkidum theasam, ivaika'lea avarka'lin pangkuka'l en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
nakaraththinin'ru pu'rappadum vazhika'laavana: vadapu'raththilea naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koalaakiya a'lavu'ndaayirukkum.

nakaraththin vaasalka'l, israveal koaththirangka'ludaiya naamangka'linpadiyea peyar pe'rakkadavathu; vadakkea roopanukku oru vaasal, yoothaavukku oru vaasal, leavikku oru vaasal, aaka moon'ru vaasalka'l iruppathaaka.
keezhppu'raththilea naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koal, athil yoaseappukku oru vaasal, penyameenukku oru vaasal, thaa'nukku oru vaasal, aaka moon'ru vaasalka'l iruppathaaka.
thenpu'raththilea naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koal, athil simiyoanukku oru vaasal, isakkaarukku oru vaasal, sepuloanukku oru vaasal, aaka moon'ru vaasalka'l iruppathaaka.
mea'rpu'raththilea naalaayiraththainnoo'ru koal, athil kaaththukku oru vaasal, aasearukku oru vaasal, napthalikku oru vaasal, aaka moon'ru vaasalka'l iruppathaaka.
sut'rilum athin a'lavu pathine'n'naayirangkoalaakum; annaa'l muthal nakaram yeakoavaa shammaa ennum peyarpe'rum.
yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeem arasaa'nda moon'raam varushaththilea paapiloanin raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar erusaleamukku vanthu, athai mut'rikkaipoattaan.

appozhuthu aa'ndavar yoothaavin raajaavaakiya yoayaakkeemaiyum theavanudaiya aalayaththin paaththirangka'lil silavat'raiyum avan kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avan anthap paaththirangka'laich sineayaar theasaththilu'l'la than theavanudaiya koavilukkuk ko'ndupoay, avaika'laith than theavanudaiya pa'ndasaalaikku'l vaiththaan.

appozhuthu israveal puththirarukku'l'lea raajakulaththaarka'lilum thuraimakka'lilum yaathoru maasum illaathavarka'lum, azhakaanavarka'lum, sakala gnaanaththilum thea'rinavarka'lum, a'rivil si'ranthavarka'lum, kalviyil nipu'narum, raajaavin aramanaiyilea seavikkath thi'ramaiyu'l'lavarka'lumaakiya sila vaaliparaik ko'nduvaravum,
avarka'lukkuk kaltheayarin ezhuththaiyum paashaiyaiyum kat'rukkodukkavum raajaa than pirathaanika'lin thalaivanaakiya aspeanaasukkuk ka'rpiththaan.

raajaa, thaan u'n'num poajanaththileayum thaan kudikkum thiraadcharasaththileayum thinam oru pangkai avarka'lukku niyamiththu, avarka'lai moon'ruvarusham va'larkkavum, athin mudivilea avarka'l raajaavukku munpaaka ni'rkumpadi seyyavum katta'laiyittaan.
avarka'lukku'l yoothaa puththiraraakiya thaaniyeal, ananiyaa, meeshaaveal, asariyaa enpavarka'l irunthaarka'l.
pirathaanika'lin thalaivan, thaaniyealukku peltheshaathsaar en'rum, ananiyaavukku saathraak en'rum, meeshaavealukku meashaak en'rum, asariyaavukku aapeathneakoa en'rum ma'rupeyarittaan.

thaaniyeal raajaavin poajanaththinaalum avar paanampa'n'num thiraadcharasaththinaalum thannaith theettuppaduththalaakaathen'ru, than iruthayaththil theermaanampa'n'nikko'ndu, thannaith theettuppaduththaathapadi pirathaanika'lin thalaivanidaththil vea'ndikko'ndaan.
theavan thaaniyealukkup pirathaanika'lin thalaivanidaththil thayavum irakkamum kidaikkumpadi seythaar.

pirathaanika'lin thalaivan thaaniyealai noakki: ungka'lukkup poajanaththaiyum paanaththaiyum ku'riththirukki'ra raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanukku naan payappaduki'rean; avar ungka'loadoththa vaaliparin mukangka'laippaarkkilum ungka'l mukangka'l vaadippoanavaika'laakak kaa'navea'ndiyathenna? athinaal raajaa ennaich sirachseathampa'n'nuvaarea en'raan.
appozhuthu pirathaanika'lin thalaivanaalea, thaaniyeal, ananiyaa, meeshaaveal, asariyaa enpavarka'lmeal visaarippukkaaranaaka vaikkappatta mealshaar enpavanaith thaaniyeal noakki:
paththunaa'lvaraikkum umathu adiyaaraich soathiththuppaarum; engka'lukkup pusikkap paruppu muthalaana marakka'rika'laiyum, kudikkath tha'n'neeraiyum koduththu,
engka'l mukangka'laiyum raajapoajanaththil pusikki'ra vaaliparudaiya mukangka'laiyum oththuppaarum; pinpu neer kaa'nki'rapadi umathu adiyaarukkuch seyyum en'raan.
avan inthak kaariyaththilea avarka'lukkuch sevikoduththu, paththunaa'la'lavum avarka'laich soathiththuppaarththaan.
paththunaa'l sen'rapinpu, raajapoajanaththaip pusiththa ellaa vaaliparaippaarkkilum avarka'l mukam ka'laiyu'l'lathaayum, sareeram pushdiyu'l'lathaayum kaa'nappattathu.
aakaiyaal mealshaar avarka'l pusikkak katta'laiyaana poajanaththaiyum, avarka'l kudikkak katta'laiyaana thiraadcharasaththaiyum neekkivaiththu, avarka'lukkup paruppu muthalaanavaika'laik koduththaan.

intha naalu vaaliparukkum theavan sakala ezhuththilum gnaanaththilum a'rivaiyum saamarththiyaththaiyum koduththaar; thaaniyealaich sakala tharisanangka'laiyum soppanangka'laiyum a'riyaththakka a'rivu'l'lavanaakkinaar.
avarka'lai raajaavinidaththil ko'nduvaruki'ratha'rkuk ku'riththa naadka'l ni'raivea'rinapoathu, pirathaanika'lin thalaivan avarka'lai neapukaathneachchaarukku munpaakak ko'nduvanthu vittaan.

raajaa avarka'loadea peasinaan; avarka'l ellaarukku'l'lum thaaniyeal, ananiyaa, meeshaaveal, asariyaa enpavarka'laippoala vea'roruvarum kaa'nappadavillai; aakaiyaal ivarka'l raajasamukaththil nin'raarka'l.

gnaanaththukkum puththikkum aduththa entha vishayaththil raajaa avarka'laik keattu visaariththaanoa, athilea than raajyam engkumu'l'la sakala saasthirika'lilum joasiyarilum avarka'laip paththumadangku samarththaraakak ka'ndaan.
koareas raajyapaarampa'n'num muthalaam varushamattum thaaniyeal angkea irunthaan.
neapukaathneachchaar raajyapaarampa'n'num ira'ndaam varushaththilea, neapukaathneachchaar soppanangka'laik ka'ndaan; athinaal, avanudaiya aavi kalangki, avanudaiya niththirai kalainthathu.

appozhuthu raajaa than soppanangka'laith thanakkuth therivikkumporuttuch saasthirika'laiyum joasiyaraiyum sooniyakkaararaiyum kaltheayaraiyum azhaikkachsonnaan; avarka'l vanthu, raajasamukaththil nin'raarka'l.
raajaa avarka'lai noakki: oru soppanam ka'ndean; anthach soppanaththai a'riyavea'ndumen'ru en aavi kalangkiyirukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu kaltheayar raajaavai noakki: raajaavea, neer en'rum vaazhka; soppanaththai umathu adiyaarukkuch sollum, appozhuthu athin arththaththai viduvippoam en'ru seeriyapaashaiyilea sonnaarka'l.

raajaa kaltheayarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennidaththilirunthu pi'rakki'ra theermaanam ennaven'raal, neengka'l soppanaththaiyum athin arththaththaiyum enakku a'riviyaama'rpoanaal thu'ndiththuppoadappaduveerka'l; ungka'l veeduka'l erukka'langka'laakkappadum.

soppanaththaiyum athin arththaththaiyum theriviththeerka'leayaakil, ennidaththil vekumathika'laiyum parisuka'laiyum mikuntha kanaththaiyum pe'ruveerka'l; aakaiyaal soppanaththaiyum athin arththaththaiyum enakkuth theriviyungka'l en'raan.
avarka'l ma'rupadiyum pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaa adiyaarukkuch soppanaththaich solvaaraaka; appozhuthu athin arththaththai viduvippoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku raajaa pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennidaththilirunthu theermaanam pi'ranthapadiyinaalea neengka'l kaalathaamatham pa'n'nappaarkki'reerka'len'ru nichchayamaaka enakkuth theriyavaruki'rathu.

kaalam maa'rumen'ru neengka'l enakku munpaakap poyyum purattumaana viseashaththaich sollumpadi eththanampa'n'ni irukki'reerka'l; neengka'l soppanaththai enakkuth therivikkaama'rpoanaal, ungka'lellaarukkum intha orea theerppu pi'ranthirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal soppanaththai enakkuch sollungka'l; appozhuthu athin arththaththaiyum ungka'laal kaa'npikkakkoodumen'ru a'rinthuko'l'luvean en'raan.

kaltheayar raajasamukaththil pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaa keadkum kaariyaththai a'rivikkaththakka manushan poomiyil oruvanum illai; aakaiyaal makaththuvamum vallamaiyumaana entha raajaavum ippadippatta kaariyaththai oru saasthiriyinidaththilaavathu joasiyanidaththilaavathu kaltheayanidaththilaavathu keattathillai.
raajaa keadki'ra kaariyam mikavum arumaiyaanathu; maamsamaayirukki'ravarka'loadea vaasampa'n'naatha theavarka'leayozhiya raajasamukaththil athai a'rivikkaththakkavar oruvarum illai en'raarka'l.
ithinimiththam raajaa makaa koapamum ukkiramungko'ndu, paapiloanil irukki'ra ellaa gnaanika'laiyum kolaiseyyumpadi katta'laiyittaan.
gnaanika'laik kolaiseyya vea'ndumenki'ra katta'lai ve'lippattapoathu, thaaniyealaiyum avan thoazharaiyum kolaiseyyath theadinaarka'l.
paapiloanin gnaanika'laik kolaiseyyap pu'rappatta raajaavinudaiya thalaiyaarika'lukku athipathiyaakiya aariyoakoadea thaaniyeal yoasanaiyum puththiyumaayp peasi:

inthak katta'lai raajaavinaal iththanai avasaramaayp pi'ranthatha'rkuk kaara'nam enna en'ru raajaavin searvaikkaaranaakiya aariyoakinidaththil keattaan; appozhuthu aariyoaku thaaniyealukkuk kaariyaththai a'riviththaan.
thaaniyeal raajaavinidaththil poay, soppanaththin arththaththai raajaavukkuk kaa'npikkumpadith thanakkuth thava'naikodukka vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

pinpu thaaniyeal than veettukkup poay, thaanum than thoazharum paapiloanin mat'ra gnaanika'loadeakooda azhiyaathapadikku intha ma'raiporu'laikku'riththup paraloakaththin theavanai noakki irakkam keadki'ratha'rkaaka,
ananiyaa, meeshaaveal, asariyaa ennum thannudaiya thoazharukku inthak kaariyaththai a'riviththaan.
pinpu iraakkaalaththil tharisanaththilea thaaniyealukku ma'raiporu'l ve'lippaduththappattathu; appozhuthu thaaniyeal paraloakaththin theavanai sthoaththiriththaan.
pinpu thaaniyeal sonnathu: theavanudaiya naamaththukku en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaka; gnaanamum vallamaiyum avarukkea uriyathu.
avar kaalangka'laiyum samayangka'laiyum maat'ruki'ravar; raajaakka'laith tha'l'li, raajaakka'lai ea'rpaduththuki'ravar; gnaanika'lukku gnaanaththaiyum, a'rivaa'lika'lukku a'rivaiyum kodukki'ravar.
avarea aazhamum ma'raiporu'lumaanathai ve'lippaduththuki'ravar; iru'lil irukki'rathai avar a'rivaar; ve'lichcham avaridaththil thangkum.

en pithaakka'lin theavanea, neer enakku gnaanamum vallamaiyum koduththu, naangka'l ummidaththil vea'ndikko'ndathai ippozhuthu enakku a'riviththu, raajaavin kaariyaththai engka'lukkuth theriviththapadiyinaal, ummaith thuthiththup pukazhuki'rean en'raan.

pinpu thaaniyeal paapiloanin gnaanika'lai azhikka raajaa katta'laiyitta aariyoakinidaththil poay: paapiloanin gnaanika'lai azhikkaatheayum, ennai raajaavin munpaaka azhaiththukko'ndupoam; raajaavukku arththaththaith therivippean en'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu aariyoaku thaaniyealai raajaavin munpaakath theeviramaay azhaiththukko'ndupoay: si'raippattuvantha yootheayaa theasaththaaril oru purushanaik ka'ndupidiththean; avan raajaavukku arththaththaith therivippaan en'raan.
raajaa peltheshaathsaarennum naamamu'l'la thaaniyealai noakki: naan ka'nda soppanaththaiyum athin arththaththaiyum nee enakku a'rivikkakkoodumaa en'ru keattaan.
thaaniyeal raajasamukaththil pirathiyuththaramaaka: raajaa keadki'ra ma'raiporu'lai raajaavukkuth therivikka gnaanika'laalum, joasiyaraalum, saasthirika'laalum, ku'risolluki'ravarka'laalum koodaathu.

ma'raiporu'lka'lai ve'lippaduththuki'ra paraloakaththilirukki'ra theavan kadaisinaadka'lil sampavippathai raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarukkuth theriviththirukki'raar; ummudaiya soppanamum umathu padukkaiyinmeal ummudaiya thalaiyil u'ndaana tharisanangka'lum ennaven'raal:

raajaavea, ummudaiya padukkaiyinmeal neer paduththirukkaiyil, inimeal sampavikkappoaki'rathenna enki'ra ninaivuka'l umakku'l ezhumpit'ru; appozhuthu ma'raiporu'lka'lai ve'lippaduththuki'ravar sampavikkappoaki'rathai umakkuth theriviththaar.

uyiroadirukki'ra ellaaraippaarkkilum enakku athika gnaanam u'ndenpathinaalea alla; arththam raajaavukkuth theriyavaravum, ummudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuka'lai neer a'riyavum, intha ma'raiporu'l enakku ve'liyaakkappattathu.
raajaavea, neer oru periya silaiyaik ka'ndeer; anthap periya silai mikuntha pirakaasamu'l'lathaayirunthathu; athu umakku ethirea nin'rathu; athin roopam payangkaramaayirunthathu.
anthach silaiyin thalai pasumponnum, athin maarpum athin puyangka'lum ve'l'liyum, athin vayi'rum athin thodaiyum ve'nkalamum,
athin kaalka'l irumpum, athin paathangka'l paathi irumpum paathi ka'lima'n'numaayirunthathu.

neer paarththukko'ndirukkumpoathea, kaika'laal peyarkkappadaatha oru kal peyarnthu uru'nduvanthathu; athu anthach silaiyai irumpum ka'lima'n'numaakiya athin paathangka'lil moathi, avaika'lai no'rukkippoattathu.

appozhuthu antha irumpum ka'lima'n'num ve'nkalamum ve'l'liyum ponnum eakamaay no'rungku'ndu, koadaikaalaththil poaradikki'ra ka'laththilirunthu pa'ranthupoaki'ra patharaippoalaayit'ru; avaika'lukku oru idamum kidaiyaathapadi kaat'ru avaika'lai adiththukko'ndupoayit'ru; silaiyai moathina kalloaven'raal, oru periya parvathamaaki poomiyaiyellaam nirappit'ru.
soppanam ithuthaan; athin arththaththaiyum raajasamukaththil therivippoam.
raajaavea, neer raajaathi raajaavaayirukki'reer; paraloakaththin theavan umakku raajareekaththaiyum paraakkiramaththaiyum vallamaiyaiyum makimaiyaiyum aru'linaar.

sakala idangka'lilumu'l'la manupuththiraraiyum ve'liyin mirukangka'laiyum aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum avar umathu kaiyil oppukkoduththu, ummai avaika'laiyellaam aa'lumpadi seythaar. ponnaana anthath thalai neerea.
umakkuppi'raku umakkuk keezhththaramaana vea'roru raajyam thoan'rum; pinpu poomiyaiyellaam aa'nduko'l'lum ve'nkalamaana moon'raam raajyam on'ru ezhumpum.

naalaavathu raajyam irumpaippoala uramaayirukkum; irumpu ellaavat'raiyum eppadi no'rukkich sinnapinnamaakkuki'rathoa, appadiyea ithu no'rukkippoaduki'ra irumpaipoala avaika'laiyellaam no'rukkith thakarththuppoadum.

paathangka'lum kaalviralka'lum paathi kuyavanin ka'lima'n'num, paathi irumpumaayirukka neer ka'ndeerea, antha raajyam pirikkappadum; aakilum ka'lima'n'noadea irumpu kalanthirukka neer ka'ndapadiyea irumpinudaiya u'ruthiyil kogncham athilea irukkum.
kaalviralka'l paathi irumpum paathi ka'lima'n'numaayirunthathu ennaven'raal, antha raajyam orupangku uramum orupangku nerisalumaayirukkum.

neer irumpaik ka'lima'n'noadea kalanthathaakak ka'ndeerea, avarka'l mat'ra manusharoadea sampanthangkalappaarka'l; aakilum ithoa, ka'lima'n'noadea irumpu kalavaathathupoala avarka'l oruvaroadoruvar ottikko'l'laathiruppaarka'l.

antha raajaakka'lin naadka'lilea, paraloakaththin theavan en'ren'raikkum azhiyaatha oru raajyaththai ezhumpappa'n'nuvaar; antha raajyam vea'rea janaththukku vidappaduvathillai; oru kal kaiyaal peyarkkappadaamal malaiyilirunthu peyarnthu, uru'nduvanthu, irumpaiyum ve'nkalaththaiyum ka'lima'n'naiyum ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum no'rukkinathai neer ka'ndeerea, appadiyea athu antha raajyangka'laiyellaam no'rukki, nirmoolamaakki, thaanoa en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum.
inimeal sampavikkappoaki'rathai makaa theavan raajaavukkuth theriviththirukki'raar; soppanamaanathu nichchayam, athin arththam saththiyam en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, thaaniyealai va'nangki, avanukkuk kaa'nikkai seluththavum thoopangkaattavum katta'laiyittaan.

raajaa thaaniyealai noakki: nee intha ma'raiporu'lai ve'lippaduththinapadiyinaal, meyyaay ungka'l theavanea theavarka'lukkuth theavanum, raajaakka'lukku aa'ndavarum, ma'raiporu'lka'lai ve'lippaduththuki'ravarumaayirukki'raar en'raan.

pinpu raajaa thaaniyealaip periyavanaakki, avanukku aneakam si'rantha vekumathika'laik koduththu, avanaip paapiloan maakaa'nam muzhuthukkum athipathiyaakavum, paapiloanilu'l'la sakala gnaanika'lin mealum pirathaana athikaariyaakavum niyamiththaan.

thaaniyeal raajaavai vea'ndikko'ndathinpearil avan saathraakkaiyum, meashaakkaiyum, aapeathneakoavaiyum paapiloan maakaa'naththuk kaariyangka'lai visaarikkumpadi vaiththaan; thaaniyealoaven'raal raajaavin koluma'ndapaththil irunthaan.
raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar a'rupathumuzha uyaramum aa'ru muzha akalamumaana oru po'rsilaiyaip pa'n'nuviththu, paapiloan maakaa'naththilirukki'ra thooraa ennum samapoomiyilea ni'ruththinaan.

pinpu raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar theasaathipathika'laiyum, athikaarika'laiyum, thalaivaraiyum, niyaayaathipathika'laiyum, pokkishakkaararaiyum, neethisaasthirika'laiyum, visaarippukkaararaiyum, naaduka'lilu'l'la uththiyoakasthar yaavaraiyum neapukaathneachchaar raajaa ni'ruththina silaiyin pirathishdaikku vanthu searumpadi azhaiththanuppinaan.

appozhuthu theasaathipathika'lum, athikaarika'lum, thalaivarum, niyaayaathipathika'lum, pokkishakkaararum, neethisaasthirika'lum, visaarippukkaararum, naaduka'lilu'l'la uththiyoakasthar yaavarum, raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ni'ruththina silaiyin pirathishdaikku vanthusearnthu, neapukaathneachchaar ni'ruththina silaikku ethiraaka nin'raarka'l.
kattiyakkaaran uraththa saththamaay: sakala janangka'lum, jaathika'lum, paashaikkaararumaanavarka'lea, ungka'lukku a'rivikkappaduki'rathu ennaven'raal:

ekkaa'lam, naakasuram, kinnaram, vee'nai, surama'ndalam, thampuru muthalaana sakalavitha keethavaaththiyangka'lin saththaththai neengka'l keadkumpoathu, neengka'l thaazhavizhunthu, raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ni'ruththina po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'l'lakkadaveerka'l.
evanaakilum thaazha vizhunthu, athaip pa'ninthuko'l'laama'rpoanaal, avan annearamea eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin naduvilea poadappaduvaan en'raan.

aathalaal sakala janangka'lum, ekkaa'lam, naakasuram, kinnaram, vee'nai, surama'ndalam muthalaana sakalavitha keethavaaththiyangka'lin saththaththaik keattavudanea, sakala janaththaarum jaathiyaarum paashaikkaararum thaazha vizhunthu, raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar ni'ruththina po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.
achsamayaththil kaltheayaril silar raajasamukaththil vanthu, yootharpearil kut'ragnsaat'ri,
raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarai noakki: raajaavea, neer en'rum vaazhka.

ekkaa'lam, naakasuram, kinnaram, vee'nai, surama'ndalam, thampuru muthalaana sakalavitha keethavaaththiyangka'lin saththaththaiyum keadki'ra entha manushanum thaazhavizhunthu, po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'l'lavea'ndumen'rum,
evanaakilum thaazha vizhunthu pa'ninthuko'l'laama'rpoanaal, avan eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin naduvilea poadappadavea'ndumen'rum, raajaavaakiya neer katta'laiyitteerea.

paapiloan maakaa'naththin kaariyangka'lai visaarikkumpadi neer ea'rpaduththina saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa ennum yootharaana manushar irukki'raarka'lea; avarka'l raajaavaakiya ummai mathikkavillai; avarka'l ummudaiya theavarka'lukku aaraathanai seyyaamalum, neer ni'ruththina po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'l'laamalum irukki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu neapukaathneachchaar ukkirakoapangko'ndu saathraakkaiyum, meashaakkaiyum, aapeathneakoavaiyum azhaiththukko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittaan; avarka'l anthap purusharai raajaavin samukaththil ko'nduvanthu vittapoathu,

neapukaathneachchaar avarka'lai noakki: saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'lea, neengka'l en theavarka'lukku aaraathanaiseyyaamalum naan ni'ruththina po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'l'laamalum irunthathu meythaanaa?

ippoathum ekkaa'lam, naakasuram, kinnaram, vee'nai, surama'ndalam, thampuru muthalaana sakalavitha keethavaaththiyangka'lin saththaththaiyum neengka'l keadkumpoathu, thaazha vizhunthu, naan pa'n'nivaiththa silaiyaip pa'ninthuko'l'la aayaththamaayirunthaal nallathu; pa'ninthuko'l'laathiruntheerka'leayaakil, annearamea eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin naduvilea poadappaduveerka'l; ungka'lai en kaikkuth thappuvikkappoaki'ra theavan yaar en'raan.
saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'l raajaavai noakki: neapukaathneachchaarea, inthak kaariyaththaik ku'riththu umakku uththaravu solla engka'lukku avasiyamillai.
naangka'l aaraathikki'ra engka'l theavan engka'laith thappuvikka vallavaraayirukki'raar; avar eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laikkum, raajaavaakiya ummudaiya kaikkum neengkalaakki viduvippaar.

viduvikkaama'rpoanaalum, naangka'l ummudaiya theavarka'lukku aaraathanai seyvathumillai, neer ni'ruththina po'rsilaiyaip pa'ninthuko'lvathumillai enki'rathu raajaavaakiya umakkuth therinthirukkakkadavathu en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu neapukaathneachchaarukkuk kadungkoapamoo'ndu: saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'lukku viroathamaay avanudaiya mukam vea'rupattathu; soo'laiyaich saathaara'namaaych soodaakkuvathaippaarkkilum eazhumadangku athikamaaych soodaakkumpadi uththaravukoduththu,
saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'lai eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyilea poaduvatha'rku avarka'laik kattumpadi, than iraa'nuvaththil palasaalika'laakiya purusharukkuk katta'laiyittaan.
appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l saalvaika'loadum nisaarka'loadum paakaika'loadum mat'ra vasthirangka'loadum kattappattu, eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin naduvilea poadappattaarka'l.

raajaavin katta'lai kadumaiyaayirunthapadiyinaalum, soo'lai mikavum soodaakkappattirunthapadiyinaalum, akkinijuvaalaiyaanathu saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'laith thookkikko'ndupoana purusharaik kon'rupoattathu.
saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa ennum antha moon'ru purusharum kattu'ndavarka'laay eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin naduvilea vizhunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar piramiththu, theeviramaay ezhunthirunthu, than manthirimaarka'lai noakki: moon'ru purusharai allavoa kattu'ndavarka'laaka akkiniyilea poaduviththoam en'raan; avarka'l raajaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aam, raajaavea en'raarka'l.

atha'rku avan: ithoa, naalupear viduthalaiyaay akkiniyin naduvilea ulaavuki'rathaik kaa'nki'rean; avarka'lukku oru seathamumillai; naalaam aa'lin saayal theavapuththiranukku oppaayirukki'rathu en'raan.

appozhuthu neapukaathneachchaar eriki'ra akkinichsoo'laiyin vaasala'ndaikku vanthu, unnathamaana theavanudaiya thaasaraakiya saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'lea, neengka'l ve'liyea vaarungka'l en'raan; appozhuthu saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'l akkiniyin naduvilirunthu ve'liyea vanthaarka'l.

theasaathipathika'lum, athikaarika'lum, thalaivarum, raajaavin manthirika'lum koodivanthu, anthap purusharudaiya sareerangka'linmeal akkini pelagnseyyaamalum, avarka'ludaiya thalaimayir karukaamalum, avarka'ludaiya saalvaika'l seathappadaamalum, akkiniyin ma'nam avarka'lidaththil veesaamalum irunthathaik ka'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu neapukaathneachchaar vasaniththu: saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'ludaiya theavanukku sthoaththiram; avarka'l thangka'ludaiya theavanaiththavira vea'roru theavanaiyum seaviththup pa'niyaamal, avaraiyea nampi, raajaavin katta'laiyaith tha'l'li, thangka'l sareerangka'lai oppukkoduththathinaal, avar thamathu thoothanai anuppi, thammudaiya thaasarai viduviththaar.

aathalaal saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'ludaiya theavanukku viroathamaakath thoosha'na vaarththaiyaich solluki'ra entha janaththaanum, entha jaathiyaanum, enthap paashaikkaaranum thu'ndiththuppoadappaduvaan; avan veedu erukka'lamaakkappadum en'ru ennaalea theermaanikkappaduki'rathu; ivvithamaay iradchikkaththakka theavan vea'roruvarum illaiyen'raan.
pinpu raajaa saathraak, meashaak, aapeathneakoa enpavarka'laip paapiloan theasaththilea uyarththinaan.
raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaar poomi engkum kudiyirukki'ra sakala janaththaarukkum jaathiyaarukkum paashaikkaararukkum ezhuthuki'rathu ennaven'raal: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam perukakkadavathu.
unnathamaana theavan ennidaththil seytha adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum pirasiththappaduththuvathu enakku nanmaiyaayk ka'ndathu.

avarudaiya adaiyaa'langka'l evva'lavu makaththuvamum, avarudaiya a'rputhangka'l evva'lavu vallamaiyumaayirukki'rathu; avarudaiya raajyam niththiya raajyam; avarudaiya aa'lukai thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka ni'rkum.
neapukaathneachchaaraakiya naan en veettilea savukkiyamu'l'lavanaayirunthu en aramanaiyilea vaazhnthuko'ndirunthean.
naan oru soppanaththaik ka'ndean; athu enakkuth thikilai u'ndaakkit'ru; en padukkaiyinmeal enakku'l u'ndaana ninaivuka'lum, en thalaiyil thoan'rina tharisanangka'lum ennaik kalangkappa'n'nit'ru.
aakaiyaal soppanaththin arththaththai enakkuth therivikki'ratha'rkaakap paapiloan gnaanika'laiyellaam ennidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittean.

appozhuthu saasthirika'lum, joasiyarum, kaltheayarum, ku'risolluki'ravarka'lum ennidaththilea vanthaarka'l; soppanaththai naan avarka'lukkuch sonnean; aanaalum athin arththaththai enakkuth therivikkamaattaama'rpoanaarka'l.

kadaisiyilea en theavanudaiya naamaththinpadiyea peltheshaathsaar ennum peyaridappattu, parisuththa theavarka'lin aaviyaiyudaiya thaaniyeal ennidaththil ko'nduvarappattaan; avanidaththil naan soppanaththai vivariththuch sonnathaavathu:

saasthirika'lin athipathiyaakiya peltheshaathsaarea, parisuththa theavarka'ludaiya aavi unakku'l irukki'rathen'rum, entha ma'raiporu'laiyum a'rivathu unakku arithallaven'rum naan a'rivean; naan ka'nda en soppanaththin tharisanangka'laiyum athin arththaththaiyum sollu.
naan paduththirunthapoathu en thalaiyil thoan'rina tharisanangka'l ennaven'raal: ithoa, theasaththin maththiyilea mikavum uyaramaana oru virudchaththaik ka'ndean.
antha virudcham va'larnthu palaththu, theasaththin ellaipariyanthamum kaa'nappadaththakkathaaka athin uyaram vaanapariyantham ettinathu.

athin ilaika'l nearththiyum, athin kani mikuthiyumaayirunthathu; ellaa jeevanukkum athil aakaaram u'ndaayirunthathu; athin keezhea ve'liyin mirukangka'l nizhalukku othungkinathu; athin koppuka'lil aakaayaththup padchika'l thaapariththuch sakala piraa'nika'lum athinaal poashikkappattathu.
naan paduththirukkaiyil en thalaiyil thoan'rina tharisanangka'laik kaa'numpoathu, kaavalaa'lanaakiya parisuththavaan oruvan vaanaththilirunthu i'rangkakka'ndean.

avan uraththa saththamittu: intha virudchaththai vetti, ithin koppuka'laith tha'riththuppoadungka'l; ithin ilaika'lai uthirththu, ithin kanika'laich sitha'radiyungka'l; ithin keezhu'l'la mirukangka'lum ithin koppuka'lilu'l'la padchika'lum poayvidattum.

aanaalum ithin vearka'laakiya adimaram poomiyil irukkattum; irumpum ve'nkalamumaana vilangku idappattu, ve'liyin pasumpullilea thangki, aakaayaththup paniyilea nanaivathaaka; mirukangka'loadea poomiyin poo'ndilea avanukkup pangku irukkakkadavathu.
avanudaiya iruthayam manusha iruthayamaayiraamal maa'rumpadi, miruka iruthayam avanukkuk kodukkappadakkadavathu; ippadiyirukki'ra avanmeal eazhu kaalangka'l kadanthupoakavea'ndum.

unnathamaanavar manusharudaiya raajyaththil aa'lukaiseythu thamakkuch siththamaanavanukku athaik koduththu, manusharil thaazhnthavanaiyum athinmeal athikaariyaakkuki'raar en'ru narajeevanka'l a'riyumpadikkuk kaavalaa'larin theerppinaal inthak kaariyamum parisuththavaanka'lin mozhiyinaal intha visaara'naiyum theermaanikkappattathu en'raan.

neapukaathneachchaar ennum raajaavaakiya naan ka'nda soppanam ithuvea; ippoathu peltheshaathsaarea, nee ithin arththaththaich sollu; en raajyaththilu'l'la gnaanika'l ellaaraalum ithin arththaththai enakkuth therivikkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru; neeyoa ithaith therivikkaththakkavan; parisuththa theavarka'ludaiya aavi unakku'l irukki'rathea en'raan.

appozhuthu peltheshaathsaarennum peyaru'l'la thaaniyeal oru naazhikaimattum thikaiththuch sinthiththuk kalangkinaan. raajaa avanai noakki: peltheshaathsaarea, soppanamum athin arththamum unnaik kalangkappa'n'navea'ndiyathillai en'raan; appozhuthu peltheshaathsaar pirathiyuththaramaaka: en aa'ndavanea, anthach soppanam ummudaiya pakaivaridaththilum, athin arththam ummudaiya saththurukka'lidaththilum palikkakkadavathu.
neer ka'nda virudcham va'larnthu palaththu, theasaththin ellaipariyantham kaa'nappadaththakkathaaka athin uyaram vaanapariyantham ettinathu.

athin ilaika'l nearththiyum, athin kani mikuthiyumaayirunthathu; ellaa jeevanukkum athil aakaaram u'ndaayirunthathu; athin keezhea ve'liyin mirukangka'l thangkinathu, athin koppuka'lil aakaayaththuppadchika'l thaapariththathu.
athu periyavarum palaththavarumaayirukki'ra raajaavaakiya neerthaamea; umathu makaththuvam peruki vaanapariyanthamum, umathu karththaththuvam poomiyin ellaipariyanthamum ettiyirukki'rathu.

intha virudchaththai vetti, ithai azhiththuppoadungka'l; aanaalum ithin vearka'laakiya adimaram tharaiyil irukkattumen'rum, irumpum ve'nkalamumaana vilangku idappattu, ve'liyin pasumpullilea thangki, aakaayaththup paniyilea nanaivathaaka; eazhu kaalangka'l avanmeal kadanthupoakumattum mirukangka'loadea avanudaiya pangku irukkakkadavathen'rum, vaanaththilirunthu i'rangkich sonna parisuththa kaavalaa'lanai raajaavaakiya neer ka'ndeerea.

raajaavea, athin arththamum raajaavaakiya en aa'ndavanpearil vantha unnathamaanavarudaiya theermaanamum ennaven'raal: manusharinin'ru neer tha'l'lividappaduveer; ve'liyin mirukangka'loadea sagncharippeer; maaduka'laippoalap pullaimeaynthu, aakaayaththup paniyilea nanaiveer.

unnathamaanavar manusharudaiya raajyaththil aa'lukaiseythu, thamakkuch siththamaayirukki'ravanukku athaik kodukki'raar enpathai neer a'rinthuko'l'lumattum eazhu kaalangka'l ummudaiyapearil kadanthupoakavea'ndum.
aanaalum virudchaththin vearka'laakiya adimaram tharaiyil irukkattum en'ru sollappattathu ennaven'raal: neer parama athikaaraththai a'rinthapin, raajyam umakku nilaini'rkum.

aakaiyaal raajaavea, naan sollum aaloasanaiyai neer angkeekariththukko'ndu neethiyaich seythu umathu paavangka'laiyum, si'rumaiyaanavarka'lukku irangki umathu akkiramangka'laiyum akat'rividum; appozhuthu ummudaiya vaazhvu neediththirukkalaam en'raan.
ithellaam raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarinmeal vanthathu.
pannira'ndu maatham sen'rapinpu, raajaa paapiloan raajyaththin aramanaimeal ulaavikko'ndirukkumpoathu:
ithu en vallamaiyin paraakkiramaththinaal, en makimaippirathaapaththukken'ru, raajyaththukku aramanaiyaaka naan kattina makaa paapiloan allavaa en'ru sonnaan.
intha vaarththai raajaavin vaayil irukkumpoathea, vaanaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaaki: raajaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarea, raajyapaaram unnaivittu neengkit'ru.

manusharinin'ru tha'l'lappaduvaay; ve'liyin mirukangka'loadea sagncharippaay; maaduka'laippoal pullai meayvaay; ippadiyea unnathamaanavar manusharudaiya raajyaththil aa'lukaiseythu, thamakkuch siththamaayirukki'ravanukku athaik kodukki'raarenpathai nee a'rinthuko'l'lumattum eazhu kaalangka'l unmeal kadanthupoakum en'ru unakkuch sollappaduki'rathu en'ru vi'lampinathu.

annearamea intha vaarththai neapukaathneachchaaridaththil ni'raivea'rit'ru; avan manusharinin'ru tha'l'lappattu, maaduka'laippoal pullai meaynthaan; avanudaiya thalaimayir kazhukuka'ludaiya i'rakuka'laippoalavum, avanudaiya nakangka'l padchika'ludaiya nakangka'laippoalavum va'larumattum avan sareeram aakaayaththup paniyilea nanainthathu.

antha naadka'l sen'rapinpu, neapukaathneachchaaraakiya naan en ka'nka'lai vaanaththukku ea'reduththean; en puththi enakkuth thirumpi vanthathu; appozhuthu naan unnathamaanavarai sthoaththiriththu, en'ren'raikkum jeeviththirukki'ravaraip pukazhnthu makimaippaduththinean; avarudaiya karththaththuvamea niththiya karththaththuvam, avarudaiya raajyamea thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka ni'rkum.

poomiyin kudika'l ellaam on'rumillaiyen'ru e'n'nappaduki'raarka'l; avar thamathu siththaththinpadiyea vaanaththin seanaiyaiyum poomiyin kudika'laiyum nadaththuki'raar; avarudaiya kaiyaith thaduththu, avarai noakki: enna seyki'reeren'ru sollaththakkavan oruvanum illai en'rean.

avvea'laiyil en puththi enakkuth thirumpi vanthathu; en raajyapaaraththin meanmaikkaaka en makimaiyum en mukakka'laiyum enakkuth thirumpi vanthathu; en manthirimaarum en pirapukka'lum ennaith theadivanthaarka'l; en raajyaththilea naan sthirappaduththappattean; athika makaththuvamum enakkuk kidaiththathu.

aakaiyaal neapukaathneachchaaraakiya naan paraloakaththin raajaavaip pukazhnthu, uyarththi, makimaippaduththuki'rean; avarudaiya kiriyaika'lellaam saththiyamum, avarudaiya vazhika'l niyaayamumaanavaika'l; akanthaiyaay nadakki'ravarka'laith thaazhththa avaraalea aakum en'ru ezhuthinaan.
pelshaathsaar ennum raajaa than pirapukka'lil aayirampearukku oru periya virunthuseythu, antha aayirampearukku munpaakath thiraadcharasam kudiththaan.

pelshaathsaar thiraadcharasaththai rusiththukko'ndirukkaiyil, avan than thakappanaakiya neapukaathneachchaar erusaleam theavaalayaththilirunthu ko'nduvantha pon ve'l'li paaththirangka'lil, raajaavaakiya thaanum than pirapukka'lum than manaivika'lum than vaippaattika'lum kudikki'ratha'rkaaka avaika'laik ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittaan.

appozhuthu erusaleamilu'l'la theavanudaiya veedaakiya aalayaththilirunthu edukkappatta po'rpaaththirangka'laik ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avaika'lil raajaavum avanudaiya pirapukka'lum avanudaiya manaivika'lum avanudaiya vaippaattika'lum kudiththaarka'l.
avarka'l thiraadcharasam kudiththu, ponnum ve'l'liyum ve'nkalamum irumpum maramum kallumaakiya theavarka'laip pukazhnthaarka'l.
annearaththilea manusha kaiviralka'l thoan'ri, vi'lakkukku ethiraaka raaja aramanaiyin saanthu poosappatta suvarilea ezhuthit'ru; ezhuthina anthak kaiyu'ruppai raajaa ka'ndaan.
appozhuthu raajaavin mukam vea'rupattathu; avanudaiya ninaivuka'l avanaik kalangkappa'n'ninathu; avanudaiya iduppin kattuka'l tha'larnthathu, avanudaiya muzhangkaalka'l on'roadon'ru moathikko'ndathu.

raajaa uraththa saththamittu; joasiyaraiyum kaltheayaraiyum ku'risolluki'ravarka'laiyum u'l'lea azhaiththuvarumpadi sonnaan. raajaa paapiloan gnaanika'lai noakki: intha ezhuththai vaasiththu, ithin arththaththai enakku ve'lippaduththuki'ravan evanoa, avan iraththaamparamum kazhuththilea po'rsarappa'niyum tharikkappattu, raajyaththilea moon'raam athipathiyaay iruppaan en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu raajaavin gnaanika'lellaarum vanthu searnthaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l antha ezhuththai vaasikkavum, athin arththaththai raajaavukkuth therivikkavum koodaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu raajaavaakiya pelshaathsaar mikavum kalangkinaan; avanudaiya mukam vea'rupattathu; avanudaiya pirapukka'l thikaiththaarka'l.

raajaavum avanudaiya pirapukka'lum sonnavaika'lai raajaaththi kea'lvippattu virunthusaalaikku'l piraveasiththaa'l. appozhuthu raajaaththi: raajaavea, neer en'rum vaazhka; umathu ninaivuka'l ummaik kalangkappa'n'navum, umathu mukam vea'rupadavum vea'ndiyathillai.

ummudaiya raajyaththilea oru purushan irukki'raan, avanukku'l parisuththa theavarka'ludaiya aavi irukki'rathu; ummudaiya pithaavin naadka'lil ve'lichchamum viveakamum theavarka'lin gnaanaththukku oththa gnaanamum avanidaththil kaa'nappattathu; aakaiyaal ummudaiya pithaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarennum raajaavaanavar avanaich saasthirika'lukkum joasiyarukkum kaltheayarukkum ku'risolluki'ravarka'lukkum athipathiyaaka vaiththaar.

raajaavinaal peltheshaathsaarennum peyaridappatta anthath thaaniyealukku'l soppanangka'lai viyaarththipa'n'nuki'rathum, puthaiporu'lka'lai ve'lippaduththuki'rathum, karukalaanavaika'laith the'livikki'rathumaana a'rivum puththiyum viseashiththa aaviyum u'nden'ru kaa'nappattathu; ippoathum thaaniyeal azhaikkappadattum, avan arththaththai ve'lippaduththuvaan en'raa'l.

appozhuthu thaaniyeal raajaavinmun u'l'lea azhaiththuvanthu vidappattaan; raajaa thaaniyealaip paarththu: nee en pithaavaakiya raajaa yoothaavilirunthu si'raipidiththuvantha yootharil oruvanaakiya thaaniyeal allavaa?
unakku'l'lea theavarka'lin aavi u'nden'rum, ve'lichchamum puththiyum viseashiththa gnaanamum unnidaththil kaa'nappattathen'rum unnaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattean.

ippoathum intha ezhuththai vaasikki'ratha'rkum, ithin arththaththai enakkuth therivikki'ratha'rkum saasthirika'lum joasiyarum enakku munpaaka azhaiththukko'nduvarappattaarka'l; aanaalum intha vasanaththin arththaththai ve'lippaduththa avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.

poru'lai ve'lippaduththavum, karukalaanavaika'laith the'livikkavum unnaalea koodumen'ru unnaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattean; ippoathum nee intha ezhuththai vaasikkavum, ithin arththaththai enakkuth therivikkavum unnaalea koodumaanaal, nee iraththaamparamum kazhuththilea po'rsarappa'niyum tharikkappattu, raajyaththilea moon'raam athipathiyaay iruppaay en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaniyeal raajasamukaththil pirathiyuththaramaaka: ummudaiya vekumaanangka'l ummidaththileayea irukkattum; ummudaiya parisuka'lai vea'roruvanukkuk kodum; intha ezhuththai naan raajaavukku vaasiththu, ithin arththaththaith therivippean.
raajaavea, unnathamaana theavan ummudaiya pithaavaakiya neapukaathneachchaarukku raajyaththaiyum makaththuvaththaiyum kanaththaiyum makimaiyaiyum koduththaar.

avarukkuk kodukkappatta makaththuvaththinaalea sakala janangka'lum jaathiyaarum paashaikkaararum avarukku munpaaka nadungkip payanthirunthaarka'l; avar thamakkuch siththamaanavanaik kon'rupoaduvaar, thamakkuch siththamaanavanai uyiroadea vaippaar; thamakkuch siththamaanavanai uyarththuvaar, thamakkuch siththamaanavanaith thaazhththuvaar.
avarudaiya iruthayam meattimaiyaaki, avarudaiya aavi karvaththinaalea kadinappattapoathu, avar thamathu singkaasanaththilirunthu tha'l'lappattaar; avarudaiya makimai avaraivittu akan'rupoayit'ru.

avar manusharinin'ru tha'l'lappattaar; avarudaiya iruthayam mirukangka'ludaiya iruthayampoalaayit'ru; kaattukkazhuthaika'loadea sagnchariththaar; unnathamaana theavan manusharin raajyaththil aa'lukaiseythu, thamakkuch siththamaanavanai athinmeal athikaariyaakkuki'raar en'ru avar u'narnthuko'l'lumattum maaduka'laippoal pullai meaynthaar; avarudaiya sareeram aakaayaththup paniyilea nanainthathu.
avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya pelshaathsaar ennum neeroaven'raal, ithaiyellaam a'rinthirunthum, umathu iruthayaththaith thaazhththaamal,

paraloakaththin aa'ndavarukku viroathamaaka ummai uyarththineer; avarudaiya aalayaththin paaththirangka'lai umakku munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l; neerum, ummudaiya pirapukka'lum, ummudaiya manaivika'lum, ummudaiya vaippaattika'lum avaika'lil thiraadcharasam kudiththeerka'l; ithuvuman'ri, thammudaiya kaiyil umathu suvaasaththai vaiththirukki'ravarum, umathu vazhika'lukku ellaam athikaariyumaakiya theavanai neer makimaippaduththaamal kaa'naamalum kea'laamalum u'naraamalum irukki'ra ve'l'liyum ponnum ve'nkalamum irumpum maramum kallumaakiya theavarka'laip pukazhntheer.
appozhuthu anthak kaiyu'ruppu avaraal anuppappattu, intha ezhuththu ezhuthappattathu.
ezhuthappatta ezhuththu ennaven'raal: menea, menea, thekkeal, uppaarsin enpathea.
intha vasanaththin arththamaavathu: menea enpatha'rku, theavan un raajyaththai mattittu, atha'rku mudivu'ndaakkinaar en'rum,
thekkeal enpatha'rku, nee tharaasilea ni'rukkappattu, ku'raiyak kaa'nappattaay en'rum,
pereas enpatha'rku, un raajyam pirikkappattu, meathiyarukkum persiyarukkum kodukkappattathu en'rum arththamaam en'raan.

appozhuthu pelshaathsaar thaaniyealukku iraththaamparaththaiyum, avanudaiya kazhuththil po'rsarappa'niyaiyum tharippikkavum, raajyaththilea avan moon'raam athikaariyaayiruppavan en'ru avanaikku'riththup pa'raimu'raiyidavum katta'laiyittaan.
an'ru iraaththiriyilea kaltheayarin raajaavaakiya pelshaathsaar kolaiseyyappattaan.
meathiyanaakiya thariyu than a'rupaththira'ndaam vayathil raajyaththaik kattikko'ndaan.
raajyam muzhuvathaiyum aa'lumpadikkuth than raajyaththinmeal noot'rirupathu theasaathipathika'laiyum,

raajaavukku nashdam varaathapadikku antha theasaathipathika'l ka'nakku oppuvikki'ratha'rkaaka avarka'lukku mealaaka moon'ru pirathaanika'laiyum ea'rpaduththuvathu thariyuvukku nalamen'ru ka'ndathu; ivarka'lil thaaniyeal oruvanaayirunthaan.

ippadiyirukkaiyil thaaniyeal pirathaanika'lukkum theasaathipathika'lukkum mea'rpattavanaayirunthaan; thaaniyealukku'l viseashiththa aavi irunthamaiyaal avanai raajyam muzhumaikkum athikaariyaaka ea'rpaduththa raajaa ninaiththaan.

appozhuthu pirathaanika'lum theasaathipathika'lum raajyaththin visaarippilea thaaniyealaik kut'rappaduththumpadi mukaantharam theadinaarka'l; aanaalum oru mukaantharaththaiyum kut'raththaiyum ka'ndupidikka avarka'laal koodaathirunthathu; avan u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthapadiyaal avanmeal sumaththa yaathoru kut'ramum ku'raivum kaa'nappadavillai.

appozhuthu antha manushar: naam inthath thaaniyealai avanudaiya theavanaippat'riya veathavishayaththilea kut'rappaduththum mukaantharaththaik ka'ndupidiththaalozhiya avanai vea'ron'rilum kut'rappaduththum mukaantharaththaik ka'ndupidikkakkoodaathu en'raarka'l.
pinpu anthap pirathaanika'lum theasaathipathika'lum koottangkoodi raajaavinidaththil poay, avanai noakki: thariyu raajaavea, neer en'rum vaazhka.

evanaakilum muppathu naa'lvaraiyil raajaavaakiya ummaiththavira enthath theavanaiyaanaalum manushanaiyaanaalum noakki, yaathoru kaariyaththaikku'riththu vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal, avan singkangka'lin kepiyilea poadappada, raajaa katta'lai pi'rappiththu, u'ruthiyaana thaakkeethu seyyavea'ndumen'ru raajyaththinudaiya ellaap pirathaanika'lum, theasaathipathika'lum, pirapukka'lum, manthirimaarka'lum, thalaivarka'lum aaloasanaipa'n'nik ko'ndirukki'raarka'l.

aathalaal ippoathum raajaavea, meathiyarukkum persiyarukkum irukki'ra maa'raatha piramaa'naththinpadiyea, anthath thaakkeethu maat'rappadaathapadi neer athaik katta'laiyittu, atha'rkuk kaiyezhuththu vaikkavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
appadiyea raajaavaakiya thariyu anthak katta'laip paththiraththukkuk kaiyezhuththu vaiththaan.

thaaniyealoaven'raal, anthap paththiraththukkuk kaiyezhuththu vaikkappattathen'ru a'rinthapoathilum, than veettukku'l'leapoay, than meal a'raiyilea erusaleamukku nearaakap palaka'nika'l thi'ranthirukka, angkea thaan mun seythuvanthapadiyea, thinam moon'ru vea'laiyum than theavanukku munpaaka muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu jepampa'n'ni, sthoaththiram seluththinaan.
appozhuthu antha manushar koottangkoodi, thaaniyeal than theavanukku munpaaka jepampa'n'ni vi'n'nappamseyki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l.

pinpu avarka'l raajaavukku munpaaka vanthu, raajaavin thaakkeethaikku'riththu: entha manushanaakilum muppathu naa'lvaraiyil raajaavaakiya ummaiththavira entha theavanaiyaanaalum manushanaiyaanaalum noakki yaathoru kaariyaththaikku'riththu vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal, avan singkangka'lin kepiyilea poadappadavea'ndum en'ru neer katta'laippaththiraththil kaiyezhuththu vaiththeer allavaa en'raarka'l. atha'rku raajaa: anthak kaariyam meathiyarukkum persiyarukkum irukki'ra maa'raatha piramaa'naththinpadi u'ruthiyaakkappattathea en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l raajaavai noakki: si'raipidikkappatta yootheayaa theasaththin puththiraril thaaniyeal enpavan ummaiyum neer kaiyezhuththu vaiththukkoduththa katta'laiyaiyum mathiyaamal, thinam moon'ru vea'laiyum thaan pa'n'num vi'n'nappaththaip pa'n'nuki'raan en'raarka'l.

raajaa intha vaarththaika'laik keattapoathu, thannil mikavum sagnchalappattu, thaaniyealaik kaappaat'rumpadikku avanpearil than manathai vaiththu, avanaith thappuvikki'ratha'rkaakach sooriyan asthamikkumattum pirayaasappattukko'ndirunthaan.

appozhuthu antha manushar raajaavinidaththil koottamaay vanthu: raajaa katta'laiyitta enthath thaakkeethum katta'laiyum maat'rappadakkoodaathenpathu meathiyarukkum persiyarukkum piramaa'namaayirukki'rathen'ru a'riveeraaka en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu raajaa katta'laiyida, avarka'l thaaniyealaik ko'nduvanthu, avanaich singkangka'lin kepiyilea poattaarka'l. raajaa thaaniyealai noakki: nee idaividaamal aaraathikki'ra un theavan unnaith thappuvippaar en'raan.

oru kal kepiyinudaiya vaasalinmeal ko'nduvanthu vaikkappattathu; thaaniyealaippat'riya theermaanam maat'rappadaathapadikku raajaa than moathiraththinaalum than pirapukka'lin moathiraththinaalum athinmeal muththiraipoattaan.

pinpu raajaa than aramanaikkuppoay, iraamuzhuthum poajanampa'n'naamalum, keethavaaththiyam muthalaanavaika'laith thanakku munpaaka varavottaamalum irunthaan; avanukku niththiraiyum varaama'rpoayit'ru.
kaalamea kizhakku ve'lukkumpoathu raajaa ezhunthirunthu, singkangka'lin kepikkuth theeviramaayp poanaan.

raajaa kepiyin kittavanthapoathu, thuyarasaththamaayth thaaniyealaik kooppittu: thaaniyealea, jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya thaasanea, nee idaividaamal aaraathikki'ra un theavan unnaich singkangka'lukkuth thappuvikka vallavaraayirunthaaraa en'ru thaaniyealaik keattaan.
appozhuthu thaaniyeal: raajaavea, neer en'rum vaazhka.

singkangka'l ennaich seathappaduththaathapadikkuth theavan thammudaiya thoothanai anuppi, avaika'lin vaayaik kattippoattaar; atheanen'raal avarukku munpaaka naan kut'ramat'ravanaayk kaa'nappattean; raajaavaakiya umakku munpaakavum naan neethikeadu seythathillai en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa thannil mikavum santhoashappattu, thaaniyealaik kepiyilirunthu thookkividach sonnaan; appadiyea thaaniyeal kepiyilirunthu thookkividappattaan; avan than theavanpearil visuvaasiththirunthapadiyaal, avanil oru seathamum kaa'nappadavillai.

thaaniyealinmeal kut'ragnsaat'rina manusharaiyoaven'raal, raajaa ko'nduvarachsonnaan; avarka'laiyum avarka'l kumaararaiyum avarka'l manaivika'laiyum singkangka'lin kepiyilea poattaarka'l; avarka'l kepiyin adiyilea searumunnea singkangka'l avarka'lmeal paaynthu, avarka'l elumpuka'laiyellaam no'rukkippoattathu.
pinpu raajaavaakiya thariyu theasamengkum kudiyirukki'ra ellaa janangka'lukkum jaathiyaarukkum paashaikkaararukkum ezhuthinathu ennaven'raal: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam perukakkadavathu.

en raajyaththin aa'lukaikku'l engkumu'l'lavarka'l yaavarum thaaniyealin theavanukku munpaaka nadungkip payappadavea'ndumen'ru ennaalea theermaanampa'n'nappaduki'rathu; avar jeevanu'l'la theavan, avar en'ren'raikkum nilaiththirukki'ravar; avarudaiya raajyam azhiyaathathu; avarudaiya karththaththuvam mudivupariyanthamum ni'rkum.

thaaniyealaich singkangka'lin kaikkuth thappuviththa avarea thappuvikki'ravarum iradchikki'ravarum, vaanaththilum poomiyilum adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum seyki'ravarumaayirukki'raar en'ru ezhuthinaan.
thariyuvin raajyapaara kaalaththilum, persiyanaakiya koareasudaiya raajyapaarakaalaththilum thaaniyealin kaariyam jeyamaayirunthathu.

paapiloan raajaavaakiya pelshaathsaarin muthalaam varushaththilea thaaniyeal oru soppanaththaiyum than padukkaiyinmeal than thalaiyil thoan'rina tharisanangka'laiyum ka'ndaan. pinpu avan anthach soppanaththai ezhuthi, kaariyangka'lin thokaiyai vivariththaan.
thaaniyeal sonnathu: iraaththirikaalaththil enakku u'ndaana tharisanaththilea naan ka'ndathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, vaanaththin naalu kaat'ruka'lum periya samuththiraththinmeal adiththathu.
appozhuthu vevvea'ru roopamu'l'la naalu periya mirukangka'l samuththiraththilirunthu ezhumpina.

munthinathu singkaththaippoala irunthathu; atha'rkuk kazhukin settaika'l u'ndaayirunthathu; naan paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, athin i'rakuka'l pidungkappattathu; athu tharaiyilirunthu edukkappattu, manushanaippoala ira'ndu kaalinmeal nimirnthu ni'rkumpadi seyyappattathu; manusha iruthayam atha'rkuk kodukkappattathu.

pinpu, karadikku oppaakiya vea'rea ira'ndaam mirukaththaik ka'ndean; athu oru pakkamaaych saaynthunin'ru, than vaayin pa'rka'lukku'l'lea moon'ru vilaavelumpuka'laik kavvikko'ndirunthathu; ezhumpi veku maamsam thinnen'ru atha'rkuch sollappattathu.

athinpinpu, sivingkiyaippoalirukki'ra vea'roru mirukaththaik ka'ndean; athin muthukinmeal padchiyin settaika'l naalu irunthathu; antha mirukaththukku naalu thalaika'lum u'ndaayirunthathu; atha'rku aa'lukai a'likkappattathu.

atha'rkuppinpu, iraaththarisanangka'lil naalaam mirukaththaik ka'ndean; athu kediyum payangkaramum makaa palaththathumaayirunthathu; atha'rkup periya iruppuppa'rka'l irunthathu; athu no'rukkip padchiththu, meethiyaanathaith than kaalka'laal mithiththuppoattathu; athu thanakku munniruntha ellaa mirukangka'laippaarkkilum veat'ruruvamaayirunthathu, atha'rkup paththuk kompuka'l irunthathu.

anthak kompuka'lai naan kavaniththirukkaiyil, ithoa, avaika'lukku idaiyilea vea'roru sinna kompu ezhumpit'ru; atha'rku munpaaka munthina kompuka'lil moon'ru pidungkappattathu; ithoa, anthak kompilea manushaka'nka'lukku oppaana ka'nka'lum perumaiyaanavaika'laip peasum vaayum irunthathu.

naan paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, singkaasanangka'l vaikkappattathu; nee'nda aayusu'l'lavar veet'rirunthaar; avarudaiya vasthiram u'raintha mazhaiyaippoalavum, avarudaiya sirasin mayir ve'nmaiyaakavum pagnchaippoalath thuppuravaakavum irunthathu; avarudaiya singkaasanam akkinijuvaalaiyum, athin sakkarangka'l eriki'ra neruppumaayirunthathu.

akkini nathi avar sannithiyilirunthu pu'rappattu oadinathu; aayiramaayirampear avaraich seaviththaarka'l; koadaakoadipear avarukku munpaaka nin'raarka'l; niyaayasangkam udkaarnthathu; pusthakangka'l thi'rakkappattathu.

appozhuthu naan paarththean; naan paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil anthak kompu perumaiyaana peachchuka'laip peasinathinimiththam antha mirukam kolaiseyyappattathu; athin udal azhikkappattu, eriki'ra akkinikku oppukkodukkappattathu.
mat'ra mirukangka'ludaiya aa'lukaiyoaven'raal, avaika'lai vittu neekkappattathu; aanaalum, avaika'lukkuk kaalamum samayamum aakumattum avaika'l uyiroadea irukkumpadi katta'laiyidappattathu.

iraaththarisanangka'lilea naan paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, manushakumaaranudaiya saayalaana oruvar vaanaththu meakangka'ludanea vanthaar; avar nee'nda aayusu'l'lavar idamattum vanthu, avar sameepaththil ko'nduvarappattaar.

sakala janangka'lum jaathiyaarum, paashaikkaararum avaraiyea seavikkumpadi, avarukkuk karththaththuvamum makimaiyum raajarikamum kodukkappattathu; avarudaiya karththaththuvam neengkaatha niththiya karththaththuvamum, avarudaiya raajyam azhiyaathathumaayirukkum.
thaaniyealaakiya naan en theakaththinu'l en aaviyilea sagnchalappattean; en thalaiyil thoan'rina tharisanangka'l ennaik kalangkappa'n'ninathu.

sameepaththil ni'rki'ravarka'lil oruvanidaththil naan poay, ithan poru'l ellaavat'raiyum enakkuch sollumpadi avanai vea'ndikko'ndean; avan anthak kaariyangka'lin arththaththai enakku a'riviththuch sonnathu ennaven'raal:
antha naalu periya mirukangka'lum poomiyilirunthu ezhumpuki'ra naalu raajaakka'l.
aanaalum unnathamaanavarudaiya parisuththavaanka'l raajarikaththaip pet'ru, en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum raajyaththaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu mat'ravaika'laiyellaam paarkkilum veat'ruruvum kediyumu'l'lathumaay, iruppup pa'rka'lum, ve'nkala nakangka'lumudaiyathaay no'rukkip padchiththu, meethiyaanathaith than kaalka'laal mithiththuppoattathumaayiruntha naalaam mirukaththaikku'riththum,

athin thalaimealu'l'la paththuk kompuka'laikku'riththum, thanakku munpaaka moon'ru kompuka'l vizhunthupoaka ezhumpinathumaay, ka'nka'laiyum perumaiyaanavaika'laip peasum vaayaiyumudaiyathumaay, mat'ravaika'laippaarkkilum parumanaakath thoan'rinathumaayiruntha antha vea'rea kompaikku'riththum, avat'rin poru'lai a'riya manathaayirunthean.

nee'nda aayusu'l'lavar varumattaakavum, niyaayavisaarippu unnathamaanavarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukkuk kodukkappattu, parisuththavaanka'l raajyaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lum kaalam varumattaakavum,
inthak kompu parisuththavaanka'loadea yuththampa'n'ni, avarka'lai mea'rko'ndathu en'ru ka'ndean.
avan sonnathu: naalaam mirukam poomiyilea u'ndaakum naalaam raajyamaam; athu ellaa raajyangka'laippaarkkilum vea'raayirunthu, poomiyai ellaam padchiththu, athai mithiththu, athai no'rukkippoadum.

anthap paththukkompuka'l ennaven'raal, antha raajyaththilea ezhumpum paththu raajaakka'laam; avarka'lukkuppinpu vea'roruvan ezhumpuvaan; avan munthinavarka'laippaarkkilum vea'raayirunthu, moon'ru raajaakka'laith thaazhththippoattu,

unnathamaanavarukku viroathamaaka vaarththaika'laip peasi, unnathamaanavarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lai odukki, kaalangka'laiyum piramaa'nangka'laiyum maat'ra ninaippaan; avarka'l oru kaalamum, kaalangka'lum, araikkaalamum sellumattum avan kaiyil oppukkodukkappaduvaarka'l.
aanaalum niyaayasangkam udkaarum; appozhuthu mudivupariyantham avanaich sangkarikkumpadiyaakavum azhikkumpadiyaakavum avanudaiya aa'lukaiyai neekkippoaduvaarka'l.

vaanaththin keezhengkumu'l'la raajyangka'lin raajarikamum aa'lukaiyum makaththuvamum unnathamaanavarudaiya parisuththavaanka'laakiya janangka'lukkuk kodukkappadum; avarudaiya raajyam niththiya raajyam; sakala karththaththuvangka'lum avaraich seaviththu, avarukkuk keezhppattirukkum en'raan.
avan sonna vaarththai iththoadea mudinthathu. thaaniyealaakiya naan en ninaivuka'laal mikavum kalangkinean; en mukam vea'rupattathu; inthak kaariyaththai en manathilea vaiththukko'ndean.

thaaniyealaakiya enakku muthalil kaa'npikkappatta tharisanaththukkup pinpu, raajaavaakiya pelshaathsaar raajyapaarampa'n'nina moon'raam varushaththilea vea'roru tharisanam enakkuk kaa'npikkappattathu.

tharisanaththilea naan ka'ndathu ennaven'raal: naan paarkkaiyil ealaam theasaththilu'l'la soosaan aramanaiyil irunthean; angkea naan oolaay ennum aat'rangkaraiyil irunthathaakath tharisanaththilea ka'ndean.

naan en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththean; ithoa, ira'ndu kompuka'lu'l'la oru aattukkadaa aat'ri'rku munpaaka nin'rathu; athin ira'ndu kompuka'lum uyarnthavaika'laayirunthathu; aakilum avaika'lil on'ru mat'rathaippaarkkilum uyarnthirunthathu; uyarnthakompu pinthi mu'laiththezhumpit'ru.

antha aattukkadaa mea'rkum vadakkum the'rkum paayki'rathaik ka'ndean; oru mirukamum athin munnea ni'rkakkoodaathirunthathu; athin kaikkuth thappuvippaarumillai; athu than ishdappadiyea seythu vallamaiko'ndathu.

naan athaik kavaniththukko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, mea'rkeayirunthu oru ve'l'laattukkadaa nilaththilea kaal paavaamal theasaththinmeethengkum sen'rathu; antha ve'l'laattukkadaavin ka'nka'lukku naduvea viseashiththa oru kompu irunthathu.
naan aat'rin munpaaka ni'rkakka'nda ira'ndu kompuka'lu'l'la aattukkadaavinidamattum athu vanthu, than palaththin ukkiraththoadea atha'rku ethiraakap paaynthathu.

athu aattukkadaavin kittach searakka'ndean; athu aattukkadaavinmeal kadungkoapangko'ndu, athai mutti, athin ira'ndu kompuka'laiyum mu'riththuppoattathu; athin mun ni'rka aattukkadaavukkup palamillaamaiyaal, ve'l'laattukkadaa athaith tharaiyilea tha'l'li mithiththuppoattathu; athin kaikku aattukkadaavaith thappuvippaar illai.

appozhuthu ve'l'laattukkadaa mikuthiyum vallamaiko'ndathu; athu palangko'ndirukkaiyil, anthap periya kompu mu'rinthupoayit'ru; atha'rkup pathilaaka aakaayaththin naalu thisaika'lukkum ethiraay viseashiththa naalukompuka'l mu'laiththezhumpinathu.
avaika'lil on'rilirunthu sinnathaana oru kompu pu'rappattu, the'rkukkum, kizhakkukkum ethiraakavum, singkaaramaana theasaththukku nearaakavum mikavum periyathaayit'ru.
athu vaanaththin seanaipariyantham va'larnthu, athin seanaiyaakiya nadchaththirangka'lil silavat'raip poomiyilea vizhappa'n'ni, avaika'lai mithiththathu.
athu seanaiyinudaiya athipathi pariyanthamum thannai uyarththi, avaridaththilirunthu an'raada paliyai neekkit'ru; avarudaiya parisuththa sthaanam tha'l'lu'ndathu.
paathakaththinimiththam an'raada paliyoadungkoodach seanaiyum atha'rku oppukkodukkappattathu; athu saththiyaththaith tharaiyilea tha'l'lit'ru; athu kiriyaiseythu anukoolamadainthathu.

parisuththavaanaakiya oruvan peasakkeattean; appozhuthu vea'roru parisuththavaan peasinavarai noakki: an'raada paliyaikku'riththum, paazhkkadippai u'ndaakkum paathakaththaikku'riththum, parisuththa sthalamum seanaiyum mithipada oppukkodukkappaduvathaikku'riththum, u'ndaana tharisanam ethuvaraikkum irukkum en'ru keattaan.
avan ennai noakki: ira'ndaayiraththu munnoo'ru iraappakal sellumvaraikkum irukkum; pinpu parisuththasthalam suththikarikkappadum en'raan.
thaaniyealaakiya naan inthath tharisanaththaikka'ndu, athin poru'lai a'riya vakaitheadukaiyil, ithoa, manushasaayalaana oruvan enakku ethirea nin'raan.
an'riyum kaapiriyealea, ivanukkuth tharisanaththai vi'langkappa'n'nen'ru oolaayin maththiyilea kooppittuch solluki'ra oru manusha saththaththaiyum keattean.

appozhuthu avan naan nin'ra idaththukku vanthaan; avan varukaiyil naan thidukkittu mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthean; avan ennai noakki: manupuththiranea kavani; inthath tharisanam mudivukaalaththukku aduththathu en'raan.
avan ennoadea peasukaiyil, naan tharaiyil mukangkuppu'rak kidanthu, ayarntha niththiraiko'ndean; avanoa ennaith thottu, naan kaaloon'ri ni'rkumpadi seythu:
ithoa, koapaththin mudivukaalaththilea sampavippathai unakkuth therivippean; ithu ku'rikkappatta mudivukaalaththukku aduththathu.
nee ka'nda ira'ndu kompu'l'la aattukkadaa meathiyaa persiyaa theasangka'lin raajaakka'l;
roamamu'l'la antha ve'l'laattukkadaa kireakku theasaththin raajaa; athin ka'nka'lukku naduvea iruntha periya kompu athin muthalaam raajaa;
athu mu'rinthupoanapinpu atha'rkup pathilaaka naalu kompuka'l ezhumpinathu ennaven'raal, antha jaathiyilea naalu raajyangka'l ezhumpum; aanaalum avanukku iruntha vallamai avaika'lukku iraathu.
avarka'ludaiya raajyapaaraththin kadaisikkaalaththiloaven'raal, paathakarudaiya paathakam ni'raivea'rumpoathu, moorkka mukamum soothaana peachchumu'l'la saamarththiyamaana oru raajaa ezhumpuvaan.

avanudaiya vallamai perukum; aanaalum avanudaiya suyapalaththinaal alla, avan athisayamaanavithamaaka azhimpu'ndaakki, anukoolam pet'rukkiriyaiseythu, palavaanka'laiyum parisuththa janangka'laiyum azhippaan.

avan than upaayaththinaal vagnchakaththaik kaikoodivarappa'n'ni, than iruthayaththil perumaiko'ndu, nirvisaaraththoadirukki'ra aneakarai azhiththu, athipathika'lukku athipathiyaayirukki'ravarukku viroathamaay ezhumpuvaan; aanaalum avan kaiyinaalalla vea'ruvithamaay mu'riththuppoadappaduvaan.
sollappatta iraappakalka'lin tharisanam saththiyamaayirukki'rathu; aathalaal inthath tharisanaththai nee ma'raiththuvai; atha'rku innum aneakanaa'l sellum en'raan.

thaaniyealaakiya naan soarvadainthu, silanaa'l viyaathippattirunthean; pinpu naan ezhunthirunthu, raajaavin vealaiyaich seythu, anthath tharisanaththinaal thikaiththukko'ndirunthean; oruvarum athai a'riyavillai.
kaltheayarudaiya raajyaththinmeal raajaavaakkappatta meathiya kulaththaanaakiya akaasvearuvin puththiranaana thariyu raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'ra muthalaam varushaththilea,

thaaniyealaakiya naan erusaleamin paazhkkadippuka'l ni'raivea'riththeera ezhupathuvarusham sellumen'ru karththar ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyoadea solliya varushangka'lin thokaiyaip pusthakangka'laal a'rinthuko'ndean.
naan upavaasampa'n'ni, irattilum saampalilum udkaarnthu, theavanaakiya aa'ndavarai jepaththinaalum vi'n'nappangka'linaalum theada enmukaththai avarukku nearaakki,

en theavanaakiya karththarai noakki jepampa'n'ni, paava a'rikkaiseythu: aa aa'ndavarea, ummil anpukoornthu, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku udanpadikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaiyum kaakki'ra makaththuvamum payangkaramumaana theavanea,
naangka'l paavagnseythu, akkiramakkaararaayirunthu, thunmaarkkamaay nadanthu, kalakampa'n'ni, ummudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum ummudaiya niyaayangka'laiyum vittu akan'rupoanoam.

umathu naamaththinaalea engka'l raajaakka'loadum engka'l pirapukka'loadum engka'l pithaakka'loadum theasaththinudaiya sakala janangka'loadum peasina theerkkatharisika'laakiya ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanoam.

aa'ndavarea, neethi umakkea uriyathu; umakku viroathamaakach seytha thuroakaththinimiththam ummaalea sameepamum thooramumaana ellaa theasangka'lilum thuraththappattirukki'ra yoothamanusharum erusaleamin kudika'lum sakala isravealarumaakiya naangka'l innaa'lil irukki'rapadiyea, vedkam engka'lukkea uriyathu.
aa'ndavarea, umakku viroathamaakap paavagnseythapadiyaal, naangka'lum engka'l raajaakka'lum engka'l pirapukka'lum engka'l pithaakka'lum vedkaththukkuriyavarka'laanoam.

avarukku viroathamaaka naangka'l kalakampa'n'ni, avar theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararaikko'ndu engka'lukku munpaakavaiththa avarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nangka'linpadi nadakkaththakkathaaka naangka'l avarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanoam.
aanaalum engka'l theavanaakiya aa'ndavaridaththil irakkangka'lum mannippuka'lum u'ndu.

isravealar ellaarum umathu niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'ri, umathu saththaththukkuch sevikodaamal vilakippoanaarka'l. avarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythoam; aakaiyaal theavanudaiya thaasanaakiya moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra saapamum aa'naiyaakkinaiyum engka'lmeal soriyappattana.

erusaleamil sampaviththathupoala vaanaththinkeezh engkum sampaviyaathirukki'ra periya theengkai engka'lmeal varappa'n'ninathinaal, avar engka'lukkum engka'lai niyaayantheerththa niyaayaathipathika'lukkum viroathamaakach solliyiruntha thammudaiya vaarththaika'lai ni'raiveat'rinaar.

moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'nap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea inthath theengkellaam engka'lmeal vanthathu; aanaalum naangka'l engka'l akkiramangka'lai vittuth thirumpuki'ratha'rkum, ummudaiya saththiyaththaik kavanikki'ratha'rkum, engka'l theavanaakiya karththarin mukaththai noakkik kegnchinathillai.

aathalaal karththar kavanamaayirunthu, anthath theengkai engka'lmeal varappa'n'ninaar; engka'l theavanaakiya karththar thaam seythuvaruki'ra thammudaiya kiriyaika'lil ellaam neethiyu'l'lavar; naangka'loa avarudaiya saththaththukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanoam.

ippoathum umathu janaththaip palaththa kaiyinaal ekipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'rapadi, umakkuk keerththiyai u'ndaakkina engka'l theavanaakiya aa'ndavarea, naangka'l paavagnseythu, thunmaarkkaraay nadanthoam.

aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya sarvaneethiyinpadiyea, umathu koapamum umathu ukkiramum ummudaiya parisuththa parvathamaakiya erusaleam ennum ummudaiya nakaraththai vittuth thirumpumpadi seyyum; engka'l paavangka'linaalum engka'l pithaakka'lin akkiramangka'linaalum erusaleamum ummudaiya janamaakiya naangka'lum engka'l sut'ruppu'raththaar yaavarukkum ninthaiyaanoam.

ippoathum engka'l theavanea, neer umathu adiyaanudaiya vi'n'nappaththaiyum avanudaiya kegnchuthalaiyum keattu, paazhaayk kidakki'ra ummudaiya parisuththa sthalaththinmeal aa'ndavarinimiththam umathu mukaththaip pirakaasikkappa'n'num.

en theavanea, ummudaiya seviyaich saayththuk keattaru'lum; ummudaiya ka'nka'laith thi'ranthu, engka'l paazhidangka'laiyum, umathu naamam tharikkappattirukki'ra nakaraththaiyum paarththaru'lum; naangka'l engka'l neethika'lai alla, ummudaiya mikuntha irakkangka'laiyea nampi, engka'l vi'n'nappangka'lai umakku munpaakach seluththuki'roam.

aa'ndavarea kea'lum, aa'ndavarea manniyum, aa'ndavarea kavaniyum; en theavanea, ummudaiya nimiththamaaka athaith thaamathiyaamal seyyum; ummudaiya nakaraththukkum ummudaiya janaththukkum ummudaiya naamam tharikkappattirukki'rathea en'rean.

ippadi naan solli, jepampa'n'ni, en paavaththaiyum en janamaakiya isravealin paavaththaiyum a'rikkaiyittu, en theavanudaiya parisuththa parvathaththukkaaka en vi'n'nappaththai en theavanaakiya karththarukku munpaakach seluththikko'ndirunthean.
appadi naan jepampa'n'nikko'ndirukkumpoathea, muthal tharisanaththilea naan ka'nda purushanaakiya kaapiriyeal, veakamaayp pa'ranthuvanthu, anthippaliyin nearamaakiya vea'laiyilea ennaith thottaan.
avan enakkuth the'livu'ndaakki, ennoadeapeasi: thaaniyealea, unakku a'rivai u'narththumpadi ippoathu pu'rappattuvanthean.

nee mikavum piriyamaanavan, aathalaal, nee vea'ndikko'l'lath thodangkinapoathea katta'lai ve'lippattathu, naan athai a'rivikkavanthean; ippoathum solluki'ra vaarththaiyai nee kavaniththukkeattu, tharisanaththai a'rinthuko'l.

mee'ruthalaith thavirkki'ratha'rkum, paavangka'laith tholaikki'ratha'rkum, akkiramaththai nivirththipa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum, niththiya neethiyai varuvikki'ratha'rkum, tharisanaththaiyum theerkkatharisanaththaiyum muththirikki'ratha'rkum, makaa parisuththamu'l'lavarai apisheakampa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum, un janaththinmealum un parisuththa nakaraththinmealum ezhupathu vaarangka'l sellumpadi ku'rikkappattirukki'rathu.

ippoathum nee a'rinthu u'narnthuko'l'lavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: erusaleamaith thirumpa eduppiththuk kattuki'ratha'rkaana katta'lai ve'lippaduvathumuthal, pirapuvaakiya measiyaa varumattum eazhu vaaramum, a'rupaththira'ndu vaaramum sellum; avaika'lil veethika'lum alangkangka'lum ma'rupadiyum kattappadum; aanaalum idukkamaana kaalangka'lil ippadiyaakum.

antha a'rupaththira'ndu vaarangka'lukkup pinpu measiyaa sangkarikkappaduvaar; aanaalum thamakkaaka alla; nakaraththaiyum parisuththa sthalaththaiyum varappoaki'ra pirapuvin janangka'l azhiththuppoaduvaarka'l; athin mudivu jalappiravaakampoala irukkum; mudivupariyantham yuththamum naasamum u'ndaaka niyamikkappattathu.

avar oru vaarama'lavum aneakarukku udanpadikkaiyai u'ruthippaduththi, antha vaaram paathi sen'rapoathu paliyaiyum kaa'nikkaiyaiyum ozhiyappa'n'nuvaar; aruvaruppaana settaika'loadea paazhaakkuki'ravan vanthu i'rangkuvaan, nir'nayikkappattirukki'ra nirmoolam paazhaakkuki'ravanmeal theerumattum soriyum en'raan.

persiyaavin raajaavaakiya koareas arasaa'nda moon'raam varushaththilea peltheshaathsaar en'ru peyaridappatta thaaniyealukku oru kaariyam ve'liyaakkappattathu; anthak kaariyam saththiyamum neediya yuththaththukku aduththathumaayirukki'rathu; anthak kaariyaththai avan kavaniththu, tharisanaththin poru'lai a'rinthuko'ndaan.
antha naadka'lil thaaniyealaakiya naan moon'ru vaaramuzhuvathum thukkiththukko'ndirunthean.

antha moon'ru vaarangka'laakiya naadka'l ni'raivea'rumattum rusikaramaana appaththai naan pusikkavumillai, i'raichchiyum thiraadcharasamum en vaaykku'l poakavumillai, naan parima'lathailam poosikko'l'lavumillai.
muthalaam maatham irupaththunaalaan theathiyilea naan ithekkeal ennum periya aat'rangkaraiyil irunthu,
en ka'nka'lai ea'redukkaiyil, sa'nal vasthiranthariththu, thamathu araiyil ooppaasin thangkakkachchaiyaik kattikko'ndirukki'ra oru purushanaik ka'ndean.

avarudaiya sareeram padikappachchaiyaippoalavum, avarudaiya mukam minnalin pirakaasaththaippoalavum, avarudaiya ka'nka'l eriki'ra theepangka'laippoalavum, avarudaiya puyangka'lum avarudaiya kaalka'lum thulakkappatta ve'nkala ni'raththaippoalavum, avarudaiya vaarththaika'lin saththam janakkoottaththin aaravaaraththaippoalavum irunthathu.
