thaaniyealaakiya naan maaththiram anthath tharisanaththaik ka'ndean; ennoadea iruntha manusharoa anthath tharisanaththaik kaa'navillai; avarka'l mikavum nadunadungki, oadi o'liththukko'ndaarka'l.
naan thaniththuvidappattu anthap periya tharisanaththaik ka'ndean; en pelanellaam poayit'ru; en uruvam maa'ri vaadippoayit'ru; thidanat'ruppoanean.

avarudaiya vaarththaika'lin saththaththaik keattean; avarudaiya vaarththaika'lin saththaththai naan keadkumpoathu, naan mukangkavizhnthu, niththirai poaki'ravanaayth tharaiyilea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthukidanthean.
ithoa, oruvan kai ennaith thottu, en muzhangkaalka'lum en u'l'langkaika'lum tharaiyai oon'riyirukka ennaith thookkivaiththathu.

avan ennai noakki: piriyamaana purushanaakiya thaaniyealea, naan ippoathu unnidaththi'rku anuppappattu vanthean; aathalaal, naan unakkuch sollum vaarththaika'linpearil nee kavanamaayirunthu, kaal oon'ri nil en'raan; intha vaarththaiyai avan ennidaththil sollukaiyil nadukkaththoadea ezhunthu nin'rean.

appozhuthu avan ennai noakki: thaaniyealea, payappadaathea; nee a'rivai adaiki'ratha'rkum, unnai unnudaiya theavanukku munpaakach si'rumaippaduththuki'ratha'rkum, un manathaich seluththina muthalnaa'l thuvakki un vaarththaika'l keadkappattathu; un vaarththaika'linimiththam naan vanthean.

persiyaa raajyaththin athipathi irupaththoru naa'lmattum ennoadu ethirththu nin'raan; aanaalum pirathaana athipathika'lil oruvanaakiya mikaaveal enakku uthaviyaaka vanthaan; aathalaal naan angkea persiyaavin raajaakka'lidaththil thariththirunthean.
ippoathum kadaisinaadka'lil un janangka'lukkuch sampavippathai unakkuth theriyappa'n'numpadikku vanthean; inthath tharisanam ni'raivea'ra innum naa'l sellum en'raan.
avan intha vaarththaika'lai ennoadea sollukaiyil, naan thalaikavizhnthu, tharaiyai noakki, peachchat'ruppoanean.

appozhuthu manupuththirarin saayalaakiya oruvan en uthaduka'laith thottaan; udanea naan en vaayaith thi'ranthu peasi, enakku ethirea nin'ravanai noakki: en aa'ndavanea, tharisanaththinaal en moottuka'l pura'ndana, pelanat'ruppoanean.
aakaiyaal en aa'ndavanudaiya adiyean en aa'ndavanoadea peasakkooduvatheppadi? ini ennil pelanillai, ennil moochchumillai en'rean.
appozhuthu manusha roopamaana oruvan thirumpa ennaith thottu, ennaith thidappaduththi,

piriyamaana purushanea, payappadaathea, unakkuch samaathaanamu'ndaavathaaka, thidangko'l, thidangko'l en'raan; ippadi avan ennoadea peasukaiyil naan thidangko'ndu avanai noakki: en aa'ndavan peasuvaaraaka; ennaith thidappaduththineerea en'rean.

appozhuthu avan: naan unnidaththi'rku vantha kaara'nam innathen'ru unakkuth theriyumaa? ippoathu naan persiyaavin pirapuvoadea yuththampa'n'nath thirumpippoaki'rean; naan poanapinpu, kireakku theasaththin athipathi varuvaan.
saththiya ezhuththilea ka'ndirukki'rathai naan unakkuth therivippean; ungka'l athipathiyaakiya mikaavealaiththavira ennoadeakooda avarka'lukku viroathamaayp palangko'l'luki'ra vea'roruvarum illai.
meathiyanaakiya thariyu arasaa'nda muthalaam varushaththilea naan avanaith thidappaduththavum palappaduththavum avanukkuth thu'nai nin'rean.

ippoathu naan meyyaana seythiyai unakku a'rivippean; ithoa, innum moon'ru raajaakka'l persiyaavil ezhumpuvaarka'l; athinpinpu naalaam raajaavaayiruppavan ellaarilum makaa aisuvariya sampannanaaki, than aisuvariyaththinaal palangko'ndu, kireakku raajyaththukku viroathamaakach sakalaraiyum ezhuppividuvaan.
aanaalum paraakkiramamu'l'la oru raajaa ezhumpi, pirapalamaay aa'ndu, thanakku ishdamaanapadi seyvaan.

avan ezhumpinapinpu, avanudaiya raajyam udainthupoay, vaanaththin naalu thisaika'lilum pakukkappadum; aanaalum athu avanudaiya santhathiyaarukku alla, avan seytha aa'lukaiyinpadiyum alla; avanudaiya raajyam pidungkappattu, avanudaiyavarka'lallaatha vea'reapearka'lidamaayth thaa'ndippoam.
then'risai raajaa palavaanaayiruppaan; aanaalum avanudaiya pirapukka'lil oruvan avanaippaarkkilum palavaanaaki aa'luvaan; ivanudaiya aa'lukai palaththa aa'lukaiyaayirukkum.

avarka'l sila varushangka'lukkuppinpu, oruvaroadoruvar sampanthampa'n'numpadikkuth then'risai raajaavin kumaaraththi vadathisai raajaavinidaththil varuvaa'l; aanaalum ava'lukkup puyapalam iraama'rpoam; avanum avanudaiya puyamum nilaini'rpathillai; ava'lum ava'lai azhaiththuvanthavarka'lum, ava'laip pet'ravanum, ava'lai akkaalangka'lil palappaduththinavanum oppukkodukkappaduvaarka'l.
aanaalum ava'ludaiya vearka'lin ki'laiyaakiya oruvan than sthaanaththil ezhumpi, iraa'nuvaththoadea vanthu, vadathisai raajaavin ara'nippukku'l piraveasiththu, avarka'lai viroathiththu,

avarka'ludaiya athipathika'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya vilaiyea'rappet'ra ve'l'liyum ponnumaakiya paaththirangka'laiyum, avarka'ludaiya theyvangka'laiyungkooda ekipthukkuk ko'ndupoay, sila varushangka'lmattum vadathisai raajaavaippaarkkilum nilaiyaay ni'rpaan.
then'risai raajaa avan raajyaththukku viroathamaaka vanthu, than theasaththukkuth thirumpippoavaan.

aanaalum avanudaiya kumaarar yuththagnseyya eththaniththu, thira'laana seanaika'laik koottuvaarka'l; ivarka'lil oruvan nichchayamaay vanthu, ve'l'lampoalak kadanthu, thirumpavum thannudaiya ara'nmattum yuththangkalanthu searuvaan.

appozhuthu then'risai raajaa kadungkoapangko'ndu pu'rappattuppoay, vadathisai raajaavoadea yuththampa'n'nuvaan; ivan periya seanaiyai eakamaay ni'ruththuvaan; aanaalum inthach seanai avan kaiyil oppukkodukkappadum.
avan inthach seanaiyai neekkinapinpu, avanudaiya iruthayam karvangko'l'lum; avan aneakamaayirampearai madivippaan; aanaalum palangko'l'lamaattaan.
sila varushangka'l sen'rapinpu vadathisai raajaa thirumpa munthina seanaiyilum perithaana seanaiyaich searththu, makaa periya seanaiyoadum veku sampaththoadum nichchayamaay varuvaan.

akkaalangka'lil then'risai raajaavukku viroathamaaka aneakar ezhumpuvaarka'l; appozhuthu un janaththilu'l'la thu'ndarikkakkaararin puththirar tharisanaththai ni'raiveat'rath thangka'lai uyarththuvaarka'l.

vadathisai raajaa vanthu, koththa'lam poattu, ara'naana nakarangka'laip pidippaan; then'risai raajaavin puyapalangka'lum avan therinthuko'nda janamum nillaama'rpoam; ethirkki'ratha'rkup pelan iraathu.
aakaiyaal avanukku viroathamaaka varuki'ravan than ishdappadich seyvaan; avanukku munpaaka nilaini'rpavan oruvanum illai; avan singkaaramaana theasaththil thangkuvaan; ellaam avan kaivasamaakum.

than raajyaththin vallamaiyoadellaam thaanum thannoadeakoodach semmaimaarkkaththaarum vara, ivan than mukaththaith thiruppuvaan; ippadich seythu keduthiyu'ndaakumpadi avanukku oru kannippe'n'naik koduppaan, aanaalum ava'laalea sthirampe'raan; ava'l avan padchaththil nillaa'l.

pinpu ivan than mukaththaith theevuka'lukku nearaakath thiruppi, aneakan theevuka'laip pidippaan; aanaalum oru seanaapathi ivan seyki'ra ninthaiyai ozhiyappa'n'nuvathumallaamal, ivan seytha ninthaiyinimiththam ivanukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattuvaan.
aakaiyaal than mukaththaith than theasaththin ara'nka'lukku nearaakath thiruppuvaan; angkea ida'rivizhunthu kaa'nappadaama'rpoavaan.
sezhippaana raajyaththil tha'ndalkaaranaith thiriyappa'n'nuki'ra oruvan than sthaanaththil ezhumpuvaan; aakilum silanaa'laikku'l koapamillaamalum yuththamillaamalum naasamadaivaan.

avan sthaanaththil avamathikkappattavan oruvan ezhumpuvaan; ivanukku raajyapaaraththin meanmaiyaik kodaathiruppaarka'l; aanaalum ivan samaathaanamaay nuzhainthu, ichchakampeasi, raajyaththaik kattikko'l'luvaan.
piravaakamaay varuki'ra seanaika'l ivanaalea piravaakamaay mu'rikkappadum; udanpadikkaiyin thalaivanum mu'rikkappaduvaan.
eanen'raal avanoadea sampanthampa'n'nina naadka'lmuthal avan soothaay nadanthu, kogncham janangka'loadea pu'rappattuvanthu pelangko'l'luvaan.

theasam sukavaazhvoadum sampoora'naththoadum irukkaiyil, avan udpiraveasiththu, than pithaakka'lum than pithaakka'lin pithaakka'lum seyyaathathaich seyvaan, ko'l'laiyittuch soo'raiyaadi, poru'lai avarka'lukku i'raiththup pangkittu, ara'nka'lukku viroathamaakath thanakku'l upaayangka'lai yoasippaan; silakaalamattum ippadiyirukkum.

pinnum then'risai raajaavukku viroathamaakap periya seanaiyoadea poarseyyath than vallamaiyaiyum than sthiraththaiyum ezhuppuvaan; appozhuthu then'risai raajaa mikavum palaththa periya iraa'nuvaththoadea poay yuththangkalappaan; aanaalum avarka'l avanukku viroathamaakath thuraaloasanai pa'n'niyirunthapadiyaal, avan ni'rkamaattaan.
avanudaiya poajanangka'laich saappiduki'ravarka'l avanai naasappaduththuvaarka'l; aakaiyaal avanudaiya iraa'nuvam piravaakamaay varum; aneakar kolaiyu'ndu vizhuvaarka'l.

intha ira'ndu raajaakka'lin iruthayamum theemai seyya ninaikkum; orea panthiyilirunthu poypeasuvaarka'l; aanaalum athu vaayppathillai; ku'riththakaalaththukku mudivu innum ni'ruththivaikkappattirukkum.
avan makaa sampaththoadea than theasaththukkuth thirumpi, than iruthayaththaip parisuththa udanpadikkaikku viroathamaaka vaiththu, atha'rkaanathaich seythu, than theasaththukkuth thirumpip poavaan.
ku'riththakaalaththilea thirumpavum thentheasaththi'rku varuvaan; aanaalum avanudaiya pinnadapadi munnadapadiyaippoal iraathu.

avanukku viroathamaakak kiththeemin kappalka'l varum; athinaal avan mananoavadainthu, thirumpippoay, parisuththa udanpadikkaikku viroathamaakak kuroathangko'ndu, atha'rkaanathaich seythu, parisuththa udanpadikkaiyaith tha'l'linavarka'lai anusarippaan.
aanaalum avanidaththilirunthu pu'rappattaseanaika'l ezhumpi, ara'naana parisuththa sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, an'raadapaliyai neekki, paazhaakkum aruvaruppai angkea vaippaarka'l.

udanpadikkaikkuth thuroakika'laayirukki'ravarka'lai ichchakappeachchuka'linaal ka'l'lamaarkkaththaaraakkuvaan; thangka'l theavanai a'rinthirukki'ra janangka'l thidangko'ndu, atha'rkeat'rapadi seyvaarka'l.
janangka'lil a'rivaa'lika'l aneakarukku a'rivai u'narththuvaarka'l; aneakanaa'lmattum pattayaththinaalum akkiniyinaalum si'raiyiruppinaalum ko'l'laiyinaalum vizhuvaarka'l.
ippadi avarka'l vizhukaiyil kogncham oththaasaiyaal sakaayamadaivaarka'l; appozhuthu aneakar ichchakavaarththaika'loadea avarka'lai ottikko'lvaarka'l.

a'rivaa'lika'laip pudamiduki'ratha'rkum, suththikarikki'ratha'rkum, ve'nmaiyaakkuki'ratha'rkum avarka'lil silar vizhuvaarka'l; mudivukaalapariyantham ippadiyirukkum; ku'riththakaalam vara innum naa'l sellum.

raajaa thanakku ishdamaanapadi seythu, thannai uyarththi, enthath theavanilum thannaip periyavanaakki, theavaathitheavanukku viroathamaaka aachchariyamaana kaariyangka'laip peasuvaan; koapam theerumattum avanukkuk kaikoodivarum; nir'nayikkappattathu nadanthea'rum.
avan than pithaakka'lin theavarka'lai mathiyaamalum, sthireeka'lin sineakaththaiyum, enthath theavanaiyum mathiyaamalum, ellaavat'ri'rkum thannaip periyavanaakki,

ara'nka'lin theavanaith than sthaanaththilea kanampa'n'ni, than pithaakka'l a'riyaatha oru theavanaip ponninaalum, ve'l'liyinaalum, iraththinangka'linaalum, uchchithamaana vasthukka'linaalum kanampa'n'nuvaan.

avan ara'nippaana koattaika'lukkaakavum, anniya theavanukkaakavum seyvathu ennaven'raal, avaika'lai mathikki'ravarka'lukku makaa kanamu'ndaakki, avarka'l aneakarai aa'lumpadich seythu, avarka'lukkuth theasaththaik kirayaththukkaakap pangkiduvaan.

mudivukaalaththiloaven'raal, then'risai raajaa avanoadea muttukku ni'rpaan; vadathisai raajaavum irathangka'loadum kuthiraiveerarka'loadum aneakam kappalka'loadum soo'raikkaat'rupoal avanukku viroathamaay varuvaan; avan theasangka'lukku'l piraveasiththu, avaika'laip piravaakiththuk kadanthupoavaan.

avan singkaaramaana theasaththilum varuvaan; appozhuthu aneaka theasangka'l kavizhkkappadum; aanaalum eathoamum, moavaapum, ammoan puththiraril pirathaanamaanavarka'lum avan kaikkuth thappippoavaarka'l.
avan theasangka'linmeal than kaiyai neettuvaan; ekipthutheasam thappuvathillai.
ekipthinudaiya ponnum ve'l'liyumaana aisuvariyangka'laiyum uchchithamaana ellaa vasthukka'laiyum aa'nduko'l'luvaan; leepiyarum eththiyoappiyarum avanukkup pinselluvaarka'l.
aanaalum kizhakkilum vadakkilum irunthuvarum seythika'l avanaik kalangkappa'n'num; appozhuthu avan aneakarai azhikkavum sangkaarampa'n'navum makaa ukkiraththoadea pu'rappattuppoay,

samuththirangka'lukku idaiyilu'l'la singkaaramaana parisuththa parvathaththa'ndaiyilea than aramanaiyaakiya koodaarangka'laip poaduvaan; aanaalum avanukku oththaasai pa'n'nuvaarillaamal, avan mudivadaivaan.

un janaththin puththirarukkaaka ni'rki'ra periya athipathiyaakiya mikaaveal akkaalaththilea ezhumpuvaan; yaathoru jaathiyaarum thoan'rinathumuthal akkaalamattum u'ndaayiraatha aapaththukkaalam varum; akkaalaththilea pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ravarka'laakak kaa'nappaduki'ra un janangka'l anaivarum viduvikkappaduvaarka'l.
poomiyin thoo'lilea niththiraipa'n'nuki'ravarka'laakiya aneakaril silar niththiyajeevanukkum, silar niththiya ninthaikkum ikazhchchikkum vizhiththu ezhunthiruppaarka'l.
gnaanavaanka'l aakaayama'ndalaththin o'liyaippoalavum, aneakarai neethikkudpaduththuki'ravarka'l nadchaththirangka'laippoalavum en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum pirakaasippaarka'l.

thaaniyealaakiya neeyoaven'raal, mudivukaalamattum intha vaarththaika'laip puthaiporu'laaka vaiththu vaiththu, inthappusthakaththai muththiraipoadu; appozhuthu aneakar ingkum angkum oadi aaraayvaarka'l, a'rivum perukippoam en'raan.
appozhuthu, thaaniyealaakiya naan aat'rukku ikkaraiyil oruvanum aat'rukku akkaraiyil oruvanumaakiya vea'rea ira'ndupear ni'rkakka'ndean.
sa'nalvasthiram thariththavarum, aat'rin tha'n'neerka'linmeal ni'rki'ravarumaakiya purushanai oruvan noakki: intha aachchariyamaanavaika'lin mudivu vara evva'lavukaalam sellum en'ru keattaan.

appozhuthu sa'nalvasthiram thariththavarum aat'rin tha'n'neerka'linmeal ni'rki'ravarumaakiya purushan thammudaiya valathukaraththaiyum thammudaiya idathukaraththaiyum vaanaththukku nearaaka ea'reduththu, oru kaalamum, kaalangka'lum, araikkaalamum sellum en'rum; parisuththa janangka'lin vallamaiyaich sitha'radiththal mudivupe'rumpoathea ivaika'lellaam ni'raivea'rith theerumen'rum en'ren'raikkum jeeviththirukki'ravarpearil aa'naiyidak keattean.
naan athaik keattum, athin poru'lai a'riyavillai; aakaiyaal: en aa'ndavanea, ivaika'lin mudivu ennamaayirukkum en'ru keattean.
atha'rku avan: thaaniyealea, poakalaam; intha vaarththaika'l mudivukaalamattum puthaiporu'laaka vaikkappattum muththirikkappattum irukkum.

aneakar suththamum ve'nmaiyumaakkappattu, pudamidappattavarka'laay vi'langkuvaarka'l; thunmaarkkaroa thunmaarkkamaay nadappaarka'l; thunmaarkkaril oruvanum u'naraan, gnaanavaanka'loa u'narnthuko'l'luvaarka'l.
an'raadapali neekkappattu, paazhaakkum aruvaruppu sthaapikkappadungkaalamuthal aayiraththirunoot'ruth tho'n'noo'runaa'l sellum.
aayiraththu munnoot'ru muppaththainthu naa'lmattum kaaththirunthu searuki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
neeyoaven'raal mudivuvarumattum poayiru; nee i'laippaa'rikko'ndirunthu, naadka'lin mudivilea un suthanthara veethaththukku ezhunthiruppaay en'raan.

yoothaa theasaththu raajaakka'laakiya usiyaa, yoathaam, aakaas, eseakkiyaa enpavarka'lin naadka'lilum, yoavaasin kumaaranaakiya yesrayealin raajaavaakiya yeropeyaam enpavanin naadka'lilum, peyeariyin kumaaranaakiya oasiyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam.

karththar oasiyaavaikko'ndu uraikkaththodangkinapoathu, karththar oasiyaavai noakki: nee poay, oru soarasthireeyaiyum soarappi'l'laika'laiyum unnidamaakach searththukko'l; theasam karththarai vittu vilakich soarampoayit'ru en'raar.
avan poay, thiplaayimin kumaaraththiyaakiya koamearaich searththukko'ndaan; ava'l karppanthariththu, avanukku oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.

appozhuthu karththar avanai noakki: ivanukku yesrayeal ennum pearidu; eanenil innum kognchakkaalaththilea naan eakoovin vamsaththaaridaththilea yesrayealin iraththappazhiyai visaariththu, israveal vamsaththaarin raajyapaaraththai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean.
annaa'lil yesrayealin pa'l'laththaakkilea isravealin villai mu'rippean en'raar.

ava'l thirumpak karppanthariththu, oru kumaaraththiyaip pet'raa'l; appozhuthu avar avanai noakki: iva'lukku loarukaamaa ennum pearidu; eanenil naan ini israveal vamsaththaarukku irakkagnseyvathillai, naan avarka'lai muzhuvathum akat'rividuvean.

yoothaavin vamsaththaarukkoa naan irakkagnseyvean; villinaalum, pattayaththinaalum, yuththaththinaalum, kuthiraika'linaalum, kuthiraiveerarinaalum naan avarka'lai iradchiyaamal, avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththaraalea avarka'lai iradchippean en'raar.
ava'l loarukaamaavai mulai ma'rakkappa'n'ninapi'rpaadu, karppanthariththu oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l.
appozhuthu avar: ivanukku loakammee ennum pearidu; eanenil neengka'l en janamalla, naan ungka'l theavanaayiruppathillai.

en'raalum, israveal puththirarin thokai a'lakkavum e'n'navungkoodaatha kada'rkarai ma'nalaippoalirukkum; neengka'l en janamalla en'ru avarka'lukkuch solvatha'rkup pathilaaka neengka'l jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollappadum.

appozhuthu yoothaa puththirarum israveal puththirarum eakamaayk koottappattu, thangka'lukku orea athipathiyai ea'rpaduththi, theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattu varuvaarka'l; yesrayealin naa'l perithaayirukkum.
ungka'l sakoathararaippaarththu ammee en'rum, ungka'l sakoatharika'laippaarththu rukaamaa en'rum sollungka'l.

ungka'l thaayoadea vazhakkaadungka'l; ava'l enakku manaiviyumalla, naan ava'lukkup purushanumalla; ava'l than veasiththanangka'laith than mukaththinin'rum, than vipasaarangka'laith than sthanangka'lin naduvinin'rum vilakkippoadakkadava'l.

illaavittaal naan ava'lai nirvaa'namaaka urinthu, ava'l pi'ranthanaa'lil irunthava'n'namaaka ava'lai ni'ruththi, ava'lai antharave'liyaippoalaakki, ava'lai va'ra'ndapoomiyaippoal vittu, ava'laith thaakaththaal saakappa'n'nuvean;
ava'ludaiya pi'l'laika'l soarappi'l'laika'laakaiyaal avarka'lukku irangkaathiruppean.

avarka'ludaiya thaay soarampoanaa'l, avarka'laik karppanthariththava'l ilachchaiyaana kaariyangka'laich seythaa'l; appaththaiyum, tha'n'neeraiyum, aattumayiraiyum, pagnchaiyum, e'n'neyaiyum, paanangka'laiyum koduththuvaruki'ra en neasarka'laip pinpat'rippoavean en'raa'l.
aakaiyaal, ithoa, naan un vazhiyai mu'l'luka'linaal adaippean; ava'l than paathaika'laik ka'ndupidikkak koodaathapadikku mathilai ezhuppuvean.

ava'l than neasarka'laip pinthodarnthum avarka'laich searuvathillai, avarka'laith theadiyum ka'ndupidippathillai; appozhuthu ava'l: naan en munthina purushanidaththukkuth thirumpippoavean; ippozhuthu irukki'rathaippaarkkilum appozhuthu enakku nanmaiyaayirunthathu enpaa'l.

thanakku naan thaaniyaththaiyum thiraadcharasaththaiyum e'n'neyaiyum koduththavaren'rum, thanakku naan ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum perukappa'n'ninavaren'rum ava'l a'riyaama'rpoanaa'l; avaika'lai avarka'l paakaaludaiyathaakkinaarka'l.

aathalaal naan en thaaniyaththai athin kaalaththilum, en thiraadcharasaththai athin kaalaththilum thirumpa eduththukko'ndu, ava'ludaiya nirvaa'naththai mooduki'ratha'rku naan koduththiruntha aattumayiraiyum sa'nalaiyum thirumpap pidungkikko'l'luvean.
ippoathum ava'ludaiya neasarka'lin ka'nka'lukku munpaaka ava'ludaiya avaladcha'naththai ve'lippaduththuvean; oruvarum ava'lai en kaikku neengkalaakki viduvippathillai.

ava'ludaiya ellaa makizhchchiyaiyum, ava'ludaiya pa'ndikaika'laiyum, ava'ludaiya maathappi'rappuka'laiyum, ava'ludaiya oayvunaadka'laiyum, sapaikooduki'ra ava'ludaiya ellaa aasarippuka'laiyum ozhiyappa'n'nuvean.

en neasarka'l enakkuk koduththa pa'naiyam en'ru ava'l sonna ava'ludaiya thiraadchachsedika'laiyum, ava'ludaiya aththimarangka'laiyum naan paazhaakki, avaika'laik kaadaayppoakappa'n'nuvean; kaattumirukangka'l avaika'laith thinnum.

ava'l paakaalka'lukkuth thoopangkaatti, than net'rippattangka'linaalum than aapara'nangka'linaalum thannaich singkaariththukko'ndu, than neasaraip pinthodarnthu, ennai ma'ranthupoana naadka'linimiththam ava'lai visaarippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aayinum, ithoa, naan ava'lukku nayangkaatti, ava'lai vanaantharaththil azhaiththukko'ndupoay, ava'loadea padchamaayp peasi,

avvidaththilirunthu ava'lukku ava'ludaiya thiraadchaththoattangka'laiyum, nampikkaiyin vaasalaaka aakoarin pa'l'laththaakkaiyum koduppean; appozhuthu ava'l angkea, than i'lavayathin naadka'lilum thaan ekipthutheasaththilirunthu vantha naa'lilum paadinathupoal paaduvaa'l.
akkaalaththil nee ennai ini paakaali en'ru sollaamal, eeshi en'ru solluvaay en'ru karththar uraikki'raar.
paakaalka'ludaiya naamangka'lai ava'l vaayilirunthu at'ruppoakappa'n'nuvean; ini avaika'lin pearaichsolli, avaika'lai ninaikki'ra ninaippum illaama'rpoakum.

akkaalaththil naan avarka'lukkaakak kaattu mirukangka'loadum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'loadum, poomiyilea oorum piraa'nika'loadum, oru udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, villaiyum pattayaththaiyum yuththaththaiyum theasaththilea iraathapadikku mu'riththu, avarka'laich sukamaayp paduththuk ko'ndirukkappa'n'nuvean.
niththiya vivaakaththukken'ru unnai enakku niyamiththukko'l'luvean; neethiyum niyaayamum kirupaiyum urukka irakkamumaay unnai enakku niyamiththukko'l'luvean.
u'nmaiyaay unnai enakku niyamiththukko'l'luvean; nee karththarai a'rinthuko'l'luvaay.
akkaalaththil naan ma'rumozhi koduppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan vaanangka'lukku ma'rumozhi koduppean, avaika'l poomikku ma'rumozhi kodukkum.
poomi thaaniyaththukkum thiraadcharasaththukkum e'n'neykkum ma'rumozhi kodukkum, ivaika'l yesrayealukkum ma'rumozhi kodukkum.

naan ava'lai enakken'ru poomiyilea vithaiththu, irakkam pe'raathirunthava'lukku irangkuvean; en janamallaathirunthavarka'lai noakki nee en janamen'ru solluvean; avarka'l en theavanea enpaarka'l en'raar.

pinpu karththar ennai noakki: anniya theavarka'lai mathiththu, thiraadcharasamu'l'la paaththirangka'lai virumpuki'ravarka'laana israveal puththirarpearil karththar vaiththirukki'ra anpukku oppaaka nee innum poay, than neasaraal neasikkappattava'lum, vipasaariyumaana oru sthireeyai neasiththukko'l en'ru sonnaar.
appozhuthu naan ava'lai enakkup pathinainthu ve'l'likkaasukkum, on'raraikkalam vaa'rkoathumaikkum ko'ndu,
ava'lai noakki: nee veasiththanampa'n'naamalum, oruvanaiyum searaamalum aneakanaa'l enakkaakak kaaththiru; unakkaaka naanum kaaththiruppean en'rean.
israveal puththirar aneakanaa'l raajaa illaamalum, athipathi illaamalum, pali illaamalum, silai illaamalum, eapoath vasthiram illaamalum, thearaapeem illaamalum iruppaarka'l.

pinpu israveal puththirar thirumpi, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaraiyum, thangka'l raajaavaakiya thaaveethaiyum theadi, kadaisinaadka'lil karththaraiyum, avarudaiya thayavaiyum naadi agnchikkaiyaay varuvaarka'l.

israveal puththirarea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungka'l; theasaththuk kudika'loadea karththarukku vazhakku irukki'rathu; atheanen'raal theasaththilea u'nmaiyum illai, irakkamum illai; theavanaippat'riya a'rivum illai.
poyyaa'naiyittu, poysolli, kolaiseythu, thirudi, vipasaarampa'n'ni, mignchi mignchippoaki'raarka'l; iraththappazhika'loadea iraththappazhika'l searuki'rathu.
ithinimiththam theasam pulampum; athil kudiyirukki'ra anaivaroadungkooda mirukajeevanka'lum aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lum thoynthupoakum; kadalin machchangka'lum vaarikko'l'lappadum.
aakilum oruvanum niyaayaththaik kaa'npikkavum, oruvanum avarka'laik kadinthuko'l'lavum koodaathu; un janangka'l aasaariyanoadea vazhakkaaduki'ravarka'laippoala irukki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal nee pakalilea ida'rivizhuvaay; iravilea unnoadeakoodath theerkkatharisiyum ida'rivizhuvaan; un thaayai naan sangkaarampa'n'nuvean.

en janangka'l a'rivillaamaiyinaal sangkaaramaaki'raarka'l; nee a'rivai ve'ruththaay, aakaiyaal nee en aasaariyanaayiraathapadikku naanum unnai ve'ruththuviduvean; nee un theavanudaiya veathaththai ma'ranthaay, aakaiyaal naanum un pi'l'laika'lai ma'ranthuviduvean.
avarka'l evva'lavaayp perukinaarka'loa, avva'lavaay enakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya makimaiyai ilachchaiyaaka maa'rappa'n'nuvean.
avarka'l en janaththin paavaththaith thin'ru, avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththinpearil pasithaakamaayirukki'raarka'l.
aathalaal janangka'lukku eppadiyoa aasaariyanukkum appadiyea; avarka'l vazhika'linpadi naan avarka'lai visaariththu, avarka'l kiriyaika'linpadi avarka'lukkup palana'lippean.
avarka'l karththarai mathiyaamalirukki'rapadiyinaal avarka'l thin'raalum thirupthiyadaiyaathiruppaarka'l; avarka'l veasiththanampa'n'ninaalum palukaathiruppaarka'l.
veasiththanamum thiraadcharasamum mathupaanamum iruthayaththai mayakkum.

en janangka'l kattaiyinidaththil aaloasanai keadki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya koal avarka'lukkuch seythiyai a'rivikkumen'rirukki'raarka'l; veasiththana aavi avarka'lai vazhithappith thiriyappa'n'nit'ru; avarka'l thangka'l theavanukkuk keezhppattiraamal soaramaarkkam poanaarka'l.

avarka'l malaiyuchchiyil paliyittu, meaduka'lilea karvaalimarangka'lin keezhum, punnaimarangka'lin keezhum, arasamarangka'lin keezhum, avaika'lin nizhal nallathen'ru, thoopangkaattuki'raarka'l; ithinimiththam ungka'l kumaaraththika'l veasiththanamum, ungka'l marumakka'lmaar vipasaaramum seyki'raarka'l.

ungka'l kumaaraththika'l veasiththanam seyki'rathinimiththamum, ungka'l marumakka'lmaar vipasaaram seyki'rathinimiththamum, naan avarka'laith tha'ndiyaamaliruppeanoa? avarka'l vilaki veasika'loadea koodappoayth thaasika'loadea paliyiduki'raarka'l; u'narvillaatha janangka'l athinaal sikku'ndu vizhuvaarka'l.

isravealea, nee soarampoanaalum, yoothaavaakilum anthap paavaththukku'l'laakaathiruppathaaka; kilkaalukku varaamalum, peththaaveanukkup poakaamalum karththarudaiya jeevanaa'nai en'ru aa'naiyidaamalum iruppeerka'laaka.
israveal adangkaatha kidaariyaippoal adangkaathirukki'rathu; ippoathu karththar avarka'lai visthaaramaana ve'liyilea aattukkuttiyaippoal meaynthu alaiyappa'n'nuvaar.
eppiraayeem vikkirakangka'loadu i'nainthirukki'raan, avanaip poakavidu.
avarka'ludaiya mathupaanam pu'liththathu, avarka'l eppoathum soarampoaki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya athipathika'l thaarungka'len'ru ilachchaiyaanathai naaduki'raarka'l.
kaat'ru avarka'laith than settaika'lil i'rukap pidikkum; avarka'l thangka'l palika'laal vedkappaduvaarka'l.

aasaariyarka'lea, ithaik kea'lungka'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, kavaniyungka'l; raajaavin veettaarea, sevikodungka'l; intha niyaaya visaarippu ungka'lmeal sellum; neengka'l mispaavil ka'n'niyum thaapoarinmeal virikkappatta valaiyumaaneerka'l.
ne'rithava'rinavarka'l mikuthiyum vathai seyki'raarka'l; avarka'l ellaaraiyum naan tha'ndippean.
eppiraayeemai naan a'rivean, israveal enakku ma'raivaanathalla; eppiraayeemea, ippoathu nee soarampoanaayea, israveal theettuppattathea.
avarka'l thangka'l theavanidaththukkuth thirumpuvatha'rkuth thangka'l kiriyaika'laich seerthiruththamaattaarka'l, veasiththana aavi avarka'l u'l'laththil irukki'rathu; karththarai a'riyaarka'l.

isravealin akanthai avarka'l mukaththukku munpaakach saadchiyiduki'rathu; aakaiyaal isravealum eppiraayeemum thangka'l akkiramaththinaal ida'ru'ndu vizhuvaarka'l; avarka'loadea yoothaavum ida'ru'ndu vizhuvaan.
avarka'l karththaraith theadumpadi thangka'l aaduka'loadum thangka'l maaduka'loadum poavaarka'l; avaraik kaa'namaattaarka'l; avar avarka'lai vittu vilakinaar.
karththarukku viroathamaaka thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l; anniyapi'l'laika'laip pet'raarka'l; ippoathum oru maathaththukku'l'laaka avarka'l thangka'l pangkuka'loadea padchikkappaduvaarka'l.
kipiyaavilea ekkaa'laththaiyum, raamaavilea poorikaiyaiyum oothungka'l; peththaaveanilea katha'rungka'l; penyameenea unnaip pinthodaruki'raarka'l.
tha'ndippin naa'lilea eppiraayeem paazhaavaan; nichchayamaay varappoaki'rathai isravealin koaththirangka'lukku'l'lea a'rivikki'rean.
yoothaavin pirapukka'l ellaika'lai othukkuki'ravarka'lukku oppaanaarka'l; avarka'lmeal en ukkirakoapaththaith tha'n'neeraippoala oot'ruvean.
eppiraayeem thakaatha ka'rpanaiyai manathaarap pinpat'rippoanapadiyaal avan odungku'ndu, niyaayavisaara'naiyil no'rukkappattuppoaki'raan.
naan eppiraayeemukkup pottarippaippoalavum, yoothaavin veettukku u'luppaippoalavum iruppean.

eppiraayeem than viyaathiyaiyum, yoothaa than kaayaththaiyum ka'ndapoathu, eppiraayeem aseeriyana'ndaikkuppoay yaareap raajaavinidaththil aa'l anuppinaan; aanaalum ungka'laik ku'namaakkavum ungka'lil irukki'ra kaayaththai aat'ravum avanaal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.
naan eppiraayeemukkuch singkampoalavum, yoothaavin vamsaththaarukkup paalasingkampoalavum iruppean; naan naanea pee'rivittup poayviduvean; thappuvippaar illaamal eduththukko'ndupoavean.
avarka'l thangka'l kut'rangka'lai u'narnthu, en mukaththaith theadumattum naan en sthaanaththukkuth thirumpip poayviduvean; thangka'l aapaththil ennaik karuththaayth theaduvaarka'l.
karththaridaththil thirumpuvoam vaarungka'l; nammaip pee'rinaar, avarea nammaik ku'namaakkuvaar; nammai adiththaar, avarea nammudaiya kaayangka'laik kattuvaar.
ira'ndu naa'lukkuppinpu avar nammai uyirppippaar; moon'raam naa'lil nammai ezhuppuvaar; appozhuthu naam avarudaiya samukaththil pizhaiththiruppoam.

appozhuthu naam a'rivadainthu, karththarai a'riyumpadi thodarnthu poavoam; avarudaiya pu'rappaduthal aru'noathayampoala aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; avar mazhaiyaippoalavum, poomiyinmeal peyyum munmaari pinmaariyaippoalavum nammidaththil varuvaar.
eppiraayeemea, unakku enna seyvean? yoothaavea, unakku enna seyvean? ungka'l pakthi kaalaiyil kaa'num meakaththaippoalavum, vidiya'rkaalaiyil thoan'rum paniyaippoalavum ozhinthupoaki'rathu.
aakaiyaal theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu avarka'lai vettinean; en vaaymozhika'laikko'ndu avarka'lai athampa'n'ninean; unmeal varum tha'ndanaika'l ve'lichchaththaippoal ve'lippadum.
paliyai alla irakkaththaiyum, thakanapalika'laippaarkkilum theavanai a'riki'ra a'rivaiyum, virumpuki'rean.
avarka'loa aathaamaippoal udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri, angkea enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l.
keeleayaath akkiramam seyki'ravarka'lin patta'nam; athu iraththakkaaladika'laal mithikkappattirukki'rathu.

pa'rikaararin koottangka'l oruvanukkuk kaaththirukki'rathupoala, seekeamukkup poaki'ra vazhiyilea kolaiseyki'ra aasaariyarin koottam kaaththirukki'rathu; thoashamaana kaariyangka'laiyea seyki'raarka'l.
payangkaramaana kaariyaththai israveal vamsaththaaril ka'ndean; angkea eppiraayeemin veasiththanam u'ndu; israveal theettuppattuppoayit'ru.
yoothaavea, unakku oru a'ruppukkaalam niyamikkappattirukki'rathu.

naan en janaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathum, naan isravealai ku'namaakka virumpumpoathum, eppiraayeemin akkiramamum samaariyaavin pollaappuka'lum ve'lippaduththappadum; avarka'l vagnchanai seyki'raarka'l; thirudan u'l'lea varuki'raan; ve'liyea pa'rikaararin koottaththaar ko'l'laiyiduki'raarka'l.

avarka'l pollaappaiyellaam naan ninaivil vaiththirukki'rean en'ru avarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththil sinthikki'rathillai; ippoathum avarka'ludaiya kiriyaika'l avarka'laich soozhnthuko'ndathu; avaika'l en mukaththukku mun irukki'rathu.
raajaavaith thangka'l pollaappinaalum, athipathika'laith thangka'l poyka'linaalum santhoashappaduththuki'raarka'l.
avarka'l ellaarum vipasaarakka'l'lar; appagnsuduki'ravan erikkum aduppaippoal irukki'raarka'l; avan maavaip pisainthathumuthal athu uppippoakumattum, analai moottaamal oaynthirukki'raan.
nammudaiya raajaavin naa'len'ru solli, athipathika'l thiraadcharasath thuruththika'laal avanukku viyaathiyu'ndaakkuki'raarka'l; sarasakkaararoadeakooda avan than kaiyai neettuki'raan.

avarka'l pathivirukkumpoathu, thangka'l iruthayaththai aduppaippoal aayaththappaduththuki'raarka'l; avarka'lil aduppumoottuki'ravan iraamuzhuthum thoongkinaalum, kaalameayoaven'raal athu juvaalikki'ra akkiniyaay eriyum.

avarka'l ellaarum aduppaippoala analaaki, thangka'l niyaayaathipathika'laip padchiththaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya raajaakka'l ellaarum vizhunthaarka'l; avarka'lil ennai noakkik kooppiduki'ravan oruvanum illai.
eppiraayeem anniyajanangka'loadea kalanthirukki'raan; eppiraayeem thiruppippoadaatha appam.
anniyar avanudaiya palaththaith thinki'raarka'l; avanoa athai a'riyaan; naraimayirum avanil the'liththirukki'rathu, avanoa athai a'riyaathirukki'raan.
isravealin akanthai avarka'l mukaththukku munpaakach saadchiyittaalum, avarka'l thangka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththil thirumpaamalum, ivai ellaavat'rilum avaraith theadaamalum irukki'raarka'l.
eppiraayeem peathaiyaana pu'raavaippoal irukki'raan, avanukkup puththiyillai; ekipthiyanaik kooppiduki'raarka'l; aseeriyanidaththukkum poaki'raarka'l.

avarka'l poakumpoathu, en valaiyai avarka'lmeal veesuvean; avarka'lai aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laippoalak keezhea vizhappa'n'nuvean; avarka'ludaiya sapaiyil kea'lviyaanathinpadiyea avarka'laith tha'ndippean.

avarka'l ennaivittu alainthu thiriki'rapadiyinaal avarka'lukku aiyoa! avarka'lukkuk keaduvarum; enakku viroathamaaka ira'ndakampa'n'ninaarka'l; naan avarka'lai meettirunthum, avarka'l enakku viroathamaakap poypeasuki'raarka'l.

avarka'l thangka'l padukkaika'lil ala'ruki'rapoathu, thangka'l iruthayaththil ennai noakkik kooppiduki'rathillai; avarka'l thaaniyaththukkaakavum thiraadcharasaththukkaakavum kooduki'raarka'l; ennai ve'ruththu vilakippoaki'raarka'l.
naan avarka'laith tha'ndiththean; avarka'ludaiya puyangka'l thirumpap palappadavumpa'n'ninean; aakilum enakku viroathamaakap pollaappu ninaikki'raarka'l.

thirumpuki'raarka'l, aanaalum unnathamaanavaridaththi'rku alla; moasampoakkuki'ra villaippoalirukki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya athipathika'l thangka'l naavinudaiya ukkiraththinimiththam pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; ithuvea ekipthutheasaththinimiththam avarka'lukku varum ninthai.

un vaayilea ekkaa'laththai vai; avarka'l en udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri, en niyaayappiramaa'naththukku viroathamaakath thuroakampa'n'ninapadiyinaal, karththarudaiya veettinmeal saththuru kazhukaippoal pa'ranthuvaruki'raan.
engka'l theavanea, ummai a'rinthirukki'roam en'ru solli isravealar kooppiduvaarka'l.
aanaalum isravealar nanmaiyai ve'ruththaarka'l; saththuru avarka'laith thodaruvaan.

avarka'l raajaakka'lai ea'rpaduththikko'ndaarka'l, aanaalum ennaalea alla; athipathika'lai vaiththukko'ndaarka'l, aanaalum naan a'riyean; avarka'l veara'ruppu'ndu poakumpadith thangka'l ve'l'liyinaalum thangka'l ponninaalum thangka'lukku vikkirakangka'laich seyviththaarka'l.
samaariyaavea, un kan'rukkutti unnai ve'ruththuviduki'rathu; en koapam avarka'lmeal moo'ndathu; ethuvaraikkum suththaangkam adaiyamaattaathiruppaarka'l?
athuvum isravealarudaiya seykaiyea; thattaan athaich seythaan, aathalaal athu theavan allavea, samaariyaavin kan'rukkutti thu'nduthu'ndaayp poakum.
avarka'l kaat'rai vithaiththu, soo'raikkaat'rai a'ruppaarka'l; vi'laichchal avarka'lukku illai; kathir maavaik kodukkamaattaathu; koduththaalum anniyar athai vizhungkuvaarka'l.
isravealar vizhungkappaduki'raarka'l; avarka'l inip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea virumpappadaatha paaththiraththaippoal iruppaarka'l.
avarka'l thaniththuth thiriki'ra kaattukkazhuthaiyaippoal aseeriyara'ndaikkup poanaarka'l; eppiraayeemar neasaraik koolikkup poruththikko'ndaarka'l.

avarka'l pu'rajaathiyaaraik koolikkup poruththikko'ndaalum, ippozhuthu naan avarka'laik koottuvean; athipathika'lin raajaa sumaththum sumaiyinaal avarka'l kognchakkaalaththukku'l'lea akappaduvaarka'l.
eppiraayeemar paavagnseyvatha'rkeathuvaayp palipeedangka'laip perukappa'n'ninaarka'l; aathalaal palipeedangka'lea avarka'l paavagnseyvatha'rku eathuvaakum.
en veathaththin makaththuvangka'lai avarka'lukku ezhuthikkoduththean; avaika'lai anniyakaariyamaaka e'n'ninaarka'l.

enakkuch seluththum palika'lin maamsaththai avarka'l paliyittup pusikki'raarka'l; karththar avarka'lmeal piriyamaayiraar; avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththai avar ninaiththu, avarka'l paavaththai visaarikkumpoathoavenil, avarka'l ekipthukkuth thirumpippoavaarka'l.

israveal thannai u'ndaakkinavarai ma'ranthu koavilka'laik kattuki'raan; yoothaa ara'naana patta'nangka'laip perukappa'n'nuki'raan; aanaalum naan athin nakarangka'lil akkiniyai varappa'n'nuvean; athu avaika'lin koavilka'laip padchikkum.
isravealea, makizhchchiyaayiraathea; mat'ra janangka'laippoal ka'likooraathea; un theavanaivittu nee soarampoanaay; thaaniyam poaradikki'ra sakala ka'langka'lilum pa'naiyaththai naaduki'raay.
thaaniyakka'lamum thiraadchaththottiyum avarka'laip pizhaippoottuvathillai; avarka'lukkuth thiraadcharasam ozhinthupoakum.
avarka'l karththarudaiya theasaththil kudiyiruppathillai; eppiraayeemar thirumpa ekipthukkup poavaarka'l; aseeriyaavil theettu'l'lathaip pusippaarka'l.

avarka'l karththarukkuth thiraadcharasaththin paanapaliyai vaarppathumillai, avarukku angkikarippaayiruppathumillai; avarka'ludaiya palika'l avarka'lukkuth thukkangko'ndaaduki'ravarka'lin appaththaipoala irukkum; athaip pusikki'ra yaavarum theettuppaduvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya appam avarka'lukkeayaakum, athu karththarudaiya aalayaththil varuvathillai.
aasarippunaa'lilum, karththarudaiya pa'ndikainaa'lilum ennaseyveerka'l?

ithoa, avarka'l paazhkkadippukkuth thappumpadi poayvittaarka'l; ekipthu avarka'laich searththukko'l'lum, moap patta'nam avarka'lai adakkampa'n'num; avarka'ludaiya ve'l'liyiruntha viruppamaana idangka'l kaagncho'rika'lukkuch suthantharamaakum; avarka'ludaiya vaasasthalangka'lil mudchedika'l mu'laikkum.

visaarippin naadka'l varum, neethi sarikkattum naadka'l varum enpathai isravealar a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l; un mikuthiyaana akkiramaththinaaleayum, mikuthiyaana pakaiyinaaleayum theerkkatharisika'l moodarum, aaviyaip pet'ra manusharka'l piththangko'ndavarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l.

eppiraayeemin kaava'rkaarar en theavanoadu ethirththuni'rki'raarka'l; theerkkatharisi than vazhika'lilellaam kuruvipidikki'ravanudaiya ka'n'niyaakavum, than theavanudaiya aalayaththilea pakaiyaa'liyaakavum irukki'raan.
kipiyaavin naadka'lil nadanthathupoala, avarka'l thangka'lai mikavum keduththukko'ndaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya akkiramaththai avar ninaippaar, avarka'ludaiya paavangka'lai visaarippaar.

vanaantharaththil thiraadchakkulaika'laik ka'ndupidippathupoala isravealaik ka'ndupidiththean; aththimaraththil muthaltharam pazhuththa kanika'laippoala ungka'l pithaakka'laik ka'ndupidiththean; aanaalum avarka'l paakaalpeayoar a'ndaikkuppoay, ilachchaiyaanatha'rkuth thangka'lai oppuviththu, thaangka'l neasiththavaika'laip poalath thaangka'lum aruvaruppu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l.
eppiraayeemin makimai oru pa'ravaiyaippoal pa'ranthupoam; athu pi'rappathumillai, vayit'riliruppathumillai, karppantharippathumillai.
avarka'l thangka'l pi'l'laika'lai va'larththaalum, avarka'lukku manushar iraathapadikku avarka'laip pi'l'laika'l at'ravarka'laakkuvean; naan avarka'lai vittuppoakaiyil avarka'lukku aiyoa!

naan eppiraayeemaith theeruvin thisaimattum irukki'rathaip paarkki'rapoathu, athu nalla vasathiyaana sthalaththilea naattappattirukki'rathu; aanaalum eppiraayeemar thangka'l kumaararaik kolaiseyki'ravanidaththil ve'liyea ko'ndupoay viduvaarka'l.
karththaavea, neer avarka'lukkuk koduppathaik kodum; avarka'lukku vizhunthupoaki'ra karppaththaiyum paalat'ra mulaika'laiyum kodum.

avarka'ludaiya pollaappellaam kilkaalilea nadakkum; angkea naan avarka'lai ve'ruththean; avarka'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam avarka'lai naan en samukaththaivittuth thuraththuvean; ini avarka'lai neasikkamaattean; avarka'ludaiya athipathika'l ellaarum thuroakika'l.
eppiraayeemar vettu'ndupoanaarka'l; avarka'l vear ularnthupoayit'ru, kanikodukkamaattaarka'l; avarka'l pi'l'laika'laip pet'raalum, avarka'ludaiya karppaththin piriyamaana kanika'lai athampa'n'nuvean.
avarka'l avarukkuch sevikodaama'rpoanapadiyaal en theavan avarka'lai ve'ruththuviduvaar; avarka'l anniyajaathika'lukku'l'lea alainthu thirivaarka'l.

israveal palanat'ra thiraadchachsedi, athu thanakkuththaanea kanikodukki'rathu; avan than kaniyin thira'lukkuch sariyaayp palipeedangka'laith thira'laakkuki'raan; thangka'l theasaththin sezhippukkuch sariyaaych si'rappaana silaika'laich seyki'raarka'l.
avarka'l iruthayam pirikkappattirukki'rathu; ippoathum kut'ragnsumaththappaduvaarka'l; avarka'l palipeedangka'lai idiththu, avarka'l silaika'lai naasamaakkuvaar.
naam karththarukkup payappadaama'rpoanapadiyinaal namakku raajaa illai; raajaa irunthaalum namakkaaka enna seyvaan en'ru inich solluvaarka'l.
poyyaa'naiyiduki'ra vaarththaika'laich solli, udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l; aakaiyaal vayalve'liyin padaichchaalka'lil vishappoo'nduka'laippoala niyaayaththeerppu mu'laikkum.

samaariyaavin kudika'l peththaaveanilu'l'la kan'rukkuttiyinimiththam payam adaivaarka'l; atha'rkaakak ka'likoorntha athin janamum, athin poosaasaarika'lum athin makimai athaivittu neengkippoayit'ren'ru atha'rkaakath thukkangko'ndaaduvaarka'l.
athuvum aseeriyaavilea yaareap raajaavukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaakak ko'ndupoakappadum; eppiraayeem ilachchaiyadaivaan; israveal than aaloasanaiyinaalea vedkappaduvaan.
samaariyaavin raajaa tha'n'neerinmeal irukki'ra nuraiyaippoal azhinthupoavaan.

isravealudaiya paavamaakiya aapeanin meadaika'l azhikkappadum; mudchedika'lum mudpoo'nduka'lum avarka'l palipeedangka'linmeal mu'laikkum; parvathangka'laippaarththu engka'lai moodungka'l en'rum, kun'ruka'laippaarththu engka'lmeal vizhungka'l en'rum solluvaarka'l.
isravealea, nee kipiyaavin naadka'lmuthal paavagnseythuvanthaay; kipiyaavilea akkiramakkaararmeal vantha yuththam thangka'laik kittuvathillaiyen'ru antha nilaiyilea ni'rki'raarka'l.
naan avarka'laith tha'ndikka virumpuki'rean; avarka'l seytha ira'nduvitha paavangka'linimiththam kattappadumpoathu, janangka'l avarka'lukku viroathamaayk kooduvaarka'l.

eppiraayeem nan'raayp pazhakkappattup poaradikka virumpuki'ra kadaariyaayirukki'raan; aanaalum naan avan azhakaana kazhuththinmeal nukaththadiyai vaippean; eppiraayeemai ear pootti oattuvean; yoothaa uzhuvaan, yaakkoapu avanukkup parampadippaan.

neengka'l neethikken'ru vithaivithaiyungka'l; thayavukkoththathaay a'ruppu a'rungka'l; ungka'l tharisunilaththaip pa'npaduththungka'l; karththar vanthu ungka'lmeal neethiyai varushikkappa'n'numattum, avaraith theadak kaalamaayirukki'rathu.
aniyaayaththai uzhutheerka'l, theevinaiyai a'ruththeerka'l; poyyin kanika'laip pusiththeerka'l; ungka'l vazhiyaiyum ungka'l paraakkiramasaalika'lin thira'laiyum nampineerka'l.
aakaiyaal ungka'l janangka'lukku'l ama'li ezhumpum; pi'l'laika'linmeal thaay moathiyadikkappatta yuththanaa'lilea peththaarpealaich salmaan azhiththathupoala, ungka'l ellaa ara'nka'lum azhikkappadum.
ungka'l kodiya pollaappinaal peththeal ippadippattathai ungka'lukkuch seyyum; athikaalamea isravealin raajaa mut'rilum sangkarikkappaduvaan.
israveal i'laignanaayirunthapoathu naan avanai neasiththean; ekipthilirunthu ennudaiya kumaaranai varavazhaiththean.
avarka'l thangka'lai azhaikki'ravarka'lin mukaththukku vilakippoayvittaarka'l; paakaalka'lukkup paliyittu, vikkirakangka'lukkuth thoopangkaattinaarka'l.
naan eppiraayeemaik kaipidiththu nadakkap pazhakkinean; aanaalum naan thangka'laik ku'namaakkuki'ravaren'ru a'riyaama'rpoanaarka'l.

manusharaik katti izhukki'ra anpin kayi'ruka'laal naan avarka'lai izhuththean, avarka'l kazhuththuka'linmeal iruntha nukaththadiyai eduththup poaduki'ravaraippoal irunthu, avarka'l padcham saaynthu, avarka'lukku aakaarangkoduththean.
mananthirumpamaattoamen'rathinaal avarka'l ekipthutheasaththukkuth thirumpippoavathillai; aseeriyan avarka'lukku raajaa.
aakaiyaal avarka'ludaiya aaloasanaika'linimiththam pattayam avarka'l patta'nangka'lukku'l paaynthu, avarka'l thaazhppaa'lka'lai nirmoolampa'n'ni, avarka'laip padchikkum.
en janangka'l ennaivittu vilakuki'ra maa'rupaattaip pat'rikko'ndirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lai unnathamaanavaridaththil varavazhaiththaalum oruvanum ezhumpuki'rathillai.

eppiraayeemea, naan unnai eppadik kaividuvean? isravealea, naan unnai eppadi oppukkoduppean? naan unnai eppadi athmaavaippoalaakkuvean? unnai eppadich sepoayeemaippoala vaippean? en iruthayam enakku'l kuzhampuki'rathu; en parithaapangka'l eakamaayp pongkuki'rathu.

en ukkira koapaththinpadiyea seyyamaattean; eppiraayeemai azhikkumpadith thirumpamaattean; eanen'raal naan manushanalla, theavanaayirukki'rean; naan un naduvilu'l'la parisuththar; aakaiyaal patta'naththukku viroathamaaka varean.
avarka'l karththaraip pinpat'ruvaarka'l; avar singkaththaippoal kerchchippaar; avar kerchchikkumpoathu avarka'l santhathiyaar mea'rkuththisaiyilirunthu nadungki varuvaarka'l.

ekipthilirunthu kuruvika'laippoalavum, aseeriyaa theasaththilirunthu pu'raakka'laippoalavum payanthu varuvaarka'l; appozhuthu avarka'lai avarka'l veeduka'lil kudiyirukkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

eppiraayeemar poyka'linaalum, israveal vamsaththaar vagnchakaththinaalum ennaich soozhnthuko'ndirukki'raarka'l; yoothaavoavenil innum theavanoadea arasaa'ndu, parisuththavaanka'loadea u'nmaiyaayirukki'raan.

eppiraayeem kaat'rai meaynthu, ko'nda'rkaat'raip pinthodaruki'raan; avan naa'lthoa'rum poyyaiyum keattaiyum varththikkappa'n'ni, aseeriyaroadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nuki'raan; ekipthukku e'n'ney ko'ndupoakappaduki'rathu.
yoothaavoadum karththarukku vazhakku irukki'rathu; avar yaakkoapai avan vazhika'lukkuththakkathaaka visaarikkappoaki'raar; avan kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaaka avanukku neethiyaich sarikkattuvaar.
avan thaayin karppaththilea than sakoatharanudaiya kuthikaalaip pidiththaan; than pelaththinaal theavanoadea poaraadinaan.
avan thoothanaanavaroadea poaraadi mea'rko'ndaan, azhuthu avarai noakkik kegnchinaan; peththealilea avar avanaik ka'ndu santhiththu, avvidaththilum nammoadea peasinaar.
karththaraakiya avar seanaika'lin theavan; yeakoavaa enpathu avarudaiya naamasangkeerththanam.
ippoathum nee un theavanidaththil thirumpu; thayavaiyum niyaayaththaiyum kaikko'ndu, idaividaamal un theavanai nampikko'ndiru.
avan viyaapaari, ka'l'laththaraasu avan kaiyil irukki'rathu; aniyaayagnseyya virumpuki'raan.

eppiraayeem: naan aisuvariyavaanaanean; naan poru'laich sampaathiththean; naan pirayaasappattuth theadina ellaavat'rilum paavamaakiya akkiramam ennidaththil ka'ndupidikkappaduvathillaiyen'ru solluki'raan.

unnai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaiththuvanthathu mutha'rko'ndu un theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'ra naan, pa'ndikai naadka'lil seyyappaduki'rathupoal, thirumpavum unnaik koodaarangka'lil thaaparikkappa'n'nuvean.
appadiyea theerkkatharisika'loadea sonnean; naan aneakam tharisanangka'lai aru'linean; theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu uvamaika'laal peasinean.

keeleayaath akkirama sthalamoa? aam, avarka'l apaththaraanaarka'l; kilkaalilea kaa'laika'laip paliyiduki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya peedangka'l vayalvarappuka'lil irukki'ra ka'rkuviyalka'laippoal irukki'rathu.
yaakkoapu seeriyaatheasaththukku oadippoay, israveal oru pe'n'nukkaaka oozhiyagnseythu, oru pe'n'nukkaaka aadu meayththaan.
karththar oru theerkkatharisiyaik ko'ndu isravealai ekipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; theerkkatharisiyinaal kaakkappattaan.
eppiraayeemoa avarai mikavum koapappaduththinaan; aakaiyaal avanudaiya aa'ndavar avanudaiya iraththappazhika'lai avanmeal sumaththi, avan seytha ninthaiyai avanmeal thiruppuvaar.
eppiraayeem peasinapoathu nadukkamu'ndaayit'ru; avan isravealilea meanmaipet'raan; avan paakaal vishayaththil kut'ragnseythu madinthupoanaan.

ippoathum avarka'l athikamathikamaayp paavagnseythu, thangka'l ve'l'liyinaal vaarppiththa suroopangka'laiyum, thangka'l puththikkea'rka vikkirakangka'laiyum thangka'lukku u'ndupa'n'nuki'raarka'l; ivaika'lellaam thattaarudaiya vealai; manusharil paliyiduki'ravarka'l kan'rukkuttika'lai muththamidalaamen'ru ivaika'laikku'riththuch solluki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal avarka'l kaalaiyil kaa'num meakaththaippoalavum, vidiya'rkaalaiyil ozhinthupoaki'ra paniyaippoalavum, perungkaat'ru ka'laththilirunthu pa'rakkadikki'ra patharaippoalavum, pukaikkoo'ndil ea'rippoaki'ra pukaiyaippoalavum iruppaarka'l.

naan unnai ekipthu theasaththilirunthu azhaiththuvanthathumuthal un theavanaakiya karththaraayirukki'rean; aakaiyaal nee ennaiyan'ri vea'rea theavanai a'riyavea'ndaam; ennaiyan'ri iradchakar oruvarum illai.
naan unnai makaa va'radchiyaana theasamaakiya vanaantharaththilea a'rinthuko'ndean.
thangka'lukku iruntha meaychchalinaal thirupthiyaanaarka'l; thirupthiyaanapinpu avarka'l iruthayam meattimaiyaayit'ru; athinaal ennai ma'ranthaarka'l.
aakaiyaal naan avarka'lukkuch singkaththaippoal iruppean; sivingkiyaippoal vazhiyarukea pathiviruppean.

kuttika'laip pa'rikoduththa karadiyaippoala naan avarka'lai ethirththu, avarka'l eera'rkulaiyaik kizhiththu, avarka'lai angkea singkam padchikki'rathupoal padchiththuppoaduvean; kaattumirukangka'l avarka'laip pee'rippoadum.
isravealea, nee unakkuk keadu'ndaakkikko'ndaay; aanaalum ennidaththil unakkuch sakaayam u'ndu.
enakku raajaavaiyum athipathika'laiyum ea'rpaduththavea'ndum en'raayea; ippoathum unnudaiya ellaap patta'nangka'lilum unnai iradchikkum raajaa engkea? un niyaayaathipathika'l engkea?
naan koapaththilea unakku raajaavaik koduththean; en ukkiraththilea avanai eduththukko'ndean.
eppiraayeemin akkiramam kattivaiththirukki'rathu; avan paavam paththirappaduththappattirukki'rathu.
pirasavasthireeyin veathanai avanukku varum; avan viveakamillaatha pi'l'lai; pea'rukaalamattum avan ni'rkavillai.

avarka'lai naan paathaa'laththin vallamaikku neengkalaakki meedpean; avarka'lai mara'naththukku neengkalaakki viduvippean; mara'namea, un vaathaika'l engkea? paathaa'lamea, un sangkaaram engkea? manamaa'ruthal en ka'nka'lukku ma'raivaanathaayirukkum.

ivan sakoathararukku'l'lea janamperuththavanaayirunthaalum, karththarudaiya kaat'raakiya keezhkkaat'ru vanaantharaththilirunthu ezhumpivarum; athanaal avanudaiya oot'ruka'l vat'rippoakum; avanudaiya thuravu suva'rippoakum; athu ichchikkappadaththakka sakala pathaarththangka'lu'l'la uththama pathaarththangka'laiyum vaarikko'ndupoakum.

samaariyaa than theavanukku viroathamaakak kalakampa'n'ninapadiyaal, kut'ragn sumaththappattathaayirukkum; avarka'l pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kuzhanthaika'l moathiyadikkappadum; avarka'ludaiya karppavathika'l kee'rappattuppoavaarka'l.
isravealea, un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil thirumpu; nee un akkiramaththinaal vizhunthaay.

vaarththaika'laikko'ndu karththaridaththil thirumpungka'l; avarai noakki: theavareer ellaa akkiramaththaiyum neekki, engka'laith thayavaay angkeekariththaru'lum; appozhuthu naangka'l engka'l uthaduka'lin kaa'laika'laich seluththuvoam.

aseeriyaa engka'lai iradchippathillai; naangka'l kuthiraika'linmeal ea'ramaattoam; engka'l kaika'lin kiriyaiyaippaarththu: neengka'l engka'l theavarka'l en'ru inich sollamaattoam; thikkat'ravan ummidaththil irakkampe'ruki'raan en'ru sollungka'l.
naan avarka'l seerkeattaik ku'namaakkuvean; avarka'lai manappoorvamaaych sineakippean; en koapam avarka'laivittu neengkit'ru.
naan isravealukkup paniyaippoaliruppean; avan leelip pushpaththaippoal malaruvaan; leepanoanaippoal vearoon'ri ni'rpaan.
avan ki'laika'l oangkip padarum, avan alangkaaram olivamaraththinudaiya alangkaaraththaippoalavum, avanudaiya vaasanai leepanoanudaiya vaasanaiyaippoalavum irukkum.

avan nizhalil kudiyirukki'ravarka'l thirumpuvaarka'l; thaaniya vi'laichchalaippoalach sezhiththu, thiraadchachsedika'laippoalap padaruvaarka'l; avan vaasanai leepanoanudaiya thiraadcharasaththin vaasanaiyaippoala irukkum.

ini enakkum vikkirakangka'lukkum enna en'ru eppiraayeem solluvaan; naan avanukkuch sevikoduththu, avanmeal noakkamaayirunthean; naan pachchaiyaana theavathaaru virudchampoalirukki'rean; ennaalea un kaniyu'ndaayit'ru en'ru eppiraayeem solluvaan.

ivaika'lai u'naraththakka gnaanamu'l'lavan yaar? ivaika'laik kirakikkaththakka puththiyu'l'lavan yaar? karththarudaiya vazhika'l semmaiyaanavaika'l, neethimaanka'l avaika'lil nadappaarka'l; paathakaroaven'raal avaika'lil ida'rivizhuvaarka'l.
peththuvealin kumaaranaakiya yoavealukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam.
muthiyoarea, ithaik kea'lungka'l; theasaththin sakala kudika'lea, sevikodungka'l; ungka'l naadka'lilaavathu ungka'l pithaakka'lin naadka'lilaavathu ippadippattathu sampaviththathu'ndaa?
ithin seythiyai ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkuth theriviyungka'l; ithai ungka'l pi'l'laika'l thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum, avarka'l thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum santhathiyaarukkum therivikkakkadavarka'l.
pachchaippuzhu vittathai vettukki'li thin'rathu; vettukki'li vittathaip pachchaikki'li thin'rathu; pachchaikki'li vittathai musukkattaippoochchi thin'rathu.
ve'riyarea, vizhiththu azhungka'l; thiraadcharasam kudikki'ra sakala janangka'lea, puthu thiraadcharasaththinimiththam ala'rungka'l; athu ungka'l vaayinin'ru vilakkappattathu.
e'n'nimudiyaatha oru palaththa jaathi en theasaththinmeal varuki'rathu; athin pa'rka'l singkaththin pa'rka'l; thushda singkaththin kadaivaayppa'rka'l atha'rku u'ndu.
athu en thiraadchachsediyai azhiththu, en aththimaraththai uriththu, athin pattaiyai mut'rilum thin'rupoattathu; athin ki'laika'l ve'nmaiyaayit'ru.
than paaliyavayathin purushanukkaaka irattuduththiyirukki'ra pe'n'naippoalap pulampu.
poajanapaliyum paanapaliyum karththarudaiya aalayaththai vittu at'ruppoayina; karththarin oozhiyakkaararaakiya aasaariyarka'l thukkikki'raarka'l.
vayalve'li paazhaayit'ru, poomi thukkangko'ndaaduki'rathu; vi'laichchal azhikkappattathu; puthu thiraadcharasam vat'rippoayit'ru; e'n'ney maa'ndupoayit'ru.
payiridung kudika'lea, vedkappadungka'l; koathumaiyum vaa'rkoathumaiyum illaama'rpoayit'ru; thiraadchaththoattakkaararea, ala'rungka'l; vayalve'liyin a'ruppu azhinthupoayit'ru.

thiraadchachsedi vathangki, aththimaram saaramat'ruppoaki'rathu; maatha'lai, peareechcham, kichchili muthaliya ve'liyin sedika'l ellaam vaadippoayina; santhoasham manupuththiraraivittu ozhinthupoayit'ru.

aasaariyarka'lea, irattuduththip pulampungka'l; palipeedaththin pa'nividaikkaararea, ala'rungka'l; en theavanudaiya tho'ndarea, neengka'l u'l'lea piraveasiththu irattuduththavarka'laay iraaththangkungka'l. ungka'l theavanudaiya aalayaththil poajanapaliyum paanapaliyum seluththappadaamal ni'ruththappattathu.

parisuththa upavaasanaa'lai niyamiyungka'l; viseashiththa aasarippaik koo'rungka'l; moopparaiyum theasaththin ellaak kudika'laiyum, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin aalayaththilea koodivarachseythu karththarai noakkik kooppidungka'l.
antha naa'linimiththam aiyoa! karththarudaiya naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu; athu sangkaarampoalach sarvavallavaridaththilirunthu varuki'rathu.
nammudaiya ka'nka'laivittu aakaaramum, nammudaiya theavanin aalayaththaivittuch santhoashamum makizhchchiyum neekkappadavillaiyoa?
vithaiyaanathu ma'nkattika'linkeezh makkippoayit'ru; payir theeynthupoaki'rathinaal pa'ndasaalaika'l paazhaakik ka'lagnchiyangka'l idinthupoayina.
mirukangka'l evva'lavaayth thavikki'rathu; maattumanthaika'l thangka'lukku meaychchal illaathathinaal kalangkuki'rathu; aattumanthaika'lum seathamaayppoayit'ru.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppiduki'rean; akkini vanaantharaththin meaychchalka'laip padchiththu, juvaalai ve'liyin virudchangka'laiyellaam eriththuppoaduki'rathu.
ve'liyin mirukangka'lum ummai noakkik katha'ruki'rathu; nathika'lil tha'n'neerellaam vat'rippoayit'ru; akkini vanaantharaththin meaychchalka'laip padchiththuppoattathu.

seeyoanilea ekkaa'lam oothungka'l, en parisuththa parvathaththilea echcharippin saththamidungka'l; theasaththin kudika'l ellaam thaththa'likkakkadavarka'l; eanenil karththarudaiya naa'l varuki'rathu, athu sameepamaayirukki'rathu.

athu iru'lum anthakaaramumaana naa'l; athu mappum manthaaramumaana naa'l; vidiya'rkaala ve'luppu parvathangka'linmeal paravuki'rathupoala earaa'lamaana palaththa oru jaathi theeviramaaka vanthu paravum; appadippattathu mun oru kaalaththilum u'ndaanathumillai, inith thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaka varum varushangka'lilum u'ndaavathumillai.

avaika'lukku munnaaka akkini padchikkum, avaika'lukkup pinnaaka juvaalai erikkum; avaika'lukku munnaakath theasam eathean thoattaththaippoalavum, avaika'lukkup pinnaakap paazhaana vanaantharaththaippoalavum irukkum; avaika'lukku on'rum thappippoavathillai.
avaika'lin saayal kuthiraika'lin saayalai oththathu; avaika'l kuthirai veeraraippoala oadum.

avaika'l oaduki'ra irathangka'lin iraichchalpoalavum, seththaika'lai erikki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyin iraichchalpoalavum, yuththaththukku aayaththappatta palaththa janaththin iraichchalpoalavum, parvathangka'ludaiya sikarangka'linmeal kuthikkum.
avaika'lukku munpaaka janangka'l nadungkuvaarka'l; ellaa mukangka'lum karukippoakum.
avaika'l paraakkiramasaalika'laippoala oadum; yuththaveeraraippoala mathilea'rum; varisaika'l pisakaamal, ovvon'rum than than a'niyilea sellum.
on'rai on'ru nerukkaathu; ovvon'rum than than paathaiyilea sellum; avaika'l aayuthangka'lukku'l vizhunthaalum kaayampadaama'rpoakum.
avaika'l patta'nam engkum sellum; mathilinmeal oadum, veeduka'linmeal ea'rum; palaka'nivazhiyaayth thirudanaippoala u'l'lea nuzhaiyum.
avaika'lukku munpaakap poomi athirum; vaanangka'l asaiyum; sooriyanum santhiranum iru'ndupoakum; nadchaththirangka'l o'li mazhungkum.

karththar thamathu seanaikkumun saththamiduvaar; avarudaiya paa'layam makaa perithu, avarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi seyki'ratha'rku vallamaiyu'l'lathu; karththarudaiya naa'l perithum makaa payangkaramumaayirukkum; athaich sakikki'ravan yaar?
aathalaal neengka'l ippozhuthea upavaasaththoadum azhukaiyoadum pulampaloadum ungka'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum ennidaththil thirumpungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

neengka'l ungka'l vasthirangka'laiyalla, ungka'l iruthayangka'laik kizhiththu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar idaththil thirumpungka'l; avar irakkamum, mana urukkamum, neediya saanthamum, mikuntha kirupaiyumu'l'lavar; avar theengkukku manasthaapappaduki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
oruvea'lai avar thirumpi manasthaapappattu, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukkup poajanapalika'laiyum paanapalika'laiyum seluththuki'ratha'rkaana aaseervaathaththaith thantharu'luvaar.
seeyoanilea ekkaa'lam oothungka'l, parisuththa upavaasanaa'lai niyamiyungka'l, viseashiththa aasarippaik koo'rungka'l.

janaththaik koottungka'l, sapaiyaip parisuththappaduththungka'l; muthiyoaraich searungka'l, pi'l'laika'laiyum paalu'nki'ra kuzhanthaika'laiyum koottungka'l; ma'navaa'lan than a'raiyaiyum, ma'navaatti than ma'raivaiyum vittup pu'rappaduvaarka'laaka.

karththarin pa'nividaikkaararaakiya aasaariyarka'l ma'ndapaththukkum palipeedaththukkum naduvea azhuthu: karththaavea, neer umathu janaththaith thappavittup pu'rajaathika'l avarka'laip pazhikkum ninthaikku umathu suthantharaththai oppukkodaathirum; ungka'l theavan engkea en'ru pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sollappaduvaanean enpaarka'laaka.
appozhuthu karththar thamathu theasaththukkaaka vairaakkiyangko'ndu, thamathu janaththaik kadaadchippaar.

karththar ma'rumozhi koduththu, thamathu janaththai noakki: ithoa, naan ungka'lai inip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea ninthaiyaaka vaikkaamal, ungka'lukkuth thaaniyaththaiyum thiraadcharasaththaiyum e'n'neyaiyum koduththean, neengka'l athinaal thirupthiyaaveerka'l.

vadathisaichseanaiyai ungka'lukkuth thooramaaka vilakki, athin muntha'ndu keezhkkadalukkum, athin pintha'ndu mea'rkadalukkum nearaaka athai va'radchiyum paazhumaana theasaththukkuth thuraththividuvean; angkea athin naat'ram ezhumpi, athin thurkkantham veesum; athu periya kaariyangka'laich seythathu.
theasamea, payappadaathea, makizhnthu ka'likooru; karththar periya kaariyangka'laich seyvaar.
ve'liyin mirukangka'lea, payappadaatheayungka'l; vanaantharaththilea meaychchalka'l u'ndaakum; virudchangka'l kaayka'laik kaaykkum; aththimaramum thiraadchachsediyum palanaith tharum.

seeyoan kumaararea, ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarukku'l makizhnthu ka'likoorungka'l; avar thakkapadi ungka'lukku munmaariyaik koduththu, ungka'lukku munmaariyaiyum pinmaariyaiyum ea'rkanavea varushikkappa'n'nuvaar.
ka'langka'l thaaniyaththinaal nirampum; aalaika'lil thiraadcharasamum e'n'neyum vazhinthoadum.

naan ungka'lidaththil anuppina en periya seanaiyaakiya vettukki'lika'lum, pachchaikki'lika'lum, musukkattaip poochchika'lum, pachchaip puzhukka'lum padchiththa varushangka'lin vi'laivai ungka'lukkuth thirumpa a'lippean.

neengka'l sampoora'namaakach saappittu, thirupthiyadainthu, ungka'lai athisayamaay nadaththivantha ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththaith thuthippeerka'l; en janangka'l orupoathum vedkappattuppoavathillai.
naan isravealin naduvil irukki'ravaren'rum, naanea ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar, vea'roruvar illaiyen'rum a'rinthuko'lveerka'l; en janangka'l orupoathum vedkappattuppoavathillai.

atha'rkup pinpu naan maamsamaana yaavarmealum en aaviyai oot'ruvean; appozhuthu ungka'l kumaararum ungka'l kumaaraththika'lum theerkkatharisanagn solluvaarka'l; ungka'l mooppar soppanangka'laiyum, ungka'l vaalipar tharisanangka'laiyum kaa'npaarka'l.
oozhiyakkaararmealum oozhiyakkaarika'lmealum, annaadka'lilea en aaviyai oot'ruvean.
vaanaththilum poomiyilum iraththam akkini pukaisthampangka'laakiya athisayangka'laik kaattuvean.
karththarudaiya perithum payangkaramumaana naa'l varumunnea sooriyan iru'laakavum, santhiran iraththamaakavum maa'rum.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avan iradchikkappaduvaan; karththar sonnapadi, seeyoan parvathaththilum erusaleamilum karththar varavazhaikkum meethiyaayiruppavarka'lidaththilum iradchippu u'ndaayirukkum.
ithoa, yoothaavukkum erusaleamukkum u'ndaayirukki'ra si'raiyiruppai naan thiruppum annaadka'lilum akkaalaththilum,

naan sakala jaathiyaaraiyum kootti, yoasapaaththin pa'l'laththaakkilea avarka'lai i'rangkippoakappa'n'ni, avarka'l en janaththaiyum isravealennum en suthantharaththaiyum pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea sitha'radiththu en theasaththaip pangkittukko'ndathinimiththamum,

avarka'l en janaththinpearil seettuppoattu, aa'nkuzhanthaika'lai veasippa'naiyamaakak koduththu, mathupaanam pa'n'numpadi, pe'n kuzhanthaika'laith thiraadcharasaththukkuk kirayamaakak koduththathinimiththamum, angkea avarka'loadu vazhakkaaduvean.

theeruvea, seethoanea, pelisthiyaavin sakala ellaika'lea, ungka'lukkum enakkum enna? ippadi enakkuch sarikkattuki'reerka'loa? ippadi enakkuch sarikkattuveerka'laakil, naan thaamathamin'ri athiseekkiramaay neengka'l sarikkattuki'rathai ungka'l thalaiyinmeal thirumpumpadi seyvean.
neengka'l en ve'l'liyaiyum en ponnaiyum eduththu, inpamum uchchithamumaana en poru'lka'lai ungka'l koavilka'lilea ko'ndupoay,
yoothaavin kumaararaiyum erusaleamin kumaararaiyum avarka'ludaiya ellaika'lukkuth thooramaakkumpadikku, kireakkaridaththil vit'ruppoatteerka'l.
ithoa, neengka'l avarka'lai vit'ruppoatta avvidaththilirunthu naan avarka'lai ezhumpivarappa'n'ni, neengka'l sarikkattinathai ungka'l thalaiyinmeal thirumpumpadi seythu,

ungka'l kumaararaiyum ungka'l kumaaraththika'laiyum yoothaa puththirarin kaiyilea vi'rpean; ivarka'l avarka'laith thooratheasaththaaraakiya sapeayaridaththil vit'ruppoaduvaarka'l; karththar ithaich sonnaar.
ithaip pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea koo'rungka'l; yuththaththukku aayaththampa'n'nungka'l, paraakkiramasaalika'lai ezhuppungka'l; yuththaveerar ellaarum searnthu ea'rivarakkadavarka'l.
ungka'l ma'nvettika'laip pattayangka'laakavum, ungka'l arivaa'lka'lai eettika'laakavum adiyungka'l; palaveenanum thannaip palavaan en'ru solvaanaaka.
sakala jaathika'lea, neengka'l sut'rilumirunthu eakamaay vanthu koodungka'l; karththaavea, neerum angkea ummudaiya paraakkiramasaalika'lai i'rangkappa'n'nuveeraaka.
jaathika'l ezhumpi yoasapaaththin pa'l'laththaakkukku varuvaarka'laaka; sut'rilumu'l'la jaathika'lai niyaayantheerkka angkea naan veet'riruppean.
payir muthirnthathu, arivaa'lai neetti a'rungka'l, vanthu i'rangkungka'l; aalai nirampiyirukki'rathu, aalaiyin thottika'l vazhinthoaduki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya paathakam periyathu.
niyaayaththeerppin pa'l'laththaakkilea janangka'l thira'lthira'laay irukki'raarka'l; niyaayaththeerppin pa'l'laththaakkilea karththarin naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathu.
sooriyanum santhiranum iru'ndupoakum, nadchaththirangka'l o'limazhungkum.

karththar seeyoanilirunthu kerchchiththu, erusaleamilirunthu saththamiduvaar; vaanamum poomiyum athirum; aanaalum karththar thamathu janaththukku adaikkalamum israveal puththirarukku ara'naana koattaiyumaayiruppaar.

en parisuththa parvathamaakiya seeyoanilea vaasamaayirukki'ra naan ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar en'ru appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lveerka'l; appozhuthu erusaleam parisuththamaayirukkum; anniyar ini athaik kadanthupoavathillai.

akkaalaththil parvathangka'l thiraadcharasaththaip pozhiyum, malaika'l paalaay oadum, yoothaavin aa'ruka'l ellaam piravaakiththu oadum; oru oot'ru karththarudaiya aalayaththilirunthu pu'rappattuch siththeem ennum pa'l'laththaakkai neerppaaychchalaakkum.
yoothaa puththirarin theasaththilea kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthi, avarka'lukkuch seytha kodumaiyinimiththam ekipthu paazhaayppoakum, eathoam paazhaana vanaantharamaakum.
aanaal yoothaavoa sathaakaalamaakavum, erusaleam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaakavum kudiyeat'rappattirukkum.
naan tha'ndiyaamal vittiruntha avarka'ludaiya iraththappazhiyaith tha'ndiyaamal videan; karththar seeyoanilea vaasamaayirukki'raar.

thekkoavaa oor meaypparukku'l iruntha aamoas, yoothaavin raajaavaakiya usiyaavin naadka'lilum, isravealin raajaavaakiya yoavaasudaiya kumaaranaakiya eropeyaamin naadka'lilum, poomi athirchchi u'ndaaka ira'ndu varushaththukku munnea, isravealaikku'riththuth tharisanangka'ndu sonna vaarththaika'l.
karththar seeyoanilirunthu kerchchiththu, erusaleamilirunthu saththamiduvaar; athinaal meaypparin thaaparangka'l thukkangko'ndaadum; karmealin kodumudiyum kaaynthupoakum.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: thamaskuvinudaiya moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan athin aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l keeleayaaththai iruppuk karuvika'linaal poaradiththaarka'lea.
aasakealin veettilea theekko'luththuvean; athu penaathaathin aramanaika'laip padchikkum.

naan thamaskuvin thaazhppaa'lai udaiththu, kudika'lai aavean ennum pa'l'laththaakkilum, sengkoal seluththuki'ravanaip petheatheanilum iraathapadikkuch sangkaarampa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu seeriyaavin janangka'l keerukkuch si'raippattuppoavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: kaathsaavinudaiya moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan athin aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l si'raippattavarka'lai eathoamiyaridaththil oppuvikkumpadi muzhuthum si'raiyaakkinaarka'lea.
kaathsaavin mathilukku'l theekko'luththuvean; athu athinudaiya aramanaika'laip padchikkum.

naan kudika'lai asthoaththilum, sengkoal seluththuki'ravanai askaloanilum iraathapadikkuch sangkaarampa'n'ni, pelistharil meethiyaanavarka'l azhiyumpadikku en kaiyai ekroanukku viroathamaakath thiruppuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

mealum: theeruvinudaiya moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan athin aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l sakoathararin udanpadikkaiyai ninaiyaamal, si'raippattavarka'lai muzhuthum eathoamiyar kaiyil oppiththaarka'lea.
theeruvin mathilukku'l theekko'luththuvean; athu athin aramanaika'laip padchikkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

mealum: eathoamudaiya moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan avan aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avan than sakoatharanaip pattayaththoadea thodarnthu, than manathai irakkamat'rathaakki, than koapaththinaalea en'raikkum avanaip pee'rippoattu, than moorkkaththai niththiyakaalamaaka vaiththirukki'raanea.
theamaanilea theekko'luththuvean; athu poas'raavin aramanaika'laip padchikkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ammoan puththirarin moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan avarka'l aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l thangka'l ellaika'lai visthaaramaakkumpadikkuk keeleayaath theasaththin karppasthireeka'laik kee'rippoattaarka'lea.
rappaavin mathilukku'l theekko'luththuvean; athu yuththanaa'lin muzhakkamaakavum, perungkaat'rin pusalaakavum athin aramanaika'laip padchikkum.
avarka'ludaiya raajaavum, avanudaiya athipathika'lum si'raippattuppoavaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: moavaapin moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan avan aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avan eathoamudaiya raajaavin elumpuka'lai nee'raakach suttuppoattaanea.
moavaaptheasaththil theekko'luththuvean; athu keeriyoaththin aramanaika'laip padchikkum; moavaapiyar ama'liyoadum aarpparippoadum ekkaa'la saththaththoadum saavaarka'l.
niyaayaathipathiyai avarka'l naduvil iraathapadikku naan sangkaarampa'n'ni, avanoadeakooda avarka'ludaiya pirapukka'laiyellaam kon'rupoaduvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

mealum: yoothaavin moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan avarka'l aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l karththarudaiya veathaththai ve'ruththu, avarudaiya katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'laamal, thangka'l pithaakka'l pinpat'rina poyka'linaal moasampoanaarka'lea.
yoothaavilea naan theekko'luththuvean; athu erusaleamin aramanaika'laip padchikkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

mealum: isravealin moon'ru paathakangka'linimiththamum, naalu paathakangka'linimiththamum, naan avarka'ludaiya aakkinaiyaith thiruppamaattean; avarka'l neethimaanaip pa'naththukkum, e'liyavanai oru joadu paatharadchaikkum vit'ruppoattaarka'lea.

avarka'l thariththirarudaiya thalaiyinmeal ma'n'naivaari i'raiththu, si'rumaiyaanavarka'lin vazhiyaip purattuki'raarka'l; en parisuththa naamaththaik kulaichchalaakkumpadikku makanum thakappanum oru pe'n'nidaththil piraveasikki'raarka'l.

avarka'l sakala peedangka'larukilum adaimaanamaay vaangkina vasthirangka'linmeal paduththukko'ndu, the'ndam pidikkappattavarka'ludaiya mathupaanaththaith thangka'l theavarka'lin koavililea kudikki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

naanoa: keathurumarangka'laippoal uyaramum, karvaali marangka'laippoal vairamumaayiruntha emoariyanai avarka'lukku munpaaka azhiththean; uyara iruntha avanudaiya kaniyaiyum, thaazha iruntha avanudaiya vearka'laiyum azhiththuppoattu,
neengka'l emoariyanudaiya theasaththaik kattikko'l'lumpadikku ungka'lai naan ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ni, ungka'lai naa'rpathu varushamaaka vanaantharaththilea vazhinadaththi,

ungka'l kumaararil silaraith theerkkatharisika'laakavum, ungka'l vaaliparil silarai nasareayaraakavum ezhumpappa'n'ninean; israveal puththirarea, ippadi naan seyyavillaiyaa en'ru karththar keadki'raar.
neengka'loa nasareayarukkuth thiraadcharasam kudikkak koduththu, theerkkatharisika'lai noakki: neengka'l theerkkatharisanagnsollavea'ndaam en'ru ka'rpiththeerka'l.
ithoa, koathumaikkattuka'l ni'raipaaramaaka eat'rappatta va'ndiyil iruththuki'rathupoala, naan ungka'lai neengka'l irukki'ra sthalaththil iruththuvean.
appozhuthu veakamaanavan oadiyum pukalidamillai; palavaan than palaththinaal palappaduvathumillai; paraakkiramasaali than piraa'nanaith thappuvippathumillai.
villaip pidikki'ravan ni'rpathumillai; veakamaanavan than kaalka'laal thappippoavathumillai; kuthiraiyinmeal ea'ruki'ravan than piraa'nanai iradchippathumillai.
palasaalika'lukku'l'lea thairiyavaan annaa'lilea nirvaa'niyaay oadippoavaan en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
israveal puththirarea, karththaraakiya naan ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'nina muzhukkudumpamaakiya ungka'lukku viroathamaaych solliya intha vasanaththaik kea'lungka'l.
poomiyin ellaa vamsangka'lukku'l'lum ungka'laimaaththiram a'rinthuko'ndean; aakaiyaal ungka'ludaiya ellaa akkiramangka'linimiththamum ungka'laith tha'ndippean.
ira'ndupear orumanappattirunthaalozhiya orumiththu nadanthupoavaarka'loa?
thanakku irai akappadaamalirukkak kaattilea singkam kerchchikkumoa? iraipidiyaamal irukkumpoathu paalasingkam than kepiyilirunthu saththamidumoa?
kuruvikkuth tharaiyilea surukkup poadappadaathirunthaal, athu ka'n'niyil akappadumoa? on'rum padaathirukkaiyil, ka'n'ni tharaiyilirunthu edukkappadumoa?
ooril ekkaa'lam oothinaal, janangka'l kalangkaathiruppaarka'loa? karththarudaiya seyal illaamal ooril theengku u'ndaakumoa?
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar theerkkatharisika'laakiya thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkuth thamathu irakasiyaththai ve'lippaduththaamal oru kaariyaththaiyum seyyaar.
singkam kerchchikki'rathu, yaar payappadaathiruppaan? karththaraakiya aa'ndavar peasuki'raar, yaar theerkkatharisanam sollaathiruppaan?

neengka'l samaariyaavin parvathangka'lil vanthu koodi, athin naduvil nadakki'ra periya kalakangka'laiyum atha'rku'l seyyappaduki'ra idukka'nka'laiyum paarungka'l en'ru asthoaththin aramanaika'lmealum, ekipthutheasaththin aramanaika'lmealum koo'rungka'l.
avarka'l semmaiyaanathaich seyya a'riyaamal, thangka'l aramanaika'lil kodumaiyaiyum ko'l'laiyaiyum kuviththukko'l'luki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal saththuru vanthu, theasaththaich soozhnthuko'ndu, un pelaththai unnilirunthu at'ruppoakappa'n'nuvaan; appozhuthu un aramanaika'l ko'l'laiyidappadum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

mealum: oru meayppan ira'ndu kaalka'laiyaavathu oru kaathin thu'ndaiyaavathu singkaththin vaayilirunthu pidungkith thappuvikkumaappoala, samaariyaavil kudiyirukki'ra israveal puththirar oru padukkaiyin moolaiyilirunthum, oru magnchaththinmealirunthum thappuvikkappaduvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l keattu yaakkoapu vamsaththaarukku'l'lea saadchiyaaka a'rivikkavea'ndiyathu: seanaika'lin theavanaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal,
naan isravealudaiya paathakangka'linimiththam avanai visaarikkum naa'lilea naan peththealin palipeedangka'lai visaarippean; palipeedaththin kompuka'l vettu'ndu tharaiyilea vizhum.
maarikaalaththu veettaiyum koadaikaalaththu veettaiyum azhippean; appozhuthu yaanaiththanthaththaal seyyappatta veeduka'l azhiyum; periya veeduka'lukkum mudivu varum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

samaariyaavin malaika'lilu'l'la paasaanin maaduka'lea, neengka'l intha vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; thariththirarai odukki, e'liyavarka'lai no'rukki, avarka'ludaiya ejamaanka'lai noakki: naangka'l kudikkumpadik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'ru solluki'reerka'l.

ithoa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavar ungka'laith thu'raduka'laalum, ungka'l pinsanthathiyai meenpidikki'ra thoo'ndilka'laalum izhuththukko'ndupoakum naadka'l varumen'ru avar thammudaiya parisuththaththaikko'ndu aa'naiyittaar.
appozhuthu neengka'l ovvoruvanum aramanaikkuch sumanthuko'ndupoavathai e'rinthuvittu, thanakku ethiraana thi'rappuka'lin vazhiyaayp pu'rappattuppoaveerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

peththealukkup poayth thuroakam pa'n'nungka'l, kilkaalukkum poayth thuroakaththaip perukappa'n'ni, kaalaithoa'rum ungka'l palika'laiyum, moon'raam varushaththilea ungka'l thasamapaakangka'laiyum seluththi,

pu'liththamaavu'l'la sthoaththirapaliyoadea thoopangkaatti, u'rchaaka palika'laik koo'rith theriyappaduththungka'l; israveal puththirarea, ippadich seyvathea ungka'lukkup piriyam en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

aakaiyaal naan ungka'l patta'nangka'lil ellaam ungka'l palluka'lukku oayvaiyum, ungka'l sthalangka'lil ellaam appakku'raivaiyum katta'laiyittean; aakilum neengka'l ennidaththil thirumpaama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithuvumallaamal, a'ruppukkaalam vara innum moon'rumaatham irukkumpoathea mazhaiyai naan thaduththean, oru patta'naththinmeal mazhaipeyyavum oru patta'naththinmeal mazhai peyyaamalirukkavum pa'n'ninean; oru vayalinmeal mazhaipeythathu, mazhaipeyyaatha mat'ra vayal kaaynthu poayit'ru.

ira'ndu moon'ru patta'nangka'lin manushar tha'n'neer kudikka orea patta'naththukkup poay alainthum thaakantheerththukko'l'lavillai; aakilum neengka'l ennidaththil thirumpaama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

karukkaayinaalum vishappaniyinaalum ungka'lai tha'ndiththean; ungka'l soalaika'lilum thiraadchaththoattangka'lilum aththimarangka'lilum olivamarangka'lilum mikuthiyaanathaip pachchaippuzhu ariththuppoattathu; aakilum ennidaththil thirumpaama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ekipthilea u'ndaanatha'rku oththa ko'l'lainoayai ungka'lukku'l anuppinean; ungka'l vaaliparaip pattayaththaalea kon'rean; ungka'l kuthiraika'lai azhiththuppoattean; ungka'l paa'layangka'lin naat'raththai ungka'l naasika'lilum ea'rappa'n'ninean; aakilum neengka'l ennidaththil thirumpaama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

soathoamaiyum komoaraavaiyum theavan kavizhththuppoattathu poala, ungka'laik kavizhththuppoattean; neengka'l akkiniyinin'ru pa'rikkappatta ko'l'liyaippoala iruntheerka'l; aakilum neengka'l ennidaththil thirumpaama'rpoaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
aakaiyaal isravealea, inthappirakaaramaaka unakkuch seyvean; isravealea, naan ippadi unakkuch seyyappoaki'rapadiyinaal un theavanaich santhikkumpadi aayaththappadu.

avar parvathangka'lai uruvaakkinavarum, kaat'raich sirushdiththavarum, manushanudaiya ninaivuka'l innathen'ru avanukku ve'lippaduththuki'ravarum, vidiya'rkaalaththai anthakaaramaakkuki'ravarum, poomiyinudaiya uyarntha sthaanangka'linmeal ulaavuki'ravarumaayirukki'raar; seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
israveal vamsaththaarea, ungka'laikku'riththu naan pulampich sollum intha vasanaththaik kea'lungka'l.
israveal ennum kannikai vizhunthaa'l, ava'l ini orupoathum ezhunthirukkamaattaa'l; than theasaththil vizhunthukidakki'raa'l, ava'lai eduppaarillai.
nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappatta aayirampearil noo'rupearum, noo'rupearil paththuppearum israveal vamsaththaarukku meenthiruppaarka'l en'ru karththaraakiya theavan solluki'raar.
karththar israveal vamsaththaarukkuch solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ennaith theadungka'l, appozhuthu pizhaippeerka'l.
peththealaith theadaatheayungka'l, kilkaalilum searaatheayungka'l, peyersepaavukkum poakaatheayungka'l; eanen'raal kilkaal si'raiyiruppaakavum, peththeal paazhaana sthalamaakavum poakum.
karththaraith theadungka'l, appozhuthu pizhaippeerka'l; illaavittaal peththealil irukki'ra oruvaraalum avikkappadaatha akkini yoaseappin veettil pat'ri, athaip padchikkum.
niyaayaththai ettiyaaka maat'ri, neethiyaith tharaiyilea vizhappa'n'nuki'ravarka'lea, avaraith theadungka'l.

avar a'rumeenaiyum mirukaseerishaththaiyum u'ndaakkinavar; avar mara'na iru'lai vidiya'rkaalamaaka maat'ri, pakalai iraaththiriyaaka anthakaarappaduththuki'ravar; avar samuththiraththin tha'n'neerka'lai varavazhaiththu, avaika'laip poomiyin visaalaththinmeal oot'ruki'ravar; karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.
ara'naana sthalaththinmeal paazhkkadippu varaththakkathaaka, avar ko'l'lai koduththavanaip palaththavanukku viroathamaay lakuvadaiyappa'n'nuki'ravar.
olimukavaasalilea kadinthuko'l'luki'ravanai avarka'l pakaiththu, yathaarththamaayp peasuki'ravanai ve'rukki'raarka'l.

neengka'l thariththiranai mithiththu, avan kaiyilea thaaniyaththaich sumaisumaiyaay vaangkuki'rapadiyinaal, neengka'l po'lintha ka'rka'laal veeduka'laik kattineerka'l, aanaalum avaika'lil neengka'l kudiyiruppathillai; inpamaana thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattineerka'l, aanaalum avaika'lin irasaththai neengka'l kudippathillai.
ungka'l mee'ruthalka'l mikuthiyen'rum, ungka'l paavangka'l palaththathen'rum a'rivean; neethimaanai odukki, parithaanam vaangki, olimukavaasalil eazhaika'lin niyaayaththaip purattuki'reerka'l.
aakaiyaal puththimaan anthak kaalaththilea maunamaayirukkavea'ndum; anthak kaalam theemaiyaana kaalam.
neengka'l pizhaikkumpadikkuth theemaiyai alla, nanmaiyaith theadungka'l; appozhuthu neengka'l solluki'rapadiyea seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar ungka'loadea iruppaar.

neengka'l theemaiyai ve'ruththu, nanmaiyai virumpi, olimukavaasalil niyaayaththai nilaippaduththungka'l; oruvea'lai seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar yoaseappilea meethiyaanavarka'lukku irangkuvaar.

aathalaal aa'ndavarum seanaika'lin theavanumaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ellaaththerukka'lilum pulampal u'ndaakum; ellaa veethika'lilum aiyoa! aiyoa! en'ru oalamiduvaarka'l; payiriduki'ravarka'laith thukkangko'ndaaduki'ratha'rkum, oppaaripaada a'rinthavarka'laip pulampuki'ratha'rkum varavazhaippaarka'l.
ellaath thiraadchaththoattangka'lilum pulampal u'ndaayirukkum, naan un naduvea kadanthupoavean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
karththarudaiya naa'lai virumpuki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa! athinaal ungka'lukku enna u'ndu? karththarudaiya naa'l ve'lichchamaayiraamal anthakaaramaayirukkum.
singkaththukkuth thappinavanukkuk karadi ethirppattathupoalavum, allathu veettukku'l'lea vanthu suvarinmeal than kaiyai vaiththapoathu paampu avanaik kadiththathupoalavum irukkum.
karththarudaiya naa'l ve'lichchamaayiraamal, iru'lum pirakaasamat'ra anthakaaramumaayirukkumallavoa?
ungka'l pa'ndikaika'laip pakaiththu ve'rukki'rean; ungka'l aasarippu naadka'lil enakkup piriyamillai.
ungka'l thakanapalika'laiyum poajanapalika'laiyum enakkup padaiththaalum naan angkeekarikkamaattean; kozhumaiyaana ungka'l mirukangka'lin sthoaththirapalika'laiyum naan noakkip paarkkamaattean.
un paattuka'lin iraichchalai ennaivittu akat'ru; un vee'naika'lin oasaiyai naan keadkamaattean.
niyaayam tha'n'neeraippoalavum, neethi vat'raatha nathiyaippoalavum pura'ndu varakkadavathu.
