israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l vanaantharaththilea iruntha naa'rpathu varushamvaraiyil palika'laiyum kaa'nikkaika'laiyum enakkuch seluththineerka'loa?
neengka'l ungka'lukku u'ndaakkina moa'loakudaiya koodaaraththaiyum, ungka'l theavarka'lin nadchaththiraraasiyaakiya ungka'l soroopangka'lin sapparaththaiyum sumanthuko'nduvantheerka'lea.
aakaiyaal ungka'laith thamaskuvukku appaalea kudiyoattuvean en'ru seanaika'ludaiya theavan ennum naamamu'l'la karththar solluki'raar.

seeyoanilea nirvisaaramaayirukki'ravarka'lum samaariyaavin parvathaththai nampikko'ndirukki'ravarka'lum, jaathika'lin thalaimaiyennappattu, israveal vamsaththaar theadivaruki'ravarka'lumaakiya ungka'lukku aiyoa!

neengka'l kalneamattum sen'ru, avvidaththilirunthu aamaath ennum periya patta'naththukkup poay, pelistharudaiya kaathpatta'naththukku i'rangki, avaika'l intha raajyangka'laippaarkkilum nallavaika'loa en'rum, avaika'lin ellaika'l ungka'l ellaika'laippaarkkilum visthaaramaanavaika'loa en'rum paarungka'l.
theengkunaa'l thooramen're'n'nik kodumaiyin aasanam kittivarumpadi seythu,
thanthak kattilka'lil paduththukko'ndu, thangka'l magnchangka'linmeal savukkiyamaaych sayaniththu, manthaiyilu'l'la aattukkuttika'laiyum, maattuththozhuvaththilu'l'la kan'rukkuttika'laiyum thin'ru,
thampurai vaasiththup paadi, thaaveethaippoal keethavaaththiyangka'laith thangka'lukku u'ndupa'n'ni,
periya paaththirangka'lil mathupaanaththaik kudiththu, si'rantha parima'lathailangka'laip poosikko'l'luki'raarka'l; aanaalum yoaseappukku nearitta aapaththukkuk kavalaippadaama'rpoaki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal avarka'l si'raiyiruppukkup poaki'ravarka'lin munna'niyilea poavaarka'l; ippadiyea selvamaaych sayaniththavarka'lin virunthuko'ndaadal nin'rupoakum.

naan yaakkoapudaiya meanmaiyai ve'ruththu, avanudaiya aramanaika'laip pakaikki'rean; naan nakaraththaiyum athin ni'raivaiyum oppukkoduththuviduvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar thammudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittaar enpathaich seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.
oru veettilea paththuppear meethiyaayirunthaalum avarka'l seththuppoavaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya inaththaanaavathu, pireathaththaith thakikki'ravanaavathu elumpuka'lai veettilirunthu ve'liyea ko'ndupoakumpadikku, avaika'lai eduththu, veettin udpu'raththilea irukki'ravanai noakki: unnidaththil innum yaaraayinum u'ndoa en'ru keadpaan, avan illaiyenpaan; appozhuthu ivan: nee maunamaayiru; karththarudaiya naamaththaich sollalaakaathu enpaan.
ithoa, karththar katta'laiyittirukki'raar; periya veettaith thi'rappuka'l u'ndaakavum, si'riya veettai vedippuka'l u'ndaakavum adippaar.
kanmalaiyinmeal kuthiraika'l oadumoa? angkea oruvan maaduka'laal uzhuvaanoa? niyaayaththai nagnchaakavum, neethiyin kaniyai ettiyaakavum maat'rineerka'l.
naangka'l engka'l palaththinaalea engka'lukkuk kompuka'lai u'ndaakkikko'l'lavillaiyoa en'ru solli, vee'nkaariyaththil makizhuki'raarka'l.

israveal vamsaththaarea, ithoa, naan oru jaathiyai ungka'lukku viroathamaaka ezhuppuvean; avarka'l aamaaththukku'l piraveasikki'ra vazhithodangkich samanaana naattin aa'rumattaaka ungka'lai odukkuvaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar.
karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuk kaa'npiththathaavathu: ithoa, raajaavinudaiya pulla'ruppukkuppinpu ira'ndaam kanthaayaththup pul mu'laikkath thodangkukaiyil avar vettukki'lika'lai u'ndaakkinaar.
avaika'l theasaththin pullaiththin'ru theernthapoathu, naan: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, manniththaru'lum; yaakkoapu thirumpa yaaraalea ezhunthiruppaan? avan si'ruththuppoanaan en'rean.
karththar atha'rku manasthaapappattu, appadi aavathillai en'raar.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuk kaa'npiththathaavathu: ithoa, akkiniyaalea niyaayam visaarippean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar ea'rpattaar; athu makaa aazhiyaip padchiththathu, athil oru pangkaip padchiththuth theernthathu.
appozhuthu naan: karththaraakiya aa'ndavarea, ni'ruththumea; yaakkoapu thirumpa yaaraalea ezhunthiruppaan? avan si'ruththuppoanaan en'rean.
karththar atha'rku manasthaapappattu, appadi aavathillai en'raar.
pinpu avar enakkuk kaa'npiththathaavathu: ithoa, thookkunool piramaa'naththinaal kattappatta oru mathilinmeal nin'raar; avar kaiyil thookkunool irunthathu.

karththar ennai noakki: aamoasea, nee ennaththaik kaa'nki'raay en'raar; thookkunoolaik kaa'nki'rean en'rean; appozhuthu aa'ndavar: ithoa, isravealennum en janaththin naduvea thookkunoolai viduvean; ini avarka'lai mannikkamaattean.
eesaakkin meadaika'l paazhum, isravealin parisuththa sthalangka'l avaantharamumaakkappadum; naan eropeyaam veettaarukku viroathamaayp pattayaththoadea ezhumpivaruvean en'raar.

appozhuthu peththealil aasaariyanaana amathsiyaa isravealin raajaavaakiya eropeyaamukku aa'l anuppi: aamoas israveal vamsaththaarin naduvea umakku viroathamaakak kattuppaadu pa'n'nuki'raan; theasam avan vaarththaika'laiyellaam sakikkamaattaathu.
eropeyaam pattayaththinaal saavaan en'rum, israveal than theasaththilirunthu si'raipidiththuk ko'ndupoakappaduvaan en'rum aamoas solluki'raan en'ru sollachsonnaan.
amathsiyaa aamoasai noakki: tharisanam paarkki'ravanea, poa; nee yoothaatheasaththukku oadippoa, angkea appam thin'ru, angkea theerkkatharisanam sollu.
peththealilea inith theerkkatharisanam sollaathea; athu raajaavin parisuththa sthalamum raajyaththin aramanaiyumaayirukki'rathu en'raan.

aamoas amathsiyaavukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan theerkkatharisiyumalla, theerkkatharisiyin puththiranumalla; naan manthai meaykki'ravanum, kaattaththippazhangka'laip po'rukkuki'ravanumaayirunthean.
aanaal manthaiyin pinnaalea poaki'rapoathu ennaik karththar azhaiththu, nee poay en janamaakiya isravealukku viroathamaakath theerkkatharisanam sollu en'ru karththar uraiththaar.
ippoathum nee karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l; isravealukku viroathamaayth theerkkatharisanam sollaathea, eesaakkin vamsaththaarukku viroathamaaka on'raiyum sollaathea en'ru solluki'raayea.

ithinimiththam: un pe'njaathi nakaraththil veasiyaavaa'l; un kumaararum un kumaaraththika'lum pattayaththaal vizhuvaarka'l; un vayal a'lavunoolaal pangkittukko'l'lappadum; neeyoavenil asuththamaana theasaththilea seththuppoavaay; isravealum than theasaththilirunthu si'raipidikkappattuk ko'ndupoakappaduvaan en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.
pinpu karththaraakiya aa'ndavar enakkuk kaa'npiththathaavathu: ithoa, pazhuththa pazhangka'lu'l'la oru koodai irunthathu.

avar: aamoasea, nee ennaththaik kaa'nki'raay en'ru keattaar? pazhuththa pazhangka'lu'l'la oru koodaiyaik kaa'nki'rean en'rean. appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: en janamaakiya isravealukku mudivukaalam vanthathu; ini avarka'lai mannikkamaattean.
annaa'lilea theavaalayappaattuka'l ala'ruthalaaka maa'rum; ellaa idaththilum thira'laana pireathangka'l pulampalillaamal e'rinthuvidappadum en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.
theasaththil si'rumaippattavarka'lai ozhiyappa'n'na, e'liyavarka'lai vizhungki:

naangka'l marakkaalaik ku'raiththu, seakkal ni'raiyai athikamaakki, ka'l'laththaraasinaal vagnchiththu, thariththiraraip pa'naththukkum, e'liyavarka'lai oru joadu paatharadchaikkum ko'l'lumpadikkum, thaaniyaththin patharai vi'rkumpadikkum,

naangka'l thavasam vi'rkaththakkathaaka maathappi'rappum, naangka'l thaaniyaththin pa'ndasaalaika'laith thi'rakkaththakkathaaka oayvunaa'lum eppoathu mudiyum en'ru solluki'ravarka'lea, ithaik kea'lungka'l.
avarka'l seykaika'laiyellaam naan orupoathum ma'rappathillaiyen'ru karththar yaakkoapudaiya makimaiyinpearil aa'naiyittaar.
ithinimiththam theasam athiravum, athin kudika'l ellaam thukkikkavum, engkum nathika'laayp pura'ndoadavum, ekipthin aat'ruve'l'laththaippoal adiththu, peruve'l'lamaakavum vea'ndaamoa?
annaa'lilea naan maththiyaanaththilea sooriyanai asthamikkappa'n'ni, pattappakalilea theasaththai anthakaarappaduththi,

ungka'l pa'ndikaika'laith thukkippaakavum, ungka'l paattuka'laiyellaam pulampalaakavum maa'rappa'n'ni, sakala araika'lilum irattaiyum, sakala thalaika'lilum mottaiyaiyum varuviththu, avarka'ludaiya thukkippai orea pi'l'laikkaakath thukkikki'ra thukkippukkuch samaanamaakki, avarka'ludaiya mudivaik kasappaana naa'laakkuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

ithoa, naan theasaththinmeal pagnchaththai anuppum naadka'l varum; aakaarak ku'raivinaal u'ndaakiya pagnchamalla, jalakku'raivinaal u'ndaakiya thaakamumalla, karththarudaiya vasanam keadkak kidaiyaatha pagnchaththai anuppuvean en'ru karththaraakiya aa'ndavar solluki'raar.

appozhuthu avarka'l karththarudaiya vasanaththaith theada oru samuththiranthodangki ma'ru samuththiramattum, vadathisaithodangkik keezhththisaimattum alainthu thirinthum athaik ka'ndadaiyaama'r poavaarka'l.
annaa'lilea saunthariyamu'l'la kannikaika'lum vaaliparum thaakaththinaal soarnthupoavaarka'l.

thaa'nea! un theavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum, peyersepaa maarkkaththin theavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum en'ru solli, samaariyaavin thoashaththinmeal aa'naiyiduki'ravarka'l vizhuvaarka'l; ini orupoathum ezhunthirukkamaattaarka'l en'raar.

aa'ndavaraip palipeedaththinmeal ni'rkakka'ndean; avar: nee vaasal nilaika'l asaiyumpadi poathikaiyai adiththu, avaika'lai avarka'l ellaarudaiya thalaiyinmealum vizha udaiththuppoadu; avarka'lukkup pinnaakavarum meethiyaanavarka'lai naan pattayaththinaal kon'rupoaduvean; avarka'lil oaduki'ravan oruvanum thappuvathumillai, avarka'lil thappuki'ravan oruvanum iradchikkappaduvathumillai.

avarka'l paathaa'lapariyantham thoa'ndip pathungkikko'ndaalum, en kai avvidaththilirunthu avarka'laip pidiththukko'nduvarum; avarka'l vaanapariyantham ea'rinaalum, avvidaththilumirunthu avarka'lai i'rangkappa'n'nuvean;

avarka'l karmealin kodumudiyilea o'liththukko'ndaalum, angkea avarka'laith theadippidippean; avarka'l samuththiraththin aazhaththilea poay en ka'nka'lukku ma'rainthuko'ndaalum, angkea avarka'laik kadikkap paampuka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvean.

avarka'l thangka'l saththuruvukku munpaakach si'raippattuppoanaalum, angkea avarka'laik kon'rupoadap pattayaththukku naan katta'laiyittu, en ka'nka'lai avarka'lmeal nanmaikkalla, theemaikken'rea vaippean.

seanaika'lin karththaraakiya aa'ndavar theasaththaith thoda, athu urukippoam; appozhuthu athin kudika'lellaarum pulampuvaarka'l; engkum nathiyaayp pura'ndoadi, ekipthinudaiya aat'ru ve'l'laththaippoal ve'l'lamaakum.

avar vaanaththil thamathu meala'raika'laik katti, poomiyil thamathu keezha'raika'lai asthipaarappaduththi, samuththiraththin tha'n'neerka'lai varavazhaiththu, avaika'laip poomiyinudaiya visaalaththinmeal oot'ruki'ravar; karththar enpathu avarudaiya naamam.

israveal puththirarea, neengka'l enakku eththiyoappiyarin puththiraraippoal irukki'reerka'l allavoa en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan isravealai ekipthutheasaththilirunthum, pelistharaik kapthoarilirunthum, seeriyaraik keerilirunthum ko'nduvaravillaiyoa?

ithoa, karththaraakiya aa'ndavarin ka'nka'l paavamu'l'la raajyaththukku viroathamaaka vaikkappattirukki'rathu; athaip poomiyinmeal iraathapadikku azhiththuppoaduvean; aakilum yaakkoapin vamsaththai muzhuvathum azhikkamaattean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, jalladaiyinaal saliththarikki'rathupoal israveal vamsaththaarai ellaa jaathika'lukku'l'lum saliththarikkumpadikku naan katta'laiyiduvean; aanaalum oru koathumaima'niyum tharaiyilea vizhuvathillai.
theengku engka'lai a'nukuvathumillai, engka'lukku neariduvathumillaiyen'ru en janaththil solluki'ra paavika'lellaarum pattayaththinaal saavaarka'l.
eathoamil meethiyaanavarka'laiyum, en naamam vi'langkiya sakala jaathika'laiyum vasamaakkikko'l'lumpadikku,

annaa'lilea vizhunthupoana thaaveethin koodaaraththai naan thirumpa eduppiththu, athin thi'rappuka'lai adaiththu, athil pazhuthaayppoanathaich seerppaduththi, poorvanaadka'lil irunthathupoala athai sthaapippean en'ru ithaich seyki'ra karththar solluki'raar.

ithoa, uzhuki'ravan a'rukki'ravanaiyum, thiraadchappazhangka'lai aalaiyaaduki'ravan vithaikki'ravanaiyum thodarnthupidiththu, parvathangka'l thiraadcharasamaay vadiki'rathum, meaduka'lellaam karaiki'rathumaana naadka'l varum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

en janamaakiya isravealin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean; avarka'l paazhaana nakarangka'laik katti, avaika'lil kudiyirunthu, thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naatti, avaika'ludaiya pazharasaththaik kudiththu, thoattangka'lai u'ndaakki, avaika'lin kanika'laip pusippaarka'l.
avarka'lai avarka'l theasaththilea naattuvean; naan avarka'lukkuk koduththa theasaththilirunthu avarka'l inip pidungkappaduvathillaiyen'ru un theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar en'raar.

opathiyaavin tharisanam; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar eathoamaik ku'riththuch solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ezhumpungka'l, atha'rku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'na ezhumpuvoam vaarungka'l en'ru a'rivikka sthaanaapathi jaathika'lidaththil anuppappadum seythiyaik karththar sollakkeattoam.
ithoa, naan unnai jaathika'lil si'rukappa'n'ninean; nee meththavum asattaipa'n'nappattirukki'raay.

kanmalai vedippuka'laakiya un uyarntha sthaanaththilea kudiyirunthu, ennaith tharaiyilea vizhaththa'l'luki'ravan yaar en'ru un iruthayaththil solluki'ravanea, un iruthayaththin akanthai unnai moasampoakkuki'rathu.
nee kazhukaippoala uyarappoanaalum, nee nadchaththirangka'lukku'l'lea un koottaik kattinaalum, avvidaththilirunthum unnai vizhaththa'l'luvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

nee evva'lavaaych sangkarippattuppoanaay! thirudaraakilum iraaththiriyil ko'l'laiyadikki'ravarka'laakilum unnidaththil vanthaal, thangka'lukkup poathumaanamattum thiruduvaarka'l allavoa? thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'rukki'ravarka'l unnidaththil vanthaal, sila pazhangka'lai vittuviduvaarka'l allavoa?
easaavinudaiyavaika'l evva'lavaayth theadippaarkkappattathu; avanudaiya antharangkap pokkishangka'l evva'lavaay aaraayntheduththuk ko'l'lappattathu.

unnoadu udanpadikkai seytha ellaa manusharum unnai ellaimattum thuraththivittaarka'l; unnoadu samaathaanamaayiruntha manushar unnai moasampoakki, unnai mea'rko'ndaarka'l; un appaththaich saappittavarka'l unakkuk keezhea ka'n'nivaiththaarka'l. avanukku u'narvillai.
annaa'lil allavoa naan eathoamilu'l'la gnaanika'laiyum, easaavin parvathaththilu'l'la puththimaanka'laiyum azhippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
theamaanea, easaavin parvathaththilu'l'la manushar yaavarum kolaiyinaal sangkarikkappadumpadi un paraakkiramasaalika'l kalangkuvaarka'l.
nee un sakoatharanaakiya yaakkoapukkuch seytha kodumaiyinimiththam vedkam unnai moodum; nee mut'rilum sangkarikkappattuppoavaay.

nee ethirththunin'ra naa'lilum, anniyar avan seanaiyaich si'raipidiththuppoana naa'lilum, ma'rutheasaththaar avan vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasiththu erusaleaminpearil seettuppoatta kaalaththil, neeyum avarka'lil oruvanaippoal irunthaay.

un sakoatharan anniyarvasamaana naa'laakiya avanudaiya naa'lai nee piriyaththoadea paaraamalum, yoothaa puththirarudaiya azhivin naa'lilea avarka'l nimiththam santhoashappadaamalum, avarka'l nerukkappaduki'ra naa'lilea nee perumaiyaayp peasaamalum irukka vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.

en janaththin aapaththunaa'lilea nee avarka'l vaasalka'lukku'l piraveasiyaamalum, avarka'l aapaththunaa'lilea avarka'l anupavikki'ra theengkai nee piriyaththoadea paaraamalum, avarka'l aapaththunaa'lilea avarka'l aasthiyil kaipoadaamalum,
avarka'lil thappinavarka'laich sangkarikkumpadi vazhichsanthika'lilea ni'rkaamalum, ikkattu naa'lil avarka'lil meethiyaanavarka'laik kaattikkodaamalum irukkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
ellaa jaathika'lukkum viroathamaana naa'laakiya karththarudaiya naa'l sameepamaay vanthirukki'rathu; nee seythapadiyea unakkum seyyappadum; un seykaiyin palan un thalaiyinmeal thirumpum.

neengka'l en parisuththa parvathaththinmeal mathupaanampa'n'ninapadiyea ellaa jaathika'lum eppozhuthum mathupaanampa'n'nuvaarka'l; avarka'l kudiththu vizhungkuvaarka'l, iraathavarka'laippoal iruppaarka'l.
aanaalum seeyoan parvathaththilea thappiyiruppaar u'ndu, avarka'l parisuththamaayiruppaarka'l; yaakkoapin vamsaththaar thangka'ludaiya suthantharangka'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.

yaakkoapu vamsaththaar akkiniyum, yoaseappu vamsaththaar akkinijuvaalaiyumaayiruppaarka'l; easaa vamsaththaaroa vaikkoal thurumpaayiruppaarka'l; avarka'l ivarka'laik ko'luththi, easaavin vamsaththil meethiyiraathapadi ivarka'laip padchippaarka'l; karththar ithaich sonnaar.

thentheasaththaar easaavin malaiyaiyum, samanaana theasaththaar pelistharin theasaththaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l eppiraayeemin naattaiyum, samaariyaavin naattaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l; penyameen manushar keeleayaaththaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.

sarpaathmattum kaanaaniyarukku'l'lea si'raippattuppoana israveal puththiraraakiya inthach seanaiyum, seappaaraaththil si'raippattuppoana erusaleam nakaraththaarum thenthisaip patta'nangka'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l.
easaavin parvathaththai niyaayantheerppatha'rkaaka iradchakarka'l seeyoan parvathaththil vanthea'ruvaarka'l; appozhuthu raajyam karththarudaiyathaay irukkum.
amiththaayin kumaaranaakiya yoanaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:
nee ezhunthu makaa nakaramaakiya niniveakkup poay, atha'rku viroathamaakap pirasangki; avarka'ludaiya akkiramam en samukaththil vanthu ettinathu en'raar.

appozhuthu yoanaa karththarudaiya samukaththinin'ru vilaki, tharsheesukku oadippoakumpadi ezhunthu, yoappaavukkup poay, tharsheesukkup poaki'ra oru kappalaikka'ndu, kooli koduththu, thaan karththarudaiya samukaththinin'ru vilakumpadi, avarka'loadea tharsheesukkup poakak kappal ea'rinaan.
karththar samuththiraththinmeal perungkaat'rai varavittaar; athinaal kadalilea kappal udaiyumen'ru ninaikkaththakka periya kontha'lippu u'ndaayit'ru.

appozhuthu kappa'rkaarar payanthu, avanavan thanthan theavanai noakki vea'nduthalseythu, paaraththai leasaakkumpadik kappalil iruntha sarakkuka'laich samuththiraththil e'rinthuvittaarka'l; yoanaavoaven'raal kappalin keezhththattil i'rangkipoayp paduththukko'ndu, ayarntha niththiraipa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu maalumi avanidaththil vanthu: nee niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathu enna? ezhunthirunthu un theavanai noakki vea'ndikko'l; naam azhinthupoakaathapadikkuch suvaami oruvea'lai nammai ninaiththaru'luvaar en'raan.

avarka'l yaarnimiththam intha aapaththu namakku nearittathen'ru naam a'riyumpadikkuch seettuppoaduvoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndu seettuppoattaarka'l; yoanaavin pearukkuch seettu vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu avarka'l avanai noakki: yaarnimiththam intha aapaththu namakku nearittathen'ru nee engka'lukkuch sollavea'ndum; un thozhilenna? nee engkeayirunthu varuki'raay? un theasam ethu? nee enna jaathiyaan en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: naan epireyan; samuththiraththaiyum poomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina paraloakaththin theavanaakiya karththar idaththil payapakthiyu'l'lavan en'raan.
avan karththarudaiya samukaththinin'ru vilaki oadippoaki'ravan en'ru thangka'lukku a'riviththathinaal, antha manushar mikavum payanthu, avanai noakki: nee ean ithaich seythaay en'raarka'l.
pinnum samuththiram athikamaayk kontha'liththukko'ndirunthapadiyaal, avarka'l avanai noakki: samuththiram namakku amarumpadi naangka'l unakku enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avan: neengka'l ennai eduththuch samuththiraththilea poattuvidungka'l; appozhuthu samuththiram ungka'lukku amarnthirukkum; ennimiththam inthap periya kontha'lippu ungka'lmeal vanthathenpathai naan a'rivean en'raan.
antha manushar karaisearumpadi veakamaayth tha'nduvaliththaarka'l; aanaalum samuththiram veku mummuramaayk kontha'liththukko'ndeayirunthapadiyaal avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.

appozhuthu avarka'l karththarai noakkik kooppittu: aa karththaavea, intha manushanudaiya jeevanimiththam engka'lai azhiththuppoadaatheayum; kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyai engka'lmeal sumaththaatheayum; theavareer karththar; umakkuch siththamaayirukki'rapadi seyki'reer en'ru solli,
yoanaavai eduththuch samuththiraththilea poattuvittaarka'l; samuththiram than mummuraththaivittu amarnthathu.
appozhuthu antha manushar karththarukku mikavum payanthu, karththarukkup paliyittup poruththanaika'laip pa'n'ninaarka'l.
yoanaavai vizhungkumpadi oru periya meenaik karththar aayaththappaduththiyirunthaar; antha meen vayit'rilea yoanaa iraappakal moon'runaa'l irunthaan.
antha meenin vayit'rilirunthu, yoanaa than theavanaakiya karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni:
en nerukkaththil naan karththarai noakkik kooppittean; avar enakku uththaravu aru'linaar; naan paathaa'laththin vayit'rilirunthu kookkuralittean, neer en saththaththaik keatteer.
samuththiraththin nadumaiyamaakiya aazhaththilea neer ennaith tha'l'livitteer; neeroattam ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; ummudaiya ve'l'langka'lum alaika'lum ellaam enmeal pura'ndathu.
naan umathu ka'nka'lukku ethirea iraathapadikkuth tha'l'lappattean; aakilum innamum ummudaiya parisuththa aalayaththai noakkuvean en'rean.
tha'n'neerka'l piraa'napariyantham ennai nerukkinathu; aazhi ennaich soozhnthathu; kada'rpaasi en thalaiyaich sut'rikko'ndathu.

parvathangka'lin adivaarangka'l pariyanthamum i'rangkinean; poomiyin thaazhppaa'lka'l en'ren'raikkum ennai adaikki'rathaayirunthathu; aanaalum en theavanaakiya karththaavea, neer en piraa'nanai azhivukkuth thappuviththeer.
en aaththumaa ennil thoynthupoakaiyil karththarai ninaiththean; appozhuthu en vi'n'nappam umathu parisuththa aalayaththilea ummidaththil vanthu searnthathu.
poyyaana maayaiyaip pat'rikko'l'luki'ravarka'l thangka'lukku varum kirupaiyaip poakkadikki'raarka'l.
naanoavenil thuthiyin saththaththoadea umakkup paliyiduvean; naan pa'n'nina poruththanaiyaich seluththuvean; iradchippu karththarudaiyathu en'raan.
karththar meenukkuk katta'laiyittaar, athu yoanaavaik karaiyilea kakkivittathu.
ira'ndaantharam karththarudaiya vaarththai yoanaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee ezhunthu makaa nakaramaakiya niniveakkup poay, naan unakkuk ka'rpikkum vaarththaiyai atha'rku viroathamaayp pirasangki en'raar.
yoanaa ezhunthu, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea niniveakkup poanaan; ninivea moon'runaa'l pirayaa'na visthaaramaana makaa periya nakaramaayirunthathu.
yoanaa nakaraththil piraveasiththu, orunaa'l pirayaa'nampa'n'ni: innum naa'rpathunaa'l u'ndu, appozhuthu ninivea kavizhkkappattuppoam en'ru koo'rinaan.
appozhuthu niniveayilu'l'la janangka'l theavanai visuvaasiththu, upavaasagnseyyumpadik koo'rinaarka'l; periyoarmuthal si'riyoarmattum irattuduththikko'ndaarka'l.
inthach seythi niniveayin raajaavukku ettinapoathu, avan than singkaasanaththaivittu ezhunthu, thaan uduththiyiruntha uduppaik kazhat'rippoattu, irattai uduththikko'ndu, saampalilea udkaarnthaan.

mealum raajaa, thaanum than pirathaanika'lum nir'nayampa'n'nina katta'laiyaaka, niniveayilengkum manusharum mirukangka'lum, maaduka'lum aaduka'lum on'rum rusipaaraathirukkavum, meayaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum irukkavum,

manusharum mirukangka'lum irattinaal moodikko'ndu, theavanai noakki uraththa saththamaayk kooppidavum, avaravar thamtham pollaatha vazhiyaiyum thamtham kaika'lilu'l'la kodumaiyaiyum vittuth thirumpavungkadavarka'l.
yaarukkuth theriyum; naam azhinthu poakaathapadikku oruvea'lai theavan manasthaapappattu, thammudaiya ukkira koapaththaivittuth thirumpinaalum thirumpuvaar en'ru koo'rachsonnaan.

avarka'l thangka'l pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumpinaarka'len'ru theavan avarka'ludaiya kiriyaika'laip paarththu, thaam avarka'lukkuch seyvean en'ru solliyiruntha theengkaik ku'riththu manasthaapappattu, athaich seyyaathirunthaar.
yoanaavukku ithu mikavum visanamaayirunthathu; avan kadungkoapangko'ndu,

karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni: aa karththaavea, naan en theasaththil irukkumpoathea naan ithaich sollavillaiyaa? ithinimiththamea naan munnamea tharsheesukku oadippoanean; neer irakkamum mana urukkamum neediya saanthamum mikuntha kirupaiyumu'l'lavarum, theengkukku manasthaapappaduki'ravarumaana theavanen'ru a'rivean.
ippoathum karththaavea, en piraa'nanai ennaivittu eduththukko'l'lum; naan uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum saaki'rathu nalamaayirukkum en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: nee erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathoa en'raar.

pinpu yoanaa nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, nakaraththukkuk kizhakkeapoay, angkea thanakku oru kudisaiyaip poattu, nakaraththukkuch sampavikkappoaki'rathaith thaan paarkkumattum athin keezh nizhalil udkaarnthirunthaan.

yoanaavudaiya thalaiyinmeal nizhalu'ndaayirukkavum, avanai avanudaiya manamadivukku neengkalaakkavum theavanaakiya karththar oru aama'nakkuch sediyai mu'laikkak katta'laiyittu, athai avanmeal oangki va'larappa'n'ninaar; antha aama'nakkinmeal yoanaa mikavum santhoashappattaan.
ma'runaa'liloa kizhakku ve'lukkum nearaththil theavan oru poochchiyaik katta'laiyittaar; athu aama'nakkuch sediyai ariththuppoattathu; athinaal athu kaaynthupoayit'ru.

sooriyan uthiththapoathu theavan ush'namaana keezhkkaat'raik katta'laiyittaar; appozhuthu veyil yoanaavudaiya thalaiyil paduki'rathinaal avan soarnthupoay, thanakku'l'lea saavai virumpi: naan uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum saaki'rathu nalamaayirukkum en'raan.
appozhuthu theavan yoanaavai noakki: nee aama'nakkinimiththam erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathoa en'raar; atha'rku avan: naan mara'napariyanthamum erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathuthaan en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: nee pirayaasappadaathathum, nee va'larkkaathathum, oru iraaththiriyilea mu'laiththathum, oru iraaththiriyilea azhinthupoanathumaana aama'nakkukkaakap parithapikki'raayea.

valathukaikkum idathukaikkum viththiyaasam a'riyaatha iladchaththu irupathinaayirampearukku athikamaana manusharum aneaka mirukajeevanka'lum irukki'ra makaa nakaramaakiya niniveakkaaka naan parithapiyaamaliruppeanoa en'raar.

yoathaam, aakaas, eseakkiyaa ennum yoothaa raajaakka'ludaiya naadka'lil, moreasaa ooraanaakiya meekaavukku u'ndaanathum, avan samaariyaavukkum erusaleamukkum viroathamaayth tharisiththathumaana karththarudaiya vaarththai.

sakala janangka'lea, kea'lungka'l; poomiyea, athilu'l'lavaika'lea, sevikodungka'l; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar, thammudaiya parisuththa aalayaththilirukki'ra aa'ndavarea, ungka'lukku viroathamaakach saadchiyaayiruppaar.
ithoa, karththar thamathu sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappattu varuki'raar; avar i'rangkip poomiyin uyarntha idangka'lai mithippaar.
mezhuku akkinikku munpaaka urukuki'rathupoalavum, malaika'lilirunthu paayun tha'n'neer tharaiyaip pi'lakki'rathupoalavum, parvathangka'l avar keezhea uruki, pa'l'laththaakkuka'l pi'lanthupoakum.

ithu ellaam yaakkoapudaiya mee'ruthalinimiththamum, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya paavangka'linimiththamum sampavikkum; yaakkoapin mee'ruthalukkuk kaara'namenna? samaariyaa allavoa? yoothaavin meadaika'lukkuk kaara'namenna? erusaleam allavoa?

aakaiyaal naan samaariyaavai ve'liyaana ma'nmeadum, thiraadchachsedi naduki'ra nilamumaakki, athin ka'rka'laip pa'l'laththaakkilea pura'ndu vizhappa'n'ni, athin asthipaarangka'laith thi'ranthuvaippean.

athin suroopangka'l ellaam no'rukkappadum; athin pa'naiyangka'l ellaam akkiniyaal eriththuppoadappadum; athin vikkirakangka'lai ellaam paazhaakkuvean; veasippa'naiyaththinaal searkkappattathu, thirumpa veasippa'naiyamaayp poakum.
ithinimiththam naan pulampi ala'ruvean; pa'rikoduththavanaakavum amma'namaakavum nadappean; naan oarika'laippoala oo'laiyittu, aanthaika'laippoala ala'ruvean.
athin kaayam aa'raathathu; athu yoothaamattum vanthathu; en janaththin vaasalaakiya erusaleammattum vanthettinathu.
athaik kaathpatta'naththilea a'riviyaatheayungka'l, azhavea vea'ndaam; pethapraavilea puzhuthiyil pura'lu.
saappeeril kudiyirukki'rava'lea, vedkaththudan amma'namaay appaalea poa; saayanaanil kudiyirukki'rava'l ve'liyea varuvathillai; petheasealin pulampal ungka'lukku adaikkalamaayiraathu.
maaroaththil kudiyirukki'rava'l nanmai varumen'ru ethirpaarththirunthaa'l; aanaalum theemai karththaridaththilirunthu erusaleamin vaasalvaraikkum vanthathu.
laakeesil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, veakamaana kuthiraika'lai irathaththilea poottu; neeyea seeyoan kumaaraththiyin paavaththukkuk kaara'ni; unnidaththil isravealin paathakangka'l kaa'nappattathu.
aakaiyaal moarsheathkaaththinidaththil unakku irukki'rathaik koduththuviduvaay; akseepin veeduka'l isravealin raajaakka'lukku apaththamaayppoakum.
mareashaavil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, unakku innum oru suthantharavaa'liyai varappa'n'nuvean; avan isravealin makimaiyaakiya athullaammattum varuvaan.
unakku arumaiyaana un pi'l'laika'linimiththam nee un thalaiyaich siraiththu mottaiyittukko'l; kazhukaippoala muzhumottaiyaayiru, avarka'l unnaivittuch si'raippattuppoaki'raarka'l.
akkiramaththai yoasiththu, thangka'l padukkaika'linmeal pollaappu seyya eththanampa'n'nith thangka'l kaiyil vallamai irukki'rapadiyinaal, vidiya'rkaalamaaki'rapoathu athai nadappiththu,
vayalka'lai ichchiththup pa'riththukko'ndu, veeduka'lai ichchiththu eduththukko'ndu, purushanaiyum avan veettaiyum, manushanaiyum avan suthantharaththaiyum odukkuki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa!

aakaiyaal karththar: naan intha vamsaththaarukku viroathamaayth theemaiyai varuvikka ninaikki'rean; athinin'ru neengka'l kazhuththai neekkamaatteerka'l; neengka'l meattimaiyaay nadappathillai; athu theemaiyaana kaalam.

annaa'lil ungka'lpearil oppuchsolli, naam mut'rilum paazhaanoam; namathu janaththin suthantharaththai maat'rippoattaar; ennamaay athai ennaivittu neekkippoattaar! namathu vayalka'laip pidungkip pakirnthukoduththaarea en'ru thuyaramaana pulampalaayp pulampuvaarka'l.
karththarin sapaiyil suthanthara veethangka'lai a'lanthukodukki'ravarka'l unakku illaathiruppaarka'l.
theerkkatharisanagn sollaathiruppeerka'laaka enki'raarka'l; avarka'l theerkkatharisanagn solluvaarka'l, inthappirakaaramaay avarka'l theerkkatharisanagn sollaavittaal ninthai neengkaathea.
yaakkoapu vamsam en'ru pearpet'ravarka'lea, karththarin aavi ku'rukiyirukki'rathoa? avarudaiya kiriyaika'l ivaika'lthaanoa? semmaiyaay nadakki'ravanukku en vaarththaika'l nanmai seyyaathoa?

en janangka'l poorvamuthal saththuruvaippoal ezhumpinaarka'l. yuththaththilirunthu thirumpivanthu vazhiyil agnchaamal kadanthupoaki'ravarka'ludaiya mealangkiyaiyum vasthiraththaiyum urinthuko'ndeerka'l.

en janaththin sthireeka'lai avarka'ludaiya saukkiyamaana veeduka'lilirunthu thuraththivitteerka'l; avarka'ludaiya kuzhanthaika'lukku iruntha en alangkaaraththai en'raikkum illaathapadikkup pa'riththukko'ndeerka'l.
ezhunthirunthu poangka'l; ithu neengka'l i'laippaa'rum idam alla, ithu theettuppattathu, ithu ungka'lai naasappaduththum, antha naasam mikavum kodiyathaayirukkum.

manampoaki'ra poakkinpadipoay, apaththamaanathai uraikki'ra oruvan, thiraadcharasaththaiyum mathupaanaththaiyungku'riththu naan unakkup pirasangkippeanen'raal, avanea intha janaththi'rku eat'ra pirasangkiyaayiruppaan.

yaakkoapin janangka'lea, ungka'lellaaraiyum naan nichchayamaayk koottuvean, isravealil meethiyaanavarka'lai nichchayamaaych searppean; poas'raavin aaduka'laippoal avarka'lai eakakkoottamaakkuvean; than thozhuvaththukku'l'lea searntha manthaikkuch samaanamaay janaththira'linaalea iraichchal u'ndaakum.

thadaika'lai neekkippoaduki'ravar avarka'lukku munpaaka nadanthupoaki'raar; avarka'l thadaika'lai neekki, vaasalaal udpiraveasiththuk kadanthupoavaarka'l; avarka'l raajaa avarka'lukku munpaakap poavaar, karththar avarka'l munna'niyil nadanthupoavaar.
naan sonnathu: yaakkoapin thalaivarka'lea, israveal vamsaththu athipathika'lea, niyaayam innathen'ru a'rivathu ungka'lukku allavoa aduththathu.
aanaalum nanmaiyai ve'ruththu, theemaiyai virumpi, avarka'lmeal irukki'ra avarka'ludaiya thoalaiyum avarka'l elumpuka'lmeal irukki'ra avarka'ludaiya sathaiyaiyum pidungki,

en janaththin sathaiyaith thin'ru, avarka'lmeal irukki'ra avarka'ludaiya thoalai urinthuko'ndu, avarka'l elumpuka'lai mu'riththu, paanaiyilea poadumva'n'namaakavum i'raichchiyaik kopparaikku'l'lea poadumva'n'namaakavum avaika'laith thu'ndikki'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avarka'l karththarai noakkik kooppiduvaarka'l; aanaalum avarka'l thangka'l kiriyaika'lil pollaathavarka'laanapadiyinaal, avar avarka'lukku ma'ruuththaravu kodaamal, thamathu mukaththai akkaalaththilea avarka'lukku ma'raiththukko'l'luvaar.

thangka'l pa'rka'linaal kadikki'ravarka'laayirunthu, samaathaanamen'ru solli, thangka'l vaaykku u'navaik kodaathavanukku viroathamaakach sa'ndaikku aayaththampa'n'ni, en janaththai moasampoakkuki'ra theerkkatharisika'lukku viroathamaayk karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:
tharisanangkaa'nakkoodaatha iraaththiriyum, ku'risollakkoodaatha anthakaaramum ungka'lukku varum; theerkkatharisika'linmeal sooriyan asthamiththu, avarka'lmeal pakal kaariru'laayp poakum.
tharisanam paarkki'ravarka'l vedki, ku'risolluki'ravarka'l naa'ni, uththaravukodukki'ra theavan illaathathinaal avarka'l ellaarum thangka'l vaayai mooduvaarka'l.

naanoa, yaakkoapukku avan mee'ruthalaiyum, isravealukku avan paavaththaiyum a'rivikkumpadi, karththarudaiya aavi aru'liya palaththinaalum, niyaayaththinaalum, paraakkiramaththinaalum nirappappattirukki'rean.
niyaayaththai aruvaruththu, semmaiyaanavaika'laiyellaam koa'nalaakki,
seeyoanai iraththappazhiyinaalum, erusaleamai aniyaayaththinaalum kattuvikki'ra yaakkoapu vamsaththuth thalaivarka'lea, israveal vamsaththu athipathika'lea, ithaik kea'lungka'l.

athin thalaivarka'l parithaanaththukku niyaayantheerkki'raarka'l; athin aasaariyarka'l koolikku upatheasikki'raarka'l; athin theerkkatharisika'l pa'naththukkuk ku'risolluki'raarka'l; aakilum avarka'l karththaraich saarnthuko'ndu: karththar engka'l naduvil illaiyoa? theengku engka'lmeal varaathu enki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal ungka'lnimiththam seeyoan vayalve'liyaippoala uzhappattu, erusaleam ma'nmeaduka'laayppoam, aalayaththin parvatham kaattu meaduka'laayppoam.

aanaalum, kadaisi naadka'lil karththarudaiya aalayamaakiya parvatham parvathangka'lin kodumudiyil sthaapikkappattu, malaika'lukku mealaay uyarththappattirukkum, ellaa jaathika'lum athinidaththi'rku oadivaruvaarka'l.

thira'laana jaathika'l pu'rappattuvanthu: naam karththarin parvathaththukkum, yaakkoapin theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum poavoam vaarungka'l; avar thamathu vazhika'lai namakkup poathippaar, naam avar paathaika'lil nadappoam enpaarka'l; eanenil seeyoanilirunthu veathamum, erusaleamilirunthu karththarin vasanamum ve'lippadum.

avar thira'laana janangka'lukku'l niyaayantheerththu, thooraththilu'l'la palaththa jaathika'laik kadinthuko'l'luvaar; appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l pattayangka'lai ma'nvettika'laakavum, thangka'l eettika'lai a'rivaa'lka'laakavum adippaarka'l; oru jaathikku viroathamaay ma'rujaathi pattayam eduppathillai; ini avarka'l yuththaththaik ka'rpathumillai.
avanavan thanthan thiraadchachsediyin nizhalilum, thanthan aththimaraththin nizhalilum payappaduththuvaar illaamal udkaaruvaan; seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vaay ithaich sollit'ru.

sakala janangka'lum thangka'l thangka'l theavanudaiya naamaththaip pat'rikko'ndu nadappaarka'l; naangka'lum engka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththaip pat'rikko'ndu en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum nadappoam.
karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: annaa'lilea naan no'ndiyaanava'laich searththu, tha'l'lu'ndava'laiyum theengku anupaviththava'laiyum koottikko'ndu,

no'ndiyaanava'lai meethiyaana janamaakavum, thooramaayth tha'l'lu'ndupoanava'laip palaththa jaathiyaakavum vaippean; avarka'lpearil karththar seeyoan parvathaththilea ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum raajaavaayiruppaar.
manthaiyin thurukkamea, seeyoan kumaaraththiyin ara'nea, munthina aa'lukai unnidaththil varum; raajarikam erusaleam kumaaraththiyinidaththil varum.
ippoathum nee saththamittuk katha'ruvaanean? raajaavaanavar unnidaththil illaiyoa? un aaloasanaikkaarar azhinthupoanaarka'loa? pirasavikki'ra sthireekku oththa veathanai unakku u'ndaakum.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, pirasava sthireeyaippoala ampaayappattu veathanaippadu; nee ippoathu nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, ve'lika'lil thangki, paapiloanvaraikkum poavaay, angkea viduvikkappaduvaay; angkea karththar unnai un saththurukka'lin kaikku neengkalaakki meedpaar.
seeyoan theettuppaduvaa'laaka, engka'l ka'n ava'laik kaa'npathaaka en'ru solli, aneaka jaathiyaar unakku viroathamaakak koodiyirukki'raarka'l.
aanaalum avarka'l karththarudaiya ninaivuka'lai a'riyaamalum, avarudaiya yoasanaiyai u'naraamalum irukki'raarka'l; avar arikkattuka'laippoala avarka'laik ka'laththilea searppaar.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, nee ezhunthu poaradi; naan un kompuka'lai irumpum, un ku'lampuka'lai ve'nkalamumaakkuvean; nee aneaka janangka'lai no'rukkippoaduvaay; avarka'l theadich searththathai nee karththarukken'rum, avarka'ludaiya aasthiyaip poomikkellaam aa'ndavaraayirukki'ravarukken'rum niyamippaay.
seanaika'laiyudaiya nakaramea, ippoathu tha'ndutha'ndaakak koodikko'l; namakku viroathamaaka mut'rikkai poadappadum; isravealudaiya niyaayaathipathiyaik koalinaal kannaththilea adippaarka'l.

eppiraaththaa ennappatta pethlekeamea, nee yootheayaavilu'l'la aayirangka'lukku'l'lea si'riyathaayirunthum, isravealai aa'lappoaki'ravar unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappattu ennidaththil varuvaar; avarudaiya pu'rappaduthal anaathinaadka'laakiya poorvaththinudaiyathu.
aanaalum pirasavikki'rava'l pirasavikki'ramattum avarka'lai oppukkoduppaar; appozhuthu avarudaiya sakoathararil meethiyaanavarka'l israveal puththiraroadungkoodath thirumpuvaarka'l.

avar nin'ruko'ndu, karththarudaiya palaththoadum thammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarudaiya naamaththin makaththuvaththoadum meayppaar; aakaiyaal avarka'l nilaiththiruppaarka'l; avar inip poomiyin ellaika'lpariyanthamum makimaippaduvaar.

ivarea samaathaana kaara'nar; aseeriyan nammudaiya theasaththilea varumpoathum, nammudaiya ara'nmanaika'lai mithikkumpoathum, eazhu meaypparaiyum manusharil ettu athipathika'laiyum avanukku viroathamaaka ni'ruththuvean.

ivarka'l aseeriyaa theasaththaiyum, nimroathin theasaththaiyum, athinudaiya vaasalka'lukku udpu'ramaakap pattayaththi'rku iraiyaakkuvaarka'l; aseeriyan nammudaiya theasaththil varumpoathum, nammudaiya ellaika'lai mithikkumpoathum avanukku nammaith thappuvippaar.

yaakkoapilea meethiyaanavarka'l karththaraalea varuki'ra paniyaippoalavum, manushanukkuk kaaththiraamalum, manupuththirarukkuth thaamathiyaamalum, poo'nduka'lmeal varuki'ra mazhaika'laippoalavum, aneaka janangka'lin naduvilea iruppaarka'l.

yaakkoapilea meethiyaanavarka'l, singkam kaattumirukangka'lukku'l'lea irukki'ratha'rkuch samaanamaakavum, kadanthupoay mithiththuth thappuvippaar illaamal pee'rippoaduki'ra paalasingkam aattumanthaika'lukku'l'lea irukki'ratha'rkuch samaanamaakavum jaathika'lukku'l aneaka janangka'lin naduvilea iruppaarka'l.
unnudaiya kai un viroathika'linmeal uyarum; un saththurukka'lellaarum sangkarikkappaduvaarka'l.
annaa'lilea naan un kuthiraika'lai un naduvil iraathapadikkuch sangkariththu, un irathangka'lai azhiththu,
un theasaththup patta'nangka'laich sangkariththu, un ara'nka'laiyellaam nirmoolamaakki,
sooniya viththaika'l un kaiyil iraathapadikku akat'ruvean; naa'l paarkki'ravarka'l unnidaththil illaama'rpoavaarka'l.
un suroopangka'laiyum un silaika'laiyum un naduvil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaakkuvean; un kaiyin kiriyaiyai nee inip pa'ninthuko'l'laay.
naan un vikkirakaththoappuka'lai un naduvil iraathapadikkup pidungki, un patta'nangka'lai azhiththu,
sevikodaatha pu'rajaathika'lidaththilea koapaththoadum ukkiraththoadum neethiyaich sarikkattuvean en'raar.
karththar solluki'rathaik kea'lungka'l; nee ezhunthu, parvathangka'lukkumun un vazhakkaich sol; malaika'l un saththaththaik keadkakkadavathu.
parvathangka'lea, poomiyin u'ruthiyaana asthipaarangka'lea, karththarudaiya vazhakkaik kea'lungka'l; karththarukku avar janaththoadea vazhakku irukki'rathu; isravealoadea avar vazhakkaaduvaar.
en janamea, naan unakku enna seythean? naan ethinaal unnai visanappaduththinean? enakku ethirea uththaravu sol.
naan unnai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ni, adimaiththana veettiliruntha unnai meettukko'ndu, moasea aaroan meeriyaam enpavarka'lai unakku munpaaka anuppinean.

en janamea, moavaapin raajaavaakiya paalaak pa'n'nina yoasanai innathen'rum, peayoarin kumaaranaana pileayaam avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaakach sonnathu innathen'rum, siththeem thodangki kilkaalmattum nadanthathu innathen'rum, nee karththarudaiya neethika'lai a'rinthuko'l'lumpadi ninaiththukko'l.

ennaththaikko'ndu naan karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu, unnathamaana theavanukku munpaakap pa'ninthuko'lvean? thakanapalika'laikko'ndum, oru vayathu kan'rukkuttika'laikko'ndum avar sannithiyil varavea'ndumoa?

aayirangka'laana aattukkadaakka'linpearilum, e'n'neyaay oaduki'ra pathinaayirangka'laana aa'ruka'linpearilum, karththar piriyamaayiruppaaroa? en akkiramaththaip poakka en mutha'rpea'raanavanaiyum, en aaththumaavin paavaththaip poakka en karppakkaniyaiyum kodukkavea'ndumoa?

manushanea, nanmai innathen'ru avar unakku a'riviththirukki'raar; niyaayagnseythu, irakkaththaich sineakiththu, un theavanukku munpaaka manaththaazhmaiyaay nadappathai allaamal vea'rea ennaththaik karththar unnidaththil keadki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam nakaraththai noakkik kooppiduki'rathu; gnaanamu'l'lavan ummudaiya naamaththai mathippaan; milaat'ri'rkum athai neamiththavarukkum sevikodungka'l.
thunmaarkkanudaiya veettilea thunmaarkkaththinaal sampaathiththa pokkishangka'lum, aruvarukkappadaththakka ku'raintha marakkaalum innum irukki'rathallavoa?
ka'l'laththaraasum ka'l'lap padikka'rka'lu'l'la paiyum irukkumpoathu, avarka'laich suththamu'l'lavarka'len'ru e'n'nuveanoa?
avarka'lil aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'l kodumaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'raarka'l; avarka'lukku'l vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'l poypeasuki'raarka'l; avarka'l vaayilu'l'la naavu kapadamu'l'lathu.
aakaiyaal naan un paavangka'linimiththam unnai adiththup paazhaakkuki'rathinaal unnaip paladchayamaakkuvean.
nee pusiththum thirupthiyadaiyaathiruppaay; unakku'l'lea soarvu'ndaakum; nee pathanam pa'n'niyum thappuvippathillai; nee thappuvippathaiyum pattayaththukku oppukkoduppean.
nee vithaiththum a'rukkaama'rpoavaay; nee olivappazhangka'laiyum thiraadchappazhangka'laiyum aalaiyaadina poathilum, e'n'ney poosikko'lvathumillai, irasam kudippathumillai.

naan unnaip paazhaakavum un kudika'lai eesalittu ninthikki'ra ninthaiyaakavum vaikkumpadi, umriyinudaiya katta'laika'lum aakaap veettaarudaiya ellaach seykaika'lum kaikko'l'lappattuvaruki'rathu; avarka'ludaiya aaloasanaika'lilea nadakki'reerka'l; aakaiyaal en janaththin ninthaiyaich sumappeerka'l.

aiyoa! ush'nakaalaththuk kanika'laich searththu, thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'ruththapinpu varuki'ravanaippoal irukki'rean; pusikki'ratha'rku oru thiraadchakkulaiyum en aaththumaa ichchiththa muthal a'ruppin kaniyum illai.

theasaththil pakthiyu'l'lavan at'ruppoanaan; manusharil semmaiyaanavan illai; avarka'lellaarum iraththagnsinthap pathivirukki'raarka'l; avanavan thanthan sakoatharanai valaiyilea pidikka veattaiyaaduki'raan.

pollaappuch seyya avarka'l ira'ndu kaika'lum nan'raayk koodum; athipathi kodu enki'raan; niyaayaathipathi kaikkooli keadki'raan; periyavan than thuraasaiyaith therivikki'raan; ivvithamaayp purattuki'raarka'l.

avarka'lil nallavan mudchedikkoththavan, semmaiyaanavan nerignchilaippaarkkilum kadungkoormaiyaanavan; un kaava'rkaarar a'riviththa un tha'ndanaiyin naa'l varuki'rathu; ippozhuthea avarka'lukkuk kalakkam u'ndu.
sineakithanai visuvaasikkavea'ndaam, vazhikaattiyai nampavea'ndaam; un madiyilea paduththukko'l'luki'rava'lukku munpaaka un vaayaith thi'ravaamal echcharikkaiyaayiru.
makan thakappanaik kanaveenappaduththuki'raan; maka'l than thaaykku viroathamaakavum, marumaka'l than maamikku viroathamaakavum ezhumpuki'raarka'l; manushanudaiya saththurukka'l avan veettaarthaanea.
naanoaven'raal karththarai noakkikko'ndu, en iradchippin theavanukkuk kaaththiruppean; en theavan ennaik keattaru'luvaar.
en saththuruvea, enakku viroathamaaych santhoashappadaathea; naan vizhunthaalum ezhunthiruppean; naan iru'lilea udkaarnthaal, karththar enakku ve'lichchamaayiruppaar.

naan karththarukku viroathamaakap paavagnseythean; avar enakkaaka vazhakkaadi en niyaayaththai visaarikkumattum avarudaiya koapaththaich sumappean; avar ennai ve'lichchaththilea ko'nduvaruvaar, avarudaiya neethiyaip paarppean.

un theavanaakiya karththar engkea en'ru ennoadea solluki'ra en saththuruvaanava'l athaip paarkkumpoathu vedkam ava'lai moodum; en ka'nka'l ava'laik kaa'num; ini veethika'lin seat'raippoala mithikkappaduvaa'l.
un mathilka'lai eduppikkum naa'l varuki'rathu; annaa'lilea piramaa'nam vekuthooram paravippoam.

annaa'lilea aseeriyaamuthal ekipthin patta'nangka'lvaraikkum, ekipthumuthal nathivaraikkum, oru samuththiramuthal ma'ru samuththiramvaraikkum, oru parvathamuthal ma'ru parvathamvaraikkumu'l'la janangka'l unnidaththi'rku varuvaarka'l.
aanaalum than kudika'linimiththamum avarka'l kiriyaika'ludaiya palanka'linimiththamum theasam paazhaayirukkum.

karmealin naduvilea thaniththu vanavaasamaayirukki'ra umathu suthantharamaana manthaiyaakiya ummudaiya janaththai umathu koalinaal meayththaru'lum; poorvanaadka'lil meaynthathupoalavea avarka'l paasaanilum keeleayaaththilum meayvaarka'laaka.
nee ekipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattanaa'lil nadanthathupoalavea unnai athisayangka'laik kaa'nappa'n'nuvean.
pu'rajaathika'l ka'ndu thangka'ludaiya ellaap paraakkiramaththaiyungku'riththu vedkappaduvaarka'l; kaiyai vaayinmeal vaiththukko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l kaathuka'l sevidaayp poakum.

paampaippoala ma'n'nai nakkuvaarka'l; poomiyin oorvanavat'raip poalath thangka'l ma'raividangka'lilirunthu nadunadungkip pu'rappaduvaarka'l; namathu theavanaakiya karththaridaththi'rkuth thikiloadea searnthu, unakkup payappaduvaarka'l.

thamathu suthantharaththil meethiyaanavarka'ludaiya akkiramaththaip po'ruththu, mee'ruthalai mannikki'ra theavareerukku oppaana theavan yaar? avar kirupaiseyya virumpuki'rapadiyaal avar en'ren'raikkum koapam vaiyaar.
avar thirumpa nammeal irangkuvaar; nammudaiya akkiramangka'lai adakki, nammudaiya paavangka'laiyellaam samuththiraththin aazhangka'lil poattuviduvaar.
theavareer poorvanaadka'lmuthal engka'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta saththiyaththai yaakkoapukkum, kirupaiyai aapirakaamukkum katta'laiyiduveeraaka.
niniveayin paaram. elkoasaanaakiya naakoomin tharisanap pusthakam.

karththar erichchalu'l'lavarum neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ravarumaana theavan; karththar neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ravar, ukkirakoapamu'l'lavar; karththar thammudaiya saththurukka'lukkup pirathipalan a'likki'ravar, avar thammudaiya pakaignarukkaakak koapaththai vaiththuvaikki'ravar.

karththar neediya saanthamum, mikuntha vallamaiyumu'l'lavar; avarka'lai aakkinaiyillaamal thappuvikkamaattaar; karththarudaiya vazhi suzhalkaat'rilum perungkaat'rilum irukki'rathu; meakangka'l avarudaiya paathaththoo'laayirukki'rathu.
avar samuththiraththai athatti, athai vat'rippoakappa'n'ni, sakala aa'ruka'laiyum va'radchiyaakkuki'raar; paasaanum karmealum soarnthu, leepanoanin sezhippu vaadippoakum.
avar samukaththil parvathangka'l athirnthu malaika'l karainthupoakum; avar pirasannaththinaal poomiyum poochchakkaramum athil kudiyirukki'ra anaivaroadum edupattuppoam.
avarudaiya koapaththukku munpaaka ni'rpavan yaar? avarudaiya ukkirakoapaththilea tharippavan yaar? avarudaiya erichchal akkiniyaippoala i'raikkappaduki'rathu; avaraalea kanmalaika'l pearkkappadum.
karththar nallavar, ikkattunaa'lilea ara'naana koattai; thammai nampuki'ravarka'lai a'rinthirukki'raar.
aanaalum niniveayin sthaanaththai, pura'nduvaruki'ra ve'l'laththinaal sarvasangkaarampa'n'nuvaar; iru'l avar saththurukka'laip pinthodarum.
neengka'l karththarukku viroathamaakach seyya ninaikki'rathenna? avar sarvasangkaarampa'n'nuvaar; idukkam ma'rupadiyum u'ndaakaathu.
avarka'l sannapinnalaayirukki'ra mudchedika'lukku oppaayirukkaiyilum, thangka'l mathupaanaththinaal ve'riko'ndirukkaiyilum, avarka'l muzhuthum kaaynthupoana seththaiyaippoala erinthupoavaarka'l.
karththarukku viroathamaakap pollaatha ninaivuko'ndirukki'ra thuraaloasanaikkaaran oruvan unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappattaan.

karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: avarka'l sampoora'namadainthu aneakaraayirunthaalum a'ruppu'ndupoavaarka'l; avan ozhinthupoavaan; unnai naan si'rumaippaduththinean, ini unnaich si'rumaippaduththaathiruppean.
ippoathum naan unmeal irukki'ra avan nukaththai mu'riththu, un kattuka'lai a'ruppean.

unnaikku'riththuk karththar katta'laikoduththirukki'raar; ini un pearukku viththuvithaikkappaduvathillai; un theavarka'lin koavilil irukki'ra vettappatta vikkirakaththaiyum, vaarkkappatta vikkirakaththaiyum naan nirmoolampa'n'nuvean; nee kanaveenanaanapadiyaal athai unakkup pireathakkuzhiyaakkuvean.

ithoa, samaathaanaththaik koo'ruki'ra suviseashakanudaiya kaalka'l malaika'linmeal varuki'rathu; yoothaavea, un pa'ndikaika'lai aasari; un poruththanaika'laich seluththu; thushdan ini un vazhiyaayk kadanthuvaruvathillai, avan muzhuvathum sangkarikkappattaan.
sitha'radikki'ravan un mukaththukku munpaaka varuki'raan; ara'naik kaaththukko'l, vazhiyaik kaavalpa'n'nu, araiyaik kettiyaayk kattikko'l, un pelanai mikavum sthirappaduththu.

ve'rumaiyaakkuki'ravarka'l avarka'lai ve'rumaiyaakki, avarka'ludaiya thiraadchakkodika'laik keduththuppoattaalum, karththar yaakkoapin makimaiyaith thirumpivarappa'n'nuvathu poal, isravealin makimaiyaiyum thirumpivarappa'n'nuvaar.

avanudaiya paraakkiramasaalika'lin keadakam iraththamayamaakum; avanudaiya yuththaveerar iraththaamparan thariththukko'ndirukki'raarka'l; avan thannai aayaththampa'n'num naa'lilea irathangka'l juvaalikki'ra kadkangka'lai udaiyathaayirukkum; eettika'l kulungkum.
irathangka'l therukka'lil kadakadaven'roadi, veethika'lil idasaari valasaari varum; avaika'l theevattika'laippoala vi'langki, minnalka'laippoala veakamaayp pa'rakkum.
avan than pirapalastharai ninaivukooruvaan; avarka'l thangka'l nadaika'lil ida'ri, alangkaththukku virainthu oaduvaarka'l; ma'raividam aayaththappaduththappadum.
aa'ruka'lin mathakuka'l thi'rakkappadum, aramanai karainthupoam.
avan si'raippattuppoakath theermaanamaayit'ru; ava'ludaiya thaathimaarka'l thangka'l maarpilea adiththukko'ndu, pu'raakka'laippoalach saththamittuk koodappoavaarka'l.
ninivea poorvakaalamuthal tha'n'neerth thadaakampoal irunthathu; ippoathoa avarka'l oadippoaki'raarka'l; nillungka'l nillungka'l en'raalum, thirumpippaarkki'ravan illai.
ve'l'liyaik ko'l'laiyidungka'l, ponnaiyum ko'l'laiyidungka'l; sampaththukku mudivillai; ichchikkappadaththakka sakalavitha poru'lka'lum irukki'rathu.

ava'l ve'rumaiyum ve'liyum paazhumaavaa'l; manam karainthupoaki'rathu; muzhangkaalka'l tha'l'laaduki'rathu; ellaa iduppuka'lilum mikuntha veathanai u'ndu; ellaarudaiya mukangka'lum karukippoaki'rathu.
singkangka'lin vaasasthalam engkea? paalasingkam iraithinki'ra idam engkea? kizhachsingkamaakiya singkamum, singkakkuttika'lum payappaduththuvaarillaamal sagncharikki'ra sthaanam engkea?

singkam than kuttika'lukkuth theavaiyaanathaip pee'ri, than pe'n singkangka'lukku vea'ndiyathaith tho'ndaiyaip pidiththuk kon'ru, iraika'linaal than kepika'laiyum, pee'rippoattavaika'linaal than thaaparangka'laiyum nirappit'ru.

ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu, irathangka'laip pukaiyezhumpa eriththuppoaduvean; pattayam un paalasingkangka'laip padchikkum; nee iraikkaakap pidikkum veattaiyaith theasaththil at'ruppoakappa'n'nuvean; un sthaanaapathika'lin saththam inik keadkappaduvathillai en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
iraththappazhika'lin nakaraththi'rku aiyoa! athu vagnchakaththinaalum kodumaiyinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; ko'l'lai oayaamal nadakki'rathu.
savukkuka'lin oasaiyum, uru'laika'lin athirchchiyum, kuthiraika'lin paaychchalum, irathangka'l kadakadaven'ru oaduki'ra saththamum,

veerar kuthirai ea'ruki'rathum, pattayangka'l thulangkuki'rathum, eettika'l minnuki'rathum, vettu'ndavarka'lin thira'lum, pireathangka'lin earaa'lamum angkea u'ndaayirukkum; pi'nangka'lukkuth thokaiyillai; avarka'l pi'nangka'lil ida'rivizhuki'raarka'l.

than veasiththanangka'linaal jaathika'laiyum, than sooniyangka'linaal vamsangka'laiyum vi'rki'ra makaa sooniyakkaariyum roopavathiyumaayirukki'ra veasiyinudaiya thira'laana veasiththanangka'linimiththam,
ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaka vanthu un vasthiraththu oarangka'lai un mukamattum thookkiyeduththu, jaathika'lukku un nirvaa'naththaiyum, raajyangka'lukku un maanaththaiyum theriyappa'n'ni,
unmeal theettaanavaika'lai e'rinthu, unnaik kanaveenappaduththi, unnai veadikkaiyaakkippoaduvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu unnaik kaa'nki'ravanellaam ninivea paazhaayppoayit'ru, atha'rkaakap pulampuki'ravar yaar? aa'ruthal solluki'ravarka'lai unakku engkea theaduveanen'ru solli, unnaivittoadip poavaan.
nathika'l maththiyiliruntha noa ammoanaippaarkkilum nee sireashdamoa? athaich sut'rilum tha'n'neer irunthathu; samuththiram athin ara'num, samuththirakkaal athin mathilumaayirunthathu.
eththiyoappiyaavum ekipthum e'n'ni'rantha seanaiyaal atha'rkup pelanaaka irunthathu; pooththum loopeemum atha'rkuch sakaayamaayirunthathu.

aayinum ava'l kudivilakkappattuch si'raiyiruppilea ko'ndupoakappattaa'l; ava'l kuzhanthaika'l ellaa veethika'lin mukanaika'lilum moathiyadikkappattaarka'l; ava'ludaiya kanavaanka'lpearil seettup poattaarka'l; ava'ludaiya periyavarka'l ellaarum sangkilika'laal kattappattaarka'l.
neeyum ve'riko'ndu o'liththukko'lvaay; neeyum un saththuruvukkuth thappa ara'naana koattaiyaith theaduvaay.
un ara'nka'lellaam muthal pazhukkum pazhangka'lu'l'la aththimarangka'laippoal irukkum; avaika'l kulukkappattaal avaika'lin pazham thinki'ravan vaayilea vizhum.
ithoa, un naduvil irukki'ra janangka'l peadika'l; un theasaththin vaasalka'l un saththuruvukkumun thi'ravu'ndupoakum; akkini un thaazhppaa'lka'laip padchikkum.
mut'rikaikkuth tha'n'neer mo'ndu vai, un ara'nka'laip palappaduththu; seat'rilea poayk ka'lima'n'nai mithi, soo'laiyaik kettippaduththu.

angkea akkini unnaip padchikkum, pattayam unnaich sangkarikkum; athu pachchaikki'lika'laippoal unnaip padchiththuppoadum; unnaip pachchaikki'lika'laththanaiyaakkikko'l, unnai vettukki'lika'laththanaiyaakkikko'l.
un varththakarai vaanaththu nadchaththirangka'lilum athikamaakkinaay; inthap pachchaikki'lika'l paravip pa'ranthupoakum.

un makudavarththanar vettukki'lika'lukkum, un tha'lakarththar perungki'lika'lukkum samaanamaayirukki'raarka'l; avaika'l ku'lirchchiyaana naa'lil vealika'lil paa'laiyami'rangki, sooriyan uthiththamaaththiraththil pa'ranthupoam; pinpu avaika'l irukkum idam innathen'ru theriyaathu.
aseeriyaa raajaavea, un meaypparka'l u'rangkuvaarka'l; un pirapalasthar paduththiruppaarka'l; un janangka'l parvathangka'linmeal sitha'riyirukki'raarka'l, avaika'laik koottich searppavan illai.
un no'rungkuthalukkup parikaaram illai; un kaayam kodiyathu; un seythiyaik keadpavar yaavarum unpearil kaikottuvaarka'l; un pollaappu ennearamum yaarpearileathaan paayaama'rpoayit'ru?
aapakook ennum theerkkatharisi tharisanamaayk ka'nda paaram.
karththaavea, naan ethuvaraikkum ummai noakkik kooppiduvean, neer kea'laamalirukki'reerea! kodumaiyinimiththam naan ethuvaraikkum ummai noakkik kooppiduvean, neer iradchiyaamalirukki'reerea!
neer enakku akkiramaththaik kaa'npiththu, ennaith theevinaiyaip paarkkappa'n'nuki'rathenna? ko'l'laiyum kodumaiyum enakku ethirea ni'rki'rathu; vazhakkaiyum vaathaiyum ezhuppuki'ravarka'l u'ndu.
aakaiyaal niyaayappiramaa'nam pelanat'rathaaki, niyaayam orupoathum sellaama'rpoaki'rathu; thunmaarkkan neethimaanai va'lainthuko'l'luki'raan; aathalaal niyaayam purattappaduki'rathu.
neengka'l pu'rajaathika'lai noakkippaarththu, aachchariyappattup piramiyungka'l; vivarikkappattaalum neengka'l visuvaasiyaatha oru kiriyaiyai ungka'l naadka'lil nadappippean.
ithoa, naan kaltheayarennum kodithum veakamumaana jaathiyaarai ezhuppuvean; avarka'l thangka'ludaiyathallaatha vaasasthalangka'laik kattikko'l'lath theasaththin visaalangka'lil nadanthuvaruvaarka'l.
avarka'l kediyum payangkaramumaanavarka'l; avarka'ludaiya niyaayamum avarka'ludaiya meanmaiyum avarka'laaleayea u'ndaakum.

avarka'ludaiya kuthiraika'l sivingkika'lilum veakamum, saayangkaalaththil thiriki'ra oanaayka'lilum theeviramumaayirukkum; avarka'ludaiya kuthiraiveerar paravuvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kuthiraiveerar thooraththilirunthu varuvaarka'l; iraikkuth theevirikki'ra kazhukuka'laippoal pa'ranthuvaruvaarka'l.
avarka'lellaarum kodumai seyyavaruvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya mukangka'l suva'rach seyyum keezhkkaat'raippoalirukkum; avarka'l ma'nalaththanai janangka'laich si'raipidiththuch searppaarka'l.

avarka'l raajaakka'lai aakadiyampa'n'nuvaarka'l; athipathika'l avarka'lukkup pariyaasamaayiruppaarka'l; avarka'l ara'nka'laiyellaam paarththu nakaiththu, ma'nmeaduka'laik kuviththu avaika'laip pidippaarka'l.
appozhuthu avanudaiya manammaa'ra, avan than pelan than theavanaalea u'ndaanathen'ru solli mignchippoayk kut'ravaa'liyaavaan.

karththaavea, neer poorvakaalamuthal en theavanum, en parisuththarumaanavar allavaa? naangka'l saavathillai; karththaavea, niyaayaththeerppuch seyya avanai vaiththeer; kanmalaiyea, tha'ndanai seyya avanai niyamiththeer.

theemaiyaip paarkkamaattaatha suththakka'n'nanea, aniyaayaththai noakkikko'ndirukkamaatteerea; pinnai thuroakika'lai neer noakkikko'ndirukki'rathenna? thunmaarkkan thannaip paarkkilum neethimaanai vizhungkumpoathu neer maunamaayirukki'rathenna?
manusharaich samuththiraththu machchangka'lukkum, athikaariyillaatha oorvanavat'ri'rkum samaanamaakkuki'rathenna?
avarka'lellaaraiyum thoo'ndilinaal izhuththukko'l'luki'raan; avarka'laith than valaiyinaal pidiththu, than pa'riyilea searththukko'l'luki'raan; athinaal santhoashappattuk ka'likooruki'raan.
aakaiyaal avaika'linaal than pangku kozhuppu'l'lathum, than poajanam rusikaramu'l'lathumaayit'ru en'ru solli avan than valaikkup paliyittuth than pa'rikkuth thoopangkaattuki'raan.
itha'rkaaka avan than valaiyai izhuththu athilu'l'lavaika'laik kottikko'ndirunthu, irakkamillaamal jaathika'lai eppoathum kon'rupoada vea'ndumoa?
naan en kaavalilea thariththu, ara'nilea nilaiko'ndirunthu, avar enakku enna solluvaaren'rum, avar ennaik ka'ndikkumpoathu naan enna uththaravu solluveanen'rum kavaniththup paarppean en'rean.
appozhuthu karththar enakkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: nee tharisanaththai ezhuthi, athaik kadanthoaduki'ravan vaasikkumpadip palakaika'lilea theerkkamaaka varai.

ku'riththakaalaththukkuth tharisanam innum vaikkappattirukki'rathu; mudivilea athu vi'langkum, athu poy sollaathu; athu thaamathiththaalum atha'rkuk kaaththiru; athu nichchayamaay varum, athu thaamathippathillai.
ithoa, akangkaariyaayirukki'raanea, avanudaiya aaththumaa avanukku'l semmaiyaanathalla; than visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaan pizhaippaan.

avan mathupaanaththinaal akkiramagnseythu akangkaariyaaki, veettilea thariyaamal, avan than aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththaippoala virivaakkith thirupthiyaakaamal, mara'naththukkuch samaanamaaych sakala jaathika'laiyum than vasamaakach searththu, sakala janangka'laiyum thannidamaakak koottikko'ndaalum,

ivarka'lellaarum avanpearil oru pazhamozhiyaiyum, avanukku viroathamaana vasaichsollaiyum vasaniththu, thannudaiyathallaathathaith thanakkaakach searththukko'l'luki'ravanukku aiyoa en'rum, athu enthamattum ni'rkum en'rum, avan thanmeal ka'lima'n sumaiyaiyallavaa sumaththikko'l'luki'raan en'rum solluvaarka'l.
unnaik kadippavarka'l sadithiyaay ezhumpuvathum, unnai alaikkazhippavarka'l vizhippathumillaiyoa? nee avarka'lukkuch soo'raiyaakaayoa?
nee aneakam jaathika'laik ko'l'laiyittapadiyinaal janangka'lil meethiyaana yaavarum nee sinthina manusharaththaththinimiththamum nee seytha kodumaiyinimiththamum unnaik ko'l'laiyiduvaarka'l.
theemaiyin vallamaikkuth thappavea'ndumen'ru than koottai uyaraththilea vaikkumpadikku, than veettukkup pollaatha aathaayaththaith theaduki'ravanukku aiyoa!
aneaka janangka'lai vettippoattathinaal un veettukku vedkamu'ndaaka aaloasanaipa'n'ninaay; un aaththumaavukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythaay.
kallu suvarilirunthu kooppidum, uththiram machchilirunthu saadchiyidum.
iraththappazhika'laalea patta'naththaik katti, aniyaayaththinaalea nakaraththaip palappaduththuki'ravanukku aiyoa!
ithoa, janangka'l akkinikku iraiyaaka uzhaiththu, janangka'l viruthaavaaka i'laiththuppoaki'rathu karththarudaiya seyal allavoa?
samuththiram jalaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathupoal, poomi karththarudaiya makimaiyai a'riki'ra a'rivinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
than thoazharukkuk kudikkakkoduththuth than thuruththiyai avarka'la'ndaiyilea vaiththu, avarka'ludaiya nirvaa'nangka'laip paarkkumpadikku, avarka'lai ve'rikkappa'n'nuki'ravanukku aiyoa!

nee makimaiyinaal alla, ilachchaiyinaal nirappappaduvaay; neeyum kudiththu viruththaseathanamillaathavan en'ru vi'langku; karththarudaiya valathukaiyil irukki'ra paaththiram unnidaththi'rkuth thirumpum; un makimaiyinmeal ilachchaiyaana vaanthipa'n'nuvaay.

leepanoanukkuch seytha kodumai unnai moodum; sinthina manusharaththaththinimiththamum theasaththi'rkum patta'naththi'rkum athin kudika'l ellaarukkum seytha kodumaiyinimiththamum mirukangka'l seyyum paazhkkadippu unnaik kalangkappa'n'num.

siththirakkaaranukku avan seytha suroopamum, oomaiyaana theyvangka'lai u'ndupa'n'nith thaan uruvaakkina suroopaththai nampinavanukku vaarkkappattathum poyppoathakam pa'n'nuki'rathumaana vikkirakamum ennaththukku uthavum?

maraththaippaarththu vizhiyen'rum, oomaiyaana kallaippaarththu ezhumpu en'rum solluki'ravanukku aiyoa! athu poathikkumoa? ithoa, athu ponnum ve'l'liyumaana thakattaal moodappattirukki'rathu; atha'rku'l'lea suvaasam illaiyea?
karththaroaven'raal, thamathu parisuththa aalayaththil irukki'raar; poomiyellaam avarukku munpaaka maunamaayirukkakkadavathu.
aapakook theerkkatharisi sikaayoanil paadina vi'n'nappam.

karththaavea, neer ve'lippaduththinathai naan keattean, enakkup payamu'ndaayit'ru; karththaavea, varushangka'lin naduvilea ummudaiya kiriyaiyai uyirppiyum, varushangka'lin naduvilea athai vi'langkappa'n'num; koapiththaalum irakkaththai ninaiththaru'lum.
theavan theamaanilirunthum, parisuththar paaraan parvathaththilirunthum vanthaar; (sealaa.) avarudaiya makimai vaanangka'lai moodikko'ndathu; avar thuthiyinaal poomi ni'rainthathu.
avarudaiya pirakaasam sooriyanaippoalirunthathu; avarudaiya karaththilirunthu kira'nangka'l veesina; angkea avarudaiya paraakkiramam ma'rainthirunthathu.
avarukku munpaakak ko'l'lainoay sen'rathu; avar adika'lilirunthu eripanthamaana kaaychchal pu'rappattathu.

avar nin'ru poomiyai a'lanthaar; avar paarththup pu'rajaathika'laik karaiyappa'n'ninaar; poorva parvathangka'l sitha'radikkappattathu, en'rumu'l'la malaika'l thaazhnthathu; avarudaiya nadaika'l niththiya nadaika'laayirunthathu.
kooshaanin koodaarangka'l varuththaththil akappattirukkakka'ndean; meethiyaan theasaththin thiraika'l nadungkina.

karththar nathika'linmeal koapamaayirunthaaroa? theavareer ummudaiya kuthiraika'linmealum iradchippu'ndaakkuki'ra ummudaiya irathangka'linmealum ea'rivaruki'rapoathu, umathu koapam nathika'lukkum umathu sinam samuththiraththi'rkum viroathamaayirunthathoa?
koaththirangka'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa vaakkinpadiyea ummudaiya vil naa'neat'rappattathaaka vi'langkinathu; (sealaa.) neer poomiyaip pi'lanthu aa'ruka'lai u'ndaakkineer.
parvathangka'l ummaik ka'ndu nadungkina; jalam piravaakiththuk kadanthupoayit'ru; aazhi irainthathu, athin kaika'lai uyara eduththathu.
santhiranum sooriyanum thanthan ma'ndalaththil nin'rana; umathu ampuka'lin joathiyilum, umathu eettiyinudaiya minnal pirakaasaththilum nadanthana.
neer koapaththoadea poomiyil nadantheer, ukkiraththoadea jaathika'laip poaradiththeer.

umathu janaththin iradchippukkaakavum neer apisheakam pa'n'nuviththavanin iradchippukkaakavumea neer pu'rappatteer; kazhuththa'lavaaka asthipaaraththaith thi'rappaakki, thushdanudaiya veettiliruntha thalaivanai vettineer; sealaa.

ennaich sitha'radippatha'rkup perungkaat'raippoal vanthaarka'l; si'rumaiyaanavanai ma'raividaththilea padchippathu avarka'lukkuch santhoashamaayirunthathu; neer avanudaiya eettika'linaaleayea avanudaiya kiraamaththu athipathika'lai uruvak kuththineer.
thira'laana tha'n'neer kuviyalaakiya samuththiraththukku'l umathu kuthiraika'loadea nadanthupoaneer.

naan keattapozhuthu en kudal kuzhampit'ru; anthach saththaththukku en uthaduka'l thudiththathu; en elumpuka'lil ukkal u'ndaayit'ru; en nilaiyilea nadungkinean; aanaalum engka'loadea ethirkkum janangka'l varumpoathu, ikkattunaa'lilea naan i'laippaa'ruthal adaivean.

aththimaram thu'lirvidaama'rpoanaalum, thiraadchachsedika'lil pazham u'ndaakaama'rpoanaalum, olivamaraththin palan at'ruppoanaalum, vayalka'l thaaniyaththai vi'laiviyaama'rpoanaalum, kidaiyil aattumanthaika'l muthalat'ruppoanaalum, thozhuvaththilea maadu illaama'rpoanaalum,
naan karththarukku'l makizhchchiyaayiruppean, en iradchippin theavanukku'l ka'likooruvean.

aa'ndavaraakiya karththar en pelan; avar en kaalka'lai maankaalka'laippoalaakki, uyaramaana sthalangka'lil ennai nadakkappa'n'nuvaar. ithu nekinoath ennum vaaththiyaththil vaasikka iraakaththalaivanukku oppuvikkappatta sangkeetham.

aamoanin puththiranaakiya yoasiyaa ennum yoothaa raajaavin naadka'lilea, eskiyaavin kumaaranaakiya aamariyaavukkuk kumaaranaana kethaliyaa enpavanudaiya makanaakiya kooshin kumaaran seppaniyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam.
theasaththil u'ndaanathai ellaam mut'rilum vaarikko'l'luvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

manusharaiyum mirukajeevanka'laiyum vaarikko'l'luvean; naan aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum, samuththiraththu machchangka'laiyum, ida'ruki'ratha'rkeathuvaanavaika'laiyum thunmaarkkaroadeakooda vaarikko'ndu, theasaththil u'ndaana manusharaich sangkaarampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
naan yoothaavinmealum, erusaleamilu'l'la ellaak kudika'linmealum en kaiyai neetti, paakaalil meethiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, aasaariyarka'loadeakoodak kemmareem enpavarka'lin pearaiyum,
veeduka'linmeal vaanaseanaiyaip pa'niki'ravarka'laiyum, karththarpearil aa'naiyittu, malkaaminpearilum aa'naiyittup pa'niki'ravarka'laiyum,
karththarai vittup pinvaangkuki'ravarka'laiyum, karththaraith theadaamalum, avaraikku'riththu visaariyaamalumirukki'ravarka'laiyum, ivvidaththil iraathapadikkuch sangkaarampa'n'nuvean.

karththaraakiya aa'ndavarukku munpaaka maunamaayirungka'l; karththarudaiya naa'l sameepiththirukki'rathu; karththar oru yaakaththai aayaththampa'n'ni, atha'rku virunthaa'lika'laiyum azhaiththirukki'raar.
karththarudaiya yaakaththin naa'lilea naan athipathika'laiyum raajakumaararaiyum ma'rutheasaththu vasthiram tharikki'ra yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean.
vaasa'rpadiyaith thaa'ndi, kodumaiyinaalum vagnchakaththinaalum thangka'l ejamaanka'lin veeduka'lai nirappuki'ra yaavaraiyum annaa'lilea tha'ndippean.

annaa'lilea meenvaasalilirunthu kookkuralin saththamum, nakaraththin ira'ndaam paakaththilirunthu ala'ruthalum, meaduka'lilirunthu makaa sangkaaraththin iraichchalum u'ndaakumen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
maktheashin kudika'lea ala'rungka'l; varththakarellaarum sangkaaramaanaarka'l; kaasukkaarar yaavarum vettu'ndupoanaarka'l.

akkaalaththilea naan erusaleamai vi'lakkukko'luththich soathiththu, va'ndalpoalak kuzhampiyirukki'ravarka'lum, karththar nanmaiseyvathum illai theemaiseyvathum illaiyen'ru thangka'l iruthayaththil solluki'ravarka'lumaana manusharaith tha'ndippean.

avarka'ludaiya aasthi ko'l'laiyaakum; avarka'ludaiya veeduka'l paazhaayppoakum; avarka'l veeduka'laik kattiyum, avaika'lil kudiyirukkamaattaarka'l; avarka'l thiraadchaththoattangka'lai naattiyum, avaika'lin pazharasaththaik kudippathillai.

karththarudaiya periyanaa'l sameepiththirukki'rathu; athu kittichsearnthu mikavum theeviriththuvaruki'rathu; karththarudaiya naa'lenki'ra saththaththukkup paraakkiramasaali muthalaay angkea manangkasanthu ala'ruvaan.
antha naa'l ukkiraththin naa'l; athu ikkattum idukkamumaana naa'l; athu azhivum paazhkkadippumaana naa'l; athu iru'lum anthakaaramumaana naa'l; athu mappum manthaaramumaana naa'l.
athu ara'nippaana nakarangka'lukkum, uyaramaana koththa'langka'lukkum viroathamaaka ekkaa'lam oothuki'rathum aarpparikki'rathumaana naa'l.

manushar karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythapadiyaal, avarka'l kurudaraippoal nadakkumpadi naan avarka'lai varuththappaduththuvean; avarka'l iraththam puzhuthiyaippoal soriyappadum; avarka'l maamsam eruvaippoal kidakkum.

karththarudaiya ukkiraththin naa'lilea avarka'l ve'l'liyum avarka'l ponnum avarka'laith thappuvikkamaattaathu; avarudaiya erichchalin akkiniyinaal theasamellaam azhiyum; theasaththin kudika'laiyellaam sadithiyaay nirmoolampa'n'nuvaar.

virumpappadaatha jaathiyea, katta'lai pi'rakkumunnum, patharaippoala naa'l pa'ranthupoakumunnum karththarudaiya ukkirakoapam ungka'lmeal i'rangkumunnum, karththarudaiya koapaththin naa'l ungka'lmeal varumunnum,
neengka'l ungka'lai uyththu aaraaynthu soathiyungka'l.

theasaththilu'l'la ellaach si'rumaiyaanavarka'lea, karththarudaiya niyaayaththai nadappikki'ravarka'lea, avaraith theadungka'l; neethiyaith theadungka'l, manaththaazhmaiyaith theadungka'l; appozhuthu oruvea'lai karththarudaiya koapaththinnaa'lilea ma'raikkappaduveerka'l.
kaathsaa kudiyat'ru, askaloan paazhaakum; asthoaththaip pattappakalilea pa'rakkadippaarka'l; ekroan vearoadea pidungkappadum.

samuththirakkarai kudika'laakiya kireaththiyarukku aiyoa! pelistharin theasamaakiya kaanaanea, karththarudaiya vaarththai unakku viroathamaayirukki'rathu; ini unnil kudiyillaathapadikku unnai azhippean.
samuththirakkarai theasam meayppar thangkum kudilka'lum aattuththoazhangka'lumaakum.

anthath theasam yoothaa vamsaththaaril meethiyaanavarka'lin vasamaakum; avarka'l avvidangka'lil manthai meayppaarka'l; askaloanin veeduka'lilea saayangkaalaththilea paduththukko'lvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar avarka'lai visaariththu, avarka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvaar.
moavaap seytha ninthanaiyaiyum, ammoan puththirar en janaththai ninthiththu, avarka'l ellaiyaik kadanthu perumaipaaraattich sonna thoosha'nangka'laiyum keattean.

aakaiyaal moavaap soathoamaippoalum, ammoan puththirarin theasam komoaraavaippoalumaaki, kaagncho'ri padarum idamum, uppuppa'l'lamum, niththiya paazhumaayirukkum; en janaththil meenthavarka'l avarka'laik ko'l'laiyittu, en jaathiyil meethiyaanavarka'l avarka'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarka'l enpathai en jeevanaikko'ndu solluki'rean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar.
avarka'l seanaika'ludaiya karththarin janaththukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraatti avarka'lai ninthiththapadiyinaal, ithu avarka'l akangkaaraththukkup pathilaaka avarka'lukkuk kidaikkum.

karththar avarka'lmeal kediyaayiruppaar; poomiyilu'l'la theavarka'laiyellaam melinthupoakappa'n'nuvaar; appozhuthu theevuka'lilu'l'la sakala pu'rajaathika'lum avaravar thangka'l thangka'l sthaanaththilirunthu avaraip pa'ninthuko'lvaarka'l.
eththiyoappiyaraakiya neengka'lum en pattayaththinaal kolaiseyyappaduveerka'l.
avar thamathu kaiyai vadatheasaththukku viroathamaay neetti, aseeriyaavai azhiththu, niniveayaip paazhum vanaantharaththukkoththa va'radchiyumaana sthalamaakkuvaar.

athin naduvil manthaika'lum jaathijaathiyaana sakala mirukangka'lum paduththukko'l'lum; athinudaiya sikarangka'linmeal naaraiyum koattaanum iraaththangkum; palaka'nika'lil koovuki'ra saththam pi'rakkum; vaasa'rpadika'lil paazhkkadippu irukkum; keathurumarangka'lin machchaith thi'rappaakkippoaduvaar.

naanthaan, ennaiththavira vea'roruvarum illai en'ru than iruthayaththil solli, nirvisaaramaay vaazhnthu ka'likoornthiruntha nakaram ithuvea; ithu paazhum mirukajeevanka'lin thaaparamumaayppoayvittathea! athin vazhiyaayppoaki'ravan evanum eesal poattuth than kaiyaik kottuvaan.
idukka'n seythu, ooththaiyum azhukkumaayirukki'ra nakaraththukku aiyoa!
athu saththaththukkuch sevikodukkavillai; athu kadinthuko'l'luthalai eat'rukko'l'lavillai; athu karththarai nampavillai; athu than theavanidaththil searavillai.

atha'rku'l'lea irukki'ra athin athipathika'l kerchchikki'ra singkangka'l; athin niyaayaathipathika'l saayangkaalaththil pu'rappaduki'rathum vidiya'rkaalamattum oru elumpaiyum meethiyaaka vaikkaathathumaana oanaayka'l.
athin theerkkatharisika'l vee'nperumaiyum vagnchakamumu'l'lavarka'l; athin aasaariyarka'l parisuththa sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, veathaththukku aniyaayagnseythaarka'l.

atha'rku'l irukki'ra karththar neethiyu'l'lavar; avar aniyaayagnseyvathillai; avar ku'raivillaamal kaalaithoa'rum thammudaiya niyaayaththai vi'langkappa'n'nuki'raar; aniyaayakkaaranoa vedkam a'riyaan.

jaathika'laich sangkariththean; avarka'l thurukangka'l paazhaayina; avarka'ludaiya veethika'lai oruvarum kadanthupoakaathapadikkup paazhaakkinean; avarka'ludaiya patta'nangka'l manushar illaathapadikkum kudiyillaathapadikkum avaantharaiyaayina.

un vaasasthalam nirmoolamaakaathapadikku nee enakkup payanthu, kadinthuko'l'luthalai eat'rukko'l en'rean; naan avarka'lai eppadith tha'ndiththaalum, avarka'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu thangka'l kiriyaika'laiyellaam keadaakkinaarka'l.

aakaiyaal naan ko'l'laiyaada ezhumpum naa'lmattum enakkuk kaaththirungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; en sinamaakiya ukkira koapaththaiyellaam avarka'lmeal soriyumpadi jaathika'laich searkkavum, raajyangka'laik koottavum naan theermaanampa'n'ninean; poomiyellaam en erichchalin akkiniyinaal azhiyum.
appozhuthu janangka'lellaarum karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu, orumanappattu avarukku aaraathanai seyyumpadikku, naan avarka'l paashaiyaich suththamaana paashaiyaaka maa'rappa'n'nuvean.
eththiyoappiyaavin nathika'lukku akkaraiyilirunthu ennidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'ravarka'laakiya sitha'radikkappattavarka'lin kumaaraththiyaanava'l enakkuk kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaruvaa'l.

enakku viroathamaayth thuroakampa'n'ni, nee seytha un ellaak kiriyaika'linimiththamum annaa'lilea vedkappadaathiruppaay; appozhuthu naan un perumaiyaikku'riththuk ka'likoornthavarka'lai un naduvilirunthu vilakkividuvean; nee ini en parisuththa parvathaththil akangkaarangko'l'lamaattaay.
un naduvil si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaana janaththai meethiyaaka vaippean; avarka'l karththarudaiya naamaththinmeal nampikkaiyaayiruppaarka'l.

isravealil meethiyaanavarka'l aniyaayagnseyvathillai; avarka'l poy peasuvathumillai; vagnchakanaavu avarka'l vaayil ka'ndupidikkappaduvathumillai; avarka'l thangka'laip payappaduththuvaarillaamal pusiththup paduththukko'lvaarka'l.
seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, kempeeriththuppaadu; isravealarea, aarppariyungka'l; erusaleam kumaaraththiyea, nee muzhu iruthayaththoadum makizhnthu ka'likooru.
karththar un aakkinaika'lai akat'ri, un saththurukka'lai vilakkinaar; isravealin raajaavaakiya karththar un naduvilea irukki'raar; inith theengkaik kaa'naathiruppaay.
annaa'lilea erusaleamaip paarththu, payappadaathea en'rum, seeyoanaip paarththu, un kaika'laith tha'laravidaathea en'rum sollappadum.

un theavanaakiya karththar un naduvil irukki'raar; avar vallamaiyu'l'lavar, avar iradchippaar; avar unpearil santhoashamaay makizhnthu, thammudaiya anpinimiththam amarnthiruppaar; avar unpearil kempeeramaayk ka'likooruvaar.
un sapaiyin manusharaayirunthu, pa'ndikai aasarippillaamaiyaal u'ndaana ninthaiyinimiththam sagnchalappattavarka'lai naan eakamaayk koottikko'l'luvean.

ithoa, akkaalaththilea unnaich si'rumaippaduththina yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean; no'ndiyaanavanai iradchiththu, tha'l'lu'ndavanaich searththukko'l'luvean; avarka'l vedkam anupaviththa sakala theasangka'lilum avarka'lukkup pukazhchchiyum keerththiyum u'ndaakach seyvean.

akkaalaththilea ungka'laik koottikko'nduvaruvean; akkaalaththilea ungka'laich searththukko'l'luvean; ungka'l ka'nkaa'na naan ungka'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, poomiyilu'l'la sakala janangka'lukku'l'lum naan ungka'laik keerththiyum pukazhchchiyumaaka vaippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

raajaavaakiya thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham aa'raam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai aakaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay seyalththiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanukkum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanukkum u'ndaaki, avar sonnathu ennaven'raal:
intha janangka'l karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattuki'ratha'rku eat'rakaalam innum varavillai enki'raarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
aanaalum aakaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar solluki'raar:
intha veedu paazhaayk kidakkumpoathu, neengka'l machchuppaavappatta ungka'l veeduka'lil kudiyirukkumpadiyaana kaalam ithuvoa?
ippoathum seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar: ungka'l vazhika'laich sinthiththuppaarungka'l.

neengka'l thira'laay vithaiththum kognchamaay a'ruththukko'nduvaruki'reerka'l; neengka'l pusiththum thirupthiyaakavillai; kudiththum paripoora'namadaiyavillai; neengka'l vasthiram uduththiyum oruvanukkum ku'lirvidavillai; kooliyaich sampaathikki'ravan poththalaana paiyilea poaduki'ravanaay athaich sampaathikki'raan.
ungka'l vazhika'laich sinthiththup paarungka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l malaiyinmeal ea'rippoay, marangka'lai vettikko'nduvanthu, aalayaththaik kattungka'l; athinpearil naan piriyamaayiruppean, athinaal en makimai vi'langkum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

athikamaay varumen'ru neengka'l ethirpaarththirunthum, ithoa, kogncham kidaiththathu; neengka'l a'ruththu veettukkuk ko'nduvanthum, naan athai oothippoaduki'rean; ethinimiththamen'raal, en veedu paazhaaykkidakkumpoathu, neengka'l ellaarum avanavan than than veetti'rku oadippoaki'reerka'lea, ithinimiththamea en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
aathalaal ungka'lmeal irukki'ra vaanam paniyaip peyyaamalum, poomi palanaik kodaamalum poayit'ru.

naan nilaththinmealum, malaika'linmealum, thaaniyaththinmealum, puthu thiraadcharasaththinmealum, e'n'neyinmealum, poomiyil vi'laiki'ra ellaavat'rinmealum, manusharinmealum, mirukangka'linmealum, kaippaadu anaiththinmealum va'radchiyai varuviththean en'raar.

appozhuthu seyalththiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapealum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanum, janaththil meethiyaana anaivarum thangka'l theavanaakiya karththarudaiya saththaththukkum, thangka'l theavanaakiya karththar anuppina aakaay ennum theerkkatharisiyinudaiya vaarththaika'lukkum sevikoduththaarka'l, janangka'l karththarukku munpaakap payanthirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothanaakiya aakaay, karththar thoothanuppiya vaarththaiyinpadi janangka'lai noakki: naan ungka'loadea irukki'rean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'raan.

pinpu karththar seyalththiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanudaiya aaviyaiyum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aaviyaiyum, janaththil meethiyaana ellaarudaiya aaviyaiyum ezhuppinaar; avarka'l vanthu, thangka'l theavanaakiya seanaika'ludaiya karththarin aalayaththilea vealaiseythaarka'l.
thariyu raajaavin ira'ndaam varusham aa'raam maatham irupaththunaalaantheathiyilea ithu nadanthathu.
eazhaam maatham irupaththoaraantheathiyilea aakaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay, karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru; avar:

nee seyalththiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanoadum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanoadum, janaththil meethiyaanavarka'loadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

intha aalayaththin munthina makimaiyaik ka'ndavarka'lil ungka'lukku'l'lea meenthirukki'ravarka'l yaar? ippozhuthu ithu ungka'lukku eppadik kaa'nki'rathu? atha'rku ithu ungka'l paarvaiyil on'rumillaathathupoal kaa'nki'rathallavaa?

aanaalum serupaapealea, nee thidanko'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanea, nee thidanko'l; theasaththin ellaa janangka'lea, neengka'l thidanko'l'lungka'l, vealaiyai nadaththungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan ungka'ludanea irukki'rean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l ekipthilirunthu pu'rappaduki'rapoathu naan ungka'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nina vaarththaiyinpadiyea, en aaviyaanavarum ungka'l naduvil nilaiko'ndiruppaar; payappadaatheayungka'l.
seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar: kognchakkaalaththukku'l'lea innum orutharam naan vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum vettaantharaiyaiyum asaiyappa'n'nuvean.
sakala jaathika'laiyum asaiyappa'n'nuvean, sakala jaathika'laalum virumpappattavar varuvaar; intha aalayaththai makimaiyinaal ni'raiyappa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
ve'l'liyum ennudaiyathu, ponnum ennudaiyathu en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

munthina aalayaththin makimaiyaippaarkkilum, inthap pinthina aalayaththin makimai perithaayirukkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; ivvidaththilea samaathaanaththaik katta'laiyiduvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
thariyuvin ira'ndaam varusham onpathaam maatham irupaththunaalaantheathiyilea, aakaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru; avar:
