oruvan than vasthiraththin thongkalilea parisuththa maamsaththaik ko'ndupoakaiyil than vasthiraththin thongkal appaththaiyaakilum, saathaththaiyaakilum, thiraadcharasaththaiyaakilum, e'n'neyaiyaakilum, mat'rentha poajanapathaarththaththaiyaakilum thottaal athu parisuththamaakumoa en'ru nee aasaariyaridaththil veatha niyaayaththaippat'rik kea'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
atha'rku aasaariyarka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: parisuththamaakaathu en'raarka'l.
pi'naththaal theettuppattavan avaika'lil ethaiyaakilum thottaal, athu theettuppadumoa en'ru aakaay pinnum keattaan; atha'rku aasaariyarka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: theettuppadum en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu aakaay: appadiyea intha janangka'lum intha jaathiyaarum en samukaththil irukki'raarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; avarka'ludaiya kaika'lin ellaak kiriyaika'lum appadiyea irukki'rathu; avarka'l angkea ko'nduvanthu padaikki'rathum theettuppattirukki'rathu.
ippoathum karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattumpadi oru kallinmeal oru kal vaikkappattathu muthal nadanthathai ungka'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungka'l.

antha naadka'l muthal oruvan irupathu marakkaalaakak ka'nda ampaaraththinidaththil vanthapoathu, paththu marakkaalmaaththiram irunthathu; oruvan aalaiyin thottiyil aimpathu kudam mo'l'la aalaiyinidaththilea vanthapoathu irupathu kudammaaththiram irunthathu.

karukkaayinaalum vishappaniyinaalum kalmazhaiyinaalum ungka'lai ungka'l kaika'lin vealaiyilellaam adiththean; aanaalum neengka'l ennidaththil manathaith thiruppaamal poaneerka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

ippoathum itha'rku munthinakaalaththil nadanthathai ungka'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungka'l; onpathaam maatham irupaththunaalaantheathiyaakiya innaa'lmuthal karththarudaiya aalayaththin asthipaaram poadappatta annaa'lvaraikkum sen'rakaalaththil nadanthathai ungka'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungka'l.

ka'lagnchiyaththil innum vithaiththaaniyam u'ndoa? thiraadchachsediyum aththimaramum maatha'lagnsediyum olivamaramum kanikodukkavillaiyea; naan in'rumuthal ungka'lai aaseervathippean en'ru solluki'raar en'raan.
irupaththunaalaantheathiyaakiya annaa'lilea karththarudaiya vaarththai ira'ndaam visai aakaay enpavanukku u'ndaaki, avar:
nee yoothaavin thalaivanaakiya serupaapealoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, naan vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum asaiyappa'n'ni,

raajyangka'lin singkaasanaththaik kavizhththu, jaathika'ludaiya raajyangka'lin pelaththai azhiththu, irathaththaiyum athil ea'riyirukki'ravarka'laiyum kavizhththuppoaduvean; kuthiraika'loadea avaika'linmeal ea'riyiruppavarka'lum avaravar thangka'l thangka'l sakoatharanin pattayaththinaalea vizhuvaarka'l.

seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar: seyalththiyealin kumaaranaakiya serupaapeal ennum en oozhiyakkaaranea, unnai naan annaa'lilea searththukko'ndu, unnai muththirai moathiramaaka vaippean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; naan unnaith therinthuko'ndean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham ettaam maathaththilea iththoavin makanaana perakiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vaarththai:
karththar ungka'l pithaakka'linmeal kadungkoapamaayirunthaar.

aakaiyaal nee avarka'lai noakki: seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: ennidaththil thirumpungka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; appozhuthu naan ungka'lidaththukkuth thirumpuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

ungka'l pithaakka'laippoaliraatheayungka'l; munthina theerkkatharisika'l avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l pollaatha vazhika'laiyum ungka'l pollaatha kiriyaika'laiyum vittuth thirumpungka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru kooppittaarka'l; aanaalum enakkuch sevikodaamalum ennaik kavaniyaamalum poanaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
ungka'l pithaakka'l engkea? theerkkatharisika'l en'ren'raikkum uyiroadiruppaarka'loa?

iraama'rpoanaalum, theerkkatharisika'laakiya en oozhiyakkaararukku naan katta'laiyitta en vaarththaika'lum en theermaanangka'lum ungka'l pithaakka'lidaththil palikkavillaiyoa? engka'l vazhika'linpadiyeayum, engka'l kiriyaika'linpadiyeayum seanaika'lin karththar engka'lukkuch seyya nir'nayiththapadiyea engka'lukkuch seythaaren'ru avarka'l thirumpavanthu sonnathillaiyoa en'ru sol en'raar.

thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham, seapaath maathamaakiya pathinoaraam maatham irupaththunaalaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai iththoavin makanaana perakiyaavin kumaaran sakariyaa ennum theerkkatharisikku u'ndaayit'ru; avan sonnathu:

ithoa, in'ru raaththiri sivappuk kuthiraiyinmeal ea'riyiruntha oru purushanaik ka'ndean; avar pa'l'laththaakkil irukki'ra miruthuchsedika'lukku'l'lea nin'raar; avarukkup pinnaalea sivappum mangkina ni'ramum ve'nmaiyumaana kuthiraika'l irunthana.
appozhuthu naan: en aa'ndavarea, ivarka'l yaaren'ru keattean; ennoadea peasuki'ra thoothanaanavar: ivarka'l yaaren'ru naan unakkuk kaa'npippean en'ru sonnaar.
appozhuthu miruthuchsedika'lukku'l'lea nin'ra anthap purushan pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivarka'l poomiyengkum sut'rippaarkkak karththar anuppinavarka'l en'raar.

pinpu avarka'l miruthuchsedika'lukku'l'lea nin'ra karththarudaiya thoothanai noakki: naangka'l poomiyengkum sut'rippaarththoam; ithoa, poomi muzhuvathum amaithalum amarikkaiyumaay irukki'rathu en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan ma'rumozhiyaaka: seanaika'lin karththaavea, intha ezhupathu varushamaay neer koapangko'ndirukki'ra erusaleaminmealum yoothaa patta'nangka'linmealum enthamattum irangkaathiruppeer en'ru solla,
appozhuthu karththar, ennoadea peasina thoothanukku nalvaarththaika'laiyum aa'ruthalaana vaarththaika'laiyum pirathiyuththaramaakach sonnaar.
appozhuthu ennoadea peasina thoothan ennai noakki: seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan erusaleamukkaakavum seeyoanukkaakavum makaa vairaakkiyam ko'ndirukki'rean.
naan kognchang koapangko'ndirunthapoathu avarka'l thangka'l keattai athikarikkath theadinapadiyinaal, sukamaay vaazhuki'ra pu'rajaathika'lpearil naan kadungkoapangko'ndean.

aakaiyaal manaurukkaththoadea erusaleaminidaththil thirumpinean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; en aalayam athilea kattappadum; erusaleaminmeal a'lavunool pidikkappadum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru koo'ru en'raar.

innum en patta'nangka'l nanmaiyinaal parampiyirukkum; innum karththar seeyoanaith theat'raravupa'n'nuvaar; innum erusaleamaith therinthuko'l'luvaar en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'ru pinnum koo'ru en'raar.
naan en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ithoa, naalu kompuka'laik ka'ndean.
avaika'l ennaven'ru ennoadea peasina thoothanaik keattean; atha'rku avar: ivaika'l yoothaavaiyum isravealaiyum erusaleamaiyum sitha'radiththa kompuka'l en'raar.
pinpu karththar enakku naalu thozhilaa'lika'laik kaa'npiththaar.

ivarka'l ennaseyya varuki'raarka'len'ru keattean; atha'rku avar: oruvanum than thalaiyai ea'redukkakkoodaathapadi anthak kompuka'l yoothaavaich sitha'radiththathea, avaika'lukkup payamu'ruththuki'ratha'rkum, yoothaavin theasaththaip paazhaakkath thangka'l kompai eduththa jaathika'ludaiya kompuka'lai vizhaththa'l'luki'ratha'rkum ivarka'l vanthaarka'l en'raar.
naan en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ithoa, than kaiyilea a'lavunool pidiththiruntha oru purushanaik ka'ndean.
neer evvidaththukkup poaki'reer en'ru keattean; atha'rku avar: erusaleamin akalam ivva'lavu en'rum athin nee'lam ivva'lavu en'rum a'riyumpadi athai a'lakki'ratha'rkup poaki'rean en'raar.
ithoa, ennoadea peasina thoothan pu'rappattapoathu, vea'roru thoothan avaraich santhikkumpadip pu'rappattuvanthaan.

ivanai avar noakki: nee oadi intha vaalipanidaththil sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, erusaleam than naduvilea koodum manusharin thira'linaalum mirukajeevanka'lin thira'linaalum mathilillaatha patta'nangka'lpoal vaasasthalamaakum.
naan atha'rkuch sut'rilum akkini mathilaayirunthu, athin naduvil makimaiyaaka iruppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
oakoa, neengka'l ezhumpi vadatheasaththilirunthu oadivaarungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar; aakaayaththu naanku thisaika'lilum ungka'lai naan sitha'rappa'n'ninean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
paapiloan kumaaraththiyinidaththil kudiyirukki'ra seeyoanea, unnai viduviththukko'l.

pi'rpaadu makimaiyu'ndaakum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; ungka'laik ko'l'laiyitta jaathika'lidaththukku ennai anuppinaar; ungka'laith thoduki'ravan avarudaiya ka'nma'niyaith thoduki'raan.
ithoa, naan en kaiyai avarka'lukku viroathamaaka asaippean; athinaal avarka'l thangka'l adimaika'lukkuk ko'l'laiyaavaarka'l; appozhuthu seanaika'lin karththar ennai anuppinaaren'ru a'riveerka'l.
seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, kempeeriththuppaadu; ithoa, naan vanthu un naduvil vaasampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
annaa'lilea aneakam jaathika'l karththaraich searnthu en janamaavaarka'l; naan un naduvil vaasamaayiruppean; appozhuthu seanaika'lin karththar ennai unnidaththil anuppinaaren'ru a'rivaay.
karththar parisuththa theasaththilea yoothaavaakiya thamathu pangkaich suthanthariththu, thirumpavum erusaleamaith therinthuko'lvaar.
maamsamaana sakalamaana pearka'lea, karththarukku munpaaka maunamaayirungka'l; avar thamathu parisuththa vaasasthalaththilirunthu ezhuntharu'linaar en'ru sol en'raar.
avar pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya yoasuvaavai enakkuk kaa'npiththaar; avan karththarudaiya thoothanukku munpaaka nin'raan; saaththaan avanukku viroathagnseyya avan valathupakkaththilea nin'raan.

appozhuthu karththar saaththaanai noakki: karththar unnaik kadinthuko'lvaaraaka; saaththaanea, erusaleamaith therinthuko'nda karththar unnaik kadinthuko'lvaaraaka; ivan akkiniyinin'ru thappuvikkappatta ko'l'li allavaa en'raar.
yoasuvaavoavenil azhukku vasthiram thariththavanaayth thoothanukku munpaaka nin'rirunthaan.

avar thamakku munpaaka ni'rki'ravarka'lai noakki: ivanmeal irukki'ra azhukku vasthirangka'laik ka'lainthupoadungka'l en'raar; pinpu avanai noakki: paar, naan un akkiramaththai unnilirunthu neengkachseythu, unakkuch si'rantha vasthirangka'laith tharippiththean en'raar.

avan sirasinmeal suththamaana paakaiyai vaippaarka'laaka en'raar; appozhuthu suththamaana paakaiyai avan sirasinmeal vaiththu, avanukku vasthirangka'laith tharippiththaarka'l; karththarudaiya thoothan angkea nin'raar.
karththarudaiya thoothan yoasuvaavukkuch saadchiyaaka:

seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: nee en vazhika'lil nadanthu en kaavalaik kaaththaal, nee en aalayaththil niyaayam visaarippaay; en piraakaarangka'laiyum kaavalkaappaay; ingkea ni'rki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea ulaavuki'ratha'rku idam naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduvean.

ippoathum, pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya yoasuvaavea, nee kea'l; unakku munpaaka udkaarnthirukki'ra un thoazharum keadkakkadavarka'l; ivarka'l adaiyaa'lamaayirukki'ra purushar; ithoa, ki'lai ennappattavaraakiya en thaasanai naan varappa'n'nuvean.

ithoa, naan yoasuvaavukku munpaaka vaiththa kal; intha orea kallinmeal eazhu ka'nka'lum vaikkappattirukki'rathu; ithoa, naan athin siththiravealaiyai ni'raiveat'ri, inthath theasaththil akkiramaththai oreanaa'lilea neekkippoaduvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
annaa'lilea neengka'l oruvaraiyoruvar thiraadchachsediyinkeezhum aththimaraththinkeezhum varavazhaippeerka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
ennoadea peasina thoothan thirumpivanthu niththiraipa'n'nuki'ra oruvanai ezhuppuvathupoal ennai ezhuppi:

nee kaa'nki'rathu ennaven'ru keattaar; atha'rku naan: ithoa, muzhuvathum ponninaal seyyappatta kuththuvi'lakkaik kaa'nki'rean; athin uchchiyil athin ki'n'namum, athinmeal athin eazhu akalka'lum, athin uchchiyil irukki'ra akalka'lukkuppoaki'ra eazhu kuzhaayka'lum irukki'rathu.
athin arukil ki'n'naththi'rku valathupu'ramaaka on'rum, atha'rku idathupu'ramaaka on'rum, aaka ira'ndu olivamarangka'l irukki'rathu en'rean.
naan ennoadea peasina thoothanai noakki: aa'ndavanea, ivaika'l ennaven'ru keattean.
ennoadea peasina thoothan ma'rumozhiyaaka: ivaika'l innathen'ru unakkuth theriyaathaa en'raar; aa'ndavanea, enakkuth theriyaathu en'rean.

appozhuthu avar: serupaapealukkuch sollappaduki'ra karththarudaiya vaarththai ennaven'raal, palaththinaalum alla, paraakkiramaththinaalum alla, ennudaiya aaviyinaaleayea aakum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

periya parvathamea, nee emmaaththiram? serupaapealukku munpaaka nee samapoomiyaavaay; thalaikkallai avan ko'nduvaruvaan; atha'rkuk kirupaiyu'ndaavathaaka, kirupaiyu'ndaavathaaka en'ru aarpparippaarka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
serupaapealin kaika'l intha aalayaththukku asthipaaram poattathu; avan kaika'lea ithai mudiththuth theerkkum; athinaal seanaika'lin karththar ennai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppinaaren'ru a'rivaay.

a'rpamaana aarampaththin naa'lai yaar asattaipa'n'nalaam? poomiyengkum sut'rippaarkki'ravaika'laakiya karththarudaiya eazhu ka'nka'lum serupaapealin kaiyil irukki'ra thookkunoolaich santhoashamaayp paarkki'rathu en'raar.
pinpu naan avarai noakki: kuththuvi'lakkukku valathupu'ramaakavum atha'rku idathupu'ramaakavum irukki'ra intha ira'ndu olivamarangka'l ennaven'ru keattean.

ma'rupadiyum naan avarai noakki: ira'ndu po'rkuzhaayka'lin vazhiyaayth thongki, ponni'ramaana e'n'neyaith thangka'lilirunthu i'rangkappa'n'nuki'ravaika'laakiya olivamarangka'lin ira'ndu ki'laika'l ennaven'ru keattean.
atha'rku avar: ivaika'l innathen'ru unakkuth theriyaathaa en'raar; aa'ndavanea, enakkuth theriyaathu en'rean.
appozhuthu avar: ivaika'l ira'ndum sarvaloakaththukkum aa'ndavaraayirukki'ravarin samukaththil ni'rki'ra apisheakam pet'ravarka'l en'raar.
naan thirumpavum en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkaiyil, ithoa, pa'rakki'ra oru pusthakachsuru'laik ka'ndean.
thoothan: nee kaa'nki'rathu ennaven'ru keattaar; pa'rakki'ra oru pusthakachsuru'laik kaa'nki'rean, athin nee'lam irupathu muzhamum athin akalam paththu muzhamumaayirukki'rathu en'rean.

appozhuthu avar: ithu poomiyinmeethengkum pu'rappattuppoaki'ra saapam; enthath thirudanum athin oru pu'raththilirukki'rathinpadiyea azhikkappattuppoavaan; aa'naiyiduki'ra evanum, athin ma'rupu'raththil irukki'rathinpadiyea azhikkappattuppoavaan.

athu thirudan veettilum, en naamaththaikko'ndu poyyaa'naiyiduki'ravan veettilum vanthu, avanavan veettin naduvilea thangki, athai athin marangka'loadum athin kalluka'loadungkooda nirmoolamaakkumpadi athaip pu'rappattuppoakappa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raar.
pinpu ennoadea peasina thoothan ve'liyea vanthu ennai noakki: nee un ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, pu'rappattuvaruki'rathai ennaven'ru paar en'raar.
athu ennaven'ru keattean; atha'rku avar: athu pu'rappattuvaruki'rathaakiya oru marakkaal en'raar. pinnum avar: poomiyengkum ithuthaan avarka'ludaiya ka'n'noakkam en'raar.
ithoa, oru thaalanthu ni'raiyaana eeyamoodi thookkivarappattathu; marakkaalin naduvilea oru sthiree udkaarnthirunthaa'l.
appozhuthu avar: iva'l akkiramakkaari en'ru solli, ava'lai marakkaalukku'l'lea tha'l'li eeyakkattiyai athin vaayilea poattaar.

appozhuthu naan en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, ithoa, pu'rappattuvaruki'ra ira'ndu sthireeka'laik ka'ndean; avarka'lukku naaraiyin settaika'lukkoththa settaika'l irunthathu; avarka'l settaika'lil kaat'rirunthathu; ivarka'l marakkaalaip poomikkum vaanaththukkum naduvaayth thookkikko'ndu poanaarka'l.
naan ennoadea peasina thoothanai noakki: ivarka'l marakkaalai engkea ko'ndupoaki'raarka'l en'ru keattean.
atha'rku avar: sineyaar theasaththilea atha'rku oru veettaik kattumpadikku athaik ko'ndupoaki'raarka'l; angkea athu sthaapikkappattu, than nilaiyilea vaikkappadum en'raar.

naan thirumpavum en ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, ithoa, ira'ndu parvathangka'lin naduvaakap pu'rappattuvaruki'ra naalu irathangka'laik ka'ndean; anthap parvathangka'l ve'nkalap parvathangka'laayirunthana.
muthalaam irathaththil sivappuk kuthiraika'lum, ira'ndaam irathaththil ka'ruppuk kuthiraika'lum,
moon'raam irathaththil ve'l'laik kuthiraika'lum, naankaam irathaththil pu'l'lipu'l'liyaana sivappuk kuthiraika'lum poottiyirunthana.
naan ennoadea peasina thoothanai noakki: aa'ndavanea, ivaika'l ennaven'ru keattean.
anthath thoothan enakkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivaika'l sarvaloakaththukkum aa'ndavaraayirukki'ravarudaiya samukaththil nin'ru pu'rappaduki'ra vaanaththinudaiya naalu aavika'l en'raar.

on'ril poottappattiruntha ka'ruppukkuthiraika'l vadatheasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoayina; ve'nmaiyaana kuthiraika'l avaika'lin pinnaalea pu'rappattuppoayina; pu'l'lipu'l'liyaana kuthiraika'l thentheasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoayina.

sivappuk kuthiraika'loaven'raal pu'rappattuppoay, poomiyilea sut'riththiriyumpadi keattukko'ndana; atha'rku avar: poayp poomiyil sut'riththiriyungka'l en'raar; appadiyea poomiyilea sut'riththirinthana.
pinpu avar ennaik kooppittu: paar, vadatheasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoanavaika'l, vadatheasaththilea en koapaththaich saanthipa'n'nit'ru en'ru ennoadea sonnaar.
pinpu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:
si'raiyiruppin manusharaakiya elthaayum, thopiyaavum, yethaayaavum paapiloanilirunthu vanthirukkum annaa'lilea nee poay, seppaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoasiyaavin veettukku'l piraveasiththu,
angkea avarka'l kaiyilea ve'l'liyaiyum ponnaiyum vaangki, kireedangka'laich seyviththu, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaakiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya sirasilea vaiththu,

avanoadea sollavea'ndiyathu: seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, oru purushan, avarudaiya naamam ki'lai ennappadum; avar thammudaiya sthaanaththilirunthu mu'laiththezhumpik karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattuvaar.

avarea karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattuvaar; avar makimaiporunthinavaraay, thammudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirunthu aa'lukai seyvaar; thammudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal aasaariyaraayum iruppaar; ivvira'ndin naduvaakach samaathaanaththin aaloasanai vi'langkum.
inthak kireedangka'loaven'raal, karththarudaiya aalayaththilea, ealeamukkum, thopiyaavukkum, yethaayaavukkum, seppaniyaavin kumaaranaakiya eanukkum ninaippoottuthalukken'ru vaikkappaduvathaaka.

thooraththilu'l'lavarka'l vanthu karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kooda irunthu kattuvaarka'l; appozhuthu seanaika'lin karththar ennai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppinaaren'ru a'rinthuko'lveerka'l; neengka'l ungka'l theavanaakiya karththarin saththaththaik keattu nadantheerka'laanaal ithu ni'raivea'rum en'ru sol en'raar.
thariyu raajaa arasaa'nda naalaam varusham, kislea ennum onpathaam maatham, naalaantheathiyilea, sakariyaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru.
karththarudaiya samukaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'navum,

naangka'l iththanai varushamvaraiyilea seythathupoala ainthaam maathaththilea azhuthu odukkaththilirukkavea'ndumoa en'ru seanaika'ludaiya karththarin aalayaththilirukkum aasaariyaridaththilum theerkkatharisika'lidaththilum keadkavum, sareathsearum rekemmeleakum avanudaiya manusharum theavanudaiya aalayaththukku anuppappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

nee theasaththin ellaa janaththoadum aasaariyarka'loadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l intha ezhupathu varushamaaka ainthaam maathaththilum eazhaam maathaththilum upavaasampa'n'ni thukkangko'ndaadinapoathu neengka'l enakken'ruthaanaa upavaasampa'n'nineerka'l?
neengka'l pusikki'rapoathum kudikki'rapoathum ungka'lukken'rallavaa pusikki'reerka'l? ungka'lukken'rallavaa kudikki'reerka'l?

erusaleamum athaich sut'rilum iruntha patta'nangka'lum kudini'rainthu sukamaayiruntha kaalaththilum the'rku naadum samapoomiyum kudiyea'riyiruntha kaalaththilum munniruntha theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu karththar koo'rina vaarththaika'l ivaika'l allavoa en'ru sol en'raar.
pinpu karththarudaiya vaarththai sakariyaavukku u'ndaaki, avar:
seanaika'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengka'l u'nmaiyaay niyaayantheerththu, avanavan thanthan sakoatharanukkuth thayavum irakkamum seythu,

vithavaiyaiyum thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum paratheasiyaiyum si'rumaiyaanavanaiyum odukkaamalum, ungka'lil oruvanum than sakoatharanukku viroathamaayth than iruthayaththil theengku ninaiyaamalum irungka'l en'raar.
avarka'loa kavanikka manathillaamal, thangka'l thoa'lai murattuththanamaay vilakki, kea'laathapadikkuth thangka'l sevika'lai adaiththukko'ndaarka'l.

veathaththaiyum seanaika'lin karththar thammudaiya aaviyin moolamaay munthina theerkkatharisika'laikko'ndu solliyanuppina vaarththaika'laiyum kea'laathapadikkuth thangka'l iruthayaththai vairamaakkinaarka'l; aakaiyaal makaa kadungkoapam seanaika'lin karththaridaththilirunthu u'ndaayit'ru.
aathalaal naan kooppittapoathu, avarka'l eppadik kea'laama'rpoanaarka'loa, appadiyea avarka'l kooppittapoathu naanum kea'laamalirunthean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avarka'l a'riyaatha pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea avarka'laip pa'rakkadiththean; athinaal avarka'l pinvaiththuppoana theasam poakkuvaraththillaamal paazhaayppoayit'ru; avarka'l inpamaana theasaththaip paazhaayppoakap pa'n'ninaarka'l en'raar.
seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vaarththai u'ndaaki, avar:
naan seeyoanukkaaka kadum vairaakkiyangko'ndean; atha'rkaaka makaa ukkiramaana vairaakkiyangko'ndean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

naan seeyoanidaththil thirumpi, erusaleamin naduvilea vaasampa'n'nuvean; erusaleam saththiya nakaram en'rum, seanaika'ludaiya karththarin parvatham parisuththa parvatham en'rum azhaikkappadum en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
thirumpavum erusaleamin veethika'lil muthirvayathinaalea thangka'l kaika'lil koalaippidiththu nadakki'ra kizhavarum kizhavika'lum kudiyiruppaarka'l.
nakaraththin therukka'lilea vi'laiyaaduki'ra aa'npi'l'laika'lum pe'npi'l'laika'lum athin veethika'lil ni'rainthirukkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: athu intha janaththil meethiyaanavarka'lin paarvaikku innaadka'lil aachchariyamaayirunthaalum, en paarvaikkum aachchariyamaayirukkumoa en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, kizhakkutheasaththilum mea'rku theasaththilumirunthu en janangka'lai naan iradchiththu,

avarka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvaruvean; avarka'l erusaleamin naduvilea kudiyiruppaarka'l; avarka'l enakku u'nmaiyum neethiyumaana janamaayiruppaarka'l, naan avarka'lukkuth theavanaayiruppean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

seanaika'ludaiya karththarin veedaakiya aalayam kattappadumpadikku athin asthipaarangka'l poadappatta naa'lmutha'r ko'ndirukki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin vaayinaal intha vaarththaika'lai innaadka'lil keattuvaruki'ravarka'lea, ungka'l kaika'l thidappadakkadavathu en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

innaadka'lukku munnea manushanudaiya vealaiyaal palanumillai, mirukajeevanudaiya vealaiyaal palanumillai; poaki'ravanukkum varuki'ravanukkum nerukkidaiyinimiththam samaathaanamumillai; ellaa manusharaiyum oruvaraiyoruvar viroathikkachseythean.
ippoathoa intha janaththil meethiyaanavarka'lukku naan munthinanaadka'lil irunthathupoala irukkamaattean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

vithaippuch samaathaanamu'l'lathaayirukkum; thiraadchachsedi than kaniyaith tharum; poomi than palanaith tharum; vaanam than paniyaith tharum; intha janaththil meethiyaanavarka'l ithaiyellaam suthantharikkak katta'laiyiduvean.

sampavippathennaven'raal: yoothaa vamsaththaarea, israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea saapamaayirunthathupoalavea, aaseervaathamaayirukkumpadi naan ungka'lai iradchippean; payappadaatheayungka'l, ungka'l kaika'l thidappadakkadavathu.
seanaika'lin karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal: ungka'l pithaakka'l enakkuk koapamoottinapoathu naan ungka'laith tha'ndikka ninaiththu, manam maa'raamal irunthathupoala,
innaadka'lil erusaleamukkum yoothaavukkum nanmaiseyyumpadith thirumpa ninaiththean; payappadaatheayungka'l.
neengka'l seyyavea'ndiya kaariyangka'l ennaven'raal: avanavan pi'ranoadea u'nmaiyaip peasungka'l; ungka'l vaasalka'lil saththiyaththukkum samaathaanaththukkum ea'rka niyaayantheerungka'l.

oruvanum pi'ranukku viroathamaayth than iruthayaththil theengku ninaiyaamalum, poyyaa'naiyinmeal piriyappadaamalum irungka'l; ivaika'lellaam naan ve'rukki'ra kaariyangka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
seanaika'ludaiya karththarin vaarththai enakku u'ndaaki, avar:

naalaam maathaththin upavaasamum, ainthaam maathaththin upavaasamum, eazhaam maathaththin upavaasamum, paththaam maathaththin upavaasamum, yoothaa vamsaththaarukku makizhchchiyaakavum santhoashamaakavum nalla pa'ndikaika'laakavum maa'rippoakum; aakaiyaal saththiyaththaiyum samaathaanaththaiyum sineakiyungka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
innum janangka'lum aneakam patta'nangka'lin kudika'lum varuvaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

oru patta'naththin kudika'l ma'rupatta'naththin kudika'lidaththil poay, naam karththarudaiya samukaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'navum seanaika'lin karththaraith theadavum theeviriththuppoavoam vaarungka'l; naangka'lum poavoam en'ru solluvaarka'l.
aneaka janangka'lum palaththa jaathika'lum erusaleamilea seanaika'lin karththaraith theadavum, karththarudaiya samukaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'navum varuvaarka'l.

annaadka'lil palavitha paashaikkaararaakiya pu'rajaathiyaaril paththu manushar oru yoothanudaiya vasthiraththongkalaip pidiththukko'ndu: theavan ungka'loadea irukki'raar en'ru kea'lvippattoam; aakaiyaal ungka'loadeakoodap poavoam en'ru solli, avanaip pat'rikko'lvaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar en'raar.

aathiraak theasaththukku viroathamaanathum, thamaskuvinmeal vanthu thangkuvathumaana karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaakiya paaram; manusharin ka'nka'lum isravealudaiya sakala koaththirangka'lin ka'nka'lum karththarai noakkikko'ndirukkum.
aamaaththum, mikavum gnaanamu'l'la theeruvum seethoanum athin ellaikku'l'laayirukkum.
theeru thanakku ara'naikkatti, thoo'laippoal ve'l'liyaiyum, veethika'lin seat'raippoal pasumponnaiyum searththuvaiththathu.
ithoa, aa'ndavar athaith tha'l'livittu, samuththiraththil athin palaththai mu'riththuppoaduvaar; athu akkinikku iraiyaakum.

askaloan athaik ka'ndu payappadum, kaathsaavum athaikka'ndu mikavum thukkikkum, ekroanum than nampikkai at'ruppoanapadiyaal mikavum piralaapikkum; kaathsaavil raajaa azhinthupoavaan; askaloan kudiyat'rirukkum.
asthoaththil veasippi'l'laika'l vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l; naan pelistharin karvaththai azhippean.

avanudaiya iraththaththai avan vaayilirunthum, avanudaiya aruvaruppuka'lai avan palluka'lin naduvilirunthum neekkippoaduvean; avanoa nammudaiya theavanukken'ru meethiyaaka vaikkappattu, yoothaavilea pirapuvaippoala iruppaan; ekroan epoosiyanaippoala iruppaan.

seanaiyaanathu pu'rappadumpoathum, thirumpi varumpoathum, en aalayam kaakkappadumpadi athaich sut'rilum paa'layampoaduvean; ini odukkuki'ravan avarka'lidaththil kadanthuvaruvathillai; athai en ka'nka'linaalea paarththukko'ndirukki'rean.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, mikavum ka'likooru; erusaleam kumaaraththiyea, kempeeri; ithoa, un raajaa unnidaththil varuki'raar; avar neethiyu'l'lavarum iradchikki'ravarum thaazhmaiyu'l'lavarum, kazhuthaiyinmealum kazhuthaikkuttiyaakiya ma'riyinmealum ea'rivaruki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.

eppiraayeeminin'ru irathangka'laiyum erusaleaminin'ru kuthiraika'laiyum at'ruppoakappa'n'nuvean, yuththavillum illaama'rpoakum; avar jaathika'lukkuch samaathaanam koo'ruvaar; avarudaiya aa'lukai oru samuththiranthodangki ma'rusamuththiramvaraikkum, nathithodangkip poomiyin ellaika'lpariyanthamum sellum.
unakku naan seyvathennaven'raal, tha'n'neerillaatha kuzhiyilea adaipattirukki'ra unnudaiyavarka'lai naan un udanpadikkaiyin iraththaththinaalea viduthalaipa'n'nuvean.
nampikkaiyudaiya si'raika'lea, ara'nukkuth thirumpungka'l; irattippaana nanmaiyaith tharuvean, in'raikkea tharuvean.

naan enakken'ru yoothaavai naa'neat'ri, eppiraayeemilea villai nirappi, seeyoanea, un puththiraraik kireakkutheasap puththirarukku viroathamaaka ezhuppi, unnaip paraakkiramasaaliyin pattayaththukku oppaakkuvean.
avarka'l padchaththil karththar kaa'nappaduvaar; avarudaiya ampu minnalaippoalap pu'rappadum; karththaraakiya aa'ndavar ekkaa'lam oothi, thenthisaich suzhalkaat'ruka'loadea nadanthuvaruvaar.

seanaika'lin karththar avarka'laik kaappaat'ruvaar; avarka'l padchiththu, kava'nka'rka'laal keezhppaduththikko'lvaarka'l; avarka'l kudiththuk ka'lippinaal aaravaarippaarka'l; paanapaaththirangka'lpoalavum palipeedaththin koadika'laippoalavum ni'rainthiruppaarka'l.

annaa'lil avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar thammudaiya janamaana manthaiyaakiya avarka'lai iradchippaar; avarka'l avarudaiya theasaththil eat'rappatta kodika'lin kireedaththil pathinthiruppaarka'l.
avarudaiya kaaru'nyam eththanai periyathu? avarudaiya saunthariyam eththanai periyathu? thaaniyam vaaliparaiyum, puthu thiraadcharasam kannikaika'laiyum va'larkkum.

pinmaarikaalaththu mazhaiyaik karththaridaththil vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; appozhuthu karththar minnalka'lai u'ndaakki, vayalve'liyil avaravarukkup payiru'ndaaka avarka'lukku mazhaiyaik katta'laiyiduvaar.

suroopangka'l apaththamaanathaich sollit'ru; ku'risolluki'ravarka'l poyyaith thariththaarka'l; soppanakkaarar vee'naanathaich solli, viyarththamaakath theat'raravupa'n'ninaarka'l; aakaiyaal janangka'l aaduka'laippoalach sitha'ri, meayppanillaathathinaal si'rumaippattaarka'l.

meaypparukku viroathamaaka en koapam moo'ndathu, kadaakka'laith tha'ndiththean; seanaika'lin karththar yoothaa vamsaththaaraakiya thamathu manthaiyai visaariththu, avarka'lai yuththaththilea thamathu si'rantha kuthiraiyaaka ni'ruththuvaar.
avarka'lilirunthu koadikkallum, avarka'lilirunthu koodaaramu'laiyum, avarka'lilirunthu yuththavillum varum; avarka'lilirunthu aa'luki'ra yaavarum eakamaayp pu'rappaduvaarka'l.

avarka'l yuththaththilea thangka'l saththurukka'lai veethika'lin seat'ril mithikki'ra paraakkiramasaalika'laippoala irunthu yuththampa'n'nuvaarka'l; karththar avarka'loadeakooda iruppaar; kuthiraika'linmeal ea'rivaruki'ravarka'l vedkappaduvaarka'l.

naan yoothaa vamsaththaaraip palappaduththi, yoaseappu vamsaththaarai iradchiththu, avarka'laith thirumpa nilaikkappa'n'nuvean; naan avarka'lukku irangkinean; avarka'l ennaal orukkaalum tha'l'lividappadaathavarka'laippoal iruppaarka'l; naan avarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya karththar, naan avarka'lukkuch sevikoduppean.

eppiraayeemar paraakkiramaraippoala iruppaarka'l; mathupaanaththaal ka'lippathupoala, avarka'ludaiya iruthayam ka'likkum; avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lum athaik ka'ndu makizhuvaarka'l; avarka'l iruthayam karththarukku'l ka'likoorum.
naan avarka'laip paarththup payilpoattu avarka'laik koottikko'l'luvean; avarka'lai meettukko'ndean; avarka'l perukiyirunthathupoalavea perukippoavaarka'l.
naan avarka'lai janangka'lukku'l'lea i'raiththapinpu, avarka'l thooratheasangka'lilea ennai ninaiththu thangka'l pi'l'laika'loadungkoodap pizhaiththuth thirumpuvaarka'l.

naan avarka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu thirumpivarappa'n'ni, avarka'lai aseeriyaavilirunthu koottikko'ndu, avarka'laik keeleayaath theasaththukkum leepanoanukkum varappa'n'nuvean; avarka'lukku idam poathaama'rpoakum.

idukkamenki'ra samuththiraththaik kadakkaiyil avar samuththiraththin alaika'lai adippaar; appozhuthu nathiyin aazhangka'l ellaam va'ra'ndupoakum; aseeriyaavin karvam thaazhththappadum, ekipthin kodungkoal vilakippoakum.
naan avarka'laik karththarukku'l palappaduththuvean; avarka'l avarudaiya naamaththilea nadanthuko'l'luvaarka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
leepanoanea, akkini un keathurumarangka'laip padchikkumpadi un vaasalka'laith thi'ra.

theavathaaru virudchangka'lea, pulampungka'l; keathurumarangka'l vizhunthathea; pirapalamaanavaika'l paazhaakkappattana. paasaanin karvaalimarangka'lea, pulampungka'l; ara'nu'l'la soalai keezhea tha'l'lappattathu.

meaypparka'lin makimai azhinthupoanapadiyaal, avarka'l ala'ruki'ra saththam keadkappaduki'rathu; yoarthaanin perumai azhinthupoanapadiyaal, paalasingkangka'l karchchikki'ra saththam keadkappaduki'rathu.
en theavanaakiya karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, kolaiyu'nki'ra aaduka'lai meaykkakkadavaay.

avaika'lai udaiyavarka'l, avaika'laik kon'rupoattuth thangka'lukkuk kut'ramillaiyen'ru e'n'nuki'raarka'l. avaika'lai vi'rki'ravarka'l, karththarukku sthoaththiram, naangka'l aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'laanoam enki'raarka'l; avaika'lai meaykki'ravarka'l, avaika'lmeal irakkamvaikki'rathillai.

naan inith theasaththuk kudika'linmeal irakkamvaiyaamal manusharil yaavaraiyum avanavanudaiya ayalaan kaiyilum, avanavanudaiya raajaavin kaiyilum akappadappa'n'nuvean; avarka'l theasaththai azhiththum, naan ivarka'lai avarka'l kaikkuth thappuvippathillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar.
kolaiyu'nki'ra manthaiyaakiya si'rumaippatta ungka'lai naan meayppean; naan ira'ndu koalka'lai eduththu, on'ri'rku anukkirakam en'rum, on'ri'rku nikkirakam en'rum pearittu manthaiyai meayththu,
orea maathaththilea moon'ru meaypparaiyum athampa'n'ninean; en aaththumaa avarka'lai aroasiththathu; avarka'l aaththumaa ennaiyum ve'ruththathu.
ini naan ungka'lai meayppathillai; saaki'rathu saakattum, athamaaki'rathu athamaakattum; meethiyaanavaika'loaven'raal, on'rin maamsaththai on'ru thinnakkadavathu en'ru naan solli,
anukkirakam ennappatta en koalai eduththu, naan antha janangka'lellaaroadum pa'n'niyiruntha en udanpadikkai at'ruppoakumpadikku athai mu'riththuppoattean.
annaa'lilea athu at'ruppoayit'ru; appadiyea manthaiyil enakkuk kaaththiruntha si'rumaippattavaika'l athu karththarudaiya vaarththaiyen'ru a'rinthuko'ndana.
ungka'l paarvaikku nan'raayk ka'ndaal, en kooliyaith thaarungka'l; illaavittaal irukkattum en'ru avarka'loadea sonnean; appozhuthu enakkuk kooliyaaka muppathu ve'l'likkaasai ni'ruththaarka'l.

karththar ennai noakki: athaik kuyavanidaththil e'rinthuvidu en'raar; ithuvea naan avarka'laal mathikkappatta meanmaiyaana mathippu; naan antha muppathu ve'l'likkaasai eduththu, avaika'laik kuyavanukken'ru karththarudaiya aalayaththilea e'rinthuvittean.
naan yoothaavukkum isravealukkum irukki'ra sakoatharakkattai at'ruppoakappa'n'numpadikku, nikkirakam ennappatta en ira'ndaam koalaiyum mu'riththean.
karththar ennai noakki: nee mathiyat'ra oru meayppanudaiya aayuthangka'lai innum eduththukko'l.

ithoa, naan theasaththilea oru meayppanai ezhumpappa'n'nuvean; avan athamaaki'ravaika'laip paraamarikkaamalum, sitha'ru'ndathaith theadaamalum, no'rungku'ndathaik ku'namaakkaamalum, i'laiththirukki'rathai aatharikkaamalum, kozhuththathin maamsaththaith thin'ru, avaika'ludaiya ku'lampuka'lai udaiththuppoaduvaan.

manthaiyaik kaividuki'ra apaththamaana meayppanukku aiyoa! pattayam avan puyaththinmealum avan valathuka'n'ninmealum varum; avan puyamuzhuthum soompippoam; avan valathuka'n mut'rilum iru'l adaiyum en'raar.

isravealaikku'riththuk karththar sonna vaarththaiyin paaram; vaanangka'lai viriththu, poomiyai asthipaarappaduththi, manushanudaiya aaviyai avanukku'l u'ndaakkuki'ra karththar solluki'rathu ennaven'raal:
ithoa, sut'rilum irukki'ra ellaa janangka'lukkum naan erusaleamaith thaththa'lippin paaththiramaakkuki'rean; erusaleamukku viroathamaayp poadappadum mut'rikaiyilea yoothaavum appadiyeayaakum.

annaa'lilea naan erusaleamaich sakala janangka'lukkum paaramaana kallaakkuvean; athaik ki'lappuki'ra yaavarum sithaikkappaduvaarka'l; poomiyilu'l'la jaathika'lellaam atha'rku viroathamaayk koodikko'lvaarka'l.

annaa'lilea naan kuthiraika'lukkellaam thikaippaiyum, avaika'linmeal ea'riyirukki'ravarka'lukkellaam puththimayakkaththaiyum varappa'n'ni, yoothaavamsaththinmeal en ka'nka'laith thi'ranthuvaiththu, janangka'ludaiya ellaak kuthiraika'lukkum kuruttaattaththai u'ndupa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
erusaleamin kudika'l, seanaika'lin karththaraakiya thangka'l theavanudaiya thu'naiyinaal engka'lukkup pelanaanavarka'l en'ru appoathu yoothaavin thalaivar thangka'l iruthayaththilea solluvaarka'l.

annaa'lilea yoothaavin thalaivarai vi'rakuka'lukku'l'lea eriki'ra akkini aduppukkum, vaikkoal kattuka'lukku'l'lea eriki'ra theevattikkum oppaakkuvean; avarka'l valathupu'ramum idathupu'ramumaakap pu'rappattu, sut'rilum irukki'ra ellaa janangka'laiyum padchippaarka'l; erusaleam thirumpavum than sthaanamaakiya erusaleamilea kudiyeat'rappattirukkum.
thaaveethu vamsaththaarin makimaiyum, erusaleamin kudika'ludaiya makimaiyum, yoothaavinmeal thannai uyarththaathapadikku, karththar yoothaavin koodaarangka'lai muthalmuthal iradchippaar.

annaa'lilea karththar erusaleamin kudika'laik kaappaat'ruvaar; avarka'lil tha'l'laadinavan annaa'lilea thaaveethaippoala iruppaan; thaaveethu kudumpaththaar avarka'lukku munpaakath theavanaippoalum karththarudaiya thoothanaippoalum iruppaarka'l.
annaa'lilea erusaleamukku viroathamaay varuki'ra ellaa jaathika'laiyum azhikkap paarppean.

naan thaaveethu kudumpaththaarinmealum erusaleam kudika'linmealum kirupaiyin aaviyaiyum vi'n'nappangka'lin aaviyaiyum oot'ruvean; appozhuthu avarka'l thaangka'l kuththina ennai noakkippaarththu, oruvan than orea pea'raanavanukkaakap pulampuki'rathupoala enakkaakap pulampi, oruvan than thalaichchan pi'l'laikkaakath thukkikki'rathupoala enakkaaka manangkasanthu thukkippaarka'l.
annaa'lilea mekithoan patta'naththup pa'l'laththaakkin ooraakiya aathaathrimmoanin pulampalaippoala erusaleamin pulampal perithaayirukkum.

theasam pulampikko'ndirukkum; ovvoru vamsamum thaniththaniyaakap pulampum; thaaveethu kudumpaththaar thaniyeayum, avarka'l sthireeka'l thaniyeayum, naaththaan kudumpaththaar thaniyeayum, avarka'l sthireeka'l thaniyeayum,
leavi kudumpaththaar thaniyeayum, avarka'l sthireeka'l thaniyeayum, seemeayi kudumpaththaar thaniyeayum, avarka'l sthireeka'l thaniyeayum,
mat'rumu'ndaana sakala kudumpangka'lilum ovvoru kudumpaththin manushar thaniththaniyeayum avarka'ludaiya sthireeka'l thaniththaniyeayum pulampuvaarka'l.
annaa'lilea paavaththaiyum azhukkaiyum neekka, thaaveethin kudumpaththaarukkum erusaleamin kudika'lukkum thi'rakkappatta oru oot'ru u'ndaayirukkum.

annaa'lilea naan vikkirakangka'linpearum theasaththil iraathapadikku azhippean; avaika'l ini ninaikkappaduvathillai; tharisanam solluki'ravarka'laiyum, asuththa aaviyaiyum theasaththilirunthu poayvidavum pa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

ini oruvan tharisanam sonnaal, avanaippet'ra avan thakappanum avan thaayum avanai noakki: nee karththarudaiya naamaththaikko'ndu poypeasuki'rapadiyaal nee uyiroadirukkappadaathu en'ru solli, avanaip pet'ra avan thakappanum avan thaayum avan tharisanam sollumpoathu avanaik kuththippoaduvaarka'l.
annaa'lilea tharisanam solluki'ra avanavan thaan sonna tharisanaththinaal vedkappattu, poysollumpadikku ini mayirppoarvaiyaip poarththukko'l'laamal,
naan tharisanam solluki'ravan alla, naan nilaththaip payiriduki'ravan; en si'ruvayathumuthal oruvan ennai vealaiko'ndaan enpaan.
appozhuthu oruvan avanai noakki: un kaika'lil irukki'ra intha vadukka'l eathen'ru keattaal, en sineakitharin veettilea kaayappattathinaal u'ndaanavaika'l enpaan.

pattayamea, en meayppanmealum en thoazhanaakiya purushanmealum ezhumpu en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; meayppanai vettu, appozhuthu aaduka'l sitha'rippoakum; aanaalum en karaththaich si'ruvarmeal thirumpa vaippean.
theasamengkum sampavikkum kaariyam ennaven'raal, athil irukki'ra ira'ndu pangku manushar sangkarikkappattu maa'ndupoavaarka'l; moon'raam pangkoa athil meethiyaayirukkum.

antha moon'raam pangkai naan akkinikkudpadappa'n'ni, ve'l'liyai urukkuki'rathupoala avarka'lai urukki, ponnaip pudamiduki'rathupoala avarka'laip pudamiduvean; avarka'l en naamaththaith thozhuthuko'lvaarka'l; naan avarka'l vi'n'nappaththaik keadpean; ithu en janamen'ru naan solluvean, karththar en theavan en'ru avarka'l solluvaarka'l.
ithoa, karththarudaiya naa'l varuki'rathu, unnil ko'l'laiyaanathu un naduvilea pangkidappadum.

erusaleamukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nach sakala jaathika'laiyum koottuvean; nakaram pidikkappadum; veeduka'l ko'l'laiyaakum; sthireeka'l avamaanappaduvaarka'l; nakaraththaaril paathi manushar si'raippattuppoavaarka'l; meethiyaana janamoa nakaraththai vittu a'ruppu'ndupoavathillai.
karththar pu'rappattu, yuththanaa'lilea poaraaduvathupoal antha jaathika'loadea poaraaduvaar.

annaa'lilea avarudaiya paathangka'l kizhakkea erusaleamukku ethirea irukki'ra olivamalaiyinmeal ni'rkum; appozhuthu makaa periya pa'l'laththaakku u'ndaakumpadi olivamalai than nadumaiyaththilea kizhakku mea'rkaay ethiraakap pi'lanthupoam; athinaalea, oru paathi vadapakkaththilum oru paathi thenpakkaththilum saayum.

appozhuthu en malaika'lin pa'l'laththaakku vazhiyaay oadippoaveerka'l; malaika'lin pa'l'laththaakku aathsaalmattum poakum; neengka'l yoothaavin raajaavaakiya usiyaavin naadka'lil poomiyathirchchikkuth thappi oadippoanathupoal oadippoaveerka'l; en theavanaakiya karththar varuvaar; theavareeroadea ellaap parisuththavaanka'lum varuvaarka'l.
annaa'lil ve'lichcham illaamal, oruvea'lai pirakaasamum oruvea'lai mappumaayirukkum.
orunaa'l u'ndu, athu karththarukkuth therinthathu; athu pakalumalla iravumalla; aanaalum saayangkaalaththilea ve'lichchamu'ndaakum.
annaa'lilea jeevaththa'n'neerka'l erusaleamilirunthu pu'rappattu, paathi kizhakkuch samuththiraththukkum, paathi mea'rkuch samuththiraththukkum poay, maarikaalaththukkum koadaikaalaththukkum irukkum.
appozhuthu karththar poomiyinmeethengkum raajaavaayiruppaar; annaa'lil orea karththar iruppaar, avarudaiya naamamum on'raayirukkum.

theasamellaam keapaathodangki erusaleamukkuth the'rkea irukki'ra rimmoanvaraikkum samapoomiyaakath thiruththappadum; erusaleamoa uyarnthathaaki, than sthaanaththilea penyameen vaasalthodangki muthalvaasalenki'ra sthalamattum koadivaasalvaraikkum, anaaneyeal koapuram thuvakki raajaavin thiraadcha aalaika'lmattum kudiyeat'rappattirukkum.
athilea janangka'l vaasampa'n'nuvaarka'l; inich sangkarippillaamal erusaleam sukamaayth thangkiyirukkum.

erusaleamukku viroathamaaka yuththampa'n'nina ellaa janangka'laiyum karththar vaathikkum vaathaiyaavathu: avarka'l kaaloon'ri ni'rkaiyilum avarka'ludaiya sathai azhinthupoakum; avarka'l ka'nka'l thangka'l kuzhika'lilea kettuppoakum; avarka'l naavu avarka'l vaayilea azhukippoakum.
annaa'lilea karththaraal periya kalakkam avarka'lukku'l u'ndaakum; avanavan than than ayalaanin kaiyaip pidippaan; avanavanudaiya kai avanavan ayalaanudaiya kaikku viroathamaaka ezhumpum.
yoothaavum erusaleamilea yuththampa'n'num; appozhuthu sut'rilum irukki'ra sakala jaathika'ludaiya aasthiyaakiya ponnum ve'l'liyum vasthirangka'lum makaa thira'laakak koottappadum.
anthap paa'laiyangka'lil irukkum kuthiraika'l koavea'ru kazhuthaika'l ottakangka'l kazhuthaika'l muthalaana ellaa mirukajeevanka'lukkum varum vaathaiyum, antha vaathaiyaip poalavea irukkum.

pinpu, erusaleamukku viroathamaaka vanthiruntha ellaa jaathika'lilum meethiyaana yaavarum seanaika'lin karththaraakiya raajaavaith thozhuthuko'l'lumpadikkum, koodaarappa'ndikaiyai aasarikkumpadikkum, varushaavarusham varuvaarka'l.
appozhuthu poomiyin vamsangka'lil seanaika'lin karththaraakiya raajaavaith thozhuthuko'l'la erusaleamukku varaathavarka'l evarka'loa avarka'lmeal mazhai varushippathillai.
mazhai varushikkaatha ekipthin vamsam varaamalum searaamalum poanaal, koodaarappa'ndikaiyai aasarikkavaraatha jaathika'laik karththar vaathikkum vaathaiyea avarka'lmealum varum.
ithu ekipthiyarudaiya paavaththukkum, koodaarappa'ndikaiyai aasarikka varaatha sakala jaathika'ludaiya paavaththukkum varum aakkinai.

annaa'lilea kuthiraika'lin ma'nika'lilea karththarukkup parisuththam ennum vilaasam ezhuthiyirukkum; karththarudaiya aalayaththilu'l'la paanaika'l palipeedaththukku munpaaka irukki'ra paaththirangka'laip poalirukkum.

appozhuthu erusaleamilum yoothaavilumu'l'la ellaap paanaika'lum seanaika'lin karththarukkup parisuththamaayirukkum; paliyiduki'ra yaavarum vanthu avaika'lil eduththu, avaika'lil samaippaarka'l; annaa'lmuthal seanaika'ludaiya karththarin aalayaththilea yaathoru kaanaaniyanum iruppathillai.
malkiyaavaikko'ndu karththar isravealukkuch sonna vaarththaiyin paaram.

naan ungka'laich sineakiththean en'ru karththar solluki'raar; atha'rku neengka'l: engka'lai eppadich sineakiththeer enki'reerka'l; karththar solluki'raar: easaa yaakkoapukkuch sakoatharan allavoa? aakilum yaakkoapai naan sineakiththean.
easaavaiyoa naan ve'ruththean; avanudaiya malaika'laip paazhum, avanudaiya suthantharaththai vanaantharaththilu'l'la valusarppangka'lin thaavum aakkinean.

eathoamiyar: naam e'limaippattoam; aanaalum paazhaanavaika'laith thirumpak kattuvoam en'ru solluki'raarka'l; atha'rkuk karththar: avarka'l kattuvaarka'l, naan idippean. avarka'l thunmaarkkaththin ellaiyen'rum, karththar en'raikkum sinam vaikki'ra janamen'rum sollappaduvaarka'l enki'raar.
ithai ungka'l ka'nka'l kaa'num. appozhuthu neengka'l: karththar isravealudaiya ellai thuvakki makimaippaduththappaduvaar enpeerka'l.

kumaaran than pithaavaiyum, oozhiyakkaaran than ejamaanaiyum kanampa'n'nuki'raarka'lea; naan pithaavaanaal en kanam engkea? naan ejamaanaanaal enakkup payappadum payam engkea en'ru seanaika'lin karththar thamathu naamaththai asattaipa'n'nuki'ra aasaariyarka'laakiya ungka'laik keadki'raar; atha'rku neengka'l: umathu naamaththai ethinaalea asattaipa'n'ninoam enki'reerka'l.

en peedaththinmeal asuththamaana appaththaip padaikki'rathinaaleayea; aanaalum ummai ethinaalea asuththappaduththinoam enki'reerka'l; karththarudaiya panthi e'n'namat'ruppoayit'ren'ru neengka'l solluki'rathinaaleayea.

neengka'l ka'n oonamaanathaip paliyidakko'nduvanthaalum athu pollaappalla, neengka'l kaaloonamaanathaiyum nasal pidiththathaiyum ko'nduvanthaalum athu pollaappalla enki'reerka'lea; athai nee un athipathikkuch seluththu, avan unmeal piriyamaayiruppaanoa? un mukaththaip paarppaanoa en'ru seanaika'lin karththar keadki'raar.

ippoathum theavanudaiya samukaththai noakkik kegnchungka'l; appozhuthu nammeal irangkuvaar; ithu ungka'laalea vantha kaariyam, avar ungka'lai angkeekarippaaroa en'ru seanaika'lin karththar keadki'raar.

ungka'lil evan kooliyillaamal kathavuka'laip poottuvaan; en palipeedaththinmeal akkiniyaik kooliyillaamal ko'luththavumaatteerka'l; ungka'lpearil enakkup piriyamillaiyen'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; ungka'l kaika'lilu'l'la kaa'nikkai enakku ukanthathalla.

sooriyan uthikki'ra thisaithodangki, athu asthamikki'ra thisaivaraikkum, en naamam jaathika'lukku'l'lea makaththuvamaayirukkum; ellaa idangka'lilum en naamaththukkuth thoopamum suththamaana kaa'nikkaiyum seluththappadum; en naamam jaathika'lukku'l'lea makaththuvamaayirukkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'loa karththarudaiya panthi asuththamaanathu en'rum, athin aakaaramaakiya athin palan a'rpamaanathu en'rum solluki'rathinaalea, en naamaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuki'reerka'l.

ithoa, ithu evva'lavu varuththamen'ru solli, athai oru thira'namaayp peasi, pee'ru'ndathaiyum kaal oonamaanathaiyum nasalko'ndathaiyum ko'nduvanthu kaa'nikkaiyaakach seluththuki'reerka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; athai ungka'l kaika'lil angkeekariththukko'lveanoa en'ru karththar keadki'raar.

than manthaiyil kadaa irukkaiyil kettuppoanathai aa'ndavarukku nearnthuko'ndu paliyiduki'ra kapadasthan sapikkappattavan; en naamam jaathika'lukku'l'lea payangkaramaayirukkum; naan makaththuvamaana raajaa en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
ippoathum aasaariyarka'lea, inthak katta'lai ungka'lukkuriyathu.

neengka'l kea'laamalum en naamaththukku makimaiyaich seluththumpadi ithaich sinthiyaamalumirunthaal, naan ungka'lukku'l'lea saapaththai anuppi, ungka'l aaseervaathangka'laiyum saapamaakkuvean; aam, neengka'l athaich sinthiyaama'rpoanathinaal avaika'laich sapiththean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
ithoa, naan ungka'ludaiya payiraik keduththu, ungka'l pa'ndikaika'lin saa'niyaiyea ungka'l mukangka'lil i'raippean; athanoadukooda neengka'lum tha'l'lupadiyaaveerka'l.
leaviyoadeapa'n'nina en udanpadikkai nilaiththirukkumpadikku inthak katta'laiyai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppinean enki'rathai appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lveerka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

avanoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkai jeevanum samaathaanamumaaka irunthathu; avan enakkup payappadum payaththoadea irukkavea'ndumen'ru, ivaika'lai avanukkuk katta'laiyittean; appadiyea avan en naamaththukkup payanthum irunthaan.

saththiyaveatham avan vaayil irunthathu; avanudaiya uthaduka'lil aniyaayam kaa'nappadavillai; avan ennoadea samaathaanamum yathaarththamumaaych sagnchariththu, aneakarai akkiramaththinin'ru thiruppinaan.
aasaariyanudaiya uthaduka'l a'rivaik kaakkavea'ndum; veathaththai avan vaayilea theaduvaarka'lea; avan seanaika'ludaiya karththarin thoothan.
neengka'loa vazhiyaivittu vilaki, aneakarai veathaththaikku'riththu ida'rappa'n'nineerka'l; leaviyin udanpadikkaiyaik keduththuppoatteerka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l en vazhika'laik kaikko'l'laamal veathaththaikku'riththup padchapaatham pa'n'ninapadiyinaal naanum ungka'lai ellaa janaththukku munpaakavum a'rparum neesarumaakkinean.

nammellaarukkum orea pithaa illaiyoa? orea theavan nammaich sirushdiththathillaiyoa? naam nammudaiya pithaakka'lin udanpadikkaiyaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, avanavan thanthan sakoatharanukkuth thuroakampa'n'nuvaanean?

yoothaa janangka'l thuroakampa'n'ninaarka'l; isravealilum erusaleamilum aruvaruppaana kaariyam seyyappattathu; karththar sineakikki'ra parisuththaththai yoothaa janangka'l parisuththak kulaichchalaakki anniya theavathaiyin kumaaraththika'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaarka'l.

ippadich seyki'ravan evanoa, avan kaavalkaakki'ravanaayinum, uththaravukodukki'ravanaayinum, seanaika'lin karththarukkuk kaa'nikkai seluththuki'ravanaayinum, avanai yaakkoapin koodaarangka'lil iraathapadikkuk karththar sangkarippaar.

neengka'l ira'ndaantharamum ithaich seythu, karththarudaiya peedaththaik ka'n'neerinaalum azhukaiyinaalum perumoochchinaalum nirappuki'reerka'l; aakaiyaal, avar inik kaa'nikkaiyai mathiyaar, athai ungka'l kaika'lil piriyamaay eat'rukko'l'lavumaattaar.
ean en'ru keadki'reerka'l; karththar unakkum un i'lavayathin manaivikkum saadchiyaayirukki'raar; un thoazhiyum un udanpadikkaiyin manaiviyumaakiya ava'lukku nee thuroakampa'n'ninaayea.

avar oruvanaiyallavaa padaiththaar? aavi avaridaththil paripoora'namaayirunthathea, pinnai ean oruvanaip padaiththaar? theavapakthiyu'l'la santhathiyaip pe'rumpadithaanea. aakaiyaal oruvanum than i'lavayathin manaivikkuth thuroakampa'n'naathapadikku, ungka'l aaviyaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

tha'l'lividuthalai naan ve'rukki'rean en'ru isravealin theavanaakiya karththar solluki'raar; appadippattavan kodumaiyinaal than vasthiraththai mooduki'raan en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; aakaiyaal neengka'l thuroakampa'n'naamal ungka'l aaviyaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

ungka'l vaarththaika'linaalea karththarai varuththappaduththuki'reerka'l; aanaalum ethinaalea avarai varuththappaduththuki'roam enki'reerka'l; pollaappaich seyki'ravanevanum karththarin paarvaikku nallavan en'rum, appadippattavarka'lpearil avar piriyamaayirukki'raaren'rum, niyaayantheerkki'ra theavan engkeayen'rum, neengka'l solluki'rathinaaleayea.

ithoa, naan en thoothanai anuppuki'rean, avan enakku munpaakap poay, vazhiyai aayaththampa'n'nuvaan; appozhuthu neengka'l theaduki'ra aa'ndavarum neengka'l virumpuki'ra udanpadikkaiyin thoothanumaanavar thammudaiya aalayaththukkuth theeviramaay varuvaar; ithoa, varuki'raar en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
aanaalum avar varum naa'laich sakippavan yaar? avar ve'lippadukaiyil nilaini'rpavan yaar? avar pudamiduki'ravanudaiya akkiniyaippoalavum, va'n'naarudaiya savukkaaraththaippoalavum iruppaar.

avar udkaarnthu ve'l'liyaip pudamittuch suththikariththukko'ndiruppaar; avar leaviyin puththiraraich suththikariththu, avarka'l karththarudaiyavarka'laayirukkumpadikkum, neethiyaay kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththumpadikkum, avarka'laip ponnaippoalavum ve'l'liyaippoalavum pudamiduvaar.
appozhuthu poorvanaadka'lilum munthina varushangka'lilum irunthathupoala, yoothaavin kaa'nikkaiyum, erusaleamin kaa'nikkaiyum karththarukkup piriyamaayirukkum.

naan niyaayaththeerppuch seyyumpadi ungka'lidaththil vanthu, sooniyakkaararukkum vipasaararukkum poyyaa'nai iduki'ravarka'lukkum, enakkup payappadaamal vithavaika'lum thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lumaakiya koolikkaararin kooliyai apakariththukko'l'luki'ravarka'lukkum, paratheasikku aniyaayagnseyki'ravarka'lukkum viroathamaayth theeviramaana saadchiyaayiruppean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
naan karththar, naan maa'raathavar; aakaiyaal yaakkoapin puththiraraakiya neengka'l nirmoolamaakavillai.

neengka'l ungka'l pithaakka'lin naadka'l thodangki en katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'laamal, avaika'laivittu vilakippoaneerka'l; ennidaththi'rkuth thirumpungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lidaththi'rkuth thirumpuvean en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; naangka'l entha vishayaththil thirumpavea'ndum enki'reerka'l.
manushan theavanai vagnchikkalaamaa? neengka'loa ennai vagnchikki'reerka'l. ethilea ummai vagnchiththoam enki'reerka'l? thasamapaakaththilum kaa'nikkaika'lilunthaanea.
neengka'l sapikkappattavarka'l; janaththaaraakiya neengka'l ellaarum ennai vagnchiththeerka'l.

en aalayaththil aakaaram u'ndaayirukkumpadith thasamapaakangka'laiyellaam pa'ndasaalaiyilea ko'nduvaarungka'l; appozhuthu naan vaanaththin palaka'nika'laith thi'ranthu, idangko'l'laama'rpoakumattum ungka'lmeal aaseervaathaththai varushikkamaatteanoaven'ru athinaal ennaich soathiththup paarungka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

poomiyin kaniyaip padchiththup poaduki'ravaika'lai ungka'l nimiththam ka'ndippean; avaika'l ungka'l nilaththin palanai azhippathillai, ve'liyilu'l'la thiraadchakkodi pazhamillaama'rpoavathumillai en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu ellaa jaathika'lum ungka'laip paakkiyavaanka'l enpaarka'l; theasam virumpappadaththakkathaayirukkum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
neengka'l enakku viroathamaayp peasina peachchuka'l kadinamaayirukki'rathu en'ru karththar solluki'raar; aanaalum umakku viroathamaaka ennaththaip peasinoam enki'reerka'l.
theavanaich seavippathu viruthaa, avarudaiya katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'luki'rathinaalum, seanaika'lin karththarukku munpaakath thukkiththu nadakki'rathinaalum enna pirayoajanam?
ippoathum akangkaarika'laip paakkiyavaanka'l enki'roam; theemai seyki'ravarka'l thidappaduki'raarka'l; avarka'l theavanaip pareedchaipaarththaalum viduvikkappaduki'raarka'lea en'ru solluki'reerka'l.

appozhuthu karththarukkup payanthavarka'l oruvaroadoruvar peasikko'lvaarka'l; karththar kavaniththukkeadpaar; karththarukkup payanthavarka'lukkaakavum avarudaiya naamaththaith thiyaanikki'ravarka'lukkaakavum gnaapakappusthakam on'ru avarukku munpaaka ezhuthappattirukki'rathu.

en sampaththai naan searkkum naa'lilea avarka'l ennudaiyavarka'laayiruppaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar; oru manushan thanakku oozhiyagnseyki'ra thannudaiya kumaaranaik kadaadchikki'rathupoala naan avarka'laik kadaadchippean.
appozhuthu neengka'l neethimaanukkum thunmaarkkanukkum, theavanukku oozhiyagnseyki'ravanukkum avarukku oozhiyagnseyyaathavanukkum irukki'ra viththiyaasaththaith thirumpavum kaa'npeerka'l.

ithoa, soo'laiyaippoala eriki'ra naa'l varum; appozhuthu akangkaarika'l yaavarum akkiramagnseyki'ra yaavarum thurumpaayiruppaarka'l; varappoaki'ra antha naa'l avarka'laich sutterikkum; athu avarka'lukku vearaiyum koppaiyum vaikkaama'rpoakum en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.

aanaalum en naamaththukkup payanthirukki'ra ungka'lmeal neethiyin sooriyan uthikkum; athin settaika'linkeezh aaroakkiyam irukkum; neengka'l ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoay, kozhuththa kan'ruka'laippoala va'laruveerka'l.
thunmaarkkarai mithippeerka'l; naan ithaich seyyumnaa'lilea avarka'l ungka'l u'l'langkaalka'linkeezh saampalaayiruppaarka'l en'ru seanaika'lin karththar solluki'raar.
oareapilea isravealarellaarukkaakavum en thaasanaakiya moaseakku naan ka'rpiththa niyaayappiramaa'namaakiya katta'laika'laiyum niyaayangka'laiyum ninaiyungka'l.
ithoa, karththarudaiya perithum payangkaramumaana naa'l varuki'ratha'rku munnea naan ungka'lidaththi'rku eliyaa theerkkatharisiyai anuppuki'rean.

naan vanthu poomiyaich sangkaaraththaal adikkaathapadikku, avan pithaakka'ludaiya iruthayaththaip pi'l'laika'lidaththi'rkum, pi'l'laika'ludaiya iruthayaththai avarka'l pithaakka'lidaththi'rkum thiruppuvaan.
aapirakaamin kumaaranaakiya thaaveethin kumaaranaana iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya vamsa varalaa'ru:
aapirakaam eesaakkaip pet'raan; eesaakku yaakkoapaip pet'raan; yaakkoapu yoothaavaiyum avan sakoathararaiyum pet'raan;
yoothaa paareasaiyum saaraavaiyum thaamaarinidaththil pet'raan; paareas esroamaip pet'raan; esroam aaraamaip pet'raan;
aaraam amminathaapaip pet'raan; amminathaap nakasoanaip pet'raan; nakasoan salmoanaip pet'raan;
salmoan poavaasai raakaapinidaththil pet'raan; poavaas oapeathai rooththinidaththil pet'raan; oapeath eesaayaip pet'raan;
eesaay thaaveethu raajaavaip pet'raan; thaaveethu raajaa uriyaavin manaiviyaayirunthava'lidaththil saalomoanaip pet'raan;
saalomoan rekopeyaamaip pet'raan; rekopeyaam apiyaavaip pet'raan; apiyaa aasaavaip pet'raan;
aasaa yoasapaaththaip pet'raan; yoasapaath yoaraamaip pet'raan; yoaraam usiyaavaip pet'raan;
usiyaa yoathaamaip pet'raan; yoathaam aakaasaip pet'raan; aakaas eseakkiyaavaip pet'raan;
eseakkiyaa manaaseayaip pet'raan; manaasea aamoanaip pet'raan; aamoan yoasiyaavaip pet'raan;
paapiloanukkuch si'raippattup poakungkaalaththil, yoasiyaa ekoniyaavaiyum avanudaiya sakoathararaiyum pet'raan.
paapiloanukkuch si'raippattup poanapinpu, ekoniyaa salaaththiyealaip pet'raan; salaaththiyeal soropaapealaip pet'raan;
soropaapeal apiyoothaip pet'raan; apiyooth eliyaakkeemaip pet'raan; eliyaakkeem aasoaraip pet'raan;
aasoar saathoakkaip pet'raan; saathoakku aakeemaip pet'raan; aakeem eliyoothaip pet'raan;
eliyooth eleyaasaaraip pet'raan; eleyaasaar maaththaanaip pet'raan; maaththaan yaakkoapaip pet'raan;
yaakkoapu mariyaa'ludaiya purushanaakiya yoaseappaip pet'raan; ava'lidaththil ki'risthu ennappaduki'ra iyeasu pi'ranthaar.

ivvithamaay u'ndaana thalaimu'raika'lellaam aapirakaammuthal thaaveethuvaraikkum pathinaalu thalaimu'raika'lum; thaaveethumuthal paapiloanukkuch si'raippattuppoana kaalamvaraikkum pathinaalu thalaimu'raika'lum; paapiloanukkuch si'raippattuppoana kaalamuthal ki'risthuvaraikkum pathinaalu thalaimu'raika'lumaam.

iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya jenanaththin vivaramaavathu: avarudaiya thaayaakiya mariyaa'l yoaseappukku niyamikkappattirukkaiyil, avarka'l koodivarumunnea, ava'l parisuththa aaviyinaalea karppavathiyaanaa'l en'ru kaa'nappattathu.
ava'l purushanaakiya yoaseappu neethimaanaayirunthu, ava'lai avamaanappaduththa manathillaamal, irakasiyamaay ava'laith tha'l'livida yoasanaiyaayirunthaan.

avan ippadich sinthiththukko'ndirukkaiyil, karththarudaiya thoothan soppanaththil avanukkuk kaa'nappattu: thaaveethin kumaaranaakiya yoaseappea, un manaiviyaakiya mariyaa'laich searththukko'l'la aiyappadaathea; ava'lidaththil u'rpaththiyaayirukki'rathu parisuththa aaviyinaal u'ndaanathu.
ava'l oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l, avarukku iyeasu en'ru peariduvaayaaka; eanenil avar thamathu janangka'lin paavangka'lai neekki avarka'lai iradchippaar en'raan.
theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththaraalea uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ithellaam nadanthathu.

avan: ithoa, oru kannikai karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l; avarukku immaanuveal en'ru peariduvaarka'l en'ru sonnaan. immaanuveal enpatha'rkuth theavan nammoadirukki'raar en'ru arththamaam.
yoaseappu niththirai the'linthu ezhunthu, karththarudaiya thoothan thanakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea than manaiviyaich searththukko'ndu;
ava'l than mutha'rpea'raana kumaaranaip pe'ruma'lavum ava'lai a'riyaathirunthu, avarukku iyeasu en'ru pearittaan.
earoathuraajaavin naadka'lil yootheayaavilu'l'la pethlekeamilea iyeasu pi'ranthapozhuthu, kizhakkilirunthu saasthirika'l erusaleamukku vanthu,
yootharukku raajaavaakap pi'ranthirukki'ravar engkea? kizhakkilea avarudaiya nadchaththiraththaik ka'ndu, avaraip pa'ninthuko'l'la vanthoam en'raarka'l.
earoathuraajaa athaik keattapozhuthu, avanum avanoadukooda erusaleam nakaraththaar anaivarum kalangkinaarka'l.
avan pirathaana aasaariyar janaththin veathapaarakar ellaaraiyum koodivarachseythu: ki'risthuvaanavar engkea pi'rappaaren'ru avarka'lidaththil visaariththaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: yootheayaavilu'l'la pethlekeamilea pi'rappaar; atheanen'raal:

yootheayaa theasaththilu'l'la pethlekeamea, yoothaavin pirapukka'lil nee si'riyathalla; en janamaakiya isravealai aa'lum pirapu unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappaduvaar en'ru, theerkkatharisiyinaal ezhuthappattirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu earoathu, saasthirika'lai irakasiyamaay azhaiththu, nadchaththiram kaa'nappatta kaalaththaikku'riththu avarka'lidaththil thittamaay visaariththu:

neengka'l poay, pi'l'laiyaikku'riththuth thittamaay visaariyungka'l; neengka'l athaik ka'ndapinpu, naanum vanthu athaip pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadi enakku a'riviyungka'l en'ru solli, avarka'laip pethlekeamukku anuppinaan.
raajaa sonnathai avarka'l keattup poakaiyil, ithoa, avarka'l kizhakkilea ka'nda nadchaththiram pi'l'lai iruntha sthalaththi'rkumeal vanthu ni'rkumvaraikkum avarka'lukkumun sen'rathu.
avarka'l antha nadchaththiraththaik ka'ndapoathu, mikuntha aanantha santhoashamadainthaarka'l.

avarka'l antha veettukku'l piraveasiththu, pi'l'laiyaiyum athin thaayaakiya mariyaa'laiyum ka'ndu, saashdaangkamaay vizhunthu athaip pa'ninthuko'ndu, thangka'l pokkishangka'laith thi'ranthu, ponnaiyum thoopavarkkaththaiyum ve'l'laippoa'laththaiyum atha'rkuk kaa'nikkaiyaaka vaiththaarka'l.
pinpu, avarka'l earoathinidaththi'rkuth thirumpip poakavea'ndaamen'ru soppanaththil theavanaal echcharikkappattu, vea'ru vazhiyaayth thangka'l theasaththi'rkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.

avarka'l poanapinpu, karththarudaiya thoothan soppanaththil yoaseappukkuk kaa'nappattu: earoathu pi'l'laiyaik kolaiseyyath theaduvaan; aathalaal nee ezhunthu, pi'l'laiyaiyum athin thaayaiyum koottikko'ndu ekipthukku oadippoay, naan unakkuch sollumvaraikkum angkea iru en'raan.
avan ezhunthu, iravilea pi'l'laiyaiyum athin thaayaiyum koottikko'ndu, ekipthukkup pu'rappattuppoay,

earoathin mara'napariyantham angkea irunthaan. ekipthilirunthu ennudaiya kumaaranai varavazhaiththean en'ru, theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththaraal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.

appozhuthu earoathu thaan saasthirika'laal vagnchikkappattathaik ka'ndu, mikuntha koapamadainthu, aadka'lai anuppi, thaan saasthirika'lidaththil thittamaay visaariththa kaalaththinpadiyea, pethlekeamilum athin sakala ellaika'lilumiruntha ira'ndu vayathukkudpatta ellaa aa'npi'l'laika'laiyum kolaiseythaan.

pulampalum azhukaiyum mikuntha thukkangko'ndaadalumaakiya kookkural raamaavilea keadkappattathu; raakeal than pi'l'laika'lukkaaka azhuthu, avaika'l illaathapadiyaal aa'ruthaladaiyaathirukki'raa'l en'ru,
ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyinaal uraikkappattathu appozhuthu ni'raivea'rit'ru.
earoathu i'ranthapinpu, karththarudaiya thoothan ekipthilea yoaseappukkuch soppanaththil kaa'nappattu:
nee ezhunthu, pi'l'laiyaiyum athin thaayaiyum koottikko'ndu, israveal theasaththukkup poa; pi'l'laiyin piraa'nanai vaangkaththeadinavarka'l i'ranthupoanaarka'l en'raan.
avan ezhunthu pi'l'laiyaiyum athin thaayaiyum koottikko'ndu israveal theasaththukku vanthaan.

aakilum, arkelaayu than thakappanaakiya earoathin pattaththukku vanthu, yootheayaavil arasaa'luki'raan en'ru kea'lvippattu, angkea poakap payanthaan. appozhuthu, avan soppanaththil theavanaal echcharikkappattu, kalileayaa naattin pu'rangka'lilea vilakippoay,
naasareaththu ennum oorilea vanthu vaasampa'n'ninaan. nasareayan ennappaduvaar en'ru, theerkkatharisika'laal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.
annaadka'lil yoavaansnaanan yootheayaavin vanaantharaththil vanthu:
mananthirumpungka'l, paraloakaraajyam sameepiththirukki'rathu en'ru pirasangkam pa'n'ninaan.

karththarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l; avarukkup paathaika'laich sevvaipa'n'nungka'l en'ru vanaantharaththilea kooppiduki'ravanudaiya saththam u'nden'ru, easaayaa theerkkatharisiyinaal sollappattavan ivanea.
intha yoavaan ottakamayir udaiyaith thariththu, than araiyil vaarkkachchaiyaik kattikko'ndirunthaan; vettukki'liyum kaattuth theanum avanukku aakaaramaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu, erusaleam nakaraththaarum, yootheayaa theasaththaar anaivarum, yoarthaanukku aduththa sut'ruppu'raththaar yaavarum avanidaththi'rkup poay,
thangka'l paavangka'lai a'rikkaiyittu, yoarthaan nathiyil avanaal gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.

pariseayarilum sathuseayarilum aneakar thannidaththil gnaanasnaanam pe'rumpadi varuki'rathai avan ka'ndu: viriyan paampuk kuttika'lea! varungkoapaththukkuth thappiththukko'l'la ungka'lukku vakaikaattinavan yaar?
mananthirumputhalukku eat'ra kanika'laik kodungka'l.

aapirakaam engka'lukkuth thakappan en'ru ungka'lukku'l'lea sollikko'l'la ninaiyaathirungka'l; theavan inthak kalluka'linaalea aapirakaamukkup pi'l'laika'lai u'ndupa'n'na vallavaraayirukki'raar en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
ippozhuthea koadariyaanathu marangka'lin vear arukea vaiththirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal, nalla kanikodaatha maramellaam vettu'ndu akkiniyilea poadappadum.

mananthirumputhalukken'ru naan jalaththinaal ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanang kodukki'rean; enakkuppin varuki'ravaroa ennilum vallavaraayirukki'raar, avarudaiya paatharadchaika'laich sumakki'ratha'rku naan paaththiran alla; avar parisuththa aaviyinaalum akkiniyinaalum ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanam koduppaar.
thoot'rukkoodai avar kaiyil irukki'rathu; avar thamathu ka'laththai nan'raay vi'lakki, thamathu koathumaiyaik ka'lagnchiyaththil searppaar; patharaiyoa aviyaatha akkiniyinaal sutterippaar en'raan.
appozhuthu yoavaanaal gnaanasnaanam pe'ruvatha'rku iyeasu kalileayaavaivittu yoarthaanukku arukea avanidaththil vanthaar.
yoavaan avarukkuth thadai seythu: naan ummaalea gnaanasnaanam pe'ravea'ndiyathaayirukka, neer ennidaththil varalaamaa en'raan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ippozhuthu idangkodu, ippadi ellaa neethiyaiyum ni'raiveat'ruvathu namakku eat'rathaayirukki'rathu en'raar. appozhuthu avarukku idangkoduththaan.
iyeasu gnaanasnaanam pet'ru, jalaththilirunthu karaiyea'rinavudanea, ithoa, vaanam avarukkuth thi'rakkappattathu; theava aavi pu'raavaippoala i'rangki, thammeal varuki'rathaik ka'ndaar.
an'riyum, vaanaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaaki: ivar ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ivaril piriyamaayirukki'rean en'ru uraiththathu.
appozhuthu iyeasu pisaasinaal soathikkappaduvatha'rku aaviyaanavaraalea vanaantharaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoakappattaar.
avar iravum pakalum naa'rpathunaa'l upavaasamaayirunthapinpu, avarukkup pasiyu'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu soathanaikkaaran avaridaththil vanthu: neer theavanudaiya kumaaraneayaanaal, inthak kalluka'l appangka'laakumpadi sollum en'raan.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: manushan appaththinaaleamaaththiramalla, theavanudaiya vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra ovvoru vaarththaiyinaalum pizhaippaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raar.
appozhuthu pisaasu avaraip parisuththa nakaraththi'rkuk ko'ndupoay, theavaalayaththu upparikaiyinmeal avarai ni'ruththi:

neer theavanudaiya kumaaraneayaanaal thaazhakkuthiyum; eanenil, thammudaiya thootharka'lukku ummaikku'riththuk katta'laiyiduvaar; umathu paatham kallil ida'raathapadikku, avarka'l ummaik kaika'lil eanthikko'ndu poavaarka'l enpathaay ezhuthiyirukki'rathu en'ru sonnaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: un theavanaakiya karththaraip pareedchai paaraathiruppaayaaka en'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raar.
ma'rupadiyum, pisaasu avarai mikavum uyarntha malaiyinmeal ko'ndupoay, ulakaththin sakala raajyangka'laiyum avaika'lin makimaiyaiyum avarukkuk kaa'npiththu:
neer saashdaangkamaay vizhunthu, ennaip pa'ninthuko'ndaal, ivaika'laiyellaam umakkuth tharuvean en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu: appaalea poa saaththaanea; un theavanaakiya karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu, avar oruvarukkea aaraathanai seyvaayaaka en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raar.
appozhuthu pisaasaanavan avarai vittu vilakippoanaan. udanea theavathootharka'l vanthu, avarukkup pa'nividai seythaarka'l.
yoavaan kaavalil vaikkappattaan en'ru iyeasu kea'lvippattu, kalileayaavukkup poay,
naasareaththai vittu, sepuloan napthali ennum naaduka'lin ellaika'lilirukkum kada'rkaraikku arukaana kapparnakoomilea vanthu vaasampa'n'ninaar.
kada'rkaraiyarukilum yoarthaanukku appu'raththilumu'l'la sepuloan naadum napthali naadum aakiya pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya kalileayaavilea,
iru'lil irukkum janangka'l periya ve'lichchaththaik ka'ndaarka'l; mara'na iru'lin thisaiyilirukki'ravarka'lukku ve'lichcham uthiththathu en'ru,
easaayaa theerkkatharisiyinaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.
athumuthal iyeasu: mananthirumpungka'l, paraloakaraajyam sameepiththirukki'rathu en'ru pirasangkikkath thodangkinaar.

iyeasu kalileayaak kadaloaramaay nadanthupoakaiyil, meenpidikki'ravarka'laayiruntha ira'ndu sakoathararaakiya peathuru ennappatta seemoanum, avan sakoatharan anthireayaavum, kadalil valaipoattukko'ndirukki'rapoathu, avarka'laik ka'ndu:
en pinnea vaarungka'l, ungka'lai manusharaip pidikki'ravarka'laakkuvean en'raar.
udanea avarka'l valaika'lai vittu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

avar avvidam vittup poakaiyil, vea'rea ira'ndu sakoathararaakiya sepetheayuvin makan yaakkoapum, avan sakoatharan yoavaanum thangka'l thakappan sepetheayuvudanea padavilirunthu, thangka'l valaika'laip pazhuthupaarththukko'ndirukki'rapoathu, avarka'laik ka'ndu, avarka'laiyum azhaiththaar.
udanea avarka'l padavaiyum thangka'l thakappanaiyum vittu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

pinpu, iyeasu kalileayaa engkum sut'ri nadanthu, avarka'ludaiya jepa aalayangka'lil upatheasiththu, raajyaththin suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu, janangka'lukku u'ndaayiruntha sakala viyaathika'laiyum sakala noayka'laiyum neekkich sosthamaakkinaar.

avarudaiya keerththi seeriyaa engkum pirasiththamaayit'ru. appozhuthu palavitha viyaathika'laiyum veathanaika'laiyum adainthiruntha sakala pi'niyaa'lika'laiyum, pisaasu pidiththavarka'laiyum santhiraroakika'laiyum, thimirvaathakkaararaiyum avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.
kalileayaavilum, thekkappoaliyilum, erusaleamilum, yootheayaavilum, yoarthaanukku appu'raththilum irunthu thira'laana janangka'l vanthu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
avar thira'laana janangka'laik ka'ndu malaiyinmeal ea'rinaar; avar udkaarnthapozhuthu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar thamathu vaayaith thi'ranthu avarka'lukku upatheasiththuch sonnathu ennaven'raal:
aaviyil e'limaiyu'l'lavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; paraloakaraajyam avarka'ludaiyathu.
thuyarappaduki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l aa'ruthaladaivaarka'l.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l poomiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarka'l.
neethiyinmeal pasithaakamu'l'lavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l thirupthiyadaivaarka'l.
irakkamu'l'lavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l irakkam pe'ruvaarka'l.
iruthayaththil suththamu'l'lavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l theavanaith tharisippaarka'l.
samaathaanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; avarka'l theavanudaiya puththirar ennappaduvaarka'l.
neethiyinimiththam thunpappaduki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; paraloakaraajyam avarka'ludaiyathu.
ennimiththam ungka'lai ninthiththuth thunpappaduththi, palavitha theemaiyaana mozhika'laiyum ungka'lpearil poyyaaych solvaarka'laanaal paakkiyavaanka'laayiruppeerka'l;
santhoashappattu, ka'likoorungka'l; paraloakaththil ungka'l palan mikuthiyaayirukkum; ungka'lukku munniruntha theerkkatharisika'laiyum appadiyea thunpappaduththinaarka'lea.

neengka'l poomikku uppaayirukki'reerka'l; uppaanathu saaramat'ruppoanaal, ethinaal saaramaakkappadum? ve'liyea kottappaduvatha'rkum, manusharaal mithikkappaduvatha'rkumea ozhiya vea'ron'rukkum uthavaathu.
neengka'l ulakaththukku ve'lichchamaayirukki'reerka'l; malaiyinmeal irukki'ra patta'nam ma'rainthirukkamaattaathu.
vi'lakkaik ko'luththi marakkaalaal moodivaikkaamal, vi'lakkuth tha'ndinmeal vaippaarka'l; appozhuthu athu veettilu'l'la yaavarukkum ve'lichcham kodukkum.
ivvithamaay, manushar ungka'l na'rkiriyaika'laik ka'ndu, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaavai makimaippaduththumpadi, ungka'l ve'lichcham avarka'l munpaakap pirakaasikkakkadavathu.
niyaayappiramaa'naththaiyaanaalum theerkkatharisanangka'laiyaanaalum azhikki'ratha'rku vanthean en'ru e'n'nikko'l'laatheayungka'l; azhikki'ratha'rku alla, ni'raiveat'ruki'ratha'rkea vanthean.

vaanamum poomiyum ozhinthupoanaalum, niyaayappiramaa'naththilu'l'lathellaam ni'raivea'ruma'lavum, athil oru si'ru ezhuththaakilum, oru ezhuththin u'ruppaakilum ozhinthupoakaathu en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

aakaiyaal, inthak ka'rpanaika'l ellaavat'rilum si'rithaanathon'raiyaakilum mee'ri, avvithamaay manusharukkup poathikki'ravan paraloakaraajyaththil ellaarilum si'riyavan ennappaduvaan; ivaika'laik kaikko'ndu poathikki'ravanoa, paraloakaraajyaththil periyavan ennappaduvaan.
veathapaarakar pariseayar enpavarka'ludaiya neethiyilum ungka'l neethi athikamaayiraavittaal, paraloakaraajyaththil piraveasikkamaatteerka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka enpathum, kolaiseyki'ravan niyaayaththeerppukku eathuvaayiruppaan enpathum, poorvaththaarukku uraikkappattathen'ru kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l.

naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; than sakoatharanai niyaayamillaamal koapiththukko'lpavan niyaayaththeerppukku eathuvaayiruppaan; than sakoatharanai vee'nanen'ru solluki'ravan aaloasanaich sangkaththeerppukku eathuvaayiruppaan; moodanea en'ru solluki'ravan erinarakaththukku eathuvaayiruppaan.
aakaiyaal, nee palipeedaththinidaththil un kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththa vanthu, unpearil un sakoatharanukkuk ku'raiu'nden'ru angkea ninaivukooruvaayaakil,
angkeathaanea palipeedaththin mun un kaa'nikkaiyai vaiththuvittup poay, munpu un sakoatharanoadea oppuravaaki, pinpu vanthu un kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththu.

ethiraa'li unnai niyaayaathipathiyinidaththil oppukkodaamalum, niyaayaathipathi unnaich seavakanidaththil oppukkodaamalum, nee si'raichsaalaiyil vaikkappadaamalum irukkumpadiyaaka, nee un ethiraa'liyoadu vazhiyil irukkumpoathea seekkiramaay avanudanea nalmanam porunthu.
porunthaavittaal, nee oru kaasum ku'raivin'rik koduththuth theerkkumattum avvidaththilirunthu pu'rappadamaattaay en'ru, meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean.
vipasaaragn seyyaathiruppaayaaka enpathu poorvaththaarukku uraikkappattathen'ru kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l.
naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; oru sthireeyai ichchaiyoadu paarkki'ra evanum than iruthayaththil ava'loadea vipasaaragnseythaayit'ru.

un valathu ka'n unakku ida'ralu'ndaakkinaal, athaip pidungki e'rinthupoadu; un sareeram muzhuvathum narakaththil tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, un avayavangka'lil on'ru kettuppoavathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.

un valathukai unakku ida'ralu'ndaakkinaal, athaith tha'riththu e'rinthupoadu; un sareeram muzhuvathum narakaththil tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, un avayavangka'lil on'ru kettuppoavathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.
than manaiviyaith tha'l'lividuki'ra evanum, tha'l'lutha'rseettai ava'lukkuk kodukkakkadavan en'ru uraikkappattathu.

naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; veasiththana mukaantharaththinaalozhiya than manaiviyaith tha'l'lividuki'ravan, ava'lai vipasaaragnseyyappa'n'nuki'ravanaayiruppaan; appadith tha'l'lividappattava'lai vivaakampa'n'nuki'ravanum vipasaaragnseyki'ravanaayiruppaan.
an'riyum, poyyaa'naiyidaamal, un aa'naika'laik karththar munnilaiyaaych seluththuvaayaaka en'ru poorvaththaarukku uraikkappattathen'ru kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l.
naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; parichseatham saththiyampa'n'navea'ndaam; vaanaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'navea'ndaam, athu theavanudaiya singkaasanam.
poomiyinpearilum saththiyampa'n'navea'ndaam, athu avarudaiya paathapadi; erusaleaminpearilum saththiyampa'n'navea'ndaam, athu makaaraajaavinudaiya nakaram.
un sirasinpearilum saththiyampa'n'navea'ndaam, athin oru mayiraiyaavathu ve'nmaiyaakkavum ka'ruppaakkavum unnaal koodaathea.
u'l'lathai u'l'lathen'rum, illathai illathen'rum sollungka'l; itha'rku mignchinathu theemaiyinaal u'ndaayirukkum.
ka'n'nukkuk ka'n, pallukkup pal en'ru, uraikkappattathaik kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l.
naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; theemaiyoadu ethirththu ni'rkavea'ndaam; oruvan unnai valathu kannaththil a'rainthaal, avanukku ma'ru kannaththaiyum thiruppikkodu.
unnoadu vazhakkaadi un vasthiraththai eduththukko'l'lavea'ndumen'rirukki'ravanukku un angkiyaiyum vittuvidu.
oruvan unnai oru mail thooramvarap palavanthampa'n'ninaal, avanoadu ira'ndu mail thooram poa.
unnidaththil keadki'ravanukkuk kodu, unnidaththil kadanvaangka virumpuki'ravanukku mukangkoa'naathea.
unakkaduththavanaich sineakiththu, un saththuruvaip pakaippaayaaka en'ru sollappattathaik kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l.

naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; ungka'l saththurukka'laich sineakiyungka'l; ungka'laich sapikki'ravarka'lai aaseervathiyungka'l; ungka'laip pakaikki'ravarka'lukku nanmai seyyungka'l; ungka'lai ninthikki'ravarka'lukkaakavum ungka'laith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'lukkaakavum jepampa'n'nungka'l.

ippadich seyvathinaal neengka'l paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaavukkup puththiraraayiruppeerka'l; avar theeyoarmealum nalloarmealum thamathu sooriyanai uthikkappa'n'ni, neethiyu'l'lavarka'lmealum aneethiyu'l'lavarka'lmealum mazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'nuki'raar.
ungka'laich sineakikki'ravarka'laiyea neengka'l sineakippeerka'laanaal, ungka'lukkup palan enna? aayakkaararum appadiyea seyki'raarka'l allavaa?
ungka'l sakoathararaimaaththiram vaazhththuveerka'laanaal, neengka'l viseashiththuch seyki'rathu enna? aayakkaararum appadich seyki'raarka'l allavaa?
aakaiyaal, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaa poora'na sa'rku'naraayirukki'rathupoala, neengka'lum poora'na sa'rku'naraayirukkakkadaveerka'l.

manushar kaa'navea'ndumen'ru avarka'lukku munpaaka ungka'l tharmaththaich seyyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; seythaal, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaavinidaththil ungka'lukkup palanillai.

aakaiyaal nee tharmagnseyyumpoathu, manusharaal pukazhappaduvatha'rku, maayakkaarar aalayangka'lilum veethika'lilum seyvathupoala, unakku munpaakath thaarai oothuviyaathea; avarka'l thangka'l palanai adainthu theernthathen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
neeyoa tharmagnseyyumpoathu, un tharmam antharangkamaayiruppatha'rku, un valathukai seyki'rathai un idathukai a'riyaathirukkakkadavathu.
appozhuthu antharangkaththil paarkki'ra un pithaa thaamea unakku ve'liyarangkamaayp palana'lippaar.

an'riyum nee jepampa'n'numpoathu maayakkaararaip poalirukkavea'ndaam; manushar kaa'numpadiyaaka avarka'l jepa aalayangka'lilum veethika'lin santhika'lilum nin'ru jepampa'n'na virumpuki'raarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l palanai adainthu theernthathen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

neeyoa jepampa'n'numpoathu, un a'raiveettukku'l piraveasiththu, un kathavaip pootti, antharangkaththilirukki'ra un pithaavai noakki jepampa'n'nu; appozhuthu, antharangkaththil paarkki'ra un pithaa ve'liyarangkamaay unakkup palana'lippaar.
an'riyum neengka'l jepampa'n'numpoathu, agngnaanika'laippoala vee'nvaarththaika'lai alappaatheayungka'l; avarka'l, athika vasanippinaal thangka'l jepam keadkappadumen'ru ninaikki'raarka'l.
avarka'laippoala neengka'l seyyaathirungka'l; ungka'l pithaavai noakki neengka'l vea'ndikko'l'luki'ratha'rku munnamea ungka'lukku innathu theavai en'ru avar a'rinthirukki'raar.
neengka'l jepampa'n'navea'ndiya vithamaavathu: parama'ndalangka'lilirukki'ra engka'l pithaavea, ummudaiya naamam parisuththappaduvathaaka.
ummudaiya raajyam varuvathaaka; ummudaiya siththam parama'ndalaththilea seyyappaduki'rathupoalap poomiyileayum seyyappaduvathaaka.
engka'lukku vea'ndiya aakaaraththai in'ru engka'lukkuth thaarum.
engka'l kadanaa'lika'lukku naangka'l mannikki'rathupoala engka'l kadanka'lai engka'lukku manniyum.
engka'laich soathanaikkudpadappa'n'naamal, theemaiyinin'ru engka'lai iradchiththukko'l'lum, raajyamum, vallamaiyum, makimaiyum en'ren'raikkum ummudaiyavaika'lea, aamen, enpathea.
manusharudaiya thappithangka'lai neengka'l avarka'lukku manniththaal, ungka'l paramapithaa ungka'lukkum mannippaar.
manusharudaiya thappithangka'lai neengka'l avarka'lukku manniyaathirunthaal, ungka'l pithaa ungka'l thappithangka'laiyum manniyaathiruppaar.

neengka'l upavaasikkumpoathu, maayakkaararaippoala mukavaadalaay iraatheayungka'l; avarka'l upavaasikki'rathai manushar kaa'numporuttaaka, thangka'l mukangka'lai vaadappa'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'l thangka'l palanai adainthu theernthathen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
neeyoa upavaasikkumpoathu, antha upavaasam manusharka'lukkuk kaa'nappadaamal, antharangkaththil irukki'ra un pithaavukkea kaa'nappadumpadiyaaka, un thalaikku e'n'ney poosi, un mukaththaik kazhuvu.
