appozhuthu, antharangkaththil paarkki'ra un pithaa unakku ve'liyarangkamaayp palana'lippaar.
poomiyilea ungka'lukkup pokkishangka'laich searththuvaikkavea'ndaam; ingkea poochchiyum thuruvum avaika'laik kedukkum; ingkea thirudarum kannamittuth thiruduvaarka'l.
paraloakaththilea ungka'lukkup pokkishangka'laich searththuvaiyungka'l; angkea poochchiyaavathu thuruvaavathu kedukki'rathum illai; angkea thirudar kannamittuth thiruduki'rathum illai.
ungka'l pokkisham engkeayirukki'rathoa angkea ungka'l iruthayamum irukkum.
ka'n'naanathu sareeraththin vi'lakkaayirukki'rathu; un ka'n the'livaayirunthaal, un sareeram muzhuvathum ve'lichchamaayirukkum.
un ka'n kettathaayirunthaal, un sareeram muzhuvathum iru'laayirukkum; ippadi unnilu'l'la ve'lichcham iru'laayirunthaal, avviru'l evva'lavu athikamaayirukkum!

ira'ndu ejamaanka'lukku oozhiyagn seyya oruvanaalum koodaathu; oruvanaip pakaiththu, mat'ravanaich sineakippaan; allathu oruvanaip pat'rikko'ndu, mat'ravanai asattaipa'n'nuvaan; theavanukkum ulakapporu'lukkum oozhiyagnseyya ungka'laal koodaathu.

aakaiyaal, ennaththai u'npoam, ennaththaik kudippoam en'ru ungka'l jeevanukkaakavum; ennaththai uduppoam en'ru ungka'l sareeraththukkaakavum kavalaippadaathirungka'l en'ru, ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; aakaaraththaippaarkkilum jeevanum, udaiyaippaarkkilum sareeramum viseashiththavaika'l allavaa?

aakaayaththup padchika'laik kavaniththuppaarungka'l; avaika'l vithaikki'rathumillai, a'rukki'rathumillai, ka'lagnchiyangka'lil searththuvaikki'rathumillai; avaika'laiyum ungka'l paramapithaa pizhaippoottuki'raar; avaika'laippaarkkilum neengka'l viseashiththavarka'l allavaa?
kavalaippaduki'rathinaalea ungka'lil evan than sareera a'lavoadu oru muzhaththaik koottuvaan?
udaikkaakavum neengka'l kavalaippaduki'rathenna? kaattup pushpangka'l eppadi va'laruki'rathen'ru kavaniththuppaarungka'l; avaika'l uzhaikki'rathumillai, noo'rki'rathumillai;
en'raalum, saalomoan muthalaayth than sarva makimaiyilum avaika'lil on'raippoalaakilum uduththiyirunthathillai en'ru, ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
a'rpa visuvaasika'lea! in'raikku irunthu naa'laikku aduppilea poadappadum kaattup pullukkuth theavan ivvithamaaka uduththuviththaal, ungka'lukku uduththuvippathu athika nichchayamallavaa?
aakaiyaal, ennaththai u'npoam, ennaththaik kudippoam, ennaththai uduppoam en'ru, kavalaippadaathirungka'l.
ivaika'laiyellaam agngnaanika'l naadiththeaduki'raarka'l; ivaika'lellaam ungka'lukku vea'ndiyavaika'l en'ru ungka'l paramapithaa a'rinthirukki'raar.
muthalaavathu theavanudaiya raajyaththaiyum avarudaiya neethiyaiyum theadungka'l, appozhuthu ivaika'lellaam ungka'lukkukkoodak kodukkappadum.
aakaiyaal, naa'laikkaakak kavalaippadaathirungka'l; naa'laiyaththinam thannudaiyavaika'lukkaakak kavalaippadum. anthantha naa'lukku athinathin paadu poathum.
neengka'l kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkappadaathapadikku mat'ravarka'laik kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkaathirungka'l.
eanenil, neengka'l mat'ravarka'laith theerkki'ra theerppinpadiyea neengka'lum theerkkappaduveerka'l; neengka'l mat'ravarka'lukku a'lakki'ra a'lavinpadiyea ungka'lukkum a'lakkappadum.
nee un ka'n'nilirukki'ra uththiraththai u'naraamal, un sakoatharan ka'n'nilirukki'ra thurumpaip paarkki'rathenna?
ithoa, un ka'n'nil uththiram irukkaiyil un sakoatharanai noakki: naan un ka'n'nilirukkum thurumpai eduththuppoadattum en'ru nee solvatheppadi?
maayakkaaranea! munpu un ka'n'nilirukki'ra uththiraththai eduththuppoadu; pinpu un sakoatharan ka'n'nilirukki'ra thurumpai eduththuppoada vakaipaarppaay.

parisuththamaanathai naayka'lukkuk kodaatheayungka'l; ungka'l muththukka'laip pan'rika'lmun poadaatheayungka'l; poattaal thangka'l kaalka'laal avaika'lai mithiththu, thirumpikko'ndu ungka'laip pee'rippoadum.
kea'lungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkuk kodukkappadum; theadungka'l, appozhuthu ka'ndadaiveerka'l; thattungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkuth thi'rakkappadum;
eanen'raal, keadki'ravan evanum pet'rukko'l'luki'raan; theaduki'ravan ka'ndadaiki'raan; thattuki'ravanukkuth thi'rakkappadum.
ungka'lil entha manushanaanaalum thannidaththil appaththaik keadki'ra than makanukkuk kallaik koduppaanaa?
meenaik keattaal avanukkup paampaik koduppaanaa?

aakaiyaal, pollaathavarka'laakiya neengka'l ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukku nalla eevuka'laik kodukka a'rinthirukkumpoathu, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaa thammidaththil vea'ndikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukku nanmaiyaanavaika'laik koduppathu athika nichchayam allavaa?
aathalaal, manushar ungka'lukku evaika'laichseyya virumpuki'reerka'loa, avaika'lai neengka'lum avarka'lukkuch seyyungka'l; ithuvea niyaayappiramaa'namum theerkkatharisanangka'lumaam.
idukkamaana vaasalvazhiyaay udpiraveasiyungka'l; keattukkup poaki'ra vaasal virivum, vazhi visaalamumaayirukki'rathu; athin vazhiyaayp piraveasikki'ravarka'l aneakar.
jeevanukkup poaki'ra vaasal idukkamum, vazhi nerukkamumaayirukki'rathu; athaik ka'ndupidikki'ravarka'l silar.
ka'l'lath theerkkatharisika'lukku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; avarka'l aattuththoalaip poarththukko'ndu ungka'lidaththil varuvaarka'l; u'l'laththiloa avarka'l padchikki'ra oanaayka'l.
avarka'ludaiya kanika'linaalea avarka'lai a'riveerka'l; mudchedika'lil thiraadchappazhangka'laiyum, mudpoo'nduka'lil aththippazhangka'laiyum pa'rikki'raarka'laa?
appadiyea nalla maramellaam nalla kanika'laik kodukkum; ketta maramoa ketta kanika'laik kodukkum.
nalla maram ketta kanika'laik kodukkamaattaathu; ketta maram nalla kanika'laik kodukkamaattaathu.
nalla kanikodaatha maramellaam vettu'ndu, akkiniyilea poadappadum.
aathalaal, avarka'ludaiya kanika'linaalea avarka'lai a'riveerka'l.

paraloakaththilirukki'ra en pithaavin siththaththinpadi seyki'ravanea paraloakaraajyaththil piraveasippaaneayallaamal, ennai noakki: karththaavea! karththaavea! en'ru solluki'ravan athil piraveasippathillai.

annaa'lil aneakar ennai noakki: karththaavea! karththaavea! umathu naamaththinaalea theerkkatharisanam uraiththoam allavaa? umathu naamaththinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththinoam allavaa? umathu naamaththinaalea aneaka a'rputhangka'laich seythoam allavaa? enpaarka'l.
appozhuthu, naan orukkaalum ungka'lai a'riyavillai; akkiramach seykaikkaararea, ennaivittu akan'rupoangka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch solluvean.
aakaiyaal, naan solliya intha vaarththaika'laik keattu, ivaika'linpadi seyki'ravan evanoa, avanaik kanmalaiyinmeal than veettaik kattina puththiyu'l'la manushanukku oppiduvean.
perumazhai sorinthu, peruve'l'lam vanthu, kaat'ru adiththu, antha veettinmeal moathiyum, athu vizhavillai; eanen'raal, athu kanmalaiyinmeal asthipaaram poadappattirunthathu.
naan solliya intha vaarththaika'laikkeattu, ivaika'linpadi seyyaathirukki'ravan evanoa, avan than veettai ma'nalinmeal kattina puththiyillaatha manushanukku oppidappaduvaan.
perumazhai sorinthu, peruve'l'lam vanthu, kaat'ru adiththu, antha veettinmeal moathinapoathu athu vizhunthathu; vizhunthu muzhuvathum azhinthathu en'raar.
iyeasu intha vaarththaika'laich solli mudiththapoathu, avar veathapaarakaraippoal poathiyaamal, athikaaramudaiyavaraay avarka'lukkup poathiththapadiyaal,
janangka'l avarudaiya poathakaththaikku'riththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.
avar malaiyilirunthu i'rangkinapoathu, thira'laana janangka'l avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
appozhuthu kushdaroaki oruvan vanthu avaraip pa'ninthu: aa'ndavarea! umakkuch siththamaanaal, ennaich suththamaakka ummaal aakum en'raan.
iyeasu thamathu kaiyai neetti avanaith thottu: enakkuch siththamu'ndu, suththamaaku en'raar. udanea kushdaroakam neengki avan suththamaanaan.

iyeasu avanai noakki: ithai nee oruvarukkum sollaathapadi echcharikkaiyaayiru; aayinum, avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka nee poay aasaariyanukku unnaik kaa'npiththu, moasea katta'laiyitta kaa'nikkaiyaich seluththu en'raar.
iyeasu kapparnakoomil piraveasiththapoathu, noot'rukku athipathi oruvan avaridaththil vanthu:
aa'ndavarea! en vealaikkaaran veettilea thimirvaathamaayk kidanthu kodiya veathanaippaduki'raan en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: naan vanthu avanaich sosthamaakkuvean en'raar.
noot'rukku athipathi pirathiyuththaramaaka: aa'ndavarea! neer en veettukku'l piraveasikka naan paaththiran alla; oru vaarththaimaaththiram sollum, appozhuthu en vealaikkaaran sosthamaavaan.

naan athikaaraththukkuk keezhppattavanaayirunthum, enakkuk keezhppattirukki'ra seavakarumu'ndu; naan oruvanaip poaven'raal poaki'raan, mat'roruvanai vaaven'raal varuki'raan, en vealaikkaaranai, ithaich seyyen'raal seyki'raan en'raan.
iyeasu ithaik keattu aachchariyappattu, thamakkup pinselluki'ravarka'lai noakki: isravealarukku'l'lum naan ippadippatta visuvaasaththaik kaa'navillai en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aneakar kizhakkilum mea'rkilumirunthu vanthu, paraloakaraajyaththil aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'loadea panthiyiruppaarka'l.
raajyaththin puththiraroa pu'rampaana iru'lilea tha'l'lappaduvaarka'l; angkea azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukkumen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pinpu iyeasu noot'rukku athipathiyai noakki: nee poakalaam, nee visuvaasiththapadiyea unakku aakakkadavathu en'raar. antha naazhikaiyilea avan vealaikkaaran sosthamaanaan.
iyeasu peathuruvin veettilea vanthu, avan maami juramaayk kidakki'rathaik ka'ndaar.
avar ava'l kaiyaith thottavudanea juram ava'laivittu neengkit'ru; ava'l ezhunthirunthu, avarka'lukkup pa'nividai seythaa'l.
asthamanamaanapoathu, pisaasu pidiththiruntha aneakarai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avar antha aavika'laith thamathu vaarththaiyinaalea thuraththi, pi'niyaa'lika'lellaaraiyum sosthamaakkinaar.
avar thaamea nammudaiya pelaveenangka'lai eat'rukko'ndu, nammudaiya noayka'laich sumanthaar en'ru, easaayaa theerkkatharisiyinaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.
pinpu, thira'laana janangka'l thammaich soozhnthirukki'rathai iyeasu ka'ndu, akkaraikkup poakak katta'laiyittaar.
appozhuthu, veathapaarakan oruvan vanthu: poathakarea! neer engkea poanaalum ummaip pinpat'ri varuvean en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: narika'lukkuk kuzhika'lum aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkuk kooduka'lum u'ndu; manushakumaaranukkoa thalaisaaykka idamillai en'raar.
avarudaiya seesharka'lil vea'roruvan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea! munpu naan poay, en thakappanai adakkampa'n'na enakku uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: mariththoar thangka'l mariththoarai adakkampa'n'nattum, nee ennaip pinpat'ri vaa en'raar.
avar padavil ea'rinapoathu avarudaiya seesharka'l avarukkup pinsen'ru ea'rinaarka'l.
appozhuthu padavu alaika'linaal moodappadaththakkathaayk kadalil perungkaat'ru u'ndaayit'ru. avaroa niththiraiyaayirunthaar.
appozhuthu, avarudaiya seesharka'l vanthu, avarai ezhuppi: aa'ndavarea! engka'lai iradchiyum, madinthupoaki'roam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: a'rpavisuvaasika'lea! ean payappaduki'reerka'l en'ru solli; ezhunthu, kaat'raiyum kadalaiyum athattinaar. udanea, mikuntha amaithal u'ndaayit'ru.
antha manusharka'l aachchariyappattu: ivar eppadippattavaroa, kaat'rum kadalum ivarukkuk keezhppadiki'rathea en'raarka'l.

avar akkaraiyilea kerkeseanar naattil vanthapoathu, pisaasu pidiththiruntha ira'ndupear pireathakkalla'raika'lilirunthu pu'rappattu, avarukku ethiraaka vanthaarka'l; avarka'l mikavum kodiyaraayirunthapadiyaal, antha vazhiyaaka oruvanum nadakkakkoodaathirunthathu.
avarka'l avarai noakki: iyeasuvea, theavanudaiya kumaaranea, engka'lukkum umakkum enna? kaalam varumunnea engka'lai veathanaippaduththa ingkea vantheeroa en'ru kooppittaarka'l.
avarka'lukkuk kognchathooraththil aneakam pan'rika'l koottamaaka meaynthuko'ndirunthana.
appozhuthu, pisaasuka'l: neer engka'laith thuraththuveeraanaal, naangka'l anthap pan'rikkoottaththil poakumpadi uththaravu kodum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndana.
atha'rku avar: poangka'l en'raar. avaika'l pu'rappattu, pan'rikkoottaththil poayina; appozhuthu, pan'rikkoottamellaam uyarntha meattilirunthu kadalilea paaynthu, jalaththil maa'ndupoayina.
avaika'lai meayththavarka'l oadi, patta'naththil sen'ru, inthach sangkathika'l ellaavat'raiyum, pisaasu pidiththirunthavarka'lukkuch sampaviththavaika'laiyum a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu, anthap patta'naththaar yaavarum iyeasuvukku ethirko'nduvanthu, avaraik ka'ndu, thangka'l ellaika'laivittup poakumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu, avar padavil ea'ri, ikkaraippattuth thammudaiya patta'naththi'rku vanthaar.

angkea padukkaiyilea kidantha oru thimirvaathakkaaranai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l. iyeasu avarka'ludaiya visuvaasaththaik ka'ndu, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki: makanea, thidanko'l, un paavangka'l unakku mannikkappattathu en'raar.
appozhuthu, veathapaarakaril silar: ivan theavathoosha'nam solluki'raan en'ru thangka'l u'l'laththil sollikko'ndaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'l ninaivuka'lai a'rinthu: neengka'l ungka'l iruthayangka'lil pollaathavaika'laich sinthikki'rathenna?
un paavangka'l mannikkappattathu en'ru solvathoa, ezhunthu nadaven'ru solvathoa, ethu e'lithu?

poomiyilea paavangka'lai mannikka manushakumaaranukku athikaaram u'ndenpathai neengka'l a'riyavea'ndum en'ru solli, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki: nee ezhunthu, un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, un veettukkup poa en'raar.
udanea avan ezhunthu, than veettukkup poanaan.
janangka'l athaikka'ndu aachchariyappattu, manusharukku ippadippatta athikaaraththaik koduththavaraakiya theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.
iyeasu avvidam vittup pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, aayaththu'raiyil udkaarnthiruntha maththeayu ennum oru manushanaik ka'ndu: enakkup pinsen'ruvaa en'raar; avan ezhunthu, avarukkup pinsen'raan.
pinpu avar veettilea poajanapanthiyirukkaiyil, aneaka aayakkaararum paavika'lum vanthu, iyeasuvoadum avar seesharoadungkoodap panthiyirunthaarka'l.
pariseayar athaik ka'ndu, avarudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: ungka'l poathakar aayakkaararoadum paavika'loadum poajanampa'n'nuki'rathennaven'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu athaik keattu: pi'niyaa'lika'lukku vaiththiyan vea'ndiyatheayallaamal sukamu'l'lavarka'lukku vea'ndiyathillai.
paliyaiyalla, irakkaththaiyea virumpuki'rean enpathin karuththu innathen'ru poayk kat'rukko'l'lungka'l; neethimaanka'laiyalla, paavika'laiyea mananthirumpuki'ratha'rku azhaikka vanthean en'raar.
appozhuthu, yoavaanudaiya seeshar avaridaththil vanthu: naangka'lum pariseayarum aneakantharam upavaasikki'roamea; ummudaiya seeshar upavaasiyaamalirukki'rathennaven'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: ma'navaa'lan thangka'loadirukkaiyil ma'navaa'lanudaiya thoazhar thuyarappaduvaarka'laa? ma'navaa'lan avarka'lai vittu edupadum naadka'l varum, appozhuthu upavaasippaarka'l.
oruvanum koadiththu'ndaip pazhaiya vasthiraththoadea i'naikkamaattaan; i'naiththaal, athinoadea i'naiththa thu'ndu vasthiraththai athikamaayk kizhikkum, pee'ralum athikamaakum.

puthu thiraadcharasaththaip pazhanthuruththika'lil vaarththuvaikki'rathum illai; vaarththuvaiththaal, thuruththika'l kizhinthupoam, irasamum sinthippoam, thuruththika'lum kettuppoam; puthu rasaththaip puthu thuruththika'lil vaarththuvaippaarka'l, appozhuthu ira'ndum paththirappattirukkum en'raar.

avar ivaika'lai avarka'lukkuch sollikko'ndirukkaiyil, thalaivan oruvan vanthu avaraip pa'ninthu: en maka'l ippozhuthuthaan mariththuppoanaa'l; aakilum, neer vanthu ava'lmeal umathu kaiyai vaiyum, appozhuthu pizhaippaa'l en'raan.
iyeasu ezhunthu, thammudaiya seesharoadukooda avan pinnea poanaar.
appozhuthu, pannira'ndu varushamaayp perumpaadu'l'la oru sthiree:
naan avarudaiya vasthiraththaiyaakilum thottaal sosthamaavean en'ru than u'l'laththil e'n'nikko'ndu, avar pinnaalea vanthu, avarudaiya vasthiraththin oaraththaith thottaa'l.
iyeasu thirumpi, ava'laip paarththu: maka'lea, thidanko'l, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu en'raar. annearammuthal antha sthiree sosthamaanaa'l.
iyeasuvaanavar thalaivanudaiya veettilea vanthu, thaarai oothuki'ravarka'laiyum, iraiki'ra janangka'laiyum ka'ndu:
vilakungka'l, inthach si'ru pe'n marikkavillai, niththiraiyaayirukki'raa'l en'raar. atha'rkaaka avaraippaarththu nakaiththaarka'l.
janangka'l ve'liyea thuraththappatta pinpu, avar u'l'lea piraveasiththu, anthach si'rupe'n'nin kaiyaip pidiththaar; udanea ava'l ezhunthirunthaa'l.
inthach sangkathi aththeasamengkum pirasiththamaayit'ru.
iyeasu avvidam vittup poakaiyil, ira'ndu kurudar avar pinnea sen'ru: thaaveethin kumaaranea, engka'lukku irangkum en'ru kooppittaarka'l.

avar veetti'rku vanthapinpu, anthak kurudar avaridaththil vanthaarka'l. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ithaich seyya enakku vallamai u'nden'ru visuvaasikki'reerka'laa en'ru keattaar; atha'rku avarka'l: aam visuvaasikki'roam, aa'ndavarea! en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lai avar thottu: ungka'l visuvaasaththinpadi ungka'lukku aakakkadavathu en'raar.
udanea avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l thi'rakkappattathu. ithai oruvarum a'riyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l en'ru iyeasu avarka'lukkuk ka'ndippaayk katta'laiyittaar.
avarka'loa pu'rappattu, aththeasamengkum avarudaiya keerththiyaip pirasiththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avarka'l pu'rappattup poakaiyil, pisaasupidiththa oomaiyaana oru manushanai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
pisaasu thuraththappatta pinpu oomaiyan peasinaan. janangka'l aachchariyappattu: isravealil ippadi orukkaalum kaa'nappadavillai en'raarka'l.
pariseayaroa: ivan pisaasuka'lin thalaivanaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'raan en'raarka'l.

pinpu, iyeasu sakala patta'nangka'laiyum kiraamangka'laiyum sut'ri nadanthu, jepa aalayangka'lil upatheasiththu, raajyaththin suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu, janangka'lukku u'ndaayiruntha sakala viyaathika'laiyum sakala noayka'laiyum neekki, avarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.
avar thira'laana janangka'laik ka'ndapozhuthu, avarka'l meayppanillaatha aaduka'laippoalath thoynthupoanavarka'lum sitha'rappattavarka'lumaay irunthapadiyaal, avarka'lmeal manathuruki,
thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: a'ruppu mikuthi, vealaiyaadka'loa kogncham;
aathalaal, a'ruppukku ejamaan thamathu a'ruppukku vealaiyaadka'lai anuppumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu, avar thammudaiya pannira'ndu seesharka'laiyum thammidaththil varavazhaiththu, asuththa aavika'laith thuraththavum, sakala viyaathika'laiyum sakala noayka'laiyum neekkavum avarka'lukku athikaarangkoduththaar.
anthap pannira'ndu appoasthalarudaiya naamangka'laavana: munthinavan peathuru ennappatta seemoan, avan sakoatharan anthireayaa, sepetheayuvin kumaaran yaakkoapu, avan sakoatharan yoavaan,
pilippu, pa'rtholomeayu, thoamaa, aayakkaaranaakiya maththeayu, alpeayuvin kumaaran yaakkoapu, thatheayu ennum ma'runaamamu'l'la lepeayu,
kaanaaniyanaakiya seemoan, avaraik kaattikkoduththa yoothaaskaariyoaththu enpavaika'lea.
inthap panniruvaraiyum iyeasu anuppukaiyil, avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittuch sonnathu ennaven'raal: neengka'l pu'rajaathiyaar naaduka'lukkup poakaamalum, samaariyar patta'nangka'lil piraveasiyaamalum,
kaa'naama'rpoana aaduka'laakiya israveal veettaaridaththi'rkup poangka'l.
poakaiyil, paraloakaraajyam sameepiththirukki'rathu en'ru pirasangkiyungka'l.

viyaathiyu'l'lavarka'laich sosthamaakkungka'l, kushdaroakika'laich suththampa'n'nungka'l, mariththoarai ezhuppungka'l, pisaasuka'laith thuraththungka'l; ilavasamaayp pet'reerka'l, ilavasamaayk kodungka'l.
ungka'l kachchaika'lil ponnaiyaavathu ve'l'liyaiyaavathu sempaiyaavathu,
vazhikkaakap paiyaiyaavathu, ira'ndu angkika'laiyaavathu, paatharadchaika'laiyaavathu, thadiyaiyaavathu theadi vaikkavea'ndaam; vealaiyaa'l than aakaaraththukkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan.
enthap patta'naththilaavathu kiraamaththilaavathu neengka'l piraveasikkumpoathu, athilea paaththiramaanavan yaaren'ru visaariththu, neengka'l pu'rappaduma'lavum avanidaththil thangkiyirungka'l.
oru veettukku'l piraveasikkumpoathu athai vaazhththungka'l.
antha veedu paaththiramaayirunthaal, neengka'l koo'rina samaathaanam avarka'lmeal varakkadavathu; apaaththiramaayirunthaal, neengka'l koo'rina samaathaanam ungka'lidaththi'rkuth thirumpakkadavathu.

evanaakilum ungka'lai eat'rukko'l'laamalum, ungka'l vaarththaika'laik kea'laamalumpoanaal, antha veettaiyaavathu patta'naththaiyaavathu vittup pu'rappadumpoathu, ungka'l kaalka'lil padintha thoosiyai utha'rippoadungka'l.
niyaayaththeerppu naa'lilea anthap patta'naththi'rku neariduvathaippaarkkilum soathoam komoaraa naatti'rku neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aaduka'lai oanaayka'lukku'l'lea anuppuki'rathupoala, ithoa, naan ungka'lai anuppuki'rean; aakaiyaal, sarppangka'laippoala vinaavu'l'lavarka'lum pu'raakka'laippoalak kapadat'ravarka'lumaay irungka'l.
manusharaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; avarka'l ungka'lai aaloasanaich sangkangka'lukku oppukkoduththu, thangka'l jepa aalayangka'lil ungka'lai vaarinaal adippaarka'l.
avarka'lukkum pu'rajaathiyaarukkum saadchiyaaka ennimiththam athipathika'lukku munpaakavum, raajaakka'lukku munpaakavum ko'ndupoakappaduveerka'l.
avarka'l ungka'lai oppukkodukkumpoathu: eppadip peasuvoam en'rum, ennaththaip peasuvoam en'rum kavalaippadaathirungka'l; neengka'l peasavea'nduvathu annearaththil ungka'lukku aru'lappadum.
peasuki'ravarka'l neengka'l alla, ungka'l pithaavin aaviyaanavarea ungka'lilirunthu peasuki'ravar.
sakoatharan than sakoatharanaiyum, thakappan than pi'l'laiyaiyum, mara'naththukku oppukkoduppaarka'l; pet'raarukku viroathamaakap pi'l'laika'l ezhumpi avarka'laik kolaiseyvaarka'l.
en naamaththinimiththam neengka'l ellaaraalum pakaikkappaduveerka'l; mudivupariyantham nilaiththiruppavanea iradchikkappaduvaan.

oru patta'naththil ungka'laith thunpappaduththinaal ma'ru patta'naththi'rku oadippoangka'l; manushakumaaran varuvatha'rku'l'laaka neengka'l isravealarudaiya patta'nangka'laiyellaam sut'rimudiyaathen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
seeshan than poathakanilum, vealaikkaaran than ejamaanilum mea'rpattavanalla.

seeshan than poathakanaippoalavum, vealaikkaaran than ejamaanaippoalavum iruppathu poathum. veettejamaanaiyea peyalsepool en'ru sonnaarka'laanaal, avan veettaarai appadich solvathu athika nichchayamallavaa?
avarka'lukkup payappadaathirungka'l; ve'liyaakkappadaatha ma'raiporu'lum illai; a'riyappadaatha irakasiyamum illai.
naan ungka'lukku iru'lilea solluki'rathai neengka'l ve'lichchaththilea sollungka'l; kaathilea keadki'rathai neengka'l veeduka'linmeal pirasiththampa'n'nungka'l.

aaththumaavaik kolla vallavarka'laayiraamal, sareeraththai maaththiram kolluki'ravarka'lukku neengka'l payappadavea'ndaam; aaththumaavaiyum sareeraththaiyum narakaththilea azhikka vallavarukkea payappadungka'l.
oru kaasukku ira'ndu adaikkalaan kuruvika'lai vi'rki'raarka'l allavaa? aayinum ungka'l pithaavin siththamillaamal, avaika'lil on'raakilum tharaiyilea vizhaathu.
ungka'l thalaiyilu'l'la mayirellaam e'n'nappattirukki'rathu.
aathalaal, payappadaathirungka'l; aneakam adaikkalaan kuruvika'laippaarkkilum neengka'l viseashiththavarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.
manushar munpaaka ennai a'rikkai pa'n'nuki'ravan evanoa, avanai naanum paraloakaththilirukki'ra en pithaavin munpaaka a'rikkaipa'n'nuvean.
manushar munpaaka ennai ma'ruthalikki'ravan evanoa, avanai naanum paraloakaththilirukki'ra en pithaavin munpaaka ma'ruthalippean.
poomiyinmeal samaathaanaththai anuppavanthean en'ru e'n'naathirungka'l; samaathaanaththaiyalla, pattayaththaiyea anuppavanthean.
eppadiyenil, makanukkum thakappanukkum, maka'lukkum thaaykkum, marumaka'lukkum maamikkum pirivinaiyu'ndaakka vanthean.
oru manushanukkuch saththurukka'l avan veettaarea.
thakappanaiyaavathu thaayaiyaavathu ennilum athikamaay neasikki'ravan enakkup paaththiran alla; makanaiyaavathu maka'laiyaavathu ennilum athikamaay neasikki'ravan enakkup paaththiran alla.
than siluvaiyai eduththukko'ndu ennaip pinpat'raathavan enakkup paaththiran alla.
than jeevanaik kaakki'ravan athai izhanthupoavaan; ennimiththam than jeevanai izhanthupoaki'ravan athaik kaappaan.
ungka'lai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan; ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai anuppinavarai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan.

theerkkatharisi ennum naamaththinimiththam theerkkatharisiyai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan theerkkatharisikkeat'ra palanai adaivaan; neethimaan ennum naamaththinimiththam neethimaanai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan neethimaanukkeat'ra palanai adaivaan.

seeshan ennum naamaththinimiththam inthach si'riyaril oruvanukku oru kalasam tha'n'neer maaththiram kudikkak kodukki'ravanum than palanai adaiyaama'rpoakaan en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
iyeasu thammudaiya pannira'ndu seesharka'lukkum katta'laikoduththu mudiththapinpu, avarka'ludaiya patta'nangka'lil upatheasikkavum pirasangkikkavum avvidam vittup poanaar.
aththaru'naththil kaavaliliruntha yoavaan ki'risthuvin kiriyaika'laikku'riththuk kea'lvippattu, than seesharil ira'ndu pearai azhaiththu:
varuki'ravar neerthaanaa, allathu vea'roruvar varakkaaththirukkavea'ndumaa? en'ru avaridaththil keadkumpadi anuppinaan.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l keadki'rathaiyum kaa'nki'rathaiyum yoavaanidaththil poay a'riviyungka'l;

kurudar paarvaiyadaiki'raarka'l, sappaa'nika'l nadakki'raarka'l, kushdaroakika'l suththamaaki'raarka'l, sevidar keadki'raarka'l, mariththoar ezhunthirukki'raarka'l, thariththirarukkuch suviseasham pirasangkikkappaduki'rathu.
ennidaththil ida'raladaiyaathirukki'ravan evanoa avan paakkiyavaan en'raar.
avarka'l poanapinpu, iyeasu yoavaanaikku'riththu janangka'lukkuch sonnathu ennaven'raal: ethaip paarkka vanaantharaththi'rkup poaneerka'l? kaat'rinaal asaiyum naa'nalaiyoa?
allaven'raal, ethaip paarkkappoaneerka'l? melliya vasthiranthariththa manushanaiyoa? melliya vasthiranthariththirukki'ravarka'l arasar maa'likaika'lil irukki'raarka'l.
allaven'raal, ethaip paarkkappoaneerka'l? theerkkatharisiyaiyoa? aam, theerkkatharisiyaippaarkkilum meanmaiyu'l'lavanaiyea en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
atheppadiyenil: ithoa, naan en thoothanai umakku munpaaka anuppuki'rean; avan umakku munnea poay, umathu vazhiyai aayaththampa'n'nuvaan en'ru ezhuthiya vaakkiyaththaal ku'rikkappattavan ivanthaan.

sthireeka'lidaththilea pi'ranthavarka'lil yoavaansnaananaippaarkkilum periyavan oruvanum ezhumpinathillai; aakilum, paraloakaraajyaththil si'riyavanaayirukki'ravan avanilum periyavanaayirukki'raanen'ru ungka'lukku meyyaakavea solluki'rean.
yoavaansnaanan kaalamuthal ithuvaraikkum paraloakaraajyam palavantham pa'n'nappaduki'rathu; palavanthampa'n'nuki'ravarka'l athaip pidiththukko'l'luki'raarka'l.
niyaayappiramaa'namum theerkkatharisika'l yaavarum yoavaanvaraikkum theerkkatharisanam uraiththathu'ndu.
neengka'l eat'rukko'l'la manathaayirunthaal, varuki'ravanaakiya eliyaa ivanthaan.
keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan.
inthach santhathiyai yaarukku oppiduvean? santhaive'lika'lil udkaarnthu, thangka'l thoazharaip paarththu:
ungka'lukkaakak kuzhal oothinoam, neengka'l kooththaadavillai; ungka'lukkaakap pulampinoam, neengka'l maaradikkavillai en'ru ku'raisolluki'ra pi'l'laika'lukku oppaayirukki'rathu.
eppadiyenil, yoavaan poajanapaanampa'n'naathavanaay vanthaan; atha'rku avarka'l: avan pisaasu pidiththirukki'ravan en'raarka'l.

manushakumaaran poajanapaanampa'n'nuki'ravaraay vanthaar; atha'rku avarka'l: ithoa, poajanappiriyanum mathupaanappiriyanumaana manushan, aayakkaararukkum paavika'lukkum sineakithan enki'raarka'l. aanaalum, gnaanamaanathu athan pi'l'laika'laal neethiyu'l'lathen'ru oppukko'l'lappadum en'raar.
appozhuthu, thamathu palaththa seykaika'lil, athikamaanavaika'laich seyyakka'nda patta'nangka'l mananthirumpaama'r poanapadiyinaal avaika'lai avar kadinthuko'l'lath thodangkinaar:

koaraasinea! unakku aiyoa, pethsaayithaavea! unakku aiyoa, ungka'lil seyyappatta palaththa seykaika'l theeruvilum seethoanilum seyyappattirunthathaanaal, appozhuthea irattuduththich saampalil udkaarnthu mananthirumpiyiruppaarka'l.
niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea ungka'lukku neariduvathaippaarkkilum, theeruvukkum seethoanukkum neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

vaanapariyantham uyarththappatta kapparnakoomea, nee paathaa'lapariyantham thaazhththappaduvaay; unnil seyyappatta palaththa seykaika'l soathoamilea seyyappattirunthathaanaal, athu innaa'lvaraikkum nilaiththirukkum.
niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea unakku neariduvathaippaarkkilum, soathoam naatti'rku neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

anthach samayaththilea iyeasu sonnathu: pithaavea! vaanaththukkum poomikkum aa'ndavarea! ivaika'lai gnaanika'lukkum kalvimaanka'lukkum ma'raiththu, paalakarukku ve'lippaduththinapadiyaal ummai sthoaththirikki'rean.
aam, pithaavea! ippadich seyvathu ummudaiya thiruvu'laththukkup piriyamaayirunthathu.

sakalamum en pithaavinaal enakku oppukkodukkappattirukki'rathu; pithaa thavira vea'roruvanum kumaaranai a'riyaan; kumaaranum, kumaaran evanukku avarai ve'lippaduththach siththamaayirukki'raaroa avanum thavira, vea'roruvanum pithaavai a'riyaan.
varuththappattup paaragnsumakki'ravarka'lea! neengka'l ellaarum ennidaththil vaarungka'l; naan ungka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal tharuvean.
naan saanthamum manaththaazhmaiyumaay irukki'rean; en nukaththai ungka'lmeal eat'rukko'ndu, ennidaththil kat'rukko'l'lungka'l; appozhuthu, ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal kidaikkum.
en nukam methuvaayum, en sumai ilakuvaayum irukki'rathu en'raar.
akkaalaththilea, iyeasu oayvunaa'lil payirvazhiyea poanaar; avarudaiya seesharka'l pasiyaayirunthu, kathirka'laik koythu, thinnath thodangkinaarka'l.
pariseayar athaikka'ndu, avarai noakki: ithoa, oayvunaa'lil seyyaththakaathathai ummudaiya seesharka'l seyki'raarka'lea en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: thaaveethum avanoadirunthavarka'lum pasiyaayirunthapoathu seythathai neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa?
avan theavanudaiya veettil piraveasiththu, aasaariyar thavira vea'roruvarum pusikkaththakaatha theavasamukaththu appangka'laith thaanum thannoadirunthavarka'lum pusiththaarka'lea.
an'riyum, oayvunaadka'lil aasaariyarka'l theavaalayaththil oaynthiraamal, oayvunaa'lai vealai naa'laakkinaalum, kut'ramillaathirukki'raarka'l en'ru neengka'l veathaththil vaasikkavillaiyaa?
theavaalayaththilum periyavar ingkea irukki'raar en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
paliyaiyalla irakkaththaiyea virumpuki'rean enpathin karuththu innathen'ru a'rintheerka'laanaal, kut'ramillaathavarka'lai neengka'l kut'rappaduththamaatteerka'l.
manushakumaaran oayvunaa'lukkum aa'ndavaraay irukki'raar en'raar.
avar avvidam vittuppoay, avarka'ludaiya jepa aalayaththil piraveasiththaar.
angkea soompina kaiyaiyudaiya manushan oruvan irunthaan. appozhuthu, avarmeal kut'ragnsaattumpadikku: oayvunaa'lil sosthamaakkuki'rathu niyaayamaa en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ungka'lil entha manushanukkaakilum oru aadu irunthu, athu oayvunaa'lil kuzhiyilea vizhunthaal, athaip pidiththuth thookkividamaattaanoa?
aattaippaarkkilum manushanaanavan evva'lavoa viseashiththirukki'raan! aathalaal, oayvunaa'lilea nanmaiseyvathu niyaayanthaan en'ru sonnaar.
pinpu antha manushanai noakki: un kaiyai neettu en'raar. avan neettinaan; athu ma'rukaiyaippoal sosthamaayit'ru.
appozhuthu, pariseayar ve'liyeapoay, avaraik kolaiseyyumpadi avarukku viroathamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
iyeasu athai a'rinthu, avvidam vittu vilakippoanaar. thira'laana janangka'l avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l; avarka'lellaaraiyum avar sosthamaakki,
thammaip pirasiththampa'n'naathapadi avarka'lukkuk ka'ndippaayk katta'laiyittaar.
easaayaa theerkkatharisiyaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu. avan uraiththathaavathu:
ithoa, naan therinthuko'nda ennudaiya thaasan, en aaththumaavukkup piriyamaayirukki'ra ennudaiya neasan; en aaviyai avarmeal amarappa'n'nuvean, avar pu'rajaathiyaarukku niyaayaththai a'rivippaar.
vaakkuvaatham seyyavumaattaar, kookkuralidavumaattaar; avarudaiya saththaththai oruvanum veethika'lil keadpathumillai.
avar niyaayaththi'rku jeyangkidaikkappa'n'nuki'ravaraikkum, nerinthanaa'nalai mu'rikkaamalum, mangkiyeriki'ra thiriyai a'naikkaamalum iruppaar.
avarudaiya naamaththinmeal pu'rajaathiyaar nampikkaiyaayiruppaarka'l enpathea.
appozhuthu, pisaasu pidiththa kurudum oomaiyumaana oruvan avaridaththil ko'nduvarappattaan; kurudum oomaiyumaanavan peasavung kaa'navunthakkathaaka avanaich sosthamaakkinaar.
janangka'lellaarum aachchariyappattu: thaaveethin kumaaran ivarthaanoa? en'raarka'l.
pariseayar athaikkeattu: ivan pisaasuka'lin thalaivanaakiya peyelsepoolinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'raaneayallaamal mat'rappadiyalla en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'l sinthanaika'lai a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: thanakkuththaanea viroathamaayp pirinthirukki'ra entha raajyamum paazhaayppoam; thanakkuththaanea viroathamaayp pirinthirukki'ra enthap patta'namum entha veedum nilaini'rkamaattaathu.
saaththaanaich saaththaan thuraththinaal thanakku viroathamaakath thaanea pirivinai seyki'rathaayirukkumea; appadich seythaal avan raajyam eppadi nilaini'rkum?
naan peyelsepoolinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththinaal, ungka'l pi'l'laika'l avaika'lai yaaraalea thuraththuki'raarka'l? aakaiyaal, avarka'lea ungka'lai niyaayantheerkki'ravarka'laayiruppaarka'l.
naan theavanudaiya aaviyinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'rapadiyaal, theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lidaththil vanthirukki'rathea.
an'riyum, palavaanai munthik kattinaalozhiyap palavaanudaiya veettukku'l oruvan pukunthu, avan udaimaika'lai eppadik ko'l'laiyidakkoodum? kattinaaneayaakil, avan veettaik ko'l'laiyidalaam.
ennoadea iraathavan enakku viroathiyaayirukki'raan; ennoadea searkkaathavan sitha'radikki'raan.
aathalaal, naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean: enthap paavamum enthath thoosha'namum manusharukku mannikkappadum; aaviyaanavarukku viroathamaana thoosha'namoa manusharukku mannikkappaduvathillai.

evanaakilum manushakumaaranukku viroathamaana vaarththai sonnaal athu avanukku mannikkappadum; evanaakilum parisuththa aavikku viroathamaakap peasinaal athu immaiyilum ma'rumaiyilum avanukku mannikkappaduvathillai.
maram nallathen'raal, athin kaniyum nallathen'ru sollungka'l; maram kettathen'raal, athin kaniyum kettathen'ru sollungka'l; maramaanathu athin kaniyinaal a'riyappadum.
viriyanpaampuk kuttika'lea, neengka'l pollaathavarka'laayirukka, nalamaanavaika'lai eppadip peasuveerka'l? iruthayaththin ni'raivinaal vaay peasum.
nalla manushan iruthayamaakiya nalla pokkishaththilirunthu nallavaika'lai eduththukkaattuki'raan, pollaatha manushan pollaatha pokkishaththilirunthu pollaathavaika'lai eduththukkaattuki'raan.
manushar peasum vee'naana vaarththaika'l yaavaiyum ku'riththu niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea ka'nakkoppuvikkavea'ndum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
eanenil, un vaarththaika'linaalea neethimaan en'ru theerkkappaduvaay; allathu un vaarththaika'linaalea kut'ravaa'li en'ru theerkkappaduvaay en'raar.
appozhuthu, veathapaarakarilum pariseayarilum silar avarai noakki: poathakarea, ummaal oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaa'na virumpuki'roam en'raarka'l.

avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthap pollaatha vipasaarach santhathiyaar adaiyaa'laththaith theaduki'raarka'l; aanaalum yoanaa theerkkatharisiyin adaiyaa'lameayan'ri vea'rea adaiyaa'lam ivarka'lukkuk kodukkappaduvathillai.
yoanaa iravum pakalum moon'runaa'l oru periya meenin vayit'ril irunthathu poala, manushakumaaranum iravum pakalum moon'runaa'l poomiyin iruthayaththil iruppaar.

yoanaavin pirasangkaththaik keattu ninivea patta'naththaar mananthirumpinaarka'l. ithoa, yoanaavilum periyavar ingkea irukki'raar. aathalaal niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea ninivea patta'naththaar inthach santhathiyaaroadezhunthu nin'ru ivarka'lmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaarka'l.

thentheasaththu raajasthiree poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu saalomoanudaiya gnaanaththaik keadka vanthaa'l. ithoa, saalomoanilum periyavar ingkea irukki'raar. aathalaal niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea antha raajasthiree inthach santhathiyaaroadezhunthu nin'ru ivarka'lmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaa'l.
asuththa aavi oru manushanai vittup pu'rappadumpoathu, va'ra'nda idangka'lil alainthu, i'laippaa'ruthal theadiyum ka'ndadaiyaamal:
naan vittuvantha en veettukkuth thirumpippoavean en'ru solli; angkea vanthu, antha veedu ve'rumaiyaakavum, perukki, joadikkappattathaakavum irukkakka'ndu,

thirumpippoay, thannilum pollaatha vea'ru eazhu aavika'laith thannoadea koottikko'nduvanthu, udpukunthu, angkea kudiyirukkum; appozhuthu, antha manushanudaiya munnilaimaiyilum avan pinnilaimai athika keadu'l'lathaayirukkum; appadiyea inthap pollaatha santhathiyaarukkum sampavikkum en'raar.
ippadi avar janangka'loadea peasukaiyil, avarudaiya thaayaarum sakoathararum avaridaththil peasavea'ndumen'ru ve'liyea nin'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, oruvan avarai noakki: ummudaiya thaayaarum ummudaiya sakoathararum ummoadea peasavea'ndumen'ru ve'liyea ni'rki'raarka'l en'raan.
thammidaththil ippadich sonnavanukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: en thaayaar yaar? en sakoatharar yaar? en'ru solli,
thammudaiya kaiyaith thamathu seesharka'lukku nearea neetti: ithoa, en thaayum en sakoathararum ivarka'lea!
paraloakaththilirukki'ra en pithaavin siththaththinpadi seyki'ravan evanoa, avanea enakkuch sakoatharanum sakoathariyum thaayumaay irukki'raan en'raar.
iyeasu an'raiyaththinamea veettilirunthu pu'rappattuppoay, kadaloaraththilea udkaarnthaar.
thira'laana janangka'l avaridaththil koodivanthapadiyaal, avar padavil ea'ri udkaarnthaar; janangka'lellaarum karaiyilea nin'raarka'l.
avar aneaka viseashangka'lai uvamaika'laaka avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: kea'lungka'l, vithaikki'ravan oruvan vithaikkap pu'rappattaan.
avan vithaikkaiyil, sila vithai vazhiyarukea vizhunthathu; pa'ravaika'l vanthu athaip padchiththuppoattathu.
sila vithai athika ma'n'nillaatha ka'rpaa'rai idangka'lil vizhunthathu; ma'n aazhamaayiraathathinaalea athu seekkiramaay mu'laiththathu.
veyil ea'rinapoathoa, theeynthu poay, vearillaamaiyaal ularnthu poayit'ru.
sila vithai mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vizhunthathu; mu'l va'larnthu athai nerukkippoattathu.
sila vithaiyoa nalla nilaththil vizhunthu, silathu noo'raakavum, silathu a'rupathaakavum, silathu muppathaakavum palan thanthathu.
keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'raar.
appozhuthu, seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: ean avarka'loadea uvamaika'laakap peasuki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: paraloakaraajyaththin rakasiyangka'lai a'riyumpadi ungka'lukku aru'lappattathu, avarka'lukkoa aru'lappadavillai.
u'l'lavan evanoa avanukkuk kodukkappadum, paripoora'namum adaivaan; illaathavan evanoa avanidaththil u'l'lathum eduththukko'l'lappadum.
avarka'l ka'ndum kaa'naathavarka'laayum, keattum kea'laathavarka'laayum, u'narnthuko'l'laathavarka'laayum irukki'rapadiyinaal, naan uvamaika'laaka avarka'loadea peasuki'rean.
easaayaavin theerkkatharisanam avarka'lidaththil ni'raivea'ruki'rathu; athaavathu: kaathaarakkeattum u'naraathiruppeerka'l; ka'n'naarakka'ndum a'riyaathiruppeerka'l.

intha janangka'l ka'nka'linaal kaa'naamalum, kaathuka'linaal kea'laamalum, iruthayaththinaal u'narnthu mananthirumpaamalum, naan avarka'lai aaroakkiyamaakkaamalum irukkumpadiyaaka, avarka'l iruthayam kozhuththirukki'rathu; kaathaal manthamaayk keattu, thangka'l ka'nka'lai moodikko'ndaarka'l enpathea.
ungka'l ka'nka'l kaa'nki'rathinaalum, ungka'l kaathuka'l keadki'rathinaalum, avaika'l paakkiyamu'l'lavaika'l.

aneaka theerkkatharisika'lum neethimaanka'lum neengka'l kaa'nki'ravaika'laik kaa'navum, neengka'l keadki'ravaika'laik keadkavum virumpiyum, kaa'naamalum kea'laamalum poanaarka'len'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aakaiyaal vithaikki'ravanaippat'riya uvamaiyaik kea'lungka'l.
oruvan, raajyaththin vasanaththaik keattum u'naraathirukkumpoathu, pollaangkan vanthu, avan iruthayaththil vithaikkappattathaip pa'riththukko'l'luki'raan; avanea vazhiyarukea vithaikkappattavan.
ka'rpaa'rai idangka'lil vithaikkappattavan, vasanaththaik keattu, udanea athaich santhoashaththoadea eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan;
aakilum thanakku'l'lea vearillaathavanaay, kognchakkaalamaaththiram nilaiththiruppaan; vasanaththinimiththam upaththiravamum thunpamum u'ndaanavudanea ida'raladaivaan.
mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vithaikkappattavan, vasanaththaik keadki'ravanaayirunthum, ulakakkavalaiyum aisuvariyaththin mayakkamum vasanaththai nerukkip poaduki'rathinaal, avanum palanat'rup poavaan.
nalla nilaththil vithaikkappattavanoa, vasanaththaik keadki'ravanum u'naruki'ravanumaayirunthu, noo'raakavum a'rupathaakavum muppathaakavum palan tharuvaan en'raar.
vea'roru uvamaiyai avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: paraloakaraajyam than nilaththil nalla vithaiyai vithaiththa manushanukku oppaayirukki'rathu.
manushar niththiraipa'n'nukaiyil avanudaiya saththuru vanthu, koathumaikku'l ka'laika'lai vithaiththuvittup poanaan.
payiraanathu va'larnthu kathirvitta poathu, ka'laika'lum kaa'nappattathu.
veettejamaanudaiya vealaikkaarar avanidaththil vanthu: aa'ndavanea, neer umathu nilaththil nalla vithaiyai vithaiththeer allavaa? pinnai athil ka'laika'l eppadi u'ndaanathu en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: saththuru athaich seythaan en'raan. appozhuthu vealaikkaarar: naangka'l poay avaika'laip pidungkippoada umakkuch siththamaa? en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: vea'ndaam, ka'laika'laip pidungkumpoathu neengka'l koathumaiyaiyungkooda vearoadea pidungkaathapadikku, ira'ndaiyum a'ruppumattum va'laravidungka'l.

a'ruppukkaalaththil naan a'rukki'ravarka'lai noakki: muthalaavathu, ka'laika'laippidungki, avaika'laich sutterikki'ratha'rkuk kattuka'laakak kattungka'l; koathumaiyaiyoa en ka'lagnchiyaththil searththuvaiyungka'l enpean en'ru sonnaan en'raar.
vea'roru uvamaiyai avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: paraloakaraajyam kaduku vithaikku oppaayirukki'rathu; athai oru manushan eduththuth than nilaththil vithaiththaan.
athu sakala vithaika'lilum si'rithaayirunthum, va'larumpoathu, sakala poo'nduka'lilum perithaaki, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l athin ki'laika'lil vanthu adaiyaththakka maramaakum en'raar.

vea'roru uvamaiyai avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: paraloakaraajyam pu'liththamaavukku oppaayirukki'rathu; athai oru sthiree eduththu, muzhuvathum pu'likkumvaraikkum, moon'rupadi maavilea adakkivaiththaa'l en'raar.
ivaika'laiyellaam iyeasu janangka'loadea uvamaika'laakap peasinaar; uvamaika'linaaleayan'ri, avarka'loadea peasavillai.
en vaayai uvamaika'linaal thi'rappean; ulakaththoat'ramuthal ma'raiporu'laanavaika'lai ve'lippaduththuvean en'ru theerkkatharisiyaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.

appozhuthu iyeasu janangka'lai anuppivittu veettukkuppoanaar. avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: nilaththin ka'laika'laippat'riya uvamaiyai engka'lukku ve'lippaduththavea'ndumen'ru keattaarka'l.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: nalla vithaiyai vithaikki'ravan manushakumaaran;
nilam ulakam; nalla vithai raajyaththin puththirar; ka'laika'l pollaangkanudaiya puththirar;
avaika'lai vithaikki'ra saththuru pisaasu; a'ruppu ulakaththin mudivu; a'rukki'ravarka'l theavathootharka'l.
aathalaal, ka'laika'laich searththu akkiniyaal sutterikki'rathupoala, ivvulakaththin mudivilea nadakkum.
manushakumaaran thammudaiya thootharka'lai anuppuvaar; avarka'l avarudaiya raajyaththil irukki'ra sakala ida'ralka'laiyum akkiramagn seyki'ravarka'laiyum searththu,
avarka'lai akkinich soo'laiyilea poaduvaarka'l; angkea azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukkum.
appozhuthu, neethimaanka'l thangka'l pithaavin raajyaththilea sooriyanaippoalap pirakaasippaarka'l. keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan.

an'riyum, paraloakaraajyam nilaththil puthaiththirukki'ra pokkishaththukku oppaayirukki'rathu; athai oru manushan ka'ndu, ma'raiththu, athaippat'riya santhoashaththinaalea poay, thanakku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum vit'ru, antha nilaththaik ko'l'luki'raan.
mealum, paraloakaraajyam nalla muththukka'laith theaduki'ra viyaapaarikku oppaayirukki'rathu.
avan vilaiyuyarntha oru muththaik ka'ndu, poay, thanakku'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum vit'ru, athaik ko'l'luki'raan.
an'riyum, paraloakaraajyam kadalilea poadappattu, sakalavithamaana meenka'laiyum searththu vaarikko'l'lum valaikku oppaayirukki'rathu.
athu ni'rainthapoathu, athaik karaiyil izhuththu, udkaarnthu, nallavaika'laik koodaika'lil searththu, aakaathavaika'lai e'rinthupoaduvaarka'l.
ippadiyea ulakaththin mudivilea nadakkum. theavathootharka'l pu'rappattu, neethimaanka'lin naduvilirunthu pollaathavarka'laip piriththu,
avarka'lai akkinichsoo'laiyilea poaduvaarka'l; angkea azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukkum en'raar.
pinpu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ivaika'laiyellaam a'rinthuko'ndeerka'laa en'ru keattaar. atha'rku avarka'l: aam, a'rinthuko'ndoam, aa'ndavarea, en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: ippadiyirukki'rapadiyaal, paraloakaraajyaththukkaduththavaika'lil upatheasikkappattuth thea'rina veathapaarakan evanum than pokkishaththilirunthu puthiyavaika'laiyum pazhaiyavaika'laiyum eduththukkodukki'ra veettejamaanaakiya manushanukku oppaayirukki'raan en'raar.
iyeasu intha uvamaika'laich solli mudiththapinpu, avvidam vittu,
thaam va'larntha oorilea vanthu, avarka'ludaiya jepaaalayaththilea avarka'lukku upatheasampa'n'ninaar. avarka'l aachchariyappattu: ivanukku intha gnaanamum palaththa seykaika'lum eppadi vanthathu?
ivan thachchanudaiya kumaaran allavaa? ivan thaay mariyaa'l enpava'l allavaa? yaakkoapu yoasea seemoan yoothaa enpavarka'l ivanukkuch sakoatharar allavaa?
ivan sakoatharika'lellaarum nammidaththil irukki'raarka'l allavaa? ippadiyirukka, ithellaam ivanukku eppadi vanthathu? en'ru solli,
avaraikku'riththu ida'raladainthaarka'l. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: theerkkatharisi oruvan than oorilum than veettilumeayan'ri vea'rengkum kanaveenamadaiyaan en'raar.
avarka'ludaiya avisuvaasaththinimiththam avar angkea aneaka a'rputhangka'laich seyyavillai.
akkaalaththil, kaa'rpangku theasaathipathiyaakiya earoathu iyeasuvin keerththiyaik kea'lvippattu,
than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: ivan yoavaansnaanan; ivan mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaan; aakaiyaal, ivanidaththil palaththa seykaika'l vi'langkuki'rathu en'raan.
earoathu than sakoatharanaakiya pilippuvin manaivi earoathiyaa'linimiththam yoavaanaip pidiththuk kattik kaavalil vaiththirunthaan.
eanenil: neer ava'lai vaiththukko'lvathu niyaayamallaven'ru yoavaan avanukkuch solliyirunthaan.
earoathu avanaik kolaiseyya manathaayirunthum, janangka'l avanaith theerkkatharisiyen'ru e'n'ninapadiyaal avarka'lukkup payanthirunthaan.
appadiyirukka, earoathin jenmanaa'l ko'ndaadappaduki'rapoathu, earoathiyaa'lin kumaaraththi avarka'l naduvea nadanampa'n'ni earoathaich santhoashappaduththinaa'l.
athinimiththam avan: nee ethaik keattaalum tharuvean en'ru ava'lukku aa'naiyittu vaakkukkoduththaan.
ava'l than thaayinaal eavappattapadiyea: yoavaansnaananudaiya thalaiyai ingkea oru thaalaththilea enakkuth thaarum en'ru keattaa'l.
raajaa thukkamadainthaan. aakilum, aa'naiyinimiththamum, panthiyil kooda irunthavarka'linimiththamum, athaik kodukkak katta'laiyittu,
aa'l anuppi, kaava'rkoodaththilea yoavaanaich sirachseathampa'n'nuviththaan.
avanudaiya sirasai oru thaalaththilea ko'nduvanthu, si'ru pe'n'nukkuk koduththaarka'l; ava'l athaith than thaayinidaththil ko'ndupoanaa'l.
avanudaiya seesharka'l vanthu udalai eduththu adakkampa'n'ni, pinpu poay anthach sangkathiyai iyeasuvukku a'riviththaarka'l.

iyeasu athaik keattu, avvidam vittu, padavil ea'ri, vanaantharamaana oar idaththukkuth thaniyea poanaar. janangka'l athaik kea'lvippattu, patta'nangka'lilirunthu kaalnadaiyaay avaridaththi'rkup poanaarka'l.
iyeasu vanthu, thira'laana janangka'laik ka'ndu, avarka'lmeal manathuruki, avarka'lil viyaathiyastharka'laayirunthavarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.

saayangkaalamaanapoathu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: ithu vanaantharamaana idam, nearamumaayit'ru; janangka'l kiraamangka'lukkup poayth thangka'lukkup poajanapathaarththangka'laik ko'l'lumpadi avarka'lai anuppividavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: avarka'l poakavea'nduvathillai; neengka'lea avarka'lukkup poajanangkodungka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: ingkea engka'lidaththil ainthu appamum ira'ndu meenka'lumeayallaamal, vea'ron'rum illai en'raarka'l.
avaika'lai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu, avar janangka'laip pullinmeal panthiyirukkak katta'laiyittu, antha ainthu appangka'laiyum, antha ira'ndu meenka'laiyum eduththu, vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, aaseervathiththu, appangka'laip pittuch seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar; seesharka'l janangka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l.
ellaarum saappittuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l; meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'laip pannira'ndu koodaini'raiya eduththaarka'l.
sthireeka'lum pi'l'laika'lum thavira, saappitta purusharka'l ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.
iyeasu janangka'lai anuppividukaiyil, thammudaiya seesharka'l padavil ea'ri, thamakku munnea akkaraikkup poakumpadi avarka'laith thurithappaduththinaar.
avar janangka'lai anuppivitta pinpu, thaniththu jepampa'n'na oru malaiyinmeal ea'ri, saayangkaalamaanapoathu angkea thanimaiyaayirunthaar.
atha'rku'l'laakap padavu nadukkadalilea searnthu, ethirkkaat'raayirunthapadiyaal alaika'linaal alaivupattathu.
iravin naalaam jaamaththilea, iyeasu kadalinmeal nadanthu, avarka'lidaththi'rku vanthaar.
avar kadalinmeal nadakki'rathaich seesharka'l ka'ndu, kalakkamadainthu, aaveasam en'ru solli, payaththinaal ala'rinaarka'l.
udanea iyeasu avarka'loadea peasi: thidanko'l'lungka'l, naanthaan, payappadaathirungka'l en'raar.
peathuru avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea! neereayaanaal naan jalaththinmeal nadanthu ummidaththil varak katta'laiyidum en'raan.
atha'rku avar: vaa en'raar. appozhuthu, peathuru padavai vitti'rangki, iyeasuvinidaththil poaka jalaththinmeal nadanthaan.
kaat'ru palamaayirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, payanthu, amizhnthupoakaiyil: aa'ndavarea, ennai radchiyum en'ru kooppittaan.
udanea iyeasu kaiyai neetti avanaip pidiththu: a'rpavisuvaasiyea, ean santheakappattaay en'raar.
avarka'l padavil ea'rinavudanea kaat'ru amarnthathu.
appozhuthu, padavil u'l'lavarka'l vanthu: meyyaakavea neer theavanudaiya kumaaran en'ru solli, avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu, avarka'l kadalaik kadanthu, keneasareaththu naattil searnthaarka'l.
avvidaththu manushar avarai innaar en'ru a'rinthu, sut'ruppu'ramengkum seythi anuppi, pi'niyaa'lika'lellaaraiyum avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu,
avarudaiya vasthiraththin oaraththaiyaakilum avarka'l thodumpadi uththaravaakavea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l; thotta yaavarum sosthamaanaarka'l.
appozhuthu, erusaleamilirunthu vantha veathapaarakarum pariseayarum iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu:
ummudaiya seesharka'l munnoarka'lin paarampariyaththai ean mee'ri nadakki'raarka'l? kaikazhuvaamal poajanam pa'n'nuki'raarka'lea! en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l ungka'l paarampariyaththinaalea theavanudaiya ka'rpanaiyai ean mee'ri nadakki'reerka'l?
un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka en'rum; thakappanaiyaavathu thaayaiyaavathu ninthikki'ravan kollappadavea'ndum en'rum, theavan ka'rpiththirukki'raarea.

neengka'loa, evanaakilum thakappanaiyaavathu thaayaiyaavathu noakki: unakku naan seyyaththakka uthavi ethu u'ndoa, athaik kaa'nikkaiyaakak kodukki'rean en'ru solli, than thakappanaiyaavathu than thaayaiyaavathu kanampa'n'naama'rpoanaalum, avanudaiya kadamai theernthathen'ru poathiththu,
ungka'l paarampariyaththinaalea theavanudaiya ka'rpanaiyai avamaakkivaruki'reerka'l.
maayakkaararea, ungka'laikku'riththu:
intha janangka'l thangka'l vaayinaal ennidaththil searnthu, thangka'l uthaduka'linaal ennaik kanampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'l iruthayamoa enakkuth thooramaay vilakiyirukki'rathu;
manusharudaiya ka'rpanaika'lai upatheasangka'laakap poathiththu, vee'naay enakku aaraathanai seyki'raarka'l en'ru, easaayaa theerkkatharisi nan'raaych solliyirukki'raan en'raar.
pinpu avar janangka'lai varavazhaiththu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l keattu u'narungka'l.
vaaykku'l'lea poaki'rathu manushanaith theettuppaduththaathu, vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'rathea manushanaith theettuppaduththum en'raar.
appozhuthu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: pariseayar intha vasanaththaik keattu ida'raladainthaarka'l en'ru a'riveeraa en'raarka'l.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: en paramapithaa nadaatha naat'rellaam vearoadea pidungkappadum.
avarka'lai vittuvidungka'l, avarka'l kurudarukku vazhikaattuki'ra kurudaraayirukki'raarka'l; kurudanukkuk kurudan vazhikaattinaal iruvarum kuzhiyilea vizhuvaarka'lea en'raar.
appozhuthu, peathuru avarai noakki: intha uvamaiyai engka'lukku ve'lippaduththavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: neengka'lum innum u'narvillaathavarka'laayirukki'reerka'laa?
vaaykku'l'lea poaki'rathellaam vayit'ril sen'ru aasanavazhiyaayk kazhinthupoam enpathai neengka'l innum a'riyavillaiyaa?
vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ravaika'l iruthayaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvarum; avaika'lea manushanaith theettuppaduththum.
eppadiyenil, iruthayaththilirunthu pollaatha sinthanaika'lum, kolaipaathakangka'lum, vipasaarangka'lum, veasiththanangka'lum, ka'lavuka'lum, poychsaadchika'lum, thoosha'nangka'lum pu'rappattuvarum.
ivaika'lea manushanaith theettuppaduththum; kaikazhuvaamal saappiduki'rathu manushanaith theettuppaduththaathu en'raar.
pinpu, iyeasu avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, theeru seethoan patta'nangka'lin thisaika'lukkup poanaar.

appozhuthu, anthath thisaika'lil kudiyirukki'ra kaanaaniya sthiree oruththi avaridaththil vanthu: aa'ndavarea, thaaveethin kumaaranea, enakku irangkum, en maka'l pisaasinaal kodiya veathanaippaduki'raa'l en'ru sollik kooppittaa'l.

ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka avar oru vaarththaiyum sollavillai. appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharka'l vanthu: iva'l nammaip pinthodarnthu kooppiduki'raa'lea, iva'lai anuppividum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: kaa'naama'rpoana aaduka'laakiya israveal veettaaridaththi'rku anuppappatteaneayan'ri, mat'rappadiyalla en'raar.
ava'l vanthu: aa'ndavarea, enakku uthaviseyyum en'ru avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaa'l.
avar ava'lai noakki: pi'l'laika'lin appaththai eduththu, naaykkuttika'lukkup poaduki'rathu nallathalla en'raar.
atha'rku ava'l: meythaan aa'ndavarea, aakilum naaykkuttika'l thangka'l ejamaanka'lin meajaiyilirunthu vizhum thu'nikkaika'laith thinnumea en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: sthireeyea, un visuvaasam perithu; nee virumpuki'rapadi unakku aakakkadavathu en'raar. annearamea ava'l maka'l aaroakkiyamaanaa'l.
iyeasu avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, kalileayaak kadalarukea vanthu, oru malaiyinmeal ea'ri, angkea udkaarnthaar.

appozhuthu, sappaa'nika'l, kurudar, oomaiyar, oonar muthaliya aneakarai, thira'laana janangka'l koottikko'ndu iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu, avarka'lai avar paathaththilea vaiththaarka'l; avarka'lai avar sosthappaduththinaar.

oomaiyar peasuki'rathaiyum, oonar sosthamadaiki'rathaiyum, sappaa'nika'l nadakki'rathaiyum, kurudar paarkki'rathaiyum janangka'l ka'ndu, aachchariyappattu, isravealin theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.

pinpu, iyeasu thammudaiya seesharka'lai azhaiththu: janangka'lukkaakap parithapikki'rean, ivarka'l ennidaththil moon'runaa'l thangkiyirunthu saappida on'rumillaathirukki'raarka'l; ivarka'laip pattiniyaay anuppivida enakku manathillai, vazhiyil soarnthupoavaarka'lea en'raar.
atha'rku avarudaiya seesharka'l: ivva'lavu thira'laana janangka'lukkuth thirupthiyu'ndaakumpadi vea'ndiya appangka'l intha vanaantharaththilea namakku eppadi akappadum en'raarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: ungka'lidaththil eththanai appangka'l u'ndu en'ru keattaar. avarka'l: eazhu appangka'lum sila si'ru meenka'lum u'ndu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar janangka'laith tharaiyil panthiyirukkak katta'laiyittu,
antha eazhu appangka'laiyum antha meenka'laiyum eduththu, sthoaththiram pa'n'ni, pittuth thammudaiya seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar; seesharka'l janangka'lukkup parimaa'rinaarka'l.
ellaarum saappittuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l; meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'lai eazhu koodaini'raiya eduththaarka'l.
sthireeka'lum pi'l'laika'lum thavira, saappitta purushar naalaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.
avar janangka'lai anuppivittu, padavil ea'ri, makthalaavin ellaika'lil vanthaar.
pariseayarum sathuseayarum avaraich soathikkumpadi avaridaththil vanthu: vaanaththilirunthu oar adaiyaa'laththaith thangka'lukkuk kaa'npikkavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: asthamanamaaki'rapoathu, sevvaanamittirukki'rathu, athinaal ve'livaangkum en'ru solluki'reerka'l.

uthayamaaki'rapoathu, sevvaanamum manthaaramumaayirukki'rathu, athinaal in'raikkuk kaat'rum mazhaiyum u'ndaakum en'ru solluki'reerka'l. maayakkaararea, vaanaththin thoat'raththai nithaanikka ungka'lukkuth theriyumea, kaalangka'lin adaiyaa'langka'lai nithaanikka ungka'laal koodaathaa?

inthap pollaatha vipasaara santhathiyaar adaiyaa'lam theaduki'raarka'l; yoanaa theerkkatharisiyin adaiyaa'lameayan'ri vea'rea adaiyaa'lam ivarka'lukkuk kodukkappaduvathillai en'ru solli, avarka'lai vittup pu'rappattuppoanaar.
avarudaiya seesharka'l akkarai searnthapoathu, appangka'laik ko'nduvara ma'ranthupoanaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: pariseayar sathuseayar enpavarka'lin pu'liththamaavaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l en'raar.
naam appangka'laik ko'nduvaraathapadiyaal ippadich solluki'raar en'ru avarka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea yoasanaipa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
iyeasu athai a'rinthu: a'rpavisuvaasika'lea, appangka'laik ko'nduvaraathathaikku'riththu neengka'l ungka'lukku'l'lea yoasanaipa'n'nuki'rathenna?
innum neengka'l u'naravillaiyaa? ainthu appangka'lai aiyaayirampearukkup pakirnthathaiyum, meethiyaanathai eththanai koodaini'raiya eduththeerka'l enpathaiyum;
eazhu appangka'lai naalaayirampearukkup pakirnthathaiyum, meethiyaanathai eththanai koodaini'raiya eduththeerka'l enpathaiyum neengka'l ninaivukooraamalirukki'reerka'laa?
pariseayar sathuseayar enpavarka'lin pu'liththamaavukku echcharikkaiyaayirukkavea'ndum en'ru naan sonnathu appaththaikku'riththuch sollavillai en'ru neengka'l u'naraathirukki'rathu eppadi en'raar.

appozhuthu, avar appaththin pu'liththamaavaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirukkavea'ndumen'ru sollaamal, pariseayar sathuseayar enpavarka'lin upatheasaththaikku'riththea appadich sonnaar en'ru a'rinthuko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu, iyeasu pilippuch sesariyaavin thisaika'lil vanthapoathu, thammudaiya seesharai noakki: manushakumaaranaakiya ennai janangka'l yaar en'ru solluki'raarka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: silar ummai yoavaansnaanan en'rum, silar eliyaa en'rum; vea'ru silar ereamiyaa, allathu theerkkatharisika'lil oruvar en'rum solluki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: neengka'l ennai yaar en'ru solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar.
seemoan peathuru pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthu en'raan.

iyeasu avanai noakki: yoanaavin kumaaranaakiya seemoanea, nee paakkiyavaan; maamsamum iraththamum ithai unakku ve'lippaduththavillai, paraloakaththilirukki'ra en pithaa ithai unakku ve'lippaduththinaar.
mealum, naan unakkuch solluki'rean, nee peathuruvaay irukki'raay, inthak kallinmeal en sapaiyaik kattuvean; paathaa'laththin vaasalka'l athai mea'rko'lvathillai.

paraloakaraajyaththin thi'ravukoalka'lai naan unakkuth tharuvean; pooloakaththilea nee kattuki'rathu ethuvoa athu paraloakaththilum kattappattirukkum, pooloakaththilea nee kattavizhppathu ethuvoa athu paraloakaththilum kattavizhkkappattirukkum en'raar.
appozhuthu, thaam ki'risthuvaakiya iyeasu en'ru oruvarukkum sollaathapadikkuth thammudaiya seesharka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.

athumuthal iyeasu, thaam erusaleamukkuppoay, moopparaalum pirathaana aasaariyaraalum veathapaarakaraalum pala paaduka'lpattu, kolaiyu'ndu, moon'raam naa'lil ezhunthirukkavea'ndum enpathaith thammudaiya seesharka'lukkuch sollaththodangkinaar.
appozhuthu, peathuru avaraith thaniyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay: aa'ndavarea, ithu umakku nearidakkoodaathea, ithu umakkuch sampavippathillai en'ru avaraik kadinthuko'l'lath thodangkinaan.

avaroa thirumpip peathuruvaip paarththu: enakkup pinnaakappoa, saaththaanea, nee enakku ida'ralaayirukki'raay; theavanukku eat'ravaika'laich sinthiyaamal manusharukku eat'ravaika'laich sinthikki'raay en'raar.
appozhuthu, iyeasu thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: oruvan ennaip pinpat'ri vara virumpinaal, avan thannaiththaan ve'ruththu, than siluvaiyai eduththukko'ndu ennaip pinpat'rakkadavan.
than jeevanai radchikka virumpuki'ravan athai izhanthupoavaan; ennimiththamaakath than jeevanai izhanthupoaki'ravan athaik ka'ndadaivaan.
manushan ulakam muzhuvathaiyum aathaayappaduththikko'ndaalum, than jeevanai nashdappaduththinaal avanukku laapam enna? manushan than jeevanukku eedaaka ennaththaik koduppaan?
manushakumaaran thammudaiya pithaavin makimaiporunthinavaraayth thammudaiya thootharoadungkooda varuvaar; appozhuthu, avanavan kiriyaikkuththakkathaaka avanavanukkup palana'lippaar.
ingkea ni'rki'ravarka'lil silar manushakumaaran thammudaiya raajyaththil varuvathaik kaa'numun, mara'naththai rusipaarppathillai en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
aa'runaa'laikkup pinpu, iyeasu peathuruvaiyum yaakkoapaiyum avanudaiya sakoatharanaakiya yoavaanaiyum koottikko'ndu thaniththirukkumpadi uyarntha malaiyinmeal poay,
avarka'lukku munpaaka ma'ruroopamaanaar; avar mukam sooriyanaippoalap pirakaasiththathu, avar vasthiram ve'lichchaththaippoala ve'nmaiyaayit'ru.
appozhuthu moaseayum eliyaavum avaroadea peasuki'ravarka'laaka avarka'lukkuk kaa'nappattaarka'l.

appozhuthu peathuru iyeasuvai noakki: aa'ndavarea, naam ingkea irukki'rathu nallathu; umakkuch siththamaanaal, ingkea umakku oru koodaaramum, moaseakku oru koodaaramum, eliyaavukku oru koodaaramumaaka, moon'ru koodaarangka'laip poaduvoam en'raan.

avan peasukaiyil, ithoa, o'liyu'l'la oru meakam avarka'lmeal nizhalittathu. ivar ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ivaril piriyamaayirukki'rean, ivarukkuch sevikodungka'l en'ru antha meakaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
seesharka'l athaik keattu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, mikavum payanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu, iyeasu vanthu, avarka'laith thottu: ezhunthirungka'l, payappadaatheayungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l thangka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththup paarkkaiyil iyeasuvaiththavira vea'roruvaraiyum kaa'navillai.

avarka'l malaiyilirunthu i'rangkuki'rapoathu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: manushakumaaran mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthirukkumvaraikkum inthath tharisanaththai oruvarukkum sollavea'ndaam en'ru katta'laiyittaar.
appozhuthu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avarai noakki: appadiyaanaal eliyaa munthi varavea'ndum en'ru veathapaarakar solluki'raarka'lea, atheppadi yen'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: eliyaa munthivanthu ellaavat'raiyum seerppaduththuvathu meythaan.
aanaalum, eliyaa vanthaayit'ru en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; avanai a'riyaamal thangka'l ishdappadi avanukkuch seythaarka'l; ivvithamaay manushakumaaranum avarka'laal paadupaduvaar en'raar.
avar yoavaansnaananaikku'riththuth thangka'lukkuch sonnaar en'ru seesharka'l appozhuthu a'rinthuko'ndaarka'l.
avarka'l janangka'lidaththil vanthapoathu, oru manushan avaridaththil vanthu, avar munpaaka muzhangkaalpadiyittu:
aa'ndavarea, en makanukku irangkum, avan santhiraroakiyaayk kodiya veathanaippaduki'raan; adikkadi theeyilum, adikkadi jalaththilum vizhuki'raan.
avanai ummudaiya seesharka'lidaththil ko'nduvanthean; avanaich sosthamaakka avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru en'raan.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: visuvaasamillaatha maa'rupaadu'l'la santhathiyea, ethuvaraikkum naan ungka'loadu iruppean? ethuvaraikkum ungka'lidaththil po'rumaiyaay iruppean? avanai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raar.
iyeasu pisaasai athattinaar; udanea athu avanai vittup pu'rappattathu; annearamea antha i'laignan sosthamaanaan.
appozhuthu, seesharka'l iyeasuvinidaththil thaniththuvanthu: athaith thuraththivida engka'laal ean koodaama'rpoayit'ru en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku iyeasu: ungka'l avisuvaasaththinaaleathaan; kadukuvithaiya'lavu visuvaasam ungka'lukku irunthaal neengka'l intha malaiyaip paarththu, ivvidam vittu appu'rampoa en'ru solla athu appu'ram poam; ungka'laal koodaathakaariyam on'rumiraathu en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
intha jaathip pisaasu jepaththinaalum upavaasaththinaalumeayan'ri mat'revvithaththinaalum pu'rappattuppoakaathu en'raar.
avarka'l kalileayaavilea sagncharikkumpoathu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: manushakumaaran manushar kaika'lil oppukkodukkappaduvaar.
avarka'l avaraik kolaiseyvaarka'l; aakilum moon'raam naa'lilea uyirththezhunthiruppaar en'raar. avarka'l mikuntha thukkamadainthaarka'l.
avarka'l kapparnakoomil vanthapoathu, varippa'nam vaangkuki'ravarka'l peathuruvinidaththil vanthu: ungka'l poathakar varippa'nam seluththuki'rathillaiyaa en'ru keattaarka'l; seluththuki'raar en'raan.

avan veetti'rku'l vanthapoathu, avan peasuki'ratha'rku munnamea iyeasu avanai noakki: seemoanea, unakku eppadith thoan'ruki'rathu? poomiyin raajaakka'l theervaiyaiyum variyaiyum thangka'l pi'l'laika'lidaththiloa, anniyaridaththiloa, yaaridaththil vaangkuki'raarka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rkup peathuru: anniyaridaththil vaangkuki'raarka'l en'raan. iyeasu avanai noakki: appadiyaanaal pi'l'laika'l athaich seluththavea'nduvathillaiyea.

aakilum, naam avarka'lukku ida'ralaayiraathapadikku, nee kadalukkup poay, thoo'ndilpoattu, muthalaavathu akappaduki'ra meenaip pidiththu, athin vaayaith thi'ranthupaar; oru ve'l'lippa'naththaik kaa'npaay; athai eduththu enakkaakavum unakkaakavum avarka'lidaththil kodu en'raar.
avvea'laiyilea seesharka'l iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu: paraloakaraajyaththil evan periyavanaayiruppaan en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu oru pi'l'laiyaith thammidaththil azhaiththu, athai avarka'l naduvea ni'ruththi:
neengka'l mananthirumpip pi'l'laika'laippoal aakaavittaal, paraloakaraajyaththil piraveasikkamaatteerka'l en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aakaiyaal inthap pi'l'laiyaippoalath thannaith thaazhththuki'ravan evanoa, avanea paraloakaraajyaththil periyavanaayiruppaan.
ippadippatta oru pi'l'laiyai en naamaththinimiththam eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan.

ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ra inthach si'riyaril oruvanukku ida'ral u'ndaakkuki'ravan evanoa, avanudaiya kazhuththil eanthirakkallaik katti, samuththiraththin aazhaththilea avanai amizhththuki'rathu avanukku nalamaayirukkum.
ida'ralka'linimiththam ulakaththukku aiyoa, ida'ralka'l varuvathu avasiyam, aanaalum entha manushanaal ida'ral varuki'rathoa, avanukku aiyoa!

un kaiyaavathu un kaalaavathu unakku ida'ral u'ndaakkinaal, athaith tha'riththu e'rinthupoadu; nee ira'ndu kaiyudaiyavanaay, allathu ira'ndu kaaludaiyavanaay niththiya akkiniyilea tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, sappaa'niyaay, allathu oonanaay, niththiya jeevanukku'l piraveasippathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.

un ka'n unakku ida'ral u'ndaakkinaal, athaip pidungki e'rinthupoadu; ira'ndu ka'n'nudaiyavanaay erinarakaththil tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, ot'raikka'n'nanaay jeevanukku'l piraveasippathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.

inthach si'riyaril oruvanaiyum a'rpamaay e'n'naathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; avarka'lukkuriya theavathootharka'l paraloakaththilea en paramapithaavin samukaththai eppoathum tharisikki'raarka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
manushakumaaran kettuppoanathai radchikka vanthaar.

ungka'lukku eppadith thoan'ruki'rathu? oru manushanukku noo'ru aaduka'lirukka, avaika'lil on'ru sitha'rippoanaal, avan mat'rath tho'n'noot'ronpathu aaduka'laiyum malaika'lil vittup poaych sitha'rippoanathaith theadaamaliruppaanoa?

avan athaik ka'ndupidiththaal, sitha'rippoakaatha tho'n'noot'ronpathu aaduka'laikku'riththuch santhoashappaduki'rathaippaarkkilum, athaikku'riththu athikamaaych santhoashappaduvaan en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
ivvithamaaka, inthach si'riyaril oruvanaakilum kettuppoavathu paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaavin siththamalla.

un sakoatharan unakku viroathamaakak kut'ragnseythaal, avanidaththil poay, neeyum avanum thaniththirukkaiyil, avan kut'raththai avanukku u'narththu; avan unakkuch sevikoduththaal, un sakoatharanai aathaayappaduththikko'ndaay.
avan sevikodaama'rpoanaal, ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'ludaiya vaakkinaalea sangkathika'lellaam nilaivarappadumpadi, ira'ndoruvarai unnudanea koottikko'ndu poa.
avarka'lukkum avan sevikodaama'rpoanaal, athaich sapaikkuth theriyappaduththu; sapaikkum sevikodaathiruppaanaanaal, avan unakku agngnaaniyaippoalavum aayakkaaranaippoalavum iruppaanaaka.

pooloakaththilea neengka'l evaika'laik kattuveerka'loa avaika'l paraloakaththilum kattappattirukkum; pooloakaththilea neengka'l evaika'laik kattavizhppeerka'loa avaika'l paraloakaththilum kattavizhkkappattirukkum en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

allaamalum, ungka'lil ira'ndu pear thaangka'l vea'ndikko'l'lappoaki'ra enthak kaariyaththaik ku'riththaakilum poomiyilea orumanappattirunthaal, paraloakaththil irukki'ra en pithaavinaal athu avarka'lukku u'ndaakum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
eanenil, ira'ndupearaavathu moon'rupearaavathu en naamaththinaalea engkea koodiyirukki'raarka'loa, angkea avarka'l naduvilea irukki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu, peathuru avaridaththil vanthu: aa'ndavarea, en sakoatharan enakku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseythu vanthaal, naan eththanaitharam mannikkavea'ndum? eazhutharamattumoa en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: eazhutharamaaththiram alla, eazhezhupathutharamattum en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean.
eppadiyenil, paraloakaraajyam than oozhiyakkaararidaththil ka'nakkup paarkkavea'ndumen'riruntha oru raajaavukku oppaayirukki'rathu.
avan ka'nakkuppaarkkath thodangkinapoathu, pathinaayiram thaalanthu kadan pattavan oruvanai avanukku munpaakak ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

kadanaiththeerkka avanukku nirvaakam illaathapadiyaal, avanudaiya aa'ndavan avanaiyum avan pe'njaathi pi'l'laika'laiyum, avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum vit'ru, kadanaith theerkkumpadik katta'laiyittaan.
appozhuthu, antha oozhiyakkaaran thaazha vizhunthu, va'nangki: aa'ndavanea! ennidaththil po'rumaiyaayirum, ellaavat'raiyum umakkuk koduththuth theerkki'rean en'raan.
antha oozhiyakkaaranudaiya aa'ndavan manathirangki, avanai viduthalaipa'n'ni, kadanaiyum avanukku manniththuvittaan.

appadiyirukka, antha oozhiyakkaaran pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, thannidaththil noo'ru ve'l'lippa'nam kadanpattirunthavanaakiya than udanvealaikkaararil oruvanaik ka'ndu, avanaip pidiththu, tho'ndaiyai neriththu: nee patta kadanai enakkuk koduththuth theerkkavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu avanudaiya udanvealaikkaaran avan kaalilea vizhunthu: ennidaththil po'rumaiyaayirum, ellaavat'raiyum umakkuk koduththuth theerkki'rean en'ru, avanai vea'ndikko'ndaan.
avanoa sammathiyaamal, poay, avan patta kadanaik koduththuth theerkkuma'lavum avanaik kaavalil poaduviththaan.
nadanthathai avanudaiya udanvealaikkaarar ka'ndu, mikavum thukkappattu, aa'ndavanidaththil vanthu, nadanthathaiyellaam a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu, avanudaiya aa'ndavan avanai azhaippiththu: pollaatha oozhiyakkaaranea, nee ennai vea'ndikko'ndapadiyinaal anthak kadan muzhuvathaiyum unakku manniththuvittean.
naan unakku irangkinathupoala, neeyum un udanvealaikkaaranukku irangkavea'ndaamoa en'ru solli,
avanudaiya aa'ndavan koapamadainthu, avan patta kadanaiyellaam thanakkuk koduththuth theerkkuma'lavum upaathikki'ravarka'lidaththil avanai oppukkoduththaan.
neengka'lum avanavan than than sakoatharan seytha thappithangka'lai manappoorvamaay manniyaama'rpoanaal, en paramapithaavum ungka'lukku ippadiyea seyvaar en'raar.
iyeasu intha vasanangka'laich solli mudiththapinpu, avar kalileayaavai vittu yoarthaanukku akkaraiyaana yootheayaavin ellaika'lil vanthaar.
thira'laana janangka'l avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l; avvidaththil avarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.
appozhuthu, pariseayar avaraich soathikkavea'ndumen'ru avaridaththil vanthu: purushanaanavan than manaiviyai entha mukaantharaththinaalaakilum tha'l'lividuvathu niyaayamaa en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: aathiyilea manusharai u'ndaakkinavar avarka'lai aa'num pe'n'numaaka u'ndaakkinaar enpathaiyum,

ithinimiththam purushanaanavan than thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum vittuth than manaiviyoadea isainthiruppaan; avarka'l iruvarum orea maamsamaayiruppaarka'l en'ru avar sonnathaiyum, neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa?
ippadi irukki'rapadiyinaal, avarka'l iruvaraayiraamal, orea maamsamaayirukki'raarka'l; aakaiyaal, theavan i'naiththathai manushan pirikkaathirukkakkadavan en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: appadiyaanaal, tha'l'lutha'rseettaik koduththu, ava'laith tha'l'lividalaamen'ru moasea ean katta'laiyittaar en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ungka'l manaivika'laith tha'l'lividalaamen'ru ungka'l iruthayakadinaththinimiththam moasea ungka'lukku idangkoduththaar; aathimuthalaay appadiyirukkavillai.

aathalaal, evanaakilum than manaivi veasiththanagnseythathinimiththameayan'ri, ava'laith tha'l'livittu vea'roruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ninaal, avan vipasaaragnseyki'ravanaayiruppaan; tha'l'lividappattava'lai vivaakampa'n'nuki'ravanum vipasaaragnseyki'ravanaayiruppaan en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avarudaiya seesharka'l avarai noakki: manaiviyaippat'rip purushanudaiya kaariyam ippadiyirunthaal, vivaakampa'n'nuki'rathu nallathalla en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: varampet'ravarka'lea thavira mat'ravarka'l intha vasanaththai eat'rukko'l'lamaattaarka'l.

thaayin vayit'rilirunthu a'n'nakarka'laayp pi'ranthavarka'lum u'ndu; manusharka'laal a'n'nakarka'laakkappattavarka'lum u'ndu; paraloakaraajyaththinimiththam thangka'lai a'n'nakarka'laakkikko'ndavarka'lum u'ndu; ithai eat'rukko'l'la vallavan eat'rukko'l'lakkadavan en'raar.
appozhuthu, si'ru pi'l'laika'linmeal avar kaika'lai vaiththu jepampa'n'numpadikku avarka'lai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; ko'nduvanthavarka'laich seesharka'l athattinaarka'l.
iyeasuvoa: si'ru pi'l'laika'l ennidaththil varuki'ratha'rku idangkodungka'l; avarka'laith thadaipa'n'naathirungka'l; paraloakaraajyam appadippattavarka'ludaiyathu en'ru solli,
avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, pinpu avvidamvittup pu'rappattuppoanaar.
appozhuthu oruvan vanthu, avarai noakki: nalla poathakarea, niththiyajeevanai adaivatha'rku naan entha nanmaiyaich seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avar: nee ennai nallavan en'ru solvaanean? theavan oruvar thavira nallavan oruvanum illaiyea; nee jeevanil piraveasikka virumpinaal ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l en'raar.
avan avarai noakki: evaika'lai en'ru keattaan. atha'rku iyeasu: kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka, vipasaaragn seyyaathiruppaayaaka, ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka, poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka;
un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka; unnidaththil nee anpukooruvathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka enpavaika'laiyea en'raar.
antha vaalipan avarai noakki: ivaika'laiyellaam en si'ruvayathumuthal kaikko'ndirukki'rean; innum ennidaththil ku'raivu enna en'raan.

atha'rku iyeasu: nee poora'na sa'rku'nanaayirukka virumpinaal, poay, unakku u'ndaanavaika'lai vit'ru, thariththirarukkuk kodu, appozhuthu, paraloakaththil unakkup pokkisham u'ndaayirukkum; pinpu ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar.
antha vaalipan mikuntha aasthiyu'l'lavanaayirunthapadiyaal, intha vaarththaiyaik keattapozhuthu, thukkamadainthavanaayp poayvittaan.
appozhuthu, iyeasu thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: aisuvariyavaan paraloakaraajyaththil piraveasippathu arithen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
mealum aisuvariyavaan theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathaippaarkkilum, ottakamaanathu oosiyin kaathilea nuzhaivathu e'lithaayirukkum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avarudaiya seesharka'l athaikkeattu mikavum aachchariyappattu: appadiyaanaal, yaar radchikkappadakkoodum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu, avarka'laip paarththu: manusharaal ithu koodaathathuthaan; theavanaalea ellaam koodum en'raar.
appozhuthu, peathuru avarai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l ellaavat'raiyum vittu, ummaip pinpat'rinoamea; engka'lukku enna kidaikkum en'raan.

atha'rku iyeasu: ma'rujenmakaalaththilea manushakumaaran thammudaiya makimaiyu'l'la singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkumpoathu, ennaip pinpat'rina neengka'lum, isravealin pannira'ndu koaththirangka'laiyum niyaayantheerkki'ravarka'laakap pannira'ndu singkaasanangka'linmeal veet'riruppeerka'l en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

en naamaththinimiththam veettaiyaavathu, sakoathararaiyaavathu, sakoatharika'laiyaavathu, thakappanaiyaavathu, thaayaiyaavathu, manaiviyaiyaavathu, pi'l'laika'laiyaavathu, nilangka'laiyaavathu vittavan evanoa, avan noo'raththanaiyaay adainthu, niththiyajeevanaiyum suthanthariththukko'l'luvaan;
aakilum, munthinoar aneakar pinthinoaraayum, pinthinoar aneakar munthinoaraayum iruppaarka'l en'raar.
paraloakaraajyam veettejamaanaakiya oru manushanukku oppaayirukki'rathu; avan than thiraadchaththoattaththukku vealaiyaadka'lai amarththa athikaalaiyilea pu'rappattaan.
vealaiyaadka'ludan naa'lon'rukku oru pa'nam koolipeasi, avarka'laith than thiraadchaththoattaththukku anuppinaan.
moon'raam ma'nivea'laiyilum avan pu'rappattuppoay, kadaiththeruvilea summaa ni'rki'ra vea'ru silaraik ka'ndu:
neengka'lum thiraadchaththoattaththukkup poangka'l, niyaayamaanapadi ungka'lukkuk kooli koduppean en'raan; avarka'lum poanaarka'l.
ma'rupadiyum, aa'raam onpathaam ma'nivea'laiyilum avan poay appadiyea seythaan.
pathinoaraam ma'nivea'laiyilum avan poay, summaa ni'rki'ra vea'ru silaraikka'ndu: neengka'l pakal muzhuvathum ingkea summaa ni'rki'rathenna en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avarka'l: oruvarum engka'lukku vealaiyidavillai en'raarka'l. avan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'lum thiraadchaththoattaththukkup poangka'l, niyaayamaanapadi kooli pet'rukko'lveerka'l en'raan.

saayangkaalaththil, thiraadchaththoattaththukku ejamaan than kaariyakkaaranai noakki: nee vealaiyaadka'lai azhaiththu, pinthivanthavarka'l thodangki munthivanthavarka'lvaraikkum avarka'lukkuk koolikodu en'raan.
appozhuthu pathinoaraam ma'nivea'laiyil vealaiyamarththappattavarka'l vanthu aa'lukku ovvoru pa'nam vaangkinaarka'l.
munthi amarththappattavarka'l vanthu, thangka'lukku athika kooli kidaikkum en'ru e'n'ninaarka'l, avarka'lum aa'lukku ovvoru pa'nam vaangkinaarka'l.
vaangkikko'ndu, veettejamaanai noakki:

pinthivanthavarka'laakiya ivarka'l oru ma'ni nearamaaththiram vealaiseythaarka'l; pakalin kashdaththaiyum veyilin ush'naththaiyum sakiththa engka'lukku ivarka'laich samamaakkineerea en'ru mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.
avarka'lil oruvanukku avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: sineakithanea, naan unakku aniyaayagnseyyavillai; nee ennidaththil oru pa'naththukkuch sammathikkavillaiyaa?
unnudaiyathai nee vaangkikko'ndu poa, unakkuk koduththathupoalap pinthi vanthavanaakiya ivanukkum koduppathu ennudaiya ishdam.
ennudaiyathai en ishdappadi seyya enakku athikaaramillaiyaa? naan thayaa'lanaayirukki'rapadiyaal, nee vanka'n'nanaayirukkalaamaa en'raan.
ivvithamaaka, pinthinoar munthinoaraayum, munthinoar pinthinoaraayum iruppaarka'l; azhaikkappattavarka'l aneakar, therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'loa silar en'raar.
iyeasu erusaleamukkup poakumpoathu, vazhiyilea pannira'ndu seesharaiyum thaniyea azhaiththu:
ithoa, erusaleamukkup poaki'roam; manushakumaaran pirathaana aasaariyaridaththilum veathapaarakaridaththilum oppukkodukkappaduvaar; avarka'l avarai mara'na aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththu,
avaraip pariyaasampa'n'navum, vaarinaal adikkavum, siluvaiyil a'raiyavum pu'rajaathiyaaridaththil oppukkoduppaarka'l; aakilum moon'raam naa'lilea avar uyiroadea ezhunthiruppaar en'raar.
appozhuthu, sepetheayuvin kumaararudaiya thaay than kumaararoadukooda avaridaththil vanthu, avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu: ummidaththil oru vi'n'nappam pa'n'navea'ndum en'raa'l.

avar ava'lai noakki: unakku enna vea'ndum en'ru keattaar. atha'rku ava'l: ummudaiya raajyaththilea en kumaararaakiya ivvira'ndupearil oruvan umathu valathupaarisaththilum, oruvan umathu idathupaarisaththilum udkaarnthirukkumpadi aru'lseyyavea'ndum en'raa'l.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l keattukko'l'luki'rathu innathu en'ru ungka'lukkuth theriyavillai. naan kudikkum paaththiraththil neengka'l kudikkavum, naan pe'rum snaanaththai neengka'l pe'ravum ungka'laal koodumaa en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: koodum en'raarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: en paaththiraththil neengka'l kudippeerka'l, naan pe'rum snaanaththaiyum neengka'l pe'ruveerka'l; aanaalum, en valathupaarisaththilum en idathupaarisaththilum udkaarnthirukkumpadi en pithaavinaal evarka'lukku aayaththampa'n'nappattirukki'rathoa avarka'lukkeayallaamal, mat'roruvarukkum athai aru'luvathu en kaariyamalla en'raar.
mat'rap paththuppearum athaikkeattu, antha ira'ndu sakoathararpearilum erichchalaanaarka'l.

appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'laik kittavarachseythu: pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya athikaarika'l avarka'lai i'rumaappaay aa'luki'raarka'l en'rum, periyavarka'l avarka'lmeal kadinamaay athikaaragn seluththuki'raarka'l en'rum, neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
ungka'lukku'l'lea appadi irukkalaakaathu; ungka'lil evanaakilum periyavanaayirukka virumpinaal, avan ungka'lukkup pa'nividaikkaaranaayirukkakkadavan.
ungka'lil evanaakilum muthanmaiyaanavanaayirukka virumpinaal, avan ungka'lukku oozhiyakkaaranaayirukkakkadavan.
appadiyea, manushakumaaranum oozhiyangko'l'lumpadi varaamal, oozhiyagn seyyavum, aneakarai meedkumporu'laakath thammudaiya jeevanaik kodukkavum vanthaar en'raar.
