avarka'l erikoavilirunthu pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, thira'laana janangka'l avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
appozhuthu vazhiyarukea udkaarnthiruntha ira'ndu kurudar, iyeasu avvazhiyea varuki'raar en'ru kea'lvippattu: aa'ndavarea, thaaveethin kumaaranea, engka'lukku irangkum en'ru kooppittaarka'l.
avarka'l peasaathirukkumpadi janangka'l avarka'lai athattinaarka'l. avarka'loa: aa'ndavarea, thaaveethin kumaaranea, engka'lukku irangkum en'ru athikamaayk kooppittaarka'l.
iyeasu nin'ru, avarka'laith thammidaththil azhaiththu: naan ungka'lukku enna seyyavea'ndum en'rirukki'reerka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: aa'ndavarea, engka'l ka'nka'laith thi'rakkavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu manathuruki, avarka'l ka'nka'laith thottaar; udanea avarka'l paarvaiyadainthu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
avarka'l erusaleamukkuch sameepamaaych searnthu, olivamalaikku arukaana pethpakeayukku vanthapoathu, iyeasuvaanavar seesharil ira'ndupearai noakki:

ungka'lukku ethirea irukki'ra kiraamaththukkup poangka'l; poanavudanea, angkea oru kazhuthaiyaiyum athanoadea oru kuttiyaiyum kattiyirukkak kaa'npeerka'l; avaika'lai avizhththu ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l.
oruvan ungka'lukku eathaakilum sonnaal: ivaika'l aa'ndavarukku vea'ndumen'ru sollungka'l; udanea avaika'lai anuppividuvaan en'ru solli, avarka'lai anuppinaar.
ithoa, un raajaa saanthaku'namu'l'lavaraay, kazhuthaiyinmealum kazhuthaikkuttiyaakiya ma'riyinmealum ea'rikko'ndu, unnidaththil varuki'raar en'ru seeyoan kumaaraththikkuch sollungka'l en'ru,
theerkkatharisiyinaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ithellaam nadanthathu.
seesharka'l poay, iyeasu thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythu,
kazhuthaiyaiyum kuttiyaiyum ko'nduvanthu, avaika'lmeal thangka'l vasthirangka'laip poattu, avarai eat'rinaarka'l.
thira'laana janangka'l thangka'l vasthirangka'lai vazhiyilea viriththaarka'l; vea'ru silar marakki'laika'laith tha'riththu vazhiyilea parappinaarka'l.

munnadappaarum pinnadappaarumaakiya thira'laana janangka'l: thaaveethin kumaaranukku oasannaa! karththarin naamaththinaalea varuki'ravar sthoaththirikkappattavar, unnathaththilea oasannaa en'ru solli aarppariththaarka'l.
avar erusaleamukku'l piraveasikkaiyil, nakaraththaar yaavarum aachchariyappattu, ivar yaar? en'ru visaariththaarka'l.
atha'rku janangka'l: ivar kalileayaavilu'l'la naasareaththilirunthu vantha theerkkatharisiyaakiya iyeasu en'raarka'l.

iyeasu theavaalayaththil piraveasiththu, aalayaththilea vi'rki'ravarka'lum ko'l'luki'ravarka'lumaakiya yaavaraiyum ve'liyea thuraththi, kaasukkaararudaiya palakaika'laiyum pu'raa vi'rki'ravarka'lin aasanangka'laiyum kavizhththu:
ennudaiya veedu jepaveedu ennappadum en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; neengka'loa athaik ka'l'lar kukaiyaakkineerka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu, kurudarum sappaa'nika'lum theavaalayaththilea avaridaththi'rku vanthaarka'l, avarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.
avar seytha athisayangka'laiyum, thaaveethin kumaaranukku oasannaa! en'ru theavaalayaththilea aarpparikki'ra pi'l'laika'laiyum, pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum ka'ndu, koapamadainthu,

avarai noakki: ivarka'l solluki'rathaik keadki'reeroa en'raarka'l. atha'rku iyeasu: aam, keadki'rean. kuzhanthaika'ludaiya vaayinaalum paalakarudaiya vaayinaalum thuthi u'ndaakumpadi seytheer enpathai neengka'l orukkaalum vaasikkavillaiyaa en'raar.
avarka'lai vittu nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, peththaaniyaavukkup poay, angkea iraaththangkinaar.
kaalaiyilea avar nakaraththukkuth thirumpivarukaiyil, avarukkup pasiyu'ndaayit'ru.

appozhuthu vazhiyarukea oru aththimaraththaik ka'ndu, athanidaththi'r poay, athilea ilaika'laiyan'ri vea'ron'raiyung kaa'naamal: ini orukkaalum unnidaththil kani u'ndaakaathirukkakkadavathu en'raar; udanea aththimaram pattuppoayit'ru.
seesharka'l athaik ka'ndu: intha aththimaram eththanai seekkiramaayp pattuppoayit'ru! en'ru solli aachchariyappattaarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l santheakappadaamal visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaal, intha aththimaraththi'rkuch seythathai neengka'l seyvathumallaamal, intha malaiyaippaarththu: nee peyarnthu samuththiraththilea tha'l'lu'ndupoa en'ru sonnaalum appadiyaakum en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
mealum, neengka'l visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laay jepaththilea evaika'laik keadpeerka'loa avaika'laiyellaam pe'ruveerka'l en'raar.

avar theavaalayaththil vanthu, upatheasampa'n'nukaiyil, pirathaana aasaariyarum janaththin moopparum avaridaththil vanthu: neer entha athikaaraththinaal ivaika'laich seyki'reer? intha athikaaraththai umakkuk koduththavar yaar? en'ru keattaarka'l.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naanum ungka'lidaththil oru kaariyaththaik keadki'rean, athai enakkuch solluveerka'laanaal, naanum inna athikaaraththinaalea ivaika'laich seyki'reanen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluvean.

yoavaan koduththa snaanam theavanaal u'ndaayit'roa? manusharaal u'ndaayit'roa? yaaraal u'ndaayit'ru? en'ru keattaar. atha'rku avarka'l: theavanaal u'ndaayit'ren'ru solvoamaanaal, pinnai ean avanai visuvaasikkavillai en'ru nammaik keadpaar;
manusharaal u'ndaayit'ren'ru solvoamaanaal, janangka'lukkup payappaduki'roam, ellaarum yoavaanaith theerkkatharisiyen'ru e'n'nuki'raarka'lea en'ru, thangka'lukku'l'lea aaloasanaipa'n'ni,
iyeasuvukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: engka'lukkuth theriyaathu en'raarka'l. appozhuthu, avar: naanum inna athikaaraththinaal ivaika'laich seyki'reanen'ru ungka'lukkuch sollean en'raar.

aayinum ungka'lukku eppadith thoan'ruki'rathu? oru manushanukku ira'ndu kumaarar irunthaarka'l; mooththavanidaththil avan vanthu: makanea, nee poay in'raikku en thiraadchaththoattaththil vealaisey en'raan.
atha'rku avan: maattean en'raan; aakilum, pinpu avan manasthaapappattup poanaan.
i'laiyavanidaththilum avan vanthu, appadiyea sonnaan; atha'rku avan: poaki'rean aiyaa, en'ru solliyum, poakavillai.

ivviruvaril evan thakappanudaiya siththaththinpadi seythavan en'ru keattaar; atha'rku avarka'l: mooththavanthaan en'raarka'l. appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: aayakkaararum veasika'lum ungka'lukku munnea theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasikki'raarka'l en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

eanen'raal, yoavaan neethimaarkkamaay ungka'lidaththil vanthirunthum, neengka'l avanai visuvaasikkavillai; aayakkaararum veasika'lumoa avanai visuvaasiththaarka'l; athai neengka'l ka'ndum, avanai visuvaasikkumpadiyaakap pinpaakilum manasthaapappadavillai en'raar.

vea'roru uvamaiyaik kea'lungka'l: veettejamaanaakiya oru manushan irunthaan, avan oru thiraadchaththoattaththai u'ndaakki, athaich sut'rilum vealiyadaiththu, athil oru aalaiyai naatti, koapuraththaiyum katti, thoattakkaararukku athaik kuththakaiyaaka vittu, pu'ratheasaththukkup poayirunthaan.
kanikaalam sameepiththapoathu, athin kanika'lai vaangkikko'nduvarumpadi than oozhiyakkaararaith thoattakkaararidaththil anuppinaan.
thoattakkaarar antha oozhiyakkaararaippidiththu, oruvanai adiththu, oruvanaik kolaiseythu, oruvanaik kalle'rinthu kon'raarka'l.
pinnum avan munthinavarka'lilum athikamaana vea'rea oozhiyakkaararai anuppinaan; avarka'laiyum appadiyea seythaarka'l.
kadaisiyilea avan: en kumaaranukku agnchuvaarka'l en'ru solli, than kumaaranai avarka'lidaththil anuppinaan.
thoattakkaarar kumaaranaik ka'ndapoathu: ivan suthantharavaa'li; ivanaik kon'ru, ivan suthantharaththaik kattikko'lvoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndu;
avanaip pidiththuth thiraadchaththoattaththi'rkup pu'rampea tha'l'lik kolaiseythaarka'l.
appadiyirukka, thiraadchaththoattaththin ejamaan varumpoathu, anthath thoattakkaararai enna seyvaan en'ru keattaar.

atha'rku avarka'l: anthak kodiyaraik kodumaiyaay azhiththu, eat'rakaalangka'lil thanakkuk kanika'laik kodukkaththakka vea'rea thoattakkaararidaththil thiraadchaththoattaththaik kuththakaiyaakak koduppaan en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: veedukattuki'ravarka'l aakaathen'ru tha'l'lina kallea moolaikkuth thalaikkallaayit'ru, athu karththaraalea aayit'ru, athu nammudaiya ka'nka'lukku aachchariyamaayirukki'rathu en'ru neengka'l veathaththil orukkaalum vaasikkavillaiyaa?
aakaiyaal, theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lidaththilirunthu neekkappattu, atha'rkeat'ra kanika'laith tharuki'ra janangka'lukkuk kodukkappadum.
inthak kallinmeal vizhuki'ravan no'rungkippoavaan; ithu evanmeal vizhumoa avanai nasukkippoadum en'ru naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyarum pariseayarum avarudaiya uvamaika'laik keattu, thangka'laikku'riththuch solluki'raar en'ru a'rinthu,
avaraip pidikka vakaitheadinaarka'l; aakilum janangka'l avaraith theerkkatharisiyen'ru e'n'ninapadiyinaal avarka'lukkup payanthirunthaarka'l.
iyeasu ma'rupadiyum avarka'loadea uvamaika'laayp peasich sonnathu ennaven'raal:
paraloakaraajyam than kumaaranukkuk kaliyaa'nagnseytha oru raajaavukku oppaayirukki'rathu.
azhaikkappattavarka'laik kaliyaa'naththi'rku varachsollumpadi avan than oozhiyakkaararai anuppinaan; avarka'loa vara manathillaathirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu avan vea'ru oozhiyakkaararai azhaiththu: neengka'l poay, ithoa, en virunthai aayaththampa'n'ninean, en eruthuka'lum kozhuththa jenthukka'lum adikkappattathu, ellaam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; kaliyaa'naththi'rku vaarungka'l en'ru azhaikkappattavarka'lukkuch sollungka'len'ru anuppinaan.
azhaikkappattavarka'loa athai asattaipa'n'ni, oruvan than vayalukkum, oruvan than viyaapaaraththukkum poayvittaarka'l.
mat'ravarka'l avan oozhiyakkaararaip pidiththu, avamaanappaduththi, kolaiseythaarka'l.
raajaa athaik kea'lvippattu, koapamadainthu, than seanaika'lai anuppi, anthak kolaipaathakarai azhiththu, avarka'l patta'naththaiyum sutteriththaan.
appozhuthu, avan than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: kaliyaa'na virunthu aayaththamaayirukki'rathu, azhaikkappattavarka'loa atha'rku apaaththiraraayp poanaarka'l.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l vazhichsanthika'lilea poay, kaa'nappaduki'ra yaavaraiyum kaliyaa'naththi'rku azhaiththukko'nduvaarungka'l en'raan.
antha oozhiyakkaarar pu'rappattu, vazhika'lilea poay, thaangka'l ka'nda nallaar pollaar yaavaraiyum koottikko'ndu vanthaarka'l; kaliyaa'nasaalai virunthaa'lika'laal ni'rainthathu.
virunthaa'lika'laip paarkkumpadi raajaa u'l'lea piraveasiththapoathu, kaliyaa'na vasthiram thariththiraatha oru manushanai angkea ka'ndu:
sineakithanea, nee kaliyaa'na vasthiramillaathavanaay ingkea eppadi vanthaay en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avan peasaamalirunthaan.
appozhuthu, raajaa pa'nividaikkaararai noakki: ivanaik kaiyungkaalum kattik ko'ndupoay, azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukki'ra pu'rampaana iru'lilea poadungka'l en'raan.
anthappadiyea, azhaikkappattavarka'l aneakar, therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'loa silar en'raar.
appozhuthu, pariseayar poay, peachchilea avarai akappaduththumpadi yoasanaipa'n'ni,

thangka'l seesharaiyum earoathiyaraiyum avaridaththil anuppinaarka'l. avarka'l vanthu: poathakarea, neer saththiyamu'l'lavaren'rum, theavanudaiya maarkkaththaich saththiyamaayp poathikki'ravaren'rum, neer mukathaadcha'niyam illaathavaraakaiyaal evanaikku'riththum umakkuk kavalaiyillaiyen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.
aathalaal, umakku eppadith thoan'ruki'rathu? iraayanukku varikodukki'rathu niyaayamoa, allavoa? athai engka'lukkuch sollum en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'l thurkku'naththai a'rinthu: maayakkaararea, neengka'l ennai ean soathikki'reerka'l?
varikkaasai enakkuk kaa'npiyungka'l en'raar; avarka'l oru pa'naththai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: inthach suroopamum mealezhuththum yaarudaiyathu en'ru keattaar.
iraayanudaiyathu en'raarka'l. atha'rku avar: appadiyaanaal, iraayanudaiyathai iraayanukkum, theavanudaiyathaith theavanukkum seluththungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l athaikkeattu aachchariyappattu avarai vittup poayvittaarka'l.
uyirththezhuthal illai en'ru saathikki'ra sathuseayar an'raiyaththinam avaridaththil vanthu:
poathakarea, oruvan santhaanam illaamal i'ranthupoanaal, avanudaiya sakoatharan avan manaiviyai vivaakampa'n'ni, than sakoatharanukkuch santhaanam u'ndaakkavea'ndum en'ru moasea sonnaarea.
engka'lukku'l'lea sakoatharar eazhupear irunthaarka'l; mooththavan vivaakampa'n'ni, mariththu, santhaanamillaathathinaal than manaiviyaith than sakoatharanukku vittuvittuppoanaan.
appadiyea ira'ndaam moon'raam sakoatharanmuthal eazhaam sakoatharanvaraikkum seythaarka'l.
ellaarukkum pinpu antha sthireeyum i'ranthupoanaa'l.
aakaiyaal, uyirththezhuthalil avveazhupearil evanukku ava'l manaiviyaayiruppaa'l? avarka'l ellaarum ava'lai vivaakampa'n'niyirunthaarka'lea en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l veathavaakkiyangka'laiyum, theavanudaiya vallamaiyaiyum a'riyaamal thappaana e'n'nangko'l'luki'reerka'l.
uyirththezhuthalil ko'lvanaiyum koduppanaiyum illai; avarka'l paraloakaththilea theavathootharaippoal iruppaarka'l;

mealum mariththoar uyirththezhuthalaippat'ri: naan aapirakaamin theavanum, eesaakkin theavanum, yaakkoapin theavanumaayirukki'rean en'ru theavanaal ungka'lukku uraikkappattirukki'rathai neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa?
theavan mariththoarukkuth theavanaayiraamal, jeevanu'l'loarukkuth theavanaayirukki'raar en'raar.
janangka'l ithaik keattu, avarudaiya poathakaththaikku'riththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.
avar sathuseayarai vaayadaiththaar en'ru pariseayar kea'lvippattu, avaridaththil koodivanthaarka'l.
avarka'lil niyaayasaasthiri oruvan avaraich soathikkumpadi:
poathakarea, niyaayappiramaa'naththilea enthak ka'rpanai pirathaanamaanathu en'ru keattaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum un muzhu manathoadum anpukooruvaayaaka;
ithu muthalaam pirathaana ka'rpanai.
itha'rku oppaayirukki'ra ira'ndaam ka'rpanai ennaven'raal, unnidaththil nee anpukooruvathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka enpathea.
ivvira'ndu ka'rpanaika'lilum niyaayappiramaa'nam muzhumaiyum theerkkatharisanangka'lum adangkiyirukki'rathu en'raar.
pariseayar koodiyirukkaiyil, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki:
ki'risthuvaikku'riththu neengka'l enna ninaikki'reerka'l, avar yaarudaiya kumaaran? en'ru keattaar. avar thaaveethin kumaaran en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: appadiyaanaal, thaaveethu parisuththa aaviyinaalea avarai aa'ndavar en'ru solliyirukki'rathu eppadi?
naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'ru karththar en aa'ndavaroadea sonnaar en'ru solliyirukki'raanea.
thaaveethu avarai aa'ndavar en'ru solliyirukka, avanukku avar kumaaranaayiruppathu eppadi en'raar.
atha'rku maa'ruththaramaaka oruvanum avarukku oru vaarththaiyum sollakkoodaathirunthathu. an'rumuthal oruvanum avaridaththil kea'lvikeadkath thu'niyavillai.
pinpu iyeasu janangka'laiyum thammudaiya seesharka'laiyum noakki:
veathapaarakarum pariseayarum moaseayinudaiya aasanaththil udkaarnthirukki'raarka'l;

aakaiyaal, neengka'l kaikko'l'lumpadi avarka'l ungka'lukkuch solluki'ra yaavaiyum kaikko'ndu seyyungka'l; avarka'l seykaiyinpadiyoa seyyaathirungka'l; eanenil, avarka'l solluki'raarka'l, solliyum seyyaathirukki'raarka'l.
sumappatha'rkariya paaramaana sumaika'laikkatti manushar thoa'lka'linmeal sumaththuki'raarka'l; thaangka'loa oru viralinaalum avaika'laith thodamaattaarka'l.
thangka'l kiriyaika'laiyellaam manushar kaa'navea'ndumen'ru seyki'raarka'l; thangka'l kaappunaadaakka'lai akalamaakki, thangka'l vasthirangka'lin thongkalka'laip perithaakki,
virunthuka'lil muthanmaiyaana idangka'laiyum, jepaaalayangka'lil muthanmaiyaana aasanangka'laiyum,
santhaive'lika'lil vanthanangka'laiyum, manusharaal rapee, rapee, en'ru azhaikkappaduvathaiyum virumpuki'raarka'l.
neengka'loa rapee en'razhaikkappadaathirungka'l; ki'risthu oruvarea ungka'lukkup poathakaraayirukki'raar, neengka'l ellaarum sakoathararaayirukki'reerka'l.
poomiyilea oruvanaiyum ungka'l pithaa en'ru sollaathirungka'l; paraloakaththilirukki'ra oruvarea ungka'lukkup pithaavaayirukki'raar.
neengka'l kurukka'l en'rum azhaikkappadaathirungka'l; ki'risthu oruvarea ungka'lukkuk kuruvaayirukki'raar.
ungka'lil periyavanaayirukki'ravan ungka'lukku oozhiyakkaaranaayirukkakkadavan.
thannai uyarththuki'ravan thaazhththappaduvaan, thannaith thaazhththuki'ravan uyarththappaduvaan.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, manushar piraveasiyaathapadi paraloakaraajyaththaip poottippoaduki'reerka'l; neengka'l athil piraveasikki'rathumillai, piraveasikkap poaki'ravarka'laip piraveasikka viduki'rathumillai.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, paarvaikkaaka nee'nda jepampa'n'ni, vithavaika'lin veeduka'laip padchiththuppoaduki'reerka'l; ithinimiththam athika aakkinaiyai adaiveerka'l.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, oruvanai ungka'l maarkkaththaanaakkumpadi samuththiraththaiyum poomiyaiyum sut'riththiriki'reerka'l; avan ungka'l maarkkaththaanaanapoathu avanai ungka'lilum irattippaay narakaththin makanaakkuki'reerka'l.

kurudaraana vazhikaattika'lea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, evanaakilum theavaalayaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'ninaal athinaal on'rumillaiyen'rum, evanaakilum theavaalayaththin ponninpearil saththiyampa'n'ninaal avan kadanaa'liyen'rum solluki'reerka'l.
mathikeadarea, kurudarea! ethu mukkiyam? ponnoa, ponnaip parisuththamaakkuki'ra theavaalayamoa?

mealum, evanaakilum palipeedaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'ninaal athinaal on'rumillaiyen'rum, evanaakilum athinmeal irukki'ra kaa'nikkaiyinpearil saththiyampa'n'ninaal, avan kadanaa'liyen'rum solluki'reerka'l.
mathikeadarea, kurudarea! ethu mukkiyam? kaa'nikkaiyoa, kaa'nikkaiyaip parisuththamaakkuki'ra palipeedamoa?
aakaiyaal, palipeedaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'nuki'ravan athinpearilum athinmealu'l'la ellaavat'rinpearilum saththiyampa'n'nuki'raan.
theavaalayaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'nuki'ravan athinpearilum athil vaasamaayirukki'ravarpearilum saththiyampa'n'nuki'raan.
vaanaththinpearil saththiyampa'n'nuki'ravan theavanudaiya singkaasanaththinpearilum athil veet'rirukki'ravarpearilum saththiyampa'n'nuki'raan.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, neengka'l o'rthalaamilum venthaiyaththilum seerakaththilum thasamapaakam seluththi, niyaayappiramaa'naththil ka'rpiththirukki'ra viseashiththavaika'laakiya neethiyaiyum irakkaththaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum vittuvitteerka'l, ivaika'laiyum seyyavea'ndum, avaika'laiyum vidaathirukkavea'ndumea.
kurudaraana vazhikaattika'lea, kosuyillaathapadi vadikatti, ottakaththai vizhungkuki'ravarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, poajanapaanapaaththirangka'lin ve'lippu'raththaich suththamaakkuki'reerka'l; udpu'raththiloa avaika'l ko'l'laiyinaalum aneethaththinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
kurudanaana pariseayanea! poajanapaanapaaththirangka'lin ve'lippu'ram suththamaakumpadi avaika'lin udpu'raththai muthalaavathu suththamaakku.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, ve'l'laiyadikkappatta kalla'raika'lukku oppaayirukki'reerka'l, avaika'l pu'rampea alangkaaramaayk kaa'nappadum, u'l'leayoa mariththavarka'lin elumpuka'linaalum sakala asuththaththinaalum ni'rainthirukkum.
appadiyea neengka'lum manusharukku neethimaanka'l en'ru pu'rampea kaa'nappaduki'reerka'l; u'l'laththiloa maayaththinaalum akkiramaththinaalum ni'rainthirukki'reerka'l.
maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea! pariseayarea! ungka'lukku aiyoa, neengka'l theerkkatharisika'lin kalla'raika'laik katti, neethimaanka'lin samaathika'laich singkaariththu:
engka'l pithaakka'lin naadka'lil irunthoamaanaal, avarka'loadea naangka'l theerkkatharisika'lin iraththappazhikku udanpattirukkamaattoam enki'reerka'l.
aakaiyaal, theerkkatharisika'laik kolaiseythavarka'lukkup puththiraraayirukki'reerka'l en'ru ungka'laikku'riththu neengka'lea saadchika'laayirukki'reerka'l.
neengka'lum ungka'l pithaakka'lin akkirama a'lavai nirappungka'l.
sarppangka'lea, viriyanpaampuk kuttika'lea! narakaakkinaikku eppadith thappiththukko'lveerka'l?

aakaiyaal, ithoa, theerkkatharisika'laiyum gnaanika'laiyum veathapaarakaraiyum ungka'lidaththil anuppuki'rean; avarka'lil silaraik kon'ru siluvaika'lil a'raiveerka'l, silarai ungka'l aalayangka'lil vaarinaal adiththu, oorukku oor thunpappaduththuveerka'l;

neethimaanaakiya aapealin iraththam muthal theavaalayaththukkum palipeedaththukkum naduvea neengka'l kolaiseytha parakiyaavin kumaaranaakiya sakariyaavin iraththamvaraikkum, poomiyinmeal sinthappatta neethimaanka'lin iraththappazhiyellaam ungka'lmeal varumpadiyaaka ippadich seyveerka'l.
ivaika'lellaam inthach santhathiyinmeal varumen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

erusaleamea, erusaleamea, theerkkatharisika'laik kolaiseythu, unnidaththil anuppappattavarka'laik kalle'riki'rava'lea! koazhi than kugnchuka'laith than si'rakuka'linkeezhea koottich searththuk ko'l'lumva'n'namaaka naan eththanai tharamoa un pi'l'laika'laik koottich searththukko'l'la manathaayirunthean; ungka'lukkoa manathillaama'rpoayit'ru.
ithoa, ungka'l veedu ungka'lukkup paazhaakkividappadum.
karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea varuki'ravar sthoaththirikkappattavar en'ru neengka'l solluma'lavum, ithumuthal ennaik kaa'naathiruppeerka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
iyeasu theavaalayaththai vittup pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, avarudaiya seesharka'l theavaalayaththin kattadangka'lai avarukkuk kaa'npikka avaridaththil vanthaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ivaika'laiyellaam paarkki'reerka'lea, ivvidaththil oru kallinmeal oru kalliraathapadikku ellaam idikkappattuppoakum en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

pinpu, avar olivamalaiyinmeal udkaarnthirukkaiyil, seesharka'l avaridaththil thaniththuvanthu: ivaika'l eppozhuthu sampavikkum? ummudaiya varukaikkum, ulakaththin mudivukkum adaiyaa'lam enna? engka'lukkuch sollavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: oruvanum ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l;
eanenil, aneakar vanthu, en naamaththaith thariththukko'ndu: naanea ki'risthu en'ru solli, aneakarai vagnchippaarka'l.
yuththangka'laiyum yuththangka'lin seythika'laiyum kea'lvippaduveerka'l; kalangkaathapadi echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; ivaika'lellaam sampavikkavea'ndiyathea; aanaalum, mudivu udanea varaathu.
janaththukku viroathamaay janamum, raajyaththukku viroathamaay raajyamum ezhumpum; pagnchangka'lum, ko'l'lainoayka'lum, poomiyathirchchika'lum pala idangka'lil u'ndaakum.
ivaika'lellaam veathanaika'lukku aarampam.
appozhuthu, ungka'lai upaththiravangka'lukku oppukkoduththu, ungka'laik kolaiseyvaarka'l; en naamaththinimiththam neengka'l sakala janangka'laalum pakaikkappaduveerka'l.
appozhuthu, aneakar ida'raladainthu, oruvaraiyoruvar kaattikkoduththu, oruvaraiyoruvar pakaippaarka'l.
aneakang ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'lum ezhumpi, aneakarai vagnchippaarka'l.
akkiramam mikuthiyaavathinaal aneakarudaiya anpu tha'ninthupoam.
mudivupariyantham nilaini'rpavanea iradchikkappaduvaan.
raajyaththinudaiya inthach suviseasham pooloakamengkumu'l'la sakala jaathika'lukkum saadchiyaakap pirasangkikkappadum, appoathu mudivu varum.
mealum, paazhaakkuki'ra aruvaruppaikku'riththuth thaaniyeal theerkkatharisi solliyirukki'raanea. vaasikki'ravan sinthikkakkadavan. neengka'l athaip parisuththa sthalaththil ni'rkak kaa'numpoathu,
yootheayaavil irukki'ravarka'l malaika'lukku oadippoakakkadavarka'l.
veettinmeal irukki'ravan than veettilea ethaiyaakilum eduppatha'rku i'rangkaathirukkakkadavan.
vayalil irukki'ravan than vasthirangka'lai eduppatha'rkuth thirumpaathirukkakkadavan.
annaadka'lilea karppavathika'lukkum paalkodukki'ravarka'lukkum aiyoa.
neengka'l oadippoavathu maarikaalaththilaavathu, oayvunaa'lilaavathu, sampaviyaathapadikku vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l.
eanenil, ulakamu'ndaanathumuthal ithuvaraikkum sampaviththiraathathum, inimealum sampaviyaathathumaana mikuntha upaththiravam appozhuthu u'ndaayirukkum.
annaadka'l ku'raikkappadaathirunthaal, oruvanaakilum thappippoavathillai; therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'linimiththamoa antha naadka'l ku'raikkappadum.
appozhuthu, ithoa, ki'risthu ingkea irukki'raar, athoa, angkea irukki'raar en'ru evanaakilum sonnaal nampaatheayungka'l.

eanenil, ka'l'lakki'risthukka'lum ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'lum ezhumpi, koodumaanaal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'laiyum vagnchikkaththakkathaakap periya adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum seyvaarka'l.
ithoa, munnathaaka ungka'lukku a'riviththirukki'rean.
aakaiyaal: athoa, vanaantharaththil irukki'raar en'ru solvaarka'laanaal, pu'rappadaathirungka'l; ithoa, a'raiveetti'rku'l irukki'raar en'ru solvaarka'laanaal nampaathirungka'l.
minnal kizhakkilirunthu thoan'ri mea'rkuvaraikkum pirakaasikki'rathupoala, manushakumaaranudaiya varukaiyum irukkum.
pi'nam engkeayoa angkea kazhukuka'l vanthu koodum.
annaadka'lin upaththiravam mudinthavudanea, sooriyan anthakaarappadum, santhiran o'liyaik kodaathirukkum, nadchaththirangka'l vaanaththilirunthu vizhum, vaanaththin saththuvangka'l asaikkappadum.

appozhuthu, manushakumaaranudaiya adaiyaa'lam vaanaththil kaa'nappadum. appozhuthu, manushakumaaran vallamaiyoadum mikuntha makimaiyoadum vaanaththin meakangka'lmeal varuki'rathaip poomiyilu'l'la sakala koaththiraththaarum ka'ndu pulampuvaarka'l.

valuvaayth thonikkum ekkaa'la saththaththoadea avar thamathu thootharka'lai anuppuvaar; avarka'l avaraal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'lai vaanaththin oru munai mutha'rko'ndu ma'rumunaimattum naalu thisaika'lilumirunthu koottich searppaarka'l.
aththimaraththinaal oru uvamaiyaik kat'rukko'l'lungka'l; athilea i'langki'lai thoan'ri, thu'lirvidumpoathu, vasanthakaalam sameepamaayit'ru en'ru a'riveerka'l.
appadiyea ivaika'laiyellaam neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, avar sameepamaay vaasalarukea vanthirukki'raar en'ru a'riyungka'l.
ivaika'lellaam sampavikkumunnea inthach santhathi ozhinthupoakaathen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
vaanamum poomiyum ozhinthupoam, en vaarththaika'loa ozhinthupoavathillai.
antha naa'laiyum antha naazhikaiyaiyum en pithaa oruvar thavira mat'roruvanum a'riyaan; paraloakaththilu'l'la thootharka'lum a'riyaarka'l.
noavaavin kaalaththil eppadi nadanthathoa, appadiyea manushakumaaran varum kaalaththilum nadakkum.
eppadiyenil, jalappira'layaththukku munnaana kaalaththilea noavaa peazhaikku'l piraveasikkum naa'lvaraikkum, janangka'l pusiththum kudiththum, pe'nko'ndum pe'nkoduththum,
jalappira'layam vanthu anaivaraiyum vaarikko'ndupoakumattum u'naraathirunthaarka'l; appadiyea manushakumaaran varungkaalaththilum nadakkum.
appozhuthu, ira'ndupear vayalil iruppaarka'l; oruvan eat'rukko'l'lappaduvaan, oruvan kaividappaduvaan.
ira'ndu sthireeka'l eanthiram araiththukko'ndiruppaarka'l; oruththi eat'rukko'l'lappaduvaa'l, oruththi kaividappaduvaa'l.
ungka'l aa'ndavar inna naazhikaiyilea varuvaaren'ru neengka'l a'riyaathirukki'rapadiyinaal vizhiththirungka'l.
thirudan inna jaamaththil varuvaanen'ru veettejamaan a'rinthirunthaal, avan vizhiththirunthu, than veettaik kannamidavottaanen'ru a'riveerka'l.
neengka'l ninaiyaatha naazhikaiyilea manushakumaaran varuvaar; aathalaal, neengka'lum aayaththamaayirungka'l.
eat'ravea'laiyilea than vealaikkaararukkup poajanangkoduththu avarka'lai visaarikkumpadi ejamaan vaiththa u'nmaiyum viveakamumu'l'la oozhiyakkaaran yaavan?
ejamaan varumpoathu appadich seyki'ravanaakak kaa'nappaduki'ra oozhiyakkaaranea paakkiyavaan.
than aasthika'l ellaavat'rinmealum avanai visaara'naikkaaranaaka vaippaanen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
antha oozhiyakkaaranoa pollaathavanaayirunthu: en aa'ndavan vara naa'l sellum en'ru than u'l'laththilea sollikko'ndu,
than udanvealaikkaararai adikkath thodangki, ve'riyaroadea pusikkavum kudikkavum thalaippattaal,
antha oozhiyakkaaran ninaiyaatha naa'lilum, a'riyaatha naazhikaiyilum, avanudaiya ejamaan vanthu,
avanaik kadinamaayth tha'ndiththu, maayakkaararoadea avanukkup pangkai niyamippaan; angkea azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukkum.
appozhuthu, paraloakaraajyam thangka'l theevattika'laip pidiththukko'ndu, ma'navaa'lanukku ethirko'ndupoakap pu'rappatta paththuk kannikaika'lukku oppaayirukkum.
avarka'lil ainthupear puththiyu'l'lavarka'lum, ainthupear puththiyillaathavarka'lumaayirunthaarka'l.
puththiyillaathavarka'l thangka'l theevattika'lai eduththukko'ndupoanaarka'l, e'n'neyaiyoa koodak ko'ndupoakavillai.
puththiyu'l'lavarka'l thangka'l theevattika'loadungkoodath thangka'l paaththirangka'lil e'n'neyaiyum ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
ma'navaa'lan varath thaamathiththapoathu, avarka'l ellaarum niththiraimayakkamadainthu thoongkivittaarka'l.
naduraaththiriyilea: ithoa, ma'navaa'lan varuki'raar, avarukku ethirko'ndupoakap pu'rappadungka'l enki'ra saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu, anthak kannikaika'l ellaarum ezhunthirunthu, thangka'l theevattika'lai aayaththappaduththinaarka'l.
puththiyillaathavarka'l puththiyu'l'lavarka'lai noakki: ungka'l e'n'neyil engka'lukkuk kognchangkodungka'l, engka'l theevattika'l a'nainthupoaki'rathea en'raarka'l.
puththiyu'l'lavarka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: appadiyalla, engka'lukkum ungka'lukkum poathaamaliraathapadi, neengka'l vi'rki'ravarka'lidaththi'r poay, ungka'lukkaaka vaangkikko'l'lungka'l en'raarka'l.
appadiyea avarka'l vaangkappoanapoathu ma'navaa'lan vanthuvittaar; aayaththamaayirunthavarka'l avaroadeakoodak kaliyaa'na veettukku'l piraveasiththaarka'l; kathavum adaikkappattathu.
pinpu, mat'rak kannikaika'lum vanthu: aa'ndavarea, aa'ndavarea, engka'lukkuth thi'rakkavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ungka'lai a'riyean en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
manushakumaaran varum naa'laiyaavathu naazhikaiyaiyaavathu neengka'l a'riyaathirukki'rapadiyaal vizhiththirungka'l.
an'riyum, paraloakaraajyam pu'raththeasaththukkup pirayaa'namaayp poaki'ra oru manushan, than oozhiyakkaararai azhaiththu, than aasthika'lai avarka'l vasamaay oppukkoduththathupoal irukki'rathu.
avanavanudaiya thi'ramaikkuththakkathaaka, oruvanidaththil ainthu thaalanthum, oruvanidaththil ira'ndu thaalanthum, oruvanidaththil oru thaalanthumaakak koduththu, udanea pirayaa'nappattup poanaan.
ainthu thaalanthai vaangkinavan poay, avaika'laikko'ndu viyaapaaram pa'n'ni, vea'ru ainthu thaalanthaich sampaathiththaan.
appadiyea ira'ndu thaalanthai vaangkinavanum, vea'ru ira'ndu thaalanthaich sampaathiththaan.
oru thaalanthai vaangkinavanoa, poay, nilaththaith thoa'ndi, than ejamaanudaiya pa'naththaip puthaiththuvaiththaan.
vekukaalamaanapinpu antha oozhiyakkaararudaiya ejamaan thirumpivanthu, avarka'lidaththil ka'nakkuk keattaan.

appozhuthu, ainthu thaalanthai vaangkinavan, vea'ru ainthu thaalanthaik ko'nduvanthu: aa'ndavanea, ainthu thaalanthai ennidaththil oppuviththeerea; avaika'laikko'ndu, ithoa, vea'ru ainthu thaalanthaich sampaathiththean en'raan.

avanudaiya ejamaan avanai noakki: nallathu, uththamamum u'nmaiyumu'l'la oozhiyakkaaranea, kognchaththilea u'nmaiyaayirunthaay, aneakaththinmeal unnai athikaariyaaka vaippean, un ejamaanudaiya santhoashaththi'rku'l piraveasi en'raan.
ira'ndu thaalanthai vaangkinavanum vanthu: aa'ndavanea, ira'ndu thaalanthai ennidaththil oppuviththeerea; avaika'laikko'ndu, ithoa, vea'ru ira'ndu thaalanthaich sampaathiththean en'raan.

avanudaiya ejamaan avanai noakki: nallathu, uththamamum u'nmaiyumu'l'la oozhiyakkaaranea, kognchaththilea u'nmaiyaayirunthaay, aneakaththinmeal unnai athikaariyaaka vaippean; un ejamaanudaiya santhoashaththi'rku'l piraveasi en'raan.
oru thaalanthai vaangkinavan vanthu: aa'ndavanea, neer vithaikkaatha idaththil a'rukki'ravarum, the'likkaatha idaththil searkki'ravarumaana kadinamu'l'la manushan en'ru a'rivean.
aakaiyaal, naan payanthu, poay, umathu thaalanthai nilaththil puthaiththu vaiththean; ithoa, ummudaiyathai vaangkikko'l'lum en'raan.

avanudaiya ejamaan pirathiyuththaramaaka: pollaathavanum soampanumaana oozhiyakkaaranea, naan vithaikkaatha idaththil a'rukki'ravanen'rum, the'likkaatha idaththil searkki'ravanen'rum a'rinthirunthaayea.
appadiyaanaal, nee en pa'naththaik kaasukkaarar vasaththil poattuvaikka vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu; appozhuthu, naan vanthu ennudaiyathai vattiyoadea vaangkikko'lveanea, en'ru solli,
avanidaththilirukki'ra thaalanthai eduththu, paththuth thaalanthu'l'lavanukkuk kodungka'l.
u'l'lavanevanoa avanukkuk kodukkappadum, paripoora'namum adaivaan; illaathavanidaththilirunthu u'l'lathum eduththukko'l'lappadum.
pirayoajanamat'ra oozhiyakkaaranaakiya ivanaip pu'rampaana iru'lilea tha'l'lippoadungka'l; angkea azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum u'ndaayirukkum en'raan.
an'riyum manushakumaaran thamathu makimaiporunthinavaraaych sakala parisuththa thootharoadungkooda varumpoathu, thamathu makimaiyu'l'la singkaasanaththinmeal veet'riruppaar.
appozhuthu, sakala janangka'lum avarukku munpaakach searkkappaduvaarka'l. meayppanaanavan semma'riyaaduka'laiyum ve'l'laaduka'laiyum vevvea'raakap pirikki'rathupoala avarka'lai avar piriththu,
semma'riyaaduka'laith thamathu valathupakkaththilum, ve'l'laaduka'laith thamathu idathupakkaththilum ni'ruththuvaar.

appozhuthu, raajaa thamathu valathu pakkaththil ni'rpavarka'laip paarththu: vaarungka'l en pithaavinaal aaseervathikkappattavarka'lea, ulakam u'ndaanathu muthal ungka'lukkaaka aayaththampa'n'nappattirukki'ra raajyaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lungka'l.
pasiyaayirunthean, enakkup poajanangkoduththeerka'l; thaakamaayirunthean, en thaakaththaith theerththeerka'l; anniyanaayirunthean, ennaich searththukko'ndeerka'l;
vasthiramillaathirunthean, enakku vasthirangkoduththeerka'l; viyaathiyaayirunthean, ennai visaarikka vantheerka'l; kaavalilirunthean, ennaip paarkkavantheerka'l enpaar.

appozhuthu, neethimaanka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aa'ndavarea, naangka'l eppozhuthu ummaip pasiyu'l'lavaraakak ka'ndu umakkup poajanangkoduththoam? eppozhuthu ummaith thaakamu'l'lavaraakakka'ndu ummudaiya thaakaththaith theerththoam?
eppozhuthu ummai anniyaraakakka'ndu ummaich searththukko'ndoam? eppozhuthu ummai vasthiramillaathavaraakak ka'ndu umakku vasthirangkoduththoam?
eppozhuthu ummai viyaathiyu'l'lavaraakavum kaavalilirukki'ravaraakavum ka'ndu, ummidaththil vanthoam enpaarka'l.

atha'rku raajaa pirathiyuththaramaaka: mikavum si'riyavaraakiya en sakoathararaana ivarka'lil oruvanukku neengka'l ethaich seytheerka'loa, athai enakkea seytheerka'l en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean enpaar.

appozhuthu, idathupakkaththil ni'rpavarka'laip paarththu avar: sapikkappattavarka'lea, ennaivittu, pisaasukkaakavum avan thootharka'lukkaakavum aayaththampa'n'nappattirukki'ra niththiya akkiniyilea poangka'l.
pasiyaayirunthean, neengka'l enakkup poajanangkodukkavillai; thaakamaayirunthean, neengka'l en thaakaththaith theerkkavillai;

anniyanaayirunthean, neengka'l ennaich searththukko'l'lavillai; vasthiramillaathirunthean, neengka'l enakku vasthirangkodukkavillai; viyaathiyu'l'lavanaayum kaavaliladaikkappattavanaayum irunthean, neengka'l ennai visaarikka varavillaiyenpaar.

appozhuthu, avarka'lum avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aa'ndavarea, ummaip pasiyu'l'lavaraakavum, thaakamu'l'lavaraakavum, anniyaraakavum, vasthiramillaathavaraakavum, viyaathippattavaraakavum, kaavaliladaikkappattavaraakavum naangka'l eppozhuthu ka'ndu, umakku uthavi seyyaathirunthoam enpaarka'l.

appozhuthu avar avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: mikavum si'riyavarka'laakiya ivarka'lil oruvanukku neengka'l ethaich seyyaathiruntheerka'loa, athai enakkea seyyaathiruntheerka'l en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean enpaar.
anthappadi, ivarka'l niththiya aakkinaiyai adaiyavum, neethimaanka'loa niththiya jeevanai adaiyavum poavaarka'l en'raar.
iyeasu intha vasanangka'laiyellaam solli mudiththapinpu, avar thammudaiya seesharai noakki:
ira'ndunaa'laikkuppinpu paskaapa'ndikai varumen'ru a'riveerka'l; appozhuthu, manushakumaaran siluvaiyil a'raiyappaduvatha'rku oppukkodukkappaduvaar en'raar.
appozhuthu, pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum janaththin moopparum, kaaypaa ennappatta pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aramanaiyilea koodivanthu,
iyeasuvaith thanthiramaayp pidiththuk kolaiseyyumpadi aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
aakilum janangka'lukku'l'lea kalakamu'ndaakaathapadikkup pa'ndikaiyilea appadich seyyalaakaathu en'raarka'l.
iyeasu peththaaniyaavil kushdaroakiyaayiruntha seemoan veettil irukkaiyil,
oru sthiree vilaiyea'rappet'ra parima'lathailamu'l'la ve'l'laikkalpara'niyaik ko'nduvanthu, avar poajanapanthiyilirukkumpoathu, anthath thailaththai avar sirasinmeal oot'rinaa'l.
avarudaiya seesharka'l athaik ka'ndu visanamadainthu: intha vee'nselavu ennaththi'rku?
inthath thailaththai uyarntha vilaikku vit'ru, thariththirarukkuk kodukkalaamea en'raarka'l.
iyeasu athai a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l intha sthireeyai ean thontharavupaduththuki'reerka'l? ennidaththil na'rkiriyaiyaich seythirukki'raa'l.
thariththirar eppoathum ungka'lidaththil irukki'raarka'l; naanoa eppoathum ungka'lidaththil irean.
iva'l inthath thailaththai en sareeraththinmeal oot'rinathu ennai adakkam pa'n'nuvatha'rku eththanamaana seykaiyaayirukki'rathu.
inthach suviseasham ulakaththil engkengkea pirasangkikkappadumoa angkangkea iva'lai ninaippatha'rkaaka iva'l seythathum sollappadum en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu, panniruvaril oruvanaakiya yoothaaskaariyoaththu enpavan pirathaana aasaariyaridaththi'rkup poay:
naan avarai ungka'lukkuk kaattikkodukki'rean, neengka'l enakku enna kodukki'reerka'l en'raan. avarka'l avanukku muppathu ve'l'likkaasaik kodukka udanpattaarka'l.
athumuthal avan avaraik kaattikkoduppatha'rkuch samayam paarththukko'ndirunthaan.

pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikaiyin muthalnaa'lilea, seesharka'l iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu: paskaavaip pusippatha'rku naangka'l engkea umakku aayaththampa'n'nach siththamaayirukki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avar: neengka'l nakaraththilea innaanidaththi'rkup poay: en vea'lai sameepamaayirukki'rathu, un veettilea en seesharoadeakoodap paskaavai aasarippean en'ru poathakar solluki'raar en'ru avanukkuch sollungka'l en'raar.
iyeasu ka'rpiththapadi seesharka'l poay, paskaavai aayaththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu, panniruvaroadungkooda avar panthiyirunthaar.
avarka'l poajanampa'n'nukaiyil, avar: ungka'liloruvan ennaik kaattikkoduppaan en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu, avarka'l mikavum thukkamadainthu, avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, naanoa, naanoa? en'ru ovvoruvaraayk keadkaththodangkinaarka'l.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennoadeakoodath thaalaththil kaiyiduki'ravanea ennaik kaattikkoduppaan.

manushakumaaran thammaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea poaki'raar; aakilum, entha manushanaal manushakumaaran kaattikkodukkappaduki'raaroa, antha manushanukku aiyoa; antha manushan pi'ravaathirunthaanaanaal avanukku nalamaayirukkum en'raar.
avaraik kaattikkoduththa yoothaasum avarai noakki: rapee, naanoa? en'raan; atha'rku avar: nee sonnapadithaan en'raar.

avarka'l poajanampa'n'nukaiyil, iyeasu appaththai eduththu, aaseervathiththu, athaip pittu, seesharka'lukkuk koduththu: neengka'l vaangkip pusiyungka'l, ithu ennudaiya sareeramaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
pinpu, paaththiraththaiyum eduththu, sthoaththirampa'n'ni, avarka'lukkuk koduththu: neengka'l ellaarum ithilea paanampa'n'nungka'l;
ithu paavamannippu'ndaakumpadi aneakarukkaakach sinthappaduki'ra puthu udanpadikkaikkuriya ennudaiya iraththamaayirukki'rathu.

ithumuthal inthath thiraadchappazharasaththai navamaanathaay ungka'loadeakooda en pithaavin raajyaththilea naan paanampa'n'num naa'lvaraikkum ithaip paanam pa'n'nuvathillaiyen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avarka'l sthoaththirappaattaip paadinapinpu, olivamalaikkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.

appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: meayppanai vettuvean, manthaiyin aaduka'l sitha'radikkappadum en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, intha iraaththiriyilea neengka'l ellaarum ennimiththam ida'raladaiveerka'l.
aakilum naan uyirththezhuntha pinpu, ungka'lukku munnea kalileayaavukkup poavean en'raar.
peathuru avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: umathunimiththam ellaarum ida'raladainthaalum, naan orukkaalum ida'raladaiyean en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: intha iraaththiriyilea seaval koovuki'ratha'rku munnea, nee ennai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaay en'ru, meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
atha'rkup peathuru: naan ummoadea marikkavea'ndiyathaayirunthaalum ummai ma'ruthalikkamaattean en'raan; seesharka'l ellaarum appadiyea sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'loadea kethsemanea ennappatta idaththi'rku vanthu, seesharka'lai noakki: naan angkea poay jepampa'n'numa'lavum neengka'l ingkea udkaarnthirungka'l en'ru solli;
peathuruvaiyum sepetheayuvin kumaarar iruvaraiyum koottikko'ndupoay, thukkamadaiyavum viyaakulappadavum thodangkinaar.
appozhuthu, avar: en aaththumaa mara'naththukkeathuvaana thukkangko'ndirukki'rathu; neengka'l ingkea thangki, ennoadeakooda vizhiththirungka'l en'ru solli,

sat'ru appu'rampoay, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: en pithaavea, inthap paaththiram ennaivittu neengkakkoodumaanaal neengkumpadi seyyum; aakilum en siththaththinpadiyalla, ummudaiya siththaththinpadiyea aakakkadavathu en'ru jepampa'n'ninaar.
pinpu, avar seesharka'lidaththil vanthu, avarka'l niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndu, peathuruvai noakki: neengka'l oru ma'ni nearamaavathu ennoadeakooda vizhiththirukkakkoodaathaa?
neengka'l soathanaikkudpadaathapadikku vizhiththirunthu jepampa'n'nungka'l; aavi u'rchaakamu'l'lathuthaan, maamsamoa palaveenamu'l'lathu en'raar.

avar ma'rupadiyum ira'ndaantharam poay: en pithaavea, inthap paaththiraththil naan paanampa'n'ninaalozhiya ithu ennaivittu neengkakkoodaathaakil, ummudaiya siththaththinpadi aakakkadavathu en'ru jepampa'n'ninaar.
avar thirumpa vanthapoathu, avarka'l ma'rupadiyum niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndaar; avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l mikuntha niththiraimayakkam adainthirunthathu.
avar ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai vittuppoay, moon'raantharamum antha vaarththaika'laiyea solli jepampa'n'ninaar.
pinpu avar thammudaiya seesharka'lidaththil vanthu: ini niththiraipa'n'ni i'laippaa'rungka'l; ithoa, manushakumaaran paavika'ludaiya kaika'lil oppukkodukkappaduki'ra vea'lai vanthathu.
ennaik kaattikkodukki'ravan, ithoa, vanthuvittaan, ezhunthirungka'l, poavoam en'raar.

avar ippadip peasukaiyil, panniruvaril oruvanaakiya yoothaas vanthaan; avanoadeakoodap pirathaana aasaariyarum janaththin moopparum anuppina thira'laana janangka'l pattayangka'laiyum thadika'laiyum pidiththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
avaraik kaattikkodukki'ravan: naan evanai muththagnseyveanoa avanthaan, avanaip pidiththukko'l'lungka'l en'ru avarka'lukku adaiyaa'lam solliyirunthaan.
udanea, avan iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu: rapee, vaazhka en'ru solli, avarai muththagnseythaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: sineakithanea, ennaththi'rkaaka vanthirukki'raay en'raar. appozhuthu, avarka'l kittavanthu, iyeasuvinmeal kaipoattu, avaraip pidiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasuvoadirunthavarka'lil oruvan kai neettith than pattayaththai uruvi, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaranaik kaatha'ra vettinaan.
appozhuthu, iyeasu avanai noakki: un pattayaththaith thirumpa athin u'raiyilea poadu; pattayaththai edukki'ra yaavarum pattayaththaal madinthu poavaarka'l.
naan ippozhuthu en pithaavai vea'ndikko'ndaal, avar pannira'ndu leakiyoanukku athikamaana thootharai ennidaththil anuppamaattaaren'ru ninaikki'raayaa?
appadich seyveanaanaal, ivvithamaaych sampavikkavea'ndum enki'ra veathavaakkiyangka'l eppadi ni'raivea'rum en'raar.

antha vea'laiyilea iyeasu janangka'lai noakki: ka'l'lanaip pidikkap pu'rappaduki'rathupoala, neengka'l pattayangka'laiyum thadika'laiyum eduththukko'ndu ennaip pidikkavantheerka'l; naan thinanthoa'rum ungka'l naduvilea udkaarnthu theavaalayaththil upatheasampa'n'nikko'ndirunthean; appozhuthu, neengka'l ennaip pidikkavillaiyea.
aakilum theerkkatharisika'l ezhuthiyirukki'ra vasanangka'l ni'raivea'rumpadi ivaika'lellaam sampavikki'rathu en'raar. appozhuthu, seesharka'lellaarum avaraivittu oadippoanaarka'l.
iyeasuvaip pidiththavarka'l avaraip pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya kaaypaavinidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea veathapaarakarum moopparum koodivanthirunthaarka'l.
peathuru, thooraththilea avarukkup pinsen'ru, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aramanaivaraikkum vanthu, u'l'lea piraveasiththu, mudivaip paarkkumpadi seavakaroadea udkaarnthaan.
pirathaana aasaariyarum moopparum sangkaththaar yaavarum iyeasuvaik kolaiseyyumpadi avarukku viroathamaayp poychsaadchi theadinaarka'l;
oruvarum akappadavillai; aneakar vanthu poychsaadchi solliyum avarka'l saadchi ovvavillai; kadaisiyilea ira'ndu poychsaadchika'l vanthu:
theavanudaiya aalayaththai idiththuppoadavum, moon'runaa'laikku'l'lea athaik kattavum ennaalea aakum en'ru ivan sonnaan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, pirathaana aasaariyan ezhunthirunthu, avarai noakki: ivarka'l unakku viroathamaaych saadchisolluki'rathaikku'riththu nee on'rum solluki'rathillaiyaa en'raan.

iyeasuvoa peasaamalirunthaar. appozhuthu, pirathaana aasaariyan avarai noakki: nee theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthuthaanaa? athai engka'lukkuch sollumpadi jeevanu'l'la theavanpearil unnai aa'naiyittuk keadki'rean en'raan.

atha'rku iyeasu: neer sonnapadithaan; an'riyum, manushakumaaran sarvavallavarudaiya valathupaarisaththil veet'riruppathaiyum vaanaththin meakangka'lmeal varuvathaiyum ithumuthal kaa'npeerka'len'ru, ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyan than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: ivan theavathoosha'nam sonnaan; inich saadchika'l namakku vea'ndiyathenna? ithoa, ivan thoosha'naththai ippozhuthu keatteerka'lea.
ungka'lukku ennamaayth thoan'ruki'rathu en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avarka'l: mara'naththukkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, avarudaiya mukaththil thuppi, avaraik kuttinaarka'l; silar avaraik kannaththil a'rainthu:
ki'risthuvea, ummai adiththavan yaar? athai gnaanathirushdiyinaal engka'lukkuch sollum en'raarka'l.

aththaru'naththil peathuru ve'liyea vanthu aramanai mut'raththil udkaarnthirunthaan. appozhuthu, vealaikkaari oruththi avanidaththil vanthu: neeyum kalileayanaakiya iyeasuvoadeakooda irunthaay en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: nee solluki'rathu enakkuth theriyaathu en'ru, ellaarukkum munpaaka ma'ruthaliththaan.
avan, vaasal ma'ndapaththi'rkup poanapozhuthu vea'roruththi avanaik ka'ndu: ivanum nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvoadeakooda irunthaan en'ru angkea irunthavarka'lukkuch sonnaa'l.
avanoa: antha manushanai naan a'riyean en'ru aa'naiyittu, ma'rupadiyum ma'ruthaliththaan.
sat'runearaththukkuppinpu angkea nin'ravarka'l peathuruvinidaththil vanthu: meyyaakavea neeyum avarka'lil oruvan; un peachchu unnai ve'lippaduththuki'rathu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: antha manushanai a'riyean en'ru solli, sapikkavum saththiyampa'n'navum thodangkinaan. udanea seaval koovit'ru.
appozhuthu peathuru: seaval koovuki'ratha'rkumunnea nee ennai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaay en'ru iyeasu thannidaththil sonna vasanaththai ninaiththukko'ndu, ve'liyea poay, manangkasanthu azhuthaan.
vidiya'rkaalamaanapoathu, sakala pirathaana aasaariyarum janaththin moopparum, iyeasuvaik kolaiseyyumpadi, avarukku viroathamaaka aaloasanaipa'n'ni,
avaraik katti, ko'ndupoay, theasaathipathiyaakiya ponthiyupilaaththuvinidaththil oppukkoduththaarka'l.

appozhuthu, avaraik kaattikkoduththa yoothaas, avar mara'naakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappattathaik ka'ndu, manasthaapappattu, antha muppathu ve'l'likkaasaip pirathaana aasaariyaridaththi'rkum moopparidaththi'rkum thirumpak ko'nduvanthu:
kut'ramillaatha iraththaththai naan kaattikkoduththathinaal paavagnseythean en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: engka'lukkenna, athu unpaadu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, avan antha ve'l'likkaasaith theavaalayaththilea e'rinthuvittu, pu'rappattuppoay, naan'ruko'ndu seththaan.
pirathaana aasaariyar antha ve'l'likkaasai eduththu: ithu iraththakkirayamaanathaal, kaa'nikkaip pettiyilea ithaip poadalaakaathen'ru solli,
aaloasanaipa'n'ninapinpu, anniyarai adakkampa'n'nuvatha'rkuk kuyavanudaiya nilaththai athinaalea ko'ndaarka'l.
ithinimiththam antha nilam innaa'lvaraikkum iraththanilam ennappaduki'rathu.
israveal puththiraraal mathikkappattavarukkuk kirayamaakiya muppathu ve'l'likkaasai avarka'l eduththu,
karththar enakkuk ka'rpiththapadi kuyavanudaiya nilaththi'rkaaka athaik koduththaarka'l en'ru ereamiyaa theerkkatharisiyaal uraikkappattathu appozhuthu ni'raivea'rit'ru.
iyeasu theasaathipathikku munpaaka nin'raar; theasaathipathi avarai noakki: nee yootharudaiya raajaavaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku iyeasu: neer solluki'rapadithaan en'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyarum moopparum avarmeal kut'ragnsaattukaiyil, avar maa'ruththaram on'rum sollavillai.
appozhuthu, pilaaththu avarai noakki: ivarka'l unmeal eththanaiyoa kut'rangka'laich saattuki'raarka'lea, nee avaika'laik keadkavillaiyaa en'raan.
avaroa oru vaarththaiyum maa'ruththaramaakach sollavillai; athanaal theasaathipathi mikavum aachchariyappattaan.

kaavalpa'n'nappattavarka'lil evanai viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndumen'ru janangka'l keattukko'lvaarka'loa, avanai avarka'lukkaaka viduthalaiyaakkuvathu pa'ndikaithoa'rum theasaathipathikku vazhakkamaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu kaavalpa'n'nappattavarka'lil parapaas ennappatta pearpoana oruvan irunthaan.
po'raamaiyinaalea avarai oppukkoduththaarka'l en'ru pilaaththu a'rinthu,
avarka'l koodiyirukkaiyil, avarka'lai noakki: evanai naan ungka'lukku viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndumen'rirukki'reerka'l? parapaasaiyoa? ki'risthu ennappaduki'ra iyeasuvaiyoa? en'ru keattaan.

avan niyaayaasanaththil udkaarnthirukkaiyil, avanudaiya manaivi avanidaththil aa'lanuppi: neer antha neethimaanai on'rum seyyavea'ndaam; avar nimiththam in'raikkuch soppanaththil veku paadupattean en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
parapaasai vittuvidak keattukko'l'lavum, iyeasuvaik kolaiseyvikkavum pirathaana aasaariyarum moopparum janangka'lai eavivittaarka'l.
theasaathipathi janangka'lai noakki: ivviruvaril evanai naan ungka'lukku viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndum en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avarka'l: parapaasai en'raarka'l.
pilaaththu avarka'lai noakki: appadiyaanaal, ki'risthu ennappatta iyeasuvai naan ennaseyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan. avanaich siluvaiyil a'raiyavea'ndum en'ru ellaarum sonnaarka'l.
theasaathipathiyoa: ean, enna pollaappuch seythaan en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: avanaich siluvaiyil a'raiyavea'ndum en'ru athikamathikamaayk kookkuralittuch sonnaarka'l.

kalakam athikamaaki'ratheayallaamal than pirayaththanaththinaalea pirayoajanamillaiyen'ru pilaaththu ka'ndu, tha'n'neerai a'l'li, janangka'lukku munpaakak kaika'laik kazhuvi: intha neethimaanudaiya iraththappazhikku naan kut'ramat'ravan, neengka'lea paarththukko'l'lungka'l en'raan.
atha'rku janangka'lellaarum: ivanudaiya iraththappazhi engka'lmealum engka'l pi'l'laika'lmealum iruppathaaka en'ru sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu, avan parapaasai avarka'lukku viduthalaiyaakki, iyeasuvaiyoa vaarinaal adippiththu, siluvaiyil a'raiyumpadikku oppukkoduththaan.
appozhuthu, theasaathipathiyin poarchseavakar iyeasuvaith theasaathipathiyin aramanaiyilea ko'ndupoay, poarchseavakarin koottam muzhuvathaiyum avaridaththil koodivarachseythu,
avar vasthirangka'laik kazhat'ri, sivappaana mealangkiyai avarukku uduththi,

mu'l'luka'laal oru mudiyaippinni, avar sirasinmeal vaiththu, avar valathukaiyil oru koalaik koduththu, avar munpaaka muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu: yootharudaiya raajaavea, vaazhka en'ru avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ni,
avarmeal thuppi, anthak koalai eduththu, avaraich sirasil adiththaarka'l.
avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ninapinpu, avarukku uduththina mealangkiyaik kazhat'ri, avarudaiya vasthirangka'lai avarukku uduththi, avaraich siluvaiyil a'raiyumpadi ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
poakaiyil, sireanea ooraanaakiya seemoan ennappatta oru manushanai avarka'l ka'ndu, avarudaiya siluvaiyaich sumakkumpadi avanaip palavantham pa'n'ninaarka'l.
kapaalasthalam en'ru arththangko'l'lum kolkothaa ennum idaththukku avarka'l vanthapoathu,
kasappukkalantha kaadiyai avarukkuk kudikkak koduththaarka'l; avar athai rusipaarththu, kudikka manathillaathirunthaar.

avaraich siluvaiyil a'rainthapinpu, avarka'l seettuppoattu avarudaiya vasthirangka'laip pangkittuk ko'ndaarka'l. en vasthirangka'laith thangka'lukku'l'lea pangkittu, en udaiyinpearil seettuppoattaarka'l en'ru theerkkatharisiyaal uraikkappattathu ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.
avarka'l angkea udkaarnthu, avaraik kaavalkaaththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
an'riyum avar adaintha aakkinaiyin mukaantharaththaik kaa'npikkum poruttu, ivan yootharudaiya raajaavaakiya iyeasu en'ru ezhuthi, avar sirasukku mealaaka vaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu, avarudaiya valathupakkaththil oruvanum avarudaiya idathupakkaththil oruvanumaaka ira'ndu ka'l'lar avaroadeakoodach siluvaika'lil a'raiyappattaarka'l.
antha vazhiyaay nadanthupoaki'ravarka'l thangka'l thalaika'laith thulukki:
theavaalayaththai idiththu, moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea kattuki'ravanea, unnai neeyea radchiththukko'l; nee theavanudaiya kumaaranaanaal siluvaiyilirunthu i'rangki vaa en'ru avaraith thooshiththaarka'l.
appadiyea pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum moopparum pariyaasampa'n'ni:
mat'ravarka'lai radchiththaan; thannaiththaan radchiththukko'l'lath thiraa'niyillai; ivan isravealin raajaavaanaal ippozhuthu siluvaiyilirunthu i'rangkivarattum, appozhuthu ivanai visuvaasippoam.
thannaith theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru solli, theavanmeal nampikkaiyaayirunthaanea; avar ivanmeal piriyamaayirunthaal ippozhuthu ivanai iradchikkattum en'raarka'l.
avaroadeakoodach siluvaika'lil a'raiyappatta ka'l'larum anthappadiyea avarai ninthiththaarka'l.
aa'raamma'ni nearamuthal onpathaamma'ni nearamvaraikkum poomiyengkum anthakaaram u'ndaayit'ru.
onpathaamma'ni nearaththil iyeasu: ealee! ealee! laamaa sapakthaani, en'ru mikuntha saththamittuk kooppittaar; atha'rku en theavanea! en theavanea! ean ennaik kaivitteer en'ru arththamaam.
angkea nin'ravarka'lil silar athaik keattapozhuthu: ivan eliyaavaik kooppiduki'raan en'raarka'l.
udanea avarka'lil oruvan oadi, kada'rkaa'laanai eduththu, kaadiyil thoayththu, athai oru koalil maatti, avarukkuk kudikkak koduththaan.
mat'ravarka'loa: po'ru, eliyaa ivanai iradchikka varuvaanoa, paarppoam en'raarka'l.
iyeasu, ma'rupadiyum makaa saththamaayk kooppittu, aaviyai vittaar.
appozhuthu, theavaalayaththin thiraichseelai mealthodangkik keezhvaraikkum ira'ndaakak kizhinthathu, poomiyum athirnthathu, kanmalaika'lum pi'lanthathu.
kalla'raika'lum thi'ranthathu, niththiraiyadainthiruntha aneaka parisuththavaanka'ludaiya sareerangka'lum ezhunthirunthathu.
avar uyirththezhunthapinpu, ivarka'l kalla'raika'laivittup pu'rappattu, parisuththa nakaraththil piraveasiththu, aneakarukkuk kaa'nappattaarka'l.

noot'rukku athipathiyum, avanoadeakooda iyeasuvaik kaavalkaaththirunthavarka'lum, poomiyathirchchiyaiyum sampaviththa kaariyangka'laiyum ka'ndu, mikavum payanthu: meyyaakavea ivar theavanudaiya kumaaran en'raarka'l.
mealum, iyeasuvukku oozhiyagnseyyumpadi kalileayaavilirunthu avaroadea vanthiruntha aneaka sthireeka'l angkea thooraththilea nin'ru paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
avarka'lukku'l'lea makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum, yaakkoapukkum yoaseakkum thaayaakiya mariyaa'lum, sepetheayuvin kumaararudaiya thaayum irunthaarka'l.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu, iyeasuvukkuch seeshanum aisuvariyavaanumaayiruntha yoaseappu ennum pearko'nda arimaththiyaa ooraanaakiya oru manushan vanthu,
pilaaththuvinidaththil poay, iyeasuvin sareeraththaik keattaan. appozhuthu, sareeraththaik kodukkumpadi pilaaththu katta'laiyittaan.
yoaseappu anthach sareeraththai eduththu, thuyyathaana melliya thuppattiyilea sut'ri,
thaan kanmalaiyil vettiyiruntha thannudaiya puthiya kalla'raiyilea athai vaiththu, kalla'raiyin vaasalil oru periya kallaip purattivaiththup poanaan.
angkea makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum mat'ra mariyaa'lum kalla'raikku ethiraaka udkaarnthirunthaarka'l.
aayaththanaa'lukkup pinnaana ma'runaa'lilea pirathaana aasaariyarum pariseayarum pilaaththuvinidaththil koodivanthu:
aa'ndavanea, antha eththan uyiroadirukkumpoathu, moon'runaa'laikkuppin ezhunthiruppean en'ru sonnathu engka'lukku gnaapakamirukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal, avanudaiya seesharka'l iraaththiriyilea vanthu, avanaik ka'lavaayk ko'ndupoay, mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaanen'ru janangka'lukkuch sollaathapadikkum, munthina eththaippaarkkilum pinthina eththu kodithaakaathapadikkum, neer moon'runaa'lvaraikkum kalla'raiyaip paththirappaduththumpadi katta'laiyidavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
atha'rkup pilaaththu: ungka'lukkuk kaavalseavakar u'ndea; poay, ungka'laal koodiyamattum paththirappaduththikko'l'lungka'l en'raan.
avarka'l poayk kallukku muththiraipoattu, kaavalvaiththu, kalla'raiyaip paththirappaduththinaarka'l.
oayvunaa'l mudinthu, vaaraththin muthalaam naa'l vidinthuvarukaiyil, makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum mat'ra mariyaa'lum kalla'raiyaip paarkkavanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu, poomi mikavum athirumpadi, karththarudaiya thoothan vaanaththilirunthi'rangki vanthu, vaasaliliruntha kallaip purattith tha'l'li, athinmeal udkaarnthaan.
avanudaiya roopam minnalpoalavum, avanudaiya vasthiram u'raintha mazhaiyaippoala ve'nmaiyaakavum irunthathu.
kaavalaa'lar avanukkup payanthathinaal thidukkittuch seththavarka'l poalaanaarka'l.
thoothan antha sthireeka'lai noakki: neengka'l payappadaathirungka'l; siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta iyeasuvaith theaduki'reerka'l en'ru a'rivean.
avar ingkea illai; thaam sonnapadiyea uyirththezhunthaar; karththarai vaiththa idaththai vanthu paarungka'l;

seekkiramaayp poay, avar mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaar en'ru avarudaiya seesharka'lukkuch sollungka'l. avar ungka'lukkumunnea kalileayaavukkup poaki'raar; angkea avaraik kaa'npeerka'l; ithoa, ungka'lukkuch sonnean en'raan.
avarka'l payaththoadum makaa santhoashaththoadum kalla'raiyai vittuch seekkiramaayp pu'rappattu, avarudaiya seesharka'lukku a'rivikka oadinaarka'l.

avarka'l avarudaiya seesharka'lukku a'rivikkap poaki'rapoathu, iyeasu thaamea avarka'lukku ethirppattu: vaazhka en'raar. avarka'l kittavanthu, avar paathangka'laith thazhuvi, avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l; neengka'l poay, en sakoatharar kalileayaavukkup poakumpadi avarka'lukkuch sollungka'l; angkea avarka'l ennaik kaa'npaarka'l en'raar.
avarka'l poakaiyil, kaavalseavakaril silar nakaraththukku'l'lea vanthu, nadantha yaavat'raiyum pirathaana aasaariyarukku a'riviththaarka'l.
ivarka'l moopparoadea koodivanthu, aaloasanaipa'n'ni, seavakarukku vea'ndiya pa'naththaik koduththu:
naangka'l niththiraipa'n'nukaiyil, avanudaiya seesharka'l iraaththiriyilea vanthu, avanaik ka'lavaayk ko'ndu poayvittaarka'l en'ru sollungka'l.
ithu theasaathipathikkuk kea'lviyaanaal, naangka'l avaraich sammathappaduththi, ungka'laith thappuvippoam en'raarka'l.
avarka'l pa'naththai vaangkikko'ndu, thangka'lukkup poathikkappattapadiyea seythaarka'l. inthap peachchu yootharukku'l'lea innaa'lvaraikkum pirasiththamaayirukki'rathu.
pathinoru seesharka'lum, kalileayaavilea iyeasu thangka'lukkuk ku'riththiruntha malaikkup poanaarka'l.
angkea avarka'l avaraik ka'ndu, pa'ninthuko'ndaarka'l; silaroa santheakappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu sameepaththil vanthu, avarka'lai noakki: vaanaththilum poomiyilum sakala athikaaramum enakkuk kodukkappattirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l pu'rappattuppoay, sakala jaathika'laiyum seesharaakki, pithaa kumaaran parisuththa aaviyin naamaththilea avarka'lukku gnaanasnaanangkoduththu,

naan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta yaavaiyum avarka'l kaikko'l'lumpadi avarka'lukku upatheasampa'n'nungka'l. ithoa, ulakaththin mudivupariyantham sakala naadka'lilum naan ungka'ludaneakooda irukki'rean en'raar. aamen.
theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasu ki'risthuvinudaiya suviseashaththin aarampam.
ithoa, naan en thoothanai umakku munpaaka anuppuki'rean, avan umakku munnea poay, umakku vazhiyai aayaththampa'n'nuvaan en'rum;

karththarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l, avarukkup paathaika'laich sevvaipa'n'nungka'l en'ru vanaantharaththilea kooppiduki'ravanudaiya saththam u'ndaakum en'rum, theerkkatharisana aakamangka'lil ezhuthiyirukki'ra pirakaaramaay;
yoavaan vanaantharaththil gnaanasnaanangkoduththu, paavamannippukken'ru mananthirumputhalukkeat'ra gnaanasnaanaththaikku'riththup pirasangkampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu yootheayaa theasaththaar anaivarum erusaleam nakaraththaar yaavarum, avanidaththi'rkuppoay, thangka'l paavangka'lai a'rikkaiyittu, yoarthaan nathiyil avanaal gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
yoavaan ottakamayir udaiyaith thariththu, than araiyil vaarkkachchaiyaik kattikko'ndavanaayum, vettukki'liyaiyum kaattuththeanaiyum pusikki'ravanaayum irunthaan.
avan: ennilum vallavar oruvar enakkuppin varuki'raar, avarudaiya paatharadchaika'lin vaaraik kuninthu avizhkki'ratha'rkum naan paaththiran alla.
naan jalaththinaal ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanam koduththean; avaroa parisuththa aaviyinaal ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanam koduppaar en'ru pirasangkiththaan.
antha naadka'lil, iyeasu kalileayaavilu'l'la naasareaththoorilirunthu vanthu, yoarthaan nathiyil yoavaanaal gnaanasnaanam pet'raar.
avar jalaththilirunthu karaiyea'rinavudanea, vaanam thi'rakkappattathaiyum, aaviyaanavar pu'raavaippoal thammeal i'rangkuki'rathaiyum ka'ndaar.
an'riyum, neer ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ummil piriyamaayirukki'rean en'ru, vaanaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
udanea aaviyaanavar avarai vanaantharaththi'rkup poakumpadi eavinaar.

avar vanaantharaththilea naa'rpathunaa'l irunthu, saaththaanaal soathikkappattu, angkea kaattumirukangka'lin naduvilea sagnchariththukko'ndirunthaar. theavathootharka'l avarukku oozhiyagnseythaarka'l.
yoavaan kaavalil vaikkappatta pinpu, iyeasu kalileayaavilea vanthu, theavanudaiya raajyaththin suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu:
kaalam ni'raivea'rit'ru, theavanudaiya raajyam sameepamaayit'ru; mananthirumpi, suviseashaththai visuvaasiyungka'l en'raar.
avar kalileayaak kadaloaramaay nadanthupoakaiyil, meenpidikki'ravarka'laayiruntha seemoanum, avan sakoatharan anthireayaavum kadalil valaipoattukko'ndirukki'rapoathu avarka'laik ka'ndaar.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: en pinnea vaarungka'l, ungka'lai manusharaip pidikki'ravarka'laakkuvean en'raar.
udanea avarka'l thangka'l valaika'lai vittu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
avar avvidam vittuch sat'ru appu'ram poanapoathu, sepetheayuvin kumaaran yaakkoapum avan sakoatharan yoavaanum padavilea valaika'laip pazhuthupaarththukko'ndirukki'rathaik ka'ndu,
udanea avarka'laiyum azhaiththaar; appozhuthu avarka'l thangka'l thakappanaakiya sepetheayuvaik kooliyaadka'loadu padavilea vittu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
pinpu kapparnakoomukkup poanaarka'l. udanea avar oayvunaa'lil jepaaalayaththilea piraveasiththu, poathakam pa'n'ninaar.
avar veathapaarakaraippoalap poathiyaamal, athikaaramudaiyavaraay avarka'lukkup poathiththapadiyinaal, avarudaiya poathakaththaikku'riththu janangka'l aachchariyappattaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya jepaaalayaththilea asuththa aaviyu'l'la oru manushan irunthaan.
avan: aiyoa! nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvea, engka'lukkum umakkum enna? engka'laik kedukkavaa vantheer? ummai innaar en'ru a'rivean, neer theavanudaiya parisuththar en'ru saththamittaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: nee peasaamal ivanai vittup pu'rappattuppoa en'ru athai athattinaar.
udanea antha asuththa aavi avanai alaikkazhiththu, mikuntha saththamittu, avanaivittup poayvittathu.

ellaarum aachchariyappattu: ithu enna? inthap puthiya upatheasam eppadippattathu? ivar athikaaraththoadea asuththa aavika'lukkum katta'laiyiduki'raar, avaika'l ivarukkuk keezhppadiki'rathea en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
athumuthal avarudaiya keerththi kalileayaa naadengkum pirasiththamaayit'ru.
udanea avarka'l jepaaalayaththai vittup pu'rappattu, yaakkoapoadum yoavaanoadungkooda, seemoan anthireayaa enpavarka'ludaiya veettil piraveasiththaarka'l.
angkea seemoanudaiya maami juramaayk kidanthaa'l; udanea avarka'l ava'laikku'riththu avarukkuch sonnaarka'l.
avar kittappoay, ava'l kaiyaip pidiththu, ava'laith thookkivittaar; udanea juram ava'lai vittu neengkit'ru; appozhuthu ava'l avarka'lukkup pa'nividaiseythaa'l.
saayangkaalamaakich sooriyan asthamiththapoathu, sakala pi'niyaa'lika'laiyum, pisaasupidiththavarka'laiyum, avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l.
patta'naththaar ellaarum veettu vaasalukku munpaakak koodivanthaarka'l.

palavithamaana viyaathika'linaal upaththiravappattiruntha aneakarai avar sosthamaakki, aneakam pisaasuka'laiyum thuraththivittaar; anthap pisaasuka'l thammai a'rinthirunthapadiyaal, avaika'l peasuki'ratha'rku avar idangkodukkavillai.
avar athikaalaiyil, iruttoadea ezhunthu pu'rappattu, vanaantharamaana oaridaththi'rkuppoay, angkea jepampa'n'ninaar.
seemoanum avanoadea irunthavarka'lum avaraip pinthodarnthupoay,
avaraik ka'ndapoathu: ummai ellaarum theaduki'raarka'l en'ru sonnaarka'l.
avarka'lai avar noakki: aduththa oorka'lilum naan pirasangkampa'n'na vea'ndumaathalaal, avvidangka'lukkup poavoam vaarungka'l; itha'rkaakavea pu'rappattuvanthean en'ru solli;
kalileayaa naadengkum avarka'ludaiya jepaaalayangka'lil avar pirasangkam pa'n'nikko'ndum, pisaasuka'laith thuraththikko'ndum irunthaar.
appozhuthu kushdaroaki oruvan avaridaththil vanthu, avar munpaaka muzhangkaalpadiyittu: umakkuch siththamaanaal ennaich suththamaakka ummaal aakum en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaan.
iyeasu manathuruki, kaiyai neetti, avanaith thottu: enakkuch siththamu'ndu, suththamaaku en'raar.
ippadi avar sonnavudanea, kushdaroakam avanai vittu neengkit'ru, avan suththamaanaan.
appozhuthu avar avanai noakki: nee ithai oruvarukkum sollaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru;

aayinum nee poay, aasaariyanukku unnaik kaa'npiththu, nee suththamaanathinimiththam, moasea katta'laiyittirukki'ravaika'lai avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaakach seluththu en'ru ka'ndippaaych solli, udanea avanai anuppivittaar.

avanoa pu'rappattuppoay, inthach sangkathi engkum vi'langkumpadiyaakap pirasiththampa'n'naththodangkinaan. athinaal avar ve'liyarangkamaayp patta'naththil piraveasikkakkoodaamal, ve'liyea vanaantharamaana idangka'lil thangkiyirunthaar; eththisaiyilumirunthu janangka'l avaridaththi'rku vanthaarka'l.
silanaadka'lukkuppinpu avar ma'rupadiyum kapparnakoomukkup poanaar; avar veettilirukki'raaren'ru janangka'l kea'lvippattu;
udanea vaasalukku munnum ni'rka idampoathaathapadikku aneakar koodivanthaarka'l; avarka'lukku vasanaththaip poathiththaar.
appozhuthu naalupear oru thimirvaathakkaaranaich sumanthuko'ndu avaridaththil vanthaarka'l;
janakkoottaththinimiththam avarukkuch sameepamaaych searakkoodaamal, avar iruntha veettin mea'rkooraiyaip piriththuth thi'rappaakki, thimirvaathakkaaran kidakki'ra padukkaiyai i'rakkinaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'l visuvaasaththaik ka'ndu, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki: makanea, un paavangka'l unakku mannikkappattathu en'raar.
angkea udkaarnthiruntha veathapaarakaril silar:
ivan ippadith theavathoosha'nam solluki'rathenna? theavan oruvareayan'rip paavangka'lai mannikkaththakkavar yaar en'ru thangka'l iruthayangka'lil sinthiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea ippadich sinthikki'raarka'len'ru iyeasu udanea thammudaiya aaviyil a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l iruthayangka'lil ippadich sinthikki'rathenna?
un paavangka'l unakku mannikkappattathen'ru solvathoa, ezhunthu un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu nadaven'ru solvathoa, ethu e'lithu?
poomiyilea paavangka'lai mannikka manushakumaaranukku athikaaram u'ndenpathai neengka'l a'riyavea'ndum en'ru solli, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki:
nee ezhunthu, un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, un veettukkup poa en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

udanea, avan ezhunthu, than padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu ellaarukkumunpaakap poanaan. appozhuthu ellaarum aachchariyappattu: naam orukkaalum ippadik ka'ndathillaiyen'ru solli, theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.
avar ma'rupadiyum pu'rappattuk kadalarukea poanaar; appozhuthu janangka'lellaarum avaridaththil vanthaarka'l; avarka'lukkup poathakampa'n'ninaar.
avar nadanthupoakaiyil, alpeayuvin kumaaranaakiya leavi aayaththu'raiyil udkaarnthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu: enakkup pinsen'ruvaa en'raar; avan ezhunthu avarukkup pinsen'raan.

appozhuthu, avanudaiya veettilea avar poajanapanthiyirukkaiyil, aneaka aayakkaararum paavika'lum avaroadukooda vanthirunthapadiyaal, avarka'lum iyeasuvoadum avar seesharoadungkoodap panthiyirunthaarka'l.

avar aayakkaararoadum paavika'loadum poajanampa'n'nuki'rathai veathapaarakarum pariseayarum ka'ndu, avarudaiya seesharai noakki: avar aayakkaararoadum paavika'loadum poajanapaanam pa'n'nuki'rathennaven'ru keattaarka'l.

iyeasu athaik keattu: pi'niyaa'lika'lukku vaiththiyan vea'ndiyatheayallaamal sukamu'l'lavarka'lukku vea'ndiyathillai; neethimaanka'laiyalla, paavika'laiyea mananthirumpuki'ratha'rku azhaikkavanthean en'raar.

yoavaanudaiya seesharum pariseayarudaiya seesharum upavaasampa'n'nivanthaarka'l. avarka'l avaridaththil vanthu: yoavaanudaiya seesharum pariseayarudaiya seesharum upavaasikki'raarka'lea, ummudaiya seeshar upavaasiyaamalirukki'rathennaven'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: ma'navaa'lan thangka'loadirukkaiyil ma'navaa'lanudaiya thoazhar upavaasippaarka'laa? ma'navaa'lan thangka'ludanea irukkumvaraikkum upavaasikkamaattaarka'lea.
ma'navaa'lan avarka'lai vittu edupadum naadka'l varum, antha naadka'lilea upavaasippaarka'l.
oruvanum koadiththu'ndaip pazhaiya vasthiraththoadu i'naikkamaattaan, i'naiththaal, athinoadea i'naiththa puthiyathu'ndu pazhaiyathai athikamaayk kizhikkum, pee'ralum athikamaakum.

oruvanum puthu thiraadcharasaththaip pazhanthuruththika'lil vaarththuvaikkamaattaan; vaarththuvaiththaal, puthurasam thuruththika'laik kizhiththuppoadum, irasamum sinthippoam, thuruththika'lum kettuppoam; puthurasaththaip puthu thuruththika'lil vaarththuvaikkavea'ndum en'raar.
pinpu, avar oayvunaa'lil payir vazhiyea poanaar; avarudaiya seesharka'l kooda nadanthupoakaiyil, kathirka'laik koyyath thodangkinaarka'l.
pariseayar avarai noakki: ithoa, oayvunaa'lil seyyaththakaathathai ivarka'l ean seyki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: thaaveethukku u'ndaana aapaththil, thaanum thannoadirunthavarka'lum pasiyaayirunthapoathu,

avan apiyaththaar ennum pirathaana aasaariyan kaalaththil seythathai neengka'l orukkaalum vaasikkavillaiyaa? avan theavanudaiya veettil piraveasiththu, aasaariyarthavira vea'roruvarum pusikkaththakaatha theyvasamukaththu appangka'laith thaanum pusiththuth thannoadirunthavarka'lukkum koduththaanea en'raar.
pinpu avarka'lai noakki: manushan oayvunaa'lukkaaka u'ndaakkappadavillai, oayvunaa'l manushanukkaaka u'ndaakkappattathu;
aakaiyaal manushakumaaran oayvu naa'lukkum aa'ndavaraay irukki'raar en'raar.
ma'rupadiyum avar jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththaar. angkea soompina kaiyaiyudaiya oru manushan irunthaan.
avar oayvunaa'lil avanaich sosthamaakkinaal avarpearil kut'ragnsaattalaamen'ru avarmeal noakkamaayirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar soompina kaiyaiyudaiya manushanai noakki: ezhunthu naduvea nil en'ru solli;
avarka'laip paarththu: oayvunaadka'lil nanmaiseyvathoa, theemaiseyvathoa, jeevanaik kaappathoa azhippathoa, ethu niyaayam en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l peasaamalirunthaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya iruthayakadinaththinimiththam avar visanappattu, koapaththudanea sut'rilum irunthavarka'laip paarththu, antha manushanai noakki: un kaiyai neettu en'raar; avan neettinaan; avan kai ma'rukaiyaippoalach sosthamaayit'ru.
udanea pariseayar pu'rappattuppoay, avaraik kolaiseyyumpadi, avarukku viroathamaay earoathiyaroadeakooda aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
iyeasu thammudaiya seesharka'loadea avvidamvittu, kadaloaraththukkup poanaar.

kalileayaavilum, yootheayaavilum, erusaleamilum, ithumeayaavilum, yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilumirunthu thira'laana janangka'l vanthu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l. allaamalum theeru seethoan patta'nangka'lin thisaika'lilumirunthu thira'laana janangka'l avar seytha a'rputhangka'laikku'riththuk kea'lvippattu, avaridaththil vanthaarka'l.
avar aneakaraich sosthamaakkinaar. noayaa'lika'lellaarum athai a'rinthu avaraith thodavea'ndumen'ru avaridaththil nerungkivanthaarka'l.
janangka'l thira'laayirunthapadiyaal avarka'l thammai nerukkaathapadikku, thamakkaaka oru padavai aayaththampa'n'navea'ndumen'ru, thammudaiya seesharka'lukkuch sonnaar.
asuththa aavika'lum avaraik ka'ndapoathu, avar munpaaka vizhunthu: neer theavanudaiya kumaaran en'ru saththamittana.
thammaip pirasiththampa'n'naathapadi avaika'lukkuk ka'ndippaayk katta'laiyittaar.
pinpu avar oru malaiyinmeal ea'ri, thamakkuch siththamaanavarka'laith thammidaththil varavazhaiththaar; avarka'l avaridaththi'rku vanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar pannira'ndu pearaith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'l thammoadukooda irukkavum, pirasangkampa'n'numpadiyaakath thaam avarka'lai anuppavum,
viyaathika'laik ku'namaakkip pisaasuka'laith thuraththumpadi avarka'l athikaaramudaiyavarka'laayirukkavum, avarka'lai ea'rpaduththinaar.
avarka'l yaarenil, seemoan, ivanukkup peathuru enki'ra peyarittaar.
sepetheayuvin kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapu, yaakkoapin sakoatharanaakiya yoavaan, ivviruvarukkum idimuzhakka makka'len'ru arththangko'l'lum povanerkeas enki'ra peyarittaar,
anthireayaa, pilippu, pa'rtholomeayu, maththeayu, thoamaa, alpeayuvin kumaaran yaakkoapu, thatheayu, kaanaaniyanaakiya seemoan,
avaraik kaattikkoduththa yoothaaskaariyoaththu enpavarka'lea.
pinpu veettukkup poanaarka'l; angkea avarka'l saappiduvatha'rkum samayamillaathapadikku aneaka janangka'l ma'rupadiyum koodivanthaarka'l.
avarudaiya inaththaar ithaikkeattapoathu, avar mathimayangkiyirukki'raar en'ru solli, avaraip pidiththukko'l'lumpadi vanthaarka'l.
erusaleamilirunthu vantha veathapaarakar: ivan peyelsepoolaikko'ndirukki'raan, pisaasuka'lin thalaivanaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'raan en'raarka'l.
avarka'lai avar azhaiththu, uvamaika'laay avarka'lukkuch sonnathaavathu: saaththaanaich saaththaan thuraththuvathu eppadi?
oru raajyam thanakkuththaanea viroathamaakap pirinthirunthaal, antha raajyam nilaini'rkamaattaathea.
oru veedu thanakkuththaanea viroathamaakap pirinthirunthaal, antha veedu nilaini'rkamaattaathea.
saaththaan thanakkuththaanea viroathamaaka ezhumpip pirinthirunthaal, avan nilaini'rkamaattaamal, azhinthupoavaanea.
palavaanai munthik kattinaalozhiya, oruvanum palavaanudaiya veettukku'l pukunthu, avan udaimaika'laik ko'l'laiyidakkoodaathu; kattinaaneayaakil, avan veettaik ko'l'laiyiduvaan.
meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean: manusharka'l seyyum ellaap paavangka'lum, avarka'l thooshikkum enthath thoosha'nangka'lum, avarka'lukku mannikkappadum;
oruvan parisuththa aavikku viroathamaakath thoosha'nagnsolvaanaakil, avan en'ren'raikkum mannippadaiyaamal niththiya aakkinaikku'l'laayiruppaan en'raar.
asuththa aaviyaik ko'ndirukki'raanen'ru avarka'l sonnapadiyinaalea avar ippadich sonnaar.
appozhuthu avarudaiya sakoathararum thaayaarum vanthu, ve'liyea nin'ru, avarai azhaikkumpadi avaridaththil aa'l anuppinaarka'l.
avaraich sut'rilum udkaarnthiruntha janangka'l avarai noakki: ithoa, ummudaiya thaayaarum ummudaiya sakoathararum ve'liyea nin'ru ummaith theaduki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: en thaayaar yaar? en sakoatharar yaar? en'ru solli;
thammaich soozha udkaarnthirunthavarka'laich sut'rippaarththu: ithoa, en thaayum, en sakoathararum ivarka'lea!
theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi seyki'ravan evanoa avanea enakkuch sakoatharanum, enakkuch sakoathariyum, enakkuth thaayumaay irukki'raan en'raar.

avar ma'rupadiyum kadaloaraththilea poathakampa'n'nath thodangkinaar. thira'laana janangka'l avaridaththil koodivanthapadiyaal, avar kadalilea nin'ra oru padavil ea'ri udkaarnthaar; janangka'lellaarum kada'rkaraiyil nin'raarka'l.
avar aneaka viseashangka'lai uvamaika'laaka avarka'lukkup poathiththaar; poathikki'rapozhuthu avarka'lukkuch sonnathu:
kea'lungka'l, vithaikki'ravan oruvan vithaikkap pu'rappattaan.
avan vithaikkaiyil, sila vithai vazhiyarukea vizhunthathu; aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l vanthu athaip padchiththuppoattathu.
sila vithai athika ma'n'nillaatha ka'rpaa'rai nilaththil vizhunthathu; atha'rku aazhamaana ma'n'nillaathathinaalea seekkiraththil mu'laiththathu;
veyil ea'rinapoathoa, theeynthu poay, vearillaamaiyaal ularnthupoayit'ru.
sila vithai mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vizhunthathu; mu'l va'larnthu, athu palan kodaathapadi, athai nerukkippoattathu.
sila vithai nalla nilaththil vizhunthu, oangkiva'laruki'ra payiraaki, on'ru muppathum, on'ru a'rupathum, on'ru noo'rumaakap palan thanthathu.
keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'ru avarka'lukkuch sonnaar.
avar thaniththirukki'rapoathu, panniruvaroadungkooda avaraich soozhnthirunthavarka'l intha uvamaiyaik ku'riththu avaridaththil keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: theavanudaiya raajyaththin irakasiyaththai a'riyumpadi ungka'lukku aru'lappattathu; pu'rampea irukki'ravarka'lukkoa ivaika'lellaam uvamaika'laakach sollappaduki'rathu.

avarka'l ku'nappadaathapadikkum, paavangka'l avarka'lukku mannikkappadaathapadikkum, avarka'l ka'ndum kaa'naathavarka'laakavum, keattum u'naraathavarka'laakavum irukkumpadi, ippadich sollappaduki'rathu en'raar.
pinpu avar avarka'lai noakki: intha uvamaiyai neengka'l a'riyavillaiyaa? a'riyaavittaal mat'ra uvamaika'laiyellaam eppadi a'riveerka'l?
vithaikki'ravan vasanaththai vithaikki'raan.
vasanaththaik keattavudanea saaththaan vanthu, avarka'l iruthayangka'lil vithaikkappatta vasanaththai eduththuppoaduki'raan; ivarka'lea vasanam vithaikkappaduki'ra vazhiyarukaanavarka'l.
appadiyea, vasanaththaik keattavudanea athaich santhoashaththoadu eat'rukko'ndum,

thangka'lukku'l'lea vearko'l'laathapadiyaal, kognchakkaalamaaththiram nilaiththirukki'raarka'l, vasanaththinimiththam upaththiravamum thunpamum u'ndaanavudanea ida'raladaiki'raarka'l; ivarka'lea ka'rpaa'rai nilaththil vithaikkappattavarka'l.

vasanaththaik keattum, ulakakkavalaika'lum, aisuvariyaththin mayakkamum, mat'ravaika'laippat'ri u'ndaaki'ra ichchaika'lum udpiraveasiththu, vasanaththai nerukkippoada, athinaal palanat'ruppoaki'raarka'l.
ivarka'lea mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vithaikkappattavarka'l.
vasanaththaik keattu, eat'rukko'ndu, on'ru muppathum on'ru a'rupathum on'ru noo'rumaakap palankodukki'raarka'l; ivarka'lea nalla nilaththil vithaikkappattavarka'l en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: vi'lakkaith tha'ndinmeal vaikki'ratha'rkeayan'ri, marakkaalin keezhaakilum, kattilin keezhaakilum, vaikki'ratha'rkuk ko'nduvaruvaarka'laa?
ve'liyarangkamaakaatha antharangkamumillai, ve'likku varaatha ma'raiporu'lumillai.
keadki'ratha'rku oruvan kaathu'l'lavanaayirunthaal keadkakkadavan en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l keadki'rathaik kavaniyungka'l. entha a'lavinaal a'lakki'reerka'loa, antha a'lavinaal ungka'lukkum a'lakkappadum, keadki'ra ungka'lukku athikam kodukkappadum.
u'l'lavanevanoa avanukkuk kodukkappadum; illaathavanevanoa avanidaththil u'l'lathum eduththukko'l'lappadum en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: theavanudaiya raajyamaanathu, oru manushan nilaththil vithaiyai vithaiththu;
iravil thoongki, pakalil vizhiththirukka, avanukkuth theriyaathavithamaay, vithai mu'laiththup payiraaki'ratha'rku oppaayirukki'rathu.
eppadiyen'raal, nilamaanathu munpu mu'laiyaiyum, pinpu kathiraiyum, kathirilea ni'raintha thaaniyaththaiyum palanaakath thaanaayk kodukkum.
payir vi'lainthu a'ruppukkaalam vanthavudanea, a'rukki'ratha'rku aadka'lai anuppuki'raan en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: theavanudaiya raajyaththai etha'rku oppiduvoam? allathu entha uvamaiyinaalea athaith thirushdaanthappaduththuvoam?
athu oru kadukuvithaikku oppaayirukki'rathu; athu poomiyil vithaikkappadumpoathu poomiyilu'l'la sakala vithaika'lilum si'rithaayirukki'rathu;
vithaikkappatta pinpoa, athu va'larnthu, sakala poo'nduka'lilum perithaaki, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l athinudaiya nizhalinkeezh vanthadaiyaththakka periya ki'laika'lai vidum en'raar.
avarka'l keatta'riyum thiraa'nikkuththakkathaaka, avar ippadippatta aneaka uvamaika'linaalea avarka'lukku vasanaththaich sonnaar.
uvamaika'linaaleayan'ri avarka'lukku on'rum sollavillai; avar thammudaiya seesharoadea thaniththirukkumpoathu, avarka'lukku ellaavat'raiyum vivariththuchsonnaar.
an'ru saayangkaalaththil, avar avarka'lai noakki: akkaraikkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l janangka'lai anuppivittu, avar padavilirunthapadiyea avaraik ko'ndupoanaarka'l. vea'rea padavuka'lum avaroadeakooda irunthathu.
appozhuthu palaththa suzhalkaat'ru u'ndaaki, padavu nirampaththakkathaaka, alaika'l athinmeal moathit'ru.
kappalin pinna'niyaththil avar thalaiya'naiyai vaiththu niththiraiyaayirunthaar. avarka'l avarai ezhuppi: poathakarea, naangka'l madinthupoaki'rathu umakkuk kavalaiyillaiyaa en'raarka'l.
avar ezhunthu, kaat'rai athatti, kadalaippaarththu: iraiyaathea, amaithalaayiru en'raar. appozhuthu kaat'ru nin'rupoay, mikuntha amaithal u'ndaayit'ru.
avar avarka'lai noakki: ean ippadip payappatteerka'l? ean ungka'lukku visuvaasam illaama'rpoayit'ru en'raar.
avarka'l mikavum payanthu: ivar yaaroa? kaat'rum kadalum ivarukkuk keezhppadiki'rathea en'ru, oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu avarka'l kadalukku akkaraiyilu'l'la kathareanarudaiya naattil vanthaarka'l.
avar padavilirunthu i'rangkinavudanea, asuththa aaviyu'l'la oru manushan pireathakkalla'raika'lilirunthu avarukku ethiraaka vanthaan.
