avanudaiya kudiyiruppu kalla'raika'lilea irunthathu; avanaich sangkilika'linaalum katta oruvanaalum koodaathirunthathu.
avan aneakantharam vilangkuka'linaalum sangkilika'linaalum kattappattirunthum, sangkilika'lai mu'riththu, vilangkuka'laith thakarththuppoaduvaan; avanaiyadakka oruvanaalum koodaathirunthathu.
avan eppozhuthum iravum pakalum, malaika'lilum kalla'raika'lilum irunthu, kookkuralittu, kalluka'linaalea thannaik kaayappaduththikko'ndirunthaan.
avan iyeasuvaith thooraththilea ka'ndapoathu, oadivanthu, avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu:
iyeasuvea, unnathamaana theavanudaiya kumaaranea, enakkum umakkum enna? ennai veathanaippaduththaathapadikkuth theavanpearil umakku aa'naiyen'ru mikuntha saththamittuch sonnaan.
eanenil avar avanai noakki: asuththa aaviyea, intha manushanai vittup pu'rappattup poa en'ru solliyirunthaar.
appozhuthu avar avanai noakki: un pear ennaven'ru keattaar. atha'rku avan: naangka'l aneakaraayirukki'rapadiyaal en pear leakiyoan en'ru solli,
thangka'lai anthath thisaiyilirunthu thuraththividaathapadikku avarai mikavum vea'ndikko'ndaan.
appozhuthu, avvidaththil malaiyarukea aneakam pan'rika'l koottamaaka meaynthuko'ndirunthathu.
anthap pisaasuka'lellaam avarai noakki: pan'rika'lukku'l'lea poakumpadi, avaika'lukku'l'lea engka'lai anuppum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndana.

iyeasu avaika'lukku uththaravu koduththavudanea, asuththa aavika'l pu'rappattup pan'rika'lukku'l poayina; udanea ea'rakku'raiya ira'ndaayiram pan'rika'lu'l'la anthak koottam uyarntha meattilirunthu oadi, kadalilea paaynthu, kadalil amizhnthu maa'ndathu.
pan'rika'lai meayththavarka'l oadi, ithaip patta'naththilum sut'ruppu'rangka'lilum a'riviththaarka'l. appozhuthu sampaviththathaip paarkkumpadi janangka'l pu'rappattu;
iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu, leakiyoanaakiya pisaasuka'l pidiththirunthavan vasthiranthariththu, udkaarnthu, puththi the'linthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, payanthaarka'l.
pisaasuka'l pidiththirunthavanukkum pan'rika'lukkum sampaviththathaik ka'ndavarka'lum avarka'lukku vivaramaaych sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu thangka'l ellaika'lai vittup poakumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'l'lath thodangkinaarka'l.
appadiyea avar padavil ea'ruki'rapozhuthu, pisaasu pidiththirunthavan, avaroadeakooda irukkumpadi thanakku uththaravukodukka avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan.
iyeasu avanukku uththaravukodaamal: nee un inaththaaridaththil un veetti'rkuppoay, karththar unakku irangki, unakkuch seythavaika'laiyellaam avarka'lukku a'riviyen'ru sonnaar.
anthappadi avan poay, iyeasu thanakkuch seythavaika'laiyellaam thekkappoali ennum naattil pirasiththampa'n'naththodangkinaan; ellaarum aachchariyappattaarka'l.
iyeasu padavil ea'ri ma'rupadiyum ikkaraikku vanthu, kadaloaraththilirunthapoathu, thira'laana janangka'l avaridaththil koodivanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu, jepaaalayaththalaivaril oruvanaakiya yaveeru enpavan vanthu, avaraik ka'ndavudanea, avar paathaththilea vizhunthu:
en kumaaraththi mara'na avasthaippaduki'raa'l, ava'l aaroakkiyam adaiyumpadikku neer vanthu, ava'lmeal umathu kaika'lai vaiyum, appozhuthu pizhaippaa'l en'ru avarai mikavum vea'ndikko'ndaan.
avar avanoadeakoodap poanaar. thira'laana janangka'l avarukkup pinsen'ru, avarai nerukkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu pannira'ndu varushamaayp perumpaadu'l'la oru sthiree,
aneaka vaiththiyarka'laal mikavum varuththappattu, thanakku u'ndaanavaika'laiyellaam selavazhiththum, sat'raakilum ku'namadaiyaamal athika varuththappaduki'rapozhuthu,
iyeasuvaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattu: naan avarudaiya vasthirangka'laiyaakilum thottaal sosthamaavean en'ru solli;
janakkoottaththukku'l'lea avarukkup pinnaaka vanthu, avarudaiya vasthiraththaith thottaa'l.
udanea ava'ludaiya uthiraththin oo'ral nin'rupoayit'ru; antha veathanai neengki aaroakkiyamadainthathai ava'l than sareeraththil u'narnthaa'l.
udanea iyeasu thammilirunthu vallamai pu'rappattathaith thamakku'l a'rinthu, janakkoottaththukku'l'lea thirumpi: en vasthirangka'laith thottathu yaar en'ru keattaar.
avarudaiya seesharka'l avarai noakki: thira'laana janangka'l ummai nerukkikko'ndirukki'rathai neer ka'ndum, ennaith thottathu yaar en'ru keadki'reerea en'raarka'l.
ithaich seythava'laik kaa'numpadikku avar sut'rilum paarththaar.
thannidaththilea sampaviththathai a'rintha antha sthireeyaanava'l payanthu, nadungki, avar munpaaka vanthu vizhunthu, u'nmaiyaiyellaam avarukkuch sonnaa'l.
avar ava'laip paarththu: maka'lea, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu, nee samaathaanaththoadeapoay, un veathanai neengki, sukamaayiru en'raar.
avar ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, jepaaalayaththalaivanudaiya veettilirunthu silar vanthu: ummudaiya kumaaraththi mariththuppoanaa'l, ini ean poathakarai varuththappaduththuki'reer en'raarka'l.
avarka'l sonna vaarththaiyai iyeasu keattavudanea, jepaaalayaththalaivanai noakki: payappadaathea, visuvaasamu'l'lavanaayiru en'ru solli;
peathuruvaiyum, yaakkoapaiyum, yaakkoapin sakoatharan yoavaanaiyum thavira, vea'roruvarum thammoadea varuki'ratha'rku idangkodaamal;
jepaaalayaththalaivanudaiya veettilea vanthu, santhadiyaiyum mikavum azhuthu pulampuki'ravarka'laiyum ka'ndu,
u'l'lea piraveasiththu: neengka'l santhadipa'n'ni azhuki'rathenna? pi'l'lai marikkavillai, niththiraiyaayirukki'raa'l en'raar.

atha'rkaaka avaraip paarththu nakaiththaarka'l. ellaaraiyum avar ve'liyea poakappa'n'ni, pi'l'laiyin thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum thammoadea vanthavarka'laiyum azhaiththukko'ndu, pi'l'laiyiruntha idaththil piraveasiththu,
pi'l'laiyin kaiyaip pidiththu: thaleeththaakoomi en'raar; atha'rku, si'rupe'n'nea ezhunthiru en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'ru arththamaam.
udanea si'rupe'n ezhunthu nadanthaa'l; ava'l pannira'ndu vayathu'l'lava'laayirunthaa'l. avarka'l mikuntha aachchariyappattup piramiththaarka'l.
athai oruvarukkum a'riviyaathapadi avarka'lukku u'ruthiyaakak katta'laiyittu, ava'lukku aakaaram kodukkumpadi sonnaar.
avar avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, thaam va'larntha oorukku vanthaar; avarudaiya seesharum avaroadeakooda vanthaarka'l.

oayvunaa'laanapoathu, jepaaalayaththil upatheasampa'n'nath thodangkinaar. aneakar keattu, aachchariyappattu, ivaika'l ivanukku engkeayirunthu vanthathu? ivan kaika'linaal ippadippatta palaththa seykaika'l nadakkumpadi ivanukkuk kodukkappatta gnaanam eppadippattathu?

ivan thachchan allavaa? mariyaa'ludaiya kumaaran allavaa? yaakkoapu yoasea yoothaa seemoan enpavarka'lukkuch sakoatharan allavaa? ivan sakoatharika'lum ingkea nammidaththil irukki'raarka'l allavaa? en'ru solli, avaraikku'riththu ida'raladainthaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: theerkkatharisi oruvan than oorilum than inaththilum than veettilumeayan'ri vea'rengkum kanaveenamadaiyaan en'raar.
angkea avar sila noayaa'lika'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, avarka'laik ku'namaakkinatheayan'ri, vea'roru a'rputhamum seyyakkoodaamal,
avarka'ludaiya avisuvaasaththaik ku'riththu aachchariyappattu; kiraamangka'lilea sut'riththirinthu, upatheasampa'n'ninaar.
avar panniruvaraiyum azhaiththu, asuththa aavika'laith thuraththa avarka'lukku athikaarangkoduththu,
vazhikkup paiyaiyaakilum, appaththaiyaakilum, kachchaiyil kaasaiyaakilum, eduththukko'ndupoakaamal, oru thadiyai maaththiram eduththukko'ndupoakavum;
paatharadchaika'laip poattukko'ndupoakavum, ira'ndu angkika'laith thariyaathirukkavum katta'laiyittaar.
pinpu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l engkeayaakilum oru veettil piraveasiththaal, avvidaththai vittup pu'rappaduki'ravaraikkum angkeathaanea thangkiyirungka'l.

evarka'laakilum ungka'lai eat'rukko'l'laamalum, ungka'l vasanangka'laik kea'laamalum irunthaal, neengka'l avvidam vittup pu'rappadumpoathu, avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka ungka'l kaalka'lin keezhea padintha thoosiyai utha'rippoadungka'l. niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea anthap patta'naththi'rku neariduvathaippaarkkilum soathoam komoaraa patta'naththi'rku neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru solli, avarka'lai ira'ndu ira'ndupearaaka anuppinaar.
avarka'l pu'rappattuppoay: mananthirumpungka'l en'ru pirasangkiththu;
aneakam pisaasuka'laith thuraththi, aneakam noayaa'lika'lai e'n'ney poosich sosthamaakkinaarka'l.

avarudaiya pear pirasiththamaanapadiyinaal, earoathuraajaa avaraikku'riththuk kea'lvippattu: yoavaansnaanan mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaan, aakaiyaal avanidaththil inthap palaththa seykaika'l vi'langkuki'rathu en'raan.
silar: avar eliyaa en'raarka'l. vea'ru silar: avar, oru theerkkatharisi, allathu theerkkatharisika'lil oruvanaippoalirukki'raaren'ru sonnaarka'l.
earoathu athaik keattapozhuthu: avan naan sirachseatham pa'n'nina yoavaanthaan; avan mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaan en'raan.
earoathu than sakoatharanaakiya pilippuvin manaivi earoathiyaa'laith thanakku manaiviyaakkikko'ndapoathu,

yoavaan earoathai noakki: neer ummudaiya sakoatharan manaiviyai vaiththukko'lvathu niyaayamallaven'ru sonnathinimiththam, earoathu seavakarai anuppi, yoavaanaip pidiththuk kattik kaavalil vaiththirunthaan.
earoathiyaa'lum avanukkuch sathi ninaiththu, avanaik kon'rupoada manathaayirunthaa'l; aakilum ava'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.

atheanen'raal yoavaan neethiyum parisuththamumu'l'lavanen'ru earoathu a'rinthu, avanukkup payanthu, avanaip paathukaaththu, avan yoasanaiyinpadi aneaka kaariyangka'laich seythu, viruppaththoadea avan sollaik keattu vanthaan.

pinpu samayam vaayththathu; eppadiyen'raal, earoathu than jenmanaa'lilea thannudaiya pirapukka'lukkum, seanaathipathika'lukkum, kalileayaa naattin pirathaana manusharukkum oru virunthu pa'n'ninapoathu,

earoathiyaa'lin kumaaraththi sapai naduvea vanthu nadanampa'n'ni, earoathuvaiyum avanoadeakoodap panthiyirunthavarka'laiyum santhoashappaduththinaa'l. appozhuthu, raajaa si'rupe'n'nai noakki: unakku vea'ndiyathai ennidaththil kea'l, athai unakkuth tharuvean en'ru sonnathumallaamal;
nee ennidaththil ethaik keattaalum, athu en raajyaththil paathiyaanaalum, athai unakkuth tharuvean en'ru ava'lukku aa'naiyum ittaan.
appozhuthu, ava'l ve'liyea poay, naan enna keadkavea'ndum en'ru than thaayinidaththil keattaa'l. atha'rku ava'l: yoavaansnaananudaiya thalaiyaik kea'l en'raa'l.
udanea ava'l raajaavinidaththil seekkiramaay vanthu: neer ippozhuthea oru thaalaththil yoavaansnaananudaiya thalaiyai enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'ru keattaa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa mikuntha thukkamadainthaan; aakilum, aa'naiyinimiththamum, koodappanthiyirunthavarka'linimiththamum, ava'lukku athai ma'rukka manathillaamal;
udanea avanudaiya thalaiyaik ko'nduvarumpadi seavakanukkuk katta'laiyittu anuppinaan.

anthappadi avan poay, kaava'rkoodaththilea avanaich sirachseathampa'n'ni, avan thalaiyai oru thaalaththilea ko'nduvanthu, athai anthach si'rupe'n'nukkuk koduththaan; anthach si'rupe'n athaith than thaayinidaththil koduththaa'l.
avanudaiya seesharka'l athaik kea'lvippattu vanthu, avan udalai eduththu, oru kalla'raiyil vaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu appoasthalar iyeasuvinidaththil koodivanthu, thaangka'l seythavaika'l upatheasiththavaika'l yaavaiyum avarukku a'riviththaarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: vanaantharamaana oaridaththil thaniththuch sat'rea i'laippaa'rumpadi poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar; eanenil, varuki'ravarka'lum poaki'ravarka'lum aneakaraayirunthapadiyinaal poajanam pa'n'nuki'ratha'rkum avarka'lukkuch samayamillaathirunthathu.
appadiyea avarka'l thanimaiyaay oru padavil ea'ri vanaantharamaana oar idaththi'rkup poanaarka'l.

avarka'l pu'rappattup poaki'rathai janangka'l ka'ndaarka'l. avarai a'rintha aneakar sakala patta'nangka'lilumirunthu kaalnadaiyaay avvidaththi'rku oadi, avarka'lukku munnea angkea searnthu, avaridaththil koodivanthaarka'l.

iyeasu karaiyil vanthu, aneaka janangka'laik ka'ndu, avarka'l meayppanillaatha aaduka'laippoalirunthapadiyaal, avarka'lmeal manathuruki, aneaka kaariyangka'lai avarka'lukku upatheasikkath thodangkinaar.
vekunearam sen'rapinpu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: ithu vanaantharamaana idam, vekunearamumaayit'ru;

pusikki'ratha'rkum ivarka'lidaththil on'rumillai; aakaiyaal ivarka'l sut'riyirukki'ra kiraamangka'lukkum oorka'lukkum poay, thangka'lukkaaka appangka'lai vaangkikko'l'lumpadi ivarka'lai anuppividavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'lea avarka'lukkup poajanangkodungka'l en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l poay, irunoo'ru pa'naththukku appangka'lai vaangki ivarka'lukkup pusikkumpadi kodukkakkoodumoa en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ungka'lidaththil eththanai appangka'lu'ndu, poayppaarungka'l en'raar. avarka'l paarththuvanthu: ainthu appangka'lum, ira'ndu meenka'lum u'ndu en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu ellaaraiyum pasumpullinmeal panthipanthiyaaka udkaaravaikkumpadi avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
appadiyea varisai varisaiyaay, noo'runoo'rupearaakavum aimpathaimpathupearaakavum, udkaarnthaarka'l.

avar antha ainthu appangka'laiyum, antha ira'ndu meenka'laiyum eduththu, vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, aaseervathiththu, appangka'laippittu, avarka'lukkup parimaa'rumpadi thammudaiya seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar. appadiyea ira'ndu meenka'laiyum ellaarukkum pangkittaar.
ellaarum saappittuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l.
mealum appangka'lilum meenka'lilum meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'laip pannira'ndu koodaini'raiya eduththaarka'l.
appam saappitta purushar ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.
avar janangka'lai anuppividukaiyil, thammudaiya seesharka'l padavil ea'ri akkaraiyil pethsaayithaavukku ethiraaka, thamakku munnea poakumpadi, avarka'laith thurithappaduththinaar.
avar janangka'lai anuppivittapinpu, jepampa'n'numpadi oru malaiyinmeal ea'rinaar.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu padavu nadukkadalilirunthathu; avaroa karaiyilea thanimaiyaayirunthaar.

appozhuthu kaat'ru avarka'lukku ethiraayirunthapadiyinaal, avarka'l tha'ndu valikki'rathil varuththappaduki'rathai avar ka'ndu, iraaththiriyil naalaam jaamaththil kadalinmeal nadanthu avarka'lidaththil vanthu, avarka'laik kadanthupoaki'ravarpoal kaa'nappattaar.
avar kadalinmeal nadakki'rathai avarka'l ka'ndu, aaveasam en'ru e'n'ni, saththamittu ala'rinaarka'l.
avarka'lellaarum avaraik ka'ndu kalakkamadainthaarka'l. udanea avar avarka'loadea peasi: thidanko'l'lungka'l, naanthaan, payappadaathirungka'l en'ru solli,
avarka'l iruntha padavil ea'rinaar. appozhuthu kaat'ru amarnthathu; athinaal avarka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea mikavum piramiththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya iruthayam kadinamu'l'lathaayirunthapadiyinaal appangka'laik ku'riththu avarka'l u'naraama'rpoanaarka'l.
avarka'l kadalaik kadanthu keneasareaththennum naatti'rku vanthu, karaipidiththaarka'l.
avarka'l padavilirunthu i'rangkinavudanea, janangka'l avarai a'rinthu,
anthach sut'ruppu'ramengkum oadiththirinthu, pi'niyaa'lika'laip padukkaika'lil kidaththi, avar vanthirukki'raaren'ru kea'lvippatta idangka'lilellaam sumanthu ko'nduvanthaarka'l.

allaamalum avar piraveasiththa kiraamangka'l patta'nangka'l naaduka'l evaika'loa, avaika'lin santhaive'lika'lilea viyaathikkaararai vaiththu, avarudaiya vasthiraththin oaraththaiyaakilum avarka'l thodumpadi uththaravaakavea'ndum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l; avaraith thotta yaavarum sosthamaanaarka'l.
erusaleamilirunthu vantha pariseayarum, veathapaarakaril silarum avaridaththil koodivanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharil silar kazhuvaatha asuththa kaika'laalea poajanampa'n'nuki'rathai avarka'l ka'ndu kut'rampidiththaarka'l.
eanenil pariseayar muthaliya yoothar anaivarum munnoarka'lin paarampariyaththaik kaikko'ndu, adikkadi kaikazhuvinaalozhiyach saappidamaattaarka'l.

kadaiyilirunthu varumpoathum snaanampa'n'naamal saappidamaattaarka'l. appadiyea sempuka'laiyum ki'n'nangka'laiyum seppukkudangka'laiyum ma'naika'laiyum kazhuvuki'rathumallaamal, vea'ru aneaka aachaarangka'laiyum kaikko'nduvaruvaarka'l.
appozhuthu, anthap pariseayarum veathapaarakarum avarai noakki: ummudaiya seesharka'l munnoarka'lin paarampariyaththai mee'ri, ean kai kazhuvaamal saappiduki'raarka'l en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: intha janangka'l thangka'l uthaduka'linaal ennaik kanampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; avarka'l iruthayamoa enakkuth thooramaay vilakiyirukki'rathu en'rum,

manusharudaiya ka'rpanaika'lai upatheasangka'laakap poathiththu, vee'naay enakku aaraathanai seyki'raarka'l en'rum, ezhuthiyirukki'rapirakaaram, maayakkaararaakiya ungka'laik ku'riththu, easaayaa nan'raayth theerkkatharisanam solliyirukki'raan.

neengka'l theavanudaiya katta'laiyaith tha'l'livittu, manusharudaiya paarampariyaththaik kaikko'nduvaruki'ravarka'laay, ki'n'nangka'laiyum sempuka'laiyum kazhuvuki'reerka'l; mat'rum ippadippatta aneaka sadangkuka'laiyum anusariththuvaruki'reerka'l en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ungka'l paarampariyaththaik kaikko'l'lumpadikkuth theavanudaiya katta'laika'lai viyarththamaakkinathu nan'raayirukki'rathu.
eppadiyenil, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka en'rum, thakappanaiyaavathu thaayaiyaavathu ninthikki'ravan kollappadavea'ndum en'rum, moasea solliyirukki'raarea.

neengka'loa, oruvan than thakappanaiyaavathu thaayaiyaavathu noakki: unakku naan seyyaththakka uthavi ethu u'ndoa, athaik korpaan ennum kaa'nikkaiyaakak kodukki'rean en'ru sollivittaal avanudaiya kadamai theernthathu en'ru solli,
avanai ini than thakappanukkaavathu than thaaykkaavathu yaathoru uthaviyum seyya ottaamal;
neengka'l poathiththa ungka'l paarampariyaththinaal theavavasanaththai avamaakkuki'reerka'l. ithupoalavea neengka'l mat'rum aneaka kaariyangka'laiyum seyki'reerka'l en'ru sonnaar.
pinpu avar janangka'lellaaraiyum varavazhaiththu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ellaarum enakkuch sevikoduththu u'narungka'l.
manushanukkup pu'rampea irunthu avanukku'l'lea poaki'rathon'rum avanaith theettuppaduththamaattaathu; avan u'l'laththilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ravaika'lea avanaith theettuppaduththum.
keadki'ratha'rku oruvan kaathu'l'lavanaayirunthaal keadkakkadavan en'raar.
avar janangka'laivittu veettukku'l piraveasiththapoathu, avarudaiya seesharka'l avar sonna uvamaiyaikku'riththu avaridaththil visaariththaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: neengka'lum ivva'lavu u'narvillaathavarka'laa? pu'rampeayirunthu manushanukku'l'lea poaki'rathon'rum avanaith theettuppaduththamaattaathen'ru neengka'l a'rinthuko'l'lavillaiyaa?
athu avan iruthayaththil poakaamal vayit'rilea poaki'rathu; athilirunthu ellaap poajanangka'lin asuththangka'laiyum kazhikki'ra aasanavazhiyaay neengkippoakum.
manushanukku'l'lea irunthu pu'rappaduki'rathea manushanaith theettuppaduththum.
eppadiyenil, manusharudaiya iruthayaththi'rku'l'lirunthu pollaatha sinthanaika'lum, vipasaarangka'lum, veasiththanangka'lum, kolaipaathakangka'lum,
ka'lavuka'lum, poru'laasaika'lum, thushdaththanangka'lum, kapadum, kaamavikaaramum, vanka'n'num, thoosha'namum, perumaiyum, mathikeadum pu'rappattuvarum.
pollaangkaanavaika'laakiya ivaika'lellaam u'l'laththilirunthu pu'rappattu manushanaith theettuppaduththum en'raar.

pinpu, avar ezhunthu avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, theeru seethoan patta'nangka'lin ellaika'lil poay, oru veettukku'l piraveasiththu, oruvarum athai a'riyaathirukka virumpiyum, avar ma'raivaayirukkak koodaama'rpoayit'ru.
asuththa aavi pidiththiruntha oru si'ru pe'n'nin thaayaakiya oru sthiree avaraikku'riththuk kea'lvippattu, vanthu avar paathaththil vizhunthaa'l.
antha sthiree seeroapeanikkiyaa theasaththaa'laakiya kireakka sthireeyaayirunthaa'l; ava'l than maka'laip pidiththiruntha pisaasaith thuraththividavea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: munthip pi'l'laika'l thirupthiyadaiyattum; pi'l'laika'lin appaththai eduththu naaykkuttika'lukkup poaduki'rathu nallathalla en'raar.
atha'rku ava'l: meythaan, aa'ndavarea, aakilum, meajaiyin keezhirukkum naaykkuttika'l pi'l'laika'l sinthuki'ra thu'nikkaika'laith thinnumea en'raa'l.
appozhuthu, avar: nee sonna antha vaarththaiyinimiththam poakalaam. pisaasu un maka'lai vittu neengkippoayit'ru en'raar.
ava'l than veettukku vanthapozhuthu, pisaasu poayvittathaiyum, than maka'l kattilil paduththirukki'rathaiyum ka'ndaa'l.
ma'rupadiyum, avar theeru seethoan patta'nangka'lin ellaika'lai vittup pu'rappattu, thekkappoaliyin ellaika'lin vazhiyaayk kalileayaak kadalarukea vanthaar.
angkea konnaivaayudaiya oru sevidanai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu, avar thamathu kaiyai avanmeal vaikkumpadi vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
appozhuthu, avar avanai janakkoottaththai vittuth thaniyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, thammudaiya viralka'lai avan kaathuka'lil vaiththu, umizhnthu, avanudaiya naavaith thottu;
vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, perumoochchuvittu: eppaththaa en'raar; atha'rkuth thi'rakkappaduvaayaaka en'ru arththamaam.
udanea avanudaiya sevika'l thi'rakkappattu, avanudaiya naavin kattum avizhnthu, avan sevvaiyaayp peasinaan.
athai oruvarukkum sollavea'ndaamen'ru avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar; aakilum evva'lavu athikamaay avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaaroa, avva'lavu athikamaay avarka'l athaip pirasiththampa'n'ni,
ellaavat'raiyum nan'raaych seythaar; sevidar keadkavum, oomaiyar peasavumpa'n'nuki'raar en'ru solli, meanmealum aachchariyappattaarka'l.
antha naadka'lilea thira'laana janangka'l koodivanthirukkaiyil, avarka'l saappiduki'ratha'rku on'rumillaathapoathu, iyeasu thammudaiya seesharai azhaiththu:
janangka'lukkaakap parithapikki'rean, ivarka'l ippozhuthu ennidaththil thangkiyiruntha moon'runaa'laaych saappida on'rumillaathirukki'raarka'l.
ivarka'lil silar thooraththilirunthu vanthavarka'laakaiyaal, naan ivarka'laip pattiniyaay veetti'rku anuppivittaal vazhiyil soarnthupoavaarka'lea en'raar.
atha'rku avarudaiya seesharka'l: intha vanaantharaththilea oruvan engkeayirunthu appangka'laik ko'nduvanthu iththanai pearka'laith thirupthiyaakkakkoodum en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ungka'lidaththil eththanai appangka'l u'ndu en'ru keattaar. avarka'l: eazhu appangka'l u'ndu en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avar janangka'laith tharaiyilea panthiyirukkak katta'laiyittu, antha eazhu appangka'laiyum eduththu, sthoaththiram pa'n'ni, pittu, avarka'lukkup parimaa'rumpadi seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar; avarka'l janangka'lukkup parimaa'rinaarka'l.
sila si'rumeenka'lum avarka'lidaththil irunthathu; avar avaika'laiyum aaseervathiththu avarka'lukkup parimaa'rumpadi sonnaar.
avarka'l saappittuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l; meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'lai eazhu koodaini'raiya eduththaarka'l.
saappittavarka'l ea'rakku'raiya naalaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l. pinpu avar avarka'lai anuppivittaar.
udanea avar thammudaiya seesharoadeakoodap padavil ea'ri, thalmanooththaavin ellaika'lil vanthaar.
appozhuthu pariseayar vanthu avaroadea tharkkikkaththodangki, avaraich soathikkumpadi, vaanaththilirunthu oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaa'npikkavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.

avar thammudaiya aaviyil perumoochchuvittu: inthach santhathiyaar adaiyaa'lam theaduki'rathenna? inthach santhathiyaarukku oru adaiyaa'lamum kodukkappaduvathillaiyen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'lai vittu ma'rupadiyum padavil ea'ri, akkaraikkup poanaar.
seesharka'l appangka'laik ko'nduvara ma'ranthupoanaarka'l; padavilea avarka'lidaththil oru appam maaththiram irunthathu.
avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l pariseayarudaiya pu'liththamaavaikku'riththum earoathin pu'liththamaavaikku'riththum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l en'ru ka'rpiththaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: nammidaththil appangka'l illaathapadiyaal ippadich solluki'raar en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea yoasanaipa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.

iyeasu athai a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lidaththil appangka'l illaathapadiyinaal neengka'l yoasanaipa'n'nuki'rathenna? innum sinthiyaamalum u'naraamalum irukki'reerka'laa? innum ungka'l iruthayam kadinamaayirukki'rathaa?
ungka'lukkuk ka'nka'lirunthum kaa'naathirukki'reerka'laa? kaathuka'lirunthum kea'laathirukki'reerka'laa? ninaivukooraamalumirukki'reerka'laa?
naan ainthu appangka'lai aiyaayiram pearukkup pangkittapoathu, meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'lai eththanai koodaini'raiya eduththeerka'l en'ru keattaar. pannira'ndu en'raarka'l.
naan eazhu appangka'lai naalaayiram pearukkup pangkittapoathu, meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'lai eththanai koodaini'raiya eduththeerka'l en'ru keattaar. eazhu en'raarka'l.
appadiyaanaal, neengka'l u'naraathirukki'rathu eppadi en'raar.
pinpu avar pethsaayithaa oorukku vanthaar; appozhuthu oru kurudanai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu, avanaith thodumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
avar kurudanudaiya kaiyaip pidiththu, avanaik kiraamaththukku ve'liyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avan ka'nka'lil umizhnthu, avanmeal kaika'lai vaiththu: ethaiyaakilum kaa'nki'raayaa en'ru keattaar.
avan ea'rittuppaarththu: nadakki'ra manusharai marangka'laippoalak kaa'nki'rean en'raan.
pinpu avar ma'rupadiyum avan ka'nka'linmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, avanai ea'rittup paarkkumpadi seythaar; appozhuthu avan sosthamadainthu, yaavaraiyum the'livaayk ka'ndaan.
pinpu avar avanai noakki: nee kiraamaththil piraveasiyaamalum, kiraamaththil ithai oruvarukkum sollaamalum iru en'ru solli, avanai veetti'rku anuppivittaar.

pinpu, iyeasuvum avarudaiya seesharka'lum pu'rappattu, pilippuch sesariyaa patta'naththaich searntha kiraamangka'lukkup poanaarka'l. vazhiyilea avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: janangka'l ennai yaar en'ru solluki'raarka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: silar ummai yoavaansnaanan en'rum, silar eliyaa en'rum, vea'ru silar theerkkatharisika'lil oruvar en'rum solluki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: neengka'l ennai yaar en'ru solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar; peathuru pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer ki'risthu en'raan.
appozhuthu thammaikku'riththu oruvarukkum sollaathapadikku avarka'lukku u'ruthiyaayk katta'laiyittaar.

allaamalum, manushakumaaran pala paaduka'lpattu, moopparaalum pirathaana aasaariyaraalum veathapaarakaraalum aakaathavanen'ru tha'l'lappattu, kollappattu, moon'runaa'laikkuppinpu uyirththezhunthirukkavea'ndiyathen'ru avarka'lukkup poathikkath thodangkinaar.
intha vaarththaiyai avar thaaraa'lamaakach sonnaar. appozhuthu, peathuru avaraith thaniyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avaraik kadinthuko'l'lath thodangkinaan.

avar thirumpith thammudaiya seesharaip paarththu, peathuruvai noakki: enakkup pinnaakappoa, saaththaanea, nee theavanukku eat'ravaika'laich sinthiyaamal manusharukku eat'ravaika'laich sinthikki'raay en'ru solli, avanaik kadinthu ko'ndaar.

pinpu avar janangka'laiyum thammudaiya seesharka'laiyum thammidaththil azhaiththu: oruvan en pinnea vara virumpinaal, avan thannaiththaan ve'ruththu, than siluvaiyai eduththukko'ndu, ennaip pinpat'rakkadavan.
than jeevanai iradchikka virumpuki'ravan athai izhanthupoavaan, ennimiththamaakavum suviseashaththinimiththamaakavum than jeevanai izhanthupoaki'ravan athai iradchiththukko'l'luvaan.
manushan ulakam muzhuvathaiyum aathaayappaduththikko'ndaalum, than jeevanai nashdappaduththinaal avanukku laapam enna?
manushan than jeevanukku eedaaka ennaththaik koduppaan?

aathalaal vipasaaramum paavamumu'l'la inthach santhathiyil ennaikku'riththum en vaarththaika'laikku'riththum evan vedkappaduvaanoa, avanaik ku'riththu manushakumaaranum thamathu pithaavin makimaiporunthinavaraayp parisuththa thootharka'loadungkooda varumpoathu vedkappaduvaar en'raar.

an'riyum, avar avarka'lai noakki: ingkea ni'rki'ravarka'lil silar theavanudaiya raajyam palaththoadea varuvathaik kaa'numun, mara'naththai rusipaarppathillaiyen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
aa'runaa'laikkup pinpu, iyeasu peathuruvaiyum yaakkoapaiyum yoavaanaiyum azhaiththu, uyarntha malaiyinmeal avarka'laith thaniyea koottikko'ndupoay, avarka'lukku munpaaka ma'ruroopamaanaar.
avarudaiya vasthiram u'raintha mazhaiyaippoal poomiyilea entha va'n'naanum ve'lukkakkoodaatha ve'nmaiyaayp pirakaasiththathu.
appozhuthu moaseayum eliyaavum iyeasuvudanea peasuki'ravarka'laaka avarka'lukkuk kaa'nappattaarka'l.

appozhuthu peathuru iyeasuvai noakki: rapee, naam ingkea irukki'rathu nallathu; umakku oru koodaaramum, moaseakku oru koodaaramum, eliyaavukku oru koodaaramumaaka, moon'ru koodaarangka'laip poaduvoam en'raan.
avarka'l mikavum payanthirunthapadiyaal, thaan peasuki'rathu innathen'ru a'riyaamal ippadich sonnaan.
appozhuthu, oru meakam avarka'lmeal nizhalittathu: ivar ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ivarukkuch sevikodungka'l en'ru antha meakaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
udanea avarka'l sut'rilum paarththapoathu, iyeasu oruvaraiththavira vea'roruvaraiyum kaa'navillai.

avarka'l malaiyilirunthu i'rangkuki'rapoathu, avar avarka'lai noakki: manushakumaaran mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthirukkumvaraikkum, neengka'l ka'ndavaika'lai oruvarukkum sollavea'ndaam en'ru katta'laiyittaar.
mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthiruppathu ennaven'ru avarka'l oruvaridaththil oruvar visaariththu, antha vaarththaiyaith thangka'lukku'l'lea adakkikko'ndu:
eliyaa munthi varavea'ndumen'ru veathapaarakar solluki'raarka'lea, atheppadiyen'ru avaridaththil keattaarka'l.

avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: eliyaa munthivanthu ellaavat'raiyum seerppaduththuvathu meythaan; allaamalum, manushakumaaran pala paaduka'lpattu, avamathikkappaduvaaren'ru, avaraikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rathea athu eppadi en'raar.
aanaalum eliyaa vanthaayit'ru, avanaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'ra pirakaaram thangka'lukku ishdamaanapadi avanukkuch seythaarka'len'ru, ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pinpu avar seesharidaththil vanthapoathu, avarka'laich sut'rith thira'laana janangka'l ni'rki'rathaiyum, avarka'loadea veathapaarakar tharkkikki'rathaiyum ka'ndaar.
janangka'lellaarum avaraik ka'ndavudanea mikavum aachchariyappattu, oadivanthu, avarukku vanthanagnseythaarka'l.
avar veathapaarakarai noakki: neengka'l ivarka'loadea ennaththaik ku'riththuth tharkkampa'n'nuki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar.
appozhuthu janakkoottaththil oruvan avarai noakki: poathakarea, oomaiyaana oru aavi pidiththa en makanai ummidaththil ko'nduvanthean.

athu avanai engkea pidiththaalum angkea avanai alaikkazhikki'rathu; appozhuthu avan nuraitha'l'li, pallaikkadiththu, soarnthupoaki'raan. athaith thuraththividumpadi ummudaiya seesharidaththil keattean; avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru en'raan.

avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: visuvaasamillaatha santhathiyea, ethuvaraikkum naan ungka'loadu iruppean? ethuvaraikkum ungka'lidaththil po'rumaiyaay iruppean? avanai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raar.
avanai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l. avaraik ka'ndavudanea, antha aavi avanai alaikkazhiththathu; avan tharaiyilea vizhunthu, nuraitha'l'lip pura'ndaan.
avar avanudaiya thakappanai noakki: ithu ivanukku u'ndaaki evva'lavu kaalamaayit'ru en'ru keattaar. atha'rku avan: si'ruvayathumutha'rko'ndea u'ndaayirukki'rathu;
ivanaik kollumpadikku athu aneakantharam theeyilum tha'n'neerilum tha'l'lit'ru. neer eathaakilum seyyakkoodumaanaal, engka'lmeal manathirangki, engka'lukku uthaviseyyavea'ndum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee visuvaasikkakkoodumaanaal aakum, visuvaasikki'ravanukku ellaam koodum en'raar.
udanea pi'l'laiyin thakappan: visuvaasikki'rean aa'ndavarea, en avisuvaasam neengkumpadi uthaviseyyum en'ru ka'n'neeroadea saththamittuch sonnaan.

appozhuthu janangka'l koottamaay oadivaruki'rathai iyeasu ka'ndu, antha asuththa aaviyai noakki: oomaiyum sevidumaana aaviyea, ivanai vittup pu'rappattuppoa, ini ivanukku'l poakaathea en'ru naan unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean en'ru athai athattinaar.
appozhuthu athu saththamittu, avanai mikavum alaikkazhiththup pu'rappattuppoayit'ru. avan seththuppoanaan en'ru aneakar sollaththakkathaakach seththavanpoal kidanthaan.
iyeasu avan kaiyaippidiththu, avanaith thookkinaar; udanea avan ezhunthirunthaan.
veettil avar piraveasiththapozhuthu, avarudaiya seesharka'l: athaith thuraththivida engka'laal ean koodaama'rpoayit'ru en'ru avaridaththil thaniththuk keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ivvakaip pisaasu jepaththinaalum upavaasaththinaalumeayan'ri mat'revvithaththinaalum pu'rappattuppoakaathu en'raar.
pinpu avvidam vittup pu'rappattu, kalileayaavaik kadanthupoanaarka'l; athai oruvarum a'riyaathirukka vea'ndumen'ru virumpinaar.

eanenil, manushakumaaran manushar kaika'lil oppukkodukkappaduvaar en'rum, avarka'l avaraik kon'rupoaduvaarka'l en'rum; kollappattu, moon'raam naa'lilea uyirththezhunthiruppaar en'rum avar thammudaiya seesharka'lukkup poathakampa'n'nich solliyirunthaar.
avarka'loa antha vaarththaiyai a'rinthuko'l'lavillai, athaikku'riththu avaridaththil keadkavum payanthaarka'l.
avar kapparnakoomukku vanthu, veettilea irukkumpoathu, avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l vazhiyilea ethaikku'riththu ungka'lukku'l'lea tharkkampa'n'nineerka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l peasaamal irunthaarka'l; eanenil avarka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea evan periyavan en'ru vazhiyil tharkkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar udkaarnthu, panniruvaraiyum azhaiththu: evanaakilum muthalvanaayirukka virumpinaal avan ellaarukkum kadaiyaanavanum, ellaarukkum oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukkakkadavan en'ru solli;
oru si'ru pi'l'laiyai eduththu, athai avarka'l naduvilea ni'ruththi, athai a'naiththukko'ndu:

ippadippatta si'ru pi'l'laika'lil on'rai en naamaththinaalea eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan; ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai alla, ennai anuppinavarai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan en'raar.

appozhuthu yoavaan avarai noakki: poathakarea, nammaip pinpat'raathavan oruvan umathu naamaththinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'rathaik ka'ndoam; avan nammaip pinpat'raathavanaanathaal, avanaith thaduththoam en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: avanaith thadukkavea'ndaam; en naamaththinaalea a'rputhagn seyki'ravan e'lithaay ennaikku'riththuth theengku sollamaattaan.
namakku viroathamaayiraathavan namathu padchaththilirukki'raan.

neengka'l ki'risthuvinudaiyavarka'laayirukki'rapadiyinaalea, en naamaththinimiththam ungka'lukku oru kalasam tha'n'neer kudikkak kodukki'ravan than palanai adaiyaama'rpoavathillai en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ra inthach si'riyaril oruvanukku ida'ral u'ndaakkuki'ravan evanoa, avanudaiya kazhuththil eanthirakkallaik katti, samuththiraththil avanaith tha'l'lippoaduki'rathu avanukku nalamaayirukkum.

un kai unakku ida'ral u'ndaakkinaal, athaith tha'riththuppoadu; nee ira'ndu kaiyudaiyavanaay aviyaatha akkiniyu'l'la narakaththilea poavathaippaarkkilum, oonanaay jeevanukku'l piraveasippathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.
angkea avarka'l puzhu saavaamalum akkini aviyaamalumirukkum.

un kaal unakku ida'ral u'ndaakkinaal athaith tha'riththuppoadu; nee ira'ndu kaaludaiyavanaay aviyaatha akkiniyu'l'la narakaththilea tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, sappaa'niyaay jeevanukku'l piraveasippathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.
angkea avarka'l puzhu saavaamalum akkini aviyaamalumirukkum.

un ka'n unakku ida'ral u'ndaakkinaal, athaip pidungkippoadu; nee ira'ndu ka'n'nudaiyavanaay naraka akkiniyilea tha'l'lappaduvathaippaarkkilum, ot'raik ka'n'nanaay theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathu unakku nalamaayirukkum.
angkea avarka'l puzhu saavaamalum akkini aviyaamalumirukkum.
enthap paliyum uppinaal uppidappaduvathupoala, entha manushanum akkiniyinaal uppidappaduvaan.

uppu nallathuthaan, uppu saaramat'ruppoanaal, atha'rku ethinaalea saaramu'ndaakkuveerka'l? ungka'lukku'l'lea uppudaiyavarka'laayirungka'l, oruvaroadoruvar samaathaanamu'l'lavarka'laayum irungka'l en'raar.

avar avvidam vittezhunthu, yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilu'l'la theasaththin vazhiyaay yootheayaavin ellaika'lil vanthaar. janangka'l ma'rupadiyum avaridaththil koodivanthaarka'l. avar thammudaiya vazhakkaththinpadiyea ma'rupadiyum avarka'lukkup poathakampa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu pariseayar, avaraich soathikkavea'ndumen'ru, avaridaththil vanthu: purushanaanavan than manaiviyaith tha'l'lividuvathu niyaayamaa en'ru keattaarka'l.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: moasea ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'rathu enna en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: tha'l'lutha'rseettai ezhuthikkoduththu, ava'laith tha'l'lividalaamen'ru moasea uththaravukoduththirukki'raar en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ungka'l iruthayakadinaththinimiththam inthak katta'laiyai ungka'lukku ezhuthikkoduththaan.
aakilum, aathiyilea manusharaich sirushdiththa theavan avarka'lai aa'num pe'n'numaaka u'ndaakkinaar.
ithinimiththam purushanaanavan than thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum vittuth than manaiviyoadea isainthiruppaan;
avarka'l iruvarum orea maamsamaayiruppaarka'l; ivvithamaay avarka'l iruvaraayiraamal orea maamsamaayirukki'raarka'l.
aakaiyaal, theavan i'naiththathai manushan pirikkaathirukkakkadavan en'raar.
pinpu veettilea avarudaiya seesharka'l anthak kaariyaththaikku'riththu ma'rupadiyum avaridaththil visaariththaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: evanaakilum than manaiviyaith tha'l'livittu, vea'roruththiyai vivaakampa'n'ninaal, avan ava'lukku viroathamaay vipasaaragnseyki'ravanaayiruppaan.
manaiviyum than purushanaith tha'l'livittu, vea'roruvanai vivaakampa'n'ninaal, vipasaaragnseyki'rava'laayiruppaa'l en'raar.
appozhuthu, si'ru pi'l'laika'lai avar thodumpadikku avarka'lai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l; ko'nduvanthavarka'laich seesharka'l athattinaarka'l.
iyeasu athaik ka'ndu, visanamadainthu: si'ru pi'l'laika'l ennidaththil varuki'ratha'rku idangkodungka'l; avarka'laith thadaipa'n'naathirungka'l; theavanudaiya raajyam appadippattavarka'ludaiyathu.
evanaakilum si'ru pi'l'laiyaippoal theavanudaiya raajyaththai eat'rukko'l'laavittaal, avan athil piraveasippathillaiyen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'lai a'naiththukko'ndu, avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, avarka'lai aaseervathiththaar.

pinpu avar pu'rappattu vazhiyilea poakaiyil, oruvan oadivanthu, avarukku munpaaka muzhangkaalpadiyittu: nalla poathakarea, niththiyajeevanaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi naan ennaseyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: nee ennai nallavan en'ru solvaanean? theavan oruvar thavira nallavan oruvanumillaiyea.

vipasaaragn seyyaathiruppaayaaka, kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka, ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka, poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka, vagnchanai seyyaathiruppaayaaka, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka enki'ra ka'rpanaika'lai a'rinthirukki'raayea en'raar.
atha'rku avan: poathakarea, ivaika'laiyellaam en si'ru vayathumuthal kaikko'ndirukki'rean en'raan.

iyeasu avanaip paarththu, avanidaththil anpukoornthu: unnidaththil oru ku'raivu u'ndu; nee poay, unakku u'ndaanavaika'laiyellaam vit'ru, thariththirarukkuk kodu; appozhuthu paraloakaththilea unakkup pokkisham u'ndaayirukkum; pinpu siluvaiyai eduththukko'ndu, ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar.
avan mikuntha aasthiyu'l'lavanaayirunthapadiyaal, intha vaarththaiyaik keattu, manamadinthu, thukkaththoadea poayvittaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu sut'rippaarththu, thammudaiya seesharai noakki: aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'l theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathu evva'lavu arithaayirukki'rathu en'raar.

seesharka'l avarudaiya vaarththaika'laikku'riththu aachchariyappattaarka'l. iyeasu pinnum avarka'lai noakki: pi'l'laika'lea, aisuvariyaththinmeal nampikkaiyaayirukki'ravarka'l theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasikki'rathu evva'lavu arithaayirukki'rathu!
aisuvariyavaan theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathaippaarkkilum, ottakamaanathu oosiyin kaathilea nuzhaivathu e'lithaayirukkum en'raar.
avarka'l pinnum athikamaay aachchariyappattu: appadiyaanaal yaar iradchikkappadakkoodum en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'laip paarththu: manusharaal ithu koodaathathuthaan, theavanaal ithu koodaathathalla; theavanaalea ellaam koodum en'raar.
appozhuthu peathuru avarai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l ellaavat'raiyumvittu, ummaip pinpat'rinoamea, en'ru sollaththodangkinaan.

atha'rku iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennimiththamaakavum, suviseashaththinimiththamaakavum, veettaiyaavathu, sakoathararaiyaavathu, sakoatharika'laiyaavathu, thakappanaiyaavathu, thaayaiyaavathu, manaiviyaiyaavathu, pi'l'laika'laiyaavathu, nilangka'laiyaavathu vittavan evanum,

ippozhuthu immaiyilea, thunpangka'loadeakooda noo'raththanaiyaaka, veeduka'laiyum, sakoathararaiyum, sakoatharika'laiyum, thaayka'laiyum, pi'l'laika'laiyum, nilangka'laiyum, ma'rumaiyilea niththiyajeevanaiyum adaivaan en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aakilum munthinoar aneakar pinthinoaraayum, pinthinoar aneakar munthinoaraayum iruppaarka'l en'raar.

pinpu avarka'l erusaleamukkup pirayaa'namaayp poakaiyil, iyeasu avarka'lukku munnea nadanthupoanaar; avarka'l thikaiththu, avarukkup pinnea, payaththoadea poanaarka'l. appozhuthu avar panniruvaraiyum azhaiththu, thamakkuch sampavikkappoaki'ravaika'lai avarka'lukku ma'rupadiyum sollaththodangkinaar:

ithoa, erusaleamukkup poaki'roam; angkea manushakumaaran pirathaana aasaariyaridaththilum veathapaarakaridaththilum oppukkodukkappaduvaar; avarka'l avarai mara'na aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththu, pu'raththeasaththaaridaththil oppukkoduppaarka'l.
avarka'l avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ni, avarai vaarinaal adiththu, avarmeal thuppi, avaraik kolaiseyvaarka'l; aakilum moon'raam naa'lilea avar uyiroadea ezhunthiruppaar en'raar.
appozhuthu sepetheayuvin kumaararaakiya yaakkoapum yoavaanum avaridaththil vanthu: poathakarea, naangka'l keattukko'l'lappoaki'rathai neer engka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'roam en'raarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'lukku ennaseyyavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: umathu makimaiyilea, engka'lil oruvan umathu valathupaarisaththilum, oruvan umathu idathupaarisaththilum udkaarnthirukkumpadi engka'lukku aru'lseyyavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l keattukko'l'luki'rathu innathu en'ru ungka'lukkea theriyavillai. naan kudikkum paaththiraththil neengka'l kudikkavum, naan pe'rum snaanaththai neengka'l pe'ravum, ungka'laal koodumaa en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: koodum en'raarka'l. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: naan kudikkum paaththiraththil neengka'l kudippeerka'l, naan pe'rum snaanaththaiyum neengka'l pe'ruveerka'l.

aanaalum en valathupaarisaththilum en idathupaarisaththilum udkaarnthirukkumpadi evarka'lukku aayaththampa'n'nappattirukki'rathoa avarka'lukkeayallaamal, mat'roruvarukkum athai aru'luvathu en kaariyamalla en'raar.
mat'rap paththuppearum athaikkeattu, yaakkoapin mealum yoavaanin mealum erichchalaanaarka'l.

appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'laik kittavarachseythu: pu'rajaathiyaarukku athikaarika'laaka e'n'nappattavarka'l avarka'lai i'rumaappaay aa'luki'raarka'l en'rum, avarka'lil periyavarka'l avarka'lmeal kadinamaay athikaaram seluththuki'raarka'l en'rum neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
ungka'lukku'l'lea appadi irukkalaakaathu; ungka'lil evanaakilum periyavanaayirukka virumpinaal, avan ungka'lukkup pa'nividaikkaaranaayirukkakkadavan.
ungka'lil evanaakilum muthanmaiyaanavanaayirukka virumpinaal, avan ellaarukkum oozhiyakkaaranaayirukkakkadavan.
appadiyea, manushakumaaranum oozhiyangko'l'lumpadi varaamal, oozhiyagnseyyavum, aneakarai meedkumporu'laakath thammudaiya jeevanaik kodukkavum vanthaar en'raar.

pinpu avarka'l erikoavukku vanthaarka'l. avarum avarudaiya seesharka'lum thira'laana janangka'lum erikoavaivittup pu'rappaduki'rapoathu, thimeayuvin makanaakiya parthimeayu enki'ra oru kurudan, vazhiyarukea udkaarnthu, pichchai keattukko'ndirunthaan.
avan nasareayanaakiya iyeasu varuki'raaren'ru kea'lvippattu: iyeasuvea, thaaveethin kumaaranea, enakku irangkum en'ru kooppidath thodangkinaan.
avan peasaathirukkumpadi aneakar avanai athattinaarka'l. avanoa: thaaveethin kumaaranea, enakku irangkum en'ru, munnilum athikamaayk kooppittaan.
iyeasu nin'ru, avanai azhaiththuvarach sonnaar. avarka'l anthak kurudanai azhaiththu: thidanko'l, ezhunthiru, unnai azhaikki'raar en'raarka'l.
udanea avan than mealvasthiraththai e'rinthuvittu, ezhunthu, iyeasuvinidaththil vanthaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: naan unakku enna seyyavea'ndum en'rirukki'raay en'raar. atha'rku anthak kurudan: aa'ndavarea, naan paarvaiyadaiyavea'ndum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee poakalaam, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu en'raar. udanea avan paarvaiyadainthu, vazhiyilea iyeasuvukkup pinsen'raan.
avarka'l erusaleamukkuch sameepamaaych searnthu, olivamalaikku arukaana pethpakea peththaaniyaa ennum oorka'lukku vanthapoathu, avar thammudaiya seesharil ira'ndupearai noakki:

ungka'lukku ethireayirukki'ra kiraamaththukkup poangka'l; athil piraveasiththavudanea, manushar oruvarum orukkaalum ea'riyiraatha oru kazhuthaikkutti kattiyirukkak kaa'npeerka'l, athai avizhththuk ko'ndu vaarungka'l.
ean ippadich seyki'reerka'l en'ru oruvan ungka'lidaththil keattaal: ithu aa'ndavarukku vea'ndumen'ru sollungka'l; udanea athai ivvidaththi'rku anuppividuvaan en'ru solli, avarka'lai anuppinaar.
avarka'l poay, ve'liyea iruvazhichsanthiyil oru vaasalarukea kattiyiruntha anthak kuttiyaik ka'ndu, athai avizhththaarka'l.
appozhuthu angkea nin'ravarka'lil silar: neengka'l kuttiyai avizhkki'rathu ennaven'raarka'l.
iyeasu ka'rpiththapadiyea avarka'lukku uththaravu sonnaarka'l. appozhuthu, avarka'laip poakavittaarka'l.
avarka'l anthak kuttiyai iyeasuvinidaththil ko'nduvanthu, athinmeal thangka'l vasthirangka'laip poattaarka'l; avar athinmeal ea'rippoanaar.
aneakar thangka'l vasthirangka'lai vazhiyilea viriththaarka'l; vea'ru silar marakki'laika'laith tha'riththu vazhiyilea parappinaarka'l.
munnadappaarum pinnadappaarum: oasannaa! karththarin naamaththinaalea varuki'ravar sthoaththirikkappattavar;
karththarin naamaththinaalea varuki'ra nammudaiya pithaavaakiya thaaveethin raajyam aaseervathikkappaduvathaaka; unnathaththilea oasannaa en'ru solli aarppariththaarka'l.
appozhuthu, iyeasu erusaleamukku vanthu, theavaalayaththil piraveasiththu, ellaavat'raiyum sut'rippaarththu, saayangkaalamaanapoathu, panniruvaroadungkoodap peththaaniyaavukkup poanaar.
ma'runaa'lilea avarka'l peththaaniyaavilirunthu pu'rappattuvarukaiyil, avarukkup pasiyu'ndaayit'ru.

appozhuthu ilaika'lu'l'la oru aththimaraththaith thooraththilea ka'ndu, athil eathaakilum akappadumoa en'ru paarkkavanthaar. aththippazhak kaalamaayiraathapadiyaal, avar athinidaththil vanthapoathu athil ilaika'laiyallaamal, vea'ron'raiyum kaa'navillai.
appozhuthu iyeasu athaip paarththu: ithumuthal orukkaalum oruvanum unnidaththil kaniyaip pusiyaathirukkakkadavan en'raar; athai avarudaiya seesharka'l keattaarka'l.

avarka'l erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l. iyeasu theavaalayaththil piraveasiththu, aalayaththil vi'rki'ravarka'laiyum ko'l'luki'ravarka'laiyum thuraththivittu, kaasukkaararudaiya palakaika'laiyum, pu'raa vi'rki'ravarka'ludaiya aasanangka'laiyum kavizhththu,
oruvanum theavaalayaththin vazhiyaaka yaathoru pa'ndaththaiyum ko'ndupoakavidaamal:
ennudaiya veedu ellaa janangka'lukkum jepaveedu ennappadum en'ru ezhuthiyirukkavillaiyaa? neengka'loa athaik ka'l'lar kukaiyaakkineerka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuch solli upatheasiththaar.

athai veathapaarakarum pirathaana aasaariyarum keattu, avaraik kolaiseyya vakaitheadinaarka'l; aakilum janangka'lellaarum avarudaiya upatheasaththaikku'riththu aachchariyappattapadiyinaalea avarukkup payanthirunthaarka'l.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu avar nakaraththilirunthu pu'rappattuppoanaar.
ma'runaa'l kaalaiyilea avarka'l avvazhiyaayp poakumpoathu, antha aththimaram vearoadea pattuppoayirukki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l.
peathuru ninaivukoornthu, avarai noakki: rapee, ithoa, neer sapiththa aththimaram pattuppoayit'ru en'raan.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: theavanidaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l.

evanaakilum intha malaiyaip paarththu: nee peyarnthu, samuththiraththilea tha'l'lu'ndupoa en'ru solli, thaan sonnapadiyea nadakkum en'ru than iruthayaththil santheakappadaamal visuvaasiththaal, avan sonnapadiyea aakum en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aathalaal, neengka'l jepampa'n'numpoathu evaika'laik keattukko'lveerka'loa, avaika'laip pet'rukko'lvoam en'ru visuvaasiyungka'l, appozhuthu avaika'l ungka'lukku u'ndaakum en'ru solluki'rean.

neengka'l nin'ru jepampa'n'numpoathu, oruvanpearil ungka'lukku yaathoru ku'rai u'ndaayirukkumaanaal, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaa ungka'l thappithangka'lai ungka'lukku mannikkumpadi, anthak ku'raiyai avanukku manniyungka'l.
neengka'l manniyaathiruppeerka'laanaal, paraloakaththilirukki'ra ungka'l pithaavum ungka'l thappithangka'lai manniyaathiruppaar en'raar.
avarka'l ma'rupadiyum erusaleamukku vanthaarka'l. avar theavaalayaththilea ulaavikko'ndirukkaiyil, pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum moopparum avaridaththil vanthu:
neer entha athikaaraththinaal ivaika'laich seyki'reer? ivaika'laich seyki'ratha'rku athikaaraththai umakkuk koduththavar yaar en'ru keattaarka'l.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naanum ungka'lidaththil oru kaariyaththaik keadki'rean, neengka'l enakku uththaravu sollungka'l, appozhuthu naanum inna athikaaraththinaalea ivaika'laich seyki'reanen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluvean.
yoavaan koduththa snaanam theavanaal u'ndaayit'roa, manusharaal u'ndaayit'roa, enakku uththaravu sollungka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: theavanaal u'ndaayit'ren'ru solvoamaanaal, pinnai ean avanai visuvaasikkavillaiyen'ru keadpaar.

manusharaal u'ndaayit'ren'ru solvoamaanaal, janangka'lukkup payappadavea'ndiyathaayirukkum; ellaarum yoavaanai meyyaakath theerkkatharisiyen'ru e'n'nuki'raarka'lea en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea aaloasanaipa'n'ni;
iyeasuvukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: engka'lukkuth theriyaathu en'raarka'l. appozhuthu iyeasu: naanum inna athikaaraththinaalea ivaika'laich seyki'rean en'ru ungka'lukkuch sollean en'raar.

pinpu avar uvamaika'laay avarka'lukkuch sollaththodangkinathaavathu: oru manushan oru thiraadchaththoattaththai u'ndaakki, athaich sut'rilum vealiyadaiththu, irasaththottiyai u'ndupa'n'ni, koapuraththaiyum katti, thoattakkaararukku athaik kuththakaiyaaka vittu, pu'raththeasaththukkup poayirunthaan.
thoattakkaararidaththil thiraadchaththoattaththuk kanika'lil than paakaththai vaangkikko'nduvarumpadi, paruvakaalaththilea avarka'lidaththil oru oozhiyakkaaranai anuppinaan.
avarka'l avanaip pidiththu, adiththu, ve'rumaiyaay anuppivittaarka'l.
pinpu vea'roru oozhiyakkaaranai avarka'lidaththil anuppinaan; avarka'l avanmeal kalle'rinthu, thalaiyilea kaayappaduththi, avamaanappaduththi, anuppivittaarka'l.
ma'rupadiyum vea'roruvanai anuppinaan; avanai avarka'l kolaiseythaarka'l. vea'ru aneakaraiyum anuppinaan; avarka'lil silarai adiththu, silaraik kon'rupoattaarka'l.
avanukkup piriyamaana orea kumaaran irunthaan; en kumaaranukku agnchuvaarka'len'ru solli, avanaiyum kadaisiyilea avarka'lidaththil anuppinaan.
thoattakkaararoa: ivan suthantharavaa'li, ivanaik kolaiseyvoam vaarungka'l; appozhuthu suthantharam nammudaiyathaakum en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndu;
avanaip pidiththuk kolaiseythu, thiraadchaththoattaththukkup pu'rampea poattuvittaarka'l.
appadiyirukka, thiraadchaththoattaththukku ejamaan enna seyvaan? avan vanthu anthath thoattakkaararaich sangkariththu, thiraadchaththoattaththai mat'ravarka'lukku oppukkoduppaan allavaa?
veedu kattuki'ravarka'l aakaathen'ru tha'l'lina kallea moolaikkuth thalaikkallaayit'ru;
athu karththaraalea aayit'ru, athu nammudaiya ka'nka'lukku aachchariyamaayirukki'rathu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra vaakkiyaththai neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa en'raar.
intha uvamaiyaith thangka'laikku'riththuch sonnaaren'ru avarka'l a'rinthu, avaraip pidikka vakaitheadinaarka'l; aanaalum janaththukkup payanthu, avarai vittup poayvittaarka'l.
avarka'l, peachchilea avarai akappaduththumpadikku, pariseayarilum earoathiyarilum silarai avaridaththil anuppinaarka'l.

avarka'l vanthu: poathakarea, neer saththiyamu'l'lavaren'rum, evanaikku'riththum umakkuk kavalaiyillaiyen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam, neer mukathaadcha'niyam illaathavaraayth theavanudaiya maarkkaththaich saththiyamaayp poathikki'reer, iraayanukku varikodukki'rathu niyaayamoa allavoa? naam kodukkalaamoa, kodukkakkoodaathoa? en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya maayaththai avar a'rinthu: neengka'l ennai ean soathikki'reerka'l? naan paarkkumpadikku oru pa'naththai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l athaik ko'nduvanthaarka'l. appozhuthu avar: inthach suroopamum mealezhuththum yaarudaiyathu en'ru keattaar; iraayanudaiyathu en'raarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: iraayanudaiyathai iraayanukkum, theavanudaiyathaith theavanukkum seluththungka'l en'raar. avarka'l avaraikku'riththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.
uyirththezhuthal illaiyen'ru saathikki'ra sathuseayar avaridaththil vanthu:

poathakarea, oruvanudaiya sakoatharan santhaanamillaamal than manaiviyai vittu i'ranthupoanaal, avanudaiya sakoatharan avan manaiviyai vivaakampa'n'ni, than sakoatharanukkuch santhaanam u'ndaakkavea'ndumen'ru moasea engka'lukku ezhuthivaiththirukki'raarea.
ippadiyirukka, eazhupear sakoatharar irunthaarka'l; mooththavan oru pe'n'nai vivaakampa'n'ni, santhaanamillaamal i'ranthupoanaan.
ira'ndaam sakoatharan ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, avanum santhaanamillaamal i'ranthupoanaan. moon'raam sakoatharanum appadiyeayaanaan.
eazhupearum ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, santhaanamillaamal i'ranthupoanaarka'l. ellaarukkum pinpu antha sthireeyum i'ranthupoanaa'l.
aakaiyaal, uyirththezhuthalil, avarka'l ezhunthirukkumpoathu, avarka'lil evanukku ava'l manaiviyaayiruppaa'l? eazhupearum ava'lai manaiviyaakak ko'ndirunthaarka'lea en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l veathavaakkiyangka'laiyum, theavanudaiya vallamaiyaiyum a'riyaathathinaalallavaa thappaana e'n'nang ko'l'luki'reerka'l?
mariththoar uyiroadezhunthirukkumpoathu ko'lvanaiyum koduppanaiyum illai. avarka'l paraloakaththil irukki'ra theavathootharaippoaliruppaarka'l.

mariththoar ezhunthiruppathaippat'ri: naan aapirakaamin theavanum, eesaakkin theavanum, yaakkoapin theavanumaay irukki'rean en'ru, theavan mudchediyaikku'riththuch solliya idaththil, moaseayin aakamaththil avanukkuch sonnathai, neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa?
avar mariththoarukkuth theavanaayiraamal, jeevanu'l'loarukkuth theavanaayirukki'raar; aakaiyaal neengka'l mikavum thappaana e'n'nangko'l'luki'reerka'l en'raar.

veathapaarakaril oruvan avarka'l tharkkampa'n'nuki'rathaikkeattu, avarka'lukku nan'raay uththaravu sonnaaren'ru a'rinthu, avaridaththil vanthu: ka'rpanaika'lilellaam pirathaana ka'rpanai ethuven'ru keattaan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ka'rpanaika'lilellaam pirathaana ka'rpanai ethuven'raal: isravealea kea'l, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar oruvarea karththar.
un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil un muzhu iruthayaththoadum, un muzhu aaththumaavoadum, un muzhu manathoadum, un muzhup palaththoadum anpukooruvaayaaka enpathea pirathaana ka'rpanai.
itha'rku oppaayirukki'ra ira'ndaam ka'rpanai ennaven'raal: unnidaththil nee anpukooruvathupoal pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka enpathea; ivaika'lilum periya ka'rpanai vea'ron'rumillai en'raar.
atha'rku veathapaarakan: sarithaan, poathakarea, neer sonnathu saththiyam; orea theavan u'ndu, avaraiththavira vea'roru theavan illai.

muzhu iruthayaththoadum, muzhu manathoadum, muzhu aaththumaavoadum, muzhup palaththoadum avaridaththil anpukooruki'rathum, thannidaththil anpukooruki'rathupoal pi'ranidaththil anpukooruki'rathumea sarvaangkathakanam muthaliya palika'laippaarkkilum mukkiyamaayirukki'rathu en'raan.
avan viveakamaay uththaravusonnathai iyeasu ka'ndu: nee theavanudaiya raajyaththukkuth thooramaanavanalla en'raar. athanpinpu oruvarum avaridaththil yaathoru kea'lviyung keadkath thu'niyavillai.
iyeasu theavaalayaththilea upatheasampa'n'nukaiyil, avar: ki'risthu thaaveethin kumaaranen'ru veathapaarakar eppadich solluki'raarka'l?

naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'ru karththar en aa'ndavaroadea sonnaar en'ru thaaveethu parisuththa aaviyinaalea solliyirukki'raanea.
thaaveethuthaanea avarai aa'ndavaren'ru solliyirukka, avanukku avar kumaaranaayiruppathu eppadi en'raar. aneaka janangka'l avarudaiya upatheasaththai viruppaththoadea keattaarka'l.
pinnum avar upatheasampa'n'nukaiyil avarka'lai noakki: nee'nda angkika'laith thariththukko'ndu thiriyavum, santhaive'lika'lil vanthanangka'lai adaiyavum,
jepa aalayangka'lil muthanmaiyaana aasanangka'lil udkaaravum, virunthuka'lil muthanmaiyaana idangka'lil irukkavum virumpi,
vithavaika'lin veeduka'laip padchiththu, paarvaikku nee'nda jepam pa'n'nuki'ra veathapaarakaraikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; avarka'l athika aakkinaiyai adaivaarka'l en'raar.
iyeasu kaa'nikkaip pettikku ethiraaka udkaarnthu, janangka'l kaa'nikkaip pettiyil pa'nam poaduki'rathaip paarththukko'ndirunthaar; aisuvariyavaanka'l aneakar athikamaayp poattaarka'l.
eazhaiyaana oru vithavaiyum vanthu, oru thuttukkuch sariyaana ira'ndu kaasaip poattaa'l.

appozhuthu avar thammudaiya seesharai azhaiththu, kaa'nikkaip pettiyil pa'nam poatta mat'rellaaraip paarkkilum intha eazhai vithavai athikamaayp poattaa'l en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean;
avarka'lellaarum thangka'l paripoora'naththilirunthu eduththuppoattaarka'l; iva'loa than va'rumaiyilirunthu than jeevanaththukku u'ndaayirunthathellaam poattuvittaa'l en'raar.

avar theavaalayaththai vittup pu'rappadumpoathu, avarudaiya seesharka'lil oruvan avarai noakki: poathakarea, ithoa, inthak kalluka'l eppadippattathu! inthak kattadangka'l eppadippattathu! paarum en'raan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthap periya kattadangka'laik kaa'nki'raayea, oru kallinmeal oru kalliraathapadikku ellaam idikkappattuppoakum en'raar.
pinpu, avar theavaalayaththukku ethiraaka olivamalaiyinmeal udkaarnthirukkaiyil, peathuruvum yaakkoapum yoavaanum anthireayaavum avaridaththil thaniththuvanthu:
ivaika'l eppozhuthu sampavikkum? ivaika'lellaam ni'raivea'rungkaalaththukku adaiyaa'lam enna? engka'lukkuch sollavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: oruvanum ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
eanenil aneakar vanthu, en naamaththaikko'ndu: naanea ki'risthu en'ru solli, aneakarai vagnchippaarka'l.
yuththangka'laiyum yuththangka'lin seythika'laiyum kea'lvippadumpoathu kalangkaatheayungka'l; ivaika'l sampavikkavea'ndiyathea. aanaalum, mudivu udanea varaathu.

janaththukku viroathamaay janamum, raajyaththukku viroathamaay raajyamum ezhumpum; poomiyathirchchika'lum pala idangka'lil u'ndaakum, pagnchangka'lum kalakangka'lum u'ndaakum; ivaika'l veathanaika'lukku aarampam.

neengka'loa echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, eanenil ungka'lai aaloasanaich sangkangka'lukku oppukkoduppaarka'l, neengka'l jepaaalayangka'lil adikkappaduveerka'l; ennimiththam theasaathipathika'lukkum raajaakka'lukkum saadchiyaaka avarka'lukku munpaaka ni'ruththappaduveerka'l.
sakala jaathika'lukkum suviseasham munthip pirasangkikkappadavea'ndum.

avarka'l ungka'laik ko'ndupoay oppukkodukkumpoathu, neengka'l enna peasuvoamen'ru munnathaakak kavalaippadaamalum sinthiyaamalumirungka'l; antha naazhikaiyilea ungka'lukku ethu aru'l seyyappadumoa athaiyea peasungka'l; eanenil peasuki'ravarka'l neengka'lalla, parisuththa aaviyea peasuki'ravar.
an'riyum sakoatharan sakoatharanaiyum, thakappan pi'l'laiyaiyum mara'naththukku oppukkoduppaarka'l; pet'raarukku viroathamaakap pi'l'laika'l ezhumpi, avarka'laik kolaiseyvaarka'l.
en naamaththinimiththam ellaaraalum pakaikkappaduveerka'l. mudivupariyantham nilaini'rpavanea iradchikkappaduvaan.

mealum paazhaakkuki'ra aruvaruppaikku'riththuth thaaniyeal theerkkatharisi solliyirukki'raanea; vaasikki'ravan sinthikkakkadavan; athu ni'rkaththakaatha idaththilea neengka'l athai ni'rkak kaa'numpoathu, yootheayaavil irukki'ravarka'l malaika'lukku oadippoakakkadavarka'l.
veettinmeal irukki'ravan than veettukku'l i'rangkaamalum, than veettil ethaiyaakilum eduththukko'l'la u'l'lea poakaamalum irukkakkadavan.
vayalil irukki'ravan than vasthiraththai eduppatha'rkup pinnittuth thirumpaathirukkakkadavan.
annaadka'lilea karppavathika'lukkum paalkodukki'ravarka'lukkum aiyoa!
neengka'l oadippoavathu maarikaalaththilea sampaviyaathapadikku vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l.
eanenil theavan ulakaththaich sirushdiththathumuthal ithuvaraikkum sampaviththiraathathum, inimealum sampaviyaathathumaana upaththiravam annaadka'lil u'ndaayirukkum.
karththar annaadka'laik ku'raiththiraavittaal, oruvanaakilum thappippoavathillai; thaam therinthuko'ndavarka'linimiththamoa, avar antha naadka'laik ku'raiththirukki'raar.
appozhuthu: ithoa, ki'risthu ingkea irukki'raar, athoa, angkeayirukki'raar en'ru evanaakilum sonnaal, nampaatheayungka'l.

eanenil ka'l'lakki'risthukka'lum ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'lum ezhumpi, koodumaanaal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'laiyum vagnchikkaththakkathaaka adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum seyvaarka'l.
neengka'loa echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; ithoa, ellaavat'raiyum munnathaaka ungka'lukku a'riviththirukki'rean.
annaadka'lilea, antha upaththiravaththi'rkup pinpu, sooriyan anthakaarappadum, santhiran o'liyaik kodaathirukkum;
vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'l vizhum, vaanangka'lilu'l'la saththuvangka'lum asaikkappadum.
appozhuthu manushakumaaran mikuntha vallamaiyoadum makimaiyoadum meakangka'linmeal varuki'rathaik kaa'npaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar thammudaiya thootharai anuppi, thaam therinthuko'ndavarka'laip poomiyin kadaimunai mutha'rko'ndu, vaanaththin kadaimunaimattumu'l'la naalu thisaika'lilumirunthu koottich searppaar.
aththimaraththinaal oru uvamaiyaik kat'rukko'l'lungka'l; athilea i'langki'lai thoan'ri, thu'lirvidumpoathu, vasanthakaalam sameepamaayit'ru en'ru a'riveerka'l.
appadiyea ivaika'l sampavikki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, avar sameepamaay vaasalarukea vanthirukki'raar en'ru a'riyungka'l.
ivaika'lellaam sampavikkum munnea inthach santhathi ozhinthupoakaathen'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
vaanamum poomiyum ozhinthupoam, en vaarththaika'loa ozhinthupoavathillai.
antha naa'laiyum antha naazhikaiyaiyum pithaa oruvar thavira mat'roruvanum a'riyaan, paraloakaththilu'l'la thootharka'lum a'riyaarka'l, kumaaranum a'riyaar.
akkaalaththai neengka'l a'riyaathapadiyaal echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, vizhiththirunthu jepampa'n'nungka'l.

oru manushan than veettaivittu, pu'raththeasaththukkup pirayaa'nampoaka eththanikkumpoathu, than oozhiyakkaararukku athikaarangkoduththu, avanavanukkuth than than vealaiyaiyum niyamiththu, vizhiththirukkumpadikkuk kaavalkaakki'ravanukkuk ka'rpippaan.
appadiyea neengka'lum vizhiththirungka'l; eanenil, veettejamaan saayangkaalaththiloa, naduraaththiriyiloa, seaval koovum nearaththiloa, kaalaiyiloa, eppozhuthu varuvaan en'ru neengka'l a'riyeerka'l.
neengka'l ninaiyaathavea'laiyil avan vanthu, ungka'laith thoongkuki'ravarka'laakak ka'ndupidiyaathapadikku vizhiththirungka'l.
naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rathai ellaarukkum solluki'rean, vizhiththirungka'l en'raar.

ira'ndu naa'laikkuppinpu pu'lippillaatha appagnsaappiduki'ra paskaapa'ndikai vanthathu. appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum, avaraith thanthiramaayp pidiththuk kolaiseyyumpadi vakaitheadinaarka'l.
aakilum janangka'lukku'l'lea kalakam u'ndaakaathapadikku, pa'ndikaiyilea appadich seyyalaakaathu en'raarka'l.

avar peththaaniyaavil kushdaroakiyaayiruntha seemoan veettilea poajanapanthiyirukkaiyil, oru sthiree vilaiyea'rappet'ra na'latham ennum uththama thailamu'l'la ve'l'laikkal para'niyaik ko'nduvanthu, athai udaiththu, anthath thailaththai avar sirasinmeal oot'rinaa'l.
appozhuthu silar thangka'lukku'l'lea visanamadainthu: inthath thailaththai ippadi vee'naaych selavazhippaanean?
ithai munnoo'ru pa'naththukku athikamaana kirayaththukku vit'ru, thariththirarukkuk kodukkalaamea en'ru solli, ava'laikku'riththu mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ava'lai vittuvidungka'l; ean ava'laith thontharavu paduththuki'reerka'l? ennidaththil na'rkiriyaiyaich seythirukki'raa'l.
thariththirar eppoathum ungka'lidaththil irukki'raarka'l, ungka'lukku manathu'ndaakumpoathellaam neengka'l avarka'lukku nanmai seyyalaam, naanoa eppoathum ungka'lidaththil irean.
iva'l thannaal iyan'rathaich seythaa'l; naan adakkampa'n'nappaduvatha'rku eththanamaaka, en sareeraththil thailampoosa munthikko'ndaa'l.
inthach suviseasham ulakaththil engkengkea pirasangkikkappadumoa angkangkea iva'lai ninaippatha'rkaaka iva'l seythathum sollappadum en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu, panniruvaril oruvanaakiya yoothaaskaariyoaththu enpavan avaraip pirathaana aasaariyarukkuk kaattikkodukkumpadi avarka'lidaththi'rkup poanaan.
avarka'l athaik keattu, santhoashappattu, avanukkup pa'nangkoduppoam en'ru vaakkuththaththam pa'n'ninaarka'l; avan avaraik kaattikkoduppatha'rkuth thakuntha samayam paarththukko'ndirunthaan.

paskaavaip paliyidum naa'laakiya pu'lippillaatha appagnsaappiduki'ra muthalaam naa'lilea, avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil vanthu: neer paskaavaip pusippatha'rku naangka'l engkea poay aayaththampa'n'nach siththamaayirukki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.
avar thammudaiya seesharil ira'ndupearai noakki: neengka'l nakaraththi'rku'l'lea poangka'l, angkea tha'n'neerkkudam sumanthuvaruki'ra oru manushan ungka'lukku ethirppaduvaan, avan pinnea poangka'l;

avan entha veetti'rku'l piraveasikki'raanoa antha veettu ejamaanai neengka'l noakki: naan en seesharoadukoodap paskaavaip pusikki'ratha'rkuth thakuthiyaana idam engkeayen'ru poathakar keadki'raar en'ru sollungka'l.

avan kampa'lam muthalaanavaika'l viriththu aayaththampa'n'nappattirukki'ra visthaaramaana mealveetta'raiyai ungka'lukkuk kaa'npippaan; angkea namakkaaka aayaththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru solli anuppinaar.
appadiyea, avarudaiya seeshar pu'rappattu nakaraththil poay, thangka'lukku avar sonnapadiyea ka'ndu, paskaavai aayaththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu, avar panniruvaroadungkooda avvidaththi'rku vanthaar.
avarka'l panthiyamarnthu poajanampa'n'nukaiyil, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ennudanea pusikki'ra ungka'lil oruvan ennaik kaattikkoduppaan en'ru, meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu avarka'l thukkamadainthu: naanoa? naanoa? en'ru ovvoruvarum, avaridaththil keadkath thodangkinaarka'l.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennudaneakoodath thaalaththil kaiyiduki'ravanaakiya panniruvariloruvanea avan en'ru solli;

manushakumaaran thammaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea poaki'raar; aakilum, entha manushanaal manushakumaaran kaattikkodukkappaduki'raaroa, antha manushanukku aiyoa! antha manushan pi'ravaathirunthaanaanaal avanukku nalamaayirukkum en'raar.
avarka'l poajanampa'n'nukaiyil, iyeasu appaththai eduththu aaseervathiththu, athaip pittu, avarka'lukkuk koduththu: neengka'l vaangkip pusiyungka'l, ithu ennudaiya sareeramaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
pinpu, paaththiraththaiyum eduththu, sthoaththirampa'n'ni, athai avarka'lukkuk koduththaar. avarka'lellaarum athilea paanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: ithu aneakarukkaakach sinthappaduki'ra puthu udanpadikkaikkuriya ennudaiya iraththamaayirukki'rathu.
naan theavanudaiya raajyaththil navamaana rasaththaip paanampa'n'num naa'lvaraikkum thiraadchappazharasaththai ini naan paanampa'n'nuvathillaiyen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avarka'l sthoaththirappaattaip paadinapinpu, olivamalaikkup pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu, iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: meayppanai vettuvean, aaduka'l sitha'radikkappadum, en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, intha iraaththiriyilea neengka'lellaarum ennimiththam ida'raladaiveerka'l.
aakilum naan uyirththezhunthapinpu, ungka'lukku munnea kalileayaavukkup poavean en'raar.
atha'rkup peathuru: umathunimiththam ellaarum ida'raladainthaalum, naan ida'raladaiyean en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: in'raikku, intha iraaththiriyilea, seaval ira'ndutharam koovuki'ratha'rkumunnea, nee moon'rutharam ennai ma'ruthalippaay en'ru meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
atha'rku avan: naan ummoadea marikkavea'ndiyathaayirunthaalum ummai ma'ruthalikkamaattean en'ru u'ruthiyaaych sonnaan; ellaarum appadiyea sonnaarka'l.
pinpu kethsemanea ennappatta idaththi'rku vanthaarka'l. appozhuthu avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: naan jepampa'n'numa'lavum ingkea udkaarnthirungka'l en'ru solli;
peathuruvaiyum yaakkoapaiyum yoavaanaiyum thammoadea koottikko'ndupoay, thikiladaiyavum, mikavum viyaakulappadavum thodangkinaar.
appozhuthu avar: en aaththumaa mara'naththukkeathuvaana thukkangko'ndirukki'rathu. neengka'l ingkea thangki, vizhiththirungka'l en'ru solli,
sat'ru appu'rampoay, tharaiyilea vizhunthu, antha vea'lai thammaivittu neengkippoakakkoodumaanaal athu neengkavea'ndumen'ru vea'ndikko'ndu:
appaa pithaavea, ellaam ummaalea koodum; inthap paaththiraththai ennidaththilirunthu eduththuppoadum, aakilum en siththaththinpadiyalla, ummudaiya siththaththinpadiyea aakakkadavathu en'raar.
pinpu avar vanthu, avarka'l niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathaikka'ndu, peathuruvai noakki: seemoanea, niththiraipa'n'nuki'raayaa? oru ma'ninearam nee vizhiththirukkakkoodaathaa?
neengka'l soathanaikkudpadaathapadikku vizhiththirunthu jepampa'n'nungka'l. aavi u'rchaakamu'l'lathuthaan, maamsamoa palaveenamu'l'lathu en'raar.
avar ma'rupadiyum poay antha vaarththaika'laiyea solli jepampa'n'ninaar.

avar thirumpa vanthapoathu, avarka'l ma'rupadiyum niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndaar; avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l mikuntha niththiraimayakkam adainthirunthapadiyaal, thaangka'l ma'rumozhiyaaka avarukkuch solvathu innathen'ru a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.
avar moon'raantharam vanthu: ini niththiraipa'n'ni i'laippaa'rungka'l; poathum, vea'lai vanthathu, ithoa, manushakumaaran paavika'ludaiya kaika'lil oppukkodukkappaduki'raar.
ennaik kaattikkodukki'ravan, ithoa, vanthuvittaan, ezhunthirungka'l, poavoam en'raar.

udanea, avar ippadip peasukaiyil, panniruvaril oruvanaakiya yoothaas vanthaan; avanoadeakoodap pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum moopparum anuppina thira'laana janangka'l, pattayangka'laiyum thadika'laiyum pidiththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
avaraik kaattikkodukki'ravan: naan evanai muththagnseyveanoa avanthaan, avanaip pidiththup paththiramaayk ko'ndupoangka'l en'ru avarka'lukkuk ku'rippuch solliyirunthaan.
avan vanthavudanea, avara'ndaiyil searnthu: rapee, rapee, en'ru solli, avarai muththagnseythaan.
appozhuthu avarka'l avarmeal kaipoattu, avaraip pidiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu koodanin'ravarka'lil oruvan kaththiyai uruvi, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaranaik kaatha'ra vettinaan.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ka'l'lanaip pidikkap pu'rappaduki'rathupoala, neengka'l pattayangka'laiyum thadika'laiyum eduththukko'ndu ennaip pidikkavantheerka'l;

naan thinanthoa'rum ungka'l naduvilea theavaalayaththil upatheasampa'n'nik ko'ndirunthean; appozhuthu neengka'l ennaip pidikkavillaiyea; aanaalum veathavaakkiyangka'l ni'raivea'ra vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
appozhuthu ellaarum avaraivittu oadippoanaarka'l.
oru vaalipan oru thuppattiyai maaththiram thanmeal poarththukko'ndu avar pinnea poanaan; avanaip pidiththaarka'l.
avan than thuppattiyaip poattu vittu, nirvaa'namaay avarka'lai vittu oadippoanaan.
iyeasuvai avarka'l pirathaana aasaariyanidaththil ko'ndupoanaarka'l; angkea aasaariyar mooppar veathapaarakar ellaarum koodivanthirunthaarka'l.
peathuru thooraththilea avarukkup pinsen'ru, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aramanaikku'l vanthu, seavakaroadeakooda udkaarnthu, neruppa'ndaiyilea ku'lirkaaynthuko'ndirunthaan.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyarum aaloasanaich sangkaththaaranaivarum iyeasuvaik kolaiseyyumpadi avarukku viroathamaakach saadchi theadinaarka'l; akappadavillai.
aneakar avarukku viroathamaakap poychsaadchi solliyum, anthach saadchika'l ovvavillai.

appozhuthu silar ezhunthu, kaivealaiyaakiya inthath theavaalayaththai naan idiththuppoattu, kaivealaiyallaatha vea'ron'rai moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea kattuvean en'ru ivan sonnathai naangka'l keattoam en'ru,
avarukku viroathamaayp poychsaadchi sonnaarka'l.
appadich solliyum avarka'l saadchi ovvaama'rpoayit'ru.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyan ezhunthu naduvea nin'ru, iyeasuvai noakki: ivarka'l unakku viroathamaaych solluki'rathaik ku'riththu nee on'rum solluki'rathillaiyaa en'ru keattaan.
avaroa oru uththaravum sollaamal peasaathirunthaar. ma'rupadiyum pirathaana aasaariyan avarai noakki: nee sthoaththirikkappatta theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthuthaanaa? en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: naan avarthaan; manushakumaaran sarvavallavarin valathupaarisaththil veet'riruppathaiyum, vaanaththin meakangka'lmeal varuvathaiyum neengka'l kaa'npeerka'l en'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyan ithaik keattavudanea, than vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu: inich saadchika'l namakku vea'ndiyathenna?
theavathoosha'naththaik keatteerka'lea, ungka'lukku ennamaayth thoan'ruki'rathu en'raan. atha'rku avarka'lellaarum: ivan mara'naththukkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan en'ru theermaanampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu silar avarmeal thuppavum, avarudaiya mukaththai moodavum, avaraik kuttavum, gnaanathirushdiyinaalea paarththuch sol en'ru sollavum thodangkinaarka'l; vealaikkaararum avaraik kannaththil a'rainthaarka'l.
aththaru'naththilea peathuru keezhea aramanai mut'raththilirukkaiyil, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaarika'lil oruththi vanthu,
ku'lirkaaynthuko'ndirukki'ra peathuruvaik ka'ndu, avanai ut'ruppaarththu: neeyum nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvoadea irunthaay en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: naan a'riyean; nee solluki'rathu enakkuth theriyaathu en'ru ma'ruthaliththu, ve'liyea vaasal ma'ndapaththukkup poanaan; appozhuthu seaval koovit'ru.
vealaikkaari avanai ma'rupadiyum ka'ndu: ivan avarka'lil oruvan en'ru arukea nin'ravarka'lukkuch sonnaa'l.

avan ma'rupadiyum ma'ruthaliththaan. sat'runearaththukkuppinpu ma'rupadiyum arukea ni'rki'ravarka'l peathuruvaip paarththu: meyyaakavea nee avarka'lil oruvan, nee kalileayan, un peachchu atha'rku oththirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: neengka'l solluki'ra manushanai a'riyean en'ru solli, sapikkavum saththiyampa'n'navum thodangkinaan.

udanea seaval ira'ndaantharam koovit'ru. seaval ira'ndutharang koovuki'ratha'rkumunnea nee ennai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaay en'ru iyeasu thanakkuch sonna vaarththaiyaip peathuru ninaivukoornthu, mikavum azhuthaan.

pozhuthu vidinthavudanea, pirathaana aasaariyarum moopparum veathapaarakarum aaloasanaich sangkaththaaranaivarum koodi aaloasanaipa'n'ni, iyeasuvaik kattik ko'ndupoay, pilaaththuvinidaththil oppukkoduththaarka'l.
pilaaththu avarai noakki: nee yootharudaiya raajaavaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avar: neer solluki'rapadithaan en'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyarka'l avarmeal aneakang kut'rangka'laich saattinaarka'l. avaroa maa'ruththaram on'rum sollavillai.
appozhuthu pilaaththu ma'rupadiyum avarai noakki: ithoa, ivarka'l unmeal eththanaiyoa kut'rangka'laich saattuki'raarka'lea, atha'rku nee uththaravu on'rum solluki'rathillaiyaa en'ru keattaan.
iyeasuvoa appozhuthum uththaravu on'rum sollavillai; athinaal pilaaththu aachchariyappattaan.

kaavalpa'n'nappattavarka'lil evanai viduthalaiyaakka vea'ndumen'ru janangka'l keattukko'lvaarka'loa, avanai avarka'lukkaaka viduthalaiyaakkuvathu pa'ndikaithoa'rum pilaaththuvukku vazhakkamaayirunthathu.
kalakampa'n'ni anthak kalakaththil kolaiseythu, atha'rkaakak kaavalpa'n'nappattavarka'lil parapaas ennappatta oruvan irunthaan.
janangka'l, vazhakkaththinpadiyea thangka'lukku oruvanai viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndumen'ru saththamittuk keattukko'l'lath thodangkinaarka'l.
po'raamaiyinaalea pirathaana aasaariyarka'l avarai oppukkoduththaarka'len'ru pilaaththu a'rinthu,
avarka'lai noakki: naan yootharudaiya raajaavai ungka'lukku viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndumen'rirukki'reerka'laa en'ru keattaan.
parapaasaith thangka'lukku viduthalaiyaakkavea'ndumen'ru janangka'l keattukko'l'lumpadi, pirathaana aasaariyarka'l avarka'lai eavivittaarka'l.
pilaaththu ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai noakki: appadiyaanaal, yootharudaiya raajaaven'ru neengka'l solluki'ravanai naan enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
avanaich siluvaiyil a'raiyum en'ru ma'rupadiyum saththamittuch sonnaarka'l.
atha'rkup pilaaththu: ean, enna pollaappuch seythaan en'raan. avarka'loa: avanaich siluvaiyil a'raiyum en'ru pinnum athikamaayk kookkuralittuch sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu pilaaththu janangka'laip piriyappaduththa manathu'l'lavanaay, parapaasai avarka'lukku viduthalaiyaakki, iyeasuvaiyoa vaarinaal adippiththu, siluvaiyil a'raiyumpadikku oppukkoduththaan.
appozhuthu poarchseavakar avaraith theasaathipathiyin aramanaiyaakiya maa'likaiyil ko'ndupoay, avvidaththil poarchseavakarudaiya koottamuzhuvathaiyum koodivarachseythu,
sivappaana mealangkiyai avarukku uduththi, mu'lmudiyaip pinni avarukkuch sootti:
yootharudaiya raajaavea, vaazhka en'ru avarai vaazhththi,
avaraich sirasil koalaal adiththu, avarmeal thuppi, muzhangkaalpadiyittu avarai va'nangkinaarka'l.
avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ninapinpu, sivappaana angkiyaik kazhat'ri, avarudaiya vasthirangka'lai avarukku uduththi, avaraich siluvaiyil a'raiyumpadi ve'liyea ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

sireanea ooraanum, aleksantharukkum rooppukkum thakappanumaakiya seemoan ennappatta oruvan naattilirunthu avvazhiyea varukaiyil, avarudaiya siluvaiyaich sumakkumpadi avanaip palavanthampa'n'ninaarka'l.
kapaalasthalam en'ru arththangko'l'lum kolkothaa ennum idaththukku avaraik ko'ndupoay,
ve'l'laippoa'lam kalantha thiraadcharasaththai avarukkuk kudikkak koduththaarka'l; avar athai eat'rukko'l'lavillai.
appozhuthu avaraich siluvaiyil a'rainthaarka'l. athanpinpu avarudaiya vasthirangka'laip pangkittu, ovvoruvan ovvoru pangkai eduththukko'l'lumpadi avaika'laikku'riththuch seettuppoattaarka'l.
avaraich siluvaiyil a'rainthapoathu moon'raamma'ni vea'laiyaayirunthathu.
avar adaintha aakkinaiyin mukaantharaththaik kaa'npikkumporuttu, yootharudaiya raajaa en'ru ezhuthi, siluvaiyinmeal kattinaarka'l.
allaamalum, avarudaiya valathupakkaththil oruvanum avarudaiya idathupakkaththil oruvanumaaka, ira'ndu ka'l'larai avaroadeakoodach siluvaika'lil a'rainthaarka'l.
akkiramakkaararil oruvanaaka e'n'nappattaar enki'ra veathavaakkiyam athanaalea ni'raivea'rit'ru.
antha vazhiyaay nadanthupoaki'ravarka'l thangka'l thalaika'laith thulukki: aa! aa! theavaalayaththai idiththu, moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea kattuki'ravanea,
unnai neeyea iradchiththukko'l; siluvaiyilirunthi'rangkivaa en'ru avaraith thooshiththaarka'l.
appadiyea pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum thangka'lukku'l'lea pariyaasampa'n'ni: mat'ravarka'lai iradchiththaan, thannaiththaan iradchiththukko'l'lath thiraa'niyillai.

naam ka'ndu visuvaasikkaththakkathaaka isravealukku raajaavaakiya ki'risthu ippozhuthu siluvaiyilirunthi'rangkattum en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l. avaroadeakoodach siluvaika'lil a'raiyappattavarka'lum avarai ninthiththaarka'l.
aa'raamma'ni nearamuthal onpathaamma'ni nearamvaraikkum poomiyengkum anthakaaram u'ndaayit'ru.
onpathaamma'ni nearaththilea, iyeasu: eloayee! eloayee! laamaa sapakthaani, en'ru mikuntha saththamittuk kooppittaar; atha'rku: en theavanea! en theavanea! ean ennaik kaivitteer en'ru arththamaam.
angkea nin'ravarka'lil silar athaik keattapozhuthu: ithoa, eliyaavaik kooppiduki'raan en'raarka'l.
oruvan oadi, kada'rkaa'laanaik kaadiyilea thoayththu, athai oru koalil maatti, avarukkuk kudikkakkoduththu: po'rungka'l, eliyaa ivanai i'rakka varuvaanoa paarppoam en'raan.
iyeasu makaa saththamaayk kooppittu jeevanai vittaar.
appozhuthu, theavaalayaththin thiraichseelai mealthodangkik keezhvaraikkum ira'ndaakak kizhinthathu.
avarukku ethirea nin'ra noot'rukku athipathi avar ippadik kooppittu jeevanai vittathaik ka'ndapoathu: meyyaakavea intha manushan theavanudaiya kumaaran en'raan.

sila sthireeka'lum thooraththilirunthu paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l. avar kalileayaavilirunthapoathu avarukkup pinsen'ru oozhiyagnseythuvantha makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum, sinna yaakkoapukkum yoaseakkum thaayaakiya mariyaa'lum, saloamea enpava'lum,
avarudaneakooda erusaleamukku vanthiruntha vea'rea aneaka sthireeka'lum avarka'loadea irunthaarka'l.
oayvunaa'lukku munthinanaa'l aayaththanaa'laayirunthapadiyaal, saayangkaalamaanapoathu,

kanamporunthiya aaloasanaikkaaranum arimaththiyaa ooraanum theavanudaiya raajyam varak kaaththirunthavanumaakiya yoaseappu enpavan vanthu, pilaaththuvinidaththil thu'ninthupoay, iyeasuvin sareeraththaik keattaan.
avar iththanai seekkiraththil mariththuppoanaaraa en'ru pilaaththu aachchariyappattu, noot'rukku athipathiyai azhaippiththu: avar itha'rku'l'lea mariththathu nichchayamaa en'ru keattaan.
noot'rukku athipathiyinaalea athai a'rinthuko'ndapinpu, sareeraththai yoaseappinidaththil koduththaan.

avan poay, melliya thuppattiyai vaangkikko'nduvanthu, avarai i'rakki, anthath thuppattiyilea sut'ri, kanmalaiyil vettiyiruntha kalla'raiyilea avarai vaiththu, kalla'raiyin vaasalil oru kallaip purattivaiththaan.
avarai vaiththa idaththai makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum yoaseayin thaayaakiya mariyaa'lum paarththaarka'l.
oayvunaa'laanapinpu makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum, yaakkoapin thaayaakiya mariyaa'lum, saloamea enpava'lum, avarukkuch sukanthavarkkamidumpadi avaika'lai vaangkikko'ndu,
vaaraththin muthalaamnaa'l athikaalaiyilea sooriyan uthayamaaki'rapoathu kalla'raiyinidaththil vanthu,
kalla'raiyin vaasalilirukki'ra kallai namakkaaka evan purattiththa'l'luvaan en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
anthak kal mikavum perithaayirunthathu; avarka'l ea'rittuppaarkki'rapoathu, athu tha'l'lappattirukkak ka'ndaarka'l.
avarka'l kalla'raikku'l piraveasiththu, ve'l'laiyangki thariththavanaay valathupakkaththil udkaarnthiruntha oru vaalipanaik ka'ndu payanthaarka'l.
