avan avarka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l, siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaith theaduki'reerka'l; avar uyirththezhunthaar; avar ingkeayillai; ithoa, avarai vaiththa idam.

neengka'l avarudaiya seesharidaththi'rkum peathuruvinidaththi'rkum poay: ungka'lukku munnea kalileayaavukkup poaki'raar, avar ungka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea angkea avaraik kaa'npeerka'l en'ru, avarka'lukkuch sollungka'l en'raan.
nadukkamum thikilum avarka'laip pidiththapadiyaal, avarka'l seekkiramaay ve'liyea vanthu, kalla'raiyai vittu oadinaarka'l; avarka'l payanthirunthapadiyinaal oruvarukkum on'rum sollaama'r poanaarka'l.
vaaraththin muthalaamnaa'l athikaalaiyilea iyeasu ezhunthirunthapinpu, makathaleanaa mariyaa'lukku muthalmuthal tharisanamaanaar.

ava'lidaththilirunthu avar eazhu pisaasuka'laith thuraththiyirunthaar. ava'l pu'rappattu, avaroadeakooda irunthavarka'l thukkappattu azhuthuko'ndirukkaiyil, avarka'lidaththil poay, anthach seythiyai a'riviththaa'l.
avar uyiroadirukki'raaren'rum ava'lukkuk kaa'nappattaar en'rum avarka'l keattapozhuthu nampavillai.
athanpinpu avarka'lil ira'ndupear oru kiraamaththukku nadanthupoaki'rapozhuthu avarka'lukku ma'ruroopamaayth tharisanamaanaar.
avarka'lum poay, athai mat'ravarka'lukku a'riviththaarka'l; avarka'laiyum avarka'l nampavillai.

athanpinpu pathinoruvarum poajanapanthiyilirukkaiyil avarka'lukku avar tharisanamaaki, uyirththezhunthiruntha thammaik ka'ndavarka'lai avarka'l nampaama'rpoanathinimiththam avarka'ludaiya avisuvaasaththaikku'riththum iruthayakadinaththaikku'riththum avarka'laik kadinthuko'ndaar.
pinpu, avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ulakamengkum poay, sarva sirushdikkum suviseashaththaip pirasangkiyungka'l.
visuvaasamu'l'lavanaaki gnaanasnaanam pet'ravan iradchikkappaduvaan; visuvaasiyaathavanoa aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappaduvaan.
visuvaasikki'ravarka'laal nadakkum adaiyaa'langka'laavana: en naamaththinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuvaarka'l; navamaana paashaika'laip peasuvaarka'l;

sarppangka'lai eduppaarka'l; saavukkeathuvaana yaathon'raik kudiththaalum athu avarka'laich seathappaduththaathu; viyaathiyastharmeal kaika'lai vaippaarka'l, appozhuthu avarka'l sosthamaavaarka'l en'raar.
ivvithamaayk karththar avarka'ludanea peasinapinpu, paraloakaththukku eduththukko'l'lappattu, theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarnthaar.

avarka'l pu'rappattuppoay, engkum pirasangkampa'n'ninaarka'l. karththar avarka'ludaneakoodak kiriyaiyai nadappiththu, avarka'laal nadantha adaiyaa'langka'linaalea vasanaththai u'ruthippaduththinaar. aamen.
makaa kanamporunthiya theyoappiluvea, naangka'l muzhunichchayamaay nampuki'ra sangkathika'lai,
aarampamuthal ka'n'naarakka'ndu vasanaththaip poathiththavarka'l engka'lukku oppuviththapadiyea avaika'laikku'riththuch sariththiram ezhutha aneakampear ea'rpattapadiyinaal,
aathimuthal ellaavat'raiyum thittamaay visaariththa'rintha naanum umakku upatheasikkappatta viseashangka'lin nichchayaththai neer a'riyavea'ndumen'ru,
avaika'lai ozhungkaay umakku ezhuthuvathu enakku nalamaayth thoan'rit'ru.

yootheayaatheasaththin raajaavaakiya earoathin naadka'lil, apiyaa ennum aasaariya vakuppil sakariyaa ennum pearko'nda aasaariyan oruvan irunthaan. avan manaivi aaroanudaiya kumaaraththika'lil oruththi, ava'l pear elisapeththu.
avarka'l iruvarum karththaritta sakala ka'rpanaika'linpadiyeayum niyamangka'linpadiyeayum kut'ramat'ravarka'laay nadanthu, theavanukku munpaaka neethiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'l.
elisapeththu maladiyaayirunthapadiyinaal, avarka'lukkup pi'l'laiyillaathirunthathu; iruvarum vayathusen'ravarka'laayum irunthaarka'l.
appadiyirukka, avan than aasaariya vakuppin mu'raippadi theavasannithiyilea aasaariya oozhiyam seythuvaruki'ra kaalaththil,
aasaariya oozhiya mu'raimaiyinpadi avan theavaalayaththukku'l piraveasiththuth thoopangkaattuki'ratha'rkuch seettaip pet'raan.
thoopangkaattuki'ra vea'laiyilea janangka'lellaarum koottamaay ve'liyea jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan oruvan thoopapeedaththin valathupakkaththilea nin'ru avanukkuth tharisanamaanaan.
sakariyaa avanaikka'ndu kalangki, payamadainthaan.
thoothan avanai noakki: sakariyaavea, payappadaathea, un vea'nduthal keadkappattathu; un manaiviyaakiya elisapeththu unakku oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l, avanukku yoavaan en'ru peariduvaayaaka.
unakkuch santhoashamum makizhchchiyum u'ndaakum, avan pi'rappinimiththam aneakar santhoashappaduvaarka'l.
avan karththarukku munpaakap periyavanaayiruppaan, thiraadcharasamum mathuvum kudiyaan, than thaayin vayit'rilirukkumpoathea parisuththa aaviyinaal nirappappattiruppaan.
avan israveal santhathiyaaril aneakarai avarka'l theavanaakiya karththaridaththi'rkuth thiruppuvaan.

pithaakka'ludaiya iruthayangka'laip pi'l'laika'lidaththi'rkum, keezhppadiyaathavarka'lai neethimaanka'ludaiya gnaanaththi'rkum thiruppi, uththamamaana janaththaik karththarukku aayaththappaduththumpadiyaaka, avan eliyaavin aaviyum palamum udaiyavanaay avarukku munnea nadappaan en'raan.
appozhuthu sakariyaa theavathoothanai noakki: ithai naan ethinaal a'rivean; naan kizhavanaayirukki'rean, en manaiviyum vayathusen'rava'laayirukki'raa'lea en'raan.
theavathoothan avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan theavasannithaanaththil ni'rki'ra kaapiriyeal enpavan; unnudanea peasavum, unakku intha na'rseythiyai a'rivikkavum anuppappattu vanthean;
ithoa, thakunthakaalaththilea ni'raivea'rappoaki'ra en vaarththaika'lai nee visuvaasiyaathapadiyinaal ivaika'l sampavikkum naa'lmattum nee peasakkoodaamal oomaiyaayiruppaay en'raan.
janangka'l sakariyaavukkuk kaaththirunthu, avan theavaalayaththil thaamathiththathinaal aachchariyappattaarka'l.

avan ve'liyea vanthapoathu avarka'lidaththil peasakkoodaamalirunthaan; athinaalea theavaalayaththil oru tharisanaththaik ka'ndaanen'ru a'rinthaarka'l. avanum avarka'lukkuch saikai kaatti oomaiyaayirunthaan.
avanudaiya oozhiyaththin naadka'l ni'raivea'rinavudanea than veettukkuppoanaan.
annaadka'lukkuppinpu, avan manaiviyaakiya elisapeththu karppavathiyaaki: janangka'lukku'l'lea enakku u'ndaayiruntha ninthaiyai neekkumpadiyaakak karththar intha naadka'lil enmeal kadaadcham vaiththu,
enakku ippadich seytharu'linaar en'ru solli, ainthu maatham ve'lippadaathirunthaa'l.
aa'raam maathaththilea kaapiriyeal ennum thoothan, kalileayaavilu'l'la naasareaththennum ooril,
thaaveethin vamsaththaanaakiya yoaseappu enki'ra naamamu'l'la purushanukku niyamikkappattiruntha oru kannikaiyinidaththi'rku theavanaalea anuppappattaan; anthak kannikaiyin pear mariyaa'l.
ava'l iruntha veettil theavathoothan piraveasiththu: kirupai pet'rava'lea, vaazhka, karththar unnudanea irukki'raar, sthireeka'lukku'l'lea nee aaseervathikkappattava'l en'raan.
ava'loa avanaik ka'ndu, avan vaarththaiyinaal kalangki, intha vaazhththuthal eppadippattathoa en'ru sinthiththukko'ndirunthaa'l.
theavathoothan ava'lai noakki: mariyaa'lea, payappadaathea; nee theavanidaththil kirupaipet'raay.
ithoa, nee karppavathiyaaki oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaay, avarukku iyeasu en'ru peariduvaayaaka.
avar periyavaraayiruppaar, unnathamaanavarudaiya kumaaran ennappaduvaar; karththaraakiya theavan avarudaiya pithaavaakiya thaaveethin singkaasanaththai avarukkuk koduppaar.
avar yaakkoapin kudumpaththaarai en'ren'raikkum arasaa'luvaar; avarudaiya raajyaththukku mudiviraathu en'raan.
atha'rku mariyaa'l theavathoothanai noakki: ithu eppadiyaakum? purushanai a'riyeanea en'raa'l.

theavathoothan ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: parisuththaaavi unmeal varum; unnathamaanavarudaiya palam unmeal nizhalidum; aathalaal unnidaththil pi'rakkum parisuththamu'l'lathu theavanudaiya kumaaran ennappadum.
ithoa, unakku inaththaa'laayirukki'ra elisapeththum than muthirvayathilea oru puththiranaik karppanthariththirukki'raa'l; maladiyennappatta ava'lukku ithu aa'raam maatham.
theavanaalea koodaathakaariyam on'rumillai en'raan.
atha'rku mariyaa'l: ithoa, naan aa'ndavarukku adimai, ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadi enakku aakakkadavathu en'raa'l. appozhuthu theavathoothan ava'lidaththilirunthu poayvittaan.
annaadka'lil mariyaa'l ezhunthu, malainaattilea yoothaavilu'l'la oru patta'naththi'rkuth theeviramaayp poay,
sakariyaavin veettukku'l piraveasiththu, elisapeththai vaazhththinaa'l.
elisapeththu mariyaa'ludaiya vaazhththuthalaik keattapozhuthu, ava'ludaiya vayit'riliruntha pi'l'lai thu'l'lit'ru; elisapeththu parisuththa aaviyinaal nirappappattu,
uraththa saththamaay: sthireeka'lukku'l'lea nee aaseervathikkappattava'l, un karppaththin kaniyum aaseervathikkappattathu.
en aa'ndavarudaiya thaayaar ennidaththil vanthathu enakku ethinaal kidaiththathu.
ithoa, nee vaazhththina saththam en kaathil vizhunthavudanea, en vayit'rilu'l'la pi'l'lai ka'lippaayth thu'l'lit'ru.
visuvaasiththava'lea paakkiyavathi, karththaraalea ava'lukkuch sollappattavaika'l ni'raivea'rum en'raa'l.
appozhuthu mariyaa'l: en aaththumaa karththarai makimaippaduththuki'rathu.
en aavi en iradchakaraakiya theavanil ka'likooruki'rathu.
avar thammudaiya adimaiyin thaazhmaiyai noakkippaarththaar; ithoa, ithumuthal ellaach santhathika'lum ennaip paakkiyavathi enpaarka'l.
vallamaiyudaiyavar makimaiyaanavaika'lai enakkuch seythaar; avarudaiya naamam parisuththamu'l'lathu.
avarudaiya irakkam avarukkup payanthirukki'ravarka'lukkuth thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkumu'l'lathu.
thammudaiya puyaththinaalea paraakkiramagnseythaar; iruthayasinthaiyil akanthaiyu'l'lavarka'laich sitha'radiththaar.
palavaanka'lai aasanangka'lilirunthu tha'l'li, thaazhmaiyaanavarka'lai uyarththinaar.
pasiyu'l'lavarka'lai nanmaika'linaal nirappi, aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'lai ve'rumaiyaay anuppivittaar.
nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku avar sonnapadiyea, aapirakaamukkum avan santhathikkum en'ren'raikkum irakkagnseyya ninaiththu,
thammudaiya thaasanaakiya isravealai aathariththaar en'raa'l.
mariyaa'l ea'rakku'raiya moon'rumaatham ava'ludanea irunthu, than veettukkuth thirumpippoanaa'l.
elisapeththukkup pirasavakaalam ni'raivea'rinapoathu ava'l oru puththiranaip pet'raa'l.
karththar ava'lidaththil thammudaiya irakkaththai vi'langkappa'n'ninaaren'ru ava'ludaiya ayalakaththaarum panthujanangka'lum kea'lvippattu, ava'ludaneakoodach santhoashappattaarka'l.
ettaamnaa'lilea pi'l'laikku viruththaseathanam pa'n'numpadikku avarka'l vanthu, athin thakappanudaiya naamaththinpadi atha'rkuch sakariyaa en'ru pearidappoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu athin thaay: appadiyalla, atha'rku yoavaan en'ru pearidavea'ndum en'raa'l.
atha'rku avarka'l: un u'ravin mu'raiyaaril inthap pearu'l'lavan oruvanum illaiyea en'ru solli,
athin thakappanai noakki: itha'rku enna pearida manathaayirukki'reer en'ru saikaiyinaal keattaarka'l.
avan ezhuththup palakaiyaik keattu vaangki, ivan pear yoavaan en'ru ezhuthinaan; ellaarum aachchariyappattaarka'l.
udanea avanudaiya vaay thi'rakkappattu, avanudaiya naavum kattavizhkkappattu, theavanai sthoaththiriththup peasinaan.
athinaal avarka'laichsut'ri vaasamaayiruntha yaavarukkum payamu'ndaayit'ru. mealum yootheayaavin malainaadengkum intha varththamaanangka'lellaam sollikko'l'lappattathu.

avaika'laik kea'lvippattavarka'lellaarum thangka'l manathilea avaika'lai vaiththukko'ndu, inthap pi'l'lai eppadippattathaayirukkumoa en'raarka'l. karththarudaiya karam anthap pi'l'laiyoadea irunthathu.
avanudaiya thakappanaakiya sakariyaa parisuththa aaviyinaalea nirappappattu, theerkkatharisanamaaka:
isravealin theavanaakiya karththarukku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka.
avar nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku vaakkuththaththampa'n'nina irakkaththaich seyvatha'rkum;
thammudaiya parisuththa udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththaru'li:

ungka'l saththurukka'lin kaika'linin'ru neengka'l viduthalaiyaakkappattu, uyiroadirukkum naa'lellaam payamillaamal enakku munpaakap parisuththaththoadum neethiyoadum enakku oozhiyagnseyyak katta'laiyiduvean en'ru,
avar nammudaiya pithaavaakiya aapirakaamukku itta aa'naiyai ni'raiveat'ruvatha'rkum;
aathimutha'rko'ndiruntha thammudaiya parisuththa theerkkatharisika'lin vaakkinaal thaam sonnapadiyea,
thamathu janaththaich santhiththu meettukko'ndu, nammudaiya saththurukka'linin'rum, nammaip pakaikki'ra yaavarudaiya kaika'linin'rum, nammai iradchikkumpadikku,
thammudaiya thaasanaakiya thaaveethin vamsaththilea namakku iradcha'niyak kompai ea'rpaduththinaar.
neeyoa paalakanea, unnathamaanavarudaiya theerkkatharisi ennappaduvaay; nee karththarukku vazhika'lai aayaththampa'n'navum,
namathu theavanudaiya urukkamaana irakkaththinaalea avarudaiya janaththukkup paavamannippaakiya iradchippaith theriyappaduththavum, avarukku munnaaka nadanthupoavaay.
anthakaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilum udkaarnthirukki'ravarka'lukku ve'lichcham tharavum,
nammudaiya kaalka'laich samaathaanaththin vazhiyilea nadaththavum, avvirakkaththinaalea unnathaththilirunthu thoan'riya aru'noathayam nammaich santhiththirukki'rathu en'raan.
anthap pi'l'lai va'larnthu, aaviyilea palangko'ndu, isravealukkuth thannaik kaa'npikkum naa'lvaraikkum vanaantharangka'lilea irunthaan.
annaadka'lil ulakamengkum kudimathippu ezhuthappadavea'ndumen'ru akusthuraayanaal katta'lai pi'ranthathu.
seeriyaanaattilea sireaniyu enpavan theasaathipathiyaayirunthapoathu intha muthalaam kudimathippu u'ndaayit'ru.
anthappadi kudimathippezhuthappadumpadikku ellaarum thangka'l thangka'l oorka'lukkup poanaarka'l.
appozhuthu yoaseappum, thaan thaaveethin vamsaththaanum kudumpaththaanumaayirunthapadiyinaalea, thanakku manaiviyaaka niyamikkappattuk karppavathiyaana mariyaa'ludanea kudimathippezhuthappadumpadi,
kalileayaa naattilu'l'la naasareaththoorilirunthu yootheayaa naattilu'l'la pethlekeam ennum thaaveethin oorukkup poanaan.
avvidaththilea avarka'l irukkaiyil, ava'lukkup pirasavakaalam nearittathu.
ava'l than mutha'rpea'raana kumaaranaippet'ru, saththiraththilea avarka'lukku idamillaathirunthapadiyinaal, pi'l'laiyaith thu'nika'lil sut'ri, munna'naiyilea kidaththinaa'l.
appozhuthu antha naattilea meaypparka'l vayalve'liyil thangki, iraaththiriyilea thangka'l manthaiyaik kaaththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
avvea'laiyil karththarudaiya thoothan avarka'lidaththil vanthu nin'raan, karththarudaiya makimai avarka'laich sut'rilum pirakaasiththathu; avarka'l mikavum payanthaarka'l.
theavathoothan avarka'lai noakki: payappadaathirungka'l; ithoa, ellaa janaththukkum mikuntha santhoashaththai u'ndaakkum na'rseythiyai ungka'lukku a'rivikki'rean.
in'ru karththaraakiya ki'risthu ennum iradchakar ungka'lukkuth thaaveethin oorilea pi'ranthirukki'raar.
pi'l'laiyaith thu'nika'lil sut'ri, munna'naiyilea kidaththiyirukkak kaa'npeerka'l; ithuvea ungka'lukku adaiyaa'lam en'raan.
anthaksha'namea paramaseanaiyin thira'l anthath thoothanudanea thoan'ri:
unnathaththilirukki'ra theavanukku makimaiyum, poomiyilea samaathaanamum, manusharmeal piriyamum u'ndaavathaaka en'ru solli, theavanaith thuthiththaarka'l.

theavathootharka'l avarka'lai vittup paraloakaththukkup poanapinpu, meaypparka'l oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: naam pethlekeam oorukkup poay, nadanthathaakak karththaraal namakku a'rivikkappatta inthak kaariyaththaip paarppoam vaarungka'l en'ru solli,
theeviramaay vanthu, mariyaa'laiyum, yoaseappaiyum, munna'naiyilea kidaththiyirukki'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum ka'ndaarka'l.
ka'ndu, anthap pi'l'laiyaik ku'riththuth thangka'lukkuch sollappatta sangkathiyaip pirasiththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
meaypparaalea thangka'lukkuch sollappattathaik keatta yaavarum avaika'laikku'riththu aachchariyappattaarka'l.
mariyaa'loa anthach sangkathika'laiyellaam than iruthayaththilea vaiththu, sinthanaipa'n'ninaa'l.
meaypparka'lum thangka'lukkuch sollappattathinpadiyea keattu ka'nda ellaavat'ri'rkaakavum theavanai makimaippaduththi, thuthiththukko'ndu thirumpippoanaarka'l.
pi'l'laikku viruththaseathanam pa'n'navea'ndiya ettaam naa'lilea, athu karppaththilea u'rpavikki'ratha'rku munnea theavathoothanaal sollappattapadiyea, atha'rku iyeasu en'ru pearittaarka'l.
moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyea avarka'ludaiya suththikarippin naadka'l ni'raivea'rinapoathu,
mutha'rpea'raana entha aa'npi'l'laiyum karththarukkup parisuththamaanathennappadum en'ru karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi avaraik karththarukken'ru oppukkodukkavum,

karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththil solliyirukki'rapadi, oru joadu kaattuppu'raavaiyaavathu ira'ndu pu'raakkugnchuka'laiyaavathu paliyaakach seluththavum, avarai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

appozhuthu simiyoan ennum pearko'nda oru manushan erusaleamil irunthaan; avan neethiyum theavapakthiyum u'l'lavanaayum, isravealin aa'ruthalvarak kaaththirukki'ravanaayum irunthaan; avanmeal parisuththaaavi irunthaar.
karththarudaiya ki'risthuvai nee kaa'numunnea mara'namadaiyamaattaay en'ru parisuththa aaviyinaalea avanukku a'rivikkappattumirunthathu.
avan aaviyin eavuthalinaal theavaalayaththilea vanthirunthaan. iyeasu ennum pi'l'laikkaaka niyaayappiramaa'na mu'raimaiyinpadi seyvatha'rkuth thaay thakappanmaar avarai u'l'lea ko'nduvarukaiyil,
avan avaraith than kaika'lil eanthikko'ndu, theavanai sthoaththiriththu:
aa'ndavarea, umathu vaarththaiyinpadi umathu adiyeanai ippozhuthu samaathaanaththoadea poakaviduki'reer;
pu'rajaathika'lukkup pirakaasikki'ra o'liyaakavum, ummudaiya janamaakiya isravealukku makimaiyaakavum,
theavareer sakala janangka'lukkum munpaaka aayaththampa'n'nina
ummudaiya iradcha'niyaththai en ka'nka'l ka'ndathu en'raan.
avaraikku'riththuch sollappattavaika'lukkaaka yoaseappum avarudaiya thaayaarum aachchariyappattaarka'l.

pinnum simiyoan avarka'lai aaseervathiththu, avarudaiya thaayaakiya mariyaa'lai noakki: ithoa, aneakarudaiya iruthaya sinthanaika'l ve'lippadaththakkathaaka, isravealil aneakar vizhuki'ratha'rkum ezhunthirukki'ratha'rkum, viroathamaakap peasappadum adaiyaa'lamaavatha'rkum, ivar niyamikkappattirukki'raar.
un aaththumaavaiyum oru pattayam uruvippoakum en'raan.

aasearudaiya koaththiraththaa'lum, paanuvealin kumaaraththiyumaakiya annaa'l ennum oru theerkkatharisi irunthaa'l; ava'l kannippiraayaththil vivaakamaanathumuthal eazhuvarusham purushanudanea vaazhnthava'lum, athika vayathusen'rava'lumaayirunthaa'l.
ea'rakku'raiya e'npaththunaalu vayathu'l'la antha vithavai theavaalayaththai vittu neengkaamal, iravum pakalum upavaasiththu, jepampa'n'ni, aaraathanai seythuko'ndirunthaa'l.
ava'lum annearaththilea vanthu nin'ru, karththaraip pukazhnthu, erusaleamilea meedpu'ndaakak kaaththiruntha yaavarukkum avaraikku'riththup peasinaa'l.
karththarudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi sakalaththaiyum avarka'l seythu mudiththapinpu, kalileayaanaattilu'l'la thangka'l ooraakiya naasareaththukkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.
pi'l'lai va'larnthu, aaviyilea pelanko'ndu, gnaanaththinaal ni'rainthathu. theavanudaiya kirupaiyum avarmeal irunthathu.
avarudaiya thaay thakappanmaar varushanthoa'rum paskaa pa'ndikaiyil erusaleamukkup poavaarka'l.
avarukkup pannira'ndu vayathaanapoathu, avarka'l anthap pa'ndikai mu'raimaiyinpadi erusaleamukkuppoay,
pa'ndikainaadka'l mudinthu, thirumpivaruki'rapoathu, pi'l'laiyaakiya iyeasu erusaleamilea irunthuvittaar; ithu avarudaiya thaayaarukkum yoaseappukkum theriyaathirunthathu.
avar pirayaa'nakkaararin koottaththilea iruppaaren'ru avarka'l ninaiththu, orunaa'l pirayaa'nam vanthu, u'ravin mu'raiyaaridaththilum a'rimukamaanavarka'lidaththilum avaraith theadinaarka'l.
kaa'naathathinaalea avaraith theadikko'ndea erusaleamukkuth thirumpip poanaarka'l.
moon'runaa'laikkup pinpu, avar theavaalayaththil poathakar naduvil udkaarnthirukkavum, avarka'l peasuki'rathaik keadkavum, avarka'lai vinaavavum ka'ndaarka'l.
avar peasakkeatta yaavarum avarudaiya puththiyaiyum avar sonna maa'ruththarangka'laiyungku'riththup piramiththaarka'l.

thaay thakappanmaarum avaraik ka'ndu aachchariyappattaarka'l. appozhuthu avarudaiya thaayaar avarai noakki: makanea! ean engka'lukku ippadich seythaay? ithoa, un thakappanum naanum visaaraththoadea unnaith theadinoamea en'raa'l.
atha'rku avar: neengka'l ean ennaith theadineerka'l? en pithaavukkaduththavaika'lil naan irukkavea'ndiyathen'ru a'riyeerka'laa en'raar.
thangka'lukku avar sonna vaarththaiyai avarka'l u'narnthuko'l'lavillai.
pinpu avar avarka'ludanea koodappoay, naasareaththooril searnthu, avarka'lukkuk keezhppadinthirunthaar. avarudaiya thaayaar inthach sangkathika'laiyellaam than iruthayaththilea vaiththukko'ndaa'l.
iyeasuvaanavar gnaanaththilum, va'larththiyilum, theavakirupaiyilum, manushar thayavilum athikamathikamaay viruththiyadainthaar.

thipeariyuraayan raajyapaaram pa'n'nina pathinainthaam varushaththilea, ponthiyupilaaththu yootheayaavukkuth theasaathipathiyaayum, earoathu kaa'rpangku theasamaakiya kalileayaavukku athipathiyaayum, avan sakoatharanaakiya pilippu kaa'rpangku theasamaakiya iththureayaavukkum thiraakoniththi naatti'rkum athipathiyaayum, lisaaniyaa kaa'rpangku theasamaakiya apileaneakku athipathiyaayum,
annaavum kaaypaavum pirathaana aasaariyaraayum irunthakaalaththil vanaantharaththilea sakariyaavin kumaaranaakiya yoavaanukkuth theavanudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu: karththarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungka'l, avarukkup paathaika'laich sevvaipa'n'nungka'l en'rum,
pa'l'langka'lellaam nirappappadum, sakala malaika'lum kun'ruka'lum thaazhththappadum, koa'nalaanavaika'l sevvaiyaakum, karadaanavaika'l samamaakum en'rum,

maamsamaana yaavarum theavanudaiya iradchippaik kaa'npaarka'l en'rum, vanaantharaththilea kooppiduki'ravanudaiya saththam u'ndaakum en'ru easaayaa theerkkatharisiyin aakamaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapirakaaram,
avan yoarthaan nathikku arukaana theasamengkum poay, paavamannippukken'ru mananthirumputhalukkeat'ra gnaanasnaanaththaikku'riththup pirasangkiththaan.

avan, thannidaththil gnaanasnaanam pe'rumpadikkup pu'rappattuvantha thira'laana janangka'lai noakki: viriyanpaampuk kuttika'lea! varungkoapaththukkuth thappiththukko'l'la ungka'lukku vakaikaattinavan yaar?

mananthirumputhalukku eat'ra kanika'laik kodungka'l; aapirakaam engka'lukkuth thakappan en'ru ungka'lukku'l'lea sollaththodangkaathirungka'l; theavan inthak kalluka'linaalea aapirakaamukkup pi'l'laika'lai u'ndupa'n'na vallavaraayirukki'raar en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
ippozhuthea koadariyaanathu marangka'lin vear arukea vaiththirukki'rathu; aakaiyaal nalla kanikodaatha maramellaam vettu'ndu akkiniyilea poadappadum en'raan.
appozhuthu janangka'l avanai noakki: appadiyaanaal naangka'l enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'lukku avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: ira'ndu angkika'laiyudaiyavan illaathavanukkuk kodukkakkadavan; aakaaraththai udaiyavanum appadiyea seyyakkadavan en'raan.
aayakkaararum gnaanasnaanam pe'ravanthu, avanai noakki: poathakarea, naangka'l ennaseyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'ratha'rku athikamaay on'rum vaangkaathirungka'l en'raan.

poarchseavakarum avanai noakki: naangka'l ennaseyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarka'l. atha'rku avan: neengka'l oruvarukkum idukka'nseyyaamalum poyyaayk kut'ragnsaattaamalum, ungka'l sampa'lamea poathumen'rum irungka'l en'raan.
yoavaanaikku'riththu: ivanthaan ki'risthuvoa en'ru janangka'lellaarum e'n'nangko'ndu, thangka'l iruthayangka'lil yoasanaiyaayirukkaiyil,

yoavaan ellaarukkum pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan jalaththinaal ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanang kodukki'rean, ennilum vallavar oruvar varuki'raar, avarudaiya paatharadchaika'lin vaarai avizhkki'ratha'rkum naan paaththiran alla, avar parisuththaaaviyinaalum akkiniyinaalum ungka'lukku gnaanasnaanang koduppaar.
thoot'rukkoodai avar kaiyil irukki'rathu, avar thamathu ka'laththai nan'raay vi'lakki, koathumaiyaith thamathu ka'lagnchiyaththil searppaar; patharaiyoa aviyaatha akkiniyinaal sutterippaar en'raan.
vea'ru aneaka puththimathika'laiyum avan janangka'lukkuch sollip pirasangkiththaan.

kaa'rpangku theasaathipathiyaakiya earoathu than sakoatharanaana pilippuvin manaivi earoathiyaa'linimiththamaakavum, thaan seytha mat'rap pollaangkuka'linimiththamaakavum, yoavaanaalea kadinthuko'l'lappattapoathu,
thaan seytha mat'rellaap pollaangkuka'lum thavira, yoavaanaiyum kaavalil adaiththuvaiththaan.
janangka'lellaarum gnaanasnaanam pet'rapoathu, iyeasuvum gnaanasnaanam pet'ru, jepampa'n'nukaiyil, vaanam thi'rakkappattathu;
parisuththa aaviyaanavar roopangko'ndu pu'raavaippoala avarmeal i'rangkinaar. vaanaththilirunthu oru saththamum u'ndaaki: neer ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ummil piriyamaayirukki'rean en'ru uraiththathu.
appozhuthu iyeasu ea'rakku'raiya muppathu vayathu'l'lavaraanaar. avar yoaseappin kumaaranen'ru e'n'nappattaar. antha yoaseappu ealiyin kumaaran;
eali maaththaaththin kumaaran; maaththaath leaviyin kumaaran; leavi melkiyin kumaaran; melki yannaavin kumaaran; yannaa yoaseappin kumaaran;
yoaseappu maththaththiyaavin kumaaran; maththaththiyaa aamoasin kumaaran; aamoas naakoomin kumaaran; naakoom esliyin kumaaran; esli nangkaayin kumaaran.
nangkaay maakaaththin kumaaran; maakaath maththaththiyaavin kumaaran; maththaththiyaa seameayin kumaaran; seameay yoaseappin kumaaran; yoaseappu yoothaavin kumaaran; yoothaa yoavannaavin kumaaran.
yoavannaa reasaavin kumaaran; reasaa soropaapealin kumaaran; soropaapeal salaaththiyealin kumaaran; salaaththiyeal neariyin kumaaran.
neari melkiyin kumaaran; melki aththiyin kumaaran; aththi koasaamin kumaaran; koasaam elmoathaamin kumaaran; elmoathaam earin kumaaran; ear yoaseayin kumaaran.
yoasea eliyeasarin kumaaran; eliyeasar yoareemin kumaaran; yoareem maaththaaththin kumaaran; maaththaath leaviyin kumaaran.
leavi simiyoanin kumaaran; simiyoan yoothaavin kumaaran; yoothaa yoaseappin kumaaran; yoaseappu yoanaanin kumaaran; yoanaan eliyaakkeemin kumaaran.
eliyaakkeem meleyaavin kumaaran; meleyaa mayinaanin kumaaran; mayinaan maaththaaththaavin kumaaran; maaththaaththaa naaththaanin kumaaran; naaththaan thaaveethin kumaaran.
thaaveethu eesaayin kumaaran; eesaay oapeathin kumaaran; oapeath poavaasin kumaaran; poavaas salmoanin kumaaran; salmoan nakasoanin kumaaran.
nakasoan amminathaapin kumaaran; amminathaap aaraamin kumaaran; aaraam esroamin kumaaran; esroam paareasin kumaaran; paareas yoothaavin kumaaran; yoothaa yaakkoapin kumaaran.
yaakkoapu eesaakkin kumaaran; eesaakku aapirakaamin kumaaran; aapirakaam thearaavin kumaaran; thearaa naakoarin kumaaran.
naakoar searookkin kumaaran; searook rekoovin kumaaran; rekoo pealeakkin kumaaran; pealeak eapearin kumaaran; eapear saalaavin kumaaran.
saalaa kaayinaanin kumaaran; kaayinaan arppakasaaththin kumaaran; arppakasaath seamin kumaaran; seam noavaavin kumaaran; noavaa laameakkin kumaaran.
laameakku meththoosalaavin kumaaran; meththoosalaa eanoakkin kumaaran; eanoakku yaareathin kumaaran; yaareath makalaaleyealin kumaaran; makalaaleyeal keanaanin kumaaran; keanaan eanoasin kumaaran.
eanoas seaththin kumaaran; seath aathaamin kumaaran; aathaam theavanaal u'ndaanavan.
iyeasu parisuththa aaviyinaalea ni'rainthavaraay yoarthaanai vittuth thirumpi, aaviyaanavaraalea vanaantharaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoakappattu,
naa'rpathunaa'l pisaasinaal soathikkappattaar. antha naadka'lil avar on'rum pusiyaathirunthaar; antha naadka'l mudinthapinpu avarukkup pasiyu'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu pisaasu avarai noakki: neer theavanudaiya kumaaraneayaanaal, inthak kal appamaakumpadi sollum en'raan.
avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: manushan appaththinaaleamaaththiramalla, theavanudaiya ovvoru vaarththaiyinaalum pizhaippaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raar.
pinpu pisaasu avarai uyarntha malaiyinmeal ko'ndupoay, ulakaththin sakala raajyangka'laiyum oru nimishaththilea avarukkuk kaa'npiththu:
ivaika'l ellaavat'rinmealumu'l'la athikaaraththaiyum ivaika'lin makimaiyaiyum umakkuth tharuvean, ivaika'l enakku oppukkodukkappattirukki'rathu; enakku ishdamaanavanukku ivaika'laik kodukki'rean.
neer ennaip pa'ninthuko'ndaal ellaam ummudaiyathaakum en'ru sonnaan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: enakkup pinnaakappoa saaththaanea, un theavanaakiya karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu, avar oruvarukkea aaraathanaiseyvaayaaka en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raar.
appozhuthu avan avarai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoay, theavaalayaththu upparikaiyinmeal avarai ni'ruththi: neer theavanudaiya kumaaraneayaanaal, ingkeayirunthu thaazhakkuthiyum.
eanenil, ummaik kaakkumpadikkuth thammudaiya thootharka'lukku ummaikku'riththuk katta'laiyiduvaar en'rum,
umathu paatham kallil ida'raathapadikku, avarka'l ummaik kaika'lil eanthikko'ndupoavaarka'l en'rum, ezhuthiyirukki'rathu en'ru sonnaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: un theavanaakiya karththaraip pareedchai paaraathiruppaayaaka en'ru solliyirukki'rathea en'raar.
pisaasaanavan soathanaiyellaam mudiththapinpu, silakaalam avarai vittu vilakippoanaan.
pinpu iyeasu aaviyaanavarudaiya palaththinaalea kalileayaavukkuth thirumpip poanaar. avarudaiya keerththi sut'rilum irukki'ra theasamengkum parampit'ru.
avarka'ludaiya jepaaalayangka'lil avar upatheasiththu, ellaaraalum pukazhappattaar.
thaam va'larntha ooraakiya naasareaththukku avar vanthu, thammudaiya vazhakkaththinpadiyea oayvunaa'lil jepaaalayaththilea piraveasiththu, vaasikka ezhunthu nin'raar.
appozhuthu easaayaa theerkkatharisiyin pusthakam avaridaththil kodukkappattathu. avar pusthakaththai viriththapoathu:

karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar enmealirukki'raar; thariththirarukkuch suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkumpadi ennai apisheakam pa'n'ninaar; iruthayam narungku'ndavarka'laik ku'namaakkavum, si'raippattavarka'lukku viduthalaiyaiyum, kurudarukkup paarvaiyaiyum pirasiththappaduththavum, no'rungku'ndavarka'lai viduthalaiyaakkavum,
karththarudaiya anukkiraka varushaththaip pirasiththappaduththavum, ennai anuppinaar, en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra idaththai avar ka'ndu,
vaasiththu, pusthakaththaich surutti, pa'nividaikkaaranidaththil koduththu, udkaarnthaar. jepaaalayaththilu'l'la ellaarudaiya ka'nka'lum avarmeal noakkamaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu avar avarka'loadea peasaththodangki: ungka'l kaathuka'l keadka intha veathavaakkiyam in'raiyaththinam ni'raivea'rit'ru en'raar.
ellaarum avarukku na'rsaadchi koduththu, avarudaiya vaayilirunthu pu'rappatta kirupaiyu'l'la vaarththaika'laik ku'riththu aachchariyappattu: ivan yoaseappin kumaaran allavaa en'raarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: vaiththiyanea, unnaiththaanea ku'namaakkikko'l enki'ra pazhamozhiyaich solli, naangka'l kea'lvippattapadi kapparnakoomooril unnaal seyyappatta kiriyaika'l evaika'loa avaika'lai un ooraakiya ivvidaththilum sey en'ru neengka'l ennudan solluveerka'l enpathu nichchayam.
aanaalum theerkkatharisi oruvanum than oorilea angkeekarikkappadamaattaan en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
an'riyum eliyaavin naadka'lilea moon'ru varushamum aa'rumaathamum vaanam adaipattu, theasamengkum mikuntha pagncham u'ndaayirunthapoathu, isravealarukku'l aneakam vithavaika'l irunthaarka'l.
aayinum eliyaa seethoan naattilu'l'la sarepthaa (saa'ripaath) ooriliruntha oru vithavaiyinidaththi'rku anuppappattaaneayallaamal mat'roruththiyinidaththi'rkum anuppappadavillai.

allaamalum elisaa theerkkatharisiyin kaalaththilea isravealarukku'l'lea aneakam kushdaroakika'l irunthaarka'l; aayinum seeriyaa theasaththaanaakiya naakamaaneayallaamal avarka'lil vea'roruvanum suththamaakkappadavillai en'ru saththiyaththinpadiyea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
jepaaalayaththiliruntha ellaarum, ivaika'laik keattapozhuthu, koapamoo'ndu,

ezhunthirunthu, avarai oorukkup pu'rampea tha'l'li, thangka'l oor kattappattiruntha sengkuththaana malaiyin sikaraththilirunthu avaraith thalaikeezhaayth tha'l'lividumpadikku avvidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
avaroa avarka'l naduvinin'ru kadanthupoayvittaar.
pinpu avar kalileayaavilu'l'la kapparnakoom patta'naththukku vanthu, oayvunaadka'lil janangka'lukkup poathakam pa'n'ninaar.
avarudaiya vasanam athikaaramu'l'lathaayirunthapadiyaal avarudaiya poathakaththaikku'riththu avarka'l aachchariyappattaarka'l.
jepaaalayaththilea asuththa aavi pidiththiruntha oru manushan irunthaan.
avan: aiyoa! nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvea, engka'lukkum umakkum enna? engka'laik kedukkavaa vantheer? ummai innaar en'ru a'rivean; neer theavanudaiya parisuththar en'ru uraththasaththamittaan.

atha'rku iyeasu: nee peasaamal ivanai vittup pu'rappattup poa en'ru athai athattinaar; appozhuthu pisaasu avanai janangka'lin naduvea vizhaththa'l'li, avanukku oru seathamugnseyyaamal, avanai vittup poayvittathu.

ellaarum aachchariyappattu: ithu enna vaarththaiyoa! athikaaraththoadum vallamaiyoadum asuththa aavika'lukkum katta'laiyiduki'raar, avaika'l pu'rappattuppoaki'rathea en'ru oruvaroadoruvar peasikko'ndaarka'l.
avarudaiya keerththi sut'rilumiruntha naaduka'lilu'l'la idangka'lilellaam pirasiththamaayit'ru.
pinpu avar jepaaalayaththai vittup pu'rappattu, seemoan veettil piraveasiththaar, seemoanudaiya maami kadum juramaayk kidanthaa'l. ava'lukkaaka avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
avar ava'lidaththil kuninthunin'ru, juram neengkumpadi katta'laiyittaar, athu ava'lai vittu neengkit'ru; udanea ava'l ezhunthirunthu avarka'lukkup pa'nividai seythaa'l.

sooriyan asthamiththapoathu, janangka'lellaarum thangka'lukku'l'lea palapala viyaathika'laal varuththappattavarka'lai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l. avarka'l ovvoruvarmealum avar thammudaiya kaika'lai vaiththu, avarka'laich sosthamaakkinaar.

pisaasuka'lum: neer theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthu en'ru saththamittu, aneakaraivittup pu'rappattathu. avaraik ki'risthu en'ru pisaasuka'l a'rinthirunthapadiyaal avar avaika'laip peasavottaamal athattinaar.

uthayamaanapoathu, avar pu'rappattu, vanaantharamaana oaridaththi'rkup poanaar. thira'laana janangka'l avaraith theadi, avaridaththil vanthu, thangka'lai vittup poakaathapadikku avarai ni'ruththikko'ndaarka'l.
avaroa avarka'lai noakki: naan mat'ra oorka'lilum theavanudaiya raajyaththaikku'riththup pirasangkikkavea'ndum, itha'rkaakavea anuppappattean en'raar.
anthappadiyea kalileayaa naattilu'l'la jepaaalayangka'lil pirasangkam pa'n'nikko'nduvanthaar.
pinpu avar keneasareaththuk kadalarukea nin'rapoathu, thira'laana janangka'l theavavasanaththaik keadkumpadi avaridaththil nerungkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu kada'rkaraiyilea nin'ra ira'ndu padavuka'laik ka'ndaar. meenpidikki'ravarka'l avaika'lai vitti'rangki, valaika'lai alaisikko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu anthap padavuka'lil on'ril ea'rinaar, athu seemoanudaiyathaayirunthathu; athaik karaiyilirunthu sat'rea tha'l'lumpadi avanaik keattukko'ndu, anthap padavil udkaarnthu, janangka'lukkup poathakampa'n'ninaar.
avar poathakampa'n'ni mudiththa pinpu seemoanai noakki: aazhaththilea tha'l'likko'ndupoay, meenpidikkumpadi ungka'l valaika'laip poadungka'l en'raar.
atha'rkuch seemoan: aiyarea, iraamuzhuvathum naangka'l pirayaasappattum on'rum akappadavillai; aakilum ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea valaiyaip poaduki'rean en'raan.
anthappadiyea avarka'l seythu, thangka'l valai kizhinthupoakaththakkathaaka mikuthiyaana meenka'laip pidiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu mat'rap padaviliruntha koottaa'lika'l vanthu thangka'lukku uthaviseyyumpadikkuch saikaikaattinaarka'l; avarka'l vanthu, ira'ndu padavuka'lum amizhaththakkathaaka nirappinaarka'l.
seemoan peathuru athaik ka'ndu, iyeasuvin paathaththil vizhunthu: aa'ndavarea, naan paaviyaana manushan, neer ennaivittup poakavea'ndum en'raan.
avarka'l thira'laana meenka'laip pidiththathinimiththam, avanukkum avanoadukooda iruntha yaavarukkum piramippu'ndaanapadiyinaal appadich sonnaan.

seemoanukkuk koottaa'lika'laana sepetheayuvin kumaararaakiya yaakkoapum yoavaanum anthappadiyea piramiththaarka'l. appozhuthu iyeasu seemoanai noakki: payappadaathea, ithumuthal nee manusharaip pidikki'ravanaayiruppaay en'raar.
avarka'l padavuka'laik karaiyilea ko'ndupoay ni'ruththi, ellaavat'raiyum vittu, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

pinpu avar oru patta'naththil irukkaiyil, kushdaroakam ni'raintha oru manushan iyeasuvaik ka'ndu, mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: aa'ndavarea, umakkuch siththamaanaal, ennaich suththamaakka ummaalea aakum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan.
avar thamathu kaiyai neetti, avanaith thottu: enakkuch siththamu'ndu, suththamaaku en'raar; udanea kushdaroakam avanai vittu neengkit'ru.

avar avanai noakki: nee ithai oruvarukkum sollaamal, poay, unnai aasaariyanukkuk kaa'npiththu, nee suththamaanathinimiththam, moasea katta'laiyittapadiyea, avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaakap pali seluththu en'ru katta'laiyittaar.

appadiyirunthum avarudaiya keerththi athikamaakap parampit'ru. thira'laana janangka'l avarudaiya upatheasaththaik keadpatha'rkum avaraalea thangka'l pi'nika'l neengkich savukkiyamadaivatha'rkum koodivanthaarka'l.
avaroa vanaantharaththil thaniththup poay, jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaar.

pinpu orunaa'l avar upatheasiththukko'ndirukki'rapoathu, kalileayaa yootheayaa naaduka'lilu'l'la sakala kiraamangka'lilum, erusaleam nakaraththilumirunthu vantha pariseayarum niyaayasaasthirika'lum udkaarnthirunthaarka'l; appozhuthu pi'niyaa'lika'laik ku'namaakkaththakkathaakak karththarudaiya vallamai vi'langkit'ru.
appozhuthu sila manushar thimirvaathakkaaran oruvanaip padukkaiyoadea eduththukko'nduvanthu, avanai u'l'lea ko'ndupoakavum avar munpaaka vaikkavum vakaitheadinaarka'l.

janakkoottam mikuthiyaayirunthapadiyaal avanai u'l'lea ko'ndupoaki'ratha'rku vakaikaa'naamal, veettinmeal ea'ri, thattoaduka'l vazhiyaay janangka'lin maththiyil iyeasuvukku munpaaka avanaip padukkaiyoadea i'rakkinaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya visuvaasaththai avar ka'ndu, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki: manushanea, un paavangka'l unakku mannikkappattathu en'raar.
appozhuthu veathapaarakarum pariseayarum yoasanaipa'n'ni, theavathoosha'nam solluki'ra ivan yaar? theavan oruvareayan'rip paavangka'lai mannikkaththakkavar yaar en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'l sinthanaika'lai a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l iruthayangka'lil neengka'l sinthikki'rathenna?
un paavangka'l unakku mannikkappattathu en'ru solvathoa, ezhunthu nadaven'ru solvathoa, ethu e'lithu?

poomiyilea paavangka'lai mannikka manushakumaaranukku athikaaram u'ndenpathai neengka'l a'riyavea'ndum en'ru solli, thimirvaathakkaaranai noakki: nee ezhunthu, un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, un veettukkup poa en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
udanea avan avarka'lukku munpaaka ezhunthu, than padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, theavanai makimaippaduththi, than veettukkup poanaan.
athinaalea ellaarum aachchariyappattu, theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l; allaamalum, avarka'l payam ni'rainthavarka'laaki, athisayamaana kaariyangka'lai in'ru ka'ndoam en'raarka'l.
ivaika'lukkup pinpu, avar pu'rappattu, aayaththu'raiyil udkaarnthiruntha leavi ennum pearudaiya oru aayakkaaranaik ka'ndu: enakkup pinsen'ru vaa en'raar.
avan ellaavat'raiyum vittu, ezhunthu, avarukkup pinsen'raan.
antha leavi enpavan than veettilea avarukkup periya virunthupa'n'ninaan. aneaka aayakkaararum mat'ravarka'lum avarka'loadeakoodap panthiyirunthaarka'l.
veathapaarakarum pariseayarum avarudaiya seesharukku viroathamaaka mu'rumu'ruththu: neengka'l aayakkaararoadum paavika'loadum poajanapaanampa'n'nuki'rathennaven'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: pi'niyaa'lika'lukku vaiththiyan vea'ndiyatheayallaamal sukamu'l'lavarka'lukku vea'ndiyathillai.
neethimaanka'laiyalla, paavika'laiyea mananthirumpuki'ratha'rku azhaikkavanthean en'raar.

pinpu avarka'l avarai noakki: yoavaanudaiya seeshar aneakantharam upavaasiththu jepampa'n'nikko'ndu varuki'raarka'l, pariseayarudaiya seesharum appadiyea seyki'raarka'l, ummudaiya seeshar poajanapaanampa'n'nuki'raarka'lea, atheppadiyen'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ma'navaa'lan thangka'loadirukkaiyil ma'navaa'lanudaiya thoazharka'lai neengka'l upavaasikkach seyyakkoodumaa?
ma'navaa'lan avarka'lai vittu edupadum naadka'l varum, antha naadka'lilea upavaasippaarka'l en'raar.

avarka'lukku oru uvamaiyaiyum sonnaar: oruvanum puthiya vasthiraththu'ndaip pazhaiya vasthiraththinmeal poattu i'naikkamaattaan, i'naiththaal puthiyathu pazhaiyathaik kizhikkum; puthiya vasthiraththu'ndu pazhaiya vasthiraththukku ovvaathu.

oruvanum puthu thiraadcharasaththaip pazhanthuruththika'lil vaarththuvaikkamaattaan; vaarththuvaiththaal puthurasam thuruththika'laik kizhiththuppoadum, irasamum sinthippoam, thuruththika'lum kettuppoam.
puthu rasaththaip puthu thuruththika'lil vaarththuvaikkavea'ndum, appozhuthu ira'ndum paththirappattirukkum.
an'riyum oruvanum pazhaiya rasaththaik kudiththavudanea puthu rasaththai virumpamaattaan, pazhaiya rasamea nallathen'ru solluvaan en'raar.
paskaapa'ndikaiyin ira'ndaam naa'laikkup pinvantha muthalaam oayvunaa'lilea, avar payirvazhiyea nadanthupoakaiyil, avarudaiya seesharka'l kathirka'laik koythu, kaika'linaal nimittith thin'raarka'l.
pariseayaril silar avarka'lai noakki: oayvunaa'lil seyyaththakaathathai neengka'l ean seyki'reerka'l en'ru keattaarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: thaaveethum avanoadirunthavarka'lum pasiyaayirunthapoathu seythathai neengka'l vaasikkavillaiyaa? avan theavanudaiya veettil piraveasiththu, aasaariyar maaththiramea thavira vea'roruvarum pusikkaththakaatha theavasamukaththu appangka'laik keattu vaangki,
thaan pusiththathuman'ri, thannudanea kooda irunthavarka'lukkum koduththaanea en'ru sonnaar.
mealum manushakumaaran oayvunaa'lukkum aa'ndavaraay irukki'raar en'raar.
vea'roru oayvunaa'lilea, avar jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththu upatheasiththaar. angkea soompina valathukaiyaiyudaiya oru manushan irunthaan.
appozhuthu veathapaarakarum pariseayarum avaridaththil kut'ram pidikkumpadi, oayvunaa'lil sosthamaakkuvaaroa en'ru avarmeal noakkamaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya sinthanaika'lai avar a'rinthu, soompina kaiyaiyudaiya manushanai noakki: nee ezhunthu, naduvea nil en'raar. avan ezhunthu nin'raan.
appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'lidaththil on'ru keadki'rean; oayvunaadka'lil nanmai seyvathoa, theemai seyvathoa, jeevanaik kaappathoa, azhippathoa, ethu niyaayam en'ru keattu,
avarka'lellaaraiyum sut'rip paarththu, antha manushanai noakki: un kaiyai neettu en'raar. appadiyea avan than kaiyai neettinaan, udanea avan kai ma'rukaiyaippoalach sosthamaayit'ru.
avarka'loa moorkkave'riko'ndu, iyeasuvai enna seyyalaamen'ru oruvaroadoruvar aaloasiththaarka'l.
annaadka'lilea, avar jepampa'n'numpadi oru malaiyinmeal ea'ri, iraamuzhuvathum theavanai noakki jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaar.
pozhuthu vidinthapoathu, avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai varavazhaiththu, avarka'lil pannira'ndupearaith therinthuko'ndu, avarka'lukku appoasthalar en'ru pearittaar.
avarka'l yaarenil, peathuru en'ru thaam pearitta seemoan, avan sakoatharanaakiya anthireayaa, yaakkoapu, yoavaan, pilippu, pa'rtholomeayu,
maththeayu, thoamaa, alpeayuvin kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapu, seloaththea ennappatta seemoan,
yaakkoapin sakoatharanaakiya yoothaa, thuroakiyaana yoothaaskaariyoaththu enpavarka'lea.

pinpu avar avarka'ludaneakooda i'rangki, samanaana oru idaththilea nin'raar. angkea avarudaiya seesharil aneakampearum avarudaiya upatheasaththaik keadkumpadikkum, thangka'l viyaathika'linin'ru ku'namaakkappadumpadikkum, yootheayaatheasaththuth thisaika'l yaavat'rilirunthum, erusaleam nakaraththilirunthum, theeru seethoan patta'nangka'l irukki'ra kadaloaraththilirunthum vanthavarka'laakiya thira'laana janangka'lum irunthaarka'l.
asuththa aavika'laal vaathikkappattavarka'lum vanthu, aaroakkiyamadainthaarka'l.
avaridaththilirunthu vallamai pu'rappattu ellaaraiyum ku'namaakkinapadiyinaalea, janangka'l yaavarum avaraith thodumpadikku vakaitheadinaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakkippaarththu: thariththiraraakiya neengka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'ludaiyathu.
ippozhuthu pasiyaayirukki'ra neengka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; thirupthiyadaiveerka'l. ippozhuthu azhuki'ra neengka'l paakkiyavaanka'l; ini nakaippeerka'l.

manushakumaaran nimiththamaaka janangka'l ungka'laip pakaiththu, ungka'laip pu'rampaakki, ungka'lai ninthiththu, ungka'l naamaththaip pollaathathen'ru tha'l'lividumpoathu neengka'l paakkiyavaanka'laayiruppeerka'l.
annaa'lilea neengka'l santhoashappattuk ka'likoorungka'l; paraloakaththil ungka'l palan mikuthiyaayirukkum; avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'l theerkkatharisika'lukkum appadiyea seythaarka'l.
aisuvariyavaanka'laakiya ungka'lukku aiyoa; ungka'l aa'ruthalai neengka'l adainthu theernthathu.
thirupthiyu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'ra ungka'lukku aiyoa; pasiyaayiruppeerka'l. ippozhuthu nakaikki'ra ungka'lukku aiyoa; ini thukkappattu azhuveerka'l.
ellaa manusharum ungka'laik ku'riththup pukazhchchiyaayp peasumpoathu ungka'lukku aiyoa; avarka'l pithaakka'l ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'lukkum appadiyea seythaarka'l.
enakkuch sevikodukki'ra ungka'lukku naan solluki'rean: ungka'l saththurukka'laich sineakiyungka'l; ungka'laip pakaikki'ravarka'lukku nanmaiseyyungka'l.
ungka'laich sapikki'ravarka'lai aaseervathiyungka'l; ungka'lai ninthikki'ravarka'lukkaaka jepam pa'n'nungka'l.
unnai oru kannaththil a'raiki'ravanukku ma'ru kannaththaiyum kodu; un angkiyai eduththukko'l'luki'ravanukku un vasthiraththaiyum eduththukko'l'lath thadaipa'n'naathea.
unnidaththil keadki'ra evanukkum kodu; unnudaiyathai eduththuk ko'l'luki'ravanidaththil athaith thirumpak kea'laathea.
manushar ungka'lukku eppadich seyya vea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'reerka'loa, appadiyea neengka'lum avarka'lukkuch seyyungka'l.
ungka'laich sineakikki'ravarka'laiyea neengka'l sineakiththaal, ungka'lukkup palan enna? paavika'lum thangka'laich sineakikki'ravarka'laich sineakikki'raarka'lea.
ungka'lukku nanmaiseyki'ravarka'lukkea neengka'l nanmaiseythaal, ungka'lukkup palan enna? paavika'lum appadich seyki'raarka'lea.
thirumpak koduppaarka'len'ru nampi neengka'l kadankoduththaal ungka'lukkup palan enna? thirumpath thangka'lukkuk kodukkappadumpadiyaakap paavika'lum paavika'lukkuk kadankodukki'raarka'lea.

ungka'l saththurukka'laich sineakiyungka'l, nanmaiseyyungka'l, kaimmaa'ru karuthaamal kadan kodungka'l; appozhuthu ungka'l palan mikuthiyaayirukkum, unnathamaanavarukku neengka'l pi'l'laika'laayiruppeerka'l; avar nan'riya'riyaathavarka'lukkum thuroakika'lukkum nanmai seyki'raarea.
aakaiyaal ungka'l pithaa irakkamu'l'lavaraayirukki'rathupoala, neengka'lum irakkamu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l.

mat'ravarka'laik kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkaathirungka'l; appozhuthu neengka'lum kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkappadaathiruppeerka'l; mat'ravarka'lai aakkinaikku'l'laakumpadi theerkkaathirungka'l, appozhuthu neengka'lum aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappadaathiruppeerka'l; viduthalaipa'n'nungka'l, appozhuthu neengka'lum viduthalaipa'n'nappaduveerka'l.

kodungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkum kodukkappadum; amukkik kulukkich sarinthu vizhumpadi nan'raay a'lanthu, ungka'l madiyilea poaduvaarka'l; neengka'l entha a'lavinaal a'lakki'reerka'loa antha a'lavinaal ungka'lukkum a'lakkappadum en'raar.
pinnum avar oru uvamaiyai avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: kurudanukkuk kurudan vazhikaattakkoodumoa? iruvarum pa'l'laththil vizhuvaarka'l allavaa?
seeshan than kuruvukku mea'rpattavanalla, thea'rinavan evanum than kuruvaippoaliruppaan.
nee un ka'n'nilirukki'ra uththiraththai u'naraamal, un sakoatharan ka'n'nilirukki'ra thurumpaip paarkki'rathenna?

allathu nee un ka'n'nilirukki'ra uththiraththai u'naraamal, un sakoatharanai noakki: sakoatharanea, naan un ka'n'nilirukki'ra thurumpai eduththuppoadattum en'ru nee solvatheppadi? maayakkaaranea! munpu un ka'n'nilirukki'ra uththiraththai eduththuppoadu, pinpu un sakoatharan ka'n'nilirukki'ra thurumpai eduththuppoada vakaipaarppaay.
nalla maramaanathu ketta kani kodaathu, ketta maramaanathu nalla kani kodaathu.
anthantha maram athanathan kaniyinaal a'riyappadum; mudchedika'lil aththippazhangka'laip pa'rikki'rathumillai, nerugnchichsediyil thiraadchappazhangka'laip pa'rikki'rathumillai.

nalla manushan than iruthayamaakiya nalla pokkishaththilirunthu nallathai eduththuk kaattuki'raan; pollaatha manushan than iruthayamaakiya pollaatha pokkishaththilirunthu pollaathathai eduththukkaattuki'raan; iruthayaththin ni'raivinaal avanavan vaay peasum.
ennai aa'ndavarea! aa'ndavarea! en'ru neengka'l solliyum, naan solluki'rapadi neengka'l seyyaama'rpoaki'rathenna?
ennidaththil vanthu, en vaarththaika'laik keattu, avaika'linpadi seyki'ravan yaarukku oppaayirukki'raanen'ru ungka'lukkuk kaa'npippean.

aazhamaayth thoa'ndi, ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal asthipaaram poattu, veedukattuki'ra manushanukku oppaayirukki'raan; peruve'l'lam vanthu, neeroattam antha veettinmeal moathiyum, athai asaikkak koodaama'rpoayit'ru; eanen'raal athu kanmalaiyinmeal asthipaaram poadappattirunthathu.

en vaarththaika'laik keattum avaika'linpadi seyyaathavanoa asthipaaramillaamal ma'n'ninmeal veedukattinavanukku oppaayirukki'raan; neeroattam athinmeal moathinavudanea athu vizhunthathu; vizhunthu muzhuvathum azhinthathu en'raar.
avar thammudaiya vaarththaika'laiyellaam janangka'ludaiya kaathuka'l keadkumpadi solli mudiththapinpu, kapparnakoomukkup poanaar.
angkea noot'rukku athipathiyaakiya oruvanukkup piriyamaana vealaikkaaran viyaathippattu mara'na avasthaiyaayirunthaan.
avan iyeasuvaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattapoathu, avar vanthu than vealaikkaaranaik ku'namaakkavea'ndumen'ru, avarai vea'ndikko'l'lumpadi yootharudaiya moopparai avaridaththil anuppinaan.
avarka'l iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu, avaraik karuththaay vea'ndikko'ndu: neer inthath thayavuseyki'ratha'rku avan paaththiranaayirukki'raan.
avan nammudaiya janaththai neasikki'raan, namakku oru jepaaalayaththaiyum kattinaan en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'ludanea koodappoanaar. veettukkuch sameepamaanapoathu, noot'rukku athipathi than sineakitharai noakki: neengka'l avaridaththil poay, aa'ndavarea! neer varuththappadavea'ndaam; neer en veettu vaasalukku'l piraveasikka naan paaththiran alla;
naan ummidaththil varavum ennaip paaththiranaaka e'n'navillai; oru vaarththaimaaththiram sollum, appozhuthu en vealaikkaaran sosthamaavaan.

naan athikaaraththukkuk keezhppattavanaayirunthum, enakkuk keezhppattirukki'ra seavakarumu'ndu; naan oruvanaip poaven'raal poaki'raan, mat'roruvanai vaaven'raal varuki'raan; en vealaikkaaranai, ithaich seyyen'raal seyki'raan en'ru naan sonnathaakach sollungka'l en'ru avarka'lai anuppinaan.

iyeasu ivaika'laik keattu avanaik ku'riththu aachchariyappattu, thirumpi, thamakkup pinselluki'ra thira'laana janangka'lai noakki: isravealarukku'l'lum naan ippadippatta visuvaasaththaik kaa'navillai en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
anuppappattavarka'l veettukkuth thirumpivanthapoathu, viyaathiyaayk kidantha vealaikkaaran sukamadainthirukki'rathaik ka'ndaarka'l.
ma'runaa'lilea avar naayeen ennum oorukkup poanaar; avarudaiya seeshar aneakarum thira'laana janangka'lum avarudaneakoodap poanaarka'l.

avar oorin vaasalukkuch sameepiththapoathu, mariththuppoana oruvanai adakkampa'n'numpadi ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avan than thaaykku orea makanaayirunthaan. ava'loa kaimpe'n'naayirunthaa'l; ooraaril veku janangka'l ava'ludaneakooda vanthaarka'l.
karththar ava'laip paarththu, ava'lmeal manathuruki: azhaathea en'ru solli,
kittavanthu, paadaiyaith thottaar; athaich sumanthavarka'l nin'raarka'l; appozhuthu avar: vaalipanea, ezhunthiru en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
mariththavan ezhunthu udkaarnthu, peasaththodangkinaan. avanai avan thaayinidaththil oppuviththaar.
ellaarum payamadainthu: makaa theerkkatharisiyaanavar namakku'l'lea thoan'riyirukki'raar en'rum, theavan thamathu janangka'laich santhiththaar en'rum solli, theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.
inthach seythi yootheayaa theasamuzhuvathilum sut'riyirukki'ra thisaika'l yaavat'rilum pirasiththamaayit'ru.
ivaika'laiyellaam yoavaanudaiya seesharka'l avanukku a'riviththaarka'l. appozhuthu yoavaan than seesharil ira'ndupearai azhaiththu,
neengka'l iyeasuvinidaththi'rkup poay: varuki'ravar neerthaanaa? allathu vea'roruvar varak kaaththirukkavea'ndumaa? en'ru kea'lungka'l en'ru solli anuppinaan.

anthappadi avarka'l avaridaththil vanthu: varuki'ravar neerthaanaa? allathu vea'roruvar varak kaaththirukkavea'ndumaa? en'ru keadkumpadi yoavaansnaanan engka'lai ummidaththi'rku anuppinaar en'raarka'l.
anthach samayaththilea noayka'laiyum kodiya viyaathika'laiyum pollaatha aavika'laiyum ko'ndiruntha aneakarai avar ku'namaakki, aneakang kurudarukkup paarvaiya'liththaar.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l poay, ka'ndavaika'laiyum keattavaika'laiyum yoavaanukku a'riviyungka'l; kurudar paarvaiyadaiki'raarka'l, sappaa'nika'l nadakki'raarka'l, kushdaroakika'l suththamaaki'raarka'l, sevidar keadki'raarka'l, mariththoar ezhunthirukki'raarka'l, thariththirarukkuch suviseasham pirasangkikkappaduki'rathu.
ennidaththil ida'raladaiyaathirukki'ravan evanoa avan paakkiyavaan en'raar.
yoavaanudaiya thootharka'l poanapinpu avar yoavaanaikku'riththu janangka'lukkuch sonnathu ennaven'raal: ethaippaarkka vanaantharaththi'rkup poaneerka'l? kaat'rinaal asaiyum naa'nalaiyoa?
allaven'raal, ethaippaarkkap poaneerka'l? melliya vasthiranthariththa manushanaiyoa? alangkaara vasthiranthariththuch selvamaay vaazhki'ravarka'l arasar maa'likaika'lilea irukki'raarka'l.
allaven'raal, ethaippaarkkap poaneerka'l? theerkkatharisiyaiyoa? aam, theerkkatharisiyaip paarkkilum meanmaiyu'l'lavanaiyea en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
ithoa, naan en thoothanai umakku munpaaka anuppuki'rean; avan umakku munnea poay, umathu vazhiyai aayaththampa'n'nuvaan en'ru ezhuthiya vaakkiyaththaal ku'rikkappattavan ivanthaan.

sthireeka'lidaththilea pi'ranthavarka'lil yoavaansnaananaippaarkkilum periya theerkkatharisi oruvanumillai; aakilum, theavanudaiya raajyaththil si'riyavanaayirukki'ravan avanilum periyavanaayirukki'raanen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
yoavaanudaiya upatheasaththaik keatta aayakkaarar muthalaana sakala janangka'lum avanaalea gnaanasnaanam pet'ru, theavan neethiparar en'ru a'rikkaiyittaarka'l.
pariseayarum niyaayasaasthirika'lumoa avanaalea gnaanasnaanam pe'raamal thangka'lukkuk keadu'ndaakath theavanudaiya aaloasanaiyaith tha'l'livittaarka'l.
pinnum karththar sonnathu: inthach santhathiyai yaarukku oppiduvean? ivarka'l yaarukku oppaayirukki'raarka'l?

santhai ve'liyil udkaarnthu, oruvaraiyoruvar paarththu: ungka'lukkaakak kuzhal oothinoam, neengka'l kooththaadavillai; ungka'lukkaakap pulampinoam, neengka'l azhavillai en'ru ku'rai solluki'ra pi'l'laika'lukku oppaayirukki'raarka'l.
eppadiyenil, yoavaansnaanan appam pusiyaathavanum thiraadcharasam kudiyaathavanumaay vanthaan; atha'rku neengka'l: avan pisaasu pidiththirukki'ravan enki'reerka'l.
manushakumaaran poajanapaanam pa'n'nuki'ravaraay vanthaar; atha'rku neengka'l: ithoa, poajanappiriyanum mathupaanappiriyanumaana manushan, aayakkaararukkum paavika'lukkum sineakithan enki'reerka'l.
aanaalum gnaanamaanathu athan pi'l'laika'lellaaraalum neethiyu'l'lathen'ru oppukko'l'lappadum en'raar.
pariseayaril oruvan thannudanea poajanampa'n'navea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan; avar anthap pariseayanudaiya veettil piraveasiththup panthiyirunthaar.
appozhuthu antha ooriliruntha paaviyaakiya oru sthiree avar pariseayan veettilea panthiyirukki'rathai a'rinthu, oru para'niyil parima'lathailam ko'nduvanthu,

avarudaiya paathangka'lin arukea pinnaaka nin'ru azhuthuko'ndu, avarudaiya paathangka'laith than ka'n'neerinaal nanaiththu, than thalaimayirinaal thudaiththu, avarudaiya paathangka'lai muththagnseythu, parima'lathailaththaip poosinaa'l.

avarai azhaiththa pariseayan athaik ka'ndapoathu, ivar theerkkatharisiyaayirunthaal thammaith thoduki'ra sthiree innaa'len'rum ippadippattava'len'rum a'rinthiruppaar; iva'l paaviyaayirukki'raa'lea en'ru thanakku'l'lea sollikko'ndaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: seemoanea, unakku naan oru kaariyam sollavea'ndum en'raar. atha'rku avan: poathakarea, sollum en'raan.
appozhuthu avar: oruvanidaththil ira'ndupear kadanpattirunthaarka'l; oruvan ainnoo'ru ve'l'likkaasum, mat'ravan aimpathu ve'l'likkaasum kodukkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
kodukka avarka'lukku nirvaakamillaathapoathu, iruvarukkum kadanai manniththuvittaan. ippadiyirukka, avarka'lil evan avanidaththil athika anpaayiruppaan? athaich sol en'raar.
seemoan pirathiyuththaramaaka: evanukku athikamaay manniththuvittaanoa avanea athika anpaayiruppaan en'ru ninaikki'rean en'raan; atha'rku avar: sariyaay nithaaniththaay en'ru solli,

sthireeyinidamaayth thirumpi, seemoanai noakki: intha sthireeyaip paarkki'raayea; naan un veettil piraveasiththean, nee en kaalka'lukkuth tha'n'neer tharavillai, iva'loa, ka'n'neerinaal en kaalka'lai nanaiththu, than thalaimayirinaal avaika'laith thudaiththaa'l.
nee ennai muththagnseyyavillai, iva'loa, naan udpiraveasiththathu muthal, en paathangka'lai oayaamal muththagnseythaa'l.
nee en thalaiyil e'n'ney poosavillai, iva'loa, en paathangka'lil parima'lathailam poosinaa'l.

aathalaal naan unakkuch solluki'rean: iva'l seytha aneaka paavangka'l mannikkappattathu; iva'l mikavum anpukoornthaa'lea. evanukkuk kogncham mannikkappaduki'rathoa, avan kognchamaay anpukooruvaan en'ru solli;
ava'lai noakki: un paavangka'l mannikkappattathu en'raar.
appozhuthu koodap panthiyirunthavarka'l: paavangka'lai mannikki'ra ivan yaar en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarka'l.
avar sthireeyai noakki: un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu, samaathaanaththoadea poa en'raar.

pinpu, avar patta'nangka'lthoa'rum kiraamangka'lthoa'rum pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, theavanudaiya raajyaththi'rkuriya na'rseythiyaik koo'rip pirasangkiththuvanthaar. panniruvarum avarudaneakooda irunthaarka'l.
avar pollaatha aavika'laiyum viyaathika'laiyum neekkik ku'namaakkina sila sthireeka'lum, eazhu pisaasuka'l neengkina makathaleanaa'l ennappatta mariyaa'lum,
earoathin kaariyakkaaranaana koosaavin manaiviyaakiya yoavannaa'lum, soosannaa'lum, thangka'l aasthika'laal avarukku oozhiyagnseythuko'nduvantha mat'ra aneakam sthireeka'lum avarudanea irunthaarka'l.
sakala patta'nangka'lilumirunthu thira'laana janangka'l avaridaththil vanthu koodinapoathu, avar uvamaiyaakach sonnathu:
vithaikki'ravan oruvan vithaiyai vithaikkap pu'rappattaan; avan vithaikkaiyil sila vithai vazhiyarukea vizhunthu mithiyu'ndathu, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l vanthu athaip padchiththuppoattathu.
sila vithai ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal vizhunthathu; athu mu'laiththapin atha'rku eeramillaathathinaal ularnthupoayit'ru.
sila vithai mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vizhunthathu; mu'l kooda va'larnthu, athai nerukkippoattathu.

sila vithai nalla nilaththil vizhunthathu, athu mu'laiththu, on'ru noo'raakap palan koduththathu en'raar. ivaika'laich solli, keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'ru saththamittuk koo'rinaar.
appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharka'l, intha uvamaiyin karuththu ennaven'ru avaridaththil keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avar: theavanudaiya raajyaththin irakasiyangka'lai a'riyumpadi ungka'lukku aru'lappattathu; mat'ravarka'lukkoa, avarka'l ka'ndum kaa'naathavarka'laakavum, keattum u'naraathavarka'laakavum irukkaththakkathaaka, avaika'l uvamaika'laakach sollappaduki'rathu.
antha uvamaiyin karuththaavathu: vithai theavanudaiya vasanam.

vazhiyarukea vithaikkappattavarka'l vasanaththaik keadki'ravarka'laayirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l visuvaasiththu iradchikkappadaathapadikkup pisaasaanavan vanthu, avvasanaththai avarka'l iruthayaththilirunthu eduththuppoaduki'raan.

ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal vithaikkappattavarka'l keadkumpoathu santhoashaththudanea vasanaththai eat'rukko'l'luki'raarka'l; aayinum thangka'lukku'l'lea vearko'l'laathapadiyinaalea, kognchakkaalamaaththiram visuvaasiththu, soathanai kaalaththil pinvaangkippoaki'raarka'l.

mu'l'lu'l'la idangka'lil vithaikkappattavarka'l vasanaththaik keadki'ravarka'laayirukki'raarka'l; keattavudanea poay, pirapagnchaththi'rkuriya kavalaika'linaalum aisuvariyaththinaalum sit'rinpangka'linaalum nerukkappattu, palankodaathirukki'raarka'l.
nalla nilaththil vithaikkappattavarka'l vasanaththaik keattu, athai u'nmaiyum nanmaiyumaana iruthayaththilea kaaththup po'rumaiyudanea palankodukki'ravarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

oruvanum vi'lakkaik ko'luththi, athai oru paaththiraththinaalea moodavumaattaan, kattilinkeezhea vaikkavumaattaan; u'l'lea piraveasikki'ravarka'l athin ve'lichchaththaik kaa'numpadikku athai vi'lakkuththa'ndinmeal vaippaan.
ve'liyarangkamaakaatha irakasiyamumillai, a'riyappattu ve'likkuvaraatha ma'raiporu'lumillai.

aathalaal neengka'l keadki'ra vithaththaikku'riththuk kavaniyungka'l; u'l'lavanevanoa avanukkuk kodukkappadum; illaathavanevanoa avan thanakku'nden'ru ninaikki'rathum avanidaththilirunthu eduththukko'l'lappadum en'raar.
appozhuthu avarudaiya thaayaarum sakoathararum avaridaththil vanthaarka'l; janakkoottaththinaalea avara'ndaiyil avarka'l searakkoodaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu: ummudaiya thaayaarum ummudaiya sakoathararum ummaip paarkkavea'ndumen'ru ve'liyea ni'rki'raarka'l en'ru avarukku a'riviththaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: theavanudaiya vasanaththaik keattu, athinpadi seyki'ravarka'lea enakkuth thaayum enakkuch sakoathararumaayirukki'raarka'l en'raar.
pinpu orunaa'l avar thamathu seesharoadungkoodap padavil ea'ri: kadalin akkaraikkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar; appadiyea pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
padavu oadukaiyil avar niththiraiyaayirunthaar. appozhuthu kadalilea suzhalkaat'ru'ndaanathaal, avarka'l moasamadaiyaththakkathaayp padavu jalaththinaal ni'rainthathu.

avarka'l avaridaththil vanthu, aiyarea, aiyarea, madinthupoaki'roam en'ru avarai ezhuppinaarka'l; avar ezhunthu, kaat'raiyum jalaththin kontha'lippaiyum athattinaar; udanea avaika'l nin'rupoay, amaithalu'ndaayit'ru.

avar avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l visuvaasam engkea en'raar. avarka'l payanthu aachchariyappattu: ivar yaaroa, kaat'rukkum jalaththukkum katta'laiyiduki'raar, avaika'lum ivarukkuk keezhppadiki'rathea en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
pinpu kalileayaavukku ethiraana kathareanarudaiya naattil searnthaarka'l.

avar karaiyili'rangkinapoathu, nedunaa'laayp pisaasuka'l pidiththavanum, vasthiranthariyaathavanum, veettil thangkaamal pireathak kalla'raika'lilea thangkinavanumaayiruntha anthap patta'naththu manushan oruvan avarukku ethiraaka vanthaan.

avan iyeasuvaik ka'ndapoathu kookkuralittu, avarukku munpaaka vizhunthu: iyeasuvea, unnathamaana theavanudaiya kumaaranea, enakkum umakkum enna? ennai veathanaippaduththaathapadikku ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'ru makaa saththaththoadea sonnaan.

antha asuththaaavi avanai vittup poakumpadi iyeasu katta'laiyittapadiyinaalea appadich sonnaan. antha asuththaaavi vekukaalamaay avanaip pidiththirunthathu; avan sangkilika'linaalum vilangkuka'linaalum kattu'ndu kaavalpa'n'nappattirunthum kattuka'lai mu'riththuppoattup pisaasinaal vanaantharangka'lukkuth thuraththappattirunthaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: un pear ennaven'ru keattaar; atha'rku avan: leakiyoan en'raan; aneakam pisaasuka'l avanukku'l pukunthirunthapadiyaal anthap pearaich sonnaan.
thangka'laip paathaa'laththilea poakak katta'laiyidaathapadikku avaika'l avarai vea'ndikko'ndana.

avvidaththil aneakam pan'rika'l koottamaay malaiyilea meaynthuko'ndirunthathu. anthap pan'rika'lukku'l poakumpadi thangka'lukku uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum en'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndana; avaika'lukku uththaravukoduththaar.
appadiyea pisaasuka'l antha manushanaivittu neengki, pan'rika'lukku'l pukunthana; appozhuthu anthap pan'rikkoottam uyarntha meattilirunthu kadalilea paaynthu, amizhnthu, maa'ndathu.
avaika'lai meayththavarka'l sampaviththathaik ka'ndu, oadippoay, patta'naththilum sut'ruppu'rangka'lilum a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu, sampaviththathaip paarkkumpadi janangka'l pu'rappattu, iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu, pisaasuka'l vittuppoana manushan vasthiranthariththu iyeasuvin paathaththarukea udkaarnthu puththithe'linthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, payanthaarka'l.
pisaasuka'l pidiththirunthavan sosthamaakkappattathaik ka'ndavarka'lum athai avarka'lukku a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu kathareanarudaiya sut'ruppu'raththilu'l'la thira'laana janangka'l ellaarum mikavum payamadainthapadiyinaalea, thangka'lai vittup poakumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l. anthappadi avar padavil ea'ri, thirumpippoanaar.
pisaasuka'l neengkina manushan avaroadeakooda irukkumpadi uththaravu keattaan.

iyeasu avanai noakki: nee un veettukkuth thirumpippoay, theavan unakkuch seythavaika'laiyellaam a'rivi en'ru solli, avanai anuppivittaar. anthappadi avan poay, iyeasu thanakkuch seythavaika'laiyellaam patta'naththil engkum pirasiththappaduththinaan.
iyeasu thirumpivanthapoathu janangka'lellaarum avarukkaakak kaaththirunthapadiyaal avaraich santhoashamaay eat'rukko'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu jepaaalayaththalaivanaakiya yaveeru ennum pearu'l'la oruvan vanthu, iyeasuvin paathaththil vizhunthu, pannira'ndu vayathu'l'la thannudaiya orea kumaaraththi mara'na avasthaiyaayirunthapadiyaal,
than veetti'rku varumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan. avar poakaiyil thira'laana janangka'l avarai nerukkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu pannira'ndu varushamaayp perumpaadu'l'lava'laayirunthu, than aasthika'laiyellaam vaiththiyarka'lukkuch selavazhiththum, oruvanaalum sosthamaakkappadaathiruntha oru sthiree,
avarukkup pinnaaka vanthu, avarudaiya vasthiraththin oaraththaith thottaa'l; udanea ava'ludaiya perumpaadu nin'rupoayit'ru.

appozhuthu iyeasu: ennaith thottathu yaar en'ru keattaar. engka'lukkuth theriyaathen'ru ellaarum sonnapoathu, peathuruvum avanudanea kooda irunthavarka'lum: aiyarea, thira'laana janangka'l ummaich soozhnthu nerukkik ko'ndirukki'raarka'lea, ennaith thottathu yaar en'ru eppadik keadki'reer en'raarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: ennilirunthu vallamai pu'rappattathai a'rinthirukki'rean; aathalaal oruvar ennaith thottathu'ndu en'raar.

appozhuthu antha sthiree thaan ma'rainthirukkavillaiyen'ru ka'ndu, nadungkivanthu, avar munpaaka vizhunthu, thaan avaraith thotta kaara'naththaiyum udanea thaan sosthamaanathaiyum ellaa janangka'lukkum munpaaka avarukku a'riviththaa'l.
avar ava'laip paarththu: maka'lea, thidanko'l, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu, samaathaanaththoadea poa en'raar.

avar ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, jepaaalayaththalaivanudaiya veettilirunthu oruvan vanthu, avanai noakki: ummudaiya kumaaraththi mariththuppoanaa'l, poathakarai varuththappaduththa vea'ndaam en'raan.
iyeasu athaik keattu: payappadaathea; visuvaasamu'l'lavanaayiru, appozhuthu ava'l iradchikkappaduvaa'l en'raar.
avar veettil vanthapoathu, peathuruvaiyum yaakkoapaiyum yoavaanaiyum pe'n'nin thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum thavira vea'roruvaraiyum u'l'lea varavottaamal,
ellaarum azhuthu ava'laikku'riththuth thukkangko'ndaaduki'rathaik ka'ndu: azhaatheayungka'l, ava'l mariththuppoakavillai, niththiraiyaayirukki'raa'l en'raar.
ava'l mariththuppoanaa'len'ru avarka'l a'rinthathinaal, avaraip paarththu nakaiththaarka'l.
ellaaraiyum avar ve'liyea poakappa'n'ni, ava'ludaiya kaiyaip pidiththu: pi'l'laiyea ezhunthiru en'raar.
appozhuthu ava'l uyir thirumpa vanthathu; udanea ava'l ezhunthirunthaa'l; ava'lukku aakaarangkodukkak katta'laiyittaar.
ava'l thaaythakappanmaar aachchariyappattaarka'l. appozhuthu nadanthathai oruvarukkum sollaamalirukkumpadi avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
avar thammudaiya pannira'ndu seesharaiyum varavazhaiththu, sakala pisaasuka'laiyum thuraththavum, viyaathiyu'l'lavarka'laik ku'namaakkavum avarka'lukku vallamaiyum athikaaramum koduththu,
theavanudaiya raajyaththaikku'riththup pirasangkikkavum, pi'niyaa'lika'laich sosthamaakkavum avarka'lai anuppinaar.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: vazhikkuth thadiyaiyaavathu paiyaiyaavathu appaththaiyaavathu kaasaiyaavathu eduththukko'ndu poakavea'ndaam; ira'ndu angkika'laik ko'ndupoakavum vea'ndaam.
entha veettilea piraveasikki'reerka'loa, angkea thangki, angkirunthu pu'rappadungka'l.
ungka'lai eat'rukko'l'laathavarka'l evarka'loa avarka'ludaiya ooraivittu neengka'l pu'rappadumpoathu, avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka ungka'l kaalka'lil padintha thoosiyai utha'rippoadungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l pu'rappattuppoay, kiraamangka'lthoa'rum thirinthu, engkum suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu, pi'niyaa'lika'laik ku'namaakkinaarka'l.
appozhuthu kaa'rpangku theasaathipathiyaakiya earoathu avaraal seyyappatta yaavaiyum kea'lvippattathuman'ri; silar yoavaan mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaan en'rum,
silar eliyaa thoan'rinaan en'rum, vea'ru silar poorvakaalaththuth theerkkatharisika'lil oruvan uyirththezhunthaan en'rum sollikko'ndapadiyaal, kalakkamadainthu:
yoavaanai naan sirachseathampa'n'ninean, ivan ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'raan en'ru kea'lvippaduki'reanea! ivan yaar? en'ru earoathu solli, avaraip paarkka virumpinaan.

appoasthalar thirumpivanthu, thaangka'l seytha yaavaiyum avarukku vivariththuch sonnaarka'l. appozhuthu avar avarka'laik koottikko'ndu, thaniththirukkumpadi pethsaayithaa ennum patta'naththaich searntha vanaantharamaana oru idaththukkup poanaar.

janangka'l athai a'rinthu, avar pinnea poanaarka'l; avarka'lai avar eat'rukko'ndu, theavanudaiya raajyaththaikku'riththu avarka'ludanea peasi, sosthamadaiyavea'ndumen'rirunthavarka'laich sosthappaduththinaar.

saayangkaalamaaki'rapoathu, panniruvarum searnthuvanthu, avarai noakki: naam irukki'ra idam vanaantharamaayirukki'rathu, sut'riyirukki'ra oorka'lilum kiraamangka'lilum janangka'l poayth thangki, poajanapathaarththangka'laich sampaathiththukko'l'lumpadi avarka'lai anuppividavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'lea avarka'lukkup poajanangkodungka'l en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: engka'lidaththil ainthu appangka'lum ira'ndu meenka'lumaaththiramu'ndu, intha janangka'lellaarukkum poajanang kodukkavea'ndiyathaanaal, naangka'l poay vaangkikko'ndu varavea'ndumea en'raarka'l.
ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayiram purushar irunthaarka'l. avarka'laip panthikku aimpathu aimpathupearaaka udkaarumpadi sollungka'l en'ru thammudaiya seesharka'lukkuch sonnaar.
avarka'l anthappadiyea ellaaraiyum udkaarumpadi seythaarka'l.

appozhuthu avar antha ainthu appangka'laiyum antha ira'ndu meenka'laiyum eduththu, vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, avaika'lai aaseervathiththu, pittu, janangka'lmun vaikkumpadi seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar.
ellaarum saappittuth thirupthiyadainthaarka'l. meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'l pannira'ndu koodaini'raiya edukkappattathu.
pinpu avar thamathu seesharoadeakoodath thaniththu jepampa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil, avarka'lai noakki: janangka'l ennai yaar en'ru solluki'raarka'l en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l: silar ummai yoavaansnaanan en'rum, silar eliyaa en'rum, vea'ru silar poorvakaalaththuth theerkkatharisika'lil oruvar uyirththezhunthaar en'rum solluki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar: neengka'l ennai yaar en'ru solluki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar; peathuru pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer theavanudaiya ki'risthu en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l athai oruvarukkum sollaathapadikku u'ruthiyaayk katta'laiyittaar.

mealum manushakumaaran pala paaduka'lpadavum, moopparaalum pirathaana aasaariyaraalum veathapaarakaraalum aakaathavanen'ru tha'l'lappadavum, kollappadavum, moon'raam naa'lil uyirththezhunthirukkavum vea'ndum en'ru sonnaar.
pinpu avar ellaaraiyum noakki: oruvan en pinnea vara virumpinaal avan thannaiththaan ve'ruththu, than siluvaiyai anuthinamum eduththukko'ndu, ennaip pinpat'rakkadavan.
than jeevanai iradchikka virumpuki'ravan athai izhanthupoavaan; ennimiththamaakath than jeevanai izhanthupoaki'ravan athai iradchiththukko'l'luvaan.
manushan ulakamuzhuvathaiyum aathaayappaduththikko'ndaalum, thannaith thaan keduththu nashdappaduththinaal avanukku laapam enna?

ennaikku'riththum en vaarththaika'laikku'riththum evan vedkappaduki'raanoa, avanaikku'riththu manushakumaaranum thammudaiya makimaiyoadum pithaavin makimaiyoadum parisuththa thootharka'lin makimaiyoadum varumpoathu vedkappaduvaar.
ingkea ni'rki'ravarka'lil silar theavanudaiya raajyaththaik kaa'numun, mara'naththai rusipaarppathillaiyen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
intha vaarththaika'lai avar solli ea'rakku'raiya ettunaa'laanapinpu, avar peathuruvaiyum yoavaanaiyum yaakkoapaiyum koottikko'ndu, jepampa'n'nuki'ratha'rku oru malaiyinmeal ea'rinaar.
avar jepampa'n'nukaiyil, avarudaiya mukaroopam maa'rit'ru, avarudaiya vasthiram ve'nmaiyaakip pirakaasiththathu.
an'riyum moasea eliyaa ennum ira'ndupearum makimaiyoadea kaa'nappattu, avarudanea sampaasha'naipa'n'ni,
avar erusaleamilea ni'raiveat'rappoaki'ra avarudaiya mara'naththaikku'riththup peasikko'ndirunthaarka'l.
peathuruvum avanoadirunthavarka'lum niththiraimayakkamaayirunthaarka'l. aakilum avarka'l vizhiththu avarudaiya makimaiyaiyum avaroadea nin'ra avvira'ndupearaiyum ka'ndaarka'l.

avviruvarum avaraivittup pirinthupoakaiyil, peathuru iyeasuvai noakki: aiyarea, naam ingkea irukki'rathu nallathu, umakku oru koodaaramum, moaseakku oru koodaaramum, eliyaavukku oru koodaaramumaaka, moon'ru koodaarangka'laip poaduvoam en'ru, thaan solluki'rathu innathen'ru a'riyaamal sonnaan.
ippadi avan peasukaiyil, oru meakam vanthu avarka'lmeal nizhalittathu; avarka'l antha meakaththukku'l piraveasikkaiyil seesharka'l payanthaarka'l.
appozhuthu: ivar ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ivarukkuch sevikodungka'l en'ru meakaththilirunthu oru saththamu'ndaayit'ru.
anthach saththam u'ndaakaiyil iyeasu oruvarea kaa'nappattaar. thaangka'l ka'ndavaika'lil on'raiyum avarka'l annaadka'lil oruvarukkum sollaamal adakkivaiththirunthaarka'l.
ma'runaa'lil avarka'l malaiyilirunthi'rangkinapoathu, thira'laana janangka'l avarukku ethirko'nduvanthaarka'l.
avarka'lil oruvan saththamittu: poathakarea, en makanaik kadaadchiththaru'la vea'ndumen'ru ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean, avan enakku orea pi'l'laiyaayirukki'raan.
oru aavi avanaip pidikki'rathu, appozhuthu ala'ruki'raan, athu avanai nuraitha'l'la alaikkazhiththu, avanaik kasakkinapinpum, avanai vittu neengkuvathu arithaayirukki'rathu.
athaith thuraththividumpadi ummudaiya seesharai vea'ndikko'ndean, avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru en'raan.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: visuvaasamillaatha maa'rupaadaana santhathiyea, ethuvaraikkum naan ungka'loadirunthu, ungka'lidaththil po'rumaiyaayiruppean? un makanai ingkea ko'nduvaa en'raar.
avan sameepiththuvarukaiyil, pisaasu avanaik keezhea tha'l'li, alaikkazhiththathu. iyeasu antha asuththaaaviyai athatti, i'laignanaik ku'namaakki, avan thakappanidaththil avanai oppukkoduththaar.
appozhuthu ellaarum theavanudaiya makaththuvaththaik ku'riththup piramiththaarka'l. iyeasu seytha yaavaiyungku'riththu anaivarum aachchariyappadukaiyil avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki:
neengka'l intha vaarththaika'laik kavanamaayk kea'lungka'l; manushakumaaran manushar kaika'lil oppukkodukkappadappoaki'raar en'raar.
avarka'l antha vaarththaiyin karuththai a'rinthuko'l'lavillai; athu avarka'lukkuth thoan'raamal ma'raiporu'laayirunthathu; antha vaarththaiyaikku'riththu avaridaththil visaarikkavum payanthaarka'l.
pinpu thangka'lil evan periyavanaayiruppaanenki'ra vaakkuvaatham avarka'lukku'l u'ndaayit'ru.
iyeasu avarka'l iruthayaththin yoasanaiyai a'rinthu, oru si'rupi'l'laiyai eduththu, athaith thamatharukea ni'ruththi,

avarka'lai noakki: inthach si'rupi'l'laiyai en naamaththinimiththam eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan; ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai anuppinavarai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan; ungka'lellaarukku'l'lum evan si'riyavanaayirukki'raanoa avanea periyavanaayiruppaan en'raar.

appozhuthu yoavaan avarai noakki: aiyarea, oruvan ummudaiya naamaththinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'rathai naangka'l ka'ndu, avan engka'ludaneakooda ummaip pinpat'raathavanaanapadiyaal, avanaith thaduththoam en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: thadukkavea'ndaam; namakku viroathiyaayiraathavan namathu padchaththilirukki'raan en'raar.
pinpu, avar eduththukko'l'lappadum naadka'l sameepiththapoathu, avar erusaleamukkup poakath thamathu mukaththaiththiruppi,
thamakku munnaakath thootharka'lai anuppinaar. avarka'l poay, avarukku idaththai aayaththampa'n'numpadi samaariyarudaiya oru kiraamaththilea piraveasiththaarka'l.
avar erusaleamukkup poaka noakkamaayirunthapadiyinaal avvooraar avarai eat'rukko'l'lavillai.

avarudaiya seesharaakiya yaakkoapum yoavaanum athaik ka'ndapoathu: aa'ndavarea, eliyaa seythathupoala, vaanaththilirunthu akkini i'rangki ivarka'lai azhikkumpadi naangka'l katta'laiyida umakkuch siththamaa en'ru keattaarka'l.
avar thirumpippaarththu: neengka'l inna aaviyu'l'lavarka'lenpathai a'riyeerka'l en'ru athatti,
manushakumaaran manusharudaiya jeevanai azhikki'ratha'rku alla, iradchikki'ratha'rkea vanthaar en'raar. athanpinpu avarka'l vea'roru kiraamaththukkup poanaarka'l.
avarka'l vazhiyilea poakaiyil oruvan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer engkea poanaalum ummaip pinpat'ri varuvean en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: narika'lukkuk kuzhika'lum aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lukkuk kooduka'lum u'ndu, manushakumaaranukkoa thalaisaaykka idamillai en'raar.
vea'roruvanai avar noakki: ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar. atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, munpu naan poay en thakappanai adakkampa'n'na enakku uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: mariththoar thangka'l mariththoarai adakkampa'n'nattum; nee poay, theavanudaiya raajyaththaikku'riththup pirasangki en'raar.
pinpu vea'roruvan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, ummaip pinpat'ruvean, aanaalum munpu naan poay veettilirukki'ravarka'lidaththil anuppuviththukko'nduvarumpadi enakku uththaravu kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: kalappaiyinmeal than kaiyai vaiththup pinnittuppaarkki'ra evanum theavanudaiya raajyaththukkuth thakuthiyu'l'lavan alla en'raar.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu karththar vea'rea ezhupathupearai niyamiththu, thaam poakum sakala patta'nangka'lukkum idangka'lukkum avarka'laith thamakku munnea ira'ndira'ndu pearaaka anuppinaar.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: a'ruppu mikuthi, vealaiyaadka'loa kogncham; aakaiyaal a'ruppukku ejamaan thamathu a'ruppukku vealaiyaadka'lai anuppumpadi avarai vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l.
pu'rappattuppoangka'l; aattukkuttika'lai oanaayka'lukku'l'lea anuppuki'rathupoala, ithoa, naan ungka'lai anuppuki'rean.
pa'nappaiyaiyum saamaan paiyaiyum paatharadchaika'laiyum ko'ndupoakavea'ndaam; vazhiyilea oruvaraiyum vinavavum vea'ndaam.
oru veettil piraveasikki'rapoathu: intha veettukkuch samaathaanam u'ndaavathaakaven'ru muthalaavathu sollungka'l.
samaathaana paaththiran angkea irunthaal, neengka'l koo'rina samaathaanam avanidaththil thangkum, illaathirunthaal athu ungka'lidaththi'rkuth thirumpivarum.
antha veettileathaanea neengka'l thangkiyirunthu, avarka'l kodukki'ravaika'laip pusiththuk kudiyungka'l; vealaiyaa'l than koolikkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan. veettukku veedu poakaathirungka'l.
oru patta'naththil neengka'l piraveasikki'rapozhuthu, janangka'l ungka'lai eat'rukko'ndaal avarka'l ungka'lmun vaikki'ravaika'lai neengka'l pusiththu,
avvidaththilu'l'la pi'niyaa'lika'laich sosthamaakki: theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lukkuch sameepamaay vanthirukki'rathu en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollungka'l.
yaathoru patta'naththil neengka'l piraveasikki'rapozhuthu, janangka'l ungka'lai eat'rukko'l'laavittaal athin veethika'lilea neengka'l poay:

engka'lil ottina ungka'l patta'naththin thoosiyaiyum ungka'lukku viroathamaayth thudaiththuppoaduki'roam; aayinum theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lukkuch sameepamaay vanthirukki'rathenpathai a'rinthuko'lveerka'laaka en'ru sollungka'l.
anthap patta'naththi'rku neariduvathaippaarkkilum antha naa'lilea soathoam naatti'rku neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

koaraaseen patta'namea, unakku aiyoa, pethsaayithaa patta'namea, unakku aiyoa, ungka'lil seyyappatta palaththa seykaika'l theeruvilum seethoanilum seyyappattirunthathaanaal, appozhuthea irattuduththi, saampalil udkaarnthu, mananthirumpiyiruppaarka'l.
niyaayaththeerppunaa'lil ungka'lukku neariduvathaippaarkkilum, theeruvukkum seethoanukkum neariduvathu ilakuvaayirukkum.
vaanapariyantham uyarththappatta kapparnakoomea, nee paathaa'lapariyantham thaazhththappaduvaay en'ru solli,

seesharai noakki: ungka'lukkuch sevikodukki'ravan enakkuch sevikodukki'raan, ungka'lai asattaipa'n'nuki'ravan ennai asattaipa'n'nuki'raan, ennai asattaipa'n'nuki'ravan ennai anuppinavarai asattaipa'n'nuki'raan en'raar.
pinpu antha ezhupathupearum santhoashaththoadea thirumpivanthu: aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya naamaththinaalea pisaasuka'lum engka'lukkuk keezhppadiki'rathu en'raarka'l.
avarka'lai avar noakki: saaththaan minnalaippoala vaanaththilirunthu vizhuki'rathaik ka'ndean.
ithoa, sarppangka'laiyum thea'lka'laiyum mithikkavum, saththuruvinudaiya sakala vallamaiyaiyum mea'rko'l'lavum ungka'lukku athikaarangkodukki'rean; on'rum ungka'laich seathappaduththamaattaathu.
aakilum, aavika'l ungka'lukkuk keezhppadiki'ratha'rkaaka neengka'l santhoashappadaamal, ungka'l naamangka'l paraloakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ratha'rkaakach santhoashappadungka'l en'raar.

antha vea'laiyil iyeasu aaviyilea ka'likoornthu: pithaavea! vaanaththukkum poomikkum aa'ndavarea! ivaika'lai neer gnaanika'lukkum kalvimaanka'lukkum ma'raiththu, paalakarukku ve'lippaduththinapadiyaal ummai sthoaththirikki'rean; aam, pithaavea! ippadich seyvathu ummudaiya thiruvu'laththukkup piriyamaayirunthathu.

sakalamum en pithaavinaal enakku oppukkodukkappattirukki'rathu; pithaa thavira vea'roruvanum kumaaran innaaren'ru a'riyaan, kumaaranum, kumaaran avarai evanukku ve'lippaduththach siththamaayirukki'raaroa avanunthavira, vea'roruvanum pithaa innaaren'ru a'riyaan en'raar.
pinpu thamathu seesharidaththil thirumpi, thaniththu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l kaa'nki'ravaika'laik kaa'nung ka'nka'l paakkiyamu'l'lavaika'l.
