aneaka theerkkatharisika'lum raajaakka'lum neengka'l kaa'nki'ravaika'laik kaa'navum, neengka'l keadki'ravaika'laik keadkavum virumpiyum, kaa'naamalum kea'laamalum poanaarka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu niyaayasaasthiri oruvan ezhunthirunthu, avaraich soathikkumpadi: poathakarea, niththiya jeevanaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadikku naan enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku avar: niyaayappiramaa'naththil enna ezhuthiyirukki'rathu? nee vaasiththirukki'rathu enna en'raar.

avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: un theavanaakiya karththaridaththil un muzhu iruthayaththoadum un muzhu aaththumaavoadum un muzhup palaththoadum un muzhuchsinthaiyoadum anpukoornthu, unnidaththil anpukooruvathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu en'raan.
avar avanai noakki: nithaanamaay uththaravu sonnaay; appadiyea sey, appozhuthu pizhaippaay en'raar.
avan thannai neethimaan en'ru kaa'npikka manathaay iyeasuvai noakki: enakkup pi'ran yaar en'ru keattaan.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: oru manushan erusaleamilirunthu erikoavukkup poakaiyil ka'l'lar kaiyil akappattaan; avarka'l avan vasthirangka'lai urinthuko'ndu, avanaik kaayappaduththi, kut'ruyiraaka vittup poanaarka'l.
appozhuthu tha'rseyalaay oru aasaariyan antha vazhiyea vanthu, avanaik ka'ndu, pakkamaay vilakippoanaan.
anthappadiyea oru leaviyanum antha idaththukku vanthu, avanaik ka'ndu, pakkamaay vilakippoanaan.
pinpu samaariyan oruvan pirayaa'namaay varukaiyil, avanaik ka'ndu, manathuruki,

kitta vanthu, avanudaiya kaayangka'lil e'n'neyum thiraadcharasamum vaarththu, kaayangka'laik katti, avanaith than suyavaakanaththinmeal eat'ri, saththiraththukkuk ko'ndupoay, avanaip paraamariththaan.

ma'runaa'lilea thaan pu'rappadumpoathu ira'ndu pa'naththai eduththu, saththiraththaan kaiyil koduththu: nee ivanai visaariththukko'l, athikamaay eathaakilum ivanukkaakach selavazhiththaal, naan thirumpivarumpoathu athai unakkuth tharuvean en'raan.
ippadiyirukka, ka'l'larkaiyil akappattavanukku intha moon'rupearil evan pi'ranaayirunthaan? unakku eppadith thoan'ruki'rathu en'raar.
atha'rku avan: avanukku irakkagnseythavanea en'raan. appozhuthu iyeasu avanai noakki: neeyum poay anthappadiyea sey en'raar.
pinpu, avarka'l pirayaa'namaayp poakaiyil, avar oru kiraamaththil piraveasiththaar. angkea maarththaa'l ennum pearko'nda oru sthiree avaraith than veettilea eat'rukko'ndaa'l.
ava'lukku mariyaa'l ennappatta oru sakoathari irunthaa'l; ava'l iyeasuvin paathaththarukea udkaarnthu, avarudaiya vasanaththaik keattukko'ndirunthaa'l.

maarththaa'loa pa'rpala vealaika'laich seyvathil mikavum varuththamadainthu, avaridaththil vanthu: aa'ndavarea, naan thaniyea vealaiseyyumpadi en sakoathari ennai vittuvanthirukki'rathaik ku'riththu umakkuk kavaiyillaiyaa? enakku uthaviseyyumpadi ava'lukkuch sollum en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: maarththaa'lea, maarththaa'lea, nee aneaka kaariyangka'laikku'riththuk kavalaippattuk kalangkuki'raay.
theavaiyaanathu on'rea, mariyaa'l thannai vittedupadaatha nalla pangkaith therinthuko'ndaa'l en'raar.

avar oru idaththil jepampa'n'ni mudiththapinpu, avarudaiya seesharil oruvan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, yoavaan than seesharukku jepampa'n'nap poathiththathupoala, neerum engka'lukkup poathikkavea'ndum en'raan.

atha'rku avar: neengka'l jepampa'n'numpoathu: parama'ndalangka'lilirukki'ra engka'l pithaavea, ummudaiya naamam parisuththappaduvathaaka; ummudaiya raajyam varuvathaaka; ummudaiya siththam parama'ndalaththilea seyyappaduki'rathupoalap poomiyileayum seyyappaduvathaaka;
engka'lukku vea'ndiya aakaaraththai an'ran'rum engka'lukkuth thaarum;

engka'l paavangka'lai engka'lukku manniyum; naangka'lum engka'lidaththil kadanpatta evanukkum mannikki'roamea; engka'laich soathanaikkudpadappa'n'naamal, theemaiyinin'ru engka'lai iradchiththuk ko'l'lum, en'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lil oruvan thanakkuch sineakithanaayirukki'ravanidaththil paathiraaththiriyilea poay: sineakithanea,

en sineakithan oruvan vazhippirayaa'namaay ennidaththil vanthirukki'raan, avanmun vaikki'ratha'rku ennidaththil on'rumillai, nee moon'ru appangka'lai enakkuk kadanaakath tharavea'ndum en'ru keattukko'ndaan.

veettukku'l irukki'ravan pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennaith thontharavu seyyaathea, kathavu poottiyaayit'ru, en pi'l'laika'l ennoadeakoodap paduththirukki'raarka'l, naan ezhunthirunthu, unakkuth tharakkoodaathu en'ru sonnaan.

pinpu, thanakku avan sineakithanaayirukki'rathinimiththam ezhunthu avanukkuk kodaavittaalum, thannidaththil avan varunthik keadki'rathinimiththamaavathu ezhunthirunthu, avanukkuth theavaiyaanathaik koduppaan en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
mealum naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rathaavathu: kea'lungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkuk kodukkappadum; theadungka'l, appozhuthu ka'ndadaiveerka'l; thattungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukkuth thi'rakkappadum.
eanen'raal, keadki'ravan evanum pet'rukko'l'luki'raan; theaduki'ravan ka'ndadaiki'raan; thattuki'ravanukkuth thi'rakkappadum.
ungka'lil thakappanaayirukki'ra oruvanidaththil makan appangkeattaal, avanukkuk kallaik koduppaanaa? meenaik keattaal meenukkup pathilaayp paampaik koduppaanaa?
allathu muttaiyaik keattaal, avanukkuth thea'laik koduppaanaa?

pollaathavarka'laakiya neengka'l ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukku nalla eevuka'laik kodukka a'rinthirukkumpoathu, paramapithaavaanavar thammidaththil vea'ndikko'l'luki'ravarka'lukkup parisuththa aaviyaik koduppathu athika nichchayam allavaa en'raar.
pinpu avar oomaiyaayiruntha oru pisaasaith thuraththinaar. pisaasu pu'rappattuppoanapinpu oomaiyan peasinaan; janangka'l aachchariyappattaarka'l.
avarka'lil silar: ivan pisaasuka'lin thalaivanaakiya peyelsepoolaikko'ndu pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'raan en'raarka'l.
vea'ru silar avaraich soathikkumpadi vaanaththilirunthu oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaattavea'ndumen'ru avaridaththil keattaarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya sinthanaika'lai avar a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: thanakkuth thaanea viroathamaayp pirinthirukki'ra entha raajyamum paazhaayppoam; thanakkuththaanea viroathamaayp pirinthirukki'ra entha veedum vizhunthupoam.
saaththaanum thanakkuththaanea viroathamaayp pirinthirunthaal avan raajyam eppadi nilaini'rkum? ippadiyirukka, peyelsepoolaikko'ndu naan pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'rean enki'reerka'lea.
naan peyelsepoolinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththinaal, ungka'l pi'l'laika'l avaika'lai yaaraalea thuraththuki'raarka'l? aakaiyaal, avarka'lea ungka'lai niyaayantheerkki'ravarka'laayiruppaarka'l.
naan theavanudaiya viralinaalea pisaasuka'laith thuraththuki'rapadiyaal, theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lidaththil vanthirukki'rathea.
aayuthanthariththa palavaan than aramanaiyaik kaakki'rapoathu, avanudaiya poru'l paththirappattirukkum.
avanilum athika palavaan vanthu, avanai mea'rko'lvaaneayaakil, avan nampiyiruntha sakala aayuthavarkkaththaiyum pa'riththukko'ndu, avanudaiya ko'l'laipporu'laip pangkiduvaan.
ennoadea iraathavan enakku viroathiyaayirukki'raan, ennoadea searkkaathavan sitha'radikki'raan.
asuththaaavi oru manushanai vittup pu'rappadumpoathu, va'ra'nda idangka'lil alainthu, i'laippaa'ruthal theadiyum ka'ndadaiyaamal: naan vittuvantha en veettukkuth thirumpippoavean en'ru solli,
athil varumpoathu, athu perukki joadikkappattirukkak ka'ndu,

thirumpippoay, thannilum pollaatha vea'ru eazhu aavika'laik koottikko'nduvanthu, udpukunthu, angkea kudiyirukkum; appozhuthu antha manushanudaiya munnilaimaiyilum avan pinnilaimai athika keadu'l'lathaayirukkum en'raar.
avar ivaika'laich sollukaiyil, janakkoottaththiliruntha oru sthiree avarai noakki: ummaich sumantha karppamum neer paalu'nda mulaika'lum paakkiyamu'l'lavaika'len'ru saththamittuch sonnaa'l.
atha'rku avar: appadiyaanaalum, theavanudaiya vaarththaiyaik keattu, athaik kaaththukko'l'luki'ravarka'lea athika paakkiyavaanka'l en'raar.

janangka'l thira'laayk koodivanthirukki'rapozhuthu avar: inthach santhathiyaar pollaathavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l, adaiyaa'laththaith theaduki'raarka'l; aanaalum yoanaa theerkkatharisiyin adaiyaa'lameayan'ri vea'rea adaiyaa'lam ivarka'lukkuk kodukkappaduvathillai.
yoanaa ninivea patta'naththaarukku adaiyaa'lamaayirunthathupoala, manushakumaaranum inthach santhathikku adaiyaa'lamaayiruppaar.

thentheasaththu raajasthiree saalomoanudaiya gnaanaththaik keadkap poomiyin ellaika'lilirunthu vanthaa'l; ithoa, saalomoanilum periyavar ingkea irukki'raar; aathalaal niyaayaththeerppu naa'lilea antha raajasthiree inthach santhathiyaaroadezhunthu nin'ru, ivarka'lmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaa'l.

yoanaavin pirasangkaththaik keattu ninivea patta'naththaar mananthirumpinaarka'l; ithoa, yoanaavilum periyavar ingkea irukki'raar; aathalaal niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea ninivea patta'naththaar inthach santhathiyaaroadezhunthu nin'ru, ivarka'lmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaarka'l.
oruvanum vi'lakkaik ko'luththi, ma'raividaththilaavathu, marakkaalin keezheayaavathu vaikkaamal, u'l'lea varuki'ravarka'l ve'lichcham kaa'numpadi, athai vi'lakkuththa'ndinmeal vaippaan.
ka'n'naanathu sareeraththin vi'lakkaayirukki'rathu; un ka'n the'livaayirunthaal, un sareeramuzhuvathum ve'lichchamaayirukkum; un ka'n kettathaayirunthaal un sareeram muzhuvathum iru'laayirukkum.
aakaiyaal unnilu'l'la ve'lichcham iru'laakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayiru.

un sareeram orupu'raththilum iru'ladainthiraamal muzhuvathum ve'lichchamaayirunthaal, oru vi'lakku than pirakaasaththinaalea unakku ve'lichcham kodukki'rathupoala un sareeramuzhuvathum ve'lichchamaayirukkum en'raar.
avar ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, pariseayan oruvan thannudaneakooda avar paka'rpoajanam pa'n'navea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan; avar poayp panthiyirunthaar.
avar poajanampa'n'nuki'ratha'rkumun kaikazhuvaamalirunthathaip pariseayan ka'ndu, aachchariyappattaan.

karththar avanai noakki: pariseayaraakiya neengka'l poajanapaana paaththirangka'lin ve'lippu'raththaich suththamaakkuki'reerka'l, ungka'l u'l'lamoa ko'l'laiyinaalum pollaappinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
mathikeadarea, ve'lippu'raththai u'ndaakkinavar udpu'raththaiyum u'ndaakkavillaiyoa?
ungka'lukku u'ndaanavaika'lil pichchai kodungka'l, appozhuthu sakalamum ungka'lukkuch suththamaayirukkum.

pariseayarea, ungka'lukku aiyoa, neengka'l o'rthalaam marukkozhunthu muthaliya sakalavitha poo'nduka'lilum thasamapaakam koduththu, niyaayaththaiyum theava anpaiyum vittuviduki'reerka'l; ivaika'laiyum seyyavea'ndum, avaika'laiyum vidaathirukkavea'ndumea.
pariseayarea, ungka'lukku aiyoa, jepa aalayangka'lil muthanmaiyaana aasanangka'laiyum, santhaika'lil vanthanangka'laiyum virumpuki'reerka'l.

maayakkaararaakiya veathapaarakarea, pariseayarea, ungka'lukku aiyoa, ma'rainthirukki'ra pireathakkuzhika'laippoalirukki'reerka'l, avaika'lmeal nadakki'ra manusharukku avaika'l theriyaathirukki'rathu en'raar.
appozhuthu niyaayasaasthirika'lil oruvan avarai noakki: poathakarea, neer ippadich solluki'rathinaal engka'laiyum ninthikki'reerea en'raan.

atha'rku avar: niyaayasaasthirika'lea, ungka'lukku aiyoa, sumakka arithaana sumaika'lai manusharmeal sumaththuki'reerka'l; neengka'loa ungka'l viralka'lil on'rinaalum anthach sumaika'laith thodavummaatteerka'l.
ungka'lukku aiyoa, ungka'l pithaakka'l kolaiseytha theerkkatharisika'lukkuk kalla'raika'laik kattuki'reerka'l.

aakaiyaal ungka'l pithaakka'ludaiya kiriyaika'lukku neengka'lum udanpattavarka'len'ru saadchiyiduki'reerka'l; eppadiyen'raal, ungka'l pithaakka'l avarka'laik kolaiseythaarka'l, neengka'loa avarka'lukkuk kalla'raika'laik kattuki'reerka'l.
aathalaal theavagnaanamaanathu: naan theerkkatharisika'laiyum appoasthalarka'laiyum avarka'lidaththil anuppuvean; avarka'lil silaraik kolaiseythu, silaraith thunpappaduththuvaarka'l;

aapealin iraththammuthal palipeedaththukkum theavaalayaththukkum naduvea kolaiyu'nda sakariyaavin iraththamvaraikkum, ulakaththoat'ramutha'rko'ndu sinthappatta sakala theerkkatharisika'ludaiya iraththappazhiyum inthach santhathiyinidaththil keadkappadaththakkathaaka appadich seyvaarka'l en'ru solluki'rathu.
nichchayamaakavea inthach santhathiyinidaththil athu keadkappadum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
niyaayasaasthirika'lea, ungka'lukku aiyoa, a'rivaakiya thi'ravukoalai eduththuk ko'ndeerka'l, neengka'lum udpiraveasikki'rathillai, udpiraveasikki'ravarka'laiyum thadaipa'n'nuki'reerka'l en'raar.

ivaika'lai avarka'lukku avar sollukaiyil, veathapaarakarum pariseayarum avarmeal kut'ragnsaattum poruttu, avar vaaymozhiyil eathaakilum pizhai ka'ndupidikkavea'ndum en'ru upaayampa'n'ni avarai mikavum nerukkavum,
aneaka kaariyangka'laikku'riththup peasumpadi avarai eavavum thodangkinaarka'l.

aththaru'naththilea aneakamaayiram janangka'l oruvaraiyoruvar mithikkaththakkathaakak koodivanthirukkaiyil, avar muthalaavathu thammudaiya seesharai noakki: neengka'l maayamaakiya pariseayarudaiya pu'liththamaavaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
ve'liyaakkappadaatha ma'raiporu'lumillai, a'riyappadaatha irakasiyamumillai.
aathalaal, neengka'l iru'lilea peasinathu ethuvoa, athu ve'lichchaththilea keadkappadum; neengka'l a'raika'lil kaathilea sonnathu ethuvoa, athu veeduka'linmeal koo'rappadum.
en sineakitharaakiya ungka'lukku naan solluki'rean: sareeraththaik kolaiseythu, athanpinpu athikamaaka on'rum seyyath thiraa'niyillaathavarka'lukkup payappadaathirungka'l.

neengka'l innaarukkup payappadavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukkuk kaa'npikki'rean: kolaiseythapinpu narakaththilea tha'l'la vallamaiyu'l'lavarukkup payappadungka'l; aam, avarukkea payappadungka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
ira'ndu kaasukku ainthu adaikkalaan kuruvika'lai vi'rki'raarka'lallavaa? avaika'lil on'raakilum theavanaal ma'rakkap paduki'rathillai.
ungka'l thalaiyilu'l'la mayirellaam e'n'nappattirukki'rathu, aakaiyaal payappadaathirungka'l, aneakam adaikkalaan kuruvika'laip paarkkilum neengka'l viseashiththavarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.
an'riyum naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean: manushar munpaaka ennai a'rikkaipa'n'nuki'ravan evanoa, avanai manushakumaaranum theavathoothar munpaaka a'rikkaipa'n'nuvaar.
manushar munpaaka ennai ma'ruthalikki'ravan theavathoothar munpaaka ma'ruthalikkappaduvaan.
evanaakilum manushakumaaranukku viroathamaana viseashaththaich sonnaal athu avanukku mannikkappadum; parisuththa aavikku viroathamaayth thoosha'nagn solluki'ravanukkoa mannikkappaduvathillai.

an'riyum, jepa aalayaththalaivarka'lukkum thuraiththanaththaarka'lukkum athikaaramu'l'lavarka'lukkum munpaaka ungka'laik ko'ndupoay vidumpoathu: eppadi, ennaththai maa'ruththaramaakach solluvoam en'rum, ethaip peasuvoam en'rum kavalaippadaathirungka'l.
neengka'l peasavea'ndiyavaika'laip parisuththa aaviyaanavar annearaththilea ungka'lukkup poathippaar en'raar.
appozhuthu janakkoottaththil oruvan avarai noakki: poathakarea, aasthiyaip paakampiriththu en veethaththai enakkuth tharumpadi en sakoatharanukkuk katta'laiyidavea'ndum en'ru keattukko'ndaan.
atha'rku avar: manushanea, ennai ungka'lukku niyaayaathipathiyaakavum pangkiduki'ravanaakavum vaiththavan yaar en'raar.
pinpu avar avarka'lai noakki: poru'laasaiyaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; eanenil oruvanukku evva'lavu thira'laana aasthi irunthaalum athu avanukku jeevan alla en'raar.
allaamalum, oru uvamaiyai avarka'lukkuch sonnaar: aisuvariyamu'l'la oruvanudaiya nilam nan'raay vi'lainthathu.
appozhuthu avan: naan enna seyvean? en thaaniyangka'laich searththu vaikki'ratha'rku idamillaiyea;
naan on'ru seyvean, en ka'lagnchiyangka'lai idiththu, perithaakak katti, enakku vi'laintha thaaniyaththaiyum en poru'lka'laiyum angkea searththuvaiththu,

pinpu: aaththumaavea, unakkaaka aneaka varushangka'lukku aneakam poru'lka'l searththu vaikkappattirukki'rathu; nee i'laippaa'ri, pusiththuk kudiththu, poorippaayiru en'ru en aaththumaavoadea solluvean en'ru thanakku'l'lea sinthiththuch sollikko'ndaan.
theavanoa avanai noakki: mathikeadanea, un aaththumaa unnidaththilirunthu intha iraaththiriyilea eduththuk ko'l'lappadum, appozhuthu nee seakariththavaika'l yaarudaiyathaakum en'raar.
theavanidaththil aisuvariyavaanaayiraamal, thanakkaakavea pokkishangka'laich searththuvaikki'ravan ippadiyea irukki'raan en'raar.

pinnum avar thammudaiya seesharai noakki: ippadiyirukki'rapadiyinaal, ennaththai u'npoam en'ru ungka'l jeevanukkaakavum, ennaththai uduppoam en'ru ungka'l sareeraththukkaakavum kavalaippadaathirungka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aakaaraththaippaarkkilum jeevanum, udaiyaippaarkkilum sareeramum viseashiththavaika'laayirukki'rathu.

kaakangka'laik kavaniththuppaarungka'l, avaika'l vithaikki'rathumillai a'rukki'rathumillai, avaika'lukkup pa'ndasaalaiyumillai, ka'lagnchiyamumillai, illaavittaalum avaika'laiyum theavan pizhaippoottuki'raar; pa'ravaika'laippaarkkilum neengka'l evva'lavoa viseashiththavarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.
kavalaippaduki'rathinaal ungka'lil evan than sareera a'lavoadu oru muzhaththaik koottuvaan.
mikavum a'rpamaana kaariyamuthalaay ungka'laal seyyakkoodaathirukka, mat'ravaika'lukkaaka neengka'l kavalaippaduki'rathenna?

kaattuppushpangka'l eppadi va'laruki'rathen'ru kavaniththuppaarungka'l; avaika'l uzhaikki'rathumillai, noo'rki'rathumillai, en'raalum saalomoan muthalaayth than sarva makimaiyilum avaika'lil on'raippoalaakilum uduththiyirunthathillai en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

ippadiyirukka, a'rpavisuvaasika'lea, in'raikkuk kaattilirunthu naa'laikku aduppilea poadappaduki'ra pullukkuth theavan ivvithamaaka uduththuviththaal, ungka'lukku uduththuvippathu athika nichchayamallavaa?
aakaiyaal, ennaththai u'npoam, ennaththaik kudippoam en'ru, neengka'l kea'laamalum santheakappadaamalum irungka'l.
ivaika'laiyellaam ulakaththaar naadith theaduki'raarka'l; ivaika'l ungka'lukku vea'ndiyavaika'len'ru ungka'l pithaavaanavar a'rinthirukki'raar.
theavanudaiya raajyaththaiyea theadungka'l, appozhuthu ivaika'lellaam ungka'lukkuk koodak kodukkappadum.
payappadaathea si'rumanthaiyea, ungka'lukku raajyaththaik kodukka ungka'l pithaa piriyamaayirukki'raar.

ungka'lukku u'l'lavaika'lai vit'rup pichchaikodungka'l, pazhamaiyaayp poakaatha pa'nappaika'laiyum ku'raiyaatha pokkishaththaiyum paraloakaththilea ungka'lukkuch sampaathiththu vaiyungka'l, angkea thirudan a'nukuki'rathumillai, poochchi kedukki'rathumillai.
ungka'l pokkisham engkea irukki'rathoa angkea ungka'l iruthayamum irukkum.
ungka'l araika'l kattappattathaakavum, ungka'l vi'lakkuka'l eriki'rathaakavum,
thangka'l ejamaan kaliyaa'naththilirunthu vanthu thattumpoathu, udanea avarukkuth thi'rakkumpadi eppozhuthu varuvaar en'ru kaaththirukki'ra manusharukku oppaakavum irungka'l.

ejamaan varumpoathu, vizhiththirukki'ravarka'laakak kaa'nappaduki'ra oozhiyakkaararea paakkiyavaanka'l. avar araikattikko'ndu, avarka'laip panthiyirukkachseythu, sameepamaay vanthu, avarka'lukku oozhiyagnseyvaar en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
avar ira'ndaam jaamaththilaavathu moon'raam jaamaththilaavathu vanthu, avarka'l appadiyea irukkakka'ndaal, avvoozhiyakkaarar paakkiyavaanka'l.
thirudan innanearaththil varuvaan en'ru veettejamaanukkuth therinthirunthaal, avan vizhiththirunthu, than veettaik kannamidavottaan en'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
anthappadiyea neengka'l ninaiyaatha nearaththil manushakumaaran varuvaar, aakaiyaal neengka'lum aayaththamaayirungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu peathuru avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, intha uvamaiyai engka'lukkumaaththiram solluki'reeroa, ellaarukkum solluki'reeroa en'ru keattaan.
atha'rkuk karththar: pa'nividaikkaararukkuth thakuthiyaana kaalaththilea padikodukkumpadi ejamaan avarka'lmeal athikaariyaaka vaikkaththakka u'nmaiyum viveakamumu'l'la visaara'naikkaaran yaavan?
ejamaan varumpoathu appadiyea seyki'ravanaayk kaa'nappaduki'ra oozhiyakkaaran paakkiyavaan.
thanakku'l'lathellaavat'rinmealum avanai visaara'naikkaaranaaka vaippaan en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
antha oozhiyakkaaranoa, en ejamaan vara naa'l sellum en'ru thanakku'l'lea sollikko'ndu, vealaikkaararaiyum vealaikkaarika'laiyum adikkavum, pusiththuk kudiththu ve'rikkavum thalaippattaal,
avan ninaiyaatha naa'lilum, a'riyaatha nearaththilum, antha oozhiyakkaaranudaiya ejamaan vanthu, avanaik kadinamaayth tha'ndiththu, u'nmaiyillaathavarka'loadea avanukkup pangkai niyamippaan.
than ejamaanudaiya siththaththai a'rinthum aayaththamaayiraamalum, avanudaiya siththaththinpadi seyyaamalum iruntha oozhiyakkaaran aneaka adika'l adikkappaduvaan.

a'riyaathavanaayirunthu, adika'lukku eathuvaanavaika'laich seythavanoa, sila adika'l adikkappaduvaan. evanidaththil athikang kodukkappaduki'rathoa avanidaththil athikang keadkappadum; manushar evanidaththil athikamaay oppuvikki'raarka'loa avanidaththil athikamaayk keadpaarka'l.
poomiyinmeal akkiniyaip poadavanthean, athu ippozhuthea pat'ri eriya vea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'rean.
aakilum naan muzhukavea'ndiya oru snaanamu'ndu, athu mudiyuma'lavum evva'lavoa nerukkappaduki'rean.
naan poomiyilea samaathaanaththai u'ndaakkavanthean en'ru ninaikki'reerka'loa? samaathaanaththaiyalla, pirivinaiyaiyea u'ndaakkavanthean en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
eppadiyenil, ithumuthal orea veettilea ainthupear pirinthiruppaarka'l, ira'ndupearukku viroathamaay moon'rupearum, moon'rupearukku viroathamaay ira'ndupearum pirinthiruppaarka'l.
thakappan makanukkum makan thakappanukkum, thaay maka'lukkum maka'l thaaykkum, maami marumaka'lukkum marumaka'l maamikkum viroathamaayp pirinthiruppaarka'l en'raar.
pinpu avar janangka'lai noakki: mea'rkea meakam ezhumpuki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, mazhai varumen'ru solluki'reerka'l; anthappadiyumaakum.
then'ral adikki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu ush'nam u'ndaakumen'ru solluki'reerka'l, anthappadiyumaakum.
maayakkaararea, poomiyin thoat'raththaiyum vaanaththin thoat'raththaiyum nithaanikka ungka'lukkuth theriyumea, inthak kaalaththaiyoa nithaaniyaama'rpoaki'rathenna?
niyaayam innathen'ru neengka'lea theermaaniyaamalirukki'rathenna?

unakku ethiraa'liyaanavan unnai athikaariyinidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoaki'rapoathu, vazhiyileathaanea avanidaththilirunthu viduthalaiyaakumpadi pirayaasappadu, illaavittaal, avan unnai niyaayaathipathikku munpaakak ko'ndupoavaan, niyaayaathipathi unnaich seavakanidaththil oppukkoduppaan, seavakan unnaich si'raichsaalaiyil poaduvaan.
nee kadaisikkaasaik koduththuth theerkkumattum, avvidaththilirunthu pu'rappadamaattaay en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pilaaththu sila kalileayarudaiya iraththaththai avarka'ludaiya palika'loadea kalanthirunthaan; antha vea'laiyilea angkea irunthavarka'lil silar anthach seythiyai avarukku a'riviththaarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: anthak kalileayarukku appadippattavaika'l sampaviththathinaalea, mat'ra ellaak kalileayaraip paarkkilum avarka'l paavika'laayirunthaarka'len'ru ninaikki'reerka'loa?
appadiyallaven'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; neengka'l mananthirumpaama'rpoanaal ellaarum appadiyea kettuppoaveerka'l.
seeloavaamilea koapuram vizhunthu pathinettuppearaik kon'rathea; erusaleamil kudiyirukki'ra manusharellaarilum avarka'l kut'ravaa'lika'laayirunthaarka'len'ru ninaikki'reerka'loa?
appadiyallaven'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; neengka'l mananthirumpaama'rpoanaal ellaarum appadiyea kettuppoaveerka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu avar oru uvamaiyaiyum sonnaar: oruvan than thiraadchaththoattaththil oru aththimaraththai nattirunthaan; avan vanthu athilea kaniyaith theadinapoathu on'rung kaa'navillai.

appozhuthu avan thoattakkaaranai noakki: ithoa, moon'ru varushamaay intha aththimaraththilea kaniyaith theadi varuki'rean; on'raiyung kaa'navillai, ithai vettippoadu, ithu nilaththaiyum ean kedukki'rathu en'raan.
atha'rku avan: aiyaa, ithu intha varushamum irukkattum; naan ithaich sut'rilung koththi, eruppoaduvean,
kanikoduththaal sari, kodaavittaal, inimeal ithai vettippoadalaam en'ru sonnaan en'raar.
oru oayvunaa'lil avar jepaaalayaththil poathakampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaar.
appozhuthu pathinettu varushamaayp palaveenappaduththum aaviyaik ko'nda oru sthiree angkeayirunthaa'l. ava'l evva'lavum nimirakkoodaatha kooniyaayirunthaa'l.
iyeasu ava'laik ka'ndu, thammidaththil azhaiththu: sthireeyea, un palaveenaththinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkappattaay en'ru solli,
ava'lmeal thamathu kaika'lai vaiththaar; udanea ava'l nimirnthu, theavanai makimaippaduththinaa'l.

iyeasu oayvunaa'lilea sosthamaakkinapadiyaal, jepa aalayaththalaivan koapamadainthu, janangka'lai noakki: vealaiseyki'ratha'rku aa'runaa'l u'ndea, antha naadka'lilea neengka'l vanthu sosthamaakkikko'l'lungka'l, oayvunaa'lilea appadich seyyalaakaathu en'raan.

karththar avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: maayakkaaranea, ungka'lil evanum oayvunaa'lil than eruthaiyaavathu than kazhuthaiyaiyaavathu thozhuvaththilirunthu avizhththukko'ndupoay, atha'rkuth tha'n'neer kaattuki'rathillaiyaa?
ithoa, saaththaan pathinettu varushamaayk kattiyiruntha aapirakaamin kumaaraththiyaakiya iva'lai oayvunaa'lil inthak kattilirunthu avizhththuvidavea'ndiyathillaiyaa en'raar.
avar appadich sonnapoathu, avarai viroathiththiruntha anaivarum vedkappattaarka'l. janangka'lellaarum avaraal seyyappatta sakala makimaiyaana seykaika'laikku'riththum santhoashappattaarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: theavanudaiya raajyam etha'rkoppaayirukki'rathu; athai etha'rku oppiduvean?

athu oru kadukuvithaikku oppaayirukki'rathu; athai oru manushan eduththuth than thoattaththilea poattaan; athu va'larnthu, periya maramaayit'ru; aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'l vanthu, athin ki'laika'lil adainthathu en'raar.
mealum avar: theavanudaiya raajyaththai naan etha'rku oppiduvean?
athu pu'liththamaavukku oppaayirukki'rathu; athai oru sthiree eduththu muzhuvathum pu'likkumvaraikkum moon'rupadimaavilea adakkivaiththaa'l en'raar.
avar erusaleamukkup pirayaa'namaayp poakumpoathu, patta'nangka'lthoa'rum kiraamangka'lthoa'rum upatheasam pa'n'nikko'ndu poanaar.
appozhuthu oruvan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, iradchikkappaduki'ravarka'l silapearthaanoa en'ru keattaan; atha'rku avar:
idukkamaana vaasalvazhiyaay udpiraveasikkap pirayaasappadungka'l, aneakar udpiraveasikka vakaitheadinaalum avarka'laalea koodaama'rpoakum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

veettejamaan ezhunthu, kathavaip poottinapinpu, neengka'l ve'liyea nin'ru: aa'ndavarea, aa'ndavarea, engka'lukkuth thi'rakkavea'ndumen'ru sollik kathavaith thattumpoathu, avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l evvidaththaaroa, ungka'lai a'riyean en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluvaar.
appozhuthu neengka'l: ummudaiya samukaththil poajanapaanampa'n'ninoamea, neer engka'l veethika'lil poathakampa'n'nineerea en'ru solluveerka'l.
aanaalum avar: neengka'l evvidaththaaroa, ungka'lai a'riyean, akkiramakkaararaakiya neengka'lellaarum ennaivittu akan'rupoangka'l en'ru solluvaar en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

neengka'l aapirakaamaiyum eesaakkaiyum yaakkoapaiyum sakala theerkkatharisika'laiyum theavanudaiya raajyaththilirukki'ravarka'laakavum, ungka'laiyoa pu'rampea tha'l'lappattavarka'laakavum kaa'numpoathu ungka'lukku azhukaiyum pa'rkadippum angkea u'ndaayirukkum.
kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vadakkilum the'rkilum irunthu janangka'l vanthu, theavanudaiya raajyaththil panthiyiruppaarka'l.
appozhuthu munthinoar pinthinoaraavaarka'l, pinthinoar munthinoaraavaarka'l en'raar.
antha naa'lilea sila pariseayar avaridaththil vanthu: neer ivvidaththai vittup poayvidum; earoathu ummaik kolaiseyya manathaay irukki'raan en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: naan in'raikkum naa'laikkum pisaasuka'laith thuraththi, viyaathiyu'l'lavarka'laich sosthamaakki, moon'raam naa'lil ni'raivadaivean.

in'raikkum naa'laikkum ma'runaa'laikkum naan nadamaadavea'ndum; erusaleamukkup pu'rampea oru theerkkatharisiyum madinthupoaki'rathillaiyen'ru naan sonnathaaka neengka'l poay antha narikkuch sollungka'l.

erusaleamea, erusaleamea, theerkkatharisika'laik kolaiseythu, unnidaththil anuppappattavarka'laik kalle'riki'rava'lea! koazhi than kugnchuka'laith than si'rakuka'lin keezhea koottich searththuk ko'l'lum va'n'namaaka naan eththanaitharamoa un pi'l'laika'laik koottich searththukko'l'la manathaayirunthean; ungka'lukkoa manathillaama'rpoayit'ru.

ithoa, ungka'l veedu ungka'lukkup paazhaakkividappadum; karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea varuki'ravar sthoaththirikkappattavar en'ru neengka'l sollungkaalam varuma'lavum ennaik kaa'naathiruppeerka'l en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
oru oayvunaa'lilea pariseayaril thalaivanaakiya oruvanudaiya veettilea avar poajanam pa'n'numpadikkup poayirunthaar.
appozhuthu neerkkoavai viyaathiyu'l'la oru manushan avarukku munpaaka irunthaan. enna seyvaaroaven'ru janangka'l avarmeal noakkamaayirunthaarka'l.
iyeasu niyaayasaasthirika'laiyum pariseayaraiyum paarththu: oayvu naa'lilea sosthamaakkuki'rathu niyaayamaa en'ru keattaar.
atha'rku avarka'l peasaamalirunthaarka'l. appozhuthu avar avanai azhaiththu, sosthamaakki, anuppivittu,
avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lil oruvanudaiya kazhuthaiyaavathu eruthaavathu oayvunaa'lil thuravilea vizhunthaal, avan athai udanea thookkividaanoa en'raar.
atha'rku uththaravusolla avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.
virunthukku azhaikkappattavarka'l panthiyil muthanmaiyaana idangka'laith therinthuko'ndathai avar paarththu, avarka'lukku oru uvamaiyaich sonnaar:
oruvanaal kaliyaa'naththukku nee azhaikkappattirukkumpoathu, panthiyil muthanmaiyaana idaththil udkaaraathea; unnilum kanamu'l'lavan oruvea'lai avanaal azhaikkappattiruppaan.
appozhuthu unnaiyum avanaiyum azhaiththavan unnidaththil vanthu: ivarukku idangkodu enpaan; appozhuthu nee vedkaththoadea thaazhntha idaththi'rkup poakavea'ndiyathaayirukkum.

nee azhaikkappattirukkumpoathu, poay, thaazhntha idaththil udkaaru; appozhuthu unnai azhaiththavan vanthu: sineakithanea, uyarntha idaththil vaarum en'ru sollumpoathu, unnudaneakoodap panthiyirukki'ravarka'lukku munpaaka unakkuk kanamu'ndaakum.
thannaiththaan uyarththuki'ravanevanum thaazhththappaduvaan, thannaiththaan thaazhththuki'ravan uyarththappaduvaan en'raar.

an'riyum avar thammai virunthukku azhaiththavanai noakki: nee pakalvirunthaavathu iraavirunthaavathu pa'n'numpoathu, un sineakitharaiyaakilum un sakoathararaiyaakilum, un panthu janangka'laiyaakilum, aisuvariyamu'l'la ayalakaththaaraiyaakilum azhaikkavea'ndaam; azhaiththaal avarka'lum unnai azhaippaarka'l, appozhuthu unakkup pathilukkup pathil seythathaakum.
nee virunthupa'n'numpoathu eazhaika'laiyum oonaraiyum sappaa'nika'laiyum kurudaraiyum azhaippaayaaka.
appozhuthu nee paakkiyavaanaayiruppaay; avarka'l unakkup pathil seyyamaattaarka'l; neethimaanka'lin uyirththezhuthalil unakkup pathil seyyappadum en'raar.
avaroadeakoodap panthiyirunthavarka'lil oruvan ivaika'laik keattapozhuthu, avarai noakki: theavanudaiya raajyaththil poajanampa'n'nuki'ravan paakkiyavaan en'raan.
atha'rku avar: oru manushan periyavirunthai aayaththampa'n'ni, aneakarai azhaippiththaan.
virunthu vea'laiyil than oozhiyakkaaranai noakki: nee azhaikkappattavarka'lidaththil poay, ellaam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu, vaarungka'l, en'ru sollen'ru avanai anuppinaan.
avarka'lellaarum poakkuchsollath thodangkinaarka'l. oruvan: oru vayalaikko'ndean, naan akaththiyamaayppoay, athaip paarkkavea'ndum, ennai mannikkumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.
vea'roruvan: ainthearmaadu ko'ndean, athaich soathiththup paarkkap poaki'rean, ennai mannikkumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.
vea'roruvan: pe'n'nai vivaakampa'n'ninean, athinaal naan varakkoodaathu en'raan.

antha oozhiyakkaaran vanthu, ivaika'laith than ejamaanukku a'riviththaan. appozhuthu veettejamaan koapamadainthu, than oozhiyakkaaranai noakki: nee patta'naththin therukka'lilum veethika'lilum seekkiramaayp poay, eazhaika'laiyum oonaraiyum sappaa'nika'laiyum kurudaraiyum ingkea koottikko'nduvaa en'raan.
oozhiyakkaaran appadiyea seythu: aa'ndavarea, neer katta'laiyittapadi seythaayit'ru, innum idam irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu ejamaan oozhiyakkaaranai noakki: nee peruvazhika'lilum vealika'larukilum poay, en veedu ni'raiyumpadiyaaka janangka'lai u'l'lea varumpadi varunthik koottikko'nduvaa;
azhaikkappattiruntha antha manusharil oruvanaakilum en virunthai rusipaarppathillai yen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raan en'ru sonnaar.
pinpu aneaka janangka'l avaroadeakoodap pirayaa'namaayp poakaiyil, avarka'lidamaay avar thirumpippaarththu:

yaathoruvan ennidaththil vanthu, than thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum manaiviyaiyum pi'l'laika'laiyum sakoathararaiyum sakoatharika'laiyum, than jeevanaiyum ve'rukkaavittaal enakkuch seeshanaayirukkamaattaan.
than siluvaiyaich sumanthuko'ndu enakkup pinsellaathavan enakkuch seeshanaayirukkamaattaan.
ungka'lil oruvan oru koapuraththaik katta manathaayirunthu,
asthipaaram poattapinpu mudikkath thiraa'niyillaama'rpoanaal, paarkki'ravarka'lellaarum:

intha manushan kattaththodangki, mudikkath thiraa'niyillaama'rpoanaan en'ru sollith thannaip pariyaasampa'n'naathapadikku, athaik kattith theerkki'ratha'rkuth thanakku nirvaakamu'ndoa illaiyoa en'ru munpu avan udkaarnthu sellugnselavaik ka'nakkup paaraamaliruppaanoa?

an'riyum oru raajaa mat'roru raajaavoadea yuththagnseyyap poaki'rapoathu, thanmeal irupathinaayiram seavakaroadea varuki'ra avanaith thaan pathinaayiram seavakaraikko'ndu ethirkkak koodumoa koodaathoa en'ru munpu udkaarnthu aaloasanaipa'n'naamaliruppaanoa?
koodaathen'ru ka'ndaal, mat'ravan innum thooraththilirukkumpoathea, sthaanaapathika'lai anuppi, samaathaanaththukkaanavaika'laik keattukko'lvaanea.
appadiyea ungka'lil evanaakilum thanakku u'ndaanavaika'laiyellaam ve'ruththuvidaavittaal avan enakkuch seeshanaayirukkamaattaan.
uppu nallathuthaan, uppu saaramat'ruppoanaal ethinaal saaramaakkappadum?
athu nilaththukkaakilum eruvukkaakilum uthavaathu, athai ve'liyea kottip poaduvaarka'l. keadki'ratha'rkuk kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'raar.
sakala aayakkaararum paavika'lum avarudaiya vasanangka'laik keadkumpadi avaridaththil vanthu searnthaarka'l.
appozhuthu pariseayarum veathapaarakarum mu'rumu'ruththu: ivar paavika'lai eat'rukko'ndu avarka'loadea saappiduki'raar en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar sonna uvamaiyaavathu:

ungka'lil oru manushan noo'ru aaduka'lai udaiyavanaayirunthu, avaika'lil on'ru kaa'naama'rpoanaal, tho'n'noot'ronpathu aaduka'laiyum vanaantharaththilea vittu, kaa'naama'rpoana aattaik ka'ndupidikkuma'lavum theadiththiriyaanoa?
ka'ndupidiththapinpu, avan santhoashaththoadea athaith than thoa'lka'linmeal poattukko'ndu,
veettukku vanthu, sineakitharaiyum ayalakaththaaraiyum kooda varavazhaiththu: kaa'naama'rpoana en aattaik ka'ndupidiththean ennoadukoodach santhoashappadungka'l enpaan allavaa?

athupoala, mananthirumpa avasiyamillaatha tho'n'noot'ronpathu neethimaanka'laikku'riththuch santhoasham u'ndaaki'rathaippaarkkilum mananthirumpuki'ra orea paaviyinimiththam paraloakaththil mikuntha santhoasham u'ndaayirukkum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

an'riyum, oru sthiree paththu ve'l'likkaasai udaiyava'laayirunthu, athil oru ve'l'likkaasu kaa'naama'rpoanaal, vi'lakkaik ko'luththi, veettaip perukki, athaik ka'ndupidikki'ravaraikkum jaakkirathaiyaayth theadaamaliruppaa'loa?

ka'ndupidiththapinpu, than sineakithika'laiyum ayal veettukkaarika'laiyum kooda varavazhaiththu: kaa'naama'rpoana ve'l'likkaasaik ka'ndupidiththean, ennoadukoodach santhoashappadungka'l enpaa'l allavaa?
athupoala mananthirumpuki'ra orea paaviyinimiththam theavanudaiya thootharka'lukku munpaakach santhoashamu'ndaayirukki'rathu en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pinnum avar sonnathu: oru manushanukku ira'ndu kumaarar irunthaarka'l.
avarka'lil i'laiyavan thakappanai noakki: thakappanea, aasthiyil enakku varum pangkai enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'raan. anthappadi avan avarka'lukkuth than aasthiyaip pangkittukkoduththaan.
sila naa'laikkuppinpu, i'laiyamakan ellaavat'raiyum searththukko'ndu, thooratheasaththukkup pu'rappattuppoay, angkea thunmaarkkamaay jeevanampa'n'ni, than aasthiyai azhiththuppoattaan.
ellaavat'raiyum avan selavazhiththapinpu, anthath theasaththilea kodiya pagnchamu'ndaayit'ru. appozhuthu avan ku'raivupadaththodangki,
anthath theasaththuk kudika'lil oruvanidaththil poay ottikko'ndaan. anthak kudiyaanavan avanaith than vayalka'lil pan'rika'lai meaykkumpadi anuppinaan.
appozhuthu pan'rika'l thinki'ra thavittinaalea than vayit'rai nirappa aasaiyaayirunthaan, oruvanum athai avanukkuk kodukkavillai.
avanukkup puththi the'linthapoathu, avan: en thakappanudaiya koolikkaarar eththanaiyoa pearukkup poorththiyaana saappaadu irukki'rathu, naanoa pasiyinaal saaki'rean.
naan ezhunthu, en thakappanidaththi'rkup poay: thakappanea, paraththukku viroathamaakavum umakku munpaakavum paavagnseythean.
inimeal ummudaiya kumaaran en'ru sollappaduvatha'rku naan paaththiranalla, ummudaiya koolikkaararil oruvanaaka ennai vaiththukko'l'lum enpean en'ru solli;

ezhunthu pu'rappattu, than thakappanidaththil vanthaan. avan thooraththil varumpoathea, avanudaiya thakappan avanaik ka'ndu, manathuruki, oadi, avan kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu, avanai muththagnseythaan.
kumaaran thakappanai noakki: thakappanea, paraththukku viroathamaakavum, umakku munpaakavum paavagnseythean, inimeal ummudaiya kumaaran en'ru sollappaduvatha'rku naan paaththiran alla en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu thakappan than oozhiyakkaararai noakki: neengka'l uyarntha vasthiraththaik ko'nduvanthu, ivanukku uduththi, ivan kaikku moathiraththaiyum kaalka'lukkup paatharadchaika'laiyum poadungka'l.
kozhuththa kan'raik ko'nduvanthu adiyungka'l. naam pusiththu, santhoashamaayiruppoam.
en kumaaranaakiya ivan mariththaan, thirumpavum uyirththaan; kaa'naama'rpoanaan, thirumpavum kaa'nappattaan en'raan. appadiyea avarka'l santhoashappadath thodangkinaarka'l.
avanudaiya mooththakumaaran vayalilirunthaan. avan thirumpi veettukkuch sameepamaay varuki'rapoathu, keethavaaththiyaththaiyum nadanakka'lippaiyum keattu;
oozhiyakkaararil oruvanai azhaiththu: ithenna en'ru visaariththaan.
atha'rku avan: ummudaiya sakoatharan vanthaar, avar ma'rupadiyum sukaththudanea ummudaiya thakappanidaththil vanthu searnthapadiyinaalea avarukkaakak kozhuththa kan'rai adippiththaar en'raan.
appozhuthu avan koapamadainthu, u'l'lea poaka manathillaathirunthaan. thakappanoa ve'liyea vanthu, avanai varunthiyazhaiththaan.

avan thakappanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ithoa, iththanai varushakaalamaay naan umakku oozhiyagnseythu, orukkaalum ummudaiya ka'rpanaiyai mee'raathirunthum, en sineakitharoadea naan santhoashamaayirukkumpadi neer orukkaalum enakku oru aattukkuttiyaiyaavathu kodukkavillai.
veasika'lidaththil ummudaiya aasthiyai azhiththuppoatta ummudaiya kumaaranaakiya ivan vanthavudanea kozhuththa kan'rai ivanukkaaka adippiththeerea en'raan.
atha'rkuth thakappan: makanea, nee eppoathum ennoadirukki'raay, enakku'l'lathellaam unnudaiyathaayirukki'rathu.

un sakoatharanaakiya ivanoa mariththaan, thirumpavum uyirththaan; kaa'naama'rpoanaan, thirumpavum kaa'nappattaan; aanapadiyinaalea, naam santhoashappattu makizhchchiyaayirukkavea'ndumea en'ru sonnaan en'raar.

pinnum avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: aisuvariyavaanaakiya oru manushanukku oru ukkiraa'nakkaaran irunthaan; avan than ejamaanudaiya aasthika'lai azhiththuppoaduki'rathaaka ejamaanukku a'rivikkappattathu.
appozhuthu ejamaan avanai varavazhaiththu: unnaikku'riththu naan ippadik kea'lvippaduki'rathenna? un ukkiraa'nak ka'nakkai yoppuvi, ini nee ukkiraa'nakkaaranaayirukkakkoodaathu en'raan.
appozhuthu ukkiraa'nakkaaran: naan enna seyvean, en ejamaan ukkiraa'na visaarippilirunthu ennaith tha'l'lippoaduki'raanea; koththuki'ratha'rku enakkup pelanillai, irakkavum vedkappaduki'rean.

ukkiraa'na visaarippaivittu naan tha'l'lappadumpoathu, ennaith thangka'l veeduka'lil eat'rukko'lvaar u'ndaakumpadi seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru enakkuth theriyavanthathu, en'ru thanakku'l'lea sollikko'ndu;
than ejamaanidaththil kadanpattavarka'lai ovvoruvanaaka varavazhaiththu: muthalaavathu vanthavanai noakki: nee en ejamaanidaththil patta kadan evva'lavu en'raan.
avan: noo'rukudam e'n'ney en'raan. appozhuthu ukkiraa'nakkaaran avanai noakki: nee un seettai vaangki, udkaarnthu, aimpathu en'ru seekkiramaay ezhuthu en'raan.
pinpu avan vea'roruvanai noakki: nee patta kadan evva'lavu en'raan. avan: noo'ru kalam koathumai en'raan. appozhuthu avan: nee un seettai vaangki, e'npathu en'ru ezhuthu en'raan.

aneethiyu'l'la ukkiraa'nakkaaran puththiyaaych seythaan en'ru ejamaan ka'ndu, avanai mechchikko'ndaan. ivvithamaay o'liyin pi'l'laika'laippaarkkilum inthap pirapagnchaththin pi'l'laika'l thangka'l santhathiyil athika puththimaanka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean, neengka'l maa'lumpoathu ungka'lai niththiyamaana veeduka'lilea eat'ruk ko'lvaaru'ndaakumpadi, aneethiyaana ulakapporu'laal ungka'lukkuch sineakitharaich sampaathiyungka'l.
kognchaththilea u'nmaiyu'l'lavan aneakaththilum u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan, kognchaththilea aneethiyu'l'lavan aneakaththilum aneethiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan.
aneethiyaana ulakapporu'laippat'ri neengka'l u'nmaiyaayiraavittaal, yaar ungka'lai nampi ungka'lidaththil meyyaana poru'lai oppuvippaarka'l?
vea'roruvanudaiya kaariyaththil neengka'l u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'laayiraavittaal, ungka'lukku yaathon'raich sonthamaakak koduppavar yaar?

entha oozhiyakkaaranum ira'ndu ejamaanka'lukku oozhiyagnseyyakkoodaathu; oruvanaip pakaiththu mat'ravanaich sineakippaan, allathu oruvanaip pat'rikko'ndu mat'ravanai asattaipa'n'nuvaan. theavanukkum ulakapporu'lukkum oozhiyagnseyya ungka'laalea koodaathu en'raar.
ivaika'laiyellaam poru'laasaikkaararaakiya pariseayarum keattu, avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.

avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l manusharmunpaaka ungka'lai neethimaanka'laakak kaattuki'reerka'l, theavanoa ungka'l iruthayangka'lai a'rinthirukki'raar; manusharukku'l'lea meanmaiyaaka e'n'nappaduki'rathu theavanukku munpaaka aruvaruppaayirukki'rathu.

niyaayappiramaa'namum theerkkatharisana vaakkiyangka'lum yoavaanvaraikkum vazhangkivanthathu; athumuthal theavanudaiya raajyam suviseashamaay a'rivikkappattuvaruki'rathu, yaavarum palavanthamaay athil piraveasikki'raarka'l.
veathaththil oru ezhuththin u'ruppu avamaayp poavathaippaarkkilum, vaanamum poomiyum ozhinthupoavathu e'lithaayirukkum.
than manaiviyaith tha'l'livittu, vea'roruththiyai vivaakampa'n'nuki'ravan vipasaaragnseyki'raan, purushanaalea tha'l'lappattava'lai vivaakampa'n'nuki'ravanum vipasaaragnseyki'raan.
aisuvariyamu'l'la oru manushan irunthaan; avan iraththaamparamum vilaiyea'rappet'ra vasthiramum thariththu, anuthinamum sampiramamaay vaazhnthuko'ndirunthaan.
laasaru ennum pearko'nda oru thariththiranum irunthaan; avan parukka'l ni'rainthavanaay, antha aisuvariyavaanudaiya vaasalarukea kidanthu,
avanudaiya meajaiyilirunthu vizhun thu'nikkaika'laalea than pasiyai aat'ra aasaiyaayirunthaan; naayka'l vanthu avan parukka'lai nakkit'ru.
pinpu anthath thariththiran mariththu, theavathootharaal aapirakaamudaiya madiyilea ko'ndupoay vidappattaan; aisuvariyavaanum mariththu adakkampa'n'nappattaan.
paathaa'laththilea avan veathanaippaduki'rapoathu, than ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, thooraththilea aapirakaamaiyum avan madiyilea laasaruvaiyum ka'ndaan.

appozhuthu avan: thakappanaakiya aapirakaamea, neer enakku irangki, laasaru than viralin nuniyaith tha'n'neeril thoayththu, en naavaik ku'lirappa'n'numpadi avanai anuppavea'ndum; intha akkinijuvaalaiyil veathanaippaduki'reanea en'ru kooppittaan.

atha'rku aapirakaam: makanea, nee poomiyilea uyiroadirukkung kaalaththil un nanmaika'lai anupaviththaay, laasaruvum appadiyea theemaika'lai anupaviththaan, athai ninaiththukko'l; ippozhuthu avan theat'rappaduki'raan, neeyoa veathanaippaduki'raay.

athuvumallaamal, ivvidaththilirunthu ungka'lidaththi'rkuk kadanthupoakavum, avvidaththilirunthu engka'lidaththi'rkuk kadanthuvaravum manathu'l'lavarka'lukkuk koodaathapadikku, engka'lukkum ungka'lukkum naduvea perumpi'lappu u'ndaakkappattirukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu avan: appadiyaanaal, thakappanea, enakku ainthupear sakoathararu'ndu, avarka'lum veathanaiyu'l'la intha idaththukku varaathapadi, avan poay avarka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka a'rivikkum poruttu,
neer avanai en thakappan veettukku anuppumpadi ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.
aapirakaam avanai noakki: avarka'lukku moaseayum theerkkatharisika'lum u'ndu, avarka'lukku avarka'l sevikodukkattum en'raan.
atha'rku avan: appadiyalla, thakappanaakiya aapirakaamea, mariththoarilirunthu oruvan avarka'lidaththi'rkup poanaal mananthirumpuvaarka'l en'raan.
atha'rku avan: avarka'l moaseakkum theerkkatharisika'lukkum sevikodaavittaal, mariththoarilirunthu oruvan ezhunthupoanaalum, nampamaattaarka'l en'ru sonnaan en'raar.
pinpu avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: ida'ralka'l varaamalpoavathu koodaathakaariyam, aakilum avaika'l evanaal varuki'rathoa, avanukku aiyoa!
avan inthach si'ruvaril oruvanukku ida'ralu'ndaakkuki'rathaip paarkkilum, avanudaiya kazhuththil eanthirakkal kattappattu, avan samuththiraththil tha'l'lu'ndupoavathu avanukku nalamaayirukkum.
ungka'laikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l. un sakoatharan unakku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseythaal, avanaik kadinthuko'l; avan manasthaapappattaal, avanukku mannippaayaaka.
avan orunaa'lil eazhutharam unakku viroathamaayk kut'ragnseythu, eazhutharamum unnidaththil vanthu: naan manasthaapappaduki'rean en'ru sonnaal, avanukku mannippaayaaka en'raar.
appozhuthu appoasthalar karththarai noakki: engka'l visuvaasaththai varththikkappa'n'navea'ndum en'raarka'l.

atha'rkuk karththar: kadukuvithaiya'lavu visuvaasam ungka'lukku u'ndaayirunthaal, neengka'l inthak kaattaththimaraththai noakki: nee vearoadea pidungku'ndu kadalilea nadappaduvaayaaka en'ru solla, athu ungka'lukkuk keezhppadiyum.
ungka'lil oruvanudaiya oozhiyakkaaran uzhuthu allathu manthaimeayththu vayalilirunthu varumpoathu, ejamaan avanai noakki: nee munpu poaych saappittuvaa en'ru avanukkuch solvaanoa?
nee enakkuch saappaadu aayaththampa'n'ni, araikattikko'ndu, naan poajanapaanampa'n'numa'lavum enakku oozhiyagnsey, atha'rkuppin nee pusiththukkudikkalaam en'ru avanukkuch solluvaanallavaa?
thaan katta'laiyittavaika'lai antha vealaikkaaran seythatha'rkaaka avanukku upasaaragnseyvaanoa? appadich seyyamaattaanea.

appadiyea neengka'lum ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyidappatta yaavat'raiyum seytha pinpu: naangka'l appirayoajanamaana oozhiyakkaarar, seyyavea'ndiya kadamaiyaimaaththiram seythoam en'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
pinpu avar erusaleamukkup pirayaa'nampa'n'nukaiyil, avar samaariyaa kalileayaa ennum naaduka'lin vazhiyaaka nadanthupoanaar.
avar oru kiraamaththil piraveasiththapoathu, kushdaroakamu'l'la manushar paththuppear avarukku ethiraaka vanthu, thooraththilea nin'ru:
iyeasu aiyarea, engka'lukku irangkum en'ru saththamittaarka'l.
avarka'lai avar paarththu: neengka'l poay, aasaariyarka'lukku ungka'laik kaa'npiyungka'l en'raar. anthappadi avarka'l poakaiyil suththamaanaarka'l.
avarka'lil oruvan thaan aaroakkiyamaanathaik ka'ndu, thirumpivanthu, uraththa saththaththoadea theavanai makimaippaduththi,
avarudaiya paathaththarukea mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, avarukku sthoaththiragnseluththinaan; avan samaariyanaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu: suththamaanavarka'l paththuppear allavaa, mat'ra onpathupear engkea?
theavanai makimaippaduththuki'ratha'rku, intha anniyanea ozhiya mat'roruvanum thirumpivarakkaa'noamea en'ru solli,
avanai noakki: nee ezhunthupoa, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu en'raar.
theavanudaiya raajyam eppozhuthu varumen'ru, pariseayar avaridaththil keattapozhuthu, avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: theavanudaiya raajyam piraththiyadchamaay varaathu.
ithoa, ingkea en'rum, athoa, angkea en'rum sollappaduki'ratha'rkum eathuviraathu; ithoa, theavanudaiya raajyam ungka'lukku'l irukki'rathea en'raar.
pinpu avar seesharka'lai noakki: manushakumaaranudaiya naadka'lilon'raik kaa'navea'ndumen'ru neengka'l aasaippadungkaalam varum; aanaalum athaik kaa'namaatteerka'l.
ithoa, ingkea en'rum, athoa, angkea en'rum, silar ungka'lidaththil solluvaarka'l; neengka'loa poakaamalum pinthodaraamalum irungka'l.
minnal vaanaththin oru thisaiyil thoan'ri ma'ruthisaivaraikkum pirakaasikki'rathupoala manushakumaaranum thammudaiya naa'lilea thoan'ruvaar.
atha'rku munpu avar aneakam paadupattu, inthach santhathiyinaal aakaathavanen'ru tha'l'lappadavea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu.
noavaavin naadka'lil nadanthathupoala manushakumaaranudaiya naadka'lilum nadakkum.
noavaa peazhaikku'l piraveasiththa naa'lvaraikkum janangka'l pusiththuk kudiththaarka'l, pe'nko'ndu koduththaarka'l; jalappira'layam vanthu ellaaraiyum azhiththuppoattathu.
loaththinudaiya naadka'lil nadanthathupoalavum nadakkum; janangka'l pusiththaarka'l, kudiththaarka'l, ko'ndaarka'l, vit'raarka'l, nattaarka'l, kattinaarka'l.
loaththu soathoamai vittup pu'rappatta naa'lilea vaanaththilirunthu akkiniyum kanthakamum varushiththu, ellaaraiyum azhiththuppoattathu.
manushakumaaran ve'lippadum naa'lilum appadiyea nadakkum.
antha naa'lilea veettinmealiruppavan veettilu'l'la than pa'ndangka'lai eduththukko'ndupoaka i'rangkaamal irukkakkadavan; appadiyea vayalilirukki'ravan pinnittuth thirumpaamalum irukkakkadavan.
loaththin manaiviyai ninaiththuk ko'l'lungka'l.
than jeevanai iradchikka vakaitheaduki'ravan athai izhanthu poavaan; izhanthupoaki'ravan athai uyirppiththuk ko'l'luvaan.
antha iraaththiriyil orea padukkaiyil paduththirukki'ra ira'ndupearil oruvan eat'rukko'l'lappaduvaan, mat'ravan kaividappaduvaan.
thirikai thirikki'ra ira'ndu sthireeka'lil oruththi eat'rukko'l'lappaduvaa'l, mat'rava'l kaividappaduvaa'l.
vayalilirukki'ra ira'ndupearil oruvan eat'rukko'l'lappaduvaan, mat'ravan kaividappaduvaan en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avarka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: engkea, aa'ndavarea, en'raarka'l. atha'rku avar: pi'nam engkeayoa angkea kazhukuka'l vanthu koodum en'raar.
soarnthupoakaamal eppozhuthum jepampa'n'navea'ndum enpathaik ku'riththu avarka'lukku avar oru uvamaiyaich sonnaar.
oru patta'naththilea oru niyaayaathipathi irunthaan; avan theavanukkup payappadaathavanum manusharai mathiyaathavanumaayirunthaan.
anthap patta'naththilea oru vithavaiyum irunthaa'l; ava'l avanidaththil poay: enakkum en ethiraa'likkum irukki'ra kaariyaththil enakku niyaayagnseyyavea'ndum en'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaa'l.
vekunaa'lvaraikkum avanukku manathillaathirunthathu. pinpu avan: naan theavanukkup payappadaamalum manusharai mathiyaamalum irunthum,
intha vithavai ennai eppozhuthum thontharavu seyki'rapadiyinaal, iva'l adikkadi vanthu ennai alattaathapadi iva'lukku niyaayagnseyyavea'ndum en'ru thanakku'l'lea sollikko'ndaan en'raar.
pinnum karththar avarka'lai noakki: aneethiyu'l'la antha niyaayaathipathi sonnathaich sinthiththuppaarungka'l.

anthappadiyea theavan thammai noakki iravum pakalum kooppiduki'ravarka'laakiya thammaal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'lin vishayaththil neediya po'rumaiyu'l'lavaraayirunthu avarka'lukku niyaayagnseyyaamaliruppaaroa?
seekkiraththilea avarka'lukku niyaayagnseyvaar en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean. aakilum manushakumaaran varumpoathu poomiyilea visuvaasaththaik kaa'npaaroa en'raar.
an'riyum, thangka'lai neethimaanka'len'ru nampi, mat'ravarka'lai a'rpamaaye'n'nina silaraikku'riththu, avar oru uvamaiyaich sonnaar.
ira'ndu manushar jepampa'n'numpadi theavaalayaththukkup poanaarka'l; oruvan pariseayan, mat'ravan aayakkaaran.
pariseayan nin'ru: theavanea! naan pa'rikaarar, aniyaayakkaarar, vipasaarakkaarar aakiya mat'ra manusharaippoalavum, intha aayakkaaranaippoalavum iraathathanaal ummai sthoaththirikki'rean.
vaaraththil ira'ndutharam upavaasikki'rean; en sampaaththiyaththilellaam thasamapaakam seluththi varuki'rean en'ru, thanakku'l'lea jepampa'n'ninaan.
aayakkaaran thooraththilea nin'ru, than ka'nka'laiyum vaanaththukku ea'redukkath thu'niyaamal, than maarpilea adiththukko'ndu: theavanea! paaviyaakiya enmeal kirupaiyaayirum en'raan.

avanalla, ivanea neethimaanaakkappattavanaayth than veettukkuth thirumpippoanaan en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; eanenil thannai uyarththuki'ravanevanum thaazhththappaduvaan, thannaith thaazhththuki'ravan uyarththappaduvaan en'raar.
pinpu kuzhanthaika'laiyum avar thodumpadikku avarka'lai avaridaththil ko'nduvanthaarka'l. seesharka'l athaik ka'ndu, ko'nduvanthavarka'lai athattinaarka'l.

iyeasuvoa avarka'laik ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittu: si'ru pi'l'laika'l ennidaththil varuki'ratha'rku idangkodungka'l, avarka'laith thadaipa'n'naathirungka'l; theavanudaiya raajyam appadippattavarka'ludaiyathu.
evanaakilum si'ru pi'l'laiyaippoal theavanudaiya raajyaththai eat'rukko'l'laavittaal, athil piraveasikkamaattaan en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu thalaivan oruvan avarai noakki: nalla poathakarea, niththiyajeevanaich suthanthariththukko'lvatha'rku naan enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaan.
atha'rku iyeasu: nee ennai nallavan en'ru solvaanean? theavan oruvar thavira nallavan oruvanum illaiyea.

vipasaaragn seyyaathiruppaayaaka, kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka, ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka, poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka, un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanam pa'n'nuvaayaaka enki'ra ka'rpanaika'lai nee a'rinthirukki'raayea en'raar.
atha'rku avan: ivaika'laiyellaam en si'ru vayathumuthal kaikko'ndirukki'rean en'raan.

iyeasu athaik keattu: innum unnidaththil oru ku'raivu u'ndu; unakku u'ndaanavaika'laiyellaam vit'ruth thariththirarukkuk kodu, appozhuthu paraloakaththilea unakkup pokkisham u'ndaayirukkum; pinpu ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar.
avan athika aisuvariyamu'l'lavanaanapadiyinaal, ithaik keattapozhuthu, mikuntha thukkamadainthaan.
avan mikuntha thukkamadainthathai iyeasu ka'ndu: aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'l theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathu evva'lavu arithaayirukki'rathu.
aisuvariyavaan theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasippathaippaarkkilum, ottakamaanathu oosiyin kaathilea nuzhaivathu e'lithaayirukkum en'raar.
athaik keattavarka'l: appadiyaanaal yaar iradchikkappadakkoodum en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: manusharaal koodaathavaika'l theavanaal koodum en'raar.
appozhuthu peathuru avarai noakki: ithoa, naangka'l ellaavat'raiyum vittu, ummaip pinpat'rinoamea en'raan.
atha'rku avar: theavanudaiya raajyaththinimiththam veettaiyaavathu, pet'raaraiyaavathu, sakoathararaiyaavathu, manaiviyaiyaavathu, pi'l'laika'laiyaavathu vittuvitta evanum,
immaiyilea athikamaanavaika'laiyum, ma'rumaiyilea niththiya jeevanaiyum adaiyaama'rpoavathillaiyen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pinpu avar panniruvaraiyum thammidaththil azhaiththu: ithoa, erusaleamukkup poaki'roam, manushakumaaranaik ku'riththuth theerkkatharisika'laal ezhuthappattavaika'lellaam ni'raivea'rum.
eppadiyenil, avar pu'rajaathiyaaridaththil oppukkodukkappattu, pariyaasamum ninthaiyum adainthu, thuppappaduvaar.
avarai vaarinaal adiththu, kolai seyvaarka'l; moon'raam naa'lilea avar uyiroadea ezhunthiruppaar en'raar.
ivaika'lil on'raiyum avarka'l u'naravillai; avaika'lin poru'l avarka'lukku ma'raivaayirunthathu, avar sonnavaika'lai avarka'l a'rinthuko'l'lavillai.
pinpu avar erikoavukkuch sameepamaay varumpoathu, oru kurudan vazhiyarukea udkaarnthu pichchai keattukko'ndirunthaan.
janangka'l nadakki'ra saththaththai avan keattu, ithenna en'ru visaariththaan.
nasareayanaakiya iyeasu poaki'raar en'ru avanukku a'riviththaarka'l. appozhuthu avan: iyeasuvea, thaaveethin kumaaranea, enakku irangkum en'ru kooppittaan.
mun nadappavarka'l avan peasaamalirukkumpadi avanai athattinaarka'l. avanoa: thaaveethin kumaaranea, enakku irangkum en'ru mikavum athikamaayk kooppittaan.
iyeasu nin'ru, avanaith thammidaththil ko'nduvarumpadi sonnaar.
avan kittavanthapoathu, avar avanai noakki:
naan unakku enna seyyavea'ndum en'rirukki'raay en'ru keattaar. atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, naan paarvaiyadaiyavea'ndum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee paarvaiyadaivaayaaka, un visuvaasam unnai iradchiththathu en'raar.
udanea avan paarvaiyadainthu, theavanai makimaippaduththikko'ndea, avarukkup pinsen'raan. janangka'lellaarum athaik ka'ndu, theavanaip pukazhnthaarka'l.
avar erikoavil piraveasiththu, athin vazhiyaaka nadanthupoakaiyil,
aayakkaararukkuth thalaivanum aisuvariyavaanumaayiruntha sakeayu ennappatta oru manushan,
iyeasu eppadippattavaroa en'ru avaraip paarkka vakaitheadinaan. avan ku'l'lanaanapadiyaal, janakkoottaththil avaraik kaa'nakkoodaamal,
avar poakum vazhiyil munnaaka oadi, avaraip paarkkumpadi oru kaattaththi maraththil ea'rinaan.
iyeasu antha idaththil vanthapoathu, a'n'naanthu paarththu, avanaik ka'ndu: sakeayuvea, nee seekkiramaay i'rangkivaa, in'raikku naan un veettilea thangkavea'ndum en'raar.
avan seekkiramaay i'rangki, santhoashaththoadea avarai azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.
athaik ka'nda yaavarum: ivar paaviyaana manushanidaththil thangkumpadi poanaar en'ru mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.

sakeayu nin'ru, karththarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, en aasthika'lil paathiyai eazhaika'lukkuk kodukki'rean, naan oruvanidaththil ethaiyaakilum aniyaayamaay vaangkinathu'ndaanaal, naalaththanaiyaakath thirumpach seluththuki'rean en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: in'raikku intha veettukku iradchippu vanthathu; ivanum aapirakaamukkuk kumaaranaayirukki'raanea.
izhanthupoanathaith theadavum iradchikkavumea manushakumaaran vanthirukki'raar en'raar.

avarka'l ivaika'laik keattuk ko'ndirukkaiyil, avar erusaleamukkuch sameepiththirunthapadiyinaalum, theavanudaiya raajyam seekkiramaay ve'lippadumen'ru avarka'l ninaiththapadiyinaalum, avar oru uvamaiyaich sonnaar:
pirapuvaakiya oruvan oru raajyaththaip pet'rukko'ndu thirumpivarumpadi thooratheasaththukkup poakap pu'rappattaan.

pu'rappadumpoathu, avan than oozhiyakkaararil paththuppearai azhaiththu, avarka'lidaththil paththuraaththal thiraviyangkoduththu: naan thirumpivaruma'lavum ithaikko'ndu viyaapaarampa'n'nungka'l en'ru sonnaan.
avanudaiya ooraar avanaip pakaiththu, ivan engka'lmeal raajaavaayirukki'rathu engka'lukku manathillaiyen'ru sollumpadi avan pinnea sthaanaapathika'lai anuppinaarka'l.

avan raajyaththaip pet'rukko'ndu thirumpivanthapoathu, thannidaththil thiraviyam vaangkiyiruntha antha oozhiyakkaararil avanavan viyaapaarampa'n'nich sampaathiththathu ivva'laven'ru a'riyumpadi, avarka'laith thannidaththil azhaiththuvarach sonnaan.
appozhuthu munthinavan vanthu: aa'ndavanea, ummudaiya raaththalinaal paththuraaththal aathaayam kidaiththathu en'raan.
ejamaan avanai noakki: nallathu uththama oozhiyakkaaranea, nee kognchaththil u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthapadiyaal paththup patta'nangka'lukku athikaariyaayiru en'raan.
appadiyea ira'ndaam oozhiyakkaaran vanthu: aa'ndavanea, ummudaiya raaththalinaal ainthuraaththal aathaayam kidaiththathu en'raan.
avanaiyum avan noakki: neeyum ainthu patta'nangka'lukku athikaariyaayiru en'raan.
pinpu vea'roruvan vanthu: aa'ndavanea, ithoa, ummudaiya raaththal, ithai oru seelaiyilea vaiththirunthean.
neer vaikkaathathai edukki'ravarum, vithaikkaathathai a'rukki'ravarumaana kadinamu'l'la manushanen'ru a'rinthu, umakkup payanthirunthean en'raan.

atha'rku avan: pollaatha oozhiyakkaaranea, un vaaychsollaikko'ndea unnai niyaayantheerkki'rean. naan vaikkaathathai edukki'ravanum, vithaikkaathathai a'rukki'ravanumaana kadinamu'l'la manushanen'ru a'rinthaayea,
pinnai ean nee en thiraviyaththaik kaasukkadaiyilea vaikkavillai; vaiththirunthaal naan varumpoathu, athai vattiyoadea varappat'rik ko'lveanea en'ru solli;
sameepamaay ni'rki'ravarka'lai noakki: antha raaththalai avan kaiyiliruntheduththu, paththuraaththal u'l'lavanukkuk kodungka'l en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: aa'ndavanea, avanukkup paththuraaththal irukki'rathea en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avan: u'l'lavan evanukkung kodukkappadum, illaathavanidaththil u'l'lathum eduththukko'l'lappadum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
an'riyum thangka'lmeal naan raajaavaaki'ratha'rku manathillaathirunthavarka'laakiya ennudaiya saththurukka'lai ingkea ko'nduvanthu, enakku munpaaka vettippoadungka'l en'ru sonnaan en'raar.
ivaika'lai avar sonnapinpu erusaleamukkup pu'rappattu, munthinadanthupoanaar.
avar olivamalaiyennappatta malaiyin arukaana pethpakea peththaaniyaa ennum oorka'lukkuch sameepiththapoathu, thammudaiya seesharil ira'ndupearai noakki:

ungka'lukku ethirea irukki'ra kiraamaththukkup poangka'l, athilea piraveasikkumpoathu manushariloruvanum orukkaalum ea'riyiraatha kazhuthaikkuttiyaik kattiyirukkak kaa'npeerka'l; athai avizhththukko'ndu vaarungka'l.
athai ean avizhkki'reerka'len'ru yaaraavathu ungka'lidaththil keattaal, athu aa'ndavarukku vea'ndumen'ru sollungka'l en'raar.
anuppappattavarka'l poay, thangka'lukku avar sonnapadiyea ka'ndaarka'l.
kazhuthaikkuttiyai avarka'l avizhkkumpoathu, atha'rku udaiyavarka'l: kuttiyai ean avizhkki'reerka'l en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avarka'l: athu aa'ndavarukku vea'ndumen'ru solli,
athai iyeasuvinidaththil ko'nduvanthu, thangka'l vasthirangka'lai athinmeal poattu, iyeasuvai athinmeal eat'rinaarka'l.
avar poakaiyil, avarka'l thangka'l vasthirangka'lai vazhiyilea viriththaarka'l.
avar olivamalaiyin adivaaraththukkuch sameepamaay varukaiyil thira'laana koottamaakiya seesharellaarum thaangka'l ka'nda sakala a'rputhangka'laiyungku'riththuch santhoashappattu,

karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea varuki'ra raajaa sthoaththirikkappattavar, paraloakaththilea samaathaanamum unnathaththilea makimaiyum u'ndaavathaaka en'ru mikuntha saththaththoadea theavanaip pukazhnthaarka'l.
appozhuthu koottaththiliruntha pariseayaril silar avarai noakki: poathakarea, ummudaiya seesharai athattum en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivarka'l peasaamalirunthaal kalluka'lea kooppidum en'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
avar sameepamaay vanthapoathu nakaraththaippaarththu, atha'rkaakak ka'n'neer vittazhuthu,
unakkuk kidaiththa intha naa'lilaakilum un samaathaanaththukku eat'ravaika'lai nee a'rinthirunthaayaanaal nalamaayirukkum, ippozhuthoa avaika'l un ka'nka'lukku ma'raivaayirukki'rathu.
unnaich santhikkungkaalaththai nee a'riyaama'rpoanapadiyaal, un saththurukka'l unnaich soozha mathilpoattu, unnai va'lainthuko'ndu, eppakkaththilum unnai nerukki,
unnaiyum unnilu'l'la un pi'l'laika'laiyum tharaiyaakkippoattu, unnidaththil oru kallinmeal oru kalliraathapadikkuch seyyum naadka'l unakku varum en'raar.
pinpu avar theavaalayaththil piraveasiththu, athilea vi'rki'ravarka'laiyum ko'l'luki'ravarka'laiyum pu'rampea thuraththaththodangki:
ennudaiya veedu jepaveedaayirukki'rathen'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu, neengka'loa athaik ka'l'larkukaiyaakkineerka'l en'raar.
avar naadoa'rum theavaalayaththil upatheasam pa'n'nikko'ndirunthaar. pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum janaththin moopparum avaraik kolaiseyya vakaitheadiyum,
janangka'lellaarum avarukkuch sevikoduththu avarai a'ndikko'ndirunthapadiyaal, athai innapadi seyyalaamen'ru vakaikaa'naathirunthaarka'l.
annaadka'lil on'ril, avar theavaalayaththilea janangka'lukku upatheasiththu, suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththapoathu, pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum moopparum avaridaththil koodivanthu:
neer entha athikaaraththinaal ivaika'laich seyki'reer? intha athikaaraththai umakkuk koduththavar yaar? athai engka'lukkuch sollum en'raarka'l.
avarka'lukku avar pirathiyuththaramaaka: naanum ungka'lidaththil oru kaariyaththaik keadki'rean, athai enakkuch sollungka'l.
yoavaan koduththa snaanam theavanaal u'ndaayit'roa? manusharaal u'ndaayit'roa? en'ru keattaar.
avarka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea yoasanaipa'n'ni: theavanaal u'ndaayit'ru en'ru solvoamaanaal, pinnai ean avanai visuvaasikkavillai en'ru keadpaar.
manusharaal u'ndaayit'ru en'ru solvoamaanaal, janangka'lellaarum yoavaanaith theerkkatharisiyen'ru e'n'nuki'rapadiyinaal nammeal kalle'rivaarka'l en'ru solli:
athu yaaraal u'ndaayit'roa, engka'lukkuth theriyaathu en'ru pirathiyuththaram sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu: naanum inna athikaaraththinaal ivaika'laich seyki'reanen'ru ungka'lukkuch sollean en'raar.

pinpu avar janangka'lukkuch sollaththodangkina uvamaiyaavathu: oru manushan oru thiraadchaththoattaththai u'ndaakki, athaith thoattakkaararukkuk kuththakaiyaaka vittu, nedunaa'laakap pu'raththeasaththukkup poayirunthaan.

anthath thoattakkaarar thiraadchaththoattaththin kanika'lil than paakaththaik koduththanuppumpadi, paruvakaalaththilea avarka'lidaththil oru oozhiyakkaaranai anuppinaan. anthath thoattakkaarar avanai adiththu, ve'rumaiyaaka anuppivittaarka'l.
pinpu avan vea'roru oozhiyakkaaranai anuppinaan; avanaiyum avarka'l adiththu, avamaanappaduththi, ve'rumaiyaaka anuppivittaarka'l.
avan moon'raantharamum oru oozhiyakkaaranai anuppinaan; avanaiyum avarka'l kaayappaduththi, thuraththivittaarka'l.
appozhuthu thiraadchaththoattaththin ejamaan: naan enna seyyalaam, enakkup piriyamaana kumaaranai anuppinaal, avanaiyaakilum ka'ndu agnchuvaarka'l en'ru e'n'ni, avanai anuppinaan.
thoattakkaarar avanaik ka'ndapoathu: ivan suthantharavaa'li, suthantharam nammudaiyathaakumpadikku ivanaik kolluvoam vaarungka'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndu,
avanaith thiraadchaththoattaththi'rkup pu'rampea tha'l'li, kon'rupoattaarka'l. ippadiyirukka, thiraadchaththoattaththin ejamaan avarka'lai ennaseyvaan?

avan vanthu anthath thoattakkaararaich sangkariththu, thiraadchaththoattaththai vea'ru thoattakkaararidaththil koduppaan allavaa en'raar. avarka'l athaikkeattu, appadiyaakaathiruppathaaka en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar avarka'laip paarththu: veedu kattuki'ravarka'l aakaathen'ru tha'l'lina kallea, moolaikkuth thalaikkallaayit'ru en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra veathavaakkiyaththin karuththenna?
anthak kallinmeal vizhuki'ravan evanoa avan no'rungkippoavaan, athu evanmeal vizhumoa avanai nasukkippoadum en'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum thangka'laikku'riththu intha uvamaiyaich sonnaaren'ru a'rinthu, annearaththilea avaraip pidikka vakaitheadiyum janangka'lukkup payanthirunthaarka'l.

avarka'l samayampaarththu, theasaathipathiyin aa'lukaikkum athikaaraththukkum avarai oppukkodukkumpadi avarudaiya peachchilea kut'rangka'ndupidikkalaamen'ru, thangka'lai u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'laayk kaa'npikki'ra veavukaararai avaridaththil anuppinaarka'l.
avarka'l vanthu: poathakarea, neer nithaanamaayp peasi upatheasikki'reeren'rum, mukathaadcha'niyamillaamal theavanudaiya maarkkaththaich saththiyamaayp poathikki'reeren'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.
iraayanukku varikodukki'rathu niyaayamoa allavoa, engka'lukkuch sollum en'ru keattaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya thanthiraththai avar a'rinthu, neengka'l ennai ean soathikki'reerka'l?
oru pa'naththai enakkuk kaa'npiyungka'l. ithilirukki'ra soroopamum mealezhuththum yaarudaiyathu en'ru keattaar. atha'rku avarka'l: iraayanudaiyathu en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: appadiyaanaal, iraayanudaiyathai iraayanukkum, theavanudaiyathaith theavanukkum seluththungka'l en'raar.
avarka'l avarai janangka'lukku munpaakap peachchilea kut'rampidikkakkoodaamal, avar sonna uththaravaikku'riththu aachchariyappattu, mavunamaayirunthaarka'l.
uyirththezhuthal illaiyen'ru saathikki'ra sathuseayaril silar avaridaththil vanthu:

poathakarea, oruvan manaiviyaiyudaiyavanaayirunthu pi'l'laiyillaamal i'ranthupoanaal, avanudaiya sakoatharan avan manaiviyai vivaakampa'n'ni, than sakoatharanukkuch santhaanamu'ndaakkavea'ndum en'ru moasea engka'lukku ezhuthivaiththirukki'raarea.
sakoatharar eazhupearirunthaarka'l, avarka'lil mooththavan oru pe'n'nai vivaakampa'n'ni, pi'l'laiyillaamal i'ranthupoanaan.
pinpu ira'ndaagnsakoatharan ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, avanum pi'l'laiyillaamal i'ranthupoanaan.
moon'raagnsakoatharanum ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ninaan. appadiyea eazhupearum ava'lai vivaakampa'n'ni, pi'l'laiyillaamal i'ranthupoanaarka'l.
ellaarukkum pinpu antha sthireeyum i'ranthupoanaa'l.
ivvithamaay eazhupearum ava'lai vivaakampa'n'niyirukka, uyirththezhuthalil avarka'lil evanukku ava'l manaiviyaayiruppaa'l en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthap pirapagnchaththin pi'l'laika'l pe'nko'ndum pe'nkoduththum varuki'raarka'l.
ma'rumaiyaiyum mariththoarilirunthezhunthirukkuthalaiyum adaiyap paaththiraraaka e'n'nappaduki'ravarka'loa pe'nko'lvathumillai pe'n koduppathumillai.
avarka'l ini marikkavumaattaarka'l; avarka'l uyirththezhuthalin pi'l'laika'laanapadiyaal theavathootharukku oppaanavarka'lumaay, theavanukkup pi'l'laika'lumaayiruppaarka'l.

an'riyum mariththoar ezhunthiruppaarka'lenpathai moaseayum mudchediyaippat'riya vaasakaththil kaa'npiththirukki'raar. eppadiyenil, karththarai aapirakaamin theavanen'rum eesaakkin theavanen'rum yaakkoapin theavanen'rum solliyirukki'raar.
avar mariththoarin theavanaayiraamal, jeevanu'l'loarin theavanaayirukki'raar; ellaarum avarukkup pizhaiththirukki'raarka'lea en'raar.
appozhuthu veathapaarakaril silar athaik keattu: poathakarea, nan'raaych sonneer en'raarka'l.
athanpinpu avarka'l avaridaththil vea'ron'rungkeadkath thu'niyavillai.
avar avarka'lai noakki: ki'risthu thaaveethin kumaaranen'ru eppadich solluki'raarka'l?
naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'ru,
karththar en aa'ndavarudanea sonnaar en'ru thaaveethu thaanea sangkeetha pusthakaththil solluki'raanea.
thaaveethu avarai aa'ndavaren'ru solliyirukka, avanukku avar kumaaranaayiruppathu eppadi en'raar.
pinpu janangka'lellaarum keadkaiyil avar thammudaiya seesharai noakki:

nee'nda angkika'laith thariththukko'ndu thiriyavum, santhai ve'lika'lil vanthanangka'lai adaiyavum, jepaaalayangka'lil muthanmaiyaana aasanangka'lil udkaaravum, virunthuka'lil muthanmaiyaana idangka'lil irukkavum virumpi,
vithavaika'lin veeduka'laip padchiththu, paarvaikku nee'nda jepampa'n'nuki'ra veathapaarakaraikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, avarka'l athika aakkinaiyai adaivaarka'l en'raar.
avar ka'n'nea'rittup paarththapoathu, aisuvariyavaanka'l kaa'nikkaip pettiyilea thangka'l kaa'nikkaika'laip poaduki'rathaik ka'ndaar.
oru eazhai vithavai athilea ira'ndu kaasaip poaduki'rathaiyum ka'ndu:
intha eazhai vithavai mat'rellaaraip paarkkilum athikamaakap poattaa'l en'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

avarka'lellaarum thangka'l paripoora'naththiliruntheduththuth theavanukken'ru kaa'nikkai poattaarka'l; iva'loa than va'rumaiyilirunthu than jeevanaththukku u'ndaayirunthathellaam poattuvittaa'l en'raar.
pinpu, si'rantha ka'rka'linaalum kaa'nikkaika'linaalum theavaalayam alangkarikkappattirukki'rathaikku'riththuch silar sonnapoathu,
avar: neengka'l paarkki'ra ivaika'lil oru kal mat'roru kallinmealiraathapadikku ellaam idikkappadum naadka'l varum en'raar.
avarka'l avarai noakki: poathakarea, ivaika'l eppozhuthu sampavikkum, ivaika'l sampavikkum kaalaththukku adaiyaa'lam enna en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avar: neengka'l vagnchikkappadaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; eanenil aneakar vanthu en naamaththaith thariththukko'ndu: naanthaan ki'risthu en'rum, kaalam sameepiththathu en'rum solluvaarka'l; avarka'laip pinpat'raathirungka'l.
yuththangka'laiyum kalakangka'laiyungku'riththu neengka'l kea'lvippadumpoathu, payappadaathirungka'l; ivaika'l munnathaakach sampavikkavea'ndiyathea; aanaalum mudivu udanea varaathu en'raar.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: janaththukku viroathamaay janamum, raajyaththukku viroathamaay raajyamum ezhumpum.
pala idangka'lil makaa poomiyathirchchika'lum, pagnchangka'lum, ko'l'lainoayka'lum u'ndaakum; vaanaththilirunthu payangkaramaana thoat'rangka'lum periya adaiyaa'langka'lum u'ndaakum.

ivaika'lellaam nadappatha'rku munnea en naamaththinimiththam, avarka'l ungka'laip pidiththu, jepa aalayangka'lukkum si'raichsaalaika'lukkum oppukkoduththu, raajaakka'l munpaakavum athipathika'l munpaakavum ungka'lai izhuththuth thunpappaduththuvaarka'l.
aanaalum athu ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaavatha'rku eathuvaayirukkum.
aakaiyaal enna uththaravu solluvoamen'ru kavalaippadaathirukkumpadi ungka'l manathilea nir'nayampa'n'nikko'l'lungka'l.
ungka'lai viroathikki'ravarka'l oruvarum ethirpeasavum ethirni'rkavum koodaatha vaakkaiyum gnaanaththaiyum naan ungka'lukkuk koduppean.
pet'raaraalum, sakoathararaalum, panthujanangka'laalum, sineakitharaalum kaattikkodukkappaduveerka'l; ungka'lil silaraik kolaiseyvaarka'l.
en naamaththinimiththam ellaaraalum pakaikkappaduveerka'l.
aanaalum ungka'l thalaimayiril on'raakilum azhiyaathu.
ungka'l po'rumaiyinaal ungka'l aaththumaakka'laik kaaththukko'l'lungka'l.
erusaleam seanaika'laal soozhappattiruppathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, athin azhivu sameepamaayit'ren'ru a'riyungka'l.

appozhuthu yootheayaavilirukki'ravarka'l malaika'lukku oadippoakavum, erusaleamilirukki'ravarka'l ve'liyea pu'rappadavum, naattuppu'rangka'lilirukki'ravarka'l nakaraththil piraveasiyaamalirukkavum kadavarka'l.
ezhuthiyirukki'ra yaavum ni'raivea'rumpadi neethiyaich sarikkattum naadka'l avaika'lea.
annaadka'lil karppavathika'lukkum paalkodukki'ravarka'lukkum aiyoa, poomiyinmeal mikuntha idukka'num intha janaththinmeal koapaakkinaiyum u'ndaakum.
pattayakkarukkinaalea vizhuvaarka'l, sakala pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lum si'raippattuppoavaarka'l; pu'rajaathiyaarin kaalam ni'raivea'rumvaraikkum erusaleam pu'rajaathiyaaraal mithikkappadum.
sooriyanilum santhiranilum nadchaththirangka'lilum adaiyaa'langka'l thoan'rum; poomiyinmealu'l'la janangka'lukkuth thaththa'lippum idukka'num u'ndaakum; samuththiramum alaika'lum muzhakkamaayirukkum.
vaanaththin saththuvangka'l asaikkappadum; aathalaal poomiyinmeal varum aapaththuka'lukkup payanthu ethirpaarththirukki'rathinaal manusharudaiya iruthayam soarnthupoam.
appozhuthu manushakumaaran mikuntha vallamaiyoadum makimaiyoadum meakaththinmeal varuki'rathaik kaa'npaarka'l.
ivaika'l sampavikkath thodangkumpoathu, ungka'l meedpu sameepamaayiruppathaal, neengka'l nimirnthu paarththu, ungka'l thalaika'lai uyarththungka'l en'raar.
an'riyum avarka'lukku oru uvamaiyaich sonnaar: aththimaraththaiyum mat'rellaa marangka'laiyum paarungka'l.
avaika'l thu'lirkki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu vasanthakaalam sameepamaayit'ren'ru a'riki'reerka'l.
appadiyea ivaika'l sampavikki'rathai neengka'l kaa'numpoathu, theavanudaiya raajyam sameepamaayit'ren'ru a'riyungka'l.
ivaiyellaam sampavikkum mun inthach santhathi ozhinthupoakaathen'ru meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
vaanamum poomiyum ozhinthupoam, en vaarththaika'loa ozhinthu poavathillai.

ungka'l iruthayangka'l perunthi'ndiyinaalum ve'riyinaalum lavukeeka kavalaika'linaalum paaramadaiyaathapadikkum, neengka'l ninaiyaatha nearaththil antha naa'l ungka'lmeal varaathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
poomiyilengkum kudiyirukki'ra anaivarmealum athu oru ka'n'niyaippoala varum.

aakaiyaal inich sampavikkappoaki'ra ivaika'lukkellaam neengka'l thappi, manushakumaaranukku munpaaka ni'rkap paaththiravaanka'laaka e'n'nappaduvatha'rku, eppozhuthum jepampa'n'ni vizhiththirungka'l en'raar.
avar paka'rkaalangka'lil theavaalayaththilea upatheasampa'n'nikko'ndirunthu, iraakkaalangka'lil ve'liyea poay, olivamalai ennappatta malaiyilea thangkivanthaar.
janangka'lellaarum avarudaiya upatheasaththaik keadkumpadi athikaalamea theavaalayaththil avaridaththi'rku varuvaarka'l.
paskaa ennappatta pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikai sameepamaayit'ru.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum avaraik kolaiseyyumpadi yoasiththu, janangka'lukkup payappattapadiyinaal, evvithamaay appadich seyyalaamen'ru vakaitheadinaarka'l.
appozhuthu panniruvaril oruvanaakiya skaariyoaththennum ma'rupearko'nda yoothaasukku'l saaththaan pukunthaan.
avan pirathaana aasaariyarka'lidaththilum seanaiththalaivarka'lidaththilum poay, avaraik kaattikkodukkum vakaiyaik ku'riththu avarka'loadea aaloasanai pa'n'ninaan.
avarka'l santhoashappattu, avanukkup pa'nangkodukka udanpattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan sammathiththu, janakkoottamillaatha vea'laiyil avarai avarka'lukkuk kaattikkodukkumpadi samayantheadinaan.
paskaavaip paliyidavea'ndiya pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikai naa'l vanthathu.
appozhuthu avar peathuruvaiyum yoavaanaiyum azhaiththu: naam paskaavaip pusikkumpadikku neengka'l poay, athai namakku aayaththampa'n'nungka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l athai engkea aayaththampa'n'numpadi siththamaayirukki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.

atha'rku avar: neengka'l nakaraththil piraveasikkumpoathu, tha'n'neerkkudam sumanthuvaruki'ra oru manushan ungka'lukku ethirppaduvaan; neengka'l avanukkup pinsen'ru, avan poakum veetti'rku'l neengka'lum poay,
antha veettejamaanai noakki: naan en seesharoadukoodap paskaavaip pusikki'ratha'rkuth thakuthiyaana idam engkea en'ru poathakar ummidaththil keadkach sonnaar en'ru sollungka'l.
avan kampa'lamuthalaanavaika'l viriththirukki'ra mealveettilu'l'la oru periya a'raiyai ungka'lukkuk kaa'npippaan; angkea aayaththampa'n'nungka'l en'ru solli anuppinaar.
avarka'l poay, thangka'lidaththil avar sonnapadiyea ka'ndu, paskaavai aayaththampa'n'ninaarka'l.
vea'laivanthapoathu, avarum avarudaneakoodap pannira'ndu appoasthalarum panthiyirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: naan paadupaduki'ratha'rku munnea ungka'ludaneakooda inthap paskaavaip pusikka mikavum aasaiyaayirunthean.
theavanudaiya raajyaththilea ithu ni'raivea'ruma'lavum naan ini ithaip pusippathillaiyen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru solli,
avar paaththiraththai eduththu, sthoaththirampa'n'ni: neengka'l ithai vaangki, ungka'lukku'l'lea pangkittuk ko'l'lungka'l;
theavanudaiya raajyam varuma'lavum naan thiraadchappazharasaththaip paanampa'n'nuvathillaiyen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

pinpu avar appaththai eduththu, sthoaththirampa'n'ni, athaip pittu, avarka'lukkuk koduththu: ithu ungka'lukkaakak kodukkappaduki'ra ennudaiya sareeramaayirukki'rathu; ennai ninaivukoorumpadi ithaich seyyungka'l en'raar.

poajanampa'n'ninapinpu avar anthappadiyea paaththiraththaiyum koduththu: inthap paaththiram ungka'lukkaakach sinthappaduki'ra ennudaiya iraththaththinaalaakiya puthiya udanpadikkaiyaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
pinpu: ithoa, ennaik kaattikkodukki'ravanudaiya kai ennudaneakoodap panthiyilirukki'rathu.
theermaanikkappattapadiyea manushakumaaran poaki'raar, aanaalum avaraik kaattikkodukki'ra manushanukku aiyoa en'raar.
appozhuthu avarka'l nammil yaar appadich seyvaan en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea visaarikkath thodangkinaarka'l.
an'riyum thangka'lil evan periyavanaayiruppaan en'ru avarka'lukku'l'lea vaakkuvaatham u'ndaayit'ru.
avar avarka'lai noakki: pu'rajaathiyaarin raajaakka'l avarka'lai aa'luki'raarka'l; avarka'lmeal athikaaram seluththuki'ravarka'lum upakaarika'l ennappaduki'raarka'l.
ungka'lukku'l'lea appadiyirukkakkoodaathu; ungka'lil periyavan si'riyavanaippoalavum, thalaivan pa'nividaikkaaranaippoalavum irukkakkadavan.
panthiyirukki'ravanoa, pa'nividaiseyki'ravanoa, evan periyavan? panthiyirukki'ravan allavaa? appadiyirunthum, naan ungka'l naduvilea pa'nividaikkaaranaippoal irukki'rean.
mealum enakku nearitta soathanaika'lil ennoadeakooda nilaiththirunthavarka'l neengka'lea.
aakaiyaal, en pithaa enakku oru raajyaththai ea'rpaduththinathupoala, naanum ungka'lukku ea'rpaduththuki'rean.
neengka'l en raajyaththilea en panthiyil poajanapaanampa'n'ni, isravealin pannira'ndu koaththirangka'laiyum niyaayantheerkki'ravarka'laaych singkaasanangka'linmeal udkaaruveerka'l en'raar.
pinnum karththar: seemoanea, seemoanea, ithoa, koathumaiyaich su'lakinaal pudaikki'rathupoalach saaththaan ungka'laip pudaikki'ratha'rku uththaravu keattukko'ndaan.
naanoa un visuvaasam ozhinthupoakaathapadikku unakkaaka vea'ndikko'ndean; nee ku'nappattapinpu un sakoathararai sthirappaduththu en'raar.
atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, kaavalilum saavilum ummaip pinpat'rivara, aayaththamaayirukki'rean en'raan.
avar avanai noakki: peathuruvea, in'raikkuch seaval koovuki'ratha'rku munnea nee ennai a'rinthirukki'rathai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaay en'ru unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

pinnum avar avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'laip pa'nappaiyum saamaanpaiyum paatharadchaika'lum illaamal anuppinapoathu, eathaakilum ungka'lukkuk ku'raivaayirunthathaa en'raar. avarka'l, on'rum ku'raivaayirunthathillai en'raarka'l.
atha'rku avar: ippozhuthoa pa'nappaiyum saamaanpaiyum udaiyavan avaika'lai eduththukko'l'lakkadavan; pattayam illaathavan than vasthiraththai vit'ru on'raik ko'l'lakkadavan.

akkiramakkaararil oruvanaaka e'n'nappattaar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra vaakkiyam ennidaththil ni'raivea'ravea'ndiyathen'ru ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean. ennaippat'riya kaariyangka'l mudivu pe'rungkaalam vanthirukki'rathu en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: aa'ndavarea, ithoa, ingkea ira'ndu pattayam irukki'rathu en'raarka'l. avar: poathum en'raar.
pinpu avar pu'rappattu, vazhakkaththinpadiyea olivamalaikkup poanaar, avarudaiya seesharum avaroadeakoodap poanaarka'l.
avvidaththil searnthapozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l soathanaikkudpadaathapadikku jepampa'n'nungka'l en'ru solli,
avarka'lai vittuk kalle'rithooram appu'rampoay, muzhangkaalpadiyittu:
pithaavea, umakkuch siththamaanaal inthap paaththiram ennaivittu neengkumpadi seyyum; aayinum ennudaiya siththaththinpadiyalla, ummudaiya siththaththinpadiyea aakakkadavathu en'ru jepampa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu vaanaththilirunthu oru thoothan thoan'ri, avaraip palappaduththinaan.
avar mikavum viyaakulappattu, athika ookkaththoadea jepampa'n'ninaar. avarudaiya vearvai iraththaththin perunthu'lika'laayth tharaiyilea vizhunthathu.
