avar jepampa'n'ni mudiththu, ezhunthirunthu, thammudaiya seesharidaththil vanthu, avarka'l thukkaththinaalea niththirai pa'n'nuki'rathaik ka'ndu:
neengka'l niththiraipa'n'nuki'rathenna? soathanaikkudpadaathapadikku, ezhunthirunthu jepampa'n'nungka'l en'raar.
avar appadip peasukaiyil janangka'l koottamaay vanthaarka'l. avarka'lukku munnea panniruvaril oruvanaakiya yoothaas enpavanum vanthu, iyeasuvai muththagnseyyumpadi avaridaththil searnthaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: yoothaasea, muththaththinaaleayaa manushakumaaranaik kaattikkodukki'raay en'raar.
avaraich soozhanin'ravarka'l nadakkappoaki'rathaik ka'ndu: aa'ndavarea, pattayaththinaalea vettuvoamaa en'raarka'l.
anthappadiyea avarka'lil oruvan pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaranai valathukaatha'ra vettinaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu: immattil ni'ruththungka'l en'ru solli, avanudaiya kaathaiththottu, avanaich sosthappaduththinaar.

pinpu iyeasu thamakku viroathamaay vantha pirathaana aasaariyarka'laiyum theavaalayaththuch seanaiththalaivarka'laiyum moopparka'laiyum noakki: oru ka'l'lanaip pidikkap pu'rappattu varuki'rathupoala, neengka'l pattayangka'laiyum thadika'laiyum eduththup pu'rappattu vantheerka'lea.
naan thinanthoa'rum theavaalayaththil ungka'ludaneakooda irukkaiyil neengka'l ennaip pidikkak kaineettavillai; ithuvoa ungka'ludaiya vea'laiyum anthakaaraththin athikaaramumaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
avarka'l avaraip pidiththapinpu, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya veettil ko'ndupoay vittaarka'l. peathuruvum thooraththilea pinsen'raan.
avarka'l mut'raththin naduvilea neruppai mootti, athaich sut'ri udkaarnthapoathu, peathuruvum avarka'l naduvilea udkaarnthaan.
appozhuthu oru vealaikkaari avanai neruppa'ndaiyilea udkaarnthirukkakka'ndu, avanai ut'ruppaarththu: ivanum avanoadirunthaan en'raa'l.
atha'rku avan: sthireeyea, avanai a'riyean en'ru ma'ruthaliththaan.
sat'runearaththukkuppinpu vea'roruvan avanaik ka'ndu: neeyum avarka'lil oruvan en'raan. atha'rkup peathuru: manushanea, naan alla en'raan.
ea'rakku'raiya oruma'ni nearaththukkuppinpu vea'roruvan avanaip paarththu: meyyaakavea ivanum avanoadirunthaan, ivan kalileayanthaan en'ru saathiththaan.
atha'rkup peathuru: manushanea, nee solluki'rathai a'riyean en'raan. avan ippadich sonnavudanea seaval koovit'ru.

appozhuthu karththar thirumpi, peathuruvai noakkip paarththaar. seaval koovuki'ratha'rku munnea nee ennai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaay en'ru karththar thannidaththil sonna vasanaththai udanea peathuru ninaivukoornthu,
ve'liyea poay, manangkasanthu azhuthaan.
iyeasuvaip pidiththukko'nda manushar avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ni, adiththu,
avarudaiya ka'nka'laik katti, avarudaiya mukaththil a'rainthu: unnai adiththavan yaar, athai gnaanathirushdiyinaal sol en'ru avaraik keattathuman'ri,
mat'rum aneaka thoosha'navaarththaika'laiyum avarukku viroathamaakach sonnaarka'l.
vidiya'rkaalamaanapoathu janaththin moopparum pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum koodivanthu, thangka'l aaloasanaich sangkaththil avaraik ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththi:
nee ki'risthuvaa? athai engka'lukkuch sol en'raarka'l. atha'rku avar: naan ungka'lukkuch sonnaalum nampamaatteerka'l.
naan ungka'lidaththil vinaavinaalum enakku maa'ruththaram sollamaatteerka'l, ennai viduthalaipa'n'navumaatteerka'l.
ithumuthal manushakumaaran sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil veet'riruppaar en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'lellaarum: appadiyaanaal, nee theavanudaiya kumaaranaa en'ru keattaarka'l. atha'rku avar: neengka'l solluki'rapadiyea naan avarthaan en'raar.
appozhuthu avarka'l: ini vea'ru saadchi namakku vea'nduvathenna? naamea ivanudaiya vaayinaalea keattoamea en'raarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya koottaththaarellaarum ezhunthirunthu, avaraip pilaaththuvinidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoay:
ivan thannaik ki'risthu ennappatta raajaaven'rum, raayarukku varikodukka vea'nduvathillaiyen'rum solli, janangka'laik kalakappaduththak ka'ndoam en'ru avarmeal kut'ragnsaattath thodangkinaarka'l.
pilaaththu avarai noakki: nee yootharudaiya raajaavaa en'ru keattaan. avar avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer solluki'rapadithaan en'raar.
appozhuthu pilaaththu pirathaana aasaariyarka'laiyum janangka'laiyum noakki: intha manushanidaththil naan oru kut'raththaiyum kaa'navillai en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: ivan kalileayaa naaduthodangki ivvidamvaraikkum yootheayaatheasamengkum upatheasampa'n'ni, janangka'laik kalakappaduththuki'raan en'ru vairaakkiyaththoadea sonnaarka'l.
kalileayaa enpathaip pilaaththu keattapozhuthu, intha manushan kalileayanaa en'ru visaariththu,
avar earoathin athikaaraththukku'l'laanavar en'ra'rinthu, annaadka'lil erusaleamilea vanthiruntha earoathuvinidaththi'rku avarai anuppinaan.

earoathu iyeasuvaikku'riththu aneaka kaariyangka'laik kea'lvippattirunthathinaalum, avaraal seyyappadum adaiyaa'laththaip paarkkavea'ndumen'ru virumpiyirunthathinaalum, avaraik kaa'numpadi vekunaa'laay aasaiko'ndirunthaan. anthappadi avaraik ka'ndapoathu, mikavum santhoashappattu,
aneaka kaariyangka'laikku'riththu avaridaththil vinaavinaan. avar ma'rumozhiyaaka avanukku on'rum sollavillai.
pirathaana aasaariyarum veathapaarakarum avarmeal pidivaathamaayk kut'ragnsaattikko'ndea nin'raarka'l.
appozhuthu earoathu than poarchseavakaroadukooda avarai ninthiththup pariyaasampa'n'ni, minukkaana vasthiraththai avarukku uduththi, avaraith thirumpap pilaaththuvinidaththi'rku anuppinaan.
munnea oruvarukkoruvar pakaivaraayiruntha pilaaththuvum earoathum an'raiyaththinam sineakitharaanaarka'l.
pilaaththu pirathaana aasaariyarka'laiyum athikaarika'laiyum janangka'laiyum koodivarachseythu,

avarka'lai noakki: janangka'laik kalakaththukkuth thoo'ndividuki'ravanaaka intha manushanai ennidaththil ko'nduvantheerka'l; naan ungka'lukku munpaaka visaariththapoathu, ivanmeal neengka'l saattuki'ra kut'rangka'lil on'raiyum naan ivanidaththil kaa'navillai.
ungka'lai earoathinidaththi'rkum anuppinean; avarum ivanidaththil kut'ram kaa'navillai; mara'naththukkeathuvaaka ivan on'rum seyyavillaiyea.
aanapadiyaal ivanaith tha'ndiththu, viduthalaiyaakkuvean en'raan.
pa'ndikaithoa'rum avarka'lukku oruvanai avan viduthalaiyaakkuvathu avasiyamaayirunthapadiyaal appadich sonnaan.
janangka'lellaarum athaik keattu: ivanai akat'rum, parapaasai engka'lukku viduthalaiyaakkum en'ru saththamittuk keattaarka'l.
anthap parapaasenpavan nakaraththil nadantha oru kalakaththinimiththamum kolaipaathakaththinimiththamum kaavalilea vaikkappattirunthaan.
pilaaththu iyeasuvai viduthalaiyaakka manathaay, ma'rupadiyum avarka'lidaththil peasinaan.
avarka'loa: avanaich siluvaiyil a'raiyum, siluvaiyil a'raiyum en'ru kookkuralittaarka'l.

avan moon'raantharam avarka'lai noakki: ean, ivan enna pollaappuch seythaan? mara'naththukku eathuvaana kut'ram on'rum ivanidaththil naan kaa'navillaiyea; aakaiyaal naan ivanaith tha'ndiththu, viduthalaiyaakkuvean en'raan.
appadiyirunthum avaraich siluvaiyil a'raiyavea'ndumen'ru avarka'l uraththa saththaththoadu keattukko'ndeayirunthaarka'l. avarka'lum pirathaana aasaariyarum itta saththam mea'rko'ndathu.
appozhuthu avarka'l keattukko'ndapadiyea aakattum en'ru pilaaththu theerppuseythu,
kalakaththinimiththamum kolaipaathakaththinimiththamum kaavalil poadappattirunthavanai avarka'l keattukko'ndapadiyea viduthalaiyaakki, iyeasuvaiyoa avarka'l ishdaththukku oppukkoduththaan.

avarka'l iyeasuvaik ko'ndupoaki'rapoathu, naattilirunthu varuki'ra sireanea ooraanaakiya seemoan enki'ra oruvanaip pidiththu, siluvaiyai avarpinnea sumanthuko'nduvarumpadi athai avanmeal vaiththaarka'l.
thira'lkoottamaana janangka'lum avarukkaakap pulampi azhuki'ra sthireeka'lum avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'l mukamaayth thirumpi: erusaleamin kumaaraththika'lea, neengka'l enakkaaka azhaamal, ungka'lukkaakavum ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkaakavum azhungka'l.
ithoa, maladika'l paakkiyavathika'len'rum, pi'l'laipe'raatha karppangka'lum paalkodaatha mulaika'lum paakkiyamu'l'lavaika'len'rum sollappadum naadka'l varum.
appozhuthu malaika'lai noakki: engka'lmeal vizhungka'len'rum, kun'ruka'lai noakki: engka'lai ma'raiththukko'l'lungka'len'rum sollaththodangkuvaarka'l.
pachchaimaraththukku ivaika'laich seythaal, pattamaraththukku enna seyyamaattaarka'l en'raar.
kut'ravaa'lika'laakiya vea'rea ira'ndupearum avaroadeakoodak kolaiseyyappaduvatha'rkuk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.

kapaalasthalam en'ru sollappatta idaththil avarka'l searnthapozhuthu, angkea avaraiyum, avarudaiya valathupakkaththil oru kut'ravaa'liyaiyum, avarudaiya idathupakkaththil oru kut'ravaa'liyaiyum siluvaika'lil a'rainthaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu: pithaavea, ivarka'lukku manniyum, thaangka'l seyki'rathu innathen'ru a'riyaathirukki'raarka'lea en'raar. avarudaiya vasthirangka'lai avarka'l pangkittuch seettuppoattaarka'l.

janangka'l nin'ru paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l. avarka'ludaneakooda athikaarika'lum avarai ikazhnthu: ivan mat'ravarka'lai iradchiththaan, ivan theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappatta ki'risthuvaanaal, thannaiththaanea iradchiththukko'l'lattum en'raarka'l.
poarchseavakarum avaridaththil searnthu, avarukkuk kaadiyaik koduththu:
nee yootharin raajaavaanaal, unnai iradchiththukko'l en'ru avaraip pariyaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
ivan yootharudaiya raajaa en'ru, kireakku laththeen epireyu ezhuththukka'lil ezhuthi, avarukku mealaaka vaikkappattathu.
an'riyum siluvaiyil a'raiyappattiruntha kut'ravaa'lika'lil oruvan: nee ki'risthuvaanaal unnaiyum engka'laiyum iradchiththukko'l en'ru avarai ikazhnthaan.
mat'ravan avanai noakki: nee intha aakkinaikkudpattavanaayirunthum theavanukkup payappaduki'rathillaiyaa?
naamoa niyaayappadi tha'ndikkappaduki'roam; naam nadappiththavaika'lukkuththakka palanai adaiki'roam; ivaroa thakaathathon'raiyum nadappikkavillaiyea en'ru avanaik kadinthuko'ndu,
iyeasuvai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer ummudaiya raajyaththil varumpoathu adiyeanai ninaiththaru'lum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: in'raikku nee ennudaneakoodap paratheesiliruppaay en'ru meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu ea'rakku'raiya aa'raamma'ni nearamaayirunthathu; onpathaamma'ni nearamvaraikkum poomiyengkum anthakaaramu'ndaayit'ru.
sooriyan iru'ladainthathu, theavaalayaththin thiraichseelai naduvil ira'ndaakak kizhinthathu.
iyeasu: pithaavea, ummudaiya kaika'lil en aaviyai oppuvikki'rean en'ru makaa saththamaayk kooppittuch sonnaar; ippadich solli, jeevanai vittaar.
noot'rukku athipathi sampaviththathaikka'ndu: meyyaakavea intha manushan neethiparanaayirunthaan en'ru solli, theavanai makimaippaduththinaan.
inthak kaadchiyaip paarkkumpadi koodivanthiruntha janangka'lellaarum sampaviththavaika'laip paarththapozhuthu, thangka'l maarpil adiththukko'ndu thirumpippoanaarka'l.
avarukku a'rimukamaanavarka'lellaarum, kalileayaavilirunthu avarukkup pinsen'ru vantha sthireeka'lum thooraththilea nin'ru ivaika'laip paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
yoaseappu ennum pearko'nda oru aaloasanaikkaaran irunthaan; avan uththamanum neethimaanumaayirunthaan.

avan yootharudaiya patta'nangka'lilon'raakiya arimaththiyaavilirunthu vanthavanum, theavanudaiya raajyaththukkuk kaaththirunthavanum, yootharka'ludaiya aaloasanaikkum seykaikkum sammathiyaathavanumaayirunthaan.
avan pilaaththuvinidaththil poay, iyeasuvin sareeraththaik keattu,
athai i'rakki, melliya thuppattiyilea sut'ri, kanmalaiyil vettappattathumaay orukkaalum oruvanum vaikkappadaathathumaayiruntha oru kalla'raiyilea vaiththaan.
antha naa'l aayaththanaa'laayirunthathu; oayvunaa'lum aarampamaayit'ru.
kalileayaavilirunthu avarudaneakooda vanthiruntha sthireeka'lum pinsen'ru, kalla'raiyaiyum avarudaiya sareeram vaikkappatta vithaththaiyum paarththu,
thirumpippoay, kanthavarkkangka'laiyum parima'lathailangka'laiyum aayaththampa'n'ni, ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea oayvunaa'lil oaynthirunthaarka'l.
vaaraththin muthalaamnaa'l athikaalaiyilea thaangka'l aayaththampa'n'nina kanthavarkkangka'lai avarka'l eduththukko'ndu vea'ru sila sthireeka'loadungkoodak kalla'raiyinidaththil vanthaarka'l.
kalla'raiyai adaiththiruntha kal purattith tha'l'lappattirukki'rathaikka'ndu,
u'l'lea piraveasiththu, karththaraakiya iyeasuvin sareeraththaik kaa'naamal,
athaikku'riththu mikuntha kalakkamadainthirukkaiyil, pirakaasamu'l'la vasthiranthariththa ira'ndupear avarka'l arukea nin'raarka'l.
antha sthireeka'l payappattuth thalaikavizhnthu tharaiyai noakki ni'rkaiyil, antha ira'ndupearum avarka'lai noakki: uyiroadirukki'ravarai neengka'l mariththoaridaththil theaduki'rathenna?
avar ingkea illai, avar uyirththezhunthaar.

manushakumaaran paavika'laana manushar kaika'lil oppukkodukkappadavum, siluvaiyil a'raiyappadavum, moon'raam naa'lil ezhunthirukkavum vea'ndumenpathaaka avar kalileayaaviliruntha kaalaththil ungka'lukkuch sonnathai ninaivukoorungka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l avarudaiya vaarththaika'lai ninaivukoornthu,
kalla'raiyai vittuth thirumpippoay, inthach sangkathika'lellaavat'raiyum pathinoruvarukkum mat'rellaarukkum a'riviththaarka'l.
ivaika'lai appoasthalarukkuch sonnavarka'l makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum, yoavannaa'lum, yaakkoapin thaayaakiya mariyaa'lum, ivarka'ludaneakooda iruntha mat'ra sthireeka'lumea.
ivarka'ludaiya vaarththaika'l avarka'lukku vee'npeachchaakath thoan'rinathinaal, avarka'l ivarka'lai nampavillai.

peathuruvoa ezhunthirunthu, kalla'raiyinidaththi'rku oadi, atha'rku'l'lea kuninthupaarkkaiyil, seelaika'laith thanippada vaiththirukkakka'ndu, sampaviththathaik ku'riththuth thannil aachchariyappattukko'ndupoanaan.
an'raiyaththinamea avarka'lil ira'ndupear erusaleamukku eazhu allathu ettumail thooramaana emmaavu ennum kiraamaththukkup poanaarka'l.
poakaiyil intha varththamaanangka'l yaavaiyungku'riththu avarka'l oruvaroadoruvar peasikko'ndaarka'l.
ippadi avarka'l peasi, sampaashiththukko'ndirukkaiyil, iyeasu thaamea searnthu avarka'ludaneakooda nadanthupoanaar.
aanaalum avarai a'riyaathapadikku avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l ma'raikkappattirunthathu.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l thukkamukamu'l'lavarka'laay vazhinadanthu, oruvarukkoruvar sollikko'l'luki'ra kaariyangka'l ennaven'ru keattaar.
avarka'lil oruvanaakiya kileyoappaa enpavan pirathiyuththaramaaka: innaadka'lil erusaleamilea nadanthavaika'lai a'riyaathapadikku neer anniyaraayirukki'reeroa en'raan.

avar: evaika'l en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaik ku'riththavaika'lea; avar theavanukku munpaakavum janangka'lellaarukku munpaakavum seykaiyilum vaakkilum vallamaiyu'l'la theerkkatharisiyaayirunthaar.
nammudaiya pirathaana aasaariyarum athikaarika'lum avarai mara'na aakkinaikkudpaduththi, siluvaiyil a'rainthaarka'l.
avarea isravealai meettiradchippavar en'ru naangka'l nampiyirunthoam. ivaika'l sampaviththu in'ru moon'ru naa'laaki'rathu.
aanaalum engka'l koottaththaich searntha sila sthireeka'l athikaalamea kalla'raiyinidaththi'rkuppoay,
avarudaiya sareeraththaik kaa'naamal, thirumpivanthu, avar uyiroadirukki'raar en'ru sonna theavathootharaith tharisiththoam en'ru solli, engka'laip piramikkappa'n'ninaarka'l.
appozhuthu engka'lilea silar kalla'raiyinidaththi'rkup poay, sthireeka'l sonnapadiyea ka'ndaarka'l; avaraiyoa kaa'navillai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avar avarka'lai noakki: theerkkatharisika'l sonna yaavaiyum visuvaasikki'ratha'rkup puththiyillaatha mantha iruthayamu'l'lavarka'lea,
ki'risthu ivvithamaakap paadupadavum, thamathu makimaiyil piraveasikkavum vea'ndiyathillaiyaa en'ru solli,
moasea muthaliya sakala theerkkatharisika'lum ezhuthina veathavaakkiyangka'lellaavat'rilum thammaikku'riththuch solliyavaika'lai avarka'lukku vivariththuk kaa'npiththaar.
aththaru'naththil thaangka'l poaki'ra kiraamaththukkuch sameepamaanaarka'l. appozhuthu avar appu'ram poaki'ravar poalak kaa'npiththaar.

avarka'l avarai noakki: neer engka'ludanea thangkiyirum, saayangkaalamaayit'ru, pozhuthum poayit'ru, en'ru avarai varunthik keattukko'ndaarka'l. appozhuthu avar avarka'ludanea thangkumpadi u'l'lea poanaar.
avarka'loadea avar panthiyirukkaiyil, avar appaththai eduththu, aaseervathiththu, athaippittu, avarka'lukkuk koduththaar.
appozhuthu avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l thi'rakkappattu, avarai a'rinthaarka'l. udanea avar avarka'lukku ma'rainthupoanaar.

appozhuthu avarka'l oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: vazhiyilea avar nammudanea peasi, veathavaakkiyangka'lai namakku vi'langkakkaattinapozhuthu, nammudaiya iruthayam namakku'l'lea kozhunthuvittu eriyavillaiyaa en'ru sollikko'ndu,
annearamea ezhunthirunthu, erusaleamukkuth thirumpippoay, pathinoruvarum avarka'loadirunthavarka'lum koodiyirukkakka'ndu:
karththar meyyaakavea uyirththezhunthu seemoanukkuth tharisanamaanaar en'ru avarka'l sollak keattu,
vazhiyil nadanthavaika'laiyum, avar appaththaip pidkaiyil thaangka'l avarai a'rinthuko'ndathaiyum vivariththuch sonnaarka'l.
ivaika'laikku'riththu avarka'l peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, iyeasu thaamea avarka'l naduvilea nin'ru: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam en'raar.
avarka'l kalangki, payanthu, oru aaviyaik kaa'nki'rathaaka ninaiththaarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ean kalangkuki'reerka'l; ungka'l iruthayangka'lil santheakangka'l ezhumpuki'rathenna?

naanthaan en'ru a'riyumpadi, en kaika'laiyum en kaalka'laiyum paarungka'l, ennaith thottuppaarungka'l; neengka'l kaa'nki'rapadi, enakku maamsamum elumpuka'lum u'ndaayirukki'rathupoala oru aavikku iraathea en'ru solli,
thammudaiya kaika'laiyum kaalka'laiyum avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaar.
aanaalum santhoashaththinaal avarka'l innum visuvaasiyaamal aachchariyappadukaiyil: pusikki'ratha'rku eathaakilum ingkea u'ndaa en'ru avarka'lidaththil keattaar.
appozhuthu poriththa meenka'ndaththaiyum theankoottuth thu'nikkaiyaiyum avarukkuk koduththaarka'l.
avaika'lai avar vaangki avarka'lukku munpaakap pusiththu,

avarka'lai noakki: moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththilum theerkkatharisika'lin aakamangka'lilum sangkeethangka'lilum ennaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'ravaika'lellaam ni'raivea'ravea'ndiyathen'ru, naan ungka'loadirunthapoathu ungka'lukkuch sollikko'nduvantha viseashangka'l ivaika'lea en'raar.
appozhuthu veathavaakkiyangka'lai a'rinthuko'l'lumpadi avarka'ludaiya manathai avar thi'ranthu avarka'lai noakki:
ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, ki'risthu paadupadavum, moon'raam naa'lil mariththoarilirunthezhunthirukkavum vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu;
an'riyum mananthirumputhalum paavamannippum erusaleam thodangkich sakala theasaththaarukkum avarudaiya naamaththinaalea pirasangkikkappadavum vea'ndiyathu.
neengka'l ivaika'lukkuch saadchika'laayirukki'reerka'l.
en pithaa vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninathai, ithoa, naan ungka'lukku anuppuki'rean. neengka'loa unnathaththilirunthu varum pelanaal tharippikkappadumvaraikkum erusaleam nakaraththil irungka'l en'raar.
pinpu avar peththaaniyaavaraikkum avarka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, thammudaiya kaika'lai uyarththi, avarka'lai aaseervathiththaar.
avarka'lai aaseervathikkaiyil, avarka'lai vittup pirinthu, paraloakaththukku eduththukko'l'lappattaar.
avarka'l avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndu, mikuntha santhoashaththoadea erusaleamukkuth thirumpivanthu,
naadoa'rum theavaalayaththilea theavanaip pukazhnthu thuthiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l. aamen.
aathiyilea vaarththai irunthathu, antha vaarththai theavanidaththilirunthathu, antha vaarththai theavanaayirunthathu.
avar aathiyilea theavanoadirunthaar.
sakalamum avar moolamaay u'ndaayit'ru; u'ndaanathon'rum avaraaleayallaamal u'ndaakavillai.
avarukku'l jeevan irunthathu, antha jeevan manusharukku o'liyaayirunthathu.
antha o'li iru'lilea pirakaasikki'rathu; iru'laanathu athaip pat'rikko'l'lavillai.
theavanaal anuppappatta oru manushan irunthaan, avan pear yoavaan.
avan thannaal ellaarum visuvaasikkumpadi antha o'liyaikku'riththuch saadchikodukka saadchiyaaka vanthaan.
avan antha o'liyalla, antha o'liyaikku'riththuch saadchikodukka vanthavanaayirunthaan.
ulakaththilea vanthu entha manushanaiyum pirakaasippikki'ra o'liyea antha meyyaana o'li.
avar ulakaththil irunthaar, ulakam avar moolamaay u'ndaayit'ru, ulakamoa avarai a'riyavillai.
avar thamakkuch sonthamaanathilea vanthaar, avarukkuch sonthamaanavarka'loa avarai eat'rukko'l'lavillai.
avarudaiya naamaththinmeal visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laay avarai eat'rukko'ndavarka'l eththanaipearka'loa, aththanaipearka'lum theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'laakumpadi, avarka'lukku athikaarang koduththaar.
avarka'l, iraththaththinaalaavathu maamsa siththaththinaalaavathu purushanudaiya siththaththinaalaavathu pi'ravaamal, theavanaalea pi'ranthavarka'l.

antha vaarththai maamsamaaki, kirupaiyinaalum saththiyaththinaalum ni'rainthavaraay, namakku'l'lea vaasampa'n'ninaar; avarudaiya makimaiyaik ka'ndoam; athu pithaavukku oreapea'raanavarudaiya makimaikku eat'ra makimaiyaakavea irunthathu.

yoavaan avaraikku'riththuch saadchikoduththu: enakkup pinvaruki'ravar enakku munnirunthavar, aakaiyaal avar ennilum meanmaiyu'l'lavar en'ru naan solliyiruntheanea, avar ivarthaan en'ru saththamittuk koo'rinaan.
avarudaiya paripoora'naththinaal naam ellaarum kirupaiyinmeal kirupaipet'roam.
eppadiyenil, niyaayappiramaa'nam moaseayin moolamaayk kodukkappattathu, kirupaiyum saththiyamum iyeasu ki'risthuvin moolamaay u'ndaayina.
theavanai oruvanum orukkaalung ka'ndathillai, pithaavin madiyilirukki'ra oreapea'raana kumaaranea avarai ve'lippaduththinaar.
erusaleamilirunthu yootharka'l aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum yoavaanidaththil anuppi: neer yaar en'ru keattapozhuthu,
avan ma'ruthaliyaamal a'rikkaiyittathuman'ri, naan ki'risthu alla en'rum a'rikkaiyittaan.
appozhuthu avarka'l: pinnai yaar? neer eliyaavaa en'ru keattaarka'l. atha'rku: naan avan alla en'raan. neer theerkkatharisiyaanavaraa en'ru keattaarka'l. atha'rkum: alla en'raan.
avarka'l pinnum avanai noakki: neer yaar? engka'lai anuppinavarka'lukku naangka'l uththaravu sollumpadikku, ummaikku'riththu enna solluki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avan: karththarukku vazhiyaich sevvaipa'n'nungka'l en'ru easaayaa theerkkatharisi sonnapadiyea, naan vanaantharaththilea kooppiduki'ravanudaiya saththamaayirukki'rean en'raan.
anuppappattavarka'l pariseayaraayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l avanai noakki: neer ki'risthuvumalla, eliyaavumalla, theerkkatharisiyaanavarumallaven'raal, ean gnaanasnaanang kodukki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.
yoavaan avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan jalaththinaalea gnaanasnaanangkodukki'rean; neengka'l a'riyaathirukki'ra oruvar ungka'l naduvilea ni'rki'raar.
avar enakkup pinvanthum ennilum meanmaiyu'l'lavar; avarudaiya paatharadchaiyin vaarai avizhppatha'rkum naan paaththiranalla en'raan.
ivaika'l yoarthaanukku akkaraiyil yoavaan gnaanasnaanangkoduththa peththaaparaavilea nadanthana.
ma'runaa'lilea yoavaan iyeasuvaith thannidaththil varakka'ndu: ithoa, ulakaththin paavaththaich sumanthutheerkki'ra theava aattukkutti.
enakkuppin oruvar varuki'raar, avar enakku munnirunthapadiyaal ennilum meanmaiyu'l'lavaren'ru naan sonneanea, avar ivarthaan.
naanum ivarai a'riyaathirunthean; ivar isravealukku ve'lippadum poruttaaka, naan jalaththinaalea gnaanasnaanang kodukkavanthean en'raan.
pinnum yoavaan saadchiyaakach sonnathu: aaviyaanavar pu'raavaippoala vaanaththilirunthi'rangki, ivarmeal thangkinathaik ka'ndean.

naanum ivarai a'riyaathirunthean; aanaalum jalaththinaal gnaanasnaanangkodukkumpadi ennai anuppinavar: aaviyaanavar i'rangki yaarmeal thangkuvathai nee kaa'npaayoa, avarea parisuththa aaviyinaal gnaanasnaanangkodukki'ravar en'ru enakkuch solliyirunthaar.
anthappadiyea naan ka'ndu, ivarea theavanudaiya kumaaran en'ru saadchi koduththuvaruki'rean en'raan.
ma'runaa'lilea yoavaanum avanudaiya seesharil ira'ndupearum ni'rkumpoathu,
iyeasu nadanthupoaki'rathai avan ka'ndu: ithoa, theava aattukkutti en'raan.
avan appadich sonnathai avvira'ndu seesharungkeattu, iyeasuvukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

iyeasu thirumpi, avarka'l pin selluki'rathaik ka'ndu: enna theaduki'reerka'l en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: rapee, neer engkea thangkiyirukki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l; rapee enpatha'rkup poathakarea en'ru arththamaam.

avar: vanthu paarungka'l en'raar. avarka'l vanthu avar thangkiyiruntha idaththaik ka'ndu, an'raiyaththinam avaridaththil thangkinaarka'l. appozhuthu ea'rakku'raiyap paththuma'ni vea'laiyaayirunthathu.
yoavaan sonnathaik keattu, avarukkup pinsen'ra ira'ndupearil oruvan seemoan peathuruvin sakoatharanaakiya anthireayaa enpavan.
avan muthalaavathu than sakoatharanaakiya seemoanaik ka'ndu: measiyaavaik ka'ndoam en'ru sonnaan; measiyaa enpatha'rkuk ki'risthu en'ru arththamaam.
pinpu, avanai iyeasuvinidaththil koottikko'nduvanthaan. iyeasu avanaip paarththu: nee yoanaavin makanaakiya seemoan, nee keapaa ennappaduvaay en'raar; keapaa enpatha'rkup peathuru en'ru arththamaam.
ma'runaa'lilea iyeasu kalileayaavukkuppoaka manathaayirunthu, pilippuvaik ka'ndu: nee enakkup pinsen'ru vaa en'raar.
pilippenpavan anthireayaa peathuru enpavarka'ludaiya ooraakiya pethsaayithaa patta'naththaan.
pilippu naaththaanvealaik ka'ndu: niyaayappiramaa'naththilea moaseayum theerkkatharisika'lum ezhuthiyirukki'ravaraik ka'ndoam; avar yoaseappin kumaaranum naasareaththooraanumaakiya iyeasuvea en'raan.
atha'rku naaththaanveal: naasareaththilirunthu yaathoru nanmai u'ndaakakkoodumaa en'raan. atha'rkup pilippu: vanthu paar en'raan.
iyeasu naaththaanvealaith thammidaththil varakka'ndu avanaikku'riththu: ithoa, kapadat'ra uththama isravealan en'raar.
atha'rku naaththaanveal: neer ennai eppadi a'riveer en'raan. iyeasu avanai noakki: pilippu unnai azhaikki'ratha'rkumunnea, nee aththimaraththin keezhirukkumpoathu unnaik ka'ndean en'raar.
atha'rku naaththaanveal: rapee, neer theavanudaiya kumaaran, neer isravealin raajaa en'raan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aththimaraththin keezhea unnaik ka'ndean en'ru naan unakkuch sonnathinaaleayaa visuvaasikki'raay; ithilum perithaanavaika'laik kaa'npaay en'raar.

pinnum, avar avanai noakki: vaanam thi'ranthirukki'rathaiyum, theavathootharka'l manushakumaaranidaththilirunthu ea'ruki'rathaiyum i'rangkuki'rathaiyum neengka'l ithumuthal kaa'npeerka'l en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
moon'raam naa'lilea kalileayaavilu'l'la kaanaa oorilea oru kaliyaa'nam nadanthathu; iyeasuvin thaayum angkeayirunthaa'l.
iyeasuvum avarudaiya seesharum anthak kaliyaa'naththukku azhaikkappattirunthaarka'l.
thiraadcharasam ku'raivupattapoathu, iyeasuvin thaay avarai noakki: avarka'lukkuth thiraadcharasam illai en'raa'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: sthireeyea, enakkum unakkum enna, en vea'lai innum varavillai en'raar.
avarudaiya thaay vealaikkaararai noakki: avar ungka'lukku enna solluki'raaroa, athinpadi seyyungka'l en'raa'l.
yootharka'l thangka'laich suththikarikkum mu'raimaiyinpadiyea, ovvon'ru ira'ndu moon'ru kudam tha'n'neer ko'l'laththakka aa'ru ka'rsaadika'l angkea vaiththirunthathu.
iyeasu vealaikkaararai noakki: jaadika'lilea tha'n'neer nirappungka'l en'raar; avarka'l avaika'lai ni'raiya nirappinaarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippozhuthu mo'ndu, panthivisaarippukkaaranidaththil ko'ndupoangka'l en'raar; avarka'l ko'ndupoanaarka'l.

anthath thiraadcharasam engkeayirunthu vanthathen'ru tha'n'neerai mo'nda vealaikkaararukkuth therinthatheayan'ri panthivisaarippukkaaranukkuth theriyaathathinaal, avan thiraadcharasamaay maa'rina tha'n'neerai rusipaarththapoathu, ma'navaa'lanai azhaiththu:
entha manushanum munpu nalla thiraadcharasaththaik koduththu, janangka'l thirupthiyadainthapinpu, rusi ku'rainthathaik koduppaan, neeroa nalla rasaththai ithuvaraikkum vaiththiruntheerea en'raan.

ivvithamaaka iyeasu intha muthalaam a'rputhaththaik kalileayaavilu'l'la kaanaa oorilea seythu, thammudaiya makimaiyai ve'lippaduththinaar; avarudaiya seesharka'l avaridaththil visuvaasam vaiththaarka'l.
athanpinpu avarum avarudaiya thaayaarum avarudaiya sakoathararum avarudaiya seesharum kapparnakoomukkuppoay, angkea silanaa'l thangkinaarka'l.
pinpu yootharudaiya paskaapa'ndikai sameepamaayirunthathu; appozhuthu iyeasu erusaleamukkup poay,
theavaalayaththilea aaduka'l maaduka'l pu'raakka'laakiya ivaika'lai vi'rki'ravarka'laiyum, kaasukkaarar udkaarnthirukki'rathaiyum ka'ndu,

kayit'rinaal oru savukkaiyu'ndupa'n'ni, avarka'l yaavaraiyum aadumaaduka'laiyum theavaalayaththukkup pu'rampea thuraththivittu, kaasukkaararudaiya kaasuka'laik kotti, palakaika'laik kavizhththuppoattu,
pu'raa vi'rki'ravarka'lai noakki: ivaika'lai ivvidaththilirunthu eduththukko'ndupoangka'l; en pithaavin veettai viyaapaara veedaakkaathirungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu: ummudaiya veettaikku'riththu u'ndaana pakthivairaakkiyam ennaip padchiththathu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathai avarudaiya seesharka'l ninaivukoornthaarka'l.
appozhuthu yootharka'l avarai noakki: neer ivaika'laich seyki'reerea, itha'rku enna adaiyaa'laththai engka'lukkuk kaa'npikki'reer en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: intha aalayaththai idiththuppoadungka'l, moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea ithai ezhuppuvean en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: intha aalayaththaik katta naa'rpaththaa'ru varusham sen'rathea, neer ithai moon'ru naa'laikku'l'lea ezhuppuveeroa en'raarka'l.
avaroa thammudaiya sareeramaakiya aalayaththaikku'riththup peasinaar.
avar ippadich sonnathai avar mariththoarilirunthezhunthapinpu avarudaiya seesharka'l ninaivukoornthu, veathavaakkiyaththaiyum iyeasu sonna vasanaththaiyum visuvaasiththaarka'l.
paskaapa'ndikaiyilea avar erusaleamilirukkaiyil, avar seytha a'rputhangka'lai aneakar ka'ndu, avarudaiya naamaththil visuvaasam vaiththaarka'l.
appadiyirunthum, iyeasu ellaaraiyum a'rinthirunthapadiyaal, avarka'lai nampi i'nangkavillai.
manusharu'l'laththiliruppathai avar a'rinthirunthapadiyaal, manusharaik ku'riththu oruvarum avarukkuch saadchi kodukkavea'ndiyathaayirukkavillai.
yootharukku'l'lea athikaariyaana nikkotheamu ennappatta pariseayan oruvan irunthaan.

avan iraakkaalaththilea iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu: rapee, neer theavanidaththilirunthu vantha poathakar en'ru a'rinthirukki'roam, eanenil oruvanum thannudanea theavan iraavittaal neer seyki'ra ippadippatta a'rputhangka'laich seyyamaattaan en'raan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: oruvan ma'rupadiyum pi'ravaavittaal theavanudaiya raajyaththaik kaa'namaattaan en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
atha'rku nikkotheamu: oru manushan muthirvayathaayirukkaiyil eppadip pi'rappaan? avan than thaayin karppaththil ira'ndaantharam piraveasiththup pi'rakkakkoodumoa en'raan.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: oruvan jalaththinaalum aaviyinaalum pi'ravaavittaal theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasikkamaattaan en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean.
maamsaththinaal pi'rappathu maamsamaayirukkum, aaviyinaal pi'rappathu aaviyaayirukkum.
neengka'l ma'rupadiyum pi'rakkavea'ndum en'ru naan unakkuch sonnathaik ku'riththu athisayappadavea'ndaam.

kaat'raanathu thanakku ishdamaana idaththilea veesuki'rathu, athin saththaththaik keadki'raay, aakilum athu inna idaththilirunthu varuki'rathen'rum, inna idaththukkup poaki'rathen'rum unakkuth theriyaathu; aaviyinaal pi'ranthavanevanoa avanum appadiyea irukki'raan en'raar.
atha'rku nikkotheamu: ivaika'l eppadi aakum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee isravealil poathakanaayirunthum ivaika'lai a'riyaamalirukki'raayaa?

meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan unakkuch solluki'rean, naangka'l a'rinthirukki'rathaich solli, naangka'l ka'ndathaikku'riththuch saadchikodukki'roam; neengka'loa engka'l saadchiyai eat'ruk ko'l'luki'rathillai.
poomikkaduththa kaariyangka'lai naan ungka'lukkuch solliyum neengka'l visuvaasikkavillaiyea, paramakaariyangka'lai ungka'lukkuch solveanaanaal eppadi visuvaasippeerka'l?
paraloakaththilirunthi'rangkinavarum paraloakaththilirukki'ravarumaana manushakumaaraneayallaamal paraloakaththukku ea'rinavan oruvanumillai.
sarppamaanathu moaseayinaal vanaantharaththilea uyarththappattathupoala manushakumaaranum,
thannai visuvaasikki'ravan evanoa avan kettuppoakaamal niththiyajeevanai adaiyumpadikku, uyarththappadavea'ndum.
theavan, thammudaiya oreapea'raana kumaaranai visuvaasikki'ravan evanoa avan kettuppoakaamal niththiyajeevanai adaiyumpadikku, avaraith thantharu'li, ivva'lavaay ulakaththil anpu koornthaar.
ulakaththai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkumpadi theavan thammudaiya kumaaranai ulakaththil anuppaamal, avaraalea ulakam iradchikkappaduvatha'rkaakavea avarai anuppinaar.

avarai visuvaasikki'ravan aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappadaan; visuvaasiyaathavanoa, theavanudaiya oreapea'raana kumaaranudaiya naamaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavanaayiraathapadiyinaal, avan aakkinaith theerppukkudpattaayit'ru.

o'liyaanathu ulakaththilea vanthirunthum manusharudaiya kiriyaika'l pollaathavaika'laayirukki'ra padiyinaal avarka'l o'liyaippaarkkilum iru'lai virumpuki'rathea antha aakkinaiththeerppukkuk kaara'namaayirukki'rathu.
pollaangku seyki'ra evanum o'liyaip pakaikki'raan, than kiriyaika'l ka'ndikkappadaathapadikku, o'liyinidaththil varaathirukki'raan.
saththiyaththinpadi seyki'ravanoa, than kiriyaika'l theavanukku'l'laaych seyyappaduki'rathen'ru ve'liyaakumpadikku, o'liyinidaththil varuki'raan en'raar.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, iyeasuvum avarudaiya seesharum yootheayaa theasaththi'rku vanthaarka'l; angkea avar avarka'loadea sagnchariththu, gnaanasnaanangkoduththuvanthaar.

saalim oorukkuch sameepamaana ayinoan ennum idaththilea tha'n'neer mikuthiyaayirunthapadiyinaal, yoavaanum angkea gnaanasnaanangkoduththuvanthaan; janangka'l avanidaththil vanthu gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
akkaalaththil yoavaan kaavalil vaikkappattirukkavillai.
appozhuthu yoavaanudaiya seesharil silarukkum yootharukkum suththikarippaikku'riththu vaakkuvaathamu'ndaayit'ru.

avarka'l yoavaanidaththil vanthu: rapee, ummudaneakooda yoarthaanukku akkaraiyil oruvar irunthaarea; avaraik ku'riththu neerum saadchikoduththeerea, ithoa, avar gnaanasnaanangkodukki'raar, ellaarum avaridaththil poaki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
yoavaan pirathiyuththaramaaka: paraloakaththilirunthu oruvanukkuk kodukkappattaalozhiya, avan on'raiyum pet'rukko'l'lamaattaan.
naan ki'risthuvalla, avarukku munnaaka anuppappattavan en'ru naan sonnatha'rku neengka'lea saadchika'l.

ma'navaattiyai udaiyavanea ma'navaa'lan; ma'navaa'lanudaiya thoazhanoa, arukea nin'ru, avarudaiya sollaik keadki'ravanaay ma'navaa'lanudaiya saththaththaikku'riththu mikavum santhoashappaduki'raan; inthach santhoasham ippozhuthu enakkuch sampoora'namaayit'ru.
avar perukavum naan si'rukavum vea'ndum.

unnathaththilirunthu varuki'ravar ellaarilum mealaanavar; poomiyilirunthu'ndaanavan poomiyin thanmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthu, poomikkaduththavaika'laip peasuki'raan; paraloakaththilirunthu varuki'ravar ellaarilum mealaanavar.
thaam ka'ndathaiyum keattathaiyum saadchiyaakach solluki'raar; avarudaiya saadchiyai oruvanum eat'rukko'l'luki'rathillai.
avarudaiya saadchiyai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan theavan saththiyamu'l'lavaren'ru muththiraipoattu nichchayappaduththuki'raan.
theavanaal anuppappattavar theavanudaiya vaarththaika'laip peasuki'raar; theavan avarukkuth thamathu aaviyai a'lavillaamal koduththirukki'raar.
pithaavaanavar kumaaranil anpaayirunthu ellaavat'raiyum avar kaiyil oppukkoduththirukki'raar.
kumaaranidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan niththiyajeevanai udaiyavanaayirukki'raan; kumaaranai visuvaasiyaathavanoa jeevanaik kaa'npathillai, theavanudaiya koapam avanmeal nilaini'rkum en'raan.
yoavaanaippaarkkilum iyeasu aneakam pearaich seesharaakki gnaanasnaanangkodukki'raaren'ru pariseayar kea'lvippattathaakak karththar a'rinthapoathu,
yootheayaavaivittu ma'rupadiyung kalileayaavukkup poanaar.
iyeasu thaamea gnaanasnaanangkodukkavillai, avarudaiya seesharka'l koduththaarka'l.
avar samaariyaa naattin vazhiyaayp poakavea'ndiyathaayirunthapadiyaal,
yaakkoapu than kumaaranaakiya yoaseappukkuk koduththa nilaththukku arukea iruntha samaariyaavilu'l'la seekaar ennappatta oorukku vanthaar.
angkea yaakkoapudaiya ki'na'ru irunthathu; iyeasu pirayaa'naththinaal i'laippadainthavaraay anthak ki'nat'rinarukea udkaarnthaar; appozhuthu ea'rakku'raiya aa'raamma'ni vea'laiyaayirunthathu.
avarudaiya seesharka'l poajanapathaarththangka'laik ko'l'lumpadi oorukku'l'lea poayirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu samaariyaa naattaa'laakiya oru sthiree tha'n'neer mo'l'la vanthaa'l. iyeasu ava'lai noakki: thaakaththukkuth thaa en'raar.

yootharka'l samaariyarudanea sampanthangkalavaathavarka'laanapadiyaal, samaariyaa sthiree avarai noakki: neer yoothanaayirukka, samaariyaa sthireeyaakiya ennidaththil, thaakaththukkuththaa en'ru eppadik keadkalaam en'raa'l.

iyeasu ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: nee theavanudaiya eevaiyum, thaakaththukkuththaa en'ru unnidaththil keadki'ravar innaar enpathaiyum a'rinthirunthaayaanaal, neeyea avaridaththil keattiruppaay, avar unakku jeevaththa'n'neeraik koduththiruppaar en'raar.
atha'rku antha sthiree: aa'ndavarea, mo'nduko'l'la ummidaththil paaththiramillaiyea, ki'na'rum aazhamaayirukki'rathea, pinnai engkeayirunthu umakku jeevaththa'n'neer u'ndaakum.
inthak ki'nat'rai engka'lukkuth thantha nammudaiya pithaavaakiya yaakkoapaippaarkkilum neer periyavaroa? avarum avar pi'l'laika'lum avar mirukajeevanka'lum ithilea kudiththathu'ndea en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: inthath tha'n'neeraik kudikki'ravanukku ma'rupadiyum thaakamu'ndaakum.
naan kodukkum tha'n'neeraik kudikki'ravanukkoa orukkaalum thaakamu'ndaakaathu; naan avanukkuk kodukkum tha'n'neer avanukku'l'lea niththiya jeevakaalamaay oo'ruki'ra neeroot'raayirukkum en'raar.
antha sthiree avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, enakkuth thaakamu'ndaakaamalum, naan ingkea mo'nduko'l'la varaamalumirukkumpadi anthath tha'n'neerai enakkuth tharavea'ndum en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: nee poay, un purushanai ingkea azhaiththuk ko'nduvaa en'raar.
atha'rku antha sthiree: enakkup purushan illai en'raa'l. iyeasu ava'lai noakki: enakkup purushan illaiyen'ru nee sonnathu sarithaan.
eppadiyenil, ainthu purushar unakkirunthaarka'l, ippozhuthu unakkirukki'ravan unakkup purushanalla, ithai u'l'lapadi sonnaay en'raar.
appozhuthu antha sthiree avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer theerkkatharisi en'ru kaa'nki'rean.
engka'l pithaakka'l intha malaiyilea thozhuthuko'nduvanthaarka'l; neengka'l erusaleamilirukki'ra sthalaththilea thozhuthuko'l'lavea'ndum enki'reerka'lea en'raa'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: sthireeyea, naan solluki'rathai nampu, neengka'l intha malaiyilum erusaleamilum maaththiramalla, engkum pithaavaith thozhuthuko'l'lungkaalam varuki'rathu.
neengka'l a'riyaathathaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'reerka'l; naangka'l a'rinthirukki'rathaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'roam; eanen'raal iradchippu yootharka'l vazhiyaay varuki'rathu.

u'nmaiyaayth thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'l pithaavai aaviyoadum u'nmaiyoadum thozhuthuko'l'lungkaalam varum, athu ippozhuthea vanthirukki'rathu; thammaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'l ippadippattavarka'laayirukkumpadi pithaavaanavar virumpuki'raar.
theavan aaviyaayirukki'raar, avaraith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'l aaviyoadum u'nmaiyoadum avaraith thozhuthuko'l'lavea'ndum en'raar.
antha sthiree avarai noakki: ki'risthu ennappaduki'ra measiyaa varuki'raar en'ru a'rivean, avar varumpoathu ellaavat'raiyum namakku a'rivippaar en'raa'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: unnudanea peasuki'ra naanea avar en'raar.

aththaru'naththil avarudaiya seesharka'l vanthu, avar sthireeyudanea peasuki'rathaippat'ri aachchariyappattaarka'l. aakilum enna theaduki'reeren'raavathu, ean ava'ludanea peasuki'reeren'raavathu, oruvanum keadkavillai.
appozhuthu antha sthiree, than kudaththai vaiththuvittu, oorukku'l'lea poay, janangka'lai noakki:
naan seytha ellaavat'raiyum oru manushan enakkuch sonnaar; avarai vanthu paarungka'l; avar ki'risthuthaanoa en'raa'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l oorilirunthu pu'rappattu avaridaththil vanthaarka'l.
ippadi nadakkaiyil seesharka'l avarai noakki: rapee, poajanampa'n'num en'ru vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: naan pusippatha'rku neengka'l a'riyaatha oru poajanam enakku u'ndu en'raar.
appozhuthu seesharka'l oruvaraiyoruvar paarththu: yaaraavathu avarukkup poajanam ko'nduvanthiruppaanoa en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: naan ennai anuppinavarudaiya siththaththinpadi seythu avarudaiya kiriyaiyai mudippathea ennudaiya poajanamaayirukki'rathu.

a'ruppukkaalam varuki'ratha'rku innum naalumaatham sellum en'ru neengka'l solluki'rathillaiyaa? ithoa, vayal nilangka'l ippozhuthea a'ruppukku vi'lainthirukki'rathen'ru ungka'l ka'nka'lai ea'reduththuppaarungka'l en'ru naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
vithaikki'ravanum a'rukki'ravanumaakiya iruvarum orumiththuch santhoashappadaththakkathaaka, a'rukki'ravan kooliyai vaangki, niththiya jeevanukkaakap palanaich searththukko'l'luki'raan.
vithaikki'ravan oruvan a'rukki'ravan oruvan enki'ra meyyaana vazhakkachsol ithinaalea vi'langkuki'rathu.
neengka'l pirayaasappattup payiridaathathai a'rukka naan ungka'lai anuppinean, mat'ravarka'l pirayaasappattaarka'l, avarka'ludaiya pirayaasaththin palanai neengka'l pet'reerka'l en'raar.
naan seytha ellaavat'raiyum enakkuch sonnaar en'ru saadchi sonna antha sthireeyinudaiya vaarththaiyinimiththam antha oorilu'l'la samaariyaril aneakar avarmeal visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l.
samaariyar avaridaththil vanthu, thangka'lidaththil thangkavea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l; avar ira'ndunaa'l angkea thangkinaar.
appozhuthu avarudaiya upatheasaththinimiththam innum aneakampear visuvaasiththu,
antha sthireeyai noakki: un sollinimiththam alla, avarudaiya upatheasaththai naangka'lea keattu, avar meyyaayk ki'risthuvaakiya ulakaradchakar en'ru a'rinthu visuvaasikki'roam en'raarka'l.
ira'ndunaa'laikkuppinpu avar avvidamvittup pu'rappattu, kalileayaavukkup poanaar.
oru theerkkatharisikkuth than sontha oorilea kanamillaiyen'ru iyeasu thaamea solliyirunthaar.
avar kalileayaavil vanthapoathu, erusaleamil pa'ndikaiyilea avar seytha ellaavat'raiyum paarththiruntha kalileayar avarai eat'rukko'ndaarka'l; avarka'lum pa'ndikaikkup poayirunthaarka'l.

pinpu, iyeasu thaam tha'n'neeraith thiraadcharasamaakkina kalileayaavilu'l'la kaanaa oorukku ma'rupadiyum vanthaar; appozhuthu kapparnakoomilea raajaavin manusharil oruvanudaiya kumaaran viyaathiyaayirunthaan.

iyeasu yootheayaavilirunthu kalileayaavukku vanthaaren'ru antha manushan kea'lvippattapoathu, avaridaththi'rkup poay, than makan mara'na avasthaiyaayirunthapadiyinaalea, avanaik ku'namaakkumpadikku varavea'ndumen'ru avarai vea'ndikko'ndaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu avanai noakki: neengka'l adaiyaa'langka'laiyum a'rputhangka'laiyum kaa'naavittaal visuvaasikkamaatteerka'l en'raar.
atha'rku raajaavin manushan: aa'ndavarea, en pi'l'lai saaki'ratha'rkumunnea varavea'ndum en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee poakalaam, un kumaaran pizhaiththirukki'raan en'raar. antha manushan, iyeasu sonna vaarththaiyai nampip poanaan.
avan poakaiyil, avanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avanukku ethirko'nduvanthu, ummudaiya kumaaran pizhaiththirukki'raan en'ru a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu: entha ma'ninearaththil avanukkuk ku'namu'ndaayit'ru en'ru avarka'lidaththil visaariththaan. avarka'l: neat'ru eazhaama'ninearaththil juram avanai vittathu en'raarka'l.
un kumaaran pizhaiththirukki'raan en'ru iyeasu thannudanea sonna ma'ninearam athuvea en'ru thakappan a'rinthu, avanum avan veettaaranaivarum visuvaasiththaarka'l.
iyeasu yootheayaavilirunthu kalileayaavukkuth thirumpivanthapinpu, ithu avar seytha ira'ndaam a'rputham.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu yootharudaiya pa'ndikai on'ru vanthathu; appozhuthu iyeasu erusaleamukkup poanaar.
epireya paashaiyilea pethasthaa ennappatta oru ku'lam erusaleamil aattuvaasalinarukea irukki'rathu, atha'rku ainthu ma'ndapangka'lu'ndu.
avaika'lilea kurudar, sappaa'nika'l, soompina u'ruppudaiyavarka'l muthalaana viyaathikkaarar aneakar paduththirunthu, tha'n'neer eppozhuthu kalangkum en'ru kaaththukko'ndiruppaarka'l.

eanenil sila samayangka'lilea theavathoothan oruvan anthak ku'laththil i'rangki, tha'n'neeraik kalakkuvaan; tha'n'neer kalangkinapinpu yaar munthi athil i'rangkuvaanoa avan eppearppatta viyaathisthanaayirunthaalum sosthamaavaan.
muppaththettu varusham viyaathiko'ndiruntha oru manushan angkea irunthaan.
paduththiruntha avanai iyeasu ka'ndu, avan vekukaalamaay viyaathisthanen'ru a'rinthu, avanai noakki: sosthamaakavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'raayaa en'ru keattaar.

atha'rku viyaathisthan: aa'ndavarea, tha'n'neer kalakkappadumpoathu ennaik ku'laththil ko'ndupoay viduki'ratha'rku oruvarumillai, naan poaki'ratha'rku'l'lea vea'roruvan enakku munthi i'rangkividuki'raan en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: ezhunthiru, un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu nada en'raar.
udanea antha manushan sosthamaaki, than padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu, nadanthupoanaan. antha naa'l oayvunaa'laayirunthathu.
aathalaal yootharka'l ku'namaakkappattavanai noakki: ithu oayvunaa'laayirukki'rathea, padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu poaki'rathu unakku niyaayamalla en'raarka'l.
avan avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennaich sosthamaakkinavar, un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu nadaven'ru enakkuch sonnaar en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: un padukkaiyai eduththukko'ndu nadaven'ru unnudanea sonna manushan yaar en'ru avanidaththil keattaarka'l.
sosthamaakkappattavan avar innaaren'ru a'riyavillai; avvidaththil janangka'l koottamaayirunthapadiyinaal iyeasu vilakiyirunthaar.
atha'rkuppinpu iyeasu avanaith theavaalayaththilea ka'ndu: ithoa, nee sosthamaanaay, athika keadaanathon'rum unakku varaathapadi inip paavagnseyyaathea en'raar.
antha manushan poay, thannaich sosthamaakkinavar iyeasu en'ru yootharka'lukku a'riviththaan.
iyeasu ivaika'lai oayvunaa'lil seythapadiyaal, yootharka'l avaraith thunpappaduththi, avaraik kolaiseyya vakaitheadinaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: en pithaa ithuvaraikkum kiriyai seythu varuki'raar, naanum kiriyai seythu varuki'rean en'raar.

avar oayvunaa'l katta'laiyai mee'rinathumallaamal, theavanaith thammudaiya sonthap pithaa en'rugnsollith thammaith theavanukkuch samamaakkinapadiyinaalea, yootharka'l avaraik kolaiseyyumpadi athikamaay vakaitheadinaarka'l.

appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean: pithaavaanavar seyyak kumaaran kaa'nki'rathethuvoa, athaiyeayan'ri, vea'ron'raiyum thaamaaych seyyamaattaar; avar evaika'laich seyki'raaroa, avaika'laik kumaaranum anthappadiyea seyki'raar.

pithaavaanavar kumaaranidaththil anpaayirunthu, thaam seyki'ravaika'laiyellaam avarukkuk kaa'npikki'raar; neengka'l aachchariyappadaththakkathaaka ivaika'laip paarkkilum perithaana kiriyaika'laiyum avarukkuk kaa'npippaar.
pithaavaanavar mariththoarai ezhuppi uyirppikki'rathupoala, kumaaranum thamakkuch siththamaanavarka'lai uyirppikki'raar.

an'riyum pithaavaik kanampa'n'nuki'rathupoala ellaarum kumaaranaiyum kanampa'n'numpadikku, pithaavaanavar thaamea oruvarukkum niyaayaththeerppuch seyyaamal, niyaayaththeerppuch seyyum athikaaram muzhuvathaiyum kumaaranukku oppukkoduththirukki'raar.
kumaaranaik kanampa'n'naathavan avarai anuppina pithaavaiyum kanam pa'n'naathavanaayirukki'raan.

en vasanaththaik keattu, ennai anuppinavarai visuvaasikki'ravanukku niththiyajeevan u'ndu; avan aakkinaith theerppukkudpadaamal, mara'naththaivittu neengki, jeevanukkudpattirukki'raan en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

mariththoar theavakumaaranudaiya saththaththaik keadkung kaalam varum, athu ippozhuthea vanthirukki'rathu; athaik keadki'ravarka'l pizhaippaarka'l en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
eanenil, pithaavaanavar thammil thaamea jeevanudaiyavaraayirukki'rathu poala, kumaaranum thammilthaamea jeevanudaiyavaraayirukkumpadi aru'lseythirukki'raar.
avar manushakumaaranaayirukki'rapadiyaal, niyaayaththeerppuch seyyumpadikku athikaaraththaiyum avarukkuk koduththirukki'raar.
ithaikku'riththu neengka'l aachchariyappadavea'ndaam; eanen'raal pireathakkuzhika'lilu'l'la anaivarum avarudaiya saththaththaik keadkung kaalam varum;
appozhuthu, nanmaiseythavarka'l jeevanai adaiyumpadi ezhunthirukki'ravarka'laakavum, theemaiseythavarka'l aakkinaiyai adaiyumpadi ezhunthirukki'ravarka'laakavum pu'rappaduvaarka'l.

naan en suyamaay on'rugn seyki'rathillai; naan keadki'rapadiyea niyaayantheerkki'rean; enakkuch siththamaanathai naan theadaamal, ennai anuppina pithaavukkuch siththamaanathaiyea naan theaduki'rapadiyaal en theerppu neethiyaayirukki'rathu.
ennaikku'riththu naanea saadchikoduththaal en saadchi meyyaayiraathu.
ennaikku'riththuch saadchikodukki'ravar vea'roruvar irukki'raar, avar ennaikku'riththuk kodukki'ra saadchi meyyaana saadchiyen'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
neengka'l yoavaanidaththil aa'lanuppi visaariththeerka'l, avan saththiyaththi'rkuch saadchikoduththaan.
naan eat'rukko'l'luki'ra saadchi manusharudaiya saadchiyalla, neengka'l iradchikkappaduvatha'rkaakavea ivaika'laich solluki'rean.
avan erinthu pirakaasikki'ra vi'lakkaayirunthaan; neengka'lum silakaalam avan ve'lichchaththilea ka'likoora manathaayiruntheerka'l.

yoavaanudaiya saadchiyaippaarkkilum meanmaiyaana saadchi enakku u'ndu; athennavenil, naan ni'raiveat'rumpadikkup pithaavaanavar enakkuk ka'rpiththathum naan seythuvaruki'rathumaana kiriyaika'lea pithaa ennai anuppinaar en'ru ennaikku'riththuch saadchi kodukki'rathu.
ennai anuppina pithaa thaamea ennaikku'riththuch saadchi koduththirukki'raar; neengka'l orukkaalum avar saththaththaik keattathumillai, avar roopaththaik ka'ndathumillai.
avar anuppinavarai neengka'l visuvaasiyaathapadiyaal avarudaiya vasanam ungka'lil thariththirukki'rathumillai.
veathavaakkiyangka'lai aaraaynthu paarungka'l; avaika'laal ungka'lukku niththiyajeevan u'nden'ru e'n'nuki'reerka'lea, ennaikku'riththuch saadchikodukki'ravaika'lum avaika'lea.
appadiyirunthum ungka'lukku jeevan u'ndaakumpadi ennidaththil vara ungka'lukku manathillai.
naan manusharaal makimaiyai eat'rukko'l'luki'rathillai.
ungka'lil theava anpu illaiyen'ru ungka'lai a'rinthirukki'rean.
naan en pithaavin naamaththinaalea vanthirunthum neengka'l ennai eat'rukko'l'lavillai, vea'roruvan than suyanaamaththinaalea vanthaal avanai eat'rukko'lveerka'l.
theavanaaleamaaththiram varuki'ra makimaiyaith theadaamal, oruvaraaloruvar makimaiyai eat'rukko'l'luki'ra neengka'l eppadi visuvaasippeerka'l?
pithaavinidaththil naan ungka'lmeal kut'ragnsaattuvean en'ru ninaiyaathirungka'l; neengka'l nampuki'ra moaseayea ungka'lmeal kut'ragnsaattuvaan.
neengka'l moaseayai visuvaasiththeerka'laanaal, ennaiyum visuvaasippeerka'l; avan ennaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'raanea.
avan ezhuthina vaakkiyangka'lai neengka'l visuvaasiyaamalirunthaal naan solluki'ra vasanangka'lai eppadi visuvaasippeerka'l en'raar.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu iyeasu thipeariyaakkadal ennappatta kalileayaak kadalin akkaraikkup poanaar.
avar viyaathikkaararidaththil seytha a'rputhangka'laith thira'laana janangka'l ka'ndapadiyaal avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.
iyeasu malaiyinmeal ea'ri, angkea thammudaiya seesharudaneakooda udkaarnthaar.
appozhuthu yootharudaiya pa'ndikaiyaakiya paskaa sameepamaayirunthathu.

iyeasu thammudaiya ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu, thira'laana janangka'l thammidaththil varuki'rathaik ka'ndu, pilippuvai noakki: ivarka'l saappidaththakkathaaka appangka'lai engkea ko'l'lalaam en'ru keattaar.
thaam seyyappoaki'rathai a'rinthirunthum, avanaich soathikkumpadi ippadik keattaar.
pilippu avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivarka'lil ovvoruvanum kognchang kogncham eduththukko'ndaalum, irunoo'ru pa'naththu appangka'lum ivarka'lukkup poathaathea en'raan.
appozhuthu avarudaiya seeshariloruvanum, seemoan peathuruvin sakoatharanumaakiya anthireayaa avarai noakki:
ingkea oru paiyan irukki'raan, avan kaiyil ainthu vaa'rkoathumai appangka'lum ira'ndu meenka'lum u'ndu, aanaalum avaika'l iththanai janangka'lukku emmaaththiram en'raan.
iyeasu: janangka'lai udkaaravaiyungka'l en'raar. antha idam mikuntha pullu'l'lathaayirunthathu. panthiyiruntha purusharka'l ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayirampearaayirunthaarka'l.

iyeasu antha appangka'lai eduththu, sthoaththirampa'n'ni, seesharka'lidaththil koduththaar; seesharka'l panthiyirunthavarka'lukkuk koduththaarka'l; appadiyea meenka'laiyum avar eduththu avarka'lukku vea'ndiyamattum koduththaar.
avarka'l thirupthiyadainthapinpu, avar thammudaiya seesharka'lai noakki: on'rum seathamaayp poakaathapadikku meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'laich searththuvaiyungka'l en'raar.
anthappadiyea avarka'l searththu, vaa'rkoathumai appangka'l ainthil avarka'l saappittu meethiyaana thu'nikkaika'linaalea pannira'ndu koodaika'lai nirappinaarka'l.
iyeasu seytha a'rputhaththai antha manushar ka'ndu: meyyaakavea ivar ulakaththil varuki'ravaraana theerkkatharisi en'raarka'l.
aathalaal avarka'l vanthu, thammai raajaavaakkumpadip pidiththukko'ndupoaka manathaayirukki'raarka'len'ru iyeasu a'rinthu, ma'rupadiyum vilaki, thaniyea malaiyinmeal ea'rinaar.
saayangkaalamaanapoathu avarudaiya seesharka'l kada'rkaraikkup poay,
padavil ea'ri, kadalin akkaraiyilu'l'la kapparnakoomukku nearaayppoanaarka'l; appozhuthu iruttaayirunthathu, iyeasuvum avarka'lidaththil varaathirunthaar.
perungkaat'ru adiththapadiyinaalea kadal kontha'liththathu.
avarka'l ea'rakku'raiya moon'ru naalu mailthooram tha'nduvaliththup poanapozhuthu, iyeasu kadalinmeal nadanthu, padavukkuch sameepamaay varuki'rathaik ka'ndu payanthaarka'l.
avarka'lai avar noakki: naanthaan, payappadaathirungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu avaraip padavil eat'rikko'l'la manathaayirunthaarka'l; udanea padavu avarka'l poaki'ra karaiyaip pidiththathu.

ma'runaa'lil kadalin akkaraiyilea nin'ra janangka'l avarudaiya seeshar ea'rina antha orea padavuthavira angkea vea'roru padavum irunthathillaiyen'rum, iyeasu thammudaiya seesharudaneakoodap padavil ea'raamal avarudaiya seesharmaaththiram poanaarka'len'rum a'rinthaarka'l.
karththar sthoaththiragnseythapinpu avarka'l appam saappitta idaththukkuch sameepamaayth thipeariyaavilirunthu vea'rea padavuka'l vanthathu.
appozhuthu iyeasuvum avarudaiya seesharum angkea illaathathai janangka'l ka'ndu, udanea anthap padavuka'lil ea'ri, iyeasuvaith theadikko'ndu, kapparnakoomukku vanthaarka'l.
kadalin akkaraiyilea avarka'l avaraik ka'ndapoathu: rapee, neer eppozhuthu ivvidam vantheer en'ru keattaarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neengka'l a'rputhangka'laik ka'ndathinaal alla, neengka'l appam pusiththuth thirupthiyaanathinaaleayea ennaith theaduki'reerka'l en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

azhinthupoaki'ra poajanaththi'rkaaka alla, niththiyajeevanvaraikkum nilaini'rki'ra poajanaththi'rkaakavea kiriyai nadappiyungka'l; athai manushakumaaran ungka'lukkuk koduppaar; avaraip pithaavaakiya theavan muththiriththirukki'raar en'raar.
appozhuthu avarka'l avarai noakki: theavanukkeat'ra kiriyaika'lai nadappikkumpadi naangka'l enna seyyavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: avar anuppinavarai neengka'l visuvaasippathea theavanukkeat'ra kiriyaiyaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: appadiyaanaal ummai visuvaasikkumpadikku naangka'l kaa'naththakkathaaka neer enna adaiyaa'laththaik kaa'npikki'reer? ennaththai nadappikki'reer?
vaanaththilirunthu avarka'lukku appaththaip pusikkakkoduththaar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, nammudaiya pithaakka'l vanaantharaththil mannaavaip pusiththaarka'lea en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: vaanaththilirunthu vantha appaththai moasea ungka'lukkuk kodukkavillai; en pithaavoa vaanaththilirunthu vantha meyyaana appaththai ungka'lukkuk kodukki'raar en'ru, meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
vaanaththilirunthi'rangki, ulakaththukku jeevanaik kodukki'ra appamea theavan aru'liya appam en'raar.
appozhuthu avarka'l avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, intha appaththai eppozhuthum engka'lukkuth tharavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: jeeva appam naanea, ennidaththil varuki'ravan orukkaalum pasiyadaiyaan, ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan orukkaalum thaakamadaiyaan.
neengka'l ennaik ka'ndirunthum visuvaasiyaamalirukki'reerka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch sonnean.
pithaavaanavar enakkuk kodukki'ra yaavum ennidaththil varum; ennidaththil varuki'ravanai naan pu'rampea tha'l'luvathillai.
en siththaththinpadiyalla, ennai anuppinavarudaiya siththaththinpadi seyyavea naan vaanaththilirunthi'rangki vanthean.
avar enakkuth thanthavaika'lil on'raiyum naan izhanthupoakaamal, kadaisi naa'lil avaika'lai ezhuppuvathea ennai anuppina pithaavin siththamaayirukki'rathu.

kumaaranaik ka'ndu, avaridaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan evanoa, avan niththiyajeevanai adaivathum, naan avanaik kadaisinaa'lil ezhuppuvathum, ennai anuppinavarudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
naan vaanaththilirunthu vantha appam en'ru avar sonnathinimiththam yootharka'l avaraikku'riththu mu'rumu'ruththu:

ivan yoaseappin kumaaranaakiya iyeasu allavaa, ivanudaiya thakappanaiyum thaayaiyum a'rinthirukki'roamea; appadiyirukka, naan vaanaththilirunthi'rangki vanthean en'ru ivan eppadich solluki'raan en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ungka'lukku'l'lea mu'rumu'rukkavea'ndaam.
ennai anuppina pithaa oruvanai izhuththukko'l'laavittaal avan ennidaththil varamaattaan; kadaisinaa'lil naan avanai ezhuppuvean.

ellaarum theavanaalea poathikkappattiruppaarka'l en'ru theerkkatharisika'lin aakamaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathea; aakaiyaal pithaavinidaththil keattuk kat'rukko'l'luki'ravan evanum ennidaththil varuki'raan.
theavanidaththinin'ru vanthavarea thavira vea'roruvarum pithaavaik ka'ndathillai, ivarea pithaavaik ka'ndavar.
ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravanukku niththiyajeevan u'nden'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
jeeva appam naanea.
ungka'l pithaakka'l vanaantharaththilea mannaavaip pusiththirunthum mariththaarka'l.
ithilea pusikki'ravan mariyaamalirukkumpadi vaanaththilirunthi'rangkina appam ithuvea.
naanea vaanaththilirunthi'rangkina jeeva appam; intha appaththaip pusikki'ravan en'ren'raikkum pizhaippaan; naan kodukkum appam ulakaththin jeevanukkaaka naan kodukkum en maamsamea en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: ivan thannudaiya maamsaththai eppadi namakkup pusikkak koduppaan en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l.

atha'rku iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l manushakumaaranudaiya maamsaththaip pusiyaamalum, avarudaiya iraththaththaip paanampa'n'naamalum irunthaal ungka'lukku'l'lea jeevanillai en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
en maamsaththaip pusiththu, en iraththaththaip paanampa'n'nuki'ravanukku niththiyajeevan u'ndu; naan avanaik kadaisinaa'lil ezhuppuvean.
en maamsam meyyaana poajanamaayirukki'rathu, en iraththam meyyaana paanamaayirukki'rathu.
en maamsaththaip pusiththu, en iraththaththaip paanampa'n'nuki'ravan ennilea nilaiththirukki'raan, naanum avanilea nilaiththirukki'rean.
jeevanu'l'la pithaa ennai anuppinathupoalavum, naan pithaavinaal pizhaiththirukki'rathupoalavum, ennaip pusikki'ravanum ennaalea pizhaippaan.
vaanaththilirunthi'rangkina appam ithuvea; ithu ungka'l pithaakka'l pusiththa mannaavaippoalalla, avarka'l mariththaarka'lea; intha appaththaip pusikki'ravanoa en'ren'raikkum pizhaippaan en'raar.
kapparnakoomilu'l'la jepaaalayaththilea avar upatheasikkaiyil ivaika'laich sonnaar.
avarudaiya seesharil aneakar ivaika'laik keattapozhuthu, ithu kadinamaana upatheasam, yaar ithaik keadpaarka'l en'raarka'l.
seesharka'l athaikku'riththu mu'rumu'rukki'raarka'len'ru iyeasu thamakku'l'lea a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: ithu ungka'lukku ida'ralaayirukki'rathoa?
manushakumaaran thaam munniruntha idaththi'rku ea'rippoaki'rathai neengka'l kaa'npeerka'laanaal eppadiyirukkum?
aaviyea uyirppikki'rathu, maamsamaanathu on'rukkum uthavaathu; naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'ra vasanangka'l aaviyaayum jeevanaayum irukki'rathu.
aakilum ungka'lil visuvaasiyaathavarka'l silar u'ndu en'raar; visuvaasiyaathavarka'l innaaren'rum, thammaik kaattikkoduppavan innaanen'rum aathimuthalaaka iyeasu a'rinthirunthapadiyaal, avar pinnum:
oruvan en pithaavin aru'laip pe'raavittaal ennidaththi'rku varamaattaan en'ru ithinimiththamea ungka'lukkuch sonnean en'raar.
athumuthal avarudaiya seesharil aneakar avarudaneakooda nadavaamal pinvaangkippoanaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu panniruvaraiyum noakki: neengka'lum poayvida manathaayirukki'reerka'loa en'raar.
seemoan peathuru avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: aa'ndavarea, yaaridaththil poavoam, niththiyajeeva vasanangka'l ummidaththil u'ndea.
neer jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthu en'ru naangka'l visuvaasiththum a'rinthum irukki'roam en'raan.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: panniruvaraakiya ungka'lai naan therinthuko'l'lavillaiyaa? ungka'lukku'l'lum oruvan pisaasaayirukki'raan en'raar.
seemoanin kumaaranaakiya yoothaaskaariyoaththu panniruvariloruvanaayirunthum, thammaik kaattikkodukkap poaki'ravanaayirunthapadiyinaal avanaikku'riththu ippadich sonnaar.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, yootharka'l iyeasuvaik kolaiseyya vakaitheadinapadiyaal, avar yootheayaavilea sagncharikka manathillaamal kalileayaavilea sagnchariththuvanthaar.
yootharudaiya koodaarappa'ndikai sameepamaayirunthathu.
appozhuthu avarudaiya sakoatharar avarai noakki: neer seyki'ra kiriyaika'lai ummudaiya seesharka'lum paarkkumpadi, ivvidamvittu yootheayaavukkup poam.
pirapalamaayirukka virumpuki'ra evanum antharangkaththilea on'raiyum seyyamaattaan; neer ippadippattavaika'laich seythaal ulakaththukku ummai ve'lippaduththum en'raarka'l.
avarudaiya sakoathararum avarai visuvaasiyaathapadiyaal ippadich sonnaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: en vea'lai innum varavillai, ungka'l vea'laiyoa eppozhuthum aayaththamaayirukki'rathu.
ulakam ungka'laip pakaikkamaattaathu; athin kiriyaika'l pollaathavaika'laayirukki'rathen'ru naan saadchikodukki'rapadiyinaalea athu ennaip pakaikki'rathu.
neengka'l inthap pa'ndikaikkup poangka'l; en vea'lai innum varaathapadiyaal naan inthap pa'ndikaikku ippozhuthu poaki'rathillai en'raar.
ivaika'lai avarka'ludanea solli, pinnung kalileayaavilea thangkinaar.
avarudaiya sakoatharar poanapinpu, avar ve'liyarangkamaayp poakaamal antharangkamaayp pa'ndikaikkup poanaar.
pa'ndikaiyilea yootharka'l avaraith theadi: avar engkeayirukki'raar en'raarka'l.
janangka'lukku'l'lea avaraikku'riththu mu'rumu'ruppu'ndaayit'ru. silar: avar nallavar en'raarka'l. vea'rusilar: appadiyalla, avan janangka'lai vagnchikki'ravan en'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l.
aanaalum yootharukkup payanthirunthathinaalea, oruvanum avaraikku'riththuth thaaraa'lamaayp peasavillai.
paathippa'ndikaiyaanapoathu, iyeasu theavaalayaththukkuppoay, upatheasampa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: ivar kallaathavaraayirunthum veatha ezhuththukka'lai eppadi a'rinthirukki'raar en'ru aachchariyappattaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: en upatheasam ennudaiyathaayiraamal, ennai anuppinavarudaiyathaayirukki'rathu.
avarudaiya siththaththinpadi seyya manathu'l'lavanevanoa avan intha upatheasam theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathoa, naan suyamaayp peasuki'reanoa en'ru a'rinthuko'l'luvaan.
suyamaayp peasuki'ravan than suyamakimaiyaith theaduki'raan, thannai anuppinavarin makimaiyaith theaduki'ravanoa u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan, avanidaththil aneethiyillai.

moasea niyaayappiramaa'naththai ungka'lukkuk kodukkavillaiyaa? appadiyirunthum ungka'lil oruvanum antha niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi nadakki'rathillai; neengka'l ean ennaik kolaiseyyath theaduki'reerka'l en'raar.
janangka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: nee pisaasupidiththavan; unnaik kolaiseyyath theaduki'ravan yaar en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: orea kiriyaiyaich seythean, athaikku'riththu ellaarum aachchariyappaduki'reerka'l.
viruththaseathanam moaseayinaal u'ndaakaamal, pithaakka'laal u'ndaayit'ru; pinpu moasea athai ungka'lukku niyamiththaan; neengka'l oayvunaa'lilum manushanai viruththaseathanam pa'n'nuki'reerka'l.

moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'nam mee'rappadaathapadikku oayvunaa'lil manushan viruththaseathanam pe'ralaamen'raal, naan oayvunaa'lil oru manushanai muzhuvathum sukamaakkinathinaalea enmeal erichchalaayirukkalaamaa?
thoat'raththinpadi theerppuseyyaamal, neethiyinpadi theerppuseyyungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu erusaleam nakaraththaaril silar: ivanaiyallavaa kolaiseyyaththeaduki'raarka'l?
ithoa, ivan thaaraa'lamaayp peasuki'raanea, oruvarum ivanukku on'rum solluki'rathillaiyea, meyyaay ivan ki'risthuthaan en'ru athikaarika'l nichchayamaaka a'rinthirukki'raarka'loa?
ivan inna idaththilirunthu vanthavanen'ru naam a'rinthirukki'roam, ki'risthu varumpoathoa, avar inna idaththilirunthu varuki'ravaren'ru oruvanum a'riyamaattaanea en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu iyeasu theavaalayaththil upatheasikkaiyil saththamittu: neengka'l ennai a'riveerka'l, naan engkeayirunthu vantheanen'rum a'riveerka'l; naan ensuyamaay varavillai, ennai anuppinavar saththiyamu'l'lavar, avarai neengka'l a'riyaathirukki'reerka'l.
naan avaraal vanthirukki'rapadiyinaalum, avar ennai anuppiyirukki'rapadiyinaalum, naanea avarai a'rinthirukki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu avaraip pidikka vakaitheadinaarka'l; aanaalum avarudaiya vea'lai innum varaathapadiyinaal oruvanum avarmeal kaipoadavillai.
janangka'lil aneakar avarai visuvaasiththu: ki'risthu varumpoathu, ivar seyki'ra a'rputhangka'laippaarkkilum athikam seyvaaroa en'raarka'l.
janangka'l avaraikku'riththu ippadi mu'rumu'rukki'rathaip pariseayar keattapozhuthu, avaraip pidiththukko'ndu varumpadikkup pariseayarum pirathaana aasaariyarum seavakarai anuppinaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: innung kognchakkaalam naan ungka'ludaneakooda irunthu, pinpu ennai anuppinavaridaththi'rkup poaki'rean.
neengka'l ennaith theaduveerka'l, aanaalum ennaik kaa'namaatteerka'l; naan irukkum idaththi'rku neengka'l varavungkoodaathu en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: ivarai naam kaa'naathapadikku engkea poavaar, kireakkarukku'l'lea sitha'riyirukki'ravarka'lidaththi'rkup poay, kireakkarukku upatheasampa'n'nuvaaroa?

neengka'l ennaith theaduveerka'l, aanaalum ennaik kaa'namaatteerka'l en'rum, naan irukkum idaththukku neengka'l varakkoodaathu en'rum, ivar sonna vaarththaiyin karuththu ennaven'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarka'l.
pa'ndikaiyin kadaisinaa'laakiya pirathaana naa'lilea iyeasu nin'ru, saththamittu: oruvan thaakamaayirunthaal ennidaththil vanthu, paanampa'n'nakkadavan.
veathavaakkiyam solluki'rapadi ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan evanoa, avan u'l'laththilirunthu jeevaththa'n'neeru'l'la nathika'l oadum en'raar.
thammai visuvaasikki'ravarka'l adaiyappoaki'ra aaviyaikku'riththu ippadich sonnaar. iyeasu innum makimaippadaathirunthapadiyinaal parisuththaaavi innum aru'lappadavillai.
janangka'lil aneakar intha vasanaththaik keattapozhuthu: meyyaakavea ivar theerkkatharisiyaanavar en'raarka'l.
vea'rusilar: ivar ki'risthu en'raarka'l. vea'rusilar: ki'risthu kalileayaavilirunthaa varuvaar?
thaaveethin santhathiyilum, thaaveethu iruntha pethlekeam oorilumirunthu ki'risthu varuvaar en'ru veathavaakkiyam sollavillaiyaa en'raarka'l.
ivvithamaaka avaraikku'riththu janangka'lukku'l'lea pirivinaiyu'ndaayit'ru.
avarka'lil silar avaraip pidikka manathaayirunthaarka'l; aakilum oruvanum avarmeal kaipoadavillai.
pinpu anthach seavakar pirathaana aasaariyaridaththi'rkum pariseayaridaththi'rkum thirumpivanthaarka'l; ivarka'l avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l avanai ean ko'nduvaravillai en'ru keattaarka'l.
seavakar pirathiyuththaramaaka: antha manushan peasuki'rathupoala oruvanum orukkaalum peasinathillai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu pariseayar: neengka'lum vagnchikkappatteerka'laa?
athikaarika'lilaavathu pariseayarilaavathu yaathaamoruvar avanai visuvaasiththathu'ndaa?
veathaththai a'riyaathavarka'laakiya intha janangka'l sapikkappattavarka'l en'raarka'l.
iraaththiriyilea avaridaththi'rku vanthavanum avarka'liloruvanumaakiya nikkotheamu enpavan avarka'lai noakki:
oru manushan solvathaik keattu, avan seykaika'lai a'riki'ratha'rku munnea, avanai aakkinaikkudpaduththalaamen'ru nammudaiya niyaayappiramaa'nam solluki'rathaa en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: neerum kalileayanoa? kalileayaavilirunthu oru theerkkatharisiyum ezhumpuki'rathillai enpathai aaraaynthupaarum en'raarka'l.
pinpu avaravar thangka'l thangka'l veettukkup poanaarka'l.
iyeasu olivamalaikkup poanaar.
ma'runaa'l kaalaiyilea avar thirumpith theavaalayaththi'rku vanthapoathu, janangka'lellaarum avaridaththil vanthaarka'l. avar udkaarnthu avarka'lukku upatheasampa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu vipasaaraththilea ka'ndupidikkappatta oru sthireeyai veathapaarakarum pariseayarum avaridaththil ko'nduvanthu, ava'lai naduvea ni'ruththi:
poathakarea, intha sthiree vipasaaraththil kaiyum meyyumaayp pidikkappattaa'l.
ippadippattavarka'laik kalle'rinthu kollavea'ndumen'ru moasea niyaayappiramaa'naththil namakkuk katta'laiyittirukki'raarea, neer enna solluki'reer en'raarka'l.
avarmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvatha'rkaana kaara'nam u'ndaakumporuttu avaraich soathikkumpadi ippadich sonnaarka'l. iyeasuvoa kuninthu, viralinaal tharaiyilea ezhuthinaar.
avarka'l oayaamal avaraik keattukko'ndirukkaiyil, avar nimirnthu paarththu: ungka'lil paavamillaathavan iva'lmeal muthalaavathu kalle'riyakkadavan en'ru solli,
avar ma'rupadiyum kuninthu, tharaiyilea ezhuthinaar.

avarka'l athaik keattu, thangka'l manachsaadchiyinaal kadinthuko'l'lappattu, periyoarmuthal si'riyoarvaraikkum ovvoruvaraayp poayvittaarka'l. iyeasu thaniththirunthaar, antha sthiree naduvea nin'raa'l.
iyeasu nimirnthu antha sthireeyaith thavira vea'roruvaraiyung kaa'naamal: sthireeyea, unmeal kut'ragnsaattinavarka'l engkea? oruvanaakilum unnai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkavillaiyaa en'raar.
atha'rku ava'l: illai, aa'ndavarea, en'raa'l. iyeasu ava'lai noakki: naanum unnai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkki'rathillai; nee poa, inip paavagnseyyaathea en'raar.
ma'rupadiyum iyeasu janangka'lai noakki: naan ulakaththi'rku o'liyaayirukki'rean, ennaip pinpat'ruki'ravan iru'lilea nadavaamal jeevao'liyai adainthiruppaan en'raar.
appozhuthu pariseayar avarai noakki: unnaikku'riththu neeyea saadchi kodukki'raay; unnudaiya saadchi u'nmaiyaanathalla en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennaikku'riththu naanea saadchi koduththaalum, en saadchi u'nmaiyaayirukki'rathu; eanenil naan engkeayirunthu vantheanen'rum, engkea poaki'reanen'rum a'rinthirukki'rean; neengka'loa naan engkeayirunthu varuki'reanen'rum, engkea poaki'reanen'rum a'riyeerka'l.
neengka'l maamsaththukkeat'rapadi niyaayantheerkki'reerka'l, naan oruvanaiyum niyaayantheerkki'rathillai;
naan niyaayantheerththaal, en theerppu saththiyaththinpadiyirukkum; eanenil naan thaniththirukkavillai, naanum ennai anuppina pithaavumaaka irukki'roam.
ira'ndupearudaiya saadchi u'nmaiyen'ru ungka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththilum ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.
naan ennaikku'riththuch saadchi kodukki'ravanaayirukki'rean, ennai anuppina pithaavum ennaikku'riththuch saadchi kodukki'raar en'raar.

appozhuthu avarka'l: ummudaiya pithaa engkea en'raarka'l. iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennaiyum a'riyeerka'l, en pithaavaiyum a'riyeerka'l; neengka'l ennai a'rintheerka'laanaal en pithaavaiyum a'riveerka'l en'raar.
theavaalayaththilea iyeasu upatheasampa'n'nuki'rapoathu, tharumappettiyirukkum idaththil intha vasanangka'laich sonnaar. avarudaiya vea'lai innum varaathapadiyinaal oruvanum avaraip pidikkavillai.
iyeasu ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai noakki: naan poaki'rean, neengka'l ennaith theadi ungka'l paavangka'lilea saaveerka'l; naan poaki'ra idaththukku vara ungka'laal koodaathu en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: naan poaki'ra idaththukku vara ungka'laal koodaathu enki'raanea, thannaiththaan kolaiseythuko'lvaanoa en'ru peasikko'ndaarka'l.
avar avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l thaazhvilirunthu'ndaanavarka'l, naan uyarvilirunthu'ndaanavan; neengka'l intha ulakaththilirunthu'ndaanavarka'l, naan intha ulakaththilirunthu'ndaanavanalla.
aakaiyaal neengka'l ungka'l paavangka'lil saaveerka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch sonnean; naanea avar en'ru neengka'l visuvaasiyaavittaal ungka'l paavangka'lilea saaveerka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: neer yaar en'raarka'l. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: naan aathimuthalaay ungka'lukkuch solliyirukki'ravarthaan.
ungka'laikku'riththup peasavum niyaayantheerkkavum enakku aneaka kaariyangka'lu'ndu. ennai anuppinavar saththiyamu'l'lavar; naan avaridaththil keattavaika'laiyea ulakaththukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
pithaavaikku'riththup peasinaaren'ru avarka'l a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.

aathalaal iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l manushakumaaranai uyarththina pinpu, naanea avaren'rum, naan en suyamaay on'rum seyyaamal, en pithaa enakkup poathiththapadiyea ivaika'laich sonnean en'rum a'riveerka'l.
ennai anuppinavar ennudaneakooda irukki'raar, pithaavukkup piriyamaanavaika'lai naan eppozhuthum seyki'rapadiyaal avar ennaith thaniyea irukkavidavillai en'raar.
ivaika'lai avar sollukaiyil, aneakar avaridaththil visuvaasam vaiththaarka'l.
iyeasu thammai visuvaasiththa yootharka'lai noakki: neengka'l en upatheasaththil nilaiththirunthaal meyyaakavea en seesharaayiruppeerka'l;
saththiyaththaiyum a'riveerka'l, saththiyam ungka'lai viduthalaiyaakkum en'raar.

avarka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naangka'l aapirakaamin santhathiyaayirukki'roam, naangka'l orukkaalum oruvanukkum adimaika'laayirukkavillai; viduthalaiyaaveerka'len'ru neer eppadich solluki'reer en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: paavagnseyki'ravan evanum paavaththukku adimaiyaayirukki'raan en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
adimaiyaanavan en'raikkum veettilea nilaiththiraan; kumaaran en'raikkum nilaiththirukki'raar.
aakaiyaal kumaaran ungka'lai viduthalaiyaakkinaal meyyaakavea viduthalaiyaaveerka'l.
neengka'l aapirakaamin santhathiyaaren'ru a'rivean; aanaalum ungka'lukku'l'lea en upatheasam idampe'raathapadiyaal, ennaik kolaiseyyath theaduki'reerka'l.
naan en pithaavinidaththil ka'ndathaich solluki'rean, neengka'lum ungka'l pithaavinidaththil ka'ndathaich seyki'reerka'l en'raar.
atha'rku avarka'l: aapirakaamea engka'l pithaa en'raarka'l. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l aapirakaamin pi'l'laika'laayirunthaal aapirakaamin kiriyaika'laich seyveerka'lea.
theavanidaththil keattirukki'ra saththiyaththai ungka'lukkuch sonna manushanaakiya ennaik kollath theaduki'reerka'l, aapirakaam ippadich seyyavillaiyea.
neengka'l ungka'l pithaavin kiriyaika'laich seyki'reerka'l en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'l veasiththanaththinaal pi'ranthavarka'lalla; orea pithaa engka'lukku'ndu, avar theavan en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: theavan ungka'l pithaavaayirunthaal ennidaththil anpaayiruppeerka'l. eanenil naan theavanidaththilirunthu vanthirukki'rean; naan suyamaay varavillai, avarea ennai anuppinaar.
en vasanaththai neengka'l ean a'riyaamalirukki'reerka'l? en upatheasaththaik keadka manathillaathirukki'rathinaal allavaa?

neengka'l ungka'l pithaavaakiya pisaasaanavanaal u'ndaanavarka'l; ungka'l pithaavinudaiya ichchaika'linpadi seyya manathaayirukki'reerka'l; avan aathimutha'rko'ndu manushakolaipaathakanaayirukki'raan; saththiyam avanidaththilillaathapadiyaal avan saththiyaththilea nilaini'rkavillai; avan poyyanum poykkup pithaavumaayirukki'rapadiyaal avan poypeasumpoathu than sonthaththil eduththup peasuki'raan.
naan ungka'lukkuch saththiyaththaich solluki'rapadiyinaalea neengka'l ennai visuvaasikki'rathillai.
ennidaththil paavam u'nden'ru ungka'lil yaar ennaik kut'rappaduththakkoodum? naan saththiyaththaich solliyirukka, neengka'l ean ennai visuvaasikki'rathillai.
theavanaal u'ndaanavan theavanudaiya vasanangka'lukkuch sevikodukki'raan; neengka'l theavanaal u'ndaayiraathapadiyinaal sevikodaamalirukki'reerka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: unnaich samaariyanen'rum, pisaasupidiththavanen'rum naangka'l solluki'rathu sarithaanea en'raarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: naan pisaasu pidiththavanalla, naan en pithaavaik kanampa'n'nuki'rean, neengka'l ennaik kanaveenampa'n'nuki'reerka'l.
naan enakku makimaiyaith theaduki'rathillai; athaith theadi niyaayantheerkki'ravar oruvar irukki'raar.
oruvan en vaarththaiyaik kaikko'ndaal, avan en'ren'raikkum mara'naththaik kaa'npathillai en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.

appozhuthu yootharka'l avarai noakki: nee pisaasupidiththavanen'ru ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'roam; aapirakaamum theerkkatharisika'lum mariththaarka'l. neeyoa: oruvan en vaarththaiyaik kaikko'ndaal en'ren'raikkum mara'naththai rusipaarppathillai enki'raay.
engka'l pithaavaakiya aapirakaamilum nee periyavanoa? avar mariththaar, theerkkatharisika'lum mariththaarka'l; unnai nee eppadippattavanaakkuki'raay en'raarka'l.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: ennai naanea makimaippaduththinaal antha makimai vee'naayirukkum, en pithaa ennai makimaippaduththuki'ravar, avarai ungka'l theavanen'ru neengka'l solluki'reerka'l.

aayinum neengka'l avarai a'riyavillai, naan avarai a'rinthirukki'rean; avarai a'riyean en'ru solveanaakil ungka'laippoala naanum poyyanaayiruppean; avarai naan a'rinthu, avarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kaikko'ndirukki'rean.
ungka'l pithaavaakiya aapirakaam ennudaiya naa'laik kaa'na aasaiyaayirunthaan; ka'ndu ka'likoornthaan en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l avarai noakki: unakku innum aimpathu vayathaakavillaiyea, nee aapirakaamaik ka'ndaayoa en'raarka'l.
atha'rku iyeasu: aapirakaam u'ndaaki'ratha'rku munnamea naan irukki'rean en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
appozhuthu avarmeal e'riyumpadi kalluka'lai eduththukko'ndaarka'l. iyeasu ma'rainthu, avarka'l naduvea kadanthu, theavaalayaththai vittuppoanaar.
avar appu'ram poakaiyil pi'ravik kurudanaakiya oru manushanaik ka'ndaar.
appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharka'l avarai noakki: rapee, ivan kurudanaayp pi'ranthathu yaar seytha paavam, ivan seytha paavamoa, ivanaip pet'ravarka'l seytha paavamoa en'ru keattaarka'l.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: athu ivan seytha paavamumalla, ivanaip pet'ravarka'l seytha paavamumalla, theavanudaiya kiriyaika'l ivanidaththil ve'lippadumporuttu ippadip pi'ranthaan.
paka'rkaalamirukkumattum naan ennai anuppinavarudaiya kiriyaika'laich seyyavea'ndum; oruvanum kiriyai seyyakkoodaatha iraakkaalam varuki'rathu.
naan ulakaththilirukkaiyil ulakaththi'rku o'liyaayirukki'rean en'raar.
ivaika'laich solli, avar tharaiyilea thuppi, umizhneerinaal sea'ru'ndaakki, anthach seat'raik kurudanudaiya ka'nka'linmeal poosi:
nee poay, seeloavaam ku'laththilea kazhuvu en'raar. seeloavaam enpatha'rku anuppappattavan en'ru arththamaam. appadiyea avan poayk kazhuvi, paarvaiyadainthavanaayth thirumpivanthaan.
appozhuthu ayalakaththaarum, avan kurudanaayirukkaiyil avanaik ka'ndirunthavarka'lum: ivan udkaarnthu pichchai keattukko'ndirunthavanallavaa en'raarka'l.
silar: avanthaan en'raarka'l. vea'rusilar: avanudaiya saayalaayirukki'raan en'raarka'l. avanoa: naanthaan avan en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l avanai noakki: un ka'nka'l eppadith thi'rakkappattathu en'raarka'l.

avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: iyeasu ennappatta oruvar sea'ru'ndaakki, en ka'nka'linmeal poosi, nee poay seeloavaam ku'laththilea kazhuvu en'raar. appadiyea naan poayk kazhuvi, paarvaiyadainthean en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l: avar engkea en'raarka'l. avan: enakkuth theriyaathu en'raan.
kurudanaayiruntha avanaip pariseayaridaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l.
iyeasu sea'ru'ndaakki, avan ka'nka'laith thi'rantha naa'l oayvunaa'laayirunthathu.

aakaiyaal pariseayarum avanai noakki: nee eppadip paarvaiyadainthaay en'ru ma'rupadiyum keattaarka'l. atha'rku avan: avar en ka'nka'linmeal seat'raip poosinaar, naan kazhuvinean, kaa'nki'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu pariseayaril silar: antha manushan oayvunaa'laik kaikko'l'laathathinaal avan theavanidaththilirunthu vanthavanalla en'raarka'l. vea'rusilar: paaviyaayirukki'ra manushan ippadippatta a'rputhangka'lai eppadich seyvaan en'raarka'l. ivvithamaay avarka'lukku'l'lea pirivinaiyu'ndaayit'ru.
ma'rupadiyum avarka'l kurudanai noakki: un ka'nka'laith thi'ranthaanea, avanaikku'riththu nee enna solluki'raay en'raarka'l. atha'rku avan: avar theerkkatharisi en'raan.
avan kurudanaayirunthu paarvaiyadainthathai yootharka'l nampaamal, paarvaiyadainthavanudaiya thaaythakappanmaarai azhaippiththu,
avarka'lai noakki: ungka'l kumaaran kurudanaayp pi'ranthaan en'ru solluki'reerka'lea, avan ivanthaanaa? ivanaanaal, ippozhuthu ivan eppadip paarvaiyadainthaan en'ru keattaarka'l.
thaaythakappanmaar pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivan engka'l kumaaranthaan en'rum, kurudanaayp pi'ranthaan en'rum engka'lukkuth theriyum.

ippozhuthu ivan paarvaiyadaintha vakai engka'lukkuth theriyaathu; ivan ka'nka'laith thi'ranthavan innaan enpathum engka'lukkuth theriyaathu; ivan vayathu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan, ivanaik kea'lungka'l, ivanea solluvaan en'raarka'l.

avanudaiya thaaythakappanmaar yootharka'lukkup payanthathinaal ippadich sonnaarka'l. eanenil iyeasuvaik ki'risthu en'ru evanaavathu a'rikkaipa'n'ninaal avanai jepaaalayaththukkup pu'rampaakkavea'ndumen'ru yootharka'l atha'rkumunnamea kattuppaadu seythirunthaarka'l.
athinimiththam: ivan vayathu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan, ivanaiyea kea'lungka'l en'ru avan thaaythakappanmaar sonnaarka'l.
aathalaal avarka'l kurudanaayiruntha manushanai ira'ndaantharam azhaiththu: nee theavanai makimaippaduththu; intha manushan paaviyen'ru naangka'l a'rinthirukki'roam en'raarka'l.
avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: avar paaviyen'ru enakkuth theriyaathu; naan kurudanaayirunthean, ippozhuthu kaa'nki'rean; ithu on'ruthaan enakkuth theriyum en'raan.
avarka'l ma'rupadiyum avanai noakki: unakku ennaseythaan, un ka'nka'lai eppadith thi'ranthaan en'raarka'l.
