avan pirathiyuththaramaaka: munnamea ungka'lukkuch sonnean, neengka'l kea'laama'rpoaneerka'l; ma'rupadiyum keadka vea'ndiyathenna? avarukkuch seesharaaka ungka'lukkum manathu'ndoa en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l avanai vaithu: nee avanudaiya seeshan, naangka'l moaseayinudaiya seeshar.
moaseayudanea theavan peasinaaren'ru a'rivoam, ivan engkeayirunthu vanthavanen'ru a'riyoam en'raarka'l.
atha'rku antha manushan: avar en ka'nka'laith thi'ranthirunthum, avar engkeayirunthu vanthavaren'ru neengka'l a'riyaathirukki'rathu aachchariyamaana kaariyam.
paavika'lukkuth theavan sevikodukki'rathillaiyen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; oruvan theavapakthiyu'l'lavanaayirunthu avarukkuch siththamaanathaich seythaal avanukkuch sevikoduppaar.
pi'ravikkurudanudaiya ka'nka'lai oruvan thi'ranthaanen'ru ulakamu'ndaanathumuthal kea'lvippattathillaiyea.
avar theavanidaththilirunthu varaathirunthaal on'rum seyyamaattaarea en'raan.
avarka'l avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: muzhuvathum paavaththil pi'rantha nee engka'lukkup poathikki'raayoa en'ru solli, avanaip pu'rampea tha'l'livittaarka'l.
avanai avarka'l pu'rampea tha'l'livittathai iyeasu kea'lvippattu, avanaik ka'ndapoathu: nee theavanudaiya kumaaranidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'raayaa en'raar.
atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, avaridaththil naan visuvaasamaayirukkumpadikku avar yaar en'raan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: nee avaraik ka'ndirukki'raay, unnudanea peasuki'ravar avarthaan en'raar.
udanea avan: aa'ndavarea, visuvaasikki'rean en'ru solli, avaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu: kaa'naathavarka'l kaa'numpadiyaakavum, kaa'nki'ravarka'l kurudaraakumpadiyaakavum niyaayaththeerppukku naan intha ulakaththil vanthean en'raar.
avarudaneakooda iruntha pariseayaril silar ivaika'laik keattapozhuthu: naangka'lum kurudaroa en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l kurudaraayirunthaal ungka'lukkup paavamiraathu; neengka'l kaa'nki'roam en'ru solluki'rapadiyinaal ungka'l paavam nilaini'rki'rathu en'raar.
meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; aattuththozhuvaththukku'l vaasalvazhiyaayp piraveasiyaamal, vea'ruvazhiyaay ea'ruki'ravan ka'l'lanum ko'l'laikkaaranumaayirukki'raan.
vaasalvazhiyaayp piraveasikki'ravanoa aaduka'lin meayppanaayirukki'raan.

vaasalaik kaakki'ravan avanukkuth thi'rakki'raan; aaduka'lum avan saththaththukkuch sevikodukki'rathu. avan thannudaiya aaduka'laip pearsollik kooppittu, avaika'lai ve'liyea nadaththik ko'ndu poaki'raan.
avan thannudaiya aaduka'lai ve'liyea vittapinpu, avaika'lukku munpaaka nadanthupoaki'raan, aaduka'l avan saththaththai a'rinthirukki'rapadiyinaal avanukkup pinselluki'rathu.
anniyarudaiya saththaththai a'riyaathapadiyinaal avaika'l anniyanukkup pinsellaamal, avanai vittoadippoam en'raar.
intha uvamaiyai iyeasu avarka'ludanea sonnaar; avarka'loa avar sonnavaika'lin karuththai a'riyavillai.
aathalaal iyeasu ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai noakki: naanea aaduka'lukku vaasal en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
enakku munnea vanthavarka'lellaarum ka'l'larum ko'l'laikkaararumaayirukki'raarka'l; aaduka'l avarka'lukkuch sevikodukkavillai.
naanea vaasal, en vazhiyaay oruvan udpiraveasiththaal, avan iradchikkappaduvaan, avan u'l'lum pu'rampum sen'ru, meaychchalaik ka'ndadaivaan.
thirudan thirudavum kollavum azhikkavum varuki'raaneayan'ri vea'ron'rukkum varaan. naanoa avaika'lukku jeevan u'ndaayirukkavum, athu paripoora'nappadavum vanthean.
naanea nalla meayppan: nalla meayppan aaduka'lukkaakath than jeevanaik kodukki'raan.

meayppanaayiraathavanum, aaduka'l thanakkuch sonthamallaathavanumaana kooliyaa'l oanaay varuki'rathaik ka'ndu aaduka'lai vittu oadippoaki'raan; appozhuthu oanaay aaduka'laippee'ri, avaika'laich sitha'radikkum.
kooliyaa'l koolikkaaka vealaiseyki'ravanaakaiyaal oadippoaki'raan, aaduka'lukkaaka avan kavalaippadaan.
naanea nalla meayppan; pithaa ennai a'rinthirukki'rathupoalavum, naan pithaavai a'rinthirukki'rathupoalavum,
naan ennudaiyavaika'lai a'rinthum ennudaiyavaika'laal a'riyappattumirukki'rean; aaduka'lukkaaka en jeevanaiyum kodukki'rean.

inthath thozhuvaththilu'l'lavaika'lallaamal vea'rea aaduka'lum enakku u'ndu; avaika'laiyum naan ko'nduvaravea'ndum, avaika'l en saththaththukkuch sevikodukkum, appozhuthu orea manthaiyum orea meayppanumaakum.
naan en jeevanai ma'rupadiyum adainthuko'l'lumpadikku athaik kodukki'rapadiyinaal pithaa ennil anpaayirukki'raar.

oruvanum athai ennidaththilirunthu eduththukko'l'lamaattaan; naanea athaik kodukki'rean, athaik kodukkavum enakku athikaaram u'ndu, athai ma'rupadiyum eduththukko'l'lavum enakku athikaaram u'ndu. inthak katta'laiyai en pithaavinidaththil pet'rukko'ndean en'raar.
intha vasanangka'linimiththam yootharukku'l'lea ma'rupadiyum pirivinaiyu'ndaayit'ru.
avarka'lil aneakar: ivan pisaasupidiththavan, payiththiyakkaaran; ean ivanukkuch sevikodukki'reerka'l en'raarka'l.
vea'rea silar: ivaika'l pisaasupidiththavanudaiya vasanangka'lallavea. kurudarudaiya ka'nka'laip pisaasu thi'rakkakkoodumaa en'raarka'l.
pinpu erusaleamilea theavaalayap pirathishdaipa'ndikai vanthathu; maarikaalamumaayirunthathu.
iyeasu theavaalayaththil saalomoanudaiya ma'ndapaththilea ulaavikko'ndirunthaar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l avaraich soozhnthuko'ndu: ethuvaraikkum engka'l aaththumaavukkuch santheakam u'ndaakkuki'reer, neer ki'risthuvaanaal engka'lukkuth the'livaaych sollum en'raarka'l.

iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: athai ungka'lukkuch sonnean, neengka'l visuvaasikkavillai; en pithaavin naamaththinaalea naan seyki'ra kiriyaika'lea ennaikku'riththuch saadchikodukki'rathu.
aanaalum, naan ungka'lukkuch sonnapadiyea, neengka'l en manthaiyin aaduka'laayiraathapadiyinaal visuvaasiyaamalirukki'reerka'l.
en aaduka'l en saththaththi'rkuch sevikodukki'rathu; naan avaika'lai a'rinthirukki'rean, avaika'l enakkup pinselluki'rathu.
naan avaika'lukku niththiyajeevanaik kodukki'rean; avaika'l orukkaalum kettuppoavathillai, oruvanum avaika'lai en kaiyilirunthu pa'riththuk ko'lvathumillai.
avaika'lai enakkuth thantha en pithaa ellaarilum periyavaraayirukki'raar; avaika'lai en pithaavin kaiyilirunthu pa'riththukko'l'la oruvanaalum koodaathu.
naanum pithaavum on'raayirukki'roam en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l ma'rupadiyum avarmeal kalle'riyumpadi, kalluka'lai eduththukko'ndaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: naan en pithaavinaalea aneaka na'rkiriyaika'lai ungka'lukkuk kaa'npiththean, avaika'lil enthak kiriyaiyinimiththam enmeal kalle'riki'reerka'l en'raar.

yootharka'l avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: na'rkiriyaiyinimiththam naangka'l unmeal kalle'riki'rathillai; nee manushanaayirukka, unnaith theavan en'ru solli, ivvithamaakath theavathoosha'nagn solluki'rapadiyinaal unmeal kalle'riki'roam en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: theavarka'laayirukki'reerka'l en'ru naan sonnean enpathaay ungka'l veathaththil ezhuthiyirukkavillaiyaa?
theavavasanaththaip pet'rukko'ndavarka'laith theavarka'l en'ru avar solliyirukka, veathavaakkiyamum thava'raathathaayirukka,
pithaavinaal parisuththamaakkappattum, ulakaththil anuppappattum irukki'ra naan ennaith theavanudaiya kumaaran en'ru sonnathinaalea theavathoosha'nagn sonnaay en'ru neengka'l sollalaamaa?
en pithaavin kiriyaika'lai naan seyyaathirunthaal, neengka'l ennai visuvaasikkavea'ndiyathillai.
seytheaneayaanaal, neengka'l ennai visuvaasiyaathirunthaalum, pithaa ennilum naan avarilum irukki'rathai neengka'l a'rinthu visuvaasikkumpadi anthak kiriyaika'lai visuvaasiyungka'l en'raar.
ithinimiththam avarka'l ma'rupadiyum avaraip pidikkath theadinaarka'l, avaroa avarka'l kaikkuth thappi,
yoarthaanukku akkaraiyilea munnea yoavaan gnaanasnaanang koduththukko'ndiruntha idaththukkuth thirumpippoay, angkea thangkinaar.
aneakar avaridaththil vanthu: yoavaan oru a'rputhaththaiyum seyyavillai; aakilum ivaraikku'riththu yoavaan sonnathellaam meyyaayirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
avvidaththilea aneakar avaridaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l.
mariyaa'lum ava'l sakoathariyaakiya maarththaa'lum iruntha peththaaniyaa kiraamaththilu'l'lavanaakiya laasaru ennum oruvan viyaathippattirunthaan.
karththarukkup parima'lathailam poosi, than thalaimayiraal avarudaiya paathangka'laith thudaiththava'l antha mariyaa'lea; ava'ludaiya sakoatharanaakiya laasaru viyaathiyaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu avanudaiya sakoatharika'l: aa'ndavarea, neer sineakikki'ravan viyaathiyaayirukki'raan en'ru solla, avaridaththi'rku aa'l anuppinaarka'l.

iyeasu athaik keattapozhuthu: intha viyaathi mara'naththukku eathuvaayiraamal theavanudaiya makimai vi'langkuvatha'rku eathuvaayirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya kumaaranum athinaal makimaippaduvaar en'raar.
iyeasu maarththaa'lidaththilum ava'ludaiya sakoathariyinidaththilum laasaruvinidaththilum anpaayirunthaar.
avan viyaathiyaayirukki'rathaaka avar kea'lvippattapozhuthu, thaam iruntha idaththilea pinnum ira'ndunaa'l thangkinaar.
athanpinpu avar thammudaiya seesharai noakki: naam ma'rupadiyum yootheayaavukkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar.
atha'rkuch seesharka'l: rapee, ippozhuthuthaan yoothar ummaik kalle'riyath theadinaarka'lea, ma'rupadiyum neer avvidaththi'rkup poakalaamaa en'raarka'l.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: pakalukkup pannira'ndu ma'ninearam illaiyaa? oruvan pakalilea nadanthaal avan intha ulakaththin ve'lichchaththaik kaa'nki'rapadiyinaal ida'ramaattaan.
oruvan iravilea nadanthaal thannidaththil ve'lichcham illaathapadiyinaal ida'ruvaan en'raar.
ivaika'lai avar solliyapinpu avarka'lai noakki: nammudaiya sineakithanaakiya laasaru niththiraiyadainthirukki'raan, naan avanai ezhuppappoaki'rean en'raar.
atha'rku avarudaiya seesharka'l: aa'ndavarea, niththiraiyadainthirunthaal sukamadaivaan en'raarka'l.
iyeasuvaanavar avanudaiya mara'naththaikku'riththu appadich sonnaar; avarka'loa niththiraiseythu i'laippaa'ruki'rathaikku'riththuch sonnaaren'ru ninaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: laasaru mariththuppoanaan en'ru ve'lippadaiyaaych solli;
naan angkea iraathathinaal neengka'l visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laaki'ratha'rku eathuvu'nden'ru ungka'lnimiththam santhoashappaduki'rean; ippozhuthu avanidaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu thithimu ennappatta thoamaa mat'rach seesharka'lai noakki: avaroadeakooda marikkumpadi naamum poavoam vaarungka'l en'raan.
iyeasu vanthapoathu avan kalla'raiyil vaikkappattu naalunaa'laayit'ren'ru ka'ndaar.
peththaaniyaa oor erusaleamukkuch sameepamaay ea'rakku'raiya ira'ndumail thooraththilirunthathu.
yootharil aneakar maarththaa'l mariyaa'l enpavarka'ludaiya sakoatharanaik ku'riththu avarka'lukku aa'ruthal sollumpadi avarka'lidaththil vanthirunthaarka'l.
iyeasu varuki'raar en'ru maarththaa'l kea'lvippattapoathu, avarukku ethirko'ndupoanaa'l; mariyaa'loa veettilea udkaarnthirunthaa'l.
maarththaa'l iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu: aa'ndavarea, neer ingkeayiruntheeraanaal en sakoatharan marikkamaattaan.
ippozhuthum neer theavanidaththil keattukko'l'luvathethuvoa athaith theavan umakkuth thantharu'luvaaren'ru a'rinthirukki'rean en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: un sakoatharan uyirththezhunthiruppaan en'raar.
atha'rku maarththaa'l: uyirththezhuthal nadakkum kadaisinaa'lilea avanum uyirththezhunthiruppaan en'ru a'rinthirukki'rean en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: naanea uyirththezhuthalum jeevanumaayirukki'rean, ennai visuvaasikki'ravan mariththaalum pizhaippaan;
uyiroadirunthu ennai visuvaasikki'ravanevanum en'ren'raikkum mariyaamalum iruppaan; ithai visuvaasikki'raayaa en'raar.
atha'rku ava'l: aam, aa'ndavarea, neer ulakaththil varuki'ravaraana theavakumaaranaakiya ki'risthu en'ru naan visuvaasikki'rean en'raa'l.
ivaika'laich sonnapinpu, ava'lpoay, than sakoathariyaakiya mariyaa'lai irakasiyamaay azhaiththu: poathakar vanthirukki'raar, unnai azhaikki'raar en'raa'l.
ava'l athaik keattavudanea, seekkiramaay ezhunthu, avaridaththil vanthaa'l.
iyeasu innum kiraamaththukku'l varaamal, maarththaa'l thammaich santhiththa idaththilea irunthaar.

appozhuthu, veettilea ava'ludaneakooda irunthu ava'lukku aa'ruthal sollikko'ndiruntha yootharka'l, mariyaa'l seekkiramaay ezhunthupoaki'rathaik ka'ndu: ava'l kalla'raiyinidaththil azhuki'ratha'rkup poaki'raa'l en'ru solli, ava'lukkup pinnea poanaarka'l.
iyeasu iruntha idaththil mariyaa'l vanthu, avaraik ka'ndavudanea, avar paathaththil vizhunthu: aa'ndavarea, neer ingkea iruntheeraanaal en sakoatharan marikkamaattaan en'raa'l.
ava'l azhuki'rathaiyum ava'loadeakooda vantha yootharka'l azhuki'rathaiyum iyeasu ka'ndapoathu aaviyilea kalangkith thuyaramadainthu:
avanai engkea vaiththeerka'l en'raar. aa'ndavarea, vanthu paarum en'raarka'l.
iyeasu ka'n'neer vittaar.
appozhuthu yootharka'l: ithoa, ivar avanai evva'lavaaych sineakiththaar en'raarka'l!
avarka'lil silar: kurudanudaiya ka'nka'laith thi'rantha ivar, ivanaich saakaamalirukkappa'n'navum koodaathaa en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu ma'rupadiyum thamakku'l'lea kalangkik kalla'raiyinidaththi'rku vanthaar. athu oru kukaiyaayirunthathu; athinmeal oru kal vaikkappattirunthathu.
iyeasu: kallai eduththuppoadungka'l en'raar. mariththavanudaiya sakoathariyaakiya maarththaa'l avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, ippozhuthu naa'rumea, naalunaa'laayit'rea en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: nee visuvaasiththaal theavanudaiya makimaiyaik kaa'npaay en'ru naan unakkuch sollavillaiyaa en'raar.

appozhuthu mariththavan vaikkappatta idaththiliruntha kallai eduththuppoattaarka'l. iyeasu thammudaiya ka'nka'lai ea'reduththu: pithaavea, neer enakkuch sevikoduththapadiyinaal ummai sthoaththirikki'rean.

neer eppozhuthum enakkuch sevikodukki'reer en'ru naan a'rinthirukki'rean; aanaalum neer ennai anuppinathaich soozhnthuni'rkum janangka'l visuvaasikkumpadiyaaka avarka'l nimiththam ithaich sonnean en'raar.
ivaika'laich sonnapinpu: laasaruvea, ve'liyea vaa en'ru, uraththa saththamaayk kooppittaar.

appozhuthu, mariththavan ve'liyea vanthaan. avan kaalka'lum kaika'lum pireathach seelaika'linaal kattappattirunthathu, avan mukamum seelaiyaal sut'rappattirunthathu. iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: ivanaik kattavizhththuvidungka'l en'raar.
appozhuthu mariyaa'lidaththil vanthirunthu, iyeasu seythavaika'laik ka'ndavarka'laakiya yootharka'lil aneakar avaridaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l.
avarka'lil silar pariseayaridaththil poay, iyeasu seythavaika'lai avarka'lukku a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyarum pariseayarum aaloasanaich sangkaththaik koodivarachseythu, naam ennaseyki'rathu? intha manushan aneaka a'rputhangka'laich seyki'raanea.
naam ivanai ippadi vittuvittaal, ellaarum ivanai visuvaasippaarka'l; appozhuthu roamar vanthu nammudaiya sthaanaththaiyum janaththaiyum azhiththup poaduvaarka'lea en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'lil oruvanum antha varushaththup pirathaana aasaariyanumaakiya kaaypaa enpavan avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lukku on'run theriyaathu;
janangka'lellaarum kettuppoakaathapadikku orea manushan janangka'lukkaaka marippathu namakku nalamaayirukkumen'ru neengka'l sinthiyaamalirukki'reerka'l en'raan.
ithai avan suyamaaych sollaamal, antha varushaththup pirathaana aasaariyanaanapadiyinaalea iyeasu yoothajanangka'lukkaaka marikkappoaki'raaren'rum,
antha janangka'lukkaakamaaththiramalla, sitha'riyirukki'ra theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'lai on'raakach searkki'ratha'rkaakavum marikkappoaki'raaren'rum, theerkkatharisanamaaych sonnaan.
annaa'lmuthal avaraik kolaiseyyumpadikku aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.

aakaiyaal iyeasu athanpinpu ve'liyarangkamaay yootharukku'l'lea sagnchariyaamal, avvidamvittu vanaantharaththukkuch sameepamaana idamaakiya eppiraayeem ennappatta oorukkuppoay, angkea thammudaiya seesharudaneakoodath thangkiyirunthaar.
yootharudaiya paskaapa'ndikai sameepamaayirunthathu. atha'rku munnea aneakar thangka'laich suththikariththukko'l'lumporuttu naattilirunthu erusaleamukkup poanaarka'l.
angkea avarka'l iyeasuvaith theadikko'ndu theavaalayaththil ni'rkaiyil, oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: ungka'luk keppadith thoan'ruki'rathu, avar pa'ndikaikku varamaattaaroa en'ru peasikko'ndaarka'l.
pirathaana aasaariyarum pariseayarum avaraip pidikkumpadi yoasiththu, avar irukki'ra idaththai evanaavathu a'rinthirunthaal, athai a'rivikkavea'ndumen'ru katta'laiyittirunthaarka'l.
paskaapa'ndikai vara aa'runaa'laikku munnea iyeasu thaam mara'naththilirunthu ezhuppina laasaru iruntha peththaaniyaavukku vanthaar.
angkea avarukku iraavirunthu pa'n'ninaarka'l; maarththaa'l pa'nividai seythaa'l; laasaruvum avarudaneakoodap panthiyirunthavarka'lil oruvanaayirunthaan.

appozhuthu mariyaa'l vilaiyea'rappet'ra ka'langkamillaatha na'latham ennum thailaththil oru iraaththal ko'nduvanthu, athai iyeasuvin paathangka'lil poosi, than thalaimayiraal avarudaiya paathangka'laith thudaiththaa'l; antha veedu muzhuvathum thailaththin parima'laththinaal ni'rainthathu.
appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharil oruvanum avaraik kaattikkodukkap poaki'ravanumaakiya seemoanudaiya kumaaranaana yoothaaskaariyoaththu:
inthath thailaththai munnoo'ru pa'naththukku vit'ru, thariththirarukkuk kodaamal poanathenna en'raan.

avan thariththiraraikku'riththuk kavalaippattu ippadich sollaamal, avan thirudanaanapadiyinaalum, pa'nappaiyai vaiththukko'ndu athilea poadappattathaich sumakki'ravanaanapadiyinaalum ippadich sonnaan.
appozhuthu iyeasu: iva'lai vittuvidu, ennai adakkampa'n'num naa'lukkaaka ithai vaiththirunthaa'l.
thariththirar eppozhuthum ungka'lidaththil irukki'raarka'l; naan eppozhuthum ungka'lidaththil irean en'raar.
appozhuthu yootharil thira'laana janangka'l avar angkeayirukki'rathai a'rinthu, iyeasuvinimiththamaakamaaththiram alla, avar mariththoarilirunthezhuppina laasaruvaik kaa'numpadiyaakavum vanthaarka'l.
laasaruvinimiththamaaka yootharka'lil aneakar poay, iyeasuvinidaththil visuvaasam vaiththapadiyaal,
pirathaana aasaariyarka'l laasaruvaiyum kolaiseyya aaloasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.
ma'runaa'lilea iyeasu erusaleamukku varuki'raaren'ru pa'ndikaikku vantha thira'laana janangka'l kea'lvippattu,

kuruththoalaika'laip pidiththukko'ndu, avarukku ethirko'ndupoakumpadi pu'rappattu: oasannaa, karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea varuki'ra isravealin raajaa sthoaththirikkappattavar en'ru aarppariththaarka'l.
allaamalum: seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, payappadaathea, un raajaa kazhuthaikkuttiyinmeal ea'rivaruki'raar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapirakaaramaaka,
iyeasu oru kazhuthaikkuttiyaik ka'ndu athinmeal ea'rippoanaar.

ivaika'lai avarudaiya seesharka'l thuvakkaththilea a'riyavillai. iyeasu makimaiyadaintha pinpu, ippadi avaraik ku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rathaiyum, thaangka'l ippadi avarukkuch seythathaiyum ninaivukoornthaarka'l.
an'riyum avarudaneakooda iruntha janangka'l avar laasaruvaik kalla'raiyilirunthu ve'liyea varavazhaiththu, avanai uyiroadea ezhuppinaaren'ru saadchikoduththaarka'l.
appadippatta a'rputhaththai avar seythaar en'ru janangka'l kea'lvippattathinaal avarka'l avarukku ethirko'ndu poanaarka'l.
appozhuthu pariseayar oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: neengka'l seyki'rathellaam vee'nen'ru a'riki'rathillaiyaa? ithoa, ulakamea avanukkup pinsen'ru poayit'rea en'raarka'l.
pa'ndikaiyil aaraathanai seyyavanthavarka'lil sila kireakkar irunthaarka'l.
avarka'l kalileayaanaattup pethsaayithaa ooraanaakiya pilippuvinidaththil vanthu: aiyaa, iyeasuvaik kaa'na virumpuki'roam en'ru avanaik keattukko'ndaarka'l.
pilippu vanthu, athai anthireayaavukku a'riviththaan; pinpu anthireayaavum pilippuvum athai iyeasuvukku a'riviththaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: manushakumaaran makimaippadumpadiyaana vea'lai vanthathu.
meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean, koathumai ma'niyaanathu nilaththil vizhunthu saakaavittaal thaniththirukkum, seththatheayaakil mikuntha palanaikkodukkum.
than jeevanaich sineakikki'ravan athai izhanthupoavaan; intha ulakaththil than jeevanai ve'rukki'ravanoa athai niththiya jeevakaalamaayk kaaththukko'l'luvaan.

oruvan enakku oozhiyagnseyki'ravanaanaal ennaip pinpat'rakkadavan, naan engkea irukki'reanoa angkea en oozhiyakkaaranum iruppaan; oruvan enakku oozhiyagnseythaal avanaip pithaavaanavar kanampa'n'nuvaar.
ippozhuthu en aaththumaa kalangkuki'rathu, naan enna solluvean. pithaavea, intha vea'laiyinin'ru ennai iradchiyum en'ru solveanoa; aakilum, itha'rkaakavea intha vea'laikku'l vanthean.
pithaavea, umathu naamaththai makimaippaduththum en'raar. appozhuthu: makimaippaduththinean, innamum makimaippaduththuvean enki'ra saththam vaanaththilirunthu u'ndaayit'ru.
angkea nin'ruko'ndirunthu, athaik keatta janangka'l: idimuzhakkamu'ndaayit'ru en'raarka'l. vea'rusilar: theavathoothan avarudanea peasinaan en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: inthach saththam ennimiththam u'ndaakaamal ungka'l nimiththamea u'ndaayit'ru.
ippozhuthea intha ulakaththukku niyaayaththeerppu u'ndaaki'rathu; ippozhuthea intha ulakaththin athipathi pu'rampaakath tha'l'lappaduvaan.
naan poomiyilirunthu uyarththappattirukkumpoathu, ellaaraiyum ennidaththil izhuththukko'l'luvean en'raar.
thaam innavithamaana mara'namaay marikkappoaki'raarenpathaik ku'rikkumpadi ippadich sonnaar.

janangka'l avarai noakki: ki'risthu en'ren'raikkum irukki'raar en'ru veathaththil solliyathai naangka'l keattirukki'roam, appadiyirukka manushakumaaran uyarththappadavea'ndiyathen'ru eppadich solluki'reer; intha manushakumaaran yaar en'raarka'l.

atha'rku iyeasu: innum kognchakkaalam o'li ungka'lidaththil irukkum; iru'lil neengka'l akappadaathapadikku o'li ungka'loadirukkaiyil nadavungka'l; iru'lil nadakki'ravan thaan poaki'ra idam innathen'ru a'riyaan.
o'li ungka'loadirukkaiyil neengka'l o'liyin pi'l'laika'laakumpadikku, o'liyinidaththil visuvaasamaayirungka'l en'raar. ivaika'lai iyeasu solli, avarka'lai vittu ma'rainthaar.
avar iththanai a'rputhangka'lai avarka'lukku munpaakach seythirunthum, avarka'l avarai visuvaasikkavillai.

karththaavea, engka'l moolamaayk kea'lvippattathai visuvaasiththavan yaar? karththarudaiya puyam yaarukku ve'lippattathu en'ru easaayaa theerkkatharisi sonna vasanam ni'raivea'rumpadi ippadi nadanthathu.
aakaiyaal avarka'l visuvaasikkamaattaamalpoanaarka'l. eanenil easaayaa pinnum:

avarka'l ka'nka'linaal kaa'naamalum, iruthayaththinaal u'naraamalum, ku'nappadaamalum irukkumpadikkum, naan avarka'lai aaroakkiyamaakkaamal irukkumpadikkum, avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'lai avar kurudaakki, avarka'l iruthayaththaik kadinamaakkinaar en'raan.
easaayaa avarudaiya makimaiyaikka'ndu, avaraikku'riththup peasuki'rapoathu ivaika'laich sonnaan.
aakilum athikaarika'lilum aneakar avaridaththil visuvaasam vaiththaarka'l. appadiyirunthum jepaaalayaththukkup pu'rampaakkappadaathapadi, pariseayarnimiththam athai a'rikkaipa'n'naathirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l theavanaal varuki'ra makimaiyilum manusharaal varuki'ra makimaiyai athikamaay virumpinaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu saththamittu: ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan ennidaththil alla, ennai anuppinavaridaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'raan.
ennaik kaa'nki'ravan ennai anuppinavaraik kaa'nki'raan.
ennidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravanevanum iru'lil iraathapadikku, naan ulakaththil o'liyaaka vanthean.
oruvan en vaarththaika'laik keattum visuvaasiyaama'rpoanaal, avanai naan niyaayantheerppathillai; naan ulakaththai niyaayantheerkkavaraamal, ulakaththai iradchikkavanthean.
ennaith tha'l'li en vaarththaika'lai eat'rukko'l'laathavanai niyaayantheerkki'rathon'rirukki'rathu; naan sonna vasanamea avanaik kadaisinaa'lil niyaayantheerkkum.
naan suyamaayp peasavillai, naan peasavea'ndiyathu innathen'rum upatheasikkavea'ndiyathu innathen'rum ennai anuppina pithaavea enakkuk katta'laiyittaar.
avarudaiya katta'lai niththiya jeevanaayirukki'rathen'ru a'rivean; aakaiyaal naan peasuki'ravaika'laip pithaa enakkuch sonnapadiyea peasuki'rean en'raar.

paskaa pa'ndikaikku munnea, iyeasu ivvulakaththaivittup pithaavinidaththi'rkup poakumpadiyaana thammudaiya vea'lai vanthathen'ru a'rinthu, thaam ivvulakaththilirukki'ra thammudaiyavarka'lidaththil anpuvaiththapadiyea, mudivupariyanthamum avarka'lidaththil anpuvaiththaar.
seemoanin kumaaranaakiya yoothaaskaariyoaththu avaraik kaattikkodukkumpadi pisaasaanavan avan iruthayaththaith thoo'ndinapinpu, avarka'l poajanam pa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil;
thammudaiya kaiyil pithaa ellaavat'raiyum oppukkoduththaarenpathaiyum, thaam theavanidaththilirunthu vanthathaiyum, theavanidaththi'rkup poaki'rathaiyum iyeasu a'rinthu;
poajanaththai vittezhunthu, vasthirangka'laik kazhat'rivaiththu, oru seelaiyai eduththu, araiyilea kattikko'ndu,
pinpu paaththiraththil tha'n'neer vaarththu, seesharudaiya kaalka'laik kazhuvavum, thaam kattikko'ndiruntha seelaiyinaal thudaikkavum thodangkinaar.
avar seemoan peathuruvinidaththil vanthapoathu, avan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer en kaalka'laik kazhuvalaamaa en'raan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan seyki'rathu innathen'ru ippozhuthu nee a'riyaay, inimeal a'rivaay en'raar.
peathuru avarai noakki: neer orukkaalum en kaalka'laik kazhuvappadaathu en'raan. iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan unnaik kazhuvaavittaal ennidaththil unakkup pangkillai en'raar.
atha'rkuch seemoan peathuru: aa'ndavarea, en kaalka'laimaaththiramalla, en kaika'laiyum en thalaiyaiyumkoodak kazhuvavea'ndum en'raan.

iyeasu avanai noakki: muzhukinavan than kaalka'laimaaththiram kazhuvavea'ndiyathaayirukkum, mat'rappadi avan muzhuvathum suththamaayirukki'raan; neengka'lum suththamaayirukki'reerka'l; aakilum ellaarum alla en'raar.
thammaik kaattikkodukki'ravanai avar a'rinthirunthapadiyinaal neengka'lellaarum suththamu'l'lavarka'l alla en'raar.
avarka'ludaiya kaalka'lai avar kazhuvinapinpu, thammudaiya vasthirangka'laith thariththukko'ndu, thirumpa udkaarnthu, avarka'lai noakki: naan ungka'lukkuch seythathai a'rinthirukki'reerka'laa?
neengka'l ennaip poathakaren'rum, aa'ndavaren'rum solluki'reerka'l, neengka'l solluki'rathu sariyea, naan avarthaan.
aa'ndavarum poathakarumaakiya naanea ungka'l kaalka'laik kazhuvinathu'ndaanaal, neengka'lum oruvarudaiya kaalka'lai oruvar kazhuvakkadaveerka'l.
naan ungka'lukkuch seythathupoala neengka'lum seyyumpadi ungka'lukku maathiriyaik kaa'npiththean.
meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean, oozhiyakkaaran than ejamaanilum periyavanalla, anuppappattavan thannai anuppinavarilum periyavanalla.
neengka'l ivaika'lai a'rinthirukki'rapadiyinaal, ivaika'laich seyveerka'laanaal, paakkiyavaanka'laayiruppeerka'l.

ungka'lellaaraiyungku'riththu naan peasavillai, naan therinthuko'ndavarka'lai a'rivean; aakilum veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'raththakkathaaka, ennudanea appam pusikki'ravan enmeal than kuthikaalaith thookkinaan.
athu nadakkumpoathu naanea avaren'ru neengka'l visuvaasikkumporuttu, ippozhuthu athu nadappatha'rku munnamea athai ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

naan anuppuki'ravanai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan, ennai eat'rukko'l'luki'ravan ennai anuppinavarai eat'rukko'l'luki'raan en'ru, meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
iyeasu ivaika'laich sonnapinpu, aaviyilea kalangki: ungka'lil oruvan ennaik kaattikkoduppaan en'ru, meyyaakavea meyyaakavea ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean en'ru saadchiyaakach sonnaar.
appozhuthu yaaraikku'riththup peasuki'raaroa en'ru seesharka'l aiyappattu, oruvaraiyoruvar noakkippaarththaarka'l.
anthach samayaththil avarudaiya seesharil iyeasuvukku anpaanavanaayiruntha oruvan iyeasuvin maarpilea saaynthuko'ndirunthaan.
yaaraikku'riththuch solluki'raaren'ru visaarikkumpadi seemoanpeathuru avanukkuch saikaikaattinaan.
appozhuthu avan iyeasuvin maarpilea saaynthuko'ndu: aa'ndavarea, avan yaar en'raan.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan inthath thu'nikkaiyaith thoayththu evanukkuk koduppeanoa, avanthaan en'ru solli, thu'nikkaiyaith thoayththu, seemoan kumaaranaakiya yoothaaskaariyoaththukkuk koduththaar.
anthath thu'nikkaiyai avan vaangkinapinpu, saaththaan avanukku'l pukunthaan. appozhuthu iyeasu avanai noakki: nee seyki'rathaich seekkiramaaych sey en'raar.
avar ippadi avanudanea sonnathin karuththaip panthiyirunthavarka'lil oruvanum a'riyavillai.

yoothaas pa'nappaiyai vaiththuk ko'ndirunthapadiyinaal, avan poay, pa'ndikaikkuth theavaiyaanavaika'laik ko'l'lumpadikkaavathu, thariththirarukku eathaakilum kodukkumpadikkaavathu, iyeasu avanudanea solliyiruppaar en'ru silar ninaiththaarka'l.
avan anthath thu'nikkaiyai vaangkinavudanea pu'rappattuppoanaan; appozhuthu iraakkaalamaayirunthathu.
avan pu'rappattuppoanapinpu iyeasu: ippozhuthu manushakumaaran makimaippaduki'raar, theavanum avaril makimaippaduki'raar.
theavan avaril makimaippattirunthaal, theavan avaraith thammil makimaippaduththuvaar, seekkiramaay avarai makimaippaduththuvaar.

pi'l'laika'lea, innum kognchakkaalam naan ungka'ludaneakooda iruppean; neengka'l ennaith theaduveerka'l; aanaalum naan poaki'ra idaththukku neengka'l varakkoodaathen'ru naan yootharoadea sonnathupoala ippozhuthu ungka'loadum solluki'rean.
neengka'l oruvariloruvar anpaayirungka'l; naan ungka'lil anpaayirunthathupoala neengka'lum oruvariloruvar anpaayirungka'l enki'ra puthithaana katta'laiyai ungka'lukkuk kodukki'rean.
neengka'l oruvariloruvar anpu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaal, athinaal neengka'l ennudaiya seesharka'len'ru ellaarum a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l en'raar.

seemoanpeathuru avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer engkea poaki'reer en'raan. iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan poaki'ra idaththukku ippozhuthu nee en pinnea varakkoodaathu, pi'rpaadu en pinnea varuvaay en'raar.
peathuru avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, naan ippozhuthu umakkup pinnea ean varakkoodaathu? umakkaaka en jeevanaiyum koduppean en'raan.

iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: enakkaaka un jeevanaik koduppaayoa? seaval koovuki'ratha'rku munnea nee ennai moon'rutharam ma'ruthalippaayen'ru, meyyaakavea meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
ungka'l iruthayam kalangkaathiruppathaaka; theavanidaththil visuvaasamaayirungka'l, ennidaththilum visuvaasamaayirungka'l.
en pithaavin veettil aneaka vaasasthalangka'l u'ndu; appadiyillaathirunthaal, naan ungka'lukkuch solliyiruppean; oru sthalaththai ungka'lukkaaka aayaththampa'n'nappoaki'rean.
naan poay ungka'lukkaaka sthalaththai aayaththampa'n'ninapinpu, naan irukki'ra idaththilea neengka'lum irukkumpadi, naan ma'rupadiyum vanthu ungka'lai ennidaththil searththukko'l'luvean.
naan poaki'ra idaththai a'rinthirukki'reerka'l, vazhiyaiyum a'rinthirukki'reerka'l en'raar.
thoamaa avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer poaki'ra idaththai a'riyoamea, vazhiyai naangka'l eppadi a'rivoam en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: naanea vazhiyum saththiyamum jeevanumaayirukki'rean; ennaaleayallaamal oruvanum pithaavinidaththil varaan.
ennai a'rintheerka'laanaal en pithaavaiyum a'rinthiruppeerka'l; ithumuthal neengka'l avarai a'rinthum avaraik ka'ndum irukki'reerka'l en'raar.
pilippu avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, pithaavai engka'lukkuk kaa'npiyum, athu engka'lukkup poathum en'raan.

atha'rku iyeasu: pilippuvea, ivva'lavukaalam naan ungka'ludaneakooda irunthum nee ennai a'riyavillaiyaa? ennaik ka'ndavan pithaavaik ka'ndaan; appadiyirukka, pithaavai engka'lukkuk kaa'npiyum en'ru nee eppadich solluki'raay?

naan pithaavilum, pithaa ennilum irukki'rathai nee visuvaasikki'rathillaiyaa? naan ungka'ludanea solluki'ra vasanangka'lai en suyamaaych sollavillai; ennidaththil vaasamaayirukki'ra pithaavaanavarea inthak kiriyaika'laich seythuvaruki'raar.
naan pithaavilum pithaa ennilum irukki'rathai nampungka'l; appadiyillaavittaalum en kiriyaika'linimiththamaavathu ennai nampungka'l.

meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean; naan en pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'rapadiyinaal, ennai visuvaasikki'ravan naan seyki'ra kiriyaika'laith thaanum seyvaan, ivaika'laippaarkkilum periya kiriyaika'laiyum seyvaan.
neengka'l en naamaththinaalea ethaik keadpeerka'loa, kumaaranil pithaa makimaippadumpadiyaaka, athaich seyvean.
en naamaththinaalea neengka'l ethaik keattaalum athai naan seyvean.
neengka'l ennidaththil anpaayirunthaal en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'lungka'l.
naan pithaavai vea'ndikko'l'luvean, appozhuthu en'ren'raikkum ungka'ludaneakooda irukkumpadikkuch saththiya aaviyaakiya vea'roru theat'raravaa'lanai avar ungka'lukkuth thantharu'luvaar.

ulakam anthach saththiya aaviyaanavaraik kaa'naamalum a'riyaamalum irukki'rapadiyaal avaraip pet'rukko'l'lamaattaathu; avar ungka'ludanea vaasampa'n'ni ungka'lukku'l'lea iruppathaal, neengka'l avarai a'riveerka'l.
naan ungka'laith thikkat'ravarka'laaka videan, ungka'lidaththil varuvean.
innum kognchakkaalaththilea ulakam ennaik kaa'naathu, neengka'loa ennaik kaa'npeerka'l; naan pizhaikki'rapadiyinaal neengka'lum pizhaippeerka'l.
naan en pithaavilum, neengka'l ennilum, naan ungka'lilum irukki'rathai annaa'lilea neengka'l a'riveerka'l.

en ka'rpanaika'laip pet'rukko'ndu avaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravanea ennidaththil anpaayirukki'raan, ennidaththil anpaayirukki'ravan en pithaavukku anpaayiruppaan; naanum avanil anpaayirunthu, avanukku ennai ve'lippaduththuvean en'raar.
skaariyoaththallaatha yoothaa enpavan avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, neer ulakaththukku ummai ve'lippaduththaamal engka'lukku ummai ve'lippaduththappoaki'ra kaara'namenna en'raan.

iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: oruvan ennil anpaayirunthaal, avan en vasanaththaik kaikko'l'luvaan, avanil en pithaa anpaayiruppaar; naangka'l avanidaththil vanthu avanoadea vaasampa'n'nuvoam.
ennil anpaayiraathavan en vasanangka'laik kaikko'l'lamaattaan. neengka'l keadki'ra vasanam ennudaiyathaayiraamal ennai anuppina pithaavinudaiyathaayirukki'rathu.
naan ungka'ludanea thangkiyirukkaiyil ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonnean.
en naamaththinaalea pithaa anuppappoaki'ra parisuththa aaviyaakiya theat'raravaa'lanea ellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukkup poathiththu, naan ungka'lukkuch sonna ellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukku ninaippoottuvaar.

samaathaanaththai ungka'lukku vaiththuppoaki'rean, ennudaiya samaathaanaththaiyea ungka'lukkuk kodukki'rean; ulakam kodukki'rapirakaaram naan ungka'lukkuk kodukki'rathillai. ungka'l iruthayam kalangkaamalum payappadaamalum iruppathaaka.

naan poavean en'rum, thirumpi ungka'lidaththil varuvean en'rum naan ungka'ludanea sonnathaik keatteerka'lea. neengka'l ennil anpu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaal pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'reanen'ru naan sonnathaik ku'riththuch santhoashappaduveerka'l, eanenil en pithaa ennilum periyavaraayirukki'raar.
ithu nadakkumpoathu neengka'l visuvaasikkumpadiyaaka, nadappatha'rkumunnamea ithai ungka'lukkuch sonnean.
ini naan ungka'ludanea athikamaayp peasuvathillai. intha ulakaththin athipathi varuki'raan, avanukku ennidaththil on'rumillai.
naan pithaavil anpaayirukki'rean en'rum, pithaa enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seyki'rean en'rum, ulakam a'riyumpadikku ippadi nadakkum. ezhunthirungka'l, ivvidamvittup poavoam vaarungka'l en'raar.
naan meyyaana thiraadchachsedi, en pithaa thiraadchaththoattakkaarar.
ennil kanikodaathirukki'ra kodi ethuvoa athai avar a'ruththuppoaduki'raar; kanikodukki'ra kodi ethuvoa, athu athika kanika'laik kodukkumpadi, athaich suththampa'n'nuki'raar.
naan ungka'lukkuch sonna upatheasaththinaalea neengka'l ippozhuthea suththamaayirukki'reerka'l.

ennil nilaiththirungka'l, naanum ungka'lil nilaiththiruppean; kodiyaanathu thiraadchachsediyil nilaiththiraavittaal athu thaanaayk kanikodukka maattaathathu poala, neengka'lum ennil nilaiththiraavittaal, kanikodukkamaatteerka'l.
naanea thiraadchachsedi, neengka'l kodika'l. oruvan ennilum naan avanilum nilaiththirunthaal, avan mikuntha kanika'laik koduppaan; ennaiyallaamal ungka'laal on'rum seyyakkoodaathu.
oruvan ennil nilaiththiraavittaal, ve'liyea e'riyu'nda kodiyaippoala avan e'riyu'ndu ularnthu poavaan; appadippattavaika'laich searththu, akkiniyilea poaduki'raarka'l; avaika'l erinthupoam.
neengka'l ennilum, en vaarththaika'l ungka'lilum nilaiththirunthaal, neengka'l keattukko'lvathethuvoa athu ungka'lukkuch seyyappadum.
neengka'l mikuntha kanika'laik koduppathinaal en pithaa makimaippaduvaar, enakkum seesharaayiruppeerka'l.
pithaa ennil anpaayirukki'rathupoala naanum ungka'lil anpaayirukki'rean; ennudaiya anpilea nilaiththirungka'l.
naan en pithaavin ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndu avarudaiya anpilea nilaiththirukki'rathupoala, neengka'lum en ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'ndirunthaal, ennudaiya anpilea nilaiththiruppeerka'l.
ennudaiya santhoasham ungka'lil nilaiththirukkumpadikkum, ungka'l santhoasham ni'raivaayirukkumpadikkum, ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonnean.
naan ungka'lil anpaayirukki'rathupoala neengka'lum oruvariloruvar anpaayirukka vea'ndumenpathea ennudaiya ka'rpanaiyaayirukki'rathu.
oruvan than sineakitharukkaakath than jeevanaik kodukki'ra anpilum athikamaana anpu oruvaridaththilumillai.
naan ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'ra yaavaiyum neengka'l seyveerka'laanaal, en sineakitharaayiruppeerka'l.

ini naan ungka'lai oozhiyakkaararen'ru solluki'rathillai, oozhiyakkaaran than ejamaan seyki'rathai a'riyamaattaan. naan ungka'laich sineakithar en'rean, eanenil en pithaavinidaththil naan kea'lvippatta ellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukku a'riviththean.

neengka'l ennaith therinthuko'l'lavillai, naan ungka'laith therinthuko'ndean; neengka'l en naamaththinaalea pithaavaik keattukko'lvathu ethuvoa, athai avar ungka'lukkuk kodukkaththakkathaaka neengka'l poayk kanikodukkumpadikkum, ungka'l kani nilaiththirukkumpadikkum, naan ungka'lai ea'rpaduththinean.
neengka'l oruvariloruvar anpaayirukkavea'ndumen'rea ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'rean.
ulakam ungka'laip pakaiththaal, athu ungka'laip pakaikki'ratha'rkumunnea ennaip pakaiththathen'ru a'riyungka'l.

neengka'l ulakaththaaraayirunthaal, ulakam thannudaiyathaich sineakiththirukkum; neengka'l ulakaththaaraayiraathapadiyinaalum, naan ungka'lai ulakaththilirunthu therinthuko'ndapadiyinaalum, ulakam ungka'laip pakaikki'rathu.

oozhiyakkaaran than ejamaanilum periyavanallaven'ru naan ungka'lukkuch sonna vaarththaiyai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l. avarka'l ennaith thunpappaduththinathu'ndaanaal, ungka'laiyum thunpappaduththuvaarka'l; avarka'l en vasanaththaik kaikko'ndathu'ndaanaal, ungka'l vasanaththaiyum kaikko'l'luvaarka'l.
avarka'l ennai anuppinavarai a'riyaathapadiyinaal en naamaththinimiththamea ivaika'laiyellaam ungka'lukkuch seyvaarka'l.
naan vanthu avarka'lidaththil peasaathiruntheanaanaal avarka'lukkup paavamiraathu; ippozhuthoa thangka'l paavaththaikku'riththup poakkuchsolla avarka'lukku idamillai.
ennaip pakaikki'ravan en pithaavaiyum pakaikki'raan.
vea'roruvarum seyyaatha kiriyaika'lai naan avarka'lukku'l'lea seyyaathiruntheanaanaal, avarka'lukkup paavamiraathu; ippozhuthu avarka'l ennaiyum en pithaavaiyum ka'ndum pakaiththumirukki'raarka'l.
mukaantharamillaamal ennaip pakaiththaarka'l en'ru avarka'ludaiya veathaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra vaakkiyam ni'raivea'rumpadikku ippadiyaayit'ru.

pithaavinidaththilirunthu naan ungka'lukku anuppappoaki'ravarum, pithaavinidaththilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ravarumaakiya saththiya aaviyaana theat'raravaa'lan varumpoathu, avar ennaikku'riththuch saadchi koduppaar.
neengka'lum aathimuthal ennudaneakooda irunthapadiyaal enakkuch saadchika'laayiruppeerka'l.
neengka'l ida'raladaiyaathapadikku ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonnean.
avarka'l ungka'lai jepaaalayangka'lukkup pu'rampaakkuvaarka'l; mealum ungka'laik kolaiseyki'ravan thaan theavanukkuth tho'nduseyki'ravanen'ru ninaikkung kaalam varum.
avarka'l pithaavaiyum ennaiyum a'riyaathapadiyinaal ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch seyvaarka'l.

anthak kaalam varumpoathu naan ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonneanen'ru neengka'l ninaikkumpadi ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch solliyirukki'rean; naan ungka'ludaneakooda irunthapadiyinaal aarampaththilea ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sollavillai.
ippozhuthu naan ennai anuppinavaridaththi'rkup poaki'rean; engkea poaki'reeren'ru ungka'lil oruvanum ennaik keadkavillai.
aanaalum naan ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonnathinaal ungka'l iruthayam thukkaththaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.

naan ungka'lukku u'nmaiyaich solluki'rean; naan poaki'rathu ungka'lukkup pirayoajanamaayirukkum; naan poakaathirunthaal, theat'raravaa'lan ungka'lidaththil varaar; naan poaveaneayaakil avarai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppuvean.
avar vanthu, paavaththaikku'riththum, neethiyaikku'riththum, niyaayaththeerppaikku'riththum, ulakaththaik ka'ndiththu u'narththuvaar.
avarka'l ennai visuvaasiyaathapadiyinaalea paavaththaikku'riththum,
neengka'l ini ennaik kaa'naathapadikku naan en pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'rapadiyinaalea neethiyaikku'riththum,
intha ulakaththin athipathi niyaayantheerkkappattathinaalea niyaayaththeerppaikku'riththum, ka'ndiththu u'narththuvaar.
innum aneakangkaariyangka'lai naan ungka'lukkuch sollavea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu, avaika'lai neengka'l ippozhuthu thaangkamaatteerka'l.

saththiya aaviyaakiya avar varumpoathu, sakala saththiyaththi'rku'l'lum ungka'lai nadaththuvaar; avar thammudaiya suyamaayp peasaamal, thaam kea'lvippattavaika'l yaavaiyugnsolli, varappoaki'ra kaariyangka'lai ungka'lukku a'rivippaar.
avar ennudaiyathil eduththu ungka'lukku a'rivippathinaal ennai makimaippaduththuvaar.
pithaavinudaiyavaika'l yaavum ennudaiyavaika'l; athinaalea avar ennudaiyathil eduththu ungka'lukku a'rivippaar en'rean.
naan pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'rapadiyinaal kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'naathiruppeerka'l, ma'rupadiyum kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'npeerka'l en'raar.

appozhuthu avarudaiya seesharil silar: naan pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'rapadiyinaal, kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'naathiruppeerka'l en'rum, ma'rupadiyum kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'npeerka'l en'rum avar nammudanea solluki'rathin karuththenna en'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea peasikko'ndathuman'ri:
kognchakkaalam enki'raarea, ithenna? avar solluki'rathu innathen'ru namakku vi'langkavillaiyea en'raarka'l.

athaikku'riththuth thammidaththil keadkumpadi avarka'l virumpuki'rathai iyeasu a'rinthu, avarka'lai noakki: kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'naathiruppeerka'l, ma'rupadiyum kognchakkaalaththilea ennaik kaa'npeerka'l en'ru naan sonnathaikku'riththu neengka'l ungka'lukku'l'lea visaarikki'reerka'loa?
meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean: neengka'l azhuthu pulampuveerka'l, ulakamoa santhoashappadum; neengka'l thukkappaduveerka'l, aanaalum ungka'l thukkam santhoashamaaka maa'rum.

sthireeyaanava'lukkup pirasavakaalam vanthirukkumpoathu ava'l thukkamadaiki'raa'l; pi'l'laipet'ravudanea oru manushan ulakaththil pi'ranthaanenki'ra santhoashaththinaal appu'ram upaththiravaththai ninaiyaa'l.

athupoala neengka'lum ippozhuthu thukkamadainthirukki'reerka'l. naan ma'rupadiyum ungka'laik kaa'npean, appozhuthu ungka'l iruthayam santhoashappadum, ungka'l santhoashaththai oruvanum ungka'lidaththilirunthu eduththuppoadamaattaan.

antha naa'lilea neengka'l ennidaththil on'rung keadkamaatteerka'l. meyyaakavea meyyaakavea naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean, neengka'l en naamaththinaalea pithaavinidaththil keattuk ko'lvathethuvoa athai avar ungka'lukkuth tharuvaar.
ithuvaraikkum neengka'l en naamaththinaalea on'rum keadkavillai; kea'lungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'l santhoasham ni'raivaayirukkumpadi pet'ruk ko'lveerka'l.
ivaika'lai naan uvamaika'laay ungka'ludanea peasuki'rean; kaalam varum, appozhuthu naan uvamaika'laay ungka'ludanea peasaamal, pithaavaikku'riththu ve'lippadaiyaaka ungka'lukku a'rivippean.
antha naa'lil neengka'l en naamaththinaalea vea'ndik ko'lveerka'l. ungka'lukkaakap pithaavai naan keattuk ko'lveanen'ru ungka'lukkuch sollavea'ndiyathillai.
neengka'l ennaich sineakiththu, naan theavanidaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvantheanen'ru visuvaasikki'rapadiyinaal pithaathaamea ungka'laich sineakikki'raar.
naan pithaavinidaththilirunthu pu'rappattu ulakaththilea vanthean; ma'rupadiyum ulakaththaivittup pithaavinidaththi'rkup poaki'rean en'raar.
avarudaiya seesharka'l avarai noakki: ithoa, ippozhuthu neer uvamaiyaayp peasaamal, ve'lippadaiyaayp peasuki'reer.

neer ellaavat'raiyum a'rinthirukki'reer en'rum, oruvan ummai vinaava vea'nduvathillaiyen'rum, ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'roam; ithinaalea neer theavanidaththilirunthu vantheeren'ru visuvaasikki'roam en'raarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ippozhuthu neengka'l visuvaasikki'reerka'l.

ithoa, neengka'l sitha'ru'ndu, avanavan than than idaththukkup poay, ennaith thaniyea vittuvidungkaalam varum; athu ippozhuthu vanthirukki'rathu; aanaalum naan thaniththirean, pithaa ennudaneakooda irukki'raar.

ennidaththil ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam u'ndaayirukkumporuttu ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch sonnean. ulakaththil ungka'lukku upaththiravam u'ndu, aanaalum thidanko'l'lungka'l; naan ulakaththai jeyiththean en'raar.
iyeasu ivaika'laich sonnapinpu thammudaiya ka'nka'lai vaanaththukku ea'reduththu:

pithaavea, vea'lai vanthathu, neer ummudaiya kumaaranukkuth thantharu'lina yaavarukkum avar niththiyajeevanaik kodukkumporuttu maamsamaana yaavarmealum neer avarukku athikaarangkoduththapadiyea, ummudaiya kumaaran ummai makimaippaduththumpadikku neer ummudaiya kumaaranai makimaippaduththum.
on'raana meyththeavanaakiya ummaiyum neer anuppinavaraakiya iyeasu ki'risthuvaiyum a'rivathea niththiyajeevan.
poomiyilea naan ummai makimaippaduththinean; naan seyyumpadi neer enakku niyamiththa kiriyaiyaich seythu mudiththean.
pithaavea, ulakam u'ndaaki'ratha'rku munnea ummidaththil enakku u'ndaayiruntha makimaiyinaalea ippozhuthu neer ennai ummidaththilea makimaippaduththum.

neer ulakaththil therintheduththu enakkuth thantha manusharukku ummudaiya naamaththai ve'lippaduththinean. avarka'l ummudaiyavarka'laayirunthaarka'l, avarka'lai enakkuth thantheer, avarka'l ummudaiya vasanaththaik kaikko'ndirukki'raarka'l.
neer enakkuth thanthavaika'lellaam ummaalea u'ndaayinaven'ru ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'raarka'l.

neer enakkuk koduththa vaarththaika'lai naan avarka'lukkuk koduththean; avarka'l avaika'lai eat'rukko'ndu, naan ummidaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthean en'ru nichchayamaay a'rinthu, neer ennai anuppineer en'ru visuvaasiththirukki'raarka'l.
naan avarka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; ulakaththukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'laamal, neer enakkuth thanthavarka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; avarka'l ummudaiyavarka'laayirukki'raarka'lea.
ennudaiyavaika'l yaavum ummudaiyavaika'l, ummudaiyavaika'l ennudaiyavaika'l; avarka'lil naan makimaippattirukki'rean.

naan ini ulakaththilirean, ivarka'l ulakaththilirukki'raarka'l; naan ummidaththi'rku varuki'rean. parisuththa pithaavea, neer enakkuth thanthavarka'l nammaippoala on'raayirukkumpadikku, neer avarka'lai ummudaiya naamaththinaalea kaaththukko'l'lum.

naan avarka'ludaneakooda ulakaththilirukkaiyil avarka'lai ummudaiya naamaththinaalea kaaththukko'ndean; neer enakkuth thanthavarka'laik kaaththuk ko'nduvanthean; veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'raththakkathaaka, keattin makan kettuppoanaaneayallaamal, avarka'lil oruvanum kettuppoakavillai.
ippozhuthu naan ummidaththi'rku varuki'rean; avarka'l en santhoashaththai ni'raivaay adaiyumpadi ulakaththil irukkaiyil ivaika'laich solluki'rean.
naan ummudaiya vaarththaiyai avarka'lukkuk koduththean; naan ulakaththaanallaathathupoala avarka'lum ulakaththaaralla; aathalaal ulakam avarka'laip pakaiththathu.
neer avarka'lai ulakaththilirunthu eduththukko'l'lumpadi naan vea'ndikko'l'laamal, neer avarka'laith theemaiyinin'ru kaakkumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naan ulakaththaanallaathathupoala, avarka'lum ulakaththaaralla.
ummudaiya saththiyaththinaalea avarka'laip parisuththamaakkum; ummudaiya vasanamea saththiyam.
neer ennai ulakaththil anuppinathupoala, naanum avarka'lai ulakaththil anuppuki'rean.
avarka'lum saththiyaththinaalea parisuththamaakkappattavarka'laakumpadi, avarka'lukkaaka naan ennaiththaanea parisuththamaakkuki'rean.
naan ivarka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'luki'rathumallaamal, ivarka'ludaiya vaarththaiyinaal ennai visuvaasikki'ravarka'lukkaakavum vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.

avarka'lellaarum on'raayirukkavum, pithaavea, neer ennai anuppinathai ulakam visuvaasikki'ratha'rkaaka, neer ennileayum naan ummileayum irukki'rathupoala avarka'lellaarum nammil on'raayirukkavum vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naam on'raayirukki'rathupoala avarka'lum on'raayirukkumpadi, neer enakkuth thantha makimaiyai naan avarka'lukkuk koduththean.

orumaippaattil avarka'l thea'rinavarka'laayirukkumpadikkum, ennai neer anuppinathaiyum, neer ennil anpaayirukki'rathupoala avarka'lilum anpaayirukki'rathaiyum ulakam a'riyumpadikkum, naan avarka'lilum neer ennilum irukkumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.

pithaavea, ulakaththoat'raththukku mun neer ennil anpaayirunthapadiyinaal, neer enakkuth thantha ennudaiya makimaiyai neer enakkuth thanthavarka'l kaa'numpadiyaaka, naan engkea irukki'reanoa angkea avarka'lum ennudaneakooda irukka virumpuki'rean.
neethiyu'l'la pithaavea, ulakam ummai a'riyavillai, naan ummai a'rinthirukki'rean; neer ennai anuppinathai ivarka'lum a'rinthirukki'raarka'l.
neer ennidaththil vaiththa anpu avarka'lidaththilirukkumpadikkum, naanum avarka'lilirukkumpadikkum, ummudaiya naamaththai avarka'lukkuth theriyappaduththinean; innamum theriyappaduththuvean en'raar.
iyeasu ivaika'laich sonnapinpu, thammudaiya seesharudaneakooda ketharoan ennum aat'rukku appu'ram poanaar; angkea oru thoattam irunthathu, athilea avarum avarudaiya seesharum piraveasiththaarka'l.
iyeasu thammudaiya seesharudaneakooda adikkadi angkea poayirunthapadiyinaal, avaraik kaattikkodukki'ra yoothaasum antha idaththai a'rinthirunthaan.

yoothaas poarchseavakarin koottaththaiyum pirathaana aasaariyar pariseayar enpavarka'laal anuppappatta oozhiyakkaararaiyum koottikko'ndu, panthangka'loadum theevattika'loadum aayuthangka'loadum avvidaththi'rku vanthaan.
iyeasu thamakku nearidappoaki'ra ellaavat'raiyum a'rinthu, ethirko'ndupoay, avarka'lai noakki: yaaraith theaduki'reerka'l en'raar.
avarukku avarka'l pirathiyuththaramaaka: nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaith theaduki'roam en'raarka'l. atha'rku iyeasu: naanthaan en'raar. avaraik kaattikkoduththa yoothaasum avarka'ludaneakooda nin'raan.
naanthaan en'ru avar avarka'lidaththil sonnavudanea, avarka'l pinnittuth tharaiyilea vizhunthaarka'l.
avar ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai noakki: yaaraith theaduki'reerka'l en'ru keattaar. avarka'l: nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaith theaduki'roam en'raarka'l.
iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naanthaanen'ru ungka'lukkuch sonneanea; ennaith theaduki'rathu'ndaanaal, ivarka'laip poakavidungka'l en'raar.
neer enakkuth thanthavarka'lil oruvanaiyum naan izhanthupoakavillai en'ru avar solliya vasanam ni'raivea'raththakkathaaka ippadi nadanthathu.
appozhuthu seemoanpeathuru, thannidaththiliruntha pattayaththai uruvi, pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaaranai valathukaatha'ra vettinaan; antha vealaikkaaranukku malkus en'ru peyar.
appozhuthu iyeasu peathuruvai noakki: un pattayaththai u'raiyilea poadu; pithaa enakkuk koduththa paaththiraththil naan paanampa'n'naathiruppeanoa en'raar.
appozhuthu poarchseavakarum, aayiram poarchseavakarukkuth thalaivanum, yootharudaiya oozhiyakkaararum iyeasuvaippidiththu, avaraik katti,
muthalaavathu avarai annaa enpavanidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; avan antha varushaththup pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya kaaypaavukku maamanaayirunthaan.
janangka'lukkaaka orea manushan saaki'rathu nalamaayirukkumen'ru yootharukku aaloasanai sonnavan inthak kaaypaavea.

seemoanpeathuruvum vea'roru seeshanum iyeasuvukkup pinsen'raarka'l. anthach seeshan pirathaana aasaariyanukku a'rimukamaanavanaayirunthathinaal, iyeasuvudaneakoodap pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aramanaikku'l piraveasiththaan.

peathuru vaasalarukea ve'liyea nin'raan. appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanukku a'rimukamaanavanaayiruntha mat'rach seeshan ve'liyea vanthu, vaasalkaakki'ravarka'ludanea peasi, peathuruvai u'l'lea azhaiththukko'ndupoanaan.
appozhuthu vaasalkaakki'ra vealaikkaari peathuruvai noakki: neeyum antha manushanudaiya seesharil oruvanallavaa en'raa'l. avan: naan alla en'raan.
ku'lirkaalamaanapadiyinaalea oozhiyakkaararum seavakarum karineruppu'ndaakki, nin'ru, ku'lirkaaynthuko'ndirunthaarka'l; avarka'ludaneakoodap peathuruvum nin'ru ku'lirkaaynthuko'ndirunthaan.
pirathaana aasaariyan iyeasuvinidaththil avarudaiya seesharaikku'riththum poathakaththaikku'riththum visaariththaan.

iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan ve'liyarangkamaay ulakaththudanea peasinean; jepa aalayangka'lileayum yootharka'lellaarum koodivaruki'ra theavaalayaththileayum eppozhuthum upatheasiththean; antharangkaththilea naan on'rum peasavillai.
neer ennidaththil visaarikkavea'ndiyathenna? naan sonnavaika'laik keattavarka'lidaththil visaariyum; naan peasinavaika'lai avarka'l a'rinthirukki'raarka'lea en'raar.
ippadi avar sonnapozhuthu, sameepaththil nin'ra seavakaril oruvan: pirathaana aasaariyanukku ippadiyaa uththaravu solluki'rathu en'ru, iyeasuvai oru a'rai a'rainthaan.
iyeasu avanai noakki: naan thakaathavithamaayp peasinathu'ndaanaal, thakaathathai oppuvi; naan thakuthiyaayp peasineaneayaakil, ennai ean adikki'raay en'raar.
pinpu annaa enpavan pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya kaaypaavinidaththi'rku avaraik kattu'ndavaraaka anuppinaan.
seemoanpeathuru nin'ru ku'lirkaaynthuko'ndirunthaan. appozhuthu silar avanai noakki: neeyum avanudaiya seesharil oruvanallavaa en'raarka'l. avan: naan alla en'ru ma'ruthaliththaan.
pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya vealaikkaararil peathuru kaatha'ravettinavanukku inaththaanaakiya oruvan avanai noakki: naan unnai avanudaneakoodath thoattaththilea kaa'navillaiyaa en'raan.
appozhuthu peathuru ma'rupadiyum ma'ruthaliththaan; udanea seaval koovit'ru.

avarka'l kaaypaavinidaththilirunthu iyeasuvaith theasaathipathiyin aramanaikkuk ko'ndupoanaarka'l; appozhuthu vidiya'rkaalamaayirunthathu. theettuppadaamal paskaavaip pusikkaththakkathaaka, avarka'l theasaathipathiyin aramanaikku'l piraveasiyaathirunthaarka'l.
aathalaal pilaaththu avarka'lidaththil ve'liyea vanthu: intha manushanmeal enna kut'ragnsaattuki'reerka'l en'raan.
avarka'l avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: ivan kut'ravaa'liyaayiraavittaal, ivanai ummidaththil oppukkodukkamaattoam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu pilaaththu avarka'lai noakki: ivanai neengka'lea ko'ndupoay, ungka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi niyaayantheerungka'l en'raan. atha'rku yootharka'l: oruvanaiyum mara'na aakkinai seyya engka'lukku athikaaramillai en'raarka'l.
thaam innavithamaana mara'namaay marikkappoaki'raarenpathaik ku'riththu iyeasu ku'rippaaych solliyiruntha vaarththai ni'raivea'raththakkathaaka ippadich sonnaarka'l.
appozhuthu pilaaththu ma'rupadiyum aramanaikku'l piraveasiththu, iyeasuvai azhaiththu: nee yootharudaiya raajaavaa en'ru keattaan.
iyeasu avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: neeraay ippadich solluki'reeroa? allathu mat'ravarka'l ennaikku'riththu ippadi umakkuch sonnaarka'loa en'raar.
pilaaththu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan yoothanaa? un janangka'lum pirathaana aasaariyarum unnai ennidaththil oppukkoduththaarka'l, nee enna seythaay en'raan.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: en raajyam ivvulakaththi'rkuriyathalla, en raajyam ivvulakaththi'rkuriyathaanaal naan yootharidaththil oppukkodukkappadaathapadikku en oozhiyakkaarar poaraadiyiruppaarka'lea; ippadiyirukka en raajyam ivvidaththi'rkuriyathalla en'raar.

appozhuthu pilaaththu avarai noakki: appadiyaanaal nee raajaavoa en'raan. iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: neer solluki'rapadi naan raajaathaan; saththiyaththaikku'riththuch saadchikodukka naan pi'ranthean, itha'rkaakavea intha ulakaththil vanthean; saththiyavaan evanum en saththam keadki'raan en'raar.
atha'rkup pilaaththu: saththiyamaavathu enna en'raan. ma'rupadiyum avan yootharka'lidaththil ve'liyea vanthu: naan avanidaththil oru kut'ramum kaa'nean.
paskaapa'ndikaiyil naan ungka'lukku oruvanai viduthalaipa'n'nuki'ra vazhakkamu'ndea; aakaiyaal yootharudaiya raajaavai naan ungka'lukkaaka viduthalaipa'n'na ungka'lukku manathu'ndaa en'raan.
appozhuthu: avarka'lellaarum ivanaiyalla, parapaasai viduthalaipa'n'navea'ndum en'ru ma'rupadiyum saththamittaarka'l; anthap parapaasenpavan ka'l'lanaayirunthaan.
appozhuthu pilaaththu iyeasuvaip pidiththu vaarinaal adippiththaan.
poarchseavakar mu'l'luka'linaal oru mudiyaip pinni avar sirasinmeal vaiththu, sivappaana oru angkiyai avarukku uduththi:
yootharudaiya raajaavea, vaazhka en'ru solli, avaraik kaiyinaal adiththaarka'l.
pilaaththu ma'rupadiyum ve'liyea vanthu: naan ivanidaththil oru kut'ramum kaa'nean en'ru neengka'l a'riyumpadikku, ithoa, ungka'lidaththil ivanai ve'liyea ko'nduvaruki'rean en'raan.
iyeasu, mu'lmudiyum sivappangkiyum thariththavaraay, ve'liyea vanthaar. appozhuthu pilaaththu avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, intha manushan en'raan.

pirathaana aasaariyarum seavakarum avaraik ka'ndapoathu: siluvaiyil a'raiyum siluvaiyil a'raiyum en'ru saththamittaarka'l. atha'rkup pilaaththu: neengka'lea ivanaik ko'ndupoaych siluvaiyil a'raiyungka'l, naan ivanidaththil oru kut'ramum kaa'nean en'raan.

yootharka'l avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: engka'lukku oru niyaayappiramaa'namu'ndu, ivan thannaith theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru sonnapadiyinaal, antha niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyea, ivan saakavea'ndum en'raarka'l.
pilaaththu intha vaarththaiyaik keattapozhuthu athikamaayp payanthu,
ma'rupadiyum aramanaikku'l'lea poay, iyeasuvai noakki: nee engkeayirunthu vanthavan en'raan. atha'rku iyeasu maa'ruththaram on'rum sollavillai.
appozhuthu pilaaththu: nee ennoadea peasuki'rathillaiyaa? unnaich siluvaiyil a'raiya enakku athikaaramu'nden'rum, unnai viduthalaipa'n'na enakku athikaaramu'nden'rum unakkuth theriyaathaa en'raan.

iyeasu pirathiyuththaramaaka: paraththilirunthu umakkuk kodukkappadaathirunthaal, enmeal umakku oru athikaaramumiraathu; aanapadiyinaalea ennai ummidaththil oppukkoduththavanukku athika paavamu'ndu en'raar.

athumuthal pilaaththu avarai viduthalaipa'n'na vakaitheadinaan. yootharka'l avanai noakki: ivanai viduthalaipa'n'ninaal neer iraayanukkuch sineakithanalla; thannai raajaavenki'ravanevanoa avan iraayanukku viroathi en'ru saththamittaarka'l.

pilaaththu intha vaarththaiyaik keattapozhuthu, iyeasuvai ve'liyea azhaiththuvanthu, tha'lavarisaippaduththina meadaiyen'rum, epireyu paashaiyilea kapaththaa en'rum sollappatta idaththilea, niyaayaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthaan.
antha naa'l paskaavukku aayaththanaa'lum ea'rakku'raiya aa'ruma'ni nearamumaayirunthathu; appozhuthu avan yootharka'lai noakki: ithoa, ungka'l raajaa en'raan.

avarka'l: ivanai akat'rum akat'rum, siluvaiyil a'raiyum en'ru saththamittaarka'l. atha'rkup pilaaththu: ungka'l raajaavai naan siluvaiyil a'raiyalaamaa en'raan. pirathaana aasaariyar pirathiyuththaramaaka: iraayaneayallaamal engka'lukku vea'rea raajaa illai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avaraich siluvaiyil a'raiyumpadikku avarka'lidaththil oppukkoduththaan. avarka'l iyeasuvaip pidiththukko'ndupoanaarka'l.
avar thammudaiya siluvaiyaich sumanthuko'ndu, epireyu paashaiyilea kolkothaa en'ru sollappadum kapaalasthalam enki'ra idaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoanaar.
angkea avaraich siluvaiyil a'rainthaarka'l; avaroadeakooda vea'rira'ndupearai ira'ndu pakkangka'lilum iyeasuvai naduvilumaakach siluvaika'lil a'rainthaarka'l.
pilaaththu oru mealvilaasaththai ezhuthi, siluvaiyinmeal poaduviththaan. athil nasareayanaakiya iyeasu yootharudaiya raajaa en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

iyeasu siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta idam nakaraththi'rkuch sameepamaayirunthapadiyinaal, yootharil aneakar antha mealvilaasaththai vaasiththaarka'l; athu epireyu kireakku laththeen paashaika'lil ezhuthiyirunthathu.
appozhuthu yootharudaiya pirathaana aasaariyar pilaaththuvai noakki: yootharudaiya raajaa en'ru neer ezhuthaamal, thaan yootharudaiya raajaa en'ru avan sonnathaaka ezhuthum en'raarka'l.
pilaaththu pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan ezhuthinathu ezhuthinathea en'raan.

poarchseavakar iyeasuvaich siluvaiyil a'rainthapinpu, avarudaiya vasthirangka'lai eduththu, ovvoru seavakanukku ovvoru pangkaaka naalu pangkaakkinaarka'l; angkiyaiyum eduththaarka'l, antha angki, thaiyalillaamal mealea thodangki muzhuvathum neyyappattathaayirunthathu.

avarka'l: ithai naam kizhiyaamal, yaarukku varumoa en'ru ithaikku'riththuch seettuppoaduvoam en'ru oruvaroadoruvar peasikko'ndaarka'l. en vasthirangka'laith thangka'lukku'l'lea pangkittu, en udaiyinmeal seettuppoattaarka'l enki'ra veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'raththakkathaakap poarchseavakar ippadich seythaarka'l.
iyeasuvin siluvaiyinarukea avarudaiya thaayum, avarudaiya thaayin sakoathari kileyoappaa mariyaa'lum, makathaleanaa mariyaa'lum nin'ruko'ndirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu iyeasu thammudaiya thaayaiyum arukea nin'ra thamakku anpaayiruntha seeshanaiyum ka'ndu, thammudaiya thaayai noakki: sthireeyea, athoa, un makan en'raar.
pinpu anthach seeshanai noakki: athoa, un thaay en'raar. annearamuthal anthach seeshan ava'laith thannidamaay eat'rukko'ndaan.
athanpinpu, ellaam mudinthathu en'ru iyeasu a'rinthu, veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'raththakkathaaka: thaakamaayirukki'rean en'raar.
kaadi ni'raintha paaththiram angkea vaikkappattirunthathu; avarka'l kada'rkaa'laanaik kaadiyilea thoayththu, eesoappuththa'ndil maatti, avar vaayinidaththil neettikkoduththaarka'l.
iyeasu kaadiyai vaangkinapinpu, mudinthathu en'ru solli, thalaiyaich saayththu, aaviyai oppukkoduththaar.

antha naa'l periya oayvunaa'lukku aayaththanaa'laayirunthapadiyinaal, udalka'l antha oayvunaa'lilea siluvaika'lil iraathapadikku, yootharka'l pilaaththuvinidaththil poay, avarka'ludaiya kaalelumpuka'lai mu'rikkumpadikkum, udalka'lai eduththuppoadumpadikkum uththaravu keattukko'ndaarka'l.
anthappadi poarchseavakar vanthu, avarudaneakoodach siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta munthinavanudaiya kaalelumpuka'laiyum mat'ravanudaiya kaalelumpuka'laiyum mu'riththaarka'l.
avarka'l iyeasuvinidaththil vanthu, avar mariththirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, avarudaiya kaalelumpuka'lai mu'rikkavillai.
aakilum poarchseavakaril oruvan eettiyinaalea avarudaiya vilaavil kuththinaan; udanea iraththamum tha'n'neerum pu'rappattathu.
athaik ka'ndavan saadchikodukki'raan, avanudaiya saadchi meyyaayirukki'rathu; neengka'l visuvaasikkumpadi, thaan solluki'rathu meyyen'ru avan a'rinthirukki'raan.
avarudaiya elumpuka'lil on'rum mu'rikkappaduvathillai enki'ra veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'rumpadi ivaika'l nadanthathu.
allaamalum thaangka'l kuththinavarai noakkippaarppaarka'l en'ru vea'roru veathavaakkiyam solluki'rathu.

ivaika'lukkuppinpu arimaththiyaa ooraanum, yootharukkup payanthathinaal iyeasuvukku antharangka seeshanumaakiya yoaseappu iyeasuvin sareeraththai eduththukko'ndupoakumpadi pilaaththuvinidaththil uththaravu keattaan; pilaaththu uththaravu koduththaan. aakaiyaal avan vanthu, iyeasuvin sareeraththai eduththukko'ndupoanaan.
aarampaththilea oru iraaththiriyil iyeasuvinidaththil vanthiruntha nikkotheamu enpavan ve'l'laippoa'lamum kariyapoa'lamum kalanthu ea'rakku'raiya noo'ru iraaththal ko'nduvanthaan.
avarka'l iyeasuvin sareeraththai eduththu, yootharka'l adakkampa'n'num mu'raimaiyinpadiyea athaich sukanthavarkkangka'ludanea seelaika'lil sut'rik kattinaarka'l.
avar siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta idaththil oru thoattamum, anthath thoattaththil orukkaalum oruvanum vaikkappattiraatha oru puthiya kalla'raiyum irunthathu.
yootharudaiya aayaththanaa'laanapadiyinaalum, anthak kalla'rai sameepamaayirunthapadiyinaalum, avvidaththilea iyeasuvai vaiththaarka'l.
vaaraththin muthalnaa'l kaalaiyil, athika iruttoadea, makathaleanaa mariyaa'l kalla'raiyinidaththi'rku vanthu kalla'raiyai adaiththiruntha kal eduththup poattirukkakka'ndaa'l.

udanea ava'l oadi, seemoanpeathuruvinidaththilum iyeasuvukku anpaayiruntha mat'rach seeshanidaththilum poay: karththaraik kalla'raiyilirunthu eduththukko'ndu poayvittaarka'l, avarai vaiththa idam engka'lukkuth theriyavillai en'raa'l.
appozhuthu peathuruvum mat'rach seeshanum kalla'raiyinidaththi'rkup poakumpadi pu'rappattu, iruvarum orumiththu oadinaarka'l.
peathuruvaippaarkkilum mat'rach seeshan thurithamaay oadi, munthik kalla'raiyinidaththil vanthu,
atha'rku'l'lea kuninthupaarththu, seelaika'l kidakki'rathaik ka'ndaan; aanaalum avan u'l'lea poakavillai.
seemoanpeathuru avanukkup pinnea vanthu, kalla'raikku'l'lea piraveasiththu,
seelaika'l kidakki'rathaiyum, avarudaiya thalaiyil sut'riyiruntha seelai mat'rach seelaika'ludanea vaiththiraamal thaniyea oru idaththilea surutti vaiththirukki'rathaiyum ka'ndaan.
munthik kalla'raiyinidaththi'rku vantha mat'rach seeshanum appozhuthu u'l'lea piraveasiththu, ka'ndu visuvaasiththaan.
avar mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthirukkavea'ndum enki'ra veathavaakkiyaththai avarka'l innum a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.
pinpu anthach seesharka'l thangka'ludaiya idaththi'rkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.
mariyaa'l kalla'raiyinarukea ve'liyea nin'ru azhuthuko'ndirunthaa'l; appadi azhuthuko'ndirukkaiyil ava'l kuninthu kalla'raikku'l'lea paarththu,
iyeasuvin sareeram vaikkappattiruntha idaththilea ve'l'ludai thariththavarka'laay ira'ndu thootharka'l, thalaimaattil oruvanum kaalmaattil oruvanumaaka, udkaarnthirukki'rathaik ka'ndaa'l.
avarka'l ava'lai noakki: sthireeyea, ean azhuki'raay en'raarka'l. atha'rku ava'l: en aa'ndavarai eduththukko'ndu poayvittaarka'l, avarai vaiththa idam enakkuth theriyavillai en'raa'l.
ivaika'laich sollip pinnaakath thirumpi, iyeasu ni'rki'rathaik ka'ndaa'l; aanaalum avarai iyeasu en'ru a'riyaathirunthaa'l.

iyeasu ava'laip paarththu: sthireeyea, ean azhuki'raay, yaaraith theaduki'raay en'raar. ava'l, avaraith thoattakkaaranen'ru e'n'ni: aiyaa, neer avarai eduththukko'ndu poanathu'ndaanaal, avarai vaiththa idaththai enakkuch sollum, naan poay avarai eduththukko'l'luvean en'raa'l.
iyeasu ava'lai noakki: mariyaa'lea en'raar. ava'l thirumpip paarththu: rapooni en'raa'l; atha'rkup poathakarea en'ru arththamaam.

iyeasu ava'lai noakki: ennaith thodaathea, naan innum en pithaavinidaththi'rku ea'rippoakavillai; nee en sakoathararidaththi'rkup poay, naan en pithaavinidaththi'rkum ungka'l pithaavinidaththi'rkum, en theavanidaththi'rkum ungka'l theavanidaththi'rkum ea'rippoaki'rean en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollu en'raar.
makathaleanaa mariyaa'l poay, thaan karththaraik ka'ndathaiyum, avar thannudanea sonnavaika'laiyum seesharukku a'riviththaa'l.

vaaraththin muthalnaa'laakiya an'raiyaththinam saayangkaalavea'laiyilea, seesharka'l koodiyiruntha idaththil, yootharka'lukkup payanthathinaal kathavuka'l poottiyirukkaiyil, iyeasu vanthu naduvea nin'ru: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam en'raar.
avar ippadich sollith thammudaiya kaika'laiyum vilaavaiyum avarka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaar. seesharka'l karththaraikka'ndu santhoashappattaarka'l.
iyeasu ma'rupadiyum avarka'lai noakki: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanamu'ndaavathaaka; pithaa ennai anuppinathupoala naanum ungka'lai anuppuki'rean en'ru solli,
avarka'lmeal oothi: parisuththa aaviyaip pet'rukko'l'lungka'l;
evarka'ludaiya paavangka'lai mannikki'reerka'loa avaika'l avarka'lukku mannikkappadum, evarka'ludaiya paavangka'lai manniyaathirukki'reerka'loa avaika'l avarka'lukku mannikkappadaathirukkum en'raar.
iyeasu vanthirunthapoathu panniruvaril oruvanaakiya thithimu ennappatta thoamaa enpavan avarka'ludaneakooda irukkavillai.

mat'rach seesharka'l: karththaraik ka'ndoam en'ru avanudanea sonnaarka'l. atha'rku avan: avarudaiya kaika'lil aa'nika'linaalu'ndaana kaayaththai naan ka'ndu, anthak kaayaththilea en viralaiyittu, en kaiyai avarudaiya vilaavilea poattaalozhiya visuvaasikkamaattean en'raan.

ma'rupadiyum ettunaa'laikkuppinpu avarudaiya seesharka'l veettukku'l'lea irunthaarka'l; thoamaavum avarka'ludaneakooda irunthaan; kathavuka'l poottappattirunthathu. appozhuthu iyeasu vanthu naduvea nin'ru: ungka'lukkuch samaathaanam en'raar.
pinpu avar thoamaavai noakki: nee un viralai ingkea neetti, en kaika'laip paar, un kaiyai neetti, en vilaavilea poadu, avisuvaasiyaayiraamal visuvaasiyaayiru en'raar.
thoamaa avarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: en aa'ndavarea! en theavanea! en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: thoamaavea, nee ennaik ka'ndathinaalea visuvaasiththaay, kaa'naathirunthum visuvaasikki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l en'raar.
inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyiraatha vea'ru aneaka a'rputhangka'laiyum iyeasu thamathu seesharukku munpaakach seythaar.

iyeasu theavanudaiya kumaaranaakiya ki'risthu en'ru neengka'l visuvaasikkumpadiyaakavum, visuvaasiththu avarudaiya naamaththinaalea niththiyajeevanai adaiyumpadiyaakavum, ivaika'l ezhuthappattirukki'rathu.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu iyeasu thipeariyaa kada'rkaraiyilea ma'rupadiyum seesharukkuth thammai ve'lippaduththinaar; ve'lippaduththina vivaramaavathu:

seemoanpeathuruvum, thithimu ennappatta thoamaavum, kalileayaa naattilu'l'la kaanaa ooraanaakiya naaththaanvealum, sepetheayuvin kumaararum, avarudaiya seesharil vea'ru ira'ndupearum koodiyirukkumpoathu,

seemoanpeathuru mat'ravarka'lai noakki: meenpidikkappoaki'rean en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: naangka'lum ummudaneakooda varuki'roam en'raarka'l. avarka'l pu'rappattuppoay, udanea padavea'rinaarka'l. antha iraaththiriyilea avarka'l on'rum pidikkavillai.
vidiya'rkaalamaanapoathu, iyeasu karaiyilea nin'raar; avarai iyeasu en'ru seesharka'l a'riyaathirunthaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: pi'l'laika'lea, pusikki'ratha'rku eathaakilum ungka'lidaththil u'ndaa en'raar. atha'rku avarka'l: on'rumillai en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu avar: neengka'l padavukku valathupu'ramaaka valaiyaip poadungka'l, appozhuthu ungka'lukku akappadum en'raar. appadiyea avarka'l poattu, thira'laana meenka'l akappattathinaal, athai izhukkamaattaathirunthaarka'l.

aathalaal iyeasuvukku anpaayiruntha seeshan peathuruvaip paarththu: avar karththar en'raan. avar karththar en'ru seemoanpeathuru keattavudanea, thaan vasthiramillaathavanaayirunthapadiyinaal, than mea'rsattaiyaik kattikko'ndu kadalilea kuthiththaan.
mat'rach seesharka'l karaikku ea'rakku'raiya irunoo'rumuzhath thooraththil irunthapadiyinaal padavilirunthu ko'ndea meenka'lu'l'la valaiyai izhuththukko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
avarka'l karaiyilea vanthi'rangkinapoathu, karineruppup poattirukki'rathaiyum, athinmeal meen vaiththirukki'rathaiyum, appaththaiyum ka'ndaarka'l.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l ippozhuthu pidiththa meenka'lil silavat'raik ko'nduvaarungka'l en'raar.
seemoanpeathuru padavil ea'ri, noot'raimpaththumoon'ru periya meenka'laal ni'raintha valaiyaik karaiyil izhuththaan; iththanai meenka'l irunthum valai kizhiyavillai.
iyeasu avarka'lai noakki: vaarungka'l, poajanampa'n'nungka'l en'raar. avaraik karththaren'ru seesharka'l a'rinthapadiyinaal avarka'lil oruvanum: neer yaar en'ru keadkath thu'niyavillai.
appozhuthu iyeasu vanthu, appaththaiyum meenaiyum eduththu, avarka'lukkuk koduththaar.
iyeasu mariththoarilirunthezhuntha pinpu thammudaiya seesharukku aru'lina tharisanangka'lil ithu moon'raavathu tharisanam.

avarka'l poajanampa'n'ninapinpu, iyeasu seemoanpeathuruvai noakki: yoanaavin kumaaranaakiya seemoanea, ivarka'lilum athikamaay nee ennidaththil anpaayirukki'raayaa en'raar. atha'rku avan: aam aa'ndavarea, ummai neasikki'rean enpathai neer a'riveer en'raan. avar: en aattukkuttika'lai meayppaayaaka en'raar.

ira'ndaantharam avar avanai noakki: yoanaavin kumaaranaakiya seemoanea, nee ennidaththil anpaayirukki'raayaa en'raar. atha'rku avan: aam aa'ndavarea, ummai neasikki'rean enpathai neer a'riveer en'raan. avar: en aaduka'lai meayppaayaaka en'raar.

moon'raantharam avar avanai noakki: yoanaavin kumaaranaakiya seemoanea, nee ennai neasikki'raayaa en'raar. ennai neasikki'raayaa en'ru avar moon'raantharam thannaik keattapadiyinaalea, peathuru thukkappattu: aa'ndavarea, neer ellaavat'raiyum a'rinthirukki'reer, naan ummai neasikki'rean enpathaiyum neer a'riveer en'raan. iyeasu: en aaduka'lai meayppaayaaka en'raar.

nee i'lavayathu'l'lavanaayirunthapoathu unnai neeyea araikattikko'ndu, unakku ishdamaana idangka'lilea nadanthu thirinthaay; nee muthirvayathu'l'lavanaakumpoathu un kaika'lai neettuvaay; vea'roruvan un araiyaik katti, unakku ishdamillaatha idaththukku unnaik ko'ndupoavaan en'ru meyyaakavea meyyaakavea unakkuch solluki'rean en'raar.
innavithamaana mara'naththinaalea avan theavanai makimaippaduththappoaki'raanenpathaik ku'rikkumpadiyaaka ippadich sonnaar. avar ithaich solliyapinpu, avanai noakki: ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar.

peathuru thirumpippaarththu, iyeasuvukku anpaayirunthavanum, iraappoajanampa'n'nukaiyil avar maarpilea saaynthu: aa'ndavarea, ummaik kaattikkodukki'ravan yaar en'ru keattavanumaakiya seeshan pinnea varuki'rathaik ka'ndaan.
avanaik ka'ndu, peathuru iyeasuvai noakki: aa'ndavarea, ivan kaariyam enna en'raan.
atha'rku iyeasu: naan varuma'lavum ivanirukka enakkuch siththamaanaal, unakkenna, nee ennaip pinpat'rivaa en'raar.

aakaiyaal anthach seeshan marippathillaiyenki'ra peachchu sakoathararukku'l'lea parampit'ru. aanaalum, avan marippathillaiyen'ru iyeasu sollaamal, naan varuma'lavum ivanirukka enakkuch siththamaanaal unakkennaven'ru sonnaar.
anthach seeshanea ivaika'laikku'riththuch saadchikoduththu ivaika'lai ezhuthinavan; avanudaiya saadchi meyyen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
iyeasu seytha vea'ru aneaka kaariyangka'lumu'ndu; avaika'lai ovvon'raaka ezhuthinaal ezhuthappadum pusthakangka'l ulakam ko'l'laathen'ru e'n'nuki'rean. aamen.
theyoappiluvea, iyeasuvaanavar thaam therinthuko'nda appoasthalarukkup parisuththaaaviyinaalea katta'laiyitta pinpu,
avar eduththukko'l'lappatta naa'lvaraikkum seyyavum upatheasikkavum thodangkina ellaavat'raiyungku'riththu, muthalaam pirapanthaththai u'ndupa'n'ninean.

avar paadupattapinpu, naa'rpathu naa'la'lavum appoasthalarukkuth tharisanamaaki, theavanudaiya raajyaththukkuriyavaika'lai avarka'ludanea peasi, aneakam the'livaana thirushdaanthangka'linaalea avarka'lukkuth thammai uyiroadirukki'ravaraakak kaa'npiththaar.

an'riyum, avar avarka'ludanea koodivanthirukkumpoathu, avarka'lai noakki: yoavaan jalaththinaalea gnaanasnaanang koduththaan; neengka'l sila naa'lukku'l'lea parisuththaaaviyinaalea gnaanasnaanam pe'ruveerka'l.
aakaiyaal neengka'l erusaleamai vittup poakaamal ennidaththil kea'lvippatta pithaavin vaakkuththaththam ni'raivea'rak kaaththirungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaar.
appozhuthu koodivanthirunthavarka'l avarai noakki: aa'ndavarea, ikkaalaththilaa raajyaththai isravealukkuth thirumpak koduppeer en'ru keattaarka'l.
atha'rku avar: pithaavaanavar thammudaiya aatheenaththilea vaiththirukki'ra kaalangka'laiyum vea'laika'laiyum a'riki'rathu ungka'lukku aduththathalla.

parisuththaaavi ungka'lidaththil varumpoathu neengka'l pelanadainthu, erusaleamilum, yootheayaa muzhuvathilum, samaariyaavilum, poomiyin kadaisipariyanthamum, enakkuch saadchika'laayiruppeerka'l en'raar.
ivaika'lai avar sonnapinpu, avarka'l paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, uyara eduththukko'l'lappattaar; avarka'l ka'nka'lukku ma'raivaaka oru meakam avarai eduththukko'ndathu.
avar poaki'rapoathu avarka'l vaanaththai a'n'naanthu paarththukko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, ve'nmaiyaana vasthiranthariththavarka'l ira'ndupear avarka'larukea nin'ru:

kalileayaraakiya manusharea, neengka'l ean vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu ni'rki'reerka'l? ungka'lidaththinin'ru vaanaththukku eduththukko'l'lappatta intha iyeasuvaanavar eppadi ungka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaaka vaanaththukku ezhuntharu'lippoanaaroa, appadiyea ma'rupadiyum varuvaar en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avarka'l erusaleamukkuch sameepamaay oru oayvunaa'l pirayaa'na thooraththilirukki'ra olivamalai ennappatta malaiyilirunthu erusaleamukkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.

avarka'l angkea vanthapoathu mealveettil ea'rinaarka'l; athil peathuruvum, yaakkoapum, yoavaanum, anthireayaavum, pilippum, thoamaavum, pa'rtholomeayum, maththeayum, alpeayuvin kumaaranaakiya yaakkoapum, seloaththea ennappatta seemoanum, yaakkoapin sakoatharanaakiya yoothaavum thangkiyirunthaarka'l.
angkea ivarka'lellaarum, sthireeka'loadum iyeasuvin thaayaakiya mariyaa'loadum, avarudaiya sakoathararoadungkooda orumanappattu, jepaththilum vea'nduthalilum thariththirunthaarka'l.
annaadka'lilea, seesharka'lil ea'rakku'raiya noot'rirupathupear koodiyirunthapoathu, avarka'l naduvilea peathuru ezhunthu nin'ru:
sakoathararea, iyeasuvaip pidiththavarka'lukku vazhikaattina yoothaasaikku'riththup parisuththaaavi thaaveethin vaakkinaal mun sonna veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'ra vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
avan engka'lil oruvanaaka e'n'nappattu, intha oozhiyaththilea pangku pet'ravanaayirunthaan.
aneethaththin kooliyinaal avan oru nilaththaich sampaathiththu, thalaikeezhaaka vizhunthaan; avan vayi'ruvediththu, kudalka'lellaam sarinthupoayit'ru.
ithu erusaleamilu'l'la kudika'l yaavarukkum therinthirukki'rathu; athinaalea antha nilam avarka'ludaiya paashaiyilea iraththanilam en'ru arththangko'l'lum akkelthamaa ennappattirukki'rathu.

sangkeetha pusthakaththilea: avanudaiya vaasasthalam paazhaakakkadavathu, oruvanum athil vaasampa'n'naathiruppaanaaka en'rum; avanudaiya ka'nkaa'nippai vea'roruvan pe'rakkadavan en'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aathalaal, yoavaan gnaanasnaanangkoduththa naa'lmutha'rko'ndu, karththaraakiya iyeasuvaanavar nammidaththilirunthu uyara eduththukko'l'lappatta naa'lvaraikkum,

avar nammidaththil sagnchariththiruntha kaalangka'lilellaam engka'ludaneakooda iruntha manusharka'lil oruvan avar uyiroadezhunthathaikku'riththu, engka'ludaneakoodach saadchiyaaka ea'rpaduththappadavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l yusthu ennum ma'runaamamu'l'la parsapaa ennappatta yoaseappum maththiyaavum aakiya ivvira'ndupearaiyum ni'ruththi:

ellaarudaiya iruthayangka'laiyum a'rinthirukki'ra karththaavea, yoothaas enpavan thanakkuriya idaththukkup poakumpadi izhanthupoana intha oozhiyaththilum intha appoasthalappattaththilum pangku pe'ruvatha'rkaaka,
ivvira'ndu pearil theavareer therinthuko'ndavanai engka'lukkuk kaa'npiththaru'lum en'ru jepampa'n'ni;
pinpu, avarka'laikku'riththuch seettuppoattaarka'l; seettu maththiyaavinpearukku vizhunthathu; appozhuthu avan pathinoru appoasthalarudanea searththukko'l'lappattaan.
penthekosthea ennum naa'l vanthapoathu, avarka'lellaarum orumanappattu oaridaththilea vanthirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu palaththa kaat'ru adikki'ra muzhakkampoala, vaanaththilirunthu sadithiyaay oru muzhakkamu'ndaaki, avarka'l udkaarnthiruntha veedu muzhuvathaiyum nirappit'ru.
allaamalum akkinimayamaana naavuka'lpoalap pirinthirukkum naavuka'l avarka'lukkuk kaa'nappattu, avarka'l ovvoruvarmealum vanthu amarnthathu.
avarka'lellaarum parisuththaaaviyinaalea nirappappattu, aaviyaanavar thangka'lukkuth thantharu'lina varaththinpadiyea vevvea'ru paashaika'lilea peasaththodangkinaarka'l.
vaanaththinkeezhirukki'ra sakala theasaththaarilumirunthuvantha theavapakthiyu'l'la yootharka'l appozhuthu erusaleamilea vaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.
anthach saththam u'ndaanapoathu, thira'laana janangka'l koodivanthu, thangka'l thangka'l paashaiyilea avarka'l peasuki'rathai avaravarka'l keattapadiyinaalea kalakkamadainthaarka'l.
ellaarum piramiththu aachchariyappattu, oruvaraiyoruvar paarththu: ithoa, peasuki'ra ivarka'lellaarum kalileayarallavaa?
appadiyirukka, nammil avaravarka'ludaiya jenmapaashaika'lilea ivarka'l peasak keadki'roamea, itheppadi?
paarththarum, meatharum, elaameeththarum, mesoppoththaamiyaa, yootheayaa, kappaththoakkiyaa, ponthu, aasiyaa, pirikiyaa,

pampiliyaa, ekipthu ennum theasaththaarka'lum, sireaneapatta'naththaich sut'riyirukki'ra leepiyaavin thisaika'lilea kudiyirukki'ravarka'lum, ingkea sagncharikki'ra roamaapuriyaarum, yootharum, yoothamaarkkaththamainthavarka'lum,
kireaththarum, arapiyarumaakiya naam nammudaiya paashaika'lilea ivarka'l theavanudaiya makaththuvangka'laip peasakkeadki'roamea en'raarka'l.
ellaarum piramiththuch santheakappattu, ithennamaay mudiyumoa en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarka'l.
mat'ravarka'loa: ivarka'l mathupaanaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'raarka'len'ru pariyaasampa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu peathuru pathinoruvaroadungkooda nin'ru, avarka'lai noakki, uraththa saththamaay: yootharka'lea, erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra janangka'lea, neengka'lellaarum a'rinthuko'lveerka'laaka, en vaarththaika'lukkuch sevikodungka'l.
neengka'l ninaikki'rapadi ivarka'l ve'riko'ndavarka'lalla, pozhuthu vidinthu moon'raam ma'ni vea'laiyaayirukki'rathea.
theerkkatharisiyaakiya yoavealinaal uraikkappattapadiyea ithu nadanthea'ruki'rathu.

kadaisinaadka'lil naan maamsamaana yaavarmealum en aaviyai oot'ruvean, appozhuthu ungka'l kumaararum ungka'l kumaaraththika'lum theerkkatharisanagnsolluvaarka'l; ungka'l vaalipar tharisanangka'lai adaivaarka'l; ungka'l mooppar soppanangka'laik kaa'npaarka'l;
ennudaiya oozhiyakkaararmealum, ennudaiya oozhiyakkaarika'lmealum annaadka'lil en aaviyai oot'ruvean, appozhuthu avarka'l theerkkatharisanagnsolluvaarka'l.
allaamalum uyara vaanaththilea a'rputhangka'laiyum, thaazhap poomiyilea iraththam, akkini, pukaikkaadaakiya athisayangka'laiyum kaattuvean.
karththarudaiya perithum pirakaasamumaana naa'l varumunnea sooriyan iru'laakavum, santhiran iraththamaakavum maa'rum.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avan iradchikkappaduvaan en'ru theavan uraiththirukki'raar.

isravealarea, naan sollum vaarththaika'laik kea'lungka'l; neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rapadi nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaikko'ndu theavan ungka'lukku'l'lea palaththa seykaika'laiyum, a'rputhangka'laiyum, adaiyaa'langka'laiyum nadappiththu, avaika'linaalea avarai ungka'lukku ve'lippaduththinaar.

appadiyirunthum, theavan nir'nayiththiruntha aaloasanaiyinpadiyeayum, avarudaiya munna'rivinpadiyeayum oppukkodukkappatta antha iyeasuvai neengka'l pidiththu, akkiramakkaararudaiya kaika'linaalea siluvaiyil aa'niyadiththuk kolaiseytheerka'l.
