theavan avarudaiya mara'na upaathika'lin kattai avizhththu, avarai ezhuppinaar; avar mara'naththinaal kattappattirukkakkoodaathirunthathu.
avaraikku'riththuth thaaveethu: karththarai eppozhuthum enakku munpaaka ni'ruththi noakkikko'ndirukki'rean; naan asaikkappadaathapadi avar en valathupaarisaththilea irukki'raar;
athinaalea en iruthayam makizhnthathu, en naavu ka'likoornthathu, en maamsamum nampikkaiyoadea thangkiyirukkum;
en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththil videer, ummudaiya parisuththar azhivaikkaa'navotteer;
jeevamaarkkangka'lai enakkuth theriyappaduththineer; ummudaiya sannithaanaththilea ennaich santhoashaththinaal nirappuveer en'ru solluki'raan.

sakoathararea, koaththiraththalaivanaakiya thaaveethaikku'riththu naan ungka'ludanea thairiyamaayp peasuki'ratha'rku idangkodungka'l; avan mara'namadainthu adakkampa'n'nappattaan; avanudaiya kalla'rai innaa'lvaraikkum nammidaththilirukki'rathu.

avan theerkkatharisiyaayirunthu: un singkaasanaththil veet'rirukka maamsaththinpadi un santhathiyilea ki'risthuvai ezhumpappa'n'nuvean en'ru theavan thanakkuch saththiyampa'n'ninathai a'rinthapadiyaal,
avan ki'risthuvinudaiya aaththumaa paathaa'laththilea vidappaduvathillaiyen'rum, avarudaiya maamsam azhivaik kaa'npathillaiyen'rum munna'rinthu, avar uyirththezhuthalaikku'riththu ippadich sonnaan.
intha iyeasuvaith theavan ezhuppinaar; itha'rku naangka'lellaarum saadchika'laayirukki'roam.

avar theavanudaiya valathukaraththinaalea uyarththappattu, pithaa aru'liya vaakkuththaththaththinpadi parisuththaaaviyaip pet'ru, neengka'l ippozhuthu kaa'nki'rathum keadki'rathumaakiya ithaip pozhintharu'linaar.
thaaveethu paraloakaththi'rku ezhunthu poakavillaiyea. naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum,
neer en valathupaarisaththil udkaarumen'ru karththar en aa'ndavarudanea sonnaar en'ru avanea solliyirukki'raan.
aakaiyinaal, neengka'l siluvaiyil a'raintha intha iyeasuvaiyea theavan aa'ndavarum ki'risthuvumaakkinaaren'ru israveal kudumpaththaar yaavarum nichchayamaay a'riyakkadavarka'l en'raan.
ithai avarka'l keattapozhuthu, iruthayaththilea kuththappattavarka'laaki, peathuruvaiyum mat'ra appoasthalaraiyum paarththu: sakoathararea, naangka'l ennaseyyavea'ndum en'raarka'l.

peathuru avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l mananthirumpi, ovvoruvarum paavamannippukken'ru iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea gnaanasnaanam pet'rukko'l'lungka'l, appozhuthu parisuththaaaviyin varaththaip pe'ruveerka'l.
vaakkuththaththamaanathu ungka'lukkum, ungka'l pi'l'laika'lukkum, nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththar varavazhaikkum thooraththilu'l'la yaavarukkum u'ndaayirukki'rathu en'ru solli;
innum aneaka vaarththaika'laalum saadchikoo'ri, maa'rupaadu'l'la inthach santhathiyai vittu vilaki ungka'lai iradchiththukko'l'lungka'l en'rum puththisonnaan.
avanudaiya vaarththaiyaich santhoashamaay eat'rukko'ndavarka'l gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l. an'raiyaththinam ea'rakku'raiya moovaayirampear searththukko'l'lappattaarka'l.
avarka'l appoasthalarudaiya upatheasaththilum, anniyoanniyaththilum, appam pidkuthalilum, jepampa'n'nuthalilum u'ruthiyaayth thariththirunthaarka'l.
ellaarukkum payamu'ndaayit'ru. appoasthalarka'laalea aneaka a'rputhangka'lum adaiyaa'langka'lum seyyappattathu.
visuvaasika'lellaarum orumiththirunthu, sakalaththaiyum pothuvaay vaiththu anupaviththaarka'l.
kaa'niyaadchika'laiyum aasthika'laiyum vit'ru, ovvoruvanukkum theavaiyaanatha'rkuththakkathaaka avaika'lil ellaarukkum pakirnthukoduththaarka'l.
avarka'l orumanappattavarka'laayth theavaalayaththilea anuthinamum thariththirunthu, veeduka'lthoa'rum appampittu makizhchchiyoadum kapadamillaatha iruthayaththoadum poajanampa'n'ni,
theavanaith thuthiththu, janangka'lellaaridaththilum thayavupet'rirunthaarka'l. iradchikkappaduki'ravarka'laik karththar anuthinamum sapaiyilea searththukko'ndu vanthaar.
jepavea'laiyaakiya onpathaamma'ni nearaththilea peathuruvum yoavaanum theavaalayaththukkup poanaarka'l.

appozhuthu than thaayin vayit'rilirunthu sappaa'niyaayp pi'rantha oru manushanaich sumanthuko'nduvanthaarka'l; theavaalayaththilea piraveasikki'ravarka'lidaththil pichchaikeadkumpadi, naadoa'rum avanai alangkaara vaasal ennappatta theavaalaya vaasala'ndaiyilea vaippaarka'l.
theavaalayaththilea piraveasikkappoaki'ra peathuruvaiyum yoavaanaiyum avan ka'ndu pichchaikeattaan.
peathuruvum yoavaanum avanai ut'ruppaarththu: engka'lai noakkippaar en'raarka'l.
avan avarka'lidaththil eathaakilum kidaikkumen'ru e'n'ni, avarka'lai noakkippaarththaan.
appozhuthu peathuru: ve'l'liyum ponnum ennidaththilillai; ennidaththilu'l'lathai unakkuth tharuki'rean; nasareayanaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea nee ezhunthu nada en'ru solli;
valathukaiyinaal avanaip pidiththuth thookkivittaan; udanea avanudaiya kaalka'lum karaduka'lum pelanko'ndathu.
avan kuthiththezhunthu nin'ru nadanthaan; nadanthu, kuthiththu, theavanaith thuthiththukko'ndu, avarka'ludaneakoodath theavaalayaththi'rku'l piraveasiththaan.
avan nadakki'rathaiyum, theavanaith thuthikki'rathaiyum, janangka'lellaarum ka'ndu:
theavaalayaththin alangkaara vaasala'ndaiyilea pichchaikeadka udkaarnthirunthavan ivanthaan en'ru a'rinthu, avanukkuch sampaviththathaikku'riththu mikavum aachchariyappattup piramiththaarka'l.
ku'namaakkappatta sappaa'ni peathuruvaiyum yoavaanaiyum pat'rikko'ndirukkaiyil, janangka'lellaarum piramiththu, saalomoan ma'ndapam ennappatta ma'ndapaththilea avarka'lidaththi'rku oadivanthaarka'l.

peathuru athaik ka'ndu janangka'lai noakki: isravealarea, ithaikku'riththu neengka'l aachchariyappaduki'rathenna? naangka'l engka'l suyasakthiyinaalaavathu, engka'l suyapakthiyinaalaavathu, ivanai nadakkappa'n'ninoamen'ru neengka'l engka'lai noakkip paarkki'rathenna?

aapirakaam eesaakku yaakkoapu enpavarka'ludaiya theavanaakiya nammudaiya pithaakka'lin theavan thammudaiya pi'l'laiyaakiya iyeasuvai makimaippaduththinaar; avarai neengka'l oppukkoduththeerka'l; pilaaththu avarai viduthalaiyaakkath theermaaniththapoathu, avanukkumunpaaka avarai ma'ruthaliththeerka'l.
parisuththamum neethiyumu'l'lavarai neengka'l ma'ruthaliththu, kolaipaathakanai ungka'lukkaaka viduthalaipa'n'navea'ndumen'ru keattu,
jeevaathipathiyaik kolaiseytheerka'l; avaraith theavan mariththoarilirunthezhuppinaar; atha'rku naangka'l saadchika'laayirukki'roam.

avarudaiya naamaththaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea avarudaiya naamamea neengka'l paarththu a'rinthirukki'ra ivanaip pelappaduththinathu; avaraal u'ndaakiya visuvaasamea ungka'lellaarukkum munpaaka, inthach sarvaangka sukaththai ivanukkuk koduththathu.
sakoathararea, neengka'lum ungka'l athikaarika'lum a'riyaamaiyinaalea ithaichseytheerka'len'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
ki'risthu paadupadavea'ndumen'ru theavan thammudaiya theerkkatharisika'lellaarudaiya vaakkinaalum munna'riviththavaika'lai ivvithamaay ni'raiveat'rinaar.
aanapadiyinaalea karththarudaiya sannithaanaththilirunthu i'laippaa'ruthalin kaalangka'l varumpadikkum, munnea ku'rikkappatta iyeasuki'risthuvai avar ungka'lidaththil anuppumpadikkum,
ungka'l paavangka'l nivirththiseyyappadumporuttu neengka'l mananthirumpik ku'nappadungka'l.

ulakaththoat'ramuthal theavan thammudaiya parisuththa theerkkatharisika'lellaarudaiya vaakkinaalum uraiththavaika'l ellaam ni'raivea'rith theerungkaalangka'l varuma'lavum paraloakam avarai eat'rukko'l'lavea'ndum.

moasea pithaakka'lai noakki: ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ennaippoala oru theerkkatharisiyai ungka'lukkaaka ungka'l sakoathararilirunthu ezhumpappa'n'nuvaar; avar ungka'lukkuchsollum ellaavat'rilum avarukkuch sevikoduppeerka'laaka.
anthath theerkkatharisiyin so'rkea'laathavanevanoa, avan janaththiliraathapadikku nirmoolamaakkappaduvaan en'raan.
saamuveal mutha'rko'ndu, eththanaipear theerkkatharisanam uraiththaarka'loa, aththanaipearum intha naadka'lai munna'riviththaarka'l.

neengka'l anthath theerkkatharisika'lukkup puththiraraayirukki'reerka'l; un santhathiyinaalea poomiyilu'l'la vamsangka'lellaam aaseervathikkappadum en'ru theavan aapirakaamukkuch solli, nammudaiya munnoarka'loadea pa'n'nina udanpadikkaikkum puththiraraayirukki'reerka'l.

avar ungka'lellaaraiyum ungka'l pollaangkuka'lilirunthu vilakki, ungka'lai aaseervathikkumpadi theavan thammudaiya pi'l'laiyaakiya iyeasuvai ezhuppi, muthalaavathu ungka'lidaththi'rkea avarai anuppinaar en'raan.
avarka'l janangka'ludanea peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, aasaariyarka'lum theavaalayaththuch seanaiththalaivanum sathuseayarum avarka'lidaththil vanthu,
avarka'l janangka'lukku upatheasikki'rathinaalum, iyeasuvai munnittu, mariththoarilirunthu uyirththezhuthalaip pirasangkikki'rathinaalum, sinangko'ndu,
avarka'laip pidiththu, saayangkaalamaayirunthapadiyinaal, ma'runaa'lvaraikkum kaavalil vaiththaarka'l.
vasanaththaik keattavarka'lil aneakar visuvaasiththaarka'l; avarka'l thokai ea'rakku'raiya aiyaayiramaayirunthathu.
ma'runaa'lilea janangka'ludaiya athikaarika'lum moopparum veathapaarakarum,
pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya annaavum, kaaypaavum, yoavaanum, aleksantharum, pirathaana aasaariyarudaiya kudumpaththaar yaavarum erusaleamilea koottangkoodi,
avarka'lai naduvea ni'ruththi: neengka'l entha vallamaiyinaalea, entha naamaththinaalea, ithaich seytheerka'l en'ru keattaarka'l.
appozhuthu peathuru parisuththaaaviyinaalea ni'rainthu, avarka'lai noakki: janaththin athikaarika'lea, isravealin moopparka'lea,
pi'niyaa'liyaayiruntha intha manushanukkuch seyyappatta upakaaraththaikku'riththu ethinaalea ivan aaroakkiyamaanaanen'ru neengka'l in'ru engka'lidaththil visaariththukkeattaal,

ungka'laal siluvaiyil a'raiyappattavarum, theavanaal mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppappattavarumaayirukki'ra nasareayanaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaaleayea ivan ungka'lukku munpaakach sosthamaay ni'rki'raanen'ru ungka'lellaarukkum, israveal janangka'lellaarukkum therinthirukkakkadavathu.
veedukattuki'ravarka'laakiya ungka'laal a'rpamaay e'n'nappatta avarea moolaikkuth thalaikkallaanavar.

avaraaleayan'ri vea'roruvaraalum iradchippu illai; naam iradchikkappadumpadikku vaanaththin keezhengkum, manusharka'lukku'l'lea avarudaiya naamameayallaamal vea'roru naamam katta'laiyidappadavum illai en'raan.

peathuruvum yoavaanum peasuki'ra thairiyaththai avarka'l ka'ndu, avarka'l padippa'riyaathavarka'len'rum peathaimaiyu'l'lavarka'len'rum a'rinthapadiyinaal aachchariyappattu, avarka'l iyeasuvudaneakooda irunthavarka'len'rum a'rinthuko'ndaarka'l.
sosthamaakkappatta manushan avarka'l arukea ni'rki'rathaik ka'ndapadiyaal, ethirpeasa avarka'lukku idamillaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu avarka'lai aaloasanaich sangkaththaivittu ve'liyea poakumpadi katta'laiyittu, thangka'lukku'l'lea yoasanaipa'n'nikko'ndu:

intha manusharai naam enna seyyalaam? erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra ellaarukkum therinthirukki'rapadi ve'liyarangkamaana a'rputham ivarka'laal seyyappattathea, athai naam illaiyen'ru sollakkoodaathu.

aakilum ithu athikamaay janaththukku'l'lea parampaathapadikku, ithumuthal oruvaroadum intha naamaththaikku'riththup peasakkoodaathen'ru, avarka'lai u'ruthiyaayp payamu'ruththavea'ndumen'ru sollikko'ndu,
avarka'lai azhaiththu: iyeasuvin naamaththaikku'riththu evva'lavum peasavum poathikkavum koodaathen'ru avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaarka'l.

peathuruvum yoavaanum avarka'lukkup pirathiyuththaramaaka: theavanukkuch sevikodukki'rathaippaarkkilum ungka'lukkuch sevikodukki'rathu theavanukku munpaaka niyaayamaayirukkumoa en'ru neengka'lea nithaaniththuppaarungka'l.
naangka'l ka'ndavaika'laiyum keattavaika'laiyum peasaamalirukkakkoodaathea en'raarka'l.

nadantha sangkathika'laikku'riththu ellaarum theavanai makimaippaduththinapadiyaal, janangka'lukkup payanthu avarka'laith tha'ndikka vakaiyon'rungkaa'naamal, avarka'laip payamu'ruththi vittuvittaarka'l.
a'rputhamaaych sosthamaakkappatta manushan naa'rpathu vayathukku mea'rpattavanaayirunthaan.
avarka'l viduthalaiyaakkappattapinpu, thangka'laich searnthavarka'lidaththil vanthu, pirathaana aasaariyarka'lum moopparka'lum thangka'lukkuch sonna yaavaiyum a'riviththaarka'l.

avarka'l athaik keattu, orumanappattuth theavanai noakkich saththamittu: karththaavea, neer vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum avaika'lilu'l'la yaavat'raiyum u'ndaakkina theavanaayirukki'reer.
pu'rajaathika'l kontha'liththu, janangka'l viruthaa kaariyangka'laich sinthippaanean en'rum,

karththarukku viroathamaakavum avarudaiya ki'risthuvukku viroathamaakavum poomiyin raajaakka'l ezhumpi nin'ru, athikaarika'l eakamaayk koottangkoodinaarka'l en'rum theavareer ummudaiya thaasanaakiya thaaveethin vaakkinaal uraiththeerea.
anthappadi ummudaiya karamum ummudaiya aaloasanaiyum munku'riththavaika'l yaavaiyum seyyumpadi,

earoathum ponthiyupilaaththum, pu'rajaathika'loadum israveal janangka'loadungkooda, neer apisheakampa'n'nina ummudaiya parisuththa pi'l'laiyaakiya iyeasuvukku viroathamaay, meyyaakavea koottangkoodinaarka'l.
ippozhuthum, karththaavea, avarka'l payamu'ruththalka'laith theavareer kavaniththu,

ummudaiya parisuththa pi'l'laiyaakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea adaiyaa'langka'lum a'rputhangka'lum nadakkumpadi seythu, pi'niyaa'lika'laik ku'namaakkumpadi ummudaiya karaththai neetti, ummudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ummudaiya vasanaththai muzhu thairiyaththoadum sollumpadi avarka'lukku anukkirakagnseytharu'lum en'raarka'l.
avarka'l jepampa'n'ninapoathu, avarka'l koodiyiruntha idam asainthathu. avarka'lellaarum parisuththaaaviyinaal nirappappattu, theavavasanaththaith thairiyamaaych sonnaarka'l.

visuvaasika'laakiya thira'laana koottaththaar orea iruthayamum orea manamumu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'l. oruvanaakilum thanakku'l'lavaika'lil on'raiyum thannudaiyathen'ru sollavillai; sakalamum avarka'lukkup pothuvaayirunthathu.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvin uyirththezhuthalaikku'riththu appoasthalarka'l mikuntha palamaaych saadchikoduththaarka'l; avarka'lellaarmealum poora'na kirupai u'ndaayirunthathu.
nilangka'laiyum veeduka'laiyum udaiyavarka'l avaika'lai vit'ru, vi'rkappattavaika'lin kirayaththaik ko'nduvanthu,
appoasthalarudaiya paathaththilea vaiththaarka'l. avanavanukkuth theavaiyaanatha'rkuththakkathaayp pakirnthukodukkappattathu; avarka'lil oruvanukkum on'rum ku'raivaayirunthathillai.
seeppurutheevaanum leaviyanum appoasthalaraalea aa'ruthalin makan en'ru arththangko'l'lum parnapaa ennum ma'rupearpet'ravanumaakiya yoasea enpavan,
thanakku u'ndaayiruntha nilaththaivit'ru, athin kirayaththaik ko'nduvanthu, appoasthalarudaiya paathaththilea vaiththaan.
ananiyaa ennum pearu'l'la oruvanum, avanudaiya manaiviyaakiya sappeeraa'lum thangka'l kaa'niyaadchiyai vit'raarka'l.
than manaivi a'riya avan kirayaththilea oru pangkai vagnchiththuvaiththu, oru pangkaik ko'nduvanthu, appoasthalarudaiya paathaththilea vaiththaan.
peathuru avanai noakki: ananiyaavea, nilaththin kirayaththil oru pangkai vagnchiththuvaiththu, parisuththaaaviyinidaththil poysollumpadi, saaththaan un iruthayaththai nirappinathenna?

athai vi'rkum munnea athu unnudaiyathaayirukkavillaiyoa? athai vit'rapinpum athin kirayam un vasaththilirukkavillaiyoa? nee un iruthayaththilea ippadippatta e'n'nangko'ndathenna? nee manusharidaththil alla, theavanidaththil poysonnaay en'raan.
ananiyaa intha vaarththaika'laik keadkavea, vizhunthu jeevanai vittaan. ivaika'laik kea'lvippatta yaavarukkum mikuntha payamu'ndaayit'ru.
vaalipar ezhunthu, avanaich seelaiyil sut'ri, ve'liyea eduththukko'ndupoay, adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
ea'rakku'raiya moon'ru ma'ni nearaththukkuppinpu, avanudaiya manaivi nadanthathai a'riyaamal, u'l'lea vanthaa'l.
peathuru ava'lai noakki: nilaththai ivva'lavukkuththaanaa vit'reerka'l, enakkuch sol en'raan. ava'l: aam, ivva'lavukkuththaan en'raa'l.

peathuru ava'lai noakki: karththarudaiya aaviyaich soathikki'ratha'rku neengka'l orumanappattathenna? ithoa, un purushanai adakkampa'n'ninavarka'ludaiya kaalka'l vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthirukki'rathu, unnaiyum ve'liyea ko'ndupoavaarka'l en'raan.

udanea ava'l avanudaiya paathaththil vizhunthu jeevanai vittaa'l. vaalipar u'l'lea vanthu, ava'l mariththuppoanathaik ka'ndu, ava'lai ve'liyea eduththukko'ndupoay, ava'ludaiya purushana'ndaiyilea adakkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
sapaiyaarellaarukkum, ivaika'laik kea'lvippatta mat'ra yaavarukkum, mikuntha payamu'ndaayit'ru.
appoasthalarudaiya kaika'linaalea aneaka adaiyaa'langka'lum a'rputhangka'lum janangka'lukku'l'lea seyyappattathu. ellaarum orumanappattuch saalomoanudaiya ma'ndapaththil irunthaarka'l.
mat'ravarka'lil oruvarum avarka'ludanea searath thu'niyavillai. aakilum janangka'l avarka'lai meanmaippaduththinaarka'l.
thira'laana purusharka'lum sthireeka'lum visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laakik karththaridamaaka athikamathikamaaych searkkappattaarka'l.

pi'niyaa'lika'laip padukkaika'lin mealum kattilka'linmealum kidaththi, peathuru nadanthupoakaiyil avanudaiya nizhalaakilum avarka'lil silarmeal padumpadikku, avarka'lai ve'liyea veethika'lil ko'nduvanthu vaiththaarka'l.

sut'ruppatta'nangka'lilumirunthu thira'laana janangka'l pi'niyaa'lika'laiyum asuththa aavika'laal vaathikkappattavarka'laiyum erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthaarka'l; avarka'lellaarum ku'namaakkappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanum avanudaneakooda iruntha sathuseaya samayaththaaranaivarum ezhumpi, po'raamaiyinaal ni'rainthu,
appoasthalarka'laip pidiththu, pothuvaana si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththaarka'l.
karththarudaiya thoothan iraaththiriyilea si'raichsaalaiyin kathavuka'laith thi'ranthu, avarka'lai ve'liyea ko'nduvanthu:
neengka'l poay, theavaalayaththilea nin'ru, intha jeevavaarththaika'l ellaavat'raiyum janangka'lukkuch sollungka'l en'raan.

avarka'l athaikkeattu, athikaalamea theavaalayaththil piraveasiththup poathakampa'n'ninaarka'l. pirathaana aasaariyanum avanudaneakooda irunthavarka'lum vanthu, aaloasanaich sangkaththaaraiyum israveal puththirarin moopparellaaraiyum varavazhaiththu, appoasthalarka'laik ko'nduvarumpadi si'raichsaalaikkuch seavakarai anuppinaarka'l.
seavakar poay, si'raichsaalaiyilea avarka'laik kaa'naamal, thirumpivanthu:
si'raichsaalai mikuntha paththiramaayp poottappattirukkavum, kaava'rkaarar ve'liyea kathavuka'lukkumun ni'rkavum ka'ndoam; thi'ranthapozhuthoa u'l'lea oruvaraiyum kaa'noam en'ru a'riviththaarka'l.
inthach seythiyai aasaariyanum theavaalayaththaik kaakki'ra seanaiththalaivanum pirathaana aasaariyarka'lum keattapozhuthu, ithennamaay mudiyumoa en'ru, avarka'laikku'riththuk kalakkamadainthaarka'l.
appozhuthu oruvan vanthu: ithoa, neengka'l kaavalil vaiththa manushar theavaalayaththilea nin'ru janangka'lukkup poathakampa'n'nuki'raarka'l en'ru avarka'lukku a'riviththaan.
udanea seanaiththalaivan seavakaroadeakoodap poay, janangka'l kalle'rivaarka'len'ru payanthathinaal, palavanthampa'n'naamal avarka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan.
appadi avarka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, aaloasanaich sangkaththukku munpaaka ni'ruththinaarka'l. appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyan avarka'lai noakki:

neengka'l antha naamaththaikku'riththup poathakampa'n'nakkoodaathen'ru naangka'l ungka'lukku u'ruthiyaayk katta'laiyidavillaiyaa? appadiyirunthum, ithoa, erusaleamai ungka'l poathakaththinaalea nirappi, antha manushanudaiya iraththappazhiyai engka'lmeal sumaththavea'ndumen'rirukki'reerka'l en'ru sonnaan.
atha'rkup peathuruvum mat'ra appoasthalarum: manusharukkuk keezhppadiki'rathaippaarkkilum theavanukkuk keezhppadiki'rathea avasiyamaayirukki'rathu.
neengka'l maraththilea thookkik kolaiseytha iyeasuvai nammudaiya pithaakka'lin theavan ezhuppi,
isravealukku mananthirumputhalaiyum paavamannippaiyum aru'luki'ratha'rkaaka, avarai athipathiyaakavum iradchakaraakavum thamathu valathukaraththinaalea uyarththinaar.
inthach sangkathika'laikku'riththu naangka'l avarukkuch saadchika'laayirukki'roam; theavan thamakkuk keezhppadiki'ravarka'lukkuth thantharu'lina parisuththaaaviyum saadchi en'raarka'l.
athai avarka'l keattapozhuthu, moorkkamadainthu, avarka'laik kolaiseyyumpadikku yoasanaipa'n'ninaarka'l.

appozhuthu sakala janangka'laalum kanampet'ra niyaayasaasthiriyaakiya kamaaliyeal ennum pearko'nda oru pariseayan aaloasanaich sangkaththil ezhunthirunthu, appoasthalaraich sat'runearam ve'liyea ko'ndupoakachsolli,
sangkaththaarai noakki: isravealarea, intha manusharukku neengka'l seyyappoaki'rathaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

eanen'raal innaadka'lukku munnea theyuthaas enpavan ezhumpi, thannai oru periyavanaakap paaraattinaan; ea'rakku'raiya naanoo'rupear avanaich searnthaarka'l; avan madinthupoanaan; avanai nampina anaivarum sitha'ri, avamaayppoanaarka'l.

avanukkuppinpu, kudimathippin naadka'lilea, kalileayanaakiya yoothaas enpavan ezhumpi, thannaip pinpat'rumpadi aneaka janangka'lai izhuththaan; avanum azhinthupoanaan; avanai nampiyiruntha anaivarum sitha'radikkappattaarka'l.

ippozhuthu naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rathennaven'raal, intha manusharukku on'rugnseyyaamal ivarka'lai vittuvidungka'l. intha yoasanaiyum inthak kiriyaiyum manusharaal u'ndaayirunthathaanaal ozhinthupoam;
theavanaal u'ndaayirunthatheayaanaal, athai ozhiththuvida ungka'laal koodaathu; theavanoadea poarseyki'ravarka'laayk kaa'nappadaathapadikkup paarungka'l en'raan.

appozhuthu avarka'l avanudaiya yoasanaikku udanpattu, appoasthalarai varavazhaiththu, adiththu, iyeasuvin naamaththaikku'riththup peasakkoodaathen'ru katta'laiyittu, avarka'lai viduthalaiyaakkinaarka'l.
avarudaiya naamaththukkaakath thaangka'l avamaanamadaivatha'rkup paaththiraraaka e'n'nappattapadiyinaal, santhoashamaay aaloasanaich sangkaththaivittup pu'rappattuppoay,
thinanthoa'rum theavaalayaththileayum veeduka'lileayum idaividaamal upatheasampa'n'ni, iyeasuvea ki'risthuven'ru pirasangkiththaarka'l.

annaadka'lilea, seesharka'l perukinapoathu, kireakkaraanavarka'l, thangka'l vithavaika'l an'raadaka visaara'naiyil thittamaay visaarikkappadavillaiyen'ru, epireyarukku viroathamaay mu'rumu'ruththaarka'l.
appozhuthu panniruvarum seeshar koottaththai varavazhaiththu: naangka'l theavavasanaththaip poathiyaamal, panthivisaara'naiseyvathu thakuthiyalla.
aathalaal sakoathararea, parisuththaaaviyum gnaanamum ni'rainthu, na'rsaadchi pet'rirukki'ra eazhupearai ungka'lil therinthuko'l'lungka'l; avarka'lai intha vealaikkaaka ea'rpaduththuvoam.
naangka'loa jepampa'n'nuvathilum theavavasanaththaip poathikki'ra oozhiyaththilum idaividaamal thariththiruppoam en'raarka'l.

intha yoasanai sapaiyaarellaarukkum piriyamaayirunthathu. appozhuthu visuvaasamum parisuththaaaviyum ni'rainthavanaakiya stheavaanaiyum, pilippaiyum, pirokoaraiyum, nikkaanoaraiyum, theemoanaiyum, parmenaavaiyum, yoothamaarkkaththamainthavanaana anthiyoakiyaa patta'naththaanaakiya nikkolaavaiyum therinthuko'ndu,
avarka'lai appoasthalarukkumunpaaka ni'ruththinaarka'l. ivarka'l jepampa'n'ni, avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l.
theavavasanam viruththiyadainthathu; seesharudaiya thokai erusaleamil mikavum perukit'ru; aasaariyarka'lil aneakarum visuvaasaththukkuk keezhppadinthaarka'l.
stheavaan visuvaasaththinaalum vallamaiyinaalum ni'rainthavanaay janangka'lukku'l'lea periya a'rputhangka'laiyum adaiyaa'langka'laiyum seythaan.

appozhuthu liparththeenar ennappattavarka'lin aalayaththaich searnthavarka'lilum, sireanea patta'naththaarilum, aleksanthiriyaa patta'naththaarilum, silisiyaa naattaarilum, aasiyaa theasaththaarilum silar ezhumpi, stheavaanudanea tharkkampa'n'ninaarka'l.
avan peasina gnaanaththaiyum aaviyaiyum ethirththuni'rka avarka'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.
appozhuthu avarka'l: moaseakkum theavanukkum viroathamaaka ivan thoosha'na vaarththaika'laip peasakkeattoam en'ru sollumpadiyaaka manusharai ea'rpaduththi;
janangka'laiyum moopparaiyum veathapaarakaraiyum ezhuppivittu; avanmeal paaynthu, avanaip pidiththu, aaloasanaich sangkaththaarukku munpaaka izhuththukko'ndupoay;
poychsaadchika'laiyum ni'ruththinaarka'l. ivarka'l: intha manushan inthap parisuththa sthalaththukkum veathappiramaa'naththukkum viroathamaakath thoosha'na vaarththaika'lai oayaama'r peasuki'raan;
eppadiyen'raal, nasareayanaakiya antha iyeasu intha sthalaththai azhiththuppoattu, moasea namakkuk koduththa mu'raimaika'lai maat'ruvaanen'ru ivan sollakkeattoam en'raarka'l.
aaloasanaich sangkaththil udkaarnthiruntha anaivarum avanmeal ka'n'noakkamaayirunthu, avan mukam theavathoothan mukampoalirukkak ka'ndaarka'l.
pirathaana aasaariyan avanai noakki: kaariyam ippadiyaayirukki'rathu en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: sakoathararea, pithaakka'lea, kea'lungka'l. nammudaiya pithaavaakiya aapirakaam kaaraanoorilea kudiyirukki'ratha'rku munnamea mesoppoththaamiyaa naattilea irukkumpoathu makimaiyin theavan avanukkuth tharisanamaaki:
nee un theasaththaiyum un inaththaiyum vittup pu'rappattu, naan unakkuk kaa'npikkum theasaththukku vaa en'raar.

appozhuthu avan kaltheayar theasaththaivittup pu'rappattu, kaaraanoorilea vaasampa'n'ninaan. avanudaiya thakappan mariththapinpu, avvidaththai vittu neengka'l ippozhuthu kudiyirukki'ra iththeasaththi'rku avanai azhaiththukko'nduvanthu kudiyirukkumpadi seythaar.

ithilea oru adi nilaththaiyaakilum avanudaiya kaiyaadchikkuk kodaamalirukkaiyil, avanukkup pi'l'laiyillaathirukkumpoathu: unakkum unakkup pinvarum un santhathikkum ithaich suthantharamaakath tharuvean en'ru avanukku vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninaar.
anthappadi theavan avanai noakki: un santhathiyaar anniya theasaththil sagncharippaarka'l; aththeasaththaar avarka'lai adimaika'laakki, naanoo'ru varusham thunpappaduththuvaarka'l.
avarka'lai adimaippaduththum janaththaiyoa naan aakkinaikkudpaduththuvean. atha'rkuppinpu avarka'l pu'rappattuvanthu ivvidaththilea enakku aaraathanai seyvaarka'l en'raar.

mealum viruththaseathana udanpadikkaiyaiyum avanukku ea'rpaduththinaar. anthappadiyea avan eesaakkaip pet'rapoathu, ettaam naa'lilea avanai viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan. eesaakku yaakkoapaiyum, yaakkoapu pannira'ndu koaththirappithaakka'laiyum pet'raarka'l.
anthak koaththirappithaakka'l po'raamaiko'ndu yoaseappai ekipthukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadiyaaka vit'ruppoattaarka'l.

theavanoa avanudaneakooda irunthu, ellaa upaththiravangka'linin'rum avanai viduviththu, ekipthin raajaavaakiya paarvoan samukaththilea avanukkuk kirupaiyaiyum gnaanaththaiyum aru'linaar; antha raajaa avanai ekipthutheasaththi'rkum than veedanaiththi'rkum athikaariyaaka ea'rpaduththinaan.
pinpu ekipthu kaanaan ennum theasangka'lilengkum pagnchamum mikuntha varuththamum u'ndaaki, nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku aakaaram kidaiyaama'rpoayit'ru.
appozhuthu ekipthilea thaaniyam u'nden'ru yaakkoapu kea'lvippattu, nammudaiya pithaakka'lai muthalaantharam anuppinaan.
ira'ndaantharam yoaseappu thannudaiya sakoathararukkuth thannaith theriyappaduththinaan. yoaseappudaiya vamsamum paarvoanukkuth theriyavanthathu.
pinpu yoaseappu, thannudaiya thakappan yaakkoapum thannudaiya inaththaar yaavarumaakiya, ezhupaththainthupearai azhaikka anuppinaan.
anthappadi yaakkoapu ekipthukkup poanaan. avanum nammudaiya pithaakka'lum mariththu,
angkeayirunthu seekeamukkuk ko'nduvarappattu, aapirakaam seekeamin thakappanaakiya eamoarudaiya santhathiyaaridaththil rokkakkirayaththukku vaangkiyiruntha kalla'raiyil vaikkappattaarka'l.
aapirakaamukkuth theavan aa'naiyittu aru'lina vaakkuththaththam ni'raivea'rungkaalam sameepiththapoathu,
yoaseappai a'riyaatha vea'roru raajaa thoan'rina kaalama'lavum, janangka'l ekipthilea palukip perukinaarka'l.

avan nammudaiya janangka'lai vagnchanaiyaay nadappiththu, nammudaiya pithaakka'lin kuzhanthaika'l uyiroadiraathapadikku avarka'l avaika'lai ve'liyea poattuvidumpadi seythu, avarka'lai upaththiravappaduththinaan.
akkaalaththilea moasea pi'ranthu, thivviya savunthariyamu'l'lavanaayirunthu, moon'ru maathama'lavum than thakappan veettilea va'larkkappattaan.
avan ve'liyea poattuvidappattapoathu, paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththi avanai eduththuth thanakkup pi'l'laiyaaka va'larththaa'l.
moasea ekipthiyarudaiya sakala saasthirangka'lilum ka'rpikkappattu, vaakkilum seykaiyilum vallavanaanaan.
avanukku naa'rpathu vayathaanapoathu, israveal puththiraraakiya thannudaiya sakoathararaik ka'ndu santhikkumpadi avanudaiya iruthayaththil e'n'namu'ndaayit'ru.
appozhuthu avarka'lil oruvan aniyaayamaay nadaththappaduki'rathai avan ka'ndu, avanukkuth thu'nainin'ru, ekipthiyanai vetti, thunpappattavanukku niyaayagnseythaan.
thannudaiya kaiyinaalea theavan thangka'lukku iradchippaith tharuvaarenpathaith thannudaiya sakoatharar a'rinthuko'lvaarka'len'ru avan ninaiththaan; avarka'loa athai a'riyavillai.

ma'runaa'lilea sa'ndaipa'n'niko'ndirukki'ra ira'ndupearukku avan ethirppattu: manusharea, neengka'l sakoathararaayirukki'reerka'l: oruvarukkoruvar aniyaayagnseyki'rathenna en'ru, avarka'laich samaathaanappaduththumpadi peasinaan.
pi'ranukku aniyaayagnseythavan avanaip pidiththuth tha'l'li: engka'lmeal athikaariyaakavum niyaayaathipathiyaakavum unnai ea'rpaduththinavan yaar?
neat'ru nee antha ekipthiyanaik kon'rathupoala ennaiyum kon'rupoada manathaayirukki'raayoa en'raan.
intha vaarththaiyinimiththam moasea oadippoay, meethiyaan theasaththilea sagnchariththukko'ndirunthaan; angkea irukkumpoathu avanukku ira'ndu kumaararka'l pi'ranthaarka'l.
naa'rpathu varusham sen'rapinpu, seenaaymalaiyin vanaantharaththilea karththarudaiya thoothanaanavar mudchedi eriki'ra akkinijuvaalaiyilea avanukkuth tharisanamaanaar.
moasea anthath tharisanaththaik ka'ndu, athisayappattu, athai ut'ruppaarkkumpadi sameepiththuvarukaiyil:

naan aapirakaamin theavanum eesaakkin theavanum yaakkoapin theavanumaakiya un pithaakka'ludaiya theavanaayirukki'rean en'ru karththar thiruvu'lampat'rina saththam avanukku u'ndaayit'ru. appozhuthu moasea nadukkamadainthu, ut'ruppaarkkath thu'niyaamalirunthaan.
pinnum karththar avanai noakki: un paathangka'lilirukki'ra paatharadchaika'laik kazhat'rippoadu; nee ni'rki'ra idam parisuththa poomiyaayirukki'rathu.

ekipthilirukki'ra en janaththin upaththiravaththai naan paarkkavea paarththu, avarka'l perumoochchaikkeattu, avarka'lai viduvikkumpadi i'rangkinean; aakaiyaal, nee vaa, naan unnai ekipthi'rku anuppuvean en'raar.

unnai athikaariyaakavum niyaayaathipathiyaakavum ea'rpaduththinavan yaar en'ru solli avarka'l ma'ruthaliththiruntha intha moaseayaiththaanea theavan, mudchediyil avanukkuth tharisanamaana thoothanaalea, thalaivanaakavum meedpanaakavum anuppinaar.

ivanea avarka'lai angkeayirunthu azhaiththukko'nduvanthu, ekipthu theasaththileayum sivantha samuththiraththileayum, naa'rpathu varushakaalamaay vanaantharaththileayum, a'rputhangka'laiyum adaiyaa'langka'laiyum seythaan.

israveal puththirarai noakki: ungka'l theavanaakiya karththar ungka'l sakoathararilirunthu ennaippoala oru theerkkatharisiyai ungka'lukkaaka ezhumpappa'n'nuvaar, avarukkuch sevikoduppeerka'laaka en'ru sonnavan intha moaseayea.
seenaaymalaiyil thannudanea peasina thoothanoadum nammudaiya pithaakka'loadungkooda vanaantharaththilea sapaikku'l'lirunthavanum, namakkuk kodukkumpadi jeevavaakkiyangka'laip pet'ravanum ivanea.
ivanukku nammudaiya pithaakka'l keezhppadiya manathaayiraamal, ivanaith tha'l'livittu, thangka'l iruthayangka'lil ekipthukkuth thirumpi,

aaroanai noakki: ekipthutheasaththilirunthu engka'lai azhaiththukko'nduvantha antha moaseakku enna sampaviththathoa a'riyoam; aathalaal engka'lukku munsellum theyvangka'lai engka'lukku u'ndupa'n'num en'ru solli;
annaadka'lil oru kan'rukkuttiyai u'ndupa'n'ni, antha vikkirakaththi'rkup paliyittu, thangka'l kaiyin kiriyaika'lil ka'likoornthaarka'l.

appozhuthu theavan avarka'lai vittu vilaki, vaanaseanaikku aaraathanaiseyya avarka'lai oppukkoduththaar. athaikku'riththu: israveal vamsaththaarea, neengka'l vanaantharaththiliruntha naa'rpathu varushamvaraiyil kaa'nikkaika'laiyum palika'laiyum enakkuch seluththineerka'loa en'rum,

pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadi neengka'l u'ndaakkina soroopangka'laakiya moa'loakinudaiya koodaaraththaiyum, ungka'l theavanaakiya rempaan ennum nadchaththira soroopaththaiyum sumantheerka'lea; aakaiyaal ungka'laip paapiloanukku appu'raththilea kudipoakappa'n'nuvean en'rum, theerkkatharisika'lin pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.

mealum nee paarththa maathiriyinpadiyea saadchiyin koodaaraththai u'ndupa'n'nuvaayaaka en'ru moaseayudanea peasinavar katta'laiyitta pirakaaramaaka, anthak koodaaram vanaantharaththilea nammudaiya pithaakka'loadu irunthathu.

mealum, yoasuvaavudaneakooda nammudaiya pithaakka'l athaip pet'rukko'ndu, theavan avarka'lukku munpaakath thuraththivitta pu'rajaathika'ludaiya theasaththai avarka'l kattikko'l'lukaiyil, athai anthath theasaththil ko'nduvanthu, thaaveethin naa'lvaraikkum vaiththirunthaarka'l.
ivan theavanidaththil thayavu pet'rapadiyinaal, yaakkoapin theavanukku oru vaasasthalaththaith thaan kattavea'ndumen'ru vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.
saalomoanoa avarukku aalayaththaik kattinaan.
aakilum unnathamaanavar kaika'linaal seyyappatta aalayangka'lil vaasamaayiraar.
vaanam enakkuch singkaasanamum poomi enakkup paathapadiyumaayirukki'rathu; enakkaaka neengka'l eppadippatta veettaik kattuveerka'l; naan thangkiyirukkaththakka sthalam ethu;
ivaika'l ellaavat'raiyum ennudaiya karam u'ndaakkavillaiyaa en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru theerkkatharisi solliyirukki'raanea.

va'nangkaak kazhuththu'l'lavarka'lea, iruthayaththilum sevika'lilum viruththaseathanam pe'raathavarka'lea, ungka'l pithaakka'laippoala neengka'lum parisuththaaavikku eppozhuthum ethirththuni'rki'reerka'l.

theerkkatharisika'lil yaarai ungka'l pithaakka'l thunpappaduththaamalirunthaarka'l? neethipararudaiya varukaiyai munna'riviththavarka'laiyum avarka'l kolaiseythaarka'l. ippozhuthu neengka'l avarukkuth thuroakika'lum avaraik kolaiseytha paathakarumaayirukki'reerka'l.
theavathootharaikko'ndu neengka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththaip pet'rirunthum, athaik kaikko'l'laama'rpoaneerka'l en'raan.
ivaika'lai avarka'l keattapozhuthu, moorkkamadainthu, avanaip paarththup pallaik kadiththaarka'l.
avan parisuththaaaviyinaalea ni'rainthavanaay, vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, theavanudaiya makimaiyaiyum, theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil iyeasuvaanavar ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndu:
athoa vaanangka'l thi'ranthirukki'rathaiyum, manushakumaaran theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil ni'rki'rathaiyum kaa'nki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu avarka'l uraththasaththamaayk kookkuralittuth thangka'l kaathuka'lai adaiththukko'ndu, orumanappattu avanmeal paaynthu,
avanai nakaraththukkup pu'rampea tha'l'li, avanaik kalle'rinthaarka'l. saadchikkaarar thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kazhat'ri, savul ennappatta oru vaalipanudaiya paathaththinarukea vaiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu: karththaraakiya iyeasuvea, en aaviyai eat'rukko'l'lum en'ru stheavaan thozhuthuko'l'lukaiyil, avanaik kalle'rinthaarka'l.
avanoa, muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu: aa'ndavarea, ivarka'lmeal inthap paavaththaich sumaththaathirum en'ru mikuntha saththamittuch sonnaan. ippadich solli, niththiraiyadainthaan.

avanaik kolaiseyki'ratha'rkuch savulum sammathiththirunthaan. akkaalaththilea erusaleamilu'l'la sapaikku mikuntha thunpam u'ndaayit'ru. appoasthalarthavira, mat'ra yaavarum yootheayaa samaariyaa theasangka'lil sitha'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
theavapakthiyu'l'la manushar stheavaanai eduththu adakkampa'n'ni, avanukkaaka mikavum thukkangko'ndaadinaarka'l.
savul veeduka'lthoa'rum nuzhainthu, purusharaiyum sthireeka'laiyum izhuththukko'ndupoay, kaavalil poaduviththu, sapaiyaip paazhaakkikko'ndirunthaan.
sitha'rippoanavarka'l engkunthirinthu, suviseashavasanaththaip pirasangkiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu pilippenpavan samaariyaavilu'l'la oru patta'naththi'rkup poay, angku'l'lavarka'lukkuk ki'risthuvaikku'riththup pirasangkiththaan.
pilippu seytha athisayangka'lai janangka'l kea'lvippattuk ka'ndu, avanaal sollappattavaika'lai orumanappattuk kavaniththaarka'l.
aneakariliruntha asuththaaavika'l mikuntha saththaththoadea kooppittu avarka'lai vittup pu'rappattathu. aneakan thimirvaathakkaararum sappaa'nika'lum ku'namaakkappattaarka'l.
anthap patta'naththilea mikuntha santhoasham u'ndaayit'ru.
seemoan en'ru pearko'nda oru manushan anthap patta'naththilea maayaviththaikkaaranaayirunthu, thannai oru periyavanen'ru solli, samaariyaanaattu janangka'laip piramikkappa'n'nikko'ndirunthaan.
theavanudaiya perithaana sakthi ivanthaan en'ru e'n'ni, si'riyoar periyoar yaavarum avanukkuch sevikoduththuvanthaarka'l.
avan aneaka kaalamaayth thannudaiya maayaviththaika'linaalea avarka'laip piramikkappa'n'ninathinaal avanai mathiththuvanthaarka'l.

theavanudaiya raajyaththukkum iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya naamaththukkum eat'ravaika'laikku'riththu, pilippu pirasangkiththathai avarka'l visuvaasiththapoathu, purusharum sthireeka'lum gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
appozhuthu seemoanum visuvaasiththu gnaanasnaanam pet'ru, pilippaip pat'rikko'ndu, avanaal nadantha adaiyaa'langka'laiyum periya a'rputhangka'laiyum ka'ndu piramiththaan.
samaariyar theavavasanaththai eat'rukko'ndathai erusaleamilu'l'la appoasthalarka'l kea'lvippattu, peathuruvaiyum yoavaanaiyum avarka'lidaththi'rku anuppinaarka'l.
ivarka'l vanthapozhuthu avarka'lil oruvanum parisuththaaaviyaip pe'raamal karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea gnaanasnaanaththai maaththiram pet'rirunthavarka'laakak ka'ndu,
avarka'l parisuththaaaviyaip pet'rukko'l'lumpadi avarka'lukkaaka jepampa'n'ni,
avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththaarka'l, appozhuthu avarka'l parisuththaaaviyaip pet'raarka'l.
appoasthalar thangka'l kaika'lai avarka'lmeal vaiththathinaal parisuththaaavi thantharu'lappaduki'rathaich seemoan ka'ndapoathu, avarka'lidaththil pa'naththaik ko'nduvanthu:
naan evanmeal en kaika'lai vaikki'reanoa, avan parisuththaaaviyaip pe'raththakkathaaka enakkum intha athikaaraththaik kodukkavea'ndum en'raan.
peathuru avanai noakki: theavanudaiya varaththaip pa'naththinaalea sampaathiththukko'l'lalaamen'ru nee ninaiththapadiyaal un pa'nam unnoadeakooda naasamaayp poakakkadavathu.
un iruthayam theavanukkumunpaakach semmaiyaayiraathapadiyaal, intha vishayaththilea unakkup pangkumillai paakamumillai.
aakaiyaal nee un thurkku'naththai vittu mananthirumpi, theavanai noakki vea'ndikko'l; oruvea'lai un iruthayaththin e'n'nam unakku mannikkappadalaam.
nee kasappaana pichchilum paavakkattilum akappattirukki'rathaakak kaa'nki'rean en'raan.
atha'rkuch seemoan: neengka'l sonna kaariyangka'lil on'rum enakku nearidaathapadikku, enakkaakak karththarai vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l en'raan.

ivvithamaay avarka'l karththarudaiya vasanaththaich saadchiyaay a'riviththuch sonnapinpu, samaariyarudaiya aneaka kiraamangka'lil suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu, erusaleamukkuth thirumpi vanthaarka'l.
pinpu karththarudaiya thoothan pilippai noakki: nee ezhunthu, the'rkumukamaay erusaleamilirunthu kaasaa patta'naththukkup poaki'ra vanaantharamaarkkamaayp poa en'raan.

anthappadi avan ezhunthupoanaan. appozhuthu eththiyoappiyarudaiya raajasthireeyaakiya kanthaakea enpava'lukku manthiriyum ava'ludaiya pokkishamellaavat'ri'rkum thalaivanumaayiruntha eththiyoappiyanaakiya oruvan pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadi erusaleamukku vanthirunthu;
oorukkuth thirumpippoakumpoathu, than irathaththilea udkaarnthu, easaayaa theerkkatharisiyin aakamaththai vaasiththukko'ndirunthaan.
aaviyaanavar: nee poay, antha irathaththudanea searnthuko'l en'ru pilippudanea sonnaar.
appozhuthu pilippu oadippoaychsearnthu, avan easaayaa theerkkatharisiyin aakamaththai vaasikki'rathaik keattu: neer vaasikki'ravaika'lin karuththu umakkuth theriyumaa en'raan.
atha'rku avan: oruvan enakkuth therivikkaavittaal athu enakku eppadith theriyum en'ru solli; pilippu ea'ri, thannoadea udkaarumpadi avanai vea'ndikko'ndaan.

avan vaasiththa veathavaakkiyam ennaven'raal: avar oru aattaippoala adikkappaduvatha'rkuk ko'ndu poakappattaar; mayirkaththarikki'ravanukku munpaakach saththamidaathirukki'ra aattukkuttiyaippoala avar thamathu vaayaith thi'ravaathirunthaar.
avar thammaith thaazhththinapoathu avarudaiya niyaayam eduththuppoadappattathu; avarudaiya jeevan poomiyilirunthu edupattuppoayit'ru; avarudaiya vamsaththai yaaraalea sollimudiyum enpathea.
manthiri pilippai noakki: theerkkatharisi yaaraikku'riththu ithaich solluki'raar? thammaikku'riththoa, vea'roruvaraikku'riththoa? enakkuch sollavea'ndum en'ru keattukko'ndaan.
appozhuthu pilippu peasaththodangki, intha veathavaakkiyaththai munnittu iyeasuvaikku'riththu avanukkup pirasangkiththaan.

ivvithamaay avarka'l vazhinadanthupoakaiyil, tha'n'neeru'l'la oaridaththi'rku vanthaarka'l. appozhuthu manthiri: ithoa, tha'n'neer irukki'rathea, naan gnaanasnaanam pe'ruki'ratha'rkuth thadaiyenna en'raan.
atha'rkup pilippu: neer muzhu iruthayaththoadum visuvaasiththaal thadaiyillaiyen'raan. appozhuthu avan: iyeasuki'risthuvaith theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru visuvaasikki'rean en'ru solli;
irathaththai ni'ruththachsonnaan. appozhuthu pilippum manthiriyum aakiya iruvarum tha'n'neeril i'rangkinaarka'l; pilippu avanukku gnaanasnaanang koduththaan.
avarka'l tha'n'neerilirunthu karaiyea'rinapozhuthu, karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar pilippaik ko'ndupoayvittaar. manthiri appu'ram avanaik kaa'naamal, santhoashaththoadea than vazhiyea poanaan.
pilippu aasoaththilea kaa'nappattu, avvidaththilirunthu pirayaa'nampa'n'ni, sesariyaavukku varuki'ravaraiyil sakala patta'nangka'lilum suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththukko'nduvanthaan.
savul enpavan innung karththarudaiya seesharaip payamu'ruththik kolaiseyyumpadi see'rip pirathaana aasaariyaridaththi'rkup poay;

intha maarkkaththaaraakiya purusharaiyaakilum sthireeka'laiyaakilum thaan ka'ndupidiththaal, avarka'laik katti erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvarumpadi, thamaskuvilu'l'la jepaaalayangka'lukku nirupangka'laik keattu vaangkinaan.
avan pirayaa'namaayp poay, thamaskuvukkuch sameepiththapoathu, sadithiyilea vaanaththilirunthu oru o'li avanaich sut'rip pirakaasiththathu;
avan tharaiyilea vizhunthaan. appozhuthu: savulea, savulea, nee ennai ean thunpappaduththuki'raay en'ru thannudanea solluki'ra oru saththaththaik keattaan.
atha'rku avan: aa'ndavarea, neer yaar, en'raan. atha'rkuk karththar: nee thunpappaduththuki'ra iyeasu naanea; mu'l'lil uthaikki'rathu unakkuk kadinamaam en'raar.

avan nadungkith thikaiththu: aa'ndavarea, naan enna seyyach siththamaayirukki'reer en'raan. atha'rkuk karththar: nee ezhunthu, patta'naththukku'l'lea poa, nee seyyavea'ndiyathu angkea unakkuch sollappadum en'raar.
avanudaneakoodap pirayaa'nampa'n'nina manusharka'l saththaththaik keattum oruvaraiyung kaa'naamal piramiththu nin'raarka'l.
savul tharaiyilirunthezhunthu, than ka'nka'laith thi'ranthapoathu oruvaraiyung kaa'navillai. appozhuthu kailaaku koduththu, avanaith thamaskuvukkuk koottikko'ndupoanaarka'l.
avan moon'ru naa'l paarvaiyillaathavanaayp pusiyaamalum kudiyaamalum irunthaan.
thamaskuvilea ananiyaa ennum pearu'l'la oru seeshan irunthaan. avanukkuk karththar tharisanamaaki: ananiyaavea, en'raar. avan: aa'ndavarea, ithoa, adiyean en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar: nee ezhunthu nearththeruvu ennappatta theruvukkuppoay, yoothaavin veettilea tharsupatta'naththaanaakiya savul ennum pearu'l'la oruvanaith theadu; avan ippozhuthu jepampa'n'nuki'raan;
ananiyaa ennum pearu'l'la oru manushan thannidaththil varavum, thaan paarvaiyadaiyumpadi thanmeal kaivaikkavum tharisanangka'ndaan en'raar.
atha'rku ananiyaa: aa'ndavarea, intha manushan erusaleamilu'l'la ummudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukku eththanaiyoa pollaangkuka'laich seythaanen'ru avanaikku'riththu aneakaraal kea'lvippattirukki'rean.
ingkeayum ummudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ra yaavaraiyung kattumpadi avan pirathaana aasaariyarka'laal athikaaram pet'rirukki'raanea en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: nee poa; avan pu'rajaathika'lukkum raajaakka'lukkum israveal puththirarukkum ennudaiya naamaththai a'rivikki'ratha'rkaaka naan therinthuko'nda paaththiramaayirukki'raan.
avan ennudaiya naamaththinimiththam evva'lavaayp paadupadavea'ndumenpathai naan avanukkuk kaa'npippean en'raar.

appozhuthu ananiyaa poay, veettukku'l piraveasiththu, avanmeal kaiyai vaiththu: sakoatharanaakiya savulea, nee vanthavazhiyilea unakkuth tharisanamaana iyeasuvaakiya karththar, nee paarvaiyadaiyumpadikkum parisuththaaaviyinaalea nirappappadumpadikkum ennai anuppinaar en'raan.
udanea avan ka'nka'lilirunthu meen sethi'lka'l poan'ravaika'l vizhunthathu. avan paarvaiyadainthu, ezhunthirunthu, gnaanasnaanam pet'raan.
pinpu avan poajanampa'n'nip palappattaan. savul thamaskuvilu'l'la seesharudanea silanaa'l irunthu,
thaamathamin'ri, ki'risthu theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru aalayangka'lilea pirasangkiththaan.

keattavarka'lellaarum aachchariyappattu: erusaleamil intha naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'lai naasamaakki, ingkeayum appadippattavarka'laik kattip pirathaana aasaariyarka'lidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi vanthavan ivanallavaa en'raarka'l.
savul athikamaakath thidanko'ndu, ivarea ki'risthuven'ru thirushdaanthappaduththi, thamaskuvil kudiyirukki'ra yootharka'laik kalangkappa'n'ninaan.
aneakanaa'l sen'rapinpu, yootharka'l avanaik kolaiseyyumpadi aaloasanai pa'n'ninaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya yoasanai savulukkuth theriyavanthathu. avanaik kolaiseyyumpadi avarka'l iravum pakalum koattaivaasalka'laik kaaththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
seesharka'l iraaththiriyilea avanaik koottikko'ndupoay, oru koodaiyilea vaiththu, mathilvazhiyaay i'rakkivittaarka'l.
savul erusaleamukku vanthu, seesharudanea searnthuko'l'lap paarththaan; avarka'l avanaich seeshanen'ru nampaamal ellaarum avanukkup payanthirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu parnapaa enpavan avanaich searththukko'ndu, appoasthalaridaththil azhaiththukko'ndupoay, vazhiyilea avan karththaraik ka'nda vithaththaiyum, avar avanudanea peasinathaiyum, thamaskuvil avan iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea thairiyamaayp pirasangkiththathaiyum avarka'lukku vivariththuch sonnaan.
athanpinpu avan erusaleamilea avarka'lidaththil poakkum varaththumaayirunthu;
karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea thairiyamaayp pirasangkiththu, kireakkarudanea peasith tharkkiththaan; avarka'loa avanaik kolaiseyya eththanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
sakoatharar athai a'rinthu, avanaich sesariyaavukku azhaiththukko'ndupoay, tharsuvukku anuppivittaarka'l.

appozhuthu yootheayaa kalileayaa samaariyaa naaduka'lilengkum sapaika'l samaathaanam pet'ru, pakthiviruththiyadainthu, karththarukkup payappaduki'ra payaththoadum, parisuththaaaviyin aa'ruthaloadum nadanthu perukina.
peathuru poay ellaaraiyum santhiththuvarukaiyil, avan liththaa oorilea kudiyirukki'ra parisuththavaanka'lidaththi'rkum poanaan.
angkea ettu varushamaayk kattilinmeal thimirvaathamu'l'lavanaayk kidantha aineayaa ennum pearu'l'la oru manushanaik ka'ndaan.
peathuru avanaip paarththu: aineayaavea, iyeasuki'risthu unnaik ku'namaakkuki'raar; nee ezhunthu, un padukkaiyai neeyea poattukko'l en'raan. udanea avan ezhunthirunthaan.
liththaavilum saaroanilum kudiyirunthavarka'lellaarum avanaik ka'ndu, karththaridaththil thirumpinaarka'l.

yoappaa patta'naththil kireakkuppaashaiyilea tho'rkaa'l en'ru arththangko'l'lum thapeeththaa'l ennum pearudaiya oru seeshi irunthaa'l; ava'l na'rkiriyaika'laiyum tharumangka'laiyum mikuthiyaaych seythuko'nduvanthaa'l.
annaadka'lil ava'l viyaathippattu mara'namadainthaa'l. ava'laik ku'lippaatti, mealveettilea kidaththivaiththaarka'l.

yoappaa patta'nam liththaa oorukkuch sameepamaanapadiyinaalea, peathuru avvidaththil irukki'raanen'ru seesharka'l kea'lvippattu, thaamathamillaamal thangka'lidaththil varavea'ndumen'ru sollumpadi ira'ndu manusharai avanidaththi'rku anuppinaarka'l.

peathuru ezhunthu, avarka'ludanea koodappoanaan. avan poaych searnthapozhuthu, avarka'l avanai mealveettukku azhaiththukko'ndu poanaarka'l. appozhuthu vithavaika'lellaarum azhuthu, tho'rkaa'l thangka'ludaneakooda irukkaiyil seythiruntha angkika'laiyum vasthirangka'laiyum kaa'npiththu, avanaich soozhnthunin'raarka'l.

peathuru ellaaraiyum ve'liyea poakachseythu, muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu jepampa'n'ni, pireathaththin pu'ramaayth thirumpi: thapeeththaa'lea, ezhunthiru en'raan. appozhuthu ava'l than ka'nka'laith thi'ranthu, peathuruvaip paarththu udkaarnthaa'l.
avan ava'lukkuk kaikoduththu, ava'lai ezhunthirukkappa'n'ni, parisuththavaanka'laiyum vithavaika'laiyum azhaiththu, ava'lai uyiru'l'lava'laaka avarka'lukku mun ni'ruththinaan.
ithu yoappaa patta'nam engkum theriyavanthathu. appozhuthu aneakar karththaridaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'laanaarka'l.
pinpu avan yoappaa patta'naththilea thoal pathaniduki'ravanaakiya seemoan ennum oruvanidaththil aneakanaa'l thangkiyirunthaan.
iththaaliyaa pattaa'lam ennappatta pattaa'laththilea noot'rukku athipathiyaakiya kornealiyu ennum pearko'nda oru manushan sesariyaa patta'naththilea irunthaan.

avan theavapakthiyu'l'lavanum thanveettaaranaivaroadum theavanukkup payanthavanumaayirunthu, janangka'lukku mikuntha tharumangka'laich seythu, eppozhuthum theavanai noakki jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaan.
pakalil ea'rakku'raiya onpathaamma'ni nearaththilea theavanudaiya thoothan thannidaththil varavum, kornealiyuvea, en'ru azhaikkavum piraththiyadchamaayth tharisanangka'ndu,
avanai ut'ruppaarththu, payanthu: aa'ndavarea, enna en'raan. appozhuthu avan: un jepangka'lum un tharumangka'lum theavanukku ninaippoottuthalaaka avar sannithiyil vanthettiyirukki'rathu.
ippozhuthu nee yoappaa patta'naththukku manusharai anuppi, peathuru en'ru ma'rupearko'nda seemoanai azhaippi.
avan thoal pathaniduki'ravanaakiya seemoan ennum oruvanidaththilea thangkiyirukki'raan; avanudaiya veedu kadaloaraththilirukki'rathu. nee seyyavea'ndiyathai avan unakkuch solluvaan en'raan.
kornealiyu thannudanea peasina theavathoothan poanapinpu, than veettu manusharil ira'ndupearaiyum thannidaththil seavikki'ra poarchseavakaril theavapakthiyu'l'la oruvanaiyum azhaiththu,
ellaavat'raiyum avarka'lukku vivariththuch solli, avarka'lai yoappaa patta'naththukku anuppinaan.
ma'runaa'lilea avarka'l pirayaa'nappattu, anthap patta'naththukkuch sameepiththu varukaiyil, peathuru aa'raamma'ni nearaththilea jepampa'n'numpadi mealveettil ea'rinaan.
avan mikuntha pasiyadainthu saappida manathaayirunthaan; atha'rku avarka'l aayaththampa'n'nukaiyil, avan gnaanathirushdiyadainthu,
vaanam thi'ranthirukki'rathaakavum, naalumunaika'lum kattappatta periya thuppattiyaippoala oruvithamaana koodu thannidaththil i'rangkith tharaiyil vidappattirukki'rathaakavum,
athilea poomiyilu'l'la sakalavithamaana naalukaal jeevanka'lum, kaattumirukangka'lum, oorum piraa'nika'lum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'lum irukki'rathaakavum ka'ndaan.
allaamalum: peathuruvea, ezhunthiru, adiththup pusi en'ru avanukkuch sollum oru saththam u'ndaayit'ru.
atha'rkup peathuru: appadiyalla, aa'ndavarea, theettum asuththamumaayirukki'ra yaathon'raiyum naan orukkaalum pusiththathillai en'raan.
appozhuthu: theavan suththamaakkinavaika'lai nee theettaaka e'n'naathea en'ru ira'ndaantharamum saththam avanukku u'ndaayit'ru.
moon'raantharamum appadiyea u'ndaayit'ru. pinpu anthak koodu thirumpa vaanaththukku eduththukko'l'lappattathu.

appozhuthu peathuru, thaan ka'nda tharisanaththaikku'riththuth thanakku'l'lea santheakappadukaiyil, ithoa, kornealiyuvinaal anuppappatta manusharka'l seemoanudaiya veettai visaariththukko'ndu vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthu nin'ru:
peathuru en'ru ma'rupearko'nda seemoan ingkea thangkiyirukki'raaraa en'ru keattaarka'l.
peathuru anthath tharisanaththaik ku'riththuch sinthanai pa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil, aaviyaanavar: ithoa, moon'ru manushar unnaith theaduki'raarka'l.
nee ezhunthu, i'rangki, on'rukkugn santheakappadaamal, avarka'ludanea koodappoa; naanea avarka'lai anuppinean en'ru avanukkuch sonnaar.
appozhuthu peathuru kornealiyuvinaal thannidaththil anuppappatta manusharidaththi'rku i'rangkippoay: ithoa, neengka'l theaduki'ravan naanthaan, neengka'l vanthirukki'ra kaariyam enna en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l: neethimaanum, theavanukkup payappaduki'ravarum, yoothajanangka'lellaaraalum nallavaren'ru saadchi pet'ravarumaakiya kornealiyu ennum noot'rukku athipathi ummaith thammudaiya veettukku azhaippiththu, ummaal sollappadum vaarththaika'laik keadkumpadi parisuththa thoothanaalea theavayaththanamaayk katta'laipet'raar en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu peathuru avarka'lai u'l'lea azhaiththu, avarka'lukku upasaaragnseythu, ma'runaa'lilea avarka'ludaneakoodap pu'rappattaan; yoappaa patta'naththaaraakiya sakoathararil silarum avanudaneakoodap poanaarka'l.

ma'runaa'lilea sesariyaa patta'naththil piraveasiththaarka'l. kornealiyu than u'ravinmu'raiyaaraiyum thannudaiya viseashiththa sineakitharaiyum koodavaravazhaiththu, avarka'lukkaakak kaaththirunthaan.
peathuru u'l'lea piraveasikki'rapozhuthu, kornealiyu avanukku ethirko'ndupoay, avan paathaththil vizhunthu, pa'ninthuko'ndaan.
peathuru avanaith thookkiyeduththu: ezhunthirum, naanum oru manushanthaan en'raan.
avanudanea peasikko'ndu, u'l'lea poay, aneakar koodivanthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu,

avarka'lai noakki: anniya jaathiyaanoadea kalanthu avanidaththil poakkuvaravaayiruppathu yoothanaanavanukku vilakkappattirukki'rathen'ru neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l; appadiyirunthum, entha manushanaiyum theettu'l'lavanen'rum asuththanen'rum naan sollaathapadikku theavan enakkuk kaa'npiththirukki'raar.
aakaiyaal neengka'l ennai azhaippiththapoathu naan ethirpeasaamal vanthean. ippoathum enna kaariyaththukkaaka ennai azhaippiththeerka'l en'ru keadki'rean en'raan.

atha'rkuk kornealiyu: naalu naa'laikku munnea innearaththilea naan upavaasiththu, onpathaamma'ni nearaththil en veettilea jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthean; appozhuthu pirakaasamu'l'la vasthiranthariththa manushan oruvan enakku munpaaka nin'ru:
kornealiyuvea, un jepam keadkappattathu, un thaanatharumangka'l theavasannithiyil ninaiththaru'lappattathu.

yoappaa patta'naththukku aa'l anuppi, peathuru en'ru ma'rupearko'nda seemoanai varavazhaippaayaaka, avan kadaloaraththilea thoalpathaniduki'ravanaakiya seemoanudaiya veettilea thangkiyirukki'raan; avan vanthu unnidaththil peasuvaan en'raar.

anthappadiyea naan udanea ummidaththi'rku aa'l anuppinean; neer vanthathu nalla kaariyam; theavanaalea umakkuk katta'laiyidappatta yaavaiyum keadkumpadikku naangka'l ellaarum ippozhuthu ingkea theavasamukaththil koodiyirukki'roam en'raan.
appozhuthu peathuru peasaththodangki: theavan padchapaathamu'l'lavaralla en'rum,
entha janaththilaayinum avarukkup payanthirunthu neethiyaich seyki'ravan evanoa avanea avarukku ukanthavan en'rum nichchayamaay a'rinthirukki'rean.
ellaarukkum karththaraayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu avar samaathaanaththaich suviseashamaayk koo'ri, israveal puththirarukku anuppina vaarththaiyai a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
yoavaan gnaanasnaanaththaikku'riththup pirasangkiththapinpu, kalileayaa naadu mutha'rko'ndu yootheayaa theasamengkum nadantha sangkathi ithuvea.

nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvaith theavan parisuththaaaviyinaalum vallamaiyinaalum apisheakampa'n'ninaar; theavan avarudaneakooda irunthapadiyinaalea avar nanmaiseyki'ravaraayum pisaasin vallamaiyil akappatta yaavaraiyum ku'namaakkuki'ravaraayum sut'riththirinthaar.
yootharudaiya theasaththilum erusaleamilum avar seythavaika'lellaavat'ri'rkum naangka'l saadchika'laayirukki'roam. avarai maraththilea thookkik kolaiseythaarka'l.
moon'raam naa'lilea theavan avarai ezhuppip piraththiyadchamaayk kaa'numpadi seythaar.

aayinum ellaa janangka'lukkum piraththiyadchamaakumpadi seyyaamal, avar mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthapinpu avaroadea pusiththuk kudiththavarka'lum theavanaal munpu niyamikkappatta saadchika'lumaakiya engka'lukkea piraththiyadchamaakumpadi seythaar.

an'riyum avarea uyiroadirukki'ravarka'lukkum mariththoarka'lukkum theavanaal ea'rpaduththappatta niyaayaathipathiyen'ru janangka'lukkup pirasangkikkavum, saadchiyaaka oppuvikkavum, avar engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
avarai visuvaasikki'ravan evanoa avan avarudaiya naamaththinaalea paavamannippaip pe'ruvaanen'ru theerkkatharisika'lellaarum avaraikku'riththea saadchikodukki'raarka'l en'raan.
intha vaarththaika'laip peathuru peasikko'ndirukkaiyil vasanaththaikkeattavarka'l yaavarmealum parisuththa aaviyaanavar i'rangkinaar.
avarka'l pala paashaika'laip peasuki'rathaiyum, theavanaip pukazhuki'rathaiyum,
peathuruvoadeakooda vanthiruntha viruththaseathanamu'l'la visuvaasika'l keadkumpoathu, parisuththaaaviyin varam pu'rajaathika'lmealum pozhintharu'lappattathaikku'riththup piramiththaarka'l.
appozhuthu peathuru: nammaippoalap parisuththaaaviyaip pet'ra ivarka'lum gnaanasnaanam pe'raathapadikku evanaakilum tha'n'neerai vilakkalaamaa en'ru solli,
karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea avarka'lukku gnaanasnaanangkodukkumpadi katta'laiyittaan. appozhuthu silanaa'l angkea thangkumpadi avanai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
pu'rajaathiyaarum theavavasanaththai eat'rukko'ndaarka'len'ru yootheayaavilirukki'ra appoasthalarum sakoathararum kea'lvippattaarka'l.
peathuru erusaleamukkuth thirumpivanthapoathu, viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'l avanai noakki:
viruththaseathanamillaatha manusharidaththil neer poay, avarka'loadea poajanampa'n'nineer en'ru, avanoadea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l.
atha'rkup peathuru kaariyaththai muthalilirunthu varisaiyaay avarka'lukku vivarikkath thodangki:

naan yoappaa patta'naththil jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthapoathu gnaanathirushdiyadainthu, oru tharisanaththaikka'ndean; athennaven'raal, naalu munaika'lum kattappatta periya thuppattiyaippoala oru koodu vaanaththilirunthu ennidaththil i'rangkivanthathu.
athilea naan ut'ruppaarththuk kavanikki'rapoathu, poomiyilu'l'la naalukaal jeevanka'laiyum, kaattumirukangka'laiyum, oorum piraa'nika'laiyum, aakaayaththup pa'ravaika'laiyum ka'ndean.
allaamalum: peathuruvea, ezhunthiru, adiththup pusi en'ru ennudanea solluki'ra saththaththaiyum keattean.
atha'rku naan: aa'ndavarea, appadiyalla, theettum asuththamumaayirukki'ra yaathon'rum orukkaalum en vaaykku'l'lea poanathillai en'rean.
ira'ndaantharamum vaanaththilirunthu saththam u'ndaaki: theavan suththamaakkinavaika'lai nee theettaaka e'n'naatheayen'ru ma'rumozhi sollit'ru.
ippadi moon'rutharam sampaviththa pinpu, ellaam vaanaththi'rkuth thirumpa eduththukko'l'lappattathu.
udanea sesariyaavilirunthu ennidaththi'rku anuppappatta moon'ru manushar naan iruntha veettukkumunnea vanthu nin'raarka'l.

naan on'rukkum santheakappadaamal avarka'loadeakoodap poakumpadi aaviyaanavar enakkuk katta'laiyittaar. sakoathararaakiya intha aa'rupearum ennoadeakooda vanthaarka'l; antha manushanudaiya veettukku'l piraveasiththoam.
avanoa than veettilea oru theavathoothan ni'rki'rathaik ka'ndathaakavum, yoappaa patta'naththilirukki'ra peathuru en'ru ma'rupearko'nda seemoanai azhaikkumpadikku manusharai avvidaththi'rku anuppu;
neeyum un veettaaranaivarum iradchikkappaduvatha'rkeathuvaana vaarththaika'lai avan unakkuch solluvaan en'ru anthath thoothan thanakkuch sonnathaakavum engka'lukku a'riviththaan.
naan peasaththodangkinapoathu, parisuththa aaviyaanavar aathiyilea nammeal i'rangkinathupoalavea, avarka'lmealum i'rangkinaar.
yoavaan jalaththinaalea gnaanasnaanang koduththaan, neengka'loa parisuththa aaviyinaalea gnaanasnaanam pe'ruveerka'l en'ru karththar sonna vaarththaiyai appozhuthu ninaivukoornthean.

aathalaal karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai visuvaasiththirukki'ra namakkuth theavan varaththai anukkirakampa'n'ninathupoala avarka'lukkum antha varaththaiyea anukkirakampa'n'niyirukkumpoathu theavanaith thadukki'ratha'rku naan emmaaththiram en'raan.

ivaika'lai avarka'l keattapozhuthu amarnthirunthu: appadiyaanaal jeevanukkeathuvaana mananthirumputhalaith theavan pu'rajaathiyaarukkum aru'lichseythaar en'ru solli, theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.

stheavaan nimiththamaay ezhumpina upaththiravaththinaalea sitha'rappattavarka'l suviseasha vasanaththai yootharka'lukkeayan'ri mat'ra oruvarukkum a'riviyaamal, penikkeanaadu, seeppurutheevu, anthiyoakiyaa patta'namvaraikkum sut'riththirinthaarka'l.
avarka'lil seeppurutheevaarum sireanea patta'naththaarumaakiya silar anthiyoakiyaa patta'naththukku vanthu, kireakkarudanea peasik karththaraakiya iyeasuvaikku'riththup pirasangkiththaarka'l.
karththarudaiya karam avarka'loadea irunthathu; aneaka janangka'l visuvaasika'laaki, karththaridaththil thirumpinaarka'l.
erusaleamilu'l'la sapaiyaar inthak kaariyangka'laikku'riththuk kea'lvippattapoathu, anthiyoakiyaavaraikkum poakumpadikkup parnapaavai anuppinaarka'l.
avan poaych searnthu, theavanudaiya kirupaiyaik ka'ndapoathu, santhoashappattu, karththaridaththil mananir'nayamaay nilaiththirukkumpadi ellaarukkum puththisonnaan.
avan nallavanum, parisuththaaaviyinaalum visuvaasaththinaalum ni'rainthavanumaayirunthaan; aneaka janangka'l karththaridamaaych searkkappattaarka'l.
pinpu parnapaa savulaith theadumpadi, tharsuvukkup pu'rappattuppoay, avanaikka'ndu, anthiyoakiyaavukku azhaiththukko'nduvanthaan.

avarka'l oru varushakaalamaaych sapaiyoadea koodiyirunthu, aneaka janangka'lukku upatheasampa'n'ninaarka'l. muthal muthal anthiyoakiyaavilea seesharka'lukkuk ki'risthavarka'l enki'ra pear vazhangkit'ru.
annaadka'lilea erusaleamilirunthu sila theerkkatharisika'l anthiyoakiyaavukku vanthaarka'l.
avarka'lil oruvanaakiya akapu enpavan ezhunthu, ulakamengkum kodiya pagncham u'ndaakum en'ru aaviyaanavaraalea a'riviththaan; athu appadiyea kilavuthiyu raayanudaiya naadka'lilea u'ndaayit'ru.

appozhuthu seesharil avaravar thangka'l thangka'l thiraa'nikkuththakkathaaka yootheayaavil kudiyirukki'ra sakoathararukku uthaviyaakap pa'nagn seakariththu anuppavea'ndumen'ru theermaanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
appadiyea avarka'l seakariththu, parnapaa savul enpavarka'ludaiya kaiyilea koduththu, moopparidaththi'rku anuppinaarka'l.
akkaalaththilea earoathuraajaa sapaiyilea silaraith thunpappaduththaththodangki;
yoavaanudaiya sakoatharanaakiya yaakkoapaip pattayaththinaalea kolaiseythaan.
athu yootharukkup piriyamaayirukki'rathen'ru avan ka'ndu, peathuruvaiyum pidikkaththodarnthaan. appozhuthu pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikai naadka'laayirunthathu.

avanaip pidiththuch si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththu, paskaapa'ndikaikkup pinpu janangka'lukku munpaaka avanai ve'liyea ko'nduvaralaamen'ru e'n'ni, avanaik kaakkumpadi vakuppukku naanku poarchseavakaraaka ea'rpaduththiya naanku vakuppuka'lin vasamaaka oppuviththaan.
appadiyea peathuru si'raichsaalaiyilea kaakkappattirukkaiyil sapaiyaar avanukkaakath theavanai noakki ookkaththoadea jepampa'n'ninaarka'l.

earoathu avanai ve'liyea ko'nduvarumpadi ku'riththiruntha naa'lukku munthina naa'l iraaththiriyilea, peathuru ira'ndu sangkilika'linaalea kattappattu, ira'ndu seavakar naduvea niththiraipa'n'nikko'ndirunthaan; kaava'rkaararum kathavukku munnirunthu si'raichsaalaiyaik kaaththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan angkea vanthu nin'raan; a'raiyilea ve'lichcham pirakaasiththathu. avan peathuruvai vilaavilea thatti, seekkiramaay ezhunthiru en'ru avanai ezhuppinaan. udanea sangkilika'l avan kaika'lilirunthu vizhunthathu.

thoothan avanai noakki: un araiyaik katti, un paatharadchaika'laith thoduththukko'l en'raan. avan anthappadiyea seythaan. thoothan pinnum avanai noakki: un vasthiraththaip poarththukko'ndu en pinnea vaa en'raan.
anthappadiyea avan pu'rappattu avanukkup pinsen'ru, thoothanaal seyyappattathu meyyen'ru a'riyaamal, thaan oru tharisanangkaa'nki'rathaaka ninaiththaan.

avarka'l muthalaangkaavalaiyum ira'ndaangkaavalaiyum kadanthu, nakaraththi'rkuppoaki'ra iruppukkathava'ndaiyilea vanthapoathu athu thaanaay avarka'lukkuth thi'ravu'ndathu; athin vazhiyaay avarka'l pu'rappattu oru veethi neduka nadanthupoanaarka'l; udanea thoothan avanai vittuppoayvittaan.

peathuruvukkuth the'livu vanthapoathu: earoathin kaikkum yoothajanangka'lin e'n'nangka'lukkum ennai viduthalaiyaakkumpadikkuk karththar thammudaiya thoothanai anuppinaaren'ru naan ippozhuthu meyyaay a'rinthirukki'rean en'raan.
avan ippadi nichchayiththukko'ndu, maa'rku ennum pearko'nda yoavaanudaiya thaayaakiya mariyaa'l veettukku vanthaan; angkea aneakar koodi jepampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaarka'l.
peathuru vaasa'rkathavaith thattinapoathu roathai ennum pearko'nda oru pe'n ot'rukkeadka vanthaa'l.
ava'l peathuruvin saththaththai a'rinthu santhoashaththinaal kathavaith thi'ravaamal, u'l'leayoadi, peathuru vaasalukkumunnea ni'rki'raar en'ru a'riviththaa'l.
avarka'l: nee pithat'ruki'raay en'raarka'l. ava'loa avarthaanen'ru u'ruthiyaaych saathiththaa'l. appozhuthu avarka'l: avarudaiya thoothanaayirukkalaam en'raarka'l.
peathuru pinnum thattikko'ndirunthaan. avarka'l thi'ranthapoathu avanaik ka'ndu piramiththaarka'l.

avarka'l peasaamalirukkumpadi avan kaiyamarththi, karththar thannaik kaavalilirunthu viduthalaiyaakkina vithaththai avarka'lukku vivariththu, inthach seythiyai yaakkoapukkum sakoathararukkum a'riviyungka'l en'ru solli; pu'rappattu, vea'roru idaththi'rkup poanaan.
pozhuthu vidinthapinpu peathuruvaikku'riththuch seavakarukku'l'lea u'ndaana kalakkam kognchamalla.

earoathu avanaith theadik kaa'naama'rpoanapoathu, kaava'rkaararai visaara'naiseythu, avarka'laik kolaiseyyumpadi katta'laiyittu, pinpu yootheayaatheasaththai vittuch sesariyaa patta'naththukkuppoay, angkea vaasampa'n'ninaan.

akkaalaththilea earoathu theeriyarpearilum seethoaniyarpearilum mikavung koapamaayirunthaan. thangka'l theasam raajaavin theasaththinaal poashikkappattapadiyinaal, avarka'l orumanappattu, avanidaththil vanthu, raajaavin veettu visaara'naikkaaranaakiya pilaasthuvaith thangka'l vasamaakkich samaathaanam keattukko'ndaarka'l.
ku'riththanaa'lilea, earoathu raajavasthiram thariththukko'ndu, singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthu, avarka'lukkup pirasangkampa'n'ninaan.
appozhuthu janangka'l ithu manushasaththamalla, ithu theavasaththam en'ru aarppariththaarka'l.
avan theavanukku makimaiyaich seluththaathapadiyinaal udanea karththarudaiya thoothan avanai adiththaan; avan puzhuppuzhuththu i'ranthaan.
theavavasanam va'larnthu perukit'ru.
parnapaavum savulum tharma oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'rinapinpu maa'rku ennum ma'rupearko'nda yoavaanaik koottikko'ndu erusaleamaivittuth thirumpivanthaarka'l.

anthiyoakiyaa patta'naththilu'l'la sapaiyilea parnapaavum, neekar ennappatta simiyoanum, sireanea ooraanaakiya lookiyum, kaa'rpangku theasaathipathiyaakiya earoathudaneakooda va'larkkappatta manaayeenum, savulum, theerkkatharisika'laayum poathakarka'laayum irunthaarka'l.

avarka'l karththarukku aaraathanaiseythu, upavaasiththukko'ndirukki'rapoathu: parnapaavaiyum savulaiyum naan azhaiththa oozhiyaththukkaaka avarka'laip piriththuvidungka'l en'ru parisuththaaaviyaanavar thiruvu'lampat'rinaar.
appozhuthu upavaasiththu jepampa'n'ni, avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, avarka'lai anuppinaarka'l.
appadiyea avarka'l parisuththaaaviyinaal anuppappattuch selookkiyaapatta'naththukku vanthu, kappal ea'ri, angkirunthu seeppurutheevukkup poanaarka'l.
saalami patta'naththil vanthapoathu avarka'l yootharudaiya jepaaalayangka'lil theavavasanaththaip pirasangkiththaarka'l. yoavaanum avarka'lukku uthavikkaaranaayirunthaan.
avarka'l paappoa patta'namvaraikkum theevaik kadanthuvanthapoathu, paryeasu ennum pearko'nda maayaviththaikkaaranum ka'l'lath theerkkatharisiyumaana oru yoothanaik ka'ndaarka'l.

avan viveakamu'l'la manushanaakiya serkiyupavul ennum athipathiyudaneakooda irunthaan. antha athipathi parnapaavaiyum savulaiyum azhaippiththu, avarka'lidaththil theavavasanaththaik keadka aasaiyaayirunthaan.
maayaviththaikkaaran en'ru arththangko'l'lum pearaiyudaiya antha elimaa enpavan athipathiyai visuvaasaththinin'ru thiruppumpadi vakaitheadi, avarka'loadu ethirththunin'raan.
appozhuthu pavul en'ru sollappatta savul parisuththaaaviyinaal ni'rainthavanaay avanai ut'ruppaarththu:
ellaak kapadamum ellaap pollaangkum ni'rainthavanea, pisaasin makanea, neethikkellaam pakaignanea, karththarudaiya semmaiyaana vazhika'laip purattuvathil oayamaattaayoa?

ithoa, ippozhuthea, karththarudaiya kai unmeal vanthirukki'rathu, silakaalam sooriyanaik kaa'naamal nee kurudanaayiruppaay en'raan. udanea manthaaramum iru'lum avanmeal vizhunthathu; avan thadumaa'ri, kailaaku kodukki'ravarka'laith theadinaan.
appozhuthu athipathi sampaviththathaik ka'ndu, karththarudaiya upatheasaththaikku'riththu athisayappattu, visuvaasiththaan.

pinpu pavulum avanaich searnthavarka'lum paappoa patta'naththaivittuk kappal ea'rip pampiliyaavilirukkum perkea patta'naththukku vanthaarka'l. yoavaan avarka'lai vittup pirinthu, erusaleamukkuth thirumpippoanaan.
avarka'l perkea patta'naththai vittup pu'rappattu, piseethiyaa naattilu'l'la anthiyoakiyaavukku vanthu, oayvunaa'lilea jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththu, udkaarnthaarka'l.

niyaayappiramaa'namum theerkkatharisana aakamamum vaasiththumudinthapinpu: sakoathararea, neengka'l janangka'lukkup puththisolla virumpinaal sollungka'l en'ru sollumpadi jepaaalayaththalaivarka'l avarka'lidaththil aa'l anuppinaarka'l.
appozhuthu pavul ezhunthirunthu, kaiyamarththi: isravealarea, theavanukkup payanthu nadakki'ra sakala janangka'lea, kea'lungka'l.

isravealaraakiya intha janaththinudaiya theavan nammudaiya pithaakka'laith therinthuko'ndu, ekipthu theasaththil avarka'l paratheasika'laaych sagnchariththapoathu janangka'lai uyarththi, thamathu puyapalaththinaalea athilirunthu avarka'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni,
naa'rpathu varushakaalamaay vanaantharaththil avarka'lai aathariththu,
kaanaan theasaththil eazhu jaathika'lai azhiththu, avarka'ludaiya theasaththai ivarka'lukkuch suthantharamaakap pangkittukkoduththu,
pinpu ea'rakku'raiya naanoot'raimpathu varushakaalamaay saamuveal theerkkatharisivaraikkum avarka'lukku niyaayaathipathika'lai ea'rpaduththivanthaar.

athumuthal thangka'lukku oru raajaa vea'ndumen'ru keattukko'ndaarka'l; appadiyea theavan penyameen koaththiraththaanaakiya keesudaiya kumaaranaana savulai naa'rpathu varushakaalamaay avarka'lukkuk koduththaar.

pinpu avar avanaith tha'l'li, thaaveethai avarka'lukku raajaavaaka ea'rpaduththi, eesaayin kumaaranaakiya thaaveethai en iruthayaththukku eat'ravanaakak ka'ndean; enakkuch siththamaanavaika'laiyellaam avan seyvaan en'ru avanaikku'riththuch saadchiyung koduththaar.
avanudaiya santhathiyilea theavan thamathu vaakkuththaththaththinpadiyea isravealukku iradchakaraaka iyeasuvai ezhumpappa'n'ninaar.
ivar ve'lippaduvatha'rkumunnea mananthirumputhalukkeat'ra gnaanasnaanaththaikku'riththu yoavaan isravealar yaavarukkum pirasangkiththaan.

yoavaan than pa'nividai oattaththai ni'raiveat'ruki'rapoathu: neengka'l ennai yaar en'ru ninaikki'reerka'l, naan avar alla, ithoa, enakkuppin oruvar varuki'raar, avarudaiya paatharadchaiyai avizhkki'ratha'rkum naan paaththiran alla en'raan.
sakoathararea, aapirakaamin santhathiyil pi'ranthavarka'lea, theavanukkup payanthu nadakki'ravarka'lea, intha iradchippin vasanam ungka'lukku anuppappattirukki'rathu.

erusaleamil kudiyirukki'ravarka'lum avarka'l athikaarika'lum avarai a'riyaamalum, oayvunaa'lthoa'rum vaasikkappaduki'ra theerkkatharisika'lin vaakkiyangka'lai a'riyaamalum, avarai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththathinaal antha vaakkiyangka'lai ni'raiveat'rinaarka'l.
mara'naththi'rku eathuvaanathon'rum avaridaththil kaa'naathirunthum, avaraik kolaiseyyumpadikkup pilaaththuvai vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
avaraikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'ravaika'l yaavaiyum avarka'l ni'raiveat'rinapinpu, avarai maraththilirunthu i'rakki, kalla'raiyilea vaiththaarka'l.
theavanoa avarai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinaar.
thammudaneakoodak kalileayaavilirunthu erusaleamukkup poanavarka'lukku avar aneakanaa'l tharisanamaanaar; avarka'lea janangka'lukku munpaaka avarukkuch saadchika'laayirukki'raarka'l.
neer ennudaiya kumaaran, in'ru naan ummai jenippiththean en'ru ira'ndaam sangkeethaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea,

iyeasuvai ezhuppinathinaalea theavan nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku aru'lichseytha vaakkuththaththaththai avarka'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laakiya namakku ni'raiveat'rinaar en'ru naangka'lum ungka'lukkuch suviseashamaay a'rivikki'roam.

ini avar azhivukkudpadaathapadikku avarai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinaar enpathaikku'riththu: thaaveethukku aru'lina nichchayamaana kirupaika'lai ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvean en'ru thiruvu'lampat'rinaar.
an'riyum, ummudaiya parisuththar azhivaik kaa'navotteer en'ru vea'roru sangkeethaththil solliyirukki'rathu.
thaaveethu than kaalaththilea theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi avarukku oozhiyagnseythapinpu niththiraiyadainthu, than pithaakka'lidaththilea searkkappattu, azhivaik ka'ndaan.
theavanaal ezhuppappattavaroa azhivaik kaa'navillai.
aathalaal sakoathararea, ivar moolamaay ungka'lukkup paavamannippu u'ndaakum en'ru a'rivikkappaduki'rathen'rum,

moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea neengka'l evaika'linin'ru viduthalaiyaaki neethimaanka'laakkappadakkoodaathirunthathoa, visuvaasikki'ravan evanum avaika'linin'ru ivaraalea viduthalaiyaaki neethimaanaakkappaduki'raan en'rum ungka'lukkuth therinthirukkakkadavathu.
an'riyum, theerkkatharisika'lin pusthakaththilea:

asattaikkaararea, paarungka'l, piramiththu azhinthupoangka'l! ungka'l naadka'lil oru kiriyaiyai naan nadappippean, oruvan athai ungka'lukku vivariththuch sonnaalum neengka'l visuvaasikkamaatteerka'l en'ru solliyirukki'rapadi, ungka'lukku nearidaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l en'raan.
avarka'l yootharudaiya jepaaalayaththilirunthu pu'rappadukaiyil, aduththa oayvunaa'lilea intha vasanangka'laith thangka'lukkuch sollavea'ndum en'ru pu'rajaathiyaar vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.

jepaaalayaththil koodina sapai kalainthupoanapinpu, yootharilum yoothamaarkkaththamaintha pakthiyu'l'lavarka'lilum aneakar pavulaiyum parnapaavaiyum pinpat'rinaarka'l. avarka'ludanea ivarka'l peasi, theavanudaiya kirupaiyilea nilaiko'ndirukkumpadi avarka'lukkup puththisonnaarka'l.
aduththa oayvunaa'lilea kognchangku'raiyap patta'naththaaranaivarum theavavasanaththaik keadkumpadi koodivanthaarka'l.
yootharka'l janakkoottangka'laik ka'ndapoathu po'raamaiyinaal ni'rainthu, pavulinaal sollappattavaika'lukku ethiridaiyaayp peasi, viroathiththuth thooshiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu pavulum parnapaavum thairiyangko'ndu avarka'lai noakki: muthalaavathu ungka'lukkea theavavasanaththaich sollavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu; neengka'loa athaith tha'l'li, ungka'lai niththiyajeevanukku apaaththiraraakath theerththuk ko'l'luki'rapadiyinaal, ithoa, naangka'l pu'rajaathiyaaridaththil poaki'roam.

neer poomiyin kadaisipariyanthamum iradchippaayirukkumpadi ummai jaathika'lukku o'liyaaka vaiththean enki'ra veathavaakkiyaththinpadi karththar engka'lukkuk katta'laiyittirukki'rapadiyinaal ippadich seyki'roam en'raarka'l.
pu'rajaathiyaar athaik keattuch santhoashappattu, karththarudaiya vasanaththai makimaippaduththinaarka'l. niththiya jeevanukku niyamikkappattavarka'l evarka'loa avarka'l visuvaasiththaarka'l.
karththarudaiya vasanam aththeasamengkum pirasiththamaayit'ru.

yootharka'l pakthiyum kanamumu'l'la sthireeka'laiyum patta'naththu muthalaa'lika'laiyum eduththuvittu, pavulaiyum parnapaavaiyum thunpappaduththumpadi seythu, thangka'l ellaika'lukkup pu'rampaaka avarka'laith thuraththivittaarka'l.
ivarka'l thangka'l kaalka'lil padintha thoosiyai avarka'lukku ethiraaka utha'rippoattu, ikkoaniyaa patta'naththukkup poanaarka'l.
seesharka'l santhoashaththinaalum parisuththa aaviyinaalum nirappappattaarka'l.
ikkoaniyaa patta'naththilea avarka'l iruvarum yootharudaiya jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththu, yootharilum kireakkarilum thira'laana janangka'l visuvaasikkaththakkathaakap pirasangkiththaarka'l.
visuvaasiyaatha yootharka'l sakoathararukku viroathamaakap pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya manathai ezhuppivittu, pakaiyu'ndaakkinaarka'l.

avarka'l angkea aneakanaa'l sagnchariththuk karththarai munnittuth thairiyamu'l'lavarka'laayp poathakampa'n'ninaarka'l; avar thamathu kirupaiyu'l'la vasanaththi'rkuch saadchiyaaka adaiyaa'langka'lum a'rputhangka'lum avarka'l kaika'laal seyyappadumpadi anukkirakampa'n'ninaar.
patta'naththu janangka'l pirinthu, silar yootharaiyum silar appoasthalaraiyum searnthuko'ndaarka'l.
ivarka'lai avamaanappaduththavum kalle'riyavum vea'ndumen'ru, pu'rajaathiyaarum yootharum avarka'l athikaarika'lum ama'lipa'n'nukaiyil,
ivarka'l athai a'rinthu, likkavoaniyaa naattilu'l'la patta'nangka'laakiya leesthiraavukkum therpaikkum avaika'lin sut'ruppu'rangka'lukkum oadippoay;
angkea suviseashaththaip pirasangkam pa'n'ninaarka'l.
leesthiraavilea oruvan than thaayin vayit'rilirunthu pi'ranthathumuthal sappaa'niyaayirunthu, orupoathum nadavaamal, kaalka'l vazhangkaathavanaay udkaarnthu,
pavul peasuki'rathaik keattukko'ndirunthaan. avanaip pavul ut'ruppaarththu, iradchippukkeat'ra visuvaasam avanukku u'nden'ru ka'ndu:
nee ezhunthu kaaloon'ri nimirnthu nil en'ru uraththa saththaththoadea sonnaan. udanea avan kuthiththezhunthu nadanthaan.
pavul seythathai janangka'l ka'ndu, theavarka'l manusharoopameduththu nammidaththil i'rangkivanthirukki'raarka'l en'ru likkavoaniyaa paashaiyilea saththamittuch solli,
parnapaavai yooppiththar en'rum, pavul pirasangkaththai nadaththinavanaanapadiyinaal avanai merkkoori en'rum sonnaarka'l.

allaamalum patta'naththukku munnea iruntha yooppiththarudaiya koavil poojaasaari eruthuka'laiyum poomaalaika'laiyum vaasala'ndaiyilea ko'nduvanthu, janangka'loadeakooda avarka'lukkup paliyida manathaayirunthaan.
appoasthalaraakiya parnapaavum pavulum athaik keattapozhuthu, thangka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththukko'ndu, koottaththukku'l'lea oadi, uraththa saththamaay:

manusharea, ean ippadich seyki'reerka'l? naangka'lum ungka'laippoalap paadu'l'la manusharthaanea; neengka'l intha vee'naana theavarka'laivittu, vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum avaika'lilu'l'la yaavat'raiyum u'ndaakkina jeevanu'l'la theavanidaththi'rkuth thirumpavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukkup pirasangkikki'roam.
sen'ra kaalangka'lil avar sakala janangka'laiyum thangka'l thangka'l vazhika'lilea nadakkavittirunthum,

avar nanmai seythuvanthu, vaanaththilirunthu mazhaika'laiyum sezhippu'l'la kaalangka'laiyum namakkuth thanthu, aakaaraththinaalum santhoashaththinaalum nammudaiya iruthayangka'lai nirappi, ivvithamaay avar thammaikku'riththuch saadchi vi'langkappa'n'naathirunthathillai en'raarka'l.
ippadi avarka'l solliyum thangka'lukku janangka'l paliyidaathapadikku avarka'lai amarththuki'rathu arithaayirunthathu.

pinpu anthiyoakiyaavilum ikkoaniyaavilumirunthu sila yootharka'l vanthu, janangka'lukkup poathanaiseythu, pavulaik kalle'rinthu, avan mariththuppoanaanen'ru e'n'ni, avanaip patta'naththukku ve'liyilea izhuththukko'ndu poanaarka'l.
seesharka'l avanaich soozhnthuni'rkaiyil, avan ezhunthu, patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasiththaan. ma'runaa'lil parnapaavudaneakoodath therpaikkup pu'rappattuppoanaan.
anthap patta'naththil avarka'l suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu, aneakaraich seesharaakkinapinpu, leesthiraavukkum ikkoaniyaavukkum anthiyoakiyaavukkum thirumpivanthu,

seesharudaiya manathaith thidappaduththi, visuvaasaththilea nilaiththirukkumpadi avarka'lukkup puththisolli, naam aneaka upaththiravangka'lin vazhiyaayth theavanudaiya raajyaththil piraveasikkavea'ndumen'ru sonnaarka'l.
allaamalum anthanthach sapaika'lil avarka'lukku moopparka'lai ea'rpaduththi vaiththu, upavaasiththu jepampa'n'ni, avarka'l visuvaasiththup pat'rikko'nda karththarukku avarka'lai oppuviththaarka'l.
pinpu piseethiyaanaattaik kadanthu, pampiliyaa naatti'rku vanthu,
perkea ooril vasanaththaip pirasangkiththu, aththaliyaa patta'naththi'rkup poanaarka'l.
angkea kappal ea'ri, thaangka'l ni'raiveat'rina kiriyaikkaakath theavanudaiya kirupaikku oppuvikkappattup pu'rappattu anthiyoakiyaavukku vanthaarka'l.
avarka'l angkea searnthapozhuthu sapaiyaik koodivarachseythu, theavan thangka'laikko'ndu seythavaika'laiyum, avar pu'rajaathika'lukku visuvaasaththin kathavaiththi'ranthathaiyum a'riviththu,
angkea seesharudaneakooda aneakanaa'l sagnchariththirunthaarka'l.
silar yootheayaavilirunthu vanthu: neengka'l moaseayinudaiya mu'raimaiyinpadiyea viruththaseathanamadaiyaavittaal, iradchikkappadamaatteerka'l en'ru sakoathararukkup poathakampa'n'ninaarka'l.

athinaalea avarka'lukkum pavul parnapaa enpavarka'lukkum mikuntha vaakkuvaathamum tharkkamum u'ndaanapoathu, antha vishayaththinimiththam pavulum parnapaavum avarka'laich searntha vea'ru silarum erusaleamilirukki'ra appoasthalaridaththi'rkum moopparidaththi'rkum poakavea'ndumen'ru theermaaniththaarka'l.

anthappadi avarka'l sapaiyaaraal vazhivittanuppappattu, penikkea samaariyaa naaduka'lin vazhiyaayp poay, pu'rajaathiyaar mananthirumpina seythiyai a'riviththu, sakoatharar ellaarukkum mikuntha santhoashaththai u'ndaakkinaarka'l.
avarka'l erusaleamukku vanthu, sapaiyaaraalum appoasthalaraalum moopparaalum eat'rukko'l'lappattapoathu, theavan thangka'laikko'ndu seythavaika'laiyellaam a'riviththaarka'l.

appozhuthu pariseaya samayaththaaril visuvaasika'laana silar ezhunthu, avarka'lai viruththaseathanampa'n'nuki'rathum moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'lumpadi avarka'lukkuk ka'rpikki'rathum avasiyam en'raarka'l.
appoasthalarum moopparum inthak kaariyaththaik ku'riththu aaloasanaipa'n'numpadi koodinaarka'l.

mikuntha tharkkam u'ndaanapoathu, peathuru ezhunthu, avarka'lai noakki: sakoathararea, neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rapadi pu'rajaathiyaar ennudaiya vaayinaalea suviseasha vasanaththaik keattu visuvaasikkumpadi theavan aneaka naadka'lukku munnea ungka'lil oruvanaakiya ennaith therinthuko'ndaar.
iruthayangka'lai a'rinthirukki'ra theavan namakkup parisuththaaaviyaith thantharu'linathupoala avarka'lukkum thantharu'li, avarka'laikku'riththuch saadchikoduththaar;
