visuvaasaththinaalea avarka'l iruthayangka'lai avar suththamaakki, namakkum avarka'lukkum yaathoru viththiyaasamumiraathapadi seythaar.
ippadiyirukka, nammudaiya pithaakka'laalum nammaalum sumakkakkoodaathiruntha nukaththadiyaich seeshar kazhuththinmeal sumaththuvathinaal, neengka'l theavanaich soathippaanean?
karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupaiyinaalea avarka'l iradchikkappaduki'rathu eppadiyoa, appadiyea naamum iradchikkappaduvoamen'ru nampiyirukki'roamea en'raan.

appozhuthu koodivanthiruntha yaavarum amainthirunthu, parnapaavum pavulum thangka'laikko'ndu theavan pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea seytha adaiyaa'langka'l a'rputhangka'l yaavaiyum vivariththuch sollakkeattaarka'l.
avarka'l peasi mudinthapinpu, yaakkoapu avarka'lai noakki: sakoathararea, enakkuch sevikodungka'l.
theavan pu'rajaathika'linin'ru thamathu naamaththi'rkaaka oru janaththaith therinthuko'l'lumpadi muthalmuthal avarka'lukkuk kadaadchiththaru'lina vithaththaich simiyoan vivariththuch sonnaarea.
atha'rkuth theerkkatharisika'ludaiya vaakkiyangka'lum oththirukki'rathu.
eppadiyenil, mat'ra manusharum, ennudaiya naamantharikkappadum sakala jaathika'lum, karththaraith theadumpadikku,

naan itha'rkuppinpu thirumpivanthu, vizhunthupoana thaaveethin koodaaraththai ma'rupadiyum eduppiththu, athilea pazhuthaayppoanavaika'lai ma'rupadiyum seerppaduththi, athaich sevvaiyaaka ni'ruththuvean en'ru ivaika'laiyellaagn seyki'ra karththar solluki'raar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
ulakaththoat'ramuthal theavanukkuth thammudaiya kiriyaika'lellaam therinthirukki'rathu.
aathalaal pu'rajaathika'lil theavanidaththil thirumpuki'ravarka'laik kalangkappa'n'nalaakaathen'rum,

vikkirakangka'lukkup padaiththa asusiyaanavaika'lukkum, veasiththanaththi'rkum, nerukku'ndu seththathi'rkum, iraththaththi'rkum, vilakiyirukkumpadi avarka'lukku naam ezhuthavea'ndumen'rum naan theermaanikki'rean.

moaseayin aakamangka'l oayvunaa'lthoa'rum jepaaalayangka'lil vaasikkappattu varuki'rapadiyaal, poorvakaalanthodangkich sakala patta'nangka'lilum antha aakamangka'laip pirasangkikki'ravarka'lum u'ndea en'raan.

appozhuthu thangka'lil silaraith therinthuko'ndu pavuloadum parnapaavoadum anthiyoakiyaavukku anuppuki'rathu appoasthalarukkum moopparukkum sapaiyaarellaarukkum nalamaakakka'ndathu. avarka'l yaaren'raal, sakoathararil viseashiththavarka'laakiya parsapaa en'ru ma'rupearko'nda yoothaavum seelaavumea.

ivarka'l kaiyil avarka'l ezhuthikkoduththanuppina nirupamaavathu: appoasthalarum moopparum sakoathararumaakiya naangka'l anthiyoakiyaavilum seeriyaavilum silisiyaavilum irukkum pu'rajaathiyaaraakiya sakoathararukku vaazhththuthal solli ezhuthiya nirupam ennaven'raal:

engka'laal katta'laipe'raatha silar engka'lidaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, neengka'l viruththaseathanamadaiya vea'ndumen'rum, niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'lavea'ndumen'rum solli, ippadippatta vaarththaika'laal ungka'laik kalakki, ungka'l aaththumaakka'laip purattinaarka'l en'ru naangka'l kea'lvippattapadiyinaalea,

nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasu ki'risthuvin naamaththi'rkaakath thangka'l piraa'nanaiyum oppukkodukkath thu'ninthavarka'lum engka'lukkup piriyamaanavarka'lumaayirukki'ra parnapaa pavul enpavarka'loadungkooda,
engka'laal therinthuko'l'lappatta sila manusharai ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppuki'rathu orumanappattuk koodina engka'lukku nalamaakak ka'ndathu.
anthappadiyea yoothaavaiyum seelaavaiyum anuppiyirukki'roam. avarka'lum ivaika'lai vaaymozhiyaaka ungka'lukku a'rivippaarka'l.
evaiyenil, vikkirakangka'lukkup padaiththavaika'lukkum, iraththaththi'rkum, nerukku'ndu seththathi'rkum, veasiththanaththi'rkum, neengka'l vilakiyirukkavea'ndumenpathea.

avasiyamaana ivaika'laiyallaamal paaramaana vea'ron'raiyum ungka'lmeal sumaththaamaliruppathu parisuththaaavikkum engka'lukkum nalamaakak ka'ndathu; ivaika'lukku vilaki neengka'l ungka'laik kaaththukko'lvathu nalamaayirukkum. sukamaayiruppeerka'laaka en'ru ezhuthinaarka'l.
avarka'l anuppividappattu, anthiyoakiyaavukku vanthu, sapaiyaik koodivarachseythu, nirupaththai oppuviththaarka'l.
athai avarka'l vaasiththu, athanaalu'ndaakiya aa'ruthalukkaakach santhoashappattaarka'l.
yoothaa seelaa enpavarka'lum theerkkatharisika'laayirunthapadiyinaalea aneaka vaarththaika'linaal sakoathararukkup puththisolli, avarka'laith thidappaduththi;
silakaalam angkeayirunthu, pinpu sakoathararaal samaathaanaththoadea appoasthalaridaththi'rku anuppividappattaarka'l.
aakilum seelaavukku angkea thariththirukki'rathu nalamaayk ka'ndathu.
pavulum parnapaavum anthiyoakiyaavilea sagnchariththu, vea'rea aneakaroadungkoodak karththarudaiya vasanaththai upatheasiththup pirasangkiththukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

silanaa'laikkuppinpu pavul parnapaavai noakki: naam karththarudaiya vasanaththai a'riviththirukki'ra sakala patta'nangka'lilumu'l'la sakoathararka'l eppadiyirukki'raarka'len'ru poayppaarppoam vaarum en'raan.
appozhuthu parnapaa enpavan maa'rku ennum pearko'nda yoavaanaikkooda azhaiththukko'ndu poakavea'ndum en'raan.
pavuloa: avan pampiliyaa naattilea nammai vittup pirinthu nammoadeakooda oozhiyaththukku varaathathinaalea, avanai azhaiththukko'ndu poakakkoodaathu en'raan.
ithaippat'ri avarka'lukku'l'lea kadungkoapamoo'ndapadiyinaal avarka'l oruvaraiyoruvar vittup pirinthaarka'l. parnapaa maa'rkuvaik koottikko'ndu kappal ea'rich seeppurutheevukkup poanaan.
pavuloa seelaavaith therinthuko'ndu, sakoathararaalea theavanudaiya kirupaikku oppuvikkappattu, pu'rappattu,
seeriyaavilum silisiyaavilum thirinthu, sapaika'laith thidappaduththinaan.
athanpinpu avan therpaikkum leesthiraavukkum poanaan. angkea theemoaththeayu ennappatta oru seeshan irunthaan; avan thaay visuvaasamu'l'la yoothasthiree, avan thakappan kireakkan.
avan leesthiraavilum ikkoaniyaavilumu'l'la sakoathararaalea na'rsaadchi pet'ravanaayirunthaan.

avanaip pavul thannudanea koottikko'ndu poakavea'ndumen'ru virumpi, avanudaiya thakappan kireakkan en'ru avvidangka'lilirukkum yootharka'lellaarum a'rinthirunthapadiyaal, avarka'l nimiththam avanukku viruththaseathanampa'n'ninaan.
avarka'l patta'nangka'lthoa'rum poakaiyil, erusaleamilirukkum appoasthalaraalum moopparaalum vithikkappatta sattangka'laik kaikko'l'lumpadi avarka'lukku oppuviththaarka'l.
athinaalea sapaika'l visuvaasaththil sthirappattu, naa'lukkunaa'l perukina.
avarka'l pirikiyaa kalaaththiyaa naaduka'laik kadanthupoanapoathu, aasiyaavilea vasanaththaich sollaathapadikkup parisuththaaaviyinaalea thadaipa'n'nappattu,
meesiyaa theasamattum vanthu, piththiniyaa naattukkup poakap pirayaththanam pa'n'ninaarka'l; aaviyaanavaroa avarka'laip poakavottaathirunthaar.
appozhuthu avarka'l meesiyaa pakkamaayp poay, thuroavaavukku vanthaarka'l.

angkea iraaththiriyilea pavulukku oru tharisanam u'ndaayit'ru; athennavenil, makkethoaniyaa theasaththaan oruvan vanthunin'ru: neer makkethoaniyaavukku vanthu engka'lukku uthaviseyya vea'ndumen'ru thannai vea'ndikko'ndathaaka irunthathu.

anthath tharisanaththai avan ka'ndapoathu, avarka'lukkuch suviseashaththai a'rivikkumpadi karththar engka'lai azhaiththaaren'ru naangka'l nichchayiththukko'ndu, udanea makkethoaniyaavukkup pu'rappattuppoakap pirayaththanampa'n'ni,
thuroavaavil kappal ea'ri, saamoaththiraakkea theevukkum, ma'runaa'lilea neyaappoali patta'naththukkum nearaay oadi,
angkeayirunthu makkethoaniyaa theasaththu naaduka'lil on'ri'rkuth thalaimaiyaanathum roamar kudiyea'rinathumaana pilippi patta'naththukku vanthu, anthap patta'naththilea silanaa'l thangkiyirunthoam.
oayvunaa'lil naangka'l patta'naththukku ve'liyea poay, aat'rinarukea vazhakkamaay jepampa'n'nuki'ra idaththil udkaarnthu, angkea koodivantha sthireeka'lukku upatheasiththoam.

appozhuthu thiyaththeeraa ooraa'lum iraththaamparam vi'rki'rava'lum theavanai va'nangkuki'rava'lumaakiya leethiyaa'l ennum pearu'l'la oru sthiree keattukko'ndirunthaa'l; pavul solliyavaika'laik kavanikkumpadi karththar ava'l iruthayaththaith thi'rantharu'linaar.

ava'lum ava'l veettaarum gnaanasnaanam pet'rapinpu, ava'l engka'lai noakki: neengka'l ennaik karththaridaththil visuvaasamu'l'lava'len'ru e'n'ninaal, en veettilea vanthu thangkiyirungka'l en'ru engka'lai varunthik keattukko'ndaa'l.

naangka'l jepampa'n'nuki'ra idaththukkup poakaiyil ku'risolla eavuki'ra aaviyaikko'ndirunthu, ku'risolluki'rathinaal than ejamaanka'lukku mikuntha aathaayaththai u'ndaakkina oru pe'n engka'lukku ethirppattaa'l.
ava'l pavulaiyum engka'laiyum pinthodarnthu vanthu: intha manushar unnathamaana theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaarar, iradchippin vazhiyai namakku a'rivikki'ravarka'l en'ru saththamittaa'l.

ippadi aneakanaa'l seythuko'nduvanthaa'l. pavul sinangko'ndu, thirumpippaarththu: nee iva'lai vittup pu'rappadumpadi iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean en'ru antha aaviyudanea sonnaan; annearamea athu pu'rappattuppoayit'ru.
ava'ludaiya ejamaanka'l thangka'l aathaayaththu nampikkai at'ruppoayit'ren'ru ka'ndu, pavulaiyum seelaavaiyum pidiththu, santhaive'liyilu'l'la athikaarika'lidaththil izhuththukko'ndu poanaarka'l.
avarka'lai athikaarika'lidaththil oppuviththu: yootharka'laakiya intha manushar nammudaiya patta'naththil kalakampa'n'ni,
roamaraakiya naam eat'rukko'l'lavum anusarikkavum thakaatha mu'raimaika'laip poathikki'raarka'l en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu janangka'l koottangkoodi, avarka'lukku viroathamaay ezhumpinaarka'l. athikaarika'l avarka'l vasthirangka'laik kizhiththuppoadavum, avarka'lai adikkavum solli;
avarka'lai aneaka adi adiththapinpu, si'raichsaalaiyilea vaiththu avarka'laip paththiramaayk kaakkumpadi si'raichsaalaikkaaranukkuk katta'laiyittaarka'l.
avan ippadippatta katta'laiyaip pet'ru, avarka'lai udkaavala'raiyilea adaiththu, avarka'l kaalka'laith thozhumaraththil maattivaiththaan.
naduraaththiriyilea pavulum seelaavum jepampa'n'ni, theavanaith thuthiththup paadinaarka'l; kaavalil vaikkappattavarka'l athaik keattukko'ndirunthaarka'l.
sadithiyilea si'raichsaalaiyin asthipaarangka'l asaiyumpadiyaakap poomi mikavum athirnthathu; udanea kathavuka'lellaam thi'ravu'ndathu; ellaarudaiya kattuka'lum kazhan'rupoayit'ru.

si'raichsaalaikkaaran niththirai the'linthu, si'raichsaalaiyin kathavuka'l thi'ranthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, kattu'ndavarka'l oadippoanaarka'len'ru e'n'ni, pattayaththai uruvith thannaik kolaiseythu ko'l'lappoanaan.
pavul mikuntha saththamittu: nee unakkuk keduthi on'rugn seythuko'l'laathea; naangka'l ellaarum ingkeathaan irukki'roam en'raan.
appozhuthu avan theepangka'laik ko'nduvarachsolli, u'l'lea oadi, nadunadungki, pavulukkum seelaavukkum munpaaka vizhunthu,
avarka'lai ve'liyea azhaiththuvanthu: aa'ndavanmaarea, iradchikkappaduvatha'rku naan enna seyyavea'ndum en'raan.
atha'rku avarka'l: karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai visuvaasi, appozhuthu neeyum un veettaarum iradchikkappaduveerka'l en'ru solli,
avanukkum avan veettiliruntha yaavarukkum karththarudaiya vasanaththaip poathiththaarka'l.
mealum iraaththiriyil annearaththileathaanea avan avarka'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avarka'ludaiya kaayangka'laik kazhuvinaan. avanum avanudaiyavarka'l anaivarum udanea gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
pinpu avan avarka'laith than veetti'rkuk koottikko'ndupoay, avarka'lukkup poajanangkoduththu, than veettaar anaivaroadungkoodath theavanidaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavanaaki manamakizhchchiyaayirunthaan.
pozhuthu vidinthapinpu: antha manusharai vittuvidungka'l en'ru solla athikaarika'l seavakarka'lai anuppinaarka'l.

si'raichsaalaikkaaran pavulukku intha vaarththaika'lai a'riviththu: ungka'lai viduthalaiyaakkumpadikku athikaarika'l katta'lai anuppinaarka'l; aakaiyaal neengka'l ippozhuthu pu'rappattuch samaathaanaththudanea poangka'l en'raan.

atha'rkup pavul: roamaraakiya engka'lai avarka'l niyaayam visaariyaamal, ve'liyarangkamaay adiththu, si'raichsaalaiyilea poattaarka'l; ippozhuthu irakasiyamaay engka'lai viduthalaiyaakkuki'raarka'loa? appadiyalla, avarka'lea vanthu, engka'lai ve'liyea azhaiththu anuppi vidattum en'raan.
seavakar intha vaarththaika'lai athikaarika'lukku a'riviththaarka'l. roamaraayirukki'raarka'len'ru avarka'l keattapozhuthu payanthuvanthu,
avarka'ludanea thayavaayp peasi, avarka'lai ve'liyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay, patta'naththai vittup pu'rappattuppoakumpadi keattukko'ndaarka'l.
anthappadi avarka'l si'raichsaalaiyilirunthu pu'rappattu leethiyaa'lidaththi'rkuppoay, sakoathararaik ka'ndu, avarka'lukku aa'ruthal sollip poayvittaarka'l.
avarka'l ampipoali patta'naththaiyum appoloaniyaa patta'naththaiyum kadanthu, thesaloanikkea patta'naththukku vanthaarka'l; angkea yootharukku oru jepaaalayam irunthathu.
pavul than vazhakkaththinpadiyea avarka'lidaththil poay, moon'ru oayvunaadka'lil veathavaakkiyangka'lin niyaayangka'lai eduththu avarka'ludanea sampaashiththu,
ki'risthu paadupadavum mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthirukkavum vea'ndiyathen'rum, naan ungka'lukku a'rivikki'ra intha iyeasuvea ki'risthu en'rum kaa'npiththu, thirushdaanthappaduththinaan.
avarka'lil silarum, pakthiyu'l'la kireakkaril thira'laana janangka'lum, kanamporunthiya sthireeka'lil aneakarum visuvaasiththu, pavulaiyum seelaavaiyum searnthu ko'ndaarka'l.

visuvaasiyaatha yootharka'l vairaakkiyangko'ndu vee'naraakiya sila pollaathavarka'laich searththukko'ndu, koottangkoodi, patta'naththil ama'liyu'ndaakki, yaasoanudaiya veettai va'lainthuko'ndu, avarka'laip patta'naththaarukku munpaaka izhuththukko'nduvara vakaitheadinaarka'l.
avarka'laik kaa'naamal, yaasoanaiyum sila sakoathararaiyum patta'naththu athikaarika'lidaththil izhuththukko'nduvanthu: ulakaththaik kalakkuki'ravarka'l ingkeayum vanthirukki'raarka'l.
ivarka'lai yaasoan eat'rukko'ndaan. ivarka'lellaarum iyeasu ennum vea'roruvanai raajaa en'ru solli, iraayanudaiya katta'laika'lukku viroathamaakach seyki'raarka'len'ru kookkuralittu,
ivaika'laik keattukko'ndiruntha janangka'laiyum patta'naththu athikaarika'laiyum kalangkappa'n'ninaarka'l.
pinpu avarka'l yaasoanidaththilum mat'ravarka'lidaththilum jaameen vaangkikko'ndu, avarka'lai vittuvittaarka'l.
udanea sakoatharar iraaththirikaalaththilea pavulaiyum seelaavaiyum peroayaa patta'naththukku anuppivittaarka'l; avarka'l angkea searnthu, yootharudaiya jepaaalayaththi'rkup poanaarka'l.

anthap patta'naththaar manoavaagnchaiyaay vasanaththai eat'rukko'ndu, kaariyangka'l ippadiyirukki'rathaa en'ru thinanthoa'rum veathavaakkiyangka'lai aaraaynthupaarththathinaal, thesaloanikkeayil u'l'lavarka'laippaarkkilum na'rku'nasaalika'laayirunthaarka'l.
athanaal avarka'lil aneakampearum kanamporunthiya kireakkaril aneaka sthireeka'lum purusharka'lum visuvaasiththaarka'l.
peroayaavilum theavavasanam pavulinaal a'rivikkappaduki'rathen'ru thesaloanikkeayaraana yootharka'l a'rinthapoathu, angkeayum vanthu, janangka'laik ki'lappivittaarka'l.
udanea sakoatharar pavulaich samuththiravazhiyaayp poaka anuppivittaarka'l. seelaavum theemoaththeayum angkea thangkiyirunthaarka'l.

pavulai vazhinadaththinavarka'l avanai aththeanea patta'namvaraikkum azhaiththukko'ndupoay; angkea seelaavum theemoaththeayum athiseekkiramaakath thannidaththi'rku varumpadi avarka'lukkuch sollak katta'lai pet'rukko'ndu pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
aththeanea patta'naththil pavul avarka'lukkaakak kaaththukko'ndirukkaiyil, anthap patta'nam vikkirakangka'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathaik ka'ndu, than aaviyil mikuntha vairaakkiyamadainthu,
jepaaalayaththil yootharoadum, pakthiyu'l'lavarka'loadum, santhaive'liyil ethirppattavarka'loadum thinanthoa'rum sampaasha'naipa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu eppikkoorarum sthoayikkarumaana gnaanika'lil silar avanudanea vaakkuvaathampa'n'ninaarka'l. silar: intha vaayaadi enna peasappoaki'raan en'raarka'l. silar: ivan anniya theavathaika'lai a'rivikki'ravanaakak kaa'nki'rathu en'raarka'l. avan iyeasuvaiyum uyirththezhuthalaiyum avarka'lukkup pirasangkiththapadiyinaalea appadich sonnaarka'l.
avarka'l avanai maars meadaikku azhaiththukko'ndupoay: nee solluki'ra puthithaana upatheasam innathen'ru naangka'l a'riyalaamaa?
noothanamaana kaariyangka'lai engka'l kaathuka'l keadkappa'n'nuki'raay; avaika'lin karuththu innathen'ru a'riya manathaayirukki'roam en'raarka'l.
antha aththeanea patta'naththaarellaarum, angkea thangkuki'ra anniyarum, navamaana kaariyangka'laich solluki'rathilum keadki'rathilumeayozhiya vea'ron'rilum pozhuthupoakkuki'rathillai.
appozhuthu pavul maars meadaiyin naduvilea nin'ru: aththeanarea, entha vishayaththilum neengka'l mikuntha theavathaapakthiyu'l'lavarka'len'ru kaa'nki'rean.

eppadiyen'raal, naan sut'riththirinthu, ungka'l aaraathanaikkuriyavaika'laik kavaniththup paarththapozhuthu, a'riyappadaatha theavanukku en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra oru palipeedaththaik ka'ndean; neengka'l a'riyaamal aaraathikki'ra avaraiyea naan ungka'lukku a'rivikki'rean.
ulakaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavat'raiyum u'ndaakkina theavanaanavar vaanaththi'rkum poomikkum aa'ndavaraayirukki'rapadiyaal kaika'linaal kattappatta koavilka'lil avar vaasampa'n'nuki'rathillai.
ellaarukkum jeevanaiyum suvaasaththaiyum sakalaththaiyum kodukki'ra avar, thamakku yaathon'ru theavaiyaanathupoala, manushar kaika'laal pa'nividaiko'l'luki'rathumillai.

manushajaathiyaana sakala janangka'laiyum avar orea iraththaththinaalea thoan'rappa'n'ni, poomiyinmeethengkum kudiyirukkachseythu, mun theermaanikkappatta kaalangka'laiyum avarka'l kudiyiruppin ellaika'laiyum ku'riththirukki'raar;
karththaraakiya thammai avarka'l thadaviyaakilum ka'ndupidikkaththakkathaakath thammaith theadumpadikku appadich seythaar; avar nammil oruvarukkum thooramaanavarallavea.
eanenil avarukku'l naam pizhaikki'roam, asaiki'roam, irukki'roam; appadiyea ungka'l pulavarka'lilum silar, naam avarudaiya santhathiyaar en'ru solliyirukki'raarka'l.
naam theavanudaiya santhathiyaaraayirukka, manusharudaiya siththiravealaiyinaalum yukthiyinaalum uruvaakkina pon, ve'l'li, kal ivaika'lukkuth theyvam oppaayirukkumen'ru naam ninaikkalaakaathu.
a'riyaamaiyu'l'la kaalangka'laith theavan kaa'naathavarpoalirunthaar; ippozhuthoa mananthirumpavea'ndumen'ru engkumu'l'la manusharellaarukkum katta'laiyiduki'raar.

mealum oru naa'laik ku'riththirukki'raar; athilea avar thaam niyamiththa manushanaikko'ndu, pooloakaththai neethiyaay niyaayantheerppaar; antha manushanai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinathinaalea athin nichchayaththai ellaarukkum vi'langkappa'n'ninaar en'raan.
mariththoarin uyirththezhuthalaikku'riththu avarka'l keattapozhuthu, silar ikazhnthaarka'l. silar: nee solluki'rathai innoruvea'lai keadpoam en'raarka'l.
ippadiyirukka, pavul avarka'lai vittup poayvittaan.

silar avanaip pat'rikko'ndu, visuvaasika'laanaarka'l. avarka'lil maarsmeadaiyin niyaayaathipathika'lil oruvanaakiya thiyoneesiyu enpavanum, thaamari ennum pearu'l'la oru sthireeyum, ivarka'ludanea vea'ru silarum irunthaarka'l.
athanpinpu pavul aththeanea patta'naththai vittu, korinthu patta'naththukku vanthu;

yootharellaarum roamaapuriyai vittup poakumpadi kilavuthiyuraayan katta'laiyittapadiyinaalea, iththaaliyaavilirunthu puthithaay vanthiruntha ponthutheasaththaanaakiya aakkillaa ennum naamamu'l'la oru yoothanaiyum avan manaiviyaakiya piriskillaa'laiyum angkea ka'ndu, avarka'lidaththi'rkup poanaan.
avarka'l koodaarampa'n'nuki'ra thozhilaa'lika'laayirunthaarka'l; thaanum anthath thozhil seyki'ravanaanapadiyinaalea avarka'lidaththil thangki, vealaiseythuko'ndu vanthaan.
oayvunaa'lthoa'rum avan jepaaalayaththilea sampaasha'naipa'n'ni, yootharukkum kireakkarukkum puththisonnaan.
makkethoaniyaavilirunthu seelaavum theemoaththeayum vanthapoathu, pavul aaviyil vairaakkiyangko'ndu, iyeasuvea ki'risthu en'ru yootharukkuth thirushdaanthappaduththinaan.

avarka'l ethirththunin'ru thooshiththapoathu, avan than vasthirangka'lai utha'ri: ungka'l iraththappazhi ungka'l thalaiyinmeal irukkum; naan suththamaayirukki'rean; ithumuthal pu'rajaathiyaaridaththi'rkup poaki'reanen'ru avarka'ludanea solli,
avvidaththaivittu, theavanai va'nangkuki'ravanaakiya yusthu ennum pearu'l'la oruvanudaiya veetti'rku vanthaan; avan veedu jepaaalayaththi'rku aduththathaayirunthathu.

jepaaalayaththalaivanaakiya ki'rispu enpavan than veettaar anaivaroadum karththaridaththil visuvaasamu'l'lavanaanaan. korinthiyaril aneakarum suviseashaththaik keattu, visuvaasiththu, gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
iraaththiriyilea karththar pavulukkuth tharisanamaaki: nee payappadaamal peasu, mavunamaayiraathea;
naan unnudaneakooda irukki'rean, unakkuth theengkuseyyumpadi oruvanum unmeal kaipoaduvathillai; inthap patta'naththil enakku aneaka janangka'l u'ndu en'raar.
avan oru varushamum aa'ru maathamum angkea thangki, theavavasanaththai avarka'lukku'l'lea upatheasampa'n'nikko'nduvanthaan.
kalliyoan enpavan akaayaa naatti'rku athipathiyaanapoathu, yootharka'l orumanappattu, pavulukku viroathamaay ezhumpi, avanai niyaayaasanaththukku munpaakak ko'ndupoay:
ivan veathappiramaa'naththukku vika'rpamaayth theavanaich seavikkumpadi manusharukkup poathikki'raan en'raarka'l.

pavul peasuvatha'rku eththanappadukaiyil, kalliyoan yootharai noakki: yootharka'lea, ithu oru aniyaayamaay, allathu pollaatha nadakkaiyaayirukkumeayaanaal naan ungka'lukkup po'rumaiyaaych sevikoduppathu niyaayamaayirukkum.

ithu so'rka'lukkum, naamangka'lukkum, ungka'l veathaththukkum aduththa tharkkamaanapadiyinaalea, ippadippattavaika'laikku'riththu visaara'naiseyya enakku manathillai, neengka'lea paarththukko'l'lungka'l en'ru solli,
avarka'lai niyaayaasanaththinin'ru thuraththivittaan.
appozhuthu kireakkarellaarum jepaaalayaththalaivanaakiya sostheaneayaip pidiththu, niyaayaasanaththukku munpaaka adiththaarka'l. ivaika'lil on'raiyungku'riththuk kalliyoan kavalaippadavillai.

pavul aneakanaa'l angkea thariththirunthapinpu, sakoathararidaththil uththaravu pet'rukko'ndu, thanakku oru piraarththanai u'ndaayirunthapadiyinaal kengkireayaa patta'naththil thalaichsavaram pa'n'nikko'ndu, seeriyaatheasaththukkup poakak kappal ea'rinaan. piriskillaa'lum aakkillaavum avanudanea koodappoanaarka'l.
avan epeasupatta'naththukku vanthapoathu, angkea avarka'lai vittu neengki, jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththu, yootharudanea sampaasha'naipa'n'ninaan.
avan innugn silakaalam thangka'ludanea irukkavea'ndumen'ru avarka'l keattukko'ndapoathu, avan sammathiyaamal,

varuki'ra pa'ndikaiyilea eppadiyaayinum naan erusaleamil irukkavea'ndum, theavanukkuch siththamaanaal thirumpi ungka'lidaththi'rku varuveanen'ru solli, avarka'lidaththil uththaravu pet'rukko'ndu, kappal ea'ri, epeasuvai vittup pu'rappattu,
sesariyaa patta'naththukku vanthu, erusaleamukkup poay, sapaiyaich santhiththu, anthiyoakiyaavukkup poanaan.
angkea silakaalam sagnchariththapinpu, pu'rappattu, kiramamaayk kalaaththiyaa naattileayum pirikiyaa naattileayum sut'riththirinthu, seesharellaaraiyum thidappaduththinaan.
appozhuthu aleksanthiriyaa patta'naththil pi'ranthavanum saathuriyavaanum veathaakamangka'lil vallavanumaana appolloa ennum pearko'nda oru yoothan epeasupatta'naththukku vanthaan.

avan karththarudaiya maarkkaththilea upatheasikkappattu, yoavaan koduththa snaanaththaimaaththiram a'rinthavanaayirunthu, aaviyil analu'l'lavanaayk karththarukku aduththavaika'laith thittamaayp poathakampa'n'nikko'nduvanthaan.

avan jepaaalayaththil thairiyamaayp peasaththodangkinapoathu aakkillaavum piriskillaa'lum avan peasuki'rathaik keattu, avanaich searththukko'ndu, theavanudaiya maarkkaththai athika thittamaay avanukku vivariththukkaa'npiththaarka'l.
pinpu avan akaayaa naatti'rkup poakavea'ndumen'rirukkaiyil, seesharka'l avanai eat'rukko'l'lumpadi sakoatharar avarka'lukku ezhuthinaarka'l.

avan angkea vanthapinpu ve'liyarangkamaaka yootharka'ludanea palamaayth tharkkampa'n'ni, iyeasuvea ki'risthu en'ru veathavaakkiyangka'laikko'ndu thirushdaanthappaduththinapadiyaal, kirupaiyinaalea visuvaasika'laanavarka'lukku mikavum uthaviyaayirunthaan.
appolloa enpavan korinthu patta'naththilea irukkaiyil, pavul meadaana theasangka'l vazhiyaayp poay, epeasuvukku vanthaan; angkea sila seesharaik ka'ndu:
neengka'l visuvaasika'laanapoathu, parisuththaaaviyaip pet'reerka'laa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku avarka'l: parisuththaaavi u'ndenpathai naangka'l kea'lvippadavea illai en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu avan: appadiyaanaal neengka'l entha gnaanasnaanam pet'reerka'l en'raan. atha'rku avarka'l: yoavaan koduththa gnaanasnaanam pet'roam en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu pavul: yoavaan thanakkuppin varuki'ravaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvil visuvaasika'laayirukkavea'ndum en'ru janangka'lukkuch solli, mananthirumputhalukku eat'ra gnaanasnaanaththaik koduththaanea en'raan.
athaik keattapoathu avarka'l karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea gnaanasnaanam pet'raarka'l.
allaamalum pavul avarka'lmeal kaika'lai vaiththapoathu, parisuththaaavi avarka'lmeal vanthaar; appozhuthu avarka'l anniyapaashaika'laip peasith theerkkatharisanagn sonnaarka'l.
antha manusharellaarum ea'rakku'raiyap pannira'ndupearaayirunthaarka'l.

pinpu pavul jepaaalayaththil piraveasiththu, thairiyamaayp pirasangkiththu, moon'ru maathama'lavum theavanudaiya raajyaththukkaduththavaika'laikku'riththuch sampaasha'naipa'n'ni, puththisollikko'ndu vanthaan.

silar kadinappattu avisuvaasika'laakik koottaththi'rku munpaaka intha maarkkaththai ninthiththapoathu, avan avarka'lai vittu vilaki, seesharai avarka'lilirunthu piriththukko'ndu, thi'rannu ennum oruvanudaiya viththiyaasaalaiyilea anuthinamum sampaashiththukko'nduvanthaan.
ira'ndu varushakaalam ippadi nadanthathinaalea aasiyaavil kudiyiruntha yootharum kireakkarumaakiya ellaarum karththaraakiya iyeasuvin vasanaththaik keattaarka'l.
pavulin kaika'linaalea theavan viseashiththa a'rputhangka'laich seytharu'linaar.

avanudaiya sareeraththilirunthu u'rumaalka'laiyum kachchaika'laiyum ko'nduvanthu, viyaathikkaararmeal poada viyaathika'l avarka'laivittu neengkippoayina; pollaatha aavika'lum avarka'laivittup pu'rappattana.

appozhuthu theasaantharika'laayth thiriki'ra manthiravaathika'laakiya yootharil silar pollaatha aavika'l pidiththirunthavarka'lmeal karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththaich sollath thu'ninthu: pavul pirasangkikki'ra iyeasuvinpearil aa'naiyittu ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduki'roam en'raarka'l.
pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya skeavaa ennum oar yoothanudaiya kumaarar eazhupear ippadich seythaarka'l.
pollaatha aavi avarka'lai noakki: iyeasuvai a'rivean, pavulaiyum a'rivean, neengka'l yaar en'ru solli,
pollaatha aaviyaiyudaiya manushan avarka'lmeal paaynthu, palaathkaarampa'n'ni, avarka'lai mea'rko'l'la, avarka'l niruvaa'nika'lum kaayappattavarka'lumaaki antha veettai vittu oadippoanaarka'l.
ithu epeasuvilea kudiyiruntha yoothar kireakkar anaivarukkum theriyavanthapoathu, avarka'lellaarum payamadainthaarka'l; karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamam makimaippattathu.
visuvaasiththavarka'lil aneakar vanthu, thangka'l seykaika'lai ve'lippaduththi a'rikkaiyittaarka'l.

maayaviththaikkaararaayirunthavarka'lil aneakar thangka'l pusthakangka'laik ko'nduvanthu, ellaarukku munpaakach sutteriththaarka'l; avaika'lin kirayaththaith thokaipaarththu, aimpathinaayiram ve'l'likkaasaakak ka'ndaarka'l.
ivva'lavu palamaayk karththarudaiya vasanam viruththiyadainthu mea'rko'ndathu.

ivaika'l mudinthapinpu, pavul makkethoaniyaa akaayaa ennum naaduka'lil sut'rinadanthu, erusaleamukkuppoakumpadi aaviyil niru'nayampa'n'nikko'ndu: naan angkea poanapinpu roamaapuriyaiyum paarkkavea'ndiyathen'ru solli,
thanakku uthaviseythavarka'lil ira'ndupearaakiya theemoaththeayuvaiyum erasthuvaiyum makkethoaniyaavukku anuppivittu; thaan pinnugn silakaalam aasiyaavilea thangkinaan.
akkaalaththilea intha maarkkaththaikku'riththup periya kalakam u'ndaayit'ru.

eppadiyen'raal, themeaththiriyu ennum pearko'nda oru thattaan thiyaanaa'lin koavilaippoala ve'l'liyinaal si'riya koavilka'laich seythu, thozhilaa'lika'lukku mikuntha aathaayam varuviththukko'ndirunthaan.
ivarka'laiyum ippadippatta thozhilseyki'ra mat'ra vealaiyaadka'laiyum avan koodivarachseythu: manusharka'lea, inthath thozhilinaal namakku nalla pizhaippu u'ndaayirukki'rathen'ru a'riveerka'l.

ippadiyirukka, kaika'linaal seyyappatta theavarka'l theavarka'lallaven'ru inthap pavul enpavan solli, epeasuvileamaaththiramalla, kognchangku'raiya aasiyaa engkum aneaka janangka'lukkup poathiththu, avarka'lai vasappaduththikko'ndaan en'ru neengka'l ka'ndum keattum irukki'reerka'l.

ithanaal nammudaiya thozhil at'ruppoakumpadiyaana apaayam nearittirukki'rathumallaamal, makaa theaviyaakiya thiyaanaa'ludaiya koavil e'n'namat'rup poaki'ratha'rkum, aasiyaa muzhumaiyum poochchakkaramum seavikki'ra ava'ludaiya makaththuvam azhinthupoaki'ratha'rkum eathuvaayirukki'rathu en'raan.
avarka'l ithaik keattu, koapaththaal ni'rainthu: epeasiyarudaiya thiyaanaa'lea periyava'l en'ru saththamittaarka'l.

patta'nam muzhuvathum kalakaththinaal ni'rainthathu. pavulukku vazhiththu'naiyaay vantha makkethoaniyaraakiya kaayuvaiyum aristharkkuvaiyum avarka'l izhuththukko'ndu, orumanappattu arangkasaalaikkup paaynthoadinaarka'l.
pavul koottaththukku'l'lea poaka manathaayirunthapoathu, seesharka'l avanaip poakavidavillai.
aasiyaanaattuth thalaivaril avanukkuch sineakitharaayiruntha silarum avanidaththi'rku aa'l anuppi, arangkasaalaikku'l poakavea'ndaam en'ru echchariththaarka'l.
koottaththil ama'liyu'ndaaki, silar ippadiyum silar appadiyumaakap peasinaarka'l; thaangka'l koodivantha kaara'nam innathen'ru aneakarukkuth theriyaathirunthathu.

appozhuthu yootharka'l aleksanthar enpavanai munni'rkath tha'l'lukaiyil, koottaththilea silar avanai munnea izhuththuvittaarka'l. aleksanthar kaiyamarththi, janangka'lukku uththaravusolla manathaayirunthaan.
avan yoothanen'ru avarka'l a'rinthapoathu, epeasiyarudaiya thiyaanaa'lea periyava'l en'ru ira'nduma'ni nearama'lavum ellaarum eakamaaych saththamittukko'ndirunthaarka'l.

patta'naththuch sampirathiyaanavan janangka'lai amarththi: epeasiyarea, epeasiyarudaiya patta'nam makaa theaviyaakiya thiyaanaa'lukkum vaanaththilirunthu vizhuntha silaikkum koavi'rparisaarakiyaayirukki'rathai a'riyaathavan u'ndoa?
ithu ethirpeasappadaatha kaariyamaakaiyaal, neengka'l on'rum patha'richseyyaamal amarnthirukkavea'ndum.
intha manusharai ingkea ko'nduvantheerka'l; ivarka'l koavi'rko'l'laikkaararumalla, ungka'l theaviyaith thooshikki'ravarka'lumalla.

themeaththiriyukkum avanaich searntha thozhilaa'lika'lukkum oruvanmeal orukaariyam u'ndaayirunthaal, niyaayam visaarikki'ra naadka'lu'ndu, theasaathipathika'lum irukki'raarka'l; oruvarpeariloruvar vazhakkaadikko'l'lattum.
neengka'l vea'rea yaathoru kaariyaththaikku'riththu visaarikkavea'ndiyathaanaal, athu niyaayasangkaththilea theerkkappadum.

in'raikku u'ndaana kalakaththaikku'riththu naam uththaravusolluki'ratha'rku eathuvillaathapadiyaal, inthak kalakaththaikku'riththu naangka'l visaarikkappadumpoathu, kut'ravaa'lika'laaki'ratha'rku eathuvaayiruppoamea en'ru solli,
pinpu koottaththai anuppivittaan.
kalakam amarnthapinpu, pavul seesharaith thannidaththi'rku varavazhaiththu, vinavikko'ndu, makkethoaniyaavukkup poakap pu'rappattaan.
avan anthath thisaika'lilea sut'ri nadanthu, seesharka'lukku vekuvaayp puththisolli, kireakku theasaththilea searnthaan.

angkea moon'rumaatham sagnchariththapinpu, avan kappal ea'ri, seeriyaatheasaththukkuppoaka manathaayirunthapoathu, yootharka'l avanukkuth theemaiseyyumpadi irakasiyamaana yoasanaiko'ndirunthapadiyaal, makkethoaniyaa theasaththin vazhiyaayth thirumpippoakath theermaanam pa'n'ninaan.

peroayaa ooraanaakiya soapaththarum, thesaloanikkeayaril aristharkkum, sekkunthum, therpaiyaanaakiya kaayuvum, theemoaththeayum, aasiyaa naattaaraakiya theekikkum thuroappeemum, aasiyaanaaduvaraikkum avanukku vazhiththu'naiyaay vanthaarka'l.
ivarka'l munnaakap poay, thuroavaapatta'naththilea engka'lukkaakak kaaththirunthaarka'l.

pu'lippillaatha appappa'ndikai naadka'lukkuppinpu naangka'l kappal ea'rip pilippipatta'naththai vittu ainthu naa'laikku'l'lea thuroavaapatta'naththukku avarka'lidaththil vanthu, angkea eazhunaa'l thangkiyirunthoam.

vaaraththin muthalnaa'lilea, appam pidkumpadi seesharka'l koodivanthirukkaiyil, pavul ma'runaa'lilea pu'rappadavea'ndumen'rirunthu, avarka'ludanea sampaashiththu, naduraaththirimattum pirasangkiththaan.
avarka'l koodiyiruntha mealveettilea aneaka vi'lakkuka'l vaiththirunthathu.

appozhuthu aiththiku ennum pearko'nda oru vaalipan jannalil udkaarnthirunthu, pavul nedunearam pirasangkam pa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil, mikuntha thookkamadainthu, niththiraimayakkaththinaal saaynthu, moon'raam meththaiyilirunthu keezhea vizhunthu, mariththavanaay edukkappattaan.
udanea pavul i'rangkippoay, avanmeal vizhunthu, avanai a'naiththukko'ndu: kalangkaathirungka'l, ivan uyir ivanukku'l irukki'rathu en'raan.
pinpu ea'rippoay, appam pittup pusiththu, vidiya'rkaalama'lavum vekunearam peasikko'ndirunthu, pinpu pu'rappattaan.
antha vaalipanai avarka'l uyiru'l'lavanaakak koottikko'nduvanthu, mikuntha aa'ruthaladainthaarka'l.

pavul aasoapatta'namvaraikkum karaivazhiyaayp poaka manathaayirunthapadiyaal, avan thittampa'n'niyirunthapadiyea, naangka'l kappal ea'ri, anthap patta'naththil avanai eat'rikko'l'lumpadi munnaaka angkea poayirunthoam.
avan aasoapatta'naththilea engka'laik ka'ndapoathu, naangka'l avanai eat'rikko'ndu, miththileanea patta'naththukku vanthoam.
avvidamvittu, ma'runaa'lilea keeyutheevukku ethiraaka vanthu,

pavul koodumaanaal penthekosthea pa'ndikainaa'lilea erusaleamilirukkavea'ndumen'ru theevirappattathinimiththam, thaan aasiyaavilea kaalampoakkaathapadikku, epeasu patta'naththaik kadanthu poakavea'ndumen'ru theermaaniththathinaal, ma'runaa'lilea saamutheevu pidiththu, thuroakilliyoan oorththu'raiyilea thangki, ma'runaa'l mileaththupatta'naththukku vanthoam.
mileaththuvilirunthu avan epeasuvukku aa'l anuppi, sapaiyin moopparai varavazhaiththaan.

avarka'l thannidaththil vanthu searnthapozhuthu, avan avarka'lai noakki: naan aasiyaanaattil vantha muthalnaa'l thodangki ellaak kaalangka'lilum ungka'ludanea innavithamaay irunthean enpathai neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
veku manaththaazhmaiyoadum, mikuntha ka'n'neeroadum, yootharudaiya theemaiyaana yoasanaika'laal enakku nearitta soathanaika'loadum, naan karththaraich seaviththean.
pirayoajanamaanavaika'lil on'raiyum naan ungka'lukku ma'raiththuvaikkaamal, ve'liyarangkamaaka veeduka'lthoa'rum ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththu, upatheasampa'n'ni,
theavanidaththi'rku mananthirumpuvathaikku'riththum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai visuvaasippathaikku'riththum, naan yootharukkum kireakkarukkum saadchiyaaka a'riviththean.
ippozhuthum naan aaviyilea kattu'ndavanaay erusaleamukkup poaki'rean; angkea enakku nearidungkaariyangka'lai naan a'riyean.
kattuka'lum upaththiravangka'lum enakku vaiththirukki'rathen'ru parisuththaaaviyaanavar patta'nanthoa'rum therivikki'rathaimaaththiram a'rinthirukki'rean.

aakilum avaika'lil on'raiyungku'riththuk kavalaippadean; en piraa'nanaiyum naan arumaiyaaka e'n'nean; en oattaththaich santhoashaththoadea mudikkavum, theavanudaiya kirupaiyin suviseashaththaip pirasangkampa'n'numpadikku naan karththaraakiya iyeasuvinidaththil pet'ra oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'ravumea virumpuki'rean.

ithoa, naan ungka'lukku'l'lea sagnchariththu, theavanudaiya raajyaththaik ku'riththup pirasangkampa'n'ninathaik keattavarka'laakiya neengka'lellaarum ini en mukaththaip paarkkamaatteerka'len'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
theavanudaiya aaloasanaiyil on'raiyum naan ma'raiththuvaikkaamal, ellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukku a'riviththapadiyinaalea,
ellaarudaiya iraththappazhikkum neengki naan suththamaayirukki'reanenpatha'rku ungka'lai in'raiyaththinam saadchika'laaka vaikki'rean.

aakaiyaal, ungka'laikku'riththum, theavan thammudaiya suyaraththaththinaalea sampaathiththukko'nda thamathu sapaiyai meayppatha'rkup parisuththaaavi ungka'laik ka'nkaa'nika'laaka vaiththa manthai muzhuvathaiyungku'riththum, echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
naan poanapinpu manthaiyaith thappavidaatha kodithaana oanaayka'l ungka'lukku'l'lea varum.
ungka'lilum silar ezhumpi, seesharka'laith thangka'lidaththil izhuththukko'l'lumpadi maa'rupaadaanavaika'laip poathippaarka'len'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
aanapadiyaal, naan moon'ruvarusha kaalamaay iravum pakalum ka'n'neeroadea idaividaamal avanavanukkup puththisollikko'nduvanthathai ninaiththu vizhiththirungka'l.

ippozhuthum sakoathararea, neengka'l pakthiviruththiyadaiyavum, parisuththamaakkappatta anaivarukku'l'lum ungka'lukkuch suthantharaththaik kodukkavum vallavaraayirukki'ra theavanukkum avarudaiya kirupaiyu'l'la vasanaththukkum ungka'lai oppukkodukki'rean.
oruvanudaiya ve'l'liyaiyaakilum ponnaiyaakilum vasthiraththaiyaakilum naan ichchikkavillai.
neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rapadi, enakkum ennudaneakooda irunthavarka'lukkum vea'ndiyavaika'lukkaaka inthak kaika'lea vealaiseythathu.

ippadip pirayaasappattu, palaveenaraith thaangkavum, vaangkuki'rathaippaarkkilum kodukki'rathea paakkiyam en'ru karththaraakiya iyeasu sonna vaarththaika'lai ninaikkavum vea'ndumen'ru ellaa vithaththileayum ungka'lukkuk kaa'npiththean en'raan.
ivaika'laich sonnapinpu, avan muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu, avarka'lellaaroadungkooda jepampa'n'ninaan.
avarka'lellaarum mikavum azhuthu, en mukaththai neengka'l inip paarkkamaatteerka'len'ru avan sonna vaarththaiyaikku'riththu athikamaayth thukkappattu,
pavulin kazhuththaik kattikko'ndu, avanai muththagnseythu, kappalvaraikkum avanudanea koodappoanaarka'l.
naangka'l avarka'lai vittup pirinthu, thu'raipeyarnthapinpu, nearaayoadi, koastheevaiyum, ma'runaa'lil roathutheevaiyum searnthu, avvidam vittup paththaaraa patta'naththukku vanthu,
angkea penikkea theasaththi'rkuppoaki'ra oru kappalaik ka'ndu, athilea ea'rippoanoam.
seeppurutheevaik ka'ndu, athai idathupu'ramaaka vittu, seeriyaanaatti'rku oadi, theerupatta'naththu'raiyil i'rangkinoam; angkea kappalin sarakkuka'lai i'rakkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
avvidaththilu'l'la seesharaik ka'ndupidiththu, angkea eazhunaa'l thangkinoam. avarka'l pavulai noakki: neer erusaleamukkup poakavea'ndaam en'ru aaviyin eavuthalinaalea sonnaarka'l.

antha naadka'l ni'raivea'rinapinpu, naangka'l pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, avarka'lellaarum manaivika'loadum pi'l'laika'loadungkoodap patta'naththukkup pu'rampea engka'lai vazhivittanuppumpadi vanthaarka'l. appozhuthu kada'rkaraiyilea naangka'l muzhangkaa'rpadiyittu jepampa'n'ninoam.
oruvaridaththiloruvar uththaravu pet'rukko'ndapinpu, naangka'l kappal ea'rinoam; avarka'l thangka'l veeduka'lukkuth thirumpippoanaarka'l.
naangka'l kappalyaaththiraiyai mudiththu, theerupatta'naththai vittup piththoloamaay patta'naththukku vanthu, sakoathararai vinavi, avarka'lidaththil orunaa'l thangkinoam.

ma'runaa'lilea pavulaich searnthavarka'laakiya naangka'l pu'rappattuch sesariyaapatta'naththukku vanthu, eazhupearil oruvanaakiya pilippennum suviseashakanudaiya veettilea piraveasiththu, avanidaththil thangkinoam.
theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ra kanniyaasthireeka'laakiya naalu kumaaraththika'l avanukku irunthaarka'l.
naangka'l aneakanaa'l angkea thangkiyirukkaiyil, akapu ennum pearko'nda oru theerkkatharisi yootheayaavilirunthu vanthaan.

avan engka'lidaththil vanthu, pavulinudaiya kachchaiyai eduththuth than kaika'laiyum kaalka'laiyum kattikko'ndu: inthak kachchaiyaiyudaiyavanai erusaleamilu'l'la yoothar ivvithamaayk kattip pu'rajaathiyaar kaika'lil oppukkoduppaarka'l en'ru parisuththa aaviyaanavar solluki'raar en'raan.
ivaika'lai naangka'l keattapozhuthu, erusaleamukkup poakavea'ndaamen'ru, naangka'lum avvidaththaarum avanai vea'ndikko'ndoam.

atha'rkup pavul: neengka'l azhuthu en iruthayaththai ean udainthupoakappa'n'nuki'reerka'l? erusaleamil naan karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththi'rkaakak kattappaduvatha'rkumaaththiramalla, marippatha'rkum aayaththamaayirukki'rean en'raan.
avan sammathiyaathapadiyinaalea, karththarudaiya siththam aakakkadavathen'ru amarnthirunthoam.
antha naadka'lukkuppinpu naangka'l pirayaa'na saamaanka'lai aayaththampa'n'nikko'ndu erusaleamukkup poanoam.

sesariyaapatta'naththilu'l'la seesharil silar engka'ludaneakooda vanthathuman'ri, seeppurutheevaanaakiya minaasoan ennum oru pazhaiya seeshanidaththilea naangka'l thangkumpadiyaaka avanaiyum thangka'loadea koottikko'ndu vanthaarka'l.
naangka'l erusaleamukku vanthapoathu, sakoatharar engka'laich santhoashamaay eat'rukko'ndaarka'l.
ma'runaa'lilea pavul engka'laik koottikko'ndu, yaakkoapinidaththi'rkup poanaan; moopparellaarum angkea koodivanthaarka'l.
avarka'lai avan vinavi, than oozhiyaththinaalea theavan pu'rajaathika'lidaththil seythavaika'lai ovvon'raay vivariththuchsonnaan.

athai avarka'l keattuk karththarai makimaippaduththinaarka'l. pinpu avarka'l avanai noakki: sakoatharanea, yootharka'lukku'l aneakamaayirampear visuvaasika'laayirukki'rathaip paarkki'reerea, avarka'lellaarum niyaayappiramaa'naththukkaaka vairaakkiyamu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

pu'rajaathika'lidaththilirukki'ra yootharellaarum thangka'l pi'l'laika'lukku viruththaseathanam pa'n'navum, mu'raimaika'linpadi nadakkavum vea'nduvathillaiyen'ru neer solli, ivvithamaay avarka'l moaseayai vittup pirinthupoakumpadi poathikki'reeren'ru ivarka'l ummaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattirukki'raarka'l.
ippozhuthu seyyavea'ndiyathu enna? neer vanthirukki'reeren'ru ivarka'l kea'lvippattu, nichchayamaakak koottangkooduvaarka'l.
aakaiyaal naangka'l umakkuch solluki'rapadi neer seyyavea'ndum; athennaven'raal, piraarththanai pa'n'nikko'ndavarka'laakiya naalupear engka'lidaththil irukki'raarka'l.

avarka'lai neer searththukko'ndu, avarka'ludaneakoodach suththikarippu seythuko'ndu, avarka'l thalaichsavarampa'n'nik ko'lvatha'rkuch sellumaanathaich selavuseyyum; appadich seythaal ummaikku'riththuk kea'lvippatta kaariyangka'l apaththamen'rum, neerum niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'ndu nadakki'ravaren'rum ellaarum a'rinthuko'lvaarka'l.

visuvaasika'laana pu'rajaathiyaar ippadippattavaika'laik kaikko'l'laamal, vikkirakangka'lukkup padaiththatha'rkum, iraththaththi'rkum, nerukku'ndu seththathi'rkum, veasiththanaththi'rkum, vilakiyirukkavea'ndumen'ru naangka'l theermaanampa'n'ni, avarka'lukku ezhuthiyanuppinoamea en'raarka'l.

appozhuthu pavul antha manusharaich searththukko'ndu, ma'runaa'lilea avarka'ludaneakoodath thaanum suththikarippu seythuko'ndu, theavaalayaththil piraveasiththu, avarka'lil ovvoruvanukkaakavum vea'ndiya paliseluththith theeruma'lavum suththikarippu naadka'lai ni'raiveat'ruveanen'ru a'riviththaan.
antha eazhunaadka'lum ni'raivea'ri varukaiyil, aasiyaanaattilirunthu vantha yootharka'l avanaith theavaalayaththilea ka'ndu, janangka'lellaaraiyum eduththuvittu, avanmeal kaipoattu:

isravealarea, uthaviseyyungka'l. nammudaiya janaththi'rkum veathappiramaa'naththi'rkum intha sthalaththi'rkum viroathamaaka engkum ellaarukkum poathiththuvaruki'ravan ivanthaan; inthath theavaalayaththi'rku'l'lea kireakkaraiyum koottikko'nduvanthu, inthap parisuththa sthalaththaith theettuppaduththinaan en'ru saththamittaarka'l.
epeasiyanaakiya thuroappeemu enpavan munnea nakaraththil pavuludaneakooda irukki'rathaik ka'ndirunthapadiyaal, pavul avanaith theavaalayaththil koottikko'ndu vanthiruppaanen'ru ninaiththaarka'l.

appozhuthu nakaramuzhuvathum kalakkamut'rathu; janangka'l koottamaay oadivanthu, pavulaippidiththu, avanaith theavaalayaththi'rkup pu'rampea izhuththukko'ndupoanaarka'l; udanea kathavuka'l poottappattathu.
avarka'l avanaik kolaiseyya eththaniththirukkaiyil, erusaleam muzhuvathum kalakkamaayirukki'rathen'ru poarchseavakarin seanaapathikkuch seythivanthathu.

udanea avan poarchseavakaraiyum avarka'ludaiya athipathika'laiyum koottikko'ndu, avarka'lidaththi'rku oadinaan; seanaapathiyaiyum poarchseavakaraiyum avarka'l ka'ndapoathu pavulai adikki'rathai vittu ni'ruththinaarka'l.
appozhuthu seanaapathi kittavanthu avanaip pidiththu, ira'ndu sangkilika'linaalea kattumpadi solli: ivan yaar en'rum enna seythaan en'rum visaariththaan.
atha'rku janangka'l palavithamaaych saththamittaarka'l; santhadiyinaalea nichchayaththai avan a'riyakkoodaamal, avanaik koattaikku'l'lea ko'ndupoakumpadi katta'laiyittaan.
avan padika'lmeal ea'rinapoathu janakkoottam thira'ndu pinsen'ru,
ivanai akat'rum en'ru ukkiramaayk kooppittapadiyinaalea, poarchseavakar avanaith thookkikko'ndu poakavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
avarka'l pavulaik koattaikku'l'lea ko'ndupoaki'ra samayaththil, avan seanaapathiyai noakki: naan ummudanea oru vaarththai peasalaamaa en'raan. atha'rku avan: unakkuk kireakkupaashai theriyumaa?
nee intha naadka'lukkumunnea kalakamu'ndaakki, naalaayirang kolaipaathakarai vanaantharaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoana ekipthiyan allavaa en'raan.
atha'rkup pavul: naan silisiyaa naattilu'l'la keerththipet'ra tharsupatta'naththu yoothan; janangka'ludanea peasumpadi enakku uththaravaakavea'ndumen'ru ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.
uththaravaanapoathu, pavul padika'linmeal nin'ru janangka'laip paarththuk kaiyamarththinaan; mikuntha amaithalu'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu avan epireyu paashaiyilea peasaththodangkinaan.
sakoathararea, pithaakka'lea, naan ippozhuthu ungka'lukkuch sollappoaki'ra niyaayangka'lukkuch sevikoduppeerka'laaka en'raan.
avan epireyu paashaiyilea thangka'ludanea peasuki'rathai avarka'l keattapozhuthu, athika amaithalaayirunthaarka'l. appozhuthu avan:

naan yoothan, silisiyaanaattilu'l'la tharsupatta'naththilea pi'ranthu, intha nakaraththilea kamaaliyealin paathaththarukea va'larnthu, munnoarka'ludaiya veathappiramaa'naththinpadiyea thittamaayp poathikkappattu, in'raiyaththinam neengka'lellaarum theavanaikku'riththu vairaakkiyamu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'rathupoala naanum vairaakkiyamu'l'lavanaayirunthean.
naan intha maarkkaththaaraakiya purusharaiyum sthireeka'laiyum katti, si'raichsaalaika'lil oppuviththu, mara'napariyantham thunpappaduththinean.

atha'rkup pirathaana aasaariyarum mooppar yaavarum saadchikoduppaarka'l; avarka'l kaiyilea naan sakoathararukku nirupangka'lai vaangkikko'ndu, thamaskuvilirukki'ravarka'lum tha'ndikkappadumpadikku, avarka'laik katti, erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvarumpadi avvidaththi'rkuppoanean.
appadi naan pirayaa'nappattuth thamaskuvukkuch sameepamaanapoathu, maththiyaana vea'laiyilea, sadithiyaay vaanaththilirunthu pearo'li u'ndaaki, ennaichsut'rip pirakaasiththathu.
naan tharaiyilea vizhunthean. appozhuthu: savulea, savulea, nee ennai ean thunpappaduththuki'raay en'ru ennudanea solluki'ra oru saththaththaik keattean.
atha'rku naan: aa'ndavarea, neer yaar en'rean. avar: nee thunpappaduththuki'ra nasareayanaakiya iyeasu naanea en'raar.
ennudaneakooda irunthavarka'l ve'lichchaththaik ka'ndu, payamadainthaarka'l; ennudanea peasinavarudaiya saththaththaiyoa avarka'l keadkavillai.
appozhuthu naan: aa'ndavarea, naan ennaseyyavea'ndum en'rean. atha'rkuk karththar: nee ezhunthu, thamaskuvukkup poa; nee seyyumpadi niyamikkappattathellaam angkea unakkuch sollappadum en'raar.
antha o'liyin makimaiyinaalea naan paarvaiyat'ruppoanapadiyinaal, ennoadirunthavarka'laal kailaaku koduththu vazhinadaththappattuth thamaskuvukku vanthean.
appozhuthu veathappiramaa'naththinpadiyea pakthiyu'l'lavanum, angkea kudiyirukki'ra sakala yootharaalum nallavanen'ru saadchipet'ravanumaakiya ananiyaa ennum oruvan,
ennidaththil vanthunin'ru: sakoatharanaakiya savulea, paarvaiyadaivaayaaka en'raan; annearamea naan paarvaiyadainthu, avanai ea'rittuppaarththean.
appozhuthu avan: nammudaiya munnoarka'lin theavanudaiya thiruvu'laththai nee a'riyavum, neethipararaith tharisikkavum, avarudaiya thiruvaaymozhiyaik keadkavum, avar unnai munnamea therinthuko'ndaar.
nee ka'ndavaika'laiyum keattavaika'laiyum ku'riththuch sakala manusharukkumunpaaka avarukkuch saadchiyaayiruppaay.
ippozhuthu nee thaamathikki'rathenna? nee ezhunthu karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu, gnaanasnaanampet'ru, un paavangka'l poakak kazhuvappadu en'raan.
pinpu naan erusaleamukkuth thirumpivanthu, theavaalayaththilea jepampa'n'nikko'ndirukkaiyil, gnaanathirushdiyadainthu, avaraith tharisiththean.
avar ennai noakki: nee ennaikku'riththuch sollum saadchiyai ivarka'l eat'rukko'l'lamaattaarka'l; aathalaal nee thaamathampa'n'naamal seekkiramaay erusaleamaivittup pu'rappattuppoa en'raar.
atha'rku naan: aa'ndavarea, ummidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravarka'lai naan kaavalil vaiththu jepaaalayangka'lilea adiththathaiyum,

ummudaiya saadchiyaakiya stheavaanudaiya iraththam sinthappaduki'rapoathu, naanum arukea nin'ru, avanaik kolaiseyvatha'rkuch sammathiththu, avanaik kolaiseythavarka'lin vasthirangka'laik kaaththukko'ndirunthathaiyum, ivarka'l a'rinthirukki'raarka'lea en'rean.
atha'rku avar: nee poa, naan unnaith thooramaayp pu'rajaathika'lidaththilea anuppuvean en'ru sonnaar en'raan.
intha vaarththaivaraikkum avanukkuch sevikoduththaarka'l. pinpu: ippadippattavanaip poomiyilirunthu akat'ravea'ndum; ivan uyiroadirukki'rathu niyaayamallaven'ru mikuntha saththamittuch sonnaarka'l.
ivvithamaay avarka'l kookkuralittuth thangka'l mealvasthirangka'lai e'rinthuvittu, aakaayaththilea puzhuthiyaith thoot'rikko'ndirukkaiyil,

seanaapathi avanaik koattaikku'l'lea ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittu, avarka'l avanukku viroathamaay ippadik kookkuralitta mukaantharaththai a'riyumpadikku avanaich savukkaal adiththu visaarikkach sonnaan.

anthappadi avarka'l avanai vaarinaal azhunthak kattumpoathu, pavul sameepamaay nin'ra noot'rukku athipathiyai noakki: roamanum niyaayam visaarikkappadaathavanumaayirukki'ra manushanai adikki'rathu ungka'lukku niyaayamaa en'raan.
noot'rukku athipathi athaikkeattu, seanaapathiyinidaththi'rkup poay, athai a'riviththu: neer seyyappoaki'rathaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirum; intha manushan roaman en'raan.
appozhuthu seanaapathi pavulinidaththil vanthu: nee roamanaa? enakkuch sol en'raan. atha'rku avan: naan roamanthaan en'raan.

seanaapathi pirathiyuththaramaaka: naan mikuntha thiraviyaththinaalea inthach silaakkiyaththaich sampaathiththean en'raan. atha'rkup pavul: naanoa inthach silaakkiyaththi'rkuriyavanaakap pi'ranthean en'raan.
avanai adiththu visaarikkumpadi eththanamaayirunthavarka'l udanea avanai vittuvittaarka'l. seanaapathi avan roamanen'ru a'rinthu, avanaik kattuviththatha'rkaakap payanthaan.

pavulinmeal yootharaalea ea'rpaduththappatta kut'ram innathen'ru nichchayamaay a'riya virumpi, avan ma'runaa'lilea avanaik kattavizhththu, pirathaana aasaariyaraiyum aaloasanaich sangkaththaar anaivaraiyum koodivarumpadi katta'laiyittu, avanaik koottikko'ndupoay, avarka'lukku munpaaka ni'ruththinaan.
pavul aaloasanaich sangkaththaarai ut'ruppaarththu: sakoathararea, innaa'lvaraikkum ellaa vishayangka'lilum naan nalmanachsaadchiyoadea theavanukkumunpaaka nadanthuvanthean en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ananiyaa avanukkuch sameepamaay nin'ravarka'lai noakki: ivan vaayil adiyungka'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan.

appozhuthu pavul avanaippaarththu: ve'l'laiyadikkappatta suvarea, theavan ummai adippaar; niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi ennai niyaayam visaarikki'ravaraay udkaarnthirukki'ra neer niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku viroathamaay ennai adikkach sollalaamaa en'raan.
sameepaththilea nin'ravarka'l: theavanudaiya pirathaanaaasaariyarai vaiki'raayaa en'raarka'l.
atha'rkup pavul: sakoathararea, ivar pirathaana aasaariyaren'ru enakkuth theriyaathu; un janaththin athipathiyaith theethu sollaayaaka en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea en'raan.

pinpu avarka'lil, sathuseayar oru pangkum pariseayar oru pangkumaayirukki'raarka'len'ru pavul a'rinthu: sakoathararea, naan pariseayanum pariseayanudaiya makanumaayirukki'rean. mariththoarudaiya uyirththezhuthalaippat'riya nampikkaiyaikku'riththu naan niyaayam visaarikkappaduki'rean en'ru aaloasanaich sangkaththilea saththamittuch sonnaan.
avan ippadich sonnapoathu, pariseayarukkum sathuseayarukkum vaakkuvaathamu'ndaayit'ru; koottam ira'ndaakap pirinthathu.
ennaththinaalen'raal, sathuseayar uyirththezhuthal illaiyen'rum, theavathoothanum aaviyum illaiyen'rum solluki'raarka'l. pariseayaroa avvira'ndum u'nden'ru oppukko'l'luki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal mikuntha kookkural u'ndaayit'ru. pariseaya samayaththaaraana veathapaarakaril silar ezhunthu: intha manushanidaththil oru pollaangkaiyum kaa'noam; oru aavi allathu oru theavathoothan ivanudanea peasinathu'ndaanaal, naam theavanudanea poarseyvathu thakaathu en'ru vaathaadinaarka'l.

mikuntha kalakam u'ndaanapoathu, pavul avarka'laal pee'ru'ndupoavaanen'ru seanaapathi payanthu, poarchseavakar poay, avanai avarka'l naduvilirunthu izhuththuk koattaikkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi katta'laiyittaan.
an'ru iraaththiriyilea karththar pavulin arukea nin'ru: pavulea, thidanko'l; nee ennaikku'riththu erusaleamilea saadchikoduththathupoala roamaavilum saadchikodukkavea'ndum en'raar.
vidiya'rkaalamaanapoathu, yootharil silar orumiththu, thaangka'l pavulaik kolaiseyyuma'lavum pusippathumillai kudippathumillaiyen'ru sapathampa'n'nikko'ndaarka'l.
ippadik kattuppaadu pa'n'nikko'ndavarka'l naa'rpathupearukku athikamaayirunthaarka'l.
avarka'l pirathaanaaasaariyarka'lidaththilum moopparka'lidaththilum poay: naangka'l pavulaik kolaiseyyuma'lavum on'rum pusippathillaiyen'ru u'ruthiyaana sapatham pa'n'nikko'ndoam.

aanapadiyinaal neengka'l aaloasanaich sangkaththaaroadea koodappoay, avanudaiya kaariyaththai athika thittamaay visaarikka manathu'l'lavarka'lpoalach seanaapathikkuk kaa'npiththu, avar naa'laikku avanai ungka'lidaththil koottikko'ndu varumpadi avaridaththil keadpeerka'laaka. avan kittavaruki'ratha'rku'l'lea naangka'l avanaik kolaiseyya aayaththamaayiruppoam en'raarka'l.
inthach sarppanaiyaip pavulinudaiya sakoathariyin kumaaran kea'lvippattu, koattaikku'l'lea poay, pavulukku a'riviththaan.
appozhuthu pavul noot'rukku athipathika'lil oruvanai azhaiththu, intha vaalipanaich seanaapathiyinidaththi'rkuk koottikko'ndupoam; avaridaththil ivan a'rivikkavea'ndiya oru kaariyam u'ndu en'raan.

anthappadiyea avan ivanaich seanaapathiyinidaththi'rkuk koottikko'ndupoay: kaavalil vaikkappattirukki'ra pavul ennai azhaiththu, umakkoru kaariyaththaich sollavea'ndumen'rirukki'ra intha vaalipanai ummidaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoakumpadi ennaik keattukko'ndaan en'raan.
appozhuthu seanaapathi avanudaiya kaiyaip pidiththuth thaniyea azhaiththukko'ndupoay: nee ennidaththil a'rivikkavea'ndiya kaariyam ennaven'ru keattaan.

atha'rku avan: yootharka'l pavulin kaariyaththai athika thittamaay visaarikka manathu'l'lavarka'lpoala, neer naa'laikku avanai aaloasanaich sangkaththaaridaththil ko'nduvarumpadi ummai vea'ndikko'l'la udanpattirukki'raarka'l.

neer avarka'lukkuch sammathikkavea'ndaam; avarka'lil naa'rpathupearukku athikamaanavarka'l avanaik kolaiseyyuma'lavum thaangka'l pusippathumillai kudippathumillaiyen'ru sapathampa'n'nikko'ndu, avanukkup pathivirunthu, ummudaiya uththaravukkaaka ippozhuthu kaaththukko'ndu aayaththamaayirukki'raarka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu seanaapathi: nee ivaika'lai enakku a'riviththathaaka oruvarukkugn sollaathea en'ru katta'laiyittu, vaalipanai anuppivittaan.

pinpu avan noot'rukku athipathika'lil ira'ndupearai azhaiththu, sesariyaapatta'naththi'rkup poakumpadi irunoo'ru kaalaadka'laiyum, ezhupathu kuthiraiveeraraiyum, irunoo'ru eettikkaararaiyum, iraaththiriyil moon'raamma'ni vea'laiyilea, aayaththampa'n'nungka'len'rum;
pavulai eat'ri, theasaathipathiyaakiya pealiksinidaththi'rkup paththiramaayk ko'ndupoakumpadikkuk kuthiraika'lai aayaththappaduththungka'len'rum sonnathuman'ri,
oru nirupaththaiyum ezhuthinaan; athin vivaramaavathu:
kanamporunthiya theasaathipathiyaakiya pealiks enpavarukkuk kilavuthiyu leesiyaa vaazhththuthal solli a'rivikki'rathu ennaven'raal:
intha manushanai yoothar pidiththuk kolaiseyyappoaki'ra samayaththil, naan poarchseavakaroadea koodappoay, ivan roamanen'ru a'rinthu, ivanai viduviththean.
avarka'l ivanmeal saattina kut'raththai naan a'riyavea'ndumen'ru ivanai avarka'l aaloasanaich sangkaththukkumun ko'ndupoanean.

ivan avarka'ludaiya veathaththi'rkaduththa vishayangka'laikku'riththuk kut'ragnsaattappattavanen'ru vi'langkinatheayallaamal, mara'naththukkaavathu vilangkukkaavathu eat'ra kut'ram yaathon'rum ivanidaththil illaiyen'ru ka'nda'rinthean.

yootharka'l ivanukku viroathamaaych sarppanaiyaana yoasanai seyki'raarka'len'ru enakkuth theriyavanthapoathu, udanea ivanai ummidaththi'rku anuppinean; kut'ragnsaattuki'ravarka'lum ivanukku viroathamaaych solluki'ra kaariyangka'lai umakku munpaaka vanthu sollumpadi avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittean. sukamaayiruppeeraaka, en'rezhuthinaan.
poarchseavakar thangka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, pavulaik koottikko'ndu, iraaththiriyilea anthippaththiri oorukkup poay,
ma'runaa'lil kuthiraiveerarai avanudaneakoodap poakumpadi anuppivittu, thaangka'l koattaikkuth thirumpinaarka'l.
avarka'l sesariyaapatta'naththil searnthu, nirupaththaith theasaathipathiyinidaththil koduththu, pavulaiyum avan munpaaka ni'ruththinaarka'l.
theasaathipathi athai vaasiththu: entha naattaanen'ru keattu, silisiyaa naattaanen'ru a'rinthapoathu:
unmeal kut'ragnsaattuki'ravarka'lum vanthirukkumpoathu un kaariyaththaith thittamaayk keadpeanen'ru solli, earoathin aramanaiyilea avanaik kaavalpa'n'numpadi katta'laiyittaan.

ainthunaa'laikkuppinpu pirathaana aasaariyanaakiya ananiyaa moopparka'loadum therththullu ennum oru niyaayasaathuriyanoadumkoodap poanaan, avarka'l pavulukku viroathamaayth theasaathipathiyinidaththil piraathupa'n'ninaarka'l.
avan azhaikkappattapoathu, therththullu kut'ragnsaattaththodangki:

kanamporunthiya pealiksea, ummaalea naangka'l mikuntha samaathaana savukkiyaththai anupavikki'rathaiyum, ummudaiya paraamarippinaalea inthath theasaththaarukkuch si'rantha nanmaika'l nadakki'rathaiyum naangka'l eppozhuthum engkum mikuntha nan'riya'rithaludanea angkikaarampa'n'nuki'roam.
ummai naan aneaka vaarththaika'linaalea alattaathapadikku, naangka'l surukkamaaych solvathai neer po'rumaiyaayk keadkavea'ndumen'ru piraarththikki'rean.

ennaven'raal, intha manushan ko'l'lainoayaakavum, poochchakkaraththilu'l'la sakala yootharka'lukku'l'lum kalakam ezhuppuki'ravanaakavum, nasareayarudaiya mathapeathaththukku muthalaa'liyaakavum irukki'raanen'ru ka'nda'rinthoam.
ivan theavaalayaththaiyum theettuppaduththap paarththaan. naangka'l ivanaippidiththu engka'l veathappiramaa'naththinpadiyea niyaayantheerkka manathaayirunthoam.
appozhuthu seanaapathiyaakiya leesiyaa vanthu, mikuntha palaathkaaramaay ivanai engka'l kaika'lilirunthu pa'riththukko'ndupoay,
ivanmeal kut'ragnsaattuki'ravarka'l ummidaththil varumpadi katta'laiyittaar. ivanidaththil neer visaariththaal naangka'l ivanmeal saattuki'ra kut'rangka'l yaavaiyum a'rinthuko'l'lalaam en'raan.
yootharka'lum atha'rku isainthu, ivaika'l yathaarththanthaan en'raarka'l.

pavul peasumpadi theasaathipathi saikaikaattinapoathu, avan uththaravaaka: neer aneaka varushakaalamaay inthath theasaththaarukku niyaayaathipathiyaayirukki'reeren'ra'rinthu, naan en kaariyangka'laikku'riththu athika thairiyaththudan uththaravu solluki'rean.
naan thozhuthuko'l'lumpadiyaaka erusaleamukkup poanathumuthal ithuvaraikkum pannira'ndu naa'lmaaththiram aayit'ren'ru neer a'rinthuko'l'lalaam.
theavaalayaththilea naan oruvaridaththilaavathu tharkkampa'n'ninathaiyum, naan jepaaalayangka'lilaakilum nakaraththilaakilum janangka'lukku'l'lea kalakamezhuppinathaiyum, ivarka'l ka'ndathillai.
ippozhuthu enmeal saattuki'ra kut'rangka'lai ivarka'l roopikkavumaattaarka'l.

ummidaththil on'rai oththukko'l'luki'rean; athennaven'raal, ivarka'l mathapeatham en'ru solluki'ra maarkkaththinpadiyea engka'l munnoarka'lin theavanukku aaraathanaiseythu niyaayappiramaa'naththileayum theerkkatharisika'l pusthakangka'lileayum ezhuthiyirukki'ra ellaavat'raiyum naan visuvaasiththu,
neethimaanka'lum aneethimaanka'lumaakiya mariththoar uyirththezhunthiruppathu u'nden'ru ivarka'l theavanidaththil nampikkaiko'ndirukki'rathu poala, naanum nampikkaiko'ndirukki'rean.
ithanaal naan theavanukkum manusharukkum munpaaka eppozhuthum kut'ramat'ra manachsaadchiyai udaiyavanaayirukkap pirayaasappaduki'rean.
aneaka varushangka'lukkup pinpu naan en janaththaarukkuth tharmappa'naththai oppuvikkavum, kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththavum vanthean.
appozhuthu koottamillaamalum ama'liyillaamalum theavaalayaththilea suththikariththukko'ndavanaayirukkaiyil, aasiyaa naattaaraana sila yootharka'l ennaik ka'ndaarka'l.
avarka'lukku enpearil viroathamaana kaariyam eathaakilum u'ndaayirunthaal, avarka'lea ingkea vanthu, umakku munpaakak kut'ragnsaattavea'ndum.
naan aaloasanaich sangkaththaarukku munpaaka nin'rapoathu avarka'l yaathoru aniyaayaththai ennidaththil ka'ndathu'ndaanaal ivarka'lea athaichsollattum.

naan avarka'lukku'l'lea nin'rapoathu mariththoar uyirththezhunthiruppathaikku'riththu, in'ru ungka'laalea niyaayantheerkkappaduki'reanen'ru naan sonna oru sollinimiththameayan'ri vea'ron'rinimiththamum kut'rangkaa'nappadavillai en'raan.

intha maarkkaththin vishayangka'lai vivaramaay a'rinthiruntha pealiks ivaika'laik keattapozhuthu: seanaapathiyaakiya leesiyaa varumpoathu ungka'l kaariyangka'laith thittamaay visaarippean en'ru solli;

pavulaik kaavalpa'n'navum, ka'ndippillaamal nadaththavum, avanukku oozhiyagnseyki'ratha'rkum avanaik ka'nduko'l'luki'ratha'rkum varuki'ra avanudaiya manusharka'lil oruvaraiyum thadaiseyyaathirukkavum noot'rukku athipathiyaanavanukkuk katta'laiyittu, avarka'laik kaaththirukkumpadiseythaan.
sila naa'laikkuppinpu pealiks yoothasthireeyaakiya than manaivi thurusillaa'ludaneakooda vanthu, pavulai azhaippiththu, ki'risthuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththaik ku'riththu avan sollakkeattaan.

avan, neethiyaiyum, ichchaiyadakkaththaiyum, inivarum niyaayaththeerppaiyumku'riththup peasukaiyil, pealiks payamadainthu: ippozhuthu nee poakalaam, enakkuch samayamaanapoathu unnai azhaippippean en'raan.
mealum, avan pavulai viduthalaipa'n'numpadi thanakku avan pa'nangkoduppaanen'ru nampikkaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; athinimiththam avan aneakantharam avanai azhaiththu, avanudanea peasinaan.

ira'ndu varusham sen'rapinpu pealiks enpavanukkup pathilaayp porkkiyupesthu theasaathipathiyaaka vanthaan; appozhuthu pealiks yootharukkuth thayavuseyya manathaayp pavulaik kaavalil vaiththuvittuppoanaan.
pesthu enpavan naatti'rku athipathiyaaka vanthu, moon'runaa'laanapinpu, sesariyaavilirunthu erusaleamukkup poanaan.
appozhuthu pirathaana aasaariyanum yootharil muthanmaiyaanavarka'lum avanidaththil vanthu, pavulukku viroathamaakap piraathupa'n'ni,
avanai vazhiyilea kon'rupoadumpadi sarppanaiyaana yoasanaiyu'l'lavarka'laay, thangka'lmeal thayavuseythu, avanai erusaleamukku azhaippikkavea'ndumen'ru vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
atha'rkup pesthu pirathiyuththaramaaka: pavulaich sesariyaavilea kaavalpa'n'niyirukki'rathea; naanum seekkiramaaka angkea poaki'rean.
aakaiyaal ungka'lil thi'ramu'l'lavarka'l koodavanthu, antha manushanidaththil kut'ram eathaakilum u'ndaanaal, anthak kut'raththai avanmeal saattattum en'raan.
avan avarka'lidaththilea ea'rakku'raiya paththunaa'l sagnchariththu, pinpu sesariyaavukkup poay, ma'runaa'lilea niyaayaasanaththil udkaarnthu, pavulaik ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittaan.
avan vanthapoathu, erusaleamilirunthuvantha yootharka'l avanaich soozhnthunin'ru, thangka'laal roopikkakkoodaatha aneakang kodiya kut'rangka'lai avanmeal saattinaarka'l.
atha'rku avan uththaravaaka: naan yootharudaiya veathappiramaa'naththukkaakilum, theavaalayaththukkaakilum, iraayarukkaakilum viroathamaaka oru kut'ramum seyyavillaiyen'ru sonnaan.

appozhuthu pesthu yootharukkuth thayavuseyya manathaay, pavulai noakki: nee erusaleamukkup poay, avvidaththilea inthak kaariyangka'laikku'riththu enakku munpaaka niyaayam visaarikkappada unakkuch sammathiyaa en'raan.

atha'rkup pavul: naan iraayarudaiya niyaayaasanaththukku munpaaka ni'rki'rean; atha'rku munpaaka naan niyaayam visaarikkappadavea'ndiyathu; yootharukku naan aniyaayam on'rum seyyavillai, athai neerum nan'raay a'rinthirukki'reer.

naan aniyaayagnseythu, mara'naththukkup paaththiramaanathu eathaakilum nadappiththathu'ndaanaal, naan saakaathapadikku manukeadkamaattean. ivarka'l enmeal saattuki'ra kut'rangka'l mut'rilum apaththamaanaal, avarka'lukkuth thayavupa'n'numporuttu oruvarum ennai avarka'lukku oppukkodukkalaakaathu. iraayarukku apayamiduki'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu pesthu than aaloasanaikkaararudanea aaloasiththu: nee iraayarukku apayamittaayea; iraayaridaththi'rkea poakakkadavaayen'ru uththaravu sonnaan.
silanaa'l sen'rapinpu, akirippaa raajaavum perneekkeayaa'lum pesthuvaik ka'nduko'l'lumpadi sesariyaavukku vanthaarka'l.
avarka'l angkea aneakanaa'l sagnchariththirukkaiyil, pesthu pavulin sangkathiyai raajaavukku vivariththu: pealiks kaavalil vaiththuppoana oru manushan irukki'raan.

naan erusaleamil irunthapoathu, pirathaana aasaariyarka'lum yootharudaiya moopparka'lum avanaikku'riththu ennidaththil piraathupa'n'ni, avanukku viroathamaakath theerppuseyyavea'ndumen'ru keattukko'ndaarka'l.

avarka'lukku naan pirathiyuththaramaaka: kut'ragnsaattappatta manushan kut'ragnsaattinavarka'lukku mukamukamaay nin'ru, saattina kut'raththukkuth thanakkaaka ethiruththaravu solla avanukku idangkidaikki'ratha'rkumunnea, kut'ragnsaattinavarka'l padchamaay avanai mara'naththi'rku oppukkodukki'rathu roamarukku vazhakkamalla en'rean.
aakaiyaal avarka'l ingkea koodivanthapoathu, naan evva'lavum thaamathampa'n'naamal, ma'runaa'l niyaayaasanaththil udkaarnthu, antha manushanaik ko'nduvarumpadi katta'laiyittean.
appozhuthu kut'ragnsaattinavarka'l vanthunin'ru, naan ninaiththiruntha kut'rangka'lil on'raiyum avanmeal sumaththaamal,

thangka'ludaiya maarkkaththaikku'riththum, mariththuppoana iyeasu ennum oruvan uyiroadirukki'raanen'ru pavul saathiththathaikku'riththum sila tharkkavishayangka'lai avan pearil viroathamaaych sonnaarka'l.

ippadippatta tharkka vishayangka'laikku'riththu enakkuch santheakamirunthapadiyinaal: nee erusaleamukkup poay, angkea ivaika'laikku'riththu niyaayam visaarikkappada unakkuch sammathiyaa en'ru keattean.

atha'rkup pavul, thaan iraayarukkumunpaaka niyaayam visaarikkappadumpadikku ni'ruththivaikkappadavea'ndumen'ru apayamittapoathu, naan avanai iraayanidaththi'rku anuppuma'lavum kaavalpa'n'numpadi katta'laiyittean en'raan.
appozhuthu akirippaa pesthuvai noakki: antha manushan solluki'rathai naanum keadka manathaayirukki'rean en'raan. atha'rku avan: naa'laikku neer keadkalaam en'raan.

ma'runaa'lilea akirippaavum perneekkeayaa'lum mikuntha aadamparaththudanea vanthu seanaapathika'loadum patta'naththuppirathaana manusharoadungkooda niyaayasthalaththil piraveasiththaarka'l. udanea pesthuvinudaiya katta'laiyinpadi pavul ko'nduvarappattaan.

appozhuthu pesthu: akirippaa raajaavea, engka'loadeakooda ivvidaththil vanthirukki'ravarka'lea, neengka'l kaa'nki'ra intha manushanaikku'riththu yoothajanangka'lellaarum erusaleamilum ivvidaththilum ennai varunthik keattukko'ndu, ivan ini uyiroadirukki'rathu thakaathen'ru sollik kookkuralittaarka'l.

ivan mara'naththukkup paaththiramaanathon'raiyum seyyavillaiyen'ru naan a'rinthuko'ndathinaalum, ivanthaanea iraayanukku apayamittapadiyinaalum, avaridaththil ivanai anuppumpadi theermaanampa'n'ninean.

ivanaikku'riththu aa'ndavanukku ezhuthuki'ratha'rku nichchayappatta kaariyamon'rum enakku vi'langkavillai. kaavalpa'n'nappatta oruvan seytha kut'rangka'lai eduththukkaattaamal anuppuki'rathu puththiyeenamaana kaariyamen'ru enakkuth thoan'ruki'rapadiyinaalea,

ivanai visaariththuk keattapinpu ezhuthaththakka viseasham eathaakilum enakku vi'langkumpadi, ivanai ungka'lukku munpaakavum, viseashamaay akirippaa raajaavea, umakku munpaakavum ko'nduvanthean en'raan.
akirippaa pavulai noakki: nee unakkaakap peasa unakku uththaravaaki'rathu en'raan. appozhuthu pavul kaiyai neetti, thanakkaaka uththaravu sollaththodangkinaan.
akirippaa raajaavea, yootharka'l enmeal saattuki'ra sakala kaariyangka'laikku'riththum naan in'raikku umakku munpaaka uththaravu sollappoaki'rapadiyinaalea ennaip paakkiyavaan en're'n'nuki'rean.

viseashamaay neer yootharudaiya sakala mu'raimaika'laiyum tharkkangka'laiyum a'rinthavaraanathaal appadi e'n'nuki'rean; aakaiyaal naan solvathaip po'rumaiyoadea keadkumpadi ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naan en si'ruvayathumutha'rko'ndu, erusaleamilea en janaththaarukku'l'lea irunthapadiyaal, aathimuthal naan nadantha nadakkaiyai yootharellaarum a'rinthirukki'raarka'l.
nammudaiya maarkkaththilu'l'la samayapeathangka'lil mikavum ka'ndippaana samayaththukku isainthapadi pariseayanaay nadantheanen'ru saadchisolla avarka'lukku manathirunthaal sollalaam.
theavan nammudaiya pithaakka'lukku aru'lichseytha vaakkuththaththam ni'raivea'rumenki'ra nampikkaikkaakavea naan ippozhuthu niyaayaththeerppadaiki'ravanaay ni'rki'rean.

iravum pakalum idaividaamal aaraathanai seythuvaruki'ra nammudaiya pannira'ndu koaththiraththaarum antha vaakkuththaththam ni'raivea'rumen'ru nampiyirukki'raarka'l. akirippaa raajaavea, antha nampikkaiyinimiththamea yootharka'l enmeal kut'ragnsaattuki'raarka'l.
theavan mariththoarai ezhuppuki'rathu nampappadaatha kaariyamen'ru neengka'l e'n'nuki'rathenna?
munnea naanum nasareayanaakiya iyeasuvin naamaththi'rku viroathamaay aneaka kaariyangka'lai nadappikkavea'ndumen'ru ninaiththirunthean.

appadiyea naan erusaleamilum seythean. naan pirathaana aasaariyarka'lidaththil athikaaram pet'ru, parisuththavaanka'lil aneakaraich si'raichsaalaika'lil adaiththean; avarka'l kolaiseyyappadukaiyil naanum sammathiththirunthean.

sakala jepaaalayangka'lilum naan avarka'lai aneakantharam tha'ndiththu, theavathoosha'nagn sollak kattaayappaduththinean; avarka'l pearil moorkkave'ri ko'ndavanaay anniyapatta'nangka'lvaraikkum avarka'laith thunpappaduththinean.
ippadich seythuvarukaiyil, naan pirathaana aasaariyarka'lidaththil athikaaramum uththaravum pet'ru, thamaskuvukkup poakumpoathu,

maththiyaana vea'laiyil, raajaavea, naan vazhiyilea sooriyanudaiya pirakaasaththilum athikamaana o'li vaanaththilirunthu ennaiyum ennudaneakoodap pirayaa'nampa'n'ninavarka'laiyum sut'rip pirakaasikkakka'ndean.

naangka'lellaarum tharaiyilea vizhunthapoathu: savulea, savulea, nee ean ennaith thunpappaduththuki'raay? mu'l'lil uthaikki'rathu unakkuk kadinamaam en'ru epireyu paashaiyilea ennudanea solluki'ra oru saththaththaik keattean.
appozhuthu naan: aa'ndavarea, neer yaar en'rean. atha'rku avar: nee thunpappaduththuki'ra iyeasu naanea.

ippozhuthu nee ezhunthu, kaalun'ri nil. nee ka'ndavaika'laiyum naan unakkuth tharisanamaakik kaa'npikkappoaki'ravaika'laiyum ku'riththu unnai oozhiyakkaaranaakavum saadchiyaakavum ea'rpaduththuki'ratha'rkaaka unakkuth tharisanamaanean.
un suyajanaththaaridaththinin'rum anniya janaththaaridaththinin'rum unnai viduthalaiyaakki,

avarka'l ennaip pat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea paavamannippaiyum parisuththamaakkappattavarka'lukkuriya suthantharaththaiyum pet'rukko'l'lumpadiyaaka, avarka'l iru'laivittu o'liyinidaththi'rkum, saaththaanudaiya athikaaraththaivittuth theavanidaththi'rkum thirumpumpadikku nee avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'laith thi'rakkumporuttu, ippozhuthu unnai avarka'lidaththi'rku anuppuki'rean en'raar.
aakaiyaal, akirippaa raajaavea, naan anthap paramatharisanaththukkuk keezhppadiyaathavanaayirukkavillai.

munpu thamaskuvilum erusaleamilum yootheayaa theasamengkumu'l'lavarka'lidaththilum, pinpu pu'rajaathiyaaridaththilum naan poay, avarka'l theavanidaththi'rku mananthirumpik ku'nappadavum, mananthirumputhalukkeat'ra kiriyaika'laich seyyavum vea'ndumen'ru a'riviththean.
ithinimiththamea yootharka'l theavaalayaththilea ennaip pidiththuk kolaiseyyap pirayaththanampa'n'ninaarka'l.
aanaalum theava anukkirakam pet'ru, naan innaa'lvaraikkum si'riyoarukkum periyoarukkum saadchikoo'ri varuki'rean.

theerkkatharisika'lum moaseayum munnamea solliyirunthapadiyea, ki'risthu paadupadavea'ndiyathen'rum, mariththoar uyirththezhuthalil avar muthalvaraaki, suya janangka'lukkum anniya janangka'lukkum o'liyai ve'lippaduththuki'ravaren'rum solluki'reaneayan'ri, vea'ron'raiyum naan solluki'rathillai en'raan.
ivvithamaay avan thanakkaaka uththaravu sollukaiyil, pesthu uraththa saththamaay: pavulea, nee pithat'ruki'raay, athikak kalvi unakkup payiththiyamu'ndaakkuki'rathu en'raan.
atha'rku avan: kanamporunthiya pesthuvea, naan payiththiyakkaaranalla, saththiyamum sosthapuththiyumu'l'la vaarththaika'laip peasuki'rean.

inthach sangkathika'lai raajaa a'rinthirukki'raar; aakaiyaal thairiyamaay avarukku munpaakap peasuki'rean; ivaika'lil on'rum avarukku ma'raivaanathallaven'ru e'n'nuki'rean; ithu oru moolaiyilea nadantha kaariyamalla.
akirippaa raajaavea, theerkkatharisika'lai visuvaasikki'reeraa? visuvaasikki'reer en'ru a'rivean en'raan.
appozhuthu akirippaa pavulai noakki: naan ki'risthavanaaki'ratha'rkuk kognchangku'raiya nee ennaich sammathikkappa'n'nuki'raay en'raan.

atha'rkup pavul: neer maaththiramalla, in'ru en vasanaththaik keadki'ra yaavarum, kognchangku'raiyamaaththiram alla, inthak kattuka'l thavira, muzhuvathum ennaippoalaakumpadi theavanai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean en'raan.
ivaika'lai avan sonnapoathu, raajaavum theasaathipathiyum perneekkeayaa'lum avarka'ludaneakooda udkaarnthirunthavarka'lum ezhunthu,
thaniyea poay: intha manushan mara'naththukkaavathu kattuka'lukkaavathu paaththiramaanathon'raiyum seyyavillaiyen'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea peasikko'ndaarka'l.
akirippaa pesthuvai noakki: intha manushan iraayanukku apayamidaathirunthaanaanaal, ivanai viduthalaipa'n'nalaakum en'raan.

naangka'l iththaaliyaa theasaththukkuk kappal ea'rip poakumpadi theermaanikkappattapoathu, pavulaiyum kaavalil vaikkappattiruntha vea'rusilaraiyum akusthu pattaa'laththaichsearntha yooliyu ennum pearko'nda noot'rukku athipathiyinidaththil oppuviththaarka'l.

athiramiththiyam oorkkappalil naangka'l ea'ri, aasiyaa naattuk karaipidiththoadavea'ndumen'ru ninaiththup pu'rappattoam. makkethoaniyaa theasaththuth thesaloanikkea patta'naththaanaakiya aristharkku engka'ludaneakooda irunthaan.
ma'runaa'l seethoan thu'raipidiththoam. yooliyu pavulaip padchamaay nadappiththu, avan than sineakitharidaththilea poayp paraamarippadaiyumpadikku uththaravu koduththaan.
avvidamvittu naangka'l pu'rappattu, ethirkaat'raayirunthapadiyinaal, seeppurutheevin othukkilea oadinoam.
pinpu silisiyaa pampiliyaa naaduka'lin kadalvazhiyaay oadi, leesiyaa naattu mee'raappatta'naththil searnthoam.
iththaaliyaavukkup poaki'ra aleksanthiriyaapatta'naththuk kappalai noot'rukku athipathi angkea ka'ndu, engka'lai athil eat'rinaan.

kaat'ru engka'laith thaduththapadiyinaalea, naangka'l aneakanaa'l methuvaaych sen'ru, varuththaththoadea kineethupatta'naththi'rku ethirea vanthu, salmoanea oorukku ethiraayk kireaththaatheevin othukkil oadinoam.
athai varuththaththoadea kadanthu, nalla thu'raimukam ennappatta oru idaththi'rku vanthoam; laseayapatta'nam atha'rkuch sameepamaayirunthathu.
vekukaalam sen'ru, upavaasanaa'lum kazhinthupoanapadiyinaalea, inik kappalyaaththirai seyki'rathu moasaththi'rku eathuvaayirukkumen'ru, pavul avarka'lai noakki:

manusharea, intha yaaththiraiyinaalea sarakkukkum kappalukkum maaththiramalla, nammudaiya jeevanukkum varuththamum mikuntha seathamum u'ndaayirukkumen'ru kaa'nki'rean en'ru solli, avarka'lai echchariththaan.
noot'rukku athipathi pavulinaal sollappattavaika'laip paarkkilum maalumiyaiyum kappal ejamaanaiyum athikamaay nampinaan.

anthath thu'raimukam mazhaikaalaththilea thangkuvatha'rku vasathiyaayiraathapadiyinaal, avvidaththai vittuth thenmea'rkaiyum vadamea'rkaiyum noakkiyirukkum kireaththaatheevilu'l'la thu'raimukamaakiya peaniks ennum idaththil searakkoodumaanaal searnthu, mazhaikaalaththil thangkumpadi aneakampear aaloasanai sonnaarka'l.
then'ral methuvaayadiththapadiyaal, thaangka'l koarinathu kaikoodivanthathen'ru e'n'ni, avvidamvittup peyarnthu kireaththaatheevukku arukaaka oadinaarka'l.
kognchanearaththukku'l'lea yooroakkilithoan ennung kadungkaat'ru athil moathit'ru.
kappal athil akappattukko'ndu, kaat'rukku ethirththuppoakakkoodaathapadiyinaal kaat'rin poakkilea ko'ndupoakappattoam.
appadik kilavuthaa ennappatta oru sinna theevin othukkilea oadukaiyil veku varuththaththoadea padavai vasappaduththinoam.
athai avarka'l thookkiyeduththapinpu, pala upaayangka'l seythu, kappalaichsut'rik katti, sorima'nalilea vizhuvoamen'ru payanthu, paayka'lai i'rakki, ivvithamaayk ko'ndupoakappattaarka'l.
mealum perungkaat'ru mazhaiyil naangka'l mikavum adipattapadiyinaal, ma'runaa'lil sila sarakkuka'laik kadalil e'rinthaarka'l.
moon'raam naa'lilea kappalin tha'lavaadangka'lai engka'l kaika'linaalea eduththu e'rinthoam.

aneakanaa'laaych sooriyanaavathu nadchaththirangka'laavathu kaa'nappadaamal, mikuntha perungkaat'rumazhaiyum adiththuk ko'ndirunthapadiyinaal, ini thappip pizhaippoamennum nampikkai muzhumaiyum at'ruppoayit'ru.

aneakanaa'l avarka'l poajanampa'n'naamal irunthapoathu, pavul avarka'l naduvilea nin'ru: manusharea, intha varuththamum seathamum varaathapadikku en sollaikkeattu, kireaththaatheevai vittuppu'rappadaamal irukkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
aakilum, thidamanathaayirungka'len'ru ippozhuthu ungka'lukkuth thairiyagnsolluki'rean. kappa'rseathameayallaamal ungka'lil oruvanukkum piraa'nachseatham varaathu.
eanen'raal, ennai aadko'ndavarum naan seavikki'ravarumaana theavanudaiya thoothanaanavan intha iraaththiriyilea ennidaththil vanthunin'ru:
pavulea, payappadaathea, nee iraayanukku munpaaka ni'rkavea'ndum. ithoa, unnudaneakooda yaaththiraipa'n'nuki'ra yaavaraiyum theavan unakkuth thayavupa'n'ninaar en'raan.
aanapadiyinaal manusharea, thidamanathaayirungka'l. enakkuch sollappatta pirakaaramaakavea nadakkum en'ru theavanidaththil nampikkaiyaayirukki'rean.
aayinum naam oru theevilea vizhavea'ndiyathaayirukkum en'raan.
pathinaalaam iraaththiriyaanapoathu, naangka'l aathiriyaak kadalilea alaivupattu oadukaiyil, nadujaamaththilea kappalaadka'lukku oru karai kittivaruki'rathaakath thoan'rit'ru.
udanea avarka'l vizhuthuvittu irupathu paakamen'ru ka'ndaarka'l; sat'rappu'ram poanapozhuthu, ma'rupadiyum vizhuthu vittup pathinainthu paakamen'ru ka'ndaarka'l.
paa'raiyidangka'lil vizhuvoamen'ru payanthu, pinna'niyaththilirunthu naalu nangkoorangka'laippoattu, pozhuthu eppoathu vidiyumoa en'rirunthaarka'l.
appozhuthu kappalaadka'l kappalai vittoadippoaka vakaitheadi, munna'niyaththilirunthu nangkoorangka'laip poadappoaki'ra paavanaiyaayp padavaik kadalil i'rakkukaiyil,
pavul noot'rukku athipathiyaiyum seavakaraiyum noakki: ivarka'l kappalil iraavittaal neengka'l thappip pizhaikkamaatteerka'l en'raan.
appozhuthu, poarchseavakar padavin kayi'ruka'lai a'ruththu, athaith thaazhavizhavittaarka'l.
pozhuthu vidikaiyil ellaarum poajanampa'n'numpadi pavul avarka'lukkuth thairiyagnsolli: neengka'l in'ru pathinaalunaa'laay on'rum saappidaamal pattiniyaayirukki'reerka'l.
aakaiyaal poajanampa'n'numpadi ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean, neengka'l thappip pizhaippatha'rku athu uthaviyaayirukkum; ungka'l thalaiyilirunthu oru mayirum vizhaathu en'raan.
ippadich solli, appaththai eduththu, ellaarukkumunpaakavum theavanai sthoaththiriththu, athaip pittup pusikkaththodangkinaan.
appozhuthu ellaarum thidamanappattup pusiththaarka'l.
kappalil irunoot'rezhupaththaa'ru pear irunthoam.
thirupthiyaakap pusiththapinpu avarka'l koathumaiyaik kadalilea e'rinthu, kappalai ilakuvaakkinaarka'l.

pozhuthu vidinthapinpu, innapoomiyen'ru a'riyaathirunthaarka'l. appozhuthu samamaana karaiyu'l'la oru thu'raimukam avarka'lukkuth thenpattathu; koodumaanaal atha'rku'l kappalaiyoatta yoasanaiyaayirunthu,
nangkoorangka'lai a'ruththuk kadalilea vittuvittu, sukkaanka'ludaiya kattuka'laith tha'laravittu, perumpaayaik kaat'rumukamaay viriththu, karaikku nearaay oadi,
irupu'ramum kadal moathiya oru idaththilea kappalaith thattavaiththaarka'l; munna'niyam oon'ri asaiyaamalirunthathu, pinna'niyam alaika'ludaiya palaththinaal udainthupoayit'ru.
appozhuthu kaavalpa'n'nappattavarka'lil oruvanum neenthi oadippoakaathapadikku avarka'laik kon'rupoadavea'ndumen'ru poarchseavakar yoasanaiyaayirunthaarka'l.
noot'rukku athipathi pavulaik kaappaat'ra manathaayirunthu, avarka'ludaiya yoasanaiyaith thaduththu, neenthaththakkavarka'l munthik kadalil vizhunthu karaiyea'ravum,
mat'ravarka'lil silar palakaika'lmealum, silar kappal thu'nduka'lmealum poayk karaiyea'ravum katta'laiyittaan; ivvithamaay ellaarum thappik karaisearnthaarka'l.
naangka'l thappik karaisearnthapinpu, anthath theevinpear meliththaa en'ru a'rinthoam.

anniyaraakiya anthath theevaar engka'lukkup paaraattina anpu kognchamalla. antha vea'laiyilea pidiththiruntha mazhaikkaakavum ku'lirukkaakavum avarka'l neruppai mootti, engka'l anaivaraiyum searththukko'ndaarka'l.
pavul sila vi'rakuka'lai vaari antha neruppinmeal poadukaiyil, oru viriyanpaampu analu'raiththup pu'rappattu avanudaiya kaiyaik kavvikko'ndathu.

vishappoochchi avan kaiyilea thongkuki'rathai anniyaraakiya anthath theevaar ka'ndapoathu, intha manushan kolaipaathakan, itha'rkuch santheakamillai; ivan samuththiraththukkuth thappivanthum, pazhiyaanathu ivanaip pizhaikkavottavillaiyen'ru thangka'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarka'l.
avan anthap poochchiyaith theeyilea utha'rippoattu, oru theengkum adaiyaathirunthaan.

avanukku veekkangka'ndu, allathu avan sadithiyaay vizhunthu saavaanen'ru avarka'l paarththukko'ndirunthaarka'l; nedunearamaayp paarththukko'ndirunthum, oru seathamum avanukku varaathathaik ka'ndapoathu, vea'ru sinthaiyaaki, ivan theavanen'ru sollikko'ndaarka'l.
