theevukku muthalaa'liyaakiya pupiliyu ennum pearko'ndavanudaiya nilangka'l antha idaththi'rkuch sameepamaayirunthathu; avan engka'lai eat'rukko'ndu, moon'runaa'l padchamaay visaariththaan.
pupiliyuvinudaiya thakappan juraththinaalum iraththapeathiyinaalum varuththappattuk kidanthaan; pavul avanidaththi'rkup poay jepampa'n'ni, avanmeal kaika'lai vaiththu, avanaik ku'namaakkinaan.
ithu nadanthapinpu, theevilea iruntha mat'ra viyaathikkaararum vanthu, ku'namaakkappattaarka'l.
avarka'l engka'lukku aneaka mariyaathai seythu, naangka'l kappal ea'rippoaki'rapoathu engka'lukkuth theavaiyaanavaika'lai eat'rinaarka'l.
moon'rumaatham sen'rapinpu, anthath theevilea mazhaikaalaththi'rkuth thangkiyiruntha mithunam ennum adaiyaa'lamudaiya aleksanthiriyaapatta'naththuk kappalilea naangka'l ea'rip pu'rappattu,
seerakoosaa patta'naththaich searnthu, angkea moon'runaa'l thangkinoam.
avvidamvittuch sut'riyoadi, reakiyuthu'raimukaththukku vanthu searnthoam. ma'runaa'lil then'ra'r kaat'redukkaiyil pu'rappattu, ira'ndaam naa'l puththeayoalipatta'naththi'rku vanthu,
angkea sakoathararaik ka'ndoam; avarka'l engka'lai eazhunaa'l thangka'lidaththil irukkumpadi vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l; anthappadi naangka'l irunthu, pinpu roamaapurikkup poanoam.

avvidaththilu'l'la sakoathararka'l naangka'l varuki'ra seythiyaik kea'lvippattu, silar appiyupuramvaraikkum, silar moon'ru saththiramvaraikkum, engka'lukku ethirko'nduvanthaarka'l; avarka'laip pavul ka'ndu, theavanai sthoaththiriththuth thairiyamadainthaan.

naangka'l roamaapuriyil searnthapoathu, noot'rukku athipathi than kaavalilirunthavarka'laich seanaapathiyinidaththil oppukkoduththaan; appozhuthu pavul thannaik kaaththirukki'ra seavakanudanea thaniththuk kudiyirukkumpadi uththaravu pet'rukko'ndaan.

moon'runaa'laikkuppinpu, pavul yootharil pirathaanamaanavarka'lai varavazhaiththaan; avarka'l koodivanthirunthapoathu, avan avarka'lai noakki: sakoathararea, nammudaiya janangka'lukkum nammudaiya munnoarka'lin mu'raimaika'lukkum viroathamaanathon'raiyum naan seyyaamalirunthum, kattappattavanaaka erusaleamilirunthu roamar kaika'lil oppukkodukkappattean.
avarka'l ennai niyaayam visaariththapoathu mara'naththukkeathuvaana kut'ram on'rum ennidaththil kaa'naathapadiyinaal, ennai viduthalaiyaakka manathaayirunthaarka'l.
yootharka'l atha'rku ethirpeasinapoathu, naan iraayanukku apayamidavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu; aayinum en janaththaarmeal yaathoru kut'ragn saattavea'ndumen'ru naan appadich seyyavillai.
inthak kaariyaththinimiththamea ungka'laik kaa'navum ungka'ludanea peasavum ungka'lai azhaippiththean. isravealudaiya nampikkaikkaakavea inthach sangkiliyaal kattappattirukki'rean en'raan.

atha'rku avarka'l: unnaikku'riththu yootheayaavilirunthu engka'lukkuk kaakitham varavumillai, vantha sakoathararil oruvanum unpearil oru pollaangkai a'riviththathumillai, athaippat'rip peasinathumillai.
engkum intha mathapeathaththukku viroathamaayp peasuki'rathaaka naangka'l a'rinthirukki'rapadiyaal, ithaikku'riththu unnudaiya apippiraayam ennaven'ru keatta'riya virumpuki'roam en'raarka'l.

atha'rkaaka avarka'l oru naa'laikku'riththu, aneakampear avan thangkiyiruntha veetti'rku avanidaththil vanthaarka'l. avan kaalamea thodangkich saayangkaalamattum moaseayin niyaayappiramaa'naththilum theerkkatharisika'lin aakamangka'lilum irunthu iyeasuvukkaduththa viseashangka'lai avarka'lukkup poathiththu, theavanudaiya raajyaththaik ku'riththuch saadchikoduththu visthariththup peasinaan.
avan sonnavaika'laich silar visuvaasiththaarka'l, silar visuvaasiyaathirunthaarka'l.
ippadi avarka'l oruvaroadoruvar ovvaamalirunthu, pu'rappattuppoakaiyil, pavul avarka'lukkuch sonna vaakkiyamaavathu:
neengka'l kaathaarakkeattum u'naraathiruppeerka'l, ka'n'naarakka'ndum paaraathiruppeerka'l.

ivarka'l ka'nka'linaal kaa'naamalum, kaathuka'linaal kea'laamalum, iruthayaththinaal u'narnthu ku'nappadaamalum, naan ivarka'lai aaroakkiyamaakkaamalum irukkumpadikku, intha janaththin iruthayam kozhuththirukki'rathu; kaathuka'linaal manthamaayk keattuth thangka'l ka'nka'lai moodikko'ndaarka'l en'ru intha janaththinidaththil poaych sollu enpathaip parisuththaaavi easaayaa theerkkatharisiyaikko'ndu nammudaiya pithaakka'ludanea nan'raaych solliyirukki'raar.
aathalaal theavanudaiya iradchippu pu'rajaathiyaarukku anuppappattirukki'rathen'rum, avarka'l atha'rkuch sevikoduppaarka'len'rum ungka'lukkuth therinthirukkakkadavathu en'raan.
ippadi avan sonnapinpu, yootharka'l thangka'lukku'l'lea mikavum tharkkam pa'n'nikko'ndu, poayvittaarka'l.
pinpu pavul thanakkaaka vaadakaikku vaangkiyiruntha veettilea ira'ndu varushamuzhuthum thangki, thannidaththil vantha yaavaraiyum eat'rukko'ndu,
mikuntha thairiyaththudanea thadaiyillaamal, theavanudaiya raajyaththaik ku'riththup pirasangkiththu, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'riya viseashangka'lai upatheasiththukko'ndirunthaan.
iyeasuki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaaranum, appoasthalanaakumpadi azhaikkappattavanum, theavanudaiya suviseashaththi'rkaakap piriththedukkappattavanumaakiya pavul,
roamaapuriyilu'l'la theavappiriyarum parisuththavaanka'laakumpadi azhaikkappattavarka'lumaakiya anaivarukkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu;
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

iyeasuki'risthuvaikku'riththuth theavan thammudaiya theerkkatharisika'l moolamaayp parisuththa veathaakamangka'lil munnea thammudaiya suviseashaththaippat'ri vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninapadi karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvaanavar,

maamsaththinpadi thaaveethin santhathiyil pi'ranthavarum, parisuththamu'l'la aaviyinpadi theavanudaiya suthanen'ru mariththoarilirunthu uyirththezhunthathinaalea palamaay roopikkappatta theavakumaaranumaayirukki'raar.
avar sakala jaathika'laiyum, avarka'lukku'l iyeasuki'risthuvinaal azhaikkappattavarka'laakiya ungka'laiyum,
thamathu naamaththinimiththam visuvaasaththukkuk keezhppadiyappa'n'numporuttu, engka'lukkuk kirupaiyaiyum appoasthala oozhiyaththaiyum aru'lichseythirukki'raar.
ungka'l visuvaasam ulakamengkum pirasiththamaaki'rapadiyinaalea, muthalaavathu naan ungka'lellaarukkaakavum iyeasuki'risthu moolamaay en theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean.

naan jepampa'n'numpoathellaam idaividaamal ungka'lai ninaiththukko'ndirukki'rathaikku'riththuth thamathu kumaaranudaiya suviseashaththinaalea en aaviyoadu naan seavikki'ra theavan enakkuch saadchiyaayirukki'raar.
neengka'l sthirappaduvatha'rkaaka aavikkuriya sila varangka'lai ungka'lukkuk kodukkumpadikkum,
ungka'lilum ennilumu'l'la visuvaasaththinaal ungka'loadeakooda naanum aa'ruthaladaiyumpadikkum, ungka'laik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rapadiyinaalea,
evvithaththilaavathu naan ungka'lidaththil varuki'ratha'rkuth theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea enakku nalla pirayaa'nam seekkiraththil kidaikkavea'ndumen'ru vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.

sakoathararea, pu'rajaathika'laana mat'ravarka'lukku'l'lea naan palanai adainthathu poala ungka'lukku'l'lum sila palanai adaiyumpadikku, ungka'lidaththil vara palamu'rai yoasanaiyaayirunthean, aayinum ithuvaraikkum enakkuth thadaiyu'ndaayit'ru en'ru neengka'l a'riyaathirukka enakku manathillai.
kireakkarukkum, mat'ra anniyarka'lukkum, gnaanika'lukkum, moodarukkum naan kadanaa'liyaayirukki'rean.
aakaiyaal roamaapuriyilirukki'ra ungka'lukkum ennaal iyan'ramattum suviseashaththaip pirasangkikka virumpuki'rean.
ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaik ku'riththu naan vedkappadean; munpu yootharilum pinpu kireakkarilum visuvaasikki'ravanevanoa avanukku iradchippu u'ndaavatha'rku athu theavapelanaayirukki'rathu.
visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaan pizhaippaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, visuvaasaththinaal u'ndaakum theavaneethi visuvaasaththi'rken'ru anthach suviseashaththinaal ve'lippaduththappaduki'rathu.
saththiyaththai aniyaayaththinaalea adakkivaikki'ra manusharudaiya ellaavitha avapakthikkum aniyaayaththukkum viroathamaay, theavakoapam vaanaththilirunthu ve'lippaduththappattirukki'rathu.
theavanaikku'riththu a'riyappaduvathu avarka'lukku'l'lea ve'lippattirukki'rathu; theavanea athai avarka'lukku ve'lippaduththiyirukki'raar.

eppadiyen'raal, kaa'nappadaathavaika'laakiya avarudaiya niththiya vallamai theavaththuvam enpavaika'l, u'ndaakkappattirukki'ravaika'linaalea, ulakamu'ndaanathumutha'rko'ndu, the'livaayk kaa'nappadum; aathalaal avarka'l poakkuchsolla idamillai.

avarka'l theavanai a'rinthum, avaraith theavanen'ru makimaippaduththaamalum, sthoaththiriyaamalumirunthu, thangka'l sinthanaika'linaalea vee'naraanaarka'l; u'narvillaatha avarka'ludaiya iruthayam iru'ladainthathu.
avarka'l thangka'lai gnaanika'len'ru solliyum payiththiyakkaararaaki,
azhivillaatha theavanudaiya makimaiyai azhivu'l'la manusharka'l pa'ravaika'l mirukangka'l oorum piraa'nika'l aakiya ivaika'ludaiya roopangka'lukku oppaaka maat'rinaarka'l.

ithinimiththam avarka'l thangka'l iruthayaththilu'l'la ichchaika'linaalea oruvaroadoruvar thangka'l sareerangka'lai avamaanappaduththaththakkathaaka, theavan avarka'lai asuththaththi'rku oppukkoduththaar.
theavanudaiya saththiyaththai avarka'l poyyaaka maat'ri, sirushdikaraith thozhuthu seaviyaamal sirushdiyaith thozhuthu seaviththaarka'l, avarea en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkappattavar. aamen.

ithinimiththam theavan avarka'lai izhivaana ichchairoakangka'lukku oppukkoduththaar; anthappadiyea avarka'ludaiya pe'nka'l supaava anupoakaththaich supaavaththukku viroathamaana anupoakamaaka maat'rinaarka'l.

appadiyea aa'nka'lum pe'nka'laich supaavappadi anupaviyaamal, oruvarmealoruvar virakathaapaththinaalea pongki, aa'noadea aa'n avaladcha'namaanathai nadappiththu, thangka'l thappithaththi'rkuth thakuthiyaana palanaith thangka'lukku'l adainthaarka'l.
theavanai a'riyum a'rivaip pat'rikko'ndirukka avarka'lukku manathillaathirunthapadiyaal, thakaathavaika'laich seyyumpadi, theavan avarka'laik keadaana sinthaikku oppukkoduththaar.

avarka'l sakalavitha aniyaayaththinaalum, veasiththanaththinaalum, thuroakaththinaalum, poru'laasaiyinaalum, kuroathaththinaalum ni'raiyappattu; po'raamaiyinaalum, kolaiyinaalum, vaakkuvaathaththinaalum, vagnchakaththinaalum, vanmaththinaalum ni'rainthavarka'lumaay,

pu'rangkoo'ruki'ravarka'lumaay, avathoo'rupa'n'nuki'ravarka'lumaay, theavapakaignarumaay, thuraakiruthampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lumaay, akanthaiyu'l'lavarka'lumaay, veempukkaararumaay, pollaathavaika'lai yoasiththup pi'naikki'ravarka'lumaay, pet'raarukkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'lumaay,
u'narvillaathavarka'lumaay, udanpadikkaika'lai mee'ruki'ravarka'lumaay, supaava anpillaathavarka'lumaay, i'nangkaathavarka'lumaay, irakkamillaathavarka'lumaay irukki'raarka'l.

ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'ravarka'l mara'naththi'rkup paaththiraraayirukki'raarka'len'ru theavan theermaaniththa neethiyaana theerppai avarka'l a'rinthirunthum, avaika'laith thaangka'lea seyki'rathumallaamal, avaika'laich seyki'ra mat'ravarka'lidaththil piriyappaduki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal, mat'ravarka'laik kut'ravaa'liyaakath theerkki'ravanea, nee yaaraanaalum sari, poakkuchsolla unakku idamillai; nee kut'ramaakath theerkki'ravaika'l evaika'loa, avaika'lai neeyea seyki'rapadiyaal, nee mat'ravarka'laikku'riththuch solluki'ra theerppinaalea unnaiththaanea kut'ravaa'liyaakath theerkki'raay.
ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'ravarka'lukkuth theavanudaiya niyaayaththeerppu saththiyaththinpadiyea irukki'rathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'ravarka'laik kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerththum, avaika'laiyea seyki'ravanea, nee theavanudaiya niyaayaththeerppukkuth thappikko'l'lalaamen'ru ninaikki'raayoa?
allathu theavathayavu nee ku'nappadumpadi unnai eavuki'rathen'ru a'riyaamal, avarudaiya thayavu po'rumai neediyasaantham ivaika'lin aisuvariyaththai asattaipa'n'nuki'raayoa?
un manakkadinaththi'rkum ku'nappadaatha iruthayaththi'rkum eat'rapadi, theavanudaiya neethiyu'l'la theerppu ve'lippadum koapaakkinainaa'lilea unakkaakak koapaakkinaiyaik kuviththukko'l'luki'raayea.
theavan avanavanudaiya kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaay avanavanukkup palana'lippaar.
soarnthupoakaamal na'rkiriyaika'laich seythu, makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum azhiyaamaiyaiyum theaduki'ravarka'lukku niththiyajeevanai a'lippaar.
sa'ndaikkaararaayirunthu, saththiyaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaamal, aniyaayaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthirukki'ravarka'lukkoa ukkirakoapaakkinai varum.
munpu yootharilum pinpu kireakkarilum pollaangkuseyki'ra entha manusha aaththumaavukkum upaththiravamum viyaakulamum u'ndaakum.
munpu yootharilum pinpu kireakkarilum evan nanmaiseyki'raanoa avanukku makimaiyum kanamum samaathaanamum u'ndaakum.
theavanidaththil padchapaathamillai.

evarka'l niyaayappiramaa'namillaamal paavagnseyki'raarka'loa, avarka'l niyaayappiramaa'namillaamal kettuppoavaarka'l; evarka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththukkudpattavarka'laayp paavagnseyki'raarka'loa, avarka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea aakkinaiththeerppadaivaarka'l.
niyaayappiramaa'naththaik keadki'ravarka'l theavanukku munpaaka neethimaanka'lalla, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi seyki'ravarka'lea neethimaanka'laakkappaduvaarka'l.

an'riyum niyaayappiramaa'namillaatha pu'rajaathika'l supaavamaay niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi seyki'rapoathu, niyaayappiramaa'namillaatha avarka'l thangka'lukkuth thaangka'lea niyaayappiramaa'namaayirukki'raarka'l.

avarka'ludaiya manachsaadchiyum koodach saadchiyiduki'rathinaalum, kut'ramu'ndu kut'ramillaiyen'ru avarka'ludaiya sinthanaika'l on'raiyon'ru theerkki'rathinaalum, niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkeat'ra kiriyai thangka'l iruthayangka'lil ezhuthiyirukki'rathen'ru kaa'npikki'raarka'l.
en suviseashaththinpadiyea, theavan iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu manusharudaiya antharangkangka'laikku'riththu niyaayaththeerppukkodukkum naa'lilea ithu vi'langkum.
nee yoothanen'ru peyarpet'ru, niyaayappiramaa'naththinmeal pat'ruthalaayirunthu, theavanaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraatti,
niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal upatheasikkappattavanaay, avarudaiya siththaththai a'rinthu, nanmai theemai innathen'ru vakaiya'rukki'raayea.
nee unnaik kurudarukku vazhikaattiyaakavum, anthakaaraththilu'l'lavarka'lukku ve'lichchamaakavum,
peathaika'lukkup poathakanaakavum, kuzhanthaika'lukku upaaththiyaayanaakavum, niyaayappiramaa'naththin a'rivaiyum saththiyaththaiyum kaattiya sattamudaiyavanaakavum e'n'nuki'raayea.
ippadiyirukka, mat'ravanukkup poathikki'ra nee unakkuththaanea poathiyaamalirukkalaamaa? ka'lavuseyyakkoodaathen'ru pirasangkikki'ra nee ka'lavuseyyalaamaa?
vipasaaram seyyakkoodaathen'ru solluki'ra nee vipasaaram seyyalaamaa? vikkirakangka'lai aruvarukki'ra nee koavilka'laik ko'l'laiyidalaamaa?
niyaayappiramaa'naththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattuki'ra nee niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'rinadanthu, theavanaik kanaveenampa'n'nalaamaa?
ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, theavanudaiya naamam pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea ungka'l moolamaayth thooshikkappaduki'rathea.

nee niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'ndu nadanthaal viruththaseathanam pirayoajanamu'l'lathuthaan; nee niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'ri nadanthaal un viruththaseathanam viruththaseathanamillaamaiyaayit'rea.
mealum viruththaseathanamillaathavan niyaayappiramaa'naththukkeat'ra neethika'laik kaikko'ndaal, avanudaiya viruththaseathanamillaamai viruththaseathanam en're'n'nappadumallavaa?

supaavaththinpadi viruththaseathanamillaathavanaayirunthum niyaayappiramaa'naththai ni'raiveat'ruki'ravanaayirunthaal, avan veatha ezhuththum viruththaseathanamum u'l'lavanaayirunthum, niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'ruki'ra unnaik kut'rappaduththuvaanallavaa?
aathalaal pu'rampaaka yoothanaanavan yoothanalla, pu'rampaaka maamsaththil seyyappadum viruththaseathanamum viruththaseathanamalla.

u'l'laththilea yoothanaanavanea yoothan; ezhuththinpadi u'ndaakaamal, aaviyinpadi iruthayaththil u'ndaakum viruththaseathanamea viruththaseathanam; ippadippattavanukkuriya pukazhchchi manusharaalea alla, theavanaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
ippadiyaanaal, yoothanudaiya meanmai enna? viruththaseathanaththinaalea pirayoajanam enna?
athu evvithaththilum mikuthiyaayirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya vaakkiyangka'l avarka'lidaththil oppuvikkappattathu viseashiththa meanmaiyaamea.
silar visuvaasiyaama'rpoanaalumenna? avarka'ludaiya avisuvaasam theavanudaiya u'nmaiyai avamaakkumoa?

appadiyaakkamaattaathu: neer ummudaiya vasanangka'lil neethipararaay vi'langkavum, ummudaiya niyaayam visaarikkappadumpoathu vet'riyadaiyavum ippadiyaayit'ru en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, theavanea saththiyaparar en'rum, entha manushanum poyyan en'rum solvoamaaka.

naan manushar peasuki'ra pirakaaramaayp peasuki'rean; nammudaiya aneethi theavanudaiya neethiyai vi'langkappa'n'ninaal enna solluvoam? koapaakkinaiyaich seluththuki'ra theavan aneetharaayirukki'raar en'ru sollalaamaa?
appadich sollakkoodaathu; sollakkoodumaanaal, theavan ulakaththai niyaayantheerppatheppadi?
an'riyum, en poyyinaalea theavanudaiya saththiyam avarukku makimaiyu'ndaaka vi'langkinathu'ndaanaal, ini naan paaviyen'ru theerkkappaduvaanean?

nanmai varumpadikkuth theemaiseyvoamaaka en'rum sollalaamallavaa? naangka'l appadip poathikki'ravarka'len'rum silar engka'laith thooshiththuch solluki'raarka'lea; appadip poathikki'ravarka'lmeal varum aakkinai neethiyaayirukkum.

aanaalum enna? avarka'laippaarkkilum naangka'l viseashiththavarka'laa? evva'laveanum viseashiththavarka'lalla. yoothar kireakkar yaavarum paavaththi'rkudpattavarka'lenpathai munpu thirushdaanthappaduththinoamea.
anthappadiyea: neethimaan oruvanaakilum illai;
u'narvu'l'lavan illai; theavanaith theaduki'ravan illai;
ellaarum vazhithappi, eakamaayk kettuppoanaarka'l; nanmaiseyki'ravan illai, oruvanaakilum illai.
avarka'l tho'ndai thi'rakkappatta pireathakkuzhi, thangka'l naavuka'laal vagnchanaiseyki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya uthaduka'lin keezhea paampin visham irukki'rathu;
avarka'l vaay sapippinaalum kasappinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu;
avarka'l kaalka'l iraththagnsinthuki'ratha'rkuth theevirikki'rathu;
naasamum nirppanthamum avarka'l vazhika'lilirukki'rathu;
samaathaana vazhiyai avarka'l a'riyaathirukki'raarka'l;
avarka'l ka'nka'lukku munpaakath theyvapayamillai, en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.

mealum, vaayka'l yaavum adaikkappadumpadikkum, ulakaththaar yaavarum theavanudaiya aakkinaiththeerppukku eathuvaanavarka'laakumpadikkum, niyaayappiramaa'nam solluki'rathellaam niyaayappiramaa'naththukku udpattirukki'ravarka'lukkea solluki'rathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.

ippadiyirukka, paavaththai a'riki'ra a'rivu niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal varuki'rapadiyaal, entha manushanum niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaalea theavanukku munpaaka neethimaanaakkappaduvathillai.
ippadiyirukka, niyaayappiramaa'namillaamal theavaneethi ve'liyaakkappattirukki'rathu; athaikku'riththu niyaayappiramaa'namum theerkkatharisanangka'lum saadchiyiduki'rathu.
athu iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea palikkum theavaneethiyea; visuvaasikki'ra evarka'lukku'l'lum evarka'lmealum athu palikkum, viththiyaasamea illai.
ellaarum paavagnseythu, theavamakimaiyat'ravarka'laaki,
ilavasamaay avarudaiya kirupaiyinaalea ki'risthu iyeasuvilu'l'la meedpaikko'ndu neethimaanka'laakkappaduki'raarka'l;

theavan po'rumaiyaayiruntha mu'rkaalaththil nadantha paavangka'laith thaam po'ruththukko'ndathaikku'riththuth thammudaiya neethiyaik kaa'npikkumporuttaakavum, thaam neethiyu'l'lavarum, iyeasuvinidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravanai neethimaanaakkuki'ravarumaay vi'langkumpadi, ikkaalaththilea thamathu neethiyaik kaa'npikkum poruttaakavum,
ki'risthu iyeasuvinudaiya iraththaththaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea palikkum kirupaathaara paliyaaka avaraiyea ea'rpaduththinaar.
ippadiyirukka, meanmaipaaraattal engkea? athu neekkappattathea. enthap piramaa'naththinaalea? kiriyaappiramaa'naththinaaleayaa? alla; visuvaasappiramaa'naththinaaleayea.
aathalaal, manushan niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'lillaamal visuvaasaththinaaleayea neethimaanaakkappaduki'raan en'ru theerkki'roam.
theavan yootharukkumaaththiramaa theavan? pu'rajaathika'lukkum theavanallavaa? aam pu'rajaathika'lukkum avar theavanthaan.
viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lai visuvaasaththinaalum, viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lai visuvaasaththin moolamaayum neethimaanka'laakkuki'ra theavan oruvarea.
appadiyaanaal, visuvaasaththinaalea niyaayappiramaa'naththai avamaakkuki'roamaa? appadiyalla; niyaayappiramaa'naththai nilaini'ruththuki'roamea.
appadiyaanaal, nammudaiya thakappanaakiya aapirakaam maamsaththinpadi ennaththaik ka'ndadainthaan en'ru solluvoam?
aapirakaam kiriyaika'linaalea neethimaanaakkappattaanaakil meanmaipaaraatta avanukku eathuvu'ndu; aakilum theavanukkumunpaaka meanmaipaaraatta eathuvillai.
veathavaakkiyam enna solluki'rathu? aapirakaam theavanai visuvaasiththaan, athu avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu en'ru solluki'rathu.
kiriyai seyki'ravanukku varuki'ra kooli kirupaiyen're'n'nappadaamal, kadanen're'n'nappadum.
oruvan kiriyai seyyaamal paaviyai neethimaanaakkuki'ravaridaththil visuvaasam vaikki'ravanaayirunthaal, avanudaiya visuvaasamea avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappadum.
anthappadi, kiriyaika'lillaamal theavanaalea neethimaanen're'n'nappaduki'ra manushanudaiya paakkiyaththaik kaa'npikkum poruttu:
evarka'ludaiya akkiramangka'l mannikkappattathoa, evarka'ludaiya paavangka'l moodappattathoa, avarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l.
evanudaiya paavaththaik karththar e'n'naathirukki'raaroa, avan paakkiyavaan en'ru thaaveethu solliyirukki'raan.
inthap paakkiyam viruththaseathanamu'l'lavanukkumaaththiram varumoa, viruththaseathanamillaathavanukkum varumoa? aapirakaamukku visuvaasam neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu en'ru solluki'roamea.

athu eppozhuthu avanukku appadi e'n'nappattathu? avan viruththaseathanamu'l'lavanaayirunthapoathoa, viruththaseathanamillaathavanaayirunthapoathoa? viruththaseathanamu'l'lavanaayirunthapoathalla, viruththaseathanamillaathavanaayirunthapoathea.

mealum, viruththaseathanamillaatha kaalaththil avan visuvaasaththinaalea adaintha neethikku muththiraiyaaka viruththaseathanamaakiya adaiyaa'laththaip pet'raan. viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'laay visuvaasikki'ra yaavarukkum neethi e'n'nappadumporuttaaka avarka'lukku avan thakappanaayirukkumpadikkum,

viruththaseathanaththaip pet'ravarka'laaymaaththiramalla, nammudaiya thakappanaakiya aapirakaam viruththaseathanamillaatha kaalaththil adaintha visuvaasamaakiya adichsuvaduka'lil nadakki'ravarka'laayumirukki'ravarka'lukkuth thakappanaayirukkumpadikkum, antha adaiyaa'laththaip pet'raan.

an'riyum, ulakaththaich suthantharippaan enki'ra vaakkuththaththam aapirakaamukkaavathu avan santhathikkaavathu niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal kidaiyaamal visuvaasaththinaal varuki'ra neethiyinaal kidaiththathu.
niyaayappiramaa'naththaich saarnthavarka'l suthantharavaa'lika'laanaal visuvaasam vee'naayppoam, vaakkuththaththamum avamaakum.
mealum niyaayappiramaa'nam koapaakkinaiyai u'ndaakkuki'rathu, niyaayappiramaa'namillaavittaal mee'ruthalumillai.

aathalaal, suthantharamaanathu kirupaiyinaal u'ndaaki'rathaayirukkumpadikku athu visuvaasaththinaalea varuki'rathu; niyaayappiramaa'naththaich saarnthavarka'laakiya santhathiyaarukkumaaththiramalla, nammellaarukkum thakappanaakiya aapirakaamudaiya visuvaasaththaich saarnthavarka'laana ellaach santhathiyaarukkum antha vaakkuththaththam nichchayamaayirukkumpadikku appadi varuki'rathu.

aneaka jaathika'lukku unnaith thakappanaaka ea'rpaduththinean en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, avan thaan visuvaasiththavarumaay, mariththoarai uyirppiththu, illaathavaika'lai irukki'ravaika'laippoal azhaikki'ravarumaayirukki'ra theavanukku munpaaka nammellaarukkum thakappanaanaan.
un santhathi ivva'lavaayirukkum en'ru sollappattapadiyea, thaan aneaka jaathika'lukkuth thakappanaavathai nampuki'ratha'rku eathuvillaathirunthum, athai nampikkaiyoadea visuvaasiththaan.

avan visuvaasaththilea palaveenamaayirukkavillai; avan ea'rakku'raiya noo'ruvayathu'l'lavanaayirukkumpoathu, than sareeram seththuppoanathaiyum, saaraa'ludaiya karppam seththuppoanathaiyum e'n'naathirunthaan.
theavanudaiya vaakkuththaththaththaikku'riththu avan avisuvaasamaaych santheakappadaamal,
theavan vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninathai ni'raiveat'ra vallavaraayirukki'raaren'ru muzhu nichchayamaay nampi, theavanai makimaippaduththi, visuvaasaththil vallavanaanaan.
aakaiyaal athu avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu.
athu avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathenpathu, avanukkaaka maaththiramalla, namakkaakavum ezhuthappattirukki'rathu.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuvai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinavarai visuvaasikki'ra namakkum appadiyea e'n'nappadum.
avar nammudaiya paavangka'lukkaaka oppukkodukkappattum, naam neethimaanka'laakkappaduvatha'rkaaka ezhuppappattum irukki'raar.
ivvithamaaka, naam visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaanka'laakkappattirukki'rapadiyaal, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthumoolamaay theavanidaththil samaathaanam pet'rirukki'roam.
avarmoolamaay naam inthak kirupaiyil piraveasikkum silaakkiyaththai visuvaasaththinaal pet'ru nilaiko'ndirunthu, theavamakimaiyai adaivoamenki'ra nampikkaiyinaalea meanmaipaaraattuki'roam.
athumaaththiramalla, upaththiravam po'rumaiyaiyum, po'rumai pareedchaiyaiyum, pareedchai nampikkaiyaiyum u'ndaakkuki'rathen'ru naangka'l a'rinthu,
upaththiravangka'lileayum meanmaipaaraattuki'roam.
mealum namakku aru'lappatta parisuththaaaviyinaalea theava anpu nammudaiya iruthayangka'lil oot'rappattirukki'rapadiyaal, antha nampikkai nammai vedkappaduththaathu.
an'riyum naam pelanat'ravarka'laayirukkumpoathea, ku'riththa kaalaththil ki'risthu akkiramakkaararukkaaka mariththaar.
neethimaanukkaaka oruvan marikki'rathu arithu; nallavanukkaaka oruvea'lai oruvan marikkath thu'nivaan.
naam paavika'laayirukkaiyil ki'risthu namakkaaka mariththathinaalea, theavan nammeal vaiththa thamathu anpai vi'langkappa'n'nuki'raar.
ippadi naam avarudaiya iraththaththinaalea neethimaanka'laakkappattirukka, koapaakkinaikku neengkalaaka avaraalea naam iradchikkappaduvathu athika nichchayamaamea.

naam theavanukkuch saththurukka'laayirukkaiyil, avarudaiya kumaaranin mara'naththinaalea avarudanea oppuravaakkappattoamaanaal, oppuravaakkappattapin naam avarudaiya jeevanaalea iradchikkappaduvathu athika nichchayamaamea.
athuvumallaamal, ippozhuthu oppuravaakuthalai namakkuk kidaikkappa'n'nina nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthumoolamaay naam theavanaippat'riyum meanmaipaaraattuki'roam.

ippadiyaaka, orea manushanaalea paavamum paavaththinaalea mara'namum ulakaththilea piraveasiththathupoalavum, ellaa manusharum paavagnseythapadiyaal, mara'nam ellaarukkum vanthathupoalavum ithuvumaayit'ru.
niyaayappiramaa'nam kodukkappaduvatha'rku munnum paavam ulakaththilirunthathu; niyaayappiramaa'nam illaathirunthaal paavam e'n'nappadamaattaathu.
appadiyirunthum, mara'namaanathu aathaammuthal moaseavaraikkum, aathaamin mee'ruthalukkoppaayp paavagnseyyaathavarka'laiyum aa'nduko'ndathu; antha aathaam pinpu vanthavarukku munnadaiyaa'lamaanavan.

aanaalum mee'ruthalin palan kirupai varaththin palanukku oppaanathalla. eppadiyenil, oruvanudaiya mee'ruthalinaalea aneakar mariththirukka, theavanudaiya kirupaiyum iyeasuki'risthu ennum orea manushanudaiya kirupaiyinaalea varum eevum aneakarmeal athikamaayp perukiyirukki'rathu.

mealum oruvan paavagnseythathinaal u'ndaana theerppu theavan aru'lum eevukku oppaanathalla; anthath theerppu orea kut'raththinimiththam aakkinaikku eathuvaayirunthathu; kirupaivaramoa aneaka kut'rangka'lai neekki neethivi'langkum theerppukku eathuvaayirukki'rathu.

allaamalum, oruvanudaiya mee'ruthalinaalea, antha oruvanmoolamaay, mara'nam aa'nduko'ndirukka, kirupaiyin paripoora'naththaiyum neethiyaakiya eevin paripoora'naththaiyum pe'ruki'ravarka'l iyeasuki'risthu ennum oruvaraalea jeevanai adainthu aa'luvaarka'lenpathu athika nichchayamaamea.

aakaiyaal orea mee'ruthalinaalea ellaa manusharukkum aakkinaikku eathuvaana theerppu u'ndaanathupoala, orea neethiyinaalea ellaa manusharukkum jeevanai a'likkum neethikku eathuvaana theerppu u'ndaayit'ru.
an'riyum orea manushanudaiya keezhppadiyaamaiyinaalea aneakar paavika'laakkappattathupoala, oruvarudaiya keezhppadithalinaalea aneakar neethimaanka'laakkappaduvaarka'l.
mealum, mee'ruthal perukumpadikku niyaayappiramaa'nam vanthathu; appadiyirunthum, paavam perukina idaththil kirupai athikamaayp perukit'ru.

aathalaal paavam mara'naththukku eathuvaaka aa'nduko'ndathupoala, kirupaiyaanathu nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin moolamaay neethiyinaalea niththiyajeevanukku eathuvaaka aa'nduko'ndathu.
aakaiyaal ennasolluvoam? kirupai perukumpadikkup paavaththilea nilaini'rkalaam en'ru solluvoamaa? koodaathea.
paavaththukku mariththa naam ini athilea eppadip pizhaippoam?
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laaka gnaanasnaanam pet'ra naamanaivarum avarudaiya mara'naththukku'l'laaka gnaanasnaanam pet'rathai a'riyaamalirukki'reerka'laa?

mealum pithaavin makimaiyinaalea ki'risthu mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppappattathupoala, naamum puthithaana jeevanu'l'lavarka'laay nadanthuko'l'lumpadikku, avarudaiya mara'naththi'rku'l'laakkum gnaanasnaanaththinaalea ki'risthuvudaneakooda adakkampa'n'nappattoam.
aathalaal avarudaiya mara'naththin saayalil naam i'naikkappattavarka'laanaal, avar uyirththezhuthalin saayalilum i'naikkappattiruppoam.
naam inip paavaththukku oozhiyagn seyyaathapadikku, paavasareeram ozhinthupoakumporuttaaka, nammudaiya pazhaiya manushan avaroadeakoodach siluvaiyil a'raiyappattathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
mariththavan paavaththukku neengki viduthalaiyaakkappattirukki'raanea.
aakaiyaal ki'risthuvudaneakooda naam mariththoamaanaal, avarudaneakoodap pizhaiththum iruppoam en'ru nampuki'roam.
mariththoarilirunthu ezhuntha ki'risthu ini marippathillaiyen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; mara'nam ini avarai aa'nduko'lvathillai.
avar mariththathu, paavaththi'rken'ru oreatharam mariththaar; avar pizhaiththirukki'rathu, theavanukken'ru pizhaiththirukki'raar.
appadiyea neengka'lum, ungka'laip paavaththi'rku mariththavarka'laakavum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l theavanukken'ru pizhaiththirukki'ravarka'laakavum e'n'nikko'l'lungka'l.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l sareera ichchaika'linpadi paavaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaththakkathaaka, saavukkeathuvaana ungka'l sareeraththil paavam aa'laathiruppathaaka.

neengka'l ungka'l avayavangka'lai aneethiyin aayuthangka'laakap paavaththi'rku oppukkodaamal, ungka'lai mariththoarilirunthu pizhaiththirukki'ravarka'laakath theavanukku oppukkoduththu, ungka'l avayavangka'lai neethikkuriya aayuthangka'laakath theavanukku oppukkodungka'l.
neengka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhppattiraamal kirupaikkuk keezhppattirukki'rapadiyaal, paavam ungka'lai mea'rko'l'lamaattaathu.
ithinaal enna? naam niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhppattiraamal kirupaikkuk keezhppattirukki'rapadiyaal, paavagnseyyalaamaa? koodaathea.

mara'naththukkeathuvaana paavaththukkaanaalum, neethikkeathuvaana keezhppadithalukkaanaalum, etha'rkuk keezhppadiyumpadi ungka'lai adimaika'laaka oppukkodukki'reerka'loa, atha'rkea keezhppadiki'ra adimaika'laayirukki'reerka'len'ru a'riyeerka'laa?
munnea neengka'l paavaththi'rku adimaika'laayirunthum, ippozhuthu ungka'lukku oppuvikkappatta upatheasa sattaththi'rku neengka'l manappoorvamaayk keezhppadinthathinaalea theavanukku sthoaththiram.
paavaththinin'ru neengka'l viduthalaiyaakkappattu, neethikku adimaika'laaneerka'l.

ungka'l maamsa palaveenaththinimiththam manushar peasuki'rapirakaaramaayp peasuki'rean. akkiramaththai nadappikkumpadi munnea neengka'l ungka'l avayavangka'lai asuththaththi'rkum akkiramaththi'rkum adimaika'laaka oppukkoduththathupoala, ippozhuthu parisuththamaanathai nadappikkumpadi ungka'l avayavangka'lai neethikku adimaika'laaka oppukkodungka'l.
paavaththi'rku neengka'l adimaika'laayiruntha kaalaththil neethikku neengkinavarka'laayiruntheerka'l.
ippozhuthu ungka'lukku vedkamaakath thoan'ruki'ra kaariyangka'linaalea akkaalaththil ungka'lukku enna palan kidaiththathu? avaika'lin mudivu mara'namea.
ippozhuthu neengka'l paavaththinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkappattu, theavanukku adimaika'laanathinaal, parisuththamaakuthal ungka'lukkuk kidaikkum palan, mudivoa niththiyajeevan.
paavaththin sampa'lam mara'nam; theavanudaiya kirupaivaramoa nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaal u'ndaana niththiyajeevan.
niyaayappiramaa'naththai a'rinthirukki'ravarka'ludanea peasuki'rean. sakoathararea, oru manushan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum niyaayappiramaa'nam avanai aa'luki'rathen'ru a'riyaamalirukki'reerka'laa?

atheppadiyen'raal, purushanaiyudaiya sthiree than purushan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadiyea avanudaiya nipanthanaikku udpattirukki'raa'l; purushan mariththa pinpu purushanaippat'riya piramaa'naththinin'ru viduthalaiyaayirukki'raa'l.

aakaiyaal, purushan uyiroadirukkaiyil ava'l vea'roru purushanai vivaakampa'n'ninaal vipasaariyennappaduvaa'l; purushan mariththapinpu ava'l anthap piramaa'naththinin'ru viduthalaiyaanapadiyaal, vea'roru purushanai vivaakampa'n'ninaalum vipasaariyalla.

appadippoala, en sakoathararea, neengka'l mariththoarilirunthu ezhuntha ki'risthu ennum vea'roruvarudaiyavarka'laaki, theavanukken'ru kanikodukkumpadi ki'risthuvin sareeraththinaalea niyaayappiramaa'naththukku mariththavarka'laaneerka'l.

naam maamsaththi'rku udpattiruntha kaalaththil niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea thoan'riya paava ichchaika'l mara'naththi'rku eathuvaana kanika'laik kodukkaththakkathaaka nammudaiya avayavangka'lilea pelanseythathu.

ippozhuthoa naam pazhamaiyaana ezhuththinpadiyalla, puthumaiyaana aaviyinpadi oozhiyagnseyyaththakkathaaka, nammaik kattiyiruntha niyaayappiramaa'naththukku naam mariththavarka'laaki, athinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkappattirukki'roam.

aakaiyaal enna solluvoam? niyaayappiramaa'nam paavamoa? allavea. paavam innathen'ru niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal naan a'rintheaneayan'ri mat'rappadi a'riyavillai; ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka en'ru niyaayappiramaa'nam sollaathirunthaal, ichchai paavam en'ru naan a'riyaamaliruppeanea.
paavamaanathu ka'rpanaiyinaalea samayam pet'ruch sakalavitha ichchaika'laiyum ennil nadappiththathu. niyaayappiramaa'nam illaavittaal paavam seththathaayirukkumea.
munnea niyaayappiramaa'namillaathavanaayirunthapoathu naan jeevanu'l'lavanaayirunthean; ka'rpanai vanthapoathu paavam uyirko'ndathu, naan mariththavanaanean.
ippadiyirukka, jeevanukkeathuvaana ka'rpanaiyea enakku mara'naththukkeathuvaayirukkakka'ndean.
paavamaanathu ka'rpanaiyinaalea samayampet'ru, ennai vagnchiththu, athinaalea ennaik kon'rathu.
aakaiyaal niyaayappiramaa'nam parisuththamu'l'lathuthaan, ka'rpanaiyum parisuththamaayum neethiyaayum nanmaiyaayum irukki'rathu.

ippadiyirukka, nanmaiyaanathu enakku mara'namaayit'roa? appadiyalla; paavamea enakku mara'namaayit'ru; paavam ka'rpanaiyinaalea mikuntha paavamu'l'lathaakumpadikkum, athu nanmaiyaanathaik ko'ndu enakku mara'naththai u'ndaakkinathinaalea, paavamaakavea vi'langkumpadikkum appadiyaayit'ru.
mealum, namakkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, niyaayappiramaa'nam aavikkuriyathaayirukki'rathu, naanoa paavaththukkuk keezhaaka vi'rkappattu, maamsaththukkuriyavanaayirukki'rean.
eppadiyenil, naan seyki'rathu enakkea sammathiyillai; naan virumpuki'rathaich seyyaamal, naan ve'rukki'rathaiyea seyki'rean.
ippadi naan virumpaathathaich seyki'ravanaayirukka, niyaayappiramaa'nam nallathen'ru oththukko'l'luki'reanea.
aathalaal naan alla, enakku'l vaasamaayirukki'ra paavamea appadich seyki'rathu.

atheppadiyenil, ennidaththil, athaavathu, en maamsaththil, nanmai vaasamaayirukki'rathillaiyen'ru naan a'rinthirukki'rean; nanmaiseyya vea'ndumenki'ra viruppam ennidaththilirukki'rathu, nanmaiseyvathoa ennidaththilillai.
aathalaal naan virumpuki'ra nanmaiyaich seyyaamal, virumpaatha theemaiyaiyea seyki'rean.
anthappadi naan virumpaathathai naan seythaal, naan alla, enakku'l'lea vaasamaayirukki'ra paavamea appadich seyki'rathu.
aanapadiyaal nanmaiseyya virumpuki'ra ennidaththil theemaiyu'ndenki'ra oru piramaa'naththaik kaa'nki'rean.
u'l'laana manushanukkeat'rapadi theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinmeal piriyamaayirukki'rean.

aakilum en manathin piramaa'naththukku viroathamaayp poaraaduki'ra vea'roru piramaa'naththai en avayavangka'lil irukkak kaa'nki'rean; athu en avayavangka'lil u'ndaayirukki'ra paavappiramaa'naththukku ennaich si'raiyaakkik ko'l'luki'rathu.
nirppanthamaana manushan naan! intha mara'nasareeraththinin'ru yaar ennai viduthalaiyaakkuvaar?

nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthumoolamaayth theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean. aathalaal naanea en manathinaalea theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththukkum, maamsaththinaaleayoa paavappiramaa'naththukkum oozhiyagnseyki'rean.
aanapadiyaal, ki'risthu iyeasuvukkudpattavarka'laayirunthu, maamsaththinpadi nadavaamal aaviyinpadiyea nadakki'ravarka'lukku aakkinaiththeerppillai.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinaalea jeevanudaiya aaviyin piramaa'nam ennaip paavam mara'nam enpavaika'lin piramaa'naththinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkit'rea.

atheppadiyenil, maamsaththinaalea palaveenamaayiruntha niyaayappiramaa'nam seyyakkoodaathathaith theavanea seyyumpadikku, thammudaiya kumaaranaip paavamaamsaththin saayalaakavum, paavaththaip poakkum paliyaakavum anuppi, maamsaththilea paavaththai aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththaar.
maamsaththinpadi nadavaamal aaviyinpadi nadakki'ra nammidaththil niyaayappiramaa'naththin neethi ni'raivea'rumpadikkea appadich seythaar.
an'riyum maamsaththinpadi nadakki'ravarka'l maamsaththukkuriyavaika'laich sinthikki'raarka'l; aaviyinpadi nadakki'ravarka'l aavikkuriyavaika'laich sinthikki'raarka'l.
maamsasinthai mara'nam; aaviyin sinthaiyoa jeevanum samaathaanamumaam.
eppadiyen'raal, maamsasinthai theavanukku viroathamaana pakai; athu theavanudaiya niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuk keezhppadiyaamalum, keezhppadiyakkoodaamalum irukki'rathu.
maamsaththukkudpattavarka'l theavanukkup piriyamaayirukkamaattaarka'l.
theavanudaiya aavi ungka'lil vaasamaayirunthaal, neengka'l maamsaththukkudpattavarka'laayiraamal aavikkudpattavarka'laayiruppeerka'l. ki'risthuvin aaviyillaathavan avarudaiyavanalla.
mealum ki'risthu ungka'lilirunthaal sareeramaanathu paavaththinimiththam mariththathaayum, aaviyaanathu neethiyinimiththam jeevanu'l'lathaayum irukkum.

an'riyum iyeasuvai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinavarudaiya aavi ungka'lil vaasamaayirunthaal, ki'risthuvai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinavar ungka'lil vaasamaayirukki'ra thammudaiya aaviyinaalea saavukkeathuvaana ungka'l sareerangka'laiyum uyirppippaar.
aakaiyaal sakoathararea, maamsaththinpadi pizhaippatha'rku naam maamsaththukkuk kadanaa'lika'lalla.
maamsaththinpadi pizhaiththaal saaveerka'l; aaviyinaalea sareeraththin seykaika'lai azhiththaal pizhaippeerka'l.
mealum evarka'l theavanudaiya aaviyinaalea nadaththappaduki'raarka'loa, avarka'l theavanudaiya puththiraraayirukki'raarka'l.
anthappadi, thirumpavum payappaduki'ratha'rku neengka'l adimaiththanaththin aaviyaip pe'raamal, appaa pithaavea, en'ru kooppidappa'n'nuki'ra puththirasuvikaaraththin aaviyaip pet'reerka'l.
naam theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'laayirukki'roamen'ru aaviyaanavarthaamea nammudaiya aaviyudaneakoodach saadchikodukki'raar.

naam pi'l'laika'laanaal suthanthararumaamea; theavanudaiya suthanthararum, ki'risthuvukku udan suthanthararumaamea; ki'risthuvudaneakooda naam makimaippadumpadikku avarudaneakoodap paadupattaal appadiyaakum.
aathalaal ikkaalaththup paaduka'l ini nammidaththil ve'lippadum makimaikku oppidaththakkavaika'l allaven'ru e'n'nuki'rean.
mealum theavanudaiya puththirar ve'lippaduvatha'rkuch sirushdiyaanathu mikuntha aavaloadea kaaththukko'ndirukki'rathu.

atheanen'raal sirushdiyaanathu azhivukkuriya adimaiththanaththinin'ru viduthalaiyaakkappattu, theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'lukkuriya makimaiyaana suyaatheenaththaip pet'rukko'l'lum enki'ra nampikkaiyoadea,
anthach sirushdiyaanathu suya ishdaththinaalea alla, keezhppaduththinavaraaleayea maayaikkuk keezhppattirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal namakkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, ithuvaraikkum sarva sirushdiyum eakamaayth thaviththup pirasavaveathanaippaduki'rathu.
athuvumallaamal, aaviyin mutha'rpalanka'laip pet'ra naamungkooda nammudaiya sareera meedpaakiya puththirasuvikaaram varuki'ratha'rkuk kaaththirunthu, namakku'l'lea thavikki'roam.
antha nampikkaiyinaalea naam iradchikkappattirukki'roam. kaa'nappaduki'rathai nampuki'rathu nampikkaiyalla; oruvan thaan kaa'nki'rathai nampavea'nduvathenna?
naam kaa'naathathai nampinoamaakil, athu varuki'ratha'rkup po'rumaiyoadea kaaththiruppoam.

anthappadiyea aaviyaanavarum namathu palaveenangka'lil namakku uthaviseyki'raar. naam eat'rapadi vea'ndikko'l'la vea'ndiyathinnathen'ru a'riyaamalirukki'rapadiyaal, aaviyaanavarthaamea vaakkukkadangkaatha perumoochchuka'loadu namakkaaka vea'nduthalseyki'raar.
aaviyaanavar theavanudaiya siththaththinpadiyea parisuththavaanka'lukkaaka vea'nduthal seyki'rapadiyaal, iruthayangka'lai aaraaynthupaarkki'ravar aaviyin sinthai innathen'ru a'rivaar.
an'riyum, avarudaiya theermaanaththinpadi azhaikkappattavarka'laay theavanidaththil anpukooruki'ravarka'lukkuch sakalamum nanmaikku eathuvaaka nadakki'rathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.

thammudaiya kumaaran aneaka sakoathararukku'l'lea mutha'rpea'raanavaraayirukkumporuttu, theavan evarka'lai munna'rinthaaroa avarka'laith thamathu kumaaranudaiya saayalukku oppaayiruppatha'rku munku'riththirukki'raar;

evarka'lai munku'riththaaroa avarka'lai azhaiththumirukki'raar; evarka'lai azhaiththaaroa avarka'lai neethimaanka'laakkiyumirukki'raar; evarka'lai neethimaanka'laakkinaaroa avarka'lai makimaippaduththiyumirukki'raar.
ivaika'laikku'riththu naam enna solluvoam? theavan nammudaiya padchaththilirunthaal namakku viroathamaayiruppavan yaar?
thammudaiya sonthakkumaaranen'rum paaraamal nammellaarukkaakavum avarai oppukkoduththavar, avaroadeakooda mat'ra ellaavat'raiyum namakku aru'laathiruppatheppadi?
theavan therinthuko'ndavarka'lmeal kut'ragnsaattuki'ravan yaar? theavanea avarka'lai neethimaanka'laakkuki'ravar.

aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkki'ravan yaar? ki'risthuvea mariththavar; avarea ezhunthumirukki'ravar; avarea theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththilum irukki'ravar; namakkaaka vea'nduthalseyki'ravarum avarea.
umathunimiththam ennearamum kollappaduki'roam, adikkappadum aaduka'laippoala e'n'nappaduki'roam en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi nearittaalum,
ki'risthuvin anpaivittu nammaip pirippavan yaar? upaththiravamoa, viyaakulamoa, thunpamoa, pasiyoa, nirvaa'namoa, naasamoasamoa, pattayamoa?
ivaiyellaavat'rileayum naam nammil anpukooruki'ravaraalea mut'rum jeyangko'l'luki'ravarka'laayirukki'roamea.
mara'namaanaalum, jeevanaanaalum, theavathootharka'laanaalum, athikaarangka'laanaalum, vallamaika'laanaalum, nikazhkaariyangka'laanaalum, varungkaariyangka'laanaalum,
uyarvaanaalum, thaazhvaanaalum, vea'renthach sirushdiyaanaalum nammudaiya karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvilu'l'la theavanudaiya anpaivittu nammaip pirikkamaattaathen'ru nichchayiththirukki'rean.
enakku mikuntha thukkamum idaividaatha manaveathanaiyum u'ndaayirukki'rathu;
naan solluki'rathu poyyalla, ki'risthuvukku'l u'nmaiyaich solluki'rean en'ru parisuththaaavikku'l en manachsaadchiyum enakkuch saadchiyaayirukki'rathu.
maamsaththinpadi en inaththaaraakiya en sakoathararukkup pathilaaka naanea ki'risthuvaivittuch sapikkappattavanaaka vea'ndumen'ru virumpuveanea.
avarka'l isravealarea; puththirasuvikaaramum, makimaiyum, udanpadikkaika'lum, niyaayappiramaa'namum, theavaaraathanaiyum, vaakkuththaththangka'lum avarka'ludaiyavaika'lea;
pithaakka'l avarka'ludaiyavarka'lea; maamsaththinpadi ki'risthuvum avarka'lil pi'ranthaarea, ivar en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkappatta sarvaththi'rkum mealaana theavan. aamen.
theavavasanam avamaayp poayit'ren'ru sollakkoodaathu; eanen'raal, israveal vamsaththaar ellaarum isravealarallavea.
avarka'l aapirakaamin santhathiyaaraanaalum ellaarum pi'l'laika'lallavea; eesaakkinidaththil un santhathi vi'langkum en'ru solliyirukki'rathea.
atheppadiyen'raal, maamsaththinpadi pi'l'laika'laanavarka'l theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'lalla, vaakkuththaththaththinpadi pi'l'laika'laanavarka'lea anthach santhathi en're'n'nappaduki'raarka'l.
antha vaakkuththaththamaana vaarththaiyaavathu: ku'riththa kaalaththilea varuvean, appozhuthu saaraa'l oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l enpathea.
ithuvumallaamal, nammudaiya pithaavaakiya eesaakku ennum oruvanaalea repekkaa'l karppavathiyaanapoathu,

pi'l'laika'l innum pi'ravaamalum, nalvinai theevinai on'rum seyyaamalumirukkaiyil, theavanudaiya therinthuko'l'luthalinpadiyirukki'ra avarudaiya theermaanam kiriyaika'linaalea nilaini'rkaamal azhaikki'ravaraalea nilaini'rkumpadikku,
mooththavan i'laiyavanukku oozhiyagnseyvaan en'ru ava'ludanea sollappattathu.
appadiyea, yaakkoapaich sineakiththu, easaavai ve'ruththean en'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal naam enna solluvoam? theavanidaththilea aneethi u'nden'ru sollalaamaa? sollakkoodaathea.
avar moaseayai noakki: evanmeal irakkamaayirukkach siththamaayiruppeanoa avanmeal irakkamaayiruppean, evanmeal urukkamaayirukkach siththamaayiruppeanoa avanmeal urukkamaayiruppean en'raar.
aakaiyaal virumpuki'ravanaalum alla, oaduki'ravanaalum alla, irangkuki'ra theavanaaleayaam.

mealum ennudaiya vallamaiyai unnidaththil kaa'npikkumpadiyaakavum, ennudaiya naamam poomiyil engkum pirasthaapamaakumpadiyaakavum, unnai nilaini'ruththinean en'ru paarvoanudanea sonnathaaka veathaththil solliyirukki'rathu.
aathalaal evanmeal irakkamaayirukkach siththamaayirukki'raaroa avanmeal irakkamaayirukki'raar, evanaik kadinappaduththach siththamaayirukki'raaroa avanaik kadinappaduththuki'raar.
ippadiyaanaal, avar innum ean kut'rampidikki'raar? avar siththaththi'rku ethirththuni'rpavan yaar? en'ru ennudanea solluvaay.
appadiyaanaal, manushanea, theavanoadu ethirththuth tharkkikki'ra nee yaar? uruvaakkappatta vasthu uruvaakkinavanai noakki: nee ennai ean ippadi u'ndaakkinaayen'ru sollalaamaa?

mithiyitta orea ka'lima'n'ninaalea kuyavan oru paaththiraththaik kanamaana kaariyaththukkum, oru paaththiraththaik kanaveenamaana kaariyaththukkum pa'n'nuki'ratha'rku ma'n'ninmeal avanukku athikaaram illaiyoa?
theavan thamathu koapaththaik kaa'npikkavum, thamathu vallamaiyaith therivikkavum,

thaam makimaikkaaka eththanamaakkina kirupaapaaththirangka'lmeal thammudaiya makimaiyin aisuvariyaththaith theriyappaduththavum siththamaay, azhivukku eththanamaakkappatta koapaakkinaip paaththirangka'lmeal mikavum neediya saanthaththoadea po'rumaiyaayirunthaaraanaal unakkenna?
avar yootharilirunthumaaththiramalla, pu'rajaathika'lilumirunthu nammai azhaiththirukki'raarea.
anthappadi: enakku janangka'lallaathavarka'lai ennudaiya janangka'l en'rum, sineakikkappadaathirunthava'laich sineakikkappattava'l en'rum solli azhaippean.

neengka'l ennudaiya janangka'lallaven'ru avarka'lukkuch sollappatta idaththilea avarka'l jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'l ennappaduvaarka'l en'ru oasiyaavin theerkkatharisanaththil solliyirukki'rathu.
allaamalum israveal puththirarudaiya ilakkam samuththiraththin ma'nalaththanaiyaayirunthaalum, meethiyaayiruppavarka'l maaththiram iradchikkappaduvaarka'l en'rum;

avar neethiyoadea seekkiramaayth thammudaiya kaariyaththai ni'raiveat'ruvaar; karththar poomiyilea seekkiramaakavea kaariyaththai ni'raiveat'ri mudippaar en'rum easaayaa isravealaraikku'riththuch solluki'raan.
allaamalum easaayaa munnea sonnapadi: seanaika'lin karththar namakku'l'lea oru santhathiyai meethiyaaka vaikkaathirunthaaraanaal naam soathoamaippoalaaki komoaraavukku oththiruppoam.
ippadiyirukka naam ennasolluvoam? neethiyaith theadaatha pu'rajaathiyaar neethiyai adainthaarka'l; athu visuvaasaththinaalaakum neethiyea.
neethippiramaa'naththaith theadina isravealaroa neethippiramaa'naththai adaiyavillai.
ennaththinaalen'raal, avarka'l visuvaasaththinaalea athaith theadaamal, niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaalea theadinapadiyaal athai adaiyavillai; ida'rutha'rkaana kallil ida'rinaarka'l.
ithoa, ida'rutha'rkaana kallaiyum, thava'rutha'rkaana kanmalaiyaiyum, seeyoanil vaikki'rean; avaridaththil visuvaasamaayiruppavan evanoa avan vedkappaduvathillai en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyaayit'ru.
sakoathararea, isravealar iradchikkappadavea'ndum enpathea en iruthayaththin viruppamum naan theavanai noakkich seyyum vi'n'nappamumaayirukki'rathu.
theavanaippat'ri avarka'lukku vairaakkiyamu'nden'ru avarka'laikku'riththuch saadchisolluki'rean; aakilum athu a'rivukkeat'ra vairaakkiyamalla.
eppadiyen'raal, avarka'l theavaneethiyai a'riyaamal, thangka'l suyaneethiyai nilaini'ruththath theaduki'rapadiyaal theavaneethikkuk keezhppadiyaathirukki'raarka'l.
visuvaasikki'ra evanukkum neethi u'ndaakumpadiyaakak ki'risthu niyaayappiramaa'naththin mudivaayirukki'raar.
moasea niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalaakum neethiyaikku'riththu: ivaika'laich seyki'ra manushan ivaika'laal pizhaippaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'raan.
visuvaasaththinaalaakum neethiyaanathu: ki'risthuvai i'rangkivarappa'n'numpadi paraloakaththukku ea'ruki'ravan yaar?
allathu ki'risthuvai mariththoarilirunthu ea'rivarappa'n'numpadi paathaa'laththukku i'rangkuki'ravan yaar? en'ru un u'l'laththilea sollaathiruppaayaaka en'ru solluki'rathuman'ri;
intha vaarththai unakkuch sameepamaay un vaayilum un iruthayaththilum irukki'rathu en'rum solluki'rathu; intha vaarththai naangka'l pirasangkikki'ra visuvaasaththin vaarththaiyea.
ennaven'raal, karththaraakiya iyeasuvai nee un vaayinaalea a'rikkaiyittu, theavan avarai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppinaaren'ru un iruthayaththilea visuvaasiththaal iradchikkappaduvaay.
neethiyu'ndaaka iruthayaththilea visuvaasikkappadum, iradchippu'ndaaka vaayinaalea a'rikkaipa'n'nappadum.
avarai visuvaasikki'ravan evanoa avan vedkappaduvathillaiyen'ru veatham solluki'rathu.
yoothanen'rum kireakkanen'rum viththiyaasamea illai; ellaarukkung karththaraanavar thammaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ra yaavarukkum aisuvariyasampannaraayirukki'raar.
aathalaal karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ra evanum iradchikkappaduvaan.

avarai visuvaasiyaathavarka'l eppadi avaraith thozhuthuko'l'luvaarka'l? avaraikku'riththuk kea'lvippadaathavarka'l eppadi visuvaasippaarka'l? pirasangkikki'ravan illaavittaal eppadik kea'lvippaduvaarka'l?

anuppappadaavittaal eppadip pirasangkippaarka'l? samaathaanaththaikkoo'ri, na'rkaariyangka'laich suviseashamaay a'rivikki'ravarka'ludaiya paathangka'l evva'lavu azhakaanavaika'l en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.
aanaalum suviseashaththukku ellaarum keezhppadiyavillai. athaikku'riththu easaayaa: karththaavea, engka'l moolamaayk kea'lvippattathai visuvaasiththavan yaar en'ru solluki'raan.
aathalaal visuvaasam kea'lviyinaalea varum, kea'lvi theavanudaiya vasanaththinaalea varum.
ippadiyirukka, avarka'l kea'lvippadavillaiyaa en'ru keadki'rean; kea'lvippattaarka'l; avaika'lin saththam poomiyengkum avaika'lin vasanangka'l poochchakkaraththuk kadaisivaraikkum selluki'rathea.

isravealar athai a'riyavillaiyaa en'ru keadki'rean, a'rinthaarka'l. muthalaavathu, moasea: enakku janangka'lallaathavarka'laikko'ndu naan ungka'lukku erichchal u'ndaakkuvean; puththiyeenamu'l'la janangka'laalea ungka'lukkuk koapamoottuvean en'raan.
allaamalum easaayaa: ennaith theadaathavarka'laalea ka'nda'riyappattean, ennai visaariththuk kea'laathavarka'lukku ve'liyarangkamaanean en'ru thairiyangko'ndu solluki'raan.
isravealaraikku'riththoa: keezhppadiyaathavarka'lum ethirththup peasuki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'ra janangka'lidaththi'rku naa'lmuzhuthum en kaika'lai neettinean en'ru avan solliyirukki'raan.
ippadiyirukka, theavan thammudaiya janangka'laith tha'l'livittaaroa en'ru keadki'rean, tha'l'lividavillaiyea; naanum aapirakaamin santhathiyilum penyameen koaththiraththilum pi'rantha isravealan.
theavan thaam munna'rinthuko'nda thammudaiya janangka'laith tha'l'lividavillai. eliyaavaikku'riththuch solliya idaththil, veatham solluki'rathai a'riyeerka'laa? avan theavanai noakki:

karththaavea, ummudaiya theerkkatharisika'lai avarka'l kolaiseythu, ummudaiya palipeedangka'lai idiththuppoattaarka'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram meethiyaayirukki'rean, en piraa'nanaiyum vaangkaththeaduki'raarka'lea en'ru isravealarukku viroathamaay vi'n'nappampa'n'ninapoathu,
avanukku u'ndaana theavauththaravu enna? paakaalukkumunpaaka muzhangkaa'rpadiyidaatha eazhaayirampearai enakkaaka meethiyaaka vaiththean enpathea.
appadippoala ikkaalaththileayum kirupaiyinaalea u'ndaakum therinthuko'l'luthalinpadi oru pangku meethiyaayirukki'rathu.

athu kirupaiyinaalea u'ndaayirunthaal kiriyaika'linaalea u'ndaayiraathu; appadiyallaven'raal, kirupaiyaanathu kirupaiyallavea. an'riyum athu kiriyaika'linaalea u'ndaayirunthaal athu kirupaiyaayiraathu; appadiyallaven'raal, kiriyaiyaanathu kiriyaiyallavea.

appadiyaanaal enna? isravealar theaduki'rathai adaiyaamalirukki'raarka'l; therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'loa athai adainthirukki'raarka'l; mat'ravarka'l in'raiyaththinamvaraikkum kadinappattirukki'raarka'l.
kananiththiraiyin aaviyaiyum, kaa'naathirukki'ra ka'nka'laiyum, kea'laathirukki'ra kaathuka'laiyum, theavan avarka'lukkuk koduththaar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyaayit'ru.
an'riyum, avarka'ludaiya panthi avarka'lukkuch surukkum ka'n'niyum ida'rutha'rkaana kallum pathilukkup pathila'liththalumaakakkadavathu;
kaa'naathapadikku avarka'ludaiya ka'nka'l anthakaarappadakkadavathu; avarka'ludaiya muthukai eppoathum kuniyappa'n'num en'ru thaaveethum solliyirukki'raan.

ippadiyirukka, vizhunthupoakumpadikkaa ida'rinaarka'l en'ru keadki'rean, appadiyallavea; avarka'lukku'l'lea vairaakkiyaththai ezhuppaththakkathaaka avarka'ludaiya thava'ruthalinaalea pu'rajaathika'lukku iradchippu kidaiththathu.
avarka'ludaiya thava'ru ulakaththi'rku aisuvariyamum, avarka'ludaiya ku'raivu pu'rajaathika'lukku aisuvariyamumaayirukka, avarka'ludaiya ni'raivu evva'lavu athikamaay appadiyirukkum.

pu'rajaathiyaaraakiya ungka'ludanea peasuki'rean; pu'rajaathika'lukku naan appoasthalanaayirukki'rathinaalea en inaththaarukku'l'lea naan vairaakkiyaththai ezhuppi, avarka'lil silarai iradchikka vea'ndumen'ru,
en oozhiyaththai meanmaippaduththuki'rean.
avarka'laith tha'l'lividuthal ulakaththai oppuravaakkuthalaayirukka, avarka'lai angkikariththukko'l'luthal ennamaayiraathu; mariththoarilirunthu jeevan u'ndaanathupoalirukkumallavoa?
mealum mutha'rpalanaakiya maavaanathu parisuththamaayirunthaal, pisainthamaa muzhuvathum parisuththamaayirukkum; vearaanathu parisuththamaayirunthaal, ki'laika'lum parisuththamaayirukkum.
sila ki'laika'l mu'riththuppoadappattirukka, kaattolivamaramaakiya nee avaika'l iruntha idaththil ottavaikkappattu, olivamaraththin vearukkum saaraththukkum udanpangkaa'liyaayirunthaayaanaal,
nee anthak ki'laika'lukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattaathea; perumaipaaraattuvaayaanaal, nee vearaich sumakkaamal, vear unnaich sumakki'rathen'ru ninaiththukko'l.
naan ottavaikkappaduvatha'rku anthak ki'laika'l mu'riththuppoadappattathen'ru solluki'raayea.
nallathu, avisuvaasaththinaalea avaika'l mu'riththuppoadappattana, nee visuvaasaththinaalea ni'rki'raay; meattimaich sinthaiyaayiraamal payanthiru.
supaavakki'laika'laith theavan thappavidaathirukka, unnaiyum thappavidamaattaar en'ru echcharikkaiyaayiru.

aakaiyaal, theavanudaiya thayavaiyum ka'ndippaiyum paar; vizhunthavarka'lidaththilea ka'ndippaiyum, unnidaththilea thayavaiyum kaa'npiththaar; anthath thayavilea nilaiththiruppaayaanaal unakkuth thayavukidaikkum; nilaiththiraavittaal neeyum vettu'ndupoavaay.
an'riyum, avarka'l avisuvaasaththilea nilaiththiraathirunthaal avarka'lum ottavaikkappaduvaarka'l; avarka'lai ma'rupadiyum ottavaikki'ratha'rkuth theavan vallavaraayirukki'raarea.

supaavaththinpadi kaattolivamaraththilirunthu nee vettappattu, supaavaththi'rku viroathamaay nalla olivamaraththilea ottavaikkappattirunthaal, supaavakki'laika'laakiya avarka'l thangka'l suya olivamaraththilea ottavaikkappaduvathu athika nichchayamallavaa?

mealum, sakoathararea, neengka'l ungka'laiyea puththimaanka'len'ru e'n'naathapadikku oru irakasiyaththai neengka'l a'riyavea'ndumen'rirukki'rean; athennavenil, pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya ni'raivu u'ndaakumvaraikkum isravealaril oru pangkukkuk kadinamaana manathu'ndaayirukkum.
inthappirakaaram isravealarellaarum iradchikkappaduvaarka'l. meedki'ravar seeyoanilirunthu vanthu, avapakthiyai yaakkoapai vittu vilakkuvaar en'rum;
naan avarka'ludaiya paavangka'lai neekkumpoathu, ithuvea naan avarka'ludanea seyyum udanpadikkai en'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
suviseashaththaikku'riththu avarka'l ungka'lnimiththam pakaignaraayirukki'raarka'l; therinthuko'l'luthalaikku'riththu avarka'l pithaakka'linimiththam anpukoorappattavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.
theavanudaiya kirupaivarangka'lum, avarka'lai azhaiththa azhaippum maa'raathavaika'lea.
aathalaal, neengka'l mu'rkaalaththilea theavanukkuk keezhppadiyaathirunthu, ippozhuthu avarka'ludaiya keezhppadiyaamaiyinaalea irakkampet'rirukki'rathupoala,
avarka'lum ippozhuthu keezhppadiyaamalirunthum, pinpu ungka'lukkuk kidaiththa irakkaththinaalea irakkam pe'ruvaarka'l.
ellaarmealum irakkamaayirukkaththakkathaaka, theavan ellaaraiyum keezhppadiyaamaikku'l'lea adaiththuppoattaar.
aa! theavanudaiya aisuvariyam, gnaanam, a'rivu enpavaika'lin aazham evva'lavaayirukki'rathu! avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l a'lavidappadaathavaika'l, avarudaiya vazhika'l aaraayappadaathavaika'l!
karththarudaiya sinthaiyai a'rinthavan yaar? avarukku aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthavan yaar?
thanakkup pathilkidaikkumpadikku munthi avarukku on'raik koduththavan yaar?
sakalamum avaraalum avar moolamaayum avarukkaakavum irukki'rathu; avarukkea en'ren'raikkum makimaiyu'ndaavathaaka. aamen.

appadiyirukka, sakoathararea, neengka'l ungka'l sareerangka'laip parisuththamum theavanukkup piriyamumaana jeevapaliyaaka oppukkodukkavea'ndumen'ru, theavanudaiya irakkangka'lai munnittu ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; ithuvea neengka'l seyyaththakka puththiyu'l'la aaraathanai.

neengka'l inthap pirapagnchaththi'rku oththa veashanthariyaamal, theavanudaiya nanmaiyum piriyamum paripoora'namumaana siththam innathen'ru pakuththa'riyaththakkathaaka, ungka'l manam puthithaaki'rathinaalea ma'ruroopamaakungka'l.

allaamalum, enakku aru'lappatta kirupaiyinaalea naan solluki'rathaavathu; ungka'lil evanaanaalum thannaikku'riththu e'n'navea'ndiyatha'rku mignchi e'n'naamal, avanavanukkuth theavan pakirntha visuvaasa a'lavinpadiyea, the'lintha e'n'namu'l'lavanaay e'n'navea'ndum.
eanenil, namakku orea sareeraththilea aneaka avayavangka'lirunthum, ellaa avayavangka'lukkum orea thozhil iraathathupoala,
aneakaraakiya naamum ki'risthuvukku'l orea sareeramaayirukka, oruvarukkoruvar avayavangka'laayirukki'roam.

namakku aru'lappatta kirupaiyinpadiyea naam vevvea'raana varangka'lu'l'lavarka'laanapadiyinaalea, nammil theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ra varaththaiyudaiyavan visuvaasappiramaa'naththukkeat'rathaakach sollakkadavan.
oozhiyagnseyki'ravan oozhiyaththilum, poathikki'ravan poathikki'rathilum,

puththisolluki'ravan puththisolluki'rathilum thariththirukkakkadavan; pakirnthukodukki'ravan vagnchanaiyillaamal kodukkakkadavan; muthalaa'liyaanavan jaakkirathaiyaayirukkakkadavan; irakkagnseyki'ravan u'rchaakaththudanea seyyakkadavan.
ungka'l anpu maayamat'rathaayiruppathaaka; theemaiyai ve'ruththu, nanmaiyaippat'rikko'ndirungka'l.
sakoathara sineakaththilea oruvarmealoruvar padchamaayirungka'l; kanampa'n'nuki'rathilea oruvarukkoruvar munthikko'l'lungka'l.
asathiyaayiraamal jaakkirathaiyaayirungka'l; aaviyilea analaayirungka'l; karththarukku oozhiyagnseyyungka'l.
nampikkaiyilea santhoashamaayirungka'l; upaththiravaththilea po'rumaiyaayirungka'l; jepaththilea u'ruthiyaayth thariththirungka'l.
parisuththavaanka'ludaiya ku'raivil avarka'lukku uthaviseyyungka'l; anniyarai upasarikka naadungka'l.
ungka'laith thunpappaduththuki'ravarka'lai aaseervathiyungka'l; aaseervathikkavea'ndiyatheayan'rich sapiyaathirungka'l.
santhoashappaduki'ravarka'ludanea santhoashappadungka'l; azhuki'ravarka'ludanea azhungka'l.
oruvaroadoruvar eakasinthaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l; meattimaiyaanavaika'laich sinthiyaamal, thaazhmaiyaanavarka'lukku i'nangkungka'l; ungka'laiyea puththimaanka'len'ru e'n'naathirungka'l.
oruvanukkum theemaikkuth theemaiseyyaathirungka'l; ellaa manusharukku munpaakavum yoakkiyamaanavaika'laich seyya naadungka'l.
koodumaanaal ungka'laalaanamattum ellaa manusharoadum samaathaanamaayirungka'l.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, pazhivaangkuthal enakkuriyathu, naanea pathi'rseyvean, en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyaal, neengka'l pazhivaangkaamal, koapaakkinaikku idangkodungka'l.
an'riyum, un saththuru pasiyaayirunthaal, avanukkup poajanangkodu; avan thaakamaayirunthaal, avanukkup paanangkodu; nee ippadich seyvathinaal akkiniththazhalai avan thalaiyinmeal kuvippaay.
nee theemaiyinaalea vellappadaamal, theemaiyai nanmaiyinaalea vellu.

entha manushanum mealaana athikaaramu'l'lavarka'lukkuk keezhppadiyakkadavan; eanen'raal, theavanaaleayan'ri oru athikaaramumillai; u'ndaayirukki'ra athikaarangka'l theavanaalea niyamikkappattirukki'rathu.

aathalaal athikaaraththi'rku ethirththu ni'rki'ravan theavanudaiya niyamaththi'rku ethirththu ni'rki'raan; appadi ethirththu ni'rki'ravarka'l thangka'lukkuth thaangka'lea aakkinaiyai varuviththukko'l'luki'raarka'l.

mealum athikaarika'l na'rkiriyaika'lukkalla, thurkkiriyaika'lukkea payangkaramaayirukki'raarka'l; aakaiyaal nee athikaaraththi'rkup payappadaathirukkavea'ndumaanaal, nanmaisey, athinaal unakkup pukazhchchi u'ndaakum.

unakku nanmai u'ndaakum poruttu, avan theavaoozhiyakkaaranaayirukki'raan. nee theemaiseythaal payanthiru; pattayaththai avan viruthaavaayp pidiththirukkavillai; theemaiseyki'ravanmeal koapaakkinai varappa'n'numpadi, avan neethiyaich seluththuki'ra theavaoozhiyakkaaranaayirukki'raanea.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l koapaakkinaiyinimiththam maaththiramalla, manachsaadchiyinimiththamum keezhppadiyavea'ndum.
itha'rkaakavea neengka'l variyaiyum kodukki'reerka'l. avarka'l intha vealaiyaip paarththuvaruki'ra theavaoozhiyakkaararaayirukki'raarka'lea.

aakaiyaal yaavarukkum seluththavea'ndiya kadamaika'laich seluththungka'l; evanukku variyaich seluththavea'ndiyathoa avanukku variyaiyum, evanukkuth theervaiyaich seluththavea'ndiyathoa avanukkuth theervaiyaiyum seluththungka'l; evanukkup payappadavea'ndiyathoa avanukkup payappadungka'l; evanaik kanampa'n'navea'ndiyathoa avanaik kanampa'n'nungka'l.
oruvaridaththiloruvar anpukooruki'ra kadaneayallaamal, mat'ron'rilum oruvanukkum kadanpadaathirungka'l; pi'ranidaththil anpukooruki'ravan niyaayappiramaa'naththai ni'raiveat'ruki'raan.

eppadiyen'raal, vipasaaram seyyaathiruppaayaaka, kolai seyyaathiruppaayaaka, ka'lavu seyyaathiruppaayaaka, poychsaadchi sollaathiruppaayaaka, ichchiyaathiruppaayaaka enki'ra inthak ka'rpanaika'lum, vea'rea enthak ka'rpanaiyum, unnidaththil nee anpukooruki'rathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka enki'ra orea vaarththaiyilea thokaiyaay adangkiyirukki'rathu.
anpaanathu pi'ranukkup pollaangkuseyyaathu; aathalaal anpu niyaayappiramaa'naththin ni'raivea'ruthalaayirukki'rathu.

niththiraiyaivittu ezhunthirukkaththakka vea'laiyaayit'ren'ru, naam kaalaththai a'rinthavarka'laay, ippadi nadakkavea'ndum; naam visuvaasika'laanapoathu iradchippu sameepamaayirunthathaippaarkkilum ippozhuthu athu namakku athika sameepamaayirukki'rathu.
iravu sen'rupoayit'ru, pakal sameepamaayit'ru; aakaiyaal anthakaaraththin kiriyaika'lai naam tha'l'livittu, o'liyin aayuthangka'laith thariththukko'l'lakkadavoam.
ka'liyaattum ve'riyum, veasiththanamum kaamavikaaramum, vaakkuvaathamum po'raamaiyum u'l'lavarka'laay nadavaamal, pakalilea nadakki'ravarka'lpoalach seeraay nadakkakkadavoam.
thurichchaika'lukku idamaaka udalaip pea'naamalirunthu, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvaith thariththukko'l'lungka'l.
visuvaasaththil palaveenamu'l'lavanaich searththukko'l'lungka'l; aanaalum avanudaiya mana aiyangka'laik kut'ramaay nir'nayikkaamalirungka'l.
oruvan enthap pathaarththaththaiyum pusikkalaamen'ru nampuki'raan; palaveenanoa marakka'rika'laimaaththiram pusikki'raan.
pusikki'ravan pusiyaathirukki'ravanai a'rpamaaye'n'naathiruppaanaaka; pusiyaathirukki'ravanum pusikki'ravanaik kut'ravaa'liyaakath theerkkaathiruppaanaaka; theavan avanai eat'rukko'ndaarea.

mat'roruvanudaiya vealaikkaaranaik kut'ravaa'liyaakath theerkki'ratha'rku nee yaar? avan nin'raalum vizhunthaalum avanudaiya ejamaanukkea avan uththaravaathi; avan nilaini'ruththappaduvaan; theavan avanai nilaini'ruththa vallavaraayirukki'raarea.

an'riyum, oruvan orunaa'lai mat'roru naa'lilum viseashamaaka e'n'nuki'raan; vea'roruvan ellaa naadka'laiyum sariyaaka e'n'nuki'raan; avanavan thanthan manathilea muzhu nichchayaththai udaiyavanaayirukkakkadavan.

naadka'lai viseashiththukko'l'luki'ravan karththarukken'ru viseashiththuk ko'l'luki'raan; naadka'lai viseashiththuk ko'l'laathavanum karththarukken'ru viseashiththukko'l'laathirukki'raan. pusikki'ravan theavanukku sthoaththiragnseluththuki'rapadiyaal, karththarukken'ru pusikki'raan; pusiyaathirukki'ravanum karththarukken'ru pusiyaathirunthu, theavanukku sthoaththiragn seluththuki'raan.
nammil oruvanum thanakken'ru pizhaikki'rathumillai, oruvanum thanakken'ru marikki'rathumillai.
naam pizhaiththaalum karththarukken'ru pizhaikki'roam, naam mariththaalum karththarukken'ru marikki'roam; aakaiyaal pizhaiththaalum mariththaalum naam karththarudaiyavarka'laayirukki'roam.
ki'risthuvum mariththoarmealum jeevanu'l'loarmealum aa'ndavaraayirukkumporuttu, mariththum ezhunthum pizhaiththumirukki'raar.
ippadiyirukka, nee un sakoatharanaik kut'ravaa'liyen'ru theerkki'rathenna? nee un sakoatharanai a'rpamaay e'n'nuki'rathenna? naamellaarum ki'risthuvinudaiya niyaayaasanaththi'rku munpaaka ni'rpoamea.
anthappadi: muzhangkaal yaavum enakku munpaaka mudangkum, naavu yaavum theavanai a'rikkaipa'n'num en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu uraikki'rean enpathaayk karththar solluki'raar en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
aathalaal nammil ovvoruvanum thannaikku'riththuth theavanukkuk ka'nakkoppuvippaan.

ippadiyirukka, naam inimeal oruvaraiyoruvar kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkaathiruppoamaaka. oruvanum than sakoatharanukku munpaakath thadukkalaiyum ida'ralaiyum poadalaakaathen'rea theermaaniththukko'l'lungka'l.

oru poru'lum thannilea theettu'l'lathallaven'ru karththaraakiya iyeasuvukku'l a'rinthu nichchayiththirukki'rean; oruporu'laith theettu'l'lathen'ru e'n'nikko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanukku athu theettu'l'lathaayirukkum.
poajanaththinaalea un sakoatharanukku visanamu'ndaakkinaal, nee anpaay nadakki'ravanalla; avanai un poajanaththinaalea kedukkaathea, ki'risthu avanukkaaka mariththaarea.
ungka'l nanmai thooshikkappada idangkodaathirungka'l.
theavanudaiya raajyam pusippum kudippumalla, athu neethiyum samaathaanamum parisuththa aaviyinaalu'ndaakum santhoashamumaayirukki'rathu.
ivaika'lilea ki'risthuvukku oozhiyagnseyki'ravan theavanukkup piriyanum manusharaal angkikarikkappattavanumaayirukki'raan.
aanapadiyaal samaathaanaththukkaduththavaika'laiyum, anniyoanniya pakthiviruththi u'ndaakkaththakkavaika'laiyum naadakkadavoam.
poajanaththinimiththam theavanudaiya kiriyaiyai azhiththuppoadaathea. enthap pathaarththamum suththamu'l'lathuthaan; aanaalum ida'ralu'ndaakap pusikki'ravanukku athu theemaiyaayirukkum.

maamsam pusikki'rathum, mathupaanam pa'n'nuki'rathum, mat'rethaiyaakilum seyki'rathum, un sakoatharan ida'ruki'ratha'rkaavathu, thava'ruki'ratha'rkaavathu palaveenappaduki'ratha'rkaavathu eathuvaayirunthaal, avaika'lil on'raiyum seyyaamaliruppathea nanmaiyaayirukkum.
unakku visuvaasamirunthaal athu theavanukkumunpaaka unmattum irukkattum. nallathen'ru nichchayiththa kaariyaththil thannaik kut'ravaa'liyaakkaathavan paakkiyavaan.
oruvan samusayappaduki'ravanaayp pusiththaal, avan visuvaasamillaamal pusikki'rapadiyinaal, aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappaduki'raan. visuvaasaththinaalea varaatha yaavum paavamea.
an'riyum, palamu'l'lavarka'laakiya naam namakkea piriyamaay nadavaamal, palaveenarudaiya palaveenangka'laith thaangkavea'ndum.
nammil ovvoruvanum pi'ranudaiya pakthiviruththikkeathuvaana nanmaiyu'ndaakumpadi avanukkup piriyamaay nadakkakkadavan.
ki'risthuvum thamakkea piriyamaay nadavaamal: ummai ninthikki'ravarka'ludaiya ninthaika'l enmeal vizhunthathu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea nadanthaar.
theavavasanaththinaal u'ndaakum po'rumaiyinaalum aa'ruthalinaalum naam nampikkaiyu'l'lavarka'laakumpadikku, munpu ezhuthiyirukki'ravaika'lellaam namakkup poathanaiyaaka ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
neengka'l orumanappattu nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaakiya theavanai orea vaayinaal makimaippaduththumpadikku,
po'rumaiyaiyum aa'ruthalaiyum a'likkum theavan, ki'risthu iyeasuvinudaiya maathiriyinpadiyea, neengka'l eakasinthaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirukkumpadi ungka'lukku anukkirakagnseyvaaraaka.
aathalaal theavanukku makimaiyu'ndaaka, ki'risthu nammai eat'rukko'ndathupoala, neengka'lum oruvaraiyoruvar eat'rukko'l'lungka'l.

mealum, pithaakka'lukkup pa'n'nappatta vaakkuththaththangka'lai u'ruthiyaakkumpadikku, theavanudaiya saththiyaththinimiththam iyeasuki'risthu viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lukku oozhiyakkaararaanaaren'rum;

pu'rajaathiyaarum irakkam pet'rathinimiththam theavanai makimaippaduththuki'raarka'len'rum solluki'rean. anthappadi: ithinimiththam naan pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea ummai a'rikkaipa'n'ni, ummudaiya naamaththaich solli, sangkeetham paaduvean en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
mealum, pu'rajaathika'lea, avarudaiya janangka'loadeakoodak ka'likoorungka'l enki'raar.
mealum, pu'rajaathika'lea, ellaarum karththaraith thuthiyungka'l; janangka'lea, ellaarum avaraip pukazhungka'l en'rum solluki'raar.
mealum, eesaayin vearum pu'rajaathiyaarai aa'lumpadikku ezhumpuki'ravarumaakiya oruvar thoan'ruvaar; avaridaththil pu'rajaathiyaar nampikkaivaippaarka'l en'ru easaayaa solluki'raan.

parisuththaaaviyin palaththinaalea ungka'lukku nampikkai perukumpadikku, nampikkaiyin theavan visuvaasaththinaal u'ndaakum ellaavitha santhoashaththinaalum samaathaanaththinaalum ungka'lai nirappuvaaraaka.

en sakoathararea, neengka'l na'rku'naththinaal ni'rainthavarka'lum, sakala a'rivinaalum nirappappattavarka'lum, oruvarukkoruvar puththisolla vallavarka'lumaayirukki'reerka'len'ru naanum ungka'laik ku'riththu nichchayiththirukki'rean.

appadiyirunthum, sakoathararea, pu'rajaathiyaaraakiya pali parisuththaaaviyinaalea parisuththamaakkappattu, theavanukkup piriyamaana paliyaakumpadikku, naan theavanudaiya suviseasha oozhiyaththai nadaththum aasaariyanaayirunthu pu'rajaathika'lukku iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakumporuttu,
theavan enakku a'liththa kirupaiyinaalea ungka'lukku gnaapakappaduththumpadikku ivaika'lai naan athika thairiyamaay ezhuthinean.
aathalaal naan theavanukkuriyavaika'laikku'riththu iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu meanmaipaaraatta enakku idamu'ndu.

pu'rajaathiyaarai vaarththaiyinaalum seykaiyinaalum keezhppadiyappa'n'numpadikku, a'rputha adaiyaa'langka'lin palaththinaalum, theava aaviyin palaththinaalum, ki'risthuvaanavar ennaikko'ndu nadappiththavaika'laich solvathallaamal vea'ron'raiyum solla naan thu'nivathillai.
ippadi erusaleam thuvakkich sut'rilum, illirikkam theasamvaraikkum, ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaip poora'namaayp pirasangkiththirukki'rean.
mealum avarudaiya seythiyai a'riyaathirunthavarka'l kaa'npaarka'len'rum, kea'lvippadaathirunthavarka'l u'narnthuko'lvaarka'len'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea,
naan mat'roruvanudaiya asthipaaraththinmeal kattaathapadikku ki'risthuvinudaiya naamam sollappattiraatha idangka'lil suviseashaththai a'rivikkumpadi naaduki'rean.
ungka'lidaththil varuki'ratha'rku ithinaalea aneakantharam thadaipattean.
ippozhuthu inthath thisaika'lilea enakku idamillaathapadiyinaalum, ungka'lidaththil varumpadi aneaka varushamaay enakku mikuntha viruppam u'ndaayirukki'rapadiyinaalum,

naan spaaniyaa theasaththi'rkup pirayaa'nampa'n'nukaiyil ungka'lidaththil vanthu, ungka'laik ka'nduko'l'lavum, ungka'lidaththil sat'ruth thirupthiyadainthapinpu, avvidaththi'rku ungka'laal vazhivittanuppappadavum, enakkuch samayang kidaikkumen'ru nampiyirukki'rean.
ippozhuthoa parisuththavaanka'lukku uthaviseyyungkaariyamaaka naan erusaleamukkup pirayaa'nampa'n'na eththanamaayirukki'rean.
makkethoaniyaavilum akaayaavilumu'l'lavarka'l erusaleamilu'l'la parisuththavaanka'lukku'l'lea irukki'ra thariththirarukkaakach sila poru'lsakaayam seyya viruppangko'ndirukki'raarka'l;

ippadichseyvathu nallathen'ru e'n'ninaarka'l; ippadich seyki'ratha'rku avarka'l kadanaa'lika'laayum irukki'raarka'l. eppadiyen'raal pu'rajaathiyaar avarka'ludaiya gnaanananmaika'lil pangkupet'rirukka, sareerananmaika'laal avarka'lukku uthaviseyya ivarka'l kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'raarka'lea.
inthak kaariyaththai naan ni'raiveat'ri, inthap palanai avarka'l kaiyilea paththiramaay oppuviththapinpu, ungka'l oor vazhiyaay spaaniyaavukkup poavean.
naan ungka'lidaththil varumpoathu ki'risthuvinudaiya suviseashaththin sampoora'namaana aaseervaathaththoadea varuveanen'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
mealum sakoathararea, theavasiththaththinaalea naan santhoashaththudanea ungka'lidaththil vanthu ungka'loadu i'laippaa'rumpadiyaaka,
yootheayaavilirukki'ra avisuvaasika'lukku naan thappuvikkappadumpadikkum, naan erusaleamilu'l'la parisuththavaanka'lukkuch seyyappoaki'ra tharmasakaayam avarka'laal angkikarikkappadumpadikkum,

neengka'l theavanai noakkich seyyum jepangka'lil, naan poaraaduvathupoala neengka'lum ennoadukoodap poaraadavea'ndumen'ru nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinimiththamum, aaviyaanavarudaiya anpinimiththamum, ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
samaathaanaththin theavan ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppaaraaka. aamen.
kengkireayaa oor sapaikku oozhiyakkaariyaakiya nammudaiya sakoathari pepeayaa'lai neengka'l karththarukku'l parisuththavaanka'lukkeat'rapadi eat'rukko'ndu,

enthak kaariyaththil ungka'l uthavi ava'lukkuth theavaiyaayirukki'rathoa athilea neengka'l ava'lukku uthaviseyyavea'ndumen'ru ava'lai ungka'lidaththil oppuvikki'rean; ava'l aneakarukkum enakkungkooda aatharavaayirunthava'l.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l en udanvealaiyaadka'laakiya piriskillaa'laiyum aakkillaavaiyum vaazhththungka'l.

avarka'l en piraa'nanukkaakath thangka'l kazhuththaik koduththavarka'l; avarka'laippat'ri naanmaaththiramalla, pu'rajaathiyaaril u'ndaana sapaiyaarellaarum nan'riya'rithalu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya veettilea koodivaruki'ra sapaiyaiyum vaazhththungka'l. akaayaavilea ki'risthuvukku mutha'rpalanaakiya en piriyamaana eppaneththai vaazhththungka'l.
engka'lukkaaka mikavum pirayaasappatta mariyaa'lai vaazhththungka'l.

appoasthalarukku'l peyarpet'ravarka'lum enakku munthik ki'risthuvukku'l'laanavarka'lum en inaththaarum ennudaneakoodak kaavalil kattu'ndavarka'lumaayirukki'ra an'roaneekkaiyum yooniyaavaiyum vaazhththungka'l.
karththarukku'l enakkup piriyamaana ampiliyaavai vaazhththungka'l.
ki'risthuvukku'l nammoadea udanvealaiyaa'laakiya urpaanaiyum, en piriyamaana sthaakkiyaiyum vaazhththungka'l.
ki'risthuvukku'l uththamanaakiya appelleayai vaazhththungka'l. aristhopooluvin veettaarai vaazhththungka'l.
en inaththaanaakiya earoathiyoanai vaazhththungka'l. narkeesuvin veettaaril karththarukkudpattavarka'lai vaazhththungka'l.
karththarukku'l pirayaasappaduki'ra thiripeanaa'laiyum thiripoasaa'laiyum vaazhththungka'l. karththarukku'l mikavum pirayaasappatta piriyamaana persiyaa'lai vaazhththungka'l.
karththarukku'l therinthuko'l'lappatta roopaiyum, enakkum thaayaakiya avanudaiya thaayaiyum vaazhththungka'l.
asingkireeththuvaiyum, pilekoanaiyum, ermaavaiyum, paththiropaavaiyum, ermeayaiyum, avarka'loadirukki'ra sakoathararaiyum vaazhththungka'l.
piloloakaiyum, yooliyaa'laiyum, neareayaiyum, avanudaiya sakoathariyaiyum, olimpaavaiyum, avarka'loadirukki'ra parisuththavaanka'lellaaraiyum vaazhththungka'l.
oruvaraiyoruvar parisuththa muththaththoadu vaazhththungka'l. ki'risthuvin sapaiyaar ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raarka'l.

an'riyum sakoathararea, neengka'l kat'rukko'nda upatheasaththi'rku viroathamaayp pirivinaika'laiyum ida'ralka'laiyum u'ndaakkuki'ravarka'laikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, avarka'lai vittu vilakavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.

appadippattavarka'l nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku oozhiyagnseyyaamal thangka'l vayit'rukkea oozhiyagnseythu, nayavasanippinaalum ichchakappeachchinaalum, kapadillaathavarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'lai vagnchikki'ravarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

ungka'l keezhppadithal yaavarukkum theriyavanthirukki'rathu. aakaiyaal ungka'laikku'riththuch santhoashappaduki'rean; aanaalum neengka'l nanmaikku gnaanika'lum theemaikkup peathaika'lumaayirukkavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'rean.
samaathaanaththin theavan seekkiramaaych saaththaanai ungka'l kaalka'linkeezhea nasukkippoaduvaar. nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupai ungka'ludaneakooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
en udanvealaiyaa'laakiya theemoaththeayum, en inaththaaraakiya lookiyum, yaasoanum, sosipaththarum ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raarka'l.
intha nirupaththai ezhuthina therthiyuvaakiya naan karththarukku'l ungka'lai vaazhththuki'rean.
ennaiyum sapaiyanaiththaiyum upasariththuvaruki'ra kaayu ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raan. patta'naththu ukkiraa'nakkaaranaakiya earasthum, sakoatharanaakiya kuvarththum ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raarka'l.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupai ungka'l anaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.

aathikaalamuthal adakkamaayirunthu, ippozhuthu theerkkatharisana aakamangka'linaalea anaathi theavanudaiya katta'laiyinpadi ve'liyarangkamaakkappattathum, sakala jaathika'lum visuvaasaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyumpadikku avarka'lukku a'rivikkappattathumaayirukki'ra irakasiyaththai ve'lippaduththuki'rathaana,
iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'riya pirasangkamaakiya en suviseashaththinpadiyea ungka'lai sthirappaduththa vallavarum,
thaam oruvarea gnaanamu'l'lavarumaayirukki'ra theavanukku iyeasuki'risthuvin moolamaay en'ren'raikkum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaakumpadi azhaikkappattavanaakiya pavulum, sakoatharanaakiya sostheneayum,

korinthuvilea ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l parisuththamaakkappattavarka'laayum, parisuththavaanka'laakumpadi azhaikkappattavarka'laayumirukki'ra theavanudaiya sapaikkum, engka'lukkum thangka'lukkum aa'ndavaraayirukki'ra nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasu ki'risthuvin naamaththai engkum thozhuthuko'l'luki'ra anaivarukkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
ki'risthuvaippat'riya saadchi ungka'lukku'l'lea sthirappaduththappattapadiyea,
neengka'l iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l'laay ellaa upatheasaththilum ellaa a'rivilum, mat'rellaavat'rilum, sampoora'namu'l'lavarka'laakkappattirukki'rapadiyaal,
avar moolamaay ungka'lukku a'likkappatta theavakirupaikkaaka, naan ungka'laikku'riththu eppozhuthum en theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean.
appadiyea neengka'l yaathoru varaththilum ku'raivillaathavarka'laay, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu ve'lippaduvatha'rkuk kaaththirukki'reerka'l.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasu ki'risthuvin naa'lilea neengka'l kut'ragnsaattappadaathavarka'laayirukkumpadi mudivupariyantham avar ungka'lai sthirappaduththuvaar.
thammudaiya kumaaranum nammudaiya karththarumaayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthuvudanea aikkiyamaayiruppatha'rku ungka'lai azhaiththa theavan u'nmaiyu'l'lavar.

sakoathararea, neengka'lellaarum orea kaariyaththaip peasavum, pirivinaika'lillaamal eakamanathum eakayoasanaiyum u'l'lavarka'laaych seerporunthiyirukkavum vea'ndumen'ru, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.
eanenil, en sakoathararea, ungka'lukku'l'lea vaakkuvaathangka'l u'nden'ru kuloaveayaa'lin veettaaraal ungka'laikku'riththu enakku a'rivikkappattathu.

ungka'lil silar: naan pavulaich searnthavanen'rum, naan appolloavaich searnthavanen'rum, naan keapaavaich searnthavanen'rum, naan ki'risthuvaich searnthavanen'rum solluki'rapadiyaal, naan ippadich solluki'rean.
ki'risthu pirinthirukki'raaraa? pavulaa ungka'lukkaakach siluvaiyila'raiyappattaan? pavulin naamaththinaaleayaa gnaanasnaanam pet'reerka'l?
en naamaththinaalea gnaanasnaanang koduththeanen'ru oruvanum sollaathapadikku,
naan ki'rispuvukkum kaayuvukkumeayan'ri, ungka'lil vea'roruvanukkum gnaanasnaanang kodukkavillai; itha'rkaakath theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean.
stheavaanudaiya veettaarukkum naan gnaanasnaanang koduththathu'ndu. ithuvumallaamal innum yaarukkaavathu naan gnaanasnaanang koduththeanoa illaiyoa a'riyean.

gnaanasnaanaththaik kodukkumpadi ki'risthu ennai anuppavillai; suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkavea anuppinaar; ki'risthuvin siluvai vee'naayppoakaathapadikku, saathuriya gnaanamillaamal pirasangkikkavea anuppinaar.
siluvaiyaippat'riya upatheasam kettuppoaki'ravarka'lukkup paiththiyamaayirukki'rathu, iradchikkappaduki'ra namakkoa athu theavapelanaayirukki'rathu.
anthappadi gnaanika'ludaiya gnaanaththai naan azhiththu, puththisaalika'ludaiya puththiyai avamaakkuvean en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
gnaani engkea? veathapaarakan engkea? ippirapagnchath tharkkasaasthiri engkea? ivvulakaththin gnaanaththaith theavan paiththiyamaakkavillaiyaa?
