eppadiyenil, theavagnaanaththukkeat'rapadi ulakamaanathu suyagnaanaththinaalea theavanai a'riyaathirukkaiyil, paiththiyamaakath thoan'ruki'ra pirasangkaththinaalea visuvaasika'lai iradchikkath theavanukkup piriyamaayit'ru.
yootharka'l adaiyaa'laththaik keadki'raarka'l, kireakkar gnaanaththaith theaduki'raarka'l;
naangka'loa siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta ki'risthuvaip pirasangkikki'roam; avar yootharukku ida'ralaayum kireakkarukkup paiththiyamaayum irukki'raar.
aakilum yootharaanaalum kireakkaraanaalum evarka'l azhaikkappattirukki'raarka'loa avarka'lukkuk ki'risthu theavapelanum theavagnaanamumaayirukki'raar.

inthappadi, theavanudaiya paiththiyam ennappaduvathu manusharudaiya gnaanaththilum athika gnaanamaayirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya palaveenam ennappaduvathu manusharudaiya palaththilum athika palamaayirukki'rathu.
eppadiyenil, sakoathararea, neengka'l azhaikkappatta azhaippaip paarungka'l; maamsaththinpadi gnaanika'l aneakarillai, vallavarka'l aneakarillai, pirapukka'l aneakarillai.

gnaanika'lai vedkappaduththumpadi theavan ulakaththil paiththiyamaanavaika'laith therinthuko'ndaar; palamu'l'lavaika'lai vedkappaduththumpadi theavan ulakaththil palaveenamaanavaika'laith therinthuko'ndaar.
u'l'lavaika'lai avamaakkumpadi, ulakaththin izhivaanavaika'laiyum, a'rpamaay e'n'nappattavaika'laiyum, illaathavaika'laiyum, theavan therinthuko'ndaar.
maamsamaana evanum theavanukku munpaakap perumaipaaraattaathapadikku appadich seythaar.
anthappadi, neengka'l avaraalea ki'risthu iyeasuvukkudpattirukki'reerka'l. ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi meanmaipaaraattuki'ravan karththaraikku'riththea meanmaipaaraattaththakkathaaka,
avarea theavanaal namakku gnaanamum neethiyum parisuththamum meedpumaanaar.
sakoathararea, naan ungka'lidaththil vanthapoathu, theavanaippat'riya saadchiyaich si'rantha vasanippoadaavathu gnaanaththoadaavathu a'rivikki'ravanaaka varavillai.
iyeasuki'risthuvai, siluvaiyil a'raiyappatta avaraiyeayan'ri, vea'ron'raiyum ungka'lukku'l'lea a'riyaathirukkath theermaaniththirunthean.
allaamalum naan palaveenaththoadum payaththoadum mikuntha nadukkaththoadum ungka'lidaththil irunthean.
ungka'l visuvaasam manusharudaiya gnaanaththilalla, theavanudaiya pelaththil ni'rkumpadikku,
en peachchum en pirasangkamum manusha gnaanaththi'rkuriya nayavasanamu'l'lathaayiraamal, aaviyinaalum pelaththinaalum u'ruthippaduththappattathaayirunthathu.
appadiyirunthum, thea'rinavarka'lukku'l'lea gnaanaththaip peasuki'roam; ippirapagnchaththin gnaanaththaiyalla, azhinthupoaki'ravarka'laakiya ippirapagnchaththin pirapukka'ludaiya gnaanaththaiyumalla,
ulakaththoat'raththi'rkumunnea theavan nammudaiya makimaikkaaka ea'rpaduththinathum, ma'raikkappattathumaayiruntha irakasiyamaana theavagnaanaththaiyea peasuki'roam.
athai ippirapagnchaththup pirapukka'lil oruvanum a'riyavillai; a'rinthaarka'laanaal, makimaiyin karththarai avarka'l siluvaiyil a'raiyamaattaarka'lea.
ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi: theavan thammil anpukooruki'ravarka'lukku aayaththampa'n'ninavaika'laik ka'n kaa'navumillai, kaathu keadkavumillai, avaika'l manushanudaiya iruthayaththil thoan'ravumillai;
namakkoa theavan avaika'laith thamathu aaviyinaalea ve'lippaduththinaar; antha aaviyaanavar ellaavat'raiyum, theavanudaiya aazhangka'laiyum, aaraaynthirukki'raar.
manushanilu'l'la aaviyeayan'ri manusharil evan manushanukkuriyavaika'lai a'rivaan? appadippoala, theavanudaiya aaviyeayan'ri, oruvanum theavanukkuriyavaika'lai a'riyamaattaan.
naangka'loa ulakaththin aaviyaippe'raamal, theavanaal engka'lukku aru'lappattavaika'lai a'riyumpadikkuth theavanilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra aaviyaiyea pet'roam.

avaika'lai naangka'l manushagnaanam poathikki'ra vaarththaika'laalea peasaamal, parisuththaaavi poathikki'ra vaarththaika'laalea peasi, aavikkuriyavaika'lai aavikkuriyavaika'loadea sampanthappaduththik kaa'npikki'roam.

jenmasupaavamaana manushanoa theavanudaiya aavikkuriyavaika'lai eat'rukko'l'laan; avaika'l avanukkup paiththiyamaakath thoan'rum; avaika'l aavikkeat'rapirakaaramaay aaraaynthu nithaanikkappaduki'ravaika'laanathaal, avaika'lai a'riyavumaattaan.
aavikkuriyavan ellaavat'raiyum aaraaynthu nithaanikki'raan; aanaalum avan mat'roruvanaalum aaraaynthu nithaanikkappadaan.
karththarukkup poathikkaththakkathaaka avarudaiya sinthaiyai a'rinthavan yaar? engka'lukkoa ki'risthuvin sinthai u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

mealum, sakoathararea, naan ungka'lai aavikkuriyavarka'len'ru e'n'ni ungka'ludanea peasakkoodaamal, maamsaththukkuriyavarka'len'rum, ki'risthuvukku'l kuzhanthaika'len'rum e'n'nip peasavea'ndiyathaayit'ru.

neengka'l pelanillaathavarka'laanathaal, ungka'lukkup poajanangkodaamal, paalaik kudikkakkoduththean; innamum neengka'l maamsaththukkuriyavarka'laayirukki'rapadiyaal, ippozhuthum ungka'lukkup pelanillai.
po'raamaiyum vaakkuvaathamum peathakangka'lum ungka'lukku'l irukki'rapadiyaal, neengka'l maamsaththi'rkuriyavarka'laayirunthu manushamaarkkamaay nadakki'reerka'lallavaa?
oruvan naan pavulaich searnthavanen'rum, vea'roruvan naan appolloavaich searnthavanen'rum solluki'rapadiyaal neengka'l maamsaththi'rkuriyavarka'lallavaa?
pavul yaar? appolloa yaar? karththar avanavanukku aru'l a'liththapadiyea neengka'l visuvaasikki'ratha'rku eathuvaayiruntha oozhiyakkaararthaanea.
naan nattean, appolloa neerppaaychchinaan, theavanea vi'laiyachseythaar.
appadiyirukka, naduki'ravanaalum on'rumillai, neerppaaychchuki'ravanaalum on'rumillai, vi'laiyachseyki'ra theavanaalea ellaamaakum.
mealum naduki'ravanum neerppaaychchuki'ravanum on'raayirukki'raarka'l; avanavan thanthan vealaikkuth thakkathaayk kooliyaip pe'ruvaan.
naangka'l theavanukku udanvealaiyaadka'laayirukki'roam; neengka'l theavanudaiya pa'n'naiyum, theavanudaiya maa'likaiyumaayirukki'reerka'l.

enakku a'likkappatta theavakirupaiyinpadiyea puththiyu'l'la si'rpaasaariyaippoala asthipaarampoattean. vea'roruvan athinmeal kattuki'raan. avanavan thaan athinmeal innavithamaayk kattuki'raanen'ru paarkkakkadavan.
poadappattirukki'ra asthipaaramaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai allaamal vea'rea asthipaaraththaip poada oruvanaalum koodaathu.
oruvan antha asthipaaraththinmeal pon, ve'l'li, vilaiyea'rappet'ra kal, maram, pul, vaikkoal aakiya ivaika'laik kattinaal,

avanavanudaiya vealaippaadu ve'liyaakum; naa'laanathu athai vi'langkappa'n'num. eanenil athu akkiniyinaalea ve'lippaduththappadum; avanavanudaiya vealaippaadu eththanmaiyu'l'lathen'ru akkiniyaanathu parisoathikkum.
athinmeal oruvan kattinathu nilaiththaal, avan kooliyaip pe'ruvaan.
oruvan kattinathu venthupoanaal, avan nashdamadaivaan; avanoa iradchikkappaduvaan; athuvum akkiniyilakappattuth thappinathupoalirukkum.
neengka'l theavanudaiya aalayamaayirukki'reerka'len'rum, theavanudaiya aavi ungka'lil vaasamaayirukki'raaren'rum a'riyaathirukki'reerka'laa?
oruvan theavanudaiya aalayaththaikkeduththaal, avanaith theavan keduppaar; theavanudaiya aalayam parisuththamaayirukki'rathu; neengka'lea antha aalayam.
oruvanum thannaiththaanea vagnchiyaathiruppaanaaka; ivvulakaththilea ungka'lil oruvan thannai gnaaniyen'ru e'n'ninaal avan gnaaniyaakumpadikkup paiththiyakkaaranaakakkadavan.
ivvulakaththin gnaanam theavanukku munpaakap paiththiyamaayirukki'rathu. appadiyea, gnaanika'lai avarka'ludaiya thanthiraththilea pidikki'raaren'rum,
gnaanika'ludaiya sinthanaika'l vee'naayirukki'rathen'ru karththar a'rinthirukki'raaren'rum ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
ippadiyirukka, oruvanum manusharaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattaathiruppaanaaka; ellaam ungka'ludaiyathea;
pavulaakilum, appolloavaakilum, keapaavaakilum, ulakamaakilum, jeevanaakilum mara'namaakilum, nikazhkaariyangka'laakilum, varungkaariyangka'laakilum, ellaam ungka'ludaiyathu;
neengka'l ki'risthuvinudaiyavarka'l; ki'risthu theavanudaiyavar.
ippadiyaaka, entha manushanum engka'laik ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaararen'rum, theavanudaiya irakasiyangka'lin ukkiraa'nakkaararen'rum e'n'nikko'l'lakkadavan.
mealum, ukkiraa'nakkaaran u'nmaiyu'l'lavanen'ru kaa'nappaduvathu avanukku avasiyamaam.

aayinum naan ungka'laaleayaavathu manusharudaiya niyaayanaa'lin visaara'naiyinaaleayaavathu theerppaip pe'ruvathu enakku mikavum a'rpa kaariyamaayirukki'rathu; naanum ennaikku'riththuth theerppuchsolluki'rathillai.
ennidaththil naan yaathoru kut'raththaiyum a'riyean; aakilum athinaalea naan neethimaanaaki'rathillai; ennai niyaayam visaarikki'ravar karththarea.

aanathaal, karththar varuma'lavum neengka'l kaalaththukkumunnea yaathon'raikku'riththum theerppuchsollaathirungka'l; iru'lil ma'rainthirukki'ravaika'lai avar ve'liyarangkamaakki, iruthayangka'lin yoasanaika'laiyum ve'lippaduththuvaar; appozhuthu avanavanukkuriya pukazhchchi theavanaal u'ndaakum.

sakoathararea, ezhuthappattatha'rku mignchi e'n'navea'ndaamen'ru neengka'l engka'laalea kat'rukko'l'lavum, oruvanum oruvanimiththam mat'roruvanukku viroathamaay i'rumaappadaiyaathirukkavum, naan ungka'lnimiththam ennaiyum appolloavaiyum thirushdaanthamaaka vaiththu, ivaika'lai ezhuthinean.

an'riyum unnai viseashiththavanaakumpadi seyki'ravar yaar? unakku u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lil nee pet'rukko'l'laathathu yaathu? nee pet'rukko'ndavanaanaal pet'rukko'l'laathavanpoal ean meanmaipaaraattuki'raay?

ippozhuthu thirupthiyadainthirukki'reerka'lea, ippozhuthu aisuvariyavaanka'laayirukki'reerka'lea, engka'laiyallaamal aa'luki'reerka'lea; neengka'l aa'luki'ravarka'laanaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu ungka'ludaneakooda naangka'lum aa'luvoamea.

engka'lukkuth thoan'ruki'rapadi theavan appoasthalarka'laakiya engka'lai mara'naththukkuk ku'rikkappattavarka'lpoalak kadaisiyaanavarka'laayk kaa'nappadappa'n'ninaar; naangka'l ulakaththukkum thootharukkum manusharukkum veadikkaiyaanoam.
naangka'l ki'risthuvinimiththam paiththiyakkaarar, neengka'l ki'risthuvil puththisaalika'l; naangka'l palaveenar, neengka'l palavaanka'l; neengka'l kanavaanka'l, naangka'l kanaveenar.
innearamvaraikkum pasiyu'l'lavarka'lum, thaakamu'l'lavarka'lum, nirvaa'nika'lum, kuttu'ndavarka'lum, thangka idamillaathavarka'lumaayirukki'roam.
engka'l kaika'linaalea vealaiseythu, paadupaduki'roam; vaiyappattu, aaseervathikki'roam; thunpappattu, sakikki'roam.
thooshikkappattu, vea'ndikko'l'luki'roam; innaa'lvaraikkum ulakaththin kuppaiyaippoalavum, ellaarum thudaiththuppoaduki'ra azhukkaippoalavumaanoam.
ungka'lai vedkappaduththumpadikku naan ivaika'lai ezhuthavillai, neengka'l enakkup piriyamaana pi'l'laika'len'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.
ki'risthuvukku'l pathinaayiram upaaththiyaayarka'l ungka'lukku irunthaalum, thakappanmaar aneakar ungka'lukku illaiyea; ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l suviseashaththinaal naan ungka'laip pet'rean.
aakaiyaal, ennaip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laakungka'len'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.

ithinimiththamaaka, enakkup piriyamum, karththarukku'l u'nmaiyumu'l'la en kumaaranaakiya theemoaththeayuvai ungka'lidaththil anuppinean; naan engkum enthach sapaiyilum poathiththuvaruki'rapirakaaram ki'risthuvukku'l'laana en nadakkaika'lai avan ungka'lukku gnaapakappaduththuvaan.
naan ungka'lidaththi'rku varuki'rathillai enki'rathaakach silar i'rumaappadainthirukki'raarka'l.
aakilum karththarukkuch siththamaanaal naan seekkiramaay ungka'lidaththi'rku vanthu, i'rumaappadainthirukki'ravarka'ludaiya peachchaiyalla, avarka'ludaiya pelaththaiyea a'rinthuko'lvean.
theavanudaiya raajyam peachchilea alla, pelaththilea u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
ungka'lukku ennavea'ndum? naan pirampoadu ungka'lidaththil varavea'ndumoa? allathu anpoadum saanthamu'l'la aaviyoadum varavea'ndumoa?

ungka'lukku'l'lea vipasaaram u'nden'ru pirasiththamaaych sollappaduki'rathea; oruvan than thakappanudaiya manaiviyai vaiththukko'ndirukki'raanea; athu agngnaanika'lukku'l'lum sollappadaatha vipasaaramaayirukki'rathea.
ippadippatta kaariyagnseythavanai neengka'l ungka'laivittu neekkaamalum thukkappadaamalum, i'rumaappadainthirukki'reerka'l.
naan sareeraththinaalea ungka'lukkuth thooramaayirunthum, aaviyinaalea ungka'loadeakooda irukki'ravanaay, ippadich seythavanaikku'riththu naan kooda irukki'rathupoala,
neengka'lum, ennudaiya aaviyum, namathu karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin athikaaraththoadea koodivanthirukkaiyil,

appadippattavanudaiya aavi karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naa'lilea iradchikkappadumpadi, maamsaththin azhivukkaaka, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea avanaich saaththaanukku oppukkodukkavea'ndumen'ru theerppuchseyki'rean.
neengka'l meanmaipaaraattuki'rathu nallathalla; kogncham pu'liththamaa pisainthamaa muzhuvathaiyum pu'lippaakkumen'ru a'riyeerka'laa?

aakaiyaal, neengka'l pu'lippillaathavarka'laayirukki'rapadiyea, puthithaayp pisaintha maavaayirukkumpadikku, pazhaiya pu'liththamaavaip pu'rampea kazhiththuppoadungka'l. eanenil nammudaiya paskaavaakiya ki'risthu namakkaakap paliyidappattirukki'raarea.
aathalaal pazhaiya pu'liththamaavoadea alla, thurkku'nam pollaappu ennum pu'liththamaavoadum alla, thuppuravu u'nmai ennum pu'lippillaatha appaththoadea pa'ndikaiyai aasarikkakkadavoam.
vipasaarakkaararoadea kalanthirukkakkoodaathen'ru nirupaththil ungka'lukku ezhuthinean.

aanaalum, ivvulakaththilu'l'la vipasaarakkaarar, poru'laasaikkaarar, ko'l'laikkaarar, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaarar ivarka'loadu evva'lavum kalanthirukkakkoodaathen'ru naan ezhuthavillai; appadiyaanaal neengka'l ulakaththaivittu neengkippoakavea'ndiyathaayirukkumea.

naan ungka'lukku ezhuthinathennaven'raal, sakoatharanennappatta oruvan vipasaarakkaaranaayaavathu, poru'laasaikkaaranaayaavathu, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaaranaayaavathu, uthaasinanaayaavathu, ve'riyanaayaavathu, ko'l'laikkaaranaayaavathu irunthaal, avanoadea kalanthirukkakkoodaathu; appadippattavanudaneakoodap pusikkavungkoodaathu.
pu'rampea irukki'ravarka'laik ku'riththuth theerppuchseyki'rathu en kaariyamaa? u'l'lea irukki'ravarka'laik ku'riththallavoa neengka'l theerppuchseyki'reerka'l?
pu'rampea irukki'ravarka'laik ku'riththuth theavanea theerppuchseyvaar. aakaiyaal anthap pollaathavanai ungka'laivittuth tha'l'lippoadungka'l.
ungka'lil oruvanukku vea'roruvanoadea vazhakku'ndaanaal, vazhakkaadumpadi avan parisuththavaanka'lidaththil poakaamal, aneethakkaararidaththil poakath thu'niki'rathenna?
parisuththavaanka'l ulakaththai niyaayantheerppaarka'len'ru a'riyeerka'laa? ulakam ungka'laal niyaayantheerkkappaduvathaayirukka, a'rpa vazhakkuka'laith theerkka neengka'l apaaththiraraa?
theava thootharka'laiyum niyaayantheerppoamen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? appadiyirukka, intha jeevanukkeat'ravaika'lai neengka'l theerththukko'l'lakkoodaathirukki'rathu eppadi?
intha jeevanukkeat'ra vazhakkuka'l ungka'lukku irunthaal, theerppuchseyki'ratha'rku, sapaiyil a'rpamaay e'n'nappattavarka'lai niyamiththukko'l'lungka'l.
ungka'lukku vedkam u'ndaakumpadi ithaich solluki'rean. sakoatharanukkum sakoatharanukkum u'ndaana vazhakkaith theerkkaththakka viveaki oruvanaakilum ungka'lukku'l illaiyaa?
sakoatharanoadea sakoatharan vazhakkaaduki'raan, avisuvaasika'lukku munpaakavum appadich seyki'raan.

neengka'l oruvaroadoruvar vazhakkaaduki'rathu evvithaththilum kut'ramaayirukki'rathu. appadich seyki'rathaivida neengka'l ean aniyaayaththaich sakiththukko'l'luki'rathillai, ean nashdaththaip po'ruththukko'l'luki'rathillai?
neengka'lea aniyaayagnseyki'reerka'l, nashdappaduththuki'reerka'l; sakoathararukkum appadich seyki'reerka'lea.

aniyaayakkaarar theavanudaiya raajyaththaich suthantharippathillaiyen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? vagnchikkappadaathirungka'l; veasimaarkkaththaarum, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaararum, vipasaarakkaararum, suyapu'narchchikkaararum, aa'npu'narchchikkaararum,
thirudarum, poru'laasaikkaararum, ve'riyarum, uthaasinarum, ko'l'laikkaararum theavanudaiya raajyaththaich suthantharippathillai.

ungka'lil silar ippadippattavarka'laayiruntheerka'l; aayinum karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalum, namathu theavanudaiya aaviyinaalum kazhuvappatteerka'l, parisuththamaakkappatteerka'l, neethimaanka'laakkappatteerka'l.
ellaavat'raiyum anupavikka enakku athikaaramu'ndu, aakilum ellaam thakuthiyaayiraathu; ellaavat'raiyum anupavikka enakku athikaaramu'ndu, aakilum naan on'ri'rkum adimaippadamaattean.

vayit'rukkup poajanamum poajanaththukku vayi'rum ea'rkum; aanaalum theavan ithaiyum athaiyum azhiyappa'n'nuvaar. sareeramoa veasiththanaththi'rkalla, karththarukkea uriyathu; karththarum sareeraththi'rku uriyavar.
theavan karththarai ezhuppinaarea, nammaiyum thamathu vallamaiyinaalea ezhuppuvaar.
ungka'l sareerangka'l ki'risthuvin avayavangka'len'ru a'riyeerka'laa? appadiyirukka, naan ki'risthuvin avayavangka'lai veasiyin avayavangka'laakkalaamaa? appadich seyyalaakaathea.
veasiyoadu isainthirukki'ravan ava'ludanea orea sareeramaayirukki'raanen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? iruvarum orea maamsamaayiruppaarka'l en'ru solliyirukki'rathea.
appadiyea karththaroadisainthirukki'ravanum, avarudanea orea aaviyaayirukki'raan.
veasiththanaththi'rku vilakiyoadungka'l. manushan seyki'ra enthap paavamum sareeraththi'rkup pu'rampaayirukkum; veasiththanagn seyki'ravanoa than suyasareeraththi'rku viroathamaayp paavagnseyki'raan.
ungka'l sareeramaanathu neengka'l theavanaalea pet'rum ungka'lil thangkiyum irukki'ra parisuththa aaviyinudaiya aalayamaayirukki'rathen'rum, neengka'l ungka'ludaiyavarka'lallaven'rum a'riyeerka'laa?
kirayaththukkuk ko'l'lappatteerka'lea; aakaiyaal theavanukku udaiyavaika'laakiya ungka'l sareeraththinaalum ungka'l aaviyinaalum theavanai makimaippaduththungka'l.
neengka'l enakku ezhuthina kaariyangka'laikku'riththu naan ezhuthuki'rathennaven'raal, sthireeyaith thodaamalirukki'rathu manushanukku nallathu.
aakilum veasiththanam iraathapadikku avanavan than sontha manaiviyaiyum, ava'lava'l than sonthap purushanaiyum udaiyavarka'laayirukkavea'ndum.
purushan than manaivikkuch seyyavea'ndiya kadamaiyaich seyyakkadavan; appadiyea manaiviyum than purushanukkuch seyyakkadava'l.
manaiviyaanava'l than suyasareeraththi'rku athikaariyalla, purushanea atha'rku athikaari; appadiyea purushanum than suyasareeraththi'rku athikaariyalla, manaiviyea atha'rku athikaari.

upavaasaththi'rkum jepaththi'rkum thadaiyiraathapadikku iruvarum silakaalam pirinthirukkavea'ndumen'ru sammathiththaalan'ri, oruvaraivittu oruvar piriyaathirungka'l; ungka'lukku virathaththuvam illaamaiyaal saaththaan ungka'laith thoo'ndividaathapadikku, ma'rupadiyum koodi vaazhungka'l.
ithai naan katta'laiyaakach sollaamal, yoasanaiyaakach solluki'rean.

ellaa manusharum ennaippoalavea irukka virumpuki'rean. aakilum avanavanukkuth theavanaal aru'lappatta avanavanukkuriya varamu'ndu; athu oruvanukku oruvithamaayum, mat'roruvanukku vea'ruvithamaayum irukki'rathu.
vivaakamillaathavarka'laiyum, kaimpe'nka'laiyumku'riththu naan solluki'rathu ennaven'raal, avarka'l ennaippoala irunthuvittaal avarka'lukku nalamaayirukkum.
aakilum avarka'l viraththaraayirukkakkoodaathirunthaal vivaakampa'n'nakkadavarka'l; veaki'rathaippaarkkilum vivaakampa'n'nuki'rathu nalam.
vivaakampa'n'nikko'ndavarka'lukku naanalla, karththarea katta'laiyiduki'rathaavathu: manaiviyaanava'l than purushanai vittup pirinthupoakakkoodaathu.
pirinthupoanaal ava'l vivaakamillaathirukkakkadava'l, allathu purushanoadea oppuravaakakkadava'l; purushanum than manaiviyaith tha'l'lividakkoodaathu.

mat'ravarka'laikku'riththuk karththar alla, naanea solluki'rathaavathu: sakoatharanoruvanudaiya manaivi avisuvaasiyaayirunthum, avanudanea vaasamaayirukka ava'lukkuch sammathamirunthaal, avan ava'laith tha'l'lividaathirukkakkadavan.
appadiyea oru sthireeyinudaiya purushan avisuvaasiyaayirunthum, ava'ludanea vaasamaayirukka avanukkuch sammathamirunthaal, ava'l avanaith tha'l'lividaathirukkakkadava'l.

ennaththinaalenil, avisuvaasiyaana purushan than manaiviyaal parisuththamaakkappaduki'raan; avisuvaasiyaana manaiviyum than purushanaal parisuththamaakkappaduki'raa'l. illaavittaal ungka'l pi'l'laika'l asuththamaayirukkumea; ippozhuthoa avaika'l parisuththamaayirukkin'rana.

aakilum avisuvaasi pirinthupoanaal pirinthupoakattum, ippadippatta vishayaththil, sakoatharanaavathu sakoathariyaavathu adimaippattavarka'lalla. samaathaanamaayirukkumpadikkea theavan nammai azhaiththirukki'raar.
manaiviyaanava'lea, nee un purushanai iradchippaayoa allavoa unakku eppadith theriyum? purushanea, nee un manaiviyai iradchippaayoa allavoa unakku eppadith theriyum?
theavan avanavanukkup pakirnthatheppadiyoa, karththar avanavanai azhaiththatheppadiyoa, appadiyea avanavan nadakkakkadavan. ellaach sapaika'lileayum ippadiyea thittampa'n'nuki'rean.

oruvan viruththaseathanam pet'ravanaay azhaikkappattirunthaal, viruththaseathanamillaathavanaayirukka vakaitheadaanaaka; oruvan viruththaseathanamillaathavanaay azhaikkappattirunthaal, viruththaseathanam pe'raathiruppaanaaka.
viruththaseathanamum on'rumillai, viruththaseathanamillaamaiyum on'rumillai; theavanudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'rathea kaariyam.
avanavan thaan azhaikkappatta nilaimaiyilea nilaiththirukkakkadavan.
adimaiyaay nee azhaikkappattirunthaal, kavalaippadaathea; nee suyaatheenanaakakkoodumaanaal athai nalamen'ru anusariththukko'l.
karththarukku'l azhaikkappatta adimaiyaanavan karththarudaiya suyaatheenanaayirukki'raan; appadiyea azhaikkappatta suyaatheenan ki'risthuvinudaiya adimaiyaayirukki'raan.
neengka'l kirayaththukkuk ko'l'lappatteerka'l; manusharukku adimaika'laakaathirungka'l.
sakoathararea, avanavan thaan azhaikkappatta nilaimaiyilea theavanukku munpaaka nilaiththirukkakkadavan.

an'riyum kannikaika'laikku'riththu, karththaraal enakkuk katta'lai illai. aakilum naan u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'ratha'rkuk karththaraal irakkampet'ru, en apippiraayaththaith theriyappaduththuki'rean.
athennavenil, ippozhuthu u'ndaayirukki'ra thunpaththinimiththam vivaakamillaamalirukki'rathu manushanukku nalamaayirukkumen'ru e'n'nuki'rean.
nee manaiviyoadea kattappattirunthaal, avizhkkappada vakaitheadaathea; nee manaivi illaathavanaayirunthaal, manaiviyaith theadaathea.

nee vivaakampa'n'ninaalum paavamalla; kannikai vivaakampa'n'ninaalum paavamalla. aakilum appadippattavarka'l sareeraththilea upaththiravappaduvaarka'l; atha'rku neengka'l thappavea'ndumen'rirukki'rean.
mealum, sakoathararea, naan solluki'rathennavenil, inivarum kaalam ku'rukinathaanapadiyaal, manaivika'lu'l'lavarka'l manaivika'lillaathavarka'lpoalavum,
azhuki'ravarka'l azhaathavarka'lpoalavum, santhoashappaduki'ravarka'l santhoashappadaathavarka'lpoalavum, ko'l'luki'ravarka'l ko'l'laathavarka'lpoalavum,
ivvulakaththai anupavikki'ravarka'l athaith thakaathavithamaay anupaviyaathavarka'lpoalavum irukkavea'ndum; ivvulakaththin veasham kadanthupoaki'rathea.
neengka'l kavalaiyat'ravarka'laayirukka virumpuki'rean. vivaakamillaathavan karththarukku eppadip piriyamaayirukkalaamen'ru, karththarukkuriyavaika'lukkaakak kavalaippaduki'raan.
vivaakampa'n'ninavan than manaivikku eppadip piriyamaayirukkalaamen'ru, ulakaththi'rkuriyavaika'lukkaakak kavalaippaduki'raan.

athupoala, manaiviyaanava'lukkum kannikaikkum viththiyaasamu'ndu. vivaakamillaathava'l sareeraththilum aaththumaavilum parisuththamaayirukkumpadi, karththarukkuriyavaika'lukkaakak kavalaippaduki'raa'l; vivaakampa'n'ninava'l than purushanukku eppadip piriyamaayirukkalaamen'ru, ulakaththi'rkuriyavaika'lukkaakak kavalaippaduki'raa'l.

ithai naan ungka'laik ka'n'niyil akappaduththavea'ndumen'ru sollaamal, ungka'lukkuth thakuthiyaayirukkumen'rum, neengka'l kavalaiyillaamal karththaraip pat'rikko'ndirukkavea'ndumen'rum, ungka'l suyapirayoajanaththukkaakavea solluki'rean.

aakilum oruvan than puththiriyin kannikaipparuvam kadanthupoanathinaalea, ava'l vivaakampa'n'naamaliruppathu ava'lukkuth thakuthiyallaven'rum, ava'l vivaakampa'n'nuvathu avasiyamen'rum ninaiththaal, avan than manathinpadi seyyakkadavan; athu paavamalla, vivaakampa'n'nattum.

aayinum atha'rku avasiyaththaik kaa'naamal, than iruthayaththilea u'ruthiyu'l'lavanaayum, suyasiththaththinpadi seyya athikaaramu'l'lavanaayumirunthu, than puththiriyin kannikaip paruvaththaik kaakkavea'ndumen'ru than iruthayaththil theermaanikki'ravan nanmaiseyki'raan.
ippadiyirukka, ava'lai vivaakampa'n'nik kodukki'ravanum nanmaiseyki'raan; kodaamalirukki'ravanum athika nanmaiseyki'raan.

manaiviyaanava'l than purushan uyiroadirukkung kaalama'lavum piramaa'naththinaal kattappattirukki'raa'l; than purushan mariththapinpu thanakku ishdamaanavanaayum karththarukkudpattavanaayumirukki'ra evanaiyaakilum vivaakampa'n'nikko'l'la viduthalaiyaayirukki'raa'l.
aakilum ennudaiya apippiraayaththinpadi ava'l appadiyea irunthuvittaal paakkiyavathiyaayiruppaa'l. ennidaththilum theavanudaiya aavi u'nden'ru e'n'nuki'rean.
vikkirakangka'lukkup padaikkappattavaika'laikku'riththa vishayaththil, nammellaarukkum a'rivu u'nden'ru namakkuth theriyumea. a'rivu i'rumaappai u'ndaakkum, anpoa pakthiviruththiyai u'ndaakkum.
oruvan thaan eatheanum on'rai a'rinthavanen'ru e'n'nikko'lvaanaanaal, on'raiyum a'riyavea'ndiyapirakaaramaaka avan innum a'riyavillai.
theavanil anpukooruki'ravanevanoa, avan theavanaal a'riyappattirukki'raan.
vikkirakangka'lukkup padaikkappattavaika'laip pusikki'ra vishayaththaippat'ri, ulakaththilea vikkirakamaanathu on'rumillaiyen'rum oruvareayan'ri vea'roru theavan illaiyen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.
vaanaththileayum poomiyileayum theavarka'l ennappaduki'ravarka'l u'ndu; ippadi aneaka theavarka'lum aneaka karththaakka'lum u'ndaayirunthaalum,

pithaavaakiya orea theavan namakku'ndu, avaraalea sakalamum u'ndaayirukki'rathu; avarukken'ru naamum u'ndaayirukki'roam. iyeasuki'risthu ennum orea karththarum namakku'ndu; avarmoolamaaych sakalamum u'ndaayirukki'rathu, avar moolamaay naamum u'ndaayirukki'roam.

aakilum, intha a'rivu ellaaridaththilum illai. silar in'raiyavaraikkum vikkirakaththai oru poru'len'ru e'n'ni, vikkirakaththukkup padaikkappattathaip pusikki'raarka'l; avarka'ludaiya manachsaadchi palaveenamaayiruppathaal asusippaduki'rathu.
poajanamaanathu nammaith theavanukku ukanthavarka'laakkamaattaathu; ennaththinaalenil, pusippathinaal namakku oru meanmaiyumillai, pusiyaathiruppathinaal namakku oru ku'raivumillai.
aakilum ithaikku'riththu ungka'lukku u'ndaayirukki'ra athikaaram evvithaththilum palaveenarukkuth thadukkalaakaathapadikkup paarungka'l.

eppadiyenil, a'rivu'l'lavanaakiya unnai vikkirakakkoavililea panthiyirukka oruvan ka'ndaal, palaveenanaayirukki'ra avanudaiya manachsaadchi vikkirakangka'lukkup padaikkappattavaika'laip pusippatha'rkuth thu'nivuko'l'lumallavaa?
palaveenamu'l'la sakoatharan un a'rivinimiththam kettuppoakalaamaa? avanukkaakak ki'risthu mariththaarea.
ippadich sakoathararukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, palaveenamu'l'la avarka'ludaiya manachsaadchiyaip pu'npaduththuki'rathinaalea, neengka'l ki'risthuvukku viroathamaayp paavagnseyki'reerka'l.
aathalaal poajanam en sakoatharanukku ida'ralu'ndaakkinaal, naan en sakoatharanukku ida'ralu'ndaakkaathapadikku, en'raikkum maamsam pusiyaathiruppean.
naan appoasthalanallavaa? naan suyaatheenanallavaa? nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai naan tharisikkavillaiyaa? karththarukku'l neengka'l en kiriyaiyaayirukki'reerka'lallavaa?
naan mat'ravarka'lukku appoasthalanaayiraavittaalum, ungka'lukkallavoa appoasthalanaayirukki'rean; karththarukku'l neengka'l en appoasthala oozhiyaththi'rku muththiraiyaayirukki'reerka'lea.
ennai niyaayam visaarikki'ravarka'lukku naan solluki'ra maa'ruththaramaavathu:
pusikkavum kudikkavum engka'lukku athikaaramillaiyaa?
mat'ra appoasthalarum, karththarudaiya sakoathararum, keapaavum seyki'rathupoala, manaiviyaakiya oru sakoathariyaik koottikko'ndu thiriya engka'lukkum athikaaramillaiyaa?
allathu, kaiththozhil seyyaathirukki'ratha'rku enakkum parnapaavukkummaaththiranthaanaa athikaaramillai?

evan than sonthappa'naththaich selavazhiththu, tha'ndilea seavakampa'n'nuvaan? evan thiraadchaththoattaththai u'ndaakki, athin kaniyil pusiyaathiruppaan? evan manthaiyai meayththu, athin paalaich saappidaathiruppaan?
ivaika'lai manushar vazhakkaththinpadi solluki'reanoa? niyaayappiramaa'namum ivaika'laich solluki'rathillaiyaa?
poaradikki'ra maattai vaaykattaayaaka en'ru moaseayin piramaa'naththilea ezhuthiyirukki'rathea. theavan maaduka'lukkaakavea kavalaiyaayirukki'raaroa?

namakkaakaththaan ithaich solluki'raaroa? uzhuki'ravan nampikkaiyoadea uzhavum, poaradikki'ravan thaan nampuki'rathil pangkadaivean enki'ra nampikkaiyoadea poaradikkavum vea'ndiyathea, aakaiyaal, athu namakkaakavea ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
naangka'l ungka'lukku gnaanananmaika'lai vithaiththirukka, ungka'l sareerananmaika'lai a'ruththaal athu periya kaariyamaa?

mat'ravarka'l ungka'lidaththilea intha athikaaraththaich seluththinaal, avarka'lilum naangka'l athikamaaych seluththalaamallavaa? appadiyirunthum, ki'risthuvin suviseashaththi'rku yaathoru thadaiyum u'ndaakaathapadikku, naangka'l intha athikaaraththaich seluththaamal ellaap paadum paduki'roam.

aasaariya oozhiyagnseyki'ravarka'l theavaalayaththi'rkuriyavaika'lil pusikki'raarka'len'rum, palipeedaththai aduththup pa'nividai seyki'ravarka'lukkup palipeedaththilu'l'lavaika'lil pangku u'nden'rum a'riyeerka'laa?
anthappadiyea suviseashaththai a'rivikki'ravarka'lukkuch suviseashaththinaalea pizhaippu u'ndaakavea'ndumen'ru karththarum katta'laiyittirukki'raar.

appadiyirunthum, naan ivaika'lil on'raiyum anupavikkavillai; ippadi enakku nadakkavea'ndumen'ru ivaika'lai naan ezhuthuki'rathumillai. en meanmaipaaraattalai oruvan avaththamaakkuki'rathaippaarkkilum saaki'rathu enakku nalamaayirukkum.
suviseashaththai naan pirasangkiththuvanthum, meanmaipaaraatta enakku idamillai; athu enmeal vizhuntha kadamaiyaayirukki'rathu; suviseashaththai naan pirasangkiyaathirunthaal, enakku aiyoa.
naan u'rchaakamaay appadich seythaal enakkup palan u'ndu; u'rchaakamillaathavanaaych seythaalum, ukkiraa'na uththiyoakam enakku oppuvikkappattirukki'rathea.

aathalaal enakkup palan enna? naan suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkaiyil athaippat'ri enakku u'ndaayirukki'ra athikaaraththai mut'rilum seluththaamal, ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaich selavillaamal sthaapippathea enakkup palan.
naan oruvarukkum adimaippadaathavanaayirunthum, naan athika janangka'lai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikku, ennaiththaanea ellaarukkum adimaiyaakkinean.

yootharai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikku yootharukku yoothanaippoalavum, niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuk keezhppattavarka'lai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikku niyaayappiramaa'naththukkuk keezhppattavanaip poalavumaanean.

niyaayappiramaa'namillaathavarka'lai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikku avarka'lukku niyaayappiramaa'nam illaathavanaip poalavumaanean. appadiyirunthum, naan theavanukkumunpaaka niyaayappiramaa'namillaathavanaayiraamal, ki'risthuvin piramaa'naththukku'l'laanavanaayirukki'rean.
palaveenarai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikkup palaveenarukkup palaveenanaippoalaanean; eppadiyaakilum silarai iradchikkumpadikku naan ellaarukkum ellaamaanean.
suviseashaththil naan udanpangkaa'liyaakumpadikku, athinimiththamea ippadich seyki'rean.
panthayach saalaiyil oaduki'ravarka'lellaarum oaduvaarka'l; aakilum, oruvanea panthayaththaip pe'ruvaanen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? neengka'l pet'rukko'l'laththakkathaaka oadungka'l.

panthayaththi'rkup poaraaduki'ra yaavarum ellaavat'rileayum ichchaiyadakkamaayiruppaarka'l. avarka'l azhivu'l'la kireedaththaip pe'rumpadikku appadich seyki'raarka'l, naamoa azhivillaatha kireedaththaip pe'rumpadikku appadich seyki'roam.
aathalaal naan nichchayamillaathavanaaka oadean; aakaayaththai adikki'ravanaakach silampampa'n'nean.
mat'ravarka'lukkup pirasangkampa'n'nuki'ra naanthaanea aakaathavanaayp poakaathapadikku, en sareeraththai odukkik keezhppaduththuki'rean.

ippadiyirukka, sakoathararea, neengka'l evaika'lai a'riyavea'ndumen'rirukki'reanen'raal; nammudaiya pithaakka'lellaarum meakaththukkuk keezhaayirunthaarka'l, ellaarum samuththiraththin vazhiyaay nadanthuvanthaarka'l.
ellaarum moaseakku'l'laaka meakaththinaalum samuththiraththinaalum gnaanasnaanampa'n'nappattaarka'l.
ellaarum orea gnaanapoajanaththaip pusiththaarka'l.
ellaarum orea gnaanapaanaththaik kudiththaarka'l. eppadiyenil, avarka'loadeakoodach sen'ra gnaanakkanmalaiyin tha'n'neeraik kudiththaarka'l; anthak kanmalai ki'risthuvea.
appadiyirunthum, avarka'lil athikamaanapearka'lidaththil theavan piriyamaayirunthathillai; aathalaal vanaantharaththilea avarka'l azhikkappattaarka'l.
avarka'l ichchiththathupoala naamum pollaangkaanavaika'lai ichchiyaathapadikku, ivaika'l namakkuth thirushdaanthangka'laayirukki'rathu.
janangka'l pusikkavum kudikkavum udkaarnthu, vi'laiyaada ezhunthaarka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, avarka'lil silar vikkirakaaraathanaikkaarar aanathupoala neengka'lum aakaathirungka'l.
avarka'lil silar veasiththanampa'n'ni, oreanaa'lil irupaththumoovaayirampear vizhunthupoanaarka'l; athupoala naamum veasiththanampa'n'naathiruppoamaaka.
avarka'lil silar ki'risthuvaip pareedchaipaarththu, paampuka'laal azhikkappattaarka'l; athupoala naamum ki'risthuvaip pareedchaipaaraathiruppoamaaka.
avarka'lil silar mu'rumu'ruththu, sangkaarakkaaranaalea azhikkappattaarka'l; athupoala neengka'lum mu'rumu'rukkaathirungka'l.
ivaika'lellaam thirushdaanthangka'laaka avarka'lukkuch sampaviththathu; ulakaththin mudivukaalaththilu'l'la namakku echcharippu'ndaakkumpadi ezhuthappattum irukki'rathu.
ippadiyirukka, thannai ni'rki'ravanen'ru e'n'nuki'ravan vizhaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirukkakkadavan.

manusharukku neariduki'ra soathanaiyeayallaamal vea'rea soathanai ungka'lukku nearidavillai. theavan u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar; ungka'l thiraa'nikku mealaaka neengka'l soathikkappaduki'ratha'rku avar idangkodaamal, soathanaiyaith thaangkaththakkathaaka, soathanaiyoadukooda atha'rkuth thappikko'l'lumpadiyaana poakkaiyum u'ndaakkuvaar.
aakaiyaal enakkup piriyamaanavarka'lea, vikkirakaaraathanaikku vilaki oadungka'l.
ungka'laip puththimaanka'len'ru e'n'nip peasuki'rean; naan solluki'rathai neengka'lea nithaaniththuppaarungka'l.

naam aaseervathikki'ra aaseervaathaththin paaththiram ki'risthuvinudaiya iraththaththin aikkiyamaayirukki'rathallavaa? naam pidki'ra appam ki'risthuvinudaiya sareeraththin aikkiyamaayirukki'rathallavaa?
antha orea appaththil naamellaarum pangkupe'ruki'rapadiyaal, aneakaraana naam orea appamum orea sareeramumaayirukki'roam.
maamsaththinpadiyaana isravealaraip paarungka'l; palika'laip pusikki'ravarka'l palipeedaththoadea aikkiyamaayirukki'raarka'lallavaa?
ippadiyirukka, vikkirakam oru poru'len'rum, vikkirakaththukkup padaikkappattathu oru poru'len'rum naan solluki'reanoa?
agngnaanika'l paliyiduki'ravaika'lai theavanukku alla, peayka'lukkea paliyiduki'raarka'len'ru solluki'rean; neengka'l peayka'loadea aikkiyamaayirukka enakku manathillai.

neengka'l karththarudaiya paaththiraththilum peayka'ludaiya paaththiraththilum paanampa'n'nakkoodaathea; neengka'l karththarudaiya poajanapanthikkum peayka'ludaiya poajanapanthikkum pangku'l'lavarka'laayirukkakkoodaathea.
naam karththarukku erichchalai moottalaamaa? avarilum naam palavaanka'laa?
ellaavat'raiyum anupavikka enakku athikaaramu'ndu, aakilum ellaam thakuthiyaayiraathu; ellaavat'raiyum anupavikka enakku athikaaramu'ndu, aakilum ellaam pakthiviruththiyai u'ndaakkaathu.
ovvoruvanum than suyapirayoajanaththaith theadaamal, pi'ranudaiya pirayoajanaththaith theadakkadavan.
kadaiyilea vi'rkappaduki'ra ethaiyum vaangkip pusiyungka'l; manachsaadchiyinimiththam neengka'l on'raiyum visaarikkavea'ndiyathillai.
poomiyum athin ni'raivum karththarudaiyathu.

an'riyum avisuvaasika'lil oruvan ungka'lai virunthukku azhaikkumpoathu, poaka ungka'lukku manathirunthaal, manachsaadchiyinimiththam on'raiyum visaariyaamal, ungka'l mun vaikkappaduki'ra ethaiyum pusiyungka'l.

aayinum ithu vikkirakangka'lukkup padaikkappattathen'ru oruvan ungka'lukkuch sonnaal, appadi a'riviththavanimiththamum manachsaadchiyinimiththamum pusiyaathirungka'l; poomiyum athin ni'raivum karththarudaiyathu.

unnudaiya manachsaadchiyaik ku'riththu naan ippadich sollaamal, mat'roruvanudaiya manachsaadchiyaik ku'riththea solluki'rean. en suyaatheenam mat'roruvanudaiya manachsaadchiyinaalea kut'ramaay e'n'nappadavea'nduvathenna?
mealum naan athai sthoaththirippudanea anupaviththaal, sthoaththiriththu anupavikki'ra poru'laikku'riththu naan thooshikkappaduvaanean?
aakaiyaal neengka'l pusiththaalum, kudiththaalum, ethaich seythaalum, ellaavat'raiyum theavanudaiya makimaikken'ru seyyungka'l.
naan en suyapirayoajanaththaith theadaamal, aneakarudaiya pirayoajanaththaith theadi, avarka'l iradchikkappadumpadikku, evvithaththilum ellaarukkum piriyamaay nadakki'rathupoala;
neengka'lum yootharukkum, kireakkarukkum, theavanudaiya sapaikkum ida'ralat'ravarka'laayirungka'l.
naan ki'risthuvaip pinpat'ruki'rathupoala, neengka'l ennaip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laayirungka'l.
sakoathararea, neengka'l ellaavat'rilum ennai ninaiththukko'ndu, naan ungka'lukku oppuviththapadi neengka'l katta'laika'laik kaikko'ndu varuki'rathinimiththam ungka'laip pukazhuki'rean.

ovvoru purushanukkum ki'risthu thalaiyaayirukki'raaren'rum, sthireekkup purushan thalaiyaayirukki'raanen'rum, ki'risthuvukkuth theavan thalaiyaayirukki'raaren'rum, neengka'l a'riyavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'rean.
jepampa'n'nuki'rapoathaavathu, theerkkatharisanagn solluki'rapoathaavathu, than thalaiyai moodikko'ndirukki'ra enthap purushanum than thalaiyaik kanaveenappaduththuki'raan.

jepampa'n'nuki'rapoathaavathu, theerkkatharisanagn solluki'rapoathaavathu, than thalaiyai moodikko'l'laathirukki'ra entha sthireeyum than thalaiyaik kanaveenappaduththuki'raa'l; athu ava'lukkuth thalai siraikkappattathupoalirukkumea.

sthireeyaanava'l mukkaadittukko'l'laavittaal thalaimayiraiyum kaththariththuppoadakkadava'l; thalaimayir kaththarikkappaduki'rathum siraikkappaduki'rathum sthireekku vedkamaanaal mukkaadittukko'ndirukkakkadava'l.
purushanaanavan theavanudaiya saayalum makimaiyumaayirukki'rapadiyaal, than thalaiyai moodikko'l'lavea'nduvathillai; sthireeyaanava'l purushanudaiya makimaiyaayirukki'raa'l.
purushan sthireeyilirunthu thoan'rinavanalla, sthireeyea purushanilirunthu thoan'rinava'l.
purushan sthireekkaakach sirushdikkappattavanalla, sthireeyea purushanukkaakach sirushdikkappattava'l.
aakaiyaal thootharka'linimiththam sthireeyaanava'l thalaiyinmeal mukkaadittukko'l'lavea'ndum.
aakilum karththarukku'l sthireeyillaamal purushanumillai, purushanillaamal sthireeyumillai.
sthireeyaanava'l purushanilirunthu thoan'ruki'rathupoala, purushanum sthireeyinaal thoan'ruki'raan; sakalamum theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
sthireeyaanava'l theavanai noakki jepampa'n'nukaiyil, than thalaiyai moodikko'l'laamalirukki'rathu iladcha'namaayirukkumoa en'ru ungka'lukku'l'lea nithaaniththukko'l'lungka'l.
purushan mayirai nee'lamaay va'larkki'rathu avanukku kanaveenamaayirukki'rathen'rum,
sthiree than mayirai nee'lamaay va'larkki'rathu ava'lukku makimaiyaayirukki'rathen'rum supaavamea ungka'lukkup poathikki'rathillaiyaa? thalaimayir ava'lukku mukkaadaakak kodukkappattirukki'rathea.
aakilum oruvan vaakkuvaathagnseyya manathaayirunthaal, engka'lukkum, theavanudaiya sapaika'lukkum, appadippatta vazhakkamillaiyen'ru a'riyakkadavan.
ungka'laip pukazhaamal ithaikku'riththu ungka'lukkuk katta'laikodukki'rean; neengka'l koodivaruthal nanmaikkeathuvaayiraamal, theemaikkeathuvaayirukki'rathea.
muthalaavathu, neengka'l sapaiyilea koodivanthirukkumpoathu, ungka'lil pirivinaika'l u'nden'ru kea'lvippaduki'rean; athil silavat'rai nampuki'rean.
ungka'lil uththamarka'l innaaren'ru ve'liyaakumpadikku maarkkapeathangka'lum ungka'lukku'l'lea u'ndaayirukkavea'ndiyathea.
neengka'l oaridaththil koodivarumpoathu, avanavan thanthan sontha poajanaththai munthich saappiduki'raan; oruvan pasiyaayirukki'raan, oruvan ve'riyaayirukki'raan.
ippadich seyki'rathu karththarudaiya iraappoajanampa'n'nuthalallavea.

pusikki'ratha'rkum kudikki'ratha'rkum ungka'lukku veeduka'l illaiyaa? theavanudaiya sapaiyai asattaipa'n'ni, illaathavarka'lai vedkappaduththuki'reerka'laa? ungka'lukku naan ennasolluvean? ithaikku'riththu ungka'laip pukazhveanoa? pukazhean.
naan ungka'lukku oppuviththathaik karththaridaththil pet'rukko'ndean; ennavenil, karththaraakiya iyeasu thaam kaattikkodukkappatta an'ru iraaththiriyilea appaththai eduththu,
sthoaththirampa'n'ni, athaip pittu: neengka'l vaangkip pusiyungka'l, ithu ungka'lukkaakap pidkappaduki'ra ennudaiya sareeramaayirukki'rathu; ennai ninaivukoorumpadi ithaich seyyungka'l en'raar.

poajanampa'n'ninapinpu, avar anthappadiyea paaththiraththaiyum eduththu: inthap paaththiram en iraththaththinaalaakiya puthiya udanpadikkaiyaayirukki'rathu; neengka'l ithaip paanampa'n'numpoathellaam ennai ninaivukoorumpadi ithaich seyyungka'l en'raar.
aakaiyaal neengka'l intha appaththaip pusiththu, inthap paaththiraththil paanampa'n'numpoathellaam karththar varuma'lavum avarudaiya mara'naththaith therivikki'reerka'l.

ippadiyirukka, evan apaaththiramaayk karththarudaiya appaththaip pusiththu, avarudaiya paaththiraththil paanampa'n'nuki'raanoa, avan karththarudaiya sareeraththaiyum iraththaththaiyum ku'riththuk kut'ramu'l'lavanaayiruppaan.
entha manushanum thannaiththaanea soathiththa'rinthu, intha appaththil pusiththu, inthap paaththiraththil paanampa'n'nakkadavan.

ennaththinaalenil, apaaththiramaayp poajanapaanampa'n'nuki'ravan, karththarudaiya sareeram innathen'ru nithaaniththu a'riyaathathinaal, thanakku aakkinaiththeerppu varumpadi poajanapaanampa'n'nuki'raan.
ithinimiththam, ungka'lil aneakar palaveenarum viyaathiyu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; aneakar niththiraiyum adainthirukki'raarka'l.
nammai naamea nithaaniththu a'rinthaal naam niyaayantheerkkappadoam.
naam niyaayantheerkkappadumpoathu ulakaththoadea aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappadaathapadikku, karththaraalea sidchikkappaduki'roam.
aakaiyaal, en sakoathararea, neengka'l poajanampa'n'nak koodivarumpoathu, oruvarukkaaka oruvar kaaththirungka'l.
neengka'l aakkinaikkeathuvaakak koodivaraathapadikku, oruvanukkup pasiyirunthaal veettilea saappidakkadavan. mat'rak kaariyangka'lai naan varumpoathu thittampa'n'nuvean.
an'riyum, sakoathararea, aavikkuriya varangka'laikku'riththu neengka'l a'riyaathirukka enakku manathillai.
neengka'l agngnaanika'laayirunthapoathu eavappattapadiyea, oomaiyaana vikkirakangka'lidaththil manathaich seluththineerka'len'ru ungka'lukkuth theriyumea.

aathalaal, theavanudaiya aaviyinaalea peasuki'ra evanum iyeasuvaich sapikkappattavanen'ru sollamaattaanen'rum, parisuththa aaviyinaaleayan'ri iyeasuvaik karththaren'ru oruvanum sollakkoodaathen'rum, ungka'lukkuth therivikki'rean.
varangka'lil viththiyaasangka'l u'ndu, aaviyaanavar oruvarea.
oozhiyangka'lileayum viththiyaasangka'l u'ndu, karththar oruvarea.
kiriyaika'lileayum viththiyaasangka'l u'ndu, ellaarukku'l'lum ellaavat'raiyum nadappikki'ra theavan oruvarea.
aaviyinudaiya anukkirakam avanavanudaiya pirayoajanaththi'rken'ru a'likkappattirukki'rathu.
eppadiyenil, oruvanukku aaviyinaalea gnaanaththaip poathikkum vasanamum, vea'roruvanukku antha aaviyinaaleayea a'rivai u'narththum vasanamum,
vea'roruvanukku antha aaviyinaaleayea visuvaasamum, vea'roruvanukku antha aaviyinaaleayea ku'namaakkum varangka'lum,

vea'roruvanukku a'rputhangka'laich seyyum sakthiyum, vea'roruvanukkuth theerkkatharisanam uraiththalum, vea'roruvanukku aavika'laip pakuththa'rithalum, vea'roruvanukkup pa'rpala paashaika'laip peasuthalum, vea'roruvanukkup paashaika'lai viyaakkiyaanampa'n'nuthalum a'likkappaduki'rathu.
ivaika'laiyellaam antha orea aaviyaanavar nadappiththu, thamathu siththaththinpadiyea avanavanukkup pakirnthukodukki'raar.

eppadiyenil, sareeram on'ru, atha'rku avayavangka'l aneakam; orea sareeraththin avayavangka'lellaam aneakamaayirunthum, sareeram on'raakaveayirukki'rathu; anthappirakaaramaakak ki'risthuvum irukki'raar.

naam yootharaayinum, kireakkaraayinum, adimaika'laayinum, suyaatheenaraayinum, ellaarum orea aaviyinaalea orea sareeraththi'rku'l'laaka gnaanasnaanampa'n'nappattu, ellaarum orea aavikku'l'laakavea thaakantheerkkappattoam.
sareeramum orea avayavamaayiraamal aneaka avayavangka'laayirukki'rathu.
kaalaanathu naan kaiyaayiraathapadiyinaalea, naan sareeraththin avayavamallaven'raal, athinaalea athu sareeraththin avayavamaayiraathoa?
kaathaanathu naan ka'n'naayiraathapadiyinaalea, naan sareeraththin avayavamallaven'raal, athinaalea athu sareeraththin avayavamaayiraathoa?
sareeram muzhuvathum ka'n'naanaal, sevi engkea? athu muzhuvathum seviyaanaal, moappam engkea?
theavan thamathu siththaththinpadi, avayavangka'l ovvon'raiyum sareeraththilea vaiththaar.
avaiyellaam orea avayavamaayirunthaal, sareeram engkea?
avayavangka'l aneakamaayirunthum, sareeram on'rea.
ka'n'naanathu kaiyaippaarththu: nee enakku vea'nduvathillaiyen'rum; thalaiyaanathu kaalka'lai noakki: neengka'l enakku vea'nduvathillaiyen'rum sollakkoodaathu.
sareera avayavangka'lil palaveenamu'l'lavaika'laayk kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'lea mikavum vea'ndiyavaika'laayirukki'rathu.
mealum, sareera avayavangka'lil kanaveenamaayk kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'lukkea athika kanaththaik kodukki'roam; nammil iladcha'namillaathavaika'lea athika alangkaaram pe'rum;
nammil iladcha'namu'l'lavaika'lukku alangkarippu vea'ndiyathillai.

sareeraththilea pirivinaiyu'ndaayiraamal, avayavangka'l on'raikku'riththu on'ru kavalaiyaayirukkumpadikku, theavan kanaththil ku'raivu'l'latha'rku athika kanaththaik koduththu, ippadich sareeraththai amaiththirukki'raar.
aathalaal oru avayavam paadupattaal ellaa avayavangka'lum koodap paadupadum; oru avayavam makimaippattaal ellaa avayavangka'lum koodach santhoashappadum.
neengka'lea ki'risthuvin sareeramaayum, thaniththaniyea avayavangka'laayumirukki'reerka'l.

theavanaanavar sapaiyilea muthalaavathu appoasthalaraiyum, ira'ndaavathu theerkkatharisika'laiyum, moon'raavathu poathakarka'laiyum, pinpu a'rputhangka'laiyum, pinpu ku'namaakkum varangka'laiyum, oozhiyangka'laiyum, aa'lukaika'laiyum, palavitha paashaika'laiyum ea'rpaduththinaar.
ellaarum appoasthalarka'laa? ellaarum theerkkatharisika'laa? ellaarum poathakarka'laa? ellaarum a'rputhangka'laich seyki'ravarka'laa?
ellaarum ku'namaakkum varangka'ludaiyavarka'laa? ellaarum anniyapaashaika'laip peasuki'raarka'laa? ellaarum viyaakkiyaanam pa'n'nuki'raarka'laa?
ippadiyirukka, mukkiyamaana varangka'lai naadungka'l; innum athika meanmaiyaana vazhiyaiyum ungka'lukkuk kaa'npikki'rean.
naan manushar paashaika'laiyum thoothar paashaika'laiyum peasinaalum, anpu enakkiraavittaal, saththamiduki'ra ve'nkalampoalavum, oasaiyiduki'ra kaiththaa'lampoalavum iruppean.

naan theerkkatharisana varaththai udaiyavanaayirunthu, sakala irakasiyangka'laiyum, sakala a'rivaiyum a'rinthaalum, malaika'laip pearkkaththakkathaakach sakala visuvaasamu'l'lavanaayirunthaalum, anpu enakkiraavittaal naan on'rumillai.
enakku u'ndaana yaavat'raiyum naan annathaanampa'n'ninaalum, en sareeraththaich sutterikkappaduvatha'rkuk koduththaalum, anpu enakkiraavittaal enakkup pirayoajanam on'rumillai.
anpu neediya saanthamum thayavumu'l'lathu; anpukkup po'raamaiyillai; anpu thannaip pukazhaathu, i'rumaappaayiraathu,
ayoakkiyamaanathaich seyyaathu, tha'rpozhivai naadaathu, sinamadaiyaathu, theengku ninaiyaathu,
aniyaayaththil santhoashappadaamal, saththiyaththil santhoashappadum.
sakalaththaiyum thaangkum, sakalaththaiyum visuvaasikkum, sakalaththaiyum nampum, sakalaththaiyum sakikkum.
anpu orukkaalum ozhiyaathu. theerkkatharisanangka'laanaalum ozhinthupoam, anniya paashaika'laanaalum oaynthupoam, a'rivaanaalum ozhinthupoam.
nammudaiya a'rivu ku'raivu'l'lathu, naam theerkkatharisanagn solluthalum ku'raivu'l'lathu.
ni'raivaanathu varumpoathu ku'raivaanathu ozhinthupoam.

naan kuzhanthaiyaayirunthapoathu kuzhanthaiyaippoalap peasinean, kuzhanthaiyaippoalach sinthiththean, kuzhanthaiyaippoala yoasiththean; naan purushanaanapoathoa kuzhanthaikkeat'ravaika'lai ozhiththuvittean.

ippozhuthu ka'n'naadiyilea nizhalaattamaayp paarkki'roam, appozhuthu mukamukamaayp paarppoam; ippozhuthu naan ku'raintha a'rivu'l'lavan, appozhuthu naan a'riyappattirukki'rapadiyea a'rinthuko'l'luvean.
ippozhuthu visuvaasam, nampikkai, anpu immoon'rum nilaiththirukki'rathu; ivaika'lil anpea periyathu.
anpai naadungka'l; gnaanavarangka'laiyum virumpungka'l; viseashamaayth theerkkatharisana varaththai virumpungka'l.

eanenil, anniyapaashaiyil peasuki'ravan, aaviyinaalea irakasiyangka'laip peasinaalum, avan peasuki'rathai oruvanum a'riyaathirukki'rapadiyinaalea, avan manusharidaththil peasaamal, theavanidaththil peasuki'raan.
theerkkatharisanagn solluki'ravanoa manusharukkup pakthiviruththiyum, puththiyum, aa'ruthalum u'ndaakaththakkathaakap peasuki'raan.
anniyapaashaiyil peasuki'ravan thanakkea pakthiviruththi u'ndaakap peasuki'raan; theerkkatharisanagnsolluki'ravanoa sapaikkup pakthiviruththi u'ndaakap peasuki'raan.

neengka'lellaarum anniyapaashaika'laip peasumpadi virumpuki'rean; aakilum, anniyapaashaika'lil peasuki'ravan sapaikkup pakthiviruththi u'ndaakumpadikku arththaththaiyum sollaavittaal, theerkkatharisanagn solluki'ravan avanilum meanmaiyu'l'lavan; aathalaal neengka'l theerkkatharisanagn solluki'ravarka'laaka vea'ndumen'ru athikamaay virumpuki'rean.

mealum, sakoathararea, naan ungka'lidaththil vanthu ungka'lukku irakasiyangka'lai ve'lippaduththuvatha'rkaavathu, a'rivu'ndaakkuvatha'rkaavathu, theerkkatharisanaththai a'rivikki'ratha'rkaavathu, poathakaththaip poathikki'ratha'rkaavathu eathuvaanathaich sollaamal, anniyapaashaika'lil peasinaal ennaalea ungka'lukkup pirayoajanam enna?

appadiyea pullaangkuzhal, surama'ndalam muthalaakiya saththamiduki'ra uyirillaatha vaaththiyangka'l thonika'lil viththiyaasam kaattaavittaal, kuzhalaalea oothappaduki'rathum, surama'ndalaththaalea vaasikkappaduki'rathum innathen'ru eppadith theriyum?
anthappadi ekkaa'lamum vi'langkaatha saththamittaal evan yuththaththi'rku aayaththampa'n'nuvaan?
athupoala, neengka'lum the'livaana peachchai naavinaal vasaniyaavittaal peasappattathu innathen'ru eppadiththeriyum? aakaayaththil peasuki'ravarka'laayiruppeerka'lea.
ulakaththilea eththanaiyoavithamaana paashaika'l u'ndaayirukki'rathu, avaika'lil on'rum arththamillaathathalla.
aayinum, paashaiyin karuththai naan a'riyaamalirunthaal, peasuki'ravanukku anniyanaayiruppean, peasuki'ravanum enakku anniyanaayiruppaan.
neengka'lum aavikkuriya varangka'lai naaduki'ravarka'laanapadiyaal, sapaikkup pakthiviruththi u'ndaakaththakkathaaka avaika'lil thea'rumpadi naadungka'l;
anthappadi anniyapaashaiyil peasuki'ravan athin arththaththaiyum sollaththakkathaaka vi'n'nappampa'n'nakkadavan.
ennaththinaalenil, naan anniyapaashaiyilea vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaal, en aavi vi'n'nappampa'n'numeayan'ri, en karuththu payanat'rathaayirukkum.
ippadiyirukka, seyyavea'nduvathenna? naan aaviyoadum vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean, karuththoadum vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean; naan aaviyoadum paaduvean, karuththoadum paaduvean.
illaavittaal, nee aaviyoadu sthoaththirampa'n'numpoathu, kallaathavan un sthoaththiraththi'rku aamen en'ru eppadich solluvaan? nee peasuki'rathu innathen'ru avan a'riyaanea.
nee nan'raay sthoaththirampa'n'nuki'raay, aakilum mat'ravan pakthiviruththiyadaiyamaattaanea.
ungka'lellaarilum naan athikamaayp paashaika'laip peasuki'rean, itha'rkaaka en theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean.

appadiyirunthum, naan sapaiyilea anniyapaashaiyil pathinaayiram vaarththaika'laip peasuki'rathilum, mat'ravarka'lai u'narththumpadi en karuththoadea ainthu vaarththaika'laip peasuki'rathea enakku athika viruppamaayirukkum.
sakoathararea, neengka'l puththiyilea kuzhanthaika'laayiraatheayungka'l; thurkku'naththilea kuzhanthaika'laayum, puththiyiloa thea'rinavarka'laayumirungka'l.
ma'rupaashaikkaararaalum, ma'ruuthaduka'laalum intha janangka'lidaththil peasuvean; aakilum avarka'l enakkuch sevikoduppathillaiyen'ru karththar solluki'raar en'ru veathaththil ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.

appadiyirukka, anniyapaashaika'l visuvaasika'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayiraamal, avisuvaasika'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayirukki'rathu; theerkkatharisanamoa avisuvaasika'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayiraamal, visuvaasika'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayirukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal, sapaiyaarellaarum eakamaayk koodivanthu, ellaarum anniyapaashaika'lilea peasikko'l'lumpoathu, kallaathavarka'laavathu, avisuvaasika'laavathu u'l'lea piraveasiththaal, avarka'l ungka'laip paiththiyam pidiththavarka'lenpaarka'lallavaa?
ellaarum theerkkatharisanagn sollukaiyil, avisuvaasiyoruvan, allathu kallaathavanoruvan, u'l'lea piraveasiththaal, avan ellaaraalum u'narththuvikkappattum, ellaaraalum nithaanikkappattum iruppaan.
avanudaiya iruthayaththin antharangkangka'lum ve'liyarangkamaakum; avan mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, theavanaippa'ninthuko'ndu, theavan meyyaay ungka'lukku'l'lea irukki'raaren'ru a'rikkaiyiduvaan.

neengka'l koodivanthirukki'rapoathu, ungka'lil oruvan sangkeetham paaduki'raan, oruvan poathakampa'n'nuki'raan, oruvan anniyapaashaiyaip peasuki'raan, oruvan irakasiyaththai ve'lippaduththuki'raan, oruvan viyaakkiyaanam pa'n'nuki'raan. sakoathararea, ithu enna? sakalamum pakthiviruththikkeathuvaakach seyyappadakkadavathu.

yaaraavathu anniyapaashaiyilea peasuki'rathu'ndaanaal, athu ira'ndupearmattil, allathu mignchinaal moon'rupearmattil adangkavum, avarka'l ovvoruvaraayp peasavum, oruvan arththaththaich sollavum vea'ndum.
arththagn solluki'ravanillaavittaal, sapaiyilea peasaamal, thanakkum theavanukkum theriyap peasakkadavan.
theerkkatharisika'l ira'ndupearaavathu moon'rupearaavathu peasalaam, mat'ravarka'l nithaanikkakkadavarka'l.
angkea udkaarnthirukki'ra mat'roruvanukku eathaakilum ve'lippaduththappattaal, munthip peasinavan peasaamalirukkakkadavan.
ellaarum ka'rki'ratha'rkum ellaarum thea'ruki'ratha'rkum, neengka'l anaivarum ovvoruvaraakath theerkkatharisanagnsollalaam.
theerkkatharisika'ludaiya aavika'l theerkkatharisika'lukku adangkiyirukki'rathea.
theavan kalakaththi'rkuth theavanaayiraamal, samaathaanaththi'rkuth theavanaayirukki'raar; parisuththavaanka'ludaiya sapaika'lellaavat'rileayum appadiyea irukki'rathu.
sapaika'lil ungka'l sthireeka'l peasaamalirukkakkadavarka'l; peasumpadikku avarka'lukku uththaravillai; avarka'l amarnthirukkavea'ndum; veathamum appadiyea solluki'rathu.
avarka'l oru kaariyaththaik kat'rukko'l'la virumpinaal, veettilea thangka'l purusharidaththil visaarikkakkadavarka'l; sthireeka'l sapaiyilea peasuki'rathu ayoakkiyamaayirukkumea.
theavavasanam ungka'lidaththilirunthaa pu'rappattathu? athu ungka'lidaththukku maaththiramaa vanthathu?
oruvan thannaith theerkkatharisiyen'raavathu, aaviyaip pet'ravanen'raavathu e'n'ninaal, naan ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'ravaika'l karththarudaiya ka'rpanaika'len'ru avan oththukko'l'lakkadavan.
oruvan a'riyaathavanaayirunthaal, avan a'riyaathavanaayirukkattum.
ippadiyirukka, sakoathararea, theerkkatharisanagnsolla naadungka'l, anniya paashaika'laip peasuki'ratha'rkum thadaipa'n'naathirungka'l.
sakalamum nallozhukkamaayum kiramamaayum seyyappadakkadavathu.
an'riyum, sakoathararea, naan ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththa suviseashaththai ma'rupadiyum ungka'lukkuth theriyappaduththuki'rean; neengka'lum athai eat'rukko'ndu, athilea nilaiththirukki'reerka'l.
naan ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththapirakaaramaay, neengka'l athaik kaikko'ndirunthaal, athinaalea neengka'l iradchikkappaduveerka'l; mat'rappadi ungka'l visuvaasam viruthaavaayirukkumea.
naan adainthathum ungka'lukkup pirathaanamaaka oppuviththathum ennaven'raal, ki'risthuvaanavar veathavaakkiyangka'linpadi namathu paavangka'lukkaaka mariththu,
adakkampa'n'nappattu, veathavaakkiyangka'linpadi moon'raam naa'lil uyirththezhunthu,
keapaavukkum, pinpu panniruvarukkum tharisanamaanaar.
athanpinpu avar ainnoo'rupearukku athikamaana sakoathararukkum oreavea'laiyil tharisanamaanaar; avarka'lil aneakar innaa'lvaraikkum irukki'raarka'l, silar maaththiram niththiraiyadainthaarka'l.
pinpu yaakkoapukkum, athanpinpu appoasthalarellaarukkum tharisanamaanaar.
ellaarukkum pinpu, akaalappi'ravipoan'ra enakkum tharisanamaanaar.
naan appoasthalarellaarilum si'riyavanaayirukki'rean; theavanudaiya sapaiyaith thunpappaduththinathinaalea, naan appoasthalanen'ru pearpe'ruvatha'rkum paaththiran alla.

aakilum naan irukki'rathu theavakirupaiyinaalea irukki'rean; avar enakku aru'liya kirupai viruthaavaayirukkavillai; avarka'lellaarilum naan athikamaayp pirayaasappattean; aakilum naan alla, ennudanea irukki'ra theavakirupaiyea appadich seythathu.
aakaiyaal naanaakilum avarka'laakilum ippadiyea pirasangkiththuvaruki'roam, neengka'lum ippadiyea visuvaasiththirukki'reerka'l.
ki'risthu mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthaaren'ru pirasangkikkappattirukka, mariththoarin uyirththezhuthalillaiyen'ru ungka'lil silar eppadich sollalaam?
mariththoarin uyirththezhuthal illaavittaal, ki'risthuvum ezhunthirukkavillaiyea.
ki'risthu ezhunthirukkavillaiyen'raal, engka'l pirasangkamum viruthaa, ungka'l visuvaasamum viruthaa.

mariththoar uyirththezhaavittaal, theavan ezhuppaatha ki'risthuvai avar ezhuppinaaren'ru naangka'l theavanaikku'riththuch saadchisonnathinaalea, theavanukkaakap poychsaadchi solluki'ravarka'laakavum kaa'nappaduvoamea.
mariththoar uyirththezhaavittaal, ki'risthuvum ezhunthirukkavillai.
ki'risthu ezhunthiraavittaal, ungka'l visuvaasam vee'naayirukkum; neengka'l innum ungka'l paavangka'lil iruppeerka'l.
ki'risthuvukku'l niththiraiyadainthavarka'lum kettiruppaarka'lea.
immaikkaakamaaththiram naam ki'risthuvinmeal nampikkaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaal, ellaa manusharaippaarkkilum parithapikkappadaththakkavarka'laayiruppoam.
ki'risthuvoa mariththoarilirunthezhunthu, niththiraiyadainthavarka'lil mutha'rpalanaanaar.
manushanaal mara'nam u'ndaanapadiyaal, manushanaal mariththoarin uyirththezhuthalum u'ndaayit'ru.
aathaamukku'l ellaarum marikki'rathupoala, ki'risthuvukku'l ellaarum uyirppikkappaduvaarka'l.
avanavan thanthan varisaiyilea uyirppikkappaduvaan, mutha'rpalanaanavar ki'risthu; pinpu avar varukaiyil avarudaiyavarka'l uyirppikkappaduvaarka'l.
athanpinpu mudivu u'ndaakum; appozhuthu avar sakala thuraiththanaththaiyum sakala athikaaraththaiyum vallamaiyaiyum parikariththu, theavanum pithaavumaayirukki'ravarukku raajyaththai oppukkoduppaar.
ellaach saththurukka'laiyum thamathu paathaththi'rkuk keezhaakkippoadumvaraikkum, avar aa'lukaiseyyavea'ndiyathu.
parikarikkappadung kadaisich saththuru mara'nam.

sakalaththaiyum avarudaiya paathaththi'rkuk keezhppaduththinaarea; aakilum sakalamum avarukkuk keezhppaduththappattathen'ru solliyirukkumpoathu, sakalaththaiyum avarukkuk keezhppaduththinavar keezhppaduththappadavillaiyenpathu ve'liyarangkamaayirukki'rathu.
sakalamum avarukkuk keezhppattirukkumpoathu, theavanea sakalaththilum sakalamumaayiruppatha'rku, kumaaran thaamum thamakkuch sakalaththaiyum keezhppaduththinavarukkuk keezhppattiruppaar.
mealum mariththoar uyirththezhaavittaal, mariththavarka'lukkaaka gnaanasnaanam pe'ruki'ravarka'l enna seyvaarka'l? mariththavarka'lukkaaka ean gnaanasnaanam pe'ruki'raarka'l?
naangka'lum ean ennearamum naasamoasaththi'rku eathuvaayirukki'roam?
naan anuthinamum saaki'rean; athai nammudaiya karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal ungka'laikku'riththu, naan paaraattuki'ra meanmaiyaikko'ndu saththiyamaaych solluki'rean.

naan epeasuvilea thushdamirukangka'ludanea poaraadineanen'ru manushar vazhakkamaaych solluki'rean; appadip poaraadinathinaalea enakkup pirayoajanamenna? mariththoar uyirththezhaavittaal, pusippoam kudippoam, naa'laikkuch saavoam en'ru sollalaamea?
moasampoakaathirungka'l; aakaatha sampaasha'naika'l nallozhukkangka'laik kedukkum.
neengka'l paavagnseyyaamal neethikkea'rka vizhiththukko'ndu, the'linthavarka'laayirungka'l; silar theavanaippat'ri a'rivillaathirukki'raarka'lea; ungka'lukku vedkamu'ndaaka ithaich solluki'rean.
aakilum, mariththoar eppadi ezhunthiruppaarka'l, eppadippatta sareeraththoadea varuvaarka'len'ru oruvan solvaanaakil,
puththiyeenanea, nee vithaikki'ra vithai seththaalozhiya uyirkkamaattaathea.
nee vithaikki'rapoathu, ini u'ndaakum meaniyai vithaiyaamal, koathumai, allathu mat'roru thaaniyaththinudaiya ve'rum vithaiyaiyea vithaikki'raay.
atha'rkuth theavan thamathu siththaththinpadiyea meaniyaik kodukki'raar; vithai vakaika'l ovvon'ri'rkum athatha'rkeat'ra meaniyaiyea kodukki'raar.
ellaa maamsamum oreavithamaana maamsamalla; manusharudaiya maamsam vea'rea, mirukangka'ludaiya maamsam vea'rea, machchangka'ludaiya maamsam vea'rea, pa'ravaika'ludaiya maamsam vea'rea.
vaanaththukkuriya meanika'lumu'ndu, poomikkuriya meanika'lumu'ndu; vaanaththukkuriya meanika'ludaiya makimaiyum vea'rea, poomikkuriya meanika'ludaiya makimaiyum vea'rea;
sooriyanudaiya makimaiyum vea'rea, santhiranudaiya makimaiyum vea'rea, nadchaththirangka'ludaiya makimaiyum vea'rea; makimaiyilea nadchaththiraththukku nadchaththiram viseashiththirukki'rathu.
mariththoarin uyirththezhuthalum appadiyea irukkum. azhivu'l'lathaay vithaikkappadum, azhivillaathathaay ezhunthirukkum;
kanaveenamu'l'lathaay vithaikkappadum, makimaiyu'l'lathaay ezhunthirukkum; palaveenamu'l'lathaay vithaikkappadum, palamu'l'lathaay ezhunthirukkum.
jenmasareeram vithaikkappadum, aavikkuriya sareeram ezhunthirukkum; jenma sareeramumu'ndu, aavikkuriya sareeramumu'ndu.
anthappadiyea munthina manushanaakiya aathaam jeevaaththumaavaanaan en'rezhuthiyirukki'rathu; pinthina aathaam uyirppikki'ra aaviyaanaar.
aakilum aavikkuriya sareeram munthinathalla, jenmasareeramea munthinathu; aavikkuriya sareeram pinthinathu.
munthina manushan poomiyilirunthu'ndaana ma'n'naanavan; ira'ndaam manushan vaanaththilirunthu vantha karththar.
ma'n'naanavan eppadippattavanoa ma'n'naanavarka'lum appadippattavarka'lea; vaanaththukkuriyavar eppadippattavaroa, vaanaththukkuriyavarka'lum appadippattavarka'lea.
mealum ma'n'naanavanudaiya saayalai naam a'ninthirukki'rathupoala, vaanavarudaiya saayalaiyum a'ninthuko'lvoam.
sakoathararea, naan solluki'rathennavenil, maamsamum iraththamum theavanudaiya raajyaththaich suthantharikkamaattaathu; azhivu'l'lathu azhiyaamaiyaich suthantharippathumillai.

ithoa, oru irakasiyaththai ungka'lukku a'rivikki'rean; naamellaarum niththiraiyadaivathillai; aakilum kadaisi ekkaa'lam thonikkumpoathu, oru nimishaththilea, oru imaippozhuthilea, naamellaarum ma'ruroopamaakkappaduvoam.
ekkaa'lam thonikkum, appozhuthu mariththoar azhivillaathavarka'laay ezhunthiruppaarka'l; naamum ma'ruroopamaakkappaduvoam.
azhivu'l'lathaakiya ithu azhiyaamaiyaiyum, saavukkeathuvaakiya ithu saavaamaiyaiyum thariththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
azhivu'l'lathaakiya ithu azhiyaamaiyaiyum, saavukkeathuvaakiya ithu saavaamaiyaiyum thariththukko'l'lumpoathu, mara'nam jeyamaaka vizhungkappattathu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'ra vaarththai ni'raivea'rum.
mara'namea! un koor engkea? paathaa'lamea! un jeyam engkea?
mara'naththin koor paavam, paavaththin pelan niyaayappiramaa'nam.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalea namakku jeyangkodukki'ra theavanukku sthoaththiram.

aakaiyaal, enakkup piriyamaana sakoathararea, karththarukku'l neengka'l paduki'ra pirayaasam viruthaavaayiraathen'ru a'rinthu, neengka'l u'ruthippattavarka'laayum, asaiyaathavarka'laayum, karththarudaiya kiriyaiyilea eppozhuthum perukuki'ravarka'laayum iruppeerka'laaka.
parisuththavaanka'lukkaakach searkkappadum tharmappa'naththaikku'riththu naan kalaaththiyaa naattuch sapaika'lukkup pa'n'nina thittaththinpadiyea neengka'lum seyyungka'l.

naan vanthirukkumpoathu pa'nagn searkkuthal iraathapadikku, ungka'lil avanavan vaaraththin muthalnaa'lthoa'rum, thanthan varavukkuth thakkathaaka ethaiyaakilum thannidaththilea searththuvaikkakkadavan.

naan varumpoathu ungka'l upakaaraththai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndupoakumpadikku, neengka'l thakuthiyu'l'lavarka'laakak ku'rikki'ravarka'l evarka'loa, avarka'lidaththil nirupangka'laik koduththu, avarka'lai anuppuvean.
naanum poakaththakkathaanaal, avarka'l ennudaneakooda varalaam.
naan makkethoaniyaa naattin vazhiyaayp poaki'rapadiyaal, makkethoaniyaa naattaik kadanthapinpu ungka'lidaththi'rku varuvean.
naan engkea poanaalum neengka'l ennai vazhivittanuppumpadikku, naan ungka'lidaththil silakaalam thangkavea'ndiyathaayirukkum; oruvea'lai mazhaikaalam mudiyumvaraiyum iruppean.
ippozhuthu vazhippirayaa'naththilea ungka'laik ka'nduko'l'lamaattean; karththar uththaravukoduththaal ungka'lidaththil vanthu silakaalam thangkiyirukkalaamen'ru nampuki'rean.
aakilum penthekosthea pa'ndikaivaraikkum epeasu patta'naththil iruppean.
eanenil ingkea perithum anukoolamumaana kathavu enakkuth thi'rakkappattirukki'rathu; viroathagnseyki'ravarka'lum aneakar irukki'raarka'l.
theemoaththeayu ungka'lidaththi'rku vanthaaneayaakil, avan ungka'lidaththil payamillaamalirukkap paarungka'l; ennaippoala avanum karththarudaiya kiriyaiyai nadappikki'raanea.

aanapadiyinaal oruvanum avanai a'rpamaay e'n'naathiruppaanaaka; sakoathararoadeakooda avan varuki'ratha'rku naan kaaththirukki'rapadiyaal, ennidaththil varumpadikku avanaich samaathaanaththoadea vazhivittanuppungka'l.

sakoatharanaakiya appolloavaik ku'riththoavenil, sakoathararoadeakooda ungka'lidaththil varumpadikku avanai mikavum vea'ndikko'ndean; aakilum ippozhuthu vara avanukku manathillai; avanukku na'rsamayam u'ndaayirukkumpoathu varuvaan.
vizhiththirungka'l, visuvaasaththilea nilaiththirungka'l, purusharaayirungka'l, thidanko'l'lungka'l.
ungka'l kaariyangka'lellaam anpoadea seyyappadakkadavathu.

sakoathararea, stheavaanudaiya veettaar akaayaanaattilea mutha'rpalanaanavarka'len'rum, parisuththavaanka'lukku oozhiyagnseyyumpadikkuth thangka'lai oppuviththirukki'raarka'len'rum a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
ippadippattavarka'lukkum, udanvealaiyaadka'laayp pirayaasappaduki'ra mat'ra yaavarukkum neengka'l keezhppadinthirukkavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.
stheavaan, porththunaaththu, akaayukku enpavarka'l vanthatha'rkaakach santhoashamaayirukki'rean, neengka'l enakkuch seyyavea'ndiyathaayirunthathai avarka'l seythirukki'raarka'l.
avarka'l en aavikkum ungka'l aavikkum aa'ruthal seythaarka'l; ippadippattavarka'lai angkikaarampa'n'nungka'l.

aasiyaa naattilu'l'la sapaiyaar ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raarka'l. aakkillaavum piriskillaa'lum thangka'l veettilea kooduki'ra sapaiyoadungkoodak karththarukku'l ungka'lai mikavum vaazhththuki'raarka'l.
sakoathararellaarum ungka'lai vaazhththuki'raarka'l. oruvaraiyoruvar parisuththa muththaththoadea vaazhththungka'l.
pavulaakiya naan en kaiyezhuththaalea ungka'lai vaazhththuki'rean.
oruvan karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinidaththil anpukooraama'rpoanaal, avan sapikkappattavanaayirukkakkadavan, karththar varuki'raar.
karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupai ungka'ludaneakooda iruppathaaka.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana ennudaiya anpu ungka'lellaaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.

theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaakiya pavulum, sakoatharanaakiya theemoaththeayum, korinthupatta'naththilu'l'la theavanudaiya sapaikkum, akaayaanaadengkumu'l'la ellaap parisuththavaanka'lukkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
namathu karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaakiya theavanum, irakkangka'lin pithaavum, sakalavithamaana aa'ruthalin theavanumaayirukki'ravarukku sthoaththiram.

theavanaal engka'lukku aru'lappaduki'ra aa'ruthalinaalea, entha upaththiravaththilaakilum akappaduki'ravarka'lukku naangka'l aa'ruthalseyyath thiraa'niyu'l'lavarka'laakumpadi, engka'lukku varum sakala upaththiravangka'lileayum avarea engka'lukku aa'ruthalseyki'ravar.
eppadiyenil, ki'risthuvinudaiya paaduka'l engka'lidaththil perukuki'rathupoala, ki'risthuvinaalea engka'lukku aa'ruthalum perukuki'rathu.

aathalaal, naangka'l upaththiravappattaalum athu ungka'l aa'ruthalukkum iradchippukkum eathuvaakum; naangka'l aa'ruthaladainthaalum athuvum ungka'l aa'ruthalukkum iradchippukkum eathuvaakum; naangka'l paadupaduki'rathupoala neengka'lum paadupattuch sakikki'rathinaalea antha iradchippu palanseyki'rathu.
neengka'l engka'loadeakoodap paadupaduki'rathupoala, engka'loadeakooda aa'ruthalum adaiki'reerka'len'ru naangka'l a'rinthu, ungka'laikku'riththu u'ruthiyaana nampikkaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'roam.

aakaiyaal sakoathararea, aasiyaavil engka'lukku nearitta upaththiravaththai neengka'l a'riyaathirukka engka'lukku manathillai. ennavenil, pizhaippoam enki'ra nampikkai at'ruppoakaththakkathaaka, engka'l palaththi'rku mignchina athika paaramaana varuththam engka'lukku u'ndaayit'ru.
naangka'l engka'lmeal nampikkaiyaayiraamal, mariththoarai ezhuppuki'ra theavanmeal nampikkaiyaayirukkaththakkathaaka, mara'nam varumen'ru naangka'l engka'lukku'l'lea nichchayiththirunthoam.
appadippatta mara'naththinin'rum avar engka'laith thappuviththaar, ippozhuthum thappuvikki'raar, innum thappuvippaar en'ru avarai nampiyirukki'roam.
aneakarmoolamaay engka'lukku u'ndaana thayavukkaaka aneakaraal engka'l nimiththam sthoaththirangka'l seluththappadumporuttu, neengka'lum vi'n'nappaththinaal engka'lukku uthaviseyyungka'l.

maamsaththi'rkeat'ra gnaanaththoadea nadavaamal, theavanudaiya kirupaiyinaal naangka'l ulakaththileayum, viseashamaaka ungka'lidaththileayum, kapadamillaamal thivviya u'nmaiyoadea nadanthoamen'ru, engka'l manathu engka'lukkuch sollugnsaadchiyea engka'l pukazhchchiyaayirukki'rathu.

eanen'raal, neengka'l vaasiththum oththukko'ndumirukki'ra kaariyangka'laiyeayan'ri, vea'ron'raiyum naangka'l ungka'lukku ezhuthavillai; mudivupariyanthamum appadiyea oththukko'lveerka'len'ru nampiyirukki'rean.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvinudaiya naa'lilea neengka'l engka'lukkup pukazhchchiyaayiruppathupoala, naangka'lum ungka'lukkup pukazhchchiyaayirukki'rathai oruvaa'ru oththukko'ndirukki'reerka'lea.
naan ippadippatta nampikkaiyaik ko'ndirukki'rapadiyinaal, ungka'lukku ira'ndaantharamum pirayoajanamu'ndaakumpadi, muthalaavathu ungka'lidaththil varavum,

pinpu ungka'l oorvazhiyaay makkethoaniyaa naattukkup poakavum, makkethoaniyaavai vittu ma'rupadiyum ungka'lidaththi'rku varavum, ungka'laal yootheayaatheasaththukku vazhivittanuppappadavum yoasanaiyaayirunthean.

ippadi naan yoasiththathu vee'naaka yoasiththeanoa? allathu aam aam enki'rathum, alla alla enki'rathum, ennidaththilea irukkaththakkathaaka, naan yoasikki'ravaika'lai maamsaththinpadi yoasikki'reanoa?
naangka'l ungka'lukkuch sonna vaarththai aam alla en'ru irukkavillai; atha'rku u'nmaiyu'l'la theavanea saadchi.
ennaalum, silvaanuvinaalum, theemoaththeayuvinaalum, ungka'lukku'l'lea pirasangkikkappatta theavakumaaranaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvum aam en'rum alla en'rum iraamal, aam en'rea irukki'raar.
engka'laal theavanukku makimaiyu'ndaakumpadi, theavanudaiya vaakkuththaththangka'lellaam iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l aam en'rum, avarukku'l aamen en'rum irukki'rathea.
ungka'loadeakooda engka'laiyum ki'risthuvukku'l sthirappaduththi, nammai apisheakampa'n'ninavar theavanea.
avar nammai muththiriththu, nammudaiya iruthayangka'lil aaviyennum achchaaraththaiyum koduththirukki'raar.
mealum naan ungka'laith thappavidumpadikkea ithuvaraikkum korinthupatta'naththi'rku varaathirukki'reanen'ru, en aaththumaavinpearil theavanaiyea saadchiyaakak koaruki'rean.
ungka'l visuvaasaththi'rku naangka'l athikaarika'laayiraamal, ungka'l santhoashaththi'rkuch sakaayaraayirukki'roam; visuvaasaththinaalea nilaini'rki'reerka'lea.
naan thukkaththudanea ungka'lidaththil ma'rupadiyum varaathapadikku enakku'l'lea theermaaniththukko'ndean.
naan ungka'laith thukkappaduththinaal, ennaalea thukkamadainthavaneayallaamal, evan ennaich santhoashappaduththuvaan?

ennudaiya santhoasham ungka'lellaarukkum santhoashamaayirukkumen'ru, naan ungka'lellaaraiyumpat'ri nampikkaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthu, naan varumpoathu, ennaich santhoashappaduththavea'ndiyavarka'laal naan thukkamadaiyaathapadikku, athai ungka'lukku ezhuthinean.

an'riyum, neengka'l thukkappadumpadikku ezhuthaamal, ungka'lmeal naan vaiththa anpin mikuthiyai neengka'l a'riyumpadikkea, mikuntha viyaakulamum mana idukkamum adainthavanaay athikak ka'n'neeroadea ungka'lukku ezhuthinean.
thukkamu'ndaakkinavan enakkumaaththiramalla, oruvaa'ru ungka'lellaarukkum thukkamu'ndaakkinaan; naan ungka'l ellaarmealum athika paaragnsumaththaathapadikku ithaich solluki'rean.
appadippattavanukku aneakaraal u'ndaana intha tha'ndanaiyea poathum.
aathalaal avan athika thukkaththil amizhnthupoakaathapadikku, neengka'l avanukku manniththu aa'ruthalseyyavea'ndum.
anthappadi, ungka'l anpai avanukkuk kaa'npikkumpadi ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
neengka'l ellaavat'rileayum keezhppadinthirukki'reerka'loa en'ru ungka'laich soathiththa'riyumpadi ippadi ezhuthinean.
evanukku neengka'l mannikki'reerka'loa, avanukku naanum mannikki'rean; mealum ethai naan manniththirukki'reanoa, athai ungka'lnimiththam ki'risthuvinudaiya sannithaanaththilea manniththirukki'rean.
saaththaanaalea naam moasampoakaathapadikku appadich seythean; avanudaiya thanthirangka'l namakkuth theriyaathavaika'l allavea.
mealum naan ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkumpadi thuroavaapatta'naththil vanthapoathu, karththaraalea enakkuk kathavu thi'rakkappattirukkaiyil,

naan en sakoatharanaakiya theeththuvaik kaa'naathathinaalea, en aavikku amaithalillaathirunthathu. aathalaal naan avarka'lidaththil anuppuviththukko'ndu, makkethoaniyaa naattukkup pu'rappattuppoanean.
ki'risthuvukku'l eppozhuthum engka'lai vet'risi'rakkappa'n'ni, ellaa idangka'lileayum engka'laikko'ndu avarai a'riki'ra a'rivin vaasanaiyai ve'lippaduththuki'ra theavanukku sthoaththiram.
iradchikkappaduki'ravarka'lukku'l'leayum, kettuppoaki'ravarka'lukku'l'leayum, naangka'l theavanukkuk ki'risthuvin na'rkanthamaayirukki'roam.

kettuppoaki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea mara'naththi'rkeathuvaana mara'navaasanaiyaakavum, iradchikkappaduki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea jeevanukkeathuvaana jeevavaasanaiyaakavum irukki'roam. ivaika'lai nadappikki'ratha'rku evan thakuthiyaanavan?
aneakaraippoala, naangka'l theavavasanaththaik kalappaayp peasaamal, thuppuravaakavum, theavanaal aru'lappattapirakaaramaakavum, ki'risthuvukku'l theavasannithiyil peasuki'roam.

engka'lai naangka'lea ma'rupadiyum mechchikko'l'lath thodangkuki'roamoa? allathu silarukku vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathupoala, ungka'lukku upasaara nirupangka'lai anuppavum, ungka'lidaththil upasaara nirupangka'laip pet'rukko'l'lavum engka'lukku vea'ndiyathoa?
engka'l iruthayangka'lil ezhuthappattum, sakala manusharaalum a'rinthu vaasikkappattum irukki'ra engka'l nirupam neengka'lthaanea.

eanenil neengka'l engka'l oozhiyaththinaal u'ndaakiya ki'risthuvin nirupamaayirukki'reerka'len'ru ve'liyarangkamaayirukki'rathu; athu maiyinaalalla, jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya aaviyinaalum; ka'rpalakaika'lilalla, iruthayangka'laakiya sathaiyaana palakaika'lileayum ezhuthappattirukki'rathu.
naangka'l theavanukku munpaakak ki'risthuvin moolamaay ippadippatta nampikkaiyaik ko'ndirukki'roam.
engka'laal eathaakilum aakum enpathupoala on'rai yoasikki'ratha'rku naangka'l engka'laalea thakuthiyaanavarka'l alla; engka'ludaiya thakuthi theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

puthu udanpadikkaiyin oozhiyakkaararaayirukkumpadi, avarea engka'laith thakuthiyu'l'lavarka'laakkinaar; antha udanpadikkai ezhuththi'rkuriyathaayiraamal, aavikkuriyathaayirukki'rathu; ezhuththu kolluki'rathu, aaviyoa uyirppikki'rathu.

ezhuththukka'linaal ezhuthappattuk ka'rka'lil pathinthiruntha mara'naththukkeathuvaana oozhiyaththaich seytha moaseayinudaiya mukaththilea makimaippirakaasam u'ndaanapadiyaal, israveal puththirar avan mukaththai noakkip paarkkakkoodaathirunthaarka'lea.
ozhinthupoaki'ra makimaiyaiyudaiya antha oozhiyam appadippatta makimaiyu'l'lathaayirunthaal, aavikkuriya oozhiyam evva'lavu athika makimaiyu'l'lathaayirukkum?
aakkinaiththeerppuk kodukkum oozhiyam makimaiyu'l'lathaayirunthaal, neethiyaik kodukkum oozhiyam athika makimaiyu'l'lathaayirukkumea.
ippadiyaaka, makimaippattiruntha antha oozhiyam intha oozhiyaththi'rku u'ndaayirukki'ra si'rantha makimaikkumunpaaka makimaippattathalla.
an'riyum ozhinthupoavathea makimaiyu'l'lathaayirunthathaanaal, nilaiththiruppathu athika makimaiyu'l'lathaayirukkumea.
naangka'l ippadippatta nampikkaiyai udaiyavarka'laathalaal, mikavum thaaraa'lamaayp peasuki'roam.
mealum ozhinthupoavathin mudivai israveal puththirar noakkippaaraathapadikku, moasea than mukaththinmeal mukkaadu poattukko'ndathupoala naangka'l poaduki'rathillai.
avarka'ludaiya manathu kadinappattathu; innaa'lvaraikkum pazhaiya ea'rpaadu vaasikkappadukaiyil, antha mukkaadu neengkaamalirukki'rathu; athu ki'risthuvinaalea neekkappaduki'rathu.
moaseayin aakamangka'l vaasikkappadumpoathu, innaa'lvaraikkum mukkaadu avarka'l iruthayaththinmeal irukki'rathea.
avarka'l karththaridaththil mananthirumpumpoathu, antha mukkaadu edupattuppoam.
karththarea aaviyaanavar; karththarudaiya aavi engkeayoa angkea viduthalaiyumu'ndu.

naamellaarum thi'rantha mukamaayk karththarudaiya makimaiyaik ka'n'naadiyilea kaa'nki'rathupoalak ka'ndu, aaviyaayirukki'ra karththaraal anthach saayalaakaththaanea makimaiyinmeal makimaiyadainthu ma'ruroopappaduki'roam.
ippadippatta oozhiyaththai udaiyavarka'laakiya naangka'l irakkam pet'riruppathaal soarnthupoaki'rathillai.

vedkamaana antharangka kaariyangka'lai naangka'l ve'ruththu, thanthiramaay nadavaamalum, theava vasanaththaip purattaamalum, saththiyaththai ve'lippaduththuki'rathinaalea theavanukku munpaaka ellaa manusharudaiya manachsaadchikkum engka'lai uththamaren'ru vi'langkappa'n'nuki'roam.
engka'l suviseasham ma'raiporu'laayirunthaal, kettuppoaki'ravarka'lukkea athu ma'raiporu'laayirukkum.

theavanudaiya saayalaayirukki'ra ki'risthuvin makimaiyaana suviseashaththin o'li, avisuvaasika'laakiya avarka'lukkup pirakaasamaayiraathapadikku, ippirapagnchaththin theavanaanavan avarka'ludaiya manathaik kurudaakkinaan.
naangka'l engka'laiyea pirasangkiyaamal, ki'risthu iyeasuvaik karththaren'rum, engka'laiyoa iyeasuvinimiththam ungka'l oozhiyakkaararen'rum pirasangkikki'roam.

iru'lilirunthu ve'lichchaththaip pirakaasikkachsonna theavan iyeasuki'risthuvin mukaththilu'l'la thamathu makimaiyin a'rivaakiya o'liyaith thoan'rappa'n'numporuttaaka, engka'l iruthayangka'lilea pirakaasiththaar.
intha makaththuvamu'l'la vallamai engka'laal u'ndaayiraamal, theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathen'ru vi'langkumpadi, inthap pokkishaththai ma'npaa'ndangka'lil pet'rirukki'roam.
naangka'l eppakkaththilum nerukkappattum odungkippoaki'rathillai; kalakkamadainthum manamu'rivadaiki'rathillai;
thunpappaduththappattum kaividappaduki'rathillai; keezhea tha'l'lappattum madinthu poaki'rathillai.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvinudaiya jeevanum engka'l sareeraththilea vi'langkumpadikku, iyeasuvin mara'naththai eppozhuthum engka'l sareeraththil sumanthu thiriki'roam.
eppadiyenil, saavukkinamaana engka'l maamsaththilea iyeasuvinudaiya jeevanum vi'langkumpadikku uyiroadirukki'ra naangka'l eppozhuthum iyeasuvinimiththam mara'naththi'rku oppukkodukkappaduki'roam.
ippadi mara'namaanathu engka'lidaththilum, jeevanaanathu ungka'lidaththilum pelanseyki'rathu.
visuvaasiththean, aakaiyaal peasinean en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, naangka'lum antha visuvaasaththin aaviyai udaiyavarka'laayirunthu, visuvaasikki'rapadiyaal peasuki'roam.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvai ezhuppinavar engka'laiyum iyeasuvaikko'ndu ezhuppi, ungka'ludaneakoodath thamakkumunpaaka ni'ruththuvaaren'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
theavanudaiya makimai vi'langkuvatha'rkeathuvaakak kirupaiyaanathu aneakarudaiya sthoaththiraththinaalea perukumpadikku, ivaiyellaam ungka'lnimiththam u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
aanapadiyinaalea naangka'l soarnthupoaki'rathillai; engka'l pu'rampaana manushanaanathu azhinthum, u'l'laana manushanaanathu naa'lukkunaa'l puthithaakkappaduki'rathu.

mealum kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'laiyalla, kaa'nappadaathavaika'lai noakkiyirukki'ra namakku, athiseekkiraththil neengkum ileasaana nammudaiya upaththiravam mikavum athikamaana niththiya kanamakimaiyai u'ndaakkuki'rathu.
eanenil, kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'l aniththiyamaanavaika'l, kaa'nappadaathavaika'loa niththiyamaanavaika'l.
poomikkuriya koodaaramaakiya nammudaiya veedu azhinthupoanaalum, theavanaal kattappatta kaivealaiyallaatha niththiya veedu paraloakaththilea namakku u'nden'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
eanenil, inthak koodaaraththilea naam thaviththu, nammudaiya parama vaasasthalaththaith thariththukko'l'la mikavum vaagnchaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'roam;
thariththukko'ndavarka'laanaal, nirvaa'nika'laayk kaa'nappadamaattoam.

inthak koodaaraththilirukki'ra naam paaragnsumanthu thavikki'roam; inthap poarvaiyaik ka'lainthupoadavea'ndumen'ru virumpaamal, mara'namaanathu jeevanaalea vizhungkappaduvatha'rkaakap poarvai thariththavarka'laayirukkavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'roam.
itha'rku nammai aayaththappaduththuki'ravar theavanea; aaviyennum achchaaraththai namakkuth thanthavarum avarea.
naam tharisiththu nadavaamal, visuvaasiththu nadakki'roam.
inthath theakaththil kudiyirukkaiyil karththaridaththil kudiyiraathavarka'laayirukki'roamen'ru a'rinthum, eppozhuthum thairiyamaayirukki'roam.
naam thairiyamaakaveayirunthu, inthath theakaththai vittuk kudipoakavum karththaridaththil kudiyirukkavum athikamaay virumpuki'roam.
athinimiththamea naam sareeraththil kudiyirunthaalum kudiyiraama'rpoanaalum avarukkup piriyamaanavarka'laayirukka naaduki'roam.
