eanen'raal, sareeraththil avanavan seytha nanmaikkaavathu theemaikkaavathu thakka palanai adaiyumpadikku, naamellaarum ki'risthuvin niyaayaasanaththi'rku munpaaka ve'lippadavea'ndum.

aakaiyaal karththarukkup payappadaththakkathen'ru a'rinthu, manusharukkup puththisolluki'roam; theavanukku munpaaka ve'liyarangkamaayirukki'roam; ungka'l manachsaadchikkum ve'liyarangkamaayirukki'roam en'ru nampuki'rean.

ithanaalea naangka'l ungka'lukku munpaaka engka'lai ma'rupadiyum mechchikko'l'laamal, iruthayaththilalla, ve'liveashaththil meanmaipaaraattuki'ravarka'lukku ethirea engka'laikku'riththu neengka'l meanmaipaaraattumpadikku eathuvu'ndaakkuki'roam.
naangka'l paiththiyangko'ndavarka'len'raal theavanukkaaka appadiyirukkum; the'linthapuththiyu'l'lavarka'len'raal ungka'lukkaaka appadiyirukkum.
ki'risthuvinudaiya anpu engka'lai nerukki eavuki'rathu; eanen'raal, ellaarukkaakavum oruvarea mariththirukka, ellaarum mariththaarka'l en'rum;
pizhaiththirukki'ravarka'l inith thangka'lukken'ru pizhaiththiraamal, thangka'lukkaaka mariththu ezhunthavarukken'ru pizhaiththirukkumpadi, avar ellaarukkaakavum mariththaaren'rum nithaanikki'roam.
aakaiyaal, ithumutha'rko'ndu, naangka'l oruvanaiyum maamsaththinpadi a'riyoam; naangka'l ki'risthuvaiyum maamsaththinpadi a'rinthirunthaalum, ini orupoathum avarai maamsaththinpadi a'riyoam.
ippadiyirukka, oruvan ki'risthuvukku'l'lirunthaal puthuchsirushdiyaayirukki'raan; pazhaiyavaika'l ozhinthupoayina, ellaam puthithaayina.
ivaiyellaam theavanaalea u'ndaayirukki'rathu; avar iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu nammaith thammoadea oppuravaakki, oppuravaakkuthalin oozhiyaththai engka'lukku oppukkoduththaar.
athennavenil, theavan ulakaththaarudaiya paavangka'lai e'n'naamal, ki'risthuvukku'l avarka'laith thamakku oppuravaakki, oppuravaakkuthalin upatheasaththai engka'lidaththil oppuviththaar.

aanapadiyinaalea, theavanaanavar engka'laikko'ndu puththisolluki'rathupoala, naangka'l ki'risthuvukkaaka sthaanaapathika'laayirunthu, theavanoadea oppuravaakungka'l en'ru, ki'risthuvinimiththam ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'roam.
naam avarukku'l theavanudaiya neethiyaakumpadikku, paavam a'riyaatha avarai namakkaakap paavamaakkinaar.
theavanudaiya kirupaiyai neengka'l viruthaavaayp pe'raathapadikku, udanvealaiyaadka'laakiya naangka'l ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'roam.
anukkiraka kaalaththilea naan unakkuch sevikoduththu, iradcha'niyanaa'lilea unakku uthaviseythean en'ru solliyirukki'raarea; ithoa, ippozhuthea anukkirakakaalam, ippozhuthea iradcha'niyanaa'l.
intha oozhiyam kut'rappadaathapadikku, naangka'l yaathon'rilum ida'ral u'ndaakkaamal, evvithaththinaaleayum, engka'laith theavaoozhiyakkaararaaka vi'langkappa'n'nuki'roam.
mikuntha po'rumaiyilum, upaththiravangka'lilum, nerukkangka'lilum, idukka'nka'lilum,
adika'lilum, kaavalka'lilum, kalakangka'lilum, pirayaasangka'lilum, ka'nvizhippuka'lilum, upavaasangka'lilum,
ka'rpilum, a'rivilum, neediya saanthaththilum, thayavilum, parisuththaaaviyilum, maayamat'ra anpilum,
saththiyavasanaththilum, thivviya palaththilum; neethiyaakiya valathidathupakkaththu aayuthangka'laith thariththirukki'rathilum,
kanaththilum, kanaveenaththilum, thurkkeerththiyilum, na'rkeerththiyilum; eththarennappattaalum nijastharaakavum,

a'riyappadaathavarka'lennappattaalum nan'raay a'riyappattavarka'laakavum, saaki'ravarka'l ennappattaalum uyiroadirukki'ravarka'laakavum, tha'ndikkappaduki'ravarka'l ennappattaalum kollappadaathavarka'laakavum,

thukkappaduki'ravarka'l ennappattaalum eppozhuthum santhoashappaduki'ravarka'laakavum, thariththirar ennappattaalum aneakarai aisuvariyavaanka'laakkuki'ravarka'laakavum, on'rumillaathavarka'lennappattaalum sakalaththaiyumudaiyavarka'laakavum engka'lai vi'langkappa'n'nuki'roam.
korinthiyarea, engka'l vaay ungka'loadea peasath thi'ranthirukki'rathu, engka'l iruthayam pooriththirukki'rathu.
engka'l u'l'lam ungka'laikku'riththu nerukkamadaiyavillai, ungka'l u'l'lamea engka'laikku'riththu nerukkamadainthirukki'rathu.
aathalaal atha'rkup pathileedaaka neengka'lum poorippaakungka'len'ru, pi'l'laika'lukkuch solluki'rathupoala, ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
anniya nukaththilea avisuvaasika'ludan pi'naikkappadaathiruppeerka'laaka; neethikkum aneethikkum sampanthameathu? o'likkum iru'lukkum aikkiyameathu?
ki'risthuvukkum pealiyaa'lukkum isaiveathu? avisuvaasiyudanea visuvaasikkup pangkeathu?

theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum vikkirakangka'lukkum sampanthameathu? naan avarka'lukku'l'lea vaasampa'n'ni, avarka'lukku'l'lea ulaavi, avarka'l theavanaayiruppean, avarka'l en janangka'laayiruppaarka'l en'ru, theavan sonnapadi, neengka'l jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya aalayamaayirukki'reerka'lea.
aanapadiyaal, neengka'l avarka'l naduvilirunthu pu'rappattup pirinthupoay, asuththamaanathaith thodaathirungka'l en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
appozhuthu, naan ungka'lai eat'rukko'ndu, ungka'lukkup pithaavaayiruppean, neengka'l enakkuk kumaararum kumaaraththika'lumaayiruppeerka'len'ru sarvavallamaiyu'l'la karththar solluki'raar.

ippadippatta vaakkuththaththangka'l namakku u'ndaayirukki'rapadiyinaal, piriyamaanavarka'lea, maamsaththilum aaviyilum u'ndaana ellaa asusiyum neengka, nammaich suththikariththukko'ndu, parisuththamaakuthalaith theavapayaththoadea poora'nappaduththakkadavoam.
engka'lukku idangkodungka'l; naangka'l oruvanukkum aniyaayagnseyyavillai, oruvanaiyum kedukkavillai, oruvanaiyum vagnchikkavillai.

ungka'laik kut'ravaa'lika'laakkum poruttaaka ippadi naan solluki'rathillai; munnea naan solliyapadi, ungka'ludaneakoodach saakavum koodap pizhaikkavunthakkathaaka engka'liruthayangka'lil neengka'l irukki'reerka'lea.

mikuntha thairiyaththoadea ungka'ludan peasuki'rean; ungka'laikku'riththu mikavum meanmaipaaraattuki'rean, aa'ruthalaal ni'rainthirukki'rean, engka'lukku u'ndaana sakala upaththiravaththileayum paripoora'na santhoashamaayirukki'rean.

eppadiyen'raal, naangka'l makkethoaniyaa naattilea vanthapoathu, engka'l sareeraththi'rku i'laippaa'ruthal on'rumillaamal, eppakkaththileayum upaththiravappattoam; pu'rampea poaraattangka'lum, u'l'lea payangka'lum irunthana.
aakilum, si'rumaippattavarka'lukku aa'ruthal seyki'ra theavan theeththu vanthathinaalea engka'lukku aa'ruthalseythaar.

avan vanthathinaalea maaththiramalla, ungka'l vaagnchaiyaiyum, ungka'l thukkippaiyum, ennaippat'ri ungka'lukku u'ndaana pakthivairaakkiyaththaiyum avan ka'ndu, ungka'laal adaintha aa'ruthalaith theriyappaduththinathinaalum, naanum aa'ruthaladainthu athikamaaych santhoashappattean.

aathalaal naan nirupaththinaalea ungka'laith thukkappaduththiyirunthum, antha nirupam kognchappozhuthaakilum ungka'laith thukkappaduththinathen'ru ka'ndu naan manasthaapappattirunthum, ippozhuthu manasthaapappaduki'rathillai.

ippozhuthu santhoashappaduki'rean; neengka'l thukkappattatha'rkaaka alla, mananthirumpuki'ratha'rkeathuvaakath thukkappattatha'rkaakavea santhoashappaduki'rean; neengka'l on'rilum engka'laal nashdappadaathapadikku, theavanukkeat'ra thukkam adaintheerka'lea.
theavanukkeat'ra thukkam pinpu manasthaapappaduki'ratha'rku idamillaamal iradchippukkeathuvaana mananthirumputhalai u'ndaakkuki'rathu; laukika thukkamoa mara'naththai u'ndaakkuki'rathu.

paarungka'l, neengka'l theavanukkeat'ra thukkamadainthathu'ndea; athu ungka'lidaththil evva'lavu jaakkirathaiyaiyum, kut'rantheera evva'lavu niyaayagnsolluthalaiyum, evva'lavu ve'ruppaiyum, evva'lavu payaththaiyum, evva'lavu aavalaiyum, evva'lavu pakthivairaakkiyaththaiyum, evva'lavu ka'ndippaiyum u'ndaakkit'ru. inthak kaariyaththilea neengka'l ellaavithaththilum ungka'laich suththavaanka'len'ru vi'langkappa'n'nineerka'l.

aathalaal naan ungka'lukku appadi ezhuthiyirunthum, aniyaayagnseythavanimiththamumalla, aniyaayagnseyyappattavanimiththamumalla, theavanukkumunpaaka ungka'laikku'riththu engka'lukku u'ndaayirukki'ra jaakkirathai ungka'lukku ve'lippadumporuttea appadi ezhuthinean.

ithinimiththam neengka'l aa'ruthaladainthathinaalea naangka'lum aa'ruthaladainthoam; viseashamaakath theeththuvinudaiya aavi ungka'l anaivaraalum aa'ruthaladainthathinaalea, avanukku u'ndaana santhoashaththinaal athika santhoashappattoam.

ippadiyirukka, ungka'lukkup pukazhchchiyaay naan avanudanea sonna yaathon'raikku'riththum, vedkappadamaattean; naangka'l sakalaththaiyum ungka'lukkuch saththiyamaaych sonnathupoala, theeththuvudanea naangka'l ungka'lukkup pukazhchchiyaaych sonnathum saththiyamaaka vi'langkit'rea.
mealum neengka'lellaarum katta'laikku amainthu, payaththoadum nadukkaththoadum thannai eat'rukko'ndathai avan ninaikkaiyil, avanudaiya u'l'lam ungka'laippat'ri athika anpaayirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal ellaavithaththilum ungka'laikku'riththu enakkuth thidanampikkai u'ndaayirukki'rathen'ru santhoashappaduki'rean.
an'riyum sakoathararea, makkethoaniyaa naattuch sapaika'lukkuth theavan a'liththa kirupaiyai ungka'lukku a'rivikki'roam.

avarka'l mikuntha upaththiravaththinaalea soathikkappadukaiyil, kodiya thariththiramudaiyavarka'laayirunthum, thangka'l paripoora'na santhoashaththinaalea mikuntha uthaaraththuvamaayk koduththaarka'l.
mealum avarka'l thangka'l thiraa'nikkuth thakkathaakavum, thangka'l thiraa'nikku mignchiyum kodukka, thaangka'lea manathu'l'lavarka'laayirunthaarka'lenpatha'rku, naan saadchiyaayirukki'rean.
thangka'l upakaaraththaiyum, parisuththavaanka'lukkuch seyyappadum tharma oozhiyaththin pangkaiyum naangka'l eat'rukko'l'lumpadi avarka'l engka'lai mikavum vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
mealum naangka'l ninaiththapadimaaththiram kodaamal, theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea munpu thangka'laiththaamea karththarukkum, pinpu engka'lukkum oppukkoduththaarka'l.
aathalaal theeththu inthath tharmakaariyaththai ungka'lidaththil thodangkinapadiyea, athai mudikkavum vea'ndumen'ru avanaik keattukko'ndoam.

allaamalum, visuvaasaththilum, poathippilum, a'rivilum, ellaavitha jaakkirathaiyilum, engka'lmealu'l'la ungka'l anpilum, mat'rellaak kaariyangka'lilum, neengka'l perukiyirukki'rathupoala, inthath tharmakaariyaththilum perukavea'ndum.
ithai naan katta'laiyaakach sollaamal, mat'ravarka'ludaiya jaakkirathaiyaikko'ndu, ungka'l anpin u'nmaiyaich soathikkumporuttea solluki'rean.

nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupaiyai a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea; avar aisuvariyamu'l'lavaraayirunthum, neengka'l avarudaiya thariththiraththinaalea aisuvariyavaanka'laakumpadikku, ungka'l nimiththam thariththiraraanaarea.

ithaikku'riththu en yoasanaiyai ungka'lukku a'rivikki'rean; ithaich seyki'ratha'rku maaththiramalla, seyyavea'ndumen'ru u'rchaakappaduki'ratha'rkum oru varushamaay aarampampa'n'nina ungka'lukku ithu thakuthiyaayirukkum.
aakaiyaal athai ippozhuthu seythu ni'raiveat'rungka'l; kodukkavea'ndum enki'ra viruppamu'ndaayirunthathupoala, ungka'lukku u'l'lavaika'lil eduththu athai ni'raiveat'ruthalum u'ndaavathaaka.
oruvanukku manaviruppamirunthaal, avanukku illaathathinpadiyalla, avanukku u'l'lathinpadiyea angkikarikkappadum.
mat'ravarka'lukkuch sakaayamum ungka'lukku varuththamum u'ndaakumpadiyalla, samanilaiyirukkumpadiyaakavea solluki'rean.
eppadiyenil, mikuthiyaaych searththavanukku athikamaanathumillai, kognchamaaych searththavanukkuk ku'raivaanathumillai en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapirakaaram,
samanilaip piramaa'naththinpadiyea, avarka'ludaiya selvam ungka'l va'rumaikku uthavumpadikku ikkaalaththilea ungka'ludaiya selvam avarka'ludaiya va'rumaikku uthavuvathaaka.
an'riyum ungka'lukkaaka ippadippatta jaakkirathai u'ndaayirukkumpadi theeththuvin iruthayaththil aru'lina theavanukku sthoaththiram.
naangka'l keattukko'ndathai avan angkikariththathumallaamal, avan athika jaakkirathaiyaayirunthu, than manaviruppaththinpadiyea ungka'lidaththi'rku varap pu'rappattaan.
suviseasha oozhiyaththil ellaach sapaika'lilum pukazhchchipet'ra oru sakoatharanai avanoadeakooda anuppiyirukki'roam.

athumaaththiramalla, karththarukku makimaiyu'ndaakavum, ungka'l manaviruppam vi'langkavum, engka'l oozhiyaththinaalea searkkappadum tharmappa'naththaik ko'ndupoakaiyil, engka'lukku vazhiththu'naiyaayirukkumpadi, avan sapaika'laal therinthu ea'rpaduththappattavanaayum irukki'raan.
engka'l oozhiyaththinaalea searkkappadum intha mikuthiyaana tharmappa'naththaikku'riththu oruvanum engka'laik kut'rappaduththaathapadikku naangka'l echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,
karththarukku munpaakamaaththiramalla, manusharukku munpaakavum yoakkiyamaanavaika'laich seyya naaduki'roam.

mealum, aneaka kaariyangka'lil jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanen'ru naangka'l palamu'rai ka'nda'rinthavanum, ippozhuthu ungka'lmealu'l'la mikuntha nampikkaiyinaalea athika jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanumaakiya nammudaiya sakoatharanaiyum ivarka'loadea kooda anuppiyirukki'roam.

theeththuvaikku'riththu oruvan visaariththaal, avan enakkuk koottaa'liyum, ungka'lukkaaka en udanvealaiyaa'lumaayirukki'raanen'rum; engka'l sakoathararaikku'riththu oruvan visaariththaal, avarka'l sapaika'ludaiya sthaanaapathika'lum, ki'risthuvukku makimaiyumaayirukki'raarka'len'rum a'riyakkadavan.
aathalaal ungka'l anpaiyum, naangka'l ungka'laikku'riththuch sonna pukazhchchiyaiyum, sapaika'lukku munpaaka avarka'lukkuth thirushdaanthappaduththungka'l.
parisuththavaanka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiya tharmasakaayaththaikku'riththu, naan athikamaaka ungka'lukku ezhuthavea'nduvathillai.

ungka'l manaviruppaththai a'rinthirukki'rean; akaayaavilu'l'lavarka'l oruvarushamaaka aayaththamaayirukki'raarka'len'ru, naan makkethoaniyarudanea solli, ungka'laip pukazhntheanea; ungka'l jaakkirathai aneakarai ezhuppivittathumu'ndu.

appadiyirunthum, ungka'laikku'riththu naangka'l sonna pukazhchchi inthak kaariyaththil vee'naayppoakaamal, naan sonnapadi neengka'l aayaththappattavarka'laayiruppatha'rku, inthach sakoathararai anuppinean.

makkethoaniyar ennudaneakooda vanthu, ungka'lai aayaththappadaathavarka'laakak ka'ndaal, ivva'lavu nichchayamaay ungka'laip pukazhnthatha'rkaaka, neengka'l vedkappaduveerka'len'ru naangka'l sollaamal, naangka'lea vedkappadavea'ndiyathaayirukkum.

aakaiyaal, vaakkuththaththam pa'n'nappattirukki'ra ungka'l thaanatharmamaanathu loapaththanamaayk kodukkappattathaayiraamal, uthaaraththuvamaayk kodukkappattathaayirukkumpadiyaaka athai aayaththappaduththuki'ratha'rkuch sakoathararai eavi, ungka'lidaththil munnathaaka anuppuvathu enakku avasiyam en'ru kaa'nappattathu.
pinnum naan solluki'rathennavenil, si'ruka vithaikki'ravan si'ruka a'ruppaan, peruka vithaikki'ravan peruka a'ruppaan.
avanavan visanamaayumalla, kattaayamaayumalla, than manathil niyamiththapadiyea kodukkakkadavan; u'rchaakamaayk kodukki'ravanidaththil theavan piriyamaayirukki'raar.

mealum, neengka'l ellaavat'rilum eppozhuthum sampoora'namudaiyavarka'laayum, sakalavitha na'rkiriyaika'lilum perukuki'ravarka'laayumirukkumpadiyaaka, theavan ungka'lidaththil sakalavitha kirupaiyaiyum perukachseyya vallavaraayirukki'raar.
vaariyi'raiththaan, eazhaika'lukkuk koduththaan, avanudaiya neethi en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyaakum.
vithaikki'ravanukku vithaiyaiyum, pusikki'ratha'rku aakaaraththaiyum a'likki'ravar ungka'lukku vithaiyai a'liththu, athaip perukappa'n'ni, ungka'l neethiyin vi'laichchalai varththikkachseyvaar.
theavanukku engka'laal sthoaththiramu'ndaavatha'rku eathuvaayirukkum mikuntha uthaaraku'naththilea neengka'l evvithaththilum sampoora'namu'l'lavarka'laaveerka'l.
inthath tharmasakaayamaakiya pa'nividai parisuththavaanka'ludaiya ku'raivuka'lai neekkuki'rathumallaamal, aneakar theavanai sthoaththirippathinaalea sampoora'na palanu'l'lathaayum irukkum.

avarka'l inthath tharmasakaayaththinaalaakiya nanmaiyai anupaviththu, neengka'l ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaik keezhppadithaloadea a'rikkaiyittirukki'rathinimiththamum, thangka'lukkum mat'ra anaivarukkum neengka'l uthaaraththuvamaayth tharmagnseyki'rathinimiththamum, avarka'l theavanai makimaippaduththi;
ungka'lukkaaka vea'nduthalseythu, theavan ungka'lukku a'liththa mikavum viseashiththa kirupaiyinimiththam ungka'lmeal vaagnchaiyaayirukki'raarka'l.
theavan aru'liya sollimudiyaatha eevukkaaka avarukku sthoaththiram.

ungka'lukku munpaaka irukkumpoathu thaazhmaiyaayum, thooraththilea irukkumpoathu ungka'lmeal ka'ndippaayum irukki'ra pavulaakiya naan ki'risthuvin saanthaththaiyum thayavaiyum munnittu ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.

engka'lai maamsaththinpadi nadakki'ravarka'l en'ru e'n'nuki'ra silaraikku'riththu naan ka'ndippaayirukkavea'ndumen'ru ninaiththirukki'ra thairiyaththoadea, ungka'lmunpaaka irukkumpoathu, naan ka'ndippu'l'lavanaayiraathapadikku neengka'l echcharikkaiyaayirukka ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naangka'l maamsaththil nadakki'ravarka'laayirunthum, maamsaththinpadi poarseyki'ravarka'lalla.
engka'ludaiya poaraayuthangka'l maamsaththukkeat'ravaika'laayiraamal, ara'nka'lai nirmoolamaakkuki'ratha'rkuth theavapalamu'l'lavaika'laayirukki'rathu.

avaika'laal naangka'l tharkkangka'laiyum, theavanai a'riki'ra a'rivukku viroathamaay ezhumpuki'ra ellaa meattimaiyaiyum nirmoolamaakki, entha e'n'naththaiyum ki'risthuvukkuk keezhppadiyach si'raippaduththuki'ravarka'laayirukki'roam.
ungka'l keezhppadithal ni'raivea'rumpoathu, ellaak keezhppadiyaamaikkunthakka neethiyu'l'la tha'ndanaiyaich seluththa aayaththamaayumirukki'roam.

ve'liththoat'raththinpadi paarkki'reerka'laa? oruvan thannaik ki'risthuvukkuriyavanen'ru nampinaal, thaan ki'risthuvukkuriyavanaayirukki'rathupoala naangka'lum ki'risthuvukkuriyavarka'len'ru avan thannileathaanea sinthikkakkadavan.

mealum, ungka'lai nirmoolamaakkuki'ratha'rkalla, ungka'lai oon'rak kattuki'ratha'rkuk karththar engka'lukkuk koduththa athikaaraththaikku'riththu, naan innum sat'rea athikamaay meanmaipaaraattinaalum naan vedkappaduvathillai.
naan nirupangka'laalea ungka'laip payamu'ruththuki'ravanaayth thoan'raathapadikku ithaich solluki'rean.
avanudaiya nirupangka'l paarayoasanaiyum palamumu'l'lavaika'l; sareeraththin thoat'ramoa palaveenamum, vasanam a'rpamumaayirukki'rathenki'raarka'lea.

appadich solluki'ravan, naangka'l thooraththilirukkumpoathu ezhuthuki'ra nirupangka'laal vasanaththil eppadippattavarka'laayirukki'roamoa, appadippattavarka'laakavea sameepaththilirukkumpoathum kiriyaiyilum iruppoam en'ru sinthikkakkadavan.

aakilum thangka'laith thaangka'lea mechchikko'l'luki'ra silarukku naangka'l engka'laich sariyaakkavum oppidavum thu'niyamaattoam; thangka'laikko'ndu thangka'lai a'lanthuko'ndu, thangka'lukkea thangka'lai oppittukko'l'luki'ra avarka'l puththimaanka'lalla.
naangka'l a'lavukku mignchi meanmaipaaraattaamal, ungka'lidamvaraikkum vanthettaththakkathaaka, theavan engka'lukku a'lanthu pakirntha a'lavuppiramaa'naththinpadiyea meanmaipaaraattuki'roam.
ungka'lidaththil vanthettaathavarka'laay naangka'l a'lavukku mignchippoaki'rathillai; naangka'l ki'risthuvin suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththu ungka'lidamvaraikkum vanthoamea.
engka'l a'lavaik kadanthu mat'ravarka'ludaiya vealaikkudpattu meanmaipaaraattamaattoam.

aakilum ungka'l visuvaasam viruththiyaakumpoathu, mat'ravarka'ludaiya ellaika'lukku'l'lea seyyappattavaika'lai naangka'l seythathaaka meanmaipaaraattaamal, ungka'lukku appu'ramaana idangka'lil suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkaththakkathaaka, engka'l a'lavinpadi ungka'laal mikavum peruki viruththiyadaivoamen'ru nampikkaiyaayirukki'roam.
meanmaipaaraattuki'ravan karththaraikku'riththea meanmaipaaraattakkadavan.
thannaiththaan pukazhuki'ravan uththamanalla, karththaraal pukazhappaduki'ravanea uththaman.
en puththiyeenaththai neengka'l sat'rea sakiththaal nalamaayirukkum; ennaich sakiththumirukki'reerka'lea.
naan ungka'laik ka'rpu'l'la kannikaiyaakak ki'risthu ennum orea purushanukku oppukkodukka niyamiththapadiyaal, ungka'lukkaakath theavavairaakkiyamaana vairaakkiyangko'ndirukki'rean.
aakilum, sarppamaanathu thannudaiya thanthiraththinaalea eavaa'lai vagnchiththathupoala, ungka'l manathum ki'risthuvaippat'riya u'nmaiyinin'ru vilakumpadi kedukkappadumoaven'ru payanthirukki'rean.

eppadiyenil, ungka'lidaththil varuki'ravan naangka'l pirasangkiyaatha vea'roru iyeasuvaip pirasangkiththaanaanaal, allathu neengka'l pet'riraatha vea'roru aaviyaiyum, neengka'l eat'rukko'l'laatha vea'roru suviseashaththaiyum pet'reerka'laanaal, nan'raaych sakiththiruppeerka'lea.
makaa pirathaana appoasthalarilum, naan on'rilum ku'raivu'l'lavanallaven'ru e'n'nuki'rean.
naan peachchilea kallaathavanaayirunthaalum, a'rivilea kallaathavanalla; entha vishayaththilum ellaarukkumunpaakavum ungka'lukku'l'lea naangka'l ve'lippattirukki'roamea.
neengka'l uyarththappadumpadi naan ennaiththaanea thaazhththi, theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ilavasamaay ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththathinaalea kut'ragnseytheanoa?
ungka'lukku oozhiyagnseyyumpadikku, mat'rach sapaika'lidaththil sampa'laththaip pet'ru, avarka'laik ko'l'laiyittean.

naan ungka'loadirunthu ku'raivupattapoathum, oruvaraiyum naan varuththappaduththavillai; makkethoaniyaavilirunthu vantha sakoatharar en ku'raivai ni'raivaakkinaarka'l; evvithaththileayum ungka'lukkup paaramaayiraathapadikku jaakkirathaiyaayirunthean, inimealum jaakkirathaiyaayiruppean.
akaayaanaattin thisaika'lilea inthap pukazhchchi ennaivittu neengkuvathillaiyen'ru ennilu'l'la ki'risthuvinudaiya saththiyaththaikko'ndu solluki'rean.
ippadich sollavea'ndiyathenna? naan ungka'laich sineakiyaathapadiyinaaleayoa? theavan a'rivaar.

mealum, engka'lai viroathikkach samayantheaduki'ravarka'lukkuch samayam kidaiyaathapadikku, thangka'laikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattuki'ra kaariyaththil avarka'l engka'laippoalak kaa'nappadumpadi, naan seyvathaiyea innum seyvean.
appadippattavarka'l ka'l'la appoasthalarka'l, kapadamu'l'la vealaiyaadka'l, ki'risthuvinudaiya appoasthalarin veashaththaith thariththukko'ndavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.
athu aachchariyamalla, saaththaanum o'liyin thoothanudaiya veashaththaith thariththukko'lvaanea.
aakaiyaal avanudaiya oozhiyakkaararum neethiyin oozhiyakkaararudaiya veashaththaith thariththukko'ndaal athu aachchariyamallavea; avarka'l mudivu avarka'l kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaayirukkum.
pinnum naan solluki'rean; oruvanum ennaip puththiyeenanen'ru e'n'navea'ndaam; appadi e'n'ninaal, naanum sat'rea meanmaipaaraattumpadi, ennaip puththiyeenanaippoalaakilum eat'rukko'l'lungka'l.
ippadi naan solluki'rathu karththarukkeat'rapadi sollaamal, meanmaipaaraattum thairiyaththinaalea puththiyeenanaippoalach solluki'rean.
aneakar maamsaththi'rkeat'rapadi meanmaipaaraattikko'l'lukaiyil, naanum meanmaipaaraattuvean.
neengka'l puththiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu puththiyillaathavarka'laich santhoashamaaych sakiththirukki'reerka'lea.

oruvan ungka'laich si'raiyaakkinaalum, oruvan ungka'laip padchiththaalum, oruvan ungka'laik kaivasappaduththinaalum, oruvan thannai uyarththinaalum, oruvan ungka'lai mukaththil a'rainthaalum sakiththirukki'reerka'lea.

naangka'l palaveenaraanathupoala, engka'lukku vantha kanaveenaththaikku'riththup peasuki'rean; oruvan ethilea thu'nivu'l'lavanaayirukki'raanoa athilea naanum thu'nivu'l'lavanaayirukki'rean; ippadip puththiyeenamaayp peasuki'rean.
avarka'l epireyaraa? naanum epireyan; avarka'l isravealaraa? naanum isravealan; avarka'l aapirakaamin santhathiyaaraa? naanum aapirakaamin santhathiyaan.

avarka'l ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaararaa? naan athikam; puththiyeenamaayp peasuki'rean; naan athikamaayp pirayaasappattavan, athikamaay adipattavan, athikamaayk kaavalka'lil vaikkappattavan, aneakantharam mara'na avathiyil akappattavan.
yootharka'laal on'ruku'raiya naa'rpathadiyaaka ainthutharam adipattean;
moon'rutharam milaa'ruka'laal adipattean, orutharam kalle'riyu'ndean, moon'rutharam kappa'rseathaththil irunthean, kadalilea oru iraappakal muzhuvathum poakkinean.

aneakantharam pirayaa'nampa'n'ninean; aa'ruka'laal vantha moasangka'lilum, ka'l'laraal vantha moasangka'lilum, en suyajanangka'laal vantha moasangka'lilum, anniya janangka'laal vantha moasangka'lilum, patta'nangka'lil u'ndaana moasangka'lilum, vanaantharaththil u'ndaana moasangka'lilum, samuththiraththil u'ndaana moasangka'lilum, ka'l'lachsakoathararidaththil u'ndaana moasangka'lilum;
pirayaasaththilum, varuththaththilum, aneakamu'rai ka'nvizhippuka'lilum, pasiyilum thaakaththilum, aneakamu'rai upavaasangka'lilum, ku'lirilum, nirvaa'naththilum irunthean.
ivai muthalaanavaika'laiyallaamal, ellaach sapaika'laikku'riththum u'ndaayirukki'ra kavalai ennai naa'lthoa'rum nerukkuki'rathu.
oruvan palaveenanaanaal naanum palaveenanaaki'rathillaiyoa? oruvan ida'rinaal en manam eriyaathirukkumoa?
naan meanmaipaaraattavea'ndumaanaal, en palaveenaththi'rkaduththavaika'laik ku'riththu meanmaipaaraattuvean.
en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkappatta theavanum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavumaanavar naan poy solluki'rathillaiyen'ru a'rivaar.
thamaskupatta'naththu areaththaa raajaavinudaiya seanaiththalaivan ennaip pidikkavea'ndumen'ru thamaskarudaiya patta'naththaik kaavalvaiththuk kaaththaan;
appozhuthu naan koodaiyilea vaikkappattu, jannalilirunthu mathil vazhiyaay i'rakkividappattu, avanudaiya kaikkuth thappinean.
meanmaipaaraattuki'rathu enakkuth thakuthiyallavea; aakilum, karththar aru'liya tharisanangka'laiyum ve'lippaduththalka'laiyum solluki'rean.

ki'risthuvukku'l'laana oru manushanai a'rivean; avan pathinaalu varushaththi'rku munnea moon'raam vaanamvaraikkum edukkappattaan; avan sareeraththilirunthaanoa, sareeraththi'rkup pu'rampeayirunthaanoa, athai a'riyean; theavan a'rivaar.
antha manushan paratheesukku'l edukkappattu, manushar peasappadaathathum vaakkukkettaathathumaakiya vaarththaika'laik keattaanen'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.
avan sareeraththilirunthaanoa, sareeraththi'rkup pu'rampeayirunthaanoa, athai a'riyean; theavan a'rivaar.
ippadippattavanaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattuvean; aanaalum ennaikku'riththu en palaveenangka'lileayan'ri, vea'ron'rilum meanmaipaaraattamaattean.

saththiyamaanathai naan peasuki'rean; naan meanmaipaaraatta manathaayirunthaalum, naan puththiyeenanalla, aanaalum oruvanum ennidaththil kaa'nki'ratha'rkum, ennaalea keadki'ratha'rkum mealaaka ennai e'n'naathapadikku appadich seyyaathiruppean.

an'riyum, enakku ve'lippaduththappattavaika'lukkuriya meanmaiyinimiththam naan ennai uyarththaathapadikku, en maamsaththilea oru mu'l kodukkappattirukki'rathu; ennai naan uyarththaathapadikku, athu ennaik kuttum saaththaanudaiya thoothanaayirukki'rathu.
athu ennaivittu neengkumpadikku, naan moon'rutharam karththaridaththil vea'ndikko'ndean.

atha'rku avar: en kirupai unakkuppoathum; palaveenaththilea en palam poora'namaay vi'langkum en'raar. aakaiyaal, ki'risthuvin vallamai enmeal thangkumpadi, en palaveenangka'laikku'riththu naan mikavum santhoashamaay meanmaipaaraattuvean.

anthappadi naan palaveenamaayirukkumpoathea palamu'l'lavanaayirukki'rean; aakaiyaal ki'risthuvinimiththam enakku varum palaveenangka'lilum, ninthaika'lilum, nerukkangka'lilum, thunpangka'lilum, idukka'nka'lilum naan piriyappaduki'rean.

meanmaipaaraatti, puththiyeenanaayinean; neengka'lea itha'rku ennaip palavanthappaduththineerka'l. naan on'rumillaiyen'raalum, makaa pirathaana appoasthalarukkum naan evva'lavum ku'rainthavanaayiraathapadiyaal, ungka'laalea mechchikko'l'lappadavea'ndiyathaayirunthathea.
appoasthalanukkuriya adaiyaa'langka'l ellaavithamaana po'rumaiyoadum, athisayangka'loadum, a'rputhangka'loadum, vallamaika'loadum, ungka'lukku'l'lea nadappikkappattathea.
ethilea mat'rach sapaika'lukkuk ku'raivaayiruntheerka'l? naan ungka'lai varuththappaduththaathirunthathea ungka'lukkuk ku'raivu; intha aniyaayaththai enakku manniyungka'l.

ithoa, ungka'lidaththi'rku moon'raantharam vara aayaththamaayirukki'rean; naan ungka'lai varuththappaduththuvathillai; naan ungka'ludaiyathaiyalla, ungka'laiyea theaduki'rean; pet'raarukkup pi'l'laika'lalla, pi'l'laika'lukkup pet'raarka'lea pokkishangka'laich searththuvaikkavea'ndum.

aathalaal, naan ungka'lil evva'lavu athikamaay anpukooruki'reanoa avva'lavu ku'raivaay ungka'laal anpukoorappattirunthaalum, mikavum santhoashamaay naan ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaakach selavupa'n'navum selavupa'n'nappadavum virumpuki'rean.
appadiyaakattum; naan ungka'lukkup paaramaayirukkavillai; aanaalum, upaayamu'l'lavanaayirunthu, thanthiraththinaalea ungka'laip pidiththeanaam.
naan ungka'lidaththi'rku anuppinavarka'lil evanmoolamaayaavathu ungka'lidaththil pozhivaith theadinathu'ndaa?

theeththu ungka'lidaththil varumpadi naan avanaik keattukko'ndu, avanudaneakooda oru sakoatharanai anuppinean; theeththu ungka'lidaththil eathaavathu pozhivaith theadinaanaa? naangka'l orea aaviyaiyudaiyavarka'laay, orea adichsuvaduka'lil nadanthoamallavaa?

naangka'l yoakkiyarka'len'ru vi'langkumpadi ungka'lidaththil peasuki'roamen'ru e'n'nuki'reerka'loa? theavanukkumunpaakak ki'risthuvukku'l peasuki'roam. piriyamaanavarka'lea, sakalaththaiyum ungka'l pakthiviruththikkaakach seyki'roam.

aakilum naan vanthu, ungka'lai en manathinpadiyirukki'ravarka'laakak kaa'naamalum, naanum ungka'l manathinpadiyirukki'ravanaakak kaa'nappadaamalumiruppeanoaven'rum; viroathangka'l, vairaakkiyangka'l, koapangka'l, vaakkuvaathangka'l, pu'rangkoo'ruthal, koadsolluthal, i'rumaappu, kalakangka'l aakiya ivaika'l ungka'lukku'l'lea u'ndaayirukkumoaven'rum;

ma'rupadiyum naan varuki'rapoathu, en theavan ungka'lidaththil ennaith thaazhththumpadikku mun paavagnseythavarka'laakiya aneakar thaangka'l nadappiththa asuththaththaiyum veasiththanaththaiyum kaamavikaaraththaiyum vittu mananthirumpaamalirukki'rathaikku'riththu, naan thukkappadavea'ndiyathaayirukkumoaven'rum payanthirukki'rean.
intha moon'raantharam naan ungka'lidaththi'rku varuki'rean; sakala kaariyangka'lum ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'ludaiya vaakkinaal nilaivarappadum.

naan ira'ndaantharam ungka'lidaththilirunthapoathu sonnathupoala, ippozhuthu thooramaayirunthum ungka'lidaththilirukki'ravanaaka, naan ma'rupadiyum vanthaal thappavidamaatteanen'ru munpu paavagnseythavarka'lukkum mat'ra ellaarukkum munna'riviththu ezhuthuki'rean.
ki'risthu enakku'l'lea peasuki'raarenpatha'rku aththaadchi theaduki'reerka'lea; avar ungka'lidamaayp palaveenaralla, ungka'lidaththil vallavaraayirukki'raar.

eanenil avar palaveenaththaal siluvaiyil a'raiyappattirunthum, theavanudaiya vallamaiyinaal pizhaiththirukki'raar; appadi naangka'lum avarukku'l palaveenaraayirunthum, ungka'lidamaay vi'langkiya theavanudaiya vallamaiyinaal avarudaneakoodap pizhaiththiruppoam.

neengka'l visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'loaven'ru ungka'lai neengka'lea soathiththu a'riyungka'l; ungka'lai neengka'lea pareedchiththup paarungka'l. iyeasuki'risthu ungka'lukku'l irukki'raaren'ru ungka'lai neengka'lea a'riyeerka'laa? neengka'l pareedchaikku nillaathavarka'laayirunthaal a'riyeerka'l.
naangka'loa pareedchaikku nillaathavarka'lallavenpathai a'riveerka'len'ru nampuki'rean.

mealum neengka'l oru pollaangkum seyyaathirukkumpadiyaaka, theavanai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'rean. naangka'l pareedchaikku nin'ravarka'len'ru kaa'nappadumporuttalla, naangka'l pareedchaikku nillaathavarka'lpoalirunthaalum, neengka'l nalamaanathaich seyyumporuttea vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'rean.
saththiyaththi'rku viroathamaaka naangka'l on'rugnseyyakkoodaamal, saththiyaththi'rku anukoolamaakavea seyyakkoodum.
naangka'l palaveenarum neengka'l palamu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukkaiyil, santhoashappaduki'roam; neengka'l na'rseerporunthumpadikkum vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'roam.

aanathaal idiththuppoadavalla, oon'rak kattavea karththar enakkuk koduththa athikaaraththinpadi, naan ungka'lidaththil vanthirukkumpoathu, ka'ndithampa'n'naathapadikku, naan thooramaayirunthu ivaika'lai ezhuthuki'rean.

kadaisiyaaka, sakoathararea, santhoashamaayirungka'l, na'rseer porunthungka'l, aa'ruthaladaiyungka'l; eakasinthaiyaayirungka'l, samaathaanamaayirungka'l, appozhuthu anpukkum samaathaanaththukkum kaara'naraakiya theavan ungka'loadeakooda iruppaar.
oruvaraiyoruvar parisuththa muththaththoadu vaazhththungka'l.
parisuththavaanka'lellaarum ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupaiyum, theavanudaiya anpum, parisuththa aaviyinudaiya aikkiyamum, ungka'l anaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
manusharaalumalla, manushan moolamaayumalla, iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, avarai mariththoarilirunthezhuppina pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, appoasthalanaayirukki'ra pavulaakiya naanum,
ennudaneakooda irukki'ra sakoathararellaarum, kalaaththiyaa naattilu'l'la sapaika'lukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka;

avar nammai ippozhuthirukki'ra pollaatha pirapagnchaththinin'ru viduvikkumpadi nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanudaiya siththaththinpadiyea nammudaiya paavangka'lukkaakath thammaiththaamea oppukkoduththaar;
avarukku en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangka'lilum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
ungka'laik ki'risthuvin kirupaiyinaalea azhaiththavarai neengka'l ivva'lavu seekkiramaay vittu, vea'roru suviseashaththi'rkuth thirumpuki'rathaippat'ri naan aachchariyappaduki'rean;
vea'roru suviseasham illaiyea; silar ungka'laik kalakappaduththi, ki'risthuvinudaiya suviseashaththaip puratta manathaayirukki'raarka'leayallaamal vea'ralla.

naangka'l ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththa suviseashaththaiyallaamal, naangka'laavathu, vaanaththilirunthu varuki'ra oru thoothanaavathu, vea'roru suviseashaththai ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththaal, avan sapikkappattavanaayirukkakkadavan.
mun sonnathupoala ma'rupadiyum solluki'rean; neengka'l eat'rukko'nda suviseashaththaiyallaamal vea'roru suviseashaththai oruvan ungka'lukkup pirasangkiththaal avan sapikkappattavanaayirukkakkadavan.

ippozhuthu naan manusharaiyaa, theavanaiyaa, yaarai naadip poathikki'rean? manusharaiyaa piriyappaduththap paarkki'rean? naan innum manusharaip piriyappaduththuki'ravanaayirunthaal naan ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaaranallavea.
mealum, sakoathararea, ennaal pirasangkikkappatta suviseasham manusharudaiya yoasanaiyinpadiyaanathallaven'ru ungka'lukkuth therivikki'rean.
naan athai oru manushanaal pet'rathumillai, manushanaal kat'rathumillai, iyeasuki'risthuvea athai enakku ve'lippaduththinaar.
naan yoothamaarkkaththilirunthapoathu ennudaiya nadakkaiyaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattiruppeerka'l; theavanudaiya sapaiyai naan mikavum thunpappaduththi, athaip paazhaakki;
en janaththaaril en vayathu'l'la aneakaraippaarkkilum yoothamaarkkaththilea thea'rinavanaay, en pithaakka'ludaiya paarampariya niyaayangka'lukkaaka mikavum pakthivairaakkiyamu'l'lavanaayirunthean.
appadiyirunthum, naan en thaayin vayit'rilirunthathumuthal, ennaip piriththeduththu, thammudaiya kirupaiyinaal azhaiththa theavan,

thammudaiya kumaaranai naan pu'rajaathika'lidaththil suviseashamaay a'rivikkumporuttaaka, avarai enakku'l ve'lippaduththap piriyamaayirunthapoathu, udanea naan maamsaththoadum iraththaththoadum yoasanaipa'n'naamalum;
enakku munnea appoasthalaraanavarka'lidaththilea erusaleamukkup poakaamalum; arapitheasaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoay, ma'rupadiyum thamasku oorukkuth thirumpivanthean.
moon'ru varusham sen'rapinpu, peathuruvaik ka'nduko'l'lumpadi naan erusaleamukkup poay, avanidaththil pathinainthunaa'l thangkiyirunthean.
karththarudaiya sakoatharanaakiya yaakkoapaith thavira, appoasthalaril vea'roruvaraiyum naan kaa'navillai.
naan ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'ra ivaika'l poyyallaven'ru theavanukkumunpaaka nichchayamaaych solluki'rean.
pinpu, seeriyaa silisiyaa naaduka'lin pu'rangka'lil vanthean.
mealum yootheayaatheasaththilea ki'risthuvukku'l'laana sapaika'lukku mukama'riyaathavanaayirunthean.
munnea nammaith thunpappaduththinavanea, thaan azhikkaththeadina visuvaasaththai ippozhuthu pirasangkikki'raan enpathaimaaththiram avarka'l kea'lvippattirunthu,
ennaippat'rith theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.
pathinaalu varusham sen'rapinpu, naan theeththuvaik koottikko'ndu parnapaavudaneakooda ma'rupadiyum erusaleamukkup poanean.

naan theava a'rivippinaalea poay, pu'rajaathika'lidaththil naan pirasangkikki'ra suviseashaththai avarka'lukku vivariththuk kaa'npiththean; aayinum naan oaduki'rathum, oadinathum vee'naakaathapadikku e'n'nikkaiyu'l'lavarka'lukkea thanimaiyaay vivariththuk kaa'npiththean.
aanaalum ennudaneakooda iruntha theeththu kireakkanaayirunthum viruththaseathanampa'n'nikko'l'lumpadikkuk kattaayampa'n'nappadavillai.

ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l namakku u'ndaana suyaatheenaththai u'lavupaarththu nammai niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku adimaika'laakkumporuttaakap pakkavazhiyaay nuzhaintha ka'l'lach sakoatharar nimiththam appadiyaayit'ru.
suviseashaththin saththiyam ungka'lidaththilea nilaiththirukkumpadi, naangka'l oru naazhikaiyaakilum avarka'lukkuk keezhppadinthu i'nangkavillai.

allaamalum e'n'nikkaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthavarka'l enakku on'rum poathikkavillai; avarka'l eppadippattavarka'laayirunthaalum enakkuk kavalaiyillai, theavan manusharidaththil padchapaathamu'l'lavarallavea.
athuvumallaamal, viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lukku appoasthalanaayirukkumpadi peathuruvaip palappaduththinavar pu'rajaathika'lukku appoasthalanaayirukkumpadi ennaiyum palappaduththinapadiyaal,

viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lukkuch suviseashaththaip pirasangkikkumpadi peathuruvukkuk kaiya'likkappattathupoala, viruththaseathanam illaathavarka'lukkup pirasangkikkumpadi athu enakkum kaiya'likkappattathen'ru avarka'l ka'ndu;

enakku a'likkappatta kirupaiyai a'rinthapoathu, thoo'nka'laaka e'n'nappatta yaakkoapum, keapaavum, yoavaanum, thaangka'l viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lukkum, naangka'l pu'rajaathika'lukkum pirasangkikkumpadi, anniyoanniya aikkiyaththi'rku adaiyaa'lamaaka enakkum parnapaavukkum valathukai koduththu,
thariththirarai ninaiththukko'l'lumpadikkumaaththiram sonnaarka'l; appadich seyyumpadi atha'rku munnamea naanum karuththu'l'lavanaayirunthean.
mealum, peathuru anthiyoakiyaavukku vanthapoathu, avanmeal kut'ragn sumanthathinaal, naan mukamukamaay avanoadea ethirththean.
eppadiyenil, yaakkoapinidaththilirunthu silar varuki'ratha'rkumunnea avan pu'rajaathiyaarudanea saappittaan; avarka'l vanthapoathoa, viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lukkup payanthu, vilakip pirinthaan.
mat'ra yootharum avanudaneakooda maayampa'n'ninaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya maayaththinaalea parnapaavum izhuppu'ndaan.

ippadi avarka'l suviseashaththin saththiyaththi'rkeat'rapadi sariyaay nadavaathathai naan ka'ndapoathu, ellaarukkum munpaaka naan peathuruvai noakkich sonnathu ennaven'raal: yoothanaayirukki'ra neer yoothar mu'raimaiyaaka nadavaamal, pu'rajaathiyaar mu'raimaiyaaka nadanthuko'ndirukka, pu'rajaathiyaarai yoothar mu'raimaiyaaka nadakkumpadi neer eppadik kattaayampa'n'nalaam?

pu'rajaathiyaaril pi'rantha paavika'laayiraamal, supaavaththinpadi yootharaayirukki'ra naamum iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaaleayan'ri, niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaalea manushan neethimaanaakkappaduvathillaiyen'ru a'rinthu, niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaalalla, ki'risthuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaanka'laakkappadumpadikkuk ki'risthu iyeasuvinmeal visuvaasika'laanoam.
niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaalea entha manushanum neethimaanaakkappaduvathillaiyea.
ki'risthuvukku'l neethimaanka'laakkappadumpadi naaduki'ra naamum paavika'laakak kaa'nappaduvoamaanaal, ki'risthu paavaththi'rkuk kaara'naroa? allavea.
naan idiththuppoattavaika'laiyea naan ma'rupadiyum kattinaal, piramaa'naththai mee'ruki'ravanen'ru kaa'nappaduvean.
theavanukken'ru pizhaikkumpadi naan niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku mariththeanea.

ki'risthuvudaneakoodach siluvaiyila'raiyappattean; aayinum, pizhaiththirukki'rean; ini naan alla, ki'risthuvea enakku'l pizhaiththirukki'raar; naan ippozhuthu maamsaththil pizhaiththirukki'rathoa, ennil anpukoornthu enakkaakath thammaiththaamea oppukkoduththa theavanudaiya kumaaranaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea pizhaiththirukki'rean.
naan theavanudaiya kirupaiyai viruthaavaakkuki'rathillai; neethiyaanathu niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea varumaanaal, ki'risthu mariththathu vee'naayirukkumea.

puththiyillaatha kalaaththiyarea, neengka'l saththiyaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoakaththakkathaaka ungka'lai mayakkinavan yaar? iyeasuki'risthu siluvaiyila'raiyappattavaraaka ungka'l ka'nka'lukkumun piraththiyadchamaay ungka'lukku'l'lea ve'lippaduththappattirunthaarea.
on'raimaaththiram ungka'lidaththil a'riya virumpuki'rean; niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaaleayoa, visuvaasak kea'lviyinaaleayoa, ethinaalea aaviyaip pet'reerka'l?
aaviyinaalea aarampampa'n'nina neengka'l ippozhuthu maamsaththinaalea mudivupe'rappoaki'reerka'loa? neengka'l iththanai puththiyeenaraa?
iththanai paaduka'laiyum vee'naayp patteerka'loa? avaika'l vee'naayppoayit'rea.
an'riyum ungka'lukku aaviyai a'liththu, ungka'lukku'l'lea a'rputhangka'lai nadappikki'ravar athai niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaika'linaaleayoa, visuvaasak kea'lviyinaaleayoa, ethinaalea seyki'raar?
appadiyea aapirakaam theavanai visuvaasiththaan, athu avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu.
aakaiyaal visuvaasamaarkkaththaarka'l evarka'loa avarka'lea aapirakaamin pi'l'laika'len'ru a'riveerka'laaka.

mealum theavan visuvaasaththinaalea pu'rajaathika'lai neethimaanka'laakkuki'raaren'ru veatham munnaakak ka'ndu: unakku'l sakala jaathika'lum aaseervathikkappadum en'ru aapirakaamukkuch suviseashamaay munna'riviththathu.
anthappadi visuvaasamaarkkaththaar visuvaasamu'l'la aapirakaamudanea aaseervathikkappaduki'raarka'l.

niyaayappiramaa'naththin kiriyaikkaararaakiya yaavarum saapaththi'rkudpattirukki'raarka'l; niyaayappiramaa'na pusthakaththil ezhuthappattavaika'laiyellaam seyyaththakkathaaka avaika'lil nilaiththiraathavan evanoa avan sapikkappattavan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.

niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea oruvanum theavanidaththil neethimaanaaki'rathillaiyenpathu ve'liyarangkamaayirukki'rathu. eanenil, visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaan pizhaippaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.
niyaayappiramaa'namoa visuvaasaththi'rkuriyathalla; avaika'laich seyki'ra manushanea avaika'laal pizhaippaan.
maraththilea thookkappatta evanum sapikkappattavan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rapadi, ki'risthu namakkaakach saapamaaki, niyaayappiramaa'naththin saapaththi'rku nammai neengkalaakki meettukko'ndaar.

aapirakaamukku u'ndaana aaseervaatham ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal pu'rajaathika'lukku varumpadiyaakavum, aaviyaikku'riththuch sollappatta vaakkuththaththaththai naam visuvaasaththinaalea pe'rumpadiyaakavum ippadiyaayit'ru.
sakoathararea, manushar mu'raimaiyinpadi solluki'rean; manusharka'lukku'l'lea u'ruthipa'n'nappatta udanpadikkaiyai oruvanum tha'l'luki'rathumillai, athinoadea on'raiyum koottuki'rathumillai.

aapirakaamukkum avanudaiya santhathikkum vaakkuththaththangka'l pa'n'nappattana; santhathika'lukku en'ru aneakaraikku'riththuch sollaamal, un santhathikku en'ru oruvanaikku'riththuch solliyirukki'raar, anthach santhathi ki'risthuvea.

aathalaal naan solluki'rathennavenil, ki'risthuvai munnittuth theavanaal mun u'ruthipa'n'nappatta udanpadikkaiyai naanoot'rumuppathu varushaththi'rkuppinpu u'ndaana niyaayappiramaa'namaanathu tha'l'li, vaakkuththaththaththai viyarththamaakkamaattaathu.
an'riyum, suthantharamaanathu niyaayappiramaa'naththinaalea u'ndaanaal athu vaakkuththaththaththinaalea u'ndaayiraathu; theavan athai aapirakaamukku vaakkuththaththaththinaalea aru'lichseythaarea.

appadiyaanaal, niyaayappiramaa'naththin noakkamenna? vaakkuththaththaththaippet'ra santhathi varuma'lavum athu akkiramangka'linimiththamaakak koottappattu, theavathootharaikko'ndu maththiyasthan kaiyilea katta'laiyidappattathu.
maththiyasthan oruvanukkuriyavanalla, theavanoa oruvar.

appadiyaanaal, niyaayappiramaa'nam theavanudaiya vaakkuththaththangka'lukku viroathamaa? allavea; uyiraik kodukkaththakka niyaayappiramaa'nam aru'lappattirunthathaanaal, neethiyaanathu niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal u'ndaayirukkumea.

appadiyiraathapadiyaal, iyeasuki'risthuvaip pat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea palikki'ra vaakkuththaththam visuvaasamu'l'lavarka'lukku a'likkappadumpadi veatham ellaaraiyum eakamaayp paavaththinkeezh adaiththuppoattathu.
aathalaal visuvaasam varuki'ratha'rkumunnea, ve'lippadappoaki'ra visuvaasaththi'rku eathuvaaka naam adaikkappattavarka'laay niyaayappiramaa'naththinkeezh kaavalpa'n'nappattirunthoam.
ivvithamaaka, naam visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaanka'laakkappaduvatha'rku niyaayappiramaa'nam nammaik ki'risthuvinidaththil vazhinadaththuki'ra upaaththiyaay irunthathu.
visuvaasam vanthapinpu naam upaaththikkuk keezhaanavarka'lallavea.
neengka'lellaarum ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaal theavanudaiya puththiraraayirukki'reerka'lea.
eanenil, ungka'lil ki'risthuvukku'l'laaka gnaanasnaanam pet'ravarka'l eththanaipearoa, aththanaipearum ki'risthuvaith thariththukko'ndeerka'lea.
yoothanen'rum kireakkanen'rumillai, adimaiyen'rum suyaatheenanen'rumillai, aa'nen'rum pe'n'nen'rumillai; neengka'lellaarum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l on'raayirukki'reerka'l.
neengka'l ki'risthuvinudaiyavarka'laanaal, aapirakaamin santhathiyaaraayum, vaakkuththaththaththinpadiyea suthanthararaayum irukki'reerka'l.
pinnum naan solluki'rathennavenil, suthantharavaa'liyaanavan ellaavat'ri'rkum ejamaanaayirunthum, avan si'rupi'l'laiyaayirukkungkaalama'lavum, avanukkum adimaiyaanavanukkum viththiyaasamillai.
thakappan ku'riththa kaalamvaraikkum avan kaariyakkaararukkum veettu visaara'naikkaararukkum keezhppattirukki'raan.
appadiyea naamum si'rupi'l'laika'laayiruntha kaalaththil ivvulakaththin vazhipaaduka'lukku adimaippattavarka'laayirunthoam.
naam puththirasuvikaaraththaiyadaiyumpadi niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhppattavarka'lai meettukko'l'laththakkathaaka,
kaalam ni'raivea'rinapoathu, sthireeyinidaththi'r pi'ranthavarum niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhaanavarumaakiya thammudaiya kumaaranaith theavan anuppinaar.
mealum neengka'l puththiraraayirukki'rapadiyinaal, appaa, pithaavea! en'ru kooppidaththakkathaakath theavan thamathu kumaaranudaiya aaviyai ungka'l iruthayangka'lil anuppinaar.
aakaiyaal ini nee adimaiyaayiraamal puththiranaayirukki'raay; nee puththiraneayaanaal, ki'risthumoolamaayth theavanudaiya suthantharanaayumirukki'raay.
neengka'l theavanai a'riyaamalirunthapoathu, supaavaththinpadi theavarka'lallaathavarka'lukku adimaika'laayiruntheerka'l.

ippozhuthoa neengka'l theavanai a'rinthirukka, allathu theavanaalea a'riyappattirukka, pelanat'rathum ve'rumaiyaanathumaana avvazhipaaduka'lukku neengka'l ma'rupadiyum thirumpi, ma'rupadiyum avaika'lukku adimaippadumpadi virumpuki'ratheppadi?
naadka'laiyum, maathangka'laiyum, kaalangka'laiyum, varushangka'laiyum paarkki'reerka'lea.
naan ungka'lukkaakap pirayaasappattathu vee'naayppoayit'roa en'ru ungka'laikku'riththup payanthirukki'rean.
sakoathararea, ennaippoalaakungka'l en'ru ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; naan ungka'laippoalumaaneanea. enakku neengka'l aniyaayam on'rum seyyavillai.
ungka'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, naan sareera palaveenaththoadu muthalaantharam ungka'lukkuch suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththean.
appadiyirunthum, en sareeraththil u'ndaayirukki'ra soathanaiyai neengka'l asattaipa'n'naamalum, aroasiyaamalum, theavathoothanaippoalavum, ki'risthu iyeasuvaippoalavum, ennai eat'rukko'ndeerka'l.
appozhuthu neengka'l ko'ndiruntha aanantha paakkiyam engkea? ungka'l ka'nka'laip pidungki enakkuk kodukkakkoodumaanaal, appadiyum seythiruppeerka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaayirukki'rean.
naan ungka'lukkuch saththiyaththaich sonnathinaalea ungka'lukkuch saththuruvaaneanoa?

avarka'l ungka'lai naadi vairaakkiyam paaraattuki'raarka'l; aakilum nalmanathoadea appadich seyyaamal, neengka'l avarka'lai naadi vairaakkiyam paaraattumporuttu ungka'laip pu'rampaakka virumpuki'raarka'l.
nalvishayaththil vairaakkiyam paaraattuvathu nallathuthaan; athai naan ungka'lidaththil irukkumpozhuthumaaththiramalla, eppozhuthum paaraattavea'ndum.
en si'rupi'l'laika'lea, ki'risthu ungka'lidaththil uruvaakuma'lavum ungka'lukkaaka ma'rupadiyum karppaveathanaippaduki'rean;
ungka'laikku'riththu naan santheakappaduki'rapadiyaal, naan ippozhuthu ungka'lidaththil vanthirunthu, vea'ruvakaiyaakap peasa virumpuki'rean.
niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhppattirukka virumpuki'ra neengka'l niyaayappiramaa'nam solluki'rathaik keadkavillaiyaa? ithai enakkuch sollungka'l.
aapirakaamukku ira'ndu kumaarar irunthaarka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu; oruvan adimaiyaanava'lidaththil pi'ranthavan, oruvan suyaatheenamu'l'lava'lidaththil pi'ranthavan.
adimaiyaanava'lidaththil pi'ranthavan maamsaththinpadi pi'ranthaan, suyaatheenamu'l'lava'lidaththil pi'ranthavan vaakkuththaththaththinpadi pi'ranthaan.

ivaika'l gnaana arththamu'l'lavaika'l; antha sthireeka'l ira'ndu ea'rpaaduka'laam; on'ru seenaaymalaiyilu'ndaana ea'rpaadu, athu adimaiththanaththi'rku'l'laakap pi'l'laipe'ruki'rathu, athu aakaar enpava'lthaanea.
aakaar enpathu arapitheasaththilu'l'la seenaaymalai; antha aakaar ippozhuthirukki'ra erusaleamukkuch sari; iva'l than pi'l'laika'loadeakooda adimaippattirukki'raa'lea.
mealaana erusaleamoa suyaatheenamu'l'lava'l, ava'lea nammellaarukkum thaayaanava'l.

anthappadi pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyea, makizhnthiru; karppaveathanaippadaathava'lea, ka'lippaay ezhumpi aarppari; purushanu'l'lava'laippaarkkilum anaatha sthireekkea athika pi'l'laika'lu'ndu en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.
sakoathararea, naam eesaakkaippoala vaakkuththaththaththup pi'l'laika'laayirukki'roam.
aakilum maamsaththinpadi pi'ranthavan aaviyinpadi pi'ranthavanai appozhuthu thunpappaduththinathupoala, ippozhuthum nadanthuvaruki'rathu.

athaikku'riththu veatham enna solluki'rathu: adimaiyaanava'lin makan suyaatheenamu'l'lava'ludaiya kumaaranoadea suthantharavaa'liyaayiruppathillai; aakaiyaal adimaiyaanava'laiyum, ava'ludaiya makanaiyum pu'rampea tha'l'lu en'ru solluki'rathu.
ippadiyirukka, sakoathararea, naam adimaiyaanava'lukkup pi'l'laika'laayiraamal, suyaatheenamu'l'lava'lukkea pi'l'laika'laayirukki'roam.
aanapadiyinaalea, neengka'l ma'rupadiyum adimaiththanaththin nukaththukkudpadaamal, ki'risthu namakku u'ndaakkina suyaatheena nilaimaiyilea nilaiko'ndirungka'l.
ithoa, neengka'l viruththaseathanampa'n'nikko'ndaal ki'risthuvinaal ungka'lukku oru pirayoajanamumiraathu en'ru pavulaakiya naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.

mealum, viruththaseathanampa'n'nikko'l'luki'ra entha manushanum niyaayappiramaa'nam muzhuvathaiyum ni'raiveat'rak kadanaa'liyaayirukki'raan en'ru ma'rupadiyum appadippattavanukkuch saadchiyaakach solluki'rean.
niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal neethimaanka'laaka virumpuki'ra neengka'l yaavarum ki'risthuvaivittup pirinthu kirupaiyinin'ru vizhuntheerka'l.
naangka'loa neethikidaikkumen'ru aaviyaikko'ndu visuvaasaththinaal nampikkaiyoadea kaaththirukki'roam.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinidaththil viruththaseathanamum viruththaseathanamillaamaiyum on'rukkum uthavaathu, anpinaal kiriyaiseyki'ra visuvaasamea uthavum.
neengka'l nan'raay oadineerka'lea; saththiyaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaama'rpoaka ungka'lukkuth thadaiseythavan yaar?
inthap poathanai ungka'lai azhaiththavaraal u'ndaanathalla.
pu'lippu'l'la kognchamaavaanathu pisaintha maavanaiththaiyum uppappa'n'num.

neengka'l vea'ruvithamaaych sinthikkamaatteerka'len'ru naan karththarukku'l ungka'laikku'riththu nampikkaiyaayirukki'rean; ungka'laik kalakkuki'ravan eppadippattavanaayirunthaalum thanakkeat'ra aakkinaiyai adaivaan.

sakoathararea, ithuvaraikkum naan viruththaseathanaththaip pirasangkikki'ravanaayirunthaal, ithuvaraikkum ennaththi'rkuth thunpappaduki'rean? appadiyaanaal siluvaiyaippat'ri varum ida'ral ozhinthirukkumea.
ungka'laik kalakkuki'ravarka'l tha'rippu'ndupoanaal nalamaayirukkum.
sakoathararea, neengka'l suyaatheenaththi'rku azhaikkappatteerka'l, inthach suyaatheenaththai neengka'l maamsaththi'rkeathuvaaka anusariyaamal, anpinaalea oruvarukkoruvar oozhiyagnseyyungka'l.
unnidaththil nee anpukooruvathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka, enki'ra intha orea vaarththaiyilea niyaayappiramaa'nam muzhuvathum ni'raivea'rum.
neengka'l oruvaraiyoruvar kadiththup padchiththeerka'laanaal azhiveerka'l, appadi oruvaraaloruvar azhikkappadaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
pinnum naan solluki'rathennaven'raal, aavikkeat'rapadi nadanthuko'l'lungka'l, appozhuthu maamsa ichchaiyai ni'raiveat'raathiruppeerka'l.

maamsam aavikku viroathamaakavum, aavi maamsaththukku viroathamaakavum ichchikki'rathu; neengka'l seyyavea'ndumen'rirukki'ravaika'laich seyyaathapadikku, ivaika'l on'rukkon'ru viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
aaviyinaal nadaththappaduveerka'laanaal, neengka'l niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuk keezhppattavarka'lalla.
maamsaththin kiriyaika'l ve'liyarangkamaayirukkin'rana; avaiyaavana: vipasaaram, veasiththanam, asuththam, kaamavikaaram,
vikkirakaaraathanai, pillisooniyam, pakaika'l, viroathangka'l, vairaakkiyangka'l, koapangka'l, sa'ndaika'l, pirivinaika'l, maarkkapeathangka'l,

po'raamaika'l, kolaika'l, ve'rika'l, ka'liyaattuka'l muthalaanavaika'lea; ippadippattavaika'laich seyki'ravarka'l theavanudaiya raajyaththaich suthantharippathillaiyen'ru munnea naan sonnathupoala ippozhuthum ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
aaviyin kaniyoa, anpu, santhoasham, samaathaanam, neediyapo'rumai, thayavu, na'rku'nam, visuvaasam,
saantham, ichchaiyadakkam; ippadippattavaika'lukku viroathamaana piramaa'nam on'rumillai.
ki'risthuvinudaiyavarka'l thangka'l maamsaththaiyum athin aasai ichchaika'laiyum siluvaiyil a'rainthirukki'raarka'l.
naam aaviyinaalea pizhaiththirunthaal, aavikkeat'rapadi nadakkavum kadavoam.
vee'n pukazhchchiyai virumpaamalum, oruvaraiyoruvar koapamoottaamalum, oruvarmeal oruvar po'raamaiko'l'laamalum irukkakkadavoam.

sakoathararea, oruvan yaathoru kut'raththil akappattaal, aavikkuriyavarka'laakiya neengka'l saanthamu'l'la aaviyoadea appadippattavanaich seerporunthappa'n'nungka'l; neeyum soathikkappadaathapadikku unnaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayiru.
oruvar paaraththai oruvar sumanthu, ippadiyea ki'risthuvinudaiya piramaa'naththai ni'raiveat'rungka'l.
oruvan, thaan on'rumillaathirunthum, thannai oru porutten'ru e'n'ninaal, thannaiththaanea vagnchikki'ravanaavaan.
avanavan thanthan suyakiriyaiyaich soathiththuppaarkkakkadavan; appozhuthu mat'ravanaip paarkkumpoathalla, thannaiyea paarkkumpoathu meanmaipaaraatta avanukku idamu'ndaakum.
avanavan thanthan paaraththaich sumappaanea.
mealum, thiruvasanaththil upatheasikkappaduki'ravan upatheasikki'ravanukkuch sakala nanmaika'lilum pakirnthukodukkakkadavan.
moasampoakaathirungka'l, theavan thammaip pariyaasampa'n'navottaar; manushan ethai vithaikki'raanoa athaiyea a'ruppaan.
than maamsaththi'rken'ru vithaikki'ravan maamsaththinaal azhivai a'ruppaan; aavikken'ru vithaikki'ravan aaviyinaalea niththiyajeevanai a'ruppaan.
nanmaiseyki'rathil soarnthupoakaamal iruppoamaaka; naam tha'larnthupoakaathirunthaal eat'rakaalaththil a'ruppoam.
aakaiyaal namakkuk kidaikkum samayaththi'rkuththakkathaaka, yaavarukkum, viseashamaaka visuvaasa kudumpaththaarka'lukkum, nanmaiseyyakkadavoam.
en kaiyezhuththaay evva'lavu ezhuthineanen'ru paarungka'l.

maamsaththinpadi nalveashamaayk kaa'nappada virumpuki'ravarka'l evarka'loa, avarka'l thaangka'l ki'risthuvinudaiya siluvaiyinimiththam thunpappadaathapadikkea ungka'lai viruththaseathanam pa'n'nikko'l'lak kattaayampa'n'nuki'raarka'l.

viruththaseathanam adainthirukki'ra avarka'lum niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'l'laamalirukki'raarka'l; appadiyirunthum, avarka'l ungka'l maamsaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattumpadikku neengka'l viruththaseathanampa'n'nikko'l'lavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'raarka'l.

naanoa nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin siluvaiyaik ku'riththeayallaamal vea'ron'raiyungku'riththu meanmaipaaraattaathiruppeanaaka; avaraal ulakam enakkuch siluvaiyila'raiyu'ndirukki'rathu, naanum ulakaththi'rkuch siluvaiyila'raiyu'ndirukki'rean.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l viruththaseathanamum on'rumillai, viruththaseathanamillaamaiyum on'rumillai; puthu sirushdiyea kaariyam.
inthap piramaa'naththinpadi nadanthuvaruki'ravarka'l evarka'loa, avarka'lukkum, theavanudaiya isravealarukkum, samaathaanamum irakkamum u'ndaayiruppathaaka.
inimeal oruvanum enakku varuththam u'ndaakkaathiruppaanaaka; karththaraakiya iyeasuvinudaiya achchadaiyaa'langka'lai naan en sareeraththilea thariththukko'ndirukki'rean.
sakoathararea, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupai ungka'l aaviyudaneakooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya appoasthalanaakiya pavul, epeasuvilea ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l visuvaasika'laayirukki'ra parisuththavaanka'lukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaakiya theavanukku sthoaththiram; avar ki'risthuvukku'l unnathangka'lilea aavikkuriya sakala aaseervaathaththinaalum nammai aaseervathiththirukki'raar.
thamakkumunpaaka naam anpil parisuththamu'l'lavarka'lum kut'ramillaathavarka'lumaayiruppatha'rku, avar ulakaththoat'raththukkumunnea ki'risthuvukku'l nammaith therinthuko'ndapadiyea,
piriyamaanavarukku'l thaam namakkuth thantharu'lina thammudaiya kirupaiyin makimaikkup pukazhchchiyaaka,
thammudaiya thayavu'l'la siththaththinpadiyea, nammai iyeasuki'risthumoolamaayth thamakkuch suvikaarapuththiraraakumpadi munku'riththirukki'raar.
avarudaiya kirupaiyin aisuvariyaththinpadiyea ivarudaiya iraththaththinaalea paavamannippaakiya meedpu ivarukku'l namakku u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
anthak kirupaiyai avar sakala gnaanaththoadum puththiyoadum engka'lidaththil perukappa'n'ninaar.
kaalangka'l ni'raivea'rumpoathu vi'langkum niyamaththinpadi paraloakaththilirukki'ravaika'lum pooloakaththilirukki'ravaika'lumaakiya sakalamum ki'risthuvukku'l'lea koottappadavea'ndumen'ru,
thamakku'l'lea theermaaniththiruntha thammudaiya thayavu'l'la siththaththin irakasiyaththai engka'lukku a'riviththaar.
mealum ki'risthuvinmeal munnea nampikkaiyaayiruntha naangka'l avarudaiya makimaikkup pukazhchchiyaayirukkumpadikku,

thamathu siththaththin aaloasanaikkuththakkathaaka ellaavat'raiyum nadappikki'ra avarudaiya theermaanaththinpadiyea, naangka'l munku'rikkappattu, ki'risthuvukku'l avarudaiya suthantharamaakumpadi therinthuko'l'lappattoam.
neengka'lum ungka'l iradchippin suviseashamaakiya saththiya vasanaththaik keattu, visuvaasika'laanapoathu, vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappatta parisuththaaaviyaal avarukku'l muththiraipoadappatteerka'l.
avarukkuch sonthamaanavarka'l avarudaiya makimaikkup pukazhchchiyaaka meedkappaduvaarka'l enpatha'rku aaviyaanavar nammudaiya suthantharaththin achchaaramaayirukki'raar.
aanapadiyinaalea, karththaraakiya iyeasuvinmealu'l'la ungka'l visuvaasaththaiyum, parisuththavaanka'lellaarmealumu'l'la ungka'l anpaiyungku'riththu naan kea'lvippattu,
idaividaamal ungka'lukkaaka sthoaththirampa'n'ni, en jepangka'lil ungka'lai ninaiththu,

nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin theavanum makimaiyin pithaavumaanavar thammai neengka'l a'rinthuko'lvatha'rkaana gnaanaththaiyum the'livaiyum a'likki'ra aaviyai ungka'lukkuth thantharu'lavea'ndumen'rum,
thaam nammai azhaiththathinaalea namakku u'ndaayirukki'ra nampikkai innathen'rum, parisuththavaanka'lidaththil thamakku u'ndaayirukki'ra suthantharaththinudaiya makimaiyin aisuvariyam innathen'rum;

thaam ki'risthuvai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppi, avaridaththil nadappiththa thamathu palaththa saththuvaththin vallamaippadiyea visuvaasikki'ravarka'laakiya nammidaththilea kaa'npikkum thammudaiya vallamaiyin makaa meanmaiyaana makaththuvam innathen'rum, neengka'l a'riyumpadikku, avar ungka'lukkup pirakaasamu'l'la manakka'nka'laik kodukkavea'ndumen'rum vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.

ellaath thuraiththanaththukkum, athikaaraththukkum, vallamaikkum, karththaththuvaththukkum, immaiyilmaaththiramalla ma'rumaiyilum pearpet'rirukkum ellaa naamaththukkum mealaay avar uyarnthirukkaththakkathaaka,
avarai unnathangka'lil thammudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarumpadi seythu,
ellaavat'raiyum avarudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththi,
ellaavat'raiyum ellaavat'raalum nirappuki'ravarudaiya ni'raivaakiya sareeramaana sapaikku avarai ellaavat'ri'rkum mealaana thalaiyaakath thantharu'linaar.
akkiramangka'linaalum paavangka'linaalum mariththavarka'laayiruntha ungka'lai uyirppiththaar.

avaika'lil neengka'l mu'rkaalaththilea ivvulaka vazhakkaththi'rkeat'rapadiyaakavum, keezhppadiyaamaiyin pi'l'laika'lidaththil ippozhuthu kiriyaiseyki'ra aakaayaththu athikaarap pirapuvaakiya aavikkeat'rapadiyaakavum nadanthuko'ndeerka'l.

avarka'lukku'l'lea naamellaarum mu'rkaalaththilea namathu maamsa ichchaiyinpadiyea nadanthu, namathu maamsamum manasum virumpinavaika'laich seythu, supaavaththinaalea mat'ravarka'laippoalak koapaakkinaiyin pi'l'laika'laayirunthoam.
theavanoa irakkaththil aisuvariyamu'l'lavaraay nammil anpukoorntha thammudaiya mikuntha anpinaalea,
akkiramangka'lil mariththavarka'laayiruntha nammaik ki'risthuvudaneakooda uyirppiththaar; kirupaiyinaalea iradchikkappatteerka'l.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l avar nammidaththil vaiththa thayavinaalea, thammudaiya kirupaiyin makaa meanmaiyaana aisuvariyaththai varungkaalangka'lil vi'langkachseyvatha'rkaaka,
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l nammai avaroadeakooda ezhuppi, unnathangka'lilea avaroadeakooda udkaaravum seythaar.
kirupaiyinaalea visuvaasaththaikko'ndu iradchikkappatteerka'l; ithu ungka'laal u'ndaanathalla, ithu theavanudaiya eevu;
oruvarum perumaipaaraattaathapadikku ithu kiriyaika'linaal u'ndaanathalla;

eanenil, na'rkiriyaika'laich seyki'ratha'rku naam ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l sirushdikkappattu, theavanudaiya seykaiyaayirukki'roam; avaika'lil naam nadakkumpadi avar munnathaaka avaika'lai aayaththampa'n'niyirukki'raar.
aanapadiyinaal munnea maamsaththinpadi pu'rajaathiyaaraayirunthu, maamsaththil kaiyinaalea seyyappaduki'ra viruththaseathanamudaiyavarka'laal viruththaseathanamillaathavarka'lennappatta neengka'l,

akkaalaththilea ki'risthuvaich searaathavarka'lum, isravealudaiya kaa'niyaadchikkup pu'rampaanavarka'lum, vaakkuththaththaththin udanpadikkaika'lukku anniyarum, nampikkaiyillaathavarka'lum, ivvulakaththil theavanat'ravarka'lumaayiruntheerka'len'ru ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l.
munnea thooramaayiruntha neengka'l ippozhuthu ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l ki'risthuvin iraththaththinaalea sameepamaaneerka'l.
eppadiyenil, avarea nammudaiya samaathaana kaara'naraaki, iruthi'raththaaraiyum on'raakki, pakaiyaaka nin'ra pirivinaiyaakiya naduchsuvaraith thakarththu,

sattathittangka'laakiya niyaayappiramaa'naththaith thammudaiya maamsaththinaalea ozhiththu, iruthi'raththaaraiyum thamakku'l'laaka orea puthiya manushanaakach sirushdiththu, ippadich samaathaanampa'n'ni,
pakaiyaich siluvaiyinaal kon'ru, athinaalea iruthi'raththaaraiyum orea sareeramaakath theavanukku oppuravaakkinaar.
allaamalum avar vanthu, thooramaayiruntha ungka'lukkum, sameepamaayiruntha avarka'lukkum, samaathaanaththaich suviseashamaaka a'riviththaar.
anthappadiyea naam iruthi'raththaarum orea aaviyinaalea pithaavinidaththil searum silaakkiyaththai avarmoolamaayp pet'rirukki'roam.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l ini anniyarum paratheasika'lumaayiraamal, parisuththavaanka'loadea orea nakaraththaarum theavanudaiya veettaarumaayirunthu,
appoasthalar theerkkatharisika'l enpavarka'ludaiya asthipaaraththinmeal kattappattavarka'lumaayirukki'reerka'l; atha'rku iyeasuki'risthu thaamea moolaikkallaayirukki'raar;
avarmeal maa'likai muzhuvathum isaivaay i'naikkappattu, karththarukku'l parisuththa aalayamaaka ezhumpuki'rathu;
avarmeal neengka'lum aaviyinaalea theavanudaiya vaasasthalamaakak koottikkattappattuvaruki'reerka'l.
ithinimiththam, pavulaakiya naan pu'rajaathiyaaraayirukki'ra ungka'lporuttuk ki'risthu iyeasuvinimiththam kattu'ndavanaayirukki'rean.
ungka'lukkaaka enakku a'likkappattirukki'ra theyvakirupaikkuriya niyamamum innathen'ru keattiruppeerka'lea;

athennavenil pu'rajaathika'l suviseashaththinaalea udan suthanthararumaay, orea sareeraththi'rku'l'laanavarka'lumaay, ki'risthuvukku'l avar pa'n'nina vaakkuththaththaththukku udanpangkaa'lika'lumaayirukki'raarka'lenki'ra intha irakasiyaththai avar enakku ve'lippaduththi a'riviththaar.
ithaikku'riththu naan munnamea surukkamaay ezhuthiyirukki'rean.
athai neengka'l vaasikkaiyil ki'risthuvin irakasiyaththaikku'riththu enakku u'ndaayirukki'ra a'rivai a'rinthuko'l'lalaam;

intha irakasiyam ippozhuthu avarudaiya parisuththa appoasthalarukkum theerkkatharisika'lukkum aaviyaanavaraalea ve'lippaduththappattirukki'rathupoala, mu'rkaalangka'lil manupuththirarukku a'rivikkappadavillai.
theavanudaiya palaththa saththuvaththaal enakku a'likkappatta varamaakiya avarudaiya kirupaiyinaalea inthach suviseashaththukku oozhiyakkaaranaanean.

parisuththavaanka'lellaarilum si'riyavanaakiya naan ki'risthuvinudaiya a'lavat'ra aisuvariyaththaip pu'rajaathika'lidaththil suviseashamaay a'rivikki'ratha'rkaaka inthak kirupai enakku a'likkappattirukki'rathu.
theavan nammudaiya karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l ko'ndiruntha anaathi theermaanaththinpadiyea,
unnathangka'lilu'l'la thuraiththanangka'lukkum athikaarangka'lukkum avarudaiya anantha gnaanamaanathu sapaiyinmoolamaay ippozhuthu theriyavarumporuttaaka,

iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu ellaavat'raiyum sirushdiththa theavanukku'l'lea aathikaalangka'l muthal ma'rainthiruntha irakasiyaththinudaiya aikkiyam innathen'ru, ellaarukkum ve'lippadaiyaakak kaa'npikki'ratha'rku, inthak kirupai enakku a'likkappattirukki'rathu.
avaraip pat'rum visuvaasaththaal avarukku'l namakkuth thairiyamum thidanampikkaiyoadea theavanidaththil searum silaakkiyamum u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal ungka'lnimiththam naan anupavikki'ra upaththiravangka'linaal neengka'l soarnthupoakaathirukka vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; avaika'l ungka'lukku makimaiyaayirukki'rathea.
ithinimiththam naan paraloakaththilum pooloakaththilumu'l'la muzhukkudumpaththukkum naamakaara'naraakiya,
nammudaiya karththaraayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya pithaavai noakki muzhangkaalpadiyittu,
neengka'l avarudaiya aaviyinaalea u'l'laana manushanil vallamaiyaayp palappadavum,
visuvaasaththinaalea ki'risthu ungka'l iruthayangka'lil vaasamaayirukkavum, neengka'l anpilea vearoon'ri, nilaipet'ravarka'laaki,
sakala parisuththavaanka'loadungkoodak ki'risthuvinudaiya anpin akalamum, nee'lamum, aazhamum, uyaramum innathen'ru u'narnthu;

a'rivukkettaatha antha anpai a'rinthuko'l'la vallavarka'laakavum, theavanudaiya sakala paripoora'naththaalum ni'raiyappadavum, avar thamathu makimaiyinudaiya aisuvariyaththinpadiyea, ungka'lukku anukkirakam pa'n'navea'ndumen'ru vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naam vea'ndikko'l'luki'ratha'rkum ninaikki'ratha'rkum mikavum athikamaay namakku'l'lea kiriyaiseyki'ra vallamaiyinpadiyea, namakkuch seyya vallavaraakiya avarukku,
sapaiyilea ki'risthu iyeasuvin moolamaayth thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum sathaakaalangka'lilum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
aathalaal, karththarnimiththam kattu'ndavanaakiya naan ungka'lukkuch solluki'ra puththiyennavenil, neengka'l azhaikkappatta azhaippukkup paaththiravaanka'laay nadanthu,
mikuntha manaththaazhmaiyum saanthamum neediya po'rumaiyum udaiyavarka'laay, anpinaal oruvaraiyoruvar thaangki,
samaathaanakkattinaal aaviyin orumaiyaik kaaththukko'lvatha'rku jaakkirathaiyaayirungka'l.
ungka'lukku u'ndaana azhaippinaalea neengka'l orea nampikkaikku azhaikkappattathupoala, orea sareeramum, orea aaviyum u'ndu;
orea karththarum, orea visuvaasamum, orea gnaanasnaanamum,
ellaarukkum orea theavanum pithaavum u'ndu; avar ellaarmealum, ellaaroadum, ungka'l ellaarukku'l'lum irukki'ravar.
ki'risthuvinudaiya eevin a'lavukkuththakkathaaka nammil avanavanukkuk kirupai a'likkappattirukki'rathu.
aathalaal, avar unnathaththi'rku ea'ri, si'raippattavarka'laich si'raiyaakki, manusharka'lukku varangka'lai a'liththaar en'ru solliyirukki'raar.
ea'rinaar enpathinaalea avar atha'rkumunnea poomiyin thaazhvidangka'lil i'rangkinaar en'ru vi'langkuki'rathallavaa?
i'rangkinavarea ellaavat'raiyum nirappaththakkathaaka, ellaa vaanangka'lukkum mealaaka unnathaththi'rku ea'rinavarumaayirukki'raar.

mealum naam anaivarum theavanudaiya kumaaranaip pat'rum visuvaasaththilum a'rivilum orumaippattavarka'laaki, ki'risthuvinudaiya ni'raivaana va'larchchiyin a'lavukkuththakka poora'napurusharaakumvaraikkum,
parisuththavaanka'l seerporunthumporuttu, suviseasha oozhiyaththin vealaikkaakavum, ki'risthuvin sareeramaakiya sapaiyaanathu pakthiviruththi adaivatha'rkaakavum,
avar, silarai appoasthalaraakavum, silaraith theerkkatharisika'laakavum, silaraich suviseashakaraakavum, silarai meaypparaakavum poathakaraakavum ea'rpaduththinaar.

naam inik kuzhanthaika'laayiraamal, manusharudaiya soothum vagnchikki'ratha'rkeathuvaana thanthiramumu'l'la poathakamaakiya palavitha kaat'rinaalea alaika'laippoala adipattu alaiki'ravarka'laayiraamal,
anpudan saththiyaththaik kaikko'ndu, thalaiyaakiya ki'risthuvukku'l ellaavat'rileayum, naam va'laruki'ravarka'laayirukkumpadiyaaka appadich seythaar.

avaraalea sareeram muzhuthum, atha'rku uthaviyaayirukki'ra sakala ka'nukka'linaalum isaivaayk kootti i'naikkappattu, ovvoru avayavamum thanthan a'lavukkuththakkathaayk kiriyaiseyki'rapadiyea, athu anpinaalea thanakkup pakthiviruththi u'ndaakkuki'ratha'rkeathuvaakach sareerava'larchchiyai u'ndaakkuki'rathu.

aathalaal, karththarukku'l naan ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaakach solli echcharikki'rathu ennavenil, mat'rap pu'rajaathika'l thangka'l vee'naana sinthaiyilea nadakki'rathupoala neengka'l ini nadavaamalirungka'l.
avarka'l puththiyil anthakaarappattu, thangka'l iruthayakadinaththinaal thangka'lil irukkum a'riyaamaiyinaalea theavanudaiya jeevanukku anniyaraayirunthu;
u'narvillaathavarka'laay, sakalavitha asuththangka'laiyum aavaloadea nadappikkumpadi, thangka'laik kaamavikaaraththi'rku oppukkoduththirukki'raarka'l.
neengka'loa ivvithamaayk ki'risthuvaik kat'rukko'l'lavillai.
iyeasuvinidaththilu'l'la saththiyaththinpadiyea, neengka'l avaridaththil keatta'rinthu, avaraal poathikkappatteerka'lea.
anthappadi, munthina nadakkaikkuriya moasampoakkum ichchaika'laalea kettuppoaki'ra pazhaiya manushanai neengka'l ka'lainthupoattu,
ungka'l u'l'laththilea puthithaana aaviyu'l'lavarka'laaki,
meyyaana neethiyilum parisuththaththilum theavanudaiya saayalaakach sirushdikkappatta puthiya manushanaith thariththukko'l'lungka'l.
an'riyum, naam oruvarukkoruvar avayavangka'laayirukki'rapadiyaal, poyyaik ka'lainthu, avanavan pi'ranudanea meyyaip peasakkadavan.
neengka'l koapangko'ndaalum paavagnseyyaathirungka'l; sooriyan asthamikki'ratha'rku munnaaka ungka'l erichchal tha'niyakkadavathu;
pisaasukku idangkodaamalum irungka'l.
thiruduki'ravan inith thirudaamal, ku'raichchalu'l'lavanukkuk kodukkaththakkathaakath thanakku u'ndaayirukkumpadi, than kaika'linaal nalamaana vealaiseythu, pirayaasappadakkadavan.
ketta vaarththai on'rum ungka'l vaayilirunthu pu'rappadavea'ndaam; pakthiviruththikku eathuvaana nalla vaarththai u'ndaanaal athaiyea keadki'ravarka'lukkup pirayoajanamu'ndaakumpadi peasungka'l.
an'riyum, neengka'l meedkappadum naa'lukken'ru muththiraiyaakap pet'ra theavanudaiya parisuththaaaviyaith thukkappaduththaathirungka'l.
sakalavithamaana kasappum, koapamum, moorkkamum, kookkuralum, thoosha'namum, mat'ra enthath thurkku'namum ungka'laivittu neengkakkadavathu.
oruvarukkoruvar thayavaayum manaurukkamaayum irunthu, ki'risthuvukku'l theavan ungka'lukku manniththathupoala, neengka'lum oruvarukkoruvar manniyungka'l.
aathalaal, neengka'l piriyamaana pi'l'laika'laippoalath theavanaip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laaki,
ki'risthu namakkaakath thammaith theavanukkuch sukantha vaasanaiyaana kaa'nikkaiyaakavum paliyaakavum oppukkoduththu nammil anpukoornthathupoala, neengka'lum anpilea nadanthuko'l'lungka'l.
mealum, parisuththavaanka'lukku eat'rapadi, veasiththanamum, mat'rentha asuththamum, poru'laasaiyum aakiya ivaika'lin pearmuthalaay ungka'lukku'l'lea sollappadavungkoodaathu.
appadiyea vampum, puththiyeenamaana peachchum, pariyaasamum thakaathavaika'l; sthoaththiragnseythalea thakum.

vipasaarakkaaranaavathu, asuththanaavathu, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaaranaakiya poru'laasaikkaaranaavathu theavanudaiya raajyamaakiya ki'risthuvin raajyaththilea suthantharamadaivathillaiyen'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.

ippadippattavaika'linimiththamaakak keezhppadiyaamaiyin pi'l'laika'lmeal theavakoapaakkinai varuvathaal, oruvanum ungka'lai vee'nvaarththaika'linaalea moasampoakkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l;
avarka'lukkup pangkaa'lika'laakaathirungka'l.
mu'rkaalaththil neengka'l anthakaaramaayiruntheerka'l, ippozhuthoa karththarukku'l ve'lichchamaayirukki'reerka'l; ve'lichchaththin pi'l'laika'laay nadanthuko'l'lungka'l.
aaviyin kani, sakala na'rku'naththilum neethiyilum u'nmaiyilum vi'langkum.
karththarukkup piriyamaanathu innathen'ru neengka'l soathiththuppaarungka'l.
kaniyat'ra anthakaarak kiriyaika'lukku udanpadaamal, avaika'laik kadinthuko'l'lungka'l.
avarka'laal o'lippidaththil seyyappadum kiriyaika'laich solluki'rathum avaladcha'namaayirukki'rathea.
avaika'lellaam kadinthuko'l'lappattu ve'lichchaththinaal ve'liyarangkamaakum; ve'liyarangkamaakkuki'rathellaam ve'lichchamaayirukki'rathu.
aathalaal, thoongkuki'ra nee vizhiththu, mariththoarai vittu ezhunthiru, appozhuthu ki'risthu unnaip pirakaasippippaaren'ru solliyirukki'raar.
aanapadiyinaalea, neengka'l gnaanamat'ravarka'laippoala nadavaamal, gnaanamu'l'lavarka'laippoalak kavanamaay nadanthuko'l'lappaarththu,
naadka'l pollaathavaika'laanathaal kaalaththaip pirayoajanappaduththikko'l'lungka'l.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l mathiyat'ravarka'laayiraamal, karththarudaiya siththam innathen'ru u'narnthuko'l'lungka'l.
thunmaarkkaththi'rku eathuvaana mathupaana ve'riko'l'laamal, aaviyinaal ni'rainthu;
sangkeethangka'linaalum keerththanaika'linaalum gnaanappaattuka'linaalum oruvarukkoruvar puththisollikko'ndu, ungka'l iruthayaththil karththaraip paadik keerththanampa'n'ni,
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea eppozhuthum ellaavat'ri'rkaakavum pithaavaakiya theavanai sthoaththiriththu,
theyva payaththoadea oruvarukkoruvar keezhppadinthirungka'l.
manaivika'lea, karththarukkuk keezhppadiki'rathupoala, ungka'l sonthap purusharukkung keezhppadiyungka'l.
ki'risthu sapaikkuth thalaiyaayirukki'rathupoala, purushanum manaivikkuth thalaiyaayirukki'raan; avarea sareeraththi'rkum iradchakaraayirukki'raar.
aakaiyaal, sapaiyaanathu ki'risthuvukkuk keezhppadiki'rathupoala manaivika'lum thangka'l sonthap purusharka'lukku enthak kaariyaththileayum keezhppadinthirukkavea'ndum.
purusharka'lea, ungka'l manaivika'lil anpukoorungka'l; appadiyea ki'risthuvum sapaiyil anpukoornthu,
thaam athaith thiruvasanaththaikko'ndu tha'n'neer muzhukkinaal suththikariththu, parisuththamaakkuki'ratha'rkum,

ka'raithirai muthalaanavaika'l on'rum illaamal parisuththamum pizhaiyat'rathumaana makimaiyu'l'la sapaiyaaka athaith thamakkumun ni'ruththikko'lvatha'rkum thammaiththaamea atha'rkaaka oppukkoduththaar.
appadiyea, purusharka'lum thangka'l manaivika'laith thangka'l sonthach sareerangka'laakap paaviththu, avarka'lil anpukooravea'ndum; than manaiviyil anpukooruki'ravan thannilthaan anpukooruki'raan.
than sontha maamsaththaip pakaiththavan oruvanumillaiyea; karththar sapaiyaip poashiththuk kaappaat'ruki'rathupoala ovvoruvanum than maamsaththaip poashiththuk kaappaat'ruki'raan.
naam avarudaiya sareeraththin avayavangka'laayum, avarudaiya maamsaththi'rkum avarudaiya elumpuka'lukkum uriyavarka'laayum irukki'roam.
ithinimiththam manushan than thakappanaiyum than thaayaiyum vittu, than manaiviyudan isainthu, iruvarum orea maamsamaayiruppaarka'l.
intha irakasiyam periyathu; naan ki'risthuvaippat'riyum sapaiyaippat'riyum solluki'rean.
eppadiyum, ungka'lilum avanavan thannidaththil anpukooruvathupoala, than manaiviyinidaththilum anpukoorakkadavan; manaiviyum purushanidaththil payapakthiyaayirukkakkadava'l.
pi'l'laika'lea, ungka'l pet'raarukkuk karththarukku'l keezhppadiyungka'l, ithu niyaayam.
unakku nanmai u'ndaayiruppatha'rkum, poomiyilea un vaazhnaa'l neediththiruppatha'rkum,
un thakappanaiyum un thaayaiyum kanampa'n'nuvaayaaka enpathea vaakkuththaththamu'l'la muthalaang ka'rpanaiyaayirukki'rathu.
pithaakka'lea, neengka'lum ungka'l pi'l'laika'laik koapappaduththaamal, karththarukkeat'ra sidchaiyilum poathanaiyilum avarka'lai va'larppeerka'laaka.
vealaikkaararea, neengka'l ki'risthuvukkuk keezhppadiki'rathupoala, sareeraththinpadi ungka'l ejamaanka'laayirukki'ravarka'lukkum payaththoadum nadukkaththoadum kapadat'ra manathoadum keezhppadinthu;
manusharukkup piriyamaayirukka virumpuki'ravarka'laakap paarvaikku oozhiyagnseyyaamal, ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaararaaka, manappoorvamaayth theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi seyyungka'l.
adimaiyaanavanaanaalum, suyaatheenamu'l'lavanaanaalum, avanavan seyki'ra nanmaiyinpadiyea karththaridaththil palanai adaivaanen'ru a'rinthu,
manusharukken'ru oozhiyagnseyyaamal, karththarukken'rea nalmanathoadea oozhiyagnseyyungka'l.

ejamaanka'lea, appadiyea neengka'lum, vealaikkaararukkuch seyyavea'ndiyavaika'laich seythu, avarka'lukkum ungka'lukkum ejamaanaanavar paraloakaththil irukki'raaren'rum, avaridaththil padchapaatham illaiyen'rum a'rinthu, kadugnsollai vittuvidungka'l.
kadaisiyaaka, en sakoathararea, karththarilum avarudaiya saththuvaththin vallamaiyilum palappadungka'l.
neengka'l pisaasin thanthirangka'loadu ethirththuni'rkath thiraa'niyu'l'lavarka'laakumpadi, theavanudaiya sarvaayuthavarkkaththaiyum thariththukko'l'lungka'l.

eanenil, maamsaththoadum iraththaththoadumalla, thuraiththanangka'loadum, athikaarangka'loadum, ippirapagnchaththin anthakaara loakaathipathika'loadum, vaanama'ndalangka'lilu'l'la pollaatha aavika'lin seanaika'loadum namakkup poaraattam u'ndu.

aakaiyaal, theengkunaa'lilea avaika'lai neengka'l ethirkkavum, sakalaththaiyum seythumudiththavarka'laay ni'rkavum thiraa'niyu'l'lavarka'laakumpadikku, theavanudaiya sarvaayuthavarkkaththaiyum eduththukko'l'lungka'l.
saththiyam ennum kachchaiyai ungka'l araiyil kattinavarka'laayum, neethiyennum maarkkavasaththaith thariththavarka'laayum;
samaathaanaththin suviseashaththi'rkuriya aayaththam ennum paatharadchaiyaik kaalka'lilea thoduththavarka'laayum;
pollaangkan eyyum akkiniyaasthirangka'laiyellaam aviththuppoadaththakkathaay, ellaavat'ri'rkum mealaaka visuvaasamennum keadakaththaip pidiththukko'ndavarka'laayum nillungka'l.
iradcha'niyamennum thalaichseeraavaiyum, theavavasanamaakiya aaviyin pattayaththaiyum eduththukko'l'lungka'l.

enthach samayaththilum sakalavithamaana vea'nduthaloadum vi'n'nappaththoadum aaviyinaalea jepampa'n'ni, athanporuttu mikuntha manau'ruthiyoadum sakala parisuththavaanka'lukkaakavum pa'n'num vea'nduthaloadum vizhiththukko'ndirungka'l.
suviseashaththi'rkaakach sangkiliyaal kattappattirukki'ra sthaanaapathiyaakiya naan athaippat'rip peasavea'ndiyapadi thairiyamaayp peasaththakkathaaka,
naan thairiyamaay en vaayaith thi'ranthu suviseashaththin irakasiyaththai a'rivikki'ratha'rku vaakku enakkuk kodukkappadumpadi enakkaakavum vi'n'nappampa'n'nungka'l.

an'riyum, enakkaduththa kaariyangka'lum, en sukaseythika'lum ungka'lukkuth theriyavarumpadikku, avaika'laiyellaam namakkup piriyamaana sakoatharanum karththarukku'l u'nmaiyu'l'la oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukki'ra theekikku ungka'lukku a'rivippaan.
neengka'l engka'l seythika'lai a'riyavum, avan ungka'l iruthayangka'lukku aa'ruthal seyyavum, avanai ungka'lidaththil anuppinean.
pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, sakoathararukkuch samaathaanamum visuvaasaththoadu koodiya anpum u'ndaavathaaka.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinidaththil azhiyaatha anpudanea anpukooruki'ra yaavaroadum kirupai u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.

iyeasuki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaararaakiya pavulum theemoaththeayum, pilippi patta'naththil ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana parisuththavaanka'l anaivarukkum, ka'nkaa'nika'lukkum, uthavikkaararukkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
suviseasham ungka'lukku a'rivikkappatta naa'lmuthal ithuvaraikkum neengka'l atha'rku udanpattavarka'laanapadiyaal,
naan pa'n'nuki'ra ovvoru vi'n'nappaththilum ungka'l anaivarukkaakavum eppoathum santhoashaththoadea vi'n'nappampa'n'ni,
ungka'lil na'rkiriyaiyaith thodangkinavar athai iyeasuki'risthuvin naa'lpariyantham mudiya nadaththivaruvaaren'ru nampi,
naan ungka'lai ninaikki'rapozhuthellaam en theavanai sthoaththirikki'rean.

en kattuka'lilum, naan suviseashaththi'rkaaka uththaravusolli athaith thidappaduththivaruki'rathilum, neengka'l anaivarum enakku a'likkappatta kirupaiyil pangku'l'lavarka'laanathaal, ungka'lai en iruthayaththil thariththukko'ndirukki'rapadiyinaalea, ungka'lellaaraiyung ku'riththu naan ippadi ninaikki'rathu enakkuth thakuthiyaayirukki'rathu.
iyeasuki'risthuvin urukkamaana anpilea ungka'lellaarmealum evva'lavoa vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rean enpatha'rkuth theavanea enakkuch saadchi.
mealum, uththamamaanavaika'lai neengka'l oppukko'l'laththakkathaaka ungka'l anpaanathu a'rivilum ellaa u'narvilum innum athikamathikamaayp perukavum,
theavanukku makimaiyum thuthiyum u'ndaakumpadi iyeasuki'risthuvinaal varuki'ra neethiyin kanika'laal ni'rainthavarka'laaki,
