neengka'l ki'risthuvin naa'lukken'ru thuppuravaanavarka'lum ida'ralat'ravarka'lumaayirukkavum vea'nduthal seyki'rean.
sakoathararea, enakkuch sampaviththavaika'l suviseasham pirapalamaakumpadikku eathuvaayit'ren'ru neengka'l a'riya manathaayirukki'rean.
aramanai yengkumu'l'lavarka'lukkum mat'ra yaavarukkum en kattuka'l ki'risthuvukku'l'laana kattuka'len'ru ve'liyarangkamaaki,
sakoathararil aneakar en kattuka'laalea karththarukku'l thidanko'ndu payamillaamal thiruvasanaththaich sollumpadi athikamaayth thu'ninthirukki'raarka'l.
silar po'raamaiyinaalum viroathaththinaalum, silar nalmanathinaalum ki'risthuvaip pirasangkikki'raarka'l.
silar en kattuka'loadea upaththiravaththaiyungkootta ninaiththu, suththamanathoadea ki'risthuvai a'riviyaamal, viroathaththinaalea a'rivikki'raarka'l.
suviseashaththi'rkaaka naan uththaravu solla ea'rpaduththappattavanen'ru a'rinthu, silar anpinaalea a'rivikki'raarka'l.
ithanaalenna? vagnchakaththinaalaavathu, u'nmaiyinaalaavathu, eppadiyaavathu, ki'risthu a'rivikkappaduki'raar; athanaal santhoashappaduki'rean, innamum santhoashappaduvean.
athu ungka'l vea'nduthalinaalum iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya aaviyin uthaviyinaalum enakku iradchippaaka mudiyumen'ru a'rivean.

naan on'rilum vedkappattuppoakaamal, eppozhuthumpoala ippozhuthum, mikuntha thairiyaththoadea jeevanaalaakilum, saavinaalaakilum, ki'risthu en sareeraththinaalea makimaippaduvaaren'ru enakku u'ndaayirukki'ra vaagnchaikkum nampikkaikkum thakkathaay, appadi mudiyum.
ki'risthu enakku jeevan, saavu enakku aathaayam.
aakilum sareeraththil pizhaiththirukki'rathinaalea en kiriyaikkup palanu'ndaayiruppathaal, naan therinthuko'l'lavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru a'riyean.
eanenil ivvira'ndinaalum naan nerukkappaduki'rean; theakaththaivittup pirinthu, ki'risthuvudaneakooda irukka enakku aasaiyu'ndu, athu athika nanmaiyaayirukkum;
appadiyirunthum, naan sareeraththil thariththiruppathu ungka'lukku athika avasiyam.
intha nichchayaththaikko'ndirunthu, naan ma'rupadiyum ungka'lidaththil varuki'rathinaal ennaikku'riththu ungka'ludaiya makizhchchi ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l perukumpadikku,
ungka'l visuvaasaththin varththanaikkaakavum santhoashaththukkaakavum naan pizhaiththu, ungka'l anaivaroadungkooda iruppeanen'ru a'rinthirukki'rean.

naan vanthu ungka'laik ka'ndaalum, naan varaamalirunthaalum, neengka'l orea aaviyilea u'ruthiyaay nin'ru, orea aaththumaavinaalea suviseashaththin visuvaasaththi'rkaakak koodappoaraadi, ethirkki'ravarka'laal on'rilum maru'laathirukki'reerka'len'ru ungka'laikku'riththu naan kea'lvippadumpadi, evvithaththilum neengka'l ki'risthuvin suviseashaththi'rkup paaththiraraaka maaththiram nadanthuko'l'lungka'l.
neengka'l maru'laathirukki'rathu avarka'l kettuppoaki'ratha'rkum, neengka'l iradchikkappaduki'ratha'rkum aththaadchiyaayirukki'rathu; ithuvum theavanudaiya seyalea.
eanenil ki'risthuvinidaththil visuvaasikki'ratha'rkumaaththiramalla, avar nimiththamaakap paadupaduki'ratha'rkum ungka'lukku aru'lappattirukki'rathu.
neengka'l ennidaththilea ka'ndathum enakku u'nden'ru ippozhuthu kea'lvippaduki'rathumaana poaraattamea ungka'lukkum u'ndu.
aathalaal ki'risthuvukku'l yaathoru aa'ruthalum, anpinaalea yaathoru thea'ruthalum, aaviyin yaathoru aikkiyamum, yaathoru urukkamaana padchamum irakkangka'lum u'ndaanaal,
neengka'l eaka sinthaiyum eaka anpumu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu, isaintha aaththumaakka'laay on'raiyea sinthiththu, en santhoashaththai ni'raivaakkungka'l.
on'raiyum vaathinaalaavathu vee'n perumaiyinaalaavathu seyyaamal, manaththaazhmaiyinaalea oruvaraiyoruvar thangka'lilum meanmaiyaanavarka'laaka e'n'nakkadaveerka'l.
avanavan thanakkaanavaika'laiyalla, pi'rarukkaanavaika'laiyum noakkuvaanaaka.
ki'risthu iyeasuviliruntha sinthaiyea ungka'lilum irukkakkadavathu;
avar theavanudaiya roopamaayirunthum, theavanukkuch samamaayiruppathaik ko'l'laiyaadina poru'laaka e'n'naamal,
thammaiththaamea ve'rumaiyaakki, adimaiyin roopameduththu, manushar saayalaanaar.
avar manusharoopamaayk kaa'nappattu, mara'napariyantham, athaavathu siluvaiyin mara'napariyanthamum keezhppadinthavaraaki, thammaiththaamea thaazhththinaar.
aathalaal theavan ellaavat'ri'rkum mealaaka avarai uyarththi,
iyeasuvin naamaththil vaanoar poothalaththoar poomiyin keezhaanoarudaiya muzhangkaal yaavum mudangkumpadikkum,
pithaavaakiya theavanukku makimaiyaaka iyeasuki'risthu karththaren'ru naavuka'l yaavum a'rikkaipa'n'numpadikkum, ellaa naamaththi'rkum mealaana naamaththai avarukkuth thantharu'linaar.

aathalaal, enakkup piriyamaanavarka'lea, neengka'l eppozhuthum keezhppadiki'rapadiyea, naan ungka'lukkuch sameepamaayirukkumpozhuthu maaththiramalla, naan thooramaayirukki'ra ippozhuthum, athika payaththoadum nadukkaththoadum ungka'l iradchippu ni'raivea'rap pirayaasappadungka'l.
eanenil theavanea thammudaiya thayavu'l'la siththaththinpadi viruppaththaiyum seykaiyaiyum ungka'lil u'ndaakkuki'ravaraayirukki'raar.

naan vee'naaka oadinathum vee'naakap pirayaasappattathumillaiyenki'ra makizhchchi ki'risthuvin naa'lil enakku u'ndaayiruppatha'rku, jeevavasanaththaip pidiththukko'ndu, ulakaththilea sudarka'laippoalap pirakaasikki'ra neengka'l,
koa'nalum maa'rupaadumaana santhathiyin naduvilea kut'ramat'ravarka'lum kapadat'ravarka'lum, theavanudaiya maasat'ra pi'l'laika'lumaayirukkumpadikku,
ellaavat'raiyum mu'rumu'ruppillaamalum tharkkippillaamalum seyyungka'l.
mealum, ungka'l visuvaasamaakiya paliyinmealum oozhiyaththinmealum naan vaarkkappattuppoanaalum, naan makizhnthu, ungka'lanaivaroadungkoodach santhoashappaduvean.
ithinimiththam neengka'lum makizhnthu, ennoadeakoodach santhoashappadungka'l.
an'riyum, naanum ungka'l seythika'lai a'rinthu manaththea'ruthal adaiyumpadikkuch seekkiramaayth theemoaththeayuvai ungka'lidaththil anuppalaamen'ru karththaraakiya iyeasuvukku'l nampiyirukki'rean.
atheanen'raal, ungka'l kaariyangka'lai u'nmaiyaay visaarikki'ratha'rku ennaippoala manathu'l'lavan avanaiyan'ri vea'roruvanum ennidaththilillai.
mat'ravarka'lellaarum ki'risthu iyeasuvukkuriyavaika'laith theadaamal, thangka'lukkuriyavaika'laiyea theaduki'raarka'l.
thakappanukkup pi'l'lai oozhiyagnseyvathupoala, avan ennudaneakooda suviseashaththinimiththam oozhiyagnseythaanen'ru avanudaiya uththamaku'naththai a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
aakaiyaal en kaariyangka'l innapadi nadakkum en'ru naan a'rinthavudanea avanai anuppalaamen'ru ninaiththirukki'rean.
an'riyum naanea seekkiraththil varuveanen'ru karththarukku'l nampikkaiyaayirukki'rean.

mealum, en sakoatharanum, udanvealaiyaa'lum, udanseavakanum, ungka'l sthaanaapathiyum, en ku'raichchalukku uthaviseythavanumaana eppaappiroatheeththuvai ungka'lidaththil anuppavea'ndumen'ru e'n'ninean.
avan ungka'l ellaarmealum vaagnchaiyu'l'lavanum, thaan viyaathippattathai neengka'l kea'lvippattathinaalea mikavum viyaakulappaduki'ravanumaayirunthaan.

avan viyaathippattu mara'naththi'rkuch sameepamaayirunthathu meythaan. aakilum, theavan avanukku irangkinaar; avanukku irangkinathumallaamal, thukkaththinmeal thukkam enakku u'ndaakaathapadikku, enakkum irangkinaar.
aakaiyaal neengka'l avanai ma'rupadiyum ka'ndu santhoashappadavum, en thukkang ku'raiyavum, avanai athiseekkiramaay anuppinean.
aanapadiyinaalea neengka'l karththarukku'l mikuntha santhoashaththoadea avanai eat'rukko'ndu, ippadippattavarka'laik kanamaay e'n'nungka'l.

eanenil neengka'l enakkuch seyyavea'ndiya oozhiyaththilea ungka'l ku'raivai ni'raivaakkumpadikku, avan than piraa'nanaiyum e'n'naamal, ki'risthuvin oozhiyaththinimiththam mara'naththi'rkuch sameepamaayirunthaan.
mealum, en sakoathararea, karththarukku'l santhoashappadungka'l. ezhuthinavaika'laiyea ezhuthuvathu enakku varuththamalla, athu ungka'lukku nalamaayirukkum.
naayka'lukku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, pollaatha vealaiyaadka'lukku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l, sunnaththukkaararukku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
eanenil, maamsaththinmeal nampikkaiyaayiraamal, aaviyinaalea theavanukku aaraathanaiseythu, ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l meanmaipaaraattuki'ra naamea viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'l.
maamsaththinmeal nampikkai vaikkavea'ndumaanaal naanum vaikkalaam; vea'roruvan maamsaththinmeal nampikkaiyaayirukka ninaiththaal naan athikamaay appadich seyyalaam.
naan ettaam naa'lil viruththaseathanamadainthavan, israveal vamsaththaan, penyameen koaththiraththaan, epireyaril pi'rantha epireyan, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi pariseayan;
pakthivairaakkiyaththinpadi sapaiyaith thunpappaduththinavan, niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuriya neethiyinpadi kut'ragnsaattappadaathavan.
aakilum, enakku laapamaayirunthavaika'levaika'loa avaika'laik ki'risthuvukkaaka nashdamen'ru e'n'ninean.
athumaaththiramalla, en karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvai a'riki'ra a'rivin meanmaikkaaka ellaavat'raiyum nashdamen'ru e'n'nikko'ndirukki'rean.

naan ki'risthuvai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikkum, niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal varuki'ra suyaneethiyai udaiyavanaayiraamal, ki'risthuvaip pat'rum visuvaasaththinaal varuki'rathum visuvaasamoolamaayth theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathumaana neethiyai udaiyavanaayirunthu, ki'risthuvukku'l irukki'ravanen'ru kaa'nappadumpadikkum,

ippadi naan avaraiyum avarudaiya uyirththezhuthalin vallamaiyaiyum, avarudaiya paaduka'lin aikkiyaththaiyum a'riki'ratha'rkum, avarudaiya mara'naththi'rkoppaana mara'naththi'rku'l'laaki, eppadiyaayinum naan mariththoarilirunthu uyiroadezhunthiruppatha'rkuth thakuthiyaakumpadikkum,
avarukkaaka ellaavat'raiyum nashdamen'ru vittean; kuppaiyumaaka e'n'nuki'rean.
naan adainthaayit'ru, allathu mut'rum thea'rinavanaanean en'ru e'n'naamal, ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal naan etha'rkaakap pidikkappatteanoa athai naan pidiththukko'l'lumpadi aasaiyaayth thodaruki'rean.
sakoathararea, athaip pidiththukko'ndeanen'ru naan e'n'nuki'rathillai; on'ru seyki'rean, pinnaanavaika'lai ma'ranthu, munnaanavaika'lai naadi,
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l theavan azhaiththa parama azhaippin panthayapporu'lukkaaka ilakkai noakkith thodaruki'rean.
aakaiyaal, nammil thea'rinavarka'l yaavarum inthach sinthaiyaayirukkakkadavoam; enthak kaariyaththilaavathu neengka'l vea'rea sinthaiyaayirunthaal, athaiyum theavan ungka'lukku ve'lippaduththuvaar.
aakilum naam ethuvaraiyil thea'riyirukki'roamoa, athumuthal orea ozhungkaay nadanthuko'ndu, orea sinthaiyaayiruppoamaaka.
sakoathararea, neengka'l ennoadeakoodap pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laaki, naangka'l ungka'lukku vazhikaattuki'rapadi nadakki'ravarka'lai maathiriyaaka noakkungka'l.
eanenil, aneakar vea'ruvithamaay nadakki'raarka'l; avarka'l ki'risthuvin siluvaikkup pakaignaren'ru ungka'lukku aneakantharam sonnean, ippozhuthu ka'n'neeroadum solluki'rean.
avarka'ludaiya mudivu azhivu, avarka'ludaiya theavan vayi'ru, avarka'ludaiya makimai avarka'ludaiya ilachchaiyea, avarka'l poomikkaduththavaika'laich sinthikki'raarka'l.
nammudaiya kudiyiruppoa paraloakaththilirukki'rathu, angkeayirunthu karththaraayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthu ennum iradchakar vara ethirpaarththukko'ndirukki'roam.

avar ellaavat'raiyum thamakkuk keezhppaduththikko'l'laththakka thammudaiya vallamaiyaana seyalinpadiyea, nammudaiya a'rpamaana sareeraththaith thammudaiya makimaiyaana sareeraththi'rku oppaaka ma'ruroopappaduththuvaar.
aathalaal, enakkup piriyamum vaagnchaiyumaana sakoathararea, enakkuch santhoashamum kireedamumaanavarka'lea, piriyamaanavarka'lea, inthappadiyea karththarukku'l nilaiththirungka'l.
karththarukku'l orea sinthaiyaayirukka eyoathiyaa'lukkum sinthikeayaa'lukkum puththisolluki'rean.

an'riyum, en uththama koottaa'liyea, avarka'lukku uthaviyaayirukkumpadi unnaiyum vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean; avarka'l kileamenthoadum mat'ra en udanvealaiyaadka'loadungkoodach suviseasha vishayaththil ennoadeakooda mikavum pirayaasappattaarka'l, avarka'ludaiya naamangka'l jeevapusthakaththil irukki'rathu.
karththarukku'l eppozhuthum santhoashamaayirungka'l; santhoashamaayirungka'l en'ru ma'rupadiyum solluki'rean.
ungka'l saanthaku'nam ellaa manusharukkum therinthiruppathaaka. karththar sameepamaayirukki'raar.
neengka'l on'rukkung kavalaippadaamal, ellaavat'raiyungku'riththu ungka'l vi'n'nappangka'lai sthoaththiraththoadea koodiya jepaththinaalum vea'nduthalinaalum theavanukkuth theriyappaduththungka'l.
appozhuthu, ellaap puththikkum mealaana theavasamaathaanam ungka'l iruthayangka'laiyum ungka'l sinthaika'laiyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laakak kaaththukko'l'lum.

kadaisiyaaka, sakoathararea, u'nmaiyu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, ozhukkamu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, neethiyu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, ka'rpu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, anpu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, na'rkeerththiyu'l'lavaika'levaika'loa, pu'n'niyam ethuvoa, pukazh ethuvoa avaika'laiyea sinthiththukko'ndirungka'l.
neengka'l ennidaththil kat'rum adainthum keattum ka'ndum irukki'ravaika'levaika'loa, avaika'laiyea seyyungka'l; appozhuthu samaathaanaththin theavan ungka'loadiruppaar.

ennai visaarippatha'rku neengka'l ippozhuthu ma'rupadiyum manamalarnthapadiyinaalea karththarukku'l mikavum santhoashappattean; ippadich seyya e'n'nangko'ndiruntheerka'l, samayammaaththiram ungka'lukku nearidavillai.
en ku'raichchalinaal naan ippadich solluki'rathillai; eanenil naan entha nilaimaiyilirunthaalum manarammiyamaayirukkak kat'rukko'ndean.

thaazhnthirukkavum enakkuth theriyum, vaazhnthirukkavum enakkuth theriyum; evvidaththilum ellaavat'rilum thirupthiyaayirukkavum pattiniyaayirukkavum, paripoora'namadaiyavum ku'raivupadavum poathikkappattean.
ennaip pelappaduththuki'ra ki'risthuvinaalea ellaavat'raiyugnseyya enakkup pelanu'ndu.
aakilum neengka'l en upaththiravaththil ennoadea udanpattathu nalamaayirukki'rathu.

mealum, pilippiyarea, suviseashaththin aarampaththilea naan makkethoaniyaavilirunthu pu'rappattapoathu, kodukkal vaangkal kaariyaththil neengka'lmaaththiram enakku udanpattatheayallaamal, vea'roru sapaiyum udanpadavillai en'ru neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
naan thesaloanikkeayilirunthapoathum, en ku'raichchalai neekkumpadi neengka'l ira'ndorutharam anuppineerka'l.
upakaaraththai naan naadaamal, ungka'l ka'nakkukkup palan perukumpadiyea naaduki'rean.

ellaam enakkuk kidaiththathu, paripoora'namum u'ndaayirukki'rathu; ungka'laal anuppappattavaika'laich sukantha vaasanaiyum theavanukkup piriyamaana ukantha paliyumaaka eppaappiroatheeththuvin kaiyil varappat'rikko'ndapadiyaal naan thirupthiyadainthirukki'rean.
en theavan thammudaiya aisuvariyaththinpadi ungka'l ku'raivaiyellaam ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l makimaiyilea ni'raivaakkuvaar.
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaanavarukku en'ren'raikkum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana parisuththavaanka'l yaavarukkum vaazhththuthal sollungka'l. ennoadirukki'ra sakoathararka'l ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
parisuththavaanka'l anaivarum, viseashamaaka iraayanudaiya aramanaiyilu'l'lavarka'lum ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
namathu karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupai ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaakiya pavulum, sakoatharanaakiya theemoaththeayum,

koloase patta'naththil ki'risthuvukku'l parisuththavaanka'lum visuvaasika'lumaayirukki'ra sakoathararka'lukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinmealu'l'la ungka'l visuvaasaththaiyum, parisuththavaanka'lellaarmealumu'l'la ungka'l anpaiyungku'riththu naangka'l kea'lvippattu,
paraloakaththil ungka'lukkaaka vaiththirukki'ra nampikkaiyinimiththam,
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaakiya theavanukku sthoaththiragnseluththi, eppozhuthum ungka'lukkaaka vea'nduthal seyki'roam.

antha nampikkaiyaikku'riththu, neengka'l munnamea saththiyavasanamaakiya suviseashaththinaalea kea'lvippatteerka'l; anthach suviseasham ulakamengkum parampip palantharuki'rathupoala, ungka'lidaththilum vanthu, neengka'l athaik keattu, theavakirupaiyaich saththiyaththinpadi a'rinthuko'nda naa'lmuthal, athu ungka'lukku'l'lum palantharuki'rathaayirukki'rathu;
athai engka'lukkup piriyamaana udanvealaiyaa'lum, ungka'lukkaakak ki'risthuvin u'nmaiyaana oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukki'ra eppaappiraavinidaththil neengka'l kat'ra'rinthirukki'reerka'l;
aavikku'l'laana ungka'l anpaiyum avanea engka'lukkuth theriyappaduththinaan.

ithinimiththam, naangka'l athaik keatta naa'lmuthal ungka'lukkaaka idaividaamal jepampa'n'nuki'roam; neengka'l ellaa gnaanaththoadum, aavikkuriya viveakaththoadum avarudaiya siththaththai a'riki'ra a'rivinaalea nirappappadavum,
sakalavitha na'rkiriyaika'lumaakiya kanika'laith thanthu, theavanai a'riki'ra a'rivil viruththiyadainthu, karththarukkup piriyamu'ndaaka avarukkup paaththiraraay nadanthuko'l'lavum,

santhoashaththoadea koodiya ellaap po'rumaiyum neediyasaanthamum u'ndaavatha'rku, makimaiyaana avarudaiya vallamaiyinpadi, ellaa vallamaiyaalum palappaduththappadavum, ungka'lukkaaka vea'nduthalseyki'roam.
o'liyilu'l'la parisuththavaanka'ludaiya suthantharaththil pangkadaivatha'rku, nammaith thakuthiyu'l'lavarka'laakkinavarum,
iru'lin athikaaraththinin'ru nammai viduthalaiyaakki, thamathu anpin kumaaranudaiya raajyaththi'rku udpaduththinavarumaayirukki'ra pithaavai sthoaththirikki'roam.
[kumaaranaakiya] avarukku'l, avarudaiya iraththaththinaalea, paavamannippaakiya meedpu namakku u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
avar atharisanamaana theavanudaiya tha'rsuroopamum, sarva sirushdikkum munthina pea'rumaanavar.

eanen'raal avarukku'l sakalamum sirushdikkappattathu; paraloakaththilu'l'lavaika'lum pooloakaththilu'l'lavaika'lumaakiya kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'lum kaa'nappadaathavaika'lumaana sakala vasthukka'lum, singkaasanangka'laanaalum, karththaththuvangka'laanaalum, thuraiththanangka'laanaalum, athikaarangka'laanaalum, sakalamum avaraikko'ndum avarukken'rum sirushdikkappattathu.
avar ellaavat'ri'rkum munthinavar, ellaam avarukku'l nilaini'rki'rathu.
avarea sapaiyaakiya sareeraththukkuth thalaiyaanavar; ellaavat'rilum muthalvaraayirukkumpadi, avarea aathiyum mariththoarilirunthu ezhuntha mutha'rpea'rumaanavar.
sakala paripoora'namum avarukku'l'lea vaasamaayirukkavum,

avar siluvaiyil sinthina iraththaththinaalea samaathaanaththai u'ndaakki, pooloakaththilu'l'lavaika'l paraloakaththilu'l'lavaika'l yaavaiyum avar moolamaayth thamakku oppuravaakkikko'l'lavum avarukkup piriyamaayit'ru.

munnea anniyaraayum thurkkiriyaika'linaal manathilea saththurukka'laayum iruntha ungka'laiyum parisuththaraakavum kut'ramat'ravarka'laakavum ka'ndikkappadaathavarka'laakavum thamakku mun ni'ruththumpadiyaaka avarudaiya maamsa sareeraththil adaintha mara'naththinaalea ippozhuthu oppuravaakkinaar.
neengka'l keatta suviseashaththinaal u'ndaakum nampikkaiyaivittu asaiyaamal, sthiramaayum u'ruthiyaayum visuvaasaththilea nilaiththiruppeerka'laanaal appadiyaakum.
anthach suviseasham vaanaththin keezhirukki'ra sakala sirushdika'lukkum pirasangkikkappattuvaruki'rathu; atha'rken'rea pavulaakiya naan oozhiyakkaaranaanean.

ippozhuthu naan ungka'lnimiththam anupavikki'ra paaduka'lil santhoashamadainthu, ki'risthuvinudaiya upaththiravangka'lil ku'raivaanathai avarudaiya sareeramaakiya sapaikkaaka, en maamsaththilea ni'raiveat'ruki'rean.

aathikaalangka'lukkum thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raika'lukkum ma'raivaayirunthu, ippozhuthu avarudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukku ve'liyaakkappatta irakasiyamaakiya theavavasanaththaip poora'namaayth theriyappaduththuki'ratha'rku,
ungka'lporuttuth theavanaal enakku a'likkappatta uththiyoakaththinpadiyea naan anthach sapaikku oozhiyakkaaranaanean.

pu'rajaathika'lukku'l'lea vi'langkiya intha irakasiyaththilu'l'la makimaiyin aisuvariyam innathen'ru, theavan thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'lukkuth theriyappaduththach siththamaanaar; ki'risthuvaanavar makimaiyin nampikkaiyaaka ungka'lukku'l iruppathea antha irakasiyam.

entha manushanaiyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l thea'rinavanaaka ni'ruththumpadikku, avaraiyea naangka'l a'riviththu, entha manushanukkum puththisolli, entha manushanukkum ellaa gnaanaththoadum upatheasampa'n'nuki'roam.
atha'rkaaka naan enakku'l'lea vallamaiyaayk kiriyai nadappikki'ra avarudaiya palaththinpadi poaraadip pirayaasappaduki'rean.

ungka'lukkaakavum lavoathikkeayaavilirukki'ravarka'lukkaakavum, sareeraththil en mukaththaik kaa'naathirukki'ra mat'rellaarukkaakavum mikuntha poaraattam enakku u'nden'ru neengka'l a'riya virumpuki'rean.

avarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'l theat'rappattu, avarka'l anpinaal i'naikkappattu, pithaavaakiya theavanukkum ki'risthuvukkum uriya irakasiyaththai a'rinthuko'l'luki'ra u'narvin poora'na nichchayaththinudaiya ellaa aisuvariyaththi'rkum uriyavarka'laakavea'ndumen'rea ippadi virumpuki'rean.
avarukku'l gnaanam a'rivu enpavaika'laakiya pokkishangka'lellaam adangkiyirukki'rathu.
oruvanum nayavasanippinaalea ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadikku ithaich solluki'rean.

sareeraththinpadi naan thooramaayirunthum, aaviyinpadi ungka'ludaneakooda irunthu, ungka'l ozhungkaiyum, ki'risthuvinmealu'l'la ungka'l visuvaasaththin u'ruthiyaiyum paarththuch santhoashappaduki'rean.
aakaiyaal, neengka'l karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvai eat'rukko'ndapadiyea, avarukku'l vearko'ndavarka'laakavum, avarmeal kattappattavarka'laakavum, avarukku'l nadanthuko'ndu,
neengka'l poathikkappattapadiyea, visuvaasaththil u'ruthippattu, sthoaththiraththoadea athilea perukuveerka'laaka.

laukika gnaanaththinaalum, maayamaana thanthiraththinaalum, oruvanum ungka'laik ko'l'laiko'ndupoakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; athu manusharka'lin paarampariya niyaayaththaiyum ulakavazhipaaduka'laiyum pat'rinatheayallaamal ki'risthuvaip pat'rinathalla.
eanen'raal, theavaththuvaththin paripoora'namellaam sareerappirakaaramaaka avarukku'l vaasamaayirukki'rathu.
mealum sakala thuraiththanangka'lukkum athikaaraththukkum thalaivaraayirukki'ra avarukku'l neengka'l paripoora'namu'l'lavarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.

allaamalum, neengka'l ki'risthuvaippat'rum viruththaseathanaththinaalea maamsaththukkuriya paavasareeraththaik ka'lainthuvittathinaal, kaiyaal seyyappadaatha viruththaseathanaththai avarukku'l pet'reerka'l.

gnaanasnaanaththilea avaroadeakooda adakkampa'n'nappattavarka'laakavum, athilea avarai mariththoarilirunthezhuppina theavanudaiya seyalinmealu'l'la visuvaasaththinaalea avaroadeakooda ezhunthavarka'laakavum irukki'reerka'l.

ungka'l paavangka'linaaleayum, ungka'l maamsa viruththaseathanamillaamaiyinaaleayum mariththavarka'laayiruntha ungka'laiyum avaroadeakooda uyirppiththu, akkiramangka'lellaavat'raiyum ungka'lukku manniththu;
namakku ethiridaiyaakavum katta'laika'laal namakku viroathamaakavum iruntha kaiyezhuththaik kulaiththu, athai naduviliraathapadikku eduththu, siluvaiyinmeal aa'niyadiththu;
thuraiththanangka'laiyum athikaarangka'laiyum urinthuko'ndu, ve'liyarangkamaana koalamaakki, avaika'linmeal siluvaiyilea vet'risi'ranthaar.
aakaiyaal, poajanaththaiyum paanaththaiyum ku'riththaavathu, pa'ndikainaa'laiyum maathappi'rappaiyum oayvunaadka'laiyungku'riththaavathu, oruvanum ungka'laik kut'rappaduththaathiruppaanaaka.
avaika'l varungkaariyangka'lukku nizhalaayirukki'rathu; avaika'lin poru'l ki'risthuvaippat'rinathu.
ka'nukka'laalum kattuka'laalum uthavipet'ru i'naikkappattu, theavava'larchchiyaay va'larnthea'ruki'ra sareeramuzhuvathaiyum aatharikki'ra thalaiyaip pat'rikko'l'laamal,

maayamaana thaazhmaiyilum, theavathootharka'lukkuch seyyum aaraathanaiyilum viruppamut'ru, kaa'naathavaika'lilea thu'nivaay nuzhainthu, than maamsasinthaiyinaalea vee'naay i'rumaappukko'ndirukki'ra evanum ungka'l panthayapporu'lai neengka'l izhanthupoakumpadi ungka'lai vagnchiyaathirukkappaarungka'l.
neengka'l ki'risthuvudaneakooda ulakaththin vazhipaaduka'lukku mariththathu'ndaanaal, innum ulaka vazhakkaththinpadi pizhaikki'ravarka'lpoala,
manusharudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadiyum poathanaika'linpadiyum nadanthu: thodaathea, rusipaaraathea, thee'ndaathea enki'ra katta'laika'lukku udpaduki'rathenna?
ivaiyellaam anupavikki'rathinaal azhinthupoakumea.

ippadippatta poathanaika'l suya ishdamaana aaraathanaiyaiyum, maayamaana thaazhmaiyaiyum, sareera odukkaththaiyumpat'ri gnaanamenki'ra pearko'ndirunthaalum, ivaika'l maamsaththaip pea'nuki'ratha'rkea ozhiya mat'ron'ri'rkum pirayoajanappadaathu.
neengka'l ki'risthuvudankooda ezhunthathu'ndaanaal, ki'risthu theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil veet'rirukkum idaththilu'l'la mealaanavaika'laith theadungka'l.
poomiyilu'l'lavaika'laiyalla, mealaanavaika'laiyea naadungka'l.
eanen'raal, neengka'l mariththeerka'l, ungka'l jeevan ki'risthuvudanea theavanukku'l ma'rainthirukki'rathu.
nammudaiya jeevanaakiya ki'risthu ve'lippadumpoathu, neengka'lum avaroadeakooda makimaiyilea ve'lippaduveerka'l.
aakaiyaal, vipasaaram, asuththam, moakam, thurichchai, vikkirakaaraathanaiyaana poru'laasai aakiya ivaika'laip poomiyil u'ndupa'n'nuki'ra ungka'l avayavangka'lai azhiththuppoadungka'l.
ivaika'linporuttea keezhppadiyaamaiyin pi'l'laika'lmeal theavakoapaakkinai varum.
neengka'lum mu'rkaalaththil avarka'lukku'l'lea sagnchariththapoathu, avaika'laich seythuko'nduvantheerka'l.
ippozhuthoa koapamum moorkkamum po'raamaiyum, ungka'l vaayil pi'rakkalaakaatha thoosha'namum vampu vaarththaika'lumaakiya ivaika'laiyellaam vittuvidungka'l.
oruvarukkoruvar poy sollaathirungka'l; pazhaiya manushanaiyum avan seykaika'laiyum ka'lainthupoattu,
thannaich sirushdiththavarudaiya saayalukkoppaayp poora'na a'rivadaiyumpadi puthithaakkappatta puthiya manushanaith thariththukko'ndirukki'reerka'lea.

athilea kireakkanen'rum yoothanen'rumillai, viruththaseathanamu'l'lavanen'rum viruththaseathanamillaathavanen'rumillai, pu'rajaathiyaanen'rum pu'ratheasaththaanen'rumillai, adimaiyen'rum suyaatheenanen'rumillai; ki'risthuvea ellaarilum ellaamumaayirukki'raar.

aakaiyaal, neengka'l theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappatta parisuththarum piriyarumaay, urukkamaana irakkaththaiyum, thayavaiyum, manaththaazhmaiyaiyum, saanthaththaiyum, neediya po'rumaiyaiyum thariththukko'ndu;
oruvaraiyoruvar thaangki, oruvarpearil oruvarukkuk ku'raipaadu u'ndaanaal, ki'risthu ungka'lukku manniththathupoala, oruvarukkoruvar manniyungka'l.
ivai ellaavat'rinmealum, poora'na sa'rku'naththin kattaakiya anpaith thariththukko'l'lungka'l.
theavasamaathaanam ungka'l iruthayangka'lil aa'lakkadavathu, itha'rken'rea neengka'l orea sareeramaaka azhaikkappatteerka'l; nan'riya'rithalu'l'lavarka'laayumirungka'l.

ki'risthuvin vasanam ungka'lukku'l'lea sakala gnaanaththoadum paripoora'namaaka vaasamaayiruppathaaka; sangkeethangka'linaalum keerththanaika'linaalum gnaanappaattuka'linaalum oruvarukkoruvar poathiththup puththisollikko'ndu, ungka'l iruthayaththilea karththaraip pakthiyudan paadi;

vaarththaiyinaalaavathu kiriyaiyinaalaavathu, neengka'l ethaich seythaalum, athaiyellaam karththaraakiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea seythu, avar munnilaiyaakap pithaavaakiya theavanai sthoaththiriyungka'l.
manaivika'lea, karththarukkea'rkumpadi, ungka'l purusharukkuk keezhppadiyungka'l.
purusharka'lea, ungka'l manaivika'lil anpukoorungka'l, avarka'lmeal kasanthuko'l'laathirungka'l.
pi'l'laika'lea, ungka'laip pet'raarukku ellaak kaariyaththileayum keezhppadiyungka'l; ithu karththarukkup piriyamaanathu.
pithaakka'lea, ungka'l pi'l'laika'l thidanat'ruppoakaathapadi, avarka'lukkuk koapamoottaathirungka'l.

vealaikkaararea, sareeraththinpadi ungka'l ejamaanka'laayirukki'ravarka'lukku ellaak kaariyaththileayum keezhppadinthu, neengka'l manusharukkup piriyamaayirukka virumpuki'ravarka'laakap paarvaikku oozhiyagnseyyaamal, theavanukkup payappaduki'ravarka'laakak kapadamillaatha iruthayaththoadea oozhiyagnseyyungka'l.
neengka'l karththaraakiya ki'risthuvaich seavikki'rathinaalea, suthantharamaakiya palanaik karththaraalea pe'ruveerka'len'ru a'rinthu,
ethaich seythaalum, athai manusharka'lukken'ru seyyaamal, karththarukken'rea manappoorvamaaych seyyungka'l.
aniyaayagnseyki'ravan thaan seytha aniyaayaththukkeat'ra palanai adaivaan; padchapaathamea illai.
ejamaanka'lea, ungka'lukkum paraloakaththil ejamaan irukki'raaren'ru a'rinthu, vealaikkaararukku neethiyum sevvaiyumaanathaich seyyungka'l.
idaividaamal jepampa'n'nungka'l, sthoaththiraththudan jepaththil vizhiththirungka'l.
ki'risthuvinudaiya irakasiyaththinimiththam kattappattirukki'ra naan antha irakasiyaththaikku'riththup peasavea'ndiyapirakaaramaayp peasi, athai ve'lippaduththuvatha'rku,
thiruvasanam sellumpadiyaana vaasalaith theavan thi'rantharu'lumpadi engka'lukkaakavum vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l.
pu'rampeayirukki'ravarka'lukku munpaaka gnaanamaay nadanthu, kaalaththaip pirayoajanappaduththikko'l'lungka'l.
avanavanukku inninnapadi uththaravu sollavea'ndumen'ru neengka'l a'riyumpadikku, ungka'l vasanam eppozhuthum kirupai porunthinathaayum uppaal saaramea'rinathaayumiruppathaaka.
piriyamaana sakoatharanum, u'nmaiyu'l'la oozhiyakkaaranum, karththarukku'l enakku udanvealaiyaa'lumaayirukki'ra theekikku enpavan en seythika'laiyellaam ungka'lukku a'rivippaan.
ungka'l seythika'lai a'riyavum, ungka'l iruthayangka'laith theat'ravum,

avanaiyum, ungka'liloruvanaayirukki'ra u'nmaiyum piriyamumu'l'la sakoatharanaakiya oneasimu enpavanaiyum, ungka'lidaththil anuppiyirukki'rean; avarka'l ivvidaththuch seythika'laiyellaam ungka'lukku a'rivippaarka'l.

ennoadeakoodak kaavalilirukki'ra aristharkku ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raan; parnapaavukku inaththaanaakiya maa'rkum vaazhththuthal solluki'raan, ivanaikku'riththuk katta'laipet'reerka'lea; ivan ungka'lidaththil vanthaal ivanai angkikariththukko'l'lungka'l.

yusthu ennappatta iyeasuvum vaazhththuthal solluki'raan. viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'lil ivarka'lmaaththiram theavanudaiya raajyaththinporuttu en udanvealaiyaadka'laayirunthu, enakku aa'ruthal seythuvanthavarka'l.

eppaappiraavum ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raan; ungka'laich searnthavanum ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaaranumaakiya ivan, neengka'l theavanukkuch siththamaanavaika'lellaavat'rilum thea'rinavarka'laayum poora'na nichchayamu'l'lavarka'laayum nilaini'rkavea'ndumen'ru, than jepangka'lil ungka'lukkaaka eppozhuthum poaraaduki'raan.
ivan ungka'lukkaakavum, lavoathikkeayarukkaakavum, eraappoaliyarukkaakavum, mikuntha jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raanenpatha'rku naan saadchiyaayirukki'rean.
piriyamaana vaiththiyanaakiya lookkaavum, theamaavum, ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
lavoathikkeayaavilirukki'ra sakoathararaiyum, nimpaavaiyum, avan veettil kooduki'ra sapaiyaiyum vaazhththungka'l.
intha nirupam ungka'lidaththil vaasikkappattapinpu ithu lavoathikkeayaa sapaiyilum vaasikkappadumpadi seyyungka'l; lavoathikkeayaavilirunthu varum nirupaththai neengka'lum vaasiyungka'l.
arkkippaik ka'ndu: nee karththaridaththil pet'ra oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'rumpadi kavanamaayiruppaayaakaven'ru sollungka'l.
pavulaakiya naan en kaiyinaal ezhuthi, ungka'lai vaazhththuki'rean. naan kattappattirukki'rathai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l. kirupai ungka'loadiruppathaaka. aamen.

pavulum, silvaanum, theemoaththeayum, pithaavaakiya theavanukku'l'lum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l'lum irukki'ra thesaloanikkeayar sapaikku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

theavanukkup piriyamaana sakoathararea, ungka'l visuvaasaththin kiriyaiyaiyum, ungka'l anpin pirayaasaththaiyum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinmealu'l'la ungka'l nampikkaiyin po'rumaiyaiyum, nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanukkumunpaaka naangka'l idaividaamal ninaivukoornthu,
neengka'l therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'len'ru naangka'l a'rinthu,
engka'l jepangka'lil idaividaamal ungka'laikku'riththu vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, ungka'lellaarukkaakavum eppozhuthum theavanai sthoaththirikki'roam.

engka'l suviseasham ungka'lidaththil vasanaththoadeamaaththiramalla, vallamaiyoadum, parisuththa aaviyoadum, muzhu nichchayaththoadum vanthathu; naangka'lum ungka'lukku'l'lea irunthapoathu ungka'lnimiththam eppadippattavarka'laayirunthoamen'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
neengka'l mikuntha upaththiravaththilea, parisuththa aaviyin santhoashaththoadea, thiruvasanaththai eat'rukko'ndu, engka'laiyum karththaraiyum pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laaki,
ivvithamaay makkethoaniyaavilum akaayaavilumu'l'la visuvaasika'l yaavarukkum maathirika'laaneerka'l.

eppadiyenil, ungka'lidaththilirunthu karththarudaiya vasanam makkethoaniyaavilum akaayaavilum thoniththathumallaamal, naangka'l athaikku'riththu on'rum sollavea'ndiyathaayiraathapadikku, theavanaippat'rina ungka'l visuvaasam engkum pirasiththamaayit'ru.

eanenil, avarka'lthaamea engka'laikku'riththu, ungka'lidaththil naangka'l adaintha piraveasam innathenpathaiyum, jeevanu'l'la meyyaana theavanukku oozhiyagnseyvatha'rku, neengka'l vikkirakangka'laivittuth theavanidaththi'rku mananthirumpinathaiyum,

avar mariththoarilirunthezhuppinavarum, inivarum koapaakkinaiyinin'ru nammai neengkalaakki iradchikki'ravarumaayirukki'ra avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasu paraloakaththilirunthu varuvathai neengka'l ethirpaarththukko'ndirukki'rathaiyum, a'rivikki'raarka'lea.
sakoathararea, naangka'l ungka'lidaththil piraveasiththathu vee'naayirukkavillaiyen'ru neengka'lea a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.

ungka'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, munnea pilippipatta'naththilea naangka'l paadupattu ninthaiyadainthirunthum, veku poaraattaththoadea theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungka'lukkuch sollumpadi, nammudaiya theavanukku'l thairiyangko'ndirunthoam.
engka'l poathakam vagnchakaththinaalum thuraasaiyinaalum u'ndaakavillai, athu kapadamu'l'lathaayumirukkavillai.

suviseashaththai engka'lidaththil oppuvikkaththakkathaay, theavan engka'lai uththamaren're'n'ninapadiyea, naangka'l manusharukku alla, engka'l iruthayangka'laich soathiththa'riki'ra theavanukkea piriyamu'ndaakap peasuki'roam.
ungka'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, naangka'l orukkaalum ichchakamaana vasanangka'laich sollavumillai, poru'laasaiyu'l'lavarka'laay maayampa'n'navumillai; theavanea saadchi.

naangka'l ki'risthuvin appoasthalaraaka ungka'lukkup paaramaayirukkak koodiyavarka'laanaalum, ungka'lidaththilaavathu, mat'ravarka'lidaththilaavathu, manusharaal varum makimaiyai naangka'l theadavillai.
ungka'lidaththil padchamaay nadanthuko'ndoam; paal kodukki'ra thaayaanava'l than pi'l'laika'laik kaappaat'ruki'rathupoala,

naangka'l ungka'lmeal vaagnchaiyaayirunthu, theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungka'lukkuk koduththathumallaamal, neengka'l engka'lukkup piriyamaanavarka'laanapadiyinaalea, engka'l jeevanaiyum ungka'lukkuk kodukka manathaayirunthoam.

sakoathararea, naangka'l patta pirayaasamum varuththamum ungka'lukku gnaapakamaayirukkum; ungka'lil oruvanukkum paaramaayiraathapadikku, iravum pakalum naangka'l vealaiseythu, theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungka'lidaththil pirasangkiththoam.
visuvaasika'laakiya ungka'lukku'l'lea naangka'l evva'lavu parisuththamum neethiyum pizhaiyinmaiyumaay nadanthoamenpatha'rku neengka'lum saadchi, theavanum saadchi.
mealum, thammudaiya raajyaththi'rkum makimaikkum ungka'lai azhaiththa theavanukku neengka'l paaththiraraay nadakkavea'ndumen'ru,
thakappan than pi'l'laika'lukkuch solluki'rathupoala, naangka'l ungka'lil ovvoruvanukkum puththiyum thea'ruthalum echcharippum sonnathai a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.

aakaiyaal, neengka'l theavavasanaththai engka'laalea kea'lvippattu eat'rukko'ndapoathu, athai manushar vasanamaaka eat'rukko'l'laamal, theavavasanamaakavea eat'rukko'ndathinaalea naangka'l idaividaamal theavanukku sthoaththiragn seluththuki'roam; athu meyyaakavea theavavasananthaan, visuvaasikki'ra ungka'lukku'l'lea athu pelanum seyki'rathu.

eppadiyenil, sakoathararea, yootheayaa theasaththil ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana theavanudaiya sapaika'lai neengka'l pinpat'rinavarka'laaki, avarka'l yootharaalea eppadip paadupattaarka'loa, appadiyea neengka'lum ungka'l suya janangka'laalea paadupatteerka'l.

antha yootharka'l karththaraakiya iyeasuvaiyum, thangka'l theerkkatharisika'laiyum kolaiseythavarka'lum, engka'laith thunpappaduththinavarka'lum, theavanukkea'rkaathavarka'lum, manushar yaavarukkum viroathika'lumaayirunthu,

pu'rajaathiyaar iradchikkappaduvatha'rku naangka'l avarka'loadea peasaathapadikkuth thadaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l; ivvithamaay ekkaalaththilum thangka'l paavangka'lai ni'raivaakkuki'raarka'l; avarka'lmeal koapaakkinai poora'namaay vanthirukki'rathu.

sakoathararea, naangka'l iruthayaththinpadi ungka'loadirunthu, sareeraththinpadi kognchakkaalam ungka'laivittup pirinthirunthapadiyinaalea, ungka'l mukaththaip paarkkavea'ndumen'ru mikuntha aasaiyoadea athikamaayp pirayaththanampa'n'ninoam.
aakaiyaal, naangka'l ungka'lidaththil vara ira'ndorutharam manathaayirunthoam, pavulaakiya naanea vara manathaayirunthean; saaththaanoa engka'laith thadaipa'n'ninaan.

engka'lukku nampikkaiyum santhoashamum makizhchchiyin kireedamumaayiruppavarka'l yaar? nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu varumpoathu avarudaiya sannithaanaththilea neengka'lallavaa appadiyiruppeerka'l;
neengka'lea engka'lukku makimaiyum santhoashamumaayirukki'reerka'l.
aakaiyaal, naangka'l inip po'ruththirukkakkoodaamal, aththeanea patta'naththil thaniththuvidappaduki'rathu nanmaiyen'ru ninaiththu,

intha upaththiravangka'linaalea oruvanum asaikkappadaathapadikku ungka'laith thidappaduththavum, ungka'l visuvaasaththaippat'ri ungka'lukkup puththisollavum, nammudaiya sakoatharanum theava oozhiyakkaaranum ki'risthuvin suviseashaththil engka'l udanvealaiyaa'lumaakiya theemoaththeayuvai anuppinoam.
ippadippatta upaththiravangka'laich sakikka naam niyamikkappattirukki'roamen'ru neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
namakku upaththiravam varumen'ru naangka'l ungka'lidaththilirunthapoathu, ungka'lukku munna'riviththoam; appadiyea vanthu nearittathen'rum a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.

aakaiyaal, naan inip po'ruththirukkakkoodaamal, engka'l vealai vee'naayp poakaththakkathaakach soathanaikkaaran ungka'laich soathanaikkudpaduththinathu'ndoaven'ru, ungka'l visuvaasaththai a'riyumpadikku, avanai anuppinean.

ippozhuthu theemoaththeayu ungka'lidaththilirunthu engka'lidaththil vanthu, ungka'l visuvaasaththaiyum anpaiyum ku'riththum, neengka'l eppozhuthum engka'laip padchamaay ninaiththukko'ndu, naangka'l ungka'laik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rathupoala neengka'lum engka'laik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirukki'reerka'lenpathaikku'riththum, engka'lukku na'rseythi sonnathinaalea,
sakoathararea, engka'lukku nearitta ellaa ikkattilum upaththiravaththilum ungka'l visuvaasaththinaalea ungka'laikku'riththu aa'ruthaladainthoam.
neengka'l karththarukku'l nilaiththirunthaal naangka'l pizhaiththiruppoam.
mealum, nammudaiya theavanukku munpaaka naangka'l ungka'laikku'riththu adainthirukki'ra mikuntha santhoashaththi'rkaaka, naangka'l theavanukku evvithamaay sthoaththiram seluththuvoam?
ungka'l mukaththaik ka'ndu, ungka'l visuvaasaththin ku'raivuka'lai ni'raivaakkumporuttu, iravum pakalum mikavum vea'ndikko'l'luki'roamea.
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanum nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvum ungka'lidaththi'rku engka'lai nearaaka vazhinadaththuvaaraaka.

naangka'l ungka'lidaththil vaiththirukki'ra anpukkoppaay, neengka'lum oruvaridaththil oruvar vaikkum anpilum mat'rellaa manusharidaththil vaikkum anpilum karththar ungka'laip perukavum nilaiththoangkavum seythu,

ivvithamaay nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu thamathu parisuththavaanka'l anaivaroadungkooda varumpoathu, neengka'l nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanukku munpaakap pizhaiyat'ra parisuththamu'l'lavarka'laayirukkumpadi ungka'l iruthayangka'lai sthirappaduththuvaaraaka.

an'riyum, sakoathararea, neengka'l inninna pirakaaramaay nadakkavum, theavanukkup piriyamaayirukkavum vea'ndumen'ru, neengka'l engka'laal keattu eat'rukko'ndapadiyea, athikamathikamaayth thea'rumpadikku, karththaraakiya iyeasuvukku'l ungka'lai vea'ndikko'ndu puththisolluki'roam.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvinaalea naangka'l ungka'lukkuk koduththa katta'laika'lai a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
neengka'l parisuththamu'l'lavarka'laakavea'ndumenpathea theavanudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu. anthappadi, neengka'l veasimaarkkaththukku vilakiyirunthu,
theavanai a'riyaatha agngnaanika'laippoala moaka ichchaikkudpadaamal,
ungka'lil avanavan thanthan sareera paa'ndaththaip parisuththamaayum kanamaayum aa'nduko'l'lumpadi a'rinthu:

intha vishayaththil oruvanum mee'raamalum than sakoatharanai vagnchiyaamalum irukkavea'ndum; munnamea naangka'l ungka'lukkuch solli, saadchiyaaka echchariththapadiyea ippadippatta vishayangka'lellaavat'raiyungku'riththuk karththar neethiyaich sarikkattuki'ravaraayirukki'raar.
theavan nammai asuththaththi'rkalla parisuththaththi'rkea azhaiththirukki'raar.
aakaiyaal asattaipa'n'nuki'ravan manusharai alla, thamathu parisuththaaaviyai namakkuth thantharu'lina theavanaiyea asattaipa'n'nuki'raan.
sakoathara sineakaththaikku'riththu naan ungka'lukku ezhuthavea'nduvathillai; neengka'l oruvariloruvar anpaayirukkumpadikkuth theavanaal poathikkappattavarka'laayirukki'reerka'lea.
anthappadi neengka'l makkethoaniyaa naadengkumu'l'la sakoathararellaarukkum seythuvaruki'reerka'l. sakoathararea, anpilea neengka'l innum athikamaayp perukavum;
pu'rampeayirukki'ravarka'laip pat'ri yoakkiyamaay nadanthu, on'rilum ungka'lukkuk ku'raivillaathirukkumpadikku,

naangka'l ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, amaithalu'l'lavarka'laayirukkumpadi naadavum, ungka'l sontha aluvalka'laip paarkkavum, ungka'l sonthak kaika'linaalea vealaiseyyavum vea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'roam.
an'riyum, sakoathararea, niththiraiyadainthavarka'linimiththam neengka'l nampikkaiyat'ravarka'laana mat'ravarka'laippoalath thukkiththu, a'rivillaathirukka enakku manathillai.
iyeasuvaanavar mariththu pinpu ezhunthirunthaaren'ru visuvaasikki'roamea; appadiyea iyeasuvukku'l niththiraiyadainthavarka'laiyum theavan avaroadeakoodak ko'nduvaruvaar.
karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai munnittu naangka'l ungka'lukkuch solluki'rathaavathu: karththarudaiya varukaimattum uyiroadirukkum naam niththiraiyadainthavarka'lukku munthikko'lvathillai.

eanenil, karththar thaamea aaravaaraththoadum, pirathaana thoothanudaiya saththaththoadum, theava ekkaa'laththoadum vaanaththilirunthu i'rangkivaruvaar; appozhuthu ki'risthuvukku'l mariththavarka'l muthalaavathu ezhunthiruppaarka'l.
pinpu uyiroadirukkum naamum karththarukku ethirko'ndupoaka, meakangka'lmeal avarka'loadeakooda aakaayaththil eduththukko'l'lappattu, ivvithamaay eppozhuthum karththarudaneakooda iruppoam.
aakaiyaal, intha vaarththaika'linaalea neengka'l oruvaraiyoruvar theat'rungka'l.
sakoathararea, ivaika'l nadakkungkaalangka'laiyum samayangka'laiyungku'riththu ungka'lukku ezhuthavea'nduvathillai.
iravilea thirudan varuki'ravithamaayk karththarudaiya naa'l varumen'ru neengka'lea nan'raay a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
samaathaanamum savukkiyamum u'nden'ru avarka'l sollumpoathu, karppavathiyaanava'lukku veathanai varuki'rathupoala, azhivu sadithiyaay avarka'lmeal varum; avarka'l thappippoavathillai.
sakoathararea, antha naa'l thirudanaippoala ungka'laip pidiththukko'l'laththakkathaaka, neengka'l anthakaaraththilirukki'ravarka'lallavea.
neengka'lellaarum ve'lichchaththin pi'l'laika'lum, pakalin pi'l'laika'lumaayirukki'reerka'l; naam iravukkum iru'lukkum u'l'laanavarka'lallavea.
aakaiyaal, mat'ravarka'l thoongkuki'rathupoala naam thoongkaamal, vizhiththukko'ndu the'linthavarka'laayirukkakkadavoam.
thoongkuki'ravarka'l iraaththiriyilea thoongkuvaarka'l; ve'riko'l'luki'ravarka'l iraaththiriyilea ve'riko'l'luvaarka'l.
pakalukkuriyavarka'laakiya naamoa the'linthavarka'laayirunthu, visuvaasam anpu ennum maarkkavasaththaiyum, iradchippin nampikkaiyennum thalaichseeraavaiyum thariththukko'ndirukkakkadavoam.
theavan nammaik koapaakkinaikken'ru niyamikkaamal, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthumoolamaay iradchippadaivatha'rken'ru niyamiththaar.
naam vizhiththiruppavarka'laanaalum, niththiraiyadainthavarka'laanaalum, thammudaneakooda naam eakamaayp pizhaiththirukkumpadi avar namakkaaka mariththaarea.
aakaiyaal neengka'l seythuvaruki'rapadiyea, oruvaraiyoruvar theat'ri, oruvarukkoruvar pakthiviruththi u'ndaakumpadi seyyungka'l.
an'riyum, sakoathararea, ungka'lukku'l'lea pirayaasappattu, karththarukku'l ungka'lai visaara'naiseyki'ravarka'laayirunthu, ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'ravarka'lai neengka'l mathiththu,
avarka'ludaiya kiriyaiyinimiththam avarka'lai mikavum anpaay e'n'nikko'l'lumpadi ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'roam. ungka'lukku'l'lea samaathaanamaayirungka'l.

mealum, sakoathararea, naangka'l ungka'lukkup poathikki'rathennaven'raal, ozhungkillaathavarka'lukkup puththisollungka'l, thidanat'ravarka'laith theat'rungka'l, palaveenaraith thaangkungka'l, ellaaridaththilum neediya saanthamaayirungka'l.
oruvanum mat'roruvan seyyum theemaikkuth theemaiseyyaathapadi paarungka'l; ungka'lukku'l'lum mat'ra yaavarukku'l'lum eppozhuthum nanmaiseyya naadungka'l.
eppozhuthum santhoashamaayirungka'l.
idaividaamal jepampa'n'nungka'l.
ellaavat'rileayum sthoaththiragn seyyungka'l; appadich seyvathea ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l ungka'laikku'riththuth theavanudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu.
aaviyai aviththuppoadaathirungka'l.
theerkkatharisanangka'lai a'rpamaaye'n'naathirungka'l.
ellaavat'raiyum soathiththup paarththu, nalamaanathaip pidiththukko'l'lungka'l.
pollaangkaayth thoan'ruki'ra ellaavat'raiyum vittu vilakungka'l.

samaathaanaththin theavan thaamea ungka'lai mut'rilum parisuththamaakkuvaaraaka. ungka'l aavi aaththumaa sareeram muzhuvathum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu varumpoathu kut'ramat'rathaayirukkumpadi kaakkappaduvathaaka.
ungka'lai azhaikki'ravar u'nmaiyu'l'lavar, avar appadiyea seyvaar.
sakoathararea, engka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l.
sakoathararellaaraiyum parisuththa muththaththoadea vaazhththungka'l.
intha nirupam parisuththamaana sakoatharar yaavarukkum vaasikkappadumpadi seyyavea'ndumen'ru karththarpearil aa'naiyittu ungka'lukkuch solluki'rean.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirupai ungka'ludaneakooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
pavulum, silvaanum, theemoaththeayum, nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanukku'l'lum, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l'lum irukki'ra thesaloanikkeayar sapaikku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

sakoathararea, naangka'l eppozhuthum ungka'lukkaakath theavanai sthoaththirikkak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'roam; ungka'l visuvaasam mikavum perukuki'rapadiyinaalum, neengka'lellaarum oruvariloruvar vaiththirukki'ra anpu athikarikki'rapadiyinaalum, appadich seyki'rathu thakuthiyaayirukki'rathu.

neengka'l sakikki'ra sakala thunpangka'lilum upaththiravangka'lilum po'rumaiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum kaa'npikki'rathinimiththam ungka'laikku'riththu naangka'l theavanudaiya sapaika'lil meanmaipaaraattuki'roam.

neengka'l theavanudaiya raajyaththinimiththam paadu anupavikki'ravarka'laayirukka, antha raajyaththi'rku neengka'l paaththiraren're'n'nappadumpadikku, theavan niyaayamaana theerppuchseyki'ravarenpatha'rku, athuvea aththaadchiyaayirukki'rathu.

ungka'lai upaththiravappaduththuki'ravarka'lukku upaththiravaththaiyum, upaththiravappaduki'ra ungka'lukku engka'loadeakooda i'laippaa'ruthalaiyum pirathipalanaakak koduppathu theavanukku neethiyaayirukki'rathea.
theavanai a'riyaathavarka'lukkum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin suviseashaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'lukkum neethiyu'l'la aakkinaiyaich seluththumpadikku,
karththaraakiya iyeasu thamathu vallamaiyin thootharoadum, juvaaliththu eriki'ra akkiniyoadum, vaanaththilirunthu ve'lippadumpoathu appadiyaakum.

annaa'lilea thammudaiya parisuththavaanka'lil makimaippadaththakkavaraayum, neengka'l engka'ludaiya saadchiyai visuvaasiththapadiyinaalea ungka'lidaththilum, visuvaasikki'ravarka'lellaaridaththilum aachchariyappadaththakkavaraayum, avar varumpoathu,
avarka'l karththarudaiya sannithaanaththilirunthum, avarudaiya vallamai porunthiya makimaiyilirunthum neengkalaaki, niththiya azhivaakiya tha'ndanaiyai adaivaarka'l.

aakaiyaal, nammudaiya theavanum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvum a'likkum kirupaiyinpadiyea, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamam ungka'lidaththilum, neengka'l avaridaththilum makimaippadumporuttaaka;

nammudaiya theavan ungka'laith thamathu azhaippukkup paaththiraraakkavum, thamathu thayaiyu'l'la siththam muzhuvathaiyum visuvaasaththin kiriyaiyaiyum palamaay ungka'lidaththil ni'raiveat'ravum vea'ndumen'ru, eppozhuthum ungka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'luki'roam.
an'riyum, sakoathararea, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin varukaiyaiyum, naam avaridaththilea searkkappaduvathaiyungku'riththu, naangka'l ungka'lai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rathu ennaven'raal,

oru aaviyinaalaavathu, vaarththaiyinaalaavathu, engka'lidaththilirunthu vanthathaayth thoan'ruki'ra oru nirupaththinaalaavathu, ki'risthuvinudaiya naa'l sameepamaayirukki'rathaakach sollappattaal, udanea sagnchalappadaamalum kalangkaamalum irungka'l.

evvithaththinaalum oruvanum ungka'lai moasampoakkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; eanenil visuvaasa thuroakam munthi nearittu, keattin makanaakiya paavamanushan ve'lippattaalozhiya, antha naa'l varaathu.

avan ethirththuni'rki'ravanaayum, theavanennappaduvathethuvoa, aaraathikkappaduvathethuvoa, avaiyellaavat'ri'rkum mealaakath thannai uyarththuki'ravanaayum, theavanudaiya aalayaththil theavanpoala udkaarnthu, thannaiththaan theavanen'ru kaa'npikki'ravanaayum iruppaan.
naan ungka'lidaththilirunthapoathu ivaika'laich sonnathu ungka'lukku gnaapakamillaiyaa?
avan than kaalaththilea ve'lippadumpadikku, ippozhuthu avanaith thadaiseyki'rathu innathen'rum a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
akkiramaththin irakasiyam ippozhuthea kiriyaiseyki'rathu; aanaalum thadaiseyki'ravan naduvilirunthu neekkappadumunnea athu ve'lippadaathu.
neekkappadumpoathu, antha akkiramakkaaran ve'lippaduvaan; avanaik karththar thammudaiya vaayin suvaasaththinaalea azhiththu, thammudaiya varukaiyin pirasannaththinaalea naasampa'n'nuvaar.
antha akkiramakkaaranudaiya varukai saaththaanudaiya seyalinpadi sakala vallamaiyoadum adaiyaa'langka'loadum poyyaana a'rputhangka'loadum,

kettuppoaki'ravarka'lukku'l'lea aneethiyinaal u'ndaakum sakalavitha vagnchakaththoadum irukkum. iradchikkappadaththakkathaaych saththiyaththinmealu'l'la anpai avarka'l angkikariyaama'rpoanapadiyaal appadi nadakkum.
aakaiyaal saththiyaththai visuvaasiyaamal aneethiyil piriyappaduki'ra yaavarum aakkinaikku'l'laakkappadumpadikku,
avarka'l poyyai visuvaasikkaththakkathaakak kodiya vagnchakaththaith theavan avarka'lukku anuppuvaar.

karththarukkup piriyamaana sakoathararea, neengka'l aaviyinaalea parisuththamaakkappaduki'rathinaalum, saththiyaththai visuvaasikki'rathinaalum iradchippadaiyumpadikku, aathimuthal theavan ungka'laith therinthuko'ndapadiyinaalea, naangka'l ungka'laikku'riththu eppozhuthum theavanai sthoaththirikkak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'roam.
neengka'l nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin makimaiyai adaiyumporuttaaka engka'l suviseashaththinaalea antha iradchippukku avar ungka'lai azhaiththaar.
aakaiyaal, sakoathararea, neengka'l nilaiko'ndu, vaarththaiyinaalaavathu nirupaththinaalaavathu naangka'l ungka'lukku upatheasiththa mu'raimaika'laik kaikko'l'lungka'l.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvum, nammidaththil anpukoornthu niththiya aa'ruthalaiyum nalnampikkaiyaiyum kirupaiyaay namakkuk koduththirukki'ra nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanum,
ungka'l iruthayangka'laith theat'ri, ellaa nalvasanaththilum na'rkiriyaiyilum ungka'lai sthirappaduththuvaaraaka.
kadaisiyaaka, sakoathararea, ungka'lidaththil karththarudaiya vasanam parampi makimaippaduki'rathupoala, evvidaththilum parampi makimaippadumpadikkum,
thurkku'naraakiya pollaatha manushar kaiyinin'ru naangka'l viduvikkappadumpadikkum, engka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; visuvaasam ellaaridaththilumillaiyea.
karththaroa u'nmaiyu'l'lavar, avar ungka'lai sthirappaduththi, theemaiyinin'ru vilakkik kaaththukko'l'luvaar.
mealum, naangka'l katta'laiyiduki'ravaika'lai neengka'l seythuvaruki'reerka'len'rum, inimealum seyveerka'len'rum, ungka'laikku'riththuk karththarukku'l nampikkaiyaayirukki'roam.
karththar ungka'l iruthayangka'laith theavanaippat'rum anpukkum ki'risthuvin po'rumaikkum nearaay nadaththuvaaraaka.

mealum, sakoathararea, engka'lidaththil eat'rukko'nda mu'raimaiyinpadi nadavaamal, ozhungkat'ru nadakki'ra enthach sakoatharanaiyum neengka'l vittu vilaka vea'ndumen'ru, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea, ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyiduki'roam.
innavithamaay engka'laip pinpat'ra vea'ndumen'ru neengka'l a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea; naangka'l ungka'lukku'l'lea ozhungkat'ru nadavaamalum,
oruvanidaththilum ilavasamaaych saappidaamalum, ungka'lil oruvanukkum paaramaayiraathapadikku iravum pakalum pirayaasaththoadum varuththaththoadum vealaiseythu saappittoam.

ungka'lmeal paaraththai vaippatha'rkaana athikaaram engka'lukku illaiyenpathinaalea appadich seyyaamal, neengka'l engka'laip pinpat'rumpadikku naangka'l ungka'lukku maathiriyaayirukkavea'ndumen'rea appadich seythoam.
oruvan vealaiseyya manathillaathirunthaal avan saappidavum koodaathen'ru naangka'l ungka'lidaththil irunthapoathu ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyittoamea.
ungka'lil silar yaathoru vealaiyum seyyaamal, vee'n aluva'rkaararaay, ozhungkat'ruth thiriki'raarka'len'ru kea'lvippaduki'roam.

ippadippattavarka'l amaithaloadea vealaiseythu, thangka'l sonthach saappaattaich saappidavea'ndumen'ru, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalea avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyittup puththisolluki'roam.
sakoathararea, neengka'l nanmai seyvathilea soarnthupoakaamalirungka'l.
mealum, intha nirupaththil solliya engka'l vasanaththukku oruvan keezhppadiyaama'rpoanaal, avanaik ku'riththukko'ndu, avan vedkappadumpadikku avanudanea kalavaathirungka'l.
aanaalum avanaich saththuruvaaka e'n'naamal, sakoatharanaaka e'n'ni, avanukkup puththisollungka'l.
samaathaanaththin karththarthaamea eppozhuthum sakalavithaththilum ungka'lukkuch samaathaanaththaith thantharu'luvaaraaka. karththar ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppaaraaka.
pavulaakiya naan en kaiyezhuththaalea ungka'lai vaazhththuki'rean, nirupangka'lthoa'rum ithuvea adaiyaa'lam; ippadiyea ezhuthuki'rean.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupai ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
nammudaiya iradchakaraayirukki'ra theavanum, nammudaiya nampikkaiyaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvum katta'laiyittapadiyea, iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaayirukki'ra pavul,

visuvaasaththil uththama kumaaranaakiya theemoaththeayuvukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum nammudaiya karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvinaalum kirupaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

veat'rumaiyaana upatheasangka'laip poathiyaathapadikkum, visuvaasaththinaal vi'langkum theyveeka pakthiviruththikku eathuvaayiraamal, tharkkangka'lukku eathuvaayirukki'ra kattukkathaika'laiyum mudivillaatha vamsavaralaa'ruka'laiyum kavaniyaathapadikkum, nee silarukkuk katta'laiyidumporuttaaka,
naan makkethoaniyaavukkup poakumpoathu unnai epeasu patta'naththilirukka vea'ndikko'ndapadiyea seyvaayaaka.
ka'rpanaiyin poru'l ennavenil, suththamaana iruthayaththilum nalmanachsaadchiyilum maayamat'ra visuvaasaththilum pi'rakkum anpea.
ivaika'laich silar noakkaamal vee'npeachchukku idangkoduththu vilakippoanaarka'l.
thaangka'l solluki'rathu innathen'rum, thaangka'l saathikki'rathu innathen'rum a'riyaathirunthum, niyaayappiramaa'na poathakaraayirukka virumpuki'raarka'l.
oruvan niyaayappiramaa'naththai niyaayappadi anusariththaal, niyaayappiramaa'nam nallathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.

engka'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, niyaayappiramaa'nam neethimaanukku vithikkappadaamal, akkiramakkaararukkum, adangkaathavarka'lukkum, pakthiyillaathavarka'lukkum, paavika'lukkum, asuththarukkum, seerkettavarka'lukkum, thaaythakappanmaarai adikki'ravarka'lukkum, kolaipaathakarukkum,
veasikka'l'larukkum, aa'npu'narchchikkaararukkum, manusharaith thiruduki'ravarka'lukkum, poyyarukkum, poyyaa'nai iduki'ravarka'lukkum,

niththiyaanantha theavanudaiya makimaiyaana suviseashaththinpadi enakku oppuvikkappattirukki'ra aaroakkiyamaana upatheasaththi'rku ethiridaiyaayirukki'ra mat'renthach seykaikkum viroathamaay vithikkappattirukki'rathu.
ennaip palappaduththuki'ra nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu ennai u'nmaiyu'l'lavanen're'n'ni, intha oozhiyaththi'rku ea'rpaduththinapadiyaal, avarai sthoaththirikki'rean.
munnea naan thooshikki'ravanum, thunpappaduththuki'ravanum, kodumai seyki'ravanumaayirunthean; appadiyirunthum, naan a'riyaamal avisuvaasaththinaalea appadich seythapadiyinaal irakkampet'rean.
nammudaiya karththarin kirupai ki'risthu iyeasuvinmealu'l'la visuvaasaththoadum anpoadungkooda ennidaththil paripoora'namaayp perukit'ru.
paavika'lai iradchikka ki'risthu iyeasu ulakaththil vanthaar enki'ra vaarththai u'nmaiyum ellaa angkikarippukkum paaththiramumaanathu; avarka'lil pirathaana paavi naan.

appadiyirunthum, niththiya jeevanai adaiyumpadi inimeal iyeasuki'risthuvinidaththil visuvaasamaayiruppavarka'lukkuth thirushdaantham u'ndaakumporuttup pirathaana paaviyaakiya ennidaththil avar ellaa neediya po'rumaiyaiyum kaa'npikkumpadikku irakkampet'rean.
niththiyamum azhivillaamaiyum atharisanamumu'l'la raajanumaay, thaam oruvarea gnaanamu'l'la theavanumaayirukki'ravarukku, kanamum makimaiyum sathaakaalangka'lilum u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.

kumaaranaakiya theemoaththeayuvea, unnaikku'riththu mun u'ndaana theerkkatharisanangka'linpadiyea, nee avaika'lai munnittu nalla poaraattampa'n'numpadi, inthak katta'laiyai unakku oppuvikki'rean; nee visuvaasamum nalmanachsaadchiyum udaiyavanaayiru.
intha nalmanachsaadchiyaich silar tha'l'livittu, visuvaasamaakiya kappalaich seathappaduththinaarka'l.
imeneayum aleksantharum appadippattavarka'l; avarka'l thooshiyaathapadi sidchikkappada avarka'laich saaththaanidaththil oppukkoduththean.
naan pirathaanamaaych solluki'ra puththiyennavenil, ellaa manusharukkaakavum vi'n'nappangka'laiyum jepangka'laiyum vea'nduthalka'laiyum sthoaththirangka'laiyum pa'n'navea'ndum;
naam ellaap pakthiyoadum nallozhukkaththoadum kalakamillaamal amaithalu'l'la jeevanampa'n'numpadikku, raajaakka'lukkaakavum, athikaaramu'l'la yaavarukkaakavum appadiyea seyyavea'ndum.
nammudaiya iradchakaraakiya theavanukkumunpaaka athu nanmaiyum piriyamumaayirukki'rathu.
ellaa manusharum iradchikkappadavum, saththiyaththai a'riki'ra a'rivai adaiyavum, avar siththamu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.
theavan oruvarea, theavanukkum manusharukkum maththiyastharum oruvarea.
ellaaraiyum meedkumporu'laakath thammai oppukkoduththa manushanaakiya ki'risthu iyeasu avarea; itha'rkuriya saadchi eat'ra kaalangka'lil vi'langkivaruki'rathu.

itha'rkaakavea naan pirasangkiyaakavum, appoasthalanaakavum, pu'rajaathika'lukku visuvaasaththaiyum saththiyaththaiyum vi'langkappa'n'nuki'ra poathakanaakavum niyamikkappattirukki'rean; naan poy sollaamal ki'risthuvukku'l u'nmaiyaich solluki'rean.
an'riyum, purusharka'l koapamum tharkkamumillaamal parisuththamaana kaika'lai uyarththi, ellaa idangka'lileayum jepampa'n'navea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'rean.
sthireeka'lum mayiraip pinnuthalinaalaavathu, ponninaalaavathu, muththukka'linaalaavathu, vilaiyea'rappet'ra vasthiraththinaalaavathu thangka'lai alangkariyaamal,

thakuthiyaana vasthiraththinaalum, naa'naththinaalum, the'lintha puththiyinaalum, theavapakthiyu'l'lavarka'len'ru sollikko'l'luki'ra sthireeka'lukku eat'rapadiyea na'rkiriyaika'linaalum, thangka'lai alangkarikkavea'ndum.
sthireeyaanava'l ellaavat'rilum adakkamudaiyava'laayirunthu, amaithaloadu kat'rukko'l'lakkadava'l.
upatheasampa'n'navum, purushanmeal athikaaragn seluththavum, sthireeyaanava'lukku naan uththaravu kodukki'rathillai; ava'l amaithalaayirukkavea'ndum.
ennaththinaalenil, muthalaavathu aathaam uruvaakkappattaan, pinpu eavaa'l uruvaakkappattaa'l.
mealum, aathaam vagnchikkappadavillai, sthireeyaanava'lea vagnchikkappattu mee'ruthalukku udpattaa'l.
appadiyirunthum, the'lintha puththiyoadu visuvaasaththilum anpilum parisuththaththilum nilaiko'ndirunthaal, pi'l'laippeat'rinaalea iradchikkappaduvaa'l.
ka'nkaa'nippai virumpuki'ravan nalla vealaiyai virumpuki'raan, ithu u'nmaiyaana vaarththai.

aakaiyaal ka'nkaa'niyaanavan kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, orea manaiviyai udaiya purushanum, jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanum, the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavanum, yoakkiyathaiyu'l'lavanum, anniyarai upasarikki'ravanum, poathakasamarththanumaay irukkavea'ndum.
avan mathupaanappiriyanum, adikki'ravanum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchikki'ravanumaayiraamal, po'rumaiyu'l'lavanum, sa'ndaipa'n'naathavanum, pa'na aasaiyillaathavanumaayirunthu,
than sonthak kudumpaththai nan'raay nadaththuki'ravanum, than pi'l'laika'laich sakala nallozhukkamu'l'lavarka'laakak keezhppadiyappa'n'nuki'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
oruvan than sonthak kudumpaththai nadaththa a'riyaathirunthaal, theavanudaiya sapaiyai eppadi visaarippaan?
avan i'rumaappadainthu, pisaasu adaintha aakkinaiyilea vizhaathapadikku, noothana seeshanaayirukkakkoodaathu.
avan ninthanaiyilum, pisaasin ka'n'niyilum vizhaathapadikku, pu'rampaanavarka'laal na'rsaadchi pet'ravanaayumirukkavea'ndum.
anthappadiyea, uthavikkaararum irunaakku'l'lavarka'laayum, mathupaanappiriyaraayum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchikki'ravarka'laayum iraamal, nallozhukkamu'l'lavarka'laayum,
visuvaasaththin irakasiyaththaich suththa manachsaadchiyilea kaaththukko'l'luki'ravarka'laayum irukkavea'ndum.
mealum, ivarka'l munnathaakach soathikkappadavea'ndum; kut'ragnsaattappadaathavarka'laanaal uthavikkaararaaka oozhiyagnseyyalaam.
anthappadiyea sthireeka'lum nallozhukkamu'l'lavarka'lum, avathoo'rupa'n'naathavarka'lum, the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'lum, ellaavat'rileayum u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukkavea'ndum.
mealum, uthavikkaararaanavarka'l orea manaiviyaiyudaiya purusharumaay, thangka'l pi'l'laika'laiyum sonthak kudumpangka'laiyum nan'raay nadaththuki'ravarka'lumaayirukkavea'ndum.
ippadi uthavikkaararudaiya oozhiyaththai nan'raaych seyki'ravarka'l thangka'lukku nalla nilaiyaiyum, ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththil mikuntha thairiyaththaiyum adaivaarka'l.
naan unnidaththi'rkuch seekkiramaay varuveanen'ru nampiyirukki'rean.

thaamathippeanaakil, theavanudaiya veettilea nadakkavea'ndiya vakaiyai nee a'riyumpadi ivaika'lai unakku ezhuthuki'rean; antha veedu jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya sapaiyaaych saththiyaththukkuth thoo'num aathaaramumaayirukki'rathu.

an'riyum, theavapakthikkuriya irakasiyamaanathu yaavarum oppukko'l'luki'rapadiyea makaa meanmaiyu'l'lathu. theavan maamsaththilea ve'lippattaar, aaviyilea neethiyu'l'lavaren'ru vi'langkappattaar, theavathootharka'laal kaa'nappattaar, pu'rajaathika'lidaththil pirasangkikkappattaar, ulakaththilea visuvaasikkappattaar, makimaiyilea ea'reduththukko'l'lappattaar.

aakilum, aaviyaanavar ve'lippadaiyaaych solluki'rapadi, pi'rkaalangka'lilea manachsaadchiyil soodu'nda poyyarudaiya maayaththinaalea silar vagnchikki'ra aavika'lukkum pisaasuka'lin upatheasangka'lukkum sevikoduththu, visuvaasaththai vittu vilakippoavaarka'l.
vivaakampa'n'naathirukkavum,
visuvaasika'lum saththiyaththai a'rinthavarka'lum sthoaththiraththoadea anupavikkumpadi theavan padaiththa poajanapathaarththangka'lai vilakkavum vea'ndumen'ru anthap poyyar katta'laiyiduvaarka'l.
theavan padaiththathellaam nallathaayirukki'rathu; sthoaththiraththoadea eat'rukko'l'lappadumaakil on'rum tha'l'lappadaththakkathalla.
athu theavavasanaththinaalum jepaththinaalum parisuththamaakkappadum.

ivaika'lai nee sakoathararukkup poathiththuvanthaal, visuvaasaththi'rkuriya vaarththaika'lilum nee anusariththa na'rpoathakaththilum thea'rinavanaaki, iyeasuki'risthuvukku nalla oozhiyakkaaranaayiruppaay.
seerkeadum kizhavika'l peachchumaayirukki'ra kattukkathaika'lukku vilaki, theava pakthikkeathuvaaka muya'rchipa'n'nu.
sareeramuya'rchi a'rpa pirayoajanamu'l'lathu; theavapakthiyaanathu intha jeevanukkum itha'rkup pinvarum jeevanukkum vaakkuththaththamu'l'lathaakaiyaal ellaavat'rilum pirayoajanamu'l'lathu.
intha vaarththai u'nmaiyum ellaa angkikarippukkum paaththiramumaayirukki'rathu.
ithinimiththam pirayaasappaduki'roam, ninthaiyum adaiki'roam; eanenil ellaa manusharukkum, viseashamaaka visuvaasika'lukkum iradchakaraakiya jeevanu'l'la theavanmeal nampikkai vaiththirukki'roam.
ivaika'lai nee katta'laiyittup poathiththukko'ndiru.
un i'lamaiyaikku'riththu oruvanum unnai asattaipa'n'naathapadikku, nee vaarththaiyilum, nadakkaiyilum, anpilum, aaviyilum, visuvaasaththilum, ka'rpilum, visuvaasika'lukku maathiriyaayiru.
naan varuma'lavum vaasikki'rathilum puththisolluki'rathilum upatheasikki'rathilum jaakkirathaiyaayiru.
moopparaakiya sangkaththaar unmeal kaika'lai vaiththapoathu theerkkatharisanaththinaal unakku a'likkappatta varaththaippat'ri asathiyaayiraathea.
nee thea'ruki'rathu yaavarukkum vi'langkumpadi ivaika'laiyea sinthiththukko'ndu, ivaika'lilea nilaiththiru.
unnaikku'riththum upatheasaththaikku'riththum echcharikkaiyaayiru, ivaika'lil nilaiko'ndiru, ippadich seyvaayaanaal, unnaiyum un upatheasaththaik keadpavarka'laiyum iradchiththukko'l'luvaay.
muthirvayathu'l'lavanaik kadinthuko'l'laamal, avanaith thakappanaippoalavum, paaliya purusharaich sakoathararaippoalavum,
muthirvayathu'l'la sthireeka'laith thaayka'laippoalavum, paaliya sthireeka'lai ellaak ka'rpudan sakoatharika'laippoalavum paaviththu, puththisollu.
uththama vithavaika'laakiya vithavaika'laik kanampa'n'nu.

vithavaiyaanava'lukkup pi'l'laika'laavathu, pearan pearththika'laavathu irunthaal, ivarka'l muthalaavathu thangka'l sonthak kudumpaththaith theavapakthiyaay visaariththu, pet'raar seytha nanmaika'lukkup pathil nanmaika'laich seyyak kat'rukko'l'lakkadavarka'l; athu nanmaiyum theavanukku munpaakap piriyamumaayirukki'rathu.
uththama vithavaiyaayirunthu thanimaiyaayirukki'rava'l theavanidaththil nampikkaiyu'l'lava'laay, iravum pakalum vea'nduthalka'lilum jepangka'lilum nilaiththiruppaa'l.
sukapoakamaay vaazhki'rava'l uyiroadea seththava'l.
avarka'l kut'ragnsaattappadaathavarka'laayirukkumpadi ivaika'laik katta'laiyidu.
oruvan than sontha janangka'laiyum, viseashamaakath than veettaaraiyum visaariyaama'rpoanaal, avan visuvaasaththai ma'ruthaliththavanum, avisuvaasiyilum kettavanumaayiruppaan.
a'rupathu vayathukkuk ku'raiyaathava'lum, orea purushanukku manaiviyaayirunthava'lumaaki,

pi'l'laika'lai va'larththu, anniyarai upasariththu, parisuththavaanka'ludaiya kaalka'laikkazhuvi, upaththiravappaduki'ravarka'lukku uthaviseythu, sakalavitha na'rkiriyaika'laiyum jaakkirathaiyaay nadappiththu, ivvithamaay na'rkiriyaika'laikku'riththu na'rsaadchi pet'rava'lumaayirunthaal, appadippatta vithavaiyaiyea vithavaika'l koottaththil searththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
i'lavayathu'l'la vithavaika'lai athilea searththukko'l'laathea; eanenil, avarka'l ki'risthuvukku viroathamaayk kaamavikaarangko'l'lumpoathu vivaakampa'n'na manathaaki,
muthalil ko'ndiruntha visuvaasaththai viduvathinaalea, aakkinaikkudpaduvaarka'l.

athuvumallaamal, avarka'l soampalu'l'lavarka'laay, veeduveedaayth thiriyappazhakuvaarka'l; soampalu'l'lavarka'laay maaththiramalla, alappuki'ravarka'laayum vee'naluva'rkaarika'laayum thakaatha kaariyangka'laip peasuki'ravarka'laayumiruppaarka'l.
aakaiyaal i'lavayathu'l'la vithavaika'l vivaakampa'n'navum, pi'l'laika'laip pe'ravum, veettai nadaththavum, viroathiyaanavan ninthikki'ratha'rku idamu'ndaakkaamalirukkavum vea'ndumen'rirukki'rean.
eanenil itha'rkumunnea silar saaththaanaip pinpat'ri vilakippoanaarka'l.

visuvaasiyaakiya oruvanidaththilaavathu oruththiyidaththilaavathu vithavaika'lirunthaal, avarka'l ivarka'lukku uthavi seyyakkadavarka'l; sapaiyaanathu uththama vithavaika'laanavarka'lukku uthaviseyyavea'ndiyathaakaiyaal anthap paaraththai athinmeal vaikkakkoodaathu.
nan'raay visaara'naiseyki'ra moopparka'lai, viseashamaakath thiruvasanaththilum upatheasaththilum pirayaasappaduki'ravarka'lai, irattippaana kanaththi'rkup paaththiraraaka e'n'navea'ndum.
poaradikki'ra maattai vaaykattaayaaka en'rum, vealaiyaa'l than koolikkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan en'rum, veathavaakkiyam solluki'rathea.
mooppanaanavanukku viroathamaaka oruvan seyyum piraathai ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'l illaamal nee eat'rukko'l'lakkoodaathu.
mat'ravarka'lukkup payamu'ndaakumpadi, paavagnseythavarka'lai ellaarukkum munpaakak kadinthuko'l.

nee padchapaathaththoadea on'rum seyyaamalum, visaarikkumun niru'nayampa'n'naamalum, ivaika'laik kaaththu nadakkumpadi, theavanukkum, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukkum, therinthuko'l'lappatta thootharukkum munpaaka, u'ruthiyaayk katta'laiyiduki'rean.
oruvanmealum seekkiramaayk kaika'lai vaiyaathea; mat'ravarka'l seyyum paavangka'lukkum udanpadaathea; unnaich suththavaanaakak kaaththukko'l.
nee inimeal tha'n'neer maaththiram kudiyaamal, un vayit'ri'rkaakavum, unakku adikkadi neariduki'ra palaveenangka'lukkaakavum, kogncham thiraadcharasamum koottikko'l.
silarudaiya paavangka'l ve'liyarangkamaayirunthu, niyaayaththeerppukku munthikko'l'lum; silarudaiya paavangka'l avarka'laip pinthodarum.
appadiyea silarudaiya na'rkiriyaika'lum ve'liyarangkamaayirukkum; appadi iraathavaika'lum ma'rainthirukkamaattaathu.

theavanudaiya naamamum upatheasamum thooshikkappadaathapadikku, adimaiththana nukaththi'rkudpattirukki'ra vealaikkaarar yaavarum thangka'l ejamaanka'lai ellaak kanaththi'rkum paaththiraren'ru e'n'nikko'l'lakkadavarka'l.

visuvaasika'laakiya ejamaanka'lai udaiyavarka'l, thangka'l ejamaanka'l sakoathararaayirukki'rathinaalea avarka'lai asattaipa'n'naamal, nalvealaiyin palanaip pet'rukko'l'luki'ra avarka'l visuvaasika'lum piriyarumaayirukki'rapadiyaal, avarka'lukku athikamaay oozhiyagnseyyakkadavarka'l; inthappadiyea poathiththup puththisollu.

oruvan nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin aaroakkiyamaana vasanangka'laiyum, theavapakthikkeat'ra upatheasangka'laiyum oppukko'l'laamal, veat'rumaiyaana upatheasangka'laip poathikki'ravanaanaal,

avan i'rumaappu'l'lavanum, on'rum a'riyaathavanum, tharkkangka'laiyum vaakkuvaathangka'laiyumpat'ri noayko'ndavanumaayirukki'raan; avaika'laalea po'raamaiyum, sa'ndaiyum, thoosha'nangka'lum, pollaatha samsayangka'lumu'ndaaki,

ketta sinthaiyu'l'lavarka'lum saththiyamillaathavarka'lum theavapakthiyai aathaayaththozhilen'ru e'n'nuki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'ra manusharka'laal u'ndaakum maa'rupaadaana tharkkangka'lum pi'rakkum; ippadippattavarka'lai vittu vilaku.
poathumenki'ra manathudanea koodiya theavapakthiyea mikuntha aathaayam.
ulakaththilea naam on'rum ko'nduvanthathumillai, ithilirunthu naam on'rum ko'ndupoavathumillai enpathu nichchayam.
u'n'navum udukkavum namakku u'ndaayirunthaal athu poathumen'rirukkak kadavoam.
aisuvariyavaanka'laaka virumpuki'ravarka'l soathanaiyilum ka'n'niyilum, manusharaik keattilum azhivilum amizhththuki'ra mathikeadum seathamumaana palavitha ichchaika'lilum vizhuki'raarka'l.
pa'na aasai ellaath theemaikkum vearaayirukki'rathu; silar athai ichchiththu, visuvaasaththaivittu vazhuvi, aneaka veathanaika'laalea thangka'lai uruvak kuththikko'ndirukki'raarka'l.
neeyoa, theavanudaiya manushanea, ivaika'lai vittoadi, neethiyaiyum theavapakthiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum anpaiyum po'rumaiyaiyum saanthaku'naththaiyum adaiyumpadi naadu.
visuvaasaththin nalla poaraattaththaip poaraadu, niththiyajeevanaip pat'rikko'l; atha'rkaakavea nee azhaikkappattaay; aneaka saadchika'lukku munpaaka nalla a'rikkai pa'n'ninavanumaayirukki'raay.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu pirasannamaakumvaraikkum, nee inthak ka'rpanaiyai maasillaamalum kut'ramillaamalum kaikko'l'lumpadikku,

ellaavat'raiyum uyiroadirukkach seyki'ra theavanudaiya sannithaanaththileayum, ponthiyupilaaththuvin munnin'ru nalla a'rikkaiyaich saadchiyaaka vi'langkappa'n'nina ki'risthu iyeasuvinudaiya sannithaanaththileayum unakkuk katta'laiyiduki'rean.
anthap pirasannamaakuthalaith theavan thammudaiya kaalangka'lil ve'lippaduththuvaar. avarea niththiyaananthamu'l'la eaka sakkaraathipathiyum, raajaathi raajaavum, karththaathi karththaavum,

oruvaraay, saavaamaiyu'l'lavarum, searakkoodaatha o'liyil vaasampa'n'nuki'ravarum, manusharil oruvarum ka'ndiraathavarum, kaa'nakkoodaathavarumaayirukki'ravar; avarukkea kanamum niththiya vallamaiyum u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.

ivvulakaththilea aisuvariyamu'l'lavarka'l i'rumaappaana sinthaiyu'l'lavarka'laayiraamalum, nilaiyat'ra aisuvariyaththinmeal nampikkai vaiyaamalum, naam anupavikki'ratha'rkuch sakalavitha nanmaika'laiyum namakkuch sampoora'namaayk kodukki'ra jeevanu'l'la theavanmeal nampikkai vaikkavum,
nanmaiseyyavum, na'rkiriyaika'lil aisuvariyavaanka'laakavum, thaaraa'lamaayk kodukki'ravarka'lum, uthaaraku'namu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukkavum,
niththiya jeevanaip pat'rikko'l'lumpadi varungkaalaththi'rkaakath thangka'lukku nalla aathaaraththaip pokkishamaaka vaikkavum avarka'lukkuk katta'laiyidu.
oa theemoaththeayuvea, unnidaththil oppuvikkappattathai nee kaaththukko'ndu, seerkeadaana vee'npeachchuka'lukkum, gnaanamen'ru poyyaayp pearpet'rirukki'ra ko'lkaiyin vipareethangka'lukkum vilaku.
silar athaip paaraatti, visuvaasaththaivittu vazhuvippoanaarka'l. kirupaiyaanathu unnoadeakooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal u'ndaayirukki'ra jeevanaippat'riya vaakkuththaththaththinpadi, theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea, iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaayirukki'ra pavul,

piriyamu'l'la kumaaranaakiya theemoaththeayuvukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: pithaavaakiya theavanaalum nammudaiya karththaraakiya ki'risthu iyeasuvinaalum kirupaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
naan iravum pakalum idaividaamal en jepangka'lil unnai ninaiththu, un ka'n'neerai gnaapakampa'n'ni, santhoashaththaal ni'raiyappadumpadikku unnaik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirunthu,
unnilu'l'la maayamat'ra visuvaasaththai ninaivukooruki'rathinaal, en munnoarka'l mutha'rko'ndu suththa manachsaadchiyoadea aaraathiththuvarum theavanai naan sthoaththirikki'rean.
antha visuvaasam munthi un paattiyaakiya loavisaa'lukku'l'lum un thaayaakiya ainikkeayaa'lukku'l'lum nilaiththirunthathu; athu unakku'l'lum nilaiththirukki'rathen'ru nichchayiththirukki'rean.
ithinimiththamaaka, naan unmeal en kaika'lai vaiththathinaal unakku u'ndaana theavavaraththai nee analmootti ezhuppividumpadi unakku ninaippoottuki'rean.
theavan namakkup payamu'l'la aaviyaik kodaamal, palamum anpum the'lintha puththiyu'l'la aaviyaiyea koduththirukki'raar.

aakaiyaal nammudaiya karththaraip pat'riya saadchiyaikku'riththaavathu, avar nimiththam kattappattirukki'ra ennaik ku'riththaavathu, nee vedkappadaamal, theavavallamaikkeat'rapadi suviseashaththi'rkaaka ennoadeakoodath theengkanupavi.

avar nammudaiya kiriyaika'linpadi nammai iradchikkaamal, thammudaiya theermaanaththinpadiyum, aathikaalamuthal ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l namakku aru'lappatta kirupaiyinpadiyum, nammai iradchiththu, parisuththa azhaippinaalea azhaiththaar.

nammudaiya iradchakaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu pirasannamaanathinaalea anthak kirupai ippozhuthu ve'lippaduththappattathu; avar mara'naththaip parikariththu, jeevanaiyum azhiyaamaiyaiyum suviseashaththinaalea ve'liyarangkamaakkinaar.
atha'rku naan pirasangkiyaakavum, appoasthalanaakavum, pu'rajaathiyaarukkup poathakanaakavum niyamikkappattean.

athinimiththam naan inthap paaduka'laiyum anupavikki'rean; aayinum, naan vedkappaduki'rathillai; eanen'raal, naan visuvaasiththirukki'ravar innaar en'ru a'rivean, naan avaridaththil oppukkoduththathai avar annaa'lvaraikkum kaaththukko'l'la vallavaraayirukki'raaren'ru nichchayiththumirukki'rean.
nee ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththoadum anpoadum ennidaththil keattirukki'ra aaroakkiyamaana vasanangka'lin sattaththaik kaikko'ndiru.
unnidaththil oppuvikkappatta antha na'rporu'lai namakku'l'lea vaasampa'n'nuki'ra parisuththa aaviyinaalea kaaththukko'l.
aasiyaanaattilirukki'ra yaavarum, avarka'lil pikellu ermokenea muthalaay ennaivittu vilakinaarka'len'ru a'rinthirukki'raay.
oneasippoaruvin veettaarukkuk karththar irakkang katta'laiyiduvaaraaka; avan aneakantharam ennai i'laippaat'rinaan; en vilangkaikku'riththu avan vedkappadavumillai;
avan roamaavil vanthirunthapoathu athika jaakkirathaiyaay ennaith theadik ka'ndupidiththaan.
annaa'lilea avan karththaridaththil irakkaththaik ka'ndadaiyumpadi, karththar avanukku anukkirakagnseyvaaraaka; avan epeasuvilea seytha pa'rpala uthavika'laiyum nee nan'raay a'rinthirukki'raayea.
aathalaal, en kumaaranea, nee ki'risthu iyeasuvilu'l'la kirupaiyil palappadu.
aneaka saadchika'lukku munpaaka nee ennidaththil keattavaika'lai mat'ravarka'lukkup poathikkaththakka u'nmaiyu'l'la manusharka'lidaththil oppuvi.
neeyum iyeasuki'risthuvukku nalla poarchseavakanaayth theengkanupavi.
tha'ndil seavakampa'n'nuki'ra evanum, thannaich seavakamezhuthikko'ndavanukku eat'ravanaayirukkumpadi, pizhaippukkaduththa aluvalka'lil sikkikko'l'lamaattaan.
mealum oruvan malyuththampa'n'ninaalum, sattaththinpadi pa'n'naavittaal mudisoottappadaan.
pirayaasappattup payiriduki'ravan palanil munthip pangkadaiyavea'ndum.
naan solluki'ravaika'laich sinthiththukko'l; karththar ellaak kaariyangka'lilum unakkup puththiyaith thantharu'luvaar.
thaaveethin santhathiyil pi'rantha iyeasuki'risthu, en suviseashaththinpadiyea, mariththoarilirunthezhuppappattavaren'ru ninaiththukko'l.
inthach suviseashaththinimiththam naan paathakanpoalak kattappattu, thunpaththai anupavikki'rean; theavavasanamoa kattappattirukkavillai.
aakaiyaal, therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'l ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal u'ndaana iradchippai niththiya makimaiyoadea pet'rukko'l'lumpadi, sakalaththaiyum avarka'l nimiththamaakach sakikki'rean.
intha vaarththai u'nmaiyu'l'lathu; ennavenil, naam avaroadeakooda mariththoamaanaal, avaroadeakoodap pizhaiththumiruppoam;
avaroadeakoodap paaduka'laich sakiththoamaanaal avaroadeakooda aa'lukaiyum seyvoam; naam avarai ma'ruthaliththaal, avarum nammai ma'ruthalippaar;
naam u'nmaiyillaathavarka'laayirunthaalum, avar u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar; avar thammaiththaam ma'ruthalikkamaattaar.

ivaika'lai avarka'lukku ninaippootti, on'rukkum pirayoajanamillaamal, keadki'ravarka'laik kavizhththuppoaduki'ratha'rkeathuvaana vaakkuvaatham seyyaathapadikku, karththarukku munpaaka avarka'lukku echchariththup puththisollu.
nee vedkappadaatha oozhiyakkaaranaayum saththiya vasanaththai nithaanamaayp pakuththup poathikki'ravanaayum unnaith theavanukku munpaaka uththamanaaka ni'ruththumpadi jaakkirathaiyaayiru.
seerkeadaana vee'npeachchuka'lukku vilakiyiru; avaika'laal (ka'l'lappoathakarka'laana) avarka'l athika avapakthiyu'l'lavarka'laavaarka'l;
avarka'ludaiya vaarththai aripi'lavaiyaippoalap padarum; imeneayum pileaththum appadippattavarka'l;
avarka'l saththiyaththai vittu vilaki, uyirththezhuthal nadanthaayit'ren'ru solli, silarudaiya visuvaasaththaik kavizhththuppoaduki'raarka'l.

aakilum theavanudaiya u'ruthiyaana asthipaaram nilaiththirukki'rathu; karththar thammudaiyavarka'lai a'rivaarenpathum, ki'risthuvin naamaththaich solluki'ra evanum aniyaayaththaivittu vilakakkadavanenpathum, atha'rku muththiraiyaayirukki'rathu.
oru periya veettilea ponnum ve'l'liyumaana paaththirangka'lumallaamal, maramum ma'n'numaana paaththirangka'lumu'ndu; avaika'lil sila kanaththi'rkum sila kanaveenaththi'rkumaanavaika'l.

aakaiyaal oruvan ivaika'lai vittu, thannaich suththikariththukko'ndaal, avan parisuththamaakkappattathum, ejamaanukku upayoakamaanathum, entha na'rkiriyaikkum aayaththamaakkappattathumaana kanaththukkuriya paaththiramaayiruppaan.

an'riyum, paaliyaththukkuriya ichchaika'lukku nee vilakiyoadi, suththa iruthayaththoadea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'ludanea, neethiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum anpaiyum samaathaanaththaiyum adaiyumpadi naadu.
puththiyeenamum ayukthamumaana tharkkangka'l sa'ndaika'laip pi'rappikkumen'ru a'rinthu, avaika'lukku vilakiyiru.
karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaaran sa'ndaipa'n'nuki'ravanaayiraamal, ellaaridaththilum saanthamu'l'lavanum, poathakasamarththanum, theemaiyaich sakikki'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
ethirpeasuki'ravarka'l saththiyaththai a'riyumpadi theavan avarka'lukku mananthirumputhalai aru'laththakkathaakavum,
pisaasaanavanudaiya ichchaiyinpadi seyya avanaal pidipattirukki'ra avarka'l ma'rupadiyum mayakkanthe'linthu avan ka'n'nikku neengkaththakkathaakavum, saanthamaay avarka'lukku upatheasikkavea'ndum.
mealum, kadaisinaadka'lil kodiya kaalangka'l varumen'ru a'rivaayaaka.

eppadiyenil, manusharka'l tha'rpiriyaraayum, pa'nappiriyaraayum, veempukkaararaayum, akanthaiyu'l'lavarka'laayum, thooshikki'ravarka'laayum, thaaythakappanmaarukkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'laayum, nan'riya'riyaathavarka'laayum, parisuththamillaathavarka'laayum,
supaava anpillaathavarka'laayum, i'nangkaathavarka'laayum, avathoo'ru seyki'ravarka'laayum, ichchaiyadakkamillaathavarka'laayum, kodumaiyu'l'lavarka'laayum, nalloaraip pakaikki'ravarka'laayum,
thuroakika'laayum, thu'nikaramu'l'lavarka'laayum, i'rumaappu'l'lavarka'laayum, theavappiriyaraayiraamal sukapoakappiriyaraayum,
theavapakthiyin veashaththaith thariththu athin pelanai ma'ruthalikki'ravarka'laayum iruppaarka'l; ippadippattavarka'lai nee vittu vilaku.
