paavangka'laal ni'rainthu, pa'rpala ichchaika'laal izhuppu'ndu,
eppoathum kat'raalum orupoathum saththiyaththai a'rinthu u'naraathavarka'laayirukki'ra pe'npi'l'laika'ludaiya veeduka'lil ippadippattavarka'l nuzhainthu, avarka'lai vasappaduththikko'l'luki'raarka'l.

yanneayum yampireayum moaseakku ethirththu nin'rathupoala ivarka'lum saththiyaththukku ethirththu ni'rki'raarka'l; ivarka'l thurppuththiyu'l'la manusharka'l, visuvaasavishayaththil pareedchaikku nillaathavarka'l.
aanaalum, ivarka'l athikamaayp palappaduvathillai; avviruvarudaiya mathikeadu ellaarukkum ve'lippattathupoala, ivarka'ludaiya mathikeadum ve'lippadum.
neeyoa en poathakaththaiyum nadakkaiyaiyum noakkaththaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum neediya saanthaththaiyum anpaiyum po'rumaiyaiyum,

anthiyoakiyaa, ikkoaniyaa, leesthiraa ennum patta'nangka'lil enakku u'ndaana thunpangka'laiyum paaduka'laiyum nan'raay a'rinthirukki'raay; evva'lavoa thunpangka'laich sakiththean; ivaiyellaavat'rinin'rum karththar ennai neengkalaakkivittaar.
an'riyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l theavapakthiyaay nadakka manathaayirukki'ra yaavarum thunpappaduvaarka'l.
pollaathavarka'lum eththarka'lumaanavarka'l moasampoakkuki'ravarka'laakavum, moasampoaki'ravarka'laakavumirunthu meanmealum keadu'l'lavarka'laavaarka'l.
nee kat'ru nichchayiththukko'ndavaika'lil nilaiththiru; avaika'lai innaaridaththil kat'raay en'ru nee a'rinthirukki'rathumallaamal,

ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea unnai iradchippukkeat'ra gnaanamu'l'lavanaakkaththakka parisuththa veatha ezhuththukka'lai, nee si'ruvayathumuthal a'rinthavanen'rum unakkuth theriyum.
veathavaakkiyangka'lellaam theavaaaviyinaal aru'lappattirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya manushan thea'rinavanaakavum, entha na'rkiriyaiyugn seyyath thakuthiyu'l'lavanaakavum irukkumpadiyaaka,
avaika'l upatheasaththukkum, kadinthuko'l'luthalukkum, seerthiruththalukkum, neethiyaip padippikkuthalukkum pirayoajanamu'l'lavaika'laayirukki'rathu.

naan theavanukku munpaakavum, uyiroadirukki'ravarka'laiyum mariththavarka'laiyum niyaayantheerkkappoaki'ra karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku munpaakavum, avarudaiya pirasannamaakuthalaiyum avarudaiya raajyaththaiyum saadchiyaaka vaiththuk katta'laiyiduki'rathaavathu:
samayam vaayththaalum vaaykkaavittaalum jaakkirathaiyaayth thiruvasanaththaip pirasangkampa'n'nu; ellaa neediya saanthaththoadum upatheasaththoadum ka'ndanampa'n'ni, kadinthuko'ndu, puththisollu.

eanen'raal, avarka'l aaroakkiyamaana upatheasaththaip po'rukka manathillaamal, seviththinavu'l'lavarka'laaki, thangka'l suya ichchaika'lukkeat'ra poathakarka'laith thangka'lukkuth thira'laakach searththukko'ndu,
saththiyaththukkuch seviyai vilakki, kattukkathaika'lukkuch saaynthupoakungkaalam varum.
neeyoa ellaavat'rilum manaththe'livu'l'lavanaayiru, theengkanupavi, suviseashakanudaiya vealaiyaich sey, un oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'ru.
eanen'raal, naan ippozhuthea paanapaliyaaka vaarkkappattuppoaki'rean; naan theakaththai vittup piriyum kaalam vanthathu.
nalla poaraattaththaip poaraadinean, oattaththai mudiththean, visuvaasaththaik kaaththukko'ndean.

ithumuthal neethiyin kireedam enakkaaka vaikkappattirukki'rathu, neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathipathiyaakiya karththar annaa'lilea athai enakkuth thantharu'luvaar; enakku maaththiramalla, avar pirasannamaakuthalai virumpum yaavarukkum athaith thantharu'luvaar.
nee seekkiramaay ennidaththil varumpadi jaakkirathaippadu.

eanen'raal, theamaa ippirapagnchaththinmeal aasaivaiththu, ennaivittup pirinthu, thesaloanikkea patta'naththukkup poayvittaan; kireskea kalaaththiyaa naatti'rkum, theeththu thalmaaththiyaa naatti'rkum poayvittaarka'l.
lookkaamaaththiram ennoadea irukki'raan. maa'rkuvai unnoadea koottikko'nduvaa; oozhiyaththil avan enakkup pirayoajanamu'l'lavan.
theekikkuvai naan epeasuvukku anuppinean.
thuroavaa patta'naththilirukki'ra kaarppu enpavan vasaththil naan vaiththuvantha mealangkiyaiyum, pusthakangka'laiyum, viseashamaayth thoa'rsuru'lka'laiyum, nee varuki'rapoathu eduththukko'nduvaa.
kannaanaakiya aleksanthar enakku veku theemaiseythaan; avanudaiya seykaikkuththakkathaakak karththar avanukkup pathila'lippaaraaka.
neeyum avanaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayiru; avan nammudaiya vaarththaika'lukku mikavum ethirththunin'ravan.
naan muthalvisai uththaravusolla ni'rkaiyil oruvanum ennoadeakooda irukkavillai, ellaarum ennaik kaivittaarka'l; anthak kut'ram avarka'lmeal sumaraathiruppathaaka.

karththaroa enakkuth thu'naiyaaka nin'ru, ennaalea pirasangkam ni'raivea'ruki'ratha'rkaakavum, pu'rajaathiyaarellaarum keadki'ratha'rkaakavum, ennaip palappaduththinaar; singkaththin vaayilirunthum naan iradchikkappattean.
karththar ellaath theemaiyinin'rum ennai iradchiththu, thammudaiya parama raajyaththai adaiyumpadi kaappaat'ruvaar; avarukkuch sathaakaalangka'lilum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
piriskaa'lukkum aakkillaavukkum, oneasippoaruvin veettaarukkum en vaazhththuthalaich sollu.
erasthu korinthupatta'naththil irunthuvittaan; thuroappeemuvai mileaththuvil viyaathippattavanaaka vittuvanthean.
maarikaalaththukkumun nee vanthu searumpadi jaakkirathaippadu. aipooluvum, putheagnsum, leenuvum, kalavuthiyaa'lum, mat'rellaach sakoathararum unakku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu un aaviyudaneakooda iruppaaraaka. kirupai ungka'loadiruppathaaka. aamen.
theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaaranum, iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya appoasthalanumaakiya pavul, pothuvaana visuvaasaththinpadi uththama kumaaranaakiya theeththuvukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, nammudaiya iradchakaraayirukki'ra karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, kirupaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

poyyuraiyaatha theavan aathikaalamuthal niththiya jeevanaikku'riththu vaakkuththaththampa'n'ni, athaikku'riththa nampikkaiyaippat'ri theavapakthikkeathuvaana saththiyaththai a'riki'ra a'rivum visuvaasamum theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'lukku u'ndaakumpadi,
eat'rakaalangka'lilea nammudaiya iradchakaraakiya theavanudaiya katta'laiyinpadi enakku oppuvikkappatta pirasangkaththinaalea thamathu vaarththaiyai ve'lippaduththinaar.
nee ku'raivaayirukki'ravaika'lai ozhungkupaduththumpadikkum, naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, patta'nangka'lthoa'rum moopparai ea'rpaduththumpadikkum, unnaik kireaththaatheevilea vittuvantheanea.

kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, orea manaiviyaiyudaiya purushanum, thunmaarkkaren'rum adangkaathavarka'len'rum pearedukkaatha visuvaasamu'l'la pi'l'laika'lai udaiyavanumaakiya oruvanirunthaal avanaiyea ea'rpaduththalaam.

eanenil, ka'nkaa'niyaanavan theavanudaiya ukkiraa'nakkaaranukkeat'ravithamaay, kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, than ishdappadi seyyaathavanum, mu'rkoapamillaathavanum, mathupaanappiriyamillaathavanum, adiyaathavanum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchiyaathavanum,
anniyarai upasarikki'ravanum, nalloarmeal piriyamu'l'lavanum, the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavanum, neethimaanum, parisuththavaanum, ichchaiyadakkamu'l'lavanum,

aaroakkiyamaana upatheasaththinaalea puththisollavum, ethirpeasuki'ravarka'laik ka'ndanam pa'n'navum vallavanumaayirukkumpadi, thaan poathikkappattatha'rkeat'ra u'nmaiyaana vasanaththai nan'raayp pat'rikko'l'luki'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
aneakar, viseashamaay viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarka'l, adangkaathavarka'lum, vee'npeachchukkaararum, manathai mayakkuki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya vaayai adakkavea'ndum; avarka'l izhivaana aathaayaththukkaakath thakaathavaika'lai upatheasiththu, muzhukkudumpangka'laiyum kavizhththuppoaduki'raarka'l.
kireaththaatheevaar oayaappoyyar, thushdamirukangka'l, peruvayit'ruch soampea'rika'l en'ru avarka'liloruvanaakiya avarka'l theerkkatharisiyaanavanea solliyirukki'raan.
inthach saadchi u'nmaiyaayirukki'rathu; ithu mukaantharamaaka, avarka'l yootharudaiya kattukkathaika'lukkum, saththiyaththai vittu vilakuki'ra manusharudaiya ka'rpanaika'lukkum sevikodaamal,
visuvaasaththilea aaroakkiyamu'l'lavarka'laayirukkumpadi, nee avarka'laik ka'ndippaayk kadinthuko'l.

suththamu'l'lavarka'lukkuch sakalamum suththamaayirukkum; asuththamu'l'lavarka'lukkum avisuvaasamu'l'lavarka'lukkum on'rum suththamaayiraathu; avarka'ludaiya puththiyum manachsaadchiyum asuththamaayirukkum.

avarka'l theavanai a'rinthirukki'roamen'ru a'rikkaipa'n'nuki'raarka'l, kiriyaika'linaaloa avarai ma'ruthalikki'raarka'l; avarka'l aruvarukkappadaththakkavarka'lum, keezhppadiyaathavarka'lum, entha na'rkiriyaiyugnseyya aakaathavarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l.
neeyoa aaroakkiyamaana upatheasaththukkeat'ravaika'laip peasu.

muthirvayathu'l'la purusharka'l jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavarka'lum, nallozhukkamu'l'lavarka'lum, the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'lum, visuvaasaththilum anpilum po'rumaiyilum aaroakkiyamu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukkumpadi puththisollu.
muthirvayathu'l'la sthireeka'lum appadiyea parisuththaththukkeat'ravithamaay nadakki'ravarka'lum, avathoo'rupa'n'naathavarka'lum, mathupaanaththukku adimaippadaathavarka'lumaayirukkavum,
theavavasanam thooshikkappadaathapadikkup paaliya sthireeka'l thangka'l purusharidaththilum, thangka'l pi'l'laika'lidaththilum anpu'l'lavarka'lum,

the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'lum, ka'rpu'l'lavarka'lum, veettil thariththirukki'ravarka'lum, nallavarka'lum, thangka'l purusharukkuk keezhppadiki'ravarka'lumaayirukkumpadi, avarka'lukkup padippikkaththakka na'rkaariyangka'laip poathikki'ravarka'lumaayirukkavum muthirvayathu'l'la sthireeka'lukkup puththisollu.
appadiyea, paaliya purusharum the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'laayirukkavum nee puththisolli,
neeyea ellaavat'rilum unnai na'rkiriyaika'lukku maathiriyaakak kaa'npiththu,

ethiriyaanavan ungka'laikku'riththup pollaangku solluki'ratha'rku on'rumillaamal vedkappadaththakkathaaka, upatheasaththilea vika'rpamillaathavanum, nallozhukkamu'l'lavanum kut'rampidikkappadaatha aaroakkiyamaana vasanaththaip peasuki'ravanumaayiruppaayaaka.
vealaikkaarar nammudaiya iradchakaraakiya theavanudaiya upatheasaththai ellaavat'rilum alangkarikkaththakkathaaka,

thangka'l ejamaanka'lukkuk keezhppadinthirunthu ethirththuppeasaamal, ellaavat'rilum piriyamu'ndaaka nadanthuko'l'lavum, thirudaamalirunthu, sakalavithaththilum nallu'nmaiyaik kaa'npikkavum puththisollu.
eanenil ellaa manusharukkum iradchippai a'likkaththakka theavakirupaiyaanathu pirasannamaaki,
naam avapakthiyaiyum laukika ichchaika'laiyum ve'ruththu, the'lintha puththiyum neethiyum theavapakthiyum u'l'lavarka'laay ivvulakaththilea jeevanampa'n'ni,

naam nampiyirukki'ra aanantha paakkiyaththukkum, makaa theavanum namathu iradchakarumaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya makimaiyin pirasannamaakuthalukkum ethirpaarththukko'ndirukkumpadi namakkup poathikki'rathu.

avar nammaich sakala akkiramangka'linin'ru meettukko'ndu, thamakkuriya sontha janangka'laakavum, na'rkiriyaika'laich seyyap pakthivairaakkiyamu'l'lavarka'laakavum nammaich suththikarikkumpadi, namakkaakath thammaiththaamea oppukkoduththaar.
ivaika'lai nee peasi, poathiththu, sakala athikaaraththoadum kadinthuko'l. oruvanum unnai asattaipa'n'na idangkodaathiruppaayaaka.
thuraiththanangka'lukkum athikaarangka'lukkum keezhppadinthu adangkiyirukkavum, sakalavithamaana na'rkiriyaika'laiyum seyya aayaththamaayirukkavum,
oruvanaiyum thooshiyaamalum, sa'ndai pa'n'naamalum, po'rumaiyu'l'lavarka'laay ellaa manusharukkum saanthaku'naththaik kaa'npikkavum avarka'lukku ninaippoottu.

eanenil, mu'rkaalaththilea naamum puththiyeenarum, keezhppadiyaathavarka'lum, vazhithappi nadakki'ravarka'lum, palavitha ichchaika'lukkum inpangka'lukkum adimaippattavarka'lum, thurkku'naththoadum po'raamaiyoadum jeevanampa'n'nuki'ravarka'lum, pakaikkappadaththakkavarka'lum, oruvaraiyoruvar pakaikki'ravarka'lumaayirunthoam.
nammudaiya iradchakaraakiya theavanudaiya thayaiyum manusharmealu'l'la anpum pirasannamaanapoathu,

naam seytha neethiyin kiriyaika'linimiththam avar nammai iradchiyaamal, thamathu irakkaththinpadiyea, ma'rujenma muzhukkinaalum, parisuththa aaviyinudaiya puthithaakkuthalinaalum nammai iradchiththaar.
thamathu kirupaiyinaalea naam neethimaanka'laakkappattu, niththiya jeevanu'ndaakum enki'ra nampikkaiyinpadi suthanthararaakaththakkathaaka,
avar namathu iradchakaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu moolamaay, anthap parisuththaaaviyai nammeal sampoora'namaayp pozhintharu'linaar.

intha vaarththai u'nmaiyu'l'lathu; theavanidaththil visuvaasamaanavarka'l na'rkiriyaika'laich seyya jaakkirathaiyaayirukkumpadi nee ivaika'laikku'riththuth thittamaayp poathikkavea'ndumen'ru virumpuki'rean; ivaika'lea nanmaiyum manusharukkup pirayoajanamumaanavaika'l.

puththiyeenamaana tharkkangka'laiyum, vamsavaralaa'ruka'laiyum, sa'ndaika'laiyum, niyaayappiramaa'naththaikku'riththu u'ndaaki'ra vaakkuvaathangka'laiyum vittu vilaku; avaika'l appirayoajanamum vee'numaayirukkum.
veathappurattanaayirukki'ra oruvanukku nee ira'ndorutharam puththi sonnapinpu avanaivittu vilaku.
appadippattavan nilaithava'ri, thannileathaanea aakkinaiththeerppudaiyavanaayp paavagnseyki'ravanen'ru a'rinthirukki'raayea.
naan arththemaavaiyaavathu theekikkuvaiyaavathu unnidaththil anuppumpoathu nee nikkoppoalikku ennidaththil vara jaakkirathaippadu; maarikaalaththilea angkea thangkumpadi theermaaniththirukki'rean.
niyaayasaasthiriyaakiya seanaavukkum appolloavukkum oru ku'raivumillaathapadikku avarka'lai jaakkirathaiyaay visaariththu vazhivittanuppu.
nammudaiyavarka'lum kaniyat'ravarka'laayiraathapadi ku'raivuka'lai neekkuki'ratha'rkeathuvaaka na'rkiriyaika'laich seyyappazhakattum.

ennoadirukki'ra yaavarum unakku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l. visuvaasaththilea nammaich sineakikki'ravarka'lukku vaazhththuthal sollu. kirupaiyaanathu ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinimiththam kattappattavanaayirukki'ra pavulum, sakoatharanaakiya theemoaththeayum, engka'lukkup piriyamu'l'lavanum udanvealaiyaa'lumaayirukki'ra pileamoanukkum,
piriyamu'l'la appiyaa'lukkum, engka'l udan poarchseavakanaakiya arkkippuvukkum, ummudaiya veettilea koodivaruki'ra sapaikkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanaalum, karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.
karththaraakiya iyeasuvinidaththilum, ellaap parisuththavaanka'lidaththilumu'l'la ummudaiya anpaiyum ummudaiya visuvaasaththaiyum naan kea'lvippattu,
en jepangka'lil ummai ninaiththu, eppozhuthum en theavanukku sthoaththiragnseythu,
ungka'lilu'l'la sakala nanmaika'lum theriyappaduki'rathinaalea ummudaiya visuvaasaththin anniyoanniyam ki'risthuiyeasuvukkaakap payanpadavea'ndumen'ru vea'nduthalseyki'rean.
sakoatharanea, parisuththavaanka'ludaiya u'l'langka'l ummaalea i'laippaa'rinapadiyaal, ummudaiya anpinaalea mikuntha santhoashamum aa'ruthalum adainthirukki'roam.
aakaiyaal, pavulaakiya naan muthirvayathu'l'lavanaakavum, iyeasuki'risthuvinimiththam ippozhuthu kattappattavanaakavum irukki'rapadiyaal,
neer seyyaththakkathai umakkuk katta'laiyidumpadikkuk ki'risthuvukku'l naan thu'niyaththakkavanaayirunthaalum, appadich seyyaamal, anpinimiththam man'raaduki'rean.
ennaven'raal, kattappattirukkaiyil naan pet'ra en makanaakiya oneasimukkaaka ummai man'raaduki'rean.
munnea avan umakkup pirayoajanamillaathavan, ippozhuthoa umakkum enakkum pirayoajanamu'l'lavan.
avanai naan ummidaththi'rku anuppuki'rean; en u'l'lampoalirukki'ra avanai neer eat'rukko'l'lum.
suviseashaththinimiththam kattappattirukki'ra enakku oozhiyagnseyyumpadi umakkup pathilaaka avanai ennidaththil vaiththukko'l'lavea'ndumen'rirunthean.
aanaalum neer seyyum nanmaiyaik kattaayaththinaalalla, manappoorvamaaych seyyaththakkathaaka, naan ummudaiya sammathiyillaamal on'rum seyya enakku manathillai.

avan en'ren'raikkum ummudaiyavanaayirukkumpadikkum, inimeal avan adimaiyaanavanaakavalla, adimaiyaanavanukku mealaanavanaakavum piriyamu'l'la sakoatharanaakavumirukkumpadikkum kognchakkaalam ummaivittup pirinthupoanaanaakkum.
enakku avan piriyamaana sakoatharanaanaal, umakkuch sareeraththinpadiyeayum karththarukku'l'lum evva'lavu piriyamu'l'lavanaayirukkavea'ndum!
aathalaal, neer ennai ummoadea aikkiyamaanavanen'ru e'n'ninaal, ennai eat'rukko'lvathupoala avanaiyum eat'rukko'l'lum.
avan umakku yaathoru aniyaayagnseythathum, ummidaththil kadanpattathum u'ndaanaal, athai en ka'nakkilea vaiththukko'l'lum.
pavulaakiya naan ithai en sonthakkaiyaalea ezhuthinean, naan athaich seluththith theerppean. neer ummaiththaamea enakkuk kadanaakach seluththavea'ndumen'ru naan umakkuch sollavea'ndiyathillaiyea.
aam, sakoatharanea, karththarukku'l ummaalea enakkup pirayoajanamu'ndaakattum; karththarukku'l en u'l'laththai i'laippaa'rappa'n'num.
naan solluki'rathilum athikamaaych seyveeren'ru a'rinthu, itha'rku neer i'nangkuveeren'ru nichchayiththu, umakku ezhuthiyirukki'rean.
mealum, ungka'l vi'n'nappangka'linaalea naan ungka'lukku anukkirakikkappaduveanen'ru nampiyirukki'rapadiyaal, naan irukkumpadikku oaridaththai enakkaaka aayaththampa'n'num.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinimiththam ennoadeakoodak kaavalil vaikkappattirukki'ra eppaappiraavum,
en udanvealaiyaadka'laakiya maa'rkuvum, aristharkkum, theamaavum, lookkaavum umakku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupai ungka'l aaviyudaneakooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
poorvakaalangka'lil pangkupangkaakavum vakaivakaiyaakavum, theerkkatharisika'l moolamaayp pithaakka'lukkuth thiruvu'lam pat'rina theavan,
inthak kadaisi naadka'lil kumaaran moolamaay namakkuth thiruvu'lampat'rinaar; ivaraich sarvaththukkum suthantharavaa'liyaaka niyamiththaar, ivaraikko'ndu ulakangka'laiyum u'ndaakkinaar.

ivar avarudaiya makimaiyin pirakaasamum, avarudaiya thanmaiyin soroopamumaayirunthu, sarvaththaiyum thammudaiya vallamaiyu'l'la vasanaththinaalea thaangkuki'ravaraay, thammaaleathaamea nammudaiya paavangka'lai neekkum suththikarippai u'ndupa'n'ni, unnathaththilu'l'la makaththuvamaanavarudaiya valathupaarisaththilea udkaarnthaar.
ivar theavathootharaippaarkkilum evva'lavu viseashiththa naamaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndaaroa, avva'lavu athikamaay avarka'lilum meanmaiyu'l'lavaraanaar.

eppadiyenil, neer ennudaiya kumaaran, in'ru naan ummai jenippiththean en'rum; naan avarukkup pithaavaayiruppean, avar enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaar en'rum, avar thootharka'lil yaarukkaavathu eppoathaakilum sonnathu'ndaa?
mealum, thamathu mutha'rpea'raanavarai ulakaththil piraveasikkachseythapoathu: theavathoothar yaavarum avaraith thozhuthuko'l'lakkadavarka'l en'raar.
theavathootharaikku'riththoa: thammudaiya thootharka'laik kaat'ruka'laakavum, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararai akkinijuvaalaika'laakavum seyki'raar en'ru solliyirukki'rathu.
kumaaranai noakki: theavanea, ummudaiya singkaasanam en'ren'raikkumu'l'lathu, ummudaiya raajyaththin sengkoal neethiyu'l'la sengkoalaayirukki'rathu.
neer neethiyai virumpi, akkiramaththai ve'ruththirukki'reer; aathalaal, theavanea, ummudaiya theavan umathu thoazharaippaarkkilum ummai aanantha thailaththinaal apisheakampa'n'ninaar en'rum;
karththaavea, neer aathiyilea poomiyai asthipaarappaduththineer; vaanangka'l ummudaiya karaththin kiriyaika'laayirukki'rathu;
avaika'l azhinthupoam; neeroa nilaiththiruppeer; avaika'lellaam vasthirampoalap pazhaimaiyaayppoam;
oru saalvaiyaippoala avaika'laich suruttuveer, appozhuthu maa'rippoam; neeroa maa'raathavaraayirukki'reer, ummudaiya aa'nduka'l mudinthupoavathillai en'rum solliyirukki'rathu.
mealum, naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'ru thootharka'lil yaarukkaavathu eppoathaakilum avar sonnathu'ndaa?
iradchippaich suthantharikkappoaki'ravarka'linimiththamaaka oozhiyagnseyyumpadikku avarka'lellaarum anuppappadum pa'nividai aavika'laayirukki'raarka'lallavaa?
aakaiyaal, naam keattavaika'lai vittu vilakaathapadikku, avaika'lai mikuntha jaakkirathaiyaayk kavanikkavea'ndum.

eanenil, theavathoothar moolamaaych sollappatta vasanaththi'rku viroathamaana enthach seykaikkum keezhppadiyaamaikkum neethiyaana tha'ndanai varaththakkathaaka avarka'ludaiya vasanam u'ruthippaduththappattirukka,
muthalaavathu karththar moolamaay a'rivikkappattu, pinpu avaridaththil keattavarka'laalea namakku u'ruthiyaakkappattathum,

adaiyaa'langka'linaalum a'rputhangka'linaalum palavithamaana palaththa seykaika'linaalum, thammudaiya siththaththinpadi pakirnthukoduththa parisuththa aaviyin varangka'linaalum, theavan thaamea saadchikoduththathumaayirukki'ra ivva'lavu perithaana iradchippaikku'riththu naam kavalaiyat'riruppoamaanaal tha'ndanaikku eppadith thappiththukko'l'luvoam.
inivarum ulakaththaikku'riththup peasuki'roamea, athai avar thootharka'lukkuk keezhppaduththavillai.
oru idaththilea oruvan saadchiyaaka: manushanai neer ninaikki'ratha'rkum, manushanudaiya kumaaranai neer visaarikki'ratha'rkum avan emmaaththiram?

avanai theavathootharilum sat'ruch si'riyavanaakkineer; makimaiyinaalum kanaththinaalum avanukku mudisootti, ummudaiya karaththin kiriyaika'linmeal avanai athikaariyaaka vaiththu, sakalaththaiyum avanudaiya paathangka'lukkuk keezhppaduththineer en'ru sonnaan.
sakalaththaiyum avanukkuk keezhppaduththinaar enki'ra vishayaththil, avar avanukkuk keezhppaduththaatha poru'l on'rumillai; appadiyirunthum, innum avanukkuch sakalamum keezhppattirukkak kaa'noam.

en'raalum, theavanudaiya kirupaiyinaal ovvoruvarukkaakavum, mara'naththai rusipaarkkumpadikku theavathootharilum sat'ruch si'riyavaraakkappattiruntha iyeasu mara'naththai uththariththathinimiththam makimaiyinaalum kanaththinaalum mudisoottappattathaik kaa'nki'roam.

eanen'raal thamakkaakavum thammaaleayum sakalaththaiyum u'ndaakkinavar, aneakam pi'l'laika'lai makimaiyil ko'nduvanthu searkkaiyil avarka'ludaiya iradchippin athipathiyai upaththiravangka'linaalea poora'nappaduththuki'rathu avarukkeat'rathaayirunthathu.

eppadiyenil, parisuththagnseyki'ravarum parisuththagnseyyappaduki'ravarka'lumaakiya yaavarum oruvaraalea u'ndaayirukki'raarka'l; ithinimiththam avarka'laich sakoathararen'ru solla avar vedkappadaamal:
ummudaiya naamaththai en sakoathararukku a'riviththu, sapai naduvil ummaith thuthiththup paaduvean en'rum;
naan avaridaththil nampikkaiyaayiruppean en'rum; ithoa, naanum, theavan enakkuk koduththa pi'l'laika'lum en'rum solliyirukki'raar.

aathalaal, pi'l'laika'l maamsaththaiyum iraththaththaiyum udaiyavarka'laayirukka, avarum avarka'laippoala maamsaththaiyum iraththaththaiyum udaiyavaraanaar; mara'naththukku athikaariyaakiya pisaasaanavanaith thamathu mara'naththinaalea azhikkumpadikkum,
jeevakaalamellaam mara'napayaththinaalea adimaiththanaththi'rku'l'laanavarka'l yaavaraiyum viduthalaipa'n'numpadikkum appadiyaanaar.
aathalaal, avar theavathootharukku uthaviyaakak kaikodaamal, aapirakaamin santhathikku uthaviyaakak kaikoduththaar.

an'riyum, avar janaththin paavangka'lai nivirththi seyvatha'rkeathuvaaka, theavakaariyangka'laikku'riththu irakkamum u'nmaiyumu'l'la pirathaana aasaariyaraayirukkumpadikku evvithaththilum thammudaiya sakoathararukku oppaakavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
aathalaal, avarthaamea soathikkappattup paadupattathinaalea, avar soathikkappaduki'ravarka'lukku uthaviseyya vallavaraayirukki'raar.

ippadiyirukka, parama azhaippukkup pangku'l'lavarka'laakiya parisuththa sakoathararea, naam a'rikkaipa'n'nuki'ra appoasthalarum pirathaana aasaariyarumaayirukki'ra ki'risthu iyeasuvaik kavaniththuppaarungka'l;
moasea theavanudaiya veettil engkum u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthathupoala, ivarum thammai ea'rpaduththinavarukku u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.
veettai u'ndupa'n'ninavan veettaippaarkkilum athika kanaththi'rkuriyavanaayirukki'raan; athupoala moaseayaippaarkkilum ivar athika makimaikkup paaththiraraayirukki'raar.
eanenil, entha veedum oruvanaal u'ndaakkappadum; ellaavat'raiyum u'ndupa'n'ninavar theavan.
sollappadappoaki'ra kaariyangka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka, moasea pa'nividaikkaaranaay, avarudaiya veettil engkum u'nmaiyu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

ki'risthuvoa avarudaiya veetti'rku mea'rpattavaraana kumaaranaaka u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar; nampikkaiyinaalea u'ndaakum thairiyaththaiyum meanmaipaaraattalaiyum mudivupariyantham u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'ndiruppoamaakil, naamea avarudaiya veedaayiruppoam.
aakaiyaal, parisuththaaaviyaanavar solluki'rapadiyea: in'ru avarudaiya saththaththaik keadpeerka'laakil,
vanaantharaththilea koapamoottinapoathum, soathanainaa'lilum nadanthathupoala, ungka'l iruthayangka'laik kadinappaduththaathirungka'l.
angkea ungka'l pithaakka'l ennaich soathiththu, ennaip pareedchaipaarththu, naa'rpathu varushakaalam en kiriyaika'laik ka'ndaarka'l.
aathalaal, naan anthach santhathiyai aroasiththu, avarka'l eppozhuthum vazhuvippoaki'ra iruthayamu'l'la janamen'rum, ennudaiya vazhika'lai a'riyaathavarka'len'rum solli;
ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil avarka'l piraveasippathillaiyen'ru ennudaiya koapaththilea aa'naiyittean en'raar.
sakoathararea, jeevanu'l'la theavanaivittu vilakuvatha'rkeathuvaana avisuvaasamu'l'la pollaatha iruthayam ungka'lil oruvanukku'l'lum iraathapadikku neengka'l echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
ungka'lil oruvanaakilum paavaththin vagnchanaiyinaalea kadinappattup poakaathapadikku, in'ru ennappaduma'lavum naadoa'rum oruvarukkoruvar puththisollungka'l.
naam aarampaththilea ko'nda nampikkaiyai mudivupariyantham u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'ndiruppoamaakil, ki'risthuvinidaththil pangku'l'lavarka'laayiruppoam.
in'ru avarudaiya saththaththaik keadpeerka'laakil, koapamoottuthalil nadanthathupoala ungka'l iruthayangka'laik kadinappaduththaathirungka'l en'ru solliyirukki'rathea.
keattavarka'lil koapamoottinavarka'l yaar? moaseayinaal ekipthilirunthu pu'rappatta yaavarum appadich seythaarka'lallavaa?
mealum, avar naa'rpathu varushamaay yaarai aroasiththaar? paavagnseythavarka'laiyallavaa? avarka'ludaiya savangka'l vanaantharaththil vizhunthupoayit'rea.
pinnum, ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasippathillaiyen'ru avar yaaraikku'riththu aa'naiyittaar? keezhppadiyaathavarka'laikku'riththallavaa?
aathalaal, avisuvaasaththinaalea avarka'l athil piraveasikkakkoodaama'rpoanaarka'len'ru paarkki'roam.

aanapadiyinaalea, avarudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasippatha'rkeathuvaana vaakkuththaththam namakku'ndaayirukka, ungka'lil oruvanum athai adaiyaamal pinvaangkippoanavanaakak kaa'nappadaathapadikkup payanthirukkakkadavoam.
eanenil, suviseasham avarka'lukku a'rivikkappattathupoala namakkum a'rivikkappattathu; keattavarka'l visuvaasamillaamal keattapadiyinaal, avarka'l keatta vasanam avarka'lukkup pirayoajanappadavillai.

visuvaasiththavarka'laakiya naamoa antha i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasikki'roam; avarudaiya kiriyaika'l ulakaththoat'ramuthal mudinthirunthum: ivarka'l ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasippathillaiyen'ru ennudaiya koapaththilea aa'naiyittean en'raar.
mealum, theavan thammudaiya kiriyaika'laiyellaam mudiththu eazhaam naa'lilea oaynthirunthaar en'ru eazhaam naa'laikku'riththu oaridaththil solliyirukki'raar.
an'riyum, avarka'l ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasippathillai en'rum antha idaththileathaanea solliyirukki'raar.

aakaiyaal, silar athil piraveasippathu innum varappoaki'ra kaariyamaayirukki'rapadiyinaalum, suviseashaththai muthalaavathu keattavarka'l keezhppadiyaamaiyinaalea athil piraveasiyaama'rpoanapadiyinaalum,

in'ru avarudaiya saththaththaik keadpeerka'laakil ungka'l iruthayangka'laik kadinappaduththaathirungka'l en'ru vekukaalaththi'rkuppinpu thaaveethin sangkeethaththilea solliyirukki'rapadi, in'ru en'ru solvathinaalea pinnum orunaa'laik ku'riththirukki'raar.
yoasuvaa avarka'lai i'laippaa'ruthalukkudpaduththiyirunthaal, pinpu avar vea'roru naa'laikku'riththuch solliyirukkamaattaarea.
aakaiyaal, theavanudaiya janangka'lukku i'laippaa'ruki'ra kaalam ini varuki'rathaayirukki'rathu.
eanenil, avarudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasiththavan, theavan thammudaiya kiriyaika'lai mudiththu oaynthathupoala, thaanum than kiriyaika'lai mudiththu oaynthiruppaan.
aakaiyaal, anthath thirushdaanthaththinpadi, oruvanaakilum keezhppadiyaamaiyinaalea vizhunthupoakaathapadikku, naam intha i'laippaa'ruthalil piraveasikka jaakkirathaiyaayirukkakkadavoam.

theavanudaiya vaarththaiyaanathu jeevanum vallamaiyum u'l'lathaayum, irupu'ramum karukku'l'la enthap pattayaththilum karukkaanathaayum, aaththumaavaiyum aaviyaiyum, ka'nukka'laiyum oonaiyum pirikkaththakkathaaka uruvak kuththuki'rathaayum, iruthayaththin ninaivuka'laiyum yoasanaika'laiyum vakaiya'rukki'rathaayum irukki'rathu.
avarudaiya paarvaikku ma'raivaana sirushdi on'rumillai; sakalamum avarudaiya ka'nka'lukkumunpaaka nirvaa'namaayum ve'liyarangkamaayumirukki'rathu, avarukkea naam ka'nakku oppuvikkavea'ndum.

vaanangka'lin vazhiyaayp paraloakaththi'rkuppoana theavakumaaranaakiya iyeasu ennum makaa pirathaana aasaariyar namakku irukki'rapadiyinaal, naam pa'n'nina a'rikkaiyai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'ndirukkakkadavoam.

nammudaiya palaveenangka'laikku'riththup parithapikkakkoodaatha pirathaana aasaariyar namakkiraamal, ellaavithaththilum nammaippoal soathikkappattum, paavamillaathavaraayirukki'ra pirathaana aasaariyarea namakkirukki'raar.
aathalaal, naam irakkaththaip pe'ravum, eat'ra samayaththil sakaayagnseyyung kirupaiyai adaiyavum, thairiyamaayk kirupaasanaththa'ndaiyilea searakkadavoam.

an'riyum, manusharil therinthuko'l'lappatta enthap pirathaana aasaariyanum paavangka'lukkaakak kaa'nikkaika'laiyum palika'laiyum seluththumpadi, manusharukkaakath theavakaariyangka'laippat'ri niyamikkappaduki'raan.
thaanum palaveenamu'l'lavanaanapadiyinaalea, a'riyaathavarka'lukkum ne'rithappippoanavarka'lukkum irangkaththakkavanaayirukki'raan.
athinimiththam avan janangka'ludaiya paavangka'lukkaakap paliyidavea'ndiyathupoala, thannudaiya paavangka'lukkaakavum paliyidavea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu.
mealum, aaroanaippoalath theavanaal azhaikkappattaalozhiya, oruvanum inthak kanamaana oozhiyaththukkuth thaanaay ea'rpaduki'rathillai.

anthappadiyea ki'risthuvum pirathaana aasaariyaraaki'ratha'rkuth thammaiththaamea uyarththavillai; neer ennudaiya kumaaran, in'ru naan ummai jenippiththean en'ru avaroadea sonnavarea avarai uyarththinaar.
appadiyea vea'roru idaththilum: neer melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi en'ren'raikkum aasaariyaraayirukki'reer en'ru solliyirukki'raar.

avar maamsaththiliruntha naadka'lil, thammai mara'naththinin'ru iradchikka vallamaiyu'l'lavarai noakki, palaththa saththaththoadum ka'n'neeroadum vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, vea'nduthalseythu, thamakku u'ndaana payapakthiyinimiththam keadkappattu,
avar kumaaranaayirunthum pattapaaduka'linaalea keezhppadithalaik kat'rukko'ndu,
thaam poora'naraanapinpu, thamakkuk keezhppadiki'ra yaavarum niththiya iradchippai adaivatha'rkuk kaara'naraaki,
melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadiyaana pirathaana aasaariyar en'ru theavanaalea naamam tharikkappattaar.
intha melkiseatheakkaippat'ri naam visthaaramaayp peasalaam; neengka'l kea'lviyil manthamu'l'lavarka'laanapadiyaal, athai vi'langkappa'n'nuki'rathu arithaayirukkum.

kaalaththaip paarththaal, poathakaraayirukkavea'ndiya ungka'lukkuth theavanudaiya vaakkiyangka'lin moola upatheasangka'lai ma'rupadiyum upatheasikkavea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu; neengka'l palamaana aakaaraththaiyalla, paalai u'n'naththakkavarka'laaneerka'l.
paalu'nki'ravan kuzhanthaiyaayirukki'rapadiyinaalea neethiyin vasanaththil pazhakkamillaathavanaayirukki'raan.
palamaana aakaaramaanathu nanmai theemaiyinnathen'ru payi'rchiyinaal pakuththa'riyaththakkathaaka muya'rchiseyyum gnaaneanthiriyangka'laiyudaiyavarka'laakiya poora'na vayathu'l'lavarka'lukkea thakum.
aakaiyaal, ki'risthuvaippat'rich solliya moola upatheasa vasanangka'lai naam vittu, seththa kiriyaika'lukku neengkalaakum mananthirumputhal, theavanpearil vaikkum visuvaasam,

snaanangka'lukkaduththa upatheasam, kaika'lai vaikkuthal, mariththoarin uyirththezhuthal, niththiya niyaayaththeerppu enpavaika'laakiya asthipaaraththai ma'rupadiyum poadaamal, poora'naraakumpadi kadanthupoavoamaaka.
theavanukkuch siththamaanaal ippadiyea seyvoam.
eanenil, orutharam pirakaasippikkappattum, paramaeevai rusipaarththum, parisuththa aaviyaip pet'rum,
theavanudaiya nalvaarththaiyaiyum inivarum ulakaththin pelanka'laiyum rusipaarththum,

ma'ruthaliththuppoanavarka'l, theavanudaiya kumaaranaith thaangka'lea ma'rupadiyum siluvaiyil a'rainthu avamaanappaduththuki'rapadiyaal, mananthirumputha'rkeathuvaay avarka'lai ma'rupadiyum puthuppikki'rathu koodaathakaariyam.
eppadiyenil, thanmeal adikkadi peyki'ra mazhaiyaik kudiththu, thannidaththil payiriduki'ravarka'lukkeat'ra payirai mu'laippikkum nilamaanathu theavanaal aaseervaatham pe'rum.
mu'lsedika'laiyum mu'lpoo'nduka'laiyum mu'laippikki'ra nilamoa thakaathathaayum sapikkappaduki'ratha'rkeat'rathaayumirukki'rathu; sutterikkappaduvathea athin mudivu.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, naangka'l ippadich sonnaalum, nanmaiyaanavaika'lum iradchippukkuriyavaika'lumaana kaariyangka'l ungka'lidaththil u'ndaayirukki'rathen'ru nampiyirukki'roam.

eanen'raal, ungka'l kiriyaiyaiyum, neengka'l parisuththavaanka'lukku oozhiyagnseythathinaalum seythu varuki'rathinaalum thamathu naamaththi'rkaakak kaa'npiththa anpu'l'la pirayaasaththaiyum ma'ranthuviduki'ratha'rkuth theavan aneethiyu'l'lavarallavea.
neengka'l asathiyaayiraamal, vaakkuththaththamaana aaseervaathangka'lai visuvaasaththinaalum neediya po'rumaiyinaalum suthanthariththukko'l'luki'ravarka'laip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laayirunthu,
ungka'lukku nampikkaiyin poora'na nichchayamu'ndaakumpadi neengka'l yaavarum mudivupariyantham appadiyea jaakkirathaiyaik kaa'npikkavea'ndumen'ru aasaiyaayirukki'roam.
aapirakaamukkuth theavan vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninapoathu, aa'naiyidumpadi thammilum periyavar oruvarumillaathapadiyinaalea thamathupearilea thaanea aa'naiyittu:
nichchayamaaka naan unnai aaseervathikkavea aaseervathiththu, unnaip perukavea perukappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
anthappadiyea, avan po'rumaiyaayk kaaththirunthu, vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappattathaip pet'raan.
manushar thangka'lilum periyavarpearil aa'naiyiduvaarka'l; u'ruthipa'n'numpadikku aa'naiyiduthalea sakala vivaathaththi'rkum mudivu.

anthappadi, theavanum vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappattavaika'laich suthanthariththukko'l'luki'ravarka'lukkuth thamathu aaloasanaiyin maa'raatha nichchayaththaip paripoora'namaayk kaa'npikkumpadi siththamu'l'lavaraay, oar aa'naiyinaalea athai sthirappaduththinaar.

namakku mun vaikkappatta nampikkaiyaip pat'rikko'l'lumpadi adaikkalamaay oadivantha namakku ira'ndu maa'raatha viseashangka'linaal ni'raintha aa'ruthalu'ndaakumpadikku evva'laveanum poyyuraiyaatha theavan appadich seythaar.
antha nampikkai namakku nilaiyum u'ruthiyum thiraikku'l'laakap poaki'rathumaana aaththuma nangkooramaayirukki'rathu.
namakku munnoadinavaraakiya iyeasu melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi niththiya pirathaana aasaariyaraay namakkaaka anthath thiraikku'l piraveasiththirukki'raar.
intha melkiseatheakku saaleamin raajaavum, unnathamaana theavanudaiya aasaariyanumaayirunthaan; raajaakka'lai mu'riyadiththuvantha aapirakaamukku ivan ethirko'ndupoay, avanai aaseervathiththaan.

ivanukku aapirakaam ellaavat'rilum thasamapaakam koduththaan; ivanudaiya mutha'rpearaakiya melkiseatheakku enpatha'rku neethiyin raajaa en'rum, pinpu saaleamin raajaa enpatha'rkuch samaathaanaththin raajaa en'rum aruththamaam.

ivan thakappanum thaayum vamsavaralaa'rum illaathavan; ivan naadka'lin thuvakkamum jeevanin mudivumudaiyavanaayiraamal, theavanudaiya kumaaranukku oppaanavanaay en'ren'raikkum aasaariyanaaka nilaiththirukki'raan.
ivan evva'lavu periyavanaayirukki'raan paarungka'l; koaththiraththalaivanaakiya aapirakaam muthalaay ko'l'laiyidappatta poru'lka'lil ivanukkuth thasamapaakam koduththaan.

leaviyin puththiraril aasaariyaththuvaththai adaiki'ravarka'lum, aapirakaamin araiyilirunthuvantha thangka'l sakoathararaana janangka'lin kaiyilea niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi thasamapaakam vaangkuki'ratha'rkuk katta'laipet'rirukki'raarka'l.
aakilum, avarka'ludaiya vamsavarisaiyil varaathavanaakiya ivan aapirakaamin kaiyil thasamapaakam vaangki, vaakkuththaththangka'laip pet'ravanai aaseervathiththaan.
si'riyavan periyavanaalea aaseervathikkappaduvaan, atha'rkuch santheakamillai.
an'riyum, ingkea, marikki'ra manusharka'l thasamapaakam vaangkuki'raarka'l; angkeayoa, pizhaiththirukki'raan en'ru saadchipet'ravan vaangkinaan.
an'riyum, melkiseatheakku aapirakaamukku ethirko'ndupoanapoathu, leaviyaanavan than thakappanudaiya araiyilirunthapadiyaal,
thasamapaakam vaangkuki'ra avanum aapirakaamin moolamaayth thasamapaakam koduththaan en'ru sollalaam.

allaamalum, israveal janangka'l leavikoaththira aasaariya mu'raimaikkudpattirunthallavoa niyaayappiramaa'naththaip pet'raarka'l; antha aasaariya mu'raimaiyinaalea poora'nappaduthal u'ndaayirukkumaanaal, aaroanudaiya mu'raimaiyinpadi azhaikkappadaamal, melkiseatheakkinudaiya mu'raimaiyinpadi azhaikkappatta vea'roru aasaariyar ezhumpavea'nduvathenna?
aasaariyaththuvam maat'rappattirukkumeayaanaal, niyaayappiramaa'namum maat'rappadavea'ndiyathaakum.
ivaika'l evaraikku'riththuch sollappattirukki'rathoa, avar vea'roru koaththiraththukku'l'laanavaraayirukki'raarea; anthak koaththiraththil oruvanaakilum palipeedaththu oozhiyam seythathillaiyea.
nammudaiya karththar yoothaakoaththiraththil thoan'rinaarenpathu pirasiththamaayirukki'rathu; anthak koaththiraththaaraikku'riththu moasea aasaariyaththuvaththaippat'ri on'rum sollavillaiyea.
allaamalum, melkiseatheakkukku oppaay vea'roru aasaariyar ezhumpuki'raar en'ru solliyiruppathinaal, mea'rsolliyathu mikavum pirasiththamaay vi'langkuki'rathu.
avar maamsa sampanthamaana katta'laiyaakiya niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi aasaariyaraakaamal,
neer melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi en'ren'raikkum aasaariyaraayirukki'reer en'ru solliya saadchikkuththakkathaaka azhiyaatha jeevanukkuriya vallamaiyinpadiyea aasaariyaraanaar.
munthina katta'lai pelaveenamu'l'lathum payanat'rathumaayirunthathinimiththam maat'rappattathu.
niyaayappiramaa'namaanathu on'raiyum poora'nappaduththavillai, athika nanmaiyaana nampikkaiyai varuvippathoa poora'nappaduththuki'rathu; antha nampikkaiyinaalea theavanidaththil searuki'roam.

an'riyum, avarka'l aa'naiyillaamal aasaariyaraakkappaduki'raarka'l; ivaroa: neer melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi en'ren'raikkum aasaariyaraayirukki'reer en'ru karththar aa'naiyittaar, manam maa'raamalumiruppaar en'ru thammudanea sonnavaraalea aa'naiyoadea aasaariyaraanaar.
aanathaal, iyeasuvaanavar aa'naiyinpadiyea aasaariyaraakkappattathu evva'lavu viseashiththa kaariyamoa,
avva'lavu viseashiththa udanpadikkaikkup pi'naiyaa'liyaanaar.
an'riyum, avarka'l mara'naththinimiththam nilaiththirukkakkoodaathavarka'laanapadiyaal, aasaariyaraakkappaduki'ravarka'l aneakaraayirukki'raarka'l.
ivaroa en'ren'raikkum nilaiththirukki'rapadiyinaalea, maa'rippoakaatha aasaariyaththuvamu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.

mealum, thamathu moolamaayth theavanidaththil searuki'ravarka'lukkaaka vea'nduthalseyyumpadikku avar eppozhuthum uyiroadirukki'ravaraakaiyaal avarka'lai mut'rumudiya iradchikka vallavaraayumirukki'raar.
parisuththarum, kut'ramat'ravarum, maasillaathavarum, paavika'lukku vilakinavarum, vaanangka'lilum uyarnthavarumaayirukki'ra ivvithamaana pirathaana aasaariyarea namakku eat'ravaraayirukki'raar.

avar pirathaana aasaariyarka'laippoala munpu sonthap paavangka'lukkaakavum, pinpu janangka'ludaiya paavangka'lukkaakavum naadoa'rum paliyidavea'nduvathillai; eanenil thammaiththaamea paliyittathinaalea ithai oreatharam seythumudiththaar.

niyaayappiramaa'namaanathu pelaveenamu'l'la manusharka'laip pirathaana aasaariyaraaka ea'rpaduththuki'rathu; niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuppinpu u'ndaana aa'naiyoadea vi'langkiya vasanamoa en'ren'raikkum poora'naraana kumaaranai ea'rpaduththuki'rathu.
mea'rsolliyavaika'lin mukkiyamaana poru'lennavenil; paraloakaththilu'l'la makaththuva aasanaththin valathupaarisaththilea udkaarnthirukki'ravarumaay,
parisuththa sthalaththilum, manusharaal alla, karththaraal sthaapikkappatta meyyaana koodaaraththilum aasaariya oozhiyagn seyki'ravarumaayirukki'ra pirathaana aasaariyar namakku u'ndu.
ovvoru pirathaana aasaariyanum kaa'nikkaika'laiyum palika'laiyum seluththumpadi niyamikkappaduki'raan; aathalaal seluththumpadikku eathoa on'ru ivarukkum avasiyam vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu.
poomiyilea avar iruppaaraanaal aasaariyaraayirukkamaattaar; eanenil, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi kaa'nikkaika'laich seluththuki'ra aasaariyarka'l irukki'raarka'lea;

ivarka'l seyyum aaraathanai paraloakaththilu'l'lavaika'lin saayalukkum nizhalukkum oththirukki'rathu; appadiyea, moasea koodaaraththai u'ndupa'n'nap poakaiyil: malaiyilea unakkuk kaa'npikkappatta maathiriyinpadiyea nee ellaavat'raiyum seyya echcharikkaiyaayiru en'ru theavan avanukkuk katta'laiyittaar.

ivaroa viseashiththa vaakkuththaththangka'linpearil sthaapikkappatta viseashiththa udanpadikkaikku eppadi maththiyastharaayirukki'raaroa, appadiyea mukkiyamaana aasaariya oozhiyaththaiyum pet'rirukki'raar.
antha muthalaam udanpadikkai pizhaiyillaathirunthathaanaal, ira'ndaam udanpadikkaikku idam theadavea'nduvathillaiyea.

avarka'laik kut'rappaduththi, avarka'lai noakki: ithoa, karththar solluki'rathennavenil: israveal kudumpaththoadum yoothaa kudumpaththoadum naan puthu udanpadikkaiyai ea'rpaduththungkaalam varuki'rathu.

avarka'ludaiya pithaakka'lai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadikku naan avarka'ludaiya kaiyaip pidiththanaa'lilea avarka'loadu pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaippoala ithu iruppathillai; antha udanpadikkaiyilea avarka'l nilaini'rkavillaiyea, naanum avarka'laip pu'rakka'niththean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.

antha naadka'lukkuppinpu naan israveal kudumpaththaaroadea pa'n'num udanpadikkaiyaavathu: ennudaiya piramaa'nangka'lai avarka'ludaiya manathilea vaiththu, avarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'lil avaika'lai ezhuthuvean; naan avarka'l theavanaayiruppean, avarka'l en janamaayiruppaarka'l.

appozhuthu si'riyavan mutha'rko'ndu periyavanvaraikkum ellaarum ennai a'rivaarka'l; aakaiyaal, karththarai a'rinthuko'l en'ru oruvan than ayalaanukkum, oruvan than sakoatharanukkum poathikkavea'nduvathillai.
eanenil naan avarka'l aniyaayangka'laik kirupaiyaay manniththu, avarka'l paavangka'laiyum akkiramangka'laiyum ini ninaiyaamaliruppean en'ru karththar solluki'raar.
puthu udanpadikkai en'ru avar solluki'rathinaalea munthinathaip pazhamaiyaakkinaar; pazhamaiyaanathum naa'lpattathumaayirukki'rathu uruvazhinthupoakak kaalam sameepiththirukki'rathu.
an'riyum, muthalaam udanpadikkaiyaanathu aaraathanaikkeat'ra mu'raimaika'lum poomikkuriya parisuththa sthalamum udaiyathaayirunthathu.
eppadiyenil, oru koodaaram u'ndaakkappattirunthathu; athin munthina paakaththil kuththuvi'lakkum, meajaiyum, theavasamukaththappangka'lum irunthana; athu parisuththa sthalamennappadum.
ira'ndaan thiraikku'l'lea makaa parisuththa sthalamennappatta koodaaram irunthathu.

athilea ponnaa'rseytha thoopakalasamum, muzhuvathum pot'rakadu pothinthirukkappatta udanpadikkaip pettiyum irunthana; anthap pettiyilea mannaa vaikkappatta po'rpaaththiramum, aaroanudaiya tha'lirththa koalum, udanpadikkaiyin ka'rpalakaika'lum irunthana.
atha'rku mealea makimaiyu'l'la kearupeenka'l vaikkappattuk kirupaasanaththai nizhalittirunthana; ivaika'laikku'riththu vivaramaayppeasa ippozhuthu samayamillai.
ivaika'l ivvithamaay aayaththamaakkappattirukka, aasaariyarka'l aaraathanai mu'raimaika'lai ni'raiveat'rumpadikku muthalaangkoodaaraththilea niththamum piraveasippaarka'l.

ira'ndaangkoodaaraththilea pirathaana aasaariyanmaaththiram varushaththi'rku orutharam iraththaththoadea piraveasiththu, antha iraththaththaith thanakkaakavum janangka'ludaiya thappithangka'lukkaakavum seluththuvaan.
athinaalea, muthalaangkoodaaram ni'rkuma'lavum parisuththa sthalaththi'rkuppoaki'ra maarkkam innum ve'lippadavillaiyen'ru parisuththa aaviyaanavar theriyappaduththiyirukki'raar.

anthak koodaaram ikkaalaththi'rku uthavuki'ra oppanaiyaayirukki'rathu; atha'rkeat'rapadiyea seluththappattuvaruki'ra kaa'nikkaika'lum palika'lum aaraathanai seyki'ravanudaiya manachsaadchiyaip poora'nappaduththakkoodaathavaika'laam.
ivaika'l seerthiruththal u'ndaakum kaalamvaraikkum nadanthea'rumpadi katta'laiyidappatta poajanapaanangka'lum, palavitha snaanangka'lum, sareeraththi'rkeat'ra sadangkuka'lumeayallaamal vea'ralla.

ki'risthuvaanavar varappoaki'ra nanmaika'lukkuriya pirathaana aasaariyaraay ve'lippattu, kaiyinaal seyyappattathaakiya inthach sirushdisampanthamaana koodaaraththin vazhiyaaka alla, perithum uththamamumaana koodaaraththin vazhiyaakavum,

ve'l'laattukkadaa, i'langkaa'lai ivaika'ludaiya iraththaththinaalea alla, thammudaiya sontha iraththaththinaalum oreatharam makaa parisuththa sthalaththilea piraveasiththu, niththiya meedpai u'ndupa'n'ninaar.
atheppadiyenil, kaa'lai ve'l'laattukkadaa ivaika'lin iraththamum, theettuppattavarka'lmeal the'likkappatta kadaariyin saampalum, sareerasuththiyu'ndaakumpadi parisuththappaduththumaanaal,

niththiya aaviyinaalea thammaiththaamea pazhuthat'ra paliyaakath theavanukku oppukkoduththa ki'risthuvinudaiya iraththam jeevanu'l'la theavanukku oozhiyagnseyvatha'rku ungka'l manachsaadchiyaich seththakkiriyaika'la'rach suththikarippathu evva'lavu nichchayam!

aakaiyaal muthalaam udanpadikkaiyin kaalaththilea nadantha akkiramangka'lai nivirththiseyyumporuttu avar mara'namadainthu, azhaikkappattavarka'l vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappatta niththiya suthantharaththai adainthuko'lvatha'rkaaka, puthu udanpadikkaiyin maththiyastharaayirukki'raar.
eanen'raal, engkea mara'nasaasanamu'ndoa, angkea anthach saasanaththai ezhuthinavanudaiya mara'namum u'ndaakavea'ndum.
eppadiyenil, mara'namu'ndaana pinpea mara'nasaasanam u'ruthippadum; athai ezhuthinavan uyiroadirukkaiyil atha'rkup pelanillaiyea.
anthappadi, muthalaam udanpadikkaiyum iraththamillaamal pirathishdai pa'n'nappadavillai.

eppadiyenil, moasea, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi, sakala janangka'lukkum ellaak katta'laika'laiyum sonnapinpu, i'langkaa'lai ve'l'laattukkadaa ivaika'lin iraththaththaith tha'n'neeroadum, sivappaana aattumayiroadum, eesoappoadungkooda eduththu, pusthakaththinmealum janangka'lellaarmealum the'liththu:
theavan ungka'lukkuk katta'laiyitta udanpadikkaiyin iraththam ithuvea en'ru sonnaan.
ivvithamaaka, koodaaraththinmealum aaraathanaikkuriya sakala pa'nimuttuka'linmealum iraththaththaith the'liththaan.
niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi kognchangku'raiya ellaam iraththaththinaalea suththikarikkappadum; iraththagnsinthuthalillaamal mannippu u'ndaakaathu.

aathalaal, paraloakaththilu'l'lavaika'lukkuch saayalaanavaika'l ippadippatta palika'linaalea suththikarikkappada vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu; paraloakaththilu'l'lavaika'loa ivaika'lilum viseashiththa palika'laalea suththikarikkappadavea'ndiyathaamea.

anthappadi, meyyaana parisuththa sthalaththukku adaiyaa'lamaana kaiyinaal seyyappattathaayirukki'ra parisuththa sthalaththilea ki'risthuvaanavar piraveasiyaamal, paraloakaththileathaanea ippozhuthu namakkaakath theavanudaiya samukaththil piraththiyadchamaakumpadi piraveasiththirukki'raar.
pirathaana aasaariyan anniya iraththaththoadea varushanthoa'rum parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasikki'rathupoala, avar aneakantharam thammaip paliyidumpadikkup piraveasikkavillai.

appadiyirunthathaanaal, ulakamu'ndaanathu mutha'rko'ndu avar aneakantharam paadupadavea'ndiyathaayirukkumea; appadiyalla, avar thammaiththaamea paliyiduki'rathinaalea paavangka'lai neekkumporuttaaka inthak kadaisikkaalaththil oreatharam ve'lippattaar.
an'riyum, oreatharam marippathum, pinpu niyaayaththeerppadaivathum, manusharukku niyamikkappattirukki'rapadiyea,

ki'risthuvum aneakarudaiya paavangka'laich sumanthu theerkkumpadikku oreatharam paliyidappattu, thamakkaakak kaaththukko'ndirukki'ravarka'lukku iradchippai aru'lumpadi ira'ndaantharam paavamillaamal tharisanamaavaar.

ippadiyirukka, niyaayappiramaa'namaanathu varappoaki'ra nanmaika'lin poru'laayiraamal, avaika'lin nizhalaaymaaththiram irukki'rapadiyaal, varushanthoa'rum idaividaamal seluththappattuvaruki'ra oreavithamaana palika'linaalea avaika'laich seluththa varuki'ravarka'lai orukkaalum poora'nappaduththamaattaathu.

poora'nappaduththumaanaal, aaraathanai seyki'ravarka'l orutharam suththamaakkappattapinpu, innum paavangka'lu'nden'ru u'narththum manachsaadchi avarka'lukku illaathiruppathinaal, anthap palika'laich seluththuki'rathu ni'ruththappadumallavaa?
appadi ni'ruththappadaathapadiyaal, paavangka'l u'nden'ru avaika'linaalea varushanthoa'rum ninaivukooruthal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
allaamalum, kaa'lai ve'l'laattukkadaa ivaika'ludaiya iraththam paavangka'lai nivirththiseyyamaattaathea.
aakaiyaal avar ulakaththil piraveasikkumpoathu: paliyaiyum kaa'nikkaiyaiyum neer virumpavillai, oru sareeraththai enakku aayaththampa'n'nineer;
sarvaangka thakanapalika'lum, paavanivaara'napalika'lum umakkup piriyamaanathalla en'reer.
appozhuthu naan: theavanea, ummudaiya siththaththinpadi seyya, ithoa, varuki'rean, pusthakachsuru'lil ennaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rathu en'ru sonnean en'raar.

niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi seluththappattuvaruki'ra palika'laikku'riththu mea'rsolliyapadi: paliyaiyum, kaa'nikkaiyaiyum, sarvaangka thakanapalika'laiyum, paavanivaara'napalika'laiyum neer virumpavillai, avaika'l umakkup piriyamaanathalla en'ru sonnapinpu:
theavanea, ummudaiya siththaththinpadi seyya, ithoa, varuki'rean en'ru sonnaar. ira'ndaavathai nilaini'ruththuvatha'rku muthalaavathai neekkippoaduki'raar.
iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya sareeram oreatharam paliyidappattathinaalea, anthach siththaththinpadi naam parisuththamaakkappattirukki'roam.
an'riyum, entha aasaariyanum naadoa'rum aaraathanai seyki'ravanaayum, paavangka'lai orukkaalum nivirththiseyyakkoodaatha oreavitha palika'lai aneakantharam seluththivaruki'ravanaayum ni'rpaan.
ivaroa, paavangka'lukkaaka orea paliyaich seluththi, en'ren'raikkum theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarnthu,
inith thammudaiya saththurukka'laith thamathu paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum kaaththukko'ndirukki'raar.
eanenil parisuththamaakkappaduki'ravarka'lai orea paliyinaalea ivar en'ren'raikkum poora'nappaduththiyirukki'raar.
ithaikku'riththup parisuththa aaviyaanavarum namakkuch saadchisolluki'raar; eppadiyenil:

antha naadka'lukkuppinpu naan avarka'loadea pa'n'num udanpadikkaiyaavathu: naan ennudaiya piramaa'nangka'lai avarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'lil vaiththu, avaika'lai avarka'ludaiya manathil ezhuthuvean en'ru karththar solluki'raarenpathai uraiththapinpu,
avarka'ludaiya paavangka'laiyum avarka'ludaiya akkiramangka'laiyum naan ini ninaippathillai enpathaich solluki'raar.
ivaika'l mannikkappattathu'ndaanaal, inip paavaththinimiththam pali seluththappaduvathillaiyea.

aakaiyaal, sakoathararea, naam parisuththasthalaththil piraveasippatha'rku iyeasuvaanavar thamathu maamsamaakiya thiraiyin vazhiyaayp puthithum jeevanumaana maarkkaththai namakku u'ndupa'n'ninapadiyaal,
antha maarkkaththinvazhiyaayp piraveasippatha'rku avarudaiya iraththaththinaalea namakkuth thairiyam u'ndaayirukki'rapadiyinaalum,
theavanudaiya veettinmeal athikaariyaana makaa aasaariyar namakku oruvar irukki'rapadiyinaalum,

thurmanachsaadchi neengkath the'likkappatta iruthayamu'l'lavarka'laayum, suththa jalaththaal kazhuvappatta sareeramu'l'lavarka'laayum, u'nmaiyu'l'la iruthayaththoadum visuvaasaththin poora'na nichchayaththoadum searakkadavoam.
allaamalum, nammudaiya nampikkaiyai a'rikkaiyiduki'rathil asaivillaamal u'ruthiyaayirukkakkadavoam; vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninavar u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raarea.
mealum, anpukkum na'rkiriyaika'lukkum naam eavappadumpadi oruvaraiyoruvar kavaniththu;

sapai koodivaruthalaich silar vittuviduki'rathupoala naamum vittuvidaamal, oruvarukkoruvar puththisollakkadavoam; naa'laanathu sameepiththuvaruki'rathai evva'lavaayp paarkki'reerka'loa avva'lavaayp puththisollavea'ndum.
saththiyaththai a'riyum a'rivai adainthapinpu naam manappoorvamaayp paavagnseyki'ravarka'laayirunthaal, paavangka'linimiththam seluththaththakka vea'rorupali iniyiraamal,
niyaayaththeerppu varumen'ru payaththoadea ethirpaarkkuthalum, viroathika'laip padchikkum koapaakkinaiyumea irukkum.
moaseayinudaiya piramaa'naththaith tha'l'luki'ravan irakkampe'raamal ira'ndu moon'ru saadchika'lin vaakkinaalea saaki'raanea;

theavanudaiya kumaaranaik kaalinkeezh mithiththu, thannaip parisuththagnseytha udanpadikkaiyin iraththaththai asuththamen're'n'ni, kirupaiyin aaviyai ninthikki'ravan evva'lavu kodithaana aakkinaikkup paaththiravaanaayiruppaan enpathai yoasiththuppaarungka'l.
pazhivaangkuthal enakkuriyathu, naanea pathi'rseyvean en'ru karththar solluki'raar en'rum, karththar thammudaiya janangka'lai niyaayantheerppaar en'rum sonnavar innaaren'ru a'rivoam.
jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya kaika'lil vizhuki'rathu payangkaramaayirukkumea.
munthina naadka'lai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l; neengka'l pirakaasamaakkappattiruntha antha naadka'lil upaththiravangka'laakiya mikuntha poaraattaththaich sakiththeerka'lea.
ninthaika'laalum upaththiravangka'laalum neengka'l veadikkaiyaakkappattathumallaamal, appadi nadaththappattavarka'lukkup pangkaa'lika'lumaaneerka'l.

naan kattappattirukkaiyil neengka'l ennaikku'riththup parithapiththathuman'ri, paraloakaththil athika meanmaiyum nilaiyu'l'lathumaana suthantharam ungka'lukku u'nden'ru a'rinthu, ungka'l aasthika'laiyum santhoashamaayk ko'l'laiyidakkoduththeerka'l.
aakaiyaal, mikuntha palanukkeathuvaana ungka'l thairiyaththai vittuvidaathirungka'l.
neengka'l theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi seythu, vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappattathaip pe'rumpadikkup po'rumai ungka'lukku vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu.
varuki'ravar innung kognchakkaalaththil varuvaar, thaamathampa'n'naar.
visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaan pizhaippaan, pinvaangkippoavaanaanaal avanmeal en aaththumaa piriyamaayiraathu enki'raar.
naamoa kettuppoakap pinvaangkuki'ravarka'laayiraamal, aaththumaa eedea'ra visuvaasikki'ravarka'laayirukki'roam.
visuvaasamaanathu nampappaduki'ravaika'lin u'ruthiyum, kaa'nappadaathavaika'lin nichchayamumaayirukki'rathu.
athinaalea munnoarka'l na'rsaadchipet'raarka'l.

visuvaasaththinaalea naam ulakangka'l theavanudaiya vaarththaiyinaal u'ndaakkappattathen'rum, ivvithamaay, kaa'nappaduki'ravaika'l thoan'rappaduki'ravaika'laal u'ndaakavillaiyen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.

visuvaasaththinaalea aapeal kaayeenudaiya paliyilum meanmaiyaana paliyai theavanukkuch seluththinaan; athinaalea avan neethimaanen'ru saadchi pet'raan; avanudaiya kaa'nikkaika'laik ku'riththuth theavanea saadchi koduththaar; avan mariththum innum peasuki'raan.

visuvaasaththinaalea eanoakku mara'naththaik kaa'naathapadikku eduththukko'l'lappattaan; theavan avanai eduththukko'ndapadiyinaalea, avan kaa'nappadaama'rpoanaan; avan theavanukkup piriyamaanavanen'ru avan eduththukko'l'lappaduvatha'rku munnamea saadchipet'raan.

visuvaasamillaamal theavanukkup piriyamaayiruppathu koodaathakaariyam; eanen'raal, theavanidaththil searuki'ravan avar u'nden'rum, avar thammaith theaduki'ravarka'lukkup palan a'likki'ravaren'rum visuvaasikkavea'ndum.

visuvaasaththinaalea noavaa tha'rkaalaththilea kaa'naathavaika'laikku'riththuth theavaechcharippup pet'ru, payapakthiyu'l'lavanaaki, than kudumpaththai iradchippatha'rkup peazhaiyai u'ndupa'n'ninaan; athinaalea avan ulakam aakkinaikku'l'laanathen'ru theerththu, visuvaasaththinaalu'ndaakum neethikkuch suthantharavaa'liyaanaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea aapirakaam thaan suthantharamaakap pe'rappoaki'ra idaththi'rkup poakumpadi azhaikkappattapoathu, keezhppadinthu, thaan poakum idam innathen'ru a'riyaamal pu'rappattuppoanaan.

visuvaasaththinaalea avan vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappatta theasaththilea paratheasiyaippoalach sagnchariththu, antha vaakkuththaththaththi'rku udan suthanthararaakiya eesaakkoadum yaakkoapoadum koodaarangka'lilea kudiyirunthaan;
eanenil, theavan thaamea katti u'ndaakkina asthipaarangka'lu'l'la nakaraththukku avan kaaththirunthaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea saaraa'lum vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninavar u'nmaiyu'l'lavaren're'n'ni, karppantharikkap pelanadainthu, vayathusen'rava'laayirunthum pi'l'laipet'raa'l.

aanapadiyaal, sareeragnseththavanen'ru e'n'naththakum oruvanaalea, vaanaththilu'l'la perukkamaana nadchaththirangka'laippoalavum kada'rkaraiyilu'l'la e'n'ni'rantha ma'nalaippoalavum, mikuntha janangka'l pi'ranthaarka'l.

ivarka'lellaarum, vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappattavaika'lai adaiyaamal, thooraththilea avaika'laik ka'ndu, nampi a'naiththukko'ndu, poomiyinmeal thangka'lai anniyarum paratheasika'lum en'ru a'rikkaiyittu, visuvaasaththoadea mariththaarka'l.
ippadi a'rikkaiyiduki'ravarka'l suyatheasaththai naadippoaki'roam en'ru theriyappaduththuki'raarka'l.
thaangka'l vittuvantha theasaththai ninaiththaarka'laanaal, atha'rkuth thirumpippoavatha'rku avarka'lukkuch samayangkidaiththirukkumea.

athaiyalla, athilum meanmaiyaana paramatheasaththaiyea virumpinaarka'l; aakaiyaal theavan avarka'ludaiya theavanennappada vedkappaduki'rathillai; avarka'lukku oru nakaraththai aayaththampa'n'ninaarea.
mealum visuvaasaththinaalea aapirakaam thaan soathikkappattapoathu eesaakkaip paliyaaka oppukkoduththaan.

eesaakkinidaththil un santhathi vi'langkum en'ru avanoadea sollappattirunthathea; ippadippatta vaakkuththaththangka'laip pet'ravan, mariththoarilirunthum ezhuppath theavan vallavaraayirukki'raaren're'n'ni,
thanakku oreapea'raanavanaiyea paliyaaka oppukkoduththaan; mariththoarilirunthu avanai paavanaiyaakath thirumpavum pet'rukko'ndaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea eesaakku varungkaariyangka'laikku'riththu yaakkoapaiyum easaavaiyum aaseervathiththaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea yaakkoapu than mara'nakaalaththil yoaseappinudaiya kumaarar iruvaraiyum aaseervathiththu, than koalin munaiyilea saaynthu thozhuthuko'ndaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea yoaseappu israveal puththirar ekipthu theasaththaivittup pu'rappaduvaarka'lenpathaippat'rith than anthiyakaalaththil peasi, than elumpuka'laikku'riththuk katta'laikoduththaan.

moasea pi'ranthapoathu avanudaiya thaaythakappanmaar avanai azhaku'l'la pi'l'laiyen'ru ka'ndu, visuvaasaththinaalea, raajaavinudaiya katta'laikkup payappadaamal avanai moon'rumaatham o'liththuvaiththaarka'l.
visuvaasaththinaalea moasea thaan periyavanaanapoathu paarvoanudaiya kumaaraththiyin makan ennappaduvathai ve'ruththu,
aniththiyamaana paavasanthoashangka'lai anupavippathaippaarkkilum theavanudaiya janangka'loadea thunpaththai anupavippathaiyea therinthuko'ndu,
inivarum palanmeal noakkamaayirunthu, ekipthilu'l'la pokkishangka'lilum ki'risthuvinimiththam varum ninthaiyai athika paakkiyamen'ru e'n'ninaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea avan atharisanamaanavaraith tharisikki'rathupoala u'ruthiyaayirunthu, raajaavin koapaththukkup payappadaamal ekipthaivittup poanaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea, mutha'rpea'raanavaika'laich sangkarikki'ravan isravealaraith thodaathapadikku, avan paskaavaiyum iraththam poosuthalaakiya niyamaththaiyum aasariththaan.
visuvaasaththinaalea avarka'l sivantha samuththiraththai ularntha tharaiyaik kadanthupoavathupoalak kadanthupoanaarka'l; ekipthiyar appadich seyyaththu'ninthu amizhnthupoanaarka'l.
visuvaasaththinaalea erikoa patta'naththin mathilka'l eazhunaa'l sut'rivarappattu vizhunthathu.
visuvaasaththinaalea raakaap ennum veasi veavukaararaich samaathaanaththoadea eat'rukko'ndu, keezhppadiyaathavarka'loadeakoodach seathamaakaathirunthaa'l.
pinnum naan enna solluvean? kithiyoan, paaraak, simsoan, yepthaa, thaaveethu, saamuveal enpavarka'laiyum, theerkkatharisika'laiyungku'riththu naan vivaragnsollavea'ndumaanaal kaalam poathaathu.
visuvaasaththinaalea avarka'l raajyangka'lai jeyiththaarka'l, neethiyai nadappiththaarka'l, vaakkuththaththangka'laip pet'raarka'l, singkangka'lin vaayka'lai adaiththaarka'l,
akkiniyin ukkiraththai aviththaarka'l, pattayakkarukkukkuth thappinaarka'l, palaveenaththil palanko'ndaarka'l; yuththaththil vallavarka'laanaarka'l, anniyarudaiya seanaika'lai mu'riyadiththaarka'l.

sthireeka'l saakakkoduththa thangka'ludaiyavarka'lai uyiroadezhunthirukkap pet'raarka'l; vea'rusilar meanmaiyaana uyirththezhuthalai adaiyumpadikku, viduthalaipe'rach sammathiyaamal, vaathikkappattaarka'l;
vea'ru silar ninthaika'laiyum adika'laiyum kattuka'laiyum kaavalaiyum anupaviththaarka'l;

kalle'riyu'ndaarka'l, vaa'laal a'ruppu'ndaarka'l, pareedchaipaarkkappattaarka'l, pattayaththinaalea vettappattu mariththaarka'l, semma'riyaattuth thoalka'laiyum ve'l'laattuth thoalka'laiyum poarththukko'ndu thirinthu, ku'raivaiyum upaththiravaththaiyum thunpaththaiyum anupaviththaarka'l;
ulakam avarka'lukkup paaththiramaayirukkavillai; avarka'l vanaantharangka'lileayum malaika'lileayum kukaika'lileayum poomiyin vedippuka'lileayum sitha'ru'ndu alainthaarka'l.
ivarka'lellaarum visuvaasaththinaalea na'rsaadchipet'rum, vaakkuththaththampa'n'nappattathai adaiyaama'rpoanaarka'l.
avarka'l nammaiyallaamal poora'naraakaathapadikku viseashiththa nanmaiyaanathon'raith theavan namakken'ru munnathaaka niyamiththirunthaar.

aakaiyaal, meakampoan'ra iththanai thira'laana saadchika'l nammaich soozhnthuko'ndirukka, paaramaana yaavat'raiyum, nammaich sut'ri nerungkini'rki'ra paavaththaiyum tha'l'livittu, visuvaasaththaith thuvakkuki'ravarum mudikki'ravarumaayirukki'ra iyeasuvai noakki, namakku niyamiththirukki'ra oattaththil po'rumaiyoadea oadakkadavoam;
avar thamakkumun vaiththiruntha santhoashaththinporuttu, avamaanaththai e'n'naamal, siluvaiyaich sakiththu, theavanudaiya singkaasanaththin valathupaarisaththil veet'rirukki'raar.

aakaiyaal neengka'l i'laippu'l'lavarka'laay ungka'l aaththumaakka'lil soarnthupoakaathapadikku, thamakku viroathamaayp paavika'laal seyyappatta ivvithamaana vipareethangka'laich sakiththa avaraiyea ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l.
paavaththi'rku viroathamaayp poaraaduki'rathil iraththagnsinthappadaththakkathaaka neengka'l innum ethirththuni'rkavillaiyea.
an'riyum: en makanea, karththarudaiya sidchaiyai a'rpamaaka e'n'naathea, avaraal kadinthuko'l'lappadumpoathu soarnthupoakaathea.

karththar evanidaththil anpukooruki'raaroa avanai avar sidchiththu, thaam searththukko'l'luki'ra entha makanaiyum tha'ndikki'raar en'ru pi'l'laika'lukkuch solluki'rathupoala ungka'lukkuch solliyirukki'ra puththimathiyai ma'rantheerka'l.
neengka'l sidchaiyaich sakikki'ravarka'laayirunthaal theavan ungka'laip puththiraraaka e'n'ni nadaththuki'raar; thakappan sidchiyaatha puththiranu'ndoa?
ellaarukkum kidaikkum sidchai ungka'lukkuk kidaiyaathirunthaal neengka'l puththiraraayiraamal veasippi'l'laika'laayiruppeerka'lea.

an'riyum, nammudaiya sareeraththin thakappanmaarka'l nammaich sidchikkumpoathu, avarka'lukku naam agnchi nadanthirukka, naam pizhaikkaththakkathaaka aavika'lin pithaavukku veku athikamaay adangki nadakkavea'ndumallavaa?

avarka'l thangka'lukku nalamen'ru thoan'rinapadi kognchakkaalam sidchiththaarka'l; ivaroa thammudaiya parisuththaththukku naam pangku'l'lavarka'laakumporuttu nammudaiya pirayoajanaththukkaakavea nammaich sidchikki'raar.
enthach sidchaiyum tha'rkaalaththil santhoashamaayk kaa'naamal thukkamaayk kaa'num; aakilum pi'rkaalaththil athil pazhakinavarka'lukku athu neethiyaakiya samaathaana palanaith tharum.
aakaiyinaal, nekizhntha kaika'laiyum tha'larntha muzhangkaalka'laiyum neengka'l thirumpa nimirththi,
mudamaayirukki'rathu pisakippoakaamal sosthamaakumpadikku, ungka'l paathangka'lukku vazhika'laich sevvaippaduththungka'l.
yaavaroadum samaathaanamaayirukkavum, parisuththamu'l'lavarka'laayirukkavum naadungka'l; parisuththamillaamal oruvanum karththaraith tharisippathillaiyea.
oruvanum theavanudaiya kirupaiyai izhanthupoakaathapadikkum yaathoru kasappaana vear mu'laiththezhumpik kalakkamu'ndaakkuki'rathinaal aneakar theettuppadaathapadikkum,
oruvanum veasikka'l'lanaakavum, oruvea'laip poajanaththukkaakath than seashdapuththirapaakaththai vit'ruppoatta easaavaippoalach seerkettavanaakavum iraathapadikkum echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.

eanen'raal, pi'rpaadu avan aaseervaathaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'la virumpiyum aakaathavanen'ru tha'l'lappattathai a'riveerka'l; avan ka'n'neervittu, kavalaiyoadea theadiyum manam maa'ruthalaik kaa'naama'rpoanaan.
an'riyum, thodakkoodiyathum, akkini pat'riyeriki'rathumaana malaiyinidaththi'rkum, manthaaram iru'l perungkaat'ru aakiya ivaika'linidaththi'rkum,

ekkaa'lamuzhakkaththinidaththi'rkum, vaarththaika'ludaiya saththaththinidaththi'rkum, neengka'l vanthu searavillai; anthach saththaththaik keattavarka'l pinnum thangka'lukku vaarththai sollappadaathapadikku vea'ndikko'ndaarka'l.
eanenil oru mirukamaakilum malaiyaith thottaal, athu kalle'riyu'ndu, allathu ampinaal eyyu'ndu saakavea'ndumen'ru sollappatta katta'laiyaich sakikkamaattaathirunthaarka'l.
moaseayum: naan mikavum payanthu nadungkuki'rean en'ru sollaththakkathaaka anthak kaadchi avva'lavu payangkaramaayirunthathu.
neengka'loa seeyoan malaiyinidaththi'rkum, jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya nakaramaakiya parama erusaleaminidaththi'rkum, aayiram pathinaayiramaana theavathootharka'linidaththi'rkum,

paraloakaththil pearezhuthiyirukki'ra mutha'rpea'raanavarka'lin sarvasangkamaakiya sapaiyinidaththi'rkum, yaavarukkum niyaayaathipathiyaakiya theavanidaththi'rkum, poora'naraakkappatta neethimaanka'ludaiya aavika'linidaththi'rkum,

puthu udanpadikkaiyin maththiyastharaakiya iyeasuvinidaththi'rkum, aapealinudaiya iraththam peasinathaippaarkkilum nanmaiyaanavaika'laip peasuki'ra iraththamaakiya the'likkappadum iraththaththinidaththi'rkum vanthu searntheerka'l.

peasuki'ravarukku neengka'l sevikodukkamaattoamen'ru vilakaathapadi echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l; eanenil, poomiyilea peasinavarukkuch sevikodukkamaattoamen'ru vilakinavarka'l thappippoakaamalirukka, paraloakaththilirunthu peasuki'ravarai naam vittuvilakinaal eppadith thappippoavoam?
avarudaiya saththam appozhuthu poomiyai asaiyappa'n'nit'ru; innum orutharam naan poomiyai maaththiramalla, vaanaththaiyum asaiyappa'n'nuvean en'ru ippozhuthu vaakkuththaththagn seythirukki'raar.
innum orutharam enki'ra sollaanathu asaiyaathavaika'l nilaiththirukkaththakkathaaka, asaivu'l'lavaika'l u'ndaakkappattavaika'lpoala maa'rippoam enpathaik ku'rikki'rathu.
aathalaal, asaivillaatha raajyaththaip pe'ruki'ravarka'laakiya naam payaththoadum pakthiyoadum theavanukkup piriyamaay aaraathanai seyyumpadi kirupaiyaip pat'rikko'l'lakkadavoam.
nammudaiya theavan padchikki'ra akkiniyaayirukki'raarea.
sakoathara sineakam nilaiththirukkakkadavathu.
anniyarai upasarikka ma'ravaathirungka'l; athinaalea silar a'riyaamal theavathootharaiyum upasariththathu'ndu.

kattappattirukki'ravarka'loadea neengka'lum kattappattavarka'lpoala avarka'lai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l; neengka'lum sareeraththoadirukki'ravarka'len'ru a'rinthu, theengkanupavikki'ravarka'lai ninaiththukko'l'lungka'l.
vivaakam yaavarukku'l'lum kanamu'l'lathaayum, vivaakamagncham asusippadaathathaayumiruppathaaka; veasikka'l'laraiyum vipasaarakkaararaiyum theavan niyaayantheerppaar.
neengka'l pa'na aasaiyillaathavarka'laay nadanthu, ungka'lukku irukki'ravaika'l poathumen'ru e'n'nungka'l; naan unnaivittu vilakuvathumillai, unnaik kaividuvathumillai en'ru avar solliyirukki'raarea.
athinaalea naam thairiyangko'ndu: karththar enakkuch sakaayar, naan payappadean, manushan enakku ennaseyvaan en'ru sollalaamea.

theavavasanaththai ungka'lukkup poathiththu ungka'lai nadaththinavarka'lai neengka'l ninaiththu, avarka'ludaiya nadakkaiyin mudivai nan'raaych sinthiththu, avarka'ludaiya visuvaasaththaip pinpat'rungka'l.
iyeasuki'risthu neat'rum in'rum en'rum maa'raathavaraayirukki'raar.

palavithamaana anniya poathanaika'laal alaippu'ndu thiriyaathirungka'l. poajanapathaarththangka'linaalalla, kirupaiyinaalea iruthayam sthirappaduki'rathu nallathu; poajanapathaarththangka'lil muya'rchiseyki'ravarka'l palanadaiyavillaiyea.
namakku oru palipeedamu'ndu, atha'rkuriyavaika'laip pusikki'ratha'rkuk koodaaraththil aaraathanai seyki'ravarka'lukku athikaaramillai.

eanen'raal, entha mirukangka'ludaiya iraththam paavangka'linimiththamaakap parisuththa sthalaththukku'l pirathaana aasaariyanaalea ko'nduvarappaduki'rathoa, antha mirukangka'lin udalka'l paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea sutterikkappadum.
anthappadiyea, iyeasuvum thammudaiya sontha iraththaththinaalea janaththaip parisuththagnseyyumpadiyaaka nakaravaasalukkup pu'rampea paadupattaar.
aakaiyaal, naam avarudaiya ninthaiyaich sumanthu, paa'layaththukkup pu'rampea avaridaththi'rkup pu'rappattuppoakakkadavoam.
nilaiyaana nakaram namakku ingkea illai; varappoaki'rathaiyea naadith theaduki'roam.
aakaiyaal, avarudaiya naamaththaith thuthikkum uthaduka'lin kaniyaakiya sthoaththirapaliyai avarmoolamaay eppoathum theavanukkuch seluththakkadavoam.
an'riyum nanmaiseyyavum, thaanatharmampa'n'navum ma'ravaathirungka'l; ippadippatta palika'linmeal theavan piriyamaayirukki'raar.

ungka'lai nadaththuki'ravarka'l, ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukkaaka uththaravaathampa'n'nuki'ravarka'laay vizhiththirukki'ravarka'laanapadiyaal, avarka'l thukkaththoadea alla, santhoashaththoadea athaich seyyumpadi, avarka'lukkuk keezhppadinthu adangkungka'l; avarka'l thukkaththoadea appadich seythaal athu ungka'lukkup pirayoajanamaayirukkamaattaathea.
engka'lukkaaka vea'ndikko'l'lungka'l; naangka'l nalmanachsaadchiyu'l'lavarka'laay ellaavat'rilum yoakkiyamaay nadakka virumpuki'roamen'ru nichchayiththirukki'roam.
naan athiseekkiramaay ungka'lidaththil varumpadikku neengka'l ippadi vea'ndikko'l'lumpadi athikamaayk keattukko'l'luki'rean.
niththiya udanpadikkaiyin iraththaththinaalea aaduka'ludaiya periya meaypparaana nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuvai mariththoarilirunthu ea'rivarappa'n'nina samaathaanaththin theavan,

iyeasuki'risthuvaikko'ndu thamakkumunpaakap piriyamaanathai ungka'lil nadappiththu, neengka'l thammudaiya siththaththinpadiseyya ungka'laich sakalavitha na'rkiriyaiyilum seerporunthinavarka'laakkuvaaraaka; avarukku en'ren'raikkum makimai u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.
sakoathararea, naan surukkamaay ungka'lukku ezhuthina inthap puththimathiyaana vaarththaika'lai neengka'l po'rumaiyaay eat'rukko'l'lumpadi vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
sakoatharanaakiya theemoaththeayu viduthalaiyaakkappattaanen'ru a'riveerka'laaka; avan seekkiramaay vanthaal, avanoadeakooda naan vanthu, ungka'laik kaa'npean.
ungka'lai nadaththuki'ravarka'laiyum, parisuththavaanka'l yaavaraiyum vaazhththungka'l. iththaaliyaa theasaththaar yaavarum ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
kirupaiyaanathu ungka'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
theavanukkum karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvukkum oozhiyakkaaranaakiya yaakkoapu, sitha'riyirukki'ra pannira'ndu koaththirangka'lukkum vaazhththuthal solli ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
en sakoathararea, neengka'l palavithamaana soathanaika'lil akappadumpoathu,
ungka'l visuvaasaththin pareedchaiyaanathu po'rumaiyai u'ndaakkumen'ru a'rinthu, athai mikuntha santhoashamaaka e'n'nungka'l.
neengka'l on'rilum ku'raivu'l'lavarka'laayiraamal, poora'naraayum ni'raivu'l'lavarka'laayum irukkumpadi, po'rumaiyaanathu poora'na kiriyai seyyakkadavathu.

ungka'lil oruvan gnaanaththil ku'raivu'l'lavanaayirunthaal, yaavarukkum sampoora'namaayk kodukki'ravarum oruvaraiyum kadinthuko'l'laathavarumaakiya theavanidaththil keadkakkadavan, appozhuthu avanukkuk kodukkappadum.
aanaalum avan evva'lavaakilum santheakappadaamal visuvaasaththoadea keadkakkadavan; santheakappaduki'ravan kaat'rinaal adipattu alaiki'ra kadalin alaikku oppaayirukki'raan.
appadippatta manushan thaan karththaridaththil ethaiyaakilum pe'ralaamen'ru ninaiyaathiruppaanaaka.
irumanamu'l'lavan than vazhika'lilellaam nilaiyat'ravanaayirukki'raan.
thaazhntha sakoatharan thaan uyarththappattathaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattakkadavan.
aisuvariyavaan thaan thaazhththappattathaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattakkadavan; eanenil avan pullin poovaippoal ozhinthupoavaan.
sooriyan kadum veyyiludan uthiththu, pullai ularththumpoathu, athin poo uthirnthu, athin azhakaana vadivu azhinthupoam; aisuvariyavaanum appadiyea than vazhika'lil vaadippoavaan.
soathanaiyaich sakikki'ra manushan paakkiyavaan; avan uththamanen'ru vi'langkinapinpu karththar thammidaththil anpukooruki'ravarka'lukku vaakkuththaththam pa'n'nina jeevakireedaththaip pe'ruvaan.
soathikkappaduki'ra evanum, naan theavanaal soathikkappaduki'rean en'ru sollaathiruppaanaaka; theavan pollaangkinaal soathikkappaduki'ravaralla, oruvanaiyum avar soathikki'ravarumalla.
avanavan thanthan suya ichchaiyinaalea izhukkappattu, sikku'ndu, soathikkappaduki'raan.
pinpu ichchaiyaanathu karppanthariththu, paavaththaip pi'rappikkum, paavam poora'namaakumpoathu, mara'naththaip pi'rappikkum.
en piriyamaana sakoathararea, moasampoakaathirungka'l.

nanmaiyaana entha eevum poora'namaana entha varamum paraththilirunthu'ndaaki, soathika'lin pithaavinidaththilirunthu i'rangkivaruki'rathu; avaridaththil yaathoru maa'ruthalum yaathoru veat'rumaiyin nizhalumillai.
avar siththangko'ndu thammudaiya sirushdika'lil naam mutha'rpalanka'laavatha'rku nammaich saththiya vasanaththinaalea jenippiththaar.
aakaiyaal, en piriyamaana sakoathararea, yaavarum keadki'ratha'rkuth theeviramaayum, peasuki'ratha'rkup po'rumaiyaayum, koapikki'ratha'rkuth thaamathamaayum irukkakkadavarka'l;
manusharudaiya koapam theavanudaiya neethiyai nadappikkamaattaathea.

aakaiyaal, neengka'l ellaavitha azhukkaiyum kodiya thurkku'naththaiyum ozhiththuvittu, ungka'l u'l'laththil naattappattathaayum ungka'l aaththumaakka'lai iradchikka vallamaiyu'l'lathaayumirukki'ra vasanaththaich saanthamaay eat'rukko'l'lungka'l.
allaamalum, neengka'l ungka'lai vagnchiyaathapadikkuth thiruvasanaththaik keadki'ravarka'laay maaththiramalla, athinpadi seyki'ravarka'laayum irungka'l.
ennaththinaalenil, oruvan thiruvasanaththaik keattum athinpadi seyyaathavanaanaal, ka'n'naadiyilea than supaava mukaththaip paarkki'ra manushanukku oppaayiruppaan;
avan thannaiththaanea paarththu, avvidamvittup poanavudanea, than saayal innathenpathai ma'ranthuviduvaan.

suyaatheenappiramaa'namaakiya poora'nappiramaa'naththai ut'ruppaarththu, athilea nilaiththirukki'ravanea keadki'rathai ma'rakki'ravanaayiraamal, atha'rkeat'ra kiriyai seyki'ravanaayirunthu, than seykaiyil paakkiyavaanaayiruppaan.
ungka'lil oruvan than naavai adakkaamal, than iruthayaththai vagnchiththu, thannaith theavapakthiyu'l'lavanen'ru e'n'ninaal avanudaiya theavapakthi vee'naayirukkum.

thikkat'ra pi'l'laika'lum vithavaika'lum paduki'ra upaththiravaththilea avarka'lai visaarikki'rathum, ulakaththaal ka'raipadaathapadikkuth thannaik kaaththukko'l'luki'rathumea pithaavaakiya theavanukkumunpaaka maasillaatha suththamaana pakthiyaayirukki'rathu.
en sakoathararea, makimaiyu'l'la nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinmealu'l'la visuvaasaththaip padchapaathaththoadea pat'rikko'l'laathiruppeerka'laaka.
eanenil, ponmoathiramum minukku'l'la vasthiramum thariththirukki'ra oru manushanum, kanthaiyaana vasthiram thariththirukki'ra oru thariththiranum ungka'l aalayaththil varumpoathu,

minukku'l'la vasthiranthariththavanaik ka'n'noakki: neer intha nalla idaththil udkaarum en'rum; thariththiranaip paarththu: nee angkea nillu, allathu ingkea en paathapadiya'ndaiyilea udkaaru en'rum neengka'l sonnaal,
ungka'lukku'l'lea peathakampa'n'ni, thakaatha sinthanaika'loadea nithaanikki'ravarka'laayiruppeerka'lallavaa?

en piriyamaana sakoathararea, kea'lungka'l; theavan ivvulakaththin thariththirarai visuvaasaththil aisuvariyavaanka'laakavum, thammidaththil anpukooruki'ravarka'lukkuth thaam vaakkuththaththampa'n'nina raajyaththaich suthantharikki'ravarka'laakavum therinthuko'l'lavillaiyaa?
neengka'loa thariththiraraik kanaveenam pa'n'nuki'reerka'l. aisuvariyavaanka'lallavoa ungka'lai odukkuki'raarka'l? avarka'lallavoa ungka'lai niyaayaasanangka'lukku munpaaka izhukki'raarka'l?
ungka'lukkuth tharikkappatta nalla naamaththai avarka'lallavoa thooshikki'raarka'l?
unnidaththil nee anpukooruki'rathupoalap pi'ranidaththilum anpukooruvaayaaka en'ru veathavaakkiyam solluki'ra raajarika piramaa'naththai neengka'l ni'raiveat'rinaal nanmaiseyveerka'l.
padchapaathamu'l'lavarka'laayiruppeerka'laanaal, paavagnseythu, mee'rinavarka'len'ru niyaayappiramaa'naththaal theerkkappaduveerka'l.
eppadiyenil, oruvan niyaayappiramaa'nam muzhuvathaiyum kaikko'ndirunthum, on'rilea thava'rinaal ellaavat'rilum kut'ravaa'liyaayiruppaan.

eanen'raal, vipasaaragnseyyaathiruppaayaaka en'ru sonnavar kolaiseyyaathiruppaayaaka en'rum sonnaar; aathalaal, nee vipasaaragnseyyaamalirunthum kolaiseythaayaanaal niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'rinavanaavaay.
suyaatheenappiramaa'naththinaal niyaayaththeerppadaiyappoaki'ravarka'laay atha'rkeat'rapadi peasi, atha'rkeat'rapadi seyyungka'l.
eanen'raal, irakkagnseyyaathavanukku irakkamillaatha niyaayaththeerppuk kidaikkum; niyaayaththeerppukkumunpaaka irakkam meanmaipaaraattum.
en sakoathararea, oruvan thanakku visuvaasamu'nden'ru solliyum, kiriyaika'lillaathavanaanaal avanukkup pirayoajanamenna? antha visuvaasam avanai iradchikkumaa?
oru sakoatharanaavathu sakoathariyaavathu vasthiramillaamalum anuthina aakaaramillaamalum irukkumpoathu,

ungka'lil oruvan avarka'lai noakki: neengka'l samaathaanaththoadea poangka'l, ku'lirkaaynthu pasiyaa'rungka'l en'ru solliyum, sareeraththi'rku vea'ndiyavaika'lai avarka'lukkuk kodaavittaal pirayoajanamenna?
appadiyea visuvaasamum kiriyaika'lillaathirunthaal thannileathaanea seththathaayirukkum.
oruvan: unakku visuvaasamu'ndu, enakkuk kiriyaika'lu'ndu; kiriyaika'lillaamal un visuvaasaththai enakkuk kaa'npi, naan en visuvaasaththai en kiriyaika'linaalea unakkuk kaa'npippean enpaanea.
theavan oruvar u'nden'ru visuvaasikki'raay, appadich seyki'rathu nallathuthaan; pisaasuka'lum visuvaasiththu, nadungkukin'rana.
vee'naana manushanea, kiriyaika'lillaatha visuvaasam seththathen'ru nee a'riyavea'ndumoa?
nammudaiya pithaavaakiya aapirakaam than kumaaran eesaakkaip palipeedaththinmeal seluththinapoathu, kiriyaika'linaalea allavoa neethimaanaakkappattaan?
visuvaasam avanudaiya kiriyaika'loadeakooda muya'rchiseythu, kiriyaika'linaalea visuvaasam poora'nappattathen'ru kaa'nki'raayea.
appadiyea aapirakaam theavanai visuvaasiththaan, athu avanukku neethiyaaka e'n'nappattathu enki'ra veathavaakkiyam ni'raivea'rit'ru; avan theavanudaiya sineakithanennappattaan.
aathalaal, manushan visuvaasaththinaaleamaaththiramalla, kiriyaika'linaaleayum neethimaanaakkappaduki'raanen'ru neengka'l kaa'nki'reerka'lea.
anthappadi raakaap ennum veasiyum thootharka'lai eat'rukko'ndu vea'ruvazhiyaay anuppivittapoathu, kiriyaika'linaalea allavoa neethiyu'l'lava'laakkappattaa'l?
appadiyea, aaviyillaatha sareeram seththathaayirukki'rathupoala, kiriyaika'lillaatha visuvaasamum seththathaayirukki'rathu.
en sakoathararea, athika aakkinaiyai adaivoam en'ru a'rinthu, ungka'lil aneakar poathakaraakaathiruppeerka'laaka.

naam ellaarum aneaka vishayangka'lil thava'ruki'roam; oruvan solthava'raathavanaanaal avan poora'napurushanum, than sareeramuzhuvathaiyum kadivaa'laththinaalea adakkikko'l'lakkoodiyavanumaayirukki'raan.
paarungka'l, kuthiraika'l namakkuk keezhppadiyumpadikku avaika'lin vaayka'lil kadivaa'lampoattu, avaika'ludaiya muzhuchsareeraththaiyum thiruppi nadaththuki'roam.

kappalka'laiyum paarungka'l, avaika'l makaa periyavaika'laayirunthaalum, kadungkaat'ruka'laal adipattaalum, avaika'lai nadaththuki'ravan poakumpadi yoasikkum idam ethuvoa avvidaththi'rku nearaaka mikavum si'rithaana sukkaanaalea thiruppappadum.
appadiyea, naavaanathum si'riya avayavamaayirunthum perumaiyaanavaika'laip peasum. paarungka'l, si'riya neruppu evva'lavu periya kaattaik ko'luththividuki'rathu!

naavum neruppuththaan, athu aneethi ni'raintha ulakam; nammudaiya avayavangka'lil naavaanathu muzhuchsareeraththaiyum ka'raippaduththi, aayu'l sakkaraththaik ko'luththividuki'rathaayum, naraka akkiniyinaal ko'luththappaduki'rathaayum irukki'rathu!
sakalavithamaana mirukangka'l, pa'ravaika'l, oorumpiraa'nika'l, neervaazhum jenthukka'l aakiya ivaika'lin supaavam manushasupaavaththaal adakkappadum, adakkappattathumu'ndu.
naavai adakka oru manushanaalum koodaathu; athu adangkaatha pollaangku'l'lathum saavukkeathuvaana visham ni'rainthathumaayirukki'rathu.
athinaalea naam pithaavaakiya theavanaith thuthikki'roam; theavanudaiya saayalinpadi u'ndaakkappatta manusharai athinaaleayea sapikki'roam.
thuthiththalum sapiththalum orea vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'rathu. en sakoathararea, ippadiyirukkalaakaathu.
orea oot'rukka'n'nilirunthu thiththippum kasappumaana tha'n'neer surakkumaa?
en sakoathararea, aththimaram olivappazhangka'laiyum, thiraadchachsedi aththippazhangka'laiyum kodukkumaa? appadiyea uvarppaana neeroot'ruth thiththippaana jalaththaik kodukkamaattaathu.
ungka'lil gnaaniyum viveakiyumaayirukki'ravan evanoa, avan gnaanaththi'rkuriya saanthaththoadea than kiriyaika'lai nalla nadakkaiyinaalea kaa'npikkakkadavan.
ungka'l iruthayaththilea kasappaana vairaakkiyaththaiyum viroathaththaiyum vaiththeerka'laanaal, neengka'l perumaipaaraattaathirungka'l; saththiyaththi'rku viroathamaayp poysollaamalumirungka'l.
ippadippatta gnaanam paraththilirunthu i'rangkivaruki'ra gnaanamaayiraamal, laukika sampanthamaanathum, jenmasupaavaththukkuriyathum, peayththanaththukkaduththathumaayirukki'rathu.
vairaakkiyamum viroathamum engkea u'ndoa, angkea kalakamum sakala thurchseykaika'lumu'ndu.
