paraththilirunthu varuki'ra gnaanamoa muthalaavathu suththamu'l'lathaayum, pinpu samaathaanamum saanthamum i'nakkamumu'l'lathaayum, irakkaththaalum na'rkanika'laalum ni'rainthathaayum, padchapaathamillaathathaayum, maayamat'rathaayumirukki'rathu.
neethiyaakiya kaniyaanathu samaathaanaththai nadappikki'ravarka'laalea samaathaanaththilea vithaikkappaduki'rathu.
ungka'lukku'l'lea yuththangka'lum sa'ndaika'lum ethinaalea varuki'rathu; ungka'l avayavangka'lil poarseyki'ra ichchaika'linaalallavaa?

neengka'l ichchiththum ungka'lukkuk kidaikkavillai; neengka'l kolaiseythum, po'raamaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthum, adaiyakkoodaama'rpoaki'reerka'l; neengka'l sa'ndaiyum yuththamumpa'n'niyum, neengka'l vi'n'nappampa'n'naamalirukki'rathinaalea, ungka'lukkuch siththikki'rathillai.
neengka'l vi'n'nappampa'n'niyum, ungka'l ichchaika'lai ni'raiveat'rumpadi selavazhikkavea'ndumen'ru thakaathavithamaay vi'n'nappampa'n'nuki'rapadiyinaal, pet'rukko'l'laamalirukki'reerka'l.
vipasaararea, vipasaarika'lea, ulaka sineakam theavanukku viroathamaana pakaiyen'ru a'riyeerka'laa? aakaiyaal ulakaththukkuch sineakithanaayirukka virumpuki'ravan theavanukkup pakaignanaaki'raan.
nammil vaasamaayirukki'ra aaviyaanavar nammidaththil vairaakkiya vaagnchaiyaayirukki'raaren'ru veathavaakkiyam vee'naaych solluki'rathen'ru ninaikki'reerka'laa?
avar athikamaana kirupaiyai a'likki'raarea. aathalaal theavan perumaiyu'l'lavarka'lukku ethirththu ni'rki'raar, thaazhmaiyu'l'lavarka'lukkoa kirupai a'likki'raaren'ru solliyirukki'rathu.
aakaiyaal, theavanukkuk keezhppadinthirungka'l; pisaasukku ethirththu nillungka'l, appozhuthu avan ungka'laivittu oadippoavaan.

theavanidaththil searungka'l, appozhuthu avar ungka'lidaththil searuvaar. paavika'lea, ungka'l kaika'laich suththikariyungka'l; irumanamu'l'lavarka'lea, ungka'l iruthayangka'laip parisuththamaakkungka'l.
neengka'l thuyarappattuth thukkiththu azhungka'l; ungka'l nakaippu thukkippaakavum, ungka'l santhoasham sagnchalamaakavum maa'rakkadavathu.
karththarukku munpaakath thaazhmaippadungka'l, appozhuthu avar ungka'lai uyarththuvaar.

sakoathararea, oruvarukkoruvar viroathamaayp peasaathirungka'l; sakoatharanukku viroathamaayp peasi, than sakoatharanaik kut'rappaduththuki'ravan niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rku viroathamaayppeasi niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kut'rappaduththuki'raan; niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kut'rappaduththuvaayaanaal, nee niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi seyki'ravanaayiraamal, atha'rku niyaayaathipathiyaayiruppaay.
niyaayappiramaa'naththaik katta'laiyiduki'ravar oruvarea, avarea iradchikkavum azhikkavum vallavar; mat'ravanaik kut'rappaduththuki'ratha'rku nee yaar?
mealum, naangka'l in'raikku allathu naa'laikku inna patta'naththi'rkup poay, angkea oruvarusham thangki, viyaapaaragnseythu, sampaaththiyam pa'n'nuvoamenki'ravarka'lea, kea'lungka'l.
naa'laikku nadappathu ungka'lukkuth theriyaathea. ungka'l jeevan eppadippattathu? kognchakkaalanthoan'rip pinpu thoan'raama'rpoaki'ra pukaiyaippoalirukki'rathea.
aathalaal: aa'ndavarukkuch siththamaanaal, naangka'lum uyiroadirunthaal, inninnathaich seyvoam en'ru sollavea'ndum.
ippozhuthu ungka'l veempuka'lil meanmaipaaraattuki'reerka'l; ippadippatta meanmaipaaraattal yaavum pollaangkaayirukki'rathu.
aathalaal, oruvan nanmaiseyya a'rinthavanaayirunthum, athaich seyyaama'rpoanaal, athu avanukkup paavamaayirukkum.
aisuvariyavaanka'lea, kea'lungka'l, ungka'lmeal varum nirppanthangka'linimiththam ala'ri azhungka'l.
ungka'l aisuvariyam azhinthu, ungka'l vasthirangka'l pottariththuppoayina.

ungka'l ponnum ve'l'liyum thuruppidiththathu; avaika'lilu'l'la thuru ungka'lukku viroathamaakach saadchiyaayirunthu, akkiniyaippoala ungka'l maamsaththaith thinnum. kadaisinaadka'lilea pokkishaththaich searththeerka'l.

ithoa, ungka'l vayalka'lai a'ruththa vealaikkaararudaiya kooli ungka'laal aniyaayamaayp pidikkappattuk kookkuraliduki'rathu; a'ruththavarka'ludaiya kookkural seanaika'ludaiya karththarin sevika'lil pattathu.
poomiyilea neengka'l sampiramamaay vaazhnthu, sukapoakaththil uzhan'reerka'l; kozhuththavaika'lai adikkum naa'lil nadakki'rathupoala ungka'l iruthayangka'laip poashiththeerka'l.
neethimaanai neengka'l aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththuk kolaiseytheerka'l; avan ungka'loadea ethirththuni'rkavillai.

ippadiyirukka, sakoathararea, karththar varuma'lavum neediya po'rumaiyaayirungka'l. ithoa, payiriduki'ravan poomiyin na'rpalanai adaiyavea'ndumen'ru, munmaariyum pinmaariyum varuma'lavum, neediya po'rumaiyoadea kaaththirukki'raan.
neengka'lum neediya po'rumaiyoadirunthu, ungka'l iruthayangka'lai sthirappaduththungka'l; karththarin varukai sameepamaayirukki'rathea.
sakoathararea, neengka'l niyaayantheerkkappadaathapadikku oruvarukkoruvar viroathamaay mu'raiyidaathirungka'l; ithoa, niyaayaathipathi vaasa'rpadiyil ni'rki'raar.
en sakoathararea, karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea peasina theerkkatharisika'laith thunpappaduthalukkum neediya po'rumaikkum thirushdaanthamaaka vaiththukko'l'lungka'l.

ithoa, po'rumaiyaayirukki'ravarka'laip paakkiyavaanka'lenki'roamea! yoapin po'rumaiyaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattirukki'reerka'l; karththarudaiya seyalin mudivaiyum ka'ndirukki'reerka'l; karththar mikuntha urukkamum irakkamumu'l'lavaraayirukki'raarea.

viseashamaay, en sakoathararea, vaanaththinpearilaavathu, poomiyinpearilaavathu, vea'rentha aa'naiyinaalaavathu saththiyampa'n'naathirungka'l; neengka'l aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerkkappadaathapadikku u'l'lathai u'l'lathen'rum, illathai illathen'rum sollakkadaveerka'l.
ungka'lil oruvan thunpappattaal jepampa'n'nakkadavan; oruvan makizhchchiyaayirunthaal sangkeetham paadakkadavan.
ungka'lil oruvan viyaathippattaal, avan sapaiyin moopparka'lai varavazhaippaanaaka; avarka'l karththarudaiya naamaththinaalea avanukku e'n'neypoosi, avanukkaaka jepampa'n'nakkadavarka'l.
appozhuthu visuvaasamu'l'la jepam pi'niyaa'liyai iradchikkum; karththar avanai ezhuppuvaar; avan paavagnseythavanaanaal athu avanukku mannikkappadum.

neengka'l sosthamadaiyumpadikku, ungka'l kut'rangka'lai oruvarukkoruvar a'rikkaiyittu, oruvarukkaaka oruvar jepampa'n'nungka'l. neethimaan seyyum ookkamaana vea'nduthal mikavum pelanu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu.
eliyaa enpavan nammaippoalappaadu'l'la manushanaayirunthum, mazhaipeyyaathapadikkuk karuththaay jepampa'n'ninaan, appozhuthu moon'ruvarushamum aa'rumaathamum poomiyinmeal mazhai peyyavillai.
ma'rupadiyum jepampa'n'ninaan, appozhuthu vaanam mazhaiyaip pozhinthathu, poomi than palanaith thanthathu.
sakoathararea, ungka'lil oruvan saththiyaththaivittu vilaki moasampoakumpoathu, mat'roruvan avanaith thiruppinaal,
thappippoana maarkkaththinin'ru paaviyaith thiruppuki'ravan oru aaththumaavai mara'naththinin'ru iradchiththu, thira'laana paavangka'lai mooduvaanen'ru a'riyakkadavan.
iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaakiya peathuru, ponthu, kalaaththiyaa, kappaththoakkiyaa, aasiyaa, piththiniyaa theasangka'lilea sitha'riyirukki'ravarka'lil,

pithaavaakiya theavanudaiya munna'rivinpadiyea, aaviyaanavarin parisuththamaakkuthalinaalea, keezhppadithalukkum iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya iraththanthe'likkappaduthalukkum therinthuko'l'lappatta paratheasika'lukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: kirupaiyum samaathaanamum ungka'lukkup perukakkadavathu.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaakiya theavanukku sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaka;

avar, iyeasuki'risthu mariththoarilirunthu ezhunthathinaalea, azhiyaathathum maasat'rathum vaadaathathumaakiya suthantharaththi'rkeathuvaaka, jeevanu'l'la nampikkai u'ndaakumpadi, thamathu mikuntha irakkaththinpadiyea nammai ma'rupadiyum jenippiththaar.

kadaisikkaalaththilea ve'lippada aayaththamaakkappattirukki'ra iradchippukku eathuvaaka visuvaasaththaikko'ndu theavanudaiya palaththinaalea kaakkappattirukki'ra ungka'lukku anthach suthantharam paraloakaththil vaikkappattirukki'rathu.
ithilea neengka'l mikavum santhoashappaduki'reerka'l; en'raalum, thunpappadavea'ndiyathu avasiyamaanathaal, ippozhuthu kognchakkaalam palavithamaana soathanaika'linaalea thukkappaduki'reerka'l.

azhinthupoaki'ra pon akkiniyinaalea soathikkappadum; athaippaarkkilum athika vilaiyea'rappet'rathaayirukki'ra ungka'l visuvaasam soathikkappattu, iyeasuki'risthu ve'lippadumpoathu ungka'lukkup pukazhchchiyum kanamum makimaiyumu'ndaakak kaa'nappadum.

avarai neengka'l kaa'naamalirunthum avaridaththil anpukooruki'reerka'l; ippozhuthu avaraith tharisiyaamalirunthum avaridaththil visuvaasam vaiththu, sollimudiyaathathum makimaiyaal ni'rainthathumaayirukki'ra santhoashamu'l'lavarka'laayk ka'likoornthu,
ungka'l visuvaasaththin palanaakiya aaththumaradchippai adaiki'reerka'l.
ungka'lukku u'ndaana kirupaiyaik ku'riththuth theerkkatharisanagnsonna theerkkatharisika'l intha iradchippaikku'riththuk karuththaay aaraaynthu parisoathanaipa'n'ninaarka'l;

thangka'lilu'l'la ki'risthuvin aaviyaanavar ki'risthuvukku u'ndaakum paaduka'laiyum, avaika'lukkup pinvarum makimaika'laiyum munna'riviththapoathu, innakaalaththaik ku'riththaarenpathaiyum, anthak kaalaththin viseasham innathenpathaiyum aaraaynthaarka'l.

thangka'lnimiththamalla, namathunimiththamea ivaika'laith theriviththaarka'len'ru avarka'lukku ve'liyaakkappattathu; paraloakaththilirunthu anuppappatta parisuththa aaviyinaalea ungka'lukkuch suviseashaththaip pirasangkiththavarka'laikko'ndu ivaika'l ippozhuthu ungka'lukku a'rivikkappattu varuki'rathu; ivaika'lai ut'ruppaarkkath theavathootharum aasaiyaayirukki'raarka'l.

aakaiyaal, neengka'l ungka'l manathin araiyaik kattikko'ndu, the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu; iyeasuki'risthu ve'lippadumpoathu ungka'lukku a'likkappadung kirupaiyinmeal poora'na nampikkaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l.
neengka'l munnea ungka'l a'riyaamaiyinaalea ko'ndiruntha ichchaika'linpadi ini nadavaamal, keezhppadiki'ra pi'l'laika'laayirunthu,
ungka'lai azhaiththavar parisuththaraayirukki'rathupoala, neengka'lum ungka'l nadakkaika'lellaavat'rileayum parisuththaraayirungka'l.
naan parisuththar, aakaiyaal neengka'lum parisuththaraayirungka'l en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathea.

an'riyum, padchapaathamillaamal avanavanudaiya kiriyaika'linpadi niyaayantheerkki'ravarai neengka'l pithaavaakath thozhuthuko'nduvaruki'rapadiyaal, ingkea paratheasika'laaych sagncharikkuma'lavum payaththudanea nadanthuko'l'lungka'l.
ungka'l munnoarka'laal paarampariyamaay neengka'l anusariththuvantha vee'naana nadaththaiyinin'ru azhivu'l'la vasthukka'laakiya ve'l'liyinaalum ponninaalum meedkappadaamal,
kut'ramillaatha maasat'ra aattukkuttiyaakiya ki'risthuvin vilaiyea'rappet'ra iraththaththinaalea meedkappatteerka'len'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.
avar ulakaththoat'raththi'rku munnea ku'rikkappattavaraayirunthu, thamathu moolamaayth theavanmeal visuvaasamaayirukki'ra ungka'lukkaaka inthak kadaisik kaalangka'lil ve'lippattaar.
ungka'l visuvaasamum nampikkaiyum theavanmealirukkumpadi, avarai mariththoarilirunthu ezhuppi, avarukku makimaiyaik koduththaar.

aakaiyaal neengka'l maayamat'ra sakoathara sineakamu'l'lavarka'laakumpadi, aaviyinaalea saththiyaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthu, ungka'l aaththumaakka'laich suththamaakkikko'ndavarka'laayirukki'rapadiyaal, suththa iruthayaththoadea oruvariloruvar ookkamaay anpukoorungka'l;
azhivu'l'la viththinaalea alla, en'ren'raikkum ni'rki'rathum jeevanu'l'lathumaana theavavasanamaakiya azhivillaatha viththinaalea ma'rupadiyum jenippikkappattirukki'reerka'lea.
maamsamellaam pullaippoalavum, manusharudaiya makimaiyellaam pullin poovaippoalavumirukki'rathu; pul ularnthathu, athin poovum uthirnthathu.
karththarudaiya vasanamoa en'ren'raikkum nilaiththirukkum; ungka'lukkuch suviseashamaay a'rivikkappattuvaruki'ra vasanam ithuvea.
ippadiyirukka, karththar thayaiyu'l'lavarenpathai neengka'l rusipaarththathu'ndaanaal,
sakala thurkku'naththaiyum, sakalavitha kapadaththaiyum, vagnchakangka'laiyum, po'raamaika'laiyum, sakalavitha pu'rangkoo'ruthalaiyum ozhiththuvittu,
neengka'l va'larumpadi, puthithaayp pi'rantha kuzhanthaika'laippoala, thiruvasanamaakiya ka'langkamillaatha gnaanappaalinmeal vaagnchaiyaayirungka'l.
manusharaal tha'l'lappattathaayinum, theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappattathum vilaiyea'rappet'rathumaayirukki'ra jeevanu'l'la kallaakiya avaridaththil searnthavarka'laakiya neengka'lum,

jeevanu'l'la ka'rka'laippoala aavikkeat'ra maa'likaiyaakavum, iyeasuki'risthu moolamaayth theavanukkup piriyamaana aavikkeat'ra palika'laich seluththumpadikkup parisuththa aasaariyakkoottamaakavum kattappattuvaruki'reerka'l.

anthappadiyea: ithoa, therinthuko'l'lappattathum vilaiyea'rappet'rathumaayirukki'ra moolaikkallai seeyoanil vaikki'rean; athinmeal visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan vedkappaduvathillai en'ru veathaththilea solliyirukki'rathu.

aakaiyaal visuvaasikki'ra ungka'lukku athu vilaiyea'rappet'rathu; keezhppadiyaamalirukki'ravarka'lukkoa veettaik kattuki'ravarka'laal tha'l'lappatta pirathaana moolaikkallaakiya anthak kal ida'rutha'rkeathuvaana kallum vizhutha'rkeathuvaana kanmalaiyumaayit'ru;
avarka'l thiruvasanaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'laayirunthu ida'ruki'raarka'l; atha'rken'rea niyamikkappattavarka'laayum irukki'raarka'l.

neengka'loa, ungka'lai anthakaaraththinin'ru thammudaiya aachchariyamaana o'liyinidaththi'rku varavazhaiththavarudaiya pu'n'niyangka'lai a'rivikkumpadikkuth therinthuko'l'lappatta santhathiyaayum, raajareekamaana aasaariyakkoottamaayum, parisuththa jaathiyaayum, avarukkuch sonthamaana janamaayum irukki'reerka'l.

munnea neengka'l theavanudaiya janangka'laayirukkavillai, ippozhuthoa avarudaiya janangka'laayirukki'reerka'l; munnea neengka'l irakkam pe'raathavarka'laayiruntheerka'l, ippozhuthoa irakkam pet'ravarka'laayirukki'reerka'l.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, anniyarka'lum paratheasika'lumaayirukki'ra neengka'l aaththumaavukku viroathamaayp poarseyki'ra maamsa ichchaika'lai vittu vilaki,

pu'rajaathika'l ungka'lai akkiramakkaararen'ru viroathamaayp peasum vishayaththil, avarka'l ungka'l na'rkiriyaika'laik ka'ndu, avat'rinimiththam santhippin naa'lilea theavanai makimaippaduththumpadi neengka'l avarka'lukku'l'lea nalnadakkaiyu'l'lavarka'laay nadanthuko'l'lungka'l en'ru ungka'lukkup puththisolluki'rean.
neengka'l manusharudaiya katta'laika'l yaavat'ri'rkum karththarnimiththam keezhppadiyungka'l.

mealaana athikaaramu'l'la raajaavukkaanaalugnsari, theemaiseyki'ravarka'lukku aakkinaiyum nanmaiseyki'ravarka'lukkup pukazhchchiyum u'ndaakumpadi avanaal anuppappatta athikaarika'lukkaanaalugnsari, keezhppadiyungka'l.
neengka'l nanmaiseyki'rathinaalea puththiyeena manusharudaiya a'riyaamaiyai adakkuvathu theavanudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu.
suyaatheenamu'l'lavarka'laayirunthum ungka'l suyaatheenaththaith thurkku'naththi'rku moodalaakak ko'ndiraamal, theavanukku adimaika'laayirungka'l.
ellaaraiyum kanampa'n'nungka'l; sakoathararidaththil anpukoorungka'l; theavanukkup payanthirungka'l; raajaavaik kanampa'n'nungka'l.

vealaikkaararea, athika payaththudanea ungka'l ejamaanka'lukkuk keezhppadinthirungka'l; nallavarka'lukkum saanthaku'namu'l'lavarka'lukkum maaththiram alla, murattukku'namu'l'lavarka'lukkum keezhppadinthirungka'l.
eanenil, theavanmeal pat'ruthalaayirukki'ra manachsaadchiyinimiththam oruvan aniyaayamaayp paadupattu upaththiravangka'laip po'rumaiyaaych sakiththaal athuvea pireethiyaayirukkum.

neengka'l kut'ragnseythu adikkappadumpoathu po'rumaiyoadea sakiththaal, athinaal enna keerththiyu'ndu? neengka'l nanmaiseythu paadupadumpoathu po'rumaiyoadea sakiththaal athuvea theavanukkumunpaakap pireethiyaayirukkum.

itha'rkaaka neengka'l azhaikkappattumirukki'reerka'l; eanenil, ki'risthuvum ungka'lukkaakap paadupattu, neengka'l thammudaiya adichsuvaduka'laith thodarnthuvarumpadi ungka'lukku maathiriyaip pinvaiththuppoanaar.
avar paavagnseyyavillai, avarudaiya vaayilea vagnchanai kaa'nappadavumillai;
avar vaiyappadumpoathu pathil vaiyaamalum, paadupadumpoathu payamu'ruththaamalum, niyaayamaayth theerppuchseyki'ravarukkuth thammai oppuviththaar.

naam paavangka'lukkuch seththu, neethikkup pizhaiththirukkumpadikku, avarthaamea thamathu sareeraththilea nammudaiya paavangka'laich siluvaiyinmeal sumanthaar; avarudaiya thazhumpuka'laal ku'namaaneerka'l.
sitha'ru'nda aaduka'laippoaliruntheerka'l; ippozhuthoa ungka'l aaththumaakka'lukku meaypparum ka'nkaa'niyumaanavaridaththil thiruppappattirukki'reerka'l.

anthappadi manaivika'lea, ungka'l sonthap purusharka'lukkuk keezhppadinthirungka'l; appozhuthu avarka'lil yaaraavathu thiruvasanaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'laayirunthaal, payapakthiyoadu koodiya ungka'l ka'rpu'l'la nadakkaiyai avarka'l paarththu,
poathanaiyin'ri, manaivika'lin nadakkaiyinaaleayea aathaayappaduththikko'l'lappaduvaarka'l.
mayiraip pinni, ponnaapara'nangka'lai a'ninthu, uyarntha vasthirangka'lai uduththikko'l'luthalaakiya pu'rampaana alangkarippu ungka'lukku alangkaaramaayiraamal,

azhiyaatha alangkarippaayirukki'ra saanthamum amaithalumu'l'la aaviyaakiya iruthayaththil ma'rainthirukki'ra ku'namea ungka'lukku alangkaaramaayirukkakkadavathu; athuvea theavanudaiya paarvaiyil vilaiyea'rappet'rathu.
ippadiyea poorvaththil theavanidaththil nampikkaiyaayiruntha parisuththa sthireeka'lum thangka'ludaiya purusharka'lukkuk keezhppadinthu thangka'lai alangkariththaarka'l.

anthappadiyea saaraa'l aapirakaamai aa'ndavan en'ru solli, avanukkuk keezhppadinthirunthaa'l; neengka'l nanmaiseythu oru aapaththukkum payappadaathiruntheerka'laanaal ava'lukkup pi'l'laika'laayiruppeerka'l.

anthappadi purusharka'lea, manaiviyaanava'l pelaveena paa'ndamaayirukki'rapadiyinaal, ungka'l jepangka'lukkuth thadaivaraathapadikku, neengka'l viveakaththoadu avarka'ludanea vaazhnthu, ungka'ludaneakooda avarka'lum niththiya jeevanaakiya kirupaiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'luki'ravarka'laanapadiyinaal, avarka'lukkuch seyyavea'ndiya kanaththaich seyyungka'l.
mealum, neengka'lellaarum orumanappattavarka'lum, irakkamu'l'lavarka'lum, sakoathara sineakamu'l'lavarka'lum, manaurukkamu'l'lavarka'lum, i'nakkamu'l'lavarka'lumaayirunthu,

theemaikkuth theemaiyaiyum, uthaasanaththukku uthaasanaththaiyum sarikkattaamal, atha'rkup pathilaaka, neengka'l aaseervaathaththaich suthanthariththukko'l'lumpadi azhaikkappattirukki'ravarka'len'ru a'rinthu, aaseervathiyungka'l.
jeevanai virumpi, nalla naadka'laik kaa'navea'ndumen'rirukki'ravan pollaappukkuth than naavaiyum, kapadaththukkuth than uthaduka'laiyum vilakkikkaaththu,
pollaappaivittu neengki, nanmaiseythu, samaathaanaththaith theadi, athaip pinthodarakkadavan.

karththarudaiya ka'nka'l neethimaanka'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu, avarudaiya sevika'l avarka'l vea'nduthalukkuk kavanamaayirukki'rathu; theemaiseyki'ravarka'lukkoa karththarudaiya mukam viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
neengka'l nanmaiyaip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'laanaal, ungka'lukkuth theemaiseyki'ravan yaar?
neethiyinimiththamaaka neengka'l paadupattaal paakkiyavaanka'laayiruppeerka'l; avarka'ludaiya payamu'ruththalukku neengka'l payappadaamalum kalangkaamalum irunthu;

karththaraakiya theavanai ungka'l iruthayangka'lil parisuththampa'n'nungka'l; ungka'lilirukki'ra nampikkaiyaikku'riththu ungka'lidaththil visaariththuk keadki'ra yaavarukkum saanthaththoadum va'nakkaththoadum uththaravusolla eppozhuthum aayaththamaayirungka'l.

ki'risthuvukkeat'ra ungka'l nalla nadakkaiyaith thooshikki'ravarka'l ungka'lai akkiramakkaararen'ru ungka'lukku viroathamaaych solluki'ra vishayaththil vedkappadumpadikku nalmanachsaadchiyudaiyavarka'laayirungka'l.
theemaiseythu paadanupavippathilum, theavanukkuch siththamaanaal, nanmaiseythu paadanupavippathea meanmaiyaayirukkum.

eanenil, ki'risthuvum nammaith theavanidaththil searkkumpadi aneethiyu'l'lavarka'lukkup pathilaaka neethiyu'l'lavaraayp paavangka'linimiththam orutharam paadupattaar; avar maamsaththilea kolaiyu'ndu, aaviyilea uyirppikkappattaar.
antha aaviyilea avar poayk kaavalilu'l'la aavika'lukkup pirasangkiththaar.

antha aavika'l, poorvaththilea noavaa peazhaiyai aayaththampa'n'num naadka'lilea, theavan neediya po'rumaiyoadea kaaththirunthapoathu, keezhppadiyaama'r poanavaika'l; anthap peazhaiyilea silaraakiya ettuppearmaaththiram piraveasiththu jalaththinaalea kaakkappattaarka'l.

atha'rku oppanaiyaana gnaanasnaanamaanathu, maamsa azhukkai neekkuthalaayiraamal, theavanaippat'rum nalmanachsaadchiyin udanpadikkaiyaayirunthu, ippozhuthu nammaiyum iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya uyirththezhuthalinaal iradchikki'rathu;
avar paraloakaththi'rkup poay, theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil irukki'raar; theavathootharka'lum athikaarangka'lum vallamaika'lum avarukkuk keezhppattirukki'rathu.
ippadiyirukka, ki'risthu namakkaaka maamsaththilea paadupattapadiyaal, neengka'lum appadippatta sinthaiyai aayuthamaakath thariththukko'l'lungka'l.

eanen'raal maamsaththil paadupaduki'ravan ini maamsaththilirukkum kaalamvaraikkum manusharudaiya ichchaika'linpadi pizhaikkaamal theavanudaiya siththaththinpadiyea pizhaikkaththakkathaakap paavangka'lai vittoaynthiruppaan.

sen'ra vaazhnaad kaalaththilea naam pu'rajaathika'ludaiya ishdaththinpadi nadanthuko'ndathu poathum; appozhuthu naam kaamavikaaraththaiyum thurichchaika'laiyum nadappiththu, mathupaanampa'n'ni, ka'liyaattuchseythu, ve'riko'ndu, aruvaruppaana vikkirakaaraathanaiyaich seythuvanthoam.
anthath thunmaarkka u'laiyilea avarka'loadeakooda neengka'l vizhaamalirukki'rathinaalea avarka'l aachchariyappattu, ungka'laith thooshikki'raarka'l.
uyiroadirukki'ravarka'lukkum mariththoarka'lukkum niyaayaththeerppukkodukka aayaththamaayirukki'ravarukku avarka'l ka'nakkoppuvippaarka'l.
itha'rkaaka mariththoaraanavarka'l, manusharmunpaaka maamsaththilea aakkinaikku'l'laakkappattirunthum, theavanmunpaaka aaviyilea pizhaikkumpadiyaaka, avarka'lukkum suviseasham a'rivikkappattathu.
ellaavat'ri'rkum mudivu sameepamaayit'ru; aakaiyaal the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu, jepampa'n'nuvatha'rku jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l.
ellaavat'ri'rkum mealaaka oruvariloruvar ookkamaana anpu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l; anpu thira'laana paavangka'lai moodum.
mu'rumu'ruppillaamal oruvaraiyoruvar upasariyungka'l.
avanavan pet'ra varaththinpadiyea neengka'l theavanudaiya pa'rpala kirupaiyu'l'la eevuka'laip pakirnthukodukkum nalla ukkiraa'nakkaararpoala, oruvarukkoruvar uthaviseyyungka'l.

oruvan poathiththaal theavanudaiya vaakkiyangka'linpadi poathikkakkadavan; oruvan uthaviseythaal theavan thantharu'lum pelaththinpadi seyyakkadavan; ellaavat'rileayum iyeasuki'risthumoolamaayth theavan makimaippadumpadiyea seyveerka'laaka; avarukkea makimaiyum vallamaiyum sathaakaalangka'lilum u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, ungka'laich soathikkumpadi ungka'l naduvil pat'riyeriki'ra akkiniyaikku'riththu eathoa puthumaiyen'ru thikaiyaamal,
ki'risthuvin makimai ve'lippadumpoathu neengka'l ka'likoornthu makizhumpadiyaaka avarudaiya paaduka'lukku neengka'l pangkaa'lika'laanathaal santhoashappadungka'l.

neengka'l ki'risthuvin naamaththinimiththam ninthikkappattaal paakkiyavaanka'l; eanen'raal theavanudaiya aaviyaakiya makimaiyu'l'la aaviyaanavar ungka'lmeal thangkiyirukki'raar; avarka'laalea thooshikkappaduki'raar; ungka'laalea makimaippaduki'raar.
aathalaal ungka'lil oruvanum kolaipaathakanaayaavathu, thirudanaayaavathu, pollaangku seythavanaayaavathu, anniya kaariyangka'lil thalaiyittukko'ndavanaayaavathu paadupaduki'ravanaayirukkakkoodaathu.
oruvan ki'risthavanaayiruppathinaal paadupattaal vedkappadaamalirunthu, athinimiththam theavanai makimaippaduththakkadavan.

niyaayaththeerppu theavanudaiya veettilea thuvakkungkaalamaayirukki'rathu; munthi nammidaththilea athu thuvakkinaal theavanudaiya suviseashaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaathavarka'lin mudivu ennamaayirukkum?
neethimaanea iradchikkappaduvathu arithaanaal, pakthiyillaathavanum paaviyum engkea ni'rpaan?
aakaiyaal theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi paadanupavikki'ravarka'l nanmaiseyki'ravarka'laayth thangka'l aaththumaakka'lai u'nmaiyu'l'la sirushdikarththaavaakiya avarukku oppukkodukkakkadavarka'l.
ungka'lilu'l'la moopparukku udanmooppanum, ki'risthuvin paaduka'lukkuch saadchiyum, ini ve'lippadum makimaikkup pangkaa'liyumaayirukki'ra naan puththisolluki'rathennaven'raal:
ungka'lidaththilu'l'la theavanudaiya manthaiyai neengka'l meayththu, kattaayamaay alla, manappoorvamaayum, avaladcha'namaana aathaayaththi'rkaaka alla, u'rchaaka manathoadum,
suthantharaththai i'rumaappaay aa'luki'ravarka'laaka alla, manthaikku maathirika'laakavum, ka'nkaa'nippuch seyyungka'l.
appadich seythaal pirathaana meayppar ve'lippadumpoathu makimaiyu'l'la vaadaatha kireedaththaip pe'ruveerka'l.

anthappadi, i'laignarea, moopparukkuk keezhppadiyungka'l. neengka'lellaarum oruvarukkoruvar keezhppadinthu, manaththaazhmaiyai a'ninthuko'l'lungka'l; perumaiyu'l'lavarka'lukkuth theavan ethirththu ni'rki'raar, thaazhmaiyu'l'lavarka'lukkoa kirupai a'likki'raar.
aakaiyaal, eat'rakaalaththilea theavan ungka'lai uyarththumpadikku, avarudaiya palaththa kaikku'l adangkiyirungka'l.
avar ungka'lai visaarikki'ravaraanapadiyaal, ungka'l kavalaika'laiyellaam avarmeal vaiththuvidungka'l.

the'lintha puththiyu'l'lavarka'laayirungka'l, vizhiththirungka'l; eanenil, ungka'l ethiraa'liyaakiya pisaasaanavan kerchchikki'ra singkampoal evanai vizhungkalaamoa en'ru vakaitheadich sut'riththiriki'raan.
visuvaasaththil u'ruthiyaayirunthu, avanukku ethirththu nillungka'l; ulakaththilu'l'la ungka'l sakoathararidaththilea appadippatta paaduka'l ni'raivea'rivaruki'rathen'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'lea.

ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l nammaith thamathu niththiya makimaikku azhaiththavaraayirukki'ra sakala kirupaiyum porunthiya theavanthaamea kognchakkaalam paadanupavikki'ra ungka'laich seerppaduththi, sthirappaduththi, palappaduththi, nilaini'ruththuvaaraaka;
avarukku makimaiyum vallamaiyum sathaakaalangka'lilum u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.

ungka'lukkup puththisollumpadikkum, neengka'l nilaiko'ndu ni'rki'ra kirupai theavanudaiya meyyaana kirupaithaanen'ru saadchiyidumpadikkum, naan surukkamaay ungka'lukku ezhuthi, enakkuth thoan'ruki'rapadi u'nmaiyu'l'la sakoatharanaakiya silvaanuvin kaiyilea koduththu anuppiyirukki'rean.
ungka'ludaneakoodath therinthuko'l'lappattirukki'ra paapiloanilu'l'la sapaiyum, en kumaaranaakiya maa'rkum ungka'lukku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l.
oruvaraiyoruvar anpin muththaththoadea vaazhththuthal seyyungka'l. ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana ungka'l anaivarukkum samaathaanamu'ndaavathaaka. aamen.

nammudaiya theavanum iradchakarumaayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya neethiyaal engka'laippoala arumaiyaana visuvaasaththaip pet'ravarka'lukku, iyeasuki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaaranum appoasthalanumaakiya seemoan peathuru ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
theavanaiyum nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuvaiyum a'riki'ra a'rivinaal ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum perukakkadavathu.

thammudaiya makimaiyinaalum kaaru'niyaththinaalum nammai azhaiththavarai a'riki'ra a'rivinaalea jeevanukkum theavapakthikkum vea'ndiya yaavat'raiyum, avarudaiya thivviya vallamaiyaanathu namakkuth thantharu'linathuman'ri,

ichchaiyinaal ulakaththilu'ndaana keattukkuth thappi, thivviya supaavaththukkup pangku'l'lavarka'laakumporuttu, makaa meanmaiyum arumaiyumaana vaakkuththaththangka'lum avaika'linaalea namakku a'likkappattirukki'rathu.
ippadiyirukka, neengka'l athika jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavarka'laay ungka'l visuvaasaththoadea thairiyaththaiyum, thairiyaththoadea gnaanaththaiyum,
gnaanaththoadea ichchaiyadakkaththaiyum, ichchaiyadakkaththoadea po'rumaiyaiyum, po'rumaiyoadea theavapakthiyaiyum,
theavapakthiyoadea sakoathara sineakaththaiyum, sakoathara sineakaththoadea anpaiyum kootti vazhangkungka'l.
ivaika'l ungka'lukku u'ndaayirunthu perukinaal, ungka'lai nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvai a'riki'ra a'rivilea vee'narum kaniyat'ravarka'lumaayirukkavottaathu.
ivaika'l illaathavan evanoa, avan munseytha paavangka'la'rath thaan suththikarikkappattathai ma'ranthu ka'nsorukippoana kurudanaayirukki'raan.
aakaiyaal, sakoathararea, ungka'l azhaippaiyum therinthuko'l'luthalaiyum u'ruthiyaakkumpadi jaakkirathaiyaayirungka'l; ivaika'laich seythaal neengka'l orukkaalum ida'rivizhuvathillai.
ivvithamaay, nammudaiya karththarum iradchakarumaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya niththiya raajyaththukkudpadum piraveasam ungka'lukkup paripoora'namaay a'likkappadum.
ithinimiththam, ivaika'lai neengka'l a'rinthum, neengka'l ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'ra saththiyaththil u'ruthippattirunthum, ungka'lukku ivaika'lai eppozhuthum ninaippootta naan asathiyaayirean.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthu enakku a'riviththapadi naan en koodaaraththaivittuppoavathu seekkiraththil nearidumen'ru a'rinthu,
inthak koodaaraththil naan irukkuma'lavum ungka'lai ninaippootti ezhuppividuvathu niyaayamen'ru e'n'nuki'rean.
mealum, naan sen'rupoanapinpu ivaika'lai neengka'l eppozhuthum ninaiththukko'l'la eathuvu'ndaayirukkumpadi pirayaththanampa'n'nuvean.

naangka'l thanthiramaana kattukkathaika'laip pinpat'rinavarka'laaka alla, avarudaiya makaththuvaththaik ka'n'naarak ka'ndavarka'laakavea nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin vallamaiyaiyum varukaiyaiyum ungka'lukku a'riviththoam.

ivar ennudaiya neasakumaaran, ivaridaththil piriyamaayirukki'rean en'ru solluki'ra saththam unnathamaana makimaiyilirunthu avarukku u'ndaaki, pithaavaakiya theavanaal avar kanaththaiyum makimaiyaiyum pet'rapoathu,
avaroadeakooda naangka'l parisuththa paruvathaththilirukkaiyil, vaanaththilirunthu pi'rantha anthach saththaththaikkeattoam.

athika u'ruthiyaana theerkkatharisanavasanamum namakku u'ndu; pozhuthu vidinthu vidive'l'li ungka'l iruthayangka'lil uthikkuma'lavum iru'lu'l'la sthalaththil pirakaasikki'ra vi'lakkaippoan'ra avvasanaththaik kavaniththiruppathu nalamaayirukkum.
veathaththilu'l'la enthath theerkkatharisanamum suyathoat'ramaana poru'laiyudaiyathaayiraathen'ru neengka'l munthi a'riyavea'ndiyathu.
theerkkatharisanamaanathu orukaalaththilum manusharudaiya siththaththinaalea u'ndaakavillai; theavanudaiya parisuththa manusharka'l parisuththa aaviyinaalea eavappattup peasinaarka'l.

ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'lum janangka'lukku'l'lea irunthaarka'l, appadiyea ungka'lukku'l'lum ka'l'lappoathakarka'l iruppaarka'l; avarka'l keattukkeathuvaana veathappurattuka'laith thanthiramaay nuzhaiyappa'n'ni, thangka'laik kirayaththukkukko'nda aa'ndavarai ma'ruthaliththu, thangka'lukkuth theeviramaana azhivai varuviththukko'l'luvaarka'l.
avarka'ludaiya ketta nadakkaika'lai aneakar pinpat'ruvaarka'l; avarka'lnimiththam saththiyamaarkkam thooshikkappadum.

poru'laasaiyudaiyavarka'laay, thanthiramaana vaarththaika'laal ungka'laith thangka'lukku aathaayamaaka vasappaduththikko'l'luvaarka'l; poorvakaalamuthal avarka'lukku vithikkappatta aakkinai ayarnthiraathu, avarka'ludaiya azhivu u'rangkaathu.
paavagnseytha thootharka'laith theavan thappavidaamal, anthakaarach sangkilika'linaalea katti narakaththilea tha'l'li niyaayaththeerppukku vaikkappattavarka'laaka oppukkoduththu;

poorva ulakaththaiyum thappavidaamal, neethiyaip pirasangkiththavanaakiya noavaa muthalaana ettuppearaik kaappaat'ri, avapakthiyu'l'lavarka'l ni'raintha ulakaththinmeal jalappira'layaththai varappa'n'ni;

soathoam komoaraa ennum patta'nangka'laiyum saampalaakkik kavizhththuppoattu, aakkinaikku'l'laakath theerththu, pi'rkaalaththilea avapakthiyaay nadappavarka'lukku avaika'laith thirushdaanthamaaka vaiththu;
akkiramakkaararukku'l vaasamaayirukkaiyil avarka'ludaiya kaamavikaara nadakkaiyaal varuththappattu;
naa'lthoa'rum avarka'ludaiya akkiramakkiriyaika'laik ka'ndu keattu neethiyu'l'la thannudaiya iruthayaththil vaathikkappatta neethimaanaakiya loaththai avar iradchiththirukka;
karththar theavapakthiyu'l'lavarka'laich soathanaiyinin'ru iradchikkavum, akkiramakkaararai aakkinaikku'l'laanavarka'laaka niyaayaththeerppu naa'lukku vaikkavum a'rinthirukki'raar.

viseashamaaka asuththa ichchaiyoadea maamsaththi'rkeat'rapadi nadanthu, karththaththuvaththai asattaipa'n'nuki'ravarka'lai appadich seyvaar. ivarka'l thu'nikarakkaarar, akangkaarika'l, makaththuvangka'laith thooshikka agnchaathavarka'l.
athika pelanaiyum vallamaiyaiyumudaiya theavathootharka'l muthalaayk karththarukku munpaaka avarka'laith thoosha'namaayk kut'rappaduththamaattaarka'lea.

ivarka'loa pidipattazhikkappaduvatha'rku u'ndaana puththiyat'ra mirukajeevanka'laippoalath thangka'lukkuth theriyaathavaika'laith thooshiththu, thangka'l keattilea kettazhinthu, aneethaththin palanai adaivaarka'l.
ivarka'l orunaa'l vaazhvai inpamen're'n'ni, ka'raika'lum ilachchaika'lumaayirunthu; ungka'loadea virunthu'nkaiyil thangka'l vagnchanaika'lil ullaasamaay vaazhki'ravarka'l;

vipasaaramayakkaththaal ni'rainthavaika'lum, paavaththai vittoayaathavaika'lumaayirukki'ra ka'nka'laiyudaiyavarka'l; u'ruthiyillaatha aaththumaakka'laith thanthiramaayp pidiththu, poru'laasaika'lil pazhakina iruthayaththaiyudaiya saapaththin pi'l'laika'l.
semmaiyaana vazhiyaivittuth thappinadanthu, peayoarin kumaaranaakiya pileayaamin vazhiyaip pinpat'rippoanavarka'l; avan aneethaththin kooliyai virumpi,
thannudaiya akkiramaththinimiththam kadinthuko'l'lappattaan; peasaatha mirukam manusharpeachchaip peasith theerkkatharisiyinudaiya mathikeattaith thaduththathu.
ivarka'l tha'n'neerillaatha ki'na'ruka'lum, suzhalkaat'rinaal adiyu'ndoaduki'ra meakangka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; en'ren'raikkumu'l'la kaariru'lea ivarka'lukku vaikkappattirukki'rathu.

vagnchakamaay nadakki'ravarka'lidaththilirunthu arithaayth thappinavarka'lidaththil ivarka'l akanthaiyaana vee'nvaarththaika'laip peasi, maamsa ichchaika'linaalum kaamavikaarangka'linaalum avarka'laith thanthiramaayp pidikki'raarka'l.
thaangka'lea keattukku adimaika'laayirunthum, avarka'lukkuch suyaatheenaththai vaakkuththaththampa'n'nuki'raarka'l; ethinaal oruvan jeyikkappattirukki'raanoa atha'rku avan adimaippattirukki'raanea.

karththarum iradchakarumaayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthuvai a'riki'ra a'rivinaalea ulakaththin asuththangka'lukkuth thappinavarka'l ma'rupadiyum avaika'lil sikkikko'ndu jeyikkappattaal, avarka'ludaiya pinnilaimai munnilaimaiyilum keadu'l'lathaayirukkum.
avarka'l neethiyin maarkkaththai a'rinthapinpu thangka'lukku oppuvikkappatta parisuththa ka'rpanaiyai vittu vilakuvathaippaarkkilum athai a'riyaathirunthaarka'laanaal avarka'lukku nalamaayirukkum.
naay thaan kakkinathaith thinnavum, kazhuvappatta pan'ri seat'rilea pura'lavum thirumpinathu en'ru sollappatta meyyaana pazhamozhiyinpadiyea avarka'lukkuch sampaviththathu.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, intha ira'ndaam nirupaththai ippozhuthu ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean.

parisuththa theerkkatharisika'laal munsollappatta vaarththaika'laiyum, iradchakaraayirukki'ra karththarudaiya appoasthalaraakiya engka'ludaiya katta'laika'laiyum neengka'l ninaivukoorumpadi intha nirupangka'linaal ungka'l u'nmaiyaana manathai ninaippootti ezhuppuki'rean.
muthalaavathu neengka'l a'riyavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: kadaisinaadka'lil pariyaasakkaarar vanthu, thangka'l suya ichchaika'linpadiyea nadanthu,
avar varuvaar en'ru solluki'ra vaakkuththaththam engkea? pithaakka'l niththiraiyadainthapinpu sakalamum sirushdippinthoat'ramuthal irunthavithamaayirukki'rathea en'ru solluvaarka'l.
poorvakaalaththil theavanudaiya vaarththaiyinaalea vaanangka'lum, jalaththinin'ru thoan'ri jalaththinaalea nilaiko'ndirukki'ra poomiyum u'ndaayinavenpathaiyum,
appozhuthu iruntha ulakam jalappira'layaththinaalea azhinthathenpathaiyum manathaara a'riyaamalirukki'raarka'l.

ippozhuthu irukki'ra vaanangka'lum poomiyum antha vaarththaiyinaaleayea akkinikku iraiyaaka vaikkappattu, theavapakthiyillaathavarka'l niyaayantheerkkappattu azhinthupoakum naa'lvaraikkum kaakkappattirukki'rathu.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, karththarukku orunaa'l aayiram varushampoalavum, aayiram varusham orunaa'lpoalavum irukki'rathenki'ra intha oru kaariyaththai neengka'l a'riyaathirukkavea'ndaam.

thaamathikki'raar en'ru silar e'n'nuki'rapadi, karththar thamathu vaakkuththaththaththaikku'riththuth thaamathamaayiraamal; oruvarum kettuppoakaamal ellaarum mananthirumpavea'ndumen'ru virumpi, nammeal neediya po'rumaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.

karththarudaiya naa'l iravilea thirudan varuki'ravithamaay varum; appozhuthu vaanangka'l madamada en'ru akan'rupoam, poothangka'l venthu urukippoam, poomiyum athilu'l'la kiriyaika'lum erinthu azhinthupoam.
ippadi ivaika'lellaam azhinthu poaki'rathaayirukki'rapadiyaal neengka'l eppadippatta parisuththa nadakkaiyum theavapakthiyum u'l'lavarka'laayirukka vea'ndum!
theavanudaiya naa'l seekkiramaay varumpadikku mikuntha aavaloadea kaaththirungka'l; antha naa'lil vaanangka'l venthu azhinthu, poothangka'l erinthu urukippoam.
avarudaiya vaakkuththaththaththinpadiyea neethi vaasamaayirukkum puthiya vaanangka'lum puthiya poomiyum u'ndaakumen'ru kaaththirukki'roam.

aakaiyaal, piriyamaanavarka'lea, ivaika'l varak kaaththirukki'ra neengka'l ka'raiyat'ravarka'lum pizhaiyillaathavarka'lumaaych samaathaanaththoadea avar sannithiyil kaa'nappadumpadi jaakkirathaiyaayirungka'l.

mealum nammudaiya karththarin neediya po'rumaiyai iradchippen'ru e'n'nungka'l; namakkup piriyamaana sakoatharanaakiya pavulum thanakku aru'lappatta gnaanaththinaalea ippadiyea ungka'lukku ezhuthiyirukki'raan;

ellaa nirupangka'lilum ivaika'laikku'riththup peasiyirukki'raan; avan sonnavaika'lil sila kaariyangka'l a'riki'ratha'rku arithaayirukki'rathu; kallaathavarka'lum u'ruthiyillaathavarka'lum mat'ra veathavaakkiyangka'laip purattuki'rathupoalath thangka'lukkuk keaduvaraththakkathaaka ivaika'laiyum purattuki'raarka'l.

aathalaal piriyamaanavarka'lea, ivaika'lai munnamea neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rapadiyaal, akkiramakkaararudaiya vagnchakaththilea neengka'l izhuppu'ndu ungka'l u'ruthiyilirunthu vilaki vizhunthupoakaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,
nammudaiya karththarum iradchakarumaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupaiyilum avarai a'riki'ra a'rivilum va'larungka'l. avarukku ippozhuthum en'ren'raikkum makimaiyu'ndaavathaaka. aamen.

aathimuthal irunthathum, naangka'l keattathum, engka'l ka'nka'linaalea ka'ndathum, naangka'l noakkippaarththathum, engka'l kaika'linaalea thottathumaayirukki'ra jeevavaarththaiyaikku'riththu ungka'lukku a'rivikki'roam.

antha jeevan ve'lippattathu; pithaavinidaththilirunthathum, engka'lukku ve'lippattathumaana niththiyamaayirukki'ra antha jeevanai naangka'l ka'ndu, athaikku'riththuch saadchikoduththu, athai ungka'lukku a'rivikki'roam.

neengka'lum engka'loadea aikkiyamu'l'lavarka'laakumpadi, naangka'l ka'ndum keattum irukki'rathai ungka'lukkum a'rivikki'roam; engka'ludaiya aikkiyam pithaavoadum avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvoadum irukki'rathu.
ungka'l santhoasham ni'raivaayirukkumpadi ivaika'lai ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'roam.
theavan o'liyaayirukki'raar, avaril evva'laveanum iru'lillai; ithu naangka'l avaridaththil keattu ungka'lukku a'rivikki'ra viseashamaayirukki'rathu.
naam avaroadea aikkiyappattavarka'len'ru solliyum, iru'lilea nadakki'ravarka'laayirunthaal, saththiyaththinpadi nadavaamal poysolluki'ravarka'laayiruppoam.

avar o'liyilirukki'rathupoala naamum o'liyilea nadanthaal oruvaroadoruvar aikkiyappattiruppoam; avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin iraththam sakala paavangka'laiyum neekki, nammaich suththikarikkum.
namakkup paavamillaiyenpoamaanaal, nammai naamea vagnchikki'ravarka'laayiruppoam, saththiyam namakku'l iraathu.
nammudaiya paavangka'lai naam a'rikkaiyittaal, paavangka'lai namakku manniththu ellaa aniyaayaththaiyum neekki nammaich suththikarippatha'rku avar u'nmaiyum neethiyum u'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.
naam paavagnseyyavillaiyenpoamaanaal, naam avaraip poyyaraakkuki'ravarka'laayiruppoam, avarudaiya vaarththai namakku'l iraathu.

en pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l paavagnseyyaathapadikku ivaika'lai ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean; oruvan paavagnseyvaanaanaal neethipararaayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthu namakkaakap pithaavinidaththil parinthu peasuki'ravaraayirukki'raar.
nammudaiya paavangka'lai nivirththi seyki'ra kirupaathaarapali avarea; nammudaiya paavangka'lai maaththiram alla, sarvaloakaththin paavangka'laiyum nivirththi seyki'ra paliyaayirukki'raar.
avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'lai naam kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'laanaal, avarai a'rinthirukki'roamenpathai athinaal a'rivoam.
avarai a'rinthirukki'reanen'ru solliyum, avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'laathavan poyyanaayirukki'raan, avanukku'l saththiyamillai.
avarudaiya vasanaththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravanidaththil theava anpu meyyaakap poora'nappattirukkum; naam avarukku'l irukki'roamenpathai athinaalea a'rinthirukki'roam.
avarukku'l nilaiththirukki'reanen'ru solluki'ravan, avar nadanthapadiyea thaanum nadakkavea'ndum.

sakoathararea, naan ungka'lukkup puthiya ka'rpanaiyai alla, aathimuthal neengka'l pet'rirukki'ra pazhaiya ka'rpanaiyaiyea ezhuthuki'rean; anthap pazhaiya ka'rpanai neengka'l aathimuthal keattirukki'ra vasananthaanea.

mealum, naan puthiya ka'rpanaiyaiyum ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean, ithu avarukku'l'lum ungka'lukku'l'lum meyyaayirukki'rathu; eanen'raal, iru'l neengkippoaki'rathu, meyyaana o'li ippozhuthu pirakaasikki'rathu.
o'liyilea irukki'rean en'ru solliyum than sakoatharanaip pakaikki'ravan ithuvaraikkum iru'lilea irukki'raan.
than sakoatharanidaththil anpukooruki'ravan o'liyilea nilaiko'ndirukki'raan; avanidaththil ida'ral on'rumillai.
than sakoatharanaip pakaikki'ravan iru'lilea irunthu iru'lilea nadakki'raan; iru'laanathu avan ka'nka'laik kurudaakkinapadiyaal thaan poakum idam innathen'ru a'riyaathirukki'raan.
pi'l'laika'lea, avarudaiya naamaththinimiththam ungka'l paavangka'l mannikkappattirukki'rathinaal ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean.

pithaakka'lea, aathimuthalirukki'ravarai neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rathinaal ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean. vaaliparea, pollaangkanai neengka'l jeyiththathinaal ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean. pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l pithaavai a'rinthirukki'rathinaal ungka'lukku ezhuthuki'rean.

pithaakka'lea, aathimuthalirukki'ravarai neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rathinaal ungka'lukku ezhuthiyirukki'rean. vaaliparea, neengka'l palavaanka'laayirukki'rathinaalum, theavavasanam ungka'lil nilaiththirukki'rathinaalum, neengka'l pollaangkanai jeyiththathinaalum, ungka'lukku ezhuthiyirukki'rean.
ulakaththilum ulakaththilu'l'lavaika'lilum anpukooraathirungka'l; oruvan ulakaththil anpukoornthaal avanidaththil pithaavin anpillai.
eanenil, maamsaththin ichchaiyum, ka'nka'lin ichchaiyum, jeevanaththin perumaiyumaakiya ulakaththilu'l'lavaika'lellaam pithaavinaalu'ndaanavaika'lalla, avaika'l ulakaththinaalu'ndaanavaika'l.
ulakamum athin ichchaiyum ozhinthupoam; theavanudaiya siththaththinpadi seyki'ravanoa en'ren'raikkum nilaiththiruppaan.

pi'l'laika'lea, ithu kadaisikkaalamaayirukki'rathu; anthikki'risthu varuki'raanen'ru neengka'l kea'lvippattapadi ippozhuthum aneaka anthikki'risthuka'l irukki'raarka'l; athinaalea ithu kadaisikkaalamen'ru a'riki'roam.

avarka'l nammaivittup pirinthupoanaarka'l, aakilum avarka'l nammudaiyavarka'laayirukkavillai; nammudaiyavarka'laayirunthaarka'laanaal nammudanea nilaiththiruppaarka'lea; ellaarum nammudaiyavarka'lallaven'ru ve'liyaakumpadikkea pirinthupoanaarka'l.
neengka'l parisuththaraalea apisheakam pet'ruch sakalaththaiyum a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.

saththiyaththai neengka'l a'riyaathathinaalalla, neengka'l saththiyaththai a'rinthirukki'rathinaalum, saththiyaththinaal oru poyyumu'ndaayiraathenpathai neengka'l a'rinthirukki'rathinaalum, ungka'lukku ezhuthiyirukki'rean.
iyeasuvaik ki'risthu alla en'ru ma'ruthalikki'ravaneayallaamal vea'rea yaar poyyan? pithaavaiyum kumaaranaiyum ma'ruthalikki'ravanea anthikki'risthu.
kumaaranai ma'ruthalikki'ravan pithaavaiyudaiyavanalla, kumaaranai a'rikkaiyiduki'ravan pithaavaiyum udaiyavanaayirukki'raan.

aakaiyaal aathimuthal neengka'l kea'lvippattathu ungka'lil nilaiththirukkakkadavathu; aathimuthal neengka'l kea'lvippattathu ungka'lil nilaiththirunthaal, neengka'lum kumaaranilum pithaavilum nilaiththiruppeerka'l.
niththiyajeevanai a'lippean enpathea avar namakkuch seytha vaakkuththaththam.
ungka'lai vagnchikki'ravarka'laikku'riththu ivaika'lai ungka'lukku ezhuthiyirukki'rean.

neengka'l avaraalea pet'ra apisheakam ungka'lil nilaiththirukki'rathu, oruvarum ungka'lukkup poathikkavea'nduvathillai; antha apisheakam sakalaththaiyungku'riththu ungka'lukkup poathikki'rathu; athu saththiyamaayirukki'rathu, poyyalla, athu ungka'lukkup poathiththapadiyea avaril nilaiththiruppeerka'laaka.
ippadiyirukka, pi'l'laika'lea, avar ve'lippadumpoathu naam avar varukaiyil avarukku munpaaka vedkappattuppoakaamal thairiyamu'l'lavarka'laayirukkumpadikku avaril nilaiththirungka'l.
avar neethiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raaren'ru ungka'lukkuth therinthiruppathinaal, neethiyaich seyki'ravanevanum avaril pi'ranthavanen'ru a'rinthirukki'reerka'l.
naam theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'len'ru azhaikkappaduvathinaalea pithaavaanavar namakkup paaraattina anpu evva'lavu perithen'ru paarungka'l; ulakam avarai a'riyaathapadiyinaalea nammaiyum a'riyavillai.

piriyamaanavarka'lea, ippozhuthu theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'laayirukki'roam, ini evvithamaayiruppoamen'ru innum ve'lippadavillai; aakilum avar ve'lippadumpoathu avar irukki'rava'n'namaakavea naam avaraith tharisippathinaal, avarukku oppaayiruppoamen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.
avarmeal ippadippatta nampikkai vaiththirukki'ravanevanum, avar suththamu'l'lavaraayirukki'rathupoala, thannaiyum suththikariththukko'l'luki'raan.
paavagnseyki'ra evanum niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'ruki'raan; niyaayappiramaa'naththai mee'ruki'rathea paavam.
avar nammudaiya paavangka'laich sumanthu theerkka ve'lippattaaren'ru a'riveerka'l; avaridaththil paavamillai.
avaril nilaiththirukki'ra evanum paavagnseyki'rathillai; paavagnseyki'ra evanum avaraik kaa'navumillai, avarai a'riyavumillai.
pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l oruvaraalum vagnchikkappadaathirungka'l; neethiyaich seyki'ravan avar neethiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'rathupoalath thaanum neethiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan.
paavagnseyki'ravan pisaasinaalu'ndaayirukki'raan; eanenil pisaasaanavan aathimuthal paavagnseyki'raan; pisaasinudaiya kiriyaika'lai azhikkumpadikkea theavanudaiya kumaaran ve'lippattaar.
theavanaal pi'rantha evanum paavagnseyyaan, eanenil avarudaiya viththu avanukku'l thariththirukki'rathu; avan theavanaal pi'ranthapadiyinaal paavagnseyyamaattaan.

ithinaalea theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'l innaaren'rum, pisaasin pi'l'laika'l innaaren'rum ve'lippadum; neethiyaich seyyaamalum than sakoatharanil anpukooraamalum irukki'ra evanum theavanaal u'ndaanavanalla.
naam oruvariloruvar anpukooravea'ndumenpathea neengka'l aathimuthal kea'lvippatta viseashamaayirukki'rathu.

pollaangkanaal u'ndaayirunthu than sakoatharanaik kolaiseytha kaayeenaippoalirukkavea'ndaam; avan ethinimiththam avanaik kolaiseythaan? than kiriyaika'l pollaathavaika'lum, than sakoatharanudaiya kiriyaika'l neethiyu'l'lavaika'lumaayirunthathinimiththanthaanea.
en sakoathararea, ulakam ungka'laip pakaiththaal aachchariyappadaathirungka'l.

naam sakoathararidaththil anpukooruki'rapadiyaal, mara'naththaivittu neengki jeevanukkudpattirukki'roamen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; sakoatharanidaththil anpukooraathavan mara'naththilea nilaiko'ndirukki'raan.
than sakoatharanaip pakaikki'ra evanum manusha kolaipaathakanaayirukki'raan; manusha kolaipaathakanevanoa avanukku'l niththiyajeevan nilaiththiraathu en'ru a'riveerka'l.
avar thammudaiya jeevanai namakkaakak koduththathinaalea anpu innathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; naamum sakoathararukkaaka jeevanaikkodukkak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'roam.
oruvan ivvulaka aasthi udaiyavanaayirunthu, than sakoatharanukkuk ku'raichchalu'nden'ru ka'ndu, than iruthayaththai avanukku adaiththukko'ndaal, avanukku'l theava anpu nilaiko'l'luki'ratheppadi?
en pi'l'laika'lea, vasanaththinaalum naavinaalumalla, kiriyaiyinaalum u'nmaiyinaalum anpukoorakkadavoam.
ithinaalea naam nammaich saththiyaththi'rkuriyavarka'len'ru a'rinthu, nammudaiya iruthayaththai avarukku munpaaka nichchayappaduththikko'l'lalaam.
nammudaiya iruthayamea nammaik kut'ravaa'lika'laakath theerkkumaanaal, theavan nammudaiya iruthayaththilum periyavaraayirunthu sakalaththaiyum a'rinthirukki'raar.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, nammudaiya iruthayam nammaik kut'ravaa'lika'len'ru theerkkaathirunthaal, naam theavanidaththil thairiyangko'ndirunthu,
avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'lai naam kaikko'ndu avarukku munpaakap piriyamaanavaika'laich seyki'rapadiyinaal naam vea'ndikko'l'luki'rathethuvoa athai avaraalea pet'rukko'l'luki'roam.

naam avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinmeal visuvaasamaayirunthu, avar namakkuk katta'laiyittapadi oruvariloruvar anpaayirukkavea'ndumenpathea avarudaiya ka'rpanaiyaayirukki'rathu.

avarudaiya katta'laika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravan avaril nilaiththirukki'raan, avarum avanil nilaiththirukki'raar; avar nammil nilaiththirukki'rathai avar namakkuth thantharu'lina aaviyinaalea a'rinthirukki'roam.

piriyamaanavarka'lea, ulakaththil aneakang ka'l'laththeerkkatharisika'l thoan'riyiruppathinaal, neengka'l ellaa aavika'laiyum nampaamal, antha aavika'l theavanaal u'ndaanavaika'loa en'ru soathiththa'riyungka'l.
theavaaaviyai neengka'l ethinaalea a'riyalaamen'raal: maamsaththil vantha iyeasuki'risthuvai a'rikkaipa'n'nuki'ra entha aaviyum theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

maamsaththil vantha iyeasuki'risthuvai a'rikkaipa'n'naatha entha aaviyum theavanaal u'ndaanathalla; varumen'ru neengka'l kea'lvippatta anthikki'risthuvinudaiya aavi athuvea, athu ippozhuthum ulakaththil irukki'rathu.
pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l theavanaal u'ndaayirunthu, avarka'lai jeyiththeerka'l; eanenil ulakaththilirukki'ravanilum ungka'lilirukki'ravar periyavar.
avarka'l ulakaththukkuriyavarka'l, aakaiyaal ulakaththukkuriyavaika'laip peasuki'raarka'l, ulakamum avarka'lukkuch sevikodukkum.

naangka'l theavanaal u'ndaanavarka'l; theavanai a'rinthavan engka'lukkuch sevikodukki'raan; theavanaal u'ndaayiraathavan engka'lukkuch sevikodukki'rathillai; ithinaalea saththiya aavi innathen'rum, vagnchakaaavi innathen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, oruvariloruvar anpaayirukkakkadavoam; eanenil anpu theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathu; anpu'l'la evanum theavanaal pi'ranthu, avarai a'rinthirukki'raan.
anpillaathavan theavanai a'riyaan; theavan anpaakavea irukki'raar.
thammudaiya orea pea'raana kumaaranaalea naam pizhaikkumpadikkuth theavan avarai ivvulakaththilea anuppinathinaal theavan nammeal vaiththa anpu ve'lippattathu.

naam theavanidaththil anpukoornthathinaal alla, avar nammidaththil anpukoornthu, nammudaiya paavangka'lai nivirththi seyki'ra kirupaathaarapaliyaakath thammudaiya kumaaranai anuppinathinaalea anpu u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
piriyamaanavarka'lea, theavan ivvithamaay nammidaththil anpukoornthirukka, naamum oruvaridaththil oruvar anpukoorak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'roam.
theavanai oruvarum orupoathum ka'ndathillai; naam oruvaridaththil oruvar anpukoornthaal theavan namakku'l nilaiththirukki'raar; avarudaiya anpum namakku'l poora'nappadum.
avar thammudaiya aaviyil namakkuth thantharu'linathinaalea naam avarilum avar nammilum nilaiththirukki'rathai a'rinthirukki'roam.
pithaavaanavar kumaaranai ulakaradchakaraaka anuppinaaren'ru naangka'l ka'ndu saadchiyiduki'roam.
iyeasuvaanavar theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru a'rikkaipa'n'nuki'ravan evanoa avanil theavan nilaiththirukki'raar, avanum theavanil nilaiththirukki'raan.

theavan nammeal vaiththirukki'ra anpai naam a'rinthu visuvaasiththirukki'roam. theavan anpaakavea irukki'raar; anpil nilaiththirukki'ravan theavanil nilaiththirukki'raan, theavanum avanil nilaiththirukki'raar.
niyaayaththeerppunaa'lilea namakkuth thairiyamu'ndaayirukkaththakkathaaka anpu nammidaththil poora'nappaduki'rathu; eanen'raal, avar irukki'rapirakaaramaaka naamum ivvulakaththil irukki'roam.
anpilea payamillai; poora'na anpu payaththaip pu'rampea tha'l'lum; payamaanathu veathanaiyu'l'lathu, payappaduki'ravan anpil poora'nappattavan alla.
avar munthi nammidaththil anpukoornthapadiyaal naamum avaridaththil anpukooruki'roam.

theavanidaththil anpukooruki'reanen'ru oruvan solliyum, than sakoatharanaip pakaiththaal, avan poyyan; thaan ka'nda sakoatharanidaththil anpukooraamalirukki'ravan, thaan kaa'naatha theavanidaththil eppadi anpukooruvaan?
theavanidaththil anpukooruki'ravan than sakoatharanidaththilum anpukooravea'ndumenki'ra inthak ka'rpanaiyai avaraalea pet'rirukki'roam.
iyeasuvaanavarea ki'risthu en'ru visuvaasikki'ra evanum theavanaal pi'ranthirukki'raan; pi'rappiththavaridaththil anpukooruki'ra evanum avaraal pi'rappikkappattavanidaththilum anpukooruki'raan.
naam theavanidaththil anpukoornthu avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'lumpoathu, theavanudaiya pi'l'laika'lidaththil anpukooruki'roamen'ru a'rinthuko'l'luki'roam.
naam theavanudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'lvathea avaridaththil anpukooruvathaam; avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'l paaramaanavaika'lumalla.
theavanaal pi'rappathellaam ulakaththai jeyikkum; nammudaiya visuvaasamea ulakaththai jeyikki'ra jeyam.
iyeasuvaanavar theavanudaiya kumaaranen'ru visuvaasikki'ravaneayan'ri ulakaththai jeyikki'ravan yaar?

iyeasuki'risthuvaakiya ivarea jalaththinaalum iraththaththinaalum vanthavar; jalaththinaalea maaththiramalla, jalaththinaalum iraththaththinaalum vanthavar. aaviyaanavar saththiyamaakaiyaal, aaviyaanavarea saadchikodukki'ravar.
[paraloakaththilea saadchiyiduki'ravarka'l moovar, pithaa, vaarththai, parisuththaaavi enpavarka'lea, immoovarum on'raayirukki'raarka'l;
pooloakaththilea] saadchiyiduki'ravaika'l moon'ru, aavi, jalam, iraththam enpavaika'lea, immoon'rum orumaippattirukki'rathu.
naam manusharudaiya saadchiyai eat'rukko'ndaal, athaippaarkkilum theavanudaiya saadchi athikamaayirukki'rathu; theavan thamathu kumaaranaikku'riththuk koduththa saadchi ithuvea.

theavanudaiya kumaaranidaththil visuvaasamaayirukki'ravan anthach saadchiyaith thanakku'l'lea ko'ndirukki'raan; theavanai visuvaasiyaathavanoa, theavan thammudaiya kumaaranaikku'riththuk koduththa saadchiyai visuvaasiyaathathinaal, avaraip poyyaraakkuki'raan.
theavan namakku niththiyajeevanaith thanthirukki'raar, antha jeevan avarudaiya kumaaranil irukki'rathenpathea anthach saadchiyaam.
kumaaranai udaiyavan jeevanai udaiyavan, theavanudaiya kumaaran illaathavan jeevan illaathavan.

ungka'lukku niththiyajeevan u'nden'ru neengka'l a'riyavum, theavakumaaranudaiya naamaththinmeal neengka'l visuvaasamaayirukkavum, theavakumaaranudaiya naamaththinmeal visuvaasamaayirukki'ra ungka'lukku ivaika'lai ezhuthiyirukki'rean.
naam ethaiyaakilum avarudaiya siththaththinpadi keattaal, avar namakkuch sevikodukki'raarenpathea avaraip pat'ri naam ko'ndirukki'ra thairiyam.
naam ethaik keattaalum, avar namakkuch sevikodukki'raaren'ru naam a'rinthirunthoamaanaal, avaridaththil naam keattavaika'laip pet'rukko'ndoamen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.

mara'naththukku eathuvallaatha paavaththaith than sakoatharan seyya oruvan ka'ndaal, avan vea'nduthalseyyakkadavan, appozhuthu avanukku jeevanaik koduppaar; yaarukken'raal, mara'naththukku eathuvallaatha paavaththaich seythavarka'lukkea; mara'naththukku eathuvaana paavamu'ndu, athaikku'riththu vea'nduthalseyya naan sollean.
aneethiyellaam paavanthaan; en'raalum mara'naththukku eathuvallaatha paavamumu'ndu.
theavanaal pi'rantha evanum paavagnseyyaanen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam; theavanaal pi'ranthavan thannaik kaakki'raan, pollaangkan avanaith thodaan.
naam theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'roamen'rum, ulakamuzhuvathum pollaangkanukku'l kidakki'rathen'rum a'rinthirukki'roam.

an'riyum, naam saththiyamu'l'lavarai a'rinthuko'lvatha'rkuth theavanudaiya kumaaran vanthu namakkup puththiyaith thanthirukki'raaren'rum a'rivoam; avarudaiya kumaaranaakiya iyeasuki'risthu ennappatta saththiyamu'l'lavarukku'l'lum irukki'roam; ivarea meyyaana theavanum niththiyajeevanumaayirukki'raar.
pi'l'laika'lea, neengka'l vikkirakangka'lukku vilaki, ungka'laik kaaththukko'lveerka'laaka. aamen.

namakku'l nilaini'rki'rathum en'ren'raikkum nammoadiruppathumaakiya saththiyaththinimiththam, naan maaththiramalla, saththiyaththai a'rinthirukki'ra yaavarum saththiyaththinpadi neasiththirukki'rava'lum,
therinthuko'l'lappattava'lumaakiya ammaa'lukkum ava'ludaiya pi'l'laika'lukkum, mooppanaakiya naan ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
pithaavaakiya theavanaalum pithaavin kumaaranaayirukki'ra karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, kirupaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum, saththiyaththoadum anpoadungkooda, ungka'loadiruppathaaka.
pithaavinaal naam pet'ra ka'rpanaiyinpadiyea ummudaiya pi'l'laika'lil silar saththiyaththilea nadakki'rathai naan ka'ndu mikavum santhoashappattean.

ippozhuthum ammaa'lea, naam oruvariloruvar anpukooravea'ndumen'ru, umakkup puthiya ka'rpanaiyaaka ezhuthaamal, aathimuthal namakku u'ndaayirukki'ra ka'rpanaiyaaka ezhuthi, ummai vea'ndikko'l'luki'rean.
naam avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadi nadappathea anpu; neengka'l aathimuthal keattirukki'rapadi nadanthuko'l'lavea'ndiya ka'rpanai ithuvea.
maamsaththil vantha iyeasuki'risthuvai a'rikkaipa'n'naatha aneaka vagnchakar ulakaththilea thoan'riyirukki'raarka'l; ippadippattavanea vagnchakanum anthikki'risthuvumaayirukki'raan.
ungka'l seykaika'lin palanai izhanthupoakaamal, poora'na palanaip pe'rumpadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungka'l.
ki'risthuvin upatheasaththilea nilaiththiraamal mee'ri nadakki'ra evanum theavanai udaiyavanalla; ki'risthuvin upatheasaththil nilaiththirukki'ravanoa pithaavaiyum kumaaranaiyum udaiyavan.
oruvan ungka'lidaththil vanthu intha upatheasaththaik ko'nduvaraamalirunthaal, avanai ungka'l veettilea eat'rukko'l'laamalum, avanukku vaazhththuthal sollaamalum irungka'l.
avanukku vaazhththuthal solluki'ravan avanudaiya thurkkiriyaika'lukkum pangku'l'lavanaaki'raan.

ungka'lukku ezhuthavea'ndiya kaariyangka'l aneakamu'ndu; kaakithaththinaalum maiyinaalum avaika'lai ezhutha enakku manathillai. ungka'ludaiya santhoasham ni'raivaayirukkumpadikku ungka'lidaththil vanthu, mukamukamaayp peasalaamen'ru nampiyirukki'rean.
therinthuko'l'lappatta ummudaiya sakoathariyin pi'l'laika'l umakku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l. aamen.
mooppanaakiya naan saththiyaththinpadi neasikki'ra piriyamaana kaayuvukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
piriyamaanavanea, un aaththumaa vaazhki'rathupoala nee ellaavat'rilum vaazhnthu sukamaayirukkumpadi vea'nduki'rean.
sakoatharar vanthu nee saththiyaththil nadanthuko'l'luki'raay en'ru unnudaiya u'nmaiyaikku'riththuch saadchi koduththapoathu mikavum santhoashappattean.
en pi'l'laika'l saththiyaththilea nadakki'raarka'l en'ru naan kea'lvippaduki'ra santhoashaththilum athikamaana santhoasham enakku illai.
piriyamaanavanea, nee sakoathararukkum anniyarukkum seyki'ra yaavat'raiyum u'nmaiyaaych seyki'raay.
avarka'l unnudaiya anpaik ku'riththuch sapaikkumunpaakach saadchi sonnaarka'l; theavanukku munpaakap paaththiramaanapadi avarka'lai nee vazhivittanuppinaal nalamaayirukkum.
eanenil avarka'l pu'rajaathiyaaridaththil on'rum vaangkaamal avarudaiya naamaththinimiththam pu'rappattuppoanaarka'l.
aakaiyaal naam saththiyaththi'rku udanvealaiyaadka'laayirukkumpadi appadippattavarka'laich searththukko'l'lak kadanaa'lika'laayirukki'roam.
naan sapaikku ezhuthinean; aanaalum avarka'lil muthanmaiyaayirukka virumpuki'ra thiyoaththireappu engka'lai eat'rukko'l'lavillai.

aanapadiyaal, naan vanthaal, avan engka'lukku viroathamaayp pollaatha vaarththaika'lai alappi, seythuvaruki'ra kiriyaika'lai ninaiththukko'lvean. avan ippadich seythuvaruvathum poathaamal, thaan sakoathararai eat'rukko'l'laamalirukki'rathuman'ri, eat'rukko'l'la manathaayirukki'ravarka'laiyum thadaiseythu, sapaikkup pu'rampea tha'l'luki'raan.
piriyamaanavanea, nee theemaiyaanathaip pinpat'raamal, nanmaiyaanathaip pinpat'ru, nanmaiseyki'ravan theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'raan; theemaiseyki'ravan theavanaik kaa'navillai.
theameaththiriyu ellaaraalum na'rsaadchipet'rathumallaamal, saththiyaththaalum na'rsaadchipet'ravan; naangka'lum saadchikodukki'roam, engka'l saadchi meyyen'ru a'riveerka'l.
ezhuthavea'ndiya kaariyangka'l aneakamu'ndu; aanaal maiyinaalum i'rakinaalum ezhutha enakku manathillai.

seekkiramaay unnaik kaa'nalaamen'ru nampiyirukki'rean, appozhuthu mukamukamaayp peasikko'l'luvoam. unakkuch samaathaanam u'ndaavathaaka. sineakithar unakku vaazhththuthal solluki'raarka'l. sineakitharaip pearpearaaka vaazhththuvaayaaka.

iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya oozhiyakkaaranum, yaakkoapinudaiya sakoatharanumaayirukki'ra yoothaa, pithaavaakiya theavanaalea parisuththamaakkappattavarka'lum, iyeasuki'risthuvinaalea kaakkappattavarka'lumaakiya azhaikkappattavarka'lukku ezhuthuki'rathaavathu:
ungka'lukku irakkamum samaathaanamum anpum perukakkadavathu.

piriyamaanavarka'lea, pothuvaana iradchippaikku'riththu ungka'lukku ezhuthumpadi naan mikavum karuththu'l'lavanaayirukkaiyil, parisuththavaanka'lukku oruvisai oppukkodukkappatta visuvaasaththi'rkaaka neengka'l thairiyamaayp poaraadavea'ndumen'ru ungka'lukku ezhuthi u'narththuvathu enakku avasiyamaayk ka'ndathu.

eanenil namathu theavanudaiya kirupaiyaik kaamavikaaraththukkeathuvaakap puratti, on'raana aa'ndavaraakiya theavanaiyum, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvaiyum ma'ruthalikki'ra pakthiyat'ravarka'laakiya silar pakkavazhiyaay nuzhainthirukki'raarka'l; avarka'l intha aakkinaikku'l'laavaarka'len'ru poorvaththilea ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

neengka'l munnamea a'rinthirunthaalum, naan ungka'lukku ninaippootta virumpuki'rathennavenil, karththar thamathu janaththai ekipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ni iradchiththu, pinpu visuvaasiyaathavarka'lai azhiththaar.

thangka'ludaiya aathimeanmaiyaik kaaththukko'l'laamal, thangka'lukkuriya vaasasthalaththai vittuvitta thootharka'laiyum, makaanaa'lin niyaayaththeerppukken'ru niththiya sangkilika'linaalea katti, anthakaaraththil adaiththuvaiththirukki'raar.

appadiyea soathoam komoaraa patta'naththaarka'lum, avaika'laich soozhntha patta'naththaarka'lum, avarka'laippoal vipasaarampa'n'ni, anniya maamsaththaith thodarnthu, niththiya akkiniyin aakkinaiyai adainthu, thirushdaanthamaaka vaikkappattirukki'raarka'l.
appadippoalavea, soppanakkaararaakiya ivarka'lum maamsaththai asusippaduththikko'ndu, karththaththuvaththai asattaipa'n'ni, makaththuvangka'laith thooshikki'raarka'l.

pirathaana thoothanaakiya mikaaveal moaseayinudaiya sareeraththaikku'riththup pisaasudanea tharkkiththup peasinapoathu, avanaith thoosha'namaayk kut'rappaduththath thu'niyaamal: karththar unnaik kadinthuko'lvaaraaka en'ru sonnaan.

ivarka'l thangka'lukkuth theriyaathavaika'laith thooshikki'raarka'l; puththiyillaatha mirukangka'laippoalach supaavappadi thangka'lukkuth therinthirukki'ravaika'laalea thangka'laik keduththukko'l'luki'raarka'l.
ivarka'lukku aiyoa! ivarka'l kaayeenudaiya vazhiyil nadanthu, pileayaam koolikkaakachseytha vagnchakaththilea virainthoadi, koaraa ethirththuppeasina paavaththi'rku'l'laaki, kettuppoanaarka'l.

ivarka'l ungka'l anpin virunthuka'lil ka'raika'laayirunthu, payamin'rik kooda virunthu'ndu, thangka'laith thaangka'lea meayththukko'l'luki'raarka'l; ivarka'l kaat'ruka'laal adiyu'ndoaduki'ra tha'n'neerat'ra meakangka'lum, ilaiyuthirnthu kaniyat'ru ira'ndutharagn seththu vearat'ruppoana marangka'lum,

thangka'l avamaanangka'lai nuraitha'l'luki'ra ama'liyaana kadalalaika'lum, maarkkanthappi alaiki'ra nadchaththirangka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; ivarka'lukkaaka en'ren'raikkum kaariru'lea vaikkappattirukki'rathu.

aathaamukku eazhaanthalaimu'raiyaana eanoakkum ivarka'laikku'riththu: ithoa, ellaarukkum niyaayaththeerppuk kodukki'ratha'rkum, avarka'lil avapakthiyu'l'lavarka'l yaavarum avapakthiyaaych seythuvantha sakala avapakthiyaana kiriyaika'linimiththamum,

thamakku viroathamaay avapakthiyu'l'la paavika'l peasina kadina vaarththaika'lellaavat'rinimiththamum, avarka'laik ka'ndikki'ratha'rkum, aayiramaayiramaana thamathu parisuththavaanka'loadungkoodak karththar varuki'raar en'ru munna'riviththaan.

ivarka'l mu'rumu'rukki'ravarka'lum, mu'raiyiduki'ravarka'lum, thangka'l ichchaika'linpadi nadakki'ravarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l; ivarka'ludaiya vaay i'rumaappaanavaika'laip peasum; tha'rpozhivukkaaka mukasthuthi seyvaarka'l.
neengka'loa piriyamaanavarka'lea, nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalaraal mun sollappatta vaarththaika'lai ninaivukoorungka'l.
kadaisikkaalaththilea thangka'l thunmaarkkamaana ichchaika'linpadi nadakki'ra pariyaasakkaarar thoan'ruvaarka'l en'ru ungka'lukkuch sonnaarka'lea.
ivarka'l pirinthupoaki'ravarka'lum, jenmasupaavaththaarum, aaviyillaathavarka'lumaamea.
neengka'loa piriyamaanavarka'lea, ungka'l makaa parisuththamaana visuvaasaththinmeal ungka'lai u'ruthippaduththikko'ndu, parisuththaaavikku'l jepampa'n'ni,
theavanudaiya anpilea ungka'laik kaaththukko'ndu, niththiyajeevanukkeathuvaaka nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya irakkaththaippe'rak kaaththirungka'l.
allaamalum, neengka'l pakuththa'rivu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu, silarukku irakkam paaraatti, silarai akkiniyilirunthu izhuththuvittu, payaththoadea iradchiththu,
maamsaththaal ka'raippattirukki'ra vasthiraththaiyum ve'ruththuth tha'l'lungka'l.
vazhuvaathapadi ungka'laik kaakkavum, thamathu makimaiyu'l'la sannithaanaththilea mikuntha makizhchchiyoadea ungka'lai maasat'ravarka'laay ni'ruththavum vallamaiyu'l'lavarum,
thaam oruvarea gnaanamu'l'lavarumaakiya nammudaiya iradchakaraana theavanukkuk kanamum makaththuvamum vallamaiyum athikaaramum ippozhuthum eppozhuthum u'ndaavathaaka. aamen.

seekkiraththil sampavikkavea'ndiyavaika'laith thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkuk kaa'npikkumporuttu, theavan iyeasuki'risthuvukku oppuviththathum, ivar thammudaiya thoothanai anuppi, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakiya yoavaanukku ve'lippaduththinathumaana viseasham.
ivan theavanudaiya vasanaththaikku'riththum, iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'riya saadchiyaikku'riththum, thaan ka'nda yaavat'raiyum saadchiyaaka a'riviththirukki'raan.
inthath theerkkatharisana vasanangka'lai vaasikki'ravanum, keadki'ravarka'lum, ithil ezhuthiyirukki'ravaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lum paakkiyavaanka'l, kaalam sameepamaayirukki'rathu.
yoavaan aasiyaavilu'l'la eazhusapaika'lukkum ezhuthuki'rathaavathu: irukki'ravarum irunthavarum varuki'ravarumaanavaraalum, avarudaiya singkaasanaththi'rku munpaaka irukki'ra eazhu aavika'laalum,
u'nmaiyu'l'la saadchiyum, mariththoarilirunthu mutha'rpi'ranthavarum, poomiyin raajaakka'lukku athipathiyumaakiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungka'lukkuk kirupaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaka.

nammidaththil anpukoornthu, thamathu iraththaththinaalea nammudaiya paavangka'la'ra nammaik kazhuvi, thammudaiya pithaavaakiya theavanukku munpaaka nammai raajaakka'lum aasaariyarka'lumaakkina avarukku makimaiyum vallamaiyum en'ren'raikkum u'ndaayiruppathaaka. aamen.

ithoa, meakangka'ludanea varuki'raar; ka'nka'l yaavum avaraik kaa'num, avaraik kuththinavarka'lum avaraik kaa'npaarka'l; poomiyin koaththiraththaarellaarum avaraip paarththup pulampuvaarka'l. appadiyea aakum, aamen.
irukki'ravarum irunthavarum varuki'ravarumaakiya sarvavallamaiyu'l'la karththar: naan alpaavum, oamekaavum, aathiyum anthamumaayirukki'rean en'ru thiruvu'lampat'ruki'raar.

ungka'l sakoatharanum, iyeasuki'risthuvinimiththam varuki'ra upaththiravaththi'rkum avarudaiya raajyaththi'rkum avarudaiya po'rumaikkum ungka'l udanpangkaa'lanumaayirukki'ra yoavaanaakiya naan theavavasanaththinimiththamum, iyeasuki'risthuvaippat'riya saadchiyinimiththamum, pathmu ennum theevilea irunthean.
karththarudaiya naa'lil aavikku'l'laanean; appozhuthu enakkup pinnaalea ekkaa'lasaththampoan'ra perithaana oru saththaththaik keattean.

athu: naan alpaavum oamekaavum, munthinavarum pinthinavarumaayirukki'rean. nee kaa'nki'rathai oru pusthakaththil ezhuthi, aasiyaavilirukki'ra epeasu, simirnaa, perkamu, thiyaththeeraa, sarthai, pilathelpiyaa, lavoathikkeayaa ennum patta'nangka'lilu'l'la eazhu sapaika'lukkum anuppu en'ru vi'lampinathu.
appozhuthu ennudanea peasina saththaththaip paarkkath thirumpinean; thirumpinapoathu, eazhu pon kuththuvi'lakkuka'laiyum,
antha eazhu kuththuvi'lakkuka'lin maththiyilea, nilaiyangki thariththu, maarparukea po'rkachchai kattiyiruntha manushakumaaranukkoppaanavaraiyum ka'ndean.
avarudaiya sirasum mayirum ve'npagnchaippoalavum u'raintha mazhaiyaippoalavum ve'nmaiyaayirunthathu; avarudaiya ka'nka'l akkinijuvaalaiyaip poalirunthathu;
avarudaiya paathangka'l ulaikka'laththil kaayntha pirakaasamaana ve'nkalampoalirunthathu; avarudaiya saththam peruve'l'laththu iraichchalaippoalirunthathu.

thamathu valathukaraththilea eazhu nadchaththirangka'lai eanthikko'ndirunthaar; avar vaayilirunthu irupu'ramum karukku'l'la pattayam pu'rappattathu; avarudaiya mukam vallamaiyaayp pirakaasikki'ra sooriyanaippoalirunthathu.

naan avaraik ka'ndapoathu seththavanaippoala avarudaiya paathaththil vizhunthean; appozhuthu avar thammudaiya valathukaraththai enmeal vaiththu, ennai noakki: payappadaathea, naan munthinavarum pinthinavarum, uyiru'l'lavarumaayirukki'rean;
mariththean, aanaalum, ithoa, sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'rean, aamen; naan mara'naththi'rkum paathaa'laththi'rkumuriya thi'ravukoalka'lai udaiyavaraayirukki'rean.
nee ka'ndavaika'laiyum, irukki'ravaika'laiyum, ivaika'lukkuppinpu sampavippavaika'laiyum ezhuthu;

en valathukaraththil nee ka'nda eazhu nadchaththirangka'lin irakasiyaththaiyum, eazhu pon kuththuvi'lakkuka'lin irakasiyaththaiyum ezhuthu; antha eazhu nadchaththirangka'lum eazhu sapaika'lin thootharka'laam; nee ka'nda eazhu kuththuvi'lakkuka'lum eazhu sapaika'laam.

epeasu sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: eazhu nadchaththirangka'laith thammudaiya valathukaraththil eanthikko'ndu, eazhu pon kuththuvi'lakkuka'lin maththiyilea ulaavikko'ndirukki'ravar solluki'rathaavathu;

un kiriyaika'laiyum, un pirayaasaththaiyum, un po'rumaiyaiyum, nee pollaathavarka'laich sakikkakkoodaamalirukki'rathaiyum, appoasthalarallaathavarka'l thangka'lai appoasthalaren'ru solluki'rathai nee soathiththu avarka'laip poyyaren'ru ka'nda'rinthathaiyum;
nee sakiththukko'ndirukki'rathaiyum, po'rumaiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, en naamaththinimiththam i'laippadaiyaamal pirayaasappattathaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.
aanaalum, nee aathiyil ko'ndiruntha anpai vittaay en'ru unpearil enakkuk ku'rai u'ndu.

aakaiyaal, nee inna nilaimaiyilirunthu vizhunthaayenpathai ninaiththu, mananthirumpi, aathiyil seytha kiriyaika'laich seyvaayaaka; illaavittaal naan seekkiramaay unnidaththil vanthu, nee mananthirumpaathapadchaththil, un vi'lakkuththa'ndai athanidaththinin'ru neekkividuvean.
naan ve'rukki'ra nikkolaay mathastharin kiriyaika'lai neeyum ve'rukki'raay, ithu unnidaththilu'ndu.

aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan; jeyangko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanukkuth theavanudaiya paratheesin maththiyilirukki'ra jeevavirudchaththin kaniyaip pusikkakkoduppean en'rezhuthu.
simirnaa sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: munthinavarum pinthinavarum, mariththirunthu pizhaiththavarumaanavar solluki'rathaavathu;

un kiriyaika'laiyum, un upaththiravaththaiyum, nee aisuvariyamu'l'lavanaayirunthum unakkirukki'ra thariththiraththaiyum, thangka'lai yootharen'ru solliyum yootharaayiraamal saaththaanudaiya koottamaayirukki'ravarka'l seyyum thoosha'naththaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.

nee padappoaki'ra paaduka'laikku'riththu evva'lavum payappadaathea; ithoa, neengka'l soathikkappadumporuttaakap pisaasaanavan ungka'lil silaraik kaavalil poaduvaan; paththunaa'l upaththiravappaduveerka'l. aakilum nee mara'napariyantham u'nmaiyaayiru, appozhuthu jeevakireedaththai unakkuth tharuvean.
aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan; jeyangko'l'luki'ravan ira'ndaam mara'naththinaal seathappaduvathillai en'rezhuthu.
perkamu sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: irupu'ramum karukku'l'la pattayaththai udaiyavar solluki'rathaavathu;

un kiriyaika'laiyum, saaththaanudaiya singkaasanamirukki'ra idaththil nee kudiyirukki'rathaiyum, nee en naamaththaip pat'rikko'ndirukki'rathaiyum, saaththaan kudiko'ndirukki'ra idaththilea ungka'lukku'l'lea enakku u'nmaiyu'l'la saadchiyaana anthippaa enpavan kollappatta naadka'lilum ennaip pat'rum visuvaasaththai nee ma'ruthaliyaamalirunthathaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.

aakilum, sila kaariyangka'laikku'riththu unpearil enakkuk ku'rai u'ndu; vikkirakangka'lukkup padaiththavaika'laip pusippatha'rkum veasiththanampa'n'nuvatha'rkum eathuvaana ida'ralai israveal puththirar munpaakap poadumpadi paalaak enpavanukkup poathanaiseytha pileayaamudaiya poathakaththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'l unnidaththilu'ndu.
appadiyea nikkolaay mathastharudaiya poathakaththaik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lum unnidaththilu'ndu; athai naan ve'rukki'rean.
nee mananthirumpu, illaavittaal naan seekkiramaay unnidaththil vanthu, en vaayin pattayaththaal avarka'loadea yuththampa'n'nuvean.

aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan; jeyangko'l'luki'ravanukku naan ma'raivaana mannaavaip pusikkakkoduththu, avanukku ve'nmaiyaana ku'rikkallaiyum, anthak kallinmeal ezhuthappattathum athaip pe'ruki'ravaneayan'ri vea'roruvanum a'riyakkoodaathathumaakiya puthiya naamaththaiyum koduppean en'rezhuthu.
thiyaththeeraa sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: akkinijuvaalai poan'ra ka'nka'lum, pirakaasamaana ve'nkalampoan'ra paathangka'lumu'l'la theavakumaaran solluki'rathaavathu;

un kiriyaika'laiyum, un anpaiyum, un oozhiyaththaiyum, un visuvaasaththaiyum, un po'rumaiyaiyum, nee munpu seytha kiriyaika'lilum pinpu seytha kiriyaika'l athikamaayirukki'rathaiyum a'rinthirukki'rean.

aakilum, un pearil enakkuk ku'rai u'ndu; ennavenil, thannaith theerkkatharisiyen'ru solluki'ra yeasapeal ennum sthireeyaanava'l ennudaiya oozhiyakkaarar veasiththanampa'n'navum vikkirakangka'lukkup padaiththavaika'laip pusikkavum avarka'lukkup poathiththu, avarka'lai vagnchikkumpadi nee ava'lukku idangkodukki'raay.
ava'l mananthirumpumpadiyaay ava'lukkuth thava'naikoduththean; than veasimaarkkaththai vittu mananthirumpa ava'lukku viruppamillai.
ithoa, naan ava'laik kattilkidaiyaakki, ava'ludanea vipasaaragnseythavarka'l thangka'ludaiya kiriyaika'laivittu mananthirumpaavittaal avarka'laiyum mikuntha upaththiravaththilea tha'l'li,

ava'ludaiya pi'l'laika'laiyum kollavea kolluvean; appozhuthu naanea u'l'linthiriyangka'laiyum iruthayangka'laiyum aaraayki'ravaren'ru ellaach sapaika'lum a'rinthuko'l'lum; an'riyum ungka'lil ovvoruvanukkum ungka'l kiriyaika'linpadiyea palana'lippean.

thiyaththeeraavilea inthap poathakaththaip pat'rikko'l'laamalum, saaththaanudaiya aazhangka'l en'ru avarka'l solluki'raarka'lea, antha aazhangka'lai a'rinthuko'l'laamalumirukki'ra mat'ravarka'laakiya ungka'lukku naan solluki'rathaavathu; ungka'lmeal vea'roru paaraththaiyum sumaththamaattean.
ungka'lukku'l'lathai naan varuma'lavum pat'rikko'ndirungka'l.
jeyangko'ndu mudivupariyantham en kiriyaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanukku, naan en pithaavinidaththil athikaaram pet'rathupoala, jaathika'lmeal athikaaram koduppean.
avan iruppukkoalaal avarka'lai aa'luvaan; avarka'l ma'npaa'ndangka'laippoala no'rukkappaduvaarka'l.
vidive'l'li nadchaththiraththaiyum avanukkuk koduppean.
aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'rezhuthu.

sarthai sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: theavanudaiya eazhu aavika'laiyum eazhu nadchaththirangka'laiyum udaiyavar solluki'rathaavathu; un kiriyaika'lai a'rinthirukki'rean, nee uyiru'l'lavanen'ru peyarko'ndirunthum seththavanaayirukki'raay.
nee vizhiththukko'ndu, saaki'ratha'rkeathuvaayirukki'ravaika'lai sthirappaduththu; un kiriyaika'l theavanukkumun ni'raivu'l'lavaika'laaka naan kaa'navillai.

aakaiyaal nee keattup pet'rukko'nda vakaiyai ninaivukoornthu, athaik kaikko'ndu mananthirumpu. nee vizhiththiraavittaal, thirudanaippoal unmeal varuvean; naan unmeal varumvea'laiyai a'riyaathiruppaay.
aanaalum thangka'l vasthirangka'lai asusippaduththaatha silapear sarthaiyilum unakku'ndu; avarka'l paaththiravaanka'laanapadiyaal ve'nvasthiranthariththu ennoadeakooda nadappaarka'l.

jeyangko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanukku ve'nvasthiram tharippikkappadum; jeevapusthakaththilirunthu avanudaiya naamaththai naan ki'rukkippoadaamal, en pithaa munpaakavum avarudaiya thoothar munpaakavum avan naamaththai a'rikkaiyiduvean.
aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'rezhuthu.

pilathelpiyaa sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: parisuththamu'l'lavarum, saththiyamu'l'lavarum, thaaveethin thi'ravukoalai udaiyavarum, oruvarum poottakkoodaathapadikkuth thi'rakki'ravarum, oruvarum thi'rakkakkoodaathapadikkup poottuki'ravarumaayirukki'ravar solluki'rathaavathu;

un kiriyaika'lai a'rinthirukki'rean; unakkuk kogncham pelan irunthum, nee en naamaththai ma'ruthaliyaamal, en vasanaththaik kaikko'ndapadiyinaalea, ithoa, thi'ranthavaasalai unakku munpaaka vaiththirukki'rean, athai oruvanum poottamaattaan.

ithoa, yootharallaathirunthum thangka'lai yootharen'ru poy solluki'ravarka'laakiya saaththaanudaiya koottaththaaril silarai unakkuk koduppean; ithoa, avarka'l un paathangka'lukku munpaaka vanthu pa'ninthu, naan unmeal anpaayirukki'rathai a'rinthuko'l'lumpadi seyvean.

en po'rumaiyaikku'riththuch solliya vasanaththai nee kaaththukko'ndapadiyinaal, poomiyil kudiyirukki'ravarka'laich soathikkumpadiyaakap poochchakkaraththinmealengkum varappoaki'ra soathanaikaalaththi'rkuth thappumpadi naanum unnaik kaappean.
ithoa, seekkiramaay varuki'rean; oruvanum un kireedaththai eduththukko'l'laathapadikku unakku'l'lathaip pat'rikko'ndiru.

jeyangko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanai en theavanudaiya aalayaththilea thoo'naakkuvean, athinin'ru avan orukkaalum neengkuvathillai; en theavanudaiya naamaththaiyum en theavanaal paraloakaththilirunthi'rangkivaruki'ra puthiya erusaleamaakiya en theavanudaiya nakaraththin naamaththaiyum, en puthiya naamaththaiyum avanmeal ezhuthuvean.
aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'rezhuthu.
lavoathikkeayaa sapaiyin thoothanukku nee ezhuthavea'ndiyathu ennavenil: u'nmaiyum saththiyamumu'l'la saadchiyum, theavanudaiya sirushdikku aathiyumaayirukki'ra aamen enpavar solluki'rathaavathu;
un kiriyaika'lai a'rinthirukki'rean; nee ku'lirumalla analumalla; nee ku'liraayaavathu analaayaavathu irunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
ippadi nee ku'lirumin'ri analumin'ri vethuvethuppaayirukki'rapadiyinaal unnai en vaayinin'ru vaanthipa'n'nippoaduvean.

nee nirppaakkiyamu'l'lavanum, parithapikkappadaththakkavanum, thariththiranum, kurudanum, nirvaa'niyumaayirukki'rathai a'riyaamal, naan aisuvariyavaanen'rum, thiraviyasampannanen'rum, enakku oru ku'raivumillaiyen'rum solluki'rapadiyaal;

naan: nee aisuvariyavaanaakumpadikku neruppilea pudamidappatta ponnaiyum, un nirvaa'namaakiya avaladcha'nam thoan'raathapadikku nee uduththikko'lvatha'rku ve'nvasthirangka'laiyum ennidaththilea vaangkikko'l'lavum, nee paarvaiyadaiyumpadikku un ka'nka'lukkuk kalikkampoadavum vea'ndumen'ru unakku aaloasanai solluki'rean.
naan neasikki'ravarka'levarka'loa avarka'laik kadinthuko'ndu sidchikki'rean; aakaiyaal nee jaakkirathaiyaayirunthu, mananthirumpu.

ithoa, vaasa'rpadiyilea nin'ru thattuki'rean; oruvan en saththaththaik keattu, kathavaith thi'ranthaal, avanidaththil naan piraveasiththu, avanoadea poajanampa'n'nuvean, avanum ennoadea poajanampa'n'nuvaan.
naan jeyangko'ndu en pithaavinudaiya singkaasanaththilea avaroadeakooda udkaarnthathupoala, jeyangko'l'luki'ravanevanoa avanum ennudaiya singkaasanaththil ennoadeakooda udkaarumpadikku aru'lseyvean.
aaviyaanavar sapaika'lukkuch solluki'rathaik kaathu'l'lavan keadkakkadavan en'rezhuthu en'raar.

ivaika'lukkuppinpu, ithoa, paraloakaththil thi'rakkappattiruntha oru vaasalaik ka'ndean. munnea ekkaa'lasaththampoala ennudanea peasa naan keattiruntha saththamaanathu: ingkea ea'rivaa, ivaika'lukkuppinpu sampavikkavea'ndiyavaika'lai unakkuk kaa'npippean en'ru vi'lampinathu.
udanea aavikku'l'laanean; appozhuthu, ithoa, vaanaththil oru singkaasanam vaikkappattirunthathu, anthach singkaasanaththinmeal oruvar veet'rirunthaar.
veet'rirunthavar, paarvaikku vachchirakkallukkum pathumaraakaththukkum oppaayirunthaar; anthach singkaasanaththaichsut'ri oru vaanavillirunthathu; athu paarvaikku marakathampoal thoan'rit'ru.

anthach singkaasanaththaich soozha irupaththunaanku singkaasanangka'lirunthana; irupaththunaanku moopparka'l ve'nvasthiranthariththu, thangka'l sirasuka'lil ponmudi soodi, anthach singkaasanangka'linmeal udkaarnthirukkakka'ndean.

anthach singkaasanaththilirunthu minnalka'lum idimuzhakkangka'lum saththangka'lum pu'rappattana; theavanudaiya eazhu aavika'laakiya eazhu akkini theepangka'l singkaasanaththi'rku munpaaka erinthuko'ndirunthana.

anthach singkaasanaththi'rku munpaakap pa'lingkukkoppaana ka'n'naadikkadalirunthathu; anthach singkaasanaththin maththiyilum anthach singkaasanaththaich sut'rilum naanku jeevanka'lirunthana, avaika'l munpu'raththilum pinpu'raththilum ka'nka'laal ni'rainthirunthana.

muthalaam jeevan singkaththi'rkoppaakavum, ira'ndaam jeevan kaa'laikkoppaakavum, moon'raam jeevan manushamukam poan'ra mukamu'l'lathaakavum, naankaam jeevan pa'rakki'ra kazhukukku oppaakavumirunthana.
