antha naanku jeevanka'lilum ovvon'ru avvaa'ru si'rakuka'lu'l'lavaika'lum, sut'rilum u'l'leayum ka'nka'laal ni'rainthavaika'lumaayirunthana. avaika'l: irunthavarum irukki'ravarum varuki'ravarumaakiya sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththar parisuththar parisuththar parisuththar en'ru iravum pakalum oayvillaamal sollikko'ndirunthana.
mealum, singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirunthu, sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'ravarukku antha jeevanka'l, makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum sthoaththiraththaiyum seluththumpoathu,

irupaththunaanku moopparka'lum singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ravarukku munpaaka va'nakkamaay vizhunthu, sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'ravaraith thozhuthuko'ndu, thangka'l kireedangka'laich singkaasanaththi'rkumunpaaka vaiththu:

karththaavea, theavareer, makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum vallamaiyaiyum pet'rukko'l'luki'ratha'rkup paaththiraraayirukki'reer; neerea sakalaththaiyum sirushdiththeer, ummudaiya siththaththinaalea avaika'l u'ndaayirukki'ravaika'lum sirushdikkappattavaika'lumaayirukki'rathu en'raarka'l.
an'riyum, u'l'lum pu'rampum ezhuthappattu, eazhu muththiraika'laal muththirikkappattiruntha oru pusthakaththaich singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ravarudaiya valathukaraththilea ka'ndean.
pusthakaththaith thi'rakkavum athin muththiraika'lai udaikkavum paaththiravaan yaar en'ru mikuntha saththamittuk koo'ruki'ra palamu'l'la oru thoothanaiyung ka'ndean.
vaanaththilaavathu, poomiyilaavathu, poomiyinkeezhaavathu, oruvanum anthap pusthakaththaith thi'rakkavum, athaip paarkkavum koodaathirunthathu.
oruvanum anthap pusthakaththaith thi'ranthu vaasikkavum athaip paarkkavum paaththiravaanaakak kaa'nappadaathathinaal naan mikavum azhuthean.

appozhuthu moopparka'lil oruvan ennai noakki: nee azhavea'ndaam; ithoa, yoothaa koaththiraththuch singkamum thaaveethin vearumaanavar pusthakaththaith thi'rakkavum athin eazhu muththiraika'laiyum udaikkavum jeyangko'ndirukki'raar en'raan.

appozhuthu, ithoa, adikkappatta va'n'namaayirukki'ra oru aattukkutti singkaasanaththi'rkum, naanku jeevanka'lukkum, moopparka'lukkum maththiyilea ni'rkakka'ndean; athu eazhu kompuka'laiyum eazhu ka'nka'laiyum udaiyathaayirunthathu; anthak ka'nka'l poomiyengkum anuppappaduki'ra theavanudaiya eazhu aavika'leayaam.
antha aattukkuttiyaanavar vanthu, singkaasanaththinmeal udkaarnthavarudaiya valathukaraththiliruntha pusthakaththai vaangkinaar.

anthap pusthakaththai avar vaangkinapoathu, antha naanku jeevanka'lum, irupaththunaanku moopparka'lum thangka'l thangka'l surama'ndalangka'laiyum, parisuththavaanka'ludaiya jepangka'laakiya thoopavarkkaththaal ni'raintha po'rkalasangka'laiyum pidiththukko'ndu, aattukkuttiyaanavarukku munpaaka va'nakkamaay vizhunthu:

theavareer pusthakaththai vaangkavum athin muththiraika'lai udaikkavum paaththiraraayirukki'reer; eanenil neer adikkappattu, sakala koaththirangka'lilum paashaikkaararilum janangka'lilum jaathika'lilumirunthu engka'laith theavanukken'ru ummudaiya iraththaththinaalea meettukko'ndu,
engka'l theavanukkumunpaaka engka'lai raajaakka'lum aasaariyarka'lumaakkineer; naangka'l poomiyilea arasaa'luvoam en'ru puthiya paattaip paadinaarka'l.

pinnum naan paarththapoathu, singkaasanaththaiyum jeevanka'laiyum moopparka'laiyum soozhnthiruntha aneaka thootharka'ludaiya saththaththaik keattean; avarka'ludaiya ilakkam pathinaayiram pathinaayiramaakavum, aayiramaayiramaakavumirunthathu.

avarka'lum makaa saththamittu: adikkappatta aattukkuttiyaanavar vallamaiyaiyum aisuvariyaththaiyum gnaanaththaiyum pelaththaiyum kanaththaiyum makimaiyaiyum sthoaththiraththaiyum pet'rukko'l'lap paaththiraraayirukki'raar en'ru sonnaarka'l.

appozhuthu, vaanaththilum poomiyilum poomiyinkeezhumirukki'ra sirushdika'l yaavum, samuththiraththilu'l'lavaika'lum, avat'ru'ladangkiya vasthukka'l yaavum: singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ravarukkum aattukkuttiyaanavarukkum sthoaththiramum kanamum makimaiyum vallamaiyum sathaakaalangka'lilum u'ndaavathaaka en'ru sollakkeattean.
atha'rku naanku jeevanka'lum: aamen en'ru sollina. irupaththunaanku moopparka'lum va'nakkamaay vizhunthu sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'ravaraith thozhuthuko'ndaarka'l.
aattukkuttiyaanavar muththiraika'lil on'rai udaikkakka'ndean. appozhuthu naanku jeevanka'lil on'ru ennai noakki: nee vanthu paar en'ru idimuzhakkampoan'ra saththamaaych sollakkeattean.

naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, oru ve'l'laikkuthiraiyaik ka'ndean; athinmeal ea'riyirunthavan villaip pidiththirunthaan; avanukku oru kireedang kodukkappattathu; avan jeyikki'ravanaakavum jeyippavanaakavum pu'rappattaan.
avar ira'ndaam muththiraiyai udaiththapoathu, ira'ndaam jeevanaanathu: nee vanthupaar en'ru sollakkeattean.

appozhuthu sivappaana vea'roru kuthirai pu'rappattathu; athinmeal ea'riyirunthavanukku, poomiyilu'l'lavarka'l oruvaraiyoruvar kolaiseyyaththakkathaakach samaathaanaththaip poomiyiliruntheduththup poadumpadiyaana athikaaram kodukkappattathu; oru periya pattayamum avanukkuk kodukkappattathu.

avar moon'raam muththiraiyai udaiththapoathu, moon'raam jeevanaanathu: nee vanthupaar en'ru sollakkeattean. naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, oru ka'ruppukkuthiraiyaik ka'ndean; athinmeal ea'riyirunthavan oru tharaasaith than kaiyilea pidiththirunthaan.

appozhuthu, oru pa'naththukku orupadi koathumaiyen'rum, oru pa'naththukku moon'rupadi vaa'rkoathumaiyen'rum, e'n'neyaiyum thiraadcharasaththaiyum seathappaduththaathea en'rum, naanku jeevanka'lin maththiyilirunthu u'ndaana saththaththaik keattean.
avar naalaam muththiraiyai udaiththapoathu, naalaam jeevanaanathu: nee vanthupaar en'ru sollugn saththaththaik keattean.

naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, mangkina ni'ramu'l'la oru kuthiraiyaik ka'ndean; athinmeal ea'riyirunthavanukku mara'nam en'ru peyar; paathaa'lam avanpin sen'rathu. pattayaththinaalum, pagnchaththinaalum, saavinaalum, poomiyin thushda mirukangka'linaalum, poomiyin kaa'rpangkilu'l'lavarka'laik kolaiseyyumpadiyaana athikaaram avaika'lukkuk kodukkappattathu.
avar ainthaam muththiraiyai udaiththapoathu, theavavasanaththinimiththamum thaangka'l koduththa saadchiyinimiththamum kollappattavarka'ludaiya aaththumaakka'laip palipeedaththinkeezhea ka'ndean.

avarka'l: parisuththamum saththiyamumu'l'la aa'ndavarea, theavareer poomiyinmeal kudiyirukki'ravarka'lidaththil engka'l iraththaththaikku'riththu ethuvaraikkum niyaayaththeerppuchseyyaamalum pazhivaangkaamalum iruppeer en'ru makaa saththamittuk kooppittaarka'l.

appozhuthu avarka'l ovvoruvarukkum ve'l'lai angkika'l kodukkappattathu; an'riyum, avarka'l thangka'laippoalak kolaiseyyappadappoaki'ravarka'laakiya thangka'l udanpa'nividaikkaararum thangka'l sakoathararumaanavarka'lin thokai ni'raivaakuma'lavum innungkognchakkaalam i'laippaa'ravea'ndum en'ru avarka'lukkuch sollappattathu.
avar aa'raam muththiraiyai udaikkakka'ndean; ithoa, poomi mikavum athirnthathu; sooriyan ka'ruppuk kampa'liyaippoalak ka'ruththathu; santhiran iraththam poalaayit'ru.
aththimaramaanathu perungkaat'rinaal asaikkappadumpoathu, athin kaayka'l uthiruki'rathupoala, vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'lum poomiyilea vizhunthathu.
vaanamum suruttappatta pusthakam poalaaki vilakippoayit'ru; malaika'l theevuka'l yaavum thangka'l idangka'laivittu akan'rupoayina.

poomiyin raajaakka'lum, periyoarka'lum, aisuvariyavaanka'lum, seanaiththalaivarka'lum, palavaanka'lum, adimaika'l yaavarum, suyaatheenar yaavarum, parvathangka'lin kukaika'lilum kanmalaika'lilum o'liththukko'ndu,

parvathangka'laiyum kanmalaika'laiyum noakki: neengka'l engka'lmeal vizhunthu, singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ravarudaiya mukaththi'rkum, aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya koapaththi'rkum engka'lai ma'raiththukko'l'lungka'l;
avarudaiya koapaakkinaiyin makaanaa'l vanthuvittathu, yaar nilaini'rkakkoodum en'raarka'l.

ivaika'lukkuppinpu, poomiyin naanku thisaika'lilum naanku thootharka'l nin'ru, poomiyinmealaavathu, samuththiraththinmealaavathu, oru maraththinmealaavathu, kaat'ru adiyaathapadikku, poomiyin naanku kaat'ruka'laiyum pidiththirukkakka'ndean.

jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya muththiraik koalaiyudaiya vea'roru thoothan sooriyan uthikkunthisaiyilirunthu ea'rivarakka'ndean; avan, poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum seathappaduththuki'ratha'rku athikaaram pet'ra antha naanku thootharaiyum noakki:

naam namathu theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararin net'rika'lil muththiraipoattuth theeruma'lavum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum marangka'laiyum seathappaduththaathirungka'l en'ru makaa saththamittuk kooppittaan.
muththiraipoadappattavarka'lin thokaiyaich sollakkeattean; israveal puththirarudaiya sakala koaththirangka'lilum muththiraipoadappattavarka'l iladchaththu naa'rpaththu naalaayirampear.

yoothaa koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. roopan koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. kaath koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram.

aasear koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. napthali koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. manaasea koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram.

simiyoan koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. leavi koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. isakkaar koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram.

sepuloan koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. yoaseappu koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram. penyameen koaththiraththil muththiraipoadappattavarka'l panneeraayiram.

ivaika'lukkuppinpu, naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, sakala jaathika'lilum koaththirangka'lilum janangka'lilum paashaikkaararilumirunthu vanthathum, oruvanum e'n'nakkoodaathathumaana thira'laana koottamaakiya janangka'l, ve'l'lai angkika'laith thariththu, thangka'l kaika'lil kuruththoalaika'laip pidiththu, singkaasanaththi'rku munpaakavum aattukkuttiyaanavarukku munpaakavum ni'rkakka'ndean.
avarka'l makaa saththamittu: iradchippin makimai singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ra engka'l theavanukkum aattukkuttiyaanavarukkum u'ndaavathaaka en'ru aarppariththaarka'l.
thootharka'l yaavarum singkaasanaththaiyum moopparka'laiyum naanku jeevanka'laiyum soozhanin'ru, singkaasanaththi'rkumunpaaka mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, theavanaith thozhuthuko'ndu:
aamen, engka'l theavanukkuth thuthiyum makimaiyum gnaanamum sthoaththiramum kanamum vallamaiyum pelanum sathaakaalangka'lilum u'ndaavathaaka; aamen, en'raarka'l.
appozhuthu, moopparka'lil oruvan ennai noakki: ve'l'lai angkika'laith thariththirukki'ra ivarka'l yaar? engkeayirunthu vanthaarka'l? en'ru keattaan.

atha'rku naan: aa'ndavanea, athu umakkea theriyum en'rean. appozhuthu avan: ivarka'l mikuntha upaththiravaththilirunthu vanthavarka'l; ivarka'l thangka'l angkika'lai aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya iraththaththilea thoayththu ve'luththavarka'l.

aanapadiyaal, ivarka'l theavanudaiya singkaasanaththi'rku munpaaka irunthu, iravum pakalum avarudaiya aalayaththilea avaraich seavikki'raarka'l; singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'ravar ivarka'lukku'l'lea vaasamaayiruppaar.
ivarka'l ini pasiyadaivathumillai, ini thaakamadaivathumillai; veyilaavathu ush'namaavathu ivarka'lmeal paduvathumillai.

singkaasanaththin maththiyilirukki'ra aattukkuttiyaanavarea ivarka'lai meayththu, ivarka'lai jeevaththa'n'neeru'l'la oot'ruka'la'ndaikku nadaththuvaar; theavanthaamea ivarka'ludaiya ka'n'neer yaavaiyum thudaippaar en'raan.
avar eazhaam muththiraiyai udaiththapoathu, paraloakaththil ea'rakku'raiya araima'ninearama'lavum amaithal u'ndaayit'ru.
pinpu, theavanukkumunpaaka ni'rki'ra eazhu thootharka'laiyung ka'ndean; avarka'lukku eazhu ekkaa'langka'l kodukkappattathu.

vea'roru thoothanum vanthu, thoopangkaattum po'rkalasaththaip pidiththup palipeedaththin padiyilea nin'raan; singkaasanaththi'rkumunpaaka iruntha po'rpeedaththinmeal sakala parisuththavaanka'ludaiya jepangka'loadum seluththumpadi mikuntha thoopavarkkam avanukkuk kodukkappattathu.
appadiyea parisuththavaanka'ludaiya jepangka'loadum seluththappatta thoopavarkkaththin pukaiyaanathu thoothanudaiya kaiyilirunthu theavanukkumunpaaka ezhumpit'ru.

pinpu, anthath thoothan thoopakalasaththai eduththu, athaip palipeedaththu neruppinaal nirappi, poomiyilea kottinaan; udanea saththangka'lum, idimuzhakkangka'lum, minnalka'lum, poomiyathirchchiyum u'ndaayina.
appozhuthu, eazhu ekkaa'langka'laiyudaiya eazhu thootharka'l ekkaa'lam oothuki'ratha'rkuth thangka'lai aayaththappaduththinaarka'l.

muthalaam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu iraththangkalantha kalmazhaiyum akkiniyum u'ndaaki, poomiyilea kottappattathu; athinaal marangka'lil moon'rilorupangku venthupoayit'ru, pasumpullellaam erinthupoayit'ru.
ira'ndaam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu akkiniyaal eriki'ra periya malaipoan'rathon'ru samuththiraththilea poadappattathu; athinaal samuththiraththil moon'rilorupangku iraththamaayit'ru.
samuththiraththiliruntha jeevanu'l'la sirushdika'lil moon'rilorupangku seththuppoayit'ru; kappalka'lil moon'rilorupangku seathamaayit'ru.

moon'raam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu oru periya nadchaththiram theevattiyaippoala erinthu, vaanaththilirunthu vizhunthathu; athu aa'ruka'lil moon'rilorupangkinmealum, neeroot'ruka'linmealum vizhunthathu.
antha nadchaththiraththi'rku ettiyen'ru peyar; athinaal tha'n'neeril moon'rilorupangku ettiyaippoalak kasappaayit'ru; ippadik kasappaana tha'n'neerinaal manusharil aneakar seththaarka'l.

naankaam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu sooriyanil moon'riloru pangkum, santhiranil moon'rilorupangkum, nadchaththirangka'lil moon'rilorupangkum seathappattathu, avat'ravat'ril moon'rilorupangku iru'ladainthathu; pakalilum moon'rilorupangku pirakaasamillaama'rpoayit'ru, iravilum appadiyeayaayit'ru.

pinpu, oru thoothan vaanaththin maththiyilea pa'ranthuvarakka'ndean; avan makaa saththamittu: ini ekkaa'lam oothappoaki'ra mat'ra moon'ru thootharudaiya ekkaa'lasaththangka'linaal poomiyil kudiyirukki'ravarka'lukku aiyoa, aiyoa, aiyoa, (aapaththuvarum) en'ru sollakkeattean.
ainthaam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu vaanaththilirunthu poomiyinmeal vizhuntha oru nadchaththiraththaik ka'ndean; avanukkup paathaa'lakkuzhiyin thi'ravukoal kodukkappattathu.
avan paathaa'lakkuzhiyaith thi'ranthaan; udanea perugnsoo'laiyin pukaiyaippoala anthak kuzhiyilirunthu pukaiezhumpit'ru; anthak kuzhiyin pukaiyinaal sooriyanum aakaayamum anthakaarappattathu.
anthap pukaiyilirunthu vettukki'lika'l pu'rappattup poomiyinmeal vanthathu; avaika'lukkup poomiyilu'l'la thea'lka'lin vallamaikkoppaana vallamai kodukkappattathu.

poomiyin pullaiyum pasumaiyaana enthap poo'ndaiyum entha maraththaiyum seathappaduththaamal, thangka'l net'rika'lil theavanudaiya muththiraiyaith thariththiraatha manusharaimaaththiram seathappaduththa avaika'lukku uththaravu kodukkappattathu.

mealum avarka'laik kolaiseyyumpadikku avaika'lukku uththaravu kodukkappadaamal, ainthumaathama'lavum avarka'lai veathanaippaduththumpadikku uththaravu kodukkappattathu; avaika'l seyyum veathanai thea'laanathu manusharaik kottumpoathu u'ndaakum veathanaiyaippoalirukkum.
annaadka'lil manusharka'l saavaiththeadiyum athaik kaa'naathiruppaarka'l, saakavea'ndumen'ru aasaippaduvaarka'l, saavoa avarka'lukku vilaki oadippoam.

antha vettukki'lika'lin uruvam yuththaththi'rku aayaththampa'n'nappatta kuthiraika'lukku oppaayirunthathu; avaika'ludaiya thalaika'linmeal ponmayamaana kireedam poan'ravaika'lirunthana; avaika'lin mukangka'l manusharudaiya mukangka'lpoalirunthana.
avaika'ludaiya koonthal sthireeka'ludaiya koonthalpoalirunthathu; avaika'lin pa'rka'l singkangka'lin pa'rka'lpoalirunthana.

iruppuk kavasangka'laippoala maarkkavasangka'l avaika'lukku irunthana; avaika'ludaiya si'rakuka'lin iraichchal yuththaththi'rku oaduki'ra aneakang kuthiraika'l poo'nda irathangka'lin iraichchalukku oppaayirunthana.

avaika'l thea'lka'lin vaalka'lukku oppaana vaalka'laiyum, antha vaalka'lil kodukkuka'laiyum udaiyavaika'laayirunthana; avaika'l ainthu maathama'lavum manusharaich seathappaduththuvatha'rku athikaaram udaiyavaika'laayirunthana.
avaika'lukku oru raajan u'ndu, avan paathaa'laththin thoothan; epireyu paashaiyilea apeththoan en'rum, kireakku paashaiyilea appolliyoan en'rum avanukkup peyar.
muthalaam aapaththu kadanthupoayit'ru; ivaika'lukkuppinpu innum ira'ndu aapaththuka'l, ithoa, varuki'rathu.
aa'raam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu theavanukku munpaaka iruntha po'rpeedaththin naanku kompuka'lilumirunthu oru saththanthoan'ri,
ekkaa'laththaip pidiththiruntha aa'raam thoothanai noakki: aipiraaththennum periya nathiya'ndaiyilea kattappattirukki'ra naanku thootharka'laiyum avizhththuvidu en'ru sollakkeattean.

appozhuthu manusharil moon'rilorupangkaik kollumpadikku oruma'ninearaththi'rkum, oru naa'lukkum, oru maathaththi'rkum, oru varushaththi'rkum aayaththamaakkappattiruntha antha naanku thootharka'lum avizhththuvidappattaarka'l.
kuthiraichseanaika'laakiya iraa'nuvangka'lin thokai irupathu koadiyaayirunthathu; avaika'lin thokaiyaich sollakkeattean.

kuthiraika'laiyum avaika'linmeal ea'riyirunthavarka'laiyum naan tharisanaththil ka'ndavithamaavathu; avarka'l akkinini'ramum neelani'ramum kanthakani'ramumaana maarkkavasangka'laiyudaiyavarka'laayirunthaarka'l; kuthiraika'ludaiya thalaika'l singkangka'lin thalaika'laippoalirunthana; avaika'ludaiya vaayka'lilirunthu akkiniyum pukaiyum kanthakamum pu'rappattana.
avaika'ludaiya vaayka'lilirunthu pu'rappatta akkini pukai kanthakam ennum immoon'rinaalum manusharil moon'rilorupangku kollappattaarka'l.

anthak kuthiraika'lin vallamai avaika'ludaiya vaayileayum vaalka'lileayum irukki'rathu; avaika'ludaiya vaalka'l paampuka'lukku oppaanavaika'laayum, thalaika'lu'l'lavaika'laayumirukki'rathu, avaika'laalea seathappaduththuki'rathu.

appadiyirunthum, antha vaathaika'laal kollappadaatha mat'ra manusharka'l peayka'laiyum, pon ve'l'li sempu kal maram enpavaika'laal seyyappattavaika'laayum kaa'navum keadkavum nadakkavumaattaathavaika'laayumirukki'ra vikkirakangka'laiyum va'nangkaathapadikkuth thangka'l kaika'lin kiriyaika'laivittu mananthirumpavumillai;
thangka'l kolaipaathakangka'laiyum, thangka'l sooniyangka'laiyum, thangka'l veasiththanangka'laiyum, thangka'l ka'lavuka'laiyum vittu mananthirumpavumillai.

pinpu, palamu'l'la vea'roru thoothan vaanaththilirunthi'rangki varakka'ndean; meakam avanaich soozhnthirunthathu, avanudaiya sirasinmeal vaanavillirunthathu, avanudaiya mukam sooriyanaippoalavum, avanudaiya kaalka'l akkini sthampangka'laippoalavum irunthathu.
thi'rakkappatta oru si'ru pusthakam avan kaiyil irunthathu; than valathupaathaththaich samuththiraththinmealum, than idathupaathaththaip poomiyinmealum vaiththu,
singkam kerchchikki'rathupoala makaa saththamaay aarppariththaan; avan aarppariththapoathu eazhu idika'lum saththamittu muzhangkina.

avveazhu idika'lum thangka'l saththangka'lai muzhangkinapoathu, naan ezhuthavea'ndumen'rirunthean. appozhuthu: eazhu idimuzhakkangka'l sonnavaika'lai nee ezhuthaamal muththiraipoadu en'ru vaanaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaakak keattean.
samuththiraththinmealum poomiyinmealum ni'rki'rathaaka naan ka'nda thoothan, than kaiyai vaanaththi'rku nearaaka uyarththi:

ini kaalam sellaathu; aanaalum theavan thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararaakiya theerkkatharisika'lukkuch suviseashamaay a'riviththapadi, eazhaam thoothanudaiya saththaththin naadka'lilea avan ekkaa'lam oothappoaki'rapoathu theavarakasiyam ni'raivea'rum en'ru,

vaanaththaiyum athilu'l'lavaika'laiyum, poomiyaiyum athilu'l'lavaika'laiyum, samuththiraththaiyum athilu'l'lavaika'laiyum sirushdiththavarum, sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'ravarumaanavarmeal aa'naiyittuch sonnaan.

naan vaanaththilirunthu pi'rakkakkeatta saththam ma'rupadiyum ennudanea peasi: samuththiraththinmealum poomiyinmealum ni'rki'ra thoothanudaiya kaiyilirukkum thi'rakkappatta si'ru pusthakaththai nee poay vaangkikko'l en'ru solla,

naan thoothanidaththil poay: anthach si'ru pusthakaththai enakkuth thaarum en'rean. atha'rku avan: nee ithai vaangkip pusi; ithu un vayit'rukkuk kasappaayirukkum, aakilum un vaaykku ithu theanaippoala mathuramaayirukkum en'raan.

naan anthach si'ru pusthakaththaith thoothanudaiya kaiyilirunthu vaangki, athaip pusiththean; en vaaykku athu theanaippoala mathuramaayirunthathu; naan athaip pusiththavudanea en vayi'ru kasappaayit'ru.
appozhuthu avan ennai noakki: nee ma'rupadiyum aneaka janangka'laiyum, jaathika'laiyum, paashaikkaararaiyum, raajaakka'laiyungku'riththuth theerkkatharisanagnsollavea'ndum en'raan.

pinpu kaikkoalukku oppaana oru a'lavukoal ennidaththil kodukkappattathu. appozhuthu theavathoothan nin'ru, ennai noakki: nee ezhunthu, theavanudaiya aalayaththaiyum, palipeedaththaiyum, athil thozhuthuko'l'luki'ravarka'laiyum a'lanthupaar.

aalayaththi'rkup pu'rampea irukki'ra piraakaaram pu'rajaathiyaarukkuk kodukkappattapadiyaal athai a'lavaamal pu'rampaakkippoadu; parisuththa nakaraththai avarka'l naa'rpaththira'ndu maathama'lavum mithippaarka'l.
ennudaiya ira'ndu saadchika'lum irattu vasthiramuduththikko'ndirukki'ravarka'laay, aayiraththirunoot'ra'rupathu naa'la'lavum theerkkatharisanagnsollumpadi avarka'lukku athikaaram koduppean.
pooloakaththin aa'ndavarukkumunpaaka ni'rki'ra ira'ndu olivamarangka'lum ira'ndu vi'lakkuththa'nduka'lum ivarka'lea.

oruvan avarka'laich seathappaduththa manathaayirunthaal, avarka'ludaiya vaayilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'laip padchikkum; avarka'laich seathappaduththa manathaayirukki'ravan evanoa avan appadiyea kollappadavea'ndum.

avarka'l theerkkatharisanagn sollivaruki'ra naadka'lilea mazhaipeyyaathapadikku vaanaththai adaikka avarka'lukku athikaaramu'ndu; avarka'l tha'n'neerka'lai iraththamaaka maat'ravum, thangka'lukku vea'ndumpoathellaam poomiyaich sakalavitha vaathaika'laalum vaathikkavum avarka'lukku athikaaramu'ndu.
avarka'l thangka'l saadchiyaich solli mudiththirukkumpoathu, paathaa'laththilirunthea'ruki'ra mirukam avarka'loadea yuththampa'n'ni, avarka'lai jeyiththu, avarka'laik kon'rupoadum.

avarka'ludaiya udalka'l makaa nakaraththin visaalamaana veethiyilea kidakkum. antha nakaram soathoam en'rum ekipthu en'rum gnaanaarththamaaych sollappadum; athilea nammudaiya karththarum siluvaiyilea a'raiyappattaar.

janangka'lilum, koaththirangka'lilum, paashaikkaararilum, jaathika'lilumu'l'lavarka'l avarka'ludaiya udalka'lai moon'rarai naa'lvaraikkum paarppaarka'l, avarka'ludaiya udalka'laik kalla'raika'lil vaikkavottaarka'l.

avvira'ndu theerkkatharisika'lum poomiyin kudika'lai veathanaippaduththinapadiyaal avarka'l nimiththam poomiyil kudiyirukki'ravarka'l santhoashappattuk ka'likoornthu, oruvarukkoruvar vekumathika'lai anuppuvaarka'l.

moon'rarai naa'laikkuppinpu theavanidaththilirunthu jeevaaavi avarka'lukku'l piraveasiththathu, appozhuthu avarka'l kaaloon'ri nin'raarka'l; avarka'laip paarththavarka'lukku mikuntha payamu'ndaayit'ru.

ingkea ea'rivaarungka'l en'ru vaanaththilirunthu thangka'lukku u'ndaana periya saththaththai avarka'l keattu, meakaththil ea'ri vaanaththi'rkup poanaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya saththurukka'l avarka'laip paarththaarka'l.

annearaththilea poomi mikavum athirnthathu, udanea antha nakaraththil paththilorupangku idinthu vizhunthathu; manusharil eazhaayirampear poomiyathirchchiyinaal azhinthaarka'l; meethiyaanavarka'l payamadainthu paraloakaththin theavanai makimaippaduththinaarka'l.
ira'ndaam aapaththu kadanthupoayit'ru; ithoa, moon'raam aapaththu seekkiramaay varuki'rathu.

eazhaam thoothan ekkaa'lam oothinaan; appozhuthu ulakaththin raajyangka'l nammudaiya karththarukkum, avarudaiya ki'risthuvukkumuriya raajyangka'laayina; avar sathaakaalangka'lilum raajyapaaram pa'n'nuvaar ennum kempeera saththangka'l vaanaththil u'ndaayina.
appozhuthu theavanukku munpaakath thangka'l singkaasanangka'lmeal udkaarnthiruntha irupaththunaanku moopparka'lum mukangkuppu'ra vizhunthu:
irukki'ravarum irunthavarum varuki'ravarumaakiya sarvavallamaiyu'l'la karththaraakiya theavanea, ummai sthoaththirikki'roam; theavareer umathu makaa vallamaiyaikko'ndu raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'reer.

jaathika'l koapiththaarka'l, appozhuthu ummudaiya koapam moo'ndathu; mariththoar niyaayaththeerppadaiki'ratha'rkum, theerkkatharisika'laakiya ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkum parisuththavaanka'lukkum umathu naamaththinmeal payapakthiyaayiruntha si'riyoar periyoarukkum palana'likki'ratha'rkum, poomiyaik keduththavarka'laik kedukki'ratha'rkum, kaalam vanthathu en'ru solli, theavanaith thozhuthuko'ndaarka'l.

appozhuthu paraloakaththil theavanudaiya aalayam thi'rakkappattathu, avarudaiya aalayaththilea avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyin petti kaa'nappattathu; appozhuthu minnalka'lum, saththangka'lum, idimuzhakkangka'lum, poomiyathirchchiyum, perungkalmazhaiyum u'ndaayina.

an'riyum oru periya adaiyaa'lam vaanaththilea kaa'nappattathu; oru sthiree sooriyanai a'ninthirunthaa'l, ava'l paathangka'lin keezhea santhiranum, ava'l sirasinmeal pannira'ndu nadchaththirangka'lu'l'la kireedamum irunthana.
ava'l karppavathiyaayirunthu, pirasavaveathanaiyadainthu, pi'l'laipe'rumpadi varuththappattu ala'rinaa'l.
appozhuthu vea'roru adaiyaa'lam vaanaththilea kaa'nappattathu; eazhu thalaika'laiyum, paththuk kompuka'laiyum, than thalaika'linmeal eazhu mudika'laiyumudaiya sivappaana periya valusarppamirunthathu.

athin vaal vaanaththin nadchaththirangka'lil moon'rilorupangkai izhuththu, avaika'laip poomiyil vizhaththa'l'lit'ru; pirasavaveathanaippaduki'ra antha sthiree pi'l'lai pet'ravudanea, ava'ludaiya pi'l'laiyaip padchiththuppoadumpadikku antha valusarppam ava'lukku munpaaka nin'rathu.
sakala jaathika'laiyum iruppukkoalaal aa'lukaiseyyum aa'npi'l'laiyai ava'l pet'raa'l; ava'ludaiya pi'l'lai theavanidaththi'rkum avarudaiya singkaasanaththinidaththi'rkum eduththukko'l'lappattathu.
sthireeyaanava'l vanaantharaththi'rku oadippoanaa'l; angkea aayiraththirunoot'ra'rupathunaa'la'lavum ava'laip poashippatha'rkaakath theavanaal aayaththamaakkappatta idam ava'lukku u'ndaayirunthathu.

vaanaththilea yuththamu'ndaayit'ru; mikaavealum avanaich searntha thootharka'lum valusarppaththoadea yuththampa'n'ninaarka'l; valusarppamum athaichsearntha thootharum yuththampa'n'niyum jeyangko'l'lavillai.
vaanaththil avarka'l iruntha idamum kaa'nappadaama'rpoayit'ru.

ulakamanaiththaiyum moasampoakkuki'ra pisaasu en'rum saaththaan en'rum sollappatta pazhaiya paampaakiya periya valusarppam tha'l'lappattathu; athu poomiyilea vizhaththa'l'lappattathu, athanoadeakooda athaichsearntha thootharum tha'l'lappattaarka'l.

appozhuthu vaanaththilea oru periya saththamu'ndaaki: ippozhuthu iradchippum vallamaiyum namathu theavanudaiya raajyamum, avarudaiya ki'risthuvin athikaaramum u'ndaayirukki'rathu; iravum pakalum nammudaiya theavanukku munpaaka nammudaiya sakoathararmeal kut'ragn sumaththumporuttu avarka'lmeal kut'ragnsaattuki'ravan thaazhath tha'l'lappattuppoanaan.
mara'nam neariduki'rathaayirunthaalum atha'rkuth thappumpadi thangka'l jeevanaiyum paaraamal, aattukkuttiyin iraththaththinaalum thangka'l saadchiyin vasanaththinaalum avanai jeyiththaarka'l.

aakaiyaal paraloakangka'lea! avaika'lil vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'lea! ka'likoorungka'l. poomiyilum samuththiraththilum kudiyirukki'ravarka'lea! aiyoa, pisaasaanavan thanakkuk kognchakkaalamaaththiram u'nden'ru a'rinthu, mikuntha koapangko'ndu, ungka'lidaththil i'rangkinapadiyaal, ungka'lukku aapaththuvarum en'ru sollakkeattean.
valusarppamaanathu thaan poomiyilea tha'l'lappattathai a'rinthu, antha aa'npi'l'laiyaippet'ra sthireeyaith thunpappaduththinathu.

sthireeyaanava'l anthap paampin mukaththi'rku vilaki, oru kaalamum, kaalangka'lum, araikkaalamumaakap poashikkappadaththakkathaay vanaantharaththilu'l'la than idaththi'rkup pa'ranthupoakumpadi perungkazhukin ira'ndu si'rakuka'l ava'lukkuk kodukkappattathu.
appozhuthu antha sthireeyai ve'l'langko'ndupoakumpadikkup paampaanathu than vaayilirunthu oru nathipoan'ra ve'l'laththai ava'lukkup pinnaaka oot'rivittathu.
poomiyaanathu sthireekku uthaviyaakath than vaayaith thi'ranthu, valusarppam than vaayilirunthu oot'rina ve'l'laththai vizhungkinathu.

appozhuthu valusarppamaanathu sthireeyinmeal koapangko'ndu, theavanudaiya ka'rpanaika'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'lum, iyeasuki'risthuvaikku'riththuch saadchiyai udaiyavarka'lumaakiya ava'ludaiya santhathiyaana mat'ravarka'ludanea yuththampa'n'nappoayit'ru.

pinpu naan kada'rkarai ma'nalinmeal nin'rean. appozhuthu samuththiraththilirunthu oru mirukam ezhumpivarak ka'ndean; atha'rku eazhu thalaika'lum paththuk kompuka'lum irunthana; athin kompuka'linmeal paththu mudika'lum, athin thalaika'linmeal thoosha'namaana naamamum irunthana.

naan ka'nda mirukam si'ruththaiyaippoalirunthathu; athin kaalka'l karadiyin kaalka'laippoalavum, athin vaay singkaththin vaayaippoalavum irunthana; valusarppamaanathu than palaththaiyum than singkaasanaththaiyum mikuntha athikaaraththaiyum atha'rkuk koduththathu.

athin thalaika'lilon'ru saavukkeathuvaayk kaayappattirukkak ka'ndean; aanaalum saavukkeathuvaana anthak kaayam sosthamaakkappattathu. poomiyilu'l'la yaavarum aachchariyaththoadea antha mirukaththaip pinpat'ri,

antha mirukaththi'rku appadippatta athikaarangkoduththa valusarppaththai va'nangkinaarka'l. allaamalum: mirukaththi'rku oppaanavan yaar? athinoadea yuththampa'n'naththakkavan yaar? en'ru solli, mirukaththaiyum va'nangkinaarka'l.
perumaiyaanavaika'laiyum thoosha'nangka'laiyum peasum vaay atha'rkuk kodukkappattathu; allaamalum, naa'rpaththira'ndu maatham yuththampa'n'na atha'rku athikaarang kodukkappattathu.
athu theavanaith thooshikkumpadi than vaayaith thi'ranthu, avarudaiya naamaththaiyum, avarudaiya vaasasthalaththaiyum, paraloakaththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarka'laiyum thooshiththathu.

mealum, parisuththavaanka'loadea yuththampa'n'ni avarka'lai jeyikkumpadikku atha'rku athikaarangkodukkappattathumallaamal, ovvoru koaththiraththinmealum paashaikkaararmealum jaathika'lmealum atha'rku athikaarangkodukkappattathu.
ulakaththoat'ramuthal adikkappatta aattukkuttiyinudaiya jeevapusthakaththil pearezhuthappattiraatha poomiyin kudika'l yaavarum athai va'nangkuvaarka'l.
kaathu'l'lavanevanoa avan keadkakkadavan.

si'raippaduththikko'ndu poaki'ravan si'raippattuppoavaan; pattayaththinaalea kolluki'ravan pattayaththinaalea kollappadavea'ndum. parisuththavaanka'ludaiya po'rumaiyum visuvaasamum ithilea vi'langkum.
pinpu, vea'roru mirukam poomiyilirunthu ezhumpak ka'ndean; athu oru aattukkuttikku oppaaka ira'ndu kompuka'laiyudaiyathaayirunthu, valusarppaththaippoalap peasinathu.

athu munthina mirukaththin athikaaram muzhuvathaiyum athin munpaaka nadappiththu, saavukkeathuvaana kaayam aa'rach sosthamadaintha munthina mirukaththaip poomiyum athin kudika'lum va'nangkumpadi seythathu.
an'riyum, athu manusharukkumunpaaka vaanaththilirunthu poomiyinmeal akkiniyai i'rangkappa'n'naththakkathaakap periya a'rputhangka'lai nadappiththu,

mirukaththinmunpaaka antha a'rputhangka'laich seyyumpadi thanakkuk kodukkappatta saththuvaththinaalea poomiyin kudika'lai moasampoakki, pattayaththinaalea kaayappattup pizhaiththa mirukaththi'rku oru soroopam pa'n'navea'ndumen'ru poomiyin kudika'lukkuch sollit'ru.

mealum ammirukaththin soroopam peasaththakkathaakavum, mirukaththin soroopaththai va'nangkaatha yaavaraiyum kolaiseyyaththakkathaakavum, mirukaththin soroopaththi'rku aaviyaik kodukkumpadi atha'rkuch saththuvangkodukkappattathu.

athu si'riyoar, periyoar, aisuvariyavaanka'l, thariththirar, suyaatheenar, adimaika'l, ivarka'l yaavarum thangka'l thangka'l valathukaika'lilaavathu net'rika'lilaavathu oru muththiraiyaip pe'rumpadikkum,

antha mirukaththin muththiraiyaiyaavathu athin naamaththaiyaavathu athin naamaththin ilakkaththaiyaavathu thariththukko'l'luki'ravan thavira vea'roruvanum ko'l'lavum vi'rkavung koodaathapadikkum seythathu.
ithilea gnaanam vi'langkum; antha mirukaththin ilakkaththaip puththiyudaiyavan ka'nakkuppaarkkakkadavan; athu manushanudaiya ilakkamaayirukki'rathu; athinudaiya ilakkam a'runoot'ra'rupaththaa'ru.

pinpu naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, seeyoan malaiyinmeal aattukkuttiyaanavaraiyum, avaroadeakooda avarudaiya pithaavin naamam thangka'l net'rika'lil ezhuthappattiruntha iladchaththu naa'rpaththu naalaayirampearaiyum ni'rkakka'ndean.

allaamalum, peruve'l'la iraichchalpoalavum, palaththa idimuzhakkampoalavum, oru saththam vaanaththilirunthu u'ndaakakkeattean; naan keatta saththam surama'ndalakkaarar thangka'l surama'ndalangka'lai vaasikki'ra oasaiyaippoalirunthathu.

avarka'l singkaasanaththi'rku munpaakavum, naanku jeevanka'lukku munpaakavum, moopparka'lukku munpaakavum puthuppaattaip paadinaarka'l; anthap paattu poomiyilirunthu meettukko'l'lappatta iladchaththu naa'rpaththunaalaayiram peareayallaamal vea'roruvarum kat'rukko'l'lak koodaathirunthathu.

sthireeka'laal thangka'laik ka'raippaduththaathavarka'l ivarka'lea; ka'rpu'l'lavarka'l ivarka'lea; aattukkuttiyaanavar engkea poanaalum avaraip pinpat'ruki'ravarka'l ivarka'lea; ivarka'l manusharilirunthu theavanukkum aattukkuttiyaanavarukkum mutha'rpalanaaka meettukko'l'lappattavarka'l.
ivarka'ludaiya vaayilea kapadam kaa'nappadavillai; ivarka'l theavanudaiya singkaasanaththi'rkumunpaaka maasillaathavarka'laayirukki'raarka'l.

pinpu, vea'roru thoothan vaanaththin maththiyilea pa'rakkakka'ndean; avan poomiyil vaasampa'n'nuki'ra sakala jaathika'lukkum, koaththiraththaarukkum, paashaikkaararukkum, janakkoottaththaarukkum a'rivikkaththakkathaaka niththiya suviseashaththai udaiyavanaayirunthu,

mikuntha saththamittu: theavanukkup payanthu, avarai makimaippaduththungka'l; avar niyaayaththeerppukkodukkum vea'lai vanthathu; vaanaththaiyum poomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum neeroot'ruka'laiyum u'ndaakkinavaraiyea thozhuthuko'l'lungka'l en'ru koo'rinaan.
vea'roru thoothan pinsen'ru: paapiloan makaa nakaram vizhunthathu! vizhunthathu! than veasiththanamaakiya ukkiramaana mathuvaich sakala jaathika'lukkum kudikkak koduththaa'lea! en'raan.

avarka'lukkup pinnea moon'raam thoothan vanthu, mikuntha saththamittu: mirukaththaiyum athin soroopaththaiyum va'nangkith than net'riyilaavathu than kaiyilaavathu athin muththiraiyaith thariththukko'l'luki'ravanevanoa,

avan theavanudaiya koapaakkinaiyaakiya paaththiraththilea kalappillaamal vaarkkappatta avarudaiya ukkiramaakiya mathuvaik kudiththu, parisuththa thootharka'lukkumunpaakavum, aattukkuttiyaanavarukkumunpaakavum akkiniyinaalum kanthakaththinaalum vaathikkappaduvaan.

avarka'ludaiya vaathaiyin pukai sathaakaalangka'lilum ezhumpum; mirukaththaiyum athin soroopaththaiyum va'nangkuki'ravarka'lukkum, athinudaiya naamaththin muththiraiyaith thariththukko'l'luki'ra evanukkum iravum pakalum i'laippaa'ruthaliraathu.
theavanudaiya ka'rpanaika'laiyum iyeasuvin mealu'l'la visuvaasaththaiyum kaaththukko'l'luki'ravarka'laakiya parisuththavaanka'ludaiya po'rumai ithilea vi'langkum en'ru koo'rinaan.

pinpu, paraloakaththilirunthu oru saththam u'ndaakak keattean; athu: karththarukku'l marikki'ravarka'l ithumuthal paakkiyavaanka'l en'rezhuthu; avarka'l thangka'l pirayaasangka'lai vittozhinthu i'laippaa'ruvaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya kiriyaika'l avarka'loadea koodappoam; aaviyaanavarum aam en'ru thiruvu'lampat'ruki'raar en'ru sollit'ru.

pinpu naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, ve'nmaiyaana meakaththaiyum, antha meakaththinmeal manushakumaaranukkoppaanavaraayth thamathu sirasinmeal po'rkireedaththaiyum thamathu kaiyilea karukku'l'la arivaa'laiyumudaiya oruvar udkaarnthirukki'rathaiyum ka'ndean.

appozhuthu vea'roru thoothan theavaalayaththilirunthu pu'rappattu, meakaththinmeal udkaarnthirukki'ravarai noakki: poomiyin payir muthirnthathu, a'rukki'ratha'rkuk kaalam vanthathu, aakaiyaal ummudaiya arivaa'lai neetti a'ruththuvidum en'ru mikuntha saththamittuch sonnaan.
appozhuthu meakaththinmeal udkaarnthavar thamathu arivaa'laip poomiyinmeal neettinaar, poomiyin vi'laivu a'ruppu'ndathu.
pinpu vea'roru thoothanum karukku'l'la arivaa'laip pidiththukko'ndu paraloakaththilu'l'la theavaalayaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthaan.

akkiniyinmeal athikaaramu'l'la vea'roru thoothanum palipeedaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthu, karukku'l'la arivaa'laip pidiththirukki'ravanai noakki: poomiyin thiraadchappazhangka'l pazhuththirukki'rathu, karukku'l'la umathu arivaa'lai neetti, athin kulaika'lai a'ruththuvidum en'ru mikuntha saththaththoadea sonnaan.
appozhuthu anthath thoothan than arivaa'laip poomiyinmealea neetti, poomiyin thiraadchappazhangka'lai a'ruththu, theavanudaiya koapaakkinaiyennum periya aalaiyilea poattaan.

nakaraththi'rkup pu'rampeayu'l'la antha aalaiyilea athu mithikkappattathu; antha aalaiyilirunthu aayiraththa'runoo'ru sthaathi thooraththi'rku iraththam pu'rappattuk kuthiraika'lin kadivaa'langka'lmattum perukivanthathu.
pinpu, vaanaththilea perithum aachchariyamumaana vea'roru adaiyaa'lamaakiya kadaisiyaana eazhu vaathaika'laiyudaiya eazhu thootharaik ka'ndean, avaika'laal theavanudaiya koapam mudiki'rathu.

an'riyum, akkinikalantha ka'n'naadik kadalpoan'ra oru kadalaiyum, mirukaththi'rkum athin soroopaththi'rkum athin muththiraikkum athin naamaththin ilakkaththi'rkum u'l'laakaamal jeyangko'ndavarka'l theava surama'ndalangka'laip pidiththukko'ndu anthak ka'n'naadik kadalarukea ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndean.

avarka'l theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaaranaakiya moaseayin paattaiyum aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya paattaiyum paadi: sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththaavea, theavareerudaiya kiriyaika'l makaththuvamum aachchariyamumaanavaika'l; parisuththavaanka'lin raajaavea, theavareerudaiya vazhika'l neethiyum saththiyamumaanavaika'l.

karththaavea, yaar umakkup payappadaamalum, umathu naamaththai makimaippaduththaamalum irukkalaam? theavareer oruvarea parisuththar, ellaa jaathika'lum vanthu umakku munpaakath thozhuthuko'lvaarka'l; ummudaiya neethiyaana seyalka'l ve'liyarangkamaayina en'raarka'l.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, naan paarththapoathu, ithoa, paraloakaththilea saadchiyin koodaaramaakiya aalayam thi'rakkappattathu;
antha aalayaththilirunthu eazhu vaathaika'laiyudaiya avveazhu thootharka'lum suththamum pirakaasamumaana melliya vasthiranthariththu, maarparukea po'rkachchaika'laik kattikko'ndu pu'rappattaarka'l.
appozhuthu antha naanku jeevanka'lil on'ru, sathaakaalangka'lilum uyiroadirukki'ra theavanudaiya koapaakkinaiyaal ni'raintha po'rkalasangka'l eazhaiyum antha eazhu thootharka'lukkung koduththathu.

appozhuthu, theavanudaiya makimaiyinaalum avarudaiya vallamaiyinaalum u'ndaana pukaiyinaalea theavaalayam ni'rainthathu; eazhu thootharka'ludaiya eazhu vaathaika'lum mudiyumvaraikkum oruvarum theavaalayaththi'rku'l piraveasikkak koodaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu theavaalayaththilirunthu u'ndaana oru perugnsaththam antha eazhu thootharudanea: neengka'l poayth theavanudaiya koapakalasangka'laip poomiyinmeal oot'rungka'l en'ru sollakkeattean.

muthalaam thoothan poay, than kalasaththilu'l'lathaip poomiyinmeal oot'rinaan; udanea mirukaththin muththiraiyaith thariththavarka'lum athin soroopaththai va'nangkuki'ravarka'lumaakiya manusharka'lukkup pollaatha kodiya pu'n'nu'ndaayit'ru.
ira'ndaam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathaich samuththiraththilea oot'rinaan; udanea athu seththavanudaiya iraththam poalaayit'ru; samuththiraththilu'l'la piraa'nika'l yaavum maa'ndupoayina.
moon'raam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathai aa'ruka'lilum, neeroot'ruka'lilum oot'rinaan; udanea avaika'l iraththamaayina.
appozhuthu tha'n'neerka'lin thoothan: irukki'ravarum irunthavarum parisuththarumaakiya theavareer ippadi niyaayantheerkka neethiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'reer.

avarka'l parisuththavaanka'ludaiya iraththaththaiyum theerkkatharisika'ludaiya iraththaththaiyum sinthinapadiyinaal, iraththaththaiyea avarka'lukkuk kudikkakkoduththeer; atha'rkup paaththiraraayirukki'raarka'l en'ru sollakkeattean.
palipeedaththilirunthu vea'roruvan: aam, sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththaavea, ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l saththiyamum neethiyumaanavaika'l en'ru sollakkeattean.
naankaam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathaich sooriyanmeal oot'rinaan; theeyinaal manusharaith thakikkumpadi atha'rku athikaarang kodukkappattathu.

appozhuthu manusharka'l mikuntha ush'naththinaalea thakikkappattu, intha vaathaika'laich seyya athikaaramu'l'la theavanudaiya naamaththaith thooshiththaarka'leayallaamal, avarai makimaippaduththa mananthirumpavillai.

ainthaam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathai mirukaththinudaiya singkaasanaththinmeal oot'rinaan; appozhuthu athin raajyam iru'ladainthathu; avarka'l varuththaththinaalea thangka'l naavuka'laik kadiththukko'ndu,
thangka'l varuththangka'laalum, thangka'l pu'nka'laalum, paraloakaththin theavanaith thooshiththaarka'leayallaamal, thangka'l kiriyaika'lai vittu mananthirumpavillai.

aa'raam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathai aipiraath ennum periya nathiyinmeal oot'rinaan; appozhuthu sooriyan uthikkun thisaiyilirunthuvarum raajaakka'lukku vazhi aayaththamaakumpadi antha nathiyin tha'n'neer vat'rippoayit'ru.
appozhuthu, valusarppaththin vaayilum mirukaththin vaayilum ka'l'laththeerkkatharisiyin vaayilumirunthu thava'laika'lukku oppaana moon'ru asuththa aavika'l pu'rappattuvarak ka'ndean.

avaika'l a'rputhangka'laich seyki'ra pisaasuka'lin aavika'l; avaika'l pooloakamengkumu'l'la raajaakka'laich sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanudaiya makaanaa'lil nadakkum yuththaththi'rkuk koottichsearkkumpadikkup pu'rappattuppoaki'rathu.
ithoa, thirudanaippoal varuki'rean. than maanam kaa'nappadaththakkathaaka nirvaa'namaay nadavaathapadikku vizhiththukko'ndu, than vasthirangka'laik kaaththukko'l'luki'ravan paakkiyavaan.
appozhuthu epireyu paashaiyilea armakethoan ennappatta idaththilea avarka'laik koottich searththaan.
eazhaam thoothan than kalasaththilu'l'lathai aakaayaththil oot'rinaan; appozhuthu paraloakaththin aalayaththilu'l'la singkaasanaththilirunthu: aayit'ru en'ru solliya perugnsaththam pi'ranthathu.
saththangka'lum idimuzhakkangka'lum minnalka'lum u'ndaayina; poomi mikavum athirnthathu, poomiyinmeal manusharka'l u'ndaana naa'lmutha'rko'ndu appadippatta periya athirchchiyu'ndaanathillai.

appozhuthu makaa nakaram moon'ru pangkaakap pirikkappattathu, pu'rajaathika'ludaiya patta'nangka'l vizhunthana. makaa paapiloanukkuth theavanudaiya ukkiramaana koapaakkinaiyaakiya mathuvu'l'la paaththiraththaik kodukkumpadi athu avarukku munpaaka ninaippoottappattathu.
theevuka'l yaavum akan'rupoayina; parvathangka'l kaa'nappadaama'rpoayina.

thaalanthu ni'raiyaana periya kalmazhaiyum vaanaththilirunthu manusharmeal vizhunthathu; anthak kalmazhaiyinaal u'ndaana vaathaiyinimiththam manusharka'l theavanaith thooshiththaarka'l; antha vaathai makaa kodithaayirunthathu.

eazhu kalasangka'laiyudaiya antha eazhu thootharil oruvan vanthu ennoadea peasi: nee vaa, thira'laana tha'n'neerka'lmeal udkaarnthirukki'ra makaa veasiyoadea poomiyin raajaakka'l veasiththanampa'n'ninaarka'lea, ava'ludaiya veasiththanamaakiya mathuvaal poomiyin kudika'lum ve'riko'ndirunthaarka'lea;
ava'lukku varuki'ra aakkinaiyai unakkuk kaa'npippean en'ru solli;

aavikku'l ennai vanaantharaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaan. appozhuthu eazhu thalaika'laiyum paththuk kompuka'laiyum udaiyathum thoosha'namaana naamangka'laal ni'rainthathumaana sivappuni'ramu'l'la mirukaththinmeal oru sthiree ea'riyirukkakka'ndean.

antha sthiree iraththaamparamum sivappaana aadaiyunthariththu, ponninaalum iraththinangka'linaalum muththukka'linaalum singkaarikkappattu, than veasiththanamaakiya aruvaruppuka'laalum asuththaththaalum ni'raintha po'rpaaththiraththaith than kaiyilea pidiththirunthaa'l.
mealum, irakasiyam, makaa paapiloan, veasika'lukkum poomiyilu'l'la aruvaruppuka'lukkum thaay ennum naamam ava'l net'riyil ezhuthiyirunthathu.
antha sthiree parisuththavaanka'lin iraththaththinaalum, iyeasuvinudaiya saadchika'lin iraththaththinaalum ve'riko'ndirukki'rathaik ka'ndean; ava'laik ka'ndu naan mikavum aachchariyappattean.

appozhuthu, thoothanaanavan ennai noakki: ean aachchariyappaduki'raay? intha sthireeyinudaiya irakasiyaththaiyum, eazhu thalaika'laiyum paththuk kompuka'laiyumudaiyathaay iva'laich sumakki'ra mirukaththinudaiya irakasiyaththaiyum unakkuch solluki'rean.

nee ka'nda mirukam munnea irunthathu, ippozhuthu illai; athu paathaa'laththilirunthu ea'rivanthu, naasamadaiyappoaki'rathu. ulakaththoat'ramuthal jeevapusthakaththil pearezhuthappattiraatha poomiyin kudika'l, irunthathum, iraama'rpoanathum, ini iruppathumaayirukki'ra mirukaththaippaarththu aachchariyappaduvaarka'l.
gnaanamu'l'la manam ithilea vi'langkum. antha eazhu thalaika'lum antha sthiree udkaarnthirukki'ra eazhu malaika'laam.
avaika'l eazhu raajaakka'laam; ivarka'lil ainthupear vizhunthaarka'l, oruvan irukki'raan, mat'ravan innum varavillai; varumpoathu avan kognchakkaalam thariththirukkavea'ndum.
irunthathum iraathathumaakiya mirukamea ettaavathaanavanum, avveazhilirunthu thoan'ruki'ravanum, naasamadaiyappoaki'ravanumaayirukki'raan.

nee ka'nda paththuk kompuka'lum paththu raajaakka'laam; ivarka'l innum raajyam pe'ravillai; ivarka'l mirukaththudaneakooda oruma'ni nearama'lavum raajaakka'lpoala athikaaram pet'rukko'l'luki'raarka'l.
ivarka'l orea yoasanaiyu'l'lavarka'l; ivarka'l thangka'l vallamaiyaiyum athikaaraththaiyum mirukaththi'rkuk koduppaarka'l.

ivarka'l aattukkuttiyaanavarudanea yuththampa'n'nuvaarka'l; aattukkuttiyaanavar karththaathi karththarum raajaathi raajaavumaayirukki'rapadiyaal avarka'lai jeyippaar; avaroadukooda irukki'ravarka'l azhaikkappattavarka'lum therinthuko'l'lappattavarka'lum u'nmaiyu'l'lavarka'lumaayirukki'raarka'l en'raan.
pinnum avan ennai noakki: antha veasi udkaarnthirukki'ra tha'n'neerka'laik ka'ndaayea; avaika'l janangka'lum koottangka'lum jaathika'lum paashaikkaararumaam.

nee mirukaththinmeal ka'nda paththuk kompuka'laanavarka'l antha veasiyaip pakaiththu, ava'laip paazhum nirvaa'namumaakki, ava'ludaiya maamsaththaip padchiththu, ava'lai neruppinaal sutteriththuppoaduvaarka'l.

theavan thammudaiya vaarththaika'l ni'raivea'ruma'lavum, avarka'l thamathu yoasanaiyai ni'raiveat'ruki'ratha'rkum, orea yoasanaiyu'l'lavarka'laayirunthu, thangka'l raajyaththai mirukaththi'rkuk kodukki'ratha'rkum avarka'ludaiya iruthayangka'lai eavinaar.
nee ka'nda sthireeyaanava'l poomiyin raajaakka'lmeal raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'ra makaa nakarameayaam en'raan.
ivaika'lukkuppinpu, vea'roru thoothan mikuntha athikaaramudaiyavanaay, vaanaththilirunthi'rangki varakka'ndean; avanudaiya makimaiyinaal poomi pirakaasamaayit'ru.

avan palaththa saththamittu: makaa paapiloan vizhunthathu! vizhunthathu! athu peayka'ludaiya kudiyiruppum, sakalavitha asuththaaavika'ludaiya kaavalveedum, asuththamum aruvaruppumu'l'la sakalavitha pa'ravaika'ludaiya koodumaayit'ru.

ava'ludaiya veasiththanaththin ukkiramaana mathuvai ellaa jaathika'lum kudiththaarka'l; poomiyin raajaakka'l ava'loadea veasiththanampa'n'ninaarka'l; poomiyin varththakar ava'ludaiya selvachserukkin mikuthiyinaal aisuvariyavaanka'laanaarka'l en'ru vi'lampinaan.

pinpu, vea'roru saththam vaanaththilirunthu u'ndaakak keattean. athu: en janangka'lea, neengka'l ava'ludaiya paavangka'lukku udanpadaamalum, ava'lukku nearidum vaathaika'lil akappadaamalum irukkumpadikku ava'laivittu ve'liyea vaarungka'l.
ava'ludaiya paavam vaanapariyantham ettinathu, ava'ludaiya aniyaayangka'laith theavan ninaivukoornthaar.

ava'l ungka'lukkup palana'liththathupoala neengka'lum ava'lukkup palana'liyungka'l; ava'ludaiya kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaaka ava'lukku irattippaakak koduththuth theerungka'l; ava'l ungka'lukkuk kalanthukoduththa paaththiraththilea irattippaaka ava'lukkuk kalanthukodungka'l.

ava'l thannai makimaippaduththi, selvachserukkaay vaazhnthathevva'lavoa avva'lavaay vaathaiyaiyum thukkaththaiyum ava'lukkuk kodungka'l. naan raajasthireeyaay veet'rirukki'rean; naan kaimpe'n'nalla, naan thukkaththaik kaa'npathillaiyen'ru ava'l than iruthayaththilea e'n'ninaa'l.

aakaiyaal ava'lukku varum vaathaika'laakiya saavum thukkamum pagnchamum oreanaa'lilea varum; ava'l akkiniyinaalea sutterikkappaduvaa'l; ava'lukku niyaayaththeerppuk kodukkum theavanaakiya karththar vallamaiyu'l'lavar.
ava'ludanea veasiththanagnseythu selvachserukkaay vaazhntha poomiyin raajaakka'lum ava'l veaki'rathinaal u'ndaana pukaiyaik kaa'numpoathu ava'lukkaaka azhuthu pulampi,
ava'lukku u'ndaana vaathaiyinaal payanthu, thooraththilea nin'ru: aiyaiyoa! paapiloan, makaa nakaramea! palamaana patta'namea! orea naazhikaiyil unakku aakkinai vanthathea! enpaarka'l.

poomiyin varththakarka'lum thangka'l thangka'l sarakkuka'laakiya ponnaiyum, ve'l'liyaiyum, iraththinangka'laiyum, muththukka'laiyum, sallaavaiyum, iraththaamparaththaiyum, pattaadaika'laiyum, sivappaadaika'laiyum,

sakalavitha vaasanaik kattaika'laiyum, thanthaththinaal seythirukki'ra sakalavitha vasthukka'laiyum, vilaiyuyarntha maraththinaalum ve'nkalaththinaalum irumpinaalum ve'l'laik kallinaalum seythirukki'ra sakalavitha vasthukka'laiyum,

ilavangkappattaiyaiyum, thoopavarkkangka'laiyum, thailangka'laiyum, saampiraa'niyaiyum, thiraadcharasaththaiyum, e'n'neyaiyum, melliya maavaiyum, koathumaiyaiyum, maaduka'laiyum, aaduka'laiyum, kuthiraika'laiyum, irathangka'laiyum, adimaika'laiyum, manusharudaiya aaththumaakka'laiyum inik ko'lvaarillaathapadiyaal, ava'lukkaaka azhuthu pulampuvaarka'l.
un aaththumaa ichchiththa pazhavarkkangka'l unnaivittu neengkippoayina; kozhumaiyaanavaika'lum sampiramamaanavaika'lum unnaivittu neengkippoayina; nee avaika'lai inik kaa'npathillai.
ippadippattavaika'laik ko'ndu varththakampa'n'ni, ava'laal aisuvariyavaanka'laanavarka'l ava'lukku u'ndaana vaathaiyinaal payanthu, thooraththilea nin'ru;

aiyaiyoa! sallaavum iraththaamparamum sivappaadaiyum thariththu, ponninaalum iraththinangka'linaalum muththukka'linaalum singkaarikkappattiruntha makaa nakaramea! oru naazhikaiyilea ivva'lavu aisuvariyamum azhinthupoayit'rea! en'ru solli, azhuthu thukkippaarka'l.
maalumika'l yaavarum, kappalka'lil yaaththirai pa'n'nuki'ravarka'l yaavarum, kappalaadka'lum, samuththiraththilea thozhilseyki'ra yaavarum thooraththilea nin'ru,
ava'l veaki'rathinaal u'ndaana pukaiyaip paarththu: intha makaa nakaraththi'rkoppaana nakaram u'ndoa en'ru saththamittu,

thangka'l thalaika'lmeal puzhuthiyaippoattukko'ndu: aiyaiyoa, makaa nakaramea! samuththiraththilea kappalka'laiyudaiya anaivarum iva'ludaiya uchchithamaana sampoora'naththinaal aisuvariyavaanka'laanaarka'lea! oru naazhikaiyilea iva'l paazhaayppoanaa'lea! en'ru azhuthu thukkiththu oalamiduvaarka'l.

paraloakamea! parisuththavaanka'laakiya appoasthalarka'lea! theerkkatharisika'lea! ava'laikku'riththuk ka'likoorungka'l. ungka'l nimiththam theavan ava'lai niyaayantheerththaarea! en'ru thoothan sonnaan.

appozhuthu, palamu'l'la thoothanoruvan periya eanthirakkallaiyoththa oru kallai eduththuch samuththiraththilea e'rinthu: ippadiyea paapiloan makaanakaram veakamaayth tha'l'lu'ndu, ini orupoathum kaa'nappadaama'rpoakum.

surama'ndalakkaararum, keethavaaththiyakkaararum, naakasurakkaararum, ekkaa'lakkaararumaanavarka'ludaiya saththam ini unnidaththil keadkappaduvathumillai; enthath thozhilaa'liyum ini unnidaththil kaa'nappaduvathumillai; eanthirasaththam ini unnidaththil keadkappaduvathumillai.

vi'lakkuve'lichcham ini unnidaththil pirakaasippathumillai; ma'navaa'lanum ma'navaattiyumaanavarka'ludaiya saththam ini unnidaththil keadkappaduvathumillai. un varththakar poomiyil periyoarka'laayirunthaarka'lea; un sooniyaththaal ellaa jaathika'lum moasampoanaarka'lea.
theerkkatharisika'ludaiya iraththamum parisuththavaanka'ludaiya iraththamum poomiyil kollappatta anaivarudaiya iraththamum ava'lidaththil kaa'nappattathu en'ru vi'lampinaan.

ivaika'lukkuppinpu, paraloakaththil thira'laana janakkoottam iduki'ra aaravaaraththaik keattean. avarka'l: allealooyaa, iradcha'niyamum makimaiyum kanamum vallamaiyum nammudaiya theavanaakiya karththarukkea uriyathu; avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuka'l saththiyamum neethiyumaanavaika'l.
than veasiththanaththinaal poomiyaik keduththa makaa veasikku avar niyaayaththeerppukkoduththu, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararin iraththaththi'rkaaka ava'lidaththil pazhivaangkinaarea en'raarka'l.
ma'rupadiyum avarka'l: allealooyaa en'ru solli aarppariththaarka'l. ava'ludaiya pukai en'ren'raikkum ezhumpuki'rathu en'raarka'l.
irupaththunaanku moopparka'lum, naanku jeevanka'lum va'nakkamaay vizhunthu: aamen, allealooyaa, en'ru solli, singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkum theavanaith thozhuthuko'ndaarka'l.

mealum, namathu theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaararea, avarukkup payappaduki'ra si'riyoarum periyoarumaanavarka'lea, neengka'l yaavarum avaraith thuthiyungka'l en'ru oru saththam singkaasanaththilirunthu pi'ranthathu.

appozhuthu thira'laana janangka'l idum aaravaarampoalavum, peruve'l'la iraichchalpoalavum, palaththa idimuzhakkampoalavum, oru saththamu'ndaaki: allealooyaa, sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththar raajyapaarampa'n'nuki'raar.
naam santhoashappattuk ka'likoornthu avarukkuth thuthiseluththakkadavoam. aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya kaliyaa'nam vanthathu, avarudaiya manaivi thannai aayaththampa'n'ninaa'l en'ru sollak keattean.
suththamum pirakaasamumaana melliya vasthiram thariththukko'l'lumpadi ava'lukku a'likkappattathu; antha melliya vasthiram parisuththavaanka'ludaiya neethika'lea.

pinnum, avan ennai noakki: aattukkuttiyaanavarin kaliyaa'na virunthukku azhaikkappattavarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l en'rezhuthu en'raan. mealum, ivaika'l theavanudaiya saththiyamaana vasanangka'l en'ru ennudanea sonnaan.

appozhuthu avanai va'nangkumpadi avanudaiya paathaththil vizhunthean. avan ennai noakki: ippadich seyyaathapadikkup paar; unnoadum iyeasuvaikku'riththuch saadchiyitta un sakoathararoadungkooda naanum oru oozhiyakkaaran; theavanaith thozhuthuko'l. iyeasuvaippat'rina saadchi theerkkatharisanaththin aaviyaayirukki'rathu en'raan.

pinpu, paraloakam thi'ranthirukkak ka'ndean; ithoa, oru ve'l'laikkuthirai kaa'nappattathu, athinmeal ea'riyirunthavar u'nmaiyum saththiyamumu'l'lavarennappattavar; avar neethiyaay niyaayantheerththu yuththampa'n'nuki'raar.
avarudaiya ka'nka'l akkinijuvaalaiyaippoalirunthana, avarudaiya sirasinmeal aneaka kireedangka'l irunthana; avarukkeayan'ri vea'roruvarukkun theriyaatha oru naamamum ezhuthiyirunthathu.
iraththaththil thoaykkappatta vasthiraththaith thariththirunthaar; avarudaiya naamam theavanudaiya vaarththai enpathea.
paraloakaththilu'l'la seanaika'l ve'nmaiyum suththamumaana melliya vasthiran thariththavarka'laay, ve'l'laikkuthiraika'linmeal ea'ri, avarukkup pinsen'raarka'l.

pu'rajaathika'lai vettumpadikku avarudaiya vaayilirunthu koormaiyaana pattayam pu'rappaduki'rathu; iruppukkoalaal avarka'lai arasaa'luvaar; avar sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanudaiya ukkirakoapamaakiya mathuvu'l'la aalaiyai mithikki'raar.
raajaathi raajaa, karththaathi karththaa ennum naamam avarudaiya vasthiraththinmealum avarudaiya thodaiyinmealum ezhuthappattirunthathu.
pinpu oru thoothan sooriyanil ni'rkakka'ndean; avan vaanaththin maththiyil pa'rakki'ra sakala pa'ravaika'laiyum paarththu:

neengka'l raajaakka'lin maamsaththaiyum, seanaiththalaivarka'lin maamsaththaiyum, palavaanka'lin maamsaththaiyum, kuthiraika'lin maamsaththaiyum, avaika'linmeal ea'riyirukki'ravarka'lin maamsaththaiyum, suyaatheenar adimaika'l, si'riyoar periyoar, ivarka'lellaarudaiya maamsaththaiyum padchikkumpadikku, makaa theavan kodukkum virunthukkuk koodivaarungka'l en'ru mikuntha saththaththoadea kooppittaan.
pinpu, mirukamum poomiyin raajaakka'lum avarka'ludaiya seanaika'lum, kuthiraiyinmeal ea'riyirukki'ravaroadum avarudaiya seanaiyoadum yuththampa'n'numpadikkuk koodivarakka'ndean.

appozhuthu mirukam pidikkappattathu; mirukaththinmunpaakach seytha a'rputhangka'laal athin muththiraiyaith thariththavarka'laiyum athin soroopaththai va'nangkinavarka'laiyum moasampoakkina ka'l'laththeerkkatharisiyungkoodap pidikkappattaan; iruvarum kanthakam eriki'ra akkinikkadalilea uyiroadea tha'l'lappattaarka'l.
mat'ravarka'l kuthiraiyinmeal ea'rinavarudaiya vaayilirunthu pu'rappaduki'ra pattayaththaal kollappattaarka'l; avarka'ludaiya maamsaththinaal pa'ravaika'l yaavum thirupthiyadainthana.
oru thoothan paathaa'laththin thi'ravukoalaiyum periya sangkiliyaiyum than kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu vaanaththilirunthi'rangki varakka'ndean.

pisaasen'rum saaththaanen'rum sollappatta pazhaiya paampaakiya valusarppaththai avan pidiththu, athai aayiram varushama'lavung kattivaiththu, antha aayiram varusham ni'raivea'rumvaraikkum athu janangka'lai moasampoakkaathapadikku athaip paathaa'laththilea tha'l'liyadaiththu, athinmeal muththiraipoattaan.
atha'rkup pinpu athu kognchakkaalam viduthalaiyaakavea'ndum.

an'riyum, naan singkaasanangka'laik ka'ndean; avaika'linmeal udkaarnthaarka'l; niyaayaththeerppuk kodukkumpadi avarka'lukku athikaaram a'likkappattathu. iyeasuvaippat'riya saadchiyinimiththamum theavanudaiya vasanaththinimiththamum sirachseathampa'n'nappattavarka'ludaiya aaththumaakka'laiyum, mirukaththaiyaavathu athin soroopaththaiyaavathu va'nangkaamalum thangka'l net'riyilum thangka'l kaiyilum athin muththiraiyaith thariththukko'l'laamalum irunthavarka'laiyum ka'ndean. avarka'l uyirththuk ki'risthuvudaneakooda aayiram varusham arasaa'ndaarka'l.
mara'namadaintha mat'ravarka'l antha aayiram varusham mudiyuma'lavum uyiradaiyavillai. ithuvea muthalaam uyirththezhuthal.

muthalaam uyirththezhuthalukkup pangku'l'lavan paakkiyavaanum parisuththavaanumaayirukki'raan; ivarka'lmeal ira'ndaam mara'naththi'rku athikaaramillai; ivarka'l theavanukkum ki'risthuvukkum munpaaka aasaariyaraayirunthu, avaroadeakooda aayiram varusham arasaa'luvaarka'l.
antha aayiram varusham mudiyumpoathu saaththaan than kaavalilirunthu viduthalaiyaaki,

poomiyin naanku thisaika'lilumu'l'la jaathika'laakiya koakaiyum maakoakaiyum moasampoakkumpadikkum, avarka'lai yuththaththi'rkuk koottikko'l'lumpadikkum pu'rappaduvaan; avarka'ludaiya thokai kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanaiyaayirukkum.

avarka'l poomiyengkum parampi, parisuththavaanka'ludaiya paa'laiyaththaiyum, piriyamaana nakaraththaiyum va'lainthuko'ndaarka'l; appozhuthu theavanaal vaanaththilirunthu akkini i'rangki avarka'laip padchiththuppoattathu.

mealum avarka'lai moasampoakkina pisaasaanavan, mirukamum ka'l'laththeerkkatharisiyumirukki'ra idamaakiya akkiniyum kanthakamumaana kadalilea tha'l'lappattaan. avarka'l iravum pakalum sathaakaalangka'lilum vaathikkappaduvaarka'l.
pinpu, naan periya ve'l'laich singkaasanaththaiyum athinmeal veet'rirukki'ravaraiyum ka'ndean; avarudaiya samukaththilirunthu poomiyum vaanamum akan'rupoayina; avaika'lukku idangkaa'nappadavillai.

mariththoaraakiya si'riyoaraiyum periyoaraiyum theavanukkumunpaaka ni'rkakka'ndean; appozhuthu pusthakangka'l thi'rakkappattana; jeevapusthakam ennum vea'roru pusthakamum thi'rakkappattathu; appozhuthu anthap pusthakangka'lil ezhuthappattavaika'linpadiyea mariththoar thangka'l thangka'l kiriyaika'lukkuththakkathaaka niyaayaththeerppadainthaarka'l.

samuththiram thannilu'l'la mariththoarai oppuviththathu; mara'namum paathaa'lamum thangka'lilu'l'la mariththoarai oppuviththana. yaavarum thangka'l thangka'l kiriyaika'linpadiyea niyaayaththeerppadainthaarka'l.
appozhuthu mara'namum paathaa'lamum akkinikkadalilea tha'l'lappattana. ithu ira'ndaam mara'nam.
jeevapusthakaththilea ezhuthappattavanaakak kaa'nappadaathavanevanoa avan akkinikkadalilea tha'l'lappattaan.
pinpu, naan puthiya vaanaththaiyum puthiya poomiyaiyum ka'ndean; munthina vaanamum munthina poomiyum ozhinthupoayina; samuththiramum illaama'rpoayit'ru.

yoavaanaakiya naan, puthiya erusaleamaakiya parisuththa nakaraththaith theavanidaththinin'ru paraloakaththaivittu i'rangki varakka'ndean; athu than purushanukkaaka alangkarikkappatta ma'navaattiyaippoala aayaththamaakkappattirunthathu.

mealum, paraloakaththilirunthu u'ndaana oru perugnsaththaththaik keattean; athu: ithoa, manusharka'lidaththilea theavanudaiya vaasasthalamirukki'rathu, avarka'lidaththilea avar vaasamaayiruppaar; avarka'lum avarudaiya janangka'laayiruppaarka'l, theavanthaamea avarka'loadeakooda irunthu avarka'ludaiya theavanaayiruppaar.
avarka'ludaiya ka'n'neer yaavaiyum theavan thudaippaar; ini mara'namumillai, thukkamumillai, ala'ruthalumillai, varuththamumillai; munthinavaika'l ozhinthupoayina en'ru vi'lampinathu.
singkaasanaththinmeal veet'rirunthavar: ithoa, naan sakalaththaiyum puthithaakkuki'rean en'raar. pinnum, avar: intha vasanangka'l saththiyamum u'nmaiyumaanavaika'l, ivaika'lai ezhuthu en'raar.
an'riyum, avar ennai noakki: aayit'ru, naan alpaavum oamekaavum, aathiyum anthamumaayirukki'rean. thaakamaayirukki'ravanukku naan jeevaththa'n'neeroot'ril ilavasamaayk koduppean.
jeyangko'l'luki'ravan ellaavat'raiyum suthanthariththukko'l'luvaan; naan avan theavanaayiruppean, avan en kumaaranaayiruppaan.

payappaduki'ravarka'lum, avisuvaasika'lum, aruvaruppaanavarka'lum, kolaipaathakarum, vipasaarakkaararum, sooniyakkaararum, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaararum, poyyar anaivarum ira'ndaam mara'namaakiya akkiniyum kanthakamum eriki'ra kadalilea pangkadaivaarka'l en'raar.

pinpu, kadaisiyaana eazhu vaathaika'laal ni'raintha eazhu kalasangka'laiyudaiya antha eazhu thootharil oruvan ennidaththil vanthu: nee ingkea vaa, aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya manaiviyaakiya ma'navaattiyai unakkuk kaa'npikki'rean en'ru solli,

perithum uyaramumaana oru parvathaththinmeal ennai aaviyil ko'ndupoay, theavanudaiya makimaiyai adaintha erusaleamaakiya parisuththanakaram paraloakaththaivittuth theavanidaththilirunthu i'rangkivaruki'rathai enakkuk kaa'npiththaan.
athin pirakaasam mikavum vilaiyuyarntha iraththinakkallaippoalavum, pa'lingkino'liyu'l'la vachchirakkallaippoalavum irunthathu.
atha'rkup perithum uyaramumaana mathilum, kizhakkea moon'ru vaasalka'l, vadakkea moon'ru vaasalka'l, the'rkea moon'ru vaasalka'l, mea'rkea moon'ru vaasalka'l aakap pannira'ndu vaasalka'lum irunthana.
vaasalka'lin arukea pannira'ndu thootharka'lirunthaarka'l; antha vaasalka'linmeal israveal santhathiyaaraakiya pannira'ndu koaththiraththaarudaiya naamangka'lum ezhuthappattirunthana.
nakaraththin mathilukkup pannira'ndu asthipaarak ka'rka'lirunthana; avaika'lmeal aattukkuttiyaanavarudaiya pannira'ndu appoasthalarin pannira'ndu naamangka'lum pathinthirunthana.
ennudanea peasinavan, nakaraththaiyum athin vaasalka'laiyum athin mathilaiyum a'lakki'ratha'rku oru po'rkoalaip pidiththirunthaan.

antha nakaram sathuramaayirunthathu, athin akalamum nee'lamum samamaayirunthathu. avan anthak koalinaal nakaraththai a'lanthaan; athu panneeraayiram sthaathi a'lavaayirunthathu; athin nee'lamum akalamum uyaramum samamaayirunthathu.
avan athin mathilai a'lanthapoathu, athu thoothanudaiya a'lavaakiya manusha a'lavinpadiyea noot'runaa'rpaththunaanku muzhamaayirunthathu.
athin mathil vachchirakkallaal kattappattirunthathu; nakaram the'lintha pa'lingkukku oppaana suththapponnaayirunthathu.

nakaraththu mathilka'lin asthipaarangka'l sakalavitha iraththinangka'linaalum alangkarikkappattirunthana; muthalaam asthipaaram vachchirakkal, ira'ndaavathu inthiraneelam, moon'raavathu santhirakaantham, naankaavathu marakatham,

ainthaavathu koameathakam, aa'raavathu pathumaraakam, eazhaavathu suvar'naraththinam, ettaavathu padikappachchai, onpathaavathu pushparaakam, paththaavathu vaidooriyam, pathinoaraavathu suneeram, pannira'ndaavathu sukanthi ivaika'lea.
pannira'ndu vaasalka'lum pannira'ndu muththukka'laayirunthana; ovvoru vaasalum ovvoru muththaayirunthathu. nakaraththin veethi the'livu'l'la pa'lingkupoalach suththapponnaayirunthathu.
athilea theavaalayaththai naan kaa'navillai; sarvavallamaiyu'l'la theavanaakiya karththarum aattukkuttiyaanavarumea atha'rku aalayam.
nakaraththi'rku ve'lichchangkodukkach sooriyanum santhiranum atha'rku vea'nduvathillai; theavanudaiya makimaiyea athaip pirakaasippiththathu, aattukkuttiyaanavarea atha'rku vi'lakku.
iradchikkappaduki'ra janangka'l athin ve'lichchaththilea nadappaarka'l. poomiyin raajaakka'l thangka'l makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum atha'rku'l'lea ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.
angkea iraakkaalam illaathapadiyaal, athin vaasalka'l pakalil adaikkappaduvathea illai.
ulakaththaarudaiya makimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum atha'rku'l'lea ko'nduvaruvaarka'l.

theettu'l'lathum aruvaruppaiyum poyyaiyum nadappikki'rathumaakiya on'rum athil piraveasippathillai; aattukkuttiyaanavarin jeevapusthakaththil ezhuthappattavarka'l maaththiram athil piraveasippaarka'l.
pinpu, pa'lingkaippoal the'livaana jeevaththa'n'neeru'l'la suththamaana nathi theavanum aattukkuttiyaanavarum irukki'ra singkaasanaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvaruki'rathai enakkuk kaa'npiththaan.

nakaraththu veethiyin maththiyilum, nathiyin irukaraiyilum, pannira'nduvithamaana kanika'laiththarum jeevavirudcham irunthathu, athu maathanthoa'rum than kaniyaik kodukkum; antha virudchaththin ilaika'l janangka'l aaroakkiyamadaiki'ratha'rku eathuvaanavaika'l.
ini oru saapamumiraathu. theavanum aattukkuttiyaanavarum irukki'ra singkaasanam athilirukkum.
avarudaiya oozhiyakkaarar avaraich seaviththu, avarudaiya samukaththaith tharisippaarka'l; avarudaiya naamam avarka'ludaiya net'rika'lil irukkum.

angkea iraakkaalamiraathu; vi'lakkum sooriyanudaiya ve'lichchamum avarka'lukku vea'nduvathillai; theavanaakiya karththarea avarka'lmeal pirakaasippaar. avarka'l sathaakaalangka'lilum arasaa'luvaarka'l.

pinpu, avar ennai noakki: intha vasanangka'l u'nmaiyum saththiyamumaanavaika'l. seekkiramaaych sampavikkavea'ndiyavaika'laith thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararukkuk kaa'npikkumporuttu, parisuththa theerkkatharisika'lin karththaraakiya theavanaanavar thammudaiya thoothanai anuppinaar.
ithoa, seekkiramaay varuki'rean; inthap pusthakaththilu'l'la theerkkatharisana vasanangka'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravan paakkiyavaan en'raar.
yoavaanaakiya naanea ivaika'laik ka'ndum keattum irunthean. naan keattuk ka'ndapoathu, ivaika'lai enakkuk kaa'npiththa thoothanai va'nangkumpadi avan paathaththil vizhunthean.

atha'rku avan: nee ippadich seyyaathapadikkup paar; unnoadum un sakoathararoadum theerkkatharisika'loadum, inthap pusthakaththin vasanangka'laik kaikko'l'luki'ravarka'loadungkooda naanum oru oozhiyakkaaran; theavanaith thozhuthuko'l en'raan.
pinnum, avar ennai noakki: inthap pusthakaththilu'l'la theerkkatharisana vasanangka'lai muththiraipoadavea'ndaam; kaalam sameepamaayirukki'rathu.
aniyaayagnseyki'ravan innum aniyaayagnseyyattum; asuththamaayirukki'ravan innum asuththamaayirukkattum; neethiyu'l'lavan innum neethiseyyattum; parisuththamu'l'lavan innum parisuththamaakattum.
ithoa, seekkiramaay varuki'rean; avanavanudaiya kiriyaika'linpadi avanavanukku naan a'likkum palan ennoadeakooda varuki'rathu.
naan alpaavum oamekaavum, aathiyum anthamum, munthinavarum pinthinavarumaayirukki'rean.
jeevavirudchaththinmeal athikaaramu'l'lavarka'laavatha'rkum, vaasalka'l vazhiyaay nakaraththi'rku'l piraveasippatha'rkum avarudaiya ka'rpanaika'linpadi seyki'ravarka'l paakkiyavaanka'l.
naayka'lum, sooniyakkaararum, vipasaarakkaararum, kolaipaathakarum, vikkirakaaraathanaikkaararum, poyyai virumpi athinpadi seyki'ra yaavarum pu'rampea iruppaarka'l.

sapaika'lil ivaika'lai ungka'lukkuch saadchiyaaka a'rivikkumpadikku iyeasuvaakiya naan en thoothanai anuppinean. naan thaaveethin vearum santhathiyum, pirakaasamu'l'la vidive'l'li nadchaththiramumaayirukki'rean en'raar.
aaviyum ma'navaattiyum vaa enki'raarka'l; keadki'ravanum vaa enpaanaaka; thaakamaayirukki'ravan varakkadavan; viruppamu'l'lavan jeevaththa'n'neerai ilavasamaay vaangkikko'l'lakkadavan.

inthap pusthakaththilu'l'la theerkkatharisana vasanangka'laik keadki'ra yaavarukkum naan saadchiyaaka echcharikki'rathaavathu: oruvan ivaika'loadea ethaiyaakilum koottinaal, inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthiyirukki'ra vaathaika'lai theavan avanmeal koottuvaar.

oruvan inthath theerkkatharisana pusthakaththin vasanangka'lilirunthu ethaiyaakilum eduththuppoattaal, jeevapusthakaththilirunthum, parisuththa nakaraththilirunthum, inthap pusthakaththil ezhuthappattavaika'lilirunthum, avanudaiya pangkai theavan eduththuppoaduvaar.
ivaika'laich saadchiyaaka a'rivikki'ravar: meyyaakavea naan seekkiramaay varuki'rean enki'raar. aamen, karththaraakiya iyeasuvea, vaarum.
nammudaiya karththaraakiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirupai ungka'l anaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaka. aamen.
